column1: Devil's Breath was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: 恶魔之息是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中灭亡。ZH

column1: Devil's Rock is a more habitable place than its name implies; it was a bustling trade hub during the peak of the Star League. While its prosperity has declined somewhat since, it still features bustling ports and a thriving black market.
column2: 恶魔岩比它名字听起来更宜居；在星盟鼎盛时期它曾是一个繁忙的贸易枢纽。虽然其繁荣此后有所衰退，它仍拥有热闹的港口和兴旺的黑市。ZH

column1: Devin was host to a massive Star League era battle where upon numerous warships crashed into the surface of the world, littering it with wreckage. Now known as the 'Boneyard', this salvage site is home to numerous salvagers.
column2: 德文曾是一场星盟时代大规模战役的战场，当时众多战舰坠毁在该行星表面，遍地残骸。如今被称为"骸骨场"的这处打捞地是众多打捞者的家园。ZH

column1: Deweidewd was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Deweidewd在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: DeWitt is a heavily guarded system, with a large training academy for Commonwealth personnel.
column2: DeWitt是一个戒备森严的星系，设有一所面向共同体人员的大型训练学院.

column1: Dhaulgiri was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Dhaulgiri是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Named for the massive diamond reserves found near the surface, Diamantia is ran by what equates to a Cartel.
column2: Diamantia因在靠近地表处发现的大量钻石储量而得名，由相当于卡特尔的组织管理.

column1: The hot surface of Diass requires all colonists to wear environmental suits when outside the colony enclosure, however it does allow easy access to rare chemicals.
column2: Diass炽热的地表要求所有殖民者在殖民地围栏之外时必须穿着环境防护服，不过这也使得获取稀有化学品变得容易.

column1: The Federated Suns took Diboll as a protectorate to protect them from the SLDF in the Reunification War. Rich with valuable water, Diboll's economy relies on the purification and shipping of many billions of litres every year.
column2: 联邦太阳在统一战争期间把迪博尔收为保护国，以保护他们免受SLDF侵害。迪博尔拥有宝贵的水资源，其经济依赖于每年净化并外运数十亿升水。ZH

column1: Dicallus is home to a branch of Bowie Industries, the premium manufacturer of the Gabriel hovercraft. Almost every industry on Dicallus exists thanks to Bowie.
column2: Dicallus是Bowie Industries一家分部的所在地，而Bowie Industries是Gabriel气垫船的顶级制造商. Dicallus上几乎每一个产业都因Bowie而存在.

column1: Dichell was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Dichell是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Dickinson is known amongst many pilots for its dangerous approach - Wind speeds can reach 1,800 km/h in the upper atmosphere
column2: 迪金森在许多机师中以其危险的进近著称——高层大气中的风速可达1,800公里/小时

column1: Once a pleasant Terran world, Dicon's climate was disastrously ruined by strip-mining of metals from its crust. Mining operations still continue, though there is little of value left to extract from the impoverished planet.
column2: 迪康曾是一颗宜人的类地世界，其气候因地表金属被露天开采而灾难性地毁坏。采矿作业仍在继续，尽管这颗贫瘠的行星上已几乎没有什么值得开采的东西。ZH

column1: Originally an independent world, Diefenbaker was one of the planets offered membership in the Taurian Concordat, which they accepted. The world has since been conquered by Davion, but the people still have a streak of fierce independence.
column2: 迪芬贝克最初是一个独立的星球，得到了金牛协约国的加入邀请，而他们接受了. 这颗星球后来被戴维恩所征服，但人民依然具有强烈的独立倾向.

column1: Die Moot is home to the Federated Judicial Academy, one of the premium academies for lawyers in the Inner Sphere.
column2: Die Moot是联邦司法学院的所在地，该学院是内天体顶尖的律师学院之一.

column1: Dieron is a mountainous planet with significant mining and manufacturing industries. It was been an important world for centuries; serving as an administrative center for the Star League before serving the same role in the Draconis Combine.
column2: Dieron是一颗多山的行星，拥有重要的采矿业和制造业. 数个世纪以来，它一直是一个重要世界；它曾是星际联盟的行政中心，之后又在天龙联合体中担任同样的角色.

column1: Dieudonné was colonised due to extensive mineral wealth and readily available native lifeforms that were tasty and nutritious. It was devastated in the Amaris Civil War however, which killed most of the native wildlife.
column2: Dieudonné 之所以被殖民，是因为其拥有丰富的矿产资源，且当地存在大量美味又营养的本地生命体. 然而，它在阿马里斯内战中遭到严重破坏，大部分本土野生动物因此死亡.

column1: Dì-fang was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Dì-fang在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Recently settled after the Fourth Succession War, Diik is a small black market colony set up amongst a large irrigated desert.
column2: Diik是在第四次继承战争结束后不久才有人定居的，它是一个建立在一片广阔灌溉沙漠中的小型黑市殖民地.

column1: Dijonne (Pain 3050+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Dijonne（Pain 3050+）是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Dili was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Dili是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Distrustful of the Inner Sphere ever since their cities were massacred in the Reunification War, Dindatari maintains good relations with nearby Outworlds Alliance members.
column2: 自从其城市在统一战争中遭到血洗以来，Dindatari一直对内天体心存疑虑，但与附近的外世界联盟成员保持着良好关系.

column1: A barren world with a breathable nitrogen/oxygen atmosphere. There are no continents, but there are several small seas and lakes.
column2: 一颗贫瘠的世界，拥有可呼吸的氮氧大气。那里没有大陆，但有几个小海与湖泊。ZH

column1: Dirkel was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Dirkel于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Dirk's Gulf was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: 德克湾是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中灭亡。ZH

column1: A warm world filled with wildlife, Dixie is home to numerous abandoned Castle Brian's and emptied SLDF caches.
column2: 作为一颗充满野生动植物的温暖行星，迪克西拥有众多被废弃的布莱恩堡和被搬空的SLDF储藏库。ZH

column1: Dneiper is home to a large academy for the AMC, where trainees from nearby worlds can train with the latest Periphery equipment.
column2: Dneiper拥有一所大型的AMC学院，来自附近星球的学员可以在这里使用最新的边陲装备进行训练.

column1: The Dnepropetrovsk system was colonized during the First Exodus from Terra, was co-opted into the Alliance of Galedon, and then the Draconis Combine prior to the Age of War.
column2: Dnepropetrovsk星系在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间被殖民，先被纳入加勒顿联盟，随后在战争时代之前被纳入天龙联合体.

column1: Dobson is home to a vast rainforest covering much of the planets surface. Historic records show Star League training facilities somewhere on the planet, but they appear lost to the undergrowth.
column2: Dobson拥有覆盖该行星表面大部分区域的广袤雨林. 历史记录显示，星际联盟的训练设施曾位于该行星某处，但它们似乎已湮没在林下植被中.

column1: Doggerbank is a jump point located in the anti-spinward region of the Deep Periphery. The closest inhabitable system is over 110 light years away.
column2: Doggerbank是位于深空外围反旋向区域的一个跃迁点. 最近的可居住星系在超过 110 光年之外.

column1: Dol was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Dol在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Domain is a world of rolling plains and steppes, filled with large ranches containing vast herds of animals.
column2: Domain是一个由起伏的平原和草原构成的世界，遍布着大型牧场，牧场里饲养着庞大的兽群.

column1: Domeyko was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Domeyko是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: Dompaire has a few Star League boreholes that are still in operation that brings rare materials to the surface.
column2: Dompaire拥有几个仍在运作的星际联盟钻孔，这些钻孔将稀有材料带到地表.

column1: Orbiting above Donegal IV there are 2 space settlements known as \"The Tin Cans\", which as well developed as the planet below. 3 continents: Dunellan, Hinterlands and Lockenar. Capital: Marsdenville. Twenty-fourth Lyran Guards are living there.
column2: 多尼戈尔IV轨道上方有两处名为“锡罐”的太空定居点，其发达程度与下方星球相当。三大洲：邓内兰、腹地与洛克纳。首府：马斯登维尔。第24莱兰卫队驻扎在那里。ZH

column1: Donenac is home to numerous biomedical companies that located to the surface after a massive outbreak of the Chelosian virus last century.
column2: Donenac是众多生物医学公司的所在地，这些公司在上世纪切洛西亚病毒大规模爆发后迁至地表.

column1: A small industrialised colony, it is however home to the Meistmorn Academy, a premium MechWarrior training centre.
column2: 这是一个小型工业化殖民地，但却是Meistmorn学院的所在地——一所顶尖的机甲战士训练中心.

column1: Dorian's Tears is a significant astronomical feature in the anti-spinward Deep Periphery, though the system itself is unremarkable.
column2: 多里安之泪是反自转方向纵深外围中一处重要的天文特征，尽管该星系本身平平无奇。ZH

column1: Recently colonised thanks to its vast agricultural lands, Dormandaine is quickly establishing itself as a premium exporter of meat products.
column2: 得益于其广袤的农业用地，Dormandaine最近才被殖民，并正迅速成为优质肉类产品的出口地.

column1: Dorpat is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League, exporting goods to other Hanseatic worlds.
column2: Dorpat是构成被称为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家的星球之一，向其他汉萨同盟星球出口货物.

column1: Dortmund is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League, exporting goods to other Hanseatic worlds.
column2: Dortmund是构成被称为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家一部分的星球之一，向其他汉萨世界出口商品.

column1: Vast underground caverns are where the majority of the population of Dothan live, as the surface is inhospitable.
column2: 广阔的地下洞穴是Dothan大部分人口居住的地方，因为地表不宜居住.

column1: Dove was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Dove在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某一时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: The surface of Dover has been host to a number of institutes of higher learning as well as a number of significant industrial concerns, while the Dover Shipyards operates in low orbit above the surface of the planet.
column2: Dover的表面一直是许多高等教育机构以及若干重要工业企业的所在地，而Dover造船厂则在行星表面上方低轨道运行.

column1: Dowles was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Dowles在统一战争结束后的某个时候于星际联盟时代被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Drachenfeld is located in the spinward region of the Deep Periphery, with the closest inhabited system over a hundred light years away.
column2: Drachenfeld位于深空外围的旋臂区域，距离最近有人居住的星系超过一百光年.

column1: Dralkig was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Dralkig在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战乱中消亡了.

column1: Settled by a band of pirates and their families during the Third Succession War, this small world offers treasures and other delights not for sale on civilized worlds.
column2: 第三次继承战争期间，一群海盗及其家人在此定居；这个小小的世界提供着文明世界上买不到的珍宝和其他享乐.

column1: Dreadlord was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Dreadlord在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡.

column1: Dresden was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Dresden在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: Whilst the surface of Dienfontein is inhospitable, underground caves and rifts allow a large population to eke out a living.
column2: 尽管Dienfontein的地表不宜居住，但地下洞穴和裂隙让大量人口得以勉强维生.

column1: Dromini VI's location on the Lyran/Kuritan border has made it a frequent base for and target of units launching raids across the border. Ownership changed 3 times in 3029-3030 alone, though House Kurita has retained control since.
column2: 德罗米尼VI位于莱兰与库瑞塔边界，这使它常成为跨境袭掠部队的基地与目标。仅3029至3030年间，其归属就三度易手，不过此后库瑞塔家族一直保有控制权。ZH

column1: Drosendorf supports nearby such as Zvolen thanks to its rich and fertile soils.
column2: 得益于其肥沃的土壤，Drosendorf为附近的Zvolen等地提供支持.

column1: A teeming agricultural world, Drozan is critical to Capellan food supply, and features massive urban centers, research facilities and food laboratories. The vast automated fields and fisheries are protected by elite Capellan Warrior House troops.
column2: 德罗赞是一个拥挤的农业星球，对卡佩拉人的食品供应很重要，它的特点是巨大的市中心区，研究设施和食品实验室. 巨大的自动化农田和渔场由精锐的卡佩拉勇士世家部队保护.

column1: Drusibacken is a self sufficient colony with a light industrial base, mining petroleum products from deep within the rainforests.
column2: Drusibacken是一个自给自足的殖民地，拥有轻工业基础，从雨林深处开采石油产品.

column1: Duantia was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Duantia在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Located in a binary system, Dubhe is famous for its periodic 'super summers' when the normal hot season lines up with a relatively close approach to the systems secondary star.
column2: 杜贝位于一个双星系统中，以其周期性的"超级夏天"闻名，那时正常的热季会与相对靠近该系统次星的时间重合。ZH

column1: The high gravity on Dukambia restricted plant growth until local scientists uncovered inverted farming methods, utilising the gravity to improve yields.
column2: Dukambia的高重力限制了植物生长，直到当地科学家发现了倒置农业法，利用重力来提高产量.

column1: Du Lac was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Du Lac于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The vast amounts of sunlight available on Dumaring allow for large amounts of photosynthesis amongst the vegetation, which has adapted to the high temperatures.
column2: Dumaring上充足的日照使植被能够进行大量光合作用，这些植被已经适应了高温.

column1: Dumassas was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Dumassas在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: The industrial world of Dunianshire, home to the Majesty Metals corporation, is choked by pollution and the sulfurous by-products of heavy industry. The majority of the population lives in the city of Londinium, where breathing filters are required to go outdoors.
column2: 工业星球杜尼安郡，威严金属公司的总部，充斥着重工业的污染物和含硫副产品. 大多数人口居住在朗蒂尼亚姆城，在那儿需要戴呼吸过滤器才能出门.

column1: Dunkerque was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Dunkerque在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Durabon was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Durabon是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Duran is a dry world, filled with dangerous sandstorms. It's rich mineral base allows it to import the food it needs from nearby worlds.
column2: 杜兰是一颗干燥的世界，遍布危险的沙暴。它丰富的矿产基础使其能从附近星系进口所需粮食。ZH

column1: \"Where the elite meet, greet, and satisfy their most wicked desires\" is the slogan of Dustball, an inhospitable world that is vastly wealthy thanks to its pleasure palaces.
column2: “精英在此相聚、相交，并满足自己最邪恶的欲望”——这是“尘球”的宣传语。这颗环境严酷的星球因其享乐宫殿而极为富有。ZH

column1: Duxford was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Duxford在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Duxfort was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Duxfort在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Though water is scarce on Dyev's surface, settlers uncovered an underground freshwater sea early in the planet's history. This supply of freshwater allows the planet to feed itself, while the productive mines on the planet drive its economy.
column2: 虽然迪耶夫地表缺水，但定居者在该星球历史早期就发现了一片地下淡水海。这份淡水供应让星球能养活自己，而星球上高产的矿场则驱动其经济。ZH

column1: A mountainous world with heavy rainfall and fertile soils, Dyfed was home to a Castle Brian during the Star League era - the location of which has been lost to time.
column2: Dyfed是一个多山、降雨充沛且土壤肥沃的星球，在星际联盟时代曾是布莱恩城堡的所在地——其位置已随时间流逝而失传.

column1: Eagle Rest was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Eagle Rest是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期建立的殖民地，但在继承战争期间的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Eaglesham is known for its large oasis spread throughout the deserts, which are surrounded by fertile land.
column2: Eaglesham以遍布沙漠的大型绿洲而闻名，这些沙漠被肥沃的土地环绕.

column1: Early Dawn was conquered by the SLDF during the Reunification War. It returned to Magistracy control after the war ended, and is now dedicated to fishing and farming. The home office of Magliss Spirits, the leading producer of wine and brandy in the Periphery, is located here.
column2: 在统一战争期间，厄利道恩被星际联盟防卫军征服. 战争结束后，它回归了自治区控制，现在它专注于渔业和农业. 外围一流的葡萄酒和白兰地生产商马格利斯烈酒公司，它的总公司就设在这儿.

column1: Early Dawn
column2: 厄利道恩

column1: The Eaton system was colonised during the early twenty-fourth century and was an independent system prior to being incorporated into the Lyran Commonwealth at some point during or shortly before the Age of War. Pro-Skye Separatists' second home.
column2: 伊顿星系在二十四世纪初被殖民，在被并入莱兰联邦之前是一个独立星系，并入时间在战火时代期间或稍早。它是亲斯凯分离主义者的第二家园。ZH

column1: All lakes and seas on Ebensburg are covered with a thick layer of algae. Some simple animal species feed on the algae, and their habitat is limited to within a few miles of the coast.
column2: Ebensburg上的所有湖泊和海洋都覆盖着一层厚厚的藻类. 一些简单的动物物种以这些藻类为食，它们的栖息地仅限于海岸几英里范围内.

column1: A very rural world with little resources, the population of Ebro has little contact with the rest of the galaxy.
column2: 一个非常乡村化的世界，资源匮乏，Ebro的居民与银河系其他地方几乎没有什么联系.

column1: Death is like the insect   Menacing the tree,   Competent to kill it,   But decoyed may be.     Bait it with the balsam,   Seek it with the saw,   Baffle, if it cost you   Everything you are.     Then, if it have burrowed   Out of reach of skill,   Wring the tree and leave it,   'Tis the vermin's will.'     - Emily Dickinson, ancient Terran poet
column2: 死亡如同昆虫 威胁着树木，足以杀死它，却也可被诱走。用香脂引诱它，用锯子寻找它，挫败它，哪怕要你付出 你所有的一切。然后，若它已钻入 技艺够不到的深处，绞紧树木然后离开它，那便是这虫豸的意愿。'  - 艾米莉·狄金森，古类地诗人

column1: High from the void above,   Entropy shall claim all,     Inside our quiet reflections,  Serenity rules.     Call upon the loyal and,   Out we rage against the void.   May the truthful word rise,   Infinite and immovable.   None stand before us,   Greatness will prevail.'     - Last broadcast from DropShip Arlund's Pike II prior to loss of contact
column2: 自上方虚空高处，熵将吞没一切，在我们静谧的沉思之中，宁静主宰。召唤忠诚者，我们向虚空怒吼。愿真言升起，无穷而不可动摇。无人能立于我们之前，伟大必将胜出。”——失联前来自空投艇阿伦德的派克II号的最后广播

column1: WARNING: Travel advisory is in effect. This system is occupied by extremely hostile and well-armed pirate elements that have refused peaceful contact and will engage passerby with lethal force. Captains are advised to plot routes around this system under any circumstances.
column2: 警告: 旅行警告已生效. 此星系被极端敌对且装备精良的海盗势力占据，他们拒绝和平接触，并会以致命武力攻击过往者. 建议舰长在任何情况下都规划绕开此星系的航线.

column1: The greatest gift the common people can have is a heart too large to falter and a mind to small to regret.' - Unknown
column2: '平民能拥有的最大礼物，是一颗大得不会动摇的心，和一个小得不会后悔的头脑。'——佚名

column1: Core sampling from the Southern polar surface revealed fragments of manufactured alloys. We must note that there is no record of the world ever being settled, nor any orbital conflicts that would have scattered debris onto the surface. The samples were also found to be microscopic in size and prevalent in the planetary crust, a characteristic more in line with the outcomes of manufacturing pollution than debris fall. We strongly urge an in-depth survey of the world prior to any colonisation efforts.'    - Preliminary survey report, unsealed by orders of General Vilma Alekto
column2: 对南极地表的岩芯取样发现了人造合金碎片。我们必须指出，没有任何记录显示该世界曾被殖民，也没有任何轨道冲突会把残骸散落至地表。样本还被发现尺寸极微且遍布行星地壳，这一特征更符合制造业污染的结果而非残骸坠落。我们强烈建议在着手任何殖民之前对该世界进行深入勘测。'  - 初步勘测报告，经维尔玛·阿莱克托将军下令解封

column1: When this blazing sun is gone,   When he nothing shines upon,   Then you show your little light,   Twinkle, twinkle, through the night.     Then the traveller in the dark   Thanks you for your tiny spark;   He could not see where to go,   If you did not twinkle so.      - Ancient traveler's prayer
column2: 当这颗炽烈的太阳消失，当他不再照耀任何事物，那时你便显出微光，一闪一闪，照亮整夜。黑暗中的旅人于是 感谢你小小的火花；若你不曾如此闪烁，他便不知该往何处去。——古旅人祷词

column1: Primitives residing in their conclaves on the plains fear to venture into the Old Canyons. On the eve each twin moonrise, the conclave elders retell their story of The Lashing, or their exile from those canyons. The details and precise wording have changed over time. Even the title differs from kinship to kinship, be it 'Worza's Lament', 'The Dawn of Knives', or 'Downfall'. No matter the small details of this fable, its central theme has never faltered: retribution.
column2: 居住在平原上各聚居区的原始人不敢冒险进入老峡谷。每至双月升起的夜晚，聚居区的长老们都会讲述他们关于"鞭笞"的故事——也就是他们被逐出那些峡谷的往事。细节与具体的措辞随时间而变。连标题在不同血缘间也各不相同，或叫《沃尔扎的哀叹》，或叫《刀锋黎明》，或叫《陨落》。无论这则寓言的小节如何变化，其核心主题从未动摇：报复。ZH

column1: '     - Fragmented, intercepted transmission, unknown source. Filed as evidence in Case 5579-124b, House Liao v. Tsang
column2: '   - 断裂的截获通讯，来源不明。作为证据归档于案件5579-124b，廖家族诉曾氏

column1: The role of the explorer is not simply the charting of unknown territories, for that is aimless wandering with extra expense. The great explorer ventures out in the interests of something bolder and larger themselves: country, unity and family. Our expedition is not in pursuit of petty glory, for we fly the colours of House Davion and we will only depart once those colours are nailed firmly to the mast, with our eyes on an endless horizon. Only then, we will do our duty, for country and countrymen.'     - Proceedings from the 827th Expeditionary Planning Board, House Davion
column2: 探索者的角色并不只是为未知疆域绘图，因为那不过是额外花钱的盲目游荡。伟大的探索者出发是为了比自身更宏大更勇敢的东西：国家、团结与家族。我们的远征并非追求卑微的荣耀，因为我们悬挂的是达维昂家族的旗帜，只有当那些旗帜牢牢钉上桅杆、我们的目光投向无尽的地平线时，我们才会启程。只有到那时，我们才会尽我们的职责，为了国家与同胞。'   ——达维昂家族第八二七次远征规划委员会会议记录

column1: Loathe the enemy within. Hate the enemy without. Fear the enemy beyond.'      - Free Worlds Proverb
column2: '憎恶内在之敌。仇恨外在之敌。恐惧超越之敌。'   - 自由世界谚语

column1: We don't go there anymore.'     - Star Captain Myra Lakshmi, TSS Tortugan Prowler
column2: 我们再也不去那里了。”——星队长迈拉·拉克什米，TSS 托尔图加潜行者号

column1: EC821-387D was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: EC821-387D在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Echo is a barren, tundra-covered planet, whose icy cyclones scourge the surface of the world. It is home to a large Zen monastery.
column2: Echo是一颗贫瘠、被苔原覆盖的行星，冰冷的气旋肆虐着世界表面. 这里是一座大型禅宗寺院的所在地.

column1: Home to Edasich Motors, the vast manufacturing base supports a highly industrialised populace.
column2: Edasich Motors的所在地，庞大的制造业基地支撑着高度工业化的人口.

column1: Eden is one of five systems known as the Pentagon Worlds and was the final Pentagon system to be settled by the Star League-in-Exile. Habitable but dry, Eden has been held by several Clans for the majority of its history as a settled world.
column2: Eden是被称为Pentagon Worlds的五个星系之一，也是流亡星际联盟最后定居的Pentagon星系. Eden适宜居住但干旱，在其作为定居世界的大部分历史中，曾被数个氏族占据.

column1: Edirne (Brank 3130+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Edirne（Brank 3130+）在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Edmondson is home to numerous borehole mining facilities that extract minerals from deep under the burning deserts.
column2: Edmondson拥有众多钻孔采矿设施，从灼热沙漠深处开采矿物.

column1: Home to Journey Aerospace, Edwards has numerous landing sites situated across the planet.
column2: Edwards是Journey Aerospace的所在地，星球各地分布着众多着陆场.

column1: This critical military and logistical world features a Duchy Regional Training Center, where volunteers for the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces are sent for training. The RTC on Egress specializes in infantry and vehicle training.
column2: 这个重要的军事与后勤星球，其特色是公国的地方训练中心，卡佩拉联邦武装部队的志愿者被派往那里受训. 埃格雷斯的地方训练中心专攻步兵与车辆训练.

column1: The low gravity on Eguilles allows for vast megaflora to be grown amongst the fertile soils.
column2: Eguilles的低重力使得肥沃的土壤中能够生长出广袤的巨型植物群落.

column1: Abandoned during the Age of War, it was subsequently repopulated during the War of Reunification as a military depot.
column2: 在战争时代被废弃，随后在统一战争期间作为军事仓库重新有人定居.

column1: Eigerland was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Eigerland在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: The inhospitable temperatures on the surface of Eilenburg force most of the population to stay within their habitation domes.
column2: Eilenburg地表恶劣的温度迫使大多数人口只能留在居住穹顶内.

column1: Eion was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Eion在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Ejeda was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ejeda于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Elba was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Elba在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Elbar once served as a resupply depot for the Star League, but now most facilities sit ruined under vegetation.
column2: Elbar曾是星际联盟的补给站，但如今大部分设施都已荒废，掩埋在植被之下.

column1: Elbing (FWL) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Elbing (FWL) 在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Elbing is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League, exporting goods to other Hanseatic worlds.
column2: Elbing是构成被称为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家一部分的星球之一，向其他汉萨同盟星球出口货物.

column1: El Dorado was vital to the commercial empire being built by Adam Davion and which laid much of the groundwork for the future Federated Suns. Has a number of \"Super Lakes\"
column2: 埃尔多拉多对亚当·达维昂正在建立的商业帝国至关重要，也为未来的联邦太阳奠定了许多基础。它拥有若干"超级湖"

column1: One of the three inhabited worlds of the Pleiades, Electra is a highly populated and industrialized planet with extensively irrigated farmlands in the major river valleys, and deep mines in the desert highlands.
column2: 伊莱克特拉是七姐妹星团三颗有人类居住的星球之一，它是颗人口稠密，高度工业化的行星，在主要的河谷地带拥有大量的水浇田，在沙漠高地拥有深井.

column1: Elektrougli is mostly a sandy desert lit by a bright blue sun, with deep canyons cut into the planet's crust.
column2: 埃列克特罗乌格利主要是被一颗明亮蓝色恒星照亮的沙漠，星球地壳上刻有深深的峡谷。ZH

column1: The vast cities on Eleusis are filled with glass windows and fantastic views due to the tainted atmosphere which can only be breathed for a few hours every day.
column2: Eleusis上广阔的城市里满是玻璃窗和绝美的景色，因为这里受污染的大气每天只有几个小时可以呼吸.

column1: El Giza is a world of purple fronds instead of conventional trees or grasses. The Heather - as its known to locals - grows up to between three and four meters tall.
column2: El Giza是一个遍布紫色叶状体而非传统树木或草类的世界. 当地人称之为“石楠”的这种植物可长到三到四米高.

column1: After the stable and self-sufficient colony on Tortuga was well-established, the Dominions began the colonization of other worlds, leading to the settlement of New Port Royal and four other worlds.
column2: 在Tortuga上稳定且自给自足的殖民地稳固建立之后，自治领开始殖民其他世界，最终在New Port Royal和其他四个世界上建立了定居点.

column1: Elidere is a rather small and drab world. It possesses several modest deposits of oil and metals that provide the resources for the planet's metals industry.
column2: 埃利德尔是一颗相当小而不起眼的星球。它拥有若干中等规模的石油与金属矿藏，为星球的金属工业提供原料。ZH

column1: Originally settled by people looking to escape from technology, Elissa was conquered by the Oberon Confederation during the Succession Wars who strip mined the world for the few resources it offered and brutalized the population.
column2: 最初由寻求逃离科技的人们定居，Elissa在继承战争期间被奥伯龙邦联征服，后者为获取这颗星球仅有的少量资源而对其进行剥离式开采，并残暴对待当地民众.

column1: Elix was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Elix是在统一战争结束后、星际联盟时代的某个时候被开拓定居的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: El Kerak was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: El Kerak在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Ellengurg is a small mining colony on a high gravity world. The raw materials are painstakingly drawn from the surface, though mine collapses are common.
column2: Ellengurg是一个位于高重力星球上的小型采矿殖民地. 原材料需要艰难地从地表开采，尽管矿井坍塌十分常见.

column1: Ellijay is unremarkable, except for a long, narrow continent that follows the line of the equator, stretching half way around the planet.
column2: Ellijay毫无特别之处，除了一条狭长的大陆沿着赤道线延伸，环绕了星球半圈.

column1: Home to a small aerospace manufacturer, Gutierrez Aerospace, Ellsworth provides raw material and expertise to the aerotech industry.
column2: 作为小型航空航天制造商Gutierrez Aerospace的所在地，Ellsworth为航空技术产业提供原材料和专业知识.

column1: There are scattered forests of dark green fungal towers that cross Elnath, and multicoloured solar flares occur annually, rendering electronics useless for a time.
column2: Elnath上散布着由深绿色真菌塔构成的森林，每年都会发生五彩斑斓的太阳耀斑，使电子设备在一段时间内失效.

column1: Eltanin is home to the virulent 'Eltanin Brain Fever', as well as a sun that may go nova at a moment's notice. Their disaster planning is therefore second to none.
column2: 埃尔塔宁是剧毒的"埃尔塔宁脑热病"的家园，也有一颗随时可能变成新星的太阳。因此他们的灾难预案无人能及。ZH

column1: Elume is a small self sufficient colony which exports dry wines and meats to nearby worlds.
column2: Elume是一个小型、自给自足的殖民地，向邻近星球出口干葡萄酒和肉类.

column1: Emar was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Emar在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Emerson is a harsh and marginally habitable world but rich in resources, and was founded by prisoners from a nearby system.
column2: Emerson是一个环境恶劣、勉强宜居的星球，但资源丰富，由来自附近星系的囚犯建立.

column1: Home to Ritza MechWarrior Academy, Emporia is also known for its numerous rare art collections and museums from eras past.
column2: 作为Ritza机甲战士学院的所在地，Emporia也以其众多来自昔日时代的珍稀艺术收藏和博物馆而闻名.

column1: A heavily industrialised world, Emris is home to Hollis Industries and StarCorps Industries which produce munitions for use across the Free Worlds League.
column2: Emris是一个高度工业化的世界，霍利斯工业和星团工业均坐落于此，它们为整个自由世界联盟生产弹药.

column1: Settled as an agricultural world, the initial settlers had to deal with the planet's axial tilt resulting in extremely long-lasting seasons.
column2: 该行星作为农业世界被殖民，最初的定居者必须应对行星的转轴倾角所造成的极为漫长的季节。ZH

column1: Ender's Cluster is one of a number of multi-star clusters found within the Inner Sphere, though no notable worlds are inhabited within the cluster - mostly pirate bases and rogue settlements for those who do not wish to be found.
column2: 恩德星团是内天体内发现的若干多恒星星团之一，不过该星团内没有值得注意的有人居住世界——大多是海盗基地，以及那些不愿被找到者的非法定居点。ZH

column1: Ancient ruins of the early Succession Wars can be found across the surface of Engadin.
column2: 在Engadin的地表，随处可见早期继承战争留下的古老遗迹.

column1: Settled by prisoners from the Rim Worlds Republic, Engadine has many areas that are covered with light snow and heavy ice. These harsh conditions forced the early involuntary settlers to become hardy survivalists.
column2: Engadine由来自边缘世界共和国的囚犯定居，许多地区覆盖着薄雪和厚冰. 这些严酷的条件迫使早期非自愿定居者成为坚韧的生存主义者.

column1: Enif's circular orbit means temperature variations are caused by the day/night cycle only.
column2: 恩尼夫的圆形轨道意味着其温度变化仅由昼夜循环造成。ZH

column1: The plant-like organisms on Enkoping are dominated by various types of grass, but they only reach short heights due to the high gravity.
column2: Enkoping上的类植物生物以各种草类为主，但由于高重力，它们只能长到很矮的高度.

column1: Enkra was once a mining world, shipping raw materials to nearby Brinton. Over-mining and the Succession Wars made it no longer a viable industry, but the planet has seen a rebirth as an agricultural world outside of the badly-polluted industrial zones.
column2: 恩克拉曾经是个矿业星球，将原材料运往附近的布林顿. 过度开采和继承战争使它不再是一个切实可行的产业，但是在污染严重的工业园区之外，这颗行星已经见证了作为一颗农业星球的重生.

column1: Entalun was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Entalun是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Enzesfled was colonised just before the Age of War, and has so far avoided any devastation in the Succession Wars.
column2: Enzesfled在战争时代开始前不久被殖民，并且迄今为止在继承战争中未遭受任何破坏.

column1: An extremely hot planet. The equatorial regions are too hot for most species, and so the only settlements are situated in the extreme polar regions.
column2: 一颗极其炽热的行星. 赤道地区对大多数物种来说都过于炎热，因此唯一的定居点都位于极地地区.

column1: Epsilon is a damp, boggy world, prone to excessive rain and wide-scale flooding.
column2: Epsilon是一个潮湿、沼泽遍布的世界，常常降雨过多，并容易发生大范围洪涝.

column1: Epsilon Eridani is a pleasant but damp world, prone to frequent mild rainstorms. It primarily exports food, though it also has significant chemical and heavy industrial manufacturing.
column2: Epsilon Eridani是一个宜人但潮湿的星球，常有频繁而温和的暴雨. 它主要出口食品，不过也拥有重要的化工和重工业制造业.

column1: Epsilon Indi is a hot, dry world rich in heavy metals. It once boasted a Star League SDS of military drone satellites capable of destroying incoming drop ships, but the SDS has been lost as pieces were destroyed and repair parts could not be sourced.
column2: Epsilon Indi是一颗炎热、干燥且富含重金属的星球. 它曾拥有一个由军用无人机卫星组成的星际联盟SDS，能够摧毁来袭的降落船，但由于部件被摧毁且无法获取维修零件，该SDS已经不复存在.

column1: Used as a base by both the Terran Hegemony and the SLDF, Columbus was abandoned until it was rediscovered by the Explorer Corps.
column2: Columbus曾被泰拉霸权和星际联盟防卫军共同用作基地，后来被废弃，直到被探索兵团重新发现.

column1: Erdvynn was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Erdvynn在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Known primarily for sheep farming and wool, Erewhon is home to a small colony and light industrial base mainly used for light vehicles for agriculture.
column2: Erewhon主要以养羊和羊毛闻名，拥有一个小型殖民地和一个轻工业基地，主要用于生产农用轻型车辆.

column1: Controlled by the lawless Von Strang family, this world is made up of a wealthy aristocracy and vast numbers of feudal workers. If you've got the money, you can buy many things here.
column2: 这颗行星由无法无天的冯·斯特朗家族控制，由富裕的贵族阶层和大量封建劳工组成。只要你有钱，在这里可以买到许多东西。ZH

column1: Recently settled after the Fourth Succession War, Erod's Escape is a small colony set up by a mercenary band who fled their employer.
column2: 埃罗德的逃脱在第四次继承战争后不久被殖民，是一支从雇主手下逃走的雇佣兵队伍建立的小型殖民地。ZH

column1: Settled during the First Exodus from Terra, Eromanga is filled with strange native wildlife called weebs that the local farmers harvest.
column2: Eromanga是在第一次从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间被定居的，这里到处都是名为weebs的奇特本土野生动物，当地农民会捕猎它们.

column1: Errai is home to a large number of casinos and clubs, making it a popular recreation destination.
column2: Errai拥有大量赌场和俱乐部，是备受欢迎的休闲目的地.

column1: Eschenberg was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Eschenberg是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Settled during the First Exodus from Terra, Escobas is filled with strange native fauna called Harels that the local farmers crossbreed and harvest.
column2: 在第一次从泰拉向外大迁徙期间被殖民，Escobas遍布一种名为Harels的奇异本土动物，当地农民会对其进行杂交培育并收获.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Espakeh was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison. Rumours of hidden caches on the surface still exist to this day.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年，Espakeh曾驻扎着一支星际联盟防卫军守备部队. 关于其地表藏有隐秘储藏点的传闻至今仍然存在.

column1: An inhospitable muddy rock, Espia was colonized only for its use as a jump route. The population lives on rocky outcroppings amid the endless, deadly mud-flats, which are capable of swallowing an entire 'Mech whole.
column2: 作为一颗环境严酷的泥泞岩石星球，埃斯皮亚被殖民只是因为它是条跳跃航线。居民生活在岩石露头上，四周是无边而致命的泥滩——泥滩能整台吞没一台机甲。ZH

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Esteros was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison. Rumours of hidden caches on the surface still exist to this day.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年，Esteros曾是星际联盟防卫军一支驻军的驻扎地. 关于地表藏有秘密储备库的传言至今仍然存在.

column1: The icy world of Estuan is home to vast mining facilities which pump rare material from deep within the permafrost.
column2: 冰封世界Estuan拥有庞大的采矿设施，它们从永久冻土深处抽取稀有材料.

column1: Esztergom was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Esztergom在统一战争结束后的某个时间点、于星盟时代被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Dense jungles of stone towers cover Etiler, which formed due to massive planetary damage.
column2: 茂密的石塔丛林覆盖着Etiler，这些石塔是在大规模行星破坏中形成的.

column1: Filled with unique forms of native life, Euclid has been home to many research teams from bioscience departments across the Inner Sphere.
column2: Euclid充满独特的原生生命形态，一直是内天体各地生物科学部门众多研究团队的所在地.

column1: Euschelus is an icy desert, with large water-filled caves that are present just beneath the surface.
column2: Euschelus是一片冰冷的沙漠，地表之下分布着充满水的大型洞穴.

column1: Apart from a few frozen lakes and rivers, Eustatius is dry. Basins of red dust exist where oceans should be.
column2: 除了少数冰封的湖泊和河流外，Eustatius十分干燥. 本该是海洋的地方，只有红色的尘土盆地.

column1: Eutin is a poor system with a growing manufacturing base, which has found a niche in being able to produce goods for a lower price than many competitors. Investors believe TharHes Industries may be interested in the growing system.
column2: Eutin是一个贫穷的星系，但制造业基础不断增长，并凭借能够以低于许多竞争对手的价格生产商品而找到了自己的市场定位. 投资者认为TharHes Industries可能会对这个不断发展的星系感兴趣.

column1: The once thriving Star League Defense Force industrial facilities on Evansville were destroyed by the Draconic Combine during the First Succession War, and centuries later the effects are still being felt.
column2: Evansville上曾经繁荣的星际联盟防卫军工业设施在第一次继承战争期间被天龙联合体摧毁，数个世纪后，其影响仍能感受到.

column1: Evciler is home to numerous high tech medical centres due to recurring outbreaks of Edison White Flu.
column2: 由于爱迪生白流感反复爆发，Evciler拥有众多高科技医疗中心.

column1: Everett was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Everett是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被建立为定居点的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: This system was originally named for Ewan Rigg, a noted entrepreneur and adventurer. During the Star League era Ewanrigg had a reputation as a vacation spot.
column2: 该星系最初以著名企业家和冒险家Ewan Rigg命名. 在星际联盟时代，Ewanrigg曾以度假胜地而闻名.

column1: Exedor was originally home to military industry, but was devastated during the First Succession War. Now it is the storage facility for the Liao family's treasures, kept in underground bunkers and guarded by members of the Chesterton Reserves.
column2: 埃克塞多原本是军工产业的所在地，但在第一次继承战争中被摧毁。如今它是廖氏家族宝物的储存设施，保存在地下掩体中，由切斯特顿预备队成员看守。ZH

column1: Home to the Galtor Blue Water Naval Yards, Exeter is wealthy planet that is the primary exporter of militarised seafaring vessels in this part of the Inner Sphere.
column2: Exeter是Galtor Blue Water Naval Yards的所在地，是一颗富裕的星球，也是内天体这一地区军用海上舰船的主要出口地.

column1: Fable was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Fable是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: A FWL system that was settled during the Age of War by refugees fleeing the conflict with the CCAF. As such, it always wasn't entirely behind the martial laws of the \"Free\" Worlds League.
column2: 这是一个自由世界联盟星系，在战火时代由逃离与CCAF冲突的难民所殖民。正因如此，它从来不曾完全拥护"自由"世界联盟的军管法。ZH

column1: The Fager system is an uninhabited system located in the Rimward sector of the Deep Periphery past the Perseus-Cepherus Cloud Complex, a vast molecular cloud or stellar nursery.
column2: Fager星系是一个无人居住的星系，位于英仙座-刻甫斯云复合体之外、深空外围的外缘扇区；后者是一片巨大的分子云或恒星孕育区.

column1: Fagerholm is a dry world with large canyon systems that are the result of millions of years of erosion from the rivers that once crossed its surface. Originally a Capellan colony, it was lost to the Free Worlds League in the aftermath of the First Succession War.
column2: 法格霍姆是个干燥的星球，有着巨大的峡谷体系，这是数百万年来穿过地面的河流侵蚀的结果. 它原本是卡佩拉的殖民地，在第一次继承战争之后被自由世界联盟占领.

column1: A wealthy world, with vast mineral wealth, Fairfax has been the administrative capital of the Fairfax Combat region.
column2: Fairfax是一个富裕的星球，拥有丰富的矿产资源，一直是Fairfax战区的行政首府.

column1: Named due the great amounts of farmland available to settlers, it was soon discovered that bacteria within the soils of the planet rendered all crops sterile. The same bacteria can be used within medical supplies, which has created a large soil mining operation on the planet.
column2: 由于可供定居者使用的农田面积广阔而得名，但人们很快发现，行星土壤中的细菌会让所有作物无法繁育. 同样的细菌可用于医疗物资，这已在行星上催生出大规模的土壤开采产业.

column1: Faleolo is nothing more than a rocky desert lit by a dim blue sun. Deep canyons cut into the planet's crust, where small mining operations eke out a living.
column2: 法莱奥洛不过是一片被昏暗蓝日照亮的岩石沙漠。深邃的峡谷切入行星地壳，小规模采矿作业在那里勉力为生。ZH

column1: Fallen Stars was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Fallen Stars是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后某个时期建立的殖民地，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Although terraformed partially during the Star League era, Fallon still has a tainted atmosphere which limits outdoor pursuits.
column2: 尽管在星际联盟时代进行过部分地球化改造，Fallon的大气仍受到污染，限制了户外活动.

column1: Fallry was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Fallry在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: False Dawn was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: False Dawn在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Falsterbo was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison, which led to the discovery of numerous small Star League caches across the surface.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年，Falsterbo驻扎着星际联盟防卫军的一支驻军，这使得人们在星球表面发现了众多小型星际联盟储藏点.

column1: Falsterbo is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League, exporting goods to other Hanseatic worlds.
column2: Falsterbo是构成被称为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家一部分的星球之一，向其他汉萨同盟世界出口货物.

column1: Famdo was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Famdo是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候建立的定居点，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: An icy and wintery world, Farandir was host to a Star League Defense Force garrison in the final years of the Star League.
column2: Farandir是一个冰天雪地的世界，在星际联盟的最后几年里，它曾是星际联盟防卫军一支驻军的驻地.

column1: Farcry was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Farcry在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: Farhome is little more than a scientific outpost gathering data on an alien world.
column2: Farhome不过是一个收集异星世界数据的科学前哨站.

column1: Farnsworth is home to strange moss like flora - the ground is covered in thick purple slime. The large flora takes the shape of giant purple geodesic domes.
column2: Farnsworth是奇特苔藓类植物的家园——地面覆盖着厚厚的紫色黏液. 大型植物呈巨大的紫色测地线穹顶状.

column1: Far Reach is over a hundred days from the jump point into the system, rendering it extremely isolated from any other system.
column2: Far Reach距离进入该星系的跃迁点超过一百天，这使其与其他任何星系都极为隔绝.

column1: Farstar is a recent colony world situated spinward of the Draconis Combine. It's large asteroid field can obscure fleets of vessels.
column2: 远星是最近才建立殖民地的行星，位于龙尼斯联合体的旋臂方向。它庞大的小行星带能遮蔽成群的舰船。ZH

column1: Farwell is a harsh, cold world. The high oxygen and low temperatures force the population to exist indoors. Large Star League era greenhouses still exist, filled with Terran flora as one of the only morale boosters to the miners.
column2: Farwell是一个严酷而寒冷的世界. 高氧和低温迫使居民只能在室内生活. 星际联盟时代的大型温室依然存在，里面种满了地球植物，是矿工们为数不多的精神慰藉之一.

column1: Fasa was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Fasa是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Fathepur was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Fathepur是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Infamous for being the site of the assassination of Alistair Steiner over half a millenia earlier, Fatima is an otherwise peaceful planet with a large industrial base.
column2: Fatima因作为五百多年前Alistair Steiner遇刺的地点而臭名昭著，除此之外，它是一颗和平的星球，拥有庞大的工业基础.

column1: Fefferfer was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Fefferfer是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Feijo was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Feijo在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Fellanin was hit by a city sized asteroid over a millenia ago, rendering much of the world uninhabitable. Mining settlements and farms are connected by subterranean railways to easily exploit the mineral deposits.
column2: Fellanin在一千多年前被一颗城市大小的小行星撞击，导致该星球大部分地区无法居住. 采矿定居点和农场由地下铁路相连，以便轻松开采矿藏.

column1: Little is Known about this system, only that it was under the control of the Escorpión Imperio in 3140
column2: 关于这个星系所知甚少，只知道 3140 年它处于"天蝎帝国"的控制之下

column1: Numerous settlements around the planet make up the industrialised world of Feltre. It's large trading centre is home to numerous interstellar corporations.
column2: 费尔特雷这颗工业化世界由行星周围众多定居点组成。它的大型贸易中心是众多星际公司的所在地。ZH

column1: Sealed complexes make up the main settlement on Ferihegy, due to the toxic atmosphere on this extremely mineral rich planet.
column2: 由于这颗矿产资源极其丰富的行星大气有毒，Ferihegy上的主要定居点由密封建筑群构成.

column1: Dense jungles of large purple flora cover Ferleiten, which has large fertile soils due to radiation from the planetary rings.
column2: Ferleiten上覆盖着由大型紫色植物构成的茂密丛林，由于行星环的辐射，这里拥有大片肥沃的土壤.

column1: Ferranil was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ferranil在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Ferrara was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ferrara在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Ferris is the location of an AGDA training facility for militia MechWarriors for the Outworlds Alliance. Mercenary and Pirate groups also recruit here.
column2: Ferris是外域联盟民兵机甲战士的AGDA训练设施所在地. 雇佣兵和海盗团体也在此招募.

column1: Settled by a group of rebels from the Draconis Combine during the Third Succession War, Ferris is now home to many hordes of disreputables. Good ale though.
column2: 第三次继承战争期间，一群来自天龙联合体的叛军在此定居，如今Ferris成了大批声名狼藉之徒的家园. 不过麦酒倒是不错.

column1: Fetsund is made up of a rocky desert lit by a wan yellow sun. There are extensive fossilized forests throughout the planet.
column2: Fetsund由一片岩石沙漠构成，被一颗暗淡的黄色太阳照耀. 整个星球上遍布着广袤的化石森林.

column1: The Fianna Massacre occurred here in 3017, where the clashes between the inexperienced Oberon Guards and rioting populace inadvertently released massive amounts of chemical weapons into the atmosphere, killing half the population and rendered the colony crippled.
column2: 3017年，Fianna大屠杀发生在这里. 当时，缺乏经验的奥伯龙卫队与暴乱民众发生冲突，意外地将大量化学武器释放到大气中，导致半数人口丧生，并使该殖民地陷入瘫痪.

column1: Fieferana welcomed Star League forces onto the planet, until the end of the Star League. Caches are believed to be hidden across the world.
column2: Fieferana欢迎星际联盟部队来到该星球，直到星际联盟终结. 据信，补给藏匿点遍布全球.

column1: Fiery Plains was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Fiery Plains是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: One of the more notable worlds in the Davion 'Outback', Filtvelt is a naturally verdant planet and an agricultural breadbasket, despite the painful decline of its industrial base and constant pirate raids.
column2: 作为戴维恩“内陆”较为知名的星球之一，菲尔维尔特是一颗天然翠绿的星球与农业粮仓，尽管其工业基础正痛苦衰退、海盗袭掠不断。ZH

column1: A sandy desert lit by a dull red sun. The local wildlife builds their shells out of rare metals, which are hunted by settlers.
column2: 一片被暗红色太阳照耀的沙质荒漠. 当地野生动物用稀有金属构筑外壳，遭到定居者的猎捕.

column1: Findal was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Findal是在统一战争结束后的星盟时代某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Finmark was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Finmark在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Finse was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Finse在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The Finsterwalde system was colonized by the Free Worlds League during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but then captured by the Lyran Commonwealth in the Second Succession war.
column2: Finsterwalde星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被自由世界联盟殖民，但随后在第二次继承战争中被天琴共同体占领.

column1: As key suppliers of salted fruits to the Commonwealth, Firenze has evolved into an economic powerhouse.
column2: 作为向共同体供应盐渍水果的主要供应商，Firenze已发展成为一个经济重镇.

column1: Firgrove is a large industrial hub, with the orbital Clyde Shipyards requiring large amounts of material for the construction of vessels.
column2: Firgrove是一个大型工业中心，轨道上的克莱德造船厂需要大量材料来建造舰船.

column1: The original colony was largely underground, built in the sides of deep kilometer-wide shafts that breach the ice that envelops this world. Fjaldr survives on its rich mineral resources and its position as a well-connected hub world near the Inner Sphere.
column2: 菲亚德尔最初的殖民地大部分都在地下，建在数千米宽的深井侧面，这些深井破开了包裹这个星球的冰层. 菲亚德尔依靠其丰富的矿产资源，以及处于内天体附近四通八达的枢纽位置而生存.

column1: Fjernet was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Fjernet是在统一战争结束后的某个时候、于星际联盟时代被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: This frozen world in the heart of Taurian space is the moon of a large ice giant. Tidal stresses from the planet have created an ocean of liquid water below the ice, and in that ocean, submarine dome cities cluster around warm volcanic vents to exploit the rich minerals found there.
column2: 这颗冰封星球位于金牛太空的中心，是一颗大型冰态巨星的卫星. 来自该行星的潮汐力在冰下创造了一片液态水的海洋，在海洋里，海底穹顶城市聚集在温暖的火山喷口周围，开采那里丰富的矿藏.

column1: Flatspin was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Flatspin是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Most of the few inhabitants of this arid world live in the extremely fertile floodplains of the planet's only major river system, where they operate and maintain the automated farms. A smaller number of people live in the mining plants of Flaum's north polar region.
column2: 这颗干旱世界稀少的居民大多生活在该行星唯一主要水系那极其肥沃的洪泛平原上，在那里操作与维护自动化农场。较少的人住在弗劳姆北部极区的采矿厂里。ZH

column1: Once home to numerous weapons manufacturers during the Star League which were destroyed during the Succession Wars, Fletcher is now the base of Fusigon Heavy Weaponry.
column2: Fletcher曾是星际联盟时期众多武器制造商的所在地，这些制造商在继承战争中遭到摧毁，如今Fletcher是Fusigon重型武器公司的总部.

column1: Home to Flame Tech manufacturing facilities, Fletcher is a large manufacturing hub for nearby systems.
column2: 作为Flame Tech制造设施的所在地，Fletcher是附近星系的大型制造中心.

column1: Settled by pirates from Tortuga, Fletcher's Feast is a veritable hive of scum and villainy.
column2: 由来自托尔图加的海盗殖民，弗莱彻盛宴是一处名副其实的渣滓与恶棍巢穴。ZH

column1: The site of a major naval battle during the Reunification War, Flintoft's orbit is still dangerously littered with debris. The industrial world has a bustling secondary market in salvaged technology from orbit as well as the many battlefields on the surface.
column2: 作为统一战争期间一场大规模海战的战场，弗林托夫特的轨道至今仍危险地散落着碎片。这颗工业世界在取自轨道的打捞技术以及地表众多战场方面，有着繁忙的二级市场。ZH

column1: Florarda was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Florarda于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Florida was originally a part of the Timbuktu Province of the Rim Worlds Republic and was conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth during the 2773-2775 Republic-Commonwealth War.
column2: Florida最初是边缘世界共和国的Timbuktu省的一部分，并在2773-2775年的共和国-共同体战争期间被天琴共同体征服.

column1: The original settlements on Flushing were destroyed in the First Succession War, but some homesteads still remain.
column2: Flushing上的最初定居点已在第一次继承战争中摧毁，但仍有一些农庄留存下来.

column1: Flychenia was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Flychenia在统一战争结束后的某个时候于星际联盟时代被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Flynn was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Flynn在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Fomalhaut is a tropical world whose population mostly live on island chains. It serves primarily as a resort world, and despite its presence along the Kurita/Davion border has been largely spared from the destruction of the Succession Wars.
column2: 北落师门是一颗热带行星，其人口大多住在岛链上。它主要作为度假世界，尽管地处栗田/达维昂边界沿线，却在继承战争的破坏中大体幸免。ZH

column1: The settlements on Foochow are carved out of the planet wide jungles, filled with dangerous predators and fauna.
column2: Foochow上的定居点是在覆盖全球的丛林中开辟出来的，那里充满了危险的掠食者和动物群.

column1: Foot Fall is known for its rapidly changing weather cycles. Both continents feature expansive mountain ranges and relatively little arable land, although the arable land that exists is prolifically fertile.
column2: Foot Fall以其迅速变化的天气周期而闻名. 两片大陆都拥有广阔的山脉和相对稀少的可耕地，不过现有的可耕地却极为肥沃.

column1: Home to an office of Skye Traders, as well as a manufacturing plant of Ford Military Limited, Ford is a stable manufacturing hub within the Inner Sphere.
column2: Ford设有Skye Traders的办事处以及Ford Military Limited的制造厂，是内天体中的一个稳定制造业中心.

column1: The Forkas system was colonised during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Forkas星系是在星际联盟时代，统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的.

column1: An important world for much of the Lyran Commonwealth's history, Fort Loudon is home to an operational Fort Brian.
column2: 作为莱兰联邦历史上长期的重要世界，劳登堡拥有一座仍在运作的布莱恩堡。ZH

column1: The Fortymile system was colonised during the Star League era at some point after the Reunification War, and is an unimportant agricultural world.
column2: Fortymile星系在统一战争后的某个时期于星际联盟时代被殖民，是一个无足轻重的农业世界.

column1: The Foster system is a mineral rich and fertile terrestrial world orbiting close the jump point around a class M primary.
column2: Foster星系是一个矿产丰富且土地肥沃的类地世界，在围绕一颗M级主星的跃迁点附近运行.

column1: The Franklin system was colonised during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra. Devastated in both the First and Second Succession Wars, little remains of the vast mineral boreholes that were created here.
column2: Franklin星系是在自泰拉出发的第一次大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民的. 它在第一次和第二次继承战争中均遭到毁灭性破坏，曾在此开凿的广阔矿物钻孔如今已所剩无几.

column1: Frankson was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Frankson在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Interstellar Expeditions has marked this world as suitable for colonisation, however little more is known about it.
column2: 星际远征组织已将这颗星球标记为适宜殖民，但除此之外对它知之甚少.

column1: Frazer is a major petroleum exporter, which provided the motivation for colonists to clear a broad swath of the native rainforest for agricultural production, allowing the world to be self-sufficient. The heavy rainfall is well-suited to Terran rice crops.
column2: 弗雷泽是个重要的石油出口地，为殖民者在当地雨林中开出大片荒地，从事农业生产提供了动力，从而使这颗星球可以自给自足. 大强度的降雨量很适合地球的稻米.

column1: Settled in the 2600s by expatriates from the Lyran Commonwealth, Fredotto fell into anarchy after the Amaris Civil War when its economy collapsed. It's few remaining settlers are mostly agrarian, with any industry being used in the export of high quality infantry weapons to neighbouring worlds.
column2: 弗雷多托于2600年代由来自莱兰联邦的侨民定居，在阿马里斯内战期间经济崩溃后陷入无政府状态。它剩下的少数定居者多为务农者，仅有的工业用于向邻近星系出口高质量步兵武器。ZH

column1: Freedom VI is a hospitable world with a single moon named Vigil's Light. Famous for its part in the Outer Reaches Rebellion. Was directly involved in the events that led to collapse of the Terran Alliance. Home of Twentieth Avalon Hussars.
column2: 自由VI是一颗宜居行星，拥有一颗名为"守夜之光"的卫星。它以外围边区叛乱中的角色而闻名。它直接卷入了导致地球联盟崩溃的一系列事件。它是第二十阿瓦隆骠骑兵的驻地。ZH

column1: The Freisland system was colonized during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra, and was one of the founding members of the Federated Suns via the Crucis Pact.
column2: Freisland星系在泰拉第一次大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民，并通过《克鲁西斯协定》成为恒星联邦的创始成员之一.

column1: Once the site of an Interstellar Expeditions genetic engineering research post, it has since been abandoned.
column2: 这里曾是星际探险组织一处基因工程研究站的所在地，但此后已被废弃.

column1: The Fröislandis system is located in the Anti-Spinward sector of the Deep Periphery past the Cygnus Loop, and is an icy world inhabited by a small outpost of researchers.
column2: Fröislandis星系位于天鹅座环之外的深空外围反旋臂星区，是一个冰封世界，居住着一支小型研究人员前哨站.

column1: Fronc was simultaneously colonized by both the Magistracy and the Concordat, and the fragile peace between the two colonial nations has been periodically broken by terrorism, local brush wars, and heated rhetoric.
column2: 弗龙茨同时被自治区和协约国殖民，两个殖民国家之间的脆弱和平已经被恐怖主义，当地的低烈度战争，还有激烈的言辞周期性地破坏掉了.

column1: Frondas is a small mining colony built to lay claim to the system during the First Exodus from Earth, but unlike most other planets of that era it has not grown substantially over the past few centuries.
column2: Frondas是一个小型采矿殖民地，建于第一次从地球出发的大迁徙期间，目的是宣示对该星系的主权；但与那个时代的大多数其他行星不同，它在过去几个世纪里并未有显著发展.

column1: Fronde was colonised after the Age of War, due to scans of rare rich platinum deposits under the surface.
column2: Fronde是在战争时代之后被殖民的，因为扫描发现其地表下蕴藏着稀有而丰富的铂矿藏.

column1: Fuentes was colonised during the First Exodus from Earth, and exports most of its foodstuffs to nearby worlds.
column2: Fuentes是在第一次地球大迁徙期间被殖民的，并将大部分食品出口到附近的世界.

column1: Fugeres was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Fugeres在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: The Fujidera system was colonised during the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the Federation of Oriente prior to the formation of the Free Worlds League.
column2: Fujidera星系在从泰拉出发的第一次大迁徙期间被殖民，并在自由世界联盟成立之前是Oriente联邦的成员.

column1: The Fukuroi system was the site of Riots during the Star League era, which were brutally quashed. Memorials to the futility of standing against the Combine still exist to this day.
column2: Fukuroi星系曾是星际联盟时代暴乱的爆发地，这些暴乱遭到残酷镇压. 纪念对抗天龙联合体徒劳无功的纪念碑至今依然存在.

column1: Blessed with abundant resources and a rich biosphere, Furillo was rapidly colonized during the First Exodus and has been crucial to the Lyran industrial base for centuries. It houses a set of major production facilities, including a Mech factory.
column2: 凭借丰富的资源和繁茂的生物圈，Furillo在第一次大迁徙期间被迅速殖民，数个世纪以来一直是天琴工业基础的关键所在. 这里设有一系列重要生产设施，包括一座机甲工厂.

column1: The Furud system was colonised at some point in the late twenty-third or early twenty-fourth century and was a member of the Sian Commonwealth prior to the formation of the Capellan Confederation.
column2: Furud星系在二十三世纪末或二十四世纪初的某个时候被殖民，并在卡佩拉邦联成立之前是锡安共同体的成员.

column1: The Futuna system was colonized during the First Exodus from Terra and by the end of the Age of War had been incorporated into the Free Worlds League.
column2: Futuna星系在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间被殖民，到战争时代结束时已被并入自由世界联盟.

column1: The Fuveau system was colonised during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War
column2: Fuveau星系是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的.

column1: Interstellar Expeditions has marked Fylover as suitable for colonisation, however little more is known about it.
column2: 星际远征已将Fylover标记为适宜殖民，但除此之外对它知之甚少.

column1: Gabenstad was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Gabenstad在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民定居，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Gacrux possesses vast mineral wealth but the star it orbits is slowly dying. As solar output wanes, the planet's average temperature drops by about a degree every century.
column2: 加克鲁克斯拥有庞大的矿产财富，但它所环绕的恒星正在慢慢死去。随着恒星输出衰减，该行星的平均温度每世纪下降约一度。ZH

column1: Gaeri was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Gaeri在统一战争结束后的某个时候、星际联盟时代被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Gahral was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Gahral在统一战争结束后的某个时期、星际联盟时代被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Galatea began to prosper when a clever treaty was negotiated with ComStar, via which the planetary government managed to establish Galatea as the center of the mercenary trade. The influx of trade led to a boom in the economy.
column2: Galatea在与ComStar达成一项巧妙条约后开始繁荣，通过该条约，行星政府成功将Galatea确立为雇佣兵贸易的中心. 贸易的涌入促成了经济繁荣.

column1: Galatia lacks strategic value or resources, which has left it largely unscathed by the Succession Wars.
column2: Galatia缺乏战略价值或资源，这使得它在继承战争中基本未受波及.

column1: Galax's large moon causes turmoil on the surface and in the atmosphere, but allows a constantly replenishing amount of new raw materials and petroleum.
column2: 加拉克斯的大卫星在地表与大气中造成动荡，却也带来不断补充的新原材料与石油。ZH

column1: Originally settled in 2282, the fifth planet in the Galedon system was attractive to early settlers due to its diamond deposits and abundant fresh water.  Galedon remains both a key agricultural centre, and an important industrial planet.
column2: Galedon星系中的第五颗行星最初于2282年有人定居，因其钻石矿藏和丰富的淡水而吸引了早期定居者. Galedon如今仍是一个重要的农业中心，也是一颗重要的工业行星.

column1: Galicia is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery region known as Nueva Castile
column2: Galicia是构成被称为新卡斯蒂利亚的深空外围区域一部分的星球之一.

column1: The Galisteo system was settled at some point during or prior to the Age of War, and avoided devastation during the Succession Wars
column2: Galisteo星系在战争时代期间或之前的某个时候被殖民，并在继承战争期间免遭毁灭.

column1: Settled during the second wave of the First Exodus from Sol, Gallatin provides materials to nearby worlds.
column2: 在从Sol出发的第一次大迁徙的第二波期间有人定居，Gallatin为附近的世界提供材料.

column1: Gallery presents a barren surface to observers. The system's weak sun cannot penetrate the perpetual heavy cloud cover, and the planet is constantly swept by violent storms. Tax laws make it a haven for less reputable companies such as Quikscell.
column2: 加勒里向观测者展现出一片荒芜的地表。该星系微弱的恒星无法穿透终年厚重的云层，行星上暴风肆虐不休。税收法律使它成为Quikscell之类名声不佳的公司的避风港。ZH

column1: The Gallis system was colonised at some point during or prior to the Age of War, and held an SLDF garrison which was banished to a remote part of the planet.
column2: Gallis星系在战争时代期间或之前的某个时候被殖民，并曾驻扎有一支SLDF驻军，该驻军被放逐到了该行星的偏远地区.

column1: The Gallitzin system was colonized during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra.
column2: Gallitzin星系是在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民的.

column1: Galtor was a populous garden world until the Succession Wars, which devastated the world and its population due to its location on the border between the Federated Suns and Draconis Combine.
column2: Galtor曾是一个人口稠密的花园世界，直到继承战争因其所处的恒星联邦与天龙联合体边界位置而摧毁了这个世界及其人口.

column1: Adverts for the tropical world of Galuzzo often talk about the \"Exotic wines and the best pizza in known space\" which supports a thriving tourist industry.
column2: 热带世界加卢佐的广告常常宣传"异域美酒与已知空间里最好的披萨"，这支撑起了一个兴旺的旅游业。ZH

column1: The Gambarare system was settled during the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the United Hindu Collective prior to the Collective joining the Federated Suns.
column2: Gambarare星系在第一次从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间被殖民，并且在联合印度教集体加入恒星联邦之前，曾是联合印度教集合体的一员.

column1: From the 2200s to the 2400s, the Gambier system was a stopover point for colony ships moving to other systems spinward from Terra. Now it is little more than an entertainment hub.
column2: 从2200年代到2400年代，Gambier星系是从泰拉向顺旋方向前往其他星系的殖民船的中转站. 如今它几乎只是一个娱乐枢纽.

column1: The Gambilon system was colonised at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: 在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代，Gambilon星系在某个时候被殖民了.

column1: Gamlestolen was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Gamlestolen在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡.

column1: Originally found due to a misjump, the Gandy's Luck system was settled during the First Exodus from Terra prior to joining the Draconis Combine.
column2: 甘迪之运星系最初因一次错误跳跃而被发现，在首次从地球出走期间被殖民，后来加入龙尼斯联合体。ZH

column1: As a recently-colonized world, Gangtok is bustling with boom-town energy; temporary cities have sprung up all over the unremarkable Terran world, as eager prospectors, colonists, and merchants crowd in, all looking to strike it rich.
column2: 甘托克作为一个新近殖民的星球，正因新兴城市的能量变得热闹起来; 随着热切的勘探者，殖民者和商人蜂拥而入，寻求发财致富，临时城市在这颗不起眼的类地星球上遍地涌现.

column1: The Gannett system was colonised at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Gannett星系是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某一时期被殖民的.

column1: The Ganshoren system was colonized at some point during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra, and by the end of the Age of War had been incorporated into the Lyran Commonwealth.
column2: Ganshoren星系在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民，到战争时代结束时已被并入天琴共同体.

column1: During the Star League era, Gan Singh served as the headquarters for the XXIV Corps (Star League) of the Star League Defense Force, supporting by a nascent mining industry which still exists to this day.
column2: 在星际联盟时代，Gan Singh曾是星际联盟防卫军第24军（星际联盟）的司令部所在地，并得到当时新兴采矿业的支持，该产业至今仍然存在.

column1: Recently settled, the colonists on Gant eke out a limited living on the hard scrabble like soils.
column2: 最近才有人定居，Gant上的殖民者在坚硬贫瘠的土壤上勉强维持着有限的生活.

column1: The original colony on Gardnaus has been almost completely reclaimed by the scouring sandstorms that constantly sweep the planet's surface. A few research teams still pick through the battlefield remnants from Star League era conflicts.
column2: 加德纳斯上的最初殖民地几乎已被不断横扫地表的蚀骨沙暴完全夺回。仍有几支研究队在这片星盟时代冲突留下的战场残骸中翻找。ZH

column1: Garrison is so named for its military training center and post. Pockmarked by weapon testing sites, it still churns out thousands of new recruits every year.
column2: Garrison因其军事训练中心和驻地而得名. 尽管遍布武器试验场，它每年仍源源不断地培养出数千名新兵.

column1: A water rich world, much of its wealth comes from the 'Underdepth Oceans', a mineral rich subterranean cavern system filled with water.
column2: 一颗水资源丰富的行星，其大部分财富来自"深渊洋"——一个充满水的富矿地下洞穴系统。ZH

column1: The steppes and prairies of Gatchina provide ample farming ground for the population.
column2: Gatchina的草原和普雷里为当地居民提供了充足的农田.

column1: Gatekeeper is an early Star League-In-Exile colony which was established prior to the SLDF's collapse in 2801.
column2: 守门人是一处早期星盟流亡殖民地，建立在SLDF于2801年崩溃之前。ZH

column1: Gateway is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League, exporting goods to other Hanseatic worlds.
column2: Gateway是组成被称为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家一部分的星球之一，向其他汉萨世界出口货物.

column1: The Gatineau system was colonized at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Gatineau星系是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某时被殖民的.

column1: This agricultural world supplies food to nearby systems and the Taurian Concordat. Much of this industry is based on factory farming of the genetically-engineered Gaucin Hog, a native life-form that some activists believe is sapient.
column2: 这颗农业星球为附近的星系和金牛协约国供应食物. 这儿的产业大部分都以基因工程高辛猪的养殖工厂作为基础，这是一种土著生物，一些活动家相信它有智慧.

column1: Recently settled, the colonists on Gaul eke out a limited living from the toxic waters and tough soils.
column2: 最近才有人定居，Gaul上的殖民者靠着有毒的水域和坚硬的土壤勉强度日.

column1: Geifer is home to the Capellan Institute of Linguistics; one of the few major universities that survived the Succession Wars. Many members of the Capellan diplomatic and intelligence services are trained here.
column2: Geifer是卡佩拉语言学院的所在地；该学院是少数在继承战争中幸存下来的主要大学之一. 许多卡佩拉外交与情报部门的成员都在这里接受培训.

column1: Gei-Fu III - more commonly known simply as Gei-Fu - is the third planet in the Gei-Fu system and has a single moon named Yè xīng. While still a Capellan world, the population is known to have a large number of St. Ives sympathists in it.
column2: Gei-Fu III——通常简称为Gei-Fu——是Gei-Fu星系中的第三颗行星，拥有一颗名为Yèxīng的卫星. 尽管它仍是一个卡佩拉世界，但据悉其人口中有大量圣艾夫斯同情者.

column1: Genf was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Genf在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Settled in 2175, the harsh desert has forced the settlers to vast rich underground caverns with great river networks.
column2: 定居于2175年，严酷的沙漠迫使定居者转入广阔富饶、拥有庞大河网的地下洞穴.

column1: Gettorf was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Gettorf于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡.

column1: Settled as late as 2750, Ghaziabad is a dry world with limited resources.
column2: 直到 2750 年才有人定居，Ghaziabad是一个干燥且资源有限的世界.

column1: Ghent is a system in the Deep Periphery beyond Ctesiphon.
column2: Ghent是Ctesiphon之外的深空外围中的一个星系.

column1: This unfortunate world was once a Capellan colony. In recent years the last few surviving inhabitants were driven off-planet by mercenaries hired by the Magistracy, in order to create a larger buffer between the two nations.
column2: 这个不幸的星球曾经是一处卡佩拉殖民地. 近年来，最后几名残存的居民被自治区雇佣的佣兵赶出了星球，其目的是为了在两国之间建立一个更大的缓冲区.

column1: Giausar is home to numerous chemical agricompound plants that utilise cutting edge technology to boost their yields.
column2: Giausar是众多化学农用化合物工厂的所在地，这些工厂利用尖端技术来提高产量.

column1: Ioto Galactic Enterprises maintains a massive manufacturing hub at the LaGrange Point between Gibbs and its moon.
column2: Ioto Galactic Enterprises在Gibbs与其卫星之间的拉格朗日点运营着一座庞大的制造中心.

column1: Gibraltar is home to an operational Star League facility, Fort Calpe.
column2: Gibraltar是仍在运作的星际联盟设施——卡尔佩堡的所在地.

column1: Gibson is the home of Gibson Federated Battlemechs and Brigadier Corporations. Together these are the two largest producers of Battlemechs and Warships in the Free Worlds League.
column2: Gibson是Gibson Federated Battlemechs和Brigadier Corporations的所在地. 这两家企业共同是自由世界联盟中最大的战斗机甲和战舰生产商.

column1: Gienah is a heavily industrialised world that is home to Gienah Automotive, which also manufactures parts for military vehicles.
column2: Gienah是一个高度工业化的世界，是Gienah Automotive的所在地，该公司还生产军用车辆零部件.

column1: Forests of giant fungal organisms for which the planet takes its namesake dominate much of the surface. The flesh of these huge mushroom trees dry out during the long, hot days, becoming tough and woody.
column2: 巨大真菌生物构成的森林占据了地表的大部分，这颗星球也正因它们而得名. 在漫长炎热的白天里，这些巨型蘑菇树的肉质会干枯，变得坚韧而木质化.

column1: Gillingham is a terrestrial planet with an extremely slow axial rotation. Days and nights here can last as long as an Earth-week
column2: Gillingham是一颗类地行星，其自转极其缓慢. 这里的白昼和黑夜可以持续长达一个地球周之久.

column1: A small Earth-like planet with dangerous levels of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere. Seasonal grasslands cover the entire surface.
column2: 一颗小型类地行星，大气中的二氧化碳含量达到危险水平. 整个地表覆盖着季节性草原.

column1: Gingeria was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Gingeria在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The majority of Girondas's surface area is covered by shallow oceans. Of the 20% of the planet's surface that is land, most is a vast marshland, hot and foul-smelling, but excellent for both agriculture and fish farming.
column2: 吉龙达大部分地表被浅海覆盖。在该星球20%的陆地中，大部分是辽阔的沼泽，炎热而气味难闻，却对农业与养鱼业都极好。ZH

column1: Gitarama was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Gitarama是在统一战争结束后的某个时间、于星际联盟时代被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: Giverny was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Giverny于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡.

column1: Givrodat was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Givrodat是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Glabach was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Glabach是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Gladius' surface is 94% covered by water and is famous for its jade green seas. The planet possesses relatively little mineral wealth so its economy is mostly based around being a tourist and retirement destination for the upper classes.
column2: 短剑的表面94%被水覆盖，以其翡翠绿的海闻名。该行星矿产财富相对稀少，所以其经济主要建立在成为上流阶级的旅游与退休目的地之上。ZH

column1: Glasgow is a terrestrial planet famous for its carnivorous trees and stormy weather. The sap from the trees is known to be a powerful intoxicant.
column2: Glasgow是一颗类地行星，以其食肉树木和暴风雨天气而闻名. 这些树木的树液被认为是一种强效致醉物.

column1: Glengarry had been a prosperous world focused on trade and light industry during the Star League era, but has been in steep decline ever since. It is now a minor world consisting mostly of small agricultural communities.
column2: Glengarry曾是星际联盟时代一个以贸易和轻工业为重点的繁荣世界，但自那以后便急剧衰落. 如今它只是一个次要星球，主要由小型农业社区组成.

column1: Glenlivet was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Glenlivet在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Glenmora's central continent, named Hades, is so named for the ring of volcanoes that surround it.
column2: 格伦莫拉的中部大陆名为哈迪斯，得名于环绕它的那一圈火山。ZH

column1: This industrial world's economy was shattered by the Second Succession War, in which Davion captured it from Liao. The atmospheric dust from orbital bombardment led to a precipitous drop in global temperatures.
column2: 这个工业世界的经济在第二次继承战争中被打得粉碎，当时达维恩从廖氏手中夺取了它。轨道轰炸造成的大气尘埃导致全球气温骤降。ZH

column1: Teaming with life, Glevakha's islands drift on the planets ocean, a phenomena caused by helium and other gases trapped in porous rock - spewed out from subaqueous volcanoes.
column2: 格列瓦哈的岛屿与生命共生，漂浮在行星的海洋上，这一现象由被困在多孔岩石中的氦与其他气体造成——它们从水下火山喷涌而出。ZH

column1: Glitnir was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Glitnir在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Glory is a remote world known for its low mountains, sparse and runty vegetation, and its breathable air.
column2: Glory是一颗偏远的星球，以其低矮的山脉、稀疏且矮小的植被以及可供呼吸的空气而闻名.

column1: Gniezno was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Gniezno在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Goat Path is so named due to the rocky terrain of the world that renders conventional vehicles useless. Combat on this world must be conducted using aircraft or bipedal transport.
column2: Goat Path之所以得名，是因为该星球遍布岩石的地形使常规车辆毫无用处. 在这个星球上的战斗必须使用飞行器或双足车辆进行.

column1: A small rocky planet in the Lagrange point of a gas giant. The planet has no atmosphere, but incredibly there is life here, living in large underground reservoirs of water
column2: 一颗位于气态巨行星拉格朗日点的小型岩质行星. 这颗行星没有大气层，但令人难以置信的是，这里有生命存在，它们生活在巨大的地下水储层中.

column1: Goetville is a world consisting mostly of carbon, with a dense diamond core. Several mines on the surface extract diamonds from beneath the surface, making the planet a major source of wealth.
column2: Goetville是一个主要由碳构成的星球，拥有致密的钻石核心. 地表的几座矿场从地表之下开采钻石，使这颗行星成为主要的财富来源.

column1: Goito has five continents, Mantovana where the capital city Gonzaga is located, Rodigo, Volta, Roverbella and Marmirolo.
column2: Goito有五块大陆，分别是Mantovana（首都Gonzaga所在地）、Rodigo、Volta、Roverbella和Marmirolo.

column1: Golandrinas is what is called an Eyeball or 'tidally locked' planet. As such Golandrinas does not have a day/night cycle but a fixed day side and night side.
column2: 戈兰德利纳斯是一颗所谓的“眼球”或“潮汐锁定”星球。因此它没有昼夜循环，只有固定的白昼面与黑夜面。ZH

column1: Goldlure was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Goldlure在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Gomeisa was a heavily contested world centuries ago during the Age of War, and still bears the pockmarks of war to this day.
column2: Gomeisa在数百年前的战争时代曾是一个争夺激烈的星球，至今仍留有战争的疮痍.

column1: Goodna's vast forests filled with wildlife make this known as a planet filled with rare edible delicacies.
column2: 古德纳广袤的森林里满是野生动植物，因此这里被认为是充满珍稀食材的行星。ZH

column1: Gorfynt was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Gorfynt在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Gorgon was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Gorgon在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Gorki was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Gorki在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Goshen has been a hotly contested world during the Succession Wars thanks to its raw materials and arable land.
column2: 在继承战争期间，Goshen因其原材料和可耕地而成为一个激烈争夺的世界.

column1: Goslar is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League, exporting goods to other Hanseatic worlds.
column2: Goslar是构成名为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家的世界之一，向其他汉萨世界出口货物.

column1: Goth Khakar is a world consisting mostly of harsh jagged plateaus, with a dense mineral core that heats up the surface. Several mines on the surface extract material from beneath the surface, providing the planet with a major source of wealth.
column2: Goth Khakar是一个主要由崎岖嶙峋的高原组成的世界，其致密的矿物核心使地表升温. 地表的若干矿场从地表之下开采物质，为这颗行星提供了主要财富来源.

column1: Once a glorious world in the Rim Worlds Republic, the colony was devastated during the Amaris Civil War and remains stuck in a nuclear winter. Now the scant population remaining either herds local reindeer or supports nearby pirate activities.
column2: 曾是边缘世界共和国一颗荣耀的世界，该殖民地在阿马里斯内战期间遭到毁灭，至今仍困于核冬天. 如今，仅存的稀少人口要么放牧当地驯鹿，要么支持附近的海盗活动.
