column1: The Goubellat system colonized during the First Exodus from Terra. Then it became a border world between the Draconis Combine and the Outworlds Alliance. In 26th century The SLDF marshalled the Forty-second Brigade on Goubellat prior to the invasion.
column2: Goubellat星系在第一次从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间被殖民. 随后它成为天龙联合体与外域联盟之间的边境世界. 在26世纪，SLDF在入侵前于Goubellat集结了第42旅.

column1: Gouderak has a very arid and oppressively hot climate, and has at least two major continents, named Ayles and Halton. Water problems continue to plague settlements here.
column2: Gouderak气候极其干旱且酷热难耐，至少有两个主要大陆，分别名为Ayles和Halton. 水源问题持续困扰着这里的定居点.

column1: Malthus Gambling Unlimited is rumoured to control the local government on the planet, which is known for its lax tax measures and black market supplies.
column2: 据传，Malthus Gambling Unlimited控制着该行星的地方政府，该行星以宽松的税收措施和黑市供应而闻名.

column1: Graham once supported significant military manufacturing capabilities. Unfortunately, this made the planet a target for WMD attacks during the 1st Succession War. With the atmosphere tainted, most inhabitants have left over the centuries.
column2: Graham曾拥有重要的军事制造能力. 不幸的是，这使这颗行星在第一次继承战争期间成为了大规模杀伤性武器攻击的目标. 由于大气受到污染，几个世纪以来，大多数居民已经离开.

column1: The gojo harvest attracts traders every year, as it is known for its usage in high end recipes and potent alcoholic spirit.
column2: gojo的丰收每年都吸引着商人，因为它以被用于高端食谱和烈性酒而闻名.

column1: Gran was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Gran在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The sole factory world amongst the region known as Nueva Castile, it is also home to many governmental buildings.
column2: 在被称为新卡斯蒂利亚的地区中，它是唯一的工厂世界，也是许多政府建筑的所在地.

column1: Grand Base is home to an Earthwerks Ltd. 'Mech production facility; the 2nd largest such factory in the Capellan Confederation. Warrior House Fujita defends this critical facility which produces Shadow Hawks, Griffins, and Cataphracts for the CCAF.
column2: 大基地是地球工厂有限公司一处机甲生产设施所在地，也是卡佩兰联邦第二大同类工厂。藤田武士团守卫着这座关键设施，它为CCAF生产影子鹰、狮鹫与甲胄骑兵。ZH

column1: Granera has not been strategically important since the Reunification War, when it was a supply depot for SLDF forces deployed against the Magistracy. It is a minor Marik colony world now, with a small but growing population.
column2: 自统一战争以来，格拉内拉在战略上就不重要了，当时它是部署在自治区面前的星际联盟防卫军的补给站. 现在它是一颗较小的马里克殖民星球，人口虽少却在不断增长.

column1: Grankum was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Grankum在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Grant's Station is home to a terrestrial world, rich with minerals and water.
column2: 格兰特站拥有一颗陆地行星，矿产与水资源丰富。ZH

column1: Graus is the innermost planet of the system, and has a notable dust ring. During the 2980s, the local government banned all heavy military equipment from the surface.
column2: Graus是该星系最内侧的行星，拥有一个显眼的尘埃环. 在2980年代，当地政府禁止所有重型军事装备出现在其地表.

column1: The failure of its Star League terraforming technology has caused much of its water to evaporate. Nonetheless, Gravenhage still hosts a sizable military presence and training facility. It is also a popular destination for LosTech prospectors.
column2: 其星际联盟地球化改造技术的失败导致大部分水体蒸发. 尽管如此，Gravenhage仍驻有相当规模的军事力量和训练设施. 这里也是失落科技探矿者的热门目的地.

column1: Gravensteen was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Gravensteen是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Graz was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Graz于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Named originally after a massive canyon that spans the southern hemisphere, Great Gorge has flourished over the centuries as the ecology has adapted to Terran vegetation.
column2: Great Gorge最初得名于一条横跨南半球的巨大峡谷，几个世纪以来，随着生态系统适应了地球植被，这里已繁荣兴旺.

column1: Great X has two moons, Y and Z. It has spent most of its history being a waypoint on the way to the front lines.
column2: Great X有两颗卫星，Y和Z. 在其历史的大部分时间里，它一直是通往前线途中的一个中转站.

column1: Most of Greeley is covered by arctic tundras. The planet's extreme axial tilt and small star ensure that it will always be cold.
column2: 格里利的大部分被北极冻原覆盖。该行星极端的转轴倾角和微小的恒星确保它永远是寒冷的。ZH

column1: The Greenlaw system was settled during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the Protectorate of Donegal prior to the formation of the Lyran Commonwealth.
column2: Greenlaw星系在第一次从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民，并且在天琴共同体成立之前曾是多尼戈尔保护国的一员.

column1: Until the Third Succession War the Clayborne system was known by the name Green Stone due to the vast jade deposits under the surface which were heavily mined.
column2: 直到第三次继承战争之前，Clayborne星系因地下蕴藏着大量并曾被大规模开采的翡翠矿藏，而被称为Green Stone.

column1: Greifswald is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League, exporting goods to other Hanseatic worlds.
column2: Greifswald是构成被称为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家的世界之一，向其他汉萨同盟世界出口货物.

column1: Greypearl was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Greypearl在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The Griffith system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War. It houses small but important weapons manufacturers which utilise the low temperatures to refine circuitry.
column2: Griffith星系在统一战争结束后的某个时候、于星际联盟时代被殖民. 该星系拥有规模虽小但重要的武器制造商，它们利用低温来精炼电路.

column1: Grobin was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Grobin是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被定居的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Gronholt is an impoverished system, with little in the way of mineral wealth or resources.
column2: Gronholt是一个贫困的星系，几乎没有矿产资源或财富.

column1: Grootfontein was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Grootfontein在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Grossbach is an impoverished system, with little in the way of mineral wealth or resources.
column2: Grossbach是一个贫困的星系，几乎没有什么矿产资源或财富.

column1: The Grosvenor system was colonized during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War. Its capital city, Andreas, houses numerous bureaucratic offices for nearby worlds.
column2: Grosvenor星系是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民的. 其首府安德烈亚斯设有众多为附近世界服务的行政办公室.

column1: Groveld III is an arid world, with short days. Notable terrain features on Groveld III include a desert named the Vashner Flats, a region surrounded by badlands, the ancient battlefield of the Viking Flats and the St. Adrian Plains.
column2: Groveld III是一颗干旱星球，白昼短暂. Groveld III上显著的地形特征包括一片名为瓦什纳平原的沙漠、一片被荒地环绕的区域、维京平原的古战场，以及圣阿德里安平原.

column1: Grumium is home to the Frihet Training Facility, which trains conventional forces and MechWarriors from nearby worlds. Grumium Creations is based here, a recent manufacturing with many products.
column2: Grumium是Frihet训练设施的所在地，该设施负责训练来自附近星球的常规部队和机甲战士. Grumium Creations也设在这里，这是一家新近成立、产品种类繁多的制造企业.

column1: The Grunwald system was settled during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the Protectorate of Donegal prior to the formation of the Lyran Commonwealth.
column2: Grunwald星系在第一次泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民，并在天琴共同体成立之前是多尼戈尔保护国的一员.

column1: Gruyeres was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Gruyeres在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Guangzho was settled during the Exodus from Terra by settlers from China.
column2: Guangzho是在从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间，由来自中国的定居者开拓定居的.

column1: The Guatavita system was settled by the Lyran Commonwealth at some point during or shortly before the Age of War.
column2: Guatavita星系在战争时代期间或稍早的某个时候被天琴共同体殖民.

column1: The ancestral home of House Madeira, Guldra is the most Earth-like planet in the entire Aurigan region, and is a major breadbasket for the area. Massive cities house a total population just over a billion, and exporting food has made Guldra an extremely wealthy, diverse, sophisticated world.
column2: 古尔德拉是马德拉家族的母星，是整个御夫座地区最像地球的行星，也是该地区的一大面包篮子. 大城市安置了超过10亿的人口，而食品出口则让古尔德拉成为一颗极为富裕，多样化，发达的星球.

column1: Gulkana has a single continent, Pangaea, and the majority of Gulkana's surface is barren, rocky, and devoid of native life due to its harsh, arid climate. It is home to Yeffters Weapons Factory.
column2: 古尔卡纳只有一块大陆——泛大陆，而它地表的大部分因严酷干旱的气候而是荒芜的岩石，没有原生生命。它是耶夫特斯武器厂的所在地。ZH

column1: Gunthar is a pleasant world covered in water. The major cities are all built on the rocky coastlines of the single small continent; however, a spray of islands in a planet-girdling archipelago support a vast agricultural enterprise.
column2: 冈萨尔是一个被水覆盖的舒适星球. 主要城市都建在唯一一小块大陆的岩质海岸线上; 然而在环绕行星的列岛中，有一群岛屿支撑着一个巨大的农业企业.

column1: The Gunzburg system was settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War. The planet is still recovering from damage from the First Succession War.
column2: Gunzburg星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期由天琴共同体殖民. 该星球仍在从第一次继承战争造成的破坏中恢复.

column1: Gurgaldar is located in the anti-spinward region of the Deep Periphery between the Vul Rift and the Eagle Cloud Complex.
column2: Gurgaldar位于深空外围的逆旋向区域，介于Vul裂谷与鹰云复合体之间.

column1: The Gurnet system was colonized at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Gurnet星系是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的.

column1: The Gurrnazovo system was settled during the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the United Hindu Collective prior to the Collective joining the Federated Suns.
column2: Gurrnazovo星系是在第一次从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间被殖民的，并且在联合印度教集体加入恒星联邦之前，曾是该集体的成员.

column1: A heavily forested world, Gustrell offers agricultural produce to nearby worlds.
column2: Gustrell是一个森林茂密的世界，向附近的世界供应农产品.

column1: According to the latest Interstellar Expeditions charts, Gwithian is a colony world located in the Deep Periphery.
column2: 根据最新的星际远征星图，Gwithian是位于深空外围的一个殖民世界.

column1: Gwynedd was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Gwynedd在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战斗中消亡.

column1: The Gypsum system was settled during the First Exodus from Terra.
column2: Gypsum星系是在第一次从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间被殖民的.

column1: The Haappajarvi system was colonised during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Haappajarvi星系是在星际联盟时代，统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的.

column1: A system rich in resources and with a strong industry. Its 3.6 billion inhabitants enjoy comparatively more freedoms than most Draconians do. It's known for an excessive night life, its high crime rate & several high ranking Yakuza as overt chairmen.
column2: 一个资源丰富、工业强大的星系。它的36亿居民享有的自由比大多数龙尼斯人多。它以过度的夜生活、高犯罪率，以及若干公开担任董事长的黑帮高层闻名。ZH

column1: Haddings was devastated by WMDs during the Amaris Civil War, to the point the planet disappeared off star charts. ComStar rediscovered it in 3028 and found it populated by small communities living at an approximately 17th century level of technology.
column2: Haddings在阿马里斯内战期间被大规模杀伤性武器摧毁，以至于这颗行星从星图上消失了. 通讯之星于 3028 年重新发现了它，并发现其上居住着一些小型社区，其技术水平大约相当于 17 世纪.

column1: The Hadnall system was colonised during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra.
column2: Hadnall星系是在第一次泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民的.

column1: Haerhbin was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Haerhbin是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Haggard was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Haggard是在统一战争结束后的星盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: The Hagiwawa system was colonised during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra. It was a member of the Alliance of Galedon before joining the Draconis Combine.
column2: Hagiwawa星系是在从泰拉出发的第一次大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民的. 它在加入德拉科尼斯联合体之前，曾是加勒顿联盟的成员.

column1: The Hahira system was colonised during the Star League era at some time after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Hahira星系是在星际联盟时代，统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的.

column1: The Hainfeld system was colonised during the Star League era at some time after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Hainfeld星系是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的.

column1: Hakkaido was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Hakkaido于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: The Halesowen system was colonised during the Star League era at some time after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Halesowen星系是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的.

column1: Halfway is best described as a barely-habitable rock. With only primitive, fern-like vegetation as the highest form of life, Halfway has largely been a stopover point for travelers for centuries.
column2: Halfway最好被描述为一块勉强可居住的岩质星球. 由于最高等的生命形式只是原始、类似蕨类的植被，数个世纪以来，Halfway在很大程度上一直是旅行者的中途落脚点.

column1: Halgrim was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Halgrim是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Halifax was originally a part of the Timbuktu Province of the Rim Worlds Republic though was almost abandoned during the Republic-Commonwealth war. It is now used as a base of operation for exploration teams.
column2: Halifax最初是边缘世界共和国的Timbuktu省的一部分，但在共和国-共同体战争期间几乎被废弃. 如今它被用作勘探团队的行动基地.

column1: Most of the population live an agricultural lifestyle maintained by technology of an equivalent to that found on Terra in the late eighteenth, a consequence of the heavy influence of the Omniss philosophy within the Compact
column2: 大多数人口过着农业生活方式，其维持技术相当于十八世纪晚期在泰拉上所见的技术，这是盟约国内部Omniss哲学强烈影响的结果.

column1: Hall is a populous planet with a significant agricultural sector as well as a large light industrial base. Only recently lost by the Capellan Confederation, a battalion of Wolf's Dragoons currently makes up part of the planetary garrison.
column2: 霍尔是一颗人口稠密的星球，拥有可观的农业部门以及庞大的轻工业基础。它最近刚被卡佩兰联邦丢掉，目前有一营狼之龙骑兵构成行星驻军的一部分。ZH

column1: Halla was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Halla是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: A bleak and frozen world, Halloran has nonetheless hosted considerable mining and manufacturing industries since its colonization, exporting large quantities of ice, copper, and hydrocarbons to other worlds.
column2: 一个荒凉冰封的世界，Halloran自殖民以来nonetheless? 不对. 翻译:一个荒凉冰封的世界，Halloran自殖民以来仍发展起了可观的采矿和制造业，向其他世界出口大量冰、铜和碳氢化合物.

column1: The Halmyre Deans system was colonised during the Star League era at some time after the end of the Reunification War. They are known for their multi million c-bill production line which exports Halmyre Beans to nearby worlds.
column2: Halmyre Deans星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民. 该星系以产值达数百万C-币、向附近世界出口Halmyre豆的生产线而闻名.

column1: Halstead Station is a world settled exclusively for its vast mineral resources. The atmosphere is toxic, so the population lives in vast underground cities.
column2: Halstead Station是一个专为其丰富矿产资源而有人定居的世界. 大气有毒，因此居民生活在巨大的地下城市中.

column1: Hamal was originally colonised by settlers from the highland regions of South America on Terra. Hamal have passed from a Capellan to the Federated Suns during the Fourth Succession War. Most of the population live in a tribal, nomadic fashion.
column2: Hamal最初由来自泰拉南美洲高地地区的定居者殖民. 在第四次继承战争期间，Hamal从卡佩拉邦联转归恒星联邦. 大多数人口以部落、游牧方式生活.

column1: Hamar was settled by the JàrnFòlk because of the large metal deposits and other raw materials located there. The mining communities are dependent on special equipment to generate a livable environment for the workers and on food produced by the farming communities found in the lowlands.
column2: 铁民联盟因当地拥有大量金属矿藏和其他原材料而在Hamar定居. 采矿社区依赖特殊设备为工人营造宜居环境，并依赖低地农业社区生产的食物.

column1: Hamburg is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League, exporting goods to other Hanseatic worlds.
column2: Hamburg是组成被称为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家的世界之一，向其他汉萨同盟世界出口商品.

column1: Hamilton was one of some fifty-one heavily contested worlds to have been placed under Terran Hegemony authority as a jointly-administered world during the Age of War or Star League era, and was almost wiped out during the First Succession War.
column2: Hamilton是战争时代或星际联盟时代被置于泰拉霸权管辖之下、作为共管世界的大约五十一个激烈争夺世界之一，并在第一次继承战争中几乎被彻底摧毁.

column1: The planetary capital city, Triergart, is located west of Lake Carivorn which is renown for its boating tourism.
column2: 行星首府特里尔加特位于卡里沃恩湖以西，该湖以划船旅游而闻名.

column1: Most of Hammer is covered by arctic tundras. The planet's extreme axial tilt and small star ensure that it will always be cold.
column2: 锤星的大部分被北极冻原覆盖。该行星极端的转轴倾角和微小的恒星确保它永远是寒冷的。ZH

column1: Handa is a favorite retirement spot thanks to its warm climate and arable land.
column2: Handa因其温暖的气候和可耕地而成为备受青睐的退休之地.

column1: Saxe-Heidelberg Heavy Industries and People's Protection form the industrial backbone of Hanover, which exports its products across the Inner Sphere.
column2: 萨克森-海德堡重工业与人民保护组织构成了汉诺威的工业脊梁，该行星的产品出口遍及内天体。ZH

column1: Hanseta was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Hanseta在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Harbin was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Harbin在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Hardcore is a warm and temperate world that is home to Fox Infantry Systems, a major manufacturer.
column2: Hardcore是一个温暖且气候温和的世界，是主要制造商Fox Infantry Systems的所在地.

column1: A singular continent makes up the landmass on this watery world, known for its native Water Horse.
column2: 这个水世界由单一大陆构成其陆地，因当地原生的水马而闻名.

column1: Harlez was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Harlez是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: A minor world in the Capellan Confederation, Harloc's prosperity is limited by its reliance on food imports.
column2: 作为卡佩兰联邦的一颗次要行星，哈洛克因依赖粮食进口而繁荣有限。ZH

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Harminous was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison who were experts in amphibious operations.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Harminous驻扎着一支精通两栖作战的星际联盟防卫军守备部队.

column1: Harmony MetalWorks has recently acquired a repair and refit center from SelaSys Incorporated, and have begun to produce Mech parts.
column2: Harmony MetalWorks最近从SelaSys Incorporated手中收购了一处维修与改装中心，并已开始生产机甲部件.

column1: The Harpster system was colonised during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra.
column2: Harpster星系是在第一次从泰拉向外大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民的.

column1: Harris is a surface garrison within the Deep Periphery, near Trinity and P3.
column2: Harris是深空外围内的一个地表驻军，靠近Trinity和P3.

column1: Harrow's Sun is a developed world that has been invaded numerous times due to its rich mineral wealth and fertile lands.
column2: 哈罗之阳是一颗发达世界，因丰富的矿产与肥沃土地而屡遭入侵。ZH

column1: The Harsefield system was colonised during the Star League era, however lost much of its technological base during the First Succession War, from which it is only just recovering.
column2: Harsefield星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，但在第一次继承战争期间失去了大部分技术基础，如今才刚刚开始从中恢复.

column1: The Hartshill system was colonised at some point during or immediately prior to the Age of War.
column2: Hartshill星系在战争时代期间或紧接其之前的某个时候被殖民.

column1: The continent of Ohio is the location of most of Harvest's major cities and agricultural industries.
column2: 俄亥俄大陆是哈维斯特大多数主要城市与农业产业的所在地。ZH

column1: A water rich world, Hassad survived the First Succession War intact only to fall victim to seismic activity which caused massive tsunamis which reduced much of the settlement to rubble.
column2: 一个水资源丰富的世界，Hassad在第一次继承战争中原封不动地幸存下来，却沦为地震活动的受害者，地震活动引发了大规模海啸，将大部分定居点化为瓦砾.

column1: Hassi R'Mel was colonized during the formation of the Star League. The system is the primary stop for ships leaving the Draconis Rift in an area of space with few habitable worlds.
column2: 哈西尔梅尔在星盟形成期间被殖民。对于离开龙尼斯裂隙的舰船来说，该星系是那片缺少宜居世界的太空中主要的落脚点。ZH

column1: The wasteland planet of Hastur is primarily a prison world, with the major city, Lockdown, functioning as a city-sized penal colony. Prisoners provide slave labor for the planet's dangerous mining industry.
column2: 荒原行星哈斯特主要是一颗监狱行星，其主要城市"封锁"发挥着城市规模流放地的作用。囚犯为该行星危险的采矿业提供奴工。ZH

column1: Haublan was once a failed colony world inside the borders of the Rim Worlds Republic, before being abandoned to its own devices. Now the world is ruled by the remains of an Agricorp, a pirate band and the few nobles who are left.
column2: Haublan曾是边缘世界共和国境内一个殖民失败的世界，后来被弃置，任其自生自灭. 如今，这个世界由一家农业公司的残部、一伙海盗以及仅存的少数贵族统治着.

column1: Prisoners assigned to the harsh landscape of Havdhem tend not to complain for long. The average life span is measured in months.
column2: 被分配到Havdhem严酷环境中的囚犯往往不会抱怨太久. 平均寿命以月计算.

column1: Hawktor was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Hawktor在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: A large rocky planet with high gravity and a thin atmosphere. The atmosphere only extends about three miles above sea level, and many mountain tops are exposed to the vacuum of space.
column2: 一颗巨大的岩质行星，重力很高，大气稀薄. 大气层仅延伸至海平面以上约三英里，许多山峰暴露在太空真空中.

column1: Hazeldean was colonised at the start of the Star League era, thanks to its abundance of arable land.
column2: Hazeldean在星际联盟时代初期被殖民，这得益于其拥有大量可耕地.

column1: The Hazelhurst system was colonized during or at some point prior to the Age of War, and prior to the Reunification War was a member of the Outworlds Alliance.
column2: Hazelhurst星系在战争时代期间或之前的某个时候被殖民，并且在统一战争之前是外域联盟的成员.

column1: The Hean system was colonised during the First Exodus from Terra, and may have been one of the worlds rendered independent as a result of the Demarcation Declaration. Hean subsequently joined or was annexed by the Terran Hegemony prior to the Age of War.
column2: Hean星系在从泰拉出发的第一次大迁徙期间被殖民，并且可能是因《分界宣言》而获得独立的世界之一. Hean随后在战争时代之前加入或被泰拉霸权吞并.

column1: Heart Fjord was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Heart Fjord在星联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Heathville was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Heathville在统一战争结束后、星际联盟时代的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: The Hecheng system was settled at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Hecheng星系是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民的.

column1: Hechnar was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Hechnar在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某时被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: One of the first worlds colonized after the landing on Strana Mechty, Hector is a frigid world. It is home to the Ice Hellion, a cunning pack predator of the world's snowy mountains, which preyed on the first Clan explorers.
column2: 赫克托是登陆斯特拉纳·麦赫蒂之后最早被殖民的行星之一，是一颗严寒的世界。它是冰地狱蜥的家园——一种狡黠的群猎掠食者，栖息于该行星的雪山之中，曾猎食最早的氏族探险者。ZH

column1: The Hednesford system was settled at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Hednesford星系是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的.

column1: Hegel was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Hegel是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Heidelburg was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Heidelburg在统一战争结束后的某个时候、星际联盟时代被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡.

column1: Heidrunn is located in the anti-spinward region of the Deep Periphery and at almost nineteen hundred light-years distant from Terra is one of the farthest-flung inhabited systems to have been identified by Interstellar Expeditions.
column2: Heidrunn位于深空外围的反旋臂区域，距离泰拉近一千九百光年，是星际探险组织已确认的最遥远有人居住星系之一.

column1: Was colonized during the Age of War by Lyran Commonwealth. The name seems to be a misspelling of Heiligenkreuz (German, roughly translates as \"Saint's Cross\").
column2: 在战火时代由莱兰联邦殖民。这个名字似乎是Heiligenkreuz的拼写错误（德语，大致意为"圣十字"）。ZH

column1: Originally known as the Helbrent system, the colony was annihilated during the Second Succession War. It was recolonised as the Andiron system a century later.
column2: 最初被称为Helbrent星系，该殖民地于第二次继承战争期间被彻底毁灭. 一个世纪后，它作为Andiron星系被重新殖民.

column1: Helduza was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Helduza在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Originally a wealthy world, the population of Helen was exterminated by Amaris forces during the Amaris Civil War. It has not recovered.
column2: Helen原本是一个富庶的世界，但在阿马里斯内战期间，其人口被阿马里斯军队灭绝. 它至今仍未恢复.

column1: Heliat is a pleasant agricultural world, but also a backwater, thanks to its position away from all major trade routes. This relative isolation has led to an insular, conservative culture, centered around the local offshoot of Catholicism.
column2: 赫利亚特是一颗宜人的农业星球，但也是个闭塞的地方，这要感谢它的位置远离所有的主要贸易路线. 这种相对的隔绝导致了一种孤立而保守的文化，它以天主教在当地的分支为中心.

column1: The capital city of Helio is surrounded by verdant green hills, making it a popular world in brochures.
column2: Helio的首府四周环绕着郁郁葱葱的绿色丘陵，使其成为宣传册中广受欢迎的星球.

column1: Helios features diverse geological features and environments that makes the world capable of supporting a thriving population.
column2: Helios拥有丰富多样的地质特征和环境，使这颗星球能够支撑繁荣的人口.

column1: Helixmar was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Helixmar于星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Helland was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Helland是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Despite its location far from the Inner Sphere, Hellespont is a rich, high-tech manufacturing world. The headquarters of the ComStar Explorer Corps (Rimward) is located on the planet, and the infrastructure necessary for ComStar's operations has led to prosperity and investment.
column2: 尽管位置远离内天体，赫勒斯滂却是一颗富庶的高科技制造行星。康星探索军团（核心方向）的总部就位于该行星，而康星运作所需的基础设施带来了繁荣与投资。ZH

column1: Hellgate is a volcanic world with an atmosphere tainted by sulfur. Life can only exist on Hellgate within huge, translucent domes that cover most major installations.
column2: Hellgate是一颗火山星球，大气被硫磺污染. 生命只能存在于Hellgate上那些覆盖了大部分主要设施的巨型半透明穹顶之内.

column1: Hellos Minor orbits a large gas giant, and was colonised at the start of the Star League era, thanks to its abundance of arable land.
column2: Hellos Minor环绕着一颗巨大的气态巨行星运行，并在星盟时代之初因可耕地丰富而被殖民.

column1: Hell's Paradise was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: 地狱天堂是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中灭亡。ZH

column1: Helm was an SLDF logistical depot long time ago. Was known for being the site of the discovery of the Helm Memory Core in 3028 by the Gray Death Legion. The Memory Core triggered the technological renaissance of the mid-31st century.
column2: Helm在很久以前曾是SLDF的一处后勤补给站. 它因是3028年灰死军团发现Helm记忆核心的地点而闻名. 该记忆核心引发了31世纪中叶的技术复兴.

column1: The Helsingfors system was colonised during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra. It was a member of the Alliance of Galedon before joining the Draconis Combine.
column2: Helsingfors星系是在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民的. 在加入天龙联合体之前，它曾是加勒顿联盟的成员.

column1: Ninety percent of the population of Helvetia lives an agricultural lifestyle maintained by technology of an equivalent to that found on Terra in the late eighteenth century, a consequence of the heavy influence of the Omniss philosophy within the Compact.
column2: Helvetia百分之九十的人口过着农业生活方式，这种生活方式由相当于18世纪末泰拉上技术水平的科技维持，这是Omniss哲学在盟约国产生重大影响的结果.

column1: Helvetica was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Helvetica在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: The Hephzibah system was colonised during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Hephzibah星系是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的.

column1: Herat (FS) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Herat (FS) 是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Herbania was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Herbania在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Here is home to a vast ancient catacomb system, due the millions of deaths during the Reunification War.
column2: 由于统一战争期间数百万人的死亡，这里成为了庞大古老地下墓穴系统的所在地.

column1: Hergazil was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Hergazil在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: The Hermagor system was colonised during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Hermagor星系是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的.

column1: The Herndon system was colonised during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Herndon星系是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的.

column1: Herotitus is famed for its planet-wide pleasure industry; it is a sought-after vacation and recreational world. This hedonism exists side-by-side with the original agricultural colonists, who are largely puritanical and staid.
column2: 希罗提多因其遍布星球的娱乐产业闻名; 这是颗炙手可热的度假与休闲之星. 这种享乐主义和那些古板的清教徒原始农业殖民者共存.

column1: Herrmaz was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Herrmaz在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Andrea County Armor Yards and Kaiser Systems both employ or contract with a large portion of Herzbergs population
column2: Andrea County Armor Yards和Kaiser Systems均雇佣或与Herzberg的大部分人口签订合约.

column1: Hè-shì was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Hè-shì在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: The Hesperus system is one of the most important manufacturing system in the Lyran Commonwealth. It has many production lines for battlemechs, including one of the last few in the Inner Sphere that can produce new Atlases for the ever expanding LCAF
column2: Hesperus星系是天琴共同体最重要的制造星系之一. 它拥有许多战斗机甲生产线，其中包括内天体所剩无几的、能够为不断扩张的天琴共同体武装部队生产新型阿特拉斯的生产线之一.

column1: The Herndon system was colonised during the Exodus from Terra, and was part of the Sian Commonwealth before joining the Capellan Confederation.
column2: Herndon星系在从泰拉出走期间被殖民，并在加入卡佩拉邦联之前是锡安共同体的一部分.

column1: Hiberius was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Hiberius是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Most of the population of Hibernia lives an agricultural lifestyle maintained by technology of an equivalent to that found on Terra in the late eighteenth century, a consequence of the heavy influence of the Omniss philosophy within the Compact.
column2: Hibernia的大部分人口过着农业生活方式，这种生活方式由相当于泰拉在18世纪晚期所拥有的技术来维持，这是盟约国Omniss哲学强烈影响的结果.

column1: This lush forest world teems with diverse insect and plant life. Almost all this life, however, is highly toxic to humans, and the theocratic government has strict laws against entering the forest without protective gear.
column2: 这颗茂盛的森林星球充斥着多种多样的昆虫和植物. 然而，几乎所有的生命对人类都是有剧毒的，神权政府有着严格的法律，禁止在没有防护装备的情况下进入森林.

column1: The Hickok system was colonised during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Hickok星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民.

column1: Highspire II - more commonly known simply as Highspire - is the second planet in the system and has a single moon named Peak.
column2: Highspire II——更常被简称为Highspire——是该星系中的第二颗行星，只有一颗名为Peak的卫星.

column1: Hildaman was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Hildaman是在统一战争结束后的某个时候、于星际联盟时代被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的战斗中消亡了.

column1: The Herndon system was colonised during the Exodus from Terra, and was part of the Protectorate of Donegal before joining the Lyran Commonwealth.
column2: Herndon星系是在从泰拉大迁徙期间被殖民的，并在加入天琴共同体之前曾是多尼戈尔保护国的一部分.

column1: Originally named Himmels, the colony was devastated during the First Succession War, leaving a scant population to survive for centuries. During the Third Succession War, it came under the dominion of the Circinus Federation.
column2: 该殖民地最初名为Himmels，在第一次继承战争期间遭到毁灭性破坏，仅剩稀少的人口幸存下来并延续了数个世纪. 在第三次继承战争期间，它落入瑟西努斯联邦的统治之下.

column1: Those who have heard of Hinckley will often only know it for its geothermal swamps, though its therapeutic baths are meant to be some of the best in the Inner Sphere.
column2: 听说过Hinckley的人往往只会因为它那些地热沼泽而知道它，尽管据称它的疗养浴是内天体中数一数二的.

column1: Prior to the Fall of the Star League, Hindmarsh served as the homeport for the 7th Fleet (SLDF) of the Star League Navy. Many caches have been found over the centuries.
column2: 在星际联盟覆灭之前，Hindmarsh曾是星际联盟海军第7舰队（SLDF）的母港. 几个世纪以来，人们发现了许多储藏点.

column1: The Hiratsuka system was colonised during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, and remains an important colony due its exports of sulfur.
column2: Hiratsuka星系在统一战争结束后、星际联盟时代的某个时间点被殖民，并因其硫磺出口而仍然是一个重要的殖民地.

column1: Hirtshals was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Hirtshals于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: The hot surface of Hivrannee requires all colonists to wear environmental suits when outside the colony enclosure, however it does allow easy access to rare chemicals.
column2: Hivrannee灼热的地表要求所有殖民者在殖民地围护区外时必须穿着环境防护服，不过这也使得获取稀有化学品变得十分便利.

column1: A cold world, Hoard gets its name from the vast mineral wealth contained within the mountain regions which has barely been tapped.
column2: Hoard是一颗寒冷的星球，其得名于山区蕴藏的巨量矿产资源，而这些资源几乎尚未被开采.

column1: During the Succession Wars the Armed Forces of the Federated Suns used the caves on Hobbs as a giant warehouse for supplies and materiel, used to support units throughout the Capellan March. The native animals known as the Takooma viewed this as an intrusion into their habitat, and waged a guerilla war against the human intruders.
column2: 在继承战争期间，恒星联邦武装部队将Hobbs上的洞穴用作巨型仓库，储存补给和军用物资，用于支援整个卡佩拉边区的部队. 被称为Takooma的当地动物将此视为对其栖息地的侵入，并向人类入侵者发动了一场游击战.

column1: The Hobson system was colonised during or shortly before the Age of War, and had been incorporated into the Federated Suns by the beginning of the Reunification War.
column2: Hobson星系在战争时代期间或之前不久被殖民，并在统一战争开始时已并入恒星联邦.

column1: Hódmezovásárhely was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Hódmezovásárhely在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Hoensbroek was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Hoensbroek是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居的，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Hoff, sometimes called 'The Hoff', developed advanced industry prior to the Succession Wars. Crippled during the Succession Wars, The Hoff then became the home of the Friden Aerospace Park, which developed prototype double heat sinks.
column2: 霍夫，有时被称作"那个霍夫"，在继承战争之前发展了先进工业。它在继承战争中被重创，之后成为弗莱登航空航天园区的所在地，该园区研发了原型双重散热器。ZH

column1: With all bar a twentieth of the surface of Hofn covered by water, the JàrnFòlk who colonised the planet established subterranean settlements, away from the mighty storms that raged across the oceans.
column2: Hofn表面有二十分之十九被水覆盖，因此殖民这颗星球的铁民联盟在远离肆虐于各大洋的猛烈风暴之处建立了地下定居点.

column1: The Hohenems system was colonised during or shortly before the Age of War, and is an unremarkable world with calm weather and steady seasons ideal for agriculture.
column2: Hohenems星系在战争时代期间或之前不久被殖民，是一个平平无奇的世界，气候平和、季节稳定，非常适合农业.

column1: The world of Hollabrunn was re-colonized during the Star League era; originally having been colonized centuries earlier during the days of the Terran Alliance, the first colony was a casualty of the Age of War.
column2: Hollabrunn星球在星际联盟时代被重新殖民；它最初是在数个世纪前的泰拉联盟时期被殖民的，而第一个殖民地则成了战争年代的牺牲品.

column1: Holloway is home to the 2nd Battalion of Warrior House Fujita. Holloway is not an important world for raw materials or manufacturing, but it provides the Warrior House with an excellent base to conduct raiding operations against FedCom border worlds.
column2: Holloway是藤田武士团第二营的驻地. Holloway并非一个在原材料或制造业方面重要的世界，但它为武士团提供了一个极佳的基地，以便对联邦共同体边境世界展开袭扰行动.

column1: Colonists from the Federal Democratic Republics of Finland, Norway and Sweden emigrated in significant numbers to Holmsbu, and set up a colony based on their freedoms from Terra.
column2: 来自芬兰、挪威和瑞典联邦民主共和国的殖民者大量移民至Holmsbu，并建立了一个以他们从泰拉获得的自由为基础的殖民地.

column1: Holt was one of some fifty-one heavily contested worlds to have been placed under Terran Hegemony authority as a jointly-administered world during the Age of War or Star League era.
column2: 在战争时代或星际联盟时代，Holt是约五十一颗作为共管世界被置于泰拉霸权管辖之下的激烈争夺星球之一.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Homam was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年，Homam曾是星际联盟防卫军一支驻军的驻地.

column1: \"There is no such thing as a wrong opinion\" is the slogan of Kira Place, a premium center for education located on Home.
column2: 不存在错误观点这回事是基拉广场的口号——那是位于家园的一处高端教育中心。ZH

column1: The Homestead system was colonised during the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the Capellan Hegemony prior to the formation of the Capellan Confederation.
column2: The Homestead星系在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间被殖民，并且在卡佩拉邦联成立之前曾是卡佩拉霸权的一员.

column1: The Hongon system was colonised during the Star League era for its easily accessible gemstone deposits.
column2: Hongon星系在星际联盟时代因拥有易于开采的宝石矿藏而被殖民.

column1: Hongquio is notable for its steamy jungle environments, from natural boreholes located deep within the rainforests.
column2: Hongquio以其湿热的丛林环境而闻名，这种环境源自雨林深处的天然孔洞.

column1: The Hood system was colonised during the Star League era by the Rim Worlds Republic, until it was devastated during the Amaris Civil War. The recovery has been slow.
column2: The Hood星系在星际联盟时代被边缘世界共和国殖民，直到阿马里斯内战期间遭到毁灭性破坏. 其恢复一直缓慢.

column1: Following the discovery of rich gem and mineral deposits on Hoonar by teams from Gronholt, relations between the two worlds broke down substantially.
column2: 在来自Gronholt的队伍于Hoonar发现丰富的宝石与矿藏后，两个世界之间的关系急剧恶化.

column1: A remote Periphery world, Randis IV was unremarkable until an order of warrior monks decided to call it home. Many pirates have since been driven offworld, and it looks as though stability may finally have arrived at last.
column2: 一个偏远的边陲世界，Randis IV原本毫不起眼，直到一个战士修士教团决定在此安家. 此后，许多海盗被逐出该星球，看起来稳定终于可能降临了.

column1: Home of Marian Arms Incorperated, Horatius serves as one of the major industrial centers of the Marian Hegemony. It is the birth place of the Ravager and Marauder Battlearmour.
column2: 作为Marian Arms Incorperated的所在地，Horatius是马里安霸权的主要工业中心之一. 它是Ravager和Marauder战斗装甲的诞生地.

column1: Horgens is located in the rimward region of the Deep Periphery beyond the Perses-Cepherus Cloud Complex and the California Nebula, and has been identified by Interstellar Expeditions as the site for a possible colony.
column2: Horgens位于深空外围的外缘区域，在英仙座-仙王座星云复合体和加利福尼亚星云之外，并被星际探险组织认定为可能建立殖民地的地点.

column1: The Horneburg system was colonized during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the Protectorate of Donegal, prior to the formation of the Lyran Commonwealth in the mid-twenty-fourth century.
column2: Horneburg星系在泰拉第一次大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民，并且在24世纪中叶天琴共同体成立之前，是多尼戈尔保护国的一部分.

column1: Hornir's Keep was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: 霍尼尔的堡垒是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中灭亡。ZH

column1: Originally a Taurian world, Horsham boasted several Taurian Defense Force naval yards. During the Reunification War, Horsham was overrun by the SLDF, pacified, and taken by the Federated Suns. The total destruction of the naval yards was a crippling blow to the world's economy.
column2: 霍舍姆原本是陶里安的世界，曾拥有若干陶里安防卫军海军船坞。在统一战争期间，霍舍姆被SLDF攻占、平定，并被联邦太阳夺取。海军船坞的彻底摧毁是对该世界经济的致命打击。ZH

column1: The Hortense system was colonised at some point during or shortly before the Age of War. It was once home to the Grandin family, who have since been ousted.
column2: Hortense星系在战争时代期间或稍早的某个时候被殖民. 它曾是格兰丁家族的家园，但他们后来被驱逐了.

column1: The world was noted for its mineral water and for having sizable portion of its people of Black American and African descent from later half of the 28th century. Tectonically active, the planet has two continents that are covered in active volcanoes.
column2: 这个星球以其矿泉水闻名，并且自28世纪下半叶起，其人口中有相当大一部分具有美国黑人和非洲人血统. 该行星地壳活动活跃，拥有两个遍布活火山的大陆.

column1: Housekarle is a moderately prosperous world in the Capellan Confederation. A safe distance from the FedCom border and the presence of a working Recharge Station have made it a popular stop for shipping in the Confederation.
column2: Housekarle是卡佩拉邦联中一个中等繁荣的世界. 与联邦共同体边界保持着安全距离，再加上拥有一座正常运作的充电站，使其成为邦联内航运的热门停靠点.

column1: The Howick system was colonised during the Star League era due to the rich deposits of petroleum under its oceans.
column2: Howick星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，原因是其海洋下蕴藏着丰富的石油矿藏.

column1: The Howrah system was colonised during the Star League era due to the rich deposits of petroleum under its oceans.
column2: Howrah星系在星际联盟时代因海洋下丰富的石油矿藏而被殖民.

column1: Hoyleton is a successful agricultural world with a large temperate zone. Many ranches dot this zone where they are the center of a large processed meat industry, based on the Terran Buffalo and the native Hoyleton Forest Steer, that exported food to other star systems.
column2: Hoyleton是一个成功的农业世界，拥有大片温带区域. 许多牧场散布在这一区域，它们是大型加工肉类产业的中心，该产业以地球水牛和当地Hoyleton森林牛为基础，将食品出口到其他恒星系.

column1: Hrafn was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Hrafn在统一战争结束后的某个时间点于星盟时代被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Hsien was only recently integrated into the Federated Commonwealth, having been a Liao possession until 3029. It is heavily garrisoned in order to protect the significant mineral wealth of the planet.
column2: Hsien直到最近才被并入联邦共同体，在此之前直到3029年一直是廖氏的领地. 该星球驻有重兵，以保护其丰富的矿产资源.

column1: The Huaide system was colonised during the Star League era due to the rich deposits of rare gemstones found amidst its turbulent volcanic band.
column2: Huaide星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，因为在其动荡的火山带中发现了丰富的稀有宝石矿藏.

column1: Much of Huan's water was made toxic to human life by overmining, chemical dumping, and fallout from the Succession Wars, which is why the largest water-purification company in the Inner Sphere is headquartered here.
column2: 环星的许多水源因过度开采、化学倾倒和继承战争辐射尘而对人类有毒，这也是内天体最大的净水公司总部设在这里的原因。ZH

column1: The icy surface of Hudeiba is home to numerous mining facilities, as well as a nascent snow sports industry.
column2: Hudeiba的冰封地表上坐落着众多采矿设施，以及一个新兴的雪上运动产业.

column1: Huesta was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Huesta在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某一时期被建立定居点，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: The Humansville system was colonised at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Humansville星系在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民.

column1: Hunan is a large inhospitable mining colony which has earned itself the reputation for being possibly the last place in the Inner Sphere anyone would want to visit, let alone live.
column2: Hunan是一个大型且环境恶劣的采矿殖民地，它为自己赢得了这样的名声: 可能是内天体中任何人最不愿造访、更不用说居住的地方.

column1: Despite the industry present on Hun Ho, along with well over one and a half billion people, much of the planet remains a tropical paradise.
column2: 尽管Hun Ho上存在工业，且人口远超十五亿，这颗行星的大部分地区仍是热带天堂.

column1: Hunter's Paradise was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: 猎人天堂是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中灭亡。ZH

column1: The Huntington system was colonised at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: 在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代，Huntington星系在某个时候被殖民.

column1: Huntress is a hospitable world with two continents. The aptly named continent of Abysmal is a vast inhospitable desert wasteland, whilst the other is a terrestrial dream.
column2: Huntress是一个宜居的世界，拥有两块大陆. 被恰如其分地命名为Abysmal的大陆是一片广阔、不宜居的沙漠荒原，而另一块大陆则是人间乐土.

column1: Hurgh was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Hurgh在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Hurik is a garden world, its steep valleys and broad plains home to over one billion inhabitants. As the gateway to the Aurigan Reach, it is a nexus for trade and exploration, and supplies food and manufactured goods to all its neighbors.
column2: 赫里克是个园艺星球，它有着陡峭的山谷和广阔的平原，是超过10亿居民的故乡. 作为御夫座远邦的门户，它是贸易和勘探的枢纽，也为所有的邻星提供食品和制成品.

column1: The Huron system was colonised at some point during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra.
column2: Huron星系在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间的某个时候或之后不久被殖民.

column1: Hustaing is the long-time home of the 1st McCarron's Armored Cavalry. While a mercenary command, the 'Big Mac' has served House Liao for years; first against the Federated Suns and now against the St. Ives Compact.
column2: 胡斯泰因是麦卡伦第一装甲骑兵长期以来的驻地。虽然是雇佣兵部队，"大麦"多年来一直为廖家族效力；先是打联邦太阳，如今又打圣艾夫斯紧凑国。ZH

column1: The Hyades Cluster is a collection of stars within close proximity to each other. During the Reunification War it was home to vast shipyards, which have now been lost to war.
column2: Hyades Cluster是一组彼此距离很近的恒星. 在统一战争期间，这里曾是庞大造船厂的所在地，而这些造船厂如今已在战火中不复存在.

column1: Named after a Terran semi-precious stone, Hyalite was originally settled to gain access to chemical compounds and gemstones. Whilst the gemstone industry ran dry centuries ago, the chemical industry still remains strong with uses including munitions and propellant.
column2: Hyalite以地球的一种半宝石命名，最初建立定居点是为了获取化合物和宝石. 尽管宝石产业在几个世纪前就已枯竭，但化学工业依然发达，其用途包括弹药和推进剂.

column1: Zettle Metals Incorporated produces purified precious metals and industrial alloys for use in civilian, commercial and military industries from the rich metal mines on Hyde.
column2: Zettle Metals Incorporated利用Hyde上丰富的金属矿藏，生产用于民用、商业和军事工业的提纯贵金属与工业合金.

column1: Luthien Armor Works operates a large facility on Hyner. The thick cloud cover makes orbital surveillance difficult.
column2: 卢西恩装甲工厂在Hyner运营着一座大型设施. 厚厚的云层使轨道侦察变得困难.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Hyperion was the host of a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Hyperion曾是星际联盟防卫军一支守备部队的驻地.

column1: Massive herds of three-legged, brown beasts move across the planet in time with the seasons.
column2: 庞大的三足棕色兽群随着季节更替穿越这颗行星.

column1: Large homesteads cover the landscape of Ibstock, whilst the capital city of Torrick has a burgeoning textiles industry.
column2: 大型农庄遍布Ibstock的地貌，而Torrick的首府则拥有蓬勃发展的纺织业.

column1: The planet of Icar has most of its surface covered by water with two continents separated by a vast channel.
column2: Icar行星的大部分表面被水覆盖，两个大陆被一条宽阔的海峡隔开.

column1: Ichlangis is a Martian planet, with atmosphere too thin to breathe, no surface water, and temperature below freezing. The planet is rich in titanium, and the ores are made easily accessible by the deep chasms that crack the planet's surface.
column2: 伊奇兰吉斯是一颗火星般的行星：大气稀薄无法呼吸，地表无水，气温低于冰点。该星球富含钛，而撕裂地表的深峡谷让矿石易于开采。ZH

column1: Ichmandu was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ichmandu是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Ictus was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ictus是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The Ideyld system was colonised at some point during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra.
column2: Ideyld星系是在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间的某个时候或之后不久被殖民的.

column1: A quiet colony not far from the Periphery, Idlewind is a minor trading hub and a semi-popular base for independent Deep Periphery explorers.
column2: Idlewind是一个距外围不远的宁静殖民地，是一个小型贸易枢纽，也是独立深空外围探险者较为青睐的基地.

column1: The failing pirate haven on Idrmach received a new lease of life when a jumpship lost in time appeared in orbit bringing new colonists in 2811.
column2: Idrmach上日渐衰败的海盗避风港重获新生: 2811年，一艘迷失于时间中的跃迁舰出现在轨道上，带来了新的殖民者.

column1: Ife was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ife是在统一战争结束后的某个时候于星际联盟时代被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Igualada has a circular orbit around its primary, meaning seasonal and temperature variations are caused by the day/night cycle only.
column2: 伊瓜拉达沿其主星做圆周轨道运行，意味着季节与温度变化仅由昼夜循环造成。ZH

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Iijima was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Iijima曾是星际联盟防卫军一支驻军的驻地.

column1: The Ikast system was colonised at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Ikast星系在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民.

column1: The Iknogoro system was colonised during the Exodus from Terra. Now a thriving agrimarket world, its history was much more grim with the Iknogoro Famine of the 2400s.
column2: Iknogoro星系是在从泰拉大迁徙期间被殖民的. 如今它是一个繁荣的农业市场世界，但它的历史却因2400年代的Iknogoro饥荒而阴暗得多.

column1: Ildlandet was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ildlandet在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Ilion was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ilion于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡.

column1: Illium was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Illium是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Illushin is famed for its cheeses; its two continents feature vast fertile grasslands on which a variety of herd animals can be grazed. Large coastal spaceport cities ship luxury foods off-world, as well as manufactured goods and military supplies.
column2: 伊鲁申因其奶酪闻名; 它的两块大陆上有着广阔的肥沃草原，在那里可以放牧各种各样的牧群动物. 沿海的大型太空港城市将奢侈食品运出星球，一起运出的还有制成品和军用物资.

column1: Settled by the poorest nations, Illizi operates at a mid 20th century level of development.
column2: Illizi由最贫穷的国家殖民建立，发展水平相当于20世纪中期.

column1: Once the capital planet of the Illyrian Palatinate, for many years Illyria's inhabitants spent their time searching their world for Star League caches rumored to exist on the world.
column2: 伊利里亚曾是伊利里亚帕拉丁国的首都行星，多年来它的居民花费时间在自己的世界上搜寻据传存在的星盟储藏库。ZH

column1: Ilmachna was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ilmachna于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Ilmar was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ilmar是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战事中消亡了.

column1: Ilzra is home to numerous rice wine vineyards, which are exported across the Inner Sphere.
column2: Ilzra拥有众多米酒葡萄园，其产品出口到内天体各地.

column1: The Imalda system was colonised at some point during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the Sian Commonwealth prior to the founding of the Capellan Confederation
column2: Imalda星系在第一次泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民，并在卡佩拉邦联成立之前是锡安共同体的成员.

column1: Was colonized during the First Exodus from Terra. Was liberated in 2804-05 during the first major AFFS counter-offensive of the First Succession War against the Draconis Combine.
column2: 于第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间被殖民. 在第一次继承战争期间，AFFS对天龙联合体的首次大规模反攻中，于2804-05年获得解放.

column1: A fairly cold world, Imbros is only important due to its strategic positioning within 2 jumps of Terra, the Draconis Combine, the Free Worlds League, and both halves of the Federated Commonwealth.
column2: Imbros是一颗相当寒冷的世界，其重要性仅在于它的战略位置: 距泰拉、天龙联合体、自由世界联盟以及联邦共同体的两半都只有 2 次跳跃.

column1: The Immenstadt system was colonised at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War. Cold for much of the year, it has a strong hydroponic industry.
column2: Immenstadt星系在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民. 一年中大部分时间气候寒冷，拥有强大的水培产业.

column1: Ina was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ina在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Inarcs had a most unusual founding when it was selected as a Star League penal colony world sight unseen, after a clerical error in the twenty-fourth century incorrectly classified the comfortable planet as uninhabitable. Nowadays, it is a thriving hub of activity.
column2: Inarcs的建立过程极不寻常: 24世纪的一场文书错误将这颗环境宜人的行星误判为不宜居住，随后它便在无人实地考察的情况下被选为星际联盟的流放地星球. 如今，这里已是一个繁荣活跃的中心.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Inchicore was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Inchicore曾是星际联盟防卫军一支驻军的驻地.

column1: The Inculkalns system was colonised at some point during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra due to its rich mineral content.
column2: Inculkalns星系在从泰拉出发的第一次大迁徙期间或之后不久的某个时候，因其丰富的矿产资源而被殖民.

column1: Independence is a lush world, dominated by vast oceans and jungle-covered volcanic islands. The plutocratic government runs the planet primarily for recreational tourists, with the inhabitants regulated by a strict caste system.
column2: 自由星是一颗郁郁葱葱的星球，大片海洋和覆盖热带丛林的火山岛构成了其主要地貌. 其富豪统治政府主要将这颗星球作为观光度假用途来运营，同时以严格的种姓制度管理着本地居民.

column1: Indicass was settled by Ceres Metals Industries and the company invests a sizeable sum in ensuring the population is comfortable despite the planet's harsh climate. Ceres' plants on Indicass manufacture a variety of munitions and military vehicles.
column2: 因迪卡斯由刻瑞斯金属工业殖民，该公司投入可观资金确保人口在这颗气候严酷的行星上生活舒适。刻瑞斯在因迪卡斯的工厂生产多种弹药与军用车辆。ZH

column1: Indrapurai was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Indrapurai在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The Ingenstrem system was colonised at some point during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra.
column2: Ingenstrem星系在第一次泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久的某个时候被殖民了.

column1: Ingersoll is a very properous world, as not only is it widely believed to be the most beautiful in the entire Confederation but it also possesses large deposits of gold and silver ore.
column2: Ingersoll是一颗非常繁荣的星球，不仅被广泛认为是整个邦联中最美丽的世界，而且还拥有大量金矿和银矿矿藏.

column1: This bleak, rocky world was captured from the Capellans early in the First Succession War. The fierce fighting has left centuries-old ruins scattered around the surface, and scavengers still turn up valuable technology on occasion.
column2: 这颗荒凉的岩质星球在第一次继承战争早期就被人从卡佩拉人手里夺走了. 激烈的战斗在地表留下了星罗棋布的古老废墟，拾荒者们偶尔还能翻出有价值的技术.

column1: Ingress was one of the first worlds settled during the Terran Exodus. Its rich soil soon allowed the inhabitants to grow a great deal of food, far more than they needed. These crops remain the foundation of Ingress' economy, but the planet does have some light industry as well, making it totally self-sufficient.
column2: 因格瑞斯是地球出走期间最早被殖民的世界之一。它肥沃的土壤很快让居民种出大量粮食，远超所需。这些作物至今仍是因格瑞斯经济的基础，但该行星也有一些轻工业，使其完全自给自足。ZH

column1: The oldest inhabited system in the modern Chainelane Isles, Ingvolstand was once home to numerous huge manufacturing complexes which were destroyed during the Amaris Civil War. Nowadays it is ran by the Helena Collective, a matriarchal pirate band known for forcing men into servitude and many coming of age orgies. Less fun than it sounds.
column2: 现代钱莱恩群岛中最古老的有居民星系，Ingvolstand曾是众多巨大制造综合体的所在地，这些综合体在阿马里斯内战期间被摧毁. 如今它由Helena Collective统治，这是一个母权制海盗团伙，以强迫男性为奴和举行许多成年礼性狂欢而闻名. 没听起来那么有趣.

column1: The Inman system was colonised at some point prior to the end of the Age of War and known for its native wildlife that tastes suspiciously like chicken.
column2: Inman星系在战争时代结束前的某个时期被殖民，并因其本土野生动物而闻名，它们的味道可疑地像鸡肉.

column1: The Inner End system was colonized during or at some point prior to the Age of War, and prior to the Reunification War was a member of the Outworlds Alliance.
column2: The Inner End星系在战争时代期间或之前的某个时候被殖民，并且在统一战争之前是外世界联盟的成员.

column1: Inner Surge was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Inner Surge在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: This system is little more than a supply and operations base for Instellar Expeditions teams.
column2: 这个星系不过是Instellar Expeditions团队的补给与行动基地而已.

column1: Now known as Diedre's Den, the original colony of Iolas died out during the Second Succession War, and was claimed by colonists from the Circinus Federation who found an abandoned colony still in working order - just no people.
column2: 如今被称为迪德蕾巢穴的伊奥拉斯原始殖民地，在第二次继承战争期间灭亡，随后被来自奇尔奇努斯联邦的殖民者占有——他们发现了一处仍在运转、只是没有人的废弃殖民地。ZH

column1: Ionus has only one major continent, Ionus where the capital city Kargon is located. In orbit, the Illium Shipyards produce components vital for warship construction.
column2: Ionus只有一块主要大陆——Ionus，首都Kargon就坐落于此. 在轨道上，Illium造船厂生产对战舰建造至关重要的部件.

column1: The Ipava system was colonised at some point during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was one of the founding worlds of the Crucis Pact.
column2: Ipava星系在第一次泰拉大迁徙期间或结束后不久被殖民，是克鲁西斯协定的创始世界之一.

column1: The Ipava system was colonised shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was one of the founding worlds of the Sian Commonwealth.
column2: Ipava星系在第一次从泰拉大迁徙后不久就被殖民，并且是锡安共同体的创始世界之一.

column1: The planet Irece has three continents, Santana, Salvador and Baiano. It is also the home of a 9.7 kilometer tall mountain known as Tengoku, which reaches into the planet's stratosphere and is located a hundred kilometers from the world's capital city.
column2: 伊雷塞星球有三大洲：圣塔纳、萨尔瓦多与巴伊亚诺。它也是高9.7公里的“天国”山的所在地——此山深入星球平流层，距该星球首府一百公里。ZH

column1: Irian is a heavily industrialized world and for much of its history has been a local power. It is the headquarters of Irian BattleMechs Unlimited, a large interstellar corporation.
column2: Irian是一个高度工业化的世界，在其历史的大部分时间里一直是当地的一股强权. 它是大型星际企业Irian BattleMechs Unlimited的总部所在地.

column1: Clan Jade Falcon's capital and location of their primary training and manufacturing facilities. The capital city is also called Ironhold City.
column2: 玉猫部族的首都及其主要训练与制造设施所在地。首府城市也叫铁堡城。ZH

column1: Iron Land was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Iron Land在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Irurzun contains a great deal of metal ores, gemstones, and radioactive materials, with New Samarkand Metals finding new deposits almost annually for centuries.
column2: Irurzun蕴藏着大量金属矿石、宝石和放射性物质，几个世纪以来，New Samarkand Metals几乎每年都能发现新的矿藏.

column1: The Isabela system was colonised during the Star League era, beginning life as a mining colony.
column2: Isabela星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，最初是一个采矿殖民地.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Isesaki was the headquarters world of the XXXV Corps (Star League) of the Star League Defense Force. It has been a trading post for centuries, with massive warehouses storing goods for dispersal to worlds across the Inner Sphere.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年，Isesaki是星际联盟防卫军第35军（星际联盟）的总部世界. 数个世纪以来，它一直是一个贸易站，拥有庞大的仓库，储存着要分发到内天体各世界的货物.

column1: Isfahan was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Isfahan是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The primary agricultural world of the Taurian Concordat, Ishtar was one of the earliest colonies in the region. It is totally undefended, and has no manufacturing or heavy industry, in an effort to make it less appealing to raiders. The entire population is engaged in food production.
column2: 伊什塔尔是金牛协约国主要的农业星球，是这一地区最早的殖民地之一. 它完全不设防，也没有制造业或重工业，以此让它不那么吸引盗匪. 整个星球的人口都从事食品生产.

column1: Once part of the United Hindu Collective, Islamabad's difficulty integrating into the Federated Suns has led to centuries of on-and-off religious tension and smoldering caste-based revolts.
column2: 伊斯兰堡曾是联合印度教集团的一部分，它在融入联邦太阳域方面的困难导致了数百年断断续续的宗教紧张与阴燃的种姓叛乱。ZH

column1: Ruled by the Humphrey Family the world of Islington is a water world that helps supply the millions of marian subjects with fresh fish. It also is the main training world for Marian Marines and terrestial naval personel.
column2: 由Humphrey家族统治的Islington星球是一个水世界，为数百万Marian臣民供应鲜鱼. 它也是Marian陆战队和地面海军人员的主要训练星球.

column1: Issaba was originally settled as part of the Finmark Province of the Rim Worlds Republic due to being extremely hospitable to human life.
column2: Issaba最初是因极其适宜人类居住而作为边缘世界共和国芬马克省的一部分被殖民的.

column1: Settled by the Terran New Habitat during the Exodus from Terra due to rich rhenium deposits, Itabaiana has an extremely agreeable climate.
column2: 由于拥有丰富的铼矿藏，Itabaiana在从地球出走期间被地球新栖息地组织建立定居点，并拥有极其宜人的气候.

column1: Itica was never better than marginally habitable, and was colonized by the Capellans mostly as a defensive measure. During the Second Succession War, the Free Worlds League seized it; they pursued a scorched-earth policy, quite literally scorching the earth to bare rock.
column2: 易提卡一直都只勉强适合居住，卡佩拉人殖民于此主要是作为一种防御措施. 在第二次继承战争期间，自由世界联盟夺走了它; 他们奉行的是焦土政策，确切地说是把土地烧成裸岩.

column1: Settled towards the end of the Star League era, the rich fertile jungles of Ito allow for large exports to nearby worlds.
column2: Ito于星际联盟时代末期被殖民，其富饶肥沃的丛林使其得以向附近世界大量出口.

column1: One of the four founding worlds of the Aurigan Coalition under the direction of House Gallas, Itrom is a jewel of the region, a pleasant Terran world with a population of over a billion. Centuries-old wars left a scar across the surface: a cratered radioactive wasteland that dominates the northern hemisphere.
column2: 伊特罗姆是御夫座联盟四大创始星系之一，由加拉斯家族统治，也是该地区的一颗明珠，是颗有着超过10亿人口的宜人类地星球. 长达数世纪的战争在地表留下了一道伤疤: 一个遍布弹坑、主导北半球的放射性荒地.

column1: Itsbur is a frozen world, nearly uninhabitable, and as a consequence the Capellan government had a difficult time recruiting colonists. Terraforming efforts never made it past the early stages, and eventually the colony died out, with insufficient population growth.
column2: 埃茨伯是一颗冰封星球，几近不适宜居住，因此卡佩拉政府在招募殖民者的过程中遇到了困难. 地球化的努力从来没有越过早期阶段，最终因人口增长不足使得殖民地消亡了.

column1: Itzehoe was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Itzehoe于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Izar is actually a binary system; the major star in the system is a blue-white B5 supergiant, which is orbited by a cool orange K0 star.
column2: Izar实际上是一个双星系统；该系统中的主星是一颗蓝白色B5 超巨星，有一颗温度较低的橙色K0 星围绕其运行.

column1: Izmir was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Izmir在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The Jaboatao system was colonised at some point during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra due to its rich mineral content.
column2: Jaboatao星系在第一次从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间或之后不久的某个时候，因其丰富的矿产资源而被殖民.

column1: The Jaboatao system was colonised at some point towards the end of the Star League era as successor states clamoured for resources.
column2: Jaboatao星系在星际联盟时代末期某个时候被殖民，当时各继承国正争相攫取资源.

column1: Jacobabad was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Jacobabad在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: A hot, wet world with a dense atmosphere, Jacomarle has very little to attract conflict; the residents are farmers and fishers, and local industry produces consumer goods for nearby systems. Thus despite being one jump from the border, there are no real military threats.
column2: 雅各马尔勒是一颗炎热，潮湿，有着稠密大气的星球，几乎不会吸引冲突; 居民是农民和渔民，当地工业为附近星系生产消费品. 因此，尽管距离边境只有一跃(迁)之遥，那里也没有真正的军事威胁.

column1: Jacson is a lush, verdant world, dominated by an equatorial megaforest known as the Perpetual Forest. The massive boles make modern sensors useless, and overmatched military forces can retreat into its relative safety.
column2: 雅克松是一个郁郁葱葱的星球，一片巨大的森林覆盖在赤道上，被称为永久森林. 巨大的树干让现代传感器变得毫无用处，这使得被击败的军队可以撤到相对安全的地方.

column1: Jaipur has long been an agricultural world that exports its products to nearby systems, though in recent years the ruling family has been attempting to industrialise.
column2: Jaipur长期以来一直是一个农业世界，向附近星系出口其产品，不过近年来统治家族一直在尝试工业化.

column1: One of the founding worlds of the Taurian Concordat, Jamestown is a peaceful, modestly prosperous world, with three continents and vast oceans. Once the site of a SLDF garrison, the planet still benefits from the high-tech industrial infrastructure.
column2: 詹姆斯敦是金牛协约国的创始星球之一，是一个平静，中等繁荣的星球，拥有三片大陆和广阔的海洋. 这颗行星曾是星际联盟防卫军一支守备部队的地方，现在依然受益于高科技工业基础设施.

column1: Janina was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Janina在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Jansen's Hold is a dry, cold world, dominated by windswept tundra in the temperate zones, and glacial mountains in the north and south. Heavily industrialized, the planet is a manufacturing center for a major arms manufacturer, Taurus Territorial Industries.
column2: 扬森要塞是一颗干燥寒冷的世界，温带地区以狂风呼啸的冻原为主，南北则是冰川山脉。该行星工业化程度很高，是重要武器制造商陶里安领地工业的制造中心。ZH

column1: Jápminboddu was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Jápminboddu在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Jardangal was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Jardangal在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: This system appears in the Argo database, but must have been struck from official records, as it does not exist on any recent charts. Strange.
column2: 这个星系出现在Argo数据库中，但肯定已从官方记录中抹去，因为最近的所有星图上都没有它. 奇怪.

column1: Alshain Weapons has a large manufacturing facility here. After the planet was attacked by the mysterious Minnesota Tribe after the Second Succession War, the company rigged the facility with explosives to ensure it can never be captured.
column2: Alshain Weapons在这里拥有一座大型制造设施. 第二次继承战争后，这颗行星遭到神秘的明尼苏达部落袭击之后，该公司在该设施内布设了炸药，以确保它永远不会被占领.

column1: Issaba was originally settled during the First Exodus from Terra due to its largest continent being extremely hospitable to human life.
column2: Issaba最初是在第一次从泰拉向外大迁徙期间被殖民的，因为其最大的大陆极其适宜人类生活.

column1: Jászberény was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Jászberény在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The Jatznik system was colonised at some point towards the end of the Star League era as successor states clamoured for resources.
column2: Jatznik星系在星际联盟时代末期某个时候被殖民，当时各继承国正竞相争夺资源.

column1: Settled in the golden age of the Star League, the rich fertile jungles of Jaumegarde allow for large exports to nearby worlds.
column2: 在星际联盟的黄金时代，Jaumegarde得到殖民开发，其富饶肥沃的丛林使其得以向附近星球大量出口.

column1: Java was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Java在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Jeanette Naval Yards produces submarine vehicles in a vast naval yard on the Tal'Dorei ocean. Their specializations in naval vehicles has created an expert workforce.
column2: 珍妮特海军船坞在塔尔多雷海上的一座庞大海军船厂内生产水下车辆。他们在海军车辆上的专精造就了一支专业化的工人队伍。ZH

column1: Jeju was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Jeju在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Jenet was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Jenet是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期建立的定居点，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Jeppens was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Jeppens是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民定居的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Jerangle was originally settled as part of the Finmark Province of the Rim Worlds Republic due to being extremely hospitable to human life, however the planet did sustain some ecological damage during the Republic-Commonwealth war.
column2: Jerangle最初是作为边缘世界共和国芬马克省的一部分被殖民的，因为这里极其适宜人类生存，不过该行星在共和国-共同体战争期间确实遭受了一些生态破坏.

column1: Settled in the golden age of the Star League, the rich fertile oasis of Jeronimo allow for large exports of foodstuffs to nearby worlds.
column2: 在星际联盟的黄金时代，Jeronimo这片富饶肥沃的绿洲得到殖民开发，从而能够向邻近世界大量出口食品.

column1: Jesenice was originally settled as part of the Apollo Province of the Rim Worlds Republic due to its easily accessible mineral deposits, however the facilities did sustain some damage during the Republic-Commonwealth war.
column2: Jesenice最初是作为边缘世界共和国阿波罗省的一部分而建立的，因为其矿藏易于开采，不过其设施在共和国-共同体战争期间确实遭受了一些损坏.

column1: A small, dry planet colonised purely because of the discovery of sizable veins of tin and silver. The entire population is involved in the small but significant mining industry, which is totally reliant on interstellar shipping for food.
column2: 一颗小而干燥的行星，之所以被殖民，纯粹是因为发现了可观的锡和银矿脉. 全体人口都从事着规模虽小但意义重大的采矿业，而该产业完全依赖星际航运来获取食物.

column1: Settled in the golden age of the Star League, the rich fertile oasis of Jezersko allow for large exports of foodstuffs to nearby worlds.
column2: 在星际联盟的黄金时代，Jezersko这片富饶肥沃的绿洲得以定居，使得大量食品能够出口到附近的世界.

column1: Jiddah was originally settled at the beginning of the golden age of the Star League due to its easily accessible mineral deposits.
column2: Jiddah最初是在星际联盟黄金时代初期，因其易于开采的矿藏而有人定居的.

column1: Jilin was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Jilin是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候建立定居点的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Joan's Post was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: 琼之哨站在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束之后的某个时候被殖民，却在继承战争的战火中消亡。ZH

column1: Neukirchen was originally named Jodipur, and was one of the three planets which formed the nucleus of the United Hindu Collective, along with Basantapur and Panpour.
column2: Neukirchen最初名为Jodipur，是与Basantapur和Panpour一同构成联合印度教集体核心的三颗行星之一.

column1: Johnson was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Johnson在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: Wunderland Enterprises and Valiant Systems export military vehicles, communications systems and electronics from Johnsondale across the Inner Sphere.
column2: Wunderland Enterprises和Valiant Systems从Johnsondale向整个内天体出口军用车辆、通信系统和电子设备.

column1: The statue of the horse of a Tikonov Grand Union general stands outside the city hall, a symbol of remembrance of the Tikonov massacres.
column2: Tikonov大联盟一位将军的骏马雕像矗立在市政厅外，是纪念Tikonov大屠杀的象征.

column1: Settled in the golden age of the Star League, the rich fertile oasis of Jonzac allow for large exports of foodstuffs to nearby worlds.
column2: 在星际联盟的黄金时代，Jonzac这片富饶肥沃的绿洲被建立为定居点，使得大量食品得以出口到附近世界.

column1: The colony of Joppa IV is located on Specula, the gas giant's largest moon, in the remains of an SLDF station. With no significant resources, the inhabitants of the moon have leveraged their position as a trade hub to survive.
column2: 约帕IV殖民地坐落在气态巨行星斯佩库拉最大的卫星上，建在一座SLDF站的残骸中。由于该卫星没有重要资源，居民们凭借其作为贸易枢纽的位置谋生。ZH

column1: A core world of the Outworlds Alliance, it escaped most notice during Operation UNION HOLD. It's primary export is of a tabletop wargame where each player controls numerous BattleMechs in battles against each other. Designed for children, it has nevertheless gained a strong foothold amongst the older aristocracy.
column2: 作为外域联盟的核心世界，它在联合控制行动期间几乎没有引起注意。它的主要出口产品是一种桌面战争游戏，每位玩家操控众多战斗机甲互相对战。它虽然是为儿童设计的，却在年长的贵族阶层中站稳了脚跟。ZH

column1: The Joradian Cluster is a collection of stars within close proximity to each other.
column2: Joradian Cluster是一群彼此距离很近的恒星.

column1: Jorvikland was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Jorvikland在统一战争结束后的星盟时代某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Joshua was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Joshua在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间因战乱而消亡.

column1: Josselin was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Josselin是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Settled during the Exodus from Terra, it was originally part of the Federation of Oriente.
column2: 于从泰拉大迁徙期间建立定居点，最初是Oriente联邦的一部分.

column1: Settled in the golden age of the Star League, the rich ore fields of Joyz allow for large exports of minerals to nearby worlds.
column2: Joyz建于星际联盟的黄金时代，其丰富的矿田使其得以向附近世界大量出口矿物.

column1: The Juazeiro system was colonised during the Star League era, beginning life as a mining colony.
column2: Juazeiro星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，最初是一个矿业殖民地.

column1: Jubka has been described as a \"lucrative mining world\" that is however vitally dependant on a lifeline of iceships supplied by Curtiss Hydrosystems.
column2: 朱布卡被描述为"利润丰厚的采矿世界"，但它极度依赖由柯蒂斯水务系统供应的冰船生命线。ZH

column1: This system contains near to nothing. It's whole purpose is to refill your jumpdrive.
column2: 这个星系几乎空无一物。它的唯一用途就是为你的跃迁引擎补给。ZH

column1: Junction once held sway over several smaller worlds in the region centuries ago, before willingly joining the Draconis Combine for protection. Its importance has waned, but it still serves as a military depot and logistical hub.
column2: 数百年前，Junction曾支配该地区的数个较小世界，后来为寻求保护而自愿加入天龙联合. 它的重要性已经减弱，但仍作为军事仓库和后勤枢纽发挥作用.

column1: Michaelson Heavy Industries utilises the raw materials from the numerous mines to create components for VTOL, as well as having a secondary line for armour threading.
column2: Michaelson Heavy Industries利用来自众多矿场的原材料制造VTOL组件，同时还设有一条用于装甲编织的辅助生产线.

column1: Jungar Qi was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Jungar Qi于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间因战乱而消亡.

column1: Settled during the golden age of the Star League, the rich ore fields of Junior allow for large exports of minerals to nearby worlds.
column2: 在星际联盟的黄金时代建立定居点，Junior丰富的矿田使其能够向附近世界大量出口矿物.

column1: Juniper was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Juniper于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: When Kabah was first settled, there was a terrible hemorrhagic fever that scythed through the colony. The population slowly developed a resistance to it over the centuries.
column2: 当Kabah最初被殖民时，一场可怕的出血热如镰刀般席卷了整个殖民地. 数百年来，居民逐渐对它产生了抵抗力.

column1: After suffering an attack from the Daemien's Destroyers mercenary unit during the First Succession War, the government is reluctant to hire mercenaries.
column2: 在第一次继承战争期间遭到戴米恩毁灭者雇佣兵部队袭击之后，该政府不愿再雇佣雇佣兵。ZH

column1: Settled during the Star League era, the vast jade deposits under the surface are heavily mined.
column2: 于星际联盟时代有人定居，地表之下蕴藏的丰富玉矿正被大规模开采.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Kagoshima was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison. It is the capital of the local prefecture.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年，Kagoshima驻有星际联盟防卫军的一支守备部队. 它是当地管区的首府.

column1: The Kaguyak system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War.
column2: Kaguyak星系是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的.

column1: Kaifeng is an agricultural world that exports its food surplus to feed a number nearby worlds, especially Sarna and Sakhalin.
column2: Kaifeng是一个农业世界，将其盈余粮食出口以供养附近若干世界，尤其是Sarna和Sakhalin.

column1: Kaitangata is an impoverished system, with little in the way of mineral wealth or resources.
column2: Kaitangata是一个贫困的星系，几乎没有什么矿产财富或资源.

column1: The Kaiyuh system was settled during the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the United Hindu Collective prior to the Collective joining the Federated Suns.
column2: Kaiyuh星系在从泰拉出发的第一次大迁徙期间被殖民，并在联合印度教集体加入恒星联邦之前是该集体的成员.

column1: Kajikazawa is a prefecture capital in the Benjamin Military District, and houses numerous luxury holiday homes for politicians and bureaucrats from Benjamin.
column2: Kajikazawa是Benjamin军区的一个专区首府，并拥有大量供来自Benjamin的政客和官僚使用的豪华度假住宅.

column1: Kakada is an impoverished system, with little in the way of mineral wealth or resources. It's main source of income is the production of woodcrafts thanks to abundant lumber.
column2: 卡卡达是一个贫困星系，几乎没有什么矿产财富或资源。它的主要收入来自木器制作，因为这里有大量木材。ZH

column1: Kaldu was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Kaldu是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Mercilessly hot and dry, Kalidasa is nonetheless a major industrial world, hosting large amounts of cross-border trade and a major Mech factory.
column2: 尽管酷热难耐、干燥无情，Kalidasa仍是一个重要的工业世界，拥有大量跨境贸易和一座大型机甲工厂.

column1: Kalmar (CC) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Kalmar (CC) 在统一战争结束后的某个时候、星际联盟时代被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.
