column2: 诺克斯由富裕的塔玛家族殖民，是塔玛协定这一短命原初国家中的世界之一。其矿场由“大地金属”公司运营，而该公司与职业健康安全部门关系松散。ZH

column1: Nuelson Minor was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Nuelson Minor是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Nukus was a minor colony until the Capellans withdrew, leaving the residents to fend for themselves. Only the volcanic equatorial region is inhabited, where temperate climate allows some subsistence agriculture. Elsewhere, the planet is scoured by ice storms.
column2: 在卡佩拉人撤出努库斯，留下居民自力更生之前，那儿是个小型殖民地. 只有赤道火山地区才有人居住，那里温和的气候使一些自给自足的农业生产得以存在. 而在其它地方，行星一直被冰风暴冲刷.

column1: Settled by colonists fleeing Terra, Nullarbor was an independent colony for over a century before joining the Free Worlds League.
column2: Nullarbor由逃离泰拉的殖民者建立，在加入自由世界联盟之前，曾作为独立殖民地存在了一个多世纪.

column1: Numenor largely escaped the ravages of warfare during the Succession Wars, leading to the population becoming some of the most confident, erudite and snobbish to be found in the Federated Suns. It is home to Aston-Martin, one of the premium electric vehicle manufacturers in the Inner Sphere.
column2: 在继承战争期间，Numenor基本未遭战火蹂躏，这使得当地居民成为恒星联邦中最为自信、博学且势利的一群人. 这里也是Aston-Martin的所在地，它是内天体高端电动汽车制造商之一.

column1: Settled by the Draconis Combine during the Star League era due to one of the Kuritas wanting to play with a space seal. Yes, really.
column2: 星际联盟时代，天龙联合体在此建立定居点，起因是栗田家族的一位成员想和一只太空海豹玩耍. 是的，真的.

column1: The Lyran Commonwealth settled Nuneaton at some point during the Star League era, taking advantage of the thick lumber in the primeval forests.
column2: 天琴共同体在星际联盟时代的某个时期殖民了Nuneaton，以利用原始森林中粗壮的木材.

column1: Nusakan, despite its cold climate, has become home to many consumer electronics and luxury aircraft manufacturers. While these are not military industries, they are highly profitable.
column2: 尽管气候寒冷，Nusakan已成为众多消费电子产品和豪华飞行器制造商的所在地. 虽然这些并非军事产业，但利润极为丰厚.

column1: Nyamlell is a colonized world within the Axumite Providence. The world is at approximately a 20th Century technological level.
column2: Nyamlell是阿克苏姆天命国境内的一颗殖民星球. 该星球的技术水平大约相当于20世纪.

column1: Nyasa was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Nyasa在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Annually, a viral plague would break-out on Nykvarn's northern continent, which was also the site of special type of grain that was the only viable cure for it. At the first sign of the plague, the grain was harvested and baked into loaves of bread which the locals ate to survive that year's outbreak.
column2: 每年，尼克瓦恩北大陆都会爆发一场病毒瘟疫，而那里也生长着一种特殊谷物，是唯一有效的解药。瘟疫一露头，人们就收割这种谷物并烤成面包，当地人就靠吃它撑过那一年的疫情。ZH

column1: Oberon, the capital of perhaps the most infamous bandit kingdom, has been home to numerous proto states over the centuries. A great pirates fortress towers over the main capital city.
column2: Oberon，或许是史上最臭名昭著的匪帮王国的首都，数百年来一直是众多原始政权的所在地. 一座巨大的海盗堡垒高耸于主要首府城市之上.

column1: The Obrenovac system was colonised at some point prior to the end of the Age of War by the Magistry of Canopus, before becoming part of the Inner Sphere during the Reunification War.
column2: Obrenovac星系在战争时代结束前的某个时候被卡诺帕斯行政区殖民，随后在统一战争期间成为内天体的一部分.

column1: Settled by colonists fleeing Terra, Oceana was an independent colony for over a century before joining the Free Worlds League.
column2: 由逃离泰拉的殖民者建立，Oceana在加入自由世界联盟之前，作为独立殖民地存在了一个多世纪.

column1: Settled by colonists fleeing Terra, Odabase was an independent colony for over a century before being annexed into the Draconis Combine.
column2: 由逃离泰拉的殖民者建立，Odabase在被并入天龙联合体之前，曾作为独立殖民地存续了一个多世纪.

column1: Odawara was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Odawara在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Odell's Star League industrial base was destroyed entirely during the First Succession War
column2: 奥德尔的星盟工业基础在第一次继承战争中被彻底摧毁

column1: Odessa was settled early in humanity's expansion to the stars and is home to the Odessan Raxx, a reptilian pack animal used across the world.
column2: 敖德萨在人类向群星扩张的早期被殖民，是敖德萨拉克的家园——一种遍布全世界的爬行类驮兽。ZH

column1: Settled by colonists fleeing Terra, O'Fallon was an independent colony for over a century before joining the Federated Suns.
column2: 奥法伦由逃离地球的殖民者建立，作为独立殖民地存在了一个多世纪之后才加入联邦太阳国。ZH

column1: During the Star League era, the planet Offerman was a lightly populated industrial world. Whilst never invaded, the fall of the Star League caused most of the factories to fall into disrepair and most of the remaining industry is related to lumber and woodwork.
column2: 在星际联盟时代，Offerman行星是一个人口稀少的工业世界. 尽管从未遭到入侵，但星际联盟的崩溃导致大多数工厂失修，而剩余的工业大多与木材和木工有关.

column1: Settled by colonists fleeing Terra, Ogano was an independent colony for over a century before being annexed into the Draconis Combine.
column2: 由逃离地球的殖民者建立，Ogano在被并入天龙联合体之前，曾作为一个独立殖民地存在了一个多世纪.

column1: Settled by colonists fleeing Terra, Ogilvie was an independent colony for over a century before being incorporated into the Federated Suns.
column2: Ogilvie由逃离泰拉的殖民者建立，作为一个独立殖民地存在了一个多世纪，之后才被并入恒星联邦.

column1: Fort Gorndack is the first sight of many to the world of Ohrensen, a vast heavily defended Star League era spaceport.
column2: Fort Gorndack是许多人抵达Ohrensen星球时看到的第一处景象，它是一座庞大且防御森严的星际联盟时代太空港.

column1: Settled by the Federated Suns at the dawn of the Star League, Okains is known for its high quality gemstones that are mined from the surface.
column2: 在星际联盟成立之初，恒星联邦在Okains建立了定居点，Okains以其从地表开采的高品质宝石而闻名.

column1: Okaya was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Okaya在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Having been colonised in the twenty-sixth century by deeply religious individuals seeking the solitude of deep space, by the end of the Second Succession War Okefenokee was one of the poorest worlds to be found within the borders of the Federated Suns.
column2: 在二十六世纪被一群寻求深空孤寂的虔诚宗教信徒殖民后，到第二次继承战争结束时，Okefenokee已成为恒星联邦境内最贫穷的星球之一.

column1: Maarakiva University, located on Olafsvik, is one of the Free Worlds League's top two business schools. Maarakiva focuses more on the academic and theoretical in its courses, with particular attention paid to advertising and market research.
column2: 位于奥拉夫斯维克的马阿拉基瓦大学是自由世界联盟两所顶级商学院之一。马阿拉基瓦的课程更偏重学术与理论，尤其注重广告与市场研究。ZH

column1: Great canyons scour the desert world of Olancha, remnants of massive detonations from the First Succession War where it was brutally and swiftly taken by the Combine.
column2: 巨大的峡谷切割着Olancha的沙漠世界，这些峡谷是第一次继承战争中大规模爆炸留下的遗迹；当时该星球被天龙联合体残酷而迅速地夺取.

column1: Old Canton was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Old Canton在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Infamously known as the planet where the Inner Sphere's only known deployment of a gigaton-range nuclear device occurred, Old Kentucky is still recovering from the centuries of abuse in the Succession Wars.
column2: 老肯塔基因内天体已知唯一一次千兆吨级核装置的使用而臭名昭著，至今仍在从继承战争中数世纪的摧残中恢复。ZH

column1: Oldsmith was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Oldsmith在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Oli was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Oli是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Oligar was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Oligar于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Settled by the Federated Suns at the dawn of the Star League, Olindo is known for its high quality radioactives that are mined from the surface.
column2: 在星际联盟成立之初，Olindo由恒星联邦殖民定居，并以从地表开采的高品质放射性材料而闻名.

column1: Oliver is an important industrial world, site of both a Brigadier Corporation's 'Mech factory and a Quickscell Military Vehicle Plant. The planet was only recently seized from the Free Worlds League who no doubt desire it back.
column2: 奥利弗是一颗重要的工业世界，既有旅长公司的机甲工厂，又有快销军事车辆厂。该行星最近才从自由世界联盟手中夺来，而后者无疑渴望收回。ZH

column1: Settled by the Federated Suns at the dawn of the Star League, Olindo is known for its high quality hydrocarbons that are mined from the surface.
column2: 在星际联盟初建之时，恒星联邦在Olindo建立了定居点；Olindo以其从地表开采的高品质碳氢化合物而闻名.

column1: Omagh was one of the initial colonies that made up the Alliance of Galedon, before it formed the Draconis Combine.
column2: 在Galedon联盟演变为天龙联合体之前，Omagh曾是组成该联盟的初始殖民地之一.

column1: Onverwacht was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Onverwacht是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: Oporto (Veil 3075+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Oporto（Veil 3075+）于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: During the Second Succession War, Isla Liao attacked the planet, only to be rebuffed. She was killed directing the Rearguard action which allowed most of her forces to escape - the first Liao Chancellor to die on the battlefield.
column2: 在第二次继承战争期间，伊斯拉·廖进攻了这颗行星，却被击退. 她在指挥后卫行动时阵亡，这次行动使她的大部分部队得以逃脱——她是首位战死沙场的廖氏首相.

column1: The major population center on Ordino, a city of a few hundred thousand, was destroyed during the Third Succession War. The remaining inhabitants eke out a living on the impoverished world, but the Capellans have largely withdrawn from the system.
column2: 奥尔迪诺上的大型人口中心，一座10万人的城市，在第三次继承战争期间被摧毁. 剩下的居民在贫瘠的星球上苦苦维生，但大部分卡佩拉人都撤离了这个星系.

column1: The world is quiet and unassuming, except for the massive rainforests that circle the equator. Here trees that tower more than 500 meters tall block out the sun, creating a mood of perpetual twilight at the forest floor.
column2: 这颗星球安静而低调，唯有环绕赤道的广袤雨林例外. 在这里，高耸超过500米的树木遮蔽了阳光，在森林地面上营造出一种永恒暮色的氛围.

column1: Organo has two continents, Alphus and Omegus. The capital city, Typae, is located on Alphus. The Pinard Protectorates Limited plant is located in a vast cavern located at the interface zone between a large agricultural area and a desert.
column2: Organo拥有两块大陆: Alphus和Omegus. 首府Typae位于Alphus上. Pinard Protectorates Limited的工厂位于一片大型农业区与沙漠交界地带的一处巨大洞穴中.

column1: Oriente was the capital of the protostate known as the Federation of Oriente, before the formation of the Free Worlds. It's status as a regional capital is maintained to this day.
column2: 奥连特曾是名为奥连特联邦的原始国家的首都，那是在自由世界联盟形成之前。它作为区域首府的地位一直保持到今天。ZH

column1: One of the core worlds of the Tamar Pact, it became a defacto world of the Lyran Commonwealth when it formed.
column2: 作为塔玛协定的核心世界之一，它在天琴共同体成立时成为其事实上的世界.

column1: Recently settled by the Taurian Concordat due to the wealth gained in the Fourth Succession War, Orkney is little more than a farming outpost at this time.
column2: 由于在第四次继承战争中获得的财富，金牛协约国最近才在Orkney建立定居点，目前Orkney不过是一个农业前哨站.

column1: Ormal was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ormal在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: The Ormstown system was colonized during or shortly before the Age of War and had been incorporated into the Rim Worlds Republic by the time of the Reunification War, where it was conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth.
column2: Ormstown星系在战争时代期间或之前不久被殖民，到统一战争时已被并入边缘世界共和国，并在那场战争中被天琴共同体征服.

column1: Settled by the Taurian Concordat in the wake of the Fourth Succession War, many privateers are attempting to create diamond and rare heavy metals industries from the harsh surface of the world.
column2: 第四次继承战争后，金牛协约国在此建立了殖民地，许多私掠者正试图利用这颗星球严酷的地表，建立钻石和稀有重金属产业.

column1: Oshika has long been a prefecture capital world. Large quantities of rare earths and germanium in the mountains power a vast economy and industrial base.
column2: Oshika长期以来一直是行政区首府星球. 山区中大量的稀土和锗支撑着庞大的经济与工业基础.

column1: Settled by colonists fleeing Terra, Osmus Saar was an independent colony after the fall of the Terran Hegemony until it was annexed by the Draconis Combine.
column2: 由逃离地球的殖民者建立，Osmus Saar在泰拉霸权崩溃后曾是一个独立殖民地，直到被天龙联合体吞并.

column1: Osset was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Osset在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Osumi was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Osumi是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Otho was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Otho是星际联盟防卫军一支驻军的驻地.

column1: Otisberg is the fourth planet in the system and has a single moon named Miloe. Recently there have been talks with nearby worlds about forming an Alliance to band together, but so far talks have stalled.
column2: Otisberg是该星系中的第四颗行星，拥有一颗名为Miloe的卫星. 最近，它与附近的世界一直在商谈组建一个联盟以联合起来，但迄今为止谈判已陷入停滞.

column1: Settled by colonists fleeing Terra, Ottumwa was an independent colony for over a century before being incorporated into the Federated Suns.
column2: 由逃离泰拉的殖民者定居建立，Ottumwa在被并入恒星联邦之前，作为一个独立殖民地存在了一个多世纪.

column1: Ouagadougou (Silence 3130+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ouagadougou (Silence 3130+) 是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Ourem was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ourem是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Settled by the Draconis Combine during the Star League era due to the high concentrations of mineral wealth within the continent spanning Kodiak mountains.
column2: 在星际联盟时代，天龙联合体因横贯大陆的Kodiak山脉中高度集中的矿产资源而在此建立了定居点.

column1: Originally only a small outpost, it gained notoriety thanks to the exotic holovid productions which used Outpost as a daring setting.
column2: 起初只是一个小型前哨站，但由于那些将Outpost用作大胆场景的异域全息影像作品，它变得声名大噪.

column1: Outreach was first settled during the twenty-second century by Terran colonists attracted to the planet's warm climate. Tourism became the mainstay of the planet's economy after it played host to the Star League Martial Olympiads in 2704.
column2: 奥特里奇在22世纪由被该星球温暖气候吸引的地球殖民者首次殖民。在2704年承办星际联盟军事奥林匹克之后，旅游业成为该星球经济的支柱。ZH

column1: Ovan is a rocky world with a river that runs around the entire equator. Ovan's industrial economy was damaged by the first two Succession Wars, and has been further damaged by mismanagement in recent years.
column2: 奥万是一颗多岩石的行星，有一条环绕整个赤道的河流。奥万的工业经济在前两次继承战争中受损，近年来又因管理不善进一步恶化。ZH

column1: Overton is temperate, mostly water covered world near where the Capellan, St. Ives, and Federated Suns borders meet. It supports a population of just under a billion, most of whom are involved in the aquaculture industry.
column2: Overton是一个气候温和、大部分被水覆盖的世界，位于卡佩拉、St. Ives和恒星联邦边界交汇处附近. 它拥有略低于十亿的人口，其中大多数人从事水产养殖业.

column1: Oyevaina was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Oyevaina在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Once a lush and beautiful world, Ozawa was wracked by nuclear bombardment. Nonetheless, its lucrative mines have kept civilization alive on this poisoned world, and there are occasional signs of recovery.
column2: Ozawa曾是一个郁郁葱葱、美丽的世界，却饱受核轰炸摧残. 尽管如此，其利润丰厚的矿藏仍让文明在这颗中毒的世界上延续，并且偶尔可见复苏的迹象.

column1: Paches was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Paches在统一战争结束后的星盟时代某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡.

column1: Pacifica has highly fertile soil and is home to a Mechwarrior Academy. Unfortunately, Pacifica has highly unpredictable weather and only a 14 hour long day-night cycle, so it requires quite a while to acclimate.
column2: Pacifica拥有极其肥沃的土壤，并且是机甲战士学院的所在地. 不幸的是，Pacifica的天气极其难以预测，而且昼夜周期只有14小时，因此需要相当长的时间才能适应.

column1: Paf was briefly a Taurian research station, but the punishing climate made large-scale construction far too expensive to further exploit the planet's possible resources.
column2: 帕夫曾短暂作为金牛座的研究站，但恶劣的气候使大规模建设成本过高，无法进一步开发该星球的潜在资源。ZH

column1: Pajarito was annexed into the Inner Sphere during the Reunification war, which caused thousands of refugees to flee the world. The ruins of entire cities can be seen from orbit.
column2: Pajarito在统一战争期间被并入内天体，这导致成千上万的难民逃离该星球. 从轨道上可以看到整座整座城市的废墟.

column1: One of the founding colonies of the Sian Commonwealth, Palladaine was the source of much of the initial mineral wealth of the Capellan Confederation.
column2: 作为锡安共同体的创始殖民地之一，Palladaine是卡佩拉邦联早期大部分矿产财富的来源.

column1: Novis AT-H, Inc maintains a megafactory on the surface of Palladix, which gets its name from the vast Palladium fields.
column2: Novis AT-H，Inc在Palladix表面运营着一座巨型工厂，Palladix因广阔的钯矿区而得名.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Palm was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Palm曾是星际联盟防卫军一支驻军的驻地.

column1: Palmyra Petrochemicals has a monopoly on the vast deposits of petroleum contained within the deserts of Palmyra, and is a major exporter.
column2: Palmyra石化公司垄断了Palmyra沙漠中蕴藏的巨量石油资源，并且是主要出口商.

column1: Palos is a large world with vastly different climates on each of its five continents.
column2: Palos是一颗巨大的星球，其五个大陆的气候差异极大.

column1: Settled by colonists from different regions, Pandora was settled due to it being a rich world. However, wars and battles raged over the world for most of its early history until the Lyran Commonwealth annexed the system before the Star League era.
column2: 来自不同地区的殖民者在此定居，Pandora之所以被殖民，是因为它是一颗富饶的星球. 然而，在其早期历史的大部分时间里，战争与战斗在这颗星球上肆虐，直到星际联盟时代之前，天琴共同体吞并了该星系.

column1: Pangkalan was a part of the Apollo Province of the Rim Worlds Republic and was conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth during the 2773-2775 Republic-Commonwealth war.
column2: Pangkalan曾是边缘世界共和国阿波罗省的一部分，并在2773-2775年共和国-共同体争期间被天琴共同体征服.

column1: Settled during the Star League era by colonists from the Free Worlds League.
column2: 于星际联盟时代由来自自由世界联盟的殖民者建立.

column1: During the Succession Wars, Panpour was responsible for a vast portion of the Federated Suns industrial output thanks to its rich minerals and industrial base.
column2: 在继承战争期间，得益于其丰富的矿产和工业基础，Panpour占据了恒星联邦工业产出的很大一部分.

column1: As a result of multiple conflicts above the surface of Panzyr, the orbital approach to the planet is potentially hazardous, so despite its pleasant climate and resources, Panzyr is in a slow decline. House Decimis, originally from Guldra, took possession of the world and it is now their home system.
column2: 由于潘济尔天上的多起冲突，从轨道前往该行星具有潜在的危险，所以即便有着宜人的气候和资源，潘济尔依然处于缓慢的衰退中. 最初来自古尔德拉的德希米斯家族，占有了该星球，现在它是他们的母星.

column1: Settled during the Star League era by relocated colonists and prisoners from the Draconis Combine.
column2: 于星际联盟时代，由来自天龙联合体的重新安置殖民者与囚犯定居建立.

column1: Sarcastically named Paradise, the dim sun makes growing crops extremely difficult whilst the constantly seismic activity makes mining dangerous.
column2: 讽刺地被命名为Paradise，昏暗的恒星使种植作物极其困难，而持续不断的地震活动又使采矿十分危险.

column1: Parakoila is a mineral rich world, known for its gold and heavy metals. The planet's capital is the city of Mainstrike, named after the vast gold veins that were struck here.
column2: 帕拉科伊拉是一颗矿产丰富的世界，以黄金与重金属闻名。该行星的首府是梅因斯特赖克城，得名于这里被发现的巨大金矿脉。ZH

column1: Paran VI served as a breadbasket system for the Rim Worlds Republic, covered in island-spanning orchards and massive fisheries. After the Amaris Civil War ended, Paran kept to itself, and slid back into 20th century tech.
column2: Paran VI曾是边缘世界共和国的粮仓星系，遍布着横跨岛屿的果园和大规模渔场. 阿马里斯内战结束后，Paran与世隔绝，并倒退回了20世纪的技术水平.

column1: Pardeau was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Pardeau是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Parian was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Parian在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: During the reign of the Star League, the 171st Mechanized Infantry Division of the Star League Defense Force was formed on this planet, and Fort McKittrick stands to this day as a ruined symbol of the Star League.
column2: 在星际联盟统治时期，星际联盟防卫军第171机械化步兵师在这颗行星上组建，而麦基特里克堡至今仍作为星际联盟的残破象征矗立着.

column1: The arable lands and parks of Park Place make this an ideal retirement world for the eldest and wealthiest citizens in the Inner Sphere.
column2: Park Place的可耕地和公园，使其成为内天体最年长、最富有公民的理想退休世界.

column1: Originally the settlers of Parma organized themselves into a plethora of city-states and declared that no one, not even the Duke, could interfere with the affairs of each city. This did not work.
column2: 最初，Parma的定居者将自己组织成众多城邦，并宣称任何人，甚至公爵，都不得干涉各城事务. 但这并未奏效.

column1: Parvan was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Parvan在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Settled at the dawn of the Star League era by Federated Suns colonists, who placed a claim on the rich gold veins contained with the peaks of Pascagoula.
column2: 在星际联盟时代初期，恒星联邦殖民者在此定居，并对Pascagoula群峰中蕴藏的丰富金矿脉提出了所有权主张.

column1: Pasemah was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Pasemah在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战乱中消亡了.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Pasig was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年，Pasig曾是星际联盟防卫军一支守备部队的驻地.

column1: Patan was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Patan在星际联盟时代，统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Settled at the dawn of the Star League era by Federated Suns colonists, who placed a claim on the rich gold veins contained with the peaks of Pattison
column2: 在星际联盟时代初期，由恒星联邦殖民者建立定居点，他们宣称对Pattison群峰中蕴藏的丰富金矿脉拥有所有权.

column1: Settled at the dawn of the Star League era by Federated Suns colonists, who placed a claim on the rich platinum veins contained with the peaks of Pattonsbrug
column2: 在星际联盟时代初期，恒星联邦的殖民者在此定居，他们宣称对Pattonsbrug群峰中蕴藏的丰富铂金矿脉拥有所有权.

column1: Settled at the dawn of the Star League era by Federated Suns colonists, who placed a claim on the rich plains ideal for agriculture.
column2: 由恒星联邦殖民者在星际联盟时代初期建立定居点，他们宣称对适宜农业的富饶平原拥有所有权.

column1: Recently colonised by the Lothian League, the rich platinum veins under the surface are being exported to nearby worlds, making the initial colonists very wealthy.
column2: 最近被洛锡安联盟殖民，地表下丰富的铂矿脉正被出口到附近世界，使最初的殖民者变得非常富有.

column1: Named after the famous mercenary commander Paul the Paulrus. The locals changed the name to Paulus after Paul's death. Their planetary flag is a walrus with machine guns and a cigar.
column2: 以著名雇佣兵指挥官保罗·海象命名。保罗死后当地人把名字改成了保卢斯。他们的行星旗帜是一只叼着雪茄、架着机枪的海象。ZH

column1: Pavia was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Pavia在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Paxon is a Clan world in the Kerensky Cluster. One manufacturer for Clan Diamond Shark is based here, churning out armaments for the war efforts.
column2: Paxon是克伦斯基星团中的一个氏族世界. 钻石鲨氏族的一家制造商设在这里，为战争行动源源不断地生产军备.

column1: This arid world was the site of a 'gold rush' of scavengers looking for LosTech. When hopes of sudden Star League era wealth proved unfounded, the planet was slowly abandoned, and is now littered with ghost towns.
column2: 这颗干旱星球曾是寻宝者寻找失落科技的“淘金地”。当一夜暴富的星际联盟时代财富幻想被证明无据之后，星球被缓慢废弃，如今遍布鬼城。ZH

column1: Payvand was the site of many battles during the Reunification War, and many of its urban areas were turned into battlefields by the SLDF despite being a clear breach of the Ares Convention.
column2: Payvand是统一战争期间许多战役的发生地，尽管明显违反了《阿瑞斯公约》，星际联盟防卫军仍将其许多城区变成了战场.

column1: Settled by colonists fleeing Terra, it was incorporated into the Federated Suns before the Star League era.
column2: 由逃离泰拉的殖民者定居，并在星际联盟时代之前并入恒星联邦.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Peacock was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Peacock驻扎着一支星际联盟防卫军守备部队.

column1: Pec was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Pec在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Pegasi is an independent Periphery world located close to the worlds of Carcri and Cephei and the Tortuga Dominions
column2: Pegasi是一个独立的外围世界，靠近Carcri和Cephei世界以及托尔图加领地.

column1: Pell was never more than a stopping-off point on the way to Buenos Aires. During the Third Succession War the refueling station in orbit was shut down due to lack of parts and technical expertise. The Capellans have since abandoned the system.
column2: 佩尔只不过是前往布宜诺斯艾利斯途中的一个中间站. 第三次继承战争期间，轨道上的燃料补给站因缺乏零件和技术人员而关闭. 自那以后，卡佩拉人就放弃了该星系.

column1: Originally one of the worlds of the Sian Commonwealth, it became a defacto member of the Capellan Confederation during its inauguration.
column2: 它原本是锡安共同体的星球之一，在卡佩拉邦联成立之际成为了其事实上的成员.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Pencader was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison. Towerlund City as it is now called is a large walled city located close to the Oxide Desert.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Pencader曾驻扎着一支星际联盟防卫军守备部队. 如今被称为塔沃伦德城的是一座大型带城墙城市，位于氧化物沙漠附近.

column1: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era, it is a mostly self sufficient agri-world.
column2: 在星际联盟时代由天琴共同体建立殖民地，这里是一个基本自给自足的农业世界.

column1: Pentvar was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Pentvar是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Once the site of a Taurian mining colony, this world was polluted beyond recovery after only a few hundred years of industry. Now the air is foul and unbreathable, and the surface is cracked by fault lines and volcanoes.
column2: 这颗星球曾经是金牛矿业殖民地的所在地，在仅仅几百年的工业活动后就被污染得无药可救了. 现在这里的空气又臭又不宜呼吸，地表被断层线和火山所分裂.

column1: Settled by the Federated Suns early in the Star League era to claim the vast mineral wealth under the surface.
column2: 星际联盟时代早期，恒星联邦为获取地表下丰富的矿产资源而在此定居.

column1: The oceanic world of Perdition is wracked by constant storms and vulcanism. It would be a fairly unpleasant place to live if not for the money that its mining and military manufacturing industries bring in.
column2: Perdition这颗海洋世界饱受持续风暴和火山活动的摧残. 要不是其采矿业和军工制造业带来的金钱，这里会是个相当不宜居住的地方.

column1: Périgueux was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Périgueux于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间战火中消亡.

column1: An oft contested world, the original industrial base was destroyed in the Succession Wars, leaving only deep mine shafts to provide material.
column2: 一个屡遭争夺的星球，最初的工业基础已在继承战争中毁灭，仅剩下深层矿井还能提供材料.

column1: When the Free Worlds League withdrew its support from the mining colony of Pernik, the residents who chose to stay were able to survive by moving to subterranean hydroponic agriculture in the planet's extensive cave systems.
column2: 当自由世界联盟撤回对佩尔尼克采矿殖民地的支持时，选择留下的居民靠转入该行星广阔洞穴群中的地下水培农业得以生存。ZH

column1: Alternatively known as Perrot or Shaula throughout the Succession Wars, it is an unremarkable agri world with areas filled with natural hot springs.
column2: 在历次继承战争期间，它也被称为Perrot或Shaula；这是一个毫不起眼的农业世界，部分地区遍布天然温泉.

column1: Persistence was one of seven worlds settled by colonists from the Rim Worlds Republic between 2334 and 2338 as an attempt by Maxwell Rowe to create a buffer zone between the Republic, the Draconis Combine and the Tamar Pact. It was conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth during the 2773-2775 Republic-Commonwealth war.
column2: Persistence是2334年至2338年间由来自边缘世界共和国的殖民者定居的七个世界之一，此举是麦克斯韦·罗为在共和国、天龙联合体和塔玛协定之间建立缓冲区而进行的尝试. 它在2773—2775年的共和国-共同体战争期间被天琴共同体征服.

column1: Pesht was discovered by early explorers which were part of the Ozawan merchants in 2212, but due to hostile wildlife wasn't colonised until 2320. A heavily forest world, it is extremely hospitable to humanoid life.
column2: 佩什特于2212年由奥扎万商人中的早期探险者发现，但由于野生动物具有敌意，直到2320年才被殖民。这是一颗森林覆盖极广的星球，对人形生命极为宜居。ZH

column1: Named for its vast petroleum deposits under the ice, Petrolia is a heavily industrialised world.
column2: Petrolia因冰层下蕴藏的大量石油矿藏而得名，是一个高度工业化的世界.

column1: The Phact system was colonized sometime prior to 2366, and has had a long history as an industrialised world.
column2: Phact星系在2366年之前的某个时候被殖民，并且作为工业化世界有着悠久的历史.

column1: Settled for rich high-quality metal and oil deposits, the only inhabited planet in the system is 'Hades', a hot caustic world.
column2: 为富饶的高品质金属与石油矿藏而殖民，该星系唯一有人居住的星球是“哈迪斯”，一颗灼热而腐蚀性的世界。ZH

column1: Phecda is a cold and inhospitable world in slow decline. The world's economy is kept afloat only by its important strategic position and its ability to produce high-tech water purification systems. It was home to Snord's Irregulars in the 3020's.
column2: 菲克达是一颗寒冷而不宜居、正在缓慢衰落的星球。其经济仅靠重要的战略位置与生产高科技净水系统的能力维持。3020年代曾是斯诺德非正规军的驻地。ZH

column1: An industrialised world, its flagship exporter is Longanecker PlastiSteel which utilises locally sourced petroleums and materials to produce synthetic plastics and materials.
column2: 一个工业化的世界，其旗舰出口商是Longanecker PlastiSteel，该公司利用当地采购的石油和材料生产合成塑料和材料.

column1: An industrialised world, its flagship exporter is Osaka Heavy Metrics which utilises locally sourced silicon to produce electronics.
column2: 一个工业化的世界，其旗舰出口商是Osaka Heavy Metrics，该公司利用本地开采的硅生产电子产品.

column1: Piedmont holds the infamous distinction of being the home of Chungalomeningitis, a disease that killed over a billion people during the Age of War. The Piedmont Institute for Disease Control was formed shortly afterwards, in order to prevent further outbreaks.
column2: Piedmont因是Chungalomeningitis的故乡而臭名昭著，这种疾病在战争时代夺去了超过十亿人的生命. 此后不久，Piedmont疾病控制研究所成立，以防止疫情进一步爆发.

column1: The initial mining colony founded by the Taurian Concordat was annexed by the Federated Suns during the Reunification War.
column2: 由金牛协约国建立的最初采矿殖民地，在统一战争期间被恒星联邦吞并.

column1: Pietermaritzburg was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Pietermaritzburg是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Pike's population live in heavy stone structures as the planet's rocky surface is regularly swept by powerful windstorms. Pike is rich in metals and most of the population make their living as miners or supporting the mining industry on the planet.
column2: 派克的居民住在厚重的石制建筑中，因为该行星多岩石的表面经常被强劲的风暴横扫。派克金属资源丰富，大多数居民以采矿或为行星上的采矿产业提供配套服务为生。ZH

column1: An independent mining colony for centuries, it was annexed by the Draconis Combine during the initial years of the Star League.
column2: 作为独立的采矿殖民地存在了数个世纪，它在星际联盟成立初期被天龙联合体吞并.

column1: Pilon was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Pilon于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Pilpala recently changed hands when the Free Worlds League moved in a large number of mercenaries that dominated the few troops stationed there by the Capellan Confederation. The planet's mercantile population is uneasily adapting to the regime change.
column2: 皮尔帕拉最近易手，当时自由世界联盟投入大量雇佣兵，压倒了卡佩兰联邦在那里驻扎的少数部队。该行星的商民人口正在不安地适应这次政权更替。ZH

column1: Pinard was and is a Taurian manufacturing center, despite having its cities bombed into radioactive rubble during the Reunification War. The Taurians built new cities and new factories, leaving the dangerous ruins as an eternal reminder.
column2: 尽管在统一战争期间，皮纳德的城市被炸成了放射性废墟，但它过去是，现在还是一处金牛制造中心. 金牛人造起了新的城市和新工厂，把危险的废墟当作永恒的提醒.

column1: An independent mining colony for centuries, it joined the Free Worlds League during the initial years of the Star League.
column2: 几个世纪以来一直是一个独立的采矿殖民地，在星际联盟成立初期加入了自由世界联盟.

column1: Settled by the Draconis Combine during the Star League era to ensure a monopoly on the world's uranium deposits.
column2: 在星盟时代由龙尼斯联合体殖民，以确保对该行星铀矿的垄断。ZH

column1: While visitors to Piriapolis are welcomed at its starport, the privilege of emigrating there is jealously guarded as a way of protecting the precious Lipizzaner horses that were once almost wiped out during a bandit raid.
column2: 造访皮里亚波利斯的访客会在星港受到欢迎，而向那儿移民的特权却被小心翼翼地限制着，作为保护珍贵的利皮扎马的一种方式，这种马在一场盗匪袭击中曾一度濒临灭绝.

column1: Annexed by the Federated Suns during the Reunification War, Pitkin is a quiet agricultural world with no particular claim to fame since then, apart from a military garrison.
column2: Pitkin在统一战争期间被恒星联邦吞并，是一个安静的农业世界，自那以后除了一支驻军外，并无特别出名之处.

column1: A mountainous world, Placida provides raw material to nearby worlds.
column2: Placida是一个多山的世界，为附近的世界提供原材料.

column1: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era to claim the vast mineral wealth under the seabed.
column2: 星盟时代由天琴共同体建立定居点，以获取海床下蕴藏的丰富矿产.

column1: Plataea was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Plataea是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The Pleiades (or Seven Sisters) is dominated by hot blue and extremely luminous B-type stars.
column2: The Pleiades（或Seven Sisters）主要由炽热、蓝色且极其明亮的B型恒星构成.

column1: Pleione is a planet with a relatively small landmass - less than twenty percent of the surface of the planet is dry land, concentrated in a single continent named Jezrael.
column2: Pleione是一颗陆地面积相对较小的行星——其表面不到百分之二十是陆地，且集中在一块名为杰兹雷尔的大陆上.

column1: Pliska was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Pliska在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某一时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Originally one of the worlds of the Protectorate of Donegal, it became a defacto member of the Lyran Commonwealth when it formed.
column2: 它最初是Donegal保护国的星球之一，在天琴共同体成立时成为其事实上的成员.

column1: Pocologan was originally a part of the Timbuktu Province of the Rim Worlds Republic and was conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth during the 2773-2775 Republic-Commonwealth war.
column2: Pocologan原本是边缘世界共和国的Timbuktu省的一部分，并在 2773-2775 年的共和国-共同体战争期间被天琴共同体征服.

column1: Point Barrow was originally settled to exploit the massive deposits of rare earth minerals. Aside from that, there is no reason for humans to be on the world. The only other interesting feature is the Point Barrow Military Academy.
column2: Point Barrow最初建立殖民地是为了开采大量稀土矿藏. 除此之外，人类没有任何理由待在这个星球上. 唯一另一个有趣之处就是Point Barrow军事学院.

column1: Pojos, with its colored ice ring, is beautiful to look at but dangerous to approach. The planet specializes in botanical concerns, and the tolerances of the thorny Pojos Rose make it a desirable bloom across the Confederation.
column2: 波若斯，拥有其五彩斑斓的冰环，看起来很美，但是却很危险. 这颗行星专门研究植物学课题，且多刺波若斯玫瑰的耐受性使其成为联邦各地向往的花朵.

column1: Pokhara was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Pokhara在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Polcenigo was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison. The families of the forces that made up the garrison were the original colonists.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Polcenigo驻扎着一支星际联盟防卫军驻军. 组成这支驻军的部队的家属就是最初的殖民者.

column1: Pollux is an arid world that was settled early on in human expansion. It has significant heavy metal reserves, though its industrial development has been inhibited over the course of the Succession Wars as the FWL and LA have fought over the planet.
column2: Pollux是一颗干旱星球，在人类扩张早期就已被殖民. 它拥有可观的重金属储量，但在继承战争期间，由于FWL和LA为争夺该星球而交战，其工业发展受到了抑制.

column1: One of many worlds settled during the Star League, Polybius was subsequently abandoned and forgotten about during the succession wars. Some claim the entire star system is nothing more than an urban legend
column2: 作为星际联盟时期殖民的众多世界之一，Polybius后来在继承战争期间被遗弃并遗忘. 有些人声称整个星系不过是一个都市传说而已.

column1: As of 3025, Pomme De Terre is considered the most productive agricultural world within the Draconis Combine. The value of this world was high due to the fact that many Combine worlds could not provide enough food for themselves.
column2: 截至3025年，Pomme De Terre被认为是天龙联合体内生产力最高的农业世界. 这个世界的价值很高，因为许多联合体世界无法为自己提供足够的食物.

column1: Pompey is a crucial Marian world. Home to Harian Mechanized Industries it employs vast numbers of slaves to meet the Marian Armed forces vicious appetite for fighting vehicles.
column2: Pompey是马里安的一个重要星球. 作为Harian Mechanized Industries的所在地，该公司雇佣大量奴隶，以满足马里安武装部队对战斗车辆贪得无厌的需求.

column1: Settled by the Draconis Combine in the run up to the Reunification War, it was used as a marshalling point for Star League forces.
column2: 在统一战争前夕，天龙联合体在此建立定居点，这里曾被用作星际联盟部队的集结地.

column1: Porrima has abundant, but not overwhelming, supplies of industrial metals, gemstones, and arable land. When originally settled, it was a paradise until the settlers discovered that every 62 years a neighbouring planet orbits close enough to cause horrific storms upon the surface.
column2: Porrima拥有丰富但并不过剩的工业金属、宝石和可耕地储量. 最初殖民时，这里曾是一处世外桃源，直到殖民者发现，每隔62年，一颗邻近行星就会运行到足够近的位置，从而在Porrima表面引发可怕的风暴.

column1: Port Arthur is a relatively sparsely-populated world, owing largely to endemic root parasites within its soil that make farming difficult. However, it boasts incredible natural and mineral resources, crucial for military production.
column2: Port Arthur是一个人口相对稀少的星球，主要因为其土壤中特有的根部寄生虫使农业耕作十分困难. 然而，它拥有惊人的自然和矿产资源，对军事生产至关重要.

column1: The Porthos system was colonized by the faction known as the Inheritors. Foreswearing any military might and with no wealth, these worlds are of no use to anyone.
column2: Porthos星系由被称为“继承者”的派系殖民. 他们摒弃一切军事力量，又毫无财富，这些世界对任何人都毫无用处.

column1: A former Taurian world, Portland was invaded as part of the Taurian-Canopian war, but its inhabitants successfully repelled the Magistracy with guerilla tactics. Now independent, the population engages in subsistence farming and a slow trickle of food exports.
column2: 波特兰过去是颗金牛星球，因金牛-船底战争而遭入侵，但是其居民成功地利用游击战术击退了船底人. 现在独立后，人们从事勉强自持的农业和细水长流的食品出口行业.

column1: The planet itself is very plain and stable. Typical weather, terrain and resources focus life into the cities where the Lyran merchants have their colorful bazaars making it an important, if boring, trading hub.
column2: 这颗行星本身非常平淡而稳定. 典型的气候、地形和资源将生活集中到城市中，天琴商人在那里经营着色彩斑斓的集市，使其成为一个重要却乏味的贸易枢纽.

column1: Port Vail (The Rack 3050+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Port Vail（The Rack 3050+）于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡.

column1: A relatively poor world, much of the population works in mining or manual labour.
column2: 一个相对贫穷的世界，大部分人口从事采矿或体力劳动.

column1: A rich world filled with farmlands and rich mountain ranges, it never the less has substantial socio economic problems.
column2: 一个富饶的世界，遍布农田和富饶的山脉，尽管如此，它仍有着严重的社会经济问题.

column1: Settled by the Free Worlds League during the Star League era due to its extensive farmland availability.
column2: 由于该星系拥有大片可用农田，自由世界联盟在星际联盟时代在此建立了定居点.

column1: Praxton is the Outworlds Alliance's primary producer of precious fusion engines, used in their tanks, AeroFighters, and Mechs. As such it is a crucial part of the Alliance's military logistics, and a constant target of attacks.
column2: 普拉克斯顿是外域联盟主要的珍贵聚变引擎产地，其引擎用于他们的坦克、航空战机与机甲。因此它是联盟军事后勤的关键一环，也是袭击的常年目标。ZH

column1: The original settlers of Prediltz fled the world when the Draconic Combine invaded during the Age of War, leaving only the stupid or brave behind.
column2: Prediltz最初的定居者在战争时代天龙联合入侵时逃离了这颗星球，只留下愚蠢或勇敢的人.

column1: Even at the height of the Star League era Premana was considered something of an isolated system, as ships traveling to the system via inhabited systems - rather than taking the riskier option of traveling through uninhabited systems - were forced to either approach from the Rimward direction, or journey outside of Commonwealth space
column2: 即便在星际联盟时代的鼎盛时期，Premana也被视为一个相当孤立的星系，因为经由有人居住星系前往该星系的飞船——而不是选择风险更高的穿越无人星系路线——被迫要么从边缘方向接近，要么航行到共同体领域之外.

column1: Pressby was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Pressby在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Pressville was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Pressville在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: By 2271, there was two worlds colonised by settlers from Terra. The clerk in charge of system naming should have by rights demanded one change their name to prevent duplicates but they couldn't be arsed.
column2: 到 2271 年，已有两个星球被来自地球的定居者殖民。负责星系命名的文书按理本应要求其中一个星球改名以免重名，但他懒得操这份心。ZH

column1: Primus is a fertile world of vast river floodplains, and its land is given over to highly-automated farming. Small farming communities serve the logistical needs of the automated farms, and a single spaceport moves food off-world.
column2: 普赖默斯是一个富饶的星球，有着广阔的泛滥平原，其土地被用于高度自动化的农业. 小型农业社区为自动化农场提供后勤服务，唯一的一座太空港则将食品运送到星球之外.

column1: Principia is the seat of the judiciary for the Capellan Confederation and, as such, caters to the needs of Capellan nobles who have taken it as a vacation home. It also has courts dedicated to adjudicating mercenary contracts with the Liao.
column2: 普林西皮亚(字面意思为“原则”)是卡佩拉联邦的司法机构所在地，因此，它迎合了将此地作为度假屋的御夫座贵族的需要. 它还有专门裁决与廖氏所签的佣兵合约的法庭.

column1: Devastated during the Reunification War, the population has revitalised many of the poisoned continents.
column2: 统一战争期间惨遭蹂躏，如今民众已让许多饱受毒害的大陆重获生机.

column1: Priori was colonized by the Clans by the 29th century. Its Terran-like atmosphere and ecology made it a popular site for colonization and was one of the major worlds held by Clan Burrock.
column2: Priori在29世纪时已被氏族殖民. 其类似地球的大气与生态使它成为热门的殖民地点，并且是Burrock氏族所控制的主要世界之一.

column1: This major manufacturing and commercial world is known for the massive typhoons that occasionally form in the vast tropical ocean. During storm season, the skyscrapers of the coastal cities seal themselves against the gale-force winds.
column2: 这颗大型制造业与商业星球之所以知名，是因为它广大热带海洋中偶尔形成的巨大台风. 在风暴季节，沿海城市的摩天大楼都要封闭，以此对抗大风.

column1: Procyon's rocky soil is ill-suited to agriculture but rich in heavy metals. While not possessed of any military industry, the output from the planets mines are used to produce a variety of civilian vehicles.
column2: 普罗西翁多岩石的土壤不适合农业，却富含重金属。虽然它没有任何军事工业，该行星矿场的产出被用于生产各种民用车辆。ZH

column1: Promised Land is one of the major ports of entry for Lyran traders entering League space, the city closest to the planet's primary spaceport containing a magnificent bazaar teeming with an endless array of merchants, wholesalers and speculators
column2: 应许之地是莱兰商人进入联盟空间的主要入口之一，离该行星主要太空港最近的城市里有一座宏伟的集市，挤满了无穷无尽的商人、批发商和投机者

column1: Settled as one of the Capellan Commonality worlds, it became a defacto member of the Capellan Confederation when it formed.
column2: 作为卡佩拉共同体的世界之一被殖民，当卡佩拉邦联成立时，它事实上成为了其成员.

column1: Proserpina was one of the Core Worlds housing heavy industry companies such as Guided Technologies and Bulldog Enterprises. These factories, and many others, exploited the petrochemical and mineral resources of the planet directly and refined metals from the ores in the world were shipped to many other planets. During the succession wars, two out the five continents were rendered uninhabitable nuclear wastelands, which the population hasn't recovered from to this day.
column2: 普洛塞庇娜是众多核心世界之一，拥有导向技术与斗牛犬企业等重工业公司。这些工厂以及许多其他工厂直接开采该行星的石化与矿产资源，从矿石中提炼出的金属被运往许多其他行星。在继承战争期间，五块大陆中有两块变成了无法居住的核废土，当地人口至今都未从这场灾难中恢复。ZH

column1: Prydain was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Prydain在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Pula was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Pula在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Settled by the Capellan Confederation during the Star League era to claim the vast mineral wealth under the surface.
column2: 在星盟时代，卡佩拉邦联在此建立定居点，以获取地表之下丰富的矿产资源.

column1: Settled by the Draconis Combine during the Star League era to claim the vast mineral wealth under the surface.
column2: 星际联盟时代，天龙联合体在此定居，以获取地表下丰富的矿产资源.

column1: Puttalam was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Puttalam是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Technically part of the Taurian Concordat, Pyrrhus is a dreary rock where convicts are turned loose with a pickaxe and a pat on the back, there to make a poor living as a miner, or, more likely, join one of the resident pirate gangs.
column2: 从技术上讲，皮洛士是金牛协约国的一部分，是块沉闷的岩石. 在那儿，给犯人们背上一把十字镐，再在背后拍一把，就打发他们去做矿工谋生，或者，更可能的是，加入一个驻在那儿的海盗团伙.

column1: Qalzi is a relatively recent addition to Aurigan holdings. The cold and rocky Terran world is in a legal limbo, with the Taurian Concordat maintaining that their original colony, since abandoned, gives them a prior claim on the system.
column2: 喀奥齐是最近加入御夫座领地的. 这颗冰冷的岩质类地星球处于法律未定状态，金牛协约国坚持他们废弃了的最初殖民地，给了他们对此星系的优先主张权.

column1: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era to claim the vast mineral wealth under the surface.
column2: 星际联盟时代，天琴共同体为获取地表下丰富的矿产资源而在此定居.

column1: Qandahar is a world that was totally exploited by humanity for its vast natural resources. Unfortunately the early settlers didn't show any care in handling the output of their factories and this has led the ecosystem of Qandahar to collapse.
column2: 坎大哈是一颗被人类为争夺其庞大自然资源而彻底榨取的星球。遗憾的是早期定居者在处理工厂排放时毫不谨慎，这导致坎大哈的生态系统崩溃。ZH

column1: Qualip is the site of a failed colony which died out due to an experiment with G-23 Paxilon Hydrochlorate, a chemical compound added to the air processors in order to pacify the populace.
column2: Qualip是一个失败殖民地的所在地，该殖民地因一项使用G-23 帕西隆盐酸盐的实验而消亡，这种化学化合物被添加到空气处理系统中，以安抚民众.

column1: Quantraine was devastated during the Reunification war and became depopulated until recently, where new colonists are striving to set up a new colony.
column2: Quantraine在统一战争期间遭到严重破坏，变得荒无人烟，直到最近才有新殖民者努力建立新的殖民地.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Quarell was considered important enough to host a SLDF garrison thanks to its rich boreholes.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年，Quarell因其丰富的钻孔而被认为重要到足以驻扎一支星际联盟防卫军守备队.

column1: Quatre Belle is a lightly-populated, agricultural world. The planet's soil was rich in nutrients from volcanic activity and the system's F-class primary provided abundant energy for the world to be covered in lush vegetation.
column2: 四美人是一颗人口稀少的农业行星。该行星的土壤因火山活动而富含养分，而该星系的F级主星提供了充沛能量，使整颗行星覆满葱郁植被。ZH

column1: Quelimane was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Quelimane是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The icy world of Quernoy was settled during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the Sarna Supremacy prior to the formation of the Capellan Confederation
column2: 冰封的Quernoy世界是在从泰拉第一次大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民的，并且在卡佩拉联邦成立之前是Sarna Supremacy的成员.

column1: Despite its tainted atmosphere, the planet of Quentin has been a prize for most of the Succession Wars due to its intact 'Mech production facilities. Recently captured by the Combine, its facilities pump out MAD-3Rs and AS-7Ks for the DCMS.
column2: 尽管大气受到污染，昆汀这颗行星在大部分继承战争期间因完好的机甲生产设施而成为争夺的奖赏。最近被联合体夺取，其设施为DCMS源源不断产出MAD-3R和AS-7K。ZH

column1: Quiberas is a core world within the Outworlds Alliance, though is but still bears the marks of the Reunification war where the Star League burned cities and populations across the Periphery.
column2: Quiberas是外域联盟内的一个核心世界，但依然留有统一战争的痕迹，在那场战争中星际联盟焚毁了边缘星域各处的城市与人口.

column1: Despite a lack of natural resources or majestic scenery, Quimberton has managed to become a recreational hub, mostly due to vast estates it rents out as timeshares to well-off people who want a taste of true wealth.
column2: 尽管昆伯顿缺乏自然资源或壮观的景色，但它已经成功地成为了一个娱乐中心，这多半要归功于那些以分时共享方式租给富人的大量庄园，那些人想品尝到真正的财富.

column1: Quimper (Chirac 3130+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Quimper（Chirac 3130+）在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Quimper was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Quimper是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The Quincy system was settled during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was incorporated into the Federated Suns during or shortly before the Age of War
column2: Quincy星系在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民，并在战争时代期间或之前不久被并入恒星联邦.

column1: Quines was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Quines是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时间点被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The Quittacas system was settled during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was incorporated into the Federated Suns during or shortly before the Age of War
column2: Quittacas星系在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民，并在战争时代期间或之前不久被并入恒星联邦.

column1: Qurayyat was discovered and colonized in the early to mid-twenty-second century by settlers from the Middle East who were drawn to the vast desert oasis on the surface.
column2: Qurayyat于22世纪早期至中期被来自中东的定居者发现并殖民，他们被地表上广阔的沙漠绿洲所吸引.

column1: Raballa was once a vast food exporter, but in the late Succession Wars the world's weather patterns shifted. With this shift in weather the amount of food it could grow declined and the population is slowly declining.
column2: 拉巴拉曾是庞大的粮食出口地，但在继承战争后期该星球的气候模式发生转变。随着气候转变，它能种植的粮食减少，人口也在缓慢下降。ZH

column1: Settled by the Draconis Combine during the Star League era to claim the vast petroleum fields.
column2: 在星际联盟时代，天龙联合为夺取广袤的油田而在此建立定居点.

column1: Before the fall of the Star League, Radostov was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: 在星际联盟覆灭之前，Radostov曾驻有星际联盟防卫军的一支卫戍部队.

column1: Radstadt is mostly known for a unique wood, the Radstadt pine which, when processed, shimmers like gold. The decentralized population is supplied with food from the planet's rich oceans
column2: 拉德施塔特最为人所知的是它一种独特的木材——拉德施塔特松，加工后会像黄金般闪烁。分散的人口由该行星富饶的海洋供应食物

column1: Discovered by Albert Radulov, it was renamed to Tanis after he was convicted of interstellar fraud. The system contains three inhabitable worlds which produces mostly agricultural products which are traded amongst each other.
column2: 由阿尔伯特·拉杜洛夫发现，在他因星际欺诈被定罪后，该星系被更名为Tanis. 该星系包含三颗可居住星球，主要生产农产品，这些农产品在彼此之间进行贸易.

column1: Raetia was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Raetia在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Ragusa was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ragusa是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Rahne is a small world without adequate water or growing seasons. Major dust storms fling themselves across the planet creating a need to protect exposed machinery, which constantly churns through the vast fields of radioactives.
column2: Rahne是一个缺乏充足水源和生长季节的小型世界. 猛烈的沙尘暴横扫这颗行星，因此需要保护暴露在外的机械，而这些机械不断在广阔的放射性物质田中作业.

column1: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era due to the vast germanium deposits under the polar ice caps.
column2: 由于极地冰盖下蕴藏着大量锗矿藏，天琴共同体在星盟时代于此建立了定居点.

column1: The Raldamax system was settled by the Outworlds Alliance during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War by refugees from the worlds seized by the Star League.
column2: Raldamax星系是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候，由外域联盟利用来自被星际联盟夺取的诸世界的难民建立的.

column1: The Raman system was colonised during the First Exodus from Terra and was an independent world prior to joining the Federated Suns.
column2: Raman星系在第一次从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间被殖民，并在加入恒星联邦之前是一个独立世界.

column1: Ramen was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Ramen在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Settled by prisoners from the Draconis Combine during the initial years of the Star League, it remains one of the less pleasant penal colonies within the Draconis Combine.
column2: 在星际联盟成立初期，来自天龙联合的囚犯在此定居；如今它仍是天龙联合境内最不宜人的流放地之一.

column1: The Ramona system was colonised during the First Exodus from Terra and was an independent world prior to joining the Federated Suns.
column2: Ramona星系在第一次泰拉大迁徙期间被殖民，在加入恒星联邦之前是一个独立世界.

column1: A warm, semi-tropical world, Ramora is home to small industrial complexes for United Outworlders Corporation and Ravenna Electronics.
column2: Ramora是一个温暖的半热带世界，是联合外世界人公司和拉文纳电子的几座小型工业综合体所在地.

column1: Ramsau is a large cold desert with ice across half the planet, and a day six times longer than it ought to be thanks to its position as an almost tidally locked world.
column2: Ramsau是一颗广袤的寒冷荒漠行星，半个星球被冰层覆盖；由于它几乎处于潮汐锁定状态，它的一天长度是应有长度的六倍.

column1: Ramsey is a surface garrison within the Deep Periphery, near St. Jean and Santiago. During Operation Revival, Ramsey is operated by Clan Steel Viper.
column2: Ramsey是深空外围内的一支地表驻军，靠近St. Jean和Santiago. 在复兴行动期间，Ramsey由钢蝰蛇氏族运作.

column1: Randar was part of the Capellan Commonality before joining the Capellan Confederation. It supplies nearby worlds with electronics and timber products.
column2: Randar在加入卡佩拉邦联之前曾是卡佩拉共同国的一部分. 它为附近的星球供应电子产品和木材产品.

column1: Raphael is a mainly agricultural world that was part of the Sian Commonwealth before joining the Confederation centuries ago.
column2: Raphael是一个以农业为主的世界，在几个世纪前加入邦联之前曾是锡安共同体的一部分.

column1: Rapla was originally a part of the Timbuktu Province of the Rim Worlds Republic and was conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth during the 2773-2775 Republic-Commonwealth war
column2: Rapla原本是边缘世界共和国Timbuktu行省的一部分，并在2773-2775年的共和国-共同体战争期间被天琴共同体征服.

column1: Annexed by the Free Worlds League during the initial years of the Star League.
column2: 在星际联盟成立初期被自由世界联盟吞并.

column1: A warm world with a light industrial base, Rasalgethi is entirely self sufficient.
column2: Rasalgethi是一个拥有轻工业基础的温暖世界，完全自给自足.

column1: The capital of the newly re-created Free Rasalhague Republic, Rassalhague has long been an important industrial and agricultural world.
column2: Rassalhague作为新近重建的自由拉绍格共和国的首都，长期以来一直是重要的工业和农业世界.

column1: Home to Rastaban Agricultural, one of the key agricultural transport companies within the Commonwealth.
column2: 这里是Rastaban Agricultural的所在地，它是共同体重要的农业运输公司之一.

column1: Redfield boasts several large plains well-suited to growing crops and raising herd animals, with a thick iron deposit under the surface in many areas - hence the name of 'Redfield'
column2: 雷德菲尔德拥有数片大平原，非常适合种植作物和饲养牲畜，许多地区地表之下还有厚实的铁矿床——"雷德菲尔德"（红野）之名便由此而来

column1: Settled by colonists from the Federated Suns in the years leading up to the formation of the Star League. It is now an important agri-world with numerous Star League era agri-domes.
column2: 在星际联盟成立之前的岁月里，来自恒星联邦的殖民者在此定居. 如今，这里是一个重要的农业世界，拥有众多星际联盟时代的农业穹顶.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Reese Station was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年，Reese Station曾是星际联盟防卫军一支卫戍部队的驻地.

column1: Refuel Base Gamma is located in the rimward region of the Deep Periphery, close to the coreward border of the Vul Rift. The nearest identified inhabited system is the Deep Periphery system known as Doggerbank.
column2: 伽马燃料补给基地位于深空外围的外缘区域，靠近Vul裂谷的核心方向边界. 最近的已确认有人居住星系是被称为“Doggerbank”的深空外围星系.

column1: Regis Roost is filled with fungal life, in a dizzying array of forms; fungal 'plants', 'fish' and even 'animals' comprise the complex biosphere of the world. Consequently, the air is thick with spores. Visitors are prone to an unpleasant illness known as 'spore-lung'.
column2: 雷吉斯罗斯特遍布真菌生命，形态之繁多令人眼花缭乱；真菌“植物”、“鱼”甚至“动物”共同构成了这个世界的复杂生物圈。因此，空气中弥漫着浓密的孢子。访客很容易患上一种名为“孢子肺”的讨厌疾病。ZH

column1: Regis Roost
column2: 里吉斯鲁斯特

column1: Once the capital world of the Principality of Regulus, it remains an important world. During the Star League era, SLDF troops would form part of the honor guard for the ruling family of the Principality of Regulus.
column2: 它曾是Regulus公国的首都星球，如今仍是一个重要星球. 在星际联盟时代，星际联盟防卫军部队会组成Regulus公国统治家族仪仗队的一部分.

column1: Reinbak was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Reinbak是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Reinhardstein was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Reinhardstein于星际联盟时代、在统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Annexed by the Draconis Combine during the initial years of the Star League for its vast rubidium deposits.
column2: 在星际联盟成立的最初几年，因其丰富的铷矿藏而被天龙联合体吞并.

column1: Settled by the Federated Suns during the Star League era due to the vast germanium deposits under the polar ice caps.
column2: 星际联盟时代，恒星联邦因极地冰盖下储量巨大的锗矿藏而在此建立了定居点.

column1: Annexed by the Capellan Confederation during the initial years of the Star League.
column2: 于星际联盟初期被卡佩拉邦联吞并.

column1: During the Star League era, Remagen was the site of the annual Remagen Rally, a military exercise for jump troops.
column2: 在星际联盟时代，Remagen是一年一度的Remagen Rally的举办地，这是一项面向跳跃部队的军事演习.

column1: Remshield exports its vast mineral wealth from its capital city, aptly named 'Mineral City'
column2: 雷姆希尔德从其首府城市出口大量矿产财富，那座城市恰如其名，叫"矿城"。ZH

column1: \"Habited\" the description in your star atlas says, and nothing more.  It seems like there should definitely be more information, but once you visit you'll understand.
column2: 你的星图上只写着“有人居住”，再无其他。看起来肯定该有更多信息，但你亲自去过就会明白。ZH

column1: One of the original planets of the Taurian Concordat, Renfield has a deep purple nutrient-rich ocean that produces the raw materials for most of the planet's thriving industries. The residents are known for being particularly antisocial.
column2: 作为陶里安协约国的原始行星之一，伦菲尔德拥有一片深紫色、富含养分的海洋，为该行星大部分繁荣产业提供原材料。当地居民以格外不喜社交而闻名。ZH

column1: Rennes was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Rennes在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Renorsal was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Renorsal在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某一时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Renown is a Terran paradise when the skies are clear, which unfortunately doesn't happen very often. The planet is subject to vast tornadoes and 'meteorologist' is an essential position in Renown's mostly-automated factories and farms.
column2: 天气晴朗时，雷农是一处类地天堂，可惜这并不常发生。该行星常遭巨型龙卷风侵袭，在雷农那些大多自动化的工厂与农场里，"气象员"是一个关键岗位。ZH

column1: Renren was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Renren是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Rentz is a habitable world with breathable atmosphere. The MacLean Valley on Rentz is a pleasant rural landscape with towns, extensive farms, and scattered grain silos as well as rivers, forests, and abandoned mine shafts.
column2: Rentz是一颗拥有可呼吸大气层的宜居星球. Rentz上的麦克莱恩谷是一片宜人的乡村景观，有城镇、广阔的农场、散落的谷物筒仓，以及河流、森林和废弃的矿井.

column1: Repulse is a lush agricultural world with valuable mining deposits accessed through vast gashes at the rocky poles. Despite the planetary resources, the population remains low due to an undesirable and mercurial climate.
column2: 里帕尔斯是一颗富饶的农业星球，通过这颗岩质星球两极的巨大裂缝，可以开采宝贵的矿藏. 尽管行星富有资源，但由于讨厌而多变的气候，人口仍然很少.

column1: Restitution was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Restitution是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The installation known as Rest Stop is located in the system in the Deep Periphery cataloged by the Star League as SLSC M9III.2855, the site of a Star League era Recharge Station thanks to the suns amazing potential.
column2: 被称为Rest Stop的设施位于深空外围中由星际联盟编目为SLSC M9III.2855 的星系，得益于这颗恒星惊人的潜力，这里曾是星际联盟时代一座充电站的所在地.

column1: Revel was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Revel在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡.

column1: Settled by colonists from the Lyran Commonwealth during the formation of the Star League.
column2: 在星际联盟成立期间，由来自天琴共同体的殖民者定居.

column1: A small farming combine near the Marian Hegemony, Reykavis manages to eke out a good living from the harsh terrain.
column2: 作为马里安霸权附近的一个小型农业联合体，Reykavis在严酷的地形中勉强维持着不错的生计.

column1: The history of Rezak's Hole is intertwined with that of the pirate group known as the Band of the Damned, pirates that raid nearby Combine worlds with little regard for human life.
column2: 雷扎克洞穴的历史与一个叫"被诅咒者团"的海盗团体紧密交织，这些海盗劫掠联合体附近的星系，毫不顾惜人命。ZH

column1: Rhodos (Runrig 2822+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Rhodos（Runrig 2822+）在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗期间消亡了.

column1: Richmond is a pleasant and very habitable planet, with breathable atmosphere, forests and rivers.
column2: Richmond是一颗宜人且非常宜居的星球，拥有可呼吸的大气、森林和河流.

column1: Once a lush world, the initial colonists brought a pictovirus with them that ended up wiping all life off the planet - down to the smallest microbes. Now quarantined, Murrain is best left to its own devices.
column2: 这里曾是一个生机盎然的世界，但最初的殖民者带来了一种pictovirus，最终将这颗行星上的所有生命——直至最小的微生物——尽数抹除. 如今Murrain已被隔离，最好任其自生自灭.

column1: Richvale is a humid and hot world best known for the Quickscell Company plants on the surface
column2: Richvale是一个潮湿炎热的星球，以其地表上的Quickscell Company工厂而闻名.

column1: The lightly populated world of Ridgebrook is best known for the battles fought there during the Reunification War. The world's surface and orbital space are littered with military debris, making salvage one of the planet's major industries.
column2: 里奇布鲁克人口稀少，以其在统一战争中发生的战斗最为知名。该星球表面与轨道空间散落着军用残骸，使打捞成为该星球的主要产业之一。ZH

column1: Riga is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League, and trades many aquatic goods with nearby worlds.
column2: Riga是构成被称为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家的星球之一，并与附近星球交易许多水产货物.

column1: Previously called Alpha Centauri, Regil Kent or Rigil Kentarus was also one of the Prime or First Circuit A-Class Hyperpulse Generator stations of the SLCOMNET and ComStar HPG Network.  The only moon is called Riken Minor. Highest native life: Mammals.
column2: Regil Kent或Rigil Kentarus曾被称为Alpha Centauri，它也是SLCOMNET与ComStar HPG Network的首要或第一回路A级超脉冲发生器站之一. 唯一的卫星名为Riken Minor. 最高原生生命: 哺乳动物.

column1: Rim Worlds Republic Outpost #11 was a station settled in this system by the Rim Worlds Republic but subsequently abandoned... Or was it?
column2: 边缘世界共和国第11号前哨站是边缘世界共和国在这个星系中建立的一处站点，但随后被废弃了……还是说，并没有？ZH

column1: Rim Worlds Republic Outpost #11
column2: 边缘世界共和国前哨11号

column1: Rim Worlds Republic Outpost #27 was a station settled in this system by the Rim Worlds Republic but subsequently abandoned, before being found by pirates who settled here.
column2: 边缘世界共和国Outpost#27 是该星系中由边缘世界共和国建立的一处站点，但随后被废弃，之后被海盗发现并在此定居.

column1: Rim Worlds Republic Outpost #4 was a station settled in this system by the Rim Worlds Republic but subsequently abandoned... Or was it?
column2: 边缘世界共和国Outpost#4 是边缘世界共和国在这个星系中建立的一处站点，但随后被废弃了……还是说并非如此？ZH

column1: Rim Worlds Republic Outpost #7 was a station settled in this system by the Rim Worlds Republic but subsequently abandoned... Or was it?
column2: 边缘世界共和国7号前哨站是由边缘世界共和国在本星系建立的一处站点，但随后被废弃了……还是说，并没有？ZH

column1: When first settled, Rio was a beautiful world covered in scenic valleys. With little to export, the world instead became known as a prime vacation spot, artists colony, and tri-vid production planet and one of the richest worlds in the Star League. Fierce nuclear bombardments throughout the Succession Wars have rendered the world dead.
column2: Rio最初被殖民时，是一颗美丽的星球，遍布风景如画的山谷. 由于可供出口的物产寥寥无几，这颗星球反而以顶级度假胜地、艺术家聚居地和三维视频制作星球闻名，并且是星际联盟中最富有的星球之一. 继承战争期间猛烈的核轰炸已使这颗星球彻底死寂.

column1: A recently discovered Star League cache has brought other visitors to this sleepy agricultural world.
column2: 最近发现的一处星际联盟秘密仓库给这个沉睡的农业世界带来了其他访客.

column1: Roadside was settled in the late 24th century to take advantage of the vast amounts of fertile soil. These vast plains were perfect for agricultural production of the Lyran Commonwealth.
column2: Roadside于24世纪后期有人定居，以利用大量肥沃的土壤. 这些广袤的平原非常适合天琴共同体的农业生产.

column1: Originally settled during the Terran Exodus, Robinson became one of the 5 founding systems of the Federated Suns, and remains a key system to the Feds to this day.  It is home to the recently rebuilt Robinson Battle Academy.
column2: Robinson最初在泰拉大迁徙期间被殖民，后来成为恒星联邦的5个创始星系之一，并且至今仍是联邦的重要星系. 这里也是最近重建的Robinson战斗学院的所在地.

column1: The site of the largest naval battle in the Reunification War, Robsart's orbital space is choked with debris even now. During its pacification, the SLDF used orbital bombardments against civilians, damaging the climate and killing a quarter million people.
column2: 作为统一战争期间最大规模海战的战场，罗布萨特的轨道空间至今仍被碎片堵塞。在其平定期间，SLDF对平民使用轨道轰炸，破坏了气候并杀死了二十五万人。ZH

column1: Roche is a world located in the Kerensky Cluster in Clan space, and is the former capital of Clan Widowmaker.
column2: Roche是位于氏族空间的克伦斯基星团中的一颗行星，曾是寡妇制造者氏族的前首都.

column1: Rochelle is a rainy world with violent thunderstorms. It's industrial base was mostly destroyed during the Succession Wars, leaving the atmosphere poisoned.
column2: 罗谢尔是一颗多雨的世界，伴有猛烈的雷暴。它的工业基础在继承战争中大部分被摧毁，留下被毒化的大气。ZH

column1: Rochers was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Rochers在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Rochester features wide plains full of arable land and pristine oceans. Unfortunately the soil and water also contain a series of trace elements that combine in Terran lifeforms to form poison, which led to the abandonment of the colony until technology was discovered during the Star League era which made the world habitable again.
column2: Rochester拥有广阔平原，遍布可耕地和原始海洋. 不幸的是，其土壤和水源中还含有多种微量元素，这些元素在地球生命体内结合后会形成毒素，导致殖民地被废弃，直到星际联盟时代发现了使该星球重新宜居的技术.

column1: Rockland is a small planet with large mountain range across the surface which gave it its name. Most of its population is concentrated on the southern continent called Granite, which is where the capital city is. The northern continent, Limerock, has numerous spread-out settlements concentrated on mining and quarrying.
column2: Rockland是一颗小型行星，表面横亘着巨大的山脉，这也正是其名字的由来. 它的大部分人口集中在名为Granite的南部大陆，首府也位于那里. 北部大陆Limerock拥有众多分散的定居点，主要集中在采矿和采石业.

column1: Formerly a Magistracy world, Rockwellawan has found new life as an independent mining colony. During the abortive Taurian-Canopian War, the Taurians landed on the planet, but were unable to decisively engage the Magistracy.
column2: 罗克韦拉万过去是颗自治区星球，它已经找到了以独立矿业殖民地为生的新生活方式. 在流产的金牛-船底战争中，金牛人登上了这颗星球，但却没能果断地与自治区交战.

column1: Rocky was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Rocky在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the formation of the Star League.
column2: 在星际联盟成立期间，由天琴共同体殖民定居.

column1: Annexed by the Free Worlds League during the initial years of the formation of the Star League.
column2: 在星际联盟成立的最初几年被自由世界联盟吞并.

column1: Temperate Rollis is the source of a rare and highly valued variety of wood, and, consequentially, a busy black market. It also serves as a jumping-off point for those planning an adventurous journey into the Periphery.
column2: 温暖的罗利斯是一种稀有且非常珍贵的树种来源地，因此，这里是个繁忙的黑市. 对于那些计划冒险进入外围的人来说，这里也是一个起点.

column1: Settled by the Free Worlds League during the initial years of the formation of the Star League.
column2: 在星际联盟成立的最初几年，由自由世界联盟殖民定居.

column1: The home of the Romulans, pointy eared ali%%%. ERROR. Holovid database corrupted.
column2: 罗慕伦人的家园，尖耳朵的外星人%%%. 错误. 全息视频数据库已损坏.

column1: The weak soils on Rondane make agriculture difficult, and starvation is commonplace.
column2: Rondane上贫瘠的土壤使农业难以发展，饥荒司空见惯.

column1: Rondon was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Rondon是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Ronel is an inhospitable world located close to its parent star. Though it possesses significant mineral wealth, the planet was never settled properly. Instead mining companies assigns workers to multi-year contracts on the world and then rotates them off-world
column2: Ronel是一颗不宜居的星球，距离其母恒星很近. 尽管它拥有可观的矿产财富，这颗星球却从未被真正定居. 相反，矿业公司会以多年期合约将工人派驻该星球，随后再将他们轮换到星球之外.

column1: A young and geologically active world, Rosamond joined the Federated Suns during the formation of the Star league.
column2: 一个年轻且地质活跃的世界，Rosamond在星际联盟成立期间加入了恒星联邦.

column1: Roscoff was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Roscoff于统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某时被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Rosendal was a cold but habitable world when it was settled just after the Reunification War, but the same instability that produced its magnificent rings slowly shifted its orbit until the planet was glacier-bound and howling ice storms swept its surface.
column2: 统一战争之后就被殖民的鲁森达尔那时是个寒冷但适宜居住的星球，但造就其壮丽星环的不稳定性同样慢慢偏移了它的轨道，直到这颗行星被冰川裹住，咆哮的冰风暴席卷了它的表面.

column1: Settled by colonists from the Federated Suns during the Star League era. It was named after a local tree with viscous thorns.
column2: 星际联盟时代，来自恒星联邦的殖民者在此定居. 它得名于当地一种长有黏性尖刺的树木.

column1: Rosetta was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Rosetta在统一战争结束后的某个时候于星际联盟时代被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Settled by colonists from the Federated Suns during the formation of the Star League.
column2: 在星盟建立期间，来自恒星联邦的殖民者在此定居.

column1: After its rediscovery by Interstellar Expeditions during their exploration of the region, Rover has evidently been the subject of some kind of experiment conducted by the Star League due to the vast network of satellites in orbit.
column2: 在星际探险公司探索该区域期间重新发现Rover后，由于轨道上庞大的卫星网络，Rover显然曾是星际联盟进行的某种实验的对象.

column1: Settled by colonists from Croatia during the Exodus from Terra, Rowe joined the Federated Suns in the years before the formation of the Star League.
column2: 在从泰拉大迁徙期间，来自克罗地亚的殖民者定居于Rowe；在星际联盟成立前的数年间，Rowe加入了恒星联邦.

column1: Royal was one of the worlds engulfed in conflict during what became known variously as the Second Hidden War of the Star League era, also known as the War of Davion Succession. DCMS infantry forces captured the First Prince, pulling him from his cockpit, forcing him to kneel and then beheading him.
column2: Royal是星际联盟时代后来以不同名称闻名的那场冲突——即第二次隐秘战争，也被称为戴维恩继承战争——中卷入战火的星球之一. DCMS步兵部队俘获了第一王子，将他从驾驶舱中拖出，强迫他跪下，然后将他斩首.

column1: The headquarters of Foxx Infantry Systems, Royal Foxx has three continents named Vixen, Skulk, and Waagosh. The capital city of Reynard is located on Vixen.
column2: Foxx Infantry Systems的总部所在地Royal Foxx拥有三块大陆，分别名为Vixen、Skulk和Waagosh. 首府城市Reynard位于Vixen.

column1: Royalston was an important trading world within the St. Ives Mercantile League  thanks to numerous jump points within easy reach of the planet.
column2: 得益于该行星近旁众多易于抵达的跃迁点，Royalston曾是圣艾夫斯商业联盟内的重要贸易世界.

column1: Rubigen is a small, dark, and cold world with over half of its surface locked away under ice. Over 15% of the admiralty of the Draconis Combine comes from Rubigen, proving the addage that tough times create tough people.
column2: Rubigen是一个微小、昏暗且寒冷的世界，其表面超过一半被冰封. 天龙联合体超过15%的海军将领都来自Rubigen，这印证了那句老话: 艰难岁月造就坚韧之人.

column1: Michaelson Heavy Industries is headquartered on Ruchbah, and is the main source of income for the world.
column2: 迈克尔森重工业总部位于Ruchbah，是该行星的主要收入来源.

column1: Settled by the Outworlds Alliance during the Star League era, this quiet world avoids attention for the most part.
column2: 在星际联盟时代由外空联盟殖民定居，这个宁静的世界大多数时候都不引人注意.

column1: Rukbat is a poisoned jewel of a world. Despite the abundant plant and animal life, the vast mineral resources, and a climate much like Terras, the environment is totally incompatible with human and Terran lifeforms.
column2: Rukbat是一颗如毒宝石般的世界. 尽管拥有丰富的动植物生命、储量巨大的矿产资源以及与地球十分相似的气候，但其环境与人类和地球生命形式完全不相容.

column1: Ruschegg once rebelled against the Free Worlds League, but mercy granted by Marion Marik has ensured that the population is now fiercely loyal.
column2: Ruschegg曾反抗自由世界联盟，但玛丽昂·马里克赐予的仁慈确保了当地民众如今忠心耿耿.

column1: Rushaven didn't attract significant attention from the Star League and Draconis Combine forces during Operation UNION HOLD.
column2: 在联合控制行动期间，拉什黑文并未引起星盟与龙尼斯联合体部队的太多注意。ZH

column1: A hot, arid world with a single, shallow, briny sea, Ryans Fate survives on flood farming in the brief rainy seasons, and mining high-quality crystals and fissionable materials from the extensive caverns that honeycomb the planet's surface.
column2: Ryans Fate 是一颗炎热干旱的世界，只有一片浅而咸的海域。它依靠短暂雨季中的漫灌农作，以及从遍布地表的广阔洞穴中开采高品质晶体与裂变材料来维持生存。ZH

column1: Ryans Fate
column2: 瑞安斯菲特

column1: Ryde is a cold world with a great deal of volcanic activity. It is an important manufacturer of pharmaceuticals, water purifiers, and chemicals (including explosives) and therefore enjoys a permanent defensive garrison of Lyran 'Mech Regiments.
column2: 赖德是一颗寒冷而火山活动频繁的星球。它是重要的药品、净水器与化学品（包括炸药）制造地，因此常年驻有莱兰机甲团作为防御卫戍。ZH

column1: Most of Ryerson's lowlands are taken up by a single massive megacity, carefully planned in the reconstruction following the Second Succession War. Industrial centers in the highlands supply raw materials to the factories at the outskirts of the city.
column2: 赖尔森的洼地大部分被一座巨大的超级都市占据，这座城市是在第二次继承战争后重建时精心规划的。高地上的工业中心为城市郊区的工厂供应原材料。ZH

column1: Rypful was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Rypful是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Rzhishchev was settled by colonists during the Exodus from Terra, and remained fiercely independent until eventually joining the Free Worlds League over three centuries later.
column2: Rzhishchev在从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间由殖民者建立，之后一直顽强地保持独立，直到三百多年后最终加入自由世界联盟.

column1: Saaremaa was settled by colonists during the Exodus from Terra, and was part of the Alliance of Galedon until eventually joining the Draconis Combine over a century later.
column2: Saaremaa是在从泰拉大出走期间由殖民者拓殖的，并一直是Galedon联盟的一部分，直到一个多世纪后最终加入天龙联合体.

column1: Gold is only one of the precious metals found here, and the other rare metals, minerals, and gems, as well as the more common metal ores, make Sabinillas a valuable resource center. Sabanillas Mining Company has an almost mafia like grip on the government.
column2: 黄金只是这里发现的贵金属之一，而其他稀有金属、矿物和宝石，以及更常见的金属矿石，使Sabinillas成为一个宝贵的资源中心. Sabanillas Mining Company对政府有着近乎黑手党般的控制.

column1: Sabhal Mòr Ostaig was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sabhal Mòr Ostaig于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Sabik is a sparsely populated desert world in a strategically important location. While there are some profitable mining operations on the planet, most of the small population exists to support the garrisoned 11th Lyran Regulars.
column2: Sabik是一颗人口稀少的沙漠世界，地处具有战略重要性的位置. 虽然星球上有一些有利可图的采矿作业，但这里稀少人口中的大多数都是为了支持驻守于此的第11天琴正规军而存在.

column1: Settled during the Star League era, the green rolling hills of Sackville are known for producing pipeweed and Bagginses.
column2: 在星际联盟时代有人定居，Sackville的翠绿起伏丘陵以出产烟斗草和巴金斯家族而闻名.

column1: This subterranean colony is excavated into a barren rocky planet. It serves as a critical shipping and travel link between the Aurigan region and the Magistracy. Trade, both legal and otherwise, thrives here.
column2: 这片地下殖民地挖入了一颗贫瘠的岩质行星. 它是御夫座地区和自治区之间重要的运输与航行纽带. 无论是合法的贸易还是其它的贸易，都在这里蓬勃发展.

column1: Most of Sadachbia's inhabitants live along the large islands scattered through the northernmost ocean for the simple reason that the most of the inland areas are harsh deserts.
column2: 萨达奇比亚的大多数居民生活在散布于最北部海洋中的大岛沿岸，原因很简单：大部分内陆地区都是严酷的沙漠。ZH

column1: Sadalbari is a mostly tropical world; most of the two major continents, Aberlani and Beth'lamel, and the island continent of New Kenya are covered with rainforests and jungles.
column2: 萨达尔巴里主要是一颗热带行星；两大主要大陆阿贝拉尼和贝斯拉梅尔，以及岛屿大陆新肯尼亚，都覆盖着雨林与丛林。ZH

column1: The agricultural world of Sadurni once served as the HQ of the SLDF 7th Army. Since then it has traded hands between Liao and Marik several times. The small population is spread out in rambling rural villages and cities, serving the surrounding farms.
column2: 农业星球萨杜尔尼曾是星际联盟防卫军第7集团军的总部. 自那以后它在廖氏和马里克之间易手了好几次. 少量的人口分散在杂乱的乡村和城市里，为周边的农场干活.

column1: Safe Port was an important trading world within the St. Ives Mercantile League  thanks to numerous jump points within easy reach of the planet.
column2: Safe Port是圣艾夫斯商业联盟内一个重要的贸易世界，这得益于该行星附近有众多易于抵达的跃迁点.

column1: Saffel is an arctic world along the Davion/Kurita border. Both a common target and staging area for attacks between the two nations, Staffel was only just seized by the Kuritans in 3039.
column2: 萨菲尔是戴维恩与库瑞塔边界上的一颗极寒星球。它既是两国之间攻击的常见目标也是集结地，3039年刚被库瑞塔人夺取。ZH

column1: Discovered by an eagle eyed private citizen as part of the OBT movement, Saggina is a long way from anywhere.
column2: 作为OBT运动的一部分，Saggina是由一位目光敏锐的普通公民发现的，它地处偏远，离哪里都不近.

column1: Saginaw was settled by colonists during the Exodus from Terra, and remained fiercely independent until eventually joining the Federated Suns over a century later.
column2: Saginaw是由殖民者在从泰拉向外大迁徙期间建立的，并且一直保持着强烈的独立倾向，直到一个多世纪后最终加入恒星联邦.

column1: Saidia is a colonized world within the Axumite Providence. Like most Axumite worlds, it survives on a late 20th Century technological level, with limited access to technology for most of the population.
column2: Saidia是阿克苏姆天命国境内的一个殖民世界. 与大多数阿克苏姆世界一样，它维持着20世纪后期的科技水平，大多数人口获取技术的机会有限.

column1: The headquarters of Sitwell Corporation, the main competitor to Bluth Corporation.
column2: Sitwell Corporation的总部，Bluth Corporation的主要竞争对手.

column1: An independent world for centuries until annexed by the Draconis Combine. During the final years of the Star League, Sakai was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
