column2: 数个世纪以来，它一直是一颗独立星球，直到被天龙联合体吞并. 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Sakai曾是星际联盟防卫军一支驻军的驻地.

column1: The icy world of Sakhalin was settled during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the Sarna Supremacy prior to the formation of the Capellan Confederation
column2: 冰封星球Sakhalin在第一次泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民，并在卡佩拉邦联成立之前是萨尔纳霸权的一员.

column1: Sakhalin marks one edge of the area of space within which the interstellar trade company Skye Traders was the dominant commercial interest, and was once host to an SLDF Garrison.
column2: Sakhalin标出了星际贸易公司Skye Traders曾占据主导商业利益的那片空间区域的一侧边缘，并且曾是一支SLDF驻军的驻地.

column1: Sakhara V was originally settled for its wide variety of rare earth metals. The harsh local terrain, mostly desert, also serves as a demanding training environment. With that in mind, the Sakhara Academy was established here.
column2: Sakhara V最初因拥有种类繁多的稀土金属而被殖民. 当地严酷的地形，多为沙漠，也可作为要求严苛的训练环境. 有鉴于此，Sakhara Academy在此建立.

column1: Sakuranoki was settled by colonists during the Exodus from Terra, and was part of the Alliance of Galedon until eventually joining the Draconis Combine over a century later.
column2: Sakuranoki是在泰拉大迁徙期间由殖民者定居的，曾隶属于加勒顿联盟，直到一个多世纪后最终加入天龙联合体.

column1: Once a minor travel hub, this system was quarantined due to an incurable, disfiguring viral plague. The moons serve as bases for pirate activity, but the status of the population on the surface is unknown.
column2: 这个星系曾经是一个小型航行枢纽，由于一种可致毁容，无药可救的病毒性疫情而遭隔离. 它的卫星群是海盗活动的基地，但地表的人口状况不详.

column1: Salem is the location of a significant percentage of the defense manufacturing that supplies the Armed Forces of the Federated Suns.
column2: Salem是相当大一部分为恒星联邦武装部队提供补给的国防制造业所在地.

column1: Home to the University of Salford, its lessons focus more on practical applications than theory.
column2: 作为Salford大学的所在地，该校的课程更注重实际应用而非理论.

column1: Salisberg was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Salisberg是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Salonika is a fleet base stationed at the Nadir jump point of an A4V star in the Deep Periphery. Located near Ctesiphon and Suda Bay, Salonika was operated by Clan Nova Cat during Operation Revival.
column2: Salonika是深空外围中一颗A4V型恒星天底跃迁点处的一处舰队基地. Salonika位于Ctesiphon和Suda Bay附近，在复兴行动期间由新猫氏族运作.

column1: During the Star League era both Saltillo and the nearby Millungera system were jointly administered by the Free Worlds League and the Star League, which sparked conflict.
column2: 在星际联盟时代，Saltillo和附近的Millungera星系均由自由世界联盟与星际联盟共同管理，这引发了冲突.

column1: Saltural was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Saltural在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Saltville was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Saltville是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居的，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: Settled by the Federation of Oriente during the initial years after the Exodus from Terra.
column2: 由Oriente联邦在从泰拉出走后的最初几年建立定居点.

column1: Salvende was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Salvende在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: One of the founding planets of the Taurian Concordat, Samantha is a large planet where cold-weather entertainment thrives and a broad range of manufacturing industries benefit from the low temperatures.
column2: 萨曼莎是金牛协约国的创始行星之一，是一颗大行星，在那儿，适于寒冷天气的娱乐产业蓬勃发展，许多制造业也受益于低温环境.

column1: San Carlos was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: San Carlos在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Sanda was settled by colonists during the Exodus from Terra, and was part of the Alliance of Galedon until eventually joining the Draconis Combine over a century later.
column2: Sanda是在从泰拉大迁徙期间由殖民者建立定居点的，并一直是加勒登联盟的一部分，直到一个多世纪后最终加入天龙联合体.

column1: Sanilac was settled by colonists during the Exodus from Terra, and remained fiercely independent until eventually joining the Federated Suns over a century later.
column2: Sanilac在从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间由殖民者建立，并在之后一直顽强保持独立，直到一个多世纪后最终加入恒星联邦.

column1: Santa-Ana was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Santa-Ana在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的交战中消亡了.

column1: Santiago IV is a surface garrison located in the Deep Periphery, near Kinbrace and Ramsey. During Operation Revival, Santiago IV was controlled by Clan Jade Falcon.
column2: Santiago IV是位于深空外围、靠近Kinbrace和Ramsey的一支地表驻军. 在复兴行动期间，Santiago IV由翡翠猎鹰氏族控制.

column1: Santander is also known as Santander's World. The infamous pirate Helmar Valasek is believed to launch operations from this planet.
column2: 桑坦德也被称为桑坦德世界。臭名昭著的海盗赫尔马·瓦拉塞克据信就是从这颗行星发起行动的。ZH

column1: Santiago IV is a surface garrison located in the Deep Periphery, near Kinbrace and Ramsey.
column2: Santiago IV是位于深空外围、靠近Kinbrace和Ramsey的地表驻防部队.

column1: Santiago (OA) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Santiago (OA) 是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: Sanurcha (Ildrong 2750+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sanurcha（Ildrong 2750+）在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡.

column1: Sanurcha was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sanurcha在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战乱期间消亡了.

column1: The Saonara system was home to a military outpost prior to the Reunification War, and became a colony world after the end of the War.
column2: Saonara星系在统一战争之前曾是一座军事前哨站的所在地，战争结束后则成为了一个殖民世界.

column1: Sapienza was originally a part of the Timbuktu Province of the Rim Worlds Republic and was conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth during the 2773-2775 Republic-Commonwealth war.
column2: Sapienza原本是边缘世界共和国Timbuktu行省的一部分，并在2773-2775年的共和国-共同体战争期间被天琴共同体征服.

column1: Sappho was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sappho是在统一战争结束后的星盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the initial years of the formation of the Star League.
column2: 在星际联盟成立的最初几年间，由天琴共同体建立定居点.

column1: Sardis was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sardis在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Sargasso was the host of a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年，Sargasso曾驻扎着星际联盟防卫军的一支卫戍部队.

column1: Colonised by the Rim Worlds Republic before the era of the Star League.
column2: 在星际联盟时代之前由边缘世界共和国殖民.

column1: Sarkel was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sarkel在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: An industrialised world of grasslands and forests, Sarmaxa exports many products across the Inner Sphere thanks to the Tao 'Mechworks facility.
column2: 作为一颗拥有草原与森林的工业化世界，萨尔马克萨凭借陶氏机甲厂向整个内天体出口众多产品。ZH

column1: Sarna has a dense population spread across seven mountainous heavily industrialized continents. The other seventy percent of the planet is deep saltwater oceans.
column2: Sarna拥有稠密的人口，分布在七个多山且高度工业化的大陆上. 这颗行星其余百分之七十是深邃的咸水海洋.

column1: After the original Terran colony was violently destroyed during the Age of War, the Star League tried to re-establish a functioning colony here with marginal success.
column2: 在战争时代，最初的泰拉殖民地被暴力摧毁后，星际联盟曾试图在此重建一个能正常运作的殖民地，但收效甚微.

column1: Sartu (Bastille 3130+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sartu (Bastille 3130+) 在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Covered in wide volcanic plains and plagued by storms, Satalice still has enough oases of beauty to support a moderate-sized population and even a 'Mech production plant.
column2: 萨塔利斯遍布广阔的火山平原，又饱受风暴困扰，但仍有足够多的美丽绿洲，足以支撑一个中等规模的人口，甚至还有一座机甲生产厂。ZH

column1: Sauk City was settled by colonists during the Exodus from Terra, and remained fiercely independent until eventually joining the Federated Suns over a century later.
column2: Sauk City是在从泰拉大迁徙期间由殖民者定居建立的，并一直保持强烈的独立，直到一个多世纪后最终加入恒星联邦.

column1: Saumur was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Saumur是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居的，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: Saunemin was settled by colonists during the Exodus from Terra, and remained fiercely independent until eventually joining the Federated Suns over a century later.
column2: Saunemin是在从泰拉大迁徙期间由殖民者定居的，并一直保持着强烈的独立，直到一个多世纪后最终加入恒星联邦.

column1: The major manufacturer on Savannah is Technicron Manufacturing, which is one of the medium sized military hardware manufacturers in the Free Worlds League, producing both a smattering of BattleMechs as well as JumpShips and WarShips.
column2: Savannah上的主要制造商是Technicron Manufacturing，它是自由世界联盟中一家中型军用硬件制造商，既生产少量战斗机甲，也生产跃迁舰和战舰.

column1: Savinsville is best known for the behavior of its satellites. Every thirty three years Schlera, Iris and Pupil (the moons) line up in the sky in such a way that they resemble a human eye. Luthien Armor Works built a factory on this world, which led to the population expanding quickly.
column2: Savinsville最出名的是其卫星的运行方式. 每隔三十三年，Schlera、Iris和Pupil（这三颗卫星）便会在天空中排成一线，看起来就像一只人眼. Luthien Armor Works在这颗星球上建造了一座工厂，这使得人口迅速增长.

column1: Savonburg is home to the Colleges of Savonburg, which educate millions of students every year. Recently, mysterious drop ships have been reported landing in the uninhabited continent of Solestra, with rumours abounding as to their purpose ranging from time travel experiments to alien invasion.
column2: Savonburg是Savonburg学院的所在地，这些学院每年培养数百万学生. 最近，据报道有神秘降落飞船降落在无人居住的索莱斯特拉大陆上，关于其目的的谣言四起，从时间旅行实验到外星入侵，不一而足.

column1: Settled during the initial years of the formation of the Star League.
column2: 在星际联盟成立初期被开拓定居.

column1: An ancient water world dotted with thousands of island chains, Sax is the home of a Liao training facility as well as several specialized research campuses that rely on the planet's tectonic stability.
column2: 萨克是一颗古老的水世界，散布着数千个岛链。它既是廖氏一处训练设施所在地，也是若干依赖该星球地壳稳定性的专业研究园区所在地。ZH

column1: Scarborough Licensing PLC is all that remains of Scarborough Manufacturing, a once massive manufacturing complex that was destroyed centuries ago in the First Succession War.
column2: Scarborough Licensing PLC是Scarborough Manufacturing仅存的一切，后者曾是一个庞大的制造综合体，于数百年前的第一次继承战争中遭到摧毁.

column1: Scheat has basic metal ores in its crust and rich fertile soil, and is known for exporting iron, aluminium, lumber and textiles.
column2: Scheat的地壳中蕴藏着基础金属矿石，并拥有肥沃的土壤，以出口铁、铝、木材和纺织品而闻名.

column1: Schedar was settled for its mineral resources. These minerals are key ingredients in semiconductors, and the harsh desert environment minimizes the incoming settlers.
column2: Schedar因其矿产资源而被殖民. 这些矿物是半导体的关键成分，而严酷的沙漠环境使迁入的定居者数量极少.

column1: Settled by the Free Worlds League during the Star League due to its easily accessible petroleum deposits.
column2: 星盟时期，自由世界联盟因其易于开采的石油矿藏而在此建立了定居点.

column1: Scheurheck once rebelled against the Free Worlds League, but mercy granted by Marion Marik has ensured that the population of Schuerheck is now fiercely loyal.
column2: Scheurheck曾反抗自由世界联盟，但马里昂·马里克赐予的仁慈确保了Schuerheck的民众如今极为忠诚.

column1: Settled by the Free Worlds League during the Star League due to its easily accessible gemstone deposits.
column2: 在星际联盟时期，自由世界联盟因其易于开采的宝石矿藏而在此定居.

column1: Schirmeck is a world with little industry, but is relatively self sufficient thanks to abundant agriculture and lumber.
column2: Schirmeck是一个工业寥寥的世界，但由于农业和木材资源丰富，相对而言能够自给自足.

column1: Schmitt was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Schmitt在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Schrim was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Schrim在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Dharma HyperSpace operates one of the last JumpShip facilities in the Inner Sphere in this system, with numerous other industries propped up by the vast mineral requirements.
column2: Dharma HyperSpace在该星系运营着内天体最后一批跃迁舰设施之一，而庞大的矿物需求也支撑着众多其他产业.

column1: The capital city of Schwartztadt lies near to the Komache Fields, a vast empty plain suitable for pastoral farming.
column2: Schwartztadt的都城位于Komache Fields附近，那是一片适合畜牧的广阔空旷平原.

column1: The forested world of Scituate was originally settled by the St Ives Mercantile League thanks to its many warp points.
column2: 森林覆盖的Scituate星球最初由圣艾夫斯商业联盟殖民，这得益于其众多的跃迁点.

column1: Prior to the fall of the Star League, Scudder was a lightly-populated world rich in germanium. Multiple mining sites were scattered over the world's four large continents. The germanium mined on this world was used in the construction of K-F drives in dozens of shipyards.
column2: 在星际联盟崩塌之前，斯卡德是一颗人口稀少、富含锗的星球。多处矿点散布在该星球的四块大陆上。这里开采的锗被用于在数十家船厂建造K-F驱动器。ZH

column1: Sebha was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sebha在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Second Chance is still littered with battle debris centuries after the First Succession War, where numerous drop ships and war ships were brought down over the surface.
column2: 第一次继承战争过去数百年后，Second Chance上仍散落着战斗残骸，当年大量降落船和战舰被击落在其表面.

column1: After the initial colony landing site was destroyed in an earthquake, the colonists moved to a new one and renamed their planet Second Try.
column2: 最初的殖民地登陆点在地震中被摧毁后，殖民者迁往了一处新地点，并将他们的行星更名为Second Try.

column1: Segerica was a Capellan industrial world, with extensive manufacturing facilities tucked into its planet-wide canyon systems. These facilities were the target of orbital nuclear strikes from the Free Worlds League, and the planet has been an empty wasteland since.
column2: 塞格利卡曾经是卡佩拉人的工业星球，遍布全球的峡谷中藏着大量的制造设施. 这些设施成了自由世界联盟轨道核打击的目标，自那以后整颗星球就变成了一片荒芜的废土.

column1: Seginus is a planet in slow decline. Bad weather paired with a long in system transit time has led to trade with the planet declining over time, although the long travel times also keeps the planet peaceful as it dissuades most raiders.
column2: Seginus是一颗正在缓慢衰落的行星. 恶劣的天气，再加上漫长的星系内航行时间，使得与该行星的贸易逐渐衰退；不过，漫长的旅途时间也让这颗行星保持安宁，因为这吓退了大多数劫掠者.

column1: Seiduts is described as being a rocky world, sparsely populated, with forests and jungles around the equator.
column2: Seiduts被描述为一个岩石世界，人口稀少，赤道周围分布着森林和丛林.

column1: Sekulmun is described as being a beautiful world, sparsely populated, with volcanoes around the equator.
column2: Sekulmun被描述为一个美丽的星球，人口稀少，赤道周围分布着火山.

column1: The dangerously high temperatures on Semenyih are just one of the dangers the miners here face.
column2: Semenyih上危险的高温只是这里的矿工面临的危险之一.

column1: The ice plains of Semichi are inhospitable to most life, but are home to a breed of bear similar to a terrestrial Kodiak.
column2: Semichi的冰原对大多数生命而言都不适宜生存，但这里却栖息着一种类似地球科迪亚克熊的熊类.

column1: Sendai was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sendai在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Sendalor's inland forests are home to the Manx Treecat, a rare delicacy that is only found on this world.
column2: 森达洛尔的内陆森林是曼克斯树猫的家园，这是一种只在本行星才能找到的稀有珍馐。ZH

column1: Senftenberg's industrial base in the Cavez Valley was destroyed during the Second Succession War, which thankfully spared most of the populace.
column2: 森夫滕贝格在卡韦兹谷的工业基地在第二次继承战争中遭到摧毁，所幸大多数平民得以幸免。ZH

column1: Senorbi was used centuries ago as a staging post during the Reunification War, which has led many treasure hunters to the surface to look for caches.
column2: Senorbi在几个世纪前曾被用作统一战争期间的中转站，这使得许多寻宝者前往其地表寻找储藏点.

column1: Sentarus was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sentarus是在统一战争结束后的某个时间点、星际联盟时代被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Serenity was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Serenity在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战乱中消亡了.

column1: Apart from a few frozen lakes and rivers, Sertar is dry. Basins of red dust exist where oceans should be.
column2: 除了少数冰封的湖泊与河流外，Sertar十分干燥. 在本该是海洋的地方，分布着红色尘土的盆地.

column1: The planet Setubal is a desert world with very hot equatorial zones. Human habitation is only possible in the polar regions with their tropical and subtropical climate. Settled for its abundant subterranean water supplies, Setubal features extensive cave systems which are used to grow edible fungi.
column2: Setubal行星是一个沙漠世界，赤道地区极其炎热. 人类只可能在拥有热带和亚热带气候的极地地区居住. 由于拥有丰富的地下水源而在此定居，Setubal拥有庞大的洞穴系统，这些洞穴被用于种植食用真菌.

column1: Seuta Bimyeong was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Seuta Bimyeong于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Seven Lands (Garotte 3130+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Seven Lands (Garotte 3130+) 在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Sevon - is a lightly-populated and lightly industrialized world with a single moon. A mutual distrust of outsiders is common across the world, due to the devastation caused to their world during the Succession Wars.
column2: Sevon——是一颗人口稀少、工业化程度较低、拥有一颗卫星的星球. 由于在继承战争期间他们的星球所遭受的破坏，整个星球普遍对外来者怀有共同的不信任.

column1: The presence of radioactive materials within the crust of Sevren support the burgeoning industrial base, which offers power plants to numerous worlds across the Inner Sphere
column2: Sevren地壳中放射性物质的存在支撑着其蓬勃发展的工业基础，该工业基础为内天体的众多世界提供发电厂.

column1: Shadow is a large moon orbiting a gas giant. The system's sun is only a slightly larger star in Shadow's dark sky which is dominated by the gas giant. The world is in twilight most of the time, with no discernible day-night-cycle.
column2: 暗影是一颗环绕气态巨行星的大型卫星。该星系的太阳在暗影黑暗的天空中只是一个略大的恒星，天幕由那颗气态巨行星主宰。该世界大部分时间处于暮光之中，没有可辨识的昼夜循环。ZH

column1: Placed deep in the Deep Periphery astrogeographical feature known as the Orion Rift, the installation known colloquially as Shady Palms is located within the asteroid belt around the the yellow-white super giant star catalogued as SLSC F81a.0086.
column2: 位于被称为Orion Rift的深空外围天文地理特征深处，俗称Shady Palms的设施坐落在编号为SLSC F81a.0086 的黄白色超巨星周围的小行星带内.

column1: One of the only Axumite Providence worlds with the resources to maintain an industrial fusion power plants, Shahhat is at roughly mid 21st century levels of technology.
column2: 作为仅有的几个拥有维持工业聚变发电厂所需资源的阿克苏姆天命国世界之一，Shahhat的技术水平大致处于21世纪中叶.

column1: The forested moon of Shahr Kord was originally settled by the Rim Worlds Republic.
column2: Shahr Kord的森林卫星最初由边缘世界共和国拓殖.

column1: Shalaine was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Shalaine在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Shardayne was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Shardayne在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Sharpe vanished from maps during the Third Succession War, but the Argo still contains its location. I wonder what is there?
column2: Sharpe在第三次继承战争期间从星图上消失了，但阿尔戈号仍然存有它的位置. 我想知道那里有什么？ZH

column1: Sharqah was once the base for an SLDF Division. After they left, the world's most notable feature was a series of religious retreats and pilgrimage sites in the world's craggy mountains.
column2: 沙尔卡曾是某支SLDF师的基地。他们离开之后，该世界最引人注目之处就是其嶙峋群山间的一系列宗教静修所与朝圣地点。ZH

column1: Settled by colonists from South America during the Exodus from Terra. Shasta is home to large amounts of native wildlife such as the Skatha Ape, Agouti Rat and Lute Shrike.
column2: 在从泰拉大迁徙期间，来自南美洲的殖民者在此定居. Shasta是大量本土野生动物的家园，例如斯卡萨猿、刺豚鼠和鲁特伯劳.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Shaul Khala was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Shaul Khala曾驻有星际联盟防卫军的一支驻军.

column1: Shaul Khala
column2: 绍尔哈拉

column1: Shaun (Burl 2822+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Shaun（Burl 2822+）在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: The population of Shaunavon is mostly confined to domes and subterranean facilities. Deep fissures in the crust allow miners to reach rare earth minerals, and the planet's economy is built around their extraction.
column2: 肖纳文的人口大多局限于穹顶与地下设施中。地壳深处的裂隙让矿工能够触及稀土矿物，该行星的经济便建立在其开采之上。ZH

column1: Iroquois Machinery Limited is the primary exporter of goods from Shawnee, a heavily industrialised world.
column2: 易洛魁机械有限公司是Shawnee所产商品的主要出口商，Shawnee是一个高度工业化的星球.

column1: Sheliak is a minor planet with few resources, and very little garrison.
column2: Sheliak是一颗资源匮乏、驻军极少的次要行星.

column1: Shensi is a Earth-like world, which is most notable for its extensive forestry and mineral reserves. It has three continents (Klondike, Mongot and Kungara), which are extensively forested.
column2: Shensi是一颗类地星球，以其广阔的森林和矿产资源而闻名. 它有三块大陆（克朗代克、蒙戈特和昆加拉），上面森林广布.

column1: Shenwan's inland seas are home to the Manx Kipper, a rare delicacy that is only found on this world.
column2: 神湾的内海是曼克斯腌鱼的家园，这是一种只在本行星才能找到的稀有珍馐。ZH

column1: Sheratan is described as being a beautiful world, sparsely populated, with forests and jungles around the equator.
column2: Sheratan被描述为一个美丽的星球，人口稀少，赤道周围有森林和丛林.

column1: Sheridan contains many ores that are considered rare within the Inner Sphere, making it an ideal world for manufacturing and industry.
column2: Sheridan蕴藏着许多在内天体被视为稀有的矿石，使其成为制造业和工业的理想世界.

column1: Dense jungles of light purple fungal towers cover Sheridan, with kilometers of large plateaus with steep sides breaking through the glowing canopy.
column2: Sheridan被茂密的浅紫色真菌塔丛林覆盖，绵延数公里、边缘陡峭的大型高原穿透了发光的林冠.

column1: Sherwood is one of those worlds that was eminently suitable for human colonisation without the need for terraforming, with a flourishing ecology that features towering, tree-like plants that reach heights of more than 100 metres.
column2: Sherwood是那些极其适合人类殖民、无需地球化改造的世界之一，其繁茂的生态系统以高逾100米的参天树状植物为特色.

column1: The hot, dry, high-gravity world of Shiba is a center for mining and manufacturing, and its two billion inhabitants live in an endless urban sprawl that surrounds the factories that drive the world's economy.
column2: 炎热干燥的高重力世界希瓦是采矿与制造中心，其二十亿居民生活在无边无际的城市蔓延之中，环绕着驱动该世界经济的工厂。ZH

column1: Shibukawa is the world where Cholobara grows, a fruit from which a potent and valuable but perishable aphrodisiac wine can be made.
column2: Shibukawa是Cholobara生长的世界，这种水果可以酿成一种强效、珍贵但不耐储存的催情酒.

column1: Shiloh is an unappealing planet, inhabited almost entirely by a splinter religious group known as the Exituri. The Exituri shun interstellar politics and advanced technology, and so Shiloh has remained an unimportant and barely inhabited world.
column2: Shiloh是一颗不讨喜的行星，居民几乎全是被称为Exituri的一个分裂宗教团体. Exituri回避星际政治和先进技术，因此Shiloh一直是一个无足轻重且几乎无人居住的世界.

column1: Shimoda was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Shimoda在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Shimonita possesses a single large industrialised continent surrounded by islands. The surrounding ocean is constantly whipped into a frenzy by massive storm activity that perpetually forms in Shimonita's atmosphere.
column2: 下仁田拥有一块被岛屿环绕的大型工业化大陆。周围海洋因该行星大气中永久形成的猛烈风暴而不断翻腾激荡。ZH

column1: Transport pilots tell stories about the horrific winds over Shimonoseki which have wrecked numerous dropships.
column2: 运输机师们讲述着Shimonoseki上空的可怕狂风，这些狂风已经摧毁了许多降落飞船.

column1: Shimosuwa was conquered by the Draconis Combine during the First Succession War, which resulted in massive civilian casualties and an end to the industrial base on the planet.
column2: 在第一次继承战争期间，Shimosuwa被天龙联合征服，导致大量平民伤亡，并终结了该行星上的工业基础.

column1: Shinonoi has a long, mild growing season, fertile land and ample native livestock, which continues to this day. Great mineral wealth was found during the Star League era which further boosted its economy.
column2: Shinonoi拥有漫长而温和的生长季、肥沃的土地和丰富的本土牲畜，这些优势延续至今. 星际联盟时代发现了大量矿产资源，进一步推动了其经济发展.

column1: Shionoha is a quiet, industrialised world that has slightly too much nitrogen in the atmosphere for human comfort, requiring either special medication or respirators for long periods outside.
column2: Shionoha是一个宁静的工业化世界，其大气中的氮气含量略高于人类舒适范围，长时间在户外需要服用特殊药物或佩戴呼吸器.

column1: Shipka was discovered by traders under the command of Captain Phillip Shipka out of St. Andre who were trying to reach Highspire. After exploring the system they discovered that the world was rich in natural resources and possessed abundant fresh water.
column2: Shipka是由来自St. Andre、试图抵达Highspire的商人发现的，他们由Phillip Shipka上尉指挥. 在探索该星系后，他们发现这颗星球自然资源丰富，并拥有充足的淡水.

column2: Shiri在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: As one of the first colonised worlds, Shiro is a heavily industrialised world with major factories of Irian BattleMechs Unlimited and Grumman Amalgamated producing massive quantities of material.
column2: 作为最早被殖民的星球之一，Shiro是一个高度工业化的世界，拥有Irian BattleMechs Unlimited和Grumman Amalgamated的大型工厂，生产着大量物资.

column1: Brusk, Massona and Meijer are the trio of cities that make up the Triumverate government of Shirotori.
column2: Brusk、Massona和Meijer是组成Shirotori三城执政政府的三座城市.

column1: Shitara's inhospitable desert like surface was originally settled not for agricultural or manufacturing reasons, but to serve as a regional transportation hub. With access to many star systems, Shitara is now a wealthy waystation and refueling point for expeditions into the further reaches of the Inner Sphere.
column2: 设田那不宜居住的沙漠般地表最初被殖民，并非出于农业或制造的原因，而是要充当区域交通枢纽。由于能通往众多星系，设田如今是一个富裕的中转站与补给点，供深入内天体更远地区探险者使用。ZH

column1: Shoreham has vast mudflats that criss cross its continents.
column2: Shoreham拥有广阔的泥滩，纵横交错贯穿其大陆.

column1: Sighisoara has vast fungal growths that criss cross its continents, used for chemical and medicinal purposes.
column2: Sighisoara拥有广袤的真菌群落，纵横交错地遍布其各大洲，被用于化学和医药用途.

column1: The planet Shuen Wan is the homeworld of the Kincha fruit, a delicacy that resists all attempts to grow it on other worlds.
column2: Shuen Wan行星是Kincha果实的母星，这种美味佳肴无法在其他任何世界种植，所有尝试均告失败.

column1: Shui-pào was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Shui-pào是在统一战争结束后的星盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Sialkot was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sialkot在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Sian is the modern capital world of the Capellan Confederation, noted be the best defended planet of House Liao. It is the home of much of House Liao's major industries and political leadership.
column2: 暹罗是卡佩兰联邦如今的都城世界，被认为是廖家族防御最严密的行星。它是廖家族大部分主要产业与政治领导层的所在地。ZH

column1: Sichuan was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.

column1: Siendou is a rocky, resource-rich world and an established constitutional theocracy. Adherants to the global faith of Siendou are prohibited from serving in a national military.
column2: Siendou是一个岩石质、资源丰富的世界，也是一个成熟的宪政神权政体. Siendou全球信仰的信徒被禁止在国家军队中服役.

column1: Sierpc is a quiet, average world that has slightly too much ozone in the atmosphere for human comfort, requiring either special medication or respirators.
column2: Sierpc是一个安静、普通的星球，其大气中的臭氧含量对人类舒适而言略高，需要服用特殊药物或佩戴呼吸器.

column1: Vast tundras filled with mineral rich rock ensure the population of Sierra is at least well paid amidst the inhospitable environment.
column2: 广袤的冻原上遍布富含矿物的岩石，这至少确保了Sierra的居民在这片不宜居的环境中能获得丰厚的报酬.

column1: Sighisoara has vast mud flats that criss cross its continents, used for mining and recreational purposes.
column2: Sighisoara拥有广袤的泥滩，纵横交错地分布在其各个大陆上，既用于采矿，也用于休闲娱乐.

column1: Despite being a small, cold and inhospitable world Sigma Mare is rather overpopulated. By the end of the Third Succession War Sigma Mare was known as a center of research for geophysical/terraforming research, something that helped make the planet liveable.
column2: 尽管是一颗寒冷小而不宜居的星球，西格玛母马却人口过剩。到第三次继承战争结束时，西格玛母马已以地球物理与地球化改造研究中心闻名，这也帮助该星球变得可居。ZH

column1: Sigurd is the cold moon of a glowing gas giant, described as a striped sphere that fills a third of the sky. The surface of Sigurd is completely made up of an ice mantle several hundred meters thick, with liquid water below.
column2: Sigurd是一颗寒冷的卫星，围绕着一颗发光的气态巨行星运行，被描述为一个布满条纹的球体，占据了天空的三分之一. Sigurd的表面完全由数百米厚的冰幔构成，冰层之下是液态水.

column1: Sikkim was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sikkim在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Sileste was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sileste在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间战火中消亡.

column1: Acid rain is a persistent problem on Silkeborg. The rain is so acidic that it poses a danger to human health, although it does carve the native rock into some interesting formations.
column2: 酸雨是Silkeborg长期存在的问题. 雨水酸性极强，对人类健康构成威胁，不过它也确实将原生岩石侵蚀成了某些有趣的地貌.

column1: Named for the large deposits of silver found on the surface, Silver is a wealthy mining colony.
column2: 因地表发现的大量银矿藏而得名，Silver是一个富裕的采矿殖民地.

column1: Simancas was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Simancas在统一战争结束后的星盟时代某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Acid rain is a persistent problem on Simferopol. The rain is so acidic that it poses a danger to human health, although it does carve the native rock into some interesting formations.
column2: 酸雨是Simferopol长期存在的问题. 雨水酸性极强，对人体健康构成危险，不过它确实将原生岩石侵蚀成了些有趣的地貌.

column1: Simone was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Simone在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: Named after a dessert thanks to a typo by a clerk, Simpson Desert is actually a world filled with beautiful forests and rolling hills.
column2: 因一名文员的笔误而以甜点命名，Simpson Desert实际上是一颗遍布美丽森林和起伏丘陵的星球.

column1: A minor Capellan colony, Sindalin's frequent impact events from its asteroid-choked orbit eventually led Liao to abandon the world. The colony buildings were soon consumed by the planet's endless dust storms.
column2: 作为卡佩兰的一块次要殖民地，辛达林因其小行星密布的轨道而频繁遭受撞击事件，最终让廖氏放弃了这颗行星。殖民地的建筑很快被该行星无尽的沙暴吞没。ZH

column1: Sinope served as the headquarters world for the XV Corps of the Star League Defense Force before the end of the Star League.
column2: 在星际联盟终结之前，Sinope曾是星际联盟防卫军第15军的总部世界.

column1: There are large underground reservoirs of liquid water, heated by geothermal vents. Occasionally this water erupts onto the surface and freezes in the cold vacuum, covering the planet with tiny ice crystals.
column2: 地下有巨大的液态水储层，由地热喷口加热. 偶尔这些水会喷涌到地表，在寒冷的真空中冻结，使整个行星覆盖上细小的冰晶.

column1: The moon of Sirius VI was colonised first, before the terraforming on the mineral rich oxygen poor main planet could take place. Sirius was recently a member of the Tikonov Free Republic until the end of the Fourth Succession War.
column2: Sirius VI的卫星最先被殖民，那时对资源丰富但氧气稀薄的主行星进行的地球化改造尚未开始. 直到第四次继承战争结束前，Sirius最近还是Tikonov自由共和国的一员.

column1: One of the original worlds of the Rasalhague Consortium, it was conquered by the Draconis Combine during its war of conquest.
column2: 它是Rasalhague Consortium的原始世界之一，在天龙联合体的征服战争期间被征服.

column1: Often used as an administrative hub or tax haven over the centuries thanks to its location, Skandia is an otherwise unexceptional world.
column2: 由于其地理位置，几个世纪以来，Skandia常被用作行政枢纽或避税天堂；除此之外，它只是一颗毫不起眼的行星.

column1: Skaslien was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Skaslien在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Skat is a quiet, average world that has slightly too much ozone in the atmosphere for human comfort, requiring either special medication or respirators.
column2: Skat是一个安静、普通的世界，大气中的臭氧含量对人类舒适度而言略高，因此需要特殊药物或呼吸器.

column1: Skepptana was the site of a major warship crash during the Amaris Civil War, leaving its surface a war torn wreck. Many scavengers and pirates find their way here to pick up repaired weaponry or mechs.
column2: Skepptana曾是阿马里斯内战期间一艘大型战舰坠毁的地点，其地表因此沦为饱受战火摧残的废墟. 许多拾荒者和海盗辗转来到此地，以获取修复过的武器或机甲.

column1: Skiland was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Skiland是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: An ice world rich in minerals, its geothermal vents produce much of the power for the mining facilities.
column2: 一个富含矿物的冰封世界，其地热喷口为采掘设施提供了大部分动力.

column1: Skondia possesses abundant deposits of rare metals and minerals. Skondia produces nickel-alloys, titanium, and steel, used in everything from forks to fusion reactors. Ownership has changed hands multiple times over the course of the Succession Wars.
column2: Skondia拥有丰富的稀有金属和矿产储量. Skondia生产镍合金、钛和钢，用于从餐叉到聚变反应堆的各种产品. 在继承战争期间，其所有权曾多次易手.

column1: Settled after the age of war, the vast bulbous plant life on on Skvorec is not very tasty but is extremely mineral rich.
column2: 战争时代之后才有人定居，Skvorec上广袤的球状植物并不太美味，但富含矿物质.

column1: The planet Skye is dominated by a single supercontinent that reaches into more than one hemisphere. Skye is a rarity, in that it is a habitable planet within a binary star system; when Skye was discovered by explorers it was an unspoiled world.
column2: Skye行星由一个延伸至不止一个半球的单一超级大陆所主导. Skye十分罕见，因为它是双星系统中的一颗宜居行星；当探险者发现Skye时，它还是一片未遭破坏的世界.

column1: A science colony which had over two million people at one point, Skyfog was abandoned in 2769 when the Amaris Coup ended the supply runs that the colonists needed to survive. The moon was rediscovered by Interstellar Expeditions in 3003.
column2: Skyfog曾是一个科学殖民地，一度拥有超过两百万人口；2769年，阿马里斯政变中断了殖民者赖以生存的补给运输，Skyfog因此被废弃. 3003年，这颗卫星被星际探险组织重新发现.

column1: Slaithwaite has vast mud flats that criss cross its continents, used for mining and recreational purposes.
column2: Slaithwaite拥有广袤的泥滩，纵横交错于其各大陆之上，用于采矿和休闲娱乐.

column1: The Slewis system was colonised by the Rim Worlds Republic by the end of the Age of War and became an fiercely independent world after the fall of the Star League.
column2: Slewis星系在战争时代末期被边缘世界共和国殖民，并在星际联盟覆灭后成为一个极度独立的世界.

column1: Devastated during the Amaris Civil War, Slocum still remains hostile to life due the nuclear bombardment centuries ago
column2: 在阿马里斯内战期间遭到毁灭性打击，由于几个世纪前的核轰炸，Slocum至今仍不适合生命生存.

column1: Small World is an arctic world in the middle of a two thousand year long ice age. Settlements are limited to a narrow band around the planet's equator and the only exports of note are high grade thorium and uranium ore.
column2: 小世界是一颗北极世界，正处于长达两千年的冰河期中。定居点仅限于行星赤道周围一条狭窄地带，值得一提的出口产品只有高品位钍矿与铀矿。ZH

column1: A former Star League era armory and fortification, Smithon is the home system of House Karosas. The old Capellan fortresses have been converted to civilian habitation, and enterprising scavengers scour the planet for any remaining LosTech.
column2: 史密森是一处前星际联盟时代的军火库兼要塞，也是卡罗萨斯家族的母星. 这座古老的卡佩拉要塞已经转变为民用居所，而有商业头脑的拾荒者则在此星球搜寻任何残存的失落科技.

column1: Early in Smolensk's history it was the site of the Smolensk Incident, where many colonists were killed by Terran Colonial Marines. It remains wary of Terra ever since.
column2: 斯摩棱斯克历史早期曾发生“斯摩棱斯克事件”，许多殖民者被地球殖民陆战队杀害。此后它一直对地球心存戒备。ZH

column1: The howling winds of Smolnik are believed to contain the souls of the departed, according to folklore.
column2: 根据民间传说，Smolnik呼啸的狂风被认为承载着逝者的灵魂.

column1: Smythe was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Smythe在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被开拓，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Snailzar was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Snailzar是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Snowdon was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Snowdon是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Settled after the age of war, the vast fungi growths on Sodertalje are not very tasty but are very nutritious.
column2: 在战争时代之后才有人定居，Sodertalje上广袤的真菌虽然不太好吃，但营养非常丰富.

column1: Sodus has vast salt plains that criss cross its continents, used for mining and recreational purposes.
column2: Sodus拥有广袤的盐原，纵横交错地分布在其各个大陆上，既用于采矿，也用于休闲娱乐.

column1: Soilihull was colonised early in the Exodus from Terra, and remains an important agricultural world for nearby systems.
column2: Soilihull在泰拉大迁徙早期就被殖民，至今仍是附近星系重要的农业世界.

column1: Solaris VII is known across the galaxy for its 'Mech fights. Gamblers place exorbitant amounts of money on longshot bets, and fortunes are won and lost daily. Solaris City, in particular, hosts six major arenas and numerous MechWarrior stables.
column2: 索拉里斯VII在整个银河以其机甲混战闻名。赌徒在冷门赌注上押下巨额金钱，财富每日在此赢得又输掉。尤其是索拉里斯城，拥有六个主要竞技场和众多机师马厩。ZH

column1: Solor was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Solor在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Somerset I - more commonly known simply as Somerset - is the innermost planet in the system and has two moons named Bull and Hint. Somerset has been home to a small military academy during its history.
column2: Somerset I——通常简称为Somerset——是该星系中最内侧的行星，拥有两颗名为Bull和Hint的卫星. 在其历史上，Somerset曾是一所小型军事学院的所在地.

column1: The Songgang system was colonised during or shortly before the Age of War by the United Hindu Collective.
column2: Songgang星系是在战争时代期间或稍早之前由联合印度教集体殖民的.

column1: Son Hoa has an interesting geographical feature: The Vanishing Sea. During the blistering summers, all the water in the sea evaporates. Once the seasons turn, the water condenses out of the atmosphere and returns to the seabed.
column2: Son Hoa拥有一个有趣的地理特征: 消失之海. 在酷热的夏季，海中所有水分都会蒸发. 一旦季节转换，水便会从大气中凝结出来，并重新回到海床.

column1: Settled at the start of the First Succession War by refugees from the borders, Sonnia has grown into an economic powerhouse.
column2: 在第一次继承战争之初，来自边境的难民定居于Sonnia，如今它已发展成为一个经济重镇.

column1: A center for the arts and learning, Sophie's Choice is an idyllic planet with vast fertile oasis dotted throughout its desert like surface.
column2: 作为艺术与学术的中心，苏菲之选是一颗田园般的行星，沙漠般的地表上点缀着大片肥沃的绿洲。ZH

column1: Sornath was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sornath在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Sorsk was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sorsk在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Sorunda has a large population of Buddists. It also possesses three continents named Black Falls, Serenity, and Xeno.
column2: Sorunda拥有大量佛教徒. 它还拥有三块大陆，分别名为Black Falls、Serenity和Xeno.

column1: Soul is a generally inhospitable world. The unforgiving environment is a combination of the dimness of the system's star, as well as Soul's lack of an axial tilt. Soul is home to a Blankenburg Technologies assault mech factory.
column2: 索尔总体上是颗不宜居的星球。严酷的环境源于该星系恒星的昏暗，以及索尔缺乏轴倾角。索尔是布兰肯堡科技公司一处突击机甲工厂的所在地。ZH

column1: Kilometer wide rapids criss cross this otherwise stepped world, allowing the creation of vast hydroelectric plants.
column2: 宽达一公里的急流纵横交错于这个在其他方面呈阶梯状的世界，使得建造庞大的水力发电厂成为可能.

column1: Home to Marley Munitions Works, Sparrevohn is specialized in the production of munitions
column2: 作为Marley Munitions Works的所在地，Sparrevohn专门从事弹药生产.

column1: Sparta was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sparta是在统一战争结束后的某个时候于星际联盟时代建立的殖民地，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: This former Taurian world is encircled by a vast shallow ocean, teeming with native and Terran aquatic life. During the abortive Taurian-Canopian War, the Magistracy invaded as a retaliation for attacks on their worlds.
column2: 这颗前金牛星球被一片广袤的浅海包围着，其中充满着本土和地球的水生生物. 在流产的金牛-船底战争期间，自治区出于对袭击他们星球的报复，入侵了这里.

column1: Spica has been fought over for centuries, leaving its surface a war torn wreck. Many scavengers and pirates find their way here to pick up repaired weaponry or mechs.
column2: 数个世纪以来，各方为争夺Spica而战，使其地表沦为饱受战火蹂躏的废墟. 许多拾荒者和海盗会寻路至此，获取修复后的武器或机甲.

column1: Spirit was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Second Succession War.
column2: Spirit在星际联盟时代，即统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在第二次继承战争期间的交战中消亡.

column1: Orignally a Draconis Combine world, Spittal is now part of the Free Resalhague Republic. Spittal is home to Benson and Bjorn which manufacures a variety of military vehicles.
column2: Spittal原本是一个天龙联合体星球，现在是自由拉萨尔哈格共和国的一部分. Spittal是Benson and Bjorn的所在地，该公司生产各种军用车辆.

column1: A nearly lifeless world reminiscent of primordial Terra, Spitz is primarily of interest to exogeologists who study the early days of future life-bearing planets.
column2: 施皮茨是一个几乎没有生命的星球，让人回忆起原始地球. 关注施皮茨的人主要是研究未来宜居行星的早期阶段的地外地质学家.

column1: St. Andre is a red desert planet located anti-spin of Terra, notable for its rich natural resources. St. Andre is noteworthy for the meeting of leaders in 2366 that formed the Capellan Confederation.
column2: St. Andre是一颗位于泰拉反旋向的红色沙漠行星，以其丰富的自然资源而闻名. St. Andre之所以引人注目，是因为2366年在此举行的领导人会议组建了卡佩拉邦联.

column1: St. Timalin is a recently rediscovered planet in the St. Andreas system, orbiting a dim red primary. It is a dark world, with black flora that has evolved to survive on the dim light emitted by the red primary, which the colonists named St. Andreas.
column2: St. Timalin是St. Andreas星系中最近被重新发现的一颗行星，环绕一颗暗淡的红色主星运行. 它是一颗黑暗的世界，拥有黑色植物群，这些植物已经进化到能在红色主星St. Andreas发出的微弱光线下生存.

column1: St. Cyr was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: St. Cyr是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: St. Gall was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: St. Gall在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: St. Ives is the capital of the newly formed St. Ives League. The military industries on the planet have been built in to the vast cavern networks present on the planet, forcing attackers to attempt to seize them in costly close quarters actions.
column2: St. Ives是新成立的St. Ives联盟的首都. 该行星上的军事工业已建入行星上庞大的洞穴网络之中，迫使进攻者试图以代价高昂的近距离作战夺取它们.

column1: St. Ives
column2: 圣艾夫斯

column1: The St. Jean colony is situated on the system's second planet. Barely 500 monks remain on the colony, as the planet slowly dies out as its largest moon falls towards the planet.
column2: 圣让殖民地位于该星系的第二颗行星上。殖民地仅剩不到500名修士，因为随着它最大的卫星向行星坠落，这个世界正慢慢消亡。ZH

column1: St John is an oceanic world, consisting of a few large islands that are dotted around an ocean mostly free of ice, except at the poles. There are great tidal plains that appear during the lunar cycle, showcasing wreckage from ancient battlefields.
column2: St John是一个海洋世界，由几座大岛组成，这些岛屿散布在一片大部分无冰的海洋中，只有两极除外. 在月相周期期间会出现大片潮汐平原，露出古代战场的残骸.

column1: St. Loris is an important agricultural center. In 3010 the 2nd St. Ives Lancers fought the Ceti Hussars there and much of the planet's vital wheat crop was destroyed, which caused a mighty famine. The crop has recovered, but the population has not.
column2: 圣洛里斯是一处重要的农业中心。3010年，第2圣艾夫斯枪骑兵在此与塞提骠骑兵交战，星球上大量重要的小麦作物被毁，引发了一场严重饥荒。作物后来恢复了，人口却再未回到从前。ZH

column1: St. Loris
column2: 圣洛里斯

column1: Dense jungles of light blue fungal towers cover St. Robert, with kilometers of large plateaus with steep sides breaking through the canopy.
column2: 茂密的淡蓝色真菌塔丛林覆盖着St. Robert，绵延数公里、侧壁陡峭的大型高原穿透了林冠.

column1: Staffin was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Staffin于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: A large recruiting world for the Marian Hegemony, Stafford's high gravity produces extremely muscular troopers who excel in mountainous terrain.
column2: 作为马里亚纳霸权的大型募兵世界，斯塔福德的高重力造就了极为强壮的士兵，他们在山地地形中表现出色。ZH

column1: A supercontinent with some small, shallow seas that are constantly steaming. Spires of sharp stone interrupt the otherwise flat terrain.
column2: 一片超大陆，点缀着几片不断冒着蒸汽的浅小海洋. 尖锐的石峰打破了原本平坦的地形.

column1: Settled by scientists during the first Exodus as a research station to examine the planet's rings, 'Stantsia' has evolved into a fully self sufficient colony.
column2: 作为第一次大逃亡期间科学家们为考察该星球环系统而建的研究站，“斯坦齐亚”已发展为一个完全自给自足的殖民地。ZH

column1: Stanzach took severe damage in the Fourth Succession War, and the recovery was stifled when it become part of the recently formed Free Rasalhague Republic. Regardless, it is still an important economic system for the FRR.
column2: Stanzach在第四次继承战争中遭受了严重破坏，而当它成为新近成立的自由拉萨尔哈格共和国的一部分时，其复苏又受到了抑制. 尽管如此，它仍是FRR重要的经济星系.

column1: Named for its poor agriculture, Stapelfeld is a grubby little world with little going for it. And that's what the last mayor called it.
column2: 因农业贫瘠而得名，施塔佩尔费尔德是一颗邋遢的小行星，几乎一无是处。而这话还是上一任市长说的。ZH

column1: An unexplored star cluster outside the Inner Sphere.
column2: 内天体之外一处未经探索的星团。ZH

column1: Star Cluster 752
column2: 星团752

column1: Stardawn was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Stardawn于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: A former mining system, Star's End has only one planetary body, Novo Cressidas, and several large asteroid belts that make navigation in the system extremely hazardous without intimate knowledge of the system.
column2: 作为一个前采矿星系，星之尽头只有一个行星体新克雷西达斯，以及若干庞大的小行星带，若没有对系统的深入了解，在该星系中航行极其危险。ZH

column1: Starshine was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Starshine是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: An icy world consisting of tundra and a few frozen lakes. Towering columns of hexagonal black stone permeate the land, whilst constant snow storms ensure no right minded individual would wish to settle here.
column2: 一个由苔原和几片冰封湖泊组成的冰封世界. 高耸的六边形黑色石柱遍布大地，而持续不断的暴风雪使得任何头脑正常的人都不会想在此定居.

column1: Steelton was settled by a mixture of artists and craftsmen from Kufstein and Predlitz, technicians from St. John and engineers from New Bergen. This mix of settlers are responsible for some of this worlds magnificent architecture.
column2: Steelton的定居者包括来自Kufstein和Predlitz的艺术家与工匠、来自St. John的技术人员以及来自New Bergen的工程师. 正是这种定居者的融合，造就了该世界一些宏伟的建筑.

column1: The high energy star offers ample solar energy for this otherwise barren world, allowing crops to grow with poor soil.
column2: 高能恒星为这个原本贫瘠的世界提供了充足的太阳能，使作物能在贫瘠的土壤中生长.

column1: Private colonists setting out for a beautiful garden world were shocked to find the only habitable regions were in the highland peninsulas, thus naming the world after their founder, Stein's Folly.
column2: 私人殖民者出发前往一颗美丽的田园星球，却震惊地发现唯一宜居的区域都在高地半岛上，于是以创始人之名把该星球命名为“斯坦的愚行”。ZH

column1: Stellaris was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Stellaris是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

column1: A small industrial world located near to the jump point for quick access, Sterling offers a multitude of products... and sins... for the right price.
column2: 一个位于跃迁点附近、便于快速进出的小型工业世界，只要价钱合适，Sterling能提供琳琅满目的商品……以及种种罪恶……

column1: Most cities on Sterlington are located on high plateaus, above an ever turbulent sea of clouds. Whilst oxygen is thin here, it does provide ample opportunity for recreation and cloud diving.
column2: Sterlington上的大多数城市坐落在高耸的高原上，俯瞰着一片永远汹涌的云海. 这里的氧气虽然稀薄，却为休闲娱乐和云中潜水提供了充足的机会.

column1: During the final years of the Star League, Sternwerde was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison. Heavy cloud cover causes many issues for exporting from Sternwerde, but below the cloud is a moist but mild climate.
column2: 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Sternwerde曾驻扎有星际联盟防卫军的一支驻军. 厚重的云层给从Sternwerde出口带来了许多问题，但云层之下是湿润而温和的气候.

column1: Sterope, sometimes named New Taurus, is an industrial world located in the rimward Periphery. The planet is home to Sterope Defense Industries as well as corporate unit of Taurus Territorial Industries.
column2: Sterope，有时也被称为New Taurus，是一颗位于边缘方向外围星域的工业世界. 这颗行星是Sterope Defense Industries以及Taurus Territorial Industries下属企业单位的所在地.

column1: Stettin (FWL) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Stettin (FWL) 于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Stettin is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League and trades goods internally within the League.
column2: Stettin是构成被称为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家一部分的星球之一，并在同盟内部进行货物贸易.

column1: Stewart was settled by colonists from the British Isles, who engineered vast terraforming works on the surface. Stewart maintains its healthy environment to this day and is one of the richest worlds in the Free Worlds League.
column2: Stewart由来自不列颠群岛的殖民者定居，他们在其表面实施了大规模的地球化改造工程. Stewart至今仍保持着良好的环境，是自由世界联盟中最富庶的星球之一.

column1: Stirling was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Stirling于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Stockpoll was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Stockpoll在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡.

column1: Stonarboi was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Stonarboi在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Storfors is the planet most like Terra in the Storfors system, but two other worlds are inhabited as well. J.B. BattleMechs Incorporated manufactures Mech parts here.
column2: Storfors是Storfors星系中最像泰拉的行星，但另外两个世界也有人居住. J.B. BattleMechs Incorporated在此生产机甲零件.

column1: Once a heavily populated world filled with factories, Strotzing was bombarded during the Second Succession War, leaving the population to subsist on agriculture for centuries amidst a tainted atmosphere.
column2: Strotzing曾是一个遍布工厂、人口稠密的世界，却在第二次继承战争期间遭到轰炸，使当地居民数百年来只能在受污染的大气中依靠农业勉强度日.

column1: Stralsund is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League, trading goods amongst the other worlds in the League.
column2: Stralsund是构成被称为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家一部分的星球之一，在同盟内的其他星球之间进行货物贸易.

column1: Strana Mechty is considered an almost sacred world to the Clans. It is the site where Nicholas Kerensky escaped too, and where he founded the rigid social structure of the Clans. The world can be seen as the birthplace of the Clans.
column2: Strana Mechty对氏族而言被视为一个近乎神圣的世界. 这里也是尼古拉斯·克伦斯基逃往的地方，以及他建立氏族严格社会结构的地方. 这个世界可以被视为氏族的诞生地.

column1: The Strandfontein system was colonized at some point during the reign of the Star League, and was host to a large SLDF garrison. Unfortunately the bases were raided during the Succession Wars, so no LosTech can be found here.
column2: Strandfontein星系在星际联盟统治时期的某个时候被殖民，并曾驻扎着一支庞大的SLDF驻军. 遗憾的是，这些基地在继承战争期间遭到劫掠，因此这里找不到任何失落科技.

column1: The world of Stratford has large rocky, polar continents with many fjords. These continents are cold and wet, yet still life thrives in this hard environment. The Stratford narwhal makes its breeding grounds near and within the many natural inlets.
column2: Stratford星球拥有大片岩石嶙峋的极地大陆，遍布众多峡湾. 这些大陆寒冷潮湿，但生命仍在这严酷环境中繁盛. Stratford独角鲸在许多天然水湾附近及其中繁育.

column1: Strato Domingo is a planet in the Clan Homeworlds that was held jointly by the Diamond Sharks and the Hell's Horses. It is the only location in Clan space where HarJel is found, and the Sharks guard it zealously.
column2: 斯特拉托·多明戈是部族母星世界中的一颗星球，由钻石鲨与地狱马共同持有。它是部族空间内唯一出产哈杰尔的地方，鲨鱼部族对其严加看守。ZH

column1: A once beautiful world that was ravaged by the Combine in both the First and Second Succession wars, Strawn has never fully recovered.
column2: Strawn曾是一颗美丽的星球，但在第一次和第二次继承战争中被天龙联合体蹂躏，至今仍未完全恢复.

column1: Once a heavily populated world filled with automated farms, Streator was bombarded by nuclear weapons during the First Succession War, decimating the population which has only now recovered to pre war levels.
column2: 曾经是一个人口稠密、遍布自动化农场的星球，Streator在第一次继承战争期间遭到核武器轰炸，人口锐减，直到现在才恢复到战前水平.

column1: Sturganos was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sturganos在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

column1: Once a heavily populated world filled with factories, Sturgis was bombarded for two months by the Draconis Combine during the Second Succession War, leaving the population to subsist on agriculture for centuries amidst a tainted atmosphere.
column2: Sturgis曾是一个人口稠密、遍布工厂的世界，在第二次继承战争期间遭到天龙联合体长达两个月的轰炸，导致其人口在受污染的大气中靠农业为生长达数个世纪.

column1: Four-fifths of the surface of the planet Styk is covered with various saltwater oceans; dotted around the surface are nine assorted continents of varying sizes. It is heavily industrialised, with Tao MechWorks being a major employer and exporter.
column2: Styk星球表面的五分之四被各类咸水海洋覆盖；表面散布着九块大小不一的各类大陆. 该星球高度工业化，Tao MechWorks是主要雇主和出口商.

column1: Styriania was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Styriania在统一战争结束后的某个时候、星际联盟时代被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Styx is a world of storms, flash floods, and mudslides, wild weather patterns caused by the gravitational pull of the planet's three moons. Nevertheless, the storms often reveal rich mineral deposits which make Styx extremely wealthy.
column2: 斯提克斯是一颗风暴、山洪与泥石流肆虐的世界，其狂暴的天气模式由该行星三颗卫星的引力造成。尽管如此，风暴常常揭露出丰富的矿藏，使斯提克斯极为富庶。ZH

column1: Suda Bay is a fleet base at the Nadir jump point of a type F21a star in the Deep Periphery near Ctesiphon and Trelleborg. Ships recharging in the system take 173 hours to recharge.
column2: Suda Bay是深空外围中一颗F21a型恒星的天底跃迁点处的一座舰队基地，靠近Ctesiphon和Trelleborg. 在该星系中充电的舰船需要 173 小时完成充电.

column1: Sudeten circles its brilliant sun at a distance of nearly three astronomical units. A mostly terran planet, it has three continents. Dargoth where the capital city Hammarr is located, Holcomb and Jarho Islands.
column2: Sudeten以近三个天文单位的距离环绕着它那颗耀眼的恒星运行. 它是一颗大部分为类地环境的行星，拥有三块大陆: 首都哈马尔所在的达戈斯、霍尔科姆和雅霍群岛.

column1: One of the worlds conquered by the Marian Hegemony, Suetonius provides logistical support to nearby Legions.
column2: 作为马里安霸权征服的星球之一，Suetonius为附近的军团提供后勤支援.

column1: A border world against the Outworlds Alliance, munitions depots were created all across the icy world of Suianheer. Nowadays, the mining colonies occasionally stumble across LosTech and more.
column2: 作为一处与外域联盟接壤的边境世界，军火库曾遍布冰冷的Suianheer星球. 如今，采矿殖民地偶尔会偶然发现失落科技以及更多东西.

column1: Suk II is a mining world rich in rare and valuable resources. It would be a pleasant world if it were not for poisonous algae that contaminate around half of the world's water and make water purification plants a requirement at all settlements.
column2: 苏克II是一颗富含稀有贵重资源的采矿世界。如果不是因为有毒藻类污染了全世界约一半的水源、使所有定居点都必须配备净水厂，它本会是一颗宜人的行星。ZH

column1: An beautiful world, it would be a breadbasket if not for the heavy metals poisoning the soil across the most habitable continent, a remnant of Lyran savagery during the First Succession War.
column2: 一个美丽的世界，若非重金属毒害了最宜居大陆的土壤，这里本会成为粮仓——这是第一次继承战争期间天琴人野蛮行径的遗留.

column1: During the Star League era, the LXVI Corps had its headquarters located on world, surrounded by mountains on a world covered in them. Sometime during the Succession Wars, the location was lost and it has been hunted for forever since.
column2: 在星际联盟时代，第66军的司令部设在一颗行星上，四周群山环绕，而这颗行星本身就遍布山脉. 在继承战争期间的某个时候，该地点失传了，自那以后人们便一直在搜寻它.

column1: Summer has been an important mining world for the last several centuries. It possessed an SLDF garrison before the fall of the Star League and has since been garrisoned by the Lyran armed forces in order to protect the planet from Kuritan raids.
column2: Summer在过去几个世纪里一直是一个重要的采矿世界. 在星际联盟覆灭之前，它曾拥有SLDF驻军，此后一直由天琴武装部队驻守，以保护该星球免受栗田袭击.

column1: Summerstide was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Summerstide在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Summit has a unique flat tax rate for its citizens, which stems from its role in the initial Outer Reaches Rebellion centuries ago. It does have a surprisingly equalising effects with high rates of contentment amongst the population.
column2: Summit对其公民实行一种独特的统一税率，这源于它几个世纪前在最初的外缘叛乱中所扮演的角色. 它确实产生了出人意料的平等化效果，民众的满意度很高.

column1: Sumy was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sumy于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Sunchon was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sunchon于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战事中消亡.

column1: Sunnywood is a disingenuously-named barren rock world where an ambitious colony spent centuries dying. Many ruins dot the world as a testament to humanity's optimism.
column2: 阳光木是一颗名字起得极不诚实的荒芜岩石世界，一个野心勃勃的殖民地在上面用了几个世纪慢慢死去。行星上遍布废墟，见证着人类的乐观。ZH

column1: Sun Prairie, famous for its name sake, is a vast steppe covered world which feeds the population on numerous surrounding worlds.
column2: Sun Prairie，因其同名而闻名，是一个广袤的、被草原覆盖的世界，为周边众多世界上的人口提供食物.

column1: Famous for its Kodiak Bearfish fished from its frozen seas, Surcin is an icy world with a plethora of native aquatic life. Once a major manufacturer of arctic survival wear, it now relies on mass aquatic life exports.
column2: 以从冰封海洋中捕捞的科迪亚克熊鱼而闻名，Surcin是一个拥有丰富本土水生生物的冰雪世界. 它曾是极地生存服装的主要制造商，如今则依赖大规模水生生物出口.

column1: In 3023 Kurita troops were sent in to break up a Leif Erickson Day celebration sponsored by the Sons of Knute and the Chrysanthemum Cross-Cultural Appreciation Society, which led to the rebellion which resulted in them joining the FRR.
column2: 3023年，栗田部队被派去驱散由克努特之子会和菊花跨文化欣赏协会赞助的莱夫·埃里克森日庆祝活动，这引发了叛乱，并最终导致他们加入了FRR.

column1: When people hear of Susulatna, they think of Susulatna Sultanas, those juicy inch long delights that can be found at many neighbouring worlds. Apart from fruits, Susulatna has a pleasant climate for wealthier Commonwealth citizens to relax at.
column2: 当人们听说Susulatna时，他们会想到Susulatna苏丹娜葡萄——那些多汁、一英寸长的美味，在众多邻近世界都能找到. 除了水果，Susulatna还拥有宜人的气候，供较富有的共同体公民放松休憩.

column1: Firmly situated amongst the Draconic Combine for centuries, Sutama produces a vast range of citrus fruits and pharmaceuticals for export. The tropical climate of Sutama makes it a vacationing hotspot for higher ranked Nobles of the Combine.
column2: Sutama数百年来一直稳固地处于天龙联合体之中，生产种类繁多的柑橘类水果和药品供出口. Sutama的热带气候使其成为天龙联合体高阶贵族的度假热点.

column1: Famous for Ando Bass fished from its frozen seas, Suzano is an icy world with a plethora of native aquatic life. Once a major manufacturer of light vehicles, it has since suffered in the most recent Succession Wars.
column2: Suzano是一个冰封世界，以其冰冻海洋中捕捞的Ando Bass而闻名，拥有大量本土水生生物. 它曾是轻型车辆的主要制造商，但后来在最近的继承战争中遭受重创.

column1: Svalstad was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Svalstad在统一战争结束后的星盟时代某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间消亡.

column1: Rolling green hills and forests surround the main city of Port Svarstaad, the central city of the planet where most major lumber based industries and exporters are located.
column2: 起伏的绿色丘陵和森林环绕着Port Svarstaad的主要城市，它是该行星的中心城市，大多数主要木材产业和出口商都位于那里.

column1: A founder of the short-lived Principality of Rasalhague, prior to the Principality being conquered by the Draconis Combine in the early to mid Twenty-fourth century, Svelvik has once again reclaimed its heritage.
column2: 作为短命的Rasalhague公国的创建者之一——该公国在二十四世纪早期至中期被天龙联合体征服——Svelvik再次夺回了自己的传承.

column1: An independent world at first, Sverdlovsk was contacted by Shiro Kurita, the Director of the newly-created Alliance of Galedon with an offer to join. They declined. Sverdlovsk was thus the first world conquered by Kurita by military force.
column2: 起初是一个独立世界，Sverdlovsk被新成立的Galedon联盟的领导者Shiro Kurita联系，对方提出邀请其加入. 他们拒绝了. 因此，Sverdlovsk成为Kurita以军事力量征服的第一个世界.

column1: Producers of the hardest, roughest swill on this side of the Lyran Commonwealth, this agricultural world has a reputation for hardy farmers in the tough climate.
column2: 作为天琴共同体这一侧最烈、最粗劣的劣酒产地，这颗农业星球以在严酷气候中坚韧耐劳的农民而闻名.

column1: Swales was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Swales在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Do you like Swartklips? Well come on down to Swartklip, home of the universe's only Swartklips!
column2: 你喜欢斯瓦特克利普吗？那就来斯瓦特克利普吧，宇宙唯一斯瓦特克利普的故乡！ZH

column1: Sweet Water was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Sweet Water在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战乱中消亡了.

column1: The native life on Sylvan is lithe and quick, often darting away before colonists can catch even a glimpse of the wonderous creatures. The nature preserves on Sylvan are renown for their beauty.
column2: Sylvan上的原生生物轻盈敏捷，常常在殖民者还没来得及瞥见这些奇妙生物一眼之前就飞快地溜走. Sylvan上的自然保护区以其美丽而闻名.

column1: The low gravity ice world of Sylvester is a popular destination for many thrill seekers, with its population devoted almost entirely to a service based economy.
column2: 低重力的冰封世界Sylvester是许多寻求刺激者的热门目的地，其人口几乎完全投身于以服务为基础的经济.

column1: An unremarkable system, noted only for the mining facilities built to withstand the high gravity and rocky terrain, as well as being located only a weeks travel from the jump point.
column2: 一个平平无奇的星系，唯一值得一提的是为抵御高重力和崎岖地形而建造的采矿设施，以及它距离跃迁点只有一周的行程.

column1: Symsonia is unique for its architecture. Many buildings are designed using local stonework and metals which create a citywide symphony when a fohn wind blows between them.
column2: Symsonia以其建筑而独具特色. 许多建筑采用当地石材与金属建造，当焚风穿行其间时，便会奏响一曲遍及全城的交响乐.

column1: Synsstad was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Synsstad于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被建立定居点，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

column1: Syrma is a water-rich world with a host of natural resources. Considered a dream world for development when it was found by explorers, Syrma remains a highly industrialised world even now.
column2: Syrma是一颗水资源丰富、拥有大量自然资源的星球. 被探险者发现时，它曾被视为开发的理想之地；时至今日，Syrma仍是一个高度工业化的星球.

column1: Once the site of numerous SLDF caches, they were bombarded from orbit when the SLDF left - leaving the world in ruins. Numerous plagues have not done the population much good over recent years.
column2: 这里曾是众多SLDF储藏库的所在地；当SLDF离开时，这里遭到了轨道轰炸——只留下一个沦为废墟的世界. 近年来，无数瘟疫也没让当地民众好过多少.

column1: Szepes was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Szepes于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Szombathely was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Szombathely是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被建立为定居点的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Tabayama is the capital world of the Galedon Military District, and many citizens are employed in running the government. There is also a market in venison exports, due to deer thriving on the surface - hunting is mandatory to save the croplands.
column2: Tabayama是Galedon军事区的首府星球，许多公民受雇从事政府管理工作. 由于鹿在地表大量繁殖，这里还有鹿肉出口市场——为保护农田，狩猎是强制性的.

column1: Tabit (Tyrfing 2350's+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: 塔比特（提尔锋2350年代+）是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中灭亡。ZH

column1: Tadjoura is a colonized world within the Axumite Providence. The system is just over 38 light-years from the Axumite Providence capital, Thala, and 1,010 light-years anti-spinward from Terra.
column2: Tadjoura是阿克苏姆天命国境内的一个殖民世界. 该星系距离阿克苏姆天命国首府Thala仅略超过38光年，并位于泰拉逆旋向1，010光年处.

column1: Taga was founded and settled by the St. Ives Mercantile League in the 23rd Century, but fell under Capellan rule soon after. This world, famed for its export of Kaidok survival wear, is often known for its rebellious tendencies.
column2: Taga由圣艾夫斯商业联盟于23世纪建立并殖民，但不久后便落入卡佩拉统治之下. 这个以出口Kaidok生存服而闻名的世界，常因其反叛倾向而著称.

column1: The ruins of Tainjin BattleWorks still fill the Kodi Valley today, picked over by salvagers of centuries past. Without industry, Tainjin is now just a harsh mining world.
column2: Tainjin BattleWorks的废墟至今仍遍布科迪谷，过去几个世纪的打捞者早已将其翻找殆尽. 失去工业后，Tainjin如今只是一个严酷的矿业世界.

column1: Takata (New Start 3130+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Takata (New Start 3130+) 于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Talcott has the significant percentage of the defense manufacturers that supply the Armed Forces of the Federated Suns. New Avalon, Crofton, Kathil, Panpour, Salem and Talcott supply move than half of all the equipment used by the AFFS.
column2: Talcott拥有为恒星联邦武装部队供货的国防制造商中相当大的比例. New Avalon、Crofton、Kathil、Panpour、Salem和Talcott供应了AFFS所用全部装备的一半以上.

column1: Talisker was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Talisker在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Prior to the Fall of the Star League, Talitha served as the headquarters of the 8th Army of the SLDF and had sway over all the Free Worlds League. Devastation from recent wars have left Talitha struggling to provide for its own citizens.
column2: 在星际联盟陨落之前，Talitha曾是星际联盟防卫军第八集团军的总部所在地，并左右着整个自由世界联盟. 近年来的战火摧残使Talitha难以供养自己的公民.

column1: Tallassee was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Tallassee于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间因战乱而消亡.

column1: Tallin was founded and settled by the St. Ives Mercantile League in the 23rd Century, but fell under Capellan rule soon after. This world, famed for its Kodiak bear pelts and clothing industry, is often known for its rebellious tendencies.
column2: Tallin由St. Ives商业联盟于23世纪建立并殖民，但不久后便落入卡佩拉统治之下. 这个星球以科迪亚克熊皮和服装产业闻名，也常因其反叛倾向而著称.

column1: Tallmadge is a large breadbasket of a world with a large local manufacturing base for personnel weaponry and small armoured vehicles. There is a large monument to a Valkyrie riding Mechwarrior, left over from the First Succession Wars.
column2: Tallmadge是一个庞大的粮仓世界，本地拥有庞大的单兵武器和小型装甲车辆制造基地. 这里还有一座巨大的纪念碑，纪念一位驾驶Valkyrie的机甲战士，这是第一次继承战争遗留下来的.

column1: Tall Trees is infamous as the site of the New Tierra del Fuego II plague, a virulent plague which hit the island and killed everyone living there. Rumour has it that the plague was actually created in a Capellan genetic research lab.
column2: Tall Trees因作为新火地岛II瘟疫的发生地而臭名昭著，这种烈性瘟疫袭击了该岛，并杀死了所有居住在那里的人. 有传言说，这种瘟疫实际上是在卡佩拉的一个基因研究实验室中制造出来的.

column1: Tamar has long been a self-sufficient world, notable only for the War College of Tamar, an important Commonwealth military academy.
column2: Tamar长期以来一直是一个自给自足的世界，仅因Tamar战争学院而闻名，那是一所重要的共同体军事学院.

column1: Tamarind is known across the Inner Sphere for the quality of its artwork. Many artists start on Tamarind and charge a premium for their artworks. This was the cause to many raids and combat engagements that took place on the world.
column2: Tamarind因其艺术品的品质而闻名于整个内层空间. 许多艺术家从Tamarind起步，并为自己的艺术作品收取高价. 这正是导致该星球上发生许多突袭和战斗冲突的原因.

column1: Tamaron is a world located in the Kerensky Cluster. It is best known for being the capital of Clan Coyote. Though Tamaron was once considered only marginally habitable, Clan Coyote has overcome its ecosystem and built a thriving culture on world.
column2: Tamaron是位于克伦斯基星团的一颗行星. 它最出名的是作为郊狼氏族的首都. 尽管Tamaron曾被认为仅勉强宜居，但郊狼氏族克服了其生态系统的限制，并在该星球上建立了繁荣的文化.

column1: A few islands are dotted around an ocean covered by ice everywhere except near the equator. There are wide, black, rocky beaches. The plants are tall purple stalks covered in black tentacles, each with a single circular leaf at the top.
column2: 几座岛屿散布在一片海洋中，除了赤道附近，海面到处都被冰层覆盖. 这里有宽阔的黑色岩石海滩. 植物是高大的紫色茎秆，上面覆满黑色触手，每根茎的顶端都长着一片圆形叶子.

column1: An extremely Earth like world with large mineral reserves, Tancredi is home to many manufacturers such as Precision Weaponry as well as the Tancredi War College.
column2: 一个与地球极为相似、拥有大量矿产储量的世界，Tancredi是众多制造商的所在地，包括Precision Weaponry以及Tancredi战争学院.

column1: Tangerz (Mayadi 2822+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Tangerz（Mayadi 2822+）在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

column1: Dense forests of tall, white stalks cover Tangipahoa. The remains of an ancient, massive impact crater can be seen all the way from orbit - the ruins of a catastrophe from the First Succession War.
column2: 高大白色茎秆组成的茂密森林覆盖着Tangipahoa. 从轨道上就能看到一处古老而巨大的撞击坑遗迹——那是第一次继承战争留下的灾难废墟.

column1: A sandy desert lit by a bright blue sun. The local plant life takes the shape of small green bubbles. The apex predators inject their prey with digestive enzymes and appear to be part of a kind of a fungal superorganism.
column2: 一片被明亮蓝色恒星照耀的沙质沙漠. 当地的植物生命呈小型绿色气泡状. 顶级掠食者会向猎物注入消化酶，并且似乎是一种真菌超个体的一部分.

column1: A hot volcanic world, the Fifth Sword of Light uses this world as a training ground for laser based combat in hot or low gravity environments.
column2: 一个炎热的火山世界，第五光之剑将这个世界用作在高温或低重力环境下进行激光作战的训练场.

column1: Mu (μ) Ursa Major, Tania Australis, is a red star in the right hind paw of the Greater Bear. Settled long after its sister world, Tania Borealis, Tania Australis is a fertile agricultural world known for its rich pepper wines.
column2: Mu (μ) Ursa Major，即Tania Australis，是大熊座右后爪上的一颗红星. Tania Australis比其姊妹世界Tania Borealis晚得多才被殖民，是一个肥沃的农业世界，以醇厚的胡椒酒闻名.

column1: Lambda (λ) Ursa Major, Tania Borealis, is a star in the right hind paw of the Greater Bear. One of five worlds to be a part of the Stewart Confederation before the Star League, Tania Borealis lost its manufacturing capabilities centuries ago.
column2: Lambda (λ) Ursa Major，Tania Borealis，是大熊座右后爪中的一颗恒星. 作为星际联盟之前斯图尔特邦联一部分的五颗星球之一，Tania Borealis在几个世纪前失去了其制造能力.

column1: A desert world with sands rich in silicon, Tannil is home to numerous small electronics industries. The Second Arkab Legion, still at full strength as they sat out the Fourth Succession War, make this one of their patrol worlds.
column2: 一个沙粒富含硅的沙漠世界，Tannil拥有众多小型电子产业. 第二阿卡布军团因未参与第四次继承战争而仍保持满编，他们将这里作为其巡逻世界之一.

column1: SURVEY DATA CORRUPT
column2: 勘测数据损坏.

column1: Tantallon was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: Tantallon在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

column1: Prior to the Fall of the Star League, Tantara was the headquarters world of the Star League Defense Forces LVII Corps (Star League) and 12th Jump Infantry Division. Rebellions were common amongst the population, a fact that remains until this day.
column2: 在星际联盟覆灭之前，Tantara曾是星际联盟防卫军第LVII军（星际联盟）和第12跳跃步兵师的总部星球. 民众中叛乱频发，这一情况至今依旧.

column1: Tanz was a part of the Traders Domain province of the Outworlds Alliance during the Star League era, but was devastated in the Second Succession Wars, leading to its abandonment.
column2: 在星盟时代，Tanz曾是外域联盟贸易者领域行省的一部分，但在第二次继承战争中遭到毁灭，导致其被废弃.

column1: The exceedingly high gravity of Tapachula means that the mineral wealth on the surface is too dangerous to extract, and thus the world has been relegated to mostly agricultural products. The foods here grow chewy in the gravity.
column2: Tapachula极高的重力意味着其地表的矿产资源开采起来太过危险，因此这颗星球主要沦为农产品产地. 这里的食物在这种重力下长得很有嚼劲.

column1: Taran's World was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
column2: 塔兰世界是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中灭亡。ZH

column1: Tarazed city sits atop a large plateau above the extensive mudflats of the world. Mining operations are common here for easily accessible heavy ores and petroleum.
column2: Tarazed城坐落于该世界广袤泥滩上方的一座大型高原之上. 由于重矿石和石油易于开采，这里的采矿作业十分常见.

column1: Tarkio has many large and small islands centered around the south pole and between the equator and south pole. Easily mined metals are scarce, but boreholes allow access to the rich depths.
column2: Tarkio拥有众多大大小小的岛屿，主要分布在南极周围以及赤道与南极之间. 易于开采的金属十分稀缺，但钻孔可以通往富饶的深层矿藏.

column1: Tarnby has five major landmasses, with the three largest centered around the polar areas. Geological activity is active across most of the surface, which brings easily mined materials in key spots.
column2: Tarnby拥有五块主要大陆，其中最大的三块集中在极地地区. 大部分地表地质活动活跃，这使得关键地点蕴藏着易于开采的材料.

column1: Settled at some point prior to the end of the Age of War, Tarol IV was a member of the Magistracy of Canopus when an SLDF task force under the command of Captain-General Marion Marik was assigned to conquer the Magistracy of Canopus in 2577.
column2: Tarol IV在战争时代结束前的某个时候被殖民，在2577年，当由马里昂·马里克元帅指挥的SLDF特遣部队被指派征服船底自治区时，它是该自治区的成员.

column1: This inhospitable world is subjected to fierce tidal stresses from the gas giant it orbits, with constant earthquakes and storms making colonization a deadly enterprise. Even so, some hardy people cling to the world, mining heavy metals and fissionable material.
column2: 这颗不宜居星球受到自身围绕的气态巨星的强大潮汐力影响，地震与风暴连续不断，殖民无异于送死. 即便如此，依然有些坚强勇敢之辈坚守在这颗星球，开采重金属与裂变材料.

column1: A hot inhospitable world, it is nevertheless a bountiful source of rare gems not found on other worlds.
column2: 一个炎热且不宜居住的世界，尽管如此，它却是其他世界所没有的稀有宝石的丰富来源.

column1: The Tatopani system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but was destroyed in the Second Succession War.
column2: Tatopani星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在第二次继承战争中毁灭.

column1: A vast desert covers three quarters of the planets surface, whilst the remaining quarter is left to an organic rich ocean with deep sea farms.
column2: 广袤的沙漠覆盖了这颗行星四分之三的表面，而剩余的四分之一则是富含有机物的海洋，并设有深海农场.

column1: Tau Ceti is famous as the destination of the first manned mission to another star system, when Captain Norm McKenna on the TAS Pathfinder jumped to Tau Ceti and back in 2108, leading to the founding of the first human colony, named New Earth.
column2: Tau Ceti因作为首次载人前往另一个恒星系统的目的地而闻名，当时诺姆·麦肯纳船长乘坐TAS Pathfinder于 2108 年跃迁至Tau Ceti并返回，促成了首个名为新地球的人类殖民地的建立.

column1: Taumaturgo was a part of the Traders Domain province of the Outworlds Alliance during the Star League era, but vanished during the First Succession War as the colony died out.
column2: Taumaturgo在星际联盟时代曾是外域联盟贸易者领域省的一部分，但在第一次继承战争期间随着殖民地消亡而消失了.

column1: The political and cultural capital of the Taurian Concordat, and the technological heart of the Periphery, this system is defended by a dangerous asteroid belt that makes it nearly impossible to approach without local support.
column2: 金牛协约国在政治和文化上的首府，也是外围的技术核心，这个星系由一条危险的小行星带保护着，没有当地支持的话接近它几乎是不可能的.

column1: Naturally forming geothermal holes pockmark the surface of Tawas, allowing easy access to drawing rich mineral wealth out of the deepest depths of the planet. Rumours of large shadow like creatures below are just that, rumours.
column2: Tawas表面遍布天然形成的地热孔洞，这使得人们可以轻松地从这颗行星的最深处开采出丰富的矿产财富. 有关其下方存在巨大阴影状生物的传闻，不过是传闻而已.

column1: An agricultural world wracked with storms, the capital city of Taygeta city still maintains some of the most nitrogen rich soils land in the entire Inner Sphere.
column2: 一个饱受风暴摧残的农业世界，其首府城市Taygeta City仍保有整个内天体中一些氮含量最丰富的土壤.

column1: Tazaraki is a planet or system within the Federated Suns territory. Located in the Edgeward Combat Theatre of the Capellan March, Tazaraki is near Beenleigh and Jenet and was wiped out during the Third Succession War.
column2: Tazaraki是恒星联邦领土内的一个行星或星系. 它位于卡佩拉边疆区的边缘战斗战区，靠近Beenleigh和Jenet，并在第三次继承战争期间被彻底摧毁.

column1: A major refiner and manufactury for nigonium, Tchamba secures its place at the heart of the Free Worlds League.
column2: 作为尼戈尼姆的主要精炼与制造中心，Tchamba稳居自由世界联盟的核心.

column1: Techne's Revenge was a member of the Magistracy of Canopus when a Star League Defense Force task force under the command of Captain-General Marion Marik was assigned to conquer the Magistracy of Canopus in 2577.
column2: 技术之复仇在2577年时是卡诺帕治安官辖区的一员，当时一支由马里昂·马里克总监将军指挥的星盟防卫部队特遣部队被派去征服卡诺帕治安官辖区。ZH

column1: Founded in the Star League era, this colony was a hive of artistry and poetry until the Succession Wars, where upon its pristine forests were harvested for lumber and ironwood, and strip mining began.
column2: 建立于星际联盟时代，这个殖民地曾是艺术与诗歌的繁荣之地，直到继承战争爆发，其原始森林被砍伐以获取木材和铁木，露天采矿也随之开始.

column1: Tedibyhr was a Star League-era inhabited system in the Kathil Operational Area of the Capellan March within the Federated Suns, which was utterly destroyed by nuclear and fission weaponry during the First Succession War.
column2: Tedibyhr是星际联盟时代恒星联邦卡佩拉边区卡希尔作战区内的一个有人居住星系，在第一次继承战争期间被核武器和裂变武器彻底摧毁.

column1: A dry desert world orbit a K class star, Telgaldanas has two continents, separated by an ocean sized canyon.
column2: Telgaldanas是一个围绕K型恒星运行的干燥沙漠世界，拥有两块大陆，被一条海洋般大小的峡谷分隔.

column1: Tellman IV is an icy mining world within the Outworlds Alliance
column2: Tellman IV是外域联盟境内的一个冰封采矿世界.
