column1: The colonists were overwhelmed by a small bat-like predator which led Dr. Tellman to forsooth that they were all doomed, but the bite turned out to be rarely fatal with the survivors boasting of better immune and digestion systems.
column2: 殖民者被一种小型蝙蝠状掠食者弄得不堪其扰，这让Tellman博士言之凿凿地断言他们都注定要完蛋，但这种咬伤后来被证明极少致命，幸存者还吹嘘自己拥有更强的免疫和消化系统.

column1: Telos IV has four continents: Dulles, Rustov, Fellin, and Haranshire. The capital city, Triumph, is located on Dulles. It has a large population that works in financial services as well as a satellite branch of Luthien Armour Works.
column2: Telos IV拥有四块大陆: Dulles、Rustov、Fellin和Haranshire. 首府城市Triumph位于Dulles. 它拥有大量从事金融服务业的人口，同时还有Luthien Armour Works的一个卫星分支机构.

column1: A small industrial outpost surrounds the main colony on this barren world. Many recreational facilities exist and nearby pirates are known to use it as a rest stop.
column2: 在这个贫瘠的世界，一座小型工业前哨站环绕着主殖民地. 这里有许多娱乐设施，已知附近的海盗会将其用作休息站.

column1: A small dry Earth-like planet with approximately half the gravity of Earth. The planet is covered by one enormous ocean. There are only two small continents, each no larger than the island of Borneo.
column2: 一颗干燥的小型类地行星，重力约为地球的一半. 这颗行星被一片巨大的海洋覆盖. 只有两块小大陆，每块都不大于婆罗洲岛.

column1: A small colony located on a hot ball of rock near to the B class star throughout most of the Succession Wars, it was destroyed by a solar flare.
column2: 一个位于靠近B型恒星的炽热岩石星球上的小型殖民地，在继承战争的大部分时间里都存在，最终被一次恒星耀斑摧毁.

column1: Deep boreholes pockmark the surface of Teniente, drawing rich mineral wealth out of the deepest depths of the planet. Some miners say they can see creatures down there...
column2: 深钻孔洞遍布Teniente的表面，从这颗行星的最深处开采出丰富的矿产资源. 一些矿工说，他们能在下面看到生物……

column1: Named as such for the first tentative steps of the colonists during the Star League era making their way onto a barren world, they nevertheless have managed to prosper and turn this world into a livable home.
column2: 之所以如此命名，是因为星际联盟时代殖民者初次试探性地踏上这个荒芜世界，尽管如此，他们还是成功繁荣发展，并将这个世界变成了宜居的家园.

column1: Terra is the home planet of humanity. Terra has been the capital of several interstellar nations and is the most industrialized planet in the Inner Sphere.
column2: 泰拉是人类母星. 泰拉曾是数个星际国家的首都，也是内天体中工业化程度最高的行星.

column1: Covered in huge forests and possessing abundant mineral resources, Terra Firma formed several trade agreements with its neighboring worlds. Bander BattleMechs have a facility here.
column2: 泰拉 Firma覆盖着广袤的森林，并拥有丰富的矿产资源，因而与周边世界缔结了多项贸易协定. Bander BattleMechs在此设有一处设施.

column1: Tetersen is a small atmospheric-less planetoid orbiting a large gas giant, which is inhabited by laboratories and hydroponics bays which research the impact of crop growing with a low gravity environment.
column2: Tetersen是一颗无大气的小型类行星体，围绕一颗巨大的气态巨行星运行，其上设有实验室和水培舱，用于研究低重力环境下作物种植的影响.

column1: Tetschner was settled during the Star League era, but was abandoned by the time of the Third Succession War.
column2: Tetschner于星际联盟时代建立定居点，但在第三次继承战争时已被废弃.

column1: Tetski was settled during the Star League era, and was a major industrial world until it was destroyed by chemical and biological agents during the Second Succession War.
column2: Tetski在星盟时代有人定居，并曾是一个主要工业世界，直到它在第二次继承战争期间被化学和生物制剂摧毁.

column1: With the highest population growth rate of the St. Ives worlds, Texlos is a pleasant garden-planet.Texlos serves as the main recruiting pool for the St. Ives Armored Cavalry regiments and also maintains a large and well equipped militia force.
column2: 作为St. Ives世界中人口增长率最高的星球，Texlos是一颗宜人的花园行星. Texlos是St. Ives装甲骑兵团的主要征兵来源地，同时也维持着一支规模庞大且装备精良的民兵部队.

column1: Previously a world containing numerous small automated mining colonies and a token population, it was destroyed during the Third Succession War.
column2: 这里曾是一个拥有众多小型自动化采矿殖民地和象征性人口的世界，但在第三次继承战争中遭到毁灭.

column1: A hot inhospitable world, it is nevertheless a bountiful source of rare materials not found on other worlds.
column2: 一个炎热而不宜居住的世界，但它却是其他世界上找不到的稀有材料的丰富来源.

column1: Recently colonised by the Circinus Federation, this icy cold mining colony is a source of precious Germanium for the Federation.
column2: 最近被圆规座联邦殖民，这个极寒的采矿殖民地是该联邦珍贵锗的来源.

column1: Thala is the capital world of the Axumite Providence. It was first settled in 2239 by colonists fleeing the Terran Alliance. Thala is a lush world with multiple smaller continents and ancient mountain ranges.
column2: Thala是阿克苏姆天命国的首都世界. 它于2239年由逃离泰拉联盟的殖民者首次定居. Thala是一颗郁郁葱葱的星球，拥有多个较小的洲和古老的山脉.

column1: An agricultural world wracked with storms, the capital city of Thannhausen Gate still maintains some of the most fertile land in the entire Inner Sphere.
column2: 一个饱受风暴侵袭的农业世界，Thannhausen Gate的首府仍保有整个内天体中一些最肥沃的土地.

column1: Tharkad is a icy and rugged planet, similar to the arctic wilderness of Terra. The planet consists of five major continents and three major island chains. The largest continent is Bremen and is home to Tharkad City, capital of the Lyran Commonwealth.
column2: Tharkad是一颗冰冷而崎岖的行星，类似泰拉的极地荒野. 该行星由五大洲和三条主要岛链组成. 最大的大陆是不来梅，Tharkad城就坐落于此，它是天琴共同体的首都.

column1: Most of the population of Thasos live an agricultural lifestyle maintained by technology of an equivalent to that found on Terra in the late eighteenth or early nineteenth century, a consequence of the heavy influence of the Omniss philosophy.
column2: Thasos的大部分人口过着农业生活方式，其维持技术相当于泰拉在十八世纪末或十九世纪初的技术水平，这是Omniss哲学巨大影响的结果.

column1: Thazi was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, and was part of the Outworlds Alliance until it was abandoned entirely during the First Succession War.
column2: Thazi在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，并一直是外域联盟的一部分，直到第一次继承战争期间被完全废弃.

column1: The Edge was one of the worlds invaded by the Lyran Commonwealth during Operation GÖTTERDÄMMERUNG, the major Commonwealth offensive of the Fourth Succession War. The Edge is a significant target due to its economic and political importance.
column2: 在第四次继承战争期间，天琴共同体发动了其大规模攻势“诸神黄昏行动”，The Edge是该攻势中遭入侵的星球之一. 由于其经济和政治重要性，The Edge是一个重要目标.

column1: Named by Explorer Corps, The Eyes in the Dark is a binary star system where both stars are red giants, massive ancient stars, one of which is believed to be within five to ten million years time of core collapse, which would lead to a supernova.
column2: 由探索者军团命名，The Eyes in the Dark是一个双星系统，其中两颗恒星都是红巨星，即巨大的古老恒星；据信其中一颗将在五百万到一千万年内发生核心坍缩，进而引发超新星爆发.

column1: Despite regular attack in the Succession Wars the Star League era Kallon Industries facilities still maintain the levels required for production of BattleMechs, such as the Wolverine.
column2: 尽管在继承战争中经常遭受攻击，星际联盟时代的卡隆工业设施仍保持着生产诸如“狼獾”等战斗机甲所需的水准.

column1: The Rock consists largely of asteroids and other small bodies orbiting the system primary; a number of these asteroids and bodies are inhabited, although some lack the atmosphere required to be habitable.
column2: The Rock主要由环绕星系主星运行的小行星及其他小天体组成；其中若干小行星和天体有人居住，尽管有些缺乏宜居所需的大气.

column1: Thessalonika is a relatively poor world in terms of natural resources. Limited to a few petroleum deposits and gemstone veins, the first settlers landed here for a different feature: broad grasslands.
column2: Thessalonika在自然资源方面是一个相对贫瘠的世界. 这里的资源仅有少量石油矿藏和宝石矿脉，而首批定居者却是为了另一种特征在此登陆: 广阔的草原.

column1: Originally a frozen ball known only for precious metal deposits, a massive meteor strike pushed the planetoid into a closer orbit, rendering the planet habitable.
column2: 最初只是一颗仅以贵金属矿藏闻名的冰冻球体，一次巨大的陨石撞击将这颗小行星推入更近的轨道，使其变得宜居.

column1: Named by Explorer Corps, The Swans Eye is a trinary star system where massive planetoids are forming to create an eye like feature on the star.
column2: 由探索者军团命名，The Swans Eye是一个三合星系统，巨大的行星体正在其中形成，在恒星上构成一处类似眼睛的特征.

column1: A cluster of worlds located far from the Inner Sphere.
column2: 一群位于远离内天体的星球.

column1: A heavily irrigated desert world, most of the agricultural work is automated. It produces many exports, considering its small size.
column2: 一个灌溉程度很高的沙漠世界，大部分农业工作都已自动化. 考虑到其规模很小，它的出口商品却很多.

column1: Thimphu is a simple agricultural world that was devastated in the Fourth Succession War when a JumpShip crashed into the main colony.
column2: Thimphu是一个质朴的农业世界，在第四次继承战争中，一艘跃迁舰撞上了主要殖民地，使其遭到毁灭性破坏.

column1: Thirty Weight was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, and was part of the Marik Commonwealth until it was abandoned entirely during the Second Succession War.
column2: Thirty Weight在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某时被建立定居点，并一直是马里克共同体的一部分，直到第二次继承战争期间被完全废弃.

column1: Thorin is a Terra-like world, which has one moon (Thorin's Twin). It is considered a jewel of a world and is home to much metal and mineral wealth utilised by manufacturers such as Newhart Industries and Johnson-Aldis Weaponries.
column2: 索林是一颗类地行星，拥有一颗卫星（索林之双）。它被视为一颗宝石般的世界，蕴藏着大量金属与矿产财富，被纽哈特工业与约翰逊-阿尔迪斯兵工等制造商所利用。ZH

column1: Thorn is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League.
column2: Thorn是组成被称为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家的星球之一.

column1: Thraxa is a semi-arctic world on the border between the Magistracy of Canopus and the Marian Hegemony. The northern landmass is tundra, a result of a deliberate conservation policy that keeps the tundra intact between cities and settlements.
column2: Thraxa是一颗半北极星球，位于船底自治区与马里安霸权之间的边境上. 北部大陆是苔原，这是刻意实施保护政策的结果，该政策使城市与定居点之间的苔原保持原貌.

column1: Thuban is a vast open-environment world with a breathable atmosphere and wide, lava-encrusted plains around Scorpius Mons, the planet's largest highest volcano
column2: 图班是一颗广阔的开阔环境行星，拥有可呼吸的大气，其最大最高的火山蝎子山周围环绕着大片覆满熔岩的平原

column1: Thule is divided into three large continents. Vik with the capital 'Thule City', Akranes as the agricultural center, whilst Husavik is frozen wasteland with several research posts. Bergan Industries, a major Locust manufacturer, has facilities here.
column2: 图勒分为三块大陆。维克拥有首都"图勒城"，阿克拉内斯是农业中心，而胡萨维克则是冰封荒原，设有若干研究站。主要蝗虫制造商贝根工业在这里有设施。ZH

column1: Thun is known for its deep, dry canyons which are often subject to landslips and falls under the high gravity of the world.
column2: Thun以其深邃、干燥的峡谷而闻名，这些峡谷在该世界的高重力下常常发生滑坡和崩塌.

column1: The site of a decisive battle between the SLDF and the Magistracy almost 500 years ago, Thurrock has long since recovered from that war and now thrives as a regional industrial and tourism center.
column2: 瑟罗克在500年前是星际联盟防卫军与船底自治区一场决定性战斗的战场，但它早已从战争中恢复过来，现在是地区性的工业中心与旅游中心.

column1: Tianamon was part of the Sarna Commonality of the Cappelan Confederation, but was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War due to famine.
column2: Tianamon曾是卡佩拉邦联Sarna共同体的一部分，但在第三次继承战争期间因饥荒被彻底废弃.

column1: A large manufacturing center situated on a rich mineral world, Clan Hell Horse and Wolf both have large facilities here.
column2: 一个位于矿产资源丰富世界的大型制造中心，地狱马氏族和狼氏族都在此拥有大型设施.

column1: Tiber is probably best known as the home of Earthwerks Incorporated. Recently the world has been rocked by violence as the labor unions on the world incited their members to riot
column2: Tiber最出名的可能便是它是地球工厂股份有限公司的所在地. 最近，该星球上的工会煽动其成员暴动，使这颗星球陷入了暴力动荡.

column1: An average agricultural world that produces large amounts of Terran timber. This timber is exported, but before it leaves the world it serves as an obstacle to the severe wind storms. The world is notable only for the Surb Gevorg Manufacturing plant.
column2: 一个普通的农业星球，出产大量地球木材. 这些木材会被出口，但在离开这个星球之前，它们被用来阻挡猛烈的风暴. 这个星球唯一值得注意的是Surb Gevorg制造厂.

column1: A well-educated population and the highly industrialized economy make Tigress a significant asset for the controlling house. Large Star League era fusion generators power the cities and provide free power to industry across the world.
column2: 受过良好教育的人口和高度工业化的经济，使Tigress成为掌控家族的一项重要资产. 星际联盟时代的大型聚变发电机为城市供电，并为全球工业提供免费电力.

column1: One of the earliest systems colonised, Tikonov has seen more than its share of conflict.  The numerous Earthwerks (and other) factories has seen it become a battlefield several times, and was most recently taken over by the Feds some 10 years ago.
column2: 作为最早被殖民的星系之一，Tikonov经历的冲突远超其应承受的程度. 众多的Earthwerks（以及其他）工厂使其数次沦为战场，而最近一次是在大约10年前被联邦接管.

column1: Timbiqui is home to a major manufacturer, Timbiqui Spirits, which is known throughout the Inner Sphere primarily for its best-known brand of beer, Timbiqui Dark. A favored choice among mercenaries, Timbiqui Dark is even sold in the Deep Periphery.
column2: Timbiqui是大型制造商Timbiqui Spirits的所在地，该公司在整个内天体声名远扬，主要是因为其最著名的啤酒品牌Timbiqui Dark. Timbiqui Dark深受雇佣兵青睐，甚至在深空外围也有销售.

column1: A dry desert world orbit a K class star, Timbuktu has two continents, Hades and Saharius where the capital city Greene is located. The Timbuktu-based corporation Diplass BattleMechs was destroyed entirely during the Amaris Civil War.
column2: Timbuktu是一颗环绕K型恒星运行的干燥沙漠世界，拥有两块大陆——哈迪斯和萨哈里乌斯，首都格林位于萨哈里乌斯. 总部位于Timbuktu的迪普拉斯战斗机甲公司已在阿马里斯内战期间被彻底摧毁.

column1: An Earth-like planet with an unusually large axial tilt causing extreme seasonal changes. Both the northern and southern hemispheres experience complete darkness for several months at a time.
column2: 一颗类地行星，其自转轴倾角异常巨大，导致极端的季节变化. 南北半球每次都会经历长达数月的完全黑暗.

column1: A cold, tundral world at the outer edge of its star's habitable zone. There are no oceans or continents, but the surface is littered with lakes and small seas. Coniferous forests cover much of the surface.
column2: 一颗寒冷、冻原化的世界，位于其恒星宜居带外缘。那里没有海洋或大陆，但地表散布着湖泊与小海。针叶林覆盖了大部分地表。ZH

column1: Tinaca has one major continent, 'The Island' where the capital city Tandalola is located. It is home to a live fire training ground often utilised by the Sun Zhang MechWarrior Academy.
column2: 蒂纳卡有一个主要大陆——"岛屿"，首府坦达洛拉坐落于此。这里是孙章机师学院经常使用的实弹训练场的所在地。ZH

column1: Tincalunas was abandoned due to natural disasters that make it a marginal colony despite its Terran climate. Intense tidal forces from a nearby gas giant shattered the planet's moon and cause constant volcanism on the surface.
column2: 廷卡卢纳斯因自然灾害而被废弃，那些灾害使它尽管拥有类地气候却仍是边缘殖民地。附近一颗气态巨行星强烈的潮汐力撕碎了该行星的卫星，并在地表造成持续不断的火山活动。ZH

column1: In 2412, FWLM force invaded Tintavel. The battle escalated until both sides employed weapons of mass destruction, leading to over 300,000 casualties and abandonment of the planet. The tragedy caused all sides to meet and form the Ares convention.
column2: 2412年，FWLM部队入侵了Tintavel. 战斗不断升级，直到双方都动用了大规模杀伤性武器，导致超过30万人伤亡，该星球也因此被废弃. 这场悲剧促使各方会面并缔结了《阿瑞斯公约》.

column1: Tirabad was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but was abandoned entirely during the Second Succession War.
column2: Tirabad是在统一战争结束后的某个时候、星际联盟时代被殖民的，但在第二次继承战争期间被完全废弃.

column1: Tiruchchirappalli was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but was abandoned entirely during the Second Succession War.
column2: Tiruchchirappalli是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在第二次继承战争期间被完全废弃了.

column1: An extremely hot planet. Mostly desert but with some small seas in the northern and southern hemispheres. The equatorial regions are too hot for most species, and so the only settlements are situated in the extreme polar regions.
column2: 一颗极其炎热的行星. 大部分地区是沙漠，但在北半球和南半球有一些小片海洋. 赤道地区对大多数物种来说过于炎热，因此唯一的定居点都位于极地地区.

column1: A hot prison world with a nitrogen/oxygen atmosphere. This planet was once covered with lush rainforest, but was burnt away during the First Succession War.
column2: 一颗拥有氮氧大气的酷热监狱世界。这颗行星曾覆盖着葱郁雨林，但在第一次继承战争期间被烧毁。ZH

column1: A large rocky planet with high gravity and a thin atmosphere. The atmosphere only extends about 1 mile above sea level, and many mountain tops are exposed to the vacuum of space. Habitable areas are in the deep valleys between mountain ranges.
column2: 一颗大型岩石行星，重力高，大气稀薄. 大气仅延伸至海平面以上约1英里，许多山峰暴露在太空真空中. 宜居区域位于山脉之间的深谷中.

column1: Tiverton is a lush water world, with archipelagos of volcanic islands strewn all around the surface. Fishing and algae farming are the backbone industries, but its also known for being a haven for organized crime and piracy.
column2: 郁郁葱葱的水系星球蒂弗顿遍布着由火山岛组成的群岛. 渔业和藻类养殖是星球上的支柱产业，但这里同时也是著名的有组织罪犯与海盗的避风港.

column1: An enormous gas giant at the outer edge of its star's habitable zone. It supports a system of small to medium-sized moons. One of the moons has a breathable nitrogen/oxygen atmosphere but is not considered habitable due to extremes of temperature.
column2: 一颗位于其恒星宜居带外缘的巨型气态行星。它拥有由中小型卫星组成的卫星系。其中一颗卫星有可呼吸的氮氧大气，但因温度极端而不被认为适宜居住。ZH

column1: Toffen is an arid world with a meagre population largely made up of isolationist loners living on scattered farms.
column2: Toffen是一个干旱的世界，人口稀少，主要由生活在分散农场中的孤立主义独居者组成.

column1: During the Star League era, Togura was rich in much-needed industrial metals and rare earths which turned it into a heavily industrialised world. Even now, numerous companies such as Stellar Trek and Osaka Heavy Metrics maintain shipyards in orbit.
column2: 在星际联盟时代，Togura富含急需的工业金属和稀土，这使其成为一个高度工业化的世界. 即便现在，Stellar Trek和Osaka Heavy Metrics等众多公司仍在轨道上维护着船坞.

column1: A small world with extremely low gravity, about the size of Earth's moon. The planet is home to the 'Jump-World Low Gravity Theme Park', which is situated inside a giant glass dome for the safety and breathing-comfort of its visitors.
column2: 一颗引力极低的小型世界，大小约相当于地球的月亮。该星球上有“跳跃世界低重力主题公园”，坐落在一座巨大玻璃穹顶之内，以保证游客的安全与呼吸舒适。ZH

column1: A small Earth-like planet with oceans and several large continents typified by open grassland regions. The planet serves as an agricultural colony, with large farms covering much of its surface.
column2: 一颗小型类地行星，拥有海洋和若干大片以开阔草原地带为特征的大陆. 该行星作为农业殖民地，其表面大部分被大型农场覆盖.

column1: Tokasha's most notable feature is the high levels of oxygen in its atmosphere. The planet has wide ranges of oceans and lush wilderness of forests and jungles. The native animal life is highly hostile to terrestrial based life.
column2: 托卡沙最显著的特征是其大气中的高氧含量。该星球拥有广阔海洋以及茂密森林与丛林的荒野。本土动物对陆地生命极具敌意。ZH

column1: A vastly populated jungle world with many untapped resources. Alshain Weapons is headquartered on Tok Do and produces light BattleMechs for the Draconis Combine.
column2: 一个人口稠密的丛林星球，拥有许多未开采的资源. Alshain Weapons总部位于Tok Do，为天龙座联合体生产轻型战斗机甲.

column1: Toland was settled by a mixture of artists and craftsmen fleeing from the First Succession War. Toland has three moons, expanses of jungle and natural resources that include rare minerals.
column2: Toland最初由一群逃离第一次继承战争的艺术家和工匠混合定居. Toland拥有三颗卫星、大片丛林，以及包括稀有矿物在内的自然资源.

column1: Deep within the Hanseatic League, Tomalov exports many foodstuffs to other Hanseatic Worlds.
column2: 在汉萨同盟腹地，Tomalov向其他汉萨世界出口大量食品.

column1: Tomans is home to the Lyran Biomaterials Complex, a vast research complex that researches and manufactures new materials.
column2: Tomans是天琴生物材料综合体的所在地，这是一座庞大的研究综合体，负责研究和制造新材料.

column1: Tongatapu is an arid world that is rich in high grade ores and material. It's surface is dotted with mines owned by Technicron Manufacturing which produce raw material which is then shipped to Tamarind, their JumpShip shipyard.
column2: 汤加塔布是一颗干旱世界，富含高品位矿石与材料。它地表遍布技术电子制造公司的矿场，产出的原材料随后被运往塔马林德，即他们的跃迁舰船坞所在地。ZH

column1: Tordenskjold was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but was abandoned entirely during the Second Succession War.
column2: Tordenskjold在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某时被殖民，但在第二次继承战争期间被完全废弃.

column1: Torgvei was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was wiped out during the First Succession War.
column2: Torgvei在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在第一次继承战争期间被彻底毁灭.

column1: An Earth-like planet with an unusually large axial tilt causing extreme seasonal changes. Both the northern and southern hemispheres experience harsh winters, with cold nights that can last for weeks or months at a time depending on latitude.
column2: 一颗类地行星，其转轴倾角异常巨大，导致极端的季节变化. 北半球和南半球都会经历严酷的冬季，寒冷的夜晚视纬度而定，一次可持续数周甚至数月.

column1: An icy world with vast underground caverns and unique fauna, Torrence is home to military manufacturer Veridian Dynamics and one of the largest pharmaceutical companies in the Suns, Vinson Pharmaceuticals.
column2: Torrence是一个拥有广阔地下洞穴和独特动物群的冰封世界，是军事制造商Veridian Dynamics以及恒星联邦最大的制药公司之一Vinson Pharmaceuticals的所在地.

column1: The Tortuga Prime system was settled by the remains of the 237th Light Cavalry Regiment in the closing stages of the Reunification War. It is the Capital of the bandit kingdom known as the Tortuga Dominions.
column2: Tortuga Prime星系由第237轻骑兵团的残部在统一战争末期建立定居点. 它是被称为Tortuga Dominions的强盗王国的首都.

column1: Toten was settled during the Star League era due to its asteroid field rich in germanium, a vital material for JumpShip construction. As such a vital target, it was destroyed utterly during the violence of the First Succession War.
column2: Toten在星际联盟时代因小行星带富含锗而得到殖民，锗是建造跃迁舰的重要材料. 作为如此重要的目标，它在第一次继承战争的战火中被彻底摧毁.

column1: Totness was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Totness在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某一时间被殖民，但在第三次继承战争期间被完全废弃.

column1: Tottori was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was devastated and abandoned during the Second Succession War.
column2: Tottori在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时间点被殖民，但在第二次继承战争期间遭到毁灭并被废弃.

column1: Tovetin (Tovetine) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was destroyed entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Tovetin（Tovetine）在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但它在第三次继承战争期间被彻底摧毁了.

column1: Towne is a slightly cooler Terran world which boasts good mineral and lumber wealth. The many active volcanoes and other geological activities continue to give the impression that the world is bigger than it actually is.
column2: Towne是一颗略偏寒冷的类地行星，拥有丰富的矿产和木材资源. 众多活火山及其他地质活动不断使其显得比实际更为庞大.

column1: A small Earth-like planet with approximately half the gravity of Earth. The planet is dotted with many small islands and a large continent covers the northern polar region. Much of the exports from Trasjkis are in the form of aquatic food.
column2: 一颗类似地球的小型行星，重力约为地球的一半. 行星上散布着许多小岛，北部极区被一块大陆覆盖. Trasjkis的出口商品大部分是水产品.

column1: Traussin was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Traussin是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居的，但在第三次继承战争期间被彻底废弃了.

column1: Winfield was originally named Treeline, but was gifted to the commander of the Stealths, Colonel Raymond Winfield, by Archon Elizabeth Steiner after their destruction in the conquest of Sakhalin in 2863 and renamed \"Winfield\" in his honour.
column2: 温菲尔德原名“树线”，2863 年隐形部队在征服萨哈林一役中全军覆没后，大公伊丽莎白·施泰纳将其赠予这支部队的指挥官雷蒙德·温菲尔德上校，并以其姓氏重新命名为“温菲尔德”。ZH

column1: A planetary year on Trellwan is only 45 standard days, while a planetary day is 30.5 standard days due to the planet's slow rotation. As a result, vulcanism and earthquakes are common and the climatic changes are quite abrupt and severe.
column2: 特雷尔万的恒星年只有45个标准日，而行星日因该行星自转缓慢长达30.5个标准日。因此火山活动与地震频发，气候变化也相当突兀剧烈。ZH

column1: Trellisane was settled by rabid democrats with the excitement to enact a direct democracy. It did not last until a novel solution was found only allowing a third of the population to vote on a rotating basis.
column2: Trellisane由狂热的民主主义者定居，他们满怀热情地想要推行直接民主. 但这种制度没能维持多久，直到有人想出一种新奇的解决方案: 只允许三分之一的人口轮流投票.

column1: An enormous super-earth planet with a breathable nitrogen/oxygen atmosphere but extremely high gravity. One large continent stretches from the north pole to the south pole. Forests of carnivorous plants cover much of the landmass.
column2: 一颗巨大的超级地球行星，拥有可呼吸的氮氧大气，但重力极高。一整块大陆从北极延伸到南极。食肉植物森林覆盖了大部分陆地。ZH

column1: An ocean world with few large landmasses but thousands of tiny islands. The islands of Northern Trentham are famous for their petrified forests. Nearby islands are used for training, weapons testing, and secretive research facilities.
column2: 一个海洋世界，大型陆地稀少，但拥有成千上万个小岛. Northern Trentham的岛屿以石化森林闻名. 附近的岛屿被用于训练、武器测试和秘密研究设施.

column1: Tresspass was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was abandoned entirely during the Second Succession War after substantial bombardment.
column2: Tresspass在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在第二次继承战争期间遭受大规模轰炸后被完全废弃.

column1: An industrialised world during the Star League, Triesting was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison. In the First Succession War the factories were erased from existence, leaving only scant remains which still exist today.
column2: 在星际联盟时期，Triesting是一个工业化世界，并曾是星际联盟防卫军一支驻军的驻地. 第一次继承战争期间，工厂被彻底抹去，只留下少量至今仍存的残迹.

column1: A lifeless planet with an economy centered around gambling. Aside from a few uranium mines, gambling is the only industry on the planet. Loose gaming laws are the only reason this backwater colony exists.
column2: 一颗没有生命的行星，其经济以赌博为中心. 除了几座铀矿外，赌博是这颗行星上唯一的产业. 宽松的博彩法律是这个偏远落后殖民地得以存在的唯一原因.

column1: Trinidad has three heavily populated continents: Arawak, Galibi, and Raleigh. The capital city, Warao, is located on Raleigh.
column2: Trinidad拥有三块人口稠密的大陆: Arawak、Galibi和Raleigh. 首府Warao位于Raleigh.

column1: A terrestrial planet with an extremely slow axial rotation. Forests of giant fungal organisms dominate much of the surface. In orbit are three heavily fortified moons.
column2: 一颗自转极其缓慢的类地行星. 巨型真菌生物构成的森林覆盖了大部分地表. 轨道上运行着三颗防御严密的卫星.

column1: An almost lifeless rock with no atmosphere, about the size of Earth's moon. A few uranium mines are the only signs of life here, and they're mostly automated. Rumours of Star League caches hidden under the surface keep the population busy though.
column2: 这是一块几乎无生命、没有大气的岩石，大小约相当于地球的月亮。几座铀矿是这里唯一的生命迹象，而且大多是自动化的。关于地表下藏有星际联盟储藏点的传言让当地人忙个不停。ZH

column1: A former Combine world that is now a key planet in the Free Rasalhague Republic.  Recent vulcanic activity has brought a plethora of mineral deposits to the surface, making this an important mining planet for the FRR.
column2: 一个曾是联合体世界、如今是自由拉萨尔哈格共和国的关键行星. 近期的火山活动将大量矿床带到了地表，使其成为FRR的重要采矿行星.

column1: Trondheim is home to some of the JàrnFòlk's few heavy industries, concentrated around the capital city of Narvik, and is where all of the parts for their various starships are manufactured and shuttled to orbiting dry docks.
column2: 特隆赫姆是雅恩福克人少数重工业的所在地，集中在首都纳尔维克周围，他们各类星舰的所有部件都在这里制造，然后被运往轨道干船坞。ZH

column1: Primarily an iron and processed steel heavy goods manufacturing world, Trondheimal is a vital part of the growing Illyrian Palatinate economy. Habitable areas are restricted to the mountain sides.
column2: Trondheimal主要是一个以铁和加工钢材为主的重型货物制造世界，是不断发展的伊利里亚帕拉蒂纳特经济中至关重要的一部分. 宜居区域仅限于山坡地带.

column1: Once a desert planet with vast irrigated flood plains, Truth was devastated in the Third Succession War. Most of the populated die of famine, leaving only a few token hardy survivors on the surface.
column2: Truth曾是一颗沙漠星球，拥有辽阔的灌溉洪泛平原，但在第三次继承战争中遭到毁灭性打击. 大部分人口死于饥荒，地表上只剩下少数顽强求生的幸存者.

column1: The Trznadel Cluster is a quaternion system, containing numerous mineral rich planets, which are mined to power the Magistracy of Canopus's industrial base.
column2: 特尔兹纳德星团是一个四星系系统，包含众多富含矿物的星球，其矿产被开采来驱动卡诺帕斯行政区的工业基础。ZH

column1: Originally named Tsunami, Tsamma was settled as an agricultural world. The many turbulent oceans have a low salt content which make it easy to create potable water. This has made Tsamma the largest exporter of drinking water in fifty light years.
column2: Tsamma最初名为Tsunami，是作为农业世界建立殖民地的. 众多汹涌的海洋盐度很低，因此很容易制取饮用水. 这使Tsamma成为五十光年范围内最大的饮用水出口地.

column1: An ocean world with a breathable nitrogen/oxygen atmosphere. Only a single island-continent rises above sea-level. While the ocean is teeming with complex life, only single-celled organisms have ventured onto the land.
column2: 一颗拥有可呼吸氮氧大气层的海洋世界。只有一块岛状大陆高出海平面。海洋中充满复杂生命，但只有单细胞生物登上了陆地。ZH

column1: A small rocky planet in the Lagrange point of a gas giant. The planet has no atmosphere, but incredibly there is life here, living in large underground reservoirs of water.
column2: 一颗位于气态巨行星拉格朗日点上的小型岩石行星. 这颗行星没有大气层，但不可思议的是，这里有生命存在，它们生活在巨大的地下储水层中.

column1: A small, flat, muddy planet. There are no oceans, instead the surface is covered with a shallow layer of water. A single moon creates a strong tidal effect, making the entire planet a tidal mudflat - perfect for certain crops and brewing of beer.
column2: 一颗小巧、平坦、泥泞的行星. 没有海洋，取而代之的是表面覆盖着一层浅水. 一颗卫星产生强烈的潮汐效应，使整个行星成为潮汐泥滩——非常适合某些作物和酿造啤酒.

column1: Tsitsang's warm and temperate climate allows the colonists are able to enjoy three full growing seasons on each of the three continents on the planet, all of which were located on the equator.
column2: 齐齐桑温暖温和的气候让殖民者得以在该行星三块大陆上各享受三个完整的生长季，而这些大陆全都位于赤道上。ZH

column1: From orbit this tropical paradise looks idyllic, however the wildlife draws energy from nitrogen rather than oxygen, and are completely inedible. All food must be imported to Tsukude but the vast amounts of rare gases are a major export.
column2: 从轨道上看，这个热带天堂宛如田园诗般宁静，然而这里的野生动物从氮而非氧中获取能量，并且完全无法食用. 所有食物都必须进口到Tsukude，但大量的稀有气体是主要出口产品.

column1: A small Earth-like planet with a thin nitrogen/oxygen atmosphere. A long, narrow continent follows the line of the equator, stretching half way around the planet. The most successful creatures on the planet are large protomammals.
column2: 一颗小型类地行星，拥有稀薄的氮氧大气。一条狭长的大陆沿赤道线延伸，环绕该行星半圈。该行星上最成功的生物是大型原哺乳动物。ZH

column1: Tuat was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was abandoned before the Third Succession War. It was once host to a large SLDF garrison, which means rumours of LosTech caches are rampant.
column2: Tuat在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在第三次继承战争之前被废弃了. 它曾拥有一支庞大的SLDF驻军，这意味着关于失落科技储藏点的谣言甚嚣尘上.

column1: This picturesque world offers a multitude of different terrain, with many religious monasteries dotting its surface. Pretty unremarkable and will be resigned to be forgotten in the history books...
column2: 这个风景如画的世界拥有多种不同的地形，其表面点缀着许多宗教修道院. 相当平平无奇，注定会被历史书遗忘……

column1: The valuable Turin beef is grown on the vast grasslands of the planet's single continent, although maintaining the alien-Terran hybrid is expensive. In recent years, the ranchers have begun branching out into horse breeding.
column2: 珍贵的都灵牛肉生长在该行星唯一大陆的广袤草原上，尽管维持这种外星-类地杂交品种成本高昂。近年来，牧场主们开始向马匹繁育拓展。ZH

column1: A terrestrial planet with an unusually large axial tilt causing extreme seasonal changes. The most advanced forms of life on the planet are marsupials.
column2: 一颗类地行星，其轴倾角异常巨大，导致极端的季节变化. 该行星上最高级的生命形式是有袋类动物.

column1: Turkalia was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, and was a major battleground in the First Succession War until it was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Turkalia是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民定居的，并在第一次继承战争中成为主要战场，直到在第三次继承战争期间被彻底废弃.

column1: Turko was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was abandoned entirely during the Second Succession War.
column2: Turko在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在第二次继承战争期间被完全废弃.

column1: Turov was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Turov是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在第三次继承战争期间被彻底废弃了.

column1: Turtle Bay is a world located near the Periphery border with the Draconis Combine.
column2: Turtle Bay是一颗位于与天龙联合体接壤的边地边境附近的行星.

column1: The fertile soils of Tuscarawas are home to many farms, as well as Interstellar Harvesters, an agricultural and industrial equipment producer.
column2: Tuscarawas肥沃的土壤是众多农场的家园，也是农业及工业设备生产商Interstellar Harvesters的所在地.

column1: Twycross is a weather-wild desert planet, where cataclysmic events and powerful wind storms are common. Due to these storms the population placed their cities and towns underground or made surface structures squat and flat.
column2: Twycross是一颗气候狂暴的沙漠行星，灾难性事件和强风暴在这里十分常见. 由于这些风暴，居民将城市和城镇建在地下，或将地表建筑建得低矮扁平.

column1: Tybalt is a world that suffers from frequent earthquakes. Eleven continents are on the world, but ten of them are so covered in mountains that large human settlement is impossible.
column2: Tybalt是一个频繁遭受地震的星球. 该星球上有十一个大陆，但其中十个都布满山脉，以至于无法进行大规模人类定居.

column1: Tylarzka was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Tylarzka是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民的，但在第三次继承战争期间被彻底废弃.

column1: Tyrlon's two worlds are both inhabited. Arid Tyrlon 5 is an agricultural world, with farming in the flood-plains of its major river systems. Oceanic Tyrlon 6 has a toxic concentration of oxygen but is habitable on plateaus above the dense cloud layer. It is there that House Parata has its seat of power.
column2: 泰尔隆的两颗星球都有人居住。干旱的泰尔隆 5 是农业星球，人们在其主要河系的泛滥平原上耕作。海洋星球泰尔隆 6 的氧气浓度有毒，但可在浓密云层之上的高原居住。帕拉塔家族（House Parata）的权力中枢就设在那里。ZH

column1: Tyrrhenia is home to numerous mining companies who desire access to the vast riches contained under the surface of this otherwise barren world. The Fourth Succession War has delayed further industrialisation.
column2: Tyrrhenia是众多采矿公司的所在地，它们渴望获取这颗在其他方面贫瘠的星球地表之下蕴藏的巨大财富. 第四次继承战争推迟了进一步的工业化.

column1: Ubangi was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Ubangi在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在第三次继承战争期间被完全废弃.

column1: A small agricultural world with a plethora of native life, Udibi has a growing pharmaceuticals sector. The tasty Gyru lizards also roam the many forests.
column2: Udibi是一个小型农业世界，拥有大量本土生命，其制药业正在不断发展. 美味的Gyru蜥蜴也出没于众多森林中.

column1: Ueda is a cold planet orbiting at the outer edge of its star's habitable zone, but it is kept relatively warm by its atmosphere, which is mostly composed of CO2. This is a damp, boggy world, prone to excessive rain and seasonal flooding.
column2: 上田是一颗寒冷行星，运行在其恒星宜居带的外缘，但它的大气（主要由二氧化碳构成）让它相对温暖。这是一颗潮湿泥泞的世界，多雨且季节性洪水频发。ZH

column1: Ugland was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Ugland是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在第三次继承战争期间被完全废弃.

column1: By the end of the Star League era Uhuru was a major industrial center, but the First Succession War devastated the planet. By the Second, those living on Uhuru were reduced to a bare subsistence level of existence from which they have not recovered.
column2: 到星际联盟时代末期，Uhuru已是一个主要工业中心，但第一次继承战争使这颗行星遭到毁灭性打击. 到第二次继承战争时，生活在Uhuru上的人们已沦落到仅能勉强维生的生存水平，至今仍未恢复.

column1: Ukunela was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Ukunela在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被建立定居点，但在第三次继承战争期间被彻底废弃.

column1: A habitable dwarf planet famous for its “stone forests”.
column2: 一个适宜居住的矮行星，以其“石林”而闻名.

column1: Settled in 2271 thanks to its steppe landscapes suitable for pastoral farming. In the years prior to the fall of the Star League, the SLDF built numerous small forts and hidden boltholes across the landscape of Ulan Bator.
column2: 2271年，由于拥有适合畜牧业的草原地貌，这里得以建立定居点. 在星际联盟覆灭前的那些年里，SLDF在Ulan Bator的地貌上建造了许多小型堡垒和隐蔽的藏身处.

column1: Ullieri was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Ullieri是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候有人定居的，但在第三次继承战争期间被完全废弃了.

column1: Ulsan was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Ulsan在统一战争结束后的星联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在第三次继承战争期间被完全废弃.

column1: Ulubis was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was abandoned entirely during the Second Succession War.
column2: Ulubis在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在第二次继承战争期间被完全废弃.

column1: Ulvskollen was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Ulvskollen是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在第三次继承战争期间被彻底废弃.

column1: An agricultural world known for their oversized four leaf clovers and their gigantic alien honey bees. The Tsamma Crucis March Militia often recruited here.
column2: 一个农业世界，以其超大的四叶草和巨大的外星蜜蜂而闻名. Tsamma Crucis March Militia经常在此招募.

column1: Due to the tidal stresses of Umgard's two moons, the planet is torn by volcanoes and earthquakes, and the air is a near-toxic soup of foul-smelling gases. It's a jungle world, with forests teeming with life, but machinery tends to corrode quickly in the murky environment.
column2: 由于 Umgard 两颗卫星引发的潮汐应力，这颗星球被火山与地震撕扯得支离破碎，空气中弥漫着近乎有毒的恶臭气体浓汤。这是一颗丛林星球，森林中生机盎然，但机械在这种阴暗潮湿的环境中往往腐蚀得很快。ZH

column1: A hotspot for Yakuza activity, Umijiri has recently been the key training ground of the Seventh and Eight Ghost regiments. These regiments are made up of former (and current) criminals and prisoners.
column2: 作为极道活动的热点，Umijiri最近一直是第七和第八幽灵团的重要训练场. 这些团由曾经的（以及当前的）罪犯和囚犯组成.

column1: Umka was settled for its extremely rich aquaculture, but it wasn't until later that heavy ores were discovered. Kerr-McGuiness, a manufacturer of BattleMech armour, has a large facility here, producing thousands of tons of Mech armour annually.
column2: 乌姆卡因其极其丰富的水产养殖而被殖民，但直到后来才发现重金属矿。战斗机甲装甲制造商科尔-麦吉尼斯在这里有大型设施，每年生产数千吨机甲装甲。ZH

column1: A small rocky planet in the Lagrange point of a gas giant. The planet has no atmosphere, but incredibly there is life here, living in large underground caverns filled with a mixture of atmospheric gasses.
column2: 一颗位于气态巨行星拉格朗日点的小型岩石行星. 这颗行星没有大气层，但令人难以置信的是，这里有生命存在，它们生活在充满混合大气气体的巨大地下洞穴中.

column1: A star cluster containing numerous small colonies far from the Inner Sphere.
column2: 一个远离内天体、包含众多小型殖民地的星团.

column1: An agricultural world with a substantial trading outpost. One corporation, Pesht Motors, has a small facility on the planet producing many small cars and tractors, but with the option to expand into larger units.
column2: 一个农业世界，设有一座规模可观的贸易前哨站. 一家名为Pesht Motors的企业在该星球上拥有一座小型设施，生产大量小型汽车和拖拉机，但也可选择扩展至更大型的产品.

column1: Unkador was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Unkador是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在第三次继承战争期间被完全废弃了.

column1: The surface of Untran is an endless bleak desert, with scouring winds and sand. It's honeycombed with caves, where the original Capellan colonists harvested precious stones and ores. The planet has no agriculture at all; when it was abandoned, the colonies withered and died.
column2: 安特兰的地表是一片无尽荒凉的沙漠，饱受蚀骨狂风与沙尘。它满是洞穴，最初的卡佩兰殖民者在那里采掘宝石与矿石。该行星完全没有农业；它被废弃时，殖民地便枯萎死亡。ZH

column1: A tropical paradise known for its rainforests, beaches, and colorful wildlife. With little natural resources of its own, it survives as an R&R stop off point for many ships.
column2: 一个热带天堂，以雨林、海滩和色彩斑斓的野生动物而闻名. 自身几乎没有自然资源，依靠作为许多飞船的R&R中途停靠站而存续.

column1: An arctic world with rocky terrain and majestic canyons, such as the Hester-Kester Fjord. Once the site of an ancient Castle Brian, it now houses a rugged but determined group of miners.
column2: 这是一个极寒世界，地形崎岖多岩，拥有壮丽的峡谷，例如Hester-Kester峡湾. 这里曾是古老布莱恩城堡的所在地，如今居住着一群粗犷却意志坚定的矿工.

column1: A tropical paradise known for its rainforests, beaches, and colorful wildlife. A single continent stretches unbroken around the planet's equator, separating the northern and southern oceans. This continent is teeming with life, as are the oceans.
column2: 一处以雨林、海滩和绚丽野生动植物闻名的热带天堂。一整块大陆不间断地沿该行星赤道延伸，分隔北南海域。这块大陆生机勃勃，海洋亦然。ZH

column1: The arctic like planet is one of the training groups for the 2nd Ceti Hussars.
column2: 这颗类似北极的行星是第二鲸鱼座骠骑兵的训练场地之一.

column1: Úr Cruinne is a frozen wasteland, but geothermal vents create temperate zones in which the planet's few inhabitants live and mine the plentiful mineral resources.
column2: 乌尔克林涅是一片冰封荒原，但地热喷口造就了温带区域，星球上为数不多的居民便生活在那里，开采丰富的矿产资源。ZH

column1: Úr Cruinne
column2: 乌尔克鲁纳

column1: The Urich system was colonized either during or shortly before the Age of War. During the final years of the Star League, Urich was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: Urich星系在战争年代期间或之前不久被殖民. 在星际联盟的最后几年，Urich驻扎着星际联盟防卫军的一支驻军.

column1: Settled before the Reunification War, it look substantial damage during that war from Free Worlds forces. The rocky terrain allows for jump jet capable troops to ambush others in large canyons and ridges.
column2: 在统一战争之前已有人定居，在那场战争中它遭到了自由世界联盟部队的严重破坏. 多岩石的地形使具备跳跃喷射能力的部队得以在大型峡谷和山脊中伏击他人.

column1: The capital city of Utrecht is Naragajan, situated high on the Labbie Plateau, one of the flattest regions of this otherwise jagged and rocky planet.
column2: Utrecht的首府是纳拉加詹，坐落在拉比高原高处，这里是这颗在其他方面崎岖多岩的星球上最平坦的区域之一.

column1: Situated close to the sun in this system, the local time on Uzhgorod only has 41 standard minutes per hour, said to be the shortest in the entire Lyran Commonwealth at the time.
column2: 由于位于该星系中靠近恒星的位置，Uzhgorod上的当地时间每小时仅有 41 标准分钟，据说当时是整个天琴共同体中最短的.

column1: Vaajakoski was a system in the Kajikazawa Prefecture of the Benjamin Military District of the Draconis Combine until it was destroyed and abandoned during the Second Succession War.
column2: Vaajakoski曾是天龙联合体本杰明军区梶川辖区内的一个星系，直到第二次继承战争期间被摧毁并废弃.

column1: An agroworld that is home to a regiment of the mercenary group known as the Dioscuri.
column2: 一个农业世界，是名为Dioscuri的雇佣兵集团一个团的驻地.

column1: Vakarel is an ice world with a turbulent atmosphere of perpetual blizzards called the \"Star Veil\". Native fauna includes the predatory Ugmar. There are rumours that Qaere Crystals are found in great quantity on Vakarel, but not officially confirmed.
column2: 瓦卡雷尔是一颗冰封世界，其动荡的大气被称为"星幕"，永不停歇的暴风雪。原生动物群包括掠食性的乌格玛。有传言称瓦卡雷尔上大量存在奎尔晶体，但未获官方证实。ZH

column1: The Valabhi system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but it was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Valabhi星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在第三次继承战争期间被彻底废弃.

column1: The Valasha system is a key entry point to the Outworlds Alliance. With its high energy star, multiple jumpships as well as cargo transfer and recharge stations could be found at both of Valasha's main jump points.
column2: 瓦拉沙星系是外域联盟的关键入口。由于其高能恒星，瓦拉沙的两个主要跳跃点都能见到多艘跃迁舰以及货运转运与充能站。ZH

column1: Valdives was originally colonized by those looking to exploit its vast geothermal energy, but the volcanos proved to be more trouble than it was worth. Lostech prospectors sometimes tell tales about the treasures under the ash.
column2: 最初殖民瓦尔代夫的是那些期望开发其庞大地热能的人，但结果和它的价值比起来，火山要更加麻烦. 勘探失落科技的人时常会讲述火山灰底下埋藏着宝藏的传说.

column1: Valencia is a beautiful oceanic planet with settlements dotted around the coastlines of the many islands that make up the world.  It exports agricultural and aquatic produce to nearby worlds.
column2: Valencia是一个美丽的海洋星球，定居点散布在构成这个世界的众多岛屿的海岸线周围. 它向附近的星球出口农产品和水产品.

column1: Subject to a decimation by Draconis forces during the Reunification War, the system serviced the Draconis Combine for centuries. This was the last system that the Minnesota Tribe was last sighted in before Comstar lost their trail.
column2: 在统一战争期间遭到天龙部队的毁灭性打击后，该星系为天龙联合体服务了数百年. 这是ComStar失去其踪迹之前，明尼苏达部落最后被目击到的星系.

column1: Valerius is an habitable world that appears to have moderate mineral deposits. Its astrographical location is its more important trait.
column2: Valerius是一颗宜居行星，似乎拥有中等规模的矿藏. 其天文位置才是它更重要的特征.

column1: Valexa was settled at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War, and exports aquatic produce to nearby worlds. The Valexa Cappelan March Militia are headquartered here.
column2: Valexa在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，并向邻近世界出口水产. Valexa卡佩拉边疆民兵的总部设在这里.

column1: Valil'yevskiy was settled at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War, and exports agricultural and aquatic produce to nearby worlds.
column2: 瓦利利耶夫斯基在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，向附近世界出口农产品与水产。ZH

column1: The Valladolid system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but was annihilated by multiple nuclear strikes during the First Succession War and left uninhabitable.
column2: Valladolid星系在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候有人定居，但在第一次继承战争期间被多次核打击彻底毁灭，并变得无法居住.

column1: Valloire was settled at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War, and produces agricultural produce for nearby worlds. It's tropical climate is known for producing the best teas in the quadrant.
column2: 瓦卢瓦尔在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，为附近世界生产农产品。它的热带气候以出产该星区最好的茶闻名。ZH

column1: Valmiera was settled at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War, and produces agricultural produce for nearby worlds.
column2: Valmiera在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民，并为附近的世界生产农产品.

column1: The Valois system was settled during the Star League era, until it was abandoned during the Third Succession War. Centuries ago a BattleMech Division earned the name \"The Alamo Division\", sacrificing to save their target from nuclear annihilation.
column2: 瓦卢瓦星系在星盟时代被殖民，直到第三次继承战争期间被废弃。数百年前，一支战斗机甲师获得了"阿拉莫师"之名，为把他们的目标从核毁灭中拯救出来而牺牲。ZH

column1: Vandalia was settled at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War, and produces agricultural goods for nearby worlds, including delicacies such as owlbear and axebeak.
column2: Vandalia是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民的，并为邻近世界生产农产品，包括枭熊和斧喙鸟等美味佳肴.

column1: Van Diemen IV was settled at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War, and is a picturesque world that produces agricultural produce for nearby worlds.
column2: Van Diemen IV是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民的，这是一颗风景如画的世界，为附近的世界生产农产品.

column1: Vanern was settled at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War, and produces agricultural produce for nearby worlds. The mumba fruit is unique to this world.
column2: Vanern在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，并为附近的世界生产农产品. mumba果是这个世界独有的.

column1: The Vangburg system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, and was a member of the Outworlds Alliance until it was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Vangburg星系是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，并且在第三次继承战争期间被完全废弃之前，一直是外世界联盟的成员.

column1: Settled during the Reunification War, Vannes was originally the site of a large Merkava tank production line. The SLDF also set up a Castle Brian here, now known as Castle Vannes with a vast underground network underneath.
column2: 在统一战争期间有人定居，Vannes最初是一条大型梅卡瓦坦克生产线的所在地. SLDF还在这里建立了一座布莱恩城堡，如今被称为Vannes城堡，其下方有着庞大的地下网络.

column1: Once the site of a large battle during the First Succession War where superior tactics won out against numbers, the forested planet of Vanra is now home to the Orloff Military Academy.
column2: Vanra曾是第一次继承战争期间一场大规模战役的发生地，当时卓越的战术战胜了数量优势；如今，这颗森林覆盖的星球是奥尔洛夫军事学院的所在地.

column1: Vantaa was settled at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War, and produces agricultural produce for nearby worlds, specifically fruit.
column2: Vantaa在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，并为附近星球生产农产品，尤其是水果.

column1: Almost a billion people live in the cleverly engineered treetop cities of Vard, where descent to the lush jungle of ground level is only possible for short times and with armed protection from the wildlife.
column2: 瓦德星上精心设计建造的树梢城市中生活着近10亿人，树底葱葱郁郁的丛林不可长时间逗留，得全副武装抵御野生生物.

column1: Vargtass was settled at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War but died out sometime between the Second and Third Succession Wars.
column2: Vargtass在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在第二次和第三次继承战争之间的某个时候消亡了.

column1: The Várri system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, and was a member of the Rim Worlds Republic until it was abandoned entirely during the Second Succession War.
column2: Várri星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，并一直是边缘世界共和国的一部分，直到第二次继承战争期间被完全废弃.

column1: A small penal colony on a harsh world, Vaucluse holds many dangerous criminals from across the Commonwealth.
column2: Vaucluse是一座位于严酷世界上的小型流放地，关押着来自共同体各地的许多危险罪犯.

column1: The Vecchio system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, and was a member of the Federated Suns until it was abandoned entirely during the Second Succession War.
column2: Vecchio星系在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，并一直是恒星联邦的一员，直到第二次继承战争期间被完全废弃.

column1: A small penal colony on a harsh world, Veckholm holds many dangerous criminals from across the Commonwealth.
column2: Veckholm是一个位于环境恶劣星球上的小型流放地，关押着来自共同体各地的许多危险罪犯.

column1: Vega is a world rich in minerals, metallic ores, and fresh water. It is home to numerous manufacturers and research complexes such as Cosby Myomer Research Firm
column2: Vega是一个富含矿物、金属矿石和淡水的世界. 这里是众多制造商和研究综合体的所在地，例如科斯比肌纤维研究公司.

column1: The Velhas system was colonized at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War. The Fourth Donegal Guards have a large training range amongst the mudflats and have often been sighted in the area.
column2: Velhas星系在统一战争结束后的星盟时代某个时期被殖民. 第四多尼戈尔卫队在泥滩中拥有一座大型训练场，并经常在该地区被目击.

column1: The Venaria system was colonized either during or shortly before the Age of War. During the final years of the Star League, Venaria was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
column2: Venaria星系是在战争时代期间或之前不久被殖民的. 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Venaria设有一支星际联盟防卫军驻军.

column1: Vendrell has two moons named Ying and Yang and is been home to manufacturing facilities operated by the noted defense manufacturer Mountain Wolf BattleMechs.
column2: Vendrell有两颗名为Ying和Yang的卫星，并且一直是著名防务制造商Mountain Wolf BattleMechs运营的制造设施所在地.

column1: The Ventabren system was colonised during the First Exodus from Terra. During the Third Succession War, it suffered a Scorched Earth campaign which resulted in a hefty rebuilding effort after the war.
column2: Ventabren星系在第一次从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间被殖民. 在第三次继承战争期间，它遭受了一场焦土战役，导致战后需要进行大规模重建.

column1: The Verde system was colonised during the First Exodus from Terra. Whilst the planetside population is poor, the lucrative mining facilities on the asteroid belt provide heavy raw materials to Galtor Naval Yards in the Exeter System.
column2: Verde星系是在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间被殖民的. 尽管行星地表的居民十分贫困，但小行星带上利润丰厚的采矿设施为Exeter星系中的Galtor海军船坞提供了大量原材料.

column1: The Verdigreis system was colonized at some point prior to the end of the Age of War, and by the eve of the Reunification War was a member of the Taurian Concordat, but fell to the Federated Suns during the First Succession War.
column2: Verdigreis星系在战争时代结束前的某个时候被殖民，到统一战争前夕时已是金牛协约国的成员，但在第一次继承战争期间落入恒星联邦之手.

column1: The Verdinge system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, and was a member of the Federated Suns until it was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Verdinge星系是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，并一直是恒星联邦的一部分，直到第三次继承战争期间被完全废弃.

column1: The Vereeniging system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War due to famine.
column2: Vereeniging星系是在统一战争结束后、星盟时代的某个时候被殖民的，但在第三次继承战争期间因饥荒而被完全废弃.

column1: Constant earthquakes and volcanic eruptions shake the surface of Verlo, a highly volatile world. Rich mineral deposits exist here for those brave enough to endure the harsh climate.
column2: 持续不断的地震和火山喷发撼动着Verlo的表面，这是一个极度动荡的世界. 这里蕴藏着丰富的矿藏，等待着那些敢于忍受严酷气候的人.

column1: The Vermezzo system settled during or shortly before the Age of War, and remained Lyran for centuries. It is known the Óleo Reserve, a very rich deposit of petroleum, notable for being the largest in the local region of space.
column2: Vermezzo星系在战争时代期间或之前不久建立定居点，并在数个世纪里一直属于天琴. 它以Óleo Reserve而闻名，那是一处极其丰富的石油矿藏，以当地太空区域中规模最大而著称.

column1: Settled during the Star League era, Versailles vanished from maps during the First Succession War, which suggests that the system had been abandoned or depopulated, though there is evidence that the system was removed from most maps by ComStar.
column2: Versailles在星际联盟时代有人定居，却在第一次继承战争期间从星图上消失，这表明该星系已被废弃或人口减少，不过有证据表明，该星系是被通讯之星从大多数星图上移除的.

column1: Vestallas was known to hold the Capellan Confederation's treasure. Its underground vaults contained priceless works of art; precious stones; bars of gold, silver, and germanium; and hard currency from the Confederation and other Successor States.
column2: 维斯塔拉斯以藏有卡佩兰联邦的财宝而闻名。其地下金库存有无价的艺术品、宝石；金、银和锗锭；以及来自联邦和其他继承国的硬通货。ZH

column1: Viborg itself is described as a \"garden world\", and the population preferred to import ores and steel from the abundant asteroid belts via the Penance mining habitat over mining the planet itself.
column2: 维堡本身被描述为"花园世界"，居民宁愿通过苦修采矿栖息地从丰富的小行星带进口矿石与钢材，也不愿开采行星本身。ZH

column1: The Vibrunum system was settled during or shortly before the Age of War. The system mainly provides agricultural produce to nearby manufacturing worlds.
column2: Vibrunum星系在战争时代期间或之前不久被殖民. 该星系主要向附近的制造业星球供应农产品.

column1: The Vicente system settled during or shortly before the Age of War. The system mainly provides agricultural produce to nearby manufacturing worlds.
column2: Vicente星系在战争时代期间或稍早之前被殖民. 该星系主要向附近的制造业星球供应农产品.

column1: The Vicksland system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but was abandoned entirely during the Second Succession War.
column2: Vicksland星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在第二次继承战争期间被完全废弃.

column1: The administrative capital of its Capellan Confederation Commonality, Victoria is famous for its violently bad weather, underground cities, and beautiful domed parks. Many industries take advantage of the local natural resources.
column2: 维多利亚是其所在卡佩拉联邦共同区的行政首府，因其极度恶劣的天气，地下城市，以及美丽的穹顶公园而盛名在外. 许多产业都充分利用了当地的自然资源.

column1: The Victralla system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Victralla星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某一时期被殖民，但在第三次继承战争期间被彻底废弃.

column1: The Vihtijarvi system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War. The system mainly provides agricultural produce to nearby manufacturing worlds.
column2: Vihtijarvi星系在统一战争结束后的某个时候、于星际联盟时代被殖民. 该星系主要向附近的制造业世界提供农产品.

column1: The Vikindu system was settled during or shortly before the Age of War and by the end of that era was a part of the Free Worlds League. The harsh desert climate prevents growth of most crops, requiring large amounts of imports for the population.
column2: Vikindu星系在战争时代期间或稍早之前被殖民，到该时代末期已成为自由世界联盟的一部分. 严酷的沙漠气候使大多数作物无法生长，导致人口需要大量进口物资.

column1: Villanueva is a lightly-settled, extremely humid water planet. Most of the inhabitants are engaged in food production and processing, and live in small settlements around automated facilities.
column2: 比亚努埃瓦是个少人居住，极度潮湿的丰水行星. 大多数居民从事食品生产和加工产业，生活在自动化工厂周边的小型定居点.

column1: The Villuisk system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, and was part of the short lived Finmark Free Republic until it was abandoned entirely during the Second Succession War.
column2: Villuisk星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，并曾是短暂的芬马克自由共和国的一部分，直到在第二次继承战争期间被彻底废弃.

column1: Vindemiatrix is best known for the Vindemiatrix Observatory, a university that focuses almost completely on stellar life cycles and planetology.
column2: Vindemiatrix最出名的是Vindemiatrix天文台，这是一所几乎完全专注于恒星生命周期和行星学的大学.

column1: The Vinstra system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, and was part of the Outworlds Alliance until it was abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War.
column2: Vinstra星系是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，并一直是外世界联盟的一部分，直到在第三次继承战争期间被完全废弃.

column1: The Vinton system was colonized during the Golden Century. In 3011 a comet passed close enough to the Diamond Shark naval cache in the system to damage the WarShips significantly enough to prevent them being restored to active service.
column2: Vinton星系于黄金世纪被殖民. 3011年，一颗彗星经过时距离该星系中钻石鲨的海军储备库足够近，严重损坏了其中的战舰，使其无法恢复现役.

column1: The Vintru system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War. Vintru was conquered by the Federated Suns during the Second Succession War and abandoned entirely during the Third Succession War
column2: Vintru星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居. Vintru在第二次继承战争期间被恒星联邦征服，并在第三次继承战争期间被完全废弃.

column1: One of the founding worlds of the Rasalhague Consortium, Vipaava enjoys a temperate climate and a healthy industry.
column2: 作为Rasalhague Consortium的创始世界之一，Vipaava享有温带气候和繁荣的工业.

column1: The Virentofta system was colonised at some point prior to the end of the Reunification War by colonists of Scandinavian descent, who settled into the arctic conditions admirably well.
column2: Virentofta星系在统一战争结束前的某个时候被斯堪的纳维亚血统的殖民者殖民，他们令人钦佩地适应了那里的极地环境.

column1: The airless world of Viribium was a critical military base, defending Liao's border from the Free Worlds League. The League seized the base in the Second Succession War, and then abandoned it, detonating nuclear devices inside the facilities before leaving.
column2: 无大气的维里比乌姆世界曾是一处关键军事基地，为廖氏防守边界、抵御自由世界联盟。联盟在第二次继承战争中夺取该基地，随后放弃它，离开前在设施内部引爆了核装置。ZH

column1: The Viroflay system was settled during the Star League era, and was a known pirate haven with a large human trafficking operation, until it was destroyed in the Succession Wars.
column2: Viroflay星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，曾是一个已知的海盗避风港，并有着大规模的人口贩卖活动，直到它在继承战争中被摧毁.

column1: The capital city of Redlight on Virtue is the headquarters of Virtue Cartographers Unlimited, the premier starmap makers in the Lyran Commonwealth, rivaling the expertise of even the ComStar Cartographic Corps.
column2: Virtue上的首府城市Redlight是Virtue Cartographers Unlimited的总部——天琴共同体首屈一指的星图制造商，其专业水准甚至可与ComStar制图兵团相媲美.

column1: An oceanic planet filled with islands, Visby offers fresh aquatic life to nearby worlds.
column2: Visby是一颗遍布岛屿的海洋行星，为附近世界提供新鲜的水生生物.

column1: Depopulated in the Succession Wars, a small consortium of Canopian corporations have resettled the world as a skiing and winter sports resort for wealthy patrons.
column2: 在继承战争中人口流失殆尽后，一个由卡诺帕斯企业组成的小型财团重新定居了这个世界，将其打造为面向富裕主顾的滑雪与冬季运动度假胜地.

column1: The Voehn system was settled during the Star League era, and was a minor colony on the periphery of the Outworlds Alliance, until the Third Succession War when it was abandoned along with many other worlds.
column2: Voehn星系在星际联盟时代有人定居，曾是外域联盟边缘的一个小型殖民地，直到第三次继承战争期间，它与许多其他世界一起被废弃.

column1: The Volders system was settled shortly after the First Exodus from Terra. During the Fourth Succession War a massive cache of Star League Mechs and weapons were discovered by Snords Irregulars.
column2: Volders星系在第一次地球大迁徙后不久便有人定居. 第四次继承战争期间，斯诺德非正规军发现了一处巨大的星际联盟机甲与武器储藏库.

column1: The Vonja system was settled during the Star League era, and became a minor colony on the periphery of the Outworlds Alliance, until the Third Succession War when it was abandoned.
column2: Vonja星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，并成为外世界联盟边缘的一个小型殖民地，直到第三次继承战争时被废弃.

column1: The Vorarlberg system was settled during the First Exodus from Terra and by the end of the Age of War was a part of the Lyran Commonwealth. It was heavily damaged during the Second Succession War, and is an contested world thanks to its factories.
column2: Vorarlberg星系在第一次从泰拉向外大迁徙期间被殖民，到战争时代结束时已成为天琴共同体的一部分. 它在第二次继承战争期间遭到严重破坏，并因其工厂而成为一颗争夺中的星球.

column1: The Vortalcoy system was either settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but was abandoned after the main colony was destroyed during the First Succession War in a chemical weapons strike.
column2: Vortalcoy星系可能是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在第一次继承战争期间，其主要殖民地因一次化学武器打击而被摧毁后，该星系便被废弃了.

column1: The Vorzel system was settled at some point during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the Protectorate of Donegal prior to the formation of the Lyran Commonwealth.
column2: Vorzel星系在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久的某个时候有人定居，并在天琴共同体成立之前是多尼戈尔保护国的成员.

column1: The Vosloorus system was settled at some point during the Age of War, and was a member of the Free Worlds League by the end of that era. Pharmaceuticals are researched produced in vast amounts here, thanks to the unique fungi growing on the planet.
column2: Vosloorus星系在战争时代的某个时期被殖民，到了那个时代末期，它已成为自由世界联盟的成员. 得益于该行星上生长的独特真菌，这里大量研究和生产药品.

column1: The Vulcan system was colonised by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War. The arid and rocky climate of the world leaves it quite defensible.
column2: Vulcan星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被天琴共同体殖民. 该世界干旱多岩的气候使其相当易守难攻.

column1: The Vulture's Nest system was either settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but was abandoned during the Second Succession War after pirates conquered and pillaged the system.
column2: 秃鹫巢星系是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在第二次继承战争中被废弃——海盗征服并洗劫了该星系。ZH

column1: The Waddesdon system was settled before the Reunification War, and has remained part of the Draconis Combine for centuries. It's vast mudflats cover a large collection of Star League era vaults, many of which are still being found to this day.
column2: 瓦德斯登星系在统一战争之前被殖民，数百年来一直是龙尼斯联合体的一部分。它广袤的泥滩之下埋藏着一大批星盟时代的储藏库，其中许多至今仍在被发现。ZH

column1: The Waimalu system was settled before the Age of War, and has remained part of the Federated Suns for centuries. It is a largely agricultural world with the finest meats cut from the avian creatures that inhabit the second continent.
column2: Waimalu星系在战争时代之前就已有人定居，数百年来一直是恒星联邦的一部分. 这是一个以农业为主的世界，最上等的肉类取自栖息在第二大陆的鸟类生物.

column1: The Waina Point system was either settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but was abandoned during the Second Succession War after the capital city was destroyed in a nuclear attack.
column2: Waina Point星系是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在第二次继承战争期间，其首府在一次核攻击中被摧毁后，该星系被废弃了.

column1: The Waipahu system was settled before the Age of War, and has remained part of the Federated Suns for centuries. It has a low tech but heavy industrial base which continues to churn out parts for ground forces, and a growing narcotics trade.
column2: Waipahu星系在战争时代之前便已有人定居，并在数个世纪里一直是恒星联邦的一部分. 它的技术水平低下，但拥有雄厚的重工业基础，持续为地面部队生产零部件，同时毒品贸易也在日益增长.

column1: The Waitur system was either settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but was abandoned during the Third Succession War as famine struck.
column2: Waitur星系可能是在统一战争结束后的某个时候、于星际联盟时代被殖民的，但在第三次继承战争期间因饥荒而被废弃.

column1: The Waldheim system was settled before or during the Reunification War. A high gravity world known for its rugged nature, many ground forces train here to simulate mountainous battles.
column2: Waldheim星系在统一战争之前或期间被殖民. 这是一颗以崎岖险峻著称的高重力星球，许多地面部队在此训练，以模拟山地战斗.

column1: Waldorff is the second planet in the system and has a single moon named Nikola. The capital of Waldorff City is known for its cavernous storm drains used for illegal racing, a dangerous pursuit in light of the savage storms that can hit the world.
column2: Waldorff是该星系中的第二颗行星，拥有一颗名为Nikola的卫星. Waldorff的首府Waldorff City以其洞穴般的排洪渠而闻名，这些排洪渠被用于非法赛车；鉴于可能袭击这个世界的狂暴风暴，这是一项危险的活动.

column1: The Wallacia system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, and had a training ground amongst the vast mudflats created for the Second Oriente Hussars.
column2: Wallacia星系是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，并在广阔的泥滩中设有一处专为第二奥连特骠骑兵团建立的训练场.

column1: Wallis is the sixth planet in the system and has a single moon. Wallis is home to factories belonging to at least one significant defense manufacturer, Ronin Incorporated. Vuzar, the seventh planet, is an icy retreat for wealthier citizens.
column2: Wallis是该星系中的第六颗行星，拥有一颗卫星. Wallis拥有至少一家重要国防制造商Ronin Incorporated的工厂. 第七颗行星Vuzar则是较富裕公民的冰冷度假胜地.

column1: The Wantorill system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but suffered famine during the Third Succession War, leaving it depopulated.
column2: Wantorill星系在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民，但在第三次继承战争期间遭遇饥荒，导致人口凋零.

column1: Wapakoneta is an oceanic world, with the local economy largely based around exporting aquaculture-grown marine life, although the planet had many small, beautiful islands suitable for tourism.
column2: Wapakoneta是一颗海洋世界，当地经济主要依靠出口水产养殖的海洋生物，尽管这颗行星拥有许多适合旅游的美丽小岛.

column1: Large canyons and heavy seismic activity make mining activities dangerous on Wappingers - but also highly lucrative. High risk, high reward is often their motto.
column2: 巨大的峡谷和剧烈的地震活动使得在Wappingers上的采矿活动十分危险——但同时也利润丰厚. 高风险、高回报往往是他们的座右铭.

column1: Ward is a warm water planet with one small continent. The utopian ideals of Ward's original settlers remain strong in its population of 1.5 billion, and the planet thrives based on their reputation for solid construction work.
column2: 沃德是一颗温水星球，只有一块小大陆。沃德最初定居者的乌托邦理想在其十五亿居民中依然强烈，该星球凭借其扎实建筑工艺的名声而繁荣。ZH

column1: Located relatively close to the Deep Periphery systems known as Cambridge and Trinity, the Wark system primary is a type G0V star.
column2: Wark星系的主星是一颗G0V型恒星，其位置相对靠近被称为Cambridge和Trinity的深空外围星系.

column1: Warlock is the third planet in the system and has a single moon named Blackguard. Warlock is the home to at least one facility operated by Ceres Metals Industries while Blackguard is the site of a substantial naval repair base.
column2: Warlock是该星系中的第三颗行星，拥有一颗名为Blackguard的卫星. Warlock拥有至少一座由Ceres Metals Industries运营的设施，而Blackguard则设有一座大型海军维修基地.

column1: An unremarkable agro world, its capital city of Hutch contains a massive memorial hall dedicated to the Third Dragonlords regiment, of whom lost many members centuries ago in a tragic dropship accident.
column2: 一颗毫不起眼的农业世界，其首府Hutch设有一座巨大的纪念堂，纪念第三龙领主团——该团数百年前在一场悲惨的降落船事故中损失了许多成员.

column1: The Warrumbungle system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but the atmosphere was boiled away during the fighting in the Second Succession War, leaving it depopulated.
column2: Warrumbungle星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在第二次继承战争的战斗中，其大气被蒸发殆尽，导致该星系人口灭绝.

column1: The Wasat system was settled during the First Exodus from Terra and was a major industrial world for the Star League. The ruins of many Castle Brian's can be found across the planet, a source of LosTech.
column2: 瓦萨特星系在首次从地球出走期间被殖民，曾是星盟的重要工业世界。全行星都能找到许多布莱恩堡的废墟，是失传科技的来源。ZH

column1: The Washburn system was settled during the First Exodus from Terra. Washburn II is the second planet in the Washburn system and has three moons named Cephas, Elihu and Israel. Washburn has been home to a refit facility operated by Irian Technologies.
column2: Washburn星系是在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间被殖民的. Washburn II是Washburn星系中的第二颗行星，拥有三颗名为Cephas、Elihu和Israel的卫星. Washburn一直是Irian Technologies运营的一处改装设施的所在地.

column1: The Watermael system was settled during the Age of War and then became a member of the Free Worlds League. The 21st Royal Division of the SLDF fought on this world centuries ago, and rumours exist of Star League weapons caches hidden away here.
column2: Watermael星系在战争时代被殖民，随后成为自由世界联盟的一员. 数个世纪前，SLDF的第21皇家师曾在这个世界上作战，并且有传闻称这里藏有星际联盟的武器储藏库.

column1: Waunakee was liberated by the Federated Suns during the first majorcounter-offensive of the First Succession War against the Draconis Combine. Centuries later, the industrial base has still not recovered to Star League era levels.
column2: Waunakee在第一次继承战争期间恒星联邦针对天龙联合体发动的首次大规模反攻中被解放. 数百年后，其工业基础仍未恢复到星际联盟时代的水平.

column1: The Waxell system was settled during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra. Since the Third Succession War, its factories and industrial base have been exporting large amounts of polymers to nearby worlds.
column2: Waxell星系是在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久建立殖民地的. 自第三次继承战争以来，其工厂和工业基础一直向附近世界出口大量聚合物.

column1: The Waycross system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, but the atmosphere was boiled away during the fighting in the Second Succession War, leaving it depopulated.
column2: Waycross星系是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在第二次继承战争期间，其大气层在战斗中被蒸发殆尽，导致该星系变得荒无人烟.

column1: The Waypoint system was settled during the Star League era, but the population eked out a meager living until recently. They have recently signed a deal for a HPG with Comstar however.
column2: Waypoint星系是在星际联盟时代有人定居的，但直到最近，当地居民都只能勉强维持微薄生计. 不过，他们最近与ComStar签署了一项关于HPG的协议.

column1: Waypoint 531 consists of a red giant sun and \"The Brothers\", four large asteroids in varying orbits around the star. The THS Yosemite, a Terran Hegemony colony JumpShip, was lost here over five hundred years ago.
column2: 五三一号航点由一颗红巨星和"兄弟"组成——那是四颗以不同轨道环绕该恒星的大型小行星。五百多年前，地球霸权的殖民跃迁舰THS约塞米蒂在此失事。ZH

column1: An oft traded world, Wazan is nevertheless full of surprises with its deep mines amongst its rocky terrain.
column2: 作为一颗贸易频繁的星球，Wazan依然充满惊喜，其崎岖地形中分布着深邃的矿坑.

column1: The Weatogue system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War. Ignored during the Succession Wars, Weatogue is an perma-frost agricultural world known for its Ice Cold Beer.
column2: Weatogue星系是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的. 在继承战争期间被忽视，Weatogue是一颗永久冻土的农业世界，以其冰镇啤酒闻名.

column1: The Wedderborg system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War and survived the first two Succession Wars, until it was struck by famine during the Third and abandoned.
column2: Wedderborg星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，并挺过了前两次继承战争，直到在第三次继承战争期间遭遇饥荒并被废弃.

column1: The Wedgefield system was settled during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra, and is known for its pastures and cloth industries.
column2: Wedgefield星系在第一次泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久有人定居，并以其牧场和纺织业闻名.

column1: The Weekapaug system was settled during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the St. Ives Mercantile League prior to the formation of the Capellan Confederation in the mid-twenty-fourth century.
column2: Weekapaug星系在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民，并在24世纪中叶卡佩拉邦联成立之前，是圣艾夫斯商业联盟的成员.

column1: During the Fourth Succession War a repository of Star League chemical weaponry and nerve agents was discovered and unleashed on the population of this world, killing almost a billion citizens. Wei is still in recovery now.
column2: 在第四次继承战争期间，一处星际联盟化学武器和神经毒剂的储藏库被发现，并被释放到这颗星球的人口之中，导致近十亿公民死亡. Wei至今仍在恢复之中.

column1: Weingarten is best known for its vast wine industry. The mild weather and long growing seasons make Weingarten ideal for growing crops, particularly grapes. Wine from the world is highly prized which leads to large profit margins for exporters.
column2: Weingarten最著名的是其庞大的葡萄酒产业. 温和的气候和漫长的生长季使Weingarten非常适合种植农作物，尤其是葡萄. 该星球出产的葡萄酒备受推崇，这为出口商带来了丰厚的利润空间.

column1: Weippe is best known for its fine grain sands and glassblowing industries, which are unique to the planet.
column2: Weippe以其细粒砂和吹玻璃产业而闻名，这些是该行星独有的.

column1: A binary star system, the fifth world is nicknamed \"Brimstone\" by the natives; it has a large satellite world called Fire. The temperature range at the polar capital of Port Erebus can vary over 70 degrees in one day.
column2: 一个双星系统，其第五颗行星被当地人昵称为"硫磺"；它有一颗巨大的卫星世界叫"火"。极地首府厄瑞玻斯港的气温一天内可变化超过70度。ZH

column1: The Weistheimer system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the Reunification War, but has been abandoned and resettled numerous times over the centuries as mineral deposits are found and depleted.
column2: Weistheimer星系在星盟时代、统一战争后的某个时期被殖民，但几个世纪以来，随着矿藏被发现和耗尽，它曾多次被废弃并重新殖民.

column1: This grim and bleak ball of mud was only colonized for its central position in rimward Capellan space. The outpost was eventually abandoned in favor of refueling stations at the jump points, and the planet-side colony buildings sunk into the mud.
column2: 这颗严酷荒凉的泥泞星球之所以被殖民，仅仅是因为它处在缘向卡佩拉星域的中心位置. 这处前哨最终被废弃，代之以设在跃迁点的燃料补给站，而星球表面的殖民地建筑则逐渐沉入泥沼之中.

column1: The Weiz system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the Reunification War. Weiz vanished from maps at some point after the end of the First Succession War after the atmosphere became too irradiated for the colonists.
column2: Weiz星系在统一战争之后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民. 第一次继承战争结束后的某个时候，由于大气层变得辐射过强，殖民者无法生存，Weiz从星图上消失了.

column1: The Weldon system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, and is home to a galaxy famous author who often writes about the heroic tales of MechWarriors.
column2: Weldon星系于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某一时期被殖民定居，这里是一位享誉银河的作家的家乡，他经常撰写关于机甲战士英雄事迹的故事.

column1: Weldry is a cold world with a thin atmosphere that's only breathable in the lowlands and valleys. The highlands are barren, windswept, uninhabited ice. The highest form of life is a vicious stinging insect that can form mile-wide swarms.
column2: 韦尔德里是一颗寒冷而大气稀薄的星球，空气只在低地和山谷中可以呼吸。高原地带是贫瘠、风蚀、无人居住的冰原。那里最高等的生命是一种凶狠的刺人昆虫，能形成宽达数英里的虫群。ZH

column1: The Werfer system was settled during or shortly before the Age of War by the Taurian Concordat, but was abandoned during the Third Succession War.
column2: Werfer星系在战争时代期间或开始前不久由金牛协约国殖民，但在第三次继承战争期间被废弃.

column1: Wernke is the third planet in the Wernke system and has a single inhabited and heavily-industrialized moon named Talon, which oft confuses stellar cartographers and map makers alike.
column2: Wernke是Wernke星系中的第三颗行星，拥有一颗名为Talon的有人居住且高度工业化的卫星，这常常令恒星制图师和地图绘制者感到困惑.

column1: Westerhand is the second planet in the system and has three moons named Delsia, Ralston and Vannora. Known for its Star League era mech repair facilities, which are renown throughout the Sian Commonality.
column2: Westerhand是该星系中的第二颗行星，拥有三颗卫星，分别名为Delsia、Ralston和Vannora. 这里以其星际联盟时代的机甲维修设施而闻名，这些设施在整个Sian Commonality都享有盛誉.

column1: The Westerstede system was settled during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the Protectorate of Donegal prior to the founding of the Lyran Commonwealth.
column2: Westerstede星系在第一次泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久被开拓定居，并且在天琴共同体成立之前曾是多尼戈尔保护国的成员.

column1: The Westfield system was settled during the Star League era but was devastated during the First Succession War, leaving the planet a molten uninhabitable ruin.
column2: Westfield星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，但在第一次继承战争中遭到毁灭，使该行星变成了一片熔融、无法居住的废墟.

column1: Westover is the fourth planet in the Westover system and has a single moon named Duban. Westover is been home to facilities belonging to numerous defense manufacturers, most notably Andurien AeroTech.
column2: Westover是Westover星系中的第四颗行星，拥有一颗名为Duban的卫星. Westover一直是众多国防制造商旗下设施的所在地，其中最著名的当属Andurien AeroTech.

column1: The Westphalia system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the Reunification War, and conquered by the Federated Suns during the Second Succession War. The system was later abandoned in the fighting of the Third Succession War.
column2: Westphalia星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争之后的某个时期被殖民，并在第二次继承战争期间被恒星联邦征服. 该星系后来在第三次继承战争的战斗中遭废弃.

column1: The Wetumpka system was settled before or during the Age of War and was a part of the Federated Suns by the end of the era. Wetumpka is known for its massive rumbling waters from its many rivers and waterfalls.
column2: Wetumpka星系在战争时代之前或期间被殖民，到该时代结束时已成为恒星联邦的一部分. Wetumpka以其众多河流和瀑布中奔涌轰鸣的巨量水流而闻名.

column1: Named \"Wheel\" after the massive recharge station and habitat at its zenith jump point (featuring a wheel-shaped gravdeck around a needle-shaped core) that also serves as administrative center for the asteroid facilities in the system.
column2: 它以天顶跳跃点那巨大的充能站与居住区命名（其特色是围绕针状核心的轮形重力甲板），那里同时也是该星系小行星设施的管理中心。ZH

column1: The Whittington system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War. The planet is mostly barren, with small patches of fertile land surrounding the extensive volcanic activity.
column2: Whittington星系是在统一战争结束后的某个时候，于星际联盟时代被殖民的. 该行星大部分贫瘠，广袤的火山活动周围只有小片肥沃土地.

column1: Wildwood is a lush and sparsely populated planet nearing the outer edge of the Magistracy of Canopus. In spite of a small population, Wildwood was the largest producer of wine and other agricultural products in the Magistracy.
column2: Wildwood是一颗郁郁葱葱、人口稀少的行星，位于船底自治区外缘附近. 尽管人口稀少，Wildwood仍是船底自治区最大的葡萄酒和其他农产品生产地.

column1: The Wilkes system was settled before or during the First Exodus from Terra, and has a thriving industrial base thanks to the thermal boreholes that descend deep into the planets mantle.
column2: Wilkes星系在第一次泰拉大迁徙之前或期间就已有人定居，并且得益于那些深入行星地幔的热力钻孔，拥有繁荣的工业基础.

column1: The Willowick system was settled during the First Exodus from Terra and became during the Age of War a member of the Federated Suns. It's large lakes and watersports are tourist hotspots for nearby worlds.
column2: 威洛威克星系在首次从地球出走期间被殖民，在战火时代成为联邦太阳的一员。它的大湖与水上运动是附近世界的旅游热点。ZH

column1: The Willunga system was originally a part of the Finmark Province by the Rim Worlds Republic, but joined the Lyran Commonwealth when the Star League fell.
column2: Willunga星系最初是边缘世界共和国芬马克省的一部分，但在星际联盟覆灭时加入了天琴共同体.

column1: The Wiltshire system was settled by the Rim Worlds Republic during the Star League era, but fell into Lyran hands during the fall of the Star League.
column2: Wiltshire星系在星际联盟时代由边缘世界共和国殖民定居，但在星际联盟崩溃期间落入天琴人之手.

column1: The Windhoek system was colonised prior to the Age of War, but was abandoned during the Third Succession War.
column2: Windhoek星系在战争时代之前已被殖民，但在第三次继承战争期间被废弃.

column1: The Windsor system was colonised during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War. Grand palaces and country seats dot the pristine landscape of Windsor, known for its aristocratic nature.
column2: Windsor星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民. 宏伟的宫殿与乡间宅邸点缀着Windsor原始纯净的景观，这里以其贵族气质而闻名.

column1: Wing was settled not for the world itself, but because its four moons have extensive amounts of titanium, bauxite, and germanium. The Capital of Crow's Nest is situated high in the mountains, providing Line of Sight to facilities on the moons.
column2: 翼星被殖民并非为了这颗行星本身，而是因为它的四颗卫星上拥有大量钛、铝土和锗。首府鸦巢坐落于高山之上，与卫星上的设施保持视线联系。ZH

column1: The Wingzar system was colonised during the Star League era, but was destroyed during the Second Succession War.
column2: Wingzar星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，但在第二次继承战争中被摧毁.

column1: Once the site of a major Displass Technologies industrial hub, Winter was devastated during the Amaris Civil War. Many facilities were completely destroyed and now only a moderate industrial base remains.
column2: Winter曾是Displass Technologies一个重要工业中心的所在地，但在阿马里斯内战期间遭到严重破坏. 许多设施被彻底摧毁，如今仅剩中等规模的工业基础.

column1: The Wisconsin system was colonized by the Free Worlds League during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, and maintains strong links with neighbouring worlds.
column2: Wisconsin星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被自由世界联盟殖民，并与邻近世界保持着紧密联系.

column1: Ruled by the Council of Merchants, Wismar is an agricultural world that provides food sources for the trade hubs across the Hanseatic League. There are also rumours of a black market in narcotics thanks to the hallucinogenic plants native to Wismar.
column2: Wismar由商人议会统治，是一个农业世界，为汉萨同盟各地的贸易枢纽提供食物来源. 由于Wismar原产的致幻植物，还有传言称这里存在毒品黑市.

column1: The Wittington system was annexed by the Draconis Combine during the Star League era, then conquered by the Federated Suns during the Second Succesion War before being eventually destroyed during the Third Succession War.
column2: Wittington星系在星际联盟时代被天龙联合体吞并，随后在第二次继承战争期间被恒星联邦征服，最终在第三次继承战争期间被摧毁.

column1: The Wokha system was settled at some time during the Star League era, but the colony died out sometime during the First Succession War.
column2: Wokha星系在星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民，但该殖民地于第一次继承战争期间的某个时候消亡了.

column1: The Wolcott system was colonised at some point during or prior to the Age of War, with the capital of Farmingbury being the muddy jewel of the entire system. The Succession Wars have succeeded in causing Wolcott to maintain a low profile.
column2: Wolcott星系在战争时代期间或之前的某个时候被殖民，首府Farmingbury是整个星系中泥泞的明珠. 继承战争成功地使Wolcott保持了低调.

column1: Wolf Orbital 82 is an orbital fleet base stationed at the Zenith jump point of a G6IV type star. Dense asteroid fields hurtle around this system, causing major navigational hazards.
column2: Wolf Orbital 82 是驻扎在一颗G6IV型恒星天顶跃迁点的一处轨道舰队基地. 密集的小行星带在该星系周围疾驰，造成重大航行危险.

column1: The Wolof system was settled by the Free Worlds League during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War. It is known for its quiet coastal villages and its vast fishing population.
column2: Wolof星系是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期由自由世界联盟殖民的. 它以宁静的沿海村庄和庞大的渔业人口而闻名.
