column1: Flankers!!!  Protect the retreating evacuees.
column2: 侧翼部队！保护正在撤离的人员.

column1: Hostiles sending another team to harass the convoy.
column2: 敌方又派了一支部队来骚扰运输车队.

column1: Initial batch of convoys ready to depart.
column2: 第一批运输车队已准备出发.

column1: Second wave, incoming...
column2: 第二波，来了……

column1: Stay put, picking you up.
column2: 原地待命，我们来接你.

column1: We've marked your evac zone.  Reach it as soon as possible.
column2: 我们已标出你的撤离区。尽快抵达。ZH

column1: Taking fire for them isn't desirable, but it's how we earn our keep.
column2: 替他们挨枪子并不理想，但这就是我们挣饭钱的方式。ZH

column1: The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}'s agents are using this installation as their forward base.  They were discovered by the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}'s intelligence and has deployed a substantial force to eliminate them. Lacking military power to mount a defense, the agents are falling back. Assist them in conducting a safe evacuation.
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的特工正以这处设施作为他们的前沿基地。他们被{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的情报部门发现，后者已派出一支可观的部队来消灭他们。由于缺乏军力组织防御，这些特工正在后撤。协助他们安全撤离。ZH

column1: Hold the installation during evac prep and cover the convoys during their escape
column2: 在撤离准备期间坚守设施，并在车队撤离时提供掩护.

column1: Protect the base structures
column2: 保护基地建筑结构

column1: All remaining evacuees are aboard; ensure their safe extraction.
column2: 所有剩余撤离人员均已登船; 请确保他们安全撤离.

column1: Convoy evacuation point is here.
column2: 车队撤离点在此处.

column1: First group of convoys is ready to roll.
column2: 第一批车队已准备出发.

column1: Onsite intelligence reports that enemy forces have breached our garrison perimeter.  We are under contract to defend the facilities while evacuation preparations are in progress.
column2: 现场情报报告称敌军已突破我方驻军防线. 我们按照合约规定，在撤离准备进行期间负责保卫设施.

column1: Second group of flankers on position!  Ensure the evacuees remain safe!
column2: 第二组侧翼包抄部队已就位! 确保撤离人员的安全!

column1: Second wave inbound --- hold positions and defend at all costs!
column2: 第二波敌军正在逼近——坚守阵地，不惜一切代价防御!

column1: Well done, Commander.  Enemy units in the area have been eliminated.  Evacuation can proceed before further reinforcements arrive.
column2: 干得好，指挥官. 该区域的敌方单位已被消灭. 在下一批增援抵达之前继续执行撤离.

column1: You heard them, boss.  Do your thing.
column2: 你听到他们的话了，老大. 按你的意思办吧.

column1: Hopefully they keep that stuff to themselves, so we don't get involved.
column2: 但愿他们把那些东西留给自己，别把我们卷进去。ZH

column1: Our employer has been cooking up some extremely questionable science. Unfortunately, they forgot one tiny detail: they don't actually have permission to do any of it here. Despite repeated calls by the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} authorities, they kept right on bubbling their beakers and poking their mysterious gizmos. Now, they're being evicted forcefully. Our mission? Give them a little breathing room to grab all their scientific doohickeys, pack up their suspiciously dubious supplies, and evacuate the place.
column2: 我们的雇主一直在鼓捣一些极其可疑的科学。遗憾的是，他们忘了关键的一点：他们其实没有在这里做这些事的许可。尽管{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}当局多次要求，他们仍继续冒着烧瓶气泡、捅着神秘小装置。如今，他们正被强制驱逐。我们的任务？给他们一点喘息空间，让他们收拾好那些科学玩意儿、打包好那些可疑得可疑的物资，然后撤离此地。ZH

column1: Detecting enemy hostiles en route to the convoy.
column2: 探测到敌方部队正在前往车队途中.

column1: First convoy is ready to roll.
column2: 第一批车队已准备好出发.

column1: More hostiles trying to intercept the retreating vechiles.
column2: 更多敌军试图拦截正在撤退的车辆.

column1: The scientists are busy packing and loading the vehicles with their gear. The lab structures must be protected until all of them and their gear and supplies are on their way.
column2: 那些科学家正忙着把装备打包装上车辆。实验室建筑必须得到保护，直到他们所有人连同装备与补给都上路。ZH

column1: Guess this facility is shutting down. Good news for us though.
column2: 看来这处设施要关停了。不过这对我们是好消息。ZH

column1: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have identified the location of {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}'s forward operating base. Friendly elements are preparing to withdraw, but enemy units are rapidly closing in. We are tasked with providing support to delay the enemy's advance. They'll need escorting out while under fire, so be prepared to split our forces.
column2: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队已定位{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}前进作战基地的位置。友军单位正准备撤退，但敌军部队正迅速逼近。我们的任务是提供支援以拖延敌军推进。他们需要在火力下被护送撤离，所以要做好分兵准备。ZH

column1: Defend and evacuate essentials
column2: 防守并撤离要员

column1: Defend the base while personnel are evacuating, Commander.   The convoy will head out as soon as it's ready and make sure they're protected no matter what.
column2: 指挥官，在人员撤离期间守住基地。车队一准备好就会出发，无论如何都要确保它们受到保护。ZH

column1: Boots on the ground...that's us.
column2: 实地人员……就是我们。ZH

column1: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have been hitting {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} bases the past few days. All signs point to this base being next. We've been asked to defend the base long enough to evacuate its occupants.
column2: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队近几天一直在袭击{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}基地。种种迹象都表明下一处就是这里。我们被要求守住该基地足够久，以便撤离其人员。ZH

column1: We underestimated the enemy numbers heading our way.  Evacuations are in progress, but it'll take time.  We need you to stall the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces while we get people onto the transport line.
column2: 我们低估了朝我们而来的敌军数量。撤离正在进行，但需要时间。我们需要你在我们把人送上运输线的同时拖住{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队。ZH

column1: We just need to buy them enough time to do the purge and then get them out safely.
column2: 我们只需要为他们争取足够的时间来完成数据清除，然后安全地将他们撤离.

column1: The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}'s intelligence-gathering facility has been compromised. {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units are mobilizing a significant strike element to neutralize the site and its occupants. Our employer is initiating a full data purge to mitigate liability and prevent sensitive material from being captured. Our mission is to delay the enemy advance long enough to ensure the purge is completed, then guard the withdrawal of personnel from the installation.
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的情报搜集设施已被攻破。{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}单位正调动一支可观的打击力量，要摧毁该地点及其人员。我们的雇主正在启动全面数据清除，以减轻责任并防止敏感材料被缴获。我们的任务是尽可能久地拖延敌军推进，确保清除完成，然后掩护人员从设施撤离。ZH

column1: Are those the last batch?
column2: 那是最后一批吗?

column1: Commander, buy us some time to rid of the stuff then we'll extract.
column2: 指挥官，给我们争取点时间把这些东西清理掉，然后我们就撤离。ZH

column1: They seem intent not to let anyone escape.
column2: 他们似乎决意不让任何人逃脱.

column1: You heard them, Commander.  Delay the enemies then guard the convoy.  Good luck.
column2: 你听到他们的话了，指挥官. 先拖延敌军，然后护卫车队. 祝你好运.

column1: Beefed Up Security
column2: 加强安保

column1: Commander, be careful: if there *is* a second attack, the raiders will go all out.
column2: 指挥官，小心点: 如果*有*第二轮攻击，那些袭击者会全力以赴.

column1: There is a small {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} base on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} that has been attacked by raiders.  Their latest attack was far better organized and equipped than the previous ones, suggesting the raiders are receiving logistical and tactical support from a hostile power.  We might not be able to withstand a second attack of that scale.   We'd like to hire you to provide additional defensive support.
column2: 在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}上有一处小型{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}基地，一直遭到劫掠者袭击。他们最近一次袭击的组织与装备远比之前几次精良，说明劫掠者正在从某个敌对势力获得后勤与战术支援。我们可能承受不住再一次那种规模的袭击。我们想雇你提供额外的防御支援。ZH

column1: Defend {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} Base
column2: 保卫 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 基地

column1: Destroy {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Additional Forces
column2: 摧毁 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 额外部队

column1: Destroy {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Auxiliaries
column2: 摧毁 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 辅助部队

column1: Destroy {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Reinforcements
column2: 摧毁 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 增援

column1: Destroy {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Vanguard
column2: 摧毁 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 先锋

column1: Good shooting, but don't celebrate yet.
column2: 射得好，但先别庆祝。ZH

column1: Whoo hoo!
column2: 呼哈！ZH

column1: Breakthrough on the Brink
column2: 濒临突破

column1: Commander, if they're hiring mercs to babysit when their forces are less than a day away they expect trouble.  Rumors say {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are in the area, they could present a threat.
column2: 指挥官，如果他们的部队不到一天就能抵达，却还要雇雇佣兵来看守，那他们就是在预期有麻烦。有传言说{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队就在这一带，他们可能构成威胁。ZH

column1: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} industrial lab is at a critical juncture in its R&D program.  Any disruption would set us back a decade. {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} has discovered this, and they've already interdicted the first lance of 'Mechs that were sent to defend the facility.  We need mercenaries to step in and buy the time necessary for further reinforcements to arrive.
column2: 一处{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}工业实验室正处于其研发计划的关键节点。任何中断都会让我们倒退十年。{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}发现了这一点，他们已经拦截了第一批被派去防守该设施的机甲。我们需要雇佣兵介入，为更多增援抵达争取必要的时间。ZH

column1: Defend a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} R&D Facility
column2: 守卫一座{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}研发设施

column1: Defend Industrial Laboratory
column2: 守卫工业实验室

column1: Destroy the Enemy Vanguard
column2: 摧毁敌方先锋

column1: Hot drop went bad, you've scattered forces.  Regroup if able, but priority is unchanged: defend the facility.
column2: 热投放出了问题，你的部队被打散。若有可能就重新集结，但优先事项不变：守住设施。ZH

column1: Expect sustained attacks from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}
column2: 预期{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}会持续进攻

column1: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} has contracted us to defend their fort, a munitions depot and BattleMech refit yard positioned in a strategically vital but undisclosed theater.  The installation serves as a critical logistics hub for its' operations, stockpiling advanced weapon systems and replacement parts for frontline units.   Intelligence confirms that a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}-aligned  strike force is en route, intent on seizing or destroying the facility before a major {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} offensive can be launched.   Your orders are to hold the installation, repel all enemy forces in open combat, and ensure the fort remains fully operational.
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}签约雇我们防守他们的堡垒，那是一处位于战略要地但未公开战区的弹药库与战斗机甲改装场。该设施是其行动的关键后勤枢纽，为前线部队储备先进武器系统与替换部件。情报确认，一支亲{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的打击部队正在赶来，意图在{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}发动大规模攻势之前夺取或摧毁该设施。你的命令是守住设施，在公开战斗中击退所有敌军，并确保堡垒保持完全可用。ZH

column1: Defend a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} the Fort
column2: 保卫{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的堡垒

column1: All units, confirm status after drop insertion.  Report in.
column2: 所有单位，确认投放后状态。回报。ZH

column1: Hold the Line
column2: 守住战线

column1: The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} facility must be running on incredibly narrow margins if they can't afford to protect it themselves.  Anyway, Commander, this should be very straightforward.
column2: 如果{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的设施连自己保护都负担不起，那它的运营余量一定极窄。总之，指挥官，这应该非常直接。ZH

column1: Hostile {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have been making increasingly bold incursions toward one of our processing facilities on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}.  This facility represents a substantial cash investment for {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}, and its destruction would be both politically and financially disastrous.  We need a capable mercenary company to defend the site.  Payment will be remitted upon the repulsion of all hostile {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units.
column2: 敌对的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军队一直向我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的一处加工设施发动袭击，袭击越来越肆无忌惮. 这座设施对{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}来说是一笔巨额资金投入，其被摧毁将带来政治和经济上的双重灾难. 我们需要一支有能力的雇佣兵部队来防御该地点. 在击退了所有敌对的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}单位后，我们就会把报酬汇给你.

column1: Defend Base from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Attackers
column2: 从{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}攻击者手里保卫基地

column1: Defend Processing Facility
column2: 守卫处理设施

column1: All right, Commander, we've been tasked with defending this installation.   We have reports of incoming hostiles from multiple directions.  They'll be targeting the structures; intercept them before they bring any down.  Good luck.
column2: 好，指挥官，我们的任务是守卫这处设施。我们接到报告，多个方向有敌人来袭。他们会把目标对准建筑；在他们弄倒任何一栋之前拦截他们。祝好运。ZH

column1: Warning commander, sensors are reading multiple contacts approaching from multiple vectors.  Looks like the attacking force has brought reinforcements.
column2: 警告，指挥官，传感器显示多个接触信号正从多个方向接近. 看来攻击部队呼叫了援军.

column1: Maintenance Base
column2: 维护基地

column1: You don't hire mercenaries on a whim. They know there's an attack incoming, and we're going to absorb it. Thankfully, all we need to do is hold out.
column2: 没人会一时兴起雇佣兵。他们知道有袭击要来，而我们要承受它。所幸我们只需坚守。ZH

column1: We operate a repair and maintenance facility on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}.  This base is critical to our operations in the system, and we suspect that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are going to assault the facility.  We'd like you to garrison the base, and if an attack comes, hold off the assault until our forces can arrive and relieve you.
column2: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}运营着一处维修与保养设施。这座基地对我们在该星系的行动至关重要，而我们怀疑{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队将进攻该设施。我们希望你去驻防该基地，若有进攻来临，拖住攻势，直到我们的部队赶到接替你。ZH

column1: Defend {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} Maintenance Base
column2: 守卫{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}维护基地

column1: Defend Maintenance Base
column2: 守卫维护基地

column1: The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} reinforcements have secured the site, Commander.  Good work.
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}援军已经拿下了该地点，指挥官. 干得好.

column1: Commander, if they're hiring mercs to babysit when their forces are less than a day away they expect trouble. Rumors say {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are in the area, they could present a threat.
column2: 指挥官，如果他们的部队不到一天就能赶到，却还要雇雇佣兵来当保姆，那说明他们预料有麻烦。有传言说{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的部队就在这一带，他们可能构成威胁。ZH

column1: We have a small, disused base in a remote part of {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}.  We need it and are preparing to reactivate it.   We'd like to hire you to recon the facility and defend it until our forces can move in.  We'll have a lance with you in half a day and a logistics team within 24 hours.
column2: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}一处偏远地区有一座闲置的小型基地。我们需要它，正准备重新启用。我们想雇你侦察该设施并防守它，直到我们的部队能进驻。半天内我们会有一支分队与你同去，24小时内会有一支后勤队抵达。ZH

column1: Defend Occupied Base
column2: 保卫已占领基地

column1: Defend Target Buildings
column2: 保卫目标建筑

column1: Commander, you are go for hot drop.  Objective is a disused {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} forward base at this grid.  Secure and hold until relief arrives.
column2: 指挥官，你可以执行热投放了。目标是这个网格上一处废弃的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}前沿基地。夺取并坚守，直到援军抵达。ZH

column1: Extra Employer reputation for completing a specific objective
column2: 完成特定目标获得的额外雇主声望

column1: Objective Bonus Reputation Reward
column2: 目标额外声望奖励

column1: Extra payment for completing a specific objective
column2: 完成特定目标的额外报酬

column1: Extra Target team reputation penalty for completing a specific objective
column2: 完成特定目标时对目标阵营声望造成的额外惩罚

column1: Objective Bonus Reputation Penalty
column2: 目标额外声望惩罚

column1: All Eyes On
column2: 万众瞩目

column1: There's worse ways to make money than influencing a whole new generation of pilot's fighting styles. Sounds fun!
column2: 影响整整一代机师的混战风格来赚钱，比很多赚钱方式都好。听起来挺有意思！ZH

column1: Commander, you've been very active. Active and successful. We're developing a new type of BattleMech simulator and we need new and improved data. Sound interesting? Good, because we want to analyse how you fight {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces. We've arranged for an ex-{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} pilot to fight you for a data gathering exercise. What do you say? You'll be well rewarded.
column2: 指挥官，你一直非常活跃。活跃且成功。我们正在研发一种新型战斗机甲模拟器，需要新的、更好的数据。听起来有意思吗？很好，因为我们想分析你如何与{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队作战。我们已安排一名前{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}机师与你对战，作为一次数据收集演习。你怎么说？报酬会很丰厚。ZH

column1: Overcome the test subject
column2: 击败测试对象

column1: And there we go. I expect to see a lot more of those moves in the future. Guess we should be ready for that ourselves.
column2: 就这样了. 我预计未来会看到更多这样的战术动作. 看来我们自己也得为此做好准备.

column1: Here we go, Commander.
column2: 开始了，指挥官.

column1: It's going to be a Circle of Equals. I hope they bring their own supply, because I don't know if we have enough sugar packets onboard.
column2: 这会是一场平等之环。我希望他们自带补给，因为我不知道船上够不够糖包。ZH

column1: Commander, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have always been a bother, always claiming to be superior to ours. So we arranged for a Trial of Grievance against {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}, and bargined for you to fight on our behalf as a slight to them. They're enraged at the implications of this, and we're more than happy to exploit it for ourselves. For the Glory of the Clan, show {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} that even our hired mercenaries are stronger than they are.
column2: 指挥官，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的部队一向令人厌烦，总自称比我们优越。所以我们安排了一场针对{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的控诉考验，并谈妥由你代表我们出战，以此羞辱他们。他们对这其中的暗示暴怒不已，而我们也乐于为己所用。为了氏族的荣耀，向{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}证明，就连我们雇来的雇佣兵都比他们强。ZH

column1: A Taste For War
column2: 嗜战之味

column1: Commander, this seems like a straight up duel. It's based in an established arena so I guess it's as good as we'll get to 'safe'.
column2: 指挥官，这看起来是一场纯粹的决斗。它设在既有的竞技场里，所以我想这已经是我们能接近“安全”的极限了。ZH

column1: A prized {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Gladiator has challenged you to solo combat, Commander. The holovid rights have already been sold to the highest bidder and we've already been wired a cut. We can't turn this chance down so we hope you can't too! We'll throw in the holo-vid footage for {COMPANY.CompanyName}'s promotional vids.
column2: 一位受器重的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}角斗士向你发起单挑挑战，指挥官。全息影像版权已经卖给了出价最高者，我们已经收到了一笔分成。我们不能拒绝这个机会，所以希望你也别拒绝！我们还会把全息影像素材送给{COMPANY.CompanyName}用于宣传片。ZH

column1: I wonder what we did to get this grievance? Was it that stuff I did on Tuesday?
column2: 我想知道我们到底做了什么才招来这场争议? 难道是我星期二干的那件事?

column1: A {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Warrior has issued you a Trial of Grievance through us, Commander. It's a good opportunity to show our Sibkos how mercenaries fight, so we'll pay you if you win. Now, will {COMPANY.CompanyName} be remembered for their glorious fight, or forgotten?
column2: 一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}战士通过我们向你发出了控诉考验，指挥官。这是向我们的同巢展示雇佣兵如何作战的好机会，所以如果你赢了我们就会付钱。那么，{COMPANY.CompanyName}会因光荣的战斗被铭记，还是被遗忘？ZH

column1: Win the Trial of Grievance
column2: 赢得申诉试炼

column1: Challenge Accepted
column2: 接受挑战

column1: No ammo left? What kind of idiot set up their supply lines. Let's clean this duel up and cash in, Commander.
column2: 没弹药了？是哪个白痴安排的补给线。我们把这场决斗收拾干净去换钱吧，指挥官。ZH

column1: Over the past few weeks we've been engaged in small stage skirmishes with {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} in and around {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. The company commander must feel they can't continue their campaign because they've requested a duel to claim this local forward base. Little do they know that we've recently run out of supplies so we've very much taken them up on their offer. This is where you come in. We need you to win this for us, Commander.
column2: 过去几周，我们一直在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}内外与{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}进行小规模前哨战。对方连长想必觉得无法继续他们的战役，因为他们请求以决斗来决定这处当地前沿基地的归属。他们不知道我们最近补给耗尽，所以我们非常乐意接下他们的提议。这就是需要你的地方。我们需要你为我们赢下这场，指挥官。ZH

column1: Destroy Duelist Commander
column2: 摧毁决斗者指挥官

column1: Save the forward base
column2: 拯救前沿基地

column1: I know they said they were going to send a proxy but, a lowly Merc? What a waste of a perfectly good duel.
column2: 我知道他们说要派个代表来，但就派个低贱的雇佣兵? 真是浪费了一场绝佳的决斗.

column1: That's the one, Commander. Take him out.
column2: 就是那个，指挥官。干掉他。ZH

column1: Much less waste when its only two mechs facing off in the field, even less if they pay us to fight for them.
column2: 当战场上只有两台机甲对决时，浪费就少得多了; 如果他们付钱让我们替他们打，那就更少了.

column1: Our battles with {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} in and around {TGT_SYSTEM.name} have been a waste of resources. {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} has issued us a Trial of Possession for this small area of the conflict. It will be a one-on-one battle in a Circle of Equals with you taking our place, ostensibly to save our own resources.
column2: 我们与{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}及其周边的战斗一直是在浪费资源. {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}已向我们发出所有权试炼，以争夺冲突中的这一小片区域. 这将是一场在平等者之环中进行的一对一战斗，由你代表我们出战，表面上是为节省我们自身的资源.

column1: Assert dominance of base
column2: 确立对基地的控制权

column1: Destroy Duelist Warrior
column2: 摧毁决斗者战士

column1: I know they said they were going to send a proxy but, a lowly Dezgra Merc? What a waste of a perfectly good Circle of Equals.
column2: 我知道他们说会派个代表来，但就派个低贱的叛节雇佣兵? 真是浪费了一场完美的平等者之环对决.

column1: That is the warrior, Commander. Take them out.
column2: 那就是那个战士，指挥官. 干掉他们.

column1: We are coming in to pick you up fast, Commander. Hold on. We will sort the fallout from this later.
column2: 我们正在快速赶来接应你，指挥官. 坚持住. 后续的善后事宜我们之后再处理.

column1: Cornered Revenge
column2: 困兽之报

column1: 'Killbox'? Haven't heard that name for a long time. Do you think she's still upset after all these years?
column2: '杀戮区'？这名字很久没听过了。你觉得过了这么多年她还生气吗？ZH

column1: We have a BattleMech causing us trouble in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} who refuses to back down until you, Commander, show up and fight them in a duel. They call themselves Killbox. I don't know what their problem is with you but we'll pay you to get here and just deal with them. It's causing us a headache.
column2: 在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}有一台战斗机甲给我们找麻烦，除非你——指挥官——露面与他们决斗，否则他们拒绝退让。他们自称"杀戮区"。我不知道他们跟你有什么过节，但我们会付钱让你过来，把这事处理掉。这让我们很头疼。ZH

column1: Defeat Killbox
column2: 击败“杀戮箱”ZH

column1: Defeat the Killbox
column2: 击败“杀戮箱”ZH

column1: Last time we saw Killbox she was stuck on that moon, Commander. Not sure how they got off it. Guess it doesn't matter now. Good luck!
column2: 上次我们见到杀戮区时，他们被困在那颗卫星上，指挥官。不知道他们是怎么脱身的。我想现在也无所谓了。祝好运！ZH

column1: Sounds like someone you may have run into before Commander. I wonder, do they write the name in blood on themselves? We should ask before the battle starts.
column2: 听起来像是你以前可能遇到过的人，指挥官. 我很好奇，他们会在自己身上用血写下名字吗? 我们应该在战斗开始前问问.

column1: There is a Warrior in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} who refuses to back down until you, Commander, show up and fight them in a Circle of Equals. As they are Bloodnamed, we feel that you cannot brush them off as easily as some drunk in a bar. It would bring great honor to our Clan if you would arrive and show them your might.
column2: 在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}有一位战士，除非你，指挥官，亲自到场在平等者之环中与之战斗，否则绝不退让. 由于他们拥有血脉名号，我们认为你无法像打发酒吧里的醉汉那样轻易敷衍过去. 如果你能到场并向他们展示你的实力，将为我们氏族带来巨大的荣誉.

column1: Defeat the Bloodnamed Warrior
column2: 击败那名拥有血脉名号的战士

column1: Defeat Warrior
column2: 击败那名战士

column1: Good work commander. Maybe that taught them a lesson
column2: 干得好，指挥官. 也许这给他们上了一课.

column1: Oh I remember this guy now, we completely humiliated them!
column2: 哦，我现在想起这家伙了，我们当时让他丢尽了脸!

column1: Well he got his revenge, and we proved that we are only the Dezgra mercenaries he though we were.
column2: 好吧，他报了仇，而我们也证明了自己不过是他所认为的那种叛节雇佣.

column1: Life Lesson
column2: 人生教训

column1: I have to hand it to this guy. At least he cares enough about his son to teach him a thing or two. Even if that means a knock on the head... or two.
column2: 我不得不佩服这家伙. 至少他对儿子上心到愿意教他点东西. 哪怕这意味着要吃一记……或者几记当头棒喝.

column1: A rich {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} business man has requested that we show his arrogant step-son what real fighting feels like. We thought {COMPANY.CompanyName} could help us here. Don't hold back. This father wants to teach a real life lesson - especially for his {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} side of the family.
column2: 一位富有的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}商人请求我们让他那傲慢的继子见识一下真正的战斗是什么滋味。我们认为{COMPANY.CompanyName}能帮上这个忙。不必留手。这位父亲想教一堂真实的人生课——尤其是给他{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}那一系的亲戚看。ZH

column1: Teach a life lesson
column2: 教一堂人生课

column1: There he is, Commander.
column2: 他在那儿，指挥官。ZH

column1: Some training work sounds nice about now. It's someone still learning, so how hard can it be?
column2: 现在来点训练工作听起来不错。对方还在学习，能有多难？ZH

column1: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} has requested we field test a new pilot from their Alpha Sibko. {COMPANY.CompanyName} has been a valuable ally and we would like our new generation to pick up some skills. Don't hold back, the pilot is going to be putting everything they learned into this fight. The Clan wants to teach some real life lessons to them, and their Sibko.
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}请求我们实战测试一名来自阿尔法育婴所的新机师。{COMPANY.CompanyName}一直是宝贵的盟友，我们希望我们新一代能学到些本领。别留手，这名机师会把学到的一切都投入这场战斗。部族想给他们和他们的育婴所上一堂现实课。ZH

column1: Proxy War
column2: 代理战

column1: 'Don't want to risk anything here?' I think they forget that we're putting our necks on the line. I suppose if the pay is good that's what we do.
column2: 不想在这儿冒任何风险？我想他们忘了我们是在拿命冒险。我想只要报酬够好，这就是我们要做的事。ZH

column1: The Governor of {TGT_SYSTEM.name} has been challenged to a proxy war duel by a rival {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Governor. We'd like you to be his proxy in this fight. If you lose, we'll just deny it was ever agreed to. We don't want to actually risk anything here.
column2: {TGT_SYSTEM.name}的总督被一位对立的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}总督挑战进行代理战争决斗。我们希望你去当他在这一战中的代理人。如果你输了，我们就干脆否认曾经同意过。我们并不想在这里真正冒任何风险。ZH

column1: Defeat the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} duelist
column2: 击败{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的决斗者

column1: At least we're keeping casualties down to a minimum here. Good luck, Commander.
column2: 至少我们把这里的伤亡控制到了最低。祝好运，指挥官。ZH

column1: Solving the lack of available experienced units by hiring the best? Well, they at least know who to turn to!
column2: 通过雇佣最优秀的人才来解决缺少有经验部队的问题? 好吧，他们至少知道该找谁!

column1: {TGT_SYSTEM.name} has been challenged to a Trial of Possession by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}. We would like you to represent us in this Trial, as all our troops are involved elsewhere. If you lose, we will just deny it was ever agreed to, or that you weren't representing us.
column2: {TGT_SYSTEM.name}已被{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}挑战进行占有试炼。我们希望由你代表我们参加这场试炼，因为我们所有部队都在别处。如果你输了，我们就干脆否认曾经同意过，或者否认你代表我们。ZH

column1: Defeat the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Warrior
column2: 击败{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的战士

column1: At least we are keeping casualties down to a minimum here. Good luck, Commander.
column2: 至少我们在这里能把伤亡降到最低. 祝你好运，指挥官.

column1: Job done and we have given the Clan a chance to resupply. Time to get some rest, Commander.
column2: 任务完成，我们也给了氏族一个补充物资的机会. 该休息了，指挥官.

column1: Well, they did say they would not acknowledge a loss. Let us see how that works out. Let us get you back to the dropship, Commander.
column2: 他们确实说过不会承认失败. 那就让我们看看最终会是什么结果吧. 我们先送你回空投艇，指挥官.

column1: Failure to preserve both facilities will be recorded as a failed contract regardless of enemy losses.
column2: 未能保住两处设施将被记录为合约失败，无论敌方损失如何。ZH

column1: A soon-to-be-operational planetary sensor array and a missile defense battery will form the backbone of {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} regional defense operations.  The two facilities are linked through a common targeting network, and the destruction of either asset will compromise the effectiveness of the entire system, once operational.   {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} units are expected to probe defenses before committing heavier assault forces against whichever site appears weakest.  The governor's office has declared both installations mission-critical.
column2: 一套即将投入运作的行星传感器阵列和一座导弹防御炮组将构成{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}区域防御行动的骨干。两处设施通过一张共同的瞄准网络相连，一旦投入运作，摧毁任一资产都会削弱整个系统的效能。预计{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}部队会先试探防御，然后对看起来较薄弱的那处设施投入更重的突击部队。总督府已宣布两处设施均为任务关键。ZH

column1: Defend Sensor Array and Missile Defense Battery
column2: 保卫传感器阵列与导弹防御炮组

column1: <color=#99ebff>{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Government} Regional Defense Liason:</color> {COMPANY.CompanyName}, this is Firebreak Control.  Although still no operational, the sensor array and the missile defense battery are linked to the regional defense grid...if either facility is destroyed, the entire network becomes ineffective.   Both sites must survive.
column2: <color=#99ebff>{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Government}区域防御联络官：</color>{COMPANY.CompanyName}，这里是防火墙控制中心。虽然尚未投入运行，但传感器阵列与导弹防御炮组都已接入区域防御网……若其中任何一处设施被毁，整个网络都会失效。两处站点都必须存活。ZH

column1: Drive a Wedge, Secondary Line, Attacking the Hammer, Strenghtening Anvil Response are classic military tactics to break this kind of engagement; choose or adapt what you require, Commander.
column2: 楔入突击、二线部署、攻击铁砧、加固应对是打破这类交战的经典军事战术；指挥官，按需选择或调整吧。ZH

column1: An ordnance plant and its associated munitions depot have come under threat from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} forces seeking to cripple local {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} military production.  While each facility can function independently, the loss of either would halt wartime manufacturing efforts across the region.   {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Government} intelligence suggests coordinated attacks intended to split defending forces between the two objectives.  Your company must maintain defensive control over both locations simultaneously throughout the operation.
column2: 一处军械厂及其附属弹药库正受到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}部队的威胁，后者意图瘫痪当地{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的军工生产。虽然两处设施都能独立运作，但失去任何一处都会使整个地区的战时制造陷入停顿。{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Government}情报显示，敌方意图协调进攻，把守军分散在两个目标之间。你的连队必须在整个行动期间同时保持对两处地点的防御控制。ZH

column1: Defend Ordnance plant and Munitions Depot
column2: 保卫军械厂与弹药库

column1: Commander, there are two critical facilities under threat: the ordnance plant and the munitions depot.  Our employers reports that the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}s intend to strike both simultaneously.
column2: 指挥官，有两处关键设施正受到威胁：军械厂和弹药库。我们的雇主报告说，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}人打算同时打击这两处。ZH

column1: Defending two assets at the same time, fun times.
column2: 同时防守两处资产，真有意思。ZH

column1: Two cargo terminals are being operated by the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Government} in the system.  Cargo operations have been divided between both terminals, if either terminal is destroyed, precious supply and logisticical assets would be lost.  {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} raiders are exepcted to launch repeated attacks intended to disable loading infrastructure and fuel depots.   Both facilities must reamin operational until reinforcements arrive.
column2: 该星系有两个货运终端由{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Government}运营。货运作业分散在两个终端，若任一终端被摧毁，宝贵的补给与后勤资产都将丧失。预计{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}劫掠者会反复发动袭击，意图瘫痪装卸基础设施与燃料库。两处设施在援军抵达前都必须保持运作。ZH

column1: Defend Both Cargo Terminals from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} raiders
column2: 抵御{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}劫掠者，保卫两个货运终端

column1: Commander, the cargo terminals, designated as Alpha and Bravo, are currently handling critical supply shipments for the front.  If either terminal falls, the entire logistics chain for this sector is compromised.
column2: 指挥官，那两个被指定为阿尔法和布拉沃的货运终端目前正处理前线的关键补给运输。若任一终端失守，整个区域的物流链都将受损。ZH

column1: The destruction of either plant would trigger a humanitarian crisis affecting thousands of civilians.  No pressure, Commander.
column2: 摧毁任一座工厂都会引发一场影响数千平民的人道主义危机。别紧张，指挥官。ZH

column1: Two water purification plants supply separate population centers and are considered vital to planetary stability.  {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} intelligence indicates {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} raiders intends to overwhelm both facilities, forcing defenders to spread thin.   Your contract is explicit: both facilities must remain operational until relief forces arrive.
column2: 两座净水厂为不同的人口中心供水，被视为行星稳定的关键。{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}情报显示{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}劫掠者意图压垮两处设施，迫使守军分散。你的合约说得很明确：两处设施必须在援军抵达前保持运作。ZH

column1: Defend Water Purification Plant from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} raiders
column2: 抵御{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}劫掠者，保卫净水厂

column1: Commander, both facilities are critical.  We need to keep Alpha and Bravo operational until relief forces arrive.  Lose either plant and the mission is a failure.   Expect multiple attack waves and stay flexible.
column2: 指挥官，两处设施都至关重要。我们需要让阿尔法与布拉沃保持运转，直到救援部队抵达。失去任何一处，任务即告失败。预期会有多波攻击，保持灵活。ZH

column1: If either relay station is rendered inoperable, mission will be considered as a failure.
column2: 若任一继电站失效，任务将被视为失败。ZH

column1: Your company is tasked with protecting two communications relay support stations.  These installations form a single communications network; if either station is destroyed, the entire regional communications grid will collapse.   {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are expected to sabotage teams and strike exploiting weak points of the defenses.   {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} has designated both sites as irreplaceable strategic assets.The contract will be considered failed if either relay station is rendered inoperable.
column2: 你的连队受命保护两处通讯中继支援站。这些设施构成一张单一通讯网络；若任一站点被摧毁，整个地区通讯网都将崩溃。预计{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队会派出破坏小组，并打击防御的弱点。{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}已指定两处站点为不可替代的战略资产。若任一继电站失效，合约将被视为失败。ZH

column1: Defend Communications Relay Support Stations from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} strikers
column2: 抵御{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}突击部队，保卫通讯中继支援站

column1: <color=#99ebff>{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Government} Relay Control Officer:</color> {COMPANY.CompanyName}, this is Relay Control.  You are defending two communications relay support stations on named Alpha and Bravo.   These facilities function as a single network --- lose one, and the entire communications grid goes dark.
column2: <color=#99ebff>{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Government}中继控制官：</color>{COMPANY.CompanyName}，这里是中继控制。你要防守分别名为阿尔法与布拉沃的两座通讯中继支持站。这两处设施作为单一网络运作——失去其一，整个通讯网格就会陷入黑暗。ZH

column1: The contract is void if either station falls to enemy action.
column2: 如果任一发电站被敌方攻陷，合约即告无效.

column1: Two power stations provide the energy required to sustain a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} civilian complex.  {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} forces have launched a campaign to seize or destroy the installations, knowing the loss of either station would destabilize the entire power grid.   Your orders are straightforward: both power stations must survive the engagement intact.
column2: 两座电站为一处{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}民用建筑群提供所需能源。{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}部队已发起战役，要夺取或摧毁这些设施——他们知道失去任一座电站都会让整个电网失稳。你的命令很直接：两座电站在交战中都必须完好存活。ZH

column2: 防守两座发电站

column2: 两座发电站，代号Alpha和Bravo，正在为整个民用区供电. 情报显示多支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}打击部队正在进入该区域.

column2: 警告! Alpha发电站已失去所有防御炮台. 你的连队是阻挡敌人摧毁那座反应堆的最后一道防线.

column1: It's hard for me to overstate what a terrible idea it is to go into a mission with no terrain intel. There could be anything down there.
column2: 没有地形情报就出任务有多糟糕，我怎么强调都不过分。下面可能什么都有。ZH

column1: Commander, we need an immediate deployment.  We've been in pursuit of a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} terrorist for months, and we've finally tracked them to this planet.  They've gone to ground but earlier today one of our orbital units spotted them moving on the surface.  This is the first verified sighting we've had of the target, and we want you to bring them down immediately, before they're able to slip away again.  There hasn't been time to do a full survey of the AO, so you'll be going in blind.
column2: 指挥官，我们需要立即部署。我们追缉一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}恐怖分子已有数月，终于追踪到这颗行星。他们已转入地下，但今天早些时候我们一个轨道单位发现他们在地表活动。这是我们首次确认目击目标，我们希望你能立即将其拿下，别让他们再次溜走。时间不够对行动区域做完整勘测，所以你会盲飞进去。ZH

column2: 消灭{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}恐怖分子

column2: 消灭游荡敌军

column1: The target might make a break for it once you engage, Commander. Be ready to intercept if they run.
column2: 一旦你开始交战，目标可能会突围. 要是他们要跑，就准备拦截他们.

column1: This is the place, Commander. Meyer, can you see the target anywhere? We're blind on the ground.
column2: 就是这里，指挥官。迈耶，你能看到目标吗？我们在地面上没有视野。ZH

column1: We've failed...
column2: 我们失败了……

column1: Insurgent Leader
column2: 叛乱领袖

column1: We've only got their word that this target is a terrorist, but that sort of extralegal maneuvering is why they're hiring us instead of using their own forces. Still, best to be alert for anything.
column2: 目标是不是恐怖分子只有他们说了算，但正是这种法外操作才让他们雇我们而不是动用自己的部队。尽管如此，最好还是对任何事保持警觉。ZH

column1: We've had confirmation from several sources that the leader of an insurgent cell backed by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} is moving in the open. This is a rare opportunity to take out one of the primary enemies of the legitimate {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} regime in {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Additionally, we'll include a bonus payment if you're able to destroy all of the target's escorting units.
column2: 我们已从多个渠道得到确认，由{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}支持的叛乱小组头目正在公开活动。这是铲除{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的合法{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}政权的主要敌人之一的难得机会。此外，如果你能摧毁目标的全部护卫单位，我们还会有额外奖金。ZH

column2: 摧毁敌方增援

column2: 摧毁叛乱分子护卫队

column2: 摧毁目标单位

column1: Move up to get eyes on the target and any escort he might have.
column2: 行动起来瞧瞧目标以及他可能拥有的护卫.

column1: Once he's down, head to the evac point for your pickup.
column2: 他一倒下，就前往撤离点等待接运。ZH

column1: These are the coordinates that {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} provided, so the insurgent leader should be in the area.
column2: 这些是{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}人提供的坐标，所以叛军首领应该就在这一地区.

column1: Insurrection Interception
column2: 叛乱拦截

column1: I've negotiated a major bump if we DO end up finding the propagandist and eliminating her, as well as a danger-pay bonus if she has any escorts and we eliminate them as well.
column2: 如果真能找到那名宣传员并除掉她，我已经谈妥了一笔可观的加价；如果她有护卫，而我们也一并清除，还有危险津贴奖金。ZH

column1: For months, we've had trouble with people here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} being riled up by talk of insurrection, rebellion, independence.  Based on top {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} analysts' reports, we believe there's a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} propagandist in the area, stirring up discontent.  We've set up a security net to capture her.  But we can't cover every possible exit from our net and could use an extra Lance of 'Mechs.  If she tries to slip through your assigned territory, turn her unit to slag.
column2: 数月来，{TGT_SYSTEM.name}这里的人一直被叛乱、起义、独立的言论煽动，令我们头疼。根据{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}顶尖分析师们的报告，我们相信这一带有一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}宣传员在煽动不满情绪。我们已布下一张安全网来抓她。但我们无法覆盖网中每一个可能的出口，所以需要一支额外的机甲分队。如果她试图从你的辖区溜过，就把她的单位熔成矿渣。ZH

column2: 消灭宣传员并摆脱敌人

column1: Commander, this is the region we've been asked to patrol as part of the net.

column2: 中层管理者

column1: Sounds like we'll be hitting a middle manager.  The target won't be alone, Commander, and there's a bonus if we clean up the escorting units as well.  Still, if things get too hot, we can always hit and run.
column2: 听起来我们要去干掉一名中层管理者。目标不会独自一人，指挥官，如果我们把护卫单位也清理掉另有奖金。不过如果局面太热，我们随时可以打了就跑。ZH

column1: Our intelligence operatives believe that a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} leader is present and vulnerable on the surface of {TGT_SYSTEM.name}.  Eliminating them will leave their organization in shambles and clear the field for {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} operations.  The target will be relatively unguarded, and we'd like you to strike during this window of opportunity.
column2: 我们的情报人员相信，一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}领袖正在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}地表上且防备薄弱。除掉他们将使他们的组织陷入混乱，为{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}行动清出场地。目标身旁不会有太多护卫，我们希望你在这一时机窗口内发动打击。ZH

column1: Commander, our intel was right; the target is in the AO and only lightly guarded.
column2: 指挥官，我们的情报是对的; 目标就在行动区域而且只有少量护卫.

column1: Take them out, get to the evac zone, and then we get paid.
column2: 干掉他们，到达撤离区域，之后我们就可以拿到报酬了.

column1: We've had confirmation from several sources that a high ranking {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} officer is moving in the open.  This is a rare opportunity to disrupt their command structure on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}.  We'll pay a 33% bonus per lance if you can also destroy his personal guard and any other {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces in the AO.
column2: 我们已从多个来源确认，一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}高级军官正在公开行动。这是在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上打乱他们指挥结构的难得机会。如果你还能摧毁他的私人卫队以及行动区域内其他{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队，我们将按每支分队额外支付33%的奖金。ZH

column2: 自行决定是否交战，指挥官.

column1: Buckle up, Commander.  This sounds like an extremely tough fight.  You know something this valuable is going to be escorted.
column2: 做好准备，指挥官. 听起来这像是一场极其艰苦的战斗. 你知道有些珍贵的东西要护送.

column1: We periodically survey 'empty' worlds just to be certain there's no unexpected activity on them.  This time, we got lucky. A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} surveillance team picked up {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} signals from the surface of {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} that correspond to a very heavy 'Mech running through a test-fire sequence.  We suspect the enemy is taking the 'Mech out for proving trials, figuring the planet is uninhabited.  If we can locate and intercept this 'Mech, we can keep a powerful piece of hardware out of enemy hands.
column2: 我们定期勘察"空"行星，只为确认上面没有意外活动。这次我们运气不错。一支{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}监视小队从{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}表面接收到了{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}信号，对应一台正在跑试射流程的极重型机甲。我们怀疑敌人是把这台机甲带出来做验证试验，以为该行星无人居住。如果我们能定位并拦截这台机甲，就能让一件强力硬件不落入敌手。ZH

column1: Someone's in serious trouble --- and they need our help now.
column2: 有人惹上大麻烦了——而他们现在就需要我们的帮助。ZH

column2: {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}爆发了激烈战斗，若不立即支援，我们的防线撑不住。我们正在签约任何能立刻派兵落地的人。< 战区可能极其漫长，请为持久战斗做好准备！

column1: Even though we've had some wins in other parts of the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} region, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}'s stepping up their game. Right now, several units have arrived at {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}, and it's looking like it might fall into their hands. Your job is to back up the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}'s lance and hold the line for as long as you can. Reinforcements are on the way, but we need to buy some time. Warzones can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat!
column2: 尽管我们在{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}区域的其他地方取得了一些胜利，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}正在加大力度。眼下，若干单位已抵达{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}，看来它可能会落入他们手中。你的任务是支援{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}的分队，尽可能久地守住阵地。增援正在赶来，但我们需要争取一些时间。< 战区可能极其漫长，请为持久战斗做好准备！

column2: 让1个单位抵达集结点

column1: Hold the line until reinforcements arrive
column2: 坚守阵地直至增援抵达

column1: Ally reinforcements are arriving any moment.  Let them deal with the stragglers.
column2: 友军增援随时抵达. 让他们去对付残兵吧.

column1: This is the fabled 'bug swarm', Commander, come prepared for an endurance battle.
column2: 这就是传说中的"虫群"，指挥官，做好打持久战的准备。ZH

column1: There is an old Kuritan theory of warfare that says that numbers matter more than skill. Our enemies here in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} have decided to put that theory to the test and have lined up a swarm of BattleMechs to attack us. We need a few elite pilots to hold off the swarm as best we can. We'll send you what help we can manage. Prove the theory wrong and be on the right side of history, Commander. Warzones can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat!
column2: 库瑞塔人有一套古老的战争理论：数量比技巧更重要。我们在 {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} 的敌人决定检验这套理论，已排出一大群战斗机甲向我们发起进攻。我们需要几位精英机师尽量抵挡这股洪流。我们会尽可能为你提供支援。指挥官，用事实证明这套理论是错的，站到历史正确的一边。战区战斗可能极为漫长，请做好持久作战的准备！

column1: We took down the swarm, well done Commander.
column2: 我们解决了那群蜂拥之敌，干得好指挥官。ZH

column1: This is a straight-up brawl and we're on our own for this one. Stay frosty, Commander.
column2: 这是一场纯粹的白刃战，这一仗只能靠我们自己。保持冷静，指挥官。ZH

column1: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} have been pushing into this region, so there are big bounties out on them. Take out as many as you can --- the more you drop, the bigger your payout. Warzones can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat!
column2: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}一直在推进这一地区，所以对他们开出的赏金很高。尽可能多干掉一些——你打掉的越多，拿到的钱越多。< 战区可能极其漫长，请为持久战斗做好准备！

column1: Get to the Evac Zone
column2: 前往撤离区

column1: No backup is coming.  Employ all necessary measures to achieve the objectives: neutralize hostiles.
column2: 没有援军会来. 采取一切必要措施达成目标: 消灭敌对单位.

column1: Being paid to get chased and shot at? Not ideal.  Fingers crossed for some extra bonuses
column2: 被雇来让别人追着打还要挨枪子? 这可不算理想. 希望能拿到一些额外奖金吧.

column1: Commander, a battalion sporting {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}'s colors are operating covertly in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. Your mission: draw their focus, hold them in place while we close their escape. Disrupt, disable, and buy us time --- extraction to follow. We will send an allied force to support your evac as soon as you draw enough enemy attention. Warzones can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat!
column2: 指挥官，一个打着{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}旗帜的营正在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}秘密活动。你的任务：吸引他们的注意力，把他们钉在原地，而我们封住他们的退路。扰乱、瘫痪、为我们争取时间——随后撤离。一旦你吸引到足够的敌军注意，我们会派一支友军来支援你的撤离。< 战区可能极其漫长，请为持久战斗做好准备！

column1: The employer is fumbling the deployment of their vanguard units.  Hold the line --- whether they show up or not.
column2: 雇主把他们前卫单位的部署搞砸了。守住防线——不管他们到底来不来。ZH

column1: Front lines, Commander --- and there's serious cash on the table for taking these guys down.  Just remember: don't get dead before you collect.
column2: 前线，指挥官——而且干掉这些人有一大笔现金。记住：别在收钱之前死掉。ZH

column1: {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} is under attack --- invaders are here to take everything. The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are holding but starting to break. We need every able hand on the frontline now. Any help you can offer will mean the world to us. Warzones can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat!
column2: {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}正在遭到攻击——入侵者来此夺走一切。{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}部队仍在坚守，但已开始崩溃。我们现在需要所有能动的人上前线。你能提供的任何帮助对我们都意义重大。战区可能极为漫长，请为持久战斗做好准备！

column1: Neutralize hostiles
column2: 消灭敌对单位

column1: Allies have communicated the rally point, they need you to be there to confirm extraction.
column2: 友军已传达集结点位置，他们需要你到达那里以确认撤离.

column1: Done and done, Commander.  Let's head on out.
column2: 办妥了，指挥官。我们出发吧。ZH

column1: Hopefully we'll not be surprised as our employers.
column2: 但愿我们不会像我们的雇主一样被打个措手不及。ZH

column1: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}'s area in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} just got hit with a surprise attack, and right now, the only thing standing in the way is a single lance. Our main forces are too far out to help in time, so we're calling on anyone willing to step up and lend a hand. Warzones can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat!
column2: {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}中{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的区域刚遭到突袭，而眼下挡在路上的只有一支分队。我们的主力部队太远，来不及救援，所以我们在号召任何愿意挺身相助的人。< 战区可能极其漫长，请为持久战斗做好准备！

column2: 等待主力援军抵达

column1: Reinforcements would mop up any remaining enemy forces.  Excellent work them holding off.
column2: 援军会扫荡任何残余的敌军. 你们坚持住了，干得漂亮.

column1: You were born and raised in the Federation. MechWarriors who hail from the Federated Suns tend to possess more finely honed skills and better equipment than their counterparts from other regions of space. They often see themselves as righteous warriors and champions of liberty - sometimes to a fault.
column2: 你出生并成长于联邦。来自联邦太阳国的机甲战士往往比太空其他地区的同行拥有更精炼的技能与更好的装备。他们常把自己视为正义的战士与自由的捍卫者——有时甚至过头。ZH

column1: You were born and raised in the [[DM.Factions[faction_Davion],Federated Suns]].
column2: 你出生并成长于[[DM.Factions[faction_Davion],联邦太阳]]。ZH

column1: MechWarriors who hail from the [[DM.Factions[faction_Davion],Federated Suns]] tend to possess more finely honed skills and better equipment than their counterparts from other regions of space. They often see themselves as righteous warriors and champions of liberty - sometimes to a fault.    Though nearly extinguished by the [[DM.Factions[faction_Kurita],Draconis Combine]] in the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreFirstSuccessionWar],First Succession War]], the Federated Suns - a constitutional monarchy ruled by the renowned [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseDavion],House Davion]] - has become arguably the most powerful of the five great [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSuccessorState],Successor States]]. Through skillful military campaigns and subtle diplomacy, House Davion has significantly increased the number of star systems under its control in the last two centuries.
column2: 出身于[[DM.Factions[faction_Davion],联邦太阳]]的机师往往比太空中其他区域的同行拥有更精湛的技能和更好的装备。他们常把自己视为正义的战士与自由的捍卫者——有时过于如此。尽管在[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreFirstSuccessionWar],第一次继承战争]]中几乎被[[DM.Factions[faction_Kurita],龙尼斯联合体]]灭国，这个由著名的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseDavion],达维昂家族]]统治的君主立宪国如今可以说是五大[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSuccessorState],继承国]]中最强大的。凭借高超的军事行动与巧妙的外交，达维昂家族在过去两个世纪里大幅增加了其控制的星系数量。ZH

column1: The Federated Suns (Davion)
column2: 恒星联邦（戴维恩）ZH

column1: You were born and raised in the Deep Periphery. MechWarriors that hail from the Deep Periphery are rare, but even rarer is the MechWarrior who will admit to such an origin. Beyond the outermost edges of the Periphery lie depths of space that remain uncharted and unknown to most of human civilization, littered with abandoned colonies and small outposts.
column2: 你出生并成长于深远外缘。来自深远外缘的机师很罕见，但更罕见的是愿意承认这种出身的机师。在外缘最外侧的边缘之外，是大部人类文明都未曾测绘、未知的深空，散落着被废弃的殖民地和小型前哨。ZH

column1: You were born and raised in the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDeepPeriphery],Deep Periphery]].
column2: 你出生并成长于[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDeepPeriphery],深远外缘]]。ZH

column1: MechWarriors that hail from the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDeepPeriphery],Deep Periphery]] are rare, but even rarer is the MechWarrior who will admit to such an origin.     Beyond the outermost edges of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRimwardPeriphery],Periphery]] lie depths of space that remain uncharted and unknown to most of human civilization. Little is known about these regions, but they are far from uninhabited. The Deep Periphery is littered with abandoned colonies and small outposts, isolated from the rest of humanity. After the fall of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreStarLeague],Star League]], General [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKerensky],Aleksandr Kerensky]] led the remnants of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSLDF],Star League Defense Force]] into the Deep Periphery, disappearing from the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere],Inner Sphere]] and from recorded history.
column2: 来自[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDeepPeriphery],深远外缘]]的机师很罕见，但更罕见的是愿意承认这种出身的机师。在[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRimwardPeriphery],外缘]]最外侧的边缘之外，是大部人类文明都未曾测绘、未知的深空。人们对这些区域知之甚少，但它们远非无人居住。深远外缘散落着与人类其余部分隔绝的废弃殖民地与小前哨。在[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreStarLeague],星盟]]覆灭之后，[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKerensky],亚历山大·克伦斯基]]将军率领[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSLDF],星盟防卫部队]]的残部进入深远外缘，从此从[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere],内天体]]和成文史中消失。ZH

column1: The Deep Periphery
column2: 深空外围

column1: Born by natural means within the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreClans],Clans]], your status has always been second class. However, this has done nothing to curb your ambition to become more than just a footnote in the known universe, let alone just the Clans.
column2: 你以自然方式生于[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreClans],氏族]]之中，身份一直是二等。然而这丝毫没有遏制你的野心——你要成为远比已知宇宙中一个脚注更重要的人物，更不用说只在氏族之内了。ZH

column1: You were born a [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreFreeborn],freeborn]] [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreClans],Clan]] member.
column2: 你生为[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreClans],氏族]]的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreFreeborn],自由出生者]]成员。ZH

column1: Clan Space (Freeborn)
column2: 氏族领地(自由生者)

column1: You were born and raised in the Free Rasalhague Republic. MechWarriors who hail from the short-lived Republic are fiercely independent, and often find themselves at odds with others. Despite frequent arguments and disagreements, they are invaluable lancemates.
column2: 你出生并成长于自由拉萨尔哈格共和国。出身于这个短命共和国的机师极为独立，常与他人发生分歧。尽管时常争论与不合，他们却是无可替代的分队队友。ZH

column1: You were born and raised in the [[DM.Factions[faction_Rasalhague],Free Rasalhague Republic]].
column2: 你出生并成长于[[DM.Factions[faction_Rasalhague],自由拉沙尔哈格共和国]]。ZH

column1: The Free Rasalhague Republic
column2: 自由蛇夫座共和国

column1: You were born and raised in the Draconis Combine. MechWarriors who hail from the Combine tend to be fierce, disciplined, and relentless fighters. Over centuries of rule, House Kurita has united the Combine into a single culture, heavily molded around medieval Japanese society.
column2: 你出生并成长于龙尼斯联合体。出身于联合体的机师往往是凶猛、自律、不屈不挠的战士。在数百年的统治中，栗田家族把联合体统一为单一文化，深受中世纪日本社会塑造。ZH

column1: You were born and raised in the [[DM.Factions[faction_Kurita],Draconis Combine]].
column2: 你出生并成长于[[DM.Factions[faction_Kurita],龙尼斯联合体]]。ZH

column1: MechWarriors who hail from the [[DM.Factions[faction_Kurita],Combine]] tend to be fierce, disciplined, and relentless fighters, no matter the odds they might face on the battlefield.    Although the Draconis Combine is as ethnically diverse as any of the vast interstellar empires, it is also one of the most culturally homogenous. Over centuries of rule, the founding [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseKurita],House Kurita]] has succeeded in uniting the people of the Combine into a single culture, one heavily molded around medieval Japanese society. While some, most notably the descendants of the conquered [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRaselhague],Principality of Rasalhague]], continue to chafe at the uniformity of Draconis society, overall this has created a more cohesive populace and military than seen in the other Great Houses of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere],Inner Sphere]].
column2: 出身于[[DM.Factions[faction_Kurita],联合体]]的机师往往是凶猛、自律、不屈不挠的战士，无论战场上面对何种劣势。尽管龙尼斯联合体与任何庞大的星际帝国一样族群多元，它也是最文化统一的政权之一。在数百年的统治中，开国的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseKurita],栗田家族]]成功将联合体的人民融合为单一文化，一种深受中世纪日本社会塑造的文化。虽然有些人——尤其显著的是被征服的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRaselhague],拉萨尔哈格公国]]后裔——仍对龙尼斯社会的单一性感到不满，但总体而言，这造就了比[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere],内天体]]其他大贵族家族更具凝聚力的民众与军队。ZH

column1: The Draconis Combine (Kurita)
column2: 天龙联合体（栗田）ZH

column1: You were born and raised in the Capellan Confederation. MechWarriors who hail from the Capellan Confederation are dedicated and steadfast combatants, capable of holding the line and often surprising those opponents who would make the mistake of underestimating them. Most Capellans take great pride in their citizenship, which must be earned through service to the state.
column2: 你出生并成长于卡佩兰联邦。来自卡佩兰联邦的机甲战士是忠诚坚定的战士，能守住阵线，常让那些犯下低估他们这一错误的对手大吃一惊。大多数卡佩兰人极为自豪于自己的公民身份——这必须通过为国服务来赢得。ZH

column1: You were born and raised in the [[DM.Factions[faction_Liao],Capellan Confederation]].
column2: 你出生并成长于[[DM.Factions[faction_Liao],卡佩兰联邦]]。ZH

column1: MechWarriors who hail from the [[DM.Factions[faction_Liao],Capellan Confederation]] are dedicated and steadfast combatants, capable of holding the line and often surprising those opponents who would make the mistake of underestimating them.    The Capellan Confederation has suffered the most at the hands of the other [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSuccessorState],Successor States]] over the last two centuries of war, having lost nearly half of the territory it once controlled at the height of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreStarLeague],Star League]]'s rule. Over time, the leadership of [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseLiao],House Liao]] has transformed the Capellan Confederation into a socialist police state with a highly regulated economy. Most Capellans take great pride in their citizenship, which must be earned through service to the state.
column2: 出身于[[DM.Factions[faction_Liao],卡佩兰联邦]]的机师是坚毅而忠诚的战斗者，能守住阵线，常常让那些错误低估他们的对手大吃一惊。在过去两个世纪的战争中，卡佩兰联邦在其他[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSuccessorState],继承国]]手中吃的苦头最多，失去了它曾在[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreStarLeague],星盟]]统治鼎盛期控制过的近一半领土。随着时间推移，[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseLiao],廖家族]]的领导层把卡佩兰联邦改造成一个经济高度管制的社会主义警察国家。大多数卡佩兰人为自己的公民身份深感自豪，而这必须通过对国家的服务来赢得。ZH

column1: The Capellan Confederation (Liao)
column2: 卡佩拉联邦（廖氏）ZH

column1: You were born and raised in the Magistracy of Canopus. MechWarriors who hail from the Magistracy of Canopus often favor clever and unorthodox tactics on the field. The Magistracy supports an open society that ensures the personal liberty of all citizens and their right to live their lives as they see fit.
column2: 你出生并成长于卡诺帕治安官辖区。出身于卡诺帕治安官辖区的机师往往偏爱战场上巧妙而非正统的战术。辖区支持一个开放社会，保障所有公民的个人自由及其按自己意愿生活的权利。ZH

column1: You were born and raised in the [[DM.Factions[faction_MagistracyOfCanopus],Magistracy of Canopus]].
column2: 你出生并成长于[[DM.Factions[faction_MagistracyOfCanopus],卡诺帕治安官辖区]]。ZH

column1: MechWarriors who hail from the [[DM.Factions[faction_MagistracyOfCanopus],Magistracy of Canopus]] can run the gamut of skill and fighting styles, but they often favor clever and unorthodox tactics on the field.    While smaller than the great [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSuccessorState],Successor States]] of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere],Inner Sphere]], the Magistracy of Canopus is one of the major powers of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRimwardPeriphery],Rimward Periphery]]. The Magistracy is a matriarchal society led by a Magestrix. This is an elected position open to any woman but largely controlled by [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseCentrella],House Centrella]] due to the family's popularity. The Magistracy supports an open society that ensures the personal liberty of all citizens and their right to live their lives as they see fit.
column2: 出身于[[DM.Factions[faction_MagistracyOfCanopus],卡诺帕治安官辖区]]的机师在技能与战斗风格上跨度极大，但他们往往偏爱战场上巧妙而非正统的战术。虽然比[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere],内天体]]的各大[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSuccessorState],继承国]]更小，卡诺帕治安官辖区是[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRimwardPeriphery],外缘星区]]的主要势力之一。辖区是一个由女执政官领导的母系社会。这是一个任何女性都可参选的选举职位，但由于家族的声望，实际上大多由[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseCentrella],森特雷拉家族]]掌控。辖区支持一个开放社会，保障所有公民的个人自由及其按自己意愿生活的权利。ZH

column1: The Magistracy of Canopus
column2: 卡诺普斯法域

column1: You were born and raised in the Free Worlds League. MechWarriors who hail from the Free Worlds League tend to be passionate, enduring fighters who value justice and equality above all else. The cultural diversity and independence of the Free Worlds League is at once the greatest strength of the Free Worlds League, and its greatest weaknesses.
column2: 你出生并成长于自由世界联盟。出身于自由世界联盟的机师往往热忱而坚韧，把正义与平等看得高于一切。自由世界联盟的文化多样性与独立性既是它最大的优势，也是它最大的弱点。ZH

column1: You were born and raised in the [[DM.Factions[faction_Marik],Free Worlds League]].
column2: 你出生并成长于[[DM.Factions[faction_Marik],自由世界联盟]]。ZH

column1: MechWarriors who hail from the [[DM.Factions[faction_Marik],Free Worlds League]] tend to be passionate, enduring fighters who value justice and equality above all else.    The oldest, and theoretically most democratic, of the great [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSuccessorState],Successor States]] of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere],Inner Sphere]], the Free Worlds League is actually a broad coalition of many minor noble houses. For most of the League's history, it has been ruled under martial law by a Captain-General, who by tradition is from [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseMarik],House Marik]]. The cultural diversity and relative independence of its component regions are at once the greatest strength of the Free Worlds League, and its greatest weaknesses.
column2: 来自[[DM.Factions[faction_Marik],自由世界联盟]]的机甲战士往往是充满激情、坚韧不拔的战士，把正义与平等置于一切之上。作为[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere],内层星域]]各[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSuccessorState],继承国]]中最古老、理论上最民主的一个，自由世界联盟实际上是众多小贵族家族的广泛联盟。在联盟历史的大部分时间里，它由一位总上将依军事管制统治，而按传统这位总上将出自[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseMarik],马里克家族]]。各组成区域的文化多样性与相对独立性，既是自由世界联盟最大的优势，也是其最大的弱点。ZH

column1: The Free Worlds League (Marik)
column2: 自由世界联盟（马里克）ZH

column1: You were born and raised in the Periphery. There is no easy way to characterize MechWarriors hailing from the Periphery - they can be anything from petty thugs to ruthless tacticians to skilled and honorable warriors. The Periphery is the galaxy's frontier, and petty politics and piracy rule the region.
column2: 你出生并成长于外缘。外缘出身的机师很难一概而论——他们可以是小混混，可以是冷酷的战术家，也可以是技艺精湛、光明磊落的战士。外缘是银河的边疆，琐碎的政治与海盗行径统治着这片区域。ZH

column1: You were born and raised in the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LorePeriphery], Periphery]].
column2: 你出生并成长于[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LorePeriphery],外缘]]。ZH

column1: There is no easy way to characterize MechWarriors hailing from the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRimwardPeriphery],Rimward Periphery]] - they can be anything from petty thugs to ruthless tacticians to skilled and honorable warriors.    The nations and minor noble houses of the Rimward Periphery have long played a role in shaping humanity - the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreStarLeague],Star League]]'s downfall began in the Periphery, eventually leading to the current tattered state of these disparate star systems on the edge of known space. The Periphery is still the galaxy's frontier, where the Great Houses of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere],Inner Sphere]] play deadly politics, petty bandit kingdoms thrive, and pirate bands prey on the minor noble houses trying to survive in this hostile environment.
column2: 来自[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRimwardPeriphery],外缘星区]]的机师很难一概而论——他们可以是从小混混到冷酷的战术家再到技艺精湛、光明磊落的战士。外缘星区的诸国与小贵族家族长期以来都在塑造人类历史中扮演着角色——[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreStarLeague],星盟]]的覆灭正是始于外缘，最终导致这些散落在已知空间边缘的星系陷入如今破败的境地。外缘至今仍是银河的边疆：[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere],内天体]]的大贵族家族在此进行致命的博弈，小小的匪帮王国在此繁荣，海盗团伙则劫掠着在这片险恶环境中挣扎求存的小贵族家族。ZH

column1: The Periphery
column2: 外围

column1: Decades ago, your family came to the Aurigan Reach from the Lyran Commonwealth. MechWarriors who hail from the Lyran Commonwealth tend to be hardy, well equipped, and well trained, though they have also earned a reputation for not being particularly strategic thinkers on the battlefield. Wealth is the greatest strength of the merchant princes of the Lyran Commonwealth.
column2: 数十年前，你的家族从莱兰联邦来到奥里根边境。出身于莱兰联邦的机师往往坚韧、装备精良、训练有素，不过他们也落下了在战场上不太讲究战略的名声。财富是莱兰联邦商业诸侯最大的实力所在。ZH

column1: You were born and raised in the [[DM.Factions[faction_Steiner],Lyran Commonwealth]].
column2: 你出生并成长于[[DM.Factions[faction_Steiner],莱兰联邦]]。ZH

column1: MechWarriors who hail from the [[DM.Factions[faction_Steiner],Lyran Commonwealth]] tend to be hardy, well equipped, and well trained, though they have also earned a reputation for not being particularly strategic thinkers on the battlefield.    Wealth is the greatest strength of the merchant princes of the Lyran Commonwealth, ruled by [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseSteiner],House Steiner]]. Despite a number of humiliating defeats in the first two [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSuccessionWars],Succession Wars]], the Lyran Commonwealth has bounced back thanks to the combined strength of its economy (the biggest of the five great [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSuccessorState],Successor States]]) and its control of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere],Inner Sphere]]'s largest functioning BattleMech factories. What the Lyran Commonwealth may lack in military prowess, it makes up for with raw numbers and industrial scale.
column2: 出身于[[DM.Factions[faction_Steiner],莱兰联邦]]的机师往往坚韧、装备精良、训练有素，不过他们也落下了在战场上不太讲究战略的名声。财富是由[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseSteiner],斯坦纳家族]]统治的莱兰联邦商业诸侯最大的实力所在。尽管在前两次[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSuccessionWars],继承战争]]中遭受了若干屈辱的失败，莱兰联邦依然凭借其经济体量（五大[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSuccessorState],继承国]]中最大）与对[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere],内天体]]最大在运转战斗机甲工厂的控制而重新振作。莱兰联邦或许在军事才能上有所欠缺，但它用纯粹的体量与工业规模弥补了这一点。ZH

column1: The Lyran Commonwealth (Steiner)
column2: 天琴共同体（施泰纳）ZH

column1: Decades ago, your family came to the Aurigan Reach from the Taurian Concordat. MechWarriors who hail from the Taurian Concordat tend to be stubborn and aggressive but are nonetheless skilled and perceptive combatants. Founded as a constitutional monarchy under the leadership of House Calderon, the Taurian Concordat is the strongest military power of the Rimward Periphery.
column2: 数十年前，你的家族从陶里安协约国来到奥里根边境。出身于陶里安协约国的机师往往固执而好斗，但依然是技艺娴熟、洞察敏锐的战斗者。陶里安协约国建立时是卡尔德隆家族领导下的君主立宪国，也是外缘星区最强的军事力量。ZH

column1: You were born and raised in the [[DM.Factions[faction_TaurianConcordat],Taurian Concordat]].
column2: 你出生并成长于[[DM.Factions[faction_TaurianConcordat],陶里安协约国]]。ZH

column1: MechWarriors who hail from the [[DM.Factions[faction_TaurianConcordat],Taurian Concordat]] tend to be stubborn and aggressive. They can be quick to anger, but they are nonetheless skilled and perceptive combatants.     Founded as a constitutional monarchy under the leadership of [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseCalderon],House Calderon]], the Taurian Concordat is the strongest military power of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRimwardPeriphery],Rimward Periphery]]. It is also one of the oldest surviving realms of human civilization, having been formed long before the creation of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreStarLeague],Star League]]. Taurian citizens enjoy extensive freedoms guaranteed by the Concordat Charter, and take pride in defending those freedoms through compulsory service. The Taurian Concordat has long had an antagonistic relationship with the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere],Inner Sphere]], particularly with the [[DM.Factions[faction_Davion],Federated Suns]].
column2: 出身于[[DM.Factions[faction_TaurianConcordat],陶里安协约国]]的机师往往固执而好斗。他们容易发怒，但依然是技艺娴熟、洞察敏锐的战斗者。陶里安协约国建立时是[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseCalderon],卡尔德隆家族]]领导下的君主立宪国，也是[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRimwardPeriphery],外缘星区]]最强的军事力量。它同时是人类文明中最古老的幸存政权之一，其成立远早于[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreStarLeague],星盟]]的建立。陶里安公民享有《协约国宪章》保障的广泛自由，并以通过义务服役来捍卫这些自由为荣。陶里安协约国与[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere],内天体]]长期敌对，尤其是与[[DM.Factions[faction_Davion],联邦太阳]]。ZH

column2: 金牛协约国

column2: 你作为[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreClans],氏族]]的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTrueborn],真出者]]而生。虽被优生计划淘汰，你仍决心在《纪念录》中赢得自己的位置。ZH

column1: After years of working for Dr. Banzai, you have stuck out on your own and were given one of Team Banzai's treasured Hatchetmen as a reward for exceptional service.
column2: 在为班宰博士工作多年之后，你终于独立门户，并因表现卓著获赠一台班宰小队珍藏的斧手作为奖赏。ZH

column1: After years of roaming the Frontier, your outfit's luck eventually ran out, landing you in an [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAuriganCoalition],Aurigan Coalition]] prison. Hearing of your bad turn of fortune, Raju dragged you out of jail, giving you a second chance under his mentorship. After heavy rehabilitation, you proved your worth and were inducted into the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseArano],House Arano]] Royal Guard.    So it is that you find yourself reunited with your old mentor, preparing your ancestral [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack],Blackjack]] for guard duty on the coronation day of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKameaArano],Lady Kamea Arano]]…
column2: 在边疆漂泊多年之后，你的部队终于耗尽了运气，你被关进了[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAuriganCoalition],Aurigan Coalition]]的监狱。得知你遭遇不幸，Raju将你从狱中拉了出来，在他的指导下给了你第二次机会。经过艰苦的康复训练，你证明了自己的价值，被吸纳入[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseArano],House Arano]]皇家卫队。就这样，你与昔日的导师重逢，为自己的祖传[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack],Blackjack]]做好护卫准备，迎接[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKameaArano],Lady Kamea Arano]]的加冕典礼……

column2: Banzai测试机师

column1: Tired of living under the authority of others, you fell in with a local pirate gang in the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRimwardPeriphery],Rimward Periphery]]. It was an unruly crew, but an effective one - roaming the Periphery afforded your outfit with a steady supply of poorly defended merchant caravans and supply depots to prey upon. While raids did occasionally devolve into combat, you quickly learned that successful piracy is mostly about being in the right place, at the right time, with the right threats and a good show of force.    +1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorGuts],Guts]]
column2: 厌倦了活在他人权威之下的日子，你混进了[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRimwardPeriphery],Rimward Periphery]]当地的一伙海盗帮派。这帮人桀骜难驯，却也相当能干——在外围地区游荡，让你这支队伍有了稳定的猎物来源：防御薄弱的商队和补给站。突袭偶尔会演变成正面交战，但你很快就明白，成功的海盗行当多半靠的是在对的时间出现在对的地点、摆出对的威胁，再加上一场像样的武力展示。+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorGuts],Guts]]

column1: You knew you would fly someday; the only question was how to get there. A chance barfight with a visiting TDF Air Chief led to the opportunity to train in air combat. You took to it as you knew you would, putting up with any draconian policy if it meant more airtime. Eventually, though, your ego got you in enough trouble to ground you from combat-readiness, and you were relegated to the position of Instructor. It took four more years of kowtowing and favors, but you got all the parts in place—nobody expected you to commandeer a bird while quitting the job, but nobody could stop you, either.
column2: 你早就知道自己终有一天会飞；唯一的问题是该如何到达那里。一次与来访TDF空军主官的酒吧斗殴带来了空中作战训练的机会。你如愿以偿地投入其中，只要能有更多飞行时间，任何苛刻政策你都忍。然而最终，你的自负给你惹了足够多麻烦，使你被取消了战备资格，降为教官。又经过四年逢迎与运作，你才把所有环节办妥——没人料到你会一边辞职一边把一架飞机开走，但也没人拦得住你。ZH

column1: You were born to fly! Quirks: [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkDisgraced],Disgraced]], [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkBrave],Brave]] Unit: choice of random [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreLAM],Land-Air 'Mech]] or random [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreVTOL],VTOL]]

column2: 飞行学校教官

column1: Desperate to escape your past, you roamed the Rimward Periphery as a freelancer, signing on for whatever odd contracts you could find as a MechWarrior for hire. It was a solitary life - but as you became more comfortable with the itinerant lifestyle, you found you have been able to eke out a decent living thus far.
column2: 急于逃离过去，你在核心方向外缘以自由职业者身份游荡，作为受雇机师接下你能找到的任何古怪合约。这是一种孤独的生活——但随着你越来越习惯这种漂泊的生活方式，你发现迄今还能凑合过个体面的日子。ZH

column1: Someone always needs some work done. Quirks: [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkDrunk],Drunk]], [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkReckless],Reckless]] Unit: random [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHunchback],Hunchback]]
column2: 总有人需要干点活。特性：[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkDrunk],醉酒]]，[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkReckless],鲁莽]] 单位：随机[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHunchback],驼背]]

column1: While running a routine patrol for a local government on the outskirts of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAuriganReach],Aurigan Reach]], you were set upon by pirates and left for dead. Raju happened to be visiting the capital city and picked up your distress call. Upon rescuing you, he offered you a job in the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseArano],House Arano]] Royal Guard.    So it is that you find yourself reunited with your old mentor, preparing your ancestral [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack],Blackjack]] for guard duty on the coronation day of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKameaArano],Lady Kamea Arano]]…
column2: 在为[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAuriganReach],奥里根边区]]边缘的某地政府执行例行巡逻时，你遭到海盗袭击并被弃之等死。拉朱恰好正在访问首府城市，接收到了你的求救信号。救出你之后，他邀请你加入[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseArano],阿然诺家族]]皇家卫队。就这样，你与旧日的导师重逢，为[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKameaArano],卡美娅·阿然诺女士]]加冕当天的守卫任务保养你的祖传[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack],二十一点]]……

column1: You roamed the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRimwardPeriphery],Rimward Periphery]] as a freelancer, signing on for whatever odd contracts you could find as a MechWarrior for hire. It was a solitary life - but as you became more comfortable with the itinerant lifestyle, you found you were able to make a decent living helping the people of the frontier.    +1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorTactics],Tactics]]
column2: 你以自由身游荡于[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRimwardPeriphery],Rimward Periphery]]，作为一名受雇的机甲战士，接下一切能找到的零散合约。那是种孤独的生活——但随着你逐渐适应了漂泊的日子，你发现自己能靠着帮助边疆的人们过上不错的生活。+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorTactics],Tactics]]

column1: Eager to escape your past, you took your Blackjack and your skills as a MechWarrior to the famed arena planet of Solaris VII. There, you eked out a living as a gladiator, fighting for the crowd in minor arenas, getting by from paycheck to paycheck.
column2: 急于逃离过去，你带着你的黑杰克和机师技能来到著名的竞技场行星索拉里斯VII。你在那里作为角斗士勉强度日，在小竞技场为观众作战，靠薪水一月过一月。ZH

column1: A [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSolaris7],Solaris 7]] Gladiator, ready to rumble. Quirks: [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkGladiator],Gladiator]], [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkHonest],Honest]] Equipment: assorted [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StarterBundleGladiator],gladiator equipment]].
column2: 一位[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSolaris7],索拉里斯7]]角斗士，准备开打。特性：[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkGladiator],角斗士]]，[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkHonest],诚实]] 装备：各式[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StarterBundleGladiator],角斗士装备]]。ZH

column1: You were a low-level champion, down on your luck and one bad fight away from the gutter, until Raju heard about you. He trekked all the way to [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSolaris7],Solaris]] to offer you passage back to the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAuriganReach],Aurigan Reach]], and a job in the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseArano],House Arano]] Royal Guard.    So it is that you find yourself reunited with your old mentor, preparing your ancestral [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack],Blackjack]] for guard duty on the coronation day of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKameaArano],Lady Kamea Arano]]…
column2: 你曾是个低级别冠军，时运不济，再输一场就要沦落街头，直到拉朱听说了你。他一路跋涉到[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSolaris7],索拉里斯]]，给你提供了一个回到[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAuriganReach],奥里根边境]]的机会，以及一份在[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseArano],阿拉诺家族]]皇家卫队的工作。于是就这样，你发现自己与昔日的导师重聚，正在为[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKameaArano],卡美娅·阿拉诺女士]]加冕日的守卫任务准备你那台祖传的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack],黑杰克]]……

column2: 索拉里斯角斗士
