column1: Following a disastrous mission that saw the rest of your unit all but wiped out, you picked up what was left to start anew. It wasn't easy as a lone battlesuit trooper, but you had experience and grit enough to make a name for yourself and pull a company together.
column2: 在一次除你之外全队几乎全灭的灾难性任务之后，你收拾残部从头开始。作为一名孤身的战斗服士兵并不容易，但你有足够的经验与胆魄为自己挣下名声，并把一家公司拉了起来。ZH

column1: For a battle armor pilot, war always brings a paycheck. Quirks: [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkBrave],Brave]], [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkDependable],Dependable]]. Unit: random [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[ConceptBattleArmor],battle armor]] squad Equipment: assorted battle armor weapons
column2: 对战斗装甲兵而言，战争总能带来薪水。特性：[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkBrave],勇敢]]，[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkDependable],可靠]]。单位：随机[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[ConceptBattleArmor],战斗装甲]]小队 装备：各式战斗装甲武器

column1: On an ill-fated mission, you were caught behind enemy lines and separated from your lance. Raju happened to be on patrol nearby, and he launched a daring rescue. Upon finding out it was you he had rescued, he brought you into the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseArano],House Arano]] Royal Guard.    So it is that you find yourself reunited with your old mentor, preparing your ancestral [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack],Blackjack]] for guard duty on the coronation day of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKameaArano],Lady Kamea Arano]]…
column2: 在一次不幸的任务中，你被困在敌后，与小队失去了联系。拉朱恰好正在附近巡逻，他发起了一场大胆的营救。当发现救出的正是你之后，他把你带进了[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseArano],阿然诺家族]]皇家卫队。就这样，你与旧日的导师重逢，为[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKameaArano],卡美娅·阿然诺女士]]加冕当天的守卫任务保养你的祖传[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack],二十一点]]……

column1: Battlesuit Infantry
column2: 战斗装甲步兵

column1: Unsure of your prospects, you traveled to [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreCoromodir],Coromodir]], the capital of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAuriganCoalition],Aurigan Coalition]], and enlisted in the Coalition military. You quickly rose through the ranks, distinguishing yourself as a reliable MechWarrior. Life as a soldier wasn't glamorous, but it suited you just fine.    +1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorGunnery],Gunnery]]
column2: 前途未卜的你前往 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreCoromodir],Coromodir]]——[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAuriganCoalition],Aurigan Coalition]] 的首都，并加入了联盟军队。你很快在军阶中步步高升，以可靠的机甲战士之名崭露头角。士兵的生活并不光鲜，却正合你意。+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorGunnery],Gunnery]]

column1: You took to plying yourself as a mercenary and found yourself traveling the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere],Inner Sphere]]. While you're not the best pilot, you've been lucky enough to make it this far and a gift from a distant relative might prove to be the break you were looking for.
column2: 你开始以雇佣兵的身份谋生，并发现自己游历于[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere],内天体]]之间。你虽不是最出色的机师，但幸运地一路走到了今天，而一位远亲的赠礼或许正是你苦寻的转机。ZH

column1: It belonged in a museum, but now it's yours. Quirks: [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkLucky],Lucky]], [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkNoble],Noble]] Unit: random rare 'Mech
column2: 它本该待在博物馆里，但现在它是你的了。特性：[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkLucky],幸运]]，[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkNoble],贵族]] 单位：随机稀有机甲

column1: After some training and a lot of networking, you found yourself on the outskirts of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAuriganReach],Aurigan Reach]], where your most recent contract went horribly wrong. Raju happened to be visiting the planet and picked up your distress call. Upon rescuing you, he offered you a job in the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseArano],House Arano]] Royal Guard.    So it is that you find yourself reunited with your old mentor, preparing your ancestral [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack],Blackjack]] for guard duty on the coronation day of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKameaArano],Lady Kamea Arano]]…
column2: 经过一些训练与大量人脉运作，你来到了[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAuriganReach],奥里根边区]]边缘，而你最近的那份合约在那里惨败。拉朱恰好正在访问该星球，接收到了你的求救信号。救出你之后，他邀请你加入[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseArano],阿然诺家族]]皇家卫队。就这样，你与旧日的导师重逢，为[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKameaArano],卡美娅·阿然诺女士]]加冕当天的守卫任务保养你的祖传[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack],二十一点]]……

column1: It may have been years since you last spoke to your great-uncle but you must have left an impression or you were simply the only one left in the family. While his passing didn't leave you with his money; it did leave you with some information on his business contacts, his prized 'Mech freshly pulled out of mothballs, and a request to make a name for yourself.
column2: 你也许已经很多年没跟叔祖父说过话，但你一定给他留下了印象，或者你只是家族里剩下的唯一一个。他的去世没有留给你他的钱，却留给你一些关于他生意伙伴的信息、他那台刚从封存中取出的珍贵机甲，以及一个出人头地的请求。ZH

column1: Eager to get away from your past and make a name for yourself, you joined up with a minor mercenary unit. Integrating into the tight-knit crew took time, but you eventually proved your worth and became part of the family.
column2: 急于摆脱过去、为自己扬名，你加入了一支小型雇佣兵部队。融入这个关系紧密的团队花了些时间，但你最终证明了自己的价值，成为家人的一员。ZH

column1: For a seasoned mercenary, war pays well. Quirks: [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkAthletic],Athletic]], [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkMechWarrior],MechWarrior]] Unit: random [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StarterBundleMercenary],advanced unit]]
column2: 对一名老练的雇佣兵而言，战争报酬丰厚。特性：[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkAthletic],运动健将]]，[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkMechWarrior],机师]] 单位：随机[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StarterBundleMercenary],高级单位]]

column1: Pure chance brought you back to the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAuriganReach],Aurigan Reach]], as your mercenary crew took an ill-fated contract against an enclave of pirates on the outskirts of Aurigan space. The job went south, and you were the only survivor of your unit. Raju's lance happened to be on patrol nearby. After rescuing you and helping to honor your fallen comrades, he offered you a job in the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseArano],House Arano]] Royal Guard.    So it is that you find yourself reunited with your old mentor, preparing your ancestral [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack],Blackjack]] for guard duty on the coronation day of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKameaArano],Lady Kamea Arano]]…
column2: 纯属偶然把你带回了[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAuriganReach],奥里根边境]]——你的雇佣兵队伍在奥里根空间郊外接了一份对海盗飞地的倒霉合约。活儿砸了，你是全队唯一的幸存者。拉朱的分队恰好就在附近巡逻。在救下你、并帮你悼念阵亡战友之后，他给了你一份在[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseArano],阿拉诺家族]]皇家卫队的工作。于是就这样，你发现自己与昔日的导师重聚，正在为[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKameaArano],卡美娅·阿拉诺女士]]加冕日的守卫任务准备你那台祖传的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack],黑杰克]]……

column1: Eager to get away from it all, you joined up with a minor [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere],Inner Sphere]] mercenary unit. Integrating into the tight-knit crew took time, but you eventually proved your worth and became part of the family.    +1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorTactics],Tactics]]
column2: 急于抛开一切，你加入了一支内天体的次要雇佣兵部队。融入这个关系紧密的团队花了些时间，但你最终证明了自己的价值，成为了家中的一员。+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorTactics],战术]]

column1: You've spent most of your lift running some kind of grift. Hell, even getting MechWarrior training was something of a happy accident. A shame that your Lyran mentor at the time wasn't too thrilled when you tried to pay him D-Bills. Once all that was settled (it wasn't), you left (fled) your way to brighter prospects, sprinkling a little cash here and there to grease the wheels and buy your way to the head of a small mercenary company. What is it they say? War is business?
column2: 你大部分时间都在搞某种骗局。见鬼，连机师训练都算是场愉快的意外。可惜当你试图用D币付钱给你当时的莱兰导师时，他并不太高兴。等这一切都算了结（其实没了结）之后，你离开（逃离）了，奔向前程更光明的去处，这里撒点钱、那里撒点钱来润滑车轮，一路买到了一个小雇佣兵公司的头把交椅。人们怎么说来着？战争就是生意？ZH

column1: There's always money in the banana stand. Quirks: [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkDishonest],Dishonest]], [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkMerchant],Merchant]] Equipment: 3 million [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreCBill],C-Bills]] (or local equivalent)
column2: 香蕉摊里总有钱赚。特性：[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkDishonest],不诚实]]、[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkMerchant],商人]] 装备：300万 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreCBill],C-Bill]]（或当地等价物）ZH

column1: While escorting a supply caravan to a small outpost on the outskirts of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAuriganReach],Aurigan Reach]], you were set upon by pirates and left for dead. Raju happened to be visiting the capital city and picked up your distress call. Upon rescuing you, he offered you a job in the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseArano],House Arano]] Royal Guard.    So it is that you find yourself reunited with your old mentor, preparing your ancestral [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack],Blackjack]] for guard duty on the coronation day of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKameaArano],Lady Kamea Arano]]…
column2: 在为前往[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAuriganReach],奥里根边区]]边缘一处小型前哨的车队护航时，你遭到海盗袭击并被弃之等死。拉朱恰好正在访问首府城市，接收到了你的求救信号。救出你之后，他邀请你加入[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseArano],阿然诺家族]]皇家卫队。就这样，你与旧日的导师重逢，为[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKameaArano],卡美娅·阿然诺女士]]加冕当天的守卫任务保养你的祖传[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack],二十一点]]……

column1: Very Legitimate Merchant
column2: 非常合法的商人

column1: You signed on as a guard for a small trading guild, providing security as the guild's caravan made trading runs between the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreInnerSphere],Inner Sphere]] and the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRimwardPeriphery],Periphery]]. It was a largely uneventful life, but you were able to put your MechWarrior skills to good use in the occasional scuffle with pirates and uncooperative local governments.    +1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorPiloting],Piloting]]
column2: 你受雇于一家小型贸易行会，为其商队在内层星域与外围地区之间跑贸易时提供安保。生活大体平淡，但你得以在偶尔与海盗和不配合的地方政府的冲突中派上机甲战士的用场。+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorPiloting],驾驶]]

column1: The school of hard knocks is for people who think that the only way to the top of the food chain is brute force. Officer training school is for the people who know the only way to the top of the food chain is brute force applied by people under your command. You graduated, did a brief stint in the organised military, dropped out, had a jaunt through the private sector, and now you find yourself at the head of your own mercenary company, with a whole slew of people ready to do the brute force for you.
column2: “硬碰硬学校”是给那些认为登上食物链顶端唯一途径就是蛮力的人上的。军官训练学校则是给那些知道登上食物链顶端唯一途径是由你指挥下的人施加的蛮力的人上的。你毕业了，在正规军里短暂服役，退出，去私营部门转了一圈，如今你发现自己坐在自家雇佣兵公司的头把交椅上，有整整一票人准备替你去施加蛮力。ZH

column1: Somebody's gotta keep the kids in line. Quirks: [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkCommand],Commander]], [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkOfficer],Officer]] Unit: choice of [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StarterBundleOfficer],Command Vehicle]]
column2: 总得有人管住这些孩子。特性：[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkCommand],指挥]]、[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkOfficer],军官]] 单位：可选 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StarterBundleOfficer],指挥车]]

column1: In the Clans' mad scramble to find suitable pilots for the ProtoMech project, you were among those selected for experimentation. While you failed to meet the frankly absurd conditions of the program, you became adept at piloting the unusual machines. Discarded once you were deemed useless, you took to the great expanse of space and landed yourself a comfortable job at the head of a mercenary company, ready to put your unconventional skills to use.
column2: 在氏族为原型机甲项目疯狂寻找合适机师的过程中，你是被选中参加实验的人之一。虽然你没达到该项目那简直荒谬的条件，你却变得擅长驾驶这些不寻常的机器。在你被判定无用之后遭到抛弃，你便投向广阔太空，为自己找到了一份舒适的工作——执掌一家雇佣兵公司，准备把你的非常规技能派上用场。ZH

column1: They're 'Mechs! But smaller! Quirks: [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkMechWarrior],MechWarrior]], [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkNeuralImplants],Neural Implants]] Unit: random [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[ConceptProtoMech],ProtoMech]]
column2: 它们是机甲！但要更小！特性：[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkMechWarrior],机师]]，[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkNeuralImplants],神经植入体]] 单位：随机[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[ConceptProtoMech],原型机甲]]

column1: You were an attempt by the science caste to convert a mechwarrior to a protomech pilot.
column2: 你是科学家种姓把机甲战士改造成原机甲机师的一次尝试。ZH

column1: ProtoMech Pilot Test Subject
column2: 原型机甲机师测试对象

column1: You signed up for your local militia as soon as you came of age. While it wasn't glamorous, the life of a soldier suited you just fine. Things took a turn for the worse several years deep, however, and you found yourself burnt out on a gruelling campaign against local pirates who were conspicuously more armed than intelligence would've had you believe. You toughed through it, but swore you'd never commit to ops that you weren't in control of any longer, and founded your own mercenary company far away from the little speck you once called home.
column2: 你一到成年就报名加入了当地民兵。虽说并不光鲜，但士兵的生活对你来说正合适。然而几年之后事情开始变糟，你在一场对当地海盗的艰苦战役中筋疲力尽——那些海盗的武装明显比情报所声称的更重。你硬撑了下来，但发誓再也不会参与任何自己无法掌控的行动，于是在远离那个你曾称之为家的微小光点的地方，建立了自己的雇佣兵公司。ZH

column1: War. War never changes. But, by God, do we wish it did. Quirks: [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkBrave],Brave]], [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkMilitary],Ex-Military]] Equipment: assorted [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StarterBundleSoldier],LosTech weaponry]]
column2: 战争。战争永不改变。但上天作证，我们真希望它会变。特性：[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkBrave],勇敢]]，[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkMilitary],退役军人]] 装备：各式[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StarterBundleSoldier],失传科技武器]]

column1: Enlisted MechWarrior
column2: 入伍机甲战士

column1: Through many years of exceptional service, you found yourself shortlisted for a strike against Clan Smoke Jaguar - Operation DAMOCLES. Along with three other Second Star League veterans, you fought your way through the Smoke Jaguar chain of command, salvaging what 'Mechs you could along the way. In the final confrontation with the would-be leader of the Clan, your salvaged 'Mech was destroyed, but you were ultimately successful. Now, with your Bushwacker in tow, you think it's time for something a little quieter.
column2: 凭借多年卓越服役，你被列入对烟虎氏族打击行动——达摩克利斯行动——的候选名单。你与另外三名第二星盟老兵一同杀穿烟虎的指挥链，沿途打捞所能得到的机甲。在与该氏族准领袖的最后交锋中，你打捞来的机甲被摧毁，但你最终取得了成功。如今，带着你的丛林狼，你觉得该是时候做点更安静的事了。ZH

column1: You survived [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDAMOCLES],Operation DAMOCLES]]. The rest is child's play. Quirks: [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkMilitary],Ex-Military]], [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkLucky],Lucky]] Unit: random [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBushwacker],Bushwacker]]
column2: 你从[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDAMOCLES],达摩克利斯行动]]中活了下来。剩下的都是小儿科。特性：[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkMilitary],退役军人]]，[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkLucky],幸运]] 单位：随机[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBushwacker],丛林狼]]

column1: Commando Veteran
column2: 突击队老兵

column1: When you were young, you were always fascinated with space. Either you spent your life amongst the stars, or you wished you could.
column2: 你小时候总是对太空着迷。你要么在群星之间度过了一生，要么曾渴望如此。ZH

column1: Space has always called to you. Quirks: [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkHonest],Honest]], [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkSpacer],Spacer]]
column2: 太空一直在召唤你。特性：[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkHonest],诚实]]，[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkSpacer],太空人]]

column1: The rest of your family died in a freak [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreJumpShip],JumpShip]] accident, after which you discovered they had left nothing behind but piles of debt.    After selling everything to settle the debt, you set off on your own, with only your family's ancestral [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack],Blackjack]] left to your name.    +1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorPiloting],Piloting]], +1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorGuts],Guts]]
column2: 你家族其余人死于一场离奇的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreJumpShip],跃迁舰]]事故，此后你发现他们除了一堆债务什么都没留下。为偿还债务变卖一切之后，你独自出发，名下只剩家族祖传的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack],二十一点]]。+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorPiloting],驾驶]]，+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorGuts],胆识]]

column1: For almost all your life, you've been drawn to games of chance. Be it simple monetary gambling, or risking your life on the field of battle.
column2: 你几乎一生都被机会游戏吸引。无论是简单的金钱赌博，还是把性命押在战场上。ZH

column1: You and old Lady Luck have a complicated relationship. Quirks: [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkJinxed],Jinxed]], [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkLucky],Lucky]]
column2: 你与老幸运女神的关系颇为复杂。特性：[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkJinxed],扫把星]]，[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkLucky],幸运]]

column1: As you grew older, you watched your family's fortune, income, and influence slowly dwindle away - until there was nothing left. Your parents, driven to despair, took their own lives.    With nothing but your family's ancestral [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack],Blackjack]] left to call your own, you set off to make a new life for yourself.    +1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorTactics],Tactics]], +1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorGuts],Guts]]
column2: 随着你长大，你看着家族的财富、收入与影响力慢慢枯竭——直到一无所有。你的父母被绝望逼到绝境，自尽身亡。只剩家族祖传的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack],黑杰克]]算作你的东西，你出发为自己开创一种新生活。+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorTactics],战术]]，+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorGuts],胆识]]

column1: In your spare time, you used to live and breathe technology. Whether you were tinkering with various systems, or scouring through every TechManual under the sun, you always found the technology that made the universe ticks to be fascinating.
column2: 在空闲时间，你过去总是活在技术里。无论你是在鼓捣各种系统，还是翻遍天下所有技术手册，你总觉得让宇宙运转的技术令人着迷。ZH

column1: Hardware and software both have always seemed so simple. Quirks: [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkLosTech],LosTech Experience]], [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkTech],Technician]]
column2: 硬件与软件从来都显得那么简单。特性：[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkLosTech],失落科技经验]]、[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkTech],技师]]

column1: Your family was betrayed and its seat of power destroyed. You defeated the betrayers, but you were the sole surviving member of your house.    With nothing but your family's ancestral [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack],Blackjack]] left to call your own, you set off to make a new life for yourself.    +1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorGunnery],Gunnery]], +1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorGuts],Guts]]
column2: 你的家族遭到背叛、权力根基被毁。你击败了背叛者，但你是家族中唯一的幸存者。名下只剩家族祖传的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack],二十一点]]，你出发去为自己开辟新生活。+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorGunnery],炮术]]，+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorGuts],胆识]]

column1: You have ever been looking to the past, perhaps to a fault. Any period of history, be it pre-spaceflight or as recent as the Age of War, has always piqued your interest. Despite not having a formal education in the field, your knowledge of some eras rivals even the most accredited historians.
column2: 你始终回望过去，或许已近成癖。任何一段历史时期——无论是前太空时代，还是近至战火时代——总能激起你的兴趣。尽管你并未在该领域受过正规教育，你对某些时代的了解甚至堪与最权威的历史学家比肩。ZH

column1: A long time ago, you used to read of times long ago. Quirks: [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkBookish],Bookish]], [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkLosTech],LosTech Experience]]
column2: 很久以前，你常常阅读很久以前的时代。特性：[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkBookish],书虫]]，[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkLosTech],失传科技经验]]

column1: Once the promising young scion of your family, you committed an unforgivable transgression and were sentenced to life in exile.    You stole away with the family's ancestral [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack],Blackjack]] and set off to find a new life to call your own.    +1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorGunnery],Gunnery]], +1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorTactics],Tactics]]
column2: 你曾是你家族中大有前途的年轻继承人，却犯下了不可饶恕的过错，被判终身流放。你带着家族祖传的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack],黑杰克]]偷偷离开，出发去寻找属于自己的新生活。+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorGunnery],射击]]，+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorTactics],战术]]

column1: In your youth, while others your age had myriad interests, you fought tooth and nail to justify your own existence. Life was tough, so you had to be tougher.
column2: 在你年少时，当同龄人有形形色色的兴趣，你却拼死拼活地证明自己存在的价值。生活很艰难，所以你不得不更坚韧。ZH

column1: You blazed a trail through life, sticking to the only guns you could trust — your own. Quirks: [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkReckless],Reckless]], [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkBrave],Brave]]
column2: 你在人生中闯出一条血路，只信赖你唯一能信得过的枪——你自己的。特性：[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkReckless],鲁莽]]、[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkBrave],勇敢]]

column1: As the heir to a noble family, you grew up wanting for nothing. And as it turns out… you couldn't stand a life of pampered nobility.    Finally, one night you stole away with the family's ancestral [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack],Blackjack]] and set off to find a new life to call your own.    +1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorPiloting],Piloting]], +1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorTactics],Tactics]]
column2: 作为贵族家族的继承人，你从小要什么有什么。而结果证明……你受不了那种被娇养的高贵生活。最终，某个夜里你带着家族祖传的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack],黑杰克]]偷偷离开，出发去寻找属于自己的新生活。+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorPiloting],驾驶]]，+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorTactics],战术]]

column1: \"I thought you were joking when you said you worked for [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTeamBanzai],Team Banzai]]!\" Yang blurts out, noting your amused expression as you look up from your datapad. You crack a small grin.  \"Your old ride's waiting for you in the 'Mech Bay, Boss,\" he informs you with no small amount of huffiness.
column2: 你说你为[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTeamBanzai],班宰小队]]工作时，我还以为你在开玩笑！杨脱口而出，注意到你从数据板上抬起头时那副觉得好笑的表情。你微微一笑。"你的老座机在机甲库里等着你，老大，"他带着不小的怨气通知你。ZH

column1: While your last raid concluded hours ago, you've barely made a dent in sifting through the spoils. You stand on the far side of the Argo's 'Mech Bay, tapping entries into a datapad as all hands ferry weaponry, shells, and slabs of BattleMech armor off the carcasses of your rivals' 'Mechs. \"Hey, Boss,\" comes Yang's voice. You look up from the pad and see him walking over, wiping greasy hands on a rag at his belt. \"One of these 'Mechs is in pretty good shape. We could get her runnin' again instead of needing to salvage her.\"
column2: 你的上一次突袭几小时前就结束了，可你连战利品的皮毛都还没分拣完。你站在阿戈号机甲库的另一头，一边往数据板里敲着条目，一边看着所有人从对手机甲的残骸上卸下武器、炮弹和大块战斗机甲装甲。"嘿，老大，"杨的声音传来。你从数据板上抬起头，看见他走过来，一边用腰带上的抹布擦着油乎乎的手。"这些机甲里有一台状态相当好。我们可以让它重新跑起来，而不是当废料拆了。"

column1: You hurry to the 'Mech Bay to find Yang punching at his datapad by the bulkhead. As you approach, he glances up and offers a short wave.  \"Hey Boss. She's all unpacked,\" he says, gesturing into the 'Mech Bay. \"A few bangs and scrapes, but I think Carrick kept his word. Nothing important's missing. You want to see for yourself?\"  You give a short nod and hurry past Yang into the bay. Sumire is loitering inside, and as you unveil your prize acquisition, her eyes go wide:
column2: 你匆匆赶到机甲库，发现杨正在舱壁旁猛戳他的数据板。你走近时，他抬眼看了看，简短地挥了下手。"嘿老大。她全卸下来了，"他说着，朝机甲库里指了指。"有几处磕碰刮擦，但我想卡里克守信了。没什么重要的东西缺失。你想亲自看看吗？"  你点了点头，匆匆越过杨走进机库。苏米蕾正在里面闲晃，当你揭开战利品时，她的眼睛睁大了：ZH

column1: As you make plans to retire for the evening, Yang catches you in the hallway outside your quarters. He seems out of breath and covered in a thin film of engine grease and sweat.  \"Hey Boss,\" he begins, idly wiping his hands on his overalls, \"we're done with the last of our checks. Your [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHunchback],Hunchback]] was pretty shot up, but she's all squeaky clean now.\"  Seeing the tiredness vanish from your face, Yang claps a greasy hand on your shoulder. \"That's the spirit! Come check her out!\"
column2: 当你准备就寝时，杨在舱室外走廊里拦住你。他气喘吁吁，浑身覆着一层薄薄的机油与汗水。“嘿老板，”他开口，随手在工装裤上擦手，“我们做完了最后一批检查。你那台[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHunchback],驼背]]被打得挺惨，不过现在干干净净、状态满满了。”看到你脸上的倦意消散，杨用一只沾满油的手拍拍你的肩。“这才对嘛！来看看她！”ZH

column1: Good as new!
column2: 完好如新！ZH

column1: \"Hey Boss, I got that crate of old Solaris gear you had sent up,\" Yang says as he walks onto the bridge. There's an air of apprehension hovering over him.  \"Alright,\" you say, a smirk on your face, \"out with it.\"  Yang glances around tentatively, then clears his throat and speaks. \"You had a different callsign back in your gladiator days, right? What was it? I might have seen a few of your matches.\"
column2: “嘿老板，你要的那箱旧索拉里斯装备我拿到了，”杨一边走上舰桥一边说。他身上笼着一层隐约的不安。“好啊，”你脸上带着一丝坏笑说，“说吧。”杨试探地环顾四周，然后清了清嗓子开口。“你当角斗士的时候用过别的呼号，对吧？是什么来着？我可能看过你几场比赛。”ZH

column1: As you stare out the window into the black expanse, Yang clears his throat.  \"Hey Boss. That crate of battle armor stuff just arrived. I'm planning to crack her open and take inventory. Figured you'd wanna know.\"
column2: 当你望着窗外无垠的漆黑时，杨清了清嗓子。“嘿老板。那箱战斗装甲的东西刚到。我打算开箱清点一下。想着你大概想知道。”ZH

column1: The mood on the bridge is solemn. You and Darius watch as a spokesperson on a flickering holo-vid dispassionately informs you of the death of your great-uncle, offering the bare minimum of condolences mandated by their estate.  As the recording comes to a close and the image winks out, Yang enters the room. \"Uh, hey, Boss,\" he begins, \"Sumire found the location those coordinates point to while you were busy dealing with all the paperwork. She took the Leopard out and hauled a 'Mech back with her. If I had to guess, this is what the message calls his 'favorite little treasure'.\"  You raise an eyebrow, expectantly.  \"I'll be honest,\" Yang continues, \"I took a peek - it belongs in a museum.\"
column2: 舰桥上的气氛肃穆。你和达里乌斯看着一个全息影像里闪烁的发言人冷淡地通知你你叔祖父的死讯，仅致以遗产执行所要求的最低限度哀悼。录音接近尾声、影像闪灭时，杨走进房间。"呃，嘿，老大，"他开口道，"你忙着处理那一堆文书的时候，苏米蕾找到了那些坐标所指的位置。她开着豹式出去，拖回了一台机甲。要我说，这就是那条消息里说的他"最心爱的小宝贝"。"  你扬起一根眉毛，等着他往下说。"老实说，"杨继续说，"我瞄了一眼——它该待在博物馆里。"

column1: You meet Yang in the 'Mech Bay, as discussed over the intercom. He's waiting by the large bulkhead doors, datapad in hand. As you approach, he glances up and offers a short wave.  \"Hey Boss. The care package from your old unit arrived an hour or so ago,\" he says, gesturing vaguely into the 'Mech Bay. \"Wanna take a look?\"
column2: 你按内部对讲里说好的，在机甲库见到杨。他在巨大的舱壁门旁等着，手里拿着数据板。你走近时，他抬眼看了看，简短地挥了下手。"嘿老大。你老部队寄来的关怀包裹一小时前到了，"他说着，含糊地朝机甲库里指了指。"想看看吗？"

column1: You nod in the affirmative and Yang turns to lead you to the bay containing the ride in question.
column2: 你肯定地点了点头，杨便转身带你前往停放那台座驾的隔舱。ZH

column1: See what your old pals sent you.
column2: 看看你的老伙计们给你寄了什么.

column1: Severance Pay
column2: 遣散费

column1: \"No,\" Darius says, firmly. His jaw is set as he folds his arms and stares pointedly at you over the holographic display in the command center. \"Oh, c'mon!\" You protest. \"It's a small risk, sure, but the pay-off is absolutely worth it!\" You and Darius have been arguing back and forth for the last fifteen minutes. You're convinced that you can flip this wayward shipment of [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHolovidMercenaries],MERCENARIES!]] before anybody in the crew finds out about it. Darius, on the other hand, is not. \"Yang'll throw a fit if he hears about this. You know that,\" Darius reiterates. \"You're playing with fire here.\" \"And? Three million, Darius.\" Eventually, he sighs and throws up his hands. \"Fine, go ahead, but don't whine to me if this comes back to bite us.\"
column2: 不行，达里乌斯坚定地说。他咬紧下巴，抱起双臂，隔着指挥中心的全息显示屏直直盯着你。"哦，别这样！"你抗议道。"风险确实很小，但回报绝对值得！" 你和达里乌斯已经来回争论了十五分钟。你确信能在这批走偏的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHolovidMercenaries],雇佣兵！]]货品被船员发现之前把它出手掉。达里乌斯则不这么认为。"杨要是听说了会大发雷霆。你知道的，"达里乌斯重申。"你这是在玩火。" "那又怎样？三百万，达里乌斯。" 最后，他叹了口气，摊开双手。"行吧，随你去，但要是这事反过来咬了咱们，别来跟我抱怨。"

column1: As you cut the connection to your last client, Yang bursts into the command center.  He looks out of breath,   \"There's a problem, Boss,\" he says, leaning on a nearby console to catch his breath.      \"Go on,\" you instruct, quirking a brow.      He goes on to explain the dilemma - while, yes, your old command vehicle was still around, there's been no small amount of confusion on the ground.  Records have been lost, found, copied wrong, lost again, copied from the copies, et cetera.    \"So, the short of it is,\" Yang concludes, \"they have an [[DM.MechDefs[vehicledef_AWACS],AWACS Command VTOL]] and an [[DM.MechDefs[vehicledef_MOBILEHQ_C3M],C3 Mobile HQ truck]], but they don't know which one actually belongs to you. The way I see it, we can just pick the one we want and they'll be none the wiser!
column2: 你刚切断与最后一位客户的联系，杨就冲进指挥中心。他看起来上气不接下气。"出问题了，老大，"他说着，靠在旁边的控制台上喘气。"继续说，"你指示道，挑起一根眉毛。他接着解释了这个难题——虽然你以前的指挥车辆确实还在，但地面上出现了不小的混乱。记录丢失过、被找到过、被抄错过、又丢过、从错件里抄过，等等等等。"所以简单说，"杨总结道，"他们有一台[[DM.MechDefs[vehicledef_AWACS],AWACS指挥VTOL]]和一辆[[DM.MechDefs[vehicledef_MOBILEHQ_C3M],C3机动指挥部卡车]]，但他们不知道到底哪一台属于你。照我看，我们可以随便挑一台想要的，他们完全看不出来！ZH

column1: Ever since you'd been informed of the accident at the facility, you've been on edge. That place and the rigorous testing regimes have a special place in your nightmares. Staring out the window of the observation pod into the inky black, you start as you hear the bulkhead door open behind you.  \"Oop, sorry, Boss,\" comes Yang's voice. The door quietly hisses shut behind him, leaving the two of you in almost complete silence. At least, until he speaks again. \"We just got back with the Leopard. It's exactly as the orbital scans said - the facility's toast.\"  For a brief moment, you don't know what to feel. What happened within those walls was a deeply formative experience for you.  \"But,\" Yang continues, \"we did find something — a couple of those [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[ConceptProtoMech],ProtoMechs]] in complete shambles. I hope you don't mind, but we brought them back with us and I've had the boys take a look at fixing them up and seeing if we can get a full squad rolling.
column2: 自从你得知那处设施出了事故，你就一直心神不宁。那个地方和那些严苛的测试规程在你的噩梦里占着特殊位置。你盯着观察舱窗外的一片漆黑，身后舱壁门打开的声音让你一惊。"哎呀，抱歉，老大，"杨的声音传来。门在他身后悄声合上，把你们两人留在近乎彻底的寂静里。至少，在他再次开口之前是如此。"我们刚带着豹式回来。跟轨道扫描说的一模一样——那处设施已经报废了。"  有那么一瞬间，你不知道该有什么感觉。那些墙里发生的一切，对你是一次塑造深远的经历。"不过，"杨继续说，"我们确实发现了点东西——几台彻底散架的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[ConceptProtoMech],原型机甲]]。希望你别介意，我们把它们带回来了，我已经让弟兄们看看能不能修好，看能不能凑出一支完整小队跑起来。ZH

column1: You approach the location of the dead drop with Yang and Sumire in tow. Both of them seem somewhat anxious, a stark comparison to your relative nonchalance.  \"Dead drops like this always make me uncomfortable,\" Yang complains, his head on a swivel.  \"You get used to them after a while,\" Sumire says, \"especially with the amount I get sent on.\"  \"Well, I'm not you, in case you hadn't noticed,\" comes Yang's reply.  \"Can it, you two,\" you butt in.  A small collection of crates sit neatly bundled at the precise location given, a locator beacon slowly blinking atop the pile.  Despite being long removed from the jarhead life, your making friends with the quartermaster sure has paid off. This is the third package of goods that's been 'misplaced', and you're certainly not going to start complaining about them now.  Only one question remains - what goodies did you ask for this time?
column2: 你带着杨和苏米蕾来到死投点。他们俩都显得有些焦虑，与你的相对淡定形成鲜明对比。"这种死投总让我不舒服，"杨抱怨着，脑袋不停转来转去。"过一阵你就习惯了，"苏米蕾说，"尤其考虑到我被派去取件的次数。"  "嗯，我可不是你，要是你没注意到的话，"杨回嘴。"你们都闭嘴，"你插话。一小堆箱子整齐地捆在给定的准确位置上，堆顶上一个定位信标缓缓闪烁。尽管早已远离军旅生活，你跟那位军需官交朋友确实值了。这是第三批被"放错地方"的货物，而你现在肯定不会抱怨它们。只剩一个问题——这次你要的是什么好东西？ZH

column1: It's been several years since you'd felt this ready to get back into the cockpit. You thought that [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDAMOCLES],DAMOCLES]] would've been enough excitement for a lifetime, and yet you find yourself once more itching to climb into the pilot seat. As you pace back and forth outside the 'Mech Bay, flanked by armored windows showcasing the inky black, Yang's voice catches your attention.  \"Hey, Boss. She's out of [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreColdStorage],mothball]],\" he informs you, \"all ready to go.\"  Your pacing abruptly stops and a small smile graces your face. Yang seems to have noticed, since he wears one of his own.  \"Well?\" He asks, \"are you just gonna stand there grinnin' or are you gonna come check her out?\"
column2: 已经好几年你没有这么渴望回到驾驶舱里了。你以为[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDAMOCLES],达摩克利斯行动]]够你兴奋一辈子，可你发现自己又一次心痒难耐，想爬进驾驶座。当你在机甲库外来回踱步、两侧装甲窗展示着漆黑一片时，杨的声音吸引了你的注意。"嘿，老大。她刚出[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreColdStorage],封存]]，"他通知你，"一切就绪。"  你的踱步戛然而止，脸上浮起一丝微笑。杨似乎注意到了，因为他自己也露出了一个。"那么？"他问，"你是就站那儿傻笑，还是过来看看她？"

column1: Back in the Saddle
column2: 重返战场

column1: Reunite with your old friend.
column2: 与你的老友重逢.

column1: Battle armor, sometimes called battlesuits or Tactical Armor, are armored infantry. Alongside the lighter power armor variety, battle armor is designed to increase the effectiveness of infantry, offering improved resilence, atmospheric containment and firepower at the cost of ... well, cost. Battle armor are typically deployed in squads of four by the Inner Sphere and Periphery, stars of five by the Clans, and ComStar and Word of Blake Level Is see six suits deployed.
column2: 战斗装甲，有时也称战斗服或战术装甲，属于重装步兵. 与轻型动力甲类似，战斗装甲旨在提升步兵的作战效能，在提供更强防护、大气环境维持能力以及火力的同时，代价是……嗯，高昂的成本. 战斗装甲通常以内天体及外围的四机小队、氏族的五机星为单位部署，而通讯之星与布雷克圣言会的一级编制则部署六套装甲.

column1: Battle Armor
column2: 战斗装甲

column1: The pirates of the known universe are widely considered to be batshit insane and nothing illustrates this more than their approach to BattleMechs. Using whatever parts they've looted, pirate MechTechs can cobble together nightmarish amalgams that are just as deadly, if not more so, to their pilots as they are their targets.
column2: 已知宇宙的海盗被普遍认为疯得离谱，而最能说明这一点的莫过于他们对待战斗机甲的方式。海盗机修技师用他们抢来的任何零件，能拼凑出噩梦般的杂合物，这些对机师来说与其说对目标的致命性不如说同样甚至更加致命。ZH

column1: Pirate BattleMechs
column2: 海盗用战斗机甲

column1: Created by Clan Smoke Jaguar in an attempt to ease the strain on resources placed upon the Clans by occupying the Inner Sphere post-invasion. The ProtoMech is a fusion between Clan Elemental Battle Armor and conventional BattleMechs. While roughly one-tenth the mass of a BattleMech, ProtoMechs are capable of carrying comparable firepower when deployed in Stars of five units. Neural interfaces and cramped cockpits mean that only specific candidates from the Clan eugenics programs are viable pilots.
column2: 原型机甲由烟虎氏族创造，旨在缓解入侵后占领内天体给各氏族带来的资源压力. 它是氏族元素战斗装甲与常规战斗机甲的融合体. 虽然质量大约只有战斗机甲的十分之一，但以五台为一个编队部署时，原型机甲能够携带不相上下的火力. 神经接口和极其局促的驾驶舱意味着，只有来自氏族优生学计划的特定候选人才适合成为机师.

column1: Vehicle refers to anything that is not a BattleMech, OmniMech, ProtoMech, or Battle Armor. This includes, but is not limited to, tanks, hovertanks, APCs, and VTOLs.
column2: “车辆”指一切不是战斗机甲、全向机甲、原生机甲或战斗装甲的东西，包括但不限于坦克、悬浮坦克、装甲运兵车与VTOL。ZH

column1: You get a message from your Chief MechTech [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[Wulf_Lore_Yang],Yang]]:    \"Commander {Commander.LastName}, we have managed to re-assemble that mech you had shipped up here. What a beauty she is. Those are some strings you must have pulled with your contacts back home.\"
column2: 你收到首席机甲技师[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[Wulf_Lore_Yang],杨]]的消息：“{COMMANDER.LastName}指挥官，我们已经把你运上来的那台机甲重新组装好了。她真漂亮。你肯定在家乡动用不少人脉才办成这事。”ZH

column1: Introduced 2598, lost 2855, and reintroduced 3035, the Artemis IV Fire Control System (FCS) is a guidance system designed for use with missile weaponry, such as Short-Range Missiles (SRM) or Long-Range Missiles (LRM). When attached to a launcher, the FCS grants the use of Artemis-enabled missiles, which benefit from massively increased accuracy and shot grouping.
column2: 阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统（FCS）于2598年推出、2855年失传、3035年重新引入，是一种为导弹武器（如短程火箭SRM或远程导弹LRM）设计的制导系统。装到发射器上时，该火控系统允许使用带阿尔忒弥斯支持的导弹，从而获得大幅提升的精度与弹着密集度。ZH

column1: The Bushwacker is a medium BattleMech weighing in at 55 tons. Full scale production of the Bushwacker began in 3053 during the Clan Invasion. While the design existed for several years prior, it was plagued with issues, ranging from cramped controls to intermittent system failure due to the fusion reactor's proximity to sensitive electronics. Despite this, the narrow profile of the Bushwacker proved invaluable at deflecting enemy fire, and against all odds it became a champion of the Inner Sphere against the invading Clans.
column2: 丛林猎手是一款55吨的中型战斗机甲，于3053年部族入侵期间开始全面量产。虽然该设计此前已存在数年，却问题缠身——从局促的操控到聚变反应堆过近于精密电子设备导致的间歇性系统故障。尽管如此，丛林猎手狭窄的轮廓在偏转敌方火力上被证明极为宝贵，它排除万难成为内层星域对抗入侵部族的利器。ZH

column1: Founded 2807. The Clans are descended from the self-exiled remnants of the Star League Defense Force, who left the Inner Sphere following the collapse of the Star League. Upon reaching what is now known at the Pentagon Worlds, the SLDF fell to infighting, prompting Nicholas Kerensky, son of General Aleksandr Kerensky, to embark on a second exodus deeper into coreward space. Those who left with him were eventually reformed into the Clans, a strictly militant society who would go on to reconquer the Pentagon Worlds and later stage an invasion of the Inner Sphere.
column2: 成立于2807年. 氏族源自星际联盟防卫军（SLDF）中自我流放的残余部队，他们在星际联盟崩溃后离开了内天体. 抵达如今被称为五角星世界的地区后，SLDF陷入了内部纷争，促使亚历山大·克伦斯基将军之子尼古拉斯·克伦斯基开始第二次大迁徙，向更深的银河核心方向进发. 跟随他离开的人员最终被重组为氏族——一个严格的军事化社会，他们后来重新征服了五角星世界，并进一步发动了对内天体的入侵.

column1: When BattleMechs or other vehicles are not planned to see use in some time, they are commonly placed in \"cold storage\", or \"mothballed\". To reduce maintenance costs, the unit in question is stripped down to its bare essentials and kept in designated storage containers. While this does make maintenance practically a non-issue, it can take several hours or even days to prepare a stored unit for deployment.
column2: 当战斗机甲或其他车辆一段时间内不打算使用时，它们通常会被置于"冷储存"或"封存"状态。为降低维护成本，相关单位会被剥到最基本配置，保存在指定储存容器中。虽然这确实让维护几乎不成问题，但要让一台封存单位准备好部署，可能需要数小时甚至数天。ZH

column1: Cold Storage
column2: 冷存储

column1: Conducted 3060. Operation DAMOCLES was a commando operation pitting an elite task force of the Second Star League against the remains of Clan Smoke Jaguar on the planet Tranquil. Despite heavy losses, the operation was considered a success, depriving the Clan of a strong potential leader and severely damaging their industrial capabilities.
column2: 达摩克利斯行动于3060年实施. 这是一次突击行动，由第二星际联盟的精锐特遣队对抗在静谧星上残存的烟虎氏族势力. 尽管伤亡惨重，该行动仍被认为是成功的，它使氏族失去了一位强有力的潜在领袖，并严重摧毁了其工业能力.

column1: Operation DAMOCLES
column2: 达摩克利斯行动

column1: Double heat sinks are, as the name implies, twice as effective per ton as standard \"single\" heatsinks, albeit at the cost of two additional critical slots. Installing double heat sinks into a 'Mech requires the engine to support them. This is done by installing a double heat sink kit to the engine housing of the 'Mech. A 'Mech may only mount one type of heat sink, which is dictated by the engine kit installed.
column2: 双重散热器正如其名，每吨的效能是标准"单重"散热器的两倍，代价是额外占用两个致命槽位。要在机甲上安装双重散热器，需要引擎支持它们。做法是给机甲的引擎外壳装上一套双重散热器套件。一台机甲只能安装一种散热器，这取决于所装的引擎套件。ZH

column1: Double Heat Sink
column2: 双散热器

column1: Freeborn refers to a member of the Clans born through natural childbirth rather than the eugenics program. They are considered inferior by most trueborn. Despite this, freeborn have proven more than capable of outperforming trueborn, with some rising to the ranks of Star Captain or Star Colonel within the Clan military.
column2: 自由生者指的是通过自然分娩而非优生学计划诞生的氏族成员. 大多数真生者视其为劣等. 尽管如此，自由生者已多次证明自己完全有能力超越真生者，其中一些人甚至在氏族军队中晋升至星上尉或星上校的军阶.

column1: The Hatchetman is a medium BattleMech weighing in at 45 tons, so named for the BattleMech hatchet affixed to its right arm. Despite first being manufactured in the Lyran Commonwealth in 3023, the Hatchetman was actually designed by Team Banzai commander Dr. B Banzai as part of a joint venture between the Federated Suns and the Lyran Commonwealth.
column2: “刽子手”是一款重45吨的中型战斗机甲，因其右臂上固定安装的战斗机甲斧而得名. 尽管“刽子手”最初于3023年在天琴共同体投产，但它实际上是由Team Banzai指挥官B·Banzai博士设计的，属于恒星联邦与天琴共同体合作项目的一部分.

column1: The Hunchback is a well-known and respected medium BattleMech weighing in at 50 tons. The name comes from the oversized right torso, within which is typically mounted a much larger weapon than is commonly seen on 'Mechs of its tonnage. Examples include the HBK-4G, which carries an Autocannon/20, or the HBK-4P, which carries a full battery of six medium lasers.
column2: 驼背是著名且受人尊敬的50吨中型战斗机甲。这个名字来自它超大的右躯干，其中通常装着一件远大于该吨位机甲常见规格的武器。例如HBK-4G装有一门自动炮/20，而HBK-4P则装有一整排六门中型激光器。ZH

column1: Produced 2300. Long-Range Missiles, commonly shortened to LRM, are self-guided missiles designed for engagement at range. While exceptionally inaccurate within the weapon's minimum targeting and arming distance, LRMs may be \"hot loaded\" and fired with no range penalty, albeit at the risk of damaging the launcher.
column2: 生产于2300年。远程导弹，通常简称为LRM，是为远距离交战设计的自导引导弹。虽然在武器的最小瞄准与解锁距离内极不精准，LRM可以"热装填"发射而不受射程惩罚，但代价是有可能损坏发射器。ZH

column1: Long-Range Missile
column2: 远程导弹

column1: The Oracle is a wheeled mobile headquarters loaded with an Advanced Command Module, Communications Gear and ECM.
column2: 神谕是一种轮式机动指挥部，搭载一台高级指挥模块、通讯设备与ECM。ZH

column1: The Periphery is a comparatively sparsely populated region of space that encircles the Inner Sphere, beginning some 500 light years from Terra. Worlds within the Periphery are typically less technologically advanced than those within in Inner Sphere proper, but commerce still thrives. Over the centuries, a handful of strong Periphery states, such as the Magistracy of Canopus and the Taurian Concordat, have emerged with a fierce independence.
column2: 外围是环绕内天体的一片相对人烟稀少的太空区域，起始于距地球约五百光年之处. 外围的星球科技水平普遍低于内天体核心区，但商贸活动依然兴盛. 数个世纪以来，当地涌现出数个强大的外围国家，如船底自治区和金牛协约国，它们都怀有强烈的独立意识.

column1: The Quikscell Company is known as the Quicksell Company, Quickscell Company, Quicsell Company, and many other variations, changing names frequently to avoid lawsuits and weasel out of small print. While an immediately recognisable name throughout the Inner Sphere, it is not for good reasons - Quikscell goods are notoriously low quality and are mass produced to flood the market.
column2: 快销公司以Quicksell、Quickscell、Quicsell以及许多其他变体名称而闻名，频繁改名以闪避诉讼、在小字条款上钻空子。虽然这个名字在内天体众所周知，但并不是因为好名声——快销的货以质量低劣著称，靠大规模量产来淹没市场。ZH

column1: The Quikscell Company
column2: Quikscell公司

column1: Produced in limited numbers in 2785, the Snub-Nose Particle Projector Cannon, or Snub-Nose PPC, is a large energy weapon which fires a concentrated stream of protons or ions. Unlike standard PPCs, the Snub-Nose variety were designed to be used at short range. In addition to being able to slag nearly a ton of armor in a single shot, PPCs also scramble enemy electronics. This comes with the drawback of high heat production, and recoil, which is notably uncommon amongst energy weapons.
column2: 短鼻粒子加农炮于2785年少量生产，是一种大型能量武器，发射集中的质子或离子流。与标准粒子加农炮不同，短鼻型号被设计用于近距使用。除了能一发熔掉近一吨装甲外，粒子加农炮还会扰乱敌方电子设备。代价是高热量与后坐力——后者在能量武器中相当罕见。ZH

column1: Established 3015. Team Banzai is an enigmatic mercenary regiment that is known for the scientific genius of its commander, Dr. B Banzai. Team Banzai has been under contract to the Federated Suns throughout its existence and while not on deployment many of its members teach advanced courses at the New Avalon Institute of Science. Their contributions to technology are varied, including cooling suits for MechWarriors and - most famously - the Hatchetman BattleMech.
column2: Team Banzai成立于3015年. 这是一支神秘的雇佣兵团，以其指挥官B·Banzai博士的科学天才而闻名. 自成立以来，Team Banzai一直受雇于恒星联邦. 在未执行任务期间，其许多成员都在新阿瓦隆科学院教授高级课程. 他们对科技的贡献多种多样，包括为机甲战士设计的冷却服，以及最负盛名的——“刽子手”战斗机甲.

column1: Team Banzai
column2: 班载队

column1: A trueborn is a Clan warrior born from the Clans' eugenics programs. The belief is that by combining the genetic material from heroic figures from Clan society, the resulting person would possess the best qualities of both. By the Clans, trueborn are considered inherently superior to natural \"freebirths\", and taught to believe that they are the only true inheritors of Aleksandr Kerensky's legacy.
column2: 真出者是由氏族优生计划诞生的氏族战士。其理念是：把氏族社会中英雄人物的遗传物质结合起来，所产生的个体将拥有双方的最佳品质。在氏族看来，真出者天生优于自然的"自由出生者"，并被教导相信他们是亚历山大·克伦斯基遗产的唯一真正继承者。ZH

column1: Introduced 2640. The Ultra autocannon, often shortened to \"Ultra AC\" or \"UAC\" is an upgraded version of the standard autocannon. It boasts roughly twice the rate of fire, albeit at the cost of being a lower calibre. Ultra autocannons are prone to jamming, during which the weapon is unusable until the MechWarrior is able to clear the jam.
column2: 超级自动炮（常简写为“Ultra AC”或“UAC”）于2640年推出，是标准自动炮的升级版。它的射速约翻倍，代价是口径更小。超级自动炮容易卡壳，卡壳期间武器无法使用，直到机甲战士排除故障。ZH

column1: Ultra Autocannon
column2: 超级自动炮

column1: Replaces starting questions with more interesting ones. Inspired by LadyAlekto unveiling the related base game jsons, and realized through some heavy lifting DLL magic by T-bone to get it working with non-Commander-only scoped events.

column2: 高级单位配备着最先进的组件. 这些组件可能包括至今仍宝刀未老的古代星际联盟遗物，或是来自通讯之星、布雷克圣言会等先进科技源头的尖端装备.

column1: Gunnery determines chance to hit with ranged weapons. In addition, it mitigates the chance of weapons jamming or misfiring, as well as increasing the chance to clear jams should they occur. Piloting increases melee hit chance and non-'Mech vehicle movement speed. It also reduces initiative variance and equipment failure chance. Tactics increases initative, sensor rolls, and offsets the accuracy penalty of Offensive Push. It also reduces the initiative penalty when a unit Reserves and the Resolve cost of abilities. Guts increases Resolve generation and injury resistance, mitigates initiative loss when the MechWarrior is the target of a melee attack or is injured, and reduces the likelihood of Overheating effects, such as ammo explosions or forced shutdown. Guts also reduces the chance of equipment failure or misfire causing damage to components.
column2: 射击决定远程武器的命中几率。此外，它还能降低武器卡壳或走火的几率，并在卡壳发生时提高解除卡壳的几率。驾驶提高近战命中率与非机甲车辆的移动速度，也会降低先制浮动与装备故障几率。战术提高先制、传感器判定，并抵消攻势推进的命中惩罚。它还能降低单位进行预备时的先制惩罚，以及能力的决心消耗。胆识提高决心产生与抗伤能力，减轻机师成为近战攻击目标或受伤时的先制损失，并降低过热效果（如弹药爆炸或强制停机）的可能性。胆识还会降低装备故障或走火对组件造成伤害的几率。ZH

column1: Darius's voice rings out over the intercom.\"Could the Comander please report to the Command Center? Incoming message for you.\"\" In the Command Center, Darius is arguing with someone on  the Holovid.\"    \"Commander? Good to know I got through to you, I was beginning to think I’d die of old age before your XO would put me through. You don’t remember me but, some idiot misplaced a few crates of my AC/5 ammo on your shuttle sometime back. You did me a favour then and I’d like you to do another for me now.\"    \"Really?    \"Yes. I’m in a spot of bother with the local crime syndicate over some misplaced demolition charges. Nothing too serious, but they want blood. You hire me and get me out of this system and I’ll give you the coordinates of a supply cache I know about.\" Suddenly the Holovid blinks out.    \"Commander, I’d recommend not associating with such a shady character, it won't end well for us.\" Darius says.
column2: 达里乌斯的声音从内部对讲里传出。"指挥官能否到指挥中心来一趟？有你的来电。"在指挥中心里，达里乌斯正在全息影像上与某人争论。"指挥官？很高兴联系上你了，我本来以为我会等到老死，你的执行官才会把我接进来。你不记得我，但不久前有个白痴把我几箱AC/5弹药放错了、落到你的穿梭机上。你当时帮了我一个忙，现在我想请你再帮一个。"  "真的？"  "是的。我因为一些放错地方的爆破装药，跟当地犯罪辛迪加有点麻烦。不算太严重，但他们想要血。你雇我、把我弄出这个星系，我就把我所知的一处补给藏点坐标给你。"全息影像突然熄灭了。"指挥官，我建议不要跟这种来路不正的人打交道，这对我们不会有好结果。"达里乌斯说。ZH
