column1: Frank Castle was born on New Avalon to parents of Italian ancestry. Enlisted into the Federated Suns Marine Corps, he excelled at every aspect of warfare and was soon trained to become a MechWarrior. After his long tour of duty during the Third Succession War, he came home only to see his family gunned down for no apparent reason. His life having lost all meaning, he went on to hunt down every criminal he could find.
column2: 弗兰克·卡斯尔出生在新瓦隆，父母有意大利血统。他入伍联邦太阳国海军陆战队，在战争的各个方面都表现出色，很快被训练为机甲战士。第三次继承战争的漫长服役结束后，他回到家中，却只见家人无故被枪杀。人生失去全部意义之后，他开始追猎他能找到的每一个罪犯。ZH

column1: Yeah, but imagine that's you:    You get your first look at the 30 ton Trash Can as you move into an intersection. But the Urbie, he knew you were there a long time ago. He moves like a heavy 'Mech: stompy, bobbing his head. And you keep still because you think, maybe, with his cheap Periphery radar he'll lose you if you don't move. But, no. Not the UrbanMech. You stare at him, and he just stares back. That's when the attack comes - not from the front, no - from the side. From the other two Urbies you didn't even know were there.    An UrbanMech is a pack-hunter, you see. He uses coordinated attack patterns and he's out in force today. And he fires at you with an Imperator AC - a 12-ton anti-'Mech weapon - like a sledgehammer on the right arm. They don't bother to go for the cockpit like a Hunchback; they just shoot here, in the center torso and here, in the leg. Or, maybe, on the gyro, spilling you across the tarmac.    Point is: you're alive when they start to eat you.
column2: 是啊，可想象一下那就是你：当你走进一个十字路口时，你第一次看到那台30吨的"垃圾桶"。但那台城市仔早就在很久以前就知道你在那儿。他像重型机甲一样移动：咚咚踩着步子，脑袋一上一下。你一动不动，因为你想，也许凭着他那廉价的外缘雷达，只要你不动作他就会失去你。但不。城市仔不会。你盯着他，他就只是回盯着你。就在这时攻击来了——不是从正面，不——是从侧面。来自你根本不知道存在的另外两台城市仔。你看，城市仔是群猎者。他使用协同攻击模式，而今天他倾巢而出。他用一门帝王自动炮——一件12吨重的反机甲武器——像右臂上的一把大锤那样朝你开火。他们不像驼背那样费劲去打驾驶舱；他们就打这里，中央躯干，还有这里，腿部。或者，也许打陀螺仪，把你洒满停机坪。重点是：他们开始吃你的时候，你还活着。ZH

column1: Alicia \"Hellion\" McEvedy comes from the Deep Periphery, only disclosing that she had a strict upbringing she couldn't stand anymore. A hotheaded, capable pilot, willing to get into the middle of any brawl and surprisingly adept at making LosTech just work. She has a deep distrust towards ComStar and smiles sharkishly when someone mentions the Exodus. She was also known as a Pirate Queen by the name of \"Lady Alekto\".
column2: 艾丽西亚·"捣蛋鬼"·麦克埃维迪来自深外围区，只肯透露自己受过一种再也无法忍受的严苛管教。她脾气火爆、能力出众，乐于冲进任何混战中心，还出人意料地擅长让失传技术听话运转。她对康星深怀戒心，一有人提起"出埃及"就露出鲨鱼般的笑。她还曾以"阿勒克托女士"之名被称为海盗女王。ZH

column1: Thomas Hobbes was an English philosopher and well-known stuffed tiger.
column2: 托马斯·霍布斯是一位英国哲学家，也是一只著名的毛绒老虎。ZH

column1: Idget was once a tech, solving issues - called 'tickets' in the jargon - that cropped up at work. After a pirate raid which saw massive casualties, the volume of tickets dropped significantly. Seeing such effective ticket-closing action, Idget quickly trained as a MechWarrior, promising to help solve tickets everywhere, one way or another. Working for mercenaries all over, Idget started to receive a reputation of being the best anti-urban-ambush pilot around, due to the methodical way in which buildings were leveled in the area of operations. They say that if you're lucky enough, when the tickets become too deep, Idget will come and save you.
column2: 伊吉特曾是一名技术员，负责解决工作中冒出来的问题——行话叫"工单"。在一次造成大量伤亡的海盗袭击之后，工单量大幅下降。看到如此高效的"清工单"行动，伊吉特迅速受训成为机师，承诺要到处帮忙解决工单，不管用什么办法。伊吉特为各地的雇佣兵工作，逐渐获得了"最擅长反城市伏击的机师"的名声，因为他们在行动区域内夷平建筑的手法极为条理分明。他们说，如果你运气够好，当工单积得太深时，伊吉特就会来救你。ZH

column1: An expert marksman, capable of drilling shot after shot through her enemies' defenses. She favors 'Mech chassis that were designed around single weapon types for devastating long-range precision fire. Preferred BattleMechs: Awesome AWS-8Q/T, Catapult CPLT-C1, JagerMech JM6-S/A
column2: 一名神射手，能一发接一发地穿透敌人的防御。她偏爱围绕单一武器类型设计的机甲底盘，以发挥毁灭性的远程精准火力。偏好机甲：神奇 AWS-8Q/T、弹射器 CPLT-C1、猎手机甲 JM6-S/A

column1: An adaptable pilot, capable of flexible responses to changing battlefield situations. When reserving her action she can be a deadly ambusher, striking and fading away before enemies have a chance to react.  <u>Preferred BattleMechs</u>: Any
column2: 一名适应性强的机师，能灵活应对变化的战场态势。当她保留行动时，可以成为致命的伏击者——在敌人有机会反应之前出击并遁去。<u>偏好机甲</u>：任意

column1: A stalwart combatant, capable of standing her ground against enemy fire while providing sustained direct fire from a stationary position. Equally capable in long- or short-ranged engagements. Preferred BattleMechs: Atlas AS7-D, Orion ON1-K/V, JagerMech JM6-S, Hunchback HBK-4G/P
column2: 一名坚定的战斗者，能在敌方火力下坚守阵地，从固定位置提供持续直射火力。远距离或近距离交战同样胜任。偏好机甲：阿特拉斯 AS7-D、猎户座 ON1-K/V、猎手机甲 JM6-S、驼背 HBK-4G/P

column1: An expert pilot, capable of tremendous feats in a jump-capable 'Mech. He favors flanking attacks, leaping into positions of advantage to set up multiple crossfires. Preferred BattleMechs: Jenner JR7-D, Vindicator VND-1R, Griffin GRF-1S
column2: 一名出色的机师，能驾驶具备跳跃能力的机甲做出惊人表现。他偏爱侧翼攻击，跃入有利位置以建立多重交叉火力。偏好机甲：詹纳 JR7-D、维护者 VND-1R、狮鹫 GRF-1S

column1: A master of support actions, the Kraken is deadly at any range. Capable of splitting his fire between multiple opponents, he prefers to carry weapons of every range band. Preferred BattleMechs: Centurion CN9-A/AL, Shadow Hawk SHD-2D, Orion ON1-K
column2: 支援行动的大师，海怪在任何距离都致命。他能把火力分给多个对手，偏爱携带覆盖所有射程段的武器。偏好机甲：百夫长 CN9-A/AL、暗影鹰 SHD-2D、猎户座 ON1-K

column1: An expert scout and support pilot. Mockingbird's primary role is providing sensor telemetry on the enemy to her lancemates, but she can hold her own in a fight if she has to. Preferred BattleMechs: Commando COM-2D/1B, UrbanMech UM-R60
column2: 一名出色的侦察与支援机师。"反舌鸟"的主要职责是为小队同僚提供敌方的传感器遥测数据，但必要时她也能在战斗中自保。偏好机甲：突击队员 COM-2D/1B、都市机甲 UM-R60

column1: A powerhouse fighter who can soak up enemy fire when shooting from a fixed position before bounding in for the final shot, Ozone is fearless and hearty. Preferred BattleMechs: Panther PNT-9R, Quickdraw QKD-5A, Vindicator VND-1R
column2: 作为一台强力战机，臭氧能在固定位置射击时吸收敌方火力，然后跃出完成最后一击；他无所畏惧且体魄强健。偏好机甲：黑豹 PNT-9R、快手 QKD-5A、维护者 VND-1R

column1: An agile pilot with a talent for avoiding incoming fire. He favors short range 'Mechs, nimbly sidestepping attacks while advancing towards the enemy's flank. Preferred BattleMechs: Kintaro KTO-18, Quickdraw QKD-4G, Victor VTR-9B/9S/b>
column2: 一名身手敏捷、擅长闪避来袭火力的机师。他偏爱近程机甲，在向敌方侧翼推进的同时灵活侧步避开攻击。偏好机甲：金太郎 KTO-18、快手 QKD-4G、维克多 VTR-9B/9S/b>

column1: Part daredevil, part Solaris gladiator, Showboat specializes in Death From Above. She prefers 'Mechs equipped with jump jets, small weapons, and extra armor, in that order. Preferred BattleMechs: UrbanMech UM-R60, Shadow Hawk SHD-2H/D, Griffin GRF-1N/S
column2: 一半是冒险家，一半是索拉里斯角斗士，炫耀女专精"从天而降"。她偏爱装备跳跃推进器、小型武器和额外装甲的机甲，按这个顺序。偏好战斗机甲：城市机甲 UM-R60、影子鹰 SHD-2H/D、格里芬 GRF-1N/S

column1: Sumo is a calm and brawny marksman who excels at standing his ground against multiple opponents. He tends to favor 'Mechs of the cannon-with-legs variety, trading range for sheer destructive potential and durability. Preferred BattleMechs: Hunchback HBK-4G, Atlas AS7-D, Orion ON1-K/V, Centurion CN9-A/AL
column2: 相扑是个沉稳而魁梧的神射手，擅长在多个对手面前站稳阵地。他倾向于"带腿的大炮"型机甲，用射程换取纯粹的破坏潜力与耐久性。偏好战斗机甲：驼背 HBK-4G、阿特拉斯 AS7-D、猎户座 ON1-K/V、百夫长 CN9-A/AL

column1: A split-fire specialist known for taking on swarms of lighter BattleMechs. She favors 'Mechs of the heavily-armed variety, sacrificing mobility for sheer volume of fire. Preferred BattleMechs: Awesome AWS-8T, BattleMaster BLR-1G, Atlas AS7-D
column2: 分火专家，以能应对成群轻型机甲闻名。她偏爱重武装型号，以机动性换取纯粹的火力密度。偏好机甲：神奇 AWS-8T、战将 BLR-1G、阿特拉斯 AS7-D

column1: A tactician and support pilot, Witness prefers to stay out of the thick of combat until needed. He uses advanced sensor techniques to resolve radar blips into firing solutions for his heavier allies. Preferred BattleMechs: Locust LCT-1V/M/S, Griffin GRF-1N/S
column2: 作为战术家与支援机师，"目击者"喜欢在需要之前远离战斗核心。他用先进传感器技术把雷达光点转为射击方案，供较重的友军使用。偏好机甲：蝗虫 LCT-1V/M/S、狮鹫 GRF-1N/S

column1: Kodiak was always a studious sort, learning about all the famous Solaris fighters over the centuries and where they and their 'Mechs came from. His research led him into the sights of Interstellar Expeditions, who had realised his knowledge of maps and technology stockpiles from different databanks did not align with their own. During his brief foray working for IE, Kodiak added much knowledge - collated from numerous sources - into the planetary databases of the Inner Sphere and the Periphery, leading to numerous updates to navigational databases across known space.    Becoming moderately wealthy due to the commission from IE, he then received passage to the Princefield Military Academy where he studied the training 'Mechs that still remained there - and learned to pilot these ancient behemoths. After graduation, the cartography royalties have kept him in a comfortable but extremely boring lifestyle, thus leading him into mercenary work. Seeking an outfit using unusual 'Mechs, Kodiak is known for being a steadfast pilot but definitely has the potential to bore other MechWarriors with tales of far-off worlds.
column2: 科迪亚克一向好学，热衷于了解数百年来所有著名的索拉里斯斗士，以及他们和他们的机甲来自何方。他的研究让他进入了星际探险协会（Interstellar Expeditions）的视野，该组织意识到，他对来自不同数据库的地图与技术储备的知识与自家资料并不吻合。在为IE短暂工作期间，科迪亚克将大量从众多来源整理出的知识添入内层星域和外围地区的行星数据库，促成已知空间内多处导航数据库的更新。由于IE的委托，他变得颇为富有，随后获准前往普林斯菲尔德军事学院，在那里研究仍留存于校内的训练机甲——并学会了驾驶这些古老巨兽。毕业后，地图版税让他过着舒适却极其乏味的生活，这最终促使他投身雇佣兵行业。他寻求使用非常规机甲的部队；科迪亚克以坚定不移的驾驶风格著称，但绝对有本事用远方世界的故事把其他机甲战士烦得够呛。ZH

column1: Natasha Jackson is our friendly neighborhood Black Marketeer. With her contacts, she can get us anything we need, if we are comfortable with her markups that is. Nicknamed Magpie for her love of shiny things, Natasha somehow manages to live a life of luxury even while on the run. Apparently her old network fell apart when she 'misplaced' a few packages, and she's been running from her creditors ever since. Apparently if we bring her aboard, she'll hook us up with a supply cache somewhere in-system. Even better, she claims to be a qualified mechanic and is licensed to drive a variety of ground crawlers. Maybe we could put her to use as a tank pilot?    XO's note: Boss, I hope you know what you are doing, letting Magpie on the ship. Anyone gets wind of her being on the ship before we are gone and we could have trouble on our hands.
column2: 娜塔莎·杰克逊是我们邻里友好的黑市商人。凭她的人脉，只要我们能接受她的加价，她就能弄到我们需要的任何东西。因喜爱闪亮之物而得绰号"喜鹊"，娜塔莎不知怎么地在逃亡之中还能过上奢华生活。显然她的旧网络因为她"放错"了几个包裹而瓦解，此后她一直在闪避债主。据说如果我们把她带上船，她会在星系内某处给我们接上一处补给藏点。更好的是，她自称是合格技师，还持有驾驶多种地面爬行器的执照。也许我们可以让她当坦克机师？执行官注：老大，我希望你知道自己在干什么，让喜鹊上船。要是我们出发前有人得知她在船上，我们可能就要有麻烦了。ZH

column1: Originally a MechTech in service of House Steiner, he got annoyed having to fix the broken mess he kept being brought. So, one day, he decided to set out into the world to break stuff for other MechTechs to fix.
column2: 他原本是施泰纳家族麾下的一名机甲技师，厌倦了不断被送来要他修的破烂货。于是有一天，他决定走进这个世界，去替别的机甲技师制造需要修的东西。ZH

column1: Hailing from the Lyran Commonwealth, \"Tex\" is a somewhat hotheaded but private MechWarrior. In typical mercenary fashion he's rowdy but reliable - when he's getting paid. He is also a professor of Inner Sphere history with a strong dislike of clanner society. A veteran of many campaigns, he has time and again demonstrated how to survive until payday.
column2: 来自莱兰联邦的"特克斯"是个有些急躁但寡言的机师。他以典型的雇佣兵作风行事：吵闹却可靠——只要有钱拿。他还是一位内天体历史教授，对氏族社会深恶痛绝。作为历经许多战役的老兵，他一次又一次地展示了如何活到发薪日。ZH

column1: Oddball sees his role as essentially defensive in nature. While our armies are advancing so fast and everyone's knocking themselves out to be heroes, he is holding himself in reserve in case the Clans mount a counteroffensive which threatens Solaris... or maybe even Terra itself. Then he can move in and stop them.
column2: 怪球认为自己本质上扮演的是防御性角色。当我们的军队推进得如此之快、人人都拼了命想当英雄时，他把自己留作预备，以防氏族发动反攻威胁索拉里斯……甚至可能是地球本身。到那时他就能出动并阻止他们。ZH

column1: Nicolette McKinney was born on Tyrlon VI, the middle child of middle-class parents. She was a quiet, undemanding child in a large and noisy family, and spent most of her time reading books. When she was a teenager, she made more friends, started career training, had a romantic relationship... and somehow, without anybody really noticing, Fell In With A Bad Crowd. It wasn't her, not really. It was her lover who, while a wonderful person, just couldn't seem to avoid getting in over their head with some really questionable people. And, over and over again, it was up to Nicolette to get them out of trouble. Eventually, those questionable people started paying Nicolette for her work, and she was lying every holiday to her family about what she did for a living, and she told herself every job was the last one. But every time she thought she'd escaped, her old friend would come back to her again. One day, after providing recon support on a sabotage mission, she realized just how far her employers had stretched. The ruling house of the Aurigan Coalition fell, and she, Nicolette McKinney was, just a tiny bit, culpable. That was the push she needed. She said farewell to her family, wrote a painfully long letter to her old lover, and talked her way onto the first mercenary ship she found leaving the system. She's been fighting ever since, and hoping like hell that nobody from her past life ever tracks her down.
column2: 妮可莱特·麦金尼出生在泰尔隆VI，是一对中产家庭夫妇的中间孩子。在一个喧闹的大家庭里，她是个安静、不惹事的孩子，大部分时间都在读书。十几岁时，她交了更多朋友，开始接受职业培训，谈了一场恋爱……然后不知怎么的，在几乎没人真正注意到的情况下，她"跟一帮坏人混到了一起"。问题不在她，真的不在。问题在她的恋人——那人虽然是个好人，却似乎总免不了跟一些极其可疑的人纠缠不清。于是一次又一次，都得靠妮可莱特把他们从麻烦里捞出来。最终，那些可疑的人开始为她的"服务"付钱，而她在每个假期都对家人撒谎说自己靠什么谋生，还每次告诉自己这是最后一单。可每当她以为自己终于脱身，那位老朋友又会回到她身边。有一天，在一次破坏任务中提供侦察支援之后，她意识到自己的雇主已经越界到了何等地步。奥里根联盟的执政家族垮台了，而她，妮可莱特·麦金尼，有一点点、一小点罪责。那就是她需要的推力。她告别家人，给旧日恋人写了一封长得令人痛苦的信，又凭三寸之舌混上了她找到的第一艘离开该星系的雇佣兵舰船。此后她一直在战斗，并且拼命祈祷上一个生活里的任何人都别找到她。ZH

column1: Ellis Simonsen was born and raised on a space station orbiting Coromodir V, the only child of a team of engineers who decided to have a child as a bonding exercise. It was, he freely admits, a weird childhood. He managed to develop a completely normal personality, with good metrics in every field that mattered and his parents are still patting themselves on the back about that twenty years later.    He went to a military academy on Coromodir VI, and after graduation pursued further schooling before joining the Royal Guard. There, he quickly became a popular lieutenant due to his mild personality, dependable nature and general patience. Unfortunately, in 3022, a new commanding officer made the mistake of assuming all those positive traits meant he would blindly obey illegal orders.    After incapacitating his commanding officer, he directed his command in the defense of House Arano until it was clear there was no immediate hope in that regard. He then saw to his command's safety before escaping off-world. Now, he works as a mercenary while monitoring the Aurigan situation, waiting for a chance to once again honor his oaths to House Arano.
column2: 埃利斯·西蒙森在环绕科罗莫迪尔V的太空站上出生并长大，是一对工程师夫妇唯一的孩子，他们决定生个孩子作为增进感情的练习。他坦然承认，那是个古怪的童年。他设法发展出了完全正常的性格，在每一个重要领域都有良好指标，二十年后他父母仍在为此沾沾自喜。他去科罗莫迪尔VI上的一所军事学院读书，毕业后又继续深造，然后加入皇家卫队。在那里，他凭借温和的性格、可靠的天性和一贯的耐心迅速成为一名受欢迎的中尉。不幸的是，3022年，一位新任指挥官犯了个错误，以为那些正面特质意味着他会盲目服从非法命令。在制服了他的指挥官之后，他指挥自己的部队为阿拉诺家族防守，直到明确看出这方面已无即时希望。随后他先安顿好部下的安全，才逃离行星。如今他做雇佣兵，一边留意奥里根的局势，等着有机会再次履行他对阿拉诺家族的誓言。ZH

column1: Page Alarcon was born on Ryans Fate, and feels that fully describes them. But just in case you're unfamiliar with Ryans Fate (lucky you!) they're willing to elaborate. They were one of many children of an industrial 'Mech pilot and her technician on a hot, desolate wasteland only valuable for the poison it harbors under the surface.    Page grew up constantly aware of the omnipresence of doom. It was unavoidable, but out of familial respect, Page made at least a token effort and thus made it to adulthood. Then, having already lost two siblings to the mines of Ryans Fate, they carefully weighed the risks and decided that, out of familial respect, piloting a mercenary BattleMech would be safer than staying at home.
column2: 佩奇·阿拉孔出生在瑞安之命，并觉得这已足以完整描述他们。但万一你不熟悉瑞安之命（算你走运！），他们愿意细说。他们是一名工业机甲机师与她的技师的众多孩子之一，那颗行星酷热荒凉，唯一的价值就在于地表之下蕴藏的毒物。佩奇从小就对厄运的无所不在深有体会。这无可避免，但出于对家族的尊重，佩奇还是做了最起码的努力，因此活到了成年。后来，在已经有两个兄弟姐妹死于瑞安之命的矿区之后，他们仔细权衡了风险，决定出于对家族的尊重，驾驶雇佣兵战斗机甲比留在家里更安全。ZH

column1: Tane Bennett was born on the archipelago of Zangul, on one of the roving fleets that served as fishing villages for the planet's solitary starport city. He spent most of his childhood barefoot, learning to climb and jump and instinctively calculate odd angles. When he was nearly grown, he was 'banished' to the starport for complaining too much about fishing. There, he saw his first BattleMech and was thoroughly unimpressed by how big and awkward they were. In the starport, his unique skills earned him unusual attention, and soon he was recruited by a mercenary company for a very particular form of covert operations. However, they neglected to properly indoctrinate him before unleashing him, and when the moment came for him to complete a particularly dishonorable assassination, he froze, fumbled, and fled. That was years ago. He never returned to his original mercenary company, but there are plenty of others. While he initially disliked BattleMechs, he now finds solace in piloting one. It's a way of earning his keep that reveals a face still on Wanted: dispatches only to his mercenary teammates.
column2: 塔内·班尼特出生在赞古尔群岛，生活在为该行星唯一星港城市充当渔村的一支支流动船队上。他童年大部分时间光着脚，学着攀爬、跳跃，并本能地计算古怪的角度。快成年时，他因为对捕鱼抱怨太多而被"流放"到星港。在那里，他第一次见到战斗机甲，并对它们又大又笨的样子大为不以为然。在星港，他独特的技能引起不寻常的关注，很快他就被一家雇佣兵公司招收，从事一种非常特殊的秘密行动。然而，他们忘了先把他好好洗脑就把他放了出去，当需要他完成一次特别不光彩的刺杀时，他僵住了、搞砸了、逃跑了。那是多年前的事。他再也没回到原来的雇佣兵公司，但别的公司多的是。虽然起初不喜欢战斗机甲，他如今在驾驶机甲中找到了慰藉。这是一种谋生方式，暴露出一个仍然挂在通缉令上的面孔：只派发给他的雇佣兵队友。ZH

column1: Some people say the spores of the fungal planet Regis Roost instill the inhabitants with a less than serious outlook on life. If so, that isn't apparent in Aadya Mehra. For Aadya, life is stern and life is earnest. She worked very hard on Regis Roost, learning everything she was taught, taking it all seriously. She thought deeply about everything around her; she even read poetry and, as a result, ran into walls a lot. They put her in a 'Mech early as a result. It started as one of those Regis Roost jokes. But the child had a gift, and it did mean she got fewer bruises from running into things. Of course when she grew up, she looked for work as a mercenary. The regular military would have probably kicked her out the first week - or so said her uncles - so it had to be mercenaries if she wanted to get off Regis Roost. And she really, really did. There were other planets with things like trees out there! Now that she has some experience as a mercenary, 'Mockingbird' tries her best to set an example for rookie pilots, and to emulate the more mature ones... sometimes to her own embarrassment.
column2: 有人说真菌行星雷吉斯巢穴的孢子会让居民对人生抱持不太严肃的态度。若果真如此，这在阿迪娅·梅赫拉身上并不明显。对阿迪娅来说，人生是严峻的，人生是认真的。她在雷吉斯巢穴非常用功，把教给她的一切都当真，什么都学。她对周围的一切都深思熟虑；她甚至读诗，结果常常撞上墙壁。正因如此，他们很早就把她塞进了机甲。起初这只是雷吉斯巢穴那种玩笑。可这孩子有天赋，而且这确实让她撞东西撞出的淤青少了些。当然，长大之后她便去找雇佣兵的活干。正规军队大概第一周就会把她踢出去——她的叔伯们是这么说的——所以如果她想离开雷吉斯巢穴，就只能当雇佣兵。而她真的、真的想离开。外面还有别的行星，那里有树之类的东西！如今有了一些雇佣兵经验，"仿声鸟"尽力为新手机师做表率，也努力效仿那些更成熟的人……有时反而闹得自己很难堪。ZH

column1: Einar Aliyev's bad luck started by being born on Panzyr, where a piece of space debris fell out of the sky and almost crushed the hospital. The only reason he survived his first day was due to the ancient BattleMech torso nearby where a decrepit old MechWarrior was enjoying his lunch. The old-timer saw the falling junk, fired up the 'Mech's lasers and blew it out of the sky. (This was, in fact, the old-timer's job, because stuff fell on Panzyr about every week around the time Einar was born.)    This pretty much set the tone for Einar's childhood. Something awful would happen to him as he was doing perfectly ordinary things like climbing on an overgrown spaceship wreck and yet, somehow, he'd survive. Barely. And then he'd get lectured on how he wasn't being careful enough.    So Einar grew up to be very, very careful indeed. And, as soon as he could, he left Panzyr, before something happened to make it impossible rather than merely very difficult. He had the fond but relieved farewells of his entire township, who rather hoped some of Panzyr's bad luck would go with him.    If it has, it's mostly been turned toward his enemies. He's a very competent MechWarrior, and well-liked among his peers. Nobody believes stories of his jinx, which is nice compared to back home. But he tries to not stay with any one company for long, all the same.
column2: 埃纳尔·阿利耶夫的霉运从他出生在潘泽尔就开始了，当时一块太空残骸从天上掉下来，差点砸扁那间医院。他头一天能活下来，全靠附近那台古老的战斗机甲躯干里有位衰朽的老机师正在享用午餐。那位老家伙看见坠落的垃圾，启动机甲激光器把它打了下来。（事实上这就是老家伙的工作，因为埃纳尔出生前后那段时间，几乎每周都有东西掉在潘泽尔。）这基本奠定了埃纳尔童年的基调。当他在做爬上一艘过度生长的太空船残骸这种再平常不过的事时，总会有可怕的事情发生，可不知怎么的，他总能活下来。勉强活下来。然后他会被人训话，说他还不够小心。于是埃纳尔长大后确实非常、非常小心。而且他一有可能就离开潘泽尔，赶在有什么事让它变得不可能、而不仅仅是很难之前。全镇的人都带着喜爱又释然的心情送别他，他们还挺希望潘泽尔的厄运会跟着他走。如果真跟着走了，那它大多转向了他的敌人。他是个非常能干的机师，在同侪中很受欢迎。没人相信他扫把星的传闻，比起老家这算不错。不过他仍尽量不在任何一家公司待太久。ZH

column1: Aleksandr Mizahri comes from Tyrlon V, where he probably had parents and was not actually constructed from spare parts by a sentient trash compactor. He grew up, he says, learning to translate between the strongly worded demands of AgroMechs and the overly-relaxed replies of the mail sorting robots.    It was tough keeping the peace between the two factions but somehow, by age ten, he managed it. As a result, he was accepted as a disciple of a particularly enlightened Dig King. While a disciple, he was taught The Way To Paradise, tested, found worthy, and then sent into the sky.    Although his mission is supposedly to spread knowledge of The Way, he's pretty terrible at evangelizing, preferring to drink, laugh, play card games and in general model 'good behavior'.    While the version he gives of his history is frankly ridiculous, there's not much else to be discovered. Born on the street, raised on the street, and coping however he could, he found something that brings him an inner glow and personal balance. He's very hard to rile up, and nobody can deny that he learned somewhere to be an excellent pilot.
column2: 亚历山大·米扎赫里来自泰尔隆 V。在那里他大概有父母，也并非由一台有自我意识的垃圾压缩机用备用零件拼装而成。据他说，他是在"翻译"农用机甲措辞强硬的诉求与邮件分拣机器人过分随意的回复中长大的。在两个派系间维持和平并不容易，但不知怎的，他到十岁时做到了。因此他被一位格外开明的"挖掘王"收为门徒。作为门徒，他被传授了"通往天堂之路"，经过考验被认为有资格，然后被送入天空。虽然他的使命号称是传播"道"的知识，但他实在不擅长布道——他更喜欢喝酒、大笑、打牌，以及总体上示范"良好行为"。他讲述的来历坦白说荒唐可笑，但也查不出别的。生于街头、长于街头，用尽办法应对生活，他找到了某种能带来内心光热与自我平衡的东西。他极难被激怒，而且没人能否认他在某处学到了如何成为一名出色的机师。ZH

column1: Amanda Ahn, who was born on 'a little planet nobody's ever heard of' always knew she was going to be a star. She started out by participating in local talent shows, where she repeatedly won Miss Congeniality, but didn't quite catch on with the local population of farmers and biologists. But after watching the 'Mech dance routine teenage Amanda put together, a supportive great-aunt scraped together the funds to take herself and her young charge off to Solaris VII. There Amanda trialed at several gladiatorial stables before her savvy great-aunt provoked a small bidding war between the stables to get Amanda one of the most excellent rookie contracts in recent history. It was an uncommon move, but Amanda Ahn was an uncommon find even in gladiatorial circles, and she went over big from the beginning. An absolute natural in the cockpit, she was a popular sensation due to her skills, style, optimism, and scrappiness.    She was living her dream, and she loved it, all the way until her great-aunt died. Her new agent, while good at the business end of things, didn't have Amanda's great-aunt's sense of how to protect Amanda's temperament from some of the darker elements of the Solaris VII gladiatorial world. As Amanda coped with the loss of a most beloved mentor, she was still expected to be her famously cheerful self. She couldn't do it alone, and turned to stimulants and alcohol for help. Eventually, as it did with so many gladiators, it backfired on her. Caught up in a hideous scandal, Amanda was advised by her new agent to leave Solaris VII for a few years so the scandal could be forgotten. Ashamed, and glad to escape from the pressures of Solaris VII celebrity, Amanda did so, heading out to the Periphery to take up work as a mercenary and, hopefully, keep her nose clean.
column2: 阿曼达·安生于"一颗没人听说过的小行星"，她始终知道自己会成为明星。她从参加地方才艺表演起步，屡次赢得"最受欢迎奖"，却始终没能真正打动当地的农场主与生物学家。但当人们的看到少女阿曼达编排的"机甲舞蹈"后，一位支持她的姑婆凑钱带着自己和这个小姑娘去了索拉里斯 VII。在那里阿曼达先在几家角斗士马厩试训，随后精明的姑婆挑起几家马厩之间的竞价战，为阿曼达争到了近代史上最优厚的新人合约之一。这是不寻常的一手，但阿曼达·安即使在角斗圈里也是不寻常的发现，她从一开始就大获成功。她驾驶舱里的天赋浑然天成，凭借技艺、风格、乐观与拼劲成为广受欢迎的轰动人物。她过着自己的梦想，也热爱这一切，直到姑婆去世。她的新经纪人在生意上很在行，却没有姑婆那种本领——懂得如何保护阿曼达的性情不受索拉里斯 VII 角斗圈阴暗面的侵蚀。在阿曼达承受失去至亲导师之痛时，人们仍期待她是那个出了名开朗的自己。她独自撑不下去，转向兴奋剂与酒精求助。最终，正如许多角斗士那样，这反噬了她。卷入一桩骇人丑闻后，新经纪人建议她离开索拉里斯 VII 几年，好让丑闻被淡忘。阿曼达羞愧难当，也庆幸能逃离索拉里斯 VII 名人的压力，于是照做，前往外围区当佣兵，希望能清清白白地过日子。ZH

column1: Samuel Dannen was a smart but troublesome child who devoured books and holovids about legendary MechWarriors.    Born on Kittery, he watched the 1st Kittery Borderers' exercises near the garrison as he grew up. Too poor to enter the local military academies, he spent years as a civilian, drifting between dead end jobs until he earned a position as a mechanic at the garrison. Some nights after repairing the 'Mechs, he would sneak back in. He spent these nights learning the complicated controls inside each 'Mech. That is until he was discovered one night and fired. No charges were pressed, but the head mechanic couldn't afford to keep him on any longer.
column2: 塞缪尔·丹嫩是个聪明却麻烦的孩子，狼吞虎咽地读着关于传奇机师的书与全息影像。他出生在基特里，成长过程中常看第一基特里边防军在驻地附近的演习。由于太穷上不起当地军事学院，他做了多年平民，在无前途的工作之间漂泊，直到在驻地谋得一个技师的职位。有些夜晚修完机甲后，他会偷偷溜回去。他用这些夜晚学习每台机甲内部复杂的控制装置。直到某晚被发现并被解雇。没有提起诉讼，但总技师再也养不起他了。ZH

column1: Born and raised on Mechdur, Anja Bray was orphaned early in a vehicle accident. She spent part of her childhood in a group home before being fostered with a family of small business owners and philanthropists. They saw that she received a good education, and after, that she had a place in their enterprise. Unfortunately, although she tried very hard to impress her benefactors, she was incurably honest. Not just honest, but truthful, in a way that embarrassed even customers of the business. Her family-turned-employers took her off the sales floor. Nobody wanted her on the admin level, so they sent her back to school for an advanced degree. They intended, eventually, to put her in an advisory position, but their kind intentions were derailed by happenstance. One day, while she was on a field trip, her convoy was attacked by one mercenary company, and rescued by another. During the battle, Anja found herself in a pilotless 'Mech and discovered that the same trait that made her unable to resist describing the problems with products also gave her a keen eye for picking out the perfect shots from a 'Mech cockpit. Well, it wasn't what her foster family wanted for their Anja, but they were too much the businesswomen to let an opportunity like that skate by. Soon Anja was working regularly as a convoy guard, which only lasted until she got bored enough to transfer to a mercenary company. Because, as she told her family, if she was going to sit in a 'Mech all day, she at least wanted to see new places. She promised she'd write them. Her letters have all sorts of interesting details, and they always know that if she says she's all right, she's doing just fine.
column2: 安雅·布雷在梅赫杜尔出生、长大，幼年因一场车祸成为孤儿。她的童年有一段时间在集体之家度过，后被一戸经营小生意并热衷慈善的家庭收养。他们让她接受了良好教育，之后又给了她一个在企业中的位置。不幸的是，尽管她极力想给恩人们留下好印象，她却诚实得无可救药。不只是诚实，而是实话实说——连公司的客户都被她弄得尴尬。从家人变成雇主的他们把她调离销售岗。没人愿意让她待在管理层，于是他们把她送回学校攻读高等学位。他们本打算最终让她做顾问，但这份善意被偶然事件打断。有一天她外出考察时，她的车队遭一家佣兵公司袭击，又被另一家所救。战斗中安雅坐进一台无人驾驶的机甲，发现正是那种让她忍不住挑剔产品问题的特质，也给了她一双从机甲驾驶舱里挑出完美射击的锐眼。嗯，这并不是养父母为他们的安雅设想的道路，但他们太是生意人了，不会放过这样的机会。很快安雅就常做车队护卫，直到她厌烦了、转入一家佣兵公司。因为正如她告诉家人的：既然她要在机甲里坐一整天，至少想看看新地方。她保证会给他们写信。她的信里有各种有趣的细节，而他们始终知道：只要她说自己没事，那就是一切安好。ZH

column1: Carson is lucky. He won't tell you that he is lucky, that'd jinx the whole damn thing. While growing up in Aurigan space on Smithon offered the Volkov family a bigger fraction of safety and peace compared to many other Periphery states, Carson certainly put his luck to the test serving in both infantry and armored divisions for several years. Eventually, he took a discarded Icarus II chassis and found his way into the local gladiatorial circuit and from there, became a merc.
column2: 卡森很幸运。他不会告诉你他很幸运，那样会把事情全毁了。虽然沃尔科夫一家在奥里根空间的史密森长大，比起外围区许多其他国家享有更多几分安全与安宁，卡森却先后在步兵与装甲部队服役数年，着实考验了自己的运气。最终，他弄到一具废弃的"伊卡洛斯 II"底盘，踏进当地的角斗圈，并由此成为佣兵。ZH

column1: Miranda Aguilera grew up in the Lyran Commonwealth. She was a tall kid who made a name for herself as 'the girl you don't mess with'. At eighteen, she signed up with a small-time mercenary company to feed her growing wanderlust. Miranda went undefeated in her crew's drinking games - and in the brawling that usually followed. When her fellow mercenaries turned to piracy, she was in. When they turned over a new leaf, she was out, and looking for a tougher crew.
column2: 米兰达·阿吉莱拉在莱兰联邦长大。她小时候个子很高，以“不好惹的女孩”而闻名。十八岁那年，为了满足日益膨胀的流浪渴望，她加入了一家小规模雇佣兵公司。在队伍的饮酒游戏里，米兰达从未输过——在随后通常发生的斗殴中也是如此。当她的雇佣兵同伴转向海盗行径时，她加入了。当他们改邪归正时，她退出了，并去寻找一支更凶悍的队伍。ZH

column1: Amir Kowalski was brought up as a loyal scion of House Liao, and sent to a military academy as soon as he was of age. There, he did not disappoint his family name and graduated on time. After graduation, by family request, he was assigned as a naval lieutenant aboard a Capellan Confederation DropShip. He served without particular distinction and was eventually transferred to a MechWarrior unit, which suited his abilities much better. After another tour of duty, in which he developed the motto: 'any battle you walk away from is a victory', he decided he wanted to pursue his own goals, and became a mercenary.
column2: 阿米尔·科瓦尔斯基作为廖家族的忠诚后裔被抚养长大，一到年龄就被送入军校。他没有辜负家族之名，按时毕业。毕业后应家族要求，他被派往一艘卡佩兰邦联空投艇担任海军中尉。他服役表现平平，最终被调入机甲战士部队——这更适合他的能力。又一轮服役期间，他总结出座右铭："任何你能走出来的战斗都是胜利"；此后他决定追求自己的目标，成为佣兵。ZH

column1: Jessica Chernovskaya had a peaceful and ordinary middle-class childhood in the heart of the Federated Suns. But even in the heart of civilization, you're not safe from a glitch. It was a garbled bioscan that got Jessica committed to a maximum security prison and changed her life. After ten years, her case was re-opened, the evidence re-examined, and her name cleared, but it was far too late for the kid Glitch had been. She'd learned skills on the inside, and she applied them on the outside. Killing for money is surprisingly easy and lucrative, and elite killers can command high prices for their discretion and effectiveness.
column2: 杰西卡·切尔诺夫斯卡娅在联邦太阳国的腹地度过了平静而普通的中产阶层童年。然而即便身处文明的核心地带，你也躲不过一次故障的捉弄。正是一次被扭曲的生物扫描让杰西卡被送进最高安全等级监狱，彻底改变了她的人生。十年之后，她的案件被重新审理，证据得以复核，她的名声也得以洗清——但对于当年那个孩子 Glitch 而言，一切都太迟了。她在狱中学会了一身本领，出狱后便将其付诸实践。为钱杀人出奇地容易，而且利润丰厚；顶尖杀手只要行事谨慎、效率出众，就能索取高昂的报酬。ZH

column1: Mohammed Benitez was born on one of Mechdur's lunar colonies and subsequently traveled with his prospector parents all over the system before moving to Katinka. There he attended a local technical school to augment the knowledge he'd picked up while growing up. He spent some time working as a tech on his parents' IndustrialMechs. Eventually, craving more excitement, he hitched a ride on a mercenary DropShip, where he soon talked his way into a BattleMech cockpit. He's never looked back.
column2: 穆罕默德·贝尼特斯出生于梅赫杜尔的一处月球殖民地，此后随其勘探者父母走遍整个星系，最后搬到卡廷卡。在那里他进入当地技术学校，充实了成长过程中积累的知识，并曾为父母的工业机甲担任技师。最终，渴望更多刺激的他搭上一艘雇佣兵空投艇，很快又靠一张嘴混进了战斗机甲驾驶舱。此后他再也没有回头。ZH

column1: An expert marksman, capable of drilling shot after shot through her enemies' defenses. She favors 'Mech chassis that were designed around single weapon types for devastating long-range precision fire. Preferred BattleMechs: Awesome AWS-8Q/T, Catapult CPLT-C1, JagerMech JM6-S/A
column2: 一名神射手，能一发接一发地穿透敌人的防御。她偏爱围绕单一武器类型设计的机甲底盘，以发挥毁灭性的远程精准火力。偏好机甲：神奇 AWS-8Q/T、弹射器 CPLT-C1、猎手机甲 JM6-S/A

column1: An adaptable pilot, capable of supporting changing battlefield situations. When reserving his action he can be a deadly ambusher, striking and fading away before enemies have a chance to react.  <u>Preferred BattleMechs</u>: Any
column2: 一名适应性强的机师，能为变化的战场态势提供支援。当他保留行动时，可以成为致命的伏击者——在敌人有机会反应之前出击并遁去。<u>偏好机甲</u>：任意

column1: Grampa Checkers is an old damn man. Even in the Inner Sphere, where age is less of an impediment for MechWarriors due to advanced medical proceedures and prosthetics, Grampa is very old to be a pilot. He didn't age gracefully either, often going off on random tangents and falling down a lot. Still, when you get him on-topic (and on-target), he proves to still be a crackshot in the cockpit. But you still have to deal with him on comms, which might not be worth it. Your call, Commander.
column2: 棋盘爷爷是个十足的老家伙。即便在内天体——那里先进的医疗手段与义体让机师的高龄不再是太大障碍——当机师对棋盘来说也实在太老了。他的老去也并不体面，常常东拉西扯地跑题，还经常摔倒。不过，只要你能让他聚焦正题（并瞄准目标），他在驾驶舱里依旧是个神枪手。但你还得忍受他在通讯里的唠叨，这或许并不值得。你自己定夺吧，指挥官。ZH

column1: More technician than warrior, drone operators are skilled in teleoperation of unmanned recon assets.
column2: 这些无人机操作员与其说是战士，不如说是技师，精通无人侦察资产远程操控。ZH

column2: 一支通用、平庸的车辆乘组，带传感器锁定，适合你不需要战斗乘组的场合。"Noncom"指的是"非战斗"，不是"非委任军官"。ZH

column1: Standard BattleMech armor is composed of several layers providing various degrees of protection and support. The first layer is extremely strong titanium alloyed with steel, the result of crystal alignment and radiation treatment, which is also very brittle. The second layer is a ceramic, cubic boron nitride, which combined with a web of artificial diamond fibers acts as a backstop to the steel layer. These two layers rest atop a titanium alloy honeycomb structure which provides support, and a layer of self-sealing polymer sealant which allows for space and underwater operations.
column2: 标准战斗机甲装甲由多层结构组成，提供不同程度的保护和支撑. 第一层是极其坚固的钛钢合金，经过晶体取向和辐射处理，但同时也非常脆. 第二层是陶瓷立方氮化硼，与人造金刚石纤维网结合，作为钢层的背衬. 这两层置于钛合金蜂窝结构之上，该结构提供支撑，并覆盖一层自密封聚合物密封剂，以实现太空和水下作战能力.

column1: Fuel Cell engines are primarily used in civilian applications like rail systems, personal transport, and IndustrialMechs. Fuel Cell engines generate electrical power that is then used by the vehicle to operate its propulsion system. A Fuel Cell engine has several advantages over the typical Internal Combustion Engine. While they require an oxidizer to operate, they are readily able to accept a stored oxidizer along with their fuel, making it a good choice for submarines, satellites, and naval applications. As most fuel cells run on hydrogen and oxygen, they have no exhaust other than water vapor so Fuel Cells are also used as generators for buildings and other large structures. Cannot use Additional Cooling Kits, Exchanger or Banks.
column2: 燃料电池引擎主要用于民用领域，如铁路系统、个人交通工具和工业机甲. 燃料电池引擎产生电能，供车辆驱动其推进系统. 与典型的内燃机相比，燃料电池引擎具有多项优势. 虽然它们需要氧化剂才能运行，但它们能够轻松接受储存的氧化剂和燃料，因此是潜艇、卫星和海军应用的理想选择. 由于大多数燃料电池以氢和氧为燃料，除水蒸气外无其他排放物，因此燃料电池也用作建筑物和其他大型结构的发电机. 无法使用附加冷却套件、换热器或蓄热器.

column1: A VTOL (Vertical Takeoff and Landing) craft is one that uses thrust to take off or land vertically, usually with the assistance of propellers and/or rotors. column1: The latest innovation in BattleMech technology is the Upper Leg Actuator Replacement, a cutting-edge component that replaces both the hip and upper leg actuators with a more compact design. Developed by our engineering team, this new actuator provides increased space and weight savings, allowing for more flexibility in mech design. However, there is a trade-off: while it provides excellent mobility, it comes at the cost of reduced stability. The unique design makes it more challenging to maintain balance and stand firmly on uneven terrain, which can impact the mech's stability during combat. Pilots will need to adapt their tactics accordingly and be mindful of the terrain they engage in.
column2: 战斗机甲技术的最新创新是大腿驱动器替换件——一种前沿部件，以更紧凑的设计替换髋关节驱动器与大腿驱动器。这一新型驱动器由我们的工程团队开发，可提供更多空间并节省重量，让机甲设计获得更大的灵活性。不过它也有取舍：虽然带来出色的机动性，代价却是稳定性下降。其独特设计使机甲更难保持平衡、在不平坦地形上站稳，从而可能影响机甲在战斗中的稳定性。机师需要相应调整战术，并在交战时留意所处地形。ZH

column1: Introduced in 2575 by the Terran Hegemony, the Laser Insulators were an advanced heat sink first used in the SLDF's Chippewa fighter. The laser bays in the fighter's wings were insulated from its superstructure and core systems with robust, lightweight aerogel blankets. While providing the equivalent of two standard heat sinks at a fraction of the weight, the primary drawback of the system was that it trapped the heat close to the source rather than allowing it to flow through the entire fighter to act as a thermal mass.
column2: 激光绝缘器由地球霸权于2575年推出，是一种先进散热器，首次用于SLDF的奇皮瓦战机。该战机机翼中的激光舱通过坚韧轻量的气凝胶隔热毯与其上层结构和核心系统隔开。它虽以极小的重量提供相当于两具标准散热器的效果，该系统的主要缺点是它把热量困在热源附近，而不是让它流过整架战机充当热质。ZH

column1: The Nano-Fluid Damper is still in prototype stage, but could be the next large step in reducing recoil of 'Mech-mounted weapons. Using a special hydraulic fluid containing a mix of high-volume, low-density nano-particles of various advanced polymer materials, the damper is able to reduce the recoil of even the heaviest of ballistic weapons, but at the risk of exploding on damage. The risk of exploding together with its prohibitively high construction cost, means it is still some way away from being adapted for general use.

column1: The Angel ECM Suite is an advanced version of the Guardian ECM Suite operating on a broader spectrum and greatly advances ECM technology on the battlefield. Development of the Angel began in the Draconis Combine shortly after the Battle of Luthien, but despite assistance from ComStar, cost overruns and internal problems within both powers kept it in its experimental stages for a long time and delayed its widespread deployment. This component has extra armor for a large increase in durability.
column2: 天使ECM套件是守护者ECM套件的高级版本，在更宽的频谱上运行，极大地推进了战场上的ECM技术. 天使的开发在天龙联合体于卢西恩战役后不久便开始，但尽管得到了ComStar的协助，成本超支以及双方内部问题使其长期停留在实验阶段，并推迟了其广泛部署. 此组件拥有额外装甲，大幅提高了耐久性.

column1: An OmniMech is a highly configurable type of BattleMech. OmniMechs mount some of their loadout in modular OmniPods. This gives Omnis the ability to replace damaged components and change battlefield role to fulfill mission requirements. Though not solely created for modular weapon loadouts, the OmniMech design greatly aids repair and construction. Once their modular weaponry and equipment is removed, the empty bays provide better access to repair the chassis. Damaged components such as arms and legs can be easily repaired in half the time it takes for common BattleMechs.
column2: 万能机甲是一种高度可配置的战斗机甲类型. 万能机甲将其部分载荷安装在模块化的OmniPod中. 这使得万能机甲能够替换受损部件，并根据任务需求改变战场角色. 虽然并非仅为模块化武器载荷而创造，但万能机甲设计大大有助于维修和建造. 一旦其模块化武器和装备被移除，空置的舱室便能提供更好的通道来修理底盘. 诸如手臂和腿部等受损部件可以轻松修复，所需时间仅为普通战斗机甲的一半.

column1: Converts an SHS engine to LHS. A Mech' Cooling System provides heat dissipation for components inside the mech and compatible extension points for additional heat sinks throughout the mech. It differs from the closed cooling system of the engine. Unlike a normal heat sink which uses radiators and heat-conductive fluids to cool a 'Mech, a laser heat sink uses lasers to excite the hot exhaust gasses to a higher-energy state, converting the infrared energy of the gasses to light which is then shunted out of the 'Mech via a series of highly polished surfaces. Functionally identical to a Clan-tech double heat sink, the lack of liquid and gas in the system reduces the chances of heat-based ammunition cook-off and means that laser heat sinks don't get the decreased performance on warmer worlds that single and double heat sinks have, while at the same time preventing laser heat sinks from taking advantage of immersion in water or colder weather to boost their performance.
column2: 把单重散热器引擎转换为LHS。机甲的冷却系统为机甲内部组件提供散热，并提供兼容的延伸点以在整台机甲上增设散热器。它与引擎的封闭式冷却系统不同。与使用散热器和导热流体来冷却机甲的普通散热器不同，激光散热器用激光把高温废气激发到更高能态，将气体的红外能量转换为光，再通过一系列高度抛光的表面导出机甲。它在功能上与氏族科技双重散热器完全相同，系统中不含液体和气体，降低了弹药因受热而殉爆的几率，也意味着激光散热器不会像单重和双重散热器那样在较热的行星上性能下降；同时，激光散热器也无法借助浸水或寒冷天气来提升性能。ZH

column1: Environmental sealing adds airtight, hermetic protection to units that otherwise can't operate in vacuum, toxins, or underwater. The retrofit increases chassis mass and cost, fitting cabins and critical compartments with tight seals, air tanks, filters, and scrubbers. This keeps crews safe and mechanisms moving, but doesn't guarantee air-breathing engines will run submerged.

column1: Developed by the Terran Hegemony in 2487, Endo Steel was designed especially for use in BattleMech skeletons. Using zero-G manufacturing techniques that uniformly mix high-density steel with lower-density titanium and aluminum, the process produces a metal twice as strong per unit of weight as standard skeleton materials thus halving the weight of the chassis, but at an increase in overall bulk.
column2: 【Endo-Steel】钢内骨结构由泰拉霸权于2487年研发，专为战斗机甲骨架而设计. 利用零重力制造技术，将高密度钢与低密度钛和铝均匀混合，该工艺生产出的金属在单位重量上的强度是标准骨架材料的两倍，从而使底盘重量减半，但整体体积有所增加.

column1: The pilot of each ProtoMech sits in a high-tech cacoon of composite armor and neural link equipment. If breached by enemy fire it could become their coffin. Mech pilots talk about the mech becoming an extension of one's body. But for a protomech warrior their suit becomes their body. It's senses are fed directly into theirs. The impulses from their motor cortex are translated into its motions. Any violence done to, or by, the protomech is experienced as if the suit was their real body. Protomech pilots have a reputation for being crazy, but they don't all start that way; If the degenerative effects of Enhanced Imaging implants don't get you, the PTSD will.

column1: The quadruped-style ProtoMechs faced numerous minor design hurdles, not the least of which was the unique quirk of the pilot-ProtoMech interface that virtually demanded a human-style gait and mobility. When these issues were worked out—either through intensive training or use of the Society's infamous Feralize treatments — the four-legged ProtoMechs that resulted achieved faster mobility and greater payload capacity than their bipedal equivalents. ProtoQuads could even make use of turret-based weapons similar to the Inner Sphere’s fourlegged battlesuits, and could be built in the standard weight range as well as the Ultraheavy category.
column2: 四足型原型机甲曾面临诸多细小的设计难题，其中尤为突出的是机师与原型机甲接口的独特特性——它几乎要求机甲具备人类式的步态与机动方式。当这些问题——无论是通过强化训练，还是动用学会臭名昭著的“野化”处理——得到解决后，由此诞生的四足原型机甲在机动速度与载荷能力上都超过了同等重量的双足型号。原型四足机甚至可以使用类似内层星域四足战斗服的炮塔式武器，并且既能按标准重量范围建造，也能归入超重型级别。ZH

column1: ProtoMechs mass between two to fifteen metric tons and stand anywhere from four to six meters in height, with the cockpit mounted in the upper chest. With their fusion engines, they can move considerably faster than battle armor but are more compact than BattleMechs. It was not until the development of the Enhanced Imaging (EI) system by Clan scientists that the ProtoMech concept became a viable one. The EI control system laid the groundwork needed by Smoke Jaguar scientists for controlling the ProtoMech. The ability to give the pilot direct neural control eliminated the need for a gyroscope and full-sized cockpit. This gave room for the pilot to ride in the torso while still allowing ample space for weapons. The ultimate goal of these machines is for a Point of five, working in unison, to be as effective as a BattleMech, while requiring less than half the amount of construction resources.
column2: 原型机甲质量为二至十五公吨，高度四至六米，驾驶舱装在胸部上方。凭借聚变引擎，它们能比战斗装甲快得多地移动，又比战斗机甲更紧凑。直到氏族科学家研发出增强成像（EI）系统，原型机甲的概念才变得可行。EI控制系统为烟虎科学家提供了控制原型机甲所需的基础。让机师实现直接神经控制的能力，免除了对陀螺仪和全尺寸驾驶舱的需求。这让机师能坐在躯干内，同时仍为武器留出充足空间。这些机器的终极目标，是让一个五点编队协同作战时能达到一台战斗机甲的效能，而所需建造资源不到一半。ZH

column1: Uniquely designed for bipedal Ultras as a consequence of the design's specialized motive systems, Gliders are low-altitude, limited-flight ProtoMechs that rely on a combination of thrust and glide wings that effectively mimic how LAMs operate in AirMech mode. Their elaborate flight systems, which include an adapted form of ProtoMech partial wing technology, modified jump thrusters, and a specialized musculature, are specifically designed to give them greater mobility in the air. As a result, Gliders have very little ground speed.
column2: 滑翔机是专为双足超轻型原型机甲设计的，这是该设计特化动力系统的结果；它们是低空、有限飞行的原型机甲，依靠推力与滑翔翼的组合，实际模仿了LAM在空甲模式下的运作方式。它们精密的飞行系统包括一种改编自原型机甲部分翼技术的形态、改造过的跳跃推进器以及特化的肌肉组织，专为赋予它们更高的空中机动性。因此滑翔机的地面速度非常低。ZH

column1: The Void Signature System is a hybrid evolution of Star League era systems such as the Chameleon Light Polarization Shield and the Null Signature System. Essentially a scaled up version of the Battle Suits Mimetic Armor, the Void Signature System shields a BattleMech's presence from both visual and electronic detection with help from a paired ECM suite.  Reserves 6 slots and requires an ECM.
column2: 虚空信号系统是星际联盟时代多种系统（比如变色龙光偏振护盾和无效信号系统）的混合演进产物。它本质上就是战斗装甲所用拟态装甲的放大版，在配对 ECM 套件的协助下，将战斗机甲的存在从视觉和电子探测中隐藏起来。占用 6 个槽位，并需要一具 ECM。ZH

column1: Developed under RISC's classified Phantom Initiative, the Wraith Suppression Shield System, or W3S, advances Star League mimetic principles through an active phased-array optical disruption field. Adaptive polarization cells across the mech's surface continuously sample and reproject surrounding terrain, blurring visual resolution at a considerably higher level than previous iterations such as CLPS.  By the time anyone noticed that even the abbreviated name was a bit of a mouthful, it was too late to redesignate the project. Most Mechwarriors just call it 'God Mode.'
column2: 幽灵压制护盾系统（W3S）在RISC机密“幽灵计划”下研制，通过主动相控阵光学干扰场推进了星际联盟的拟态原理。遍布机甲表面的自适应偏振单元持续采样并重新投射周围地形，其视觉分辨率模糊程度远高于CLPS等先前方案。等到有人意识到就连这个缩写都拗口得离谱时，项目早已来不及改名。大多数机甲战士干脆叫它“上帝模式”。ZH

column1: Targeting Computers are sophisticated pieces of electronics that, unlike normal targeting systems, physically help MechWarriors target their opponents. Recoil compensators and gyroscopic stabilizers are used to prevent normal weapon drift from factors such as recoil and movement while the computer accounts for atmospheric and other conditions to present an accurate ''lead'' on the target. This allows for more surgical precision of weapons fire, especially with naturally accurate systems.
column2: 瞄准计算机是精密的电子设备，与普通瞄准系统不同，它以物理方式协助机师瞄准对手。反冲补偿器与陀螺稳定器用于防止因后坐力和移动等因素造成的常规武器偏移，同时计算机会考虑大气及其他条件，对目标给出精确的"提前量"。这让武器射击具有更外科手术式的精度，尤其对本身精准的系统更是如此。ZH

column1: Targeting Computers are sophisticated pieces of electronics that, unlike normal targeting systems, physically help MechWarriors target their opponents. Recoil compensators and gyroscopic stabilizers are used to prevent normal weapon drift from factors such as recoil and movement while the computer accounts for atmospheric and other conditions to present an accurate ''lead'' on the target. This allows for more surgical precision of weapons fire, especially with naturally accurate systems. This system has been further improved to help the mechwarrior to aim more accurate in all ranges.
column2: 瞄准计算机是精密的电子设备，与普通瞄准系统不同，它以物理方式协助机师瞄准对手。反冲补偿器与陀螺稳定器用于防止因后坐力和移动等因素造成的常规武器偏移，同时计算机会考虑大气及其他条件，对目标给出精确的"提前量"。这让武器射击具有更外科手术式的精度，尤其对本身精准的系统更是如此。该系统经过进一步改进，帮助机师在所有射程上瞄得更准。ZH

column1: The Hypervelocity Autocannon (HVAC) family of weapons is based on the Autocannon. While they have the same damage classes, they're capable of firing much further. However, in order to obtain the increased ballistic range, the hypervelocity ammo is larger and uses a unique type of propellant, reducing the number of shots per ton of ammo along with a couple other drawbacks, such as a chance of the weapon exploding, and a thick smoke trail every time the weapon is fired. Uses HVAC10 Ammo.

column1: Developed by Lubalin Ballistics for the Terran Hegemony, the LB-X Autocannon was a derivative of the standard and relatively primitive Autocannon design. Uses LBX10 Ammo.

column1: The Autocannon LB 10-X-P is the prototype of what eventually became the normal LB 10-X. Developed to fill the need for a dual-purpose weapon capable of both powerful direct fire as well as anti-air fire, the LB 10-X-P utilizes two different ammunition types: traditional armor-piercing shells as well as flechette shells that proved as equally capable in anti-air roles as in anti-armor and anti-personnel roles. The SLDF debuted the prototype autocannon in time to participate in the final battles in both the Rim Worlds Republic and the Taurian Concordat, while those two nations fielded only a relative handful of prototypes before the end of the war.
column2: LB 10-X-P自动炮是最终成为标准LB 10-X的原型产品. 为满足既能进行强力直射又能进行防空的双重用途武器的需求而开发，LB 10-X-P使用两种不同的弹药类型: 传统的穿甲弹以及被证明在防空、反装甲和反人员角色上同样有效的飞镖弹. SLDF及时让这款原型自动炮在边缘世界共和国和金牛协约国的最终战斗中亮相，而这两个国家在战争结束前只部署了相对少数的原型机.

column1: Developed by Lubalin Ballistics for the Terran Hegemony, the LB-X Autocannon was a derivative of the standard and relatively primitive Autocannon design. Uses LBX2 Ammo.

column1: The Rotary Autocannon is based only loosely on the Autocannon. column1: Also known as flechette weapons, needler weapons (or simply needlers) are typically useless on the battlefield, specifically against battlesuits and other armored units. Essentially a projectile weapon that uses a block of treated polymer for ammunition, a needler sprays a shotgun-like cloud of shredded plastic, intended to rip through lighter personal armor and bare flesh. While devastatingly effective in close-quarters, anti-personnel situations, the typical needler lacks the range and the armor penetration to be of much use beyond crowd control or spacecraft boarding missions.
column2: 针刺武器（又称飞镖武器）通常被视为战场上的鸡肋，尤其是面对战斗服及其他装甲单位时. 究其本质，这是一种采用经处理聚合物块作为弹药的投射武器，能喷射出类似霰弹枪的碎塑料弹幕，旨在撕开轻型单兵装甲和裸露的肉体. 尽管在近身反人员场合具有毁灭性的杀伤效果，但典型的针刺武器缺乏足够射程与穿甲能力，因此除了人群控制和飞船登舰任务外，其用途十分有限.

column1: This is a rare weapon indeed, a Pop-Up Mine designed for mounting on the Sloth Battle Armor suit. The first quad battle armor, the Sloth was designed to carry this mine into combat and deploy it while directly beneath the target mech. The mine would then pop up and penetrate the armor from below, dealing direct structure damage. The BA-scale Pop-Up Mine was only ever deployed on the Sloth and fell out of favor along with the Sloth as technology advanced and suits became more complex.
column2: 这确实是一种稀有武器，一种设计用于安装在Sloth战斗装甲服上的弹出式地雷. 作为第一种四足战斗装甲，Sloth被设计用于携带这种地雷进入战斗，并在目标机甲正下方部署. 地雷随后会弹出并从下方穿透装甲，造成直接结构损伤. 战斗装甲级别的弹出式地雷仅曾在Sloth上部署，随着技术进步和装甲服变得更为复杂，它与Sloth一同失宠.

column1: Combines are agricultural equipment using rotating blades to thresh grain crops. Built from sturdy materials for durability, they're rarely used in combat, usually mounted on AgroMechs or farming vehicles only out of desperation, since they inflict negligible damage against armored units. Against unarmored infantry, however, a combine isn't desperation but cruelty, capable of shredding soft targets in seconds.
column2: 收割机是使用旋转刀片脱粒谷物的农业设备。它由坚固材料制成以求耐用，很少用于战斗，通常只因绝望才装在农用机甲或农用车辆上，因为它对装甲单位的伤害微不足道。然而面对无装甲步兵，收割机就无关绝望而是残忍了，能在数秒内把软目标撕成碎条。ZH

column1: Rivet guns, popularized by Sheridan Constructs' SC-M \"Powerjoin\" series, drive white-hot rivets at high speed through construction materials. Ineffective against BattleMech armor, they can pierce personal body armor and cause serious foreign-object damage to stripped armor sections. column1: Based on the weapon used by infantry for centuries, the Mech Mortar fires a small shell in a high arc that falls onto the target. Though the Mech Mortar was created by the Terran Hegemony, by 2835 the Succession Wars had relegated it to history. With the reintroduction of the Anti-Missile System, engineers revived the Mech Mortar concept. The munitions used by the mortars, though often possessing limited guidance packages, weren't destroyed by AMS systems in tests. Mortar shells also proved very adaptable, accepting several types of payloads. Uses Mortar Ammo.
column2: 机甲迫击炮基于步兵使用了数世纪的武器，以高弧线发射小型炮弹落向目标。虽然机甲迫击炮由地球霸权创造，到 2835 年继承战争已把它扫入历史。随着反导系统的重新引入，工程师们复活了机甲迫击炮的概念。迫击炮所用弹药虽通常制导组件有限，但在测试中不会被 AMS 拦截。迫击炮弹还被证明适应性极强，可接受多种载荷。使用迫击炮弹药。

Though this was seen as a step backwards in technological development, the inexpensive and deadly MRMs have spread throughout the Draconis Combine and to many mercenary units. Uses MRM Ammo.

column1: The plasma rifle was developed by the Capellan Confederation. Based upon their man-portable version, the Confederation created what is essentially a massive flamer. Plasma weapons use the power of the fusion engine or power amplifiers to power an electromagnetic accelerator to a stream, pulse, or toroid of plasma (i.e. very hot, energetic, and excited matter). The plasma is created by using a lasing process to flash cartridges of plastic foam into white-hot projectiles that cause thermal, as well as physical, damage. Because this foam ammo is inert, it will not explode even if destroyed.Uses Plasma Ammo.
column2: 等离子步枪由卡佩兰联邦研发。联邦以其单兵便携版本为基础，造出了本质上是一具巨型火焰喷射器的武器。等离子武器利用聚变引擎或动力放大器的能量驱动电磁加速器，将等离子（即极高温、高能、激发态的物质）以流、脉冲或环面形式发射出去。等离子通过激光过程将塑料泡沫弹匣瞬间汽化，形成白热射弹，造成热能与物理伤害。由于这种泡沫弹药是惰性的，即使被摧毁也不会爆炸。使用等离子弹药。

column2: 无壳自动炮弹药由联邦联邦开发，以提供更多弹药。无壳弹不用装满发射药的标准金属或塑料弹壳，而是把发射药"包"在弹丸周围。弹药箱受到暴击时，其内剩余弹药会爆炸并对所在部位造成伤害。使用 C.A.S.E. 可以降低此风险。ZH

column1: Doubled Ammo Bins replace one ammo bins feeding and storing mechanism to fit 25% more shots into one location. column2: 双倍弹药箱通过替换单个弹药箱的供弹和储存机构，在同一位置多容纳25%的弹药. 在遭受暴击时，弹药箱内储存的任何剩余弹药都会爆炸，对安装位置造成伤害. 使用C.A.S.E.可以降低此风险.

column1: Inferno ammunition can be used in standard autocannons and their lighter cousins. Developed by NAIS scientists from the Federated Suns, these autocannon rounds contained an Inferno warhead and were covered in a thin coat of magnesium.

column1: C.A.S.E. ammunition bins are designed with blast plates facing away from vital components on a mech. column1: A thermobaric or Fuel Air Explosion (FAE) explosion occurs when fuel is aerosolized with a scattering charge and then detonated. The resulting explosion is significantly more energetic than a conventional high explosive of the same mass. While the name suggests an incendiary effect the fuel is detonated not burnt. The heat is immense but of very short duration; however flammable materials are likely to be ignited. Primary damage is caused by the massive blast followed by a near vacuum in the area, which quickly collapses. The shockwaves are devastating to structures and armored units. Exposed personal who are unlucky enough not to be vaporized by the blast often die slowly, lungs and eardrums ruptured by the catastrophic pressure differentials. Ammo Bins contain the rounds needed for projectile-based weaponry, with at least one bin required per weapon type. Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.

column1: This ammunition is an attempt to make primitive Rifle weapons effective in the face of modern armor. Armor Piercing Fin Stabilized Discarding Sabot munitions have been used for centuries. column2: 资产拒止

column1: A {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} detachment of fire support vehicles is on the move to a strategic location. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} would prefer that they do not reach their destination.
column2: 一支 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} 火力支援车辆分遣队正在前往某战略地点。{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 希望它们到不了目的地。ambushconvoy

column1: Commander, the targets will probably be on the slow and squishy side. But the reason we're being asked to hit them in transit, outside entrenched positions, is because they pack a punch.
column2: 指挥官，目标很可能又慢又脆。但之所以要我们在运输途中、在既设阵地之外打击他们，是因为他们火力不弱。ambushconvoy

column2: 任务完成。火力支援车辆已被清除。ambushconvoy

column1: Nothing more to do here Commander, lets go home.
column2: 这里没别的可做了，指挥官，回家吧。ambushconvoy

column1: The target vehicles should be just ahead. Be careful commander, who knows what they're packing.
column2: 目标车辆应该就在前方。小心，指挥官，谁知道它们带了什么。ambushconvoy

column1: That's got it, primary target damaged. Keep on those ones.

column1: We've got company!

column1: Reprisal
column2: 报复

column1: We need you to destroy a convoy of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} vehicles that was involved in a strike on our holdings. You like credits, yes?
column2: 我们需要你摧毁一支 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} 的车队，他们参与了对我们领地的一次打击。你喜欢信用点，对吧？ambushconvoy

column1: There's not a lot of detail here, Commander.
column2: 这里细节不多，指挥官。ambushconvoy

column1: I'll keep an eye out from up here.

column1: Mission accomplished.

column1: Our employer didn't include that detail. Completing this contract could have serious consequences, Commander.

column2: 这份合约也许失败对我们的声望比完成更有利。ambushconvoy

column1: One down.

column1: A lance of newly manufactured {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} 'mechs is being moved overland from manufacturing facilities to a their garrison. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} would like these units destroyed before they enter military service.
column2: 一个连新出厂的 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} 机甲正从制造设施经陆路运往其驻地。{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 希望这些单位在服役前被摧毁。ambushconvoy

column1: Commander, from what I understand the mechs are being piloted by either rookies or support staff. They'll likely try to escape rather than battle. They will have an escort however.
column2: 指挥官，据我了解，这些机甲的机师要么是新手，要么是后勤人员。他们多半会试图逃跑而不是战斗。不过他们会有一支护卫队。ambushconvoy

column2: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 正以快速车队通过信使运送机密信息。让这些信息永远无法抵达目的地符合我们的利益。我们不知道哪辆车携带目标信息，因此需要你摧毁全部车辆。ambushconvoy

column2: 守卫部队已经解决; 明智之举.

column1: Backyard Barbecue
column2: 后院烧烤

column1: Clever smugglers, hiding in plain sight. Now that their cover's blown, they're likely to call for military backup.
column2: 这些走私者很聪明，藏在大庭广众之下。既然他们的伪装已经暴露，他们很可能会呼叫军事支援。ZH

column1: We maintain a very accurate registry of all military convoys on this planet. Recently, an analyst spotted something odd: a convoy that wasn't accounted for anywhere in our records. It's been regularly traveling along one of our standard logistical routes, and using our logistical comms, which is how it evaded detection for so long. Our signals intercepts tell us they're {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} drivers, so we have to assume they're smuggling right in our own backyard. We don't want to spook them with our own military comm chatter; we need an independent force to intercept and destroy them.
column2: 我们对该星球上所有军事车队都保有极为准确的登记。最近，一名分析员发现了异常：一支在任何记录中都不存在的车队。它一直规律地沿我们的一条标准后勤路线行进，并使用我们的后勤通讯——这正是它长期未被发现的缘故。我们的信号截获显示机师是{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}人，因此我们必须假定他们就在我们自家后院走私。我们不想用自己的军用通讯去打草惊蛇；我们需要一支独立力量去拦截并摧毁他们。ZH

column2: 摧毁 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 护卫

column1: According to these survey maps, you should be able to see the convoy's route from this location.
column2: 根据这些勘测图，从这个位置你应该能看到车队的路线。ZH

column1: Enemy Reinforcements, get ready for contact.
column2: 敌方增援，准备接敌。ZH

column1: One down. Keep engaging those threats and we'll be out of here.
column2: 解决一个。继续对付那些威胁，我们就能离开这里了。ZH

column1: Only if we take out that convoy, Meyer.
column2: 除非我们干掉了那支车队，梅耶尔.

column1: Seems like our employers may have a leak.
column2: 似乎我们的雇主有内鬼.

column1: That's got it, keep firing on those targets until they are neutralized.
column2: 打中了，继续向那些目标开火直到它们被消灭。ZH

column1: The convoy is finished, now get what mechs you have to the extraction point and we'll pull you out. Move quickly.

column1: This contract turned out to be slightly more exciting than we were led to believe.
column2: 这份合约已证明比我们受引导而相信的那样还要刺激一点.

column1: We have a lock on the target vehicles. They should be to your front. Engage and destory, Commander.
column2: 我们已锁定目标车辆。他们应该在你正前方。交战并摧毁，指挥官。ZH

column1: Clever smugglers, hiding in plain sight. Now that their cover's blown, they'll probably call for military backup.
column2: 这些走私者很聪明，藏在大庭广众之下。既然他们的伪装已经暴露，他们大概会呼叫军事支援。ZH

column1: This contract turned out to be quite a bit more exciting than we were led to believe.
column2: 这份合约已证明比我们受引导而相信的那样还要刺激的多.

column1: Yes. This was clearly a trap, and our employers let us stumble right into it. Commander, clear out that convoy while I have a conversation with our {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} contact.
column2: 是的. 这明显是个陷阱，我们的雇主要我们掉进去. 指挥官，在我联系我们的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}联络人的时候清理那支车队.

column1: Covert Supplies
column2: 秘密补给

column1: Our employers don't really have any more legitimate a claim to this system than anyone else, but they do have the money to hire us, which is a solid argument for ownership.
column2: 我们的雇主对这个星系的主权主张其实并不比其他人更正当，但他们有钱雇佣我们，而这本身就是所有权的一个有力论据。ZH

column1: A routine orbital survey of {TGT_SYSTEM.name} picked up coded transmissions from the surface. Our intelligence experts believe these transmissions come from a well-hidden {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility in this supposedly uninhabited system. Needless to say, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} is not willing to tolerate secret military bases in this region. We need a mercenary company to intercept one of the supply caravans traveling to the secret base. Even if we can't find their facility, we can still starve them out.
column2: 对{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的一次例行轨道勘测接收到了来自地表的加密传输。我们的情报专家认为这些信号来自这个据称无人居住的星系中一处隐蔽的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}设施。不用说，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}不会容忍本区域存在秘密军事基地。我们需要一家雇佣兵公司拦截前往该秘密基地的补给车队。即便找不到他们的设施，我们也能把他们饿死。ZH

column1: Escorts are down, Commander. Good work. Let's wrap this up.

column1: Good luck, Commander.

column1: That's a disappointing result, Commander.

column1: The convoy's almost escaped, Commander. You need to step it up or we're going to miss the window of opportunity.
column2: 车队快要逃脱了，指挥官。你得加快节奏，否则我们就要错过这次机会了。ZH

column1: Then proceed to the evac point for pickup.

column1: Well done, Commander. Drinks are on me.
