column1: Commander, the target is bugging out! Eliminate them before they escape.
column2: 指挥官，目标正在逃跑！在他们逃掉之前消灭他们。ZH

column1: Commander, you're in the AO, and we're expecting hostile contacts.
column2: 指挥官，你已进入作战区域，预计会有敌对接触。ZH

column1: Mission accomplished. The target is dead. Well done, Commander.
column2: 任务完成. 目标死亡. 做得不错，指挥官.

column1: Readings indicate the ambushing units are out of commission. The employer will be pleased.
column2: 读数显示伏击单位已失去作战能力。雇主会满意的。ZH

column1: Recon has provided the general vicinity of the diplomat.
column2: 侦察确认了外交官大致就在附近.

column1: Sensors are showing enemy movement beyond our initial count. Be advised you might meet with increased resistance.
column2: 传感器显示敌军动向超出我们最初的判断。请注意，你可能会遇到更强的抵抗。ZH

column1: Take the target out, and get to the evac zone. Oliveira out.
column2: 消灭目标，然后到撤离区域去. 奥利维拉完毕.

column1: That is our target, sustain fire on that unit!
column2: 那就是我们的目标，对那个单位持续开火！ZH

column1: Time to make a withdrawal. No way of getting out clean on this one.
column2: 是时候撤退了. 没办法利落地抽身了.

column1: Destroy enemy Ambushers before extraction
column2: 在撤离前摧毁敌方伏击部队

column1: Destroy the Target, clear area of additional forces Enemies, and Escape
column2: 摧毁目标，清除区域内额外敌军，然后撤离

column1: The objective for the player to escape and complete the mission.
column2: 该目标是让玩家撤离并完成任务。ZH

column1: The objective to destroy the Assassination Target.
column2: 该目标是摧毁刺杀目标。ZH

column1: The objective to stop the assassination target for escaping, the player will fail if the target escapes.
column2: 该目标要求阻止刺杀目标逃脱，若目标逃脱则玩家失败。ZH

column1: The secondary objective to destroy an additional lance supporting the assassination target.
column2: 次要目标：摧毁支援刺杀目标的一支额外小队。ZH

column1: Commander, we need an immediate deployment. We've been in pursuit of a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} terrorist for months, and we've finally tracked them to this planet. They've gone to ground but earlier today one of our orbital units spotted them moving on the surface. This is the first verified sighting we've had of the target, and we want you to bring them down immediately, before they're able to slip away again. There hasn't been time to do a full survey of the AO, so you'll be going in blind.
column2: 指挥官，我们需要立即部署。我们追踪一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}恐怖分子已有数月，终于把他逼到了这颗星球。他已经藏匿起来，但今天早些时候我们的一个轨道单位发现他在地表活动。这是我们首次确认目击到目标，我们希望你能立刻把他拿下，别让他再次溜走。我们没时间对行动区域做完整勘察，所以你会是盲入。ZH

column1: Eliminate Ambushers
column2: 消灭伏击部队

column1: Keep the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Terrorist from Escaping
column2: 阻止{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}恐怖分子逃走

column1: Mission accomplished. The terrorist is dead.
column2: 任务完成. 恐怖份子死亡.

column1: Time to make a withdrawal. No way of pulling this one out of the fire.
column2: 是时候撤退了. 没办法解决这个麻烦了.

column1: That extra lance of enemy forces is why I hate going in without intel. In any case, the terrorist is dead.
column2: 敌军多出来的那支小队就是我讨厌没有情报时进场的原因. 总之，恐怖分子死了.

column1: Dead or Alive
column2: 生或死

column1: War Criminal
column2: 战犯

column1: Destroy the target, clear area of additional forces, and escape
column2: 摧毁目标，肃清区域内的额外部队，并撤离.

column1: These days 'war criminal' basically means anyone on the other side of the battlefield. I wouldn't worry about that 'trial' comment. There won't be one.
column2: 如今"战争罪犯"基本上就是指站在战场另一边的人。我不会为那句"审判"的说法担心。根本不会有什么审判。ZH

column1: A wanted war criminal has been spotted on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Unfortunately, he appears to have integrated himself into a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}-aligned mercenary company. We need you to track him down and destroy his 'Mech. If he ejects, we'll take him into custody to be tried before a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} court. If not, no harm done - you'll be paid the same either way.
column2: 一名被通缉的战犯在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}被发现。不幸的是，他似乎已经混进了一支亲{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的雇佣兵公司。我们需要你把他揪出来并摧毁他的机甲。如果他弹射逃生，我们会把他收押，交由{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}法庭审判。如果没有，也没什么损失——两种情况下你的报酬都一样。ZH

column1: Destroy Supporting {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Forces
column2: 消灭支援的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队

column1: Eliminate Wanted MechWarrior
column2: 消灭被通缉的机甲战士

column1: Good hunting, Commander. Oliveira out.
column2: 狩猎愉快，指挥官。奥利韦拉通话结束。ZH

column1: Kill confirmed, Commander - the target is down and you are cleared for extraction. Get to the rendezvous with the Leopard, and Sumire will bring you home.
column2: 击杀确认，指挥官--目标完蛋了，你们可以前往撤离点. 去和豹式会合，苏米尔会带你们回家.

column1: We're only contracted for a single target here, but we both know it won't be that easy.
column2: 我们在这里只签约打一个目标，但我们都知道事情不会这么简单。ZH

column1: Escaping Spy
column2: 逃跑的间谍

column1: Covert Agent
column2: 秘密特工

column1: Commander, we'll get paid whether or not we find anything, so this could be a very profitable trip.
column2: 指挥官，不管我们找不找得到东西都会拿到报酬，所以这可能是一趟非常赚钱的差事。ZH

column1: We've been scouring the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system for weeks, looking for a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} spy who took something that didn't belong to them. Recent intelligence has revealed a possible location, but we can't possibly chase every lead with our thin resources. We need you to look into this long shot. If you find the spy, destroy them.
column2: 我们已经在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}星系搜寻了数周，寻找一名拿走了不属于他们东西的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}间谍。最近的情报揭示了一个可能的位置，但以我们薄弱的人手不可能追查每一条线索。我们需要你去查一下这条希望渺茫的线索。如果你找到那名间谍，就消灭他们。ZH

column1: Eliminate the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Spy
column2: 消灭{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}间谍

column1: Stop the Spy from Escaping
column2: 阻止间谍逃走

column1: Commander, you're near the coordinates provided to us by {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} intel.
column2: 指挥官，你已经接近{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}情报部门提供给我们的坐标。ZH

column1: If we find him, take him out, then evac.
column2: 如果我们找到他，就消灭他，然后撤离.

column1: We believe the target may be in this general region.
column2: 我们相信目标可能在这个大区.

column1: False Security
column2: 虚假的安全感

column1: I'm not excited about taking on someone with The Professional's reputation with an under-strength lance, but at least we'll have the element of surprise.
column2: 我并不乐意带着一支兵力不足的分队去对付一个有"专家"那种名声的人，但至少我们握有奇袭之利。ZH

column1: The target we'd like your people to eliminate is a notorious killer-for-hire who goes by the name 'The Professional'. They're currently under contract with {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}, and they've been spotted here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, which is extremely concerning for our interests. This mercenary is cagey and cautious and will attempt escape at any indication that they're overmatched. We'd like you to land a low-tonnage lance to engage them, to give them a false sense of security, and then eliminate them before they can escape. We're prepared to offer very generous salvage terms.
column2: 我们希望你们的人消灭的目标是一名臭名昭著的雇佣杀手，代号"专家"。他们目前受雇于{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}，并已在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}这里被发现，这对我们的利益极为不利。这名雇佣兵谨慎多疑，一有任何处于劣势的迹象就会试图逃跑。我们希望你们投放一支低吨位分队去交战，给他们一种虚假的安全感，然后在它们逃脱之前将其消灭。我们准备提供非常优厚的打捞条款。ZH

column1: Destroy The Professional
column2: 消灭专家

column1: Prevent The Professional from Escaping
column2: 阻止“专家”逃走

column1: Did you really just drop into my backyard with that lance? I'm offended. This won't even be a challenge.
column2: 你真的就带着那支分队降落到了我的后院？我被冒犯了。这甚至算不上挑战。ZH

column1: Target destroyed, Commander.
column2: 目标被摧毁了，指挥官.

column1: A hit-and-run operation sounds straightforward enough, Commander. Just remember that if you get bogged down in fighting the escorts, escape is always an option.
column2: 一次打了就跑的行动，听起来够简单明了的了，指挥官. 只是记住如果你陷入了和护卫队的苦斗，撤退始终是一个选择.

column1: Commander, this mission should be simple. A {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} noble is participating in a patrol, as a show of support for the troops. She's insisted on using her ancestral family 'Mech, which is a Cicada CDA-2A. This should make eliminating her quite easy. Recognizing the danger, her handlers have sent along an extremely heavy supporting lance. If you're quick, and aggressive, you should be able to destroy her little Cicada before her escorts can react.
column2: 指挥官，这次任务应该很简单。一位{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}贵族正在参加巡逻，以示对部队的支持。她坚持驾驶家族祖传的机甲，那是一台蝉 CDA-2A。这让除掉她变得相当容易。她的幕僚察觉到了危险，随行派出了一支极重型的支援小队。只要你动作够快、够凶狠，就能在她的护卫做出反应之前摧毁那台小小的蝉。ZH

column1: Destroy {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Noble
column2: 消灭{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}贵族

column1: Keep the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Noble from Escaping
column2: 阻止{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}贵族逃走

column1: Do you have anything helpful to offer, Yang?
column2: 你有什么有用的建议吗，杨?

column1: Good luck and good hunting.
column2: 祝你好运，狩猎顺利.

column1: If you ask me, boss, anyone who sends their VIPs out in a CDA-2A is asking to be shot.
column2: 要是你问我的话，头，任何一个把自己的重要人物塞进一部CDA-2A派出去的人都该被枪毙.

column1: These little bastards are fast, so watch for the VIP to make a run for it.
column2: 这些小混蛋跑得很快，所以注意重要人物可能会试图逃跑.

column1: A hit-and-run operation should be straightforward enough, Commander. Just remember that if you get bogged down in fighting the escorts, escape is always an option.
column2: 一次打了就跑的行动，听起来够简单明了的了，指挥官. 只是记住如果你陷入了和护卫队的苦斗，撤退始终是一个选择.

column1: Frontier Justice
column2: 边地的正义

column1: Rogue MechWarrior
column2: 恶棍机甲战士

column1: Destroy the Target, clear area of additional enemies, and escape
column2: 摧毁目标，清除区域内额外敌人，然后撤离

column1: If I had to guess, Commander, I'd say the 'outlaw' part of this is just propaganda. Outlaw or not, though, the payout's the same for us.
column2: 如果要我猜，指挥官，我会说这其中"不法"那部分只是宣传。不过不管合法与否，对我们来说报酬都一样。ZH

column1: We are offering a sizeable bounty for the head of a local outlaw. The target is a rogue {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} MechWarrior who has attacked {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} personnel and facilities in this system. We need a mercenary company to find her and take her down before she takes out her aggressions on any more of our settlements.
column2: 我们要出一大笔赏金缉拿当地一名不法分子的首级. 目标是一名在这个星系中攻击了{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}人员和设施的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}恶棍机甲战士. 我们需要一家佣兵公司找到她，在她继续攻击我们的定居点之前把她干掉.

column1: Destroy the Enemy Forces
column2: 消灭敌方部队

column1: Destroy the Outlaw MechWarrior
column2: 消灭不法分子机甲战士

column1: Stop the Outlaw from Escaping
column2: 阻止不法分子逃走

column1: Excellent work as always, Commander. When you get back, drinks are on me.
column2: 工作一如既往的漂亮，指挥官. 你回来时，我请你喝一杯.

column1: Find the target, take her out, and proceed to the LZ for evac. Good hunting, Commander. Oliveira out.
column2: 找到目标，干掉她，然后前往着陆区撤离. 狩猎顺利，指挥官. 奥利维拉完毕.

column1: There's only one target that matters on this drop, Commander.
column2: 这次投放只有一个目标要紧，指挥官。ZH

column1: Hard Target
column2: 硬目标

column1: Elite MechWarrior
column2: 精锐机甲战士

column1: The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} MechWarrior is headed to a major military compound on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}, where they'll take command of a company-sized 'Mech force, and become untouchable. They're en route to the encampment, but until they arrive, they're vulnerable.
column2: 那名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}机师正前往{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}上的一处大型军事营地，在那里他们将接管一支连级机甲部队，从此不可触及。他们正在前往营地的路上，但在抵达之前，他们是脆弱的。ZH

column1: An elite MechWarrior has been deployed to take command of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces in this system. We need a skilled mercenary force to remove this MechWarrior before they reach their command, while they're only lightly escorted. Every downed 'Mech will help our cause, so there will be a bonus for complete destruction of the target's supporting forces. Additionally, the MechWarrior's command may send out an escort unit to meet them; expect enemy reinforcements once you engage.
column2: 一名精英机甲战士被派来接管该星系{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队的指挥权。我们需要一支技术娴熟的雇佣兵力量，在这名机甲战士抵达其指挥部之前、且只有轻装护卫时将其除掉。每击毁一台机甲都有助于我们的事业，因此彻底摧毁目标的护航部队还有奖金。此外，该机甲战士的指挥部可能会派出一支护航单位前来会合；一旦交战，预期会有敌方增援。ZH

column1: Defeat the Elite MechWarrior and Escape
column2: 击败精锐机甲战士后摆脱敌人

column1: Destroy Elite {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} MechWarrior
column2: 消灭{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}精锐机甲战士

column1: Commander, intel says the target and their escorts will be moving through this area.
column2: 指挥官，情报显示目标和他们的护卫将通过这一地区.

column1: Take them out, and then head for the evac zone.
column2: 干掉他们，然后前往撤离区域.

column1: The bigger they are.... Well done, Commander.
column2: 他们越是庞大....做得不错，指挥官.

column1: Heart of Darkness
column2: 黑暗之心

column1: Enemy Commander
column2: 敌方指挥官

column1: Commander, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} needs this cleaned up quietly. Our intel shows the former commander has more loyal units than our employers will admit. This fight could escalate quickly, so stay alert.
column2: 指挥官，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}希望这件事能悄悄解决. 我们的情报显示，这位前任指挥官掌握的忠诚部队比雇主所承认的要多得多. 这场战斗可能会迅速升级，请保持警惕.

column1: A former {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} commander, backed by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces, has set up his own government. To avoid any unwanted personnel conflicts, and to save our people the stress of fighting their former comrades, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} requires a Merc unit to remove this traitor and keep him from destroying his own people.
column2: 一名前{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}指挥官，在{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军队的支持下，建立了自己的政权. 为了避免不必要的人员冲突，并减轻我方人员与昔日同袍作战的压力，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}需要一支雇佣兵部队去除掉这个叛徒，防止他继续伤害自己的人民.

column1: Defeat {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Forces
column2: 击败{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队

column1: Defeat {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Reinforcements
column2: 击败{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}援军

column1: Defeat the Traitorous Commander
column2: 击败叛国的指挥官

column1: Destroy the Commander and Escape
column2: 消灭指挥官并摆脱敌人

column1: Keep your eyes open and be ready for a counterattack.
column2: 睁大眼睛，准备应对反击.

column1: Nice, clean, and quiet. Perfect. Good work, Commander.
column2: 美妙，干净，同时还隐秘. 完美. 干得漂亮，指挥官.

column1: The target was far better prepared for us than our employers led us to believe. Time to dust off and call it even.
column2: 目标所做的准备比我们雇主所说的还要充分. 是时候拍拍屁股到此为止了.

column1: With the backing of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}, this 'king' could prove to be a tough opponent.
column2: 有了{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}的支持，这位“国王”可能会是个难对付的对手。ZH

column1: He Does His Own Stunts
column2: 他亲自上阵

column1: Brock Armstrong
column2: 布罗克·阿姆斯特朗

column1: Have you seen the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} holo-vid show \"Mercenaries\"? Yes, we're being asked to kill its star, Brock Armstrong. He knows his way around a 'Mech and will have two full lances as escorts.
column2: 你看过{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的全息剧集《雇佣兵》吗？没错，我们被要求杀掉它的主演，布洛克·阿姆斯特朗。他对机甲很在行，而且会有整整两支分队作为护卫。ZH

column1: Commander, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has arranged for a holo-vid celebrity to visit {TGT_SYSTEM.name} in the hopes of rallying the morale of the local citizens. This is an opportunity for {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} psy-ops to instead make them understand how dangerous the region really is. Deploy your lance, find the target, eliminate him. Destroy his bodyguards if you feel so inclined.
column2: 指挥官，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}已经安排一位全息影视明星前往{TGT_SYSTEM.name}，以提升当地民众的士气. 这正是{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}心理战部队发挥作用的好机会，让他们真正明白这片区域有多危险. 派出你的小队，找到目标，消灭他. 如果你想的话，也可以一并消灭他的护卫.

column1: Destroy Enemy Escorts
column2: 消灭敌方护卫

column1: Commander, from here on out, we're expecting to encounter enemy forces.
column2: 指挥官，从现在起，我们预计会遇到敌军。ZH

column1: Take him out, and get to the evac zone.
column2: 除掉他，再到撤离区域去.

column1: Destroy the target, clear area of additional enemy forces, and reach the evac zone with all surviving 'Mechs.
column2: 摧毁目标，清除区域内额外敌军，并带着所有幸存机甲抵达撤离区。ZH

column1: Target eliminated. Mop up the remaining enemies, or head for the evac LZ.
column2: 目标已消灭. 扫荡剩下的敌人，或前往撤离区.

column1: This is a disaster. Commander, I'm pulling the plug on this operation.
column2: 这是场灾难。指挥官，我要中止这次行动。ZH

column1: Well done, Commander. Let's go get paid.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。我们去领钱吧。ZH

column1: For months, we've had trouble with people here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} being riled up by talk of insurrection, rebellion, independence. Based on top {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} analysts' reports, we believe there's a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} propagandist in the area, stirring up discontent. We've set up a security net to capture her. But we can't cover every possible exit from our net and could use an extra Lance of 'Mechs. If she tries to slip through your assigned territory, turn her unit to slag.
column2: 数月来，{TGT_SYSTEM.name}这里的人一直被叛乱、起义、独立的言论煽动，令我们头疼。根据{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}顶尖分析师们的报告，我们相信这一带有一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}宣传员在煽动不满情绪。我们已布下一张安全网来抓她。但我们无法覆盖网中每一个可能的出口，所以需要一支额外的机甲分队。如果她试图从你的辖区溜过，就把她的单位熔成矿渣。ZH

column1: Mission accomplished. The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} propagandist is dead.
column2: 任务完成. {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}宣传员死了.

column1: Our employers need us to keep an eye out for the propaganda agent, as this is one possible escape route she might take.
column2: 我们的雇主需要我们密切注意宣传员，因为这是她可能采用的一条逃跑路线.

column1: Target eliminated. We can clean up any remaining hostiles, or head for the evac zone.
column2: 目标已消灭. 我们可以清理所有剩余的敌人，或前往撤离区.

column1: Key Personnel
column2: 关键人员

column1: Sounds like we'll be hitting a middle manager. Not much glory, but it pays. The target won't be alone, Commander, and there's a bonus if we clean up the escorting units. Still, if things get too hot, we can always hit and run.
column2: 听起来我们要去干掉一名中层管理者。没什么荣耀，但有报酬。目标不会独自一人，指挥官，如果我们把护卫单位也清理掉另有奖金。不过如果局面太热，我们随时可以打了就跑。ZH

column1: We have an opportunity to eliminate a key figure in the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} hierarchy in this system, which will leave their organization in chaos and ensure safety for {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} operations. The target will be relatively unguarded and vulnerable, and we'd like you to strike in this window of opportunity.
column2: 我们有机会除掉该星系{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}层级中的一名关键人物，这会让他们的组织陷入混乱，并确保{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}行动的安全。目标身旁不会有太多护卫、防备薄弱，我们希望你在这一时机窗口内发动打击。ZH

column1: Sounds like we'll be hitting a middle manager. The target won't be alone, Commander, and there's a bonus if we clean up the escorting units as well. Still, if things get too hot, we can always hit and run.
column2: 听起来我们要去干掉一名中层管理者。目标不会独自一人，指挥官，如果我们把护卫单位也清理掉另有奖金。不过如果局面太热，我们随时可以打了就跑。ZH

column1: Our intelligence operatives believe that a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} leader is present and vulnerable on the surface of {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Eliminating them will leave their organization in shambles and clear the field for {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} operations. The target will be relatively unguarded, and we'd like you to strike during this window of opportunity.
column2: 我们的情报人员相信，一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}领袖正在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}地表上且防备薄弱。除掉他们将使他们的组织陷入混乱，为{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}行动清出场地。目标身旁不会有太多护卫，我们希望你在这一时机窗口内发动打击。ZH

column1: Destroy Ambushers
column2: 摧毁伏击部队

column1: The target is down, Commander. Well done.
column2: 目标完蛋了，指挥官. 做得不错.

column1: Code of Silence
column2: 沉默法则

column1: Target MechWarrior
column2: 目标机甲战士

column1: I suppose the target probably should have known what he was getting into. Lay down with dogs...
column2: 我想目标已经知道他接下来会发生什么. 近墨者黑......

column1: We had a deal with a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} MechWarrior here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. He helped out with some of our operations, and in turn we kept him supplied with things he couldn't get on the open market, if you know what I mean. But he's decided he's too good to work with us anymore. That's not okay. We want you to go down there and show him that it's not okay. He's probably gonna try to make a break for it. Don't let him escape.
column2: 我们跟{TGT_SYSTEM.name}这里的一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}机师有过约定。他帮过我们一些行动的忙，作为交换，我们一直供应他一些他在公开市场上弄不到的东西，你懂我的意思。但他现在觉得自己不值得我们合作了。那可不行。我们要你下去让他明白这不行。他大概会试图跑路。别让他逃掉。ZH

column1: Destroy {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} MechWarrior
column2: 消灭{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}机甲战士

column1: Prevent the Target from Escaping
column2: 阻止目标逃脱

column1: From here, you should be able to get eyes on him.
column2: 从这里，你应该可以看到他.

column1: This is where the target should be patrolling, Commander.
column2: 这里应该就是目标巡逻的地方，指挥官.

column1: There's a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} MechWarrior here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, involved in keeping the peace. He helped out with some of our operations, and in turn we kept him supplied with things he couldn't get on the open market, if you know what I mean. But he's started talking to the authorities, and making threats about exposing our business. We want you to put a stop to that. He's probably gonna try to make a break for it. Don't let him escape.
column2: {TGT_SYSTEM.name}这里有一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}机师，参与维持治安。他帮过我们一些行动的忙，作为交换，我们一直供应他一些他在公开市场上弄不到的东西，你懂我的意思。但他开始与当局接触，还威胁要揭露我们的生意。我们要你把这事掐断。他大概会试图跑路。别让他逃掉。ZH

column1: An Eye For An Eye
column2: 以眼还眼

column1: If this MechWarrior is singlehandedly making a dent in pirate activity in {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, he's going to be a tough enemy.
column2: 如果这名机甲战士能凭一己之力削减 {TGT_SYSTEM.name} 的海盗活动，他会是个强敌。ZH

column1: We've lost three hidden supply bases on this ball of rock, Commander, and all three losses were thanks to one man, a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} MechWarrior tasked with tracking down our activities in this region. We're tired of letting him pick the time and place of battle, so we'd like you to give him a little surprise visit while he's on patrol. He'll be lightly defended but given his paranoia he'll probably have backup waiting nearby, so watch for an ambush.
column2: 我们在这块石头球上丢了三处隐蔽补给基地，指挥官，而三次损失都归功于一个人——一名被派来追查我们在此区域活动的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}机师。我们受够了他来选定战斗的时间与地点，所以我们希望在他巡逻时给他一次小小的惊喜拜访。他的护卫很少，但鉴于他的多疑，附近大概会有后援等着，所以当心伏击。ZH

column1: From here, you should be able to get eyes on him, Commander.
column2: 从这里，你应该可以看到他，指挥官.

column1: This is where our employers said to look for the target.
column2: 这里就是我们雇主说要寻找目标的地方.

column1: The Price of Freedom
column2: 自由的代价

column1: It's reached a point where we can no longer operate in {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, Commander, and it's all thanks to a particular {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} MechWarrior tasked with tracking down our activities in this region. We're tired of letting him pick the time and place of battle, so we'd like you to give him a little surprise visit while he's on patrol. He'll be defended and given his paranoia he'll probably have backup waiting nearby, so watch for an ambush.
column2: 已经到了我们无法再在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}行动的地步，指挥官，这全拜一名被派来追查我们在此区域活动的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}机师所赐。我们受够了他来选定战斗的时间与地点，所以我们希望在他巡逻时给他一次小小的惊喜拜访。他会有护卫，而鉴于他的多疑，附近大概会有后援等着，所以当心伏击。ZH

column1: Recruitment Drive
column2: 征兵行动

column1: Veteran MechWarrior
column2: 机甲战士老兵

column1: His 'Mech may be heavy, Commander, but I don't see a lot of 'Mech repair facilities out here, so this might not be as difficult as it looks.
column2: 他的机甲可能很重，指挥官，但我在这一带看不到多少机甲维修设施，所以这也许不像看上去那么难。ZH

column1: Our spies report that a veteran {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} MechWarrior from the Succession Wars retired to this system, and {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} would very much like to keep him retired. Permanently if possible. We've been monitoring a DropShip in orbit around the planet, and believe that they're preparing for a pickup. We need you to drop and intercept this MechWarrior before he can be reactivated. He's likely in a fairly heavy 'Mech, so be careful when you engage him.
column2: 我们的间谍报告，一名继承战争时期的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}老兵机师退役定居在这个星系，而{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}非常希望让他保持退役状态。如果可能的话是永久性的。我们一直在监视轨道上的一艘空投艇，相信他们正准备接人。我们需要你降下去，在这名机师被重新启用之前拦截他。他大概驾驶着一台相当重的机甲，所以交战时小心。ZH

column1: Destroy the Veteran MechWarrior and Escape
column2: 消灭机甲战士老兵并摆脱敌人

column1: Destroy Veteran MechWarrior
column2: 消灭机甲战士老兵

column1: Engage and destroy the target, then proceed to the evac zone.
column2: 交战并摧毁目标，之后前往撤离区域.

column1: This is where the last transmission from the surface originated from.
column2: 这里就是地面最后发送讯息的位置.

column1: We've arrived at the coordinates provided by our employers.
column2: 我们已抵达雇主提供的坐标。ZH

column1: I have a bad feeling about this, Commander. If they want that 'Mech torched, I'm guessing it's relatively powerful. Be careful.
column2: 我有不好的预感，指挥官。如果他们想烧掉那台机甲，我猜它相当强大。小心点。ZH

column1: One of our covert facilities was breached, Commander, in what appears to have been an inside job. A MechWarrior stationed there murdered the rest of the staff and is defecting to {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, taking a valuable {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 'Mech with her. The facility is a total loss, but we don't want that 'Mech falling into enemy hands. Track down the renegade and destroy her 'Mech. We believe she's being escorted by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces, and there's a bonus if you destroy them as well.
column2: 指挥官，我们的一处秘密设施被突破了，看样子是内部人员所为。驻守在那里的一名机甲战士杀害了其余工作人员，并叛逃到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}，还带走了一台宝贵的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}机甲。设施已彻底损毁，但我们绝不能让那台机甲落入敌手。找到这名叛徒并摧毁她的机甲。我们认为她正由{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队护送，若你将其一并摧毁，还有额外奖励。ZH

column1: Destroy Renegade
column2: 消灭叛徒

column2: 消灭叛徒并摆脱敌人

column2: 阻止叛徒逃走

column1: That 'Mech is leaving a trail anyone could follow. Our target is not subtle.
column2: 那台机甲留下的痕迹谁都跟得上。我们的目标一点也不隐蔽。ZH

column1: Commander, we should expect heavy resistance. We might get a shot at the officer alone but his guard and support units won't be far off. You'll have to either strike hard and fast then bug out, or bring enough firepower for everyone.
column2: 指挥官，我们应预期会遇到顽抗。我们也许有机会单独袭击那名军官，但他的卫兵与支援单位不会离得太远。你要么快打快撤，要么带上足以应付所有人的火力。ZH

column1: We've had confirmation from several sources that a high ranking {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} officer is moving in the open. This is a rare opportunity to disrupt their command structure on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. We'll pay a 20% bonus per lance if you can also destroy his personal guard.
column2: 我们已从多个来源确认，一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}高级军官正在公开行动。这是在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上打乱他们指挥结构的难得机会。如果你还能摧毁他的私人卫队，我们将按每支分队额外支付20%的奖金。ZH

column1: Target eliminated. Mop up the remaining enemies, or come on home.
column2: 目标已消灭. 清剿剩余敌人，或者直接回家.

column1: Thorn In The Side
column2: 芒刺在背

column1: Commander, this is a bold move by the smugglers so we have to assume they have more than just a simple token force there. Be prepared for anything.
column2: 指挥官，这伙走私者敢采取如此大胆的行动，我们最好假设他们不止有一支象征性部队在那儿. 准备好应付任何情况.

column1: Smugglers funded by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} have set up just outside our borders, causing an ongoing problem for {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} operations. We'd like to cut the head off this particular snake with a targeted, limited, and deniable strike on their leader. Ideally, this will shut them down permanently.
column2: 受{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}资助的走私者在我们的边界外扎了营，持续给{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的行动制造麻烦。我们想对这条毒蛇来个斩首行动：一次精准、有限且可否认的打击，直取他们的头目。若能如愿，这将永久终结他们。ZH

column1: Destroy All Smuggler Forces
column2: 消灭所有走私者部队

column1: Destroy Smuggler Reinforcements
column2: 消灭走私者的援军

column2: 消灭走私者的首领并摆脱敌人

column2: 消灭走私者首领

column1: Intel suggests hostile {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units in the area. Be alert.
column2: 情报指出敌对{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}单位出现在了这一地区. 请警惕.

column1: Once the target is down, head for the extraction point for a pickup.
column2: 一旦目标完蛋了，就前往撤离点接受接应.

column1: The target is down. Head for the extraction point.
column2: 目标完蛋了. 前往撤离点.

column1: This is the area where the smugglers reportedly set up shop.
column2: 据报这里是走私者开展业务的地方.

column1: Well done, Commander. Our employer will be very happy to hear the news.
column2: 做得不错，指挥官. 我们的雇主听到这个消息会非常高兴的.

column1: Destroy the Target, clear area of additional forces, and Escape
column2: 摧毁目标，肃清区域内的额外部队，并撤离.

column1: We get paid only for a confirmed kill, although there's a bonus for clearing out any additional {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces. Still, it may be best to approach this as a hit-and-run operation.
column2: 我们只有确认击杀才能拿到报酬，不过清除任何额外的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队另有奖金。尽管如此，把这当成一次打了就跑的行动也许最好。ZH

column1: Our intelligence has identified an infamous war criminal in the service of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. We do not care about the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces, but the criminal must be brought to justice. And by 'justice' we mean 'dead'.
column2: 我们的情报确认了一名在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}上为{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}效力的臭名昭著战犯。我们不在乎{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队，但这名罪犯必须被绳之以法。而我们说的"法"是指"死"。ZH

column1: Destroy the War Criminal and Escape
column2: 消灭战犯并摆脱敌人

column1: Destroy the War Criminal
column2: 消灭战犯

column1: Commander, the criminal we're after should be nearby.
column2: 指挥官，我们要抓的那名罪犯应该就在附近。ZH

column1: Mission accomplished. The target is dead.
column2: 任务完成. 目标死亡.

column1: The target will be supported by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces, but we have no contractual obligation to engage them.
column2: 目标将会有{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队的支援，但我们没有合约义务去和他们交战.

column1: This is a hit and run. If you prefer, just kill the target and get out. Good hunting, Commander.
column2: 这是一场打了就跑的任务. 如果你喜欢，只要击杀目标就脱离. 狩猎顺利，指挥官.

column1: Buckle up, Commander. This sounds like an extremely tough fight. You know something this valuable is going to be escorted.
column2: 做好准备，指挥官. 听起来这像是一场极其艰苦的战斗. 你知道有些珍贵的东西要护送.

column1: We periodically survey 'empty' worlds just to be certain there's no unexpected activity on them. This time, we got lucky. A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} surveillance team picked up {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} signals from the surface of {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} that correspond to a very heavy 'Mech running through a test-fire sequence. We suspect the enemy is taking the 'Mech out for proving trials, figuring the planet is uninhabited. If we can locate and intercept this 'Mech, we can keep a powerful piece of hardware out of enemy hands.
column2: 我们定期勘察“空置”星球，只为确认那里没有意外活动。这次我们运气不错。一支{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}监视小队从{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}地表接收到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}信号，对应一台正在跑试射序列的超重型机甲。我们怀疑敌人认为该星球无人居住，正把这台机甲开出来做验证试车。如果我们能定位并拦截这台机甲，就能让一件强力硬件不落入敌手。ZH

column1: We were outgunned and outnumbered. Not a good showing, Commander.
column2: 我们在火力和人数上都被超越了. 情况不妙，指挥官.

column1: Well done, Commander. You made that look easy.
column2: 做得不错，指挥官. 你让它看起来很简单.

column1: Weakest Link
column2: 最弱的一环

column1: The target seems to be just a low-level officer in the overall {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} scheme of things - just a link in the chain. We just need to dive in, take out the target and get out.
column2: 目标似乎只是整个{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}体系中的一名低级官员——只是链条上的一环. 我们只需要潜入进去，消灭目标，然后撤离.

column1: A member of the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} chain of command in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} has been troubling us. We need this irksome operative eliminated. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} intelligence operatives have located the target's position planetside.
column2: {TGT_SYSTEM.name}中{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}指挥链的一名成员一直在烦扰我们。我们需要除掉这名恼人的干员。{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}情报人员已定位目标在行星上的位置。ZH

column1: Only marginally effective for a light tank, the Scorpion has proven effective in mass numbers. Swarms of Scorpions, easily procured due to their low cost, are an often-encountered danger on poorer worlds.
column2: 对轻型坦克来说它只能算勉强有效，但蝎式以数量证明了威力。由于采购成本低廉，成群结队的蝎式在贫困星球上屡见不鲜，是常见的威胁。ZH

column1: Another enemy lance in the AO, Commander.
column2: 任务区的另一个敌方长枪，指挥官.

column1: Another job well done.
column2: 又一项任务圆满完成.

column1: Argo, our facility is taking fire over here. We need you to draw that fire off, or we're dead!
column2: 阿尔戈，我们这边的设施正在遭到射击。我们需要你引开火力，否则我们就死定了！ZH

column1: Argo, our forces are ready to assist in defending the base.
column2: 阿尔戈号，我们的部队已准备好协助保卫基地.

column2: 阿尔戈，我们遭到猛烈—— [静电] ——坚守—— [静电]

column1: Argo, we've taken control of the facility. You need to keep it intact and neutralize the attackers.
column2: 阿戈号，我们已控制该设施。你需要让它保持完好并消灭进攻者。ZH

column1: As long as you're still in the AO, Commander, you'll need to keep the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} base secure.
column2: 只要你还待在作战区域，指挥官，你就得确保 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 基地安全。ZH

column1: Commander, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} reinforcements are inbound to this location.
column2: 指挥官，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 增援正前往此处。ZH

column1: Commander, a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Leopard just dropped another lance into the AO.

There's a well-defended {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} base that we suspect of being a secure data storage facility. We'd like your team to land, capture the base, and take a complete image of the contents of their databases. Once the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces realize what we're doing, they'll launch a counteroffensive, so we'll need you to stay in the field until the download is complete.
column2: 我们一直在监视{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的通讯流量，并辨认出一种规律。那里有一处防御严密的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}基地，我们怀疑它是安全数据存储设施。我们希望你的团队降落、夺取该基地，并完整拍摄其数据库内容。一旦{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队意识到我们在做什么，他们就会发起反攻，因此我们需要你留在战场直到下载完成。ZH

column1: Scout the Facility
column2: 侦察设施

column1: Commander, once you reach the base I'll be able to start extracting the data. It shouldn't take very long; I can't imagine their data security is very sophisticated.
column2: 指挥官，等你抵达基地，我就能开始提取数据了。应该不会花太久；我无法想象他们的数据安全措施有多精密。ZH

column1: Oh hey, just like I said. Turrets. Watch yourself, Commander.
column2: 噢嘿，就像我说过的. 炮台. 小心，指挥官.

column1: We should get eyes on that base before we charge in shooting. This should be a good vantage point.
column2: 在我们冲进去射击之前，应该先看看那座基地. 这里应该是最佳视点.

column1: This shouldn't be all that difficult, but we'll need Dr. Murad on the ground to do the actual data hacking. She's already agreed to go in with your team.
column2: 这应该不会太难，但我们需要穆拉德博士到地面上来实际进行数据入侵。她已经同意跟你的小队一起进去。ZH

column1: Sounds like our employers have their own data security problems.
column2: 听起来我们的雇主有他们自己的数据安全问题.

column1: Stealing is a Form of Flattery
column2: 偷窃是种“恭维”ZH

column1: Commander, plausible deniability is our specialty.
column2: 指挥官，合理否认可是我们的拿手好戏.

column1: We have long suspected that there is a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} research station hidden in the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system, and we've finally gotten wind of its possible location. We need a few brave, and plausibly deniable, mercenaries to secure the location for a dropship extraction of any valuable scientific personnel.
column2: 我们长期怀疑{TGT_SYSTEM.name}星系内藏有一处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}研究站，如今终于探得它可能的位置。我们需要几位勇敢且可矢口否认的雇佣兵，去控制该地点，以便空投艇撤离任何有价值的科研人员。ZH

column1: Capture the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Research Station
column2: 夺取{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}研究站

column2: 消灭{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队

column2: 占领研究站

column2: 侦察研究站

column1: Alright, you should have good view of the research facility now.
column2: 好了，你们现在应该可以清楚地看到研究设施了.

column1: Be careful of additional forces. Reports are they have additional units in the area that are rallying back at the base. Expect contact.
column2: 小心增援部队. 报告说他们在该区域还有额外单位，正在基地集结. 预计会发生接触.

column1: Commander, a word of warning: we have reports this base may have gun emplacements for point defense.
column2: 指挥官，提醒一下: 我们收到报告称这个基地可能部署了防御炮台.

column1: Eliminate opposition and take control of the territory, Commander.
column2: 消灭敌对势力并控制该区域，指挥官.

column1: Sit tight, Commander. I think {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} will be pleased with the results.
column2: 原地别动，指挥官. 我想{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}会满意这次的结果.

column1: The research station is under our control, Commander.
column2: 研究站在我们控制之下了，指挥官.

column2: 我们来夺取 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 的研究站。ZH

column1: Clandestine Research
column2: 秘密研究

column1: We're going to land in a hot AO, with no idea where we are, capture a well-defended military facility, and hold it against a counter-attack. What could go wrong?
column2: 我们即将降落在一片热区，完全不知道自己在哪儿，夺取一处防御严密的军事设施，然后顶住反攻守住它。还能出什么岔子？ZH

column1: Commander, we're preparing a series of operations on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. However, before we can begin, we need a secure lodgement to bring military units and supplies down to the surface. We've identified a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} military facility that will be ideal for our purposes. We need you to land a strike force, capture the facility, and hold it until we can bring down our people to secure the location. Because this operation is covert and on an extremely tight schedule, you'll be inserting with no topographical intel.
column2: 指挥官，我们正准备在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上开展一系列行动。但在开始之前，我们需要一处安全的落脚点，把军事单位与补给送上地表。我们已确定一处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军事设施，对我们的目的而言堪称理想。我们需要你投下一支打击部队，夺取该设施并守住它，直到我们能把人手送下来确保该地点安全。由于这次行动是隐蔽的且时间极紧，你将在没有地形情报的情况下投放进去。ZH

column1: Capture the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} military facility
column2: 夺取{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军用设施

column1: I don't like dropping dark like this. Meyer, we need some eyes on the target. Any thoughts?
column2: 我不喜欢这样摸黑投放。迈耶，我们需要有人盯着目标。有什么想法吗？ZH

column1: Um, let me look... Okay, this location seems like a good vantage point. You should be able to see the facility from there.
column2: 嗯，我来看看...好吧，这个位置似乎是最佳视点. 从那儿你应该可以看到设施.

column1: Logistical Base Capture
column2: 夺取后勤基地

column1: This should be straightforward. Move up, recon the depot, and then occupy it. Once we secure the area, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} will send in their people to loot the place.
column2: 这应该很简单明了. 前进，侦察仓库，然后占领它. 一旦我们拿下了这块地方，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}就会派他们的人洗劫这里.

column1: We've been tracking the movement of several {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} convoys, and that's allowed us to pinpoint their destinations: a hidden, well-defended logistics depot. This facility is a key supplier for  {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces in this region, and taking it from them will significantly damage their efforts against us. We'd like you to drop in, take the depot, and hold out against any enemy reinforcements.
column2: 我们一直在追踪几支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}车队的动向，这让我们精确定位了它们的目的地：一处隐蔽、防守严密的后勤库。该设施是该地区{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队的关键供应方，从他们手里夺下将严重打击他们对我们的行动。我们希望你能降落进去，拿下后勤库，并顶住任何敌方增援。ZH

column1: Capture & Hold Depot
column2: 夺取并守住仓库

column2: 夺取后勤仓库

column2: 占领补给站

column1: Scout the Depot
column2: 侦察补给站

column1: Commander, I'm not picking up any active hostiles, anywhere. The place looks deserted.
column2: 指挥官，我在任何地方都没探测到活动的敌人。这地方看起来空无一人。ZH

column1: I suspect {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} will be very pleased with this haul.
column2: 我猜{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}会对这批缴获非常满意.

column1: The depot is ours, Commander.
column2: 这座补给站是我们的了，指挥官.

column1: Manufacturing Facility
column2: 制造设施

column1: They haven't told us what, precisely, the facility is producing, but given the strength of enemy forces on the ground, it's something worth protecting.
column2: 他们没告诉我们那座设施究竟在生产什么，但看地面上敌军兵力的规模，这东西值得保护。ZH

column1: We've discovered that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has reactivated an old manufacturing facility in this system. To maintain the balance of power in this system, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} needs to capture this facility. You'll make a surgical strike, occupy the base, and hold it until {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces can arrive to take control.
column2: 我们发现{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}已重新启用了本星系内的一处旧制造设施。为维持本星系的势力平衡，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}需要夺取该设施。你要实施一次精准打击，占领基地，并坚守到{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}部队抵达接管为止。ZH

column1: Capture the Manufacturing Facility
column2: 夺取制造设施

column1: Hold the Facility Until Reinforcements Arrive
column2: 守住设施直到援军抵达

column1: Occupy the Facility
column2: 占领设施

column1: The manufacturing facility is just ahead, Commander.
column2: 那座生产设施就在前方，指挥官.

column1: Capturing Production
column2: 夺取生产设施

column1: Mech Factory
column2: 机甲工厂

column1: Embarrassing to have an enemy stealing data right out from under your nose. I'm guessing the opfor won't have had time to get any of the facility defenses online, so at least there won't be turrets.
column2: 敌人从你眼皮底下偷走数据，真是丢脸。我猜敌方来不及让该设施的任何防御上线，所以至少不会有炮塔。ZH

column1: We picked up a coded transmission from the surface of {TGT_SYSTEM.name}: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} scouts report a previously unknown manufacturing plant has been activated by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces, and they're broadcasting what we believe might be pre-war blueprints to an unknown recipient somewhere in the system. We need you to move in and capture that facility, intact, and protect it while we mobilize a garrison.
column2: 我们从{TGT_SYSTEM.name}地表截获一段加密传输：{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}侦察兵报告，一处此前未知的制造厂已被{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队启动，而他们正向该星系中某个未知收件人广播我们认为是战前蓝图的东西。我们需要你推进并完好地夺取该设施，并在我们动员驻军期间保护它。ZH

column1: Capture the BattleMech Factory
column2: 夺取战斗机甲工厂

column2: 消灭正在占领的敌方部队

column2: 侦察战斗机甲工厂

column1: Sure enough, Commander, there's a lot of comm chatter coming from that factory.
column2: 果然如此，指挥官，那座工厂传来大量通讯杂音。ZH

column1: The factory is under control, Commander, and {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are setting up defenses. Good work.
column2: 我们已经控制了工厂，指挥官，同时{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}部队正在建立防御. 干得好.

column1: Nine-Tenths of the Law
column2: 占有即所有

column1: The legal justification here sounds sketchy, Commander, but we're mercenaries, not lawyers. As long as they're happy, we get paid.
column2: 这里的法律依据听起来很可疑，指挥官，但我们自己是雇佣兵，不是律师。只要他们满意，我们就能拿到钱。ZH

column1: We've learned that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have constructed a forward base on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, ignoring the express wishes of the local government. Naturally, the planetary governor is furious, but he can't make a stand against {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} BattleMechs without assistance; {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} has offered that assistance. You are to seize control of the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} base and hold it until we gain a legal claim to the facility. We will then sell it back to the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} government at a considerable discount.
column2: 我们得知{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队无视当地政府的明确意愿，在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上建起了一处前进基地。行星总督自然震怒，但没有援助他无法对抗{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}战斗机甲；{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}已提出提供这一援助。你要夺取{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}基地的控制权并守住它，直到我们获得该设施的合法所有权。届时我们将以相当大的折扣把它卖回给{TGT_SYSTEM.name}政府。ZH

column1: Capture the Outpost

column2: 侦察{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}基地

column1: Before we go for the base, we should get eyes on the enemy - the positioning of their garrison, and ideally the layout of the base itself.
column2: 在我们前往基地之前，我们应该先看看敌人--守备部队的位置，最好还有基地本身的布局.

column1: Remember, that base is our payday, and our {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} employers want it intact. Good hunting, Commander. Oliveira out.
column2: 记住，那座基地就是我们的发薪日，同时我们的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}雇主要求它完好无损. 狩猎顺利，指挥官. 奥利维拉完毕.

column1: Sit tight, the employer will be very pleased with this haul.
column2: 原地别动，雇主会非常满意这次押运的.

column1: The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility that we're here to capture should be just ahead, Commander.
column2: 我们要夺取的那处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}设施应该就在前方，指挥官。ZH

column1: The base is ours, Commander.
column2: 这座基地是我们的了，指挥官.

column1: Word of warning, Commander: this base is likely to be defended by point defense turrets.
column2: 提醒一句，指挥官: 这座基地好像被一些防御炮台守卫着.

column1: You should have a clear view of the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility now, Commander.
column2: 你现在应该可以清楚地看到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}设施了，指挥官.

column1: Ordnance Depot Capture
column2: 军火补给站夺取行动

column1: We've been tracking the movement of several {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} convoys, and that's allowed us to pinpoint their destinations: a hidden, well-defended ordnance depot. This facility is a key supplier for local {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces, and taking it from them will significantly damage their efforts against us. We'd like you to drop in, take the depot, and hold out against any enemy reinforcements.
column2: 我们一直在追踪几支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}车队的动向，这让我们精确定位了它们的目的地：一处隐蔽、防守严密的军械库。该设施是当地{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队的关键供应方，从他们手里夺下将严重打击他们对我们的行动。我们希望你能降落进去，拿下军械库，并顶住任何敌方增援。ZH

column1: Capture the Ordnance Depot
column2: 夺取军火补给站

column1: Spazz is a nasty, nasty drug, Commander, but not really recreational in any way. If some MechWarrior wants to burn themself out on the stuff, that's on them.
column2: 疯狂是一种非常、非常凶险的药物，指挥官，根本算不上什么娱乐品。如果某个机师想把自己烧在这玩意儿上，那是他自己的事。ZH

column1: We've been following this shipment of Spazz that the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} authorities here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} intercepted. You'd think that, given all the things they say about Spazz, they'd have torched the stuff already. But instead they've locked it up in a secure depot. I'm sure they won't mind if we take that stuff off their hands. We have much better uses for it than just blowing it all up.
column2: 我们一直在追查这批被{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}当局截获的斯帕兹。你会以为，既然他们那样说斯帕兹，早该把东西烧了。但他们却把它锁进了安全仓库。我相信他们不会介意我们把东西从他们手里接走。比起一把火烧掉，我们对它有大得多的用处。ZH

column1: Capture the Secure Depot.
column2: 夺取安全仓库.

column2: 摧毁敌方增援
