Earlier today, our facility here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} received what they believed was a normal data transmission. It was badly garbled, and when they requested it be re-sent, they got no response. Shortly thereafter the base systems began to malfunction, and then we lost contact with both the base and the synchronous satellites covering that region. We'd like you to investigate the facility.
column2: 我们刚与一处设施失去联系，指挥官，我们需要你的帮助。今天早些时候，我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的设施收到了一段他们以为是常规数据的传输。它严重错乱，他们要求重发后却毫无回应。此后不久，基地系统开始故障，然后我们同时失去了与该基地和覆盖该区域的同步卫星的联系。我们希望你去调查那处设施。ZH

column1: Destroy Facility Defenders
column2: 消灭设施守卫

column1: Investigate Facility and Extract Safely
column2: 调查设施并安全撤离

column1: As odd as this sounds... I agree with Mr. Virtanen. Anything that was exposed to that signal needs to be completely destroyed.
column2: 这听着有点怪...我同意维尔塔宁先生的看法. 任何暴露在那个信号下的东西都需要彻底摧毁.

column1: Boss, there's a garbage signal blasting out of that base's transmitters. Want me to put it through?
column2: 老板，那座基地的发射器正往外喷垃圾信号。要我接进来吗？ZH

column1: Commander, with comms switched off, I have no idea if the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are part of an attack, or additional victims of the signal.
column2: 指挥官，由于通讯关闭的关系，我就不知道{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队到底是攻击的一部分，还是这个信号的另一个受害者了.

column1: I wonder if {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} intended this to happen, or if they were themselves infected?
column2: 我在想{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}是不是有意让这事发生的，还是说他们自己也感染了?

column1: We need to pull out and alert our employers about this situation. Containing this signal is their problem, now.
column2: 我们需要撤出来，再向我们的雇主警告这一局面. 现在，控制这个信号是他们的问题了.

column1: Deniable Destruction
column2: 可以撇清关系的毁灭

column1: They're using us so the raid can't be traced to them. Shooting your own people... This is an ugly situation for them to be in, but nobody said the Periphery was a safe place to work.
column2: 他们在利用我们，这样袭击就追查不到他们头上。向自己人开枪……对他们来说这处境实在难看，但没人说过外围地区是个能安心干活的地方。ZH

column1: We are looking for a mercenary company to do some covert work for us. We've lost a base to {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, and believe {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} personnel are being interrogated even now. We can't allow those people to spill their secrets, but it would look bad if we were seen to destroy our own base. We need deniability. We need you to level the base, particularly the storage and communications facilities. We'd appreciate it if you ensured there were no living witnesses, and will pay a bonus if you wipe out all the opposition.
column2: 我们在找一家愿意为我们做一些秘密工作的雇佣兵公司。我们丢了一处基地给{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}，并且相信{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的人员此刻正在被审讯。我们不能容许那些人泄露秘密，但如果被人看到我们摧毁自己的基地，那会很难看。我们需要可否认性。我们需要你把那座基地夷平，尤其是仓储与通讯设施。如果你能确保没有活口，我们会很感激，并会在你清掉所有对手后额外支付奖金。ZH

column1: Destroy All {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Forces
column2: 消灭所有{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队

column1: Destroy Captured Base and Escape
column2: 摧毁被夺走的基地并摆脱敌人

column1: Destroy the Captured Base
column2: 摧毁被占领的基地

column1: Move in, engage the base defenses, and start the demolition.
column2: 行动，和基地的防御力量交火，然后开始拆毁基地.

column1: The captured base is just up ahead, Commander.
column2: 被夺走的基地就在前面，指挥官.

column1: The forces that captured the base are still on-site, so be ready for opposition.
column2: 夺走基地的部队还在现场，所以准备应付敌人.

column1: Destroy {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Structures
column2: 摧毁 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 建筑

column1: We should expect heavy resistance; {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} isn't saying what's in that facility, but whatever it is has them riled up.
column2: 我们得做好遭遇强抵抗的准备；{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} 不肯说那座设施里有什么，但无论是什么都让他们很激动。ZH

column1: The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} manufacturing facility on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} is an illegal intrusion into our territory, and a cover for military personnel and units. Our efforts to resolve this through diplomatic channels have been rebuffed, so we are now turning to a military solution. The facility must be destroyed.
column2: 位于{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}制造设施是对我方领土的非法入侵，并且还是军事人员和部队的掩护点. 我们试图通过外交途径解决此事，但遭到了拒绝，因此现在只能诉诸军事手段. 这处设施必须被摧毁.

column1: Destroy {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Structures and Escape
column2: 摧毁{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}建筑物并摆脱敌人

column1: Destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Facility
column2: 摧毁{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}设施

column1: Assault the base and destroy enough of it to force {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} to abandon the location.
column2: 突袭这座基地并摧毁足够多的东西，迫使{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}放弃这一地区.

column1: We should expect strong opposition on this one. Be wary, Commander. Oliveira out.
column2: 这次行动预计会遇到强烈抵抗. 小心点，指挥官. 奥利维拉完毕.

column1: Your target is the nearby {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} base.
column2: 你的目标是附近的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}基地.

column1: Territorial Claims
column2: 领土主张

column1: Factory Recall
column2: 收回工厂

column1: Depending on what's being produced there, this could be trivial or terrifying. I wish I could be more specific, but our employers don't even know who we're fighting.
column2: 取决于那里在生产什么，这可能只是小事，也可能是件可怕的事。我希望自己能说得更具体，但我们的雇主甚至连我们在跟谁打都不知道。ZH

column1: A routine sweep of the planet's surface revealed something unexpected: a power signature coming from the location of an abandoned facility. From the readings we're getting, it could be a 'Mech factory powering up. We're not in a good strategic position to claim the factory, so we need you to find it and destroy it. If we act quickly, we can deal with this before any 'Mechs are produced. If you do come across any newly produced 'Mechs, of course, you should reduce them to scrap as well.
column2: 对行星表面的一次例行扫描发现了意料之外的情况：一处废弃设施的位置传出了能量信号。从我们读到的数据来看，可能是某座机甲工厂正在启动。在战略上，我们并不处于能夺取这座工厂的位置，所以需要你们找到它并将其摧毁。如果我们行动够快，就能在任何机甲被生产出来之前解决此事。当然，如果你们确实遇到任何新生产的机甲，也应当把它们打成废铁。ZH

column1: Destroy Factory and Extract Safely
column2: 摧毁工厂并安全撤离

column1: Destroy Factory Defenders
column2: 消灭工厂守卫

column1: Destroy the Factory
column2: 摧毁工厂

column1: Damn, I hate to see all that hardware turned to scrap. Imagine if we could have gotten a half-dozen of those Orions working.
column2: 该死，我讨厌看到所有的硬件都变成废铁. 想象一下，如果我们能让六部这样的“猎户座”工作的话.

column1: Okay, folks, I've spotted another DropShip in the area, with {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} markings. So now we know who we're fighting.
column2: 好了各位，我在区域内又发现一艘带 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 标识的空投艇。现在我们知道在跟谁打了。ZH

column1: They've got multiple units protecting this facility, careful not to get caught in an ambush.
column2: 他们有多支部队保护这座设施，小心别被伏击。ZH

column1: Depending on what's being produced there, this could be simple, or it could be terrifying. I wish I could be more specific, but our employers don't even know who we're fighting.
column2: 取决于那里在生产什么，这事可能很简单，也可能很可怕。我希望我能说得更具体，但我们的雇主连我们在跟谁打都不知道。ZH

column1: Destroy Enemy Orions
column2: 摧毁敌方的“猎户座”ZH

column1: We have to assume they are. Things just got more complicated.
column2: 我们得假设他们就是如此. 事情刚刚变得更复杂了.

column1: Turn The Tables
column2: 扭转局势

column1: Destroy enemy structures, deal with defending forces as needed.
column2: 摧毁敌方建筑，按需处理防守部队。ZH

column1: Commander, in my experience, merchants will defend their profits with extreme prejudice. Expect a hostile response as soon as you kick down the door.
column2: 指挥官，根据我的经验，商人们会用极端的偏见来捍卫他们的利润. 当你把门踢开时，就该预料到有充满敌意的反应.

column1: A consortium of {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} manufacturers has been losing ground to a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} competitor every fiscal quarter for years. It's time to turn the tables with one well-timed strike at the primary {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} manufacturing plant here in the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system.
column2: 一个由{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}制造商组成的财团多年来每个财季都在输给一家{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}竞争对手。是时候用一次时机恰到好处的打击扭转局面了——目标就是{TGT_SYSTEM.name}星系里那家{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}主要制造厂。ZH

column1: Destroy Defending Forces
column2: 摧毁守卫部队

column1: Destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Manufacturing Plant and Escape
column2: 摧毁{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}制造厂并摆脱敌人

column1: Destroy the Manufacturing Plant
column2: 摧毁制造工厂

column1: Be wary of the security forces, but the buildings should take priority. Good hunting, Commander.
column2: 小心安保部队，但建筑物应该优先考虑. 狩猎顺利，指挥官.

column1: Move to the facility and start wrecking the buildings.
column2: 前往设施并开始摧毁建筑物.

column1: That was disappointing, commander. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} will not be pleased.
column2: 那真是令人失望，指挥官. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}不会满意的.

column1: We're tasked with destroying several manufacturing structures in the target facility.
column2: 我们的任务是摧毁目标设施内的若干制造建筑。ZH

column1: Incomplete Intelligence
column2: 不完整的情报

column1: This could be {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} using the supplies as cover, but it could also be {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} looking for plausible deniability. We'll probably never learn which.
column2: 这可能是{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}拿补给做掩护，也可能是{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}在寻求可推诿的说辞。我们大概永远不会知道是哪种。ZH

column1: Our {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} enemies are hiding restricted munitions in a series of warehouses used to distribute medical supplies. We would make a public accusation that they're hiding munitions in medical supplies, but that would reveal the source of our intel. Instead, we need you to go in and do what we cannot: destroy the warehouses.
column2: 我们的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}敌人正把受管制弹药藏在一系列用于配送医疗物资的仓库里。我们本可以公开指控他们把弹药藏在医疗物资中，但那会暴露我们情报的来源。所以，我们需要你进去做我们不能做的事：摧毁那些仓库。ZH

column1: Destroy the Target Warehouses
column2: 摧毁目标仓库

column1: Destroy The Warehouses and Escape
column2: 摧毁仓库并摆脱敌人

column1: Be wary of any {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} defenders, and additional patrols in the area. Good hunting, Commander.
column2: 小心任何{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的防御部队，以及该区域的额外巡逻队. 狩猎顺利，指挥官.

column1: Move to the base and start wrecking the buildings.
column2: 前往基地并开始拆毁建筑物.

column1: We're tasked with destroying several structures in the target medical warehouse facility.
column2: 我们的任务是摧毁目标医疗仓库设施内的若干建筑。ZH

column1: Leave A Mark
column2: 留下标记

column1: This seems straightforward, Commander. If things get out of hand, remember you can just blow up the buildings and make a run for it.
column2: 看起来很简单明了，指挥官. 如果局势失控，记住你可以直接炸掉建筑物然后撤离.

column1: There's a minor {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} base in this region, and we'd like to remind them that {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} is aware of their base and they should not become complacent. Destroying a handful of the facility's structures should send the proper message. The base is likely to be guarded; destroy the units guarding it and there's a bonus in it for you.
column2: 这一带有一处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}小型基地，我们想提醒他们，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}知道他们基地的存在，他们不该自满。摧毁该设施的一小部分建筑应该就能传达恰当的信息。基地很可能有守卫；摧毁守卫部队另有奖金给你。ZH

column1: Destroy {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Garrison
column2: 消灭{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}守备部队

column1: Destroy Structures in the Base
column2: 摧毁基地里的建筑物

column1: Take them out, and start doing some damage.
column2: 干掉他们，制造一点破坏.

column1: There will be a garrison, so keep your eyes open for it. Oliveira out.
column2: 那里会有一支守备部队，所以你的眼睛要睁大些. 奥利维拉完毕.

column1: We're seeing fixed defenses powering up, Commander. Turrets are such a pain in the ass.
column2: 指挥官，我们看到固定防御正在启动。炮塔真是麻烦透顶。ZH

column1: If there are enough pirates there to present a problem for local authorities, we should be prepared for a tough fight, Commander.
column2: 如果那儿的海盗已经足以成为当局的问题，那我们该准备好打一场硬仗，指挥官.

column1: A heavily armed pirate band has taken control of a facility on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} and are using it as a base of operations for raiding and terrorizing nearby settlements. The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} authorities do not have the local military resources to assault the base, given how extensively they've entrenched. We need you to destroy the base so that they can no longer use it as a staging area for their criminal acts.
column2: 一伙武装精良的海盗控制了{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}上的一处设施，并把它当作基地，对附近定居点进行袭掠与恐吓。{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}当局没有足够的当地军事资源去强攻该基地，因为他们构筑的工事极为完备。我们需要你摧毁该基地，使他们再也无法把它当作犯罪行动的集结地。ZH

column1: Destroy Facility Structures
column2: 摧毁设施建筑物

column1: Destroy Pirate Facility Structures and Escape
column2: 摧毁海盗设施的建筑物并摆脱敌人

column1: Destroy Pirate Garrison
column2: 消灭海盗守备部队

column1: Destroy Pirate Reinforcements
column2: 消灭海盗的援军

column1: Commander, our target is just ahead. You need to knock down enough structures to cripple the facility.
column2: 指挥官，我们的目标就在前方. 你需要摧毁足够多的建筑物来瘫痪这座设施.

column1: There may be additional enemy units deployed away from the base, so keep your eyes open. Oliveira out.
column2: 可能会有额外的敌方单位部署在远离基地的地方，所以眼睛请睁大些. 奥利维拉完毕.

column1: Well done, Commander. Any remaining pirate forces will have nowhere to hide.
column2: 做得不错，指挥官. 剩下的海盗部队将会无处可藏.

column1: Blood Feud
column2: 血仇

column1: Two wrongs don't make a right, Commander, but they do make a payday.
column2: 指挥官，两个错误加不出一个正确，但它们确实能带来一笔进账。ZH

column1: The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} authorities here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} have just finished a very ambitious operation. They rounded up two dozen members of a rival criminal organization and they're holding them in a secure detention facility. We're not happy with the idea that those scumbags get to live out their lives in comfort and safety behind bars. We want you to give them a bit more severe sentencing.
column2: {TGT_SYSTEM.name}这里的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}当局刚刚完成一次极为大手笔的行动。他们围捕了一个敌对犯罪组织的两打成员，把他们关在一处安全拘留设施里。我们可不乐意看到那些渣滓在铁窗后舒适安全地过完余生。我们想让你给他们一个更严厉点的判决。ZH

column1: Destroy the Detention Facility
column2: 摧毁拘禁设施

column1: Another successful criminal operation in the can, Commander.
column2: 又一场杀青的成功犯罪行动，指挥官.

column1: Enough, Sumire. Commander, your target is just ahead. Good luck.
column2: 好了，苏米尔. 指挥官，你的目标就在前面. 祝你好运.

column1: Unknown BattleMech lance, this is a secure facility. Halt and identify yourselves.
column2: 不明身份的战斗机甲小队，这是一座安全设施. 站住并表明你的身份.

column1: Hide the Evidence
column2: 掩盖证据

column1: No honor among thieves, I suppose.
column2: 盗贼之中没有任何荣誉可言，我认为.

column1: We had a few associates go missing recently, and where should they happen to turn up but a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} black site? We have to assume they're being interrogated right now. Normally, we'd be extremely concerned for their welfare and we'd try to rescue them, but in this case it seems likely they're beyond rescue. We need you to level that black site, to ensure any secrets they've spilled are erased.
column2: 我们最近有几名同伙失踪了，而他们偏偏出现在一处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}黑牢里。我们必须假设他们此刻正在被审讯。通常我们会极为担心他们的安危并设法营救，但这次他们似乎已经救不回来了。我们需要你把那处黑牢夷平，确保他们泄露的任何秘密都被抹除。ZH

column1: Anybody still inside that facility is not going to be doing much talking anytime soon, Commander.
column2: 还留在那座设施里面的人很快就再也开不了口了，指挥官.

column1: THIS IS AN AUTOMATED WARNING. YOU ARE ENTERING A RESTRICTED AREA. WITHDRAW OR YOU WILL BE FIRED ON.
column2: 这是自动警告. 你正在进入限制区域. 请立即撤离，否则将遭到攻击.

column1: Leave No Trace
column2: 不留痕迹

column1: It never occurred to me that 'accountant to pirates' would be a particularly risky position. Makes sense, I suppose.
column2: 我从没想过"给海盗当会计"会是个特别危险的岗位。不过想想也说得通。ZH

column1: One of our sources inside a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} law enforcement facility just reported some alarming news. Somehow, the authorities have gotten their filthy hands on one of our accountants, and they're interrogating him for all our business secrets right now. That's not something we're willing to tolerate. We can't take any chances on this one, Commander. We need you to flatten that facility.
column2: 我们在{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}执法设施里的一位线人刚报告了令人警觉的消息。不知怎么的，当局把他们肮脏的手伸到了我们的一名会计身上，此刻正在为榨取我们所有的生意秘密而审讯他。这不是我们愿意容忍的事。这一票我们不能冒任何风险，指挥官。我们需要你把那处设施夷平。ZH

column1: That could mean reinforcements, Commander. Keep your eyes peeled.
column2: 那可能意味着增援，指挥官. 睁大眼睛.

column1: THE SYSTEM AUTHORITIES HAVE BEEN NOTIFIED OF YOUR INTRUSION.
column2: 星系当局已接到你入侵的通知.

column1: THIS IS AN AUTOMATED WARNING. THIS IS A SECURE FACILITY. WITHDRAW OR YOU WILL BE FIRED ON.
column2: 这是自动警告. 此区域为安全设施. 请立即撤离，否则将遭到攻击.

column1: Sending a Message
column2: 传达信息

column1: This sort of tit-for-tat never works out well, but it means steady work for us.
column2: 这种针锋相对的做法从来不能有效地解决问题，但对我们来说意味着稳定的工作.

column1: Commander, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} leadership has been taking an increasingly hard line against {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}-affiliated corporate interests in the Rimward Periphery; {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} leadership has recently authorized the military interdiction of assets and resources from our corporate affiliates. Their behavior is tantamount to theft, and cannot go unpunished. We need you to send a message back to them by destroying one of their munitions factories on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}.
column2: 指挥官，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}领导层在缘向外围对{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}下属企业的利益集团采取了越来越强硬的立场; 最近，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}领导层甚至授权军方对我们公司附属机构的资产和资源进行查扣. 这种行为无异于盗窃，必须予以惩罚. 我们需要你摧毁他们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的一座军工厂，以此回敬他们一个信息.

column1: In the morning briefing, Sumire had laid out her plans to tour the archeological ruins of {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. \"I've only seen them in Holovids,\" followed by the fateful invitation: \"Commander, you should join me!\"    But now Sumire's splendid views are being ruined by a rabid band of relic hunters, standing between the two of you and the Leopard. Sumire groans. \"This doesn't always happen, Commander, I swear...\"    A voice echoes unexpectedly through the broken buildings. \"These odds aren't very fair. I hope you don't mind if I even them up.\" A man steps out from the shadows on the far side of the smugglers, dressed outlandishly in the style of a Star League era movie star, but brandishing two gleaming pistols.    Two smugglers spin in the gunslinger's direction, then immediately crumple to the dirt, with a spray of blood and an echo of gunshots. After a fusillade of bullets from your and Sumire's sidearms, a third enemy crumples lifelessly. The remaining smugglers flee toward their vehicles.    The gunslinger holsters his pistols in a dextrous flourish. \"You look out of place without your Mech, Commander.\"    \"Uh, have we met?\" asks Sumire.    The man laughs. \"No. I just have a good eye for warriors who have forgotten their swords.\"

column1: <color=#BFBFBF>Yang's voice comes over the comm from the cargo bay, breathless.</color> \"Commander, get down here.\"  <color=#BFBFBF>By the time you arrive, the salvaged transport's cargo container is already cracked open, its contents spilled across the deck plating. column1: In Navigation, Sumire highlights a blinking red alert in the Argo's path. \"We've got some space junk in our way, Commander. Permission to blast it to dust with the Leopard?\" \"Debris,\" Dr. Murad corrects her. \"I recommend that we attempt to avoid it. Otherwise, you risk sending the debris in unexpected directions. column1: \"It's not like I'm the only noble-born person on the ship,\" says [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], slumping low in your guest chair. \"I mean, there's you. Why can't [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] harass you about their stupid idea?\" Apparently when {TGT_MW.Callsign} asked to speak to you privately about something 'Darius wouldn't understand', it was about the trials and tribulations of being nobility.    \"Well, what is {SCN_MW.Callsign}'s idea?\" you ask.    \"I don't know. Something about cooling systems. {SCN_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:want|Default:wants} me to use my 'connections' to get the idea to people who can implement it. And {SCN_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:don't|Default:doesn't} believe me when I say that my birth doesn't automatically open doors like that. And even if it did, I can't waste it on bullshit.\" {TGT_MW.Callsign} gives you a plaintive look, clearly hoping for advice, or at least sympathy.
column2: “船上又不是只有我一个贵族出身，”[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]说，在你客座椅子里萎靡地瘫着。“我是说，还有你呢。为什么[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]不去拿他们那蠢主意烦你？”看来{TGT_MW.Callsign}所谓想私下谈“达里乌斯不会理解”的事，指的就是当贵族有多么苦多么难。“那么，{SCN_MW.Callsign}的主意是什么？”你问。“我不知道。好像是散热系统之类的。{SCN_MW.Subj_C}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:想|Default:想}让我用我的‘人脉’把主意传给能实现它的人。而{SCN_MW.Subj}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:不|Default:不}信我说的：我的出身并不会自动打开那种门。就算会，我也不能把它浪费在胡扯上。”{TGT_MW.Callsign}可怜巴巴地看着你，显然在期待建议，或者至少是同情。ZH

column1: While inspecting the goods in a crowded marketplace, escorted by [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and several other MechWarriors, a berserker roar erupts behind you. You wheel around to see a huge, hairy, leather-clad man bellowing in apparent fury at your group.     As you prepare for a brawl, Behemoth says, \"Hey, Commander, let me handle this.\" She's grinning. \"You can keep shopping if you want.\"    You step out of her way, but linger a moment.    Behemoth takes a wide stance, raises her fists in the air, and roars back at the berserker down the street. His eyes bulge out and he changes position, leaning forward like he's about to charge, and roars again. In response, Behemoth drops low and roars at the heavens.    Whatever is going on, she seems to have it well in hand.
column2: 在拥挤的集市里检查货物时，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]和几名机甲战士护在你身边，你身后突然爆发出一声狂战士般的怒吼。你转过身，只见一个身材巨大、毛发浓密、穿着皮衣的男人正对着你们一群人咆哮，显然怒不可遏。你正准备开打，巨兽说：“嘿，指挥官，这个交给我。”她在笑。“你想继续逛街也行。”你让开一步，但停留了片刻。巨兽岔开腿、双拳举向空中，朝街那头的狂战士吼了回去。那人眼睛鼓起，改变姿势前倾，仿佛要冲锋，又吼了一声。作为回应，巨兽压低身形，朝天空咆哮。不管这是在干什么，她似乎完全应付得来。ZH

column1: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] presents herself in your office as ordered, standing at something that passes for attention. \"What's up, Commander?\"     \"According to the logs, you haven't been using the lounge lately. Yet according to eyewitness reports, you have been. What's going on?\"     Glitch sighs. \"The XO had Dr. Murad install that bioscanner on the lounge door, remember? So she could restrict troublemakers? Well, it doesn't work for me. I get locked out every time.\"     A quick call to the engineer confirms Glitch's report. \"It's very vexing, Commander,\" says Dr. Murad. \"I've recalibrated it for her three times but it never really takes. Something about her biochemistry, maybe.\"     Glitch has a patient, long-suffering look as she waits for your pronouncement.
column2: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]奉命来到你的办公室，站出一个勉强算立正的姿势。"什么事，指挥官？"  "根据记录，你最近没使用休息室。但据目击报告，你用过了。怎么回事？"  故障叹了口气。"执行官让穆拉德博士在休息室门上装了那个生物扫描仪，记得吗？好让她限制捣乱分子？可它对我不起作用。我每次都被锁在外面。"  给工程师的快速通话证实了故障的说法。"这非常令人烦恼，指挥官，"穆拉德博士说。"我为她重新校准了三次，但总是不生效。也许是她的生物化学有什么问题。"  故障带着耐心而长期受苦的表情，等待你的裁决。ZH

column1: Sumire interrupts your morning rituals with an unusual communication from planetside. \"Commander, you'll want to see this message.\"    As the video playback comes through, you see an older man, grizzled and hard-worn, with an equally-tired looking woman beside him.    \"Uh, hello? This is a message for Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. We wanted to thank-you for what you've done here in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}.\"    He pauses and with encouragement from his wife continues. \"And ah... we've heard that our boy is working for you. He goes by [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]? We were hoping you could contact us and tell us how he's doing. When he left us, we didn't really part on the best of terms. He hasn't talked to us for a long time. But recent events... well, you know. We miss him and we'd really appreciate it if you could give us a little bit of news.\"

column1: A stranger with slicked back hair and a tailored suit shoves a compad at Darius, while you're loading up the Leopard on [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]]. The XO stomps over, pulling you and [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] aside. \"Unbelievable! Today, {TGT_MW.Callsign} racked up a huge debt—two million C-bills—at a crime syndicate’s gambling ring and had the gall to run out on 'em.\" \"I don't know what you're talking about.\" {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s gaze flickers toward the stranger. Darius points to a video feed on the stranger's compad. On the screen, {TGT_MW.Callsign} climbs out the window of a seedy industrial structure. \"They want their money, but they'll accept {TGT_MW.Callsign} in lieu of cash. It's 'strictly business,' he assured me.\" \"I can't afford to pay that back. Let's take off!\" {TGT_MW.Callsign} blurts out. \"Forget this creep.\" Darius grabs {TGT_MW.Callsign} by the arm. \"Pipe down, Card Shark. This is the Commander's call. These gentlemen are tied to pirates all over the Periphery. We might piss off a whole slew of bad guys if we bolt.\"

From the outside.\" {TGT_MW.Callsign} averts {TGT_MW.DET} gaze. \"Apparently, {TGT_MW.SUBJ} managed to jimmy the door open without alerting anyone.\" The XO's lip curls into an angry frown. \"How about it, MechWarrior? Care to explain why you took an unauthorized [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreEVA],EVA]]?\" {TGT_MW.Callsign} sighs. \"I just had to, Commander.\" {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:search|Default:searches} your face for a reaction. \"It's so peaceful out there—floating free, just me and the stars. No explosions, no sweltering cockpit. Just calm and quiet.\" Darius shoots you a sidelong glance. \"This little stunt could've gone wrong in a hundred different ways. Chuckles here is lucky {TGT_MW.SUBJ} didn't get anyone killed. How do you think we should handle it?\"
column2: 达里乌斯用手指戳着[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]，后者闷闷不乐地坐在临时禁闭室里。“昨晚杨抓到这家伙从阿尔戈的腹部气闸偷偷进来。是从外面。”{TGT_MW.Callsign}移开{TGT_MW.DET}目光。“看样子，{TGT_MW.SUBJ}撬开了舱门而没惊动任何人。”副官气得嘴角绷紧。“怎么样，机甲战士？愿意解释一下你为什么未经许可进行[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreEVA],舱外活动]]吗？”{TGT_MW.Callsign}叹了口气。“我非去不可，指挥官。”{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:端详|Default:端详}着你的脸，看你的反应。“外面太宁静了——自由漂浮，只有我和星星。没有爆炸，没有闷热的驾驶舱。只有安静与平和。”达里乌斯斜眼瞥你。“这出小把戏有一百种出事的方式。这位笑匠运气好，{TGT_MW.SUBJ}没害死任何人。你觉得我们该怎么处理？”ZH

column1: The Alyina Mercantile League is an independent state formed in the wake of Clan Jade Falcon's collapse during the mid-32nd century. Centered on the planet Alyina, the League emerged as a coalition of mercantile interests and planetary governments seeking to establish stability and economic independence in a region long ravaged by Clan conflict. Blending pragmatic governance with a strong focus on commerce, the League fosters cooperation among its member worlds while actively defending its sovereignty through a combination of mercenaries and local forces. Positioned at a crossroads of trade and strategy, the Alyina Mercantile League has become a beacon of order and prosperity in a fractious era.
column2: 阿莉娜商业联盟是翡翠猎鹰氏族在三十二世纪中叶崩溃之后形成的一个独立国家。联盟以阿莉娜行星为中心，由商业利益方与行星政府结成的同盟组成，力求在一个长期被氏族冲突蹂躏的地区建立稳定与经济独立。联盟把务实治理与对商业的强烈关注相结合，在成员世界之间促进合作，同时通过雇佣兵与本地部队的组合积极捍卫自身主权。地处贸易与战略的十字路口，阿莉娜商业联盟已成为这个纷乱时代里秩序与繁荣的灯塔。ZH

column1: The Amaris Empire was the realization of Stefan's great ambitions. Viewing all the Inner Sphere, and specifically the Star League, as oppressor states who were crushing the Periphery states, Stefan planned a military coup to overthrow the League leadership and take the power. The death of First Lord Simon Cameron in 2751 was his opportunity. The First Lord's death, apparently an accident, later was discovered to be a murder, but it remains unknown if it was the work of Stefan or not. In any case, Stefan approached Richard Cameron, the young successor of Simon, winning his trust, murdering him, all his family and anyone loyal to the Camerons. The Amaris Coup was a great initial success, conquering all worlds of the Terran Hegemony.
column2: 阿马里斯帝国是斯特凡宏大野心的实现。斯特凡把所有内层星域势力、尤其是星际联盟视为压迫外围国家的压迫者，因而策划了一场军事政变以推翻联盟领导层并夺取权力。2751年第一领主西蒙·卡梅隆之死成了他的机会。这位第一领主的死表面上是意外，后来被发现是谋杀，但是否出自斯特凡之手仍不清楚。无论如何，斯特凡接近了西蒙的年轻继承人理查德·卡梅隆，赢得他的信任，随后谋杀了他、他全家以及一切忠于卡梅隆的人。阿马里斯政变初期大获成功，征服了地球霸权的所有世界。ZH

column1: The Arc-Royal Liberty Coalition (ARLC) is a breakaway state formed in the mid-32nd century after the collapse of the Wolf Empire and Clan Wolf's occupation of the Lyran Commonwealth's Arc-Royal region. Centered on the planet Arc-Royal, the ARLC was established under the leadership of Clan Wolf-in-Exile. It represents an alliance of local systems seeking autonomy, rejecting external domination while embracing both the Clan and Inner Sphere traditions. Known for its strong military capability, the Coalition is characterized by its hybrid culture and pragmatic governance, embodying a unique blend of freedom and security within a turbulent Inner Sphere.
column2: 弧王自由联盟（ARLC）是一个分离国家，于三十二世纪中叶在狼帝国崩溃、狼族占领莱兰联邦弧王地区之后成立。它以弧王行星为中心，在流亡狼族氏族的领导下建立。它代表着寻求自治的地方星系联盟，拒绝外部支配，同时拥抱氏族与内天体两种传统。联盟以强大的军事能力著称，其特征是混合文化与务实治理，在动荡的内天体中体现了自由与安全的独特融合。ZH

Many noble houses of the Aurigan Directorate harbor sympathies for the Restoration and its cause: returning the Arano monarchy to power.

column1: Untouched by attacks from the Word of Blake, the Protectorate actively worked to improve the fledgling nation's industrial base and used the developing manufacturing resources to help boost the economy through exports. The improved manufacturing base also gave the CPM local sources of supply, and military recruitment picked up both as a result of the more enthusiastic amongst the energized citizens of the protectorate and the swarms of immigrants from the Concordat who fled to the Protectorate to escape the ruling military junta.  The Protectorate further improved its economic base by establishing trade ties with the nearby Filtvelt Coalition and Fronc Reaches, as well as the more distant Raven Alliance - and these ties also helped to secure the Protectorate's borders.  Eighty-one years after the Calderon Protectorate was formed, on 29 August 3147, Protector Sam Calderon and Kaff Doru announced that Doru's twelve-year-old daughter Reva and Calderon's eight-year-old son Bryant would marry once Bryant turned eighteen. Until then, the two nations would expand their trade relations and engage in mutual defense operations, with additional safeguards to prevent events like the Bromhead Massacre of 3067.
column2: 由于未遭布雷克之言的攻击，保护国积极致力于改善这个初生国家的工业基础，并利用发展中的制造资源，通过出口提振经济。改进后的制造基础也为CPM提供了本地供应来源，军事招募也随之上扬——既有保护国公民中更热心者的踊跃，也有大批为逃避执政军政府而从协约国逃往保护国的移民。保护国还通过与附近的菲尔特地联盟和弗朗克边疆，以及更遥远的渡鸦联盟建立贸易关系，进一步夯实其经济基础——这些纽带也有助于保障保护国的边界安全。卡尔德隆保护国成立八十一年后，3147年8月29日，保护者萨姆·卡尔德隆与卡夫·多鲁宣布，多鲁十二岁的女儿雷瓦与卡尔德隆八岁的儿子布莱恩特将在布莱恩特满十八岁后成婚。在此之前，两国将扩大贸易往来并开展共同防御行动，并附加额外保障措施，以防止再出现像3067年布罗姆黑德惨案那样的事件。ZH

column2: 岩蜍氏族是尼古拉斯·克伦斯基创立的原始20个氏族之一，在对待平民与自由出生者的方式上，被视为十字军氏族中较为开明的一支。ZH

column1: Clan Burrock
column2: 伯洛克氏族

column1: Cloud Cobra
column2: 云眼镜蛇

column1: The only Clan defined by its incorporation of organized religions, Clan Cloud Cobra's warrior-priests are organized into Cloisters and dedicated themselves to an overarching concept known as The Way.  Clan Cloud Cobra are one of the Warden Clans, who seek to preserve the inner sphere.
column2: 作为唯一以纳入组织化宗教为特征的部族，云眼镜蛇的战士祭司按“隐修院”编制，献身于一个被称为“道”的总体理念。云眼镜蛇是守护者部族之一，致力于保存内层星域。ZH

column1: Clan Cloud Cobra
column2: 云蛇氏族

column1: The Coyote Clan was responsible for the invention of the OmniMech and is one of the strongest of the Warden Clans. The Coyotes were also known for their mystical beliefs, based on native American religious practices.
column2: 郊狼氏族是万能机甲的发明者，也是守望者氏族中最强大的氏族之一. 郊狼氏族还以其基于美洲原住民宗教习俗的神秘信仰而闻名.

column1: Diamond Shark
column2: 钻石鲨

column1: Originally known as Clan Sea Fox, and often referred to as the Merchant Clan, the Diamond Sharks were among the most powerful and progressive of the Warden Clans.
column2: 钻石鲨最初被称为海狐氏族，常被称作商人氏族，是守护者氏族中最强大、最进步的一支。ZH

column1: Fire Mandrill
column2: 火狒狒

column1: Probably the most fractious of the Clans, the Fire Mandrill are as likely to fight each other as they are an enemy.
column2: 可能是各部族中最易内斗的，火狒狒彼此开战的可能性不亚于与外敌开战。ZH

column1: Clan Fire Mandrill
column2: 氏族火狒狒

column1: Ghost Bear
column2: 鬼熊

column1: Among the most powerful of the Clans, the Ghost Bears were defined by their conservative 'wait and see nature' and their deep familial relationship with each other.
column2: 身为氏族中最强大的几支之一，幽灵熊的特征是其保守的"观望"天性以及彼此间深厚的家族式纽带。ZH

column1: The Goliath Scorpion Clan was obsessed with recovering any and all lost artifacts of the fallen Star League, sending Seekers fueled by necrosa visions far and wide to recover them.
column2: 蝎狮氏族痴迷于寻回覆灭星盟的一切失落造物，派出由死灵幻象驱动的探寻者远赴四方将其收回。ZH

column1: Known for their prominent use of combat vehicles in front-line forces, the Hell's Horses lived by the motto that man came before machine and all members were valued as being part of a greater whole, including freebirths.
column2: 以在前线部队中大量使用战斗车辆而闻名，地狱马的座右铭是人先于机器，所有成员——包括自由出生者——都被视为更大整体的一部分而受到重视。ZH

column1: Clan Hell's Horses
column2: 氏族地狱马

column1: Ice Hellion
column2: 冰恶棍

column1: A fierce, quick-handed Clan bordering on reckless, the Ice Hellion Clan often grasped for prizes beyond their reach and could be their own worst enemy. Ice Hellion warriors prized the ability to strike first above other considerations.
column2: 冰地狱狮是一个凶猛、出手迅速的部族，几近鲁莽，常伸手去抓超出自身能力的东西，可能是自己最大的敌人。冰地狱狮战士把先手打击的能力看得比什么都重。ZH

column1: Jade Falcon
column2: 玉鹰

column1: Staunch traditionalists and aggressive fighters, the Jade Falcons were central in the creation of the Crusader philosophy. They live by the mantra 'might makes right'
column2: 作为坚定的传统主义者与好斗的战士，玉猫部族在十字军哲学的创立中处于核心地位。他们奉行“强者即正义”的信条。ZH

column1: Clan Jade Falcon
column2: 玉鹰氏族

column1: Gutted in the fight for Terra and the proceeding ilKhan Trial, with 98% percent of their forces on Terra perishing in the struggles, Clan Jade Falcon's survivors numbered roughly 120, with many of those severely injured. Clan Jade Falcon then began serving as a bodyguard Clan vowing to protect the ilKhan and the reborn Star League under new leadership after abandoning the Mongol Doctrine and choosing a new Khan.  The most intact part of the Falcon's Touman was their Warfleet, which helped Clan Wolf units to keep watch over the other Clans invited to the IlClan's founding ceremony.  The remaining forces in the Occupation Zone were either conquered by Inner Sphere factions or splintered into newer incarnations of the Clan. One maintains the Clan Jade Falcon identity and is led by Khan Jiyi Chistu, the other, composed by the bulk of the Falcon's Merchant Caste, is the Alyina Mercantile League, led by Merchant caste Syndic Marena.
column2: 在争夺地球的战斗及随后的伊尔汗大考验中被彻底打残，驻地球部队有98%在战火中覆灭，翡翠猎鹰氏族的幸存者仅约120人，其中许多人身负重伤。此后翡翠猎鹰放弃蒙古教义、选出新可汗，转而充当护卫氏族，誓言保护伊尔汗与重生星盟的新领导层。猎鹰图曼中最完整的一部分是其战舰队，它协助狼族部队看管受邀参加伊尔汗建国典礼的其他氏族。占领区内的残余部队要么被内天体势力征服，要么分裂成该氏族的新化身。其中一支保持翡翠猎鹰氏族的身份，由可汗吉伊·奇斯图统领；另一支由猎鹰商人种姓的主体组成，即阿莉娜商业联盟，由商人种姓理事玛蕾娜领导。ZH

column1: Clan Mongoose was one of the original twenty Clans founded by Nicholas Kerensky, named for the creature on Shadow that preyed upon the dangerous venom worms and thus endeared itself to Shadow's colonists. While the Clan did well enough for itself during the first half of the twenty-ninth century, its heavy reliance upon politics over honorable combat alienated other Clans and eventually sealed its fate when Clan Smoke Jaguar won the right to Absorb them in 2868. After a brutal campaign the Jaguars prevailed and, save for some aerospace pilot heritages taken by Clan Cloud Cobra, Clan Mongoose's legacies ceased to exist.
column2: 獴氏族是尼古拉斯·克伦斯基创立的原始二十个氏族之一，得名于影星上一种捕食危险毒虫的生物，因此深受影星殖民者的喜爱。虽然该氏族在二十九世纪前半段发展得相当不错，但它过度依赖政治而非荣誉战斗，使其他氏族疏远，最终在2868年烟虎氏族赢得吸收它的权利时注定了它的命运。经过一场残酷的战役，烟虎胜出，除了一些被云眼镜蛇氏族收走的航空机师血脉之外，獴氏族的传承不复存在。ZH

column1: Nova Cat
column2: 新星猫

column1: A Clan marked by their own unique brand of mysticism, the Nova Cats are guided by visions and portents, and even its Khans first consulted with the Oathmaster before undertaking any action which could affect the Clan.
column2: 新星猫是一个以独特神秘主义风格著称的部族，他们受幻象与预兆指引，就连可汗在采取任何可能影响部族的行动之前，也要先咨询誓约长。ZH

column1: The Clan Protectorate is a unique province within the Free Worlds League, formed under the leadership of Clan Sea Fox and inspired by the vision of Lady Julletta Marik. Recognizing the strategic and economic advantages of partnering with Clans rather than opposing them, Lady Julletta facilitated the Protectorate's creation as a semi-autonomous region blending Clan efficiency with Free Worlds League governance. The Protectorate is centered around worlds granted to Clan Sea Fox in exchange for their mercantile prowess, fostering stability and prosperity through trade and mutual cooperation. It represents an ambitious experiment in hybrid governance, uniting Clan and Inner Sphere ideals within the Marik realm.
column2: 氏族保护国是自由世界联盟中一个独特的省，在海狐氏族领导下建立，灵感来自朱莱塔·马里克女士的构想。朱莱塔女士认识到与氏族合作、而非对抗它们的战略与经济优势，促成保护国作为一个半自治区域建立，把氏族效率与自由世界联盟的治理融为一体。保护国以那些为换取海狐氏族的商业才能而授予他们的世界为中心，通过贸易与相互合作促进稳定与繁荣。它代表着一次雄心勃勃的混合治理实验，在马里克领域内把氏族与内天体的理想结合起来。ZH

column1: Clan Protectorate
column2: 氏族保护领

column1: Clan Sea Fox is the original name of Clan Diamond Shark. Clan Sea Fox and Clan Snow Raven had a falling out, and in response Clan Snow Raven created the Diamond Shark, a predator designed solely to hunt and kill the Sea Foxes who lived in Strana Mechty's oceans. After most of the Sea Foxes had been killed, Clan Sea Fox petitioned the Grand Council to change its name to Clan Diamond Shark. Several sea foxes were preserved by the Clan and placed on other worlds, where they flourished. As a result, Clan Diamond Shark changed its name back to Clan Sea Fox by 3100. The Diamond Shark/Sea Fox Clan has relied heavily on its Merchant Caste since its inception, giving them more power and freedom than most Clans. Though many believe them to be weak because of their democratic attitudes toward their lower castes, the Diamond Sharks maintained one of the largest and most elite toumans among the Clans.
column2: 海狐氏族是钻石鲨氏族的原名。海狐氏族与雪鸦氏族发生争执，作为回应，雪鸦氏族创造了钻石鲨——一种专为猎杀斯特拉纳·麦赫蒂海洋中海狐而设计的掠食者。在大部分海狐被杀之后，海狐氏族向大议会请愿，要求改名为钻石鲨氏族。该氏族保存了几只海狐并安置到其他行星上，它们在那里繁衍兴旺。因此，钻石鲨氏族在3100年前又把名字改回了海狐氏族。钻石鲨/海狐氏族自创立起就严重依赖其商人种姓，给予他们的权力与自由远超大多数氏族。尽管许多人因其对低等种姓的民主态度而认为他们软弱，钻石鲨仍保有着氏族中规模最大、最精锐的图曼之一。ZH

column1: Clan Sea Fox
column2: 海狐氏族

column1: 50 years after Clan Diamond Shark officially changes its name back to Clan Sea Fox, they proceed to buy all of the Free Worlds League's ComStar assets and absorbs all Wolf Empire's working and nonworking HPGs. They also supplied Clan Wolf for their campaign to Terra.  Clan Sea Fox, after the rise of the IlClan, began bonding mercenary contracts across Federated Suns and Draconis Combine space, quickly replacing the MRBC.
column2: 在钻石鲨部族正式改回海狐部族之名50年后，他们着手买下自由世界联盟的全部通讯之星资产，并吸收狼帝国所有可运行与不可运行的HPG。他们还为狼部族的远征地球行动提供补给。在伊尔克兰崛起之后，海狐部族开始在联邦太阳国与龙脉联合体空间内串联雇佣兵合约，迅速取代了MRBC。ZH

column1: Smoke Jaguar
column2: 烟虎

column1: Clan Smoke Jaguar was among the most aggressive and warlike of the Clans, even at the expense of more peaceful endeavors, and were early supporters of the Crusader philosophy.  They are noted for repressing anyone but their own Warrior Caste.
column2: 烟虎氏族是氏族中最具侵略性和最好战的成员之一，即便以牺牲更为和平的事业为代价，并且是十字军哲学的早期支持者。他们以压制除自身武士阶层以外的所有人而为人所知。ZH

column1: Clan Smoke Jaguar
column2: 烟虎氏族

column1: Masters of compromise and manipulation, Clan Snow Raven were opportunists of the highest order, possessing an almost un-Clanlike sense of self-preservation and a willingness to sell their services to the highest bidder.
column2: 作为妥协与操纵的大师，雪鸦氏族是最高级别的机会主义者，拥有近乎不像氏族人的自保意识，以及把服务卖给出价最高者的意愿。ZH

column1: Clan Snow Raven
column2: 雪鸦氏族

column1: Star Adder
column2: 星蝰蛇

column1: A conservative Clan, the Star Adders are known for their pragmatism and their strategic (rather than tactical) view towards battle, as well as treating freeborn that proved themselves as equals.
column2: 星蝰氏族是一个保守的氏族，以实用主义和注重战略（而非战术）层面的作战观念而闻名，同时也以平等对待那些证明了自己价值的自由生而著称.

column1: Clan Star Adder
column2: 星蝰氏族

column1: Steel Viper
column2: 钢蝰

column1: The Steel Vipers had the toughest training regime of any Clan save the Blood Spirits, graduating fewer but more elite warriors, and were more discriminating against freebirths than other Clans.
column2: 钢蛇氏族拥有除血灵氏族外所有氏族中最严苛的训练制度，培养出的战士数量更少但更为精锐，并且比其他氏族更歧视自由生者.

column1: Clan Steel Viper
column2: 钢蛇氏族

column1: Stone Lion
column2: 石狮

column1: Named from the feline inhabiting the northern mountains of Tokasha, Clan Stone Lion was created from the remaining Homeworld members of Clan Hell's Horses after the Abjuration of their Inner Sphere portion in 3075
column2: 以栖息在托卡沙北部山脉的猫科动物命名，石狮氏族是在其内天体分支于3075年被弃绝之后，由地狱马氏族余下的本土星系成员创建的

column1: Clan Stone Lion
column2: 石狮氏族

column1: Clan Widowmaker was one of the original twenty Clans. Their homeworld was Roche, settled in 2812. Known as an extremely aggressive Clan, they had a relatively short history before their Absorption by Clan Wolf.
column2: 寡妇制造者氏族是原始二十个氏族之一。他们的母星是罗什，于2812年殖民。作为一个以极度好斗著称的氏族，他们在被狼族吸收之前历史相对短暂。ZH

column1: Clan Widowmaker
column2: 氏族造寡妇者

column1: The chosen Clan of Nicholas Kerensky, the Wolves have dominated Clan society since their inception. Less formal and more flexible than others, Clan Wolf emulated its namesake by blending caution with decisiveness.
column2: 作为尼古拉斯·克伦斯基选中的部族，狼族自创立以来一直主导着部族社会。狼部族比其他部族更少形式、更为灵活，以其同名者（狼）为榜样，把谨慎与果断融为一体。ZH

column1: Clan Wolf-in-Exile is a splinter faction of the original Clan Wolf, one of the twenty Clans created by Nicholas Kerensky. Born from the destruction of the original Clan Wolf in the Refusal War, the Wolves-in-Exile continued to uphold the Warden traditions of their forebears under the leadership of Khan Phelan Kell by siding with the Inner Sphere
column2: 狼族流亡者是原狼部族的分裂派系，而狼部族是尼古拉斯·克伦斯基所创二十个部族之一。流亡之狼诞生于原狼部族在拒绝战争中的覆灭，他们在可汗费伦·凯尔的领导下站在内层星域一边，继续坚守先辈的守护者传统。ZH

column1: One of the original twenty Clans, Clan Wolverine was Annihilated in the years after Operation KLONDIKE, officially for having detonated nuclear devices to destroy a genetic repository of Clan Snow Raven and for opposing Nicholas Kerensky and the Clans as a whole.     The Clans subsequently went to great lengths to purge Clan Wolverine from their history. They refer to the former Clan Wolverine only as the \"Not-Named Clan\". Instead of properly referring the \"IIC\"-style evolution of the Wolverine BattleMech as the Wolverine IIC, it was renamed the Conjurer (Hellhound). More than two hundred years after Clan Wolverine's annihilation, the mere comparison of a Clan warrior to an animal identified as wolverine, in a completely unrelated situation and by a person not accustomed to Clan society, was still considered a shocking insult that might elicit a violent response.
column2: 作为原始二十个氏族之一，狼獾氏族在克朗代克行动之后的岁月里被灭绝，官方理由是它引爆核装置摧毁了雪鸦氏族的一处基因库，并反对尼古拉斯·克伦斯基与整个氏族体制。此后氏族们不遗余力地把狼獾氏族从历史中抹除。他们只把前狼獾氏族称作"无名氏族"。狼獾战斗机甲那种"IIC"式演化本应称为狼獾IIC，却被改名为咒术师（地狱犬）。在狼獾氏族被灭绝两百多年后，仅仅把一名氏族战士比作一种被认作狼獾的动物——在完全无关的场合，由不熟悉氏族社会的人做出——仍被视为可能招致暴力回应的惊人侮辱。ZH

column1: Clan Wolverine
column2: 狼獾氏族

column1: Far be it from a simple organization like ComStar to reprimand you in matters of warfare, Commander, butâ€¦ your performance on that operation was positively abysmal. We roundly condemn your inadequacies.
column2: 像通讯之星这样简单的组织本不该在作战事务上斥责你，指挥官，但……你在那次行动中的表现实在糟糕透顶。我们对你的无能予以严正谴责。ZH

column1: ComStar, the institution and religion, grew out of the Star League Department of Communications, as reenvisioned by Jerome Blake, Minister of Communications. ComStar is transnational, beholden to none of the Successor States, and its priesthood exclusively controls access to the only means of faster-than-light communications, the HyperPulse Generators. ComStar facilities and personnel are sacrosanct, a status enforced aggressively by the institution; offending statesâ€”even entire Successor Statesâ€”can find themselves cut off from the rest of the Inner Sphere, unable to communicate or trade. The current head of ComStar is Primus Julian Tiepolo.
column2: 通讯之星(ComStar)，作为一个机构与宗教，脱胎于星际联盟通讯部，由时任通讯部长杰罗姆·布雷克重新构想而创立. 通讯之星是跨国组织，不对任何继承国效忠，其教士阶层独掌着唯一超光速通讯手段——超脉冲发生器的使用权. 通讯之星的设施与人员神圣不可侵犯，这一地位由该机构极力维护; 冒犯它的国家——甚至是整个继承国——都可能发现自己被内天体其余部分隔绝，无法通讯与贸易. 通讯之星目前的领袖是首席主教朱利安·蒂耶波洛.

column1: It seems apparent that while you failed to achieve our goals, you engaged the enemy for as long as you were able. Better luck next time, Commander. May the Spirit of Blake be with you.
column2: 这看起来似乎很显然，虽然你没有达成我们的目标，但已经尽你所能来和敌人交战了. 希望你下次能走运一些，指挥官. 希望布雷克的精神与你同在.

column1: ComStar congratulates you on your successful mission, mercenary. We are pleased you've been able to assist us so thoroughly.
column2: 康星祝贺你任务成功，佣兵。我们很高兴你能如此彻底地协助我们。ZH

column1: Dark Caste
column2: 黑暗种姓

column1: The Dark Caste is largely a mystery. Equipped with ancient Clan mechs from their Golden Century as well as old mothballed SLDF mechs, the Dark Caste appear to be little more than Clan renegades and bandits, raiding Deep Periphery states with impunity and marauding at will. They have no leadership or goals, they exist only to survive at any cost.
column2: 黑暗种姓大体是个谜。他们装备着来自黄金世纪的古老氏族机甲以及旧封存的SLDF机甲，看起来不过是氏族的叛徒与匪徒，肆无忌惮地劫掠深远外缘国家，任意横行。他们没有领袖或目标，只为了不惜一切代价生存。ZH

column1: Come now, mercenary—did you even try to complete the contract, or did you believe we'd pay you for your own inadequacies? Such a dismal performance cannot be rewarded, only reprimanded.
column2: 得了吧，雇佣兵——你到底有没有尽力去履行合约，还是以为我们会为你自己的无能付钱？如此糟糕的表现得不到奖赏，只能受到训斥。ZH

column1: The Federated Suns is one of the five Successor States of the Star League, located rimward and spinward of Terra. Ruled by House Davion, the Federation is the most powerful of the five, and the people of the Federation pride themselves on their self-proclaimed role as defenders of justice and liberty. The Federation is quite capable of ruthless, decisive action, though, and its idealism readily gives way to pragmatism when called for. The current ruler of the Federation, Prince Hanse Davion, is an experienced and unconventional military commander. The Federation's alliance with the Lyran Commonwealth effectively ended the Third Succession War.
column2: 联邦太阳国是星际联盟的五个继承国之一，位于地球的外缘方向与顺旋方向。它由达维昂家族统治，是五国中最强大的一个，其人民也以自封的正义与自由捍卫者自居而自豪。不过，这个联邦同样能采取无情而果断的行动，必要时其理想主义也会让位于务实。联邦现任统治者汉斯·达维昂亲王是一位经验丰富、不循常规的军事指挥官。联邦与莱兰联邦的结盟实质上终结了第三次继承战争。ZH

column1: Well, let it never be said House Davion does not believe in charity. Obviously, your skills could not be equivalent to our own regular armies—so we do not blame you for your inability to complete the contract.
column2: 嗯，可别让人说戴维恩家族不信慈善。显然，你的本领无法与我们正规军相提并论——所以我们不怪你没能完成合约。ZH

column1: Excellent performance, Commander. The Federated Suns are pleased with what you have accomplished and the skill you've evidenced. Expect our payment in full!
column2: 表现出色，指挥官。联邦太阳国对您的成就与展现出的技艺十分满意。报酬将足额奉上！ZH

column1: the Federated Suns
column2: 恒星联邦

column1: Little is known about the New Delphi Compact, apart from the capital being New Delphi.  This area will probably be quickly absorbed into a nearby faction anyway, so it's almost certainly not worth your trouble.
column2: 关于新德尔菲共同体知道的很少，除了首都是新德尔菲。这一地区大概很快就会被附近某个派系吸收，所以几乎肯定不值得你费心。ZH

column1: New Delphi Compact
column2: 新德尔斐盟约国

column1: We are deeply disappointed in your performance, Commander. Your efforts on the battlefield were those of a raw cadet, not the leader of a mercenary company.
column2: 我们对你的表现深感失望，指挥官。你在战场上的作为像个新兵，而不是一名佣兵团的领袖。ZH

column1: The Duchy of Andurien was a member province of House Marik's Free Worlds League throughout most of its history before becoming an independent nation in 3079. The water-rich Andurien worlds were disputed between the Free Worlds League and House Liao's Capellan Confederation from early in the Age of War until the First Succession War when the region was finally secured by the League.
column2: 安杜里恩公国在其历史的大部分时间里都是马里克家族自由世界联盟的成员省，直到3079年成为一个独立国家。这些水资源丰富的安杜里恩世界从战火时代早期起就在自由世界联盟与廖氏卡佩兰联邦之间争夺，直到第一次继承战争才最终被联盟稳固掌控。ZH

column1: The Duchy Of Andurien understands that sacrifice on the battlefield doesn't always translate to victory. You've made a fine effort, even if it failed. Just another lesson for the next battle.
column2: 安杜里恩公国明白，战场上的牺牲并不总能换来胜利。你已经付出了出色的努力，即便它失败了。这不过是下一场战斗的又一条教训。ZH

column1: Top-tier work, Commander—House Humphreys is very happy with your performance. Keep it up, and I'll make sure a lot more work comes your way.
column2: 一流的活儿，指挥官——汉弗莱斯家族对你的表现非常满意。继续保持，我保证会有更多工作找上你。ZH

column1: Duchy Of Andurien
column2: 安杜瑞恩公国

column1: During the mid-thirty-second century the Duchy of Andurien strengthened its ties with the Canopians and Capellan Confederation while staunchly refusing to join the resurrected Free Worlds League.  Attempts to annex eleven unaligned world between them and the Regulan Fiefs would cease after the FWLM invades the Regulan Fiefs.
column2: 在32世纪中叶，安杜瑞恩公国加强了与船底人及卡佩拉联邦的联系，同时坚决拒绝加入重生的自由世界联盟。在自由世界联盟军队入侵雷古兰领地后，其试图吞并位于本国与雷古兰领地之间11个中立世界的行动遂告终止。ZH

column1: The Elysian worlds are all planets maintained in their pristine wilderness state. The people supported themselves mainly as hunters and gatherers, and almost universally follow the One Star faith.
column2: 极乐世界诸星球都保持着原始荒野状态。其居民主要以狩猎与采集为生，并几乎普遍信仰“一星”教。ZH

column1: Escorpion Imperio
column2: 天蝎帝国

column1: The Escorpion Imperio was formed in 3080 after Clan Goliath Scorpion was Abjured by the Grand Council. They left Clan Space and conquered the Deep Periphery states known as Nueva Castile and the Umayyad Caliphate
column2: 蝎帝国成立于3080年，此前歌利亚蝎部族被大议会放逐。他们离开部族空间，征服了被称为新卡斯蒂利亚与倭马亚哈里发的纵深外围国家

column1: The Federated Commonwealth was the union of the Lyran Commonwealth and Federated Suns. The accession of Archon-Prince Victor Steiner-Davion in 3055 formally brought the nation into being, though in practice it had existed as the Federated Commonwealth Alliance since 3028. Katherine Steiner-Davion seceded the Lyran half of the nation in 3057, creating the Lyran Alliance, which would lead to the FedCom Civil War in 3062. Victor abdicated the throne in 3067 and his successor, Prince-Regent Yvonne Steiner-Davion, reverted to the \"Federated Suns\". In 3084 the Lyran Alliance reverted to the Lyran Commonwealth.
column2: 联邦共同体是莱兰联邦与联邦太阳的联合体。3055年大公-亲王维克托·施泰纳-达维昂继位，正式使这一国家成立，尽管实际上它自3028年起就以联邦共同体联盟的形式存在。凯瑟琳·施泰纳-达维昂在3057年让国家的莱兰半边退出，建立了莱兰联盟，这最终导致3062年的联邦共同体内战。维克托于3067年退位，其继任者、摄政亲王伊冯娜·施泰纳-达维昂又恢复为"联邦太阳"。3084年，莱兰联盟恢复为莱兰联邦。ZH

column1: The Ferris Collective is a small independent state located between the Rasalhague Dominion and the Republic of the Barrens. Established in the chaos following the collapse of the Hegemony, the Collective is governed by a self-appointed 'Emperor,' who oversees a patchwork of settlements and factories. Known for its pragmatic reliance on mercenary forces to secure its interests, the Ferris Collective is both a trading hub and a fiercely defended enclave, using its manufacturing capabilities and mercenary contracts to maintain independence in the turbulent 32nd century Inner Sphere.
column2: 费里斯集体是一个位于拉萨尔哈格自治领与荒原共和国之间的小型独立国家。它建立于霸权崩溃后的混乱之中，由一个自封的"皇帝"统治，管辖着一片拼凑起来的定居点与工厂。费里斯集体以务实地依赖雇佣兵部队来保障自身利益而闻名，既是贸易枢纽，又是防御严密的飞地，凭借其制造能力与雇佣兵合约，在动荡的三十二世纪内天体中维持独立。ZH

column1: Ferris Collective
column2: 费里斯集合体

column1: The Filtvelt Coalition is a Periphery realm that formed on February 20, 3072 from worlds that seceded from the Federated Suns
column2: 菲尔特地联盟是一个外缘政权，于3072年2月20日由从联邦太阳分离的各行星建立

column1: Filtvelt Coalition
column2: 菲尔特维尔特联盟

column1: The Filtvelt Coalition is a Periphery realm that formed on February 20, 3072 from worlds that seceded from the Federated Suns.  When Sherwood was conquered by Tortugan pirates, the Coalition aided the Periphery March to counter the invasion.
column2: 菲尔特维尔特联盟是一个外围国度，于3072年2月20日由脱离恒星联邦的诸世界组建而成。当舍伍德星被托尔图加海盗攻占时，该联盟曾协助外围边疆区抵御入侵。ZH

column1: Finmark Free Republic
column2: 芬马克自由共和国

column1: The Finmark Free Republic was a rising periphery power that became another casualty of the First Succession War.    Between 2779 and 2782 Finmark created a government modeled on the early Rim Worlds system and managed to pull together a defense force comprised largely of fresh recruits and orphaned elements of the SLDF and the former Rim Worlds Army; these forces mustered a strength of almost two BattleMech regiments, a similar number of aerospace fighters, and enough armor and infantry units for each world in the Republic to have approximately two regiments of mixed armor and infantry each.    Finmark's influence continued to grow, with systems as far away as Inner Surge and Port Vail receiving some form of defensive support from Finmark by the late 2780s as the government worked on rebuilding as much of the former Finmark Province as possible; the government also worked to restore the orbital shipyards above Finmark, with the shipyards nearing fully operational status by the late 2780s. Unfortunately for the nascent interstellar state - and particularly the inhabitants of Finmark - the increasing savagery of the First Succession War combined with Finmark's growing strength attracted predatory attention from the Lyran Commonwealth.
column2: 芬马克自由共和国曾是一个崛起中的外缘势力，后来成为第一次继承战争的又一牺牲品。在2779至2782年间，芬马克建立了一个仿效早期边缘世界体制的政府，并设法拼凑起一支国防力量，主要由新兵以及SLDF和前边缘世界陆军的孤儿部队组成；这些部队集结起将近两个战斗机甲团的兵力、数量相当的航空战机，以及足以让共和国每颗行星各拥有约两个混编装甲与步兵团规模的装甲与步兵单位。芬马克的影响力持续增长：到2780年代末，连内浪和维尔港这样遥远的星系也在接受芬马克某种形式的防御支援，政府则致力于尽可能重建前芬马克省的版图；政府还着手修复芬马克上方的轨道船坞，到2780年代末这些船坞已接近全面运转状态。对这位初生的星际国家——尤其是芬马克的居民——而言不幸的是，第一次继承战争日益加剧的残酷加上芬马克不断增强的实力，招来了莱兰联邦的掠食性关注。ZH

column1: The Fronc Reaches is a small Periphery state located in the Capellan Marches rimward of the Capellan Confederation, spinward of the Magistracy of Canopus, and anti-spinward of the Taurian Concordat. The Fronc Reaches formed from worlds jointly colonized by the Magistracy of Canopus and the Taurian Concordat, formerly known as the New Colony Region.
column2: 弗朗克边疆是卡佩兰边疆区里的一个小型外缘国家，位于卡佩兰联邦的核心方向、卡诺帕治安官辖区的旋臂方向、陶里安协约国的反旋臂方向。弗朗克边疆由卡诺帕治安官辖区与陶里安协约国共同殖民的世界组成，此前被称为新殖民地地区。ZH

column1: Fronc Reaches
column2: 弗朗克边域

column1: The Fronc Reaches is a small Periphery state located in the Capellan Marches rimward of the Capellan Confederation, spinward of the Magistracy of Canopus, and anti-spinward of the Taurian Concordat. The Fronc Reaches formed from worlds jointly colonized by the Magistracy of Canopus and the Taurian Concordat, formerly known as the New Colony Region. From 3135, trade negotiations were opened with both the Capellan Confederation and the Magistracy of Canopus, with both markets eager for military equipment manufactured by the Reaches.
column2: 弗朗克边域是一个小型外围国家，位于卡佩拉边疆区，地处卡佩拉联邦的缘向方向、船底自治区的自旋方向，以及金牛协约国的逆自旋方向。弗朗克边域由船底自治区与金牛协约国共同殖民的星球组建而成，这些星球前称为新殖民地星区。自3135年起，弗朗克边域与卡佩拉联邦及船底自治区开启了贸易谈判，这两个市场都对其制造的军事装备翘首以待。ZH

column1: Galatean League
column2: 加拉蒂亚联盟

column1: The Galatean League emerged as a formal entity on December 24, 3144, following the successful defense of Galatea against an invasion by Clan Jade Falcon. Originally a loose coalition of mercenary commands led by Hansen's Roughriders, the League was established to safeguard Galatea and its neighboring worlds from future Clan advances. Envoys from the League extended invitations to Menkent, Mizar, and Syrma, securing the allegiance of Syrma and Mizar in 3145, though Menkent chose to align with the Jade Falcons. Alcor later joined the League as well. Despite Mizar's withdrawal in 3149, the League maintained a protective presence there, highlighting its commitment to regional stability. The Galatean League represents a bastion of independence and mercenary cooperation in the fractured Inner Sphere of the 32nd century.
column2: 加拉提亚联盟于3144年12月24日正式成立，此前加拉提亚成功抵御了玉猫部族的入侵。该联盟最初是由汉森猛骑兵领导的雇佣兵部队松散联盟，成立目的是保护加拉提亚及其邻近世界免受部族未来的推进。联盟使节向门肯特、米扎尔与西尔玛发出邀请，并在3145年获得西尔玛与米扎尔的效忠，但门肯特选择与玉猫结盟。阿尔科尔后来也加入了联盟。尽管米扎尔于3149年退出，联盟仍在那里维持保护性存在，体现出其对区域稳定的承诺。在32世纪四分五裂的内层星域中，加拉提亚联盟代表着独立与雇佣兵合作的堡垒。ZH

column1: An amalgamation of the Free Rasalhague Republic and Clan Ghost Bear, the Rasalhague Dominion is a blend of the political, military and cultural styles of Inner Sphere and Clan societies. Founded in 3060 as the Ghost Bear Dominion the new state was isolationist by inclination, only waging war against the Draconis Combine and Word of Blake due to external factors
column2: 拉萨尔哈格自治领是自由拉萨尔哈格共和国与幽灵熊氏族的融合体，混合了内天体与氏族社会的政治、军事与文化风格。它于3060年作为幽灵熊自治领建立，这个新国家在倾向上是孤立主义的，只因外部因素才对龙尼斯联合体与布雷克之言发动战争

column1: Ghost Bear Dominion
column2: 鬼熊 Dominion

column1: Green Ghosts
column2: 绿幽灵

column1: The so-called Green Ghosts are an enigmatic and highly unusual warband. They began raiding the Lyran (coreward and anti-spinward) periphery border, i.e. the general area of the former Rim Worlds Republic, in 3060 and continued their operations at least through 3089.
column2: 所谓绿幽灵是一支神秘而极不寻常的作战团体。他们于3060年开始劫掠莱兰（核心方向与反旋臂方向）外缘边界，即前边缘世界共和国的大致区域，其行动至少持续到3089年。ZH

column1: The Hanseatic League is a mercantile faction located in the Deep Periphery.  Mercenaries are welcome, and the overall technological level of their defence forces is equal to any faction in the Inner Sphere.
column2: 汉萨同盟是一个位于深远外缘的商业派系。雇佣兵在此受欢迎，其防御部队的整体技术水平与内天体任何派系相当。ZH

column1: The Havens
column2: 庇护之地

column1: The Havens is a proto-state in the BattleTech universe, comprising systems such as Porthos and Santander.  Emerging after the Ferris Rebellion when the Ghost Bears opted to return Santander and Porthos to the inheritors, The Havens is known for its strategic positioning and the unique challenges it presents to neighboring factions.
column2: 庇护之地是BattleTech宇宙中的一个原型国家，辖有波托斯和桑坦德等星系。在费里斯叛乱之后，幽灵熊氏族选择将桑坦德和波托斯归还其继承者，庇护之地便由此兴起，以其战略位置及对邻近势力构成的独特挑战而闻名。ZH

column1: The Illyrian Palatinate was founded in the mid 24th century by groups of Scandinavian colonists, however it currently faces pressure from both the Circinus Federation and the Marian Hegemony.
column2: 伊利里亚帕拉丁领由斯堪的纳维亚殖民者群体于24世纪中期建立，但如今它同时面临切尔西努斯联邦与马里亚纳霸权的压力。ZH

column1: Illyrian Palatinate
column2: 伊利里亚边区

column1: The St. Ives Compact was a minor Inner Sphere nation that existed from 3029 to 3063.
column2: 圣艾夫斯共同体是一个存在于 3029 至 3063 年的内天体小国。ZH

column1: St. Ives Compact
column2: 圣艾夫斯 Compact

column1: The JarnFolk (literally 'Iron People') are a society of deep Periphery denizens residing approximately 250 light years spinward of Columbus.  They live a primarily agrarian lifestyle.
column2: 雅恩福克人（字面意为"铁人"）是一个深远外缘居民社会，居住在哥伦布旋臂方向约250光年处。他们主要过着农耕生活。ZH

column1: In 3071, Devlin Stone escaped from a Word of Blake reeducation camp on Kittery - RBMU 105 - in the company of Professor David Lear. Together, they organized a local resistance against Word of Blake forces that was finally able to destroy the Blakist organization on Kittery by the end of that year. By 3072, Stone led a force that liberated a number of nearby worlds from the grip of the Jihad. These worlds eventually joined to form Kittery Prefecture.    When word started spreading about this group of planets that were being liberated from the control of the Blakists, Victor Steiner-Davion believed that this idea of a prefecture was the work of a bandit-king looking to create their own power within the Inner Sphere. In October of 3073, Victor and Stone met on of Tukayyid, where Devlin told him what he was doing and how he was going to do it. Victor had to decide whether he was going to stop Stone or get out of his way. Victor decided to get out of his way, to let Stone restructure the Inner Sphere to allow for peace. Victor knew that society was going to collapse because of the Word of Blake attacks, and restructuring the way society had worked for hundreds of years was the only way to bring peace to the Inner Sphere.
column2: 3071年，德夫林·斯通在教授大卫·李尔的陪同下，从基特里（RBMU 105）的布莱克之词再教育营逃脱。两人共同组织当地抵抗力量对抗布莱克之词部队，最终在那年年底摧毁了基特里的布莱克派组织。到3072年，斯通率领一支部队从圣战魔掌中解放了附近若干星球，这些星球最终联合成立基特里辖区。当关于这批被解放星球的传言开始扩散时，维克多·施泰纳-戴维恩认为“辖区”这一构想是某个匪盗之王想在内层星域内建立自己势力的产物。3073年10月，维克多与斯通在图卡伊迪会面，德夫林向他说明自己在做什么、以及打算怎么做。维克多必须决定是阻止斯通，还是给他让路。维克多决定让路，让斯通重塑内层星域以谋求和平。维克多明白，布莱克之词的攻击将导致社会崩溃，而重塑这套运行了数百年的社会方式，是给内层星域带来和平的唯一途径。ZH

column1: Your performance was an embarrassment, Commander. The Draconis Combine expects more of their mercenaries. Keep this up, and we may not offer you any contracts at all!
column2: 指挥官，你的表现令人难堪. 天龙联合体对他们的佣兵期待更大. 如果你继续保持这种状态，那我们可能根本不会给你任何合约!

column1: The Draconis Combine is one of the five Successor States of the Star League, located coreward and spinward of Terra. Ruled by House Kurita, the Combine has always been aggressively expansionist—the head of the Combine was the first of the Council Lords to declare himself the new ruler of the collapsing Star League. Regularly in conflicts along its borders with all its neighbors, the Combine is a highly structured, militaristic society, with rulership in the hands of the Coordinator, the commander-in-chief of the Draconis military. The Combine's culture is heavily influenced by the Japanese roots of the ruling family—despite the minority status of those with Japanese ancestry—as this cultural heritage is imposed from above by the predominantly Japanese ruling class. The current leader of the Combine is Coordinator Takashi Kurita.
column2: 龙脉联合体是星际联盟五个继承国之一，位于地球朝核心与朝旋臂方向的一侧。它由 Kurita 家族统治，历来极具扩张性——联合体的首领是议会领主中第一个自立为崩溃中的星际联盟新统治者的人。联合体与其所有邻国的边境上冲突不断，是一个高度结构化、军事化的社会，统治权掌握在协调官手中，他同时也是龙脉军队的总司令。联合体的文化深受统治家族日本血统的影响——尽管具日本血统者实为少数——因为这一文化传统是由以日本人为主的统治阶层自上而下强加的。联合体现任领袖是协调官 Takashi Kurita。ZH

column1: While your retreat would be grounds for censure in one of our soldiers, we understand that a mercenary life is more… complicated. We hope it will not become a habit, however.
column2: 虽然你的撤退若发生在我们自己的士兵身上会招致谴责，但我们理解雇佣兵的生活更为……复杂。不过我们希望这不会成为习惯。ZH

column1: The Draconis Combine is pleased with your fervor, Commander. Your skills in battle are precisely the sort that young cadets could learn from.
column2: 天龙联合体对你的热忱表示赞赏，指挥官. 你的作战技艺正是年轻的军校生可以学习的典范.

column1: the Draconis Combine
column2: 天龙联合体

column1: The Draconis Combine is one of the five Successor States of the Star League, located coreward and spinward of Terra. Ruled by House Kurita, the Combine has always been aggressively expansionist—the head of the Combine was the first of the Council Lords to declare himself the new ruler of the collapsing Star League. Regularly in conflicts along its borders with all its neighbors, the Combine is a highly structured, militaristic society, with rulership in the hands of the Coordinator, the commander-in-chief of the Draconis military. The Combine's culture is heavily influenced by the Japanese roots of the ruling family—despite the minority status of those with Japanese ancestry—as this cultural heritage is imposed from above by the predominantly Japanese ruling class. The current leader of the Combine is Coordinator Takashi Kurita.  By 3152, the Combine would have numerous Heavy Aerospace and Major Defense industries under it's control.
column2: 龙尼斯联合体是星盟五大继承国之一，位于地球的核心方向与旋臂方向。由栗田家族统治的联合体一直极具扩张主义色彩——联合体首脑是议会领主中第一个自封为崩塌中的星盟新统治者的人。联合体与其所有邻国的边界上经常发生冲突，是一个高度结构化、军事化的社会，统治权掌握在协调官手中——他是龙尼斯军队的总司令。联合体的文化深受统治家族日本根源的影响——尽管有日本血统者只占少数——因为这一文化遗产是由以日本人为主的统治阶级自上而下强加的。联合体现任领袖是协调官栗田隆。到3152年，联合体将拥有众多重型航空与主要国防工业归其掌控。ZH

column1: If you cannot accomplish the missions we lay before you, Commander, we will find another mercenary who can! Consider this a warning to perform better—or be replaced.
column2: 指挥官，如果你无法完成我们交给你的任务，我们会另找一位能完成的雇佣兵！把这当作一次警告：要么干得更好，要么被替换。ZH

column1: The Capellan Confederation is one of the five Successor States of the Star League, located rimward of Terra. Ruled by House Liao, the Confederation is the smallest and newest of the Successor States and often the loser in conflicts against the other powers of the Inner Sphere. It is an authoritarian police state, with philosophical origins in a text known as the Korvin Doctrine, which argues for total subservience of the individual to the state. column2: 卡佩拉联邦是星际联盟五大继承国之一，位于地球的(银河)缘向(即南方). 廖氏家族统治的卡佩拉联邦是继承国中最小和最年轻的国家，在与内天体其它强国的冲突中常常处于不利地位. 这是个专制的警察国家，其哲学基础源于名为《科尔文主义》的理论，该理论主张个体应完全服从国家. 联邦公民必须通过为社区服务来赢得地位和公民权的福利. 联邦现任统治者总理大臣马克西米利安·廖是一位精明的策划者和操纵大师.

column1: Loss on the battlefield is not always failure. Losses teach us to improve and better ourselves. You fought well, Commander, even if you did not prevail. Learn from this lesson and do better next time.

column1: House Liao has always believed in one thing, Commander: victory at any cost. It seems you also understand this vital lesson. We are pleased you've performed so well.
column2: 指挥官，廖家始终信奉一件事：不惜一切代价取胜。看来你也深谙这一要义。我们对你的出色表现很满意。ZH

After decades of conflict and unrest with the Marian Hegemony, the Lothian League officially gained its independence in 3128 and resembled little of the free state that existed a century before.  The League is currently ruled by Grand Mistress Clarissa Logan.
column2: 洛锡安联盟是一个小型外围国度，由六颗冰雪星球组成，位于自由世界联盟外缘之外，靠近马里安霸权。在与马里安霸权经历了数十年的冲突与动荡后，洛锡安联盟于3128年正式获得独立，但此时它已与一个世纪前那个自由国家的样貌相去甚远。该联盟目前由大女宗主克拉丽莎·洛根统治。ZH

column1: Lady Centrella represents The Magistracy of Canopus, a large Periphery state, located rimwards and anti-spinwards of Terra, just beyond the Free Worlds League. Founded explicitly as a matriarchy, the Magistracy is ruled by a Magestrix, a position open only to women, and usually held by a member of the founding Centrella family. Independent since the fall of the Star League, the Magistracy has remained mostly untouched by the Succession Wars, except by the overall collapse of trade and travel. The Magistracy is famed for its social and cultural freedom, with no consensual behavior forbidden by law or custom. The current ruler of the Magistracy is the Magestrix Kyalla Centrella, who harbors a deep grudge against the Inner Sphere, and the Free Worlds League in particular.
column2: 琴特雷拉女士代表了船底自治区，这是个较大的外围国家，位于地球的银河缘向(南方)和反旋向(西方)，就在自由世界联盟下方. 船底自治区明确作为母系社会创立，由女导师统治，这一职位仅向女性开放，通常由创始家族琴特雷拉家族成员把持. 自治区在星际联盟消亡后独立，除了贸易和航行的全面崩溃外，自治区大体上并未受到继承战争的波及. 自治区以其社会与文化上的自由，自愿行为不受法律或习俗禁止而闻名，自治区现任统治者女导师基娅拉·琴特雷拉，对内天体，特别是自由世界联盟报以极深的敌意.

column2: 马里安霸权是地球核心方向、反旋臂方向的一个主要外缘国家，位于塔马林德-阿比公国与边缘共同体的更远处。这个君主共和制国家与古罗马帝国相似，其国徽是一名装甲罗马战士的胸像，衬以浅褐色旗帜，旗帜中央用英文写着"马里安霸权"，两端则是拉丁文"Pax"（和平）与"Mortis"（死亡）。ZH

column1: The Free Worlds League is one of the five Successor States of the Star League, located rimward and anti-spinward of Terra. column2: 自由世界联盟是星际联盟五大继承国之一，位于地球的(银河)缘向(即南方)和反旋向(即西方). 马里克家族统治的联盟和卡佩拉联邦一样，都是最早签署建立星际联盟条约的成员国之一. 在星际联盟崩溃后，自由世界联盟将经济和政府的广泛控制权交给了军队的最高指挥官——总司令. 联盟以强大的商业实力著称，但继承战争几乎摧毁了它的经济. 联盟现任统治者是总司令亚诺斯·马里克.

column1: The Free Worlds League is one of the five Successor States of the Star League, located rimward and anti-spinward of Terra. Ruled by House Marik, the League was, with the Capellan Confederation, one of the original signatories of the treaties that would eventually form the Star League. After the fall of the Star League, the Free Worlds League granted broad control over its economy and government to the commander of its military, the Captain-General. The League is known for being a powerful mercantile state, but the Succession Wars have nearly destroyed its economy. In 3148, the reborn League faced invasions from the Marian Hegemony, Regulan Fiefs, and Duchy of Andurien, managing to defeat them all and invade the Regulan Fiefs. The state surrendered to the Free Worlds League following an invasion that was sparked by the assassination of Jessica Marik. The Regulan Fiefs were granted provisional status within the League for a period of ten years, after which they would be allowed to request full membership.  The current ruler of the League is Captain-General Nikol Marik.
column2: 自由世界联盟是星际联盟的五大继承国之一，位于地球的缘向与逆自旋方向。由马里克家族统治的联盟，曾与卡佩拉联邦一道，是最终促成星际联盟成立条约的最初签署方。星际联盟崩溃后，自由世界联盟将其经济与政府的广泛控制权授予了其军队统帅，即总司令。联盟素以强大的商业国家著称，但继承战争几乎摧毁了其经济。3148年，重生的联盟面临来自马里安霸权、雷古兰领地和安杜瑞恩公国的入侵，并成功将其全部击败，随后入侵了雷古兰领地。在杰西卡·马里克遇刺所引发的入侵之后，该国向自由世界联盟投降。雷古兰领地获准在联盟内享有为期十年的临时地位，期满后可申请成为正式成员。联盟当前的统治者是总司令妮可·马里克。ZH

column1: The New Oberon Confederation emerged in 3086 following the withdrawal of Clan Hell's Horses from the Periphery. Centered on Oberon VI, the Confederation reestablished its independence under local administrators who took control after the Clan's departure. With assistance from Clan Ghost Bear technicians, they refurbished Grimfort — a fortress originally built by Hendrik Grimm — transforming it into a modern Castle Brian to bolster their defenses.

Oriente is theoretically a representative government, but it operates under military rule, much like the Free Worlds League after the fall of the Star League.

column1: The Ragnarök Union is a microstate in the Barrens region, established in July 3084. It comprises three worlds—Götterdämmerung, Botany Bay, and Last Chance—which were formerly part of the Greater Valkyrate. Under the leadership of Hu Xiao Lin, who maintained her position since before the Clan Invasion, the Union achieved self-sufficiency by leveraging historical ties with Lackhove and Erewhon to access advanced technology. By 3095, the Union operated a cluster of tanks acquired from Clan Jade Falcon; however, efforts to secure training at the Falcon's military academy on Somerset had not yet succeeded.
column2: 诸神黄昏联盟是荒原地区的一个微型国家，建立于3084年7月。它由三颗行星组成——诸神黄昏、植物学湾和最后机会——它们原本是大瓦尔基里特的一部分。在胡晓琳的领导下（她在氏族入侵之前就一直保持这一地位），该联盟通过利用与拉克霍夫和埃瑞璜的历史纽带获取先进技术，实现了自给自足。到3095年，联盟拥有一批从翡翠猎鹰氏族获得的坦克；不过，在萨默塞特的猎鹰军事学院争取训练的努力尚未成功。ZH
