column2: 自由蛇夫座共和国是在第四次继承战争之后诞生的国家，享有独立不到二十年，便发现自己正处在氏族入侵的必经之路上.

column1: Free Rasalhague Republic
column2: 自由蛇夫座共和国

column1: The Rasalhague Dominion is a unique hybrid political entity that emerged in the late 31st century from the unification of Clan Ghost Bear and the Free Rasalhague Republic. Combining the rigid structure and traditions of the Clans with the democratic ideals of the Republic, the Dominion has created a balanced and innovative society. Centered around Skandia and Alshain, it maintains strong military capabilities under the tenets of Clan Ghost Bear's warrior caste, while fostering economic growth and civilian governance through the influence of its Rasalhagian citizens. The Dominion is defined by its emphasis on cooperation and unity, ensuring its people thrive within a structure that respects both cultural heritage and martial strength.
column2: 拉萨尔哈格自治领是一个独特的混合政治实体，于三十一世纪末由幽灵熊氏族与自由拉萨尔哈格共和国的统一而形成。自治领把氏族严整的结构与传统同共和国的民主理想结合起来，创造出一个平衡而创新的社会。它以斯坎迪亚和阿尔沙因为中心，在幽灵熊氏族战士种姓的信条下维持强大的军事能力，同时通过其拉萨尔哈格公民的影响促进经济增长与文官治理。自治领的特征在于强调合作与团结，确保其人民在一个既尊重文化遗产又尊重军事实力的结构中繁荣。ZH

column1: Rasalhague Dominion
column2: 蛇夫座自治领

column1: Raven Alliance
column2: 渡鸦同盟

column1: After Clan Snow Raven lost their holdings and was abjured from Clan Space during the Wars of Reaving, they would seek refuge with their allies in the Outworlds Alliance. Seeing the similarities and benefits between both factions, they would bore a fruitful relationship that would result in the merging of the Raven Alliance after the Jihad ended.
column2: 雪鸦部族在“掠夺战争”中失去领地并被逐出部族空间后，前往外域联盟寻求盟友庇护。看到双方之间的相似与互利之处，他们建立起富有成果的关系，最终在圣战结束后合并为鸦联盟。ZH

column1: After Clan Snow Raven lost their holdings and was abjured from Clan Space during the Wars of Reaving, they would seek refuge with their allies in the Outworlds Alliance. Seeing the similarities and benefits between both factions, they would bore a fruitful relationship that would result in the merging of the Raven Alliance after the Jihad ended. The Alliance's Khans, as members of the Council of Six, were invited to Terra in the aftermath of the ilClan Trial. The Ravens affirmed Alaric Ward as ilKhan, subordinating the Alliance to the new Star League.
column2: 在收割战争期间失去领地并被逐出氏族空间后，雪鸦氏族向他们在外域联盟的盟友寻求庇护。看到两个派系之间的相似性与共同利益，他们建立起富有成果的关系，最终在圣战结束后合并为渡鸦联盟。联盟的可汗们作为六人议会的成员，在伊尔氏族试炼之后受邀前往地球。渡鸦们确认阿拉里克·沃德为伊尔汗，使联盟从属于新星盟。ZH

column1: The Principality of Regulus is one of the founding nations of the Free Worlds League. Following the dissolution of that confederation, the Regulan Fiefs was founded as the union of the Principality of Regulus, Regulan Free States, and the Principality of Gibson. It is led by the Cameron-Jones family from the city of Tunis on Regulus.
column2: 雷古鲁斯公国是自由世界联盟的创始国之一。该邦联解体后，雷古鲁斯封地作为雷古鲁斯公国、雷古鲁斯自由邦与吉布森公国的联合体而成立，由卡梅隆-琼斯家族从雷古鲁斯上的突尼斯城统治。ZH

column1: The Regulan Fiefs understands that sacrifice on the battlefield doesn't always translate to victory. You've made a fine effort, even if it failed. Just another lesson for the next battle.
column2: 雷古兰封地明白，战场上的牺牲并不总能换来胜利。你已经付出了出色的努力，即便它失败了。这不过是下一场战斗的又一条教训。ZH

column1: Top-tier work, Commander—House Cameron-Jones is very happy with your performance. Keep it up, and I'll make sure a lot more work comes your way.
column2: 一流的活儿，指挥官——卡梅伦-琼斯家族对你的表现非常满意。继续保持，我保证会有更多工作找上你。ZH

column1: The Republic of the Sphere is the buffer state created in the wake of the Word of Blake Jihad. Keeping the peace in the heart of the Inner Sphere is no small task.
column2: 天球共和国是布雷克之言圣战之后创造的缓冲国。在内天体腹地维持和平绝非易事。ZH

column1: Republic of the Sphere
column2: 球体共和国

column1: The Republic of the Barrens is a nascent proto-state formed in the aftermath of the Clan invasions, situated in the desolate and chaotic region known as the Barrens. Founded on principles of survival and resilience, it emerged as a loose confederation of worlds united by necessity rather than shared ideology. Its population, composed of scattered settlements and independent factions, relies heavily on resourcefulness and adaptability to thrive in the harsh and lawless environment. The Republic maintains a tenuous existence, balancing its efforts to establish governance with the constant threats of piracy, clan raiding parties, and internal dissent. While small and often overlooked by larger powers, the Republic symbolizes human perseverance in one of the Inner Sphere's most unforgiving territories.
column2: 荒原共和国是氏族入侵后形成的一个初生原始国家，坐落于被称为荒原的荒凉混乱地带。它以生存与坚韧为立国原则，是各行星出于必要而非共同意识形态结成的松散邦联。其人口由零散定居点与独立派系组成，高度依赖机智与适应力在这片严酷且无法无天的环境中求生。共和国维持着岌岌可危的存续，在建立治理的努力与海盗、氏族劫掠队和内部异议的持续威胁之间苦苦平衡。尽管弱小且常被更大的势力忽视，共和国象征着人类在内天体最不宽容的疆域之一的顽强。ZH

column1: Republic of the Barrens
column2: 荒原共和国

column1: The Rim Collection is a minor nationstate founded by six planets that remembered the old Rim Worlds Republic, pre-Amaris, and wanted to recreate that dream. They are small, democratic, and pretty much harmless. Their military is composed of the mercenary group Able's Aces who have become national heroes for the Collection.
column2: 边缘集团是一个由六颗行星建立的小国，这些行星记得阿马里斯之前那个旧的边缘世界共和国，想要重现那个梦想。他们规模小、实行民主，基本无害。其军队由雇佣兵团体"艾布尔王牌"组成，后者已成为边缘集团的民族英雄。ZH

column1: Rim Commonality
column2: 边缘共同圈

column1: During the Jihad, the Rim Commonality declared independence from the League on the 13th of April 3075 The Rim Commonality cited the historic Camlann versus Free Worlds ruling as precedent, barring entry to all high-ranking Free Worlds League representatives and breaking away from the League.
column2: 在圣战期间，边缘共同体于3075年4月13日宣布脱离联盟独立。边缘共同体援引卡姆兰诉自由世界案的裁决为先例，禁止所有自由世界联盟高级代表入境，并脱离联盟。ZH

column1: The Rim Commonality understands that sacrifice on the battlefield doesn't always translate to victory. You've made a fine effort, even if it failed. Just another lesson for the next battle.
column2: 边缘共同体明白，战场上的牺牲并不总能换来胜利。你已经付出了出色的努力，即便它失败了。这不过是下一场战斗的又一条教训。ZH

column1: Top-tier work, Commander—The Commonality is very happy with your performance. Keep it up, and I'll make sure a lot more work comes your way.
column2: 一流的活儿，指挥官——共同体对你的表现非常满意。继续保持，我保证会有更多工作找上你。ZH

column1: The Rim Territories is a proto-state officially presented as a mutual defense and trade pact. In truth, it operates as a loose collective of pirate groups, with each world functioning as a criminal fiefdom under the control of its dominant gang or raiding clan. Governed from the capital world of Pain, the Rim Territories thrives on illicit trade, plunder, and under-the-table alliances, while maintaining a thin veneer of legitimacy to negotiate with other factions. This pragmatic and ruthless structure allows the Rim Territories to survive and even profit amidst the chaos of the Inner Sphere.
column2: 边缘领是一个对外宣称为共同防御与贸易协定的原型国家。实际上，它是一个由海盗团体组成的松散集合体，每个星球都在其主宰帮派或劫掠氏族的控制下，如同一个个犯罪领地。边缘领以苦痛星为首都进行统治，其经济建立在非法贸易、劫掠和地下联盟之上，同时为了与其他势力交涉，它又维持着一层薄弱的合法性外衣。这种务实而冷酷的统治结构，使得边缘领得以在内天体的混乱中生存，甚至从中牟利。ZH

column1: Rim Territories
column2: 边缘领

column1: The Rim Worlds Republic, 2250-2769, was born of Hector Worthington Rowe and his five-hundred-strong Theban Legion at the end of their own Second Exodus. Journeying for six years through the Dark Nebula, the men who would create the Republic were anti-Alliance veterans on the run aboard blackmailed JumpShips, plunder from slain garrisons, and a limited number of provisions and women they'd taken as slaves. Simply put - pirates.
column2: 边缘世界共和国（2250-2769）诞生于赫克托·沃辛顿·罗及其五百人底比斯军团在他们自己的第二次出走结束时。在暗星云中跋涉六年，这些将创建共和国的人是一群在逃的反联盟老兵，靠着被胁迫的跃迁舰、从被屠驻军缴获的战利品，以及数量有限的给养和他们掳为奴隶的女人。简单说——海盗。ZH

column1: Rim Worlds Republic
column2: 边缘世界共和国

column1: Scorpion Empire
column2: 天蝎帝国

column1: The Scorpion Empire emerged from the remnants of Clan Goliath Scorpion and absorbed the assets of the shattered Clan Ice Hellion, establishing a new realm built on their shared histories and philosophies. Guided by the Scorpion Imperio, a unique governing body blending Clan traditions with the cultural influences of the Nueva Castile region, the Scorpion Empire seeks a balance between strength and cultural enrichment. Known for their esoteric outlook, the Empire reveres the mythical vision quests central to their Scorpion heritage while extending dominion across systems in the deep periphery.
column2: 天蝎帝国由残存的巨蝎氏族脱胎而来，并吸收了分崩离析的冰狱氏族遗产，在它们共同的历史与哲学基础上建立了一个新的国度。在天蝎皇廷——一个融合了氏族传统与新卡斯蒂利亚地区文化影响的独特治理机构——的指引下，天蝎帝国致力于在武力与文化积淀之间寻求平衡。该帝国以其深奥的世界观而闻名，尊崇其天蝎传承中核心的神圣幻视之旅，同时将统治权扩展至深空外围中的各个星系。ZH

column1: The Enigmatic Shadow Divisions constituted some of the most fanatical military units in the Protectorate forces. By the end of the Jihad some of these units were still unaccounted for, are you sure you should be looking into this?
column2: 神秘的暗影师是保护国部队中最狂热的军事单位之一。圣战结束时，其中一些单位仍下落不明。你确定要查这件事吗？ZH

column1: Star League
column2: 星际联盟

column1: The Star League Defense Force (SLDF) was the principal military force defending the Star League, a conglomeration of star systems within roughly 500 light years of Terra. At its height the SLDF was the largest military force known to man, composed of over 100 million soldiers organized into 486 divisions. The Star League Defense Force left the Inner Sphere after fighting the Amaris Civil War, when Stefan Amaris overthrew the ruling First Lord of the Star League, Richard Cameron. After a long series of bloody battles throughout the Star League, Commanding General Aleksandr Kerensky ended the coup with the liberation of Terra and the execution of Amaris. However when no new First Lord could be agreed upon by the Great Houses the Star League was dissolved. Kerensky then led the surviving 113 divisions out beyond the Inner Sphere in Operation EXODUS, hoping to save the essence of the League from the internecine violence that was to come. The SLDF would return 300 years later as the Clans, a technologically superior military that invaded the Inner Sphere in 3049.
column2: 星际联盟防卫军（SLDF）是保卫星际联盟的主要军事力量，星际联盟是由泰拉周围约500光年内的星系组成的联合体. 在其鼎盛时期，SLDF是人类已知最庞大的军事力量，由超过1亿名士兵组成，编为486个师. 星际联盟防卫军在阿玛里斯内战之后离开了内天体——当时斯蒂芬·阿玛里斯推翻了星际联盟在任的第一领主理查德·卡梅伦. 在星际联盟全境经历了一系列漫长的血腥战斗后，总司令亚历山大·克伦斯基解放了泰拉并处决了阿玛里斯，从而终结了政变. 然而，由于各大国未能就新任第一领主达成一致，星际联盟随之解体. 克伦斯基随后带领剩余的113个师通过“大迁徙行动”离开内天体，希望将星际联盟的精髓从即将到来的内部冲突中拯救出来. 300年后，SLDF以氏族的身份归来——一支技术优势明显的军事力量，于3049年入侵了内天体.

column1: Star League Defense Force
column2: 星际联盟防卫军

column1: Alternately known as the Exodus Planetary Council, the so-called Star League-in Exile was a provisional government that oversaw the Pentagon and Kerensky Cluster worlds settled by the Exodus Fleet. The collapse of the Star League-in-Exile following the death of General Aleksandr Kerensky and the resulting Pentagon Civil War would trigger the formation of the Clans.    On 24 August 2786, the Exodus Fleet arrived in the Pentagon Worlds. Five systems were found in close proximity to one another: Arcadia, Babylon, Circe, Dagda, and Eden. Landing began on each of the worlds by 17 September that year, and colonies began to take shape. Each world was either marginally habitable or had some dangerous pathogen native to it.    Of six million people, two million were SLDF personnel, a military far beyond what they would need or support. General Kerensky and General Aaron DeChavilier demobilized noncombat specialties and, for any combatants who wished to remain in uniform, held testing at every rank, reducing the SLDF to a half-million strong.    Exploration of the nearby Kerensky Cluster began, and more habitable worlds were found. Strana Mechty and six other worlds were colonized in the Cluster, though the bulk of the population remained in the Pentagon Worlds. The infrastructure and manufacturing to support the new nation were established.  New Moscva on Eden was established as the new capital.
column2: 它也被称为出走行星议会，这个所谓的星盟流亡政权是一个临时政府，管辖着由出走舰队殖民的五角星系与克伦斯基星团诸世界。在亚历山大·克伦斯基将军去世后，星盟流亡政权的崩溃以及随之而来的五角内战，将触发氏族的形成。2786年8月24日，出走舰队抵达五角星系。人们发现五个彼此邻近的星系：阿卡迪亚、巴比伦、喀耳刻、达格达和伊甸。当年9月17日起，各世界陆续开始着陆，殖民地开始成形。每颗行星要么勉强可居，要么有某种原生危险病原体。在六百万人中，有两百万是SLDF人员——这支军队远超他们所需或所能供养。克伦斯基将军与亚伦·德沙维利耶将军复员了非战斗专业，而对任何希望继续穿军装的战斗人员，则在每个军衔层级进行测试，把SLDF削减到五十万人。对附近克伦斯基星团的探索开始了，并发现了更多宜居世界。星团中殖民了斯特拉纳·麦赫蒂及其他六个世界，不过大部分人口仍留在五角星系。支撑这个新国家的基础设施与制造业建立起来。伊甸上的新莫斯科瓦被定为新首都。ZH

column1: SLDF in Exile
column2: 流亡星盟防卫军

column1: The Society is a secret cabal of Clan Scientists spread across most of the homeworld clans; they are not pleased with the Warrior caste being in control.
column2: 协会是一个由氏族科学家组成的秘密结社，遍布大部分本土星系氏族；他们对战士种姓掌权感到不满。ZH

column1: House Steiner has no place for cowards or failures, Commander. Ensure your future efforts are more robust, or the Lyran Commonwealth will be no friend to you.
column2: 指挥官，施泰纳家族没有胆小鬼或失败者的位置. 确保你未来的成绩更加强劲，不然天琴共同体不会同你交好.

column1: The Lyran Commonwealth is one of the five Successor States of the Star League, located coreward and anti-spinward of Terra. Ruled by House Steiner, the Commonwealth is the wealthiest of the five, with an entrenched and powerful noble class. The focus on pedigree and prestige among the nobility has often resulted in less-than-brilliant officers being elevated to high command, to the detriment of the Commonwealth's military strength. Much of the Commonwealth's success comes from the vast resources located within its borders. The current ruler of the Commonwealth is Archon Katrina Steiner, notable for her peace proposal that, in allying the Commonwealth with the Federated Suns, effectively ended the Third Succession War.
column2: 莱兰联邦是星盟五大继承国之一，位于地球的核心方向与反旋臂方向。由斯坦纳家族统治的莱兰联邦是五国中最富有的，拥有根深蒂固而强大的贵族阶层。贵族间对血统与声望的重视，常导致才具平庸的军官被提拔至高位，损害了联邦的军事实力。联邦的诸多成就大多来自其疆域内的庞大资源。联邦现任统治者是大公卡特里娜·斯坦纳，她以那份和平提案闻名——该提案使联邦与联邦太阳结盟，实际上终结了第三次继承战争。ZH

column1: The Lyran Commonwealth didn't get where it is by accepting victory or defeat as inevitable, but by continuing to fight after a loss. I hope you'll do the same, Commander. While you were defeated, you acquitted yourself well.
column2: 莱兰联邦不是靠把胜利或失败视为必然才有今天的地位，而是靠在失败之后继续战斗。我希望你也能如此，指挥官。你虽然战败，但表现可圈可点。ZH

column1: Large coffers pay for larger victories—and you have been instrumental in ensuring that our winning streak is intact. Excellent work, mercenary. House Steiner is pleased.
column2: 更大的金库换来更大的胜利——而你在确保我们连胜不败上起到了关键作用。干得漂亮，雇佣兵。施泰纳家族很满意。ZH

column1: The Duchy of Tamarind was originally a province of the Free Worlds League. It seceded from the League during the Word of Blake Jihad, and would later combine with the Abbey District to form the Duchy of Tamarind-Abbey, an independent state.
column2: 塔马林德公国原本是自由世界联盟的一个省。它在布雷克之言圣战期间脱离联盟，后来与阿比区合并，成为独立国家塔马林德-阿比公国。ZH

column1: The Duchy of Tamarind-Abbey understands that sacrifice on the battlefield doesn't always translate to victory. You've made a fine effort, even if it failed. Just another lesson for the next battle.

column1: In 3151, Hauptmann-General Sarah Regis led the resurrection of the Tamar Pact, following the collapse of the Republic of the Sphere and the Lyran Commonwealth. Acting independently, she freed her homeworld, Arcturus, from Falcon rule and began a campaign to reclaim abandoned systems like Kelenfold, Borghese, and Blue Diamond. On August 13, 3151, she declared the rebirth of the Tamar Pact, renounced her LCAF rank, and appointed herself Governor-General. Despite internal dissent, Regis reorganized her forces into the Armed Forces of Tamar, bolstering them with loyalists, mercenaries, and advanced supplies from Clan Sea Fox and the Alyina Mercantile League. Early successes, including the capture of Kerensky's Vision, established the Pact's position, and with her family's wealth, strategic alliances, and a growing military, Regis transformed the Tamar Pact into a powerful and independent nation determined to restore its former territories and industrial might.
column2: 3151年，大统领将军莎拉·雷吉斯在天球共和国与莱兰联邦崩溃之后，领导了塔马条约的重生。她独立行动，从猎鹰的统治下解放了她的母星阿克图鲁斯，并开始一场收复凯伦福尔德、博尔盖塞和蓝钻等被废弃星系的战役。3151年8月13日，她宣布塔马条约重生，放弃LCAF的军衔，自任总督将军。尽管内部有异议，雷吉斯仍把她的部队重组为塔马武装力量，用效忠者、雇佣兵以及来自海狐氏族和阿莉娜商业联盟的先进补给加以充实。早期的成功——包括夺取克伦斯基之见——确立了条约的地位，凭借家族财富、战略同盟与不断壮大的军力，雷吉斯把塔马条约转变为一个强大而独立的国家，决心恢复其昔日的领土与工业实力。ZH

column1: The Taurian Concordat is one of the largest Periphery states, located rimward of Terra, beyond the Federated Suns. Founded and ruled by House Calderon, the Concordat prides itself on its independence, freedom, and stability. The Concordat is wealthy, well educated, and well armed for a Periphery state. The Taurians defend their independence fiercely against Inner Sphere aggression, particularly by the Federated Suns; they perceive House Davion's reputation as a protector of liberties as unwarranted and even hypocritical, and they have a long history of conflict with the much larger Successor State. The current ruler of the Concordat is Protector Thomas Calderon.
column2: 陶里安协约国是最大的外围地区国家之一，位于地球朝外围方向的一侧、联邦太阳国之外。协约国由卡尔德隆家族创建并统治，以其独立、自由与稳定为傲。就外围地区国家而言，协约国富庶、教育水平高且军备精良。陶里安人顽强捍卫自身独立，抵御内层星域的侵略，尤其是联邦太阳国的侵犯；他们认为戴维恩家族“自由守护者”的名声毫无根据，甚至虚伪，并且与这个强大得多的继承国有着悠久的冲突历史。协约国现任统治者是护国公托马斯·卡尔德隆。ZH

The Taurians defend their independence fiercely against Inner Sphere aggression, particularly by the Federated Suns; they perceive House Davion's reputation as a protector of liberties as unwarranted and even hypocritical, and they have a long history of conflict with the much larger Successor State. 3147 would see the proposed marriage of Kaff Doru's son and Sam Calderon's daughter in 3157, which would reunify them as one nation again.  Until then, the two nations would expand their trade relations and engage in mutual defense operations.  The current ruler of the Concordat is Protector Kaff Doru.
column2: 金牛座协约是最大的外围国家之一，位于地球边缘方向、联邦太阳国之外。它由卡尔德隆家族创建并统治，以独立、自由与稳定为傲。作为外围国家，协约富裕、教育良好、武装精良。金牛座人激烈捍卫自身独立以对抗内层星域的侵略，尤其是联邦太阳国；他们认为戴维恩家族“自由捍卫者”的名声毫无根据甚至虚伪，并且与这个庞大得多的继承国有长期冲突史。3147年，卡夫·多鲁之子与萨姆·卡尔德隆之女的婚约被提出，将在3157年使两国重新统一为一国。在那之前，两国将扩大贸易关系并开展共同防御行动。协约现任统治者是保护者卡夫·多鲁。ZH

column1: The Terran Hegemony was an interstellar state located at the center of the Inner Sphere. Established after a military coup led by James McKenna overthrew the dictatorial and decaying Terran Alliance, the Hegemony quickly rose to dominating positions in the realms of technology, military innovation, and diplomacy, and remained the most influential of all interstellar powers for the rest of its existence. The Hegemony's early expansionist period contributed to the formation of the Great Houses, its era of aggressive diplomacy eventually led to the creation of the Star League, and its destruction in the Amaris Civil War led to the Succession Wars.
column2: 地球霸权是位于内层星域中心的星际国家。它由詹姆斯·麦肯纳领导的军事政变推翻独裁且衰朽的地球联盟后建立，随后迅速在技术、军事创新与外交领域攀升至主导地位，并在其存续的余下时间里始终是所有星际势力中最具影响力者。霸权早期的扩张时期促成了各大家族的形成，其激进外交时代最终催生了星际联盟，而它在阿马里斯内战中的毁灭则导致了继承战争。ZH

column2: 泰拉霸权

column1: The Tikonov Free Republic was a short-lived state formed during the Fourth Succession War. Following his defection to the Federated Suns in early 3029, Capellan Confederation Colonel Pavel Ridzik established his own fiefdom from Tikonov Commonality worlds as yet unconquered by the Suns. After his death the statelet voted to merge with the Lyran Commonwealth's Sarna March in 3031
column2: 提科诺夫自由共和国是第四次继承战争期间成立的一个短命国家。卡佩兰联邦上校帕维尔·里兹克在3029年初叛逃到联邦太阳之后，以尚未被联邦太阳征服的提科诺夫共同体各行星建立了自己的领地。他死后，这个小国于3031年投票决定与莱兰联邦的萨尔纳边区合并

column1: The Timbuktu Collective is a protective alliance formed in June 3148 through the merger of the Rim Collection and five worlds from the Lyran Commonwealth's Timbuktu Theater. This union was driven by secessionist sentiments and a desire for greater autonomy amid perceived neglect by the Commonwealth. The Collective's capital is Timbuktu II, and as of 3151, it controlled 17 systems. Its military, the Collective Armed Guards (CAG), was initially formed from defected units and has since expanded through local enlistment and the hiring of mercenaries. The Collective has steadily expanded its borders, incorporating additional worlds such as Pocologan, Viborg, and Sapienza. Despite economic challenges due to reduced interstellar trade, the Timbuktu Collective remains determined to restore its former territories and industrial might.
column2: 廷巴克图集体是一个防御性联盟，于3148年6月由边缘集团与来自莱兰联邦廷巴克图战区的五颗行星合并而成。这一联合源于分离主义情绪，以及在感受到联邦的忽视之下对更大自治的渴望。集体的首都是廷巴克图II，截至3151年它控制着17个星系。其军队"集体武装卫队"（CAG）最初由叛变部队组成，此后通过本地征募与雇佣雇佣兵而扩充。集体稳步扩张边界，吸纳了波科洛根、维堡和萨皮恩扎等更多世界。尽管因星际贸易减少而面临经济挑战，廷巴克图集体仍决心恢复其昔日领土与工业实力。ZH

column1: The Umayyad Caliphate is a small state residing within the Deep Periphery. The Umayyads are in a region of space roughly seventy-five light years in diameter, situated 150 light years coreward from the Hanseatic League and 200 light years anti-spinward from the Clan Jade Falcon colony of St. Jean. Originally separate entities, more than 200 years of continuous warfare and shared history has inextricably bound the Umayyads to Nueva Castile, even resulting in the intermingling of some bloodlines.
column2: 乌玛雅王朝是位于深空外围的一个小国。乌玛雅人占据的星域直径约75光年，距离汉萨同盟向内核方向约150光年，并位于玉鹰氏族殖民地St.Jean反旋向约200光年之外。乌玛雅人最初是一个独立的实体，但超过200年的持续战争和共同历史，将他们与新卡斯蒂利亚密不可分地联系在一起，甚至导致了一些血脉的融合.

It was notable for emphasizing the dominance of women over men.
column2: 3028年，奥伯龙邦联中两个分离派系——比特霍尔德与莫格雷恩的女武神领——合并，创建了“大女武神领”。这个海盗王国作为其强势对手，牵制着奥伯龙邦联。它因强调女性对男性的主导而引人注目。ZH

column1: The Vesper Marches is a nation established in March 3151 within the former Clan Jade Falcon Occupation Zone. Founded by Duke Vedet Brewer, the Marches emerged following Brewer's departure from the Lyran Commonwealth and his subsequent takeover of Melissia, which became the capital of his new realm. Initially, its military strength centered around the First Hesperus Guards, with later expansions incorporating noble personal armies. Politically, the Vesper Marches function as Brewer's personal domain, maintained through alliances with Melissia's noble families. Economically, the nation benefits from corporate support on Medellin and trade relations with the Free Guilds of the Malthus Confederation.
column2: 维斯珀边区是一个于3151年3月在原翡翠猎鹰氏族占领区内建立的国家。它由维德特·布鲁尔公爵建立，出现于布鲁尔离开莱兰联邦、随后接管梅利西亚之后，后者成为他新领域的首都。起初其军力以第一赫斯佩鲁斯卫队为中心，后来扩张时吸纳了贵族私人军队。政治上，维斯珀边区充当布鲁尔的私人领地，通过与梅利西亚贵族家族的联盟维系。经济上，该国受益于梅德林的企业支持以及与马尔萨斯邦联自由行会的贸易关系。ZH

column1: The Wolf Empire, established on January 1, 3142, emerged from Clan Wolf's strategic expansion into the Inner Sphere during the tumultuous Blackout period. Under the leadership of Khan Alaric Ward, Clan Wolf seized over sixty worlds from the Free Worlds League and the Lyran Commonwealth, culminating in the proclamation of the Wolf Empire. With its capital on Gienah, the Empire continued its aggressive campaigns, ultimately breaching the Republic of the Sphere's defenses to capture Terra in 3151, thereby becoming the ilClan of the reborn Star League.
column2: 狼帝国建立于3142年1月1日，诞生于动荡的大停电时期狼族向内天体的战略扩张。在可汗阿拉里克·沃德的领导下，狼族从自由世界联盟和莱兰联邦手中夺取了六十多个星系，最终宣告狼帝国的成立。帝国以吉拿为首都，继续其侵略性战役，最终突破天球共和国的防线，于3151年夺取地球，从而成为重生星盟的伊尔氏族。ZH

column1: On your way to the Leopard's galley, you run into Sumire heading the same way. \"Commander, it has been a long week. I know I can't make more hours in the day, but I can make more coffee!\" When you enter the cramped galley, you find [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] in a tense stand-off in front of a nearly empty coffee pot. {TGT_MW.Callsign} sees you. \"Commander, this is the last of the coffee! The XO says we won't have any more until the next supply run.\" {SCN_MW.Callsign} shoves {SCN_MW.DET} way forward. \"I got here first, and {TGT_MW.SUBJ} almost stole it while I was looking for my favorite mug.\"
column2: 在前往豹式厨房的路上，你撞上同路的苏米蕾。"指挥官，这一周可真长。我知道没法把一天变长，但我能煮更多咖啡！" 你走进拥挤的厨房，发现[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]和[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]正在一壶几乎见底的咖啡前紧张对峙。{TGT_MW.Callsign}看见了你。"指挥官，这是最后一点咖啡了！执行官说下次补给之前都不会再有了。" {SCN_MW.Callsign}把{SCN_MW.DET}身子往前一挺。"我先到的，而{TGT_MW.SUBJ}趁我找我那只最爱杯子的时候差点把它偷走。"

column1: In the morning briefing, Yang jumps right in. \"Commander, the Leopard is too small! My MechTechs keep tripping over everything.\"    \"Chief, we've talked about this,\" Darius says in exasperation. \"We can't exactly knock down any walls.\"    Sumire inserts herself. \"What if we moved some supplies into other parts of the Leopard? The bunks, the kitchen, hell, I'll even store some boxes in the cockpit if it'll help.\"    Yang rubs his chin. \"Yeah, if I had some breathing room for a week, I could re-organize and make room for everything to move back.\"
column2: 晨间简报时，杨直接切入正题。"指挥官，豹式太小了！我的机修技师们老是被东西绊倒。"  "总工，我们谈过这个了，"达里乌斯无奈地说。"我们又不能把墙拆了。"  苏米蕾插话。"要是我们把一些补给搬到豹式的其他部分呢？铺位、厨房，见鬼，要是有用我甚至愿意在驾驶舱里堆几个箱子。"  杨摩挲着下巴。"行，要是能有一周喘息的余地，我就能重新归整，腾出空间把所有东西搬回来。"

column1: You're on the Leopard's bridge with Sumire, Yang, and Darius for the daily staff briefing. Darius says, \"We received three messages from the banks—\"    \"Loan sharks,\" Sumire cuts in.    \"—From the people who are financing us,\" Darius continues. \"They're considering rewriting the terms of our loans, so it will be easier to seize this ship if we miss a payment. As usual, they're only doing this because they believe we can't fight it in court.\"
column2: 你和苏米蕾、杨、达里乌斯在豹式的舰桥上开每日幕僚简报会。达里乌斯说："我们收到银行的三条消息——"  "是高利贷，"苏米蕾插嘴。"——来自那些资助我们的人，"达里乌斯继续说。"他们正考虑改写我们的贷款条款，这样一旦我们错过一次还款，他们就更容易没收这艘船。一如既往，他们这么做只是因为他们相信我们没法在法庭上抗争。"

column2: 声望: 痛恨

column1: Asset Retrieval
column2: 回收资产

column1: UNUSED KILL OBJECTIVE for AutoComplete
column2: 未使用的击杀目标（供自动完成）ZH

column1: I'm guessing the 'technology' is some broken piece of scrap, but {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} is willing to pay to recover it. We go in and get out before they even know what hit them.
column2: 我猜那"科技"不过是块破烂废铁，但{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}愿意为回收它付钱。我们进去取出来，等他们反应过来是什么砸了他们之前就走。ZH

column1: Our operatives on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} recovered a functional piece of SLDF technology, but before they could deliver it to us, they were captured by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces. We need a team to assault the location they're being held, recover the technology, and escape.
column2: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的干员回收了一件可用的SLDF科技，但在他们能把它交给我们之前，被{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队俘获了。我们需要一队人去袭击他们被关押的地点，回收科技并撤离。ZH

column1: Ensure Secondary Asset Recovery unit survives
column2: 确保次要资产回收单位存活

column1: Hidden KILL OBJECTIVE for OpFor1
column2: 隐藏的敌军歼灭目标 1

column1: Hidden KILL OBJECTIVE for OpFor2
column2: 隐藏的敌军歼灭目标 2

column1: Recover the SLDF Tech by Securing the Location
column2: 占领该地点来回收星际联盟防卫军科技

column1: Recover the VIP's assistant by securing the Secondary Designated Area
column2: 占领次要指定区域以接回要人的助手

column1: Retrieve the SLDF Technology and Escape
column2: 回收星际联盟防卫军科技并摆脱敌人

column1: Unit Carrying the Tech Must Survive
column2: 装有技术设备的单位必须存活

column1: [GENERIC VO] The asset has been recovered, Commander. Good work.
column2: [通用语音] 资产已回收，指挥官。干得好。ZH

column1: [GENERIC VO] The asset is sustaining damage, Commander!
column2: [通用语音] 资产正在受损，指挥官！ZH

column1: [GENERIC VO] The secondary asset has been recovered, Commander.
column2: [通用语音] 次要资产已回收，指挥官。ZH

column1: [GENERIC VO] The secondary asset is sustaining damage, Commander!
column2: [通用语音] 次要资产正在受损，指挥官！ZH

column1: Best of luck, Commander. Oliveira out.
column2: 祝你好运，指挥官。奥利韦拉通话结束。ZH

column1: Commander, the target location is likely to be well-defended.
column2: 指挥官，目标地点看起来守卫森严.

column1: Hold this location until our people can grab the asset.
column2: 坚守该位置直到我们的人拿到资产.

column1: That's it, mech recovering our Secondary Target is scraped. S&R will look for what's left. That objective is failed. Focus on the Primary.
column2: 完了，回收我们次要目标的那台机甲报废了。搜救队会去找剩下能用的东西。那个目标失败了。专注主要目标。ZH

column1: We need to move up, get eyes on the location, and neutralize any enemy forces.
column2: 我们需要行动起来看看那个地方，然后消灭任何敌方部队.

column1: Biological Sample
column2: 生化样本

column1: Commander, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} isn't kidding about that non-tampering clause. The contract includes twenty pages of protocol for handling the sample cases we'll be recovering.
column2: 指挥官，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}对那条禁止篡改的条款可不是在开玩笑。合约里有二十页的规程，专门说明我们回收样品箱时的处理流程。ZH

column1: We need you to recover our operatives from inside a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} research facility. They will be carrying highly sensitive scientific materials which must be returned to us. These materials are of a biological nature, and must not be tampered with. Opening or tampering with the materials will be considered a breach of contract.
column2: 我们需要你从{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的研究设施中救出我们的特工. 他们携带的都是高度敏感的科学材料，必须完好无损地回到我们这里. 这些材料具有生化性质，禁止擅自处理. 打开或擅自处理这些材料将被视为违反合约.

column1: Retrieve operatives and biological samples and Escape
column2: 回收行动人员和生化样本并摆脱敌人

column1: Secure the Facility to collect the sample cases
column2: 拿下设施来搜集样本箱

column1: Secure the Secondary Facility to rescue the operatives
column2: 拿下次要设施以营救行动人员

column1: Best of luck, Commander.
column2: 祝你好运，指挥官.

column1: Mission complete, Commander. Come on back.
column2: 任务完成，指挥官. 回来吧.

column1: Pick them up and get them to the evac point.
column2: 接上他们并护送他们到达撤离点.

column1: The operatives are lost, Commander. For now, focus on getting the sample cases out of there.
column2: 我们失去了特工，指挥官. 现在，请专注于把样本箱带离那里.

column1: Your target is a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} research facility. You'll be recovering {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} operatives carrying biological sample cases.
column2: 你的目标是一座 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 研究设施。你需要接回携带生物样本箱的 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 特工。ZH

column1: Black Site
column2: 黑狱

column1: Retrieve the VIP and Extract Safely
column2: 接回要人并安全撤离

column1: The objective for the player to retrieve the primary rescue target.
column2: 该目标是让玩家接回主要救援目标。ZH

column1: The objective to escape with all player units.
column2: 该目标是让所有玩家单位撤离。ZH

column1: The objective to keep the unit which is carrying the primary target alive. Player will fail if it is destroyed.
column2: 该目标要求让携带主要目标的单位存活。若其被摧毁玩家将失败。ZH

column1: The objective to keep the unit which is carrying the secondary target alive. The player can fail this objective.
column2: 该目标要求让携带次要目标的单位存活。玩家可能在此目标上失败。ZH

column1: The secondary and optional objective to secure the second rescue target.
column2: 次要且可选的目标：确保第二个救援目标安全。ZH

column1: Unsurprising that they want the key first. The risks you take as a covert operative.
column2: 不用惊讶他们优先要密钥. 这是身为一名秘密特工必须承担的风险.

column1: A few months ago, we intercepted a number of highly encrypted transmissions originating from the planet, none of which we've been able to decrypt and read. We suspected that the transmissions came from a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} black site, and sent an operative to infiltrate and steal the decryption key. They reported in requesting immediate emergency extraction. We'd like you to recover the key, and the operative if they're still alive.
column2: 几个月前，我们截获了若干发自该星球的高度加密传输，却一直无法解密读取。我们怀疑这些传输来自一处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}黑站，便派出一名特工潜入窃取解密密钥。该特工报告后请求紧急撤离。我们希望你去取回密钥，如果那名特工还活着，也把他带回来。ZH

column1: Recover the covert operative by securing the Secondary Designated Area.
column2: 占领次要指定区域来回收秘密特工.

column1: Retrieve the Decryption Key and Extract Safely
column2: 回收解密密钥并安全撤离

column1: Apparently they had some kind of device that started signaling when their heart stopped. They left the key on an automated broadcast loop, though, so we can still make the pickup.
column2: 显然他们有某种设备，在他们心脏停跳时开始发送信号. 不过，他们把钥匙落在了自动广播回路上，所以我们依然可以完成接应.

column1: Damn. Commander, I just got an update from our employer. The operative's dead.
column2: 该死。指挥官，我刚收到雇主的更新。那名干员死了。ZH

column1: How do they know? We just got here.
column2: 他们怎么知道的? 我们才刚来这儿.

column1: I loathe the priorities given to us by our employers, that allow us to call this a victory.
column2: 我非常讨厌雇主给我们的优先事项，那让我们称此为一场胜利.

column1: No rescue, and no key. That poor person died for nothing.
column2: 没有救援，没有密钥. 那个可怜人白死了.

column1: Commander, our employer reports that their operative is still alive, so if we rescue them, we get a bonus.
column2: 指挥官，我们的雇主报告说他们的特工还活着，所以如果我们救出他们，就会获得额外奖励.

column1: The heartbeat monitor is transmitting from this location; if you decide to rescue the operative, move into the area and pick them up.
column2: 心跳监视器是从这个地方发送出来的; 如果你决定营救特工，就进入这一地区接上他们.

column1: The key is safe. Well done, Commander.
column2: 密钥安全了. 做得不错，指挥官.

column1: We never even found out their name. Sometimes I hate this business.
column2: 我们甚至都不知道他们的名字. 有时我讨厌干这行.

column1: Brilliant Minds
column2: 杰出头脑

column1: This {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} scientist is a top weapons researcher, and extremely valuable to any faction that employs her.
column2: 这名{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}科学家是顶级武器研发人员，对任何雇佣她的派系来说都是极有价值的.

column1: Commander, we perform a substantial amount of scientific research here in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have been sabotaging our research stations, stretching our defenses thin. We've just learned that their ultimate target is a key scientist in our weapons development program. They've launched an assault that we believe is intended to capture her. We need you to reach the facility where she's stationed and extract her to safety.
column2: 指挥官，我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}这里进行着大量科学研究。{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队一直在破坏我们的研究站，把我们的防御摊得太薄。我们刚得知他们的最终目标是我们武器研发项目中的一位关键科学家。他们已发动一次袭击，我们相信其意图是俘获她。我们需要你抵达她驻守的设施，把她安全撤离。ZH

column1: Recover the Scientist by Securing the Designated Area
column2: 占领指定区域来回收科学家

column1: Retrieve the Scientist and Escape
column2: 回收科学家并摆脱敌人

column1: Excellent work, commander. The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} research can continue.
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的研究可以继续下去了.

column1: This is an in-and-out mission. Locate the scientist and retrieve her.
column2: 这是一次快进快出的任务. 找到科学家并带回她.

column1: I can only imagine what Yang is going to say to the idea of infecting one of our 'Mechs with hostile code.
column2: 我只能想象杨听到要给我们的机甲染上敌方代码会说什么。ZH

column1: We've discovered a facility where {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} researchers have developed a new computer virus that targets the control mechanisms of our 'Mechs. We can't build an effective defense against this virus without a sample of its code to work with. We need you to get one of your 'Mechs within range of the research facility and download the virus into its systems. Then extract the infected carrier 'Mech so we can analyze the virus.
column2: 我们发现了{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}研究人员的一处设施，他们研发出一种新型计算机病毒，专门攻击我们机甲的控制机制。没有病毒代码样本，我们无法建立有效防御。我们需要你让你的一台机甲进到该研究设施范围内，把病毒下载进它的系统。然后撤出被感染的载体机甲，好让我们分析这病毒。ZH

column1: Retrieve the Virus and Extract Safely
column2: 回收病毒并安全撤离

column1: Goddamn right we will.
column2: 太tm对了，我们会的.

column1: Good! Now wipe that damn thing before it gets into the Leopard!
column2: 好! 现在在那该死的东西进入豹式空投艇之前清除掉它!

column1: Protect the infected unit until you reach the extraction LZ, where Sumire will pick you up. Good luck, Commander.
column2: 在你抵达苏米尔接应你的撤离用着陆区之前，保护好被感染的单位. 祝你好运，指挥官.

column1: Told you so.
column2: 早告诉过你了.

column1: You want to do what with my 'Mechs?
column2: 你想对我的机甲做什么？ZH

column1: Corporate Secrets
column2: 公司机密

column1: Locate the scientist. She'll need to ride along in one of the mechs, so keep that mech safe until extraction.
column2: 找到那位科学家。她需要搭乘其中一台机甲，所以要保证那台机甲安全直到撤离。ZH

column1: I think I've lost track of how many layers of betrayal this represents. Is this a quadruple-cross? This must be some scientist.
column2: 我已经数不清这是第几层背叛了。这是四重反水？这位科学家可真不简单。ZH

column1: A scientist for a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} conglomerate has turned industrial spy for a rival corporation from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}. She was privy to numerous industrial secrets that we would prefer not to fall into our competitor's hands. The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} leadership has offered to sell her back, but we intend to use the false hope of negotiations to buy you time to extract the scientist through more proactive means.
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}一家企业集团的科学家已投身为来自 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} 的竞争对手公司充当工业间谍。她掌握着大量工业机密，我们绝不希望这些机密落入竞争对手手中。{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 高层提出把她卖还给我们，但我们打算利用谈判的虚假希望来为你争取时间，以更主动的方式把这位科学家营救出来。ZH

column1: Recover the scientist by securing the designated area
column2: 占领指定区域来回收科学家

column1: Recover the Secondary Asset by securing the Secondary Designated Area
column2: 占领次要指定区域来回收第二项资产

column1: Retrieve {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}'s double-crossing scientist and Escape
column2: 接回 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} 那位两面三刀的科学家并撤离

column1: Excellent work, commander. The wayward {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} scientist is on her way home.
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官. 这个任性的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}科学家在回家的路上了.

column1: Sumire will be waiting for your signal to pick you up. Best of luck, Commander.
column2: 苏米尔会等候你的信号来接应你. 祝你好运，指挥官.

column1: There it is. Move up and occupy the facility, Commander.
column2: 就是那儿了. 行动起来占领设施，指挥官.

column1: This is the region where the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility is located.
column2: 这个区域就是{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}设施所在的位置.

column1: Embassy Extraction
column2: 撤出大使

column1: The enemy has to be expecting an attempt to break their siege, so there will be significant resistance.
column2: 敌人肯定会料到有人要尝试图突破他们的包围，所以会有激烈抵抗.

column1: One of our VIPs is in a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} facility on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. We need to get her offworld, but the building is surrounded by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces. You will sweep aside the opposition, recover our VIP, and transport her to a designated landing zone for extraction. Be prepared for opposition - the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units surrounding the embassy won't let you extract our personnel without a fight. Payment will be issued when you deliver our VIP alive and in one piece.
column2: 我们的一位贵宾在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的一处{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}设施里。我们需要把她送出行星，但那栋建筑被{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队包围。你要清扫对手，接回我们的贵宾，并把她送到指定着陆区撤离。为遭遇抵抗做好准备——包围使馆的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队不会让你安然带走我们的人员。当贵宾活着、完好地送到时，报酬即行支付。ZH

column1: Recover the VIP by Securing the Designated Area.
column2: 占领指定区域来回收重要人物.

column1: Retrieve the VIP and Escape
column2: 回收重要人物并摆脱敌人

column1: All right, this should be a straightforward retrieval mission: get in, acquire the VIP, and get back out again.
column2: 好了，这应该是一次简单明了的回收任务: 进去，找到重要人物，然后再撤出来.

column1: Once you have the VIP in hand, get her to the designated landing zone for extraction.
column2: 一旦你掌握了重要人物，就带她前往指定的着陆区撤离.

column1: The VIP is secure, Commander - well done.
column2: 重要人物安全了，指挥官--做得不错.

column1: Intelligence Agent
column2: 情报特工

column1: There shouldn't be any surprises here, Commander. The target is expecting a pickup so she'll be aboard in a matter of moments. The data might be tougher but it's your call if you want to go after it.
column2: 指挥官，这里应该不会有什么意外。目标正在等待接应，所以她片刻之后就会登船。数据可能更难搞，但是否要去取由你决定。ZH

column1: One of our covert operatives was captured by a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} patrol during a routine data drop, and is being held at a secure facility on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. We need a rapid response team to raid the facility and get our operative out safely. We will pay a bonus if you're able to secure the data she was trying to deliver, as well. It's being held at a separate facility.
column2: 我们的一名卧底人员在一次例行数据交接中被{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}巡逻队抓获，目前被关押在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的一处戒备森严的设施中。我们需要一支快速反应小队突袭该设施，把我们的人安全救出。如果你还能找回她当时试图送出的数据，我们会额外支付奖金——那些数据被存放在另一处设施里。ZH

column1: Recover the Agent by Securing the Facility
column2: 占领整个设施来回收特工

column1: Recover the Data by Securing the Secondary Facility
column2: 占领次要目标设施来回收数据

column1: Retrieve the Agent and Escape
column2: 回收特工并摆脱敌人

column1: Get her to the evac zone, and get the hell out of there.
column2: 带她到撤离区域，然后离开那鬼地方.

column1: There it is. Move up, secure the location, and pick up the agent.
column2: 就是那儿了. 开始行动，拿下这个地方，然后接上特工.

column1: We're coming up on the target facility, Commander.
column2: 我们正在接近目标设施，指挥官。ZH

column1: Lost Contact
column2: 失联

column1: They just happened to be transporting valuable cargo through a rival's territory, and their DropShip just happened to go down? Sure.
column2: 他们偏偏要运着贵重货物穿过对手领地，而他们的空投艇偏偏掉了下去？当然。ZH

column1: One of our DropShips was in the {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} system when it experienced technical issues. A final message indicated a hard landing. That DropShip was carrying a valuable piece of technology as cargo, and while we are willing to write off the ship itself, we very much need to recover the cargo. Satellite imagery suggests that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces recovered the cargo and are holding it at a nearby facility. We need you to raid that facility and recover the item.
column2: 我们的一艘空投艇在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}星系发生了技术故障. 最后的通讯显示它已进行了硬着陆. 那艘空投艇搭载了一件极其珍贵的技术设备，虽然我们可以放弃空投艇本身，但我们非常需要将货物找回. 卫星图像显示，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的部队已经回收了这批货物，并将其存放在附近的一个设施中. 我们需要你突袭那座设施，把东西找回来.

column1: Keep the Item Safe
column2: 保证物品的安全

column1: Recover the Cargo by Securing the Facility
column2: 占领整个设施来回收货仓

column1: Retrieve the DropShip's Cargo and Escape
column2: 取回空投艇的货物并撤离

column1: Commander, the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility is just up ahead.
column2: 指挥官，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}设施就在前面.

column1: Lost Heir
column2: 失踪的继承人

column1: Locate the heir. She'll need to ride along in one of the mechs, so keep that mech safe until extraction.
column2: 找出那位继承人。她需要搭乘其中一台机甲随行，所以在撤离前保护好那台机甲。ZH

column1: Looks like {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} is really over a barrel here. My kind of customer.
column2: 看来{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}在这儿真的一筹莫展了. 这种客户正合我胃口.

column1: The scion of a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} mercantile concern has been missing for months. We suspect a kidnapping by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}, but there's been no ransom demand. A local group of sympathizers on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} recently picked up a garbled message from the scion indicating that she's being held in a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility there. Our intel failed to trace her to {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, so any loyal mechs are several jumps away. We need your help to extract her.
column2: 一位{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}商界要人的继承人已失踪数月。我们怀疑是{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}绑架，但一直没有收到赎金要求。{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上一群当地同情者最近收到这位继承人发来的一条含混不清的消息，表明她被关押在那里的某处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}设施中。我们的情报未能追踪她到{TGT_SYSTEM.name}，所以任何忠诚的机甲都在好几个跳跃之外。我们需要你帮忙把她救出来。ZH

column2: 确保带着重要人物的那部机甲存活

column2: 占领指定区域来回收重要人物

column2: 回收{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}重要人物并摆脱敌人

column1: ... and extract safely. Keep the Mech carrying the VIP in one piece!
column2: ......并且安全脱离. 请保障载有重要人物的机甲安然无恙!

column1: Excellent work, commander. The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} VIP is on her way home.
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的重要人物在回家的路上了.

column1: First step. Find our target in the location of the last known signal...
column2: 首先. 在最后一次侦测到目标信号的地点寻找...

column1: This is a straightforward retrieval. Locate the VIP and get to the Evac Zone.
column2: 这是一个简单明了的回收任务. 找到重要人物然后前往撤离区域.

column1: Locate the painter. He'll need to ride along in one of the mechs, then keep that mech safe until extraction.
column2: 找出那位画家。他需要搭乘其中一台机甲随行，然后在撤离前保护好那台机甲。ZH

column1: Commander, I don't pretend to understand what's so offensive about this painting, but they take that sort of thing seriously out here. As for retrieving the painting, apparently it's worth even more after all this controversy.
column2: 指挥官，我不假装明白这幅画有什么冒犯之处，但这里的人对这类事很认真。至于取回那幅画，显然经过这一番争议之后它更值钱了。ZH

column1: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} philanthropist is a patron of the arts here in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. A favored painter has been accused of heresy by the system's religious police. These zealots are propped up by foreign {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} agents. He'll be extradited to face trial and likely execution in {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} territory. We can't allow that to happen, but we don't want to incur reprisal from the religious leaders. That's where you come in. Locate the painter, rescue him and, at the personal request of the patron, recover the painting that started this whole mess.
column2: 一位{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}慈善家是{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}这里的艺术赞助人。他赏识的一位画家被该星系的宗教警察指控为异端。这些狂热分子由外国{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}特工扶持。他会被引渡受审，很可能在{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}领地被处决。我们不能让这种事发生，但又不想招致宗教领袖的报复。这就需要你了。找到那位画家，把他救出来，并且应赞助人本人的请求，找回引发这一连串麻烦的那幅画。ZH

column2: 这是一个简单明了的回收任务. 找到画家然后前往撤离区域.

column1: Payroll Seizure
column2: 夺取军饷

column1: Personally, I'm not above simple robbery to pay the bills, Commander.
column2: 就我个人而言，为了付账单，我不介意干点简单粗暴的抢劫，指挥官。ZH

column1: We've located the secure facility where {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} stores its payroll before distributing it to local forces. We believe we could put that payroll to better use. We'd like to hire you to hit the facility and steal the payroll. It will be well-defended, and there is a bonus if you eliminate all the defenders.
column2: 我们已定位{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}在向当地部队分发军饷之前存放军饷的安全设施。我们相信那笔军饷能派上更好的用场。我们想雇你去打那处设施并把军饷偷出来。那里会有严密防守，若你能消灭所有守军另有奖金。ZH

column1: Destroy Primary Enemy Force
column2: 消灭主要敌军

column1: Destroy Second Enemy Lance
column2: 消灭第二支敌方小队

column1: Seize the Payroll and Escape
column2: 夺取军饷并摆脱敌人

column2: 占领目标地点来夺取军饷

column2: 装有军饷的单位必须存活

column1: Hold this location until our people can grab the payroll crates.
column2: 坚守该位置直到我们的人拿到军饷箱子.

column1: I'm getting updated intel from our employer. They believe the base is going to be even more heavily defended than we thought.
column2: 我刚从雇主那儿收到最新情报。他们认为该基地的防御会比我们预想的还要严密得多。ZH

column1: Copyright Violations
column2: 侵犯版权

column1: If this is the next season of Rough Riders, we need to not let Yang know. He'll trade our whole payment for early access.
column2: 如果这是《粗野骑手》的下一季，我们可千万别让杨知道。他会把我们整笔报酬都换去买提前观看权。ZH

column1: We have an opportunity to get our hands on the next season of a popular holovid series before it's sent out for general distribution. Fans will pay through the nose to get a copy even a few weeks early. All you have to do is go to the secure {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility where the data is being stored, and our agent will transmit the data directly to your 'Mech. Oh, if you have a chance, pick the agent up, too? He's holed up in a secondary facility.
column2: 我们有机会赶在一部热门全息剧集公开发行之前拿到下一季。粉丝们愿意花大价钱买哪怕是早几周拿到的拷贝。你要做的只是前往存放数据的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}安全设施，我们的特工会把数据直接传送到你的机甲上。哦，如果有机会，把那名特工也接出来？他藏在次级设施里。ZH

column1: Ensure Primary Asset Recovery unit survives
column2: 确保首要资产回收单位存活

column1: Recover the Holovid Data by Securing the Designated Area.
column2: 占领指定区域来回收全息影视数据.

column2: 占领次要指定区域来回收海盗的特工.

column1: Retrieve the Data and Extract Safely
column2: 回收数据并安全撤离

column1: Dammit. Secondary target is down. Focus on the primary target.
column2: 该死. 次要目标完蛋了. 请专注于首要目标.

column1: Never mind, Yang.
column2: 别介意，杨.

column1: The facility is located in this region, Commander. Move into the area and the data will begin transmitting automatically.
column2: 这座设施位于这一地区，指挥官. 进入这个区域后数据就会自动开始传输.

column1: Why do pirates always think they need to be so clever about this stuff? This is a standard rescue op, Commander.
column2: 为什么海盗们总自以为自己聪明透顶? 这就是一次标准的救援行动，指挥官.

column1: One of our people has been staying in accommodations provided by our friends, the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} authorities. She's ready to move on, though, and so we'd like you to go in and pick her up. Her current landlords probably won't let her just leave, however, so expect to settle some arguments. There might be shooting involved.
column2: 我们的一位同伴一直住在我们朋友{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}当局提供的住处里。不过她已经准备好离开了，所以我们希望你去把她接出来。她现在的房东大概不会就这么放她走，所以要准备好解决一些争执。可能免不了交火。ZH

column1: The target is a facility located here, Commander. Move up and occupy it.
column2: 目标是坐落在这里的一处设施，指挥官. 行动起来占领它.

column1: One of our people has been staying in high-class accomodations provided by our friends, the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} authorities. She's ready to move on, though, and so we'd like you to go in and pick her up. Her current landlords probably won't let her just leave, however, so expect to settle some arguments. There might be shooting involved.
column2: 我们的人一直待在我们的朋友——{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}当局提供的高档住所里。不过她已准备好离开，所以我们希望你进去接她出来。但她目前的房东大概不会让她就这么走，所以预期要解决一些争执。可能会有交火。ZH

column1: Hold position, Commander. Your target is on her way out now.
column2: 别动，指挥官. 你的目标正在跑出来的路上.

column1: The detention facility is located here, Commander. Move up and occupy it.
column2: 拘禁设施就坐落在这里，指挥官. 行动起来拿下它.

column1: Professional Exchange
column2: 职业交流

column1: It must take some serious chutzpah to insist on a clause like that in your contract. I'm impressed.
column2: 敢在合约里坚持这样的条款，得有多大的胆子。我印象深刻。ZH

column1: We have an ongoing relationship with a well-known mercenary, and one of the elements of that relationship that they insisted on was an insurance policy: if they're captured, we're obligated to mount a rescue attempt. They've been captured by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces, and that's triggered the rescue clause. They managed to escape on their own but have no way off the planet, and are surrounded by hostiles. We need you to reach the facility where they're hiding and pick them up.
column2: 我们与一位知名雇佣兵保持着长期合作关系，而他们坚持的一项合作条件是一份保险条款：一旦他们被俘，我们有义务发起救援行动。他们已被{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队俘获，这触发了救援条款。他们设法自行逃脱了，但没有离开这颗行星的途径，而且四周都是敌人。我们需要你抵达他们藏身的设施并把它们接走。ZH

column1: Retrieve the Captured Mercenary and Extract Safely
column2: 回收被捕的佣兵并安全撤离

column1: I still can't believe we're doing this. What kind of mercenary has a rescue clause?
column2: 我还是不敢相信我们在干这事。哪种雇佣兵会有救援条款？ZH

column1: Spare me the attempts at humor, and let me aboard.
column2: 别跟我开玩笑了，让我登船吧.

column1: That was a lot more trouble than it was going to be worth.
column2: 这里的麻烦远远大于它的价值.

column1: Was- was that sarcasm?
column2: 那--那是讽刺吗?

column1: Smash and Grab
column2: 强夺行动

column1: Commander, if this is the real thing, it's going to be defended like you can't even imagine. This one will be tough.
column2: 指挥官，如果这是真货，它的防守会超乎你的想象。这一场会很难。ZH

column1: A {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} defector has given us an extremely interesting and time-sensitive piece of information, and we need a fast response. Before joining our side, this defector worked at a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility on this planet. She claims she was responsible for extracting data from a device that sounds, from her descriptions, very much like a Star League era memory core. We don't know what data is on it, but {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} cannot be allowed to keep it.
column2: 一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}叛逃者给了我们一条极其有趣且时效紧迫的情报，我们需要快速反应。在投向我们这边之前，这名叛逃者在这颗行星上的一处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}设施工作。她声称自己负责从一个装置中提取数据，从她的描述看，那东西非常像星盟时代的记忆核心。我们不知道上面是什么数据，但不能让{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}留着它。ZH

column2: 需要懊悔的帮助

column1: Commander, this seems like a rough fight. We'll be the shield that blocks the head of the spear. If any support units do make a showing, only engage if you're in a good position after dealing with the 'Mechs.
column2: 指挥官，这看起来是场硬仗。我们将是挡住矛尖的盾。如果真有支援单位露面，只在处理完机甲后处于有利位置时再交战。ZH

column1: A high tonnage {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance will shortly make planetfall, at the behest of a group of petty nobles and commercial interests. Intel suggests this is the vanguard of a larger force of conventional tanks and infantry, and they're scouting the region for a suitable landing site. We need a competent mercenary company to intercept the 'Mechs and stop the invasion before it gets underway. If their planet-side allies send any support, you are to wipe them out as well.
column2: 一支高吨位的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}分队即将降落，此事受一群小贵族与商业利益方的请求。情报显示这是一支更大规模常规坦克与步兵部队的前卫，他们正在该区域侦察合适的着陆场。我们需要一家称职的雇佣兵公司拦截这些机甲，在入侵展开之前将其阻止。如果他们的行星地表盟友派出任何支援，你也要把他们一并消灭。ZH

column1: Blunt the advance of the invading force, and punish any supporting local forces
column2: 挫败侵略军的进攻，并惩罚任何支援他们的当地军队
