column1: Trade negotiations between {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} and {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} have broken down. We believe that if we capture and hold a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} military base in the {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} system, we will be able to force them back to the negotiating table. Your job is to take the base and hold it until our forces can occupy it.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}与{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}之间的贸易谈判破裂。我们相信，如果我们夺取并守住{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}星系中一处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军事基地，就能迫使对方回到谈判桌。你的任务是拿下该基地并守住它，直到我们的部队能够占领。[警告：丧尸]

column1: DropShip arriving! Prepare to head out.
column2: 空投艇来了! 准备出发.

column1: We've been monitoring communications traffic on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, and discerned a pattern. There's a well-defended {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} base that we suspect of being a secure data storage facility. We'd like your team to land, capture the base, and take a complete image of the contents of their databases. Once the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces realize what we're doing, they'll launch a counteroffensive, so we'll need you to stay in the field until the download is complete.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 我们一直在监视{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的通讯流量，并辨认出一种规律。那里有一处防御严密的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}基地，我们怀疑它是安全数据存储设施。我们希望你的团队降落、夺取该基地，并完整拍摄其数据库内容。一旦{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队意识到我们在做什么，他们就会发起反攻，因此我们需要你留在战场直到下载完成。[警告：丧尸]

column1: This system was targeted as part of a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} expansion plan. Unfortunately, the colonial plan fell through, and we now have to extract our people from the planet's surface before they're intercepted by hostile forces. As the colony was a secret, thanks to the conflicting and dubious claims on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}, we cannot be seen to mount a major rescue operation. We need a deniable middle-man.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 这个星系是{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}扩张计划的目标之一。不幸的是，殖民计划落空了，我们现在必须在殖民者被敌对势力拦截之前，把他们从行星表面撤出来。由于对{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}存在互相矛盾且可疑的主权声索，而该殖民地本是秘密，我们不能公开进行一次大规模救援行动。我们需要一个可否认的中间人。[警告：丧尸]

column1: Rumor has it that the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} have been smuggling restricted munitions in amongst their medical supplies. On the surface, at least, we're being tasked with a humanitarian escort mission.
column2: 有传言称{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}一直在把受限弹药混在医疗物资中走私。至少表面上，我们的任务被说成是一次人道主义护送。ZH

column1: Contravening all decency and acceptable behavior on the battlefield, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has been targeting our hospitals and medical supplies. We're seeking to redistribute our supplies to safer locations, but one convoy remains without a proper escort. That's where you come in. While {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces will be stretched thin, attempting to intercept all of our separate shipments, you can expect that this one will not go unnoticed.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 违背战场上一切体面与可接受的行为，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}一直在把目标对准我们的医院与医疗物资。我们正设法把补给重新分配到更安全的地点，但有一支车队还没有适当护卫。这就需要你了。虽然{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队会因试图拦截我们所有分开的货运而被摊薄，但你可以预料这一批不会无人注意。[警告：丧尸]

column1: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} DropShip went down on this empty rock, and shortly thereafter we detected a distress signal from the surface. By the time we arrived, the crew had been taken captive by a heavily armed {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force. We don't have an in-system military presence large enough to mount a hostage rescue mission, so we're looking for a competent mercenary company to do it. We need you to reach the facility where the crew is being held, destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units guarding them, and escort them to safety.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 一艘{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}空投艇坠毁在这块空荡的岩石上，此后不久我们探测到来自地表的求救信号。我们赶到时，船员已被一支装备精良的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队俘获。我们在该星系内没有足够大的军事存在来执行人质营救行动，所以我们在找一家称职的雇佣兵公司来做。我们需要你抵达关押船员的那处设施，摧毁看守他们的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}单位，并护送他们到安全地带。[警告：丧尸]

column1: Top Secret
column2: 最高机密

column1: The Algea A Varient Quadvee, designed by Clan Hells Horse, is a force to be reckoned with. Equipped with 60 LRM tubes and a trio of ER medium lasers, this 100-ton assault mech is a versatile and deadly addition to any battlefield. With its impressive long-range capabilities and quick maneuverability, the Algea can rain down a barrage of missiles on enemies from afar or close in for devastating laser strikes. Its armor plating is reinforced with the latest materials and its engines are top of the line, ensuring both speed and protection. The Algea is a true feat of engineering and a testament to the ingenuity of its creator. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
column2: 由地狱马部族设计的 Algea A 变型 QuadVee 是一支不可小觑的力量。这台 100 吨的突击机甲装备了 60 管 LRM 和三门增程中型激光，是任何战场上多才多艺且致命的战力。凭借出色的远程打击能力和灵活的机动性，Algea 可以从远处向敌人倾泻导弹弹幕，也能逼近目标施以致命的激光打击。其装甲板采用最新材料强化，引擎也是顶级配置，兼顾速度与防护。Algea 是真正的工程杰作，也是其设计者智慧的明证。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.19

column1: Equipped with 60 Long Range Missile tubes and a trio of Extended Range medium lasers. At first, I was skeptical about how effective it could be without the Gauss rifles, but I have to say, I'm excited to see it in action. The LRM tubes will give us a serious punch at long range, and the ER medium lasers will provide some added flexibility up close. Let's hope the professor's other modifications are just as promising.
column2: 它装60具远程导弹发射管和三门增程中型激光器。起初我怀疑没有高斯步枪它能有多有效，但我得说，我很期待看它实战。LRM发射管会给我们远程带来沉重一击，增程中型激光器则在近距离提供额外的灵活性。希望教授的其他改装也同样有前途。ZH

column1: Variant B of the Algea Quadvee is equipped with 36 SRM tubes and a single ER medium laser. While it sacrifices some of the long-range capabilities of the original Prime variant, it excels in close combat situations with its impressive missile loadout. The single ER medium laser provides additional firepower for mid-range engagements. With its 100-ton weight and sturdy construction, the Algea Variant B is a formidable opponent on any battlefield. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
column2: Algea 四足变形车辆的 B 型配备 36 个 SRM 发射管和一具增程中型激光。它牺牲了原始 Prime 型的一部分远程能力，却凭借可观的导弹搭载量在近距离战斗中表现突出。单独一具增程中型激光为中距离交战提供了额外火力。凭借 100 吨的重量和坚固的结构，Algea B 型在任何战场上都是令人生畏的对手。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.19

column1: Commander, you're going to love Variant B of the Algea Quadvee! It's a real brawler, equipped with 36 SRM Tubes and a single ER med laser. With this loadout, it can dish out massive damage at close range and keep the pressure on the enemy. It's perfect for those intense urban combat situations where you need to get up close and personal with the enemy. Trust me, you won't be disappointed!
column2: 指挥官，你一定会喜欢阿尔盖四足机甲B型的！它是个十足的混战好手，装备36具SRM发射管和一门增程中型激光器。凭借这套配置，它能在近距离输出巨量伤害并持续压制敌人。对于那些需要与敌人贴身混战的高强度城市战场合，它是完美的选择。相信我，你不会失望的！ZH

column1: The Algea Variant C was designed as a highly mobile skirmisher, utilizing its top speed of 64kph to engage enemies at range with its primary weapon, a Rotary Autocannon 5. It also boasts a quad array of ER medium lasers for additional firepower. While lacking in heavier weaponry, its lighter weight and speed make it a formidable opponent in the hands of a skilled pilot. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
column2: Algea 的 C 变型被设计为高机动游击机甲，凭借 64kph 的最高速度，以主武器一门旋转自动炮 5 在远距离与敌交战。它还拥有四联装增程中型激光阵列以增强火力。虽然缺乏更重的武器，但它较轻的重量与速度使其在熟练机师手中成为可怕的对手。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.19

column1: Commander, we have a Variant C of the Algea. It's been modified to replace the Hyper Gauss rifles with a Rotary Autocannon 5 and two tons of ammo. To be honest, I'm not thrilled about this setup, but we could use it as a brawler if we position it right. We'll need to be strategic with our movements and use cover effectively. It's not ideal, but we can make it work if we have to.
column2: 指挥官，我们有一台阿尔盖的C型。它经过改装，把超高斯步枪换成一门旋转自动炮5和两吨弹药。老实说，我对这套配置并不兴奋，但如果我们位置摆得好，可以把它当混战者用。我们需要在移动上讲策略，并有效利用掩体。这不是理想方案，但必要时我们能凑合。ZH

column1: The Algea's advanced targeting systems and enhanced sensor suite make it a formidable opponent, capable of engaging multiple targets simultaneously with deadly precision. Its armored hull, reinforced by cutting-edge composite materials, offers unparalleled protection against enemy fire, while its sophisticated ECM suite can disrupt enemy communications and sensors, rendering them ineffective against its onslaught. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
column2: Algea 先进的瞄准系统和增强型传感器套件使它成为一名令人生畏的对手，能够以致命的精度同时应对多个目标。其装甲外壳由尖端复合材料强化，对敌方火力提供无与伦比的防护；而精密的电子对抗套件则能干扰敌方的通讯与传感器，使其在它的猛攻面前形同虚设。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.19

column1: I'm not sure about this one, Commander. The hyper gauss rifles are impressive, no doubt, but can the chassis handle the recoil? And what about the ammo? Still, I have to admit, I'm excited to see it in action. If it works, we could have a real game-changer on our hands.
column2: 我对这个不太确定，指挥官。超高斯步枪无疑令人印象深刻，但底盘承受得住后坐力吗？弹药呢？不过我得承认，我很期待看它上场。如果它能行，我们手里就有了真正的游戏规则改变者。ZH

column1: Versatile and powerful, the BattleMaster 1G is one of the best known BattleMechs in existence. Normally mounting a varied array of Energy weapons, the BattleMaster can engage enemies at any range and packs a powerful punch. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13

column1: Ah, the Catapult C1. Just like its namesake, it's good at lobbing large numbers of missiles over terrain without fear of return fire. Surprisingly, it's also not too shabby at closer ranges in a pinch. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 啊，投石机 C1。正如它的名字一样，它擅长隔着地形向远处抛射大量导弹，而无需担心遭到反击。出人意料的是，它在迫不得已时打混战也毫不含糊。特性：精准武器 - 导弹 投放费用倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column2: 啊，弹射器 C1。正如其名，它擅长越过地形投掷大量导弹而不必担心回击。令人惊讶的是，必要时刻它在较近距离也相当不赖。ZH

column1: A sturdy and reliable 'Mech, the Centurion is good at both taking and giving a beating. CN9-A models are able to engage at any range, but their damage curve increases as they approach a target. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 百夫长是一台坚固可靠的机甲，既能挨打也擅长打人。CN9-A 型号能在任何距离上交战，而且越接近目标，其伤害曲线越高。特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: This custom Solaris variant debuted in 3128 in Noisiel and piloted first by Natalia Porter and then by her daughter Carolyn Fischer, this Clint IIC upgrade reverses the trend of Clan-modified-Inner-Sphere machines. Starting from the Clan-built frame, the variant drops the Jump Jets to change the weapon load. It keeps the two Clan Extended Range Medium Laser and swaps the Clan LB 10-X AC for a Large Variable Speed Pulse Laser and a Medium Re-Engineered Laser mating them all to a Clan Targeting Computer. The standard plate armor is replaced with Ballistic-Reinforced Armor. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这款定制Solaris改型于3128年在Noisiel首次登场，先后由Natalia Porter及其女儿Carolyn Fischer驾驶。这型Clint IIC的升级一反部族改装内层星域机体的潮流。它以部族制造的骨架为起点，拆除了跳跃推进器以更改武器配置。它保留了那两门部族增程中型激光，并把部族LB 10-X AC换成一门大型可变速度脉冲激光与一门中型再工程激光，再将它们全部连接至一具部族瞄准计算机。标准平板装甲则替换为实弹强化装甲。特性：可变距离瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: This custom chassis based on the Cougar is apparently an attempt by the Jade Falcons to use experimental technology in a combat unit. Unlike the early prototype designated the Cougar XR, this unit actually is a fully developed Land Air Mech. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: 这一基于美洲狮的定制底盘显然是玉猫部族在战斗单位上使用实验技术的尝试。与早期被编号为美洲狮XR的原型不同，此单位实际上是一台完整开发的地空机甲。特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.02

column1: A uniquely hybridized brawler built from the husk of a CRB-20. Bogdan ''The Steel Beast'' Tubbs had the Big Steel Claw's chassis rebuilt to support the mounting of ballistic weaponry, presumably in the interest of creating a louder and more violent spectacle in the arena. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 这是一款由CRB-20残骸打造出的独特混合式斗士。博格丹·“钢铁野兽”·塔布斯让人重建了大钢爪的底盘，以支撑弹道武器的安装，想必是为了在竞技场中制造更响亮、更暴力的场面。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.04

column1: Check it out, Boss we've landed ourselves a FrankenMech! Looks like a Crab, but on the inside, it's at least a quarter Urbie... that's where the new ballistic mounting hardware came from. I'm honestly amazed that this thing even works, but it does, and it's ours now!
column2: 你瞧，老大，我们弄到一台拼装机甲！看着像螃蟹，但里面至少有四分之一是城市仔……新的弹道挂载硬件就是从那儿来的。老实说我很惊讶这东西居然能用，但它确实能用，而且现在是我们的了！ZH

column1: The Dragon 1N is a beefy machine that can take a serious beating but tends to be a bit light on weaponry. It moves fast for a heavy 'Mech, though, which makes it well suited to closing for Melee attacks against slower targets. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 龙 1N 是一台皮糙肉厚的机器，能承受沉重打击，但武器配置略显单薄。不过作为重型机甲，它移动得很快，因此非常适合逼近较慢的目标发动近战攻击。特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Debuted in 3144 on the Tennessee Valley Arena and piloted by Marie Costa, the most striking piece of technology this machine features is a Void Signature System followed by the Clan-spec Ferro-Fibrous Armor that replaced its original Capellan-style Starshield Stealth Armor and its eleven Double Heat Sinks. In the weapons section, a single MML-9 launcher appears where once there were twin MML-3s, while the mech losses the Light PPCs in favor of more ER Medium Lasers (now three). Missing is Beagle active probe while an Improved Narc Missile Beacon Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 该机于 3144 年在田纳西河谷竞技场首次亮相，由玛丽·科斯塔驾驶。这台机器上最引人注目的技术是虚空信号系统，其次是取代了原有卡佩兰式星盾隐形装甲的部族规格铁纤维装甲，以及十一台双散热器。武器方面，原本的双联 MML-3 变成了一具 MML-9 发射器，同时该机甲舍弃轻型粒子加农炮，换用更多增程中型激光（现为三门）。鱼鹰主动探测器被取消，改为一具改进型纳克导弹信标。特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：1.1

column1: This Griffin was introduced to the Taurian Concordat. It carries a Plasma Cannon and three ER medium lasers. It also has a higher top speed than its inspiration and can jump farther as well.
column2: 这台狮鹫是为金牛座协约国推出的。它装备一门等离子炮和三门增程中型激光，最高速度也比其灵感来源更快，跳跃距离也更远。ZH

column1: The Gundam is a testament to cutting-edge technology and raw power. With advanced weapons and mobility systems, this machine is built for domination on the battlefield. Its heavily armored exterior provides unrivaled protection from enemy attacks, making it a formidable opponent for any force that stands in its way. The Gundam is a technological marvel, and the pilots who use it should be ready for a high-powered and efficient machine. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 高达是尖端技术与原始力量的证明。凭借先进武器与机动系统，这台机器为统治战场而生。其厚重装甲外壳提供无与伦比的防护，使它成为任何阻挡者的可怕对手。高达是技术奇迹，驾驶它的机师应准备好迎接一台高性能、高效率的机器。特质：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: The Gundam is a technological marvel. Its advanced weapons and mobility systems make it a force to be reckoned with on the battlefield. Its heavily armored exterior offers unparalleled protection from enemy attacks. I'm impressed with its capabilities and I have no doubt it will perform well in combat. Anyone using it should be prepared for a high-powered, efficient machine.
column2: 高达是技术奇迹。其先进武器与机动系统使它成为战场上不容小觑的力量，厚重装甲外壳提供无与伦比的防护。它的能力令我印象深刻，我毫不怀疑它会在战斗中表现出色。使用它的人应准备好迎接一台高性能、高效率的机器。ZH

column1: The HBK-LGN-Pin Ugly Stepsister Drizella is assembled from the parts of three distinct BattleMechs: a 3050s-vintage Hunchback, an early run Legionnaire, and a Clan-made Pinion. The mech has a decent speed and carries enough laser weapons to host a lethal, but short-ranged, rave party. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: HBK-LGN-Pin“丑姐妹”德里泽拉由三台不同战斗机甲的部件组装而成：一台3050年代的驼背、一批早期生产的军团兵，以及一台部族制造的翼羽。该机甲速度尚可，携带的激光武器足以开一场致命但射程有限的狂欢派对。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.04

column1: The HBK-LGN-Pin Ugly Stepsister Drizella is assembled from the parts of three distinct BattleMechs: a 3050s-vintage Hunchback, an early run Legionnaire, and a Clan-made Pinion. The mech has a decent speed and carries enough laser weapons to host a lethal, but short-ranged, rave party.
column2: HBK-LGN-Pin"丑继姐"德莉泽拉由三台截然不同的战斗机甲的部件拼装而成：一台3050年代的老式驼背、一台早期批次的军团兵，以及一台氏族制造的翼羽。这台机甲速度不错，携带的激光武器足以举办一场致命但短程的电音派对。ZH

column1: The JagerMech S model is highly specialized at long-range Autocannon fire support. It doesn't have much in the way of protection or closer-range weapons, though, so keep it distant and out of harm's way. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 猎手机甲 S 型号高度专精于远程自动炮火力支援。不过它没有多少防护，近距离武器也不多，所以要让它保持距离、远离危险。特性：对空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Sniper & Direct-Fire Support
column2: 狙击手与直射火力支援

column1: Jenner Ds run hot, and they run fast but can quickly bound into combat to deliver a knockout punch, even against heavier units. Their capability with speed and weaponry tends to come at the expense of lower armor capacity, though. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 迅捷D发热高、跑得快，但能迅速跃进战斗打出一记击倒重拳，即便面对更重的单位也一样。不过，这种速度与火力上的能力往往以装甲较薄为代价。特性：改进生命维持 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Fast Striker Cavalry
column2: 快速打击骑兵

column1: Jenner Ds run hot, and they run fast but can quickly bound into combat to deliver a knockout punch, even against heavier units. Their capability with speed and weaponry tends to come at the expense of lower armor capacity, though.
column2: 詹纳 D 散热偏热、跑得很快，能迅速跃入战斗打出暴击，即使对更重的单位也是如此。不过它在速度与武器上的本事，往往是以较低装甲容量为代价的。ZH

column1: In 2775 as Aleksander Kerensky's forces were tightening the noose around the Amaris Empire, weapons development became increasingly frantic in hopes of finding a miracle weapon to turn the tides of the war. The most well known of these is the Matar, commonly referred to as Amaris' Folly, an attempt to create a BattleMech able to withstand an entire company. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 2775 年，当 Aleksander Kerensky 的部队正逐步收紧对 Amaris 帝国的绞索时，武器研发变得愈发疯狂，人们希望找到一种奇迹武器来扭转战局。其中最有名的便是 Matar——通常被称为“Amaris 的蠢行”——其目标是造出一台能抵挡整整一个连队的战斗机甲。特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.2 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: In 2775 as Aleksander Kerensky's forces were tightening the noose around the Amaris Empire, weapons development became increasingly frantic in hopes of finding a miracle weapon to turn the tides of the war. column2: 2775年，当亚历山大·克伦斯基的部队正收紧对阿马里斯帝国的绞索时，武器研发变得愈发疯狂，只为找到一件能扭转战局的奇迹武器。其中最著名的是玛塔尔，通常被称为“阿马里斯之愚”——一次尝试造出一台能抗衡整个连队的战斗机甲。ZH

column1: This Mongoose variant was developed for the SLDF Gunslinger Program, but never saw service. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: 这款Mongoose变型是为SLDF枪手计划研发的，但从未投入使用。特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.02

column1: This is one fast ghost. Invisible and packing a nasty punch; its a shame the star league never put this one into production.
column2: 这是个快得吓人的幽灵。隐形且带着凶狠的一击；可惜星盟从没把这一款投入生产。ZH

column1: The Orion K was the first true heavy 'Mech. As a multirole brawler, the Orion can engage enemies at a variety of ranges, and with plenty of armor, it can survive combined fire for quite some time. Slow, yes, but powerful. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 猎户座 K 是第一台真正的重型机甲。作为多面手混战机甲，猎户座能在各种距离上迎战敌人，凭借充足的装甲，它能在集火下坚持相当长的时间。速度是慢，但威力强大。特性：对空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Brawler & Close Assault
column2: 缠斗者与近距突击

column1: The Orion K was the first true heavy 'Mech. As a multirole brawler, the Orion can engage enemies at a variety of ranges, and with plenty of armor, it can survive combined fire for quite some time. Slow, yes, but powerful.

column1: Panther 9Rs are solid all-around 'Mechs, if a bit on the slow side. They make up for it with Jump Jets, considerable armor, and a hefty punch from their trademark PPC. They've even been used in physical slugging matches to good effect. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 黑豹 9R 是性能均衡的全能机甲，只是速度稍慢。它凭借跳跃推进器、可观的装甲以及招牌粒子加农炮的沉重打击弥补了这一缺憾，甚至曾被用于近身混战战并取得不错的效果。特性：空中突击 投放费用倍率：0.98

column1: Originally built as a new assault class mech by Jade Falcon just three years after Project Eryie the Phoenix Hawk IIC LAM is based on the venerable 50 ton Phoenix Hawk LAM but almost twice as heavy at 90 tons. The Phoenix Hawk IIC LAM features as close as possible speed and agility to the original Phoenix Hawk LAM making it an effective fast interdiction unit. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2
column2: 凤凰鹰 IIC LAM 最初由翡翠隼在"鹰眼计划"仅三年后作为新型突击级机甲建造，它基于经典的 50 吨凤凰鹰 LAM，但重近一倍，达 90 吨。其速度与灵活度尽可能贴近原版凤凰鹰 LAM，使其成为有效的快速拦截单位。特质：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.2

column2: 凤凰鹰 IIC LAM

column2: 凤凰鹰 IIC LAM 最初是翡翠猎鹰在 Eryie 计划之后仅三年作为新型突击级机甲打造的，它以久经考验的 50 吨凤凰鹰 LAM 为基础，但重量几乎翻倍，达到 90 吨。凤凰鹰 IIC LAM 的速度与灵活性尽可能贴近原版凤凰鹰 LAM，使其成为高效的快速拦截单位。ZH

column1: Developed for the Star League Defense Force Royal Divisions in 2692, not surprising that at some point the Clanners decided to refit one and see what they could get out of it. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
column2: 该系统于2692年为星际联盟防御军皇家师团研发，因此部族成员后来决定改装一台、看看能从中榨出什么性能，也就不足为奇了。特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.06

Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 与 C 配置相似，猛禽 F 配置携带五门 ER 中型激光，并额外加装三台双倍散热器。F 型通过加装七个跳跃推进器提升机动性，可跳起至二百一十米。特质：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.93 臂部驱动器限制：全能

column1: Debuted in 3144 on the Hartford Gardens Arena and piloted by Robert Benson, The Beast is a remote-operated drone controlled from the copilot seat of the Watchman known as Belle and may well be a triumph of modern military technology. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 野兽于3144年在哈特福德花园竞技场首次亮相，由罗伯特·本森驾驶。它是一架遥控无人机，从名为“美人”的守夜人副驾驶座上操控，很可能代表了现代军事技术的一项成就。特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.08

column1: Debuted in 3141 on the Tennessee Valley Arena and piloted by Ira Kuhn-Bedard, the variant keeps the best features of this hundred-year-old machine and make it even better. With Clan Ferro-Lamellor Armor improving its resistance to nearly all forms of damage and combined with a Clan-spec XL Engine model instead of the original Inner Sphere one to improve endurance. MASC boosting its land speed, and four Clan ER Medium Lasers replacing all the original weaponry. A Hatchet has been fitted to make it more Solaris Games enabled. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
column2: 该变型于 3141 年在田纳西谷竞技场首次亮相，由伊拉·库恩-贝达德驾驶；它保留了这具百年老机体最优秀的特点，并使其更加出色。部族铁鳞装甲提升了它对几乎所有伤害形式的抵抗力，同时以部族规格的 XL 引擎取代原本的内层星域型号，以增强耐久性。MASC 提升了它的地面速度，四门部族中型增程激光则替换了原有的全部武器。此外还加装了一把战斧，使其更适应 Solaris 竞技赛。特性：近战驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.13

column1: Solaris Mech
column2: 索拉里斯机甲

With Clan Ferro-Lamellor Armor improving its resistance to nearly all forms of damage and combined with a Clan-spec XL Engine model instead of the original Inner Sphere one to improve endurance. MASC boosting its land speed, and four Clan ER Medium Lasers replacing all the original weaponry. A Hatchet has been fitted to make it more Solaris Games enabled.
column2: 该改型于3141年在田纳西谷竞技场首次亮相，由伊拉·库恩-贝达德驾驶，它保留了这台百年老兵的最佳特性并使其更加出色。氏族铁甲装甲提升了它对几乎所有伤害形式的抗性，并以氏族规格的XL引擎型号取代原本的内天体型号以提升续战力。MASC提升了它的地面速度，四门氏族增程中型激光器替换了原有的全部武器。它还装上了一把斧头，使其更适合索拉里斯赛事。ZH

column1: Developed under the guidance of Angelique Claw for Zellbrigen Stables, the Wraith Alexander combines Experimental Technology from the Clans and Inner Sphere to create a unique 'Mech. The use of a Clan-made XL Engine keeps the speed high, and allows for the installation of more equipment. The jump jets, Endo Steel structure, and Snub-Nose PPC are of Inner Sphere manufacture, but the two ER Medium Lasers, Ferro-Fibrous Armor, and twin Partial Wings were built by the Clans. The partial wings increase the Wraith's jump range to 270 meters. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
column2: 幽灵亚历山大由安吉莉克·克劳指导、为兹尔布里根马厩研制，融合了部族与内层星域的实验技术，打造出一台独一无二的机甲。它采用部族制造的XL引擎以保持高速，并腾出空间安装更多装备。跳跃推进器、钢内骨结构和短管粒子加农炮均为内层星域制造，而两具增程中型激光、铁纤维装甲和一对部分翼则出自部族之手。这对部分翼将幽灵的跳跃距离提升至270米。特性：随处可见 投放费用倍率：1.13

column1: Developed under the guidance of Angelique Claw for Zellbrigen Stables, the Wraith Alexander combines Experimental Technology from the Clans and Inner Sphere to create a unique 'Mech. The use of a Clan-made XL Engine keeps the speed high, and allows for the installation of more equipment. column1: We have a VIP at a base on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, and we've just received a garbled transmission from a local agent that the base will be attacked by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}. They're striking at the VIP, and they know our forces are not in position to come to his aid. We need a team of competent mercenaries to protect the facility and our personnel.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的一处基地有一位贵宾，刚收到当地特工发来的混乱讯息，称基地将遭到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}的袭击。他们的目标就是这位贵宾，而且他们知道我军的兵力无法及时赶到救援。我们需要一支能干的雇佣兵小队来保护设施和我们的人员。[警告：丧尸]

column1: We have a centralized supply depot here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, located to support multiple fronts of hostile action. With so many troops elsewhere, we're looking for a lance of Mercs to babysit our outpost. We have no intel that suggests a specific threat, but better to be certain.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}有一个集中补给站，用来支援多个敌对战线的行动。由于兵力大多调往他处，我们想找一支雇佣兵分队来看守我们的前哨。没有任何情报显示存在特定威胁，但还是稳妥为上。[警告：丧尸]

column1: We have an extremely odd assignment for you. We have a manufacturing facility on the planet below, and we've been aware that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have been scouting in the area. We've expected them to make a move, but we didn't expect them to... send us a warning beforehand? Apparently they've hired a mercenary who contacted us to let us know when the attack would be, because, and I'm quoting, \"professional ethics.\" We have no idea what that means.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 我们有一个极其古怪的任务给你。我们在下面那颗行星上有一处制造设施，我们一直知道{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队在附近侦察。我们预计他们会有所动作，但没料到他们会……事先给我们发警告？显然他们雇了一名雇佣兵，那人联系我们告知攻击将在何时进行，因为——我引用原话——"职业操守"。我们完全不明白那是什么意思。[警告：丧尸]

column1: Clever Girl
column2: 聪明的女孩

column1: The Raptors are notorious for using coordinated unit tactics, flanking, and misdirection. Be on your guard, Commander.
column2: 猛禽组织以运用协同单位战术、侧翼包抄和声东击西而臭名昭著. 请保持警惕，指挥官.

column1: The Raptors are holed up at their Salinization Plant, converting all the raw materials they can get their hands on into salt. Intercepted transmissions from the facility have been somewhat garbled, but they're apparently on the brink of setting up something called a 'salt meme economy', whatever that is. What they're up to doesn't really matter; we're going to go in, demolish their operation, take them out, and collect that bounty.

column1: We've just lost contact with one of our facilities, Commander, and we need your help. Earlier today, our facility here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} received what they believed was a normal data transmission. It was badly garbled, and when they requested it be re-sent, they got no response. Shortly thereafter the base systems began to malfunction, and then we lost contact with both the base and the synchronous satellites covering that region. We'd like you to investigate the facility.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 我们刚与一处设施失去联系，指挥官，我们需要你的帮助。今天早些时候，我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的设施收到了一段他们以为是常规数据的传输。它严重错乱，他们要求重发后却毫无回应。此后不久，基地系统开始故障，然后我们同时失去了与该基地和覆盖该区域的同步卫星的联系。我们希望你去调查那处设施。[警告：丧尸]

column1: We are looking for a mercenary company to do some covert work for us. We've lost a base to {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, and believe {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} personnel are being interrogated even now. We can't allow those people to spill their secrets, but it would look bad if we were seen to destroy our own base. We need deniability. We need you to level the base, particularly the storage and communications facilities. We'd appreciate it if you ensured there were no living witnesses, and will pay a bonus if you wipe out all the opposition.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 我们在找一家雇佣兵公司为我们做些隐蔽工作。我们失去了一处基地，落到了{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}手里，并相信{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}人员此刻正在受审。我们不能让那些人泄密，但如果被看到是我们自己摧毁了基地，那就难看了。我们需要可否认性。我们需要你把那座基地夷平，尤其是仓储与通讯设施。如果你能确保没有活口，我们将不胜感激；若清除全部抵抗者，我们还会付一笔奖金。[警告：丧尸]

column1: A routine sweep of the planet's surface revealed something unexpected: a power signature coming from the location of an abandoned facility. From the readings we're getting, it could be a 'Mech factory powering up. We're not in a good strategic position to claim the factory, so we need you to find it and destroy it. If we act quickly, we can deal with this before any 'Mechs are produced. If you do come across any newly produced 'Mechs, of course, you should reduce them to scrap as well.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 对行星表面的一次例行扫描发现了意外之物：一处废弃设施的位置传出能量信号。从我们读到的数值看，那可能是一座正在通电启动的机甲工厂。我们在战略上无力宣称占有那座工厂，所以需要你找到并摧毁它。若我们行动迅速，就能在任何机甲被造出来之前解决此事。如果你真碰上任何新造出的机甲，当然，也该把它们拆成废铁。[警告：丧尸]

column1: Darius brings to the briefing an issue that has lingered on the back-burner ever since that ill-fated Contract to eliminate a defector from the Draconis Combine.    \"The Mercenary Review Board has finally reviewed our claim of Non-Payment, and have invited us to a sit down with the House Kurita envoy, [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRepKurita],Shugo Yamaguchi]].\"     Sumire bristles in her chair. \"Finally! I say we take our pound of flesh, and an extra pound for our troubles!\"    Darius shakes his head. \"I can't believe I'm suggesting walking away from C-Bills, but If we allow Yamaguchi to save face here, we could gain a significant boost in our reputation with Kurita.\"    Dr. Murad clears her throat and pauses, holding the room's attention. \"Remember how the Shugo delegated the contract to his [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreGakuHironaka],underling]], so he could rush off to Herotitus? The notorious pleasure planet?\" She pauses again before adding,  \"Do you think we could get some leverage from that?\"
column2: 达里乌斯在简报会上提出一个自那次不幸的清除龙尼斯联合体叛逃者合约以来一直搁置的问题。"雇佣兵审查委员会终于审理了我们关于未付款的申诉，并邀请我们与栗田家族特使[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRepKurita],山口修护]]坐下来谈谈。"  苏米蕾在椅子上浑身一紧。"终于！我说咱们得拿走应得的血肉，再额外多拿一磅辛苦费！"  达里乌斯摇摇头。"我简直不敢相信我会建议放弃C币，但如果我们让山口在这儿保住面子，我们与栗田的声望可能会有显著提升。"  穆拉德博士清了清嗓子，顿了顿，把全场的注意力都抓住了。"还记得吗，那位修护把合约委派给了他的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreGakuHironaka],下属]]，好让自己赶去赫罗提图斯？那颗臭名昭著的享乐星球？"她又停了一下，然后补上一句："你们觉得我们能拿这件事做点文章吗？"

column2: 兵营走廊里传来高声叫嚷，你赶到时看见[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]正与[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]对峙。"事情不是这么办的！"{TGT_MW.Callsign}说。"我们或许是雇佣兵，但也不该那样抛下格威迪恩连。" "你说得对，我们是雇佣兵。钱在哪儿我们就去哪儿。"{SCN_MW.Callsign}冷笑道。"你难道宁愿我们去对上那支施泰纳打击队？！我们中可能有个人已经死了。" {TGT_MW.Callsign}爆发了。"我表兄就在格威迪恩连，而他比你这辈子都比不上的机师！"{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:stalk|Default:stalks}着冲出了兵营。在随之而来的沉默中，房间里的人终于注意到你来了。ZH

column1: Data Liberation

column1: This sounds like a messy scenario, Commander. That satellite is only going to be overhead for a short time.
column2: 这听起来像是个棘手的情况，指挥官. 卫星在设施上方停留的时间会很短.

column1: We have an operative in place in a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} research facility, and for the past year they've been gathering sensitive research data for us. They've notified us that they're ready for us to extract the data, and we need a deniable force to arrange that extraction. The research facility is not connected to any data networks, and all the secure laboratories are far enough underground that wireless data signals are blocked. To get the information out, we're going to need to position a satellite receiver directly above the site. Your task will be to place positioning beacons to allow the satellite to lock on to the research data signal and download it.
column2: 我们在{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的一处研究设施内安插了一名特工，过去一年里他们一直为我们收集敏感研究数据。他们已通知我们，准备好让我们取走数据，而我们需要一支可矢口否认的力量来安排这次提取。该研究设施不与任何数据网络相连，且所有安全实验室都深埋地下，无线数据信号被阻断。为把情报送出来，我们需要在该地点正上方部署一颗卫星接收器。你的任务是放置定位信标，让卫星锁定研究数据信号并下载它。ZH

column1: You need to move into position in three marked locations, here...

column1: This sounds like a messy scenario, Commander. That satellite is only going to be overhead for a short time, and this place is going to be very heavily guarded.
column2: 这听起来像是个棘手的情况，指挥官. 卫星在设施上方停留的时间会很短，且该地点守备极其森严.

column1: We have an operative in place in a covert {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} research facility, and for the past year they've been gathering sensitive research data for us. They've notified us that they're ready for us to extract the data, and we need a deniable force to arrange that extraction. The research facility is not connected to any data networks, and all the secure laboratories are far enough underground that wireless data signals are blocked. To get the information out, we're going to need to position a satellite receiver directly above the site. Your task will be to place positioning beacons to allow the satellite to lock on to the research data signal and download it.
column2: 我们有一名特工潜伏在一处隐蔽的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}研究设施中，过去一年里他们一直在为我们收集敏感研究数据。他们已通知我们准备就绪，等我们提取数据，而我们需要一支可否认的部队来安排这次提取。该研究设施未连接任何数据网络，所有安全实验室都深埋地下，无线数据信号被阻断。要把信息传出去，我们需要在该地点正上方部署一颗卫星接收器。你的任务是放置定位信标，让卫星能锁定研究数据信号并将其下载。ZH

column1: Fire for Effect
column2: 效力射

column1: There is a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} base in this region. We have the equipment to level it, however our recon capability has been diminished. We would like you to take a team and attack the installation. Place beacons for our artillery to target, and exfiltrate while our guns destroy the base.
column2: 该区域有一座{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的基地. 我们有夷平它的装备，但侦察能力已受损. 我们希望你们派一支小队攻击该设施，为我们的火炮放置目标指示信标，然后在我方炮火摧毁基地时撤离.

column1: The time-frame on this is tight, since we need the artillery strike to hit while the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} representative has everyone looking in the right direction. And Commander, I wouldn't take any bets on that military base actually being abandoned.
column2: 这件事的时间窗口很紧，因为我们需要在{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}代表把所有人的注意力引向正确方向时让炮击命中。指挥官，至于那座军事基地是否真的被废弃，我可不打算打赌。ZH

column1: We are engaged in delicate negotiations with a private manufacturer from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} space, but we have reached an impasse. Our representative has requested a demonstration. \"Something dramatic,\" she said. So we turn to you. Your team will provide on-site assistance to target an abandoned {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} military base near the trade conference. We'll have a WarShip standing by to light it up… dramatically.
column2: 我们正与一个来自{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}空间的私营制造商进行微妙谈判，但已陷入僵局。我们的代表要求做一次演示。"要有点戏剧性，"她说。所以我们求助于你。你的团队将提供现场协助，为贸易会议附近一处废弃的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军事基地标定目标。我们会有一艘战舰待命，把它照亮——很有戏剧性地照亮。ZH

column1: Mark the military base for destruction from orbit
column2: 标记军事基地以便从轨道上摧毁

column1: Observer Actual this is Fire Control: Shot Over. Splash in 30.
column2: 观察员，这里是火控: 发射完毕，30秒后弹着.

column1: Observer Actual this is Fire Control: Target Locked. Firing for Effect. HE 30 rounds. Danger Close.
column2: 观察员，这是火控中心: 目标锁定，实施火力压制——发射高爆30发，危险临近！ZH

column1: The client wants to put on a show. We're here to mark the target so that can happen.
column2: 客户想搞一场表演。我们来这里是为目标做标记，好让表演得以进行。ZH

column1: Three points make a triangle around the target base. Set up beacons at those points and we can go home.
column2: 我们需要对目标基地进行三角测量，这就是为什么你需要将信标放置在基地周围的三个点上. 然后我们就可以离开这里了.

column1: Bringing a military ship this far out towards the Periphery is a hell of a risk. This operative must know something big.
column2: 把军用飞船开到这么远的边境地区，风险极大. 这名特工一定掌握着什么重要的东西.

column1: Commander, one of our senior operatives has defected to {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}. They know far too much about our operations to be allowed to share their knowledge with their new friends. It seems the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} handlers have realized how valuable the knowledge our operative possesses is, because they're being held in an extremely secure facility, deep underground. Such extreme defensive measures probably makes them feel as though they're untouchable. We have a military DropShip with a naval PPC on station to demonstrate to them just how touchable they are. We need you to help us precisely target the PPC.
column2: 指挥官，我们一名高级特工叛逃到了{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}。他们对我们行动的知情太多，不能容许他们把所知分享给新朋友。看来{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的接头人已经意识到我们特工掌握的情报有多宝贵，因为他们被关押在一处极其安全、深埋地下的设施里。这种极端的防御措施大概让他们觉得自己不可触及。我们在轨道上有一艘装备舰载PPC的军用空投艇，可以演示给他们看他们有多可触及。我们需要你帮我们精准瞄准那门PPC。ZH

column1: Observer Actual, this is {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} Fast Mover: Target Locked. Cover your eyes, folks.
column2: 观察员，这里是{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}高速机: 目标锁定——大家遮住眼睛！ZH

column1: Ok, Commander, the clock is ticking on this one, so let's cover the basics quickly. Right now there's a military DropShip inbound to this location. It's going to have only a few moments to make a flyby and take the shot.
column2: 好的指挥官，这事时间很紧，所以我们要快速过一遍要点。目前有一艘军用空投艇正在飞往此处。它只有短短片刻进行一次掠飞并开火。ZH

column1: A scientist for a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} conglomerate has turned industrial spy for a rival corporation from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}. She was privy to numerous industrial secrets that we would prefer not to fall into our competitor's hands. The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} leadership has offered to sell her back, but we intend to use the false hope of negotiations to buy you time to extract the scientist through more proactive means.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 一位{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}企业集团的科学家的为来自{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}的对手公司充当了工业间谍。她掌握着大量我们不愿落入竞争对手之手的工业机密。{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}领导层提出把她卖回给我们，但我们打算利用谈判的虚假希望为你争取时间，让你通过更主动的手段把这位科学家救出来。[警告：丧尸]

column1: One of our VIPs is in a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} facility on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. We need to get her offworld, but the building is surrounded by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces. You will sweep aside the opposition, recover our VIP, and transport her to a designated landing zone for extraction. Be prepared for opposition - the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units surrounding the embassy won't let you extract our personnel without a fight. Payment will be issued when you deliver our VIP alive and in one piece.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 我们的一位贵宾在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的一处{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}设施里。我们需要把她送出行星，但那栋建筑被{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队包围。你要清扫对手，接回我们的贵宾，并把她送到指定着陆区撤离。为遭遇抵抗做好准备——包围使馆的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队不会让你安然带走我们的人员。当贵宾活着、完好地送到时，报酬即行支付。[警告：丧尸]

column1: A {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} defector has given us an extremely interesting and time-sensitive piece of information, and we need a fast response. Before joining our side, this defector worked at a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility on this planet. She claims she was responsible for extracting data from a device that sounds, from her descriptions, very much like a Star League era memory core. We don't know what data is on it, but {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} cannot be allowed to keep it.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}叛逃者给了我们一条极其有趣且时效紧迫的情报，我们需要快速反应。在投向我们这边之前，这名叛逃者在这颗行星上的一处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}设施工作。她声称自己负责从一个装置中提取数据，从她的描述看，那东西非常像星盟时代的记忆核心。我们不知道上面是什么数据，但不能让{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}留着它。[警告：丧尸]

column1: A lance of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} BattleMechs has been rampaging in {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} territory on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. They've been razing population centers, burning fields and refineries, looting storage facilities. They're clearly doing everything they can think of to drive our people out. This is terrorism, pure and simple. We need you to find them and destroy them - no escape, and no prisoners.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}战斗机甲小队一直在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}领地里肆虐。他们烧毁居民点、焚烧农田与炼油厂、劫掠仓储设施。他们显然在尽其所能把我们的人赶走。这是纯粹的恐怖主义。我们需要你找到并消灭他们——不许逃脱，不要俘虏。[警告：丧尸]

column1: We have detected an inbound dropship belonging to {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}. Our local defense forces in the expected drop area are ill-equipped to handle a lance of 'Mechs, but with your aid we can ensure that the raid does minimal damage. We'd like you to intercept the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance and destroy it.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 我们探测到一艘属于{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}的空投艇正进入。我们在预计投放区域的本地防御部队无力应付一支机甲分队，但有你的协助，我们能确保这次袭击造成的损害降到最低。我们希望你去拦截那支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}分队并将其摧毁。[警告：丧尸]

column1: Within the last three months, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has struck our facilities, personnel, and supply convoys over half a dozen times. My superiors in the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Government} leadership would like to even the score. We'd like to hire you to find a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance and destroy it, to demonstrate we are not without military resources on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 在过去三个月里，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}袭击了我们的设施、人员与补给车队超过六次。我在{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Government}领导层的上级希望扳平比分。我们想雇你找到一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}分队并将其摧毁，以表明我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}上并非没有军事资源。[警告：丧尸]

column1: [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] sprints into the Command Center, excitedly waving a [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMRBC],MercNet]] bulletin.    \"Commander, a bounty was just posted against a paramilitary group known as The Raptors, and it appears they're here in this system. I've always suspected they were really pirates and it looks like they finally crossed the line. For years I've hoped to have a chance at taking them down, but they've always proved too clever. No more.\"      [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[TooltipSimGameCharacterDARIUS],Darius]] looks over the bulletin, his eyes twinkling as he gets to the numbers at the bottom. \"Say the word Commander, and we'll hit the Raptors hard and collect this bounty. Should be a pretty good payday! The bounty is set at 250,000 c-bills on top of whatever we can salvage on-site.\"
column2: [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]冲进指挥中心，兴奋地挥舞着一份[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMRBC],雇佣网]]公告。"指挥官，刚刚发布了一笔针对一个叫"猛禽"的准军事团体的赏金，而他们似乎就在这个星系。我一直怀疑他们其实是海盗，看来他们终于越了线。多年来我一直盼望有机会干掉他们，但他们总是太狡猾。不会再有下次了。"  [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[TooltipSimGameCharacterDARIUS],达里乌斯]]看着公告，当目光落到最下面的数字时眼睛发亮。"你一句话，指挥官，我们就把猛禽狠狠打一顿并领走这笔赏金。应该是笔相当可观的进账！赏金定为25万C币，外加我们在现场能打捞到的一切。"

column2: 红海盗 II

column1: Wait, the local government Milita are Clan Wolf forces? This is Inner Sphere space. I am still trying to wrap my head around this one Commander.
column2: 等等，当地政府的民兵是狼族部队？这里是内天体空间。指挥官，我到现在还没想明白这件事。ZH

column1: These 'Militia' as they call themselves are freeborn Clan Wolf warriors. They don't belong in the inner sphere, and I am trying to drive them out. Break through their front lines then we will take down their base.
column2: 这些自称"民兵"的人是狼族氏族的自由出生者战士。他们不属于内天体，而我在试图把他们赶出去。突破他们的前线，然后我们就拿下他们的基地。ZH

column1: Destroy the Militia Lances
column2: 摧毁民兵分队

column1: You will see for yourself. Up ahead should be a second line unit or better Touman.
column2: 你会亲眼看到的。前方应该是二等部队或更好的图曼。ZH

column1: Red Corsair III
column2: 红海盗 III

column1: Time to kick the Clan Pups off this ball of rock. Engage their base and clear out any remaining Touman.
column2: 该把那些部族崽子从这块石头上踢下去了。攻击他们的基地，清掉任何残留部队。ZH

column1: Capture the Militia Facility
column2: 夺取民兵设施

column1: If we can kick Clan Pup hard enough here it will break their ability to resist and I can finish driving them off of this world.
column2: 如果我们能在这里狠狠踢小狗族一脚，就能打断他们的抵抗能力，我就能把他们彻底赶出这颗行星。ZH

column1: Well, looks like we're going to stop a disaster today instead of starting one, for a change.
column2: 好吧，看来今天我们是要阻止一场灾难，而不是引发一场，算是换换花样。ZH

column1: Things are going well. It seems Kell has lured the Corsair out for single battle. However, I have come upon information this was not her real goal. We discovered there is a nuclear warhead device being set up in the potential area of the duel. We will need you to deploy to draw off any defenders while we attempt to gain access and disarm the device. Expect heavy resistance.
column2: 事情进展顺利。看来凯尔已经把海盗引出来进行单挑了。不过我查到情报，说这并不是她真正的目的。我们发现决斗可能发生的区域里正被安放一件核弹头装置。我们需要你部署出去引开任何守军，而我们尝试接近并拆除该装置。预期会遇到强烈抵抗。ZH

column1: Let's get in there and stop the Red Corsair's plan. Lord Commander has given us the coordinates of the nuclear device.
column2: 我们进去，阻止红海盗的计划。领主指挥官已经把核装置的坐标给了我们。ZH

column1: What a Charlie Foxtrot, Commander.
column2: 真是一团乱麻，指挥官。ZH

column1: Now we are being ambushed by Clan Wolf. How can this day get any worse? I need you to head out and defend our east flank, Commander.
column2: 现在我们又遭到狼族伏击。这一天还能更糟吗？我需要你出去防守我们的东翼，指挥官。ZH

column1: We are getting multiple contacts.
column2: 我们正在接收多个接触信号。ZH

column1: We have our work cut out for us on this one. We have to make sure these guys stay safe so they can get back in the fight and help us.
column2: 这一票我们得下大功夫。我们必须确保这些人安全无虞，好让他们能重新投入战斗并帮助我们。ZH

column1: Glad you're still with us. Since setting up this outpost we have been constantly harassed by the Red Corsair and her pirate goons. They must be making a tidy profit since she can afford some seriously advanced technlogy. Let's protect the base and give our personnel a chance to recuperate
column2: 很高兴你还活着。自打建起这座前哨，我们就不断遭到红海盗和她的海盗喽啰骚扰。他们一定赚得盆满钵满，因为她买得起一些相当先进的技术。让我们守住基地，给手下人一个喘息的机会

column1: A chance to dish out some pain back to the enemy, always my favorite.
column2: 有机会把痛苦还给敌人，永远是我最喜欢的。ZH

column1: We need you to search for and destroy any pirate stragglers, Commander.
column2: 指挥官，我们需要你搜寻并消灭任何落单的海盗。ZH

column1: Glad we could get some revenge on these Solahma!... I mean Pirates.
column2: 很高兴我们能对这些索拉赫玛报一箭之仇！……我是说海盗。ZH

column1: It definately feels like a festive engagement.
column2: 这确实像是一场节日般的交战。ZH

column1: We're under heavy assault from Kell's Hounds. I need you to take out the advancing forces while I prepare to meet with their leaders. We have almost made it to the goal. I am thrilled you decided to stick around. The party is going to be fun.
column2: 我们正遭到凯尔猎犬的猛烈攻击。我需要你在准备会见他们领袖时干掉那些推进的部队。我们几乎就要达成目标了。我很高兴你决定留下。这场派对会很有趣。ZH

column1: Destroy the Hound's Lances
column2: 摧毁猎犬的分队

column1: We have enemy contact, I would recommend a solid firing line. Tactics should not be one of their strong suites.
column2: 发现敌军接触，我建议排成稳固的射击线。战术应该不是他们的强项之一。ZH

column1: The Annihilator is an extremely rare 'Mech that is essentially a mobile siege tower. It can kick out more damage than almost any other unit on the field. It's unbelievably slow, though, and poorly armored for its size. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 歼灭者是一种极为稀有的机甲，本质上是一座可移动的攻城塔，能打出的伤害几乎超过战场上的任何其他单位。但它慢得难以置信，就体型而言装甲也很差。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Annihilator is an extremely rare 'Mech that is essentially a mobile siege tower. It can kick out more damage than almost any other unit on the field. It's unbelievably slow, though, and poorly armored for its size.
column2: 歼灭者是一种极为稀有的机甲，本质上是一座移动的攻城塔。它能比战场上几乎任何其他单位打出更多伤害。不过它慢得难以置信，就其体型而言装甲也很差。ZH

column1: The Archer's 2S variant trades some of its long-range punch to become even deadlier when it gets up close, mounting SRMs to follow up what its LRMs have battered. Its heat management still poses a huge problem, though, so its pilots have to stay very wary of overheating. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 弓箭手的2S变型牺牲了部分远程打击力，换来近身后的更强杀伤力——它加装的SRM能在LRM轰击之后继续追击。不过它的散热依然是一大难题，机师必须时刻警惕过热。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.08

column1: The Archer's 2S variant trades some of its long-range punch to become even deadlier when it gets up close, mounting SRMs to follow up what its LRMs have battered. Its heat management still poses a huge problem, though, so its pilots have to stay very wary of overheating.
column2: 弓手的2S改型牺牲部分远程打击力，以便在近身时更加致命，加装SRM来跟进其LRM已经打坏的部位。不过它的热量管理仍是巨大问题，所以其机师必须非常警惕过热。ZH

column1: The well-known Archer is the epitome of the \"missile boat\" concept. It is commonly found hurling deadly swarms of LRMs at targets from behind the safety of a hill. It's not too shabby in closer-range fights, either. Its only real weakness is terrible heat management. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 广为人知的弓手是“导弹母舰”概念的典范，常被发现躲在山头后方，向目标倾泻致命的LRM弹群。它在较近距离的交战中也不算差。唯一真正的弱点是糟糕的热量管理。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.08

column1: The well-known Archer is the epitome of the \"missile boat\" concept. It is commonly found hurling deadly swarms of LRMs at targets from behind the safety of a hill. It's not too shabby in closer-range fights, either. Its only real weakness is terrible heat management.
column2: 著名的弓手是"导弹艇"概念的典范。它常被发现躲在土丘的安全后方，向目标抛掷致命的LRM弹群。在近距离战斗中它也不差。它唯一真正的弱点是糟糕透顶的热量管理。ZH

column1: The Atlas is the king of the battlefield, capable of bringing a dizzying array of weapons to bear on targets at any range. It is also noteworthy for normally mounting the maximum amount of armor possible. Few opponents can survive even brief contact with this monster. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2
column2: Atlas 是战场之王，能在任何距离上向目标倾泻令人眼花缭乱的各种武器。它还以通常搭载尽可能多的装甲而著称。很少有对手能在与这头怪物短暂接触后幸存下来。特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.2

column1: The Atlas is the king of the battlefield, capable of bringing a dizzying array of weapons to bear on targets at any range. It is also noteworthy for normally mounting the maximum amount of armor possible. Few opponents can survive even brief contact with this monster.
column2: 阿特拉斯是战场之王，能在任何距离上向目标倾泻令人目眩的各类武器。它还以通常装备可容纳的最大装甲量而著称。很少有对手能在与这头怪物短暂接触后幸存。ZH

column1: The personal 'Mech of the mysterious Red Corsair started life as a Royal BLR-1Gbc model, but was refitted with Clan-tech weaponry and structural components. A single ER PPC is located in each arm, with a Large Pulse Laser installed in the center torso, and all six of the medium lasers are upgraded to medium pulse lasers. Twenty-one double heat sinks manage the heat generated by these weapons. To command her force, the Red Corsair's BattleMaster mounted a Command Console in the head. Sixteen tons of standard armor protected an Endo Steel skeleton and an XL engine. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21
column2: 神秘的“红海盗”（Red Corsair）的座机最初是皇家 BLR-1Gbc 型，但被改装上了部族科技武器与结构部件。每条手臂各装有一门增程粒子加农炮，中央躯干内装有一门大型脉冲激光，六门中型激光则全部升级为中型脉冲激光。二十一台双散热器负责处理这些武器产生的热量。为指挥她的部队，红海盗的战斗大师（BattleMaster）在头部装有一台指挥控制台。十六吨标准装甲保护着钢内骨结构和 XL 引擎。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.21

column1: The personal 'Mech of the mysterious Red Corsair started life as a Royal BLR-1Gbc model, but was refitted with Clan-tech weaponry and structural components. A single ER PPC is located in each arm, with a Large Pulse Laser installed in the center torso, and all six of the medium lasers are upgraded to medium pulse lasers. Twenty-one double heat sinks manage the heat generated by these weapons. To command her force, the Red Corsair's BattleMaster mounted a Command Console in the head. Sixteen tons of standard armor protected an Endo Steel skeleton and an XL engine.
column2: 这位神秘红海盗的私人机甲最初是皇家BLR-1Gbc型，但改装了氏族科技武器与结构组件。两臂各装一门增程PPC，中央躯干装一门大型脉冲激光器，六门中型激光器全部升级为中型脉冲激光器。二十一具双重散热器处理这些武器产生的热量。为指挥她的部队，红海盗的战斗大师在头部装了一台指挥控制台。十六吨标准装甲保护着内层钢骨架和一具XL引擎。ZH

column1: I've never seen anything like this, Commander. This 'Mech oozes deadly grace and can obviously devastate anything in its path. It's otherworldly, but clearly influenced by Star League tech. It has a mounted artillery piece to boot, I wonder where it came from. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 我从没见过这样的东西，指挥官。这台机甲散发着致命的优雅，显然能摧毁路上的一切。它非人间所有，却明显受星际联盟技术影响。它还装了一门火炮，我真想知道它从哪来。特性：威吓 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The Marauder was first built by General Motors in 2612 for use as an attack and direct fire support BattleMech. The first 'Mech to diverge from the traditional humanoid shape of previous machines, the Marauder was one of the most well-known 'Mechs in existence and originally meant to usher in a new generation of 'Mechs. Unfortunately, with the fall of the Star League, this new generation never quite materialized. On its own merits though, the Marauder was a devastatingly powerful 'Mech, outclassed only by larger machines like the Stalker and BattleMaster. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
column2: 掠夺者最初由通用汽车公司于2612年制造，用作攻击与直射火力支援战斗机甲。作为首款摆脱以往人形机甲传统造型的机甲，掠夺者是有史以来最负盛名的机甲之一，最初被寄望于开启机甲的新一代。遗憾的是，随着星际联盟的覆灭，这一代新机甲终究未能真正成形。不过就自身实力而言，掠夺者是一台极具毁灭性的强力机甲，唯有潜行者、战斗大师等更大型的机体才能压过它一头。特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.13

column2: 狙击手与远程突击

column2: 疯... 我告诉你疯了！ZH

column1: The RFL-3N Rifleman is as well known for its terrible armor as for its ability to hammer opponents from long range. It has only average speed and poor heat sinking ability, but if you can put it in the right position, it can rain death on anything it surveys. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: RFL-3N Rifleman 以装甲薄弱闻名，也以能从远距离猛击对手而闻名。它的速度平平，散热能力也很差，但只要你能把它摆到合适的位置，它就能让视野内的一切目标沐浴在死亡之雨中。特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The RFL-3N Rifleman is as well known for its terrible armor as for its ability to hammer opponents from long range. It has only average speed and poor heat sinking ability, but if you can put it in the right position, it can rain death on anything it surveys.
column2: “步枪手 3N”以其可怕的装甲和远距离打击对手的能力而闻名. 尽管它只有平均水平的速度以及极差的散热能力，但在正确的位置它会对能看到的一切降下死亡之雨.

column1: Darius calls you to the bridge. \"My contacts came through, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. I've got a lead on the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDobrev],Dobrev]].\" A grainy image fills the viewscreen. \"What you're looking at is a [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBaumannGroup],Baumann Group]] distribution center on [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreIndependence],Independence]]. Every scrap of exotic contraband that's been turning up on the black market has gone through this site.\" Sumire nods thoughtfully. \"Sounds good, XO. I'll mark it on the star map. When we're ready to check it out, just let me know.\" \"One other thing, Commander.\" Darius pulls up a dossier on the viewscreen. \"For 50,000 C-Bills, I can arrange for a portion of Baumann's security team to call in sick on the day of our arrival. Could save us some trouble when we follow up on this.\"
column2: 达里乌斯把你叫到舰桥。"我的联系人办成了，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。我拿到了关于[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDobrev],多布雷夫]]的线索。"一张颗粒感很重的图像占满了显示屏。"你看到的是[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBaumannGroup],鲍曼集团]]在[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreIndependence],独立星]]上的一个配送中心。所有出现在黑市上的异域违禁品，都是从这里流出去的。" 苏米蕾若有所思地点点头。"听起来不错，执行官。我会把它标在星图上。等我们准备去查看时，告诉我一声就行。" "还有一件事，指挥官。"达里乌斯在显示屏上调出一份档案。"给我5万C币，我可以安排鲍曼的部分安保人员在我们抵达那天请病假。这也许能让我们后续追查时省点麻烦。"

column1: Yang calls you to the MechLab, where you find him standing in the shadow of an enormous ferro-aluminum crate. \"I don't think that the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBountyHunter],Bounty Hunter]] realized what he was giving us, Boss. What we've got is one third of a mothballed assault 'Mech—mostly the guts, so it doesn't look like much to the untrained eye. But what I can tell you is that this 'Mech is strange. Never seen anything quite like it.\" Farah raises her hand. \"And I think I have a lead on the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDobrev],Dobrev]]. An old colleague of mine contacted me about a group of patients at the hospital she administrates. They were suffering from what appeared to be [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMisjump],misjump]]-induced injuries. I think it's worth investigating.\" Sumire rubs her temples. \"I can't believe I'm saying this, but I've got one, too. A [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreJumpShip],JumpShip]] operator I used to hang with has been running his mouth about a big job he just did for Notker Baumann. Want me to follow up?\"
column2: 杨把你叫到机甲实验室，你看见他站在一只巨大的铁铝合金箱子的阴影里。"我觉得[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBountyHunter],赏金猎人]]没意识到他给了我们什么，老大。我们拿到的是三分之一的封存突击机甲——大部分是内脏，所以在没受过训练的人眼里看着不起眼。但我能告诉你的是，这台机甲很怪。我从没见过类似的东西。" 法拉举起手。"而我想我有一条关于[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDobrev],多布雷夫]]的线索。我的一位老同事联系我，说她主管的医院里有一群病人。他们遭受的似乎是[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMisjump],误跳]]造成的损伤。我觉得值得调查。" 苏米蕾揉着太阳穴。"我简直不敢相信我会这么说，但我也有条线索。一个以前跟我混在一起的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreJumpShip],跃迁舰]]操作员一直在吹嘘他刚为诺特克·鲍曼做的一桩大活。要我去跟进吗？"

column1: Mystery Box
column2: 神秘盒子

column1: Farah calls you to the Argo's Command Center, where you find the viewscreen overflowing with grainy Holo images and dossiers. \"Multiple sources confirm that an unknown spacecraft crashed into a saltwater lake on [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[Lore],Mantharaka]] about a month ago. Her surviving crew was medevaced to an orbiting station, where they were all found to have suffered misjump-induced injuries.\" \"That's the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDobrev],Dobrev]]!\" Farah pumps her fist, her smile radiant with triumph. \"It has to be!\" Darius nods. \"Yes, and that was the good news. The bad news is, we're not the only company on the derelict's trail. The [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlackWidow],Black Widow]] has been carving a bloody trail across the Frontier, burning out black market sites on over a dozen worlds. And I have reliable information that she's moving toward Mantharaka.\" Sumire shakes her head. \"If we fight the Black Widow, she's gonna end us. This is a bad idea, Commander.\" Farah shrugs. \"So we move fast. If we recover the Dobrev's navigation logs before she gets there, we won't even need to fight.\"
column2: 法拉把你叫到阿戈号的指挥中心，那里显示屏上满是颗粒感强烈的全息影像与档案。"多个来源确认，约一个月前有一艘不明航天器坠入[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[Lore],曼塔拉卡]]的一处咸水湖。其幸存的船员被医疗后送到一座轨道站，在那里发现他们全都遭受了误跳造成的损伤。" "那就是[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDobrev],多布雷夫]]！"法拉挥拳庆祝，笑容因胜利而灿烂。"一定是它！" 达里乌斯点点头。"是的，那是好消息。坏消息是，我们不是唯一在追这艘废船的。[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlackWidow],黑寡妇]]在边疆一路血洗，烧毁了十几个世界的黑市据点。而我有可靠情报说她正朝曼塔拉卡移动。" 苏米蕾摇头。"如果跟黑寡妇打，她会把我们了结掉。这是个坏主意，指挥官。" 法拉耸耸肩。"那我们就快点行动。如果在她到那儿之前取回多布雷夫的导航日志，我们根本不用打。"

column1: Assert that if it comes to a fight, you can beat the Black Widow.
column2: 断言如果发生战斗，你肯定能击败黑寡妇.

column1: According to ISF intelligence, Captain Gaku Magorian is being held prisoner in one of a dozen safe houses within the boundaries of Alamedo Province. Obviously, we can't rely on trial and error to find him, so we're going to have to narrow down the list. Our unidentified syndicate is known to maintain a forward base in this AO. Capture it so that Dr. Murad can scour the OpFor's mainframe for confirmation of Captain Magorian's whereabouts.
column2: 根据ISF情报，学·马戈里安上尉被关押在阿拉梅多省边界内十几处安全屋中的某一处。显然，我们不能靠试错来找他，所以必须缩小范围。我们那个身份不明的辛迪加已知在此行动区域维持着一处前沿基地。夺取它，好让穆拉德博士能在敌军主机里搜寻确认马戈里安上尉下落的资料。ZH

column2: 我找你来做这份工作是因为我相信你的公司能胜任这项任务. 现在我明白我错了.

column2: 好，指挥官。我们那个身份不明的犯罪辛迪加的前沿基地应该就在前方某处。把头探得够远，你一定能找到它。ZH

column1: Zeta Lance moved Captain Magorian out of Alamedo Province two days ago. They're holding him in a bunker somewhere under the ruins of New Vulci, a city that fell victim to a nuclear accident in 2977. Engage Zeta Lance and destroy their 'Mechs. When you're finished, I'll scour their combat computers for the bunker's coordinates.
column2: 泽塔分队两天前把马戈里安上尉转移出了阿拉梅多省。他们把他关在新武尔奇废墟地下的某处掩体里——那座城市在2977年毁于一场核事故。交战并摧毁泽塔分队的机甲。等你们完事，我会翻查他们的战斗计算机，找出掩体的坐标。ZH

column1: You think it has something to do with the derelict?
column2: 你觉得这跟那艘废弃飞船有关?

column2: 我把你投放在鲍曼集团的军械库，指挥官。打得够狠，监狱的守备队就该赶过来了，从而为莫德比约恩用无人机营救马戈里安上尉清出道路。ZH

column2: 摧毁鲍曼集团的军械库.

column1: Already, huh? These hired guns must be starving for action. You with us, M-B?
column2: 已经来了，嗯? 这些雇佣兵肯定是饿疯了，急着想干架. 我们可以指望你，对吧，M-B?

column1: Mission accomplished, Commander. Assuming the Moderbjörn has done its part, our job here should be done.
column2: 任务完成，指挥官. 既然“熊妈妈”已达成目标，我们在此地的任务应该结束了.

column1: Our distraction is already working, Commander. I'm picking up a lance of heavy 'Mechs between us and the armory, and they don't look friendly.
column2: 我们的牵制已经起效了，指挥官。我在我们与军械库之间侦测到一支重型机甲分队，看起来不太友好。ZH

column1: What about Baumann? Is his JumpShip still up there?
column2: 鲍曼呢? 他的跃迁舰还在现场吗?

column1: If the Moderbjörn holds up its end, we should be golden. Our lance will be in trouble if it doesn't.
column2: 如果莫德比约恩能撑住它那一头，我们就稳了。如果不能，我们的分队就会有麻烦。ZH

column1: Captain Magorian is being held in a subterranean bunker attached to a complex just ahead of us. We're going to sneak a scout lance in, rescue the captain, and bug out. If all goes according to plan, the Moderbjörn's combat drones will distract the bunker's garrison and keep it out of our hair for the duration of the operation.
column2: 马戈里安上尉被关押在我们前方一处建筑群附属的地下掩体里。我们要偷偷潜入一支侦察分队，救出上尉，然后撤出。如果一切按计划进行，莫德比约恩的战斗无人机将牵制掩体的守军，让它在整个行动期间不碍我们的事。ZH

column1: Recover Captain Magorian by Securing the Designated Area
column2: 通过控制指定区域来营救马格里安船长.

column1: Retrieve Captain Gaku Magorian and Extract Safely
column2: 找到贺久·马格里安船长并安全撤离.

column1: Captain Magorian's safe house is just ahead of you, Commander. Defenses should be light. That said, there'll probably be some armed resistance, so be ready to brush it aside.
column2: 马戈里安上尉的安全屋就在你前方，指挥官。防御应该不重。话虽如此，大概还是会有些武装抵抗，所以准备好把它扫开。ZH

column1: The Baumann Group's made a lot of money off of the Dobrev. We're gonna find out where they took it—and get a piece of the profits for ourselves while we're at it.
column2: 鲍曼集团靠多布雷夫赚了大钱。我们要查出他们把它带到哪儿去了——顺便给自己分一份利润。ZH

column1: Like I said, the Baumann Group's distribution center is heavily defended, so we're gonna approach this as a two-stage operation. For this first stage, you're going to descend at the outermost edge of the OpFor's territory and engage their patrolling cavalry. Take out as many vehicles and 'Mechs as you can to clear the way for an assault on the distribution center.
column2: 如我所说，鲍曼集团的分销中心防御严密，所以这次行动要分两阶段。第一阶段，你将在敌方领土最外缘降落，并交上其巡逻骑兵。尽可能多地消灭车辆与机甲，为攻打分销中心清出道路。ZH

column2: 消灭鲍曼集团的骑兵部队.

column1: According to our intel, the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBaumannGroup],Baumann Group]]'s cavalry lance should be patrolling through this AO. Get in there, hit 'em hard, and wipe 'em out. When the cavalry lance is on ice, you'll be clear to advance on Baumann's distribution center.
column2: 根据我们的情报，[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBaumannGroup],鲍曼集团]]的骑兵分队应该正在这一行动区域巡逻。进去，狠狠打击，把他们清掉。等骑兵分队上了冰，你就可以放心向鲍曼的配送中心推进。ZH

column1: Gods. Commander, we have company.
column2: 老天！指挥官，我们有“客人”了.

column1: If we turn tail and run, the Bounty Hunter will probably shoot us in the ass on our way out the door. The man has a reputation.
column2: 要是我们掉头逃跑，赏金猎人可能会直接朝我们开枪. 这个人因此而闻名.

column1: So much for our cautious approach. Can you get us over there now, Meyer?
column2: 谨慎行动的计划泡汤了！现在能带我们赶过去吗，梅耶尔?

column1: Thanks for the heads-up, I guess?
column2: “多谢提醒”——大概?

column1: Who is it, Meyer?
column2: 对方是谁，梅耶尔?

column1: We're almost there, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. Just one more push and the derelict is ours.
column2: 我们快到了，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。再推进一步，那艘废船就是我们的了。ZH

column1: As per our earlier discussion, I'm going to drop you right on top of a Baumann Group security outpost some 20 klicks from the Dobrev's spaceport. You're going to have to capture the site and clear out its defenses. When the job's done, the Moderbjörn will use the complex's computers to drop the spaceport's defenses and remotely engage the Dobrev's docking clamps. I'd expect the OpFor's defenses to run heavy on this one, so I'd advise building your lance accordingly.
column2: 按照我们先前讨论的，我会把你直接投放在鲍曼集团一处安保前哨的头顶，那里距离多布雷夫的太空港约20公里。你得夺取该地点并清掉其防御。任务完成后，莫德比约恩会用该建筑群的计算机解除太空港的防御，并远程启动多布雷夫的对接钳。我预计这次敌方防御会很厚，所以建议你相应组建分队。ZH

column2: 攻击鲍曼集团的安全综合体.

column2: 夺取鲍曼集团的安保基地.

column2: 消灭鲍曼集团的防御力量.

column2: 好，指挥官，我已把我们的分队降落在鲍曼集团视野范围之外。防御大概会偏重型，所以我建议谨慎接近。ZH

column1: What is it, Meyer? Who do you have on the line?
column2: 怎么了，梅耶尔? 你在和谁通话?

column1: Obviously, this deployment is gonna be a little fraught. It's on us to handle it anyway.
column2: 显然，这次部署会有点惊险。无论如何都得由我们来处理。ZH

column1: Nicely done, pal! You just pulled my feet out of the fire, big time!
column2: 干得漂亮，伙计！你刚刚把我从火坑里拉了出来，太及时了！ZH

column1: The Dobrev is gone, but its crew left an undefined amount of valuable contraband behind at the spaceport. Unfortunately, the Black Widow wants to melt every scrap of that contraband to slag. The Moderbjörn will draw the Black Widow's attention away from our AO, which should buy Yang and me enough time to ransack the spaceport. We'll be relying on your lance to protect us from anyone else who might come along.
column2: 多布雷夫已经不见了，但它的船员在太空港留下了数量不明的贵重违禁品。不幸的是，黑寡妇想把这些违禁品全部熔成矿渣。莫德比约恩会把黑寡妇的注意力引离我们的行动区域，这应该能给我和杨争取到足够时间洗劫太空港。我们将依靠你的分队保护我们免受任何其他来人干扰。ZH

column1: Defend the Evacuated Spaceport
column2: 保卫已疏散的太空港.

column2: 消灭黑寡妇公司的雇佣兵.

column2: 好了，指挥官。我刚把你放在鲍曼集团废弃的太空港前。法拉、杨和他们的团队应该已经在里面了。杨，你能确认吗？ZH

column1: Escort them safely to the generators. We can boost our defensive capabilities with those turrets activated. Good luck!
column2: 护送他们安全抵达发电机那里，一旦那些炮台启动，我们的防御能力就能大幅提升. 祝你好运！ZH

column2: 他们在基地周围设置了炮台. 不过目前处于离线状态.

column2: 一个充满技术人员的盟军车队必须被护送到防御，以便他们可以被激活.

column2: 快，{COMMANDER.FirstName}！黑寡妇和赏金猎人正在路上.

column1: We've found the Dobrev, and this time, it's in no condition to run. Time is of the essence here, so we're going to deploy alongside the Moderbjörn's drones. Hit the Baumann Group fast, hit 'em hard, and wipe the AO clean. After we've taken the Dobrev, we'll discuss our next steps.
column2: 我们找到多布雷夫了，而这一次，它没法再跑了。时间紧迫，所以我们将与莫德比约恩的无人机一同部署。快速打击鲍曼集团，狠狠打击，把行动区域清干净。等我们拿下多布雷夫，再讨论下一步。ZH

column2: 护送任何剩余的战斗无人车到撤离点.

column1: This is it—the final confrontation between ourselves, the Black Widow, and the Bounty Hunter. Succeed in this, and the Moderbjörn will have all the time it needs to harvest the Dobrev's navigation logs. The secrets of the Star League lie within our grasp, Commander. I know we can do this, so let's get to it.
column2: 就是这一下了——我们、黑寡妇与赏金猎人之间的最后对决。成功之后，莫德比约恩就会有充足的时间来提取多布雷夫的导航日志。星盟的秘密就在我们掌握之中，指挥官。我知道我们能做到，那就动手吧。ZH

column1: My read on the situation is that by 'personnel' they mean 'covert operatives'. You don't hire 'Mechs to cover the retreat of clerical staff.
column2: 我对这个局面的解读是，他们说的"人员"其实指的是"秘密特工"。你不会雇机甲来掩护文员的撤退。ZH

column1: Commander, our covert forces are poised to seize a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} prison facility where a large number of {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} personnel are being held prisoner. However, the facility is protected by a nearby military base, and as soon as we seize the prison, they'll move against it, and reduce those buildings to rubble before they let us extract those people. We'll be moving our own 'Mechs and Leopards in as quickly as we can but before we can land them and extract the personnel, we need you to pacify that military base.
column2: 指挥官，我们的隐蔽部队已准备好夺取一处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}监狱设施，那里关押着大量{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}人员。然而，该设施受附近一处军事基地保护，我们一夺取监狱，他们就会对监狱动手，在让我们撤出那些人之前把这些建筑夷为瓦砾。我们会尽快调动自己的机甲与豹式，但在我们能让它们降落并撤出人员之前，我们需要你压制那座军事基地。ZH

column1: Acknowledged. Meyer, how long have we got before the bad guys respond?
column2: 明白了. 梅耶尔，在敌人反应之前我们，多久了?

column1: Argo, we've taken control of the facility. Our DropShips are on station; as soon as the area's secure we'll start evacuating our people.
column2: 阿尔戈，我们已控制设施。我们的空投艇已就位；区域一安全我们就开始撤离人员。ZH

column1: Commander, I'm seeing hostile defenders surrounding the enemy base.
column2: 指挥官，我看到敌方基地周围有敌对守军。ZH

column1: Our employer wants us to kill these guys. This mission isn't ending until they die.
column2: 我们的雇主想让我们干掉这些人。他们不死，这任务就不算结束。ZH

column1: Emergency Evacuation
column2: 紧急疏散

column1: I'm guessing these 'civilians' are some kind of covert operatives, for this much metal to be put on the field to extract them.
column2: 我猜这些"平民"其实是某种秘密特工，否则不会为了把他们撤出来而投入这么多钢铁到战场上。ZH

column1: Commander, this is an extremely time-sensitive mission and we're on a strict deadline, so I hope you can assist us. Our covert forces are poised to seize a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility where a large number of {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} civilians are being held prisoner. However, the facility is protected by a nearby military base, and as soon as we seize the prison, they'll move against it, and reduce those buildings to rubble before they let us extract those people. We'll be moving our own 'Mechs and Leopards in as quickly as we can but before we can land them and extract the civilians, we need you to pacify that military base.
column2: 指挥官，这是一个时间极为敏感的任务，我们期限很紧，所以希望你能协助。我们的隐蔽部队正准备夺取一处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}设施，那里关押着大量{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}平民。然而该设施受到附近一处军事基地的保护，我们一旦夺取监狱，他们就会采取行动，在允许我们撤离那些人之前把那些建筑轰成瓦砾。我们会尽快投入自己的机甲与豹式，但在我方着陆并撤出平民之前，我们需要你压制那座军事基地。ZH

column1: High Tide
column2: 洪水

column1: A 'major' force sounds like a whole lot of metal on the field. Expect a long slog, Commander, and maybe pack lasers instead of autocannons.
column2: 一支"主力"部队听起来意味着战场上会出现一大堆钢铁。预期会是一场漫长的苦战，指挥官，也许该多带激光器而不是自动炮。ZH

column1: Commander, we need your assistance in fending off an attack on one of our facilities. This base is a critical logistical center for us, primarily for food and medicine; if we lose it, our forces in the region will be hamstrung. A major {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} strike force has deployed to the region, and we've just gotten word that they've seized an auxiliary base near the logistics facility, and are using it as a staging point for a further assault. We need you to level that auxiliary base and cut off their offensive.
column2: 指挥官，我们需要你协助击退对我方一处设施的进攻。这座基地是我们的关键后勤中心，主要用于粮食与药品；如果失去它，我们在这个地区的部队将寸步难行。一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}大型打击部队已部署到该地区，而我们刚得到消息，他们夺取了后勤设施附近的一处辅助基地，并以此为跳板发动进一步进攻。我们需要你把那座辅助基地夷平，切断他们的攻势。ZH

column1: Commander, if we lose another building, this mission is over.
column2: 指挥官，如果我们失去了另一座建筑物，任务失败.

column1: Good kill, Commander.
column2: 好杀，指挥官.

column1: Leopard inbound, boss. Looks like more {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units on the field.
column2: 豹式即将进场，老板. 看来战场上又出现了更多{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队.

column1: Move in to make the pickup, Meyer. Commander, your evac zone is here.
column2: 让他们离开那里，梅耶尔. 指挥官，你的撤离区在这里.

column1: Some of the enemy forces are hanging back at their base, presumably to defend it from us.
column2: 一些敌军仍在基地，大概是为了防御他们的攻击.

column1: The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} has provided some of their own forces to support us.
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} 派出了自己的一些部队来支援我们。ZH

column1: The friendly facility is under fire, Commander. If we lose it, the mission is scrubbed.
column2: 我方设施正遭受攻击，指挥官. 要是丢了它，任务就泡汤了.

column1: We're entering the AO, boss, and my board just lit up like a Christmas tree. There's a whole lot of hostiles down there, folks.
column2: 我们正在进入行动区域，老大，我的面板亮得像圣诞树。下面有一大堆敌人，各位。ZH

column1: Given the framing, I think it's best we never investigate who these 'dear friends' are, or why they're locked up.
column2: 考虑到这个构陷，我想我们最好永远别去调查这些"亲爱的朋友"是谁，或者他们为什么被关起来。ZH

column1: Some of our favorite people are currently being held in a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} prison facility. We'd like to break them out and evacuate them, but the prison's protected by a nearby military base. We're very competent at prison breaks, but less experienced at defending bases from lances of military 'Mechs. That's where you come in! We'll seize control of the prison, and then you land and shoot anyone who tries to keep us from evacuating our dear friends. In fact, it would probably be best if you simply destroyed their base entirely. Wouldn't do to have them tracking us!
column2: 我们的一些好朋友目前被关押在{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的一处监狱设施中。我们想把他们救出来并撤离，但监狱受到附近一座军事基地的保护。我们非常擅长劫狱，但在抵御成队军用机甲守卫基地方面经验较少。这正是需要你的地方！我们会先夺取监狱的控制权，然后你降落并射杀任何试图阻止我们撤离挚友的人。事实上，干脆把他们的基地彻底摧毁可能最好。让他们追踪到我们可就不好了！ZH

column1: Acknowledged. Meyer, how much time have we got before the military base responds?
column2: 明白了. 梅耶尔，在军事基地做出反应之前，我们还有，多长时间?

column1: Right! We've taken control of the facility. Our evacuation DropShips are ready to start the evacuation once you've destroyed that base.
column2: 好！我们已经控制了该设施。你一摧毁那座基地，我们的撤离空投艇就准备开始撤离。ZH

column1: We'll be outnumbered and outmatched, Commander, but that's hardly a new experience for us.
column2: 我们会寡不敌众、火力也不及，指挥官，但这对我们来说不算什么新鲜事。ZH

column1: We've been able to infiltrate personnel into a contested region to take control of an abandoned base. We've brought the base's primary power and communications systems online, but in doing so, we've made an unfortunate discovery: a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force has done the same thing with a nearby facility. They're somewhat ahead of us in the process, and have their base's turrets online; they're also landing troops and 'Mechs to hold their new acquisition. Only one of us can control this area when we're finished; we'd like you to ensure that it's us.
column2: 我们已成功把人员渗透进一处争夺区，控制了一座废弃基地。我们已经让基地的主电力与通讯系统上线，但在此过程中，我们不幸发现：一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队对附近一处设施做了同样的事。他们在这过程中比我们领先一些，已经让自家基地的炮塔上线；他们还在投放部队与机甲来守住新到手的地盘。结束时只能有一方控制这片区域；我们希望你能确保是我们。ZH

column1: A new lance of enemy reinforcements has arrived.
column2: 一支新的敌方增援小队已经抵达.

column1: All right, Commander; we're already behind the competition here, so we'll need to move fast.
column2: 好，指挥官；我们在这里已经落后于竞争对手，所以得行动迅速。ZH

column1: Boom. One down, Commander.
column2: 轰. 干掉一个，指挥官.

column1: Commander, we've got a lance of enemy forces moving towards the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} base.
column2: 指挥官，有一支敌方小队正朝 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 基地移动。ZH

column1: Enemy reinforcements just arrived on the field, Commander.
column2: 敌人的增援刚刚到达，指挥官.

column1: That was their last structure, Commander. The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} base is rubble.
column2: 那是他们最后一座建筑了，指挥官. {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的基地已经成了一片废墟.

column1: They're coming in fast, don't let them get too close.
column2: 他们来得很快，别让他们靠得太近。ZH

column1: Watch out commander, more hostiles are arriving. They'll be landing in this area.
column2: 小心，指挥官，更多敌人正在赶来。他们将在这一带着陆。ZH

column1: Commander, this mission is... insane. And I don't say that lightly. We're going to take a serious beating on this one.
column2: 指挥官，这次任务……疯了。我说这话可不是随便说的。这一仗我们会挨得很惨。ZH

column1: Commander, we have a developing situation and need an unorthodox solution, which we're hoping your team can provide. Six hours ago, a heavily-armed {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} strike force landed near one of our research facilities and took control of it. That facility is stuffed with critical intelligence and research data, all of which is being accessed and transmitted off-planet right now. We simply don't have enough local firepower to dislodge them. We've got a plan, though. We're going to bait a third party into helping us destroy the base and its intel. You're the bait.
column2: 指挥官，我们出现了一个新情况，需要一个非常规的解决办法，希望你的团队能提供。六小时前，一支重武装的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}打击部队降落在我们一处研究设施附近并夺取了它。那座设施里塞满了关键情报与研究数据，而所有这些此刻正被读取并传输到行星之外。我们现有的本地火力根本不足以把他们赶走。不过我们有个计划。我们要引诱第三方来帮我们摧毁这座基地及其情报。你就是那个诱饵。ZH

column1: Commander, we lose another building, this mission is over.
column2: 指挥官，我们又失去了一栋建筑. 这次任务结束了.

column1: Hey, guys? What was that flash I just saw from the friendly base?
column2: 嘿，伙计们?，我刚刚在盟军基地看到的闪电是什么?

column1: More {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units, Commander. Just uh, just let me know if you need me to pull you out of there.
column2: 更多{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的部队，指挥官. 当你想离开那里时，请告诉我，嗯.

column1: Not helpful, Meyer. Stay on station to make the pickup once the base is down. Commander... good luck.
column2: 这没有帮助，梅耶尔. 等基地被摧毁后就进行接应. 指挥官……祝你好运.

column1: We're expecting the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces to begin their assault on this facility at any moment. If they destroy it, our employers lose their eyes on the operational area; they'll scrub the mission at that point.
column2: 我们预计{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队随时会开始进攻这处设施。如果他们摧毁了它，我们的雇主就失去了对行动区域的监视；到那时他们会取消任务。ZH

column1: Yeah, whose bullshit idea was this, anyway?
column2: 是啊. 这到底是谁出的馊主意?

column1: We've got to intercept 'Mechs, destroy a base, save a base... and there are base defense systems? Sounds like a mess.
column2: 我们得拦截机甲、摧毁一座基地、拯救一座基地……还有基地防御系统？听起来一团乱。ZH

column1: Commander, we've just received a distress signal from one of our facilities on the planet. A team of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} terrorists have seized control of the primary base, executed the base commander, and subverted the base's defense systems. Satellite imagery tells us they're preparing for an assault on the secondary base. We need a rapid response force to eliminate their assault team, and level the seized base. Our own forces are inbound but won't get there in time to save the secondary base.
column2: 指挥官，我们刚收到行星上一处设施发来的求救信号。一队{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}恐怖分子夺取了主基地的控制权，处决了基地指挥官，并破坏了基地的防御系统。卫星图像显示他们正准备突袭次基地。我们需要一支快速反应部队去消灭他们的突击队，并把被夺取的基地夷平。我们自己的部队正在赶来，但赶不上救下次基地。ZH

column1: The product of an aborted series of experiments into LAM technology, the Urbanmech LAM is not surprisingly; poorly suited for either role. Designed by the self proclaimed professor of Cluffs Stand, Mencius Horvat; using a mixture of stolen Urbanmech parts and Lostech recovered from throughout the Periphery. Slow by LAM standards and drastically under gunned by Urbanmech standards, this mech struggles to fill either role. That said, the shock factor of an Urbanmech LAM deployed against uninformed opponents, has allowed it a measure of success when used as a raider. Dual ER Mediums and a bevy of rockets provide a nasty punch at close quarters, but prove mediocre at longer ranges. The only known examples of this mech were were recovered by the DMI and were turned over to the NAIS, though their current status is unknown. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 作为 LAM 技术一系列中途夭折的实验的产物，Urbanmech LAM 哪一种角色都不适合，这一点并不令人意外。它由自称克拉夫斯站教授的门修斯·霍瓦特设计，材料是偷来的 Urbanmech 零件和从外围地区各地回收的失落科技。按 LAM 的标准它太慢，按 Urbanmech 的标准它的火力又严重不足，无论哪个角色都难以胜任。即便如此，把它派去对付毫无防备的对手时，其震撼效果让它在充当突袭者时取得了一定成功。双联增程中型激光加上一堆火箭，在近距离能打出凶狠的一击，但在较远距离上表现平平。已知仅存的几台此型机甲被 DMI 回收并移交给了 NAIS，不过它们目前的下落不明。特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column2: 你在战场上的事迹为你赢得了我的冠军锦标赛的邀请。加入我们，在竞技场中对阵外缘最凶悍的战士，占据你的一席之地！ZH

column2: 我有一份高度敏感的合约需要你立即处理。此事敏感到了无法在公开频道上讨论的程度。到安杜里恩公国来见我，我会把细节告诉你。ZH

column1: Hey, Boss. I've got a line on a really juicy opportunity out on Electra, but I need to check it out in person to be sure. Think you could authorize taking a little detour?
column2: 嘿，老大。我在伊莱克特拉上得到一条非常肥的机会的线索，但我得亲自去确认一下。你看能不能批准我们绕个小道？ZH

column1: You heard Lady Suiko. Let's put Luthendorff down, {COMMANDER.FirstName}.
column2: 你听到水子小姐的话了。{COMMANDER.FirstName}，让我们把卢滕多夫放倒。ZH

column1: My daughter will arrive shortly at a private compound, and Luthendorff is on the way to greet her. Intercept and eliminate this criminal. But be on guard—she has bodyguards with her, although I expect you to easily outmaneuver and outsmart them.
column2: 我女儿很快会抵达一处私人庄园，卢滕多夫正在前往迎接她的路上。拦截并消灭这个罪犯。但要提防——她身边带着保镖，不过我相信你能轻易地机动胜过、智取他们。ZH

column1: Ambush and Eliminate Luthendorff
column2: 伏击并消灭卢森道夫

column1: Destroy Luthendorff
column2: 消灭卢森道夫

column1: Prevent Luthendorff from Escaping
column2: 阻止卢森道夫逃跑

column1: Bold of you to charge for this kind of service, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}.
column2: 你有很多胆量，为这样的服务要钱，指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}.

column1: Luthendorff is getting away, Commander. Run her down!
column2: 卢森道夫要跑了，指挥官. 追上去！ZH

column1: Luthendorff will be forced to make her way through this pass. You can use that to catch her unawares.
column2: 卢森道夫不得不通过这个关口. 你可以利用这点打她个措手不及.

column1: Of course she does.
column2: 她当然会.

column1: Thanks for the pep talk, Lady Suiko. We can handle it from here.
column2: 感谢你的动员讲话，翠子夫人. 接下来就交给我们吧.

column2: 家族内讧 II

column2: 科琳娜·卢森道夫

column2: 中野翠子夫人

column1: Let's see what Lady Suiko's lance of geriatric MechWarriors can do.
column2: 让我们看看水子小姐那支“高龄机甲战士”小队能做什么。ZH

column1: Luthendorff will not escape death again, Commander. Don't expect an easy fight. This time she'll be prepared for us. I'm picking up multiple heavy contacts on my sensors. More scrap for Luthendorff's funeral pyre.
column2: 卢滕多夫不会再逃过一死，指挥官。别指望轻松的一战。这一次她会为我们做好准备。我在传感器上读到多个重型目标。又多了一批为卢滕多夫火葬堆添柴的废铁。ZH

column2: 摧毁卢滕多夫的部队

column2: 消灭卢森道夫和她的部队

column2: 确保翠子夫人存活

column1: Kill the comms. Enough talk.
column2: 切断通讯. 不必多言.

column1: So, where's Lady Suiko and her lance of Third Succession War vets? Think they had trouble waking up from a nap?
column2: 那么，隋子夫人和她那支第三次继承战争老兵的队伍在哪儿？你想他们是午睡醒不过来吗？ZH

column1: Well, let's see if we can hold off Lady Suiko's geriatric MechWarriors.
column2: 好吧，我们来看看能不能挡住隋子夫人那些老掉牙的机师。ZH

column1: Lady Suiko is inbound, and she's not alone. Her old war buddies are moving in fast-two lances of 'em. Keep in mind, we've got one goal: stop her from killing Luthendorff.
column2: 隋子夫人正在赶来，而且她不是一个人。她的老战友正快速靠拢——两支分队。记住，我们只有一个目标：阻止她杀死卢滕多夫。ZH

column1: Defeat Lady Suiko and Her Second Lance
column2: 击败翠子夫人和她的第二支小队

column1: Defend Luthendorff
column2: 保卫卢森道夫

column1: Defend the Surrounding Structures
column2: 保卫周围的建筑物

column1: Hold Out While Luthendorff Requests Reinforcements
column2: 坚守，直到卢森道夫的增援到达

column1: Did I not make myself clear? Poverty is a small price to pay to retain our honor.
column2: 可能我没说清楚?如果我们能保持我们的荣誉，那么贫穷是一个荒谬的代价.

column1: Escort them safely to the generators, and we can boost our defensive capability with those turrets activated. Good luck!
column2: 护送他们安全抵达发电机那里，一旦那些炮台启动，我们的防御能力就能提升. 祝你好运！ZH

column1: Not that I expect you to understand. Your only loyalty is to your bank account. Kill the comms.
column2: 我并不指望你能理解. 毕竟，你唯一的忠诚就是对你的银行账户. 结束通讯.

column1: So, Commander, you've proven that your word means nothing. No matter. My comrades are hardened veterans, the embodiment of discipline and loyalty.
column2: 那么，指挥官，你已经证明你的承诺一文不值。无所谓。我的同志都是久经沙场的老兵，是纪律与忠诚的化身。ZH
