column2: 好吧，这应该会很刺激.

column1: I've given your pilot a map of Men Lojowen, complete with the rough location of the Star League installation. I want you to get in there, brush aside any resistance, and loot whatever your BattleMechs can carry. You'll get your pay when my associates have the goods.
column2: 我已给你的机师一份门洛乔恩的地图，上面标有星盟设施的粗略位置。我要你进去，扫开任何抵抗，把你们的战斗机甲能搬走的都搬走。等我的同伙拿到货，你就拿钱。ZH

column1: Loot the Star League Stapler Factory
column2: 洗劫星际联盟订书机工厂

column2: 回收更多星际联盟时代的物资

column1: Unit Carrying the Star League-era Cache Must Survive
column2: 拥有明星联赛的单位必须生存

column1: According to Corbu's map, our Star League \"stapler factory\" should be somewhere just ahead of you. He also said that we shouldn't run up against anything more dangerous than a combat vehicle or two, but I'd take that with a grain of salt.
column2: 根据科尔布的地图，我们那个星盟"订书机工厂"应该就在你前方某处。他还说我们最多只会撞上一两辆战斗车辆，但这话我还是打点折扣听。ZH

column1: One Man's Trash II
column2: 他人之废 II

column1: Corbu's time-share is in a civilian housing development, not a military base. We're gonna have to hustle if we want to protect it.
column2: 科尔布的分时度假房在一处民用住宅区，不是军事基地。若想保护它，我们得赶紧。ZH

column1: The last time I checked, Binton and Modge had a bunch of combat vehicles in the streets around my time-share. Maybe a light 'Mech or two, I can't say for sure. Get 'em off my back, and then we'll conclude our business with the antique staplers.
column2: 我上次查看时，宾顿和莫奇在我分时住处周围的街上有一堆战斗车辆。也许还有一两台轻型机甲，我说不准。把他们从我的地盘上赶走，然后我们就可以用那些古董订书机了结我们的生意。ZH

column1: Destroy the hostile mercenaries
column2: 消灭敌方雇佣兵

column1: Protect All Condo Complex Buildings
column2: 保护所有财产

column1: Protect Ed Corbu's Time-Share Condominium
column2: 保护埃德·科尔布的分时公寓

column1: Eyes up, Modge. Corbu's pet mercenaries are here.
column2: 打起精神，莫奇。科尔布的宠物佣兵来了。ZH

column1: THERE IS NO TREASURE!
column2: 没有宝藏！ZH

column1: Binton and Modge were fighting against each other on Men Lojowen. They may be allies of convenience for now, but I'll bet that'll change when they've got the \"treasure\" in their sights.
column2: 宾顿与莫吉在门洛乔文互相厮杀。他们眼下也许是因为利益而结盟，但我打赌等“宝藏”出现在视野里时就会变。ZH

column1: I've told Binton and Modge that you're gonna drop their \"treasure\" in a field about a hundred klicks southeast of Louth Abbey. That should put you far enough away to avoid collateral damage, so feel free to go after 'em with whatever BattleMechs you like. Just be aware that there's nothing stopping them from doin' the same to you.
column2: 我已经告诉宾顿和莫奇，你要把他们那件"宝物"丢在劳斯修道院东南约一百公里外的一片田地里。这样你距离够远，可以避免附带损伤，所以尽管用你喜欢的任何战斗机甲去收拾他们。只是要知道，没有什么能阻止他们也这么对付你。ZH

column1: Destroy Hostile Mercenaries
column2: 消灭敌方雇佣兵

column1: Huh. Whaddya know? There they are.
column2: 呵，还真有. 箱子就在那儿.

column1: Remind me to smack Ed for ever having hired this guy.
column2: 提醒我以后绝对不能再雇这种疯子.

column2: 红色狩猎 I

column1: Gray Death
column2: 格雷死神

column1: This seems simple enough, which makes me nervous. I don't like when we're asked to defend \"research\" without knowing what the research is.
column2: 这看起来够简单，反而让我紧张。我不喜欢在我们不知道研究内容的情况下被要求去防守"研究"。ZH

column1: Commander, this installation is a vital part of Combine research efforts, and we need to ensure the enemy doesn't destroy it. We believe the opposing forces are a mercenary unit hired by our erstwhile allies in the Free Worlds League, and their intent is to disrupt the important work being done here. Your job will be to hold them off until they exhaust themselves, at which point we'll launch our own counterattack.
column2: 指挥官，这处设施是联合体研究工作的关键部分，我们必须确保敌人不会摧毁它。我们相信敌方部队是自由世界联盟（我们昔日的盟友）雇佣的一支雇佣兵，其意图是破坏这里正在进行的重要工作。你的任务将是顶住他们，直到他们力竭，届时我们会发起自己的反攻。ZH

column1: Defend the Draconis Combine Research Base
column2: 保卫天龙联合体研究基地

column1: Keep All Target Structures Standing
column2: 确保所有目标建筑不被摧毁

column1: Additionally, our communications are being disrupted by a ground installation. We can relay messages through the Leopard, but only over short distances.
column2: 此外，我们的通信正受到地面设施的干扰. 我们可以通过豹式中继消息，但范围受到严重限制.

column1: To be completely honest with you, I haven't the faintest idea what kind of research goes on here. Nevertheless, a credible threat has been made. Your opposition is a mercenary company using the rather grandiose name \"[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreGrayDeath],Gray Death Legion]].\"
column2: 老实跟你说，我完全不知道这里进行的是哪一类研究。不过，威胁是可信的。你的对手是一家雇佣兵公司，用着相当浮夸的名字——"[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreGrayDeath],灰死军团]]"。ZH

column1: Red Hunt II
column2: 红色狩猎 II

column1: The only way we get off this planet and find out what kind of double cross the Kuritans are pulling here is to rescue Carlyle and his people.
column2: 要想离开这颗星球并揭穿栗田的阴谋，唯一的方法就是救出卡莱尔和他的部下.

column1: It looks like we're both on the Kurita shit list, Commander. This situation is bad and getting worse. My people are pinned down by fire from the DEST forces, and we can't use our Leopard to get into orbit. We've evacuated the Fire Lance, but the Command Lance is still stuck on-world—which concerns me personally, because I'm part of the Command Lance and one of the people who's stuck. I want to get to the bottom of this mess, but I'm going to need your help.
column2: 看来我们俩都在栗田的黑名单上了，指挥官。这局面很糟，而且还在恶化。我的人被DEST部队的火力压制住，我们没法用豹式进入轨道。我们已经撤离了火力分队，但指挥分队还困在行星上——这让我个人很担心，因为我就是指挥分队的一员，也是被困的人之一。我想把这团乱麻查个水落石出，但我需要你的帮助。ZH

column1: Defend Grayson Carlyle's Forces
column2: 保卫格雷森·卡莱尔的部队

column1: Destroy Additional DEST Team
column2: 摧毁额外的DEST部队

column1: Destroy DEST Team
column2: 摧毁DEST部队

column1: Another DEST lance just deployed, Commander. Getting hot down there.
column2: 又一支DEST机甲小队刚刚部署，指挥官. 地面战况正在升温.

column1: Carlyle. This is Darius Oliveira, XO of the Argo. We need some answers about what just happened.
column2: 卡莱尔。我是达里乌斯·奥利维拉，阿戈号的执行官。关于刚才发生的事，我们需要一些答案。ZH

column1: Duke Ricol sends his regards, Carlyle.
column2: 里科尔公爵向你问好，卡莱尔.

column1: Red Hunt III
column2: 红色狩猎 III

column1: As long as Carlyle's people can handle their part of this operation, we shouldn't have any trouble destroying the base.
column2: 只要卡莱尔的人能处理好他们那部分，我们摧毁基地应该没有麻烦。ZH

column1: Commander, we're prepared to start our assault on the ComStar facility. Before we make our move, we need you to take out that military base, so that DEST can't coordinate a response. Once that base is rubble, give us the all clear. Then we'll commence our attack, break in there, and broadcast the signal to Tor.
column2: 指挥官，我们已准备好对通讯之星设施发起进攻。动手之前，我们需要你拔掉那座军事基地，这样DEST就无法协调应对。基地一旦变成瓦砾，就通知我们。随后我们将发起攻击，突入其中，并向托尔广播信号。ZH

column1: Destroy Base Defenders
column2: 摧毁基地的防御者

column1: Destroy Kurita Military Base
column2: 摧毁房子栗田军事基地

column1: Destroy Kurita Reinforcements
column2: 摧毁房屋栗田增援部队

column1: Destroy the Kurita Military Base
column2: 摧毁栗田军事基地

column1: Carlyle, you are clear to begin your assault.
column2: Carlyle，你可以开始你的攻击了.

column1: Roger that. Here comes some ass kicking, courtesy of the Gray Death Legion.
column2: 收到. 接下来就让格雷死神军团来大显身手吧.

column1: The Kurita base is just ahead, Commander. All we have to do is get in there, level the place, and get out again.
column2: 栗田基地就在前方，指挥官. 我们要做的就是冲进去，把那地方夷为平地，然后再撤出来.

column1: As long as Carlyle's people can handle their part of this operation, we shouldn't have any trouble taking the base.
column2: 只要卡莱尔的人能处理好他们那部分，我们拿下这座基地应该不会有麻烦。ZH

column1: Commander, we're starting our assault. As soon as we take out the Combine military base, the Kuritans will lose their ability to coordinate a response. That's your cue to move in and capture the ComStar facility, shut down the jamming gear DEST set up there, and get our signal broadcasting. We've got a pretty big window before Tor leaves again, so the only hurry is that our DEST friends aren't going to sit on their hands after we start shooting at them.
column2: 指挥官，我们开始进攻了。我们一摧毁联合体的军事基地，栗田人就会失去协调应对的能力。那时你就该行动，夺取康星设施，关停DEST在那里设置的干扰设备，让我们的信号播出去。在托尔再次离开之前我们有相当大的时间窗口，所以唯一要赶的就是：我们一开始朝他们开火，我们那些DEST朋友就不会干坐着。ZH

column1: Destroy any additional DEST forces
column2: 摧毁所有DEST增援部队

column1: Destroy DEST defensive force
column2: 摧毁DEST防御部队

column1: Destroy the DEST Reinforcements
column2: 摧毁DEST增援部队

column1: Scout the ComStar Facility
column2: 侦察 ComStar 设施

column1: Occupy the facility and take care of any additional DEST forces that show up. Good luck, Commander.
column2: 占领设施并清除所有出现的DEST增援部队. 祝你好运，指挥官.

column1: Shit. We dropped the ball on this one, Commander.
column2: 该死. 我们搞砸了，指挥官.

column1: The Kurita military outpost is rubble, Commander. You're clear to begin your assault. Good luck.
column2: 栗田军事前哨已成瓦砾，指挥官。你可以放心开始进攻了。祝好运。ZH

column1: You should be able to see the ComStar facility from here, Commander. Looks like DEST got the base turrets running, as we suspected.
column2: 你应该能从这里看到ComStar设施，指挥官. 看来DEST果然启动了基地的炮台.

column1: Emerald Dawn Outrider
column2: 翡翠黎明先驱

column1: This all sounds pretty straightforward, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. Keep your eyes open, all the same.
column2: 听起来相当明确，{COMMANDER.FirstName}. 但务必保持警惕.

column1: Matis \"Bishop\" Crenshaw and his retinue are en route to a meeting with Sian Triumphant, a satellite organization of the Emerald Dawn. Intercept Crenshaw's BattleMech, destroy it, and contact my DropShip to confirm the kill.
column2: 马蒂斯"主教"克伦肖及其随从正在前往与"西安胜利者"会面的途中——那是翠绿黎明的一个卫星组织。拦截克伦肖的战斗机甲，将其摧毁，然后联系我的空投艇确认击杀。ZH

column1: Destroy Emerald Dawn Outriders
column2: 消灭翡翠黎明先驱

column2: 摧毁翡翠黎明先锋部队

column2: 消灭马蒂斯·“主教”·克伦肖

column2: 前往撤离区

column1: CONNECTION LOST.
column2: 连接中断.

column1: Does the timing of that feel a little suspicious to anyone else, or is it just me?
column2: 时间对任何人来说都是西班牙式的还是只是我自己?

column1: I've been picking up sporadic hits on the Leopard's sensors, Commander. Lady Cunningham was right; Crenshaw is definitely moving through this AO.
column2: 我在豹式的传感器上不断读到零散的信号，指挥官。坎宁安女士说得对；克伦肖确实正在穿过这一行动区域。ZH

column1: Scratch one Emerald Dawn combat lance.
column2: 解决一支来自翡翠黎明的机甲小队.

column1: So much for keeping in touch with our client.
column2: 这下跟雇主保持联络的计划也泡汤了.

column1: Hearts and Minds II
column2: 民心 II

column1: Emerald Dawn Irregular
column2: 翡翠黎明民兵

column1: Sometimes you're left with nothing but bad options. This is one of those times, but we're professionals, and it's on us to handle it.
column2: 有时你只剩下糟糕的选项。这就是那种时候，但我们是专业人士，这活儿该我们扛。ZH

column1: Tiesa \"Navaja\" Norkus has holed up in the Emerald Dawn's most heavily fortified stronghold, and she's using a number of civilian hostages as human shields. Unfortunately, there isn't much that we can do for those people; Lady Cunningham has made it very clear that eliminating the Emerald Dawn's leadership is imperative, and it'll be impossible for us to take out Norkus without incurring collateral damage.
column2: 蒂莎"剃刀"诺库斯窝藏在翠绿黎明防御最严密的据点里，并用多名平民人质作为人盾。不幸的是，我们为那些人做不了什么；坎宁安女士已经非常明确地表示，除掉翠绿黎明的领导层是必须的，而我们不可能在不造成附带损伤的情况下拿下诺库斯。ZH

column1: Destroy Emerald Dawn Irregulars
column2: 摧毁翡翠黎明非正规军

column1: Destroy Emerald Dawn Stronghold
column2: 摧毁翡翠黎明据点

column1: Destroy the Emerald Dawn's Stronghold
column2: 摧毁翡翠黎明的据点

column1: Eliminate Emerald Dawn Garrison
column2: 消灭翡翠黎明守备部队

column1: Your Davion masters aren't going to like this, scum. There are two dozen flag-waving Federation citizens in here who're gonna wind up in pieces if you don't stand down now.
column2: 你们的达维昂主子不会喜欢这个的，渣滓。这里面有两打挥舞旗帜的联邦公民，你要是不放下武器，他们就会变成碎块。ZH

column1: Even if we can't cut the head off the Emerald Dawn, we should be able to inflict a lot of damage.
column2: 即便我们无法斩掉翠绿黎明的头颅，也应该能造成大量损伤。ZH

column1: We may not be able to take out Tiesa Norkus, but at least we can contain her. If she wants to hide behind human shields, fine—let her hide. We'll do as much damage to the Emerald Dawn as we can, and when Lady Cunningham's DropShip touches down, she can handle the hostage negotiations.
column2: 我们也许无法除掉蒂莎·诺库斯，但至少能困住她。如果她想躲在人盾后面，行——就让她躲着。我们要尽可能重创翠绿黎明，等坎宁安女士的空投艇降落，她可以处理人质谈判。ZH

column1: Destroy Emerald Dawn Units
column2: 摧毁翡翠黎明的单位

column1: Destroy Sian Triumphant Forces
column2: 消灭仙安凯旋的部队

column1: Keeping your distance, Commander? Good choice. You get any closer and I'll start throwing these traitors out a 30th-floor window. They'll have plenty of time to regret their mistakes before they splatter against the pavement.
column2: 保持距离，指挥官？明智的选择。你再靠近一点，我就把这些叛徒从30层楼的窗户扔出去。他们在摔上人行道之前会有充足时间后悔自己的错误。ZH

column1: We're talking about House Steiner here. Considering the context, \"scout\" may not mean what we think it means.
column2: 我们说的是施泰纳家族。考虑到语境，“侦察”可能不是我们想的意思。ZH

column1: For your first deployment, you will rendezvous with Azura \"Cheval\" Damestroir of the Mitchel Planetary Militia. She and her lance have been scout-hunting in northern Gauthier's wealthy Museum District, and it appears that they've caught a Lyran scout. Assist her lance in defeating it, then proceed to your next rendezvous point.
column2: 你的首次部署，你将与米切尔行星民兵的艾祖拉"谢瓦尔"·达梅斯特罗尔会合。她和她的分队一直在北加蒂埃富裕的博物馆区猎杀侦察兵，看起来他们逮住了一名莱兰侦察兵。协助她的分队击败它，然后前往下一个会合点。ZH

column1: Destroy Steiner Reinforcement Lance
column2: 摧毁施泰纳增援机甲

column1: Destroy Steiner Units
column2: 摧毁施泰纳单位

column1: Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. Lieutenant Azura Damestroir here. We appreciate the assistance, because we're gonna need it.
column2: 指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}。我是艾祖拉·达梅斯特罗尔中尉。感谢你的协助，因为我们确实需要。ZH

column1: These Lyrans are packing too much heat, Commander. Lieutenant Damestroir and her lance have been destroyed.
column2: 这些天琴人的火力太猛了，指挥官. 戴米斯托尔中尉及其小队已全军覆没.

column1: Siegebreaker II
column2: 破围者 II

column1: \"Former militia member and paroled felon.\" I think I'm getting why Cheval doesn't trust her.
column2: 前民兵成员、已假释的重罪犯。我想我开始明白谢瓦尔为什么不信任她了。ZH

column1: Your next objective is in Jessup Downs, on the far side of Gauthier. Your point of contact, a former militia member and paroled felon who operates under the callsign \"Jailbird,\" has been holding the Downs with no outside support for nearly a month. She has reported signs of a heavy Steiner patrol lance moving through the area. I need you to assist her in bringing down that patrol.
column2: 你的下一个目标在加蒂埃远侧的杰瑟普丘陵。你的接头人是一名前民兵成员、已假释的重罪犯，代号"狱鸟"，她在几乎没有外部支援的情况下守住了丘陵将近一个月。她报告说发现一支施泰纳重型巡逻分队正穿过该地区。我需要你协助她击溃那支巡逻队。ZH

column1: Destroy Additional Steiner Forces
column2: 摧毁额外的施泰纳部队

column1: Eliminate Steiner Heavy Patrol
column2: 消灭重型施泰纳巡逻队

column1: Eliminate the Steiner Heavy Patrol
column2: 消灭施泰纳重型巡逻队

column1: Beautiful work, Commander! Scratch one Steiner heavy patrol!
column2: 出色的工作，指挥官！重型施泰纳巡逻队已成为历史！ZH

column1: Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. We've been waiting for you. Welcome to Jessup Downs, the unofficial armpit of Gauthier.
column2: 指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}。我们一直在等你。欢迎来到杰瑟普丘陵，加蒂埃非官方的胳肢窝。ZH

column1: For some reason, the Lyrans have seen fit to send one of their heavy patrols in our direction. We could use your help to eliminate it.
column2: 出于某种原因，天琴人向我们派出了一支重型巡逻队. 我们需要你的帮助来消灭它.

column1: Jailbird is down, Commander. Repeat, Jailbird is down.
column2: “监狱鸟”倒下了，指挥官. 重复一遍:“监狱鸟”倒下了.

column1: Mission successful, Commander. Time to get out of here.
column2: 任务成功，指挥官. 该撤离这里了.

column1: On what charge?
column2: 以什么罪名?

column1: Roger that, Oliveira. Jailbird out.
column2: 收到，奥利维拉.“监狱鸟”完毕.

column1: Siegebreaker III
column2: 破围者 III

column1: I'm glad we're gonna have Cheval and her lance on our side for this, but we should keep our eyes open for Jailbird. She didn't sound like she was planning on sitting this one out quietly.
column2: 我很高兴这次有谢瓦尔和她的分队站在我们这边，但我们得留心'狱鸟'。听她的口气，她可没打算安安静静地缺席这场。ZH

column1: Even with a portion of Dobrescu's sentries out chasing shadows in the Museum District, the Ziegelhaus will be heavily defended. You'll need to hit the structure hard, while at the same time protecting Militia HQ from an expected Steiner counterattack. Good hunting, Commander. Show Hauptmann-General Dobrescu that his excesses will not be tolerated.
column2: 即便多布雷库已把部分哨兵派去博物馆区追查虚影，齐格尔豪斯仍会有重兵防守。你需要在猛攻该建筑的同时，保护民兵总部免遭预料之中的施泰纳反攻。狩猎愉快，指挥官。让豪普特曼将军多布雷库明白，他的暴行不会被容忍。ZH

column1: Destroy Steiner Attackers
column2: 摧毁施泰纳攻击者

column1: Destroy Steiner Garrison
column2: 摧毁施泰纳要塞

column1: Destroy the Ziegelhaus While Protecting Militia HQ
column2: 摧毁砖房并保护民兵总部

column1: Destroy the Ziegelhaus
column2: 摧毁砖房

column1: Heads up, Commander: another Steiner lance has just entered the AO.
column2: 注意，指挥官: 又一个施泰纳小队刚刚进入行动区域.

column1: I see you, little militiamen. You think to come for me, eh? I salute your courage, but your efforts are doomed to failure. And when my BattleMechs crush you under their feet, I will tighten my grasp around Gauthier. You will surrender what is mine, or your city will starve.
column2: 我瞧见你们了，小民兵们. 想打我的主意? 我佩服你们的勇气，但你们的努力注定徒劳. 当我的战斗机甲把你们碾在脚下时，我必将收紧对高蒂尔的掌控. 要么乖乖交出属于我的东西，要么眼睁睁看着你们的城市陷入饥荒.

column1: Just keep an eye on the militia buildings until you leave the field. You know, just in case.
column2: 只需在撤离战场前确保民兵建筑安全. 你知道的——以防万一.

column1: Look out, Commander. Another wave of Steiner units just appeared on my screen.
column2: 注意，指挥官. 又一批施泰纳部队出现在我的屏幕上.

column1: Roger that, Cheval. Keep us posted on your situation, and call out if you need help.
column2: 收到，“骑士”. 随时通报你们的情况，如需支援请呼叫.

column1: Structure down, Commander! Press on, and that whole fortification is history!
column2: 结构已摧毁，指挥官！继续，整个防御工事即将成为历史！ZH

column1: The Ziegelhaus is down, Commander. Repeat, the Ziegelhaus is down.
column2: 砖房已被摧毁，指挥官. 重复一遍: 砖房已被摧毁.

column1: This is it, Commander—our chance to break the siege. I hope that your people are ready for this, because we may never get another opportunity.
column2: 就是这一下了，指挥官——我们打破围困的机会。我希望你的人为此准备好了，因为我们可能再也不会得到另一个机会。ZH

column1: I'm glad that we're gonna have Jailbird and her lance on our side for this, but we should keep our eyes open for Cheval. She didn't sound like she was planning on sitting this one out quietly.
column2: 我很高兴这次有狱鸟和她的分队站在我们这边，但我们得留心谢瓦尔。听她的口气，她可没打算安安静静地缺席这场。ZH

column1: Destroy {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Attackers
column2: 消灭{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}进攻部队

column1: Appreciate it, Jailbird. Call out if you need our help.
column2: 谢了，“监狱鸟”. 需要支援就喊话.

column1: This is it, Commander. There's a gang of big metal bastards between us and Dobrescu, and then we'll have a mountain of steel to get through. But I think we can do it.
column2: 就是这一下了，指挥官。我们和多布雷库之间有一帮大金属混蛋，然后还有一座钢铁之山要穿过去。但我觉得我们能做到。ZH

column1: We're going it alone on this one, so we shouldn't have any infighting to worry about. That's a good thing, because we're gonna be outnumbered enough as it is.
column2: 这一票我们得独自干，所以不用担心内讧。这是好事，因为我们已经够寡不敌众了。ZH

column1: A friendly structure is taking damage, Commander. We may need to allocate more resources to protecting Militia HQ.
column2: 友方建筑正在受损，指挥官. 我们可能需要调拨更多资源来保护民兵指挥部.

column1: They can handle it. Our people are professionals, and we can trust them. That puts them a step ahead of Cheval and Jailbird.
column2: 他们能应付. 我们的员工都是专业人士，值得信赖. 这使他们比“骑士”和“监狱鸟”更可靠.

column1: This is it, Commander. I'm picking up a lot of sensor activity around the Ziegelhaus. Our lance is in for a hell of a fight.
column2: 就是这一下了，指挥官。我在齐格尔豪斯周围读到大量传感器活动。我们分队要打一场恶仗。ZH

column1: When Lady Helen gives Yamaguchi what he wants, we get paid. Let's get to it, Commander.
column2: 等海伦女士给了山口他想要的，我们就能拿到报酬。开始动手吧，指挥官。ZH

column1: Commander Yuetu and her Red Hare Irregulars have proven an intolerable threat to my interests and to the future of House Khulan. I need you to hunt her down and destroy her BattleMech, an \"Orion,\" I believe it's called. Smash it to pieces and bring me proof of Yuetu's death, and I will lend Shugo Yamaguchi my support.
column2: 月兔指挥官和她的红兔非正规军已被证明是对我利益和库兰家族未来的不可容忍威胁。我需要你追猎她并摧毁她的战斗机甲——我想它叫"猎户座"。把它砸成碎片，并把月兔死亡的证据带给我，我就会把支持借给山口修护。ZH

column1: Destroy Red Hare Irregular Mercenaries
column2: 消灭赤兔军的雇佣兵

column1: Eliminate Commander Yuetu and Escape
column2: 消灭月兔指挥官并撤离

column1: Eliminate Commander Yuetu
column2: 消灭月兔指挥官

column1: Eliminate Red Hare Irregular Reinforcements
column2: 消灭赤兔军的增援

column1: Target down, Commander.  A nice, clean kill.
column2: 目标已倒下，指挥官. 漂亮一击，干净利落.

column1: Wait. Your mother?
column2: 等一下. 你妈妈?

column1: We still may be able to catch up with her ejection pod if you hurry.
column2: 如果动作快点，我们或许还能追上她的逃生舱.

column1: Well, she sounds confident.
column2: 嗯，她听起来很自信.

column1: We're getting an incoming transmission, Commander. Looks like our target has something to say.
column2: 我们有来电通讯，指挥官。看来我们的目标有话要说。ZH

column1: Succession II
column2: 继承人 II

column1: Lady Yvonne \"Yuetu\" Khulan
column2: “月兔”胡兰夫人

column1: Destroy Red Hare Irregular Reinforcements
column2: 消灭赤兔军的增援部队

column1: We promised Shugo Yamaguchi we'd do this. May as well get it over with.
column2: 我们答应过山口修护要做这件事。不如就把它办了吧。ZH

column1: The vile mercenary Yuetu is on her last legs. Cut them out from under her! Safeguard my beloved son, and prevent our enemies from destroying House Khulan. If you do, I will see to Reynauld's needs, and he in turn will see to yours.
column2: 那卑劣的雇佣兵月兔已经走投无路了。把她脚下的路砍断！保护我心爱的儿子，阻止我们的敌人摧毁库兰家族。如果你做到，我会照顾雷诺德的需要，而他则会照顾你的。ZH

column1: Assassinate Lady Yvonne \"Yuetu\" Khulan
column2: 刺杀“月兔”胡兰夫人

column1: Destroy Red Hare Irregular Forces
column2: 消灭赤兔军部队

column1: Prevent Yuetu from Escaping
column2: 阻止月兔逃跑

column1: I'm setting you down at Yuetu's last known coordinates, Commander. She should be close.
column2: 我把你投放在月兔最后一次已知坐标，指挥官。她应该就在附近。ZH

column1: We're taking a gamble on this one, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. But given our options, it's one that I can live with.
column2: 这一票我们是在赌，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。但考虑到我们的选项，这是我愿意承受的一场赌。ZH

column1: You'll find my brother waiting for you at the Red Roost. It looks like a commercial office park, but don't be fooled. The structure is reinforced to withstand military payloads. Engage my brother's security team and raze the Red Roost. Let his stronghold serve as his tomb!
column2: 我弟弟会在红鸡舍等你。它看着像个商业办公园区，但别被骗了。那结构经过加固，能承受军用弹药。与我弟弟的安保队交战，把红鸡舍夷为平地。让他的据点成为他的坟墓！ZH

column1: Destroy Bodyguard Reinforcements
column2: 消灭保镖增援部队

column1: Destroy Lord Angus Khulan's Stronghold
column2: 摧毁安格斯·库兰领主的据点

column1: Destroy the Red Roost
column2: 摧毁红公鸡

column1: Looks like we're in the right place, Commander. Lord Angus Khulan is hailing us.
column2: 看来我们来对地方了，指挥官。安格斯·库兰领主正在呼叫我们。ZH

column1: You can thank us by lending Shugo Yamaguchi your support, like you promised you would.
column2: 你可以通过向山口修吾提供支持来表示感谢——就像你承诺的那样.

column1: Basilisk Jackson
column2: 巴吉里斯克·杰克逊

column1: Jake Saito
column2: 斋藤杰克

column1: An Urbie is basically a walking dustbin with a big gun. That weapon packs a hell of a punch, but it's only so long till it's a paperweight. Keep an eye on those heat gauges, {COMMANDER.FirstName}.
column2: 城市仔基本上就是个会走路的垃圾桶配一门大炮。那武器打击力惊人，但迟早会变成一个镇纸。盯紧那些热量表，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。ZH

column1: Welcome to my Tournament, Commander. Here you will prove your mettle against the Periphery's fiercest champions. Today, your MechWarriors will demonstrate their worth using only the simplest of tools: the UrbanMech. Like a huntsman's spear, it is an instrument with a single purpose. Wield it skillfully, and ascend into triumph.
column2: 欢迎来到我的锦标赛，指挥官。在此你将与外缘最凶悍的冠军们较量本事。今天，你的机师们将只用最简单的工具来证明自己的价值：城市机甲。它就像猎人的长矛，是一件只有单一用途的器具。娴熟地挥舞它，登上胜利之巅。ZH

column1: Win the first round of the Tournament
column2: 赢得锦标赛第一轮胜利

column1: Mencius Horvat
column2: 孟修斯·霍瓦特

column1: Defeat Professor Horvat and Win the Tournament of Champions
column2: 击败霍瓦特教授并赢得冠军赛

column1: Calamar Gigante
column2: 卡拉马·吉甘特

column1: She got through that entire briefing without saying, \"The hunter will become the hunted.\" I'm pleasantly surprised.
column2: 她整场简报下来居然没说过"猎人将成为猎物"。这倒是让我惊喜。ZH

column1: Eliminate Professor Mencius Horvat
column2: 消灭孟修斯·霍瓦特教授

column1: You heard the man. Let's go make ourselves useful.
column2: 你听到他的话了。咱们去干点正事。ZH

column1: For your first deployment, you will take the field alongside Ombra and the rest of Bravo Lance. Together, you will sweep the AO for hostiles, eliminating any Capellan units you find along the way. Bravo Lance has endured a great deal of punishment over the past few months and will need your help to come through this deployment in one piece.
column2: 在你第一次出击时，你将与Ombra和Bravo小队的其他成员一起上战场. 你们将共同清扫敌军，消灭途中遇到的任何卡佩拉单位. Bravo小队在过去的几个月中承受了巨大的损失，这次任务将需要你的帮助，确保他们能顺利完成，并完好无损地回归.

column1: Destroy Liao Invasion Force
column2: 歼灭廖氏侵略军

column1: Destroy Liao Reinforcements
column2: 摧毁廖氏援军

column1: Eliminate Steiner Strike Team
column2: 消灭施泰纳突击小队

column1: Escort Bravo Lance to Evac Point
column2: 护送Bravo小队到撤离点

column1: Support and Protect Bravo Lance
column2: 支援并保护Bravo小队

column1: Capellan reinforcements?
column2: 卡佩拉的增援?

column1: Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. Please contact me when you reach a safe altitude. We need to talk.
column2: 指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}. 请在达到安全高度后立即联系我. 我们需要谈谈.

column1: Here we are, XO—scenic New Jakobstad, the shiniest combat zone on Fagerholm. I've got Bravo Lance on the comms, and their Drop Pods are prepared to launch. Are you reading us, Ombra?
column2: 我们到了，副官——风景如画的新雅各布斯塔德，法格霍尔姆最闪亮的战区。布拉沃小队在通讯里，他们的投放舱已准备发射。能听到我们吗，翁布拉？ZH

column1: Lyrans. It looks like House Steiner has decided to join the party.
column2: 天琴人. 看起来施泰纳家族也决定加入派对了.

column1: No problem, Viscacha. Force Commander Singh will be pleased that you made it through.
column2: 没问题，兔鼠. 辛格司令会很高兴，你做到了.

column1: The AO is clear, everybody. All hostile contacts down.
column2: 行动区域已清理. 所有敌人都被消灭了.

column1: Prototype II
column2: 原型 II

column1: Let's make this strike quickly, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. Bravo Lance will be holding off the Capellans while we work, and I don't want to leave them out there any longer than I have to.
column2: 我们快点打完这一击，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。布拉沃分队会在我们干活时拖住卡佩兰人，我不想让他们在外面多待一分钟。ZH

column1: According to Ombra, a Black Caldera convoy has been scheduled to pass through the badlands north of New Jakobstad. Engage the convoy and destroy it. Bravo Lance will then interface with the command vehicle's black box to obtain the location of the Raven prototype, as well as the R&D facility Black Caldera has been using to reverse engineer it.
column2: 据翁布拉说，一支黑破火山口车队已安排要穿过新雅各布斯塔德北部的荒地。与车队交战并将其摧毁。布拉沃分队随后会接入指挥车辆的黑匣子，获取渡鸦原型机的位置，以及黑破火山口一直用来逆向工程它的研发设施。ZH

column1: Destroy Black Caldera Reinforcements
column2: 摧毁黑色火山口的增援部队

column1: Destroy the Black Caldera Convoy
column2: 摧毁黑色火山口车队

column1: Black Caldera BattleMechs down, Commander. Focus your fire on those transports!
column2: 黑色火山口的战斗机甲已被击毁，指挥官. 集中火力攻击那些空投艇！ZH

column1: Okay, Commander. According to Ombra, this convoy will be carrying a black box with data on the locations of the stolen Raven and Black Caldera Defense's secret R&D lab.
column2: 好，指挥官。据翁布拉说，这支车队将携带一个黑匣子，里面有被盗渡鸦以及黑破火山口防务秘密研发实验室位置的数据。ZH

column1: Our window of opportunity is closing, Commander. You need to stop those transports before they depart the AO.
column2: 留给我们的时间不多了，指挥官. 你需要在那两艘空投艇离开任务区域之前阻止它们.

column1: Prototype III
column2: 原型 III

column1: Ombra died for this, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. It's on us to make sure that her sacrifice counts for something.
column2: 翁布拉为此而死，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。我们必须确保她的牺牲有意义。ZH

column1: According to the intel we found, Black Caldera Defense is storing their stolen Raven prototype at an old armory in southern New Jakobstad. We need to capture the base and recover the prototype. Conqueror, Viscacha, and Peregrine will be standing by to carry out the second half of the operation when we're done.
column2: 根据我们找到的情报，黑破火山口防务把他们偷来的渡鸦原型机存放在新雅各布斯塔德南部的一处旧军械库里。我们需要夺取基地并回收原型机。征服者、毛丝鼠和游隼将待命，等我们完成前半段后执行行动的后半段。ZH

column1: Capture the Armory to Recover the Prototype Raven
column2: 占领军械库，找回“渡鸦”原型机

column1: Destroy the Black Caldera Garrison
column2: 摧毁黑色火山口驻军

column1: Eliminate Black Caldera Reinforcements
column2: 消灭黑色火山口的增援部队

column1: Recover the Prototype Raven
column2: 夺回“渡鸦”原型机

column1: Scout the Black Caldera Armory
column2: 侦察黑色火山口的军械库

column1: Okay, Commander. According to our intel, the Raven is being stored in a dilapidated armory in this part of the city. The OpFor's unit strength is unknown, but I bet it'll be somewhere between \"a lot\" and \"way too much.\"
column2: 好的，指挥官。据我们的情报，那台渡鸦存放在城中这一片的一座破败军械库里。敌方兵力不明，但我打赌大概在“很多”到“多得离谱”之间。ZH

column1: Prototype IV
column2: 原型 IV

column1: Handle this and we're done here, {COMMANDER.FirstName}.
column2: 把这事办完我们就完事了，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。ZH

column1: According to the intel we found, Black Caldera's hardened R&D facility is protected by a phalanx of LRM batteries. Using the Raven's unique capabilities, you will protect Bravo Lance from these weapons while leading them to destroy the facility.
column2: 根据我们找到的情报，黑破火山口的加固研发设施由一排LRM炮组保护。利用渡鸦的独特能力，你将在带领布拉沃分队摧毁该设施时，保护他们免受这些武器的攻击。ZH

column1: Destroy the Black Caldera R&D Facility
column2: 摧毁黑色火山口研究实验室

column1: Good riddance.
column2: 幸运的是.

column1: This is it, Commander. The Black Caldera facility should lie just ahead of us.
column2: 就是这里，指挥官. Black Caldera的设施应该就在我们前方.

column1: Let's hope this heist works out the way Yang said that it would.
column2: 但愿这次劫案能像杨说的那样顺利。ZH

column1: Wallo's got a mercenary company on retainer to protect his private aerospace hangar, the imaginatively named \"Security Solutions, Inc.\" I looked 'em up, and they're the real deal—they've got combat vehicles, BattleMechs, the works. But we'll have the element of surprise on our side, given that Wallo's never heard of us. That's something, right?
column2: 瓦洛雇了一家雇佣兵公司常驻保护他的私人航空机库，名字起得很有想象力，叫"安保解决方案公司"。我查过他们，他们是真家伙——有战斗车辆、战斗机甲，全套。但我们会有奇袭之利，因为瓦洛从没听说过我们。这也算点东西，对吧？ZH

column1: Capture the Hangar and Eliminate Wallo's Security Detail
column2: 夺取机库并消灭沃洛的安保队

column1: Scout the Hangar
column2: 侦察机库

column1: The hangar is defenseless, and it looks like Graves is taking the bait. Long-range sensors are picking up activity out by his showroom.
column2: 机库已毫无防备，格雷夫斯似乎上钩了. 远程传感器探测到他的展厅外有动静.

column1: The hangar's just ahead, Commander. I'm picking up a lot of BattleMech activity out front.
column2: 机库就在前方，指挥官。我在门口读到大量战斗机甲活动。ZH

column1: Yang Virtanen's Big Score II
column2: 杨·维尔塔宁的大收获 II

column1: Let's protect that merchandise, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. It's what we're doing this for, after all.
column2: 保护好那批货物，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。毕竟我们就是为这个来的。ZH

column1: Okay, Boss! We've got the hot rods, and we're on our way to the LZ. Did I mention that I still hate rumble seats? Boy, do I ever! You'd better get on the comms to guide us through this—we're moving at a solid clip, but I suspect we're being followed…
column2: 好的，老板！热车已经到手，我们正在前往着陆点。我说过我还是讨厌简易座椅吗？天哪，我真是太讨厌了！你最好用通讯指引我们穿过这一带——我们跑得挺快，但我怀疑有人跟着我们……

column1: Destroy Graves's Security Team
column2: 消灭格雷夫斯的安保小队

column1: Eliminate Paladin Protection LLC reinforcements
column2: 消灭圣骑士安保LLC的增援部队

column1: Your Entire Lance must survive
column2: 你的整个小队必须存活

column1: Commander, we've got problems down here. Graves's security team is closing in on us, and we're gonna have to fight our way out.
column2: 指挥官，我们这边出事了。格雷夫斯的安保小队正逼近我们，我们得杀出一条路。ZH

column1: Okay, Boss! We've got the monster trucks, and we're slugging our way to the LZ. Did I mention that I still hate rumble seats? Boy, do I ever! You'd better get on the comms to guide us through this; we're trudging along at a steady pace, but we're about to have company…
column2: 好，老大！我们弄到怪兽卡车了，正一路轰着往着陆区去。我说过我讨厌颠簸座吗？天哪，我可真是讨厌！你最好赶紧上通讯引导我们穿过这里；我们正以稳定速度艰难前行，但马上要有客人来了……

column1: Adder ADR-A
column2: 蝰蛇 ADR-A

column1: Adder
column2: 蝰蛇

column1: For a mech of just 35 tons this little turtle sports a lot of long range fire support in the form of 40 LRM tubes, which can scare away even much much larger enemies. For close range, self defense or a last effort push if the ammo bins are empty, the ADR-A carries 2 Small Pulse Lasers and the standard Flamer.
column2: 区区 35 吨的小乌龟却拥有大量远程火力支援——40 个 LRM 发射管，足以吓退远比它庞大的敌人。近程自卫、或在弹药打空时的最后一搏，ADR-A 携带 2 门小型脉冲激光和标准火焰喷射器。Base

column1: Support OmniMech
column2: 支援万能机甲

column1: For a mech of just 35 tons this little turtle sports a lot of long range support fire power in form of 40 LRM tubes, which can scare away even much much larger enemies. For close range, self defense or a last effort push if the ammo bins are empty, the ADR-A carries 2 Small Pulse Lasers.
column2: 区区 35 吨的小乌龟却拥有大量远程支援火力——40 个 LRM 发射管，足以吓退远比它庞大的敌人。近程自卫、或在弹药打空时的最后一搏，ADR-A 携带 2 门小型脉冲激光。Base

column1: Adder ADR-B
column2: 蝰蛇 ADR-B

column1: Every time the Adder-B is spotted you can't stop wondering how the clans fit all that firepower on a tiny 35 ton chassis. With an extremely accurate Large Pulse Laser this mid to long range configuration softens up the armor of an enemy to finish it at medium range with its powerful LB-X AC/5, backed up by a pair of ERMLs. Never underestimate the power of an ADR-B, it might be a mistake you can't recover from.
column2: 每次看到 Adder-B，你都会忍不住想知道氏族是怎么把那么多火力塞进区区 35 吨底盘的。凭借一门极其精准的大型脉冲激光，这套中远程配置能软化敌方装甲，然后在中距离以强力 LB-X AC/5 予以了结，另有两门 ER 中型激光支援。永远不要低估一台 ADR-B 的实力，那可能是个你无法挽回的错误。Base

column1: Adder ADR-C
column2: 蝰蛇 ADR-C

column1: As a slightly lighter armed long range bombardment variant, the Adder-C 'only' sports two LRM-15 launchers as the main armament... And also an additional launcher for a NARC Homing Beacons. You can't hide anywhere if you have one of those stuck on your hull. For CQC and as a non ammo-dependent backup weapon, a single Medium Pulse Laser can absolutely ruin the day for ambushers who think the LRM support mech might be an easy kill.
column2: 作为一款搭载略轻武装的远程轰炸变体，Adder-C"仅仅"以两具 LRM-15 发射器为主武器……另外还多装了一具发射 NARC 自导信标的发射器。只要有那玩意儿粘在你船壳上，你无处可藏。用于近距混战并作为不依赖弹药的备用武器，一门中型脉冲激光足以彻底毁掉那些以为这台 LRM 支援机甲是个软柿子的伏击者的好日子。Base

column1: Adder ADR-D
column2: 蝰蛇 ADR-D

column1: Sticking to the general theme for this rather slow 35 tonner, the Adder-D fields a mid to long range setup in form of an ER Large Laser and an Ultra Autocannon/5. The ADR-D will try to keep its distance and open up components from a safe distance before it moves in to finish the job with a set of Streak SRM2s.
column2: 秉持这款相当缓慢的 35 吨机体的总体主题，Adder-D 以一门 ER 大型激光和一门超速自动炮/5 构成中远程配置。ADR-D 会尽量保持距离，在安全距离上打开对手的部件孔洞，然后推进以一组连续 SRM2 收尾。Base

column1: Adder ADR-PRIME
column2: 蝰蛇 ADR-原装型

column1: Codenamed Puma by Inner Sphere forces who first engaged it, the Adder is a light Clan OmniMech that serves as a direct or an indirect fire-support unit in most of its configurations. The Primary configuration has a basic but powerful arsenal of two ER PPCs which are linked to an advanced Targeting Computer, allowing the Primary configuration of the Adder to strike at long range with deadly accuracy. It also sports a flamer.
column2: 被首次交战的内天体部队代号为"美洲狮"，蝰蛇是一款轻型氏族全能机甲，在多数配置中充当直接或间接火力支援单位。主配置装备一套基础但强大的两门 ER PPC 武器，联接一台先进瞄准计算机，使蝰蛇主配置能以致命精度在远距离打击。它还配有一具火焰喷射器。Base

column1: Khan Marthe Pryde decided to upgrade the 'Mechs her Clan fielded. Rather than waste precious resources designing a new OmniMech from the ground up, she instructed her scientists to improve upon existing designs. The design the scientists chose to modify was the Adder. Though the two 'Mechs are visually similar and share the same weight, the Cougar is slower and better armed.
column2: 玛尔特·普莱德可汗决定升级其氏族装备的机甲。为不浪费宝贵资源从头设计新型全能机甲，她指示科学家改良现有设计。科学家选择改造的是蝰蛇。尽管两款机甲外观相似且重量相同，美洲狮更慢但武装更强。Base

column1: Albatross
column2: 信天翁

column1: The Albatross was designed by the Free Worlds League in 3053 with an eye toward a possible future conflict with the then advancing Clans. The 'Mech is built using a Hermes 380 XL Engine to minimize weight and maximize free tonnage for its weapon loadout. The Albatross also uses a variety of weapons in an attempt to make the 'Mech effective at any range. The 'Mech has average mobility with a maximum speed of 64.8 kph and also makes use of double heat sinks for their greater heat dissipation capability.
column2: 信天翁由自由世界联盟于 3053 年设计，着眼点是与当时正在推进的氏族可能发生的未来冲突。机甲采用一台赫尔墨斯 380 XL 引擎建造，以最小化重量并为武器载荷最大化可用吨位。信天翁还使用多种武器，力图使机甲在任何距离上都有效。机甲机动性中等，最高速度 64.8 公里/小时，并使用双倍散热器以获得更强的散热能力。Base

column1: Juggernaut
column2: 主宰者

column1: The Albatross does not specialize in one role and is more of a workhorse design than anything else. The 'Mech carries an Irian Weapons Works V7 LRM-15 launcher which gives it long range and indirect fire support capabilities. This is backed up by an Oriente Model O LB-X Autocannon/10 and a Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser which give the 'Mech a powerful long-range punch. The 'Mech carries a Tronel PPL-20 Large Pulse Laser which allows the 'Mech to engage an enemy at the edge of the medium to long-range envelope. Finally, for close combat, the 'Mech has an Irian Weapons Works 60mm SRM-6 and two Irian Weapons Works Super 6 Medium Lasers.
column2: 信天翁不专精于某一角色，更像是一款主力设计。机甲携带一具"伊里安兵器工厂 V7"LRM-15 发射器，赋予它远程与间接火力支援能力。它由一门"东方 O 型"LB-X 自动炮/10 和一门"多元光学阳光"ER 大型激光支援，为机甲提供强大的远程打击力。机甲携带一门"特罗内尔 PPL-20"大型脉冲激光，使机甲能在中远程范围边缘交战。最后，混战方面，机甲有一具"伊里安兵器工厂 60 毫米"SRM-6 和两门"伊里安兵器工厂超级 6"中型激光。Base

column1: Annihilator
column2: 歼灭者

column1: Originally developed in the final year of the Amaris Civil War as the ultimate fixed position city defense BattleMech, the Annihilator was built as a sign of the military strength of the Star League in Exile. The -1A was armed with four Autocannon/10s and four Medium Lasers. While less accurate than the original -2A, the 1A was still a highly destructive and dangerous 'Mech that no MechWarrior looked forward to engaging.
column2: 歼灭者最初在阿马里斯内战最后一年被开发为终极固定阵地城市防御战斗机甲，作为流亡星盟军事实力的象征而建造。-1A 装备四门自动炮/10 和四门中型激光。虽然精度不如原版-2A，1A 仍是破坏力惊人、危险至极的机甲，没有哪个机甲战士愿意与它交战。Base

column1: Juggernaut & Siege Mech
column2: 重装与攻城机甲

column1: Still a fearsome and powerful design, where the original Annihilator-1A carries a bevy of powerful autocannons, the -1E instead opts for an all-energy weapon loadout. Four Particle Projection Cannons give the Annihilator-1E a brutal and incredibly powerful punch while the Medium Lasers from the -1A are carried over for in-close protection while increasing the armor protection somewhat to mitigate enemy return fire.
column2: 歼灭者仍是令人生畏的强大设计，原版歼灭者-1A 携带大量强力自动炮，而-1E 则选择全能量武器配置。四门粒子加农炮赋予歼灭者-1E 残暴而惊人的打击力，而-1A 的中型激光被保留用于近身防护，同时装甲防护略有提升以缓解敌方还击。Base

column1: Originally developed in the final year of the Amaris Civil War as the ultimate fixed position city defense BattleMech, the Annihilator was built as a sign of the military strength of both the Star League in Exile and the newly created Clans.
column2: 歼灭者最初在阿马里斯内战最后一年开发，作为终极固定阵地城市防御战斗机甲，它的建造是流亡星盟与新生的氏族双方军事实力的象征。Base

column1: Mechazilla
column2: 机甲斯拉

column1: Clan Mechazilla
column2: 氏族机甲斯拉

column1: Apollo
column2: 阿波罗

column1: The Apollo is designed to be a long range fire support BattleMech. This is accomplished by mounting an engine on the 'Mech that gives it a top speed of only 64.8 kph and eleven and a half tons of armor. The 'Mech was then armed with massive missile launchers which can rain destruction down on an enemy. While the Apollo has less than average speed for a medium 'Mech, if it is employed correctly the Apollo should have nothing to fear from enemy fire; it is fully capable of staying at the edge of the battlefield and laying down suppressive LRM fire.
column2: 阿波罗被设计为远程火力支援战斗机甲。为此它搭载的引擎仅能提供 64.8 公里/小时的最高速度和十一吨半装甲。随后它装备了巨型导弹发射器，可将毁灭倾泻到敌人头上。虽然阿波罗的速度低于中型机甲平均水平，但只要运用得当，它便无需惧怕敌方火力；它完全能停留在战场边缘，倾泻压制性 LRM 火力。Base

column1: Archer
column2: 弓箭手

column1: The 2K Archer was a modification built for House Kurita in 2856, designed to increase its direct firepower capability and give it more staying power on the battlefield once it had run out of ammunition
column2: 2K 弓箭手是 2856 年为库瑞塔家族建造的改装型，旨在提升其直射火力，并在弹药耗尽后仍能在战场上坚持更久

column1: Heavy Fire Support & Defender
column2: 重型火力支援 & 防御者

column1: The Archer is a one the best known fire support 'Mechs and can still put up a good fight closer ranges.
column2: 弓箭手是最著名的火力支援机甲之一，在近距离也能打出漂亮的一仗。Base

column1: A contemporary of 'Mechs such as the Thunderbolt and the Banshee, the Archer's primary role was fire support
column2: 作为雷霆和女妖等机甲的同时代产物，弓箭手的主要角色是火力支援

column1: The 2Rb variant of the Archer was built for SLDF Royal units starting in 2752. A contemporary of 'Mechs such as the Thunderbolt and the Banshee, the Archer's primary role was fire support.
column2: 弓箭手 2Rb 变体自 2752 年起为星盟防卫军皇家单位建造。作为雷霆和女妖等机甲的同时代产物，弓箭手的主要角色是火力支援。Base

column1: A another modification made to allow the Archer to defend itself more easily against an enemy that managed to close range with it. Built for House Steiner in 2915
column2: 这是另一项改装，使弓箭手能更轻易地抵御设法逼近的敌人。2915 年为施泰纳家族建造

column1: Carrying a pair of SRM-4s in place of two medium lasers, this was the trademark variant used by the Wolf's Dragoons, which they produced in the assembly plant aboard their space station Hephaestos until its destruction in 3028. It was once stated by Jaime Wolf that all of the Dragoons' Archers were of this variant.
column2: 此变体以两具 SRM-4 取代两门中型激光，是狼之龙骑兵的标志性变体，他们在空间站"赫菲斯托斯"上的装配厂生产，直到 3028 年该站被毁。海梅·沃尔夫曾表示，龙骑兵所有的弓箭手都是这一变体。Base

column1: Heavy Artillery and Fire Support
column2: 重型火炮与火力支援

column1: The 4M variant of the Archer was built using rediscovered Star League technology. A contemporary of 'Mechs such as the Thunderbolt and the Banshee, the Archer's primary role was fire support
column2: 弓箭手 4M 变体使用重新发现的星盟技术建造。作为雷霆和女妖等机甲的同时代产物，弓箭手的主要角色是火力支援

column1: A Clan-tech retrofit of the standard Star League Defense Force ARC-2R Archer and intended for second-line and solahma troops.
column2: 这是对标准星盟防卫军 ARC-2R 弓箭手的氏族技术改装，供二线部队与"索拉赫马"部队使用。Base

column1: Arctic Cheetah
column2: 极地猎豹

column1: A sleek, mobile, and versatile design, the Clan Arctic Cheetah was long suspected to be one of the first OmniMechs produced by the Clans.
column2: 作为一款流线型、机动且多用途的设计，氏族极地猎豹长期被认为是最早由氏族生产的全能机甲之一。Base

column1: Scout & Disabler
column2: 侦察兵 & 致残者

column1: Arctic Fox
column2: 北极狐

column1: The Arctic Fox is a light OmniMech reverse engineered by the Kell Hounds from the Clan Uller OmniMech with assistance in the final stages from Clan Wolf-in-Exile. The resulting OmniMech is a powerful light 'Mech that has a top speed of 97.2 km/h that is provided by a GM 180 XL engine, shaving off valuable weight from the Arctic Fox's base chassis while also making the 'Mech vulnerable to becoming a combat kill through the loss of one of its side torsos. The Arctic Fox has ten double heat sinks which are generally enough to handle the 'Mech's heat load, with the ability to add more if needed. To protect itself from enemy fire, the Arctic Fox has six tons of Royal-7 armor.
column2: 极地狐是凯尔猎犬依据氏族乌勒尔全能机甲逆向工程而来的轻型全能机甲，最终阶段得到流亡狼氏族的协助。成品是一款强劲的轻型机甲，由 GM 180 XL 引擎提供 97.2 公里/小时的最高速度，既为极地狐的基础底盘省下宝贵重量，也使它因失去任一侧面躯干而容易被击毁。它装有十台双倍散热器，通常足以应对其热负荷，必要时还可加装。为抵御敌方火力，极地狐拥有六吨 Royal-7 装甲。Base

column1: Striker
column2: 攻击手

column1: The primary configuration of the Arctic Fox is intended to wear an enemy's armor down at long ranges and then close for the kill. To do this, the Arctic Fox carries an ER PPC that can hit a target at up to six hundred and ninety meters. For close combat, two Medium Lasers provide the primary hitting power while two SRM-4 launchers seek out weak points in an enemy's armor.
column2: 北极狐主配置意在远距离磨掉敌人装甲，然后逼近收尾。为此，北极狐携带一门 ER PPC，能在六百九十米外命中目标。混战方面，两门中型激光构成主要打击力，而两具 SRM-4 发射器搜寻敌人装甲上的弱点。Base

column1: Arctic fox
column2: 北极狐

column1: The A configuration is intended for short range engagements and carries four Medium Pulse Lasers and three Small Pulse Lasers. Six jump jets have been added in order to increase mobility.
column2: A 配置用于近程交战，携带四门中型脉冲激光和三门小型脉冲激光。为提升机动性加装了六个跳跃推进器。Base

column1: Useful in anti-aircraft and in vehicle hunting roles, the B configuration has an LB-X Autocannon/10 as its primary weapon. This is backed up by a Medium Laser. This configuration is highly flexible in its roles but also severely handicapped by its reliance on a ballistic weapon.
column2: B 配置适用于防空与猎杀车辆角色，以一门 LB-X 自动炮/10 为主武器。它由一门中型激光支援。此配置在角色上高度灵活，但也因依赖实弹武器而严重受限。Base

column1: Another sniper and cleanup 'Mech rolled into one, the C configuration mounts an ER PPC as its primary weapon, giving it superb long range firepower. This is matched up with a Large Pulse Laser, which has a much shorter range but is extremely accurate.
column2: C 配置把狙击手与清道夫合二为一，以一门 ER PPC 为主武器，赋予它卓越的远程火力。与之搭配的是一门大型脉冲激光，射程短得多但极其精准。Base

column1: A dedicated fire support configuration, the D configuration carries two LRM-10 missile launchers linked to an Artemis IV fire control system for greater missile accuracy.
column2: D 配置是专职火力支援配置，携带两具联接 Artemis IV 火控系统的 LRM-10 导弹发射器以提升导弹精度。Base

column1: Assassin
column2: 刺客

column1: Keeping the top speed of the ASN-21 as well as its base weapon load of missiles, the ASN-101 is a rare Federated Suns variant that drops two jump jets and a half ton of armor to mount a trio of Small Lasers, giving the ASN-101 a much better close-in punch compared to its progenitor.
column2: ASN-101 保留了 ASN-21 的最高速度与基础导弹武器配置，是联邦太阳稀有的变体，它削减两个跳跃推进器和半吨装甲，以装载三门小型激光，使 ASN-101 相比其前身具备强得多的近身打击力。Base

column1: Flanker and Assassin
column2: 侧翼与刺客

column1: Assassin was designed to complete against the lighter scout mechs like the Wasp and Stinger but is twice as heavy, faster, greater jump range, heavier armor and much more firepower.
column2: 刺客的设计目标是抗衡黄蜂与毒刺等轻型侦察机甲，但它的重量翻倍、速度更快、跳跃距离更远、装甲更厚、火力强得多。Base

column1: Hunter-Killer & Ambusher
column2: 猎杀者 & 伏击者

column1: Assassins are a rare mech nowadays with good firepower and armor with great speed and jumping range.  Makes are really good scout mech killer if you ask me. Dangerous to get jumped by one of these from behind no matter your size.
column2: 刺客如今是稀有机甲，火力与装甲都不错，速度与跳跃距离出色。要我说，它们是极好的侦察机甲杀手。无论你体型如何，被这东西从背后跳上来都很危险。Base

column1: The -23 variant of the Assassin is an upgrade of the original model using Lostech; originally seen as a standardized field modification, in 3067 new production began at Hellespont 'Mech Works. The SRM-2 has been removed to upgrade the Medium Laser to a Medium Pulse Laser and an Artemis IV fire control system has been added for the LRM-5 launcher. Within the CCAF, TDF and MAF it is largely used as a cheap way to rebuild shattered forces and sees service mostly in green and reserve formations. The Capellans in particular use the -23 as a fire-support unit for pursuit and strike lances, though shortages of Artemis munitions means many are forced to use mine-delivery missiles.
column2: 刺客的-23 变体是使用失落科技的原版升级型；最初被视为标准化的野战改装，3067 年由赫勒斯庞特机甲厂开始新的生产。SRM-2 被移除以把中型激光升级为中型脉冲激光，并为 LRM-5 发射器加装 Artemis IV 火控系统。在 CCAF、TDF 和 MAF 中，它主要被用作重建残破部队的廉价手段，多在生疏与预备编队中服役。卡佩兰人尤其把-23 用作追击与打击小队的火力支援单位，不过 Artemis 弹药短缺意味着许多只能使用布雷导弹。Base

column1: Atlas II
column2: 大力神II

column1: First fielded in 2765, the Atlas II was designed by the Hegemony Research and Development Department, Weapons Division of the original Star League to maintain the technological edge over the other Great Houses. It was exclusively for the SLDF's Royal Regiments. In 2785, when General Aleksandr Kerensky put out his call for loyal forces to join him in his Exodus, every Atlas II pilot responded and left with him. The Atlas II is armed with an array of weaponry, including an LB-X Autocannon/10, a pair of ER Large Lasers, and a 20-tube Long Range Missile Launcher for long range attacks. For close range combat, the 'Mech is equipped with a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and a Holly Six Pack. In addition, the 'Mech has been given CASEfor both sides of the torso in order to keep an ammunition cook-off from consuming the 'Mech.
column2: 阿特拉斯 II 于 2765 年首次投入战场，由原星盟的霸权研发部武器司设计，以维持对各大议院的技术优势。它专供星盟防卫军皇家团使用。2785 年亚历山大·克伦斯基将军号召忠诚部队随他出埃及时，每一位阿特拉斯 II 机师都响应并随他离开。阿特拉斯 II 装备一系列武器，包括一门 LB-X 自动炮/10、两门 ER 大型激光和一具 20 管远程导弹发射器用于远程攻击。近距离战斗则配备两门中型脉冲激光和一具冬青六联装。此外，机甲两侧躯干都装有 C.A.S.E.，以防弹药殉爆吞噬整机。Base

column1: This variant of the Atlas II exchanges both ER Large Lasers and its LB 10-X for a Kinslaughter ER PPC and a Gauss Rifle while removing only one double heat sink
column2: 此阿特拉斯 II 变体将两门 ER 大型激光和 LB 10-X 换成一门"屠亲"ER PPC 和一门高斯步枪，仅移除一台双倍散热器

column1: Atlas
column2: 大力神

column1: The Atlas A is the first try to be the king of the battlefield, capable of bringing a dizzying array of weapons to bear on targets at any range. It is also noteworthy for normally mounting the maximum amount of armor possible. Few opponents can survive even brief contact with this monster.
column2: 阿特拉斯 A 是成为战场之王的最初尝试，能在任何距离上向目标倾泻令人目眩的各类武器。它还以通常装备可容纳的最大装甲量而著称。很少有对手能在与这头怪物短暂接触后幸存。Base

column1: The Atlas A is the king of short range engagements, capable of bringing a dizzying amount of short range missiles to bear on targets at close range. It is also noteworthy for normally mounting the maximum amount of armor possible. Few opponents can survive even brief contact with this monster.
column2: 阿特拉斯 A 是近程交战之王，能在近距离向目标倾泻令人目眩的大量短程火箭。它还以通常装备可容纳的最大装甲量而著称。很少有对手能在与这头怪物短暂接触后幸存。Base

column1: Built in 2776, this Atlas variant is the largest 'Mech equipped with a Command Console. To free up the weight required to fit this device, the AS7-D-DC removes one ton of LRM ammunition and the paired rear firing lasers. Effective at Close and Long Range Fire Support. Recommended for use by Experienced Tactical Commanders. Extremely Rare and largely Extinct.
column2: 这款阿特拉斯变体于 2776 年建造，是装备指挥控制台的最大机甲。为腾出安装该装置所需的重量，AS7-D-DC 移除一吨 LRM 弹药和成对的后向激光。在近程与远程火力支援上都很有效。推荐由经验丰富的战术指挥官使用。极为稀有且基本绝迹。Base

column1: Command 'Mech, Juggernaut & Close Assault
column2: 指挥机甲、重装 & 近身突击

column1: I've heard of these older refits and thankfully our Battalion never faced one. Facing a single Pilot in an Atlas is one thing, but going up against two pilots in one of these is something else altogether; an experienced Commander and MechWarrior is a force to be reckoned with. Its no wonder they were targeted so heavily targeted during the Early Succession Wars. The loss of ammo and medium lasers makes this design no less deadly.
column2: 我听说过这些较早的改装，所幸我们营从未遇到过。面对一台阿特拉斯里的单个机师是一回事，但面对这种机甲里的两名机师就完全是另一回事了；一位经验丰富的指挥官兼机甲战士是股不容小觑的力量。难怪他们在继承战争早期成为重点打击目标。损失弹药和中型激光并没有让这个设计变得不那么致命。Base

column1: Known as the 'Atlas II,' the D-HT model carries more Energy weaponry and usually a lighter, more flexible Autocannon. It still has unbelievable protection and the same crushing Melee ability as other Atlas models.
column2: D-HT 型号被称为"阿特拉斯 II"，携带更多能量武器，通常配一门更轻便灵活点的自动炮。它仍拥有难以置信的防护，以及其他阿特拉斯型号同样摧枯拉朽的近战能力。Base

column1: The Atlas D is the king of the battlefield, capable of bringing a dizzying array of weapons to bear on targets at any range. It is also noteworthy for normally mounting the maximum amount of armor possible. Few opponents can survive even brief contact with this monster.
column2: 阿特拉斯 D 是战场之王，能在任何距离向目标施加令人眼花缭乱的武器阵列。它还以通常装备最大可能的装甲量而著称。很少有对手能在与这头巨兽的短暂接触中幸存。Base

column1: A Combine upgrade of the Atlas that used rediscovered Star League technology, the K model was built with a Vlar 300 XL Engine. Carrying a Shigunga LRM-20 with two tons of ammo in the left torso the 'Mech was rearmed for long range combat with an Imperator Dragon's Fire Gauss Rifle in place of the autocannon, with two tons of gauss rounds carried in the right arm, backed up by a pair of Victory Nickel Alloy ER Large Lasers split between both arms. This armament allowed the AS7-K to keep an enemy at range, though the continued use of twenty single heat sinks caused swift heat buildup if both lasers are fired repeatedly. For close range defense, the K model carried two Victory Heartbeat Medium Pulse Lasers and a Yori Flyswatter Anti-Missile System in the left arm. To round off the AS7-K's defense, CASE was added to the side torsos to protect against an ammunition explosion.
column2: K 型是联合体利用重新发现的星盟技术对阿特拉斯的升级，采用一台 Vlar 300 XL 引擎建造。左躯干携带一具"紫郡"LRM-20 与两吨弹药，机甲以远程战斗重新武装：用一门"帝皇龙焰"高斯步枪取代自动炮，右臂携带两吨高斯弹，并由分置双肩的两门"胜利镍合金"ER 大型激光支援。这一武器配置使 AS7-K 能让敌人保持在远处，不过继续使用二十台单散热器意味着若两门激光反复开火会迅速积热。近程防御方面，K 型在左臂携带两门"胜利心跳"中型脉冲激光和一套"织部苍蝇拍"反导系统。为完善 AS7-K 的防御，两侧躯干加装了 C.A.S.E. 以防弹药爆炸。Base

column1: Juggernaut & Mid/Longe Assault
column2: 重装与中远程突击

column1: A Combine upgrade of the Atlas that used rediscovered Star League technology. The 'Mechs 300 XL engine makes room for two ER Large -, two Medium Pulse Lasers and an AMS, and the AC-20 was swapped for a huge Gauss Rifle. But due to it's twenty -just- single heat sinks, you have to keep an eye your heat buildup.
column2: 这是联合体利用重新发现的星盟技术对阿特拉斯的升级。机甲的 300 XL 引擎为两门 ER 大型激光、两门中型脉冲激光和一套 AMS 腾出空间，AC-20 则换成一门巨型高斯步枪。但由于它那"仅仅"二十台单散热器，你必须留意积热。Base

column1: A Succession Wars era attempt at recreating the Atlas II's loadout, the AS7-RS downgrades the AutoCannon, LRMs and SRMs while trading out the Medium Lasers for a pair of arm mounted Large Lasers.
column2: AS7-RS 是继承战争时代重现阿特拉斯 II 配置的尝试，它降级了自动炮、LRM 和 SRM，并把中型激光换成两门臂载大型激光。Base

column1: Avatar
column2: 化身

column1: The first of the Inner Sphere OmniMechs to be conceptualized and one of the last to reach production by the Draconis Combine, the Avatar's design is based on captured Vulture OmniMechs.
column2: 化身是内天体最早被构想、也是联合体最后投产的全能机甲之一，其设计基于缴获的秃鹫全能机甲。Base

column1: Brawler & Firesupport
column2: 混战与火力支援

column1: Focused on close combat, the A configuration carries an ER Large Laser as its only long range weapon. Mounting a pair of SRM-6 launchers, an Autocannon/20 and the two Medium Lasers mounted on the base chassis, the Avatar A is a fearsome opponent with devastating close range punch.
column2: A 配置聚焦混战，以一门 ER 大型激光作为唯一的远程武器。它装有一对 SRM-6 发射器、一门自动炮/20，以及基础底盘上的两门中型激光，降世神 A 是个可怕的对手，拥有毁灭性的近程打击力。Base

column1: Brawler
column2: 缠斗者

column1: Now, this is solid Avatar configuration! An AC20 and pair of SRMs to blast away at the enemy. Just don't run out of ammo, boss.
column2: 这才是扎实的降世神配置！一门 AC20 和一对 SRM 轰击敌人。别把弹药打光就行，老大。Base

column1: A fire support variant, the B configuration carries two LRM-15 racks and two LRM-10 racks. These are all mated to an Artemis IV Fire Control System. The only short range weaponry on the B configuration consists wholly of the two Medium Lasers mounted on the base chassis.
column2: B 配置是一款火力支援变体，携带两具 LRM-15 挂架和两具 LRM-10 挂架，全部配以 Artemis IV 火控系统。B 配置唯一的近程武器完全由底盘上安装的两门中型激光构成。Base

column1: As a command configuration, the C configuration carries a C3 Master Computer into battle. The C configuration attempts to keep enemies at arms length with a PPC and Ultra Autocannon/5 supported by a pair of LRM-10 launchers.
column2: 作为指挥配置，C 配置把 C3 主控计算机带入战斗。C 配置以一门 PPC 和一门超速自动炮/5 搭配两具 LRM-10 发射器，力求把敌人拒于臂长之外。Base

column1: Command & Fire Support
column2: 指挥 & 支援

column1: As a command configuration, the C configuration carries a C3 Master Computer into battle. The C configuration attempts to keep enemies at arms length with a PPC and Ultra Autocannon/5 supported by a pair of LRM-10 launchers.
column2: 作为指挥配置，C 配置把 C3 主控计算机带入战斗。C 配置以一门 PPC 和一门超速自动炮/5 搭配两具 LRM-10 发射器，力求把敌人拒于臂长之外。Base

column1: The D configuration is intended to act as a sniper. The primary weapon is a Light Gauss Rifle. For close to medium range combat, the Avatar D has two MRM-20 launchers and a pair of ER Medium Lasers in addition to the two hard-wired Medium Lasers. Finally, the D Configuration has a C3 Slave unit that allows it to work in C3 lances.
column2: D 配置意在担任狙击手。主武器是一门轻型高斯步枪。中近距离战斗方面，降世神 D 除两门固定中型激光外，还有两具 MRM-20 发射器和一对 ER 中型激光。最后，D 配置装有一台 C3 从属单元，使它能在 C3 小队中作战。Base

column1: Sniper
column2: 狙击手

column1: A dedicated 'Mech killer, the Avatar G carries a Gauss Rifle with two tons of ammunition in each arm.
column2: 降世神 G 是专职机甲杀手，每臂各携带一门高斯步枪，配两吨弹药。Base

column1: A field upgrade developed in the midst of Operation Bulldog, this configuration utilized captured Clan Smoke Jaguar weapons to help bolster the SLDF forces in later waves. Mounting a mix of Combine and Clan-tech, this config carries an MRM-40 supported by a Clan Gauss Rifle, ER Large Laser and Streak SRM-4.
column2: 此配置是"斗牛犬"行动期间开发的野战升级，利用缴获的烟虎氏族武器帮助增强后期波次的星盟防卫军部队。它混装联合体与氏族科技，携带一具 MRM-40，辅以一门氏族高斯步枪、一门 ER 大型激光和一具连续 SRM-4。Base

column1: Awesome
column2: 可畏

column1: A 'Mech that truly lives up to its name! The Awesome 8Q mounts a frightening trio of PPCs that can destroy, knock down, or debilitate any target in no time. It's ungainly, but it can shrug off huge amounts of incoming fire.
column2: 一台真正配得上名字的机甲！神奇 8Q 装备三门的可怕 PPC，能在极短时间内摧毁、击倒或瘫痪任何目标。它笨拙不灵，却也能轻易扛下大量来袭火力。Base

column1: Heavy Sniper & Defender
column2: 重型狙击手 & 防御者

column1: The AWS-8R replaces the more expensive PPCs with a Large Laser and paired LRM-15s.  While this variant can still dish out a similar amount of damage, it suffers from its dependency on a limited supply of ammunition.
column2: AWS-8R 以一门大型激光和成对的 LRM-15 取代更昂贵的 PPC。虽然此变体仍能造成相近的伤害，却因依赖有限的弹药储备而吃亏。Base

column1: The main benefit of this variant is its ability to lob indirect fire.  Otherwise this is a case where I prefer the original recipe.
column2: 这一变体的主要优势是能投掷间接火力。除此之外，这情况我更偏好原配方。Base

column1: The Awesome 8T is a superb fire support 'Mech, though its heavy armor is a bit wasted in that role. It can still put up a good fight at medium ranges, and it can crush smaller units outright with Melee attacks.
column2: 卓越 8T 是一款出色的火力支援机甲，尽管其厚重装甲在这个角色上略显浪费。它在中距离仍能打出漂亮的一仗，也能用近战攻击直接碾碎较小单位。Base

column1: Seeking to address the issues with the 8R model, the AWS-8V is a blend of the 8R and 8Q.  This allows a pilot to provide indirect fire support, while still being a potent combatant with its PPC and Large Laser.
column2: 为解决 8R 型号存在的问题，AWS-8V 融合了 8R 与 8Q。这使机师既能提供间接火力支援，又能凭借其 PPC 和大型激光成为强悍的战斗者。Base

column1: The best of both worlds, with LRMs and the PPC - Large Laser combo you have a versatile fire support platform.
column2: 两全其美，凭借 LRM 和 PPC-大型激光的组合，你得到了一款多用途火力支援平台。Base

column1: The 9M is an upgrade of the Awesome that uses Star League technologies. The 'Mech is built around a 320 Hermes XL Fusion engine, giving the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The heat sinks were upgraded to double heat sinks to allow this variant to be rearmed with three Fusigon Longtooth ER PPCs. The ER PPCs are backed up by two Hovertec Streak SRM-2s, split between the left arm and center torso and fed by one ton of reloads in the left leg, a Magna 400P Medium Pulse Laser also in the center torso, and a Diverse Optics Type 10 Small Pulse Laser in place of the head-mounted small laser.
column2: 9M 是使用星盟技术对神奇的升级。机甲围绕一台 320 赫尔墨斯 XL 聚变引擎建造，最高速度 64.8 公里/小时。散热器升级为双倍散热器，使此变体得以重新装备三门"富西贡长牙"ER PPC。这些 ER PPC 由两具"气垫"连续 SRM-2 支援（分置左臂与中央躯干，由左腿一吨再装填供弹）、中央躯干一门玛格纳 400P 中型脉冲激光，以及取代头部小型激光的"多元光学 10 型"小型脉冲激光。Base

column1: The 9M is an upgrade of the Awesome that uses Star League technologies. Twenty double Heatsinks keeping it cool while firing the three Fusigon Longtooth ER PPCs constantly, and with it's 320 XL engine it is faster and allows in addition a variety of backup weapons, but makes the 'Mech also more fragile.
column2: 9M 是使用星盟技术对神奇的升级。二十台双倍散热器让它在持续发射三门"富西贡长牙"ER PPC 时保持低温；凭借 320 XL 引擎它更快，还允许加装多种备用武器，但也使机甲更脆弱。Base

column1: Bane Prime
column2: 灾祸 原装型

column1: Bane
column2: 灾祸

column1: The Bane is a BattleMech that is based upon a Star League prototype that was never put into production. Tagged the Kraken by Inner Sphere forces who opposed it, the Bane was first built in 2827. It was originally a significant part of many Clan toumans, but was gradually relegated to second-line status following the introduction of the OmniMech. As such, it is still critical to many defensive units.
column2: 灾祸是一款以星盟从未投产的原型为基础的战斗机甲。它被对抗它的内天体部队冠以"海怪"之名，于 2827 年首次建造。它原本是许多氏族图曼的重要组成部分，但随着全能机甲的引入逐渐退居二线。即便如此，它对许多防御单位仍至关重要。Base

column1: Clan Fire Support
column2: 氏族火力支援

column1: Banshee
column2: 报丧女妖

column1: The original design first produced in 2445, this Banshee variant carries the PPC, Autocannon/5, and Small Laser of the later 3E, as well as a pair of Medium Lasers.
column2: 此女妖变体源于 2445 年首次生产的原始设计，携带后来 3E 型的 PPC、自动炮/5 和小型激光，以及两门中型激光。Base

column1: Heavy Brawler & Sniper
column2: 重型缠斗者 & 狙击手

column1: The Banshee 3E was originally designed for close combat, with better speed than most other assault 'Mechs. While it has heavy armor and powerful Melee attack capability, its firepower is severely lacking and it can still be flanked by lighter units.
column2: 女妖 3E 最初为近战而设计，速度优于大多数其他突击机甲。虽然它有厚重装甲和强大的近战攻击能力，火力却严重不足，且仍可能被轻型单位包抄。Base

column1: The Banshee 3M mounts respectable weaponry with better-than-average speed and armor. This comes at the cost of very poor heat management. It's good at hunting lighter units, especially if it can close to Melee range.
column2: 女妖 3M 装备可观的武器，速度与装甲优于平均。代价是散热管理极差。它擅长猎杀轻型单位，尤其当它能逼近至近战距离时。Base

column1: The Banshee 3MC was a special design of the Magistracy of Canopus. It replaced the autocannon with a bigger one. To make room for it, most of the original heatsinks had to go.
column2: 女妖 3MC 是卡诺普斯法域的特殊设计。它用一门更大的自动炮替换原有自动炮。为腾出空间，大部分原有散热器不得不被舍弃。Base

column1: The Banshee 3E was originally designed for close combat, with better speed than most other assault 'Mechs. While it has heavy armor and powerful Melee attack capability, its firepower is severely lacking and it can still be flanked by lighter units. To address this design flaw, the Magistracy of Canopus exchanged the autocannon with a bigger one, at the expense of heat management in the MC variant.
column2: 女妖 3E 最初为近战而设计，速度优于大多数其他突击机甲。虽然它有厚重装甲和强大的近战攻击能力，火力却严重不足，且仍可能被轻型单位包抄。为解决这一设计缺陷，卡诺普斯法域在 MC 变体中用一门更大的自动炮替换了原有自动炮，代价是散热管理。Base

column1: The Banshee 3Q variant lacks the long distance capabilities of its predecessor, replacing its AC10 and PPC with an AC20 and enough ammo to last in a sustained fight.
column2: 女妖 3Q 变体缺乏前代的长距离能力，它以一门 AC20 和足以支撑持久战的弹药取代了 AC10 与 PPC。Base

column1: Heavy Brawler & Juggernaut
column2: 重型混战与重装

column1: A very recent variant, the 3S downgrades the engine size making the Banshee slower, but more than makes up for this by more than doubling its firepower.
column2: 3S 是极新的变体，它降级引擎尺寸使女妖更慢，但以超过两倍的火力远远弥补了这一点。Base

column1: This is some new Steiner variant, and those techs at Defiance Industries really made it a monster.  While not as fast as the original, this damage output on this 'Mech would make an Atlas jealous.
column2: 这是某种新的施泰纳变体，迪法恩斯工业的那些技师真把它做成了怪物。虽然不如原版快，但这台机甲的伤害输出会让阿特拉斯嫉妒。Base

column1: BattleAxe
column2: 战斧

column1: The original production variant of this 'Mech, the BKX-7K, utilizes two massive Donal Particle Projection Cannons, which were relatively new at the time. To support the massive cannons, it also has two Federated-5 Shot LRM-5 launchers with one ton of ammo to split between them and a Harpoon-6 SRM-6, giving it something to hit with at all ranges.
column2: 这台机甲的最初量产变体 BKX-7K 采用两门巨型多纳尔粒子加农炮，它们在当时相对较新。为支援这两门巨炮，它还装有两具联邦 5 发 LRM-5 发射器，共分一吨弹药，以及一具"鱼叉-6"SRM-6，使它在任何距离上都有可用的武器。Base

column1: A failed prototype but with a hell of a punch.
column2: 失败的原型机，但威力惊人。Base

column1: With the introduction of the BattleAxe’s successor, the Hammerhands, no official variants ever surfaced. However, many MechWarriors, especially those who never quite learned to manage the BattleAxe as it leapt through the air, had technicians remove the temperamental jump jets and install a second LRM 5 in each torso, deeming it the “No Crash” version, or simply 7NC.
column2: 随着战斧的继任者"锤手"问世，再没有官方变体出现过。然而许多机甲战士——尤其是那些始终没学会如何驾驭空中跳跃的战斧的人——让技师拆下反复无常的跳跃推进器，在每侧躯干各装一具 LRM 5，称之为"不摔机"版本，或简称 7NC。Base

column1: A failed prototype but with a hell of a punch. But be careful with ammo you will run dry fast.
column2: 失败的原型机，但打击力惊人。不过要小心弹药，你会很快打空。Base

column1: Battle Hawk
column2: 战斗鹰

column1: The Battle Hawk was originally designed and built at a time when Defiance Industries felt threatened by the large amount of equipment being produced by, and imported from, the Free Worlds League. It was built to prove that Defiance Industries was still an industry leader in BattleMechs. This came from a 'Mech that, while slow for its weight class, is a force to be reckoned with on the modern battlefield. The Battle Hawk has a top speed of 86.4 kph, which puts it on par with 'Mechs fifteen to twenty tons heavier than itself, but it also carries a powerful arsenal for its size. Its five and a half tons of armor give it good protection for a light 'Mech. Additionally, to make the Battle Hawk more maneuverable on the battlefield, it can jump up to one hundred and fifty meters.
column2: 战斗鹰设计与建造之时，迪法恩斯工业正感到被自由世界联盟生产与进口的大量装备所威胁。它的诞生是为了证明迪法恩斯工业仍是战斗机甲行业的领导者。成果是一款虽在同重量级中偏慢、但在现代战场上不容小觑的机甲。战斗鹰最高速度 86.4 公里/小时，与其重十五到二十吨的机甲持平，同时也为此尺寸携带了强大的武器库。五吨半装甲为轻型机甲提供了良好防护。此外，为提升战场机动性，战斗鹰可跳跃至一百五十米。Base

column1: The Battle Hawk is armed with a powerful short-range arsenal. The primary weaponry is a trio of Defiance P5M Medium Pulse Lasers, which provides the Battle Hawk with a blistering short-range laser arsenal. The 'Mech is also armed with a Hovertec Streak SRM-2 which allows the 'Mech to attempt to seek out weak points in an enemy's armor. The 'Mech is also armed with a McArthur Anti-Missile System which provides the Battle Hawk with a degree of protection from missile attacks.
column2: 战鹰装备强大的近程武器库。主武器为三门迪法恩斯 P5M 中型脉冲激光，为战鹰提供炽烈的近程激光武器库。机甲还装备一具"气垫"连续 SRM-2，使机甲能尝试搜寻敌方装甲上的弱点。机甲另装有一套麦克阿瑟反导系统，为战鹰提供一定程度的导弹攻击防护。Base

column1: BattleMaster
column2: 战斗大师

column1: A upgrade Battlemaster 1DC Command refit, carrying advanced Technologies and Hardened Armour to stay in the fight as long as possible.
column2: 这是战斗大师 1DC 指挥型的升级改装，携带先进技术与硬化装甲，以尽可能长时间留在战斗中。Base

column1: Command 'Mech, Heavy Brawler, & Close Assault
column2: 指挥机甲、重型混战 & 近身突击

column1: More of a refit than a production variant, the SRM-6 and two Medium Lasers are removed so that six Heat Sinks and an extra ton of armor could be added.  Making the BLR-1D a formitable opponent.
column2: 它更像是一次改装而非量产变体：SRM-6 与两门中型激光被移除，以便加装六台散热器和一吨额外装甲，使 BLR-1D 成为令人敬畏的对手。Base

column1: Command Console refit built in 2855 - The BattleMaster was one of the Federated Suns' preferred 'Mechs to install Command Consoles. Standard refits usually installed the Command Console on the BLR-1G, removing one heat sink and both rear-mounted Medium Lasers.
column2: 2855 年建造的指挥控制台改装型——战将是联邦太阳系首选安装指挥控制台的机甲之一。标准改装通常在 BLR-1G 上安装指挥控制台，移除一台散热器和两门后向中型激光。Base

column1: Thankfully I never faced one of these during my stint with the Second St. Ives Lancers on Kittery. The Fedrats, after all, preferred installing Command Consoles on the BattleMaster, but from my understanding these were relegated to training duties by the late Third Succession War. The loss of only one heat sink and two Medium Lasers is not too bad for a trade-off.
column2: 幸好我在基特里随第二圣艾夫斯枪骑兵服役期间从未遇到过这种机甲。毕竟联邦鼠更喜欢把指挥控制台装在战将上，但据我了解，这些到第三次继承战争后期已被降级用于训练任务。只损失一台散热器和两门中型激光，这样的代价不算太糟。Base

column1: A new variant produced for the Lyran Commonwealth by Red Devil industries which changes its mission profile to be more of a support 'Mech, removing its PPC and SRM-6 and replacing them with an LRM-15, LRM-5 and a pair of SRM-2s.
column2: 这是红魔工业为莱兰联邦生产的新变体，其任务定位更偏支援机甲，移除 PPC 和 SRM-6，换成一套 LRM-15、LRM-5 和两具 SRM-2。Base

column1: Blackhawk BHKU-O
column2: 黑鹰 BHKU-O

column1: Blackhawk
column2: 黑鹰

column1: The Black Hawk-KU is an Inner Sphere version of the Clan Black Hawk OmniMech. In order to make it possible to copy the Black Hawk, the Black Hawk-KU is built ten tons heavier than its Clan counterpart. The Black Hawk-KU is built on a sixty ton chassis and is powered by a Vlar 300 XL Engine which propels it to a top speed of 86.4 kph.
column2: 黑鹰-KU 是氏族黑鹰全能机甲的内天体版本。为使复制黑鹰成为可能，黑鹰-KU 比其氏族对应型重了十吨。它采用六十吨底盘，由 Vlar 300 XL 引擎驱动，最高速度 86.4 公里/小时。Base

column1: Blackjack
column2: 海盗旗

column1: Blackjack 0s are Primitive downgrades of the BJ-1, replacing both AC's with Medium Rifles, and maximizing armour as best as it can.
column2: 黑杰克 0 是 BJ-1 的原始降级版，将两门 AC 换成中型步枪，并尽可能最大化装甲。Base

column1: Blackjack 1s are solid, well-rounded 'Mechs for their tonnage. They typically mount Jump Jets, which give them an extra edge by repositioning quickly to keep a direct line of fire for their Autocannons.
column2: 黑杰克 1 就其吨位而言是扎实而全面的机甲。它们通常装备跳跃推进器，能迅速重新定位以保持自动炮的直射视野，从而获得额外优势。Base

column1: A recent Federated Suns variant, the BJ-1DB replaces the AutoCannon with Large Lasers.  In order to assist with the added heat, it also drops some armor and the torso mounted lasers to make room for more Heat Sinks.
column2: BJ-1DB 是联邦太阳系新近变体，将自动炮换成大型激光。为帮助应对增加的热量，它还削减了一些装甲和躯干激光，为更多散热器腾出空间。Base

column1: Sacrificing the Jump Jets, the BJ-1DC adds a Small Laser in each side torso and a Heat Sink to help ease the extra burden.
column2: BJ-1DC 牺牲跳跃推进器，在两侧躯干各加一门小型激光，并加一台散热器以缓解额外负担。Base

column1: In The Periphery Maintaining Mechs Tends To Be A Problem, As A Result The 1P Was Designed Generally As A Downgrade From The Os, But Much Cheaper To Maintain And Repair, Pilots Often Complain About The Structure 'Making Strange Noises', These Remarks Were Usually Ignored.
column2: 在外围区，维护机甲往往是个难题。因此 1P 大体上是 O 型的降级版，但维护和修理便宜得多。机师常抱怨其结构"发出奇怪的响声"，这些说法通常被无视。Base

column1: Well Isnt This Just a Bucket of bolts, Look At These Weapons, If You Can Call Them That,The Lasers Are Out Of Alignment And The 'Rifles' Are Dented, They Even Took The Fusion Core Out! Barbarians.. At Least It's Cheap To Replace, Not Sure Why You'd Want To.. Commander
column2: 好啊，这不就是一堆破铜烂铁吗？看看这些武器，如果还能叫武器的话——激光全都没校准，"步枪"上全是凹痕，他们居然连聚变核心都拆走了！野蛮人……至少替换起来便宜，不过我不确定你为什么会想替换它……指挥官

column1: This early Blackjack prototype started along a completely different path for the 'Mech.  Focusing on close in weapons, the BJ-1X has four Flamers and four Medium Lasers.  The BJ-1X also focused more on speed than jump manueverability, increasing the engine size while removing the Jump Jets.
column2: 这款早期黑杰克原型为该机甲开辟了一条完全不同的道路。BJ-1X 聚焦近程武器，配备四具火焰喷射器和四门中型激光。它还更注重速度而非跳跃机动，增大引擎尺寸并移除跳跃推进器。Base

column1: Brawler & Disabler
column2: 混战与瘫痪

column1: The BJ-2 was introduced in 3052 by the Federated Suns as the new production model of the Blackjack, based on earlier experimental designs. It upgrades the 'Mech with two Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Lasers in place of the autocannons and removes the medium lasers for four Hovertec Streak SRM-2 launchers, two each in the left and right sides of the torso. One ton of ammo for the launchers is kept in the left torso while the standard heat sinks were upgraded to double heat sinks.
column2: BJ-2 由联邦太阳系于 3052 年推出，是黑杰克的新量产型号，基于早期实验设计。它将自动炮换成两门多元光学"日光束"ER 大型激光，并移除中型激光，换成四具霍弗泰克连续 SRM-2 发射器，左右躯干各两具。发射器的一吨弹药存于左侧躯干，标准散热器则升级为双倍散热器。Base

column1: In the 3030s, the St. Ives Compact experimented with recovered technology on some of their Blackjacks. One prototype that showed great promise replace the autocannon and one heat sink with a pair of Ceres Arms Smasher PPCs. Three of the remaining heat sinks were replaced with experimental “freezer” double efficiency units.
column2: 在 3030 年代，圣艾夫斯共同体在他们的一些黑杰克上试验了找回的技术。一个前景看好的原型以一对"塞雷斯兵器粉碎者"PPC 取代自动炮和一台散热器。剩余散热器中有三台被换成实验性的"冷冻机"双倍效率装置。Base

column1: Blackjack 1s are solid, well-rounded 'Mechs for their tonnage. This prototype tends to run hot even with the experimental "freezer" double heat sinks.
column2: 黑杰克 1 就其吨位而言是扎实而全面的机甲。这台原型机即便装上了实验性的"冷冻机"双倍散热器，也容易过热。Base

column1: The Blackjack 3T replaces the standard AC/2s with Large Laser, providing greater punch at the cost of some Heat and carries a large collection of Machine guns and 2 Small Lasers.
column2: 黑杰克 3T 以大型激光取代标准 AC/2，以一些热量为代价换取更强的打击力，并携带一大批机枪和 2 门小型激光。Base

column1: The Blackjack 5 is a rather unusual refit, replacing the Autocannons with a pair of Mortars to allow indirect firing support and giving AMS coverage.
column2: 黑杰克 5 是一款颇为不寻常的改装型，以两门迫击炮取代自动炮，以提供间接火力支援并配备 AMS 防护。Base

column1: The Blackjack G, unlike the average variant, carries twin Ultra AC/10s. This variant also features an advanced targeting computer, an ultra-light gyro, and a supercharger.
column2: 黑杰克 G 与一般变体不同，携带双联超速 AC/10。此变体还配备先进瞄准计算机、超轻型陀螺仪和增压器。Base

column1: An upgrade of the Blackjack BattleMech, the Blackjack OmniMech is a powerful and adaptable medium weight workhorse. Much like the Firestarter OmniMech, the genesis of the omni-Blackjack stems from the Combine's technology exchange program during the initial Clan Invasion with Ceres Metals Industries ' St. Ives Compact branch offering Luthien Armor Works specifications and licenses to manufacturer the ill-regarded Blackjack.
column2: 作为黑杰克战斗机甲的升级版，黑杰克全能机甲是一款强劲且适应性强的中量级主力。与火焰使者全能机甲相似，全能版黑杰克的诞生源于氏族入侵初期联合体的技术交换计划——谷神星金属工业的圣艾夫斯契约分部向卢西恩装甲工厂提供了规格与许可，以制造这款评价不佳的黑杰克。Base

column1: An upgrade of the Blackjack BattleMech, the Blackjack OmniMech is a powerful and adaptable medium weight workhorse. Much like the Firestarter OmniMech, the genesis of the omni-Blackjack stems from the Combine's technology exchange program during the initial Clan Invasion with Ceres Metals Industries ' St. Ives Compact branch offering Luthien Armor Works specifications and licenses to manufacturer the ill-regarded Blackjack. Even though it received the upgraded and more effective BJ-2 version, LAW manufactured only a few examples before reworking and retooling the line to manufacture an OmniMech version.
column2: 黑杰克全能机甲是黑杰克战斗机甲的升级版，是一款强大而适应性强的中型主力机。与火焰使者全能机甲很像，全能黑杰克的起源来自联合体在氏族入侵初期的技术交换计划——塞雷斯金属工业的圣艾夫斯共同体分部向鲁西恩装甲工厂提供规格与许可，以生产这款评价不佳的黑杰克。尽管它获得了升级且更有效的 BJ-2 版本，LAW 只制造了少数几台，随后就改造并重新装备生产线以制造全能机甲版本。Base

column1: Here We Have the OA Variant Of The Blackjack OmniMech. This Loadout Replaces The UAC/5's With LRM Launchers For Some Long Range Support.
column2: 这是黑杰克全能机甲的 OA 变体。此配置以 LRM 发射器取代 UAC/5，提供一些远程支援。Base

column1: Here We Have the OB Variant Of The Blackjack OmniMech. This Loadout Replaces The UAC/5's With A Guass Rifle And A LRM10 Including An Artemis IV FCS.
column2: 这是黑杰克全能机甲的 OB 变体。此配置以一具高斯步枪和一具带 Artemis IV 火控系统的 LRM10 取代 UAC/5。Base

column1: Here We Have the OC Variant Of The Blackjack OmniMech. This Loadout Replaces The UAC/5's With LBX AC10's.
column2: 这是黑杰克全能机甲的 OC 变体。此配置以 LBX AC10 取代 UAC/5。Base

column1: Here We Have the OD Variant Of The Blackjack OmniMech. This Loadout Replaces The UAC/5's With A PPC And A 'Few' Lasers, As A Result 3 Extra Heatsinks Were Added To Compensate
column2: 这是黑杰克全能机甲的 OD 变体。此配置以一门 PPC 和"少数"激光取代 UAC/5，因此额外加装了 3 台散热器作为补偿

column1: Here We Have the OE Variant Of The Blackjack OmniMech. This Loadout Replaces The UAC/5's With A Light Guass Rifle,LRM10 and Two ER Lasers For Long Range Support
column2: 这是黑杰克全能机甲的 OE 变体。此配置以一门轻型高斯步枪、LRM10 和两门 ER 激光取代 UAC/5，用于远程支援

column1: Here We Have the OF Variant Of The Blackjack OmniMech. This Loadout Replaces The UAC/5's With A Bigger UAC/10 Two More Double Heatskinks, ER Lasers And Finally ER PPC
column2: 这是黑杰克全能机甲的 OF 变体。此配置以更大的 UAC/10、两门额外双倍散热器、ER 激光以及最后的 ER PPC 取代 UAC/5

column1: Here We Have the OR Variant Of The Blackjack OmniMech. This Loadout Replaces The UAC/5's With A Gauss Rifle, Maybe A Few Pulse Lasers.
column2: 这是黑杰克全能机甲的 OR 变体。此配置以一具高斯步枪，也许还有几门脉冲激光，取代 UAC/5。Base

column1: Black Knight
column2: 黑骑士

column1: The Black Knight 6-KNT is a dedicated Energy weapon platform. It can shell out hellish damage with its beams and shrug off a lot of damageÔÇª just gotta make sure to keep its heat in check.
column2: 黑骑士 6-KNT 是专职能量武器平台。它能以光束倾泻地狱般的伤害，并轻易承受大量打击……只要确保把热量控制住。Base

column1: Brawler & Ranged Assault
column2: 缠斗者 & 远程突击

column1: The Black Knight 6B was the harder-hitting, cooler-running Star League ancestor to the standard BL-6-KNT we have today. It did everything the 6 does, but better. Mostly thanks to its Double Heat Sinks.
column2: 黑骑士 6B 是我们今天所熟知的标准 BL-6-KNT 的星盟祖先，打击更狠、散热更好。6 型能做到的一切，它都做得更好。这主要归功于它的双倍散热器。Base

column1: A Free Worlds League variant, the BL-7-KNT-L replaces the rarer PPC with a 3rd Large Laser and 2 additional Heat Sinks.
column2: 这是自由世界联盟的变体，BL-7-KNT-L 将较稀有的 PPC 换成第三门大型激光和 2 台额外散热器。Base

column1: The Black Knight 7-KNT-L still dishes out almost as much firepower as its namesake, perhaps more, since it can keep firing longer with the combination of the extra heat sinks and the removal of the PPC.
column2: 黑骑士 7-KNT-L 输出的火力几乎与其同名型号相当，也许更多，因为凭借额外散热器和移除 PPC，它能持续开火更久。Base

column1: The Black Knight 7-KNT is a dedicated Energy weapon platform. It can shell out hellish damage with its beams and shrug off a lot of damageÔÇª just gotta make sure to keep its heat in check.
column2: 黑骑士 7-KNT 是专职能量武器平台。它能以光束倾泻地狱般的伤害，并轻易承受大量打击……只要确保把热量控制住。Base

column1: The Black Knight 7B is a refit made for and sold to Mercenary Commanders deeply in favour with the Federated Commonwealth, sporting advanced technologies and Prototype X-Pulse Laser.
column2: 黑骑士 7B 是为深得联邦联邦青睐的佣兵指挥官制造并出售的改装型，配备先进技术和原型 X 脉冲激光。Base

column1: The Black Knight 9-KNT is essentially a LosTech upgrade to the 6 variant, replacing most of its standard lasers with pulse versions, and the standard PPC with an ER version. This variant also carries double heat sinks to manage the extra heat generated by these weapons.
column2: 黑骑士 9-KNT 实质上是 6 型的失落科技升级版，将其大部分标准激光换成脉冲版本，标准 PPC 换成 ER 版本。该变体还配备双倍散热器以应对这些武器产生的额外热量。Base

column1: Black Lanner A
column2: 黑猎隼 A

column1: Black Lanner
column2: 黑猎隼

column1: The Black Lanner A is configured for electronic warfare and scouting. It uses an Active Probe to find hidden units, an ECM Suite to counteract enemy electronics, and a TAG spotting laser to designate targets for homing artillery. Offensively, it can call upon an ER PPC and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers.
column2: 黑猎隼 A 配置为电子战与侦察。它使用主动探测器寻找隐藏单位，ECM 套件反制敌方电子设备，TAG 指示激光为制导炮击标记目标。进攻方面，它可调用一门 ER PPC 和一对中型脉冲激光。Base

column1: The Black Lanner A is configured for electronic warfare and scouting. It uses an Active Probe to find hidden units, an ECM Suite to counteract enemy electronics, and a TAG spotting laser to designate targets for homing artillery. Offensively, it can call upon an ER PPC and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers.
column2: 黑猎隼 A 为电子战与侦察而配置。它使用主动探测器寻找隐藏单位、ECM 套件对抗敌方电子设备、TAG 侦察激光为寻的炮弹标记目标。攻击方面，它能依靠一门 ER PPC 和两门中型脉冲激光。Base

column1: Black Lanner C
column2: 黑猎隼 C

column1: The C is a close-support variant that mounts six ER Medium Lasers and a Streak SRM-6. It also uses three additional double heat sinks to help combat heat levels.
column2: C 型是近距支援变体，装备六门 ER 中型激光和一具连续 SRM-6。它还使用三台额外双倍散热器以帮助控制热量水平。Base

column1: Black Lanner D
column2: 黑猎隼 D

column1: This close-range brawler mounts pairs of Medium Pulse Lasers, SRM-6s, ER Small Lasers, Flamers, and four Machine Guns. This configuration is devastating to conventional infantry and a serious threat to combat vehicles. An Active Probe ensures that it is rarely surprised.
column2: 这款混战混战型装备成对的中型脉冲激光、SRM-6、ER 小型激光、火焰喷射器和四挺机枪。此配置对常规步兵极具毁灭性，对战斗车辆也是严重威胁。主动探测器确保它很少被突袭。Base

column1: Black Lanner Prime
column2: 黑猎隼 原装型

column1: The primary configuration of the Black Lanner is effective at all ranges. At long range, it can make use of an ER Large Laser and LRM-10. When it closes in, it can attack with a pair of ER Medium Lasers and an SRM-6 that can exploit holes in its opponent's armor. An ECM Suite protects it from many forms of electronics.
column2: 黑猎隼的主配置在各类距离上都很有效。远距离可用一门 ER 大型激光和一具 LRM-10。接近后，它可用两门 ER 中型激光和一具 SRM-6 攻击，后者能利用对手装甲上的破口。ECM 套件保护它免受多种电子手段干扰。Base

column1: Blitzkrieg
column2: 闪电战

column1: Taking its name from a term meaning 'Lightning War' the Blitzkrieg completely lives up to the name. The Blitzkrieg is built on a lightweight Coventry BTZ-VII Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a Magna 350 XL engine that weighs half as much as a standard fusion engine while giving the 'Mech a top speed of 118.8 km/h.
column2: 闪电战之名取自意为"闪电战争"的术语，而它完全配得上这个名字。它建立在轻量化的考文垂 BTZ-VII 内骨骼底盘上，由一台玛格纳 350 XL 引擎驱动——重量仅为标准聚变引擎的一半，同时赋予机甲 118.8 公里/小时的最高速度。Base

column1: Fast Raider
column2: 快速袭击者

column1: Blood Asp
column2: 血蝮

column1: Introduced at the turn of the century, the bloodasp was created by the Smoke Jaguars in anticipation of the Clans' return to the Inner Sphere.
column2: 血蝮于世纪之交推出，由烟虎氏族为迎接氏族重返内天体而研制。Base

column1: Fast Assault
column2: 快速突击

column1: Introduced at the turn of the century, the bloodasp was created by the Smoke Jaguars in anticipation of the Clans' return to the Inner Sphere..
column2: 血蝮于世纪之交推出，由烟虎氏族为迎接氏族重返内天体而研制。.

column1: Bombard
column2: 轰击

column1: The original Bombard mounted a pair of massive Autocannon/20s in place of the Thunderbolt launchers as well as standard Medium Lasers instead of the MBM-013's ER lasers. This version was also equipped with experimental War of 3039-vintage double heat sinks, less bulky than standard double heat sinks, but which utilized corrosive coolant.
column2: 原版轰击者以一对巨型自动炮/20 取代雷霆发射器，并以标准中型激光取代 MBM-013 的 ER 激光。此版本还装备了 3039 年战争时期的实验性双倍散热器——比标准双倍散热器更不笨重，但使用腐蚀性冷却剂。Base

column1: The original Bombard mounted a pair of massive Autocannon/20s in place of the Thunderbolt launchers as well as standard Medium Lasers instead of the MBM-013's ER lasers. This version was also equipped with experimental War of 3039-vintage double heat sinks, less bulky than standard double heat sinks, but which utilized corrosive coolant.
column2: 原版轰击者以一对巨型自动炮/20 取代雷霆发射器，并以标准中型激光取代 MBM-013 的 ER 激光。此版本还装备了 3039 年战争时期的实验性双倍散热器——比标准双倍散热器更不笨重，但使用腐蚀性冷却剂。Base

column1: Brigand
column2: 强盗
