column1: The Brigand is a BattleMech that is surrounded by a sea of controversy as it is the first 'Mech to be produced by a pirate band. Manufactured by a company named Vengeance Incorporated, which is run by the pirates of the Haven Star Cluster and 'Lady Death' Trevaline, the Brigand represents an unprecedented threat because in spite of the fact that it is built by pirates, it uses advanced construction techniques and weapons.
column2: 强盗是一台备受争议的战斗机甲，因为它是首款由海盗团伙生产的机甲。它由一家名为"复仇公司"的企业制造，该企业由避风港星团的海盗与"死亡女士"特雷瓦琳经营。强盗代表着前所未有的威胁，因为尽管它由海盗建造，却使用了先进的建造技术和武器。Base

column1: Freebooter Scout
column2: 掠夺者侦察

column1: Bushwacker
column2: 丛林猎手

column1: The Bushwacker was originally a failed BattleMech designed to have a smaller forward profile to make the 'Mech a harder target to hit. The Bushwacker's unique design caused problems with the engine shielding, the side-effects of which manifested themselves as various gremlins in the 'Mech's on board electronics on the prototypes fielded.
column2: 伏击者最初是一款失败的战斗机甲，设计初衷是缩小正面轮廓以使机甲更难被击中。但伏击者独特的设计导致引擎屏蔽出现问题，副作用表现为已部署原型机上各种机载电子设备的莫名故障。Base

column1: Guerilla Prototype
column2: 游击原型

column1: Caesar
column2: 凯撒

column1: Originally a reverse-engineered version Cataphract the finished design surprisingly enough proving to be a high quality design itself.
column2: 它最初是铁甲舰的逆向工程版本，而最终的成品令人惊讶地被证明本身就是一个高质量设计。Base

column1: Cataphract
column2: 重装骑兵

column1: We call the Cataphract a "FrankenMech" because it's got a little bit of everything stitched together on it. The 1X model works well at medium-long to closer range, with good armor and weaponry.
column2: 我们称铁甲舰为"拼装机甲"，因为它把五花八门的东西缝在了一起。1X 型号在中远到较近距离都表现出色，装甲与武器俱佳。Base

column1: The 2X replaces the PPC with a heavy laser, while the arm-mounted medium lasers are removed in favor of a SRM-4.  This reduction in heat load also allows for the removal of 2 heat sinks and adding armor in their stead.
column2: 2X 将 PPC 换成重型激光，同时移除臂载中型激光，改为一具 SRM-4。热负荷的降低还允许移除 2 台散热器，并以装甲取而代之。Base

column1: The CTF-4X is the latest variant of this prototype 'Mech.  The 4X downgrades the Engine, making for a slower ride, but adds more long range firepower with two Autocannon 5s, a Large Laser and LRM5.
column2: CTF-4X 是这款原型机甲的最新变体。4X 降级了引擎，使它跑得更慢，但以两门自动炮 5、一门大型激光和一具 LRM5 增加了更多远程火力。Base

column1: Honestly Commander, I've never even heard of this thing.  Have to hand it to the Capellans though, these FrankenMechs are nothing if not interesting.
column2: 老实说指挥官，我连听都没听过这东西。不过得佩服卡佩兰人，这些"科学怪机"真是有趣得很。Base

column1: Catapult
column2: 弩炮

column1: The Catapult A1 was designed as a true support role model.  The CPLT-A1 removes all 4 Medium Lasers in favor of additional LRM ammunition and armor.
column2: 弹射器 A1 被设计为真正的支援型型号。CPLT-A1 移除全部 4 门中型激光，换成额外的 LRM 弹药和装甲。Base

column1: The A1 model is going to need that extra armor if another 'Mech gets close in, as it doesn't have any real close in defenses.  On the brighter side, you aren't likely to run out of ammo.
column2: A1 型号若有其他机甲贴近就需要那层额外装甲，因为它没有任何真正的混战防御。好的一面是，你不太可能打光弹药。Base

column1: The Royal Catapult, the -C1b was designed to fill the same role as the normal -C1 but better. Thanks to Ferro-Fibrous armor it sports better protection, and thanks to double heat sinks it can jump and fire all day long without problems.
column2: 皇家弹射器-C1b 的设计目标是执行与普通-C1 相同的角色，但做得更好。得益于铁纤维装甲，它拥有更好的防护；得益于双倍散热器，它可以整天跳跃开火而毫无问题。Base

column1: The CPLT-C4 is an explosive addition to any outfit's arsenal.  Trading out the stock LRM-15s, Medium Lasers and extra Heat Sinks for LRM-20s and Small Lasers - along with 2 extra tons of ammo, the C4 gives the Catapult impressive long range firepower.
column2: CPLT-C4 是任何部队武器库中的爆炸性补充。它把标准 LRM-15、中型激光和额外散热器换成 LRM-20 与小型激光——外加 2 吨额外弹药，C4 赋予弹射器令人印象深刻的远程火力。Base

column1: If you can't find yourself an Archer, this is the next best thing.  While not as potent close in as the standard C1 model, the C4 can still hold its own in a brawl against a lighter opponent.
column2: 如果你找不到弓箭手，这就是次优选择。虽然混战不如标准 C1 型号强悍，C4 在对抗较轻的对手时仍能立足。Base

column1: The Catapult K2 is an outside-the-box redesign that trades the indirect-fire capability for heavier direct-fire PPCs. It doesn't usually mount Jump Jets, though, so it can be a bit more restricted in its use.
column2: 弹射器 K2 是一次跳出常规的重新设计，以更强的直射 PPC 取代间接火力能力。不过它通常不装跳跃推进器，因此在运用上稍有局限。Base

column1: An upgrade of the K2 Catapult, the K2K model changes the engine to an extralight model. The twin PPCs also have been upgraded to ER PPCs. The 'Mech carries two ER Medium Lasers for close range firepower. To handle the added heat from the upgrades, the 'Mech uses 20 double heat sinks. Finally, the K2K model carries thirteen and a half tons of armor. .
column2: K2K 型号是 K2 弹射器的升级，把引擎换成超轻型。双联 PPC 也升级为 ER PPC。机甲携带两门 ER 中型激光用于近程火力。为处理升级带来的额外热量，机甲使用 20 台双倍散热器。最后，K2K 型号携带十三吨半装甲。Base

column1: An upgrade of the K2 Catapult, the K2K model changes the engine to an extralight model. The twin PPCs also have been upgraded to ER PPCs. The 'Mech carries two ER Medium Lasers for close range firepower. To handle the added heat from the upgrades, the 'Mech uses 20 double heat sinks. Finally, the K2K model carries thirteen and a half tons of armor.
column2: K2K 型号是 K2 弹射器的升级，把引擎换成超轻型。双联 PPC 也升级为 ER PPC。机甲携带两门 ER 中型激光用于近程火力。为处理升级带来的额外热量，机甲使用 20 台双倍散热器。最后，K2K 型号携带十三吨半装甲。Base

column1: Though this design never reached full production, it was prototyped during the War of 3039. It upgrades the PPCs of the K2 to ER PPCs.
column2: 该设计从未进入量产，但在 3039 年战争期间被作成原型。它将 K2 的 PPC 升级为 ER PPC。Base

column1: Another Kuritan variant, the -K5 goes back to its roots by carrying two MRM-30 launchers as its primary weapon.
column2: 又一款库瑞塔变体，-K5 回归本源，以两具 MRM-30 发射器为主武器。Base

column1: CattleMaster
column2: 牧牛人

column1: The CattleMaster was created at the turn of the thirty-first century as an IndustrialMech to handle large herd animals. The concept for the Rancher 'Mech dates back to the twenty-fourth century. The 'Mech is noted for its durability and flexible Internal Combustion Engine.
column2: 牧牛人于三十一世纪之交被制造为工业机甲，用于处置大型畜群。这类"牧场主"机甲的概念可追溯至二十四世纪。此机甲以其耐用性和灵活的内燃引擎著称。Base

column1: Industrial Mech
column2: 工业机甲

column1: Bessie
column2: 贝茜

column1: The CattleMaster was created at the turn of the thirty-first century as an IndustrialMech to handle large herd animals. Being fed up by local Troublemakers and Pirates trying to steal his livestock, one farmer went and upgraded his Cattlemaster.
column2: 牧牛人于三十一世纪之交被制造为工业机甲，用于处置大型畜群。由于受够了当地捣蛋鬼和海盗试图偷窃他的牲畜，一位农场主升级了自己的牧牛人。Base

column1: Centurion
column2: 百夫长

column1: A primitive downgrade of the Centurion-9A commonly found among LowTech States and Bandits.
column2: 这是百夫长-9A 的原始降级版，在低技术国家和匪帮中很常见。Base

column1: A sturdy and reliable 'Mech, the Centurion is good at both taking and giving a beating. CN9-A2 models come with a UAC/10 and usually carry Hotloaded LRMs.
column2: 百夫长是一款坚固可靠的机甲，既能挨打也能打人。CN9-A2 型号配备一门 UAC/10，通常携带热装 LRM。Base

column1: A somewhat radical departure from the stock Centurion, the CN9-AH Variant trades out the stock AC10 and Medium Lasers for a single AC20.  While this amounts to the same degree of firepower, it has the benefit of concentrating the damage to a single location.
column2: CN9-AH 变体是对标准百夫长的较大偏离，它把标准 AC10 和中型激光换成一门 AC20。虽然火力总量相当，但它有利于把伤害集中在单一部位。Base

column1: The AH model gives the Centurion more of a focused punch, but I still prefer the original for keeping the OpFor at arm's reach.
column2: AH 型号赋予百夫长更集中的打击力，但我仍偏好原版，因为它能让对手保持在臂长之外。Base

column1: The AL variant of the Centurion tends to trade the larger burst damage of an Autocannon for more Energy weaponry and heavier armor. ALs can take an incredible amount of damage for their size but still pack a good punch.
column2: 百夫长的 AL 变体倾向于以自动炮较大的爆发伤害换取更多能量武器和更厚的装甲。AL 就其尺寸而言能承受惊人的伤害，同时打击力依然不错。Base

column1: A sturdy and reliable 'Mech, the Centurion is good at both taking and giving a beating. CN9-B1 models are able to engage at extreme range thanks to a Light Gauss Rifle and stay in the field with their AMS and Medium Shield.
column2: 百夫长是一款坚固可靠的机甲，既能挨打也能打人。CN9-B1 型号凭借一门轻型高斯步枪能在极远距离交战，并靠其 AMS 与中型盾牌留在战场。Base

column1: Flanker & Support
column2: 侧翼与支援

column1: The D variant of the Centurion, introduced in 3049, is the first of many upgrades using Star League technology. The chassis was re-engineered to use Endo Steel construction techniques. Next the power plant was changed from the standard engine to an GM 300 extralight engine, increasing its maximum speed to 97.2 km/h. Finally, the weapons were upgraded. The Autocannon/10 was swapped for a Mydron Excel LB-X Autocannon/10 and an Artemis IV fire control system was added to the LRM launcher. The two medium lasers were retained.
column2: 百夫长的 D 变体于 3049 年推出，是众多星盟科技升级中的首个。底盘经重新设计以采用内骨骼构造工艺。随后动力装置从标准引擎改为 GM 300 超轻型引擎，最高速度提升至 97.2 公里/小时。最后武器也获升级：自动炮/10 换成迈德龙 Excel LB-X 自动炮/10，LRM 发射器加装 Artemis IV 火控系统，两门中型激光予以保留。Base

column1: A sturdy and reliable 'Mech, the Centurion is good at both taking and giving a beating. CN9-D models are upgraded for a LB-X AC and Artemis supported MML.
column2: 百夫长是一款坚固可靠的机甲，既能挨打也能打人。CN9-D 型号升级为 LB-X AC 和 Artemis 支援的 MML。Base

column1: The CN9-D3 variant introduced in 3052 is identical to the CN9-D Centurion with one exceptional difference. The D3 uses Triple Strength Myomer to increase its top speed up to 118.8 kph while it is running hot.
column2: 3052 年推出的 CN9-D3 变体与 CN9-D 百夫长完全相同，只有一个特殊差异。D3 使用三倍强度人造肌，在过热运转时把最高速度提升至 118.8 公里/小时。Base

column1: The D3D variant of this 'Mech is a potent long-range sniper, first built in 3060. It uses the same chassis and engine combination as the D3 variant but uses MASC to augment its movement to give it a maximum speed of 129.6 kph. The primary weapon on the D3D is a Light Gauss Rifle. For added long range assistance, the 'Mech carries an LRM-10 launcher and for close range combat it carries an ER Medium Laser. This is all protected with eight tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor.
column2: 该机甲的 D3D 变体是威力强大的远程狙击型，于 3060 年首次建造。它使用与 D3 变体相同的底盘与引擎组合，但用 MASC 增强其移动，最高速度达 129.6 公里/小时。D3D 的主武器是一门轻型高斯步枪。为增强远程支援，机甲携带一具 LRM-10 发射器，混战则一门 ER 中型激光。这一切由八吨铁纤维装甲保护。Base

column1: The first purely Marian mech to come from hegemony Factories. It keeps costs down with both primitive armour and engine but counteracts this with a masive alpha from it's 40 Rockets.
column2: 这是首款完全由霸权工厂出品的马里安机甲。它以原始装甲和引擎压低成本，但用 40 枚火箭构成的巨型齐射来抵消这一劣势。Base

column1: Brawler & General Trooper
column2: 混战与通用士兵

column1: The armour is shit, the engine is shit but what do you expect from a slaver nation. It still can serve as a trooper in a pinch.
column2: 装甲是垃圾，引擎也是垃圾，但你对一个奴役者国家还能指望什么。不过必要时它仍能充当通用机。Base

column1: The Chameleon was designed to help a new MechWarrior master the skills of maneuvering and heat management, with a top speed of 97.2 kph and a jumping distance of one hundred and eighty meters. The 'Mech also had an almost all energy weapons loadout, but cooled only by ten standard heat sinks. This paucity of freezers forces MechWarriors to concentrate on the 'Mech's heat levels. In some instances, the Chameleon had been forced into combat situations, notably during the Dragoon Civil War. Production of the Chameleon halted briefly in 3052 when Defiance Industries decided to switch its production to the Nightsky, but was quickly resumed when J.B. BattleMechs Incorporated purchased the rights to the design. J.B. BattleMechs also introduced two battle-worthy variants of the Chameleon. The Chameleon is a training 'Mech, intended to simulate a variety of opponents by mounting a wide variety of weapon systems. A Chameleon is a medium 'Mech, but it doesn't always look like one. It can be fitted out with extra plates to modify its appearance, and carries special electronics to falsify its signature; these special abilities let it look and scan as something other than what it is, hence the machine's name.
column2: 变色龙旨在帮助新手机甲战士掌握机动与散热管理技巧，最高速度 97.2 公里/小时，跳跃距离一百八十米。该机甲还配备几乎全能量的武器配置，但仅由十台标准散热器冷却。散热器的匮乏迫使机甲战士专注于机甲的热量水平。某些情况下，变色龙被迫投入实战，尤其是在龙骑兵内战期间。变色龙的生产曾在 3052 年短暂中断，当时迪法恩斯工业决定将生产转向夜空，但在 J.B. 机甲公司购得该设计权后迅速恢复。J.B. 机甲还推出了两款具备战斗力的变色龙变体。变色龙是一款训练机甲，旨在通过搭载多种武器系统来模拟各类对手。变色龙是中型机甲，但不总是看起来像。它可以加装额外装甲板改变外观，并携带特殊电子设备伪造自身信号；这些特殊能力让它看起来和扫描起来都不像自己，因此得名。Base

column1: Scout
column2: 侦察兵

column1: The Chameleon carried a basic arsenal that allowed a MechWarrior-in-training to learn the skill of heat management. The 'Mech's reliable low-tech arsenal had proven effective when forced into combat. The primary weapon was a Cyclops Eye Large Laser. This was backed up by two Intek Medium Lasers and a trio of Defiance B3S Small Lasers. To make the threat of overheating more real to the new MechWarrior, the 'Mech carried two Scatter Gun Light Machine Guns that can be used for anti-infantry training.
column2: 变色龙携带基础武器库，让受训中的机甲战士学习散热管理技巧。机甲可靠的低技术武器库在被拖入战斗时证明有效。主武器是一门"独眼巨人眼"大型激光。它由两门英泰克中型激光和三门"迪法恩斯 B3S"小型激光支援。为使过热威胁对新手机甲战士更真实，机甲携带两挺"散射枪"轻型机枪，可用于反步兵训练。Base

column1: The 7W variant of the Chameleon looked to use the 'Mech in a full time combat role. The 'Mech had upgraded the Large Laser to an ER Large Laser. Additionally, the Machine Guns and Small Lasers had been removed and replaced with a Medium Pulse Laser and double heat sinks.
column2: 变色龙 7W 变体试图让机甲承担全职战斗角色。机甲把大型激光升级为 ER 大型激光。此外，机枪和小型激光被移除，换成一门中型脉冲激光和双倍散热器。Base

column1: Another combat variant of the Chameleon, the 7Z carried as its primary weapons two Large Lasers and a single ER Large Laser. The 7Z carried no other secondary weapons on its chassis and used twelve double heat sinks to handle its massive heat load.
column2: 作为变色龙的另一战斗变体，7Z 以两门大型激光和一门 ER 大型激光为主武器。7Z 底盘上没有其他次要武器，并使用十二台双倍散热器处理其庞大热负荷。Base

column1: (also referred to as the CHM-3 Chameleon Training Scout) A formerly common but now obscure training 'Mech, the TRC-4B was armed with one Large Laser, two Medium Lasers, four Small Lasers and two Machine Guns. With only 10 normal heat sinks this 'Mech was quite prone to overheating.
column2: （又称 CHM-3 变色龙训练侦察型）TRC-4B 曾是常见而如今鲜为人知的训练机甲，装备一门大型激光、两门中型激光、四门小型激光和两挺机枪。由于只有 10 台普通散热器，这台机甲极易过热。Base

column1: Champion
column2: 冠军

column1: Where the CHP-2N is the downgraded Succession Wars variant of the Champion, the -1N is the fully powered Star League variant and is the original one the designers introduced. The high speed for a mech its size remains as does the somewhat anemic armor, the main benefit the mech gets from Star League technology is found in the weaponry: a LB-10X Autocannon, a SRM 6 with an Artemis IV system, and a pair each of Medium and Small Lasers. Otherwise, the -1N is much the same as the -2N and performs the same in many ways.
column2: CHP-2N 是冠军在继承战争中的降级版，而-1N 则是完整的星盟版本，也是设计师最初推出的原始型号。对如此尺寸的机甲而言速度依旧很高，装甲依然略显单薄，机甲从星盟科技中获得的主要好处体现在武器上：一门 LB-10X 自动炮、一具配 Artemis IV 系统的 SRM 6，以及成对的中型与小型激光。除此之外，-1N 与-2N 大体相同，表现也多有相似。Base

column1: Heavy Recon and Striker
column2: 重型侦察与打击者

column1: During the Star League when the Champion-1N was in full production, there was a frequent pilot modification that turned into a production variant. This mech, the -1N2, is exactly the same as the -1N with the exception of the heat sinks, which have been upgraded to doubles. In all other respects, the -1N2 is the same as the -1N.
column2: 星盟时期，冠军-1N 全速生产时，有一种常见的机师改装后来变成了量产变体。这台机甲就是-1N2，除散热器升级为双倍外，与-1N 完全相同。其他方面-1N2 与-1N 一致。Base

column1: Royal Champion
column2: 皇家冠军

column1: A variant reserved for SLDF Royal units, this Champion was introduced in 2751 and replaces all the standard weaponry with a Gauss Rifle and ER PPC. It also uses double heat sinks. This gave the -1Nb an extremely long range weapon profile and a serious punch while also solving its heat issues.
column2: 这是为星盟防卫军皇家部队保留的变体，2751 年推出，将所有标准武器换成一门高斯步枪和一门 ER PPC。它还使用双倍散热器。这使-1Nb 拥有极远射程的武器配置和强悍打击力，同时解决了散热问题。Base

column1: Heavy Recon and Sniper
column2: 重型侦察与狙击

column1: The Champion debuted in 2602 as a generalist combat 'Mech with a focus on heavy reconnaissance and fast strike capabilities. While definitely faster and more maneuverable than other heavy 'Mechs, it was criticized by many for being too large, underarmed and underarmored. The armament on the Champion is considered by many to be feeble for its size, especially after losing its advanced technology from the Star League. Carrying an AC/10, a SRM 6, and a pair each of Medium and Small Lasers, the Champion is woefully underarmed for its size.
column2: 冠军于 2602 年首次亮相，是一款通用战斗机甲，侧重重型侦察与快速打击能力。虽然确实比其他重型机甲更快更灵活，它却被许多人批评体型过大、武装与装甲不足。许多人认为冠军的武器就其尺寸而言过于孱弱，尤其在失去星盟的先进技术之后。它携带一门 AC/10、一具 SRM 6，以及成对的中型与小型激光，就尺寸而言武装弱得可怜。Base

column1: Charger
column2: 冲锋者

column1: The Charger is seen as an example of abject failure in BattleMech design. Wells Technologies originally wanted to produce an ultra-heavy scout 'Mech for the Star League Defense Force that was not only fast but could survive contact with the enemy. This was done by building the Charger on an 80-ton frame, making it the heaviest scout 'Mech in existence, and powering it with a massive LTV 400 fusion engine that took up almost sixty percent of the Charger's mass. With a top speed which allowed it to outrun most other 'Mechs the Charger was then given ten tons of Durallex Heavy armor, enough to survive repeated hits from a Class 20 Autocannon. However these features left very little room for offensive capability, an intentional deficiency on the part of the design team as they saw any task other than gathering data a distraction.
column2: 冲锋者被视为战斗机甲设计中彻底失败的例子。威尔斯科技原本想为星盟防卫军生产一款超重型侦察机甲，不仅快速，还能在与敌接触中存活。为此他们把冲锋者建在 80 吨骨架上，使其成为现存最重的侦察机甲，并以一台占据冲锋者近百分之六十质量的巨大 LTV 400 聚变引擎驱动。凭借使其能跑赢大多数其他机甲的极高速度，冲锋者随后获得十吨杜拉莱克斯重型装甲，足以反复承受 20 级自动炮的命中。然而这些特性几乎没给进攻能力留下空间——这是设计团队有意为之的缺陷，因为他们认为除收集数据之外的任何任务都是干扰。Base

column1: Heavy Scout & Harasser
column2: 重型侦察与骚扰

column1: Because the designers of the Charger wanted to discourage any activities that would put the 'Mech in danger, the engineers at Wells Technologies equipped the Charger with five Magna Mk I Small Lasers, mounted in its arms, torso and head. As these leave the 'Mech dangerously undergunned, arguably its most potent weapons are its fists; if the Charger is able to close the distance and get within hand-to-hand combat, it is more than capable of pounding to pieces other 'Mechs, especially lightweight ones.
column2: 由于冲锋者的设计者想阻止任何让机甲陷入危险的活动，威尔斯科技的工程师为冲锋者装备了五门玛格纳 Mk I 小型激光，装在臂部、躯干和头部。这让机甲火力严重不足，因此可以说它最有力的武器是拳头；若冲锋者能拉近距离进入混战，它完全有能力把其他机甲——尤其是轻型机甲——砸成碎片。Base

column1: The 1A5 variant of the Charger was one of the first variants of the Charger made to take it from the role of scout to assault 'Mech. A Capellan modification to the CGR-1Ls they received as part of the Kapteyn Accords, the engine was downgraded to a 320 version, which reduced the maximum speed of the 'Mech to 64.8 km/h, and four of the small lasers were removed. In their place was a Tomodzuru Autocannon/20 as its primary weapon, two Bical SRM-6 launchers and an Argra 3L Medium Laser, while the 'Mech's armor was increased by five tons. This made the CGR-1A5 extremely dangerous at close ranges and gave it a speed comparable to most 'Mechs in the heavy weight class, while carrying armor on par with other eighty-ton 'Mechs.
column2: 冲锋者 1A5 变体是最早把冲锋者从侦察角色转变为突击机甲的变体之一。它是卡佩兰对作为卡普坦协定一部分所获 CGR-1L 的改装，引擎降级为 320 版本，把机甲最高速度降至 64.8 公里/小时，并移除四门小型激光。取而代之的是作为主武器的"友鹤"自动炮/20、两具比卡尔 SRM-6 发射器和一门阿尔格拉 3L 中型激光，机甲装甲增加五吨。这使 CGR-1A5 在近程极为危险，速度可与多数重型机甲相当，同时装甲与其他八十吨机甲持平。Base

column1: Assault & Brawler
column2: 突击与混战

column1: A Combine-LAW attempt to make the Charger more effective at long ranges, the 1A9 used a reduced 320-rated engine, lowering its top speed to 64.8 km/h, and its arsenal was overhauled. All of the smaller lasers (except for the head mounted one) were replaced with medium lasers and a single LRM-20 launcher was mounted in the right torso, with two tons of reloads carried in the left torso. To make up for the lost mobility, four jump jets were also installed, two in each leg, to allow the Charger to jump up to one hundred and twenty meters. This variant was fielded in time to surprise the Armed Forces of the Federated Suns during the War of 3039, but in years since the design fell into the hands of the Outworlds Alliance thanks to a legal snafu which gave Ravenna Electronics a production license.
column2: 1A9 是联合体-LAW 为使冲锋者在远程更有效所做的尝试，它采用缩小的 320 级引擎，把最高速度降至 64.8 公里/小时，并全面改造了武器库。所有较小激光（除头部那门）都换成中型激光，右躯干安装一具 LRM-20 发射器，左躯干携带两吨再装填。为弥补丧失的机动性，还安装了四个跳跃推进器（每腿两个），使冲锋者可跳跃至一百二十米。该变体及时投入战场，在 3039 年战争中令联邦太阳系武装部队大为意外，但此后数年因一次法律纠纷授予雷文纳电子生产许可，该设计落入外域联盟之手。Base

column1: Support & Skirmisher
column2: 支援与游骑

column1: An export model sold to the Capellan Confederation as part of the Kapteyn Accords, the CGR-1L was a simple modification of the Charger in an attempt to make it more effective following their disastrous use on Chara in 3023. In place of four and a half tons of armor and all five Small Lasers, the 1L mounts a Large Laser in its right arm and two medium lasers in either side torso. While more prone to overheating and less protected - mounting armor comparable to that of a traditional scout 'Mech - it was better capable of defending itself against other scout 'Mechs, and at the time that was good enough for the desperate warriors of the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces. Since then, the CGR-1L has remained in Capellan service as a training 'Mech and, according to rumor, punishment assignment for dissident soldiers.
column2: CGR-1L 是作为卡普坦协定一部分出售给卡佩兰邦联的出口型号，是对冲锋者的简单改装，试图在 3023 年查拉星上的灾难性使用之后让它更有效。1L 以四吨半装甲和全部五门小型激光为代价，在右臂装一门大型激光，两侧躯干各两门中型激光。虽然更易过热、防护也更差——装甲水平堪比传统侦察机甲——但它更能抵御其他侦察机甲，而在当时，对卡佩兰邦联武装部队绝望的战士而言已经足够。此后 CGR-1L 一直留在卡佩兰服役，作为训练机甲，据传也是对付异见士兵的惩罚性差事。Base

column1: Heavy Scout & Sniper
column2: 重型侦察与狙击

column1: This radical modification looks to turn the Charger into a traditional assault 'Mech by reducing the 'Mechs speed to 54 km/h, which allows the use of a smaller engine (incidentally, the commonplace Pitban 240 reactor). The 'Mech is armored with fifteen and a half tons of armor and is armed with four Large Lasers, one in each arm and side torso, and a Medium Laser in its head; twenty-eight heat sinks kept the 'Mech cool.
column2: 这项激进的改装试图把冲锋者变成传统的突击机甲：将机甲速度降至 54 公里/小时，从而得以使用更小的引擎（顺带一提，是常见的皮特班 240 反应堆）。机甲披挂十五吨半装甲，武装为四门大型激光（每臂与每侧躯干各一）以及头部一门中型激光；二十八台散热器使机甲保持凉爽。Base

column1: Called Challenger by its designers, the -SB modification is not remarkable because it is not particularly difficult to apply.  Using a common and well-know reactor in the refit and essentially only upgrading the existing lasers to heavier versions, in turn requiring the Targeting-Tracking System to be tampered with.
column2: -SB 改装被设计者称为"挑战者"，它并不起眼，因为实施起来并不特别困难。改装中使用了常见且知名的反应堆，本质上只是把现有激光升级为更重的版本，相应地需要对瞄准追踪系统进行调整。Base

column1: Cicada
column2: 知了

column1: In all honesty, Cicadas as a rule are very fragile. The 2A model was designed to be as fast as any light 'Mech, but that massive engine leaves little room for much else. Still, if you use it cautiously, it can be a successful scout and diversion.
column2: 说实话，蝉总体上非常脆弱。2A 型号被设计得与任何轻型机甲一样快，但那台庞大的引擎几乎没给其他东西留下空间。不过只要谨慎使用，它仍能成为成功的侦察与佯动机甲。Base

column1: Scout & Harasser
column2: 侦察兵 & 骚扰手

column1: A swap out of the 2A's Small Laser and half a ton of armor for a Flamer, this 'Mech can be quickly maneuvered in to heat up an opponent that is already having issues.
column2: 它以一台火焰喷射器换掉 2A 的小型激光和半吨装甲，可以迅速机动上去给本就散热吃紧的对手再加把火。Base

column1: Not much of an improvement over the 2A model, if anything, the removal of half a ton of armor just makes you a bit more vulnerable.
column2: 相比 2A 型号没什么改进，反而移除半吨装甲只让你更脆弱一点。Base

column1: A typical Periphery raider, the Cicada 2P is fast and hard hitting but lacks endurance and cannot survive long once it has delivered it's payload. 4 RL-20's make up the bulk of the mechs firepower, capable of threatening even an Assault mech if used correctly. The secondary weapons are a pair of medium chem lasers with a ton of ammo between them. Achieving almost identical speeds to its Inner Sphere counterparts, the 2P is designed as a heavy scout and head hunter with a nasty alpha strike capable of shredding most opponents regardless of the target. Designed to be easy to maintain and even easier to replace, the 2P is built with parts that can be salvaged from most battlefields or brought in any number of back street bazaars or disreputable arms markets. Indeed, most new 2P’s are often repurposed wrecks hauled off the battlefield and rebuilt as quickly as possible.
column2: 蝉 2P 是典型的外围区袭扰型，速度快、打击狠，但缺乏耐久，一旦倾泻完弹药就难以久撑。4 具 RL-20 构成机甲火力的主体，运用得当甚至能威胁突击机甲。次要武器是两门中型化学激光，共一吨弹药。2P 的速度几乎与内天体同类相当，被设计为重型侦察与猎头机甲，具备凶悍的全力齐射，不论目标是谁都能撕碎大多数对手。它易于维护、更易替换，用可从大多数战场回收或在任何后街集市、不名誉军火市场上买到的零件建造。事实上，大多数新的 2P 都是被拖离战场的残骸重新拼装，尽快重建而成。Base

column1: Head Hunter
column2: 猎头者

column1: A typical Periphery raider, the Cicada 2P is fast and hard hitting but lacks endurance and cannot survive long once it has delivered it's payload. 4 RL-20's make up the bulk of the mechs firepower, capable of threatening even an Assualt mech if used correctly. The secondary weapons are a pair of medium chem lasers with a ton of ammo between them. Achieving almost identical speeds to its Inner Sphere counterparts, the 2P is designed as a heavy scout and head hunter with a nasty alpha strike capable of shredding most opponents regardless of the target. Designed to be easy to maintain and even easier to replace, the 2P is built with parts that can be salvaged from most battlefields or brought in any number of back street bazaars or disreputable arms markets. Indeed, most new 2P’s are often repurposed wrecks hauled off the battlefield and rebuilt as quickly as possible.
column2: 蝉 2P 是典型的外围区劫掠者，快速且打击凶狠，但缺乏耐力，一旦投出载荷便无法长久生存。4 具 RL-20 构成机甲的主要火力，若运用得当甚至能威胁突击机甲。次要武器是两门中型化学激光，共配一吨弹药。2P 的速度几乎与内天体同类相当，被设计为重型侦察兵与猎头者，其凶猛的齐射足以撕裂大多数对手，无论目标为何。2P 为易于维护、更易于替换而设计，其部件可从大多数战场回收，或从任意后巷集市和不入流的军火市场弄到。事实上，多数新的 2P 往往是从战场拖回的报废机体被尽快重建而成。Base

column1: The Cicada 3C is slightly slower than the 2A but has more room for weaponry and armor. It still generally underperforms in most areas except speed, but it can put up more of a fight, with better survival rates.
column2: 蝉 3C 比 2A 略慢，但有更多空间容纳武器和装甲。除速度外它在多数方面仍普遍表现不佳，但它更能一战，生存率也更高。Base

column1: A somewhat unusual design, this fire support mech is popular among the more advanced periphery states and with many mercenary commands. Refitting a standard 2A with an XL Engine, Gibson Federated stripped the weapons and replaced them with a pair of LRM-15’s and 3 tons of ammunition. Conceived as a relatively cheap support mech, with the speed to keep up with lighter scout elements and enough ammunition to last most engagements, it has maintained steady sales since it’s introduction and convinced Gibson to refit one of their older 2A production lines; to produce this variant. Deployed by everyone from the FWL to the Outworlds Alliance, this mech has been spreading across the IS and is a common sight among defensive garrisons. Critics of the design note it’s lack of armour and CASE whilst proponents praise it’s low cost and tactical flexibility.
column2: 这是一款略显另类的设计，这款火力支援机甲在较先进的外围区国家和许多佣兵部队中颇受欢迎。吉布森联邦将一个标准 2A 换上 XL 引擎，拆除武器代之以两具 LRM-15 和三吨弹药。它被构想为一款相对廉价的支援机甲，速度足以跟上轻型侦察部队，弹药也足以支撑大多数交战，自推出以来销量稳定，并说服吉布森改装了他们一条较老的 2A 生产线以生产此变体。从自由世界联盟到外域联盟都在部署，这款机甲已遍布内天体，在防御驻军中十分常见。批评者指出它缺乏装甲与 C.A.S.E.，支持者则称赞其低成本与战术灵活性。Base

column1: The 3F Cicada is one of the most advanced versions of this 'Mech, its upgrades based on combat reports from the front lines of the Clan Invasion, and was introduced in 3052. The chassis has been constructed using Endo Steel construction techniques and the 'Mech is protected with six and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. The 3F is powered by an extralight engine and carries a weapons loadout that appears to be a cross between the 2A and 3C models. The primary weapon is an ER PPC, which is backed up by two medium lasers. What's more the Cicada can now jump up to two hundred and forty meters thanks to the inclusion of eight jump jets.
column2: 3F 蝉是该机甲最先进的版本之一，其升级基于氏族入侵前线的战斗报告，于 3052 年推出。底盘采用内骨骼建造技术，机甲由六吨半铁纤维装甲保护。3F 由超轻型引擎驱动，武器配置看起来介于 2A 与 3C 型号之间。主武器是一门 ER PPC，辅以两门中型激光。更重要的是，得益于八个跳跃推进器的加入，蝉如今能跳起至二百四十米。Base

column1: Based off of the same chassis as the 3F, the 3G was introduced in 3056 to transform the chassis into a more dedicated recon platform. It trades in the PPC for an ER Large Laser, a Beagle Active Probe, and additional armor.
column2: 3G 与 3F 使用相同底盘，于 3056 年推出，旨在把底盘改造为更专注的侦察平台。它把 PPC 换成 ER 大型激光、比格犬主动探测器和额外装甲。Base

column1: A Combine rebuild of captured 3E’s, this design swaps the LRM-15’s for a pair of MRM-20’s and 2 tons of ammo, augmented by an Artemis IV system. Assigned to the Ghost Regiments and the Legions of Vega, these Cicadas are typically employed as scout-skirmishers and scout hunters. Unfortunately the limited ammo and lack of serious protection has lead to many mechwarriors petitioning for reassignment to other units or refusing to pilot these mechs. The Procurement Department on the other hand, is thrilled that it can offload these retrofitted Cicadas to units who have no choice in the matter. Nonetheless pilots who can master this design, report satisfaction with it’s performance and many have turned to field conversions to improve it’s endurance. The most commonly one reported is the installation of an Endosteel skeleton allowing another ton of ammo or the installation CASE II.
column2: 这款设计是联合体对缴获 3E 的重建，把 LRM-15 换成一对 MRM-20 和 2 吨弹药，并加装 Artemis IV 系统。这些蝉被配属给幽灵团与维加军团，通常作为侦察散兵和侦察猎手使用。遗憾的是，有限的弹药和缺乏像样的防护导致许多机甲战士申请调往其他单位或拒绝驾驶这些机甲。另一方面，采购部门却为能把这些改装蝉甩给别无选择的单位而欣喜若狂。尽管如此，能驾驭此设计的机师报告对其性能满意，许多人转而进行野战改装以提升其续航力。最常被报告的改装是安装内骨骼骨架以多带一吨弹药，或加装 C.A.S.E. II。Base

column1: The Cicada 3L is a succession war refit turning it into a fire support platform.
column2: 蝉 3L 是继承战争时期的改装型，将其改造为火力支援平台。Base

column1: The 3M upgrade of this older BattleMech uses some of the newest technology available at its introduction in 3049. It uses an extralight version of the same Pitban 320 engine, freeing up extra space to upgrade the small laser to a Small Pulse Laser and adding an Ultra Autocannon/5 to the left torso. The new ballistic weapon is fed by one ton of ammunition stored in the right torso and protected by CASE in the event of an ammunition explosion. The Star Slab armor has also been replaced with Durallex Light, although the amount of protection is the same as in the 2A.
column2: 这款较老战斗机甲的 3M 升级版使用了 3049 年推出时可获得的部分最新技术。它采用同款皮特班 320 引擎的超轻型版本，腾出额外空间把小型激光升级为小型脉冲激光，并在左躯干加装一门超速自动炮/5。这门新实弹武器由右躯干储存的一吨弹药供弹，并在弹药爆炸时由 C.A.S.E. 保护。"星板"装甲也已换成杜拉莱克斯轻型，尽管防护量与 2A 相同。Base

column1: The Cicada 4L is yet another refit born from a shortage of proper parts. It carries two Light Rifles with two tons of ammo.
column2: 蝉 4L 又是一个因缺乏合适零件而生的改装型。它携带两门轻型步枪和两吨弹药。Base

column1: Clint
column2: 克林特

column1: This was once a Clint mech, but now it has spikes all over and it's current weapons, that either fire or blow up in your face.
column2: 这曾经是一台克林特机甲，但现在浑身是尖刺，武器不是开火就是炸你一脸。Base

column1: Pirate Mech
column2: 海盗机甲

column1: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty meters, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. The 1-2R Clint was the original prototype variant that carried an Armstrong Buster Autocannon/10 with a single Medium Laser as a secondary weapon and no jump jets.
column2: 克林特主要被设计为廉价的侦察单位，具备武装良好的入门级中量级机甲的能力，在这方面它表现出色。凭借 97.2 公里/小时的最高速度和一百八十米的跳跃能力，克林特能轻松跟上其他侦察单位，并能穿越山地或城市地形。1-2R 克林特是最初的原型变体，携带一门阿姆斯特朗"破坏者"自动炮/10，以一门中型激光为次要武器，且没有跳跃推进器。Base

column1: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty meters, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. The 2-2R Clint is an even more cheap refit of the original variant, equipping primitive, cheaper weaponry, that periphery states can afford.
column2: 克林特主要被设计为廉价的侦察单位，具备武装良好的入门级中量级机甲的能力，在这方面它表现出色。凭借 97.2 公里/小时的最高速度和一百八十米的跳跃能力，克林特能轻松跟上其他侦察单位，并能穿越山地或城市地形。2-2R 克林特是原变体更为廉价的改装版，装备原始而便宜的武器，是外围区国家负担得起的。Base

column1: Primitive Mech
column2: 原始机甲

column1: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty meters, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. The Clint 2-3T equipped with one Autocannon/5 with one ton of ammunition. As secondary weapons, the Clint carries two Martell Medium Lasers. This well-balanced mix of weapons when combined with the Clint's above-average maneuverability for its size make the Clint a highly effective multi-role BattleMech.
column2: 克林特主要被设计为廉价的侦察单位，具备武装良好的入门级中量级机甲的能力，在这方面它表现出色。凭借 97.2 公里/小时的最高速度和一百八十米的跳跃能力，克林特能轻松跟上其他侦察单位，并能穿越山地或城市地形。克林特 2-3T 装备一门自动炮/5，配一吨弹药。作为次要武器，克林特携带两门马特尔中型激光。这种均衡的武器搭配结合克林特同尺寸中高于平均的机动性，使克林特成为极为高效的多用途战斗机甲。Base

column1: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty meters, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. The Clint 2-3U is a Capellan field upgrade of the Clint that strips all of the armaments from the chassis and replaces them with more potent and enduring weaponry, the most radical of which is the primary weapon. The AC/5 has been replaced with an ER PPC while both the Medium Lasers were replaced with Medium Pulse Lasers; as a result, it runs much hotter than the original. The 3U also packs double heat sinks in place of single models and is more deadly in combat.
column2: 克林特主要被设计为廉价的侦察单位，具备武装良好的入门级中量级机甲的能力，在这方面它表现出色。凭借 97.2 公里/小时的最高速度和一百八十米的跳跃能力，克林特能轻松跟上其他侦察单位，并能穿越山地或城市地形。克林特 2-3U 是克林特的卡佩兰野战升级型，它剥离底盘上全部武器，换上更强劲耐久的装备，其中最激进的是主武器。AC/5 换成 ER PPC，两门中型激光则换成中型脉冲激光；因此它比原版热得多。3U 还以双倍散热器取代单散热器，在战斗中更为致命。Base

column1: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty meters, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. This variant of the Clint carries two Autocannon/2s in place of the single AC/5, giving it one of the longest ranges possible on such a small chassis. It also bears a single Medium Laser as a secondary weapon. Like the 1-2R variant, the 2-4T also has no jumping capability.
column2: 克林特主要被设计为廉价的侦察单位，具备武装良好的入门级中量级机甲的能力，在这方面它表现出色。凭借 97.2 公里/小时的最高速度和一百八十米的跳跃能力，克林特能轻松跟上其他侦察单位，并能穿越山地或城市地形。此克林特变体以两门自动炮/2 取代单门 AC/5，在如此小的底盘上拥有最远的射程之一。它还携带一门中型激光作为次要武器。与 1-2R 变体一样，2-4T 也没有跳跃能力。Base

column1: When General Aleksandr Kerensky led most of the Star League Defense Force into exile in 2784, they brought prototypes of the Clint BattleMech with them. After the annihilation of Clan Wolverine, Clan Snow Raven revisited these prototypes and was able to begin mass-production of the 'Mech in 2830 and introduced 2842. They ensured that it kept up with advances in Clan technology, eventually becoming the design that is now known as the Clint IIC. This speedy medium 'Mech is armed with a Type KOV LB-10X Autocannon and a pair of Series 2d ER Medium Lasers. This makes the Clint IIC an effective light 'Mech killer. It is capable of ranging far beyond supply lines thanks to its four tons of ammunition, though it only uses ten standard heat sinks and seven tons of standard armor.
column2: 2784 年亚历山大·克伦斯基将军率领星盟防卫军大部流亡时，带上了克林特战斗机甲的原型机。在狼獾氏族被灭绝后，雪鸦氏族重新审视这些原型，于 2830 年得以开始量产并于 2842 年推出。他们确保其跟上氏族技术的进步，最终演变为如今被称为克林特 IIC 的设计。这款高速中型机甲装备一门 KOV 型 LB-10X 自动炮和两门 2d 系列 ER 中型激光，使其成为高效的轻型机甲杀手。凭借四吨弹药，它能远离补给线长期作战，不过它仅使用十台标准散热器和七吨标准装甲。Base

column1: Clan Sniper & Light Brawler
column2: 氏族狙击手与轻型混战

column1: Commando
column2: 突击手

column1: The original Commando used prototype equipment that was similarly primitive to those found in the first BattleMech, the Mackie. This version was completely replaced by its successor. First constructed in 2463, the 'Mech was equipped with only an Odin Large Laser mounted in its right arm.
column2: 原版突击队员使用与首款战斗机甲"麦基"同样原始的原型装备。此版本已被其继任者完全取代。该机甲于 2463 年首次建造，仅装备右臂一门奥丁大型激光。Base

column1: Light Sniper & Scout
column2: 轻型狙击手 & 侦察兵

column1: The Large Laser mounted by most 1B models is nothing to sniff at, but it lacks the close-up impact of the SRMs it replaces. Best to keep these units at range for flanking and spotting.
column2: 大多数 1B 型号装备的大型激光不容小觑，但它缺乏被它取代的 SRM 那种近距离冲击力。最好让这些单位保持距离，用于侧翼包抄和目标指示。Base

column1: The Commando 1C is a recent variant that attempts to make a long range direct fire support unit, by removing the missiles and replacing them with a single AC2 in the right arm.
column2: 突击队员 1C 是近期变体，试图打造一款远程直射支援单位：它移除导弹，在右臂换上一门 AC2。Base

column1: The predesessor to the 2D, the Commando 1D was meant to give the MechWarrior a little more long range punch with a Large Laser. at the cost of some of its armor.  While the 2D is superior in most aspects, there are still a number of this older design still in service today.
column2: 作为 2D 的前身，突击队员 1D 意在用一门大型激光为机甲战士提供更多远程打击力，代价是部分装甲。虽然 2D 在多数方面更优，但这款较老设计至今仍有不少在役。Base

column1: You don't see many of these outside of Lyran space.  While I like the added range, the reduced armor and increased heat profile make this a troublesome 'Mech.  There is a reason they moved on to the 2D.
column2: 在莱兰空间之外你见不到多少这种机甲。虽然我喜欢它增加的射程，但减少的装甲和升高的热量曲线使它成为一台麻烦的机甲。他们转向 2D 是有原因的。Base

column1: Dubbed the 'Blazing Inferno', this variant of the 2D chassis removes all the missiles and instead adds three more Medium Lasers and six Small Lasers, along with an extra ton of armor.
column2: 此变体绰号"炽烈地狱"，基于 2D 底盘，移除全部导弹，改为加装三门中型激光和六门小型激光，以及额外一吨装甲。Base

column1: When the say Inferno, no one realized they were referring to the temperature inside the cockpit.  I suggest removing some of the lasers and adding a heat sink or two.
column2: 当人们说"燃烧弹"时，没人意识到他们指的是驾驶舱内的温度。我建议移除一些激光，加一两台散热器。Base

column1: With all those SRMs, the COM-2D is like a small, highly mobile shotgun that can take down 'Mechs twice its size or bigger. You've gotta be careful with it, though, because it's not meant to take much of a beating.
column2: 凭借这些 SRM，COM-2D 就像一把小型、高度机动的霰弹枪，能放倒体型两倍于己或更大的机甲。不过你得小心使用，因为它经不起多少打击。Base

column1: In 3055 the Taurian Concordat's Vandenburg Mechanized Industries produced limited runs of this factory refit of the Commando COM-2D using stealth and sensor packages imported from the Cappelan Confederation. While the result was an effective scout, with respectable ambush capabilities, the expense compared to the base model, and the difficulties of multinational production, kept it from widespread adoption.
column2: 3055 年，陶里安协约的范登堡机械化工业公司限量生产了这款突击队 COM-2D 的工厂改装型，使用从卡佩兰邦联进口的隐形与传感器组件。成果是一款有效的侦察机甲，具备可观的伏击能力，但与基础型号相比的高昂成本以及跨国生产的困难，使其未能被广泛采用。Base

column1: Well Commander, as outfitted from the factory it's certainly a superior Commando. At the chassis level it's not much different than it's cheaper cousins. But the custom Null Signature system puts it on another level.
column2: 嗯，指挥官，按出厂配置它的确是一台更优秀的突击队员。在底盘层面它与其较廉价的表亲区别不大。但定制的"虚无信号"系统让它上升到了另一个层次。Base

column1: The Commando 2I features modified SRMs with an Inferno payload. This pirate favorite is notorious for its ability to harass and disable, while also packing a punch with its two RL-10s.
column2: 突击队员 2I 采用装有燃烧弹载荷的改装 SRM。这款海盗最爱以骚扰与瘫痪能力而臭名昭著，同时凭借两具 RL-10 也有相当打击力。Base

column1: A very recent variant, the 3A mounts a pair of SRM-6 racks and supplements its close in firepower with a Flamer.  It is an excellent quick strike 'Mech, but suffers in drawn out fights due to a limited supply of ammunition for the SRMs.
column2: 3A 是极新的变体，装备一对 SRM-6 挂架，并以一具火焰喷射器补充其近距火力。它是出色的快速打击机甲，但由于 SRM 弹药有限，在持久战中会吃亏。Base

column1: For a light 'Mech, the COM-3A can dish out a lot of damage in a single volley.  Though it is bound to chew up that ammo faster than my crew would go through a case of Triple-F Burgers.
column2: 作为轻型机甲，COM-3A 单次齐射就能造成大量伤害。不过它肯定会比我手下那帮人吃"三重 F 汉堡"还快地耗光弹药。Base

column1: The Commando 4H is the Marian Hegemony's primary garrison mech, often sent out against pirates twice the weight with surprising success. 90 Rockets ensure that even out weighed it isn't out gunned.
column2: 突击队员 4H 是马里安霸权的首要驻防机甲，常被派去对抗两倍重量的海盗并取得惊人成功。90 枚火箭确保它即便体重落于下风，火力也不落于下风。Base

column1: The Commando 4H is a periphery pilots dream as far as light mechs go. All mechs are equal under such a ridiculous rocket barrage.
column2: 就轻型机甲而言，突击队员 4H 是外围区机师的梦想。在如此荒谬的火箭弹幕之下，所有机甲都是平等的。Base

column1: The COM-5S was introduced in 3050 and was the first Commando to feature Star League technology. Its new Cyclops MultiTasker 10 Targeting System links an Artemis IV Fire Control System to the Coventry 90 mm SRM-6, which replaces the Shannon Six-Shooter, and exchanges the SRM-4 with a Coventry T4H Streak SRM-2 launcher. Additionally, the chassis has been upgraded with Endo Steel, the armor has been upgraded to Ferro-Fibrous, and CASE has been added to protect the ammunition.
column2: COM-5S 于 3050 年推出，是首款采用星盟科技的突击队。其新的独眼巨人 MultiTasker 10 瞄准系统将 Artemis IV 火控系统与考文垂 90 毫米 SRM-6（取代香农六发左轮）联动，并将 SRM-4 换成考文垂 T4H 连续 SRM-2 发射器。此外底盘升级为内骨骼，装甲升级为铁纤维，并加装 C.A.S.E. 保护弹药。Base

column1: This update of the COM-5S introduced in 3059 is also built on an Endo Steel chassis but uses a new Light Fusion engine. The 'Mech carries two Streak SRM-2 launchers, an SRM-4 with an Artemis IV Fire Control System, and an ER Medium Laser in each arm
column2: 3059 年推出的这款 COM-5S 更新版同样建立在内骨骼底盘上，但采用新的轻型聚变引擎。机甲携带两具连续 SRM-2 发射器、一具配 Artemis IV 火控系统的 SRM-4，每臂各一门 ER 中型激光

column1: During the Amaris Civil War, several Lyran MechWarriors joined the SLDF in defiance of their government's policy of neutrality. With this came the coup that the Star League Defense Force had attempted to pull off for decades: the acquisition of the Lyran Commando. Long considered one of the better scout 'Mechs in the Inner Sphere, at least one of these Commandos accompanied Kerensky into exile and several of them appeared in the forces assigned to Operation Klondike. As newer weapons and 'Mechs made their way into the Clan arsenal, these Commandos began to show their age, so Clan Goliath Scorpion began a program to upgrade theirs. Dubbed the Commando IIC, this upgrade used newer technologies to outperform its venerable cousin. With the proliferation of OmniMechs, most Commando IICs were relegated to second line status, though the Scorpions still continue to outfit some of their pirate hunters with these 'Mechs.
column2: 阿马里斯内战期间，数名莱兰机甲战士不顾政府中立政策加入星盟防卫军。随之而来的是星盟防卫军数十年来一直试图实现的目标：获得莱兰突击队。突击队长期被视为内天体最好的侦察机甲之一，至少有一台随克伦斯基流亡，数台出现在"克朗代克行动"的部队中。随着更新式武器与机甲进入氏族武库，这些突击队开始显露老态，于是歌利亚蝎氏族启动了升级计划。命名为突击队 IIC，该升级利用更新技术超越了它古老的表亲。随着全能机甲普及，大多数突击队 IIC 退居二线，但蝎氏族仍继续用它们装备部分猎杀海盗的部队。Base

column1: Clan BattleMech
column2: 氏族战斗机甲

column1: Copperhead
column2: 铜头蛇

column1: First produced in late fall of 3054, the Copperhead is a finely honed arena 'Mech. The design rose to fame when Silver Dragons Stables MechWarrior Brendon Frazer piloted his Copperhead, the Silver Snake, into the Solaris Top Twenty prior to his untimely death. The Silver Dragons commissioned Solaris Arms to develop a new exclusive variant to try and repeat the feat, but the new model's expensive experimental weaponry forced them to allow sales to other interested parties. The Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery snapped up a number of the original CPR-HD-002 models. While not increasing the original model's meager four and half tons of armor coverage, Solaris Arms chose to replace the original Durallex plating with ArcShield Reflective Armor to enhance its endurance against the large volume of energy weapons carried by Arena 'Mechs. Already a relatively speedy design, the addition of a Supercharger enhanced its ground speed. Its extremely short jumping distance was neither improved nor removed; instead it was retained to expand a pilot's options in tight terrain. An extra Double Heat Sink, bringing the total to thirteen, is still not enough to keep up with the increased heat produced by the CPR-HD-003's advanced laser weaponry. Allowing the designers to squeeze in the new systems, a cramped Small Cockpit is used, which is less of a liability in the short duration arena battles than on an actual battlefield.
column2: 铜斑蛇于 3054 年深秋首次生产，是一台精炼的竞技场机甲。当银龙马厩的机甲战士布伦登·弗雷泽驾驶他的铜斑蛇"银蛇"跻身索拉里斯前二十名后，这一设计声名大噪——随后他不幸身亡。银龙委托索拉里斯兵工厂开发一款新的独家变体以图重现这一壮举，但新型号昂贵的实验性武器迫使他们允许向其他有意方销售。德拉科尼斯联合体征募兵部队迅速抢购了若干原版 CPR-HD-002 型号。索拉里斯兵工厂并未增加原型那可怜的四吨半装甲覆盖，而是选择把原有的杜拉莱克斯装甲板换成"弧盾"反射装甲，以增强其对竞技场机甲所携带大量能量武器的耐久力。这本来就已是相对高速的设计，加装增压器后地面速度进一步提升。它极短的跳跃距离既未改进也未取消，而是保留下来以拓展机师在狭窄地形中的选择。增加一台双倍散热器使总数达到十三台，仍不足以应对 CPR-HD-003 先进激光武器产生的更高热量。为让设计者塞进这些新系统，采用了狭窄的小型驾驶舱——在短时的竞技场战斗中，这比在真实战场上危害更小。Base

column1: The original model lacked the CPR-HD-003's supercharger and small cockpit. Instead of the Reflective armor, it was fitted with Ferro-Fibrous armor and carried only twelve heat sinks. The weapons loadout consisted of four Medium Lasers, a Small Pulse Laser, a standard SRM-4, and a one-shot Streak SRM-2.
column2: 原版型号没有 CPR-HD-003 的增压器和小型驾驶舱。它没有采用反射装甲，而是装铁纤维装甲，仅携带十二台散热器。武器载荷包括四门中型激光、一门小型脉冲激光、一具标准 SRM-4 和一具一次性连续 SRM-2。Base

column1: Corsair
column2: 海盗

column1: While Corsair is supposedly a generic Periphery term referring to heavy and assault class FrankenMechs cobbled together out of desperation as the Succession War era dragged on, with no specific weight or base chassis, the most successful of these are ninety-five ton brutes modeled in a generally similar style, usually marked with a COR designation. Armed with a grab-bag array of weaponry, the Corsair's primary weapons are an AC/10 and LRM-15 mounted in its right torso, supported by a trio of Medium Lasers split between its left and center torsos and a SRM-6 and Large Laser mounted in its vestigial left arm.
column2: 虽然"海盗船"据称是外围区的泛称，指继承战争时代拖长过程中因绝望而拼凑起来的重型与突击级"科学怪机"，没有特定重量或基础底盘，但其中最成功的那些是九十五吨的猛兽，造型大体相似，通常标以 COR 编号。海盗船装备五花八门的武器，主武器为装在右躯干的一门 AC/10 和一具 LRM-15，辅以分置左、中躯干的三门中型激光，以及装在退化左臂上的一具 SRM-6 和一门大型激光。Base

column1: Heavy Frankenmech
column2: 重型拼装机甲

column1: Boss, what on earth is this thing? I'm all one for a challenge but this thing looks like a pirate deathtrap. Somehow it works but I couldn't begin to tell you why or how it works. I guess we should be grateful that it works at all.
column2: 老大，这到底是什么玩意儿？我向来乐意接受挑战，但这东西看起来像个海盗版的死亡陷阱。不知怎的它居然能用，但我说不清为什么或怎么用的。我想我们该庆幸它至少还能用。Base

Armed with a grab-bag array of weaponry, the Corsair-5T's primary weapons are a set of six AC/2s for long range pepperbox engagements with a ton of ammo per weapon. For close-range backup, the -5T mounts four Medium Lasers.

To defeat enemy missile fire, the COR-7A carries a quartet of Anti-Missile Systems.

However, the -7R's real punch comes from 70 Rocket Launcher tubes scattered across the mech in a pair of RL 20s and a trio of RL 10s.
column2: 虽然"海盗船"据称是外围区的泛称，指继承战争时代拖长过程中因绝望而拼凑起来的重型与突击级"科学怪机"，没有特定重量或基础底盘，但其中最成功的那些是九十五吨的猛兽，造型大体相似，通常标以 COR 编号。海盗船-7R 装备五花八门的武器，主武器为一门 AC/20 和两门大型激光。然而-7R 真正的打击力来自散布全身的 70 个火箭发射管——两具 RL 20 和三具 RL 10。Base
