column2: 名为荷兰人 II 的 F5 变体是荷兰人的改型，试图通过把底盘加重十吨、跨入中量级来解决机甲的问题。它于 3058 年首次建造，仍以高斯步枪为主武器，但辅以一门中型激光和一具连续 SRM-2 发射器。Base

column1: The F7, debuting in 3061 is a modification of the F5 that takes advantage of the Hollander II's larger weapons payload to mount the Lyran Alliance's new Heavy Gauss Rifle, which is capable of causing a great deal of damage at short to medium ranges. While improving upon the firepower of the variant, the removal of backup weaponry to fit these massive weapon leaves it with the same problems as the original Hollander.
column2: F7 于 3061 年亮相，是 F5 的改型，利用荷兰人 II 更大的武器负载能力搭载莱兰联盟新型重型高斯步枪，能在中近距离造成大量伤害。虽然火力优于前型，但为容纳这些巨型武器而移除备用武器，使它仍带有原版荷兰人的同样问题。Base

column1: Hollander
column2: 荷兰人

column1: The Hollander was introduced in 3054 specifically to carry a Gauss Rifle into combat and act as a sniper. The Federated Commonwealth was in dire need of a response to the fast-moving, long-range firepower of the Clan Invaders at the time, and looked at a number of light 'Mech designs featuring PPCs or LRMs as a potential answer. It was Coventry's unorthodox decision to mount such a large weapon, one that had neither the overheating or ammunition explosion drawbacks of the other designs, which won them the contract. With its single massive cannon and use of rediscovered technology, the Hollander can destroy another light 'Mech in a single hit at extreme range and threaten heavier targets easily.
column2: 荷兰人于 3054 年推出，专门为了把高斯步枪带上战场并担任狙击手。当时联邦联邦急需应对氏族入侵者快速机动的远程火力，考察了多款装备 PPC 或 LRM 的轻型机甲设计方案。考文垂大胆决定装上如此巨大的武器——既没有其他设计那样的过热或弹药爆炸缺陷——从而赢得了合约。凭借其单门巨型火炮和对重新发现技术的运用，荷兰人能在极远距离一炮摧毁另一台轻型机甲，并轻易威胁更重的目标。Base

column1: The G1 variant of the Hollander is built to address concerns about the Hollander's lack of back up weapons. First debuting in 3056 the 'Mech replaces the heavy Gauss Cannon with an LB-X Autocannon/10 as its primary weapon, freeing up weight to mount two Defiance B3M Medium Lasers in its arms as backup weapons and add two tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. The G1 is an excellent 'Mech for vehicle hunting as well as anti-aircraft use with its LB-X cluster rounds.
column2: 荷兰人的 G1 变体旨在解决人们对荷兰人缺乏备用武器的担忧。它于 3056 年首次亮相，将重型高斯步枪换成 LB-X 自动炮/10 作为主武器，腾出重量在双臂装两门迪法恩斯 B3M 中型激光作为备用，并加两吨铁纤维装甲。凭借 LB-X 集束弹，G1 是出色的反车辆兼防空机甲。Base

column1: Hoplite
column2: 重装步兵

column1: Conceived by Martinson Armaments of Terra in 2578 as an infantry support 'Mech, the Hoplite first saw service with the newly formed Star League Defense Force during the Reunification War before being relegated to Terran Hegemony militia units in the twenty-seventh century. Intended for infantry support, the Hoplite is slow for a medium 'Mech with a top speed of only 64.8 km/h. However its eleven and a half tons of armor and heavy arsenal, both impressive for a 'Mech of its size, makes the Hoplite a rugged machine able to fight its way out of most situations using superior firepower. The original Reunification War era model, save for using an older Dalban Sniper targeting and tracking system, was all but identical to the 4C.
column2: 重装步兵由泰拉的马丁森军械于 2578 年构想为步兵支援机甲，在统一战争中首次随新成立的星盟防卫军服役，后在二十七世纪被降级至地球霸权民兵单位。作为步兵支援机甲，重装步兵对中型机甲而言偏慢，最高速度仅 64.8 公里/小时。然而其十一吨半装甲与重型武器库对如此尺寸的机甲都堪称出色，使重装步兵成为一台凭借优势火力就能从大多数困境中杀出重围的坚固机器。统一战争时代的原始型号除了使用较老的达尔班狙击瞄准追踪系统外，与 4C 几乎完全相同。Base

column1: Conceived by Martinson Armaments of Terra in 2578 as an infantry support 'Mech, the Hoplite first saw service with the newly formed Star League Defense Force during the Reunification War before being relegated to Terran Hegemony militia units in the twenty-seventh century. Intended for infantry support, the Hoplite is slow for a medium 'Mech with a top speed of only 64.8 km/h. However its eleven and a half tons of armor and heavy arsenal, both impressive for a 'Mech of its size, makes the Hoplite a rugged machine able to fight its way out of most situations using superior firepower. The 4B variant of the Hoplite is an early variant of the 'Mech that attempts to both alleviate the ammunition dependence of its primary weapon and increase its long-range damage potential. This is done by mounting a Magna Hellstar PPC as the primary weapon that is backed up by a massive Mitchell Systems LRM-15 launcher with two tons of reloads, giving it excellent long-range and indirect fire support capabilities.
column2: 重装步兵由泰拉的马丁森军械于 2578 年构想为步兵支援机甲，在统一战争中首次随新成立的星盟防卫军服役，后在二十七世纪被降级至地球霸权民兵单位。作为步兵支援机甲，重装步兵对中型机甲而言偏慢，最高速度仅 64.8 公里/小时。然而其十一吨半装甲与重型武器库对如此尺寸的机甲都堪称出色，使重装步兵成为一台凭借优势火力就能从大多数困境中杀出重围的坚固机器。重装步兵 4B 变体是该机甲的早期变体，试图同时缓解其主武器的弹药依赖并提升远程伤害潜力。做法是装备一门玛格纳"地狱星"PPC 作为主武器，辅以一具巨型米切尔系统 LRM-15 发射器（配两吨再装填），赋予其出色的远程与间接火力支援能力。Base

column1: Essentially a Royal variant in everything but name, the Double B Hoplite was put into production at Strana Mechty MechWorks and Eden Weaponry Consolidated just before the death of Aleksandr Kerensky and found its way both into the forces of the Pentagon Powers and the infant toumans of the Clans. Keeping the LRM rack of the 4B, the Double B upgrades the Holly LRM-15 launcher with an Artemis IV system, swaps the PPC for an Kinslaughter H-Class ER PPC, and increases the 'Mech's survivability with a Guardian ECM system, CASE in both torsos, double heat sinks, and an anti-missile system. However, the design's speed and armor were not upgraded, enforcing the need to deploy the 4Bb as a fire-support unit.
column2: 双 B 重装步兵实质上除名字之外一切皆为皇家变体，在亚历山大·克伦斯基去世前夕于斯特拉纳·麦赫蒂机甲工厂与伊甸兵器联合体投产，既进入五角势力部队，也进入氏族初生的图曼。双 B 保留 4B 的 LRM 挂架，把"冬青"LRM-15 发射器升级加装 Artemis IV 系统，把 PPC 换成"族杀 H 级"ER PPC，并通过守护者 ECM 系统、两侧躯干的 C.A.S.E.、双倍散热器和一套反导系统提升机甲生存力。然而该设计的速度与装甲并未升级，因此 4Bb 必须作为火力支援单位使用。Base

column1: Conceived by Martinson Armaments of Terra in 2578 as an infantry support 'Mech, the Hoplite first saw service with the newly formed Star League Defense Force during the Reunification War before being relegated to Terran Hegemony militia units in the twenty-seventh century. Intended for infantry support, the Hoplite is slow for a medium 'Mech with a top speed of only 64.8 km/h. However its eleven and a half tons of armor and heavy arsenal, both impressive for a 'Mech of its size, makes the Hoplite a rugged machine able to fight its way out of most situations using superior firepower. Effectively identical to the original Hoplite, the 4C carries as its primary weapon a Luxor HV Autocannon/10, which allows it to put a good amount of damage on a target, with a low amount of heat. The 'Mech is also armed with a Conan/5 LRM-5 launcher. Arriving with the Wolf's Dragoons, these were the first Hoplites seen in the Inner Sphere since their extinction during the Succession Wars.
column2: 重装步兵由泰拉的马丁森军械于 2578 年构想为步兵支援机甲，在统一战争中首次随新成立的星盟防卫军服役，后在二十七世纪被降级至地球霸权民兵单位。作为步兵支援机甲，重装步兵对中型机甲而言偏慢，最高速度仅 64.8 公里/小时。然而其十一吨半装甲与重型武器库对如此尺寸的机甲都堪称出色，使重装步兵成为一台凭借优势火力就能从大多数困境中杀出重围的坚固机器。4C 与原版重装步兵实际上完全相同，主武器为一门卢克索 HV 自动炮/10，能以低热量对目标造成可观伤害。机甲还装备一具柯南/5 LRM-5 发射器。这些机甲随狼之龙骑兵抵达，是自继承战争中灭绝以来在内天体首次见到的重装步兵。Base

column1: A Hell's Horses field refit from Operation KLONDIKE, the 4Cb removes the weapons, electronics suite, and a heat sink in favor of a Gauss rifle, SRM-6, and Ferro-Fibrous armor.
column2: 4Cb 是"克朗代克"行动中地狱马的野战改装，它移除武器、电子套件和一台散热器，换成高斯步枪、SRM-6 和铁纤维装甲。Base

column1: Conceived by Martinson Armaments of Terra in 2578 as an infantry support 'Mech, the Hoplite first saw service with the newly formed Star League Defense Force during the Reunification War before being relegated to Terran Hegemony militia units in the twenty-seventh century. Intended for infantry support, the Hoplite is slow for a medium 'Mech with a top speed of only 64.8 km/h. However its eleven and a half tons of armor and heavy arsenal, both impressive for a 'Mech of its size, makes the Hoplite a rugged machine able to fight its way out of most situations using superior firepower. Refitted by the Dragoons after the Inner Sphere's recovery of the Helm Memory Core, the HOP-4D Hoplite is armed with an impressive Mydron Excel LB-X Autocannon/10, which allows it to fire either standard rounds or cluster rounds, which are similar to the blast from a shotgun, only on a 'Mech scale. As a secondary weapon, the Hoplite carries a Conan/5 LRM-5 launcher, which also allows it to keep the enemy at long ranges.
column2: 重装步兵由泰拉的马丁森军械于 2578 年构想为步兵支援机甲，在统一战争中首次随新成立的星盟防卫军服役，后在二十七世纪被降级至地球霸权民兵单位。作为步兵支援机甲，重装步兵对中型机甲而言偏慢，最高速度仅 64.8 公里/小时。然而其十一吨半装甲与重型武器库对如此尺寸的机甲都堪称出色，使重装步兵成为一台凭借优势火力就能从大多数困境中杀出重围的坚固机器。内天体找回赫尔姆记忆核心后，龙骑兵改装了 HOP-4D 重装步兵，装备一门令人印象深刻的迈德龙 Excel LB-X 自动炮/10，可发射标准弹或集束弹——后者类似霰弹枪的散射，只是机甲级别。作为次要武器，重装步兵携带一具柯南/5 LRM-5 发射器，同样能迫使敌人远距离交战。Base

column1: Developed after the Battle of Luthien, the Hoplite C is a variant exclusively used by the Wolf's Dragoons that uses all Clan technology. Clad in 10 tons of Ferro-Fibrous and fitted with double heat sinks, the 'Mech carries as its primary weapon an Ultra Autocannon/10. This is supported for long-range engagements by an LRM-15 launcher and for close range combat the 'Mech carries two Medium Pulse Lasers and an ER Medium Laser.
column2: 重装步兵 C 在卢西恩战役后开发，是狼之龙骑兵独家使用的变体，全部采用氏族科技。它披挂 10 吨铁纤维装甲并配双倍散热器，主武器为一门超速自动炮/10。远程交战由一具 LRM-15 发射器支援，混战则有两门中型脉冲激光和一门 ER 中型激光。Base

column1: Hornet
column2: 大黄蜂

column1: The Hornet debuted in 2760 as an urban recon 'Mech, but lack of interest forced the design to be shelved two years later. In 2990, Kallon Industriesrediscovered the blueprints and resumed production. The upgraded HNT-171 started production in 3051. The production line was destroyed by the Capellans in 3069. The 'Mech is designed around the concept of being able to swiftly move through an urban environment with relatively heavy armor. Overall, because of its eclectic mix of weapons and relatively slow speed, the Hornet is only somewhat effective when inside of a city. When caught outside an urban environment the 'Mech is hard pressed to defend itself.
column2: 大黄蜂于 2760 年作为城市侦察机甲首次亮相，但因缺乏兴趣，两年后该设计被搁置。2990 年，卡隆工业重新发现了图纸并恢复生产。升级版 HNT-171 于 3051 年开始生产。生产线于 3069 年被卡佩兰人摧毁。此机甲的设计理念是能以相对厚重的装甲在城市环境中快速机动。总体而言，由于武器配置杂糅且速度相对缓慢，大黄蜂仅在城内表现尚可。一旦身陷城外环境，它便难以自保。Base

column1: The version of the Hornet that debuted in 2990, the 151, has standard armor and a standard internal structure. It also lacks the advanced Anti-Missile System, CASE, and a ton of LRM ammunition, though the jumping capacity is one hundred fifty meters and the weapons also include a small laser.
column2: 大黄蜂于 2990 年首次亮相的版本 151 使用标准装甲和标准内部结构。它也缺少先进反导系统、C.A.S.E. 和一吨 LRM 弹药，不过跳跃能力为一百五十米，武器还包括一门小型激光。Base

column1: A fairly common field modification of the 151, the 152 replaces the LRM with a Holly SRM-4.
column2: 152 是 151 相当常见的野战改装，以一具"冬青"SRM-4 取代 LRM。Base

column1: Wolf's Dragoons fields this variant, which eschews the anti-missile system in favor of a full one-hundred fifty meters of jumping and the Small Laser.
column2: 狼之龙骑兵装备此变体，它舍弃反导系统，换取整整一百五十米的跳跃能力和那门小型激光。Base

column1: The Hornet carries as its primary long-range weapon a Holly LRM-5launcher. This allows the Hornet to strike at an enemy at a distance of over six hundred meters. In an urban environment the LRM launcher becomes more of a liability than an asset. As a secondary weapon the Hornet carries a Martell Medium Laser, and finally the 'Mech is armed with a MainFire Point Defense Anti-Missile System to defend against missile attacks.
column2: 大黄蜂以"冬青"LRM-5 发射器为主要远程武器。这使大黄蜂能在六百多米外打击敌人。在城市环境中，LRM 发射器更像是负担而非资产。作为次要武器，大黄蜂携带一门马特尔中型激光，最后机甲还装备一套"主火点防御"反导系统以抵御导弹攻击。Base

column1: Hunchback
column2: 驼背

column1: The Hunchback 1G is a primitive refit trying to retain the 4G's impressive firepower by replacing the weapons with a Medium and Heavy Rifle inplace of the AC/20.
column2: 驼背 1G 是原始改装型，试图以一门中型和一门重型步枪取代 AC/20，从而保留 4G 令人印象深刻的火力。Base

column1: The Hunchback 4G is a tried and tested juggernaut on the field. One of the lightest 'Mechs to mount such a massive Autocannon, it is capable of destroying some lighter units in a single volley. It tends to mount heavy armor to boot.
column2: 驼背 4G 是战场上久经考验的巨兽。它是最轻的、装备如此巨型自动炮的机甲之一，能一轮齐射摧毁一些较轻单位。它还倾向于配备厚重装甲。Base

column1: During the War of 3039, the 9th Ghost regiment was engaged by the Screaming Eagles mercenary company during the Elidere IV campaign, when they decided to modify two of their Hunchbacks to carry prototype Gauss Rifles. Thus, the HBK-4GG was born, able to cause tremendous damage at ranges beyond anyone's expectations.
column2: 3039 年战争中，第 9 幽灵团在埃利代尔 IV 战役期间与"尖叫之鹰"佣兵团交战，当时他们决定改装两台驼背以搭载原型高斯步枪。HBK-4GG 由此诞生，能在超出所有人预期的距离上造成巨大伤害。Base

column1: A 'Swayback' variant, the 4H replaces the AC20 with the lighter AC10 and two Medium Lasers.  While this reduces its overall raw firepower, it gives the Hunchback some much needed ranged capabilities.
column2: 作为"摇摆背"变体，4H 以更轻的 AC10 和两门中型激光取代 AC20。虽然这降低了整体原始火力，却赋予驼背急需的远程能力。Base

column1: Modified to aid with indirect fire support as well as being able to act as a guardian for fire support lances, the HBK-4J succeeds at both roles.  With its twin LRM-10s it can contribute to the barrage, witlst its five Medium Lasers allow it to fend off the Light 'Mechs that tend to harass fire support teams.
column2: HBK-4J 经改装既能协助间接火力支援，又能充当火力支援小队的护卫，两个角色都胜任。凭借双联 LRM-10 它能加入弹幕，而五门中型激光使它能击退惯于骚扰火力支援组的轻型机甲。Base

column1: Another Swayback 'Mech, this variant was first employed in 2856, and changed the Hunchback's focus from short range combat to fire support by removing the AC/20 and replacing it with an LRM-20 launcher.
column2: 又是一款"驼背佬"机甲，此变体于 2856 年首次使用，它移除 AC/20 代之以一具 LRM-20 发射器，把驼背的重心从混战转向火力支援。Base

column1: Juggernaut & Fire Support
column2: 重装与火力支援

column1: A Kurita Refit of the Swayback J Hunchback that replaces the LRM with a MRM40 and vastly upgrades the chassis.
column2: 这是库瑞塔对"驼背佬 J"驼背的改装，把 LRM 换成 MRM40，并大幅升级底盘。Base

column1: Combining elements of the 4H and 4J 'Swaybacks', the HBK-4N uses an AC5 and two LRM-5s to give it range, while the four Medium Lasers give it punch up close.
column2: HBK-4N 融合了 4H 与 4J"驼背佬"的元素，用一门 AC5 和两具 LRM-5 提供射程，四门中型激光则负责近身打击。Base

column1: The 4P version of the Hunchback trades the singular impact of a massive Autocannon for a frightening array of lighter Energy weaponry that is actually capable of dealing more damage overall. This all comes at the cost of greatly increased heat buildup, of course.
column2: 驼背 4P 版本以一批令人生畏的轻型能量武器取代巨型自动炮的单点冲击，实际上整体伤害更高。当然，代价是热量积累大幅增加。Base

column1: The 4SP variant of the Hunchback replaces the Autocannon with two SRM6 launchers. This has the potential of doing more damage than the standard model, though the damage is more spread out.  This firepower is supplemented by two Medium Lasers in each arm.
column2: 驼背 4SP 变体以两具 SRM6 发射器取代自动炮。这有可能造成比标准型号更多的伤害，虽然伤害更分散。这一火力由每臂两门中型激光补充。Base

column1: The 4SP is a pretty solid close in 'Mech.  That being said, sitting 2 tons of ammo in the engine compartment worries me a bit.
column2: 4SP 是一台相当扎实的混战机甲。话虽如此，把 2 吨弹药放在引擎舱里让我有点担心。Base

column1: Originally a refit line converted to full production, the -5S is a complete overhaul of the Hunchback design developed by Norse-Storm BattleMechs in 3058. The structure has been modified to use Endo Steel construction techniques, the engine has been upgraded to a Light Fusion Engine, and four Jump Jets were added for increased mobility. The 'Mech carries, as its primary weapon, an LB-X Autocannon/20 with CASE-protected ammunition supported by two medium pulse lasers and a single small laser.
column2: -5S 最初是一条改装线，后转为全面量产，是诺斯-风暴战斗机甲公司于 3058 年开发的驼背设计全面翻新。结构已改用内骨骼建造技术，引擎升级为轻型聚变引擎，并加装四个跳跃推进器以提升机动性。机甲的主武器为一门 LB-X 自动炮/20，弹药由 C.A.S.E. 保护，辅以两门中型脉冲激光和一门小型激光。Base

column1: The Hunchback IIC is a ClanTech refit of the venerable Hunchback. Its meager armor, coupled with paltry ammunition and lack of long-range weapons, led Inner Sphere observers to conclude that this 'Mech was a last-ditch effort for failed warriors to die with glory. In truth, the assignment of a Hunchback IIC was essentially a death sentence. Warriors given this machine were not expected to survive their next battle.
column2: 驼背 IIC 是古老的驼背的氏族科技改装版。它可怜的装甲，加上稀少的弹药和缺乏远程武器，让内天体观察家断定这款机甲是失败战士求取荣耀战死的最后一搏。事实上，被分配驼背 IIC 基本等于死刑。获得此机的战士不被指望能活过下一场战斗。Base

column1: The Hunchback IIC is a ClanTech refit of the venerable Hunchback. Its meager armor, coupled with paltry ammunition and lack of long-range weapons, led Inner Sphere observers to conclude that this 'Mech was a last-ditch effort for failed warriors to die with glory. In truth, the assignment of a Hunchback IIC was essentially a death sentence. Warriors given this machine were not expected to survive their next battle.
column2: 驼背 IIC 是古老的驼背的氏族科技改装版。它可怜的装甲，加上稀少的弹药和缺乏远程武器，让内天体观察家断定这款机甲是失败战士求取荣耀战死的最后一搏。事实上，被分配驼背 IIC 基本等于死刑。获得此机的战士不被指望能活过下一场战斗。Base

column1: Huntsman
column2: 猎人

column1: Useful at all ranges, the first alternate configuration uses an LRM-10 and an LB-X Autocannon/2 at long range. A pair of Large Pulse Lasers are accurate at all ranges, though they necessitated the addition of two double heat sinks.
column2: 首个备用配置在各类距离上都有用：远程使用一具 LRM-10 和一门 LB-X 自动炮/2。两门大型脉冲激光在各距离都精准，但为此必须加装两台双倍散热器。Base

column1: Multi-Role Omnimech
column2: 多用途全能机甲

column1: The Huntsman B uses an ER PPC at long range. Close in, it can call upon an LB-X Autocannon/10 and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers. Two Machine Guns can make short work of unarmored infantry.
column2: 猎人 B 在远距离使用一门 ER PPC。近距离可依靠一门 LB-X 自动炮/10 和两门中型脉冲激光。两挺机枪能轻松对付无装甲步兵。Base

column1: This long-range support variant uses an LRM-20, LRM-15, and an Ultra Autocannon/5 for most of its work. An ER Medium Laser, ER Small Laser, and Streak SRM-4 handle units that get in close. A Flamer provides defense against infantry and combat vehicles.
column2: 此远程支援变体主要使用一具 LRM-20、一具 LRM-15 和一门超速自动炮/5。一门 ER 中型激光、一门 ER 小型激光和一具连续 SRM-4 负责对付逼近的单位。一具火焰喷射器提供对步兵与战斗车辆的防御。Base

column1: The primary configuration of the Huntsman sports a myriad of weapons. An Ultra Autocannon/2 and Artemis IV-linked LRM-10 provide long-range capability, while four ER Medium Lasers and a Streak SRM-6 make it a vicious close range 'Mech. A pair of Anti-Personnel Pods and a Flamer protect it from conventional infantry, and an Anti-Missile System provides it with some defense against incoming missiles. An Active Probe finds hidden units, and a TAG spotting laser can designate targets for homing artillery strikes.
column2: 猎人的主配置武器种类繁多。一门超速自动炮/2 和 Artemis IV 联接的 LRM-10 提供远程能力，而四门 ER 中型激光和一具连续 SRM-6 使它成为凶悍的混战机甲。一对反人员荚舱和一具火焰喷射器保护它免受常规步兵攻击，反导系统则为它提供对来袭导弹的防御。主动探测器可发现隐藏单位，TAG 指示激光能为制导炮击标记目标。Base

column1: Huron Warrior
column2: 休伦战士

column1: The primary weapon that the Huron Warrior carries is a Grizzard Gauss Rifle (Modified 210 Version) that is capable of stripping off a ton of armor with each shot at extremely long ranges. The Gauss Rifle is backed up by a Martell ER Large Laser that provides good supplemental firepower at long ranges. Finally, it is armed with a Martell Medium Pulse Laser, which gives the Huron Warrior the ability to protect itself at short ranges.
column2: 休伦战士的主要武器是一门格里扎德高斯步枪（210 改进版），能在极远距离一枪削掉一吨装甲。高斯步枪辅以一门马特尔 ER 大型激光，在远距离提供良好的补充火力。最后它还装备一门马特尔中型脉冲激光，使休伦战士具备近距离自保能力。Base

column1: Icarus II
column2: 伊卡洛斯 II

column1: The Icarus II was the first homegrown BattleMech design to be mass-produced by the Free Worlds League. It was originally designed as a speedy striker to compliment the Mackie and combat vehicles with a similar speed profile.
column2: 伊卡洛斯 II 是自由世界联盟首个量产的自主战斗机甲设计。它最初被设计为一款高速突击机甲，以配合麦基和速度相近的战斗车辆。Base

column1: Wow, boss. This is an old design. She may be old but she is solid and that AC10 has some serious punch.
column2: 哇，老大。这可是个老设计。她也许老旧，但很扎实，而那门 AC10 打击力相当可观。Base

column1: IceFerret A
column2: 冰貂 A

column1: IceFerret
column2: 冰貂

column1: The A configuration carries a single LB-X Autocannon/2 for its excellent long range sniping capabilities. This is backed up by two ER Medium Lasers for close combat capabilities and a single Anti-Missile System for added defense against missile weapons.
column2: A 配置携带一门 LB-X 自动炮/2，具备出色的远程狙击能力。它辅以两门 ER 中型激光提供混战能力，以及一套反导系统增加对导弹武器的防御。Base

column1: Fast Scout
column2: 快速侦察

column1: IceFerret B
column2: 冰貂 B

column1: The Ice Ferret B has an ER Large Laser as its only long-range weapon. For close combat, the B configuration carries an SRM-4 and an SRM-6 launcher as well as a highly accurate Small Pulse Laser.
column2: 冰貂 B 只有一门 ER 大型激光作为远程武器。混战方面，B 配置携带一具 SRM-4 和一具 SRM-6 发射器，以及一门极为精准的小型脉冲激光。Base

column1: IceFerret C
column2: 冰貂 C

column1: A fire support configuration of the Ice Ferret, the C configuration has a trio of LRM-5 launchers, each linked to an Artemis IV fire control system for increased missile accuracy. For close range defense, the 'Mech has a single ER Small Laser.
column2: 冰貂 C 是冰貂的火力支援配置，装备三具 LRM-5 发射器，每具联接一套 Artemis IV 火控系统以提升导弹精度。近程防御方面，机甲有一门 ER 小型激光。Base

column1: In its primary configuration, the Ice Ferret is capable of acting in a variety of roles. The Ice Ferret carries an Active Probe allowing the 'Mech to detect hidden enemy units. For close combat, the Ice Ferret prime has a Streak SRM-2 launcher and an ER Small Laser. For long range engagements, the 'Mech is armed with a single ER PPC, giving it excellent long range hitting power for its size.
column2: 主配置中，冰貂能胜任多种角色。它携带主动探测器，可侦测隐藏的敌方单位。混战方面，冰貂主型号有一具连续 SRM-2 发射器和一门 ER 小型激光。远程交战时，机甲装备一门 ER PPC，就其尺寸而言拥有出色的远程打击力。Base

column1: Incubus
column2: 梦魔

column1: A second line mech designed for settling clan duels, the laser armed Incubus has found considerable success with Clan Hell's Horses'49th Battlemech Cluster as a protomech hunter..
column2: 作为一款为裁定氏族决斗而设计的二线机甲，装备激光的梦魇在地狱马氏族第 49 战斗机甲集群中作为原机甲猎手取得了相当成功。Base

column1: Light and Protomech Hunter
column2: 轻型与原型机甲猎手

column1: Initiate
column2: 新兵

column1: The Initiate started production after the Word of Blake retook Terra. This medium 'Mech has been produced in record numbers by the Word of Blake with no shortage of pilots. It is built on a Geometric 1000 Endo Steel chassis to save weight and is powered by a LTV 160 fusion engine that gives it a top speed of 64.8 km/h. For protection from enemy fire, the Initiate carries eight and a half tons of armor that allows the 'Mech to stand up to fire from most other 'Mechs of the same weight class or lower, and enjoys increased durability because of its CASE system that protects against ammunition explosions. Overall, the Initiate is a reliable trooper 'Mech that is capable of filling a variety of roles on the modern battlefield.
column2: 启蒙者在布雷克之言重夺泰拉后开始生产。这款中型机甲被布雷克之言以创纪录的数量生产，机师从不短缺。它基于"几何 1000"内骨骼底盘建造以减重，由 LTV 160 聚变引擎驱动，最高速度 64.8 公里/小时。为抵御敌方火力，启蒙者携带八吨半装甲，使机甲能承受同重量级或更低级别大多数机甲的射击，并因其 C.A.S.E. 系统防护弹药爆炸而拥有更高耐久度。总体而言，启蒙者是一台可靠的通用机甲，能在现代战场上胜任多种角色。Base

column1: The Initiate has a diverse weapons mix that allows it to engage an enemy at a variety of ranges. For long-range combat, the Initiate has an Irian Weapons Works V7 LRM-15 launcher that gives the Initiate the ability to strike at an enemy at long ranges as well as giving an indirect fire capability to the 'Mech. For medium range combat, the Initiate has two Irian Weapons Works Super 6 Medium Lasers and an Irian Weapons Works 60mm SRM-6 launcher. For close ranges, the 'Mech has three Diverse Optics Type ER Small Lasers. Finally, to protect against missile attacks, the 'Mech has a McArthur Anti-Missile System.
column2: 启蒙者的武器搭配多样，能在多种距离上交战。远程战斗方面，启蒙者有一具"伊里安兵器工厂 V7"LRM-15 发射器，使启蒙者能在远距离打击敌人，并为机甲提供间接火力能力。中程战斗方面，启蒙者有两门"伊里安兵器工厂超级 6"中型激光和一具"伊里安兵器工厂 60 毫米"SRM-6 发射器。近程方面，机甲有三门"多元光学 ER 型"小型激光。最后，为防御导弹攻击，机甲装有一套麦克阿瑟反导系统。Base

column1: JagerMech
column2: 猎杀机甲

column1: The JagerMech A model attempts to provide an indirect-fire support platform that can dish out damage without ever being seen. It has lower overall focused damage capability, but it usually mounts decent armor.
column2: 猎手机甲 A 型试图提供一款能在大发雷霆却始终不被看见的间接火力支援平台。它的整体集中伤害能力较低，但通常装备可观的装甲。Base

column1: A recent variant to the JagerMech, the JM6-B removes most of the ammunition dependencies of the original model by swapping out the AutoCannons for Lasers.  To make up for the loss in range, a pair of LRM-15 launchers have been added.
column2: 作为猎手机甲的新近变体，JM6-B 把自动炮换成激光，从而消除了原型号大部分的弹药依赖。为弥补射程损失，加装了一对 LRM-15 发射器。Base

column1: While I like the overall lack of ammunition dependence, this beast runs HOT.  I'd suggest we swap out the LRM-15s for LRM-10s and add in another 4 Heat Sinks to help cool her down to a manageable level.
column2: 虽然我喜欢它整体上不依赖弹药，但这头猛兽太热了。我建议我们把 LRM-15 换成 LRM-10，再加 4 台散热器，把它降到可控水平。Base

column1: The JagerMech X model mounts unusually thick Armor alongside 2 LBX5
column2: 猎手机甲 X 型装备异常厚重的装甲以及 2 门 LBX5

column1: Jenner
column2: 詹纳

column1: The Jenner R was downgraded to accommodate a lack of replacement parts, carrying 2 SRM6, 2 Rocketlauncher and 2 Medium laser.
column2: 詹纳 R 因缺乏替换零件而遭降级，携带 2 具 SRM6、2 具火箭发射器和 2 门中型激光。Base

column1: The original Jenner model mounted a Large Laser with a pair of Medium Lasers in a torso mounted turret.  While it was a solid fast moving 'Mech, its Argra 27C Medium Lasers suffered from a targetting defect.
column2: 原版詹纳型号在躯干炮塔中装有一门大型激光和一对中型激光。虽然它是一台扎实的高速机甲，其"阿尔格拉 27C"中型激光却存在瞄准缺陷。Base

column1: I like the idea of mounting the Large Laser - those old Drac techs had the right idea, but they executed it poorly.  We should yank out the extra Medium Lasers and replace them with Heat Sinks.
column2: 我喜欢装大型激光这个主意——那些老联合体技师的想法是对的，但执行得很糟。我们应该拆掉那些多余的中型激光，换成散热器。Base

column1: The JR7-C was a basic upgrade of the JR7-K, removing one of the Medium Lasers and replacing it with a C3 Slave Unit. Combined with its speed this made the Jenner an ideal spotter for a C3 company.
column2: JR7-C 是 JR7-K 的基础升级，移除其中一门中型激光，换成一台 C3 从属单元。结合其速度，这使詹纳成为 C3 连的理想目标指示者。Base

column1: The JR7-C was a basic upgrade of the JR7-K, removing one of the Medium Lasers and replacing it with a C3 Slave Unit. Combined with its speed this made the Jenner an ideal spotter for a C3 company..
column2: JR7-C 是 JR7-K 的基础升级，移除其中一门中型激光，换成一台 C3 从属单元。结合其速度，这使詹纳成为 C3 连的理想目标指示者。Base

column1: The Jenner F drops the SRM in favor of increasing armor across the entire 'Mech, producing a more durable striker.
column2: 詹纳 F 舍弃 SRM，转而增强整台机甲的装甲，造就了一款更耐久的突击手。Base

column1: The Jenner was first fielded in September 2784, the same year the Exodus fleet that would eventually become the Clans left the Inner Sphere in November. How exactly they acquired this design in that short timeframe is not known, but what is known is that the Clan version fields Clan weaponry.
column2: 詹纳首次投入战场是在 2784 年 9 月，同年 11 月，最终演变为氏族的出埃及舰队离开了内天体。他们如何在如此短的时间内获得该设计不得而知，但已知氏族版本装备的是氏族武器。Base

column1: The JR7-K adds a higher degree of survivability to the Jenner by upgrading the armor to Ferro-Fibrous, while removing a half ton of the armor. This provides virtually the same armor protection while allowing space for CASE to protect the SRM-4 ammunition.
column2: JR7-K 通过把装甲升级为铁纤维并削减半吨装甲，为詹纳提升了生存性。这提供了几乎相同的装甲防护，同时腾出空间加装 C.A.S.E. 以保护 SRM-4 弹药。Base

column1: A lumbering mountain of armor and weaponry, Solaris Arms' massive assault 'Mech definitely lives up to the name of Juggernaut in the Solaris Games. While not a flashy design, Solaris Arms kept up steady production of the design since the early 3050s. Sixteen and half tons of Valiant Chainmail armor protect a GM 270 Fusion Engine, propelling the 'Mech at fairly standard assault 'Mech speed of 54 kph.
column2: 作为一座笨重的装甲与武器之山，索拉里斯兵工厂的巨型突击机甲在索拉里斯竞技场上绝对配得上"主宰者"之名。虽然设计并不炫目，索拉里斯兵工厂自 3050 年代初以来一直稳定生产该设计。十六吨半的"勇武锁子甲"装甲保护着一台 GM 270 聚变引擎，推动机甲以相当标准的突击机甲速度——54 公里/小时——行进。Base

column1: A lumbering mountain of armor and weaponry, Solaris Arms' massive assault 'Mech definitely lives up to the name of Juggernaut in the Solaris Games. Sixteen and half tons of Valiant Chainmail armor protect a GM 270 Fusion Engine, propelling the 'Mech at fairly standard assault 'Mech speed of 54 kph.
column2: 作为一座笨重的装甲与武器之山，索拉里斯兵工厂的巨型突击机甲在索拉里斯竞技场上绝对配得上"主宰者"之名。十六吨半的"勇武锁子甲"装甲保护着一台 GM 270 聚变引擎，推动机甲以相当标准的突击机甲速度——54 公里/小时——行进。Base

column1: The Juggernaut's main armament is a trio of Large X-Pulse Lasers, one in each arm with one in its center torso, backed up by three Sutel Precision Line Medium X-Pulse Lasers divided between each arm and the head. Due to the 'Mech's lack of hand actuators, at knife-fighting range the Juggernaut is protected by a staggering twelve Machine Guns fed from two tons of reloads.
column2: 重装的主要武装是三门大型 X 脉冲激光，每臂各一，中央躯干一门，辅以三门苏特尔精准线中型 X 脉冲激光，分列每臂与头部。由于机甲没有手部驱动器，在贴身距离上重装靠十二挺机枪（由两吨再装填供弹）提供惊人的防护。Base

column1: Kabuto
column2: 兜甲

column1: Developed by Diplan mechyards as an easy to repair, scout and ambusher. This mech can deliver a nasty punch, before having to withdraw.
column2: 由迪普兰机甲船坞开发，作为一款易于修理的侦察与伏击机甲。这台机甲能打出凶狠一击，然后不得不撤离。Base

column1: For a scout this kabuto does the job with the benefit of a quick mission kill on other lights in it's weight bracket. We can work with it boss.
column2: 作为侦察机甲，这台"兜"能完成任务，还有能迅速击杀同重量级其他轻型机甲的优点。我们能凑合用，老大。Base

column1: An upgrade of the base model. This mech is sold only to the DCMS and fills the ranks if a number of elite units.
column2: 基础型号的升级版。此机甲仅售予 DCMS，充实了若干精锐单位的编制。Base

column1: Kanazuchi Power Armour
column2: 金槌动力甲

column1: The Kanazuchi, Japanese for 'hammer', is a Draconis Combine battle armor design, one of the heaviest to come from that realm.
column2: 金槌（日语"锤子"）是德拉科尼斯联合体的战斗装甲设计，是该势力出品中最重的一种。Base

column1: King Crab
column2: 帝王蟹

column1: The King Crab KGC-0 is a badly maintained primitive version of one of the most heavily armed and armored 'Mechs ever constructed. While carrying lesser weaponry is its arsenal still able to deliver a crushing Blow.
column2: 帝王蟹 KGC-0 是维护不良的原始版本，属史上武装与装甲最厚重的机甲之一。虽然武器较弱，其火力库仍能造成毁灭性打击。Base

column1: One of the so-called Clanbuster variants developed in 3052 during the lead-up to the Battle of Tukayyid, ComStar's techs replaced the twin autocannons with two M-7 Gauss Rifles and four tons of ammo in the arms, trading a minor reduction in destructive capacity for greatly increased range. While retaining the LRM launcher the large laser was upgraded to a Tronel XIII Large Pulse Laser and two Hovertec Streak SRM-2s, split between the side torsos with a single ton of reloads each, were added. These changes were accomplished by using an extralight engine in place of the standard model.
column2: 这是 3052 年图卡伊德战役前夕开发的所谓"破氏族"变体之一。康星技师将双联自动炮换成两门 M-7 高斯步枪，臂部携带四吨弹药，以略微降低的破坏力换取大幅提升的射程。保留 LRM 发射器的同时，大型激光升级为特罗内尔 XIII 大型脉冲激光，并加装两具霍弗泰克连续 SRM-2，分列两侧躯干、各配一吨再装填。这些改动通过以超轻型引擎取代标准引擎实现。Base

column1: One of the most heavily armed and armored 'Mechs ever constructed, the King Crab 0002 variant mounts twin UAC10 with MRM's.
column2: 帝王蟹 0002 变体是史上武装与装甲最厚重的机甲之一，装备双 UAC10 与 MRM。Base

column1: The King Crab-000b, the Star League's Royal variant, is every bit as powerful as its downgraded cousin, the -0000. Still armed with twin AC/20s, the -000b's double heat sinks and doubled ammo keeps the massive cannons firing far longer and more frequently making the -000b a true terror on the battlefield.
column2: 帝王蟹-000b 是星盟的皇家变体，威力丝毫不逊于其降级版表亲-0000。它仍装备双 AC/20，其双倍散热器与双倍弹药让这对巨炮能更持久、更频繁地开火，使-000b 成为战场上真正的恐怖。Base

column1: This version of the King Crab was created by the Star League to be a command 'Mech and introduced alongside the original 000 model in 2743. Conceived in secret between Cosara and the Terran Hegemony, it was an attempt to produce a deadly command 'Mech by mounting a pair of newly-developed Hellstar Magna PPCs in either side torso backed by bya pair of SRM-6's. A pair of newly developed LBX/10's replaced the standard autocannon. The 010 model was more than capable of taking down an Atlas, but the entire line left with Kerensky during the Exodus and even knowledge of the design's existence became lost during the Succession Wars.
column2: 此版帝王蟹由星盟打造为指挥机甲，与原始 000 型于 2743 年一同推出。它由科萨拉与地球霸权秘密构想，试图通过在两肋各装一对新研制的"地狱星"大型 PPC 并辅以两具 SRM-6，打造一款致命的指挥机甲。一对新研制的 LBX/10 取代了标准自动炮。010 型完全有能力击杀一台阿特拉斯，但整条生产线随克伦斯基一同出走，连该设计存在的知识也在继承战争中失传。Base

column1: Kintaro
column2: 金太郎

column1: The Kintaro 18 isÔÇª a beast of a machine. It's fast for its size, mounts heavy armor, and can literally shred most other 'Mechs with its almost ridiculous amount of close-range weaponry. But, it runs hotter than Hell's saunas.
column2: 金太郎 18 是……一台猛兽般的机器。就体型而言它很快，装备厚重装甲，凭其近乎荒谬的近程武器数量，几乎能把大多数其他机甲撕成碎片。不过，它比地狱的桑拿房还热。Base

column1: The Kintaro 18K is a beast of a machine. Still running hot does this Kurita refit carry a light PPC and Deadfire enhanced launcher for every engagement range.
column2: 金太郎 18K 是一台猛兽般的机器。这款库瑞塔改装型依然散热偏热，为每个交战距离都配备了一门轻型 PPC 和死火增强发射器。Base

column1: This Marik refit of the Kintaro was built in cooperation with Holly as a testbed for Streak and NARC missiles.
column2: 这款马里克对金太郎的改装是与冬青公司合作建造的，用作连续导弹与 NARC 导弹的试验台。Base

column1: The Kintaro 19 isÔÇª a beast of a machine. It's fast for its size, mounts heavy armor, and can literally shred most other 'Mechs with its almost ridiculous amount of Narc supported close-range weaponry. But, it runs hotter than Hell's saunas.
column2: 金太郎 19 是……一台猛兽般的机器。就体型而言它很快，装备厚重装甲，凭其近乎荒谬的、由 NARC 支援的近程武器数量，几乎能把大多数其他机甲撕成碎片。不过，它比地狱的桑拿房还热。Base

column1: The KTO-19b was an upgrade utilized by the Royal Brigades of the SLDF. It used an XL Engine and Double Heat Sinks to free up space to upgrade the KTO-19's LRM-5 launcher to a larger LRM-15.
column2: KTO-19b 是星盟防卫军皇家旅使用的升级型。它使用 XL 引擎和双倍散热器腾出空间，把 KTO-19 的 LRM-5 发射器升级为更大的 LRM-15。Base

column1: The KTO-20, used to good effect in the War of 3039, was the slightly downgraded version of the KTO-19 given to the Draconis Combine by ComStar as part of Operation Rosebud. The KTO-20 was nearly identical to its Star League era cousin, the only real difference being the loss of the Narc Missile beacon in exchange for a Magna Mk III Large Laser. It was equipped with double heat sinks.
column2: KTO-20 在 3039 年战争中发挥了良好作用，是康星作为"玫瑰花蕾"行动一部分交给德拉科尼斯联合体的 KTO-19 的轻度降级版。KTO-20 与其星盟时代的表亲几乎相同，唯一真正的差别是失去了 NARC 导弹信标，换成一门玛格纳 Mk III 大型激光。它装备了双倍散热器。Base

column1: The KTO-20, used to good effect in the War of 3039, was the slightly downgraded version of the KTO-19 given to the Draconis Combine by ComStar as part of Operation Rosebud. The KTO-20 was nearly identical to its Star League era cousin, the only real difference being the loss of the Narc Missile beacon in exchange for a Magna Mk III Large Laser. It was equipped with double heat sinks.
column2: KTO-20 在 3039 年战争中发挥了良好作用，是康星作为"玫瑰花蕾"行动一部分交给德拉科尼斯联合体的 KTO-19 的轻度降级版。KTO-20 与其星盟时代的表亲几乎相同，唯一真正的差别是失去了 NARC 导弹信标，换成一门玛格纳 Mk III 大型激光。它装备了双倍散热器。Base

column1: Developed by both ComStar and the Word of Blake, the KTO-21 was the first 'Mech to utilize both the new Improved Narc Missile Beacon (iNarc for short) and the improved C3 computer system. In order to utilize these new systems, the KTO-21 was refitted with an Endo Steel chassis and carried half a ton less armor than the KTO-19. Retaining only the two SRM launchers, the LRM launcher was dropped and the standard medium lasers were upgraded to more advanced ER Medium Lasers, enhanced by a switch to Double Heat Sinks.
column2: KTO-21 由康星与布雷克之言共同开发，是首款同时使用新型改进型 NARC 导弹信标（简称 iNarc）和改进型 C3 计算机系统的机甲。为使用这些新系统，KTO-21 改装了内骨骼底盘，装甲比 KTO-19 少半吨。它只保留两具 SRM 发射器，去掉了 LRM 发射器，标准中型激光升级为更先进的 ER 中型激光，并改用双倍散热器加以强化。Base

column1: A variant of the Combine's KTO-20, the KTO-C was one of the test bed 'Mechs for the C3 Slave Unit, one of the Medium Lasers being removed in order to free up the necessary weight.
column2: KTO-C 是联合体 KTO-20 的变体，是 C3 从属单元的试验台机甲之一，它移除一门中型激光以腾出所需重量。Base

column1: A ClanTech upgraded Kintaro.
column2: 氏族科技升级的金太郎。Base

column1: An upgrade to the KTO-C, the KTO-K removed the Large Laser and LRM launcher to upgrade the short-range missiles to Streak SRM-6s. The lasers were upgraded to ER Medium Lasers and a third was added. The most significant difference was the addition of Jump jets to allow the unit to leap up to 150 meters.
column2: KTO-K 是 KTO-C 的升级版，移除大型激光和 LRM 发射器，把短程火箭升级为连续 SRM-6。激光升级为 ER 中型激光，并加装第三门。最显著的区别是加装跳跃推进器，使单位能跃至 150 米。Base

column1: Kitfox KF-A
column2: 小狐 KF-A

column1: Kitfox
column2: 小狐

column1: The A configuration of the Kit Fox uses a Gauss Rifle as its primary long-range weapon. Two ER Medium Lasers provide medium and short-range firepower.
column2: 小狐 A 配置以一门高斯步枪为主要远程武器。两门 ER 中型激光提供中近程火力。Base

column1: Kitfox KF-B
column2: 小狐 KF-B

column1: The B configuration of the Kit Fox boasts a rapid-fire Ultra Autocannon-10 as its primary weapon, startling considering the 'Mech's tonnage. An ER Medium Laser, ER Small Laser, and an SRM-6 rack allow the Kit Fox B to finish off anything that manages to close ranges.
column2: 小狐 B 配置以一门速射超速自动炮-10 为主武器，就机甲的吨位而言令人吃惊。一门 ER 中型激光、一门 ER 小型激光和一具 SRM-6 挂架使小狐 B 能干掉任何设法接近的目标。Base

column1: Kitfox KF-D
column2: 小狐 KF-D

column1: The Kit Fox D is configured for indirect fire support, mounting dual LRM-15 racks as well as a LRM-5. A Narc Missile Beacon is also carried, which may be exploited by the Kit Fox D itself, as the targeting systems of Clan LRMs lack a minimum range; this literally allows the Kit Fox D to run up to an enemy and mark them for increased accuracy, and then fall back, firing the entire time.
column2: 小狐 D 配置为间接火力支援，装备双联 LRM-15 挂架以及一具 LRM-5。它还携带一具 NARC 导弹信标，且此信标可被小狐 D 自己利用——因为氏族 LRM 的瞄准系统没有最小射程，这实际上让小狐 D 能冲到敌人跟前为其标记以提升精度，然后一面后撤一面持续开火。Base

column1: Kitfox KF-Prime
column2: 小狐 KF-原装型

column1: In its primary configuration, the Kit Fox mounts an ER Large Laser and Small Pulse Laser on the left arm as its primary source of firepower. These are supplemented by an LB 5-X Autocannon for tactical flexibility and a Streak SRM-4 rack for close range combat.
column2: 主配置中，小狐左臂装备一门 ER 大型激光和一门小型脉冲激光作为主要火力。它们由一门 LB 5-X 自动炮（提供战术灵活性）和一具连续 SRM-4 挂架（用于混战）作补充。Base

column1: Kitfox KF-S
column2: 小狐 KF-S

column1: The Kit Fox S is a Clan Snow Raven variant based for space combat. The primary weapon is a Large Pulse Laser, while a Medium Pulse Laser and a Small Pulse Laser complement this, with a Streak SRM-4 for additional firepower.
column2: 小狐 S 是雪鸦氏族的太空战变体。主武器为一门大型脉冲激光，辅以一门中型脉冲激光和一门小型脉冲激光，另有一具连续 SRM-4 提供额外火力。Base

column1: Kodiak
column2: 科迪亚克

column1: A fast moving assault Mech, the Kodiak was originally designed by Clan Ghost Bear as a second-line mech and represents the epitome of Ghost Bear thinking: mostly defensive but capable of surprising speed and a devastating attack when launched.
column2: 科迪亚克是一款高速突击机甲，最初由鬼熊氏族设计为二线机甲，体现了鬼熊思维的精髓：偏重防御，但在发动时能展现出惊人的速度和毁灭性的攻击。Base

column1: Komodo
column2: 科莫多

column1: The Komodo was designed in 3053 to hunt and kill Clan Elemental Battle Armor. The 'Mech is built to be able to catch up to and destroy them with exceptional speed and maneuverability. The 'Mech is powered by a VOX 225 XL Engine that propels the 'Mech to a maximum speed of 86.4 kph. The Komodo can jump up to one hundred and fifty meters allowing it to traverse just about any terrain with ease, and is armored with seven and a half tons of armor. The 'Mech is also equipped with a Matabushi Guardian ECM Suite to defend against any enemy electronic warfare systems and also a Forward-1 TAG allowing the Komodo to designate a target for an Arrow IV artillery strike.
column2: 科莫多于 3053 年设计，专为猎杀氏族元素战斗装甲。机甲能以卓越的速度与机动性追上并消灭它们。它由 VOX 225 XL 引擎驱动，最高速度 86.4 公里/小时。科莫多可跳跃至一百五十米，轻松跨越几乎任何地形，并有七吨半装甲。它还配备马塔布希守护者 ECM 套件以防御敌方电子战系统，以及 Forward-1 TAG 使科莫多能为箭矢 IV 炮击标记目标。Base

column1: The Komodo is armed with ten Victory 23R Medium Lasers as its primary weapons. While these have a range of only 270 meters, the 'Mech has enough firepower to annihilate an entire point of Elementals. The 'Mech is also armed with two Yori Flyswatter Anti-Missile Systems to defend against missile attacks.
column2: 科莫多以十门"胜利 23R"中型激光为主武器。虽然这些武器射程仅 270 米，机甲却有足够火力歼灭整整一"点"元素步兵。机甲还装备两套"织部苍蝇拍"反导系统以抵御导弹攻击。Base

column1: The 2A variant of the Komodo is a modification that looks to increase the 'Mechs reach by replacing five of the Medium Lasers with a single ER Large Laser, allowing the Komodo to strike at a much farther range at the cost of raw firepower.
column2: 科莫多 2A 变体是一项改装，旨在通过以一门 ER 大型激光取代五门中型激光来提升机甲的打击距离，使科莫多以牺牲原始火力为代价能在远得多的距离上攻击。Base

column1: Linebacker A
column2: 中后卫 A

column1: Linebacker
column2: 中后卫

column1: Configured similarly to the Timber Wolf Prime, the Linebacker A carries, as its primary long-range weapons, a pair of ER Large Lasers that are backed up by an LRM-5 launcher and LRM-15 launcher, both of which allow the Linebacker to bombard its target at long range. For close combat, the 'Mech carries two ER Medium Lasers.
column2: 中后卫 A 配置与木材狼主型号相似，其主要远程武器为一对 ER 大型激光，辅以一具 LRM-5 和一具 LRM-15 发射器，使中后卫能在远距离轰击目标。混战方面，机甲携带两门 ER 中型激光。Base

column1: Linebacker B
column2: 中后卫 B

column1: The Linebacker B is a sniper configuration. The 'Mech carries a powerful Gauss Rifle for fearsome long range hitting power. For close combat, the 'Mech has three ER Medium Lasers and a single ER Small Laser.
column2: 中后卫 B 是狙击配置。机甲携带一门强劲的高斯步枪，具备可怕的远程打击力。混战方面，它有三门 ER 中型激光和一门 ER 小型激光。Base

column1: Linebacker D
column2: 中后卫 D

column1: The Linebacker D is a committed close-combat configuration with four highly accurate Streak SRM-6 launchers providing an overwhelming close range missile barrage. The launchers are backed up by two ER Medium Lasers and a rear-mounted ER Small Laser, making this configuration a ferocious short-range brawler - until its three ammunition bins run dry.
column2: 中后卫 D 是一款彻底的混战配置，四具极为精准的连续 SRM-6 发射器提供压倒性的短程火箭弹幕。发射器辅以两门 ER 中型激光和一门后向 ER 小型激光，使此配置成为凶悍的近距离缠斗者——直到三个弹药箱打空为止。Base

column1: In its primary configuration the Linebacker is configured for long range combat, with two powerful ER PPCs for its primary firepower, as they can reach a target at long range and are each capable of vaporizing almost a full ton of standard armor. These are backed up by an LRM-5 launcher for long range missile bombardment. For close combat, the Linebacker Prime carries a light arsenal of a highly accurate Streak SRM-4 launcher and a rear-mounted ER Small Laser.
column2: 主配置中，中后卫为远程战斗而设，以两门强力 ER PPC 为主火力，它们能在远距离触及目标，各自几乎能蒸发整整一吨标准装甲。这两门主炮辅以一具 LRM-5 发射器用于远程导弹轰炸。混战方面，中后卫主型号携带一套轻型武器：一具极为精准的连续 SRM-4 发射器和一门后向 ER 小型激光。Base

column1: Lineholder
column2: 战线守护者

column1: The Lineholder was the first BattleMech design to come from Kressly Warworks. The Lineholder is designed around a set of Common Sense Rules for 'Mech design. This approach has produced a 'Mech with a good ground speed and respectable amount of armor and firepower. The 'Mech has a top speed of 86.4 km/h, allowing it to keep up with all but the fastest light and medium 'Mechs. The Lineholder also carries ten tons of armor protection and has fourteen heat sinks. Its mix of off-the-shelf weapons and equipment makes the Lineholder a reliable 'Mech that is easy to repair and is dependable in battle. However, the ultimate selling point for the Lineholder, especially to its target audience of small units and minor nobles, is value and price. In the first year of sales, the Lineholder was historically successful compared with other 55-ton BattleMechs. For minor factions able to afford brand new BattleMechs, the Lineholder has become the garrison machine of choice.
column2: 战线守护者是克雷斯利兵工厂出品的第一款战斗机甲设计。它围绕一套"机甲设计常识规则"构建。这一思路造就了一台地面速度良好、装甲与火力都相当可观的机甲。它最高速度 86.4 公里/小时，除最快的轻中型机甲外都能跟上。战线守护者还携带十吨装甲防护并有十四台散热器。它采用的现货武器与装备组合使其成为易于修理、作战可靠的机甲。然而其终极卖点——尤其对小型单位与末等贵族这类目标客户——是性价比。在销售第一年，战线守护者的业绩与其他 55 吨战斗机甲相比堪称历史性成功。对买得起全新战斗机甲的小势力而言，它已成为驻防机型的首选。Base

column1: The primary weapons on the Lineholder are a pair of LongFire V LRM-5 launchers. These allow the Lineholder to keep an enemy at long range and enable the 'Mech to provide limited indirect fire support. The LRMs are backed up by a BlazeFire Systems Large Laser. Finally, the Lineholder carries four Intek Medium Lasers to protect itself in close combat.
column2: 战线守护者的主武器是一对"长火 V"LRM-5 发射器。它们让战线守护者能把敌人保持在远距离，并使机甲能提供有限的间接火力支援。LRM 由一门"烈焰系统"大型激光支援。最后，战线守护者携带四门英泰克中型激光以在混战中自卫。Base

column1: An upgrade of the Lineholder to make it more viable on the modern battlefield, the LH3 variant replaces the Large Laser with an ER Large Laser and the four Medium Lasers with two Medium Pulse Lasers.
column2: LH3 变体是对战线守护者的升级，使其在现代战场上更具生存力：它以一门 ER 大型激光取代大型激光，以两门中型脉冲激光取代四门中型激光。Base

column1: Linesman
column2: 巡线员

column1: Developed by the Capellan Confederation at the same time as the Cataphract this prototype 'Mech never entered full production. Its designs were eventually sold and used to create the Daboku and Mauler. It carries two Medium Lasers, four AC/2s, and two LRM-15
column2: 此原型机甲由卡佩兰邦联与铁甲舰同期开发，从未进入量产。其设计最终被出售，用于打造打木与重击者。它携带两门中型激光、四门 AC/2 和两具 LRM-15

column1: Loader King
column2: 装载之王

column1: The Loader King is one of the few IndustrialMechs still being manufactured in the Inner Sphere. This is due in large part to the fact that Achernar BattleMechs, the parent company of Achernar Heavy Industries, chose to maintain their IndustrialMech output rather than retool the lines for BattleMech production. Achernar BattleMechs already produces the Locust, Wasp, Phoenix Hawk and the Enforcer at their headquarters on New Avalon.
column2: 装载之王是内天体仍在制造的少数工业机甲之一。这在很大程度上是因为阿克尔纳战斗机甲的母公司阿克尔纳重工选择维持其工业机甲产量，而非将生产线改装用于战斗机甲生产。阿克尔纳战斗机甲已在其新阿瓦隆总部生产蝗虫、黄蜂、凤凰鹰和执法者。Base

column1: Industrial 'Mech
column2: 工业机甲

column1: I'm sure we can do something with this Commander, but we are pretty limited without completely gutting and rebuilding it as a whole new 'Mech.  First thing we'd have to do, is get rid of that I.C.E. and get a proper fusion engine in it.  Not sure this will be worth it.  Might not be bad for moving things around the bays though...
column2: 我相信我们能对它做点什么，指挥官，但如果不彻底掏空并作为全新机甲重建，我们的余地相当有限。首先我们得扔掉那台内燃机，换上正经的聚变引擎。不确定这值不值得。不过用来在机库里搬搬东西也许不错……

column1: Locust IIC
column2: 蝗虫 IIC

column1: The Clan Jade Falcon version carries CASE with an Extended Range Medium Laser in the center torso section and two Streak SRM-2s in each arm.
column2: 翡翠猎鹰氏族版本携带 C.A.S.E.，中央躯干有一门 ER 中型激光，每臂两具连续 SRM-2。Base

column1: This Clan Smoke Jaguar version is set up to sport an Extended Range Large Laser in its center torso, with a Small Pulse Laser in each arm, making this variant a quite capable infantry killer in addition to its role as a fast sniper.
column2: 此烟虎氏族版本在中央躯干装备一门 ER 大型激光，每臂一门小型脉冲激光，使该变体除了担任快速狙击手外，还是相当出色的步兵杀手。Base

column1: This version was redesigned so that it could be produced in the Inner Sphere by Clan Jade Falcon on their Occupation Zone headquarters world of Sudeten. It replaces the small lasers of the standard variant with three General Systems Heavy Small Lasers in each arm. The medium pulse laser has been downgraded to a Series 7Ja ER Medium Laser, while a pair of additional double heat sinks are added to help deal with the increased heat.
column2: 此版本经过重新设计，以便翡翠猎鹰氏族能在其占领区总部世界苏德滕于内天体生产。它将标准变体的小型激光换成每臂三门通用系统重型小型激光。中型脉冲激光被降级为 7Ja 系列 ER 中型激光，同时加装两台额外双倍散热器以应对增加的热量。Base

column1: One of the best known BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere for its low production and operation costs, the Locust is also well known in the Clans. In 2832, Clan Mongoose unleashed an upgraded version of the venerable 'Mech on the Clans, known as the Locust IIC. The speedy design complemented Mongoose tactics, enabling them to win many Trials.
column2: 蝗虫因其低廉的生产与运营成本成为内天体最知名的战斗机甲之一，在氏族中同样广为人知。2832 年，猫鼬氏族向氏族推出这款古老机甲的升级版，称为蝗虫 IIC。该高速设计与猫鼬战术相得益彰，使他们赢下许多试炼。Base

column1: Locust
column2: 蝗虫

column1: The Locust 0P is a primitive downgrade, favored among Bandits and Local Security forces for it's easy to maintain Internal Combustion Engine.
column2: 蝗虫 0P 是原始降级版，因其易于维护的内燃引擎而受匪帮与地方保安部队青睐。Base

column1: Light Fire Support
column2: 轻型火力支援

column1: The Locust 1E was an attempt to turn the Locust into a viable front line mech by increasing its firepower with an additional Medium Laser.  Having removed its reliance on ammunition, the Locust is able to operate for an extended amount of time without supplies.
column2: 蝗虫 1E 试图通过加装一门额外中型激光提升火力，把蝗虫变成可行的前线机甲。摆脱对弹药的依赖后，蝗虫能在无补给的情况下长时间作战。Base

column1: The Locust's 1M model is interesting in that it can churn out a decent volley of LRMs for such a small 'Mech. It's a great harasser, especially if you can use its speed to lob missiles into the weaker rear armor of targets. But it normally has almost no armor itself.
column2: 蝗虫 1M 型号有趣之处在于，如此小的机甲竟能喷出可观的 LRM 齐射。它是出色的骚扰者，尤其当你能用速度把导弹甩进目标较薄弱的后方装甲时。但它自身通常几乎无装甲。Base

column1: Extremely Fast Scout
column2: 极端快速侦察兵

column1: Locust 1S models tend to sacrifice the little armor they normally mount to fire respectable SRM salvos. Definitely useful for hit-and-runs, especially if those shots provide the extra punch to knock down a target.
column2: 蝗虫 1S 型号倾向于牺牲本来就不多的装甲，以倾泻可观的 SRM 齐射。对打了就跑的战术绝对有用，尤其当这些射击能提供击倒目标的额外打击力时。Base

column1: The basic Locust 1V has one big advantage: speed. It's not meant to put up much of a fight, but you'd be hard-pressed to find a 'Mech that goes further and is harder to hit.
column2: 基础型蝗虫 1V 有一个巨大优势：速度。它本就不为硬拼而设，但你也很难找到另一台跑得更远、更难被击中的机甲。Base

column1: The Royal Locust-1Vb was used by the Star League's Royal brigades as a scout and makes use a bevy of advanced technologies that now lostech.
column2: 皇家蝗虫-1Vb 曾被星盟皇家旅用作侦察机甲，采用了一批如今已成失传技术的先进技术。Base

column1: Scout and Flanker
column2: 侦察与侧翼

column1: The 2S variant was designed by Majesty Metals of the Magistracy of Canopus as a fast raider and tank hunter suitable for export throughout the periphery. Armed with twin SRM6s, loaded with 2 tons of munitions and fitted with MASC; the 2S is a fearsome knife fighter that can quickly close in and cripple it’s opponents. To make room for the missiles, the standard engine was substituted for an XL engine and paired with an endo steel chassis. Unfortunately the low armour and lack of CASE protected magazines has lead to a high mortality rate among it’s pilots; earning it the nickname dead woman's coffin. As the pilot often goes down with their mech – usually in a fiery explosion as the ammunition magazines detonate. Considered an expensive failure by the Magistracy, the design is nonetheless in high demand throughout the periphery with back orders sufficient to keep Magistracy Metals supplying the design for years to come.
column2: 2S 变体由卡诺普斯法域的 Majesty Metals 设计，作为适合向外围区各地出口的快速劫掠者与坦克猎手。它装备双联 SRM6，装填 2 吨弹药并配备 MASC；2S 是一名令人生畏的短兵相接者，能迅速逼近并瘫痪对手。为给导弹腾出空间，标准引擎被换成 XL 引擎，并搭配内骨骼底盘。遗憾的是，薄弱的装甲和缺乏 C.A.S.E. 保护的弹仓导致其机师死亡率很高；为它赢得了"死人棺材"的绰号——机师常常随座机一同陨落，通常是弹药库殉爆时的猛烈爆炸。法域认为这是一次昂贵的失败，但该设计在外围区仍需求旺盛，积压订单足以让 Majesty Metals 在未来数年继续供应这一设计。Base

column1: Fast Striker
column2: 快速打击者

column1: The LCT-0S, or Dead Woman's Coffin, is designed to unleash a withering fusillade of SRMs, and then it will likely be destroyed. Since the only SRMs its armed with are unguided, it's unlikely to score any hits. Carrying subsequent salvos is only wasted tonnage
column2: LCT-0S，又称"死人棺材"，其设计目的是倾泻一阵猛烈的 SRM 弹雨，然后它很可能会被摧毁。由于它装备的 SRM 都是无制导的，很可能一发都打不中。携带后续齐射只是浪费吨位

column1: The 3D Locust introduced in 3049 used Star League technology to take the concept of the 1M further. Although it carried only two Magna Longbow-5 launchers, the engineers at Achernar BattleMechs on New Avalon upgraded the armor to Ferro-Fibrous and the structure to Endo Steel. Completely lacking in close-range weaponry this variant was suitable for harassing the enemy at long range then fleeing before they could get too close.
column2: 3D 蝗虫于 3049 年推出，使用星盟科技把 1M 的理念推进得更远。虽然它只携带两具玛格纳长弓-5 发射器，但新阿瓦隆阿克尔纳战斗机甲的工程师把装甲升级为铁纤维、结构升级为内骨骼。该变体完全没有近程武器，适合在远距离骚扰敌人，然后在对方逼近前逃离。Base

column1: The 3M Locust was built for the Free Worlds League in 3050, with production carried out at both Corean Enterprises on Stewart and Free Worlds Defense Industries on Gibson. It retained the Martell medium laser but replaced the machine guns with four Magna Small Lasers and added a Voelkers Parasol Anti-Missile System in the left arm for missile defense. The armor was upgraded to Kallon FWL Special Ferro-Fibrous with CASE in the left torso to protect the one ton of AMS ammo and utilized a Corean-II Delux Endo Steel chassis. The electronics were also updated to a Garrett T10 B communications system and a Corean CalcMaster targeting-tracking system.
column2: 3M 蝗虫于 3050 年为自由世界联盟建造，在斯图尔特上的科里安企业与吉布森上的自由世界防务工业同时生产。它保留马特尔中型激光，但把机枪换成四门玛格纳小型激光，并在左臂加装一套"沃克斯阳伞"反导系统用于导弹防御。装甲升级为卡隆 FWL 特种铁纤维，左躯干的 C.A.S.E. 保护一吨 AMS 弹药，底盘则采用科里安-II 豪华内骨骼。电子设备也更新为加勒特 T10 B 通讯系统和科里安 CalcMaster 瞄准追踪系统。Base

column1: The 3S Locust, constructed on Furillo by Defiance Industries in 3049, carried the 1S upgrade further. This time, as with the 3M, the structure used Endo Steel and the armor was upgraded with Ferro-Fibrous. The SRM-2s were upgraded to Coventry T4H Streak SRM-2s while the medium laser was kept
column2: 3S 蝗虫由迪法恩斯工业于 3049 年在弗里洛建造，将 1S 的升级推进得更远。这次与 3M 一样，结构采用内骨骼，装甲升级为铁纤维。SRM-2 升级为考文垂 T4H 连续 SRM-2，中型激光则予以保留

column1: The Locust 3V trades off protection for more firepower, relying on its superior speed to avoid getting hit in the first place.
column2: 蝗虫 3V 以防护换取更多火力，依靠其卓越速度从一开始就避免被击中。Base

column1: Longbow
column2: 长弓

column1: To add some speed to the Longbow, the OW variant removes two Medium Lasers and five and a half tons of armor. This allowed the 255 Fusion Engine to be replaced with a larger 340, increasing the top speed of the Longbow to 64 km/h, allowing the 'Mech to keep up with most heavy 'Mechs. The -0W is otherwise the same as the -7Q variant.
column2: 为给长弓增加一些速度，OW 变体移除两门中型激光和五吨半装甲。这使 255 聚变引擎得以换成更大的 340，长弓最高速度提升至 64 公里/小时，能与大多数重型机甲并驾齐驱。-0W 在其他方面与-7Q 变体相同。Base

column1: Hail of Missiles
column2: 导弹弹幕

column1: The Longbow, introduced in 2480, has seen service in the armies of the Inner Sphere since the days of the Star League and is one of the most well-known fire support 'Mechs in existence. As a fire-support 'Mech though, the Longbow is a trusted and reliable machine that can be counted on to carry out the mission it is designed for. The primary weapons on the Longbow are its LRM launchers, four in all, a pair of 20s and a pair of 5s, letting the Longbow put out 50 LRMs into any target it can see.
column2: 长弓于 2480 年推出，自星盟时代起就在内天体各军服役，是现存最知名的火力支援机甲之一。作为火力支援机甲，长弓是一台值得信赖的可靠机器，能被指望完成其设计使命。长弓的主要武器是其 LRM 发射器——共四具，成对的 20 型和成对的 5 型——让它能向任何看得见的目标倾泻 50 枚 LRM。Base

column1: The 7V variant of the Longbow upgrades the design to more modern specifications. The 'Mech is powered by an XL engine that weighs half as much as the original engine. The 'Mech also removes the two LRM-5 launchers and adds Artemis IV to the LRM-20 launchers, and CASE for added protection. For close combat, the 7V has 5 Medium Pulse Lasers. To add a little more long range firepower, the 7V has also has an ER Large Laser.
column2: 长弓 7V 变体将该设计升级至更现代的规格。机甲由一台重量仅为原引擎一半的 XL 引擎驱动。它还移除两具 LRM-5 发射器，为 LRM-20 发射器加装 Artemis IV，并用 C.A.S.E. 增加保护。混战方面，7V 有 5 门中型脉冲激光。为进一步增加远程火力，7V 还配备一门 ER 大型激光。Base

column1: Louse
column2: 虱子

column1: A favorite tool of planetary governments through out the Periphery, the Louse is designed for riot suppression. Capable of dispersing riots with lethal and non lethal options, it works well against civilians and lightly armed vehicles while posing no significant threat to actual battlemechs or military grade vehicles. Dual grenade launchers and a mixed laser package provide the bulk of the firepower, whilst a pair of flare launchers provides additional deterrent and can be used defensively in combat. Spall lined armour provides additional protection against infantry grade weapons and a set of sensors designed specifically for peering through cluttered urban environments round out the package. Often deployed as scouts and support forces; this mech is a common sight amongst the pirate bands who find themselves facing it across the battlefield. Not designed for battle, it is nonetheless pressed into service by desperate militias and governments that lack real battlemechs.
column2: 作为外围区各行星政府钟爱的工具，虱子专为镇压暴乱而设计。它能以致命与非致命手段驱散暴乱，对付平民和轻武装车辆效果良好，而对真正的战斗机甲或军用级车辆不构成显著威胁。双联榴弹发射器和混合激光组提供主要火力，另有一对照明弹发射器提供额外威慑，也可在战斗中用于防御。防崩落内衬装甲提供对步兵级武器的额外防护，一套专为穿透杂乱城市环境而设计的传感器补全了整套配置。它常作为侦察与支援部队部署；在那些与它战场相见的强盗团伙中也很常见。它并非为战斗设计，却仍被缺乏真正战斗机甲的绝望民兵与政府强行投入使用。Base

column1: Riot Suppresion
column2: 防暴压制

column1: Lupus
column2: 狼人

column1: This configuration was used for direct fire support roles. A Large Pulse Laser in one arm supported an Ultra AC/10 in the other. A pair of ER Medium Lasers gave the Lupus A additional firepower in case the 'Mech went through all 30 reloads for the autocannon. Twelve double heat sinks kept the heat manageable.
column2: 此配置用于直射火力支援角色。一臂的大型脉冲激光配合另一臂的超速 AC/10。两门 ER 中型激光为狼人 A 提供额外火力，以备机甲打光自动炮的 30 发再装填。十二台双倍散热器使热量可控。Base

column1: This version also used an autocannon, but it was a massive LB 20-X AC with three tons of ammunition. This was supported by a pair each of Medium Pulse Lasers, ER Small Lasers, and ER Medium Lasers. This variant carried eleven double heat sinks.
column2: 此版本同样使用自动炮，但是一门巨型 LB 20-X AC，配三吨弹药。它由成对的中型脉冲激光、ER 小型激光和 ER 中型激光支援。该变体携带十一台双倍散热器。Base

column1: The primary configuration of the Lupus replaces the Archer and Bombardier 'Mechs. A pair of LRM-20 launchers with improved Artemis IV guidance systems allows the warrior to destroy a foe before they can reach close range. The Lupus Prime also carries a set of jump jets which allowed a smart warrior the opportunity to hold the range open, bombarding the enemy with heavy missile barrages. The only drawback is the limited ammunition supply: A mere three tons of ammunition allows for only a brief engagement. Should the enemy close with the Lupus all is not lost. The ER Medium Laser in each arm allow the Lupus to slice off armor, and the ECM Suite makes the Lupus Prime more difficult to target.
column2: 狼人的主配置取代了弓箭手与轰炸机两款机甲。两具配改进型 Artemis IV 制导系统的 LRM-20 发射器，让战士能在敌人接近前将其摧毁。狼人主型号还携带一套跳跃推进器，让聪明的战士有机会保持距离，用重型导弹弹幕轰炸敌人。唯一缺点是弹药有限：仅三吨弹药只够短暂交战。若敌人逼近狼人，也并非无计可施。每臂的 ER 中型激光让狼人能削切装甲，而 ECM 套件使狼人主型号更难被锁定。Base

column1: Mackie
column2: 麦基

column1: The initial prototype Mackie was designated the MSK-5S, and carried a slightly different weapons load than the production model MSK-6S. Using an Autocannon/5 in the right arm instead of the AC/10, the MSK-5S also mounted a Large Laser in the center torso, rather than the twin Medium Lasers, and had two more heat sinks. Twenty tons of Primitive Armor protected the first generation Mackie. This armor, though heavier, provided less protection than later models. The MSK-5S was used by Colonel Kincaid in his now-famous combat trial versus the Merkava tanks.
column2: 最初的麦基原型被定名为 MSK-5S，武器载荷与量产型号 MSK-6S 略有不同。它在右臂使用一门自动炮/5 而非 AC/10，中央躯干也装一门大型激光而非双联中型激光，并多两台散热器。二十吨原始装甲保护着第一代麦基。这种装甲虽然更重，提供的防护却少于后来的型号。MSK-5S 被金凯德上校用于他如今著名的对抗梅卡瓦坦克的战斗试验。Base

column1: Granddady Mech
column2: 老祖宗机甲

column1: The initial prototype Mackie was designated the MSK-5S, and carried a slightly different weapons load than the production model MSK-6S. Using an Autocannon/5 in the right arm instead of the AC/10, the MSK-5S also mounted a Large Laser in the center torso, rather than the twin Medium Lasers, and had two more heat sinks. Twenty tons of Primitive Armor protected the first generation Mackie. This armor, though heavier, provided less protection than later models. The MSK-5S was used by Colonel Kincaid in his now-famous combat trial versus the Merkava tanks. .
column2: 最初的麦基原型被定名为 MSK-5S，武器载荷与量产型号 MSK-6S 略有不同。它在右臂使用一门自动炮/5 而非 AC/10，中央躯干也装一门大型激光而非双联中型激光，并多两台散热器。二十吨原始装甲保护着第一代麦基。这种装甲虽然更重，提供的防护却少于后来的型号。MSK-5S 被金凯德上校用于他如今著名的对抗梅卡瓦坦克的战斗试验。.

column1: Developed by the Terran Hegemony in the 25th century, the Mackie was the first true BattleMech. Based on advanced technology that the Hegemony Armed Forces (HAF) had been developing for decades under Director-General Jacob Cameron, the Mackie was the ultimate manifestation of Hegemony military might.
column2: 麦基由地球霸权在二十五世纪开发，是首款真正的战斗机甲。基于霸权武装部队在总监雅各布·卡梅隆治下数十年研发的先进技术，麦基是霸权军事力量的终极体现。Base

column1: This catchall series of Mackies was used to designate -6S's retrofitted with a wide variety of more modern components.
column2: 这一"杂项"麦基系列用于指代以各种更现代组件改装的-6S。Base

column1: Though most nations got rid of their cloned Mackies in favor of their own 'Mechs, the Hegemony was proud of their achievement. Moreover, many Hegemony militia units made extensive use of the first BattleMech, resulting in a continuous production of the first BattleMech right up until the Amaris Coup. Many of the various militia upgrades coalesced into the -9H, helped by the fact that Skobel continued to produce small quantities of this design. It mounts two Donal PPCs and an Imperator Autocannon/20, backed up by the pair of Starflash Medium Lasers. Nineteen tons of armor gave it full protection, allowing the 9Hs longevity.
column2: 尽管多数国家放弃克隆的麦基转而使用自家机甲，霸权仍为这一成就自豪。此外，许多霸权民兵单位大量使用首款战斗机甲，导致这款初代战斗机甲一直持续生产至阿马里斯政变。诸多民兵升级方案最终汇聚成-9H，这也得益于斯科贝尔持续小批量生产该设计。它装备两门多纳尔 PPC 和一门帝皇自动炮/20，辅以一对"星闪"中型激光。十九吨装甲给予它全面防护，使 9H 得以长盛不衰。Base

column1: Mad Dog
column2: 疯狗

column1: The Mad Dog A can bring devastating fire on targets at any range, mounting an ER PPC and an LB 5-X AC, with which it can easily cripple enemies from long range. Should it get close enough, its six SRM-6 racks ensure the demise of nearly any foe.
column2: 疯狗 A 能在任何距离上向目标倾泻毁灭火力，装备一门 ER PPC 和一门 LB 5-X AC，凭此可轻易在远距离瘫痪敌人。一旦它贴近，六具 SRM-6 挂架几乎能确保任何敌人的灭亡。Base

column1: The Mad Dog's most distinctive feature is its side torso and arm pods, which are practically full modules by themselves, suggesting that the mech was conceived as a long-range support unit. The torso modules, angled high, are ideal for missiles while the arms serve as extended turrets suited for direct-fire weaponry.
column2: 疯狗最显著的特征是其侧面躯干与臂部吊舱——它们本身几乎就是完整模块，暗示这款机甲最初是作为远程支援单位构想的。高高倾斜的躯干模块非常适合导弹，而臂部则如同延伸炮塔，适合直射武器。Base

column1: The Mad Dog C greatly differs from the other configurations, having replaced its entire weapon load with two massive Gauss Rifles for a powerful long-range punch.
column2: 疯狗 C 与其他配置差异极大，它把全部武器载荷换成两门巨型高斯步枪，换取强大的远程打击力。Base

column1: This variant uses a pair of ATM 12s that are powerful at all ranges. It also uses paired ER Medium Lasers, Medium Pulse Lasers, and ER Small Lasers. An extra heat sink helps to keep heat levels under some control.
column2: 此变体使用两具在所有距离上都强劲的 ATM 12。它还配有成对的 ER 中型激光、中型脉冲激光和 ER 小型激光。一台额外散热器有助于将热量水平控制在某种程度的掌握之中。Base

column1: Built with new Heavy Laser technology, the Mad Dog H downgrades the LRM-20 launchers to LRM-15s, so it can mount it's arsenal of a Heavy Large Laser and three Heavy Medium Lasers, making it much more capable at close range.
column2: 疯狗 H 采用新型重型激光技术建造，将 LRM-20 发射器降级为 LRM-15，以便搭载由一门重型大型激光和三门重型中型激光组成的武器库，使其在近距离强大得多。Base

column1: Marauder IIC A
column2: 掠夺者 IIC A

column1: Marauder IIC
column2: 掠夺者 IIC

column1: A modern Clan take on the classic Succession Wars era MAR-3R Marauder, the A variant retains the arm-mounted weaponry of the standard Marauder IIC, removing the torso-mounted ER PPC and ER Small Lasers in exchange for a LB 5-X AC in its right torso supplied with single ton of ammo.
column2: 这是氏族对经典继承战争时代 MAR-3R 掠夺者的现代演绎。A 变体保留标准掠夺者 IIC 的臂载武器，去掉躯干搭载的 ER PPC 与 ER 小型激光，换取右侧躯干一具 LB 5-X AC，配一吨弹药。Base

column1: Built around the Extended Range Particle Projector Cannon, one of the most powerful weapons in the Clan arsenal, the Marauder IIC's weapon layout is typical of the standard Marauder, each pod-like forearm carrying an ER PPC paired with Medium Pulse Lasers. Where the Marauder IIC differs is with its torso weaponry, replacing the top-mounted autocannon and its vulnerable ammunition-feed linkage with another ER PPC, and adding a set of four ER Small Lasers. Twenty-one double heat sinks keep heat levels manageable, with an enterprising MechWarrior able to use volley fire to keep up a steady barrage of fire.
column2: 掠夺者 IIC 以 ER 粒子加农炮——氏族武库中最强大的武器之一——为核心，其武器布局与标准掠夺者一致：每只吊舱式前臂各载一门 ER PPC 并配以中型脉冲激光。不同之处在于躯干武器：以另一门 ER PPC 取代顶部自动炮及其脆弱的供弹连接，并加装一组四门 ER 小型激光。二十一台双倍散热器将热量维持在可控水平，有进取心的机甲战士可用齐射维持稳定的火力倾泻。Base

column1: Marauder II
column2: 掠夺者 II

column1: The Marauder II was first built in 3012 in an attempt to take the firepower of the Marauder and combine it with the reliability and ruggedness of an assault chassis. This Variant was captured and rebuilt by Kurita to carry 2 Heavy and 2 Light PPC.
column2: 掠夺者 II 于 3012 年首次建造，旨在将掠夺者的火力与突击底盘的可靠性和坚固性相结合。此变体被库瑞塔缴获并重建，携带 2 门重型与 2 门轻型 PPC。Base

column1: The Marauder II was first built in 3012 in an attempt to take the firepower of the Marauder and combine it with the reliability and ruggedness of an assault chassis. This was achieved by generally upgrading the entire 'Mech's chassis to allow it to carry a much heavier armor and weapons load. The 'Mech was then armored with nineteen tons of armor, giving it protection that rivals that of the Atlas. Finally, to make up for the reduced mobility of the Marauder II, the 'Mech was outfitted with jump jets that give it a jumping capability of up to ninety meters. Blackwell Heavy Industries produced the design exclusively for Wolf's Dragoons until the end of the Fourth Succession War, when Jaime Wolf allowed them to sell to others.
column2: 掠夺者 II 于 3012 年首次建造，旨在将掠夺者的火力与突击底盘的可靠性和坚固性相结合。为此整机底盘全面升级，以承载重得多的装甲与武器。机甲配备了十九吨装甲，防护水平可与阿特拉斯匹敌。最后，为弥补掠夺者 II 机动性的下降，它装上了跳跃推进器，可跳跃至九十米。布莱克威尔重工一直为狼之龙骑兵独家生产该设计，直到第四次继承战争结束，海梅·沃尔夫才允许他们对外销售。Base

column1: The Marauder II was first built in 3012 in an attempt to take the firepower of the Marauder and combine it with the reliability and ruggedness of an assault chassis. This variant of the Marauder II, the -4B, is a rare introtech variant that carries a ballistic-heavy loadout while maintaining the -4A's armor and speed profile. The -4B carries a pair of AC/10s for its main firepower with 4 tons of ammo while a Large Laser and a pair of Medium Lasers back the autocannons up.
column2: 掠夺者 II 于 3012 年首次建造，旨在将掠夺者的火力与突击底盘的可靠性和坚固性相结合。此-4B 变体是罕见的入门科技变体，携带偏重弹道的配置，同时保持-4A 的装甲与速度。它装备两门 AC/10 作为主要火力，配 4 吨弹药，另有大型激光与两门中型激光支援自动炮。Base

column1: Take your average Marauder.  Pump it up, and make it even more maddening.
column2: 拿一台普通的掠夺者。强化它，让它更加疯狂。Base

column1: While the standard Marauder II, the MAD-5A, was built to spec for the Wolf's Dragoons to be a line combat unit and a traditional assault mech, the MAD-4HB is only one step removed from being a pirate design. Constructed by pirates after stealing a shipment of Marauder IIs meant for someone else, they removed the fancy equipment they couldn't maintain and filled in the holes with a frankly ungodly number of rockets, allowing the -4HB a punch that can instantly delete lesser mechs and even seriously damage mechs of its own caliber. After the rockets though, the -4HB has little firepower for an assault mech.
column2: 标准的掠夺者 II（MAD-5A）是按狼之龙骑兵的规格打造的战线作战单位与传统的突击机甲，而 MAD-4HB 离海盗设计只差一步。海盗们截获了一批本应交给他人的掠夺者 II 后自行建造，拆掉了他们无力维护的精良装备，用简直骇人的火箭数量填补空缺，使-4HB 拥有一击秒杀较弱机甲、甚至重创同级机甲的打击力。不过打完火箭之后，作为突击机甲它的火力就很有限了。Base

column1: Rocket Brawler
column2: 火箭混战

column1: Boss, I've got no words. Those damn Marian pirates are absolutely nuts. It's a miracle this thing doesn't blow itself in half when it fires all those rockets but at least it usually blows its target in half instead.
column2: 老大，我无话可说。那些该死的马里安海盗简直疯了。这东西在发射那一堆火箭时居然没把自己炸成两半，简直是奇迹，不过至少它通常会把目标炸成两半。Base

column1: The Marauder II 5D is a Davion refit to showcase both UAC10 and a Massive 400XXL Engine.
column2: 掠夺者 II 5D 是达维昂改装型，用以展示 UAC10 与庞大的 400XXL 引擎。Base

column1: Flanker & Ranged Assault
column2: 侧翼与远程突击

column1: The Marauder II 5D is a Davion refit to showcase both UAC and a Massive 400XXL Engine.
column2: 掠夺者 II 5D 是达维昂的改装型，用于展示超速自动炮和一台巨大的 400XXL 引擎。Base

column1: The Marauder II 6A is a Wolf's Dragoon upgrade to the 4A fielding an incredibly strong Engine with a Composite Structure under Reactive Plating to bring its terrible Weaponry to bear.
column2: 掠夺者 II 6A 是狼之龙骑兵对 4A 的升级型，配备极其强劲的引擎，在反应装甲之下使用复合结构，以发挥其可怕的火力。Base

column1: Marauder
column2: 掠夺者

column1: The Marauder is among the most classic of all Mech designs, venerable, powerful, respected. However, the original Marauder, the -1R, is mostly forgotten today. Clad in Ferro-Fibroous armor, it is otherwise the same as the downgraded -3R and is just as formidable.
column2: 掠夺者是所有机甲设计中最经典者之一：古老、强大、受人尊敬。然而原版掠夺者-1R 如今几乎被遗忘。它披挂铁纤维装甲，除此之外与降级版-3R 相同，同样令人生畏。Base

column1: The Marauder-2R is the Star League Royal regiments variant of the classic and powerful Marauder. It makes minimal changes, simply upgrading the PPCs to ER PPCs and the heat sinks to doubles, but those changes are enough to give the -2R much better staying and hitting power.
column2: 掠夺者-2R 是经典而强大的掠夺者的星盟皇家团变体。它改动极小，只是把 PPC 升级为 ER PPC、散热器升级为双倍，但这些改动已足以让-2R 拥有好得多的续航力与打击力。Base

column1: The Marauder-2R is the Star League Royal regiments variant of the classic and powerful Marauder. It makes minimal changes, simply upgrading the PPCs to ER PPCs and the heat sinks to doubles, but those changes are enough to give the -2R much better staying and hitting power.!
column2: 掠夺者-2R 是经典而强大的掠夺者的星盟皇家团变体。它改动极小，只是把 PPC 升级为 ER PPC、散热器升级为双倍，但这些改动已足以让-2R 拥有好得多的续航力与打击力。！Base

column1: The 3D Marauder was a modification of the 'Mech introduced for House Davion in 2834 which removed its ammunition dependency. In order to do this, the 3D replaced the Autocannon/5 and with a Large Laser. The saved weight was used to add four more heat sinks to the 'Mech to handle the added heat burden from the large laser.
column2: 3D 掠夺者是 2834 年为达维昂家族推出的改装型，它消除了机甲对弹药的依赖。为此，3D 以一门大型激光取代自动炮/5。节省的重量用于为机甲增加四台散热器，以处理大型激光带来的额外热负担。Base

column1: Built for House Liao in 2905, the 3L attempted to make the Marauder more heat efficient (and make up for a shortage in reliable PPCs) by replacing one of the arm-mounted particle cannons with a large laser. Additionally, two more heat sinks were added to further increase the Marauder's heat efficiency.
column2: 3L 于 2905 年为廖家族建造，它试图通过把一门臂载粒子加农炮换成大型激光来提升掠夺者的散热效率（并弥补可靠 PPC 的短缺）。此外还增加两台散热器，进一步提升掠夺者的散热效率。Base

column1: The 3M was introduced in 2873 specially for the Free Worlds League. Because of the abundance of large lasers built by that realm, the 3M model carried two large lasers in place of the PPCs. While running cooler than the weapons they replaced, the large lasers also caused slightly less damage. Additionally, the 3M added four heat sinks to the design, making the 'Mech much more manageable for pilots who have trouble with overheating their 'Mechs.
column2: 3M 于 2873 年专为自由世界联盟推出。由于该势力生产的大型激光数量充裕，3M 型号以两门大型激光取代 PPC。虽然比被替换的武器更凉，大型激光造成的伤害也略低。此外，3M 为设计增加了四台散热器，使这台机甲对那些容易让机甲过热的机师而言好驾驭得多。Base

column1: The Marauder was first built by General Motors in 2612 for use as an attack and direct fire support BattleMech. The first 'Mech to diverge from the traditional humanoid shape of previous machines, the Marauder was one of the most well-known 'Mechs in existence and originally meant to usher in a new generation of 'Mechs. Unfortunately, with the fall of the Star League, this new generation never quite materialized. On its own merits though, the Marauder was a devastatingly powerful 'Mech, outclassed only by larger machines like the Stalker and BattleMaster.
column2: 掠夺者最初由通用汽车于 2612 年建造，用作攻击与直射火力支援战斗机甲。作为首款偏离以往机种传统人形外形的机甲，掠夺者是现存最知名的机甲之一，原本意在开启新一代机甲。遗憾的是，随着星盟的陨落，这一代新机从未真正成为现实。不过就自身而言，掠夺者是一台破坏力惊人的强大机甲，只有潜行者和战将之类更大的机种能压过它。Base

column1: Built for the budget conscious mercenary, the 3S is designed for prolonged operations and utilises an all energy loadout that is cheaper to maintain than the standard 3R; whilst using widely available components cuts down on repair costs. The maintenance intensive Autocannon and it’s infamously bad ammunition feed are replaced with an extra trio of Medium Lasers and 6 heat sinks, dramatically increases the amount of time the mech can go without resupply. The extra heat sinking helps offset the increased heat profile added by the lasers, whilst the increased number of medium lasers act as a strong deterrent to any lighter mechs seeking to get inside the PPC’s firing arc. Debuting in 2955, production has remained steady; with two dozen of these machines being built a year at the General Motors Kathil facility. Sold exclusively to the mercenary market, the 3S is a common site on worlds like Outreach and Galatia and remains a favorite of mercenaries everywhere despite it's age.
column2: 3S 为预算有限的佣兵打造，专为长期作战设计，采用全能量武器配置，维护成本低于标准 3R；使用随处可得的组件也降低了修理费用。维护密集的自动炮及其臭名昭著的糟糕供弹系统被另外三门中型激光和 6 台散热器取代，大幅延长了机甲无需补给即可作战的时间。额外的散热能力有助于抵消激光带来的更高热负荷，而更多数量的中型激光则对任何试图钻进 PPC 射界的轻型机甲构成强力威慑。3S 于 2955 年首次亮相，生产一直稳定；通用汽车卡西尔工厂每年建造两打这样的机器。它专供佣兵市场，在"外联"和"加拉提亚"等世界随处可见，尽管年代久远，仍是各地佣兵的最爱。Base

column1: This experimental variant was made at Ronin Incorporated's facility on Wallis in 3039. Techs removed the standard weaponry from a Marauder and replaced the arm mounted weapons with a Binary Laser Cannon in each arm, while the torso mounted autocannon was replaced by twin SRM-6 launchers backed by one ton of ammunition. The Marauder-4X was also noteworthy because it used a Prototype Endo Steel chassis. To keep the heat under control, technicians installed twelve single heat sinks and six prototype Double Heat Sinks.
column2: 此实验变体于 3039 年在浪人公司位于沃利斯的工厂制造。技师从一台掠夺者上拆除标准武器，把臂载武器换成每臂一门双联激光炮，躯干自动炮则换成双联 SRM-6 发射器（配一吨弹药）。掠夺者-4X 还以使用原型内骨骼底盘而著称。为控制热量，技师安装了十二台单散热器和六台原型双倍散热器。Base

column1: Built for Solaris by Barrymore Munitions, this Marauder replaces the usual Autocannon with a unique Mech mortar capable of launching 10 Shells per Salvo.
column2: 这款掠夺者由巴里摩尔弹药公司为索拉里斯建造，以一门独特的机甲迫击炮取代通常的自动炮，每次齐射可发射 10 发炮弹。Base

column1: Support & Ranged Assault
column2: 支援与远程突击

column1: A Clan-tech retrofit of the classic MAD-3R Marauder, designed for use by second-line garrison and solahma forces, the Marauder C replaced some of the Inner Spheroid weaponry with Clan equivalents. The Marauder C swapped the PPCs for a pair of Clan-tech Large Pulse Lasers and the standard autocannon for a Ultra AC/5 model, but retained the IS medium lasers. The munitions for the autocannon were also protected with CASE.
column2: 掠夺者 C 是经典 MAD-3R 掠夺者的氏族技术改装版，供二线驻军与"索拉赫马"部队使用，它以氏族同类武器替换了部分内天体武器。掠夺者 C 把 PPC 换成一对氏族技术大型脉冲激光，把标准自动炮换成超速 AC/5，但保留内天体中型激光。自动炮弹药也由 C.A.S.E. 保护。Base

column1: Marshal
column2: 元帅

column1: When the Treaty of Taurus was signed, it established the New Colony Region in co-operation between the Magistracy of Canopus and the Taurian Concordat and also created the Colonial Marshals.
column2: 陶鲁斯条约签署后，卡诺普斯法域与陶里安协约合作建立了新殖民地地区，并创设了殖民地法警。Base

column1: This is a Sherrifs mech, It brings a peice of mind to folk, but is not heavy on technology.
column2: 这是治安官的机甲，它让人安心，但在技术上并不复杂。Base

column1: Mauler
column2: 重击者

column1: The MAL-1P utilizes just about the same weapons as stock maulers, except this version carries a PPC in each arm. It retains both LRMs, downgrading these from the LRM-15s to LRM-10s, and keeps the MAL-1R's four Autocannon/2s. A extra-light 270 engine keeps it moving and eleven Double Heat Sinks keep the heat at bay.
column2: MAL-1P 使用的武器与原装重击者几乎相同，只是此版本每臂携带一门 PPC。它保留两具 LRM（从 LRM-15 降级为 LRM-10），并保留 MAL-1R 的四门自动炮/2。一台 270 超轻型引擎让它保持机动，十一台双倍散热器则将热量挡在外面。Base

column1: The Mauler is armed with four Imperator Smoothie-2 Autocannon/2s as its longest ranged primary weapons. Individually, the damage the AC/2s deal is insignificant, but together they can steadily whittle away armor at extreme range. The 'Mech also carries two Shigunga LRM-15 launchers, adding much needed punch to the extreme reach of its four autocannons. The 'Mech also carries two Victory Nickel Alloy ER Large Lasers for added long range punch.
column2: 重击者装备四门"帝皇奶昔-2"自动炮/2 作为最远程的主武器。单门 AC/2 的伤害微不足道，但合在一起便能在极远距离持续削弱敌方装甲。它还携带两具"紫郡"LRM-15 发射器，为四门自动炮的极远射程增添急需的打击力。机甲还携带两门"胜利镍合金"ER 大型激光以增加远程打击力。Base

column1: The Mauler MAL-2P should be considered a prototype. Unlike the -1P or MX90, the -2P carries a pair of Lasers in each arm; it's rumored that more than two can affixed if need be. Its twin LRM-10s allow it to send missiles at a greater distance and two Ultra Autocannon/5s give it long to close range support. Both the LRMs and UAC/5s have two tons of ammunition a piece, and like the -1P and MX90, the 2P has Cellular Ammunition Storage Equipment to help protect it from ammo explosions. Eleven Double Heat Sinks and a 270 Standard Engine round out the rest of it load out.
column2: 重击者 MAL-2P 应被视为原型机。与-1P 或 MX90 不同，-2P 每臂携带两门激光；据传必要时可加装两门以上。其双联 LRM-10 使其能将导弹投送到更远距离，两门超速自动炮/5 提供远至近程支援。LRM 与 UAC/5 各配两吨弹药，且与-1P 和 MX90 一样，2P 拥有蜂窝式弹药储存设备以防弹药爆炸。十一台双倍散热器与 270 标准引擎构成其配置的其余部分。Base

column1: The -2R variant of the Mauler uses relatively new weapons. The standard AC/2s are replaced with Ultra versions, doubling their potential damage. Paired ER Medium Lasers are fitted in arms formerly housing the ER Large Lasers. The missile launchers are reduced to smaller LRM-10s. A heavier standard fusion engine is utilized instead of the expensive XL.
column2: 重击者-2R 变体使用相对较新的武器。标准 AC/2 换成超速版本，潜在伤害翻倍。原本安装 ER 大型激光的臂部改装成对的 ER 中型激光。导弹发射器缩减为较小的 LRM-10。它采用较重的标准聚变引擎，而非昂贵的 XL。Base

column1: The -C variant of the Mauler is a modification that was made to the -1R model to allow it to carry a C3 Slave unit into battle. This is achieved by removing one ton of autocannon ammunition. This small modification allows the Mauler to share targeting data with friendly units and makes the 'Mech a highly effective sniper.
column2: 重击者的-C 变体是对-1R 型号的改装，使其能携带一台 C3 从属单元进入战斗。这通过移除一吨自动炮弹药实现。这一小小改动让重击者能与友军共享瞄准数据，使其成为高效的狙击手。Base

column1: Men Shen
column2: 门神

column1: Named for the door guards who serve to ward off evil spirits from a home, the Men Shen is the first OmniMech to come from the Capellan Confederation, it borrows heavily from the Raven BattleMech for its basic design concept. The 'Mech is built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a vulnerable but light VOX 330 XL Engine that gives it a top speed of 97.2 km/h that is augmented by MASC system allowing the 'Mech to be pushed up to 129.6 km/h in short bursts. The Men Shen comes with eleven tons of armor, giving it a respectable amount of protection. The Men Shen carries on its base chassis a Beagle Active Probe allowing it to serve in a recon role regardless of its configuration. For weapons and equipment the Men Shen has seventeen tons of free pod space.
column2: 门神之名取自守护家宅驱除邪灵的门卫，它是卡佩兰邦联的首款全能机甲，基本设计概念大量借鉴渡鸦战斗机甲。该机甲建立在轻量化内骨骼底盘上，由脆弱但轻便的 VOX 330 XL 引擎驱动，最高速度 97.2 公里/小时，并可由 MASC 系统在短促爆发中推至 129.6 公里/小时。门神配有十一吨装甲，防护相当可观。其基础底盘搭载比格犬主动探测器，使其无论何种配置都能胜任侦察任务。武器与装备方面，门神拥有十七吨自由吊舱空间。Base

column1: In its primary configuration the Men Shen is a powerful close combat 'Mech and is capable of providing indirect fire support to friendly units. For close-range combat, the primary configuration has four highly accurate Medium Pulse Lasers. To provide both direct and indirect long range fire support, the primary configuration of the Men Shen has an LRM-15 launcher with an Artemis IV fire control system for increased missile accuracy.
column2: 主配置中，门神是一台强大的混战机甲，并能向友军单位提供间接火力支援。近程战斗方面，主配置有四门极为精准的中型脉冲激光。为提供直接与间接的远程火力支援，门神主配置装有一具带 Artemis IV 火控系统以提升导弹精度的 LRM-15 发射器。Base

column1: A versatile configuration, the A configuration has an LB-X Autocannon/10 that allows it to fire both standard and cluster ammunition. For close combat, the A configuration has three ER Medium Lasers and a TAG laser designator allowing the 'Mech to call in friendly artillery fire on a target.
column2: A 配置是多用途配置，装有一门 LB-X 自动炮/10，可发射标准弹与集束弹。混战方面，A 配置有三门 ER 中型激光和一具 TAG 激光指示器，使机甲能召唤友军炮火打击目标。Base

column1: Intended to act as a long range sniper, the B configuration of the Men Shen carries as its primary weapons a pair of LB-X Autocannon/2s that allow it to fire either standard and cluster ammunition as well as act as a anti-aircraft 'Mech. For close combat, the B configuration has four ER Medium Lasers.
column2: 门神 B 配置意在担任远程狙击手，主武器为一对 LB-X 自动炮/2，可发射标准弹与集束弹，也能充当防空机甲。混战方面，B 配置有四门 ER 中型激光。Base

column1: A close combat machine, the C configuration carries two highly accurate Large Pulse Lasers as its primary weapons. These are backed up by an ER Small Laser. To handle the 'Mech's heat load, the C configuration has an additional double heat sink. The C configuration also has an ECM Suite to protect against enemy electronic warfare equipment.
column2: C 配置是一台混战机器，以两门极为精准的大型脉冲激光为主武器，辅以一门 ER 小型激光。为处理机甲的热负荷，C 配置多一台双倍散热器。C 配置还装有 ECM 套件以抵御敌方电子战设备。Base

column1: Intended for both long range and close combat, the D configuration of the Men Shen has an ER PPC to provide long range firepower. When it closes with an enemy, it can bring its two SRM-4 launchers and two Medium Pulse Lasers to bear. For added heat dissipation, the D configuration has an additional double heat sink.
column2: 门神 D 配置兼顾远程与混战，装有一门 ER PPC 提供远程火力。接近敌人时，它可动用两具 SRM-4 发射器和两门中型脉冲激光。为提升散热，D 配置多一台双倍散热器。Base

column1: Mist Lynx B
column2: 雾豹 B
