column2: 这款导弹平台携带四具 LRM-20 发射器，每具都从属于一套 Artemis IV 火控系统。六吨弹药勉强够它持续开火一分钟。一门大型脉冲激光和一门中型脉冲激光是有效的备用武器。Base

column1: The primary configuration is hard-hitting, mounting a pair of ER PPCs located in the left arm and an Ultra Autocannon/10 in the right. This blistering firepower can often take down an opponent before they are in range. Three Medium Pulse Lasers serve as accurate backups. Eight additional double heat sinks keep the 'Mech fairly cool.
column2: 主配置打击凶猛，左臂装一对 ER PPC，右侧装一门超速自动炮/10。这种炽烈火力常常能在对手进入射程前将其击倒。三门中型脉冲激光作为精准的备用武器。八台额外双倍散热器使机甲保持相当凉爽。Base

column1: A sleek, mobile, and versatile design, the Clan nova was long suspected to be one of the first OmniMechs produced by the Clans.
column2: 作为一款流线型、机动且多用途的设计，氏族诺瓦长期被认为是最早由氏族生产的全能机甲之一。Base

column1: The original primitive Orion 'Mech as it was first commissioned lacked an LRM launcher and used an Autocannon/5 in place of the AC/10.  A massive 360 engine allowed the 'Mech to obtain a maximum speed of nearly 64.8 km/h, however there was not enough saved weight to mount additional weaponry besides two Medium Lasers, one in each arm. In addition it only mounted 14.5 tons of armor, and ultimately would be considered too lightly armed and armored with the prototype dismissed as a candidate for production.
column2: 初版原始猎户座机甲在被首次定型时没有 LRM 发射器，并以一门自动炮/5 取代 AC/10。一台巨大的 360 引擎使机甲能达到近 64.8 公里/小时的最高速度，但节省的重量不足以在每臂各一门中型激光之外加装更多武器。此外它只披挂 14.5 吨装甲，最终被认为武装与装甲都过于薄弱，该原型被排除在量产候选之外。Base

column1: Built by General Mechanics, the ON1-H was the third known primitive prototype of the Orion 'Mech that was eventually accepted for mass production in 2456. While slower than the first iterations, with a top speed of only 54 km/h (the same as that of a Mackie or Banshee), due to the inclusion of a smaller 275-class engine, the additional weight saved allowed the designers to mount far more firepower. A newly developed Class-10 Prototype Autocannon was installed and two tons of ammo in place of the AC/5. This was backed up by two 5-tube Long-Range Missile launchers with one ton of reloads in the left torso for striking enemies at range and a short-range SRM-4 missile launcher and a ton of ammunition installed in the left arm for close-in defense. It was also heavily protected by 21 tons of armor. A minimal amount of heatsinks, however, could cause build-up of heat within crippling levels, but could be avoided by competent MechWarriors.
column2: ON1-H 由通用机械制造，是猎户座机甲第三个已知的原始原型，最终于 2456 年被批准量产。虽然比最初几版更慢，最高速度仅 54 公里/小时（与麦基或女妖相当），因为采用了更小的 275 级引擎，但节省的额外重量让设计师能装上多得多的火力。它安装了新研制的 10 级原型自动炮和两吨弹药，取代 AC/5。远程打击方面辅以两具 5 管远程导弹发射器（左躯干一吨再装填），近身防御则有左臂的一具短程 SRM-4 导弹发射器和一吨弹药。它还有 21 吨装甲的重型防护。然而散热器数量极少，热量可能累积到致残水平，但能干的机甲战士可以避免这一点。Base

column1: This is one of the many minor variants of the ON1-M model introduced in 3052. The Narc Missile Beacon is removed to allow a larger SRM-6 to replace the four pack. Both missile racks also have Artemis IV Fire Control System to increase accuracy. Finally, medium pulse lasers are mounted in place of original mediums.
column2: 这是 3052 年推出的 ON1-M 型号众多次要变体之一。它移除 NARC 导弹信标，以便用更大的 SRM-6 取代四联装。两个导弹挂架也都配有 Artemis IV 火控系统以提升精度。最后，原来的中型激光换成中型脉冲激光。Base

column1: A second minor variant of the ON1-M introduced in 3058. The LB-X Autocannon/10 is swapped for a Light Gauss Rifle with a single ton of ammunition while the medium lasers are upgraded to extended range versions.
column2: 这是 3058 年推出的 ON1-M 第二个次要变体。LB-X 自动炮/10 换成一门轻型高斯步枪（配一吨弹药），中型激光则升级为增程版本。Base

column1: Upgraded with Star League technology, the 2D variant of the Ostroc extends the 'Mechs maximum range by replacing the Large Lasers with two ER Large Lasers. The 2D retains the Medium Lasers and SRM-4 of the 2C model. To handle the heat burden it is also equipped with double heat sinks. Being a relatively rare design, the Ostroc had no official field refit kit but the 2D variant was a common upgrade in 3050 if the parts could be obtained.
column2: 奥斯特洛克 2D 变体以星盟科技升级，将大型激光换成两门 ER 大型激光，从而拓展机甲的最大射程。2D 保留 2C 型号的中型激光和 SRM-4。为应对热负荷它还配备双倍散热器。作为一个相对罕见的设计，奥斯特洛克没有官方野战改装套件，但 2D 变体在 3050 年是常见的升级方案——前提是能弄到零件。Base

column1: The 2L variant of the Ostroc introduced in 2884 is modified for long range combat. The SRM-4 launcher has been replaced with an LRM-5 launcher, increasing the 'Mechs long-range damage capabilities slightly by sacrificing some of its close range firepower.
column2: 奥斯特罗克 2L 变体于 2884 年推出，为远程战斗而改装。SRM-4 发射器换成 LRM-5 发射器，以牺牲部分近程火力为代价略微提升机甲的远程伤害能力。Base

column1: The 2M Ostwar was armed with a twenty-tube Doombud Long Range Missile launcher for its long range attacks. In close range, the 'Mech was armed with two four-tubed Shannon SH-40 Short-Range Missile launchers in each of its paddle shaped forearms. It also mounted two Martell Medium Lasers mounted on the left torso. The 'Mech carried three tons of ammunition for the LRM rack, while carrying a ton of SRM ammunition in its left arm.
column2: 2M 奥斯特战争装备一具 20 管末日芽远程导弹发射器用于远程攻击。近距离方面，它的两只桨形前臂各装备两具四管香农 SH-40 短程火箭发射器。左躯干还装有两门马特尔中型激光。机甲为 LRM 挂架携带三吨弹药，左臂则携带一吨 SRM 弹药。Base

column1: The Pack Hunter is the first new design produced by Clan Wolf-in-Exile on Arc-Royal. It also represents a new partnership between Phelan's Wolves and the Kell Hounds, as the armor and communications gear are Kell Hound products, traded to the Wolves in exchange for Endo Steel. Reflecting their Khan's bias towards light, fast designs, Wolf scientists designed the Pack Hunter to be fast and have a sharp bite. Though its four tons of armor are light, the BattleMech is supposed to use its speed and maneuverability to stay out of trouble.
column2: 猎群者是流亡狼氏族在弧-皇家星生产的第一款新设计。它也代表费兰的狼群与凯尔猎犬之间的新合作——装甲与通讯设备均为凯尔猎犬的产品，用来向狼群换取内骨骼。狼族科学家遵循其可汗对轻型快速设计的偏爱，把猎群者设计得又快又利齿。尽管四吨装甲偏薄，这台战斗机甲本应依靠速度与机动性避免陷入麻烦。Base

column1: The Perseus is the product of a program begun by the League Central Coordination and Command to create an OmniMech completely indigenous to the Free Worlds League from concept to production. The Perseus shares much with the venerable Orion, a staple of Free Worlds League Military, both broadly resembling the older design visually and using a number of the same components. This similarity prompted more than a few FWLM technicians to nickname the new design the Omni-Orion and the deployment of Perseus has largely been to front-line units that fielded large concentrations of its progenitor, replacing older Orions on a one-for-one basis. Built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis, the Perseus is powered by a Hermes 300 XL engine helping save even more weight and giving the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The advanced structure and engine save a great deal of weight for weapons and equipment. The Perseus is protected by fourteen tons of Valiant Lamellor armor, giving it around average armor protection for a 'Mech of its size. It also has twelve double heat sinks that are fixed on the chassis.
column2: 珀尔修斯是联盟中央协调与指挥部发起的一项计划的产物，旨在从概念到生产打造一款完全属于自由世界联盟的全能机甲。珀尔修斯与备受尊崇的猎户座共享诸多特征——后者是自由世界联盟军队的中坚，两者不仅外观上大体相似，还使用了若干相同部件。这种相似让不少联盟军技师将新设计戏称为"全能猎户座"，而珀尔修斯的部署也主要面向那些大量装备其前身的精锐部队，一对一替换老旧猎户座。珀尔修斯采用轻量化内骨骼底盘，由赫尔墨斯 300 XL 引擎驱动，进一步节省重量，最高速度 64.8 公里/小时。先进的结构与引擎为武器和装备腾出大量重量。它以十四吨英勇拉梅洛装甲防护，装甲水平约为此尺寸机甲的平均值。它还固定配备十二台双倍散热器。Base

column1: The primary configuration of the Perseus shares a great deal with the Orion. For long range direct and indirect fire support, the Perseus carries an LRM-20 with Artemis IV for increased missile accuracy. For long range direct fire, the Perseus carries a powerful Ultra Autocannon/10 that is capable of firing at twice the rate as a standard autocannon. The Perseus has a devastating short range arsenal with a highly accurate Medium Pulse Laser, four ER Medium Lasers , an ER Small Laser, and finally an SRM-4 launcher that is linked to an Artemis IV FCS. The primary configuration mounts two tons each of both Ultra Autocannon and LRM munitions as well as single ton of SRM reloads in CASE protected ammunition bays in both its side torsos.
column2: 英仙座主配置与猎户座有诸多共通之处。远程直接与间接火力支援方面，英仙座携带一具带 Artemis IV 以提升导弹精度的 LRM-20。远程直射火力方面，英仙座携带一门强力超速自动炮/10，射速可达标准自动炮的两倍。英仙座拥有毁灭性的近程武器库：一门极为精准的中型脉冲激光、四门 ER 中型激光、一门 ER 小型激光，最后一具联接 Artemis IV 火控系统的 SRM-4 发射器。主配置在两侧躯干受 C.A.S.E. 保护的弹药舱中各携带两吨超速自动炮弹药和两吨 LRM 弹药，以及一吨 SRM 再装填。Base

column1: Configured for long range fire support, the A configuration carries a pair of LRM-20 launchers in its arm, both of which are linked to an Artemis IV FCS for increased accuracy. For close range defense, the 'Mech carries two Medium Pulse Lasers and has an SRM-6 launcher linked to an Artemis IV FCS. The 'Mech also has a leg-mounted TAG laser designator, allowing it to call in Semi-Guided LRM and Arrow IV attacks from friendly units and has an ECM Suite to defend itself from enemy electronic warfare systems.
column2: A 配置为远程火力支援而设，臂部装一对 LRM-20 发射器，均联接 Artemis IV 火控系统以提升精度。近程防御方面，机甲携带两门中型脉冲激光和一具联接 Artemis IV 火控系统的 SRM-6 发射器。机甲还有一具装在腿部的 TAG 激光指示器，使其能召唤友军单位的半制导 LRM 和箭矢 IV 攻击，并有一套 ECM 套件防御敌方电子战系统。Base

column1: Capable of fighting at close and long ranges, the B configuration has a Gauss Rifle and ER Large Laser for long range combat, though only a single ton of reloads relegates the Gauss to use as a secondary rather than primary weapon. The Perseus B is also capable of handling close combat with two Large Pulse Lasers and has an Anti-Missile System to protect itself from missile attacks.
column2: B 配置能在近程与远程作战：远程有一门高斯步枪和一门 ER 大型激光，不过仅一吨再装填使高斯更宜作次要而非主要武器。英仙座 B 也能以两门大型脉冲激光应对混战，并有一套反导系统防御导弹攻击。Base

column1: An all around configuration, the C is built to be capable of engaging an enemy at both long and short ranges. To do this, the Perseus C carries a Light Gauss Rifle, giving the 'Mech an extremely long reach. This is backed up by an Ultra Autocannon/10 capable of engaging the enemy as they close. For close combat, the Perseus C has three ER Medium Lasers, a Medium Pulse Laser, and a Streak SRM-2 launcher. Two tons of gauss reloads, three tons of Ultra autocannon ammunition and a ton of missile reloads give the design adequate field endurance.
column2: C 配置是全方位配置，能在远程与近程交战。为此，英仙座 C 携带一门轻型高斯步枪，赋予机甲极远的射程。它由一门能在敌人接近时交战的超速自动炮/10 支援。混战方面，英仙座 C 有三门 ER 中型激光、一门中型脉冲激光和一具连续 SRM-2 发射器。两吨高斯再装填、三吨超速自动炮弹药和一吨导弹再装填为设计提供足够的战场续航力。Base

column1: Configured specifically for close combat, the D configuration has an LRM-20 launcher with an Artemis IV FCS for increased accuracy as well as an LB-X Autocannon/10 for long range combat. For close ranges, the 'Mech has an SRM-6 launcher linked to an Artemis IV FCS, three ER Medium Lasers, and a ER Small Laser. The D also has an ECM suite to protect itself from enemy electronic warfare systems and a Beagle Active Probe that allows it to find hidden units in close combat situation.
column2: D 配置专为混战而设，装有一具带 Artemis IV 火控系统以提升精度的 LRM-20 发射器，以及一门用于远程交战的 LB-X 自动炮/10。近程方面，机甲有一具联接 Artemis IV 火控系统的 SRM-6 发射器、三门 ER 中型激光和一门 ER 小型激光。D 还装有 ECM 套件以防御敌方电子战系统，以及一具比格犬主动探测器，使其能在混战中找出隐藏单位。Base

column1: The Pouncer was originally a test bed design that was upgraded to combat specifications on the orders of then-IlKhan Ulric Kerensky, as it was realized that a more mobile 'Mech was needed when combating Inner Sphere forces. The Pouncer is built on a lightweight DSAM Endo 4 Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a 240 XL engine which gives it a maximum speed of 97.2 km/h. The 'Mech's mobility is enhanced with five Grandthrust Mk. Four jump jets that allow it to jump up to one hundred and fifty meters. For protection from enemy fire, the Pouncer has a respectable six tons of Forging ZM15 Ferro-Fibrous armor. Overall, the Pouncer is an excellent OmniMech with fifteen and a half tons of pod space, allowing it to carry a wide variety of weapons payloads.
column2: 猛扑者原本是试验台设计，因意识到对抗内天体部队需要更机动的机甲，遂奉时任伊尔汗乌尔里克·克伦斯基之命升级至作战规格。它采用轻量化的 DSAM Endo 4 内骨骼底盘，由 240 XL 引擎驱动，最大速度 97.2 公里/小时。五个 Grandthrust Mk. Four 跳跃推进器使其机动性提升，可跳跃至一百五十米。为抵御敌方火力，猛扑者装备了可观的六吨 Forging ZM15 铁纤维装甲。总体而言，猛扑者是一款出色的全能机甲，拥有十五吨半的吊舱空间，可搭载多种武器配置。Base

column1: Fast Striker Omni
column2: 快速打击全能机甲

column1: Technicron's replacement for the original 4G model, the 5M was introduced in 3049 as an answer to the original's heat problems by replacing the thirteen normal heat sinks with double-strength versions. It also improved the design's defenses by swapping out the regular armor with Kallon FWL Special Ferro-Fibrous and installing CASE for the LRM's ammunition. The space necessary for these upgrades was provided for by removing the SRM launcher for a one-shot Hovertec SRM-4 Launcher, a disposable missile launcher more commonly found on VTOLs, hovercraft and similar combat vehicles. The loss in sheer short-range firepower is more than made up for by the other upgrades to the design.
column2: 5M 是泰克尼创为原 4G 型号打造的替代品，于 3049 年推出，以双倍强度散热器取代十三台普通散热器来回应原版的热量问题。它还通过把常规装甲换成卡隆 FWL 特制铁纤维、并为 LRM 弹药安装 C.A.S.E. 来改善设计的防御。这些升级所需的空间来自移除 SRM 发射器，换成单次发射的霍弗泰克 SRM-4 发射器——一种在垂直起降机、悬浮车及类似战斗车辆上更常见的可弃导弹发射器。近程火力上的损失，被其他升级远远补偿。Base

column1: he Savage Coyote OmniMech was created as a showcase OmniMech. The 'Mech was also part of Khan Koga's attempts to revitalize the fading Clan that invented the OmniMech.
column2: 野蛮郊狼全能机甲是作为展示型全能机甲而打造的。这台机甲也是可汗科加重振发明全能机甲却日渐衰落的氏族的努力之一。Base

column1: The primary configuration of the Savage Coyote makes use of a pair of the largest ATM, An ER PPC, an LB-X Autocannon/10, three ER Medium Lasers, and a pair of ER Small Lasers. MechWarriors must carefully manage heat levels, even with three additional double heat sinks
column2: 野蛮郊狼主配置使用一对最大的 ATM、一门 ER PPC、一门 LB-X 自动炮/10、三门 ER 中型激光和一对 ER 小型激光。即便有三台额外双倍散热器，机甲战士也必须小心管理热量水平

column1: At the beginning of this century, the leaders of Clan Nova Cat commissioned a new medium Mech that could compete with and outperform the Fenris. The Shadow Cat was the result.
column2: 本世纪初，氏族诺瓦猫的领袖委托研制一款能与芬里斯竞争并超越它的新型中型机甲。影猫由此诞生。Base

column1: A Clan Tech Shadowhawk. The first version of the Shadow Hawk IIC that Inner Sphere forces encountered is meant for close-range fighting, and appears to be designed with urban warfare in mind.
column2: 氏族科技影鹰。内天体部队遭遇的第一版影鹰 IIC 是为混战而设，看起来在设计时考虑了城市战。Base

column1: A Clan Tech Shadowhawk. A newer variant that dates to the late 3050s, the IIC 3's main gun is a Heavy Large Laser.
column2: 氏族科技影鹰。较新的变体，可追溯至 3050 年代末，IIC 3 的主炮是一门重型大型激光。Base

column1: A Clan Tech Shadowhawk. First fielded in 3060, the IIC 4 was resulted in a 'Mech that is visually very different from the design it is considered a variant of.
column2: 氏族科技影鹰。于 3060 年首次投入战场，IIC 4 造就了一台在外观上与其所归属的设计大相径庭的机甲。Base

column1: Reintroduced in 3053, the Spector mounts a Magna 245 XL engine in combination with an XL Engine and an  Endo Steel chassis. It carries seven and a half tons of armor along with seven jump jets. The Spector carries a Nightwind Large Laser as its primary weapon,  backed up by a pair of Defiance B3M Medium Lasers and a single Defiance B4S Small Laser for close combat. Defensively the Spector carries a Norse Guardian ECM Suite that allows it to defend itself against advanced enemy targeting and range finding equipment.
column2: 幽灵于 3053 年重新推出，采用玛格纳 245 XL 引擎，结合 XL 引擎与内骨骼底盘。它携带七吨半装甲和七个跳跃推进器。幽灵以一门风夜大型激光为主武器，辅以两门迪法恩斯 B3M 中型激光和一门迪法恩斯 B4S 小型激光用于混战。防御方面，幽灵携带北欧守护者 ECM 套件，可防御敌方先进的瞄准与测距设备。Base

column1: An upgrade originating from the Free Worlds League, the 5M variant of the Stalker was introduced in 3050 using moderate amounts of Star League technology. Most of the weaponry was retained but both large lasers were removed for a single Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser placed in the 'Mech's centerline and a Narc Missile Beacon in the left torso accompanied by two tons of reloads, allowing the Stalker to tag enemy units with homing beacon and direct friendly missile fire onto them. The seventeen double heat sinks of the 5M afford it far greater heat efficiency than the twenty single heat sinks of previous models, although it still could not handle firing all of its weaponry simultaneously, and an additional ton of armor was added for survivability. Other changes included the use of proprietary components such as an Irian E.A.R. communications system, Riese-456 armor and a Irian Chassis Class 30. Unfortunately the designers of the new 5M dismissed the inclusion of CASE, a factor which led directly to the deaths of several Stalkers during the Clan Invasion due to ammunition cook-offs caused by overheating and weapon penetrations.
column2: 5M 变体源自自由世界联盟，是潜行者的升级版，于 3050 年推出，使用了适度数量的星盟技术。大部分武器得以保留，但两门大型激光被移除，换成一门装在机甲中线上的"多元光学阳光"ER 大型激光，以及左躯干一具 NARC 导弹信标配两吨再装填，使潜行者能为敌方单位打上自导信标并把友军导弹火力引导到它们身上。5M 的十七台双倍散热器赋予它远胜前型号二十台单散热器的散热效率，尽管它仍无法同时发射全部武器，另加了一吨装甲以提升生存性。其他改动包括采用专有组件，如"伊里安 E.A.R."通讯系统、里泽-456 装甲和伊里安 30 级底盘。遗憾的是，新 5M 的设计者放弃了 C.A.S.E.，这一因素直接导致氏族入侵期间数台潜行者因过热与武器穿透引发弹药殉爆而损毁。Base

column1: An upgrade originating from the Free Worlds League, the 5M variant of the Stalker uses moderate amounts of Star League technology. The seventeen double heat sinks of the 5M afford it far greater heat efficiency than the twenty single heat sinks of previous models. The Large Lasers were removed, replaced with a single Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser placed in the 'Mech's centerline and a Narc Missile Beacon. The beacon allows the Stalker to tag enemy units with homing beacons, allowing friendly 'Mechs to easily send missile salvos its way. Finally, the 'Mech bears an additional ton of armor for added survivability.
column2: 5M 变体源自自由世界联盟，使用适度数量的星盟技术。5M 的十七台双倍散热器赋予它远胜前型号二十台单散热器的散热效率。两门大型激光被移除，换成一门装在机甲中线的"多元光学阳光"ER 大型激光和一具 NARC 导弹信标。信标使潜行者能为敌方单位打上自导信标，让友军机甲轻易向它倾泻导弹齐射。最后，机甲多携带一吨装甲以提升生存性。Base

column1: The Stormcrow A is configured mainly for close combat.
column2: 风暴鸦 A 主要配置为混战。Base

column1: The Stormcrow B is another close combat configuration.
column2: 风暴鸦 B 是另一种混战配置。Base

column1: The Stormcrow C is armed with some of the most accurate weapons available to the clans.
column2: 暴风鸦 C 装备了氏族所能获得的一些最精准的武器。Base

column1: A long range support configuration, the Stormcrow D has, as its primary weapons, a pair of LRM-20 launchers. These are backed up by two SRM-2 launchers for close combat.
column2: 风暴鸦 D 是一款远程支援配置，主武器为两具 LRM-20 发射器。它们由两具 SRM-2 发射器支援用于混战。Base

column1: Capable of engaging an enemy at any range, the Stormcrow E's primary weapons are a pair of ATM-9 launchers. These are capable of firing short, medium, and long range munitions. The launchers are backed up, for added close range firepower, by four ER Small Lasers and two ER Medium Lasers.
column2: 暴风鸦 E 能在任何距离上交战，主武器为一对 ATM-9 发射器。它们能发射短程、中程和远程弹药。为增强近程火力，这些发射器由四门 ER 小型激光和两门 ER 中型激光支援。Base

column1: A heavy laser-toting version of the primary configuration, the H has, as its main weapons, two Heavy Large Lasers. These are backed up by three ER Medium Lasers.
column2: H 是主配置的重型激光版本，以两门重型大型激光为主武器。它们由三门 ER 中型激光支援。Base

column1: A heavy laser-toting version of the primary configuration, the H has, as its main weapons, two Heavy Large Lasers. These are backed up by three ER Medium Lasers.
column2: H 是主配置的重型激光版本，以两门重型大型激光为主武器。它们由三门 ER 中型激光支援。Base

column1: A pair of LRM-15 launchers provide long range firepower while each arm carries an ER Large Laser and ER Medium Laser. To ferret out hidden enemy forces, the Stormcrow I configuration mounts an Active Probe in the head.
column2: 两具 LRM-15 发射器提供远程火力，每臂则携带一门 ER 大型激光和一门 ER 中型激光。为搜出隐藏的敌军，暴风鸦 I 配置在头部安装一具主动探测器。Base

column1: A pair of LRM-15 launchers provide long range firepower while each arm carries an ER Large Laser and ER Medium Laser.
column2: 两具 LRM-15 发射器提供远程火力，每臂则携带一门 ER 大型激光和一门 ER 中型激光。Base

column1: A sleek, mobile, and versatile design, the Clan Stormcrow was long suspected to be one of the first OmniMechs produced by the Clans.
column2: 作为一款流线型、机动且多用途的设计，氏族风暴鸦长期被认为是最早由氏族生产的全能机甲之一。Base

column1: For long range combat, the Summoner A has a powerful Gauss Rifle which is supported by a Large Pulse Laser for intermediate ranges and an SRM-6 launcher for close combat.
column2: 远程战斗中，召唤者 A 有一门强劲的高斯步枪，配一门大型脉冲激光负责中距离，以及一具 SRM-6 发射器负责混战。Base

column1: A missile bombardment configuration, the B configuration carries a pair of LRM-20 launchers for long range engagements. For close combat, the Summoner B has two SRM-4 launchers. A Narc Missile Beacon allows the Summoner to designate targets for missile fire from other friendly units. The Summoner B has further protection through the use of an Anti-Missile System which gives it increased protection from missile attacks.
column2: 召唤者 B 是一款导弹轰炸配置，携带两具 LRM-20 发射器用于远程交战。混战方面，它有两具 SRM-4 发射器。一具 NARC 导弹信标让召唤者能为其他友军单位的导弹火力标记目标。召唤者 B 还通过一套反导系统获得进一步保护，提升对导弹攻击的防御。Base

column1: A close range brawler, the Summoner C is armed with a single ER Large Laser for long range sniping at enemy targets but truly comes into its own at close range. The 'Mech relies on a powerful Ultra Autocannon/20 for quick kill capabilities at close ranges. This is backed up by a highly accurate Streak SRM-6 launcher to seek out weak points in an enemy's armor and an ER Small Laser.
column2: 召唤者 C 是一款混战混战型，装备一门 ER 大型激光用于对敌方目标的远程狙击，但真正发挥威力是在近距离。机甲依靠一门强劲的超速自动炮/20 在近距离快速击杀。它辅以一具极为精准的连续 SRM-6 发射器以寻找敌方装甲弱点，以及一门 ER 小型激光。Base

column1: In its primary configuration the Summoner has a basic yet effective arsenal. The primary direct fire weapon is an ER PPC backed up by an LB 10-X Autocannon that can fire both standard and cluster ammunition. For fire support and bombardment, the Summoner has an LRM-15 launcher.
column2: 主配置中，召唤者拥有基础却有效的武器库。主要直射武器是一门 ER PPC，辅以一门 LB 10-X 自动炮，后者可发射标准弹与集束弹。用于火力支援与轰炸，召唤者有一具 LRM-15 发射器。Base

column1: Almost a direct counter-point to the Prime, the A Config mounts twin Ultra AC/2s in each side torso, supported by an ER Large Laser in each arm if the two tons of Ultra reloads run dry. The config is rounded out by an extra Double Heat Sink.
column2: A 配置几乎与主型号针锋相对，每侧躯干装双联超速 AC/2，若两吨超速弹药耗尽，则由每臂一门 ER 大型激光支援。该配置另有一台额外双倍散热器补全。Base

column1: A mixed-range combatant, the Sun Spider B is built around a right-torso mounted Gauss Rifle, supported by a left-torso ER Large Laser and matched Streak SRM-6 and ER Medium Lasers in each arm. An Anti-Missile System and a Light Active Probe in the left torso prevent the B from being caught unaware, carrying two tons of Gauss and Streak reloads along with a single ton of AMS ammo and an extra double heat sink.
column2: 太阳蜘蛛 B 是一款混合射程战斗型，以右躯干的高斯步枪为核心，左躯干的 ER 大型激光以及每臂配对的连续 SRM-6 和 ER 中型激光为支援。左躯干的反导系统与轻型主动探测器使 B 不会被打个措手不及，它携带两吨高斯与连续导弹再装填、一吨 AMS 弹药和一台额外双倍散热器。Base

column1: The C configuration is a classic LRM Missile Boat, fitted with a pair of LRM-15s in each arm and supported by an LRM-20 in each side torso. Carrying six tons of LRM missiles, an extra double heat sink strives to try and keep the Sun Spider firing.
column2: C 配置是经典的 LRM 导弹平台，每臂装备两具 LRM-15，两侧躯干各以一具 LRM-20 支援。它携带六吨 LRM 导弹，一台额外双倍散热器尽力维持太阳蜘蛛的火力。Base

column1: A short-ranged brawler, the Sun Spider D carries a mammoth Ultra AC/20 in each arm, with just a pair of Heavy Machine Guns in the right torso as supporting weapons. Lacking in ranged weapons, an ECM Suite is fitted in the left torso to try and assist in closing with its foes so it can make full use of the four tons of Ultra ammunition and single ton HMG bin.
column2: 太阳蜘蛛 D 是一款混战混战型，每臂携带一门巨型超速 AC/20，右躯干仅以两挺重机枪作为支援武器。由于缺乏远程武器，左躯干装有 ECM 套件以协助接近敌人，从而充分利用四吨超速弹药与一吨重机枪弹药。Base

column1: The Sun Spider F configuration mounts an ERPPC in each arm and an LBX10 Autocannon in the right torso. A single AP Gauss rifle and anti-Battlearmor pod help deal with enemy infantry. A pair of anti-missile systems and an ECM suite enhance defense.
column2: 太阳蜘蛛 F 配置在每臂装一门 ER PPC，右躯干一门 LBX10 自动炮。一门单装 AP 高斯步枪和反战斗装甲荚舱帮助对付敌方步兵。两套反导系统和一套 ECM 套件增强防御。Base

column1: The F model of the Sun Spider can put out some solid hits at almost any range, it's well protected with a pair of AMS and slight up-armoring.
column2: 太阳蜘蛛 F 型号几乎能在任何距离上打出扎实的命中，它由一对 AMS 和少量额外装甲保护好。Base

column1: The Sun Spider Prime is built for short-range combat and carries a pair of Streak SRM-6 launchers in each arm, supported at range by Ultra AC/10 and an ER Large Laser in the right and left torsos, respectively. Two tons of Ultra Autocannon reloads and three tons of Streak SRM missiles are more than adequate for Clan Trials.
column2: 太阳蜘蛛主型号为混战而设，每臂携带两具连续 SRM-6 发射器，远程则由右躯干的超速 AC/10 和左躯干的 ER 大型激光支援。两吨超速自动炮再装填与三吨连续 SRM 导弹对氏族试炼而言绰绰有余。Base

column1: Four Myths
column2: 四个神话

column1: The Thorn carries a weapons array that is not usually seen on light 'Mechs: a Zeus-5 LRM launcher mounted in the right arm with one ton of reloads in the right torso, paired with two Hellion Spitfire Medium Lasers split between the head and left arm. Four and a half tons of armor provides the Thorn with good protection, especially when mated with CASE to contain any ammunition explosions.
column2: 荆棘携带轻型机甲上不常见的武器阵列：右臂一具宙斯-5 LRM 发射器（右躯干一吨再装填），配以分列头部与左臂的两门海利昂"喷火"中型激光。四吨半装甲为荆棘提供良好防护，尤其配合 C.A.S.E. 遏制弹药爆炸时。Base

column1: Developed in 3051 on the orders of Precentor Martial Anastasius Focht to try and close the gap between the Clans and Com Guards, the factory refit THE-N1 received its baptism of fire during the Battle of Tukayyid. Having reached a similar conclusion that resulted in the THE-Nb, the CASE was dropped and the standard engine was swapped for an XL Engine to allow the standard weaponry to be stripped for an all energy weapon array: a right arm mounted Kinslaughter H-Class ER PPC and a head-mounted Intek Small Laser. This new weapons array, enhanced by double heat sinks, added a level of lethality never seen before on the Thorn.
column2: THE-N1 于 3051 年根据战务长官阿纳斯塔修斯·福赫特的命令开发，试图缩小氏族与康卫之间的差距，这款工厂改装型在图卡伊德战役中接受了战火洗礼。它得出了与 THE-Nb 相似的结论，因此舍弃 C.A.S.E. 并把标准引擎换成 XL 引擎，以便剥离标准武器、改用全能量武器阵列：右臂一门"族杀 H 级"ER PPC 和头部一门英泰克小型激光。这一新武器阵列在双倍散热器的强化下，为荆棘带来了前所未有的杀伤力。Base

column1: A new production variant of the THE-N1 developed by the Word of Blake in 3071, the THE-N2 took its cues from both the THE-N and THE-T variants, swapping the ER-PPC with an MML 7 and the standard small laser for a Diverse Optics ER Small Laser. A two-ton CASE protected ammo bay allowed the THE-N2 to carry both LRM and SRM munitions to make best use of the Multi-Missile Launcher.
column2: THE-N2 是布雷克之言于 3071 年开发的 THE-N1 新量产变体，它同时借鉴了 THE-N 与 THE-T 变体，把 ER PPC 换成 MML 7，标准小型激光换成多元光学 ER 小型激光。一个两吨、有 C.A.S.E. 保护的弹药舱使 THE-N2 能同时携带 LRM 与 SRM 弹药，以最大化利用多用途导弹发射器。Base

column1: The advanced model employed by the Star League Defense Force Royal Divisions in 2743 changed the role of the 'Mech from a missile to an energy boat, replacing the LRM launcher with an ER Large Laser, retaining one medium laser and downgrading the other to a Small Laser. Dropping the no longer required CASE, the 'Mech also used a MASC system for temporary speed bursts and Double Heat Sinks to vent its increased waste heat output. The THE-Nb mounted an XL Engine to save the weight to mount this extra equipment, at the cost of reduced survivability.
column2: 这款先进型号于 2743 年由星盟防卫军皇家师使用，它把机甲的角色从导弹平台改为能量平台，以一门 ER 大型激光取代 LRM 发射器，保留一门中型激光，另一门降级为小型激光。舍弃不再需要的 C.A.S.E.，机甲还使用 MASC 系统实现临时速度爆发，并以双倍散热器排出增加的废热。THE-Nb 装 XL 引擎以省出重量安装这些额外装备，代价是生存性降低。Base

column1: Supplied by ComStar to the Draconis Combine as part of Operation Rosebud in 3035, the THE-S was a downgraded factory refit of the THE-N. Stripping out the advanced Endo Steel chassis and CASE, the use of a heavier standard chassis forced a reduction in the Thorns armor protection by half a ton, most of which was removed from the head and rear torso. The communications system was also changed to a more primitive Olmstead 30, although the Omicron VII targeting-tracking system was similar in capabilities to the Orion 80 it replaced.
column2: THE-S 由康星作为 3035 年"玫瑰花蕾"行动的一部分提供给德拉科尼斯联合体，是 THE-N 的降级工厂改装型。它拆除了先进的内骨骼底盘和 C.A.S.E.，改用较重的标准底盘，迫使荆棘的装甲防护减少半吨，其中大部分从头颅和后躯干扣除。通讯系统也换成更原始的奥姆斯特德 30，尽管奥米克戎 VII 瞄准追踪系统的性能与被它取代的猎户座 80 相近。Base

column1: Developed in 3038 by the Draconis Combine in an attempt to upgrade the 'Mech's short range firepower prior to the War of 3039, the THE-T is a field refit of the downgraded THE-S that swaps out the LRM launcher for an SRM-4.
column2: THE-T 由德拉科尼斯联合体于 3038 年开发，试图在 3039 年战争前升级机甲的近程火力，它是对降级版 THE-S 的野战改装，把 LRM 发射器换成 SRM-4。Base

column1: The Timber Wolf is a fast, heavy OmniMech. A signature design of the Clans' military might, it was arguably the first Clan OmniMech encountered by Inner Sphere forces on The Rock by Phelan Kell. Vaguely resembling a cross-over between the MAD (Marauder) and CAT (Catapult) series, the Timber Wolf was tagged with the Inner Sphere reporting name Mad Cat on first contact.
column2: 森林狼是一款高速重型全能机甲。作为氏族军事力量的标志性设计，它可以说是内天体部队在"岩石"星上由菲兰·凯尔首次遭遇的氏族全能机甲。因其隐约呈现出 MAD（掠夺者）与 CAT（投石机）系列的杂交特征，森林狼在首次接触时被内天体冠以"疯猫"的报告代号。Base

column1: The Turkina is named after Turkina, the first Jade Falcon to be tamed, who inspired the leaders of Clan Jade Falcon in its early days.
column2: 图尔基娜以图尔基娜命名——第一只被驯服的翡翠猎鹰，它在翡翠猎鹰氏族早期激励了其领袖。Base

column1: the Turkina mounts enough jump jets to vault 90 meters hardwired onto the frame, rather than using them in modular pods. While this simplified repair, it also uses tonnage that could be devoted to other systems when a mission does not call for jumping.
column2: 图尔基娜装有足以跃过 90 米的跳跃推进器，且是硬接在框架上而非使用模块化吊舱。这虽然简化了维修，但也占用了在任务无需跳跃时可分配给其他系统的吨位。Base

column1: Don't let the stubby 'Urbie' fool you, it may look like a walking trash can, but it can mount heavy armor and a grown-up-sized Autocannon. R63s aren't known for their speed, but they are very useful if you can draw the enemy into their firing range.
column2: 别被矮胖的"都市"骗了，它也许看起来像个会走路的垃圾桶，却能装备厚重装甲和成人尺寸的自动炮。R63 不以速度著称，但如果你能把敌人引到它的射程内，它们就非常有用。Base

column1: The Valkyrie II project originated as an assignment for two NAIS student design teams to create a new heavy scout and skirmisher mech based on the Valkyrie VLK-QA. A rivalry between the two teams and outside pressures from Davion bureaucrats pushed both designs far beyond a replacement for the VLK-QA. Achernar BattleMechs was contracted to construct the Valkyrie II-1A which sports a Hermes 360XL Engine, six Jump Jets, an ER PPC, a LRM10, and over eleven tons of armor.
column2: 女武神 II 项目最初是给两个 NAIS 学员设计小组的作业：基于女武神 VLK-QA 打造一款新的重型侦察与散兵机甲。两队之间的竞争以及达维昂官僚的外来压力，把两个设计都推得远超 VLK-QA 的替代品。阿克尔纳战斗机甲公司获得合约建造女武神 II-1A，它配备一台赫尔墨斯 360XL 引擎、六个跳跃推进器、一门 ER PPC、一具 LRM10 以及超过十一吨装甲。Base

column1: Heavy Recon
column2: 重型侦察

column1: I heard of this project; it was pretty bad, lot's of money changing hands and lot's of competing design requirements. It's a miracle these things ever made it to production. I will say this, the Valkyrie II is faster than the original despite being twice the weight while carrying a stronger weapons and armor compliment. It may not excel at anything in particular but it can work for most jobs it is tasked with.
column2: 我听说过这个项目；相当糟糕，大量资金易手，大量相互冲突的设计要求。这些东西能投产简直是奇迹。我得说，女武神 II 虽然重量是原版的两倍，却比原版更快，还携带更强的武器与装甲配置。它也许在任何方面都不突出，但能胜任交给它的大多数工作。Base

column1: An upgrade using Star League technology, the 9K replaces the Autocannon/20 with a Gauss Rifle which can do serious damage at much greater ranges. The 'Mech also carries two Medium Pulse Lasers and a SRM-4 launcher for close combat. In order to make these changes possible, the 9K is built on an Endo Steel chassis. With the weight saved the 'Mech also carries an additional ton of armor.
column2: 9K 是使用星盟技术的升级，以一门高斯步枪取代自动炮/20，能在远得多的距离上造成严重伤害。机甲还携带两门中型脉冲激光和一具 SRM-4 发射器用于混战。为实现这些改动，9K 基于内骨骼底盘建造。凭借节省的重量，机甲还多携带一吨装甲。Base

column1: Heavy Cavalry & Skirmisher
column2: 重骑兵与游骑

column1: The VTR-9K incorporates several Lostech technologies, replacing the AC/20 with a Gauss Rifle, the Medium Lasers with Medium Pulse Lasers, and adding CASE, all on an Endo-Steel frame.
column2: VTR-9K 融入多项失传技术，以一门高斯步枪取代 AC/20，以中型脉冲激光取代中型激光，并加装 C.A.S.E.，全部基于内骨骼框架。Base

column1: Utilizing a heavier mix of shorter ranged weapons among many of the configurations, the Viper saw success when paired with other light platforms.
column2: 毒蛇的多种配置都偏向更重型的短程武器组合，与其他轻型平台搭配时表现出色。Base

column1: Utilizing a heavier mix of shorter ranged weapons among many of the configurations, the Viper saw success when paired with other light platforms.
column2: 毒蛇的多种配置都偏向更重型的短程武器组合，与其他轻型平台搭配时表现出色。Base

column1: This House Kurita variant, introduced in 3054, was built on an Endo Steel skeleton. It carried ER PPCs, two medium lasers, and two small pulse lasers. The SRM-6 was replaced by a pair of Streak SRM-2 launchers, while a TAG system allowed the 7K to spot for friendly artillery units.
column2: 这款库瑞塔家族变体于 3054 年推出，建立在内骨骼骨架上。它携带 ER PPC、两门中型激光和两门小型脉冲激光。SRM-6 换成两具连续 SRM-2 发射器，TAG 系统则使 7K 能为友军炮兵单位侦察。Base

column1: The 7M variant was introduced in 3047 by Ronin Inc. as the official upgraded variant of the Warhammer for the Free Worlds League. Built around a Magna 280 fusion engine, the 7M had a top speed of 64.5 km/h and carried eighteen double heat sinks to handle the waste heat generated by its two Fusigon Longtooth ER PPCs. Backing up these new weapons were two Martell medium lasers in the side torsos and a Shannon SH-60 SRM-6 launcher over the right shoulder. A LFN Lindblad machine gun was carried in the right torso, while the left mounted an LFN Lindblad Shotgun Anti-Missile System. One ton of machine gun rounds were carried in the center torso, while one ton each of missile reloads and AMS rounds were carried in the right.
column2: 7M 变体由浪人公司于 3047 年推出，是自由世界联盟战锤的官方升级变体。它围绕玛格纳 280 聚变引擎建造，最高速度 64.5 公里/小时，携带十八台双倍散热器以处理两门"富西贡长牙"ER PPC 产生的废热。支援这些新武器的是两侧躯干的两门马特尔中型激光和右肩上方一具"香农 SH-60"SRM-6 发射器。右躯干携带一挺 LFN 林德布拉德机枪，左侧则装一套 LFN 林德布拉德霰弹反导系统。中央躯干携带一吨机枪弹，右侧则各携带一吨导弹再装填和一吨 AMS 弹药。Base

column1: The 7S Warhammer was the official upgraded version built for the Federated Commonwealth by Olivettie Weaponry. Built out of their Sudeten factory starting in 3050, the 7S retained the small lasers of the original but updated the rest of the weaponry. It carried two arm-mounted ER PPCs, two Defiance P5M medium pulse lasers in the side torsos, and two Coventry T4H Streak SRM-2 launchers in place of the SRM-6 launcher. Eighteen double heat sinks handled the additional waste heat and one ton of reloads for the Streak launchers was carried in the center torso.
column2: 7S 战锤是奥利维蒂兵器为联邦联邦建造的官方升级版。自 3050 年起在其苏德滕工厂生产，7S 保留了原版的小型激光，但更新了其余武器。它携带两门臂载 ER PPC、两侧躯干各两门迪法恩斯 P5M 中型脉冲激光，以及两具考文垂 T4H 连续 SRM-2 发射器取代 SRM-6。十八台双倍散热器处理额外废热，中央躯干携带一吨连续发射器再装填。Base

column1: Introduced at the turn of the century, the Warhawk was created by the Smoke Jaguars in anticipation of the Clans' return to the Inner Sphere.
column2: 战鹰于世纪之交推出，由烟虎氏族为迎接氏族重返内天体而研制。Base

column1: Apparently designed to reduce heat, this configuration of the Warhawk carries a single ER PPC in each arm backed up by an LRM-20 and LRM-10. A torso-mounted Ultra AC/2 rounds out the weapons. Like most Warhawk variants, this version carries an advanced Targeting Computer.
column2: 此战鹰配置显然是为降低热量而设计，每臂一门 ER PPC，辅以一具 LRM-20 和一具 LRM-10。躯干搭载的是一门超速 AC/2。与大多数战鹰变体一样，此版本配备先进瞄准计算机。Base

column1: The Yu Huang, named for the Jade Emperor that rules the Heavenly Court in the ancient Chinese pantheon, debuted with the promise from Sun-Tzu Liao that 'it shall sit in judgment over a battlefield, meting out justice to those who would transgress against us'. To live up to the promise of the Chancellor of the Capellan Confederation, the Yu Huang carries some of the most advanced technologies available at the time of its initial production. The Yu Huang is built on a Chariot Type II Endo Steel chassis and carries a Hermes 360 XL engine that gives the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The 'Mech is capable of jumping up to one hundred and twenty meters with its four Rodan 90 jump jets.
column2: 玉皇以中国古代神话中主宰天庭的玉皇大帝命名，首次亮相时孙泰子承诺"它将坐镇战场之上，向那些侵犯我们的人施以正义"。为不负卡佩兰邦联大臣的承诺，玉皇在首次生产时携带了当时最先进的技术。它建立在战车型 II 内骨骼底盘上，搭载赫尔墨斯 360 XL 引擎，使机甲最高速度达 64.8 公里/小时。凭借四个罗丹 90 跳跃推进器，机甲可跳跃至一百二十米。Base

column1: The H10G variant is designed to directly engage an enemy at short ranges. The 10G removes all of the 'Mechs weapons. Instead, it carries a powerful Gauss Rifle for long range combat. This is supported by an ER Large Laser for additional long range firepower. For close combat, the 10G has six ER Medium Lasers and also carries a Guardian ECM Suite and a Beagle Active Probe to both protect the 'Mech from advanced enemy electronics systems and find hidden enemy units to prevent ambushes.
column2: H10G 变体设计用于在近程直接与敌交战。10G 移除机甲全部武器，改为携带一门强力高斯步枪用于远程战斗。它由一门 ER 大型激光支援以增加远程火力。混战方面，10G 有六门 ER 中型激光，还携带一套守护者 ECM 套件和一具比格犬主动探测器，既能保护机甲免受敌方先进电子系统干扰，也能找出隐藏的敌方单位以防伏击。Base

column1: This Clan upgraded Alacorn mounts four Gauss Rifles with five tons of ammo. Developed in 2587, the Alacorn attracted a reputation in the SLDF as an effective and dependable tank. Deployed throughout the Periphery, General Aleksandr Kerensky was reported to have taken hundreds of them during the Exodus. Although some of the earliest versions mount various autocannons the Alacorn became famous for it's array of gauss rifles. Their combination of heavy punch and long range makes the Alacorn a threat to any unit on the field. Tracked: Slow but able to cross most terrain. Fusion: Expensive engine that works in a Vacuum.
column2: 这款氏族升级版阿拉科恩装备四门高斯步枪和五吨弹药。阿拉科恩于 2587 年开发，在星盟防卫军中赢得了高效可靠坦克的声誉。它被部署到整个外围区，据报亚历山大·克伦斯基将军在出埃及期间带走了数百辆。尽管最早的一些版本装的是各种自动炮，阿拉科恩是因它那批高斯步枪而成名的。重击与远程的结合使阿拉科恩成为战场上对任何单位的威胁。 履带式： 缓慢，但能穿越大多数地形。 聚变： 昂贵的引擎，可在真空中工作。Base

column1: The AS7-K-DC is a command version of the AS7-K. To be able to fit a command console, a ton of LRM ammo and one medium pulse laser was removed.
column2: AS7-K-DC 是 AS7-K 的指挥版本。为容纳一台指挥控制台，移除了一吨 LRM 弹药和一门中型脉冲激光。Base

column1: Though bearing a remarkable outward resemblance to the Timberwolf, this BattleMech is a new and powerful creation. Carrying thirteen tons of ferro-fibrous armor, the Mad Cat MK II is an incredibly resilient design. A pair of arm mounted Gaussrifles supported by torso mounted LRM racks give it complete command over the battlefield.
column2: 虽然外观与森林狼极为相似，这款战斗机甲却是全新而强大的创造。疯猫 MK II 携带十三吨铁纤维装甲，是极为坚固的设计。臂载的双高斯步枪配以躯干搭载的 LRM 挂架，使其能完全掌控战场。Base

column1: A sleek, mobile, and versatile design, the Clan hellhound was long suspected to be one of the first OmniMechs produced by the Clans.
column2: 作为一款流线型、机动且多用途的设计，氏族地狱犬长期被认为是最早由氏族生产的全能机甲之一。Base

column1: A Griffin sporting ClanTech upgrades.
column2: 装备氏族科技升级的狮鹫。Base

column1: With a high damage profile at long and short range, the Hellbringer B does not utilize energy weapons as much, and so has few issues with heat buildup.
column2: 凭借远程与近程的高伤害曲线，地狱使者 B 不太使用能量武器，因此在积热上问题不大。Base

column1: The Jenner was first fielded in September 2784, the same year the Exodus fleet that would eventually become the Clans left the Inner Sphere in November. How exactly they acquired this design in that short timeframe is not known, but what is known is that the Clan version fields Clan weaponry.
column2: 詹纳于 2784 年 9 月首次投入战场，同年的 11 月，最终成为氏族的出埃及舰队离开了内天体。他们究竟如何在如此短的时间内获得这一设计尚不清楚，但已知的是氏族版本装备的是氏族武器。Base

column1: A ClanTech upgraded Kintaro.
column2: 氏族科技升级的金太郎。Base

column1: One of the best known BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere for its low production and operation costs, the Locust is also well known in the Clans. In 2832, Clan Mongoose unleashed an upgraded version of the venerable 'Mech on the Clans, known as the Locust IIC. The speedy design complemented Mongoose tactics, enabling them to win many Trials.
column2: 蝗虫因其低廉的生产与运营成本成为内天体最知名的战斗机甲之一，在氏族中同样广为人知。2832 年，猫鼬氏族向氏族推出这款古老机甲的升级版，称为蝗虫 IIC。该高速设计与猫鼬战术相得益彰，使他们赢下许多试炼。Base

column1: This version was redesigned so that it could be produced in the Inner Sphere by Clan Jade Falcon on their Occupation Zone headquarters world of Sudeten. It replaces the small lasers of the standard variant with three General Systems Heavy Small Lasers in each arm. The medium pulse laser has been downgraded to a Series 7Ja ER Medium Laser, while a pair of additional double heat sinks are added to help deal with the increased heat.
column2: 此版本经过重新设计，以便翡翠猎鹰氏族能在其占领区总部世界苏德滕于内天体生产。它将标准变体的小型激光换成每臂三门通用系统重型小型激光。中型脉冲激光被降级为 7Ja 系列 ER 中型激光，同时加装两台额外双倍散热器以应对增加的热量。Base

column1: The Mad Dog’s most distinctive feature is its side torso and arm pods, which are practically full modules by themselves, suggesting that the mech was conceived as a long-range support unit. The torso modules, angled high, are ideal for missiles while the arms serve as extended turrets suited for direct-fire weaponry.
column2: 疯狗最显著的特征是其侧躯干与臂部吊舱——它们本身几乎就是完整模块，暗示这台机甲在设计时就构想为远程支援单位。躯干模块高高倾斜，非常适合安装导弹，而臂部则充当适于直射武器的延伸炮塔。Base

column1: A sleek, mobile, and versatile design, the Clan Nova was long suspected to be one of the first OmniMechs produced by the Clans.
column2: 作为一款流线型、机动且多用途的设计，氏族诺瓦长期被认为是最早由氏族生产的全能机甲之一。Base

column1: Since it was the chosen BattleMech of the Great Father, the venerable Orion has always held a special place in the mystique of the Clans. Out of respect for General Kerensky's legacy, all the Clans maintained the design for several decades even as the development of newer and more advanced technologies increasingly left it less effective on the battlefield. Not a radical reworking of the design, as some Clan upgrades are, the Orion IIC replaces much of the innards and weapons of the original, while preserving its mass and aesthetics. This IIC upgrade utilizes an Endo Steel chassis and twelve tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, while also making use of twelve double heat sinks, freeing up weight for heavier weapons loadout.
column2: 由于它是"伟大之父"选用的战斗机甲，古老的猎户座在氏族的神秘传统中始终占有特殊地位。出于对克伦斯基将军遗产的尊重，所有氏族都维持该设计数十年，即便更新更先进技术的发展日益令它在战场上失去效力。猎户座 IIC 并非像某些氏族升级那样彻底重做，而是更换了原版的大部分内部结构与武器，同时保留其质量与外观。此次 IIC 升级采用内骨骼底盘和十二吨铁纤维装甲，并使用十二台双倍散热器，腾出重量以搭载更重的武器。Base

column1: Since it was the chosen BattleMech of the Great Father, the venerable Orion has always held a special place in the mystique of the Clans. Out of respect for General Kerensky's legacy, all the Clans maintained the design for several decades even as the development of newer and more advanced technologies increasingly left it less effective on the battlefield. Not a radical reworking of the design, as some Clan upgrades are, the Orion IIC replaces much of the innards and weapons of the original, while preserving its mass and aesthetics. This IIC upgrade utilizes an Endo Steel chassis and twelve tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, while also making use of twelve double heat sinks, freeing up weight for heavier weapons loadout. This variant switches the Gauss Rifle to an Ultra Autocannon/5.

column1: Since it was the chosen BattleMech of the Great Father, the venerable Orion has always held a special place in the mystique of the Clans. Out of respect for General Kerensky's legacy, all the Clans maintained the design for several decades even as the development of newer and more advanced technologies increasingly left it less effective on the battlefield. Not a radical reworking of the design, as some Clan upgrades are, the Orion IIC replaces much of the innards and weapons of the original, while preserving its mass and aesthetics. This IIC upgrade utilizes an Endo Steel chassis and twelve tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, while also making use of twelve double heat sinks, freeing up weight for heavier weapons loadout. This variant retains the Gauss Rifle, but switches the LRM-20 rack to an SRM-6 launcher.

column1: The 'Mech was also part of Khan Koga's attempts to revitalize the fading Clan that invented the OmniMech.

column1: A Clan redesign of 'Amaris Folly'.
column2: 氏族重新设计的"阿马里斯之愚"。Base

column1: The Stormcrow A is configured mainly for close combat.
column2: 风暴鸦 A 主要配置为混战。Base

column1: The Stormcrow B is another close combat configuration.
column2: 风暴鸦 B 是另一种混战配置。Base

column1: The Stormcrow C is armed with some of the most accurate weapons available to the clans.
column2: 暴风鸦 C 装备了氏族所能获得的一些最精准的武器。Base

column1: Capable of engaging an enemy at any range, the Stormcrow E's primary weapons are a pair of ATM-9 launchers. These are capable of firing short, medium, and long range munitions. The launchers are backed up, for added close range firepower, by four ER Small Lasers and two ER Medium Lasers.
column2: 暴风鸦 E 能在任何距离上交战，主武器为一对 ATM-9 发射器。它们能发射短程、中程和远程弹药。为增强近程火力，这些发射器由四门 ER 小型激光和两门 ER 中型激光支援。Base

column1: Don't let the stubby 'Urbie' fool you—it may look like a walking trash can, but it can mount heavy armor and a grown-up-sized Autocannon. R63s aren't known for their speed, but they are very useful if you can draw the enemy into their firing range.
column2: 别被矮胖的"都市"骗了——它也许看起来像个会走路的垃圾桶，却能装备厚重装甲和成人尺寸的自动炮。R63 不以速度著称，但如果你能把敌人引到它的射程内，它们就非常有用。Base

column1: The original Warhammer was designed as an assault BattleMech. However, it had been superseded by later and heavier 'Mech designs, though it remained a powerful weapons platform. The Clans wisely maintained and built on this solid frame a real assault 'Mech, the Warhammer IIC.
column2: 最初的战锤被设计为突击战斗机甲。尽管后来被更重的机甲设计取代，它仍是一个强大的武器平台。氏族明智地在这一坚固框架上维护并建造出真正的突击机甲——战锤 IIC。Base

column1: Introduced at the turn of the century, the Warhawk was created by the Smoke Jaguars in anticipation of the Clans’ return to the Inner Sphere.
column2: 战鹰于世纪之交推出，由烟虎氏族为迎接氏族重返内天体而研制。Base

column1: This was a Turhan Urban Assault Vehicle. Someone stuffed most of a space to ground microwave power transmission system into it's infantry bay. This large red button worries me.

column1: The J-27 Ordnance Transport was the backbone of the Star League Defense Force and remains a common sight in Inner Sphere and Periphery armies. Consisting of a tracked cab and wheeled trailer unit driven by two crewmen, each J-27 can carry eleven tons of ammo in total.
column2: J-27 弹药运输车曾是星盟防卫军的脊梁，至今仍常见于内天体与外围区的军队中。它由一辆履带式驾驶舱和一个轮式拖车组成，由两名乘员驾驶，每辆 J-27 总共可运载十一吨弹药。Base

column1: The Achileus was jointly designed by scientists from the Free Worlds League and Word of Blake with the goal of creating a light battle armor suit that could be mass produced. Inspired by the Federated Commonwealth's ultimately flawed Infiltrator Mk. I, the research team used the Blakist Tornado PA(L) as the basis for the new suit while seeking to overcome some of its defects. The resulting Achileus manages to add armoring, weaponry and integrated jump jets while still maintaining its stealth aspects. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.886 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 阿喀琉斯由自由世界联盟与布雷克之言的科学家联合设计，目标是在制造可以量产的轻量战斗装甲服。受联邦联邦最终存在缺陷的"渗透者 Mk. I"启发，研究团队以布雷克派的"龙卷风"轻动力甲为基础研制新装甲服，同时力图克服其部分缺陷。成品的阿喀琉斯在保持其隐身特性的同时，成功加装了装甲、武器和一体化跳跃推进器。特质：伏击者 投放费用倍率：0.886 可挂载全能单位，可近战，可蜂群攻击。

It also sports a flamer. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

column2: 蝰蛇唯一真正意义上的近身混战配置，蝰蛇 H 以两门极具破坏性的重型大型激光为主武器，仅有固定的火焰喷射器作为补充。为帮助散发机甲热量，它额外安装了六台双散热器。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A variant designed for hunting infantry and vehicles, the Adder TC was created specifically for Tukayyid. Diamond Shark politics limited the variant to a single unit, which fought and died on Tukayyid, covering the retreat of Alpha and Gamma galaxies. Powered by a 210-rated XL Engine and built with a combination of Ferro-Fibrous and Endo Steel, the Adder TC has 16 tons of pod space. 10 Machine Guns and a Small Pulse Laser make up the Anti Infantry weapons, while a Large Pulse Laser gives the TC some range. A Targeting Computer, Active Probe and an AMS fill out the remaining pod space. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Adder TC 是为猎杀步兵和车辆而设计的变型，专为图卡伊德之战打造。钻石鲨部族的内部政治使该变型仅生产了一台，它参与了图卡伊德之战并最终战损，其间掩护了阿尔法与伽马星系的撤退。Adder TC 由一台 210 级 XL 引擎驱动，采用铁纤维与钢内骨结构的组合，拥有 16 吨挂载空间。10 挺机枪和一门小型脉冲激光构成其反步兵武器，一门大型脉冲激光则赋予 TC 一定的射程。瞄准计算机、主动探测器和一套 AMS 填满了剩余的挂载空间。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A variant designed for hunting infantry and vehicles, the Adder TC was created specifically for Tukayyid. Diamond Shark politics limited the variant to a single unit, which fought and died on Tukayyid, covering the retreat of Alpha and Gamma galaxies. Powered by a 210-rated XL Engine and built with a combination of Ferro-Fibrous and Endo Steel, the Adder TC has 16 tons of pod space. 10 Machine Guns and a Small Pulse Laser make up the Anti Infantry weapons, while a Large Pulse Laser gives the TC some range. A Targeting Computer, Active Probe and an AMS fill out the remaining pod space.
column2: 这是为猎杀步兵与车辆而设计的变型，蝰蛇TC专为图卡伊迪而造。钻石鲨的政治运作把该变型限制为单一单位，它在图卡伊迪作战并阵亡，掩护了阿尔法与伽马星系的撤退。蝰蛇TC由一台210额定XL引擎驱动，采用铁纤维与钢内骨结构的组合，拥有16吨挂载空间。10挺机枪和一门小型脉冲激光构成反步兵武器，一门大型脉冲激光则赋予TC一定射程。一台瞄准计算机、一台主动探测器和一套反导弹系统填满剩余挂载空间。ZH

column1: A loadout mainly fielded by the Wolf's Dragoons. Two ER Large Lasers are the main damage dealers, while a C3 slave computer and a basic ECM suite provides some extra performance. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这套配置主要由狼之龙骑兵使用。两门增程大型激光是主要的伤害输出，C3 从属计算机和一套基础电子对抗套件则提供额外性能。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A prototype LAM, the Ajax was a next generation Star League design. Following relatively successful initial trials, the Amaris Civil War rendered the design extinct, with production and testing ceasing due to the war. Designed to be easy to maintain, the Ajax uses pod mounted weapons similar to the modular weapons designed for the Mercury scout 'Mech. Though able to switch modes faster than standard LAM designs, particularly heavy loadouts still hinder the Ajax's speed and versatility. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 作为原型 LAM，阿贾克斯是星盟的次世代设计。在相对成功的初期试验之后，阿马里斯内战使该设计绝迹——生产与测试因战争而中止。阿贾克斯设计上便于维护，使用类似水星侦察机甲模块化武器的吊舱式武器。虽然它能比标准 LAM 设计更快切换模式，但过重的载荷仍会拖累阿贾克斯的速度与灵活性。特质：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: At the end of the Amaris Civil War advances in land air mechs were starting to take shape. They say that the Spider found one of these advanced prototypes and used it in a very infamous ambush on Terra in the year 3025.
column2: 阿马里斯内战末期，陆空机甲的技术进步开始成形。据说蜘蛛找到了一台这样的先进原型机，并在 3025 年泰拉上一场臭名昭著的伏击中使用了它。ZH

column1: The Akuma AKU-1X carries an ER PPC and a powerful LB-X Autocannon/10 as its primary long-range weapons. The latter weapon gives it a good amount of flexibility in engaging targets as the autocannon can fire both solid and cluster ammunition. For medium to close range combat, the Akuma has a MRM-30 launcher and two highly accurate short range missile launchers; a Streak SRM-6 and a Streak SRM-4 launcher. Finally, a medium laser and a Medium Pulse Laser round out the Akuma's eclectic and effective weapons payload. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 恶鬼AKU-1X以一门增程粒子加农炮和一门强力LB-X自动炮/10作为主要远程武器。后者让它交战时相当灵活，因为该自动炮既可发射实心弹也可发射集束弹。中近距离作战时，恶鬼有一具MRM-30发射器和两具高精度的短程火箭发射器——一具连发SRM-6和一具连发SRM-4。最后，一门中型激光和一门中型脉冲激光为恶鬼这套杂而有效的武器载荷收尾。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: Created in 3058 in response to a call from Kurita to build more cost-effective BattleMechs with which to combat the Clans, the Akuma was designed by Independence Weaponry as a low-cost alternative to their Atlas variant. The Akuma actually shares several components with the Atlas and, much like that design, also features a head design intended to evoke fear in its enemies. The Akuma is built on a Foundation AKU Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a rugged and reliable GM 270 fusion engine that allows the 'Mech to reach a top speed of 54.0 km/h. The 'Mech has thirteen double heat sinks to dissipate waste heat and carries seventeen and a half tons of Durallex Special Heavy armor for protection from enemy fire.
column2: 恶鬼于3058年应库瑞塔家族的号召而造，当时需要更经济的战斗机甲来对抗部族；它由独立武器公司设计，作为其阿特拉斯变型的低成本替代品。恶鬼实际上与阿特拉斯共用若干部件，并与其相似地采用了意在让敌人心生恐惧的头部造型。恶鬼建在基础AKU钢内骨结构底盘上，由一台坚固可靠的GM 270聚变引擎驱动，最高速度54.0公里/小时。它有十三个双散热器散发废热，并带十七吨半杜拉莱克斯特种重型装甲抵御敌方火力。ZH

column1: The 2XU is an early, limited run prototype variant of what would eventually become the 2X series of the Akuma. It manages to fit an ER PPC, one LB 10-X autocannon, one MRM-40 launcher for primary firepower. As if that wasn't enough, the 'Mech also carries a Streak SRM-6 and two Medium Pulse Lasers as secondary weapons. The design does suffer from huge struggles with heat management as the cooling is far from adequate. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 2XU是阿库玛2X系列早期限量生产的原型变型。它成功塞入了一门增程粒子加农炮、一门LB 10-X自动炮以及一具MRM-40发射器作为主要火力。仿佛这还不够，该机甲还搭载了连发SRM-6和两门中型脉冲激光作为次要武器。由于散热能力远远不足，该设计在热量管理上极为吃力。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: The Álfar AL-A1 fielded an impressive amount of firepower for its size. A PPC mounted on its right arm was the main weapon. Three medium lasers, two on the left arm and one in the head, plus a SRM-6 missile rack with 1 ton of ammo, all in the left shoulder, provided ample backup and close-range punch. Fifteen heat sinks provided good battlefield endurance. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 阿尔法AL-A1就体型而言火力相当可观：右臂一门粒子加农炮是主武器，三门中型激光（左臂两门、头部一门）加上左肩一具SRM-6导弹挂架（配1吨弹药）提供充足的后手与近程打击力。十五个散热器带来良好的战场持续力。特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：1.03

column1: The Álfar, named for the elves of Germanic legend, was developed on Coventry during the reign of Archon Tracial Steiner to improve the Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces performance in mobile BattleMech warfare, and to provide a homegrown competitor to widespread standard designs like the Griffin and Shadow Hawk. Thanks to its good speed, a jumping distance of 90 meters, 10 tons of then-cutting-edge ferro-fibrous armor, and some serious firepower, the design was popular with its pilots. It was, however, liked much less by the technical crews. Ironically, Coventry Metal Works' desire to outdo their competition proved the Álfar's downfall. The design used so many nonstandard parts that repairs and logistics quickly became a big problem. Of all the Star League Defense Force Álfars lost in the war, a full third were scrapped solely because repairing them was deemed too difficult.
column2: 阿尔法以日耳曼传说中的精灵命名，由考文垂在大公特雷西尔·施泰纳统治时期研制，意在提升莱兰联邦武装部队在机动作战中的表现，并为狮鹫、影子鹰这类普及的标准设计提供一个本土竞争者。凭借良好的速度、90米的跳跃距离、10吨当时最前沿的铁纤维装甲以及可观的火力，该设计深受机师喜爱，却远不为技术地勤所喜。讽刺的是，考文垂金属厂想要压过竞争对手的愿望恰恰成了阿尔法的败因：该设计使用了太多非标准部件，使维修与后勤很快成为大问题。在战争中损失的SLDF阿尔法中，整整三分之一仅仅因为维修被判定过于困难而被拆解报废。ZH

column1: Nicknamed \"baby Warhammer\", this less common Dark Elf variant replaced all lasers and the SRM with a second PPC to provide a cheap fire support option at the cost of short-range capability and heat endurance. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 这款较少见的黑暗精灵变型绰号“小风暴之锤”，它以第二门粒子加农炮取代所有激光和SRM，提供廉价的火力支援选项，代价是近程能力与耐热性。特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：1.03

column1: The original variant of the Ambassador was fully unarmed, but as the StarLeague started fracturing some basic defensive firepower was adding in the form of a single Small Laser. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: Ambassador 的原始变型完全没有武装，但随着星际联盟开始分崩离析，人们以一门小型激光的形式为其添加了基本的自卫火力。特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：0.97

column1: The Ambassador is one of the most unusual, yet luxurious, BattleMechs every built. The 15-ton ultralight 'Mech was initally custom built for diplomatic and ambassadorial duties by the StarLeague's high-ranking officers, but with time it spread through the Inner Sphere and many powerful officials and leaders started using it as a means to handle face-to-face diplomacy.
column2: 大使是有史以来建造过的最不寻常、却又最豪华的战斗机甲之一。这种15吨超轻型机甲最初由星盟高级军官为外交与大使命而定制建造，但随着时间推移它流传至内天体各处，许多有权势的官员与领袖开始用它作为面对面外交的手段。ZH

column1: Debuting in 3055, the Anvil is an FWL Mech designed to work with the light Hammer fire support Mech. A heavy brawler, the Anvil is a 60-ton mech with a 300-rated Fusion Core and an Endo Steel chassis. The Anvil ANV-3M is armed with a pair of Large Pulse Lasers and a pair of Medium Lasers. A Guardian ECM Suite distorts enemy sensors. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 铁砧于3055年首次亮相，是自由世界联盟的一款机甲，设计用于配合轻型锤式火力支援机甲作战。作为重型斗士，铁砧是60吨机甲，带300额定聚变核心和钢内骨结构底盘。铁砧ANV-3M装有一对大型脉冲激光和一对中型激光。一套守护者电子对抗套件可干扰敌方传感器。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.08

column2: Anvil 于 3055 年首次亮相，是自由世界联盟的机甲，设计上用于与轻型火力支援机甲 Hammer 协同作战。作为一款重型近身混战机甲，Anvil 重 60 吨，配备额定 300 的聚变引擎和钢内骨结构。Anvil ANV-6M 装有两门大型脉冲激光、一门中型激光和一具 TAG。一具 Guardian 电子对抗套件可扰乱敌方传感器。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.08

A pair of ER Medium Lasers round out the armament, while MASC and Guardian ECM enhance the Mechs speed and defensive capabilities. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
column2: 铁砧于3055年亮相，是自由世界联盟的机甲，设计上用于配合轻型锤式火力支援机甲作战。作为一台重型混战混战机甲，铁砧重60吨，装备一台额定240的聚变核心与钢内骨结构底盘。铁砧ANV-8M装备一门箭IV导弹和一门增程大型激光。两门增程中型激光补全了武装，而MASC与守护者电子对抗套件则提升了该机甲的速度与防御能力。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左上

A pair of ER Medium Lasers round out the armament, while MASC and Guardian ECM enhance the Mechs speed and defensive capabilities.

column1: Created by Wolf's Dragoons in the early 3060s, this mech has a unique Prototype Light Fusion Engine alongside early production models of the Multi-Missile Launcher and an assortment of tactical munitions. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: 这台机甲由狼之龙骑兵在3060年代初打造，配有独特的原型轻型聚变引擎，以及早期量产型多用途导弹发射器和各类战术弹药。特性：可变距离瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.07

column1: Created by Wolf's Dragoons in the early 3060s, this mech has a unique Prototype Light Fusion Engine alongside early production models of the Multi-Missile Launcher and an assortment of tactical munitions.
column2: 这台机甲由狼之龙骑兵在3060年代初打造，配有独特的原型轻型聚变引擎，以及早期量产型多用途导弹发射器和各类战术弹药。ZH

column1: The APN-1J is armed with two medium lasers and a machine gun, which is a surprising amount of weapons for 15-ton BattleMech considering it also sports 3 tons of standard armor. The drawback is the 90 rated engine core which leads to a - for ultralights - slow movement across the battlefield. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: APN-1J 装备两门中型激光和一挺机枪；考虑到它还披挂 3 吨标准装甲，这对一台 15 吨战斗机甲来说已是相当可观的武器配置。它的短板在于额定 90 的引擎核心，导致它在战场上的移动速度——对于超轻型机甲而言——相当缓慢。特性：随处可见 投放费用倍率：0.97

column1: As House Marik was running low of funds after the long fighting of the Reunification War they tried to find new ways to cut costs. The Apollon was born from once such project, creating a cheap 15 ton ultralight 'Mech. The design was never liked by the armed forces of the Free Worlds League due to its obvious cost-cutting measures, but although most of the produced 'Mechs have been lost as the years passed a surprising amount has somehow still stayed relevant and even found their way to other Great Houses.
column2: 由于马里克家族在统一战争的长期作战后资金匮乏，他们试图寻找削减成本的新办法。阿波罗就诞生于这样一个项目，造出一种廉价的15吨超轻型机甲。由于明显的削减成本措施，该设计从未受到自由世界联盟武装部队的喜爱，但尽管随着岁月流逝大部分已生产的机甲都已损失，仍有数量惊人的一些不知怎么地保持了适用性，甚至流入了其他大贵族家族。ZH

column1: For long range combat, the Arcas carries a ER Large Laser in each arm. When the Arcas' opponent closes, it can bring three Streak SRM-4s and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers to bear. These accurate weapons help the second-line warrior once an enemy gets close. Fifteen double heat sinks help keep the 'Mech cool. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 远程作战时，阿卡斯每只手臂各带一门增程大型激光。当对手逼近，阿卡斯可动用三具连发SRM-4和一对中型脉冲激光。这些精准武器在敌人靠近后帮助二线战士。十五个双散热器帮助机甲保持凉爽。特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Following the move of Clan Ghost Bear to the Inner Sphere, Khan Bjorn Jorgensson ordered the creation of a new BattleMech. The Arcas was designed as a symbol to mark the beginning of a new era, so Loremaster Laurie Tseng named it after a character in the mythology of the Greeks who eventually became the constellation known as Ursa Minor. First produced in 3061, the Arcas is expensive for a second-line 'Mech. It utilizes an XL engine that enables it to move up to 86 km/h and jump jets for a maximum jump capacity of one hundred fifty meters at a time. The Arcas mounts thirteen and a half tons of standard armor, the most a 'Mech of its size can carry.
column2: 在 Ghost Bear 部族迁入内层星域之后，可汗 Bjorn Jorgensson 下令研制一款新的战斗机甲。Arcas 被设计为一个象征，用以标志新时代的开端，因此学识大师 Laurie Tseng 以希腊神话中的人物为它命名——那人最终化作了名为小熊座的星座。Arcas 于 3061 年首次投产，作为二线机甲而言价格昂贵。它采用 XL 引擎，最高可移动至 86 km/h，并配备跳跃推进器，单次最大跳跃距离可达一百五十米。Arcas 搭载十三点五吨标准装甲，这是该体型的机甲所能携带的极限。ZH

column1: This variant is used primarily when far from supply lines. It removes the missiles and ER Large Lasers for a pair of ER PPCs and additional double heat sinks. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 此变型主要在远离补给线时使用。它拆掉导弹和增程大型激光，换成一对增程粒子加农炮和额外双散热器。特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A customized variant of the Arctic Cheetah piloted by Eva Hordwon, the Shard carries two ER Medium Lasers in each arm, supported by twin Heavy Machine Guns in the right torso and a left torso-mounted Streak SRM-4. A single ton of Streak missiles and a ton and a half of HMG ammo give the Shard good endurance. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 由伊娃·霍德翁驾驶的 Arctic Cheetah 定制改型，Shard 每臂各带两门增程中型激光，右躯干配双联重型机枪，左躯干装有一具连发 SRM-4。一吨连发导弹和一吨半的重型机枪弹药让 Shard 具备良好的持续作战能力。特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A special configuration of the Arctic Cheetah used for batchall, the ritualistic combat challenge between Clan warriors. Two Heavy Medium Lasers and two SRM-6 launchers are the main damage dealers, but a pair of Micro Pulse Lasers and a Flamer gives better close combat capabilities. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Arctic Cheetah 用于 batchall（部族战士之间仪式性的战斗挑战）的特殊配置。两台重型中型激光和两部 SRM-6 发射器是主要的输出手段，而两门微型脉冲激光和一门火焰喷射器则提升了混战能力。特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The design of the Arctic Wolf is simple: get close, unleash a torrent of missiles, and get out. To do this, it is armed with six Type 1 SRM Six-Shooters and two Type 1 Cross-Pattern SRM-4 Launchers. Aiding the accuracy of these missiles is the Tracker Series Narc Missile Beacon. The Arctic Wolf also boasts an impressive four tons of ammunition for its launchers. The 'Mech has ten double heat sinks which can be overwhelmed, but only if a MechWarrior insists on staying in the fight or going full-tilt for long periods. The Arctic Wolf is protected by six tons of standard armor. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 北极狼（Arctic Wolf）的设计思路很简单：贴近、倾泻导弹、然后撤离。为此，它装备了六具 1 型 SRM 六连发器和两具 1 型交叉弹道 SRM-4 发射器。追踪者系列 Narc 导弹信标则提升了这些导弹的命中精度。北极狼还拥有令人瞩目的四吨发射器弹药储备。该机甲装有十台双散热器，只有当机甲战士执意长时间持续作战或全力输出时，散热器才可能不堪重负。北极狼由六吨标准装甲提供防护。特性：改进瞄准 - 近距 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column2: 北极狼

To do this, it is armed with six Type 1 SRM Six-Shooters and two Type 1 Cross-Pattern SRM-4 Launchers. Aiding the accuracy of these missiles is the Tracker Series Narc Missile Beacon. The Arctic Wolf also boasts an impressive four tons of ammunition for its launchers. The Arctic Wolf is protected by six tons of standard armor.
