column1: This variant replaces the SRM-4s and two SRM-6s with an Alpha Series large pulse laser. This gives the 'Mech some long-range capability and provides it with a punch weapon, as well as increased accuracy and a reduction on ammunition dependency. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 该变型用一门Alpha系列大型脉冲激光替换了SRM-4和两具SRM-6。这为机甲带来了一定的远程作战能力，也赋予它一件重击武器，同时提升了精度并降低了对弹药的依赖。特性：改进瞄准 - 短距 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The very first Argus Design spec's that was rejected by the AFFCS, while being a lot more flexible then contemporary Chassis did its more advanced and rare components make it unfit for larger Engagements. Quirk: Advanced Missile TTS Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是最早被 AFFCS 否决的 Argus 设计方案。虽然它比同时代的底盘灵活得多，但其更先进、更稀有的组件令它不适合大规模交战。特性：高级导弹瞄准系统 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向机甲

column1: The very first Argus Design spec's that was rejected by the AFFCS, while being a lot more flexible then contemporary Chassis did its more advanced and rare components make it unfit for larger Engagements.
column2: 这是阿格斯设计规格的最初版本，被AFFCS否决；虽然它比同时代底盘灵活得多，但更先进、更稀有的部件使它不适合大规模交战。ZH

column1: One of several variants that attempt to modernize the weaponry of the AS7-D. The AS7-8D replaces the AC/20 with a Gauss Rifle, adds Artemis IV support to the LRM launcher and upgrade to Medium Pulse Lasers over the standard ones. Further, the SRM is replaced with a Streak SRM and both a Guardian ECM Suiote and a Beagle Active Probe were added. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 这是在为 AS7-D 的武器进行现代化改造的若干变型之一。AS7-8D 以高斯步枪取代 AC/20，为 LRM 发射器加装 Artemis IV 辅助系统，并将标准中型激光升级为中型脉冲激光。此外，SRM 被换成连发 SRM，同时还加装了一套 Guardian ECM 套件和一台 Beagle 主动探测器。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.18

column1: An upgrade of the original -D, this variant uses an Endo Steel chassis to fit more Lasers and add Artemis IV FCS to the missile launchers. The Autocannon is also switch to a more accurate Gauss Rifle. The downside of all the energy weapons is the fact the 'Mech overheats very easily, event after the switch to Double Heat Sinks. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 这是对原版-D的升级，此变型采用钢内骨结构底盘以装入更多激光，并为导弹发射器加装阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统；自动炮也换成更精准的高斯步枪。这些能量武器的缺点是该机甲极易过热，即便改用了双散热器也是如此。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.18

column1: The AS7 'Boar's Head' is a little-seen trial Atlas run that attempted to make a more mobile striker assault 'Mech while still maintaining the dreaded reputation of the Atlas. Among Defiance's changes included routing all the energy weapon power couplings to the arms - 3 in each - and a massive XL engine. Ultimately, the AS7-BH proved too fragile and vulnerable to weapons loss for it's weight and altogether excessive cost. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2
column2: AS7“野猪头”是一批鲜为人知的试验型阿特拉斯，试图在保留阿特拉斯令人畏惧的名声的同时，打造一台更具机动性的突击机甲。Defiance所做的改动包括将所有能量武器的供电耦合全部改走手臂——每条手臂三组——以及一具巨大的XL引擎。最终，AS7-BH被证明对于其吨位而言过于脆弱、极易损失武器，而且造价高得离谱。特性：威慑 投放费用倍率：1.2

column1: The AS7 'Boar's Head' is a little-seen trial Atlas run that attempted to make a more mobile striker assault 'Mech while still maintaining the dreaded reputation of the Atlas. Among Defiance's changes included routing all the energy weapon power couplings to the arms - 3 in each - and a massive XL engine. Ultimately, the AS7-BH proved too fragile and vulnerable to weapons loss for it's weight and altogether excessive cost.
column2: AS7"野猪头"是一种鲜为人知的试验型阿特拉斯型号，试图在保持阿特拉斯那可怕名声的同时，把它做成更具机动性的打击型突击机甲。反抗所做的改动包括把所有能量武器的电力耦合线路都引向双臂——每臂3条——以及一具巨大的XL引擎。最终，AS7-BH被证明就其重量而言过于脆弱、太容易损失武器，而且成本过高。ZH

column1: The Atlas C is the result of the first rudimentary refit protocol created for the Atlas C, which upgraded the weapons, and was later commonly implemented on captured Inner Sphere Atlases during Operation Revival Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: Atlas C 源于为 Atlas C 制订的第一套初级改装方案，该方案升级了武器，后来在复兴行动期间被广泛用于改装缴获的内层星域 Atlas。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.16

column1: After the success of the initial conversion protocol of the Atlas C, the C-2 is a more thorough upgrade that replaces the LRMs with an additional ER PPC and the rest of the weapons with superior clan versions. The C-2 protocol is the most common conversion to be implemented on Atlases and Atlas IIs in Clan space. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22
column2: 在 Atlas C 的初步改装方案取得成功之后，C-2 是一次更为彻底的升级：它用一门额外的增程粒子加农炮取代了 LRM，并将其余武器全部更换为性能更优的部族版本。C-2 改装方案是部族领地上 Atlas 与 Atlas II 最常采用的改装形式。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.22

column1: A more uncommon clan conversion than the C 2, the Atlas C 3 removes some of the original weapon systems to fit a giant Arrow IV artillery system in the left torso. In the right torso a Gauss Rifle is mounted, and each arm also carries a ER Large Laser. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22
column2: Atlas C 3 是比 C 2 更为罕见的部族改装型。它拆除了部分原有武器系统，以便在左躯干内安装一套巨大的 Arrow IV 火炮系统。右躯干内装有一门高斯步枪，每条手臂还各携有一门增程大型激光。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.22

column1: The personal 'Mech of General Caesar Steiner of the Lyran Alliance, the Duke of Furilo and son to Margrave Iris Steiner. The 'Mech is ostensibly designated AS7-CS, but referred to as the 'Dämmerung' by most. It mounts a massive weaponry spread thanks to it’s advanced XL engine. Using the weight savings, the Medium Lasers that once rested in the forearms are replaced by Large Pulse Lasers, mounted underslung on the forearms. Regarding the Gauss rifle as the next evolution of heavy-bore ballistic weapons, the Archon requested that one with an ample ammo supply replaced the Atlas' AC/20. The SRM magazine was completely removed and the LRM magazine downsized to make room for an ER Large Laser along the ‘Mech’s centerline, and the arsenal is rounded out by hip-mounted Medium Lasers. This broad spread of weapons allows for the design to bring the bulk of its weapons to bear at any range Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2
column2: 这是莱兰联盟 Caesar Steiner 将军的私人座机——他是 Furilo 公爵，也是边区伯爵 Iris Steiner 之子。该机甲名义上的编号为 AS7-CS，但大多数人称其为“Dämmerung”。凭借先进的 XL 引擎，它搭载了极为庞大的武器配置。利用节省下来的重量，曾置于前臂的中型激光被替换为吊挂在前臂下方的大型脉冲激光。执政官将高斯步枪视为大口径实弹武器的下一步进化，因此要求用一门弹药充足的高斯步枪取代 Atlas 的 AC/20。SRM 弹仓被完全拆除，LRM 弹仓则缩减容量，以便沿机甲中轴线装入一门增程大型激光；其武器库最后由臀侧安装的中型激光补足。如此广泛的武器分布使该设计能在任何距离上倾泻其大部分火力。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.2

column1: Arena Juggernaut
column2: 竞技场主宰者

column1: A Clan-tech retrofit of the AS7-D Atlas, the Atlas C replaced the older autocannon and missile launchers with a Clan standard Ultra AC/20, Swarm LRM compatible LRM-20, and Streak SRM-6 launchers; but the Inner Sphere Medium Lasers remained unchanged. Lighter Clan components allowed the Atlas C to carry 3 tons of autocannon ammunition. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: Atlas C是AS7-D Atlas的部族科技改装型，以部族标准型Ultra AC/20、兼容Swarm LRM的LRM-20以及连发SRM-6发射器取代了旧式的自动炮与导弹发射器；但内层星域的中型激光则保持不变。更轻的部族部件让Atlas C得以携带3吨自动炮弹药。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.18

column1: Piloted by Wolf's Dragoons Captain Danielle Rondema, this modified Atlas carried three medium lasers in each arm, trading away the SRM rack to do so. The additional heat was dissipated by two additional heat sinks that replaced the rear-firing medium lasers. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2
column2: 这台改装过的阿特拉斯由沃尔夫龙骑兵的丹妮尔·隆德马上尉驾驶，为此每只手臂各装了三门中型激光，代价是舍弃了SRM发射巢。由此产生的额外热量由两个额外散热器散逸，它们取代了朝后射击的中型激光。特性：威慑 投放费用倍率：1.2

column1: Piloted by Wolf's Dragoons Captain Danielle Rondema, this modified Atlas carried three medium lasers in each arm, trading away the SRM rack to do so. The additional heat was dissipated by two additional heat sinks that replaced the rear-firing medium lasers.
column2: 由狼族龙骑兵上尉丹妮尔·龙德玛驾驶，这台改装阿特拉斯在双臂各装三门中型激光器，为此拆掉了SRM架。额外的热量由两具额外散热器散发——它们替换了向后开火的中型激光器。ZH

column1: Used by Vayil Oonthrax on Solaris VII this variant of the Atlas removed the LRM-20 for another SRM-6, more SRM-6 ammunition and Heat Sinks. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 这款Atlas改型由Vayil Oonthrax在Solaris VII上使用，它拆除了LRM-20，换装另一具SRM-6、更多SRM-6弹药以及散热器。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.18

column1: The Atlas AS7-D-CE replaces the AC/20 from the standard model with the newly developed LB 20-X autocannon, and the LRM and SRM launchers with improved versions. To lower weight of the new technology even makes it possible to add two more heat sinks and more ammunition. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: Atlas AS7-D-CE 用新研制的 LB 20-X 自动炮替换了标准型号的 AC/20，并将 LRM 与 SRM 发射器换成改进型。新技术带来的重量下降甚至使其可以再加装两台散热器和更多弹药。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.16

column1: When the Star League Defense Force left the Inner Sphere under Commanding General Aleksandr Kerensky during Operation Exodus, they brought with them many of the most common 'Mechs. As the SLDF-in-exile slowly started turning into the Clans, they started developing improved weapons, which they mounted on their existing armies of 'Mech. These weapons are commonly called Clan Early, and as such the Mech's using them got the -CE suffix added to their designation.
column2: 当星盟防卫军在"出埃及"行动中随总指挥官亚历山大·克伦斯基离开内天体时，他们带走了许多最常见的机甲。随着流亡的星盟防卫军逐渐演变为氏族，他们开始研发改进型武器，并装到已有的机甲部队上。这类武器通常被称为"氏族早期型"，使用它们的机甲编号因此带上了 -CE 后缀。ZH

column1: The AS7-DRR is a refit of the AS7-D, replacing the AC/20 with a Gauss Rifle, allowing the addition of two more Medium Lasers and Artemis IV Support for the launchers. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: AS7-DRR是AS7-D的改装型，以一门高斯步枪取代AC/20，从而得以加装两门额外的中型激光，并为发射器增加Artemis IV支援。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.18

column1: A classic variant of the AS7-D used by the Lyran Commonwealth, the AS7-H trades the autocannon and LRM 20 for a smaller LRM 10, a trio of Large Lasers and a huge hatchet. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: 这是莱兰联邦所使用的 AS7-D 经典变型。AS7-H 以更小的 LRM 10、三门大型激光和一把巨大的战斧替换了自动炮与 LRM 20。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.16

column1: A partial clan refit used by some of the high-end mercenary outfits, based of their gathered loot. A few have also been stolen by Pirates or gone missing under suspicious circumstances. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 一种部分采用部族技术改装的型号，由一些高端雇佣兵部队根据其搜集到的战利品改造而成。也有少数被海盗盗走，或在可疑的情况下不翼而飞。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.18

column1: Featured as a custom Solaris VII 'Mech the 'Kraken' Is very similar too and likely built upon the chassis of a standard AS7-K, switching out the Medium Pulse Lasers for standard models. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2
column2: 作为Solaris VII的定制机甲登场，“Kraken”与该型号非常相似，很可能是在标准AS7-K的底盘上建造的，只是将中型脉冲激光换成了标准型号。特性：威慑 投放费用倍率：1.2

column1: Featured as a custom Solaris VII 'Mech the 'Kraken' Is very similar too and likely built upon the chassis of a standard AS7-K, switching out the Medium Pulse Lasers for standard models.
column2: 作为定制索拉里斯VII机甲登场，“海怪”与标准AS7-K极为相似，很可能就建在其底盘上，只是把中型脉冲激光换成了标准型号。ZH

column1: A Large Laser refit of the AS7-D, reducing the LRM launcher to 15 tubes and the Autocannon to an AC/10 to be able to fit a Large Laser in each arm. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: 这是 AS7-D 的大型激光改装型：将 LRM 发射器减少到 15 管，自动炮改为 AC/10，从而能在每条手臂各装入一门大型激光。特性：战斗铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.16

column1: A mercenary refit of the Atlas, mounting a Gauss Rifle, the stock LRM-20 launcher and two ER Large Lasers. Two Medium Pulse Lasers provide close fire support. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 这是Atlas的雇佣兵改装版，搭载一门高斯步枪、原装LRM-20发射器和两门增程大型激光。两门中型脉冲激光提供近距离火力支援。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.18

column1: The Atlas AS7-MCJ is similar to the -MCA, but drops a ton of armor and uses an endo steel chassis to fit three Jump Jets. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: Atlas AS7-MCJ与-MCA相似，但减少了一吨装甲，并采用钢内骨结构底盘以容纳三台跳跃推进器。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.18

column1: Another refit of the AS7-D similar to the -MCA and MCJ, this variant replaces the Large Lasers with two ER PPCs. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是AS7-D的另一款改装，与-MCA和MCJ类似，以两门增程粒子加农炮取代大型激光。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Another typical Export from the Gamesworld is this Atlas redesigned around an Articulated and 3 Directional Jump Jets, to close in and punch the Enemy with its Hydraulic Fists. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2
column2: 又一款来自游戏世界的典型出口型号：这台阿特拉斯围绕铰接式结构与3台定向跳跃推进器重新设计，以便逼近敌人，用它的液压铁拳痛击对手。特性：战斗铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.2

column1: Another typical Export from the Gamesworld is this Atlas redesigned around an Articulated and 3 Directional Jump Jets, to close in and punch the Enemy with its Hydraulic Fists.
column2: 作为游戏世界的另一种典型出口产品，这台阿特拉斯围绕一具铰接式与3具定向跳跃推进器重新设计，以便逼近并用液压拳击打敌人。ZH

column1: The personal 'Mech of Galedon Military District commander Warlord Grieg Samsonov during the DCMS's Third Succession War invasion of Galtor III in 3025, only the massive autocannon remains, with the rest of the standard weaponry replaced with a PPC mounted in each arm. The remaining weight and space is devoted to six additional heat sinks. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2
column2: 这台机甲是加勒登军区指挥官、军阀格里格·萨姆索诺夫在3025年DCMS第三次继承战争入侵加尔托III时的座机，它只保留了那门巨大的自动炮，其余标准武器被替换为每条手臂各装一门粒子加农炮。剩余的重量和空间则用于加装六台额外散热器。特性：威吓 投放费用倍率：1.2

column1: The personal 'Mech of Galedon Military District commander Warlord Grieg Samsonov during the DCMS's Third Succession War invasion of Galtor III in 3025, only the massive autocannon remains, with the rest of the standard weaponry replaced with a PPC mounted in each arm. The remaining weight and space is devoted to six additional heat sinks. While lacking much of the close-range weaponry of the AS7-D, this unusual, modified variant was highly effective in a Direct Fire Support Role.
column2: 这是加勒登军区指挥官格雷格·萨姆索诺夫领主在3025年DCMS第三次继承战争入侵加尔特III时的私人机甲，如今只剩下那门巨大的自动炮，其余标准武器被替换为双臂各一门PPC。剩余重量与空间用于六具额外散热器。虽然缺少AS7-D的大部分近距离武器，这一不寻常的改装改型在直射火力支援角色上极为有效。ZH

column1: The Atlas AS7-ZL was originally part of the the DCMS, but it was converted to the personal 'Mech of Zackary Lee by Free Rasalhague engineers after its capture. Due to its severe damage much of its equipment had to be either painstakingly restored or completely scrapped. The internal structure and 300-rated Fusion powerplant was kept the same, but most of the weapons were either replaced by similar ones of a different make or new ones. The main weapon of the original Atlas AS7-D was too damage to repair, and instead got replaced with a Gauss Rifle for increased precision. Since most of the armor was practically missing, the technicians took the chance to upgrade the 'Mech to use Ferro-Fibrous armor. For similar reasons the cooling system was rebuilt from scratch using double heat sinks rather than standard. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2
column2: 阿特拉斯AS7-ZL原本隶属于龙脉联合体军方，但在被缴获后，由自由拉塞哈格的工程师改装成扎卡里·李的专属机甲。由于损伤严重，它的许多设备要么被费尽心力地修复，要么被彻底废弃。内部结构与额定300的聚变动力装置保持不变，但大部分武器不是被不同厂商的同类产品替换，就是换成了全新的型号。原版阿特拉斯AS7-D的主武器损伤过重而无法修复，于是被换成一门高斯步枪以提升精准度。由于装甲几乎荡然无存，技术人员趁机将机甲升级为铁纤维装甲。出于类似的原因，冷却系统也从头重建，改用双散热器而非标准散热器。特性：战斗铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.2

column1: An late Clan Invasion era variant created as an attempt to counter certain Clan 'Mechs. Each side torso carries a Gauss Rifle and both arms an ER Large Laser. A chest mounted LRM-10 provides some indirect fire capabilities. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 这是部族入侵晚期的一种变型，为对抗某些部族机甲而造。两侧躯干各装一门高斯步枪，双臂各一门增程大型激光，胸口一具LRM-10提供一定的间接火力。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.18

column1: The custom version used by Nicholas Kerensky, this version of the Atlas II retains the weapon array of the original but swaps the Inner Sphere components for more advanced Clan equivalents. It also adds a second SRM launcher. All the missile systems are equipped with Artemis IV fire control systems. Double heat sinks were replaced with their less bulky Clan equivalents and increased to nineteen. The ferro-fibrous armor protection remains the same, but again was replaced by more compact Clan version. To handle electronic warfare duties, a small ECM Suite and Active Probe were added to the center torso. The CASE systems were integrated into the side torsos, as was common to all Clan designs. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24
column2: 这是尼古拉斯·克伦斯基使用的定制版本，这台阿特拉斯II保留了原型的武器阵列，但把内层星域的部件换成更先进的部族同类产品。它还增加了一具SRM发射器。所有导弹系统都配备了Artemis IV火控系统。双散热器被替换为体积更小的部族同类产品，数量增至十九台。铁纤维装甲的防护水平保持不变，但同样换成了更紧凑的部族版本。为承担电子战任务，中央躯干加装了一套小型电子对抗套件和主动探测器。CASE系统被整合进左右躯干，这也是所有部族设计的通行做法。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.24

column1: A customized variant of the stock AWS-9M model that was utilized by Adam Steiner during the 1st Somerset Strikers' liberation of Somerset in the midst of the Clan Invasion. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这是库存 AWS-9M 型号的定制变型，曾在部族入侵期间由亚当·施泰纳在第一萨默塞特突击队解放萨默塞特的行动中使用。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: The Awesome is traditionally used in a vanguard role when penetrating enemy defenses. The Awesome's massive firepower also lends it to defensive actions, acting as a mobile turret when necessary. Because of its reliance on PPCs, the Awesome is able to act independently for extended periods of time. This trait is also useful in siege situations where the 'Mech can keep up a constant barrage, allowing it to win battles of attrition through bleeding an enemy dry. The only downsides to the Awesome is its low maneuverability and lack of rear-facing weaponry, making it vulnerable to being outflanked and surrounded by lighter 'Mechs, although good intelligence and a well-deployed screening force can mitigate this issue.
column2: 神奇传统上在突破敌方防御时担任先锋。神奇庞大的火力也使它适合防御行动，必要时充当移动炮塔。由于依赖 PPC，神奇能够长时间独立作战。这一特性在围攻情境中也很有用，机甲可以持续不断地轰击，通过放干敌人的血来赢下消耗战。神奇唯一的缺点是机动性低、缺乏后向武器，因此容易被轻型机甲侧翼包抄并包围，尽管良好的情报与部署得当的屏护部队可以缓解这一问题。ZH

column1: Danielle Peterson's Awesome, the 'Pretty Baby' Hero 'Mech has some unexpected speed, achieved through the use of an 340-rated Extralight Engine. The Pretty Baby (serial number AWS8V99TG-2957) also features a unique weapon loadout as well - mounting a standard PPC in the right arm, a LRM-15 in the right torso, a Medium Laser in the head, Large Laser in the left torso and an SRM-4 in the left arm. 19 Double Heat Sinks, two tons of LRM and three of SRM missiles keep it in the thick of battle. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 丹妮尔·彼得森的 Awesome，即英雄机甲“Pretty Baby”，拥有出人意料的速度，这得益于一台 340 级超轻型引擎。Pretty Baby（序列号 AWS8V99TG-2957）还拥有独一无二的武器配置：右臂一门标准粒子加农炮、右躯干一门 LRM-15、头部一门中型激光、左躯干一门大型激光，左臂一具 SRM-4。19 个双散热器、两吨 LRM 弹药和三吨 SRM 导弹让它能在激战中持续作战。特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: Danielle Peterson's Awesome, the 'Pretty Baby' Hero 'Mech has some unexpected speed, achieved through the use of an 340-rated Extralight Engine. The Pretty Baby (serial number AWS8V99TG-2957) also features a unique weapon loadout as well - mounting a standard PPC in the right arm, a LRM-15 in the right torso, a Medium Laser in the head, Large Laser in the left torso and an SRM-4 in the left arm. 19 Double Heat Sinks, two tons of LRM and three of SRM missiles keep it in the thick of battle.
column2: 丹妮尔·彼得森的恐怖，"俏宝贝"英雄机甲有着出人意料的速度，这是靠一具340级超轻型引擎实现的。俏宝贝（序列号AWS8V99TG-2957）还有一套独特的武器载荷——右臂装一门标准PPC，右躯干一具LRM-15，头部一门中型激光器，左躯干一门大型激光器，左臂一具SRM-4。19具双重散热器、两吨LRM和三吨SRM导弹让它留在激战中心。ZH

column1: The Bandersnatch, named after the monster in Lewis Carroll's 'Wonderland' series, is the brainchild of Felifious Bander and is built around the concept of an affordable and effective BattleMech for sale to mercenary units. The Bandersnatch shares most of its components with the Marauder, making the 'Mech cheaper and easier to repair. The Bandersnatch uses double heat sinks for superior heat dissipation capabilities, allowing a heavier weapons payload. Further, the Bandersnatch carries a respectable eleven tons of armor. While not the maximum amount of armor that the chassis can handle, the 'Mech is still well protected. The primary armaments are for long to medium range combat, a trio of Holly LRM-5 missile launchers and a pair of Armstrong Class-B ClusterGuns LB-X Autocannon/10s that fire both solid and cluster rounds. In the event that an enemy does close to short ranges, the 'Mech carries six Magna Mk II Medium Lasers, two of which are rear mounted, giving it good close range protection. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Bandersnatch 得名于刘易斯·卡罗尔《仙境》系列中的怪物，是 Felifious Bander 的心血之作，其设计理念是为雇佣兵部队提供一款价格适中且战力可靠的战斗机甲。Bandersnatch 的大部分组件与 Marauder 通用，因此造价更低，也更易于维修。它采用双散热器，散热能力出色，可承载更重的武器载荷。此外，Bandersnatch 还披挂令人称道的十一吨装甲。虽然尚未达到该底盘所能承受的最大装甲量，这台机甲的防护仍相当完备。主要军备面向中远距交战：三具 Holly LRM-5 导弹发射器和两门 Armstrong Class-B ClusterGuns LB-X 自动炮/10，可发射实心弹与集束弹。一旦敌人逼近到近距离，该机甲还携有六门 Magna Mk II 中型激光，其中两门朝后安装，为其提供良好的近距离防护。特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Long-Range Brawler
column2: 远程缠斗者

column1: Ware the frumious Bandersnatch, because a terror she is to all, dangerous as the knout. Passing through quick, as a minute on yonder clock, she speeds ahead with fang and claw soon at your throat. Best to lie down it is, otherwise her meal you are, crossing the Styx faster than on Charon's boat. Ware the Bandersnatch, deadly and fast, leaving none the room to gloat.
column2: 当心那只暴躁的班德斯纳奇，因为她对众生皆是恐怖，危险如同皮鞭。她一闪而过，快如钟上的一分钟，獠牙与利爪旋即抵上你的咽喉。最好还是躺下吧，否则你就会成为她的餐食，跨过冥河比坐卡戎的船还快。当心班德斯纳奇，致命而迅捷，不留任何人得意的时间。ZH

column1: A unique customized Bandersnatch which was created for ex-Nova Cat MechWarrior Horus. Equipped with Endo Steel, the 'Mech's weaponry had been almost completely refitted with the exception of the rear-firing Medium Lasers. In each arm, the 'Mech has been given a Class 20 Autocannon. It has 2 tons of CASE protected ammunition for the cannons in each side torso. For long-range firepower, it was fitted with a torso-mounted ER Large Laser. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 一具独一无二的定制 Bandersnatch，专为新星猫部族的前机甲战士 Horus 打造。该机甲配备钢内骨结构，除朝后射击的中型激光外，武器几乎全部重新改装。每只手臂各装有一门 20 级自动炮。两侧躯干各有 2 吨受 CASE 保护的自动炮弹药。为获得远程火力，它还搭载了一具安装在躯干上的增程大型激光。特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: I can see what the guy was aiming for, Boss. I just am not sure this was the right way to do it. Sure, the 'Mech can cause a big thud, but what if you miss...
column2: 我能看出那家伙想干什么，老大。我只是不确定这是不是正确的做法。的确，这台机甲能砸出很大的动静，可要是你没打中呢……

column1: A custom design of the Bandersnatch from an mostly unknown designer know as 'Tricky Dick'. Very little is known of this 'Mech beyond its basic parameters. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是Bandersnatch的一款定制设计，出自一位几乎无人知晓、人称“滑头迪克”的设计师之手。除了基本参数之外，人们对这台机甲几乎一无所知。特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Huh. Where did you find this one, Boss? Don't think I ever seen a Bandersnatch like it before. No idea why the changes though, it doesn't seem that different from the normal variants.
column2: 嗯。你从哪儿找到这台，老板？我觉得自己从没见过这样的班德斯纳奇。不过我不知道为什么会有这些改动，它似乎和常规变型没多大差别。ZH

column1: The Bane is a BattleMech that is based upon a Star League prototype that was never put into production. Tagged the Kraken by Inner Sphere forces who opposed it, the Bane was first built in 2827. It was originally a significant part of many Clan toumans, but was gradually relegated to second-line status following the introduction of the OmniMech. As such, it is still critical to many defensive units. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 灾星是一款以从未投产的星际联盟原型为基础的战斗机甲。它被对抗它的内层星域部队称作“海怪”，于2827年首次建造。它原本是许多部族部队的重要组成部分，但在全向机甲出现后逐渐被降为二线地位，即便如此，对许多防御单位而言它仍至关重要。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Designed for medium and short range combat, the Bane 2 trades out the Ultra Autocannon/2s for four Ultra Autocannon/10s. Fourteen tons of ammunition allow the Bane 2 to stay in the fight for a long time. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Bane 2 专为中近距离作战而设计，它把 Ultra 自动炮/2 换成了四门 Ultra 自动炮/10。十四吨弹药让 Bane 2 能在战斗中坚持很长时间。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Designed for medium and short range combat, the Bane 2 trades out the Ultra Autocannon/2s for four Ultra Autocannon/10s. Fourteen tons of ammunition allow the Bane 2 to stay in the fight for a long time.
column2: 作为中近距离战斗设计，灾星2以四门超级自动炮/10取代超级自动炮/2。十四吨弹药让灾星2能长时间留在战斗中。ZH

column1: Designed for fire support, the Bane 3 is a radical rework of the Bane. Eight LRM-15 provide the bulk of the designs fire, with sixteen tons of ammunition supplying the launchers. A Streak SRM-4 provides limited close support. Nineteen double heat sinks are up to the task of keeping the design cool. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 灾星3为火力支援而设计，是对灾星的激进重做。八具LRM-15构成该设计火力的大部分，十六吨弹药为这些发射器供弹；一具连发SRM-4提供有限的近距支援。十九个双散热器足以让该设计保持凉爽。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Designed for fire support, the Bane 3 is a radical rework of the Bane. Eight LRM-15 provide the bulk of the designs fire, with sixteen tons of ammunition supplying the launchers. A Streak SRM-4 provides limited close support. Nineteen double heat sinks are up to the task of keeping the design cool.
column2: 为火力支援而设计，灾祸3是对灾祸的一次彻底重制。八具LRM-15提供该设计的大部分火力，十六吨弹药供应这些发射器。一具连发SRM-4提供有限的近距离支援。十九具双重散热器足以让该设计保持凉爽。ZH

column1: An unusual variant of the Bane acting as a missile boat rather the usual long range direct attack weapons. A total of eight LRM-15 launchers can fire 120 missiles in each volley, enough to penetrate even the most powerful AMS defenses. Four Machine Guns acts as close range defense against any infantry or squads trying to engage the 'Mech directly. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Bane 的一个不寻常变型，它不承担惯常的远程直射角色，而是充当导弹平台。八具 LRM-15 发射器每轮齐射可发射 120 枚导弹，足以突破即便最强大的 AMS 防御。四挺机枪则负责近距离自卫，应对任何试图直接攻击该机甲的步兵或小队。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: This modified Bane 1 is configured for one thing only: rattling a 'Mech's armor so hard that things start breaking on the inside. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这台改装灾星1只为唯一一个目的而配置：把机甲的装甲震得内部零件都开始散架。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: This modified Bane 1 is configured for one thing only: rattling a 'Mech's armor so hard that things start breaking on the inside.
column2: 这台经过改装的灾祸1只为一件事配置：把机甲装甲震得如此厉害，以致内部开始崩坏。ZH

column1: An unusual variant of the Bane acting as a close range missile boat rather the usual long range direct attack weapons. A total of twelve SRM-6 launchers can fire 72 SRM missiles in each volley, a formidable attack that is able to cripple all but the most heavily armored 'Mechs. Four Heavy Machine Guns acts as close range defense against any infantry or squads trying to engage the 'Mech directly. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是 Bane 的一款不寻常变型，它不再充当常规的远程直射火力平台，而是担任短程火箭艇。十二具 SRM-6 发射器每轮齐射可发射 72 枚 SRM 导弹，这种可怕的攻击足以重创除装甲最厚重者之外的所有机甲。四挺重型机枪则提供近程防御，对付任何试图直接接战的步兵或小队。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: A heavily re-designed and improved variant, the -1DM is based on an Endo Steel skeleton and powered by a 380 XL engine, but trades battlefield longevity for an expanded weapons loadout and a brand new Targeting Computer. The primary guns are a pair of ER PPC and a RAC-5. Finally, the -1DM carries an LRM-10 Long Range Missile rack supplied with a single ton of ammo. Protecting the 'Mech is a full sixteen and a half tons of standard armor, and sixteen Double Heat Sinks helps cool it all down. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: -1DM 是一款经过大幅重新设计并改进的变型，以钢内骨结构为基础，搭载一台 380 XL 引擎，但以牺牲战场续航能力为代价，换来了扩充的武器配置和一台全新的瞄准计算机。主要火力为一对增程粒子加农炮和一门 RAC-5。最后，-1DM 还携带一具 LRM-10 远程导弹发射架，配一吨弹药。保护机甲的是整整十六吨半的标准装甲，而十六个双散热器则帮助它整体降温。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: This is really a huge difference to the base -3E and its constant heat woes. The combination of the PPCs, with their signature long reach and solid damage, and the RAC-5, with its respectable range, massive damage potential and a decent three-ton supply of ammunition, makes for a powerful strike. The LRM10 launcher only has ammunition for two minutes worth of missile fire, but this is acceptable in light of the added Targeting Computer. There's even enough cooling to ensure this variant need never suffer from debilitating heat buildup of its cousins - the pilot can fire both ER PPCs while at a dead run and remain cool in the cockpit.
column2: 与基础-3E及其持续的热量困扰相比，这真是天差地别。PPC那招牌的远程触及与扎实伤害，加上RAC-5可观的射程、巨大的伤害潜力和充足的三吨弹药供给，组合成一次强力打击。LRM10发射器只够打两分钟的导弹，但考虑到加装的瞄准计算机，这是可以接受的。散热甚至足以确保这一改型永不会像它的表亲那样受制于令人衰弱的积热——机师可以一边全力奔跑一边发射两门增程PPC，驾驶舱里仍然凉爽。ZH

column1: Exclusive to Noisiel and serving as one of the 'Queens' in the Noisiel Summer Games' famed 'BattleChess' matches, the low technology BNC-3EA trades the standard BNC-3E's PPC for a Large Laser, saving weight to add a single rear-facing Small Laser to each side torso and forward facing Medium Laser in the center torso. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: BNC-3EA为努瓦西尔所独有，是努瓦西尔夏季运动会著名“战棋”比赛中的“女王”之一。这款低技术机甲以一门大型激光取代标准BNC-3E的粒子加农炮，省下的重量用于在两侧躯干各加一门后向小型激光，并在中央躯干加装一门前向中型激光。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.15

column1: An utterly useless variant, why would you ruin the -3E to produce this?
column2: 一个完全没用的改型，你干嘛要毁掉-3E来造这个？ZH

column1: A battlefield refit of the -3E, the -3ER replaces the PPC and head-mounted small laser with eight Medium Lasers mounted in the Right Torso. The 'Mech also carries a C3 slave computer and CASE for the AC/5 ammunition. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: -3ER 是 -3E 的战地改装型，它将粒子加农炮和头部安装的小型激光替换为八门安装在右躯干的中型激光。该机甲还携带一台 C3 从属计算机，并为 AC/5 弹药配备了 CASE。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.17

column1: I just can't see this work at all, it must be hotter than the deepest parts of Hell inside that cockpit when all the weapons fire.
column2: 我完全看不出这怎么行得通，所有武器一起开火时，驾驶舱里肯定比地狱最深处还热。ZH

column1: A customized BNC-3S geared toward close combat. The PPCs are removed in favor of a left arm Hatchet and a right arm Large Laser. Also, the SRM-6 is swapped for an LRM-10. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: 这是面向近距离战斗定制的 BNC-3S。粒子加农炮被拆除，换成左臂的一把战斧和右臂的一门大型激光。此外，SRM-6 也被换成 LRM-10。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.17

column1: So, if this one catches you in melee range it will hurt. A lot. Other than that it is just a weaker -3S.
column2: 所以，如果这一个在近战距离抓到你，那会很痛。非常痛。除此之外它只是一台更弱的-3S。ZH

column1: A refit for the -3S, replacing two of the Medium Lasers with an Armored Cowl and C3 slave unit for better battlefield performance. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 这是-3S的改装，以装甲机罩和C3从机取代其中两门中型激光，以获得更好的战场表现。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: Nothing special really, just another example of taking what you have available when you need the 'Mech back in the fight as soon as possible.
column2: 其实没什么特别的，不过是又一个例子——当你需要尽快让机甲重回战斗时，手头有什么就用什么。ZH

column1: An attempted upgrade of the -3S that never was produced beyond a very low number initial run, making this variant quite rare to see. Amongst 'Mech collectors the -4S is almost seen as a white whale, many have attempted to acquire one from not-so-legal sources only to be disappointed to find it a false refit instead of an actual production unit. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: -3S 的一次升级尝试，除极少量初始批次外从未量产，因此这一变型相当罕见。在机甲收藏者眼中，-4S 几乎如同白鲸一般；许多人试图通过不太合法的渠道弄到一台，结果却失望地发现那不过是假的改装货，而非真正的量产机型。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.17

column1: It's an assault 'Mech with a LB 10-X AC, six medium Pulse Lasers and two ER PPC, what else is there to say? Except that it gets very, very hot.
column2: 这是一台突击机甲，装一门LB 10-X自动炮、六门中型脉冲激光和两门增程粒子加农炮，还能说什么？只补充一点：它会变得非常非常热。ZH

column1: Based on a heavily modified -5S, this custom refit replaces the Lasers with an ER PPC and two medium Pulse Lasers, and the SRM-6 launcher with a Streak counterpart. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 这套定制改装以经过大幅改造的 -5S 为基础，把激光换成了一门增程粒子加农炮和两门中型脉冲激光，并把 SRM-6 发射器换成了连发型号。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部

column1: Supposedly created by a mercenary company to improve their Banshee BNC-5S, a few other companies have applied the same refit to their 'Mechs.
column2: 据说是一家雇佣兵公司为了改进他们的女妖BNC-5S而创的，另有几家公司也对自家机甲采用了同样的改装。ZH

column1: A customized BNC-5S that sacrifices weaponry for mobility. An ER PPC and heat sink are removed to add four jump jets. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
column2: 一台为追求机动性而牺牲武器的定制 BNC-5S。拆下一门 ER PPC 和一个散热器，换来四个跳跃推进器。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.19

column1: A customized BNC-5S that sacrifices weaponry for mobility. An ER PPC and heat sink are removed to add four jump jets.
column2: 这是定制版BNC-5S，以武器换取机动性：拆掉一门增程粒子加农炮和一个散热器，加装四具跳跃推进器。ZH

column1: The Banshee HK mounts two Hydraulic Fists and is outfitted with a selection of newly developed defensive technologies. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
column2: Banshee HK 搭载两个液压拳，并配备了一系列新研发的防御技术。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.19

column1: The Banshee HK mounts two Hydraulic Fists and is outfitted with a selection of newly developed defensive technologies.
column2: 女妖HK装有两具液压拳，并配备了一系列新研发的防御技术。ZH

column1: The unique “La Malinche” variant is a powerful war machine, and with the Aztec-inspired art of old Terra, she is both as beautiful, as she is deadly. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
column2: 独一无二的“La Malinche”变型是一台强大的战争机器；她饰有旧地球阿兹特克风格的艺术纹饰，既美丽动人，又致命无比。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.19

column1: The unique “La Malinche” variant is a powerful war machine, and with the Aztec-inspired art of old Terra, she is both as beautiful, as she is deadly.
column2: 独特的"拉马林切"改型是一台强力战争机器，配上古地球阿兹特克风格的涂装，她既美丽又致命。ZH

column1: Classified Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
column2: 机密 特质：战斗铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.11

column1: The -1T carries two ER Large Lasers that allow the Barghest to hit a target at up to five hundred and seventy meters. For medium to close range combat, the 'Mech carries a powerful LB-X Autocannon/20 that is capable of firing both standard ammunition and cluster rounds that act like 'Mech-sized shotgun shells. The 'Mech's simplicity is also a weakness, as the Barghest has only the two ER Large Lasers if the autocannon falls silent from a lack of ammunition or a jam. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: -1T 搭载两门增程大型激光，使 Barghest 能够击中远达五百七十米外的目标。在中近距离作战中，该机甲配备一门威力强大的 LB-X 自动炮/20，既能发射标准弹药，也能发射霰弹弹，后者如同机甲大小的霰弹枪弹药。机甲设计的简洁同时也是弱点：一旦自动炮因弹药耗尽或卡壳而哑火，Barghest 就只剩下那两门增程大型激光了。特性：改进散热套件 - 激光 投放费用倍率：1.1

column1: Katherine Steiner-Davion decided during her reign over the Lyran Alliance that she wanted a four legged BattleMech that would evoke fear in its enemies in a similar vein to the classic Atlas and Banshee designs. To do this, the Barghest is built on an Earthwerk GRF Quad chassis that supports a Magna 350 XL engine that saves weight and allows the 'Mech to carry a heavy weapons payload. The Barghest is protected by thirteen tons of Durallex Heavy armor that protects it from all but the heaviest enemy fire. To handle the 'Mech's heat buildup from its weapons, the Barghest has ten double heat sinks.
column2: 凯瑟琳·斯坦纳-戴维安在统治莱兰联盟期间决定，她要一台四足战斗机甲，能像经典的 Atlas 和 Banshee 那样令敌人闻风丧胆。为此，Barghest 以 Earthwerk GRF 四足底盘为基础，搭载一台 Magna 350 XL 引擎，既减轻了重量，又让机甲能够携带沉重的武器负载。Barghest 由十三吨 Durallex 重型装甲保护，除最猛烈的敌方火力外均可抵挡。为应对武器产生的热量积聚，Barghest 配备了十个双散热器。ZH

column1: The 2T removes the weapons of the 1T model and replaces them with a single ER PPC and an Ultra Autocannon/20. The ultra autocannon is capable of firing at twice the rate as a standard autocannon, giving the 2T an incredible amount of short range firepower. The Barghest has also gained an additional ton of armor protection, making the 'Mech even harder to take down on the battlefield. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 2T拆掉1T型号的武器，换成一门增程粒子加农炮和一门超级自动炮/20。超级自动炮的射速可达标准自动炮的两倍，赋予2T惊人的近程火力。巴尔杰斯特还额外获得一吨装甲防护，使它在战场上更难被击倒。特性：改进冷却套 - 激光 投放费用倍率：1.1

column1: The PFT variant of the Barghest utilizes the power of cheese. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
column2: 犬妖的PFT变型动用了奶酪之力。特性：改进冷却套件（激光） 投放费用倍率：1.06

column1: Hey boss, do you believe in the <color=#f5b247>power of cheese</color>?
column2: 嘿老板，你相信<color=#f5b247>奶酪之力</color>吗？ZH

column1: The Battle Cobra makes use of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous technologies, but uses a standard Fusion Engine for increased durability. The A variant excels at close range with a variety of smaller pulse lasers. It wields four Medium Pulse Lasers and six Small Pulse Lasers. This armament forces unarmored infantry to be especially wary. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 战斗眼镜蛇利用钢内骨结构与铁纤维技术，但采用标准聚变引擎以提高耐久性。A变型以多种较小的脉冲激光在近距表现出色，装备四门中型脉冲激光和六门小型脉冲激光。这套武器迫使无装甲步兵格外警惕。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Battle Cobra
column2: 战斗眼镜蛇

column1: The Battle Cobra was already in the prototype stages when Clan Steel Viper introduced their first OmniMech, the Crossbow. The Battle Cobra prototypes were quickly redesigned to allow similar arm-mounted Omni-Pods, debuting only a few years later. Like the Crossbow, the Battle Cobra does not mount fixed jump jets and cannot mount them in their arms - therefore, early Battle Cobras would not be jump-capable.
column2: 战斗眼镜蛇在钢蝰氏族推出其首款全能机甲"弩炮"时已处于原型阶段。战斗眼镜蛇的原型机被迅速重新设计以兼容类似的臂载全能吊舱，仅几年后便首次亮相。与弩炮一样，战斗眼镜蛇不装固定跳跃推进器，也无法在臂部安装——因此早期战斗眼镜蛇不具备跳跃能力。ZH

column1: The Battle Cobra makes use of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous technologies, but uses a standard Fusion Engine for increased durability. This B loadout is popular with the Clan Blood Spirit warriors who use a Battle Cobra. It mounts twin ER PPCs and Small Pulse Lasers. However, it lacks additional heat sinks to cope with the heat generated by the cannons. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 战斗眼镜蛇利用钢内骨结构与铁纤维技术，但采用标准聚变引擎以提高耐久性。这一B载荷在使用战斗眼镜蛇的血灵部族战士中颇受欢迎：它装双联增程粒子加农炮和几门小型脉冲激光，但缺少额外散热器来应对这些炮产生的热量。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Battle Cobra makes use of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous technologies, but uses a standard Fusion Engine for increased durability. A mid-range Jump Jet equipped brawler, the F config mounts an Ultra AC/5 and single ton of reloads in its right arm supported by a trio of ER Medium Lasers in its left. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 战眼镜蛇（Battle Cobra）采用了钢内骨结构与铁纤维技术，但使用标准聚变引擎以提升耐用性。作为一台装备跳跃推进器的中距离混战机甲，F 配置在右臂装有一门超速 AC/5 及一吨备用弹药，并以左臂的三门增程中型激光提供支援。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Battle Cobra makes use of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous technologies, but uses a standard Fusion Engine for increased durability. Instead of the pulse lasers common to the other variants, the H configuration mounts a pair each of ER Large Lasers and Heavy Medium Lasers. Four additional double heat sinks help to keep heat levels manageable. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Battle Cobra 采用了钢内骨结构与铁纤维技术，但使用标准聚变引擎以提升耐用性。H 配置没有采用其他变型常见的脉冲激光，而是各装一对大型增程激光和重型中型激光。四具额外的双散热器有助于将热量控制在可管理的范围内。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Battle Cobra makes use of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous technologies, but uses a standard Fusion Engine for increased durability. The primary configuration uses a pair of Large Pulse Lasers and Small Pulse Lasers. With these, it is capable of highly accurate fire that is effective against armored and unarmored targets alike. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 战斗眼镜蛇利用钢内骨结构与铁纤维技术，但采用标准聚变引擎以提高耐久性。主配置使用一对大型脉冲激光和几门小型脉冲激光，凭借这些能实现高精度射击，对装甲与非装甲目标同样有效。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The first native Battlemech to be built by the FedSuns, the 70 ton Battleaxe debuted in 2459. Based off of the technology used in the Mackie, the Battleaxe would be constantly updated with new technology, before being retired after the Reunification War when newer designs such as the Hammerhands and Warhammer entered service. The Battleaxe BKX-1X is the original prototype model. Built around a 255-rated Fusion Core, the BKX-1X is armed with a pair of Large Lasers and a pair of LRM-5’s. An SRM-6 and a pair of Machine Guns give the Mech some close range firepower. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.88 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Battleaxe 是联邦太阳国建造的第一款本土战斗机甲，70 吨的它于 2459 年首次亮相。它以 Mackie 所用的技术为基础，此后不断以新技术进行更新，直到统一战争结束后，Hammerhands 和 Warhammer 等更新的设计服役，它才退出现役。Battleaxe BKX-1X 是最初的原型型号，以 255 级聚变核心为核心，装备两门大型激光和两具 LRM-5。一具 SRM-6 和两挺机枪为机甲提供了一定的近距离火力。特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：0.88 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

column1: The first native Battlemech to be built by the FedSuns, the 70 ton Battleaxe debuted in 2459. Based off of the technology used in the Mackie, the Battleaxe would be constantly updated with new technology, before being retired after the Reunification War when newer designs such as the Hammerhands and Warhammer entered service. The Battleaxe BKX-1X is the original prototype model. Built around a 255-rated Fusion Core, the BKX-1X is armed with a pair of Large Lasers and a pair of LRM-5’s. An SRM-6 and a pair of Machine Guns give the Mech some close range firepower.
column2: 作为联邦太阳建造的第一种本土战斗机甲，70吨的战斧于2459年首次亮相。它基于麦基所用的技术，此后不断以新技术更新，直到统一战争结束后、锤手与重锤等更新的设计服役才退役。战斧BKX-1X是最初的原型型号。BKX-1X围绕一具255级聚变核心建造，武装为两门大型激光器和两具LRM-5。一具SRM-6和两挺机枪赋予该机甲一定的近距离火力。ZH

column1: Classified Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 机密 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

column1: This command version of the BattleMaster mounts a Command Console and is equipped with 20 Heat Sinks. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
column2: 这款 BattleMaster 的指挥型安装了指挥控制台，并配备 20 个散热器。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.13

column1: Versatile and powerful, the BattleMaster is one of the best known 'Mechs in existence. Originally designed to be the largest and most powerful 'Mech for the Star League armies in the 27th century, the sheer size of the BattleMaster, combined with the cost and resources needed to build one, meant the 'Mech can only be manufactured on a few planets. Still, those lucky enough to pilot a BattleMaster can attest to some of the stories surrounding the 'Mech. With good reliability, firepower and armoring, the BattleMaster is equally adept anchoring an assault lance or serving as a command vehicle.
column2: 多才多艺且强大，战将是现存最知名的机甲之一。它最初在二十七世纪被设计为星盟军队中最大最强的机甲，但战将庞大的体积加上建造一艘所需的成本与资源，意味着它只能在少数星球上制造。尽管如此，有幸驾驶战将的人都能印证围绕这台机甲的种种传说。凭借良好的可靠性、火力与装甲，战将既能稳固地充当突击小队的核心，也能胜任指挥车辆。ZH

column1: A Starleague Royals version of the BLR-1C, exchanging the Command Console for a Dual Cockpit, removing the Machine Guns in favor of an Anti-Missile System and upgrading the PPC to an Extended Range version. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: BLR-1C 的星际联盟皇家版本，把指挥控制台换成双人驾驶舱，以反导弹系统取代机枪，并将粒子加农炮升级为增程型号。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.17

column1: Produced by the Federated Suns during the Star League era, this variant drops the machine guns and ammunition while all the forward firing medium lasers are replaced by Medium Pulse Lasers. Sixteen double heat sinks keep the 'Mech cool. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: 该变型由联邦太阳国在星际联盟时代生产，它拆除了机枪与弹药，所有前射的中型激光则替换为中型脉冲激光。十六具双散热器为机甲保持低温。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.15

column1: This Star League era variant removes two of the forward-facing medium lasers, both machine guns, the SRM launcher and their ammunition. In place of the SRM launcher are three Streak SRM-2 launchers with a single ton of ammunition with an extra PPC mounted in the left arm. Sixteen double heat sinks keep the 'Mech cool, and the 'Mech's armor is upgraded to Ferro-Fibrous armor. An extra half ton of armor is also installed. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: 这款星际联盟时代的变型拆除了两门朝前的中型激光、两挺机枪、SRM 发射器及其弹药。取而代之的是三部连发 SRM-2 发射器（配一吨弹药），并在左臂加装了一门额外的粒子加农炮。十六个双散热器为机甲提供冷却，其装甲也升级为铁纤维装甲，此外还额外安装了半吨装甲。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.17

column1: This Star League era variant removes two of the forward-facing medium lasers, both machine guns, the SRM launcher and their ammunition. In place of the SRM launcher are three Streak SRM-2 launchers with a single ton of ammunition with an extra PPC mounted in the left arm. Sixteen double heat sinks keep the 'Mech cool, and the 'Mech's armor is upgraded to Ferro-Fibrous armor. An extra half ton of armor is also installed.
column2: 这一星盟时代改型拆掉两门朝前的中型激光器、两挺机枪、SRM发射器及其弹药。SRM发射器的位置换成三具连发SRM-2发射器配一吨弹药，左臂另加装一门PPC。十六具双重散热器让该机甲保持凉爽，机甲装甲升级为铁纤装甲。还额外加装了半吨装甲。ZH

column1: This Star League era variant removes two of the forward medium lasers, both machine guns, the SRM launcher and their ammunition. In place of the SRM launcher are three Streak SRM-2 launchers with a single ton of ammunition with an extra PPC mounted in the left arm. Sixteen double heat sinks keep the 'Mech cool, and the 'Mech's armor is upgraded to ferro-fibrous armor. An extra half ton of armor is also installed. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: 这一星际联盟时代的变型拆除了两门前射中型激光、两挺机枪、SRM 发射器及其弹药。取而代之的是三组连发 SRM-2 发射器与一吨弹药，并在左臂加装一门粒子加农炮。十六具双散热器为机甲保持低温，同时机甲装甲升级为铁纤维装甲，还额外加装了半吨装甲。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.17

column1: The BLR-1GR is an attempt to restore old disused or damage BattleMaster chassis using surplus parts. Mainly found in the less controlled parts of the Periphery, the variant does pack an unexpected amount of weapons and even a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: BLR-1GR是试图用剩余零件修复废旧或受损BattleMaster底盘的尝试。该变型主要见于外围地区管控较弱的区域，却搭载了出人意料的武器数量，甚至还有一台C3从属单元。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.15

column1: Originating as the heavily customized and personal 'Mech of General Gregor Tucker, the 1GT become a rare but favoured favourite of the Free Rasalhague Republic's elite MechWarriors. The weapons layout has been reworked almost from scratch, moving the medium Lasers to the arms and two PPC in the side torsos. A single SRM-4 launcher in the center torso can provide some unexpected close range damage. The 'Mech further utilizes both Ferro-Fibrous armor and an XL Engine, allowing increased armor and a total of 18 double heat sinks. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: 1GT最初是格雷戈尔·塔克将军重度定制化的私人机甲，后来成为自由拉沙尔哈格共和国精英机甲战士中稀有却受青睐的宠儿。武器布局几乎从头重做：中型激光移到手臂，两侧躯干装两门粒子加农炮；中央躯干一具单独的SRM-4发射器可提供出人意料的近程伤害。该机甲还同时采用铁纤维装甲与一台XL引擎，得以增加装甲并带总共18个双散热器。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.15

column1: The BLR-1HD is named after First Prince Hanse Davion, and created as a thank you for funding the successful development project of the Medium Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: BLR-1HD以第一王子汉斯·戴维恩命名，是作为对其资助中型脉冲激光研发项目成功的致谢而打造。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.15

column1: A heavily upgraded version of the BLR-1G, using a downgraded engine size to allow the addition of both Jump Jets and an extra PPC. The variant is even able to increase the armor to a total of 16.5 tons, the chassis practical limit. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
column2: 这是 BLR-1G 的大幅升级版本，通过缩小引擎尺寸，为同时加装跳跃推进器和一门额外的粒子加农炮创造了条件。该变型甚至能将装甲总量提升至 16.5 吨，达到底盘的实际上限。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.13

column1: A Mercenary conversion of the BattleMaster, using mostly Clan grade equipment. The weapons loadout consists of six ER Medium Lasers, one ER PPC and one Streak SRM-6 launcher. A C3 Slave provides increased combat capabilities. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
column2: 这是雇佣兵对战法师的改装，大多使用部族级装备。武器包括六门增程中型激光、一门增程粒子加农炮和一具连发SRM-6发射器。一台C3从机提升了作战能力。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.19

column1: This melee-focused BattleMaster mounts arm-mounted large laser in place of the PPC, adding a small laser beside the classic twin medium lasers in each side torso along with a left shoulder–mounted SRM-4, the saved weight allowing it to carry an assault claymore in its left hand. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
column2: 这款偏重近战的战法师以一门臂载大型激光取代粒子加农炮，并在每侧躯干经典的双联中型激光旁各加一门小型激光，左肩另装一具SRM-4；省下的重量让它左手能握一把突击克莱莫大剑。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.13

column1: This version of the BattleMaster comes with Angel ECM and a Bloodhound Active Probe. A single machine gun is located in each arm, with an additional large laser mounted in the right arm, the right torso contains the electronic warfare equipment along with two medium lasers, and two medium lasers along with a SRM-4 sit in the left torso. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: 这一版战斗大师装备天使电子对抗套件与血犬主动探测器。每只手臂各装有一挺机枪，右臂另有一具大型激光；右躯干容纳电子战设备与两具中型激光；左躯干则有两具中型激光和一具SRM-4。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.15

column1: A Prototype that was modified For Hanse Davions personal use. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: 一台为汉斯·戴维昂个人使用而改装的原型机。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.17

column1: A Prototype that was modified For Hans Davions personal use.  .
column2: 这是一款为汉斯·达维昂私人使用而改装的原型。ZH

column1: Dating back from 2925, this designated command vehicle sported a Command Console and a Beagle Active Probe wired into the targeting system. Instead of the machine guns it carries an anti-missile system installed in the left arm; the rearward firing lasers are retained. Like with the BLR-1C, House Kurita received at least one BLR-2C from ComStar in full working condition and used it to good effect in the War of 3039. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: 这种被指定为指挥车辆的型号可追溯至 2925 年，配有指挥控制台以及一台接入瞄准系统的比格犬主动探测器。它以安装在左臂的反导弹系统取代了机枪，向后射击的激光则予以保留。与 BLR-1C 一样，栗田家族（House Kurita）从通讯之星手中至少获得了一台处于完全可用状态的 BLR-2C，并在 3039 年战争中取得了良好战果。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.15

column1: An variant of the BLR-2C used by the SLDF Royal Divisions. The design replaces the Command Console with the smaller Dual Cockpit, using the saved weight to add two Small Lasers and extra external armoring. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: 这是SLDF皇家师使用的BLR-2C变型。它把指挥控制台换成更小的双人驾驶舱，并用省下的重量加装两门小型激光和额外外部装甲。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.17

column1: A command version of the Battle Master, mounting a Dual Cockpit allowing the battlefield Commander to focus on commanding. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: 战斗大师的指挥型号，装有双人驾驶舱，让战场指挥官能够专注于指挥。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.15

column1: Used by Colonel Wayne Rogers of Waco Rangers during the Coventry campaign, this BattleMaster drops five heat sinks, the single machine gun, and the SRM-6 of a BLR-3M and replaces them with seven Streak SRM-2 launchers. The loss of some armor is compensated for by using ferro-fibrous armor instead. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: 在考文垂战役期间由韦科游骑兵的韦恩·罗杰斯上校使用，这台战斗大师拆除了五台散热器、那挺机枪以及BLR-3M的SRM-6，并换装七具连发SRM-2发射器。装甲上的一些损失则通过改用铁纤维装甲得到补偿。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.17

column1: The BattleMaster 3NC (C) is a strange clan rebuild of the chassis. Although the design lowers the chassis tonnage to only 75 ton, using all Clan technology weapons allows the 'Mech to mount an impressive all energy loadout. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: BattleMaster 3NC (C) 是对该底盘一次奇特的部族重建。尽管设计将底盘吨位降至仅75吨，但采用全部族科技武器后，这台机甲得以搭载令人印象深刻的纯能量武装。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.15

column1: Another upgrade of the BattleMaster using lost technology from the Star League, the 3S was introduced in 3050 by Red Devil Industries for the Federated Commonwealth. Still using standard heat sinks it actually removes a half-ton of armor along with the PPC and one of the machine guns, although it still retains the SRM-6. These changes along with the inclusion of an 340 XL engine make room for a LRM-20 launcher as its primary weapon backed up by six Medium Pulse Lasers for fighting close in, with two of the lasers being rear facing. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: 3S是战斗大师借助星际联盟失落科技进行的又一次升级，由红魔工业于3050年为联邦共和国推出。它仍使用标准散热器，实际上还拆掉了半吨装甲、粒子加农炮与一挺机枪，但仍保留SRM-6。这些改动，再加上一具340 XL引擎，为作为主武器的LRM-20发射器腾出了空间，另有六门中型脉冲激光用于近距离作战，其中两门朝后。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.15

column1: The -3W is a full Clan conversion of the Battlemaster that sometimes can be spotted on the battlefield for Clan forces close the Inner Sphere. Mounting an impressive combined loadout of two ER PPC, a Large Pulse Laser, four Medium Pulse Lasers and three ER Medium Lasers - all of the Clan variety - means it can deliver a lot of damage if not dealt with, but it does suffer from heat management limiting factors like many other Clan designs. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
column2: -3W是Battlemaster的完全部族化改造型，偶尔会出现在内层星域附近部族部队的战场上。它拥有令人瞩目的组合武器配置——两门增程粒子加农炮、一门大型脉冲激光、四门中型脉冲激光和三门增程中型激光，全部为部族型号——若放任不管，它就能造成巨大伤害，但与许多部族设计一样，它也受制于散热管理的瓶颈。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.19

column1: The 5R is a modernization of the more classic BattleMasters. Besides the LB 10-X autocannon mounted in the right arm as the main weapon, the variant replaces all of the Medium Lasers with Pulse variants and the PPC with an ER Large Laser. Four jump jets makes the -5M one of the few models that can jump. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: 5R是对较经典战法师的现代化改造。除右臂安装的LB 10-X自动炮作为主武器外，该变型把所有中型激光换成脉冲版本，并把粒子加农炮换成增程大型激光。四具跳跃推进器使-5M成为少数能跳跃的型号之一。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.15

column1: No real information exists on who created the design of this variant and why the unusual name. One theory is that it's a dig at the Clans use of IIC variants, attempting to one-up them. The 'Mech itself caries a combination of Pulse Lasers and ER PPC, combined with a single SRM-6 launcher with an attached Artemis IV Fire Control System. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: 关于这一变型由谁设计、为何取了这样一个古怪的名字，并没有确切的资料。一种说法是，这是对部族滥用IIC变型的做法进行讥讽，试图压他们一头。这台机甲本身结合了脉冲激光与增程粒子加农炮，并配有一具附带阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统的SRM-6发射器。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.15

column1: By replacing the BattleMaster's 350 fusion engine with a 255 engine, the BLR-TD is slightly slower but allow for 14 more tons of weapons. A second PPC was added as well as the additional heat sink kits to fire it. To compensate for the slower speed, Jump Jets where placed in the Legs and Center Torso. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
column2: BLR-TD 将 BattleMaster 的 350 聚变引擎换成 255 引擎，速度因此略有下降，却腾出了额外 14 吨用于武器。它加装了一门粒子加农炮，以及为发射它所需的额外散热套件。为弥补速度的降低，腿部与中央躯干内装设了跳跃推进器。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.13

column1: Classified Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 机密 特质：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: A Clan IIC variant, created from the Battlemasters the SLDF took with them during the exodus from the Inner Sphere - but upsized to 90 ton. To fit the two ER PPC, six ER Medium Lasers and two Streak SRM-6 launchers the variant uses an Endo Steel chassis and an XL engine. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2
column2: 这是一款部族IIC变型，由星际联盟防卫军在大逃亡期间带离内层星域的战斗大师改造而来，但体型放大到了90吨。为容纳两门增程粒子加农炮、六具增程中型激光和两具连发SRM-6发射器，该变型采用钢内骨结构底盘和XL引擎。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.2

column2: 战将 IIC

column1: Unique among Wolfs Dragoon's, this is apparently a downgraded Stone Rhino equipped with locally made Inner Sphere technology. The sole known example was lost at the battle of Misery and the Dragoon's have been unusually reticent about the mech or it's origins, refusing to confirm where the mech came from or whether they posses anymore. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这台机甲在狼之龙骑兵中独一无二，显然是一台降级版石犀牛，换装了本地制造的内层星域技术。唯一已知的样机在苦难星之战中损失，而龙骑兵对这台机甲及其来历异常缄口，既不愿确认它的出处，也不肯透露是否还拥有更多。<特性：扰敌 <投放费用倍率：1.18 <手臂驱动器限制：左臂下段，右臂下段

column1: Unique among Wolfs Dragoon's, this is apparently a downgraded Stone Rhino equipped with locally made Inner Sphere technology. The sole known example was lost at the battle of Misery and the Dragoon's have been unusually reticent about the mech or it's origins, refusing to confirm where the mech came from or whether they posses anymore.
column2: 在狼族龙骑兵中独一无二，这显然是一台降级版石犀牛，装备着本地制造的内天体技术。已知的唯一一台在苦难战役中损失，而龙骑兵对这台机甲或其来源异常缄默，拒绝确认它从何而来、或他们是否还有更多。ZH

column1: Debuting soon after the Mackie, the Bellerophon was Defiance Industries attempt at creating their own Battlemech. Basing the prototype on an earlier generation Mackie prototype, the project would prove to be fundamentally flawed. While 20% faster than the Mackie, the Bellerophon BEL-1X only mounted 60% of the armor carried by the Mackie. Even worse, the Mech suffered from balance issues stemming from the early generation gyroscope and the concentration of firepower on the right of the Mech. Despite an attempt to market the Mech to the Terran Hegemony, the project was eventually abandoned and the fate of the original prototypes is unknown. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.86 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Upper
column2: Bellerophon 在 Mackie 问世后不久便首次登场，是 Defiance Industries 打造自家战斗机甲的尝试。该项目以前一代 Mackie 原型机为基础，最终被证明存在根本性缺陷。虽然 Bellerophon BEL-1X 比 Mackie 快 20%，但其装甲量仅为 Mackie 的 60%。更糟的是，由于采用早期型号的陀螺仪，且火力集中在机甲右侧，这款机甲存在平衡性问题。尽管曾试图向地球霸权推销，该项目最终还是被放弃，原型机的下落至今不明。特性：驾驶舱护罩 投放费用倍率：0.86 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右上

column1: Debuting soon after the Mackie, the Bellerophon was Defiance Industries attempt at creating their own Battlemech. Basing the prototype on an earlier generation Mackie prototype, the project would prove to be fundamentally flawed. While 20% faster than the Mackie, the Bellerophon BEL-1X only mounted 60% of the armor carried by the Mackie. Even worse, the Mech suffered from balance issues stemming from the early generation gyroscope and the concentration of firepower on the right of the Mech. Despite an attempt to market the Mech to the Terran Hegemony, the project was eventually abandoned and the fate of the original prototypes is unknown.
column2: 紧接麦克机之后亮相，贝勒罗丰是挑战工业打造自家战斗机甲的尝试。原型以更早一代的麦克机原型为基础，而这个项目最终被证明存在根本缺陷：虽然比麦克机快20%，贝勒罗丰BEL-1X却只装麦克机60%的装甲。更糟的是，该机甲受困于早期陀螺仪带来的平衡问题，以及火力集中在机体右侧。尽管曾试图把该机甲推销给地球霸权，项目最终被放弃，原始原型的下落无人知晓。ZH

column1: The primary weapon on the Beowulf is a highly accurate large pulse laser, supported by two ER medium lasers. To make it easier for the 'Mech to hunt down its targets, the Beowulf also mounts a Beagle active probe, and a TAG target designator allows the 'Mech to designate targets for artillery attacks. To save weight on the 'Mech and still allow for high speeds, the Beowulf is powered by a 270 XL engine that weighs half as much as a standard fusion engine. It also mounts MASC, enhancing its top speed of 129.6 km/h to allow it to keep up with most light 'Mechs. To traverse rough terrain, the Beowulf has six jump jets that allow it to jump up to 180 meters. For protection from enemy fire, the Beowulf carries eight and a half tons of ferro-fibrous armor. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: Beowulf 的主武器是一门精度极高的大型脉冲激光，辅以两门中型增程激光。为便于机甲追猎目标，Beowulf 还安装了 Beagle 主动探测器，而 TAG 目标指示器则让机甲能够为炮击指定目标。为了在减轻重量的同时仍保持高速度，Beowulf 由 270 XL 引擎驱动，其重量仅为标准聚变引擎的一半。它还装有 MASC，使其 129.6 km/h 的最高时速进一步提升，从而能跟上大多数轻型机甲。为穿越崎岖地形，Beowulf 配备六具跳跃推进器，最远可跳跃 180 米。为抵御敌方火力，Beowulf 携带八吨半铁纤维装甲。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.03

column1: The Beowulf medium BattleMech was designed to act as a replacement for Mongoose reconnaissance 'Mechs that ComStar lost access to when Terra fell to the Word of Blake. The Beowulf weighs almost twice as much as the 'Mech it replaces, allowing it to carry a heavier weapons payload and more armor.
column2: 贝奥武夫中型战斗机甲被设计用来取代猫鼬侦察机甲——当地球落入布莱克之词之手时，通讯之星失去了对它们的获取途径。贝奥武夫的重量几乎是它所取代机甲的两倍，因而能携带更重的武器载荷与更多装甲。ZH

column1: Designed to engage in close range brawls, the 100 ton Berserker debuted in 3056. A 400-rated XL Engine paired with MASC allows the BRZ-A3 to outrun almost any other heavy or assault grade Mech. An ER PPC and a pair of Large Pulse Lasers make up the Mech’s ranged armament while a colossal 10 ton Hatchet is lethal at close range. AMS and Guardian ECM keep the Mech safe as it closes in, while a head mounted Flamer adds to the Mechs intimidation factor. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 100 吨的 Berserker 专为近距离搏斗而生，于 3056 年首次登场。400 额定的 XL引擎搭配 MASC，使 BRZ-A3 几乎能跑赢任何其他重型或突击级机甲。机甲的中远距离武装由一门增程粒子加农炮与两门大型脉冲激光组成，而一把重达 10 吨的巨型战斧在近距离足以致命。机体逼近时，AMS 与 Guardian 电子对抗套件为其提供保护，头部安装的火焰喷射器则进一步增添了威慑力。特性：近战驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.18

column1: Designed to engage in close range brawls, the 100 ton Berserker debuted in 3056. A 400-rated XL Engine paired with MASC allows the BRZ-A3 to outrun almost any other heavy or assault grade Mech. An ER PPC and a pair of Large Pulse Lasers make up the Mech’s ranged armament while a colossal 10 ton Hatchet is lethal at close range. AMS and Guardian ECM keep the Mech safe as it closes in, while a head mounted Flamer adds to the Mechs intimidation factor.
column2: 为近距离混战而设计，100吨的狂战士于3056年首次亮相。一具400级XL引擎配以MASC，让BRZ-A3能跑赢几乎任何其他重型或突击级机甲。一门增程PPC和两门大型脉冲激光器构成该机甲的远程武装，而一把重达10吨的巨斧在近距离极为致命。AMS与守卫者ECM在它逼近时保护机甲，头部的火焰喷射器则增添了威慑感。ZH

column1: Designed to engage in close range brawls, the 100 ton Berserker debuted in 3056. A 400-rated XL Engine paired with MASC allows the BRZ-B3 to outrun almost any other heavy or assault grade Mech. An ER PPC and a pair of LRM-10’s make up the Mech’s ranged armament while a colossal 10 ton Hatchet is lethal at close range. AMS and Guardian ECM keep the Mech safe as it closes in, while a head mounted Flamer adds to the Mechs intimidation factor. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 作为一款为近身近战而设计的机甲，100吨的狂战士于3056年首次亮相。一台400额定XL引擎配MASC，使BRZ-B3能跑赢几乎任何其他重型或突击级机甲。一门增程粒子加农炮和两具LRM-10构成机甲的远程武装，而一把十吨重的巨型战斧在近距致命无比。反导弹系统与守护者电子对抗套件在它逼近时提供保护，头部一具火焰喷射器更增添了它的威慑力。特性：近战驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.18

A 400-rated XL Engine paired with MASC allows the BRZ-B3 to outrun almost any other heavy or assault grade Mech. An ER PPC and a pair of LRM-10’s make up the Mech’s ranged armament while a colossal 10 ton Hatchet is lethal at close range. AMS and Guardian ECM keep the Mech safe as it closes in, while a head mounted Flamer adds to the Mechs intimidation factor.
