column1: Engineers had clearly intended for the BSN-3K to engage its enemies at short to medium ranges. The primary weapon on the 'Mech is a MRM-20 launcher, backed up by a pair of ER Medium Lasers and two highly accurate Medium Pulse Lasers. While the 'Mech is vulnerable to long-range attacks, when engaged in close quarters the Bishamon is an extremely dangerous 'Mech to face. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 工程师们显然打算让BSN-3K在短到中距离上与敌人交战。该机甲的主武器是一具MRM-20发射器，辅以两门增程中型激光和两门高精度中型脉冲激光。虽然该机甲易受远程攻击压制，但在近距离交战中，毗沙门天是极为危险的对手。特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：1.03

column1: Heavy Scout Quad
column2: 重型火箭 Scout Quad

column1: The Bishamon is a quad BattleMech designed by Nimakachi Fusion Products Limited, which uses a mix of advanced construction techniques and advanced weapons systems to both save weight and make it as effective as possible on the battlefield. Officials had approached Nimakachi Fusion after the success of the Venom to build a larger design with newer technologies that had been introduced at the time. Nimakachi engineers originally intended for the Bishamon to have jump jets, however with a heavier weapons load the tradeoffs were enough to satisfy DCMS officials. Intended as a heavy scout, the Bishamon is built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a 315 XL engine that gives it a ground speed of 118.8 km/h. While the Bishamon's high ground speed makes it a hard target to hit, the 'Mech carries 10.5 tons of Nimakachi Type 3 armor that provides adequate protection for the 'Mech's size. The Bishamon also has an extremely stable frame due to its quadrupedal chassis, at the expense of space available for weapons and equipment.
column2: Bishamon 是由 Nimakachi Fusion Products Limited 设计的四足战斗机甲，它结合了先进的建造工艺与先进的武器系统，既节省重量，又尽可能提升战场效能。在 Venom 取得成功后，官方曾找上 Nimakachi Fusion，希望以当时新推出的技术打造一款更大的设计。Nimakachi 的工程师原本打算为 Bishamon 配备跳跃推进器，但由于武器载荷更重，权衡取舍的结果足以让 DCMS 官员满意。Bishamon 定位为重型侦察机甲，采用轻量化的钢内骨结构底盘，由一台 315 XL 引擎驱动，地面速度可达 118.8 km/h。Bishamon 的高地面速度使其成为难以命中的目标，同时该机甲披挂 10.5 吨 Nimakachi Type 3 装甲，为其体量提供了足够的防护。得益于四足底盘，Bishamon 的框架极其稳定，代价则是可用于武器和装备的空间减少。ZH

column1: The 4K variant of the Bishamon is intended to command a C3 lance. In order to accomplish this, the 'Mech has had the MRM-20 launcher downgraded to an MRM-10 launcher, and replaces its two ER medium lasers with two ER small lasers. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 毗沙门的 4K 变型旨在指挥一个 C3 小队。为此，这台机甲的 MRM-20 发射器被降级为 MRM-10 发射器，两门增程中型激光也换成了两门增程小型激光。特性：先进光学系统 投放费用倍率：1.03

column1: Black Hawk-KU
column2: 黑鹰-KU

column1: Formerly known as the Bulldog variant, this configuration is a field upgrade developed in the midst of Operation Bulldog. It utilized captured Clan Smoke Jaguar weapons to help bolster the SLDF forces in later waves. A mix of arm-mounted short and long range weapons, this configuration mounts two Clan-tech ER Large Lasers mounted in the right, with two Clan Streak SRM-6 launchers in the left. Carrying a ton of reloads of each Streak Missile Launcher, a C3 Slave unit allows further enhances its abilities. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这一构型原称斗牛犬改型，是在斗牛犬行动期间开发的战场升级方案。它利用缴获的Smoke Jaguar部族武器，帮助增强后续几波攻势中的SLDF部队。这一构型混合了臂挂式近程与远程武器，右侧装有两门部族科技增程大型激光，左侧则装有两具部族连发SRM-6发射器。每具连发导弹发射器都携带一吨再装填弹药，而一个C3从属单元则进一步增强了它的能力。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Black Hawk-KU is an Inner Sphere version of the Clan Black Hawk OmniMech. In order to make it possible to copy the Black Hawk, the Black Hawk-KU is built ten tons heavier than its Clan counterpart. The Black Hawk-KU is built on a sixty ton chassis and is powered by a Vlar 300 XL Engine which propels it to a top speed of 86.4 km/h.
column2: 黑鹰-KU 是氏族黑鹰全能机甲的内天体版本。为能复制黑鹰，黑鹰-KU 比其氏族原版重十吨。它基于六十吨底盘建造，由一台 Vlar 300 XL 引擎驱动，最高速度 86.4 公里/小时。ZH

column1: This variant carries seven medium lasers in each arm and a C3 Slave next to the cockpit. To keep the BHKU-OX cool, it carries an experimental Coolant Pod in the left and right torsos. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 该变型在每条手臂各携带七门中型激光，驾驶舱旁装有一台 C3 从属计算机。为给 BHKU-OX 降温，它还在左右躯干各携带一个实验性冷却剂罐。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: This dedicated fire-support model uses a pair of LRM-20s, though they can only call upon three tons of ammunition. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这款专职火力支援型号使用一对LRM-20，但只能依靠三吨弹药。特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: This dedicated fire-support model uses a pair of LRM-20s, though they can only call upon three tons of ammunition.
column2: 这一专用火力支援型号使用两具LRM-20，不过它们只能调用三吨弹药。ZH

column1: The Black Lanner 'Bellonarius' is a custom designed 'Mech, carrying a Streak SRM-4 in each side torso, supported by three machine guns in each arm, a heavy medium laser in the left torso, and a heavy small laser in the head. Two tons of Streak ammunition and four tons of machine gun reloads give the Bellonarius reasonable field endurance. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 黑隼"贝罗纳里乌斯"是一台定制设计的机甲，两侧躯干各装有一具连发SRM-4，每只手臂另有三挺机枪，左躯干装有一具重型中型激光，头部则装有一具重型小型激光。两吨连发导弹弹药与四吨机枪备弹让"贝罗纳里乌斯"拥有相当不错的战场续航能力。特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Newly developed by Clan Jade Falcon for the Clan Invasion of the Inner Sphere, the Black Lanner is a fast medium OmniMech that can take on a variety of roles. Intended as a front-line 'Mech, the Black Lanner makes use of all weight-saving technology available to the Clan Jade Falcon scientists who designed it, including an XL engine, endo steel, and eight tons of ferro-fibrous armor. The Black Lanner also includes a MASC system on the base chassis that enables it to run up to 151 km/h in bursts, allowing it to outrun many 'Mechs half its size. The design sacrifices pod space for that speed however, with an engine almost half the Black Lanner's weight leaving a mere 13 tons for offensive weaponry.
column2: 黑猎隼由翡翠隼氏族为入侵内天体而新近开发，是一款能承担多种角色的快速中型全能机甲。作为一线机甲，黑猎隼用上了设计它的翡翠隼科学家所能获得的一切减重技术，包括 XL 引擎、内骨骼和八吨铁纤维装甲。黑猎隼的基础底盘还装有 MASC 系统，使其能在爆发中跑至 151 公里/小时，足以甩开许多体型只有它一半的机甲。不过该设计为速度牺牲了吊舱空间——引擎几乎占去黑猎隼一半重量，只留下 13 吨用于攻击武器。ZH

column1: The Black Lanner's F2 loadout is currently only used with the Jade Falcon Clan. It is a general-purpose design, intended to take on recon patrols and disrupt supply lines on an intermittent basis. The choice of weapons suggests a need to minimize the burden on the Jade Falcon support and technical training pipelines. Unfortunately, while it is capable of many routine assignments, the F2 will do none of them well. It is presumed the Jade Falcons will exercise caution, fielding this configuration only when they are sure there are no massed formations of Battlemechs in the target area. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 黑兰纳的F2配置目前仅供翡翠猎鹰部族使用。这是一种通用设计，用于执行侦察巡逻，并间歇性地破坏补给线。其武器选择表明，该设计有意将对翡翠猎鹰后勤与技术人员培养体系的负担降到最低。遗憾的是，尽管F2能胜任许多常规任务，却没有一项能做得很好。可以推测，翡翠猎鹰使用时也会相当谨慎，只有在确信目标区域内没有大规模战斗机甲编队时，才会投入这一配置。特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The ability to close quickly on large, slow-moving Assault 'Mechs, combined with the potential to kill such foes with a single headshot, makes it abundantly clear the Black Lanner G2 configuration is intended for brutal sledgehammer operations. Deployed in pure Stars, the G2 can quickly gain the upper hand and go on to dominate the battlefield, moving about at will. Jade Falcon Commanders who make proper use of this threat can force an opponent into defensive strategies which will ultimately lead to defeat. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 能迅速逼近庞大而行动迟缓的突击机甲，再加上一记爆头即可击杀这类敌人的潜力，充分说明黑鹞G2配置是为残酷的“大锤”作战而设。以纯星队部署时，G2能迅速占据上风并进而主宰战场，随心所欲地机动。善用这一威胁的玉猫指挥官可以迫使对手转入防御策略，最终走向失败。特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The H configuration mounts four additional double heat sinks to combat the heat that the heavy large laser and pair of medium pulse lasers build; it also has an ECM suite. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: H构型额外加装了四具双散热器，以应对重型大型激光与两门中型脉冲激光产生的热量；它还配备了一套电子对抗套件。特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The S loadout is a hunter-killer designed primarily to take out enemy support 'Mechs. It can easily deal with enemy recon patrols, rapidly bypass front lines and bring the fight to softer targets in the rear or close in quickly on large, slow-moving ‘missile boats’ and artillery support vehicles - all depending on the current needs. Seventy-two percent of the weapons systems are energy-based, giving the Lanner S respectable battlefield endurance. This, combined with its impressive mobility, translates to chaos and carnage when it reaches the back field Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: S配置是一种猎杀者构型，主要用于清除敌方的支援机甲。它能轻松应对敌方侦察巡逻队，迅速绕过前线，把战斗带到后方更脆弱的目标身上，或快速逼近庞大迟缓的“导弹艇”与炮击支援车辆——一切视当下需要而定。其武器系统有百分之七十二为能量武器，让Lanner S拥有相当不错的战场续航力。再加上其出色的机动性，这意味着当它突入后方时，带来的便是混乱与屠杀。特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Black Python
column2: 黑蟒

column1: This variant was introduced by Clan Steel Viper. It replaces the traditional weaponry with a pair of ER PPCs, a Gauss rifle, and two Machine Guns. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: 该变型由钢蝰蛇部族推出，它以2门增程粒子加农炮、1门高斯步枪和2挺机枪取代了传统武器。<特性：改进瞄准（近程） <投放费用倍率：1.17

column1: The 7R carries a Light Gauss Rifle as its primary weapon, allowing the 'mech to engage an enemy at up to seven hundred and fifty meters. This is backed up by an Ultra Autocannon/10 that can fire at twice the rate of a standard autocannon. For medium to short ranges, the Black Watch has a MRM-40 launcher. The Black Watch has received some criticism due to its heavy reliance on ammunition based weapons. To make the most of them, the Black Watch carries a C3 slave unit to allow it to share targeting data with friendly units through a C3 network. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: 7R的主武器是一门轻型高斯步枪，使机甲能够在最远七百五十米的距离上交战。它的补充火力是一门超级自动炮/10，射速可达标准自动炮的两倍。在中近距离上，Black Watch配备一具MRM-40发射器。由于过度依赖弹药类武器，Black Watch也招致了一些批评。为充分发挥这些武器的效能，Black Watch搭载了C3从属单元，可通过C3网络与友军单位共享瞄准数据。特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：右上

column1: Black Watch
column2: 黑色守望

column1: Built with the intention of showing solidarity in the spirit of the new Star League, the Black Watch is the culmination of the efforts of Cosara Weaponries, the Northwind Highlanders, and Captain Neil Campbell of the Royal Black Watch. The Black Watch is built on the same chassis as the classic Crockett which served with distinction in the old Star League Defense Force. The 'Mech is powered by the rugged and durable Strand 255 fusion engine, giving the Black Watch a top speed of 54.0 km/h. For added mobility, the Black Watch has three Rawlings 54 jump jets that allow the 'Mech to jump up to ninety meters. The Black Watch has ten double heat sinks that are more than adequate for the needs of the 'mech and has fifteen tons of Valiant Lamellor armor with CASE to protect itself from ammunition explosions.
column2: 为在新星盟的精神下展现团结而建造，黑卫是科萨拉兵工、北风高地团以及皇家黑卫的尼尔·坎贝尔上尉共同努力的结晶。黑卫建立在与经典克罗基特相同的底盘上——后者曾在旧星盟防卫部队中服役并功勋卓著。该机甲由坚固耐用的斯特兰德255聚变引擎驱动，使黑卫的最高速度达到54.0公里/小时。为增强机动性，黑卫装有三个罗林斯54跳跃推进器，可让机甲跳跃至多九十米。黑卫有十具双重散热器，完全足以满足该机甲的需求，并披挂十五吨瓦利安特·拉梅洛装甲，配以CASE以保护自身免受弹药爆炸之害。ZH

column1: Blackjack 1s are solid, well-rounded 'Mechs for their tonnage. The 1B is a typical example of a battlefield refit, swapping the autocannons and arm-mounted medium lasers for two LRM-15 launchers and three tons of reloads between them. In addition, two jumpjets and one ton of armor were removed. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 就吨位而言，二十一点（Blackjack）1 系列都是扎实而全面的机甲。1B 型是战场改装的典型例子：它把自动炮和臂装中型激光换成两具 LRM-15 发射器，并为其配备三吨备用弹药。此外，还拆除了两具跳跃推进器和一吨装甲。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Blackjack 1s are solid, well-rounded 'Mechs for their tonnage. The 1B is a typical example of a battlefield refit, swapping the autocannons and arm-mounted medium lasers for two LRM-15 launchers and three tons of reloads between them. In addition, two jumpjets and one ton of armor were removed.
column2: 黑杰克1就其吨位而言是扎实、均衡的机甲。1B是战地改装的典型例子：把自动炮和臂装中型激光器换成两具LRM-15发射器，合计三吨备用弹。此外，还拆掉了两个跳跃推进器和一吨装甲。ZH

column1: A common refit of the standard BJ-2, the BJ-2t replaces the streak launchers with standard SRM-2 launchers. This frees up the space for another ton of ammunition, as well allows the addition of C.A.S.E. protection in both side torsos to lower the impact of internal ammo explosions. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: BJ-2t 是标准 BJ-2 的常见改装，它用标准 SRM-2 发射器取代连发发射器。这腾出了空间以增加一吨弹药，同时还得以在两侧躯干加装 C.A.S.E. 防护，以减轻内部弹药爆炸造成的冲击。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

column1: Michael Ubodo's Arrow is armed with a trio of Machine Guns in each arm supplied with two tons of ammo, supported by a Medium Laser in side torso and a Large Pulse Laser mounted in the center torso. Mounting a 235 standard engine, its varation of the Arrow is clad in Ferro-Fibrous armor on an Endo Steel frame, carrying eleven Double Heat Sinks and just two Jump Jets. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 迈克尔·乌博多的箭在每只手臂上装三挺机枪（配两吨弹药），侧躯干一门中型激光、中央躯干一门大型脉冲激光辅助。它采用235标准引擎，该变型的箭披挂铁纤维装甲、建在钢内骨结构框架上，带十一个双散热器和仅两具跳跃推进器。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Michael Ubodo's Arrow is armed with a trio of Machine Guns in each arm supplied with two tons of ammo, supported by a Medium Laser in side torso and a Large Pulse Laser mounted in the center torso. Mounting a 235 standard engine, its variation of the Arrow is clad in Ferro-Fibrous armor on an Endo Steel frame, carrying eleven Double Heat Sinks and just two Jump Jets.
column2: 迈克尔·乌博多的箭在双臂各装三挺机枪、配两吨弹药，由侧躯干的一门中型激光器和中央躯干的一门大型脉冲激光器支援。它装一具235标准引擎，其箭的变体以内层钢框架上的铁纤装甲披挂，携带十一具双重散热器和仅两个跳跃推进器。ZH

column1: Given to Ross McKinnon upon his father's retirement in 3051, the family 'Mech continued to be upgraded with the latest technology. By the FedCom Civil War the right arm and torso weaponry of Ross's 'Mech was upgraded to extended range models, with the triple strength myomers and hatchet retained. The use of production grade ferro-fibrous and double heat sinks, along with downgrading the large lasers to medium pulse lasers and the left arm medium for an ER Small Laser, freed up enough weight for a Targeting Computer to be added. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
column2: 这台家族机甲在 3051 年其父退役时传给了罗斯·麦金农，此后不断以最新科技进行升级。到联邦共和国内战时期，罗斯机甲的右臂和躯干武器已升级为增程型号，三倍强度肌纤维和战斧则予以保留。量产级铁纤维和双散热器的使用，加上将大型激光降级为中型脉冲激光、把左臂中型激光换成增程小型激光，腾出了足够的重量来加装一台瞄准计算机。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.13

column1: The Black Knight was designed both as a front-line combatant and as a command BattleMech at the company and battalion level for the Star League Defense Force. Its advanced communications gear allowed the Black Knight to effortlessly coordinate an entire company of 'Mechs simultaneously, and could easily link together the command frequencies of an entire parent regiment and connect with orbital support satellites. Advanced building materials gave the Black Knight a light but strong chassis able to carry more weapons and armor for less weight. Given the type and amount of firepower the 'Mech carries the only issue facing the Black Knight is heat management.
column2: 黑骑士既被设计为前线战斗单位，也被设计为星盟防卫军连级与营级的指挥战斗机甲。其先进通讯设备使黑骑士能轻易同时协调一整连机甲，并能轻松接通整个上级团的指挥频率并与轨道支援卫星联络。先进的建造材料赋予黑骑士轻而坚固的底盘，能以更小的重量携带更多武器与装甲。考虑到它所携带火力的类型与数量，黑骑士面临的唯一问题是散热管理。ZH

column1: Downgraded during the technological decline of the Succession Wars era, the personal 'Mech of the McKinnon family was selected to receive among the first experimental weapons developed from the Helm Memory Core by the New Avalon Institute of Science, thanks to the exploits of Fox's Teeth commander Ian McKinnon. When piloted by Ian during the War of 3039, the 'Mech was clad in prototype ferro-fibrous armor and the standard heat sinks outside the engine were replaced with corrosive 3039-era double heat sinks. These weight savings, along with the removal of the head-mounted small laser, allowed the 'Mech to carry a Hatchet whose damage was boosted by the addition of Triple Strength Myomer. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
column2: 麦金农（McKinnon）家族的座机在继承战争时期的技术衰退中遭到降级，但凭借“狐牙”（Fox's Teeth）指挥官伊恩·麦金农的战绩，它被选中，成为新阿瓦隆科学研究所依据地狱核心（Helm Memory Core）研发的首批实验性武器之一的搭载平台。3039 年战争期间由伊恩驾驶时，这台机甲披挂原型铁纤维装甲，引擎之外的标准散热器则被替换为 3039 年代那批具有腐蚀性的双散热器。这些减重措施，再加上拆除头部安装的小型激光，使该机甲得以携带一把战斧，其伤害因加装三重强度人造肌而进一步提升。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.13

column1: The Black Knight BL-6-KNT-K is a full conversion of the classic Black Knight to use Clan technology. Originally designed and ordered by Kell's Hounds, it can lately also sometimes be seen with other mercenary forces. The full energy weapons loadout combines an ER PPC with a Large Pulse Laser and an ER Large Laser as the main damage dealers, four ER Medium Lasers are available as secondary firepower. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: 黑骑士BL-6-KNT-K是把经典黑骑士全面改装为部族技术的版本。它最初由凯尔猎犬设计并订购，近来有时也能在其他雇佣兵部队中见到。这套全能量武器载荷以一门增程粒子加农炮、一门大型脉冲激光和一门增程大型激光为主要伤害来源，四门增程中型激光则作为次要火力。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.17

column1: A mysterious variant sighted in 3057 on an uninhabited world in the Spinward Periphery near Antallos, the so-called BL-6-RR swaps out the standard medium lasers and PPC of the BL-6-KNT for more deadly Clan ER medium lasers and an ER PPC. The lighter particle cannon allows an additional single heat sink to be added. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
column2: 这台被称为 BL-6-RR 的神秘变型于 3057 年在安塔洛斯（Antallos）附近的顺旋臂外围地区一颗无人星球上现身。它把 BL-6-KNT 的标准中型激光和粒子加农炮换成了更致命的部族增程中型激光与增程粒子加农炮。更轻的粒子加农炮还让它可以额外加装一台单散热器。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.13

column1: Introduced in 3040, this variant retains the side torso–mounted large lasers and right arm medium laser, replacing the PPC with another large laser and upgrading the head-mounted small laser to another medium. The weight saved allows the BL-7-KNT-P to carry a heavy longsword in its left arm. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 这是3040年推出的变型，保留侧躯干大型激光和右臂中型激光，以另一门大型激光取代粒子加农炮，并把头部小型激光升级为另一门中型激光。省下的重量让BL-7-KNT-P左手能握一把重型长剑。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: An updated version of the classic BL-7-KNT using modern Ferro-Fibrous armor and double heat sinks. The saved weight allows the 'Mech to mount an Beagle Active Probe and considerably more armor. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 这是对经典BL-7-KNT的更新版本，采用现代铁纤维装甲与双散热器。省下的重量让机甲得以装设一台比格犬主动探测器和多得多的装甲。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: The BL-8W-KNT is a further enhancement of the 7W, replacing its active probe with two more double heat sinks to address the subpar cooling. The design is otherwise the same. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: BL-8W-KNT是7W的进一步强化型，它用两台额外的双散热器取代了主动探测器，以解决散热不佳的问题。除此之外设计保持不变。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: This variant is based on Ian McKinnon's Black Knight. The only difference is the Hatchet being replaced by an Autocannon/5 and SRM-2. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
column2: 该变型以伊恩·麦金农的黑骑士为基础，唯一的区别是战斧被替换为一门 AC/5 自动炮和一具 SRM-2。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左上

column1: The Bloedhond BLH-6D carries several lasers, utilizing its high speed and small size to repeatedly flank and hit an enemy in less protected locations. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: 血犬BLH-6D装有多门激光，凭借其高速度与小体型反复包抄并打击敌人防护较弱的部位。特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：0.97

column1: Ultralight Flanker
column2: 超轻型侧翼手

column1: The Bloedhond is a 15-ton ultralight 'Mech. Due to its small size the 'Mech is quite cheap to acquire and easy to pilot, and as a result is used mainly by remote periphery garrisons and pirate bands.
column2: 血犬是一台15吨超轻型机甲。由于体型小，它采购便宜、易于驾驶，因此主要被偏远的外围驻防部队与海盗团伙使用。ZH

column1: The Bloedhond BLH-7D replaces the medium pulse laser of the 6D with two standard medium lasers. Otherwise the 'Mech configuration is the same as -6D. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: 血犬BLH-7D以两门标准中型激光取代6D的中型脉冲激光，其余配置与-6D相同。特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：0.97

column1: The Alpha loadout has a single weapon, an ER PPC mounted in the left arm. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Alpha载荷只有一件武器：左臂安装的一门增程粒子加农炮。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Blood Ferret
column2: 血貂

column1: Not much is known about the creation of the Blood Ferret, but somehow this little scout has spread through the clans.
column2: 关于血貂的诞生所知甚少，但这款小侦察机甲不知怎地在各氏族中传开了。ZH

column1: The B configuration of the Blood Ferret mounts three ATM-3 launchers. A single ER Small Laser in the center torso works as backup firepower. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Blood Ferret 的 B 配置装有三具 ATM-3 发射器。中央躯干的一门增程小型激光充当备用火力。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The C configuration is all energy based; two ER Medium Lasers in each Side Torso together with two ER Small Lasers in each arm. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: C配置为全能量配置：每侧躯干各装两具增程中型激光，每只手臂各装两具增程小型激光。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The primary configuration of the Blood Ferret combines three Streak SRM-2 launchers with a single Small Pulse Laser and a TAG. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 血貂的主配置把三具连发SRM-2发射器与一门小型脉冲激光和一具TAG结合起来。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Blood Kite does not use advanced electronic targeting systems or expensive weaponry. For long range, it mounts a trio of ER Large Lasers and three LRM-15 launchers. The missile launchers each contain enough ammunition for protracted engagements, though the twenty-one double heat sinks preclude continuous fire of all six weapons. At short range, three SRM-4 launchers give the 'Mech the ability to score critical damage against exposed components. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 血鸢不使用先进的电子瞄准系统或昂贵武器。远程方面它装三门增程大型激光和三具LRM-15发射器；每具导弹发射器都带足弹药以支持持久交战，不过二十一个双散热器不足以支撑全部六件武器持续开火。近程方面，三具SRM-4发射器让该机甲能对已暴露的部件造成致命伤害。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.21 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Blood Kite
column2: 血鸢

column1: The Blood Kite is a BattleMech that was designed on the orders of Clan Blood Spirit Khan Ceana Boques following the deployment of the OmniMech by Clan Coyote in 2854. Because Khan Boques expected the Trials for the OmniMech technology to escalate to the point that her small Clan's touman would not be able to compete, she ordered her scientist caste to rethink the way they designed 'Mechs. Boques dictated that this design philosophy was to conform to four points that seem like they would be common sense: be as cheap as is reasonable, have a reasonable chance of surviving an engagement, sustain a steady barrage, and be as efficient as possible. In fact, many prior designs created by the Clan's scientists violated many or all of these principles. The cream of this crop was the Blood Kite, which debuted in the early part of the thirtieth century. The Blood Kite eschews the use of expensive technology and weapons, only making use of an Endo Steel internal structure to save weight. It contains as much standard armor as the engineers could fit onto the eighty-five ton frame, as well as jump jets that propel it up to ninety meters at a time.
column2: 血鸢是一种战斗机甲，在郊狼氏族于2854年部署全方位机甲之后，由血灵氏族可汗西娜·博克斯下令设计。因为博克斯可汗预计围绕全方位机甲技术的试炼会升级到她这个小氏族的图曼无法竞争的程度，她命令她的科学家种姓重新思考设计机甲的方式。博克斯规定这套设计哲学要符合四条看来像是常识的要点：尽可能便宜合理、有合理的机会在交战中存活、能持续稳定火力输出，以及尽可能高效。事实上，该氏族科学家此前创造的许多设计违反其中多条甚至全部原则。这批成果中的精华就是血鸢，它在三十世纪初首次亮相。血鸢避免使用昂贵的技术与武器，只采用内层钢内部结构来减重。它装了工程师能塞上八十五吨框架的最大量标准装甲，还配了能一次推进九十米的跳跃推进器。ZH

column1: The 10D variant of the Bombardier is a refit performed by Earthwerks Incorporated during the Succession Wars as many advanced components became lostech; while Wakazashi were content not to manufacture any more Bombardiers, the company was prepared to license Earthwerks to produce parts for existing 'Mechs, resulting in the 10D refit. While the Delphinius and Arrowlight launchers were swapped out for low-tech Doombud and Hovertech models, the AMS system was completely replaced with a Machine Gun. Perhaps the biggest difference was the replacement of VOX 325 XL engine with the smaller Magna 260, giving the design a top speed of 64.8 km/h and cruising speed of 43 km/h. In addition, the CASE that protected the vulnerable ammunition stores has been removed from the design, while the armor protection itself has not changed. As a part of the refit performed by Earthwerks in their Calloway VI plant the communications system was replaced with the Neil 5000 system and the targeting and tracking system was replaced with the RCA Instatrac Mark XII system. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: 轰炸机的10D变型是Earthwerks Incorporated在继承战争期间进行的改装，当时许多先进部件已成为失落科技；Wakazashi满足于不再生产轰炸机，但愿意授权Earthwerks为现有机甲生产零件，10D改装因此诞生。Delphinius和Arrowlight发射器被换成低技术的Doombud和Hovertech型号，而AMS系统则被一挺机枪彻底取代。或许最大的变化是用更小的Magna 260替换了VOX 325 XL引擎，使该设计的最高时速为64.8 km/h、巡航速度为43 km/h。此外，用于保护脆弱弹药库的CASE已被从设计中移除，装甲防护本身则没有变化。作为Earthwerks在其卡洛威VI工厂进行改装的一部分，通讯系统被更换为Neil 5000系统，瞄准与跟踪系统则更换为RCA Instatrac Mark XII系统。特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.07

column1: Heavy Support
column2: 重型支援

column1: The 10D variant of the Bombardier is a refit performed by Earthwerks Incorporated during the Succession Wars as many advanced components became lostech; while Wakazashi were content not to manufacture any more Bombardiers, the company was prepared to license Earthwerks to produce parts for existing 'Mechs, resulting in the 10D refit. While the Delphinius and Arrowlight launchers were swapped out for low-tech Doombud and Hovertech models, the AMS system was completely replaced with a Machine Gun. Perhaps the biggest difference was the replacement of VOX 325 XL engine with the smaller Magna 260, giving the design a top speed of 64.8 km/h and cruising speed of 43 km/h. In addition, the CASE that protected the vulnerable ammunition stores has been removed from the design, while the armor protection itself has not changed. As a part of the refit performed by Earthwerks in their Calloway VI plant the communications system was replaced with the Neil 5000 system and the targeting and tracking system was replaced with the RCA Instatrac Mark XII system.
column2: 轰击手的10D变型是地球工厂公司在继承战争期间进行的改装，当时许多先进部件已成失落科技；和泉虽然满足于不再制造任何轰击手，却愿意授权地球工厂为现有机甲生产部件，于是有了10D改装。德尔菲尼乌斯与箭光发射器换成低技术的杜姆巴德与霍弗泰克型号，反导弹系统则被一挺机枪完全取代。或许最大的差别是用较小的马格纳260取代VOX 325 XL引擎，使该设计的最高速度为64.8公里/小时、巡航速度43公里/小时。此外，保护脆弱弹药库的CASE被拆掉，而装甲防护本身没有变化。作为地球工厂在其卡洛韦VI工厂所做改装的一部分，通讯系统换成了尼尔5000，瞄准追踪系统换成了RCA因斯塔特拉克Mark XII。ZH

column1: Continuing the trend toward specialized BattleMechs, the Bombardier was proposed to the Star League in 2735 by Wakazashi Enterprises as an \"artillery 'Mech.\" The concept behind the design was to make a BattleMech that could replace less-mobile artillery vehicles, which might fall behind in an advance or be destroyed by counter-battery fire. It would be well-protected with twelve and a half tons of armor and use specialized missile racks which could carry diverse types of advanced missiles. Over years of testing and field exercises the Bombardier proved itself extremely effective at fulfilling the long-range fire support role, easily surpassing its vehicular counterparts and even inspiring talks of disbanding the SLDF's artillery arm once enough Bombardiers were operational. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 在机甲专用化的潮流之中，Wakazashi 企业于 2735 年向星际联盟提出轰炸机的方案——一款“炮击机甲”。这一设计的理念是打造一种能够取代机动性较差的炮击车辆的战斗机甲，因为那些车辆在推进时可能掉队，或被反炮兵火力摧毁。它将拥有十二吨半装甲的优异防护，并使用可携带多种先进导弹的特制导弹发射架。经过多年的测试与野外演习，轰炸机在远程火力支援任务中证明自己极为高效，轻松超越了同类车辆，甚至引发了解散 SLDF 炮兵部队的讨论——只要足够数量的轰炸机投入服役。特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: Continuing the trend toward specialized BattleMechs, the Bombardier was proposed to the Star League in 2735 by Wakazashi Enterprises as an \"artillery 'Mech.\" The concept behind the design was to make a BattleMech that could replace less-mobile artillery vehicles, which might fall behind in an advance or be destroyed by counter-battery fire. It would be well-protected with twelve and a half tons of armor and use specialized missile racks which could carry diverse types of advanced missiles. Over years of testing and field exercises the Bombardier proved itself extremely effective at fulfilling the long-range fire support role, easily surpassing its vehicular counterparts and even inspiring talks of disbanding the SLDF's artillery arm once enough Bombardiers were operational.
column2: 延续专用战斗机甲的趋势，轰击者由若狭企业于2735年作为"炮兵机甲"提交给星盟。该设计背后的构想是造出一种能替代机动性较差火炮车辆的战斗机甲，后者可能在推进中掉队或被反炮兵火力摧毁。它将以十二吨半装甲获得良好防护，并使用能携带多种先进导弹的特制导弹架。经过多年测试与实地演习，轰击者被证明在执行远程火力支援角色上极为有效，轻松超越其车辆同类，甚至引发了在足够多轰击者投入运作后解散SLDF炮兵部队的讨论。ZH

column1: An early clan Mech dating from the days of Operation Klondike, the Bombardier BMB-12D-EC was an upgrade of the BMB-12D that replaced the weapons with Early Clan variants. It would be discontinued and forgotten as modern clan spec weapons entered production. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: Bombardier BMB-12D-EC 是源自克朗代克行动时期的早期部族机甲，它是对 BMB-12D 的升级，将武器替换为早期部族型号。随着现代部族规格武器投入生产，它最终停产并被人们遗忘。特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: An early clan Mech dating from the days of Operation Klondike, the Bombardier BMB-12D-EC was an upgrade of the BMB-12D that replaced the weapons with Early Clan variants. It would be discontinued and forgotten as modern clan spec weapons entered production.
column2: 作为可追溯到克朗代克行动时期的一种早期氏族机甲，轰击者BMB-12D-EC是BMB-12D的升级版，把武器换成了早期氏族变体。随着现代氏族规格武器投产，它被停产并逐渐被遗忘。ZH

column1: The Bowman utilizes an XL engine to maintain its rapid pace, as well an Endo Steel internal structure to save weight. An ECM Suite protects it from some forms of electronic warfare, while twelve and a half tons of armor protect it from weapons fire. The primary armament on the Bowman is a Class 16 Arrow IV Artillery launcher. Enough ammunition is included to allow for various types to be utilized. Though the original design incorporated two artillery pieces, the modern version accedes to modern demands by utilizing a LRM-20, though it has a limited amount of ammunition. Three ER Medium Lasers are meant for anti-vehicle use, while two Anti-Personnel Pods on each leg keep conventional infantry at bay. Fourteen double heat sinks keep heat levels down for the most part. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: 弓手利用XL引擎保持其迅捷节奏，并采用钢内骨结构内部结构减轻重量。一套电子对抗套件保护它免受某些形式的电子战，十二吨半装甲则抵御武器火力。弓手的主要武器是一门16型箭IV火炮发射器，配足量弹药以使用多种弹种。虽然原设计整合了两门火炮，现代版本顺应需求改用一具LRM-20，尽管弹药量有限。三门增程中型激光用于反车辆，每条腿两具反人员舱则把常规步兵挡在外面。十四个双散热器大体上压住了热量水平。特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右上

column1: The Bowman first saw production in 2960 as Clan Hell's Horses started a crash program to build defensive BattleMechs following the fall of Tokasha MechWorks to Clan Ghost Bear in 2921. Now a rare sight on the battlefield, the Bowman began its life as an artillery platform mounting a pair of Arrow IV artillery systems. However, this configuration never met with success, due mostly to Clan biases against indirect warfare. Therefore, the Bowman was modified to its present \"standard\" configuration in 2973. Still unpopular with Clan warriors, the Bowman is primarily utilized by Clan Hell's Horses.
column2: 弓手于2960年首次投产，当时地狱马部族在2921年托卡沙机甲厂落入鬼熊部族之后，启动了一项紧急计划来建造防御型战斗机甲。如今战场上已难得一见；弓手最初是作为搭载两套箭IV火炮系统的火炮平台而生。然而这一配置从未成功，主要因为部族对间接作战的偏见。因此弓手在2973年被改为如今的“标准”配置。弓手在部族战士中仍不受欢迎，主要由地狱马部族使用。ZH

column1: This variant abandons any hope of the Bowman being an ArtilleryMech. The remaining artillery is replaced with a second LRM-20 launcher, three additional tons of ammunition, and an ER Large Laser. More heat sinks are added to keep the heat in check. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: 这个变型彻底放弃了让弓手充当火炮机甲的可能：剩余的火炮被替换为第2具LRM-20发射器、3吨额外弹药和1门增程大型激光，并加装更多散热器以控制热量。<特性：稳定 <投放费用倍率：1.16 <手臂驱动器限制：右臂上段

column1: This is the original Bowman configuration introduced in 2923, carrying a pair of Arrow IV missile artillery systems. Its only other defense are a pair of A-Pods in each leg. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: 这是 Bowman 于 2923 年推出的原始配置，携带两套 Arrow IV 导弹炮击系统。它仅有的其他防御手段是每条腿上的两具 A-Pod。特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右臂上部

column1: Designed primarily for short range combat, the Buccaneer carries a single ER large laser to give it some striking capability at long ranges. With the elevation of physical combat to an art in the Inner Sphere, the Buccaneer's most fearsome weapon is its four ton hatchet, supported at medium to close ranges by four medium lasers, a highly accurate medium pulse laser, and a SRM-6 with an Artemis IV guidance system for increased missile accuracy. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 海盗主要设计用于近程战斗，却带有一门增程大型激光，使它在远距离上也具备一定的打击能力。随着混战战在内层星域被提升为一门艺术，海盗最令人畏惧的武器是它那把四吨重的战斧；中近距离则由四门中型激光、一门高精度中型脉冲激光和一具带阿尔忒弥斯IV制导系统的SRM-6支援，以提高导弹精度。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: The Buccaneer is a product of the Word of Blake's voracious appetite for military equipment in its first few years, as the order had far more MechWarriors than they had 'Mechs. The Buccaneer was originally designed to be used by ComStar, but had not begun production. When the schism that created the Word of Blake occurred, the design was modified to accommodate equipment available to the Word of Blake in their temporary home of the Free Worlds League. The Buccaneer is built with a lightweight VOX 330 XL engine giving the 'Mech a top speed of 97.2 km/h. It also carries an impressive ten tons of ferro-fibrous armor, the maximum amount of protection the chassis can carry, and mounts 10 double heat sinks as standard.
column2: 海盗是布雷克之言在其最初几年对军事装备贪婪渴求的产物，因为该教团的机师远比机甲多。海盗原本是为康星设计使用，但尚未投产。当导致布雷克之言诞生的分裂发生时，该设计被修改，以适应布雷克之言在其临时家园自由世界联盟所能获得的装备。海盗采用一台轻量的VOX 330 XL引擎，使该机甲最高速度达到97.2公里/小时。它还携带令人印象深刻的十吨铁纤装甲，是该底盘能承载的最大防护量，并标配10具双重散热器。ZH

column1: A derivative variant of the old Bushwacker prototypes, the High Roller uses an XL275 engine and Endo-Steel structure to field an AC/10, LRM-5, three Medium Lasers, and a pair of Machine Guns. While it's enhancements increase the damage output of these weapons, it still suffers from the prototype models' electronic systems, especially in its TTS and FCS. This means that while powerful, the High Roller requires an above-average warrior to land a hit. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 作为早期 Bushwacker 原型机的衍生变型，High Roller 采用 XL275 引擎和钢内骨结构，得以装备一门 AC/10、一具 LRM-5、三具中型激光和两挺机枪。虽然它的改进提升了这些武器的伤害输出，但它仍然受累于原型型号的电子系统，尤其是其 TTS 和 FCS。这意味着 High Roller 虽然威力强大，却需要一位水准高于常人的战士才能命中目标。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: A Kell Hounds refit, the -3KH carries all Clan weapons. The mercenary outfit kept most of the 'Mech the same, but did manage to squeeze in a C3 Slave unit in the head. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 凯尔猎犬的改装版，-3KH搭载的全是部族武器。这支雇佣兵部队让机甲的大部分保持原样，但设法在头部塞进了一台C3从属单元。特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.1

column1: Originally a reverse-engineered version Cataphract the finished design surprisingly enough proving to be a high quality design itself.Though never attracting great sales, the Caesar would prove to be relatively popular in the Capellan March, among Lyran units on the Clan front, and with both FedCom-employed mercenaries and the Com Guards.Though never attracting great sales, the Caesar would prove to be relatively popular in the Capellan March, among Lyran units on the Clan front, and with both FedCom-employed mercenaries and the Com Guards.
column2: 凯撒最初是甲胄的逆向工程版本，但成品设计本身出人意料地证明是一种高质量设计。虽然从未取得亮眼销量，凯撒在卡佩兰边区、氏族前线的莱兰部队中，以及在联邦共同体雇佣的雇佣兵和康卫队中都相当受欢迎。ZH

column1: The personal 'Mech of Marcus GioAvanti, commander of Avanti's Angels, all of Archangel's weapons are upgraded to Clantech equivalents with the right arm medium pulse laser moved to the left arm and an extra Clan medium pulse laser added to the center torso. The resulted weight and space saved allowed the mounting of an extra double heat sink as well as additional armor. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12
column2: 这是阿万蒂之天使指挥官马库斯·乔阿万蒂的私人机甲，大天使的所有武器都升级为部族同类，右臂的中型脉冲激光移到左臂，中央躯干再加一门部族中型脉冲激光。由此节省的重量与空间让它得以多装一个双散热器以及额外装甲。特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.12

column1: The personal 'Mech of Marcus GioAvanti, commander of Avanti's Angels, all of Archangel's weapons are upgraded to Clantech equivalents with the right arm medium pulse laser moved to the left arm and an extra Clan medium pulse laser added to the center torso. The resulted weight and space saved allowed the mounting of an extra double heat sink as well as additional armor.
column2: 这是阿万蒂之天使指挥官马库斯·乔阿万蒂的私人机甲，大天使的所有武器都升级为部族同类，右臂的中型脉冲激光移到左臂，中央躯干再加一门部族中型脉冲激光。由此节省的重量与空间让它得以多装一个双散热器以及额外装甲。ZH

column1: The energy weapons on the Canis are four arm-mounted Series 7Ja ER Large Lasers. While these pack a powerful, long-range punch, they often overload the design's sixteen double heat sinks. For medium-range support, the Canis utilizes a pair of torso-mounted Type 9 Ultra Autocannon/10s, though it only carries enough ammunition for approximately a minute and a half of sustained firing. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Canis 的能量武器是四门安装在手臂上的 Series 7Ja 增程大型激光。它们虽然拥有强大的远程打击力，却常常让该设计配备的十六具双散热器不堪重负。中距离支援方面，Canis 使用两门安装在躯干上的 Type 9 超级自动炮/10，不过其携带的弹药仅够持续射击约一分半钟。特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.2 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: Paying tribute to other highly successful Clan Wolf designs, the Blood Reaper is a symbolic and straightforward second-line BattleMech in heavy use in the post-Jihad Clan Wolf touman. Seeking to standardize his forces and weed out non-Wolf designs, Khan Vlad Ward ordered his scientists to develop a rugged yet symbolic 'Mech for warriors of Clan Wolf to rally around. A standard BattleMech in the mold of the successful Tundra Wolf, the Blood Reaper first entered service in 3079 and went on to form a large part of the Wolves' post-Jihad touman. Khan Ward overcame the stigma of a second-line machine with classic Clan posturing; by insisting that warriors truly worthy of the spirit of the Wolf would win even while being hobbled by such a design.
column2: 向其他极为成功的狼族设计致敬，血收割者是战后圣战中狼族图曼里大量使用的一种象征性、直截了当的二等战斗机甲。可汗弗拉德·沃德为求标准化其部队、淘汰非狼族设计，命令他的科学家研发一种粗犷却具象征意义的机甲，供狼族战士凝聚于其周围。作为成功机型冻原狼式的标准战斗机甲，血收割者于3079年首次服役，此后构成战后狼族图曼的一大部分。沃德可汗以经典的氏族姿态克服了二等机甲的污名：他坚称真正配得上狼之精神的战士，即便被这种设计拖着后腿也能取胜。ZH

column1: The Cataphract Hero 'Mech, Grigori Kovalenko's custom Cataphract 'Ilya Muromets', Identification Number CTF2X0042A-1013, is armed with an AC/5 in each arm, supported by a right arm Small Laser, a Medium Laser in each side torso and a right torso mounted AC/10. Such a heavy autocannon loadout is made possible through the use of 280-rated XL engine, while three tons of AC/5 rounds and two of AC/10 reloads keep those cannons firing. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: Cataphract 英雄机甲——格里戈里·科瓦连科的定制型 Cataphract“Ilya Muromets”，识别编号 CTF2X0042A-1013——两条手臂各装备一门 AC/5，并有右臂一门小型激光、两侧躯干各一门中型激光以及右躯干的 AC/10 提供支援。如此沉重的自动炮配置之所以能够实现，得益于 280 级 XL 引擎的使用；三吨 AC/5 炮弹和两吨 AC/10 弹药则保证了这些火炮的持续射击。特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: The Cataphract Hero 'Mech, Grigori Kovalenko's custom Cataphract 'Ilya Muromets', Identification Number CTF2X0042A-1013, is armed with an AC/5 in each arm, supported by a right arm Small Laser, a Medium Laser in each side torso and a right torso mounted AC/10. Such a heavy autocannon loadout is made possible through the use of 280-rated XL engine, while three tons of AC/5 rounds and two of AC/10 reloads keep those cannons firing.
column2: 这台甲胄英雄机甲，格里戈里·科瓦连科的定制甲胄"伊利亚·穆罗梅茨"，识别号CTF2X0042A-1013，双臂各装一门AC/5，由右臂一门小型激光器支援，两侧躯干各一门中型激光器，右躯干另装一门AC/10。如此沉重的自动炮载荷之所以可行，要归功于280级XL引擎，而三吨AC/5炮弹和两吨AC/10备用弹让这些炮持续开火。ZH

column1: The personal ride of MechWarrior Jenny Templeton of the Chesterton Reserves. This custom variant of the Catapult C1, the Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是切斯特顿预备役机甲战士珍妮·坦普尔顿的私人座机。这款弹射器C1的定制变型，其 特性：精准武器 - 导弹 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The personal ride of MechWarrior Jenny Templeton of the Chesterton Reserves. This custom variant of the Catapult C1, the Butterbee, replaces the standard arm-mounted LRM-15s with two SRM-6 missile launchers in each arm, giving it deadly close combat capability.
column2: 这是切斯特顿预备役机甲战士珍妮·坦普尔顿的私人座机。这款弹射器C1的定制变型黄油蜂以每只手臂两具SRM-6导弹发射器取代标准臂载LRM-15，赋予它致命的混战能力。ZH

column1: A field refit given popularity after repeated sightings in combat piloted by MechWarrior Leigh Voss, the CLPT-Jester typically begins life as a refit kit for a CPLT-K2 or similar variant. Stripping out the PPCs, the Jester manages to run enough power couplings to cram a laser into each arm, each side torso, and two in the center torso, with additional fittings for support weapons if available. It also mounts an AMS system and advanced TTS systems, allowing for lethally accurate fire even beyond traditional weapon ranges. The only major advanced piece of kit is its Endo-Steel structure; the engine and armor are both standard, making the Jester quite tough. With a plethora of double heat sinks keeping its weapons cool and the ability to lay down volley after pinpoint volley of fire, the Jester is simple, but not to be underestimated. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这种战地改装因机甲战士莉·沃斯多次驾驶它现身战场而流行起来，小丑（CLPT-Jester）通常以CPLT-K2或类似变型的改装套件为基础。它拆除粒子加农炮，设法布设足够的动力耦合，把激光装进每条手臂、左右躯干各一门，中央躯干则有两门，并在条件允许时预留加装支援武器的额外接口。它还装有AMS系统和先进的TTS系统，即便在传统武器射程之外也能打出致命精准的射击。唯一重要的先进部件是它的钢内骨结构；引擎和装甲均为标准型，这使小丑相当耐打。凭借大量双散热器保持武器低温，以及接连不断打出精准齐射的能力，小丑结构简单，却绝不可小觑。特性：精准武器 - 能量 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

The only major advanced piece of kit is its Endo-Steel structure; the engine and armor are both standard, making the Jester quite tough. With a plethora of double heat sinks keeping its weapons cool and the ability to lay down volley after pinpoint volley of fire, the Jester is simple, but not to be underestimated.
column2: 作为一款在机师莉·沃斯反复实战目击之后流行起来的战地改装，CLPT-小丑通常从CPLT-K2或类似改型的改装套件开始。它拆掉PPC，设法接入足够的电力耦合线路，在双臂、两侧躯干各塞入一门激光器、中央躯干两门，如果条件允许还加装支援武器的接口。它还装有一套AMS和先进TTS系统，使其即使在传统武器射程之外也能进行致命精准的射击。唯一的主要先进组件是它的内层钢结构；引擎和装甲都是标准型，使小丑相当耐用。凭借大量双重散热器保持武器凉爽，以及一轮接一轮精确齐射的能力，小丑简单，但不可小觑。ZH

column1: The CattleMaster was created at the turn of the thirty-first century as an IndustrialMech to handle large herd animals. The concept for the Rancher 'Mech dates back to the twenty-fourth century. The 'Mech is noted for its durability and flexible Internal Combustion Engine. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.71
column2: 牧牛人于三十一世纪之交被制造为工业机甲，用于处置大型畜群。这类"牧场主"机甲的概念可追溯至二十四世纪。此机甲以其耐用性和灵活的内燃引擎著称。特质：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：0.71

column1: The CattleMaster was created at the turn of the thirty-first century as an IndustrialMech to handle large herd animals. Being fed up by local Troublemakers and Pirates trying to steal his livestock, one farmer went and upgraded his Cattlemaster. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.71
column2: 牧牛大师于31世纪之交作为管理大群牲畜的工业机甲而造。由于受够了当地捣乱分子与海盗不断偷他的牲口，一位农场主索性把自己的牧牛大师升级了。特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：0.71

column1: The Cavalier is a battle armor suit built in response to sagging morale in the Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth, due in large part to the secession of the Lyran state from the Federated Commonwealth. Although originally heavily based on the Inner Sphere Standard, the redesign turned out to be more than cosmetic: the redistribution of armor plating had increased leg protection at the expense of upper body protection. While there were some misgivings, in the final analysis it was discovered these alterations also gave superior dexterity to the trooper compared to that of the Standard. Reluctantly the officers in charge agreed that the benefits outweighed the drawbacks and approved mass production of the suit, which started in June of that same year. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 骑士战斗装甲服是为应对联邦联邦武装部队士气低落而建造的，这在很大程度上源于莱兰邦从联邦联邦中脱离。虽然它在最初很大程度上以"内天体标准型"为基础，但这次重新设计远不止外观改动：装甲板的重新分配以牺牲上半身防护为代价增强了腿部防护。尽管当时存有疑虑，但最终分析发现这些改动还使士兵的灵活性优于标准型。主管军官们不情愿地承认利大于弊，批准了该装甲服量产，并于同年六月开始。特质：灵活 投放费用倍率：0.888 可挂载全能单位，可近战，可蜂群攻击。

column1: While not mounting any defensive weaponry, the Celerity CLR-02-X-D's head is equipped with a Drone Remote Control System and carries a C3i module. The fact the 'Mech has no MechWarrior piloting it is a good thing given the Celerity's single ton of armor and the fragile nature of its XXL engine and XL gyro, even a single skid following a misstep would almost cripple the design let alone combat fire on the battlefield. The standard design carries no weapon, but this version has been altered to mount a single Small Laser. Quirk: Quad Mech (Squad) Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 迅捷CLR-02-X-D虽然没有安装任何防御武器，其头部却配备了无人机遥控系统，并携带1个C3i模块。由于迅捷仅有1吨装甲，其XXL引擎和XL陀螺仪又极为脆弱，机甲里没有机甲战士驾驶反倒是件好事——哪怕是一次失足后的打滑都几乎足以让这台设计报废，更不用说战场上的火力了。标准型号不携带任何武器，但这个版本经过改装，安装了1门小型激光。<特性：四足机甲（小队） <投放费用倍率：0.99

column1: The ultralight OmniMech Celerity was initially ComStar's attempt at creating an expendable drone reconnaissance BattleMech right after the Battle of Tukayyid. The 'Mech' is built on an endo steel frame and is powered by a massive 240-rated XXL fusion engine, the bulky engine making the animalistic drone capable of high-speed sprints, further enhanced by the addition of MASC to make it among the fastest ground units in existence.
column2: 超轻型全方位机甲迅捷最初是康星在图卡伊德战役之后不久，尝试打造一种可消耗的无人机侦察战斗机甲。这台"机甲"建在内层钢框架上，由一台巨大的240级XXL聚变引擎驱动，笨重的引擎让这具兽形无人机能高速冲刺，再加上MASC，使它跻身现存最快的地面单位之列。ZH

column1: One of the best first generation ProtoMechs, the Centaur combines high speed, decent armor, and a varied weapons mix. These features make it a flexible combatant, able to keep up with scout 'Mechs while supporting them. The SRM and LRM missile launchers provide much of the striking power of the Centaur, backed up ER Micro Laser. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 作为最优秀的第一代原型机甲之一，Centaur 兼具高速度、尚可的装甲和多样化的武器组合。这些特点使它成为一具多面手，既能跟上侦察机甲的步伐，又能为其提供支援。SRM 和 LRM 导弹发射器提供了 Centaur 大部分的打击力，微型增程激光则作为补充。特性：灵活 投放费用倍率：0.98

column2: 作为最好的第一代原型机甲之一，半人马兼具高速度、可靠的装甲与多样的武器组合。这些特点使它成为灵活的战斗单位，能跟上侦察机甲同时为其提供支援。SRM与LRM导弹发射器提供半人马大部分打击力，另有一门增程微型激光器作为后援。ZH

column1: A heavier 55-ton version of the venerable Centurion, the CN10-J was built in 3057 and uses an Endo Steel chassis to save weight on the design while retaining the CN9-A's original ground speed through the use of a 220-rated standard fusion engine. Much like the CN9-D, the 10-J carries an LB-X Autocannon/10 as its primary weapon with an LRM-10 launcher with an Artemis IV fire control system, but these are backed up by a Medium Laser and a Medium Pulse Laser. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 百夫长的55吨加重版本，CN10-J于3057年制造，采用钢内骨结构底盘以减轻重量，同时通过一台220额定标准聚变引擎保持CN9-A原有的地面速度。与CN9-D很像，10-J以一门LB-X自动炮/10为主武器，配一具带阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统的LRM-10发射器，另有中型激光和中型脉冲激光作为后手。特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: A second, later configuration of the Yen-Lo-Wang. Commonly referred to as the CN9-YLW2, it is still based upon a CN9-A chassis but uses more modern equipment. Keeping the speed the same, the engine was changed to an extra-light version. The AC/10 has been upgraded to a Gauss Rifle with two tons of ammunition. Three medium pulse lasers, two in the left arm and another rear-mounted in the center torso, replace the old standard ones. A left arm Hatchet is paired with Triple-Strength Myomer. Quirk: Yen Lo Wang Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: Yen-Lo-Wang的第二种也是更晚的配置，通常被称为CN9-YLW2，它仍以CN9-A底盘为基础，但使用了更现代的装备。速度保持不变，引擎更换为超轻型版本。AC/10升级为一门高斯步枪，配两吨弹药。三门中型脉冲激光——两门在左臂，另一门朝后安装在中央躯干——取代了旧式标准激光。左臂的战斧与三重强度肌纤维搭配使用。特性：Yen Lo Wang 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：右下
