column1: The primary weapons on the MR-5M are a pair of Gauss rifles, each of which is capable of taking one ton of armor off of an enemy at long range. In the event that an enemy does move into short range, the Cerberus is ready for them because it carries four Medium Pulse Lasers and two rear-mounted Machine Guns. Additionally, for increased defense against missile attacks, the Cerberus carries an anti-missile system. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: MR-5M的主要武器是两门高斯步枪，每一门都能在远距离上削掉敌人一吨装甲。若敌人真的逼近到近距离，Cerberus也早有准备：它装有四门中型脉冲激光和两挺后置机枪。此外，为加强对导弹攻击的防御，Cerberus还配备了一套反导弹系统。特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Designed to compete with 'Mechs like the Atlas and King Crab, the Cerberus is a 'Mech designed around speed and firepower. The Cerberus uses a massive GM 380 XL engine to propel it to a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The 'Mech is also armored with eleven tons of Heavy ferro-fibrous armor, which provides more protection per ton than standard armor. The large amount of free weight on the 'Mech, almost half of its mass, is dedicated to its weapons systems, which are designed to do as much damage to an enemy at as great a distance as possible.
column2: Cerberus 是为与 Atlas、King Crab 这类机甲一较高下而设计的机甲，以速度与火力为核心。它采用一台巨大的 GM 380 XL引擎，将其推进至 64.8 km/h 的最高速度。该机甲还披挂十一吨重型铁纤维装甲，每吨提供的防护优于标准装甲。机甲上充裕的富余重量几乎占其质量的一半，全部投入武器系统，而这些武器旨在尽可能远的距离上对敌人造成尽可能大的伤害。ZH

column1: The primary weapons on the Cerberus are a pair of Grizzard Model 200 Gauss rifles, each of which is capable of taking one ton of armor off of an enemy at long range. In the event that an enemy does move into short range, the Cerberus is ready for them because it carries four Blankenburg Medium Pulse Lasers and two rear-mounted Sperry Browning Machine Guns. Additionally, for increased defense against missile attacks, the Cerberus carries a McArthur anti-missile system. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 地狱犬的主武器是两门格里扎德200型高斯步枪，每门都能在远距离上剥掉敌人一吨装甲。若敌人真的逼近近距，地狱犬也已做好准备：它带四门布兰肯堡中型脉冲激光和两挺后向斯佩里-勃朗宁机枪。此外，为加强对导弹攻击的防御，地狱犬还带一套麦克阿瑟反导弹系统。特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Cestus 6X was produced for the SLDF in 2603. Considered a failure due to abysmal heat sinking on an energy-exclusive loadout, the Cestus design would eventually see an overhaul into the 6Y, albeit half a century later. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: Cestus 6X于2603年为SLDF生产。由于全能量载荷的散热能力糟糕透顶而被视为失败之作，Cestus设计最终在半个世纪后被彻底翻新为6Y。特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: General Motors
column2: 通用汽车

column1: Whoever designed this thing apparently never got the memo that energy weapons generate heat. I wouldn't recommend firing more than a single weapon at a time on this thing, Boss. Not unless you want to fry your pilots.
column2: 不管是谁设计的这东西，显然从没收到"能量武器会产生热量"这条备忘录。我不建议在这玩意儿上同时发射超过一件武器，老大。除非你想把机师烤熟。ZH

column1: Designed for the SLDF in 2766, the Cestus production was plagued with delays and setbacks. The 6Y is considered a design correction over the original 6X, which ran notoriously hot, by replacing some of the energy weapons with ballistics. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: Cestus于2766年为SLDF设计，其生产却饱受延误与挫折。6Y被认为是对原始6X的设计修正——后者以过热问题臭名昭著——做法是用实弹武器替换了部分能量武器。特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: The Cestus moves at a slower clip than most 65-tonners, but it puts that extra tonnage where it counts. More armor and an arsenal that's threatening at all ranges make it a solid choice.
column2: Cestus的移动比大多数65吨机甲更慢，但它把额外的吨位用在了关键处。更多的装甲与一套在任何射程上都有威胁的武库，使它成为一个扎实的选择。ZH

column1: A Clan-tech retrofit performed by Clan Fire Mandrill. While the original loadout remains identical to the base Cestus 6Y, the 6Y-EC benefits from the early fruits of Clan weapons research. Despite proving to be a success, the redesigned Cestus was overshadowed by further advancements in Clan technology and by 3020 was all but forgotten. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 这是火狒狒部族进行的部族技术改装。虽然原始配置与基础Cestus 6Y完全相同，但6Y-EC得益于部族武器研究的早期成果。尽管被证明是成功的，重新设计的Cestus仍被部族技术的进一步进步所掩盖，到3020年已几乎被遗忘。特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: Interesting. Very interesting. So, what we've got here looks to be a sort of middle ground between the technology that the SLDF left with, and the technology that they came back with. This thing is like a peek into the history of Clan weapons tech, Boss.
column2: 有意思。非常有意思。那么我们这里拿到的，看起来是SLDF离开时所带技术与他们归来时所带技术之间的某种中间形态。这东西就像一窥氏族武器技术史，老大。ZH

column1: Created for the Federated Commonwealth during the Clan Invasion, the 6Z variant of the Cestus returns to the original energy-exclusive loadout of the BattleMech, this time with better cooling. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 6Z 变型是部族入侵期间为联邦共和国打造的，Cestus 借此回归了该战斗机甲最初的全能量武器配置，而这一次散热更为出色。特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: The 6Z runs hot, but it's a massive improvement over the original 6X. As long as you don't have Mechjocks firing weapons at targets beyond their ranges, the heat should be manageable.
column2: 6Z跑起来很热，但相比原来的6X是巨大的改进。只要别让机师朝超出射程的目标开火，热量应该可控。ZH

column1: The 5C is a weird one, no official creator exists in the records of the design but the 'Mech was produced at several factories at one point of time. A slight rebuild of the classic TRC-4B, the variant does not introduce any major changes except moving the internals around. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: 5C 是一个古怪的型号：设计档案中查不到任何官方设计者，但该机甲曾一度在多家工厂同时生产。它是对经典 TRC-4B 的小幅重构，除了调整内部构件的布局之外，并没有引入任何重大改动。特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.02

column1: A Clan refurbished version of the TRC-4B, replacing its internals with Clan versions but keeping all weapon systems from the original 'Mech. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 这是 TRC-4B 的部族翻新型，其内部构件全部换为部族版本，但保留了原机甲的全部武器系统。特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.08

column1: The personal 'Mech of Force Commander Pasi Irin assigned to the First Free Worlds Legionnaires, this custom variant replaces the SRM-6 w/Artemis IV with a pair of Streak SRM-2 and additional armor. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是配属第一自由世界军团的部队指挥官 Pasi Irin 的专属机甲。这款定制改型用一对连发 SRM-2 和额外装甲取代了带阿尔忒弥斯 IV 的 SRM-6。特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The personal 'Mech of Force Commander Pasi Irin assigned to the First Free Worlds Legionnaires, this custom variant replaces the SRM-6 w/Artemis IV with a pair of Streak SRM-2 and additional armor.
column2: 这是配属第一自由世界步兵团的部队指挥官帕西·伊林的私人机甲，这一定制改型把带阿尔忒弥斯IV的SRM-6换成两具连发SRM-2，并增加装甲。ZH

column1: One of the so-called \"Clanbuster\" variants developed in 3052 by ComStar in the lead-up to the Battle of Tukayyid, this variant is a major upgrade that replaces the standard fusion engine with a lighter but more vulnerable 300-rated ExtraLight engine, the heat sinks have been upgraded to double heat sinks and two Large Lasers, surplus from the Clanbuster upgrade of the Wyvern, have been added to the 'Mech's unoccupied arms. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是通讯之星在Tukayyid战役前夕于3052年研发的所谓“部族克星”变型之一。该变型是一次重大升级：标准聚变引擎被替换为更轻但更脆弱的300级超轻型引擎，散热器升级为双散热器，并将Wyvern部族克星升级中富余的两门大型激光加装到机甲空置的双臂上。特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: One of the so-called \"Clanbuster\" variants developed in 3052 by ComStar in the lead-up to the Battle of Tukayyid, this variant is a major upgrade that replaces the standard fusion engine with a lighter but more vulnerable 300-rated ExtraLight engine, the heat sinks have been upgraded to double heat sinks and two Large Lasers, surplus from the Clanbuster upgrade of the Wyvern, have been added to the 'Mech's unoccupied arms.
column2: 这是3052年图卡伊迪战役前夕由通讯之星研制的所谓“部族克星”变型之一。它是一次重大升级：以更轻但更脆弱的300额定超轻型引擎取代标准聚变引擎，散热器升级为双散热器，并在机甲空置的手臂上加装两门大型激光——它们来自飞龙的部族克星升级项目余料。ZH

column1: The 3P is the newest variant of the Champion, introduced in 3061. The 'Mech's arsenal has been completely upgraded to modern standards with the complete removal of all of its weapons. In their place this version of the Champion carries four ER Medium Lasers, one in each arm. An Ultra Autocannon/10 replaces the LB-X Autocannon and the SRM-6 has been replaced by an improved Narc Missile Beacon. In addition, the ExtraLight engine used in the 3N has been retained and an improved C3 computer was added to allow the Champion to work as part of a 6-unit C3 network. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 3P是Champion最新的变型，于3061年推出。该机甲的武库已按现代标准全面升级，原有武器被尽数拆除。取而代之的是，这一版本的Champion搭载四门增程中型激光，每臂各一门。一门Ultra自动炮/10替换了LB-X自动炮，SRM-6则被改进型Narc导弹信标取代。此外，3N所使用的超轻型引擎得以保留，并增设了一台改进型C3计算机，使Champion能够作为6单位C3网络的一环运作。特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The 3P is the newest variant of the Champion, introduced in 3061. The 'Mech's arsenal has been completely upgraded to modern standards with the complete removal of all of its weapons. In their place this version of the Champion carries four ER Medium Lasers, one in each arm. An Ultra Autocannon/10 replaces the LB-X Autocannon and the SRM-6 has been replaced by an improved Narc Missile Beacon. In addition, the ExtraLight engine used in the 3N has been retained and an improved C3 computer was added to allow the Champion to work as part of a 6-unit C3 network.
column2: 3P是冠军的最新改型，于3061年推出。该机甲的武库已完全按现代标准升级，所有武器都被彻底替换。取而代之的是，这一版冠军携带四门增程中型激光器，每臂一门。一门超速自动炮/10取代LB-X自动炮，SRM-6则换成一具改进型Narc导弹信标。此外，3N使用的超轻型引擎被保留，并加装一台改进型C3计算机，让冠军能作为6单位C3网络的一部分运作。ZH

column1: An upgraded Champion with Clantech, the Champion C is simply an updated Champion 1N2. Built in 2867 it uses an XL engine with the weight saved going into the addition of 5 jump jets that enable the 'Mech to jump up to 150 meters at a time. The medium lasers were upgraded to Medium Pulse Lasers and a pair of ER Medium Lasers were added. The small lasers are also upgraded to Small Pulse Lasers. The rest of the weaponry is upgraded to Clan standards and the remaining tonnage went to additional armor. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 冠军 C（Champion C）是采用部族科技升级的冠军，实质上就是更新版的冠军 1N2。它于 2867 年建造，使用 XL 引擎，节省下来的重量用于加装 5 具跳跃推进器，使该机甲一次最多可跳跃 150 米。中型激光升级为中型脉冲激光，并新增了两门增程中型激光。小型激光也升级为小型脉冲激光。其余武器均升级至部族标准，剩余的吨位则用于增加装甲。特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: An upgraded Champion with Clantech, the Champion C is simply an updated Champion 1N2. Built in 2867 it uses an XL engine with the weight saved going into the addition of 5 jump jets that enable the 'Mech to jump up to 150 meters at a time. The medium lasers were upgraded to Medium Pulse Lasers and a pair of ER Medium Lasers were added. The small lasers are also upgraded to Small Pulse Lasers. The rest of the weaponry is upgraded to Clan standards and the remaining tonnage went to additional armor.
column2: 冠军C是用部族技术升级的冠军式，本质上就是更新版的冠军1N2。它制造于2867年，采用XL引擎，节省下来的重量用于加装5个跳跃推进器，使机甲一次可跳跃至多150米。中型激光升级为中型脉冲激光，并新增两门增程中型激光。小型激光也升级为小型脉冲激光。其余武器均升级至部族标准，剩余吨位则用于增加装甲。ZH

column1: An upgrade of the 3K, the Charger CGR-C was modified to carry a C3 Slave unit that allowed it to share targeting data with other 'Mechs in its unit. In order to add the slave unit, a medium pulse laser had to be removed from the design. The left over mass went towards extra ammunition for the LRM launcher. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 作为3K的升级型，Charger CGR-C经过改装以搭载C3从属单元，使其能够与本单位内其他机甲共享瞄准数据。为了加装该从属单元，设计上不得不移除一门中型脉冲激光。剩下的重量则用于为LRM发射器增加额外弹药。特性：枪管拳 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: An upgrade of the 3K, the Charger CGR-C was modified to carry a C3 Slave unit that allowed it to share targeting data with other 'Mechs in its unit. In order to add the slave unit, a medium pulse laser had to be removed from the design. The left over mass went towards extra ammunition for the LRM launcher.
column2: 作为3K的升级版，冲锋者CGR-C经过改装以携带一套C3从属系统，使它能与本单位其他机甲共享瞄准数据。为了加装从属系统，必须从设计中拆除一门中型脉冲激光器。剩余的重量则用于为LRM发射器增加弹药。ZH

column1: A simple refit of the -1A1, replacing three of the Small Lasers and some of the armor for a Medium Laser and a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 对-1A1的简易改装：拆除三具小型激光和部分装甲，换装一具中型激光和一个C3从属单元。特性：枪管拳 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: An attempt to make the early Charger models more successful by downgrading the 400 engine to a 320 core. The freed up weight allows both considerably more armor as a much different weapons mix of weapons - a Large Laser, a PPC and three Medium Lasers. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 通过将400引擎降级为320核心，试图让早期型的Charger型号获得更好的表现。省下的重量既带来了大幅增加的装甲，也带来了截然不同的武器组合——一门大型激光、一门粒子加农炮和三门中型激光。特性：枪管拳 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: A melee-focused variation of the CGR-1A5 model introduced in 3028, the 1P5 retains the lasers and SRM racks but downgrades the AC/20 for an much smaller AC/5 to free up the weight for an assault Battle Axe carried in the right arm. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 1P5是3028年推出的CGR-1A5型号的近战向变体，它保留了激光与SRM发射槽，但把AC/20降级为小得多的AC/5，以腾出重量在右臂携带一把突击型战斧。特性：枪管拳 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: A very unusual total refit of the Charger, it's origins uncertain but likely some blackshop in the periphery as it is only used by pirates and other unsavory groups. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 这是对 Charger 一次极为罕见的大改，来历不明，很可能出自外围地区的某家黑作坊，因为只有海盗和其他不三不四的团体才使用它。特性：炮管铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: Terry Ford's \"Number Seven\" is built around an 320-rated standard engine, the slower engine allows it to retain the 'Mech's ten tons of armor and head mounted small laser while freeing up weight to carry a Large Laser in each side torso supported by a Medium Laser in each arm and the right torso. Twenty-five single heat sinks and four jump jets ensure Number Seven surprising mobility and endurance in battle. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 特里·福特的“七号”围绕额定 320 的标准引擎打造。较慢的引擎使它得以保留机甲原有的十吨装甲和头部安装的小型激光，同时腾出重量，在两侧躯干各装一门大型激光，并由每条手臂和右躯干各一门中型激光提供支援。二十五个单散热器和四具跳跃推进器，使“七号”在战斗中拥有出人意料的机动性与续航能力。特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂

column1: Terry Ford's \"Number Seven\" is built around an 320-rated standard engine, the slower engine allows it to retain the 'Mech's ten tons of armor and head mounted small laser while freeing up weight to carry a Large Laser in each side torso supported by a Medium Laser in each arm and the right torso. Twenty-five single heat sinks and four jump jets ensure Number Seven surprising mobility and endurance in battle.
column2: 特里·福特的“七号”围绕一台320额定标准引擎建造。较慢的引擎让它得以保留机甲的十吨装甲和头部小型激光，同时腾出重量在两侧躯干各装一门大型激光，并由每只手臂和右躯干的中型激光支援。二十五个单散热器和四具跳跃推进器确保“七号”在战斗中拥有惊人的机动性与持续力。ZH

column1: Punch Bot started as an standard CGR-1A1 of a lance sized merc unit with limited funds available. The first pilot repeatedly threw his 'Mech first into every tough situation hoping to to be able to collect the insurance on the Charger, but the 'Mech just wouldn't die. Eventually the unit realized they could save over 10 tons by replacing the LTV 400 Engine with a GM 380 out of a salvaged Banshee. The then dropped 5 of those tons of the 'Mech's overall weight to keep the same top speed. The extra tonnage allowed them to embrace Punch Bot's usual tactics by mounting Jump Jets, a ton and a half extra armor and upgraded arm actuators. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
column2: 拳击机器人起初是一个经费有限的排级雇佣兵单位的一台标准CGR-1A1。首位机师反复把机甲第一个扔进每个险境，指望能靠冲锋者拿到保险金，可这台机甲就是死不了。最终该部队意识到，用一台从废弃女妖上拆下的GM 380替换LTV 400引擎，能省下十吨以上。他们随后又削掉其中5吨总重量以保持同样的最高速度。多出的吨位让他们得以拥抱拳击机器人的惯用战术：装跳跃推进器、一吨半额外装甲，并升级手臂驱动器。特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.13

column1: An interesting departure from standard 'Mech design, deciding to use the Chargers speed and dedicate it to beating heavy and assault 'Mechs into scrap with it's fists.
column2: 这是对标准机甲设计一次有趣的偏离——决定利用冲锋者的速度，把它专门用于用拳头把重型与突击机甲砸成废铁。ZH

column1: The 2G is a Clan conversion of the Cicada, although its purpose is unknown it does allow the 'Mech to perform better and fit more advanced electronic warfare components. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 2G是蝉式机甲经部族技术改造而成的型号。尽管其用途不明，但它确实让这台机甲性能更佳，并能容纳更先进的电子战部件。特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Introduced in 2740, the 40 ton Cicada was developed as a competitor to the Locust. Slightly better armed and just as fast, the Cicada’s heavier armor and better melee capabilities enable it to function as an effective Light Mech hunter and scout. Powered by a 320-rated Fusion Core, the Cicada 2A is armed with a pair of Medium Lasers and a Small Laser.
column2: 40吨的蝉于2740年推出，是为与蝗虫竞争而研制。它武装略强、速度相当，而更厚的装甲与更好的近战能力使它成为有效的轻型机甲猎手与侦察机。蝉2A由一台320额定聚变核心驱动，装有两门中型激光和一门小型激光。ZH

column1: Introduced in 2740, the 40 ton Cicada was developed as a competitor to the Locust. Slightly better armed and just as fast, the Cicada’s heavier armor and better melee capabilities enable it to function as an effective Light Mech hunter and scout. Powered by a 320-rated XL Engine, the prototype Cicada X5 is armed with quad Medium Lasers and a pair of SRM-2’s. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 40吨的蝉于2740年推出，是为与蝗虫竞争而研制。它武装略强、速度相当，而更厚的装甲与更好的近战能力使它成为有效的轻型机甲猎手与侦察机。原型蝉X5由一台320额定XL引擎驱动，装四门中型激光和两具SRM-2。特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Introduced in 2740, the 40 ton Cicada was developed as a competitor to the Locust. Slightly better armed and just as fast, the Cicada’s heavier armor and better melee capabilities enable it to function as an effective Light Mech hunter and scout. Powered by a 320-rated XL Engine, the prototype Cicada X5 is armed with quad Medium Lasers and a pair of SRM-2’s.
column2: 蝉于2740年推出，这种40吨机甲是作为蝗虫的竞争者而研发的。武装略好、速度相当，蝉更厚的装甲与更强的近战能力使它成为有效的轻型机甲猎手与侦察兵。蝉X5原型由一具320级XL引擎驱动，武装为四门中型激光器和两具SRM-2。ZH

column1: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty meters, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. This custom model exchanges the Autocannon/5 with a Large Laser and four Heat Sinks. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: Clint 最初是作为廉价侦察单位设计的，却具备武装精良的低端中型机甲的作战能力，在这方面它表现相当出色。其最高速度为 97.2 km/h，跳跃距离达一百八十米，能轻松跟上其他侦察单位，并在山地或城市地形中灵活机动。这款定制型号用一门大型激光和四具散热器换掉了自动炮/5。特性：可变距离瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty meters, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. This custom model exchanges the Autocannon/5 with a Large Laser and four Heat Sinks.
column2: 克林特主要被设计为一种廉价的侦察单位，具备武装良好、低端中型机甲的作战能力，在这点上它表现出色。凭借97.2公里/小时的最高速度和一百八十米的跳跃能力，克林特能轻松跟上其他侦察单位，并在山地或城市地形中机动。这台定制型号把自动炮/5换成了一门大型激光器和四具散热器。ZH

column1: A battlefield refit of the CLNT-2-3T, replacing one of the medium lasers for a small laser and CASE protection to the autocannon ammunition. Two jump jets are also removed to enable the use of a C3 Slave unit. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这是 CLNT-2-3T 的战场改装：将其中一门中型激光换为小型激光，并为自动炮弹药加装 CASE 防护。此外还拆除了两具跳跃推进器，以便使用 C3 从属单元。特性：可变距离瞄准 投放费用倍率：1 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: A full conversion of the standard Clint to Clan tech, used by the famous elite mercenary unit the Gray Death Legion. By using both Ferro-Fibrous armor and an Endo-Steel chassis the design manages to fit an Ultra AC/5 and three ER Medium Lasers, making the 40 ton 'Mech capable to deliver an unexpectedly heavy strike. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这是将标准型克林特全面改装为部族科技的产物，由著名精锐雇佣兵部队灰死军团使用。通过同时采用铁纤维装甲与钢内骨结构底盘，该设计成功装下了一门超级AC/5和三门增程中型激光，让这台40吨机甲能够打出出人意料的沉重一击。特性：可变距离瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty meters, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. Produced by the Taurian Concordat at the outbreak of the Jihad, the 3-3T modifies the original 2-3T. It adds Ferro-Fibrous armor to the design and swaps out the AC/5 with a Light AC/5, presumably supplied to them by the Word of Blake. This lighter weapon makes room for the inclusion of CASE and two tons of ammunition, ensuring it is able to carry various types of munitions.
column2: 克林特主要被设计为一种廉价的侦察单位，具备武装良好、低端中型机甲的作战能力，在这点上它表现出色。凭借97.2公里/小时的最高速度和一百八十米的跳跃能力，克林特能轻松跟上其他侦察单位，并在山地或城市地形中机动。由陶里安协约国在圣战爆发时生产，3-3T改装自原本的2-3T。它为该设计增加了铁纤装甲，并把AC/5换成轻型AC/5——想必是布雷克之言提供给他们的。这件更轻的武器为加装CASE和两吨弹药腾出了空间，确保它能携带多种弹药。ZH

column1: A mercenary refit of the Clint CLNT-3-3T using acquired clan tech. Mounting an Ultra AC/5 and three ER Medium Lasers, made possibly by use of both Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel structure, making it considerably better armed than its base variant. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这是雇佣兵利用取得的部族技术对克林特CLNT-3-3T的改装。它装有一门超级AC/5和三门增程中型激光，靠铁纤维装甲与钢内骨结构才得以实现，武装明显优于基础变型。特性：可变距离瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: The CRH-2B distinguishes itself through an unusual density of reinforced components, including an armored cockpit, armored engine shielding, a defensive-rated gyro, and reinforced leg and arm actuators that resist crippling damage. Ferro-Fibrous armor plating keeps weight manageable despite this added bulk, while internal spall liners reduce the risk of catastrophic crew or component loss from penetrating hits. Armed with twin PPCs and three Medium Lasers, and fitted with assault-class jump jets for repositioning, the CRH-2B remains a stubbornly difficult mech to put down for good. Quirk: Reinforced Structure Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: CRH-2B的独特之处在于强化部件密度异常之高：装甲驾驶舱、装甲引擎屏蔽、防御级陀螺仪，以及能抵抗致残伤害的加固腿部与手臂驱动器。尽管增加了这些体积，铁纤维装甲板仍让重量保持可控，而内部崩落衬层则降低了穿透命中导致乘员或部件灾难性损失的风险。CRH-2B装双粒子加农炮与三门中型激光，并配突击级跳跃推进器用于重新站位，是一台顽固得难以彻底击倒的机甲。特性：加固结构 投放费用倍率：1.14

column1: Defensive Juggernaut
column2: 防御型主宰者

column1: Designed in the waning years of the Star League to bolster SLDF garrisons amid mounting civil unrest, the Cockroach prioritized survivability above all else, trading offensive punch for unmatched resilience under fire. Following the Amaris Civil War, production blueprints scattered across the Inner Sphere, picked up intermittently by various manufacturers ever since. Now an uncommon but unsurprising sight in garrison forces of nearly every major faction, with scattered units even reaching Periphery militias.
column2: 蟑螂在星盟末期设计，用于在内乱加剧之际强化星盟防卫军驻军，它把生存性置于一切之上，以牺牲进攻打击力换取无与伦比的抗打击能力。阿马里斯内战之后，其生产蓝图散落内天体各地，此后被各家制造商断断续续地拾起。如今它几乎在每个主要势力的驻军中都能见到——虽不常见却也并不令人意外，零星机体甚至流入外围区民兵手中。ZH

column1: The CRH-2Br is a common field refit of the original CRH-2B, replacing its single heat sinks with double heat sinks throughout. This simple upgrade allows the Cockroach's twin PPCs to fire more frequently without risking shutdown, meaningfully improving sustained combat performance while leaving the chassis's signature armor, reinforced actuators, and defensive systems entirely untouched. Quirk: Reinforced Structure Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: CRH-2Br是CRH-2B常见的野战改装，把单散热器全面换成双散热器。这项简单升级让蟑螂的双粒子加农炮能更频繁地射击而不必担心停机，显著改善持续战斗表现，同时完全不动其标志性装甲、加固驱动器和防御系统。特性：加固结构 投放费用倍率：1.16

column1: The CRH-4H represents a significant rework of the original CRH-2B, upgrading its twin PPCs to ER PPCs for greater range and replacing single heat sinks with double heat sinks throughout to support them. A Guardian ECM Suite has been added for electronic protection, and Reinforced Internal Structure further bolsters the chassis's already formidable durability. These additions come at a slight cost to armor coverage, though the CRH-4H remains every bit as difficult to bring down as its predecessor. Quirk: Reinforced Structure Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: CRH-4H 是对原始 CRH-2B 的一次重大改造：将成对的粒子加农炮升级为增程粒子加农炮以获得更大射程，并全面以双散热器替换单散热器来支撑它们。它还加装了 Guardian 电子对抗套件以提供电子防护，而强化内部结构则进一步增强了机体本就强悍的耐用性。这些改动以略微削减装甲覆盖为代价，不过 CRH-4H 依旧如前代一样难以被击倒。特性：强化结构 投放费用倍率：1.16

column1: The CRH-4H2 builds directly on the CRH-4H, upgrading all three Medium Lasers to Medium Pulse Lasers and adding a fourth in the center torso for substantially improved close-range accuracy and output. An Advanced Targeting Computer and additional energy and heat tracking systems further sharpen its weapons' effectiveness, supported by extra heat sinks in both arms. To accommodate this expanded and refined arsenal, the CRH-4H2 sacrifices its jump jets entirely — a trade-off that grounds the design but leaves its renowned armor and defensive systems fully intact. Quirk: Reinforced Structure Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: CRH-4H2直接以CRH-4H为基础，把三门中型激光全部升级为中型脉冲激光，并在中央躯干加装第四门，近距精度与输出显著提升。一台先进瞄准计算机与额外的能量和热量追踪系统进一步强化了武器效能，双臂还加了额外散热器。为容纳这套扩充且精炼的武器，CRH-4H2完全牺牲了跳跃推进器——这一取舍让该设计失去了跳跃能力，但其著名的装甲与防御系统完好无损。特性：加固结构 投放费用倍率：1.16

column1: The original Colossus design, introduced in 3053, carried a standard AC/20, and a Large Pulse Laser teamed with a Medium Pulse Laser in each arm. Like the updated version, this prototype could jump 90 meters. The armor protection remained the same, but it carried three Coolant Pods in the right and left torsos instead of the shields that would later appear on the CLS-4S. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 最初的巨像设计于3053年推出，带一门标准AC/20，每只手臂则有一门大型脉冲激光配一门中型脉冲激光。与更新版本一样，此原型可跳跃90米。装甲防护保持不变，但它在左右躯干装了三个冷却剂罐，而非后来出现在CLS-4S上的护盾。特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: A Solaris VII BattleMech, the Colossus was one of the first 'Mechs to use X-Pulse Lasers. Bethel Labs, the developers of the X-Pulse technology, wanted a demonstrator for their new technology. Omnitech Industries brushed off their Colossus design and the rest is history. Using a standard engine, Endo Steel chassis, and armor, the Colossus can take enormous amounts of damage. Though not a particularly fast 'Mech, it does move at the same rate as the Atlas and other assault 'Mechs. In addition it has a 90 meter jump capability which can maneuver it out of trouble.
column2: 作为一台索拉里斯VII战斗机甲，巨像是首批使用X脉冲激光器的机甲之一。X脉冲技术的开发者贝塞尔实验室想为他们的新技术做一个展示机。全能科技工业翻出他们的巨像设计，余下的就成了历史。它采用标准引擎、内层钢底盘和装甲，能承受巨量伤害。虽然不算特别快，它的移动速度与阿特拉斯及其他突击机甲相当。此外它还有90米的跳跃能力，可以机动脱离麻烦。ZH

column1: The 2A is an unofficial refit of the 2D, adding one and a half ton of armor and switching from single to double heat sinks. The SRM-6 launcher is converted to a hand-mounted SRM-4, and the Medium Laser moved to a side torso. The 'Mech also adds protection against internal ammunition explosions in form of a C.A.S.E. system. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: 2A是对2D的非官方改装，增加了一吨半装甲，并将单散热器换成双散热器。SRM-6发射器被改为手持式SRM-4，中型激光则移至侧躯干。该机甲还以C.A.S.E.系统的形式增添了针对内部弹药爆炸的防护。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

column1: The 2A is an unofficial refit of the 2D, adding one and a half ton of armor and switching from single to double heat sinks. The SRM-6 launcher is converted to a hand-mounted SRM-4, and the Medium Laser moved to a side torso. The 'Mech also adds protection against internal ammunition explosions in form of a C.A.S.E. system.
column2: 2A是2D的非官方改装，增加一吨半装甲，并把单重散热器改为双重散热器。SRM-6发射器被改为手持式SRM-4，中型激光器移到侧躯干。该机甲还以C.A.S.E.系统的形式增加了对内部弹药爆炸的防护。ZH

column1: A refit of the 2D chassis removing all the missiles and instead adds three more Medium Lasers and six Small Lasers, along with an extra ton of armor. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: 2D 底盘的改装型，拆除了全部导弹，改为加装三具中型激光和六具小型激光，并额外增加一吨装甲。特性：改进冷却套 - 激光 投放费用倍率：0.96

column1: A variant of the -2D that drops the Medium Laser to replace it with a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: 这是-2D的变型，拆掉中型激光，换成一台C3从机。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

column1: A variant of the -2D that drops the Medium Laser to replace it with a C3 slave unit.
column2: 这是-2D的一个改型，拆掉中型激光器，换上一套C3从属系统。ZH

column1: A battlefield refit of the 2D, the 2J mounts 6 jump jets and replaces the SRM-6 with a SRM-4 launcher. The 'Mech further uses double heat sinks to support the increased heat build up from the jump jets. To be able to carry the weight of the jump jets, the 2J uses an XL engine core and Ferro-Fibrous armor. This does however mean that an extra ton of armor and a C.A.S.E. system can be added. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 2J 是 2D 的战地改装型，安装了 6 台跳跃推进器，并以 SRM-4 发射器取代 SRM-6。该机甲还采用双散热器，以应对跳跃推进器带来的额外热量积聚。为了承受跳跃推进器的重量，2J 使用 XL 引擎核心和铁纤维装甲，不过这也意味着还能额外增加一吨装甲并加装 C.A.S.E. 系统。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.98

column1: A battlefield refit of the 2D, the 2J mounts 6 jump jets and replaces the SRM-6 with a SRM-4 launcher. The 'Mech further uses double heat sinks to support the increased heat build up from the jump jets. To be able to carry the weight of the jump jets, the 2J uses an XL engine core and Ferro-Fibrous armor. This does however mean that an extra ton of armor and a C.A.S.E. system can be added.
column2: 作为2D的战地改装，2J装6个跳跃推进器，并把SRM-6换成SRM-4发射器。该机甲还使用双重散热器以应对跳跃推进器带来的额外积热。为承载跳跃推进器的重量，2J采用XL引擎核心和铁纤装甲。不过这确实意味着可以加装额外一吨装甲和一套C.A.S.E.系统。ZH

column1: Another common refit of the COM-2D is the 2P, which adds a Large Laser at the cost of only keeping a downgraded SRM-2 launcher. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: COM-2D 另一种常见的改装是 2P，它增加了一门大型激光，代价是仅保留一具降级的 SRM-2 发射器。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

column1: Another common refit of the COM-2D is the 2P, which adds a Large Laser at the cost of only keeping a downgraded SRM-2 launcher.
column2: COM-2D另一个常见的改装是2P，它以只保留降级版SRM-2发射器为代价，加装了一门大型激光器。ZH

column1: Five tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, an XL engine, double heat sinks, C.A.S.E. system and an extra Medium laser makes the 2W quite a refit of the 2D. To make it even more interesting the SRM-6 has been replaced by a Streak SRM-4 launcher. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 五吨铁纤维装甲、一台XL引擎、双散热器、C.A.S.E.系统和一门额外中型激光，使2W成为对2D相当彻底的改装。更有意思的是，SRM-6被换成了连发SRM-4发射器。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.98

column1: Five tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, an XL engine, double heat sinks, C.A.S.E. system and an extra Medium laser makes the 2W quite a refit of the 2D. To make it even more interesting the SRM-6 has been replaced by a Streak SRM-4 launcher.
column2: 五吨铁纤装甲、一具XL引擎、双重散热器、C.A.S.E.系统和一门额外中型激光器，使2W成为对2D相当大的一次改装。为了更有意思，SRM-6被换成了连发SRM-4发射器。ZH

column1: A strange variant of the Commando that is focused more on durability than most other variants, the 3H only mounts a single Large Laser. Instead, it carries a full 2 extra tons of armor and an extra heat sink. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: 3H 是 Commando 的一个特殊变型，相比其他大多数变型更注重耐用性，因此仅安装了一门大型激光，取而代之的是整整多出两吨的装甲和一具额外散热器。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

column1: A strange variant of the Commando that is focused more on durability than most other variants, the 3H only mounts a single Large Laser. Instead, it carries a full 2 extra tons of armor and an extra heat sink.
column2: 这是突击队员一种奇怪的改型，比大多数改型更注重耐久，3H只装有一门大型激光器。取而代之的是，它携带了整整多出2吨的装甲和一具额外散热器。ZH

column1: The 3H2 mounts a Large Laser and a Small Laser, protected by 5.5 tons of armor. This makes it more durable than a 2D, allowing it to remain scouting for a longer time on the battlefield. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: 3H2装有一门大型激光和一门小型激光，由5.5吨装甲保护。这使它比2D更耐久，能够在战场上坚持侦察更长时间。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

column1: The 3H2 mounts a Large Laser and a Small Laser, protected by 5.5 tons of armor. This makes it more durable than a 2D, allowing it to remain scouting for a longer time on the battlefield.
column2: 3H2装有一门大型激光和一门小型激光，由5.5吨装甲保护。这使它比2D更耐久，能在战场上保持更久的侦察状态。ZH

column1: The best armored of the of the -7 series, the -7A still manages to fit a total of 200 C.A.S.E. protected SRM missiles for its two SRM-4 launchers. A single Medium Laser in the Left Arm is the only other weapon of the variant. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: -7A是-7系列中装甲最厚的一款，却仍能为其两具SRM-4发射器携带总计200枚受C.A.S.E.保护的SRM导弹。左臂的一门中型激光是该变型唯一的其他武器。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

column1: Long the darling of the Lyran Commonwealth's scouting formations, the Commando has enjoyed vast success over its seven centuries of service. Once exclusively Lyran, the Succession Wars spread the capable little 'Mech to various mercenary companies, where a score of variants commonly called the -7 series emerged. Thrifty mercenaries often swap missile racks for energy independence, and the Commando is a common sight in Mech-it-Lube franchise refit bays.
column2: 作为莱兰联邦侦察编队长期的心头好，突击队员在其七个世纪服役中取得了巨大成功。它曾为莱兰独有，继承战争把这款能干的小机甲传播到各家佣兵部队，并涌现出被称为"-7 系列"的众多变体。节俭的佣兵常用导弹挂架换取能量武器的后勤独立性，因此突击队员在"Mech-it-Lube"连锁改装店里随处可见。ZH

column1: Similar to the -7A in weapons loadout with two SRM-4 launchers and a Medium Laser, the -7J mounts five jump jets instead of the extra armor and ammunition of the -7A. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: -7J的武器配置与-7A相似，同为2具SRM-4发射器和1门中型激光，但它用5具跳跃推进器替代了-7A上额外的装甲与弹药。<特性：狭小/低矮外形 <投放费用倍率：0.96

column1: The -7W reaches for longevity with extra ammo and a Streak SRM-2 launcher. Task Force Serpent used these variants to great effect on Huntress, prompting Coventry Metal Works to dedicate factory space to producing official re-creations. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: -7W以额外弹药和一具连发SRM-2发射器追求持久力。蛇特遣队在亨特雷斯上大量使用这些变型并效果卓著，促使考文垂金属厂专门腾出厂房生产官方复刻版。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.98

column1: A 4th Succession war variant that saw limited production, the 7X variant exchanges the SRM-4 for an additional 2 medium lasers but is otherwise identical to the standard Commando. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: 7X是第四次继承战争时期产量有限的变型，以额外2门中型激光取代SRM-4，其余与标准突击兵完全相同。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

column1: A 4th Succession war variant that saw limited production, the 7X variant exchanges the SRM-4 for an additional 2 medium lasers but is otherwise identical to the standard Commando.
column2: 这是第四次继承战争中产量有限的改型，7X把SRM-4换成额外两门中型激光器，其余与标准突击队员完全相同。ZH

column1: The COM-7Y swaps the -2D's SRM-4 for two more medium lasers and another ton of armor in an attempt to improve the Commando's longevity on the battlefield. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: COM-7Y以两门额外中型激光和另一吨装甲取代-2D的SRM-4，意在提升突击兵在战场上的存续力。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

column1: The -7Y2 is more than just a sub-variant of the -7Y, it has become so famous and beloved it earned its own nickname of the 'Blazing Inferno'. It sacrifices the SRM launchers, but instead adds 6 small lasers. The only downside of the variant is its quite bad cooling capabilities considering all its weapons. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: -7Y2 不只是 -7Y 的子改型，它已经太过出名、太受欢迎，以至于获得了自己的绰号“炽烈地狱”。它舍弃了 SRM 发射器，改为加装 6 门小型激光。该改型唯一的缺点在于，考虑到它的全部武器，其散热能力相当糟糕。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

column1: The recovery of Cellular Ammunition Storage Equipment technology saw the emergence of a new more durable variant of the Commando, the -7Z. To fit the C.A.S.E. system the variant drops one of the -7Y's Medium Lasers, but also adds a bit more armor. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: 随着细胞式弹药储存设备技术的重获，Commando出现了一种更耐用的新型改款——7Z。为了容纳C.A.S.E.系统，该改型舍弃了7Y的一门中型激光，但也增加了一些装甲。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

column1: A sub-variant of the -7Z, the Commando COM-7Z2 downgrades the two Medium Lasers to Small Lasers to be able to fit a Beagle Active Probe. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: Commando COM-7Z2是7Z的子改型，将两门中型激光降级为小型激光，以便装下一具Beagle主动探测器。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.98

column1: Built on an Endo Steel chassis, the 9D combines a 200 XL engine with 5 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, two Medium Lasers and a Streak SRM-6 launcher. A ton of streak ammunition and an Beagle Active Probe finishes the design. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 9D 以钢内骨结构底盘打造，整合了 200 XL 引擎、5 吨铁纤维装甲、两门中型激光和一部连发 SRM-6 发射器。一吨连发弹药和一部 Beagle 主动探测器构成了这套设计的收尾。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.98

column1: Built on an Endo Steel chassis, the 9D combines a 200 XL engine with 5 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, two Medium Lasers and a Streak SRM-6 launcher. A ton of streak ammunition and an Beagle Active Probe finishes the design.
column2: 9D建在内层钢底盘上，把一具200 XL引擎与5吨铁纤装甲、两门中型激光器和一具连发SRM-6发射器结合起来。一吨连发弹药和一个比格犬主动探测器补全该设计。ZH

column1: A refresh of the 9D, the 9DA replaces the Medium Lasers with Small Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 9DA是9D的改良型，用小型脉冲激光替换了中型激光。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.98

column1: A refresh of the 9D, the 9DA replaces the Medium Lasers with Small Pulse Lasers.
column2: 作为9D的更新版，9DA把中型激光器换成小型脉冲激光器。ZH

column1: The Commando R2D2, except for having a very strange designation, is a pretty standard looking refit of the 2D replacing the Medium Laser with a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: 突击兵R2D2除了有个非常奇怪的编号之外，就是对2D相当标准的改装，以一台C3从机取代中型激光。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.96

column1: A unique Commando piloted by Captain Bono Duganmare of the 22nd Skye Rangers, the \"Death's Knell\"; is refitted with recovered LosTech. Swapping the standard SRM racks for an additional 3 Medium lasers, allows the TDK’s engine to be refitted with a 175 core. The inclusion of DHS keeps the mech comfortably cool. An extra half ton of armor round out the design. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 第22斯凯游骑兵上尉博诺·杜根梅尔驾驶的一台独特突击兵“丧钟”，装上了回收的失落科技。它以额外3门中型激光取代标准SRM挂架，使这台TDK的引擎得以换装175核心。双散热器的加入让机甲保持舒适的温度，另加半吨装甲为该设计收尾。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.03

column1: A unique Commando piloted by Captain Bono Duganmare of the 22nd Skye Rangers, the \"Death's Knell\"; is refitted with recovered LosTech. Swapping the standard SRM racks for an additional 3 Medium lasers, allows the TDK’s engine to be refitted with a 175 core. The inclusion of DHS keeps the mech comfortably cool. An extra half ton of armor round out the design.
column2: 这是第22斯凯游骑兵的博诺·杜根梅尔上尉驾驶的一台独特突击队员，名为"丧钟"；它以回收的失传科技改装。把标准SRM架换成额外3门中型激光器，使TDK的引擎得以改配175核心。加入双重散热器让该机甲保持舒适凉爽。另加半吨装甲补全设计。ZH

column1: Commando IIC
column2: 突击队员 IIC

column1: Designed as a successor to the Wolverine, the Conjurer is a 50-ton Mech seen in Clan Second Line formations. Powered by a 300-rated Fusion Core, the Conjurer CJR-7 mounts 6 Jump jets. A Large Pulse Laser and 2 LRM-5’s form the bulk of the CJR-7’s weapons, with a pair of ER Medium Lasers for close combat. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 幻术师作为狼獾的后继型号而设计，是部族二线编队中得见的50吨机甲。它由一台300额定聚变核心驱动，幻术师CJR-7装6具跳跃推进器。一门大型脉冲激光和2具LRM-5构成CJR-7武器的大部分，另有一对增程中型激光用于混战。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.1

column1: Designed as a successor to the Wolverine, the Conjurer is a 50-ton Mech seen in Clan Second Line formations. Powered by a 300-rated Fusion Core, the Conjurer CJR-7 mounts 6 Jump jets. A Large Pulse Laser and 2 LRM-5’s form the bulk of the CJR-7’s weapons, with a pair of ER Medium Lasers for close combat.
column2: 作为狼獾的后继者而设计，咒术师是一种出现在氏族二线编队中的50吨机甲。咒术师CJR-7由一具300级聚变核心驱动，装6个跳跃推进器。一门大型脉冲激光器和2具LRM-5构成CJR-7的主要武器，另有一对增程中型激光器用于混战。ZH

column1: The Corona is a battle armor design that was created by Clan Star Adder following the Trials to determine which Clans would take part in Operation REVIVAL. The idea was to build the battlesuit around a weapon that could threaten 'Mechs from a distance. The mass necessary to mount such a heavy weapon resulted in a twenty percent armor decrease and the removal of the jump pack, despite a fifty percent overall increase in mass. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.935 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: 科罗娜是星蝰部族在决定哪些部族参与“复兴行动”的试炼之后所创造的战斗装甲设计。其构想是围绕一件能从远处威胁机甲的武器来打造这套战斗服。安装如此沉重的武器所需的重量，导致装甲减少百分之二十并取消了跳跃背包，尽管整体重量增加了百分之五十。特性：威慑 投放费用倍率：0.935 可搭载全向单位，可进行近战，无法发动蜂群攻击。

column1: The Corona is a battle armor design that was created by Clan Star Adder following the Trials to determine which Clans would take part in Operation REVIVAL. The idea was to build the battlesuit around a weapon that could threaten 'Mechs from a distance. The mass necessary to mount such a heavy weapon resulted in a twenty percent armor decrease and the removal of the jump pack, despite a fifty percent overall increase in mass.
column2: 日冕是星蝰氏族在确定哪些氏族参加复兴行动的试炼之后创造的战斗装甲设计。其理念是围绕一件能从远距离威胁机甲的武器来打造整套战斗服。为承载如此重型的武器所需的质量，导致装甲减少了百分之二十并拆除了跳跃背包，尽管整体质量增加了百分之五十。ZH

column1: Jake Kalmar's infamous Ravager was built around a 285-rated XL Engine to save weight to carry eighteen tons of armor and fifteen double heat sinks. Offensively the Ravager is armed with a Gauss Rifle in the left arm and a Ultra AC/5 in the right torso, supported by a center torso mounted Large Pulse Laser, a standard Large Laser in the left torso and right arm, rounded out by a Medium Laser in the head and each arm. Two tons each of Gauss and UAC reloads gave it good endurance. The 'Mech was salvaged by Chloe's Cavaliers after they tracked Kalmar to Sigurd in 3037 and killed him there. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: 杰克·卡尔马（Jake Kalmar）那台臭名昭著的“蹂躏者”（Ravager）以额定 285 的 XL 引擎为核心，从而省下重量来携带十八吨装甲和十五台双散热器。在攻击方面，蹂躏者的左臂装有一门高斯步枪，右躯干装有一门超速 AC/5，并由中央躯干的大型脉冲激光、左躯干与右臂的标准大型激光提供支援，头部与每条手臂各一门中型激光则补齐了配置。高斯弹药与 UAC 弹药各两吨，使它具备良好的持续作战能力。3037 年，克洛伊骑兵团（Chloe's Cavaliers）追踪卡尔马至西格德（Sigurd）并将其击毙后，回收了这台机甲。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：右上

column1: Boss, what on earth is this thing? I'm all one for a challenge but this thing looks like a pirate deathtrap. Somehow it works but I couldn't begin to tell you why or how it works.
column2: 老板，这玩意儿到底是什么？我不怕挑战，但这东西看起来像个海盗死亡陷阱。它不知怎么就能用，但我完全说不出它为什么、以及怎么能用。ZH

column1: The Corvis 1 is built on a Model MH-24 endo steel chassis, protected by seven tons of ferro-fibrous armor; a good thing since it is so slow. This low speed is due to the 160-rated fusion engine that powers the 'Mech. Thankfully this low speed is augmented by four jump jets, giving the Corvis a jump range of 120 meters. The main gun of the Corvis is its UAC/10, backed up by a pair of medium pulse lasers. These guns enable the Corvis to operate effectively in medium to short ranges. Between the generous supply of autocannon ammunition and 10 double heat sinks that keep the 'Mech chilled, the Corvis can operate without resupply for a respectable amount of time. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: Corvis 1 以 Model MH-24 钢内骨结构机体建造，由七吨铁纤维装甲保护；鉴于它的速度如此之慢，这倒是件好事。低速源于为机甲提供动力的 160 级聚变引擎。所幸四具跳跃推进器弥补了这一缺陷，使 Corvis 拥有 120 米的跳跃距离。Corvis 的主炮是 UAC/10，辅以两门中型脉冲激光。这些武器让 Corvis 在中近距离都能有效作战。凭借充裕的自动炮弹药和 10 具让机甲保持凉爽的双散热器，Corvis 能够在相当长的时间内无需补给持续作战。特性：模块化武器 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：右臂下部

column1: The Corvis was one of the predecessors to the OmniMech, utilizing the same semi-modular ports as the Star League Mercury BattleMech. Clan technicians eventually expanded upon this design to create the Stormcrow, and with the development of that front-line OmniMech, all of the Clans save the Horses lost interest in the Corvis, which was often derided as too slow for its weight class. In fact, the Corvis' only saving grace is its use of jump jets, because they allow the medium-range 'Mech to be useful when on restricting terrain, such as urban environments. The Corvis was often deployed as support for conventional troops, such as combat vehicles and infantry, so it only seems natural that the Horses would want to keep producing it.
column2: 科维斯是全方位机甲的前身之一，使用了与星盟水星战斗机甲相同的半模块化接口。氏族技师最终在这一设计上扩展创造出暴风鸦，而随着那台前线全方位机甲的研发，除地狱马之外的所有氏族都对科维斯失去了兴趣，它常被嘲笑为对其重量级而言太慢。事实上，科维斯唯一可取之处就是它对跳跃推进器的使用，因为它们让这台中型机甲在受限制的地形（如城市环境）中仍有用处。科维斯常被部署为常规部队（如战斗车辆与步兵）的支援，所以地狱马想继续生产它似乎也很自然。ZH

column1: With a focus on indirect fire support, the COU-A fields a pair of Artemis IV guided LRM-20s. If the pilot finds itself in a position with direct line of sight he or she can also rely on a pair of ERML's and a single backup Small Pulse Laser. In total this makes for a lot of firepower in a very small package. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: COU-A专注间接火力支援，装备两具由阿尔忒弥斯IV制导的LRM-20。若机师获得直视射界，还可依靠两具增程中型激光和一具备用的小型脉冲激光。总体而言，这让它在极小的机体中汇聚了相当可观的火力。特性：高级光学 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Cougar-B is a classic clan direct fire support / sniper build. Dual ERPPCs and a backup ERML make for a formidable punch. With a set of six additional Double Heatsinks the COU-B runs reasonably cool and is able to keep its barrage up for quite a while. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 美洲狮-B 是典型的部族直射火力支援/狙击配置。两门增程粒子加农炮加上一门作为备份的增程中型激光，构成相当可观的打击力。额外的六个双散热器让 COU-B 运行得相当凉爽，能够长时间持续倾泻火力。特性：先进光学系统 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A custom Cougar configuration, the Blood Adder is armed with a pair of ATM-9’s. A pair of torso mounted HMG’s back the ATM’s up at closer ranges while a head mounted AMS enhances the configurations defensive capabilities. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 作为美洲狮的定制配置，血蝰蛇装有一对ATM-9。两挺躯干机枪在较近距离为ATM提供后手，头部一套反导弹系统则增强该配置的防御能力。特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A custom Cougar configuration, the Blood Adder is armed with a pair of ATM-9’s. A pair of torso mounted HMG’s back the ATM’s up at closer ranges while a head mounted AMS enhances the configurations defensive capabilities.
column2: 作为美洲狮的定制配置，血蝰武装为两具ATM-9。两挺装在躯干的重型机枪在更近距离为ATM提供后援，而头部的AMS增强该配置的防御能力。ZH

column1: A mix of long and medium range weaponry is what makes the Cougar-C variant quite unique. A Gauss Rifle is an absolutely scary main weapon system for a mech of just 35 tons and even the backup weapons are more than enough to strike fear in its enemies heart: 5 ERML will allow the COU-C to stay active and dangerous even after the ammo for the Gauss is depleted. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 远程与中程武器的混装使美洲狮-C变型相当独特。就一台仅35吨的机甲而言，高斯步枪是绝对可怕的主武器系统，就连后备武器也足以在敌人心中种下恐惧：5门ERML让COU-C即便在高斯弹药耗尽后仍能保持活跃与危险。特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Conceptualized to be a sniper with a good near field defense the Cougar-D variant relies on a single ERLL and an Ultra Autocannon/10 for long range and dual SRM4 launchers for close range fire. The COU-D might not be quick, but if he closes in after ripping the armor open, these Short Range Missiles have great finishing potential. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 美洲狮-D变型的设计构想是兼具优秀近距防御的狙击手：远程依靠一门ERLL和一门超级自动炮/10，近程则用双联SRM4发射器。COU-D也许不算快，但如果它撕开装甲后逼近，这些短程火箭的收割能力极强。特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: This configuration was introduced during the 3060s. It was equipped with four Jump Jets and an ECM suite. This variant is armed with an Ultra Autocannon/5 and a trio of Heavy Medium Lasers for when any opponent tries to close range. It also has three additional double heat sinks to deal with heat the trio of heavy lasers produce. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 此配置于3060年代推出，配备四具跳跃推进器和一套电子对抗套件。它装有一门超级AC/5和三门重型中型激光，以应对任何试图逼近的对手，另有三个额外双散热器处理三门重型激光产生的热量。特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A configuration focused on medium and short distance engagements, can do a fair amount of damage if used properly.
column2: 这是一个专注中近距离交战的配置，使用得当能造成相当可观的伤害。ZH

column1: The Huntress configuration of the Cougar is a rare sight, designed to be a scout hunter and Heavy Hitter is most of its capability shifted to advanced electronics and the ability to detect and effectively kill even stealthed units in a single devastating Blow. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Cougar 的 Huntress 配置十分罕见，它的定位是猎杀侦察兵的“重击手”，大部分性能都转移到了先进电子设备上，并具备侦测乃至一击摧毁隐身单位的能力。特性：高级光学 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The primary configuration in the MC custom line of Cougars, based on an upgraded 210 XL engine instead of the stock 175 XL. The MCA's purpose is long rage attacks, carrying a LRM-15 and a Large Pulse Laser. For defensive purposes it mounts an Anti Missile System and to deal with infantry attacks the MCA also mounts a Flamer. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是美洲狮MC定制品系列的主配置，基于升级的210 XL引擎而非原装175 XL。MCA的用途是远程打击，带一具LRM-15和一门大型脉冲激光。为自卫它装有一套反导弹系统，为应对步兵袭击还装有一具火焰喷射器。特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Another configuration in the MC custom line of Cougars, based on an upgraded 210 XL engine instead of the stock 175 XL. The addition of six jump jets makes the MCJ one of the most mobile configurations of the Cougar, at the cost of only being able to mount a single LRM-15 launcher and a Large Pulse Laser for combat, with a chest mounted Flamer for defensive purposes. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是Cougar的MC定制系列中的另一款构型，以升级的210 XL引擎取代原来的175 XL引擎。六具跳跃推进器的加入使MCJ成为Cougar中机动性最强的构型之一，代价是作战时只能装备一具LRM-15发射器与一门大型脉冲激光，并在胸部装一具火焰喷射器用于自卫。特性：高级光学 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Another configuration in the MC custom line of Cougars, based on an upgraded 210 XL engine instead of the stock 175 XL. Mounting four LRM-5 launchers and double Large Pulse Lasers, the damage profile is higher than expected. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是美洲狮MC定制品系列的又一配置，基于升级的210 XL引擎而非原装175 XL。它装四具LRM-5发射器和双联大型脉冲激光，伤害曲线高于预期。特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Khan Marthe Pryde decided to upgrade the 'Mechs her Clan fielded. Rather than waste precious resources designing a new OmniMech from the ground up, she instructed her scientists to improve upon existing designs. The design the scientists chose to modify was the Adder. Though the two 'Mechs are visually similar and share the same weight, the Cougar is slower and better armed. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 可汗玛尔特·普赖德决定升级其部族列装的机甲。与其耗费宝贵资源从头设计一款新的全向机甲，她指示科学家改进现有设计。科学家们选择改造的是蝰蛇。虽然两款机甲外观相似且重量相同，美洲狮更慢、武装更好。特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Coyotl has the honor of being the first OmniMech. Developed by Clan Coyote with some help from Clan Sea Fox, the Coyotl was first fielded in 2854. By using an XL Engine and Endo Steel chassis, the scientists were able to create a medium 'Mech that could carry a great deal of equipment. In addition, the high ground speed of the Coyotl allowed it to rush from one area of a battlefield to another, providing support for its teammates. The A configuration was introduced during a conflict against Clan Cloud Cobra. Seven Jump Jets gave the Coyotl A much greater maneuverability, while the long range weapons were traded for a Large Pulse Laser, Small Pulse Laser, and an additional Streak SRM-4 launcher. This version also dropped the Medium Pulse Laser of the original. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Coyotl 拥有作为首款全向机甲的荣耀。它由郊狼部族在海洋狐部族的协助下开发，于 2854 年首次投入战场。通过采用 XL 引擎和钢内骨结构机体，科学家们得以打造出一具能携带大量装备的中型机甲。此外，Coyotl 的高地面速度使其能够迅速从战场一处奔赴另一处，为队友提供支援。A 配置是在与云眼镜蛇部族的冲突中推出的。七具跳跃推进器大幅提升了 Coyotl A 的机动性，远程武器则被换成了一门大型脉冲激光、一门小型脉冲激光和一具额外的连发 SRM-4 发射器。该版本还去掉了原型的中型脉冲激光。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: This is the first of them all. The Grandfather that paved the path for the Omni revolution. Too bad it isn't that great a 'Mech compared to later designs. But at least it has historical value.
column2: 这是它们中的第一款，是为全向机甲革命铺平道路的鼻祖。可惜与后来的设计相比，它算不上出色的机甲。但至少它有历史价值。ZH

column1: The Coyotl has the honor of being the first OmniMech. Developed by Clan Coyote with some help from Clan Sea Fox, the Coyotl was first fielded in 2854. By using an XL Engine and Endo Steel chassis, the scientists were able to create a medium 'Mech that could carry a great deal of equipment. In addition, the high ground speed of the Coyotl allowed it to rush from one area of a battlefield to another, providing support for its teammates. The B configuration uses an Ultra AC/10 in the right arm as its main firepower, supported by an ER Medium Laser and SRM-6 launcher. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 郊狼有幸成为史上第一台全向机甲，由郊狼部族在海狐部族的一些协助下研制，于2854年首次投入战场。借助XL引擎和钢内骨结构底盘，科学家们得以造出一台能携带大量装备的中型机甲。此外，郊狼较高的地面速度使其能快速从战场一处奔赴另一处，为队友提供支援。B配置以右臂的1门超级自动炮/10为主要火力，并配1门增程中型激光和1具SRM-6发射器。<特性：扩展躯干旋转 <投放费用倍率：1.03 <手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Coyotl has the honor of being the first OmniMech. Developed by Clan Coyote with some help from Clan Sea Fox, the Coyotl was first fielded in 2854. By using an XL Engine and Endo Steel chassis, the scientists were able to create a medium 'Mech that could carry a great deal of equipment. In addition, the high ground speed of the Coyotl allowed it to rush from one area of a battlefield to another, providing support for its teammates. The primary version of the Coyotl used an ER PPC and LRM-10 as the primary long range weapons, while a Medium Pulse Laser and Streak SRM-4 provided short range firepower. Originally the engineers thought they would build each variant around the PPC, but this proved to be too limiting, particularly with the high heat it caused. The missile systems were added to provide firepower at a lower heat cost. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Coyotl 有幸成为史上第一款全向机甲。它由郊狼族在海狐族的协助下研发，于 2854 年首次投入战场。通过采用 XL 引擎和钢内骨结构，科学家们得以打造出一款能携带大量装备的中型机甲。此外，Coyotl 出众的地面速度使其能够迅速在战场各处穿梭，为队友提供支援。Coyotl 的主配置以一门增程粒子加农炮和一具 LRM-10 作为主要远程武器，一门中型脉冲激光和一具连发 SRM-4 则提供近距离火力。最初工程师们打算围绕粒子加农炮来打造每一个变型机，但这被证明限制过多，尤其是粒子加农炮产生的高热量。导弹系统正是为了以更低的热量代价提供火力而加入的。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A Star League era training mech, the Crockett was introduced in 2735. An 85-ton mech with a mix of weapon types alongside double heat sinks, the Crockett would go on to see frontline service as a command mech and assault mech. The CRK-5003-0 is a downgrade resulting from the Succession War’s decline in technology and features a 255-rated engine alongside a trio of Jump Jets. A pair of Large Lasers and an AC/10 form the bulk of the mechs weapons, with paired SRM-6's Lasers and Small Lasers surprising opponents at close range. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Crockett是星际联盟时代的训练机甲，于2735年推出。这台85吨机甲混合了多种武器类型并配备双散热器，后来更作为指挥机甲与突击机甲在前线服役。CRK-5003-0是继承战争导致科技衰退后产生的降级版本，配备一具255级引擎与三具跳跃推进器。两门大型激光与一门AC/10构成这台机甲的主要武器，而配对的SRM-6、激光与小型激光则能在近距离让对手措手不及。特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A Star League era training mech, the Crockett was introduced in 2735. An 85-ton mech with a mix of weapon types alongside double heat sinks, the Crockett would go on to see frontline service as a command mech and assault mech. The CRK-5003-1b is an upgrade model used by the SLDF Royal regiments and features a 255-rated engine alongside an Endo Steel skeleton and a trio of Jump Jets. A pair of ER Large Lasers and a Gauss Rifle form the bulk of the mechs weapons, with 2 Medium Lasers and 4 Medium Pulses surprise opponents at close range. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 作为星际联盟时期的训练机甲，克罗基特于2735年推出。这台85吨机甲混装多种武器并配双散热器，后来还作为指挥机甲与突击机甲投入一线服役。CRK-5003-1b是SLDF皇家团使用的升级型号，配备一台255额定引擎、钢内骨结构和三具跳跃推进器。两门增程大型激光和一门高斯步枪构成机甲武器的绝大部分，另有2门中型激光和4门中型脉冲激光在近距给对手一个惊喜。特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Crosscut is a popular type of LoggerMech, praised for operating efficiency in woodlands and dominating commercial forestry. The X2M is a militarized crosscut on the cheap, with only minor modifications to the base industrial model. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.72
column2: 横切是受欢迎的伐木机甲类型，以在林地作业高效、称霸商业林业而受赞誉。X2M是一款低成本的军用化横切，仅对基础工业型号做了少量改动。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.72

column1: The Crosscut is a popular type of LoggerMech, praised for operating efficiency in woodlands and dominating commercial forestry. The X2M is a militarized crosscut on the cheap, with only minor modifications to the base industrial model.
column2: 克罗斯卡特是一种广受欢迎的伐木机甲，以林地作业效率高、称霸商业林业而著称。X2M是廉价的军用化克罗斯卡特，只对基础工业型号做了轻微改动。ZH

column1: The Crosscut is a popular type of LoggerMech, praised for operating efficiency in woodlands and dominating commercial forestry. The X4X is the dual-chainsaw version (not to be confused with the dual-saw version, which is different). It's particularly popular in forestry with dense tree coverage. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.72
column2: 横切是受欢迎的伐木机甲类型，以在林地作业高效、称霸商业林业而受赞誉。X4X是双链锯版本（不要与双锯版本混淆，那是不一样的东西）。它在树冠茂密的林区尤其受欢迎。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.72

column1: The Crosscut is a popular type of LoggerMech, praised for operating efficiency in woodlands and dominating commercial forestry. The X4X is the dual-chainsaw version (not to be confused with the dual-saw version, which is different). It's particularly popular in forestry with dense tree coverage.
column2: 克罗斯卡特是一种广受欢迎的伐木机甲，以林地作业效率高、称霸商业林业而著称。X4X是双链锯版本（别与双锯版本混淆，那是另一种）。它在林木茂密的地带尤其受欢迎。ZH

column1: Used by 'Crusading Crael', the reigning champion of the DeathRain Arena in Port Krin on Antallos in 3057, this heavily modified Crusader had huge spikes protruding from its chest and shoulders; the latter served to conceal missile launchers and fall off as soon as the shoulder-mounted SRMs were fired for the first time. The shoulder-mounted LRM-15 launchers of the original were replaced with two more SRM-6 racks (mounted in the side torso sections) to boost short-range firepower over the LRM's long range that was less useful in arena combat, and maximized the infighter capabilities by installing Claws on each arm. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
column2: 这台机甲由“十字军克雷尔”使用——他是3057年安塔洛斯克林港“死亡雨竞技场”的卫冕冠军。这台大幅改装的十字军胸口与肩部伸出巨大尖刺；肩部那些还用来隐藏导弹发射器，在肩载SRM首次发射后便会脱落。原本的肩载LRM-15发射器被换成另外两组SRM-6挂架（装在侧躯干），以在竞技场战斗中用处不大的LRM远程火力换取更强的近程火力，并给每只手臂装上爪，最大限度发挥近身混战能力。特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.11

column1: Don't get close to this one. Ever. Or it will turn your 'Mech to scrap before you can say the word <i>Honorificabilitudinitatibus<i> out loud.
column2: 永远别靠近这一个。绝不。否则在你把<i>Honorificabilitudinitatibus<i>大声念完之前，它就会把你的机甲变成废铁。ZH

column1: A refit of the -3R that replaces the Machine Guns with a C3 slave unit and CASE protection to improve battlefield performance against other Mechs and Vehicles. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: 这是 -3R 的改装型，以一套 C3 从机和 CASE 防护替换了机枪，以提升在战场上对付其他机甲和车辆的表现。特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.07

column1: Another of those refits which don't really change that much of the how the 'Mech performs. But I guess if you care about surviving, having CASE can be a good thing.
column2: 这又是一次其实没怎么改变机甲表现的改装。不过我想，如果你在乎活命，有CASE总是好事。ZH

column1: Custom refit of the Crusader CRD-3R used by the mercenary band Wolf's Dragoons. The main features are the replacement of all the weapons with Clan tech versions and the use of a Clan XL engine core, combined with four JumpJets and an Artemis IV system. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 这是雇佣兵部队沃尔夫龙骑兵所使用的 Crusader CRD-3R 定制改装版。主要特点是将全部武器换成部族科技型号，并采用部族 XL 引擎核心，同时配备四台跳跃推进器和一套 Artemis IV 系统。特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: This, and the other Wolf's Dragoons refits of the stock Crusader, are such huge improvements that they can't be compared on any level except sharing the chassis name and structure.
column2: 这一台，以及狼族龙骑兵对现有十字军的其他改装，改进之大使它们在任何层面都无法比较，除了共用底盘名称与结构。ZH

column1: One of several custom designs used by the famous mercenary company Wolf's Dragoons. Based off the -3R but heavily improved with Clan tech, the design uses a 360 XL Clan Engine core to be able to fit better weapons, a C3 slave unit, jumpjets and better cooling. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 这是著名雇佣兵公司沃尔夫龙骑兵所使用的数款定制设计之一。它以-3R为基础，但用部族科技大幅改良，采用额定360的部族XL引擎核心，从而能装下更好的武器、一套C3从属单元、跳跃推进器以及更强的散热系统。特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: So, see it like this, Boss. Take a normal Crusader CRD-3R, but replace half of the weapons with Clan Tech, add Jump Jets and improve its battlefield performance a lot. That is what these beasts are.
column2: 你看，老大。拿一台普通的十字军CRD-3R，把一半武器换成氏族科技，装上跳跃推进器，并大幅提升其战场表现。这些猛兽就是这样。ZH

column1: A Star League-tech retrofit of the classic CRD-3R developed by Bander BattleMechs for the mercenary market in 3054, the 4BR switches to double heat sinks and replaces the SRM-6 launchers with a pair of Streak SRM-2s. The weight saved allows an extra ton of LRM reloads for each launcher to be carried, protected by the addition of CASE in each torso. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 4BR 是 Bander BattleMechs 于 3054 年为雇佣兵市场开发的、经典 CRD-3R 的星际联盟技术改装型。它换装双散热器，并以两具连发 SRM-2 取代 SRM-6 发射器。节省下来的重量使每具发射器都能多携带一吨 LRM 备用弹药，并由各躯干新增的 CASE 提供保护。特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: An all-round upgrade for the 'Mech, most of the improvements are aimed to improve the survivability and length of useful deployment.
column2: 对该机甲的全方位升级，大部分改进都旨在提升生存能力与有效部署时长。ZH

column1: The -4Db was an initial alternative upgrade route from the -3R before -4D design was fully finished. However, due the use of Artemis IV FCS, Streak SRM-4s rather than Streak SRM-2s and Endo Steel structure made the design far too expensive for the intended market. Only a few units were ever produced. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: -4Db是-4D设计完全定型之前，-3R的一条早期替代升级路线。然而，由于采用阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统、连发SRM-4而非连发SRM-2以及钢内骨结构，该设计对目标市场而言过于昂贵，只生产了少数几台。特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: Probably a better 'Mech than the final -4D, but I see why it would be a problem for smaller mercenary outfits to afford both the initial purchase and the continued maintenance of this version.
column2: 大概是台比最终-4D更好的机甲，但我明白为什么较小的雇佣兵部队会既负担不起初次购买、又负担不起这一版本持续的维护费用。ZH

column1: A Capellan Confederation specific variant, similar to the CRD-4D except for a slightly different paintjob. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 卡佩兰联邦专属的变型，与CRD-4D相似，只是涂装略有不同。特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: It's a -4D, nothing special.
column2: 它就是个-4D，没什么特别的。ZH

column1: A production-model upgrade of the Crusader utilizing Star League equipment, the 5S was built by TharHes industries on Tharkad for FedCom forces starting in 3049. It varies little from the 3R model, instead removing the machine guns to make room for double heat sinks, CASE to protect the missile reloads, and the addition of a Flamer in the right arm. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 5S是Crusader采用星际联盟装备的量产升级型，自3049年起由Tharkad上的TharHes工业为联邦共和国部队制造。它与3R型差别不大，只是拆除了机枪以腾出空间安装双散热器、保护导弹弹药的CASE，并在右臂增设了一门火焰喷射器。特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: Trading the two machine guns for better cooling and CASE just sounds like a no-brainer deal. Who would keep a -3R when there is this to replace it? Well, the poor mercenary outfits, I guess. Unlike us. So let's use this!
column2: 用两挺机枪换成更好的散热与CASE，听起来是个不用过脑子的交易。既然有这东西可以替换，谁还会留着-3R？嗯，我想是那些穷雇佣兵部队吧。不像我们。所以用上这个吧！ZH

column1: A Kallon variant with a top speed of 86 km/h thanks to an XL engine. Each arm carries six medium lasers and the leg mounted weapons are a flamer in each hip mount. Seventeen double heat sinks struggle to keep things cool, but twelve and a half tons of armor protect the 'Mech. A C3 slave unit is mounted in the head, allowing this Crusader to share targeting data. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: Kallon 出品的变型，凭借 XL 引擎最高速度可达 86 km/h。每只手臂搭载六具中型激光，腿部武器则是每个髋部安装座内的一具火焰喷射器。十七具双散热器勉力维持散热，十二点五吨装甲则为该机甲提供防护。头部装有一具 C3 从属单元，使这具 Crusader 能够共享瞄准数据。特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: The Crusader was initially designed as a close combat BattleMech for the Star League Defense Force, but soon proved itself to be a very adaptable, multirole design. This reliable workhorse of the SLDF, while not excelling in any one job, was quite capable of accomplishing just about any mission, whether it be close assault, anti-aircraft, counterinsurgency, or even reconnaissance. Its versatility and large number of manufacturers ensured the Crusader its place as one of the most common heavy 'Mechs in the Inner Sphere.
column2: 十字军最初是作为星盟防卫部队的混战战斗机甲设计的，但很快证明自己是一种适应性极强的多用途设计。这台SLDF可靠的主力机型虽然在任何单一领域都不算顶尖，却几乎能胜任任何任务——无论是近距突击、防空、反叛乱，还是侦察。它的多用途性与众多的制造商共同确保了十字军在内天体最常见重型机甲中的地位。ZH

column1: The Cudgel 1B was the first of a handful of BattleMechs designed off of the Charger chassis by Solarian manufacturer Innovative Design Concepts. By mounting all weaponry in the torsos, IDC found that MechWarriors were able to make melee strikes without sacrificing any firepower. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: 短棍1B是索拉里斯制造商创新设计概念公司基于冲锋者底盘设计的少数战斗机甲中的第一款。通过把所有武器装进躯干，IDC发现机甲战士能在不牺牲任何火力的情况下进行近战打击。特性：近战驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.14

column1: The Cudgel 1B was the first of a handful of BattleMechs designed off of the Charger chassis by Solarian manufacturer Innovative Design Concepts. By mounting all weaponry in the torsos, IDC found that MechWarriors were able to make melee strikes without sacrificing any firepower.
column2: 棍棒1B是索拉里斯制造商创新设计理念公司基于冲锋者底盘设计的少数战斗机甲中的第一款。通过把所有武器都装进躯干，IDC发现机师能在不牺牲任何火力的前提下进行近战打击。ZH

column1: The original flagship model, the Cyclone A1 began mass-manufacture in 2631 and proved to be the most expensive variant until the 3060s. Sporting a Magna 210XL Fusion engine, the Cyclone A1 can reach and maintain speeds up to 118km/h. Sold as a Scout Mech, the A1 features both a Guardian ECM Suite and a Beagle Active Probe which leaves just enough space for its light weapons payload consisting of a pair of Longfire V LRM 5s in the arms and a pair of Magna Mk II Medium Lasers in the side torsos. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 作为最初的旗舰型号，Cyclone A1 于 2631 年开始量产，并在此后直到 3060 年代一直是价格最高的改型。它搭载 Magna 210XL 聚变引擎，最高可达到并维持 118km/h 的速度。作为侦察机甲发售的 A1 同时配备守卫者电子对抗套件和鱼鹰主动探测器，留下的空间恰好够装它那套轻量武器：双臂各一具 Longfire V LRM 5，两侧躯干各一门 Magna Mk II 中型激光。特性：灵活 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: This thing really lives up to it's name, Boss; it's pretty quick and surprisingly hard to stop for its size. The tech specs claims it tops out around 118km/h and when you combine that with the ECM Suite, you can quickly get into and out of trouble.
column2: 这东西真配得上它的名字，老大；它相当快，而且就其体型而言出奇地难以拦住。技术规格称它最高约118公里/小时，再把ECM套件结合起来，你就能迅速进出麻烦。ZH

column1: A downgrade of the original A1 variant, the Cyclone A3 was produced throughout the Amaris Civil War and all four Succession Wars. Replacing the 210XL Fusion engine with an ultra-reliable Magna 150 Fusion engine made the A3 cost half as much as the A1 variant. While the A3 retains the Magna MkII Medium Lasers and Longfire V LRM 5s, the ECM Suite and Active Probe are replaced by a pair of Sperry Browning Machine Guns and a Zippo Flamer. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Cyclone A3 是原 A1 变型的降级版，其生产贯穿了阿马里斯内战与全部四次继承战争。它用极为可靠的 Magna 150 聚变引擎替换了 210XL 聚变引擎，使 A3 的成本只有 A1 变型的一半。A3 保留了 Magna MkII 中型激光与 Longfire V LRM 5，但 ECM 套件和主动探测器被一对 Sperry Browning 机枪和一具 Zippo 火焰喷射器所取代。特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The A3 variant is a Succession Wars downgrade of the Cyclone A1. It is not fancy by any means.  I remember my old pappy had a saying about the thing: you pays your monies, you gets your picks. Whatever that means.
column2: A3改型是继承战争期间对旋风A1的降级版。它绝对不算花哨。我记得我老爹对这玩意儿有句说法：你付了你的钱，你拿到你的货。管它什么意思。ZH

column1: The Cyclone A3P refit became popular in the late 2960s and became the primary variant produced, under license, by Luthien Armor Works in the Draconis Combine until the design was retired in the 3060s. The A3P retains the Magna 150 Fusion engine and Magna Mk II Medium lasers of the A3 but replaces the remainder of the weapons payload for a Magna Hellstar PPC and an extra heat sink. The Luthien production runs of the A3P variant were the first Cyclones to feature lower arm and hand actuators. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: 旋风A3P改装在2960年代后期流行起来，并成为龙脉联合体内卢西恩装甲厂授权生产的主力变型，直到该设计在3060年代退役。A3P保留了A3的马格纳150聚变引擎和马格纳Mk II中型激光，其余武器则换成一门马格纳地狱星粒子加农炮和一个额外散热器。卢西恩生产的A3P变型是首批配备下臂与手部驱动器的旋风。特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：0.97

column1: Hey, this is one of those Kuritan Cyclones! The refit to drop the LRMs for a PPC was so popular that the Luthien factory switched over to producing only this variant. Just be careful, boss, it runs damn hot.
column2: 嘿，这是一台库瑞塔旋风！为装粒子加农炮而拆掉LRM的改装太受欢迎，卢西恩工厂索性转产只造这个变型。不过小心点，老板，它热得要命。ZH

column1: After the discovery of the Helm Memory Core and the development of several additional key technologies, Magna Metals Inc. revisited the Cyclone design in 3058. The B2 variant features an Endo-Steel chassis paired with a 180L Fusion Engine to make room for a pair of experimental Hellcat Class 5 Thunderbolt 5 launchers with a ton of ammunition each and a pair of Magna Mk VI ER Medium Lasers. Further differences from the previous A3 variant come in the form of Double Heat Sinks, lower arm and hand actuators, and the reintroduction of the Guardian ECM Suite. The Cyclone B2 found only a tepid response from military buyers as the Thunderbolt missiles are susceptible to being rendered ineffectual by Anti-Missile Systems. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 在地狱记忆核心被发现并发展出若干关键附加技术之后，马格纳金属公司于3058年重新审视了旋风设计。B2变型采用钢内骨结构底盘配一台180L聚变引擎，为两具实验型地狱猫5级雷神之锤5发射器（各配一吨弹药）和两门马格纳Mk VI增程中型激光腾出空间。相较此前的A3变型，它还有双散热器、下臂与手部驱动器，以及重新引入的守护者电子对抗套件。旋风B2在军方买家中反响平平，因为雷神之锤导弹容易被反导弹系统化为无效。特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：0.99

column1: Well, you don't see a lot of Thunderbolt Missile systems outside of the Solaris arenas for a reason, boss. The two Thunderbolt 5s on this thing hit pretty hard but any AMS systems in the area are going to give you headaches.
column2: 嗯，你在索拉里斯竞技场之外看不到多少雷霆导弹系统，是有原因的，老大。这东西上的两具雷霆5打得确实狠，但这一带任何AMS系统都会让你头疼。ZH

column1: After the lack-luster reaction to the Cyclone B2 in most markets, Magna Metals Inc., in collaboration with Hollis Incorporated, developed the C1 variant. The Cyclone C1 is built around the same Magna 210XL engine of the A1 variant. Using the same Endo-Steel chassis of the B2, the C1 replaces the weapons payload of the B2 with a Magna Firestar ER PPC, a pair of Magna Mk VI ER Medium Lasers, a Guardian ECM Suite, and an additional Double Heat Sink. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 在 Cyclone B2 于大多数市场反响平平之后，Magna Metals 公司与霍利斯公司合作开发了 C1 改型。Cyclone C1 围绕与 A1 改型相同的 Magna 210XL 引擎打造。它沿用 B2 的钢内骨结构底盘，把 B2 的武器配置换成了一门 Magna Firestar 增程粒子加农炮、一对 Magna Mk VI 增程中型激光、一具守卫者电子对抗套件和一台额外的双散热器。特性：灵活 投放费用倍率：0.99

column1: Hit-and-Run Sniper
column2: 打了就跑的狙击手

column1: The Cyclone C1 is a mobile direct-fire support platform. A top speed of 118km/h and a Guardian ECM suite make this thing a ghost at longer ranges.
column2: 旋风C1是一种机动的直射火力支援平台。118公里/小时的最高速度和一套守卫者ECM让这东西在远距离上如同幽灵。ZH

column1: The original Daedalus carried a large pulse laser, machine gun, small laser, SRM-6, and a pair of SRM-4 missile launchers. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 最初的 Daedalus 搭载一门大型脉冲激光、一挺机枪、一门小型激光、一具 SRM-6，以及两组 SRM-4 导弹发射器。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：右臂下部

column1: The Daedalus is a Solaris VII BattleMech, which was developed from an original Phoenix Hawk PXH-1 in the middle of the thirty-first century. Innovative Design Concepts took the original Phoenix Hawk design and updated it with several missile racks and the newly rediscovered large pulse laser, while utilizing speed to keep the design maneuvering out of tight situations.
column2: 代达罗斯是一台索拉里斯VII战斗机甲，于三十一世纪中叶从原有的凤凰鹰PXH-1发展而来。创新设计理念公司取来原本的凤凰鹰设计，用若干导弹架和新近重新发现的大型脉冲激光器对其升级，同时利用速度让该设计脱离险境。ZH

column1: The original Dagoth design was meant to be a competitor to Defiance's Berserker but never made it to full production. However, the original design did see a few prototypes dubbed the Dagoth DG-UR-1. A 380XL engine with supercharger strains to move the over 30 tons of Hardened armor at reasonable speeds to bring the sword and Snub-Nose PPC into range. Quirk: Well Balanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: 最初的达戈斯设计意在成为挑战公司狂战士的竞争者，却从未进入量产。不过该原始设计确实造出了几台被称为达戈斯DG-UR-1的原型。一台380XL引擎配增压器，勉力推动超过30吨的硬化装甲以尚可的速度移动，把长剑和短鼻粒子加农炮带入射程。特性：平衡良好 投放费用倍率：1.17

column1: Vining Engineering and Salvage Team
column2: 瓦伊宁工程与打捞队

column1: What a grand and intoxicating innocence! I, uh, I'm not sure what came over me boss. This is THE Dagoth Ur of Solaris fame.
column2: 多么宏大而令人沉醉的纯真！我，呃，我不知道自己刚才是怎么了老板。这位可是索拉里斯赫赫有名的达戈斯·乌尔。ZH

column1: The DAI-01 is built around long-range firepower. The primary weapon the 'Mech carries is a ER PPC backed up by a pair of Ultra autocannon/5s. This combination of weapons gives the Daikyu a devastating long-range punch. The 'Mech also carries a LRM-5 launcher, giving it limited indirect fire support capabilities. For close combat, the Daikyu carries a single medium laser. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: DAI-01 以远程火力为核心。该机甲的主武器是一具增程粒子加农炮，辅以两门超级自动炮/5。这一武器组合赋予 Daikyu 毁灭性的远程打击力。该机甲还搭载一具 LRM-5 发射器，具备有限的间接火力支援能力。近距离作战方面，Daikyu 装有一具中型激光。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.1

column1: Named for the ancient Japanese longbow and first produced in 3055, the Daikyu is armed to strike an enemy with a powerful blow at long range and, as such, is poorly armed for short-range combat. The Daikyu attempts to dictate the range at which it engages with its top speed of 86.4 km/h, which allows the Daikyu to keep up with most medium and heavy 'Mechs and makes it capable of outpacing most assault 'Mechs. The Daikyu is also well protected with twelve tons of armor and CASE to protect against ammunition explosions.
column2: 大弓以日本古长弓命名，于3055年首次生产。它被武装为在远距离对敌人打出强力一击，因此近距战斗武装薄弱。大弓试图用86.4公里/小时的最高速度主导交战距离，这使它跟得上大多数中型与重型机甲，并能超过大多数突击机甲。大弓防护也好，有十二吨装甲和CASE防止弹药爆炸。ZH

column1: A variant made to address concerns of a lack of short-range firepower, the 02 variant was built soon after Operation Bulldog. The 'Mech carries a pair of Streak SRM-6 launchers in place of the two Ultra autocannon/5s. Additionally, for close combat, the 02 variant of the Daikyu has two ER medium lasers. It is also outfitted with a C3 slave unit to share targeting information with other friendly units. It also has the addition of jump jets, giving it a jumping capacity of 150 meters. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 02改型是为解决近距离火力不足的担忧而打造，在斗牛犬行动结束后不久便投入生产。这台机甲以两具连发SRM-6发射器取代了两门Ultra自动炮/5。此外，为应付混战，Daikyu的02改型还装有两门增程中型激光。它还配备了C3从属单元，可与其他友军单位共享瞄准信息。它还加装了跳跃推进器，使其跳跃能力达到150米。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.1

column1: The original prototype Defiance produced on Hesperus II, this version was powered by an 300 XL engine and used an experimental compact gyro, which freed up space to mount a second SRM-6 rack in the center torso. As extended-range versions of medium and small lasers were not yet available to the Federated Commonwealth, it carried two pairs of small and medium pulse lasers instead, the increased weight devoted to weapons limiting the armor to twelve tons. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是挑战公司在赫斯佩鲁斯II生产的原始原型，由一台300 XL引擎驱动并使用实验型紧凑陀螺仪，从而腾出空间在中央躯干加装第二具SRM-6挂架。由于当时联邦共和国还无法获得中型与小型激光的增程版本，它改为带两对小型与中型脉冲激光；投入武器的重量增加，使装甲被限制在十二吨。特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Described as a \"Warhammer on steroids\", the Defiance is visually similar to the original WHM-6R and carries a similar weapons array. Where it differs from the classic design is in the use of digitigrade instead of humanoid legs, and modern construction components such as an endo steel skeleton, light fusion engine, and triple strength myomers. Due in part to the high heat levels required by its specialized myomers, as well as weight constraints, the Defiance carries only twelve double heat sinks, forcing it to rely upon volley fire to avoid shutdown, much like the design upon which it was based.
column2: 被描述为"吃了兴奋剂的重锤"，反抗在外观上与原始WHM-6R相似，武器阵列也相近。它与经典设计的不同之处在于采用了趾行式而非人形腿部，以及内层钢骨架、轻型聚变引擎和三倍强度肌纤维等现代建造组件。部分由于其特化肌纤维所需的高热量水平以及重量限制，反抗只带十二具双重散热器，迫使它依靠轮番齐射来避免停机，这很像它所基于的那个设计。ZH

column1: The customized 'Mech of fierce Azami warrior Ukla Mauck, Mauck stripped the missile launchers from his 'Mech and replaced them with a trio of MRM-10s. The further addition of Triple Strength Myomer makes Mauck's nearly 200-year-old Dervish a terror in close-range combat. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是凶悍的阿扎米战士乌克拉·毛克的定制机甲。毛克拆掉机甲上的导弹发射器，换成三具MRM-10，并进一步加装三倍强度人造肌，使这台近两百年历史的苦行僧在近距战斗中成为恐怖的存在。特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The DV-6MRU - or Minor Resilience Upgrade - was an upgrade program provided for a while for the original DV-6M, replacing one of the Medium Lasers with a C3 slave unit and C.A.S.E. protection for the ammunition. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: DV-6MRU——“小型韧性升级”——曾为原版DV-6M提供过一段时间的升级，以一台C3从机替换其中一门中型激光，并为弹药加装C.A.S.E.防护。特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The 7S is in practice a 6M with one of the medium lasers exchanged for two small ones and some relocation of the 'Mechs components and weapons. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 7S实际上就是一台6M，把其中一门中型激光换成两门小型激光，并对机甲的部件与武器做了些位置调整。特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Frenzy is built around an 275-rated extralight engine and an endo steel frame, carrying an SRM-4 in each arm in support of LRM-20 in each side torso. Clad in seven and half tons of standard armor and fitted with five jump jets and ten double heat sinks, the Frenzy carries two tons each of LRM and SRM missile reloads. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Frenzy 以 275 级超轻型引擎和钢内骨结构框架打造，每条手臂各携带一具 SRM-4，用以辅助两侧躯干中的 LRM-20。它披挂七吨半标准装甲，配备五具跳跃推进器和十具双散热器，并携带 LRM 与 SRM 导弹各两吨备用弹药。特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

column1: This 'Frenzy' packs a lot of firepower for a medium 'Mech, with AMS-resistant LRM-20 Delta racks and eight SRM tubes for close combat. The usual medium lasers have been removed, though, so it's dead weight if it runs out of missiles.
column2: 这台"狂热"对中型机甲而言火力相当充沛，装有抗AMS的LRM-20德尔塔挂架和八具SRM发射管用于混战。不过通常的中型激光器被拆掉了，所以一旦导弹打光，它就是死重。ZH

column1: Dervish IIC
column2: 苦行僧 IIC

column1: A Star League era mech designed to correct the flaws of the original Titan, the Devastator was rediscovered by the FedSuns in 3023. Powered by a 300-rated engine, the Devastator DVS-1D carries a pair of AC/10’s, with 2 Large Lasers and 4 Medium Lasers as secondary weapons. 18 tons of armor and 15 heat sinks round out the design. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
