It exchanges the 10 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor for 9.5 tons of standard, and replaces the two SRM-6 launchers with a Streak SRM-6 instead. It further exchanges the Guardian ECM for a Beagle Active Probe and removes one heat sink, but adds two Medium Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: -2N2是对原版狮鹫2N的大幅改装：它把10吨铁纤维装甲换成9.5吨标准装甲，并以一具连发SRM-6取代两具SRM-6发射器；还把守护者电子对抗套件换成比格犬主动探测器，拆掉一个散热器，但加装两门中型脉冲激光。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: The -2N2 is a major refit of the original Griffin 2N. It exchanges the 10 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor for 9.5 tons of standard, and replaces the two SRM-6 launchers with a Streak SRM-6 instead. It further exchanges the Guardian ECM for a Beagle Active Probe and removes one heat sink, but adds two Medium Pulse Lasers.
column2: -2N2是对原版格里芬2N的一次重大改装。它把10吨铁纤装甲换成9.5吨标准装甲，并把两具SRM-6发射器换成一具连发SRM-6。它还进一步把守卫者ECM换成比格犬主动探测器，并拆掉一具散热器，但加装两门中型脉冲激光器。ZH

column1: A Clan Invasion era version of the GRF-1RG, the 3RG retains the right-arm medium laser and torso machine guns but swaps the remaining lasers for their pulse laser equivalents. This swap is made possible in part by dropping one ton of machine gun ammo and removing three heat sinks though a swap to double strength models compensates somewhat for the reduction. Just like its predecessor the 3RG is mostly used to guard the leaders of the Lyran Commonwealth. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 这是部族入侵时期的GRF-1RG版本，3RG保留右臂中型激光和躯干机枪，其余激光则换成脉冲型号。这一更换部分得益于拆掉一吨机枪弹药和移除三个散热器，而改用双倍强度型号在一定程度上弥补了减少的损失。与其前身一样，3RG主要用于护卫莱兰联邦的领导人。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: A custom modified Griffin used by the Kell Hounds. Using exclusively clan weapons allows the 'Mech the ability to cause far more damage than expected with its LRM-20 and ER PPC combo. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 这是凯尔猎犬使用的定制改装狮鹫。由于独用部族武器，该机甲能借其LRM-20与增程粒子加农炮的组合造成远超预期的伤害。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: A custom modified Griffin used by the Kell Hounds. Using exclusively clan weapons allows the 'Mech the ability to cause far more damage than expected with its LRM-20 and ER PPC combo.
column2: 这是凯尔猎犬使用的一台定制改装格里芬。完全采用氏族武器使该机甲凭借其LRM-20与增程PPC的组合，能造成远超预期的伤害。ZH

column1: The Clans upgraded and lightened the venerable Griffin design until the BattleMech now known as the Griffin IIC emerged. Seven tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor are mounted on an Endo Steel frame, giving the Griffin IIC almost maximum armor protection for its size. It is slightly faster than its antecedent, and it correspondingly mounts enough jump jets to leap up to 180 meters at a time. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
column2: 氏族对经典的狮鹫设计不断升级减重，最终诞生了如今被称为狮鹫 IIC 的战斗机甲。七吨铁纤维装甲装在内骨骼框架上，使狮鹫 IIC 拥有接近其尺寸上限的装甲防护。它比前身略快，也相应装足了可一次跃出 180 米的跳跃推进器。特质：战斗铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.06

column1: A Griffin sporting ClanTech upgrades, they've stuffed roughly the equivalent of an Inner Sphere Griffin into a package 15 tons lighter.
column2: 一台装备氏族技术升级的狮鹫，他们把一个内天体狮鹫的等价战力塞进了轻 15 吨的机体里。ZH

column1: Similar to the IIC 2, this variant retains the large laser, but trades out the rest of the armament for a Heavy Small Laser, two Streak SRM-2s and two Heavy Medium Lasers. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
column2: 与IIC 2类似，这一变型保留了大型激光，但把其余武装换成一门重型小型激光、两具连发SRM-2与两门重型中型激光。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.06

column1: This upgrade was first designed by Clan Nova Cat with assistance from Clan Diamond Shark and Clan Cloud Cobra. It retains the Series 7NC ER Large Laser and Series 1NC ER Small Laser, but replaces the missile launchers with a pair of ATM 3s. Three tons of ammunition allow for maximum flexibility. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
column2: 这一升级最初由新星猫部族设计，钻石鲨部族与云眼镜蛇部族提供了协助。它保留了 7NC 系列增程大型激光和 1NC 系列增程小型激光，但把导弹发射器换成了两具 ATM-3。三吨弹药带来了最大的灵活性。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.06

column1: The Clans upgraded and lightened the venerable Griffin design until the BattleMech now known as the Griffin IIC emerged. Seven tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor are mounted on an Endo Steel frame, giving the Griffin IIC almost maximum armor protection for its size. It is slightly faster than its antecedent, and it correspondingly mounts enough jump jets to leap up to 180 meters at a time. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 部族对历史悠久的 Griffin 设计进行了升级和减重，最终诞生了如今被称为 Griffin IIC 的战斗机甲。七吨铁纤维装甲安装在钢内骨结构上，使 Griffin IIC 获得了接近其体量极限的装甲防护。它比前代机型略快，并相应配备了足以一次跃出 180 米的跳跃推进器。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.08

column1: This one's a bit unusual for a Griffin, sporting only short to mid range brawling weapons instead of being built for fire support.
column2: 这一台对格里芬来说有点不寻常，它只装短到中程的混战武器，而不是为火力支援而建。ZH

column1: The primary configuration of the Grotesque mounts a Gauss Rifle in the left arm and the combination of an ER PPC and a SRM 4 launcher in the right. A single center torso mounted ER Medium Laser provides extra firepower as needed. The 'Mech also carries a 4 ton targeting computer to improve its battlefield performance. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 怪诞的主配置在左臂安装一门高斯步枪，右臂则是增程粒子加农炮与一具SRM 4发射器的组合。中央躯干单独安装的一门增程中型激光可在需要时提供额外火力。该机甲还搭载一台重4吨的瞄准计算机，以提升其战场表现。特性：稳定武器 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Grotesque is an 80 ton Clan OmniMech designed by Clan Diamond Shark. An offshoot of the Gargoyle program, it was an attempt to branch out into more varied designs. Besides using the same basic setup of a 400 XL engine and ferro-fibrous armor as the Gargoyle, the Grotesque further attempts to free up more pod capacity by using an Endo Steel structure. As the original production run of the 'Mech never saw much success, its production was not continued for very long before the project was abandoned.
column2: 怪诞是钻石鲨部族设计的一款80吨部族全向机甲，是石像鬼计划的分支，意在拓展出更多样化的设计。除沿用石像鬼的400 XL引擎与铁纤维装甲基本方案外，怪诞还进一步尝试用钢内骨结构释放更多挂载容量。由于最初的量产从未取得多大成功，它的生产并未持续多久，项目便被放弃。ZH

column1: The Guardian GRD-1N is armed with five machine guns, one mounted in each arm, in each torso side and in the center torso, respectively. Two and a half tons of ammunition in the right torso provide an ample supply of ammunition. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - MG Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: 守卫者GRD-1N装有5挺机枪，分别安装在左右手臂、左右侧躯干和中央躯干各1挺。右躯干内的2.5吨弹药为其提供了充足的补给。<特性：精准武器（机枪） <投放费用倍率：0.97

column1: Ultralight SecurityMech
column2: 超轻型安保机甲

column1: Although a BattleMech by design (and not an IndustrialMech, like most SecurityMechs), the ultralight Guardian was not made for the military. Instead, it was marketed as a SecurityMech and sold to large corporations and law enforcement agencies. Its relatively small size and low weight allows it to go where other 'Mechs could not, giving it somewhat better mobility in urban environments. However, its relatively slow speed means that almost all other 'Mechs can run it down.
column2: 虽然按设计来说是战斗机甲（而非大多数保安机甲那样的工业机甲），超轻型的守卫者并非为军用而造，而是作为保安机甲营销，卖给大型企业与执法机构。它相对小巧轻便，能去其他机甲去不了的地方，在城市环境中机动性略好；但相对缓慢的速度意味着几乎所有其他机甲都能追上它。ZH

column1: A frequent field refit for Guardians is to drop half a ton of ammunition to replace one machine gun with a medium laser, to give it at least a chance to stand against other 'Mechs. It remains a poor fighting machine when compared to virtually any other BattleMech. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - MG Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: 卫士常见的战场改装方式是削减半吨弹药，用一门中型激光替换一挺机枪，好让它至少有机会与其他机甲一较高下。但即便如此，与几乎任何其他战斗机甲相比，它依然是一台糟糕的战斗机器。特性：精准武器 - 机枪 投放费用倍率：0.97

column1: Designed in 2499 for the Terran Hegemony and later the SLDF, the Guillotine served as a heavy raider; using a combination of speed and Jump Jets to out manoeuvre opponents. The Guillotine 3N is armed with a Large Laser and a quartet of Medium Lasers, backed up by an SRM-6 for close range engagements. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Right Lower, Left Upper
column2: 断头台（Guillotine）于 2499 年为地球霸权设计，后来也装备了 SLDF，担任重型袭击机甲，依靠速度与跳跃推进器的结合在机动上压制对手。断头台 3N 装备一门大型激光和四门中型激光，并有一具 SRM-6 作为近距离交战的补充火力。特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：右下、左上

column1: Designed in 2499 for the Terran Hegemony and later the SLDF, the Guillotine served as a heavy raider; using a combination of speed and Jump Jets to out manoeuvre opponents. The Guillotine 3N is armed with a Large Laser and a quartet of Medium Lasers, backed up by an SRM-6 for close range engagements.
column2: 断头台于 2499 年为地球霸权设计，后来也服务于 SLDF，担任重型袭击机甲，结合速度与跳跃推进器在机动性上压倒对手。断头台 3N 装备一门大型激光和四门中型激光，并配有一具 SRM-6 用于近距离交战。ZH

column1: Delivered to Kapten Harald Estridsen of the Free Rasalhague Republic, this Guillotine variant was initially designed by ComStar. It has been updated with double heat sinks and upgraded weaponry. Kapten Estridsen suspects that it was a prototype for a new Com Guard variant that was shipped to him by mistake. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Right Lower, Left Upper
column2: 这台断头台变型交付给了自由拉什哈格共和国的哈拉尔德·埃斯特里德森上尉，最初由通讯之星设计。它已更新为双散热器并升级了武器。埃斯特里德森上尉怀疑，它本是通讯之星卫队某个新型变型的原型机，却被误送到了他手上。特性：集成探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：右下、左上

column1: The 4L Guillotine is a downgraded version of the original 3N model introduced in 2825. Although 3N used a significant number of off-the-shelf components, the two exceptions were its Endo Steel internal structure and CASE to protect its ammunition bay. The 4L was a simple redesign that consisted of utilizing a standard internal structure, removing its CASE system and three single heat sinks to free up the necessary tonnage. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Right Lower, Left Upper
column2: 4L Guillotine 是 2825 年推出的原始 3N 型号的降级版本。虽然 3N 大量采用现成部件，但有两处例外——采用钢内骨结构的内部结构，以及保护弹药舱的 CASE。4L 只是一次简单的重新设计：改用标准内部结构，拆除 CASE 系统和三具单散热器，以腾出所需的吨位。特性：集成探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：右下、左上

column1: Designed in 2499 for the Terran Hegemony and later the SLDF, the Guillotine served as a heavy raider; using a combination of speed and Jump Jets to out manoeuvre opponents. The Guillotine 4L is armed with a Large Laser and a quartet of Medium Lasers, backed up by an SRM-6 for close range engagements.
column2: 断头台于2499年为地球霸权、后来为SLDF设计，充当重型袭扰者；利用速度与跳跃推进器的组合机动压制对手。断头台4L武装为一门大型激光器和四门中型激光器，另有一具SRM-6作为近距离交战的后援。ZH

column1: This variant of the 4L model was introduced in 2833. While few pilots were willing to tamper with the original design, this refit replaces the Large Laser with a PPC at the expense of two tons of armor. Results with this variant have been mixed. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Right Lower, Left Upper
column2: 该变型属于 4L 型号，于 2833 年推出。虽然很少有机师愿意改动原始设计，但这次改装仍以牺牲两吨装甲为代价，用粒子加农炮替换了大型激光。该变型的实战表现褒贬不一。特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：右臂下部、左臂上部

column1: Designed in 2499 for the Terran Hegemony and later the SLDF, the Guillotine served as a heavy raider; using a combination of speed and Jump Jets to out manoeuvre opponents. The Guillotine 4P is armed with a PPC and a quartet of Medium Lasers, backed up by an SRM-6 for close range engagements.
column2: 断头台于2499年为地球霸权、后来为SLDF设计，充当重型袭扰者；利用速度与跳跃推进器的组合机动压制对手。断头台4P武装为一门PPC和四门中型激光器，另有一具SRM-6作为近距离交战的后援。ZH

column1: The 5M model is a redesign performed after the technological renaissance that started in the late 3040s. Introduced in 3049 the 5M is a 'Mech that is nearly identical to the original 3N. With the sole exception of the primary weapon being upgraded to a Sunbeam ER Large Laser model for extended reach, the 5M has an almost identical weaponry configuration, speed profile, and armor coverage as the 3N. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Right Lower, Left Upper
column2: 5M 型号是 3040 年代末开始的技术复兴之后重新设计的产品。5M 于 3049 年推出，与原版 3N 几乎一模一样。除了主武器升级为射程更远的 Sunbeam 增程大型激光型号之外，5M 的武器配置、速度特性和装甲覆盖量都与 3N 几乎完全相同。特性：集成探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂、左上臂

column1: Designed in 2499 for the Terran Hegemony and later the SLDF, the Guillotine served as a heavy raider; using a combination of speed and Jump Jets to out manoeuvre opponents. The Guillotine 3N is armed with an ER Large Laser and a quartet of Medium Lasers, backed up by an SRM-6 for close range engagements.
column2: 断头台于2499年为地球霸权设计，后来也为SLDF效力，充当重型袭掠者：以速度与跳跃推进器的组合在机动上压过对手。断头台3N装有一门增程大型激光和四门中型激光，另有一具SRM-6用于近距交战。ZH

column1: An unofficial refresh of the basic Guillotine, mainly used by mercenaries, pirates and the occasional deep periphery militia. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Right Lower, Left Upper
column2: 这是对基础断头台的民间翻新，主要被雇佣兵、海盗以及偶尔出现的外围纵深民兵使用。特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右下、左上

column1: A Clan built upgrade of the Guillotine, the Guillotine IIC is assigned to second line units and solahma troops. The Guillotine IIC is armed with a pair of Large Pulse Lasers and an ER PPC. 2 ER Medium Lasers and an SRM-6 give the mech a nasty punch at closer ranges. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是部族制造的断头台升级版，断头台IIC配属给二线单位与索拉马部队。它装有一对大型脉冲激光和一门增程粒子加农炮；2门增程中型激光和一具SRM-6在更近的距离上给该机甲凶狠的打击力。特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A Clan built upgrade of the Guillotine, the Guillotine IIC is assigned to second line units and solahma troops. The Guillotine IIC is armed with a pair of Large Pulse Lasers and an ER PPC. 2 ER Medium Lasers and an SRM-6 give the mech a nasty punch at closer ranges.
column2: 作为断头台机甲的氏族升级版，断头台IIC配属二线单位与索拉赫玛部队。断头台IIC武装为两门大型脉冲激光器和一门增程PPC。2门增程中型激光器和一具SRM-6让该机甲在更近的距离上打出狠辣一击。ZH

column1: Jointly developed by the Federated Commonwealth and the Draconis Combine, the 85 ton Gunslinger entered production in 3053. Powered by a 255-rated XL Engine, the Gunslinger 1ERD is armed with a pair of Gauss Rifles. 4 Medium Lasers, a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and a Small laser add additional firepower at close ranges. A Guardian ECM Suite and a Beagle Active Probe enhance the Mechs capabilities, while a pair of Jump Jets increase mobility. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 85吨的枪手由联邦共和国与龙脉联合体联合研制，于3053年投产。枪手1ERD由一台255额定XL引擎驱动，装有一对高斯步枪；4门中型激光、一对中型脉冲激光和一门小型激光在近距提供额外火力。一套守护者电子对抗套件和一台比格犬主动探测器增强机甲能力，两具跳跃推进器则提升机动性。特性：机罩 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Jointly developed by the Federated Commonwealth and the Draconis Combine, the 85 ton Gunslinger entered production in 3053. Powered by a 255-rated XL Engine, the Gunslinger 1ERD is armed with a pair of Gauss Rifles. 4 Medium Lasers, a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and a Small laser add additional firepower at close ranges. A Guardian ECM Suite and a Beagle Active Probe enhance the Mechs capabilities, while a pair of Jump Jets increase mobility.
column2: 85吨的枪手由联邦共和国与龙脉联合体联合研制，于3053年投产。枪手1ERD由一台255额定XL引擎驱动，装有一对高斯步枪；4门中型激光、一对中型脉冲激光和一门小型激光在近距提供额外火力。一套守护者电子对抗套件和一台比格犬主动探测器增强机甲能力，两具跳跃推进器则提升机动性。ZH

column1: A missile boat, the Ha Otoko 1 uses a pair of torso-mounted LRM-20s and a pair of arm-mounted LRM-10 launchers. However, it only incorporates thirteen single heat sinks, so MechWarriors must carefully manage their heat. Many only fire the LRM-10s when enemies attempt to flank them. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
column2: 作为一台导弹平台，Ha Otoko 1使用两具安装在躯干上的LRM-20和两具安装在手臂上的LRM-10发射器。然而它只配备十三台单散热器，因此机甲战士必须谨慎管理热量。许多人在敌人试图包抄时才会发射LRM-10。特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.13

column1: Ha Otoko
column2: 羽男

column1: The Ha Otoko (Bladed Man in Japanese) is primarily a defensive, second-line BattleMech. Clan Diamond Shark first fielded the cheap 'Mech when they helped Clan Nova Cat evacuate from Clan space in 3060. Clan Jade Falcon merchants were the first to point out that the Ha Otoko name and oriental aspect and style of combat were meant to be sold to the Inner Sphere, being easily modified to accommodate similar Inner Sphere weaponry, in addition to the Oriental styling of the 'Mech's exterior. The Ha Otoko is protected by thirteen tons of armor.
column2: Ha Otoko（日语意为"刀男"）主要是一款用于防御的二线战斗机甲。3060年，钻石鲨部族在协助新星猫部族从部族领域撤离时首次将其投入战场。翡翠猎鹰部族的商人最先指出，Ha Otoko这一名称、东方化的外观与战斗风格本就是为了向内层星域推销而设计的——它很容易改装以适配内层星域的同类武器，机甲的外形也带有东方风格。Ha Otoko由十三吨装甲提供防护。ZH

column1: This variant is the Draconis Combine model that Clan Jade Falcon merchants predicted would appear. The variant replaces the Clan weaponry with missile launchers of Inner Sphere manufacture. In order to account for the increased weight, this Ha Otoko variant makes use of an extralight fusion engine and double heat sinks. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: 此变型正是玉猫部族商人预言会出现的那种龙脉联合体型号。它以内层星域制造的导弹发射器替换部族武器。为应对增加的重量，这款羽鸦变型采用超轻型聚变引擎和双散热器。特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.07

column1: The Hades is an exclusive design to Wolf's Dragoons developed from the Loki and is an attempt to rectify that design's poor armor problems while retaining its offensive capabilities. The standard chassis is replaced with an Endo Steel model and the armor is upgraded to Ferro-Fibrous. The Hades maintains the same mobility of the original Loki. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 哈迪斯是狼之龙骑兵的专属设计，由洛基发展而来，试图在保留其进攻能力的同时纠正该设计装甲薄弱的缺陷。标准底盘换成内骨骼型号，装甲升级为铁纤维。哈迪斯保持与原版洛基相同的机动性。特质：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.06 臂部驱动器限制：全能

column1: The Hades is an exclusive design to Wolf's Dragoons developed from the Loki and is an attempt to rectify that design's poor armor problems while retaining its offensive capabilities. The standard chassis is replaced with an Endo Steel model and the armor is upgraded to Ferro-Fibrous. The Hades maintains the same mobility of the original Loki.
column2: 哈迪斯是狼之龙骑兵的专属设计，由洛基发展而来，试图在保留其进攻能力的同时纠正该设计装甲薄弱的缺陷。标准底盘换成内骨骼型号，装甲升级为铁纤维。哈迪斯保持与原版洛基相同的机动性。ZH

column1: An early FedSuns BattleMech, the 75 ton Hammerhands debuted in 2475 and served as one of the progenitor designs that would influence the iconic Warhammer. Powered by a 225-rated Fusion Core, the Hammerhands HMH-3D is armed with a pair of AC/10’s, with a pair of Medium Lasers and an SRM-6 for close range combat. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 作为联邦太阳国的早期战斗机甲，75吨的锤手于2475年首次登场，是影响了经典战锤的先行设计之一。锤手HMH-3D由225额定聚变核心驱动，装备2门AC/10，并配2门中型激光和1具SRM-6用于近距交战。<特性：炮管拳 <投放费用倍率：1.09 <手臂驱动器限制：左臂下段，右臂下段

column1: An early FedSuns BattleMech, the 75 ton Hammerhands debuted in 2475 and served as one of the progenitor designs that would influence the iconic Warhammer. Powered by a 225-rated Fusion Core, the Hammerhands HMH-3D is armed with a pair of AC/10’s, with a pair of Medium Lasers and an SRM-6 for close range combat.
column2: 作为一种早期联邦太阳战斗机甲，75吨的锤手于2475年首次亮相，是影响后来标志性重锤的始祖设计之一。锤手HMH-3D由一具225级聚变核心驱动，武装为两门AC/10，另有一对中型激光器和一具SRM-6用于近距离作战。ZH

column1: An early FedSuns BattleMech, the 75 ton Hammerhands debuted in 2475 and served as one of the progenitor designs that would influence the iconic Warhammer. Powered by a 225-rated Fusion Core, the customised Hammerhands HMH-3D used by Lorn Kessem is armed with a pair of LB-10X’s, with a pair of Medium Lasers and an SRM-6 for close range combat. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Hammerhands 是联邦太阳国的早期战斗机甲，重 75 吨，于 2475 年首次亮相，也是影响了标志性机型 Warhammer 的先行设计之一。Lorn Kessem 所使用的定制型 Hammerhands HMH-3D 由 225 额定聚变核心驱动，装备两门 LB-10X，并以两门中型激光和一具 SRM-6 应付近距离战斗。特性：炮管铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: An early FedSuns BattleMech, the 75 ton Hammerhands debuted in 2475 and served as one of the progenitor designs that would influence the iconic Warhammer. Powered by a 225-rated Fusion Core, the customised Hammerhands HMH-3D used by Lorn Kessem is armed with a pair of LB-10X’s, with a pair of Medium Lasers and an SRM-6 for close range combat.
column2: 作为联邦太阳国早期战斗机甲，75吨的锤拳于2475年首次亮相，是影响了标志性风暴之锤的先行设计之一。洛恩·凯塞姆使用的定制锤拳HMH-3D由一台225额定聚变核心驱动，装有一对LB-10X，另有一对中型激光和一具SRM-6用于近程战斗。ZH

column1: An early FedSuns BattleMech, the 75 ton Hammerhands debuted in 2475 and served as one of the progenitor designs that would influence the iconic Warhammer. Powered by a 225-rated Fusion Core, the Hammerhands HMH-4D is armed with a pair of AC/10’s and a PPC. A pair of Medium Lasers support the bigger guns at close range. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 作为联邦太阳国早期的战斗机甲，75 吨的锤手于 2475 年首次亮相，是影响了标志性机型战锤的原型设计之一。锤手 HMH-4D 由一台 225 级聚变核心驱动，装备两门 AC/10 和一门 PPC。近距离时由两门中型激光为这些主炮提供支援。特性：炮筒拳 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: An early FedSuns BattleMech, the 75 ton Hammerhands debuted in 2475 and served as one of the progenitor designs that would influence the iconic Warhammer. Powered by a 225-rated Fusion Core, the Hammerhands HMH-4D is armed with a pair of AC/10’s and a PPC. A pair of Medium Lasers support the bigger guns at close range.
column2: 作为一种早期联邦太阳战斗机甲，75吨的锤手于2475年首次亮相，是影响后来标志性重锤的始祖设计之一。锤手HMH-4D由一具225级聚变核心驱动，武装为两门AC/10和一门PPC。一对中型激光器在近距离支援这些更大的火炮。ZH

column1: The Harpy, the first ProtoMech ever created, it is about as effective as a single elemental, it did however show that Protomechs could be a effective weapon. This Variant carries a MG and 20 rounds of ammo. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95
column2: 鹰身女妖是有史以来第一台原生机甲，效能大致相当于一个元素，但它证明了原生机甲可以成为有效武器。此变型带一挺机枪和20发弹药。特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：0.95

column1: So boss. We got our hands on a two ton ProtoMech. I would ask what you plan on doing with this thing but frankly there is so very little you can put on this thing, but your the boss.
column2: 所以老板。我们弄到了一台两吨的原生机甲。我本想问你打算拿这东西怎么办，但说实话，这东西能装的东西实在太少，不过你是老板。ZH

column1: The Mech Daniel received was a bridging design between the early field-test HTM-26T and the later production HTM-27T. Dropping two tons of armor and outfitted with a bulkier and less refined Endo-Steel chassis, enough weight was saved to mount a pair of experimental Luthien Armor Works developed LB 10-X AC prototypes in it arms and a pair of Telos SRM-4 launchers in its chest. Quirk: Way of the Samurai Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: Daniel收到的这台机甲是早期野战测试型HTM-26T与后来量产型HTM-27T之间的过渡设计。它减掉两吨装甲，并装上更笨重、工艺更粗糙的钢内骨结构底盘，由此省下的重量足以在双臂安装两门实验性的Luthien Armor Works研发的LB 10-X AC原型，以及在胸部装设两具Telos SRM-4发射器。特性：武士之道 投放费用倍率：1.16

column1: Mech Daniel received was a bridging design between the early field-test HTM-26T and the later production HTM-27T. Dropping two tons of armor and outfitted with a bulkier and less refined Endo-Steel chassis, enough weight was saved to mount a pair of experimental Luthien Armor Works developed LB 10-X AC prototypes in it arms and a pair of Telos SRM-6 launchers in its chest.
column2: 丹尼尔收到的机甲是早期实地测试型HTM-26T与后期量产型HTM-27T之间的过渡设计。它减去两吨装甲，换装更笨重、更粗糙的内层钢底盘，省出的重量足以在双臂装上一对卢西恩装甲厂研发的实验性LB 10-X AC原型，并在胸部装上两具泰洛斯SRM-6发射器。ZH

column1: Refitted in the relative quiet of the Sabres' guard duty years on Luthien after the initial Clan Invasion, the prototype chassis and autocannons were swapped for production-grade components, while the power plant was swapped for a lighter model. Though reducing the 'Mech's maximum ground speed to 50 km/h, this frees up the weight to increase the armor to fifteen and half tons, add a C3 master computer and swap the SRM-4s for a pair of Streak SRM-6 launchers, while retaining the same volume of missile and autocannon ammunition. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: 在部族入侵初期之后，Sabres 于 Luthien 执行守备任务的那段相对平静的岁月里，该机体接受了改装：原型底盘与自动炮换成量产级部件，动力装置也换成更轻的型号。虽然这将机甲的最大地面速度降至 50 km/h，但省出的重量得以把装甲增至十五吨半、加装一套 C3 主控计算机，并把 SRM-4 换成两组连发 SRM-6 发射器，同时保持导弹与自动炮弹药的数量不变。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.16

column1: A melding of the popular Star League era Thug and the poorly regarded Charger, the samurai-themed Hatamoto-Chi was the first post–Succession Wars Draconis Combine BattleMech constructed utilizing recovered LosTech. Tasked by Kanrei Theodore Kurita to reverse engineer examples of the advanced Star League Defense Force BattleMechs provided by ComStar in 3035 for future production, Luthien Armor Works secretly mated the weaponry of the Thug to the form of the maligned Charger. While initially unable to mass produce the advanced Endo Steel chassis required to match the Thug, the appearance of the early Hatamoto-Chi and their endless variations born of the Charger's spacious torso sent the combined Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth into confusion during the War of 3039.
column2: 武士主题的旗本-智是星盟时代广受欢迎的恶棍与评价不佳的冲锋者的融合体，也是继承战争后德拉科尼斯联合体首款使用找回的失传技术建造的战斗机甲。在政务官西奥多·库瑞塔的委派下，鲁西恩装甲工厂着手对康星于 3035 年提供的先进星盟防卫军战斗机甲样机进行逆向工程以备未来生产，并秘密地把恶棍的武器装进了遭人诟病的冲锋者躯壳。虽然最初无法量产与恶棍匹配的先进内骨骼底盘，但早期旗本-智凭借冲锋者宽敞躯干衍生出的无尽变体，在 3039 年战争期间令联邦联邦联合武装部队陷入混乱。ZH

column1: The 27U, also known as the Hatamoto-Hi, is almost identical to the 27T. The differences in the designs come in with the removal of the two SRM-6 launchers and the addition of four Medium Pulse Lasers and an additional heat sink to help with the additional heat burden. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 27U 也被称为 Hatamoto-Hi，与 27T 几乎完全相同。两者的差异在于拆除了两具 SRM-6 发射器，并加装四门中型脉冲激光和一台额外的散热器，以应对额外的热负荷。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂

column1: The 27Y, known as the Hatamoto-Mizo, removes both of the SRM-6 launchers and replaces them with a single ER Large Laser. This 'Mech is a powerful long range combat 'Mech and can keep an enemy at range and slowly take the armor off of a 'Mech. By the time an enemy is able to close with the Hatamoto-Mizo it can usually be taken out in physical combat. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 27Y 又名 Hatamoto-Mizo，它拆除了两具 SRM-6 发射器，代之以一具增程大型激光。这具机甲是强大的远程战斗机甲，能将敌人压制在远处，慢慢剥去其装甲。等到敌人终于能逼近 Hatamoto-Mizo 时，通常已经可以在近身混战中将其解决。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂

column1: A 3059 upgrade of the 27T model, the 28T exchanges the two PPCs for two ER PPCs. The 'Mech also upgrades the two SRM-6 launchers to Streak SRM-6 launchers. Finally, the 'Mech is armed with two ER medium lasers and carries a C3 slave unit to allow it to share targeting data with other friendly units. The 'Mech achieves this by reducing its top speed to 54 km/h and makes up for some of the 'Mech's lost maneuverability by adding three jump jets, giving it a jumping distance of ninety meters. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是27T型号的3059年升级版，28T把两门粒子加农炮换成两门增程粒子加农炮，并把两具SRM-6发射器升级为连发SRM-6，最后还装了两门增程中型激光并带一台C3从机，以便与其他友军单位共享瞄准数据。为达成这些，该机甲把最高速度降到54公里/小时，并通过加装三具跳跃推进器（跳跃距离九十米）弥补部分损失的机动性。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: A complete rearmament of an HTM-28T, only the C3 slave remains. A gauss rifle is fitted in the left arm with three tons of ammunition riding in the left torso. The left torso also holds six medium pulse lasers. The right arm carries a large sword. Triple-Strength Myomer greatly increase the damage done by the blade. Only ten double heat sinks are used, allowing the TSM to remain active. Quirk: Way of the Samurai Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: 这是对HTM-28T的彻底重新武装，仅保留了C3辅助单元。左臂装有一门高斯步枪，左躯干携带三吨弹药。左躯干还装有六门中型脉冲激光。右臂携带一把大型剑。三倍强度肌纤维大幅提升了剑刃造成的伤害。整机仅使用十台双散热器，从而使三倍强度肌纤维得以保持激活状态。特性：武士道 投放费用倍率：1.16

column1: The HTM-56K, also known as the Hatamoto-Ni or Hatamoto-Chi II, mounts two ER PPC as the main damage dealers, one in each arm. Four side torso mounted Medium Lasers and a Streak SRM-2 act as reserve firepower as needed, while an AMS and a Small Laser provide defensive capabilities. The 'Mech also carries a Guardian ECM and a C3 Slave computer. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: HTM-56K 又称 Hatamoto-Ni 或 Hatamoto-Chi II，双臂各装一门增程粒子加农炮作为主要伤害输出。位于侧躯干的四门中型激光和一具连发 SRM-2 在需要时充当后备火力，而一套反导弹系统（AMS）和一门小型激光则提供防御能力。该机甲还配有一具守护者电子对抗系统和一台 C3 从属计算机。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.14

column1: A simple refit of the 56K, dropping the C.A.S.E. protection to instead increase the armoring by a half-ton. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: 56K的简单改装型，去掉了C.A.S.E.防护，转而将装甲增加半吨。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.14

column1: An mercenary variant of the HTM-27T, upgraded with ER PPC. Although not officially sold by the Draconis Combine, several of these somehow found their way across the galaxy. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: HTM-27T 的雇佣兵变型，升级为 增程粒子加农炮。虽然龙脉联合体并未正式出售该型号，仍有数台不知怎么地辗转流落到了银河各处。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: The Hatamoto-Hi HTM-60U is an unofficial mercenary refit of the original Hatamoto-Hi. It upgrades the PPC to Extended Range versions, and replaces all the lasers with four Medium Pulse Lasers. A C3 slave computer is alos added to the head of the 'Mech. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: Hatamoto-Hi HTM-60U 是雇佣兵对原版 Hatamoto-Hi 的非官方改装。它将粒子加农炮升级为增程型号，并将所有激光替换为四具中型脉冲激光。机甲的头部还加装了一台 C3 从属计算机。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂

column1: A unsanctioned variant of the Hatamoto-Ku, which replaces the cooling to use double heat sinks. The freed up weight capacity is used to exchange the PPCs for ER version as well as adding two Medium Lasers. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 这是 Hatamoto-Ku 的一种未经批准的变型，它改用双散热器。腾出的重量用于将粒子加农炮换成增程型号，并加装两门中型激光。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: The Hatamoto-Mizo HTM-60Y replaces the PPC with ER PPC and adds an extra Medium Laser. This is achieved by converting the design to use double heat sinks, thus freeing two tons of weight capacity. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 旗本·美佐（Hatamoto-Mizo）HTM-60Y 将粒子加农炮替换为增程粒子加农炮，并额外增加一门中型激光。这是通过将该设计改用双散热器实现的，由此腾出了两吨的承重余量。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: The HTM-60Z, or the Hitamoto-Samurai, carries a large Katana-like vibro sword, mainly to bring fear to its opponents. The 'Mech still manages to fit two ER Large Lasers, four Medium Pulse Lasers, three Medium Lasers and two Small Lasers, as well as a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Way of the Samurai Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: HTM-60Z，又称“旗本武士”，携带着一柄类似武士刀的大型振动剑，主要是为了震慑对手。这台机甲仍设法装下了两门增程大型激光、四门中型脉冲激光、三门中型激光与两门小型激光，以及一台C3从属机。特性：武士道 投放费用倍率：1.14

column1: A further variation of the Hatamoto-Hi, the C variant is identical to the 27U with the exception of the removal of a single heat sink. The HTM-C also carries a C3 slave unit into battle. The 'Mech is an excellent sniper 'Mech because of the ability to share targeting data with friendly units. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 作为旗本-飞进一步衍生的变型，C型除拆掉一个散热器外与27U完全相同。HTM-C还带一台C3从机参战。由于能与友军共享瞄准数据，该机甲是一款出色的狙击机甲。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: The HTM-CM is also based on the Hatamoto-Hi variant and carries a C3 master computer into battle, allowing it to coordinate an entire C3 lance. This is done by removing two of the Medium Pulse Lasers and a heat sink. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: HTM-CM 同样以 Hatamoto-Hi 变型机为基础，并携 C3 主控计算机投入战斗，因而能够协调整个 C3 小队。为此拆除了两门中型脉冲激光和一具散热器。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂

column1: While many may attribute the model code of this 'Mech to the term \"samurai,\" this Hatamoto-Chi was in fact piloted by Samuel Yoshida of the Second Sword of Light. Yoshida was a known lover of puns, which may explain why the 'Mech holds two prototype assault katana blades - two \"swords of light\". Quirk: Way of the Samurai Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: 许多人或许会把这台机甲的型号代码归因于“武士”一词，但这台旗本·智实际上由第二光之剑的塞缪尔·吉田驾驶。吉田是出了名的双关语爱好者，这或许能解释为何这台机甲手持两把原型突击武士刀——两把“光之剑”。特性：武士之道 投放费用倍率：1.16

column1: You'd think the Dracs would be a little less on the nose with slapping \"dash S A M\" onto a 'Mech modeled after a samurai, but what do I know? Cool swords, though. Shame they're fused to the hands.
column2: 你会以为龙脉人在给一台以武士为原型的机甲刷上“dash S A M”时会稍微含蓄一点，但我知道什么呢？剑挺酷的。可惜焊死在手上了。ZH

column1: The Alpha configuration of the Havoc is a pure short range alpha striker. Two Large Pulse Lasers and ten SRM-6 launchers means the sudden damage can be quite substantial. The 'Mech also carries a NARC launcher to assist with targeting. Quirk: Experimental TC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 浩劫的 A 型配置是纯粹的近程爆发打击手。两门大型脉冲激光和十具 SRM-6 发射器意味着瞬间伤害相当可观。这台机甲还装有一具 NARC 发射器以辅助瞄准。特性：实验性瞄准计算机 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Developed by Clan Diamond Shark but sold all through the clans, the Havoc is a not very advanced but still carries an impressive arsenal of weapons. Created as a cheap line 'Mech, the goal is to dish out maximum damage at close to medium ranges.
column2: 浩劫由钻石鲨氏族开发，却销往各氏族。它技术不算先进，却携带可观的武器库。作为廉价一线机甲设计，目标是在近中距离输出最大伤害。ZH

column1: The B loadout carries a massive Autocannon/20 in the Left Arm and three large pulse lasers in the right. A targeting computer help coordinate the firing sequences of the weapons. Quirk: Experimental TC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: B配置在左臂搭载一门巨大的自动炮/20，右臂则装有三门大型脉冲激光。一台瞄准计算机帮助协调各武器的射击时序。特性：实验性瞄准计算机 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The C configuration serves as the long range missile boat of the chassis. Four LRM-20 ensures that any missile volley will be quite hard to counter even with AMS protection. Quirk: Experimental TC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: C 配置是该底盘的远程导弹平台。四具 LRM-20 确保任何一轮导弹齐射都极难被拦截，即便有 AMS 防护也不例外。特性：实验型瞄准计算机 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The primary configuration of the Havoc uses a LBX AC/10 as the main damage dealer together with one Large and three Medium Pulse Lasers. Three Streak SRM-6 provide extra punch at close ranges, while an Artemis IV-enabled LRM-15 launcher provide some longer range missile fire capabilities. Quirk: Experimental TC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 浩劫的主配置以一门LBX AC/10作为主要伤害来源，搭配一门大型脉冲激光和三门中型脉冲激光。三具连发SRM-6在近距提供额外打击力，而一具带阿尔忒弥斯IV的LRM-15发射器提供一定的远程导弹火力。特性：实验型瞄准计算机 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A product of the brief détente between the Circinus Federation and the Marian Hegemony, the Hazard is a rarity in the Periphery; a brand new mech model built from scratch. While much hyped by both parties, the breakdown of diplomatic relations lead to the mechs near extinction, with only a couple of dozen models produced. The Hazard HZD-1A is a 45-ton mech designed to hunt Infantry and Battle Armor in an Urban Environment. The 1A is armed with 4 Flamers, a pair of SRM-4’s and a pair of Medium Lasers. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 作为切尔西努斯联邦与马里亚纳霸权短暂缓和期的产物，哈扎德在外围地区十分罕见：一款从零打造的全新机甲型号。虽然双方都大肆宣传，但外交关系破裂使这款机甲几近灭绝，只造出二十来台。哈扎德HZD-1A是45吨机甲，设计用于在城市环境中猎杀步兵与战斗装甲。1A装有4具火焰喷射器、一对SRM-4和两门中型激光。特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A 3050's era design, the Hecatoncheires is the FWL's attempt to produce a dedicated heavy scout suitable for the modern battlefield. Based on a previously rejected redesign of the venerable Cyclops, the Hecatoncheires downsizes the classic cyclops to 65 tons in weight. A Beagle Active probe, paired with a C3 unit make up the mechs specialist electronics. 4 Medium Lasers and a pair of SRM-6's with Artemis IV provide a nasty punch at close range, while a Gauss Rifle covers longer ranges. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: Hecatoncheires 是 3050 年代的设计，是 FWL（自由世界联盟）为打造适用于现代战场的专用重型侦察机甲所做的尝试。它以早先被否决的 Cyclops 改进方案为基础，将这台经典机甲缩小至 65 吨。机甲的特种电子设备由一部 Beagle 主动探测器与一套 C3 单元组成。4 门中型激光与两套带 Artemis IV 的 SRM-6 在近距离能打出凶猛的打击，而一门高斯步枪则负责较远距离的交战。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: A 3050's era design, the Hecatoncheires is the FWL's attempt to produce a dedicated heavy scout suitable for the modern battlefield. Based on a previously rejected redesign of the venerable Cyclops, the Hecatoncheires downsizes the classic cyclops to 65 tons in weight. The 4-Cm is a command variant intended to lead lances of Hecatoncheires or other C3 equipped mechs in combat. Downsizing the SRM-6's to a pair of SRM-4's allows the C3 Slave to swapped out for a Master unit. The mech is otherwise the same as the standard configuration. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 百臂是3050年代的设计，是自由世界联盟为打造适合现代战场的专职重型侦察机所作的尝试。它基于此前被否决的对古老独眼巨人的重新设计，把经典的独眼巨人缩减到65吨。4-Cm是用于率领百臂或其他装备C3机甲小队的指挥变型。把SRM-6缩减为一对SRM-4，使C3从机得以换成主机；除此之外该机甲与标准配置相同。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: An export model of the Hecatoncheires, the 4H was an unpopular failure. Intended to compliment the C3 lances, the 4H strips out the C3 and Probe to replace them with Jump Jets. A UAC/10 replaces the Gauss Rifle and Streak SRMs are mounted in place of the standard models. Whilst more mobile and possessing a heavier punch at close range, the design was unpopular with most of the production run sold to the Mercenary market. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 作为百臂巨人的外销型号，4H 是一次不受欢迎的失败之作。它本意是作为 C3 小队的补充，却拆掉了 C3 与探测器，换装跳跃推进器。一门 UAC/10 取代了高斯步枪，连发 SRM 也取代了标准型号。虽然机动性更好，近距离打击也更沉重，但该设计并不受欢迎，大部分产量都卖到了雇佣兵市场。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: The second BattleMech model introduced by the Free Worlds League, the Hector entered service in 2471, only one year after the original Icarus. Built by Corean Enterprises on Stewart, it used a simple design suited for mass production and quickly became the workhorse of the Free Worlds League. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.88 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 赫克托是自由世界联盟推出的第二款战斗机甲型号，于 2471 年服役，仅比原始伊卡洛斯晚一年。它由斯图尔特上的科里安企业建造，设计简洁、适合量产，很快成为自由世界联盟的主力。特质：窄小低矮轮廓 投放费用倍率：0.88 臂部驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: Designed to support Assault Mechs such as the Victor and the Emperor, the 60 ton Helios is a St. Ives Compact design that entered production in 3058. Powered by a 240-rated Fusion Core and built on an Endo Steel chassis, the Helios HEL-3D is armed with a Gauss Rifle. Paired ER Medium Lasers and SRM-6’s make for a potent combo should anyone try to close range. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Helios 重 60 吨，是圣艾夫斯协约的设计，于 3058 年投产，旨在为 Victor、Emperor 等突击机甲提供支援。Helios HEL-3D 由额定 240 的聚变引擎驱动，采用钢内骨结构，装备一具高斯步枪。两门增程中型激光与 SRM-6 的组合，足以应对任何试图逼近的敌人。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: The 4S Hermes was introduced in 3057 and based on the 3S1 variant. It carries over the MASC and endo steel chassis from the 3S1 model, but has had a complete upgrade of its weapons and engine. The original standard engine has been replaced with an extralight engine, and the armor protection has been upgraded to five and a half tons. The weapons on board the Hermes have also been replaced by three medium pulse lasers, giving the Hermes an unprecedented amount of firepower in its long history. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 赫尔墨斯（Hermes）4S 型于 3057 年推出，以 3S1 变型为基础。它沿用了 3S1 型的 MASC 与钢内骨结构底盘，但对武器和引擎进行了全面升级。原本的标准引擎被替换为超轻型引擎，装甲防护也提升至五点五吨。赫尔墨斯机上的武器同样被替换为三门中型脉冲激光，使赫尔墨斯在其漫长历史中获得了前所未有的火力。特性：改进通信 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: Also known as the 'Mercury', this variant of the Hermes II was introduced in 2802 and used primarily by SAFE's Dark Shadows units. A larger VOX 280 engine was installed to bring the 'Mech's top speed up to 118.8 km/h, although this necessitated the removal of the AC/5, eliminating the 'Mech's long-range firepower. To make up for this, short-range firepower was increased with two additional medium lasers and two machine guns mounted in the right torso. Half a ton of machine gun ammo was stored in the left torso while an additional single heat sink was added. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 该变型也被称为“水星”（Mercury），是 Hermes II 的一款变型，于 2802 年推出，主要装备 SAFE 的暗影部队。它换装了更大的 VOX 280 引擎，将机甲的最高速度提升至 118.8 km/h，但为此不得不拆除 AC/5，从而使机甲彻底失去了远程火力。作为弥补，其近距离火力得到加强，右躯干加装了两门中型激光和两挺机枪。左躯干储存了半吨机枪弹药，并额外增加了一个单散热器。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: The Hermes II was first produced in 2798, based on the original Hermes BattleMech that had been used by the Star League. A heavy scout, the Hermes II boasted respectable weaponry, armoring, and speed, allowing it to easily brawl with lighter 'Mechs or survive an encounter with heavier 'Mechs and retreat. Out of all medium-weight 'Mechs at the time the Hermes II was the easiest to perform field maintenance on, leading to its nickname 'old reliable.' As combination scout and light strike platforms, Hermes II 'Mechs often operated alone, employed for missions for which lighter 'Mechs were too fragile and heavier 'Mechs too clumsy. The Hermes II was in its element when operating in a restrictive environment like a forest or city, where it could employ a most unusual tactic of setting its surroundings on fire to escape pursuit. Since most 'Mech pilots would naturally avoid a fire to prevent overheating and the flames interfered with most thermal scanners, starting a blaze allowed the Hermes II to more easily slip away.
column2: 赫尔墨斯 II 于 2798 年首次生产，基于星盟曾使用的原版赫尔墨斯战斗机甲。作为重型侦察机甲，赫尔墨斯 II 拥有可观的武器、装甲和速度，使其能轻松与轻型机甲缠斗，或在遭遇重型机甲后存活并撤退。在当时所有中型机甲中，赫尔墨斯 II 是最容易进行野战维护的，因此获得"老可靠"的绰号。作为侦察与轻型打击平台的结合体，赫尔墨斯 II 常单独行动，用于那些轻型机甲过于脆弱、重型机甲过于笨拙的任务。在森林或城市之类的受限环境中，赫尔墨斯 II 如鱼得水，可以采用一种极为罕见的战术：点燃周围环境以摆脱追击。由于大多数机甲机师会本能地避开火焰以防过热，而火焰又会干扰大多数热扫描仪，放火能让赫尔墨斯 II 更轻易地溜走。ZH

column1: The Hermes II HER-2R is a late 28th century refit of the classic Hermes II, replacing almost everything except the flamer with more modern technology. The switch to double heat sinks allowed two Extended Range Large Lasers as its main weapons. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: Hermes II HER-2R 是 28 世纪后期对经典 Hermes II 的改装型号，除了火焰喷射器之外几乎全部换装了更为现代的技术。改用双散热器后，它得以将两具增程大型激光作为主武器。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂

column1: The primary weapon on the -2S is an AC/5 in the right torso, with a single ton of ammo in the left torso. The 'Mech carries limited secondary weapons, only a medium laser in the right arm as well as a flamer in the left. The rest of the stats of the 'Mech are pretty normal for its size and time of design, 7.5 tons of standard armor, a 240-rated engine core and 10 single heat sinks. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: -2S 的主要武器是装在右躯干的一门 AC/5，左躯干放有一吨弹药。该机甲的副武器很有限，只有右臂的一门中型激光和左臂的一具火焰喷射器。该机甲其余的属性以其体型和设计年代而言相当普通：7.5 吨标准装甲、额定 240 的引擎核心和 10 台单散热器。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂

column1: A lostech era downgrade of the HER-2R distinct enough to earn it the separate designation of Hermes III, the HER-4K was introduced in 3025. Although based on the Hermes II, it replaces the autocannon of the design with two Large Lasers to not be ammunition dependant, and uses single heat sinks instead of the original's double heat sinks. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: HER-4K是失落科技时代对HER-2R的一次降级改造，改动之大足以让它获得独立编号“赫尔墨斯III”，于3025年推出。它虽以赫尔墨斯II为基础，却以两门大型激光取代该设计的自动炮，从而不依赖弹药，并用单散热器取代原来的双散热器。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.02

column1: The Hermes III was created by Ostmann Industries by taking a Hermes II HER-2S and adapting it to the available technology in the Draconis Combine at that time. Its main goal was to act as a smaller companion to the Ostsol line, retaining the scouting and light skirmisher role of the original Hermes and Hermes II. As the demand for more upgraded mechs in these roles started growing, Luthien Armor Works upgraded a number of ageing first generation Hermes III to modern standards.
column2: 赫尔墨斯III由奥斯特曼工业打造：他们取一台赫尔墨斯II HER-2S，将其改装以适配当时龙脉联合体可用的技术。其主要目标是作为奥斯特索系列的较小伙伴，保留原版赫尔墨斯与赫尔墨斯II的侦察与轻型散兵角色。随着这些角色对升级机甲的需求开始增长，卢西恩装甲厂把若干老化的第一代赫尔墨斯III升级到现代标准。ZH

column1: The 5S variant of the Hermes II was an upgrade of the design incorporating the recovery of lostech. Its standard chassis has been replaced with an Endo Steel one, freeing up mass for a number of changes. The original AC/5 was replaced with an UAC/5, although it still only carries one ton of ammo, and the medium laser with an Medium Pulse Laser. The original Flamer was kept, while the single heat sinks were replaced with doubles. Although this change was met with some criticism since the original design was not known to cause heat management problems in the first place, the double heat sinks allow pilots to redline their machines even after significant engine damage. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: Hermes II 的 5S 变型是结合失落科技复兴成果的升级设计。它的标准底盘被钢内骨结构底盘取代，从而腾出质量进行多项改动。原有的 AC/5 换成 UAC/5——尽管仍只携带一吨弹药——中型激光则换成中型脉冲激光。原有火焰喷射器予以保留，单散热器则替换为双散热器。尽管这一改动招致一些批评，毕竟原设计本就不以散热管理问题著称，但双散热器让机师即便在引擎严重受损后也能把机甲压到极限运转。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部

Quirk: Reinforced Legs Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 据说由星蛇部族的星上校 Hazel 驾驶，这具 Highlander IIC 在右臂和左躯干各装备一门高斯步枪，近距离由左臂和右躯干的两具连发 SRM-4 发射器支援。万一那四吨高斯弹药和五吨连发弹药耗尽，左臂还搭载着一具增程大型激光。Keeper 以一台 280 级 XL 引擎和一副钢内骨结构为基础，配备三具跳跃推进器、十二具双散热器，并披挂十四点五吨标准装甲。特性：强化腿部 投放费用倍率：1.24 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

column1: Reportedly piloted by Star Colonel Hazel of Clan Star Adder, this Highlander IIC is armed with a Gauss Rifle in the right arm and left torso, supported at short-range by a pair of Streak SRM-4 launchers in left arm and right torso. In case the four tons of Gauss rounds and five tons of Streak reloads run out, the left-arm also carries an ER Large Laser. Keeper is built around an 280-rated XL engine and an Endo Steel frame, fitted with three jump jets and twelve double heat sinks and clad in fourteen and a half tons of standard armor.
column2: 据报由星蝰氏族的黑兹尔星上校驾驶，这台高地人IIC在右臂和左躯干各装一门高斯步枪，近距离由左臂与右躯干的成对连发SRM-4发射器支援。万一四吨高斯步枪弹和五吨连发备用弹打光，左臂还装有一门增程大型激光器。守门人围绕一具280级XL引擎和内层钢框架建造，装三个跳跃推进器、十二具双重散热器，并披挂十四吨半标准装甲。ZH

column1: A Wolf Dragoons refit if the classic Hoplite, the 5W mounts both a Gauss Rifle and an MRM-40 launcher. A C3 slave unit was also added. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是经典Hoplite的狼龙骑兵团改装版，5W同时装备一门高斯步枪和一座MRM-40发射器。此外还加装了一台C3从属单元。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Armed with a single large pulse laser in the center torso and a medium pulse laser in each arm, the Horned Owl HOW-1's devastatingly accurate fire can quickly destroy other light 'Mechs. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: Horned Owl HOW-1 在中央躯干装有一门大型脉冲激光，每条手臂各有一门中型脉冲激光，其精准得可怕的射击能迅速摧毁其他轻型机甲。特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.04

column1: Horned Owl
column2: 角鸮

column1: The Horned Owl, or Peregrine as the Inner Sphere designated it, is a light, fast second-line BattleMech capable of highly accurate fire. It was designed by Clan Goliath Scorpion as a rugged submersible construction ’Mech and was later rebuilt for combat[1]. A harassing platform, the Horned Owl is also a capable dueling 'Mech. Five tons of ferro-fibrous armor provide adequate protection for the light 'Mech.
column2: 角鸮（Horned Owl）——内层星域将其编号为“游隼”（Peregrine）——是一种轻便、高速的二线战斗机甲，能够实施极高精度的射击。它由歌利亚蝎部族设计，原本是一种坚固耐用的潜水工程机甲，后来被改装用于作战[1]。作为一种骚扰平台，角鸮同时也是一台出色的决斗机甲。五吨铁纤维装甲为这台轻型机甲提供了充足的防护。ZH

column1: This variant trades in its lasers for six LRM-5s and four tons of ammunition. Though it is entirely ammunition-dependent, this model can provide light Stars with sustained support, as it will not build up heat under normal circumstances. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 该变型用六具 LRM-5 和四吨弹药换掉了全部激光。尽管它完全依赖弹药，但该型号能为轻型星群提供持续支援，因为在正常情况下它不会积热。特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.04

column1: Unlike the 2, this variant returns to a design similar to the original. In place of the large pulse laser there is an ER PPC tied to a targeting computer, allowing this variant to snipe efficiently. In place of the medium pulse lasers are two trios of light machine guns, allowing the design to deal with infantry should it need to. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 与 2 型不同，这一变型回归了接近原版的设计。它用一门与瞄准计算机相连的 ER PPC 取代了大型脉冲激光，使这一变型能够高效狙击。中型脉冲激光的位置则换成两组、每组三挺的轻型机枪，让该设计在需要时能够对付步兵。特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.04

column1: A NAIS sponsored modification to the 171 Hornet model, the 172 transforms the mech into a close range ambush fighter. Mounting a pair of experimental Medium X-Pulse lasers and a SRM-2, the 172 is designed to hunt and harass enemy recon units in urban environments. Never entering full production, the limited production of the experimental lasers quickly shelved the 172 design with only a dozen units entering field trials with frontline units. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 172 是由 NAIS 资助、基于 171 Hornet 型号的改装型，将该机甲改造成近程伏击战机。172 装有两门实验性中型 X 脉冲激光和一具 SRM-2，设计用于在城市环境中猎杀和骚扰敌方侦察单位。它从未进入全面生产，实验性激光的产量有限，使 172 的设计很快被束之高阁，仅有十几台在一线部队中参加野外试验。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: A NAIS sponsored modification to the 171 Hornet model, the 172 transforms the mech into a close range ambush fighter. Mounting a pair of experimental Medium X-Pulse lasers and a SRM-2, the 172 is designed to hunt and harass enemy recon units in urban environments. Never entering full production, the limited production of the experimental lasers quickly shelved the 172 design with only a dozen units entering field trials with frontline units.
column2: 作为NAIS赞助的对171黄蜂型号的改装，172把这台机甲变成近距伏击战斗机。它装有一对实验性中型X脉冲激光器和一具SRM-2，172被设计用于在城市环境中猎杀并袭扰敌方侦察单位。它从未进入量产，实验性激光器的有限产量很快让172设计被搁置，只有十几台进入前线部队的实地测试。ZH

column1: The Hounddog mounts a total of six machine guns, but only with a single ton of ammunition. For increased mobility it also mounts two jump jets, but at the cost of only being able to fit 1.5 tons of standard armor. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: 猎犬共装有六挺机枪，但只有一吨弹药。为增强机动性，它还装有两个跳跃推进器，代价是只能安装1.5吨标准装甲。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.97

column1: The Hounddog is a 15 ton ultralight Battlemech of dubious origin. Created and constructed by some unnamed periphery factory, most likely using stolen designs, it has mainly been seen in use by pirates and mercenary outfits.
column2: 猎犬是一种来历可疑的15吨超轻型战斗机甲。由某家无名的外缘工厂创造并建造，很可能使用了窃取的设计，它主要出现在海盗与雇佣兵部队手中。ZH

column1: Originally developed by Clan Fire Mandrill during the Golden Century, the 20-ton Howler is a light support mech. Built around a 140-rated Fusion Core the Howler HWR-1 uses a combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel; allowing the Mech to carry 3 LRM-5’s and 3 tons of ammo. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: 20吨的嚎叫者最初由火狒部族在黄金世纪期间开发，是一台轻型支援机甲。嚎叫者HWR-1围绕一具额定140的聚变核心打造，采用铁纤维装甲与钢内骨结构的组合，从而得以携带3具LRM-5与3吨弹药。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.97

column1: Originally developed by Clan Fire Mandrill during the Golden Century, the 20-ton Howler is a light support mech. Built around a 140-rated Fusion Core the Howler HWR-1 uses a combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel; allowing the Mech to carry 3 LRM-5’s and 3 tons of ammo.
column2: 嚎叫者最初由火狒氏族在黄金世纪研发，20吨的嚎叫者是一种轻型支援机甲。嚎叫者HWR-1围绕一具140级聚变核心建造，采用铁纤装甲与内层钢的组合，使机甲能携带3具LRM-5和3吨弹药。ZH

column1: Originally developed by Clan Fire Mandrill during the Golden Century, the 20-ton Howler is a light support mech. Built around a 140-rated Fusion Core the Howler HW-4 uses a combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel; allowing the Mech to carry a single LRM-5 and a ton of ammo. 7 Jump Jets round out this variant; which is typically used as a trainer Mech. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: 20吨的嗥叫由火狒狒部族在黄金世纪研制，是一款轻型支援机甲。嗥叫HW-4围绕一台140额定聚变核心建造，采用铁纤维装甲与钢内骨结构的组合，使机甲得以携带一具LRM-5和一吨弹药。此变型另有7具跳跃推进器，通常被用作教练机甲。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.97

column1: Originally developed by Clan Fire Mandrill during the Golden Century, the 20-ton Howler is a light support mech. Built around a 140-rated Fusion Core the Howler HW-4 uses a combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel; allowing the Mech to carry a single LRM-5 and a ton of ammo. 7 Jump Jets round out this variant; which is typically used as a trainer Mech.
column2: 嚎叫者是火狒氏族在黄金世纪研发的20吨轻型支援机甲。嚎叫者HW-4围绕一具140级聚变核心建造，采用铁纤装甲与内层钢的组合，使机甲能携带一具LRM-5和一吨弹药。7个跳跃推进器补全了这一改型；它通常被用作教练机甲。ZH

column1: Originally developed by Clan Fire Mandrill during the Golden Century, the 20-ton Howler is a light support mech. Built around a 140-rated Fusion Core the Howler HWR-5 uses a combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel; allowing the Mech to carry 6 ER Medium Lasers. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: Howler 最初由火狒狒部族（Clan Fire Mandrill）在黄金世纪研发，是一台 20 吨的轻型支援机甲。HWR-5 围绕一台 140 额定的聚变核心建造，结合铁纤维装甲与钢内骨结构，使该机甲得以搭载 6 门增程中型激光。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.97

column1: Originally developed by Clan Fire Mandrill during the Golden Century, the 20-ton Howler is a light support mech. Built around a 140-rated Fusion Core the Howler HWR-5 uses a combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel; allowing the Mech to carry 6 ER Medium Lasers.
column2: 嚎叫者最初由火狒氏族在黄金世纪研发，20吨的嚎叫者是一种轻型支援机甲。嚎叫者HWR-5围绕一具140级聚变核心建造，采用铁纤装甲与内层钢的组合，使机甲能携带6门增程中型激光器。ZH

column1: The -4A replaces the AC/20 with a LBX 20 Autocannon, and drops the Small Laser to add a C.A.S.E. system for better protection against ammo explosions. This variant was introduced as a response to the arrival of the Clans in the Inner Sphere, and with that the need for a modernization of second line 'Mechs. However, the change proved to not make a large impact and the design never saw wide use. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: -4A 型将 AC/20 替换为 LBX 20 自动炮，并舍弃小型激光，以加装 C.A.S.E. 系统，从而更好地防范弹药殉爆。该变型是为应对部族进入内层星域、以及随之而来的二线机甲现代化需求而推出的。然而事实证明，这一改动影响有限，该设计从未得到广泛使用。特性：战斗铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.04

column1: The -4A replaces the AC/20 with a LBX 20 Autocannon, and drops the Small Laser to add a C.A.S.E. system for better protection against ammo explosions. This variant was introduced as a response to the arrival of the Clans in the Inner Sphere, and with that the need for a modernization of second line 'Mechs. However, the change proved to not make a large impact and the design never saw wide use.
column2: -4A把AC/20换成LBX 20自动炮，并拆掉小型激光器以加装C.A.S.E.系统，更好地防护弹药爆炸。该改型是为回应氏族进入内天体、以及随之而来的二线机甲现代化需求而推出。然而这一改动被证明影响不大，该设计从未广泛使用。ZH

column1: Assigned Jerrar's 'Mech after his retirement from the Sabres, Hohiro Utsonomiya had it refitted with post-Clan Invasion technology during the Jihad. The addition of an Endosteel chassis and Ferro-Fibrous armor frees up weight to swap the standard AC/20 for an Ultra Autocannon/10, retaining the two ton ammo bay, carrying standard production grade Medium Pulse Lasers in the arms and a ER Small Laser in the head, adding a C3 Slave in the center torso. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
column2: 杰拉尔从“军刀”部队退役后，他的机甲被分配给了宏广·宇都宫；后者在圣战期间用部族入侵后的技术对其改装。加入钢内骨结构底盘与铁纤维装甲腾出重量，把标准AC/20换成超级自动炮/10，保留两吨弹药舱，双臂装标准生产级中型脉冲激光，头部一门增程小型激光，中央躯干加装一台C3从机。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.06

column1: Assigned Jerrar's 'Mech after his retirement from the Sabres, Hohiro Utsonomiya had it refitted with post-Clan Invasion technology during the Jihad. The addition of an Endosteel chassis and Ferro-Fibrous armor frees up weight to swap the standard AC/20 for an Ultra Autocannon/10, retaining the two ton ammo bay, carrying standard production grade Medium Pulse Lasers in the arms and a ER Small Laser in the head, adding a C3 Slave in the center torso.
column2: 杰拉尔从军刀退役后，这台机甲被分配给了他；弘人·宇都宫在圣战期间用氏族入侵后的技术对它进行了改装。加入内层钢底盘和铁纤装甲省出的重量，把标准AC/20换成了一门超速自动炮/10，保留两吨弹药舱，双臂装标准量产级中型脉冲激光器，头部装一门增程小型激光器，中央躯干加一套C3从属系统。ZH

column1: The personal 'Mech of Sorenson's Sabres member and future Internal Security Force director Shakir Jerrar was refitted to an advanced variation of the -4H in the lead-up to the War of 3039, carrying two prototype medium pulse lasers in place of the four standard medium lasers. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 索伦森之剑成员、后来的内部安全部队总监沙基尔·杰拉尔的私人机甲，在3039年战争前夕被改装为-4H的先进变型，以两门原型中型脉冲激光取代四门标准中型激光。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.04

column1: Created for the SLDF Royal Divisions, the Hunchback 4Gb is a variant of the regular 4G. Built around a larger 250-rated XL Engine the 4Gb is capable of achieving speeds in excess of 80 km/h. The excess weight generated by the larger engine allowed engineers to replace the AC/20 with a Gauss Rifle. The other major change made by the SLDF engineers was to swap the 4G's heat sinks for double strength models; freeing up additional weight that was used to upgrade the Lasers to Pulse models and add CASE to the volatile Gauss Rifle. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
column2: Hunchback 4Gb 是为 SLDF 皇家师团打造的，是常规 4G 的变型。4Gb 围绕更大的一台 250 级 XL 引擎建造，速度可超过 80 km/h。更大引擎带来的额外重量让工程师得以用高斯步枪取代 AC/20。SLDF 工程师所做的另一项重大改动，是把 4G 的散热器换成双倍效能型号；由此腾出的额外重量被用于将激光升级为脉冲型号，并为易爆的高斯步枪加装 CASE。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.06

column1: Created for the SLDF Royal Divisions, the Hunchback 4Gb is a variant of the regular 4G. Built around a larger 250-rated XL Engine the 4Gb is capable of achieving speeds in excess of 80 km/h. The excess weight generated by the larger engine allowed engineers to replace the AC/20 with a Gauss Rifle. The other major change made by the SLDF engineers was to swap the 4G's heat sinks for double strength models; freeing up additional weight that was used to upgrade the Lasers to Pulse models and add CASE to the volatile Gauss Rifle.
column2: 为SLDF皇家师创造，驼背4Gb是常规4G的一个改型。4Gb围绕一具更大的250级XL引擎建造，最高速度可超过80公里/小时。更大引擎产生的富余重量让工程师得以把AC/20换成一门高斯步枪。SLDF工程师做出的另一项主要改动是把4G的散热器换成双倍强度型号；省下的额外重量用于把激光器升级为脉冲型号，并为易爆的高斯步枪加装CASE。ZH

column1: An early clan Mech dating from the days of Operation Klondike, the Hunchback HBK-4G-EC was an upgrade of the HBK-4G that replaced the weapons with Early Clan variants. It would be discontinued and forgotten as modern clan spec weapons entered production. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: 驼背HBK-4G-EC是源自克朗代克行动时期的早期部族机甲，是HBK-4G的升级型，将武器替换为早期部族型号。随着现代部族规格武器投产，它最终停产并被遗忘。特性：战斗铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.02

column1: An early clan Mech dating from the days of Operation Klondike, the Hunchback HBK-4G-EC was an upgrade of the HBK-4G that replaced the weapons with Early Clan variants. It would be discontinued and forgotten as modern clan spec weapons entered production.
column2: 作为可追溯到克朗代克行动时期的一种早期氏族机甲，驼背HBK-4G-EC是HBK-4G的升级版，把武器换成了早期氏族变体。随着现代氏族规格武器投产，它被停产并逐渐被遗忘。ZH

column1: A custom refit of the Hunchback HBK-4G by the Kell Hounds. The mercenary band upgraded the outdated design greatly by just replacing all weapons with Clan-tech, and otherwise keep the rest of the 'Mech almost the same. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 这是凯尔猎犬对 Hunchback HBK-4G 的定制改装。这支雇佣兵团仅通过将全部武器替换为部族科技，就让这一过时设计得到了极大提升，机甲其余部分则几乎保持原样。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.04

column1: A minor battlefield refit of the -4G, removing the head mounted Small Laser and a heat sink to be able to add a C3 slave unit and C.A.S.E. protection. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: 这是-4G的小幅野战改装，拆掉头部小型激光和一个散热器，以便加装一台C3从机和C.A.S.E.防护。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.02

column1: A full conversion of the -4G to Clan-tech by the Wolf's Dragoons using parts from destroyed or captured 'Mechs during battle. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 这是沃尔夫龙骑兵利用战斗中损毁或缴获机甲的零件，将-4G全面改装为部族科技的产物。特性：战斗铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.1

column1: An upgrade to the HBK-4G, adding both an Anti Missile System and C.A.S.E. for better resilience and switching the 'Mech to use double heat sinks for better heat management. The extra free weight capacity is used to add another half ton of armor. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 这是HBK-4G的升级，同时加装一套反导弹系统和C.A.S.E.以提升韧性，并把机甲改用双散热器以改善热量管理。额外的自由重量容量用于再加半吨装甲。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.04

column1: An upgrade to the HBK-4G, adding both an Anti Missile System and C.A.S.E. for better resilience and switching the 'Mech to use double heat sinks for better heat management. The extra free weight capacity is used to add another half ton of armor.
column2: 作为对HBK-4G的升级，它同时加装了反导弹系统和C.A.S.E.以提升韧性，并把机甲改用双重散热器以获得更好的热量管理。多出的自由重量容量用于增加额外半吨装甲。ZH

column1: A subvariant of the -4G, the -4MJ mounts four Jump Jets for increased mobility. A C.A.S.E. system, slightly different armor profiles, and an upgrade to double heat sinks fills out the design. Mainly seen amongst backwater garrisons and other out of the way locations as the main design is mostly the -4G still, making it very outdated. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: -4MJ 是 -4G 的子变型，为提升机动性加装四个跳跃推进器。一套 C.A.S.E. 系统、略有不同的装甲布局以及升级为双散热器，构成了这一设计的其余部分。它主要出现在偏远驻防部队和其他偏僻地区，因为主力型号至今仍多为 -4G，使其显得十分过时。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.02

column1: The HBK-4MW drops a ton of armor to enable fitting a Large Laser, but to make up for the added fragility a C.A.S.E. system was added and the 'Mech was switched to use double heat sinks. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: HBK-4MW削掉一吨装甲以装入一门大型激光，但为弥补增加的脆弱性，它加装了C.A.S.E.系统并改用双散热器。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.04

column1: The Hunchback HBK-4T, nicknamed Turbo Hunchback, drops both the Medium Lasers to upgrade to a new 250-rated fusion engine core. Due to the increased size of the engine the chassis had to be adapted in such a way that the engine is literally part of the frame, making it impossible to replace. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: Hunchback HBK-4T绰号“涡轮驼背”，它舍弃了两门中型激光，以升级为新的250级聚变引擎核心。由于引擎尺寸增大，底盘不得不随之调整，使引擎实际上成为骨架的一部分，因而无法更换。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.02

column1: The -4TD has one big change from the -4G, the fact that it houses a 350 XL engine core. Also knows as the 'Turbo Hunchback Deluxe', it drops the armoring down to 7 tons and uses an Endo Steel chassis to be able to fit both the massive engine and an extra Medium Laser. Similar to its predecessor, the normal 'Turbo Hunchback', the chassis had to be modified in such a way that replacing the engine core is not possible. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 与-4G相比，-4TD有一个重大变化：它内置了一台350 XL引擎核心。它也被称为“豪华涡轮驼背”，装甲削减到7吨，并采用钢内骨结构底盘，以便同时容纳那台巨型引擎和1门额外的中型激光。与它的前辈——普通的“涡轮驼背”——一样，其底盘经过特殊改造，以致无法更换引擎核心。<特性：战拳 <投放费用倍率：1.04

column1: The -4U replaces the AC/20 with an Ultra AC/10, allowing more ammunition and a C.A.S.E. system to be added. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: -4U以一门超级AC/10取代AC/20，从而得以增加弹药并加装C.A.S.E.系统。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.04

column1: Based on the most common Hunchback ever build was the 4X upgraded with a single OmniSlot module in Right Torso as a Testbed for a wide range of newly developed Weapons and Technologies Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 4X 基于史上最常见的驼背改造，在右躯干加装单个全能槽模块，作为一系列新研发武器与技术的试验平台 特质：战斗铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.04

column1: Based on the most common Hunchback ever build was the 4X upgraded with a single OmniSlot module in Right Torso as a Testbed for a wide range of newly developed Weapons and Technologies
column2: 它基于有史以来最常见的驼背型号4X升级而来，在右躯干加装一个全方位槽位模块，作为各种新研发武器与技术的试验台

column1: Based on the most common Hunchback ever build was the 4X upgraded with a single OmniSlot module in Right Torso as a Testbed for a wide range of newly developed Weapons and Technologies.
column2: 它基于有史以来最常见的驼背型号4X升级而来，在右躯干加装一个全方位槽位模块，作为各种新研发武器与技术的试验台。ZH

column1: A field upgrade kit for the popular 4J model, the 5J is a set of simple upgrades enhancing the effectiveness of the aging design. The addition of double heatsinks enables the removal of 3 heat sinks, whilst still running cooler than the original design. This free weight is used to upgrade the LRM's to the Artemis IV Fire Control system and to replace a pair of medium lasers with pulse variants. The small laser is removed to allow for the addition of CASE , preventing lethal ammo explosions. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 作为热门4J型号的野战升级套件，5J是一组简单升级，旨在提升这款老旧设计的效能。加入双散热器后得以拆掉3个散热器，同时运行温度仍比原设计更低。这份省出的重量用于把LRM升级为阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统，并把两门中型激光换成脉冲型号；小型激光被拆掉，以便加装CASE防止致命的弹药爆炸。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.04

column1: A field upgrade kit for the popular 4J model, the 5J is a set of simple upgrades enhancing the effectiveness of the aging design. The addition of double heatsinks enables the removal of 3 heat sinks, whilst still running cooler than the original design. This free weight is used to upgrade the LRM's to the Artemis IV Fire Control system and to replace a pair of medium lasers with pulse variants. column2: 作为广受欢迎的4J型号的战地升级套件，5J是一组简单升级，提升这一老设计的效能。加入双重散热器使拆掉3具散热器成为可能，同时运行温度仍低于原设计。这些省出的重量用于把LRM升级为阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统，并把两门中型激光器换成脉冲型号。小型激光器被拆除，以便加装CASE，防止致命的弹药爆炸。ZH

column1: An attempt at creating an energy only based Hunchback, the -5L has a total of nine Medium Lasers and two ER Large Lasers. For obvious reasons this design never caught on despite its otherwise similarity to the -5M base design, as even a switch to use 12 double heat sinks still provided far too low cooling capacity. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 这是一次打造纯能量驼背的尝试，-5L共有九门中型激光和两门增程大型激光。由于显而易见的原因，该设计尽管在其余方面与-5M基础设计相似，却始终未能流行——即便改用12个双散热器，冷却能力仍远远不足。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.04

column1: An attempt at creating an energy only based Hunchback, the -5L has a total of nine Medium Lasers and two ER Large Lasers. For obvious reasons this design never caught on despite its otherwise similarity to the -5M base design, as even a switch to use 12 double heat sinks still provided far too low cooling capacity.
column2: -5L是一次打造纯能量驼背的尝试，共有九门中型激光器和两门增程大型激光器。出于显而易见的原因，该设计从未流行起来，尽管它在其他方面与基础设计-5M相似，因为即便改用12具双重散热器，冷却能力仍然远远不足。ZH

column1: The -5SU, or the -5MU as it should really have been called if not for a clerical error when formalizing the prototype patent, is a -5M but with an Ultra AC/20 rather than the normal AC/20 and upgraded ER Medium Lasers. To fit the new weapons, the three extra heat sinks have been dropped. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: -5SU（若不是原型专利定稿时的一处文书错误，它其实本该叫做-5MU）就是一台-5M，只是把普通的AC/20换成了超级AC/20，并升级了增程中型激光。为容纳这些新武器，三具额外散热器已被拆除。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.04

column1: The -5SU, or the -5MU as it should really have been called if not for a clerical error when formalizing the prototype patent, is a -5M but with an Ultra AC/20 rather than the normal AC/20 and upgraded ER Medium Lasers. To fit the new weapons, the three extra heat sinks have been dropped.
column2: 5SU——或者说，如果不是把原型专利正式化时出了个笔误，本该叫5MU——是5M的改型，但装的是超速AC/20而非普通AC/20，并把增程中型激光器升级。为了容纳新武器，三具额外散热器被拆除。ZH

column1: An early concept version of what would eventually become the -6S, based around the same 300 XL engine and Endo Steel chassis. The main weapon is still kept as the classic Autocannon 20 and lasers, unlike the -6S's LBX/20 and ER lasers. The six jump jets mounted on the concept never made it to the final production model either. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 这是最终演变为-6S的早期概念版本，同样以300 XL引擎和钢内骨结构底盘为基础。与-6S的LBX/20和增程激光不同，它的主武器仍保留经典的自动炮AC/20与激光。概念机上安装的六具跳跃推进器也没能出现在最终量产型号上。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.04

column1: An early concept version of what would eventually become the -6S, based around the same 300 XL engine and Endo Steel chassis. The main weapon is still kept as the classic Autocannon 20 and lasers, unlike the -6S's LBX/20 and ER lasers. The six jump jets mounted on the concept never made it to the final production model either.
column2: 这是最终成为-6S那个设计的早期概念版本，基于同样的300 XL引擎和内层钢底盘。主武器仍保留为经典的自动炮20和激光器，不像-6S的LBX/20和增程激光器。概念机上装的六个跳跃推进器也没能进入最终量产型号。ZH

column1: The HBK-GI Grid Iron is the Hero variant of the Hunchback. It has the characteristic hunch with quirks that emphasize the Gauss Rifle and Medium Pulse Lasers. It comes from the factory with Double Heat Sinks, Endo-Steel, and an XL engine. Unfortunately, since Gauss Rifles explode like ammo, the XL engine tends to be more of a downside. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
column2: HBK-GI“铁格栅”是驼背的英雄变型。它有着标志性的隆背，特性上突出高斯步枪与中型脉冲激光。出厂即配双散热器、钢内骨结构和一台XL引擎。遗憾的是，由于高斯步枪会像弹药一样爆炸，XL引擎往往更像个缺点。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.06

column1: The HBK-GI Grid Iron is the Hero variant of the Hunchback. It has the characteristic hunch with quirks that emphasize the Gauss Rifle and Medium Pulse Lasers. It comes from the factory with Double Heat Sinks, Endo-Steel, and an XL engine. Unfortunately, since Gauss Rifles explode like ammo, the XL engine tends to be more of a downside.
column2: HBK-GI烙铁是驼背的英雄改型。它有标志性的驼背，以及强调高斯步枪和中型脉冲激光器的特性。它出厂即配双重散热器、内层钢和一具XL引擎。可惜，由于高斯步枪会像弹药一样爆炸，XL引擎往往更像个缺点。ZH

column2: 驼背 IIC

column1: Each side torso of the Hunchback IIC A carries an ER Large Laser and twin Medium Pulse Lasers, supported by the standard pair of ER Medium Lasers in the center torso. Built on an 200XL engine with an Endo Steel frame, the remaining weight goes towards four jump jets, twenty double heat sinks and eight tons of armor. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 驼背IIC A的两侧躯干各装一门增程大型激光和双联中型脉冲激光，中央躯干则有标准的一对增程中型激光支援。它建在200XL引擎与钢内骨结构框架上，剩余重量用于四具跳跃推进器、二十个双散热器和八吨装甲。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.08

column1: Each side torso of the Hunchback IIC A carries an ER Large Laser and twin Medium Pulse Lasers, supported by the standard pair of ER Medium Lasers in the center torso. Built on an 200XL engine with an Endo Steel frame, the remaining weight goes towards four jump jets, twenty double heat sinks and eight tons of armor.
column2: 驼背IIC A的两侧躯干各装一门增程大型激光器和两门中型脉冲激光器，由中央躯干标准的一对增程中型激光器支援。它建在一具200XL引擎与内层钢框架上，剩余重量用于四个跳跃推进器、二十具双重散热器和八吨装甲。ZH

column1: A Streak SRM Missile Boat, carrying a pair of Streak SRM-6 launchers in each side torso, supported by twin center torso mounted Medium Pulse Lasers. The IIC B carries a mammoth six tons of Streak reloads, the remaining weight going to an extra two double heat sinks and eight tons of armor. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 这是一台连发SRM导弹艇，两侧躯干各装两具连发SRM-6发射器，并由中央躯干的双联中型脉冲激光提供支援。IIC B携带多达六个吨位的连发弹药，剩余重量则用于两个额外的双散热器与八吨装甲。特性：战斗铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.08

column1: A version of the standard Hunchback IIC with greater field endurance, the C variant downgrading the Ultra AC/20s to lighter Ultra Autocannon/10s, the saved weight going towards an ER Medium Laser in each arm and two tons of Ultra Autocannon rounds in each side torso. The remaining features are identical to the standard model. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: C 变型机是标准 Hunchback IIC 的强化续航版本，它将超级 AC/20 降级为更轻的超级自动炮/10，省下的重量用于在每条手臂各加装一门增程中型激光，并在每个侧躯干各携带两吨超级自动炮弹药。其余特征与标准型号完全相同。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.08

column1: A customized variant of the Hunchback IIC supposedly piloted by the Star of Rage, the Deathwish retains only one of the standard Hunchback IIC's Ultra AC/20s, dropping the left-torso autocannon to mount an ER PPC, moving the center torso ER Mediums to the left arm and adding a similar pair to the right arm. Built on the same basic frame as the Hunchback IIC while still keeping the two tons of Ultra Autocannon rounds, the remaining weight goes to extra double heat sinks, the Deathwish carrying a total of eighteen. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 这是驼背IIC的定制变型，据信由“狂怒之星”驾驶。死愿只保留标准驼背IIC的其中一门超级AC/20，拆掉左躯干自动炮以装入一门增程粒子加农炮，把中央躯干的增程中型激光移到左臂，并在右臂加装一对同样的激光。它与驼背IIC沿用相同基础框架，仍保留两吨超级自动炮弹药，其余重量则用于额外双散热器，死愿共带十八个。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.1

column1: One of several attempts by Xander BattleMech Design to create a cheaper, alternative Hunchback IIC design. Never saw any real success and only few production series were run before most of the 'Mechs fell into pirate hands. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 这是赞德战斗机甲设计公司为打造更便宜的驼背IIC替代设计所做的若干尝试之一，从未真正成功，只进行了少数几个生产批次，随后大多数机甲落入海盗之手。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.08

column1: One of several attempys by Xander BattleMech Design to create a cheaper, alternative Hunchback IIC design. Never saw any real success and only few production series were run before most of the 'Mechs fell into pirate hands.
column2: 这是桑德机甲设计公司为打造更便宜的驼背IIC替代设计所做的若干尝试之一。它从未真正成功，只跑了几个生产批次，多数机甲就落入了海盗手中。ZH

column1: One of several attempts by Xander BattleMech Design to create an alternative Hunchback IIC design. Never saw a lot of usage, but the occasional model can still be found in Clan garrisons. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 这是Xander BattleMech Design为打造另一款驼背式IIC设计所做的数次尝试之一。使用量一直不大，但偶尔仍能在部族驻军中见到。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.08

column1: One of several attempts by Xander BattleMech Design to create an alternative Hunchback IIC design. Never saw a lot of usage, but the occasional model can still be found in Clan garrisons.
column2: 这是桑德机甲设计公司为打造驼背IIC替代设计所做的若干尝试之一。它从未获得多少使用，但在氏族驻防部队中偶尔还能见到一台。ZH

column1: The most successful of several attempts by Xander BattleMech Design to create an alternative Hunchback IIC design, the few models that survived the early days are now part of Clan reserves. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 在 Xander 战斗机甲设计公司为打造替代版驼背 IIC 所做的数次尝试中，这款最为成功；早期幸存下来的少数几台如今已成为部族的后备力量。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.08

column1: A Nova Cat design, the 50 ton Huntsman was designed for Operation Revival and the invasion of the Inner Sphere; first entering production in 3049. An OmniMech, the Huntsman is built around a 250-rated XL Engine with an Endo Steel Skeleton and Ferro-Fibrous armor giving the OmniMech, 21.5 tons of pod space. 5 Jump Jets are fixed to the chassis, giving the Huntsman additional flexibility. The Huntsman D is armed with a UAC/10 and an ATM-6. A pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and a Small Pulse Laser provide additional firepower at close range. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Huntsman是新星猫部族的设计，这台50吨机甲为“复兴行动”及入侵内层星域而生，于3049年首次投产。作为全向机甲，Huntsman以额定250的XL引擎为核心，搭配钢内骨结构和铁纤维装甲，从而获得21.5吨挂载空间。底盘上固定安装的5台跳跃推进器为Huntsman带来额外的灵活性。Huntsman D装备一门UAC/10和一具ATM-6。两门中型脉冲激光和一门小型脉冲激光可在近距离提供额外火力。特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Its speed is its defense, not its paltry three and a half tons of standard armor, and its meager weapons do not tax the ten single heat sinks. The Icestorm still sees use in the majority of Hellion Galaxies, though Clan Wolf also maintains a fair number in their garrison Clusters. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: Icestorm 诞生于 29 世纪末，是一台速度惊人的战斗机甲，用作侦察兵与观察员。它以 Cameroon 为基础，那是一款星际联盟设计，由冰地狱氏族可汗斯蒂芬·凯奇加以改造。它的防御靠的是速度，而非那区区 3.5 吨标准装甲；其单薄的武器也不会让十台单散热器吃力。Icestorm 在冰地狱氏族的大多数星系部队中仍有使用，不过狼氏族也在其驻防星团中保有一定数量。特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：1.02

column1: Designed around short-range weaponry, the lightning-fast Icestorm can quickly close and use its Series 2f ER medium laser and Pattern Alpha SRM-2. While this may seem a meager offense, even the heaviest of units must respect the firepower that its Hellion Class Homing TAG can call down.
column2: 冰暴围绕近程武器设计，快如闪电，能迅速逼近并动用其2f系列增程中型激光和阿尔法型SRM-2。这看似火力单薄，但即便是最重型的单位也必须敬畏其地狱狮级寻的TAG所能召来的打击。ZH

column1: A custom version of the 3E created by the Wolf's Draggons, upgrading the whole design to Clan spec technology. The combination of two Large Pulse Lasers, two LRM-15, two ER PPC, two Medium Pulse Lasers and finally two ER Medium and one ER Small laser means the 'Mech is able to handle fights at almost any distance. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是狼之龙骑兵打造的3E定制版，把整个设计升级到部族规格技术。两门大型脉冲激光、两具LRM-15、两门增程粒子加农炮、两门中型脉冲激光，最后还加上两门增程中型和一门增程小型激光——这意味着该机甲几乎能在任何距离上应付战斗。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.24 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: A short range modification of the 4E mainly used by mercenaries, the 4U carries four Stream SRM-6 and five Medium Lasers, while still retaining the two ER PPC. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 4U是4E主要供雇佣兵使用的近程改装型，装备四具连发SRM-6和五具中型激光，同时保留了原有的两门增程粒子加农炮。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: A Wolf's Dragoons custom refit of the Imp, using all Clan tech. The 'Mech's primary weapons are two ER PPC, two Large Pulse Lasers and two LRM-15 with attached Artemis IV FCS. As secondary fireline the 4W carries two ER Medium Laser and two Medium Pulse Laser, while two ER Small Lasers are kept for defensive purposes. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是狼之龙骑兵对“小鬼”的定制改装，全部采用部族技术。该机甲的主武器为2门增程粒子加农炮、2门大型脉冲激光和2具带阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统的LRM-15。作为次要火力线，4W还搭载2门增程中型激光和2门中型脉冲激光，并保留2门增程小型激光用于自卫。<特性：指挥机甲 <投放费用倍率：1.24 <手臂驱动器限制：左臂上段，右臂上段

column1: Apparently somebody saw the Lyran Giftzwerg and thought to themselves \"We can do better.\" Enhanced with Clan-grade weaponry and sporting the same incredibly solid armor as the Poisoned Dwarf, \"Puck\" also sports an incredibly unstable custom heatsink kit and C3 Master command unit. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

column2: 作为专为裁定部族决斗而设计的二线机甲，以激光为武装的梦魇在部族地狱之马第49战斗机甲集群中担任原生机甲猎手，取得了相当可观的战果。特性：精准武器 - 激光 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: A second-line battlemech designed for dueling, the Incubus is a frequent sight in Clan garrison units. A 30 ton light Mech, the Incubus is built around a 270-rated XL Engine with an Endo Steel Chassis and Ferro-Fibrous armor. The Incubus 7 is armed with a UAC/2, a pair of ER Medium Lasers and 4 Machine Guns. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: Incubus 是专为决斗而设计的二线战斗机甲，在部族驻防部队中颇为常见。这台 30 吨的轻型机甲以一台 270 级 XL 引擎、钢内骨结构底盘与铁纤维装甲为核心。Incubus 7 装备一门 UAC/2、一对增程中型激光以及 4 挺机枪。特性：精准武器 - 激光 投放费用倍率：1.05

Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: 这台定制机甲装有270 XL引擎，两侧躯干各配两门增程微型激光和重型机枪，中央躯干一具连发SRM 4（配一吨弹药），右臂两具连发SRM 2；另有10个双散热器应对热量，左躯干半吨重型机枪弹药，右躯干则有整整一吨重型机枪与连发SRM 4弹药舱。特性：精准武器 - 激光 投放费用倍率：1.07

column1: The only weapon on the Infiltrator is a Grenade Launcher carried in the left arm. Firing a burst of five grenades at once, the launcher has limited offensive value against most combat units. The right arm ends in a Basic Manipulator, however the Infiltrator is not set up for making anti-'Mech attacks or being transported via OmniMech. While it can achieve a top speed of 21.6 km/h, the suit has an ungainly gait, likened to a \"waddling toy robot\", and hence its nickname of the \"Waddler\". Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.886 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 渗透者唯一的武器是左臂携带的一具榴弹发射器。它能一次射出五发榴弹，但对大多数作战单位而言攻击价值有限。右臂末端是一只基础机械手，不过渗透者并不适合执行反机甲攻击，也无法由全向机甲运送。虽然它的最高速度可达 21.6 km/h，但步态笨拙，被比作“摇摇摆摆的玩具机器人”，因而得了个“摇摆者”的绰号。特性：伏击者 投放费用倍率：0.886 可搭载全向单位，可近战，可蜂拥。

column1: The Infiltrator is part of the so-called \"first generation\" of battle armor created by the Federated Commonwealth. Thanks to salvage captured from the Clans, the New Avalon Institute of Science was able to reverse engineer the technology for battlesuits, and decided to create a lighter type than the Inner Sphere Standard which was geared towards reconnaissance and stealth. The result was a unit armored with an early form of stealth armor and sophisticated sensing equipment, meant to operate deep behind enemy lines and gather intelligence.
column2: 渗透者是由联邦共和国打造的所谓“第一代”战斗装甲之一。借助从部族缴获的战利品，新瓦隆科学研究院得以逆向还原战斗服技术，并决定造出一种比内层星域标准型更轻的型号，偏向侦察与隐蔽。成果是一套装备早期隐形装甲与精密探测设备的单位，用于深入敌后搜集情报。ZH

column1: The Infiltrator Mk. II is a battle armor suit designed as a replacement for the earlier Infiltrator Mk. I. With better armament and protection than its predecessor, the Mk. II was superior in all ways except cost. A battle armor-scale Magshot rifle provides firepower while an anti-infantry SMG provides light defense. A suite of stealth armor keeps the suit protected on the field. The only serious downside is the slow ground speed of the Mk. II, though jump jets help keep the suit semi-mobile. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 渗透者Mk. II是一款战斗装甲，设计用于取代早期的渗透者Mk. I。它的武装与防护都优于前身，除成本外各方面都更胜一筹。一门战斗装甲级磁射步枪提供火力，一挺反步兵冲锋枪提供轻度防御，一套隐形装甲让它在战场上受到保护。唯一严重的缺点是Mk. II地面速度缓慢，不过跳跃推进器帮助它保持半机动。特性：伏击者 投放费用倍率：0.888 可搭载全向单位，可近战，可蜂拥攻击。

column1: The Inner Sphere Standard was developed following the initial thrust of the Clan invasion, as Inner Sphere powers rushed to duplicate the battle armor technology the Clans fielded. Lacking any battlefield salvage on which to base their development though, engineers were forced to work off of ancient rumors of early power armor suits like the Nighthawk, more akin to armored Exoskeletons than the 'Toads' currently rampaging through known space, and these prototypes fared poorly during testing. It took salvage from the first victories over the Clans to truly kick-start the development of battle armor. The New Avalon Institute of Science was the first to reproduce in part the Clans' Elemental armor as the Inner Sphere Standard. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 内天体标准型是在氏族入侵首轮攻势后开发的，当时内天体各势力竞相复制氏族装备的战斗装甲技术。然而由于缺乏战场缴获作为研发基础，工程师们只能依据关于"夜鹰"等早期动力甲服的古老传闻——那些装备更像是装甲外骨骼，而非正在已知空间横行的"蟾蜍"——而这些原型在测试中表现不佳。真正推动战斗装甲发展的，是首次战胜氏族后获得的战场缴获。新阿瓦隆科学院最先部分复现了氏族的元素装甲，即内天体标准型。特质：标准部件 投放费用倍率：0.888 可挂载全能单位，可近战，可蜂群攻击。
