column1: A refit of the original -OW, the -OW2 is mostly similar, but instead of a head mounted Small Laser and with one ton of ammo less the armor protection is instead increased. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是对原版-OW的改装，-OW2大体相似，但不再装头部小型激光，并以少一吨弹药为代价增加装甲防护。特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The -10C is a refresh of the -8C, converting it to use more advanced technology. By changing to double heat sinks, 8 tons of cooling can be dropped while still improving the performance. The freed tons are used to add Artemis IV capabilities to all the LRM launchers, replacing the lasers with their extended range counterpart and adding CASE protection to the side torso. Another ton of ammo was also added, while keeping the same level of armoring. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: -10C是-8C的改良版本，改用更先进的技术。通过换装双散热器，可以在提升性能的同时省下8吨散热重量。腾出的吨位用于为所有LRM发射器加装阿尔忒弥斯IV功能，把激光更换为增程型号，并为侧躯干加装CASE保护。此外还增加了一个吨位的弹药，同时保持原有的装甲水平。特性：对空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: A Star League era fire support platform, the Longbow is an 85 ton Assault Mech and one of the most used fire support mechs in existence. The LGB-12C is armed with paired LRM-20 and LRM-15 launchers, supported by a trio of ER Small Lasers. A 255-rated XL Engine, DHS and 12.5 tons of armor round out the design. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 作为星际联盟时代的火力支援平台，Longbow 是一具 85 吨的突击机甲，也是现存使用最广泛的火力支援机甲之一。LGB-12C 装备成对的 LRM-20 与 LRM-15 发射器，另有三具增程小型激光作为支援。一台 255 级 XL 引擎、双散热器和 12.5 吨装甲构成了完整的设计。特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: An attempt to create the ultimate missile platform based on the Longbow chassis, the -12U mounts four Artemis IV enabled LRM-20 launchers and 10 tons of ammunition. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是基于长弓底盘打造终极导弹平台的尝试，-12U装四具带阿尔忒弥斯IV的LRM-20发射器和10吨弹药。特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: An uncommon variant of the Longbow that mounts an Arrow IV artillery in each arm. A head mounted TAG helps with aquiring targets, and two ER Medium Lasers are available for defense. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 长弓的一款罕见变型，在每只手臂各装一门 Arrow IV 火炮。头部安装的 TAG 有助于捕获目标，另有两门 ER 中型激光可供自卫。特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The Longbow LGB-8C mounts two LRM-20 and two LRM-5 launchers, combined with 4 Medium Lasers. The -8C carries a total of 22 heat sinks, but it still isn't enough to cover the heat generated from full alpha strikes. Five tons of LRM ammo rounds up the design. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Longbow LGB-8C 搭载两组 LRM-20 与两组 LRM-5 发射器，并配合 4 门中型激光。-8C 共配备 22 具散热器，但仍不足以抵消全齐射产生的热量。五吨 LRM 弹药让该设计更趋完备。特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

column1: The confusingly named -OW variant of the Longbow is despite its similarity in designation with the more common variant -0W not actually based of it. Instead the -OW - or as it is commonly referred to due to its often garrison duties, the OverWatch - is a refit of the standard -7Q, adding two more Medium Lasers by dropping two tons of LRM ammunition. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 长弓这款命名令人困惑的-OW变型，尽管编号与更常见的-0W相似，实际上并非以其为基础。相反，-OW——或因常担任驻防任务而被称为“俯瞰”——是对标准-7Q的改装：通过拆掉两吨LRM弹药加装两门中型激光。特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The Longinus is the Free Worlds League's attempt to duplicate Elemental Battle Armor. Though they were unable to match the original Clan-tech machine, the Longinus came the closest of any Inner Sphere attempt at the time, thanks in part to the help of the Word of Blake. Quirk: Well Designed Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 朗基努斯是自由世界联盟试图复制元素战斗装甲的成果。虽然他们无法与原始的氏族技术机器匹敌，但朗基努斯是当时所有内天体尝试中最接近的，部分得益于布雷克之言的帮助。特质：设计精良 投放费用倍率：0.888 可挂载全能单位，可近战，可蜂群攻击。

Instead of the LNG-2's reactive armor, it was instead protected by six tons of standard armor. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 最初的远射出厂即配一套Narc导弹信标系统、双联SRM-6挂架、两门中型激光和两门小型激光。它没有LNG-2的反应装甲，而是由六吨标准装甲保护。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: A Solaris VII BattleMech, the Longshot was introduced to the featherweight fight circuit in the early 3050's, and though it was quick and agile, MechWarriors were not impressed with it when it arrived. The fact that the original variants carried a Narc missile beacon instead of some heavier weaponry was useful in team matches and grand melees, but in the one-on-one duels that were popular the Narc was a liability.
column2: Longshot 是一款索拉里斯七号战斗机甲，于 3050 年代初进入羽量级近战赛事。尽管它迅捷灵活，但机甲战士们在它登场时并不看好它。原型变型机以 NARC 导弹信标取代了部分更重型的武器，这在团队赛和大近战中颇为实用，但在当时流行的单挑决斗中，NARC 却成了累赘。ZH

column1: The Longshot LNG-2's main armament are its dual SRM-6 launchers with Artemis IV fire control system, backed up by a pair of medium X-Pulse lasers. At close range it is protected by a pair of Innovative Design Concepts small X-Pulse lasers. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: Longshot LNG-2 的主要武器是两部配备阿尔忒弥斯 IV 火控系统的 SRM-6 发射器，并由两门中型 X 脉冲激光提供辅助。在近距离，它则依靠 Innovative Design Concepts 公司的两门小型 X 脉冲激光获得保护。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: A hard hitting striker mech, the Lynx was one of the first mechs to mount an ER PPC. Produced by Blue Shot Weapons, the Lynx was designed as a striker mech, with a design that blended speed, armor and firepower into a fearsome package. Built around a 275-rated Fusion Core, the Lynx LNX-8Q is armed with a pair of Large Lasers. A pair of Medium Lasers provide close range firepower. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

column1: An evolution of the Star League Lynx, the Lynx C was an early Smoke Jaguar mech. Pushed out of front line service by the newly developed Omnimechs, the Lynx C was relegated to garrison and Solahma units with significant numbers of Lynx C’s still in service during the Word of Blake Jihad. Retaining the 275 XL Engine of the original Lynx, the Lynx C is a full clan tech rebuild of the older Star League design. An ER PPC is paired with an ER Large Laser and a Large Pulse Laser. A pair of ER Medium Lasers and a ER Small Laser provide close range firepower. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Lynx C 是星际联盟 Lynx 的进化型，也是烟虎部族早期的机甲。随着新研制的全向机甲将其挤出一线服役，Lynx C 被降级配属守备与 solahma 部队，而直到布莱克之词圣战期间，仍有相当数量的 Lynx C 在役。Lynx C 保留了原版 Lynx 的 275 XL引擎，是对这台较早期星际联盟设计的全面部族技术重制。一门增程粒子加农炮搭配一门增程大型激光与一门大型脉冲激光。两门增程中型激光与一门增程小型激光提供近距离火力。特性：多重追踪 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

column2: Mackie 的更新型号，搭载了可应对各种战况的武器组合：一门 AC-20、一门大型激光、一门粒子加农炮、五挺机枪和两门中型激光。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

column1: The Mackie 6S2 is a prime example of the patchwork mechs of the Deep Periphery. Battered and rusting, these Mackies are in a shoddy state of repair, maintained by people with neither the skills nor the resources for anything better than rudimentary patch jobs. The original AC/10 has been removed and replaced with a locally made knock off of the classic Thumper artillery piece, whilst the delicate PPC has been replaced with a Large Laser. Never seen in the Inner Sphere, these Mackies are found in the deepest parts of the Periphery, their existence only confirmed by the expeditions of the Explorer Corps. Other variants are rumoured to exist, but have not been confirmed at this time. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Mackie 6S2 最能体现外围地区深处那些拼凑机甲的面貌。这些 Mackie 伤痕累累、锈迹斑斑，维修状况极差，维护它们的人既无技术也无资源，只能做最粗陋的临时修补。原有的 AC/10 已被拆除，换成本地仿制的经典 Thumper 火炮；精密的粒子加农炮则换成了大型激光。这些 Mackie 从未出现在内层星域，只存在于外围地区最偏远的角落，其存在仅由探索军团的远征所证实。据传还有其他变型机存在，但目前尚未得到确认。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The unofficial mascot of the Desert Wars portion of the Martial Olympiad, Kill Roy uses two LB 10-X autocannons instead of the single AC/20. Two tons of ammunition are stored in each side torso. For protection, the torsos are equipped with CASE. To make room for these, the Beagle Active Probe has been removed. column1: Though bearing a remarkable outward resemblance to the Timberwolf, this BattleMech is a new and powerful creation. Carrying thirteen tons of ferro-fibrous armor, the Mad Cat MK II is an incredibly resilient design. A pair of arm mounted Gaussrifles supported by torso mounted LRM racks give it complete command over the battlefield. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

column1: The Mad Dog is a heavy Clan OmniMech used for long-range indirect fire support. With hunched shoulders, a protruding head, and reverse-jointed legs, the Mad Dog resembles a vulture, so much so that it was codenamed Vulture by the Inner Sphere forces which first encountered it. The Mad Dog’s most distinctive feature is its side torso and arm pods, which are practically full modules by themselves, suggesting that the mech was conceived as a long-range support unit. The torso modules, angled high, are ideal for missiles while the arms serve as extended turrets suited for direct-fire weaponry.
column2: 疯狗是一款用于远程间接火力支援的氏族重型全能机甲。它肩部前倾、头部突出、腿部反关节，酷似秃鹫，因此首次遭遇它的内天体部队给了它"秃鹫"的代号。疯狗最显著的特征是其侧躯干与臂部吊舱——它们本身几乎就是完整模块，暗示这台机甲在设计时就构想为远程支援单位。躯干模块高高倾斜，非常适合安装导弹，而臂部则充当适于直射武器的延伸炮塔。ZH

column1: The personal ride of Smoke Jaguar Galaxy Commander Russou Howell. The Bandit is armed with a mammoth Ultra Autocannon/20 in each side torso and only twin ER Small Lasers in each arm as supporting weapons, its pilot must make every shot of its combined total of two tons of reloads count. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是烟虎部族星系指挥官拉苏·豪威尔的私人座机。强盗在两侧躯干各装一门庞大的超级AC/20，每只手臂只有双联增程小型激光作为支援武器，因此机师必须让总共两吨再装填弹药的每一发都打中。特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Mad Dog J loadout is trying to be a jack-of-all-trades, mounting an assortment of ER lasers, three Machine Guns, two LRM-10 launchers and a LB-X 20 Autocannon. column1: A loadout used by the mercenary band the Kell Hounds for their 'aquired' Mad Dogs. The combination of a UAC/5, two Artemis IV-enabled LRM-15 launchers and a Large Pulse Laser means the loadout brings quite the punch to the table. A C3 slave unit and a ER Medium Laser rounds up the KH. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

column1: The Maelstrom was originally designed to carry on legacy of the Marauder, with its hunched-over profile and the unique ball-and-socket construction. The collapse of the Star League doomed the project and left the Maelstrom on the drawing board. With the discovery of the Helm Memory Core by the GDL, the plans for the Maelstrom were also rediscovered and production was started in the Inner Sphere. The Maelstrom is built using a weight-saving 375 XL engine that propels the 'Mech up to 86.4 km/h. For protection, the Maelstrom carries 14.5 tons of armor and uses 19 double heat sinks to handle the 'Mech's heavy heat load. The armament of the Maelstrom is a Defiance 1001 ER PPC paired up with a Cyclops XII ER Large Laser. For close combat, the Maelstrom carries two Defiance P5M Medium Pulse Lasers and a Jackson Model 12 Small Laser. Finally, the Maelstrom carries a TAG laser designator. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 漩涡最初的设计意图是继承掠夺者的血脉——同样弓背的轮廓和独特的球窝式结构。星际联盟的崩溃让这个项目夭折，漩涡也一直停留在图纸上。随着灰死军团发现地狱记忆核心，漩涡的设计方案也被重新找到，并在内层星域开始生产。漩涡采用减轻重量的 375 XL 引擎，可推动机甲达到 86.4 km/h。防护方面，漩涡携带 14.5 吨装甲，并使用19个双散热器来应对机甲沉重的热负荷。漩涡的武器是一门 Defiance 1001 ER PPC，搭配一门 Cyclops XII 增程大型激光。近身战斗方面，漩涡装有两门 Defiance P5M 中型脉冲激光和一门 Jackson Model 12 小型激光。最后，漩涡还装有一具 TAG 激光指示器。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Pretty much a slightly updated Marauder, Boss. It is not the most spectacular 'Mech but it is versatile enough to still find its uses on the battlefield with the not horrible long and short range weaponry.
column2: 基本上是一台略微升级的掠夺者，老大。它不是最出色的机甲，但足够多用途，凭借不算糟糕的远近射程武器，仍能在战场上找到用处。ZH

column1: Created by Clan Widowmaker in the Golden Century, it carries an Enhanced ER PPC and a standard Clan ER Large Laser. The small laser has been replaced by a prototype ER Medium Laser. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 由部族寡妇制造者于金世纪研制，装备一门增强型 增程粒子加农炮和一门标准的部族 ER 大型激光。小型激光则被一门原型 ER 中型激光取代。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Wow, this is one rare find! One of the original clan Maelstrom prototypes, with the early clan tech and all.
column2: 哇，这可真是稀罕货！一台原版部族漩涡原型机，还带着早期部族技术。ZH

column1: Over a third of the Mandrill's tonnage is devoted to a pair of LRM-20 launchers and their attendant ammunition, which is limited, but usually enough for duels. The head-mounted ER small laser is something of an afterthought, though it does allow Mandrills to keep fighting after they run out of ammo. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: Mandrill 超过三分之一的吨位都用于两具 LRM-20 发射器及其配套弹药，弹药量虽然有限，但通常足以应付决斗。头部安装的小型增程激光多少算是事后补上的，不过它确实让 Mandrill 在弹药耗尽后仍能继续战斗。特性：精准武器（激光） 投放费用倍率：1.03

column1: The Mandrill was the first of the totem 'Mechs created. Designed to resemble its namesake animal, the Mandrill is clearly a Clan Fire Mandrill design, and was the last gasp of a united Mandrill Clan before it became hopelessly fragmented into its various Kindraa. Hoping to recapture some of that spirit, Khan Amanda Carrol ordered Kindraa Sainze to produce new Mandrills in 3058, the first in over a century, which was originally a Kindraa Payne design. She also ordered the Kindraa to trade the 'Mech to other Kindraa so that the totem 'Mech is present in each.
column2: 狒狒是最早创造的图腾机甲。它的设计模仿了其同名动物，显然是火狒氏族的设计，也是一个统一的狒狒氏族在无可挽回地分裂成各个金德拉之前的最后余响。为了重拾那份精神，可汗阿曼达·卡罗尔在3058年下令赛恩兹金德拉生产新的狒狒——这是一百多年来的第一批，原本是佩恩金德拉的设计。她还下令该金德拉把这台机甲交易给其他金德拉，以确保图腾机甲出现在每一支中。ZH

column1: Debuting in 3052, the Mantis is a light mech designed for the Mech arenas on Solaris VII. A 30-ton Mech, the Mantis is powered by a 270-rated XL Engine, giving it the speed to outrun or out-maneuver almost any other Mech. The Mantis MTS-S is armed with 3 ER Medium Lasers and a pair of ER Small Lasers. MASC and a pair of Claws allow it to tear apart other Mechs. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 螳螂于3052年首次亮相，是为索拉里斯VII机甲竞技场设计的轻型机甲。这台30吨机甲由一台270额定XL引擎驱动，速度足以跑赢或机动胜过几乎任何其他机甲。螳螂MTS-S装有三门增程中型激光和一对增程小型激光。MASC和一对爪让它能撕碎其他机甲。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：0.99

Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 不清楚这台定制机甲原先属于谁，但对方想必资金或零件都很紧张。这套毫不起眼的武器只有三门大型和两门标准中型激光，外加头部一具SRM-4。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Maruder II MAD-5V is mainly seen amongst mercenary outfits, as it is one of the cheapest and most accessible variants of the Marauder II. A LBX AC/10 and two ER PPC are the main damage sources, with two Medium Lasers as backup. The design also includes CASE protection, a Beagle active probe and a Guardian ECM suite. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Maruder II MAD-5V 主要出现在雇佣兵部队中，因为它是 Marauder II 最便宜、最容易获得的变型之一。其主要伤害来源为一门 LBX AC/10 和两门增程粒子加农炮，另有两门中型激光作为备用。该设计还包括 CASE 防护、一具 Beagle 主动探测器和一套 Guardian 电子对抗套件。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: Used by the Wolf's Dragoons, the 6W is a full Clan technology conversion of the Marauder II. Besides the two ER PPC, two Large Pulse Lasers and the LBX AC/10, the variant also brings a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是狼之龙骑兵使用的6W，是把劫掠者II完全改装为部族技术的版本。除两门增程粒子加农炮、两门大型脉冲激光和那门LBX AC/10外，该变型还带一台C3从机。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.24 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: This 'Mech features a unique loadout - an Ultra AC/10 in each arm supported by a pair of left torso-mounted Streak SRM-6 launchers and twin Medium Pulse Lasers in the right torso. Built around a 300-rated XL Engine, the 'Mech features a Beagle Active Probe, three jump jets, nineteen tons of armor, three tons each of Ultra autocannon and Streak missile reloads offer reasonable endurance. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 该机甲采用独特载荷：每只手臂各一门超级AC/10，辅以左躯干的一对连发SRM-6发射器和右躯干的双联中型脉冲激光。它围绕一台300额定XL引擎建造，配备比格犬主动探测器、三具跳跃推进器、十九吨装甲；各三吨的超级自动炮与连发导弹再装填弹药提供了不错的持续力。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.2 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The personal 'Mech of Major Susan Barber, the leader of the mercenary unit known as Barber's Marauder IIs. The design contains two Clan ER PPC, two Medium Lasers and a LBX AC/10, combined with a 300 XL engine and CASE protection. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是雇佣兵部队“巴伯的劫掠者II”首领苏珊·巴伯少校的私人机甲。该设计装有两门部族增程粒子加农炮、两门中型激光和一门LBX AC/10，并配合300 XL引擎和CASE防护。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.2 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Introduced back in 3025 but unknown to Inner Sphere intelligence forces until the Jihad era, this older version replaces the ER PPC found in the left arm with the Medium Pulse Laser from the right arm. An LRM-10 with a ton of ammunition is added to the left torso and the ER Small Lasers in the center and right torsos are replaced with a single Medium Pulse Laser in each. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这一较早的版本于3025年推出，但直到圣战时期才被内层星域情报部门知晓。它把左臂的增程粒子加农炮换成右臂的中型脉冲激光，左躯干加装一具LRM-10（配一吨弹药），中央与右躯干的增程小型激光则各换成一门中型脉冲激光。特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Touted as one of the most effective 'Mechs of all time, the Marauder saw wide usage by the SLDF before and during their Exodus from the Inner Sphere. During the years before their return, the Clans developed a followup to the venerable design, later dubbed the Marauder IIC, representing the pinnacle of Clan weapons technology prior to the advent of the OmniMech. Like other IIC designs, visual similarities between it and its predecessor initially led ComStar to incorrectly label the design as a mere refit of the original.
column2: Marauder 被誉为有史以来最有效的机甲之一，在 SLDF 撤离内层星域之前及期间被广泛使用。在部族回归之前的岁月里，他们为这一久负盛名的设计开发了后续型号，后来被称为 Marauder IIC，它代表了全向机甲问世之前部族武器技术的巅峰。与其他 IIC 设计一样，它与前代在外观上的相似之处最初让通讯之星误将其判定为原型的简单改装。ZH

column1: This variant uses the ER PPCs of the standard Marauder IIC but replaces the short range weapons with two Streak SRM-4s, one in the center torso and one in the right torso. These missile launchers share a single ton of ammunition. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 此变型使用标准劫掠者IIC的增程粒子加农炮，但以两具连发SRM-4取代近程武器——中央躯干一具，右躯干一具。这些导弹发射器共用一吨弹药。特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.19 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A customized variant of the Marauder IIC, the Scorch mounts a Large Pulse Laser and Ultra AC/5 in each arm supported by four Streak SRM-6 launchers split between each side torso. Twelve tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor protect Scorch and the two-tons each of Streak and Ultra Autocannon ammo and fifteen double heat-sinks it carries. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 作为 Marauder IIC 的定制变型，Scorch 在每只手臂各搭载一具大型脉冲激光和一门超级 AC/5，另有四具连发 SRM-6 发射器分置于两侧躯干作为支援。十二吨铁纤维装甲为 Scorch 以及它携带的各两吨连发弹药、超级自动炮弹药与十五具双散热器提供防护。特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.21 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: A customized variant of the Marauder IIC, the Scorch mounts a Large Pulse Laser and Ultra AC/5 in each arm supported by four Streak SRM-6 launchers split between each side torso. Twelve tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor protect Scorch and the two-tons each of Streak and Ultra Autocannon ammo and fifteen double heat-sinks it carries.
column2: 作为劫掠者IIC的定制变型，焦灼每只手臂装一门大型脉冲激光和一门超级AC/5，并由分装在两侧躯干的四具连发SRM-6发射器支援。十二吨铁纤维装甲保护着焦灼，另有各两吨的连发导弹与超级自动炮弹药，以及它携带的十五个双散热器。ZH

column1: This Early Clan upgrade of the SLDF's Marauder 2R replaces the AC/5 with a prototype Ultra AC/2 and both ER PPCs with Clan Wolverine's Enhanced ER PPC. Everything else on the 'Mech remains the same as the original Royal variant. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是SLDF的Marauder 2R的早期部族升级版，以一门原型Ultra AC/2替换AC/5，并将两门增程粒子加农炮换成狼獾部族的增强型增程粒子加农炮。机甲上的其他一切与原皇家变型完全相同。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: When the Star League Defense Force left the Inner Sphere under Commanding General Aleksandr Kerensky during Operation Exodus, they brought with them many of the most common 'Mechs. As the SLDF-in-Exile was forged into the Clans, they started developing improved weapons, which they mounted onto their existing BattleMechs. These weapons are commonly called \"Clan Enhanced\" and 'Mech's fitted with them often had the \"-CE\" suffix added to their designation.
column2: 当星际联盟国防军在“大逃亡行动”中随指挥官亚历山大·克伦斯基离开内层星域时，他们带走了许多最常见的机甲。随着流亡SLDF被锻造成部族，他们开始研发改进型武器，并装到现有的战斗机甲上。这些武器通常被称为“部族增强”，装了这些武器的机甲常在编号后加上“-CE”后缀。ZH

column1: A battlefield refit of the Marauder MAD-3D, which adds both considerable more armor and a C3 slave unit by switching to Double Heat Sinks. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是劫掠者MAD-3D的野战改装，通过改用双散热器同时添加了相当多的装甲和一台C3从机。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A Marauder variant update on a Clan tech base, designed and primarily used by the Grey Death Legion mercenary forces. Two ER PPC and a single Ultra AC/5 are the main damage dealers, with two secondary Medium Pulse Lasers as support. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是掠袭者在部族科技基础上更新的变型，由灰死军团雇佣兵部队设计并主要使用。两门增程粒子加农炮和一门超级AC/5是主要的输出武器，另有两门中型脉冲激光作为次要支援。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The MAD-3H Marauder, dubbed the 'Fiddler Crab', abandons elegance for terror. Bristling with blazers and wielding a crushing mace, it advances relentlessly into close quarters. Its asymmetric, heavily armored frame embodies a nightmarish evolution of a once-proud command BattleMech, built to intimidate and destroy. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: MAD-3H劫掠者绰号“招潮蟹”，它抛弃优雅转向恐怖：浑身烈焰炮、手持碾压大锤，无情地推进到近身距离。它那不对称、装甲厚重的构架，体现出一台曾经骄傲的指挥战斗机甲噩梦般的演化——为恐吓与毁灭而造。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: The -3K is a custom Clan tech variant of the Marauder fielded by the Kell Hounds. It centers around a Gauss Rifle in the Right Torso and two ER PPC, one in each arm. Two Medium Pulse Lasers provide extra firepower as needed. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: -3K是凯尔猎犬使用的劫掠者定制部族技术变型。它以右躯干的一门高斯步枪和两臂各一门增程粒子加农炮为核心，两门中型脉冲激光按需提供额外火力。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A common refit of the 3R. By upgrading to Double Heat Sinks both more weapons and better protection could be added to the design. A C3 slave was also part of the additions. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是3R的常见改装。通过升级为双散热器，该设计得以加装更多武器和更好的防护，此外还加装了一台C3从机。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The 3T is an uncommon variant of the Marauder, with its full energy build of four ER Large Lasers it tends to overheat easily even with 22 double heat sinks. The variant never saw any greater acceptance with MechWarriors due to this. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 3T 是掠夺者中不常见的一个变型，纯粹的能量武器配置带来四门 ER 大型激光，即使有 22 台双散热器也容易过热。正因如此，该变型从未在机甲战士中获得更广泛的认可。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The 3W was used with the Wolf's Dragoons mercenary outfit as a command mech. Even though it looks like a normal Marauder on the outside, most of its internal have been replaced by Clan grade technology. The weapons consist of two ER PPC, one Large and two Medium Pulse Lasers, and a C3 Master unit is mounted in the left torso. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 3W曾被狼之龙骑兵雇佣兵部队用作指挥机甲。虽然外表看起来像普通的劫掠者，其内部大多已换成部族级技术。武器包括两门增程粒子加农炮、一门大型和两门中型脉冲激光，左躯干内装有一台C3主机。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Marauder 4D is, despite its variant name starting with a 4, not based on the Marauder II chassis, but the original Marauder. It combines two ER PPC with four ER Medium Lasers and a single Large Pulser Laser. A TAG is further mounted in the head. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 劫掠者4D虽然变型名以4开头，却并非以劫掠者II底盘为基础，而是原始劫掠者。它把两门增程粒子加农炮与四门增程中型激光和一门大型脉冲激光组合起来，头部还装有一具TAG。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Born of a collaboration between Majesty Metals and Taurus Territorial Industries, the Marauder MAD-4T is an upgrade package for the standard Marauder MAD-3R. Largely identical to the MAD-3R, the 4T swaps the standard SHS for 14 DHS. The remaining 2 tons are devoted to a CASE protected ammo bay for the autocannon and a Beagle Active Probe sourced from the Cappellans. Intended as a bodyguard Mech for Command Lances, the MAD-4T is marketed as a cheaper alternative to the newer Marauder variants appearing in the Inner Sphere. Approved for limited export by both the Magistracy and the Concordant, the MAD-4T is starting to spread to customers through out the Periphery. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Marauder MAD-4T是Majesty Metals与Taurus Territorial Industries合作的产物，是标准型Marauder MAD-3R的升级套件。4T与MAD-3R大体相同，只是把标准SHS换成了14具DHS。剩下的2吨则用于为自动炮增设一个受CASE保护的弹药舱，以及一具从卡佩兰人手中取得的Beagle主动探测器。MAD-4T定位为指挥小队的护卫机甲，以比内层星域新出现的Marauder改型更便宜的替代方案作为卖点。该型获Magistracy与Concordant双方批准限量出口，如今正开始流向整个外围地区的客户。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Born of a collaboration between Majesty Metals and Taurus Territorial Industries, the Marauder MAD-4T is an upgrade package for the standard Marauder MAD-3R. Largely identical to the MAD-3R, the 4T swaps the standard SHS for 14 DHS. The remaining 2 tons are devoted to a CASE protected ammo bay for the autocannon and a Beagle Active Probe sourced from the Cappellans. Intended as a bodyguard Mech for Command Lances, the MAD-4T is marketed as a cheaper alternative to the newer Marauder variants appearing in the Inner Sphere. Approved for limited export by both the Magistracy and the Concordant, the MAD-4T is starting to spread to customers through out the Periphery.
column2: 作为陛下金属与牛郎星领地工业合作研制的产物，劫掠者MAD-4T是标准劫掠者MAD-3R的升级包。它与MAD-3R大体相同，只是把标准单散热器换成14个双散热器，其余2吨用于为自动炮加装CASE防护弹药舱，以及一台从卡佩兰人那里取得的比格犬主动探测器。MAD-4T定位为指挥小队的护卫机甲，作为内层星域出现的新式劫掠者变型的廉价替代品推销。它已获卡诺帕斯行政区与协约的有限出口批准，正开始在外围地区扩散客户。ZH

column1: A Clan Buster upgrade, the Marauder 5CS was developed specifically for Tukayyid. More or less an upgrade package for the Marauder 3R, the 5CS used Star League era technology to improve it’s effectiveness against the Clans, while being designed to be for new pilots to use. Powered by a 300-rated XL Engine with DHS, the Marauder 5CS is armed with a pair of ER PPC’s, a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and an LB-10X. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 作为“部族克星”升级型号，Marauder 5CS 是专为图卡伊德之战开发的。它大体可视为 Marauder 3R 的升级套件，采用星际联盟时代的技术提升对部族的作战效能，同时设计上便于新机师上手。Marauder 5CS 由配备双散热器的 300 级 XL 引擎驱动，装备两门增程粒子加农炮、两门中型脉冲激光和一具 LB-10X。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

column1: A Clan Buster upgrade, the Marauder 5CS was developed specifically for Tukayyid. More or less an upgrade package for the Marauder 3R, the 5CS used Star League era technology to improve it’s effectiveness against the Clans, while being designed to be for new pilots to use. Powered by a 300-rated XL Engine with DHS, the Marauder 5CS is armed with a pair of ER PPC’s, a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and an LB-10X.
column2: 作为一款"灭族者"升级，掠夺者5CS专为图卡伊德研发。它或多或少是掠夺者3R的升级包，5CS使用星盟时代技术提升其对抗氏族的效能，同时被设计为供新机师使用。掠夺者5CS由一具300级XL引擎配双重散热器驱动，武装为两门增程PPC、两门中型脉冲激光器和一门LB-10X。ZH

column1: The 5D Marauder was the first updated variant to be designed in the wake of the Helm Memory Core recovery. A direct upgrade of the 3D model, the 5D's engine was replaced with a 300 XL engine, retaining the same speed profile at a much-reduced weight, to allow the entire weapons payload to be stripped out and upgraded. The 5D's primary weapons were two ER PPCs, carried in either arm, supported by a Large Pulse Laser in place of the autocannon. The medium lasers were replaced with two Medium Pulse Lasers, while a Streak SRM-2 launcher was also added to the left torso, along with one ton of CASE-protected ammo, for more close-range firepower. The model was protected by fourteen tons of armor, and carried sixteen double heat sinks for heat management. It also had a jumping capability of up to 120 meters thanks to four jump jets mounted in its legs. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 5D Marauder 是地狱核心失而复得之后设计出的第一个升级变型。作为 3D 型号的直接升级版，5D 的引擎换成了 300 XL 引擎，在重量大幅降低的同时保持相同的速度表现，从而得以把整套武器全部拆下并加以升级。5D 的主要武器是两门增程粒子加农炮，分装于左右两臂，另有一门大型脉冲激光取代自动炮作为补充。中型激光被换成两门中型脉冲激光，左躯干还增设了一具连发 SRM-2 发射器，并配有一吨受 CASE 保护的弹药，以增强近距离火力。该型号披挂十四吨装甲，并搭载十六台双散热器来管理热量。得益于腿部安装的四台跳跃推进器，它还能跳跃至多 120 米。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A command version of the MAD-5D. It strips out the Streak launcher, ammunition, CASE, and one heat sink to make room for a Command Console. The rest of the design remains the same. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是MAD-5D的指挥版本。它拆掉连发发射器、弹药、CASE和一个散热器，为指挥控制台腾出空间，其余设计保持不变。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The 5M variant of the Marauder was introduced in 3051 by Ronin Inc. and Free Worlds Defense Industries for the Free Worlds League. Compared to the original it replaced the standard fusion engine with an XL Engine and completely re-armed the 'Mech with recovered Star League-era weapons. The primary weapons were two Large Pulse Lasers, backed up by two Medium Pulse Lasers, in either arm. Finally, in place of the Autocannon/5, the 5M carried a LB-X Autocannon/10. The 5M had a jumping distance of up to one hundred and twenty meters thanks to four jump jets mounted in the legs and carried sixteen double heat sinks. One ton of ammunition for the LB-X was carried in the left torso and protected by CASE. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Marauder的5M变型由Ronin Inc.和自由世界国防工业于3051年为自由世界联盟推出。与原版相比，它以XL引擎替换了标准聚变引擎，并用回收的星际联盟时代武器彻底重装了机甲。主武器为两门大型脉冲激光，每臂各一门，辅以两门中型脉冲激光。最后，5M以一门LB-X自动炮/10取代了自动炮/5。得益于安装在腿部的四台跳跃推进器，5M的跳跃距离最远可达一百二十米，并搭载十六台双散热器。左躯干携带一吨LB-X弹药，由CASE保护。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The 5M variant of the Marauder was introduced in 3051 by Ronin Inc. and Free Worlds Defense Industries for the Free Worlds League. Compared to the original it replaced the standard fusion engine with an XL Engine and completely re-armed the 'Mech with recovered Star League-era weapons. The primary weapons were two Large Pulse Lasers, backed up by two Medium Pulse Lasers, in either arm. Finally, in place of the Autocannon/5, the 5M carried a LB-X Autocannon/10. The 5M had a jumping distance of up to one hundred and twenty meters thanks to four jump jets mounted in the legs and carried sixteen double heat sinks. One ton of ammunition for the LB-X was carried in the left torso and protected by CASE.
column2: 劫掠者5M变型由罗宁公司与自由世界防御工业公司于3051年为自由世界联盟推出。与原版相比，它把标准聚变引擎换成XL引擎，并为机甲全面换装了回收的星际联盟时期武器。主要武器是双臂各两门大型脉冲激光，辅以两门中型脉冲激光；最后，5M以一门LB-X自动炮/10取代自动炮/5。得益于腿部安装的四具跳跃推进器，5M的跳跃距离可达一百二十米，并携带十六个双散热器。LB-X的一吨弹药存放在左躯干，由CASE保护。ZH

column1: The Marauder 5R2 is an export model for the Periphery market. It was constructed on the same line as the 5R, but with much cheaper components, in an attempt to sell based on the relation to the actual 5R alone. Its weapons consist of only three Large and two Medium standard lasers, its cooling is using single heat sinks and the engine is a standard 300 rated core. Overall, the design is pretty much very subpar for a Marauder, but a number of 5R2 were produced and sold before this was fully realized. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 掠夺者5R2是面向外围地区市场的出口型号。它与5R共用同一条生产线，但采用便宜得多的部件，试图仅凭与真正5R的渊源来打开销路。其武器只有3门大型激光和2门中型标准激光，散热使用单散热器，引擎则是标准300额定核心。总体而言，这台设计对一台掠夺者来说相当不堪，但在人们完全意识到这点之前，已有不少5R2被生产并售出。<特性：狭小/低矮外形 <投放费用倍率：1.09 <手臂驱动器限制：左臂下段，右臂下段

column1: The 5S variant of the Marauder dates to the Clan Invasion, introduced in 3051 by Bowie Industries after the Draconis Combine captured plans for the 5D design. The variant was built around an XL engine to save weight and upgraded the heat sinks to double-strength models. Like the 5D, the 5S carried ER PPCs and medium pulse lasers, but replaced the autocannon with a Gauss Rifle. One ton of ammunition for this powerful, long-ranged weapon was carried in the left torso. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 劫掠者5S变型可追溯至部族入侵时期，由鲍伊工业在龙脉联合体夺取5D设计图纸后于3051年推出。该变型围绕一台XL引擎建造以减轻重量，散热器升级为双倍强度型号。与5D一样，5S装有增程粒子加农炮和中型脉冲激光，但以高斯步枪取代自动炮，这门强力远程武器的一吨弹药存放在左躯干。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The 5S variant of the Marauder dates to the Clan Invasion, introduced in 3051 by Bowie Industries after the Draconis Combine captured plans for the 5D design. The variant was built around an XL engine to save weight and upgraded the heat sinks to double-strength models. Like the 5D, the 5S carried ER PPCs and medium pulse lasers, but replaced the autocannon with a Gauss Rifle. One ton of ammunition for this powerful, long-ranged weapon was carried in the left torso.
column2: 掠夺者的5S改型可追溯到氏族入侵时期，由鲍伊工业在龙尼斯联合体缴获5D设计的图纸之后于3051年推出。该改型围绕XL引擎建造以减轻重量，并将散热器升级为双倍强度型号。与5D一样，5S携带增程PPC和中型脉冲激光器，但把自动炮换成了一门高斯步枪。这门强力远程武器的一吨弹药储存在左躯干。ZH

column1: This unusual variant piloted by the Bounty Hunter featured various lostech equipment: the standard 300 Vlar fusion engine was downgrade to a 225-rated version giving it a top speed of 54 km/h. It mounted a standard PPC and a Medium Laser in each arm while another PPC and medium laser were mounted on the right torso; additional medium lasers were mounted in the center and left torso. Sixteen double heat sinks were use to cool this beast down, allowing it to firing all 3 PPCs without even generating excess heat. It featured fourteen and a half tons of standard armor, giving it maximum armor for it's weight, and was capable of jumping over 90 meters with three jump jets. It was also painted all green with credit symbols. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是赏金猎人驾驶的一台不寻常变型，配备多种失落科技装备：标准300弗拉尔聚变引擎降级为225额定版本，最高速度54公里/小时。每只手臂装一门标准粒子加农炮和一门中型激光，右躯干另有一门粒子加农炮和一门中型激光；中央与左躯干还装了额外中型激光。十六个双散热器为这头猛兽降温，使它发射全部3门粒子加农炮都不产生多余热量。它带十四吨半标准装甲，为同重量提供最大装甲；三具跳跃推进器可跳跃90米以上。它还通体漆成绿色并绘有信用符号。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: This unusual variant piloted by the Bounty Hunter featured various lostech equipment: the standard 300 Vlar fusion engine was downgrade to a 225-rated version giving it a top speed of 54 km/h. It mounted a standard PPC and a Medium Laser in each arm while another PPC and medium laser were mounted on the right torso; additional medium lasers were mounted in the center and left torso. Sixteen double heat sinks were use to cool this beast down, allowing it to firing all 3 PPCs without even generating excess heat. It featured fourteen and a half tons of standard armor, giving it maximum armor for it's weight, and was capable of jumping over 90 meters with three jump jets. It was also painted all green with credit symbols.
column2: 这台由赏金猎人驾驶的罕见改型配备了各种失传科技装备：标准的300维拉聚变引擎被降级为225级版本，使其最高速度为54公里/小时。它在双臂各装一门标准PPC和一门中型激光器，右躯干另装一门PPC和一门中型激光器；更多的中型激光器装在中央与左躯干。十六具双重散热器用来冷却这头野兽，使它即便同时发射全部3门PPC也不会产生多余热量。它披挂十四吨半标准装甲，使其达到该重量的最大装甲量，并凭借三个跳跃推进器可跳跃90米以上。它还通体漆成绿色并绘有信用符号。ZH

column1: The Bounty Hunter upgraded his Marauder sometime in 3044. The fusion engine was upgrade to an extra-light version while keeping it at the same rating to save weight, though the increased size meant three heat sinks had to be removed. The standard PPCs were upgrade to ER PPCs, both the left and right torso-mounted medium lasers were removed while the center torso medium laser was moved to the head to make room for a Gauss Rifle on the right torso and two tons of ammunition. This upgrade allowed the Bounty Hunter to engage enemies at a far greater range while still able to continuously operate without fear of overheating. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 赏金猎人在3044年前后升级了他的掠夺者。聚变引擎被换成超轻型版本，同时保持额定值不变以减轻重量，尽管体积增大导致必须拆除三具散热器。标准粒子加农炮升级为增程粒子加农炮，左右躯干的中型激光均被拆除，而中央躯干的中型激光则移到头部，以便在右躯干腾出空间安装一门高斯步枪与两吨弹药。这次升级让赏金猎人能在远得多的距离上接战，同时仍可连续作战而无过热之虞。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Bounty Hunter upgraded his Marauder sometime in 3044. The fusion engine was upgrade to an extra-light version while keeping it at the same rating to save weight, though the increased size meant three heat sinks had to be removed. The standard PPCs were upgrade to ER PPCs, both the left and right torso-mounted medium lasers were removed while the center torso medium laser was moved to the head to make room for a Gauss Rifle on the right torso and two tons of ammunition. This upgrade allowed the Bounty Hunter to engage enemies at a far greater range while still able to continuously operate without fear of overheating.
column2: 赏金猎人在3044年某时升级了他的掠夺者。聚变引擎被升级为超轻型版本，同时保持相同等级以减轻重量，不过尺寸增加意味着必须拆掉三具散热器。标准PPC升级为增程PPC，左右躯干的中型激光器都被拆除，中央躯干的中型激光器被移到头部，以便在右躯干腾出空间安装一门高斯步枪和两吨弹药。这次升级让赏金猎人能在远得多的距离上交战，同时仍能持续作战而无需担心过热。ZH

column1: A variant designed by the New Avalon Institute of Science as part of the Worst Case initiative. The right arm carries an Extended Range Particle Projection Cannon and two Medium Lasers. The left arm has two Medium Lasers as well, but the ER PPC was swapped out for an ER Large Laser. The usual AC/5 was replaced by the newly invented Gauss Rifle. With its smaller range, but a much larger hitting power, this change may be the most important. The Marauder's mobility was also upgraded by the addition of four jump jets. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是新阿瓦隆科学研究院作为“最坏情况”计划的一部分设计的变型。右臂携带一门增程粒子加农炮和两门中型激光。左臂同样装有两门中型激光，但增程粒子加农炮被换成了增程大型激光。惯用的AC/5则被新发明的高斯步枪取代。它射程较近，威力却大得多，这一改动或许最为关键。掠夺者的机动性也通过加装四个跳跃推进器得到提升。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

column1: The personal 'Mech of 12th Vegan Rangers Alpha Regiment commander Margrave Sheridan Douglass during the DCMS's Third Succession War invasion of Galtor III, only the arm mounted medium lasers remain, with each PPC replaced by a large laser and the autocannon swapped for a pair of SRM-4 launchers with a shared ton of reloads. The remaining weight and space was devoted to five additional heat sinks and three extra tons of armor. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是第12维根游骑兵阿尔法团指挥官、侯爵谢里丹·道格拉斯在DCMS第三次继承战争入侵加尔特III期间的私人机甲。它只保留臂载中型激光，每门粒子加农炮换成大型激光，自动炮换成一对共用一吨再装填弹药的SRM-4发射器。剩余重量与空间用于五个额外散热器和三吨额外装甲。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: When the Treaty of Taurus was signed, it established the New Colony Region in co-operation between the Magistracy of Canopus and the Taurian Concordat and also created the Colonial Marshals. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 《金牛座条约》签署后，卡诺普斯行政国与陶里安协约国合作建立了新殖民地地区，并组建了殖民地法警。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: This is a Sherrif's mech, it brings a piece of mind to folk, but is not heavy on technology.
column2: 这是一台治安官机甲，它让民众安心，但技术含量不高。ZH

column1: Developed by Clan Coyote as a dueling machine, scientists used an Endo Steel chassis as a base. It also carries an XL engine and sixteen double heat sinks. Four jump jets allowed it to jump one hundred twenty meters at a time. The right arm carried an LB 10-X and the left arm carried a pair of Large Pulse Lasers. The right and left torsos had a Streak SRM-2 to capitalize on the damage inflicted by the heavier weapons. The right torso had an anti-missile system, while an ER small laser was mounted in the opposite torso. The AMS and Streaks each had one ton of ammunition and the LB 10-X had three tons of ammo. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 由郊狼部族作为决斗机甲开发，科学家以钢内骨结构底盘为基础。它还装有一具XL引擎与十六具双散热器。四台跳跃推进器让它每次可跳跃一百二十米。右臂装有一门LB 10-X，左臂装有一对大型脉冲激光。左右两侧躯干各有一具连发SRM-2，用以扩大重武器所造成的伤害。右躯干装有反导弹系统，对侧躯干则安装了一门增程小型激光。反导弹系统与连发SRM各有弹药一吨，LB 10-X则有三吨弹药。特性：精准武器（导弹） 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: Developed by Clan Coyote as a dueling machine, scientists used an Endo Steel chassis as a base. It also carries an XL engine and sixteen double heat sinks. Four jump jets allowed it to jump one hundred twenty meters at a time. The right arm carried an LB 10-X and the left arm carried a pair of Large Pulse Lasers. The right and left torsos had a Streak SRM-2 to capitalize on the damage inflicted by the heavier weapons. The right torso had an anti-missile system, while an ER small laser was mounted in the opposite torso. The AMS and Streaks each had one ton of ammunition and the LB 10-X had three tons of ammo.
column2: 这是郊狼部族作为决斗机研制的设计，科学家以钢内骨结构底盘为基础。它还带一台XL引擎和十六个双散热器，四具跳跃推进器让它一次可跃升一百二十米。右臂装一门LB 10-X，左臂装一对大型脉冲激光；左右躯干各一具连发SRM-2，以利用重武器造成的伤害。右躯干有一套反导弹系统，对面的躯干则装一门增程小型激光。反导弹系统与连发导弹各配一吨弹药，LB 10-X则有三吨弹药。ZH

column1: The MAL-1PT5 was one of two early variants of the Mauler produced during the initial design and testing phases. Armed with only two Medium Lasers in its arms, the 'Mech had to rely on its two LRM-15 and four AC/2 instead for the majority of its damage. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: MAL-1PT5是Mauler在最初设计与测试阶段生产的两款早期变型之一。机甲双臂仅装备两门中型激光，其大部分伤害因此不得不依赖两具LRM-15和四门AC/2。特性：干扰 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: When House Liao requested proposals for a more powerful BattleMech than the Vindicator, then the backbone of its military, part of Earthwerks' bid was an assault 'Mech named the \"Mauler.\" The  new creation aimed for combat effectiveness at ranges where targets could not respond. Anemic arm-mounted lasers offered only token protection, with their huge baffles intended not as battering rams, but to  accommodate future upgrades. However, Earthwerks’ other entry, the Cataphract, was more effective at conventional ranges, much cheaper, and easier on logistics, literally reusing parts from other BattleMechs. Deemed the worse alternative, this first variant of Maulers never saw production beyond a half dozen custom prototypes.
column2: 当廖氏家族为寻求一款比当时军中骨干辩护者更强的战斗机甲而征集方案时，地球工厂投标的一部分是一款名为“痛击者”的突击机甲。这一新作追求在目标无法还击的距离上取得作战效能。装在手臂上的贫弱激光只提供象征性防护，其巨大整流罩的用途并非当作撞锤，而是为日后升级预留空间。然而地球工厂的另一份方案——甲胄骑兵——在常规距离上更有效、便宜得多、后勤也更简单，因为它实际上重复利用了其他战斗机甲的部件。第一款痛击者因此被评为较差方案，除六台定制原型外从未投产。ZH

column1: The MAL-1PT6 was one of two early variants of the Mauler produced during the initial design and testing phases. Armed with two Large Lasers, two LRM-15 and four AC/2 meant the 'Mech was somewhat successful at handling engagements at most medium to long distances. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: MAL-1PT6是痛击者在设计定型与测试阶段生产的两种早期变型之一。它以两门大型激光、两具LRM-15与四门AC/2为武装，这使该机甲在大多数中远距离交战中表现尚可。特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Captured Maulers, deployed in Federated Commonwealth with the MAL-1X-AFFC designation, swapped the LRMs for quad SRM 4s.Their fewer but more pronounced missile ports are an easy identifier of the variant in early Clan Invasion footage. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 被缴获的痛击者以MAL-1X-AFFC编号在联邦共和国服役，以四联SRM 4取代LRM。其发射口更少但更突出，是早期部族入侵影像中辨识该变型的简易标志。特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: After meeting the first units of House Liaos brand new and still being tested 'Mech - the Mauler - shock and paranoia over its sudden appearance were a powerful motivator to the Department of Military Intelligence's MI2, which quickly gained thorough knowledge of the assault 'Mech. In the 3040s, the Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth judiciously deployed its few captured Maulers in quiet assignments on the Lyran Periphery border, where they could be operated despite a dearth of replacement parts. Here, the 'Mech quickly proved its worth against the invading forces of the Clans.
column2: 在遭遇廖氏家族全新且仍在测试中的机甲——Mauler——的首批单位之后，对它的突然出现所产生的震惊与偏执，成为军事情报局 MI2 的强大动力，他们很快便全面掌握了这款突击机甲的情报。3040 年代，联邦共和国武装力量审慎地将缴获的少数几台 Mauler 部署到莱兰联邦外围边境上一些不引人注目的岗位，那里即使备件极度匮乏也能让它们运转起来。也正是在这里，这款机甲在面对入侵的部族部队时迅速证明了自己的价值。ZH

column1: Some early MAL-1R had their ER Large Lasers replaced by standard ones due to supply shortages. These sub-variants were designated the Mauler MAL-1Y. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 由于供应短缺，一些早期 MAL-1R 的增程大型激光被换成了标准型号。这些子变型被命名为痛击者 MAL-1Y。特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Zachary Miles Hawkins personal variant of the mauler saw use at the time of the Clan Invasion, the Knockout upgrades the torso mounted missile racks from 15s to LRM-20s and inverts the usual Mauler energy and ballistic placements with an LB 10-X AC in each arm supported by ER Larger Laser in each side torso. Fitted with an 270 XL engine and twelve and half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, Knockout's heavy weapons array comes at the cost of field endurance, mounting only ten double heat sinks, two tons of LB-X autocannon munitions and single ton of LRM missiles. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 扎卡里·迈尔斯·霍金斯的个人定制猛击者变型曾在部族入侵期间投入使用。“击倒”把躯干上的导弹架从 LRM-15 升级为 LRM-20，并颠倒了猛击者惯常的能量武器与实弹武器布局：每只手臂各装一门 LB 10-X 自动炮，每个侧躯干各配一门 ER 大型激光。该机采用额定 270 的 XL 引擎与十二吨半铁纤维装甲，“击倒”强大的武器阵列以持续作战能力为代价，只装设了十台双散热器、两吨 LB-X 自动炮弹药和一吨 LRM 导弹。特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Zachary Miles Hawkins personal variant of the mauler saw use at the time of the Clan Invasion, the Knockout upgrades the torso mounted missile racks from 15s to LRM-20s and inverts the usual Mauler energy and ballistic placements with an LB 10-X AC in each arm supported by ER Larger Laser in each side torso. Fitted with an 270 XL engine and twelve and half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, Knockout's heavy weapons array comes at the cost of field endurance, mounting only ten double heat sinks, two tons of LB-X autocannon munitions and single ton of LRM missiles.
column2: 扎卡里·迈尔斯·霍金斯的个人版痛击者在部族入侵时期投入使用。“击倒”把躯干导弹挂架从15联升级为LRM-20，并颠倒了痛击者通常的能量与弹道布置：每只手臂装一门LB 10-X自动炮，每侧躯干配一门增程大型激光。它配一台270 XL引擎和十二吨半铁纤维装甲，“击倒”的重型武器配置以战场持续力为代价：只装十个双散热器、两吨LB-X自动炮弹药和一吨LRM导弹。ZH

column1: The Medusa is an expensive but effective cavalry 'Mech developed by Clan Cloud Cobra during the Golden Century to act as the follow-up hammer-blow to their favored aerospace assaults. The primary variant sports a Large Pulse Laser and two ER Medium Lasers for ranged combat and uses its battery of three SRM-6s arranged around the cockpit as a devastating follow-up in close combat. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Medusa是云眼镜蛇部族在黄金世纪研发的一款昂贵却高效的骑兵机甲，用于在部族钟爱的航空航天突击之后跟进补上重锤一击。主变型在远距离作战中配备一门大型脉冲激光和两门增程中型激光，而环绕驾驶舱布置的三具SRM-6则在混战中发动毁灭性的后续打击。特性：改进瞄准 - 短距 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Medusa is an expensive but effective cavalry 'Mech developed by Clan Cloud Cobra during the Golden Century to act as the follow-up hammer-blow to their favored aerospace assaults. The primary variant sports a Large Pulse Laser and two ER Medium Lasers for ranged combat and uses its battery of three SRM-6s arranged around the cockpit as a devastating follow-up in close combat.
column2: 美杜莎是云眼镜蛇氏族在黄金世纪研发的一种昂贵但高效的骑兵机甲，用作其偏爱的空天突袭之后的跟进重拳。主改型装备一门大型脉冲激光器和两门增程中型激光器用于远距作战，并在近距离以围绕驾驶舱布置的三具SRM-6作为毁灭性的后续打击。ZH

column1: Developed only a year after the original, the Medusa 2 variant is a logical companion to the Medusa 1. Unlike many fire-support designs, this variant relies on the speed and manueverability provided by its 300XL engine and six jump jets to keep pace with the Medusa-1. The Medusa 2 fields three LRM-10s and a pair of ER Medium Lasers in each arm. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Medusa 2 变型仅比原型晚一年开发，是 Medusa 1 顺理成章的搭档。与许多火力支援设计不同，该变型依靠 300XL 引擎和六具跳跃推进器提供的速度与机动性，与 Medusa-1 保持同步。Medusa 2 装备三门 LRM-10，每条手臂各有一对中型增程激光。特性：改进瞄准（近程） 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

column1: Developed only a year after the original, the Medusa 2 variant is a logical companion to the Medusa 1. Unlike many fire-support designs, this variant relies on the speed and manueverability provided by its 300XL engine and six jump jets to keep pace with the Medusa-1. The Medusa 2 fields three LRM-10s and a pair of ER Medium Lasers in each arm.
column2: 美杜莎2改型仅比原版晚一年研发，是美杜莎1的合理搭档。与许多火力支援设计不同，这一改型依靠其300XL引擎和六个跳跃推进器提供的速度与机动性来跟上美杜莎1。美杜莎2在双臂各装三具LRM-10和一对增程中型激光器。ZH

column1: Regarded by some as a survivable alternative to the Hunchback IIC, the Medusa 3 packs an incredible close-range punch while still keeping the speed, manueverability, and armor of the previous designs. The Medusa 3 hosts a massive Ultra Autocannon 20 on its right torso supplemented by an ER Medium Laser in each arm. In order to capitalize on any weaknesses in enemy armor, this variant retains an SRM-6 in the center torso. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 有人将其视为 Hunchback IIC 的生存性替代方案。Medusa 3 拥有惊人的近距离火力，同时保留了前代设计的速度、机动性和装甲。Medusa 3 的右躯干装有一门庞大的 Ultra 自动炮 20，双臂各配一门增程中型激光。为了抓住敌方装甲的任何薄弱之处，这一改型在中央躯干保留了一具 SRM-6。特性：改进瞄准 - 短距 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: Regarded by some as a survivable alternative to the Hunchback IIC, the Medusa 3 packs an incredible close-range punch while still keeping the speed, manueverability, and armor of the previous designs. The Medusa 3 hosts a massive Ultra Autocannon 20 on its right torso supplemented by an ER Medium Laser in each arm. In order to capitalize on any weaknesses in enemy armor, this variant retains an SRM-6 in the center torso.
column2: 被一些人视为驼背IIC的可生存替代方案，美杜莎3在保持前代设计的速度、机动性与装甲的同时，拥有令人难以置信的近距离打击力。美杜莎3在右躯干装一门巨大的超速自动炮20，双臂各有一门增程中型激光器补充。为了利用敌方装甲上的任何弱点，这一改型在中央躯干保留了SRM-6。ZH

column1: Despite the animosity between Clan Cloud Cobra and Clan Coyote, it did not take long for the former to field a new variant of their venerable Medusa 'Mech once they had access to the new Advanced Tactical Missile system. The Medusa 4 carries a staggering seven ATM-3s with six tons of ammunition to allow it unparalleled flexibility during combat and all are supplemented by an ER Large Laser. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 尽管云眼镜蛇部族与郊狼部族之间存在敌意，但前者在获得新型先进战术导弹系统后，很快就为它古老的墨杜萨机甲推出了新变型。墨杜萨4装有惊人的七具ATM-3和六吨弹药，使其在战斗中拥有无与伦比的灵活性，全部由一门增程大型激光补充。特性：改进瞄准 - 近程 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The T loadout combines two ER Medium Lasers with three Streak SRM-6 launchers, for a medium to short range engagement package. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: T挂载把两门增程中型激光与三具连发SRM-6发射器结合，构成中近距离交战组合。特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：0.95 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: An upgrade to the original Mercury line, Clan Wolverine spared no expense in the production of the Mercury II, including seven and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, double heat sinks and an XL Engine. Despite this the medium 'Mech is still slower than its lighter antecedent, only managing 119 km/h, though it makes up for that with jump jets that enable it to leap up to 210 meters at a time. The inclusion of a Beagle Active Probe and Guardian ECM Suite make the 'Mech a capable scout. Though the Mercury II is designed to be a scout, it can hold its own in a fight. An ER Large Laser gives it a credible ranged threat, while paired Medium Lasers and Small Lasers make it an effective hunter-killer. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 作为对原始水星系列的升级，狼獾部族在生产水星II时不遗余力，包括七吨半铁纤维装甲、双散热器和一台XL引擎。尽管如此，这台中型机甲仍比它更轻的前身慢，只能跑119公里/小时；不过它用跳跃推进器弥补了这一点，一次可跃升210米。比格犬主动探测器与守护者电子对抗套件的加入让该机甲成为称职的侦察机。虽然水星II设计为侦察机，它在战斗中也能自保：一门增程大型激光赋予它可信的远程威胁，成对的中型激光与小型激光则使它成为高效的猎杀者。特性：模块化武器 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: When Clan Wolverine was annihilated, Clan Coyote captured one of these 'Mechs and used it as the base of the Coyotl design - the first Omni Mech to ever be produced.
column2: 狼獾部族被消灭时，郊狼部族缴获了其中一台机甲，并以它为郊狼设计的基础——那是有史以来第一款全向机甲。ZH

column1: The MCY-100P is an early prototype of what would become the Mercury II, but before it's tonnage was increased. Using an 180 XL engine and MASC, it is even faster than the MCY-99 while keeping the 3.5 tons of ferro-fibrous armor. Using double heat sinks improved the cooling enough to change the weapons to one Medium Laser and a Center Torso mounted Extended Range Large Laser. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: MCY-100P 是后来 Mercury II 的早期原型机，当时其吨位尚未提升。它采用 180 XL 引擎和 MASC，速度甚至快于 MCY-99，同时保留了 3.5 吨铁纤维装甲。双散热器的使用大幅改善了散热能力，使其得以将武器改为一门中型激光和一门安装在中央躯干的增程大型激光。特性：模块化武器 投放费用倍率：0.97

column1: A stepping stone to today's light 'Mechs, the Mercury was very impressive when first introduced. Now it has fallen almost completely from grace and only see the occasional pirate or mercenary use.
column2: 作为今日轻型机甲的踏脚石，水星初次亮相时令人印象深刻。如今它几乎彻底失宠，只偶尔出现在海盗或佣兵手中。ZH

column1: The MCY-97 variant of the Mercury was created by ComStar in 3049 for recon duties. The armor, engine and MASC system are kept and one medium laser and one small laser have been dropped in favor of a Beagle Active Probe, giving the MCY-97 Mercury superior enemy detection capabilities at the cost of half of its firepower. Though an excellent scout this variant was largely discarded after the Battle of Tukayyid on account of insufficient firepower. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: 水星MCY-97变型由通讯之星于3049年研制，用于侦察任务。它保留了装甲、引擎和MASC系统，拆掉一门中型激光和一门小型激光，换装一台比格犬主动探测器，使MCY-97水星以损失一半火力为代价获得卓越的敌方探测能力。尽管是出色的侦察机，该变型在图卡伊德战役后因火力不足而被大量弃用。特性：模块化武器 投放费用倍率：0.97

column1: The Mercury debuted for the first time in 2742, intended as a replacement for the aging Wasps and Stingers in use by the Star League Defense Force. Hailed as the beginning of a new age in 'Mech design, the Mercury was faster and better-armed than its competition without sacrificing armor protection. It also featured an advancement in weapons installation, making use of a modular replacement system to allow for considerably faster and easier repairs. The MCY-98 is a downgraded version introduced during the Succession Wars in 2810. While it retains the same armament and engine of the original, the primary changes in the 'Mech is its armor, using standard plating in place of Ferro-Fibrous, and the MASC system, which has been removed to allow for the armor to be one ton heavier. These changes lower its maximum speed to 129.6 km/h and slightly increases the overall armor protection. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95
column2: Mercury 于 2742 年首次亮相，旨在取代星际联盟防御部队中日益老旧的 Wasp 和 Stinger。它被誉为机甲设计新时代的开端，在不牺牲装甲防护的前提下比竞争对手更快、火力更强。它在武器安装方式上也有所进步，采用模块化更换系统，使维修变得更快、更容易。MCY-98 是继承战争期间于 2810 年推出的降级版本。它保留了原有的武器配置和引擎，主要变化在于装甲——用标准装甲板取代了铁纤维——以及被拆除的 MASC 系统，腾出的重量让装甲可以多装一吨。这些改动将其最大速度降至 129.6 km/h，并略微提升了整体装甲防护。特性：模块化武器 投放费用倍率：0.95

column1: The Mercury debuted for the first time in 2742, intended as a replacement for the aging Wasps and Stingers in use by the Star League Defense Force. Hailed as the beginning of a new age in 'Mech design, the Mercury was faster and better-armed than its competition without sacrificing armor protection. It also featured an advancement in weapons installation, making use of a modular replacement system to allow for considerably faster and easier repairs. The Mercury carries an assortment of energy weapons which helps to extend its endurance on long campaigns. The primary weapons are two Medium Lasers in the right arm and left torso, supported by two Small Lasers in the center torso and head. The heart of the Mercury is its MASC System which, in combination with a 160 fusion engine, allows for momentary bursts of speed up to 172 km/h. Three tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor gives it superior protection compared to other 20-ton 'Mechs. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: 水星于2742年首次登场，意在替换星际联盟防卫军中使用已久、日渐老旧的黄蜂和毒刺。它被誉为机甲设计新时代的开端：在不牺牲装甲防护的前提下，水星比竞争对手更快、武装更好。它还在武器安装方式上有所创新，采用模块化更换系统，使维修显著更快、更容易。水星携带多种能量武器，这有助于延长它在长期战役中的续航。主武器是分别位于右臂和左躯干的2门中型激光，另有位于中央躯干和头部的2门小型激光支援。水星的核心是它的MASC系统，配合160聚变引擎可短时爆发到172 km/h。3吨铁纤维装甲让它在防护上优于其他20吨机甲。<特性：模块化武器 <投放费用倍率：0.97

column1: Released in 3010, the Merlin was the first original design to be manufactured in over a century. Designed by mountain Wolf Battlemechs as a durable and easy to repair mech, the Merlin is powered by a 240-rated fusion engine. Clad in 10 and a half tons of standard armor, it carries 18 heatsinks and a varied weapons load, designed to engage an enemy at any range. A PPC and LRM-5 launcher provide long range firepower, with a pair of medium lasers covering the shorter ranges. Also installed a machine gun and a flamer to guard against infantry attacks. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 梅林于3010年发布，是一个多世纪以来首款原创设计。它由山狼机甲公司设计为坚固且易于维修的机甲，由一台240额定聚变引擎驱动，披挂十吨半标准装甲，带18个散热器和多样的武器载荷，设计用于在任意距离上与敌人交战。一门粒子加农炮和一具LRM-5提供远程火力，两门中型激光覆盖较近距离，另装一挺机枪和一具火焰喷射器防备步兵袭击。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A rare variant of the Merlin, the 1A1 is a rebuild that strips out the expensive lasers and replaces them with cooler running Chemical alternatives. With the reduced heat burden, the LRM-5 is upgraded to an LRM-15 and a second ton of LRM ammo is added. Only seen among the poorer parts of the Periphery, its increased ammo dependency makes it a poor choice in anything other than a defensive role. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 1A1 是 Merlin 的稀有变型，这次重建拆掉了昂贵的激光，换成发热更低的化学型号。由于热量负担减轻，LRM-5 升级为 LRM-15，并增加了一吨 LRM 弹药。它只出现在外围地区较为贫困的地方；对弹药依赖的增加，使其除防御任务之外都不是好选择。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

column1: An unofficial refit kit that incorporates Star League era technology, the Merlin 1Ar never entered mainstream production but was a common upgrade if the parts could be obtained. The 1A's standard PPC is swapped for an Extended Range version, whilst the Medium Lasers are exchanged for Pulse versions. To handle the extra heat load and free up the weight needed for the Pulses, double heatsinks are added to the design. With the excess free weight, the LRM-5 is upgraded to a LRM-10. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是纳入星际联盟时期技术的非官方改装套件，梅林1Ar从未进入主流量产，但只要弄得到零件就是常见的升级。1A的标准粒子加农炮换成增程版本，中型激光换成脉冲型号。为应对额外热负荷并腾出脉冲激光所需重量，设计中加入了双散热器。借多出的重量，LRM-5升级为LRM-10。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Introduced in 3053, the Merlin 1B variant removes the Machine Gun and its ammunition and replaces them with an additional heat sink to help handle the Merlin's heat load. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Merlin 1B 变型于 3053 年推出，它拆除了机枪及其弹药，代之以一具额外的散热器，以帮助应对 Merlin 的热负荷。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: A field modification of the Merlin 1A, the 1B1 removes the Machine Gun and Flamer of the 1A and replaces them with an additional pair of medium lasers. Hotter running then the regular 1A or 1B designs, it nonetheless packs a greater punch at close range and is a favorite configuration for pilots assigned to long range reconnaissance or raiding operations. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 1B1 是 Merlin 1A 的野战改型，它拆除了 1A 的机枪与火焰喷射器，代之以额外两门中型激光。虽然比常规的 1A 或 1B 设计更容易过热，但它在近距离的打击力更强，是执行远程侦察或袭扰任务的机师最喜爱的配置。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

Hotter running then the regular 1A or 1B designs, it nonetheless packs a greater punch at close range and is a favorite configuration for pilots assigned to long range reconnaissance or raiding operations.
column2: 作为梅林1A的战地改装，1B1拆掉1A的机枪和火焰喷射器，换成额外一对中型激光器。它比常规的1A或1B设计更热，但在近距离打击更重，是派驻远程侦察或袭扰行动机师的偏爱配置。ZH

column1: A uniquely customized Merlin introduced in 3064, which was created by a tech named Porter Romero on the world of Armington. He salvaged the 'Mech from a pirate raid during the 3060s. Using a wrecked militia Bulldog for parts, he replaced the ruined PPC and LRM-5 with the tank's Large Laser and SRM 4 Launcher as well as adding additional armor. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 一台于3064年问世的、经过独特定制的梅林，出自阿明顿星上一位名叫波特·罗梅罗的技术人员之手。他在3060年代的一次海盗袭击中把这台机甲抢救了下来。他利用一台报废的民兵斗牛犬坦克上的部件，把损毁的粒子加农炮与LRM-5换成那辆坦克的大型激光与SRM 4发射器，并加装了额外的装甲。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A prototype that never saw widespread adoption, the Merlin 2A was Mountain Wolfs next generation offering unveiled alongside the 1B variant in 3053. Built around a 240-rated XL Engine, it is armed with a pair of ER Large Lasers and a pair of Medium Pulses. The 1A's Machine Gun is retained and the LRM-5 upgraded to a LRM-10. The addition of CASE protects the ammunition bays and 14 Double Heat Sinks handle the increased heat burden. At almost 19 million CBills, the design was rejected as too expensive and too reliant on advanced technology that the Outworlds Alliance struggled to produce. Mountain Wolf shelved the design, though not before a single run of 20 2A's were produced. Most of these were fielded by the Mountain Wolf security team, but some found their way into the hands of the elite Avellar Guard. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Merlin 2A 是一款从未被广泛采用的原型机，是山地狼公司于 3053 年与 1B 改型一同发布的下一代产品。它围绕额定 240 的 XL引擎建造，装备一对增程大型激光和一对中型脉冲激光。1A 的机枪得以保留，LRM-5 升级为 LRM-10。加装 CASE 保护了弹药舱，14 台双散热器则应对增加了的热负荷。由于价格接近 1900 万 CBill，该设计被认为过于昂贵，且过度依赖外域联盟难以生产的先进技术，因而遭到否决。山地狼公司将其搁置，不过在那之前已生产了一批 20 台 2A。这些机甲大多由山地狼安保队使用，但也有一些流入了精锐的阿韦拉尔卫队手中。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column2: 以托尔·米拉博格的私人蚱蜢为基础，雷神之锤主武装为右臂的PPC和左臂的高斯步枪，保留了GHR-5H的跳跃推进器、侧躯干中型激光器与中央躯干大型激光器。它围绕脆弱的280级XL引擎、内层钢框架与接近最大量的标准装甲建造，三吨高斯步枪弹和十三具双重散热器让雷神之锤拥有绰绰有余的战场续航力。ZH

column1: An upgrade to the ageing 68 model, this Mongoose was one of the first models to trial the Combines new C3 Slave unit. Featuring a characteristically minimalist upgrade package, this Mongoose variant served with distinction during Operation Bulldog. An ER Large Laser serves as the sole weapons system, augmented by a new fire control system and the C3 unit. A cheap upgrade, this is a favorite of pilots who were previously assigned a 68; with many praising the enhanced range and accuracy of the Laser. Paired into demi lances, and assigned a C3 Master equipped mech to coordinate, these Mongoose's are deployed as head hunters and long range harassers; both roles that make use of their high ground speed and manoeuvrability. Fast and deadly, they have already made a name for themselves, with one Mongoose formation accounting for 5 kills, including a Star Colonel in a Timberwolf during the Great Refusal. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 作为对老旧68型的升级，这台Mongoose是最早试装龙脉联合体新型C3从属单元的型号之一。它采用了典型的极简升级方案，在“斗牛犬行动”中表现卓著。它唯一的武器系统是一门增程大型激光，并辅以新的火控系统和C3单元。作为一项廉价的升级，它深受此前驾驶68型的机师喜爱，许多人称赞这门激光的射程与精度都有提升。它们以半分队编组，并配属一台装备C3主控单元的机甲进行协调，被部署为猎头者与远程骚扰单位——这两个角色都能充分发挥其出色的地面速度和机动性。它们快速而致命，如今已声名鹊起：在大拒绝之战中，一支Mongoose编队取得了5个战果，其中包括一名驾驶Timberwolf的星团长。特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：0.98

column1: An upgrade to the ageing 68 model, this Mongoose was one of the first models to trial the Combines new C3 Slave unit. Featuring a characteristically minimalist upgrade package, this Mongoose variant served with distinction during Operation Bulldog. An ER Large Laser serves as the sole weapons system, augmented by a new fire control system and the C3 unit. A cheap upgrade, this is a favorite of pilots who were previously assigned a 68; with many praising the enhanced range and accuracy of the Laser.
