Fast and deadly, they have already made a name for themselves, with one Mongoose formation accounting for 5 kills, including a Star Colonel in a Timberwolf during the Great Refusal.
column2: 作为对老旧68型号的升级，这台猫鼬是最早试用联合体新型C3从属系统的型号之一。它以标志性的极简升级包为特色，在斗牛犬行动中功勋卓著。一门增程大型激光器是它唯一的武器系统，另有新火控系统和C3单元的加持。作为一次廉价升级，它深受此前配属68型号机师的喜爱；许多人称赞这门激光器提升后的射程与精度。它们成对编入半分队并配属一台C3主机机甲来协调，被部署为猎头者与远程袭扰者；这两个角色都充分利用了它们的高地面速度与机动性。快速而致命，它们已经闯出了名声——在大拒绝期间，一支猫鼬编队创下5个击杀，其中包括一名驾驶铁木狼的星上校。ZH

column1: A Clantech upgrade to the again Royal Mongoose, that debuted during the Golden Age. The C2 was a Clan Mongoose model developed as a testbed for the newly developed Targeting Computers. Removing 2 heat sinks allowed Mongoose engineers to install the targeting computer, otherwise this design is unchanged from the standard MON-C. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 这是对再度成为皇家机型的 Mongoose 进行的部族科技升级，于黄金时代首次亮相。C2 是部族 Mongoose 的一个型号，作为新研制的瞄准计算机的试验平台而开发。拆除 2 具散热器让 Mongoose 的工程师得以安装瞄准计算机，除此之外该设计与标准 MON-C 完全相同。特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.04

column1: A Clantech upgrade to the again Royal Mongoose, that debuted during the Golden Age. The C2 was a Clan Mongoose model developed as a testbed for the newly developed Targeting Computers. Removing 2 heat sinks allowed Mongoose engineers to install the targeting computer, otherwise this design is unchanged from the standard MON-C.
column2: 这是对再次回归的皇家猫鼬的部族技术升级，于黄金时代首次亮相。C2是猫鼬部族的型号，作为新研制的瞄准计算机的试验平台。拆掉2个散热器让猫鼬工程师得以装入瞄准计算机，除此之外该设计与标准MON-C没有差别。ZH

column1: The original Morpheus carried a medium laser, pair of Medium Pulse Lasers, and an anti-missile system. It also carried a Beagle active probe and Guardian ECM suite. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 最初的Morpheus装有一门中型激光、两门中型脉冲激光和一套反导弹系统，此外还配有猎犬主动探测器和守护者电子对抗套件。特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: A Solaris VII BattleMech, the Morpheus is a heavily-armored combatant. The high ground speed allow the Morpheus to close quickly, while the heavy armor protects the 'Mech and pilot from enemy fire. The Morpheus is basically a larger version of the Tsunami medium arena fighter, and the engineers of Omnitech Industries learned many lessons from the Tsunami's disappointing appearance. Strangely, one thing they didn't bring over to the Morpheus was triple strength myomer.
column2: 作为一台索拉里斯VII战斗机甲，摩耳甫斯是重装甲的战斗者。高地面速度让摩耳甫斯能迅速逼近，而厚重的装甲保护机甲与机师免受敌方火力。摩耳甫斯基本上是海啸中型竞技机甲的放大版，全技工业的工程师们从海啸令人失望的表现中学到了许多教训。奇怪的是，他们没有移植到摩耳甫斯身上的一样东西是三倍强度肌纤维。ZH

column1: The Mosquito mounts two small and one medium laser, a C3 Slave and a MASC. To free the space required, the 'Mech uses both lighter Ferro-Fibrous armor and an Endo Steel chassis. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: Mosquito 装备两门小型激光和一门中型激光，外加一套 C3 从机和一套 MASC。为腾出所需空间，该机甲同时采用了更轻的铁纤维装甲和钢内骨结构底盘。特性：精准武器 - 激光 投放费用倍率：0.97

column1: The Mosquito is a 15-ton ultralight 'Mech created by several different companies within the Inner Sphere. It is often seen used for crowd control and garrison duties, but is also decent in a more battle oriented role.
column2: 蚊子是内天体数家不同公司创造的15吨超轻型机甲。它常用于人群控制与驻防任务，但在更偏战斗的角色上也表现不错。ZH

column1: This apparent precursor to the Phoenix Hawk LAM may have had a different name originally, but in any case became known as the Munin LAM. The only samples known to exist were those recovered from a cache by the Tyr Resistance Movement shortly before the Fourth Succession War. Unbeknownst to many, recovered blueprints and manufacturing manuals not only allowed production to resume, but aided in Upgraded Designs. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 这台显然是凤凰鹰 LAM 前身的设计可能原本另有其名，但无论如何后来被称为穆宁 LAM。已知存在的唯一样本，是第四次继承战争前不久由提尔抵抗运动从一处储藏库中取回的。许多人不知道的是，取回的蓝图与制造手册不仅让生产得以重启，还帮助了升级设计。特质：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: Munin LAM
column2: 穆宁 LAM

column1: This apparent precursor to the Phoenix Hawk LAM may have had a different name originally, but in any case became known as the Munin LAM. The only samples known to exist were those recovered from a cache by the Tyr Resistance Movement shortly before the Fourth Succession War. Unbeknownst to many, recovered blueprints and manufacturing manuals not only allowed production to resume, but aided in Upgraded Designs.
column2: 这种显然是凤凰鹰 LAM 前身的机型最初可能另有其名，但无论如何，它后来被称为穆宁 LAM。已知存在的唯一一批样品，是泰尔抵抗运动在第四次继承战争前不久从一处储藏点中回收的。鲜为人知的是，回收到的蓝图和制造手册不仅让生产得以恢复，还对升级设计有所助益。ZH

column1: The primary configuration of the Naga II combines an Ultra AC/10 in the right arm with an LB 10-X AC in the left for its primary damage. A single side torso mounted LRM-20 launcher allows for secondary fire support and indirect engagements. A single ER Small Laser in the center torso provide some very limited anti-infantry defense capabilities. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 娜迦 II 的主配置以右臂一门超速 AC/10 搭配左臂一门 LB 10-X AC 作为主要伤害来源。单具装在侧躯干的 LRM-20 发射器用于次要火力支援与间接交战。中央躯干的一门 ER 小型激光提供非常有限的反步兵防御能力。特质：强化躯干扭转 投放费用倍率：1.13 臂部驱动器限制：全能

column1: Naga II
column2: 娜迦 II

column1: The Naga II is a further continuation from Clan Wolf's first OmniMech, the Woodsman. What originally was a technical failure during the first batches of production of the Woodsman got converted into the Naga, later refined into the Naga II, but still suffering from bad reputation as a partial failure. The Naga II keeps much of of the core design the same as the original Naga; an Endo Steel internal structure, 9 tons of standard armor and a 400 XL engine.
column2: 娜迦 II 是狼氏族首款全能机甲"林中人"的进一步延续。林中人最初几批生产中存在的技术缺陷被转化成娜迦，后又精炼为娜迦 II，但仍背负着"部分失败"的坏名声。娜迦 II 保留原版娜迦的大部分核心设计：内骨骼内部结构、9 吨标准装甲与 400 XL 引擎。ZH

column1: The Naga is a fire-support successor to the first-generation Woodsman OmniMech, but is an oddity in many ways. Most of what could be pod space for the design is actually taken up by a pair of fixed Arrow IV Artillery Systems. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 娜迦是第一代"林中人"全能机甲的火力支援后继者，但在许多方面都颇为古怪。该设计本可用于吊舱的空间，实际上大部分被一对固定安装的箭矢 IV 火炮系统占据。特质：强化躯干扭转 投放费用倍率：1.13 臂部驱动器限制：全能

column1: The Naginata NG-C3A serves in the dual role of command and fire support 'Mech. The C3 master computer allows the 'Mech to share the targeting data of its lancemates and to take advantage of their targeting information, making the three LRM-15s with Artemis IV fire control systems and the ER PPC extremely accurate. The Artemis IV fire control system gives the 'Mech increased missile accuracy. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 薙刀NG-C3A兼具指挥与火力支援两种角色。C3主控计算机让它能共享小队成员的瞄准数据并利用他们的目标信息，使三门配备阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统的LRM-15和增程粒子加农炮具备极高的精准度。阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统进一步提升了机甲的导弹精度。特性：头罩 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: The Naginata is designed as a command and fire support 'Mech. The 'Mech is built using a massive 285 fusion engine, giving it a top speed of 54 km/h. The Naginata makes use of double heat sink technology for its added heat dissipation capabilities to handle the waste heat that is produced by the 'Mech's massive arsenal. For protection, the Naginata carries fifteen tons of armor and includes CASE to protect against an ammunition explosion. The mix of heavy armor, CASE, and a standard engine make the Naginata a zombie of a 'Mech that can take a tremendous amount of damage.
column2: 薙刀被设计为指挥与火力支援机甲。该机甲采用一台巨大的285聚变引擎，最高速度54公里/小时。薙刀利用双重散热器技术增强散热能力，以处理该机甲庞大武库产生的废热。防护方面，薙刀携带十五吨装甲并配备CASE以防弹药爆炸。厚甲、CASE与标准引擎的组合使薙刀成为一台能承受巨量伤害的僵尸机甲。ZH

column1: An early Clan Mech, the Naja was built by the Cloud Cobras, using the Royal Kintaro as the base chassis. Designed to showcase the Cobras new missile technology, the Naja is armed with a Clan LRM-20, along with paired Improved SRM-2's, a pair of Improved SRM-6's, and 3 lasers supplementing this. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 纳迦是部族早期机甲，由云眼镜蛇部族以皇家金太郎为底盘基础建造。为展示云眼镜蛇的新型导弹技术，纳迦装有一具部族LRM-20，另有成对的改进型SRM-2、两具改进型SRM-6，以及3门激光作为补充。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: An early Clan Mech, the Naja was built by the Cloud Cobras, using the Royal Kintaro as the base chassis. Designed to showcase the Cobras new missile technology, the Naja is armed with a Clan LRM-20, along with paired Improved SRM-2's, a pair of Improved SRM-6's, and 3 lasers supplementing this.
column2: 作为早期氏族机甲，娜迦由云眼镜蛇建造，以皇家金太郎为基础底盘。它旨在展示眼镜蛇的新型导弹技术，武装为一具氏族LRM-20，另有成对的改进型SRM-2、两具改进型SRM-6，以及3门激光器作为补充。ZH

column1: An early Clan mech used by Clan Cloud Cobra, the Naja is built on the Kintaro chassis sporting an LRM-20, and a trio of ER Lasers. A pair of Improved SRM2's and Improved SRM6's are retained from the first generation Naja. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: Naja 是云眼镜蛇部族早期使用的一款机甲，以 Kintaro 底盘为基础建造，装备一具 LRM-20 和三门增程激光。第一代 Naja 的改进型 SRM2 与改进型 SRM6 各一对被保留了下来。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: An early Clan mech used by Clan Cloud Cobra, the Naja is built on the Kintaro chassis sporting an LRM-20, and a trio of ER Lasers. A pair of Improved SRM2's and Improved SRM6's are retained from the first generation Naja.
column2: 作为云眼镜蛇氏族使用的一种早期氏族机甲，娜迦建在金太郎底盘上，装有一具LRM-20和三门增程激光器。两具改进型SRM2和改进型SRM6从第一代娜迦保留下来。ZH

column1: As a recon 'Mech intended to rarely engage an enemy in a pitched battle, the Nexus is armed with a Medium Laser backed up by two highly accurate Medium Pulse Lasers. As a weapon of last resort, the Nexus also has two Small Lasers. For added protection against missile attacks, the Nexus has an AMS. The Nexus has a top speed of 119 km/h and is powered by a 175-rated fusion engine which is both light and rugged. To save weight without the vulnerability of an XL engine, the Nexus is built on a Endo Steel chassis. For protection, the 'Mech carries a light two tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, relying on its speed and maneuverability, which is enhanced with a jumping capability of up to one hundred and twenty meters. Finally, to handle the heat from the arsenal of energy weapons, the Nexus carries ten double heat sinks. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Nexus 是一款侦察机甲，设计中极少在正面会战中与敌交战。它装备一门中型激光，辅以两门精准度极高的中型脉冲激光。作为最后手段，Nexus 还配有两门小型激光。为加强对导弹攻击的防护，Nexus 装有一具 AMS。Nexus 的最高时速为 119 km/h，由一台额定 175 的聚变引擎驱动，既轻便又坚固。为在不承受 XL 引擎脆弱性的前提下减轻重量，Nexus 采用钢内骨结构打造。防护方面，该机甲仅携带轻量的两吨铁纤维装甲，依靠自身的速度与机动性——其跳跃能力可达一百二十米。最后，为应对大量能量武器产生的热量，Nexus 配备十个双散热器。特性：灵活 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: The BattleMech known as the Nexus was originally based on the Jackrabbit, a light scout and combat vehicle and infantry support 'Mech built for the Star League Defense Force by Skobel MechWorks. Ironically, the Jackrabbit ended testing two weeks before Stefan Amaris seized power on Terra and was instead primarily used by units loyal to Amaris against the SLDF in General Kerensky's drive to liberate the Terran Hegemony. Though the SLDF captured Skobel's plant relatively intact, thanks to the stigma of being used against his forces Kerensky ordered it shutdown and the unloved Jackrabbit disappeared into history outside of ComStar's records. With the Com Guards looking to recoup their grievous losses in the wake of the Battle of Tukayyid, in 3054 Precentor Martial Anastasius Focht ordered the Skobel plant reactivated, reworking the slower Jackrabbit into a fast and highly mobile recon striker 'Mech he renamed the Nexus.
column2: 这台被称为联结的战斗机甲最初以豺兔为基础——那是斯考贝尔机械厂为星盟防卫部队建造的轻型侦察兼战斗车辆与步兵支援机甲。讽刺的是，豺兔在斯特凡·阿马里斯于地球夺权前两周就结束了测试，结果反倒主要被忠于阿马里斯的部队用来对抗SLDF，在克伦斯基将军解放地球霸权的进军中登场。尽管SLDF相对完整地夺取了斯考贝尔的工厂，但由于该机型曾被用来对付自己的部队这一污名，克伦斯基下令将其关停，不受待见的豺兔从此从历史中消失，只存在于康星的记录之外。图卡伊德战役之后，康卫队力图弥补惨重损失，3054年，尚武主教阿纳斯塔修斯·福赫特下令重启斯考贝尔工厂，把较慢的豺兔重造为一台快速且高度机动的侦察打击机甲，并将其更名为联结。ZH

column1: The alternate loadout of the Night Chanter combines an LRM-10 launcher with an ER Medium Laser and an ER PPC as primary weapons, while mounting two A-Pods and two Machine guns to deal with vehicles and infantry. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: 夜吟者的备用配置以LRM-10发射器、一具增程中型激光和一具增程粒子加农炮为主武器，同时装有两具A-Pod和两挺机枪以对付车辆与步兵。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.02

column1: Night Chanter
column2: 夜咏者

column1: As the knowledge of how to build OmniMechs spread throughout the clans although Coyote had tried to keep it for themselves, they quickly realized they needed to bolster their 'Mech forces and started the Pueblo Initiative to remodel older SLDF 'Mechs into OmniMechs. The Night Chanter was the first result of the initiative, using the Crab as its base. However, the rushed development led to a somewhat dubious design, and the 'Mech was easily beaten by other Omnis of the same size. Despite this compromise, the Night Chanter still spread through the clans quickly and became the most used of the Pueblo Initiative designs.
column2: 随着制造全向机甲的技术在部族间流传开来——尽管 Coyote 曾试图将其据为己有——他们很快意识到必须充实自己的机甲部队，于是启动了 Pueblo 计划，将较老的 SLDF 机甲改造为全向机甲。Night Chanter 是该计划的首个成果，以 Crab 为基础。然而仓促的研发导致设计略显可疑，这台机甲很容易被同级别的其他全向机甲击败。尽管存在这些妥协，Night Chanter 仍迅速在部族中流传，成为 Pueblo 计划设计中使用最广泛的一款。ZH

column1: The Primary loadout of the Night Chanter is a combination of pulse and extended range lasers, making the 'Mech somewhat able to deal damage at most ranges. The varied loadout does mean it lacks the weapon profile to excel at any particular range, but the idea of the design is that any intended engagement does not occur within only a limited amount of ranges, and instead it is a constant flow back and forth. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: 夜吟者的主配置结合了脉冲激光与增程激光，使这台机甲在大多数距离上都能造成一定伤害。这种多样化的配置确实意味着它缺乏在某一特定距离上出类拔萃的武器组合，但该设计的理念本就是不让交战只发生在有限的几段距离内，而是持续不断地来回游走。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.02

column1: The A variant is a short-range powerhouse. It mounts an Ultra Autocannon/20 to breach opponent's armor and a pair of Streak SRM-6s to exploit those holes. A Large Pulse Laser and a trio of Medium Pulse Lasers are highly accurate weapons that can help to minimize collateral damage in an urban environment. Even with four additional double heat sinks, this variant can be quickly overwhelmed by heat. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: A变型是近程重炮。它装一门超级自动炮/20撕裂对手装甲，两具连发SRM-6利用这些破口；一门大型脉冲激光和三门中型脉冲激光是高精度武器，有助于在城市环境中尽量减少附带损伤。即便有四个额外双散热器，此变型也可能迅速被热量压倒。特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Another long-range variant, the C mounts three Ultra Autocannon/2s and two ER Large Lasers. A pair of ER Medium Lasers are present for backup. All of these weapons are linked to a Targeting Computer. Six extra heat sinks ensure the 'Mech stays mostly cool. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 作为另一款远程变型，C配置装三门超级AC/2和两门增程大型激光，另有两门增程中型激光作为后手。这些武器全部联动一台瞄准计算机。六个额外散热器确保机甲大体保持凉爽。特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: This variant uses massed pulse lasers, two large and six medium, in conjunction with an ATM 6 and an SRM-6. The ATM only mounts two tons of ammunition, limiting its flexibility. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 该变型集中配备脉冲激光，两具大型与六具中型，并搭配一具ATM 6和一具SRM-6。ATM仅携带两吨弹药，灵活性因此受到限制。特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A customized variant of the Night Gyr. The Jade Kite uses a pair of Ultra Autocannon/2s in its left arm, supported by a pair of ammo. The left torso carries a pair of Machine Guns, each with one ton of autocannon ammo and a half-ton of machine gun ammo. The right arm carries a pair of ER PPCs. In the right torso, two Streak SRM-6s with two tons of ammo. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是夜鹫的定制变型。碧玉风筝左臂装一对超级AC/2，配两吨弹药；左躯干带一对机枪，各配一吨自动炮弹药和半吨机枪弹药；右臂装一对增程粒子加农炮；右躯干内有两具连发SRM-6，配两吨弹药。特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A customized variant of the Night Gyr. The Jade Kite uses a pair of Ultra Autocannon/2s in its left arm, supported by a pair of ammo. The left torso carries a pair of Machine Guns, each with one ton of autocannon ammo and a half-ton of machine gun ammo. The right arm carries a pair of ER PPCs. In the right torso, two Streak SRM-6s with two tons of ammo.
column2: 夜隼的定制改型。翠绿风筝在左臂装一对超速自动炮/2，配两吨弹药支援。左躯干携带一对机枪，各配一吨自动炮弹药和半吨机枪弹药。右臂携带一对增程PPC。右躯干内有两具连发SRM-6，配两吨弹药。ZH

column1: The Nighthawk Mk. XXI is a PA(L) design and the progenitor of modern battle armor. The original Nighthawk was based upon exoskeletons originally used for commercial purposes during the Star League. It took fifteen years and twenty prototypes before the SLDF finally perfected the design that would eventually be produced. A working prototype was first introduced in 2718, which was followed by two years of field testing and, finally, full production, entering service with the Special Forces Command. Quirk: Power Armor Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.8832 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 夜鹰Mk. XXI是一种PA(L)设计，也是现代战斗装甲的鼻祖。最初的夜鹰基于星际联盟时期原本用于商业用途的外骨骼。在SLDF最终完善并定型生产之前，共耗费了十五年时间和二十台原型机。首台可运作的原型机于2718年问世，随后经过两年的野战测试，最终实现量产，并进入特种部队司令部服役。特性：动力甲 投放费用倍率：0.8832 可搭载全向单位，可近战，可蜂拥攻击。

column1: A fast reaction mech designed to hunt down enemy scouts and raiding units, the 35 ton Night Hawk was developed by Mountain Wolf Battlemechs in 2656. Built around a 210-rated XL Engine, the Night Hawk NTK-2Q is armed with an ER Large Laser and a Large Laser. A Medium Pulse Laser provides additional firepower should enemies close in. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 作为一款用于猎杀敌方侦察与袭掠单位的快速反应机甲，35吨的夜鹰由山狼机甲公司于2656年研制。夜鹰NTK-2Q围绕一台210额定XL引擎建造，装有一门增程大型激光和一门大型激光；敌人逼近时，一门中型脉冲激光提供额外火力。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

A Guardian ECM Suite and a Beagle Active Probe increase the Mechs effectiveness as a scout. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Night Hawk 是一台为追猎敌方侦察与袭击单位而设计的快速反应机甲，这台 35 吨机甲由 Mountain Wolf Battlemechs 于 2656 年研制。Night Hawk NTK-2S 以一台 210 级 XL 引擎为核心，装备一门增程大型激光和一门大型激光。守护者电子对抗套件与 Beagle 主动探测器提升了该机甲作为侦察兵的效能。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

A Guardian ECM Suite and a Beagle Active Probe increase the Mechs effectiveness as a scout.

column1: The original variant of the Nightsky is built around a massive 300 XL engine, propelling the 'Mech up to speeds of 97.2 km/h. Superb ground speed and the added maneuverability provided by six jump jets allows the Nightsky to jump up to 180 meters. The 'Mech is protected with nine and a half tons of armor, considered good protection for its size. Besides the massive hatchet, the Nightsky carries two Medium and one Large Pules Laser, with a single Small Pulse Lasers as backup. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 夜天最初变型围绕一台庞大的300 XL引擎建造，把机甲推到97.2公里/小时。出色的地面速度加上六具跳跃推进器带来的额外机动性，让夜天可跳跃至多180米。该机甲由九吨半装甲保护，就体型而言算是不错的防护。除那把大战斧外，夜天带两门中型和一门大型脉冲激光，另有一门小型脉冲激光作为后手。特性：近战驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.04

column1: Brawler & Skirmisher
column2: 缠斗者与散兵

column1: The Nightsky is the successor to the Hatchetman and Axeman developed by Defiance Industries. As with its predecessors, the centerpiece of the Nightsky is a massive four-ton hatchet that is built into its right arm, which allows the 'Mech to cut through another 'Mech's armor.
column2: 夜天是迪法恩斯工业开发的斧手与伐木者的后继者。与其前辈一样，夜天的核心是右臂内置的一柄巨大四吨战斧，能让机甲劈开另一台机甲的装甲。ZH

column1: The 4T is a variant of the Nightsky that looks to make the 'Mech more powerful in both long and close range combat. This is done by swapping the Large Pulse Laser for an ER Large Laser and an Anti-Missile System, for added defense against enemy missiles. The 'Mech also adds an additional Small Laser for added close range firepower. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 4T是夜天的变型，力求让该机甲在远程与近程战斗中更强大：它以一门增程大型激光和一套反导弹系统取代大型脉冲激光，以加强对敌方导弹的防御，并额外加装一门小型激光以提升近程火力。特性：近战驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.04

column1: A simple upgrade of the Nightsky, the 5S looks to make the 'Mech more heat efficient. This is achieved by removing the jump jets and replacing them with three additional double heat sinks. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 5S是Nightsky的一次简单升级，目的是让机甲散热更高效。做法是拆除跳跃推进器，代之以三台额外的双散热器。特性：近战驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.04

column1: The 5T is a modification of the 4S that replaces the large pulse laser with an ER PPC, but is otherwise identical to the 4S model. This modification of the 'Mech makes the Nightsky capable of targeting an enemy 'Mech at extreme ranges and wearing them down until the 'Mech can bring its hatchet to bear on its target. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 5T 是 4S 的改型，用一门增程粒子加农炮替换了大型脉冲激光，除此之外与 4S 型号完全相同。这一改动让 Nightsky 能够在极远距离上锁定敌方机甲并不断消磨它，直到战斧能够劈向目标为止。特性：近战驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.04

column1: Reconfigured for greater speed, the 9FC variant of the Nightstar replaces the two Gauss Rifles with a pair of LB-X Autocannon/10s that are not as destructive as the weapons they replace, but can use both standard and cluster ammunition, making them effective in a variety of roles. The Small Laser has also been upgraded and the Medium Pulse Lasers downgraded, giving the Nightstar a total of three medium lasers. To make the 'Mech fit better into the mobile warfare doctrine of the Federated Suns and Federated Commonwealth, the 9FC model has used the saved weight to upgrade its engine, giving it a top speed of 64.8 km/h. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: 为追求更高速度而重新配置的夜星9FC变型以一对LB-X自动炮/10取代两门高斯步枪；它们不如被替换的武器那样具破坏性，却可使用标准弹与集束弹，因而胜任多种角色。小型激光也被升级、中型脉冲激光则降级，使夜星共带三门中型激光。为使该机甲更契合联邦太阳国与联邦共和国的机动作战理念，9FC用省下的重量升级引擎，把最高速度提升到64.8公里/小时。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.17

column1: The personal machine of Shelly Brubaker, this Nightstar variant replaced the standard weapons with Clan-spec weapons: Two Gauss Rifles, three Large Pulse Lasers, and an ER Small Laser. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
column2: 这是 Shelly Brubaker 的专属座机。这款 Nightstar 变型以部族规格武器取代了标准武器：两门高斯步枪、三门大型脉冲激光和一门增程小型激光。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.19

column1: The No-Dachi was designed by Cosby as a test bed for two new technologies. The first was the Sword. The seven-meter long katana that the 'Mech wields was designed to counter the Hatchet used by some Federated Commonwealth 'Mechs. Because the samurai mindset had been so successfully drilled into the warriors of the Draconis Combine, they were loathe to use a ''barbaric'' ax. The second new technology was the Triple Strength Myomer that had been pioneered by the Federated Suns. The new melee weapon, combined with the improved myomers, make the No-Dachi a dangerous in-fighter. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: No-Dachi 由 Cosby 设计，用作两项新技术的试验平台。第一项是剑。该机甲所持的长达七米的武士刀，是为了对抗联邦共和国部分机甲所使用的战斧而设计的。由于武士道精神已被成功地灌输到龙脉联合体的战士心中，他们不愿使用“野蛮的”斧头。第二项新技术是由联邦太阳国率先采用的三倍强度人造肌肉。这种新型近战武器与改进后的人造肌肉相结合，使 No-Dachi 成为危险的近身缠斗者。特性：近战驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂

column1: The No-Dachi was designed by Cosby as a test bed for two new technologies. The first was the Sword. The seven-meter long katana that the 'Mech wields was designed to counter the Hatchet used by some Federated Commonwealth 'Mechs. The second new technology was the Triple Strength Myomer that had been pioneered by the Federated Suns. column2: 野太刀由科斯比设计，用作两项新技术的试验平台。第一项是剑：这台机甲挥舞的七米长武士刀，专门用来对抗某些联邦共和国机甲所使用的战斧。由于武士道精神已被深深灌输进龙脉联合体的战士心中，他们对这种“野蛮的”斧头深恶痛绝。第二项新技术是联邦太阳国率先采用的三倍强度肌纤维。新型近战武器与改良后的肌纤维相结合，使野太刀成为危险的近身近战机甲。ZH

column1: The 2K variant has been altered to be even more dangerous in close quarters. The advantages are at the expense of its long-range weaponry, however. The ER PPC is downgraded to an ER Large Laser and the MRM-20s to MRM-10s. The resulting weight savings are used to upgrade the medium laser to a Medium Pulse Laser and add four more of the same. The remaining tonnage is devoted to an additional double heat sink, a Guardian ECM Suite, a single Small Laser, and more armor. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
column2: 2K 变型经过改造，在近距离战斗中更加危险，不过这些优势是以牺牲其远程武器为代价的。增程粒子加农炮被降级为增程大型激光，MRM-20 则换成 MRM-10。由此节省下来的重量被用于把中型激光升级为中型脉冲激光，并再增加四门同类武器。剩余的吨位则用于加装一台双散热器、一套守护者电子对抗套件、一具小型激光以及更多装甲。特性：近战驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左上

column1: The newer 2KO was designed to be even more lethal up-close than the 2K. This variant removes the MRMs entirely and changes the Large Laser to a Large Pulse Laser. An additional Medium Pulse Laser and Small Pulse Laser were added, as well as a Flamer and three more double heat sinks. A ton and a half of armor has been added to the 'Mech's rear to provide addition protection as has a pair of ER Medium Lasers. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 更新的2KO被设计得比2K在近距离更致命。此变型完全拆掉MRM，并把大型激光换成大型脉冲激光，另加一门中型脉冲激光和一门小型脉冲激光，以及一具火焰喷射器和三个额外双散热器。机甲后方加了一吨半装甲以提供额外防护，另加一对增程中型激光。特性：近战驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: The newer 2KO was designed to be even more lethal up-close than the 2K. This variant removes the MRMs entirely and changes the Large Laser to a Large Pulse Laser. An additional Medium Pulse Laser and Small Pulse Laser were added, as well as a Flamer and three more double heat sinks. A ton and a half of armor has been added to the 'Mech's rear to provide addition protection as has a pair of ER Medium Lasers.
column2: 较新的2KO被设计得比2K在近距离更加致命。这一改型完全拆除MRM，并把大型激光器换成大型脉冲激光器。另加了一门中型脉冲激光器、一门小型脉冲激光器，以及一具火焰喷射器和三具额外双重散热器。机甲后部增加了一吨半装甲以提供额外防护，还加装了一对增程中型激光器。ZH

column1: The NDA-2U replaces all the Pulser Laser of the 2K with standard variants, allowing replacing the two MRM-10 with one LRM-15 and one MRM-20. The variant also replaces the ER Large Laser with an ER PPC and drops the Small Laser. The Guardian ECM is further exchanged for a C3 slave computer. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: NDA-2U将2K的所有脉冲激光全部换成标准型号，从而得以把两具MRM-10替换为一具LRM-15和一具MRM-20。该改型还以增程粒子加农炮取代增程大型激光，并去掉了小型激光。此外，Guardian电子对抗套件也被换成一具C3从属计算机。特性：近战驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: This custom configuration of Nova Cat was first spotted during the escalation of the FedCom civil war. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 新星猫的这一定制配置最早在联邦共和内战升级期间被发现。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: This custom configuration of Nova Cat was first spotted during the escalation of the FedCom civil war.
column2: 这一新猫定制配置首次现身于联邦共同体内战升级期间。ZH

column1: One of several prototype rebuilds of the Prime configuration with the goal of making it run less hot. This was done by shifting the weapons more towards ballistics with two LB-X 20 Autocannons, but still mounting three Medium Pulse Lasers. Further, the A prototype mounts a MASC instead of jump jets to keep some mobility. These prototypes eventually lead to the standardized M configuration. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是Prime构型的几种原型改造之一，目标在于让它的运行温度更低。为此，武器配置向实弹类偏移，装有两门LB-X 20自动炮，但仍保留三门中型脉冲激光。此外，A原型以MASC取代跳跃推进器，以保持一定的机动性。这些原型最终催生出标准化的M构型。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Prototype Refit
column2: 原型 Refit

column1: Long regarded as a pocket Assault OmniMech, the Nova Cat sacrifices speed for firepower. With over half of its tonnage dedicated to weapons, ammunition, and equipment, the Nova Cat packs a punch in all configurations. Some recent configurations increased the speed and agility that Clan customers typically desire.
column2: 长期以来被视为袖珍突击全能机甲，新星猫以速度换取火力。它把超过一半的吨位用于武器、弹药和装备，因此在所有配置下都打击沉重。近期的一些配置提升了氏族客户通常看重的速度与灵活性。ZH

column1: One of several prototype rebuilds of the Prime configuration with the goal of making it run less hot. This was done by shifting the weapons more towards ballistics with two LB-X 20 Autocannons, but still mounting three Medium Pulse Lasers. Further, the J prototype added Ferro-Fibrous structuring to free enough weight capacity to keep the jump jets. These prototypes eventually lead to the standardized M configuration. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是主配置若干原型重建之一，目标是让它运行时不那么热。为此把武器更多地转向弹道，采用两门LB-X 20自动炮，但仍装三门中型脉冲激光。此外J原型加入铁纤维结构以腾出足够重量容量保留跳跃推进器。这些原型最终催生了标准化的M配置。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: One of several prototype rebuilds of the Prime configuration with the goal of making it run less hot. This was done by shifting the weapons more towards ballistics with two LB-X 20 Autocannons, with two Streak SRM-6 launchers for close range fire support. These prototypes eventually lead to the standardized M configuration. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是在主配置基础上进行的几种原型重建之一，目标是降低其运行温度。为此采用的方法是将武器更多转向实弹类，配备两门LB-X 20自动炮，并以两具连发SRM-6发射器提供近距离火力支援。这些原型最终催生了标准化的M配置。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A customized Hero 'Mech configuration of the Nova supposedly piloted by Mar Helmer, the Breaker mounts a Streak SRM-4 and a Streak SRM-6 rack in the left arm, supported by five ER medium lasers with three in the right arm and the remaining two in the left torso. Rounded out with twin machine guns in the right torso, three tons of Streak missiles, half a ton of machine gun rounds and two extra double heat sinks keep Breaker in the thick of combat. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Breaker 是 Nova 的定制英雄机甲配置，据称由 Mar Helmer 驾驶。它于左臂搭载一组连发 SRM-4 与一组连发 SRM-6 发射架，并以五门增程中型激光为支援，其中三门位于右臂，其余两门位于左侧躯干。右躯干的双联机枪、三吨连发导弹、半吨机枪弹药，再加上两具额外的双散热器，让 Breaker 能始终坚守激战中心。特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The E2 configuration of the Nova focuses on Medium lasers, and lots of them. A total of 7 ER Medium standard and 3 Medium Pulse Lasers, spread over both arms and side torsos, provide good accuracy and damage at closer ranges, but also presents a new problem with managing the heat. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Nova 的 E2 配置专注于中型激光，而且数量众多。共 7 门标准增程中型激光与 3 门中型脉冲激光，分布于双臂与两侧躯干，在较近的距离上兼顾良好的精度与伤害，但也带来了散热管理的新难题。特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The F2 loadout carries only two weapons, one Ultra AC/5 and one LBX AC/5. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: F2 配装仅携带两件武器：一门 Ultra AC/5 与一门 LBX AC/5。特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The G2 configuration mounts three Medium Pulse Lasers in each arm, cooled by 15 double heat sinks. To improve the performance a targeting computer in the right torso is linked to the weapons. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: G2配置在每只手臂上装三门中型脉冲激光，由15个双散热器降温。为提升效能，右躯干内的瞄准计算机与这些武器联动。特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The P1 loadout carries 5 ER Medium Lasers in the right arm, a LRM-20 in the left arm and a single Medium Pulse Laser in the left torso. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: P1 配置在右臂搭载 5 具增程中型激光，左臂搭载一具 LRM-20，左躯干搭载一具中型脉冲激光。特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A modified A configuration used by Samson Furey, a Clan Smoke Jaguar abtakha fighting for Wolf's Dragoons in Delta Regiment, dropped the pair of anti-missile systems in the shoulders for two additional double heat sinks. It also drops the medium pulse laser for two ER medium lasers. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是萨姆森·富里所使用的改进型A配置——他是一名出身部族烟虎、被沃尔夫龙骑兵收编的战士（abtakha），服役于三角洲团。该配置拆除了双肩的一对反导弹系统，换装为两个额外的双散热器，同时以两门增程中型激光取代了中型脉冲激光。特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The O-Bakemono weighs in at eighty tons and has a top speed of 64.8 km/h, which is considered a good ground speed for an assault 'Mech. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 大鬼面重达八十吨，最高速度64.8公里/小时，对突击机甲而言算是不错的地面速度。特性：模块化武器 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: For close combat, the A configuration has six medium pulse lasers; two in each arm and two in the center torso. A Streak SRM-6 and one ton of ammunition is mounted in each side torso. A small pulse laser is mounted in the head for anti-infantry work. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 在混战方面，A配置装有六门中型脉冲激光：每只手臂各两门，中央躯干两门。两侧躯干各装有一具连发SRM-6及一个吨位的弹药。头部装有一门小型脉冲激光，用于反步兵作战。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Omni-Corvis is an early prototype of OmniMech technology that was developed by Clan Hell's Horses. Based on the Corvis BattleMech, it carries the modular systems first introduced in the Mercury to the logical extreme. After Clan Ghost Bear took control of Tokasha MechWorks in 2921 they released the plans for the Omni-Corvis on the Chatterweb to punish the Horses for the death of Khan Kilbourne Jorgensson. The only Clan to take advantage of the design was Clan Snow Raven, who used the plans to create the Stormcrow.
column2: Omni-Corvis 是全向机甲技术的早期原型，由地狱之马部族开发。它以 Corvis 战斗机甲为基础，把最早在水星上引入的模块化系统推向了极致。2921 年幽灵熊部族接管 Tokasha 机甲工厂后，为惩罚地狱之马部族害死可汗 Kilbourne Jorgensson，他们在 Chatterweb 上公布了 Omni-Corvis 的图纸。唯一利用了这一设计的部族是雪鸦部族，他们用这些图纸创造了风暴鸦。ZH

column1: A long range fire support model, the B configuration has an LRM-20 and three tons of ammunition in each arm. These are supported by a right torso Narc missile beacon with two tons of ammunition. A pair of machine guns with a half-ton of ammunition are carried in the left torso. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: B 型配置是远程火力支援型号，每条手臂各有一具 LRM-20 和三吨弹药。它们由右躯干的一具 NARC 导弹信标提供支援，配两吨弹药。左躯干则携带两挺机枪和半吨弹药。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The default configuration is inspired by the Corvis. A UAC/10 with four tons of ammunition is supported by an ER large laser and an ER medium laser. Two additional pod-mounted double heat sinks are installed as well. This allows the Omni-Corvis to operate in the same medium range brackets that Corvis pilots are used to. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 默认配置的灵感来自Corvis。一门UAC/10配四吨弹药，辅以一门增程大型激光和一门增程中型激光。此外还安装了两台额外的挂载式双散热器。这让Omni-Corvis能够在Corvis机师所熟悉的中距离区间内作战。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: This is the original version of the Onslaught. It is protected by only 12 tons of armor and is armed with an Ultra AC/5, Large Laser two SRM-6 and six Machine Guns. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
column2: 这是猛攻的原始版本，仅有12吨装甲防护，武装为一门超级AC/5、一门大型激光、两具SRM-6和六挺机枪。特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左上

column1: A Solaris VII BattleMech, the Onslaught was originally designed as a technology testing platform. Approximately one hundred of these 'Mechs were built. A capable heavy BattleMech, the Onslaughts most noticeable feature was its high speed. Its cruising speed of 58 km/h was more commonly seen on medium 'Mechs.
column2: Onslaught 是一具 Solaris VII 战斗机甲，最初是作为技术测试平台设计的，总共建造了约一百具。作为一具有实力的重型战斗机甲，Onslaught 最引人注目的特点就是速度快，其 58 km/h 的巡航速度通常多见于中型机甲。ZH

column1: This slight modification of the original SA-OS removes one of the C.A.S.E. systems, allowing the increase of Machine Gun ammunition. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
column2: 这是对原版SA-OS的小幅改动，拆掉其中一套C.A.S.E.系统，从而得以增加机枪弹药。特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左上

column2: 猎户座 IIC

column1: The Orion ON1-AJA slaps. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 猎户座 ON1-AJA 强得离谱。特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Orions don't have hands, but this thing slaps
column2: 猎户座没有手，但这东西能扇人。ZH

column1: The Orion ON1-E is a seldom seen variant of the Orion heavy 'Mech. As its main loadout the ON1-E mounts a LB-X 10 in the right torso and an Artemis IV enabled LRM-15 in the left torso. For close quarters combat and defense, the variant also has a Streak SRM-6 launcher in the left arm and an ER Medium Laser in each arm. To be able to comfortably carry the weapons, the chassis uses an Endo Steel structure. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 猎户座ON1-E是重型机甲猎户座中较为罕见的变型。作为主要武装，ON1-E在右躯干装有一门LB-X 10，左躯干装有带阿尔忒弥斯IV的LRM-15。为应对近身混战与防御，该变型还在左臂装有一具连发SRM-6发射器，每只手臂各有一具增程中型激光。为了从容承载这些武器，其机身采用钢内骨结构。特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Terran Hegemony's Royal Division's variant of the ON1-K, the ON1-Kb upgrades the base design with a better heat sink kit. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是地球霸权皇家师的ON1-K变型，ON1-Kb以更好的散热器套件升级了基础设计。特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Eager to test the brand new LB 2-X autocannon prototypes, the Orion ON1-K had its AC/10 replaced with two of the Clan Early LB-X. Using the fact that Clan Early missile launchers are considerably lighter, it was also possible to upgrade them to an Improved SRM-6 and an Improved LRM-20 - with two tons of ammunition each. Even then, enough capacity remained to add two more heat sinks. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 为急于测试全新的LB 2-X自动炮原型，猎户座ON1-K的AC/10被换成两门部族早期LB-X。利用部族早期导弹发射器重量大幅减轻这一点，它还得以把导弹升级为改进型SRM-6和改进型LRM-20——各配两吨弹药。即便这样，仍余下足够容量加装两个散热器。特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: When the Star League Defense Force left the Inner Sphere under Commanding General Aleksandr Kerensky during Operation Exodus, they brought with them many of the most common 'Mechs. As the SLDF-in-exile slowly started turning into the Clans, they started developing improved weapons, which they mounted on their existing armies of 'Mech. These weapons are commonly called Early Clan, and as such the Mech's using them got the -EC suffix added to their designation.
column2: 当星盟防卫部队在统帅亚历山大·克伦斯基率领下执行出走行动、离开内天体时，他们带走了许多最常见的机甲。随着流亡的SLDF逐渐演变成氏族，他们开始研发改进型武器，并装到现有的机甲部队上。这些武器通常被称为"早期氏族"武器，因此使用它们的机甲在型号后缀加上了-EC。ZH

column1: This Orion was used by the commanding general Aleksandr Kerensky himself in the war against the Usurper. This mech carries an experimental snub nose PPC. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这台猎户座曾在对抗篡位者的战争中被指挥官亚历山大·克伦斯基亲自使用。该机甲装备一门实验性的短管粒子加农炮。特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column2: 命令与征服

column1: This Orion was used by the commanding general Aleksandr Kerensky himself in the war against the Usurper. This mech carries an experimental snub nose PPC.
column2: 这是指挥官亚历山大·克伦斯基本人在对抗篡位者战争中所用的猎户座。这台机甲装有一门实验型短鼻粒子加农炮。ZH

column1: This Orion was inspired by the original customized Orion used by the commanding general Aleksandr Kerensky in the war against the Usurper. It was further upgraded with advanced components such as Endo Composite structure and a Command Console cockpit. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这台猎户座灵感来自指挥官亚历山大·克伦斯基在对抗篡位者战争中所用的原始定制猎户座。它进一步升级了钢内骨复合结构与指挥控制台驾驶舱等先进部件。特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: This Orion was inspired by the original customized Orion used by the commanding general Aleksandr Kerensky in the war against the Usurper. It was further upgraded with advanced components such as Endo Composite structure and a Command Console cockpit.
column2: 这台猎户座的灵感来自亚历山德尔·克伦斯基统帅在对篡位者战争中使用的原始定制猎户座。它进一步以先进组件升级，例如内层复合结构和指挥控制台式驾驶舱。ZH

column1: A battlefield refit of the ON1-K, replacing the SRM-4 with a Small Laser. This leaves enough room to add an Artemis IV FCS for the LRM launcher, C.A.S.E. protection for the ammunition, as well as a C3 Slave computer. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是ON1-K的野战改装，以一具小型激光取代SRM-4。这样便腾出足够空间为LRM发射器加装阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统、为弹药加装C.A.S.E.防护，以及一台C3从机计算机。特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A minor variant of the ON1-M introduced in 3058. The designers removed both missile racks and Narc launcher to make room for two Medium Range Missile launchers. In place of the LRM-20 is an MRM-20, while a larger MRM-30 is crammed in the torso where the SRM-4 formerly sat. Enough room is left to add a head-mounted C3 Slave Unit. This variant was much-used by the Draconis Combine. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是3058年推出的ON1-M的小变型。设计者拆掉两组导弹挂架和Narc发射器，为两具中程导弹发射器腾出空间：LRM-20的位置换成MRM-20，而更大的MRM-30则塞进原来SRM-4所在的躯干。剩下的空间足以加装一台头部C3从机。此变型被龙脉联合体大量使用。特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Introduced in 3053, this 1-M sub-variant trades one ton each of SRM and Narc ammunition plus one double heat sink for a Command Console. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 于 3053 年推出的这款 1-M 子改型，用一吨 SRM 弹药、一吨纳克弹药和一台双散热器换取了一座指挥控制台。特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: Based on General Kerensky's custom variant, the 'Protector' carries an almost identical weapons loadout. The most notable difference is its use of a standard PPC in the place of the still-lostech snub-nosed version, dropping the CASE and volume of ferro-fibrous armor carried to free up the weight for the heavier weapon. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: “保护者”以克伦斯基将军的定制变型为基础，武器配置几乎完全相同。最显著的差异是它用标准粒子加农炮取代了仍属失落科技的短鼻版本，并拆掉CASE和部分铁纤维装甲，以腾出重量容纳更重的武器。特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Based on General Kerensky's custom variant, the 'Protector' carries an almost identical weapons loadout. The most notable difference is its use of a standard PPC in the place of the still-lostech snub-nosed version, dropping the CASE and volume of ferro-fibrous armor carried to free up the weight for the heavier weapon.
column2: “保护者”以克伦斯基将军的定制变型为基础，武器配置几乎完全相同。最显著的差异是它用标准粒子加农炮取代了仍属失落科技的短鼻版本，并拆掉CASE和部分铁纤维装甲，以腾出重量容纳更重的武器。ZH

column1: Piloted by Aditi Whidbey, a MechWarrior who had been driven to madness by a cult known as the Will of Kali, she claimed that the Orion had fallen out of the sky and styled it 'Yad al-Jauza' or 'Hand of Orion'. The 'Yad al-Jauza' is built upon a XL engine. A large laser is mounted in each arm, with the right arm additionally mounting a LRM-10; two LRM-10s are mounted in the left torso, along with another large laser. Fifteen double heatsinks keep the 'Mech cold. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 驾驶者 Aditi Whidbey 是一名被名为“迦梨之意志”的邪教逼疯的机甲战士，她声称这具 Orion 是从天上坠落下来的，并将其命名为“Yad al-Jauza”，意为“猎户座之手”。“Yad al-Jauza”以一台 XL 引擎为基础建造。每只手臂各装有一具大型激光，右臂还额外搭载一具 LRM-10；左躯干装有两具 LRM-10，以及另一具大型激光。十五具双散热器让这具机甲保持低温。特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: The original SLDF model created in 2738, the Osprey OSP-15 mounted the same M-7 Gauss Rifle as the modern models, but had an LRM-10 Launcher backed up by three Medium Lasers in place of the MML and ER Medium Lasers. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是2738年制造的原始SLDF型号，鱼鹰OSP-15装与现代型号相同的M-7高斯步枪，但以一门LRM-10发射器和三门中型激光取代了MML与增程中型激光。特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The original SLDF model created in 2738, the Osprey OSP-15 mounted the same M-7 Gauss Rifle as the modern models, but had an LRM-10 Launcher backed up by three Medium Lasers in place of the MML and ER Medium Lasers.
column2: 最初的SLDF型号造于2738年，鱼鹰OSP-15装的是与现代型号相同的M-7高斯步枪，但用一具LRM-10发射器配三门中型激光器，取代了MML和增程中型激光器。ZH

column1: When Ostmann Industries first tried creating a heavier 'Mech than the Ostwar it resulted in the OstLord. It used much of the same components as the Ostwar but with size increased as needed. This 80 ton prototype assault 'Mech carried double LRM15 launchers, a Large Laser and two Medium Lasers and used a 320 rating fusion core. However, the design never went past prototype stage as it showed severe reliability problems during its trials and Ostmann Industries sold the few prototypes created on the second hand market before shutting the project down. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12
column2: 当Ostmann工业公司首次尝试打造一款比Ostwar更重的机甲时，结果便是OstLord。它沿用了Ostwar的大部分部件，只是按需放大了尺寸。这台80吨的原型突击机甲装备两具LRM15发射器、一门大型激光和两门中型激光，并采用额定320的聚变核心。然而，该设计在试车中暴露出严重的可靠性问题，始终未能走出原型阶段；Ostmann工业公司将仅有的几台原型机转手到二手市场，随后终止了该项目。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.12

column1: This is just an oversized Ostwar, Boss. And a damn bad job at one, I could assemble a better one myself!
column2: 这不过是一台加大号的奥斯特瓦，老大。而且是糟糕透顶的一台，我自己都能装出更好的！ZH

column1: The Ostroc Mk II swaps the SRM-4 for one SRM-2 launcher in each side torso, with one ton of ammunition in the center torso. Half a ton of armor was added to the front torso and legs (adding one point to each leg and side torso, and four to center torso), and four more heat sinks were installed along with three jump jets for a jump capacity of 90 meters. To make room for these components, the engine had to be changed to a Pitban 240, reducing the top speed to 64.8 km/h. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 奥斯特罗克Mk II以两侧躯干各一具SRM-2发射器取代SRM-4，中央躯干带一吨弹药。前躯干与腿部增加半吨装甲（每条腿与每侧躯干各加一点，中央躯干加四点），并加装四个散热器和三具跳跃推进器，跳跃能力达90米。为给这些部件腾出空间，引擎不得不换成皮特班240，最高速度降到64.8公里/小时。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Ostroc Mk II
column2: 奥斯特洛克 Mk II

column1: This 'Mech might as well be considered a new, different design from the old Ostroc. Just like the Grand Dragon evolved from the Dragon, the Mauler from the Daboku or the Hatamoto-Chi from the Charger.
column2: 这台机甲简直该被视作与旧奥斯罗克完全不同的新设计。就像巨龙从龙演化而来、猛击者从打木而来，或旗本千从冲锋者而来一样。ZH

column1: Piloted by Michi Noketsuna in the fighting on Misery against Wolf's Dragoons in 3028, this customized Ostroc had a top speed of 64 km/h. The reduced engine size allowed the Ostroc Michi to jump 120 meters and replace the SRM-4 with an SRM-6 launcher. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 3028年在米泽里星对抗狼之龙骑兵的战斗中，这台定制奥斯特罗克由米奇·诺克茨纳驾驶，最高时速可达64 km/h。引擎功率的缩减让米奇型奥斯特罗克能跳跃120米，并以一具SRM-6发射器取代了原来的SRM-4。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.08

column1: Piloted by Michi Noketsuna in the fighting on Misery against Wolf's Dragoons in 3028, this customized Ostroc had a top speed of 64 km/h. The reduced engine size allowed the Ostroc Michi to jump 120 meters and replace the SRM-4 with an SRM-6 launcher.
column2: 由道口道纲在3028年米泽里对抗狼之龙骑兵的战斗中驾驶，这台定制奥斯特索最高速度64公里/小时。引擎缩小使奥斯特索道口得以跳跃120米，并以一具SRM-6发射器取代SRM-4。ZH

column1: A variant of the Ostroc OSR-2C adding a C3 slave unit and replacing the single heat sink with doubles. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 这是奥斯特罗克OSR-2C的变型，加装了1台C3从属单元，并将单散热器更换为双散热器。<特性：狭小/低矮外形 <投放费用倍率：1.08

column1: A variant of the Ostroc OSR-2C adding a C3 slave unit for better lance performance.
column2: 这是奥斯特罗克OSR-2C的变型，加装一台C3从机以提升小队表现。ZH

column1: The custom 'Mech of Major Kira Tang, the Ostroc OSR-2X, is a full rebuild of the original mech. Sporting 4 Medium Pulse Lasers, 2 Small Lasers, a NARC and a supercharged 360 XL fusion engine, this 'Mech is in fact a lot deadlier than it seems at first glance. Using Endo-Steel structure and Ferro-Fibrous armor still leaves room for a MASC and both a Beagle Active Probe and a Guardian ECM Suite. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 奥斯特罗克OSR-2X是基拉·唐少校的专属机甲，是对原版机体的彻底重建。它配备4门中型脉冲激光、2门小型激光、一具NARC以及一台增压的360 XL聚变引擎，实际上比乍看之下要致命得多。采用钢内骨结构与铁纤维装甲之后，仍有空间容纳MASC、一套小猎犬主动探测器以及一套守护者电子对抗套件。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: To say that Ostroc OSR-2X is a custom machine would be something of an understatement. Taking the 'Mech’s pilot, Command Sergeant Major Kira Tang's orders to \"make a 'Mech that people would remember\" to the limit, the technicians and researchers truly pushed the envelope of 'Mech capabilities.
column2: 说奥斯罗克OSR-2X是一台定制机，都算是相当保守的说法。技师与研究员们把该机甲机师、军士长基拉·唐"造一台让人铭记的机甲"的命令执行到了极限，真正把机甲性能的边界推到了极致。ZH

column1: The Ostscout was designed as a pure recon BattleMech by Ostmann Industries. To that end, it was built entirely around gathering data and getting out of trouble, tasks for which it is exceptional; the Ostscout is quick enough to escape most traps, and very few other designs can match it in terms of speed and maneuverability. The 7R is a variant of the OTT-7J that replaces two of the Jump Jets with a C3 slave unit and some extra armor. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: Ostscout是Ostmann工业公司设计的纯侦察战斗机甲。为此，它的全部设计都围绕收集情报与摆脱困境展开，而它在这两项任务上表现卓越；Ostscout的速度足以逃脱大多数陷阱，在速度与机动性方面很少有其他设计能与之匹敌。7R是OTT-7J的变型，用一台C3从属单元和额外的装甲替换了两台跳跃推进器。特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：0.98

column1: This 'Mech is quick as hell, but the Ostscout would be hard-pressed to win a fight against all but the lightest of opposition.
column2: 这台机甲快得要命，但东探除了对付最轻的对手，很难赢下任何战斗。ZH

column1: The Ostsol OTL-4DR was an attempt by Ostmann Industries to create a version of the 'Mech that could be built faster and handled hot environments better. Replacing all weapons with a pair of ER PPCs, switching to Double Heat Sinks and adding a C3 Slave unit did not meet the goals and the variant was never built in any larger volumes. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Ostsol OTL-4DR是Ostmann Industries的一次尝试，意在打造一台能更快建造、也更能适应高温环境的机甲版本。它的做法是以两门增程粒子加农炮替换全部武器、改用双散热器并加装一个C3从属单元，但这些并未达到既定目标，该改型也从未进行过任何大规模生产。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Why would they do this...? It makes no sense, this one's practically useless with just the PPCs. At least it can be used for spare parts, I suppose.
column2: 他们为什么要这么做……？完全说不通，这台只有粒子加农炮的话几乎没用。至少还能当备件用，我想。ZH

column1: A refresh of the Ostwar OWR-2M, the OWR-2MX replaces the LRM and Medium Lasers with an upgrade to double SRM6 launchers and 3 Extended Range Large Lasers. Using an XL engine and Endo Steel structure allows the switch to Double Heat Sinks for better cooling performance as well as an upgrade to a 325-rated fusion core. One large oddity is the fact the SRM6 launchers are in the legs, leading a strange angle of launching that can surprise enemy Mech Warriors. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是对奥斯特瓦ORW-2M的翻新，OWR-2MX以双联SRM6发射器和3门增程大型激光取代LRM和中型激光。采用XL引擎与钢内骨结构后，它得以换装双散热器以改善冷却，并升级为325额定聚变核心。特别古怪的一点是SRM6发射器装在腿部，形成奇特的发射角度，足以让敌方机甲战士措手不及。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A refresh of the Ostwar OWR-2M, the OWR-2MX replaces the LRM and Medium Lasers with an upgrade to double SRM6 launchers and 3 Extended Range Large Lasers. Using an XL engine and Endo Steel structure allows the switch to Double Heat Sinks for better cooling performance as well as an upgrade to a 325-rated fusion core. One large oddity is the fact the SRM6 launchers are in the legs, leading a strange angle of launching that can surprise enemy Mech Warriors.
column2: 作为奥斯特瓦OWR-2M的更新版，OWR-2MX把LRM和中型激光器换成升级后的双SRM6发射器与3门增程大型激光器。采用XL引擎和内层钢结构使其得以改用双重散热器以获得更好的散热性能，并将聚变核心升级到325级。一个很大的怪处在于SRM6发射器装在腿部，导致一种奇怪的发射角度，能打敌方机师一个措手不及。ZH

column1: The Jenner Hero 'Mech, the Oxide mounts an SRM-4 in each arm supported by a pair of LRM-5s in the center torso. Fitted with ten double heat sinks and carrying a ton of reloads for each missile launcher, such a heavy weapons loadout is made possible through the use of Endo Steel chassis, a downgrade to a 235-rated engine and the removal of Jenner's signature jump jets. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 詹纳（Jenner）英雄机甲“氧化物”（Oxide）在每条手臂各装有一具 SRM-4，并由中央躯干的两具 LRM-5 提供支援。它装有十台双散热器，并为每具导弹发射器各配备一吨备用弹药；如此沉重的武器配置之所以能够实现，靠的是钢内骨结构底盘的使用、引擎降级为额定 235 型号，以及拆除詹纳标志性的跳跃推进器。特性：改进生命维持系统 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The Jenner Hero 'Mech, the Oxide mounts an SRM-4 in each arm supported by a pair of LRM-5s in the center torso. Fitted with ten double heat sinks and carrying a ton of reloads for each missile launcher, such a heavy weapons loadout is made possible through the use of Endo Steel chassis, a downgrade to a 235-rated engine and the removal of Jenner's signature jump jets.
column2: 作为詹纳英雄机甲，氧化在双臂各装一具SRM-4，并有两具LRM-5置于中央躯干支援。它装有十具双重散热器，每个导弹发射器各带一吨备用弹；如此沉重的武器配置之所以可行，得益于内层钢底盘、降级为235级引擎以及拆除詹纳标志性的跳跃推进器。

column1: The Pack Hunter is the first new design produced by Clan Wolf-in-Exile on Arc-Royal. It also represents a new partnership between Phelan's Wolves and the Kell Hounds, as the armor and communications gear are Kell Hound products, traded to the Wolves in exchange for Endo Steel. Reflecting their Khan's bias towards light, fast designs, Wolf scientists designed the Pack Hunter to be fast and have a sharp bite. Though its four tons of armor are light, the BattleMech is supposed to use its speed and maneuverability to stay out of trouble. Quirk: Reinforced Legs Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 集群猎手是狼族流亡者在弧王家研制出的首款新设计。它也代表着费伦之狼与凯尔猎犬的新伙伴关系：装甲与通讯设备是凯尔猎犬的产品，用来与狼族交换钢内骨结构。出于其可汗对轻型、快速设计的偏好，狼族科学家把集群猎手设计得又快又利。虽然四吨装甲偏薄，但该战斗机甲本应靠速度与机动性避开麻烦。特性：加固腿部 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: Pack Hunter
column2: 猎群者

column1: The original Paladin features seven Machine Guns and a single Large Pulse Laser providing long range firepower, and the Machine Guns are backed up by an Artemis IV-equipped SRM-6 and a pair of Streak SRM-2 missile launchers. It features a standard engine, standard ferro-fibrous armor and an Endo Steel chassis. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Right Lower, Left Upper
column2: 初代 Paladin 拥有七挺机枪，以及一门提供远程火力的大型脉冲激光；机枪的后盾则是一部配备阿尔忒弥斯 IV 的 SRM-6 和两具连发 SRM-2 导弹发射器。它采用标准引擎、标准铁纤维装甲和钢内骨结构底盘。特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：右下、左上

column1: A Solaris VII BattleMech, the Paladin was created by Innovative Design Concepts as their entry into the heavy 'Mech weight class. Equipped with an XXL fusion engine, the modern Paladin can move through the battlefield quickly and keep enemy forces in the ideal range band.
column2: 作为一台索拉里斯VII战斗机甲，圣骑士由创新设计理念公司打造，是他们进军重型机甲重量级的作品。它装备XXL聚变引擎，现代化的圣骑士能快速穿行战场，并让敌军停留在理想的距离区间内。ZH

column1: An early draft for an upgraded Panther by the Draconis Combine. Only a few units were ever produced and ended up in the hands of various mercenary units despite its too high maintenance cost for House Kurita. Utilizing an XL engine and Endo Steel allows mounting three Streak SRM-2 launchers, one ER PPC, one medium laser and 5 Jump Jets. The cooling is handled by double heat sinks and a C3 slave unit is installed for better battlefield awareness. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 这是龙脉联合体为升级版Panther绘制的早期草案。由于对栗田家族而言维护成本过高，最终只生产了少数几台，并流落到多支雇佣兵部队手中。借助XL引擎与钢内骨结构，它得以安装三具连发SRM-2发射器、一门增程粒子加农炮、一门中型激光和5台跳跃推进器。散热由双散热器负责，并安装了C3从属单元以提升战场态势感知。特性：空降突击 投放费用倍率：0.98

column1: Sure, it has some good weapons, but the cooling is just not sufficient for all those weapons and 5 jump jets. Good heat management is a must for any MechWarrior piloting this one.
column2: 当然，它有一些好武器，但散热对那些武器和5个跳跃推进器来说根本不够。良好的热量管理对驾驶这台机甲的机师来说必不可少。ZH

column1: Custom variant used by the mercenary unit 'Kell Hounds', one of the most renowned in the Inner Sphere. Most of the standard equipment has been replaced by Clan tech, resulting in a considerably better performing light 'Mech. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 这是雇佣兵部队“凯尔猎犬”——内层星域最负盛名的部队之一——所使用的定制变型。大部分标准装备都被部族技术取代，使这台轻型机甲的性能显著提升。特性：空中突击 投放费用倍率：1.04

column1: A Stream SRM-6 and an ER PPC is not really a bad weaponry for such a small 'Mech, but it doesn't suddenly make it good.
column2: 一具连发SRM-6和一门增程PPC对这么小的机甲来说不算糟糕的武器，但这并不会让它突然变好。ZH

column1: An early attempted design of the Panther by Draconis Combine, using a SRM-4 launcher and a Large Laser. Was never produced in large quantities. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 这是龙脉联合体早期对黑豹的尝试设计，使用一具SRM-4发射器和一门大型激光，从未大量生产。特性：空中突击 投放费用倍率：0.98

column1: Pretty much close to the same thing as a Panther PNT-9R if you compare the actual performance.
column2: 如果比较实际性能，它和黑豹PNT-9R几乎差不多。ZH

column1: The personal 'Mech of Hohiro 'T-Bone' Tanaka, a Solaris Arena Pilot and member of the 'Mavericks'. His Panther has been modified for use in the close confines of the dueling arena. The PPC was removed from the right arm, and a large laser, medium laser, and one heat sink were installed. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: 这是 Solaris 竞技场机师、'Mavericks' 成员 Hohiro 'T-Bone' Tanaka 的专属机甲。他的 Panther 经过改装，以适应决斗竞技场狭窄的场地。右臂的粒子加农炮被拆除，改为安装一门大型激光、一门中型激光和一具散热器。特性：空中突击 投放费用倍率：1.02

column1: Skirmisher & Light Brawler
column2: 散兵与轻型斗士

column1: Tanaka apparently had success with this custom refit in the Solaris Arena as a close-range Skirmisher. He and his other teammate, Jason 'Equalizer' Yasbek were considered a favored 'Unlimited Class' team in the dueling arenas of Solaris City.
column2: 田中显然在索拉里斯竞技场靠这套定制改装作为近距游击手取得了成功。他和他另一位队友、"平衡器"杰森·亚斯贝克，在索拉里斯城的决斗竞技场中被视为"无限制级"的夺冠热门队伍。ZH

column1: The -9RR is a refit of the -9R that by switching to double Heat Sinks allow the addition of a medium and a small laser, while still improving the cooling. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: -9RR是-9R的改装型，通过换装双散热器，得以加装一门中型激光和一门小型激光，同时散热能力反而有所改善。特性：空降突击 投放费用倍率：0.98

column1: So it is a slightly better -9R. Nothing to write home to grandma about, still a weak 'Mech I'd say.
column2: 所以它是一台略好的-9R。没什么值得写信告诉奶奶的，我还是会说它是台弱机甲。ZH

column1: The Penetrator PTR-4D has an all energy weapons arsenal and uses twelve double heat sinks to handle the massive heat load from its weapons. The 'Mech uses a Vlar 300 fusion engine for its combat durability, giving the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. To help offset the 'Mech's lack of mobility, the Penetrator has four Anderson 398 jump jets giving it added mobility with a jumping distance of one hundred and twenty meters. The Penetrator also carries a respectable thirteen tons of armor. The 'Mech's heavy armor protection, combined with its standard engine and limited amounts of ammunition, make for a 'Mech that is very rugged and hard to kill. The primary weapons are a pair of arm mounted Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Lasers for long range firepower. For close range combat, the 'Mech carries six Sutel Precision Line Medium Pulse Lasers which are mounted in its right and left torsos. Finally, the 'Mech carries its only ammunition based weapon, a Yori Flyswatter Anti-Missile System, for added defense against missile attacks. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 穿透者PTR-4D采用全能量武器，并使用十二个双散热器处理武器带来的巨大热负荷。该机甲采用弗拉尔300聚变引擎以保证战斗耐久性，最高速度64.8公里/小时。为弥补机动性不足，穿透者装四具安德森398跳跃推进器，跳跃距离一百二十米。它还带可观的十三吨装甲。厚重的装甲防护、标准引擎与有限的弹药量，使该机甲极为坚固、难以击杀。主要武器是装在双臂的一对Diverse Optics日束增程大型激光，负责远程火力；混战中，它带六门苏特尔精密线中型脉冲激光，装在左右躯干。最后，该机甲唯一的弹药类武器是一套尤里苍蝇拍反导弹系统，用于加强对导弹攻击的防御。特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Skirmisher & Heavy Flanker
column2: 散兵与重型侧翼

column1: This is the base model of the Penetrator, Boss. It is not a bad mech for its purpose and when it was designed, but it lacks anything special to make it stand out over newer designs. The all Laser load out can be both a strength and a weakness depending on the opposing forces composition and the biome the battle is in. Over all, not a 'Mech I'd keep around in the long run but might have its uses short-term.
column2: 这是穿透者的基础型号，老大。就其用途和设计年代而言它不算坏机甲，但它缺乏任何能让它在更新设计面前脱颖而出的特别之处。全激光载荷既可以是优势也可以是弱点，取决于对手部队构成和战斗所在的生物群系。总的来说，不是我会长期保留的机甲，但短期内也许有它的用处。ZH

column1: The Penetrator became the trademark 'Mech of AFFC officer Archer Christifori, who piloted one through the FedCom Civil War and Operation BULLDOG. Originally a stock example, Christifori's 'Mech was eventually upgraded with salvaged Clan-tech ER Large Lasers. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 穿透者成为AFFC军官阿彻·克里斯蒂福里的标志性机甲，他在联邦共和国内战与“斗牛犬行动”期间一直驾驶这台机甲。它原本是标准型号，后来克里斯蒂福里的机甲用回收来的部族技术增程大型激光进行了升级。特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A typical field upgrade with capture tech, it improves the mech slightly but that is about it. Nothing special here.
column2: 这是一次典型的带缴获技术的野战升级，它略微提升了机甲，差不多就这样。没什么特别的。ZH

column1: Intended to act as a fire support 'Mech, The PTR-4F Penetrator sacrifices two of its Medium Pulse Lasers and the ER Large Lasers, freeing enough tonnage to add two LRM-10 missile launchers. The LRM-10s were then mated to Artemis IV fire control systems for added accuracy. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: PTR-4F Penetrator 旨在充当火力支援机甲，它牺牲了两门中型脉冲激光和增程大型激光，腾出足够的吨位加装两具 LRM-10 导弹发射器。这两具 LRM-10 随后配上了 Artemis IV 火控系统以提高精度。特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: A base Penetrator with two LRM launchers instead of some lasers. That doesn't change the fact the 'Mech itself isn't very interesting, but at least it can act as a longe range support to better ones.
column2: 这是基础型穿透者，以两具LRM发射器取代部分激光。这并不能改变该机甲本身并不有趣的事实，但至少它能作为更优秀机甲的远程支援。ZH

column1: In an attempt to make the -4F more durable, the -4FX variant was a field modification of the Penetrator. Replacing the 4 Medium Pulse Lasers with 6 Medium Lasers allowed the addition of CASE in both side torsos, which after moving the Anti-Missile System ammunition from Center Torso to the Left Torso ensured any ammo explosion should not be able to penetrate the Center Torso. The 0.5 ton weight capacity still remaining was used to improve the armor of the legs and side torsos. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 为了让-4F更加耐用，-4FX变型是对Penetrator的一次野战改装。用6门中型激光替换4门中型脉冲激光，从而能够在两个侧躯干加装CASE；而在将反导弹系统弹药从中央躯干移至左躯干之后，任何弹药爆炸都无法再穿透中央躯干。剩余的0.5吨载重则用于加强腿部和侧躯干的装甲。特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: No amount of changes will prevent some hothead pilot getting too close to the fray in this support 'Mech, but I guess at least they might survive long enough to shot another salvo.
column2: 再多的改动也无法阻止某个热血机师把这台支援机甲开得太靠混战团，不过我猜至少他们可能活得够久，能再打一轮齐射。ZH

column1: The 6M is a variant of the Penetrator that looks to alleviate the 'Mech's heat build up by removing two of the Medium Pulse Lasers and replacing them with five additional double heat sinks. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 6M是穿透者的变型，试图通过拆掉两门中型脉冲激光并换成五个额外双散热器来缓解机甲的热量积累。特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A needed improvement to the cooling of the Penetrator, but the trade-off of less firepower makes the mech considerable worse as a frontline brawler.
column2: 这是穿透者散热的一次必要改进，但火力的减少使其作为前线混战者明显变差。ZH

column1: A simple modification of the Penetrator, the 6S model removes one and a half tons of armor. This frees enough weight to add a Guardian ECM Suite to the 'Mech, protecting the 'Mech from foes' advanced electronics. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 6S 型号是对 Penetrator 的简单改动，拆除了一吨半装甲。这腾出了足够的重量为该机甲加装一具守卫者电子对抗套件，使其免受敌方先进电子设备的威胁。特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: Not sure this was a wise move, Boss. All it takes is one ECCM and that ECM is useless and suddenly the removed 1.5 ton of armor will be very missed.
column2: 我不确定这是个明智的举动，老大。只要来一个ECCM，那套ECM就废了，而那时被拆掉的那1.5吨装甲就会让人非常怀念。ZH

column1: The Perseus is the product of a program begun by the League Central Coordination and Command to create an OmniMech completely indigenous to the Free Worlds League from concept to production. The Perseus shares much with the venerable Orion, a staple of Free Worlds League Military, both broadly resembling the older design visually and using a number of the same components. This similarity prompted more than a few FWLM technicians to nickname the new design the Omni-Orion and the deployment of Perseus has largely been to front-line units that fielded large concentrations of its progenitor, replacing older Orions on a one-for-one basis. Built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis, the Perseus is powered by a Hermes 300 XL engine helping save even more weight and giving the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The advanced structure and engine save a great deal of weight for weapons and equipment. The Perseus is protected by fourteen tons of Valiant Lamellor armor, giving it around average armor protection for a 'Mech of its size. It also has twelve double heat sinks that are fixed on the chassis. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 英仙座是联盟中央协调与指挥部发起的一项计划的产物，旨在从概念到生产打造一款完全属于自由世界联盟的全能机甲。英仙座与备受尊崇的猎户座共享诸多特征——后者是自由世界联盟军队的中坚，两者在外观上大体相似，并使用若干相同部件。这种相似性让不少 FWLM 技师把新设计戏称为"全能猎户座"；英仙座的部署主要给那些大量装备其前身的一线部队，一对一替换较老的猎户座。英仙座基于轻量化内骨骼底盘建造，由一台赫尔墨斯 300 XL 引擎驱动，进一步节省重量，最高速度 64.8 公里/小时。先进的底盘与引擎为武器和装备省下大量重量。英仙座由十四吨"勇武拉梅洛"装甲保护，防护约处于同尺寸机甲的平均水平。它还固定装有十二台双倍散热器。特质：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.06 臂部驱动器限制：全能

column1: Developed for the Star League Defense Force Royal Divisions in 2692, this variant of the Phoenix Hawk LAM used four Medium Lasers and a single ER Large Laser as its main firepower. Twelve double heat sinks kept the heat curve low, but the limited fuel, armor, and maneuverability made the Phoenix Hawk LAM easy prey for AeroSpace Fighters of the same weight. It could maneuver fast enough to evade heavier foes however Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
column2: 这是2692年为星际联盟国防军皇家师研制的凤凰鹰LAM变型，以四门中型激光和一门单独的增程大型激光作为主要火力。十二个双散热器让热量曲线保持低位，但有限的燃料、装甲与机动性使凤凰鹰LAM容易成为同重量航空航天战斗机的猎物；不过它机动得足以躲开更重的对手。特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.06

column1: This version was created before the introduction of the PHX-HK2, in 2695. It removed the ER Large Laser, a Medium Laser, and two heat sinks, replacing them with an experimental Snub-Nose PPC, Beagle Active Probe, and an additional half ton of armor. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
column2: 此版本在2695年PHX-HK2推出之前就已造出。它拆掉增程大型激光、一门中型激光和两个散热器，换成一门实验型短鼻粒子加农炮、一台比格犬主动探测器和额外半吨装甲。特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.06

column1: The Phoenix Hawk LAM was the largest Land-Air 'Mech produced during the Star League. Allied Aerospace reworked their designs for conversion equipment and the size of the LAM, learning from their mistake with the Shadow Hawk LAM and the success of the Stinger LAM. The resulting LAM was the largest LAM ever constructed capable of remaining in AirMech mode. Unfortunately, large Land-Air 'Mech conversion technology was not fully researched before the fall of the Star League, and the Phoenix Hawk LAM frequently met its end due to the occasional glitch. The end of the Star League and destruction of the Allied Aerospace facilities at the beginning of the First Succession War prevented further development and refinement. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: Phoenix Hawk LAM 是星际联盟时期生产的最大型陆空机甲。Allied Aerospace 借鉴了 Shadow Hawk LAM 的失败教训与 Stinger LAM 的成功经验，重新设计了变形设备以及 LAM 的尺寸。由此诞生的 LAM 是有史以来建造的、能够在空中机甲形态下维持飞行的最大型陆空机甲。遗憾的是，大型陆空机甲的变形技术在星际联盟覆灭前尚未被充分研究，Phoenix Hawk LAM 常常因偶发的故障而折戟。星际联盟的终结，以及第一次继承战争初期 Allied Aerospace 设施的毁灭，使进一步的研发与改进无从进行。特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.04

column1: House Marik produced a variant of the Phoenix Hawk LAM which replaces the Large Laser and Machine Guns with a Holly LRM-10. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 马里克家族生产了一款凤凰鹰LAM变型，以一门霍利LRM-10取代大型激光和机枪。特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.04

column1: The original Pillager, designed in 2575 and fielded for the first two decades of the Reunification War, uses a standard fusion engine instead of the extralight model that later went into production. Other limitations include a 60 meter jump range and 17 tons of armor. The weapons suite was also different, relying on twin torso mounted Autocannon/20s, a single SRM-4, and three medium lasers; one mounted in each arm and a head-mounted laser firing to the rear. Sixteen single heat sinks kept the heat under control. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 最初的Pillager设计于2575年，在统一战争的头二十年里投入使用，它采用标准聚变引擎，而非后来投产的超轻型型号。其他限制还包括60米的跳跃距离与17吨装甲。武器配置也有所不同，主要依靠躯干上的一对自动炮/20、一具SRM-4以及三门中型激光；其中每只手臂各装一门，另有一门装在头部朝后射击。十六具单散热器把热量控制在范围内。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.18

column2: 破门与近距突击

column1: The largest BattleMech ever built by HildCo Interplanetary, the Pillager is built as a larger version of the Victor, and is intended for assaulting urban centers and hardened fortifications. These design parameters were paramount as the SLDF mobilized to wage the Reunification War. Later Pillagers were upgraded with more cutting-edge Star League technology. Production of the Pillager halted not because its facility was destroyed, but the advanced Gauss rifle and XL engine production lines had been obliterated by the end of the Second Succession War. Curiously, HildCo did not restart production of the original PLG-1N, rather the Pillager lines only began production again in 3058 when advanced components were once again available for the PLG-3Z.
column2: 劫掠者是HildCo星际行星公司建造过的最大战斗机甲，作为维克托的放大版本打造，用于攻打城市中心与坚固工事。在SLDF动员发动统一战争时，这些设计指标被置于首位。后来的劫掠者以更尖端的星际联盟技术进行了升级。劫掠者停产并非因为工厂被毁，而是到第二次继承战争结束时，先进的高斯步枪与XL引擎生产线已被彻底摧毁。耐人寻味的是，HildCo并未重新生产最初的PLG-1N，而是直到3058年先进部件再次可供PLG-3Z使用时，劫掠者的生产线才重新开工。ZH

column1: The PLG-3Z Pillager is built using a 300 XL engine, which weighs half as much as a standard fusion engine and gives the Pillager a top speed of 54 km/h. The small mass of the engine allows the 'Mech to mount an obscene array of weapons. The 'Mech's mobility is enhanced with three jump jets that allow it to jump up to ninety meters. The Pillager has excellent armor protection at nineteen and a half tons and has fourteen double heat sinks that provide more than enough heat dissipation capability for the Pillager's needs. The primary weapons on the Pillager are a pair of Gauss rifles, which allows the 'Mech' to engage an enemy at very long ranges. The Gauss rifles were supported at intermediate to close range by a Large laser and four Medium lasers. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: PLG-3Z Pillager采用一具300 XL引擎建造，其重量只有标准聚变引擎的一半，使Pillager的最高时速达到54 km/h。引擎体积小巧，让这台机甲得以装载一套夸张的武器阵列。机甲的机动性由三具跳跃推进器增强，最远可跳跃九十米。Pillager拥有十九吨半的出色装甲防护，并配备十四具双散热器，散热能力远超其所需。Pillager的主要武器是两具高斯步枪，使这台机甲能够在极远距离上与敌人交战。在中近距离，高斯步枪则由一门大型激光与四门中型激光提供支援。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.18

column1: An early clan Mech dating from the days of Operation Klondike, the Pillager PLG-3Z-EC was an upgrade of the PLG-3Z that replaced the weapons with Early Clan variants. It would be discontinued and forgotten as modern clan spec weapons entered production. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 掠夺者PLG-3Z-EC是一款可追溯到克朗代克行动时期的部族早期机甲，是对PLG-3Z的升级，以部族早期型号替换了武器。随着现代部族规格武器投产，它被停产并逐渐被遗忘。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.18

column1: An early clan Mech dating from the days of Operation Klondike, the Pillager PLG-3Z-EC was an upgrade of the PLG-3Z that replaced the weapons with Early Clan variants. It would be discontinued and forgotten as modern clan spec weapons entered production.
column2: 作为可追溯到克朗代克行动时期的一种早期氏族机甲，掠夺者PLG-3Z-EC是PLG-3Z的升级版，把武器换成了早期氏族变体。随着现代氏族规格武器投产，它被停产并逐渐被遗忘。ZH

column1: The Piranha's main threat is its twelve Series XII Rotary Machine Guns. These are a serious threat to any foe on such a speedy 'Mech, especially if a Star of Piranhas operate in a pack, and such a large array allows the 'Mech to chew through an opponent's rear armor almost instantly. They are most deadly, however, to unarmored infantry, capable of wiping out an entire company in seconds. For work against hardened targets, the Piranha mounts a pair of Mk. 3 ER Medium Lasers and a single Series 1 ER Small Laser. Since the design only uses ten single heat sinks, the MechWarrior must still manage heat levels. The ammunition dependency of the Machine Guns ensure that Piranhas must stay close to supply lines, so most have been relegated to solahma or garrison roles. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
column2: 食人鱼的主要威胁来自它的十二挺 XII 系列旋转机枪。在如此高速的机甲上，这些武器对任何敌人都构成严重威胁，尤其是在一个“星”的食人鱼成群行动时；如此庞大的阵列让这台机甲几乎能瞬间撕开对手的后部装甲。然而，它们对无装甲步兵最为致命，几秒钟内就能消灭整整一个连。为对付坚固目标，食人鱼还装有两门 Mk. 3 增程中型激光和一门 1 系列增程小型激光。由于该设计只使用十个单散热器，机甲战士仍须管理热量水平。机枪对弹药的依赖使食人鱼必须靠近补给线，因此大多数已被降格到 solahma 或驻防任务。特性：改进瞄准 - 近程 投放费用倍率：1.01

column1: A 'Batchall' version of the Pouncer, seldom seen outside the Clan honor fights. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是投掷者的“战前叫阵”版本，在部族荣誉战之外极少见到。特性：空中突击 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Predator II 1 combines a large Gauss Rifle with four Medium Pulse Lasers, enabling a surprising amount of damage for what can fool the inexperienced MechWarrior as a simple 'Mech design. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 捕食者II 1将一支大型高斯步枪与四具中型脉冲激光结合在一起，能造成惊人的伤害——经验不足的机甲战士甚至会误以为这只是一款普通的机甲设计。特性：高级光学 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column2: 掠食者 II

column1: The Predator II slightly increases its tonnage compared to the original Predator, and switches the 'Mech's role more towards a longer range sniper.
column2: 掠夺者 II 相比原版掠夺者略增吨位，并把机甲角色更偏向远程狙击手。ZH

column1: The Predator II 2 replaces the gauss rifle of the original variant with a LB 10-X Autocannon and an extra Medium Pulse Laser. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 捕食者II 2将原型的高斯步枪替换为一门LB 10-X自动炮和一具额外中型脉冲激光。特性：高级光学 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: Roughly a third of the Predator's mass is consumed by two LB 10-X Autocannons. These have ample ammunition for most Clan Trials and usually stock both cluster and slug rounds. They are supported by a pair of ER Medium Lasers and paired ER Small Lasers. Not only can the lasers keep the symmetrical design in the fight after its autocannon ammunition runs out, they do not create a burden on the 'Mech's ability to control heat under normal circumstances. Ten double heat sinks is all the Predator needs to keep its heat in check. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 掠食者约三分之一的质量被两门LB 10-X自动炮占据。它们弹药充足，足以应付大多数部族试炼，通常同时装填集束弹与实心弹。两门增程中型激光和成对的增程小型激光为其提供支援。这些激光不仅能在自动炮弹药耗尽后让这套对称设计继续作战，在正常情况下也不会给机甲的热量控制能力造成负担。十个双散热器便是掠食者控制热量所需的全部。特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Predator is a second-line BattleMech that is the product of a cooperative venture between the various Clan Fire Mandrill Kindraa. It is protected by eleven and a half tons of armor and can move at a respectable speed for a heavy 'Mech. Useful as either a medium-range duelist or as a close-up skirmisher, it can use its autocannons to deal a strong punch, then follow up with cluster rounds that exploit holes in an enemy 'Mech's armor.
column2: 掠食者是二等战斗机甲，是火狒氏族各金德拉之间合作项目的产物。它由十一吨半装甲保护，对其重型机甲的身份而言速度相当可观。无论用作中距离决斗者还是近距离游击手都很有用，它可以用自动炮打出沉重一击，然后用集束弹去利用敌方机甲装甲上的破口。ZH

column1: Initially created as a ClanTech test bed by the AFFC, the Prometheus is more known for its legendary run in the Solaris 7 arenas. Stolen by the notorious Professor Burke Kale, the Prometheus was fitted with an illegal Direct Neural Interface and a Virtual Reality Piloting Pod; allowing the Professor to control the Mech as easily as if it were his own body. Powered by a 375-rated XL Engine and built around a clan made Endo Steel skeleton, the Prometheus had a top speed of 80km/h and nearly 12 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. The Prometheus's weapons were all ClanTech and consisted of an ER PPC and Large Pulse Laser paired with 2 LRM-15's. For close range combat, it mounted a Medium Pulse Laser, 2 SRM-6's and 6 Machine Guns. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Prometheus最初是AFFC打造的部族技术试验平台，但它更以在索拉里斯7竞技场上的传奇战绩闻名。它被臭名昭著的伯克·凯尔教授盗走，并装上了非法的直接神经接口与虚拟现实驾驶舱，让教授操控这台机甲如同支配自己的身体一般轻松。Prometheus由额定375的XL引擎驱动，采用部族制造的钢内骨结构，最高速度达80km/h，并披挂近12吨铁纤维装甲。其武器全部为部族技术，包括一门增程粒子加农炮、一门大型脉冲激光以及2具LRM-15。混战则装有一门中型脉冲激光、2具SRM-6和6挺机枪。特性：分散注意力 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下
