The Prometheus's weapons were all ClanTech and consisted of an ER PPC and Large Pulse Laser paired with 2 LRM-15's. For close range combat, it mounted a Medium Pulse Laser, 2 SRM-6's and 6 Machine Guns.
column2: 普罗米修斯最初是AFFC创立的氏族科技试验台，但它更以在索拉里斯7竞技场的传奇战绩闻名。它被臭名昭著的伯克·凯尔教授窃取后，装上了非法的直接神经接口和虚拟现实驾驶舱；让教授能像控制自己的身体一样轻松地操控机甲。普罗米修斯由一具375级XL引擎驱动，围绕氏族制造的内层钢骨架建造，最高速度80公里/小时，披挂近12吨铁纤装甲。普罗米修斯的武器全是氏族科技，包括一门增程PPC和一门大型脉冲激光器，配以2具LRM-15。近距离作战时，它装有一门中型脉冲激光器、2具SRM-6和6挺机枪。ZH

column1: Built for long-range firepower, the Pulverizer relied on a modified ER PPC and LRMs to strike at a distance, while ECM systems and large lasers discouraged enemy sensors and kept wary opponents at arm’s length. More than 15 tons of armor, CASE and a standard fusion engine made the Pulverizer extremely hard to kill compared to more sophisticated early Clan machines. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - PPC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: 粉碎者专为远距离火力而生，依靠一门改进型增程粒子加农炮与LRM在远处发起打击，同时以电子对抗套件和大型激光干扰敌方传感器，让心存戒备的对手不敢近身。超过15吨的装甲、CASE以及标准聚变引擎，使粉碎者相比早期部族那些更精密的机型极难被击毁。特性：精准武器（粒子加农炮） 投放费用倍率：1.14

column1: Built for long-range firepower, the Pulverizer relied on a modified ER PPC and LRMs to strike at a distance, while ECM systems and large lasers discouraged enemy sensors and kept wary opponents at arm’s length. More than 15 tons of armor, CASE and a standard fusion engine made the Pulverizer extremely hard to kill compared to more sophisticated early Clan machines.
column2: 粉碎者为远程火力而建，依靠一门改装增程PPC和LRM在远处打击，同时以ECM系统与大型激光器干扰敌方传感器、把谨慎的对手挡在一臂之外。超过15吨的装甲、CASE和一台标准聚变引擎，使粉碎者与更精巧的早期氏族机型相比极难被击毁。ZH

column1: Developed by Clan Snow Raven this configuration trades the standard Large Lasers for Improved Large Lasers. The armor has also been replaced by Clan spec Ferro-Fibrous armor. The weight savings from these changes allows the Pulverizer to carry eighteen double heat sinks. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - PPC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: 该配置由雪鸦部族研发，将标准大型激光换成改进型大型激光。装甲也已更换为部族规格的铁纤维装甲。这些改动省下的重量，让Pulverizer得以搭载十八台双散热器。特性：精准武器 - 粒子加农炮 投放费用倍率：1.14

column1: Developed by Clan Snow Raven this configuration trades the standard Large Lasers for Improved Large Lasers. The armor has also been replaced by Clan spec Ferro-Fibrous armor. The weight savings from these changes allows the Pulverizer to carry eighteen double heat sinks.
column2: 这一配置由雪鸦氏族研发，把标准大型激光器换成改进型大型激光器。装甲也换成了氏族规格铁纤装甲。这些改动省下的重量让粉碎者得以携带十八具双重散热器。ZH

column1: The PUL-C has been fully upgraded with clan tech from the previous mixed variants. A Clan ER PPC has replaced the early Enhanced ER PPC and the Large Lasers have been upgraded to Clan Large Pulse Lasers giving the PUL-C the ability to deal and withstand damage at long ranges. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - PPC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22
column2: PUL-C 已在此前混装变型的基础上全面换装部族科技。部族增程粒子加农炮取代了早期的强化增程粒子加农炮，大型激光也升级为部族大型脉冲激光，使 PUL-C 具备在远距离输出与承受伤害的能力。特性：精准武器 - 粒子加农炮 投放费用倍率：1.22

column1: The PUL-C has been fully upgraded with clan tech from the earlier mixed variants.  A Clan ER PPC has replaced the early Enhanced ER PPC and the Large Lasers have been upgraded to Clan Large Pulse Lasers giving the PUL-C the ability to deal and withstand damage at long ranges.
column2: PUL-C已用部族技术从早期的混合变型全面升级：部族增程粒子加农炮取代了早期增强型增程粒子加农炮，大型激光升级为部族大型脉冲激光，使PUL-C能在远距离上输出并承受伤害。ZH

column1: The Quasit's main long range weapon is its LRM-5 launcher, mounted in the center torso. Its close range weapons are an SRM-4 launcher mounted on left hand actuator and a medium laser in the right hand actuator. For handling infantry, the 'Mech has a machine gun mounted in its right torso. Seven and a half tons of Lexington Limited Heavy Industrial armor provides a surprisingly strong defense for the MilitiaMech. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.76
column2: 奎西特的主要远程武器是装在中央躯干的LRM-5发射器；近程武器则是一具装在左手驱动器上的SRM-4发射器和右手驱动器上的一门中型激光。为对付步兵，该机甲右躯干装有一挺机枪。七吨半列克星敦有限重工业装甲为这台民兵机甲提供了出人意料坚固的防御。特性：改进生命维持 投放费用倍率：0.76

column1: The Quasit was an Industrial Mech armed with military-grade weapons, created in 2517 by Concordat Telecom and the TransStellar Company. Initially, the design was sold to unsuspecting settlements in the Periphery as a BattleMech, but once the new owners had the Quasit face a proper BattleMech, the truth was revealed by its limitations. After a brief setback, once the CTT decided to sell it as a MilitiaMech to support militia troops, the design worked well in this role.
column2: 奎西特是一款装有军用级武器的工业机甲，由协约电信与跨星公司于2517年创造。它最初被当作战斗机甲卖给外围地区毫无戒心的定居点，但当新主人们让奎西特正面对上一台真正的战斗机甲时，其局限便揭穿了真相。在短暂的挫折之后，CTT决定把它作为民兵机甲出售以支援民兵部队，该设计在这一角色上表现出色。ZH

column1: A simple refit of the -4G, adding a C3 Slave unit by dropping one of the Medium Lasers. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
column2: -4G 的简单改装型，通过拆下一门中型激光加装了一个 C3 从属单元。特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.06

column1: The Quickdraw was originally built in 2779 as a replacement for the Rifleman BattleMech. While it was unsuccessful in supplanting the Rifleman, over time the Quickdraw proved itself to be a good generalist 'Mech. Packing excellent firepower, solid armor protection and above-average speed, it quickly earned the respect of many MechWarriors and status as a workhorse in every Successor State's military.
column2: 快手最初于 2779 年建造，意在取代步枪手战斗机甲。虽然它未能成功顶替步枪手，但随着时间推移，快手证明自己是一台优秀的通用机甲。凭借出色的火力、扎实的装甲防护和高于平均的速度，它迅速赢得了许多机甲战士的尊重，并在每个继承国的军队中获得了主力机型的地位。ZH

column1: The -4P is an uncommon variant of the Quickdraw, made largely obsolete by more modern mechs and therefore only seen with mercenary bands low on luck, pirates or deep periphery garrisons. The largest drawback of the 'Mech is the giant Electronic Warfare Equipment fixed to its side torso, weighing in at 7.5 tons while providing considerably worse EWS capabilities then the most basic modern system. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
column2: -4P是迅捷的不常见变型，由于更现代的机甲使其大多过时，因而只见于运气不佳的雇佣兵团、海盗或外围纵深驻军。该机甲最大的缺点是侧躯干固定安装的巨型电子战设备：重达7.5吨，其电子战能力却明显不如最基本的现代系统。特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.06

column1: A simple modification of the 5K's weapons array introduced in 3057, the rear-firing medium lasers are remounted to fire forward. The SRM-4 is then mounted to be fired rearward. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 这是3057年推出的对5K武器组的小幅改动：后向中型激光改为朝前射击，SRM-4则改为朝后安装。特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.08

column1: A periphery refit of a QKD-5M, the -5P combines the standard four medium lasers with a large Hatchet and a Supercharger, to bring the 'Mech quickly into melee range. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
column2: 这是外围地区对QKD-5M的改装，-5P把标准的四门中型激光与一把大战斧和一台增压器结合起来，让机甲迅速进入近战距离。特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.06

column1: The -6KH is a clan conversion of the Quickdraw, initially seen amongst the mercenary band the Kell Hounds. A total of four ER Medium Lasers and an Artemis IV enabled LRM-10 missile launcher as the primary armament, while a Streak SRM-4 provides secondary close range firepower. The design even manages to fit both a C3 slave and a small targeting computer. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
column2: -6KH是迅捷的部族化改装，最早见于雇佣兵团体凯尔猎犬。它的主要武器是四门增程中型激光和一具带阿尔忒弥斯IV的LRM-10导弹发射器，另有一具连发SRM-4提供次要近程火力。该设计甚至设法同时装下了一台C3从机和一台小型瞄准计算机。特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.06

column1: The C is a modified version of the 5K Quickdraw first fielded in 3053. One of the rear-facing lasers is replaced with a C3 slave unit, allowing it to work as part of a C3 lance. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: C 型是 5K Quickdraw 的改进版本，于 3053 年首次列装。它把一门朝后的激光替换为 C3 从属单元，使其能够作为 C3 小队的一员协同作战。特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.08

column1: A Clan IIC variant of the Quickdraw, utilizing the smaller and lighter Clan based technology to fit a total of nine ER Medium Lasers. However, the design never passed trials and is very seldom used by except piloting it into battle as a punishment. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12
column2: Quickdraw的部族IIC变型，利用更小更轻的部族科技，容纳了总共九门增程中型激光。然而该设计从未通过试炼，极少被使用，除了作为惩罚被驾驶上战场。特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.12

column1: The custom mode Quickdraw variant piloted by the MechWarrior Ivy Upsalom, more commonly known as 'The Ladykiller'. The -IV4 features a plentitude of advanced systems not commonly available, showing the owner's determination to let no cost stop the the dream of the perfect 'Mech. Despite its impressive firepower through twin Imperator AC/5s, two Valiant SRM-6 launchers and two Medium Pulse Lasers, the 'Mech still suffers from being easily forced off the battlefield due to the somewhat mediocre armor and XL engine. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: Quickdraw 的定制变型，由机甲战士 Ivy Upsalom 驾驶，人送绰号“淑女杀手”。-IV4 配备了大量并不常见的先进系统，足见其主人不惜代价追求完美机甲的心志。尽管凭借双联 Imperator AC/5、两具 Valiant SRM-6 发射器与两门中型脉冲激光拥有可观的火力，该机甲仍因装甲平平与 XL引擎而容易被逐出战场。特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.1

column1: The Scrapper was the personal 'Mech of Solaris gladiator Signe Hague, up until their recent demise. Although fully focused on Melee fighting and arena combat with its large Sword and very thick armor, it still manages to mount three SRM launchers and a Medium Laser. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: Scrapper 曾是索拉里斯角斗士西格妮·哈格的专属机甲，直到其不久前殒命。该机虽完全专注于近身近战与竞技场战斗，配备巨剑与极厚的装甲，却仍设法装设了三具 SRM 发射器和一门中型激光。特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.1

column1: The Raiden is a battle armor design that hails from the Draconis Combine. It is essentially the Combine's take on the Inner Sphere Standard which, though debuting first and also produced by the Kuritans themselves, represents an improvement on the design. Quirk: Well Designed Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 雷电是一款来自德拉科尼斯联合体的战斗装甲设计。它本质上是联合体对"内天体标准型"的诠释——后者虽然更早问世且同样由库瑞塔人生产，但雷电代表了该设计的改进。特质：设计精良 投放费用倍率：0.888 可挂载全能单位，可近战，可蜂群攻击。

column1: The Raiden is a battle armor design that hails from the Draconis Combine. It is essentially the Combine's take on the Inner Sphere Standard which, though debuting first and also produced by the Kuritans themselves, represents an improvement on the design.
column2: 雷电是一款来自德拉科尼斯联合体的战斗装甲设计。它本质上是联合体对"内天体标准型"的诠释——后者虽然更早问世且同样由库瑞塔人生产，但雷电代表了该设计的改进。ZH

column1: The Raijin is designed to be highly mobile and capable of engaging an enemy at a variety of ranges. The Raijin is built around a 300 XL Engine that gives it a top speed of 97.2 km/h. For added mobility, the Raijin carries six jump jets, allowing the 'Mech to jump up to one hundred and eighty meters. The Raijin carries seven tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. The 'Mech's relatively light armor can be a liability if it is engaged in close combat or finds itself in a protracted engagement. To handle the heat from the weapons onboard, the Raijin carries ten double heat sinks. For long-range striking power, the Raijin carries a ER PPC that can be used to engage a target at up to six hundred and ninety meters. For close combat, the Raijin has three Medium Pulse Lasers. Additionally, to seek out any weak points in an enemy's armor, the Raijin has a SRM-6 and an ammunition efficient Streak SRM-2 Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 雷神被设计为高度机动，能在多种距离上与敌人交战。它围绕一台300 XL引擎建造，最高速度97.2公里/小时。为进一步提升机动性，雷神带六具跳跃推进器，可跳跃至多一百八十米。雷神带七吨铁纤维装甲。若陷入近身战或持久交战，其相对轻薄的装甲会成为隐患。为处理武器热量，雷神带十个双散热器。远程打击方面，雷神装有一门增程粒子加农炮，可在六百九十米外攻击目标；混战方面则有三门中型脉冲激光。此外，为寻找敌方装甲的弱点，雷神还带有一具SRM-6和一具弹药效率极高的连发SRM-2。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Fire Support & Striker
column2: 火力支援与打击者

column1: The Raijin was designed after the Battle of Tukayyid to rearm ComGuard units that had suffered losses in the campaign. Despite having stockpiled Star League-era BattleMechs at his disposal, Precentor Martial Focht wanted something unfamiliar to both the Inner Sphere and the Clans.
column2: 雷神是在图卡伊德战役之后设计的，用于为在这场战役中损失惨重的通讯之星卫队重新装备。尽管军事大导师福赫特手头库存着星际联盟时代的战斗机甲，他却想要一种对内层星域和部族都陌生的东西。ZH

column1: A failed prototype to improve the survivability rate of the MechWarriors piloting Raijins. By converting the SRM6 launcher to a one shot, a CASE system was added to protected the Streak SRM ammunition. However, in real battle scenarios this only meant that the Mech's firepower got considerably nerfed for a minimal durability improvement. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是一款旨在提高Raijin机甲战士生存率的失败原型机。它把SRM6发射器改为一次性发射，从而腾出空间加装CASE系统保护连发SRM弹药。然而在实际战斗中，这仅仅意味着机甲的耐久度只得到微乎其微的提升，火力却被大幅削弱。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Produced by the Rim Worlds Republic in 2735, the Rampage 2G was a standard line unit in the Rim Worlds Army. The 2G model was basic, but effective in its role, carrying a wide assortment of weapons to handle threats at any range of engagement. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 由边缘世界共和国于 2735 年生产，Rampage 2G 是边缘世界军队的标准一线单位。2G 型号虽然基础，但在其定位上相当有效，配备种类繁多的武器，足以应对任何交战距离上的威胁。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂

column1: I know this is an old 'Mech and all, Boss, but ... c'mon. This thing is like somebody looked at the Victor and went \"hey, let me copy your homework,\" and then didn't even improve on the design.
column2: 我知道这是台老机甲，老大，可是……得了吧。这东西就像有人看了胜利者一眼，说"嘿，借我抄抄作业"，然后连设计都没改进一下。ZH

column1: Built in 2750, the Rampage 4G was a massive overhaul to the original 2G model, upgrading many of the components to modern equivalents. Most notable was the addition of a Gauss rifle at the expense of the missile tubes, giving the 4G considerable punch at longer ranges. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 狂暴 4G 于 2750 年制造，是对原始 2G 型号的大规模改造，把许多部件升级为现代型号。最引人注目的是以牺牲导弹发射管为代价加装了一门高斯步枪，使 4G 在较远距离上也拥有相当可观的打击力。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: The Rampage 4G is a long range powerhouse. It's not very often that you see 'Mechs come off the factory line capable of the same one-two punch that the Gauss Rifle and LB 10-X AC can manage here.
column2: 暴走4G是远程重炮。很少见到有机甲能出厂就打出高斯步枪与LB 10-X自动炮这样的连环重拳。ZH

column1: The personal BattleMech of Rim Worlds Army General Viktoria Benbaoudaoud. Based on the Rampage 5G, the 4G \"Benbaoudaoud\" was a minor custom refit, most notably removing the MASC for additional missile tubes. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 这是边境世界军将军维克托里娅·本鲍达乌德的私人战斗机甲。4G“本鲍达乌德”以暴走5G为基础，是一次小幅定制改装，最显著之处是拆掉MASC以增加导弹发射管。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: Small touch-ups like these aren't too unheard of, even back from the Star League days. Every MechWarrior's got their preferences, and some of them have the pull and the cash to make them happen. Sound familiar, Boss?
column2: 这种小修小补其实并不罕见，甚至在星盟时代也是如此。每个机师都有自己的偏好，而其中一些人既有门路又有钱把它变成现实。听着耳熟吗，老大？ZH

column1: While the original Rampage had its debut in 2735 as a standard line unit, it saw a large scale redesign following the Amaris Coup in 2767. Taking advantage of the newly acquired SLDF R&D facilities, the Rampage 5G was outfitted with state-of-the-art weaponry previously unheard of in the Rim Worlds Republic. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 最初的暴走于2735年作为标准战列单位首次亮相，在2767年阿马里斯政变后经历了大规模重新设计。凭借新取得的SLDF研发设施，暴走5G装备了此前在边境世界共和国闻所未闻的最先进武器。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: Origins aside, the Rampage 5G is a solid assault 'mech. Big slabs of armor, weapons leagues ahead of its peers at the time. The tally marks next to the flamer do make me a little nervous, though. I think we'll just buff those out.
column2: 撇开来历不谈，狂怒5G是一台扎实的突击机甲。厚重的装甲板，武器在当时远超同侪。不过火焰喷射器旁的那些计数刻痕让我有点紧张。我想我们干脆把它们磨掉。ZH

column1: An offshoot of the Jenner, the 35 ton Rattlesnake JR7-31 was developed as part of the joint MIIO-LIC Trapdoor Project during the early years of the Clan Invasion. Meant primarily as a disinformation campaign targeted at House Kurita, few Rattlesnakes were ever manufactured, with the design becoming extinct within 30 years. Built around a 245-rated XL Engine and 7 Jump Jets, the Rattlesnake mounts 7 Medium Lasers. Guardian ECM is included and the remaining tonnage devoted to additional armor. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Rattlesnake JR7-31 是 Jenner 的分支机型，这台 35 吨机甲是部族入侵初期 MIIO 与 LIC 联合开展的“活板门计划”（Trapdoor Project）的产物。它主要被用作针对库瑞塔家族的虚假情报行动，因此制造的 Rattlesnake 数量极少，该设计在 30 年内便告绝迹。Rattlesnake 以一台 245 级 XL 引擎和 7 具跳跃推进器为核心，装有 7 门中型激光。它还配有一具守护者电子对抗系统，剩余吨位则全部用于增加装甲。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: An offshoot of the Jenner, the 35 ton Rattlesnake JR7-31 was developed as part of the joint MIIO-LIC Trapdoor Project during the early years of the Clan Invasion. Meant primarily as a disinformation campaign targeted at House Kurita, few Rattlesnakes were ever manufactured, with the design becoming extinct within 30 years. Built around a 245-rated XL Engine and 7 Jump Jets, the Rattlesnake mounts 7 Medium Lasers. Guardian ECM is included and the remaining tonnage devoted to additional armor.
column2: 响尾蛇 JR7-31 是詹纳的分支，35 吨，作为 MIIO 与 LIC 联合"活板门计划"的一部分在氏族入侵初期开发。它主要用于针对库瑞塔家族的假情报行动，因此制造数量极少，该设计在 30 年内便绝迹。响尾蛇围绕一台 245 额定 XL 引擎和 7 个跳跃推进器建造，装 7 门中型激光，另有守护者 ECM，剩余吨位全部用于增加装甲。ZH

column1: The JR7-31B is a slightly cheaper version of the JR7-31P. By dropping one of the heat sinks, the armor was able to be switched from the more expensive Ferro-Fibrous to standard grade. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: JR7-31B 是 JR7-31P 的略微廉价版本。通过拆除一具散热器，装甲得以从更昂贵的铁纤维更换为标准型号。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：0.98

column1: An offshoot of the Jenner, the 35 ton Rattlesnake JR7-31P was developed as part of the joint MIIO-LIC Trapdoor Project during the early years of the Clan Invasion. Meant primarily as a disinformation campaign targeted at House Kurita, few Rattlesnakes were ever manufactured, with the design becoming extinct within 30 years. Built around a 245-rated XL Engine and 7 Jump Jets, the Rattlesnake mounts 7 Medium Lasers. A C3 Slave is included and the remaining tonnage devoted to additional armor. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 作为迅捷的分支，35吨的响尾蛇JR7-31P是部族入侵早期MIIO-LIC“活板门计划”的产物。它主要针对库瑞塔家族进行假情报行动，制造的响尾蛇极少，该设计在30年内便灭绝。响尾蛇围绕一台245额定XL引擎和7具跳跃推进器建造，装7门中型激光，另带一台C3从机，其余吨位用于额外装甲。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: An offshoot of the Jenner, the 35 ton Rattlesnake JR7-31P was developed as part of the joint MIIO-LIC Trapdoor Project during the early years of the Clan Invasion. Meant primarily as a disinformation campaign targeted at House Kurita, few Rattlesnakes were ever manufactured, with the design becoming extinct within 30 years. Built around a 245-rated XL Engine and 7 Jump Jets, the Rattlesnake mounts 7 Medium Lasers. A C3 Slave is included and the remaining tonnage devoted to additional armor.
column2: 作为詹纳的一个分支，35吨的响尾蛇JR7-31P是在氏族入侵初期作为MIIO-LIC"活板门计划"的联合项目研发的。它主要是一场针对栗田家族的假情报行动，响尾蛇从未大量制造，该设计在30年内就灭绝了。响尾蛇围绕一具245级XL引擎和7个跳跃推进器建造，装7门中型激光器。它还装有一套C3从属系统，剩余吨位则用于增加装甲。ZH

column1: The 31PX is the early prototype version of what eventually got introduced as the JR7-31P. The C3 slave computer of the later version is missing in the PX, but instead an extra Medium Laser is mounted in the head. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 31PX是后来定型为JR7-31P的早期原型版本。PX上没有后续型号的C3从属计算机，取而代之的是头部加装的一具中型激光。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：0.98

column1: The JR7-31U switches to an endo steel chassis to free enough weight capacity to increase the amount of armor. The Guardian ECM of the original JR7-31 is also replaced by a C3 Slave computer. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: JR7-31U改用钢内骨结构底盘，腾出足够重量容量以增加装甲。原JR7-31的守护者电子对抗套件也被换成一台C3从机。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The Razor Jaw carries an ATM-9 in each side torso and a Medium Pulse Laser in each arm. Five Jump Jets improves mobility enough to compensate for its lack of a high max speed. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 剃刀颚在左右躯干各装有一具ATM-9，每条手臂各有一门中型脉冲激光。五个跳跃推进器充分提升了机动性，弥补了最高速度不足的缺陷。特性：改进生命维持系统 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

column1: Razor Jaw
column2: 剃刀颚

column1: The Razor Jaw is a 55 ton mobile medium to long range striker. Originally created by Clan Nova Cat, it soon spread within all the Clans that headed to the Inner Sphere. Although early production runs of the 'Mech had some reliability issues, once they were ironed out the 'Mech was considered quite efficient .
column2: 剃刀颚是一种55吨机动中型至远程打击者。它最初由新猫氏族创造，很快便流传到所有前往内天体的氏族中。虽然该机甲早期生产批次有些可靠性问题，但问题解决之后，它被认为相当高效。ZH

column1: As a BattleMech design the Reconquista was a mixed-bag. Its numerous faulty components included the internal combustion engine, myomer, chassis, spare parts, controls and software. The Reconquista's slow speed and limited agility were also severe weaknesses exploited by Umayyad artillery and tanks. On the other hand, the armor, heat sinks and mix of weaponry (autocannon, machine gun and long-range missiles) proved adequate, and the 'Mech could be built in (relatively) large enough numbers at a critical time of the invasion. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.89 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 作为一款战斗机甲设计，再征服是好坏参半的。它众多有缺陷的部件包括内燃机、人造肌、底盘、备件、控制系统和软件。再征服缓慢的速度与有限的灵活性也是倭马亚火炮与坦克所利用的严重弱点。另一方面，它的装甲、散热器和武器组合（自动炮、机枪与远程导弹）被证明是够用的，而且该机甲能在入侵的关键时刻以（相对）足够大的数量生产出来。特性：无处不在 投放费用倍率：0.89 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: The Reconquista was the first BattleMech produced by Nueva Castile, created as a response to the Umayyad invasion. While this design was hardly equal to the Mackie, let alone the Star League-level 'Mechs used by the Umayyads, the Reconquista did redress the battlefield imbalance enough that the Castilians were able to halt the Umayyad advance. The Reconquista also had the virtue of being easy enough to manufacture that the Castilians could deploy them in company strength at a time when the Umayyads still couldn't replace their own 'Mech losses.
column2: 再征服是新卡斯蒂利亚生产的第一种战斗机甲，为应对倭马亚入侵而创造。虽然这一设计远不及麦基，更不用说倭马亚人使用的星盟级机甲，但再征服确实足以纠正战场上的失衡，使卡斯蒂利亚人得以阻止倭马亚的推进。再征服还有一个优点：它足够易于制造，使卡斯蒂利亚人能在倭马亚人仍无法补充自身机甲损失之时，以连级规模部署它们。ZH

column1: The Rhino was an early attempt made by Clan Hell's Horses to develop true battle armor during the Golden Century. The Rhino's weapons layout and equipment was similar to the Elemental (Battle Armor), but was not as capable as the later machine. Its weapons ranges were shorter and it lacked maneuverability and speed. However, the armor was greater than what the Elemental battlesuit would carry. In addition, while the suit's SRM 2 was easy to use and reload, it had a significant jamming issue. This issue would cause catastrophic ammo explosions dealing major damage to the suit and the pilot (for an example, see Bertram). Engineers tried to resolve the issue, but the Rhino was shelved before the issue could be rectified. Quirk: Armored Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.935 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: 犀牛是地狱马部族在黄金世纪早期尝试研制真正的战斗装甲的产物。犀牛的武器布局与装备与元素（战斗装甲）相似，但能力不及后来的型号：武器射程更短，也缺乏机动性与速度。不过它的装甲比元素战斗装甲更厚。此外，虽然该装甲的SRM 2易于使用和再装填，却存在严重的卡壳问题，会引发灾难性的弹药爆炸，对装甲与机师造成重大伤害（示例见伯特伦）。工程师曾试图解决该问题，但问题未能修正，犀牛便被束之高阁。特性：装甲化 投放费用倍率：0.935 可搭载全向单位，可近战，不可蜂拥攻击。

column1: The Rhino's main armament is a Large Laser mounted in the center torso, while it also carries a Medium Laser in each leg, one rear-facing one in the left torso and another in the head. A basic 300-rated fusion core keeps mobility up just enough to not be easily flanked. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
column2: 犀牛的主要武器是装在中央躯干的一门大型激光，同时每条腿各装一门中型激光，左躯干一门后向、头部另一门。一台基本的300额定聚变核心让机动性刚好够用，不至于轻易被包抄。特性：精准武器 - 激光 投放费用倍率：1.06

column1: A 60-ton QuadMech similar to the Goliath in appearance, created specifically for the export market outside the Inner Sphere. Using only basic technology the cost is kept low enough for even the most back-water garrisons and the maintenance needs are kept very simple. Although the 'Mech shares the name of the 50-ton Clan QuadMech, they have no relation to each other.
column2: 一种外观类似歌利亚的60吨四足机甲，专为内天体之外的出口市场打造。它只使用基础技术，成本低到连最偏远的驻军也负担得起，维护需求也极为简单。虽然该机甲与那台50吨氏族四足机甲同名，两者并无关联。ZH

column1: The Rifleman IIC Chironex carries an Ultra AC/2 and ATM 3 rack in each arm, supported by head mounted ER Small Laser and a Large Pulse Laser in each side torso. Built around a 195-rated standard engine, Endo Steel frame and thirteen tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, the Chironex is fitted with fourteen Double Heat Sinks, three Jump Jets, three tons of ATM reloads and two tons of UAC rounds. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 步枪兵 IIC“奇罗内克斯”（Chironex）每条手臂各装有一门 Ultra AC/2 和一具 ATM 3 发射架，并由头部安装的增程小型激光以及两侧躯干各一门大型脉冲激光提供支援。它以额定 195 的标准引擎、钢内骨结构及十三吨铁纤维装甲为基础建造，装设了十四台双散热器、三具跳跃推进器、三吨 ATM 备用弹药和两吨 UAC 弹药。特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The Rifleman IIC Chironex carries an Ultra AC/2 and ATM 3 rack in each arm, supported by head mounted ER Small Laser and a Large Pulse Laser in each side torso. Built around a 195-rated standard engine, Endo Steel frame and thirteen tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, the Chironex is fitted with fourteen Double Heat Sinks, three Jump Jets, three tons of ATM reloads and two tons of UAC rounds.
column2: 步枪兵IIC喀戎在双臂各装一门超速AC/2和一具ATM 3架，由头部的增程小型激光器和两侧躯干各一门大型脉冲激光器支援。它围绕一具195级标准引擎、内层钢框架和十三吨铁纤装甲建造，装十四具双重散热器、三个跳跃推进器、三吨ATM备用弹和两吨UAC弹药。ZH

column1: Developed for the Emperor Stefan Amaris's occupying army, the Rifleman III was an experimental prototype which was rushed into service to defend against the invading Star League Defense Force Army led by General Aleksandr Kerensky in 2777. Only a single prototype was produced after years of development, and it was destroyed during the battle for Terra. Used in the role of an ambusher before being destroyed, the 'Mech's Battle ROM would recount that it had downed nine SLDF BattleMechs before it was rendered inoperable by battle damage. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Rifleman III 是为斯特凡·阿马里斯皇帝的占领军开发的实验性原型机，于 2777 年被匆忙投入使用，以抵御亚历山大·克伦斯基将军率领的入侵中的星际联盟防卫军。历经多年研发，最终只生产出一台原型机，它也在争夺泰拉的战火中被摧毁。这台机甲在被摧毁前担任伏击手，其战斗记录仪记载，它曾击落九台 SLDF 战斗机甲，最终因战损而彻底失去战斗力。特性：多重追踪 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Rifleman III
column2: 步枪手III

column1: Although the Rifleman III carries an insufficient supply of both armor and ammunition it is perfectly designed for its role — that is, to burst from concealment and demolish the nearest enemies with incredible physical and psychological firepower.
column2: 虽然步枪兵III携带的装甲与弹药都不足，它却为其角色设计得恰到好处——即从隐蔽处暴起，以惊人的物理与心理火力摧毁最近的敌人。ZH

column1: The personally built 'Mech of Cranston Snord's Irregulars member 'Shorty' Sneede, his Rifleman is a FrankenMech featuring a Phoenix Hawk head, Warhammer right arm and the left torso and arm from an Archer, with only the center and right torsos and both legs left from the parent design. Built around the 3N's standard 240-rated engine, much of the weapons and ammunition from the donor 'Mechs was retained, Sneede's custom being armed with a right-arm mounted PPC, left-torso mounted LRM-20 with two tons of ammo, and three Medium Lasers - one fitted to the right torso and two to the left arm. Carrying a total of fourteen single heat sinks, Sneede's patchwork Rifleman is clad in nine tons of armor. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是克兰斯顿·斯诺德“非正规军”成员“矮子”斯尼德的私人座驾；他的 Rifleman 是一具拼装机甲，装有 Phoenix Hawk 的头部、Warhammer 的右臂，以及来自 Archer 的左躯干和左臂，只有中央躯干、右躯干和双腿是原设计的部件。它以 3N 的标准 240 级引擎为核心，保留了供体机甲的大部分武器和弹药：斯尼德的定制机右臂装有一门粒子加农炮，左躯干装有一具带两吨弹药的 LRM-20，另有三门中型激光——一门装在右躯干，两门装在左臂。斯尼德这具拼凑而成的 Rifleman 共携带十四具单散热器，披挂九吨装甲。特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

column1: The personally built 'Mech of Cranston Snord's Irregulars member 'Shorty' Sneede, his Rifleman is a FrankenMech featuring a Phoenix Hawk head, Warhammer right arm and the left torso and arm from an Archer, with only the center and right torsos and both legs left from the parent design. Built around the 3N's standard 240-rated engine, much of the weapons and ammunition from the donor 'Mechs was retained, Sneede's custom being armed with a right-arm mounted PPC, left-torso mounted LRM-20 with two tons of ammo, and three Medium Lasers - one fitted to the right torso and two to the left arm. Carrying a total of fourteen single heat sinks, Sneede's patchwork Rifleman is clad in nine tons of armor.
column2: 这是克朗斯顿·斯诺德非正规军成员"矮子"斯尼德亲手拼装的机甲，他的步枪兵是一台拼装机甲：装凤凰鹰的头、重锤的右臂，以及弓箭手的左躯干和左臂，只有中央与右躯干和双腿仍属原设计。它围绕3N标准的240级引擎建造，来自捐赠机甲的许多武器与弹药都被保留，斯尼德的定制机武装为右臂一门PPC、左躯干一具LRM-20配两吨弹药，以及三门中型激光器——一门装在右躯干，两门装在左臂。斯尼德这台拼装步枪兵总共携带十四具单重散热器，披挂九吨装甲。ZH

column1: Originally conceived by Clan Jade Falcon during the Clans' Golden Century, the Emerald Harrier is a 15-ton BattleMech. It was out of production by the time of the Clan Invasion of the Inner Sphere and, as such, was only sparsely deployed there. ComStar ROM operatives gave it the reporting name RD-1R Roadrunner when they first observed it in the Jade Falcon occupation zone. It was last reported with Eyrie units on Coventry in 3058 and is thought to have been meant as a training 'Mech. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: Emerald Harrier 最初由翡翠猎鹰部族在部族黄金世纪期间构想，是一台 15 吨的战斗机甲。到部族入侵内层星域时它已经停产，因此在内层星域只有少量部署。通讯之星 ROM 特工在翡翠猎鹰占领区首次观察到它时，为其取了个代号 RD-1R Roadrunner。它最后一次被记录是 3058 年随 Eyrie 单位出现在考文垂，据信其设计初衷是作为训练机甲。特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.03

column1: Jesus.. how fast does this go? Meep Meep Commander?
column2: 天哪……这玩意儿能跑多快？哔哔，指挥官？ZH

column1: The Roc is considered one of the best of the first generation ProtoMechs, and most known successful, as it was produced, operative and fighting for almost a century. In a sense a 'super-Elemental', a Roc carries a single ER Medium Laser and is equipped with sufficient Jump Jets to leap 150 meters at a time. Quirk: Accurate Weapons - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.972
column2: Roc 被视为第一代原生型机甲（ProtoMech）中最优秀的型号之一，也是最广为人知的成功之作，它的生产、服役与作战延续了近一个世纪。从某种意义上说，Roc 是一台“超级元素”，搭载一门增程中型激光，并配备足以一次跳跃 150 米的跳跃推进器。特性：精准武器 - 能量 投放费用倍率：0.972

column1: The SA-RN model uses four Artemis IV FCS-guided SRM-4 launchers protected by CASE. It also sports a prototype claw in the left arm and a Large Pulse Laser in the right. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

column1: A Solaris VII BattleMech introduced by Solaris Arms in the mid-3050. As their entry in the medium range weight class arenas, the original Ronin was based on a Centurion chassis. By using an existing chassis rather than building a custom one, Solaris Arms was able to reduce development time and costs. This design philosophy, pioneered with the Ronin, remains in place today. The 'Mech features balanced speed, armor, and weaponry, making it very popular with the Solaris stables, but it is a rare sight on any other world.
column2: Ronin 是 Solaris Arms 于 3050 年代中期推出的索拉里斯七号战斗机甲。作为该厂进军中量级竞技场的参赛机型，初代 Ronin 以 Centurion 的骨架为基础。通过沿用现有骨架而非另行设计专用骨架，Solaris Arms 得以缩短开发周期并降低成本。这一由 Ronin 开创的设计理念沿用至今。该机甲在速度、装甲和武器之间取得了均衡，因而深受索拉里斯各竞技马厩的欢迎，但在其他任何星球上都难得一见。ZH

column1: The SA-RNS is almost identical to the SA-RN, but drops one ton of SRM ammunition to increase the armoring of the 'Mech. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: SA-RNS与SA-RN几乎相同，只是拆掉一吨SRM弹药以增加机甲装甲。特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: The Rook relies on its many weapons and substantial amount of armor rather than speed, but to improve mobility it has three Assault-class Jump Jets. The two PPC, three SRM-6 and three Medium Lasers are cooled by a total of 22 heat sinks, which despite the large number of sinks is far from enough to cool a full alpha strike of the 'Mech. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: 车堡依靠其众多武器与厚实装甲而非速度，但为提升机动性，它装了三具突击级跳跃推进器。两门粒子加农炮、三具SRM-6和三门中型激光由总共22个散热器降温；尽管散热器数量众多，仍远不足以支撑该机甲一次全力齐射。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.16

column1: A 100-ton Inner Sphere 'Mech created just a few years before the Helm Memory Core was found, resulting in the rediscovery of many lost technologies. As a result the Rook was quickly found obsolete, and as a result only a single variant was designed.
column2: 这是亥姆记忆核心被发现前几年创造的一台100吨内天体机甲，而那次发现重新找回了许多失传技术。结果乌鸦很快就被认定过时，也因此只设计了一个改型。ZH

The kit is mainly used by mercenary outfits when advanced electronics like the Artemis IV FCS are rare or difficult to maintain. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: PPR-6U火蜥蜴是6S的侧级改装套件，拆掉阿尔忒弥斯IV系统，改为一门大型脉冲激光，两门中型脉冲激光也不得不降级为标准型号。该套件主要被雇佣兵部队使用——当阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统这类先进电子设备稀少或难以维护时。特性：精准武器 - 导弹 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: The Salamander the design incorporates fire-based weapons; its primary armaments being a pair of Flamers slung under the arms and a single, one-shot short-range missile strapped to the shoulder, invariably one with an Inferno payload. This makes the Salamander especially potent against infantry and combat vehicles, though that does not mean it is less intimidating to MechWarriors: few would want to get caught in the sights of a Salamander Point. Quirk: Fire Demon Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount any unit, can melee, can swarm.
column2: Salamander 的设计以火焰类武器为核心；其主要武器是挂在双臂下方的两具火焰喷射器，以及绑在肩部的一枚一次性短程火箭，且弹头无一例外都是燃烧弹。这使 Salamander 对步兵和战斗车辆尤为致命，但这并不意味着它对机甲战士的威慑力会小一些：很少有人愿意被一支 Salamander 小队盯上。特性：火焰恶魔 投放费用倍率：0.93 可搭乘任何单位，可近战，可蜂拥攻击。

column1: The Sarissa MN1-K was armed simply. It carried a battery of lasers, one large and several medium, and mounted as much armor as could be fi tted with the remaining weight budget. Though truly a BattleMech, it drew heavily on a century of IndustrialMech construction experience and was often assembled in civilian facilities. The result was a mechanically reliable and durable machine ideal for Marik militias with little BattleMech training, but otherwise not terribly impressive. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.82
column2: Sarissa MN1-K的武器配置十分简单。它搭载一组激光——一门大型激光和若干门中型激光——并在剩余重量预算内尽可能多地安装装甲。虽然它确确实实是一台战斗机甲，却大量借鉴了长达一个世纪的工业机甲制造经验，并常常在民用设施中组装。其结果是机械可靠、坚固耐用，非常适合缺乏战斗机甲训练的马尔克民兵，但除此之外并不特别出众。特性：随处可见 投放费用倍率：0.82

column1: One of the first primitive BattleMechs produced by the Free Worlds League, the Sarissa is one of many centuries-old Age of War designs reborn during the desperation of the Jihad. A contemporary of the Icarus and Mackie, the original MN1-K Sarissa, designed sometime shortly after 2470, was intended as a stopgap that could be readily manufactured in civilian IndustrialMech facilities to bolster the League's member state militias in the face of Lyran Commonwealth and Capellan Confederation newborn BattleMech forces. This philosophy would also make the Sarissa very appealing in 3080 as the Principality of Regulus suffered increasing losses during the Word of Blake Jihad, favoring even a primitive BattleMech over even more simple to build combat vehicles for propaganda purposes.
column2: 作为自由世界联盟最早生产的原始战斗机甲之一，萨里沙是众多在圣战绝境中重生的数百年战火时代设计之一。作为伊卡洛斯与麦基的同时代产物，最初的MN1-K萨里沙设计于2470年之后不久的某个时候，本意是一种权宜之计，可在民用工业机甲设施中迅速制造，以在莱兰联邦与卡佩兰联邦新生战斗机甲部队面前增强联盟成员国的民兵。这一理念也使萨里沙在3080年极具吸引力——当时雷古兰公国在布雷克之言圣战中损失日增，出于宣传目的，哪怕一台原始战斗机甲也胜过更易于建造的战斗车辆。ZH

column1: The original Sasquatch model produced in 3054, the 001 would infamously be stolen resulting in VEST creating the 002 model to hunt down and destroy the prototype. Hand made for the Solaris arenas, the Sasquatch SQS-TH-001 is an 85 ton Assault Mech powered by a 340-rated XL Engine. Primarily armed with a Gauss Rifle, the 001 has 4 Medium Pulse Lasers and an SRM-6 for close range combat. A pair of Machine Guns and a Small Laser are added as an after thought. AMS is mounted in the right torso and 6 Jump Jets improve mobility. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 001是3054年生产的大脚怪初代型号，它后来因被盗而臭名昭著，VEST公司因此制造出002型去追捕并摧毁原型机。大脚怪SQS-TH-001为索拉里斯竞技场手工打造，是一台85吨的突击机甲，由一具340级XL引擎驱动。它以一支高斯步枪为主要武器，另有4具中型脉冲激光和一具SRM-6用于混战，还顺手加装了两挺机枪和一具小型激光。右躯干装有反导弹系统，6具跳跃推进器则提升了机动性。特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column2: SQS-TH-007 将初代 Sasquatch 升级为铁纤维装甲，从而获得更强的防护。此外还各增加了一吨高斯步枪弹药和 AMS 弹药。特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

column1: The Satyr ProtoMech was designed to serve as a deep raider and reconnaissance unit. Offering only slightly more protection than a Harpy or Siren, the Satyr's best defense is to remain hidden from enemy units. The Satyr's single ER Small Laser allows it to inflict moderate damage on any enemy unit that gets too close. It also carries a Light Active Probe in its torso, allowing it to more easily find hidden units. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: 萨提尔原生机甲被设计为纵深袭掠与侦察单位。它的防护只比鹰身女妖或塞壬稍好，因此最好的防御就是不被敌方单位发现。萨提尔那门单独的增程小型激光能对任何靠得太近的敌方单位造成中等伤害；它躯干内还带一台轻型主动探测器，使其更容易发现隐藏单位。特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：0.97

Enough jump jets to vault up to ninety meters at a time helps MechWarriors get into close range, while an Anti-Missile System grants added defensive capability. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 第一套备用配置虽然以近程作战为重点，却仍携带一门增程大型激光和一门高斯步枪用于远程打击。三具 ATM 6 在各射程上都有效，而三门中型脉冲激光则为这场毁灭性攻势助力。足以一次跃出九十米的跳跃推进器帮助机甲战士迅速接近对手，一套反导弹系统则额外增强了防御能力。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：全向机甲

column1: The Savage Coyote OmniMech was created as a showcase OmniMech. The 'Mech was also part of Khan Koga's attempts to revitalize the fading Clan that invented the OmniMech.
column2: 野蛮郊狼全向机甲是作为展示用全向机甲而造的，也是可汗科加试图重振这个发明了全向机甲却日渐衰落的部族的一部分努力。ZH

column1: This variant is effective at all ranges. A pair of ER Large Lasers and a Large Pulse Laser combine with an Ultra Autocannon/5 to provide an effective long-range punch. Six Small Pulse Lasers aid at knife-fighting range and can quickly devastate conventional infantry. Two pairs of ATM 3s provide support at all ranges. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 此变型在任意距离上都有效：一对增程大型激光和一门大型脉冲激光，配合一门超级AC/5提供有效的远程重拳；六门小型脉冲激光在贴身距离上协助作战，能迅速歼灭常规步兵；两对ATM 3则在所有距离上提供支援。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The personal 'Mech of Khan Sullivan Koga, it mimics her trends in leading the Coyotes; a strong base, upgraded and enhanced by new features. Building off of the classic Awesome loadout, three ER PPCs provide long range firepower without ammo constraints, or thanks to the 23 double heatsinks, heat worries. Running relatively minimal ammo considering the heat produced by the ER PPCs, the UAC/10 and ATM 9 are more support weapons; available to finish off a target, instead of waiting for the PPCs to recharge. Khan Koga used this to great effect when attacking the Nova Cats on Huntress, splitting fire between a distant target with two PPCs, and finishing off a closer 'Mech with the UAC/10 and ATM 9. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是可汗沙利文·科加的专属机甲，延续了她统领郊狼部族时的风格：扎实的基础，再以新装备升级强化。本机在经典的"敬畏"配置上发展而来，三门增程粒子加农炮带来不受弹药限制的远程火力，而23具双散热器则让它无需担心过热。考虑到增程粒子加农炮产生的热量，它携带的弹药相对有限，UAC/10与ATM 9更像是支援武器，用于终结目标，而不必等待粒子加农炮重新冷却。科加可汗在进攻亨特雷斯星的新星猫部族时充分发挥了本机的威力：以两门粒子加农炮攻击远处目标，再用UAC/10与ATM 9解决逼近的机甲。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: It's a solid 'Mech, Boss. Triple ER PPCs, enough heatsinks to keep them cool; there's a reason everyone loves the Awesome and tries to mimic it.  That UAC/10 and ATM 9 are more of an afterthought, they don't really have enough ammo to be primary weapons, but are great at finishing off targets. You do have to admit, this Khan Koga was really ahead of their time; the mech doesn't overheat that badly on an Alpha, and most of the weaponry is ammo independent. If the other Khans were as forward thinking as her, maybe they would have won their invasion...
column2: 这是台扎实的机甲，老大。三兄弟增程PPC，散热器足够让它们保持凉爽；大家喜爱恐怖并试图模仿它是有原因的。那门UAC/10和ATM 9更像是事后加的，它们的弹药不足以作为主武器，但在收尾目标上很棒。你得承认，这位可汗科加真是超前于她的时代；这台机甲全弹齐射时过热并不严重，而且大部分武器都不依赖弹药。要是其他可汗也像她那样有远见，也许他们就能赢下入侵了……

column1: Clan Coyote created the LUNA experimental model as a reminder of their history with the Inner Sphere and Star League, borrowing heavily from Native American lore; they had foolishly left their love when trying to impress them, and their nightly howl is their eternal promise to return. The howl of the HAG 40, the burning display of the Laser Heatsinks, all reinforce the theme of announcing their love for, and sorrow for leaving, their love. Outside of the handful of Coyotes who know the stories though, the LUNA designator is assumed to be related to the effectiveness of the unit on low-atmospheric worlds, perfectly masking the feelings of those who feel the decision to stay with the Clan Homeworlds was not the right choice. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 郊狼部族创造了LUNA实验型号，以纪念他们与内层星域和星际联盟的过往，大量借用美洲原住民的传说：他们曾愚蠢地在试图讨好爱人时离开了所爱，而每夜的嗥叫便是他们永世归来的承诺。HAG 40的啸声、激光散热器的灼热光芒，都在强化这一主题：宣告他们对爱人的爱，以及离开的悲伤。不过除了少数知晓这些故事的郊狼成员之外，LUNA这个编号被外界认为与该单位在低大气星球上的效能有关，恰好完美掩盖了那些认为留在部族母星世界的决定并不正确之人的心绪。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: This is definitely dangerous on any moon.  The laser heatsinks are ideal in that low atmosphere environment, and the Ferro Lamellor armor prevents any accidental through-armor-criticals that could cause the 'Mech to suffer fatal damage, while also reducing any taken. The sextuple SRM6's are lethal to anything that gets close, while the HAG 40 allows the pilot to reach out and touch someone.  Only thing this mech needs, is something stripping armor off, so it can crit the insides of the target reliably, instead of sandpapering them.
column2: 在任何卫星上这都绝对是危险的。激光散热器在那种低大气环境中最为理想，而铁甲装甲可防止任何意外的穿甲致命伤导致机甲遭受致命损伤，同时也减少所受伤害。六具SRM6对任何靠近的东西都是致命的，而HAG 40则让机师能伸手触到别人。这台机甲唯一缺的，就是能剥掉装甲的东西，好让它可靠地对目标内部打出致命伤，而不是拿砂纸慢慢磨。ZH

column1: The SCP-1B model uses a smaller engine and replaces the PPC with a blazer, a second SRM rack, and additional heat sinks Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: SCP-1B型使用更小的引擎，并以一门双联激光炮、第二具SRM发射架和额外的散热器取代粒子加农炮 特性：改进生命维持 投放费用倍率：1.03

column1: One of the first mass production QuadMechs, the 55 ton Scorpion entered production in 2570 as an infantry support unit. Shunned by most MechWarriors due to its notoriously unstable gait, the Scorpion would nevertheless see uninterrupted use throughout the Succession Wars and beyond. The Scorpion 1N is powered by a 330-rated Fusion Core giving it a top speed of 97 km/h. A PPC and an SRM-6 form the Mechs weapons load.
column2: 作为首批量产四足机甲之一，55 吨的蝎式于 2570 年作为步兵支援单位投产。由于出了名的不稳步态，蝎式被大多数机甲战士嫌弃，却仍在继承战争及之后被不间断地使用。蝎式 1N 由 330 额定聚变核心驱动，最高速度 97 公里/小时，武器为一门 PPC 和一具 SRM-6。ZH

column1: This custom variant of the Scorpion 1N was used by the leader of the mercenary band Rubinsky's Renegades. It replaces the PPC with two arrays and two dual mountings of Clan-grade Machine Guns and a MASC. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 这款 Scorpion 1N 的定制变型由雇佣兵部队“鲁宾斯基叛徒”（Rubinsky's Renegades）的首领使用。它用两套阵列、两座双联装的部族级机枪和一套 MASC 取代了粒子加农炮。特性：改进生命维持 投放费用倍率：1.05

Shunned by most MechWarriors due to its notoriously unstable gait, the Scorpion would nevertheless see uninterrupted use throughout the Succession Wars and beyond. column1: This 'Mech was used by the Wolf's Dragoons during their campaigns in the Inner Sphere. The design replaces most of the technology in the 'Mech with Clan-grade equivalents, considerably improving the performance compared to the original Scorpion designs. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 这台机甲曾在狼之龙骑兵于内层星域的征战中使用。该设计把机甲上的大部分技术替换为部族级同类装备，性能比原版蝎子设计有了显著提升。<特性：改进生命维持系统 <投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: The Sentinel is a medium BattleMech built by Defiance Industries, originally under exclusive contract for the Lyran Commonwealth, as an infantry support and installation defense 'Mech. While initially pleased to have a then Terran Hegemony controlled factory manufacturing the 'Mech exclusively for the LCAF, the Lyrans were less so when a Star League Council amendment in 2652 permitted the Star League Defense Force to purchase a highly advanced version of the design which Houses Steiner, Marik and Davion would not receive until years later. The Sentinel was one of many designs to suffer from the technological decline of the Succession Wars era, with Defiance first losing the ability to manufacture its advanced weapon systems before discontinuing production entirely in 3014 due to lack of both parts and interest. Rather than disappear from the battlefield, the Sentinel now began to appear in increasing numbers thanks to ComStar and its massive stockpile of SLDF material, both providing the design to the Draconis Combine prior to the War of 3039 and using it to help outfit its Com Guards. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
column2: 哨兵是迪法恩斯工业建造的中型战斗机甲，最初依莱兰联邦独家合约作为步兵支援与设施防御机甲。莱兰人起初为有一家当时由地球霸权控制的工厂专为 LCAF 制造该机甲而欣喜，但当 2652 年星盟理事会修正案允许星盟防卫军采购该设计的高度先进版本、而施泰纳、马里克与达维昂家族要多年后才能获得时，他们的喜悦便大打折扣。哨兵是继承战争时代技术衰退的众多受害者之一：迪法恩斯先失去制造其先进武器系统的能力，随后于 3014 年因零件与需求双双匮乏而彻底停产。然而哨兵并未从战场消失——凭借康星及其庞大的星盟防卫军物资储备，它反而越来越多地出现：康星既在 3039 年战争前把该设计提供给德拉科尼斯联合体，也用它装备自己的康卫。特质：改进型通讯 投放费用倍率：1 臂部驱动器限制：左上臂

column1: The 1S Sentinel was the original production model commissioned by House Steiner in 2651. The 1S lacked the advanced technologies of the 3L, mounting an Defiance Model F AC/5 instead of the advanced Ultra model and a Conventry Quad-Rack SRM-4 instead of the Streak Missile Launcher. The 1S also mounted a half ton more armor, but is otherwise identical to the 3L. After years of hassles and bureaucratic maneuvering, all Lyran 1S Sentinels were eventually upgraded to 3L, only to be all but destroyed during the Succession Wars.
column2: 1S哨兵是斯坦纳家族于2651年委托建造的原始量产型号。1S缺乏3L的先进技术，装的是反抗F型AC/5而非先进的超速型号，以及一具考文垂四联SRM-4而非连发导弹发射器。1S还多装了半吨装甲，但除此之外与3L相同。经过多年麻烦与官僚运作，所有莱兰1S哨兵最终都被升级为3L，却只是在继承战争中几乎全部被摧毁。ZH

column1: The 3K Sentinel is the downgraded Succession Wars era version of the 3L model. The Ultra Autocannon and Streak SRM have both been downgraded to a Defiance Type J Autocannon and a Holly SRM-2 rack. While its speed has stayed the same, the 'Mechs endurance in the field is actually enhanced by an extra ton of autocannon reloads and an extra half ton of armor.
column2: 3K哨兵是3L型号在继承战争时代的降级版本。超速自动炮和连发SRM都被降级为一门反抗J型自动炮和一具冬青SRM-2架。虽然速度保持不变，该机甲在战场上的续航力实际上因额外一吨自动炮备用弹和额外半吨装甲而增强。ZH

column1: The 3KA Sentinel is an uncommon field refit of the 3K. This variant replaces the autocannon with a large laser, adds more armor and three extra heat sinks.
column2: 3KA哨兵是3K一种不常见的战地改装。这一改型把自动炮换成大型激光器，增加更多装甲和三具额外散热器。ZH

column1: The 3KB Sentinel is an uncommon field refit of the 3K. This variant replaces the autocannon with a PPC and three extra heat sinks.
column2: 3KB哨兵是3K不常见的野战改装。此变型以一门粒子加农炮和三个额外散热器取代自动炮。ZH

column1: The Star League Sentinel carried a somewhat unique and highly advanced armament for its time. Its primary weapon was a Kawabata Weapons Industries Ultra Autocannon/5. Developed especially for the 3L, this advanced weapon was capable of firing at double the rate of a standard AC/5, at the cost of slightly increased possibility of jamming the weapon until it can be overhauled. The Sentinel also mounted an advanced Defiance Streak SRM-2, the launcher designed to only fire if it gains a lock, saving ammo until the entire salvo is virtually guaranteed to hit. However the weapon's benefits were hampered by the companion Small laser, the swap from the fragile A-1 for more sturdy Defiance B-1A moved the launcher's ammo feed by half a meter, resulting in ammo jams during abrupt maneuvers. Though MechWarriors discovered that they could clear a jam in the field by thumping the 'Mech's chest with its right fist, opponents quickly learned to concentrate fire on any Sentinel performing this, forcing pilots to retreat from battle anyway.
column2: 星际联盟的哨兵在当时携带了一套颇为独特且高度先进的武器。主武器是一门川端武器工业超级自动炮/5。这门专为3L研制的先进武器射速可达标准AC/5的两倍，代价是卡壳直到彻底检修前无法使用的几率略高。哨兵还装有一具先进的挑战连发SRM-2，该发射器只在锁定后才开火，从而节省弹药、直到整次齐射几乎必中。然而这门武器的优势被其配套的小型激光拖累：从脆弱的A-1换成更坚固的挑战B-1A，使发射器供弹位置移动了半米，导致急机动时弹药卡滞。虽然机甲战士发现可以用右拳猛击机甲胸口来现场排除卡滞，对手很快学会集中火力打击任何这样做的哨兵，迫使机师无论如何都得退出战斗。ZH
