Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
column2: Sentinel 是由 Defiance Industries 制造的中型战斗机甲，最初依据独家合约为莱兰联邦打造，用作步兵支援与设施防御机甲。起初莱兰人还很满意——那座当时由地球霸权掌控的工厂专为 LCAF 生产该机甲；但当星际联盟议会于 2652 年通过修正案，允许星际联盟国防军采购该设计的高度先进版本，而施泰纳、马里克和达维昂家族还要再等数年才能获得时，莱兰人就不那么高兴了。Sentinel 是众多受继承战争时代技术衰退拖累的设计之一：Defiance 先是丧失了制造其先进武器系统的能力，随后又因缺少零件且缺乏兴趣，于 3014 年彻底停产。但 Sentinel 并未从战场上消失，反而开始以越来越多的数量出现——这要归功于通讯之星及其庞大的星际联盟国防军物资储备：它既在 3039 年战争前夕把该设计提供给龙脉联合体，又用它来装备自己的通讯之星卫队。特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部

column1: The Royal version of the Sentinel featured a significantly upgraded weapon load-out, mounting a Gauss Rifle in place of the autocannon and a Medium Laser in place of the Streak rack, retaining the small laser. To handle the weight of the Gauss Rifle, it was almost entirely rebuilt using a XL engine and Endo-Steel structure, with the one and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous plate enhancing its protection.
column2: 哨兵的皇家版本拥有显著升级的武器载荷，以一门高斯步枪取代自动炮、一门中型激光器取代连发SRM架，保留小型激光器。为承受高斯步枪的重量，它几乎完全重建，采用XL引擎与内层钢结构，另以一吨半铁纤装甲板增强防护。ZH

column1: An early clan Mech dating from the days of Operation Klondike, the Sentinel STC-3L-EC was an upgrade of the standard STL-3L that replaced the weapons with Early Clan variants. Prodcution of the Mech was discontinued when modern clan spec weapons entered production. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
column2: 哨兵STC-3L-EC是可追溯到克朗代克行动时期的部族早期机甲，是对标准STL-3L的升级，以部族早期型号替换了武器。随着现代部族规格武器投产，该机甲被停产。特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：左上

column1: An early clan Mech dating from the days of Operation Klondike, the Sentinel STC-3L-EC was an upgrade of the standard STL-3L that replaced the weapons with Early Clan variants. Prodcution of the Mech was discontinued when modern clan spec weapons entered production.
column2: 哨兵STC-3L-EC是可追溯到克朗代克行动时期的部族早期机甲，是对标准STL-3L的升级，以部族早期型号替换了武器。随着现代部族规格武器投产，该机甲被停产。ZH

column1: The Sentinel is a medium BattleMech built by Defiance Industries, originally under exclusive contract for the Lyran Commonwealth, as an infantry support and installation defense 'Mech. While initially pleased to have a then Terran Hegemony controlled factory manufacturing the 'Mech exclusively for the LCAF, the Lyrans were less so when a Star League Council amendment in 2652 permitted the Star League Defense Force to purchase a highly advanced version of the design which Houses Steiner, Marik and Davion would not receive until years later. The Sentinel was one of many designs to suffer from the technological decline of the Succession Wars era, with Defiance first losing the ability to manufacture its advanced weapon systems before discontinuing production entirely in 3014 due to lack of both parts and interest. Rather than disappear from the battlefield, the Sentinel now began to appear in increasing numbers thanks to ComStar and its massive stockpile of SLDF material, both providing the design to the Draconis Combine prior to the War of 3039 and using it to help outfit its Com Guards. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
column2: Sentinel是由Defiance Industries制造的中型战斗机甲，最初依据独家合约为莱兰联邦生产，作为步兵支援与设施防御机甲。莱兰人起初很高兴拥有一座当时由地球霸权掌控的工厂专为LCAF制造该机甲，但当星际联盟议会于2652年通过修正案，允许星际联盟防御军采购该设计的高度先进版本——而Steiner、Marik和Davion家族要等到多年之后才能获得——他们的心情就没那么好了。Sentinel是众多因继承战争时代技术衰退而受创的设计之一，Defiance先是失去了制造其先进武器系统的能力，随后又因零件与兴趣双双匮乏而在3014年彻底停产。Sentinel并未就此从战场上消失，反而因通讯之星及其庞大的SLDF物资储备而数量渐增——通讯之星既在3039年战争之前将该设计提供给龙脉联合体，也用它来装备自己的通讯卫队。特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左上

column1: The downgraded STN-3M model provided by ComStar to the Draconis Combine as part of Operation ROSEBUD carried attributes of both the 3L and 3K Sentinels, retaining the advanced 'Mech's Ultra autocannon, but replacing the Streak rack with a standard Markin Mini SRM-2 launcher. While House Kurita was angered as much as the loss of the LosTech system as the use of a `foreign` Magistracy of Canopus manufactured launcher, the swap allowed the small laser to be upgraded to Magna Mk II Medium Laser.
column2: 作为"玫瑰花蕾行动"的一部分，由康星提供给龙尼斯联合体的降级版STN-3M型号兼具3L与3K哨兵的特征，保留了先进机甲的超速自动炮，但把连发SRM架换成标准马金迷你SRM-2发射器。虽然栗田家族既为失去失传科技系统、也为使用一件"外国"卡诺帕治安官辖区制造的发射器而愤怒，这一更换却使小型激光器得以升级为玛格纳Mk II中型激光器。ZH

column1: The Shadow Cat is a heavily-armed and maneuverable medium OmniMech developed by Clan Nova Cat to replace the Ice Ferret in the early 31st century during preparations for Operation Revival. The SHC-M configuration boasts a full energy loadout featuring a Large Pulse Laser in each arm and a pair of ER Medium Lasers. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Shadow Cat 是一款火力强大、机动灵活的中型全向机甲，由新星猫部族在 31 世纪初为“复兴行动”做准备期间开发，用以取代 Ice Ferret。SHC-M 配置为全能量武器方案，每臂各装一门大型脉冲激光，另有一对增程中型激光。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Shadow Cat is a heavily-armed and maneuverable medium OmniMech developed by Clan Nova Cat to replace the Ice Ferret in the early 31st century during preparations for Operation Revival. The SHC-M configuration boasts a full energy loadout featuring a Large Pulse Laser in each arm and a pair of ER Medium Lasers.
column2: 影猫是新猫氏族在三十一世纪初为复兴行动做准备时研发的一种重武装、高机动中型全方位机甲，用以取代冰貂。SHC-M配置拥有全能量载荷，双臂各装一门大型脉冲激光器，另有一对增程中型激光器。ZH

column1: The personal mech of Clan Nova Cat Khan, Lucian Carns. The ''Mishapeshu'' uses a ER Large Laser in its left arm. The right arm carries an Ultra Autocannon/5 with one ton of ammo, supported by an ER Medium Laser and in the right torso, a Streak SRM-6 with a ton of ammo. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是云豹部族可汗卢西恩·卡恩斯的私人机甲。“米沙佩舒”左臂装一门增程大型激光，右臂一门超级AC/5（配一吨弹药），辅以一门增程中型激光；右躯干内则是一具连发SRM-6（配一吨弹药）。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The personal mech of Clan Nova Cat Khan, Lucian Carns. The ''Mishapeshu'' uses a ER Large Laser in its left arm. The right arm carries an Ultra Autocannon/5 with one ton of ammo, supported by an ER Medium Laser and in the right torso, a Streak SRM-6 with a ton of ammo.
column2: 这是新猫氏族可汗卢西恩·卡恩斯的私人机甲。"米沙佩舒"在左臂装一门增程大型激光器。右臂装一门超速自动炮/5配一吨弹药，由一门增程中型激光器支援，右躯干则有一具连发SRM-6配一吨弹药。ZH

column1: A 45 ton Clan OmniMech, the Shadow Cat was designed as a replacement for the Ice Ferret. Debuting in 3003, the OmniMech is powered by a 270-rated XL Engine with a combination of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous providing the free weight for 17 tons of pod space. 6 Jump Jets and MASC are hardwired to the chassis, enhancing it’s mobility. The Shadow Cat TC was originally a custom variant, but made a name for itself on Tukayyid; fighting against the massed tanks and infantry of the Comguard. An LB-10X, supported by a pair of Small Pulse Lasers and an SRM-4 make up the TC’s weapons, while an Active Probe allows the TC to scout enemy positions. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 影猫是一款 45 吨的部族全向机甲，设计初衷是替代冰貂。该全向机甲于 3003 年首次亮相，由一台额定 270 的 XL 引擎驱动，并借助钢内骨结构与铁纤维的组合腾出重量，提供 17 吨挂载空间。6 台跳跃推进器与 MASC 硬接在底盘上，进一步增强了机动性。影猫 TC 原本只是一款定制变型，却在图卡伊德一战中声名鹊起，当时它与通讯之星卫队的大批坦克和步兵交战。TC 的武器包括一门 LB-10X，辅以两门小型脉冲激光和一部 SRM-4，而一个主动探测器则让 TC 能够侦察敌方阵地。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A 45 ton Clan OmniMech, the Shadow Cat was designed as a replacement for the Ice Ferret. Debuting in 3003, the OmniMech is powered by a 270-rated XL Engine with a combination of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous providing the free weight for 17 tons of pod space. 6 Jump Jets and MASC are hardwired to the chassis, enhancing it’s mobility. The Shadow Cat TC was originally a custom variant, but made a name for itself on Tukayyid; fighting against the massed tanks and infantry of the Comguard. An LB-10X, supported by a pair of Small Pulse Lasers and an SRM-4 make up the TC’s weapons, while an Active Probe allows the TC to scout enemy positions.
column2: 作为45吨氏族全方位机甲，影猫被设计为冰貂的替代品。它于3003年首次亮相，由一具270级XL引擎驱动，内层钢与铁纤的组合提供了17吨吊舱空间的自由重量。6个跳跃推进器和MASC固接在底盘上，增强其机动性。影猫TC原本是定制改型，但在图卡伊德打出了名声；它在对抗康卫队集结的坦克与步兵时大放异彩。一门LB-10X，配以两门小型脉冲激光器和一具SRM-4构成TC的武器，而一个主动探测器让TC能侦察敌方阵地。ZH

column1: The U loadout drops both the MASC and the Jump Jets, which allows the 'Mech to carry more armor and better cooling. The mounted weapons are two Large Pulse Lasers and two ER Medium Lasers. To save costs the chassis is also downgraded to standard specification instead of using Endo Steel. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: U配置拆除了MASC和跳跃推进器，使机甲能够携带更多装甲并拥有更好的散热能力。装备的武器为两门大型脉冲激光和两门增程中型激光。为节省成本，底盘也降级为标准规格，不再使用钢内骨结构。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Shadow Cat is a heavily-armed and maneuverable medium OmniMech developed by Clan Nova Cat to replace the Ice Ferret in the early 31st century during preparations for Operation Revival. The primary configuration of the Shadow Cat wields a Gauss Rifle allowing it to handily defeat smaller opponents, often before they can get within range. A pair of smaller ER Medium Lasers back up the rifle, and an Active Probe gives the Shadow Cat the ability to detect hidden units, making it a capable scout.
column2: 影猫是新星猫氏族在三十一世纪初"复兴行动"筹备期间为取代冰貂而开发的重视武装且机动的中型全能机甲。影猫主配置装备一具高斯步枪，使它轻松击败较小的对手——往往在对方进入射程之前。两门较小的 ER 中型激光为步枪提供后备，主动探测器让影猫能发现隐藏单位，使其成为能干的侦察机甲。ZH

column1: The V configuration mounts two Large Pulse Laser and two ER Medium Lasers, making it an all energy weapon build. To handle the increased heat three additional double heat sinks were added, but in turn dropped the MASC and carries no equipment for electronic warfare. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: V 配置装设两门大型脉冲激光和两门增程中型激光，是一套纯能量武器的配置。为应对增加的热量，额外加装了三具双散热器，但相应取消了 MASC，并且未携带任何电子战设备。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The W loadout removes the Jump Jets of the primary configuration. This allows the use of three Large Pulse Lasers as the main armament of the 'Mech, with three additional heat sinks to deal with the heat build-up. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: W 配置去掉了主配置的跳跃推进器。这使机甲得以将三门大型脉冲激光作为主武器，并加装三具散热器来应对热量积累。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The X loadout is used when a formal battle challenge, more commonly knows as a batchall, is used. Since the Gauss rifle of the primary configuration is too unwieldy during such combat a LBX/5 autocannon is used instead, accompanied by a Large Pulse Laser and two SRM-4 launchers. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: X 配置用于正式的战斗挑战——通常称为“batchall”（议战）——的场合。由于主配置的高斯步枪在此类战斗中过于笨重，因此改用一门 LBX/5 自动炮，并搭配一门大型脉冲激光和两具 SRM-4 发射器。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向机甲

column1: The Shadow Hawk IIC is a second-line Clan BattleMech based upon the Shadow Hawk that was first fielded by the Star League. The first version of the Shadow Hawk IIC is meant for close-range fighting, and appears to be designed with urban warfare in mind. It is armed with a Medium Pulse Laser in each arm, two Streak SRM-2 launchers in each side torso, an ER Medium Laser in the head, and an ER Small Laser in the torso. Ten double heat sinks take care of most heat, especially since the Streaks will build no heat if they do not achieve a lock and fire. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: 影子鹰 IIC 是以星际联盟最初投入战场的影子鹰为基础开发的二线部族战斗机甲。影子鹰 IIC 的第一个版本专为近距离混战设计，其思路显然针对城市战。它在每只手臂各装一门中型脉冲激光，每个侧躯干各装两部连发 SRM-2 发射器，头部一门 ER 中型激光，躯干一门 ER 小型激光。十台双散热器足以应付大部分热量，尤其是连发导弹在未能锁定而未发射时不会产生任何热量。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.07

column1: Shadow Hawk IIC
column2: 暗影鹰 IIC

column1: Boss, these Shadow Hawk IICs are a sleek redesign of the classic Shadow Hawk.  They are lighter and faster than the original but still manage to pack a similar punch.
column2: 老板，这些暗影鹰 IIC 是经典暗影鹰的全新流线设计。它们比原版更轻更快，却仍保有相近的打击力。ZH

column1: The Shadow Hawk IIC is a second-line Clan BattleMech based upon the Shadow Hawk that was first fielded by the Star League. The second variant is designed for long-range, direct-fire support using two ER Large Lasers as its primary weapons. The ER Small Laser is retained and supplemented by three Small Pulse Lasers for close in work. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: 影子鹰IIC是一款以星际联盟最初装备的影子鹰为基础的部族二线战斗机甲。其第二种变型专为远程直射支援而设计，以两具增程大型激光为主武器；原有的增程小型激光被保留，并增配三具小型脉冲激光用于近距离作战。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.07

column1: The Shadow Hawk IIC is a second-line Clan BattleMech based upon the Shadow Hawk that was first fielded by the Star League. A newer variant that dates to the late 3050s, the IIC 3's primary weapon is a Heavy Large Laser, supplemented by a Medium Pulse Laser. The 'Mech carries paired ER Micro Lasers and Micro Pulse Lasers should it find itself in a close range fight. Four additional double heat sinks keep down the heat generated by the all-laser complement. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: Shadow Hawk IIC 是部族的二线战斗机甲，以星际联盟最初投入战场的 Shadow Hawk 为基础。作为可追溯至 3050 年代末的较新变型，IIC 3 的主武器是一门重型大型激光，并以一门中型脉冲激光作为补充。若陷入近距离交战，该机甲还配备成对的增程微型激光与微型脉冲激光。四具额外的双散热器用于压制这套全激光武器配置产生的热量。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.09

column1: The Shadow Hawk IIC is a second-line Clan BattleMech based upon the Shadow Hawk that was first fielded by the Star League. First fielded in 3060, the IIC 4 was a joint effort by Clan Nova Cat and Clan Diamond Shark to upgrade their second-line forces. The result was a 'Mech that is visually very different from the design it is considered a variant of. This 'Mech carries a ATM 6 System with three tons of varied ammunition to allow for flexibility of choice. The missile launcher is backed up by two Medium Pulse Lasers and an ER Medium Laser. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: Shadow Hawk IIC是基于星际联盟最初投入使用的Shadow Hawk而开发的部族二线战斗机甲。IIC 4于3060年首次投入使用，是Nova Cat部族与Diamond Shark部族为升级其二线部队而联合推出的成果。其成品在视觉上与它所被视为改型的那款设计大不相同。这台机甲装有ATM 6系统，配有3吨不同种类的弹药以提供选择上的灵活性。导弹发射器则由两门中型脉冲激光与一门增程中型激光作为后盾。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.07

column1: The original and considerably flawed prototypes were completed in 2680. Based on the Shadow Hawk SHD-2H, the 'Mech carried a Class 2 Autocannon in place of the Class 5. The SHD-X1 carried only 6.5 tons of armor for protection. Only one chassis survived multiple crashes caused by its faulty schematics. It had a top ground speed of 86.4 km/h like its progenitor, the SHD-2H, and used ten single heat sinks. Field refits to increase firepower with wing-mounted weapons were common, but often caused more problems than they solved. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 最初的原型机于 2680 年完成，缺陷相当明显。这台机甲以 Shadow Hawk SHD-2H 为基础，用 2 级自动炮取代了 5 级自动炮。SHD-X1 仅携带 6.5 吨装甲作为防护。由于图纸存在缺陷，多台原型机接连坠毁，最终只有一个底盘幸存下来。它的最高地面速度与其鼻祖 SHD-2H 相同，为 86.4 km/h，并使用十台单散热器。为增强火力而在翼端加装武器的野战改装十分常见，但往往带来的麻烦比解决的问题更多。特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: The original and considerably flawed prototypes were completed in 2680. Based on the Shadow Hawk SHD-2H, the 'Mech carried a Class 2 Autocannon in place of the Class 5. The SHD-X1 carried only 6.5 tons of armor for protection. Only one chassis survived multiple crashes caused by its faulty schematics. It had a top ground speed of 86.4 km/h like its progenitor, the SHD-2H, and used ten single heat sinks. Field refits to increase firepower with wing-mounted weapons were common, but often caused more problems than they solved.
column2: 最初那批缺陷颇多的原型于2680年完成。基于影子鹰SHD-2H，该机甲以一门2级自动炮取代5级自动炮。SHD-X1只携带6.5吨装甲作为防护。只有一台底盘在其故障图纸造成的多次坠毁中幸存。它像其前身SHD-2H一样最高地面速度86.4公里/小时，并使用十具单重散热器。用翼载武器提升火力的战地改装很常见，但往往带来的问题多于解决的。ZH

column1: Allied Aerospace won the SLDF's contract to produce a series of Land-Air mechs with a design based on the venerable Shadow HawkBattleMech. Allied gave their new Land-Air 'Mech the ability to convert directly into an Aerospace Fighter. While construction was completed in 2680, thanks to the chassis' numerous flaws, lackluster performance and a number of ill-fated and publicly witnessed test-flights disasters during SLDF reviews in 2682, Allied Aerospace was forced to go back to the drawing board. The more refined X2 variant faced considerable scrutiny by SLDF evaluators in 2684, successfully meeting the SLDF's requirements but still rejected thanks to its high fuel consumption and the bad press generated by the earlier X1. Twenty SHD-X2 were built for trials with potential customers, but failed to attract any interest. Ultimately Allied scrapped the Shadow Hawk LAM program in favor of what became the considerably more successful Phoenix Hawk LAM. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 同盟航空航天公司赢得了 SLDF 的合约，要以久负盛名的 Shadow Hawk 战斗机甲为基础设计一系列陆空机甲。同盟为他们的新型陆空机甲赋予了直接变形成航空航天战斗机的能力。虽然建造工作于 2680 年完成，但由于底盘存在诸多缺陷、性能乏善可陈，加上 2682 年 SLDF 审查期间发生的多起结局不幸且被公开目睹的试飞事故，同盟航空航天公司被迫回到设计图前重新来过。经过进一步改进的 X2 改型在 2684 年接受了 SLDF 评估人员的严格审查，虽然成功满足了 SLDF 的要求，却仍因燃料消耗过高以及早期 X1 造成的负面舆论而被否决。共有二十台 SHD-X2 被制造出来供潜在客户试用，却未能引起任何兴趣。最终，同盟放弃了 Shadow Hawk LAM 项目，转而发展后来取得更大成功的 Phoenix Hawk LAM。特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: The original and considerably flawed prototypes were completed in 2680. Based on the Shadow Hawk SHD-2H, the 'Mech carried a Pair of SRM-6 Valiant in place of the Class 5 Autocannon. The SHD-X3 carried only 6.5 tons of armor for protection. Only one chassis survived multiple crashes caused by its faulty schematics. It had a top ground speed of 86.4 km/h like its progenitor, the SHD-2H, and used ten single heat sinks. Field refits to increase firepower with wing-mounted weapons were common, but often caused more problems than they solved. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 最初且缺陷相当多的原型机于2680年完成。它以影子鹰SHD-2H为基础，以一对SRM-6勇者取代5型自动炮。SHD-X3只带6.5吨装甲防护。由于图纸故障导致多次坠毁，只有一台底盘幸存。它的地面速度与祖先SHD-2H一样是86.4公里/小时，使用十个单散热器。为提升火力而加装翼载武器的野战改装很常见，但往往带来的问题比解决的多。特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: The original and considerably flawed prototypes were completed in 2680. Based on the Shadow Hawk SHD-2H, the 'Mech carried a Pair of SRM-6 Valiant in place of the Class 5 Autocannon. The SHD-X3 carried only 6.5 tons of armor for protection. Only one chassis survived multiple crashes caused by its faulty schematics. It had a top ground speed of 86.4 km/h like its progenitor, the SHD-2H, and used ten single heat sinks. Field refits to increase firepower with wing-mounted weapons were common, but often caused more problems than they solved.
column2: 最初那批缺陷颇多的原型于2680年完成。基于影子鹰SHD-2H，该机甲以一对SRM-6"勇敢"取代5级自动炮。SHD-X3只携带6.5吨装甲作为防护。只有一台底盘在其故障图纸造成的多次坠毁中幸存。它像其前身SHD-2H一样最高地面速度86.4公里/小时，并使用十具单重散热器。用翼载武器提升火力的战地改装很常见，但往往带来的问题多于解决的。

column1: Introduced in 3024, this variant of the Shadow Hawk drops the SHD-2H's SRM-2 rack to free up the weight for a medium claw fitted in the SHD-1P's left arm. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 该影子鹰变型于3024年推出，它拆去SHD-2H的SRM-2发射架以腾出重量，在SHD-1P的左臂上安装了一具中型爪。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.03

column1: A multirole BattleMech developed in 2550 during the Golden Age, the Shadow Hawk is a powerful fusion of maneuverability and firepower. With a mix of long-range and short-range weapons, good maneuverability thanks to jump jets, and excellent endurance, the Shadow Hawk has long been regarded as one of the best 'Mechs in its weight class. The Shadow Hawk is equally adept whether commanding a reconnaissance company or serving as a spotter for heavy and assault lances.
column2: 暗影鹰是黄金时代 2550 年开发的多用途战斗机甲，是机动性与火力的强效融合。远程与近程武器的搭配、借助跳跃推进器获得的良好机动性、以及出色的续航力，使暗影鹰长期以来被视为同重量级中最好的机甲之一。无论是指挥侦察连，还是为重型与突击小队担任目标指示，暗影鹰都同样胜任。ZH

column1: The 2D2 is an upgrade of the -2D Shadow Hawk introduced in 3049, born of the Federated Commonwealth buying original-model 2Hs from Majesty Metals and refitting them for use by militia forces or for sale to mercenaries. Like the 2D this upgrade adds another SRM launcher to the center torso and a medium laser to the left arm, however both center torso and head launchers are Federated SuperStreak Streak SRM-2s. Besides carrying slightly more armor, a total of six and a half tons, and one ton of Streak ammo in the right torso, it is otherwise identical to the 2D Shadow Hawk. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 2D2 是 3049 年推出的 -2D Shadow Hawk 的升级型号，起因是联邦共和国从 Majesty Metals 购入原始型号的 2H，并将其改装后供民兵部队使用或出售给雇佣兵。与 2D 一样，这次升级在中央躯干增加了一具 SRM 发射器，并在左臂加装一门中型激光，不过中央躯干和头部的发射器均为 Federated SuperStreak 连发 SRM-2。除了装甲略多（共六吨半）以及在右躯干携带一吨连发弹药外，它在其他方面与 2D Shadow Hawk 完全相同。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.03

column1: A heavily modified variant of the Shadow Hawk, using Clan tech to improve its performance greatly. Originally conceptualized by Grey Death Legion, the variant has seen some spread to other mercenaries as well. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
column2: Shadow Hawk 的重度改装变型，运用部族科技大幅提升了性能。该变型最初由灰死军团构想，后来也流传到了其他雇佣兵手中。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.11

column1: An early clan Mech dating from the days of Operation Klondike, the Shadow Hawk SHD-2Hb-EC was an upgrade of the Royal SHD-2Hb that replaced the weapons with Early Clan variants. It would be discontinued and forgotten as modern clan spec weapons entered production. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 作为一款可追溯到“克朗代克行动”时代的早期部族机甲，Shadow Hawk SHD-2Hb-EC 是皇家型 SHD-2Hb 的升级版，将武器替换为早期部族型号。随着现代部族规格武器投入生产，它被停产并逐渐被人遗忘。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: An early clan Mech dating from the days of Operation Klondike, the Shadow Hawk SHD-2Hb-EC was an upgrade of the Royal SHD-2Hb that replaced the weapons with Early Clan variants. It would be discontinued and forgotten as modern clan spec weapons entered production.
column2: 暗影鹰SHD-2Hb-EC是可追溯到克朗代克行动时期的部族早期机甲，是对皇家SHD-2Hb的升级，以部族早期型号替换了武器。随着现代部族规格武器投产，它被停产并逐渐被遗忘。ZH

column1: A refit of the 2H, dropping 2 heat sinks to mount CASE protection for the ammunition and a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 这是2H的改装，拆掉2个散热器以加装弹药CASE防护和一台C3从机。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.03

column1: A Clan Buster upgrade, the Shadow Hawk 2Ht was a Comstar refit built with scrapped SLDF plans and modified for use as an Elemental hunter. Built on the standard SHD-2H chassis, the original 275-rated Fusion Core is retained along with the pair of arm mounted Medium Lasers. Replacing the AC/5 is a Large Laser, while 5 Streak SRM-2’s and a ton of ammo replace the original missile launchers. DHS replaces the original SHS, freeing up weight for CASE and an extra pair of Jump Jets. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 作为一项“反部族”升级，影鹰2Ht是通讯之星利用废弃的星际联盟防卫军图纸打造、并改造为元素猎手的改装型。它沿用标准SHD-2H底盘，保留275额定聚变核心和2门装在手臂上的中型激光。AC/5被1门大型激光取代，原有的导弹发射器则由5具连发SRM-2和1吨弹药顶替。双散热器取代了原来的单散热器，腾出的重量用于安装CASE和2具额外的跳跃推进器。<特性：战拳 <投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: A Clan Buster upgrade, the Shadow Hawk 2Ht was a Comstar refit built with scrapped SLDF plans and modified for use as an Elemental hunter. Built on the standard SHD-2H chassis, the original 275-rated Fusion Core is retained along with the pair of arm mounted Medium Lasers. Replacing the AC/5 is a Large Laser, while 5 Streak SRM-2’s and a ton of ammo replace the original missile launchers. DHS replaces the original SHS, freeing up weight for CASE and an extra pair of Jump Jets.
column2: 作为一款"灭族者"升级，影子鹰2Ht是康星用废弃的SLDF图纸改装而成，并被改作元素猎手。它建在标准SHD-2H底盘上，保留原有的275级聚变核心以及双臂的中型激光器。AC/5被换成大型激光器，而5具连发SRM-2和一吨弹药取代了原有的导弹发射器。双重散热器取代原有单重散热器，腾出重量用于CASE和额外一对跳跃推进器。ZH

column1: Introduced in 2846, this variant of the Shadow Hawk replaces its AC/5 with a medium rifle, supplied by two tons of ammunition. Further changes include an additional ton of ammunition for the LRM-5 launcher, the removal of two single heat sinks and the installation of a supercharger. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 这是2846年推出的影子鹰变型，以一门中型步枪（配两吨弹药）取代AC/5。其他改动还包括为LRM-5发射器增加一吨弹药、拆掉两个单散热器，并安装一台增压器。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.03

column1: A rare ''upgrade'' to the classic Shadow Hawk, the SHD-3H arose out of the political manoeuvring that surrounded the development of the Royal Shadow Hawk. Created as cover for the 2Hb program, the SHD-3H is a stock Shadow Hawk refitted for anti-insurgent work. A pair of Machine Guns and a ton of ammo replace the original SRM-2. The design can still be seen well into the 31st century with units lacking supplies often being forced to convert damaged 2H models to the 3H standard. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 作为对经典影子鹰的一次罕见“升级”，SHD-3H源于围绕皇家影子鹰研制而展开的政治运作。3H是为2Hb计划作掩护而造，是把现成影子鹰改装用于反叛乱工作的产物。一对机枪和一吨弹药取代了原来的SRM-2。直到31世纪仍能看到这一设计，缺乏补给的部队往往被迫把受损的2H型号改成3H标准。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.03

column1: A rare ''upgrade'' to the classic Shadow Hawk, the SHD-3H arose out of the political manoeuvring that surrounded the development of the Royal Shadow Hawk. Created as cover for the 2Hb program, the SHD-3H is a stock Shadow Hawk refitted for anti-insurgent work. A pair of Machine Guns and a ton of ammo replace the original SRM-2. The design can still be seen well into the 31st century with units lacking supplies often being forced to convert damaged 2H models to the 3H standard.
column2: 作为对经典影子鹰的一次稀有"升级"，SHD-3H源自围绕皇家影子鹰研发的政治运作。它作为2Hb项目的掩护而创，是一台为反叛乱工作改装的现有影子鹰。两挺机枪和一吨弹药取代了原有的SRM-2。直到三十一世纪仍可见到该设计，缺乏补给的部队常被迫把受损的2H型号改装为3H标准。ZH

column1: An offshoot of the SHD-3H design, the Shadow Hawk SHD-3H2 is a full redesign of the 3H model. Intended for Terran Hegemony militia units, the 3H2 is optimised for anti-vehicle and anti-insurgent warfare. Somewhat slower then a standard Shadow Hawk due to the replacement of the 275 rated engine with a 220 rated one, the 3H2 uses the extra weight to pack in a pair of Small Lasers, 3 SRM-4 launchers and a Vehicular Grenade Launcher. Leftover Ferro-Fibrous armour from the Royal SHD-2Hb production line is used to improve armour protection. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 作为 SHD-3H 设计的分支，暗影鹰 SHD-3H2 是对 3H 型号的全面重新设计。3H2 面向地球霸权民兵部队，针对反车辆与反叛乱作战进行了优化。由于 275 级引擎被替换为 220 级，它比标准暗影鹰稍慢一些，3H2 便利用多出的重量塞进了两门小型激光、3 具 SRM-4 发射器和一具车载榴弹发射器。皇家 SHD-2Hb 生产线上剩余的铁纤维装甲被用于加强装甲防护。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.03

column1: An offshoot of the SHD-3H design, the Shadow Hawk SHD-3H2 is a full redesign of the 3H model. Intended for Terran Hegemony militia units, the 3H2 is optimised for anti-vehicle and anti-insurgent warfare. Somewhat slower then a standard Shadow Hawk due to the replacement of the 275 rated engine with a 220 rated one, the 3H2 uses the extra weight to pack in a pair of Small Lasers, 3 SRM-4 launchers and a Vehicular Grenade Launcher. Leftover Ferro-Fibrous armour from the Royal SHD-2Hb production line is used to improve armour protection.
column2: 作为SHD-3H设计的分支，影子鹰SHD-3H2是对3H型号的全面重新设计。它面向地球霸权民兵部队，针对反车辆与反叛乱作战进行了优化。由于275额定引擎换成220额定，3H2比标准影子鹰略慢；它利用额外的重量塞入两门小型激光、3具SRM-4发射器和一具车载榴弹发射器。皇家SHD-2Hb生产线上剩余的铁纤维装甲也被用来提升装甲防护。ZH

column1: The 5S2 has the same layout as the 5S, expect a slightly adjusted armor profile. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 5S2的布局与5S相同，只是装甲分布略有调整。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: The 5SF is a variant of the 5M used by the Special Forces. It replaces all standard weapons with one Large Laser, one medium pulse laser and four medium lasers. In addition, it carries a Beagle Active Probe and an ECM Suite. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 5SF是特种部队使用的5M变型。它以一门大型激光、一门中型脉冲激光和四门中型激光取代全部标准武器，此外还带一台比格犬主动探测器和一套电子对抗套件。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: The 5SF is a variant of the 5M used by the Special Forces. It replaces all standard weapons with one Large Laser, one medium pulse laser and four medium lasers. In addition, it carries a Beagle Active Probe and an ECM Suite.
column2: 5SF是特种部队使用的5M改型。它把所有标准武器换成一门大型激光器、一门中型脉冲激光器和四门中型激光器。此外，它还携带一个比格犬主动探测器和一套ECM套件。ZH

column1: A Clan-tech retrofit of the classic Shadow Hawk and intended for second-line and solahma troops, the Shadow Hawk C replaces all Inner Sphere–tech weaponry with Clan equivalents. The C mounts an LB 5-X AC, an LRM-5 equipped with Swarm LRM munitions, a Streak SRM-2, and an ER medium laser. Two additional jump jets were added, extending the jump radius to 150 meters, as well as one additional single heat sink. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 影子鹰C是对经典影子鹰的部族技术改装，供二线与索拉玛部队使用，它以部族同类武器替换了全部内层星域技术的武器。C型装备一门LB 5-X自动炮、一具使用蜂群LRM弹药的LRM-5、一具连发SRM-2和一具增程中型激光。它还加装了两具跳跃推进器，把跳跃半径扩大到150米，并增加了一具单散热器。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.03

column1: A custom variant supposedly created by Grayson Death Carlyle, despite the fact that neither Grayson nor second Shadow Hawk pilot Sharyl piloted such a variant, the Gray Death swaps the AC/5 for an AC/10 with two tons of ammunition, and carries two medium lasers in each arm. The LRM-5 and SRM-2 are kept, along with the three jump jets, and cooling is handled by 12 double heat sinks. The tonnage required for the heavier weapons loadout is freed up by using a 275-rated XL engine. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 这个定制变型据称出自格雷森·戴斯·卡莱尔之手，尽管格雷森本人和二号 Shadow Hawk 机师莎莉尔都从未驾驶过这样的变型。Gray Death 以一门 AC/10 和两吨弹药替换了 AC/5，并在每条手臂各装两门中型激光。LRM-5 和 SRM-2 得以保留，三具跳跃推进器也一并留下，散热则由 12 具双散热器负责。更重武器配置所需的吨位，通过换装 275 级 XL 引擎腾出。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: This custom Shadow Hawk mounts a trio of LB 2-X ACs in it's right torso supported by a pair of MRM-10 racks in the left torso. Built around an 255-rated XL engine, double heat sinks, endo steel frame and clad in light ferro-fibrous armor, the Scattershot carries a total of three tons of LBX rounds and three tons of MRM reloads. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: 这台定制影子鹰在右躯干装三门LB 2-X自动炮，左躯干则以两具MRM-10挂架支援。它围绕一台255额定XL引擎、双散热器与钢内骨结构框架建造，披挂轻型铁纤维装甲，总共携带三吨LBX弹药与三吨MRM再装填弹药。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.07

column1: The Sheepdog is more advanced than its first deceiving appearance, using Ferro-Fibrous armor, Endo Steel structure and an 100 XL engine - all to save weight. One medium laser and one small laser are accompanied by a strong sensor suite, a C3 slave and a MASC system for even faster movement. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: Sheepdog 比它初看之下极具迷惑性的外表要先进得多：它采用铁纤维装甲、钢内骨结构和一台 100 XL 引擎，一切都是为了减轻重量。一门中型激光和一门小型激光之外，还搭配了强大的传感器套件、一个 C3 从属单元以及一套 MASC 系统，使移动更加迅捷。特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：0.99

column1: The Sheepdog is a 10-ton ultralight 'Mech commonly seen sprinting across the battlefield throughout the Inner Sphere. Although both lightly armored and under-armed, its sheer speed makes it a decently competent scout - as long as the 'Mech never stops moving.
column2: 牧羊犬是一种10吨超轻型机甲，常见于内天体各处疾驰过战场。虽然装甲轻薄、武装不足，但它纯粹的速度使它成为相当称职的侦察兵——只要这台机甲永不停止移动。ZH

column1: Downgraded by the Dragoons to Succession Wars era technology the 2E simply carries a PPC in place of the ER PPC. Otherwise, the 2E is completely identical to the 2F model. Ironically, because the 2E uses an older PPC model, the PPC produces less heat at the cost of a shorter range than the 2F model, making the 'Mech's waste heat easier to manage. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 龙骑兵将该机降级至继承战争时代的技术水平，2E 仅以粒子加农炮取代增程粒子加农炮。除此之外，2E 与 2F 型完全相同。颇具讽刺意味的是，由于 2E 使用较老的粒子加农炮型号，其粒子加农炮产生的热量更少，但射程比 2F 型更短，反而让机甲废热的管控更为容易。特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: The Shogun began production before the Star League fell and eventually was thought to be lost to the Succession Wars. The 'Mech suddenly reappeared when Wolf's Dragoons showed up in 3005, bringing a sizable number of Shoguns with them. The 'Mech was intended to be used as an urban combat 'Mech where its jumping distance and slow speed makes it able to easily traverse the close confines of a city. Though the Dragoons brought Shoguns with them from the Clan Homeworlds, they could not reach a deal with any manufacturer that met their desires, so by 3068 the total count of the 'Mech in the Inner Sphere was reduced to two, both of which were in the hands of Wannamaker's Widowmakers, taken as salvage from the Dragoons.
column2: 将军在星盟陨落之前就已投产，最终被认为已随继承战争失传。当狼之龙骑兵于 3005 年现身时，这台机甲突然重现，龙骑兵带来了数量可观的将军。该机甲本意是用作城市战机甲，其跳跃距离与缓慢速度使它能在城市的狭窄空间中轻松穿行。尽管龙骑兵从氏族母星带来了将军，他们却未能与任何制造商达成符合期望的协议，因此到 3068 年，内天体的将军总数降至两台，且都在"瓦纳梅克的寡妇制造者"手中，是从龙骑兵那里缴获的。ZH

column1: Though built for close combat, the weapons payload on the Shogun is built for long range combat. The 'Mech carries as its primary weapon a ER PPC and two LRM-15 launchers which allow the 'Mech to engage an enemy very effectively at long ranges. The 'Mech does also carry two SRM-6 launchers for close combat, allowing the 'Mech to find any weak spots in an enemy's armor when they do get to close ranges with the Shogun. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 尽管将军是为混战而生，其武器配置却是围绕远距离交战打造的。该机甲的主武器是一门 增程粒子加农炮和两部 LRM-15 发射器，使其能在远距离上极为有效地压制敌人。此外它还携带两部 SRM-6 发射器用于混战，一旦敌人贴近将军，便能借此在敌方装甲上寻找任何薄弱之处。特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The original 2777 Shogun model is similar to the 3050's era SHG-2F, adding Artemis IV fire control systems to the LRM racks. The SRM-6 racks are replaced with four Streak SRM-2 launchers, which share a single ton of ammunition. A head-mounted Medium Pulse Laser and a medium laser in the center torso rounds out the weapons. Armorscale ferro-fibrous armor and CASE protect the 'Mech. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 最初的2777年将军型与3050年代的SHG-2F相似，为LRM发射巢加装了阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统。SRM-6发射巢被替换为四具连发SRM-2发射器，它们共用一个吨位的弹药。头部安装的一门中型脉冲激光与中央躯干的一门中型激光补全了武器配置。装甲鳞式铁纤维装甲与CASE保护着这台机甲。特性：炮管铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A pirate refit of the Shogun, mounting three LRM-5 and three SRM-2 launchers in each arm, with a single standard PPC in the right torso. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是海盗对将军的改装：每只手臂装三具LRM-5和三具SRM-2发射器，右躯干一门标准粒子加农炮。特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: An unofficial refresh of the SHG-2F, the 4F places the SRM launchers with Streak SRM-4s and adds an Artemis IV FCS for each LRM launcher. The design is obviously inspired the Shogun C the Wolf's Dragoons introduced to the Inner Sphere, but due to having no access to Clan-level technology the 4F is slightly worse in most regards. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: 作为SHG-2F的非官方改良版，4F将SRM发射器换成连发SRM-4，并为每具LRM发射器加装一套Artemis IV火控系统。该设计显然受到狼之龙骑兵引入内层星域的幕府将军C的启发，但由于无法获得部族级技术，4F在多数方面都略逊一筹。特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.15

column1: The 4W is a custom variant of the Shogun brought by the Wolf's Dragoons to the Inner Sphere prior to the Clan Invasion. The fact it uses far more advanced technology than was available to the Great Houses meant its more efficient weapons loadout of two LRM-15 and four Streak SRM-6, combined with an ER PPC, really stood out. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 4W 是狼之龙骑兵在部族入侵之前带到内层星域的 Shogun 定制变型。它所使用的技术远比各大家族的现役装备先进，因此其更高效的武器配置——两门 LRM-15 和四部连发 SRM-6，再加上一门增程粒子加农炮——格外引人注目。特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.21 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A complete redesign of the Shogun using Clan technology that is used exclusively by Wolf's Dragoons, the Shogun C is armed with two LRM-20 missile racks with an Artemis IV fire control system for greater missile accuracy. The 'Mech also carries an ER PPC and four Streak SRM-6 launchers, giving it a devastating close range damage capability. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是用部族技术对将军做的彻底重新设计，为狼之龙骑兵独用。将军C装有两具带阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统的LRM-20导弹挂架以提高导弹精度，另有一门增程粒子加农炮和四具连发SRM-6发射器，赋予它毁灭性的近程伤害能力。特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.21 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A variant of the standard Shootist ST-8A, the ST-8A2 is a refit designed to enhance the Mech's utility as a bodyguard for Command lances. A class D refit, the 8A2 replaces the standard Medium Pulse Lasers with standard Medium Lasers. The free tonnage this creates is used to install a Beagle Active Probe and upgrade the Small Laser to a Pulse model. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
column2: 作为标准枪手ST-8A的变型，ST-8A2是一次改装，旨在提升该机甲作为指挥小队护卫的实用性。作为D级改装，8A2以标准中型激光取代标准中型脉冲激光，由此产生的自由吨位用于安装一台比格犬主动探测器，并把小型激光升级为脉冲型号。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左上

column1: A variant of the standard Shootist ST-8A, the ST-8A2 is a refit designed to enhance the Mech's utility as a bodyguard for Command lances. A class D refit, the 8A2 replaces the standard Medium Pulse Lasers with standard Medium Lasers. The free tonnage this creates is used to install a Beagle Active Probe and upgrade the Small Laser to a Pulse model.
column2: 作为标准射击手ST-8A的一个改型，ST-8A2是一次旨在提升该机甲作为指挥分队护卫效用的改装。作为D级改装，8A2把标准中型脉冲激光器换成标准中型激光器。由此产生的自由吨位用于安装一个比格犬主动探测器，并把小型激光器升级为脉冲型号。ZH

column1: The Shrike relies on its speed to flank any foes, as it lacks the firepower to easily punch through the thicker frontal armor of most foes. Its equipped with four ER Medium Lasers and four Machine guns, and a single center torso mounted flamer. An ECM and active probe ensures the 'Mech can keep its targets locked. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: Shrike 依靠速度迂回包抄敌人，因为它的火力不足以轻易击穿大多数对手较厚的正面装甲。它装备四门增程中型激光、四挺机枪，以及一具安装在中央躯干的火焰喷射器。电子对抗套件与主动探测器确保该机甲能始终锁定目标。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.1

column1: The Shrike is a 50-ton QuadMech designed and fielded by Clan Hell's Horses. The combination of a 350 XL engine, seven jump jets and a MASC makes the 'Mech extremely mobile despite its size.
column2: 伯劳是地狱马氏族设计并部署的一种50吨四足机甲。一具350 XL引擎、七个跳跃推进器和一具MASC的组合，使该机甲尽管体型不小却极为机动。ZH

column1: This is Your Fault. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 这是你的错。特性：空中突击 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: Intended to keep its enemies at medium to long ranges, the Shugenja is armed with an ER PPC that is capable of striking an enemy at a distance, allowing the Shugenja to snipe at its victims. For just outside medium range to short range, the 'Mech carries a MRM-30 launcher and two Large Lasers. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 修验者意在把敌人保持在中远程，装有一门能远距离打击敌人的增程粒子加农炮，使其得以狙击目标。在中距外到近距范围内，它带一具MRM-30发射器和两门大型激光。特性：机罩 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Designed to be a heavy C3 command 'Mech the Shugenja is built around a chassis that supports a 300 XL engine which gives the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h allowing the Shugenja to keep up with most 'Mechs of its size while sacrificing durability for more free weight. The Shugenjas C3 computer allows it to act as a hub for friendly units equipped with C3 slave units to share targeting data.
column2: 作为重型C3指挥机甲而设计，修验者建在一副支持300 XL引擎的底盘上，使该机甲最高速度达到64.8公里/小时，让修验者能跟上大多数同尺寸机甲，同时牺牲耐久性换取更多自由重量。修验者的C3计算机让它能充当装配有C3从属系统的友军单位的枢纽，共享瞄准数据。ZH

column1: Apparently based on the Timber Wolf, the Sidewinder OmniMech was developed by Clan Cloud Cobra in preparation for the Clan Invasion of the Inner Sphere. When it turned out that the Cloud Cobras would likely not be among the invader clans they became increasingly desperate and eventually fielded a Sidewinder against Clan Jade Falcon in a trial on Babylon that they lost. The Jade Falcons salvaged the heavily damaged 'Mech and all available information is based on their investigation of the design. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 响尾蛇全向机甲表面上以森林狼为基础，由云眼镜蛇部族为筹备对内层星域的部族入侵而研制。当事实证明云眼镜蛇很可能不在入侵部族之列后，他们愈发绝望，最终在巴比伦星上的一场试炼中派出一台响尾蛇对抗翡翠猎鹰部族，结果落败。翡翠猎鹰回收了这台受损严重的机甲，现存的所有资料都基于他们对这一设计的调查。特性：改进生命维持 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Siren ProtoMech was originally designed by Clan Smoke Jaguar to serve as a reconnaissance unit. Its high speed allowed it to rush forward, find enemy forces, call in a missile strike, and evacuate without the enemy being able to see them. As the Siren was intended to be a scout and observer, it only carries a Light Machine Gun in either arm. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: 塞壬原型机甲最初由烟豹部族设计，用作侦察单位。其高速度使其能够迅速前出、发现敌军、呼叫导弹打击，并在敌人察觉之前撤离。由于塞壬的定位是侦察与观察，它仅在每条手臂上装有一挺轻型机枪。特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：0.96

column1: The Siren ProtoMech was originally designed by Clan Smoke Jaguar to serve as a reconnaissance unit. Its high speed allowed it to rush forward, find enemy forces, call in a missile strike, and evacuate without the enemy being able to see them. As the Siren was intended to be a scout and observer, it only carries a Light Machine Gun in either arm.
column2: 塞壬原型机甲最初由烟虎氏族设计用作侦察单位。它的高速度使其能冲向前方、发现敌军、呼叫导弹打击，然后在敌人看不到它们的情况下撤离。由于塞壬本意是侦察与观察单位，它只在双臂各装一挺轻机枪。ZH

column1: The Siren ProtoMech was originally designed by Clan Smoke Jaguar to serve as a reconnaissance unit. Its high speed allowed it to rush forward, find enemy forces, call in a missile strike, and evacuate without the enemy being able to see them. Introduced during the 3060s, this variant of the Siren was upgraded with regular Machine Guns. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: 塞壬原生机甲最初由烟虎部族设计，用作侦察单位。它的高速度让它能冲上前去、发现敌军、呼叫导弹打击，然后在敌人来不及看清的情况下撤离。此变型于3060年代推出，塞壬被升级为装备标准机枪。特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：0.96

column1: The Siren ProtoMech was originally designed by Clan Smoke Jaguar to serve as a reconnaissance unit. Its high speed allowed it to rush forward, find enemy forces, call in a missile strike, and evacuate without the enemy being able to see them. Introduced during the 3060s, this variant of the Siren was upgraded with regular Machine Guns.
column2: 塞壬原生机甲最初由烟虎部族设计，用作侦察单位。它的高速度让它能冲上前去、发现敌军、呼叫导弹打击，然后在敌人来不及看清的情况下撤离。此变型于3060年代推出，塞壬被升级为装备标准机枪。ZH

column1: Introduced in 3060, the 95-ton Sirocco was conceived as a replacement for the older Goliath QuadMech. Built by Corean Enterprises, the Sirocco is powered by a 285-rated Fusion Core giving it a top speed of 50 km/h. The Sirocco SRC-3C is armed with a pair of UAC/10s and a quad of ER Medium Lasers. A Medium Pulse Laser, two Anti-Personnel Pods and a Guardian ECM round out the arsenal. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: 95吨的沙洛科于3060年推出，构想为老式歌利亚四肢机甲的替代品，由科林企业建造。沙洛科由一台285额定聚变核心驱动，最高速度50公里/小时。沙洛科SRC-3C装有一对UAC/10和四门增程中型激光，另有一门中型脉冲激光、两具反人员舱和一具守护者电子对抗套件补全武装。特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.17

column2: 西罗科于3060年推出，95吨，被构想为老旧歌利亚四足机甲的替代品。西罗科由科雷恩企业建造，装有一具285级聚变核心，最高速度50公里/小时。西罗科SRC-3C武装为两门UAC/10和四门增程中型激光器。另有一门中型脉冲激光器、两个反人员吊舱和一套守卫者ECM补全了武备。ZH

The Sirocco SRC-5C is armed with a pair of Light Gauss Rifles and a quad of ER Medium Lasers. A Medium Pulse Laser, two Anti-Personnel Pods and a Guardian ECM round out the arsenal. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: 于 3060 年推出的 95 吨 Sirocco，最初是为取代较老的 Goliath 四足机甲而构想。Sirocco 由科林企业制造，搭载额定 285 的聚变核心，最高速度可达 50 km/h。Sirocco SRC-5C 装备一对轻型高斯步枪和四门增程中型激光，另有一门中型脉冲激光、两个反步兵吊舱和一具守卫者电子对抗套件，使武器配置趋于完整。特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.17

column1: Reportedly piloted by Star Colonel Jaela Ward, the Orion IIC Hero 'Mech retains the right torso mounted Gauss Rifle unchanged but swaps the LRM rack for an ER PPC, upgrades the SRM-4 rack with Artemis IV FCS and downgrades the arm lasers to ER Medium Lasers. Carrying three tons of Gauss rounds and two of SRM reloads, the weight saved allows the mounting of two extra double heat sinks and MASC. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 据称由星上校杰拉·沃德驾驶的猎户座IIC英雄机甲保留了右躯干上的高斯步枪，但把LRM发射架换成了增程粒子加农炮，为SRM-4发射架加装阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统，并将手臂激光降级为增程中型激光。它携带三吨高斯步枪弹和两吨SRM备弹，节省下来的重量用于加装两具双散热器和MASC。特性：防空瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Reportedly piloted by Star Colonel Jaela Ward, the Orion IIC Hero 'Mech retains the right torso mounted Gauss Rifle unchanged but swaps the LRM rack for an ER PPC, upgrades the SRM-4 rack with Artemis IV FCS and downgrades the arm lasers to ER Medium Lasers. Carrying three tons of Gauss rounds and two of SRM reloads, the weight saved allows the mounting of two extra double heat sinks and MASC.
column2: 据报由星上校贾艾拉·沃德驾驶，猎户座IIC英雄机甲保留右躯干高斯步枪不变，但把LRM架换成增程PPC，将SRM-4架升级为带阿尔忒弥斯IV火控的型号，并把臂部激光器降级为增程中型激光器。它携带三吨高斯步枪弹和两吨SRM备用弹，节省下的重量则用于加装两具额外双重散热器和MASC。ZH

column1: The Inner Sphere adapted to battle armor quickly after being introduced to the concept by the Clan Elemental suit, so much so that the IS started innovating and testing the limits of what was possible almost immediately. In the 3050s the Lyran Commonwealth led the charge with this, the Sloth, the first quadruped battle armor. The Lyrans armed each suit with two Small Lasers and a BA-scale Pop-Up Mine, a weapon designed to penetrate armor and deal direct internal damage. The Sloth proved dangerous but unwieldy to control, making it unpopular with pilots. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.892 Can only be transported by internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.
column2: 在部族元素战斗装甲服让内层星域接触到这一概念后，内层星域很快便适应了战斗装甲，甚至几乎立刻就开始创新并试探各种可能性的极限。3050 年代，莱兰联邦率先推出了这款 Sloth——首款四足战斗装甲。莱兰人为每套装甲配备两门小型激光和一枚战斗装甲级弹出式地雷，这种武器专门用于穿透装甲并直接造成内部伤害。Sloth 威力惊人，但操控起来十分笨拙，因此不受机师欢迎。特性：标准零件 投放费用倍率：0.892 只能通过内部舱室运输，无法近战，无法攀附。

The Lyrans armed each suit with two Small Lasers and a BA-scale Pop-Up Mine, a weapon designed to penetrate armor and deal direct internal damage. The Sloth proved dangerous but unwieldy to control, making it unpopular with pilots.
column2: 内天体在经元素战斗服引入战斗装甲概念后迅速适应，适应之快甚至让内天体几乎立刻开始创新并试探可能性的极限。3050年代，莱兰联邦带头推出这款"树懒"——首款四足战斗装甲。莱兰人为每套战斗服配备两门小型激光器和一具战斗装甲规格的弹出式地雷，一种为穿透装甲并直接造成内部伤害而设计的武器。树懒被证明危险但难以操控，因此不受机师欢迎。ZH

column1: The Slowpoke is armed with a single medium laser in the center torso. With a movement profile matching the infamous UrbanMech, its two and a half tons of armor is woefully inadequate even though it provides near maximum protection for a 'Mech of this small size. The jump jets can vault the Slowpoke 65 meters. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: Slowpoke 在中央躯干装有一门中型激光。它拥有与臭名昭著的 UrbanMech 相同的机动性能，两吨半的装甲即便对如此小型的机甲而言已接近最大防护，却依然严重不足。跳跃推进器能让 Slowpoke 跃出 65 米。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：0.99

column1: The third Great House to develop an ultralight BattleMech, after House Davion and House Kurita, House Liao created the Slowpoke in response to the appearance of the Federated Suns' Junior in the twenty-fifth century. An altogether unimpressive design due to poor planning and implementation of its conception and manufacture, the Slowpoke never reached any greater success and was often relegated to secondary duties.
column2: 作为继戴维恩家族与库瑞塔家族之后第三个开发超轻型战斗机甲的大望族，廖氏家族在25世纪为回应联邦太阳国“少年”的出现而打造了懒汉。由于构想与制造的计划与执行都很差，该设计毫无亮点，从未取得更大成功，常被降级用于次要任务。ZH

column1: The Snake is a 'Mech that was built under the aegis of an Elemental hunter. With the power of hindsight though the Snake is clearly designed to hunt Inner Sphere Battle Armor suits. The 'Mech is built using a Vox 225 XL Engine to move at a top speed of 86.4 km/h. The Snake also has a jumping capability of one hundred and fifty meters making it capable of outmaneuvering any battle armor suit and also keeping it on par with most medium 'Mechs. The Snake is also armored with seven tons of armor and uses double heat sinks to cool the 'Mech's excess heat. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 蛇式最初是在“元素猎手”的名目下打造的。不过事后看来，蛇式显然是为猎杀内层星域的战斗装甲而设计的。这台机甲采用 Vox 225 XL 引擎，最高速度可达 86.4 km/h。蛇式还能跳跃一百五十米，这使它能够以机动性压制任何战斗装甲，同时也与大多数中型机甲不相上下。蛇式还配有七吨装甲，并使用双散热器来冷却机甲多余的热量。特性：改进瞄准 - 近程 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: A customized variant produced for House Marik MechWarrior Alexi Danisov. During Operation Guerrero, his Liao-built Snake was always running out of ammunition. With ammunition scarce, Alexi had his BattleMech's LB-X 10 Class Autocannon replaced with a pair of Large Lasers. The 'Mech performed well, and Alexi retained these weapons and upgraded the lasers to Extended Range Models.
column2: 这是为马里克家族机师亚历克西·丹尼索夫生产的定制改型。在格雷罗行动期间，他那台廖氏制造的蛇总是打光弹药。由于弹药紧缺，亚历克西把机甲上的LB-X 10级自动炮换成两门大型激光器。该机甲表现出色，亚历克西保留了这些武器，并把激光器升级为增程型号。ZH

column1: Armed with only a head-mounted Series ER Medium Laser and a pair of ER Small Lasers, the Snow Fox excels at making high-speed passes. Though the 'Mech uses standard heat sinks, it takes an extremely bad pilot to cause the Snow Fox any overheating problems. Finally, it is protected as well as it can be by four tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
column2: 雪狐只装有头部一门系列增程中型激光和两门增程小型激光，擅长高速掠袭。虽然该机甲使用标准散热器，但要让它过热得有个极差劲的机师才行。最后，它由四吨铁纤维装甲提供尽可能好的防护。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.01

column1: Snow Fox
column2: 雪狐

column1: The Snow Fox was designed by Clan Ice Hellion as a fast 'Mech that is capable of fulfilling a number of roles. Its primary weapon is its speed, which it uses to quickly close with enemies, swiftly damage them, and get out before repeating the process. It has also found use as a Battle Armor hunter. The Hellions scientists were also gauging warrior interest in a quad design and saw the Snow Fox as a test bed for a future quad OmniMech, but the interest was not there. Not only are bipedal 'Mechs more intuitive to operate, the fast quad takes getting used to and lacks hands.
column2: 雪狐由冰地狱狮部族设计为一款能胜任多种角色的快速机甲。它的主要武器就是速度：用它迅速逼近敌人、快速造成伤害，然后在重复这一过程之前撤离。它也常用于猎杀战斗装甲。地狱狮的科学家还在试探战士对四足设计的兴趣，把雪狐当作未来四足全向机甲的试验平台，但兴趣并不存在——不仅双足机甲操作更直观，快速的四足机体也需要时间适应，而且没有手。ZH

column1: The first known variant of the Snow Fox introduced 3015 during the Succession Wars era or Golden Century. This variant replaces the lasers with an LRM-10, creating a very mobile support 'Mech. It is also incapable of building any noticeable amount of heat before it starts taking damage. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
column2: Snow Fox首个已知变型，于3015年推出，时值继承战争时代或黄金世纪。该变型以LRM-10取代激光，打造出一款机动性极强的支援机甲。此外，它在开始承受损伤之前也不会积累起任何明显的热量。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.01

column1: StarCorps Industries’s Project: SORCERER was shrouded in such secrecy that the first Sorcerer Battlemechs just seemed to appear in Star League Defense Force ranks where they were met with varying degrees of suspicion. The 95-ton Sorcerer 1A is built around a PlasmaStar 380XL engine to propel it to a respectable 64.8 km/h which enables the Sorcerer to bring its arsenal and Guardian ECM Suite to the enemy. The design carries a pair of Ceres Arms Smasher PPCs, a pair of Donal Snub-Nose PPCs, a pair of Magna MkII Medium Lasers, and a Magna MkI Small Laser. A staggering twenty Double Heat Sinks is barely enough to keep the weapons’ heat generation in check. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: StarCorps Industries 的“SORCERER 计划”笼罩在重重保密之中，以至于首批 Sorcerer 战斗机甲仿佛是凭空出现在星际联盟防御部队的序列里，引来程度不一的猜疑。95 吨的 Sorcerer 1A 围绕一台 PlasmaStar 380XL 引擎打造，可推进至相当可观的 64.8 km/h，使 Sorcerer 得以为敌人送上其全套武器与 Guardian 电子对抗套件。该设计装有两门 Ceres Arms Smasher 粒子加农炮、两门 Donal 短鼻粒子加农炮、两门 Magna MkII 中型激光和一门 Magna MkI 小型激光。惊人的二十具双散热器也仅勉强能将武器产生的热量控制住。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.17

column1: That's a lot of lightning, boss. You play your cards right, this monster will be spitting out four PPCs without breaking much sweat. Oh, and it's pretty quick on its feet too.
column2: 那可是不少闪电啊，老板。只要你牌打得好，这头怪物一口气喷出四门粒子加农炮都不带喘的。哦对了，它腿脚还挺利索。ZH

column1: Shortly after the Sorcerer 1A began walking off of the StarCorps Industries production lines on Fletcher, the Sorcerer 1B began production in the satellite facility on Crofton. The 1B variant trades in the array of PPCs and Lasers for a Blankenburg Technologies ER PPC, a pair of Artemis IV-enhanced Holly LRM15s, and a trio of Defiance P5M Medium Pulse Lasers. The reduced Heat generation of this payload allowed designers to remove the five external Double Heat Sinks and freed up room for CASE in the right torso. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: Sorcerer 1A开始从Fletcher的StarCorps Industries生产线上下线后不久，Sorcerer 1B也在Crofton的卫星工厂投产。1B改型用一门Blankenburg Technologies增程粒子加农炮、两具经Artemis IV增强的Holly LRM15以及三门Defiance P5M中型脉冲激光，换掉了原有的整组粒子加农炮与激光。这套配置产生的热量更低，让设计人员得以拆掉那五具外挂双散热器，并腾出空间在右侧躯干加装CASE。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.17

column1: I've heard these Sorcerer 1B's called 'That other Sorcerer' a few times. Despite being produced around the same time as the 1A, the 1B's weapon payload is notably different; primarily that is trades the array of PPCs for an ER PPC and a pair of LRM launchers. If someone tries to under-run your LRMs, this thing's three Medium Pulse Lasers and Battlefists should help correct the issue.
column2: 我听过有人把这种术士1B叫做"那另一台术士"好几次。尽管它与1A大约同期生产，1B的武器载荷明显不同；主要是它把那一排PPC换成了增程PPC和两具LRM发射器。如果有人试图钻进你的LRM最小射程，这东西的三门中型脉冲激光器和战斗拳应该能纠正这个问题。ZH

column1: Despite being designed for Urban and close-quarters warfare, the Sorcerer 1C variant drops the pair Snub-Nosed PPCs of the original Sorcerer 1A in favor of the easier-to-obtain Blankenburg Large Pulse Lasers. Less surprisingly, the 1A’s PPC and laser complement is replaced by a quartet of Magna 400P Medium Pulse Lasers and a pair of Holly Streak SRM2s. The Sorcerer 1C dedicates eight tons to mount four Pitban LFT-50 jump jets to propel it 120 meters in short bursts and utilizes only sixteen Double Heat Sinks. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: 尽管是为城市与近距作战而设计，巫师1C变型却拆掉原版巫师1A的一对短鼻粒子加农炮，改用更易获得的布兰肯堡大型脉冲激光。不那么令人意外的是，1A的粒子加农炮与激光组合被四门马格纳400P中型脉冲激光和两具霍利连发SRM2取代。巫师1C腾出八吨装四具皮特班LFT-50跳跃推进器，可在短促爆发中推进120米，并且只使用十六个双散热器。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.17

column1: I don't know if I would have put four jump jets on something this big, boss, but I guess someone thought it was a good idea. This thing has got a load of pulse lasers that give it a much shorter range than its other Sorcerer cousins but what it lacks in range it makes up for in numbers and supplements the whole lot with a pair of Stream SRM launchers.
column2: 我不知道我会不会给这么大的东西装上四个跳跃推进器，老大，不过我猜有人觉得这是个好主意。这东西装了一堆脉冲激光器，射程比它其他的术士表亲短得多，但射程上的不足由数量弥补，并且还有两具连发SRM发射器为整套武器加成。ZH

column1: Of the relatively few Sorcerers built before the Amaris Coup, the Sorcerer 1CC variant was considered an exceptionally rare design. Originally planned as a replacement for the 90 ton Cyclops, it quickly became apparent that the design teams at StarCorps Industries were not going to be able to best its incredible computer systems. Rather than spending several more decades of development, the design team decided that modifying the Sorcerer 1A would be a suitable method to cut corners. The 1CC drops the Snub-Nose PPCs, lasers and five Double Heat Sinks in order to mount an additional Ceres Arms Smasher PPC, a quintet of Magna 400P Medium Pulse Lasers, and the advanced Command Console. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
column2: 在阿马里斯政变之前建造的 Sorcerer 数量本就不多，其中 Sorcerer 1CC 变型更被视为极其罕见的设计。它原本计划作为 90 吨 Cyclops 的替代型号，但人们很快发现，StarCorps Industries 的设计团队根本无法超越 Cyclops 那套出色的计算机系统。与其再耗费数十年继续开发，设计团队决定改造 Sorcerer 1A 作为走捷径的办法。1CC 拆除了短管粒子加农炮、激光和五个双散热器，改为加装一门额外的 Ceres Arms Smasher 粒子加农炮、五门 Magna 400P 中型脉冲激光以及先进的指挥控制台。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.19

column1: This one's pretty exceptional, boss. Not many Sorcerers were made back in the day and these 1CC's were only a small fraction of them. That Command Console is a damn fine piece of equipment to have orchestratn' everything and the trio of PPCs aren't something to scoff at either.
column2: 这一台相当特别，老大。当年术士造得并不多，而这些1CC只占其中一小部分。那台指挥控制台是统筹指挥一切的好装备，而那三兄弟PPC也不容小觑。ZH

column1: StarCorps Industries’s Project: SORCERER is considered one of the best examples of effective counter-industrial espionage techniques; despite being in development for nearly two decades, the various intelligence agencies of the Great Houses never managed to collect any meaningful data on the program. The project’s primary goal was to create an assault BattleMech capable of slipping behind and operations behind enemy lines for an indefinite period of time and if at all possible, do this task undetected. Produced in exceptionally small quantities up until Amaris forces overran their facilities on Fletcher, the 95-ton Sorcerer 1X sports a combination of a Null Signature System and a Chameleon Light Polarization Shield. The 1X carries a pair of Ceres Arms Smasher PPCs, a pair of Donal Snub-Nose PPCs, and pair of Magna 400P Medium Pulse Lasers which in combination with the stealth systems onboard can easily overpower the Mech’s nineteen Double Heat Sinks. Few remember the 1X variant as the more widely-produced and fielded 1A variant stepped off of the manufacturing lines on the same day. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
column2: StarCorps Industries的“SORCERER计划”被视为有效反工业间谍技术的典范之一；尽管该计划已研发近二十年，各大家族的各情报机构却始终未能收集到任何有关该计划的有价值情报。该计划的首要目标是打造一型能够潜入敌后、并在敌后无限期作战的突击战斗机甲，如有可能，还要在无人察觉的情况下完成这一任务。直到Amaris部队占领其在Fletcher的设施之前，这款机甲都以极小的产量生产。95吨的Sorcerer 1X同时配备了一具零点特征系统与一面变色龙光偏振护盾。1X装有两门Ceres Arms Smasher粒子加农炮、两门Donal短鼻粒子加农炮，以及两门Magna 400P中型脉冲激光，这些武器与机上隐身系统相结合，很容易就压过这台机甲十九具双散热器的散热能力。很少有人记得1X改型，因为产量更大、装备更普及的1A改型与它同一天走下生产线。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.19

column1: Like many designs lost during the Succession Wars, the Sorcerer design saw new life in the decades after the discovery of the Helm Memory Core. The Draconis Combine was the first to create a new variant of the aged SLDF design utilizing technologies at their disposal in 3058. The Sorcerer 2D retains the 380XL Engine, Guardian ECM Suite, one of the original PPCs, and thirteen of the original Double Heat Sinks and adds a pair of Shigunga MRM40s fed by four tons of ammo. A Small Laser is also added to the right arm for anti-personnel work. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: 与许多在继承战争中失传的设计一样，巫师在发现地狱记忆核心之后的几十年里重获新生。龙脉联合体是首个在3058年利用其掌握的技术为这款老旧SLDF设计打造新变型的势力。巫师2D保留380XL引擎、守护者电子对抗套件、原有粒子加农炮中的一门，以及原有双散热器中的十三个，并加装一对紫郡MRM40（配四吨弹药）。右臂还加装一门小型激光用于反人员。特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.15

column1: Boss, I get it. Missiles are cool and all, but letting loose with 80 of them at a time might be a bit over-zealous. Leave it to the Dracs to slap a pair of MRM40s on one of these brutes; at least they kept one of the PPCs for some longer range work.
column2: 老大，我懂。导弹是很酷没错，但一口气放80枚可能有点过于热情了。也只有龙尼斯人会往这种蛮物上塞两具MRM40；至少他们还留了一门PPC做点远程活。ZH

column1: The Spartan C is the result of Clan-tech improvements by Clan Fire Mandrill to the original design. The C variant saw usage by a handful of the Clans, although only Clan Fire Mandrill continued to field the 'Mech through the invasion of the Inner Sphere. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 斯巴达C是火狒狒部族对原始设计进行部族技术改进的成果。C变型被少数几个部族使用过，但只有火狒狒部族在入侵内层星域期间持续投入该机甲。特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：1.18

column1: So, this is the final evolution of the Spartan, huh? Kind of fitting that it left with the SLDF and returned reborn with the Clans. Poetic, almost.
column2: 那么，这就是斯巴达的最终演化，是吧？它随SLDF离去、又随氏族重生归来，倒也挺相称。几乎有种诗意。ZH

column1: The earliest model of the Spartan assault 'Mech. The N1 suffered from inadequate cooling for its advanced weapons systems, which led to the design being revised into the more heat-efficient N2 in 2765. Despite this, a handful of N1 models still made their way into the hands of various buyers across the Sphere. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: 斯巴达突击型机甲的最早型号。N1的先进武器系统因散热不足而备受困扰，这促使该设计在2765年被修订为散热效率更高的N2。尽管如此，仍有少数N1流入内层星域各地买家的手中。特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：1.14

column1: Do you have any idea how rare this 'Mech is, Boss? You're looking at one of the last remaining Spartan assault 'Mechs. Not only that, but this is one of the original N1 models! I mean — it's worse in every single way than the N2, but hey! It's rarer!
column2: 你知道这台机甲有多稀有吗，老大？你眼前的是最后残存的斯巴达突击机甲之一。不止如此，这是最初的N1型号之一！我是说——它每一个方面都比N2差，但嘿！它更稀有！ZH

column1: Designed in 2765 as a response to rising hostility in the Periphery, the Spartan is a fast-moving assault 'Mech. During the Amaris Coup, the Martinson production line was destroyed, resulting in the Spartan's almost complete extinction; less than two dozen are known to still be in service. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: 斯巴达于2765年设计，是对外围地区日益增长的敌意的回应，是一款快速机动的突击机甲。阿马里斯政变期间马丁森产线被毁，导致斯巴达几乎灭绝；已知仍在服役的不足二十台。特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：1.14

column1: Do you have any idea how rare this 'Mech is, Boss? You're looking at one of the last remaining Spartan assault 'Mechs. These bad boys were known for their speed, their firepower, and their durability. They did it all.
column2: 你知道这台机甲有多稀有吗，老大？你眼前的是最后残存的斯巴达突击机甲之一。这些猛家伙以速度、火力以及耐久著称。它们样样都行。ZH

column1: The NF variant of the Spartan is an upgrade of the standard N2 variant. The NF was fielded almost exclusively by the Star League Defense Force's Royal Divisions. Following the destruction of the Martinson production lines during the Amaris Coup, and the subsequent exodus of the SLDF, the design is considered extinct. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: Spartan 的 NF 变型是标准 N2 变型的升级版。NF 几乎只装备于星际联盟防卫军的皇家师。在阿马里斯政变期间 Martinson 生产线被摧毁、SLDF 随后踏上大逃亡之后，该设计被认为已经绝迹。特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：1.16

column1: And I thought the original Spartan was rare! The NF doesn't boast much over the regular N2. Like most Star League upgrades, it just does what the original did, but better.
column2: 我还以为原来的斯巴达就够稀有了！NF相比普通N2并没有多少优势。像大多数星盟升级一样，它只是把原版能做的做得更好。ZH

column1: The Spider IIC is armed with two ER Small Lasers and two Medium Pulse Lasers, with all of them linked through an advanced targeting computer. Ten double heat sinks are just barely enough to keep the 'Mech fully cooled in most situations. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 蜘蛛IIC装有两门增程小型激光和两门中型脉冲激光，全部联动一台先进瞄准计算机。十个双散热器刚刚够在大多数情况下让机甲完全冷却。特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：1.03

column1: Spider IIC
column2: 蜘蛛 IIC

column1: The Spider IIC is a clan conversion of the venerable Spider. Much of the original design was kept, such as it's very large 240 XL engine and many jump jets to ensure an extremely mobile 'Mech. Thanks to the conversion to Clan technologies the 'Mech has considerably more armor, making it both unexpectedly durable and persistent.
column2: 蜘蛛IIC是古老蜘蛛的氏族改造版。原设计的许多部分被保留，例如它那台巨大的240 XL引擎和众多跳跃推进器，以确保机甲极其机动。得益于改用氏族技术，该机甲装甲显著增加，使它出人意料地既耐久又难缠。ZH

column1: A simple refit of the Spider SDR-5V, this variant drops two jump jets to fit a C3 slave computer. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: 这是蜘蛛SDR-5V的简单改装，此变型拆掉两具跳跃推进器以装入一台C3从机。特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：0.97

column1: The Spider 5V and 5VR are hands down the most maneuverable 'Mechs you can field, but they're made of paper. Though excellent scouts, and even able to jump into the rear arc of most enemies for surprise back shots, their low durability makes them often take crippling damage in the smallest of engagements.
column2: 蜘蛛5V和5VR无疑是你能派上场的最机动机甲，但它们脆得像纸。它们虽是出色的侦察兵，甚至能跳到大多数敌人的后方弧线上打冷枪，但耐久度低下使它们在最小的交战中都会受到致残性损伤。ZH

column1: A major upgrade of the 5V, this custom variant used by the mercenary outfit Wolf's Dragoons make the Spider be a far more capable 'Mech by upgrading almost all the equipment with Clan tech. However, even with more tons being added due to the use of Ferro-Fibrous armor, the main flaw of it still remains in the lack of proper protection. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 这是 5V 的大幅升级版，由雇佣兵部队 Wolf's Dragoons 使用的定制变型。通过将几乎所有装备升级为部族科技，它使 Spider 成为一台性能强得多的机甲。然而，即便因采用铁纤维装甲而增加了数吨重量，它最大的缺陷依然存在——缺乏像样的防护。特性：灵活 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: The Spider is hands down the most maneuverable 'Mech you can field, but it's made of paper. It's an excellent scout, though, and can even jump into the rear arc of most enemies for surprise back shots.
column2: 蜘蛛无疑是你能派上场的最机动机甲，但它脆得像纸。不过它是极出色的侦察兵，甚至能跳到大多数敌人的后方弧线上打冷枪。ZH

column1: The Spider 6V, precursor to the Venom spider variants, features upgraded armor and Jump Jets, as well as a Medium Pulse Laser, but it's still one of the most fragile targets on the battlefield. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
column2: Spider 6V是Venom系列蛛型改型的前身，拥有升级的装甲与跳跃推进器，还装有一门中型脉冲激光，但它依然是战场上最脆弱的目标之一。特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：1.01

column1: The Spider 6V, precursor to the Venom spider variants, features upgraded armor and Jump Jets, as well as a Medium Pulse Laser, but it's still one of the most fragile targets on the battlefield.
column2: 蜘蛛6V是毒液蜘蛛改型的前身，拥有升级的装甲与跳跃推进器，以及一门中型脉冲激光器，但它仍是战场上最脆弱的目标之一。ZH

column1: The Alpha loadout of the Spirit Walker is mainly focused on powerful, direct engagements head on. A combination of lasers, machine guns and even a Gauss Rifle ensures the 'Mech can deliver damage at practically any distance of engagements. However, it's relative slow speed makes it vulnerable to being flanked or outmaneuvered by more agile units. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: Spirit Walker 的 Alpha 配装主要着眼于正面硬碰硬的强力交战。激光、机枪乃至一门高斯步枪的组合，确保该机甲几乎能在任何交战距离上造成伤害。然而，它相对迟缓的速度使其容易被更灵活的部队侧翼包抄或以机动压制。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.1

column1: Spirit Walker
column2: 灵魂行者

column1: As the knowledge of how to build OmniMechs spread throughout the clans although Coyote had tried to keep it for themselves, they quickly realized they needed to bolster their 'Mech forces and started the Pueblo Initiative to remodel older SLDF 'Mechs into OmniMechs. The Spirit Walker was one of the results of the initiative, creating a more rugged front liner from the Black Knight. Due to its heavy armor the 'Mech was quite vulnerable against faster flankers, but if faced head on could pack a punch for its size.
column2: 随着建造全向机甲的知识在部族间传播开来——尽管郊狼（Coyote）部族曾试图将其据为己有——他们很快意识到必须扩充自己的机甲部队，于是发起了“普韦布洛计划”（Pueblo Initiative），把较旧的 SLDF 机甲改造成全向机甲。幽灵行者（Spirit Walker）正是该计划的成果之一，它以黑骑士（Black Knight）为基础打造出一台更为坚固的前线机甲。由于装甲厚重，该机甲面对速度更快的侧翼包抄者时相当吃亏，但若正面交锋，其火力对于自身吨位而言相当可观。ZH

column1: The Primary configuration requires a very skilled MechWarrior to operate properly, using advanced volley and engage tactics. During the volley phase the 'Mech should engage with some of its ER Large Lasers, but keeping heat under control. As the engagement distance shrinks, the use of the Large Lasers should be switched to the Medium Pulse Lasers instead. If at any point all lasers will be fire together, the 'Mech will most likely instantly go into overheat shutdown. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 主配置需要一名技艺极其娴熟的机甲战士才能正确操控，需运用进阶的齐射与接战战术。在齐射阶段，机甲应以部分增程大型激光接战，同时将热量控制在安全范围内。随着交战距离缩短，大型激光应改用中型脉冲激光。若在任何时候所有激光同时开火，机甲极有可能立即因过热而停机。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.1

column1: The so-called Stag II incorporated a prototype version of the ER PPC that was roughly comparable to the Clan version of the weapon, though it was slightly less destructive. This upgrade of the large laser necessitated removal of the MASC, though the top speed was upgraded to 119 km/h. Additionally, Ferro-Fibrous weave was incorporated into the armor, though at an overall decrease in protection. The SRMs were removed in favor of an additional Medium Laser, two Medium Pulse Lasers, and two Small Lasers. This gave the 'Mech greater battlefield longevity, though the potential for excessive heat buildup was much greater. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 所谓的“雄鹿II”采用了增程粒子加农炮的原型版本，性能大致可与该武器的部族版本相比，只是破坏力略低。用这种大型激光的升级型号替换原有武器，使MASC不得不被拆除，不过最高时速提升到了119 km/h。此外，装甲中加入了铁纤维编织层，整体防护却有所下降。SRM被拆掉，换来1门额外的中型激光、2门中型脉冲激光和2门小型激光。这让该机甲在战场上更耐久，但过热的风险也大得多。<特性：改进通讯 <投放费用倍率：1.03 <手臂驱动器限制：右臂下段

column1: Stag II
column2: 雄鹿 II

column1: The so-called Stag II incorporated a prototype version of the ER PPC that was roughly comparable to the Clan version of the weapon, though it was slightly less destructive. This upgrade of the large laser necessitated removal of the MASC, though the top speed was upgraded to 119 km/h. Additionally, Ferro-Fibrous weave was incorporated into the armor, though at an overall decrease in protection. The SRMs were removed in favor of an additional Medium Laser, two Medium Pulse Lasers, and two Small Lasers. This gave the 'Mech greater battlefield longevity, though the potential for excessive heat buildup was much greater.
column2: 所谓“雄鹿II”整合了一版原型增程粒子加农炮，性能大致可与部族版本的该武器相比，只是破坏力略低。这次对大型激光的升级迫使它拆掉MASC，不过最高速度提升到119公里/小时。此外装甲中加入了铁纤维织层，尽管整体防护有所下降。SRM被拆掉，改为额外一门中型激光、两门中型脉冲激光和两门小型激光。这赋予该机甲更强的战场持续力，尽管热量过度积累的可能性也大得多。ZH

column1: The Stag was built on an Endo Steel frame and powered by an XL Engine. Ten tons of armor provided the 'Mech with the maximum possible protection. The long-range threat from the cavalry 'Mech comes from one ER Large Laser. At close range it is supplemented by paired Medium Lasers and SRM-4s. Two, CASE-protected tons of ammunition gives MechWarriors the flexibility to use different types of munitions, making the Stag a threat to a variety of units. Twelve double heat sinks handles all of the heat generated by the weapons. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 雄鹿采用钢内骨结构，由XL引擎驱动。十吨装甲为机甲提供了最大限度的防护。这台骑兵机甲的远程威胁来自一门增程大型激光。近距离则由成对的中型激光和SRM-4作为补充。两吨由CASE保护的弹药让机甲战士能够灵活选用不同类型的弹种，使雄鹿足以威胁多种单位。十二台双散热器足以处理武器产生的全部热量。特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：右臂下部

column1: The Stag was built on an Endo Steel frame and powered by an XL Engine. Ten tons of armor provided the 'Mech with the maximum possible protection. The long-range threat from the cavalry 'Mech comes from one ER Large Laser. At close range it is supplemented by paired Medium Lasers and SRM-4s. Two, CASE-protected tons of ammunition gives MechWarriors the flexibility to use different types of munitions, making the Stag a threat to a variety of units. Twelve double heat sinks handles all of the heat generated by the weapons.
column2: 雄鹿建在内层钢框架上，由一具XL引擎驱动。十吨装甲为该机甲提供最大可能的防护。这台骑兵机甲的远程威胁来自一门增程大型激光器。在近距离，它由成对的中型激光器和SRM-4补充。两吨CASE保护的弹药让机师能灵活使用不同弹药类型，使雄鹿对各类单位都构成威胁。十二具双重散热器处理武器产生的所有热量。ZH

column1: The personal 'Mech of Sho-sho Jagawen Torisobo of the Eigth Sword of Light. Designed for close combat, this custom Stalker replaces the LRM launchers with twin SRM-6 racks in each torso and installed six additional heat sinks. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是第八光之剑少将贾加文·托里索博的私人机甲。这款定制潜行者专为混战而设，以每侧躯干内的双联SRM-6挂架取代LRM发射器，并加装了六个散热器。特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Juggernaut, Close Support, & Ranged Assault
column2: 巨无霸、近距支援与远程突击

column1: The personal 'Mech of Sho-sho Jagawen Torisobo of the Eigth Sword of Light. Designed for close combat, this custom Stalker replaced the LRM launchers with twin SRM-6 racks in each torso and installed six additional heat sinks.
column2: 这是第八光之剑少将贾加文·托里索博的私人机甲。这款定制潜行者专为混战而设，以每侧躯干内的双联SRM-6挂架取代LRM发射器，并加装了六个散热器。ZH

column1: The Stalker 3F mounts a ridiculous amount of weaponry, even for an assault 'Mech. It is also notable for its incredibly poor heat management, which is the cost it pays for such amazing damage output. Powerful, but to be used wisely. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.23 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Stalker 3F 搭载的武器多到离谱，即便以突击机甲的标准来看也是如此。它还以散热管理极其糟糕而闻名，这正是它为如此惊人的伤害输出所付出的代价。威力强大，但需善加运用。特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.23 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: It's not flashy. It's not the cutting edge. It just keeps coming.
column2: 它不炫目。它不是最前沿的。它就是源源不断地打过来。ZH

column1: A unit used by the 4th Sword of Light, this variant of the Stalker replaces the heat sinks with Double Heat Sinks, adds Artemis IV FCS to the LRM-10 launchers, and replaces the SRM-6 packs with four Streak SRM-2 systems. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是第4光之剑使用的单位，此潜行者变型把散热器换成双散热器，为LRM-10发射器加装阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统，并以四套连发SRM-2系统取代SRM-6包。特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: A battlefield refit of the -3F, adding some more protection for the MechWarriors piloting the 'Mech in form of CASE protection for the ammunition and an armored cowl for the cockpit. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: -3F 的战地改装型，为弹药加装 CASE 防护、为驾驶舱加装装甲护罩，从而为驾驶该机甲的机甲战士提供更多保护。特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: A total refit of the -3F, replacing much of the equipment and weapons with aquired clan tech. Mainly seen amongst the more prominent Mercenary outfits, such as the Wolf's Dragoons or Kell Hounds. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是对-3F的全面改装，将大部分设备与武器替换为获取来的部族科技。它主要出现在较为知名的雇佣兵部队中，例如沃尔夫龙骑兵或凯尔猎犬。特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The -4F is a refresh of the -3F, updating its weaponry and using an Endo Steel chassis. The build is focused around two MRM-30 launchers and two ER Large Lasers, with four Medium Pulse Lasers providing extra firepower as needed. However, the design struggles majorly with heat even with 5 external double heat sinks, reducing its combat effectiveness. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: -4F 是 -3F 的翻新版，更新了武器配置并采用钢内骨结构底盘。其构型以两具 MRM-30 发射器和两门增程大型激光为核心，另有四门中型脉冲激光在需要时提供额外火力。然而，即便装有 5 具外部双散热器，该设计仍严重受困于散热问题，战斗力因此打了折扣。特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: A field refit of the -3H, upgrading the SRM6 launchers to Streak models and the Medium lasers to Pulse variants. Taking the design back to the root of the -3F model, two ER Large Lasers are added by changing to an Endo Steel chassis and downgrading the LRM launchers to 10 tubes each. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: -3H的战地改装型，将SRM6发射器升级为连发型号，中型激光升级为脉冲型号。为让设计回归-3F型号的本源，通过改用钢内骨结构底盘并把LRM发射器降级为每具10管，又加装了两门增程大型激光。特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Outfitted with the relatively recently rediscovered Star League technology of circa 3050, the FedCom 5S can be characterized primarily by its tendency to overheat. The designers behind this variant took the simple expedient of upgrading its engine and firepower without taking heat build-up into consideration. The 'Mech has had its engine replaced with an XL Engine and the large lasers have been removed and replaced with two Thunderbolt-12 Large Pulse Lasers. For protection against ammunition explosions, CASE has been added to both side torsos, and an Deprus Swarmshot Anti-Missile System has been added for protection against incoming missiles. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: FedCom 5S 装备了 3050 年前后才被重新发现的星际联盟技术，其最显著的特点便是极易过热。该变型机的设计者只图方便，升级了引擎与火力，却未考虑热量的累积。机甲的引擎已更换为 XL 引擎，大型激光被拆除，代之以两门 Thunderbolt-12 大型脉冲激光。为防范弹药殉爆，两侧躯干均加装了 CASE；为抵御来袭导弹，还加装了一套 Deprus Swarmshot 反导系统。特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: Implied to be a Stalker piloted by J. Elliot Jamison, the Misery Hero 'Mech retains the STK-3F's twin Medium Lasers in each arm, right torso mounted SRM-6 and center torso mounted Large Laser but removes the remaining SRM-6 and LRM-10s to mount a mammoth Gauss Rifle in the left torso. Carrying two tons each of Gauss rounds and SRM missiles, twenty-two single heat sinks strive to keep the Misery in the thick of combat. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 相传是由J. Elliot Jamison驾驶的一台跟踪者，这台名为苦难的英雄机甲保留了STK-3F每条手臂上的两门中型激光、右躯干的SRM-6与中央躯干的大型激光，但拆除了其余的SRM-6与LRM-10，以便在左躯干安装一门巨型高斯步枪。它分别携带两吨高斯弹药与两吨SRM导弹，二十二具单散热器则竭力让苦难始终冲杀在战斗最激烈处。特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Implied to be a Stalker piloted by J. Elliot Jamison, the Misery Hero 'Mech retains the STK-3F's twin Medium Lasers in each arm, right torso mounted SRM-6 and center torso mounted Large Laser but removes the remaining SRM-6 and LRM-10s to mount a mammoth Gauss Rifle in the left torso. Carrying two tons each of Gauss rounds and SRM missiles, twenty-two single heat sinks strive to keep the Misery in the thick of combat.
column2: 据推测是一台由J·埃利奥特·贾米森驾驶的潜行者，苦难英雄机甲保留了STK-3F双臂各一对中型激光器、右躯干的SRM-6和中央躯干的大型激光器，但拆掉了其余的SRM-6和LRM-10，以在左躯干装上一门巨型高斯步枪。它各携带两吨高斯步枪弹和SRM导弹，二十二具单重散热器努力让苦难留在激战中心。ZH

column1: The big gun on the Stalking Spider is its ER PPC, which allows it deal a strong strike from long ranges. For close-up work, it has a pair of SRM-4 launchers and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers. While the design can build a significant amount of heat if the MechWarrior constantly alpha strikes, an experienced pilot should be able to manage the Stalking Spider's heat easily. The design can stay at long range and snipe with its ER PPC, then quickly close to finish off an opponent with its pulse lasers and missiles. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 潜行蜘蛛的大杀器是它的增程粒子加农炮，能在远距离上打出强力一击。近身作战时，它有一对SRM-4发射器和一对中型脉冲激光。虽然若机甲战士不停全力齐射会积累相当多的热量，但老练的机师应该能轻松管理潜行蜘蛛的热量。该设计可以停留在远距离用增程粒子加农炮狙击，然后迅速逼近用脉冲激光和导弹了结对手。特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.1

column1: Stalking Spider
column2: 潜行蜘蛛

column1: Skirmish Quad
column2: 四足散兵

column1: After obtaining the husk of an Inner Sphere Tarantula, Clan Cloud Cobra scientists decided to use it as the basis for a quadruped BattleMech. The 'Mech received the name Stalking Spider because it mounts enough jump jets in the legs to rocket it to 150 meters in one jump. Because the MechWarrior must move the legs during the jump, it appears that the design is crawling through the air like a spider, making it very impressive during drops. The Stalking Spider also uses MASC to move up to 119 km/h in short bursts.
column2: 云眼镜蛇部族的科学家在获得一具内层星域狼蛛的残骸后，决定以它为基础打造一台四足战斗机甲。这台机甲得名“潜行蜘蛛”，因为它的腿部装有足够的跳跃推进器，一次跳跃便能将它送上150米高空。由于机甲战士在跳跃过程中必须摆动腿部，看起来就像这台设计正以蜘蛛般的姿态在空中爬行，在空降时极为壮观。潜行蜘蛛还装有MASC，可在短时间内加速至119 km/h。ZH

column1: This variant of the Stalking Spider, introduced 3060, removes the PPC and missiles, but retains the pulse lasers. It adds a Heavy Large Laser and a Targeting Computer to direct the 'Mech's laser fire. This hunter-killer is aided by the inclusion of an Active Probe and TAG. An additional double heat sink keeps heat levels manageable. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 这是3060年推出的潜行蜘蛛变型，拆掉粒子加农炮与导弹，但保留脉冲激光；它加装一门重型大型激光和一台瞄准计算机来引导机甲的激光火力。这台猎杀者还得益于主动探测器与TAG的加入。一个额外双散热器让热量水平保持可控。特性：武器稳定 投放费用倍率：1.1

column1: The primary loadout of the Starhawk brings an Ultra AC/10 in each arm, with a right shoulder mounted SRM 6 for some extra short range punch. An active probe and an ECM suite provides some basic EWS capabilities. Quirk: Well Balanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Starhawk 的主配装在每侧手臂各配备一门 Ultra AC/10，右肩安装的 SRM 6 则提供额外的近距离打击力。主动探测器与电子对抗套件赋予其基本的电子战能力。特性：良好平衡 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: After winning the design to the Timberwolf legs from Clan Wolf during a Trial of Possession, Clan Snow Raven quickly combined the legs with the torso  of a Hellbringer. The result was the 70 ton OmniMech called the Starhawk. It sports a 350 XL engine to carry, making it adequately agile for the Clan's needs, but not much of the design made it stand out compared to other already established 'Mechs. The Starhawk was never seen as a success and are now rare to spot outside of garrison duties.
column2: 在占有试炼中从狼族赢得铁木狼腿部设计后，雪鸦氏族迅速把这些腿与地狱使者的躯干结合起来。结果就是这台名为星鹰的70吨全方位机甲。它配有350 XL引擎以承载重量，机动性足以满足氏族需求，但该设计相较其他已成型的机甲并无太多突出之处。星鹰从未被视为成功之作，如今在驻防任务之外已很少见到。ZH

column1: A Star League era mech, the Starslayer was intended to replace the Crab as the SLDF’s standard medium chassis, though politics kept it from seeing full production until 2781. A 50 ton medium mech, the Starslayer is powered by a 250-rated fusion core and has 5 JJ’s for maximum mobility. The STY-2C carries 2 Large Lasers, with a pair of Medium Lasers and a Small laser for closer ranged combat. An SRM-4 with a ton of ammo rounds out the design. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: Starslayer 是星际联盟时代的机甲，本打算取代 Crab 成为 SLDF 的标准中型底盘，但政治因素使其直到 2781 年才得以全面量产。这具 50 吨的中型机甲由一台 250 级聚变核心驱动，并配备 5 具跳跃推进器以实现最大机动性。STY-2C 搭载 2 具大型激光，另有两具中型激光和一具小型激光用于近距离作战。一具 SRM-4 及一吨弹药使整个设计更趋完善。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：右上臂

One SRM-6 and one Streak SRM-2 launcher provides short range punch, while the two Medium Lasers and Small Laser provides more consistent damage, not being ammunition reliant. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

column1: The STL-7CE Stiletto was one of very few ultralight BattleMechs designed for a specific combat role: to fight short-range delaying actions and to engage the Lyran Commonwealth's new COM-2D Commando reconnaissance 'Mech. During the 2460s and 2470s, quantities of Commandos began appearing in regiments along the Steiner/Kurita border, a situation that concerned Lord Kurita greatly. Deciding to assume the offensive, he ordered a new BattleMech design constructed, cheaper than its intended adversary and available in quantity. The result, the Stiletto, entered full-scale production in 2473. This Variant of the Stiletto has been Used in Solaris for Exclusive Use in Ultralight Mech Combat. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: STL-7CE Stiletto 是为数不多为特定作战角色而设计的超轻型战斗机甲之一：执行近距离迟滞作战，并对抗莱兰联邦新型的 COM-2D Commando 侦察机甲。在 2460 年代和 2470 年代，大量 Commando 开始出现在斯坦纳/库瑞塔边境的军团中，这一情况令库瑞塔领主深感忧虑。他决定转入攻势，下令设计一款新型战斗机甲，要求比预定对手更便宜且能大量供应。成果便是 Stiletto，它于 2473 年进入全面生产。该 Stiletto 变型曾被用于 Solaris 的超轻型机甲混战专属赛事。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.97
