The result, the Stiletto, entered full-scale production in 2473. This Variant of the Stiletto has been Used in Solaris for Exclusive Use in Ultralight Mech Combat. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: STL-TAG Stiletto 是为特定战斗角色而设计的极少数超轻型战斗机甲之一：执行近距离迟滞作战，并迎战莱兰联邦新型的 COM-2D Commando 侦察机甲。在 2460 年代和 2470 年代，大量 Commando 开始出现在施泰纳与栗田边境沿线的军团中，这一局面令栗田领主深感不安。他决定采取攻势，下令建造一种新的战斗机甲设计，比预定对手更便宜且能够大量供应。其成果便是 Stiletto，于 2473 年全面量产。Stiletto 的这一变型曾在 Solaris 用于超轻型机甲混战的专属赛事。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.97

column1: The STL-TAG Stiletto was one of very few ultralight BattleMechs designed for a specific combat role: to fight short-range delaying actions and to engage the Lyran Commonwealth's new COM-2D Commando reconnaissance 'Mech. During the 2460s and 2470s, quantities of Commandos began appearing in regiments along the Steiner/Kurita border, a situation that concerned Lord Kurita greatly. Deciding to assume the offensive, he ordered a new BattleMech design constructed, cheaper than its intended adversary and available in quantity. The result, the Stiletto, entered full-scale production in 2473. This Variant of the Stiletto has been Used in Solaris for Exclusive Use in Ultralight Mech Combat.
column2: STL-TAG短剑是为数不多为特定战斗角色设计的超轻型战斗机甲之一：执行短程迟滞行动，并迎击莱兰联邦新型的COM-2D突击队员侦察机甲。在2460与2470年代，大批突击队员开始出现在施泰纳/栗田边界的各团中，这一情况令栗田领主大为忧心。他决定采取攻势，下令建造一种新的战斗机甲设计，比其预定对手更便宜且能大量供应。结果就是短剑，于2473年投入全面量产。这一短剑改型曾在索拉里斯用于超轻型机甲专属混战。ZH

column1: As all the other 3-series variants, the Stiletto STO-3A is focused on longer range indirect fire, as its three LRM-5 launchers makes evident. For short range defense a single Stream SRM-2 is mounted in the center torso. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 与其他3系列变型一样，短剑STO-3A着重于较远距离的间接火力——三具LRM-5发射器便是明证。近程防御方面，中央躯干装有一具溪流SRM-2。特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The Stiletto 3J adds ferro-fibrous armor and an endo steel chassis to enable the addition of 8 jump jets. Another sacrifice that had to be made was the removal of the C.A.S.E. protection for the two tons of missile ammunition kept in the right torso. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Stiletto 3J 增加了铁纤维装甲和钢内骨结构机体，从而得以加装 8 具跳跃推进器。另一个不得不做出的牺牲，是取消了右躯干中两吨导弹弹药的 C.A.S.E. 防护。特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

column1: The 3W trades one LRM-5 launcher and the Stream SRM launcher for a Large Pulse Laser, making the 'Mech capable to handles prolonged engagements without the MechWarrior having to worry about being complexly defenseless once all the ammunition is used up. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 3W以一具LRM-5发射器和连发SRM发射器换取一门大型脉冲激光，使这台机甲能够应付持久交战，机甲战士无需担心弹药耗尽后彻底失去自卫能力。特性：多重追踪 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: In 2680, the Star League requested designers to develop 'Mechs which could fly as well as function as standard 'Mechs. The first Land-Air 'Mech off the drawing board, the Shadow Hawk LAM, proved so fatally flawed, the concept was almost shelved. However, LexaTech Industries reworked the conversion equipment and unveiled the first viable LAM, the Stinger LAM in 2688, based on the old Stinger design. LexaTech's reworking of the concept proved so successful, the Land-Air 'Mech became highly sought after, especially for space combat operations. In fact, the Stinger LAM first saw combat destroying a nuclear weapons facility in the Oort Cloud orbiting Sol, Terra's star. Found in the Draconis Combine, this variant uses two pairs of Martell Small Lasers on the arms instead of a single Medium Laser. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 2680年，星际联盟要求设计者研制既能飞行又能作为标准机甲运作的机甲。第一台走下图纸的陆空机甲——影子鹰LAM——缺陷致命，几乎使整个构想被搁置。然而莱克萨科技工业重新设计了变形设备，并于2688年基于老式螫针设计推出了第一台可行的LAM：螫针LAM。莱克萨对这套构想的重做极为成功，陆空机甲随即备受追捧，尤其是在太空作战中。事实上，螫针LAM的首次战斗，是摧毁了绕地球恒星太阳运行的奥尔特云中的一处核武器设施。此变型见于龙脉联合体，以两对马特尔小型激光取代了单门中型激光。特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：0.99

column1: Stinger LAMC
column2: 毒刺 LAMC

column1: The Stinger STG-3GD is a custom Clan-tech full conversion fielded by the mercenary command known as Grey Death Legion. One ER Medium Laser and two Heavy Machine Guns combined with its mobility fulfills the role of an anti-squad and infantry capable scout 'Mech. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: Stinger STG-3GD 是由名为 Grey Death Legion 的雇佣兵部队装备的部族科技全套改装定制机。一门增程中型激光和两挺重型机枪，再加上其机动性，使它足以胜任一台能对抗步兵班组的侦察机甲。特性：随处可见 投放费用倍率：0.97

column1: Based on the 3P variant and introduced in 3076, this model also uses Endo Steel chassis and adds an XL Engine. The engine gives the STG-5G a top speed of 111 km/h and provides enough weight savings to add more armor and an advanced PPC Capacitor.
column2: 基于 3P 变体并于 3076 年推出，此型号同样使用内骨骼底盘并加装 XL 引擎。该引擎让 STG-5G 的最高速度达到 111 公里/小时，并省出足够重量加装更多装甲和一台先进 PPC 电容器。ZH

column1: A common field refit of the 3R, replacing the Machine Guns with an extra Medium Laser and a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95
column2: 这是3R常见的战场改装，以一门额外的中型激光与一个C3从属单元取代机枪。特性：随处可见 投放费用倍率：0.95

column1: Created in 3057, the Stinger 3T is a product of a joint project between Pinard Protectorates and Vandenburg Mechanized Industries to develop an upgraded Stinger for use by the TDF. Based on the STG-3R, the 3T swaps the Machine Guns for Small Lasers and the Medium Laser for a Pulse model. Ferro-Fibrous armor is used to increase protection. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: 螫针3T于3057年问世，是皮纳尔保护国与范登堡机械化工业联合项目的成果，旨在为TDF研制一款升级版螫针。3T以STG-3R为基础，把机枪换成小型激光，中型激光换成脉冲型号，并用铁纤维装甲提升防护。特性：无处不在 投放费用倍率：0.97

column1: Created in 3057, the Stinger 3T is a product of a joint project between Pinard Protectorates and Vandenburg Mechanized Industries to develop an upgraded Stinger for use by the TDF. Based on the STG-3R, the 3T swaps the Machine Guns for Small Lasers and the Medium Laser for a Pulse model. Ferro-Fibrous armor is used to increase protection.
column2: 3T型毒刺造于3057年，是皮纳德保护国与范登堡机械化工业联合项目的产物，旨在为TDF开发一种升级版毒刺。3T以STG-3R为基础，把机枪换成小型激光器，把中型激光器换成脉冲型号。它使用铁纤装甲以提升防护。ZH

column1: The Stinger Cs emerging from the Wolf Empire's Keystone factory mirror those of the early Clans. Initially developed by the Hell's Horses as a training unit, other Clans found the Stinger to be a competent fighter, especially useful when Trials did not necessitate wasting larger, more valuable BattleMechs. An ER Medium Laser, two Machine Guns and a Small Pulse Laser makes for an surprising amount of damage potential from such a light 'Mech. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
column2: 狼帝国内基斯通工厂出产的螫针C，与早期部族的版本如出一辙。它最初由地狱马部族作为训练单位研制，其他部族却发现螫针是称职的战斗机，尤其在试炼不必浪费更大、更宝贵的战斗机甲时格外有用。一门增程中型激光、两挺机枪和一门小型脉冲激光，使这样一台轻型机甲拥有出人意料的伤害潜力。特性：无处不在 投放费用倍率：1.01

column1: The C 2, created by the Blood Spirits, swaps the machine guns for another laser. The Wolves deploy this variant as a harasser, reserving the primary version for scouting and anti-piracy duties. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
column2: 由血灵部族打造的C 2以另一门激光取代机枪。狼部族将此变型用作骚扰车，把主型号留作侦察与反海盗任务。特性：无处不在 投放费用倍率：1.01

column1: The M1, nicknamed 'First Modification' by the techs on Chara III, is a field modification of the STG-3R that exchanges both machine guns and their ammunition for four small lasers, two mounted in each arm. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: M1被查拉III的技术人员昵称为“第一改装”，是STG-3R的野战改装，以四门小型激光（每臂两门）替换两挺机枪及其弹药。特性：无处不在 投放费用倍率：0.97

column1: The M2, nicknamed 'Second Modification' by the techs on Chara III, is a field modification of the STG-3R that exchanges the jump jets for two medium lasers in the center torso and another ton of armor. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: M2被卡拉III星的技术人员昵称为“第二改装”，是STG-3R的战地改装型，用中央躯干的两门中型激光与另一吨装甲换掉了跳跃推进器。特性：随处可见 投放费用倍率：0.97

column1: The design featured Large Pulse Lasers in each arm, twin Gauss Rifles mounted behind flip-open circular firing ports on each side torso, and an almost superfluous Small Pulse Laser located above the cockpit. The Stone Rhino also sported an interesting feature; each arm contained a retractable, shock-absorbing cowl covering the weapon barrels. This allowed MechWarriors to use the arms as battering rams without damaging the weaponry. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 该设计在每臂各装一门大型脉冲激光，两侧躯干各在可翻转的圆形射击口后方装有两门高斯步枪，驾驶舱上方还有一门几乎多余的 Small Pulse Laser。Stone Rhino 还有一项有趣的特点：每条手臂都带有可收放、能吸收冲击的护罩，将炮管遮盖起来。这让机甲战士能够用双臂充当撞锤，而不必担心损坏武器。特性：干扰 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: In order to plug holes in their touman, Clan Goliath Scorpion scientists revisited the Behemoth. Like Clan Smoke Jaguar before them, they upgraded and improved upon the design. This version used an Extra-light Engine to mount a pair of Thunderstroke Series 2b Gauss Rifles along the top of the 'Mech. Each arm carried a Series 4D-2 Heavy Large Laser, a Series 22a Heavy Medium Laser, and a General Systems Heavy Small Laser. It retained the shock-absorbing cowls of the original. Another pair of Heavy Mediums protected the rear of the 'Mech. A head-mounted Shield-3 Anti-Missile System defended against missiles, while an Anti-Personnel Pod in each leg discouraged unarmored infantry. This design had jump jets, nineteen tons of armor, and a meager sixteen double heat sinks. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 为填补部队编制的空缺，戈利亚斯蝎部族的科学家重新审视了 Behemoth。与此前的烟虎部族一样，他们对这一设计进行了升级与改进。该版本采用超轻型引擎，在机甲顶部安装了两门 Thunderstroke Series 2b 高斯步枪。每条手臂各装备一门 Series 4D-2 重型大型激光、一门 Series 22a 重型中型激光，以及一门 General Systems 重型小型激光。它保留了原型机的减震罩。另有一对重型中型激光守护机甲的后方。头部安装的 Shield-3 反导弹系统用于抵御导弹，而每条腿上的反人员荚舱则能遏制无装甲步兵。该设计配备跳跃推进器、十九吨装甲，以及仅十六具双散热器。特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.24 手臂驱动器限制：左臂上部、右臂上部

column1: A variable range variant, the Stone Rhino 4 uses an XL Engine to provide weight savings for four LRM 10s to lay down impressive long range fire. Backing these up are a pair of Ultra AC-10s for mid-range engagements. From there, four ER Medium Lasers provide a solid short range punch. Lastly, four Machine Guns provide anti-infantry support. These combine to make a solid and well rounded configuration. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Stone Rhino 4 是一款可变射程变型，它采用 XL 引擎节省重量，从而装下四具 LRM 10 倾泻出可观的远程火力。为其提供支援的是两门 Ultra AC-10，负责中距离交战；再往近处，四门增程中型激光提供扎实的近距离打击力；最后，四挺机枪提供反步兵支援。这些武器结合起来，构成了一套稳健而均衡的配置。特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: A design based off of early specifications for Amaris's Folly, the Stone Rhino 5 uses a 400XL engine to reach speeds up up to 64.8 km/h. It is armed with four LB-5X Autocannons mounted in the torsos backed up by six ER Medium Lasers in the arms. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是基于“阿马里斯之愚”早期规格的设计，石犀牛5采用一台400XL引擎达到最高64.8公里/小时。它装有四门装在躯干的LB-5X自动炮，并以六门臂载增程中型激光支援。特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: A design based off of early specifications for Amaris's Folly, the Stone Rhino 5 uses a 400XL engine to reach speeds up up to 64.8 km/h. It is armed with four LB-5X Autocannons mounted in the torsos backed up by six ER Medium Lasers in the arms.
column2: 这是基于“阿马里斯之愚”早期规格的设计，石犀牛5采用一台400XL引擎达到最高64.8公里/小时。它装有四门装在躯干的LB-5X自动炮，并以六门臂载增程中型激光支援。ZH

column1: A close combat design based on the Stone Rhino 5, the Stone Rhino 6 is armed with a simple yet effective loadout of 14 Medium Pulse Lasers. These are backed up by a single ER Small Laser. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 石犀牛 6 是基于石犀牛 5 的混战设计，装备了简单而高效的 14 门中型脉冲激光，另有一门增程小型激光作为补充。特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: With the STR-7 variant being designed for space operations, its full weaponry is energy based as to work efficiently in a vacuum environment, and the leg actuators have been reinforced to handle higher loads. The variant mounts a Large Pulse Laser on each Arm, a ER Larger Laser in each torso location and a Small Pulse Laser in the Head. 14 external Double Heat Sinks allows the STR-7 to operate its weapons and three Jump Jets inside an atmosphere. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 由于STR-7变型为太空作战而设计，其武器全部为能量武器以便在真空环境中高效运作，腿部驱动器也经过加固以承受更高载荷。该变型每只手臂装一门大型脉冲激光，两侧躯干各一门增程大型激光，头部一门小型脉冲激光。14个外置双散热器让STR-7能在大气层内使用武器和三具跳跃推进器。特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: With the STR-7 variant being designed for space operations, its full weaponry is energy based as to work efficiently in a vacuum environment, and the leg actuators have been reinforced to handle higher loads. The variant mounts a Large Pulse Laser on each Arm, a ER Larger Laser in each torso location and a Small Pulse Laser in the Head. 14 external Double Heat Sinks allows the STR-7 to operate its weapons and three Jump Jets inside an atmosphere.
column2: 由于STR-7改型是为太空作战设计，它的全部武器都是能量型，以便在真空环境中高效运作，而腿部驱动器经过加固以承受更高载荷。该改型在双臂各装一门大型脉冲激光器，在每个躯干部位装一门增程大型激光器，头部装一门小型脉冲激光器。14具外置双重散热器让STR-7得以在大气层内运作其武器与三个跳跃推进器。ZH

column1: A Clan redesign of 'Amaris Folly'. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是部族对“阿马里斯之愚”的重新设计。特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Classified Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 机密 特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: A direct-fire support loadout, the A uses a pair of ER PPCs. It retains the jump jets of the primary configuration to aid in finding a spot to snipe from. The variant also mounts seven additional double heat sinks to keep the heat buildup controlled. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 作为直射支援配置，A 型采用两具增程粒子加农炮。它保留了主配置的跳跃推进器，以便寻找合适的狙击位置。该变型还额外搭载七具双散热器，以控制积热。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Stooping Hawk
column2: 俯冲鹰

column1: Despite Khan Ceana Boques's demand for a low-cost and rugged design, the Blood Spirit scientist caste built the Stooping Hawk around a more expensive Endo Steel frame and ferro-fibrous armor to enhance Pod Space, but even they did not dare attempt the inclusion of an extralight fusion engine recognizing that this would be a step too far. While not as affordable as the Spirits would have preferred, the Stooping Hawk is a sturdy 'Mech with twenty-one and a half tons pod space and a ground speed maxing out at 86 km/h.
column2: 尽管可汗塞安娜·博克斯要求一款低成本、坚固的设计，血灵科学家种姓仍围绕更昂贵的内骨骼框架与铁纤维装甲建造俯冲鹰以增强吊舱空间，但即便是他们也不敢尝试加入超轻型聚变引擎——他们认识到那会是太过分的一步。虽然不如血灵所愿那样便宜，俯冲鹰仍是一台结实的机甲，拥有二十一吨半吊舱空间，地面速度最高 86 公里/小时。ZH

column1: The B configuration is a missile boat that is capable of delivering forty-five long-range missiles through its three LRM-15 launchers, each of which is aided by an Artemis IV FCS. Four tons of ammunition keep it well supplied, while a single ER Large Laser keeps it in the fight should ammunition run out. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: B配置是一艘导弹母舰，通过三具LRM-15发射器能投送四十五枚远程导弹，每具都由一套阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统辅助。四吨弹药让它供应充足，而一门增程大型激光让它在弹药耗尽时仍能留在战斗中。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Stooping Hawk C comes equipped with two ER Large Lasers and two ER Medium Lasers, all of which are guided by an advanced Targeting Computer. It also uses jump jets to vault up to 150 meters, like the A, and it makes use of seven additional double heat sinks, like the A. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 俯冲鹰 C 配备两门增程大型激光和两门增程中型激光，全部由先进的瞄准计算机引导。与 A 型一样，它也使用跳跃推进器跃出至多 150 米，同样像 A 型那样额外使用了七个双散热器。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: This D configuration uses heavy laser technology captured from Clan Star Adder. This all-energy variant uses an ER Large Laser, two ER Medium Lasers, and an ER Small Laser, but its punch comes from three Heavy Medium Lasers. In order to combat the massive heat buildup this design can produce, twelve double heat sinks are added. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这一D配置使用从星蝰部族缴获的重型激光技术，是全能量变型，装有一门增程大型激光、两门增程中型激光和一门增程小型激光，但真正的重拳来自三门重型中型激光。为应对这套设计可能产生的巨大热量，加装了十二个双散热器。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The bulk of the E configuration's weight is taken up by an LB 10-X AC with two tons of ammunition. It is supplemented by two ER Medium Lasers and the new ATM technology, utilizing three ATM-3s with three tons of ammo between the three launchers. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: E配置的大部分重量被一门LB 10-X自动炮和两吨弹药占据。它由两门增程中型激光和新型ATM技术补充，采用三具ATM-3，三具发射器共配三吨弹药。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Stooping Hawk's primary configuration uses jump jets to vault up to 150 meters at a time. Its main gun is an Ultra Autocannon/10 that has enough rounds to keep it supplied throughout a traditional Trial. It is supported by four medium lasers, two extended range versions, and two pulses. The medium-range weaponry allows the 'Mech to excel at Trials where it can use cover (and its jumping ability) to its advantage. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Stooping Hawk 的主配置利用跳跃推进器一次可跃出 150 米。其主炮为一门超级自动炮/10，备弹充足，足以应付一场传统试炼的全过程。支援武器为四具中型激光——两具增程型、两具脉冲型。这些中距离武器让该机甲在能借助掩体（以及自身跳跃能力）的试炼中占尽优势。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Predating the development of the OmniMech, the Storm Giant was an early Steel Viper mech commissioned by the then Khan, Sanra Mercer. Developed specifically to operate in the tropical environments of New Kent, the Storm Giant STG-1 is a 100-ton Mech with a 400-rated XL Engine. A pair of LRM-20’s make up the bulk of the Mechs firepower, with a pair of SSRM-6’s and a UAC/20 for close range combat. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 风暴巨人早于全向机甲的出现，是钢蛇部族早期的机甲，由时任可汗桑拉·默瑟下令建造。它专为新肯特的炎热环境作战而研制，风暴巨人STG-1是100吨机甲，带一台400额定XL引擎。两具LRM-20构成机甲火力的大部分，混战则由一对SSRM-6和一门UAC/20负责。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A common sight in Clan Toumans, the 55 ton Stormcrow is a second generation OmniMech that entered production in 2930. Powered by a 330-rated XL Engine, a combination of Ferro-Fibrous and Endo Steel give the OmniMech 23 tons of Pod Space. The Stormcrow Attwater is the personal configuration of Mia Attwater of the Nova Cats. An anti aircraft specialist, her Stormcrow was reconfigured to improve its effectiveness in this role. A pair of LB-5X’s and a pair of LRM-5’s augmented by Artemis IV make up the Attwater’s armament with 6 Jump Jets filling the remaining pod space. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 作为部族部队中常见的存在，55吨的暴风鸦是第二代全向机甲，于2930年投产。它由一台330额定XL引擎驱动，铁纤维与钢内骨结构的组合为这款全向机甲提供23吨挂载空间。暴风鸦阿特沃特是云豹部族米娅·阿特沃特的私人配置。作为防空专家，她的暴风鸦经过重新配置以提升该角色效能：一对LB-5X和一对加装阿尔忒弥斯IV的LRM-5构成阿特沃特的武装，其余挂载空间由6具跳跃推进器填满。特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：全向

The Ryoken 'Kotare' carries a quintet of ER medium lasers in the right arm and a pair of Streak SRM-6 launchers in the left torso. The right torso houses a single LRM-20. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

column1: The R loadout is a field upgrade developed in the midst of Operation Bulldog. This configuration utilized captured Clan Smoke Jaguar weapons to help bolster the SLDF forces in later waves. Based off the Strider E, thanks to lighter Clan weaponry it is able to mount two Clan-tech Streak SRM-6 launchers and a pair of Clan Medium Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: R 配置是在“斗牛犬行动”（Operation Bulldog）期间研发的战场升级。这套配置利用缴获的烟美洲豹部族武器，为后续几波攻势中的 SLDF 部队提供助力。它以步行者（Strider）E 型为基础，凭借更轻的部族武器，得以装设两具部族科技连发 SRM-6 发射器和两门部族中型脉冲激光。特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Striker STC-2C is built using rugged, off-the-shelf technologies that allow it to stand up to a great deal of punishment and enable easy repair. The 2C has a top speed of 64.8 km/h, provided by a 320-rated Fusion engine. For protection, it carries thirteen and a half tons of armor, solidly average for a 'Mech of the Striker's size. The Striker STC-2C dissipates the heat from its arsenal with fifteen standard heat sinks. It has an arsenal that is capable of engaging an enemy at a variety of ranges. At maximum range, the 2C brings its PPC and a AC/5 to bear. As the enemy closes, it can also make use of its Large Laser, though the unit's pilot will need to monitor their heat generation carefully. Finally, for close range defense, it has three Medium Lasers. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 打击者STC-2C采用坚固的现成技术建造，能承受大量打击且易于修理。2C由一台320额定聚变引擎驱动，最高速度64.8公里/小时。防护方面它带十三吨半装甲，对打击者这一尺寸的机甲而言正好是平均水平。打击者STC-2C用十五个标准散热器散发武器热量。它的武器组合能在多种距离上交战：最大射程上，2C可用粒子加农炮和一门AC/5攻击；敌人逼近后还可以动用大型激光，不过机师需要小心监控热量。最后，近距防御由三门中型激光负责。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: The Striker was originally commissioned by the SLDF high command in 2571 for non-Royal SLDF units. Along with the Stalker, the Striker became one of the most common 'Mechs in service. The Striker was built with the intent of being rugged and reliable, but more importantly, allowed House Lords to reserve their precious and limited numbers of assault BattleMechs for their own personal armies. In this way, the Striker may have been the show of good faith the House Lords needed to make the Star League work. In spite of the 'Mech's dependability, the Striker was marginal compared with later assault BattleMechs, and was eventually relegated to serving in militia units, with the highest concentration ending up on the rimward edge of the Terran Hegemony. After the destruction of the Stormvanger lines in 2867, fewer than 300 Strikers were known to exist in 3058.
column2: Striker 最初由 SLDF 最高指挥部于 2571 年委托研制，供非皇家 SLDF 部队使用。与 Stalker 一样，Striker 成为服役数量最多的机甲之一。Striker 的设计初衷是坚固可靠，但更重要的是，它让各家族领主得以把数量稀少而宝贵的突击战斗机甲保留给自己的私人军队。从这个意义上说，Striker 或许正是家族领主们为了让星际联盟得以运转所需的诚意之举。尽管该机甲可靠性出众，但与后来的突击战斗机甲相比仍显平庸，最终被降级到民兵部队服役，其中部署最集中的地区位于地球霸权靠近外围的边缘地带。在 2867 年 Stormvanger 生产线被摧毁之后，到 3058 年已知仅存不到 300 台 Striker。ZH

column1: The 2D variant of the Striker is a very basic upgrade of the design used by the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces. The PPC has been upgraded to an ER PPC, the three medium lasers have been replaced with a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers, and the 'Mech has had three heat sinks removed. The remaining heat sinks have been upgraded to double heat sinks. The remaining available space has been used to add two tons of armor to the 'Mech. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 打击者（Striker）2D 变型是对卡佩兰联邦武装部队所用设计的一次非常基础的升级。粒子加农炮升级为增程粒子加农炮，三门中型激光被替换为两门中型脉冲激光，该机甲还拆除了三台散热器。剩余的散热器则升级为双散热器。余下的可用空间被用于为该机甲增加两吨装甲。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: The Striker was originally commissioned by the SLDF high command in 2571 for non-Royal SLDF units. Along with the Stalker, the Striker became one of the most common 'Mechs in service. The Striker was built with the intent of being rugged and reliable, but more importantly, allowed House Lords to reserve their precious and limited numbers of assault BattleMechs for their own personal armies. In this way, the Striker may have been the show of good faith the House Lords needed to make the Star League work. In spite of the 'Mech's dependability, the Striker was marginal compared with later assault BattleMechs, and was eventually relegated to serving in militia units, with the highest concentration ending up on the rimward edge of the Terran Hegemony. After the destruction of the Stormvanger lines in 2867, fewer than 300 Strikers were known to exist in 3058
column2: 打击者最初由SLDF最高司令部于2571年为非皇家SLDF单位订购。与潜行者一样，打击者成为服役中最常见的机甲之一。它的建造初衷是坚固可靠，但更重要的是让各大家族领主能把珍贵而有限的突击战斗机甲留给自己的私人军队。从这个角度看，打击者或许正是让星际联盟得以运转的那份善意姿态。尽管可靠性出色，打击者与后来的突击战斗机甲相比仍显平庸，最终被下放到民兵部队服役，其中最大的一批集中在地球霸权朝向边缘的一侧。2867年斯托姆万格产线被毁之后，到3058年已知存世的打击者不足300台。ZH

column1: n order to make the Striker more heat-efficient, the House Steiner variant removed the Large Laser and autocannon to incorporate an Autocannon/10 with a two-ton magazine. The result is a 'Mech that has less damage potential, but easier heat management. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 为使打击者更省热，施泰纳家族变型拆掉大型激光和自动炮，改装一门AC/10（配两吨弹匣）。结果是一台伤害潜力更低但热量管理更容易的机甲。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左下

Backing these up are the standard LRM15 in the Left Torso and a pair of ER Medium Pulse Lasers in the left arm. A single Anti-Missile System in the right torso rounds out the configuration. column1: Hey Boss, the clans call these things the Summoner but I've always called em' the Thor.  These OmniMechs are a tad light on available pod space for their weight class and those early structural mounts are not compatible with anything else. But with that huge engine and lots of jumpjet hardpoints you will be hard pressed to find many 'Mechs its size that are faster.
column2: 嘿老板，氏族管这东西叫召唤者，但我一直叫它雷神。这些全能机甲在其重量级里可用吊舱空间偏少，而且那些早期结构挂架跟别的什么都不兼容。不过凭那台巨大的引擎和一堆跳跃推进器挂点，你很难找到多少同尺寸还比它快的机甲。ZH

column1: The Summoner is a highly mobile heavy OmniMech that is commonly used in a wide variety of roles. Barely a second generation OmniMech, the Jade Falcons introduced the Summoner just after becoming the first Clan to win OmniMech technology from Clan Coyote in 2863. A customized variant of the Summoner supposedly piloted by Jade Falcon Star Colonel Aidan Pryde, the Pryde uses an Ultra Autocannon/10 in its left arm, supported by a Ultra Autocannon/5 in the right arm, each with one ton of ammo. The left torso carries an ER small Laser with two Clan Anti Missile Systems and a ton of AMS ammo. A single ER Medium Laser in the right torso rounds out the loadout. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Summoner 是一种机动性极强的重型全向机甲，常用于各类不同的任务。它勉强算得上是第二代全向机甲——2863 年，翡翠猎鹰成为第一个从郊狼部族手中赢得全向机甲技术的部族，随即推出了 Summoner。这台定制变型据称由翡翠猎鹰星际上校艾丹·普莱德驾驶；Pryde 的左臂装有一门 Ultra 自动炮/10，右臂有一门 Ultra 自动炮/5 作为支援，两者各配一吨弹药。左躯干装有一门增程小型激光、两套部族反导弹系统以及一吨 AMS 弹药。右躯干的一门增程中型激光完善了整套配置。特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A vicious infighter, this configuration carries six ER Medium Lasers in each arm. Eleven pod-mounted double heat sinks are added to the torsos (bringing the total to twenty-three) to deal with the heat. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这一配置是凶悍的近身缠斗者，每条手臂各装有六门增程中型激光。躯干内加装了十一台荚舱式双散热器（总数达到二十三台）以应对热量。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Sun Bear is best known as the progenitor design for the Stooping Hawk. Originally named the Prototype A, it was developed by Clan Ghost Bear as a competitor of the Stormcrow and Mad Dog designs. Eschewing bulky equipment like ferro-fibrous armor and an Endo Steel chassis, it instead used an XL engine to provide 24 tons of pod space. This was less than the pod space of the Mad Dog but slightly more than the Stormcrow. Despite these advantages, the Sun Bear ultimately was not favored by Clan Ghost Bear. The Prototype As entered service under the name of Sun Bear. The design was beloved by its pilots and it frequently went to the most aggressive pilots in the Bear touman.
column2: 太阳熊（Sun Bear）最广为人知的身份是俯冲鹰（Stooping Hawk）的前身设计。它最初名为原型 A，由幽灵熊部族研发，用以与暴鸦（Stormcrow）和疯狗（Mad Dog）设计竞争。它舍弃了铁纤维装甲和 Endo Steel 底盘这类笨重装备，转而采用 XL 引擎，以提供 24 吨的挂载空间。这少于疯狗的挂载空间，却略多于暴鸦。尽管具备这些优势，太阳熊最终仍未得到幽灵熊部族的青睐。原型 A 以太阳熊之名进入服役。这种设计深受机师喜爱，常常被分配给熊部族 touman 中最具攻击性的机师。ZH

column1: The B configuration is a long range fire support specialist. Each arm carries an ER Large Laser supported by an ER Medium Laser. Each side torso carries an LRM-20 with one ton of ammunition. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: B配置是远程火力支援专家。每条手臂各携带一门增程大型激光，辅以一门增程中型激光。左右躯干各装有一具LRM-20，备弹一吨。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The primary configuration of the Sun Bear uses a massive Ultra AC/20 to quickly destroy threats. Three tons of ammunition are carried in a CASE protected bay. Each arm carries an ER Medium Laser and a Medium Pulse Laser. Protection comes from ten and a half tons of standard plate armor. Two more pod mounted heat sinks take the total to fourteen. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 太阳熊的主配置用一门庞大的超级AC/20迅速摧毁威胁，三吨弹药存放在CASE防护弹药舱中。每只手臂各带一门增程中型激光和一门中型脉冲激光。防护来自十吨半标准板式装甲。另有两个挂载式散热器使总数达到十四个。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Ambush mounts an Ultra AC/10 in each arm and a pair of ER Medium lasers in each side torso. Four tons of ammunition feed the cannons, and a total of 15 double-heatsinks cool the machine. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 伏击每只手臂装一门超级AC/10，两侧躯干各装两门增程中型激光。四吨弹药为自动炮供弹，总共15个双散热器为这台机器降温。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The custom config of Star Colonel Tabok of the Fourth Scorpion Cuirassiers, the 'Manul' Hero 'Mech is a ranged energy boat with an ER PPC and ER Large Laser in each arm. Its only other weapon is an ER Small Laser in the left torso. 'Manul' is fitted with AMS and single ton of reloads, the remaining weight devoted to nine extra double heat sinks. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是第四蝎子胸甲骑兵团星上校塔博克的定制配置，“Manul”英雄机甲是一具远程能量平台，每条手臂各装有一门增程粒子加农炮和一门大型增程激光。它唯一的其他武器是左躯干中的一门小型增程激光。“Manul”装有 AMS 及一吨备弹，剩余重量全部用于九具额外的双散热器。特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A Draconis Combine developed Omni mech, the Sunder is based on reverse engineered Loki and Thor Omnimechs. A 360-rated XL Engine allows the omnimech to carry 15 DHS along with 16.5 tons of armor and 36 tons of weapons. The Sunder SD1-O is armed with an AC/20 and a pair of Large Lasers. 2 Medium Lasers and a trio of SRM-4’s act as secondary weapons. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 作为龙脉联合体研发的全向机甲，Sunder以逆向工程仿制的Loki与Thor全向机甲为基础。额定360的XL引擎让这台全向机甲能够携带15台双散热器，外加16.5吨装甲和36吨武器。Sunder SD1-O装备一门AC/20和两门大型激光，2门中型激光与三具SRM-4则充当副武器。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The GRF-2N-X Super Griffin is an evolution of the classic Griffin, a re-design that essentially produced a new BattleMech with even a different tonnage. Using a sixty ton frame, engineers fitted Prototype Improved Jump Jets to the 'Mech to compensate for its reduced speed. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: GRF-2N-X超级狮鹫是经典狮鹫的进化型，这次重新设计实质上造就了一台全新的战斗机甲，连吨位都截然不同。工程师们采用六十吨的底盘，为这台机甲装上了原型改进型跳跃推进器，以弥补其速度上的损失。特性：空中突击 投放费用倍率：1.1

column1: The WSP-2A-X Super Wasp is an evolution of the classic Wasp, a re-design that essentially produced a new BattleMech with even a different tonnage. Weighing as much as a Commando, the Super Wasp maintained the basic ground speed and jump capability of its inspiration, but also added an engine Supercharger which allowed it to sprint at speeds of up to 120 km/h. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: WSP-2A-X超级黄蜂是经典黄蜂的演化体，一次实质上是造出全新机甲、连吨位都不同的重新设计。超级黄蜂重量与突击兵相当，保持了原型的基本地面速度与跳跃能力，但还加装了引擎增压器，使其能以高达120公里/小时的速度疾驰。特性：空中突击 投放费用倍率：0.96

column1: The Supernova 1's only armaments are six Clan ER Large Lasers. While this is a fair amount of firepower for a 'Mech of its size, it has a severe overheating problem. After firing no more than three full, consecutive salvos, the Supernova will force an automatic shutdown, so MechWarriors must carefully manage their heat. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 超新星1仅有的武器是六门部族增程大型激光。虽然对同尺寸机甲而言火力相当可观，但它有严重的过热问题：连续全力齐射不超过三轮，超新星就会强制自动停机，因此机甲战士必须小心管理热量。特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.2 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: This variant strips out all the lasers and replaces them with four Large Pulse Lasers, two Heavy Medium Lasers, and a Targeting Computer. This variant retains enough additional double heat sinks to help with heat management.
column2: 这一改型拆掉所有激光器，换成四门大型脉冲激光器、两门重型中型激光器和一台瞄准计算机。该改型保留了足够多的额外双重散热器以协助热量管理。ZH

column1: While feared by the Inner Sphere, the Supernova design was born out of necessity in an attempt to address ammunition shortages by changing the original King Crab design to an all-energy loadout. The Boiler is a customized Supernova variant that seeks to re-engineer the Supernova back to the original King Crab loadout using Clan technology, essentially making the Boiler a 'King Crab IIC'. It mounts an Ultra AC/20 in each arm supported by a Large Pulse Laser in the right torso and an LRM-15 rack in the left. As it was built upon the frame of the standard Supernova, it retains the jump jets but mounts only seventeen double heat sinks. Like its progenitor, the Boiler lacks field endurance, carrying only two tons of Ultra Autocannon rounds and one ton of LRM reloads. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 超新星的设计虽令内层星域忌惮，却源于无奈：为应对弹药短缺，它把原本的帝王蟹设计改为全能量配置。锅炉是一台定制的超新星变型，试图用部族技术把超新星改回原版帝王蟹的配置，实质上让它成为一台"帝王蟹IIC"。它每只手臂各装一门超级自动炮AC/20，右躯干有一具大型脉冲激光支援，左躯干则装有一具LRM-15发射架。由于以标准超新星的机架为基础，它保留了跳跃推进器，但只装有十七具双散热器。与其前身一样，锅炉缺乏战场续航能力，仅携带两吨超级自动炮弹和一吨LRM备弹。特性：改进瞄准（远程） 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: While feared by the Inner Sphere, the Supernova design was born out of necessity in an attempt to address ammunition shortages by changing the original King Crab design to an all-energy loadout. The Boiler is a customized Supernova variant that seeks to re-engineer the Supernova back to the original King Crab loadout using Clan technology, essentially making the Boiler a 'King Crab IIC'. It mounts an Ultra AC/20 in each arm supported by a Large Pulse Laser in the right torso and an LRM-15 rack in the left. As it was built upon the frame of the standard Supernova, it retains the jump jets but mounts only seventeen double heat sinks. Like its progenitor, the Boiler lacks field endurance, carrying only two tons of Ultra Autocannon rounds and one ton of LRM reloads.
column2: 虽然令内天体畏惧，超新星的设计却是出于无奈——为应对弹药短缺，把原本的帝王蟹设计改成全能量载荷。锅炉是一台定制超新星改型，试图用氏族科技把超新星重新改回帝王蟹原本的载荷，本质上让锅炉成为一台"帝王蟹IIC"。它在双臂各装一门超速AC/20，由右躯干的一门大型脉冲激光器和左躯干的一具LRM-15架支援。由于它建在标准超新星的框架上，保留了跳跃推进器，但只装了十七具双重散热器。与其前身一样，锅炉缺乏战场续航力，只携带两吨超速自动炮弹和一吨LRM备用弹。ZH

column1: The Swordsman was an early Federated Suns medium-class BattleMech which was originally built in 2463 as House Davion's third in-house BattleMech design. The design was tainted by heavy use in the Davion Civil War of 2525-2540. Eventually, production ended and the design was relegated to the dustbin of history. However, in the 3060s, the mech was put back into production by House Davion to supplement their forces in the FedCom Civil War. The SWD-2 is the stock production design, mounting heavy armor and firepower for the tonnage: 7.5 tons of armor and a grab-bag mix of guns including an AC/5, LRM-5, SRM-4, two Medium Lasers, and a Small Laser. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1
column2: 剑士是联邦太阳国早期的一款中型机甲，最初于2463年制造，是戴维恩家族第三款自研机甲设计。该设计因在2525-2540年的戴维恩内战中大量使用而蒙上污名。最终生产终止，设计被弃入历史的垃圾堆。然而在3060年代，戴维恩家族为补充联邦共和内战中的兵力，将其重新投入生产。SWD-2是标准量产型号，在同吨位下配备了厚重的装甲与火力：7.5吨装甲，以及一支拼凑而成的混合武器组合，包括一门AC/5、一具LRM-5、一具SRM-4、两门中型激光和一门小型激光。特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1

column1: The Sylph was created by Clan Cloud Cobra to augment their vast aerospace forces with a fully-airborne battle armor suit. Naming it after elemental spirits representing air, development of the suit was driven as much by the Cloud Cobra's faith as it was by Khan Din Steiner's orders. Despite their scientist caste's vast knowledge of aircraft, the Clan had a great deal of trouble getting the VTOL capabilities of the Sylph to function, with a number of test pilots dying during its secretive development. As it is, the Sylph only possesses limited flight capabilities, but even this remains an impressive accomplishment. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.9475 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 风精由云眼镜蛇部族创造，旨在用一套可完全空中机动的战斗装甲来增强其庞大的航空航天部队。它以代表空气的元素精灵命名，这套装甲的研发既出于云眼镜蛇的信仰，也出于可汗 Din Steiner 的命令。尽管其科学家种姓对飞行器有着渊博的知识，该部族在让风精的垂直起降功能正常运作方面却遇到了极大困难，在其秘密研发过程中有多名试飞员丧生。就实际效果而言，风精仅具备有限的飞行能力，但即便如此仍是一项令人瞩目的成就。特性：灵活 投放费用倍率：0.9475 可搭载全向单位，可近战，可蜂拥。

column1: The Tai-sho concentrates on keeping an enemy at long range and using targeting data from friendly units to enhance its long range capabilities. The primary weapons it carries are a pair of ER PPCs capable of keeping an adversary at arms reach. These are backed up by an Ultra Autocannon/10 which can fire at twice the rate of a standard autocannon. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 大将着重把敌人挡在远处，并利用友军单位的瞄准数据增强自身远程能力。它的主要武器是一对能把对手挡在一臂之外的增程粒子加农炮，辅以一门能以标准自动炮两倍射速射击的超级自动炮/10。特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Tai-sho carries a 255 fusion engine, giving the 'Mech a top speed of 54.0 km/h while also adding to the durability of the design. The 'Mech is protected with fifteen tons of Durallex ferro-fibrous armor and also has CASE in its right torso to protect the 'Mech from an ammunition explosion. To dissipate waste heat, the Tai-sho is equipped with thirteen double heat sinks.
column2: 大将携带一台255聚变引擎，使该机甲最高速度达到54.0公里/小时，同时也增强了该设计的耐久性。该机甲由十五吨杜拉雷克斯铁纤装甲保护，右躯干还装有CASE，以保护机甲免受弹药爆炸之害。为散发废热，大将配备十三具双重散热器。ZH

column1: The 3L has a lackluster range of weapons compared to the other variants of the Talon; three Medium Lasers and one Small Laser. The 'Mech is instead focused more on the scouting role, with a Beagle Active Probe and an Angel ECM suite. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 与 Talon 的其他变型机相比，3L 的武器射程表现平平：三门中型激光和一门小型激光。该机甲反而更侧重于侦察角色，配备一具 Beagle 主动探测器和一套 Angel 电子对抗套件。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：0.98

column1: A Star League era mech, the Talon debuted in 2670 as a light fire support mech. Rendered extinct by the destruction of the Succession Wars, it re-entered production in 3056, though the Clans retain a number of SLDF models from the Exodus. Built around a 280 XL Engine, the Talon TLN-5V is armed with a PPC and a pair of Medium Lasers.
column2: 利爪是一台星际联盟时代的机甲，2670 年作为轻型火力支援机甲首次登场。继承战争的破坏令其绝迹，直到 3056 年才重新投产，不过部族仍保有一些来自大逃亡时期的 SLDF 型号。利爪 TLN-5V 以 280 XL 引擎为核心，装备一门粒子加农炮和两门中型激光。ZH

column2: Talon 是星际联盟时代的机甲，于 2670 年作为轻型火力支援机甲首次亮相。继承战争的破坏曾使它一度绝迹，直到 3056 年才重新投产，不过部族仍保留着若干随大逃亡带出的星际联盟防御部队型号。Talon TLN-5V 围绕一台 280 XL 引擎建造，装备一门粒子加农炮和两门中型激光。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The 5VNO is a downgraded Succession Wars era version using a standard 210 engine, reducing its ground speed down to a maximum of 90 km/h with seven and a half tons of standard armor. It has a single PPC in the right arm for ranged combat, backed up pair of medium lasers in the left arm. This design has no lower arm actuators allowing it to flip its weapons into the rear arc. A few units have been reported fielded by pirates. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 5VNO 是继承战争时期的降级版本，使用标准 210 引擎，地面最高速度降至 90 km/h，装甲为七吨半标准装甲。它在右臂装有一门粒子加农炮用于远距离作战，左臂则有两门中型激光作为补充。这一设计没有下臂驱动器，因此可以把武器翻转朝后方射击。据报道，有少量此型机甲被海盗投入使用。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂
