column2: 战锤 LAM

column1: Wow Boss, a Thor's Hammer production model? These things were rare as hell, considering the Clans took great offense to having LAMs built to fight them. They went out of their way to track down and destroy all the factories, and their warriors would focus on them even if it meant ignoring bigger threats. This is the basic model, pretty good at what it was set out to do: bomb, rear attack, then crit the enemy out. But remember, it's a LAM; none of that 'stand and shoot' stuff you might pull off in a Warhammer will work with this.
column2: 哇老大，托尔之锤的量产型号？这些东西罕见得要命，因为氏族对有人造LAM来打他们极为恼怒。他们不遗余力地追踪并摧毁所有工厂，他们的战士就算要放过更大的威胁也会优先打它们。这是基础型号，很擅长它本来的任务：轰炸、后方袭击，然后把敌人打出致命伤。但要记住，它是LAM；你在重锤上可能玩出来的那种"站着对射"都不适用。ZH

column1: Developed as part of Project Thor's Hammer, the Warhammer LAM aims to merge the effectiveness of the Warhammer's twin PPCs, with the mobility of a LAM, in hopes of aiding the fight against the Clans. The B variant replaces the bomb bay and SRMs for MMLs, providing 16 tubes in total, and was marketed towards Mercenary groups. The lack of PPC Capacitors aids in repairs, and the loss of damage is replaced by the MMLs providing long range fire support with the LRMs. For close range combat, the quadrupling of SRMs fired offsets the loss of the bomb bay, but allows for a few more short range passes as the MMLs can fire multiple times. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Warhammer LAM作为“雷神之锤计划”的一部分研发，旨在将Warhammer双粒子加农炮的威力与LAM的机动性融为一体，以期助力对抗部族。B变型以MML替换弹舱和SRM，共提供16个发射管，并面向雇佣兵团体销售。省去粒子加农炮电容器有利于维修，损失的伤害则由MML发射LRM提供的远程火力支援弥补。近距战斗方面，SRM发射量增至四倍，弥补了弹舱的损失，同时还能多进行几次短程突袭，因为MML可以多次发射。特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A Merc's Hammer? These were never as popular as the advertisements claimed; the minimal ammo for the MMLs meant most Mercs would immediately buy a refit package to drop one of the leg MMLs for some extra ammunition. Though, they are great fire support units once you get past that ammo issue; anything that could outrange them, was often too slow to keep them in range, which meant they would often survive traps that would eliminate other fire support lances.
column2: 雇佣兵之锤？这些从来没有广告宣称的那么受欢迎；MML的弹药极少，意味着大多数雇佣兵会立刻买一套改装包，拆掉一具腿部MML以换取额外弹药。不过，一旦你解决了弹药问题，它们就是极佳的火力支援单位；任何能在射程上超过它们的东西，往往又太慢而无法把它们留在射程内，这意味着它们常能在会消灭其他火力支援分队的陷阱中幸存。ZH

column1: Fulfilling the initial goal of Project Thor's Hammer, the Warhammer LAM ver. C is able to take out a Clan's Thor Omnimech with a single pass, and survive the encounter. While single-kill mechs were often relegated to the trashbin in the planning stages, the necessity of defeating a mech, and then claiming the salvage during the early Clan Invasion, saw such units come to the forefront of battle for a brief period. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 战锤LAM ver. C实现了“托尔之锤计划”的初衷：它能在一次通场中击杀部族的托尔全向机甲并全身而退。虽然“单位击杀型机甲”在规划阶段常被丢进废纸篓，但在部族入侵早期，既击败机甲又夺取战利品的必要性让这类单位短暂地走到了战斗前沿。特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Boss, you got a pilot you hate, but still want to rack up some kills with? If so, this is the mech for them. Those bombs will definitely destroy something, but then you're looking at either melee combat, or running interference, if not retreating, considering the lack of weaponry. I still can't believe this was a production model, what were the engineers thinking?!
column2: 老大，你有个讨厌的机师，但又想攒点击杀数吗？那么，这就是给他准备的机甲。那些炸弹肯定会炸掉点东西，但考虑到缺乏武器，之后你要么打近战，要么就去干扰，不然就是撤退。我还是不敢相信这是量产型号，工程师当时在想什么？！ZH

column1: A battlefield refit of the 6R, switching the armor to Ferro-Fibrous allowing the upgrade of side torso mounted small lasers to Medium Pulse Lasers. An extra Small Laser was added to the center torso, and the cooling switched to use Double Heatsinks. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是6R的野战改装，把装甲换成铁纤维，从而把侧躯干的小型激光升级为中型脉冲激光。中央躯干再加一门小型激光，冷却也改用双散热器。特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: One of the mainstays of the heavy 'Mechs. Solid, dependable, and heavy hitting.
column2: 重型机甲的中坚之一。扎实、可靠、打击沉重。ZH

column1: A custom variant used by the Gray Death Legion mercenary outfit. Converting the Warhammer to full Clan technology greatly improved its combat potential, making it a proper line unit for the mercenaries. Two ER PPC, two ER Medium and two ER Small Lasers, a single SRM-6, and three Heavy Machine Guns allows the design to handle both large and small targets. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是灰死军团雇佣兵部队使用的定制变型。把风暴之锤改为全部部族技术后，其作战潜力大幅提升，成为这支部队名副其实的战列单位。两门增程粒子加农炮、两门增程中型和两门增程小型激光、一具SRM-6以及三挺重型机枪，让该设计既能对付大型也能对付小型目标。特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Piloted by Chu-sa Fengo Olesko, commander of Third Battalion of the Fifth Amphigean Light Assault Group replaced the SRM and ammunition with four tons of Communications Equipment to coordinate her forces. The only weapons remaining were the arm-mounted PPCs and torso-mounted medium lasers. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 由第五Amphigean轻型突击群第三营营长Fengo Olesko中佐驾驶的这台机甲，把SRM及其弹药换成了四吨通讯设备，以便协调她的部队。剩下的武器只有安装在手臂上的粒子加农炮与装在躯干上的中型激光。特性：集成探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Known and revered across the Inner Sphere and beyond, the Warhammer is the pre-eminent heavy Mech. Debuting in 2515, the 70-ton Mech is a solid blend of firepower and mobility designed to outfight almost any opponent. Powered by a 350 XL Engine, the Warhammer WHM-6Rk is armed with a pair of PPC’s. A pair of Medium Lasers, Small Lasers, Machine Guns and an SRM-6 deter opponents from closing in. Double Heat Sinks round out the variant. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Warhammer在内层星域乃至更远之处都闻名遐迩、备受尊崇，是最杰出的重型机甲。这款70吨的机甲于2515年首次亮相，是火力与机动性的坚实结合，设计目标就是要击败几乎所有对手。Warhammer WHM-6Rk由一台350 XL引擎驱动，装备一对粒子加农炮。一对中型激光、小型激光、机枪和一具SRM-6则阻止对手近身。双散热器构成了该变型的最后一块拼图。特性：集成探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Known and revered across the Inner Sphere and beyond, the Warhammer is the pre-eminent heavy Mech. Debuting in 2515, the 70-ton Mech is a solid blend of firepower and mobility designed to outfight almost any opponent. Powered by a 350 XL Engine, the Warhammer WHM-6Rk is armed with a pair of PPC’s. A pair of Medium Lasers, Small Lasers, Machine Guns and an SRM-6 deter opponents from closing in. Double Heat Sinks round out the variant. Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1.
column2: 在内天体及更远处广为人知、备受尊崇，重锤是最杰出的重型机甲。它于2515年首次亮相，这种70吨机甲是火力与机动性的坚实融合，设计上要打败几乎任何对手。重锤WHM-6Rk由一具350 XL引擎驱动，武装为两门PPC。一对中型激光器、小型激光器、机枪和一具SRM-6阻止对手逼近。双重散热器补全了该改型。投放成本倍率：1.1。

column1: A refit of the 6R, freeing 6 tons of weight capacity by switching to double heat sinks. This allowed adding both more armor and CASE protection, improving the durability greatly. Further, a C3 slave unit was added for improved lance communications. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是 6R 的改装型，通过换装双散热器腾出了 6 吨重量容量。这使其既能增加装甲，又能加装 CASE 防护，大幅提升了耐用性。此外还加装了一具 C3 从属单元，以改善小队通讯。特性：集成探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A fully Clan converted variant of the Warhammer, mainly seen with the Wolf's Dragoons mercenaries. Two ER PPC are the main damage source, with two ER Medium Laser, Medium Pulse Laser and Streak SRM-6 as extra firepower as needed at various ranges. An advanced targeting computer and ECM suite were also fitted. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是风暴之锤的完全部族化变型，主要见于狼之龙骑兵雇佣兵部队。两门增程粒子加农炮是主要伤害来源，两门增程中型激光、中型脉冲激光和一具连发SRM-6则在不同距离上按需提供额外火力。它还配有一台先进瞄准计算机和一套电子对抗套件。特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A subvariant of the WHM-6W, which adds a C3 slave computer by dropping the ECM suite. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: WHM-6W的子变型，通过拆除电子对抗套件来加装一台C3从属计算机。特性：集成探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: An experimental upgrade of the 6D done by Apple for the Lyran Alliance military forces. It mounts two cutting edge ER PPC, two Medium Lasers and two Machine Guns - all cooled by 18 single heat sinks. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是Apple为莱兰联盟军队打造的6D实验性升级版。它装备两门最前沿的增程粒子加农炮、两门中型激光和两挺机枪，全部由18台单散热器冷却。特性：集成探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A Clan Buster upgrade, the Warhammer 7CS was developed specifically for Tukayyid. Designed as a general purpose unit designed for offence and defensive roles, the Warhammer 7CS mounts a 280-rated XL Engine and DHS. A pair of ER PPC’s and 4 Medium Lasers make up the bulk of the 7CS’s load out. A trio of Streak SRM-2’s with a ton of CASE protected ammo round out the weapons, while 4 Jump Jets offer additional mobility. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Warhammer 7CS是专为图凯伊德之战研发的“部族杀手”升级型号。作为一款兼顾进攻与防御的通用单位，Warhammer 7CS搭载额定280的XL引擎和双散热器。两门增程粒子加农炮和4门中型激光构成7CS武器的主体。三具连发SRM-2外加一吨CASE保护的弹药补全了武器配置，另有4台跳跃推进器提供额外机动性。特性：集成探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A Clan Buster upgrade, the Warhammer 7CS was developed specifically for Tukayyid. Designed as a general purpose unit designed for offence and defensive roles, the Warhammer 7CS mounts a 280-rated XL Engine and DHS. A pair of ER PPC’s and 4 Medium Lasers make up the bulk of the 7CS’s load out. A trio of Streak SRM-2’s with a ton of CASE protected ammo round out the weapons, while 4 Jump Jets offer additional mobility.
column2: 作为一款"灭族者"升级，重锤7CS专为图卡伊德研发。7CS被设计为兼顾攻防的通用单位，装有一具280级XL引擎和双重散热器。两门增程PPC和4门中型激光器构成7CS负载的主体。三具连发SRM-2配一吨CASE保护的弹药补全武器，另有4个跳跃推进器提供额外机动性。ZH

column1: An alteration of the 6R model introduced in 2835, the 6D removed the machine guns and the SRM-6 launcher to add an additional four tons of armor to the design, increasing its leg protection, as well as two more heat sinks. The 6D was particularly favored by the Federated Suns. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 6D 是 2835 年推出的 6R 型号改动版，它移除机枪和 SRM-6 发射器，为设计增加四吨装甲（提升腿部防护）以及两台额外散热器。6D 尤其受联邦太阳系青睐。特质：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.08 臂部驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: A house Kurita refresh of the 7K, using double heat sinks and Endo Steel to fit an impressive amount of weapons yet remain very well armored. Two ER PPC, four ER lasers and a Streak SRM-6 ensures the 'Mech can handle most threats at anything except extremely long ranges. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是库瑞塔家族对7K的翻新，使用双散热器和钢内骨结构，装入可观数量的武器同时保持极为出色的装甲。两门增程粒子加农炮、四门增程激光和一具连发SRM-6，确保该机甲除极远距离外几乎能应付大多数威胁。特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Known and revered across the Inner Sphere and beyond, the Warhammer is the pre-eminent heavy Mech. Debuting in 2515, the 70-ton Mech is a solid blend of firepower and mobility designed to outfight almost any opponent. Powered by a 280 Fusion Core, the Warhammer WHM-7M-DC is armed with a pair of ER PPC’s. A Medium Laser, Machine Gun and SRM-6 deter opponents from closing in. A Command Console rounds out the design. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Warhammer 闻名于内层星域内外并备受尊崇，是最杰出的重型机甲。这台 70 吨机甲于 2515 年首次亮相，将火力与机动性扎实地融为一体，旨在击败几乎任何对手。Warhammer WHM-7M-DC 由一台 280 聚变核心驱动，装备两门增程粒子加农炮。一门中型激光、一挺机枪和一具 SRM-6 可阻止对手逼近。指挥控制台则让该设计更为完善。特性：集成探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Known and revered across the Inner Sphere and beyond, the Warhammer is the pre-eminent heavy Mech. Debuting in 2515, the 70-ton Mech is a solid blend of firepower and mobility designed to outfight almost any opponent. Powered by a 280 Fusion Core, the Warhammer WHM-7M-DC is armed with a pair of ER PPC’s. A Medium Laser, Machine Gun and SRM-6 deter opponents from closing in. A Command Console rounds out the design.
column2: 风暴之锤在内层星域内外广为人知并备受崇敬，是最杰出的重型机甲。这台70吨机甲于2515年首次亮相，是火力与机动性的扎实融合，设计用于压制几乎任何对手。风暴之锤WHM-7M-DC由一台280聚变核心驱动，装有一对增程粒子加农炮；一门中型激光、一挺机枪和一具SRM-6阻止对手逼近；另有一座指挥控制台为该设计收尾。ZH

column1: A seemingly average Warhammer, the 'Widows Whammy', was rumoured to be the configuration piloted by the Black Widow Natasha Kerensky herself. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - PPC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这台看似普通的“寡妇之锤”风暴之锤，据传正是“黑寡妇”娜塔莎·克伦斯基本人驾驶的配置。特性：改进冷却套 - 粒子加农炮 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A seemingly average Warhammer, the 'Widows Whammy', was rumoured to be the configuration piloted by the Black Widow Natasha Kerensky herself.
column2: 一台看似平平无奇的重锤，"寡妇重击"，据传正是黑寡妇娜塔莎·克伦斯基亲自驾驶的配置。ZH

column1: A Clan-tech retrofit of the venerable Warhammer intended for second-line and solahma troops, this variant replaced most of the Inner Sphere-tech weaponry of the original WHM-6R with Clan equivalents and used the weight savings to add two more heat sinks. The PPCs were replaced with Large Pulse Lasers, the SRM-6 was upgraded to a Streak SRM-6, and all of the lasers were upgraded to ER medium and ER small lasers. Only the machine guns were not replaced with Clan-tech models. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是为二线与索拉马部队进行的一次古老风暴之锤部族技术改装，以部族同类武器替换原版WHM-6R的大部分内层星域武器，并用省下的重量加装两个散热器。粒子加农炮换成大型脉冲激光，SRM-6升级为连发SRM-6，所有激光升级为增程中型和增程小型激光。只有机枪没有换成部族技术型号。特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The C2 is a further upgrade of previously upgraded Inner Sphere Warhammers. Retaining its Inner Sphere engine, internal structure, armor, and 18 double heat sinks the C2 completely upgrades the weaponry to Clan standards. Clan ER PPCs sit in the arms. Each side torso houses a Clan Medium Pulse Laser, and both a pulse and ER Small Laser. A Streak SRM-6 replaces the typical shoulder-mounted SRMs; its one ton of ammo is in the right torso. Both the lack of CASE and low amount of armor makes this Warhammer a bit of a glass cannon. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: C2 是在此前已升级过的内层星域 Warhammer 之上做的进一步升级。C2 保留其内层星域的引擎、内部结构、装甲与 18 具双散热器，却把武器全面升级至部族标准。双臂装设部族增程粒子加农炮。每侧躯干各有一门部族中型脉冲激光，以及脉冲小型激光与增程小型激光各一门。一具连发 SRM-6 取代了惯常的肩载 SRM，其弹药一吨位于右躯干。由于既没有 CASE、装甲又偏薄，这台 Warhammer 多少有点“玻璃大炮”的味道。特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

column1: A Golden Century refit popular with Wolf's Dragoons, this Warhammer was rebuilt from the ground up with Clan technology. Built using an endo steel internal structure and XL engine, the C 3 has plenty of space for weapons and heat sinks. An ER PPC is carried in each arm. Both side torsos carry an ER Medium Laser, a Medium Pulse Laser, and a Streak SRM-6. An ECM Suite protects this variant, while a Targeting Computer makes the already fearsome weaponry even more dangerous. 17 double heat sinks cannot keep the 'Mech cool unless the pilot fires either its long range or short range weapons. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这款战锤在"黄金世纪"时期翻新，深受狼之龙骑兵青睐，以部族技术从头重建。它采用钢内骨结构和XL引擎，C 3因此有充裕空间容纳武器与散热器。每只手臂各装备一门增程粒子加农炮，两侧躯干各装有一具增程中型激光、一具中型脉冲激光和一具连发SRM-6。该变型由电子对抗套件提供防护，而瞄准计算机则让本已可怕的武器更加致命。17具双散热器不足以让机甲保持凉爽，除非机师只使用远程或近程武器中的一种。特性：集成探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The TD variant of the Warhammer is focused on long to medium range engagements, using its two ER PPC and four Medium Pulse Lasers to overwhelm any foes. A SRM-6 provides extra punch at closer range together with a single Small Laser, and an AMS provides some extra defense. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 风暴之锤的TD变型专注中远程交战，用两门增程粒子加农炮和四门中型脉冲激光压倒任何敌人。一具SRM-6与一门单独的小型激光在较近距离提供额外打击力，一套反导弹系统则提供额外防御。特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The personal OmniMech of Star Colonel Anwen, this Warhawk shows the warrior's penchant for energy-based weapons may have given way to an obsession. Beginning with its primary weapons array, this Warhawk boasts four ER Large Lasers. Another grouping of energy weapons make up Anwen's secondary weapons system, a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers mounted on the 'Mech's center torso. Furthermore, one ER Medium Laser and one ER Small Laser offer even more added damage potential. Anwen kept the Warhawk’s integrated targeting computer, but had to make some modifications to allow for an increased weapons load. Mounting only energy-weapons makes heat dissipation a primary concern. In an attempt to solve the problem, Blood Spirit technicians equipped the 'Mech with 26 high efficiency heat sinks. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这台战鹰是星上校安雯的专属全向机甲，显示出这位战士对能量武器的偏爱或许已演变为痴迷。它的主武器阵列以四门增程大型激光傲视群雄；副武器同样由能量武器组成——两具中型脉冲激光安装在机甲的中躯干。此外，一具增程中型激光和一具增程小型激光进一步增强了伤害潜力。安雯保留了战鹰内置的瞄准计算机，但为增加武器负载不得不做了一些改动。由于全身只装能量武器，散热成为首要难题；血灵部族的技术人员为此为机甲配备了26具高效散热器。特性：改进瞄准（远程） 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: An alternate take on the C configuration replaces the two ER PPCs with another pair of Large Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是C配置的另一种做法，以另一对大型脉冲激光取代两门增程粒子加农炮。特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Warhawk I mounts one Large Laser and one ER PPC in each arm, with the addition of a SRM-6 and a LRM-5 in the center torso. A total of 24 heatsinks tries to cool it, but it still runs quite hot. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Warhawk I 于每侧手臂各装一门大型激光与一门增程粒子加农炮，中央躯干另加装一具 SRM-6 与一具 LRM-5。总共 24 具散热器试图为其散热，但它运行时依然相当高温。特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The J configuration mounts four jump jets, allowing the 'Mech to flank enemies easier to unleash its weaponry. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: J配置装有四具跳跃推进器，让机甲更容易绕到敌人侧翼倾泻火力。特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A customized variant of the Warhawk, reportedly piloted by Hunter Tseng from Clan Ghost Bear. The Nanuq uses a trio of ER Medium Lasers in its left arm. The center torso carries a Active Probe. In it's right torso carries a LRM-15 with two tons of ammo and one ton of ultra autocannon ammo. The right arm carries a pair of Ultra Autocannon/10s with two tons of ammo. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是战鹰的定制变型，据报由鬼熊部族的猎人曾格驾驶。纳努克左臂装三门增程中型激光，中央躯干带一台主动探测器；右躯干带一具LRM-15（配两吨弹药）和一吨超级自动炮弹药；右臂则装一对超级AC/10（配两吨弹药）。特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: An the R configuration replaces two of the ER PPC from the primary configuration of the Warhawk with Large Pulse Lasers. Two added flamers also provide anti-infantry defense. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: R配置将Warhawk主配置中的两门增程粒子加农炮替换为大型脉冲激光。另加装的两具火焰喷射器还可提供反步兵防御。特性：改进瞄准 - 远距 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The S configuration is similar to the Warhawks primary configuration, but replaces the LRM-10 with a Small Laser, allowing the 'Mech to pack three more heat sinks. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: S配置与战鹰主配置相似，但以一具小型激光取代LRM-10，让机甲能多带三个散热器。特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The V configuration carries four medium pulse lasers and an ER PPC as the main damage dealers, while four Jump Jets allow more maneuverability. For close quarters combat a flamer and three Streak SRM-6s are also available. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: V配置以4门中型脉冲激光和1门增程粒子加农炮作为主要输出手段，4具跳跃推进器则带来更强的机动性。近身缠斗时，还可动用1具火焰喷射器和3具连发SRM-6。<特性：改进瞄准（远程） <投放费用倍率：1.16 <手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Mounting a Gauss Rifle and an ER PPC in each arm, the Warhawk W is one of the more unusual configurations. The 'Mech still keeps the LRM-10 launcher from the Primary configuration. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 战鹰 W 在每条手臂上各装一门高斯步枪和一门 ER PPC，是较为少见的配置之一。这台机甲仍保留了主要配置的 LRM-10 发射器。特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The X configuration is seldom seen outside Clan space, as it is the main configuration for a Batchall. The combination of two heavy large lasers and an Ultra AC/20 makes the damage potential high enough at most ranges that it suits the needs of most warriors. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: X配置在部族领地之外难得一见，因为它是用于Batchall的主要配置。两门重型大型激光与一门Ultra AC/20的组合，让它在多数距离上都能造成足够高的伤害潜力，从而满足大多数战士的需求。特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Smoke Jaguar claims this world. Identify the forces that defend it so that we from the mists of space may know on whom we pounce.
column2: 烟虎宣称拥有这个世界。查明防守它的部队，好让我们从太空迷雾中知晓该扑向谁。ZH

column1: The Warlord carries its main damage dealers on the right side of the 'Mech, a Gauss rifle in the arm and an ER PPC in the side torso. A center torso mounted ER Large Laser is able to provide extra damage at range as needed, but needs to be overused due to the limited cooling from the 'Mechs twelve double heat sinks. At closer ranges the 'Mech can switch to use its seven Medium Lasers, with an SRM-6 as an extra punch. The final weapon is an Artemis IV-enabled LRM-20, able to provide accurate missile fire at most ranges. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 战帅把主要伤害输出集中在机甲右侧：手臂上的高斯步枪和侧躯干里的增程粒子加农炮。安装在中央躯干上的增程大型激光能在需要时提供额外的远程伤害，但由于该机十二台双散热器的散热能力有限，不宜过度使用。距离拉近后，机甲可改用七门中型激光，并以一具SRM-6作为额外重击。最后一件武器是一具配备Artemis IV的LRM-20，能在多数距离上提供精准的导弹火力。特性：精准武器 - 能量 投放费用倍率：1.18

column1: Created by Black Rooster Mechanical Development, (also knows as BRoMeD) as their first foray into the 100-ton 'Mech bracket, the Warlord took a lot of inspiration from the Pillager 5L in both appearance and weapons configuration. However, since Arrow IV systems were seen as too expensive, it was replaced by both a long and a short range missile launcher. The design was quickly challenged by Hellespont Industrials on Betelguese, the main supplier of Pillagers to the Capellan Confederation. After negotiations broke down, Hellespont started a very successful smear campaign that eventually drove the BRoMeD out of business. No more Warlords were produced, and some of the 'Mech's spare components are quite hard to find as a result.
column2: 由黑公鸡机械开发公司（简称BRoMeD）打造，作为其首次进军100吨机甲领域的尝试，军阀在外观与武器配置上都大量借鉴了掠夺者5L。但由于箭IV系统被认为过于昂贵，它改用一具远程和一具短程火箭发射器。该设计很快遭到贝特尔吉斯上的赫勒斯庞特工业公司质疑——后者是卡佩兰联邦掠夺者的主要供应商。谈判破裂后，赫勒斯庞特发起了一场极为成功的抹黑行动，最终迫使BRoMeD破产。再没有军阀被生产出来，因此该机甲的一些备件如今相当难找。ZH

column1: The WLD-1P is armed only with two Large and three Medium Pulse Lasers, but is very mobile thanks to its large 300 XL engine, MASC and five jump jets. This allows the 'Mech to maneuver around and flank foes, hitting them with the pulse lasers at weaker locations that are easily penetrated. The 'Mech is cooled by twelve double heat sinks, meaning some care in regards to heat build up has to be taken. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: WLD-1P只装两门大型和三门中型脉冲激光，但凭借其庞大的300 XL引擎、MASC和五具跳跃推进器而极为机动。这使该机甲能绕行并包抄敌人，用脉冲激光打击其容易被击穿的薄弱部位。该机甲由十二个双散热器降温，意味着必须对热量积累多加留意。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Warlord WLD-1P is a 60-ton mobile cavalry 'Mech mainly found in the Periphery. Originally created by Pinard Protectorates Limited on the Pinard, in the middle of the Taurian Concordat, the design has since been sold to various manufacturers spread throughout the periphery. One of the main design goals of the 'Mech was easy access to replace all components and weapons in case of damage, greatly reducing its maintenance times. As a result the 'Mech quickly spread to mercenaries, who appreciated the ease of maintenance as it saves both time and money.
column2: 军阀WLD-1P是一种60吨机动骑兵机甲，主要见于外缘。它最初由皮纳德保护国有限公司在陶里安协约国中部的皮纳德创造，此后该设计被卖给了遍布外缘的各家制造商。该机甲的主要设计目标之一是受损时便于接触替换所有组件与武器，大幅缩短维护时间。因此该机甲迅速流布到雇佣兵手中，他们欣赏这种维护便利，因为它既省时间又省钱。ZH

column1: This variant, used by the SLDF, has a LTV 150 engine, slightly lower maximum ground speed (84 km/h), a 120 meter jump capability, and replaces the SRM-2 with a rear-facing One-Shot version. In exchange the WSP-100 was equipped with a five ton bomb bay. This Bomb Bay allowed the WSP-100 to carry Arrow IVmissiles and conventional bombs without losing any speed. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这一变型供 SLDF 使用，搭载 LTV 150 引擎，最高地面速度略低（84 km/h），可跳跃 120 米，并以一具朝后的单发型 SRM-2 取代了标准 SRM-2。作为交换，WSP-100 装设了一个五吨重的弹舱。这个弹舱使 WSP-100 能在不损失任何速度的情况下携带 Arrow IV 导弹与常规炸弹。特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: Wasp LAM Mk I
column2: 黄蜂 LAM Mk I

column1: This variant, used by the SLDF, has a LTV 150 engine, slightly lower maximum ground speed (84 km/h), a 120 meter jump capability, and replaces the SRM-2 with a rear-facing One-Shot version. In exchange the WSP-100 was equipped with a five ton bomb bay. This Bomb Bay allowed the WSP-100 to carry Arrow IVmissiles and conventional bombs without losing any speed.
column2: 这是SLDF使用的变型：采用一台LTV 150引擎，最高地面速度略低（84公里/小时），跳跃能力120米，并以一具后向一次性SRM取代SRM-2。作为交换，WSP-100配备了五吨炸弹舱，使其能携带箭IV导弹与常规炸弹而不损失速度。ZH

column1: This version of the Wasp LAM replaces the bomb bay with an LRM-10 launcher and an extra jump jet. This variant was later used as the inspiration for the Valkyrie. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: Wasp LAM的这一型号用一具LRM-10发射器和一台额外的跳跃推进器取代了弹舱。该变型后来成为Valkyrie的设计灵感来源。特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: This variant was designed for the SLDF's \"Blackhearts\" teams. Based on the standard WSP-100, it replaced the medium laser and bomb bay with an extra jump jet, Medium Pulse Laser, Streak SRM-2, and Guardian ECM Suite. The armor protection was also increased slightly. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 此变型为SLDF的“黑心”小队设计，以标准WSP-100为基础，用一具额外跳跃推进器、一门中型脉冲激光、一具连发SRM-2和一套守护者电子对抗套件取代了中型激光与弹舱，装甲防护也略有提升。特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: This variant was designed for the SLDF's \"Blackhearts\" teams. Based on the standard WSP-100, it replaced the medium laser and bomb bay with an extra jump jet, Medium Pulse Laser, Streak SRM-2, and Guardian ECM Suite. The armor protection was also increased slightly.
column2: 此变体为星盟防卫军"黑心"小队设计。以标准 WSP-100 为基础，它将中型激光和炸弹舱换成一个额外跳跃推进器、一门中型脉冲激光、一具连续 SRM-2 和守护者 ECM 套件。装甲防护也略有增强。ZH

column1: Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: A very rare version of the Wasp, upgrading it to a total of 25 tons. The extra weight is used to fit a larger, 150 rated engine core, a total of four tons of armor and more weapons. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: 黄蜂极为罕见的一个版本，总重量升级到 25 吨。多出的重量用于安装更大的额定 150 引擎核心、总共四吨装甲以及更多武器。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.96

column1: An uncommon battlefield refit of the 1A, dropping a ton of armor for a TAG and replaces one of the Medium Lasers with two Small lasers instead. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这是1A不多见的野战改装：削掉一吨装甲换装一具TAG，并把其中一门中型激光换成两门小型激光。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.95 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: A Clan tech rebuild of the Wasp, seen amongst the Kell Hounds. Carries a Medium Pulse Laser and an SRM-2 launcher, with the addition of a C3 Slave for better performance. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 凯尔猎犬中可见的一款采用部族科技重造的 Wasp。它携带一门中型脉冲激光和一具 SRM-2 发射器，并加装了一台 C3 从属单元以提升表现。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

column1: Manufactured by Achernar for Wolf's Dragoons in 3050, the Clan Invasion era 3W upgraded the armor to ferro-fibrous and carried two Sutel Precision Line small pulse lasers in the right arm and four ChisComp 32 small lasers split between left leg and left torso. This increased firepower came at the cost of reducing armor protection to just two tons. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 该机由 Achernar 于 3050 年为狼之龙骑兵制造，属于部族入侵时期的 3W 型。它将装甲升级为铁纤维，并在右臂装设两门 Sutel Precision Line 小型脉冲激光，在左腿与左躯干共装设四门 ChisComp 32 小型激光。火力增强的代价，是装甲防护被削减至仅两吨。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

column1: Together model is an upgrade of the 3W, an alternative to the more common 4W, and is mainly used by the Wolf's Dragoons. The upgrade replaces all the weapons with a single Medium Pulse Laser and five ER Small Lasers, and adds another half ton of armor and a C3 Slave unit. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: Together型是3W的升级型号，作为较常见的4W的替代方案，主要由狼之龙骑兵使用。该升级把全部武器替换为一具中型脉冲激光和五具增程小型激光，并额外增加半吨装甲和一个C3从属单元。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: This variant, nicknamed 'First Modification' by the the techs on Chara III, is a field modification of the WSP-1A that exchanges the SRM-2 and ammunition for one medium laser in the left leg and a ton of armor. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这一变型被卡拉III星的技术人员昵称为“第一改装”，是WSP-1A的战地改装型，用左腿的一门中型激光与一吨装甲换掉了SRM-2及其弹药。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.95 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: This variant, nicknamed 'Second Modification' by the the techs on Chara III, is a further modification of the M1 that exchanges the jump jets for three medium lasers, one each installed in the head, center torso, and left arm. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这一变型被卡拉III星的技术人员昵称为“第二改装”，是对M1的进一步改装，用头部、中央躯干与左臂各一门的三门中型激光换掉了跳跃推进器。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.95 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: The original Weevil variant, the -L31, mounts an AC/2 in the right arm and a ER Large Laser in the left. Due to only mounting ten single heatsinks, the 'Mech still runs quite hot even with just a single energy weapon. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是象鼻虫最初的变型，-L31在右臂装一门AC/2，左臂装一门增程大型激光。由于只装十个单散热器，即便只有一件能量武器，该机甲运行起来依然相当热。特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Long Range Support
column2: 远程支援

column1: An attempt to create a light long range support fire platform, the Weevil was never a success and is seldom brought out of storage anymore. The main issue is the lack of weight capacity for the proper long range support weapons and cooling, meaning all variants tend to suffer from either being under-gunned or very overheat prone.
column2: 象鼻虫（Weevil）是为了打造一种轻型远程支援火力平台而进行的尝试，但从未取得成功，如今已极少被人从仓库中取出使用。主要问题在于缺乏足够的承重能力来搭载合适的远程支援武器与散热设备，这意味着它的所有变型要么火力不足，要么极易过热。ZH

column1: The -P14 was introduced solely for the Periphery market. Armed with only a single LBX AC/5, it runs quite cool even in the more common lunar and martian biomes spread out in the periphery. The design also mounts an AMS Mk.2 for better defense. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: -P14专为外围地区市场推出。它仅装备一门LBX AC/5，即便在外围地区常见的月球与火星环境中也能保持相当低的温度。该设计还安装了AMS Mk.2以强化防御。特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: After the -P14 proved more popular than the -L31, the -R2 was created as an updated Weevil for the Inner Sphere. Instead of the LBX of the -P14, its only weapon is an Ultra AC/5. However, the 'Mech also fits an Active Probe, improving its sensor capabilities. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 在 -P14 被证明比 -L31 更受欢迎之后，-R2 作为面向内层星域的更新版 Weevil 被制造出来。它不像 -P14 那样装有 LBX，其唯一的武器是一门 Ultra AC/5。不过，该机甲还装有一具主动探测器，提升了其传感器能力。特性：高级光学 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The WER-LF-004 carries a Medium Pulse Laser, a pair of Small Pulse Lasers, a standard SRM-6 launcher and a Machine Gun. Four jump jets are enough to propel the 'Mech considerable distances. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: WER-LF-004装有一门中型脉冲激光、一对小型脉冲激光、一具标准SRM-6发射器与一挺机枪。四台跳跃推进器足以让这台机甲跨越相当远的距离。特性：改进冷却外套（激光） 投放费用倍率：1.02

column1: A Solaris VII BattleMech, the Werewolf was introduced in 3056. Designed as an ambush 'Mech, the Werewolf was a huge hit with pilots who favored the dense jungle or industrial scrapyard arenas because it mounted a Null Signature System. This system allows a skilled pilot to hide in plain sight, striking an opponent quickly and often fatally. The eight tons of armor provide decent protection against most foes and the Werewolf's speed allows it to evade anything it can't outfight. The Werewolf mounts Jump Jets, which provide it with a limited jump capability. This capability is most frequently used by arena MechWarriors to launch a Death From Above attack, but it is also useful when evading a foe.
column2: 狼人（Werewolf）是一台索拉里斯 VII 的战斗机甲，于 3056 年问世。作为一款专为伏击而设计的机甲，狼人深受那些偏爱茂密丛林或工业废料场竞技场的机师欢迎，因为它装备了零信号系统。这套系统能让技艺娴熟的机师隐匿于众目睽睽之下，迅速而往往致命地打击对手。八吨装甲足以抵御大多数敌人，而狼人的速度让它能够避开任何无法正面击败的对手。狼人还装设了跳跃推进器，赋予它有限的跳跃能力。竞技场的机甲战士最常用这一能力发动“从天而降”攻击，但在闪避敌人时同样十分实用。ZH

column1: The WER-LF-004P is the prototype of the WER-LF-004, similar in almost all regards as the eventual final version. The only difference is slightly more armor at the cost of one less jump jet. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: WER-LF-004P是WER-LF-004的原型，在几乎所有方面都与最终定型版本相似。唯一的区别是装甲略多，代价是少一具跳跃推进器。特性：改进冷却夹套 - 激光 投放费用倍率：1.04

column1: The Werewolf WE-LF-005's main armament is its Large X-Pulse Laser, which is backed up by a Streak SRM-6 launcher, and a pair of Magshots. All of these close-in weapons were chosen because they encourage the pilot to attack from closer ranges. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: 狼人WE-LF-005的主武器是它的大型X脉冲激光，辅以一具连发SRM-6发射器和两具磁射枪。选用这些近程武器，是为了鼓励机师从更近的距离发起攻击。特性：改进冷却套 - 激光 投放费用倍率：1.02

column1: A simple refit of the WTH-1 that trades its jump jets for a C3 slave and C.A.S.E. protection for the LRM ammunition. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 惠特沃斯 WTH-1 的简单改装，把跳跃推进器换成一套 C3 从属单元，并为 LRM 弹药加装 C.A.S.E. 防护。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A somewhat mediocre Scout and Light Strike platform, the Whitworth has been in service across the Inner Sphere since the end of the Age of War. A 40-ton Mech, the Whitworth is powered by a 160-rated Fusion Core and mounts 4 Jump Jets. The Whitworth WTH-1 is armed with a trio of Medium Lasers and a pair of LRM-10s.
column2: 惠特沃斯是一台略显平庸的侦察与轻型打击平台，自战争年代结束以来一直在整个内层星域服役。这台 40 吨机甲由一台 160 额定聚变核心驱动，并装备 4 台跳跃推进器。惠特沃斯 WTH-1 配备三门中型激光和两具 LRM-10。ZH

column1: A solaris special, someone has torn out the original LTV 160 fusion engine; replacing it is a Nissan 200 torn out of a scrapped Hunchback. In order to cram in the larger engine, the LRM-10s were downgraded to a pair of smaller LRM-5s fed by a single ton of ammo. A Large Laser replaces the left arm Medium Laser. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是一台 Solaris 特色改装机：有人拆掉了原来的 LTV 160 聚变引擎，换上从一台报废 Hunchback 上拆下的 Nissan 200。为了塞进更大的引擎，LRM-10 被降级为两具更小的 LRM-5，共用一吨弹药供弹。左臂的中型激光则被一门大型激光取代。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: A solaris special, someone has torn out the original LTV 160 fusion engine; replacing it is a Nissan 200 torn out of a scrapped Hunchback. In order to cram in the larger engine, the LRM-10s were downgraded to a pair of smaller LRM-5s fed by a single ton of ammo. A Large Laser replaces the left arm Medium Laser.
column2: 一台索拉里斯特制品，有人把原本的LTV 160聚变引擎扯了出来；换上的是一台从报废驼背上拆下的日产200。为了塞进更大的引擎，LRM-10被降级为两具更小的LRM-5，共用一吨弹药。一门大型激光器取代了左臂的中型激光器。ZH

column1: A refit of the 1S, upgrading the 'Mech to use double heat sinks. The increased cooling capacity allows dropping four of the heat sinks, and the freed space is used to add a C3 slave, C.A.S.E. protection and Artemis IV FCS. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 1S 的改装型，将机甲升级为使用双散热器。散热能力的提升使其可以拆除四个散热器，而腾出的空间则用于加装 C3 从属单元、C.A.S.E. 防护和阿尔忒弥斯 IV 火控系统。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Wildfire P1-WF traded the Crusader's long range firepower for speed and armor protection. Intended to pursue fast-moving opponents, the Wildfire used a suite of pulse lasers as its primary armament. When in close combat with an enemy, the pair of Streak SRM-2 launchers provided additional firepower without being wasteful. The Machine Guns were very useful for defending against enemy infantry units. Defensively, the Wildfire mounted CASE in the right torso to protect the 'Mech from ammunition explosions. Quirk: Well Balanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: Wildfire P1-WF以Crusader的远程火力换取了速度与装甲防护。Wildfire意在追击高速移动的对手，因此以一套脉冲激光作为主武器。与敌人近身交战时，两具连发SRM-2发射器能提供额外火力而不会浪费弹药。机枪则在抵御敌方步兵单位时非常有用。防护方面，Wildfire在右侧躯干安装了CASE，以保护机甲免受弹药爆炸之害。特性：平衡良好 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: Designed at the same facility that birthed Burke Kale’s Direct Neural Interface project, the Wildfire was designed from the ground up to use a Torso Cockpit. Based on the 3050 era Crusader, the Wildfire was intended to show the new cockpit technology in use. As a result, it became the first documented headless BattleMech. Equipped with a suite of close range weapons, the Wildfire was intended to be a close combat fighter. The lack of any significant long-range firepower made the Wildfire rely on its heavy armor to bring it into effective range.
column2: 野火诞生于伯克·凯尔直接神经接口项目所在的那处设施，从设计之初便是为了使用躯干驾驶舱。它以3050年时代的十字军为基础，意在展示这种新驾驶舱技术的实际应用，也因此成为有记录以来第一台无头战斗机甲。野火装备了一整套近距武器，定位是近身混战机型；由于缺乏任何可观的远程火力，它不得不依赖厚重装甲把自己送入有效射程。ZH

column1: The Wildfire P7-WF drops the torso mounted cockpit, returning to a standard head mounted one, and replaces one of the Machine Guns with an AMS. Quirk: Well Balanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 野火P7-WF拆掉躯干驾驶舱，恢复为标准头部驾驶舱，并把其中一挺机枪换成一具反导弹系统。特性：平衡良好 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: The Wisp is only armed with a single Medium Laser supported by a small laser, which are more useful at starting fires and harassing the enemy rather than being true anti-'Mech weapons. Pilots of the Wisp should always remember that he who spies then runs away may live to spy another day. Quirk: Improved Jammer Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 鬼火只装一门中型激光，辅以一门小型激光；这些武器更适合放火和骚扰敌人，而非真正的反机甲武器。鬼火的机师应始终牢记：窥探之后撒腿就跑的人，才能活到下一次窥探。特性：改进干扰器 投放费用倍率：0.99

column1: The Wisp is a recon 'Mech first and foremost. Though it does have some capabilities as an infantry support 'Mech, its light armor and limited armament makes it unsuitable for any save the most limited of missions. Its extremely high speed allows it to act as a scout, withdrawing at the first sign of danger utilizing its MASC circuitry.
column2: 微光是彻头彻尾的侦察机甲。虽然它作为步兵支援机甲也有一些能力，但其轻薄装甲与有限武装使它除最有限的任务外都不适用。它极高的速度让它能充当侦察兵，一有危险迹象便利用其MASC电路撤离。ZH

column1: The Wolf Trap carries as its main weapon an LB-X autocannon/10, which allows it to fire both standard solid shells or cluster shells that act like a shotgun and cause damage all over the enemy. For added long range firepower, the Wolf Trap carries a LRM-10 launcher which allows it to fire directly and also give indirect fire support when needed. Finally, for close combat, the 'Mech carries a pair of medium lasers. This varied arsenal lets the Wolf Trap effectively engage an enemy at any range. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: Wolf Trap的主武器是一门LB-X自动炮/10，既可发射标准实心弹，也可发射如同霰弹般散射、在敌人身上造成全面伤害的集束弹。为增强远程火力，Wolf Trap还装有一具LRM-10发射器，既能直瞄射击，也能在需要时提供间接火力支援。最后，为应对近身战斗，机甲还配备了两门中型激光。这套多样化的武器组合让Wolf Trap能在任何距离上有效打击敌人。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：右上

column1: Wolf Trap
column2: 狼夹

column1: The Wolf Trap is a BattleMech that the Draconis Combine designed to be used as a long-range combat 'Mech. Originally called the Tora, Luthien Armor Works hastily rechristened it the Wolf Trap, the name Federated Commonwealth analysts had given it, to downplay its association with the Combine. The 'Mech is built on an endo steel chassis and protects any ammunition stores that it carries onboard with CASE that redirects the force of the explosion when an ammunition bin is hit by enemy fire. The 'Mech has a very respectable speed of 97.2 km/h, which it achieves through the use of a 270 XL engine.
column2: 捕狼夹是龙脉联合体设计用作远程作战的战斗机甲。它最初名为 Tora，卢西恩装甲工厂匆忙把它改名为捕狼夹——也就是联邦共和国分析人员给它起的名字——以淡化它与联合体的关联。这台机甲以钢内骨结构底盘为基础，并用 CASE 保护机上携带的弹药储备，当弹药箱被敌方火力击中时，CASE 会引导爆炸的冲击力。机甲最高速度达到相当可观的 97.2 km/h，这要归功于 270 XL 引擎。ZH

column1: A uniquely customized Wolf Trap created for former Kurita MechWarrior Daitama Muraki, refitted by Star League Defense Force techs from the shell of a Wolf Trap given to him. The tech fitted a 270-rated XL fusion engine and 10 double heat sinks into the 'Mech. The design retained the 'Mech's two medium lasers and LRM 10 Launcher, while adding an extended-range PPC in place of the autocannon. The Second Star League techs then added a Beagle active probe and C3i computer to the 'Mech. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: 这台独一无二的定制捕狼夹是为前栗田机甲战士 Daitama Muraki 打造的，由星际联盟防卫军的技师在他获赠的一具捕狼夹机壳基础上改装而成。技师为这台机甲装上了 270 级 XL 聚变引擎和10个双散热器。该设计保留了机甲原有的两门中型激光和一具 LRM-10 发射器，同时以一门增程粒子加农炮取代了自动炮。随后第二星际联盟的技师又为它加装了猎犬主动探测器和 C3i 计算机。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：右上

column1: A field modification of the Wolf Trap, the C model is modified to carry a C3 slave unit onto the battlefield, allowing the Wolf Trap to share targeting telemetry with other friendly units. The 'Mech achieves this by removing one of the medium lasers that it carries. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: 狼阱的C型是一种野战改装型号，能够把C3从属单元带上战场，让狼阱与其他友军单位共享瞄准遥测数据。为此它拆除了自身携带的其中一具中型激光。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：右上

column1: Phelan Kell and his Wolfhound, nicknamed Grinner, were captured by the forces of Clan Wolf during Operation Revival. When Phelan was inducted into the Wolf Clan as a Warrior, Khan Ulric Kerensky ordered his 'Mech be upgraded using Clan technology. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 费伦·凯尔和他的 Wolfhound（绰号“咧嘴者”）在复兴行动期间被狼族部队俘获。当费伦作为战士被接纳进入狼族时，可汗乌尔里克·克伦斯基下令用部族技术升级他的机甲。特性：精准武器 - 能量 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

column1: Wolfhound IIC
column2: 狼犬 IIC

column1: Phelan Kell and his Wolfhound, nicknamed Grinner, were captured by the forces of Clan Wolf during Operation Revival. When Phelan was inducted into the Wolf Clan as a Warrior, Khan Ulric Kerensky ordered his 'Mech be upgraded using Clan technology.
column2: 费兰·凯尔和他的狼犬（绰号"咧嘴"）在复兴行动期间被狼族部队俘获。当费兰作为战士被引入狼族时，可汗乌尔里克·克伦斯基下令用氏族科技升级他的机甲。ZH

column1: Based off Phelan Kell's 'Mech 'Grinner', the Wolfhound IIC 3 is a Clan tech version of the Wolfhound. The design includes Endo Steel structure, Ferro-Fibrous armor and XL engine, combined with an ECM suite. The weapons are fully energy based, consisting of two ER Medium Lasers, one ER Large Laser and three Medium Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: Wolfhound IIC 3 以 Phelan Kell 的座机“Grinner”为蓝本，是 Wolfhound 的部族科技版本。该设计采用钢内骨结构、铁纤维装甲和 XL 引擎，并配有电子对抗套件。其武器全部为能量武器，包括两门增程中型激光、一门增程大型激光和三门中型脉冲激光。特性：精准武器 - 能量 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

column1: A clan version of the Wolfhound, how filthy. Those damned clanners just have to taint everything!
column2: 氏族版狼犬，真恶心。那些该死的氏族佬就是要把什么都污染一遍！ZH

column1: Based off Phelan Kell's 'Mech 'Grinner', the Wolfhound IIC 3A is a Clan tech version of the Wolfhound. The design includes Endo Steel structure, Ferro-Fibrous armor and XL engine, combined with an ECM suite. The weapons are fully energy based, consisting of one Large Pulse Laser and four Medium Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 猎狼犬IIC 3A以菲兰·凯尔的座机“咧嘴者”为基础，是猎狼犬的部族技术版本。该设计采用钢内骨结构、铁纤维装甲和XL引擎，并整合了1具电子对抗套件。武器全为能量型，包括1门大型脉冲激光和4门中型脉冲激光。<特性：精准武器（能量） <投放费用倍率：1.06 <手臂驱动器限制：右臂下段

column1: A mixed tech refit of the Wolfhound, using aquired Clan tech to improve its performance. Mainly used by the mercenary outfit the Kell Hounds. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 狼犬的混合科技改装型，利用缴获的部族科技提升其性能。主要由雇佣兵部队“凯尔猎犬”使用。特性：精准武器 - 能量 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

column1: Rare variant with a mix of Tech. Usually only way to get them is to capture one the battlefield.
column2: 技术混搭的稀有改型。通常唯一的获取方式就是在战场上俘获一台。ZH

column1: A battlefield refit of the WLF-1R, switching from single to double heat sinks and trading one medium laser for a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: WLF-1R的战地改装型，将单散热器换成双散热器，并以一门中型激光换取一台C3从属机。特性：精准武器（能量） 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: It's a -1R with more cooling and less weapons. Oh, and a C3.
column2: 它是台-1R，散热更多、武器更少。哦，还有一套C3。ZH

column1: A mixed tech refit of the Wolfhound, using acquired Clan tech to improve its performance. Mainly used by the mercenary outfit the Wolf Dragoons. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 猎狼犬的混合技术改装型，利用取得的部族技术提升性能。主要由雇佣兵部队狼之龙骑兵使用。特性：精准武器 - 能量 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: Another custom refit by mercenaries. You can't call our kind anything but resourceful.
column2: 这是雇佣兵们的又一次定制改装。我们这类人除了“脑子活”还能说什么呢。ZH

column1: The Star League changed so much from the WVR-6R that they called this the Wolverine II. It carries a similar weapon load but enhanced by the Star League's superior technology, making this a far deadlier machine. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: 星际联盟对 WVR-6R 做了如此大的改动，以至于把它称为 Wolverine II。它携带的武器载荷与之相似，但在星际联盟更优越的技术加持下得到强化，使其成为一台致命得多的机器。特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.07

column1: When the Clan Jade Falcon designers took a Wolverine II WVR-7H and started replacing parts of it with clan tech in several configurations, this was one of the resulting prototype designs. Eventually the result was the Conjurer, since they could not name a 'Mech after the Not-Named Clan. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
column2: 当玉猫部族的设计者取来一台狼獾II WVR-7H，并开始用部族技术在多种配置中替换其部件时，这就是由此产生的原型设计之一。最终成果便是幻术师，因为他们不能用一个“不可提及的部族”来命名机甲。特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.11

column1: Wolverine IIC
column2: 狼獾 IIC

column1: A Wolverine with a bunch of Clan tech can never go wrong, I'll have one please.
column2: 一台装了氏族科技的狼獾永远不会出问题，我要一台。ZH

column1: An uncommon refit of some of the Wolverines the SLDF brought with them during their exodus from the Inner Sphere, the goal was to bring them in line with the more clear IIC versions of 'Mechs. However, very few were actually kept once Clan Wolverine was annihilated due to their name. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
column2: 这是对一些SLDF在大逃亡离开内层星域时带走的狼獾所做的不常见改装，目的是让它们与更明确的IIC版本机甲保持一致。然而，狼獾部族因其名号被消灭之后，真正保留下来的极少。特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.11

column1: Not the best refit ever done by the Clans, I can understand why it was dropped even beyond the naming issue.
column2: 这不是氏族做过的最好的改装，我能理解为什么除了命名问题之外它也被放弃了。ZH

column1: Entering production in 2490, the primitive 3R was built in response to the Terran Hegemony creating new versions of the 'Mechs the Wolverine was originally based on. It traded in 3 tons of armor and a ton of autocannon ammunition for a shoulder-mounted six-pack SRM launcher with one ton of reloads - a loadout that would remain essentially unchanged for the later 'modernized' 6R. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.83
column2: 原始型3R于2490年投产，其研制是为了回应地球霸权为狼獾最初所依据的几款机甲推出新版本。它用3吨装甲和一个吨位的自动炮弹药，换取了一具装在肩部的六联装SRM发射器及一个吨位的备用弹药——这一配置在后来“现代化”的6R上基本保持不变。特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：0.83

column1: Upgrade of the 1R, this still is a 'Mech not even worth its weight as scrap metal. Everything is so outdated...
column2: 作为1R的升级版，这仍是一台连当废铁卖都不值其重量的机甲。一切都太过时了……

column1: Introduced in 2834, the 6D drops the SRM and one heat sink of the 6R to upgrade the AC/5 to an Autocannon/10, mounted in the left arm. Two tons of ammunition in the left side supply it, spread through the arm and torso. One jump jet is moved from each leg to the corresponding side torso. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 6D 于 2834 年推出，它去掉了 6R 的 SRM 和一具散热器，将 AC/5 升级为安装在左臂的自动炮/10。左侧的两吨弹药为其供弹，弹药分布在手臂和躯干之中。每条腿各有一具跳跃推进器移至对应的侧躯干。特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.03

column1: The -6D has it uses like most Wolverines, it is neither great nor horrible - just somewhere inbetween.
column2: -6D与大多数狼獾一样有它的用处，它既不出色也不糟糕——只是在两者之间。ZH

column1: A variant used by the Mercenary unit Gray Death Legion before their demise. Using mostly stolen or looted Clan tech they can upgrade the firepower considerable, including an Ultra AC/5 and Medium Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
column2: 这是雇佣兵部队灰死军团在其覆灭前使用的变型。他们大多用偷来或缴获的部族技术，把火力大幅升级，包括一门超级AC/5和几门中型脉冲激光。特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.11

column1: The unit did not survive long, but they did leave some good 'Mechs behind. This is one of them.
column2: 这支单位没能撑多久，但他们确实留下了一些不错的机甲。这就是其中一台。ZH

column1: The Wolverine WVR-6KH was made popular when the mercenary unit Kell Hounds used this custom design of theirs to infiltrate a pirate base by painting them in the same color scheme as the pirates own Wolverines. The mercenaries then opened fire without warning once inside, unleashing their advanced weaponry to great success at point blank range. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 狼獾WVR-6KH之所以出名，是因为雇佣兵部队凯尔猎犬用他们的这款定制设计潜入了一处海盗基地——把它涂成与海盗自己的狼獾相同的配色。进入后，这些雇佣兵毫无预警地开火，在零距离上倾泻他们的先进武器，大获成功。特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: The reputation this variant gained after that raid has made it sound amazing to those who don't know better. In reality it is just some more advanced tech put on a -6R 'Mech as base.
column2: 这次袭掠之后该变型获得的名声，让不明就里的人觉得它了不起。实际上它只是在一台-6R机甲基础上加了些更先进的技术。ZH

column1: Another of the many custom refits of the Wolverine WVR-6R by a mercenary outfit, the -6MR was the preferred variant of the famous McCarron's Armored Cavalry unit. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: -6MR是某支雇佣兵部队对Wolverine WVR-6R进行的众多定制改装之一，也是著名的麦卡伦装甲骑兵团偏爱的变型。特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: Unlike other mercenary refits, this one is mostly using standard equipment. My guess would be that they wanted easier and cheaper maintenance.
column2: 与其他雇佣兵改装不同，这一款主要使用标准装备。我猜他们想要更简便、更便宜的维护。ZH

column1: The 'Renata' has some interesting upgrades over a stock Wolverine WVR-6R, it replaces both the generic autocannon and the medium laser with a more advanced versions, and uses Ferro-Fibrous armor to increase the amount of armor plating the 'Mech can carry. The FCS and sensors of the 'Mech have also been upgraded with improved aftermarket models. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: “Renata”相比原厂的 Wolverine WVR-6R 有几项颇有意思的升级：它把通用型自动炮和中型激光都换成了更先进的型号，并使用铁纤维装甲来增加机甲可携带的装甲板数量。该机甲的火控系统与传感器也换装了改进型的售后改装件。特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: This customized Wolverine WVR-6R was originally commissioned by Major Miraslova Renata during the SLDF expeditionary force's Operation Smother during the Davion Succession war. However, when Major Renata answered the call of Kerensky and joined the Exodus, the 'Mech was abandoned in a Star League mint on Nouveau Toulouse. The Wolverine was eventually found there by Lawrence Helmund Nelson, who claimed it as his personal 'Mech from that point forwards.
column2: 这台定制版狼獾WVR-6R最初是米拉斯洛娃·雷娜塔少校在SLDF远征军执行"窒息"行动期间（达维昂继承战争时期）委托建造的。然而当雷娜塔少校响应克伦斯基的号召加入出走时，这台机甲被遗弃在新图卢兹的一处星盟造币厂里。狼獾最终在那里被劳伦斯·赫尔蒙德·尼尔森发现，此后他便将其据为自己的座机。ZH

column1: This Clan Early variant of the 6R exchanges the AC/5 for two LB 2-X Autocannons and upgrades the SRM-6 to an Improved version. Two of the heat sinks are dropped as a result of the lowered cooling needs. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 这是6R的部族早期变型，以两门LB 2-X自动炮取代AC/5，并把SRM-6升级为改进型。由于冷却需求下降，拆掉了两个散热器。特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.03

column1: A Mercenary refit of the -6R which adds more durability in form of CASE protection to both side torsos and a C3 slave at the cost of two heat sinks. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: -6R的雇佣兵改装型，以牺牲两具散热器为代价，在两侧躯干加装CASE防护并提供一台C3从属机，从而提升了生存能力。特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.03

column1: Not a fan of this change, it just runs too hot now. But it is a common Merc thing to do to cram more stuff in and worry about heat later.
column2: 我不太喜欢这个改动，现在它跑起来实在太热了。但雇佣兵常干这种事：先往里塞更多东西，热量以后再说。ZH

column1: A high tech, high cost refit of the -6R initially by a small mercenary outfit called 'Silver Lining', but eventually caught attention of the larger units and as a result there are a number of them out there. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 这是 -6R 的高技术、高成本改装型，最初由一支名为“Silver Lining”的小型雇佣兵部队完成，但最终引起了更大规模部队的关注，因此如今存世的这类机甲数量不少。特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: Built out of only Inner Sphere tech, this still manages to be an impressive refit. It could almost go toe-to-toe with one of the Clan tech refits.
column2: 它完全用内天体科技建成，却仍是一次令人印象深刻的改装。它几乎能与氏族科技的改装型正面较量。ZH

column1: The first 'Mech used by famous arena MechWarrior Victor Vandergriff as he defeated Drago 'Death from Above' Alldredge. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: 这是著名竞技场机甲战士维克托·范德格里夫使用的第一台机甲，他驾驶它击败了绰号“天降死神”的德拉戈·奥德里奇。特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.07

column1: Wow. I understand how he won with this. It has a lot of rare tech for the time when he first used it.
column2: 哇。我明白他当初是怎么靠这个赢的了。在他头一次用它的时候，上面有很多当时的稀有科技。ZH

column1: A prototype version of the later mass produced -8K variant. Mounting a ER Large Laser, three Medium Pulse Lasers and an SRM-4 combined with a Guardian ECM Suite and a master C3 computer. The produced units of the variant eventually were sold off to mainly mercenary units or acquired in underhanded ways by pirates. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 这是后来量产的-8K变型的原型版本，装有一门增程大型激光、三门中型脉冲激光和一具SRM-4，并配合一套守护者电子对抗套件和一台C3主计算机。该变型产出的机体最终主要卖给了雇佣兵部队，或被海盗以不正当手段获取。特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: Nothing special with this prototype really. Use it for parts or move it to the battlefield, nothing of value risked.
column2: 这个原型其实没什么特别的。拿它当零件用，或者送到战场上，没什么有价值的东西会受风险。ZH

column1: The Quarantine Hero 'Mech is built around 275-rated XL engine and an Endo Steel frame, fitted with three jump jets and clad in near maximum armor. Using its entire left-side as a shield, the Quarantine carries an AC/5 and a trio of Medium Lasers in its right arm supported by two right torso mounted SRM-6 launchers. Carrying only twelve double heat sinks, the 'Mech stores three tons worth of SRM and autocannon reloads split between both legs. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: Quarantine 英雄机甲以一台 275 级 XL 引擎和钢内骨结构框架为核心，装有 3 台跳跃推进器，并披挂接近最大值的装甲。Quarantine 以整个左侧作为盾牌，右臂搭载一门 AC/5 和三门中型激光，并有两具装在右躯干的 SRM-6 发射器提供支援。这台机甲仅携带十二台双散热器，三吨重的 SRM 与自动炮弹药则分装在两条腿中。特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.07

column1: The Quarantine Hero 'Mech is built around 275-rated XL engine and an Endo Steel frame, fitted with three jump jets and clad in near maximum armor. Using its entire left-side as a shield, the Quarantine carries an AC/5 and a trio of Medium Lasers in its right arm supported by two right torso mounted SRM-6 launchers. Carrying only twelve double heat sinks, the 'Mech stores three tons worth of SRM and autocannon reloads split between both legs.
column2: 隔离英雄机甲围绕一具275级XL引擎和内层钢框架建造，装三个跳跃推进器并披挂接近最大量的装甲。它用整个左侧当盾牌，右臂装一门AC/5和三兄弟中型激光器，由右躯干的两具SRM-6发射器支援。这台机甲只带十二具双重散热器，三吨SRM与自动炮备用弹分置双腿。ZH

column1: A refit by the design entity known as Tricky Dick. Based on the -7K, the TD replaces the SRM-6 racks with Streak SRM-6 tubes, and the Large Pulse Laser was turned into an ER PPC to make the 'Mech more viable for longer ranged attacks. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 这是名为“狡猾迪克”的设计机构所进行的改装。该型号以-7K为基础，将SRM-6发射巢更换为连发SRM-6发射管，并把大型脉冲激光改为增程粒子加农炮，使这台机甲在远距离攻击时更具优势。特性：改进通讯 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: Not much is known about this 'Tricky Dick'. Is it a person? Or several? I have no idea!
column2: 关于这个"滑头迪克"知道的并不多。它是一个人？还是好几个人？我完全不知道！ZH

column1: The A loadout upsizes the LBX from the primary configuration to an LBX AC/20, but drops the Ultra AC/10 to instead mount two ER Large Laser. The LRM launcher is exchanged for a Streak SRM-6. Four additional heat sinks were also added. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: A载荷把主配置的LBX升级为LBX AC/20，但拆掉超级AC/10，改为装两门增程大型激光。LRM发射器换成连发SRM-6，另加四个散热器。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Woodsman II
column2: 林中人 II

column1: The Woodsman II's introduction followed shortly after original Woodsman, acting as a longer range sniper and support 'Mech. At 80-tons total, the 'Mech is slightly larger than its predecessor, which is used to fit a considerable larger 400 XL engine. As a result the 'Mech can easier be repositioned to keep its distance from main engagements or strike from unexpected angles.
column2: 樵夫 II 在原版樵夫问世后不久推出，担任射程更远的狙击与支援机甲。它总重 80 吨，比前代略大，多出的体量用于容纳大得多的 400 XL 引擎。因此，这台机甲能更容易地转移位置，以远离主战场或从意想不到的角度发起打击。ZH

column1: The Bravo configuration switches the 'Mech to a missile boat role, with four LRM-20 launchers as the main weapons. The 'Mech also mounts a Narc launcher and an AMS. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Bravo 配置将这台机甲转为导弹平台角色，以四部 LRM-20 发射器为主武器。它还装有一部 Narc 发射器和一套 AMS。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Primary configuration of the Woodsman II mounts both an LBX AC/10 and an Ultra AC/10, for the capability of a devastating hit at long range. An LRM-20 launcher can provide both direct or indirect fire as needed. The only short range weapon is a small ER Laser in the right torso. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Woodsman II的主配置同时搭载LBX AC/10和Ultra AC/10，具备在远距离发动毁灭性打击的能力。一具LRM-20发射器可按需提供直瞄或间接火力。唯一的近程武器是右躯干上的一门增程小型激光。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The most common alternate configuration in the Woodsman's long career mounted two ER PPCs, two Medium Pulse Lasers, and a Large Pulse Laser and ER Small Laser for backup. It keeps the same number of double heat sinks as the primary configuration, but relocates them across the torso. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 在 Woodsman 漫长的服役生涯中，最常见的备用配置装设两门增程粒子加农炮、两门中型脉冲激光，以及作为辅助的一门大型脉冲激光和一门增程小型激光。它保留了与主配置相同数量的双散热器，但将其重新分布到躯干各处。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The first heavy OmniMech developed by Clan Wolf, the Woodsman was one of the most heavily tested weapons ever produced by the Clan. Every last detail was considered and problems were eliminated before production began. This resulted in a chassis that would not only function well in the Clan's front line forces for nearly a century, but also inspire the Timber Wolf, Gargoyle, and Naga OmniMechs. Heavy armor provided excellent protection, while a standard fusion engine improved longevity on the battlefield. The light Endo Steel chassis allowed the Woodsman to devote 27 tons to pod space, allowing many mission specific loadouts and prototype weapon configurations. The permanently installed MASC system allowed a pilot to briefly exceed 80 km/h to either withdraw or capitalize on breaches in enemy ranks.
column2: 樵夫是狼部族开发的第一款重型全向机甲，也是有史以来经过最严苛测试的部族武器之一。每一个细节都被反复推敲，问题在生产开始前就已被解决。由此诞生的底盘不仅在近一个世纪里于部族一线部队中表现出色，还启发了森林狼、石像鬼和娜迦全向机甲。厚重的装甲提供了出色的防护，标准聚变引擎则延长了战场生存时间。轻巧的钢内骨结构底盘让樵夫能把 27 吨重量用于吊舱空间，从而实现多种任务专用配置和原型武器搭配。永久安装的 MASC 系统让机师能短暂超过 80 km/h，以便脱离战斗或利用敌军阵线的缺口。ZH

column1: This configuration is a low-heat high damage option for pilots. A Gauss rifle is mounted in the right arm while the left arm has an ER Large Laser and ER Medium Laser. The right torso has an SRM-4 while the left torso carries an LRM-10. Both of these launchers have an Artemis IV FCS. For anti-infantry work, a Small Pulse Laser is carried in the center torso. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 此配置是给机师的一个低热量高伤害选项：右臂装一门高斯步枪，左臂一门增程大型激光和一门增程中型激光；右躯干一具SRM-4，左躯干一具LRM-10，这两具发射器都带阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统。反步兵方面，中央躯干带一门小型脉冲激光。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The primary Woodsman configuration would be mirrored in the default Timber Wolf weapon load. Each arm carried an ER Large Laser and an ER Medium Laser, and a pair of LRM-15s rounded out the configuration in each side torso. To provide anti-infantry capability, a pair of Machine Guns were mounted in the center torso. Five additional pod mounted double heat sinks brought the total up to seventeen, allowing the Woodsman to fire most of its weaponry without worrying about heat overloads. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 樵夫的主配置后来被映射为木狼的默认武器配置。每只手臂各带一门增程大型激光和一门增程中型激光，两侧躯干内各有一对LRM-15补全配置。为提供反步兵能力，中央躯干装了两挺机枪。五个额外挂载式双散热器使总数达到十七个，让樵夫能在不必担心热量过载的情况下发射大部分武器。特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Wraith marked Curtiss Militech's entry into BattleMech production. When the design was announced, many felt that the design would be little more than a walking water cooler. What the critics got was a shock. The Wraith is a 'Mech that, when properly employed, can wreak havoc on an enemy with its astounding speed and maneuverability. It is built around a massive LTV 385 XL Engine that allows it to reach speeds of just under 119 km/h. The Wraith has a simple, yet effective, pulse weapons payload. Pulse laser weaponry allows the Mech to negate most of the side effects on accuracy that are introduced by the Wraith's heavy use of jump jets, making it incredibly accurate and powerful for such a lightly armed Mech. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 幽灵标志着柯蒂斯军工正式进军战斗机甲生产领域。当该设计公布时，许多人认为它不过是个会走路的饮水机；而批评者们得到的却是一记重击。幽灵是一台在运用得当时，能凭借惊人的速度与机动性在敌阵中肆虐的机甲。它以一台庞大的LTV 385 XL引擎为核心，最高速度略低于119 km/h。幽灵的脉冲武器配置简单而高效——脉冲激光武器让机甲能够抵消大量使用跳跃推进器所带来的命中率副作用，使其在如此轻装的机甲中拥有难以置信的精准度与威力。特性：随处可见 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: The Wraith marked Curtiss Militech's entry into BattleMech production. When the design was announced, many felt that the design would be little more than a walking water cooler. What the critics got was a shock. The Wraith is a 'Mech that, when properly employed, can wreak havoc on an enemy with its astounding speed and maneuverability. It is built around a massive LTV 385 XL Engine that allows it to reach speeds of just under 119 km/h. The Wraith has a simple, yet effective, pulse weapons payload. Pulse laser weaponry allows the Mech to negate most of the side effects on accuracy that are introduced by the Wraith's heavy use of jump jets, making it incredibly accurate and powerful for such a lightly armed Mech.
column2: 幽灵标志着柯蒂斯军工进军战斗机甲生产。该设计公布时，许多人觉得它不过是个会走路的水冷器。批评者们得到的是震惊。幽灵是一台只要运用得当，就能以惊人的速度与机动性在敌阵中大闹的机甲。它围绕一台巨大的LTV 385 XL引擎建造，使其速度可达略低于119公里/小时。幽灵拥有一套简单却有效的脉冲武器载荷。脉冲激光武器让该机甲能抵消其大量使用跳跃推进器对精度造成的大部分副作用，使这台轻武装机甲拥有令人难以置信的精度与威力。ZH

column1: The Wraith marked Curtiss Militech's entry into BattleMech production. When the design was announced, many felt that the design would be little more than a walking water cooler. What the critics got was a shock. The Wraith is a 'Mech that, when properly employed, can wreak havoc on an enemy with its astounding speed and maneuverability. It is built around a massive LTV 385 XL Engine that allows it to reach speeds of just under 119 km/h. The Wraith has a simple, yet effective, pulse weapons payload. Pulse laser weaponry allows the Mech to negate most of the side effects on accuracy that are introduced by the Wraith's heavy use of jump jets, making it incredibly accurate and powerful for such a lightly armed Mech. A simple modification of the Wraith, the TR2 simply replaces the Large Pulse Laser with an ER PPC, turning the 'Mech into a highly capable sniper. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

What the critics got was a shock. The Wraith is a 'Mech that, when properly employed, can wreak havoc on an enemy with its astounding speed and maneuverability. It is built around a massive LTV 385 XL Engine that allows it to reach speeds of just under 119 km/h. The Wraith has a simple, yet effective, pulse weapons payload. Pulse laser weaponry allows the Mech to negate most of the side effects on accuracy that are introduced by the Wraith's heavy use of jump jets, making it incredibly accurate and powerful for such a lightly armed Mech. column1: A second line Clan mech, the 45 ton Wyvern IIC is an upgrade of the SLDF Wyverns that survived the Exodus. Built using a cache of Wyverns, Clan Burrock upgraded every aspect of the original mech with Clan tech. Retaining the original 180-rated Fusion Core, the Wyvern IIC is armed with a mix of weapons. An ER Large Laser and an LRM-10 make up the Mechs long range firepower, with a pair of ER Medium Lasers and an SRM-6 for medium range combat. A pair of MG’s, a Flamer and a pair of ER Smalls give additional firepower at close range. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
