column1: An early, primitive prototype introduced in 2564, the 2O used Age of War technology. In particular, the engine, cockpit and armor were all primitive technology. It could reach a top speed of 54 km/h and was protected by fifteen tons of primitive armor. Eighteen single heat sinks dissipated the heat produced by an Autocannon/10, SRM-4, Large Laser, and two medium and Small Lasers. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: 2O 是 2564 年推出的早期原始型原型机，采用战争年代的技术。尤其是引擎、驾驶舱与装甲全部为原始技术。它的最高速度可达 54 km/h，由十五吨原始装甲提供防护。十八具单散热器用于散发一门 AC/10、SRM-4、大型激光以及两门中型与小型激光产生的热量。特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：0.96

column1: The Xanthos was first introduced by the Capellan Confederation in 2564, designed by a young engineer named Dr. David Harrison. Working for Hollis Inc., he pioneered the technology to create four-legged BattleMechs. This technological advancement that later allowed the research into the Scorpion and Goliath enabled the Xanthos to get on the field. It was presented to the Terran Hegemony for review after the cancellation of the Catapult. Hollis pushed to have this 'Mech presented against Dr. Harrison's wishes in a bid to maintain financial solvency. Clumsy and stiff, the 'Mech failed to win the contract from the Star League purchasing committee.
column2: 桑托斯由卡佩兰联邦于2564年首次推出，设计者是年轻工程师大卫·哈里森博士。他在霍利斯公司工作期间开创了制造四足战斗机甲的技术。这项技术进步后来也让蝎式与歌利亚的研究成为可能，并让桑托斯得以登场。弹射器项目取消后，它被提交给地球霸权审查。霍利斯不顾哈里森博士的意愿力推这款机甲，以求维持财务上的偿付能力。但该机甲笨拙僵硬，未能赢得星际联盟采购委员会的合约。ZH

column1: An Autocannon/20 with three tons of ammunition provides substantial close hitting power. It is backed up with three Medium Lasers, a six-tube SRM Pack, and a rear-firing small laser. A single PPC rounds out this design's weaponry, giving it some range. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: 一门AC/20配三吨弹药提供可观的近程打击力，辅以三门中型激光、一组六管SRM包和一门后向小型激光。一门单独的粒子加农炮为该设计的武器收尾，赋予它一定的射程。特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.16

column1: Designed specifically as a fire support 'Mech by Curtis Militech, the Yeoman uses a combination of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous armor, allowing paired LRM-15 launchers and LRM-10 launchers to be mounted in each side torso. 6 tons of ammunition are stored in CASE protected magazines. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 自耕农由柯蒂斯·米尔泰克专门设计为火力支援机甲，采用钢内骨结构与铁纤维装甲的组合，使每侧躯干都能装下成对的LRM-15和LRM-10发射器。6吨弹药储存在CASE防护的弹药舱中。特性：精准武器 - 导弹 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Designed specifically as a fire support 'Mech by Curtis Militech, the Yeoman uses a combination of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous armor, allowing paired LRM-15 launchers and LRM-10 launchers to be mounted in each side torso. 6 tons of ammunition are stored in CASE protected magazines.
column2: 作为柯蒂斯军工专门设计的火力支援机甲，自耕农采用内层钢与铁纤装甲的组合，使每侧躯干都能装成对的LRM-15发射器和LRM-10发射器。6吨弹药储存在CASE保护的弹仓中。ZH

column1: The base production version, the BWP-2B was a bit of a generalized work horse. The 'Mech design mounts an Autocannon 5, four SRM-2 launchers, two LRM-5 launchers and a Large Laser. A Small Laser was also added to use up some spare space. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 作为基础生产版本，BWP-2B算是一台泛用主力。该机甲设计装有一门自动炮5、四具SRM-2发射器、两具LRM-5发射器和一门大型激光，另加一门小型激光以用掉些多余空间。特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: The Ymir was the Lyran Commonwealth's first homegrown BattleMech, designed during the Age of War.  Named for the frost giants of Scandinavian mythology, the Ymir was developed by Coventry Defense Conglomerate by taking the basic frame of the Mackie, shaving ten tons from it and then modifying it to form a sleeker design, that offered greater stability and the ability to maneuver more easily.
column2: 伊米尔是莱兰联邦首款自研战斗机甲，设计于战锤时代。它以斯堪的纳维亚神话中的霜巨人命名，由考文垂防务集团以麦基的基本框架为基础，削去十吨后改装成更流线的设计，带来更好的稳定性与更灵活的机动能力。ZH

column1: An \"upgunned\" version of the 2B , the 2E replaced the LRMs with a single LRM-10 and the SRMs with one SRM-6. The Small Laser was replaced with an extra half-ton of armor. The Large Laser and autocannon were swapped out for two PPCs. Because they did not upgrade the heat dissipation system along with the weapons, MechWarriors had to use volley fire, leading to displeasure with the design. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 作为2B的“加炮”版本，2E以一门单独的LRM-10取代LRM，以一具SRM-6取代SRM，小型激光换成额外半吨装甲，大型激光和自动炮则换成两门粒子加农炮。由于没有随武器一起升级散热系统，机甲战士不得不采用交替齐射，这引发了对该设计的不满。特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The 3A is an upgrade of the 2E Ymir using Star League technology and was developed in 2733. It downgraded the PPCs to standard Large Lasers even as double heat sinks were used. An Artemis IV Fire Control System was added to each missile launcher. The remaining tonnage went towards a Medium Laser and additional armor. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 3A是2E伊米尔采用星际联盟技术的升级型号，于2733年研制完成。它把粒子加农炮降级为标准大型激光，同时改用双散热器，并为每具导弹发射器加装了阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统。剩余的吨位则用于一具中型激光和额外装甲。特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The original Ymir, the X1 prototype could only reach 53 km/h due to its primitive engine. The cockpit and armor were also both primitive, but the design mounted fifteen and a half tons of armor in total. Mounting sixteen heat sinks, the X1 was equipped with two LRM-5s in the right torso,a large laser in the right arm and an AC/5 in the left arm for long-range work. Four SRM-2s were mounted in the left torso for short range work - the designers believing that multiple small systems would be easier to maintain and adapt than larger systems - along with two vehicle flamers mounted in the right hand arm. The vehicle flamers were chosen for the design because of concerns about the safety of taking plasma directly from the reactor, although protecting and shielding the flamers caused problems. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.94 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 作为最初的伊米尔，X1原型机因采用原始引擎，最高时速只能达到53 km/h。驾驶舱与装甲同样是原始型号，但该设计的装甲总重达到十五吨半。X1装有十六台散热器，右躯干配备两具LRM-5，右臂装有一门大型激光，左臂装有一门AC/5用于远程作战。左躯干装有四具SRM-2用于近程作战——设计师认为多个小型系统比大型系统更易维护和改装——右手臂上还装有两具车辆用火焰喷射器。该设计之所以选用车辆用火焰喷射器，是因为担心直接从反应堆抽取等离子体的安全性，不过为火焰喷射器提供防护与屏蔽也带来了不少麻烦。特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：0.94 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部、右臂下部

column1: Yu Huang
column2: 玉皇

column1: The Yu Huang Y-H11F has a mixed weapons loadout, aimed to cover most ranges of engagement. For long rang attacks, the 'Mech carries an ER PPC and LRM-10. Two ER Medium Lasers cover medium range, and as the foes get closer an Ultra AC/20 is ready to finish them off. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 玉皇Y-H11F采用混装武器，意在覆盖大多数交战距离。远程攻击用一门增程粒子加农炮和一具LRM-10；两门增程中型激光覆盖中距离；敌人逼近后，一门超级AC/20随时准备解决他们。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The Yu Huang, named for the Jade Emperor that rules the Heavenly Court in the ancient Chinese pantheon, debuted with the promise from Sun-Tzu Liao that \"it shall sit in judgment over a battlefield, meting out justice to those who would transgress against us\". To live up to the promise of the Chancellor of the Capellan Confederation, the Yu Huang carries some of the most advanced technologies available at the time of its initial production. The Yu Huang is built on an Endo Steel chassis and carries a 360 XL engine that gives the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The 'Mech is capable of jumping up to one hundred and twenty meters with its four jump jets.
column2: 玉皇以上古中国神系中掌管天庭的玉皇大帝命名，它的首次亮相伴随着孙慈廖的承诺："它将坐镇战场之上，对那些敢侵犯我们的人施以审判。"为了不负这位卡佩兰联邦议长的承诺，玉皇携带了其最初投产时最先进的一些技术。玉皇建在内层钢底盘上，携带一台360 XL引擎，使该机甲最高速度达64.8公里/小时。该机甲凭借四个跳跃推进器可跳跃至多一百二十米。ZH

column1: The Zeus was first built by the Lyran Commonwealth in 2787, just as the First Succession War began. Built at the request of Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces commanders for a new light-assault 'Mech, the Zeus is fast enough to keep up with most heavy 'Mechs, and is equally capable of defeating them. Introduced in 2940, and an apparent precursor to the 6T, the 6A sports a PPC and Large Laser backed up by considerable short range firepower in the form of three SRM6 launchers and two Medium Lasers. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 宙斯最早由莱兰联邦于2787年建造，当时第一次继承战争刚刚爆发。应莱兰联邦武装部队指挥官之请而开发的这款新型轻型突击机甲，速度足以跟上大多数重型机甲，也完全有能力击败它们。6A于2940年问世，显然是6T的前身，它装有一门粒子加农炮与一门大型激光，并以三门SRM6发射器与两门中型激光所构成的强大近距离火力作为后盾。特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Ah, the Zeus. These fine machines were designed to be a fast light-assault 'Mech capable of a wide variety of roles with its mix of hardpoints and speed. The old joke aside, this is the REAL Steiner Scout 'Mech.
column2: 啊，宙斯。这些精良的机器被设计为一款快速的轻型突击机甲，凭借其挂点组合与速度能胜任多种角色。抛开那个老笑话不谈，这才是真正的施泰纳侦察机甲。ZH

column1: The -6SR is a battlefield refit from the standard -6S. It replaces the AC/5 with an Ultra AC/5, switches to use double heat sinks and adds C.A.S.E. protection for all ammunition. To improve its defensive strengths, the 'Mech also adds a C3 Slave computer to the center torso and an Armored Cowl to its head. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: -6SR是由标准-6S改来的野战改装。它把AC/5换成超级AC/5，改用双散热器，并为全部弹药加装C.A.S.E.防护。为增强防御，该机甲还在中央躯干加装一台C3从机计算机，并为头部加装机罩。特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Zeus was first built by the Lyran Commonwealth in 2787, just as the First Succession War began. Built at the request of Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces commanders for a new light-assault 'Mech, the Zeus is fast enough to keep up with most heavy 'Mechs, and is equally capable of defeating them. The 9S was an upgrade using Star League technology, debuting in 3048. It carried as its main weapon an ER PPC in its left arm, retained as back-up for long-range combat an LRM-15 launcher and an ER Large Laser. For close combat, the 9S is equipped with two Medium Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 宙斯最早由莱兰联邦于2787年建造，当时第一次继承战争刚刚爆发。应莱兰联邦武装部队指挥官之请而开发的这款新型轻型突击机甲，速度足以跟上大多数重型机甲，也完全有能力击败它们。9S是采用星际联盟技术的升级型号，于3048年首次亮相。它以左臂的增程粒子加农炮为主武器，并保留了一具LRM-15发射器与一门增程大型激光作为远距离战斗的后备。近距离作战时，9S装备两门中型脉冲激光。特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Zeus was first built by the Lyran Commonwealth in 2787, just as the First Succession War began. Built at the request of Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces commanders for a new light-assault 'Mech, the Zeus is fast enough to keep up with most heavy 'Mechs, and is equally capable of defeating them. The 9S2 was a modified version of the 9S. The armor and twelve double heat sinks of original were retained, but the engine was changed to an XL. A Gauss Rifle took the place of the ER PPC while the right arm carried a pair of LRM-15s. Though the Cyclops XII extended range laser was kept, the medium pulse lasers had to be removed to provide enough space for the modifications. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 宙斯由莱兰联邦于2787年首次建造，正值第一次继承战争爆发。它应莱兰联邦武装部队指挥官对新型轻型突击机甲的要求而生，速度足以跟上大多数重型机甲，同样有能力击败它们。9S2是9S的改进版：原版的装甲和十二个双散热器被保留，但引擎换成XL。一门高斯步枪取代了增程粒子加农炮，右臂则装一对LRM-15。虽然独眼巨人XII增程激光被保留，但中型脉冲激光不得不拆除，以腾出足够空间完成改装。特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Zeus was first built by the Lyran Commonwealth in 2787, just as the First Succession War began. Built at the request of Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces commanders for a new light-assault 'Mech, the Zeus is fast enough to keep up with most heavy 'Mechs, and is equally capable of defeating them. The 9S-DC is a sub-variant of the 9S introduced in 3049 designed to include a Command Console. It carried as its main weapon an ER PPC in its left arm, retained as back-up for long-range combat an LRM-15 launcher and an ER Large Laser. The inclusion of a Command Console necessitated the removal of one of the two Medium pulse Lasers. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 宙斯由莱兰联邦于2787年首次建造，正值第一次继承战争爆发。它应莱兰联邦武装部队指挥官对新型轻型突击机甲的要求而生，速度足以跟上大多数重型机甲，同样有能力击败它们。9S-DC是3049年推出的9S子变型，设计上包含一座指挥控制台。它的主武器是左臂一门增程粒子加农炮，远程战斗的后手则保留一具LRM-15发射器和一门增程大型激光。加装指挥控制台迫使它拆掉两门中型脉冲激光中的一门。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Ah, the Zeus. These fine machines were designed to be a fast light-assault 'Mech capable of a wide variety of roles with its mix of hardpoints and speed. The old joke aside, this is the REAL Steiner Scout 'Mech. This model appears to have been a purpose built command 'Mech, its cockpit has been enlarged to all that huge command module and an operator for them.
column2: 啊，宙斯。这些精良的机器被设计为一种快速轻型突击机甲，凭借其硬点组合与速度能胜任各式各样的角色。抛开老笑话不谈，这才是真正的施泰纳侦察机甲。这个型号看起来是一台专门建造的指挥机甲，驾驶舱被扩大到能容纳那个巨大的指挥模块以及一名操作员。ZH

column1: The Zeus was first built by the Lyran Commonwealth in 2787, just as the First Succession War began. Built at the request of Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces commanders for a new light-assault 'Mech, the Zeus is fast enough to keep up with most heavy 'Mechs, and is equally capable of defeating them. The personal 'Mech of Hauptmann-General Leonidas Brannock, commander of the 4th Skye Guards during their assault on Glengarry, the Zeus Leonidas was based on the ZEU-9S. It carried an Artemis IV enhanced LRM-20 and a Gauss Rifle in place of the PPC and LRM-15. The rest of the weapons remained the same. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 宙斯由莱兰联邦于2787年首次建造，正值第一次继承战争爆发。它应莱兰联邦武装部队指挥官对新型轻型突击机甲的要求而生，速度足以跟上大多数重型机甲，同样有能力击败它们。这是第4斯凯卫队指挥官、上校将军列奥尼达斯·布兰诺克在进攻格伦加里时的私人机甲，宙斯列奥尼达斯以ZEU-9S为基础，以一门带阿尔忒弥斯IV的LRM-20和一门高斯步枪取代粒子加农炮与LRM-15，其余武器保持不变。特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Zeus ZEU-P-X is a prototype version of the Zeus that would eventually be further developed into the Zeus X. It mounts the same LBX AC/20, MRM-30 and two ER Medium Lasers as the eventual Zeus X ZEU-X, but uses a standard chassis and has considerably less armor. However, the ZEU-X-P mounts a C3 Slave computer, something the ZEU-X is lacking. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 宙斯ZEU-P-X是宙斯的原型版本，后来进一步发展成了宙斯X。它装与最终版宙斯X ZEU-X相同的LBX AC/20、MRM-30和两门增程中型激光，但使用标准底盘，装甲也少得多。不过ZEU-X-P带一台C3从机计算机，而ZEU-X没有。特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Zeus was first built by the Lyran Commonwealth in 2787, just as the First Succession War began. Built at the request of Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces commanders for a new light-assault 'Mech, the Zeus is fast enough to keep up with most heavy 'Mechs, and is equally capable of defeating them. The Shokomish is the custom variant of the 6S designed to emulate the capabilities of the MechWarrior known as Sealth. Mounting the stock AC/5 and Medium Laser, this variant also features a PPC, twin SRM6 , and twin LRM10 launchers. Included on the Shokomish is a MASC in order to allow nearly any MechWarrior to emulate the famed Sealth, if not replicate him. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Zeus 于 2787 年由莱兰联邦首次建造，恰逢第一次继承战争爆发。它是应莱兰联邦武装力量指挥官的要求而打造的轻型突击机甲；Zeus 的速度足以跟上大多数重型机甲，也完全有能力击败它们。Shokomish 是 6S 的定制改型，旨在复现被称为 Sealth 的机甲战士的能力。它保留原装的 AC/5 和中型激光，同时还配备一门粒子加农炮、双联 SRM6 和双联 LRM10 发射器。Shokomish 还装有一具 MASC，让几乎任何机甲战士都能效仿那位著名的 Sealth，即便无法完全复制他。特性：炮管拳 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: Boss, whoever built this thing went through a lot of trouble to try and replicate the capabilities of a Lyran MechWarrior from the Succession Wars named Sealth who was said to possess unnatural agility and speed on the battlefield. I don't know that this will make the MechWarrior in it any better but that MASC sure will make it move pretty good!
column2: 老大，不管是谁造了这东西，都费了很大功夫去复制一位名叫希尔斯的继承战争时期莱兰机师的能力——据说他在战场上拥有非自然的灵活与速度。我不知道这能不能让坐在里面的人变得更强，但那套MASC肯定会让它跑得相当漂亮！ZH

column1: Manufactured on Kwangjong-ni by Defiance, the Zeus X was both a poster child for excellence in production engineering and an innovative high-technology platform. The first of what became commonly referred to as the Zeus X series, the ZEU-X was a variant of the venerable Zeus BattleMech developed using Experimental Technology to push the envelope of the original design. The 'Mech was armed with an LB-X Autocannon/20 as its primary weapon, backed up by an MRM-30 launcher. The ZEU-X carried three tons of ammunition for the LB-X AC/20 and two tons for the MRM-30, stored in the right torso and protected by CASE II. For close combat, the Zeus had two Medium X-Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Zeus X 由 Defiance 在 Kwangjong-ni 星制造，既是生产工程卓越水准的典范，也是一款创新的高技术平台。ZEU-X 是后来被通称为 Zeus X 系列的首个型号，是经典 Zeus 战斗机甲的变型，采用实验性技术研制，以突破原始设计的极限。该机甲以一门 LB-X 自动炮/20 为主武器，辅以一具 MRM-30 发射器。ZEU-X 为 LB-X AC/20 携带三吨弹药，为 MRM-30 携带两吨弹药，均储存于右躯干并由 CASE II 保护。近距离作战方面，Zeus 装有两门中型 X 脉冲激光。特性：指挥机甲 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: Boss, this thing looks to be a limited production prototype Zeus variant of some kind and is stuffed full of unique cockpit gear. I'm not sure how you got this thing but there probably isn't but a couple in the whole galaxy!
column2: 老板，这东西看起来是某种限量生产的宙斯原型变型，还塞满了独特的驾驶舱设备。我不知道你是怎么弄到它的，但整个银河大概也就那么几台！ZH

column1: Developed by the New Earth Trading Company in 2587, the Alacorn attracted a reputation in the SLDF as an effective and dependable tank. The Mk II Alacorn was another design prototype introduced alongside with the Mk I. Though it used the same engine and chassis as the Mk I, the Mk II carried three AC/20s in its turret. It only carried three tons of ammunition however, and to make room for the heavier guns the armor protection was reduced to six tons. This resulted in a vehicle with a much shorter effective range, meaning it had to close with enemy forces, but the machine lacked the armor to survive a close-up fight. Biome Restrictions: None. column1: Developed by Team Banzai as the big brother of the highly successful Hatchetman, the Axman was designed exclusively to be a 'Mech killer. The Axman was also intended as a symbol of solidarity throughout the Federated Commonwealth by using components that were produced in Davion, Steiner, and even former Liao space. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: 斧兵由班宰小队研发，是极为成功的刽子手的大哥，专门被设计为机甲杀手。斧兵还被用作整个联邦共同体团结的象征——它的部件分别产自达维昂、施泰纳乃至前廖氏领地。特质: 近战驱动器 投放成本倍率: 1.07

column1: An early prototype of the Axman, the AXM-1X paved the road for the large investments into the project by the AFFC that eventually led to its large success. Besides its large hatchet it mounts a Autocannon/10, a Large Laser and two Medium Lasers. It also used a standard size engine and single heat sinks, making it quite inferior to many production run Axmans. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: 作为斧兵的早期原型，AXM-1X为AFFC对该项目的大笔投资铺平了道路，最终带来了它的巨大成功。除了一把大斧，它还装有一门自动炮/10、一门大型激光器和两门中型激光器。它还采用标准尺寸引擎和单重散热器，使其远逊于多数量产型斧兵。特质: 近战驱动器 投放成本倍率: 1.07

column1: The 2N variant of the Axman, introduced in the late 3040s, has been called a mistake by some and a stroke of genius by others. The 2N carries two LRM-15 launchers in place of the massive Autocannon/20 as the autocannon often jammed on early models. While this changes the 'Mech's role from a city fighter to a long-range bombardment 'Mech, it also allows the Axman to be a support 'Mech that can defend itself with its massive Hatchet at ranges where the LRMs are ineffective if an enemy closes. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 斧兵的2N改型于3040年代末推出，有人称其为错误，也有人称之为神来之笔。由于早期型号的自动炮经常卡壳，2N以两具LRM-15发射器取代了庞大的自动炮/20。这虽然把该机甲的角色从城市战士变为远程轰炸机甲，但也让斧兵成为一台能自保的支援机甲——当敌人逼近、LRM失效时，它可以靠那把巨斧自我防卫。特质: 近战驱动器 投放成本倍率: 1.09

column1: A short range brawler variant of the Axman, the AXM-2R is often run as the follow-up unit after other Axman models punched through most of an enemy's armor. Its short range loadout of two Artemis IV-enabled SRM-6 launchers, two Medium Pulser Lasers and a single Large Pulser Laser can deliver quite the punch. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 作为斧兵的近距近战改型，AXM-2R常在其他斧兵型号打穿敌方大部分装甲之后作为后续单位投入。它那套由两具带阿尔忒弥斯IV的SRM-6发射器、两门中型脉冲激光器和一门大型脉冲激光器构成的近距载荷，打击力相当可观。特质: 近战驱动器 投放成本倍率: 1.09

column1: The Furillo manufactured 3S introduced in 3057 removes the XL Engine of the 1N and 2N variants and replaces it with a Light Fusion Engine. This exclusively Lyran variant of the Axman is armed with a massive LB-X Autocannon/20, which allows it to fire either solid rounds or cluster rounds that act like a 'Mech sized shotgun. The 'Mech also carries three ER Medium Lasers for close combat and a Guardian ECM Suite, which defends against enemy electronic warfare equipment. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 这台由富里洛制造、3057年推出的3S，拆掉了1N与2N改型的XL引擎，换成一具轻型聚变引擎。这款莱兰专属的斧兵改型武装为一门巨大的LB-X自动炮/20，可发射实心弹或集束弹，效果如同机甲尺寸的霰弹枪。该机甲还携带三门增程中型激光器用于近战，以及一套守卫者ECM套件，用于防御敌方电子战装备。特质: 近战驱动器 投放成本倍率: 1.09

column1: Designed in 2719 during the last days of the Star League, the Crab was built as a medium-weight raider and guerrilla fighter for the Star League Defense Force. Although lacking hand actuators or jump jets, it possessed good overland speed and its all-energy weapons payload was suitable for long-range missions without the prospect for resupply. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: 螃蟹于2719年、星盟最后的日子里设计，是星盟防卫部队的中量级袭扰与游击战斗机甲。虽然没有手部驱动器或跳跃推进器，它拥有良好的地面速度，且全能量武器载荷使其适合在无从补给的情况下执行远程任务。特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.02

column1: An early clan Mech dating from the days of Operation Klondike, the Crab CRB-27-EC was an upgrade of the CRB-27 that replaced the weapons with Early Clan variants. It would be discontinued and forgotten as modern clan spec weapons entered production. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 作为可追溯到克朗代克行动时期的一种早期氏族机甲，螃蟹CRB-27-EC是CRB-27的升级版，把武器换成了早期氏族变体。随着现代氏族规格武器投产，它被停产并逐渐被遗忘。特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.02 手臂驱动器限制: 左下

column1: Crab 27s fulfill an oft overlooked role, that of a skirmisher with firepower. Wielding strong energy weapons, the Crab delivers a punch at nearly all ranges, with no ammunition constraints. The blend of firepower, heat efficiency, and speed make the Crab the perfect 'Mech to raid enemy positions. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 螃蟹27履行着一个常被忽视的角色：带火力的游击手。凭借强力的能量武器，螃蟹几乎在所有射程上都能打出打击，且不受弹药限制。火力、热效率与速度的结合，使螃蟹成为袭扰敌方阵地的完美机甲。特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.02 手臂驱动器限制: 左下

column1: A simple upgrade utilized by the SLDF Royals concurrently with the original Crab, the 27b replaces the heat sinks with double-strength models and the Lasers with Extended Range variants. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是SLDF皇家部队与原版螃蟹同期使用的一次简单升级，27b把散热器换成双倍强度型号，激光器换成增程型号。特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

column1: A simple upgrade utilized by the SLDF Royals concurrently with the original Crab, the 27sl changes the weapons payload to pulse variants. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是SLDF皇家部队与原版螃蟹同期使用的一次简单升级，27sl把武器载荷换成脉冲型号。特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.06 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

column1: Crab 30s are a complete overhaul of the old Crab design, upgrading its electronics, engine and weapons to the latest standards. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 螃蟹30是对老旧螃蟹设计的彻底翻新，把电子设备、引擎与武器升级到最新标准。特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.02 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

column1: The CRB-C Crab is a minor update of the design modified to include a C3 Slave Unit. Introduced by the Draconis Combine in 3056 this Crab makes space for the C3 unit by removing the medium laser. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

column1: Based on the Crab that Judith Faber piloted during the Battle of Tukkayyid, this model named Florentine, this variant is a virtual mini-King Crab mounting an Ultra AC/5 in each arm supported by a left-torso mounted LRM-5 and a right-torso mounted Medium Laser. Carrying one ton of LRM missiles and three of Ultra Autocannon rounds, the Florentine's weapon loadout is made possible through use of a 250 XL Engine and an Endo Steel frame. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 该型号名为“佛罗伦萨”，基于朱迪思·法贝尔在图卡伊德战役中驾驶的螃蟹。它实际上是一台迷你帝王蟹，双臂各装一门超速AC/5，由左躯干的LRM-5和右躯干的中型激光器支援。它携带一吨LRM导弹和三吨超速自动炮弹，之所以能装下这套武器，得益于250 XL引擎与内层钢框架。特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.06 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

column1: Repurposed by a Goliath Scorpion Seeker who recovered it from a lost Brian Cache, this CRB-27b has undergone an extensive restoration effort. Sporting Clan tech weapons, augmented by a targeting computer and an active probe; this Crab aids the Seeker in their search for Star League relics. Surprisingly, the design mounts jump jets – enough to leap 150 metres at a time- an unusual addition to the Crab. Intended to aid in exploration work, they have surprised many opponents in combat or a circle of equals, helping to contribute to the Seeker's many victories. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这台CRB-27b由一位从失落布莱恩储藏库中寻回它的蝎狮氏族探寻者重新启用，并经过大规模修复。它装备氏族科技武器，辅以一台瞄准计算机和一个主动探测器；这台螃蟹协助探寻者搜寻星盟遗物。令人意外的是，该设计装了跳跃推进器——足以一次跃出150米——这对螃蟹而言是异乎寻常的加装。它们本意是辅助勘探工作，却在战斗或同侪圆环中让许多对手措手不及，为探寻者的诸多胜利立下功劳。特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

column1: Cyclops
column2: 独眼巨人

column1: The most notable of all Cyclops variants, introduced in 2750, fits the 'Mech with a Collapsible Command Module strapped to its rear torso, allowing a fully operational headquarters bunker to be set up in fifteen minutes. In order to make room for the module the Autocannon/20 and its ammunition was removed from this variant. Irreparable damages suffered during the Succession Wars means less than half of those Cyclopses with a working B-2000 have an operable command module. Quirk: Battle Computer B2000 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: 作为所有独眼巨人改型中最著名的一款，它于2750年推出，在后躯干绑上一台可折叠指挥模块，能在十五分钟内搭建起一座完整运作的指挥部掩体。为给该模块腾出空间，这一改型拆掉了自动炮/20及其弹药。继承战争期间遭受的不可修复损伤，意味着装有可用B-2000的独眼巨人中，不到一半还保有可运转的指挥模块。特质: 战斗计算机 B2000 投放成本倍率: 1.14

column1: A refit of the original CP-10-HQ that replaces two heat sinks with two extra tons of ammunition. This refit is very uncommon, only seeing use at a few select battle fields where it was a last ditch effort to have even the command 'Mechs engage in prolonged battles, thus needing the extra ammunition. Quirk: Battle Computer B2000 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: 这是原版CP-10-HQ的一次改装，用两吨额外弹药替换两具散热器。该改装非常罕见，只在少数几处战场上使用过——那是最后的无奈之举，为的是让连指挥机甲也投入持久战，因此需要额外弹药。特质: 战斗计算机 B2000 投放成本倍率: 1.14

column1: Cyclops 10-Qs are strong support units. Lacking the close in weapons and command suite of the 10-Z variant, this model instead capitalizes on a longer range weapon configuration and added armor. The protection and expanded missile racks make the 10-Q a significant threat at range in the right hands. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: 独眼巨人10-Q是强力的支援单位。它没有10-Z改型的近距武器与指挥套件，改而以一套更远程的武器配置和增加的装甲取胜。防护与扩充的导弹架使10-Q在行家手中成为远程上的重大威胁。特质: 罩壳 投放成本倍率: 1.16

column1: A custom variant of the Cyclops CP-10-Q, fielded by Wolf's Dragoons and their affiliated Mercnary outfits. Replacing almost all of the equipment with Clan tech, the 'Mech primarily save use as a defensive AMS platform as the Wolf's Dragoons did not consider the 'Mech of much battleworth. Quirk: Battle Computer B2000 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22
column2: 这是独眼巨人CP-10-Q的定制改型，由狼族龙骑兵及其附属雇佣兵部队使用。它把几乎所有装备换成氏族科技，但该机甲主要被当作防御性AMS平台使用，因为狼族龙骑兵并不认为这台机甲有多少战斗价值。特质: 战斗计算机 B2000 投放成本倍率: 1.22

column1: Cyclops 10-Zs use their imposing presence and unique communications equipment to control the battlefield. While the 10-Z carries a lethal array of close range weaponry, its primary role is command and control, bolstering friendly units with its specialized battle computer. Quirk: Battle Computer B2000 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: 独眼巨人10-Z凭借其威压般的存在感与独特的通讯设备掌控战场。虽然10-Z携带致命的近距离武器阵列，其主要角色仍是指挥与控制，用专门的战斗计算机增强友军单位。特质: 战斗计算机 B2000 投放成本倍率: 1.14

column1: An attempt by Wolf's Dragoons to make the CP-10-Z more useful in battle. Upgrading most of its weaponry with ER or Clan versions, the main weapon is a side torso mounted UAC/10 and two Artemis IV enabled LRM-10 launchers. Quirk: Battle Computer B2000 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22
column2: 这是狼族龙骑兵为使CP-10-Z在战斗中更有用所做的一次尝试。它把大部分武器升级为增程或氏族版本，主武器是侧躯干的一门UAC/10与两具带阿尔忒弥斯IV的LRM-10发射器。特质: 战斗计算机 B2000 投放成本倍率: 1.22

column1: The Cyclops is one of the Capellan Confederation's preferred 'Mechs to install Dual Cockpits. This standard refit installs the Dual Cockpit on a CP-11-A, removing one ton of gauss rifle ammunition. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: 独眼巨人是卡佩兰联邦偏爱的双座驾驶舱安装平台之一。这一标准改装在CP-11-A上安装双座驾驶舱，拆掉一吨高斯步枪弹药。特质: 罩壳 投放成本倍率: 1.16

column1: A common modification of the Cyclops that uses some rediscovered Star League technology, the 11-A was introduced in 3045 and replaces the massive Autocannon/20 for a Zeus Slingshot Gauss Rifle with two tons of ammo. Although doing slightly less damage it has a much larger effective range. Quirk: Battle Computer B2000 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: 作为独眼巨人常见的一项改装，11-A使用了部分重新发现的星盟科技，于3045年推出，把那门庞大的自动炮/20换成一门宙斯弹弓高斯步枪配两吨弹药。虽然伤害略低，其有效射程大得多。特质: 战斗计算机 B2000 投放成本倍率: 1.14

column1: The 11-C is similar to the 11-A in that they carry an almost identical weapons payload. Built in 3050 the only difference is that the 11-C has removed the LRM-10 launcher and replaced it with a C3 Computer, which allows it to share targeting data and coordinate C3 lances. An additional two tons of armor have been added to the design as well. This makes the 11-C a highly effective sniper and command 'Mech. Quirk: Battle Computer B2000 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: 11-C与11-A相似，两者武器载荷几乎相同。11-C造于3050年，唯一区别在于它拆掉了LRM-10发射器，换上一台C3计算机，使其能共享瞄准数据并协调C3分队。该设计还额外加装了两吨装甲。这使11-C成为高效的狙击与指挥机甲。特质: 战斗计算机 B2000 投放成本倍率: 1.16

column1: A full redesign of the Cyclops, the 11-G was built by Grumium Creations for the Second Star League Defense Force, Com Guards and Free Rasalhague Republic. Debuting in 3058 it redesigns the chassis to use Endo Steel construction and also replaces the standard armor with fifteen tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. For long range combat it retains the Gauss Rifle and LRM-10 missile launcher minus one ton of missile reloads, while the arm-mounted medium lasers and center-torso SRM launcher were also upgraded to ER Medium Lasers and a Streak SRM-4 launcher. All ammunition for the weapons was also shifted to the right-side torso and uses CASE to protect itself from complete destruction in the event of an ammunition explosion. Quirk: Battle Computer B2000 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: 作为独眼巨人的全新设计，11-G由格鲁缪姆创意为第二星盟防卫部队、康卫队与自由拉萨尔哈格共和国建造。它于3058年首次亮相，底盘改用内层钢构造，并以十五吨铁纤装甲替换标准装甲。远程作战方面，它保留高斯步枪和LRM-10导弹发射器（少一吨导弹备用弹），同时把臂装中型激光器与中央躯干SRM发射器升级为增程中型激光器和一具连发SRM-4发射器。所有武器弹药也移到右侧躯干，并使用CASE以防弹药爆炸时整机尽毁。特质: 战斗计算机 B2000 投放成本倍率: 1.16

column1: This version of the Cyclops was improved by using an Endo Steel frame. As a result the variant is able to mount a SRM 4 in the center torso, a LRM-5 along with Guardian ECM in the left torso, 2 AC/5's in the right torso, and 2 Medium Lasers in each arm. Rounding up the design is 14 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. Quirk: Battle Computer B2000 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: 这一版独眼巨人通过采用内层钢框架得到改进。因此该改型得以在中央躯干装一具SRM 4，左躯干装一具LRM-5和守卫者ECM，右躯干装2门AC/5，双臂各2门中型激光器。该设计另有14吨铁纤装甲收尾。特质: 战斗计算机 B2000 投放成本倍率: 1.16

column1: The 12-K variant of the Cyclops takes the 'Mech to the logical conclusion based on equipment available to the DCMS. Built by Grumium and introduced in 3059, the 'Mech is armed with an Ultra Autocannon/10 for close to intermediate range combat. In place of the LRM launcher it carries an MRM-20 launcher, which compliments the Autocannon's range profile, while retaining two ER medium lasers and a Streak SRM-4 for for close ranges. The 'Mech is also armored with fourteen and a half tons of armor. Quirk: Battle Computer B2000 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: 独眼巨人的12-K改型基于DCMS可获得的装备，把这台机甲推向合乎逻辑的终点。它由格鲁缪姆建造并于3059年推出，武装为一门超速自动炮/10，负责近至中距作战。它以一具MRM-20发射器取代LRM发射器，与自动炮的射程曲线相配，同时保留两门增程中型激光器和一具连发SRM-4用于近距离。该机甲还披挂十四吨半装甲。特质: 战斗计算机 B2000 投放成本倍率: 1.16

column1: There is little knowledge of the source of this variant of the Cyclops. Similar in base design to CP-10 and CP-11 models mounting C3 units, the design also incorporates an XL engine on an Endo Steel frame, allowing both more armor and weapons to be mounted. Quirk: Battle Computer B2000 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: 关于这台独眼巨人改型的来源所知甚少。它的基础设计与装有C3单元的CP-10和CP-11型号相似，同时在内层钢框架上采用XL引擎，使其能装下更多装甲与武器。特质: 战斗计算机 B2000 投放成本倍率: 1.16

column1: Hatchetman
column2: 刽子手

column1: Hatchetman 3Fs are the king of the close quarters fight. Packing high impact short range weaponry, and a unique melee Hatchet, any target is in danger when close to the Hatchetman. The Hatchetmans lighter armor requires it to rely on maneuvering and ambushing to stay in the fight. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
column2: 斧手3F是近距离近战之王。它携带高冲击力的短程武器和一把独特的近战斧，任何目标一旦靠近斧手都处于危险之中。斧手较薄的装甲要求它依靠机动与埋伏来留在战斗中。特质: 近战驱动器 投放成本倍率: 1.01

column1: A field refit of the -3F, converting the mech to use double heat sinks and downgrades one of the medium lasers to a small so CASE protection can be added. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
column2: 这是-3F的战地改装，把机甲改用双重散热器，并把其中一门中型激光器降级为小型，以便加装CASE防护。特质: 近战驱动器 投放成本倍率: 1.01

column1: Originally assigned to the NAIS Training Cadres, it was selected as a NAIS technology test bed before being assigned to Fox's Teeth member Austin Vorster in the lead-up to the War of 3039. Mounting a NAIS Mk. 1 LB 10-X Autocannon prototype saved enough weight to add a third medium laser, moving all three to the left arm to avoid inhibiting use of the 'Mech's hatchet. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 它最初被分配给NAIS训练干部，后被选为NAIS技术试验台，随后在3039年战争前夕分配给狐牙成员奥斯汀·沃斯特。装上一门NAIS Mk. 1 LB 10-X自动炮原型省下的重量足以加装第三门中型激光器，三门全部移到左臂，以免妨碍该机甲使用斧头。特质: 近战驱动器 投放成本倍率: 1.03

column1: This unusual variant of the Hatchmen does not actually bring a hatchet. Instead it improves the cooling of the 'Mech. This was however never an intended design, but rather a field refit of 'Mechs that were waiting for replacement Hatchets after losing theirs. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
column2: 这一不寻常的斧手改型其实并没有带斧头。它改为改善机甲散热。不过这从不是有意设计的改型，而是对那把斧头丢失后等待替换的机甲所做的战地改装。特质: 近战驱动器 投放成本倍率: 1.01

column1: The Hatchetman -3X further indexes on the stock design's close combat role, adding more armor and replacing its AC/10 for an array of SRMs, Lasers, and Anti-Personnel weapons. This is the ultimate melee brawler. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
column2: 斧手-3X进一步强化了原设计的近战角色，增加装甲，并把它的AC/10换成一批SRM、激光器和反人员武器。这是终极的近战蛮牛。特质: 近战驱动器 投放成本倍率: 1.01

column1: An upgrade to the -3 series of Hatchetmen, using Endo Steel structure to allow adding both more armor and two more tons of ammo. The 'Mech is also converted to use double heat sinks. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
column2: 这是对斧手-3系列的升级，采用内层钢结构，得以同时增加装甲和两吨弹药。该机甲也改用双重散热器。特质: 近战驱动器 投放成本倍率: 1.01

column1: Dismissed by some upon its introduction as little more than a rapidly overheating deathtrap, the HCT-5S is nonetheless one of the most efficient city and close quarters fighting 'mechs ever produced. Its LB-X AC/10 and three Medium Pulse Lasers give it destructive alpha strike potential at close range, and the Hatchetman's natural melee abilities give it a useful fallback when at risk of overheating. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: HCT-5S推出时曾被一些人贬为不过是个很快就会过热的死亡陷阱，但它仍是有史以来最高效的城市与近距战斗机甲之一。它的LB-X AC/10与三门中型脉冲激光器赋予其近距离毁灭性的全弹齐射潜力，而斧手天生的近战能力在有过热风险时提供了有用的退路。特质: 近战驱动器 投放成本倍率: 1.03

column1: Receiving a 3050s era 5S model after the Fox's Teeth faced Clan Jade Falcon on Wotan in 3051, Austin Vorster had it refitted in the lead-up to the FedCom Civil War. Almost identical to the 6S created by the Lyran Alliance in the conflict, the only significant difference is the placement of all ER Medium Lasers in the 'Mech's left arm. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 在狐牙于3051年在沃坦对上翡翠猎鹰氏族之后，奥斯汀·沃斯特收到了一台3050年代的5S型号，并在联邦共同体内战前夕对它进行了改装。它与莱兰联盟在那场冲突中打造的6S几乎完全相同，唯一显著差别是所有增程中型激光器都装在机甲左臂。特质: 近战驱动器 投放成本倍率: 1.05

column1: Scarabus
column2: 圣甲虫

column1: The Scarabus is equipped with a close range weapons arsenal, with the primary weapons being a pair of medium lasers backed up by a pair of small lasers. To defend itself when the 'Mech gets into extremely close range combat, the Scarabus carries a two ton hatchet, which allows it to cleave into an enemy's armor. The 'Mech is also equipped with a Guardian ECM suite to protect itself from advanced electronic detection equipment when scouting against an enemy, and mounts a TAG to designate targets for Arrow IV artillery attacks. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 圣甲虫装备一套近距离武器库，主武器是一对中型激光器，由一对小型激光器提供后援。为了在机甲陷入极近距离战斗时自保，圣甲虫携带一把两吨重的斧头，能劈开敌方装甲。该机甲还装备一套守卫者ECM套件，在对敌侦察时保护自己免遭先进电子探测设备的发现，并装有一具TAG，为箭矢IV炮击标定目标。特质: 坚固 投放成本倍率: 0.99 手臂驱动器限制: 左下

column1: The 9B variant of the Scarabus is built using Triple Strength Myomer to enhance the 'Mech's speed and strength once in the proper heat range. This enhances the 'Mech's top speed to a maximum of 183.6 km/h and also increases the sheer amount of damage that the Scarabus is capable of doing with its hatchet. The only other change is the conversion to use double heat sinks for improved cooling, something that can be seen as counterproductive for the added TSM. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 圣甲虫的9B改型采用三倍强度肌纤维建造，在达到合适热量区间后提升机甲的速度与力量。这将其最高速度提升到183.6公里/小时，也大幅增加圣甲虫用斧头所能造成的伤害。唯一的其他改动是改用双重散热器以改善散热——考虑到新增的TSM，这可以看作是反效果。特质: 坚固 投放成本倍率: 0.99 手臂驱动器限制: 左下

column1: The 9T variant of the Scarabus is built using Triple Strength Myomer to enhance the 'Mech's speed and strength once in the proper heat range. This enhances the 'Mech's top speed to a maximum of 183.6 km/h and also increases the sheer amount of damage that the Scarabus is capable of doing with its hatchet. Otherwise, the 'Mech has not had any significant changes made. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 圣甲虫的9T改型采用三倍强度肌纤维建造，在达到合适热量区间后提升机甲的速度与力量。这将其最高速度提升到183.6公里/小时，也大幅增加圣甲虫用斧头所能造成的伤害。除此之外，该机甲没有做任何重大改动。特质: 坚固 投放成本倍率: 0.99 手臂驱动器限制: 左下

column2: 尖啸者 LAM

column1: Screamer
column2: 尖啸者

column1: The Screamer LAM is a prototype Land-Air 'Mech which was produced during the reign of Emperor Stefan Amaris when his forces were occupying the Terran Hegemony in late Star League Era. The design shares the same tonnage as the Shadow Hawk LAM. The 'Mech was built as a harasser and quick strike machine. Unlike the original prototype LAM, the Screamer was able to transition into a fighter, 'Mech, or AirMech modes. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: 尖啸者LAM是一种原型陆空机甲，在星盟时代末期、斯特凡·阿马里斯皇帝麾下部队占领地球霸权期间生产。该设计与影子鹰LAM吨位相同。它被建造为袭扰与快速打击机器。与最初的原型LAM不同，尖啸者能转换为战机、机甲或空甲模式。特质: 陆空机甲 投放成本倍率: 1.07

column1: Originally developed in the final year of the Amaris Civil War as the ultimate fixed position city defense BattleMech, the Annihilator was built as a sign of the military strength of the Star League in Exile. The -1A was armed with four Autocannon/10s and four Medium Lasers. While less accurate than the original -2A, the 1A was still a highly destructive and dangerous 'Mech that no MechWarrior looked forward to engaging. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 歼灭者最初在阿马里斯内战的最后一年作为终极固定阵地城市防御战斗机甲研发，被打造为流亡星盟军事实力的象征。-1A武装为四门自动炮/10和四门中型激光器。虽然不如最初的-2A精准，1A仍是一台破坏力极强、极度危险的机甲，没有机师愿意与它交战。特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

column1: Still a fearsome and powerful design, where the original Annihilator-1A carries a bevy of powerful autocannons, the -1E instead opts for an all-energy weapon loadout. Four Particle Projection Cannons give the Annihilator-1E a brutal and incredibly powerful punch while the Medium Lasers from the -1A are carried over for in-close protection while increasing the armor protection somewhat to mitigate enemy return fire. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这仍是一个令人生畏、威力强大的设计：原本的歼灭者-1A携带着一批强力自动炮，而-1E改而选择全能量武器载荷。四门粒子加农炮赋予歼灭者-1E残暴而难以置信的打击力，同时继承了-1A的中型激光器用于近距离自卫，并略微增加装甲防护以减轻敌方回击。特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

column1: This variant had an ER PPC in the right torso, and three Gauss Rifles (one in each arm, and one in the left torso) to provide hard hitting firepower. Each Gauss Rifle had two tons of ammunition. Ten double heat sinks were more than adequate to keep the machine cool. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这一改型右躯干装一门增程PPC，另有三门高斯步枪（双臂各一门，左躯干一门）提供沉重打击火力。每门高斯步枪配两吨弹药。十具双重散热器足以让这台机器保持凉爽。特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

column1: The original model created in 2779 was equipped with a head-mounted Small Laser, four LB 10-X AC, a pair of Small Pulse Lasers, and four Medium Lasers. It carried six tons of LB 10-X ammunition, and the torsos were protected with CASE. Ten double heat sinks kept heat manageable. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 最初于2779年创造的型号装备头部一门小型激光器、四门LB 10-X AC、一对小型脉冲激光器和四门中型激光器。它携带六吨LB 10-X弹药，躯干以CASE保护。十具双重散热器将热量控制在可管理范围。特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

column1: Originally developed in the final year of the Amaris Civil War as the ultimate fixed position city defense BattleMech, the Annihilator was built as a sign of the military strength of both the Star League in Exile and the newly created Clans. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 歼灭者最初在阿马里斯内战的最后一年作为终极固定阵地城市防御战斗机甲研发，被打造为流亡星盟与新生氏族双方军事实力的象征。特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

column1: An upgrade of 'acquired' ANH-1X variant 'Mechs from Clans storage as they were phased out due to their inferior design. The main goal of the update was increasing its mobility through a 300-rated XL engine. While the design managed to keep the four LBX AC/10 and Medium Lasers, to be able to carry the engine both the C.A.S.E. protection and the small lasers had to be dropped. However, a C3 Slave unit was added in the 'Mechs head. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是对从氏族库存中“获得”的ANH-1X改型机甲的一次升级——它们因设计低劣而被逐步淘汰。升级的主要目标是通过一具300级XL引擎提升其机动性。该设计设法保留了四门LBX AC/10和中型激光器，但为了装下这台引擎，必须去掉C.A.S.E.防护和小型激光器。不过，机甲头部加装了一套C3从属系统。特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

column1: The ANH-4W is a Wolf Dragoon's upgrade performed on some of the Annihilators they managed to 'free' from the clans control. These Annihilators were upgraded with a 200 XL clan engine and switched to clan double heat sinks. The weaponry was exchanged with a highly unusual mix of Ultra and LBX autocannons, since this is what was in surplus at the time. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: ANH-4W是狼族龙骑兵对他们设法从氏族控制下“解放”的部分歼灭者所做的升级。这些歼灭者换装了一台200 XL氏族引擎，并改用氏族双重散热器。武器被换成一种极不寻常的超速与LBX自动炮混合配置，因为当时手上富余的就是这些。特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.24 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

column1: A variant of the Annihilator that was built using only Clan technology and used exclusively by the Wolf's Dragoons, the Annihilator C increased its maximum speed to 54 km/h. The 'Mech was armed with four Ultra Autocannon/10s and four ER Medium Lasers. The Ultra Autocannon/10s allowed the 'Mech to fire at twice the rate of a normal autocannon, allowing it to put as much fire out as if it was carrying eight regular autocannons. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 作为仅使用氏族科技建造、且由狼族龙骑兵独家使用的歼灭者改型，歼灭者C把最高速度提升到54公里/小时。该机甲武装为四门超速自动炮/10和四门增程中型激光器。超速自动炮/10让该机甲能以普通自动炮两倍的射速开火，使其火力输出相当于携带八门常规自动炮。特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.22 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

column1: Apparently based on the ANH-1G, this variant only uses Clan technology. The 'Mech's top speed was 32.4 km/h and the armor protection was reduced, but four Gauss Rifles backed up by an ER PPC in the center torso and a head mounted ER Small Laser provided withering firepower for defensive engagements. Ten tons of ammunition kept the Gauss Rifles fed through the longest engagements. To make room for all these weapons, the C2 used an Endo Steel internal structure. Integrated CASE protected the arms and torsos from Gauss Rifle explosions. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这一改型显然以ANH-1G为基础，只使用氏族科技。该机甲最高速度32.4公里/小时，装甲防护有所减少，但四门高斯步枪配以中央躯干的一门增程PPC和头部一门增程小型激光器，为防御作战提供了摧枯拉朽的火力。十吨弹药让高斯步枪能撑过最漫长的交战。为容纳这些武器，C2采用了内层钢内部结构。整合式CASE保护双臂与躯干免受高斯步枪爆炸之害。特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.22 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

column1: Designed as a joke, the "Gausszilla" was never intended for production, let alone deployment. Nobody is quite sure who submitted the design file titled "Gausszilla_Meme_Final_NOTFINAL_DONOTUSE_v3.mtf" to the factory. Stranger still is that it was greenlit. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Gauss Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 作为玩笑设计的“高斯步枪哥斯拉”从未打算投产，更不用说部署。没人十分确定是谁把那份名为“Gausszilla_Meme_Final_NOTFINAL_DONOTUSE_v3.mtf”的设计文件提交给工厂的。更奇怪的是它居然被批准了。特质: 精准武器 - 高斯步枪 投放成本倍率: 1.2 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

column1: Apparently based on the Annihilator C 2, this customized variant of the chassis carries five Clan Gauss rifles. It was thought lost to history. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Gauss Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这台定制改型的底盘显然以歼灭者C 2 为基础，装有五门氏族高斯步枪。它一度被认为已湮没于历史。特质: 精准武器 - 高斯步枪 投放成本倍率: 1.24 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

column1: A custom battlefield refit of the ANH-3A1 that gained some popularity, as trading the C3 slave unit for putting the CASE protection back in was well worth it to many 'MechWarriors that had the choice. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是ANH-3A1的一次战地定制改装，并颇受欢迎——对许多有得选的机师来说，用C3从属系统换回CASE防护非常值得。特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

column1: A jump-enabled version of the -2R, the -2J fits four jump jets at the cost of replacing two the LRM-20 launchers with its smaller kin, the LRM-15 launcher. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: -2R的跳跃改型，-2J装四个跳跃推进器，代价是把两具LRM-20发射器换成了更小的同类——LRM-15发射器。特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.08

column1: The 2K Archer was a modification built for House Kurita in 2856, designed to increase its direct firepower capability and give it more staying power on the battlefield once it had run out of ammunition Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 2K弓箭手是2856年为栗田家族建造的改装，旨在提升其直射火力，并让它在弹药耗尽后仍能在战场上撑得更久 特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.08

column1: Introduced in 3026, the 2P is rebuilt for short-range and melee combat, retaining only the left and center-torso medium lasers of the ARC-2R, dropping the LRM racks to carry an SRM-4 and SRM-6 rack in each side torso, freeing up the weight for a heavy longsword carried in the right arm. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 2P于3026年推出，为近距离与近战重建，只保留ARC-2R的左侧与中央躯干中型激光器，拆掉LRM架，改为每侧躯干各装一具SRM-4和SRM-6架，省出的重量用于在右臂携带一把重型长剑。特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.08

column2: 作为雷霆与女妖等机甲的同时代产物，弓箭手的主要角色是火力支援 特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.08

column1: The 2Rb variant of the Archer was built for SLDF Royal units starting in 2752. A contemporary of 'Mechs such as the Thunderbolt and the Banshee, the Archer's primary role was fire support. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 弓箭手的2Rb改型从2752年起为SLDF皇家部队建造。作为雷霆与女妖等机甲的同时代产物，弓箭手的主要角色是火力支援。特质: 指挥机甲 投放成本倍率: 1.1

column1: A battlefield refit of the -2R, replacing the two Center Torso-mounted Medium Lasers with C.A.S.E. system side torso protection and a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 这是-2R的战地改装，把中央躯干的两门中型激光器换成C.A.S.E.系统侧躯干防护和一套C3从属系统。特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.08

column1: A clan partial refit of the original -2R, replacing all the weapons with the improved clan versions allowing more LRM launchers to be added. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 这是对原本-2R的氏族部分改装，把所有武器换成改进后的氏族版本，从而得以加装更多LRM发射器。特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.08

column1: The Personal 'Mech of Kell Hounds commander Morgan Kell, during the Clan Invasion he had his stock ARC-2R model upgraded with recovered Star League and salvaged Clan systems. Using Clan-grade LRM-20s and Double Heat Sinks freed up weight for more armor, more LRM ammunition, Artemis IV, CASE and a Clan Active Probe in the head to enhance it's command abilities. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12
column2: 这是凯尔猎犬指挥官摩根·凯尔的私人机甲，氏族入侵期间他把自己原厂的ARC-2R升级为回收的星盟系统与打捞来的氏族系统。使用氏族级LRM-20和双重散热器省出重量用于更多装甲、更多LRM弹药、阿尔忒弥斯IV、CASE以及头部的氏族主动探测器，以增强其指挥能力。特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.12

column1: One of the personal 'Mechs used by Colonel Marco Rubinsky, the leader of the mercenary band Rubinsky’s Light Horse. Focused mainly on the defense off himself from ambushes and assassination attempts, the Mech replaces the long range capabilities of the LRM launchers with SRM ones and carries a hatchet. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 这是雇佣兵团体鲁宾斯基轻骑兵首领马可·鲁宾斯基上校使用的私人机甲之一。它主要着眼于保护自己免遭伏击与刺杀，把LRM发射器的远程能力换成SRM，并携带一把斧头。特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.1

column1: A another modification made to allow the Archer to defend itself more easily against an enemy that managed to close range with it. Built for House Steiner in 2915 Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 这是为了让弓箭手更容易抵御逼近的敌人而做的另一项改装。2915年为斯坦纳家族建造 特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.08

column1: Carrying a pair of SRM-4s in place of two medium lasers, this was the trademark variant used by the Wolf's Dragoons, which they produced in the assembly plant aboard their space station Hephaestos until its destruction in 3028. It was once stated by Jaime Wolf that all of the Dragoons' Archers were of this variant. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 它以两具SRM-4取代两门中型激光器，是狼族龙骑兵的标志性改型，他们曾在其太空站赫菲斯托斯上的装配厂生产该型号，直到该厂于3028年被摧毁。海梅·沃夫曾说过，龙骑兵所有的弓箭手都是这个改型。特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.08

column1: The 4M variant of the Archer was built using rediscovered Star League technology. A contemporary of 'Mechs such as the Thunderbolt and the Banshee, the Archer's primary role was fire support Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 弓箭手的4M改型采用重新发现的星盟科技建造。作为雷霆与女妖等机甲的同时代产物，弓箭手的主要角色是火力支援 特质: 指挥机甲 投放成本倍率: 1.1

column1: Personal 'Mech of Lieutenant James Ismail of the Lexington Combat Group's 180th Dragoon Combat Group has been refit for close combat. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 这是列克星敦战斗群第一八〇龙骑兵战斗群詹姆斯·伊斯梅尔中尉的私人机甲，已为混战改装。特质: 指挥机甲 投放成本倍率: 1.1

column1: A Clan Buster upgrade, the Archer 5CS was a Comstar prototype rushed into production specifically to outfit units that would be fighting on Tukayyid. Designed to carry as much firepower as possible, a combination of a 280-rated XL Engine, Endo Steel chassis and DHS free up the tonnage need to mount 4 LRM-15’s with an Artemis IV FCS. A pair of Medium Lasers are retained should enemies close on the Archer. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 作为一款“灭族者”升级，弓箭手5CS是康星的原型，专门赶工投产，用以装备将在图卡伊德作战的部队。它以尽可能多的火力为设计目标，280级XL引擎、内层钢底盘与双重散热器的组合腾出了安装4具LRM-15（带阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统）所需的吨位。若敌人逼近，它还保留了一对中型激光器。特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.1

column1: The -5KH is a clan tech refit of the -5R chassis by the mercenary outfit the Kell Hounds with the goal of strengthening it's long-range capabilities by mounting two LRM-20 as its main weaponry. The addition of four medium lasers give some closer range protection, and more armor plating has been added to improve the battlefield endurance. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: -5KH是雇佣兵部队凯尔猎犬对-5R底盘所做的氏族科技改装，目标是通过装两具LRM-20作为主武器来强化其远程能力。新增的四门中型激光器提供一些近距离防护，另加装了更多装甲板以提升战场续航力。特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.16

column1: Built by the GKT Enterprise factory on Satalice for the Free Rasalhague Republic, the 5R was introduced in 3050 and bore similarities to the 2K model of the Archer. It carried a pair of FarFire LRM-15 launchers but mounted two Victory Nickel Alloy ER Large Lasers, one in either arm, in place of the medium lasers. It also linked Artemis IV fire control systems to the launchers and utilized twelve double heat sinks to improve waste heat dissipation. Despite being built around an Endo-Steel chassis, these improvements necessitated a decrease in armor protection by two tons. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 为自由拉萨尔哈格共和国建造，5R由萨塔利斯上的GKT企业工厂生产，于3050年推出，与弓箭手的2K型号有相似之处。它携带两具法火LRM-15发射器，却以两门胜利镍合金增程大型激光器（双臂各一门）取代中型激光器。它还为发射器接上了阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统，并使用十二具双重散热器以改善废热散发。尽管以内层钢底盘建造，这些改进仍迫使装甲防护减少两吨。特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.1

column1: The 5S variant of the Archer, built out of Defiance Industries' massive Hesperus II complex in 3050, was the official variant for the Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth. The 5S upgraded the engine to an Edasich Motors 280 XL Engine, cutting the engine's weight in half while retaining the same speed profile. The 5S also reduced the LRM-20 launchers to LRM-15s. This saved weight was used to add two Coventry T4H Streak SRM-2 launchers, one in each arm and fed by two tons of reloads in the side torsos. They also upgraded the four medium lasers to Medium Pulse Lasers. Finally, the 'Mech carried a Doering Electronics Glowworm Narc Missile Beacon launcher in its left torso along with one ton of ammo. This allowed the Archer to tag enemy units with a beacon so that friendly 'Mechs could more easily hit the unit with their own missile weapons. All of the ammunition carried by the 5S was protected by CASE. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 弓箭手的5S改型于3050年由反抗工业庞大的赫斯佩鲁斯II厂区产出，是联邦太阳武装部队的官方改型。5S把引擎升级为一台埃达西奇动力280 XL引擎，在保持相同速度表现的同时把引擎重量减半。5S还把LRM-20发射器缩减为LRM-15。省出的重量用于加装两具考文垂T4H连发SRM-2发射器，双臂各一，由侧躯干的两吨备用弹供弹。他们还把四门中型激光器升级为中型脉冲激光器。最后，该机甲在左躯干携带一具多林电子萤火虫Narc导弹信标发射器配一吨弹药。这让弓箭手能用信标标记敌方单位，使友军机甲更容易用自己的导弹武器命中该单位。5S携带的所有弹药都由CASE保护。特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.1

column1: The 5W was an upgrade of the 2W variant, and was produced for the Wolf's Dragoons by Bowie Industries at Alarion. This was done in an orbital 'Mech repair facility which was converted into a 'Mech assembly line. Introduced in 3050, the 'Mech was upgraded with an XL Engine to save weight and used ten double heat sinks for greater heat dissipation. It retained the two LRM-20 launchers but replaced all other weaponry with one TharHes Blue SRM-4 launchers in each arm and a Doering Electronics Glowworm Narc Missile Beacon launcher in the center torso. The 5W was supplied with four tons of LRM reloads, two tons of SRM reloads, and two tons of Narc reloads, all carried in the CASE-protected side torsos. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 5W是2W改型的升级版，由鲍伊工业在阿拉里昂为狼族龙骑兵生产。这项工作在一处轨道机甲维修设施中完成，该设施被改造成了机甲装配线。5W于3050年推出，升级了XL引擎以减轻重量，并使用十具双重散热器以增强散热。它保留两具LRM-20发射器，但把其他所有武器换成双臂各一具塔尔赫斯蓝SRM-4发射器，以及中央躯干一具多林电子萤火虫Narc导弹信标发射器。5W配备四吨LRM备用弹、两吨SRM备用弹和两吨Narc备用弹，全部装在CASE保护的侧躯干中。特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.1

column1: The -5WDR is a mercenary full clan tech refit of the -5R initially introduced by the Wolf's Dragoons. Using an XL clan engine allows the mounting of four Artemis IV-enabled LRM-15 launchers and four ER Medium Lasers, combined with two Small Pulse Lasers for close range, leading to high damage capabilities. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: -5WDR是雇佣兵对-5R的全氏族科技改装，最初由狼族龙骑兵推出。使用氏族XL引擎使机甲得以装下四具带阿尔忒弥斯IV的LRM-15发射器和四门增程中型激光器，再加两门小型脉冲激光器用于近距离，带来极高的伤害能力。特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.16

column1: Rather than a refit of the -6S or the -6W, the -6WDR is actually a refresh of the -5WDR by the mercenary outfit the Wolf's Dragoons. Removing the two seldom used Small Pulse Lasers allows the use of an Armored Cowl and one more heat sink. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: -6WDR并非对-6S或-6W的改装，实际上它是雇佣兵部队狼族龙骑兵对-5WDR的翻新版。拆除两门很少使用的小型脉冲激光器，得以使用一顶装甲罩壳和额外一具散热器。特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.1

column1: The Archer 8L is a prototype chassis designed to provide fire support with 2 Arrow IV Launchers loaded with Incendiary Missiles and the newly developed Guardian ECM and Stealth Armor. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12
column2: 弓箭手8L是一种原型底盘，旨在以2具装填燃烧弹的箭矢IV发射器，加上新研发的守卫者ECM与隐形装甲，提供火力支援。特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.12

column1: The Agincourt is armed with a medium laser and a SRM-6 in each arm with two tons of ammo for the SRM-6's, A Streak SRM-2 and a LRM-10 are equipped in each side torso with two ton of reloads for the Streak SRM-2's and two tons of reloads for the LRM-10's, a Beagle Active Probe is additionally mounted in the left torso, two Medium Pulse Lasers are mounted in the center torso, and fourteen double heat sinks keep the 'Mech cool. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12
column2: 阿金库尔双臂各装一门中型激光器和一具SRM-6，并为SRM-6配两吨弹药；两侧躯干各装一具连发SRM-2和一具LRM-10，连发SRM-2与LRM-10各配两吨备用弹；左躯干另装一个比格犬主动探测器，中央躯干装两门中型脉冲激光器，十四具双重散热器让机甲保持凉爽。特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.12

column1: A contemporary of 'Mechs such as the Thunderbolt and the Banshee, the Archer's primary role was fire support. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 作为雷霆与女妖等机甲的同时代产物，弓箭手的主要角色是火力支援。特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.08

column1: Named for Morgan Kell's pirate lover, the -2T Tempest is identical to the standard ARC-2R in most respects. The use of an Endo Steel frame frees up the weight for a Guardian ECM suite and two extra heat sinks, all of which are upgraded to double heat sinks boosting the Tempest's endurance. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12
column2: 以摩根·凯尔的海盗情人命名，-2T暴风在大多数方面与标准ARC-2R相同。采用内层钢框架省出的重量用于一套守卫者ECM套件和两具额外散热器，所有散热器都升级为双重散热器，提升了暴风的续航力。特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.12

column1: This variant of the Archer carried Clan-spec equipment. The arms mounted ER Large Lasers, while a pair of Small Pulse Lasers covered the rear. The LRM-20s were enhanced with Artemis IV Fire Control Systems, and an ECM Suite and AMS protected against incoming fire. Fifteen double heat sinks kept the 'Mech cool. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 弓箭手的这一改型携带氏族规格装备。双臂装增程大型激光器，一对小型脉冲激光器掩护后方。LRM-20由阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统增强，另有一套ECM套件和AMS防御来袭火力。十五具双重散热器让机甲保持凉爽。特质: 指挥机甲 投放成本倍率: 1.18

column1: Archer IIC
column2: 弓箭手 IIC

column1: A clan update of the Archer rarely seen due to not performing as well as expected. The philosophy of the design is to create the optimal support heavy for indirect fire, mounting four Artemis IV-enabled LRM-20 launchers. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: 这是弓箭手的一种氏族升级版，因表现不如预期而罕见。该设计的理念是打造最优的间接火力重型支援机甲，装有四具带阿尔忒弥斯IV的LRM-20发射器。特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.14

column1: Keeping the top speed of the ASN-21 as well as its base weapon load of missiles, the ASN-101 is a rare Federated Suns variant that drops two jump jets and a half ton of armor to mount a trio of Small Lasers, giving the ASN-101 a much better close-in punch compared to its progenitor. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: ASN-101保留了ASN-21的最高速度及其以导弹为基础的基础武器载荷，是联邦太阳的一种稀有改型。它拆掉两个跳跃推进器和半吨装甲，以安装三兄弟小型激光器，使其相比前身拥有好得多的近距离打击力。特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1 手臂驱动器限制: 右下

column1: Assassin was designed to complete against the lighter scout mechs like the Wasp and Stinger but is twice as heavy, faster, greater jump range, heavier armor and much more firepower. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 刺客的设计初衷是与黄蜂、毒刺这类更轻的侦察机甲竞争，但它的重量是它们的两倍，速度更快、跳跃距离更远、装甲更厚、火力也强得多。特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1 手臂驱动器限制: 右下

column1: The -23 variant of the Assassin is an upgrade of the original model using Lostech; originally seen as a standardized field modification, in 3067 new production began at Hellespont 'Mech Works. The SRM-2 has been removed to upgrade the Medium Laser to a Medium Pulse Laser and an Artemis IV fire control system has been added for the LRM-5 launcher. Within the CCAF, TDF and MAF it is largely used as a cheap way to rebuild shattered forces and sees service mostly in green and reserve formations. The Capellans in particular use the -23 as a fire-support unit for pursuit and strike lances, though shortages of Artemis munitions means many are forced to use mine-delivery missiles. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 刺客的-23改型是使用失传科技对原始型号的升级；它最初被视为一种标准化的战地改装，3067年由赫勒斯滂机甲厂开始新生产。它拆掉SRM-2，把中型激光器升级为中型脉冲激光器，并为LRM-5发射器加装阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统。在CCAF、TDF与MAF中，它主要被用作重建残破部队的廉价手段，多服役于新兵与预备编队。卡佩兰人尤其把-23用作追击与打击分队的火力支援单位，不过阿尔忒弥斯弹药短缺意味着许多单位被迫使用布雷导弹。特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.02 手臂驱动器限制: 右下

column1: Introduced in 3026 to tap into the rise of interest in melee weapons, the ASN-25 retains the right arm's medium laser, but replaces the remaining weaponry with a right torso-mounted medium laser and left torso-mounted small laser, the weight saved to mount a medium claw in the left arm. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: ASN-25于3026年推出，以迎合近战武器兴趣的兴起，它保留右臂的中型激光器，但把其余武器换成右躯干一门中型激光器和左躯干一门小型激光器，省出的重量用于在左臂装一只中型爪。特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1 手臂驱动器限制: 右下

column1: A 3050's tech version of the -30, the -26 also uses an endo steel chassis but mounts an XL engine, the extra weight saved allowing the 'Mech to carry an UAC/5 and a pair of medium pulse lasers for offensive armament. Field endurance is limited however, as six and half tons of armor provided basic protection, and a single ton of autocannon reloads are chewed through rapidly. The 10 double heat sinks struggle to manage heat strain. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 作为-30的3050年代技术版本，-26同样采用内层钢底盘，但装一具XL引擎，省出的额外重量让该机甲能携带一门UAC/5和一对中型脉冲激光器作为进攻武备。然而其战场续航力有限：六吨半装甲只提供基础防护，而一吨自动炮备用弹很快就会被消耗殆尽。10具双重散热器很吃力地应对热应力。特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.02 手臂驱动器限制: 右下

column1: A 3050 era take on -99, the -27 drops the sword to upgrade the light PPC to a full size PPC thanks to the use of endo steel, retaining the Guardian ECM suite but replacing the stealth armor with an equal volume of standard armor. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 作为-99的3050年代演绎，-27拆掉长剑，借内层钢之利把轻型PPC升级为全尺寸PPC，保留守卫者ECM套件，但把隐形装甲换成等体积的标准装甲。特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.02 手臂驱动器限制: 右下

column1: Assassin was designed to complete against the lighter scout mechs like the Wasp and Stinger but is twice as heavy, faster, greater jump range, heavier armor and much more firepower. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 刺客的设计初衷是与黄蜂、毒刺这类更轻的侦察机甲竞争，但它的重量是它们的两倍，速度更快、跳跃距离更远、装甲更厚、火力也强得多。特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.02 手臂驱动器限制: 右下

column1: Supposedly the custom Assassin that Dale Sandstrom piloted, this DarkDeath is built around a 280-rated XL engine on endo steel chassis, and is armed with an AC/2 in the right arm, twin LRM-5s in right torso, and a pair of medium lasers split between head and left torso. Retaining the ASN-21's seven jump jets, that variant's single heat sinks are also upgraded to double strength versions. Though carrying only a single ton of autocannon and LRM reloads limits it field endurance, DarkDeath mounts a Guardian ECM suite to help ensure the fight is on its terms. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这台“暗死”据称是戴尔·桑德斯特罗姆驾驶的定制刺客，它以内层钢底盘上的280级XL引擎为核心建造，武装为右臂一门AC/2、右躯干两具LRM-5，以及分装于头部与左躯干的一对中型激光器。它保留ASN-21的七个跳跃推进器，该改型原本的单重散热器也升级为双倍强度型号。虽然只带一吨自动炮和LRM备用弹限制了它的战场续航力，暗死装有守卫者ECM套件，有助于确保战斗按其节奏进行。特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制: 右下

column1: A 95-ton Assault 'Mech of unknown origin, the Bull Shark was originally discovered aboard an abandoned jump ship named Dobrev. Since then, the design has been studied and copied by Majesty Metals and Manufacturing within the Inner Sphere. The BSK-1 is mostly faithful to the original 'Mech, though it lacks the iconic artillery piece and standardizes the weapons selection for a more consistent range. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 作为一台来历不明的95吨突击机甲，牛鲨最初是在一艘名为多布雷夫的废弃跃迁舰上被发现的。此后，该设计在内天体被至尊金属制造公司研究并仿制。BSK-1大体忠于原始机甲，只是缺少那件标志性的火炮，并把武器选择标准化以获得更一致的射程。特质: 威吓 投放成本倍率: 1.17 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

column1: A 95-ton Mech, the Bullshark was recovered from the wreck of the Jump Ship Dobrev and schematics were later acquired by Majesty Metals which produced the Mech in limited quantities. The difficulty in sourcing parts and the hand built nature of each Bullshark would limit it to a mere 2 dozen examples, most of which served with the Magistracy Armed Forces. The unveiling of the Helm Core and subsequent Clan Invasion signaled the end of the Bullshark, with Majesty Metals reallocating resources to more profitable projects. The Bullshark M3 is a Juggernaut, built around a 190-rated Fusion Core and armed with paired AC/10s and AC/5s. Quad Medium Lasers and LRM-5s round out the design. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 作为一台95吨机甲，牛鲨是从跃迁舰多布雷夫的残骸中回收的，其图纸后来被至尊金属获得，后者限量生产了该机甲。由于零件难以采购、每台牛鲨都是手工打造，其产量仅有两打左右，大多服役于治安官辖区武装部队。亥姆核心的公开与随后的氏族入侵标志着牛鲨的终结，至尊金属把资源重新分配到更赚钱的项目上。牛鲨M3是一台巨无霸，围绕一具190级聚变核心建造，武装为成对的AC/10和AC/5。四门中型激光器和LRM-5补全该设计。特质: 威吓 投放成本倍率: 1.15 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

column1: Entering production in 2519 the FLE-14 Flea was an attempt to create an ultra-light BattleMech. Weighing a mere fifteen tons, it could arguably be regarded as a different 'Mech design than the true Flea. It was capable of a maximum ground speed of nearly 150 km/h with a 120 meter jump capability. Its weapons and armor however were very light: Only one ton of armor protected the unit, and the single Medium Laser mounted in the right arm was barely enough to make it a viable battlefield unit. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: FLE-14跳蚤于2519年投产，是一次打造超轻型战斗机甲的尝试。它仅重十五吨，可以说已算是一种不同于真正跳蚤的机甲设计。它最高地面速度接近150公里/小时，跳跃能力120米。但它的武器与装甲都非常轻薄：只有一吨装甲保护该单位，右臂那唯一一门中型激光器勉强让它成为可用的战场单位。特质: 改进生命维持 投放成本倍率: 0.97

column1: One of two common refits for the FLE-14 ultralight scout, the -14B replaces one of the jump jets with slightly more armor and a rocket launcher. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: 作为FLE-14超轻型侦察机甲两种常见改装之一，-14B把一个跳跃推进器换成稍多一些的装甲和一具火箭发射器。特质: 改进生命维持 投放成本倍率: 0.97

column1: A common refit of the FLE-14, dropping one of the jump jets to mount more armor. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: 这是FLE-14的常见改装，拆掉一个跳跃推进器以加装更多装甲。特质: 改进生命维持 投放成本倍率: 0.97

column1: An expensive mech that is good against other 20-ton mechs and infantry but not able to stand up to any major threat from larger mechs. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 一台昂贵的机甲，对付其他20吨机甲与步兵不错，但无力抵挡更大机甲带来的任何重大威胁。特质: 改进生命维持 投放成本倍率: 0.95 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

column1: A refitted version of the Flea FLE-15 fielded by the Wolf's Dragoons in their attempts to not look inconspicuous with all the for Inner Sphere advanced and unknown 'Mechs. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是狼族龙骑兵使用的跳蚤FLE-15改装版，为的是不让他们带着一堆内天体先进且未知的机甲显得那么扎眼。特质: 改进生命维持 投放成本倍率: 1.03 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

column1: Built as part of the Wolf's Dragoons exclusive contract with Earthwerks Incorporated to replenish the Dragoon's losses at the end of the Fourth Succession War, alongside renewed production of original Fleas, the FLE-16 was the first new production model of the extremely rare 'Mech in centuries. The variant remedied the earlier FLE-14's weaknesses by combining incredible speed with additional armor and weaponry on a 20 ton chassis. The engine was upgraded to a GM 180 in order to reach a similar maximum ground speed of nearly 150 km/h. It mounts two Medium Lasers and an Flamer while retaining an armor profile like the earlier FLE-15. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 作为狼族龙骑兵与厄斯沃克斯公司独家合约的一部分——该合约旨在第四次继承战争结束时补充龙骑兵的损失——FLE-16伴随原版跳蚤的恢复生产而诞生，是这种极为稀有机甲数百年来首个新量产型号。该改型通过在20吨底盘上结合惊人的速度与额外装甲和武器，弥补了早期FLE-14的弱点。引擎升级为GM 180以达到接近150公里/小时的相近最高地面速度。它装有两门中型激光器和一具火焰喷射器，同时保持与早期FLE-15相似的装甲配置。特质: 改进生命维持 投放成本倍率: 0.95 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

column1: Originally produced exclusively for the Dragoons until the Capellan Confederation acquired the design's blueprints via a Maskirovka raid during the 3040s, the post-Helm Memory Core FLE-17 variant is based on the older FLE-15 model. Since the Dragoons used the Flea in a recon role more than an antipersonnel 'Mech, Earthwerks conceived a new design by incorporating recovered technology. Retaining the design's maximum speed of 97.2 km/h, the addition of an Endo Steelchassis frees up weight for a MASC system that allows the 'Mech's speed to be pushed up to 129.6 km/h in short bursts. The increase of speed is required to ensure survival on the modern battlefield, as the FLE-17 is only clad in a pitiful three tons of Livingston Ceramics armor plating. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 该型号最初只为龙骑兵独家生产，直到卡佩兰联邦在3040年代通过一次伪装局突袭获得其图纸；亥姆记忆核心之后的FLE-17改型以较老的FLE-15为基础。由于龙骑兵更多把跳蚤用于侦察而非反人员，厄斯沃克斯通过引入回收技术构想出新设计。它保留该设计97.2公里/小时的最高速度，加入内层钢底盘省出的重量用于一套MASC系统，使机甲速度可在短时冲刺中推高到129.6公里/小时。这种提速对于在现代战场上存活是必要的，因为FLE-17只披挂着可怜的三吨利文斯顿陶瓷装甲板。特质: 改进生命维持 投放成本倍率: 0.97 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上
