column1: Originally developed by Luthien Armor Works as a cheap but durable garrison unit, the Kumazemi entered production after a brief test period showing promising results. Its name, meaning "bear cicada", is a nod to both its imposing bulk and to some borrowed design elements from the venerable Cicada chassis. Initially fielded exclusively within Combine garrison units, limited export agreements have made the Kumazemi an increasingly more common sight among both Inner Sphere and Periphery garrisons, as well as the occasional mercenary command.
column2: Kumazemi最初由Luthien Armor Works研发，定位为廉价而耐用的守备单位，经过一段短暂的测试期显示出可喜成果后投产。它的名字意为“熊蝉”，既指其庞大的体型，也致敬了它从历史悠久的蝉式底盘上借鉴的一些设计元素。最初Kumazemi只在联合体的守备部队中装备，有限的出口协议让它在内天体和外围区的守备部队中越来越常见，偶尔也会出现在佣兵部队里。

column1: Named for the demonic wolf of Germanic myth, the Fenrir was less a traditional battle suit and more a mobile fire support platform. The trooper controlling the suit was situated inside a cramped "cockpit" and piloted the Fenrir like a small walking tank. The single, configurable turret mounted on the suit could accept a wide variety of weapon configurations and the Fenrir's sturdy, powerful legs could propel it to much greater speeds than the Sloth.
column2: Fenrir以日耳曼神话中的魔狼命名，与其说它是一套传统战斗装甲，不如说是一台移动式火力支援平台。操控这套装甲的士兵坐在一个狭窄的“驾驶舱”里，像驾驶一台小型步行坦克那样操控Fenrir。装甲上那具可配置的单炮塔能适配多种武器配置，而Fenrir结实有力的双腿能让它达到远超Sloth的速度。

You watch from a viewscreen as [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], in EVA suit, struggles with the low gravity and the oxygen hose anchoring {SCN_MW.OBJ} to the Argo. "Less than 10% of the bolts were replaced." She sighs. "We will need to be vigilent until we can exact proper replacement of the remaining bolts."

把[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]的住处移到军官区附近，不仅让{TGT_MW.OBJ}与船员们有了更多往来，也让这位幸运的机甲战士得到了{TGT_MW.SUBJ}想要的独处空间。

Yang chimes in. "Yeah, and then {TGT_MW.Subj_C}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'re|Default:} showed up in the Mech Bay. It only took a few minutes for {TGT_MW.Callsign} to figure out what was wrong with one of my winches."

Finally, Darius notices you standing in the doorway and explains. "Commander, we have to do something special for {TGT_MW.Callsign}. {TGT_MW.Subj_C}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'re|Default:'s} the most helpful member on the ship!"

column1: You and Darius head over to the Infirmary, where you are stopped by a nurse outside the entrance, "May I assist you?," the nurse asks. Darius steps forward, "My Commander was one of the combatants in that duel, and wished to speak with the opponent he faced." The nurse types in some information into the computer, "Yes, they are in exam room C." The nurse points at the palm scanner, "Place your hand there to sign in, then go through the doors to the 3rd room on the left." You follow the directions given and arrive with Darius at the room. Seated on the exam table is the MechWarrior you fought with freshly applied bandages covering parts of their body. You look your former opponent in the eyes, "You fought valiantly MechWarrior Mychel, and I now claim you as my [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBondswoman],bondswoman]]. You will wear this [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBondcord],bondcord]] until you have sufficently demonstrated all three virtues: combat talent, integrity and loyalty." You reach foward and attach the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBondcord],bondcord]] to MechWarrior Mychel's right wrist, "With this [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBondcord],bondcord]], I claim you as [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBondswoman],bondswoman]]." MechWarrior Mychel will meet you in the barracks.
column2: 你和达里乌斯前往医务室，在入口处被一名护士拦下：“需要我帮忙吗？”护士问道。 达里乌斯上前一步：“我的指挥官是那场决斗的参战者之一，他想和当时的对手谈一谈。” 护士在电脑里输入了一些信息：“是的，他们在C检查室。”护士指了指掌纹扫描仪：“把手放在那里登记，然后穿过大门，走到左侧第三间房。” 你按照指示前行，与达里乌斯一同来到那间房。检查台上坐着与你交手的那名机甲战士，身上新包扎的绷带覆盖着部分躯体。 你直视昔日对手的双眼：“你战斗得十分英勇，机甲战士米切尔，现在我宣布你为我的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBondswoman],女契约奴]]。你将佩戴这条[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBondcord],契约绳]]，直到你充分展现出全部三项美德：战斗才能、正直与忠诚。” 你伸手向前，把[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBondcord],契约绳]]系到机甲战士米切尔的右腕上：“凭这条[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBondcord],契约绳]]，我宣布你为我的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBondswoman],女契约奴]]。” 机甲战士米切尔将在营房与你会合。

column1: Derided by critics and loved by it’s crews, the 25 ton Venator is a VTOL designed to hunt tanks. Slower then other contemporary VTOL’s, the low cost Venator makes up for it’s slower speed by mounting an AC/10 or a large missile launcher, giving it exceptionally heavy firepower for it’s small size. Produced by a handful of companies in the Periphery, the Venator is a common sight on the battlefields of the Periphery where it is often fielded in large quantities. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 7/11 hexes / 210/330 meters. column1:
Relax, MechWarrior…

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] slowly turns, visibly avoiding any sudden movement.

"If you're wondering how you're going to get back in that 'Mech again, reliving the moment won't help. I take it resting in the MedBay isn't working for you either?"

{TGT_MW.Callsign} hesitates before nodding silently.

"We're orbiting one of the most popular recreation planets in the Periphery, according to their hardworking Tourism Bureau. I'm sending you down there to recuperate. Darius will find a facility that can tend to your rehabilitation in more pleasant surroundings. Get better."

It's always a roll of the dice on how a MechWarrior will come out of an injury like this. Time will tell.
column2:
“放轻松，机甲战士……”

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]缓缓转过身来，明显在避免任何突然的动作。

“如果你在想自己怎样才能重新坐进那台机甲，重温那一刻是帮不上忙的。我猜，待在医疗舱里对你也没什么用吧？”

{TGT_MW.Callsign}犹豫了一下，然后默默地点了点头。

“我们正环绕着边境星域最热门的度假星球之一飞行——这是他们勤勉的旅游局自己说的。我打算送你下去休养。达里乌斯会找一家设施，让你在更舒适的环境里接受康复治疗。快点好起来。”

机甲战士从这样的伤势中恢复后会变成什么样，从来都是掷骰子听天由命。时间会给出答案。

column1: Ubiquitous across the Inner Sphere, the Igor is a name given to a generic super heavy lift platform. Originally developed to rapidly relocate heavy armor under battlefield conditions, the design has since spawned a host of imitators and copy cats with almost every developed world in the Inner Sphere and the Periphery possessing at least one Igor or Igor derived clone. An FWL combat model of the 60 ton VTOL, the Igor (L-Gauss) mounts a pair of Light Gauss Rifles and a C3 Slave unit. A combination of an XL Engine and Ferro-Fibrous armor boosts the VTOL’s speed and protection. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 7/11 hexes / 210/330 meters. column1: The Mobile Long Tom was essentially an artillery piece on tracks. The purpose of this entire convoy of vehicles was to move one weapon: a Long Tom Artillery Piece. The artillery piece was capable of extremely long range fire more suited to demolishing defensive fortifications than firing into a firefight. The only short-range weapons were four, side-mounted Machine Guns that were more suited to anti-infantry than anti-'Mech duty. column1:
With a heavy heart, you sigh loudly as you survey the damage, "Darius, tell the MedTechs they are to do their utmost to save all three MechWarriors.  Give priority to [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]."

Darius nods, "Yes, Commander."

Yang approaches, an angry look on his face, "Boss, we lost a few asTechs in that accident.  Four anchor bolts on the cargo door, improperly installed, appears to be the point of failure," he hisses.  "Totally Boeing Interstellar's fault and their damned shortcuts!"  

Your jaw tightens, "We need a full report on the damage,  Every bolt, every rivet checked!”  

The sad truth is this could have been avoided. Boeing Interstellar's negligence had nearly cost them their lives.
column2:
你心情沉重，一边查看损坏情况一边大声叹了口气，“达里乌斯，告诉医疗技师们，要尽一切努力保住这三名机甲战士。优先救治 [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] 和 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]。”

达里乌斯点点头，“是，指挥官。”

杨走了过来，脸上带着怒容，“老板，那场事故里我们损失了几名技工。货舱门的四颗锚栓安装不当，看起来就是失效点，”他咬着牙说。“全是波音星际公司的错，还有他们那该死的偷工减料！”

你咬紧牙关，“我们需要一份关于损坏的完整报告，每一颗螺栓、每一颗铆钉都要检查过！”

令人痛心的事实是，这本可以避免。波音星际公司的疏忽几乎要了他们的命。

column1: The Apollo is designed to be a long range fire support BattleMech. This is accomplished by mounting an engine on the 'Mech that gives it a top speed of only 64.8 km/h and eleven and a half tons of armor. The 'Mech was then armed with massive missile launchers which can rain destruction down on an enemy. While the Apollo has less than average speed for a medium 'Mech, if it is employed correctly the Apollo should have nothing to fear from enemy fire; it is fully capable of staying at the edge of the battlefield and laying down suppressive LRM fire.
column2: 阿波罗被设计为一款远程火力支援战斗机甲。实现的方式是为机甲装上一台最高速度仅 64.8 公里/小时的引擎和 11.5 吨装甲，然后为它配备巨型导弹发射器，让毁灭如雨点般倾泻到敌人头上。虽然阿波罗的速度低于中型机甲的平均水平，但只要使用得当，阿波罗就无需惧怕敌方火力；它完全有能力待在战场边缘，持续输出压制性的 LRM 弹幕。

column1:
With a heavy heart, you sigh loudly as you survey the damage, "Darius, tell the MedTechs they are to do their utmost to save all three MechWarriors.  Give priority to [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]."

Darius nods, "Yes, Commander."

Yang approaches, an angry look on his face, "Boss, we lost a few asTechs in that accident.  Four anchor bolts on the cargo door, improperly installed, appears to be the point of failure," he hisses.  "Totally Boeing Interstellar's fault and their damned shortcuts!"  

Your jaw tightens, "We need a full report on the damage,  Every bolt, every rivet checked!”  

The sad truth is this could have been avoided. Boeing Interstellar's negligence had nearly cost them their lives.
column2:
你心情沉重，一边查看损坏情况一边大声叹了口气，“达里乌斯，告诉医疗技师们，要尽一切努力保住这三名机甲战士。优先救治 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 和 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]。”

达里乌斯点点头，“是，指挥官。”

杨走了过来，脸上带着怒容，“老板，那场事故里我们损失了几名技工。货舱门的四颗锚栓安装不当，看起来就是失效点，”他咬着牙说。“全是波音星际公司的错，还有他们那该死的偷工减料！”

你咬紧牙关，“我们需要一份关于损坏的完整报告，每一颗螺栓、每一颗铆钉都要检查过！”

令人痛心的事实是，这本可以避免。波音星际公司的疏忽几乎要了他们的命。

column1:
I suppose that was in storage for a reason, so we can afford to lose it if things go wrong. Just be careful. These weapons are meant to destroy 'Mechs, after all.

Later that week, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] catches you in the hall, but doesn't look you in the eyes.

"Commander, I'm sorry to report that I wasn't able to modify that weapon like I wanted to. And…" {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:struggle|Default:struggles} to continue. "I wasn't able to put it back together again. I already told the Chief and he raked me over the coals. No more than I deserve, though."
column2:
“我想那东西被收进仓库是有原因的，所以就算出了岔子，我们也损失得起。只是要小心一点。毕竟这些武器是用来摧毁机甲的。”

那一周晚些时候，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 在走廊里拦住了你，却不敢直视你的眼睛。

“指挥官，很抱歉向您报告，我没能按自己的设想去改造那件武器。而且……”{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:挣扎|Default:挣扎}着想继续说下去。“我没能把它重新装回去。我已经告诉总机械师了，被他狠狠训了一顿。不过那也是我活该。”

column1:

Later that week, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] catches you in the hall, glowing with excitement.

"I did it, Commander! That locust is a LOT deadlier now. Well, in the hands of a mech that wants to clobber other 'Mechs. I welded the legs together, removed the weapons and other gear and then filled all the empty spaces with scrap metal to bring it back to 20 tons.  I call it the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[BaseDesc_Special_Mace_Locust],Locust Stick]]."
column2:
“我想那东西被收进仓库是有原因的，所以试试你的点子也许无妨。只是要小心一点。它可能只是一台 20 吨的机甲，但并不是一文不值。”

那一周晚些时候，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 在走廊里拦住了你，兴奋得满脸放光。

“我成功了，指挥官！那台蝗虫现在致命多了。嗯，在一个想抡起家伙砸别的机甲的机师手里的话。我把它的腿焊在一起，拆掉了武器和其他装备，然后往所有空位里填满废金属，让它重新回到 20 吨。我叫它 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[BaseDesc_Special_Mace_Locust],蝗虫棒]]。”

column1: Miranda Aguilera grew up in the Lyran Commonwealth. She was a tall kid who made a name for herself as 'the girl you don't mess with'. At eighteen, she signed up with a small-time mercenary company to feed her growing wanderlust. Miranda went undefeated in her crew's drinking games - and in the brawling that usually followed. When her fellow mercenaries turned to piracy, she was in. When they turned over a new leaf, she was out, and looking for a tougher crew.\n\n
column2: 米兰达·阿吉莱拉在莱兰联邦长大。她是个高个子孩子，以“别惹那个女孩”而小有名气。十八岁那年，她加入了一家小型雇佣兵公司，以满足自己日益膨胀的流浪欲望。在同伴的饮酒游戏中，米兰达从未输过——在随之而来的斗殴中也是如此。当她的雇佣兵同伴转向海盗行当时，她加入了；当他们洗心革面时，她退出了，并开始寻找一支更难对付的队伍。\n\n

"Less than 10% of the bolts were replaced." She sighs. "We will need to be vigilant until we can exact proper replacement of the remaining bolts."

On {SCN_MW.Callsign}'s last EVA to replace the remaining bolts, you learn that {SCN_MW.Callsign} was injured when a bolt shot out and punctured their suit. You visit {SCN_MW.OBJ} in the MedBay. "You did some amazing work out there, {SCN_MW.Callsign}," you say. "Anyone else would have hesitated in a situation like that, fearful that the whole hatch would blow out. I've already punished the crew responsible for not having that section depressurized in advance of your repair work." You hand {SCN_MW.Obj} the bolt they removed during surgery, conveniently made into a necklace.
column2: 你让达里乌斯从 [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] 购买了螺栓，它们随下一班空投艇送到。你从显示屏上看着身穿 EVA 服的 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 灵活地飘过空投艇皱褶的船壳。{SCN_MW.Callsign} 娴熟地更换着 阿戈号 号这一段船壳上的众多螺栓。 几个小时后，{SCN_MW.Callsign} 被安全地拉回船内稍作休息。按照这个进度，所有螺栓应该能在几周内全部更换完毕。 在 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 最后一次出舱更换剩余螺栓时，你得知 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 受了伤——一颗螺栓飞射而出，刺穿了宇航服。你在医疗舱探望了 {SCN_MW.OBJ}。“你在外面干得非常出色，{SCN_MW.Callsign}，”你说。“换作别人，在这种情况下都会犹豫，害怕整个舱门会爆开。我已经处罚了那些没有在维修前给该区域减压的责任船员。” 你把手术中取出的那颗螺栓递给 {SCN_MW.Obj}——它已被顺手做成了一条项链。

column1: I thought you trusted me, Commander, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] mutters, visibly sagging, but {SCN_MW.SUBJ} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:drop|Default:drops} the subject as you instruct Darius to organize the repairs.\n\nThankfully, while over-priced, the repair crew are expedient and efficient and waste no time in flying up from [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] to begin replacing all the faulty hatch bolts on the Argo. There are no further issues with the Argo, but you notice {SCN_MW.Callsign} lingering in the observation deck for the next couple of weeks, {SCN_MW.DET} gaze fixed on the view of the Argo's hull. {SCN_MW.DET_C} mind is elsewhere as {SCN_MW.SUBJ} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:attend|Default:attends} to {SCN_MW.DET} daily tasks.
column2: “我以为你是信任我的，指挥官，”[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 低声说道，明显垮了下去，但当 {SCN_MW.SUBJ} 听到你吩咐达里乌斯组织维修时，{SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:放下|Default:放下}了这个话题。\n\n值得庆幸的是，维修队虽然要价过高，但迅速高效，毫不耽搁地从 [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] 飞上来，开始更换 阿戈号 号上所有有缺陷的舱门螺栓。阿戈号 号此后再无问题，但你注意到接下来的几周里 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 常常在观景甲板上逗留，{SCN_MW.DET} 目光紧盯着 阿戈号 号船壳的影像。当 {SCN_MW.SUBJ} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:处理|Default:处理} {SCN_MW.DET} 日常事务时，{SCN_MW.DET_C} 心思却飘在别处。

column1: In the final years of the Star League-in-Exile, SLDF researchers and weapons manufacturers attempted to increase the size of the Streak SRM launchers to include four- and six-missile racks. While they had some limited success, the true breakthroughs would not come until the beginning of the Golden Century, when Clan scientists conquered problems with the Streak targeting and guidance systems in the larger rack sizes. Experimental versions of Streak SRM-4 and -6 racks were available in limited quantities during and immediately after Operation KLONDIKE. \n\nUses Streak SRM Ammo.

column1: Originally built as a new assault class mech by Clan Steel Viper just three years before the introduction of the Omnimech, the Phoenix Hawk IIC is based on the venerable 45 ton Phoenix Hawk but almost twice as heavy at 80 tons. The Phoenix Hawk IIC features as close as possible ground speed and agility to the original Phoenix Hawk making it an effective fast interdiction unit.
column2: 凤凰鹰 IIC 最初是部族钢毒蛇在原生机甲问世仅仅三年前作为一款新式突击级机甲建造的，它以古老的 45 吨凤凰鹰为基础，但重量几乎是其两倍，达到 80 吨。凤凰鹰 IIC 的地面速度与灵活性尽可能接近原版凤凰鹰，使其成为一款有效的快速拦截单位。

column1: A Capellan infantry support variant, the 20 strips a half ton of armor to mount two ER Medium Lasers and a Light PPC. The loss of armor is not seen as a risk, since it is replaced with Stealth Armor, along with the required Guardian ECM Suite.
column2: 作为一款卡佩兰步兵支援改型，“20”型削减了半吨装甲，以安装两门 ER 中型激光和一门轻型 PPC。装甲的减少并不被视为风险，因为它换装了隐形装甲，并配有必需的守护者 ECM 套件。

column1: Developed by Team Banzai as the big brother of the highly successful Hatchetman, the Axman was designed exclusively to be a 'Mech killer. The Axman was also intended as a symbol of solidarity throughout the Federated Commonwealth by using components that were produced in Davion, Steiner, and even former Liao space.

column1: The Scarabus is a 'Mech that was designed to be faster than the Locust, with more firepower. The 'Mech achieves this with a massive 300 XL engine, built on a endo steel chassis. These lightweight technologies allow it to move at a maximum speed of 162 km/h and still have weight left over for heavier weaponry and equipment. To protect its internals and save even more weight, the 'Mech is armored with five and a half tons of Valiant Gauntlet ferro-fibrous armor.
column2: 斯卡拉布斯是一款被设计得比蝗虫更快、火力更强的机甲。它通过一台巨大的 300 XL 引擎实现这一点，并采用内钢骨架。这些轻量化技术使它能够以 162 公里/小时的最高速度移动，同时还有余重安装更重的武器与装备。为保护内部结构并进一步减重，该机甲披挂了 5.5 吨 Valiant Gauntlet 铁纤维。

column1: While in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}, you get a message from the commander of another mercenary company passing through. After some formalities, the message gets straight to the point. "My boys tell me you have [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] on your crew. As one commander to another, I need to tell you {TGT_MW.Callsign} is not a good hire. To be blunt, {TGT_MW.Gender?Male:he's|Female:she's|NonBinary:they're} a thief and a backstabber and only common decency had me leave {TGT_MW.OBJ} on a station instead of booting {TGT_MW.OBJ} through the airlock when I finally fired {TGT_MW.DET} ass. Be careful with your crew and keep in mind that a MechWarrior with a bad reputation can bring down the reputation of your whole outfit."
column2: 在 {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} 逗留期间，你收到了另一支路过此地的雇佣兵公司指挥官发来的信息。一番寒暄过后，信息直入主题。“我的手下告诉我，你的船员里有个叫 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 的。作为一个指挥官对另一个指挥官，我得提醒你，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 不是个好雇员。说得直白点，{TGT_MW.Gender?Male:他是个|Female:她是个|NonBinary:他们是个}小偷，还是个背后捅刀的家伙；我最后炒掉 {TGT_MW.DET} 的时候，仅仅是出于基本的体面才把 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 留在空间站上，而不是把 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 从气闸里扔出去。小心你的船员，记住，一个名声不好的机甲战士会拖垮你整支队伍的名声。”

column1:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] shakes {TGT_MW.DET} head. "None of that's true, but if my old commander is gonna rake me through the mud like this, I don't know how I'd prove it to you."

"You prove things by your actions, {TGT_MW.Callsign}," you say.

"Right, Commander."
column2:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 摇了摇 {TGT_MW.DET} 头。“那些都不是真的，但如果我的老指挥官要这样往我身上泼脏水，我也不知道该怎么向您证明。”

“你要用行动来证明，{TGT_MW.Callsign}，”你说。

“是，指挥官。”

column1: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] clenches {TGT_MW.DET} fists. "I thought I'd finally found a place where I was trusted but I see even here an ex-con can't get a break. Whatever. I get it. You're watching me. Is that all?"
column2: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 攥紧了 {TGT_MW.DET} 拳头。“我以为我终于找到了一个被人信任的地方，可看来就算在这里，一个坐过牢的人也得不到机会。算了。我明白，你在盯着我。就这些吗？”

column1: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] sits on the edge of {TGT_MW.DET} seat, looking serious. "I've never hidden my history, boss. I don't blame you for being worried. But I like it here and I don't want to screw it up."
column2: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 坐在 {TGT_MW.DET} 座位边缘，神情严肃。“我从不隐瞒自己的过去，老板。你担心也是理所当然的。但我喜欢这里，我不想把它搞砸。”

column1: You read through the information on the datapad, "You know what, Darius, let's go ahead and take them up on their offer.  May as well give [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] the same ride they had in training to gain more experience in until we can find a better upgrade."\n\nDaruis takes back the datapad, "I will make the payment now, Commander.  We should have the delivery by the end of the day."

Yang bends down, loosening the screws on the venting unit in your private quarters. "I've got bad news, Boss." He pries the grate free, coughing because of the floating particles.

"Let me guess…" Darius leans in the doorway. "Killer dust bunnies?"

Yang ignores the XO. "You know the MechTechs are always griping. It's nearly an official pastime in the Mech Bay, but what I'm catching a whiff of sounds like real trouble. They're overworked and underpaid. They want a serious end-of-year bonus. Can't say I blame 'em."

"Aren't we all?" Darius's grin slips as he pulls up the budget on his compad. "They know we gotta keep costs down. How about we replace the 'Techs that are complaining? It's risky, but new expenses are popping up every day. What do you say, Commander?"
column2:
杨弯下腰，拧松你私人舱室里通风装置的螺丝。“我有坏消息，老板。”他撬开格栅，被飘浮的颗粒呛得咳嗽起来。

“让我猜猜……”达里乌斯靠在门框上。“致命灰尘团？”

杨没理会这位副官。“你知道机甲技师们总在抱怨。这几乎成了机甲库里的官方消遣，但我嗅到的味道像是真出了麻烦。他们工作过度、薪水过低，想要一笔像样的年终奖金。这我怪不了他们。”

“我们不也一样吗？”达里乌斯调出个人终端上的预算，笑容淡了下去。“他们知道我们得控制成本。不如把那些抱怨的技师换掉怎么样？这有风险，但新开销天天都在冒出来。你说呢，指挥官？”

column1:
This is just a friendly game, Darius intones as he shuffles the deck of cards.

Sumire settles behind her [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTimbiquiDark],Timbiqui Dark]]. "We'll just see about that." Darius meets her direct look and smiles.

You glance between Dr. Murad and Yang and note their lack of enthusiasm, then say, "A nice friendly game sounds about right tonight."

"Hah!" says Sumire, but she makes a visible effort to relax. Darius shrugs and follows along. At the end of the evening, Sumire's pile of chips is noticeably larger than everybody else's and she once again says, "Hah!" You start to suspect that maybe she wasn't quite treating the game as casually as everybody else.
column2:
“这只是一场友好的牌局，”达里乌斯一边洗牌一边郑重其事地说道。

苏米蕾在她那杯[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTimbiquiDark],蒂姆比基黑啤]]后面坐定。“那可说不准。”达里乌斯迎上她直率的目光，笑了笑。

你瞥了一眼穆拉德博士和杨，注意到他们缺乏热情，于是说：“今晚来一场友好的牌局听起来不错。”

“哈！”苏米蕾说，但她明显在努力放松下来。达里乌斯耸耸肩，跟着照做。夜深时，苏米蕾的筹码堆明显比其他人高出一截，她又一次说了句“哈！”你开始怀疑，她或许并不像其他人那样把这局牌看得那么随意。

column1:
This is just a friendly game, Darius intones. He shuffles the deck of cards as Sumire distributes everybody's favorite drink.

Dr. Murad, who attends to socialize rather than play, sets her [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreQuillarFizz],Quillar Fizz]] beside her datapad and looks solemnly at Darius. "Is this really going to be friendly?"

"Of course!" says Darius and smiles widely. "You see? I'm smiling. We're all smiling. You can do it too." He nods around at everybody. Yang grins, while Sumire's smile is small and crooked. As a reluctant grin quivers at the corners of Dr. Murad's mouth, you smile as well. The game starts, but play is slow and leisurely, ending long before the gathering breaks up.
column2:
“这只是一场友好的牌局，”达里乌斯郑重其事地说道。他一边洗牌，苏米蕾一边给每个人分发各自最喜欢的饮料。

穆拉德博士来这里主要是为了社交而非打牌，她把[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreQuillarFizz],奎拉气泡酒]]放在数据板旁，一本正经地看着达里乌斯。“这真的会是友好的吗？”

“当然！”达里乌斯说着露出大大的笑容。“你看？我在笑。我们都在笑。你也可以的。”他向四周的人点头示意。杨咧嘴一笑，苏米蕾的笑容则浅浅的、歪歪的。当穆拉德博士嘴角抽动着露出一丝勉强的笑意时，你也笑了。牌局开始了，但出牌缓慢悠闲，聚会还没散就早早结束了。

column1: Darius cracks open a new deck of cards. "Because not everybody here follows the rules." You blink innocently, consider the mental state of your staff, and decide how you want the game to resolve. Cheating to help Darius win is hardly necessary, but it's a satisfying game-within-a-game, especially when he demands to replay a hand he won. After the game, as he stirs his pile of chips, he says, "I hate it when you screw around with the game." You stretch and clap him on the back. "Just consider it advanced training in 'keeping your skills sharp.'" You toss your one remaining chip in the air and catch it again. "But Darius… I didn't actually cheat at all tonight. I just made you think I would." And off you stroll, leaving him wondering.
column2: 达里乌斯拆开一副新牌。“因为这里并非人人都守规矩。”你无辜地眨了眨眼，思量着手下人的精神状态，然后决定这场牌局该如何收场。 作弊帮达里乌斯取胜大可不必，但那是一场令人满足的局中局，尤其是当他要求重打一局他明明赢了的牌时。牌局结束后，他拨弄着自己的筹码堆说：“我最讨厌你在牌局上乱搞花样。” 你伸了个懒腰，拍拍他的背。“就当这是让你‘保持技艺锋利’的高级训练吧。”你把自己仅剩的一枚筹码抛向空中又接住。“不过达里乌斯……今晚我其实一点也没作弊。我只是让你以为我会作弊。”说罢你转身走开，留他一个人琢磨。

column1:
This is just a friendly game, Darius intones as he shuffles the deck.

"And thank God for that." Yang clinks his [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAmbergristVermouth],Ambergrist vermouth]] with your cup and looks at his hand. His eyes widen immediately. Ah, poker night.

You keep an eye on your cards but soon you're pulled into a conversation with Yang about the rarity of functional quad 'Mechs. Darius is displeased at how lightly you're taking the game but it's not clear why until Yang notices the pile of chips he'd been absently collecting all night.

"Wow," says Yang. "I guess I got lucky tonight."

Sumire taps her own small stack of chips. "We're all lucky. If Darius had the cards you were just flashing around, we'd owe him our shirts."
column2:
“这只是一场友好的牌局，”达里乌斯一边洗牌一边郑重其事地说道。

“谢天谢地。”杨用他的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAmbergristVermouth],安伯格里斯特味美思]]碰了碰你的杯子，看了看自己的牌。他的眼睛立刻睁大了。啊，扑克之夜。

你留意着自己的牌，但很快就和杨聊起了能正常运作的四足机甲有多罕见。达里乌斯对你如此轻慢地对待牌局感到不满，但谁也说不清原因，直到杨注意到他整晚无意识间收集的那堆筹码。

“哇哦，”杨说。“看来我今晚运气不错。”

苏米蕾敲了敲自己那一小堆筹码。“我们都很幸运。如果达里乌斯手上有你刚才炫耀的那些牌，我们连衬衫都得输给他。”

column1:
You join Yang and Darius in the lounge to watch a new drama set during the Second Succession War. The hero is a young, idealistic Davion struggling against far greater forces.

Darius is amused by how often the boy makes emotional speeches, while Yang provides commentary on the Holovid's special effects: "That's so obviously fake! A Shadow Hawk wouldn't fall over like that! The hip actuators are all wrong—blowing them out would make it stagger to the side."

"You know, you don't have to watch this." Darius says.

"What? But I'm having so much fun!"
column2:
你到休息室和杨、达里乌斯一起观看一部以第二次继承战争为背景的新剧。主角是个年轻而理想主义的达维昂人，正与远比自己强大的势力抗争。

达里乌斯觉得那少年动不动就慷慨陈词十分好笑，杨则对全息影像的特效评头论足：“假得也太明显了！暗影鹰才不会那样栽倒！髋部驱动器全弄错了——把它们打爆应该会让它向侧面踉跄。”

“你知道，你大可以不看这个。”达里乌斯说。

“什么？可我正看得开心呢！”

column1: The Merkava (meaning 'chariot' in Hebrew) was the main heavy tank of the Terran Alliance, with variants of the design in service continually since the late 23rd century. column1: Superheavy version of the Burke tank created for the Rim Worlds Republic army during their occupation of Terra in 2776-2777. Fielded by the SLDF Royal Divisions, this variant of the Burke uses an XL Engine. Armor protection was increased to 8.5 tons. The Burke was created as a static defense vehicle for the Star League Defense Force in 2580. Due to its ponderous speed and lack of short ranged weaponry, SLDF frontline forces disliked the vehicle, though garrison forces highly prized it. column2: 这周晚些时候，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 回到了阿尔戈号。你发现 {TGT_MW.Obj} 正在食堂里向听众们讲述自己的英勇事迹，一同参赛的船员也在旁边添油加醋。\n\n“指挥官，谢谢你让我参加跳水比赛！”{TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:say|Default:says} 兴致勃勃地说，“我没赢，但表现绝对拿得出手。那些本地人，哇，他们完全不知道什么叫害怕。我勉强跟了他们一阵，可悬崖上最高的那几层？离水面实在太远了。被 PPC 打可能还更安全些。”

Much to Darius' surprise, you turn to the chart and start discussing the odds that [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] has assigned to the various MechWarriors.

"The tricky part, Commander, was trying to find a sort of baseline for the math. We finally settled on what I call the 'Dekker Value'. I think it's a solid foundation".

Darius throws up his hands and walks off in a huff. As he leaves, you can't help but wonder if this betting pool has been helping to relieve the pressure, or if it will just cause more problems in the end.

“指挥官，麻烦的地方在于给这套算法找个基准值。我们最后定了所谓的‘德克尔值’。我觉得这个基础很扎实。”

column1:
You give Darius a knowing look and turn to confront [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]].

"You think you're clever, but this kind of thing is only going to backfire in the end."

As you lay into the MechWarrior, Darius sets about scrubbing the wall until the chart is just a smear of chalk.

{TGT_MW.Callsign} opens {TGT_MW.DET} mouth, but wisely shuts it immediately. It remains to be seen whether the loss of their betting pool will turn morale around, or just make it worse.
column2:
你意味深长地看了达里乌斯一眼，转头去质问 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。

“你以为自己很聪明，可这种事到头来只会反噬你自己。”

你痛斥这名机甲战士时，达里乌斯动手擦墙，把整张图表抹成了一片粉笔灰。

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 张开{TGT_MW.DET}嘴，但明智地立刻闭上了。失去这个赌局究竟能扭转士气，还是只会让情况更糟，还有待观察。

column1:
You rest a hand on [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] shoulder. "You did the right thing telling us. Darius and I may just take this stranger up on his offer."

{TGT_MW.DET_C} brow furrows, confused. Darius laughs. "Don't worry. We'll tell you exactly what to say, and you'll work with Sumire to send the messages. All above board. You go on and join the others."

After {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:leave|Default:leaves}, Darius muses. "Honestly, I like that we've rattled a few cages here in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. But you know what I like even better? The idea of messing with these jokers. Think we can make a few C-Bills on the side with a disinformation campaign?"

You give a nod to Darius. "I was thinking the same thing. Make it happen."
column2:
你把手搭在 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 肩上。“你把这事告诉我们，做得对。我和达里乌斯也许真会接受这个陌生人的提议。”

{TGT_MW.DET_C} 眉头皱起，一脸困惑。达里乌斯笑了：“别担心。我们会告诉你该说的每一句话，你配合苏米尔把消息发出去。一切都摆在明面上。你去忙吧，跟大家会合。”

{TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:leave|Default:leaves} 之后，达里乌斯若有所思：“说实话，我喜欢我们在 {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} 把某些人搅得坐立不安。但你知道我更喜欢什么吗？耍弄这帮家伙。你觉得我们能顺便靠一场假情报战赚点 C-Bill 吗？”

你朝达里乌斯点点头：“我也正这么想。去办吧。”

column1: Designed after the personal ‘Mech of Elle Bennett of the 5th Donegal Guards, the GRF-1E 'Sparky' is a radical departure from standard Griffin design ethos. In place of its typical missile rack, the 1E features enough power couplings to mount a cluster of Medium Lasers - five of them, in fact - alongside the typical PPC. In a curious design decision, the engineers behind the Sparky opted for an innovative radiator pattern instead of more sophisticated heat sinks, likely as a cost-saving experiment. While this does give the 'Mech above-average heat dissipation, it's provided complement of standard heat sinks is still woefully inadequate for such a high heat load. This means that, while powerful, this 'Mech needs an equally disciplined pilot to avoid cooking alive. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: GRF-1E“Sparky”以第5多尼戈尔卫队 Elle Bennett 的座机为原型设计，与 Griffin 的标准设计理念截然不同。1E 用足量的动力耦合装置取代了常见的导弹架，从而能在标志性的 PPC 旁并列安装一组中型激光——实际上有五门之多。一个颇为奇特的设计决定是，Sparky 背后的工程师选择了创新的散热器布局，而非更先进的散热器，很可能是出于节约成本的实验考虑。虽然这确实让该机甲拥有高于平均水平的散热能力，但其配备的标准散热器数量对于如此高的热负荷而言仍远远不够。这意味着，这具机甲虽然威力强大，却需要同样自律的机师来避免被活活烤熟。 特性：战斗铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.07

The Fire Moth C is armed with a pair of LRM-5’s and an AMS. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 由200级XL引擎驱动并装有 MASC，20吨的 Fire Moth 是有史以来最快的机甲之一。Fire Moth 为侦察以及作为元素步兵运输车辆而设计，于2874年投产。铁纤维装甲与内衬钢的组合为 Fire Moth 提供了7.5吨的挂载空间。Fire Moth C 装备两具LRM-5和一具 AMS。 特性：狭窄/低矮轮廓 投放费用倍率：0.98

column1: The Fire Scorpion is a quadrupedal BattleMech designed by Clan Goliath Scorpion scientists to be a totem 'Mech. It is visually similar to a scorpion, complete with a "tail" rising up from the rear of the BattleMech. The claw-like elements near the cockpit are actually armored guards, placed on either side of the head to keep ground troops from sniping at the cockpit. Scientists who designed it apparently believed in a quantity over quality approach, as the Fire Scorpion is rugged, cheap and primarily fielded by second-line forces that defend cities, the role in which it excels.
column2: Fire Scorpion 是一台四足战斗机甲，由 Goliath Scorpion 氏族的科学家设计为图腾机甲。它的外形酷似蝎子，机甲后部还竖立着一条“尾巴”。驾驶舱附近的爪状部件实际上是装甲护板，安装于头部两侧，以防地面部队狙击驾驶舱。设计它的科学家显然信奉数量优先于质量的理念：Fire Scorpion 坚固、廉价，主要装备于负责守城的二线部队，而这正是它最擅长的角色。

column1: Created during the Golden Century by Clan Sea Fox, the CS-2 Fox had few equals. The 50-ton Mech was powered by a 300-rated cXL engine, that propelled the Mech to speeds of 97 km/h. Protected by 10 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, the CS-2 Fox was armed with a pair of LRM-15’s and an ER Large Laser. At closer ranges, a pair of ER Medium Lasers, a pair of Streak SRM-2’s and a pair of Machine Guns provided additional firepower. Production of the Fox mysteriously stopped partway through the Golden Century as the Mech was dropped from use in the Sea Fox Touman. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 由 Sea Fox 氏族在黄金世纪期间打造，CS-2 Fox 几乎没有对手。这台50吨机甲由300级cXL引擎驱动，可达到97公里/小时的速度。CS-2 Fox 由10吨铁纤维装甲保护，装备两具LRM-15和一门ER大型激光。在更近的距离上，两门ER中型激光、两具 Streak SRM-2 和两挺机枪提供额外火力。Fox 的生产在黄金世纪中途神秘停止，该机甲也随之从 Sea Fox 的 Touman 序列中除名。 特性：可变距离瞄准 投放费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 作为联邦太阳的早期战斗机甲，75吨的 Hammerhands 于2475年首次亮相，是影响后世标志性机型 Warhammer 的始祖设计之一。由225级聚变核心驱动，Hammerhands HMH-4D 装备两门 AC/10 和一门 PPC。两门中型激光在近距离上为这些更大的主炮提供支援。 特性：炮管铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Designed by the Explorer Corps to provide heavy fire support in environments unsuited to a normal tank or support unit, the 4E is a field refit that mounts a Thumper Artillery piece in place of the standard AC/20. Removing a mostly superfluous heat sink frees up the weight for the 4E to retain its secondary weaponry should it be engaged by head hunter units. By 3010, the Explorer Corps had entered into a long term contract with Kali Yama Weapons to produce limited numbers of this design under license. The design spread to other interested parties, after the Corps relaxed their licensing arrangements following the Scarlet Fist debacle; in which a lone Corps pilot – Larissa ‘‘Raza’’ Brooks – managed to successfully evade the pirate band responsible for the destruction of her lance, before stalking them back to their base and leveling it with repeated Thumper volleys in the middle of the night. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: 4E 由探险军团设计，用于在常规坦克或支援单位难以适应的环境中提供重型火力支援；这是一种战地改装型，以一门 Thumper 火炮取代标准的 AC/20。拆除一台基本多余的散热器腾出了重量，使4E 在遭遇斩首部队袭击时仍能保留其副武器。到3010年，探险军团已与 Kali Yama Weapons 签订长期合约，获许可限量生产该设计。在“猩红之拳”事件之后，军团放宽了许可安排，该设计随之流向其他有意向的各方；在那次事件中，军团唯一的机师 Larissa“Raza”Brooks 成功摆脱了摧毁她所属小队的海盗团，随后一路追踪他们回到基地，并在深夜以反复的 Thumper 齐射击平了那里。 特性：战斗铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.02

column1: A product of the brief détente between the Circinus Federation and the Marian Hegemony, the Hazard is a rarity in the Periphery; a brand new mech model built from scratch. While much hyped by both parties, the breakdown of diplomatic relations lead to the mechs near extinction, with only a couple of dozen models produced. The Hazard HZD-1B is a 45-ton mech designed to hunt Infantry and Battle Armor in an Urban Environment. The 1B is armed with 4 Flamers, a pair of SRM-4’s and 4 Small Lasers. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 作为 Circinus 联邦与 Marian 霸权短暂缓和时期的产物，Hazard 在外围区堪称罕见之物：一款从零开始打造的全新机甲型号。尽管双方都大肆宣传，但外交关系的破裂却导致该机甲几近灭绝，仅生产了几十台。Hazard HZD-1B 是一台45吨机甲，专为在城市环境中猎杀步兵与战斗装甲而设计。1B 装备4具火焰喷射器、两具SRM-4 和4门小型激光。 特性：扰敌 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Designed to support Assault Mechs such as the Victor and the Emperor, the 60 ton Helios is a St. Ives Compact design that entered production in 3058. Powered by a 240-rated Fusion Core and built on an Endo Steel chassis, the Helios HEL-3D is armed with a Gauss Rifle. Paired ER Medium Lasers and SRM-6’s make for a potent combo should anyone try to close range. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

column1: A 65-ton design that emphasizes overwhelming firepower over speed or armor, the Hellbringer is a Clan OmniMech. Powered by a 325-rated XL Engine, the Hellbringer has 28.5 tons of pod space. The Hellbringer A is armed with a pair of ER Large Laser’s, a UAC/5 and an LRM-20. An ER Medium Laser and a pair of Machine Guns cover close range combat. An Active Probe allows improve the Hellbringers scouting ability while a Narc Beacon allows the Mech to tag enemies with Narc Beacons. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Hellbringer 是一台65吨的氏族全能机甲，偏重压倒性火力而非速度或装甲。由325级XL引擎驱动，Hellbringer 拥有28.5吨挂载空间。Hellbringer A 装备两门ER大型激光、一门 UAC/5 和一具LRM-20。一门ER中型激光和两挺机枪负责近距离作战。主动探测器可提升 Hellbringer 的侦察能力，而一具 Narc 信标则使该机甲能够用 Narc 信标标记敌人。 特性：集成探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：Omni

column1: Introduced in 2740, the 40 ton Cicada was developed as a competitor to the Locust. Slightly better armed and just as fast, the Cicada’s heavier armor and better melee capabilities enable it to function as an effective Light Mech hunter and scout. Powered by a 320-rated XL Engine, the Cicada 3M is armed with a pair of Medium Lasers, a Small pulse Laser and a UAC/5. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 蝉 于2740年推出，40吨的它是作为 Locust 的竞争对手而开发的。它的火力略强、速度同样迅捷，加上更厚重的装甲和更强的近战能力，使其能够胜任轻型机甲猎手与侦察兵的角色。由320级XL引擎驱动，蝉 3M 装备两门中型激光、一门小型脉冲激光和一门 UAC/5。 特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: A unique Commando piloted by Captain Bono Duganmare of the 22nd Skye Rangers, the "Death's Knell"; is refitted with recovered LosTech. Swapping the standard SRM racks for an additional 3 Medium lasers, allows the TDK’s engine to be refitted with a 175 core. The inclusion of DHS keeps the mech comfortably cool. An extra half ton of armor round out the design. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 这台独一无二的 Commando 由第22斯凯游骑兵的 Bono Duganmare 上尉驾驶，名为“Death's Knell（丧钟）”；它以回收的失落科技进行了改装。将标准SRM挂架换成额外3门中型激光后，TDK 的引擎得以改装为175级核心。DHS 的加入让该机甲保持舒适的低温。额外半吨装甲则令整个设计更趋完善。 特性：狭窄/低矮轮廓 投放费用倍率：1.03

column1: The CRH-4H2 builds directly on the CRH-4H, upgrading all three Medium Lasers to Medium Pulse Lasers and adding a fourth in the center torso for substantially improved close-range accuracy and output. An Advanced Targeting Computer and additional energy and heat tracking systems further sharpen its weapons' effectiveness, supported by extra heat sinks in both arms. To accommodate this expanded and refined arsenal, the CRH-4H2 sacrifices its jump jets entirely — a trade-off that grounds the design but leaves its renowned armor and defensive systems fully intact. Quirk: Reinforced Structure Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: CRH-4H2 直接以 CRH-4H 为基础，将全部三门中型激光升级为中型脉冲激光，并在中央躯干增设第四门，大幅提升近距离的精度与输出。先进的瞄准计算机以及额外的能量与热量追踪系统进一步提升其武器效能，双臂中加装的散热器为此提供支持。为容纳这套扩充且精炼的武器配置，CRH-4H2 完全舍弃了跳跃推进器——这一取舍让该设计失去了跳跃能力，但其著称的装甲与防御系统则完好无损。 特性：强化结构 投放费用倍率：1.16

column1: Hailing from the Free Rasalhague Republic, Tyra Murchie is often characterised as an eccentric genius. Her latest ride is proof of this. Originally a standard Bulldog MBT, it has been rebuilt around a custom made Fuel Cell engine. Taking advantage of the lighter engine, a Guardian ECM unit was installed and Clan spec Large Pulse Laser replaces the original Large Laser. Where the Laser came from or how Tyra managed to adapt the supposedly incompatible IS and Clan technology remains a mystery. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 140 30 Left 120 30 Right 120 30 Rear 100 30 Turret 120 30 Total 600 150 Quirk: Main Battle Tank
column2: Tyra Murchie 来自自由拉什哈格共和国，常被形容为一位古怪的天才。她的最新座驾便是明证。它原本是一辆标准的 Bulldog 主战坦克，如今已围绕一台定制的燃料电池引擎重建。利用更轻的引擎，车上加装了一套 Guardian ECM，并以氏族规格的大型脉冲激光取代了原有的大型激光。这门激光从何而来、Tyra 又是如何设法将据说互不兼容的内层空间与氏族技术整合起来，至今仍是个谜。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：4/6 格 / 120/180 米。 装甲：标准装甲 结构：标准结构 数值 A S 前部 140 30 左侧 120 30 右侧 120 30 后部 100 30 炮塔 120 30 总计 600 150 特性：主战坦克

column1: The Chevalier Light Tank was produced by and for the Star League. The Succession Wars devastated the stores of the Chevalier as the Successor States often cannibalized them for parts. Only Millennium Industries of Terra continued to produce the design, and that was snapped up by ComStar. Though the top speed is only 97 km/h, it is still respectable for a wheeled vehicle. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 6/9 hexes / 180/270 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 140 20 Left 125 20 Right 125 20 Rear 110 20 Turret 120 20 Total 620 100 Quirk: Easy to Pilot
column2: Chevalier 轻型坦克是由星际联盟为其自身生产的。继承战争摧毁了 Chevalier 的库存，因为各继承国常常拆解它们以获取零件。只有地球的 Millennium Industries 继续生产该设计，而其产品被 ComStar 全部包下。虽然最高时速只有97公里，但对轮式车辆而言仍相当可观。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：6/9 格 / 180/270 米。 装甲：标准装甲 结构：标准结构 数值 A S 前部 140 20 左侧 125 20 右侧 125 20 后部 110 20 炮塔 120 20 总计 620 100 特性：易于驾驶

column1: Long rumoured to be a representative of the Draconis Combine, Michika Miyazaki's latest refit of her beloved Brutus appear to confirm the rumours. A 225 rated XL Engine - allegedly sourced from a Komodo KIM-2 - and Ferro-Fibrous armour are the centrepiece of the upgrades though the most eye catching is a Clan spec targeting computer linked into the new ER Large Lasers. A pair of the Combines experimental MRM-10's replace the LRM-20 and a Beagle Active Probe rounds out the overhaul. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 190 40 Left 150 40 Right 150 40 Rear 125 40 Turret 150 40 Total 765 200 Quirk: Main Battle Tank
column2: 长期有传闻说 Michika Miyazaki 是天龙联合体的代表，而她对心爱座驾 Brutus 的最新改装似乎证实了这些传言。一台225级XL引擎——据称取自一台 Komodo KIM-2——与铁纤维装甲是此次升级的核心，不过最引人注目的还是一台与新装ER大型激光相连的氏族规格瞄准计算机。两具联合体的实验型MRM-10取代了LRM-20，一台 Beagle 主动探测器则为这次大修画上句号。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：3/5 格 / 90/150 米。 装甲：铁纤维装甲 结构：标准结构 数值 A S 前部 190 40 左侧 150 40 右侧 150 40 后部 125 40 炮塔 150 40 总计 765 200 特性：主战坦克

column1: Introduced in 2740, the 40 ton Cicada was developed as a competitor to the Locust. Slightly better armed and just as fast, the Cicada’s heavier armor and better melee capabilities enable it to function as an effective Light Mech hunter and scout. Powered by a 320-rated XL Engine, the Cicada 3G is armed with a pair of Medium Lasers and an ER Large Laser. A Beagle Probe augments the Mechs scouting capabilities. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 蝉 于2740年推出，40吨的它是作为 Locust 的竞争对手而开发的。它的火力略强、速度同样迅捷，加上更厚重的装甲和更强的近战能力，使其能够胜任轻型机甲猎手与侦察兵的角色。由320级XL引擎驱动，蝉 3G 装备两门中型激光和一门ER大型激光。一台 Beagle 探测器增强了该机甲的侦察能力。 特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: A customised Behemoth model A of uncertain origin outfitted in rare LosTech, this tank is the property of the Solaris Tank Jockey Scott Mayur. The main guns are replaced with vintage LB-10X Auto-cannons, 4 Streak SRM-2's are mounted in place of the LRM-5's and a pair of LRM-10 racks take the place of the original SRM-6's. These changes are enabled by the new 200 rated Fusion Engine, allegedly salvaged from a downed Enforcer. Where the LosTech came from or who provided the technical assistance needed for the retrofit is unclear. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 2/3 hexes / 60/90 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 370 50 Left 330 50 Right 330 50 Rear 325 50 Turret 370 50 Total 1725 250 Quirk: Main Battle Tank
column2: 这是一辆来历不明、以稀有失落科技武装的定制 Behemoth A 型，归索拉里斯坦克骑手 Scott Mayur 所有。主炮被替换为老式 LB-10X 自动炮，4具 Streak SRM-2 取代了LRM-5，两具LRM-10挂架则取代了原有的SRM-6。这些改动之所以可行，得益于一台新的200级聚变引擎，据称是从一架被击落的 Enforcer 上拆下来的。这些失落科技来自何处、又是谁提供了改装所需的技术支持，目前仍不清楚。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：2/3 格 / 60/90 米。 装甲：标准装甲 结构：标准结构 数值 A S 前部 370 50 左侧 330 50 右侧 330 50 后部 325 50 炮塔 370 50 总计 1725 250 特性：主战坦克

column1: Designed as a successor to the Wolverine, the Conjurer is a 50-ton Mech seen in Clan Second Line formations. Powered by a 300-rated Fusion Core, the Conjurer CJR-7 mounts 6 Jump jets. A Large Pulse Laser and 2 LRM-5’s form the bulk of the CJR-7’s weapons, with a pair of ER Medium Lasers for close combat. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: Conjurer 为 Wolverine 的后继机型，是氏族二线部队中常见的50吨机甲。由300级聚变核心驱动，Conjurer CJR-7 装设6具跳跃推进器。一门大型脉冲激光和2具LRM-5 构成 CJR-7 的主要武器，另有2门ER中型激光用于混战。 特性：加长躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.1

column1: A Snow Raven variation on the original Howler chassis, the 30 ton Devil entered service in 2911. Gaining 10 tons over it’s predecessor, it is powered by a 300-rated XL Engine; enabling it to accelerate to higher speeds then the Baboon. A combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel provide the free weight for an ER PPC and a Targeting Computer. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: Devil 是 Snow Raven 氏族在原始 Howler 底盘上做出的变体，30吨的它于2911年服役。相比前身增重10吨，由300级XL引擎驱动，使它能够加速到比 Baboon 更高的速度。铁纤维装甲与内衬钢的组合腾出了自由重量，用于安装一门ER PPC 和一台瞄准计算机。 特性：加长躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: A Star League era mech designed to correct the flaws of the original Titan, the Devastator was rediscovered by the FedSuns in 3023. Powered by a 300-rated XL engine, the Devastator DVS-3S carries a pair of Gauss Rifles and 2 PPC’s. A Medium laser and a Small Laser round out the Mechs weapons. 18.5 tons of armor and 14 DHS round out the design. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Devastator 是星际联盟时代为修正初代 Titan 缺陷而设计的机甲，于3023年被联邦太阳重新发现。由300级XL引擎驱动，Devastator DVS-3S 携带两门高斯步枪和2门 PPC。一门中型激光和一门小型激光补足了该机甲的武器配置。18.5吨装甲和14台 DHS 则为该设计收尾。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Eisenfaust was originally designed shortly after the Lyran Commonwealth began building 'Mechs. Based on their experience with the Commando and Ymir, the LCAF tried to build a medium class "siege engine" 'Mech. Though the trials looked promising, the battlefield performance of the early Eisenfaust was poor and the design was canceled. After the recovery of lostech and advanced SLDF technologies, Defiance Industries looked at the early Eisenfaust design again. The updated Eisenfaust entered production after simulations showed it could be an effective battlefield unit if equipped with updated technologies. In fact the Eisenfaust was one of the first designs to enter production after the start of the Jihad
column2: Eisenfaust 最初是在联邦太阳开始建造机甲后不久设计的。基于他们在 Commando 和 Ymir 上的经验，LCAF 试图打造一台中型“攻城引擎”机甲。虽然试验看起来很有前景，但早期 Eisenfaust 的战场表现不佳，该设计因此被取消。在失落科技与先进 SLDF 技术被重新发现之后，Defiance Industries 再次审视了早期 Eisenfaust 的设计。模拟显示，若配备更新后的技术，它可以成为有效的战场单位，于是更新版 Eisenfaust 得以投产。事实上，Eisenfaust 是圣战爆发后最早投产的设计之一

column1: This variant uses a single ATM-12 with three tons of ammo—enough to carry each of the different ammo types. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 该变体使用一具ATM-12，配三吨弹药——足以携带每一种不同的弹药类型。 特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：Omni

column1: Designed with the aim of upgrading the ageing Firebee with more advanced Star League technology, the 2Ep was still a prototype when the Succession Wars began. The only completed models of this design were lost with the destruction of the Exedor factory in the First Succession War. The design was briefly revived in the 3045, with a few surviving Firebee’s being converted as a showcase of home grown Capellan science and engineering. Armed with an ER Large Laser, dual Streak SRM-2's and augmented with the addition of a Beagle Probe, the 2Ep is a fast scout hunter and skirmisher. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 为了用更先进的星际联盟技术升级日渐老旧的 Firebee，2Ep 被设计出来，但在继承战争爆发时它仍只是一台原型机。这一设计的唯一一批完成品随 Exedor 工厂在第一次继承战争中毁灭而失落。该设计在3045年短暂复苏，几台残存的 Firebee 被改装为展示本土卡佩兰科学与工程成果的样板。2Ep 装备一门ER大型激光和两门 Streak SRM-2，并加装一台 Beagle 探测器，是一台高速的侦察猎手与游击机甲。 特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: A Star League era mech designed to correct the flaws of the original Titan, the Devastator was rediscovered by the FedSuns in 3023. Powered by a 300-rated XL engine, the Devastator DVS-2 carries a pair of Gauss Rifles, with 2 PPC’s and 4 Medium Lasers as secondary weapons. 18.5 tons of armor and 14 DHS round out the design. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Devastator 是星际联盟时代为修正初代 Titan 缺陷而设计的机甲，于3023年被联邦太阳重新发现。由300级XL引擎驱动，Devastator DVS-2 携带两门高斯步枪，并以2门 PPC 和4门中型激光作为副武器。18.5吨装甲和14台 DHS 则为该设计收尾。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A Star League era training mech, the Crockett was introduced in 2735. An 85-ton mech with a mix of weapon types alongside double heat sinks, the Crockett would go on to see frontline service as a command mech and assault mech. The CRK-5003-0 is a downgrade resulting from the Succession War’s decline in technology and features a 255-rated engine alongside a trio of Jump Jets. A pair of Large Lasers and an AC/10 form the bulk of the mechs weapons, with paired SRM-6's Lasers and Small Lasers surprising opponents at close range. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 作为一款星际联盟时代的训练机甲，Crockett 于2735年推出。这台85吨机甲混合配备多种类型的武器，并装有双倍散热器，后来更作为指挥机甲与突击机甲走上了一线。CRK-5003-0 是因继承战争技术衰退而产生的降级版本，配备一台255级引擎和三具跳跃推进器。两门大型激光和一门 AC/10 构成该机甲的主要武器，成对的SRM-6激光与小型激光则在近距离让对手措手不及。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A custom Cougar configuration, the Blood Adder is armed with a pair of ATM-9’s. A pair of torso mounted HMG’s back the ATM’s up at closer ranges while a head mounted AMS enhances the configurations defensive capabilities. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Blood Adder 是一种定制的 Cougar 配置，装备两具ATM-9。两挺安装于躯干的 HMG 在更近的距离上为ATM提供支援，而头部安装的AMS则增强了该配置的防御能力。 特性：先进光学 投放费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：Omni

column1:
Over the next several days, everyone helps move all the Mech Bay supplies to other parts of the Leopard.

As a result, emotions get heated over the following week. [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] gets particularly upset when {SCN_MW.SUBJ} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:trip|Default:trips} over an unexpected box of tools.

Before long, however, Yang and his technicians reclaim their supplies. His mood, at least, is much sunnier than everyone else's. When you arrive in the Mech Bay, he's practically glowing, and you can see why. The Mech Bay has never been better organized.
column2:
接下来的几天里，所有人都帮忙把机甲库的物资搬到 Leopard 号的其他区域。

结果，接下来的一周里气氛变得紧张起来。当 {SCN_MW.SUBJ} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:trip|Default:trips} 被一箱意料之外的工具绊到时，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 尤其恼火。

然而没过多久，Yang 和他的技术人员就夺回了他们的物资。至少他的心情比其他人都要明朗得多。当你走进机甲库时，他几乎容光焕发，而你也明白原因。机甲库从未如此井井有条。

column1: A Star League era mech designed to correct the flaws of the original Titan, the Devastator was rediscovered by the FedSuns in 3023. Powered by a 300-rated engine, the Devastator DVS-1D carries a pair of AC/10’s, with 2 Large Lasers and 4 Medium Lasers as secondary weapons. 18 tons of armor and 15 heat sinks round out the design. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Devastator 是星际联盟时代为修正初代 Titan 缺陷而设计的机甲，于3023年被联邦太阳重新发现。由300级引擎驱动，Devastator DVS-1D 携带两门 AC/10，并以2门大型激光和4门中型激光作为副武器。18吨装甲和15台散热器则为该设计收尾。 特性：超伸展驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Considered to be a middleweight machine compared to the heavier Mackies and Ymirs already in circulation, the Crossbow was built to be a fast missile support unit. As was the case with the Coventry Defense Conglomerate, Arcturan Arms’ engineers initially failed to make their prototype Crossbow live up to expectations, but as the techniques for producing BattleMechs grew more refined, the Crossbow received an upgrade worthy of its original concept. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.86 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 与已经流通的更重型 Mackie 和 Ymir 相比，Crossbow 被视为一台中量级机体，它的定位是快速的导弹支援单位。与 Coventry Defense Conglomerate 的情况类似，Arcturan Arms 的工程师最初未能让原型 Crossbow 达到预期，但随着战斗机甲生产技术日趋精进，Crossbow 获得了一次无愧于其最初构想的升级。 特性：模块化武器 投放费用倍率：0.86 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Developed during the Clan Invasion, the 5A takes advantage of the newly reintroduced Arrow IV and an Artemis IV FCS. Intended to operate in support of a lance or as part of a dedicated battery, the 5A carries a mix of homing missiles and utility ammo; enabling it to bombard targets that have been tagged by supporting forces or deploying FASCAM and other speciality ammo as and when needed. Guardian ECM confuses and blinds enemy sensors, vastly reducing the chances of accurate counter battery fire, whilst the use of CASE protects against catastrophic ammunition explosions. Sold to any interested buyer as part of Kali Yama’s contribution to the war effort, the design has been seen all across the Inner Sphere and is increasingly found in the Periphery, where reliable and cheap Artillery assets are in high demand. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 5A 在氏族入侵期间开发，充分利用了新近重新引入的 Arrow IV 和 Artemis IV 火控系统。5A 旨在配合一个小队作战或作为专用炮组的一部分，携带了寻的导弹与多功能弹药的混合配置；这使它能够轰击被友军标记的目标，或在需要时投放 FASCAM 及其他特种弹药。Guardian ECM 可迷惑并致盲敌方传感器，大幅降低遭到精准反炮兵射击的几率，而 CASE 的使用则能防止灾难性的弹药爆炸。作为 Kali Yama 对战事贡献的一部分，该设计向任何有兴趣的买家出售，如今在内层空间各地都能见到，在外围区也愈发常见——那里对可靠而廉价的炮兵力量需求旺盛。 特性：战斗铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.04

column1: The first Mech to be produced by the Ghost Bears, the 70 ton Minsk entered production in 2830. Surpassed in performance by newer designs, the Minsk fell out of favour and was eventually retired. Powered by a 210-rated Fusion Core, the Minsk 101 is armed with a pair of Gauss Rifles and an LRM-10. Paired SRM-6’s, Small Pulse Lasers and Machine Guns add additional firepower at close range. A Star League era Beagle Active Probe allows the Minsk to spot hidden opponents.n Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Minsk 是 Ghost Bear 氏族生产的第一款机甲，70吨的它于2830年投产。由于性能被更新的设计超越，Minsk 逐渐失宠，最终退役。由210级聚变核心驱动，Minsk 101 装备两门高斯步枪和一具LRM-10。成对的SRM-6、小型脉冲激光和机枪在近距离补充火力。一台星际联盟时代的 Beagle 主动探测器使 Minsk 能够发现隐藏的对手。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The first Mech to be produced by the Ghost Bears, the 70 ton Minsk entered production in 2830. Surpassed in performance by newer designs, the Minsk fell out of favour and was eventually retired. Powered by a 210-rated Fusion Core, the Minsk 1 is armed with a pair of Gauss Rifles and an LRM-10. Paired SRM-6’s, Small Pulse Lasers, B-Pods and Machine Guns add additional firepower at close range. An Active Probe allows the Minsk to spot hidden opponents.n Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Minsk 是 Ghost Bear 氏族生产的第一款机甲，70吨的它于2830年投产。由于性能被更新的设计超越，Minsk 逐渐失宠，最终退役。由210级聚变核心驱动，Minsk 1 装备两门高斯步枪和一具LRM-10。成对的SRM-6、小型脉冲激光、B-Pod 和机枪在近距离补充火力。一台主动探测器使 Minsk 能够发现隐藏的对手。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A common Light OmniMech, the Mist Lynx is fielded by every Clan since its introduction in 2926. A 25-ton mech, the Mist Lynx is powered by a 175-rated XL Engine and is built with a combination of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous that gives it a respectable 7.5 tons of pod space. column1: When House Liao requested proposals for a more powerful BattleMech than the Vindicator, then the backbone of its military, part of Earthwerks' bid was an assault 'Mech named the "Mauler." The  new creation aimed for combat effectiveness at ranges where targets could not respond. Anemic arm-mounted lasers offered only token protection, with their huge baffles intended not as battering rams, but to  accommodate future upgrades. However, Earthwerks’ other entry, the Cataphract, was more effective at conventional ranges, much cheaper, and easier on logistics, literally reusing parts from other BattleMechs. Deemed the worse alternative, this first variant of Maulers never saw production beyond a half dozen custom prototypes.
column2: 当廖氏家族寻求比 Vindicator——当时其军队的支柱——更强大的战斗机甲方案时，Earthwerks 投标方案的一部分是一台名为“Mauler”的突击机甲。这一新造物追求在目标无法还击的距离上取得战斗效能。细弱的手臂激光只能提供象征性的防护，其巨大的整流罩并非用作撞锤，而是为了容纳未来的升级。然而，Earthwerks 的另一项参选方案 Cataphract 在常规射程上更有效、便宜得多，后勤也更轻松，甚至直接复用其他战斗机甲的零件。由于被视为较差的选项，这第一款 Mauler 变体除半打定制原型机外从未投入量产。

column1: Appearing in 3012, the Marauder II is a redesign of the classic Marauder, turning the 75 ton Heavy Mech into a 100 ton Assault. Originally a Wolf's Dragoons exclusive Mech, it wasn’t until after the 4th War of Succession in 3030 that the Mech would spread beyond the Dragoons. Powered by a 300-rated Fusion Core, the Marauder II MAD-5B is armed with a Gauss Rifle, paired ER PPC’s and Medium Lasers. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

column1: A Clan Buster upgrade, the Marauder 5CS was developed specifically for Tukayyid. More or less an upgrade package for the Marauder 3R, the 5CS used Star League era technology to improve it’s effectiveness against the Clans, while being designed to be for new pilots to use. Powered by a 300-rated XL Engine with DHS, the Marauder 5CS is armed with a pair of ER PPC’s, a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and an LB-10X. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 作为一项“氏族杀手”升级，掠夺者 5CS 是专为图卡伊德（Tukayyid）之战开发的。它大体上是掠夺者 3R 的升级套件，5CS 使用星际联盟时代的技术来提升对氏族的作战效能，同时在设计上便于新机师上手。由300级XL引擎配合 DHS 驱动，掠夺者 5CS 装备两门ER PPC、两门中型脉冲激光和一门 LB-10X。 特性：狭窄/低矮轮廓 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Built for the budget conscious mercenary, the 3S is designed for prolonged operations and utilises an all energy loadout that is cheaper to maintain than the standard 3R; whilst using widely available components cuts down on repair costs. The maintenance intensive Autocannon and it’s infamously bad ammunition feed are replaced with an extra trio of Medium Lasers and 6 heat sinks, dramatically increases the amount of time the mech can go without resupply. The extra heat sinking helps offset the increased heat profile added by the lasers, whilst the increased number of medium lasers act as a strong deterrent to any lighter mechs seeking to get inside the PPC’s firing arc. Debuting in 2955, production has remained steady; with two dozen of these machines being built a year at the General Motors Kathil facility. Sold exclusively to the mercenary market, the 3S is a common site on worlds like Outreach and Galatia and remains a favorite of mercenaries everywhere despite it's age. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 3S 为预算有限的雇佣兵而造，专为长期作战设计，采用全能量配置，维护成本低于标准型的3R；同时使用易于获得的部件，降低了维修费用。维护负担繁重的自动炮及其臭名昭著的糟糕供弹系统，被额外三门中型激光和6台散热器取代，大幅延长了该机甲无需补给就能作战的时间。额外的散热能力有助于抵消激光带来的热量上升，而更多数量的中型激光则对任何试图钻进 PPC 射界之内的轻型机甲形成强力威慑。3S 于2955年首次亮相，生产一直保持稳定；通用汽车公司 Kathil 工厂每年制造两打这种机体。由于只面向雇佣兵市场销售，3S 在 Outreach、Galatia 等世界随处可见，尽管年岁已高，仍旧是全球各地雇佣兵的最爱。 特性：狭窄/低矮轮廓 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Originating from the short lived Concord of Kapteyn, this design was designed to showcase each realms newly rediscovered technology in one show-piece design. Unfortunately the Concord fell apart before the design could be put into production. The Clan Invasion left the Free Worlds League scrambling for new designs that could be used in the fight against the Clans. Among the designs pushed into production was the 69K, redesigned to use modern technologies from across the Inner Sphere. The chassis is sourced from the Combine, whilst the engine is of Lyran make; paired with a FWL built Streak SRM-2 and one of the Capellan Confederation’s newly rediscovered Beagle Probes. Produced at Irian technologies Shiro III facility until the early 3060’s, the mech was sold at cost to buyers; with the FWL subsidising production as part of their contributions to the war. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 该设计源自昙花一现的卡普坦协约，其初衷是以一件示范性设计展现各王国重新发现的科技。遗憾的是，协约在该设计投产之前便已分崩离析。氏族入侵让自由世界联盟急于寻找可用于对抗氏族的新设计。被推入量产的方案中就有 69K，它经过重新设计，采用来自内层空间各地的现代技术。其底盘来自联合体，引擎则是天琴制造；再搭配一台自由世界联盟生产的 Streak SRM-2 以及一台卡佩兰联邦新近重新发现的 Beagle 探测器。该机甲在 Irian 科技公司的 Shiro III 工厂生产至3060年代初，并以成本价出售给买家；自由世界联盟则将其生产补贴作为参战贡献的一部分。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：0.98

column1: Built by Krupp Armament Works under contract for the ComGuard, the 66C was intended for deployment on Tukayyid. Unfortunately the design was unable to be finished in time and Krupp was left with a finished mech that had no prospective buyers. In a deal brokered by Comstar, the company agreed to sell its finished production to the reformed SLDF and provide them with additional production runs as requested. Built as a fast interdiction unit, it was designed to chase down and annihilate Elemental formations. Armed with 4 small pulse lasers, a medium pulse laser and a Streak SRM-2; the variant performed with distinction throughout the post Tukayyid years and then through Operations Bulldog and Serpent. The Word of Blake invasion choked off the flow of new mechs, as Krupp’s production shifted to the newer designs demanded by the Word. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 66C 由克虏伯军械厂按 ComGuard 的合约制造，原本计划部署于图卡伊德。遗憾的是该设计未能及时完工，克虏伯手上便多了一台找不到买主的成品机甲。在 Comstar 撮合的一项交易中，公司同意将成品卖给改革后的 SLDF，并按需为其提供额外的生产批次。作为一种高速拦截单位，它被设计用来追击并歼灭元素步兵编队。该变体装备4门小型脉冲激光、一门中型脉冲激光和一具 Streak SRM-2，在图卡伊德之后的岁月里，以及“斗牛犬”和“巨蛇”行动中表现卓越。Blake 之言的入侵掐断了新机甲的产出，因为克虏伯的产能转向了该教派所需的新设计。 特性：易于驾驶 投放费用倍率：0.98

column1: A first generation BattleMech, the 50 ton Phoenix was the first native BattleMech to be built by the Rim Worlds Republic. column1: A common Light OmniMech, the Mist Lynx is fielded by every Clan since its introduction in 2926. A 25-ton mech, the Mist Lynx is powered by a 175-rated XL Engine and is built with a combination of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous that gives it a respectable 7.5 tons of pod space. An Active Probe is hardwired into the chassis boosting the Mist Lynx’s effectiveness as a scout. The Mist Lynx P is armed with an ER Large Laser, 3 Micro Pulse Lasers and 4 ER Micro Lasers. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

The Kit Fox G is armed with a ER Large Laser and a pair of LRM-10’s. An ER Medium Laser and a Guardian ECM Suite round out the variant. column1: A fast moving assault ’Mech, the Kodiak was originally designed by Clan Ghost Bear as a second-line mech and represents the epitome of Ghost Bear thinking: mostly defensive but capable of surprising speed and a devastating attack when launched. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24
column2: Kodiak 是一台高速机动的突击机甲，最初由 Ghost Bear 氏族设计为二线机甲，体现了 Ghost Bear 思维的极致：以防御为主，但一旦发动，便能展现出惊人的速度与毁灭性的攻击力。 特性：战斗铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.24

column1: Designed as a replacement to the Timber Wolf, the 65 ton Linebacker entered production in 3052. Built around a 390-rated XL Engine, the Linebacker’s faster speed enables it to keep up with lighter star mates in running battles, something the Timber Wolf struggled to do. A combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel give the OmniMech 17.5 tons of free pod space. The Linebacker LBK-A is armed with a pair of ER Large Lasers and an LRM-15. An LRM-5 and 2 ER Medium Lasers fill out the remaining free weight. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 作为 Timber Wolf 的替代机型，65吨的 Linebacker 于3052年投产。它围绕390级XL引擎建造，更快的速度使其在运动战中能跟上更轻的星队友，而这正是 Timber Wolf 难以做到的。铁纤维装甲与内衬钢的组合为这台全能机甲提供了17.5吨自由挂载空间。Linebacker LBK-A 装备两门ER大型激光和一具LRM-15。一具LRM-5和2门ER中型激光用尽剩余的自由重量。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：Omni

column1: Custom built from discarded Locust wrecks, the Koto is a 25-ton mech built exclusively for the Solaris 7 arenas by Omnitech Industries. Sharing the same basic shape as it’s parent design the Koto is extensively rebuilt with an Endo Steel skeleton, Ferro-Fibrous armor, double heat sinks and an XL Engine. Weighing 5 tons heavier then the Locust, the Koto has a significantly heavier weapons array; built for annihilating opponents in the arena. The Koto 2A is armed with a Large X-Pulse Laser, 2 ER Medium Lasers and an ER Small Laser. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: Koto 由 Omnitech Industries 用废弃的 Locust 残骸定制打造，是一台专为索拉里斯7竞技场制造的25吨机甲。Koto 与其母设计拥有相同的基本外形，但被彻底重建：内衬钢骨架、铁纤维装甲、双倍散热器和一台XL引擎。Koto 比 Locust 重5吨，武器阵容也显著更重，专为在竞技场中歼灭对手而生。Koto 2A 装备一门大型X脉冲激光、2门ER中型激光和一门ER小型激光。 特性：狭窄/低矮轮廓 投放费用倍率：0.98

Favouring a mix of firepower and armor over speed, the Kit Fox is powered by a 180 XL Engine and features a mix of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous; giving it 16 tons of pod space. The Kit Fox COL is armed with paired SRM-6’s and SRM-4’s. Dual ER Medium Lasers, 3 Machine Guns and a Laser AMS round out the variant. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 作为一款轻型氏族全能机甲，30吨的 Kit Fox 由 Cloud Cobra 氏族于2890年推出。它偏重火力与装甲的组合而非速度，由一台180级XL引擎驱动，采用内衬钢与铁纤维的混合结构，拥有16吨挂载空间。Kit Fox COL 装备成对的SRM-6和SRM-4。双门ER中型激光、3挺机枪和一具激光 AMS 则为该变体收尾。 特性：狭窄/低矮轮廓 投放费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：Omni

column1: A Nova Cat design, the 50 ton Huntsman was designed for Operation Revival and the invasion of the Inner Sphere; first entering production in 3049. An OmniMech, the Huntsman is built around a 250-rated XL Engine with an Endo Steel Skeleton and Ferro-Fibrous armor giving the OmniMech, 21.5 tons of pod space. 5 Jump Jets are fixed to the chassis, giving the Huntsman additional flexibility. Allegedly the personal mech of Calvin Deleportas, the Huntsman PA is armed with an ER Large Laser. 4 Streak SRM-4’s and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers provide additional firepower at close range. AMS protects the Huntsman from incoming missiles. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Huntsman 是 Nova Cat 的设计，这台50吨机甲为“复兴行动”与入侵内层空间而打造，于3049年首次投产。作为全能机甲，Huntsman 围绕250级XL引擎建造，采用内衬钢骨架与铁纤维装甲，拥有21.5吨挂载空间。5具跳跃推进器固定于底盘上，为 Huntsman 带来额外的灵活性。据称这是 Calvin Deleportas 的座机，Huntsman PA 装备一门ER大型激光。4具 Streak SRM-4 和两门中型脉冲激光在近距离提供额外火力。AMS 则保护 Huntsman 免受来袭导弹的伤害。 特性：稳定 投放费用倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：Omni

The Huntsman P is armed with a pair of LRM-10’s. A UAC/10, a pair of Streak SRM-4’s, an ER Medium Laser and an ER Small Laser provide additional firepower at close range. column1: First produced in 2948, the Ice Ferret is a medium scout OmniMech often employed as a head hunter or strike unit. A 45 ton Clan OmniMech, the Ice Ferret is powered by a 360-rated XL Engine and has 9.5 tons of pod space thanks to a combination of Endo Steel, an XL Engine and Ferro-Fibrous. The Ice Ferret IFR-C is armed with an ER Small Laser and a trio of Artemis IV enhanced LRM-5’s. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Ice Ferret 于2948年首次生产，是一台中型侦察全能机甲，常被用作斩首单位或打击单位。作为一台45吨的氏族全能机甲，Ice Ferret 由360级XL引擎驱动，凭借内衬钢、XL引擎与铁纤维的组合拥有9.5吨挂载空间。Ice Ferret IFR-C 装备一门ER小型激光和三具经过 Artemis IV 强化的LRM-5。 特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：Omni

column1: One of the earliest second generation OmniMech designs, the Kingfisher debuted in 2887 and is reputed to have influenced all subsequent Clan Assault OmniMech designs. A 90-ton mech powered by a 360-rated Fusion Engine, the Kingfisher has 24 tons of podspace provided by a combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and an Endo Steel skeleton. The Kingfisher C is armed with a pair of ER PPC’s. At closer ranges, the C can bring to bear 5 ER Medium Lasers. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 作为最早的第二代全能机甲设计之一，Kingfisher 于2887年首次亮相，据称影响了此后所有氏族突击型全能机甲的设计。这台90吨机甲由360级聚变引擎驱动，凭借铁纤维装甲与内衬钢骨架的组合拥有24吨挂载空间。Kingfisher C 装备两门ER PPC。在更近的距离上，C 型可以动用5门ER中型激光。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：Omni

column1: One of the Vining Engineering and Salvage Team’s more curious creations, the Ion Raptor is a hand built marque of battlemechs built with salvaged mech chassis's from the Clan front lines. First debuting in 3053, the original Ion Raptor was built from the remains of a Masakari and a Crab. Built specifically for the Solaris Arenas, less than a dozen Ion Raptors are known to exist, though speculation is rife that VEST intends to sell the design to a major manufacturer in the near future. The ION-2R is the standard model offered by VEST and the most well known one. 4 Medium Pulse Lasers and 4 Streak-4’s form the bulk of the Mechs armament, with a pair of Large Lasers providing a ranged punch. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 作为 Vining 工程与打捞团队较为古怪的作品之一，Ion Raptor 是手工打造的机甲品牌，使用从氏族前线打捞来的机甲底盘拼装而成。最初的 Ion Raptor 于3053年首次亮相，由一台 Masakari 和一台 Crab 的残骸拼成。它专为索拉里斯竞技场而造，已知存世不足一打，不过有传言盛传 VEST 打算在不久的将来把该设计卖给一家大型制造商。ION-2R 是 VEST 提供的标准型号，也是最为人熟知的一款。4门中型脉冲激光和4具 Streak-4 构成该机甲的主要武器，两门大型激光则提供远程打击力。 特性：战斗计算机 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: An evolution of the Star League Lynx, the Lynx C was an early Smoke Jaguar mech. Pushed out of front line service by the newly developed Omnimechs, the Lynx C was relegated to garrison and Solahma units with significant numbers of Lynx C’s still in service during the Word of Blake Jihad. Retaining the 275 XL Engine of the original Lynx, the Lynx C is a full clan tech rebuild of the older Star League design. An ER PPC is paired with an ER Large Laser and a Large Pulse Laser. A pair of ER Medium Lasers and a ER Small Laser provide close range firepower. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Lynx C 是星际联盟 Lynx 的进化型，属于 Smoke Jaguar 氏族的早期机甲。由于新开发的全能机甲将其挤出前线，Lynx C 被降级至驻防部队与 Solahma 部队，直到 Blake 之言圣战期间仍有大量 Lynx C 在役。Lynx C 保留了原版 Lynx 的275级XL引擎，是对这一较老的星际联盟设计进行的全氏族技术重建。一门ER PPC 与一门ER大型激光和一门大型脉冲激光搭配。两门ER中型激光和一门ER小型激光提供近距离火力。 特性：多履带 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: A refit developed with Comstar’s mothballed 9Hb’s, the Mackie 9Hc was an attempt to fix the failings of it’s predecessor design. Identifying the lack of CASE and adequate secondary weapons as the key weaknesses, the Comguard designers searched for a solution. The designers made the decision to slow the 'Mech's top speed even further as the preferred option. With the additional weight, both ammo magazines were upgraded with CASE and the designers installed an additional 3 Medium Lasers with the heat sinks upgraded to double strength models to handle the increased heat. The 5 completed prototypes served with distinction on Tukayyid, though the design never reached production status; with only 2 other conversions finished before the Word of Blake seized Terra and the remaining stocks of 9Hb’s. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Mackie 9Hc 是用 Comstar 封存的 9Hb 改装而成的改型，意在修正前代设计的缺陷。Comguard 的设计师认定缺乏 CASE 与足够的副武器是关键弱点，并着手寻找解决方案。他们最终选择进一步降低该机甲的最高速度。凭借多出的重量，两个弹药仓都加装了 CASE，设计师还额外安装了3门中型激光，并将散热器升级为双倍强度型号以应对增加的热量。5台完成的原型机在图卡伊德之战中表现出色，但该设计从未达到量产状态；在 Blake 之言夺取地球以及剩余 9Hb 库存之前，仅又有2台改装完成。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Designed primarily as a fire support Mech, the Vulture emphasizes speed and firepower over armor. The 60 ton OmniMech is powered by a 300-rated XL Engine with Ferro-Fibrous Armor; giving the OmniMech, 28 tons of pod space. The Vulture S is armed with a pair of ER PPC’s and a trio of Medium Pulse Lasers. An Active Probe allows the Vulture to function as a scout, while 5 Jump Jets improve it’s mobility. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Vulture 主要作为火力支援机甲设计，重视速度与火力而非装甲。这台60吨全能机甲由300级XL引擎驱动，配铁纤维装甲，拥有28吨挂载空间。Vulture S 装备两门ER PPC和三门中型脉冲激光。一台主动探测器使 Vulture 能充当侦察单位，5具跳跃推进器则提升其机动性。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中距离 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：Omni

column1: The Mad Dog is a heavy Clan OmniMech used for long-range indirect fire support. With hunched shoulders, a protruding head, and reverse-jointed legs, the Mad Dog resembles a vulture, so much so that it was codenamed Vulture by the Inner Sphere forces which first encountered it. The Mad Dog’s most distinctive feature is its side torso and arm pods, which are practically full modules by themselves, suggesting that the mech was conceived as a long-range support unit. The torso modules, angled high, are ideal for missiles while the arms serve as extended turrets suited for direct-fire weaponry. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Mad Dog 是一台氏族重型全能机甲，用于远程间接火力支援。它肩部隆起、头部前突、腿部反关节，外形酷似秃鹫，以至于最初遭遇它的内层空间部队将其代号定为 Vulture。Mad Dog 最显著的特征是其侧躯干与手臂挂舱，这些挂舱本身几乎就是完整的模块，暗示该机甲本就是作为远程支援单位构思的。高高倾斜的躯干模块非常适合安装导弹，而手臂则充当适用于直射武器的延伸炮塔。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中距离 投放费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：Omni

column1: A hard hitting striker mech, the Lynx was one of the first mechs to mount an ER PPC. Produced by Blue Shot Weapons, the Lynx was designed as a striker mech, with a design that blended speed, armor and firepower into a fearsome package. Built around a 275-rated XL Engine, the Lynx LNX-9C is armed with an ER PPC. 4 Medium Lasers and a pair of SSRM-2’s provide close range firepower. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Lynx 是一台打击力强劲的突击机甲，也是最早搭载ER PPC的机甲之一。它由 Blue Shot Weapons 生产，定位为突击机甲，其设计将速度、装甲与火力融为一体，构成令人生畏的整体。围绕275级XL引擎建造，Lynx LNX-9C 装备一门ER PPC。4门中型激光和两具 SSRM-2 提供近距离火力。 特性：多履带 投放费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: A typical Periphery raider, the Cicada 2P is fast and hard hitting but lacks endurance and cannot survive long once it has delivered it's payload. 4 RL-20's make up the bulk of the mechs firepower, capable of threatening even an Assault mech if used correctly. The secondary weapons are a pair of medium chem lasers with a ton of ammo between them. Achieving almost identical speeds to its Inner Sphere counterparts, the 2P is designed as a heavy scout and head hunter with a nasty alpha strike capable of shredding most opponents regardless of the target. Designed to be easy to maintain and even easier to replace, the 2P is built with parts that can be salvaged from most battlefields or brought in any number of back street bazaars or disreputable arms markets. Indeed, most new 2P’s are often repurposed wrecks hauled off the battlefield and rebuilt as quickly as possible. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 作为典型的外围区劫掠者，蝉 2P 速度快、打击狠，但缺乏持久力，一旦打出全部弹药便难以久战。4具 RL-20 构成该机甲的主要火力，若运用得当，甚至能威胁到突击机甲。副武器是两门中型化学激光，两者合计只有一吨弹药。2P 的速度与内层空间同型机甲几近相同，定位为重型侦察兵与斩首者，其凶狠的首轮齐射足以撕碎大多数对手，不论目标为何。2P 的设计便于维护，更便于更换零件，其所用部件都能从大多数战场上回收，或从任意一家后街集市和名声不佳的军火市场上买到。事实上，大多数新的 2P 往往都是从战场上拖回来的报废机体，被尽可能地快速重建而成。 特性：改进传感器 投放费用倍率：1 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: Leaning back in your chair, you look up at the drunks nonchalantly. "No, you've got the wrong guys. We saw the same match you did on the Ironwood channel. Holovid quality so high, it was like you were there." One of the fans starts ranting. "Why'd they have to kill him, though? I heard it was because of that Steiner brat." Her friend steps forward, fist clenched. "Yeah, Arjun had been bad-mouthing The Beast for weeks. He couldn't let him live after that!" After not being able to get a rise out of your crew, they depart. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] relaxes. "Good call to play it cool, Commander. I think those fans were itching for a fight."
column2: 你靠在椅背上，漫不经心地抬头看着这群醉汉。“不，你们找错人了。我们跟你们一样，是在 Ironwood 频道看的同一场比赛。全息影像质量高得就像你身临其境。” 其中一名粉丝开始叫嚷：“可他们为什么非得杀了他？我听说是那个施泰纳家的小崽子搞的。” 她的朋友握紧拳头走上前来。“没错，Arjun 骂了The Beast好几个星期。他哪能让他活下去！” 见无法激起你和手下的反应，他们便离开了。[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 松了口气。“沉住气不接招，做得对，指挥官。我看那群粉丝是手痒想打架。”

column1:
You stall for time with the preacher, keeping him confused, yet engaged. Meanwhile, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] maneuvers through the crowd. One after the other, {TGT_MW.SUBJ} quietly disarms several thugs. The crowd is none the wiser, focused as they are on the preacher's insistence as to your identity.

The rest of the crowd hums for a moment longer, disappointed at the lack of conflict, but then continues with their business in the market.

As you return the shuttle, Darius breathes a sigh of relief. "Commander, we may or may not have made the right decisions about the Volkovites. But they're Lady Liao's problem now, not ours. Best to stay out of this as best we can."
column2:
你与传教士周旋拖延时间，让他既困惑又不得不继续纠缠。与此同时，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 在人群中穿行。一个接一个，{TGT_MW.SUBJ} 悄悄解除了几名暴徒的武装。人群毫不知情，注意力都集中在传教士坚称你的身份上。

余下的人群又嗡鸣了一阵，为冲突没能发生而失望，随后便继续在集市上忙自己的事。

当你们返回穿梭机时，Darius 松了口气。“指挥官，关于这些 Volkovites，我们做的决定或许对、或许不对。但现在他们是廖女士的麻烦，不是我们的。最好尽量别掺和进去。”

column1: You and Darius have finished networking for new contracts on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} and find yourself in a bar with [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], who is on shore leave. Holovid screens dominate every wall showing Solaris VII matches. As the drinks flow, stories turn to the dramatic battle with The Steel Beast. {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s voice is particularly loud at several points. Heavy footsteps approach and several particularly drunk individuals loom over you. "Hey, you're that mercenary company that took down The Steel Beast, that right?"
column2: 你和 Darius 在 {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} 上为新合约做完人脉疏通后，与正在休假的 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 一起待在酒吧里。 每一面墙上都挂满播放索拉里斯7比赛的全息屏幕。随着酒一杯杯下肚，话题转向了与The Steel Beast的那场激战。讲到几处时，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 的声音格外响亮。 沉重的脚步声逼近，几个醉得厉害的家伙气势逼人地俯视着你。“嘿，你们就是干掉The Steel Beast的那支雇佣兵公司，对吧？”

column1: {SCN_MW.FirstName}... come with me. Such familiarity from {SCN_MW.DET} commanding officer brings {SCN_MW.OBJ} up short. {SCN_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:follow|Default:follows} you into the hall. "You clearly didn’t know that {TGT_MW.Callsign} took the battle with Gwydion company so personally. But you need to keep in mind just how small the Periphery can be. Every Noble House is represented on the Argo, and no small number of individual systems." {SCN_MW.Callsign} defiantly looks you in the eye. "Commander, I get it, I really do. But when I joined this company, I left all that behind. Every contract we take might be attacking someone's cousin. If I let that into my head, I'd be afraid of pulling the trigger out on the battlefield. Do you want me to follow orders, or not?" Not waiting for an answer, {SCN_MW.SUBJ} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:turn|Default:turns} on {SCN_MW.DET} heel and strides away.
column2: “{SCN_MW.FirstName}……跟我来。”来自 {SCN_MW.DET} 直属长官的这般亲昵称呼让 {SCN_MW.OBJ} 一时愣住。{SCN_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:follow|Default:follows} 你走进大厅。 “你显然不知道 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 把与 Gwydion 连队的那一战看得多么私人。但你要记住，外围区可以小得很。每一位贵族世家在Argo 上都有代表，独立的星系也不在少数。” {SCN_MW.Callsign} 挑衅地直视你的眼睛。“指挥官，我明白，我真的明白。但我加入这家公司时，就把那些都抛在身后了。我们接的每一份合约，可能都是在攻击某人的表亲。要是我把这些都放在心上，上了战场我都不敢扣扳机了。你是要服从命令，还是不要？” 不等你回答，{SCN_MW.SUBJ} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:turn|Default:turns} 便以 {SCN_MW.DET} 脚跟为轴转身，大步离去。

column1: The first native Battlemech to be built by the FedSuns, the 70 ton Battleaxe debuted in 2459. Based off of the technology used in the Mackie, the Battleaxe would be constantly updated with new technology, before being retired after the Reunification War when newer designs such as the Hammerhands and Warhammer entered service. The Battleaxe BKX-1X is the original prototype model. Built around a 255-rated Fusion Core, the BKX-1X is armed with a pair of Large Lasers and a pair of LRM-5’s. An SRM-6 and a pair of Machine Guns give the Mech some close range firepower. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.88 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

column1: The personal 'Mech of General Caesar Steiner of the Lyran Alliance, the Duke of Furilo and son to Margrave Iris Steiner. The 'Mech is ostensibly designated AS7-CS, but referred to as the 'Dämmerung' by most. It mounts a massive weaponry spread thanks to it’s advanced XL engine. Using the weight savings, the Medium Lasers that once rested in the forearms are replaced by Large Pulse Lasers, mounted underslung on the forearms. Regarding the Gauss rifle as the next evolution of heavy-bore ballistic weapons, the Archon requested that one with an ample ammo supply replaced the Atlas' AC/20. The SRM magazine was completely removed and the LRM magazine downsized to make room for an ER Large Laser along the ‘Mech’s centerline, and the arsenal is rounded out by hip-mounted Medium Lasers. This broad spread of weapons allows for the design to bring the bulk of its weapons to bear at any range Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2
column2: 这是天琴联盟的凯撒·施泰纳将军的座机，他是 Furilo 公爵，也是边疆伯爵 Iris Steiner 之子。该机甲的正式编号为 AS7-CS，但大多数人称之为“Dämmerung（黄昏）”。凭借先进的XL引擎，它搭载了庞大的武器阵列。利用节省下来的重量，曾位于前臂的中型激光被替换为大型脉冲激光，悬挂安装在前臂下方。鉴于高斯步枪被视为大口径弹道武器的下一步演进，大公要求以一门弹药充足的高斯步枪取代 Atlas 的 AC/20。SRM弹药仓被完全拆除，LRM弹药仓也缩小，以便沿机甲中线安装一门ER大型激光，而髋部安装的中型激光则使武器库更为完整。如此广泛的武器配置，使该设计在任何距离上都能发挥其大部分武器的威力 特性：战斗铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.2
