[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] leaps in the way as a shot rings out, and {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:spin|Default:spins} to the ground, clutching {TGT_MW.DET} arm. After that, all hell breaks loose. By the time the authorities arrive on the scene, you and your team are long gone, nursing your injuries on the shuttle ride back to the Argo. Darius breathes a sigh of frustration. "Commander, these Volkovites are Lady Liao's problem now, not ours. If we must pick a fight with them, perhaps we should be in our 'Mechs."
column2: 传教士似乎有些困惑，仍大声坚称你的身份。随后他的一名追随者高喊“杀人犯！”，举起了步枪。 枪声响起时，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 纵身挡在前面，{TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:spin|Default:spins} 倒在地，捂着 {TGT_MW.DET} 手臂。此后，场面彻底失控。 等当局赶到现场时，你和你的队员早已离去，在返回Argo 的穿梭机上处理着伤口。 Darius 沮丧地叹了口气。“指挥官，这些 Volkovites 现在是廖女士的麻烦，不是我们的。如果我们非得跟他们打一架，也许该坐进我们的机甲里打。”

column1:
You and Darius have finished networking for new contracts on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} and are walking through a farmer's market with [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], who is on shore leave.

A street preacher suddenly appears at your elbow. "Have you heard the good word of the Volkovites?" He presses a pamphlet into your hands, emblazoned with a stylized "V".

The preacher studies the insignia on your gear. "You! You were there when the Capellan storm troopers descended on the great martyrs."

Looking around, you see the same stylized "V" on numerous necklaces, patches and even etched into a young woman's rifle butt. The crowd has grown quietly attentive.
column2:
你和 Darius 在 {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} 上为新合约做完人脉疏通后，正与正在休假的 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 一起走过一个农贸市场。

一名街头传教士突然出现在你手肘边。“你听过 Volkovites 的福音吗？”他把一本小册子塞进你手里，上面印着一个风格化的“V”字。

传教士端详着你装备上的徽记。“你！卡佩兰冲锋队降临于伟大的殉道者时，你就在场。”

环顾四周，你看到同样的风格化“V”字出现在无数项链、徽章上，甚至刻在一位年轻女子的步枪枪托上。人群已悄然变得专注起来。

column1:
The confused preacher makes a half-hearted argument about your identity before giving up and moving down the street with his pamphlets.

The rest of the crowd hums for a moment longer, disappointed at the lack of conflict, but then continues with their business in the market.

Darius breathes a sigh of relief. "Commander, we may or may not have made the right decisions about the Volkovites. But they're Lady Liao's problem now, not ours. Best to stay out of this as best we can."
column2:
困惑的传教士就你的身份勉强争辩了几句，随后放弃，带着他的小册子沿街走远了。

余下的人群又嗡鸣了一阵，为冲突没能发生而失望，随后便继续在集市上忙自己的事。

Darius 松了口气。“指挥官，关于这些 Volkovites，我们做的决定或许对、或许不对。但现在他们是廖女士的麻烦，不是我们的。最好尽量别掺和进去。”

Ten and half tons of armor provides respectable protection for a heavy tank. Along with its ease of maintenance and decent firepower, this protection has made the Po a popular choice among cash strapped mercenaries, lower ranked garrison units, the Free Worlds League and Word of Blake, with such export sales keeping much needed funds flowing into the Confederation's coffers. However, sending vehicles to market in the Inner Sphere was to be more costly than anticipated. With the Great Houses' shrinking numbers of ships in their JumpShip fleets, the vehicle did not make the impact she had hoped it would. It became a favorite of ComStar's growing garrison forces for their HPG complexes. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. column1: The Rommel tank is a 65-ton armored combat vehicle, specializing in close range fighting and urban combat. Identical to its twin, the Patton, in every way but armament and armor configuration, the Rommel has primarily served with the Lyran Commonwealth and the Lyran Alliance. It is named after Field Marshal Erwin Rommel, a legendary commander of armored and mechanized forces renowned for his exploits during World War II on Terra. The Rommel was designed concurrently with the Patton in the early 3000s, when Defiance Industries decided that an armored combat vehicle capable of replacing 'Mechs was needed. column1: Named after Archon Robert Marsden, who had died the year before, the Marsden Main Battle Tank entered into service with the Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces in 2396. Combining a time-tested, simple design with modern equipment, it proved a successful general workhorse MBT for the Commonwealth for almost seven decades before it was pushed into second-line duties by its successor, the very similar Marsden II. The Marsden carried an Arcturan Arms Longarm Series Autocannon/5 as its main gun on a fully pivoting turret. The autocannon benefited from an advanced fire control system and quickly gained a reputation for accuracy. The turret also contained a coaxial General A70 Model machine gun for use against infantry. The real innovation, however, was the six-tube Alpha Wave missile launcher embedded in the thick frontal armor of the tank's hull. The basic design was eventually copied by other major states, leading to almost identical tanks with different names in other militaries. column1: The original prototype for the Marsden II, the tank features an even amount of primitive armor on all locations. The tank otherwise offers the same weaponry and speed as its production model. The Marsden II Main Battle Tank was introduced by Arcturan Arms in 2463 to improve upon and replace its venerable predecessor after seventy years of frontline service. Not only did it share the name of the Lyran Commonwealth's late founding father with the Marsden I, but also its mission profile and much of its general layout. Improved technical and manufacturing knowledge allowed the company to improve the new tank's arms and armor while still making it five tons lighter. With its excellent firepower and thick armor, it was considered a cutting edge combat vehicle when it premiered during the Age of War. The durable Marsden II continued to soldier on in various planetary militias and private security force arsenals into the Succession Wars. column1: In 3050 the Duchy of Vendôme's military realized a need for a new main battle tank. Engineers on Brekke took a shortcut and reverse engineered the legendary Estevez from surviving examples. A modern fuel cell engine allowed the gun to be replaced with a versatile Thumper, and a 10 tube SRM array for close combat. Basic but modern armor and fire control upgrades complete a simple but serviceable tank that could be manufactured with tech centuries behind the cutting edge. Named after a militia officer on New Avalon where it was built, the Estevez was the main battle tank of the Federated Suns throughout the twenty-fourth century and into the Age of War. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 210 40 Left 150 40 Right 150 40 Rear 140 40 Turret 185 40 Total 835 200 Quirk: Rugged

column1: Produced in 2546, the Toro was the Taurian Concordant’s first battlemech design. Based on captured Firebees, the Toro is a long range support mech. Armed with a PPC and a pair of LRM-5s the Toro carried two tons of ammo and 10 single heat sinks. The last Toro factory was demolished in 2598 by invading Star League troops and production would not resume until the Word of Blake Jihad. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 托罗于2546年生产，是金牛座协约的第一款战斗机甲设计。它以缴获的萤火虫为基础，是一款远程支援机甲，装有一门粒子加农炮和一对LRM-5，带两吨弹药和10个单散热器。最后一座托罗工厂于2598年被入侵的星际联盟部队拆毁，生产直到布莱克之词圣战才恢复。 特性：易于维护 投放费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: Recognised and feared throughout the Inner Sphere, the Timber Wolf is a 75 ton Clan OmniMech with a deadly blend of speed, armor and firepower. Powered by a 375-rated XL Engine, a combination of Ferro-Fibrous and Endo Steel give the OmniMech 27.5 tons of Pod Space. The Timber Wolf TC is a Clan Wolf special designed for Tukayyid and the expectation of an extended campaign. Armed with a pair of Large Pulse Lasers and a pair of Streak SRM-6’s, the TC mounts a pair of ER Medium Lasers and an ER Small as secondary weapons. 5 Jump Jets enhance the TC’s mobility. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 木狼在内层星域无人不知、无人不惧，是一台75吨部族全向机甲，把速度、装甲与火力融为一体、致命非常。它由一台375额定XL引擎驱动，铁纤维与钢内骨结构的组合提供27.5吨挂载空间。木狼TC是狼部族为图卡伊德及预期中的长期战役而设计的特制型号，装有一对大型脉冲激光和一对连发SRM-6，另有两门增程中型激光和一门增程小型激光作为次要武器。5具跳跃推进器增强TC的机动性。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: An Age of War Mech, the 65 ton Von Rohrs was one of the first non-primitive Mechs to be fielded by the Draconis Combine. Powered by a 325-rated Fusion Core, the Von Rohrs VON 4RH-6 was armed with a PPC, a pair of SRM-4’s and a Flamer. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: 作为战争年代的机甲，65 吨的 Von Rohrs 是龙脉联合体最早列装的非原始型机甲之一。VON 4RH-6 型 Von Rohrs 由 325 额定聚变核心驱动，装备一门粒子加农炮、两具 SRM-4 和一门火焰喷射器。 特性：护罩 投放费用倍率：1.07

column1: Known and revered across the Inner Sphere and beyond, the Warhammer is the pre-eminent heavy Mech. Debuting in 2515, the 70-ton Mech is a solid blend of firepower and mobility designed to outfight almost any opponent. Powered by a 350 XL Engine, the Warhammer WHM-6Rk is armed with a pair of PPC’s. A pair of Medium Lasers, Small Lasers, Machine Guns and an SRM-6 deter opponents from closing in. Double Heat Sinks round out the variant. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Warhammer在内层星域乃至更远之处都闻名遐迩、备受尊崇，是最杰出的重型机甲。这款70吨的机甲于2515年首次亮相，是火力与机动性的坚实结合，设计目标就是要击败几乎所有对手。Warhammer WHM-6Rk由一台350 XL引擎驱动，装备一对粒子加农炮。一对中型激光、小型激光、机枪和一具SRM-6则阻止对手近身。双散热器构成了该变型的最后一块拼图。 特性：集成探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The original Warhammer was designed as an assault BattleMech. However, it had been superseded by later and heavier 'Mech designs, though it remained a powerful weapons platform. The Clans wisely maintained and built on this solid frame a real assault 'Mech, the Warhammer IIC. The IIC-ML is a custom variant of the IIC-1 replaces 3 of the Medium Pulse Lasers with a pair of HMG’s and adds a second SRM-6. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 最初的风暴之锤是作为突击战斗机甲设计的。尽管后来被更重型的机甲设计取代，它依然是强力的武器平台。部族明智地维护并在这副坚固框架上发展出真正的突击机甲——风暴之锤IIC。IIC-ML是IIC-1的定制变型，把其中3门中型脉冲激光换成两挺重型机枪，并加装第二具SRM-6。 特性：内置探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The THR-1L Thunder is the first heavy ’Mech designed and produced by a Capellan manufacturer following the Clan invasion. Powered by a 350 XL Engine, the 70 ton Thunder is armed with an AC/20 supplied with three tons of ammunition. Complementing the autocannon is an LRM-5 located in the left torso, with one ton of ammunition. Three Medium Pulse Lasers back up the autocannon at close range, and the designers installed CASE to protect against ammo detonation. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: THR-1L 雷霆是部族入侵之后由卡佩兰厂商设计并生产的第一款重型机甲。这台 70 吨的雷霆由一台 350 XL 引擎驱动，装备一门 AC/20，配有三吨弹药。与这门自动炮搭配的是位于左躯干的一部 LRM-5，带一吨弹药。三门中型脉冲激光在近距离为自动炮提供后备火力，设计者还装设了 CASE 以防止弹药殉爆。 特性：护罩 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右上

column1: The Thug was designed by Maltex Corporation as a direct competitor to the popular Warhammer BattleMech. First seeing production in 2572, the Thug sought to directly address some of the challenges which faced the Warhammer, chief of which was to increase armor protection without sacrificing firepower. The Thugs long range striking power comes from a pair of arm mounted PPC’s. Backing up the PPCs are two SRM-6 launchers mounted in either side torso with one ton of CASE-protected reloads. Eighteen double heat sinks comfortably dissipate the enormous heat generated by the PPC’s while an Endo Steel frame allows it to carry fifteen and a half tons of armor. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: 暴徒由马尔泰克斯公司设计，用以直接竞争广受欢迎的战争锤战斗机甲。它于2572年首次投产，力图直接解决战争锤所面临的一些难题，其中最主要的一条便是要在不牺牲火力的前提下增强装甲防护。暴徒的远距离打击力来自双臂各安装的一门粒子加农炮。为粒子加农炮提供支援的是分别装在两侧躯干的两具SRM-6发射器，各有一个吨位受CASE保护的备用弹药。十八个双散热器能从容散逸粒子加农炮产生的巨大热量，而钢内骨结构则让它能携带十五吨半的装甲。 特性：精准武器 - 能量 投放费用倍率：1.14

column1: A Draconis Combine developed Omni mech, the Sunder is based on reverse engineered Loki and Thor Omnimechs. A 360-rated XL Engine allows the omnimech to carry 15 DHS along with 16.5 tons of armor and 36 tons of weapons. The Sunder SD1-OR is armed with a Clan LB-10X and a pair of Clan Large Pulse Lasers. 4 Clan ER Medium Lasers and paired Clan Streak-6’s act as secondary weapons. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 雷霆是龙脉联合体研制的全向机甲，以逆向仿制的洛基与托尔全向机甲为基础。一台360额定XL引擎让这款全向机甲得以携带15个双散热器、16.5吨装甲和36吨武器。雷霆SD1-OR装有一门部族LB-10X和一对部族大型脉冲激光，4门部族增程中型激光和成对的部族连发-6作为次要武器。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The custom variant piloted by ex–Com Guard and Broadsword Legion CO Kari Marita, the standard PPCs have been swapped for Clan ER PPCs, helping to free up weight for a C3i unit. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: 这是前通讯之星卫队成员、Broadsword Legion 指挥官 Kari Marita 驾驶的定制变型，标准粒子加农炮被换成部族增程粒子加农炮，从而腾出重量安装一具 C3i 单元。 特性：精准武器 - 能量 投放费用倍率：1.16

column1: This Thunder Stallion is the personal BattleMech of Galaxy Commander Titus Mitchell, commander of Clan Hell’s Horses Beta Galaxy. While still a support ‘Mech, the Thunder Stallion Mitchell carries a unique loadout when compared to the standard Thunder Stallion, or even the common variant, the Fire Stallion. Mitchell’s ‘Mech carries an LB-X autocannon, much like the standard version, but tones it down to an LB-10X instead of the larger LB-20X. Besides the autocannon, the Thunder Stallion carries energy weapons exclusively. One Large Pulse Laser, a Medium Pulse Laser, and an ER Medium Laser were added to the left torso. On the right torso three more Medium Pulse Lasers are arrayed. Along with his weaponry upgrades, Mitchell also had a clan targeting computer added to his Thunder Stallion. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21
column2: 这台 Thunder Stallion 是星系指挥官提图斯·米切尔的专属战斗机甲，他是地狱马族贝塔星系的指挥官。虽然 Thunder Stallion 仍是一款支援机甲，但米切尔的座机与标准型 Thunder Stallion、甚至与常见变型机 Fire Stallion 相比，都拥有独一无二的配置。米切尔的机甲与标准型一样装有一门 LB-X 自动炮，但将其降级为 LB-10X，而非更大的 LB-20X。除自动炮外，Thunder Stallion 只使用能量武器。左躯干加装了一门大型脉冲激光、一门中型脉冲激光和一门增程中型激光，右躯干则排列着另外三门中型脉冲激光。除了武器升级，米切尔还为他的 Thunder Stallion 加装了一台部族瞄准计算机。 特性：干扰 投放费用倍率：1.21

column1: When the Magistracy of Canopus found an abandoned Star League facility in 3018, amongst the stored equipment was a number of Thunderbolt chassis. All of them were severely damage and missing key components such as the weapons, gyro and engine. The Magistracy had to acquire these at great cost from the open market, and therefore opted to install internal combustion engines instead of the fusion cores. The F4W was intended as a hedge against civil unrest. The planetary armory traded one AC/5 for a SRM-6 and a heavy battery of machine guns whose short range meant the F4W could only engage at close quarters – excellent for controlling unruly mobs, but nearly useless against anything else. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.87
column2: 3018 年，卡诺帕斯枢机国发现了一处废弃的星际联盟设施，在其储存的装备中有若干 Thunderbolt 底盘。这些底盘全都严重受损，并缺失武器、陀螺仪和引擎等关键部件。枢机国不得不花费高昂代价从公开市场上采购这些部件，因此决定用内燃机替代聚变核心。F4W 的问世是为了防备民间动乱。行星军械库用一具 SRM-6 换掉了一门 AC/5，并加装了大量机枪——其射程之短意味着 F4W 只能在近身距离交战：用于镇压不听话的暴民堪称出色，但对付其他任何目标都几乎毫无用处。 特性：多履带 投放费用倍率：0.87

column1: A Clan Buster upgrade, the Warhammer 7CS was developed specifically for Tukayyid. Designed as a general purpose unit designed for offence and defensive roles, the Warhammer 7CS mounts a 280-rated XL Engine and DHS. A pair of ER PPC’s and 4 Medium Lasers make up the bulk of the 7CS’s load out. A trio of Streak SRM-2’s with a ton of CASE protected ammo round out the weapons, while 4 Jump Jets offer additional mobility. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Warhammer 7CS是专为图凯伊德之战研发的“部族杀手”升级型号。作为一款兼顾进攻与防御的通用单位，Warhammer 7CS搭载额定280的XL引擎和双散热器。两门增程粒子加农炮和4门中型激光构成7CS武器的主体。三具连发SRM-2外加一吨CASE保护的弹药补全了武器配置，另有4台跳跃推进器提供额外机动性。 特性：集成探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Designed for Urban combat, the 45 ton Wyvern blends heavy armor, jump jets and a versatile weapons package. Powered by a 180-rated Fusion Engine, the Wyvern 5UX is armed with an ER Large Laser. For close range combat, the Mech carries a pair of SRM-6’s and a pair of Grenade Launchers. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 45吨的双足飞龙为城市战而设计，兼具厚重装甲、跳跃推进器与多样的武器组合。由一具额定180的聚变引擎驱动，双足飞龙5UX装备一门增程大型激光。近距离作战时，这台机甲携带一对SRM-6与一对榴弹发射器。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1:
I suppose that was in storage for a reason, so we can afford to lose it if things go wrong. Just be careful. These weapons are meant to destroy 'Mechs, after all.

Later that week, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] catches you in the hall with an update.

"Commander, I'm sorry to report that I wasn't able to modify that weapon like I wanted to. But I was able to put it back together again just the way it was before. Double and triple-checked it, just to be sure."
column2:
“我猜它被收进仓库是有原因的，所以就算出了岔子、把它弄丢了，我们也还承受得起。不过还是小心点。毕竟这些武器是用来摧毁机甲的。”

那周晚些时候，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]在走廊里拦住你，带来一个消息。

“指挥官，很抱歉，我没能按自己的设想改装那件武器。但我把它恢复成了一模一样的状态，还再三检查过，确保万无一失。”

column1:
MechWarriors belong in the 'Mechs. Technicians belong in the Mech Bay. But you seem pretty knowledgeable about these things, and you've already gutted the weapon. Explain to Yang what you were going for, and maybe he can finish what you started.

Later that week, you catch [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] in the hall.

"Chief Virtanen wanted me to pass along the news. He investigated your suggestions, but they didn't lead anywhere productive."

{TGT_MW.Callsign} stares at the floor, crestfallen. "Damn, I thought for sure that would work. Thanks for asking the Chief to give it a try, though. I guess I'd better stick to what I do best: shooting the weapons instead of trying to modify them."
column2:
“机甲战士该待在机甲里，技师该待在机库舱里。但你似乎对这东西相当在行，而且已经把武器拆开了。把你想要的效果告诉杨，也许他能把你开头的活儿干完。”

那周晚些时候，你在走廊里遇到[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。

“维塔宁主管让我转告你消息。他研究过你的建议，但没能得出有用的结果。”

{TGT_MW.Callsign}盯着地板，一脸失望。“可恶，我还以为那肯定能行。不过还是谢谢你请主管试了一次。看来我还是老实干我擅长的事吧：开枪，而不是改武器。”

column1: The Indra Infantry Transport excels at its role as a personnel carrier with three tons of cargo space. It can deliver its payload swiftly to the battlefield with a top speed of 86 km/h, though not as fast as some other transports can. It compensates for that with five tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor that keep its crew safe from even the most damaging gun in the Clan arsenal. The Indra's main weapon is an ER PPC, capable of threatening armored vehicles and mechs alike. Four Machine Guns in a turret mount serve to support its own infantry forces in battle against enemy infantry. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 5/8 hexes / 150/240 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 150 20 Left 110 20 Right 110 20 Rear 90 20 Turret 105 20 Total 565 100 Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Ballistics
column2: 因陀罗步兵运输车以三吨货物空间出色履行运兵职责。它能以86公里/小时的最高速度迅速把载荷送上战场，虽然不如某些运输车快，却以五吨铁纤维装甲作为补偿——足以让车组免受部族武库中威力最强的火炮伤害。因陀罗的主武器是一门增程粒子加农炮，可威胁装甲车辆与机甲。炮塔内的四挺机枪用于在战斗中支援己方步兵对抗敌方步兵。 生态限制：无。 移动：5/8 格 / 150/240 米。 装甲： 铁纤维（C） 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 150 20 左侧 110 20 右侧 110 20 后方 90 20 炮塔 105 20 总计 565 100 特性：精准武器 - 弹道

column1: Developed in 2587, the Alacorn attracted a reputation in the SLDF as an effective and dependable tank. Although some of the earliest versions mount various autocannons the Alacorn became famous for its array of gauss rifles. This Clan upgraded Alacorn mounts four Gauss Rifles with five tons of ammo. Their combination of heavy punch and long range makes the Alacorn a threat to any unit on the field. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 350 50 Left 275 50 Right 275 50 Rear 170 50 Turret 270 50 Total 1340 250 Quirk: Improved Communications
column2: 阿拉科恩于2587年研制，在SLDF中赢得了高效可靠坦克的名声。虽然最早的几个版本装有各种自动炮，阿拉科恩却以其高斯步枪阵列闻名。这款部族升级版阿拉科恩装有四门高斯步枪和五吨弹药。重拳与远射程的结合，使阿拉科恩对战场上的任何单位都构成威胁。 生态限制：无。 移动：3/5 格 / 90/150 米。 装甲： 铁纤维（C） 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 350 50 左侧 275 50 右侧 275 50 后方 170 50 炮塔 270 50 总计 1340 250 特性：改进通讯

column1: Designed for Urban combat, the 45 ton Wyvern blends heavy armor, jump jets and a versatile weapons package. Powered by a 180-rated Fusion Core, the Wyvern 5Nsl is armed with an ER Large Laser and an LRM-10. For close range combat, the Mech carries a 4 Small Lasers and 3 SSRM-2’s. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 飞龙为城市作战而设计，这款45吨机甲融合了厚重装甲、跳跃推进器与多用途武器组合。飞龙5Nsl由一台额定180的聚变核心驱动，装备一门增程大型激光和一具LRM-10。在近距离作战方面，该机甲携带4门小型激光和3具SSRM-2。 特性：坚固耐用 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: The personal OmniMech of Star Colonel Anwen, this Warhawk shows the warrior's penchant for energy-based weapons may have given way to an obsession. Beginning with its primary weapons array, this Warhawk boasts four ER Large Lasers. Another grouping of energy weapons make up Anwen's secondary weapons system, a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers mounted on the 'Mech's center torso. Furthermore, one ER Medium Laser and one ER Small Laser offer even more added damage potential. Anwen kept the Warhawk’s integrated targeting computer, but had to make some modifications to allow for an increased weapons load. Mounting only energy-weapons makes heat dissipation a primary concern. In an attempt to solve the problem, Blood Spirit technicians equipped the 'Mech with 26 high efficiency heat sinks. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这台战鹰是星上校安雯的专属全向机甲，显示出这位战士对能量武器的偏爱或许已演变为痴迷。它的主武器阵列以四门增程大型激光傲视群雄；副武器同样由能量武器组成——两具中型脉冲激光安装在机甲的中躯干。此外，一具增程中型激光和一具增程小型激光进一步增强了伤害潜力。安雯保留了战鹰内置的瞄准计算机，但为增加武器负载不得不做了一些改动。由于全身只装能量武器，散热成为首要难题；血灵部族的技术人员为此为机甲配备了26具高效散热器。 特性：改进瞄准（远程） 投放费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Known and revered across the Inner Sphere and beyond, the Warhammer is the pre-eminent heavy Mech. Debuting in 2515, the 70-ton Mech is a solid blend of firepower and mobility designed to outfight almost any opponent. Powered by a 280 Fusion Core, the Warhammer WHM-7M-DC is armed with a pair of ER PPC’s. A Medium Laser, Machine Gun and SRM-6 deter opponents from closing in. A Command Console rounds out the design. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Warhammer 闻名于内层星域内外并备受尊崇，是最杰出的重型机甲。这台 70 吨机甲于 2515 年首次亮相，将火力与机动性扎实地融为一体，旨在击败几乎任何对手。Warhammer WHM-7M-DC 由一台 280 聚变核心驱动，装备两门增程粒子加农炮。一门中型激光、一挺机枪和一具 SRM-6 可阻止对手逼近。指挥控制台则让该设计更为完善。 特性：集成探照灯 投放费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A somewhat mediocre Scout and Light Strike platform, the Whitworth has been in service across the Inner Sphere since the end of the Age of War. A 40-ton Mech, the Whitworth is powered by a 160-rated Fusion Core and mounts 4 Jump Jets. The Whitworth WTH-0 is armed with a pair of Medium Lasers, a Flamer and a pair of Inferno equipped SRM-6’s. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 惠特沃斯是一款略显平庸的侦察与轻型打击平台，自战争年代结束以来便一直在内层星域各地服役。这台40吨机甲由一台160额定聚变核心驱动，装有4具跳跃推进器。惠特沃斯WTH-0装备两门中型激光、一具火焰喷射器和两具装填炼狱弹的SRM-6。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A second line Clan mech, the 45 ton Wyvern IIC is an upgrade of the SLDF Wyverns that survived the Exodus. Built using a cache of Wyverns, Clan Burrock upgraded every aspect of the original mech with Clan tech. Retaining the original 180-rated Fusion Core, the Wyvern IIC is armed with a mix of weapons. An ER Large Laser and an LRM-10 make up the Mechs long range firepower, with a pair of ER Medium Lasers and an SRM-6 for medium range combat. A pair of MG’s, a Flamer and a pair of ER Smalls give additional firepower at close range. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: 45吨的飞龙IIC是部族二线机甲，是对挺过大逃亡的SLDF飞龙的升级。伯洛克部族利用一批飞龙库存，用部族技术升级了原机甲的各个方面。飞龙IIC保留原来的180额定聚变核心，采用混装武器：一门增程大型激光和一具LRM-10构成远程火力，一对增程中型激光和一具SRM-6用于中距作战，两挺机枪、一具火焰喷射器和两门增程小型激光在近距提供额外火力。 特性：受保护驱动器 投放费用倍率：1.07

column1: A somewhat mediocre Scout and Light Strike platform, the Whitworth has been in service across the Inner Sphere since the end of the Age of War. A 40-ton Mech, the Whitworth is powered by a 160-rated Fusion Core and mounts 4 Jump Jets. The Whitworth WTH-1S is armed with a trio of Medium Lasers and a pair of SRM-6’s. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 惠特沃斯是一款略显平庸的侦察与轻型打击平台，自战争年代结束以来便一直在内层星域各地服役。这台40吨机甲由一台160额定聚变核心驱动，装有4具跳跃推进器。惠特沃斯WTH-1S装备三门中型激光和两具SRM-6。 特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A 45 ton Clan OmniMech, the Shadow Cat was designed as a replacement for the Ice Ferret. Debuting in 3003, the OmniMech is powered by a 270-rated XL Engine with a combination of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous providing the free weight for 17 tons of pod space. 6 Jump Jets and MASC are hardwired to the chassis, enhancing it’s mobility. The Shadow Cat TC was originally a custom variant, but made a name for itself on Tukayyid; fighting against the massed tanks and infantry of the Comguard. An LB-10X, supported by a pair of Small Pulse Lasers and an SRM-4 make up the TC’s weapons, while an Active Probe allows the TC to scout enemy positions. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 影猫是一款 45 吨的部族全向机甲，设计初衷是替代冰貂。该全向机甲于 3003 年首次亮相，由一台额定 270 的 XL 引擎驱动，并借助钢内骨结构与铁纤维的组合腾出重量，提供 17 吨挂载空间。6 台跳跃推进器与 MASC 硬接在底盘上，进一步增强了机动性。影猫 TC 原本只是一款定制变型，却在图卡伊德一战中声名鹊起，当时它与通讯之星卫队的大批坦克和步兵交战。TC 的武器包括一门 LB-10X，辅以两门小型脉冲激光和一部 SRM-4，而一个主动探测器则让 TC 能够侦察敌方阵地。 特性：狭小/低矮外形 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A Clan-tech retrofit of the classic Shadow Hawk and intended for second-line and solahma troops, the Shadow Hawk C replaces all Inner Sphere–tech weaponry with Clan equivalents. The C mounts an LB 5-X AC, an LRM-5 equipped with Swarm LRM munitions, a Streak SRM-2, and an ER medium laser. Two additional jump jets were added, extending the jump radius to 150 meters, as well as one additional single heat sink. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 影子鹰C是对经典影子鹰的部族技术改装，供二线与索拉玛部队使用，它以部族同类武器替换了全部内层星域技术的武器。C型装备一门LB 5-X自动炮、一具使用蜂群LRM弹药的LRM-5、一具连发SRM-2和一具增程中型激光。它还加装了两具跳跃推进器，把跳跃半径扩大到150米，并增加了一具单散热器。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.03

column1: StarCorps Industries’s Project: SORCERER was shrouded in such secrecy that the first Sorcerer Battlemechs just seemed to appear in Star League Defense Force ranks where they were met with varying degrees of suspicion. The 95-ton Sorcerer 1A is built around a PlasmaStar 380XL engine to propel it to a respectable 64.8 km/h which enables the Sorcerer to bring its arsenal and Guardian ECM Suite to the enemy. The design carries a pair of Ceres Arms Smasher PPCs, a pair of Donal Snub-Nose PPCs, a pair of Magna MkII Medium Lasers, and a Magna MkI Small Laser. A staggering twenty Double Heat Sinks is barely enough to keep the weapons’ heat generation in check. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: StarCorps Industries 的“SORCERER 计划”笼罩在重重保密之中，以至于首批 Sorcerer 战斗机甲仿佛是凭空出现在星际联盟防御部队的序列里，引来程度不一的猜疑。95 吨的 Sorcerer 1A 围绕一台 PlasmaStar 380XL 引擎打造，可推进至相当可观的 64.8 km/h，使 Sorcerer 得以为敌人送上其全套武器与 Guardian 电子对抗套件。该设计装有两门 Ceres Arms Smasher 粒子加农炮、两门 Donal 短鼻粒子加农炮、两门 Magna MkII 中型激光和一门 Magna MkI 小型激光。惊人的二十具双散热器也仅勉强能将武器产生的热量控制住。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.17

column1: StarCorps Industries’s Project: SORCERER is considered one of the best examples of effective counter-industrial espionage techniques; despite being in development for nearly two decades, the various intelligence agencies of the Great Houses never managed to collect any meaningful data on the program. The project’s primary goal was to create an assault BattleMech capable of slipping behind and operations behind enemy lines for an indefinite period of time and if at all possible, do this task undetected. Produced in exceptionally small quantities up until Amaris forces overran their facilities on Fletcher, the 95-ton Sorcerer 1X sports a combination of a Null Signature System and a Chameleon Light Polarization Shield. The 1X carries a pair of Ceres Arms Smasher PPCs, a pair of Donal Snub-Nose PPCs, and pair of Magna 400P Medium Pulse Lasers which in combination with the stealth systems onboard can easily overpower the Mech’s nineteen Double Heat Sinks. Few remember the 1X variant as the more widely-produced and fielded 1A variant stepped off of the manufacturing lines on the same day. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
column2: StarCorps Industries的“SORCERER计划”被视为有效反工业间谍技术的典范之一；尽管该计划已研发近二十年，各大家族的各情报机构却始终未能收集到任何有关该计划的有价值情报。该计划的首要目标是打造一型能够潜入敌后、并在敌后无限期作战的突击战斗机甲，如有可能，还要在无人察觉的情况下完成这一任务。直到Amaris部队占领其在Fletcher的设施之前，这款机甲都以极小的产量生产。95吨的Sorcerer 1X同时配备了一具零点特征系统与一面变色龙光偏振护盾。1X装有两门Ceres Arms Smasher粒子加农炮、两门Donal短鼻粒子加农炮，以及两门Magna 400P中型脉冲激光，这些武器与机上隐身系统相结合，很容易就压过这台机甲十九具双散热器的散热能力。很少有人记得1X改型，因为产量更大、装备更普及的1A改型与它同一天走下生产线。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.19

column1: Despite being designed for Urban and close-quarters warfare, the Sorcerer 1C variant drops the pair Snub-Nosed PPCs of the original Sorcerer 1A in favor of the easier-to-obtain Blankenburg Large Pulse Lasers. Less surprisingly, the 1A’s PPC and laser complement is replaced by a quartet of Magna 400P Medium Pulse Lasers and a pair of Holly Streak SRM2s. The Sorcerer 1C dedicates eight tons to mount four Pitban LFT-50 jump jets to propel it 120 meters in short bursts and utilizes only sixteen Double Heat Sinks. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: 尽管是为城市与近距作战而设计，巫师1C变型却拆掉原版巫师1A的一对短鼻粒子加农炮，改用更易获得的布兰肯堡大型脉冲激光。不那么令人意外的是，1A的粒子加农炮与激光组合被四门马格纳400P中型脉冲激光和两具霍利连发SRM2取代。巫师1C腾出八吨装四具皮特班LFT-50跳跃推进器，可在短促爆发中推进120米，并且只使用十六个双散热器。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.17

column1: A Clan Buster upgrade, the Shadow Hawk 2Ht was a Comstar refit built with scrapped SLDF plans and modified for use as an Elemental hunter. Built on the standard SHD-2H chassis, the original 275-rated Fusion Core is retained along with the pair of arm mounted Medium Lasers. Replacing the AC/5 is a Large Laser, while 5 Streak SRM-2’s and a ton of ammo replace the original missile launchers. DHS replaces the original SHS, freeing up weight for CASE and an extra pair of Jump Jets. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 作为一项“反部族”升级，影鹰2Ht是通讯之星利用废弃的星际联盟防卫军图纸打造、并改造为元素猎手的改装型。它沿用标准SHD-2H底盘，保留275额定聚变核心和2门装在手臂上的中型激光。AC/5被1门大型激光取代，原有的导弹发射器则由5具连发SRM-2和1吨弹药顶替。双散热器取代了原来的单散热器，腾出的重量用于安装CASE和2具额外的跳跃推进器。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.05

column1: An assault grade fire support mech, the Salamander entered production in 3055. An 80-ton mech, the Salamander is built around a 320-rated XL Engine and an Endo Steel Skeleton, allowing it to carry 43 tons of weapons and equipment. The Salamander PPR-5S is armed with a trio of LRM-20’s. A pair of Medium Lasers act as back up weapons. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 作为一台突击级火力支援机甲，火蜥蜴于3055年投产。这台80吨的机甲围绕320额定XL引擎和钢内骨结构建造，可携带43吨武器与装备。火蜥蜴PPR-5S装备3具LRM-20，并由2门中型激光充当备用武器。 特性：精准武器（导弹） 投放费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下段

column1:
You look at [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. "What’s in this pod? "Magpie frowns and leans over to check the sensor readings. "Honestly Commander, your guess is as good as mine. I never asked what my clients were hiding away and I don't plan on asking now."

 Darius starts to frown and starts paging through the sensors readings. "I’m not sure what to make of it Commander. Sensors are picking up what could be an inactive Fusion Core. The pod doesn't look dangerous but I'd recommend opening it outside. Just in case anything happens."

Magpie nods in agreement. "It's probably the safest course of action. My client liked to hide stuff in the middle of nowhere for good reason. It's probably safe, but I wouldn't want to bet on it."

The Argo backs off and Magpie approaches the pod in an EVA suit.
column2:
你看向 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。“这个舱里装的是什么？”喜鹊皱起眉头，俯身查看传感器读数。“说实话，指挥官，你问我我也一样不知道。我从不过问客户藏了什么，现在也不打算问。”

达里乌斯也开始皱眉，翻看起传感器读数。“我不太确定该怎么判断，指挥官。传感器探测到的可能是处于停机状态的聚变堆芯。这个舱看起来不危险，但我建议在外面打开它，以防万一。”

喜鹊点头赞同。“这大概是最稳妥的做法。我的客户喜欢把东西藏在荒无人烟的地方，是有原因的。它大概很安全，但我不想拿这个打赌。”

阿尔戈号后退，喜鹊身穿 EVA 服靠近了那个舱。

column1: The increased use of heavily armed and armored strike VTOL by the Inner Sphere eventually forced a Clan response. The Kukri was the result, a VTOL designed to hunt its own kind. It is unusually heavily armored for a Clan vehicle, and further protected by AMS front and rear. Early armament proposals included large missile racks to ensure some hits vulnerable areas like rotors and maneuvering jets. However, noting the effective AMS carried by many of its targets the design committee eventually proposed a Plasma Rifle, a quartet of AP Gauss Rifles and, as an apparent afterthought, an ER Micro Laser Array. Although the Scientist Caste insisted plasma would be effective in air to air engagements many were skeptical. However the Great Houses of the Inner Sphere also use tanks and conventional infantry in quantity, both highly vulnerable to the Kukri’s weapons. Higher-ups were eventually satisfied that even if it failed as a fighter, it might succeed as a tank hunter. There was no need for worry. During the first combat trial Kukri pilot Larysa Kosko disabled two enemy Balac VTOL within 10 seconds of engaging. She then went on to win the subsequent dogfight with a third. Its success on the battlefield caused a minor increase in the status of aircraft pilots in some circles. Unlike most combat vehicles with large crews of poorly trained washout mechwarriors, the single pilot (albeit accompanied by a communications and sensor operator) appealed to the ideal of personal glory so important to the Clans. column2: 内层空间越来越多地使用重装重甲的突击 VTOL，最终迫使氏族做出回应。库克利便是答案——一种专门猎杀同类的 VTOL。对氏族车辆而言，它的装甲异常厚重，前后还各有一套 AMS 提供额外防护。早期武器方案包括大型导弹发射巢，以确保能命中旋翼和机动喷口等脆弱部位。不过，设计委员会注意到许多目标都装有高效的 AMS，最终提出以一门等离子步枪、四门 AP 磁射步枪，以及看似事后补上的 ER 微型激光阵列作为装备。尽管科学家种姓坚持认为等离子武器在空对空交战中会很有效，许多人仍持怀疑态度。然而内层空间的大豪族同样大量使用坦克和常规步兵，这两者都极易被库克利的武器杀伤。高层最终认为，即便它作为战斗机失败，作为坦克猎手也可能成功。事实证明无需担忧。在首次实战测试中，库克利机师拉丽萨·科斯科在交火 10 秒内便瘫痪了两架敌方 Balac VTOL，随后又赢下了与第三架的缠斗。它在战场上的成功让某些圈子里机师的地位略有提升。与大多数战斗车辆配备大批训练不足的淘汰机甲战士车组不同，库克利只有一名机师（尽管还有一名通讯与传感器操作员随行），这迎合了氏族极为看重的个人荣誉理想。 生态限制：该单位无法部署在月球生态区。 移动力：9/14 格 / 270/420 米。 装甲：铁层压装甲（C） 结构：标准结构 数值 A S 正面 125 24 左侧 105 24 右侧 105 24 后方 95 24 炮塔 20 24 总计 450 120 特性：防空瞄准

column1:
I could've handled it, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] argues for a moment, but your withering stare gives {SCN_MW.Obj} pause and {SCN_MW.SUBJ} quickly {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:drop|Default:drops} the subject.

You turn back to Darius, "Let's get a repair crew up here to take care of this."

Later that day, Darius knocks on your office door, "Commander, bad news.  I was unable to locate any companies on [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] that have the equipment and personel to replace the failing door bolts.  We are going to need to find a system that has it's own manufacturing industy or come up with another way of fixing the issue."

You rub your face in your hands before responding to Darius, "Okay.  Let's look for a nearby system that can assist us and hope we do not have another accident before then."
column2:
“我本来能处理好的，”[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 争辩了一句，但你那逼人的注视让 {SCN_MW.Obj} 顿住，{SCN_MW.SUBJ} 很快 {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:drop|Default:drops} 了这个话题。

你转回头对达里乌斯说：“叫一支维修队上来处理这件事。”

当天晚些时候，达里乌斯敲响了你办公室的门：“指挥官，坏消息。我在 [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] 上找不到任何拥有设备和人手来更换那些失效门栓的公司。我们得找一个拥有自己制造工业的星系，或者另想办法解决这个问题。”

你用双手搓了搓脸，然后回答达里乌斯：“好吧。我们找一个附近能帮上忙的星系，希望在那之前别再出事故了。”

column1: You are in the cargo bay surveying the aftermath of yet another door failure when Darius approaches, "Commander, here is the safety audit report you ordered on the Argo." You take the datapad from Darius and scan the data. You let out a long exhale, "This is not good, Darius. We need to get those bolts all replaced or one of these times the whole bloody Argo is going to decompress." Yang wanders over at the moment, "Boss, we need to hold Boeing Interstellar accountable for this!" You push through your pounding headache, "Yang, I get it. It is just not that easy to take a ship that is centuries old and hold its manufacturer liable. Darius, remind me again what it is going to take to fix this mess." Darius reads from his datapad, "Well Commander, as before, our options are: Purchase replacement bolts and manually do the job ourselves. [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] has mentioned being willing to assist with external repair work; Hire a repair crew from [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] to expedite the repairs professionally; or do nothing and revisit this later hoping it doesn't happen again in the mean time. What do you wish to do, Commander?"
column2: 你正在货舱里查看又一起舱门故障的现场，这时达里乌斯走了过来：“指挥官，这是你要求的关于阿尔戈号的安全审计报告。” 你从达里乌斯手中接过数据板，扫视着数据。你长长地吐了口气：“这可不妙，达里乌斯。我们得把那些门栓全部换掉，否则总有一天整艘该死的阿尔戈号都会失压。” 杨此时也晃了过来：“老板，我们得让波音星际公司为此负责！” 你强忍着阵阵头痛：“杨，我明白。只是要让一家几百年前造的飞船的制造商担责，没那么容易。达里乌斯，再跟我说一遍，要收拾这摊子得做些什么。” 达里乌斯读着数据板：“好的，指挥官，和之前一样，我们的选择有： 购买替换门栓，自己动手完成这项工作。[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 提过愿意协助外部维修工作； 从 [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] 雇佣一支维修队，专业地加快维修进度； 或者什么都不做，日后再处理，指望期间别再出事。 你想怎么做，指挥官？

Still produced via different companies, the Maxim is still heavily used by many units as their principal APC. It has proven itself popular both to unit commanders, who respect its firepower, speed and ability to carry a full platoon of infantry, and to the troops it carries, who respect its roomy, comfortable infantry bay. column1: Amir Kowalski was brought up as a loyal scion of House Liao, and sent to a military academy as soon as he was of age. There, he did not disappoint his family name and graduated on time. After graduation, by family request, he was assigned as a naval lieutenant aboard a Capellan Confederation DropShip. He served without particular distinction and was eventually transferred to a MechWarrior unit, which suited his abilities much better. After another tour of duty, in which he developed the motto: 'any battle you walk away from is a victory', he decided he wanted to pursue his own goals, and became a mercenary.\n\n
column2: 阿米尔·科瓦尔斯基自幼被培养为廖氏家族的忠诚子弟，一到年龄就被送入军事学院。在那里他没有辜负家族名声，如期毕业。毕业后，他应家族要求被派往一艘卡佩兰联邦空投艇担任海军中尉。他的服役表现平平，最终被调入一支机甲战士部队，这才更契合他的能力。又经历过一轮服役后——其间他形成了“能全身而退的战斗就是胜利”这句座右铭——他决定去追求自己的目标，成为一名雇佣兵。\n\n

column1: Jessica Chernovskaya had a peaceful and ordinary middle-class childhood in the heart of the Federated Suns. But even in the heart of civilization, you're not safe from a glitch. It was a garbled bioscan that got Jessica committed to a maximum security prison and changed her life. After ten years, her case was re-opened, the evidence re-examined, and her name cleared, but it was far too late for the kid Glitch had been. She'd learned skills on the inside, and she applied them on the outside. Killing for money is surprisingly easy and lucrative, and elite killers can command high prices for their discretion and effectiveness.\n\n
column2: 杰西卡·切尔诺夫斯卡娅在联邦太阳腹地度过了平静而普通的中产童年。但即便在文明的核心地带，你也躲不过小故障。一次乱码的生物扫描让杰西卡被送进最高安全级别监狱，从此人生彻底改变。十年后，她的案件被重新审理，证据被重新核查，她的名誉得以洗清——但对当年那个被称作“Glitch”的孩子来说，已经太晚了。她在狱中学到了各种本领，出狱后便加以运用。为钱杀人竟出奇地容易且有利可图，精英杀手还能凭谨慎与高效索要高价。\n\n

Originally designed and prototyped during the 2nd Succession War, the vehicle suffered from instability and other technical problems that proved to be insurmountable at the time. column1:
You look your former opponent in the eyes, "You fought valiantly, and I now claim you as my [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBondsman],bondsman]].  You will wear this [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBondcord],bondcord]] until you have sufficently demonstrated all three virtues: combat talent, integrity and loyalty."

As you reach forward to place the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBondcord],bondcord]] on the MechWarrior's wrist, they pull their arm behind them, "My honour will not allow me to become a [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBondsman],bondsman]].  I claim my right of refusal."

You nod assent, "As you wish, MechWarrior."

You feel saddened at the loss of a potentially great pilot.
column2:
你直视昔日对手的双眼：“你战斗得很英勇，我现在宣布将你收为我的 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBondsman],bondsman]]。你将佩戴这条 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBondcord],bondcord]]，直到你充分展现出全部三项美德：战斗天赋、正直与忠诚。”

当你伸手要把 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBondcord],bondcord]] 戴到这名机甲战士的手腕上时，他把手臂抽到身后：“我的荣誉不允许我成为 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBondsman],bondsman]]。我主张我的拒绝权。”

你点头同意：“如你所愿，机甲战士。”

你为失去一位可能极为出色的机师而感到惋惜。

column1: A 95-ton Mech, the Bullshark was recovered from the wreck of the Jump Ship Dobrev and schematics were later acquired by Majesty Metals which produced the Mech in limited quantities. The difficulty in sourcing parts and the hand built nature of each Bullshark would limit it to a mere 2 dozen examples, most of which served with the Magistracy Armed Forces. The unveiling of the Helm Core and subsequent Clan Invasion signaled the end of the Bullshark, with Majesty Metals reallocating resources to more profitable projects. The Bullshark M4 is a fire support design, built around a 285-rated Fusion Core and armed with a pair of Large Lasers and a pair of AC/5’s. An LRM-15 and a pair of Medium Lasers round out the design. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

column1: Repurposed by a Goliath Scorpion Seeker who recovered it from a lost Brian Cache, this CRB-27b has undergone an extensive restoration effort. Sporting Clan tech weapons, augmented by a targeting computer and an active probe; this Crab aids the Seeker in their search for Star League relics. Surprisingly, the design mounts jump jets – enough to leap 150 metres at a time- an unusual addition to the Crab. Intended to aid in exploration work, they have surprised many opponents in combat or a circle of equals, helping to contribute to the Seeker's many victories. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这台 CRB-27b 被一名歌利亚蝎氏族探求者从失落的布莱恩储存库中寻获后加以改造，并经过大规模修复。它装备氏族技术武器，并配有瞄准计算机和主动探测器；这台蟹式机甲协助探求者搜寻星盟遗物。令人意外的是，该设计还装设了跳跃喷流——一次足以跃出 150 米——这对蟹式而言是罕见的加装。它们本是为协助勘探工作而设，却在战斗或平等圈中让许多对手措手不及，为探求者赢得众多胜利立下功劳。 特性：易于维护 空投成本倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

Popular among rookie pilots, the 1GS trades range and firepower for increased survivability and an easier heat curve. Built from salvaged PHX-1D’s, the 1GS strips out the XL Engine and extra DHS. The weapons are replaced with a Large Laser and a Small Laser in each arm, the additional range of the ER’s not being needed in the close quarter fighting of the Arena. Both the primary lasers are mounted in gunpods giving the variant its "Gunslinger" nickname. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 凤凰鹰 1GS 是蓝枪武器公司的特制品，是基于 STR-3G 毒刺的定制订购型号。1GS 在菜鸟机师中颇受欢迎，它以射程和火力换取了更高的生存能力和更平缓的热量曲线。1GS 由拆解自战场残骸的 PHX-1D 改装而成，拆除了XL引擎和额外的DHS。武器换成每臂一门大型激光和一门小型激光——在竞技场的近距离混战中，增程型号多出的射程并无用武之地。两门主激光均安装在武器吊舱中，这也为该型号赢得了“枪手”的绰号。 特性：改良通讯 出击成本系数：1.03

column1: A Clan Buster upgrade, the Phoenix Hawk 1bC was a Comstar refit built with damaged Phoenix Hawk 1b’s inherited from the 112th Royal Hussar regiment of the SLDF. Powered by a 270 XL Engine and possessing an Endo Steel chassis, the PHX-1bC is armed with an ER Large Laser and a pair of Medium Lasers. A Narc Beacon and 4 tons of ammo allow the Mech to spot for allied artillery and support assets, while a Flamer gives the Mech some anti-infantry capability. The 1b’s CASE and Guardian ECM are retained. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 凤凰鹰 1bC 是一款“氏族杀手”升级型，是通讯之星利用继承自SLDF第112皇家骠骑兵团的受损凤凰鹰 1b 进行的改装。PHX-1bC 由270 XL引擎驱动，采用内钢骨架，装备一门增程大型激光和两门中型激光。Narc信标和4吨弹药使该机甲能为友方火炮与支援单位提供指引，而一具火焰喷射器则赋予其一定的反步兵能力。1b 的CASE和Guardian ECM得以保留。 特性：改良通讯 出击成本系数：1.03

column1: You place a tick next to [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s name on the datapad and scribble your signature. Darius jumps up and heads off to the barracks as you proceed to the MedBay to speak to the Argo's surgeon. You arrive to find the surgeon inspecting the Neural Implant matrix. They look up when you arrive, "Hello, Commander. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] is being prepped for surgery as we speak." You nod, "You feel comfortable performing this procedure?" The surgeon nods back, "I do Commander. I have done similar types of surgeries in my past before I hired on with your company." You turn to exit the room, "Very well, let me know how the procedure goes." :::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: Hours later, Darius finds you in the lounge, "Boss, umm, well, we lost [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. You lean forward in your chair, head in hands, staring at the floor, "How? What happened." Darius's shoulders slump, "Apparently [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] had a reaction to the implants. The doc said..." You look up, anger on your face, "What the hell?! I thought they did a full medical workup on [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]?" Darius sits down, "They did. But [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s condition was one that in 99% of these types of surgeries is never an issue. This time, it was." You fall back into the chair and down the whiskey in your glass, "Drop off the reports to my office and I will get them signed off and filed and notify [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s kin."
column2: 你在数据板上的 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 名字旁打了个勾，草草签上自己的名字。你站起身，把数据板递给达里乌斯，“好，把 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 送到医疗舱，确认 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:仍然想|Default:仍然想} 做这件事。 达里乌斯跳起来奔向营房，你则前往医疗舱去见 Argo号的外科医生。 你到达时，医生正在检查神经植入体矩阵。你进来时他们抬起头，“你好，指挥官。[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 正在为手术做术前准备。” 你点点头，“你有把握做这台手术吗？” 医生也点头，“有，指挥官。在加入您的公司之前，我做过类似的手术。” 你转身离开房间，“很好，手术进展如何随时告诉我。” :::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: 几小时后，达里乌斯在休息室里找到你，“老板，呃，那个，我们失去了 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。 你从椅子上前倾身体，双手抱头，盯着地板，“怎么会？发生了什么。” 达里乌斯垂下肩膀，“[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 对植入体产生了排异反应。医生说……” 你抬起头，满脸怒火，“搞什么鬼？！我以为他们对 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 做过全面体检了？” 达里乌斯坐下，“做了。但 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 的情况在这类手术中有99%的情况下根本不成问题。这一次，它偏偏成了问题。” 你倒回椅子里，把杯中的威士忌一饮而尽，“把报告送到我办公室，我签完归档，再通知 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 的亲属。”

column1: The Javelin is a dangerous 'Mech for its tonnage, especially against other light mechs and some mediums. The JVN-10F also makes a decent light 'Mech hunter-killer.
column2: 标枪（Javelin）按其吨位而言是台危险的机甲，对付其他轻型机甲和部分中型机甲尤其如此。JVN-10F 也是一款相当不错的轻型机甲猎杀者。

column1: A first generation BattleMech, the 50 ton Phoenix was the first native BattleMech to be built by the Rim Worlds Republic. Powered by a 250-rated Fusion Core, the Phoenix 3R carried a PPC and a pair of SRM-2’s. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: 作为第一代战斗机甲，50吨的凤凰（Phoenix）是边缘世界共和国自行建造的首款战斗机甲。凤凰 3R 由一台额定250的聚变核心驱动，装备一门PPC和两具SRM-2。 特性：易于维护 出击成本系数：1.04 臂部驱动器限制：Right Upper

column1: A Clan Buster upgrade, the Rifleman 5CS was a Comstar refit designed with the aim of extending the Rifleman’s battlefield endurance. Replacing the original 240-rated Fusion Core with a larger 300-rated XL Engine increased the Mechs speed and allowed for the installation of additional armor. DHS replaced the original SHS, reducing the chronic overheating issues that plagued the Rifleman, while the AC/5’s were upgraded to a pair of UAC/5’s with 2 tons of ammo. The pair of Large Lasers remain, but the 2 Medium Lasers were removed to make space for the UAC ammo. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 步枪手 5CS 是一款“氏族杀手”升级型，是通讯之星为延长步枪手战场续航能力而进行的改装。它用更大的额定300 XL引擎替换原有的额定240聚变核心，提升了机甲速度并得以加装更多装甲。DHS取代了原有的SHS，缓解了长期困扰步枪手的过热问题，同时AC/5升级为两门UAC/5，配2吨弹药。两门大型激光被保留，但2门中型激光被拆除，为UAC弹药腾出空间。 特性：对空瞄准 出击成本系数：1.08 臂部驱动器限制：Left Upper, Right Upper

column1: Refitted on Coordinator Takashi Kurita's order when Shin Yodama was promoted to command the Izanagi Warriors, the basic frame of the Kuroi Kiri mirrored the 3M and was primarily armed with a PPC and ER large laser in its right and left arms respectively. For supporting weaponry, a medium laser is also carried in each arm, along with a left arm–mounted machine gun and right arm–mounted AMS. Fitted with 11 double heat sinks, Shin's 'Mech carries a single ton each of machine gun and AMS ammo in the CASE-protected left torso. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 黑雾（Kuroi Kiri）是在与田慎晋升为伊邪那岐武士团指挥官时奉协调官栗田隆之命改装的，其基本骨架与3M相同，主武器分别是右臂的PPC和左臂的增程大型激光。辅助武器方面，每臂还各有一门中型激光，另有左臂机枪和右臂AMS。该机甲配备11具双散热器，机枪弹与AMS弹药各一吨，存放于受CASE保护的左躯干。 特性：改良通讯 出击成本系数：1.05

column1:
You look over the names and records of the three volunteers.  You thumb back through their files numerous times, before letting out a long sigh and closed the datapad.

You hand the pad back to Darius, "Thanks Darius, but I do not think any of those three pilots understand the risks involved here.  See if there are any other volunteers.  We do not need to rush into this blindly."

Darius takes the datapad, "As you wish, Commander.  The clinic also states the applicants must wait 90 days to be reassessed should you change your mind later."

<color=#E62E00>The following pilots are not eligible again for 90 days: 
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]
[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]
[[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]]
</color>
column2:
你翻看着三名志愿者的姓名和档案。你把他们的档案来回翻了许多遍，最后长叹一口气，合上了数据板。

你把数据板递还给达里乌斯，“谢谢你，达里乌斯，但我认为这三名机师里没人真正明白其中的风险。看看还有没有其他志愿者。我们不必盲目地仓促行事。”

达里乌斯接过数据板，“如您所愿，指挥官。诊所还表示，如果您日后改变主意，申请人必须等待90天才能重新评估。”

column1: The Ferret Light Scout VTOL was first introduced to House Davion troops in 2901 and later adopted by House Marik, House Steiner and certain Periphery powers. The vehicle serves as an advanced scout with the ability to monitor enemy troop movements and radio in artillery strikes. Thanks to its speed, a single Ferret can patrol a front of up to twenty kilometers long, moving quickly from one area to the next. The vehicle is lightly armored and a hit from nearly any kind of 'Mech weaponry will destroy the Ferret. However, the Ferret's job is to avoid combat, and its agility allows it to remain outside the effective range of the enemy's weapons until reinforcements arrive. Besides reconnaissance and artillery spotting, the Ferret's cargo capacity also makes it suitable for transport and rescue operations. column1: Mohammed Benitez was born on one of Mechdur's lunar colonies and subsequently traveled with his prospector parents all over the system before moving to Katinka. There he attended a local technical school to augment the knowledge he'd picked up while growing up. He spent some time working as a tech on his parents' IndustrialMechs. Eventually, craving more excitement, he hitched a ride on a mercenary DropShip, where he soon talked his way into a BattleMech cockpit. He's never looked back.\n\n
column2: 穆罕默德·贝尼特斯出生在梅赫杜尔星的月球殖民地之一，此后跟随探矿的父母走遍了整个星系，之后才搬到卡廷卡。在那里他进入一所当地技术学校学习，以充实成长过程中积累的知识。他曾有一段时间在父母的工业机甲上做技术员。最终，他渴望更多刺激，便搭上一艘雇佣兵空投艇，很快又凭一张嘴混进了战斗机甲的驾驶舱。从此他再未回头。\n\n

column1: The only successful field variant from the original production run of the tank. This variant removes a machine gun and one of the SRM-6 launchers to swap out the AC/5 for an AC/10. The Marsden II Main Battle Tank was introduced by Arcturan Arms in 2463 to replace its venerable predecessor after seventy years of frontline service. column1:
What can we expect? you ask.

Darius smiles thinly. "Since we can provide immediate fulfillment, we should do pretty well. I can't really give you a final amount until I close the deal, though."

You grin back, thinking of your XO's abilities. "The crew will hate it, but with you negotiating… Well, I know you can squeeze gold out of a lemon. Make a push for as much as you can and maybe we can purchase better rations until the next harvest."
column2:
“我们能有多少进账？”你问道。

达里乌斯淡淡一笑。“既然我们能立即交付，收益应该相当不错。不过，在敲定交易之前，我没法给你一个确切的数目。”

你咧嘴一笑，想起这位副手的手段。“船员们会不高兴，但有你去谈判……嗯，我知道你能从柠檬里榨出金子。尽量多争取一些吧，也许下次收成之前我们就能吃上更好的口粮了。”

column1: Later in the week, Darius provides an update. "I did some bargaining with some, ah, unlicensed medical distributors. The selection was a bit random, but they had lots of it." He hesitates. "One small note, though. I swear I didn't find out about this until after the deal was done…" Sumire interrupts. "Yeah, I saw this on the planetary news feed. A humanitarian crisis has been unfolding and an entire shipment of medical supplies went missing. It sounds just like what we bought." Darius looks pained. "What's done is done. But yes, I think word got out to the crew. We'll see how they take it."
column2: 本周稍晚，达里乌斯带来了最新消息。“我跟一些，呃，没有执照的医疗经销商讨价还价了一番。货品搭配有点随机，但量很足。” 他犹豫了一下。“不过有件小事。我发誓，我是在交易完成之后才知道这事的……” 苏米尔打断了他。“是啊，我在行星新闻频道上看到了。一场人道主义危机正在蔓延，而整整一批医疗物资失踪了。听起来就跟我们买的那批一模一样。” 达里乌斯一脸痛苦。“做都做了。不过没错，我想船员们已经听到风声了。看看他们会是什么反应吧。”

column1:
<color=#BFBFBF>Yang's voice comes over the comm from the cargo bay, breathless.</color> "Commander, get down here."

<color=#BFBFBF>By the time you arrive, the salvaged transport's cargo container is already cracked open, its contents spilled across the deck plating. Yang crouches beside a stack of dense metal ingots, running a scanner over one.</color>

"Whatever this thing was hauling cargo for, they packed it right. This is naval-grade Ferro-Aluminum, same stuff Farah's been hunting for the hangar job." <color=#BFBFBF>He hefts one of the ingots, testing its weight.</color> "Can't tell you what it was meant to be used for, they stripped the ID plates clean off the container before it ever left port. Doesn't matter much either way. What matters is we've got it now."

<color=#BFBFBF>He does a rough count of the stacked ingots.</color> "Looks close to a full ton, near as I can eyeball it. Worth having it weighed properly before anybody starts celebrating."
column2:
<color=#BFBFBF>杨的声音从货运舱透过通讯器传来，上气不接下气。</color>“指挥官，下来一趟。”

<color=#BFBFBF>等你赶到时，那艘被打捞上来的空投艇的货柜已经被撬开，里面东西洒了一甲板。杨蹲在一堆致密的金属锭旁，拿扫描仪扫着其中一块。</color>

“不管这玩意是给谁运货的，他们包装得挺讲究。这是舰用级铁铝合金，正是法拉为机库那活儿一直在找的东西。”<color=#BFBFBF>他掂起一块金属锭，试了试分量。</color>“我没法告诉你它本来打算用在哪儿——货柜离港之前，上面的识别铭牌就被刮得一干二净。不过哪样都无所谓，重要的是东西现在在我们手上。”

<color=#BFBFBF>他粗略清点了堆叠的金属锭。</color>“照我目测，差不多有一整吨。在有人开始庆祝之前，最好拿去正经称一下。”

column1: This simple 3060's refit of the classic model upgrades the cannons to LBX and adds CASE. Introduced in 2952, the Behemoth was designed for increased firepower and heavy armor rather than speed or manoeuvrability. The design allowed the Behemoth to engage both distant and short-range targets, while allowing it to stand up to almost any type of unit possible. The two turret-mounted AC-10s enable the Behemoth to deal out a great deal of damage at a long distance. The four front-mounted LRM-5’s increase this damage potential. For closer targets, two SRM-6 packs are mounted on the turret and the Behemoth boasts two ball turrets, each mounting one SRM-2 and two Machine Guns. The final two SRM-2 packs are mounted in a half-turret on the front of tank. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE.
