column1:
BattleMechs may rule the day in 31st century combat, but the brick and mortar of many a militia - and even professional military - are the dedicated tread-heads; those men and women who willingly and ably fire up their trusty Vedettes or Galleons in defense of hearth and home, or for the glory of their ruling House. Being part of the conventional side of things is often a thankless, fruitless endeavor that leaves many crews bitter while the MechWarriors hog the spotlight. But sometimes, tankers get lucky. Sometimes they get the right shot at the right time, winning the salvage lottery, and joining the illustrious ranks of MechWarriors - the knights of the modern era. But sometimes, weird shit happens and you end up sitting in the cockpit of a Cicada, still wondering how all this could have happened.

That's Axle's story. She was the commander of one of the many Vedettes assigned to garrison duty on St. Andre, then in the Chaos March. As is often the case, her company was sent to engage raiders who sought to pick at the corpse of an ancient Star League base called Fort Ravengale. The battle was joined, and as the chaos set in, she was manning her cupola when an enemy Cicada suddenly bore down on her Vedette, landing a kick that threw her from her perch and detonated the autocannon ammunition stored in the tank. Only moments after, a friendly shot destroyed the head of the marauding 'Mech, sending it toppling down beside her wrecked tank. The friendly that made the shot was then obliterated by a stray particle cannon bolt, and the rest is a blur as she fell unconscious. When she woke, she was in the hospital with a concussion, broken ribs, and a ruptured disc, and found herself the sole remaining professionally trained person within 1000 klicks that had any kind of a shot at strapping into and utilizing the 40-ton war machine that had died right next to her. She didn't have a choice then, and still doesn't now - the bills won't pay themselves. The Capellans didn't want to keep her, so she struck out to the Periphery to make ends meet. And most merc outfits are too fancy for treads.
column2:
战斗机甲或许主宰着 31 世纪的战场，但许多民兵团——甚至正规军——的砖石基石，是那些专职的“铁履带”；是那些甘愿且能干地启动自己可靠的 Vedette 或 Galleon，为家园而战、或为统治家族的荣耀而战的男人与女人们。身处常规部队往往是一份吃力不讨好的差事，让许多车组心怀苦涩，而机甲战士却独占荣光。不过，有时坦克手也会走运。有时他们能在正确的时机打出正确的一发，赢得战利品彩票，跻身机甲战士——这个时代的骑士——的光荣行列。但有时，离奇的事也会发生，你最终坐进了一台蝉的驾驶舱，还在纳闷这一切究竟是怎么发生的。

这就是 Axle 的故事。她是被派往 St. Andre 执行驻防任务的众多 Vedette 之一的指挥官，当时那里还属于混沌地带。一如往常，她的连队被派去迎击那些试图啃食一座名为渡鸦谷堡（Fort Ravengale）的古老星际联盟基地遗骸的袭击者。战斗打响，混乱蔓延之际，她正站在指挥塔口，一台敌方蝉突然朝她的 Vedette 扑来，一记踢击把她从驾驶舱顶掀了下来，同时引爆了坦克内储存的自动炮弹药。仅仅片刻之后，一发友军炮弹打爆了那台肆虐机甲的头部，让它轰然倒在受损的坦克旁。开炮的友军随后被一发流弹般的粒子加农炮光束抹去，接下来的事一片模糊，她昏死了过去。醒来时，她躺在医院里，脑震荡、肋骨骨折、椎间盘破裂，并且发现自己方圆一千公里内唯一受过专业训练、还有一丝可能把自己绑进那台就死在她身旁的 40 吨战争机器里的人。她当时别无选择，如今也一样——账单不会自己付清。卡佩兰人不愿留她，于是她远走外围星域谋生。而大多数佣兵部队又都太讲究，看不上履带。

column1:
There are those who grow up knowing what it means to want, and then there are those who are blessed like Diego Velazquez. The only child of a wealthy Lyran mercantile family, Diego dreamt of ruling the battlefield as a war hero, at the controls of a gilded Zeus; a legend in his own right. When his schooling revealed an easily distracted child with trouble navigating his lessons, his parents knew he would be ill-suited to inherit the family business, but never had the heart to tell him. When he said he wanted to be a MechWarrior, they knew he needed better grades, and more discipline, and didn't have the heart to tell him. In the end, money made everything right, and his parents secured him a BattleMech; a washed-up merc needed cash and they wanted the best for their only boy, so he was hired to train the teenage Diego to be a 'Mech pilot, and eventually turn his Blackjack over to the Velazquez scion.

Diego never did learn discipline, and never took no for an answer from his mentor. For two years the aging soldier tried to tutor the boy, and mold him into something resembling a MechWarrior. But more often than not, the two ended up butting heads, with the elder calling the younger a "stubborn goat", and the youth storming off to do something else less demanding. Eventually, the MechWarrior's health started to fail, and while resting in bed he officially turned his decrepit 'Mech over to Diego, handing him a set of dog tags with "Capricorn" stamped into them, and wishing him luck. Diego never saw the old man die, as he paid passage as soon as he could to Outreach, to find adventure and glory. Unsurprisingly, the headstrong, naive young man lost his 'Mech, and finally, his misplaced pride. Life had slapped him in the face, and now that his eyes were open to reality, he felt humble, and wished for nothing more than to actually earn himself a spot among a real mercenary command, and a chance to really earn that which was unfairly bought.
column2:
有些人从小就懂得“匮乏”意味着什么，而另一些人则像迭戈·贝拉斯克斯一样被命运眷顾。作为莱兰一个富裕商贾家庭的独子，迭戈梦想着驾驭一台镀金的宙斯，以战争英雄之姿主宰战场，成为属于他自己的传奇。当学业显示他是个容易分心、功课吃力的孩子时，他的父母知道他不适合继承家业，却始终狠不下心告诉他。当他说想成为机甲战士时，他们知道那需要更好的成绩和更多的自律，同样狠不下心告诉他。最终，金钱让一切都变得顺理成章：一位落魄的佣兵需要现金，而他们想给独子最好的，于是这名佣兵受雇来把少年迭戈训练成机甲机师，并最终把他那台黑杰克移交到贝拉斯克斯家的继承人手中。

迭戈始终没学会自律，也从不接受导师的“不”。那位上了年纪的军人花了两年时间试图教导这个男孩，把他塑造成有点像机甲战士的样子。但更多时候，两人总是针锋相对，年长者骂年少者“倔驴”，年轻人则怒气冲冲地跑去干别的轻松事。最终，这位机甲战士的健康开始恶化，卧床休养时他正式把破旧的机甲移交给了迭戈，递给他一副刻着“摩羯座”（Capricorn）的狗牌，祝他好运。迭戈从未见到老人离世，因为他一有机会便付了船资前往 Outreach，去寻找冒险与荣耀。不出所料，这个固执而天真的年轻人失去了他的机甲，最终也失去了错位的骄傲。生活狠狠给了他一记耳光，如今他睁眼面对现实，变得谦卑，只希望能真正在一支真正的佣兵部队里赢得一席之地，并有机会真正凭本事挣得那些曾被不公平地买来的东西。

column1: Built around prototype TSM, the Raven 3X is a moderate upgrade to the 1X model that came before it.
column2: 渡鸦 3X 以原型 TSM 为核心构建，是在其前身 1X 型号基础上的一次中度升级。

column1:
Grigori Izzo wasn't born, he was built. At least, that what his father told him. "No kid as big as you came from anything but a box!", he'd exclaim, and Grigori would giggle. And he was a big kid. Not too quick on the uptake though. He spent a long time getting bullied before he realized what his size meant, but once he did, he used it to his full advantage. And the same thing applied to his schooling. Once he got his teeth into a subject, he absorbed it like a sponge. So when it came time to do something with himself after school, he wanted to go big. And nothing was big like a BattleMech. He wanted to make the Inner Sphere his playground, and so he enrolled in the Hero Training Institute; racking up significant debt, but determined to be a MechWarrior.

Training at HTI was spotty to put it politely, but after nearly being thrown out for getting into a fistfight with his Tactics and Strategy 112 "professor", he graduated along with a class of fourteen other MechWarriors, and promptly fell into the ranks of the Dispossessed. There were more men than machines, and even though Izzo had a talent for using every ounce of armor on his 'Mech to weather enemy fire, and a fair grasp of shooting straight, he was stuck waiting with so many others, hoping for his big break with a merc outfit in the Rimward Periphery.
column2:
格里戈里·伊佐不是生出来的，他是被“造”出来的。至少他父亲是这么说的。“像你这么大的孩子，除了从箱子里出来，还能从哪儿来！”他会这么嚷嚷，而格里戈里就咯咯笑。他确实是个大块头孩子，学东西却不怎么灵光。在意识到自己的体型意味着什么之前，他长期被人欺负，可一旦明白过来，他便把这份体型发挥到了极致。学业上也是如此：一旦他咬住某个科目，就会像海绵一样把它吸收殆尽。所以当毕业要考虑出路时，他想干一番大事业。而没有什么比战斗机甲更大。他想让内层星域成为自己的游乐场，于是报名进入英雄训练学院，背上了沉重的债务，却决心要成为机甲战士。

用委婉的说法，HTI 的训练时断时续。但在差点因与“战术与战略 112”课的“教授”打架而被开除之后，他还是毕业了，与他一起毕业的还有另外十四名机甲战士，随后便一头栽进了“失甲者”的行列。人比机器多，尽管伊佐有天赋——能把机甲上每一盎司装甲都用来扛住敌人的炮火，枪法也还算靠谱——他仍只能与许多人一起排队等待，盼着在外缘星域某支佣兵部队里迎来属于自己的大机会。

column1: Named for one of the mythical ravens that aided the Norse god Odin. The Muninn is armed for long range combat, carrying a incendiary LRM alongside a single Bombast Laser.
column2: 得名于北欧神祇奥丁身旁的神话渡鸦之一。Muninn 为远程战斗而武装，除了一门 Bombast Laser 外还携带一套燃烧型 LRM。

column1: Named for one of the mythical ravens that aided the Norse god Odin and piloted by Sergeant Odin Sigurd of the Free Rasalhague Republic. The Huginn is armed for close range combat, mounting paired Machine Guns in each arm in support of right torso SRM-6 and left torso Streak SRM-2.
column2: 得名于北欧神祇奥丁身旁的神话渡鸦之一，由自由拉萨尔哈格共和国的奥丁·西格德中士驾驶。Huginn 为近距战斗而武装，每条手臂各装一对机枪，配合右躯干的 SRM-6 与左躯干的 Streak SRM-2。

column1: A Capellan variant of the original prototype, with the battlefield failure of the -1X, the -4X was an attempt to reuse the chassis as a more combat orientated unit. It removes the EW equipment and is outfitted with five jump jets and two Machine Guns with a ton of ammunition. The armor was increased to the chassis' limit of seven tons. Used as a substitute in lances that normally used a JR7-D but needed more anti-infantry capability.
column2: 这是原始原型机的卡佩兰改型；-1X 在战场上的失败之后，-4X 试图重新利用该底盘，使其成为更偏向作战的单位。它拆除了电子战设备，改装五具跳跃推进器以及两挺机枪和一吨弹药。装甲被提升至该底盘七吨的上限。它被用作通常配备 JR7-D、但需要更强反步兵能力的小队的替代机型。

column1: The Raven was a light-weight electronic warfare BattleMech which, when it first debuted after the end of the Third Succession War, was not just one of the first truly original 'Mech designs produced in centuries, but also represented humanity's refusal to slide back technologically.
column2: 渡鸦是一款轻型电子战战斗机甲，在第三次继承战争结束后首次亮相时，它不仅是数个世纪以来首批真正原创的机甲设计之一，更代表了人类拒绝在技术上倒退的决心。

column1: This variant, based on the 3L, removed the SRM-6 launcher, the medium lasers, and the electronic warfare systems and TAG laser in order to turn the Raven into a long range fire support unit.
column2: 这一改型以 3L 为基础，拆除了 SRM-6 发射器、中型激光以及电子战系统和 TAG 激光，目的是把渡鸦改造成远程火力支援单位。

column1:
The Magistracy of Canopus may be blessed with its first proper martial academy in several centuries, thanks to the Trinity Alliance and its partners the Capellan Confederation and the Taurian Concordat, but not every MechWarrior is given the chance to attend. And some who qualify choose not to, thinking the new alliance to be a farce. Sharon is one of those latter folks. She graduated from a provincial academy, and received the very best, roughest, most experience-driven training the undefunded MAF could muster with scant subsidy. Her assignment had been to a Spider 5D, and she loved every moment of it. The speed was what appealed to her most, and it always will. She believes that not only is speed armor, it is also life.

Unfortunately for her, she talks as fast as she likes her 'Mechs to run, and her scathing opinions regarding the Capellan Confederation attracted the wrong sort of attention. She was discharged without pension (thought not dishonorably) to avoid any undue friction between the MAF and their new advisiors, and so struck out on her own, looking for like-minded soldiers to sign on with; preferably those who dislike the Confederation.
column2:
多亏了三方同盟及其伙伴卡佩兰邦联与金牛协约国，卡诺帕斯辖区或许在数个世纪后终于拥有了第一所像样的军事学院，但并非每位机甲战士都有机会入学。而一些有资格的人则选择不去，认为这个新同盟不过是场闹剧。莎伦就是后者之一。她毕业于一所省级学院，接受了经费拮据的 MAF 在微薄补贴下所能提供的最好、最严酷、最富实战经验的训练。她被分配到一台蜘蛛 5D，她热爱其中的每一刻。最吸引她的是速度，而且永远如此。她相信速度不仅是装甲，更是生命。

不幸的是，她说话的速度就像她希望机甲奔跑的速度一样快，而她对卡佩兰邦联的尖刻看法引来了不该有的关注。为避免 MAF 与其新顾问之间产生不必要的摩擦，她被解职且没有退休金（但并非不名誉退役），于是她独自出发，寻找志同道合的士兵签约——最好是那些讨厌邦联的人。

column1: A weird all-energy weapons based custom variant that tries to cut back on operating costs by using no ammunition. The increased heat means the 'Mech has to carry 7 external heatsinks, reducing the saved costs by enough to make this a very unpopular version by most.
column2: 这是一个古怪的纯能量武器定制改型，试图通过不使用弹药来削减运营成本。热量上升意味着该机甲必须携带 7 具外置散热器，省下的成本因此被抵消得差不多，使这个版本在多数人眼中极不受欢迎。

column1: Custom Kell Hounds variant using looted Clan Large Pulse Lasers and LBX/5 Autocannons to achieve battlefield superiority.
column2: 凯尔猎犬的定制改型，使用缴获的氏族大型脉冲激光与 LBX/5 自动炮来夺取战场优势。

column1: The Kell Hounds found the stock RFL-3N to be very lacking, replacing most of its weaponry with tech acquired during the company's initial battles with the Clans. The resulting RFL-3N-KH was a lot more deadly, mounting twin Clan UAC/5s with four Clan Extended Range Medium Lasers and two A-Pods as complimentary weaponry.
column2: 凯尔猎犬认为原厂 RFL-3N 严重不足，于是用该连队在与氏族的初期战斗中缴获的技术替换了它的大部分武器。由此诞生的 RFL-3N-KH 致命得多，安装了一对氏族 UAC/5，并以四门氏族增程中型激光和两具 A-Pod 作为辅助武器。

column1: The first production version of the Rifleman weighed fifty tons and used primitive technology. Each arm carried a single large laser and medium laser. It was protected by eleven and a half tons of Primitive Armor and used a Primitive Engine to reach a top speed of 64 km/h. Though it served in the Reunification War, this version of the Rifleman was usually used by militia and second line forces thereafter.
column2: 步枪兵的第一个量产版本重五十吨，采用原始技术。每条手臂各装一门大型激光与一门中型激光。它由十一吨半的原始装甲防护，并使用原始引擎，最高时速达到 64 公里/小时。虽然该版本步枪兵曾在统一战争中服役，但此后通常装备民兵与二线部队。

column1: Introduced in 2556, this version replaced the primitive components with standard armor and engine. The freed space and weight allowed engineers to fit in sixteen heat sinks. The large lasers were removed from the arms and replaced by PPCs, while two more medium lasers were added, one in each side torso. Production of this model continued until the RFL-3N was introduced.
column2: 这一版本于 2556 年推出，以标准装甲与引擎取代了原始部件。腾出的空间与重量让工程师得以装入十六具散热器。大型激光从手臂上拆下，换成 PPC，同时增设两门中型激光，分别位于左右躯干。该型号的生产一直持续到 RFL-3N 问世。

column1: Point in direction of the enemy and shoot. Never ever show your back to them. It is literally held together with chewing gum and cardboard back there.
column2: 把炮口指向敌人然后开火。永远别把后背露给他们。那后面真的是用口香糖和纸板粘在一起的。

column1: Introduced in 2740, the 40 ton Cicada was developed as a competitor to the Locust. Slightly better armed and just as fast, the Cicada’s heavier armor and better melee capabilities enable it to function as an effective Light Mech hunter and scout. Powered by a 320-rated XL Engine, the Cicada 3F is armed with a pair of Medium Lasers and an ER PPC. The 3F has the unique distinction of being the only Cicada variant to mount Jump Jets.
column2: 40 吨的蝉于 2740 年推出，是作为蝗虫的竞争机型开发的。它的武器略好、速度相当，而更厚重的装甲与更强的近战能力使它能够成为有效的轻型机甲猎手与侦察兵。蝉 3F 由一台 320 额定 XL 引擎驱动，装备一对中型激光与一门 ER PPC。3F 有一个独特之处：它是唯一安装跳跃推进器的蝉改型。

column1: The 4L was an attempt to make the RFL-4D more useful and increase its survivability. The design replaces the PPCs with a number of Lasers and switches to using double heat sinks. The combination of Endo Steel structure and an XL engine also allowed it to carry several tons more of armor. The variant however underperformed on the battlefield and never reached any success.
column2: 4L 试图让 RFL-4D 更有用、更易存活。该设计以若干激光取代 PPC，并改用双联散热器。钢内骨结构钢结构与 XL 引擎的组合还让它能多携带数吨装甲。然而该改型在战场上表现不佳，从未取得任何成功。

column1: Introduced in 2740, the 40 ton Cicada was developed as a competitor to the Locust. Slightly better armed and just as fast, the Cicada’s heavier armor and better melee capabilities enable it to function as an effective Light Mech hunter and scout. Powered by a 320-rated XL Engine, the Cicada 3E is armed with a pair of LRM-15’s.
column2: 40 吨的蝉于 2740 年推出，是作为蝗虫的竞争机型开发的。它的武器略好、速度相当，而更厚重的装甲与更强的近战能力使它能够成为有效的轻型机甲猎手与侦察兵。蝉 3E 由一台 320 额定 XL 引擎驱动，装备一对 LRM-15。

column1: The RFL-3NR brings just some slight changes to the base RFL-3N design. It replaces the two Medium Lasers with a single Small Laser, but instead adds a C3 slave unit, C.A.S.E protection for the AC/5 ammunition and switches to use Double Heat Sinks.
column2: RFL-3NR 只对基础 RFL-3N 设计做了些许改动。它以一门小型激光取代两门中型激光，但增设了一个 C3 从属单元，为 AC/5 弹药加装了 C.A.S.E 防护，并改用双联散热器。

column1: Long rumored to have piloted a uniquely customized variant, one possible version of Gray Noton's infamous 'Legend-Killer' using only Succession Wars era technology was supposedly built around a lighter 180-rated engine, its lowered ground speed off-set by the inclusion of three jump jets. Offensively this variant reportedly retains the Large Lasers and AC/5s with their single ton ammo bay but drops the Medium Lasers in exchange for four extra heat sinks and a extra half ton of armor.
column2: 长期以来有传闻说，格雷·诺顿曾驾驶过一台独一无二的定制改型。据称，“传奇杀手”的一个可能版本只用继承战争时代的技术，围绕一台更轻的 180 额定引擎打造，降低的地面速度则由三具跳跃推进器弥补。在火力方面，该改型据称保留了大型激光与 AC/5 及其一吨弹药舱，但舍弃中型激光，换取四具额外散热器与半吨额外装甲。

column1: Another possible version of Gray Noton's 'Legend-Killer', this Third Succession War tech level variant retains the 240-rated engine of the RFL-3N but adds four jump jets for enhanced mobility. Their inclusion is made possible by the removal the Large Lasers, moving the torso Medium Lasers into their mounts. Still carrying a single ton of reloads, eleven single heat sinks frees weight for nine and a half tons of armor.
column2: 格雷·诺顿“传奇杀手”的另一个可能版本。这一采用第三次继承战争技术等级的改型保留了 RFL-3N 的 240 额定引擎，但增设四具跳跃推进器以增强机动性。之所以能装下它们，是因为拆除了大型激光，并把躯干上的中型激光移入其原位。它仍携带一吨再装填弹药，十一具单联散热器则腾出重量，换来九吨半装甲。

column1: A heavily rebuilt variant of the RFL-3N claimed to be the infamous 'Mech 'Legend Killer', piloted by the notorious gladiator Noton Gray. By using chassis parts from heavier mechs the tonnage of the RFL-1LK has been increased to 70 ton, allowing it to carry a very deadly arsenal into battle.
column2: 这是 RFL-3N 的一台经过大幅重建的改型，据称就是那台臭名昭著的“传奇杀手”，由声名狼藉的角斗士诺顿·格雷驾驶。通过使用来自更重型机甲的底盘部件，RFL-1LK 的吨位被提升到 70 吨，使其能够把极为致命的武器库带上战场。

column1: Introduced in 2740, the 40 ton Cicada was developed as a competitor to the Locust. Slightly better armed and just as fast, the Cicada’s heavier armor and better melee capabilities enable it to function as an effective Light Mech hunter and scout. Powered by a 320-rated XL Engine, the Cicada 3G is armed with a pair of Medium Lasers and an ER Large Laser. A Beagle Probe augments the Mechs scouting capabilities.
column2: 40 吨的蝉于 2740 年推出，是作为蝗虫的竞争机型开发的。它的武器略好、速度相当，而更厚重的装甲与更强的近战能力使它能够成为有效的轻型机甲猎手与侦察兵。蝉 3G 由一台 320 额定 XL 引擎驱动，装备一对中型激光与一门 ER 大型激光。一具 Beagle 探测器进一步增强了该机甲的侦察能力。

column1: The PXH-1VC is Golden Star Entertainments most expensive marketing stunt in the congolmerates history. It is also a Mech. I think I have copy of Gothic season 1 somewhere; if you want to watch ancient history, boss.
column2: PXH-1VC 是 Golden Star Entertainment 在集团历史上最昂贵的营销噱头。它也是一台机甲。我想我哪儿还存着《Gothic》第一季的拷贝；要是你想看古代史的话，老板。

column1: The Phoenix Hawk 2L was one of the first new mechs to be produced under the Long Road initiative. A compete overhaul designed to be compatible with the myriad PXH-1 variants found throughout the Periphery, the redesign takes advantage of Lushan Industries production license for the new ER Large Laser. Mounting this in place of the original Large Laser, the weapons increased heat is balanced by the inclusion of 2 extra heat sinks; with an Endo steel chassis providing the necessary free weight. Retaining the medium lasers and the Guardian ECM suite, the 2L is a cheap upgrade for anyone fielding a PXH-1 design. Available for export throughout the Periphery, the only constraint to production is the lack of a production facility for the PXH chassis, though Alliance Mech Works has plans to build a dedicated PHX line should the design prove popular. Until then the current output is limited to in-situ conversions of existing mechs and the restoration of battlefield salvage.
column2: 凤凰鹰 2L 是“长路”计划下首批投产的新机甲之一。这一彻底重制旨在与遍布外围星域的各种 PXH-1 改型兼容，并利用了 Lushan Industries 对新型 ER 大型激光的生产许可。它以此取代原有的大型激光，武器增加的热量则由额外两具散热器平衡；钢内骨结构钢底盘提供了所需的富余重量。2L 保留了中型激光与 Guardian ECM 套件，对任何装备 PXH-1 设计的人来说都是一次廉价升级。该型号可供外围星域各地出口，唯一制约产量的是缺少 PXH 底盘的生产设施，不过 Alliance Mech Works 已计划在证明该设计受欢迎后建造一条专门的 PHX 生产线。在此之前，当前产量仅限于对现有机甲的就地改装与战场战利品的修复。

column1: First introduced by the Terran Hegemony in 2568, the Phoenix Hawk was one of the most well known BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere. The 'Mech began life when Orguss Industries realized that it could reinforce the Stinger chassis to create a larger version, one with the same speed and maneuverability as the Stinger but with superior armor, firepower and electronics. Though not without its own drawbacks, the Phoenix Hawk quickly became the standard by which all other reconnaissance 'Mechs were measured.
column2: 凤凰鹰由泰拉霸权于 2568 年首次推出，是内层星域最广为人知的战斗机甲之一。它诞生于 Orguss Industries 意识到可以通过加固毒刺底盘来创造一款更大的版本——速度与机动性和毒刺相同，却拥有更优的装甲、火力与电子设备。尽管自身也有缺点，凤凰鹰很快就成为衡量其他所有侦察机甲的标准。

column1: A Clan Buster upgrade, the Phoenix Hawk 1bC was a Comstar refit built with damaged Phoenix Hawk 1b’s inherited from the 112th Royal Hussar regiment of the SLDF. Powered by a 270 XL Engine and possessing an Endo Steel chassis, the PHX-1bC is armed with an ER Large Laser and a pair of Medium Lasers. A Narc Beacon and 4 tons of ammo allow the Mech to spot for allied artillery and support assets, while a Flamer gives the Mech some anti-infantry capability. The 1b’s CASE and Guardian ECM are retained.
column2: 作为“氏族杀手”升级项目之一，凤凰鹰 1bC 是通讯之星的改装型号，以从 SLDF 第 112 皇家骠骑兵团继承下来的受损凤凰鹰 1b 为基础打造。PHX-1bC 由一台 270 XL 引擎驱动，并拥有钢内骨结构钢底盘，装备一门 ER 大型激光与两门中型激光。一枚 NARC 信标与 4 吨弹药让该机甲能为友军火炮与支援资产指示目标，而一具喷火器则赋予它一定的反步兵能力。1b 的 CASE 与 Guardian ECM 均予以保留。

column1: The 1D variant of the Phoenix Hawk was commonly used by the forces of House Davion. Introduced in 2856, it removes both of the machine guns and the ammunition and replaces them with two additional heat sinks. While removing a small amount of the 'Mech's short-range firepower and a powerful set of weapons against infantry, the additional heat sinks made the 1D's heat load more manageable.
column2: 凤凰鹰的 1D 改型为戴维昂家族部队普遍使用。它于 2856 年推出，拆除了两挺机枪及其弹药，换成两具额外散热器。虽然这让该机甲的短程火力、尤其是对付步兵的强力武器有所削弱，但额外散热器使 1D 的热量负担更易于管理。

column1: The 3S model of this 'Mech, first deployed in 3042, was another upgrade using rediscovered technology that attempted to make the Phoenix Hawk even more effective for reconnaissance. The engine was upgraded to an ExtraLight version and ten double heat sinks improved heat management. The overall armor protection was increased by one ton and replaced with Lexington Ltd. High Grade Ferro-Fibrous armor. The primary weapon on the 'Mech was a Thunderbolt-12 Large Pulse Laser built into the right arm, though it still retained the two medium lasers and machine guns of the original. Additionally an anti-missile system was mounted on the right arm, with its two tons of ammo (along with two tons of machine gun ammo) protected by CASE in the left torso. Its primary difference from other variants introduced during the time period was the addition of a MASC system, which allowed the 'Mech to reach speeds of up to 129.6 in short bursts.
column2: 这款机甲的 3S 型号于 3042 年首次部署，是又一次利用重新发现的技术进行的升级，力图让凤凰鹰成为更有效的侦察机甲。引擎升级为超轻型版本，十具双联散热器改善了热量管理。整体装甲防护增加一吨，并更换为 Lexington Ltd. High Grade 铁纤维装甲。该机甲的主武器是一门内置于右臂的 Thunderbolt-12 大型脉冲激光，但仍保留原有的两门中型激光与机枪。此外，右臂还安装了一套反导弹系统，其两吨弹药（连同两吨机枪弹药）由左躯干的 CASE 保护。它与同期推出的其他改型的主要区别在于加装了 MASC 系统，使该机甲能在短时冲刺中达到 129.6 的速度。

column1: Another contender for the claim of the infamous gladiator Gray Noton's 'Mech 'Legend-Killer'. As with the other claimants it is not known if this was the actual one or if in fact Noton had several different 'Mechs. This version is an upgraded Rifleman II , which fits with the rumours of Noton bringing back LosTech from the periphery when he returned to conquer the Solaris VII Class Five arenas for seven consecutive years.
column2: 又一个声称是那位臭名昭著的角斗士格雷·诺顿座机“传奇杀手”的候选者。与其他候选者一样，无从得知它是否就是真正的机体，甚至不确定诺顿是否拥有过数台不同的机甲。这个版本是升级后的步枪兵 II，这与传闻相符：诺顿回归并连续七年征服索拉里斯七号五级竞技场时，从外围星域带回了失落科技。

column1: Yet another 'Mech that could possibly be the 'Legend-Killer' piloted by Gray Noton in the Solaris VII arenas. The 'Mech just barely fits the name of the Rifleman, as many parts of the chassis have been replaced from heavier Assault 'Mechs.
column2: 又一台可能是在索拉里斯七号竞技场中由格雷·诺顿驾驶的“传奇杀手”。这台机甲勉强还配得上步枪兵之名，因为其底盘的许多部件都已用更重的突击机甲部件替换。

column1: The 3D variant of this 'Mech was introduced in 3048, based on the 1D used by Davion forces. It was built out of New Avalon by Archenar BattleMechs as one of a slew of redesigns using recovered lostech. The 'Mech utilized Endo Steel construction techniques and a Extra-Light engine to free up weight and space for a number of improvements, particularly its weaponry. The 'Mech carried a pair of ER Large Lasers and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers split between both arms. With the machine guns and their ammunition removed, this allowed two additional heat sinks to be added, and all single heat sinks were exchanged for double strength models.
column2: 这款机甲的 3D 改型于 3048 年推出，以戴维昂部队使用的 1D 为基础。它由 Archenar BattleMechs 在新阿瓦隆制造，是一系列采用复得失落科技重新设计的型号之一。该机甲利用钢内骨结构钢构造技术与一台超轻型引擎，腾出重量与空间用于多项改进，尤其是武器。它携带一对 ER 大型激光与一对中型脉冲激光，分装于两条手臂上。机枪及其弹药被拆除后，得以加装两具额外散热器，所有单联散热器也都换成了双联型号。

column1: The 3K Phoenix Hawk was another upgrade of the design that used rediscovered technologies, built by Alshain Weapons and GKT Enterprises for House Kurita and the Free Rasalhague Republic respectively. Introduced in 3050, the engine was upgraded to an XL model, with the saved weight used to upgrade the weapons payload on the 'Mech, taking its cues from the 1K variant. Like the PXH-3D model the 3K carries carries two ER large lasers and two medium Lasers. It also carried twelve double heat sinks to manage the additional waste heat, and the eight tons of standard armor were replaced with the same amount of New Samarkand Royal Ferro-Fibrous armor, improving its survivability.
column2: 凤凰鹰 3K 是又一次采用重新发现技术的升级，分别由 Alshain Weapons 与 GKT Enterprises 为栗田家族和自由拉萨尔哈格共和国建造。它于 3050 年推出，引擎升级为 XL 型号，节省的重量用于提升该机甲的武器载荷，其思路沿袭自 1K 改型。与 PXH-3D 一样，3K 携带两门 ER 大型激光与两门中型激光。它还带有十二具双联散热器来管理额外废热，八吨标准装甲则被等量的 New Samarkand Royal 铁纤维装甲取代，提升了生存能力。

column1: The 3M variant of the 'Mech was also introduced in 3048, built by Earthwerks Incorporated from their Keystone factory and using upgrades based on rediscovered Star League technology. First, the internal structure of the 'Mech has been redesigned to utilize a 1A Type7 Endo Steel chassis. The engine was then replaced with a GM 270 XL and the heat sinks were upgraded to double heat sinks. This allowed the weapons payload to be changed extensively, with all of the original weapons being stripped from the chassis. In their place the 'Mech carried two Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Lasers as its primary weapons and two Martell Medium Pulse Lasers for close in work, with one of each mounted in either arm. Finally, a MainFire Point Defense Anti-Missile System replaced the right-arm machine gun, with two tons of both AMS and machine gun reloads carried in the CASE-protected left torso. The electronic systems were also replaced with an Achernar Electronics HID-8 comm system and Federated Hunter target-tracking system.
column2: 这款机甲的 3M 改型同样于 3048 年推出，由 Earthwerks Incorporated 在其 Keystone 工厂建造，并采用基于重新发现的星际联盟技术的升级。首先，机甲内部结构经重新设计，改用 1A Type7 钢内骨结构钢底盘。随后引擎被换成一台 GM 270 XL，散热器也升级为双联散热器。这让武器载荷得以大规模调整，原有武器全部从底盘上拆除。取而代之的是两门 Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER 大型激光作为主武器，以及两门 Martell 中型脉冲激光用于近距离作战，每条手臂各装一门。最后，一套 MainFire Point Defense 反导弹系统取代了右臂机枪，其两吨 AMS 弹药与机枪弹药一同存放在受 CASE 保护的左躯干中。电子系统也换成了 Achernar Electronics HID-8 通讯系统与 Federated Hunter 目标追踪系统。

column1: Long-Range Support
column2: 远程支援

column1: The Bloodlust is a custom Vulcan variant.Weaponry consists of two Machine Guns in the Left Arm, while a Small Laser and another Machine Gun round out the Right Arm. The Head, Right and Left Torso each carry an SRM-4, while four tons of ammo help keep the SRM's sufficiently supplied. Like all the current variants of the Canon versions, the Bloodlust is jump capable, however, has Standard Heat Sink capability.
column2: Bloodlust 是一台定制的火神改型。其武器包括左臂的两挺机枪，右臂则有一门小型激光与另一挺机枪。头部、右躯干与左躯干各携带一具 SRM-4，四吨弹药足以让这些 SRM 获得充分补给。与官方版本目前的所有改型一样，Bloodlust 具备跳跃能力，但使用的是标准散热器。

column1: A further update of the -5T, the -6M uses Endo-Steel structure and an XL engine, drops half a ton of the Machine Gun ammunition and switches to Double Heatsinks. As a result the variant is able to replace the Lasers with 4 Medium Pulse Lasers, add a C3 slave unit, increase the amount of armor, upgrade the rating of the engine core to 280 and add an extra Jump Jet.
column2: 这是对 -5T 的进一步更新，-6M 采用钢内骨结构钢结构与一台 XL 引擎，削减半吨机枪弹药并改用双联散热器。因此该改型得以用 4 门中型脉冲激光取代原有激光，增设一个 C3 从属单元，增加装甲量，将引擎核心额定值提升至 280，并增设一具跳跃推进器。

column1: The Wolfman was first created by Valdis Ullman, a MechWarrior belonging to the Legion of Vega, on Bergman's Planet during the Second Battle of Ryersson in 2986. Originally piloting a Wolverine, his BattleMech was damaged in a fight with a Davion Marauder, with most of its upper body damaged or destroyed. Fortunately, a Davion Rifleman had been destroyed only a hundred meters away from his 'Mech. The Rifleman had suffered damage to its torso and legs. Ullman's personal technician, Sharis Brand thought that the two 'Mechs could be merged together, taking the intact legs and hips from Ullman's Wolverine and combining it with the torso and arms from the Rifleman.
column2: 狼人最初由贝加军团（Legion of Vega）的机甲战士瓦尔迪斯·乌尔曼于 2986 年在 Bergman's Planet 的第二次 Ryersson 战役期间创造。他原本驾驶一台狼獾，在与一台戴维昂掠夺者的交战中受损，上半身大部分被毁或摧毁。幸运的是，一台戴维昂步枪兵就在他机甲仅一百米外被击毁。那台步枪兵的躯干与腿部受损。乌尔曼的私人技师莎丽丝·布兰德认为可以把两台机甲拼合起来，取乌尔曼狼獾完好的腿部与髋部，与步枪兵的躯干和手臂组合。

column1: Clan Early Close Support
column2: 氏族早期近距支援

column1: The VL-2TR replaces the Flamer in the Right Arm and the external Heat Sink with a C3 slave unit in the head, increasing the Vulcans in-lance performance.
column2: VL-2TR 以头部的一个 C3 从属单元替换了右臂的喷火器与外置散热器，提升了火神在小队内的作战表现。

column1: Piloted by Richard Timms of the 3rd Davion Guards during the failed attack on Vega during the War of 3039. The Machine Guns, ammo and Medium Laser were replaced with two additional Flamers and a Small laser.
column2: 该机由第 3 戴维昂卫队的理查德·蒂姆斯驾驶，参与了 3039 年战争期间对 Vega 的那次失败进攻。机枪、弹药与中型激光被替换为两具额外喷火器和一门小型激光。

column1: The 10P model is an upgrade of the 10N model introduced by the Federated Commonwealth amid much secrecy in 3049. The 10P retains the armor and speed profile of the 10N, removes one of the SRM-6 launchers and replaces it with two Streak SRM-2 launchers. While sacrificing slightly in terms of firepower, this variant is far more ammo-efficient than the original
column2: 10P 型号是联邦太阳国于 3049 年在高度保密中推出的 10N 型号的升级版。10P 保留了 10N 的装甲与速度特性，拆除了其中一具 SRM-6 发射器，换成两具 Streak SRM-2 发射器。虽然火力略有牺牲，但该改型在弹药效率上远胜原版

column1: The original 3024 prototype of what became the RVN-3L Raven, this was the unit that was pressed into service against the Federated Suns during the Fourth Succession War. With XL engine technology not yet available, the 'Mech mounted a standard Omni 175 fusion engine, giving it a maximum speed of 86 km/h, and was protected by four tons of standard armor. The EW Equipment at the time that this 'Mech was built consisted of a massive 7.5 ton experimental electronic warfare suite that unfortunately did not live up to expectations.
column2: 这是后来成为 RVN-3L 渡鸦的原型机（3024 年版），正是它在第四次继承战争期间被投入对联邦太阳国的作战。当时 XL 引擎技术尚不可用，该机甲安装一台标准 Omni 175 聚变引擎，最高时速 86 公里/小时，并由四吨标准装甲防护。该机甲建造时所用的电子战设备是一套重达 7.5 吨的大型实验性电子战套件，遗憾的是它并未达到预期。

column1: Many of the Ravens captured by the Federated Suns in the Fourth Succession War were refitted in 3030 to the 2X standard. This variant replaced the EW equipment with a Large Laser.
column2: 联邦太阳国在第四次继承战争中缴获的许多渡鸦于 3030 年被改装至 2X 标准。该改型以一门大型激光取代了电子战设备。

column1: Sneak Archery Meta
column2: 潜行射击流派

column1: Whoever this "Jonathon" was, he had access to some very high-tech equipment. A pair of Enhanced LRM-20 Artemis launchers are backed up by a handheld "Avenger Rifle", which is some kind of hand-held RAC/5 comparable to the best RISC technology. Maybe it would be more appropriate to call that thing the primary weapon, as it carries more than twice as much ammo as the meager three tons of missiles. This is all wrapped in a thick shell of top-of-the-line mimetic stealth armor.
column2: 不管这位“乔纳森”是谁，他都能接触到一些极其高端的装备。一对增强型 LRM-20 Artemis 发射器之外，还有一把手持的“复仇者步枪”（Avenger Rifle），某种堪比最顶尖 RISC 技术的手持式 RAC/5。也许把那样东西称作主武器更合适，因为它的弹药量是那可怜的三吨导弹的两倍还多。而这一切都包裹在一层最顶级的拟态隐形装甲厚壳之中。

column1: Introduced in 2752, the 10A is a long-range harasser. Both SRM-6 racks are replaced by one LRM-15 in the right torso with one ton of reloads.
column2: 10A 于 2752 年推出，是一款远程骚扰机型。两具 SRM-6 挂架均被拆除，换成位于右躯干的一具 LRM-15，配一吨再装填弹药。

column1: The predecessor to the original Flea FLE-4 model, the Trooper TP-1R prototype was built in 2475, by Toddlette Industries, on a primitive chassis and maintained ground speeds of nearly 100 km/h.
column2: 作为原始跳蚤 FLE-4 型号的前身，Trooper TP-1R 原型机由 Toddlette Industries 于 2475 年建造，采用原始底盘，地面速度接近 100 公里/小时。

column1: Introduced in 2740, the 40 ton Cicada was developed as a competitor to the Locust. Slightly better armed and just as fast, the Cicada’s heavier armor and better melee capabilities enable it to function as an effective Light Mech hunter and scout. Powered by a 320-rated XL Engine, the Cicada 3M is armed with a pair of Medium Lasers, a Small pulse Laser and a UAC/5.
column2: 40 吨的蝉于 2740 年推出，是作为蝗虫的竞争机型开发的。它的武器略好、速度相当，而更厚重的装甲与更强的近战能力使它能够成为有效的轻型机甲猎手与侦察兵。蝉 3M 由一台 320 额定 XL 引擎驱动，装备一对中型激光、一门小型脉冲激光与一门 UAC/5。

column1: A Clan Buster upgrade, the Rifleman 5CS was a Comstar refit designed with the aim of extending the Rifleman’s battlefield endurance. Replacing the original 240-rated Fusion Core with a larger 300-rated XL Engine increased the Mechs speed and allowed for the installation of additional armor. DHS replaced the original SHS, reducing the chronic overheating issues that plagued the Rifleman, while the AC/5’s were upgraded to a pair of UAC/5’s with 2 tons of ammo. The pair of Large Lasers remain, but the 2 Medium Lasers were removed to make space for the UAC ammo.
column2: 作为“氏族杀手”升级项目之一，步枪兵 5CS 是通讯之星设计的改装型号，旨在延长步枪兵在战场上的续航力。它以一台更大的 300 额定 XL 引擎取代原有的 240 额定聚变核心，提升了机甲速度，也让它得以加装额外装甲。DHS 取代了原有的 SHS，减轻了长期困扰步枪兵的过热问题，而两门 AC/5 则升级为一对 UAC/5，配 2 吨弹药。两门大型激光保留下来，但两门中型激光被拆除，为 UAC 弹药腾出空间。

column1: A recovered-technology version of the RFL-4D, the 5D was introduced in 3050 for the Federated Commonwealth. Based on the earlier 4D, it replaces the PPCs with ER PPC models and restores the original model's medium lasers to the side torsos. A 240-rated XL engine was used to free up weight for the mounting of seventeen double heat sinks and an increase in armor protection to nine tons. Production of this model was taken up by Kallon Industries on Talon, Trellshire Industires on Twycross and Red Devil Industries on Pandora.
column2: 作为 RFL-4D 的复得技术版本，5D 于 3050 年为联邦太阳国推出。它以早先的 4D 为基础，用 ER PPC 型号取代 PPC，并恢复了原型号装于两侧躯干的中型激光。一台 240 额定 XL 引擎腾出了重量，用于安装十七具双联散热器，并把装甲防护提升至九吨。该型号的生产由 Talon 的 Kallon Industries、Twycross 的 Trellshire Industires 与 Pandora 的 Red Devil Industries 承接。

column1: The RFL-4R uses the combination of Endo Steel structure and Ferro-Fibrous armor to free enough weight to increase the armoring significantly while still allowing the use of two LB-X AC/5s.
column2: RFL-4R 结合运用钢内骨结构钢结构与铁纤维装甲，腾出了足够重量以大幅增加装甲，同时仍能使用两门 LB-X AC/5。

column1: Developed by Clan Goliath Scorpion, the Phoenix Hawk PHX-1-EC was an upgrade of the earlier PHX-1. Designed at the start of the Golden Age, the PHX-1-EC is built around a 270-rated Fusion Core and is armed with an Improved Large Laser. A pair of prototype ER Medium Lasers and an AMS make up the rest of the PHX-1-EC’s weapons.
column2: 由歌利亚蝎氏族开发，凤凰鹰 PHX-1-EC 是早先 PHX-1 的升级版。它在黄金时代之初设计，围绕一台 270 额定聚变核心构建，装备一门改进型大型激光。一对原型 ER 中型激光与一套 AMS 构成了 PHX-1-EC 的其余武器。

column1: Introduced in 2740, the 40 ton Cicada was developed as a competitor to the Locust. Slightly better armed and just as fast, the Cicada’s heavier armor and better melee capabilities enable it to function as an effective Light Mech hunter and scout. Powered by a 280-rated Fusion Core, the Cicada 3K is armed with a pair of MRM-20’s.
column2: 40 吨的蝉于 2740 年推出，是作为蝗虫的竞争机型开发的。它的武器略好、速度相当，而更厚重的装甲与更强的近战能力使它能够成为有效的轻型机甲猎手与侦察兵。蝉 3K 由一台 280 额定聚变核心驱动，装备一对 MRM-20。

column1: The 'Dao Breaker' is a custom Solaris VII 'Mech configured to carry twin class 5 Autocannons, twin Large Lasers and twin Medium Lasers.
column2: “破道者”是一台索拉里斯七号定制机甲，配置为携带两门 5 级自动炮、两门大型激光与两门中型激光。

column1: A prototype further development of the base Rifleman design created by an Inner Sphere design collective a few years before the Clan invasion. The IIA chassis uses its 20 ton increased carry capacity for a combination of long range energy and ballistic weaponry and uses a C3 slave unit to improve the lance performance.
column2: 这是基础步枪兵设计的进一步原型开发机型，由内层星域的一个设计团队在氏族入侵前几年打造。IIA 底盘利用其增加的 20 吨承载能力，组合了远程能量与弹道武器，并使用一个 C3 从属单元来提升小队表现。

column1: Designed by the same team as the RFL-IIA, this variant uses a pair of LBX/10 Autocannons, twin ER Large Lasers, two leg mounted LRM-5s and a TAG. It never went beyond early prototype stage, as many of the issues of the original Rifleman was inherited.
column2: 与 RFL-IIA 出自同一设计团队，该改型使用一对 LBX/10 自动炮、两门 ER 大型激光、两具装于腿部的 LRM-5 以及一个 TAG。它始终停留在早期原型阶段，因为原版步枪兵的许多问题都被它继承了下来。

column1: The 5M is another product of the Gray Death Memory Core technology boon, built by Kallon Industries at Thermopolis for the Free Worlds League. Introduced in 3049, it retained the same energy weapons as the original 3N but replaced the standard autocannons with Imperator Ultra models; though the ammunition load remained a single ton, it was moved to the right torso and protected by CASE. Twelve double heat sinks were mounted and another ton of Kallon Royalstar armor was carried. The free weight for all these changes was created by the use of an Hermes 240 XL Engine. One thing which wasn't replaced however were the Garret comms and targeting systems.
column2: 5M 是灰死军团记忆核心技术红利的又一产物，由 Kallon Industries 在 Thermopolis 为自由世界同盟建造。它于 3049 年推出，保留了原版 3N 的能量武器，但把标准自动炮换成 Imperator 超级型号；弹药量仍是单吨，不过被移到右躯干并由 CASE 保护。安装了十二具双联散热器，并多携带一吨 Kallon Royalstar 装甲。所有这些改动所需的富余重量来自一台 Hermes 240 XL 引擎。唯一没有被替换的，是 Garret 通讯与瞄准系统。

column1: Gray Noton's infamous 'Legend-Killer' used LosTech, outfitted with an 240-rated XL engine and built on an Endo Steel frame to free up the weight to swap the classic RFL-3N's AC/5s for LB-X Autocannon/10s fed with three tons of reloads. With the RFL-3N's Large and Medium Lasers retained, the remaining weight saved after the LB-X autocannons goes towards an extra half ton of armor while a swap to double heat sinks gives it unexpected endurance in the arenas.
column2: 格雷·诺顿那台臭名昭著的“传奇杀手”使用了失落科技，装配 240 额定 XL 引擎，并建造在钢内骨结构钢框架上，从而腾出重量，把经典 RFL-3N 的 AC/5 换成 LB-X 自动炮/10，配三吨再装填弹药。RFL-3N 的大型与中型激光均予保留，LB-X 自动炮之后剩余节省的重量用于增加半吨装甲，而改用双联散热器则让它在竞技场中拥有意想不到的续航力。

column1: Custom BattleMech
column2: 定制战斗机甲

column1:
Having grown up on All Dawn - a backwater agricultural world - Nathan worked on a farm raising Dutch Pygmy Rabbits and knew nothing of combat. That is not to say he wasn't familiar with the violence that came with living on the fringes of the Inner Sphere. With All Dawn being on the outskirts of Steiner-controlled territory, he was no stranger to regular harassment from pirates.

After a series of increasingly brutal raids on their settlement, Nathan finally worked up the courage to defend his home. Rallying together a local militia, they managed to give the raiders a taste of their own medicine with improvised explosives made from one of the most readily available resources on the world - fertilizer. But, the victory would prove to be pyrrhic: Upon returning to his farm, he found the pirates had set fire to his farmhouse - with all of his little fuzzy friends inside.

In light of such a loss, Nathan picked up what few belongings remained and left to join a small-time mercenary outfit where he endeavored to shape himself into the bulwark upon which Hell itself would break.

In memoriam of his lost friends and the hope and joy that Nathan believed they brought to the world, he took on the callsign: HBFT - Happy Bunny Fluffy Toes.
column2:
内森在一个名为 All Dawn 的偏远农业星球上长大，在农场里饲养荷兰侏儒兔，对战斗一无所知。这并不是说他对生活在内层星域边缘所伴随的暴力一无所知。由于 All Dawn 位于施泰纳控制区的外围，他对海盗的频繁骚扰并不陌生。

在定居点接连遭受愈发残暴的袭击之后，内森终于鼓起勇气保卫家园。他召集起一支当地民兵，用该星球上最容易获取的资源之一——肥料——制成简易炸药，让袭击者尝到了自己的苦头。然而这场胜利代价惨重：回到农场时，他发现海盗已经放火焚烧了他的农舍——他所有毛茸茸的小朋友都在里面。

面对这样的损失，内森收拾起所剩无几的财物，加入了一支小规模佣兵部队，在那里他努力把自己锻造成一道连地狱都会在其上撞碎的壁垒。

为纪念失去的朋友，以及内森相信它们曾带给这世界的希望与欢乐，他取了个呼号：HBFT——快乐兔子毛绒脚掌（Happy Bunny Fluffy Toes）。

column1: As a slightly lighter armed long range bombardment variant, the Adder-C 'only' sports two LRM-15 launchers as the main armament... And also an additional launcher for NARC Homing Beacons. You can't hide anywhere if you have one of those stuck on your hull. For CQC and as a non ammo-dependent backup weapon, a single Medium Pulse Laser can absolutely ruin the day for ambushers who think the LRM support mech might be an easy kill.
column2: 作为一款武器略轻的远程轰击改型，Adder-C“仅仅”以两具 LRM-15 发射器作为主武器……另外还有一具用于发射 NARC 寻的信标的额外发射器。只要那东西粘在你车体上，你躲到哪儿都没用。用于近距混战以及作为不依赖弹药的备用武器，一门中型脉冲激光足以让那些以为 LRM 支援机好欺负的伏击者彻底倒霉。

column1: For a mech of just 35 tons this little turtle sports a lot of long range support firepower in form of 40 LRM tubes, which can scare away even much much larger enemies. For close range, self-defense or a last effort push if the ammo bins are empty, the ADR-A carries 2 Small Pulse Lasers.
column2: 对于一台仅 35 吨的小机甲而言，这只小乌龟却拥有大量远程支援火力——共 40 根 LRM 发射管，足以吓退远比它庞大的敌人。用于近距自卫，或在弹药舱打空后做最后挣扎时，ADR-A 携带 2 门小型脉冲激光。

column1:
Doyle is a seasoned mercenary pilot who started his career with the Ghost Warriors Brigade. He quickly got frustrated with their lack of drive and ambition, and soon found himself signing up and fighting with the Steel Jaguars, a merc unit that prided themselves on their dedication to tough training, hard work and excellence in the field of battle. Before too long, Doyle had become an integral part of the battalion he fought for. He found himself fighting in every available mission, building up a wealth of knowledge and experience, and eventually he was given a promotion. But it was his next promotion, the one that he never wanted, that would end up shaping his future.

One day, their Commanding Officer walked away after deciding that he was unable to continue in his position. The CO quitting the life of a mercenary left Doyle to take on his post. Doyle didn't want this position but, after looking around and deciding that if he left it to someone else they would probably get him killed, he decided to take the job. He led the battalion through a series of successful missions, but never truly saw eye to eye with the company's owner. There were many straws but - as they say - the last one finally broke the camel's back, and Doyle decided to leave the Steel Jaguars to form his own company from the ground up.

What he didn't expect was for the vast majority of his former battalion to follow him, but so they did. Finding himself in possession of almost a full battalion's worth of seasoned merc pilots, he struck out with his new company after naming them The Sanguine Tigers. Years later, a merge with a friendly fellow merc unit - known as 9th Blood and Fire - saw the company renamed to The 9th Sanguine Tigers, and they spent many happy years taking contracts and kicking ass. Until, one day, Doyle decided he needed a change of pace. To give up the life of a merc and to settle down. Which he tried to do, but not before a brief but lucrative spell as a Solaris VII jock...

Old habits die hard, however, and it turned out the peaceful life wasn't for him after all. He set out once more to find the thrill of the battlefield, working for any company that was happy to take on a grizzled old veteran pilot - as long as they promised to never give him a promotion.
column2:
多伊尔是一位经验丰富的佣兵机师，职业生涯始于幽灵战士旅（Ghost Warriors Brigade）。他很快便对他们缺乏干劲与雄心感到失望，不久便签约加入并与钢豹（Steel Jaguars）并肩作战——这支部队以严苛训练、勤奋工作与战场上的卓越表现而自豪。没过多久，多伊尔就成了他所在营不可或缺的一员。他几乎参与了所有能参加的任务，积累了丰富的知识与经验，最终获得晋升。但正是下一次晋升——他从未想要的那一次——最终塑造了他的未来。

某天，他们的指挥官在认定自己无法继续履职后一走了之。指挥官弃佣兵生涯而去，让多伊尔不得不接任其职位。多伊尔并不想要这个位置，但环顾四周后他判断，若交给别人，那人多半会把他害死，于是他决定接下这份工作。他带领该营完成了一系列成功任务，却始终与公司老板看法不合。压垮骆驼的稻草有许多根，而正如人们所说——最后一根终于还是断了，多伊尔决定离开钢豹，从零开始组建自己的公司。

他没料到的是，昔日营中的绝大多数人都跟着他走了，但他们确实如此。发现自己拥有几乎整整一个营的老练佣兵机师后，他带领新公司出发，并将其命名为“血色猛虎”（The Sanguine Tigers）。数年后，与一支友好的友军佣兵部队——名为“第九血与火”（9th Blood and Fire）——合并，公司更名为“第九血色猛虎”，此后他们度过了多年愉快的时光，接合约、揍敌人。直到有一天，多伊尔决定需要换个节奏：放弃佣兵生涯，安顿下来。他试着这么做了，但在那之前还短暂而收益丰厚地当了一阵子索拉里斯七号的角斗士……

然而旧习难改，事实证明平静的生活终究不适合他。他再次出发去寻找战场的刺激，为任何乐意接纳一位饱经风霜的老兵的连队工作——只要他们承诺永远不给他升职。

column1:
Garrison is a true son of Arcturus, the one-time capital system of the Lyran Commonwealth - and like any good citizen of the Commonwealth, he joined the military as soon as he was of age. He tested well in the VR pods and was promptly sent to Coventry Military Academy. There he excelled in his tactics classes and was put on a fast track to being assigned to a line unit as a replacement to the ever increasing losses caused by the Third Succession War. Being given an early commission with the severely depleted Sixth Arcturian Guards, Garrison was sent to Starshine at the age of 21.

On Starshine, he was assigned to be First Leutnant of a support lance, and he was able to make excellent use of his academy training against pirate raiders and Free Worlds League units.

"Where is Starshine?", you may ask. Well, don't bother looking for it on star maps, it's a dead world now. What about the Sixth Arcturian Guards? They no longer show on the rolls of active units for the Commonwealth - yet Garrison was there at the end of both.

Barely a year into his new assignment, Garrison was thrust right into action. During the Marik Civil War of 3014 (also known as Anton's Revolt), the Commonwealth decided to take advantage of the situation and sent the Sixth in to raid Griffith. With the chaos of Anton's Revolt, the 1st Fusiliers of Oriente were slow to respond and the Sixth's raid was considered a rousing success. During the fighting, Garrison would bait the enemy into terrain of his choosing to allow his support lance to pepper the opposing force with indirect fire while performing slow withdrawals toward the other lances in his company. The Hauptmann of the company took to saying the OpFor got 'Garrisoned' and it wasn't long before it stuck as his callsign.

Returning to their post on Starshine, the Sixth was celebrating their victory in one of the larger domed habitats when the Fusiliers got their revenge. Performing a Hover-Drop Maneuver, a mobile force of Fusiliers attacked, catching the Sixth completely unaware. Scrambling to get back to his 'Mech, Garrison found he was cut off by the Fusiliers forces. Over the next few days, he bided his time until opportunity knocked in the form of a Fusiliers Hunchback 4P that was left in the old Sixth depot area for repairs. Subduing the technicians, Garrison took control of the 'Mech and made his escape. There are many stories about what happened next, but the one thing every story has in common is that the depot was set off, causing a chain reaction that destroyed the Star League era air purifying system that kept the planetary domes habitable. This ultimately led to the world being abandoned in the next few years - another casualty of the Succession Wars.

While the 1st Fusiliers of Oriente made it off-world mostly intact, the same could not be said for the Sixth. Between their losses during the surprise assault, and the destruction of the depot - the Sixth ceased to be a solvent unit. Garrisoned was one of the few to escape with his life and his new 'Mech. But, even this bit of luck didn't last. While in transit to the Jump Point, the Black Raiders pirates took advantage of the chaos and attempted to capture the DropShip ferrying Garrison and his 'Mech. During a strafing run by a Black Raider AeroSpace Fighter, a freak accident occurred with the restraint system in the MechBay, and the LRM pods on the Hunchback triggered. It seemed that the techs had forgotten to remove the load during the frenzy to get off-world. The explosion caused a systematic failure resulting in the loading bay door opening and all unsecured equipment being blown into space, including Garrison's HBK-4P. While the DropShip was able to escape, Garrison was now without a unit, without a world and without a 'Mech.

Considering his past - knowing that both the world and unit he last served on have passed from existence - many believe Garrison to be jinxed. And considering how he wound up dispossessed and in the hiring halls, there may be something to it. But Garrisoned is a skilled tactician, and he has a plan to get back in the game - even if he has had to take his lumps as a merc for nearly a decade.
column2:
加里森是阿图鲁斯的真正儿子——这颗星球曾是莱兰联邦的首府星系——像任何一位优秀的联邦公民一样，他一到年龄便参军入伍。他在 VR 模拟舱中成绩优异，随即被送往考文垂军事学院。在那里他在战术课上表现突出，被列入快速通道，作为替补去填补第三次继承战争造成日益惨重损失的一线部队。他早早获得任命，加入严重缺编的第 6 阿图鲁斯卫队，21 岁时被派往 Starshine。

在 Starshine，他被任命为一个支援小队的中尉（First Leutnant），得以把学院训练卓有成效地用于对抗海盗袭击者与自由世界同盟部队。

“Starshine 在哪儿？”你可能会问。别费劲去星图上找了，它如今是一颗死星。那第 6 阿图鲁斯卫队呢？他们已不再出现在联邦现役部队名册上——然而加里森却见证了二者的终结。

新岗位上任还不到一年，加里森就被推入了行动。在 3014 年的马里卡内战（又称安东之乱）期间，联邦决定趁势派第 6 卫队突袭 Griffith。由于安东之乱造成的混乱，Oriente 第 1 燧发枪团反应迟缓，第 6 卫队的突袭被认为大获成功。战斗中，加里森会把敌人引诱到他选定的地形，让他的支援小队以间接火力扫射对手，同时朝连队其他小队缓慢后撤。该连的上尉（Hauptmann）开始说敌方“被加里森了”（got 'Garrisoned'），没多久这就成了他的呼号。

第 6 卫队返回 Starshine 驻地后，正在一座较大的穹顶居住区庆祝胜利时，燧发枪团发动了复仇。他们实施“悬停空投”机动，一支机动部队突袭而来，将第 6 卫队打了个措手不及。加里森匆忙赶回自己的机甲，却发现已被燧发枪团部队切断。接下来的几天里，他耐心等待时机，直到机会敲门：一台被留在第 6 卫队旧仓库区维修的燧发枪团 Hunchback 4P。制服技师后，加里森控制住这台机甲并成功脱逃。关于随后发生的事有许多说法，但所有说法都有一个共同点：仓库被引爆，引发连锁反应，摧毁了维持行星穹顶宜居的星际联盟时代空气净化系统。这最终导致该星球在此后数年内被废弃——继承战争的又一名受害者。

虽然 Oriente 第 1 燧发枪团基本完好地撤离了星球，第 6 卫队就没这么幸运了。加上突袭中的损失与仓库被毁，第 6 卫队不再是一支能维持运转的部队。加里森是少数带着性命与新机甲逃脱的人之一。但即便是这点运气也没能持续。在前往跳跃点的途中，黑袭者（Black Raiders）海盗趁乱试图夺取运送加里森及其机甲的空投艇。在一次黑袭者航空航天战斗机的扫射中，机甲舱内的固定系统发生罕见的意外，Hunchback 上的 LRM 弹舱被触发。看来技师们在匆忙离星时忘了卸下弹药。爆炸造成系统性故障，导致装货舱门开启，所有未固定的设备都被吹入太空，包括加里森的 HBK-4P。虽然空投艇得以逃脱，加里森却失去了部队、失去了星球，也失去了机甲。

考虑到他的过往——他最后服役的星球与部队都已不复存在——许多人认为加里森是个扫把星。而想到他最终如何变得失甲、流落于佣兵大厅，这说法或许有几分道理。但加里森是一位战术娴熟的指挥官，他有一套重返战场的计划——尽管为此他不得不做了近十年的佣兵，受尽苦头。

column1:
Originally a ground-pounder NCO for a support unit in the 2nd Robinson Rangers, Paul was stationed on Breed for garrison duty along with an up-and-coming mercenary unit called the Steel Jaguars. Part of what made the Jaguars stand out was their rigorous training regimen which involved a lot of wargames. During the time stationed on Breed, the Rangers and Jaguars participated in multiple exercises - at first pitting each unit against each other, and later performing mixed unit operations. It was during one of these exercises that Paul's life would take an unexpected turn.

During an exercise, Paul's company lost their Command Squad, but he was unwilling to concede defeat and organized a trap to even the score. Luring the Jaguar scout lance into a geothermal valley, Paul's squad signaled the mock trigger for his unit's SRM Inferno rounds, which had been placed along the most likely trail the OpFor lance would take - the combined heat overload from the geysers and Infernos shut down 3 of the 4 'Mechs, with the final 'Mech being dispatched with overlapping fire from Paul's 2 remaining squads. The mercenary command staff were so impressed with Paul that their CO, Doyle, offered him a billet in the Steel Jaguars when his tour with the Rangers was complete. It was at this point that he took on the nickname Haree - some say it is because no matter how hairy the situation gets, he can turn it around and make it hairier for the enemy.

Despite having very little BattleMech experience, Haree joined up with the Jaguars a year later, and quickly adapted to the life of a MechWarrior. His natural combat and leadership abilities helping to propel him through the ranks, it seemed like Haree had barely moved into his locker when he was granted command of a scout lance and then the company - expedited somewhat by his predecessor taking an AC/10 round through the cockpit.

Under Haree's guidance, the Steel Jaguar battalion became one of the premiere units to hire when you absolutely had to get the job done. During his tenure as Captain, his company failed a contract only once - just prior to Haree retiring his mantle. Despite appearances to the contrary, it wasn't this failure that made him stand down, though. Rather, it was the draw of his life-long dream to take the money he had earned and settle down on his home world of Robinson. Haree yearned to feel the grass between his toes instead of the burn of melting BattleMech armor in his nostrils.

Recently, Haree has seen his savings become just another casualty of the Succession Wars, and has been forced into trying to find an employer - with one eye still on the dream he holds on to.
column2:
保罗原本是第 2 罗宾逊游骑兵（2nd Robinson Rangers）支援单位的一名陆军士官，与一支名为钢豹的新兴佣兵部队一同驻扎在 Breed 执行驻防任务。让钢豹脱颖而出的一点，是他们包含大量兵棋推演的严格训练制度。驻扎 Breed 期间，游骑兵与钢豹参与了多次演习——起初是两支部队互相对抗，后来则进行混编部队行动。正是在其中一次演习中，保罗的人生发生了意想不到的转折。

一次演习中，保罗所在连失去了指挥班，但他不愿认输，于是组织了一个圈套来扳平比分。他们把钢豹的侦察小队诱入一处地热山谷，保罗的班发出他们单位 SRM 燃烧弹的模拟触发信号——这些燃烧弹早已被布置在敌军小队最可能经过的路线上——间歇泉与燃烧弹叠加的热量过载让 4 台机甲中有 3 台停机，最后一台则被保罗剩余 2 个班的交叠火力解决。佣兵部队的指挥层对保罗印象深刻，他们的指挥官多伊尔在他与游骑兵的服役期结束后，为他提供了钢豹中的一个职位。也正是在那时，他得到了“Haree”这个绰号——有人说，是因为无论局势多么惊险（hairy），他都能扭转乾坤，让敌人更加难堪。

尽管几乎没多少战斗机甲经验，哈雷（Haree）还是一年后加入了钢豹，并迅速适应了机甲战士的生活。他天生的战斗与领导才能帮助他一路晋升，看起来他刚把东西放进储物柜，就被授予一个侦察小队的指挥权，随后又升任连长——其中部分原因是他的前任让一发 AC/10 炮弹穿过了驾驶舱。

在哈雷的带领下，钢豹营成为在你绝对必须完成任务时最值得雇用的顶尖部队之一。在他担任上尉期间，他的连队只失败过一次合约——就在哈雷卸任前不久。尽管表面上看如此，但让他隐退的并不是这次失败。真正的原因是那份他毕生的梦想在召唤：用他挣来的钱，回到家乡星球罗宾逊安顿下来。哈雷渴望感受脚趾间的青草，而不是鼻子里融化的战斗机甲装甲的焦味。

近来，哈雷眼看着自己的积蓄成为继承战争的又一名受害者，被迫四处寻找雇主——同时仍有一只眼睛盯着他坚守的梦想。

column1: Darius nods, and makes the order.\n\n"Alright Commander I understand. We won't be getting our 15 minutes of fame on C.B.S. It's a shame. I think I'd look good on Holo-Vid."He says with a chuckle.
column2: 达里乌斯点点头，下达了命令。\n\n“好吧，指挥官，我明白。我们没法在 C.B.S. 上享受那 15 分钟的名气了。真可惜。我觉得我上全息影像会挺上镜的。”他笑着说。

column1: The company is going wolf hunting.
column2: 连队要去猎狼了。

column1:
Darius pulls up beside you in a hurry. "Commander you have to come to the Command Center. You're not going to believe it. We're on C.B.S"

Darius smiles as you both make your way to the Command Center. 

"This is a C.B.S. Breaking News Alert...The Capellan Confederation has extended an open bounty to five mercenary companies to hunt down and eliminate a rogue company of the Wolf's Dragoons for war crimes against the Confederation. The companies named by our exclusive source are Broadsword Legion, Gray's Ghosts, Lone Star Regiment, The Knights of Caerbannog  and {COMPANY.CompanyName}. The amount of the bounty has not been disclosed. But is reportedly very large."

Darius turns to you and asks. "So {COMMANDER.FirstName}, are we going wolf hunting?"
column2:
达里乌斯急匆匆地赶到你身旁。“指挥官，你得来指挥中心。你不会相信的。我们上 C.B.S 了”

你们一同前往指挥中心，达里乌斯面带笑容。

“这是一条 C.B.S. 突发新闻警报……卡佩兰邦联已向五支佣兵连队发布公开悬赏，要求追杀并消灭狼之龙骑兵中一支因对邦联犯下战争罪行而叛变的连队。据我们的独家消息源，被点名的连队是 Broadsword Legion、Gray's Ghosts、Lone Star Regiment、The Knights of Caerbannog 以及 {COMPANY.CompanyName}。悬赏金额尚未披露，但据称数额巨大。”

达里乌斯转向你问道。“那么 {COMMANDER.FirstName}，我们要去猎狼吗？”

column1:
Born on Atreus, the capital world of the Federated Suns, Larry had a complicated history from day one. His father was a noble diplomat from the Lyran Commonwealth and his mother a prominent officer in the New Avalon Crucis March Militia. Their relationship was initially viewed with suspicion by factions within both Houses and life was difficult for Larry as he grew up between worlds. Ironically, years later his family would be lauded as an important step in the improving relations between the two realms. But, this would not come in time to make Larry's life any easier.

From a very early age, Larry showed an aptitude for VR combat simulation games, often taking units known to be underpowered, yet somehow finessing them to victory. This eventually led him to seek a career with the military - much to his mother's delight and father's grudging tolerance. He was soon enrolled at the newly formed New Avalon Institute of Science, but life there was no picnic - all his classmates believed him to be there based on his parent's accomplishments and not his own merits. Nevertheless, Larry was determined to prove himself, and would never back down from a challenge.

After graduation, his mother offered to help him gain a position in the March Militia, but Larry continued to want to forge his own destiny. Accepting a junior officer position with the 33rd Avalon Hussars, he left New Avalon behind, yet the spectre of his family continued to follow him.

Always a risk taker, Larry found he much preferred the role of the scout - both for the solitude and the opportunities it provided him to show what he could accomplish. Through sheer determination, he rose to the rank of Leftenant, but still yearned for a chance to step out from his parents' shadow. Not long after, he would have his chance in spades.

In 3022, the 33rd was part of an expedition to retake Galtor III from the Draconis Combine in what became known as one of the bloodiest campaigns in the later part of the Third Succession War. During that campaign, Leftenant Thornet's lance was instrumental in scouting out the enemy forces, helping the Federated Suns to eventually retake the planet.

Larry felt for the people of Galtor III, who were suffering horrendous losses. It was during an information gathering mission, when Larry saw the atrocities being committed by the Combine Troops on the citizenry and, despite orders not to reveal themselves, he took matters into his own hands and attacked the DCMS forces. The sheer wildness and bravado of the attack threw the Combine Soldiery into disarray and, believing that Lt. Thornet's lance was a spearhead for a larger force, they withdrew. While he had saved these poor souls, what he saw that day caused him to resign his commission and seek ways to help the people.
column2:
拉里出生在联邦太阳国的首府星球阿图鲁斯，从第一天起就有着复杂的经历。他的父亲是来自莱兰联邦的贵族外交官，母亲则是新阿瓦隆十字进军民兵中的知名军官。两人的关系起初遭到两大家族内部派系的猜疑，而拉里在两地之间长大的生活也十分艰难。讽刺的是，多年以后，他的家庭会被誉为两国关系改善的重要一步。但这份赞誉来得太晚，没能让拉里的日子好过一些。

拉里很小就展现出对 VR 战斗模拟游戏的天赋，常常选用公认性能偏弱的单位，却总能设法取胜。这最终促使他投身军旅——这让母亲欣喜，让父亲勉强容忍。他很快被新成立的新阿瓦隆科学研究院录取，但那里的生活并不轻松——所有同学都认为他能入学靠的是父母的成就而非自己的本事。尽管如此，拉里仍决心证明自己，从不退缩于任何挑战。

毕业后，母亲提出帮他在进军民兵中谋个职位，但拉里始终想开辟自己的命运。他接受了第 33 阿瓦隆骠骑兵团的一个初级军官职位，把新阿瓦隆抛在身后，可家族的阴影依旧如影随形。

拉里一向敢于冒险，发现自己更喜欢侦察兵的角色——既能享受孤独，又能获得机会展示自己的能力。凭借纯粹的决心，他升至少尉（Leftenant），但仍渴望有机会走出父母的阴影。不久之后，他将迎来大把的机会。

3022 年，第 33 团参与了一次从天龙联合体手中夺回 Galtor III 的远征，这场战役后来成为第三次继承战争后期最血腥的战役之一。在那场战役中，索内特少尉的小队在侦察敌军兵力方面发挥了关键作用，帮助联邦太阳国最终夺回了该星球。

拉里为 Galtor III 的人民感到痛心，他们正承受着惨重的损失。正是在一次情报搜集任务中，拉里目睹了联合体部队对平民犯下的暴行，尽管有命令不得暴露自己，他还是自作主张攻击了 DCMS 部队。这次攻击的狂野与胆气让联合体士兵陷入混乱，他们以为索内特中尉的小队是更大规模部队的先锋，因而撤退了。虽然他救下了这些可怜人，但那天所见的一切促使他辞去军职，去寻找能帮助民众的途径。

column1: Tell Darius not to worry about looking into the contract.
column2: 告诉达里乌斯不必费心去查那份合约。

column1: Darius provides an update. "I was able to get the details of the contract Commander."\n\nHe hesitates for a moment. "That Wolf's Dragoons company was pulling garrison duty on Repulse when their commander snapped. No one knows exactly why, either. But after the dust settled. They'd wiped out the entire settlement down to the last man, woman, and child. Needless to say, the Cappies are anxious or payback. They tracked the outfit to the planet Dicon. Which is where we'll need to head for the contract, Commander."
column2: 达里乌斯带来了最新消息。“指挥官，我弄到了合约的细节。”\n\n他迟疑了一下。“那支狼之龙骑兵连队在 Repulse 执行驻防任务时，他们的指挥官突然发疯。没人确切知道原因。但等尘埃落定，他们已经把整个定居点杀了个干净，男人、女人、孩子一个不剩。不用说，卡佩兰人急着要报复。他们追踪这支部队到了 Dicon 星球。指挥官，这正是我们接下合约后要去的地方。”

column1:
Dakotah was the son of a noble baron of a small city in the Fronc system. While life was hard on the frontier, the support given to the colonists by both the Magistracy and the Taurians gave them hope of a prosperous future. Dakky's father was a retired Taurian MechCommander who had been gifted the posting to Fronc with the understanding that he was to form the nucleus of that province's militia. Lord Brumagin sadly passed away under mysterious circumstances, and the young master Dakotah was suddenly thrust into the hereditary position of Lord.

Surprising everyone - aside from himself - Dakotah took to the role adeptly and, leading by example, made great strides towards stabilizing the province. This Lordling was not afraid to get his hands dirty: he was willing to work the fields, take his turns on patrol, did not shirk from any responsibilities that came his way. But his greatest love was working on the family 'Mech, and he spent many hours working with the MechTechs learning their trade.

It was near his coming of age that he met the woman that would become his wife - but their wedding was both the best and worst day of their lives. On the day of the ceremony, a pirate band struck, killing most of Dakotah's family, sacking the city and stealing his family 'Mech. With the city in ruins, many of the survivors moved to other provinces or returned to their homeworlds. But the young Lord had a thirst for vengeance. Setting off on the first JumpShip off-world with his new wife, he took to the life of a mercenary to build up his coffers so he might one day hunt down and wipe out the pirates that attacked his home.

Now, though, he is out of C-bills and looking for work.
column2:
达科塔是 Fronc 星系一座小城中一位贵族男爵的儿子。虽然边疆生活艰苦，但辖区与金牛座人给予殖民者的支持让他们对未来繁荣抱有希望。达基的父亲是一位退役的金牛座机甲指挥官，他获得 Fronc 的职位时，得到的理解是：他要在那里成为该省民兵的核心。布鲁马金领主不幸在神秘情况下离世，年轻的达科塔少爷突然被推上了世袭的领主之位。

让所有人——除了他自己——都感到意外的是，达科塔十分得心应手地承担起了这个角色，并以身作则，在稳定该省方面取得了长足进展。这位年轻领主不怕弄脏双手：他愿意下田耕作，轮班巡逻，从不推卸落到自己身上的任何责任。但他最爱的还是修理家族机甲，他花了大量时间与机甲技师一起学习他们的手艺。

就在他即将成年时，他遇见了后来成为他妻子的女人——但他们的婚礼是两人一生中最好也最糟的一天。典礼当天，一伙海盗来袭，杀害了达科塔的大部分家人，洗劫了城市，还偷走了他的家族机甲。城市化为废墟，许多幸存者迁往其他省份或返回自己的母星。但年轻的领主心中满是复仇的渴望。他带着新婚妻子搭乘第一艘离星的跃迁舰出发，投入佣兵生涯积累财富，好有朝一日追捕并消灭袭击他家乡的海盗。

而现在，他的 C-币已经花光，正在寻找工作。

column1:
The saying 'Nice guys finish last' has some truth to it sometimes; at least in the case of Gavin Oikos at any rate. He certainly plays at being a nice guy, and he's not shy about honestly admitting he finished last in his class at the Legionary Training Academy. But he finished, he likes to quip. He takes a quiet pride in his homeworld of Andurien, and is less quiet about his love of Capellan jokes. He gets as well as he gives though, and prides himself on having never started a barroom brawl. He'll joke that he's finished a few though.

Zed gets his callsign from his graduating class; they dubbed him 'Zed' because he was always last place in everything, even if at the same time he never really failed at anything either. He'll jest about all the best callsigns having some truth to them, of course. Unfortunately his cheerful exterior is the shimmery wrapping paper around a very sad little box. It's no mean task to check his records, and see that he went to the academy because his family, down to a person, died in an outbreak carried to his locale on Andurien by an offworlder, and the money he spent to do so was what remained of their financial legacy. There isn't anything or anyone left now but Zed, and his quirky sense of humor. He can't seem to stop being last.
column2:
“好人总是垫底”这句话有时确有几分道理；至少在加文·奥伊科斯身上是这样。他确实扮演着一个好人的样子，也不讳言自己诚实地承认在军团士兵训练学院的班上排名垫底。但他毕竟毕业了，他喜欢这么打趣。他对自己家乡安杜里恩怀有低调的自豪，而对卡佩兰笑话的喜爱则没那么低调。不过他有来有往，并引以为傲的是自己从未挑起重启酒吧斗殴——不过他会开玩笑说自己“打完”过几场。

Zed 的呼号来自他的毕业班；他们给他起了“Zed”，因为他在所有事情上总是最后一名，尽管与此同时他也从未真正在任何事上失败过。他当然会打趣说，最好的呼号都带点真实的影子。遗憾的是，他开朗的外表只是一层闪亮的包装纸，包着一个非常悲伤的小盒子。不难查出他的档案：他去上学院，是因为他的家人——一个不剩——全部死于一名外来者带到安杜里恩当地的疫病，而他为此花掉的钱，是家里剩下的全部财产。如今除了 Zed 和他古怪的幽默感，什么都没剩下，也没人剩下。他似乎总也摆脱不了最后一名。

column1:
Darius grew up on Nassau Heights, one of the hab stations orbiting the Aurigan Coalition world Artru. Thirty decks of economic stratification, with the corporate suits on the upper decks and everyone else crammed into the lower ones. His father was a deckhand and the whole family lived on Deck 28, two levels up from the bottom, with other station maintenance personnel. Twelve hours a day, six days a week, his father would load and unload cargo shuttles. Vacuum-sealed quillar and nutrient paste for common people, and luxury goods for the suits upstairs. According to Darius, he must've unloaded a thousand cases of Cassildan eel roe-plump, succulent eggs the size of melon balls. Never got to taste any, though. Any one of those tins would've cost him a half a year's wages.

Suffice it to say, Darius got an eyeful of what he did not want to be on Nassau Heights, and did what he had to do to change his circumstances. By the age of sixteen, he struck out on his own, leaving with a handful of skills, an enormous web of contacts, and a rucksack full of that expensive caviar. And once he made it off of Nassau Heights, he never, ever looked back. He took up a career as a MechWarrior and eventually made it to the position of Executive Officer of Markham's Marauders, where his fortunes would be made for life. And now, he's decided it is time to get back into the cockpit for a little action.
column2:
达里乌斯在 Nassau Heights 长大，那是环绕奥里根联盟星球 Artru 运行的居住站之一。三十层甲板构成了经济分层：企业西装们住在高层甲板，其他人则挤在低层。他的父亲是一名甲板工，全家住在第 28 层甲板，距最底层还有两层，与车站其他维护人员为邻。父亲每天工作十二小时，一周六天，装卸货运穿梭机上的货物。给普通人吃的真空封装藜麦和营养糊，给楼上西装们享用的奢侈品。据达里乌斯说，他肯定卸过上千箱 Cassildan 鳗鱼籽——饱满多汁、大小如瓜球的鱼卵。但他从没尝过。任何一罐都抵得上他半年的工钱。

可以说，达里乌斯在 Nassau Heights 亲眼看够了“自己绝不想成为的样子”，于是他做了必须做的事来改变处境。到十六岁时，他独自出发，带着一身技能、一张庞大的人脉网，以及一背包装满昂贵鱼子酱的行囊。而一旦离开 Nassau Heights，他再也没有回过头。他以机甲战士为职业，最终坐上了 Markham's Marauders 的执行官之位，命中的财富就此奠定终生。而现在，他决定重回驾驶舱，找点乐子。

column2: 氏族早期碾压者

column1:
Virago hails from the other side of the Sphere, and from the wrong side of the war. At least, that's what everyone, including her, says. She makes most folk uneasy with her size and her origins in equal measure, as she's a veteran of the Clan Jade Falcon invasion force. An Elemental, to be precise. How it is she ended up in the Rimward Periphery looking for a mercenary outfit is anyone's guess, but broken noses and worse are the typical fate of those who ask. Might be a worthwhile mercenary hidden in there behind all the odd mannerisms and patterns of speech. Clan lingo is weird, to say the least, and that's not even going into their abhorrence of contractions. Makes an odd duck odder in a place as frontiersy as the Periphery.

As she tells it, she's been working as an exoskeleton operator in cargo bays to make ends meet, but she's tired of being out of the fight, and wants a shot at real combat again. Barfights, apparently, don't appeal when you're a head taller than the next biggest person in the room

.
column2:
薇拉戈来自星域的另一端，也来自战争的错误一方。至少所有人——包括她自己——都这么说。她的体型与出身同样让多数人感到不安，因为她是翡翠猎鹰氏族入侵部队的老兵。准确地说，是一名元素战士。她究竟如何流落到外缘星域来找佣兵部队，谁也猜不透，但问起的人通常会落得鼻青脸肿甚至更惨。在那堆古怪的举止与说话方式背后，或许藏着一名称职的佣兵。氏族的行话至少可以说十分古怪，更不用提他们对缩略语的厌恶。在这般边陲的外围星域，这让她这只怪鸭子显得更加古怪。

按她自己的说法，她一直在货舱里当外骨骼操作员以维持生计，但她厌倦了远离战斗，想再次体验真正的作战。显然，当你比屋里第二高的人还高出一个头时，酒馆斗殴可没什么吸引力

。

column1:
Nathaniel Stoyanov, known by his callsign TheChronicToast (or Toast for short), is a character with a mysterious past and an unequalled love of toaster pastries. Many pin him as affiliated with the former Periphery mercenary company "Absolution's Gap", which gained notoriety by assisting Kamea Arano's coalition forces in the Aurigan Reach; though whether this is true isn't something he's likely to comment on.

His upbringing is a familiar one for a MechWarrior in the Rimward Periphery. Born to an immigrant family that had positioned itself powerfully as agricultural barons on Heliat, his family was betrayed by those that deemed them outsiders to the local, insular culture. Evading his captors, his family missing and their holdings destroyed, he fled off world. Hiring on as a novice pilot he, continued life as a merchant guard; providing himself a taste of dealing with tactical situations in underpowered and poorly maintained 'Mechs.

It was in these formative years he realized that, with unexpected but surprisingly reckless tactics, an underdog could get an edge on a superior foe - even more so if one was willing to risk everything to accomplish the mission at hand. With this knowledge firmly grasped, his piloting skill and deployment count grew, eventually winning seats in various mercenary outfits. He earned his keep but never stayed in one place for long, as he always gained a reputation for burning through his 'Mechs if it meant a mission success; company finances be darned.

Eventually he got pulled into the historic events surrounding Kamea Arano and the civil war with the Directorate, but that is a story for another day - if you can get him to tell it. As it stands, he's a solid pilot with a few tales to share.

"Every action has a cost on the battlefield. Make the sacrifices needed for victory a personal endeavor, and your lancemates will thank you when it's over."
column2:
纳撒尼尔·斯托亚诺夫，呼号 TheChronicToast（简称 Toast），是一位身世神秘、对烤面包糕点有着无与伦比热爱的角色。许多人认定他与昔日外围星域的佣兵公司“Absolution's Gap”有关联——该公司因在奥里根领域协助卡美亚·阿拉诺的联合部队而声名远扬；不过这是否属实，他大概不会置评。

他的成长经历对外缘星域的机甲战士来说十分耳熟。他出生于一个移民家庭，家族在 Heliat 上以农业贵族之姿占据了强势地位，却被那些视他们为当地封闭文化之外来者的人背叛。他躲过了抓捕者，家人失踪、家产被毁，于是他逃往星外。作为一名新手机师受雇后，他继续以商队护卫为生，这让他在性能不足、维护糟糕的机甲中尝到了应对战术局面的滋味。

正是在这些成长岁月里，他意识到，凭借出人意料又相当鲁莽的战术，弱者也能占到强敌的上风——若一个人愿意为完成任务押上一切，效果更是如此。牢牢掌握这一认知后，他的驾驶技术与出击次数不断增长，最终在各支佣兵部队中赢得席位。他能挣到饭吃，却从不在一处长留，因为他总是以“只要任务成功，烧毁多少台机甲都无所谓”而闻名——公司财务？管它呢。

最终他被卷入了围绕卡美亚·阿拉诺以及与 Directorate 内战的重大事件，但那是另一个故事了——前提是你能让他讲出来。就目前而言，他是一名扎实的机师，也有几个故事可以分享。

“战场上的每个行动都有代价。把胜利所需的牺牲变成个人的事，战斗结束后你的小队战友会感谢你。”

column1:
Originally from the Duchy of Andurien in the Free Worlds League, James Pato grew up tinkering with anything he could get his hands on. He was drawn to an apprenticeship as a MechTech, starting with AgroMechs and moving on to BattleMechs after being called upon to help the local garrison with a broken 'Mech crossing his family's property.

Working for the militia, he quickly rose through the ranks and became the local subject matter expert on the coding for 'Mech's Targeting and Tracking Systems (TTS) and internal diagnostic computers. More than once his custom adjustments have led to his unit's MechWarriors nearly dying in the field, almost costing him his position. He found himself putting in countless hours behind the command couches of BattleMechs in order to understand what his pilots experience, eventually earning his own title as MechWarrior.

His ability to find work as either MechTech or MechWarrior has granted him freedom to travel around the Rimward Periphery, searching for LosTech - with an eye out for Star League era TTS. He's heard rumors there was once a totally autonomous BattleMech drone project run in secret, but has yet to find any real evidence. If he were to find such a LosTech cache, it would allow him to establish his own brand of TTS that would rival the best the Inner Sphere has to offer.
column2:
詹姆斯·帕托原籍自由世界同盟的安杜里恩公国，从小就把能拿到手的东西拆开研究。他被机械技师的学徒生涯吸引，从农用机甲做起，后来因为帮当地驻军修理一台路过他家土地的故障机甲，进而转向战斗机甲。

为民兵工作期间，他迅速晋升，并成为当地在机甲瞄准与追踪系统（TTS）编码及内部诊断计算机方面的专家。不止一次，他的自定义调整导致所在部队的机甲战士差点在战场上丧命，也几乎让他丢了职位。他开始在战斗机甲的指挥座椅后度过无数小时，以理解机师们的体验，最终也为自己赢得了机甲战士的头衔。

他既能当机甲技师也能当机甲战士，这让他得以自由地在外缘星域四处游历，寻找失落科技——尤其留意星际联盟时代的 TTS。他听闻曾有某个完全自主的战斗机甲无人机项目在秘密进行，但始终未找到任何确凿证据。若能找到这样一处失落科技宝库，他就能建立自己的 TTS 品牌，与内层星域最好的产品一较高下。

column1:
Born on Terra, Adam joined ComStar as an Acolyte at a young age. After years of training on Terra, he continued to serve the Blessed Blake as a HPG technician on a fairly backwater world in the Taurian Concordat know as Argos (new Acolytes have to learn somewhere). For several years, he labored at his duties without much distinction or notice.

Near the close of the Third Succession War, the HPG station was attacked by a group of extremely bold (if not more than a little stupid) pirates. ComStar put out a call to the local militia while their meager security force held the pirates at bay as best as they could. However, the pirates soon overwhelmed the ComStar base, and several of them exited their vehicles to begin looting the compound. It was at this moment that Adam's life took a turn. Making a rash decision to do whatever it took to protect the blessed HPG and technology of old, Adam climbed into a vacated 'Mech and powered it up. Despite a lack of actual training, he found that the controls matched the simulation pods that he enjoyed playing with in his off hours. With his purloined 'Mech lurching into motion, he managed some lucky shots, destroying a pirate APC transport and crippling two tanks. He even managed to knock over one of their Stinger light 'Mechs as he careened off to the side in an ungainly attempt at a charge. Between this unexpected resistance, and the sudden appearance of the local militia, the tide was turned and the pirates were soon in full retreat.

With the battle over, the Precentor in charge of the HPG noted Adam's deeds and encouraged him to walk the missionary's path, believing that Blessed Blake had a higher purpose in mind for him. Adam was to learn the way of the MechWarrior while also spreading the Word of Blake amongst the stars, searching out other like-minded warriors of faith. Calling in some old favors, the Precentor sponsored Adam and had him sent to a Concordat training academy. Wishing him well, the Precentor gifted Adam with a rare printed copy of Jerome Blake's writings to help guide him through this new future and keep him on the path, and it would become one of Adam's most cherished possessions over the following years.

Adam now travels the stars, preaching the good word of Blake and fighting for good causes that champion the little folk who so often get forgotten by the larger powers - but not by the little mercenaries.
column2:
亚当出生于泰拉，年少时便作为侍僧加入了通讯之星。在泰拉受训多年后，他继续以 HPG 技师的身份为受福的布莱克效力，被派往金牛协约国一颗相当偏远、名为 Argos 的星球（新侍僧总得有个地方学习）。数年间，他勤恳履职，并无多少出众或引人注目之处。

第三次继承战争接近尾声时，该 HPG 站遭到一群极其大胆（若不是有点愚蠢）的海盗袭击。通讯之星在向当地民兵求援的同时，以自己微薄的安保力量尽力抵挡海盗。然而海盗很快压垮了通讯之星基地，数名海盗下车开始洗劫园区。就在这一刻，亚当的人生发生了转折。他草率地决定不惜一切保护神圣的 HPG 与古老的科技，爬进一台空置的机甲并将其启动。尽管缺乏真正的训练，他发现操纵装置与他闲暇时玩得入迷的模拟舱如出一辙。他偷来的机甲跌跌撞撞地开动起来，幸运地打出几发命中，摧毁了一辆海盗 APC 运输车并使两辆坦克失去战斗能力。当他笨拙地试图冲撞、车身歪向一侧时，甚至撞翻了对方一台毒刺轻型机甲。在这番意外的抵抗与当地民兵的突然出现之间，战局逆转，海盗很快全面撤退。

战斗结束后，主管 HPG 的教长注意到亚当的作为，鼓励他走上传道者之路，相信受福的布莱克为他安排了更高的使命。亚当要一边学习机甲战士之道，一边在群星间传播布莱克之语，寻找其他志同道合的信徒战士。教长动用了一些旧日人情，资助亚当并把他送往一所协约国训练学院。教长祝他一切顺利，还赠予亚当一份罕见的杰罗姆·布莱克著作印刷本，帮助他在这个新未来中指引方向、坚守正道——此后多年，这成为亚当最珍视的财产之一。

如今亚当在群星间旅行，宣讲布莱克的福音，为那些常被大势力遗忘、却未被小佣兵遗忘的普通人所拥护的正义事业而战。

column1:
Born on Coromodir to a pair of high-ranking military officers, Blue had little choice in her upbringing or career path - joining the Aurigan Coalition's military was her destiny from the moment she was born, and though she did as her parents bid, it was with smouldering resentment rather than enthusiasm. This won her few favors with her fellow officers in training, and after an incident in 'anger management' that left another trainee in the hospital, she was quietly shuffled off to join with the rowdier - and rather less sheltered - crowd of young MechWarriors.

With her parents' patronage, she was given into Raju Montgomery's care. Here, for the first time, she found something she was both good at and enjoyed. She quickly acquired the callsign Aether, through her ability to remain untouched, seemingly intangible and ephemeral, through a hail of incoming fire. Though not important enough socially to rub shoulders with the heir to the Coalition, sharing a common teacher often led to Blue sharing training with Kamea Arano. When it became clear that Blue was becoming rather inappropriately enamoured with the royal lady, she was again - quietly - transferred to the furthest reaches of the Reach. There was only so far her parents' reputation could go.

Tragedy struck, as both of her loyalist parents were killed in the opening moments of Espinoza's coup. With Kamea and Raju reported dead, her parents gone, and the Directorate heading in a direction she was unwilling to support, Aether took advantage of the chaos to simply disappear. She's back now though, and ready to seek revenge upon those who destroyed her life - and who threatened, exiled, and hunted her liege.
column2:
布鲁出生于 Coromodir，父母是两位高级军官，她的成长与职业道路几乎没有选择——从出生那一刻起，加入奥里根联盟军队就是她的宿命。虽然她照父母的意愿行事，但伴随的是郁积的怨恨而非热情。这没让她在同期受训军官中赢得多少好感；在一次“情绪管理”事件把另一名学员送进医院后，她被悄悄调去与那群更吵闹——也更不谙世事——的年轻机甲战士为伍。

在父母的庇护下，她被交到拉朱·蒙哥马利手中照管。在这里，她第一次找到了自己既擅长又喜欢的事。她很快凭借在弹雨中毫发无伤、仿佛虚幻无质的能力获得了呼号“以太”（Aether）。虽然她的社会地位不足以与联盟继承人往来，但共同的老师常让布鲁与卡美亚·阿拉诺一同训练。当布鲁对这位王室小姐表现出相当不恰当的爱慕时，她再次被悄悄调往奥里根领域最偏远的角落。她父母的名声也就能走这么远。

悲剧降临，她两位忠于政府的父母在埃斯皮诺萨政变的最初时刻被杀害。卡美亚与拉朱据报已死，父母不在，而 Directorate 正朝着她不愿支持的方向前进，以太趁乱干脆消失。不过她如今回来了，准备好向那些毁掉她生活的人——以及威胁、流放并追捕她君主的人——复仇。

column1: Ultralight Backstabber
column2: 超轻型背刺者

column1: John was on a fast track to command straight out of Albion Military Academy. However, while attached to the Ceti Hassars, he was captured by a Capellan patrol after an intel snafu failed to warn them of recent movements in the area. Beagle was held prisoner for 4 years and was subjected to intense interrogation techniques in the early years of his captivity. On the fourth year, Beagle was sprung from prison by his old unit - now operating as a mercenary band - and would assist in combat and command of what would later be known as Operation Gatecrasher. John has been running his own mercenary unit on and off since his newfound freedom, but has recently been looking for a company where he can find good return for his skills and experience.\n\n
column2: 约翰从阿尔比恩军事学院毕业时就踏上了通往指挥岗位的快车道。然而在隶属于 Ceti Hassars 期间，因一次情报失误未能警示该地区近期的兵力调动，他被一支卡佩兰巡逻队俘虏。比格尔被关押了四年，在被俘的头几年里经受了高强度的审讯手段。到第四年，比格尔被他的老部队——如今以佣兵队伍形式运作——从监狱中救出，并协助参与作战与指挥了后来被称为“破门行动”（Operation Gatecrasher）的行动。重获自由后，约翰断断续续地经营着自己的佣兵部队，但近来他一直在寻找一家能让他的技能与经验得到良好回报的连队。\n\n
