column2: 狙击与近距突击

column1: The first native Battlemech to be built by the FedSuns, the 70 ton Battleaxe debuted in 2459. Based off of the technology used in the Mackie, the Battleaxe would be constantly updated with new technology, before being retired after the Reunification War when newer designs such as the Hammerhands and Warhammer entered service. The Battleaxe BKX-7K is the mass production model. Built around a 280-rated Fusion Core, the BKX-7K is armed with a pair of PPC’s and a pair of LRM-5’s. An SRM-6 provides some close range firepower.
column2: Battleaxe 是联邦太阳自行建造的第一款战斗机甲，70 吨，于 2459 年首次亮相。它以麦基所用的技术为基础，不断以新技术进行升级，直到统一战争之后、Hammerhands 与战锤等更新的设计服役后才退役。Battleaxe BKX-7K 是量产型号。该机围绕一台 280 级聚变核心建造，装备两门粒子加农炮与两具 LRM-5。一具 SRM-6 则提供部分近距离火力。

column1:
Nobles are born with silver spoons in their mouths. Toni Okoye was born with a wrench. Raised in the Outback of the Federated Suns, she learned quickly that one man's junk was another man's treasure. Parts and supplies could be hard to find in the wilder parts of the Suns, and so many learned to re-jigger, reuse, and recycle. Toni enjoyed tinkering with all manner of devices, and her family had an oddly rich history in technology. Her grandfather had worked building Nissan 200s for the Enforcer, and he took that knowledge with them when the lot of them were forced to move after he lost his job at the fusion engine plant. Unfortunately, he passed on in transit to their new home, but the Okoyes kept all his manuals and notes, and Toni's mother and father both took jobs in repair and maintenance once the family re-settled.

Toni learned about 'Mechs the same way a lot of people in the rougher parts of the Inner Sphere do; she got lucky. The garrison on her world had a chassis in need of an engine, and as it happened, Toni managed to blunder into one, get it working, and install it into the decrepit Enforcer 4R, giving the 'Mech it's first hum of life in a hundred years. A thankful local government let her train in it under the Dispossessed MechWarrior they'd hired to pilot it for the militia, and before long the dream of being a real MechWarrior took root. It didn't help that the MechWarrior Toni was learning from filled her head with stories of battles and victory, and it wasn't long before she decided to market herself to any Mercenary company passing through as a two-for-one tech and pilot deal; after all, the budget-conscious might appreciate an extra hand in the Mechbay. However solid her skills with a wrench are, the aesthetics of her work often leave something to be desired, and it's not uncommon for the Chief Tech of her outfit to wonder why the leg of the CO's ride looks like it lost a fight with a junk pile.
column2:
贵族生来就含着银匙，而托妮·奥科耶生来手里握着的是扳手。她在联邦太阳的偏远内陆长大，很快就明白一个人的破烂就是另一个人的宝贝。在太阳系那些更荒蛮的地区，零件和物资常常难以寻得，于是许多人都学会了拆改、复用与回收。托妮喜欢鼓捣各式各样的设备，而她的家族在技术方面有着一段出奇深厚的历史。她的祖父曾为 Enforcer 制造日产 200 型引擎；后来他在聚变引擎厂丢了工作，一家人在被迫搬迁时，他把这些知识也一并带走了。遗憾的是，他在迁往新家的途中去世，但奥科耶一家保留了他所有的说明书与笔记；一家人重新安顿下来后，托妮的父母都在维修与保养行业找到了工作。

托妮了解机甲的方式，与内天体许多更艰苦地区的人如出一辙：她走运。她所在星球的驻军有一具机体缺一台引擎，而机缘巧合之下，托妮竟鬼使神差地弄到一台，把它修好，并装进了那台破败的 Enforcer 4R，让这台机甲一百年来第一次重新发出嗡鸣。心怀感激的当地政府允许她在他们雇来的“无产机甲战士”指导下接受训练——那人本是替民兵驾驶这台机甲的；没过多久，成为真正机甲战士的梦想就在她心中扎了根。再加上教她的那位机甲战士不断用战斗与胜利的故事填满她的脑袋，她很快就决定向任何路过的雇佣兵公司推销自己，提出技师与机师二合一的打包价；毕竟，精打细算的人或许会喜欢机库多一双帮手。无论她摆弄扳手的本事多么扎实，作品的外观却常常令人不敢恭维，她所在部队的首席技师时常纳闷：为什么指挥官座驾的腿看起来像是跟垃圾堆打了一架。

column1:
Tariq grew up knowing he wanted to serve in the LCAF as a MechWarrior. He would skip school to sneak off and spend time with his mother who worked at Coventry Metal Works to be around the BattleMechs. He would stay up nights, looking at blueprints, studying how myomer works, or building models of his favorite machines. He had a particular fondness for the Hunchback; the massive autocannon put a twinkle in his eyes.

Thanks to his connections, he was able to attend the Conventry Military Academy, and was enrolled in the Reconnaissance program when the Jade Falcons invaded Steiner space. He was there when they attacked Coventry. He fought alongside his training cadre as the clanners tried to take his home planet. And he, like the rest of his comrades, failed in its defense. He was captured, and taken as bondsman by the Falcons. When they departed, he was released, but his time in detention left a mark on Tariq. Instead of participating in the rebuilding of the academy, he instead left Lyran space, believing his training had not been enough. He felt he needed real experience in a place where people didn't fight by the book. So he sought passage to the Periphery and a commission in a mercenary unit.

Tariq is a friendly guy, always wearing a sideways smile, hence his handle. He's relaxed and approachable, but he's fierce in his commitment to return to Conventry and participate in the fight. With the Civil War in flames between the Lyrans and FedSuns though, he's content to remain in mercenary employ for the time being. He might grimace at taking a Davion contract, and he makes no bones about the fact that he will leave one day to return home, but for now he's a dedicated, loyal soldier.
column2:
塔里克从小就明白自己想以机甲战士的身份加入 LCAF。他会逃课溜出去，跑到母亲工作的考文垂金属厂，只为了能待在战斗机甲旁边。他会熬夜看图纸，研究肌纤维的工作原理，或者拼装自己最喜欢的机体的模型。他尤其钟爱 Hunchback；那门巨大的自动炮在他眼里闪闪发光。

靠着人脉，他得以进入考文垂军事学院；翡翠猎鹰入侵施泰纳领空时，他正在侦察专业就读。猎鹰进攻考文垂时，他就在那里。当氏族试图夺取他的母星时，他随训练教官一同作战。而他，和他的战友们一样，在保卫战中失败了。他被俘，并被猎鹰收为契约奴。猎鹰撤离时，他获释了，但那段被拘押的经历在塔里克身上留下了烙印。他没有参与学院的重建，而是离开了莱兰领空，认为自己受的训练还不够。他觉得自己需要在一个人们不按教条作战的地方获得真正的经验。于是他设法前往外围区，并在某支雇佣兵部队谋得了职位。

塔里克性格友善，脸上总挂着一丝歪笑，他的外号也正由此而来。他随和、易于接近，但他重返考文垂、投身战斗的决心极为坚定。不过既然莱兰与联邦太阳之间的内战正打得火热，他暂时也安于留在雇佣兵队伍里。接到联邦太阳的合约时他或许会皱眉，他也坦承自己终有一天会离开回家，但就目前而言，他是一名忠诚、尽职的士兵。

column1:
Pistol doesn't like to talk about her childhood. Her story starts with the first time she went to prison, which she proudly hails as 'growing up'. After that, her life was a blur of petty crime, thuggery, and gang time. Unlike a lot of the roughs she ran with, Pistol used her head. She was smart, and ruthless, and someone with her capabilities wasn't long for petty crime. Pirates eventually swept her away to a life of cargo theft, raiding stockpiles, and fleeing the authorities in multiple systems. The pirates were more wily than the low-rent crooks she'd been with, but her savvy kept her fingerprints off most of their heists.

After a duel with a member of a rival pirate crew got blood on her hands for the first time, Pistol started getting a tattoo for each mark she knocked off; often times double-tapping by collecting bounties on the riff-raff as a side gig. That sort of work suited her tastes, and the criminal aspects of things started to fall to the wayside. The other pirates noticed, and not wanting to lose their share of her bounty takes, they offered her a spot among the few 'Mech jocks they had. She was put at the controls of a primitive, derelict Shadow Hawk, and her eye for killing only grew sharper. She found that she equally enjoyed hunting targets with her autocannon or her sidearm, and unfortunately for the rest of the rabble, her resolve to leave the pirate life only got stronger.

Pistol snuck away one evening when the rest of the pirates were in a drunken stupor, left word of their whereabouts to the authorities, and collected the bounty. She used the cash to get off-world, and register with the MRB as a pilot-fore-hire, hoping to shack up with a more reputable lot who favored bounty hunting as much as she did. Amusingly, having to register with the MRB forced her to use her real name (which she hates), so any potential commanders might take care not to use it in casual conversation.
column2:
“手枪”不愿谈起自己的童年。她的故事从第一次进监狱开始，她自豪地称之为“长大成人”。那之后，她的人生就是一堆小偷小摸、聚众斗殴和帮派勾当的模糊片段。与她混在一起的那些粗人不同，“手枪”会用脑子。她既聪明又冷酷，而她这种本事的人，注定不会长期停留在小打小闹的犯罪上。海盗们最终把她卷入了劫货、洗劫仓库、在多星系逃避当局追捕的生活。这些海盗比她以前跟着的低级混混精明得多，而她的机敏也让她在他们的大多数劫案中都没留下指纹。

在与敌对海盗团成员的一场决斗中，她第一次亲手沾上了血；此后，“手枪”每解决一个目标就在身上纹一个记号，还常常顺带做兼职，把那些渣滓的悬赏金也一并领了，一石二鸟。这种活儿正合她的口味，犯罪的那一面也渐渐退居其次。其他海盗注意到了这一点，他们不愿失去自己那份赏金分成，便从手下为数不多的机甲机师里给了她一个位置。她被安排在一台原始、破败的 Shadow Hawk 的驾驶舱里，而她猎杀的眼力也随之愈发锐利。她发现自己无论是用自动炮还是用手枪猎杀目标都同样享受；而对其他乌合之众来说不幸的是，她离开海盗生涯的决心反而越来越坚定了。

某个晚上，趁其他海盗烂醉如泥，“手枪”悄悄溜走，向当局通报了他们的藏身之处，并领走了赏金。她用这笔钱离开了星球，在 MRB 注册为待雇机师，希望能投靠一支声誉更好、和她一样热衷赏金猎杀的队伍。有趣的是，在 MRB 注册迫使她使用了自己的真名（她讨厌这个名字），所以任何有意雇佣她的指挥官最好注意，别在闲聊中随口用那个名字称呼她。

column1: A Clan Buster upgrade, the Black Knight BL-9-KNT was developed specifically for Tukayyid. Powered by a 300-rated XL Engine with DHS, the BL-9-KNT is armed with a Hatchet and an ER PPC. A pair of Large Lasers support the ER PPC at range, while 4 Medium Pulse Lasers and a Large Pulse Laser are devastating at close range.
column2: 作为一款“氏族克星”升级型，Black Knight BL-9-KNT 是专为图卡伊德开发的。该机由一台 300 级 XL 引擎驱动并配备双散热器，装备一柄战斧与一门增程粒子加农炮。两门大型激光在远距离上支援增程粒子加农炮，而 4 门中型脉冲激光与一门大型脉冲激光在近距离上极具毁灭性。

column1: The Black Knight 7-KNT is a dedicated Energy weapon platform. It can shell out hellish damage with its beams and shrug off a lot of damage... just gotta make sure to keep its heat in check.
column2: Black Knight 7-KNT 是一台专职能量武器的平台。它能用光束倾泻出地狱般的伤害，还能承受大量打击……只是得确保把热量控制住。

column1: Continuing the trend toward specialized BattleMechs, the Bombardier was proposed to the Star League in 2735 by Wakazashi Enterprises as an "artillery 'Mech." The concept behind the design was to make a BattleMech that could replace less-mobile artillery vehicles, which might fall behind in an advance or be destroyed by counter-battery fire. It would be well-protected with twelve and a half tons of armor and use specialized missile racks which could carry diverse types of advanced missiles. Over years of testing and field exercises the Bombardier proved itself extremely effective at fulfilling the long-range fire support role, easily surpassing its vehicular counterparts and even inspiring talks of disbanding the SLDF's artillery arm once enough Bombardiers were operational.
column2: 为延续战斗机甲专业化的潮流，Wakazashi 企业于 2735 年向星际联盟提出把 Bombardier 作为一款“火炮机甲”。该设计背后的构想，是打造一款能够取代机动性较差的火炮车辆的战斗机甲——那些车辆可能在推进中掉队，或被反炮兵火力摧毁。它将得到充分的保护，拥有十二吨半的装甲，并使用可携带多种先进导弹的特制导弹挂架。经过多年的测试与野战演习，Bombardier 证明自己在履行远程火力支援角色方面极为高效，轻松超越了对应的车辆型号，甚至一度引发讨论：待足够多的 Bombardier 投入服役后，是否要解散 SLDF 的炮兵部队。

column1:
When asked, Dermot Laughlin is content to simply tell people he is from the far side of the Magistracy of Canopus, and leave it at that. He might continue that he served in a militia, piloting a Wasp that had a couple of flamers installed in the leg in place of the missile rack, and that he didn't do much beyond some minor scrumming with pirates, and some civil engineering using his 'Mech as a substitute crane.

But the manner in which he carries himself, and especially the way he talks, tell a different story - and it's one that doesn't come anywhere near matching the words that come out of his mouth when you can get him to talk about himself. One look at the bookshelf in his quarters confirms he has some pretty serious investment in the workings and histories of ancient empires, specifically the Romans. And this seeming obsession is reflected in his demeanor on the battlefield; he will bark orders and make calls if his commanding officer is too slow to respond to changing battlefield conditions, and brush off any reprimand after the fact. But when paired with a mind like his, he is efficient and supportive, and he will echo commands to the rest of his compatriots, helping keep operations orderly and regimented.
column2:
若有人问起，德莫特·劳克林只乐意告诉对方自己来自卡诺帕斯行政区的最远端，然后就此打住。他或许还会补上一句：他曾在民兵部队服役，驾驶一台在腿部导弹挂架位置装了两具火焰喷射器的 Wasp；除了与海盗有过一些小型冲突，以及用机甲当起重机干过一些土木工程之外，他也没干出什么名堂。

但他举手投足的做派，尤其是他说话的方式，讲的却是另一个故事——而且只要你能让他谈起自己，就会发现那个故事和他嘴里说出来的话完全对不上。只要看一眼他舱房里那排书架，就能确认他对古代帝国的运作与历史投入了相当认真的研究，尤其是罗马。而这种看似痴迷的爱好也映照在他战场上的举止：如果指挥官对瞬息万变的战况反应太慢，他会大声下达命令、做出决断，事后也毫不在意受到训斥。但当这样一副头脑被用在正途上时，他高效且善于配合，会向其余同袍复述命令，帮助让行动保持有序与整齐。

column1:
Hannah Yamashita hails from the Draconis Combine, and it shows. She expresses that very Japanese tendency towards perfection in all that she does, from pruning the bonsai she keeps in her very orderly quarters, to negotiating narrow alleyways and streets in her preferred BattleMech, the Firestarter. She has a penchant for urban combat, light 'Mechs, and anti-infantry operations, and when given the opportunity, gladly partakes in all three. She also has the habit of writing haikus on the side of her 'Mech after each engagement; beautiful little poems describing and entire conflict in three simple lines.  And many of her 'Mechs have read like compilations.

Something troubling seems to follow her, however; she has a mien like a black cat, and she often makes the more superstitious of her colleagues uneasy. It's hard to say why, but it could be the smile she wears after a particularly eventful day stalking the city, rooting out entrenched opposition.
column2:
汉娜·山下来自德拉科尼斯联合体，这一点显而易见。她在自己所做的每一件事上都体现出日本人追求完美的倾向——从修剪她摆在极为整洁的舱房里的盆景，到驾驶她偏爱的战斗机甲 Firestarter 穿梭于狭窄的巷陌与街道。她钟情于城市战、轻型机甲与反步兵作战，只要有机会，这三样她都乐于尽情施展。她还习惯在每次交战后在自己的机甲侧面写下俳句；那些优美的小诗用三行简短的句子描绘并概括整场冲突。她的许多机甲读起来就像一本本诗集。

然而，似乎总有什么令人不安的东西跟随着她；她带着一种黑猫般的气质，常让比较迷信的同僚感到不自在。很难说清原因，也许是她在那漫长一天里追猎于城中、清剿固守之敌后脸上挂着的微笑。

column1:
Once House Arano regained their throne, and Lady Kamea Arano reclaimed her crown, the Restoration efford ended, and so did the flow of money from the Centrellas. The fate of those displaced by the end of a war rarely gets shared in any history book, this war included, and many loyal MechWarriors and vehicle crewfolk were left without prospects. The Magistracy has new politics to attend to now, and former Aurigan soldiers like Clinton have to do what they can.

Dubbed 'Plato' by his lancemates due to a penchant for debate over off-hours drinks, MechWarrior Knox is otherwise a fairly unremarkable soldier, aside from the bittersweet loyalty he has towards his old outfit and nation. He feels betrayed, but at the same time proud of his role in re-securing the Arano heritage, wearing that weight like a veteran would. He gets on well with most crews, and has little or naught to say about much, unless there's an open beer and a friendly conversation at hand. He seems content to follow orders and serve his contract; quietly continuing to be a good soldier for whoever cuts his checks.
column2:
阿哈诺家族重登王座、卡梅亚·阿哈诺女士取回王冠之后，复国行动便告终结，来自森特雷拉家族的金钱也随之断流。战争结束时流离失所者的命运，很少会写进任何史书，这场战争也不例外；许多忠诚的机甲战士与车辆乘员都失去了前程。行政区如今有新的政治要操心，而像克林顿这样的前奥里根士兵，只能尽力而为。

因其在业余时间喝酒时喜好辩论，同袍给他起了个“柏拉图”的绰号；除此之外，机甲战士诺克斯是个相当不起眼的士兵，唯有他对旧部队与旧国家那份苦乐交织的忠诚值得一提。他感到被背叛，但同时也为自己在重新夺回阿哈诺遗产中所扮演的角色而自豪，并以老兵的方式背负着这份重量。他与大多数队员都相处融洽，对大多数事情几乎不发一言，除非手边有开好的啤酒和一场友好的交谈。他似乎乐于服从命令、履行合约；不论是谁给他开支票，他都默默继续做个好士兵。

column1:
Not every person behind the controls of a 'Mech chooses to be there. Sometimes their options are limited due to the circumstances of their birth. Annabelle Geates was born in the officer's quarters of a Leopard-class DropShip en route between planets in the Free World's League. Her mother was the CO of a mercenary group; her father a pilot. They had been trying to get to a proper hospital, but the trip from the jump point in-system was a long one, and Annabelle ended up being born a few days early. Her entire childhood was spent aboard the ship, with the crew and techs and pilots being her aunts and uncles. She learned about PPCs, and about KF drives, and jump jets, and tactics. She had few toys, but several of the mercs had books, so she read a lot as soon as she was able. Books became her escape when the hull of the Leopard rumbled from meteorites or weapons fire and she was afraid. They taught here everything she learned that didn't have a military application. Her parents wanted her to learn the family business, but she wanted to go into the arts. She loved writing, and would read her prose to anyone that would listen to her.

As she grew up, she found herself behind the controls of her mother's Phoenix Hawk, learning the ropes. It was the last place she wanted to be, but she had few other choices. Her parents were worried about leaving her someplace to study, only to be kidnapped or worse by someone upset with the unit. So Annabelle became a MechWarrior.

Her parents eventually had a falling out, and the group dissolved. Both parents joined different outfits, and she chose to live with her father for a time, but the group he'd signed up with were too rowdy for her tastes, so she left. She missed the more family-like environment of her old unit. She met up with her mother, but she was bitter about Annabelle choosing her father first, and they had a falling out. Left with few prospects, Geates put her name out looking for a new outfit; one that she hopes has a quiet corner for her to read and write in between contracts. And maybe, a new kind of family more like her old one.
column2:
并非每一个坐在机甲驾驶舱里的人都是自愿的。有时，他们的选择受限于自己出身的境遇。安娜贝尔·吉茨出生在自由世界联盟境内、行星间航行的 Leopard 级空投艇上的军官舱里。她的母亲是一支雇佣兵部队的指挥官，父亲是机师。他们本想赶往一家正规医院，但从小行星跳跃点进入星系内的航程太长，结果安娜贝尔早产了几天。她的整个童年都在船上度过，船员、技师和机师就是她的叔叔阿姨。她学会了粒子加农炮，也学会了 KF 驱动器、跳跃推进器与战术。她几乎没有玩具，但好几名雇佣兵都有书，所以她识字之后就读了很多书。当 Leopard 的船体因陨石或武器射击而轰鸣、她感到害怕时，书便成了她的避难所。凡是她所学到的不带军事用途的东西，都是这些书教给她的。她的父母希望她学会家族的行当，但她想投身艺术。她热爱写作，会把自己的散文读给任何愿意听的人。

随着她长大，她发现自己坐在母亲的凤凰鹰的驾驶舱里，学着入行。那是她最不想待的地方，但她几乎没有别的选择。她的父母担心把她留在某处求学，会被不满该部队的人绑架或遭遇更糟的事。于是安娜贝尔成了一名机甲战士。

她的父母最终反目，部队也随之解散。两人各自加入了不同的队伍，她一度选择和父亲一起生活，但他签约加入的那支队伍对她来说太过喧闹，于是她离开了。她怀念旧部队那种更像家庭的环境。她找到母亲，可母亲对她当初先选了父亲一事耿耿于怀，两人也闹翻了。前途寥寥的吉茨便放出消息，寻找一支新部队；她希望这支队伍能在合约间隙给她留一个安静的角落读书写作。或许，还能找到一种更像她旧部队那样的、新的家人。

column1: Blackjack 0s are Primitive downgrades of the BJ-1, replacing both AC's with Medium Rifles, and maximizing armor as best as it can.
column2: Blackjack 0s 是 BJ-1 的原始降级版本，把两门 AC 都换成了中型步枪，并尽可能把装甲加到最厚。

column1:
Thiago never set foot in an actual military academy, and he's proud of that fact. He'd hitched a ride as a boy with a rough-and-tumble outfit that'd come in to protect the mining outpost where he was born, and where his parent died. He doesn't seem too broken up about it; his mother was a drunk and his dad was a gambler, and between ol' pops wasting what little money they had left on dicing in the alleyways after his ma drank most of it up, he figures the pirates did him a solid. He'd started in the mess, washing dishes, and as a gofer for the crew. He tried learning from the techs, from the pilots, from the officers... anyone who'd give him a lesson. He had no designs on peeling potatoes and fetching bad coffee for the rest of his life.

As he grew up, he learned about 'Mech combat, and it took a lot longer for him to get behind the wheel, so to speak, than it did for him to grasp the basics of tactics and strategy, since the latter didn't involve any risks to the outfit's hardware. His callsign, Rhino, is a bit of an in-joke. Turns out just because he's built like one doesn't mean he's anywhere as tough as one. Bit of a glass jaw. Not that you'd want to let a tactical mind like his get bounced around in his skull in a bar fight, mind.
column2:
蒂亚戈从未踏入过真正的军事学院，而他为此自豪。他还是个男孩时，就搭上一支粗野部队的顺风车——那支部队是来保护他出生的采矿哨站的，他的父母也死在那里。他似乎并不为此太过伤心；他母亲是个酒鬼，父亲是个赌徒，老娘把仅剩的那点钱喝掉大半之后，老爸又把剩下的钱输在了小巷的骰子上，所以他觉得海盗们算是帮了他一把。他从食堂干起，洗碗，给大家跑腿。他试着向技师学、向机师学、向军官学……任何愿意教他的人都行。他可不打算一辈子削土豆、端馊咖啡。

随着他长大，他学会了机甲作战；而比起掌握战术与战略的基础，他真正坐进驾驶舱的时间要晚得多，因为后者不会给部队的装备带来任何风险。他的呼号“犀牛”算是个内部笑话。事实证明，他体格虽然像犀牛，皮糙肉厚的程度却远远比不上。有点玻璃下巴。不过话说回来，你也不会想让像他这样一颗战术头脑在酒吧斗殴里被晃来晃去吧。

column1: The Black Knight 6-KNT is a dedicated Energy weapon platform. It can shell out hellish damage with its beams and shrug off a lot of damage. Just  make sure to keep its heat in check.
column2: Black Knight 6-KNT 是一台专职能量武器的平台。它既能用光束倾泻出地狱般的伤害，又能承受大量打击。只是得确保把它的热量控制住。

column1: Here We Have the OC Variant Of The Blackjack OmniMech. This Loadout Replaces The UAC/5's With LBX AC/10's.
column2: 这里带来的是 Blackjack 全能机甲的 OC 变型。这套配置把 UAC/5 换成了 LBX AC/10。

column1: This early Blackjack prototype started along a completely different path for the 'Mech.  Focusing on close in weapons, the BJ-1X has four Flamers and four Medium Lasers.  The BJ-1X also focused more on speed than jump maneuverability, increasing the engine size while removing the Jump Jets.
column2: 这款早期的 Blackjack 原型机走上了一条截然不同的道路。BJ-1X 专注混战武器，装有四具火焰喷射器和四门中型激光。它还更注重速度而非跳跃机动性，增大了引擎功率，同时拆除了跳跃推进器。

column1: An updated version of the primitive Ostwar developed in 2620, this variant carries 12 tons of standard BattleMech armor and a modern cockpit. The chassis has been upgraded to use Endo Steel, while an XL Engine increases the Ostwar's ground speed to 84 km/h. Eighteen double heat sinks dissipate the heat from three ER Large Lasers and twin SRM-6 launchers.
column2: 这款变型是 2620 年开发的原始型 Ostwar 的更新版本，携带 12 吨标准战斗机甲装甲与一座现代化驾驶舱。机体已升级为内钢结构，而一台 XL 引擎把 Ostwar 的地面速度提升到 84 公里/小时。十八具双散热器负责散发三门增程大型激光与两具 SRM-6 发射器的热量。

column1: The 4F Ostsol introduced in 2871 was the only common variant of the 'Mech pre-Clan Invasion, completely removing the laser weapons and replacing them with two Dominion-V PPCs in the side torsos. The 'Mech is seen as, in some ways at least, a poor man's Marauder or Warhammer, and the PPC array can quickly overload the sixteen heat sinks. Though, on its own merits, the variant is a good long-range direct fire support 'Mech which uses its top speed of 86.4 km/h to dictate combat ranges against most heavier 'Mechs.
column2: 2871 年推出的 4F Ostsol 是氏族入侵前该机唯一常见的变型，它彻底拆除了激光武器，改在两侧躯干各装一门 Dominion-V 粒子加农炮。在某些方面，该机被视为穷人版的掠夺者或战锤，而这样的粒子加农炮配置会很快压过十六具散热器的散热能力。不过就其自身而言，这个变型是一款优秀的远程直射火力支援机甲，它凭借 86.4 公里/小时的最高速度，能在面对大多数更重型的机甲时主导交战距离。

column1: The Ostscout already is lightly armed but this thing has gone a step further and replaced its weaponry with an Arrow IV TAG laser designator.
column2: Ostscout 本就已经火力贫弱，而这台东西更进一步，把自己的武器换成了一套箭式 IV TAG 激光指示器。

column1: The Raptor began as a proof of concept design by Luthien Armor Works that turned into a respected recon and fast strike OmniMech. The Raptor is built on an Alshain Type KR140 Endo Steel chassis and uses a weight-saving Omni 175 XL Engine, which gives the Raptor a top speed of 118.8 km/h.
column2: Raptor 最初是 Luthien Armor Works 的验证概念设计，后来成为一款备受推崇的侦察与快速打击全能机甲。Raptor 建立在 Alshain KR140 型内钢机体之上，并使用减重的全能 175 XL 引擎，使其最高速度达到 118.8 公里/小时。

column1: I know this is an old 'Mech and all, Boss, but ... c'mon. This thing is like somebody looked at the Victor and went "hey, let me copy your homework," and then didn't even improve on the design.
column2: 我知道这是台老机甲了，老板，但是……得了吧。这东西就像有人看了 Victor 一眼，说“嘿，作业借我抄一下”，然后连设计都没改进。

column1: The Owens is intended to be an OmniMech upgrade of the Jenner BattleMech. The intended role for the Owens is as a cavalry 'Mech that can move along the enemy lines and designate targets for bombardment with Arrow IV artillery attacks. The Owens is a strong spotting unit as well as a point 'Mech for C3 lances with its Beagle Probe and C3 Slave unit.
column2: Owens 意在成为 Jenner 战斗机甲的全能机甲升级版。Owens 的预定角色是骑兵机甲，能够沿敌方战线机动，并用箭式 IV 火炮打击为队友指示目标。凭借 Beagle 探测器和 C3 从属单元，Owens 既是出色的侦察标定单位，也是 C3 小队的核心机甲。

column1: Built by Krupp Armament Works under contract for the ComGuard, the 66C was intended for deployment on Tukayyid. Unfortunately the design was unable to be finished in time and Krupp was left with a finished mech that had no prospective buyers. In a deal brokered by Comstar, the company agreed to sell its finished production to the reformed SLDF and provide them with additional production runs as requested. Built as a fast interdiction unit, it was designed to chase down and annihilate Elemental formations. Armed with 4 small pulse lasers, a medium pulse laser and a Streak SRM-2; the variant performed with distinction throughout the post Tukayyid years and then through Operations Bulldog and Serpent. The Word of Blake invasion choked off the flow of new mechs, as Krupp’s production shifted to the newer designs demanded by the Word.
column2: 66C 由克虏伯军械厂按 ComGuard 的合约制造，原本计划部署于图卡伊德。遗憾的是该设计未能及时完工，克虏伯手里只剩下一台造好却无人问津的机甲。在 Comstar 居中撮合的一笔交易中，该公司同意把已完工的产品卖给重组后的 SLDF，并按需为其提供额外的生产批次。该机作为快速封锁单位而建造，设计目的是追猎并歼灭元素步兵编队。它装备 4 门小型脉冲激光、1 门中型脉冲激光和 1 具连发 SRM-2；在图卡伊德之后的岁月里，以及随后的“斗牛犬”与“毒蛇”行动中，该变型表现出众。布雷克之语的入侵掐断了新机甲的供应，因为克虏伯的生产转向了布雷克所需的新设计。

column1: A common Light OmniMech, the Mist Lynx is fielded by every Clan since its introduction in 2926. A 25-ton mech, the Mist Lynx is powered by a 175-rated XL Engine and is built with a combination of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous that gives it a respectable 7.5 tons of pod space. An Active Probe is hardwired into the chassis boosting the Mist Lynx’s effectiveness as a scout. The Mist Lynx Prime is armed with an LRM-10, a Streak SRM-4 and a pair of Machine Guns.
column2: 作为一款常见的轻型全能机甲，Mist Lynx 自 2926 年推出以来被每个氏族使用。这台 25 吨机甲由一台 175 级 XL 引擎驱动，采用内钢与铁纤维的组合，拥有可观的 7.5 吨挂载空间。机身内硬接了主动探测器，增强了 Mist Lynx 作为侦察单位的效能。Mist Lynx Prime 装备一具 LRM-10、一具连发 SRM-4 和两挺机枪。

column1: A common Light OmniMech, the Mist Lynx is fielded by every Clan since its introduction in 2926. A 25-ton mech, the Mist Lynx is powered by a 175-rated XL Engine and is built with a combination of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous that gives it a respectable 7.5 tons of pod space. An Active Probe is hardwired into the chassis boosting the Mist Lynx’s effectiveness as a scout. The Mist Lynx C is armed with an ER Large Laser, an ER Medium Laser and an AMS. Guardian ECM rounds out the variant.
column2: 作为一款常见的轻型全能机甲，Mist Lynx 自 2926 年推出以来被每个氏族使用。这台 25 吨机甲由一台 175 级 XL 引擎驱动，采用内钢与铁纤维的组合，拥有可观的 7.5 吨挂载空间。机身内硬接了主动探测器，增强了 Mist Lynx 作为侦察单位的效能。Mist Lynx C 装备一门增程大型激光、一门增程中型激光和一具 AMS。变型还配有 Guardian ECM 作为补充。

column1: To say that Ostroc OSR-2X is a custom machine would be something of an understatement. Taking the 'Mech’s pilot, Command Sergeant Major Kira Tang's orders to "make a 'Mech that people would remember" to the limit, the technicians and researchers truly pushed the envelope of 'Mech capabilities.
column2: 要说 Ostroc OSR-2X 是一台定制机体，那还算说得轻了。技师与研究人员把该机甲机师、军士长基拉·唐“造一台让人记住的机甲”的命令执行到了极限，真正把机甲性能推到了边缘。

column1: Early Clan Brawler
column2: 氏族早期混战机

column1: An upgrade to the Mongoose 67, the 67L is a locally produced model used by the Outworlds Alliance. Assigned to the First and Second Long Road Legions, every part of the mech is manufactured in the Alliance, save for the imported TAG system. The Alliance Military Corps provides the Mongoose chassis from their reserve stocks of Mon-67 models. Refitting the original MON-67 chassis in Ferro-Fibrous armor allows for additional protection and when combined with the removal of the Small Laser; the addition of the TAG system. Developed as a fast harasser and spotter, designed to work in concert with the Alliance Air Wings and Planetary garrisons; the design has proven popular among Mongoose pilots as much for it's improved capabilities as it's locally made parts.
column2: 作为 Mongoose 67 的升级型，67L 是外世界联盟本地生产的型号。它被分配给第一与第二长路军团，除了进口的 TAG 系统之外，机甲的每一个部件都在联盟制造。联盟军事部队从库存的 Mon-67 型号中提供 Mongoose 机体。将原有的 MON-67 机体改装为铁纤维装甲可带来额外防护，再加上拆除小型激光，便有了加装 TAG 系统的空间。该机被开发为快速袭扰者与标定单位，设计上与联盟空军联队及行星驻军协同作战；由于性能的提升，也由于采用本地制造的零件，这一设计在 Mongoose 机师中广受欢迎。

column1: Roadrunner
column2: 走鹃

column1: The Spider 5V is hands down the most maneuverable 'Mech you can field, but it's made of paper. It's an excellent scout, though, and can even jump into the rear arc of most enemies for surprise back shots.
column2: Spider 5V 无疑是你能投入战场的最灵巧的机甲，但它薄得像纸。不过它是极出色的侦察机，甚至能跳到大多数敌人的后方弧线内，来一记出其不意的背射。

column1: Custom Clan BattleMech
column2: 定制氏族战斗机甲

column1: The Shadow Cat is a heavily-armed and maneuverable medium OmniMech developed by Clan Nova Cat to replace the Ice Ferret in the early 31st century during preparations for Operation Revival. A more recent variant, the Shadow Cat C marries a pair of ATM 6s to three ER Medium Lasers. It mounts enough ammunition to make use of the flexibility of the Advanced Tactical Missile System. A Narc Missile Beacon helps Starmates' missiles target an enemy unit.
column2: Shadow Cat 是 Nova Cat 氏族在 31 世纪早期为“复兴行动”做准备时开发的重武装、高机动中型全能机甲，用以取代 Ice Ferret。较新的变型 Shadow Cat C 把一对 ATM 6 与三门增程中型激光结合在一起。它携带了足够的弹药，以充分利用先进战术导弹系统的灵活性。一具 NARC 导弹信标能帮助星伴的导弹锁定敌方单位。

column1: Due to ongoing structural weakness issues with the aging Stalker chassis, it was necessary to reduce the load by 10 tons by removing a LRM launcher effectively reclassifying this variant as a Heavy 'Mech.
column2: 由于老旧的 Stalker 机体存在持续的结构强度问题，不得不拆除一具 LRM 发射器以减重 10 吨，这实际上把该变型重新归类为重型机甲。

column1: The Stalker 3H was intended as a siege 'Mech.  Replacing the twin LRM-10s and Large Lasers for paired LRM-20s, the STK-3H is a powerful fire support 'Mech.
column2: Stalker 3H 意在成为一台攻城机甲。STK-3H 用成对的 LRM-20 取代了双联 LRM-10 与大型激光，是一台强大的火力支援机甲。

column1: The Spider I1 is a cheap refit from the Frontier Worlds that comes with a Plasma Cutter and Fluid Gun, along with marginally improved armor.
column2: Spider I1 是边疆世界推出的廉价改装型，配备一具等离子切割器和一具流体枪，装甲也有所小幅改善。

column1: Solaris Prototype
column2: 索拉里斯原型机

column1: A militarized BattleMech version of Achernar's Loader King IndustrialMech, the Roughneck is a low-cost heavy 'Mech intended for price conscious buyers such as planetary militias and down-on-their-luck mercenary units. The Roughneck-1C leans hard on its missiles for firepower, carrying a pair of SRM-6s and a pair of Machine Guns for close range power, with long range firepower provided by a LRM-10 and an AC/5.
column2: Roughneck 是 Achernar 公司的 Loader King 工业机甲的军用战斗机甲版本，是一款低成本重型机甲，面向注重价格的买家，例如行星民兵和时运不济的雇佣兵部队。Roughneck-1C 在火力上严重依赖导弹，携带一对 SRM-6 和两挺机枪提供近距离火力，远程火力则由一具 LRM-10 和一门 AC/5 提供。

column1: A militarized BattleMech version of Achernar's Loader King IndustrialMech, the Roughneck is a low-cost heavy 'Mech intended for price conscious buyers such as planetary militias and down-on-their-luck mercenary units. The Roughneck-1B swaps the AC/10 of the -1A for an AC/5 and upgrades the missiles to a pair of SRM-6 racks. The Small Laser and two of the Machine Guns are retained.
column2: Roughneck 是 Achernar 公司的 Loader King 工业机甲的军用战斗机甲版本，是一款低成本重型机甲，面向注重价格的买家，例如行星民兵和时运不济的雇佣兵部队。Roughneck-1B 把 -1A 的 AC/10 换成 AC/5，并将导弹升级为两具 SRM-6 发射器。小型激光和两挺机枪予以保留。

column1: The Shadow Cat is a heavily-armed and maneuverable medium OmniMech developed by Clan Nova Cat to replace the Ice Ferret in the early 31st century during preparations for Operation Revival. The B variant is also a fusion of long-range weaponry with a scouting system. This configuration adds a pair of Artemis IV-guided LRM 15s to the Active Probe. It also has a pair of ER Medium Lasers for backup, though it adds an ECM Suite to the electronics package.
column2: Shadow Cat 是 Nova Cat 氏族在 31 世纪早期为“复兴行动”做准备时开发的重武装、高机动中型全能机甲，用以取代 Ice Ferret。B 变型同样把远程武器与侦察系统融为一体。这套配置在主动探测器之外增加了一对阿尔忒弥斯 IV 制导的 LRM 15。它还备有一对增程中型激光作为后手，同时在电子设备套件中加入了一套 ECM。

column1: The Shadow Cat is a heavily-armed and maneuverable medium OmniMech developed by Clan Nova Cat to replace the Ice Ferret in the early 31st century during preparations for Operation Revival. The first alternate configuration is also potent at long range, but it uses a pair of ER Large Lasers to gain that potency. It retains the Active Probe of the prime, but uses a Streak SRM-6 for backup. It also utilizes three extra double heat sinks to keep heat levels comfortable.
column2: Shadow Cat 是 Nova Cat 氏族在 31 世纪早期为“复兴行动”做准备时开发的重武装、高机动中型全能机甲，用以取代 Ice Ferret。第一个备用配置在远距离上同样颇具威力，但它靠的是两门增程大型激光。它保留了主配置的主动探测器，但改以一具连发 SRM-6 作为后手。它还额外使用三具双散热器，让热量水平保持舒适。

column1: Elite Juggernaut
column2: 精锐碾压型

column1: Designed as a replacement to the Timber Wolf, the 65 ton Linebacker entered production in 3052. Built around a 390-rated XL Engine, the Linebacker’s faster speed enables it to keep up with lighter star mates in running battles, something the Timber Wolf struggled to do. A combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel give the OmniMech 17.5 tons of free pod space. The Linebacker LBK-B is armed with a Gauss Rifle and 3 ER Medium Lasers. An ER Small Laser fills out the remaining free weight.Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1.
column2: 为取代 Timber Wolf 而设计，65 吨的 Linebacker 于 3052 年投产。它围绕一台 390 级 XL 引擎建造，更快的速度让它能在运动中跟上更轻的星伴，而这正是 Timber Wolf 难以做到的。铁纤维装甲与内钢的组合让这台全能机甲拥有 17.5 吨的自由挂载空间。Linebacker LBK-B 装备一门高斯步枪和 3 门增程中型激光。一门增程小型激光则填满了剩余的自由重量。空投成本倍率：1.1。

column1: Designed as a replacement to the Timber Wolf, the 65 ton Linebacker entered production in 3052. Built around a 390-rated XL Engine, the Linebacker’s faster speed enables it to keep up with lighter star mates in running battles, something the Timber Wolf struggled to do. A combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel give the OmniMech 17.5 tons of free pod space. The Linebacker LBK-A is armed with a pair of ER Large Lasers and an LRM-15. An LRM-5 and 2 ER Medium Lasers fill out the remaining free weight.Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1.
column2: 为取代 Timber Wolf 而设计，65 吨的 Linebacker 于 3052 年投产。它围绕一台 390 级 XL 引擎建造，更快的速度让它能在运动中跟上更轻的星伴，而这正是 Timber Wolf 难以做到的。铁纤维装甲与内钢的组合让这台全能机甲拥有 17.5 吨的自由挂载空间。Linebacker LBK-A 装备两门增程大型激光和一具 LRM-15。一具 LRM-5 和 2 门增程中型激光填满了剩余的自由重量。空投成本倍率：1.1。

column1: A Light Clan OmniMech, the 30 ton Kit Fox was introduced in 2890 by Clan Cloud Cobra. Favouring a mix of firepower and armor over speed, the Kit Fox is powered by a 180 XL Engine and features a mix of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous; giving it 16 tons of pod space. The Kit Fox S is armed with a Large Pulse Laser and a Streak SRM-4. A Medium Pulse Laser, Small Pulse Laser and a pair of Machine Guns complement this.
column2: 作为一款轻型氏族全能机甲，30 吨的 Kit Fox 由 Cloud Cobra 氏族于 2890 年推出。它偏重火力与装甲而非速度，由一台 180 XL 引擎驱动，并采用内钢与铁纤维的组合，拥有 16 吨挂载空间。Kit Fox S 装备一门大型脉冲激光和一具连发 SRM-4。一门中型脉冲激光、一门小型脉冲激光和两挺机枪则作为补充。

column1: Though most nations got rid of their cloned Mackies in favor of their own 'Mechs, the Hegemony was proud of their achievement. Moreover, many Hegemony militia units made extensive use of the first BattleMech, resulting in a continuous production of the first BattleMech right up until the Amaris Coup. Many of the various militia upgrades coalesced into the -9H, helped by the fact that Skobel continued to produce small quantities of this design. It mounts two PPCs and an Autocannon/20, backed up by the pair of Medium Lasers. Nineteen tons of armor gave it full protection, allowing the 9Hs longevity.
column2: 尽管大多数国家都舍弃了仿制的麦基、转而使用自己设计的机甲，泰拉霸权仍为自己的成就感到自豪。此外，许多霸权民兵部队大量使用了这第一台战斗机甲，使得第一款战斗机甲的持续生产一直延续到阿马里斯政变。多种民兵升级方案最终汇集成了 -9H，这也得益于 Skobel 仍在持续小批量生产这一设计。它装有两门粒子加农炮和一门 AC/20，并以一对中型激光作为补充。十九吨装甲给予它全面的防护，也让 9H 得以长久服役。

column1: Mobile Artillery
column2: 机动炮兵

column1: Designed as a replacement to the Timber Wolf, the 65 ton Linebacker entered production in 3052. Built around a 390-rated XL Engine, the Linebacker’s faster speed enables it to keep up with lighter star mates in running battles, something the Timber Wolf struggled to do. A combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel give the OmniMech 17.5 tons of free pod space. The Linebacker LBK-D is armed with 4 Streak SRM-6’s. A pair of ER Medium lasers and an ER Small Laser fill out the remaining free weight.Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1.
column2: 为取代 Timber Wolf 而设计，65 吨的 Linebacker 于 3052 年投产。它围绕一台 390 级 XL 引擎建造，更快的速度让它能在运动中跟上更轻的星伴，而这正是 Timber Wolf 难以做到的。铁纤维装甲与内钢的组合让这台全能机甲拥有 17.5 吨的自由挂载空间。Linebacker LBK-D 装备 4 具连发 SRM-6。一对增程中型激光和一门增程小型激光填满了剩余的自由重量。空投成本倍率：1.1。

column1: I can't decide if I love this thing or if I hate it, Boss. On the one hand, "wow, cool quad 'mech," and on the other hand, "why in God's name would you do this?"
column2: 我说不好自己是爱这东西还是恨它，老板。一方面，“哇，酷，四足机甲”；另一方面，“你到底是为什么要这么干？”

column1: This version of the King Crab was created by the Star League to be a command 'Mech and introduced alongside the original 000 model in 2743. Conceived in secret between Cosara and the Terran Hegemony, it was an attempt to produce a deadly command 'Mech by mounting a pair of newly-developed Hellstar Magna PPCs in either side torso backed by a pair of SRM-6s. A pair of newly developed LBX/10s replaced the standard autocannon. The 010 model was more than capable of taking down an Atlas, but the entire line left with Kerensky during the Exodus and even knowledge of the design's existence became lost during the Succession Wars.
column2: 这个版本的 King Crab 由星际联盟为打造一款指挥机甲而创造，于 2743 年与最初的 000 型号一同推出。它由 Cosara 与泰拉霸权秘密构思，试图通过在两肋各装一门新研制的 Hellstar Magna 粒子加农炮、再配上一对 SRM-6，造出一台致命的指挥机甲。一对新研制的 LBX/10 取代了标准自动炮。010 型号完全有能力击倒一台 Atlas，但整条生产线都在大迁徙中随克伦斯基离去，甚至连该设计曾经存在的知识也在继承战争中失传了。

column1: The King Crab KGC-0 is a badly maintained primitive version of one of the most heavily armed and armored 'Mechs ever constructed. While carrying lesser weaponry, its arsenal still able to deliver a crushing Blow.

column1: A refit developed with Comstar’s mothballed 9Hb’s, the Mackie 9Hc was an attempt to fix the failings of it’s predecessor design. Identifying the lack of CASE and adequate secondary weapons as the key weaknesses, the Comguard designers searched for a solution. The designers made the decision to slow the 'Mech's top speed even further as the preferred option. With the additional weight, both ammo magazines were upgraded with CASE and the designers installed an additional 3 Medium Lasers with the heat sinks upgraded to double strength models to handle the increased heat. The 5 completed prototypes served with distinction on Tukayyid, though the design never reached production status; with only 2 other conversions finished before the Word of Blake seized Terra and the remaining stocks of 9Hb’s.
column2: Mackie 9Hc 是用 Comstar 封存的 9Hb 改装而成的改进型，意在修正前代设计的缺陷。设计者认定缺乏 CASE 与足够的副武器是关键弱点，于是着手寻找解决办法。他们最终选择把机甲的最高速度进一步降低。借助多出来的重量，两个弹药仓都加装了 CASE，设计者还额外安装了 3 门中型激光，并把散热器升级为双倍强度的型号以应对增加的热量。5 台完工的原型机在图卡伊德表现出色，但该设计终究未能进入量产；在布雷克之语夺取泰拉以及剩余的 9Hb 库存之前，只又完成了 2 台改装。

column1: A prototype that never saw widespread adoption, the Merlin 2A was Mountain Wolfs next generation offering unveiled alongside the 1B variant in 3053. Built around a 240-rated XL Engine, it is armed with a pair of ER Large Lasers and a pair of Medium Pulses. The 1A's Machine Gun is retained and the LRM-5 upgraded to a LRM-10. The addition of CASE protects the ammunition bays and 14 Double Heat Sinks handle the increased heat burden. At almost 19 million CBills, the design was rejected as too expensive and too reliant on advanced technology that the Outworlds Alliance struggled to produce. Mountain Wolf shelved the design, though not before a single run of 20 2A's were produced. Most of these were fielded by the Mountain Wolf security team, but some found their way into the hands of the elite Avellar Guard.\n
column2: Merlin 2A 是一款从未被广泛采用的试验机型，是 Mountain Wolf 于 3053 年与 1B 变型一同推出的下一代产品。它围绕一台 240 级 XL 引擎建造，装备两门增程大型激光和两门中型脉冲激光。1A 的机枪予以保留，LRM-5 则升级为 LRM-10。加装 CASE 保护了弹药仓，14 具双散热器则应对增加的热负荷。由于造价接近 1900 万 C 币，且过度依赖外世界联盟难以生产的先进技术，该设计被判定过于昂贵而遭否决。Mountain Wolf 将其束之高阁，不过在此之前已生产了一批共 20 台 2A。它们大多由 Mountain Wolf 安保队使用，但也有一些流入了精锐的阿韦拉尔卫队手中。\n

These weapons are commonly called "Clan Enhanced" and 'Mech's fitted with them often had the "-CE" suffix added to their designation.
column2: 当星际联盟国防军在“大迁徙”行动中随总司令亚历山大·克伦斯基离开内天体时，他们带走了许多最常见的机甲。随着流亡中的 SLDF 被锻造成氏族，他们开始研制改进型武器，并将其装到现有的战斗机甲上。这些武器通常被称为“氏族增强型”，而配备它们的机甲往往会在型号后加上“-CE”后缀。

column1: The Yu Huang, named for the Jade Emperor that rules the Heavenly Court in the ancient Chinese pantheon, debuted with the promise from Sun-Tzu Liao that "it shall sit in judgment over a battlefield, meting out justice to those who would transgress against us". To live up to the promise of the Chancellor of the Capellan Confederation, the Yu Huang carries some of the most advanced technologies available at the time of its initial production. The Yu Huang is built on an Endo Steel chassis and carries a 360 XL engine that gives the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The 'Mech is capable of jumping up to one hundred and twenty meters with its four jump jets.
column2: Yu Huang 得名于中国古代神话中统领天庭的玉皇大帝，它在首次亮相时伴随着孙武·廖的承诺：“它将端坐于战场之上施行审判，向那些胆敢侵犯我们的人施以正义。”为了兑现卡佩兰联盟大公的承诺，Yu Huang 在最初投产时便搭载了当时最先进的一些技术。Yu Huang 建立在一条内钢机体之上，携带一台 360 XL 引擎，使该机甲的最高速度达到 64.8 公里/小时。该机甲还能凭借 4 具跳跃推进器跃出最远一百二十米。

column1: The Talos is extremely old but reliable Taurian design. I'm pretty sure they stopped making these things before the Succession Wars but here we are, one in the flesh. Complete with an AC/10, two LRM-5s, and a SRM-6, the Talos was a go-to mech for the Taurians for a good reason.
column2: Talos 是金牛座一款极其古老却可靠的设计。我很确定他们在继承战争之前就停产了这些东西，可现在它就在眼前，货真价实。AC/10、两具 LRM-5 加一具 SRM-6，Talos 成为金牛座人的首选机甲是有充分理由的。

column1: Armed to engage an enemy at either short or long ranges, the B configuration is an attempt to use the Timber Wolf in a workhorse role. For long range combat, a Gauss Rifle and an LRM-10 launcher gives the Timber Wolf B a powerful long range punch. For short to medium range engagements, a Large Pulse Laser is carried. Finally, for short ranges, a Small Pulse Laser and SRM-4 launcher are carried. Additionally, both of the missile launchers are linked to an Artemis IV Fire Control System to allow for greater missile accuracy.
column2: 该配置的武装可应对远近距离的敌人，B 配置试图把 Timber Wolf 用作主力干活的角色。远程作战时，一门高斯步枪与一具 LRM-10 发射器赋予 Timber Wolf B 强大的远程打击力。中近距离交战时，它携带一门大型脉冲激光。最后，近距离作战时，它携带一门小型脉冲激光与一具 SRM-4 发射器。此外，两具导弹发射器都连接了阿尔忒弥斯 IV 火控系统，以获得更高的导弹命中率。

column1: Configured specifically for long range, direct fire combat, the A configuration of the Timber Wolf is armed with a pair of ER PPCs. These give the Timber Wolf A the capability of stripping nearly two tons of armor off of an enemy 'Mech at extreme ranges. For close combat, the A configuration has three Medium Pulse Lasers, an ER Small Laser, and a Streak SRM-6 to find any weak points in an enemy's armor.
column2: A 配置专为远程直射交战而设计，装备两门增程粒子加农炮。这让 Timber Wolf A 能在极远距离上从敌方机甲身上剥掉近两吨装甲。近距离作战时，A 配置有三门中型脉冲激光、一门增程小型激光和一具连发 SRM-6，用来寻找敌方装甲上的任何弱点。

column1: FrankenMech
column2: 拼装机甲

column1: This variant of the Strider has NARC Beacons along with a Beagle Active Probe to tag enemy Mechs.
column2: Strider 的这一变型配备 NARC 信标以及一具 Beagle 主动探测器，用于给敌方机甲挂标。

column1: A pair of Clan-tech ATM-6 launchers installed on this Mech is accompanied by small and medium ER Pulse Lasers carried in each arm.
column2: 这台机甲上安装的一对氏族技术 ATM-6 发射器，配有两臂各载的小型与中型增程脉冲激光。

column1: A Heavy Laser-toting version of the primary configuration; the H has, as its main weapons, two Heavy Large Lasers. These are backed up by three ER Medium Lasers.
column2: H 配置以重型激光为主，是主配置的重型激光版本；其主要武器为两门重型大型激光，并有三门增程中型激光作为后盾。

column1: This variant of the Strider uses two Streak SRM-2s, two Medium Pulse Lasers, a Tag and C3 along with a Beagle Probe.
column2: Strider 的这一变型使用两具连发 SRM-2、两门中型脉冲激光、一具 TAG 与 C3，外加一具 Beagle 探测器。

column1: This variant of the Strider uses two LRM-5s and a Large Laser paired with a C3 Slave Computer.
column2: Strider 的这一变型使用两具 LRM-5 和一门大型激光，并搭配一台 C3 从属计算机。

column1: This variant of the Strider has two LRM-10s.
column2: Strider 的这一变型装备两具 LRM-10。

column1: A long range configuration of the Timber Wolf, the C configuration carries an assortment of long range weapons. For direct fire capabilities, the Timber Wolf C mounts two ER Large Lasers and an Ultra Autocannon/5. For indirect fire support capability, its two LRM-15 launchers provide an ample quantity of firepower. Finally, for close range protection, the C carries an ER Medium Laser and an Anti-Missile System.
column2: 作为 Timber Wolf 的远程配置，C 配置携带了各式各样的远程武器。就直射能力而言，Timber Wolf C 装有两门增程大型激光和一门 UAC/5。就间接火力支援而言，它的两具 LRM-15 发射器提供了充足的火力。最后，为近距离自卫，C 配置携带一门增程中型激光和一具反导弹系统。

column1: Crazy Men
column2: 狂人小队

column1: Gladiator 'Mech
column2: 角斗士机甲

column1: Almost an entirely new 'Mech, the Trebuchet 7K moves away from its missile support to direct fire support, using a PPC and AC/5 along with a SRM-2 for some close in support.
column2: Trebuchet 7K 几乎算是一台全新的机甲，它从导弹支援转向直射火力支援，使用一门粒子加农炮和一门 AC/5，外加一具 SRM-2 提供部分近身支援。

column1: Early Clan Heavy Cavalry
column2: 氏族早期重骑兵

column1: Early Clan Defender
column2: 氏族早期防御机

column1: The Undine battle armor was created by Clan Goliath Scorpion as a combat upgrade to the original "water elementals," the underwater exoskeletons that inspired Clan Wolf's Elemental battle armor.
column2: Undine 战斗装甲由 Goliath Scorpion 氏族创造，是对最初的“水元素”——那种启发了 Wolf 氏族元素战斗装甲的水下外骨骼——的作战升级版。

column1: A configuration that is capable of engaging an enemy with devastating effect at any range, the H configuration carries a pair of LRM-20 launchers linked to an Artemis IV Fire Control System for long range firepower. For close combat, two Heavy Large Lasers are carried, each of which can strip a full ton of armor from an enemy 'Mech at short ranges. Finally, seemingly added almost as an afterthought, an ER Small Laser completes the H's weaponry loadout.
column2: H 配置能在任何距离上对敌人造成毁灭性打击：它携带两具连接阿尔忒弥斯 IV 火控系统的 LRM-20 发射器，提供远程火力。混战时，它携带两门重型大型激光，每一门都能在近距离从敌方机甲上剥下整整一吨装甲。最后，似乎只是顺带加上的一门增程小型激光补全了 H 的武器配置。

column1: Configured to use the added flexibility of the new Advanced Tactical Missile system, the E configuration mounts two ER Large Lasers as its primary direct fire weapons. The E Configuration also carries two ATM 9 launchers which can fire ammunition that is tailored to the ranges which it is engaging the enemy at. Finally, it carries a Light TAG designator for calling in Arrow IV artillery fire.
column2: E 配置旨在利用新型先进战术导弹系统带来的额外灵活性，以两门增程大型激光作为其主要直射武器。E 配置还携带两具 ATM 9 发射器，可以发射针对当前交战距离量身选配的弹药。最后，它还携带一具轻型 TAG 指示器，用于呼叫箭式 IV 火炮打击。

column1: This configuration mounts a pair of ER PPCs as its primary weapons. These are supported by four Streak SRM-6 launchers with two in the left torso and two in the right torso. One Streak SRM-6 on both torsos is rear mounted. A single ER Small Laser rounds out the Timber Wolf D's arsenal.
column2: 该配置以两门增程粒子加农炮为主要武器。它们由四具连发 SRM-6 发射器支援，左躯干两具、右躯干两具。两侧躯干各有一具连发 SRM-6 为后向安装。一门增程小型激光补全了 Timber Wolf D 的武器配置。

column1: Rebuilt from the salvaged remains of a Trebuchet 5S, this low tech refit is a common sight throughout the battlefields of the Deep Periphery. Mounting between 2 and 4 Rocket pods and backed up by a pair of Large Chem Lasers; makes the 5SP into a fearsome short range brawler. Some designs include scavenged or salvaged Endo Steel or Ferro-Fibrous, either for increased protection or to mount additional rocket pods. Limited by the 4 tons of Chemical Laser ammunition and the single salvos of the rocket pod, the SP lacks the endurance for protracted engagements. Fortunately these are rarely a concern in the Deep Periphery and this design is commonly seen during raids and border skirmishes, where its heavy firepower can give it an edge over less durable opponents.
column2: 这台由 Trebuchet 5S 的残骸重建而来的低技术改装机，在深外围的战场上随处可见。它装有 2 到 4 具火箭巢，并以两门大型化学激光作为后盾，使 5SP 成为一台令人生畏的近距离混战机。有些设计会采用拾获或回收的内钢或铁纤维，或用于增强防护，或用于加装更多火箭巢。受限于 4 吨化学激光弹药和火箭巢的单次齐射，SP 缺乏持久交战的能力。所幸在深外围这很少成为问题；这种设计常见于突袭与边境冲突，在这些场合，它沉重的火力能让它在面对不够耐打的对手时占据优势。

column1: Urban Mad Cat
column2: 城市疯猫

column1: The default configuration of the Timber Wolf features a well blended mix of energy and missile weaponry; primarily extended-range lasers and long range missile racks that give the Timber Wolf considerable firepower at medium and long range. A pair of LRM-20 racks supplemented by two Extended Range Large Lasers make up the bulk of the Timber Wolf's firepower. The Timber Wolf also has an array of lighter, shorter ranged weaponry for use once the 'Mech draws closer to its prey: two ER Medium Lasers and a Medium Pulse Laser. Finally, it has two Machine Guns for point defense against infantry.
column2: Timber Wolf 的默认配置融合了能量武器与导弹武器：主要是增程激光与远程导弹挂架，让 Timber Wolf 在中远距离拥有可观的威力。两具 LRM-20 挂架再加上两门增程大型激光，构成了 Timber Wolf 的主要火力。它还备有一批更轻、射程更短的武器，供机甲接近猎物后使用：两门增程中型激光和一门中型脉冲激光。最后，它还有两挺机枪用于对步兵的近程防御。

column1: The 2N variant of the Axman, introduced in the late 3040s, has been called a mistake by some and a stroke of genius by others. The 2N carries two LRM-15 launchers in place of the massive Autocannon/20 as the autocannon often jammed on early models. While this changes the 'Mech's role from a city fighter to a long-range bombardment 'Mech, it also allows the Axman to be a support 'Mech that can defend itself with its massive Hatchet at ranges where the LRMs are ineffective if an enemy closes.
column2: 2N 变型于 3040 年代后期推出，有人称之为错误，也有人称之为神来之笔。由于早期型号的自动炮常常卡壳，2N 以两具 LRM-15 发射器取代了巨大的 AC/20。这既把机甲的角色从城市战机体转变为远程轰击机甲，也让 Axman 成为一台支援机甲：一旦敌人逼近，它还能在 LRM 失去效力的距离上用巨大的战斧自卫。

column1: Clan Munchkin
column2: 氏族强力党

column1: Configured almost exclusively for long range combat, the B configuration of the Gargoyle carries a powerful Gauss Rifle backed up by an LRM-10 launcher linked to an Artemis IV FCS, allowing it to keep its distance from enemy units. For self-defense at short ranges, the 'Mech has an SRM-4 launcher which is also enhanced with an Artemis IV FCS. The main drawback to this configuration is its over reliance on ammunition based weaponry, making it effective only so long as it has sufficient ammunition for its weapons.
column2: B 配置几乎专为远程交战而设，携带一门强大的高斯步枪，并以一具连接阿尔忒弥斯 IV 火控系统的 LRM-10 发射器作为后盾，使它能与敌方单位保持距离。近身自卫方面，该机甲装有一具同样由阿尔忒弥斯 IV 火控系统增强的 SRM-4 发射器。这一配置的主要缺陷在于过度依赖弹药类武器，因此只有在弹药充足时才能发挥效力。

column1: Born from the Terran Hegemony's attempts to create a medium fire-support platform that would be more advanced than the RLN-1N Rifleman, Mitchell Vehicles unveiled the GLH-1D Galahad in 2570. Though it outgunned the earlier design and found significant acceptance within the Hegemony Armed Forces, the Galahad suffered from the same heat issues as the BattleMech it was meant to replace. This variant uses the original 50-ton mech weapon loadout.
column2: 诞生于泰拉霸权打造一款比 RLN-1N 步枪手更先进的中型火力支援平台的尝试，Mitchell Vehicles 于 2570 年推出了 GLH-1D Galahad。虽然它火力胜过更早的设计，并在霸权武装部队中获得了相当程度的认可，Galahad 却和它本要取代的战斗机甲一样受困于散热问题。这一变型沿用了原始 50 吨机甲的武器配置。

column1: There's something foreboding about this 'Mech, Boss. I don't like it. While I was workin' on it, I got this feeling I couldn't explain. Like it's not supposed to exist.
column2: 这台机甲给我一种不祥的预感，老板。我不喜欢它。修它的时候，我有种说不清的感觉。就好像它本不该存在。

column1: Gray Death Scout is a radical take on battle armor, almost taking the "battle" out of battle armor. When the New Avalon Institute of Science sent prototypes of its Inner Sphere Standard to the Gray Death Legion, the mercenaries were duly impressed with many of its features. They also had a number of criticisms, sending a long list of improvements back to NAIS while Legion technicians went about with their own tinkering. By late 3051 the Legion had created two distinct suits from the original prototype: a Gray Death Standard similar in form and function of the Inner Sphere Standard, and a light "scout armor" suit. By stripping off more than half of the prototype's armor and its integrated weaponry, the technicians were able to improve the Scout's jumping and sensor capabilities, creating a suit suitable for deep reconnaissance missions.
column2: Gray Death 侦察型是对战斗装甲的一次激进演绎，几乎把“战斗”二字从战斗装甲里剔了出去。当新阿瓦隆科学学院把其内天体标准型的原型送到 Gray Death 军团时，这些雇佣兵对其诸多特性印象深刻。同时他们也提出了一系列批评意见，把一长串改进建议送回 NAIS，军团技师们也自顾自地动手改造。到 3051 年末，军团已从原始原型发展出两款截然不同的套装：一型在形态与功能上类似内天体标准型的 Gray Death 标准型，以及一型轻量的“侦察装甲”。通过剥掉原型一半以上的装甲和内置武器，技师们得以改善侦察型的跳跃与传感器能力，造出了一款适合深度侦察任务的套装。

column1: Affectionately known as the 'Grand Dragon', the DRG-1G replaces the AC/5 with a PPC, Medium Laser and 2 extra Heat Sinks.
column2: DRG-1G 被亲切地称为“大龙”，它用一门粒子加农炮、一门中型激光和 2 具额外的散热器取代了 AC/5。

column1: They dropped both the Artemis-enhanced LRM-20s for eight SRM-4 launchers, four per torso, while the two rear facing medium lasers are also removed for two forward facing Medium Pulse Lasers.
column2: 他们撤掉了两具阿尔忒弥斯增强的 LRM-20，换成八具 SRM-4 发射器，每侧躯干四具；同时两门朝后的中型激光也被移除，换成两门朝前的中型脉冲激光。

column1: A Clan Buster upgrade, the Archer 5CS was a Comstar prototype rushed into production specifically to outfit units that would be fighting on Tukayyid. Designed to carry as much firepower as possible, a combination of a 280-rated XL Engine, Endo Steel chassis and DHS free up the tonnage need to mount 4 LRM-15’s with an Artemis IV FCS. A pair of Medium Lasers are retained should enemies close on the Archer.
column2: 作为一款氏族克星升级型，Archer 5CS 是 Comstar 专为装备将在图卡伊德作战的部队而赶制的原型机。为尽可能携带更多火力，280 级 XL 引擎、内钢机体与双散热器的组合腾出了所需的吨位，得以安装 4 具配备阿尔忒弥斯 IV 火控系统的 LRM-15。若敌人逼近 Archer，则保留一对中型激光应对。

column1: Built by the GKT Enterprise factory on Satalice for the Free Rasalhague Republic, the 5R was introduced in 3050 and bore similarities to the 2K model of the Archer. It carried a pair of FarFire LRM-15 launchers but mounted two Victory Nickel Alloy ER Large Lasers, one in either arm, in place of the medium lasers. It also linked Artemis IV fire control systems to the launchers and utilized twelve double heat sinks to improve waste heat dissipation. Despite being built around an Endo-Steel chassis, these improvements necessitated a decrease in armor protection by two tons.
column2: 5R 由 GKT 企业在萨塔利斯的工厂为自由拉沙尔哈格共和国制造，于 3050 年推出，与 Archer 的 2K 型号有相似之处。它携带两具 FarFire LRM-15 发射器，但装有两门 Victory Nickel Alloy 增程大型激光，两臂各一门，取代了中型激光。它还为发射器连接了阿尔忒弥斯 IV 火控系统，并使用十二具双散热器来改善废热散发。尽管建立在一条内钢机体之上，这些改进仍迫使装甲防护削减了两吨。

column1: They said it couldn't be done. They said it shouldn't be done. Perhaps, Boss ... perhaps they were right.
column2: 他们说过这做不到。他们说过这不该做。也许吧，老板……也许他们是对的。

column1: The Archer is a one the best known fire support 'Mechs and can still put up a good fight at closer ranges.
column2: Archer 是最知名的火力支援机甲之一，即便拉到近距离也能打得有来有回。

column1: Ultralight FlameMech
column2: 超轻型喷火机甲

column1: Munchkin
column2: 强力党

column1: A common modification of the Cyclops that uses some rediscovered Star League technology, the 11-A was introduced in 3045 and replaces the massive Autocannon/20 for a Zeus Slingshot Gauss Rifle with two tons of ammo. Although doing slightly less damage it has a much larger effective range.
column2: 作为 Cyclops 的常见改装型，11-A 使用了一些被重新发现的星际联盟技术，于 3045 年推出，用一门 Zeus Slingshot 高斯步枪和两吨弹药取代了巨大的 AC/20。虽然伤害略低，但其有效射程要大得多。

column1: The 11-C is similar to the 11-A in that they carry an almost identical weapons payload. Built in 3050 the only difference is that the 11-C has removed the LRM-10 launcher and replaced it with a C3 Computer, which allows it to share targeting data and coordinate C3 lances. An additional two tons of armor have been added to the design as well. This makes the 11-C a highly effective sniper and command 'Mech.
column2: 11-C 与 11-A 相似，两者的武器载荷几乎完全相同。11-C 造于 3050 年，唯一的区别是它拆除了 LRM-10 发射器，换上一台 C3 计算机，从而能共享瞄准数据并协调 C3 小队。该设计还额外增加两吨装甲。这让 11-C 成为一台高效的狙击与指挥机甲。

column1: A full redesign of the Cyclops, the 11-G was built by Grumium Creations for the Second Star League Defense Force, Com Guards and Free Rasalhague Republic. Debuting in 3058 it redesigns the chassis to use Endo Steel construction and also replaces the standard armor with fifteen tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. For long range combat it retains the Gauss Rifle and LRM-10 missile launcher minus one ton of missile reloads, while the arm-mounted medium lasers and center-torso SRM launcher were also upgraded to ER Medium Lasers and a Streak SRM-4 launcher. All ammunition for the weapons was also shifted to the right-side torso and uses CASE to protect itself from complete destruction in the event of an ammunition explosion.
column2: 11-G 是对 Cyclops 的全面重新设计，由 Grumium Creations 为第二星际联盟国防军、Com Guards 与自由拉沙尔哈格共和国制造。它于 3058 年首次亮相，重新设计了机体以采用内钢构造，并用十五吨铁纤维装甲取代标准装甲。远程作战方面，它保留了高斯步枪和 LRM-10 导弹发射器，但少了一吨导弹备用弹；而臂装中型激光与中央躯干 SRM 发射器也升级为增程中型激光和一具连发 SRM-4。所有武器弹药还统一移至右侧躯干，并使用 CASE 保护，以免在弹药爆炸时彻底损毁。

column1: The Cyclops is one of the Capellan Confederation's preferred 'Mechs to install Dual Cockpits. This standard refit installs the Dual Cockpit on a CP-11-A, removing one ton of gauss rifle ammunition.
column2: Cyclops 是卡佩兰联盟最偏爱安装双人驾驶舱的机甲之一。这项标准改装在一台 CP-11-A 上安装双人驾驶舱，并拆除一吨高斯步枪弹药。

column1: You'd think the Dracs would be a little less on the nose with slapping "dash S A M" onto a 'Mech modeled after a samurai, but what do I know? Cool swords, though. Shame they're fused to the hands.
column2: 你会以为德拉科尼斯人给一台以武士为原型的机甲冠上“-SAM”后缀时会稍微含蓄一点，但我知道什么呢？剑倒是挺酷的。可惜跟手长在一起了。

column1: Honorable Warrior
column2: 荣耀武士

column1: There is little knowledge of the source of this variant of the Cyclops. Similar in base design to CP-10 and CP-11 models mounting C3 units, the design also incorporates an XL engine on an Endo Steel frame, allowing both more armor and weapons to be mounted.
column2: 关于 Cyclops 这一变型的来源，所知甚少。它的基础设计与装备 C3 单元的 CP-10 和 CP-11 型号相似，但还在一具内钢框架上采用了 XL 引擎，从而得以安装更多装甲与武器。

column1: The Screamer LAM is a prototype Land-Air 'Mech which was produced during the reign of Emperor Stefan Amaris when his forces were occupying the Terran Hegemony in late Star League Era. The design shares the same tonnage as the Shadow Hawk LAM. The 'Mech was built as a harasser and quick strike machine. Unlike the original prototype LAM, the Screamer was able to transition into a fighter, 'Mech, or AirMech modes.
column2: Screamer LAM 是一款原型陆空机甲，生产于斯特凡·阿马里斯皇帝统治时期——当时他的部队正占领着泰拉霸权，时值星际联盟时代末期。该设计与 Shadow Hawk LAM 吨位相同。这台机甲被打造为袭扰与快速打击兵器。与最初的 LAM 原型不同，Screamer 能够在战斗机、机甲或空中机甲形态之间切换。

column1: Sharon Bryan, an up and comming officer in Steiner, has requested our aid.
column2: 施泰纳部队中一位崭露头角的军官莎伦·布莱恩已请求我们援助。

column1: Created by a pilot who lost the LRM rack off his Griffin, the -6CV replaces the long-range payload with a mid-range weapon system: a MRM-30. Backing up the MRM rack is an ER PPC with a PPC Capacitor for extra punch. To keep the heat under control, the -6CV mounts double heat sinks and is powered by a Light Fusion Engine for speed. It also has gained a little armor for extra survivability
column2: 这台 -6CV 出自一位弄丢了 Griffin 上 LRM 挂架的机师之手，它把远程载荷换成了中程武器系统：一具 MRM-30。为 MRM 挂架撑腰的是一门增程粒子加农炮，另配一具粒子加农炮电容器以增强威力。为了控制热量，-6CV 装有双散热器，并由一台轻型聚变引擎提供速度。它还获得了一点额外装甲，以提升生存能力。

column1: This version of the Cyclops was improved by using an Endo Steel frame. As a result the variant is able to mount a SRM 4 in the center torso, a LRM-5 along with Guardian ECM in the left torso, 2 AC/5's in the right torso, and 2 Medium Lasers in each arm. Rounding up the design is 14 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor.
column2: 这一版本的 Cyclops 采用内钢框架加以改进。因此该变型得以在中央躯干装一具 SRM 4、在左躯干装一具 LRM-5 与 Guardian ECM、在右躯干装 2 门 AC/5，并在两臂各装 2 门中型激光。最后以 14 吨铁纤维装甲收尾。

column1: The 12-K variant of the Cyclops takes the 'Mech to the logical conclusion based on equipment available to the DCMS. Built by Grumium and introduced in 3059, the 'Mech is armed with an Ultra Autocannon/10 for close to intermediate range combat. In place of the LRM launcher it carries an MRM-20 launcher, which compliments the Autocannon's range profile, while retaining two ER medium lasers and a Streak SRM-4 for for close ranges. The 'Mech is also armored with fourteen and a half tons of armor.
column2: Cyclops 的 12-K 变型根据 DCMS 可用装备，把这台机甲推向了合乎逻辑的终点。该机由 Grumium 制造并于 3059 年推出，装备一门 UAC/10 用于中近距离作战。它以一具 MRM-20 发射器取代了 LRM 发射器，与自动炮的射程特性相得益彰，同时保留两门增程中型激光和一具连发 SRM-4 用于近距离。该机甲还披挂十四吨半装甲。

column1: A 95-ton Mech, the Bullshark was recovered from the wreck of the Jump Ship Dobrev and schematics were later acquired by Majesty Metals which produced the Mech in limited quantities. The difficulty in sourcing parts and the hand built nature of each Bullshark would limit it to a mere 2 dozen examples, most of which served with the Magistracy Armed Forces. The unveiling of the Helm Core and subsequent Clan Invasion signaled the end of the Bullshark, with Majesty Metals reallocating resources to more profitable projects. The Bullshark M3 is a Juggernaut, built around a 190-rated Fusion Core and armed with paired AC/10s and AC/5s. Quad Medium Lasers and LRM-5s round out the design.
column2: 作为一台 95 吨机甲，Bullshark 是从跃迁舰 Dobrev 的残骸中打捞出来的，其图纸后来被 Majesty Metals 获得，并以有限数量生产。零件来源困难，加上每台 Bullshark 都是手工打造，使其总产量仅有区区二十余台，其中大部分在行政区武装部队服役。赫尔姆核心的问世以及随后的氏族入侵宣判了 Bullshark 的终结，Majesty Metals 把资源重新分配给了更有利可图的项目。Bullshark M3 是一台碾压型机甲，围绕一台 190 级聚变核心建造，装备成对的 AC/10 与 AC/5。四门中型激光与 LRM-5 为该设计收尾。

column1: The 7P is a Medium Range Missile Boat, carrying an MRM-20 and MRM-10 in each arm, supported by a Medium Laser in each arm and side torso. Such a heavy loadout while retaining the Dervish's usual seven and half tons of armor and five jump jets is made possible with an 275-rated extralight engine and Endo Steel frame. The 7P is fitted with ten double heat sinks and carries a combined four tons of MRM reloads.
column2: 7P 是一台中程导弹艇，两臂各携带一具 MRM-20 和 MRM-10，并由两臂及两侧躯干各一门中型激光支援。如此沉重的载荷之所以能在保留 Dervish 惯有的七吨半装甲和五具跳跃推进器的同时实现，靠的是一台 275 级超轻引擎和内钢框架。7P 装有十具双散热器，并携带总计四吨的 MRM 备用弹。

column1: Described as a "Warhammer on steroids", the Defiance is visually similar to the original WHM-6R and carries a similar weapons array. Where it differs from the classic design is in the use of digitigrade instead of humanoid legs, and modern construction components such as an endo steel skeleton, light fusion engine, and triple strength myomers. Due in part to the high heat levels required by its specialized myomers, as well as weight constraints, the Defiance carries only twelve double heat sinks, forcing it to rely upon volley fire to avoid shutdown, much like the design upon which it was based.
column2: Defiance 被形容为“打了兴奋剂的战锤”，外观与最初的 WHM-6R 相似，武器组合也大同小异。它与经典设计的不同之处在于使用了趾行式而非人形腿部，以及内钢骨架、轻型聚变引擎和三倍强度肌纤维等现代构造部件。部分由于专用肌纤维所需的高热量水平，部分由于重量限制，Defiance 只装了十二具双散热器，迫使它像它所效仿的设计那样依赖齐射来避免过热停机。

column1: Equipped with 4 Imperator Smoothie AC/2s, 2 Holly LRM-10 Launchers and 2 Large Lasers this 'Mech was nothing more than a laughingstock when it was first released. It served as the basis for the more successful Mauler
column2: 这台机甲装备 4 门 Imperator Smoothie AC/2、2 具 Holly LRM-10 发射器和 2 门大型激光，刚推出时不过是个笑柄。它后来成了更为成功的 Mauler 的基础。

column1: The Romeo 5000 is built upon a 120-rated Light Fusion Engine and Endo Steel frame, saving weight to carry a center torso mounted Medium Pulse Laser, an SRM-2 in each side torso and twin ER Small Lasers in each arm. Clad in three tons of armor, Romeo 5000 carries two tons of SRM reloads and is fitted with ten double heat sinks.
column2: Romeo 5000 建立在一台 120 级轻型聚变引擎和内钢框架之上，通过减重得以在中央躯干装一门中型脉冲激光、两侧躯干各一具 SRM-2，并在两臂各装两门增程小型激光。它身披三吨装甲，携带两吨 SRM 备用弹，并装有十具双散热器。

column1: The Commando 1C is a recent variant that attempts to make a long range direct fire support unit, by removing the missiles and replacing them with a single AC/2 in the right arm.
column2: Commando 1C 是近期推出的一款变型，试图通过拆除导弹、改在右臂装一门 AC/2，把它打造成一台远程直射火力支援单位。

column1: A favorite tool of planetary governments through out the Periphery, the Louse is designed for riot suppression. Capable of dispersing riots with lethal and non lethal options, it works well against civilians and lightly armed vehicles while posing no significant threat to actual battlemechs or military grade vehicles. Dual grenade launchers and a mixed laser package provide the bulk of the firepower, whilst a pair of flare launchers provides additional deterrent and can be used defensively in combat. Spall lined armor provides additional protection against infantry grade weapons and a set of sensors designed specifically for peering through cluttered urban environments round out the package. Often deployed as scouts and support forces; this mech is a common sight amongst the pirate bands who find themselves facing it across the battlefield. Not designed for battle, it is nonetheless pressed into service by desperate militias and governments that lack real battlemechs.
column2: Louse 是外围各地行星政府钟爱的工具，专为镇压暴乱而设计。它能以致命与非致命手段驱散暴乱，对付平民和轻武装车辆效果良好，同时对真正的战斗机甲或军用车辆不构成明显威胁。两具榴弹发射器和一整套混合激光构成其主要火力，另有一对照明弹发射器提供额外的威慑，并可在战斗中转用于防御。防崩落衬层装甲提供了对步兵级武器的额外防护，一整套专为穿透杂乱城市环境而设计的传感器则为该机甲画上句号。它常被用作侦察与支援力量；在那些发现自己要在战场上面对它的海盗团伙中，这台机甲相当常见。它并非为战斗而生，却仍被缺乏真正战斗机甲的绝望民兵与政府强行投入使用。

column1: The Conjurer  is a fast, inexpensive medium BattleMech that excels at medium to short range. As befitting its status as a second-line 'Mech, the Conjurer uses a standard engine, though it is constructed on an Endo Steel chassis and uses eight and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. Its jump jets enable it to leap up to 180 meters at a time. Armed with a Large Pulse Laser, the Conjurer can fall back on paired ER Medium Lasers and Streak SRM-2s for closer range combat. Ten double heat sinks are able to keep heat under control.
column2: Conjurer 是一台快速、廉价的中型战斗机甲，在中近距离表现出色。与其作为二线机甲的身份相称，Conjurer 使用标准引擎，但机体采用内钢构造，并使用八吨半铁纤维装甲。它的跳跃推进器能让它一次跃出最远 180 米。Conjurer 以一门大型脉冲激光为主力，混战时还能退而使用成对的增程中型激光和连发 SRM-2。十具双散热器足以把热量控制住。

column1: A unique Commando piloted by Captain Bono Duganmare of the 22nd Skye Rangers, the "Death's Knell"; is refitted with recovered LosTech. Swapping the standard SRM racks for an additional 3 Medium lasers, allows the TDK’s engine to be refitted with a 175 core. The inclusion of DHS keeps the mech comfortably cool. An extra half ton of armor round out the design.
column2: 一台由第 22 斯凯游骑兵的博诺·杜根梅尔上尉驾驶的独一无二的 Commando，“丧钟”以回收的失落科技改装。把标准 SRM 挂架换成额外的 3 门中型激光后，“丧钟”的引擎得以改装为 175 级核心。双散热器的加入让这台机甲保持舒适的温度。额外半吨装甲为该设计收尾。

column1: The Dervish IIC-0, a 55-ton Clan refit of the Star-League-era Dervish, was first seen in 3058 along the Smoke Jaguar front bordering the Draconis Combine. It has similar movement and jump capabilities to the original Dervish, but carries significantly more firepower.
column2: Dervish IIC-0 是星际联盟时代 Dervish 的 55 吨氏族改装型，于 3058 年首次出现在与德拉科尼斯联合体接壤的 Smoke Jaguar 战线上。它的移动与跳跃能力与原版 Dervish 相近，但火力强得多。

column1: Designed for the SLDF in the wake of the Reunification War, the Falcon is a Scout Mech hunter and an anti-infantry Mech. A 30 ton Light Mech, the Falcon is powered by a 180-rated Fusion Core. The Falcon FLC-4Nb-PP2 is armed with a Medium Pulse Laser, a Medium Laser and an ER Large Laser.
column2: Falcon 是统一战争之后为 SLDF 设计的，是一台猎杀侦察机甲的机甲，也是一台反步兵机甲。这台 30 吨轻型机甲由一台 180 级聚变核心驱动。Falcon FLC-4Nb-PP2 装备一门中型脉冲激光、一门中型激光和一门增程大型激光。

column1: Designed for the SLDF in the wake of the Reunification War, the Falcon is a Scout Mech hunter and an anti-infantry Mech. A 30 ton Light Mech, the Falcon is powered by a 180-rated Fusion Core. The Falcon FLC-4Nb-PP is armed with a Medium Laser and a PPC.
column2: Falcon 是统一战争之后为 SLDF 设计的，是一台猎杀侦察机甲的机甲，也是一台反步兵机甲。这台 30 吨轻型机甲由一台 180 级聚变核心驱动。Falcon FLC-4Nb-PP 装备一门中型激光和一门粒子加农炮。

column1: Designed for the SLDF in the wake of the Reunification War, the Falcon is a Scout Mech hunter and an anti-infantry Mech. A 30 ton Light Mech, the Falcon is powered by a 180-rated Fusion Core. The Falcon FLC-4N is armed with a Medium Laser, 2 Small Lasers and a pair of Machine Guns.
column2: Falcon 是统一战争之后为 SLDF 设计的，是一台猎杀侦察机甲的机甲，也是一台反步兵机甲。这台 30 吨轻型机甲由一台 180 级聚变核心驱动。Falcon FLC-4N 装备一门中型激光、2 门小型激光和两挺机枪。

column1: The 5S variant of the Archer, built out of Defiance Industries' massive Hesperus II complex in 3050, was the official variant for the Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth. The 5S upgraded the engine to an Edasich Motors 280 XL Engine, cutting the engine's weight in half while retaining the same speed profile. The 5S also reduced the LRM-20 launchers to LRM-15s. This saved weight was used to add two Coventry T4H Streak SRM-2 launchers, one in each arm and fed by two tons of reloads in the side torsos. They also upgraded the four medium lasers to Medium Pulse Lasers. Finally, the 'Mech carried a Doering Electronics Glowworm Narc Missile Beacon launcher in its left torso along with one ton of ammo. This allowed the Archer to tag enemy units with a beacon so that friendly 'Mechs could more easily hit the unit with their own missile weapons. All of the ammunition carried by the 5S was protected by CASE.
column2: Archer 的 5S 变型于 3050 年在 Defiance 工业公司庞大的赫斯珀鲁斯 II 综合设施中制造，是联邦联合体武装部队的官方变型。5S 把引擎升级为 Edasich Motors 280 XL 引擎，在保持同样速度特性的同时把引擎重量减半。5S 还把 LRM-20 发射器缩减为 LRM-15。由此省下的重量用于加装两具 Coventry T4H 连发 SRM-2 发射器，两臂各一具，由两侧躯干中两吨备用弹供弹。他们还把四门中型激光升级为中型脉冲激光。最后，机甲在左躯干装了一具 Doering Electronics Glowworm NARC 导弹信标发射器，并配一吨弹药。这让 Archer 能给敌方单位挂上信标，使友方机甲更容易用导弹武器命中该单位。5S 携带的所有弹药都由 CASE 保护。

column1: Designed for the SLDF in the wake of the Reunification War, the Falcon is a Scout Mech hunter and an anti-infantry Mech. A 30 ton Light Mech, the Falcon is powered by a 180-rated Fusion Core. The Falcon FLC-4P is armed with a Medium Pulse Laser, 2 Small Lasers and an AMS.
column2: Falcon 是统一战争之后为 SLDF 设计的，是一台猎杀侦察机甲的机甲，也是一台反步兵机甲。这台 30 吨轻型机甲由一台 180 级聚变核心驱动。Falcon FLC-4P 装备一门中型脉冲激光、2 门小型激光和一具 AMS。

column1: Designed for the SLDF in the wake of the Reunification War, the Falcon is a Scout Mech hunter and an anti-infantry Mech. A 30 ton Light Mech, the Falcon is powered by a 180-rated Fusion Core. The Falcon FLC-4Nb is armed with a pair of Medium Lasers and a Snub Nose PPC. Endo Steel and Double Heat Sinks free up the weight needed for the experimental PPC.
column2: Falcon 是统一战争之后为 SLDF 设计的，是一台猎杀侦察机甲的机甲，也是一台反步兵机甲。这台 30 吨轻型机甲由一台 180 级聚变核心驱动。Falcon FLC-4Nb 装备两门中型激光和一门短管粒子加农炮。内钢与双散热器腾出了安装这门试验性粒子加农炮所需的重量。

column1: The S configuration is intended for the close confines of urban and jungle warfare. The S configurations primary weapon is a massive LB-X Autocannon/20 which is capable of disabling most light and medium 'Mechs in a single blast. This is backed up by a single Large Pulse Laser to provide some long range firepower should the Dire Wolf S be caught in the open. Additional short range firepower is provided by five Medium Pulse Lasers and two Streak SRM-4 launchers. Two Anti-Personnel Pods and two Machine Guns provide exceptional anti-infantry capabilities. The S configuration has added mobility with three jump jets allowing it to jump up to ninety meters.
column2: S 配置意在应对城市与丛林战的近距离环境。S 配置的主力武器是一门巨大的 LB-X AC/20，足以一击瘫痪大多数轻型与中型机甲。它由一门大型脉冲激光作为后盾，以便 Dire Wolf S 在开阔地带被发现时提供一些远程火力。额外的近距离火力由五门中型脉冲激光和两具连发 SRM-4 发射器提供。两具反人员荚舱和两挺机枪带来出色的反步兵能力。S 配置还通过三具跳跃推进器提升了机动性，使它最远可跳出九十米。

column1: Piloted by Baron Oliver Kincaid who once served with the prestigious Free World Guards before being dishonorably discharged. After that he spent some time as a mercenary serving with Nik's Cavaliers which is when he gave his Archer the name 'Agincourt'. When he was asked to explain why he chose that name he replied that it was named to remind him of how powerful the turns of fate can be, and to work hard to earn back what he once had.
column2: 这台 Archer 由男爵奥利弗·金凯德驾驶，他曾服役于声望卓著的自由世界卫队，后被不名誉地除役。此后他当了一段时间雇佣兵，在 Nik's Cavaliers 服役，也正是在那期间他给自己的 Archer 起名“阿金库尔”。当被问及为何选这个名字时，他回答说，起这个名字是为了提醒自己命运的转折能有多么强大，也为了努力夺回自己曾经拥有的一切。

column1: This variant of the Archer carried Clan-spec equipment. The arms mounted ER Large Lasers, while a pair of Small Pulse Lasers covered the rear. The LRM-20s were enhanced with Artemis IV Fire Control Systems, and an ECM Suite and AMS protected against incoming fire. Fifteen double heat sinks kept the 'Mech cool.
column2: 这一版本的 Archer 携带氏族规格的装备。两臂装的是增程大型激光，一对小型脉冲激光则掩护后方。LRM-20 由阿尔忒弥斯 IV 火控系统增强，另有一套 ECM 套件与一具 AMS 防御来袭火力。十五具双散热器让机甲保持低温。

column1: Developed by Capellan engineers just before the Clan Invasion, this Emperor is a retrofit of the standard 5A. Armed with the newly introduced Arrow IV launcher and a pair of large lasers, the 5B is built to provide fire support at long range.
column2: 这台 Emperor 由卡佩兰工程师在氏族入侵前夕开发，是对标准型 5A 的改装。5B 装备新近推出的箭式 IV 发射器和两门大型激光，专为提供远程火力支援而建造。

column1: This version of the Emperor was a model introduced in the Age of War. It carried an AC/5 in each arm instead of the LB10-Xs that were used in later versions. It also carried sixteen single heat sinks.Restricted Actuators-Right: Lower
column2: 这一版本的 Emperor 是战争年代推出的型号。它两臂各装一门 AC/5，而非后期版本使用的 LB10-X。它还装有十六具单散热器。驱动器受限-右：下部

column1: The 5W was an upgrade of the 2W variant, and was produced for the Wolf's Dragoons by Bowie Industries at Alarion. This was done in an orbital 'Mech repair facility which was converted into a 'Mech assembly line. Introduced in 3050, the 'Mech was upgraded with an XL Engine to save weight and used ten double heat sinks for greater heat dissipation. It retained the two LRM-20 launchers but replaced all other weaponry with one TharHes Blue SRM-4 launchers in each arm and a Doering Electronics Glowworm Narc Missile Beacon launcher in the center torso. The 5W was supplied with four tons of LRM reloads, two tons of SRM reloads, and two tons of Narc reloads, all carried in the CASE-protected side torsos.
column2: 5W 是 2W 变型的升级版，由 Bowie 工业公司在阿拉里昂为 Wolf's Dragoons 生产。生产是在一座轨道机甲维修设施中完成的，该设施被改造成了机甲装配线。该机于 3050 年推出，用一台 XL 引擎来减重，并使用十具双散热器以提升散热能力。它保留了两具 LRM-20 发射器，但把其他所有武器都换成了两臂各一具 TharHes Blue SRM-4 发射器，以及中央躯干一具 Doering Electronics Glowworm NARC 导弹信标发射器。5W 配发四吨 LRM 备用弹、两吨 SRM 备用弹和两吨 NARC 备用弹，全部存放在由 CASE 保护的侧躯干中。

column1: A custom variant of the Cyclops CP-10-Q, fielded by Wolf's Dragoons and their affiliated Mercnary outfits. Replacing almost all of the equipment with Clan tech, the 'Mech primarily save use as a defensive AMS platform as the Wolf's Dragoons did not consider the 'Mech of much battleworth.
column2: 这是 Cyclops CP-10-Q 的定制变型，由 Wolf's Dragoons 及其附属雇佣兵部队使用。它几乎把所有装备都换成了氏族技术，主要用途是作为防御性的 AMS 平台，因为 Wolf's Dragoons 并不认为这台机甲有多大战斗力。

column1: The Hunchback 5A replaces much of the close in firepower of traditional variants for an Arrow IV launcher enabling it to provide dedicated fire support for a lance.
column2: Hunchback 5A 用一具箭式 IV 发射器取代了传统变型的大部分近距火力，使其能为一个小队提供专门的火力支援。

column1: A simple upgrade utilized by the SLDF Royals concurrently with the original Crab, the 27sl changes the weapons payload to pulse variants.
column2: 这是 SLDF 皇家部队与原始 Crab 同时使用的一种简单升级型，27sl 把武器载荷改为脉冲型号。

column1: A Nova Cat design, the 50 ton Huntsman was designed for Operation Revival and the invasion of the Inner Sphere; first entering production in 3049. An OmniMech, the Huntsman is built around a 250-rated XL Engine with an Endo Steel Skeleton and Ferro-Fibrous armor giving the OmniMech, 21.5 tons of pod space. 5 Jump Jets are fixed to the chassis, giving the Huntsman additional flexibility. The Huntsman C is armed with a UAC/5, an LRM-15 and an LRM-20. A ER Medium Laser, ER Small Laser, Flamer and Streak SRM-4 provide additional firepower at close range.
column2: 作为 Nova Cat 的设计，50 吨的 Huntsman 是为“复兴行动”与入侵内天体而打造的，于 3049 年首次投产。作为一台全能机甲，Huntsman 围绕一台 250 级 XL 引擎建造，配以内钢骨架和铁纤维装甲，拥有 21.5 吨挂载空间。5 具跳跃推进器固定在机体上，赋予 Huntsman 额外的灵活性。Huntsman C 装备一门 UAC/5、一具 LRM-15 和一具 LRM-20。一门增程中型激光、一门增程小型激光、一具火焰喷射器和一具连发 SRM-4 在近距离提供额外火力。

column1: Combining elements of the 4H and 4J 'Swaybacks', the HBK-4N uses an AC/5 and two LRM-5s to give it range, while the four Medium Lasers give it punch up close.
column2: HBK-4N 结合了 4H 与 4J 两型“驼背”的元素，用一门 AC/5 和两具 LRM-5 赋予它射程，而四门中型激光则让它在近身时极具冲击力。

column1: Crab 30s are a complete overhaul of the old Crab design, upgrading its electronics, engine and weapons to the latest standards.
column2: Crab 30s 是对老式 Crab 设计的彻底翻修，把它的电子设备、引擎和武器都升级到了最新标准。

column1: A simple upgrade utilized by the SLDF Royals concurrently with the original Crab, the 27b replaces the heat sinks with double-strength models and the Lasers with Extended Range variants.
column2: SLDF 皇家部队在原版 Crab 服役期间同步采用的一种简单升级型，27b 将散热器更换为双倍强度型号，并将激光器更换为增程型。

column1: The Furillo manufactured 3S introduced in 3057 removes the XL Engine of the 1N and 2N variants and replaces it with a Light Fusion Engine. This exclusively Lyran variant of the Axman is armed with a massive LB-X Autocannon/20, which allows it to fire either solid rounds or cluster rounds that act like a 'Mech sized shotgun. The 'Mech also carries three ER Medium Lasers for close combat and a Guardian ECM Suite, which defends against enemy electronic warfare equipment.
column2: 3057 年推出、由 Furillo 制造的 3S 型移除了 1N 与 2N 型的 XL 引擎，代之以轻型聚变引擎。这款 Axman 的莱伦专属改型装备一门巨大的 LB-X 自动炮/20，可发射实心弹或集束弹，如同一把机甲大小的霰弹枪。该机甲还携带三门 ER 中型激光用于混战，以及一套 Guardian ECM 套件，用以抵御敌方电子战装备。

column1: The Infiltrator is part of the so-called "first generation" of battle armor created by the Federated Commonwealth. Thanks to salvage captured from the Clans, the New Avalon Institute of Science was able to reverse engineer the technology for battlesuits, and decided to create a lighter type than the Inner Sphere Standard which was geared towards reconnaissance and stealth. The result was a unit armored with an early form of stealth armor and sophisticated sensing equipment, meant to operate deep behind enemy lines and gather intelligence.
column2: 渗透者是联邦合众国所创所谓“第一代”战斗装甲的一员。凭借从氏族手中缴获的战利品，新阿瓦隆科学研究所得以逆向工程出战斗服技术，并决定制造一种比内天体标准型更轻、面向侦察与隐身的型号。其成果是一种装备早期隐形装甲与精密传感设备的单位，用于深入敌后搜集情报。

column1: First produced in 2948, the Ice Ferret is a medium scout OmniMech often employed as a head hunter or strike unit. A 45 ton Clan OmniMech, the Ice Ferret is powered by a 360-rated XL Engine and has 9.5 tons of pod space thanks to a combination of Endo Steel, an XL Engine and Ferro-Fibrous. The Ice Ferret IFR-C is armed with an ER Small Laser and a trio of Artemis IV enhanced LRM-5’s.
column2: 冰鼬最初于 2948 年投产，是一种中型侦察型 OmniMech，常被用作猎头者或打击单位。这台 45 吨的氏族 OmniMech 由 360 级 XL 引擎驱动，凭借内钢骨架、XL 引擎与铁纤维装甲的组合，拥有 9.5 吨吊舱空间。Ice Ferret IFR-C 装备一门 ER 小型激光与三具 Artemis IV 增强型 LRM-5。

column1: A lumbering mountain of armor and weaponry, Solaris Arms' massive assault 'Mech definitely lives up to the name of Juggernaut in the Solaris Games. Sixteen and half tons of Valiant Chainmail armor protect a GM 270 Fusion Engine, propelling the 'Mech at fairly standard assault 'Mech speed of 54 km/h.
column2: Solaris Arms 出品的这台巨型突击机甲是笨重如山的装甲与武器集合体，在 Solaris 竞技场上绝对配得上 Juggernaut 之名。十六吨半的 Valiant Chainmail 装甲保护着 GM 270 聚变引擎，推动机甲以相当标准的突击机甲速度 54 公里/小时行进。

column2: Jenner R 为应对替换零件短缺而进行了降级改装，携带 2 具 SRM-6、2 具火箭发射器与 2 门中型激光。

column1: Wow, boss. This is an old design. She may be old but she is solid and that AC/10 has some serious punch.
column2: 哇，老板。这可是个老旧的设计。她虽老，却结实可靠，那门 AC/10 打起来可是相当有分量的。

column1: A next generation design, partly based on data from the Battle of Tukkayid; the Hussar 450-D entered production in 3059. An LB-5X provides the bulk of the Mechs ranged firepower, with a pair of ER Medium Lasers offering additional firepower at closer ranges.
column2: 这是一款次世代设计，部分基于图卡伊德战役的数据；Hussar 450-D 于 3059 年投产。一门 LB-5X 提供该机甲的大部分远程火力，两门 ER 中型激光则在较近距离提供额外火力。

column1: An early clan Mech dating from the days of Operation Klondike, the Crab CRB-27-EC was an upgrade of the CRB-27 that replaced the weapons with Early Clan variants. It would be discontinued and forgotten as modern clan spec weapons entered production.
column2: 作为可追溯至克朗代克行动时期的早期氏族机甲，Crab CRB-27-EC 是 CRB-27 的升级型，将武器替换为早期氏族型号。随着现代氏族规格武器投入生产，它最终停产并被遗忘。

column1: Designed in 2719 during the last days of the Star League, the Crab was built as a medium-weight raider and guerrilla fighter for the Star League Defense Force. Although lacking hand actuators or jump jets, it possessed good overland speed and its all-energy weapons payload was suitable for long-range missions without the prospect for resupply.
column2: Crab 设计于 2719 年，即星际联盟的最后岁月，是为星际联盟防卫军打造的中量级袭掠者与游击战机体。它虽然没有手部致动器与跳跃推进器，却拥有良好的陆行速度，而全能量武器的配置使其适合在没有补给希望的情况下执行远程任务。

The Ice Ferret IFR-B is armed with an ER Large Laser, Small Pulse Laser, SRM-4 and an SRM-6.
column2: 冰鼬最初于 2948 年投产，是一种中型侦察型 OmniMech，常被用作猎头者或打击单位。这台 45 吨的氏族 OmniMech 由 360 级 XL 引擎驱动，凭借内钢骨架、XL 引擎与铁纤维装甲的组合，拥有 9.5 吨吊舱空间。Ice Ferret IFR-B 装备一门 ER 大型激光、小型脉冲激光、SRM-4 与一具 SRM-6。

column1: A 65-ton design that emphasizes overwhelming firepower over speed or armor, the Hellbringer is a Clan OmniMech. Powered by a 325-rated XL engine, the Hellbringer has 28.5 tons of pod space. The Hellbringer H is armed with an ER PPC, a heavy large laser, an LRM-15 and a UAC/5. 4 heavy small lasers, a pair of machine guns and a pair of A-Pods cover close range combat. An active probe improves the Hellbringer's scouting abilities.
column2: Hellbringer 是一款强调压倒性火力而非速度或装甲的 65 吨设计，属于氏族 OmniMech。它由 325 级 XL 引擎驱动，拥有 28.5 吨吊舱空间。Hellbringer H 装备一门 ER PPC、一门重型大型激光、一具 LRM-15 与一门 UAC/5。4 门重型小型激光、两挺机枪与两具 A-Pod 负责近距离作战。一部主动探测器提升 Hellbringer 的侦察能力。

column1: The Hellbringer GP is a laser heavy version of the 'Mech. Designed for sustained combat, this 'Mech can always go the distance.
column2: Hellbringer GP 是该机甲的激光重装型。它为持久作战而设计，总能坚持到底。

column1: A 65-ton design that emphasizes overwhelming firepower over speed or armor, the Hellbringer is a Clan OmniMech. Powered by a 325-rated XL engine, the Hellbringer has 28.5 tons of pod space.
