column1: Repurposed by a Goliath Scorpion Seeker who recovered it from a lost Brian Cache, this CRB-27b has undergone an extensive restoration effort. Sporting Clan tech weapons, augmented by a targeting computer and an active probe; this Crab aids the Seeker in their search for Star League relics. Surprisingly, the design mounts jump jets – enough to leap 150 metres at a time- an unusual addition to the Crab. Intended to aid in exploration work, they have surprised many opponents in combat or a circle of equals, helping to contribute to the Seeker's many victories.
column2: 这台 CRB-27b 被一名从失落的布赖恩缓存中将其寻回的戈尔贡蝎氏族探寻者重新改装，并经历了一场大规模的修复工程。它装备氏族科技武器，并辅以瞄准计算机与主动探测器；这台 Crab 协助这位探寻者搜寻星际联盟遗物。令人意外的是，该设计装备了跳跃推进器——足以一次跃过 150 米——这对 Crab 而言是非同寻常的添加。它们本是为协助勘探工作而设，却在战斗或平等之圈中令许多对手措手不及，帮助这位探寻者屡获胜利。

column1: The most notable of all Cyclops variants, introduced in 2750, fits the 'Mech with a Collapsible Command Module strapped to its rear torso, allowing a fully operational headquarters bunker to be set up in fifteen minutes. In order to make room for the module the Autocannon/20 and its ammunition was removed from this variant. Irreparable damages suffered during the Succession Wars means less than half of those Cyclopses with a working B-2000 have an operable command module.
column2: 所有 Cyclops 改型中最著名的一种于 2750 年推出，它在机甲后躯上绑装一个可折叠指挥模块，使一个可全面运作的指挥部掩体能在十五分钟内搭建完成。为腾出模块空间，该改型移除了自动炮/20 及其弹药。继承战争期间遭受的不可修复损伤，意味着装有可用 B-2000 的 Cyclops 中，不到一半仍拥有可运作的指挥模块。

column1: A refit of the original CP-10-HQ that replaces two heat sinks with two extra tons of ammunition. This refit is very uncommon, only seeing use at a few select battle fields where it was a last ditch effort to have even the command 'Mechs engage in prolonged battles, thus needing the extra ammunition.
column2: 这是对原始 CP-10-HQ 的改装，用两吨额外弹药替换两个散热器。该改装非常罕见，仅在少数特定战场上使用，那是一种最后的尝试——让连指挥机甲也投入持久战，因而需要额外弹药。

The Hellbringer C is armed with an ER large laser and an ATM-6. An LB-20X, ER small laser and a pair of ER medium lasers cover close range combat.
column2: Hellbringer 是一款强调压倒性火力而非速度或装甲的 65 吨设计，属于氏族 OmniMech。它由 325 级 XL 引擎驱动，拥有 28.5 吨吊舱空间。Hellbringer C 装备一门 ER 大型激光与一具 ATM-6。一门 LB-20X、ER 小型激光与两门 ER 中型激光负责近距离作战。

The Hellbringer B is armed with a Gauss rifle and an LB-5X. An ER small laser and a pair of Artemis IV enhanced SRM-6s cover close range combat.
column2: Hellbringer 是一款强调压倒性火力而非速度或装甲的 65 吨设计，属于氏族 OmniMech。它由 325 级 XL 引擎驱动，拥有 28.5 吨吊舱空间。Hellbringer B 装备一门高斯步枪与一门 LB-5X。一门 ER 小型激光与两具 Artemis IV 增强型 SRM-6 负责近距离作战。

column1: A 65-ton design that emphasizes overwhelming firepower over speed or armor, the Hellbringer is a Clan OmniMech. Powered by a 325-rated XL engine, the Hellbringer has 28.5 tons of pod space. The Hellbringer A is armed with a pair of ER large lasers, a UAC/5 and an LRM-20. An ER medium laser and a pair of machine guns cover close range combat. An active probe improves the Hellbringer's scouting ability, while a NARC beacon allows the 'Mech to tag enemies with NARC beacons.
column2: Hellbringer 是一款强调压倒性火力而非速度或装甲的 65 吨设计，属于氏族 OmniMech。它由 325 级 XL 引擎驱动，拥有 28.5 吨吊舱空间。Hellbringer A 装备两门 ER 大型激光、一门 UAC/5 与一具 LRM-20。一门 ER 中型激光与两挺机枪负责近距离作战。主动探测器提升 Hellbringer 的侦察能力，而 NARC 信标则让该机甲能用 NARC 信标标记敌人。

column1: Based on the Crab that Judith Faber piloted during the Battle of Tukkayyid, this model named Florentine, this variant is a virtual mini-King Crab mounting an Ultra AC/5 in each arm supported by a left-torso mounted LRM-5 and a right-torso mounted Medium Laser. Carrying one ton of LRM missiles and three of Ultra Autocannon rounds, the Florentine's weapon loadout is made possible through use of a 250 XL Engine and an Endo Steel frame.
column2: 该改型以朱迪丝·费伯在图卡伊德战役中所驾驶的 Crab 为基础，此型号被命名为 Florentine，实质上是一台迷你王蟹：每条手臂各装一门 Ultra AC/5，左躯干搭载 LRM-5，右躯干搭载中型激光。它携带一吨 LRM 导弹与三吨 Ultra 自动炮弹药，而 Florentine 的武器配置得益于 250 XL 引擎与内钢骨架才得以实现。

column1: Designed by the Explorer Corps to provide heavy fire support in environments unsuited to a normal tank or support unit, the 4E is a field refit that mounts a Thumper Artillery piece in place of the standard AC/20. Removing a mostly superfluous heat sink frees up the weight for the 4E to retain its secondary weaponry should it be engaged by head hunter units. By 3010, the Explorer Corps had entered into a long term contract with Kali Yama Weapons to produce limited numbers of this design under license. The design spread to other interested parties, after the Corps relaxed their licensing arrangements following the Scarlet Fist debacle; in which a lone Corps pilot – Larissa ‘‘Raza’’ Brooks – managed to successfully evade the pirate band responsible for the destruction of her lance, before stalking them back to their base and leveling it with repeated Thumper volleys in the middle of the night.
column2: 4E 由探险军团设计，用于在不适合普通坦克或支援单位的环境中提供重型火力支援；这是一种战地改装型，以一门 Thumper 火炮取代标准 AC/20。移除一个几乎多余的散热器所腾出的重量，使 4E 在遭遇猎头单位时仍能保留其副武器。到 3010 年，探险军团已与 Kali Yama Weapons 签订长期合约，以授权方式限量生产该设计。在“赤拳”惨败之后，军团放宽了授权安排，该设计随之流传到其他有兴趣的势力；那场惨败中，军团唯一一名机师——拉里萨·“拉萨”·布鲁克斯——成功摆脱了摧毁其小队的海盗团伙，随后一路尾随其返回基地，并在半夜以连续不断的 Thumper 齐射将其夷为平地。

column1: The CRB-C Crab is a minor update of the design modified to include a C3 Slave Unit. Introduced by the Draconis Combine in 3056 this Crab makes space for the C3 unit by removing the medium laser.
column2: CRB-C Crab 是该设计的一次小幅更新，改装后加入了 C3 从属单元。它由德拉科尼斯联合体于 3056 年推出，通过移除中型激光为 C3 单元腾出空间。

column1: Ultralight
column2: 超轻量

column1: A field grade refit turned official variant often fielded by House Kurita, the Hunchback HBK-4K features a massive MRM-40 as its primary weapon. Armour protection is improved with the addition of Ferro-Fibrous and CASE is installed to protect the ammunition bay. The remaining free tonnage is devoted to upgrading the Head Laser to a Medium model and adding additional Heat Sinks.
column2: 这是一种由野战级改装转正的官方改型，常由栗田家族投入使用；Hunchback HBK-4K 以一门巨大的 MRM-40 作为主武器。装甲防护通过加装铁纤维装甲得到提升，并安装了 CASE 以保护弹药舱。剩余的自由吨位用于将头部激光升级为中型型号并增加额外散热器。

column1: Modified to aid with indirect fire support as well as being able to act as a guardian for fire support lances, the HBK-4J succeeds at both roles.  With its twin LRM-10s it can contribute to the barrage, whilst its five Medium Lasers allow it to fend off the Light 'Mechs that tend to harass fire support teams.
column2: 为协助间接火力支援并同时充当火力支援小队的护卫而改装，HBK-4J 在两种角色上都表现出色。凭借双联 LRM-10，它能参与弹幕压制；而五门中型激光则让它能击退那些惯于骚扰火力支援小组的轻型机甲。

column1: Don't think of the AC/10 as a downgrade from the AC/20, Commander. This 'mech is a fierce brawler with an improved effective range.
column2: 别把 AC/10 当成 AC/20 的降级，指挥官。这台机甲是台凶猛的近身斗士，有效射程还更远。

column1: The Highlander IIC A is an ER PPC boat. Swapping the Gauss Rifle for ER PPC, the left-torso pulse lasers are also replaced by twin ER PPCs. These swaps are made possible by the removal of one of the left arm Streak 6 launchers and the Artemis unit from the right torso LRM-20, carrying three tons of missiles for each launcher. The Highlander IIC A downgrades the Ferro-Fibrous armor to standard plating to free up space for a Endo Steel frame instead and carries a total of twenty Double Heat Sinks.
column2: Highlander IIC A 是一台 ER PPC 平台。它用 ER PPC 换下高斯步枪，左躯干的脉冲激光也被双联 ER PPC 取代。这些替换之所以可行，是因为拆除了左臂一具 Streak 6 发射器，以及右躯干 LRM-20 上的 Artemis 单元，而每具发射器携带三吨导弹。Highlander IIC A 将铁纤维装甲降级为标准装甲，以便腾出空间改用内钢骨架，并共搭载二十个双散热器。

column1: The Highlander is a well known SLDF Era Battlemech. Originally designed as a base or installation defender, the HGN-732 is probably the most famous Highlander model. At long ranges, a Gauss Rifle and LRM-20 can effectively deter many more lightly armored opponents. If a mech does decide to close the distance, two Medium Lasers and a SRM-6 are waiting to meet them.
column2: Highlander 是星际联盟时代广为人知的战斗机甲。它最初被设计为基地或设施的防御者，而 HGN-732 大概是最著名的 Highlander 型号。在远距离上，一门高斯步枪与一具 LRM-20 能有效震慑许多装甲较薄的对手。若有机甲决定拉近距离，两门中型激光与一具 SRM-6 正等着迎接它们。

column1: Special Forces Mech
column2: 特种部队机甲

column1: A field upgrade of the 4C, the 4Cb replaces the brawler loadout with a Gauss rifle, SRM-6, and Ferro-Fibrous armor.
column2: 作为 4C 的野战升级型，4Cb 以高斯步枪、SRM-6 与铁纤维装甲取代了近身搏斗型的武器配置。

column1: The Highlander IIC C trades the standard variant's Gauss Rifle for a pair of Ultra Autocannon/10s, retaining the trio of Medium Pulse Lasers while removing the LRM-20's Artemis module and one of the left-arm Streak SRM-6 launchers Such a heavy loadout is made possible thanks to the use of 280-rated XL Engine. The C is clad in the maximum amount of Ferro-Fibrous armor and fitted with fourteen double heat sinks.
column2: Highlander IIC C 将标准型的高斯步枪换成两门 Ultra 自动炮/10，保留三门中型脉冲激光，同时移除 LRM-20 的 Artemis 模块与左臂一具 Streak SRM-6 发射器。如此沉重的武器配置得益于 280 级 XL 引擎的使用。C 型披挂最大量的铁纤维装甲，并装有十四个双散热器。

column1: Like the original Highlander IIC, the B retains the Gauss Rifle and twin Streak SRM-6 racks, but replaces the single LRM-20 with twin LRM-15 racks in the right torso, removing one of the Medium Pulse Lasers to help free up the weight needed. Trading Ferro-Fibrous armor to standard to free up space for a Endo Steel frame like the A, the Highlander IIC B is fitted with fourteen double heat sinks.
column2: 与原版 Highlander IIC 一样，B 型保留高斯步枪与双联 Streak SRM-6，但将单具 LRM-20 换成右躯干的双联 LRM-15，并移除其中一门中型脉冲激光以腾出所需重量。与 A 型相同，它将铁纤维装甲换为标准装甲，以便腾出空间使用内钢骨架；Highlander IIC B 装有十四个双散热器。

column1: Tell the truth, teamed up with ComStar
column2: 说实话，与 ComStar 联手

column1: Made to order by Vining Engineering and Salvage Team, the 'Avenger' is anything but shoddy. Built around a Mydron Rotary AC5 with specialized Shock Absorbers and 3 tons of caseless ammo storage, it howls Victory and Vengeance through the Arena. \n\n Has 120 Shots.
column2: “复仇者”由 Vining 工程与打捞团队定制，绝非粗制滥造之作。它以一门 Mydron 旋转 AC5 为核心，配以专用减震器与 3 吨无壳弹药储存，在竞技场中咆哮着胜利与复仇。\n\n 拥有 120 发弹药。

column1: Melee attacks deal 10 Heat damage.
column2: 近战攻击造成 10 点热量伤害。

column1: Recovered from an SLDF research Facility. Seemingly similar to an AC10 in Caliber and Damage, this weapon was designed along the lines of advanced Infantry Assault Weapons with a Select Fire Switch.\n\n Firing Modes: Single Shot, Burst Fire, Full Auto.
column2: 从一处 SLDF 研究设施中回收。其口径与伤害看似与 AC10 相近，但这件武器是按照配备选射开关的先进步兵突击武器的思路设计的。\n\n 射击模式：单发、点射、全自动。

column1: Amazing, at first this looks like junk, but if you look closer, it's an old SLDF Wasp Laser Rifle Prototype; I've got no idea where they dug this thing up or even made it work at all! \n\n 20 rounds.
column2: 了不起，乍看之下这像堆垃圾，但仔细一瞧，它是老式 SLDF Wasp 激光步枪原型；我完全不知道他们是从哪儿把这东西挖出来的，更别说还让它能用了！\n\n 20 发。

column1: Leave it to some Periphery Junkhead to take a perfectly fine LBX and Redneck it into a 'Sawed Off Shotgun' and scribble stuff all over, where do they get this stuff... 'Klaatu barada nihikturhun'..... \n\n Internal Ammo 10 Shots
column2: 也只有外缘区的废土脑瓜才会把一把好端端的 LBX 改成“锯短霰弹枪”，还在上面乱涂乱画，他们到底从哪儿弄来这些玩意儿……“Klaatu barada nihikturhun”……\n\n 内置弹药 10 发

column1: MeleeWeapon Extra Hits
column2: 近战武器额外命中

column1: A Clan grade Chemical Laser Rifle! Similar to the old SLDF designs but they linked 2 Chemical Medium laser together. 20 rounds. Alternative firing mode allows a stronger shot with double ammo consumption
column2: 一把氏族级化学激光步枪！与旧式 SLDF 设计类似，但他们把 2 具化学中型激光串联在一起。 20 发。 备用射击模式可发射更强的一击，但弹药消耗翻倍

column1: This clan-made masterpiece of a Laser Rifle debuted on Solaris VII. Combining Clan advances to laser technology with an SLDF Laser Rifle, this weapon is able to outmatch many opponents in the arena as well as the battlefield. 12 rounds. Alternative firing modes allows either a stronger shot or extreme range, with increased ammo consumption.
column2: 这件氏族制造的激光步枪杰作在 Solaris VII 首次亮相。它将氏族激光技术的进步与 SLDF 激光步枪相结合，无论在竞技场还是战场上都能压制众多对手。 12 发。 备用射击模式可选择更强的一击或极远射程，但弹药消耗增加。

column1: This Handheld package combines 2 Clan LRM5 Launchers able to fire a salvo accurately or in Tandem Salvo with a higher chance to cluster.\n\n 60 Rounds.
column2: 这套手持包整合了 2 具氏族 LRM5 发射器，可精准齐射，也可采用串联齐射以获得更高的集束概率。\n\n 60 发。

column1: A single Streak SRM4 Launcher System.\n\n 52 Rounds.
column2: 单具 Streak SRM4 发射器系统。\n\n 52 发。

column1: A single Streak LRM5 Launcher System.\n\n 60 Rounds.
column2: 单具 Streak LRM5 发射器系统。\n\n 60 发。

column1: Enhanced Long Range Missiles were developed by the Federated Commonwealth in response to the superior performance of Clan weaponry. These new LRMs use a more sophisticated arming mechanism to increase their viability at close range. The result has been a much smaller blind spot compared to traditional LRMs while still retaining the same long-range functionality. This is packaged with half a ton of ammo in an unarmored handheld package, intended for firing and ejecting before getting into brawling range.\n\n 60 rounds.
column2: 增强型远程导弹由联邦合众国研发，用以应对氏族武器的优越性能。这些新型 LRM 采用更精密的起爆机制，以提升其在近距离下的可用性。其结果是，与传统 LRM 相比盲区大大缩小，同时仍保留相同的远程功能。这套装置以半吨弹药封装在无装甲手持包中，设计用途是在进入近身搏斗距离前发射并抛弃。\n\n 60 发。

column1: Based on the same technology as a coolant pod, this unit includes an inbuilt sensor to automatically flush coolant in extreme situations.VOLATILE!
column2: 该装置基于与冷却剂舱相同的技术，内置传感器可在极端情况下自动排放冷却剂。易爆！

column1: Remove 40 extra heat.
column2: 额外消除 40 点热量。

column1: Attempting to extend the benefits of prototype heatsinks to the entire Engine Block, Luthien engineers created this experimental "compact prototype" cooling system, resulting in highly efficient, less bulky cooling at cost of some weight. While effective, it was prohibitively expensive to manufacture and maintain, and only a few were ever produced.\n\nVOLATILE!
column2: 为将原型散热器的优势扩展至整个引擎模块，Luthien 的工程师创造了这套实验性“紧凑原型”冷却系统，以部分重量为代价换来高效、体积更小的散热效果。虽然有效，但其制造与维护成本高得令人望而却步，最终只生产了极少数。\n\n易爆！

column1: This does Look like a pretty basic AC10 Class Weapon, but it fires a steady stream of Ultra Munitions.\n\n Uses UAC10 Ammo.
column2: 这看起来确实像一件相当基础的 AC10 级武器，但它发射的是源源不断的 Ultra 弹药。\n\n 使用 UAC10 弹药。

column1: Melee attacks deal 50% Extra damage.
column2: 近战攻击造成 50% 额外伤害。

column1: Based on the same technology as a coolant pod, this unit includes an inbuilt sensor to automatically flush coolant in extreme situations. VOLATILE!
column2: 该装置基于与冷却剂舱相同的技术，内置传感器可在极端情况下自动排放冷却剂。易爆！

column1: This is a handheld Streak SRM-6 launcher protected by one ton of armour.\n\n 90 rounds.
column2: 这是一具手持式 Streak SRM-6 发射器，由一吨装甲保护。\n\n 90 发。

column1: This unit is very vulnerable to arm crits
column2: 该单位的手臂极易遭受暴击

column1: This is a handheld trio of Streak SRM-4 launchers protected by two tons of armour.\n\n 90 rounds.
column2: 这是三具手持式 Streak SRM-4 发射器，由两吨装甲保护。\n\n 90 发。

column1: Remove 30 extra heat.
column2: 额外消除 30 点热量。

column1: Basically this is a Vehicle Mortar, Boss. Some Junker wired it up to be Held by a Battlemech and to fire home made 'Grenades'.\n\n 10 Shots.
column2: 基本上这就是门车辆迫击炮，老板。某个废品匠把它接线改造成可由战斗机甲持握，并发射自制“手雷”。\n\n 10 发。

column1: A Handheld battery of 3 Anti-Personel Gauss Rifles.\n\n 40 Shots.
column2: 一组手持式 3 门反人员高斯步枪。\n\n 40 发。

column1: Early Clan prototypes of the LB-X also underwent testing during Operation KLONDIKE. Though a little less effective and a little more bulky than their modern Inner Sphere-made equivalents, these autocannons paved the way for what became known as the Clan standard. \n\n Uses LBX10 Ammo.
column2: LB-X 的早期氏族原型也在克朗代克行动期间接受过测试。虽然比现代内天体制造的同类产品效能略低、体积略大，但这些自动炮为后来被称为氏族标准的设计铺平了道路。\n\n 使用 LBX10 弹药。

column1: The Battle Armor Tube Artillery (often simple BA Tube Artillery) is an infantry scale artillery piece designed for use with battle armor. The weapon was introduced during the Jihad, but it's unclear by whom. \n\n Uses Tube Artillery Ammo.
column2: 战斗装甲管式火炮（通常简称 BA 管炮）是专为战斗装甲使用而设计的步兵级火炮。该武器在圣战期间问世，但由谁引入并不清楚。\n\n 使用管式火炮弹药。

column1: Early Clan prototypes of the LB-X also underwent testing during Operation KLONDIKE. Though a little less effective and a little more bulky than their modern Inner Sphere-made equivalents, these autocannons paved the way for what became known as the Clan standard. \n\n Uses LBX20 Ammo.
column2: LB-X 的早期氏族原型也在克朗代克行动期间接受过测试。虽然比现代内天体制造的同类产品效能略低、体积略大，但这些自动炮为后来被称为氏族标准的设计铺平了道路。\n\n 使用 LBX20 弹药。

column1: Early Clan prototypes of the LB-X also underwent testing during Operation KLONDIKE. Though a little less effective and a little more bulky than their modern Inner Sphere-made equivalents, these autocannons paved the way for what became known as the Clan standard. \n\n Uses LBX5 Ammo.
column2: LB-X 的早期氏族原型也在克朗代克行动期间接受过测试。虽然比现代内天体制造的同类产品效能略低、体积略大，但这些自动炮为后来被称为氏族标准的设计铺平了道路。\n\n 使用 LBX5 弹药。

column1: Early Clan prototypes of the LB-X also underwent testing during Operation KLONDIKE. Though a little less effective and a little more bulky than their modern Inner Sphere-made equivalents, these autocannons paved the way for what became known as the Clan standard. \n\n Uses LBX2 Ammo.
column2: LB-X 的早期氏族原型也在克朗代克行动期间接受过测试。虽然比现代内天体制造的同类产品效能略低、体积略大，但这些自动炮为后来被称为氏族标准的设计铺平了道路。\n\n 使用 LBX2 弹药。

column1: This compact NARC launcher fires a single beacon that attaches itself to the enemy and emits a homing signal for all friendly missiles.\n\n Uses BA NARC ammo.
column2: 这种紧凑型 NARC 发射器发射单个信标，信标会附着在敌人身上，并为所有友方导弹发出归航信号。\n\n 使用 BA NARC 弹药。

column1: This unit's maximum number of EVASIVE charges is increased.
column2: 该单位的最大闪避次数增加。

column1: Battle Armor that can transform to a quick to deploy Rider form. Can't swarm while in bike mode
column2: 可变形为便于快速部署的骑乘形态的战斗装甲。处于摩托模式时无法进行蚁附攻击

column1: Melee weapon accuracy
column2: 近战武器精准度

column1: Harpooned ye Landlubber! 15% reduced Unsteady threshold.
column2: 叉中你了，旱鸭子！失衡阈值降低 15%。

column1: Increased crits.
column2: 暴击效果提升。

column1: Prototype versions of the Ultra Autocannon all saw limited use with the Clans during Operation KLONDIKE. As with the other weapons of this era, the final evolution of modern ''Clan-spec'' versions would not come until after the conquest of the Pentagon worlds and the dawn of the Golden Century. \n\n Uses UAC10 Ammo.
column2: Ultra 自动炮的原型版本在克朗代克行动期间曾在氏族中得到有限使用。与这一时代的其他武器一样，现代“氏族规格”版本的最终演化，要等到五角星系被征服、黄金世纪开启之后才会出现。\n\n 使用 UAC10 弹药。

column1: Improved Accuracy for all weapons
column2: 所有武器精准度提升

column1: Developed by the Clans, Enhanced Imaging is an advanced targeting and piloting system for use with humanoid shaped combat vehicles such as BattleMechs. While offering considerable advantages, EI inflicts serious side effects on the user, including possible mental instability, nerve damage and death.
column2: 增强成像由氏族研发，是一种用于战斗机甲等类人形战斗车辆的先进瞄准与驾驶系统。虽然能带来可观的优势，EI 也会对使用者造成严重的副作用，包括可能的精神失常、神经损伤乃至死亡。

column1: Less Laser Heat

column1:
Sabrewolf - he never uses 'Zebak Koga' - was born to explorers of the Periphery who simply didn't return one day from one of their expeditions. At least that's the story he was told. Perhaps they died, or perhaps they decided a child was an unwanted burden. He was passed around the small community his parents had been using as a base until he was old enough to be sent off to school, at which point he was promptly given to a passing mercenary company. 'Apprenticed', they called it. He does not say the name of the company, except to observe, with dark glee, that they no longer exist.

After escaping his original company as a young man, he continued to seek employment as a mercenary, first as ground support for BattleMech lances, and then as a BattleMech pilots. He has had many commanders, and does not always leave with good reports. Insubordination is a common complaint. It's not that he's rude. It's just that if he disapproves of a mission, or how it's being carried out, he will instead enact his own plan. But somehow, he stays alive and brings his 'Mech back, which is valuable enough in a pilot.
column2:
萨伯狼——他从不使用“Zebak Koga”这个名字——出生于外缘区的探险者家庭，而他的父母某天外出探险后就再也没回来。至少他听到的说法是这样。也许他们死了，也许他们觉得孩子是个不受欢迎的累赘。他在父母曾用作基地的小社区里被人轮流照料，直到长大到该上学的年纪，随即被直接交给一支路过的雇佣兵公司。他们称之为“学徒”。他不肯说出那家公司的名字，只会带着阴沉的快意指出：它们早已不存在。

年轻时逃离原来的公司后，他继续以雇佣兵身份谋生，先是作为战斗机甲小队的陆上支援，后来成为战斗机甲机师。他有过许多指挥官，离职时并不总能留下好评价。不服从指挥是常见的抱怨。倒不是他粗鲁，只是如果他不认同某项任务，或任务的执行方式，他就会改按自己的计划行事。但不知怎的，他总能活下来并把机甲带回来，这对一名机师来说已经足够有价值了。

column1:
Lorenzo Raldoron grew up in a working class family of mechanics in the Federated Suns. While his parents and aunts worked on urban vehicles and passenger aircraft, they had a family love of BattleMechs, watching holovids of the Solaris games together and once enjoying a family trip to the legendary planet. In their spare time, they'd construct models together.

By the time Lorenzo was old enough to attend technical school, work as a MechTech was no longer an elite position for mechanics. Decades of war did that. When he graduated, he had his pick of positions, and chose to work on a DropShip so he could see other systems. After his first tour of duty was up, he realized that he could enjoy more freedom working for a mercenary company rather than the AFFS, and moved Rimward. This allowed him more time to continue working on the models that had been a lifetime interest. He enjoyed trying to recreate the look of LosTech designs even if the technology itself was beyond him.

Becoming a pilot was never a driving interest of his, but when his current employer ended up in a situation where pilots were needed more than techs, he stepped up and discovered how easy it was for him to maneuver BattleMechs. Now he accepts work in either position, but has found, on average, he has more time to pursue his hobby if he works as a pilot.
column2:
洛伦佐·拉尔多隆在联邦太阳的一个工人阶级机械师家庭中长大。他的父母与姑姨们修理城市车辆与客机，但全家人都热爱战斗机甲，会一起观看 Solaris 竞技赛的全息影像，还曾举家前往那颗传奇星球旅行。闲暇时，他们会一起制作模型。

等到洛伦佐到了上技术学校的年纪，机甲技师已不再是机械师中的精英职位——数十年的战争把它磨成了这样。毕业时他有多个职位可选，他选择到一艘空投艇上工作，以便见识其他星系。第一次服役期满后，他意识到为雇佣兵公司工作比为 AFFS 工作享有更多自由，于是向边缘方向迁移。这让他有更多时间继续钻研那项贯穿一生的爱好——制作模型。他乐于尝试重现失落科技的造型，即使那些技术本身对他而言遥不可及。

成为机师从来不是他的热切追求，但当他的现任雇主陷入机师比技师更紧缺的境地时，他挺身而出，并发现自己驾驶战斗机甲竟如此轻松。如今他两种职位的工作都接，但发现平均而言，当机师时能有更多时间投入自己的爱好。

column1:
Viona Heinrici was born on Hesperus II in the Lyran Commonwealth to a family with a long history of working in and around the famous Defiance Industries BattleMech factory. While her father and brothers worked in the factory itself, her mother and aunts were pilots serving in defense of the factory, so naturally, Viona followed in their footsteps.

However, while she was still in training, there was a particularly brutal attack on Hesperus II by the Free Worlds League. While the LCAF successfully defended Defiance Industries, a large portion of Viona's family were casualties of the assault. As a result, out of respect for her family's long service, Viona was allowed to finish her training but refused a combat assignment.

Disappointed at not having a chance to put her training to the test, Viona chose to go to Solaris VII, where she found work in a stable and survived her first bout. Later, while training, she was defeated by a rough-edged older pilot from the Federated Suns. Fascinated by his gruff attitude, she immediately adopted him as her mentor. When he abruptly left Solaris VII, she tracked him down and then followed him out to the Periphery, which turned out to be an even more interesting place than Solaris VII. Now she works as a mercenary, staying in contact with both her mentor and her remaining family on Hesperus II, and thoroughly enjoying life.
column2:
维奥娜·海因里希出生在莱伦联合体的赫斯佩鲁斯 II，家族世代都在著名的 Defiance Industries 战斗机甲工厂内外工作。她的父亲与兄弟们进厂做工，而她的母亲与姑姨们则是守护工厂的机师，因此维奥娜自然追随了她们的脚步。

然而，她还在受训期间，自由世界联盟对赫斯佩鲁斯 II 发动了一次极为残暴的进攻。尽管 LCAF 成功守住了 Defiance Industries，维奥娜的家族仍有很大一部分在袭击中伤亡。出于对其家族长期服役的敬意，维奥娜被允许完成训练，但未获分配作战任务。

由于没有机会检验自己的训练成果，维奥娜感到失望，于是选择前往 Solaris VII，在那里的一家训练营找到工作，并在自己的首场比赛中存活下来。后来在一次训练中，她败给了一位来自联邦太阳、性情粗野的年长机师。她被他的粗犷气质所吸引，立刻将他认作自己的导师。当他突然离开 Solaris VII 时，她一路追寻，随后跟随他前往外缘区——结果那里比 Solaris VII 更有意思。如今她以雇佣兵身份工作，与导师和留在赫斯佩鲁斯 II 的家人保持联系，并且非常享受自己的生活。

column1:
Growing up on a Periphery planet repeatedly ransacked during the latter stages of the Third Succession War, Matthew Osis acquired an unusual taste for violence. He was adopted from the ruins of his home by the commander of a passing mercenary company. Seeing unusual potential in the boy, his proclivities were encouraged and indulged by his protector, right up until there was a mutiny and fourteen-year-old Matthew was abandoned once again.

He spent two years working his way across the Periphery, keeping his tendency toward violence in check until he finally arrived at Solaris VII — the destination his mentor had been aiming him toward all along. There he found one of the least respected gladiatorial stables and promised them that if they put him in a 'Mech, he'd take them to the top. Such was the force of his personality that they did. He kept his word.

While he wasn't as showy as some of the champions and he didn't have crowd-pleasing manners, excellence has its own charm, and savagery creates its own reputation. For fifteen years, he dominated one-on-one arenas, until eventually his stable had trouble finding opponents for him to fight. As part of a long-term strategy to set up an explosive comeback fight, Matthew's manager convinced him to take an extended sabbatical from the ring. Now, unable to relax unless he's fought something recently, Matthew is working as a mercenary in the Periphery. If baring his teeth counts as a smile, he smiles every time somebody recognizes his name.
column2:
马修·奥西斯在外缘区一颗于第三次继承战争后期屡遭劫掠的星球上长大，因而养成了对暴力的异样嗜好。他从家园的废墟中被一支路过的雇佣兵公司指挥官收养。这位保护者在这个男孩身上看到了不寻常的潜质，于是鼓励并纵容他的嗜好，直到一场兵变发生，十四岁的马修再次被抛弃。

他花了两年时间一路穿越外缘区，一路克制着自己的暴力倾向，最终抵达 Solaris VII——这正是一直以来导师为他指引的目的地。在那里，他找到一家最不受尊重的角斗训练营，并向他们承诺：只要让他上机甲，他就能带他们登上顶峰。他的人格力量如此强大，他们照做了。而他也信守了诺言。

虽然他不像某些冠军那样张扬，也没有讨观众欢心的举止，但卓越自有一种魅力，凶悍自会造就名声。十五年间，他统治着一对一竞技场，直到最终他的训练营难以找到能与他交手的对手。为实施一项长期策略、为一场爆发式的复出之战做铺垫，马修的经纪人说服他暂时长期告别擂台。如今，除非最近打过一场，否则他无法放松，于是他正在外缘区当雇佣兵。如果说龇牙也算微笑，那么每当有人认出他的名字，他都会微笑。

column1:
Jason Castro is the firstborn son of the Duke of Rio in the Draconis March of the Federated Suns, and as such he received all the best training available, and was taught to know his own value. He was one of the first graduates from the newly rebuilt Robinson Battle Academy, and was assigned a position of responsibility early.

Unfortunately, despite his lineage, his training and his confidence, he lacked the wisdom to lead his command well. Too soon after receiving his commission, he bungled an attack on a superior Draconis Combine force along the border. His entire unit was wiped out, and he barely escaped with his life.

Horrified, his father pulled strings to have him sent home to relative safety. While Jason accepted the opportunity to resign his commission, he refused to return to Rio, and instead headed out to the Periphery to pick up work as a mercenary. While he is still too arrogant to admit it, he is hoping to acquire the experience and wisdom he needs to somehow make up for the disaster of his first command. Meanwhile, he affects a hard-bitten cynicism beyond his years.
column2:
杰森·卡斯特罗是联邦太阳德拉科尼斯辖区里奥公爵的长子，因此他接受了所有最好的训练，并被教导要认清自己的价值。他是重建后的罗宾逊战斗学院首批毕业生之一，并早早被委以重任。

不幸的是，尽管出身显赫、训练有素又自信满满，他却缺乏带好部队所需的智慧。获得委任后不久，他就在边境对一支占据优势的德拉科尼斯联合体部队发动了一次糟糕的进攻。他的整个部队被全歼，他自己也几乎丧命。

他的父亲大为惊骇，动用关系把他送回家中相对安全的地方。杰森接受了辞去军职的机会，却拒绝回到里奥，转而前往外缘区以雇佣兵身份谋生。虽然他仍傲慢得不肯承认，但他希望获得所需的经验与智慧，以某种方式弥补自己首次指挥的灾难。与此同时，他摆出一副超越年龄的久经世故的愤世嫉俗。

column1:
Victoria Samson was born on Thule, in the Draconis Combine. The only daughter of a long line of infantry officers, she had a number of brothers, all of whom adored her. While her parents pushed her toward the traditional occupations of a Draconian girl, her brothers encouraged her in both mischief and combat training.

It was inevitable that as soon as she was of age, she enlisted. While she quickly proved her worth as an exceptional 'Mech pilot, her taste for mischief could not be satisfied so easily. She began dabbling in the barracks black market. During her first tour of duty, she piloted her Jenner with distinction - and ran the odd illegal substance along the way.

On her next tour, without any combat action, she started cozying up to the Yakuza. This, however, was not as much fun as she'd hoped, and she soon found herself looking for an escape from water that had gotten much too hot. With the aid of some Davion connections she'd made, she fled the Combine and headed straight to the Periphery. Now she hires herself out as a mercenary - and if she makes a little on the side moving things from here to there, well, it makes people happy. And isn't that what counts?
column2:
维多利亚·萨姆森出生在德拉科尼斯联合体的图勒。她是一个步兵军官世家唯一的女儿，上有几个兄弟，个个都宠爱她。父母推着她走德拉科尼斯女孩的传统道路，兄弟们却鼓励她调皮捣蛋，还陪她练武。

她一达到年龄就入伍，这是必然的。她很快证明自己是名出色的机甲机师，但她对捣蛋的嗜好却没那么容易满足。她开始在军营黑市里小打小闹。第一次服役期间，她驾驶 Jenner 表现出色——同时也顺路捎带些奇怪的违禁品。

下一次服役期间没有作战任务，她便开始与山口组套近乎。然而这并不如她期望的那般有趣，她很快发现自己需要从越来越烫的水里脱身。借助一些她在戴维恩方面建立的关系，她逃离了联合体，直奔外缘区。如今她以雇佣兵身份受雇——如果顺便把东西从一处运到另一处赚点外快，那也让人高兴。而这不才是最重要的吗？

column1: Crime doesn't pay, Teo Navarro, said his Mama. "You just keep your head down and work hard and be glad we're in the Federated Suns and not in any of those other places." Crime doesn't pay... except when it does. Crime paid for his Mama's heart surgery and his little sisters' schooling. Crime put food on the table when Mama couldn't get enough work and basic benefits were cut once again so the military could build yet more war machines. Crime does pay... until you get caught. And even then, the House Davion military industrial complex wanted to recruit him, not punish him. That was what the Third Succession War had driven proud House Davion to. He wanted to spit in their faces and accept the execution they offered him as an alternative. But would the criminal organization continue to take care of his family if he died for them? Sometimes they did, and sometimes they didn't. Best, he decided, was to appear to die. To do what the Federated Suns asked him to do. So he did, for a while. He tracked and brokered and assassinated. Until Mama died anyhow, at the bottom of an endless waiting list for another surgery. He walked away that night, collected his two youngest sisters and his orphaned nieces, and took them all out to the Periphery, away from the corrupt, treacherous Inner Sphere. Now, they live someplace safe. He still sends them most of the money he makes as a mercenary, and his kit is covered in photos of his family. The older ones are somber, but the younger ones smile. Mama would, finally, be proud.
column2: “犯罪没有好下场，特奥·纳瓦罗，”他妈妈说。“你只管低头干活，努力做事，庆幸我们是在联邦太阳，而不是在别的什么鬼地方。”犯罪没有好下场……除非它有好下场。犯罪付了妈妈的心脏手术费和妹妹们的学费。在妈妈找不到足够工作、基本福利又被再次削减以便军方建造更多战争机器时，是犯罪让餐桌上有饭吃。 犯罪确实有好下场……直到你被抓。而即便如此，戴维恩家族的军工复合体想要的是招募他，而不是惩罚他。第三次继承战争已经把骄傲的戴维恩家族逼到了这一步。 他本想朝他们脸上吐口水，接受他们提出的枪决作为替代。可如果他为他们而死，那个犯罪组织还会继续照顾他的家人吗？有时会，有时不会。他决定，最好的办法是假装死掉。去做联邦太阳要求他做的事。 于是他做了，做了一阵子。他追踪、居间斡旋、暗杀。直到妈妈终究还是死了，死在等待下一次手术的无尽名单末尾。那晚他抽身离开，接走两个最小的妹妹和失去双亲的侄女们，把她们全都带到外缘区，远离那腐败而背叛的内天体。如今她们住在某个安全的地方。他仍把当雇佣兵赚来的大部分钱寄给她们，他的装备上贴满了家人的照片。年长的那些神情肃穆，年幼的却在微笑。妈妈终于会为他骄傲了。

column1:
The Steiner-affiliated mercenary unit that raised Aaron Morrow told him his parents had died heroes. It wasn't until he was older that he learned they wouldn't have had to die heroes if House Steiner had sent the reinforcements they'd promised. It was at the same time he learned about the elaborate, long-term revenge ploy his commander had been pursuing.

Young Aaron had already been on half a dozen missions at this point. He was involved romantically with an LCAF regular. When he learned that the Steiner had betrayed his unit and his family, and that in return, years later, his unit was about to betray House Steiner — well, some young men might have chosen revenge. Others might have chosen love. Aaron Morrow, torn between his heart and his history, chose neither. He warned his lover what was planned, explained why, and walked away.

In the Periphery, he continues performing the only trade he knows. He travels light, his only valuable possession a wrecked SLDF neurohelmet his lover gave him right before he left. He keeps it, he says, to remember the past.
column2:
抚养亚伦·莫罗长大的那支与施泰纳有关的雇佣兵部队告诉他，他的父母是作为英雄牺牲的。直到他长大一些，他才知道，如果施泰纳家族当初派出了他们承诺的援军，他的父母本不必成为英雄。也正是在那时，他得知了指挥官一直在推行的那套精心策划、旷日持久的复仇计划。

此时年轻的亚伦已经执行过五六次任务。他与一名 LCAF 现役军人相恋。当他得知施泰纳背叛了他的部队和他的家人，而作为回报，多年之后他的部队也即将背叛施泰纳家族——嗯，有些年轻人也许会选择复仇，另一些也许会选择爱情。亚伦·莫罗夹在自己的心与自己的过去之间，两者都没选。他把计划告诉了自己的爱人，解释了原因，然后转身离去。

在外缘区，他继续干着自己唯一会干的营生。他轻装上路，唯一的贵重物品是爱人临别前送给他的一个破损的 SLDF 神经头盔。他说，留着它，是为了记住过去。

column1:
Llana Huxley was raised to be loyal to her planet of New Hessen, rather the the Capellan Confederation that claimed it. Her wealthy father was a 'Mech enthusiast who volunteered his own BattleMech for local militia use. From age 8 she rode with him in the cockpit, becoming an informal mascot for the militia. But as she grew, her role as mascot worked against her. She wanted to be taken seriously as a future leader of the militia, but despite their affection, her seniors gave her no credit for actual ability.

So Llana tried to prove herself through enlistment. But her first deployment was more than she bargained for, and a part of her simply broke. During what she would later recall as the darkest time of her life, Llana joined other deserters from her unit on an interplanetary crime spree. It wasn't until her father personally tracked her down and confronted her that she started coming to terms with what she'd done and what she was willing to do.

She wanted to turn herself in to her original unit, but her father convinced her to come home again instead. She no longer had a legal identity in the Capellan Confederation, but her father's militia welcomed her anyhow. Once again she sat in the cockpit of a 'Mech, defending the home she loved — all the way up until her father died. Then the lawyers came for her father's 'Mech, and her continued existence was discovered. Once again, she wanted to stay and face her fate, but the militia members who had watched her grow up couldn't bear it, and forced her to flee her home. Now she wanders the Periphery, taking mercenary jobs and hoping to one day put together her own company that she can lead back to the defense of New Hessen.
column2:
拉娜·赫克斯利从小被教导要忠于自己所在的星球新黑森，而不是宣称拥有它的卡佩兰联盟。她富有的父亲是个机甲爱好者，自愿提供自己的战斗机甲供当地民兵使用。从八岁起，她就跟着父亲坐在驾驶舱里，成了民兵队伍的非正式吉祥物。但随着她长大，吉祥物的身份反倒成了阻碍。她希望被认真对待，成为民兵未来的领袖，但尽管长辈们疼爱她，却从不为她的实际能力给予肯定。

于是拉娜试图通过参军来证明自己。但她的首次部署远超她的预想，她内心某处就这样崩坏了。在她日后回想为人生最黑暗的那段时期，拉娜与部队里其他逃兵一起，卷入了一场跨星球的犯罪狂潮。直到父亲亲自追踪找到她、与她当面对质，她才开始正视自己所做的事以及自己愿意做的事。

她想向原部队自首，但父亲说服她再次回家。她在卡佩兰联盟已不再拥有合法身份，但父亲的民兵仍然接纳了她。她再次坐进机甲驾驶舱，守护她所热爱的家园——直到父亲去世。随后律师们来讨要父亲的机甲，她的存在也因此曝光。她再一次想要留下面对命运，但看着她长大的民兵成员们不忍心，逼她逃离家园。如今她在外缘区游荡，接雇佣兵活儿，希望有朝一日能组建自己的连队，带它回去保卫新黑森。

column1: Siegfried Krauss, born to a noble Lyran lineage, educated at the best Lyran school, and appointed to the most prestigious and safest of positions, has a nemesis. It's his only explanation for how he could go from that most prestigious of positions, to enlisting in a BattleMech corps. It's his explanation for how he went from a ranking position in the BattleMech corps to wandering the Inner Sphere. It's even his explanation for how, once he settled on Solaris VII and built up his own stable, he threw it all away to become a mercenary in the Periphery. Siegfried Krauss doesn't deal with breakups very well at all. But he can't seem to help falling in love. And, of course, who can resist falling in love with him? If only they'd stay in love. If only all sparkling-eyed brunettes would just... stay away. If only, once the relationship ended, he could stand to stay where once he'd had so many happy memories. But he can't. It simply hurts too much.
column2: 西格弗里德·克劳斯出身莱伦贵族世家，就读于莱伦最好的学校，被委派到最显赫也最安全的职位——而他有一个宿敌。 这是他对自己如何从最显赫的职位转而加入战斗机甲部队的唯一解释。这是他对自己如何从战斗机甲部队的军官职位流落到内天体四处漂泊的解释。这也是他对为何在 Solaris VII 安顿下来、建立起自己的训练营之后，又把一切抛下、跑到外缘区当雇佣兵的解释。 西格弗里德·克劳斯实在不擅长处理分手。但他似乎总忍不住坠入爱河。当然，谁又能抗拒爱上他呢？只求他们能一直爱下去。只求所有眼睛闪闪发亮的深发女子都……离远一点。只求关系结束后，他还能忍住在曾经拥有那么多美好回忆的地方待下去。但他做不到。那实在太痛了。

column1:
Aidan McRae was the only child of the commander of a Davion mercenary unit assigned to monitor Mendham Electronics after it was liberated from the Capellan Confederation. His mother was only a minor noble, but during the time her company was under contract to House Davion, they were one of the wealthiest families on Mendham. Aidan received every advantage in education and training, including attending a prestigious military academy, before returning to his mother's house to take his place in the BattleMech that had been reserved for him since birth.

Unfortunately, that BattleMech belonged to House Davion, just like much of the company equipment. And unfortunately, Aidan's mother had no income stream other than her mercenary contract, and a decided taste for living in the style of her noble childhood. All would have been well if the Mendham contract had continued past the company's probationary period. It might still have been well if House Davion hadn't formed an alliance with House Steiner. But alas, Mendham Electronics was deemed trustworthy, and peace broke out, and so the McRae mercenary company that was to be Aidan's inheritance was scattered.

But peace never lasts forever. There's always somebody, somewhere, looking for mercenaries. While Aidan's mother remains in her new, much smaller home in the Federated Suns, Aidan travels the Periphery, working, networking, and saving money, so that one day the Sons of Grace might rise again.
column2:
艾丹·麦克雷是一支戴维恩雇佣兵部队指挥官的独子，该部队被派往门德姆电子公司，在其从卡佩兰联盟手中解放后负责监视。他的母亲只是个低级贵族，但在她的连队受雇于戴维恩家族期间，他们曾是门德姆最富有的家族之一。艾丹在教育和训练上享有一切优势，还就读过一所声望卓著的军事学院，之后回到母亲的宅邸，坐进那台自他出生起就为他预留的战斗机甲。

不幸的是，那台战斗机甲属于戴维恩家族，连队的大部分装备也是如此。更不幸的是，艾丹的母亲除了雇佣兵合约外没有任何收入来源，却偏偏热衷于维持贵族童年式的生活方式。如果门德姆的合约能延续过连队的试用期，一切本来都会好起来。如果戴维恩家族没有与施泰纳家族结盟，事情也许仍然会好起来。但可惜，门德姆电子公司被认为值得信任，和平降临了，于是本该成为艾丹遗产的麦克雷雇佣兵连队就此四散。

但和平从不会长久。总有人、在某个地方，需要雇佣兵。当艾丹的母亲待在联邦太阳那栋新添的、小得多的宅子里时，艾丹在外缘区四处奔走，工作、结交人脉、攒钱，只为有朝一日“格雷斯之子”能够东山再起。

column1:
Lantalia Metke was the eldest child of one of the Counts of Galax, in the Federated Suns. She was a bright, but deeply withdrawn child. After a standard battery of psychological testing indicated a need for medical intervention, she was sent to New Avalon and her younger brother replaced her in the stressful position of Metke heir.

While she was primarily on New Avalon for assistance with her gender transition, the early treatment encouraged her to overcome her withdrawal and soon she found a place as the protege of a noted AI researcher. After graduating from her academy early, she chose to return to Galax to do avionics development for Boeing and was assigned to a roaming DropShip recovery team.

When her team was attacked while on assignment, she was the only survivor, and dying of dehydration herself when a mercenary company boarded the drifting ship and rescued her. After bonding with the mercenaries, she decided to stay with them for a while. They trained her as a backup pilot. Unfortunately, when a crisis came that required her skills, she alone was not enough to save the day. While the civilians her company was defending survived, her friends did not.

Now she drifts around the Periphery, intermittently working as a mercenary pilot. She has an invitation to work at the New Avalon Institute of Science with her mentor, a standing offer from Boeing to work for them again, and a family that misses her. But she has lost two crews, two sets of friends, and she is not yet sure what she's ready to lose next.
column2:
兰塔莉亚·梅特克是联邦太阳加莱克斯某位伯爵的长女。她聪慧过人，却极为孤僻。在接受了标准的一系列心理测试后，测试显示她需要医疗介入，于是她被送往新阿瓦隆，由她的弟弟接替她承担梅特克继承人这一压力重重的身份。

她前往新阿瓦隆主要是为了接受性别转换方面的帮助，而早期的治疗反而激励她走出了孤僻，不久她便成为一位著名人工智能研究者的门生。提前从学院毕业后，她选择回到加莱克斯，为波音公司从事航空电子开发，并被分配到一个流动的空投艇打捞队。

当她的队伍在执行任务时遭到袭击，她是唯一的幸存者；当一支雇佣兵公司登上那艘漂流的飞船时，她也已因脱水而濒死，是他们救了她。与这些雇佣兵建立起情谊后，她决定暂时跟着他们。他们把她训练成替补机师。不幸的是，当危机来临、需要她的技能时，单凭她一人不足以挽回局面。她所在公司保护的平民活了下来，她的朋友们却没有。

如今她在外缘区漂泊，断断续续地做着雇佣兵机师。她收到导师的邀请，可以去新阿瓦隆科学研究所工作；波音公司也长期欢迎她回去；还有一个思念她的家庭。但她已经失去了两批同伴、两拨朋友，她还不知道自己准备好再失去什么。

column1:
Kyone Akashi was the eldest child and first daughter of a DCMS MechWarrior. Her father decided early to train her to inherit his skills, as she was by far the most aggressive of his children. She spent her childhood being taught by retainers, while being instructed remotely by her father. On his rare return visits, he would test her. When she was fourteen, she won early admission to the Benjamin District Gymnasium.

Shortly before she could graduate from the Gymnasium, her father was arrested as a traitor and the family assets were seized by ISF. She learned this when a friend of her father's attempted to kidnap her from the school for her own protection. After verifying the prisoner's story, she decided to accompany him off-planet so that she might investigate and, if needed, avenge her family.

Her guardian had other plans. Soothing her with talk of a long game, Kyone and 'Uncle' Yosuke spent several years traveling from one system to the next, with less and less talk of returning to Shirotori. Eventually, having traveled enough to realize the futility of it, Kyone gave up talk of justice and revenge.

Soon after, Yosuke's money ran out. Coincidentally, they happened to be on Solaris VII at that point. Bored with constant travel, Kyone chose not to dig below the surface of her guardian's request that she participate in gladiator fights to help with the bills.

She won early and often, and the financial pressures on her protector eased. But as her battles became more and more carefully arranged, and more and more risky, Yosuke's financial burdens grew again. And yet Kyone enjoyed herself... until one bloodsoaked black night all her pleasure in the arena vanished forever. That was the night she discovered Yosuke, brutally murdered over secret debts he'd incurred supporting her all those years, and set out to punish those who had once again taken her family.

That was then. Now... she's in the Periphery, alone, working as a mercenary MechWarrior. She doesn't talk much. And when she fights, she's very, very hard to stop.
column2:
恭音·明石是 DCMS 一名机甲战士的长女。她的父亲早早决定训练她继承自己的本领，因为在他的孩子中她最为好斗。她的童年由家臣们教导，同时由父亲远程授课。在他难得的归家时，他会考校她。十四岁那年，她获得本杰明辖区健身馆的提前录取。

就在她即将从健身馆毕业前不久，她的父亲被当作叛徒逮捕，家族资产被 ISF 没收。她得知此事，是因为父亲的一位朋友试图把她从学校绑架走，以保护她。在核实了这名囚徒的说法后，她决定跟随他离开星球，以便展开调查，并在必要时为家族复仇。

她的监护人另有打算。他用“这是一场长局”的说辞安抚她，恭音与“洋介叔叔”花了数年时间从一个星系辗转至另一个星系，而关于重返白鸟星的谈论越来越少。最终，走得够多的她意识到其中徒劳，便不再提正义与复仇。

此后不久，洋介的钱花光了。凑巧的是，那时他们正好在 Solaris VII。恭音厌倦了不断漂泊，对监护人让她参加角斗比赛以补贴开销的请求，也就懒得深究其背后详情。

她赢得既早又频繁，保护者的财务压力随之缓解。但随着她的比赛安排得越来越精心、风险越来越大，洋介的财务负担再度加重。而恭音却乐在其中……直到一个血染的黑夜，她在竞技场中的全部乐趣永远消失了。那一夜，她发现洋介因多年来为支持她而欠下的秘密债务被残忍杀害，于是她踏上路途，去惩罚那些再一次夺走她家人的人。

那都是过去的事了。现在……她在外缘区，独自一人，做着雇佣兵机甲战士。她话不多。而一旦开打，她极难被挡住。

column1:
Risenki Ariamaki was born on a merchant ship in the Outworld Alliance, to an extended family of tinkers and traders that spent far more time traveling between systems than planet-side. He grew up learning almost all of the trades associated with spacefaring merchants, but was far better working with his hands than bartering with customers.

For many years, he felt he had nothing to complain about as one of the younger members of a very large family. However, as the oldest generation began passing away, Risenki found himself being drawn into the more complicated squabbles of the new generation of leaders. He hadn't minded obeying the dictates of his grandparents and great-aunts. But his aunts and uncles would hand him responsibility and then countermand his instructions to his juniors, then berate him when things didn't turn out as they wished. This was simply not the life he wished to lead.

So, after much thought, he struck out on his own. He had some trouble finding work outside of the connections of his family, and at last washed up on Solaris VII. Here, he found there was always work in one of the gladiatorial stables. When they put him in a BattleMech, he further found they were far easier to pilot that he'd expected. However, he was not of a warrior mindset, and as soon as his contract with his stable was completed, they let him go.

He returned to wandering. However, he now had skills that were always in demand among the mercenary companies of the Periphery. While he could not shine in gladiatorial combat, he enjoys working as part of a mercenary lance. He gets instructions, and he works with his 'Mech to accomplish his task, and all is well. Well, for him. Not so much for those he steps on.
column2:
利森基·阿里阿马基出生于外域联盟的一艘商船上，家族庞大，尽是修补匠与商人，他们在星系间航行的时间远多于在星球上。他在成长中学到了与太空商人相关的几乎所有行当，但比起与顾客讨价还价，他更擅长动手干活。

多年来，作为这个庞大家族中较年轻的成员，他觉得自己没什么可抱怨的。然而，随着最年长的一代相继离世，利森基发现自己被卷入了新一代领导者之间更复杂的纷争。他并不介意听从祖父母和姑婆们的吩咐。可他的姑姨叔伯们会把责任交给他，却又推翻他给下属的指令，然后在事情不遂其愿时斥责他。这根本不是他想过的生活。

于是，经过深思，他独自出走。在家族关系之外找工作费了些周折，最终他流落到 Solaris VII。在这里，他发现角斗训练营里总有活干。当他们把他塞进一台战斗机甲时，他更发现驾驶远比想象中容易。然而他并不具备战士的心态，所以他与训练营的合约一结束，他们便让他走人。

他重又四处漂泊。不过此时他已拥有外缘区雇佣兵公司永远需要的技能。虽然他在角斗场上无法出彩，他却喜欢作为雇佣兵小队的一员工作。他接到指令，然后与自己的机甲一起完成任务，一切安好。嗯，对他来说安好。被他踩在脚下的人可就没那么好了。

column1:
While Todd Ryia was born in the Outworld Alliance, his blue-collar family immigrated to Solaris VII in his early childhood. Raised among tradesmen working among the residents of Solaris VII, he developed early a jaundiced eye toward the gladiatorial industry.

When he was an adult, he enlisted in one of the local security firms. First as a beat officer and then as a detective. After some time, he was invited to join the Solaris PD special forces unit. He became intimately familiar with the dark side of the gladiatorial industry, as well as the inside of a 'Mech.

He lived for his work, for the sense that he was accomplishing something. Until one day he was set on the task of tracking down the person behind a series of brutal murders that led across the International Zone. Through the whole damn city, and through a sordid story that had, at its heart, a betrayed warrior princess with eyes like cinders, and that ended with a mercenary DropShip returning to the sky.

Todd's jurisdiction ended there. Unless she returned, he had other cases to solve. But somehow, he couldn't let go. The purity of the girl in the holovid haunted him. He had to follow her, find her, hear her story for himself. He had to find the lies, or accept his own failure.

So now... well, he's been in 'hot pursuit' for a few years, working hard on finding her. But she's too smart to use her gladiatorial name as a mercenary, and his holo-vid of her was stolen a year ago, so he's not quite sure he'd recognize her anymore, but... she's out there. Somewhere. And maybe, if he finds her, he'll finally be able to sleep peacefully again. Meanwhile... he has to eat.
column2:
虽然托德·瑞亚出生在外域联盟，但他那劳动阶层的家庭在他幼年时就移居 Solaris VII。在 Solaris VII 居民中长大的工人之间成长，他早早便对那个角斗产业抱有鄙夷的眼光。

成年后，他加入当地一家安保公司，先是当巡区警员，后来做侦探。过了一段时间，他受邀加入 Solaris 警局的特别行动单位。他对角斗产业的阴暗面变得了如指掌，也对机甲内部了如指掌。

他为工作而活，为那种自己在做实事的感觉而活。直到有一天，他被派去追查一系列残忍谋杀案背后的主谋，线索穿过国际区，穿过整座该死的城市，穿过一个卑劣的故事——故事的核心是一位双眼如炭的、遭背叛的战士公主，而故事的结尾是一艘雇佣兵空投艇升回天空。

托德的管辖权到此为止。除非她回来，否则他还有其他案子要办。但不知怎的，他放不下。全息影像中那个女孩的纯粹攫住了他。他必须追随她、找到她、亲耳听她讲述自己的故事。他必须找出那些谎言，或者承认自己的失职。

所以现在……嗯，他已经“紧追不舍”了好几年，努力寻找她。但她太聪明了，当雇佣兵时绝不用自己角斗时的名字，而他那段关于她的全息影像一年前被偷了，所以他也不太确定自己还能认出她，但……她就在外面。在某个地方。也许，如果他找到她，他终于能再次安然入睡。与此同时……他总得吃饭。

column1:
One of the many children orphaned by the Third Succession War, Jeffrey Scott was lucky enough to be adopted by the noble Scott family of the Free Worlds League, and raised as a cherished member of their large family.

After being educated at a local military academy, his family arranged for him to work at a military testing range instead of on the front lines. Not an uncommon act at the time, he still welcomed the opportunity to broaden the MechWarrior skills he'd acquired during school sports.

What could have been a splendid career was severely curtailed when he discovered that one of his siblings had been using him as a catspaw in a criminal endeavor with the potential to destabilize a Duchy. Rather than be indicted and betray his foolish brother, he abandoned his position.

Now he travels the Periphery, taking work as a mercenary. Perhaps he'll make it home again. Perhaps not. Most of his stories of old days are of the Shadow Hawk he piloted on the test range, and if he'll ever see it again.
column2:
作为第三次继承战争造成的众多孤儿之一，杰弗里·斯科特幸运地被自由世界联盟的贵族斯科特家族收养，在这个大家庭中作为受珍爱的成员长大。

在当地一所军事学院接受教育后，家族安排他到一处军事试验场工作，而不是上前线。这在当时并不少见，而他仍然乐于有机会拓宽自己在学校体育活动中获得的机甲战士技能。

本可辉煌的职业生涯被严重截断——他发现自己的一位手足把他当作爪牙，用于一场可能动摇某个公国的犯罪勾当。他不愿被起诉、也不愿出卖自己愚蠢的兄弟，于是放弃了职位。

如今他在外缘区漂泊，以雇佣兵身份接活。也许他能再次回到家。也许不能。他关于旧日的故事多半围绕他在试验场驾驶的那台 Shadow Hawk，以及他是否还能再见它一面。

column1: Karina Spenthia Yvonne Marsin, scion of the First Families of the Federated Suns, had the most ancient and noble of lineages. And, oh, she had a very fine education, the best of weapons, the shiniest of buttons. She had the wisest of older sisters and the kindest of younger brothers. And yet she was so, so bored. There was so much she could get away without anybody noticing. So much that nobody needed, so much that would hardly even be noticed if it went missing. So much others were forced to do without. Not that she particularly valued giving away her scores to the poor. Except... it did make her laugh to see her least favorite cousin's dress on a grubby nine year old. One day, though, somebody did notice. Perhaps, perhaps because she'd wanted them to. Perhaps she'd gotten more and more brazen, more and more taunting, until they couldn't help but catch her, red-handed, black-suited. Oh, the looks on their faces! But though she was a humiliation, though she was a scandal, still she was a Marsin. She skipped, singing, into her exile in the Periphery. There she did quite, quite well turning her hobby into a career. Until one day, she opened a vault that was much larger than expected and found her first BattleMech. She may have lost it since: to a thief, a thief, a thief she'll find someday and... In any case, being a MechWarrior-for-hire is a nice change from the boredom of burglary. For now.
column2: 卡丽娜·斯彭西亚·伊冯娜·马辛，联邦太阳第一家族的贵胄，拥有最古老、最高贵的血统。哦，她受过极好的教育，用最好的武器，佩最亮的纽扣。她有最睿智的姐姐和最善良的弟弟。然而她实在太、太无聊了。 有那么多东西她可以在无人察觉的情况下顺手拿走。那么多没人需要的东西，那么多就算消失也几乎没人会注意的东西。那么多别人被迫无所拥有的东西。倒不是说她特别看重把赃物送给穷人。只是……看到自己最不喜欢的表亲的裙子穿在一个脏兮兮的九岁孩子身上，确实让她发笑。 可是有一天，真有人注意到了。也许，也许，是因为她本就想让他们注意到。也许她变得越来越肆无忌惮、越来越挑衅，直到他们忍不住当场逮住她——人赃并获，一身黑衣。哦，他们脸上的表情！ 尽管她是家族的耻辱、是桩丑闻，但她终究是马辛家的人。她一路唱着歌，蹦跳着走进了在外缘区的流放生活。在那里，她把爱好变成了职业，做得相当、相当出色。直到有一天，她打开一个远超预期的金库，找到了属于自己的第一台战斗机甲。 那台机甲后来也许是被她弄丢了：被一个贼，一个贼偷走了，总有一天她会找到那个贼，然后……总之，当雇佣机甲战士比百无聊赖地入室行窃要好得多。至少目前如此。

column1:
Lars was born on Arcturus, the original capital of the Lyran Commonwealth, in one of the metropolises reclaimed by the ecosystem after the capital moved to Tharkad. As a result, his childhood an odd mix of the urban and the rural. But like many other Arcturans, Lars was raised with near fanatical devotion to the Commonwealth. When he was old enough, he enlisted in the LCAF.

On his first tour in the LCAF, he was assigned to the infantry, trained in anti-'Mech operations. He spent most of his tour living in harsh environments, avoiding being stomped on or shot by enemy 'Mechs. After his first tour ended, Lars used his earnings from his enlistment to attend the Blackjack School of Conflict, training to become a MechWarrior.

The unconventional methods taught at the Blackjack School of Conflict made Lars a perfect fit for the 6th Lyran Guards. But after surviving the 13th Battle of Hesperus II, Lars decided his life and skills were worth more than a government paycheck and left the LCAF to find wealth through his trade as a Solaris VII gladiator.

He had a promising start on Solaris, but an embarrassing defeat found Lars relegated to fighting small-time matches in The Reaches. After racking up some serious debt through gambling and expensive living, Lars decided to sell his skills as a mercenary to pay off his debts... before someone comes collecting.
column2:
拉尔斯出生在莱伦联合体的旧都阿尔克图鲁斯，那是一座在首都迁往萨卡德后被生态系统重新收复的大都市之一。因此他的童年交织着城市与乡村的色彩。但和许多阿尔克图鲁斯人一样，拉尔斯在成长中被灌输了近乎狂热的对联合体的忠诚。一到年龄，他便加入了 LCAF。

在 LCAF 的首次服役中，他被分配到步兵部队，接受反机甲作战训练。他的大部分服役时光都在严酷环境中度过，一边避免被敌方机甲踩扁或射中。首次服役结束后，拉尔斯用入伍所得进入黑杰克冲突学院，受训成为机甲战士。

黑杰克冲突学院所授的非传统战法，让拉尔斯与第 6 莱伦卫队完美契合。但在第 13 次赫斯佩鲁斯 II 战役中幸存后，拉尔斯认定自己的性命与技艺不只值一份政府薪水，于是离开 LCAF，前往 Solaris VII 以角斗士之身谋取财富。

他在 Solaris 起步颇为顺利，但一场难堪的败仗让他被贬到“边区”打些小场次。在通过赌博和奢侈生活欠下可观债务后，拉尔斯决定出售自己的雇佣兵技艺来还债……赶在有人上门收账之前。

column1:
Duncan Bronski claims he was born an old man. The son of working class parents in the Duchy of Oriente while it was still part of the Free Worlds League, he grew up knowing the value of hard, skilled work. He earned excellent marks in his primary schooling, and his references all commented on his maturity and responsibility. Despite this, he was refused entrance to the Princefield Military Academy. His family, his planet, his entire Duchy lacked the status to compel Princefield to accept him. Hard work was valuable, but not to the elite.

In retaliation, he anonymously drew caricatures of many of the figures associated with the school that had rejected him, and the local net went wild over them. When offended nobles started sending investigators to find out who had mocked them, Duncan quickly enlisted, reasoning correctly that it was the best place to hide in plain sight.

In basic training, nobody cared about his cartoons as long as he did as ordered. They cared even less when he volunteered for anti-'Mech and insurgency training. Once again, he was in a place where hard work mattered, and soon he was assigned to SAFE, the Free Worlds League intelligence arm. They found his artistic skills and the keen perception that went with them quite useful. He did not, of course, make a name for himself, because his work was never signed, but even after he was injured and transferred back home again, some of his cartoons were used as an unofficial currency among the members of the Analysis Branch.

He remained on his home planet until it was attacked and annexed by the Capellan Confederation. After escaping the invasion with his family and seeing them resettled elsewhere in the Duchy, he made his way to Galatea to earn a living as a mercenary. He still draws his cartoons, still never signs them, but the junior pilots and crew who receive one after a blunder know exactly who they come from and, if they're smart, they treasure them.
column2:
邓肯·布朗斯基宣称自己一出生就是个老头。他的父母是奥连特公国的劳动阶层，当时那里仍属自由世界联盟，他从小便懂得辛勤而熟练的劳动的价值。他在小学阶段成绩优异，所有推荐人都在评语里提到他的成熟与责任心。尽管如此，他却被普林斯菲尔德军事学院拒之门外。他的家庭、他的星球、他的整个公国都缺乏迫使普林斯菲尔德录取他的地位。勤奋自有价值，但在精英眼中并非如此。

作为回击，他匿名画了许多与那所拒绝他的学院相关人物的讽刺漫画，当地网络为之沸腾。当被冒犯的贵族们开始派调查员追查是谁在嘲讽他们时，邓肯迅速入伍，正确判断出这是藏身于众目之下的最佳去处。

在基础训练中，只要他听从命令，没人在意他的漫画。当他自愿参加反机甲与暴乱作战训练时，他们就更不在意了。他再一次置身于勤奋被看重的地方，很快便被分配到 SAFE——自由世界联盟的情报机构。他们发现他的美术技能以及随之而来的敏锐洞察力相当有用。当然，他从未扬名，因为他的作品从不署名，但即使在他受伤退役回家之后，他的部分漫画仍在分析处成员之间被当作非官方货币流通。

他一直留在家乡星球，直到它遭受卡佩兰联盟进攻并被吞并。在携家人逃离入侵、看着他们在公国其他地方安顿下来后，他辗转来到加拉蒂亚，靠当雇佣兵谋生。他仍在画漫画，仍从不署名，但那些在犯下失误后收到一幅画的年轻机师与船员，都清楚它们出自谁手；如果他们聪明，就会把它们珍藏起来。

column1:
Chris Winzar's mother cleaned the houses of the rich on Chara III while Chris played in the back streets nearby. Richer children went to private schools, while he struggled to keep his place in a rundown two-room public schoolhouse. And eventually, they went off to lucrative jobs, while he stayed at home to take care of an increasingly ill mother, reading her books. After she died in their leaking apartment, he enlisted the next day. It was the only way off Chara III for him, and the only way he could make sure his future children would have a better childhood than he did.

After basic training, he served a five-year tour at Hesperus II, where almost anybody could get cockpit experience in a BattleMech. After his tour was over, he left the LCAF and headed to Solaris VII, hoping, as so many hoped, to do well enough that he could build up a nest egg for a brighter future.

He landed on his feet on Solaris with Lion City Stables. They treated him well, but while his skills were adequate to keep him alive, he didn't have the personality to shine. After several years, his manager advised him to give up on Solaris while he still could. He was advised to head out to the Periphery where he would do well as a mercenary. His manager even provided him with a list of companies to try to join, and a letter of recommendation that spoke highly of his even temperament and marksman skills.
column2:
克里斯·温扎的母亲在查拉 III 为富人打扫宅邸，而克里斯就在附近的背街里玩耍。富人家的孩子上私立学校，他却在破旧的两间房公立学堂里苦苦保住自己的位置。最终，他们走向了收入丰厚的工作，而他却留在家中照顾日益病重的母亲，为她读书。母亲在那间漏水的公寓里去世后，他第二天就入伍了。那是他离开查拉 III 的唯一途径，也是他确保自己未来的孩子能有比他更好的童年的唯一办法。

基础训练结束后，他在赫斯佩鲁斯 II 服役五年，在那里几乎人人都能在战斗机甲里获得驾驶舱经验。服役期满后，他离开 LCAF，前往 Solaris VII，像许多人那样希望闯出足够的名堂，为更光明的未来攒下一笔积蓄。

他带着“狮城训练营”在 Solaris 站稳了脚跟。他们待他不错，但尽管他的技术足以保命，他却缺乏出彩的个性。几年之后，他的经纪人建议他趁还来得及放弃 Solaris。他被建议前往外缘区，在那里他会是个不错的雇佣兵。经纪人甚至给了他一份可以尝试加入的公司名单，还有一封推荐信，高度评价他平和的性情与射手本领。

column1:
The pilot called Christoph Nick came from... somewhere. Everybody comes from somewhere, after all. And the people he spent most of his time working with were particularly notorious for not giving a damn about somebody's past. He showed up one day on Tortuga Prime, and he knew his way around, and that was all that mattered.

For years, he worked in various pirate bands out of Tortuga, raiding and stealing, but refusing to enslave anybody. For him, being a pirate was about freedom, not power, and he had the skills to back up his point of view. As a result he had an antagonistic relationship with the ruler of Tortuga. He managed to avoid her intermittent assassination attempts and never came in direct conflict with her until he at last decided that life under Dame Trevaline no longer fit his ideals. In one very busy night, he freed two hundred slaves, stole three ships, and burned down four of Dame Trevaline's stashes... possibly all by himself.

He doesn't tell this story himself, of course. But the dregs of society in every port city recognize his name, and whispers surround him when he goes out for a drink. As for Christoph himself? He likes to stay on the move, and only works with mercenary companies without a fixed contract.
column2:
这位名叫克里斯托夫·尼克的机师来自……某个地方。毕竟人人都来自某个地方。而他大部分时间共事的人，偏偏以毫不在意别人的过去而臭名昭著。某天他出现在托尔图加主星，而且对那里门儿清，这就足够了。

多年来，他在托尔图加的各路海盗团伙中效力，劫掠偷盗，却拒绝奴役任何人。对他来说，当海盗关乎自由，而非权力，而他有本事支撑自己的观点。因此，他与托尔图加的统治者关系敌对。他成功躲过她时断时续的暗杀，也从未与她正面冲突，直到他终于认定在特雷瓦琳女爵治下的生活不再符合自己的理想。在一个极其忙碌的夜晚，他解救了二百名奴隶，偷走三艘船，烧毁了特雷瓦琳女爵的四座仓库……很可能全是他一个人干的。

当然，这个故事不是他自己讲的。但每个港口城市的社会渣滓都认得他的名字，他一出门喝酒，周围便满是低语。至于克里斯托夫本人？他喜欢四处走动，只与没有固定合约的雇佣兵公司合作。

column1:
Michael Dark was born on Coventry in the Lyran Commonwealth, the son of an overseer of Coventry Metal Works. He worked hard in school and graduated from the Coventry Military Academy near the top of his class. He was then assigned to the LCAD Sixth Guards on Hesperus II, where he saw combat against Wolf's Dragoons.

After his tour with LCAF was up, he chose to become a mercenary. Early in his mercenary career, he met Cecilia Bowens, who was serving as a MechTech and general support staff for the second company he worked for. They fell in love and married, but as they both enjoyed the mercenary lifestyle they decided to stay in the business. Now they have two children, Hugh and Julie, and Michael Dark often pitches his family to prospective employers as a package deal. Although children are unusual on a mercenary DropShip, his are well-trained and manage to make themselves useful. They're cute, too. It tends to be a good bargain.
column2:
迈克尔·达克出生在莱伦联合体的考文垂，是考文垂金属工厂一名监工的儿子。他在学业上十分努力，以接近班级第一的成绩从考文垂军事学院毕业。随后他被分配到赫斯佩鲁斯 II 的 LCAD 第六卫队，在那里与沃尔夫龙骑兵团交战。

LCAF 的服役期满后，他选择成为雇佣兵。雇佣兵生涯早期，他遇到了塞西莉亚·鲍恩斯，她当时在他效力的第二家公司担任机甲技师与一般支援人员。他们相爱并结婚，但两人都喜欢雇佣兵的生活方式，于是决定继续干这一行。如今他们有两个孩子，休与朱莉，迈克尔·达克常把全家作为一个整体打包向潜在雇主推介。虽说雇佣兵空投艇上有孩子并不寻常，但他的孩子训练有素，也能帮上忙。而且他们很可爱。这通常是一笔好买卖。

column1:
Garrat Dardai was born on Erod's Escape in the Periphery years before its official colonization by Jacob Erod. His family was part of group of slaves from a pirate planet who had escaped on a stolen ship and stumbled onto the Escape's verdant lushness. Unfortunately his own parents had both died from disease by the time he was ten years old, and he was taken in by a local orphanage run by a man who had picked up his moral code from pirates.

Young Garrat spent his teenage and young adult years picking pockets, casing houses, and fleecing the occasional visitors to the Escape who stopped to resupply. It wasn't his preferred life and he often dreamed of escape, but could never work out a way out of his situation... until one day he messed with the wrong mercenary company. Or, from a long-term perspective, the right one. After being caught red-handed stealing from the company, the commander had him thrown into their DropShip's brig and, once he was off planet, demanded he repay what he stole through hard labor. He did so, and so cheerfully that he was soon simply one of the crew. When his term with that company was up, he was free to make his own way in the Periphery, with plenty of legitimate skills to keep himself fed.
column2:
加拉特·达尔代出生在外缘区的埃罗德避难星，那时它还未被雅各布·埃罗德正式殖民。他的家族属于一群从海盗星球逃出、乘着一艘偷来的船误打误撞来到这颗郁郁葱葱的避难星的奴隶。不幸的是，他十岁时父母都已因病去世，他被当地一家孤儿院收留，而院长的道德准则都是从海盗那里学来的。

少年与青年时期，加拉特靠扒口袋、踩点民宅、偶尔从停靠补给的访客身上骗取钱财度日。这不是他想要的生活，他常梦想逃离，却始终想不出摆脱处境的办法……直到有一天，他惹错了雇佣兵公司。或者说，从长远来看，是惹对了。在偷窃公司财物时被当场拿获后，指挥官把他关进空投艇的禁闭室，等飞船离开星球后，便要他以苦役偿还所偷之物。他照做了，而且做得那么起劲，不久他就干脆成了船员中的一员。与那家公司的合约到期后，他已能凭自己在外缘区谋生，身上还带着不少正当技能可以糊口。

column1:
The son of a renowned Davion diplomat, Phaelon Halder spent his early childhood traveling with his mother as she went on the many missions created by the Third Succession War. He grew up steeped in intrigue and court drama, and learned early to confound those who were willing use children to get an edge in their negotiations.

When he was old enough, he was sent to the New Avalon Institute of Science, where he was enrolled in both the College of Military Science and the elite College of Finance. Once he graduated, he went onto the position waiting for him at the Ministry of Ways and Means.

However, five years into his ten year contract, he realized that if he spent any more time at a desk job there would be 'an unhappy Incident even Mother couldn't smooth over'. To forestall this, he manipulated his supervisor into terminating his contract. Then he promptly bought his way into a Davion-aligned mercenary company, where he enjoyed himself thoroughly until the Third Succession War ended.

When his unit was disbanded, he was still unready to settle down. He headed out to the Periphery where there was still plenty of mercenary work to be found. He stays in regular contact with his family, and will certainly return home again if there is ever a real need for him. Meanwhile, he continues to pursue the adventurous lifestyle.
column2:
作为一位著名戴维恩外交官的儿子，费伦·哈尔德幼年时常随母亲出行，奔赴第三次继承战争催生的众多任务。他在阴谋与宫廷戏码的浸染中长大，早早学会如何让那些愿意利用孩子来在谈判中占便宜的人自乱阵脚。

到了合适的年纪，他被送往新阿瓦隆科学研究所，同时进入军事科学学院与精英的金融学院就读。毕业后，他前往“方法与手段部”为他预留的职位。

然而，在十年合约做到第五年时，他意识到如果继续坐办公室，迟早会闹出一桩“连母亲都压不下去的不愉快事件”。为防患于未然，他设法让上司终止了他的合约。随后他立刻花钱买进一支与戴维恩结盟的雇佣兵公司，在那里尽情享受，直到第三次继承战争结束。

他的部队解散时，他仍未准备好安定下来。他前往外缘区，那里仍有大量雇佣兵工作可找。他与家人保持定期联系，若真有需要，他必定会回家。与此同时，他继续追求这种充满冒险的生活。

column1:
Hadden Cornichon, later known as Coldfire, was born in the Brixtana system of the Magistracy of Canopus. He grew up on the back stage of a traveling pleasure circus as part of an extended family responsible for the circus's pyrotechnic displays. While he shared his family's love for explosions, he quickly became bored with the limited creativity of the circus' well-defined show. As soon as he could talk his family into it, he and two of his cousins were traded to a new circus looking to start up its own pyrotechnics show in exchange for an apprentice dancer. The new circus focused on dramatic reenactments of historical battles — complete with BattleMech shells that required his expertise to look and sound real.

Barely two years after joining his new circus, he started knocking at the doors of the Magistracy Armed Forces, hoping to join the Magistracy Royal Guard as a MechWarrior. Since his education up until that point had been very spotty, he was repeatedly turned away in favor of more traditional candidates. But the young Coldfire knew nothing could be better than piloting a 'Mech into battle, so he buckled down and learned just enough to pass the entry exams imposed by the MAF. They gave him the training he wanted, but not the battles. As soon as his contract expired, he abandoned the peace-loving Magistracy for a place where a MechWarrior could always find work: the unclaimed, lawless systems of the Rimward Periphery.

As a pilot, Coldfire is loud, jovial, and always up for the highest-risk missions — even if the likelihood of getting paid is low. Helping others is in his blood, he claims, and if he can have a good time while doing it, even better! He loves pushing the biggest 'Mechs to their highest speeds and relishes a well-executed Death From Above. Outside of battle, he's rambunctious but usually stops short of causing real trouble to his COs. And if you ever need a pyrotechnics display, he's your man.
column2:
哈登·科尔尼雄，后来被称为“冷火”，出生在卡诺帕斯女权国的布里克斯塔纳星系。他在一支巡回享乐马戏团的后台长大，家族庞大，负责马戏团的烟火特效。虽然他与家人一样热爱爆炸，却很快对马戏团那套程式化演出中有限的创意感到厌倦。他说服家人后，便与两位表亲被交换到一家新马戏团，对方正准备开办自己的烟火秀，换来一名学徒舞者。新马戏团主打历史战役的戏剧化重演——少不了需要他的专业技艺来让战斗机甲外壳看起来、听起来都像真的。

加入新马戏团不到两年，他就开始敲女权国武装部队的大门，希望成为机甲战士加入女权国皇家卫队。由于他此前的教育十分零散，他屡次被拒，转而录取更传统的候选人。但年轻的“冷火”知道，没有比驾驶机甲投入战斗更棒的事了，于是他埋头苦学，学到刚好够通过 MAF 入学考试。他们给了他想要的训练，却没给他想要的战斗。合约一到期，他就抛下爱好和平的女权国，前往机甲战士总能找到工作的去处：外缘区边缘那些无人宣称、无法无天的星系。

作为机师，“冷火”嗓门大、性情开朗，总是抢着接风险最高的任务——哪怕拿到报酬的可能性很低。他声称助人是他骨子里的东西，如果还能顺带玩得开心，那就更好了！他喜欢把最大的机甲开到最高速，也钟爱一次执行漂亮的“天降死神”。战场之外，他喧闹聒噪，但通常不至于给上司惹出真正的麻烦。如果你需要一场烟火表演，找他就对了。

column1:
Diana Lunari, of the Outworld Alliance, grew up in the shadow of the Praxton fusion engine factories where her single mother scraped out a living. In primary school, she learned a number of safety routines, but the only ones that really mattered were the Fusion Accident drill and the Raiders drill. In her teens, she spent time developing an improved drill so that kids would have a better chance of surviving either eventuality, but nobody wanted to change what hadn't yet failed and all she accomplished was losing her chance at a scholarship. So, as soon as she could, she enlisted.

In the Alliance Grenadiers, she kept her head down for a while, pushing herself to be the toughest of the tough while learning all the protocols of her regiment. After a few years she once again felt like she'd identified some easily repairable flaws in the military machine and, cautiously, to a trusted superior, she made some suggestions. Once again, her suggestions were rejected, but this time she was transferred to the unnumbered 'shadow battalion' of the Grenadiers, where her superior promised her analysis skills would be appreciated. They were. She spent five satisfying years developing strategies for dealing with the ever-evolving pirate threat to Praxton, until internal politics she hadn't anticipated dissolved the shadow battalion and discharged most of its staff.

Since then, she's been a wanderer. At first, she lived as a tourist, getting to know more of the Periphery, but eventually, as funds ran out and her contacts dried up, she found herself signing onto a mercenary company as a MechWarrior. It isn't a career, but as she learns more about mercenary companies, she's realized that perhaps it's a stepping stone to one.
column2:
戴安娜·卢纳里来自外域联盟，在普拉克斯顿聚变引擎工厂的阴影下长大，她的单身母亲在那里艰难谋生。在小学里，她学过许多安全规程，但真正重要的只有聚变事故演练和袭掠者演练。十几岁时，她花时间设计了一套改进版演练，好让孩子们在两种情况下都有更高的存活几率，但没人愿意改动尚未出问题的事，结果她只落得失去奖学金的机会。于是，一到年龄她就入伍了。

在联盟掷弹兵团里，她先是一段时间低调行事，一边逼自己成为强者中的强者，一边学习本团的一切规程。几年后，她再次觉得自己发现了军事机器中几处容易修补的缺陷，于是谨慎地向一位可信赖的长官提出了建议。这一次，她的建议仍被否决，但她被调到了掷弹兵团的番号不明“影子营”，长官向她保证，她的分析才能在那里会得到赏识。确实如此。她度过了五年充实的时光，为应对普拉克斯顿不断演变的海盗威胁制定策略，直到一场她未曾预料的内部政治斗争解散了影子营，并遣散了大部分人员。

此后她一直在漂泊。起初她像游客一样生活，结识更多外缘区的地方，但最终资金耗尽、人脉断绝，她发现自己签进了一支雇佣兵公司当机甲战士。这不是什么事业，但在了解更多雇佣兵公司的过程中，她意识到这或许是通往某项事业的踏脚石。

column1:
Adam Doochin has only a few fragmented memories of a glittering childhood spent in a Lyran Commonwealth palace, all overshadowed by a nightmarish memory of the night his family fell. He was rescued from his nursery by a roguish 'old friend' of his mother's, who fled with him to the Periphery.

His new guardian, while committed to keeping him alive, wasn't above teaching him how to pick pockets and con the gullible. As he got older, they moved into smuggling operations, working as a team until one job went horribly wrong and his guardian sacrificed himself to cover Adam's escape.

Alone for the first time in his life, Adam drifted away from the criminal lifestyle, wandering the Periphery and re-evaluating his life from an adult's perspective. Almost accidentally, he was pulled into a criminal investigation where his childhood skills could be used for the good of others, an opportunity he welcomed.

Soon he was doing regular work as an investigator. It kept food in his mouth and a roof over his head, but after a few years in one location, restlessness once again threatened his security. When he found himself working with a MechWarrior on a case, and invited afterward to join their mercenary company as a rookie pilot, he jumped at the chance.
column2:
亚当·杜钦对在莱伦联合体宫殿中那段光鲜童年的记忆只剩下一些碎片，全都被家人覆灭那夜的噩梦记忆所遮蔽。他被母亲一位浪荡的“老朋友”从育婴室救走，带着他逃往外缘区。

他的新监护人虽然一心要保他活命，却也不介意教他如何扒口袋、如何哄骗轻信之人。随着年龄增长，他们转向走私活动，作为搭档行动，直到一次活儿出了大岔子，监护人牺牲自己掩护亚当逃走。

人生中第一次孤身一人，亚当渐渐远离犯罪生活，在外缘区漂泊，以成年人的眼光重新审视自己的人生。几乎是偶然间，他被卷入一桩刑事调查，而他童年的技能可以用于为他人谋福，他欣然接受了这个机会。

很快他便开始定期做调查员的工作。这能让他有饭吃、有屋住，但在一个地方待上几年后，不安分又一次威胁到他的安稳。当他与一名机甲战士搭档办一起案子，随后被邀请作为新手机师加入他们的雇佣兵公司时，他欣然应允。

column1:
Josh Durand started life in a rural town attached to a Federated Suns military base, the son of an enlisted man who'd mustered out early to settle down and raise a family. Josh was something of a problem child for his teachers, although he loved spending time with his family. While he achieved an adequate technical education, his heart was elsewhere, and he spent hours watching maneuvers at the military base.

As soon as he was eligible, he enlisted. While school discipline had riled him, military discipline suited him. He immediately started on a Special Forces track as a communications officer, before eventually transitioning to ops and intelligence work.

Then, as the needs of the military shifted, he underwent training to pilot BattleMechs. He served as a 'Mech pilot for the Federated Suns for five years, picking up the callsign 'Bullet Trap' for his preference for the front lines. The end of the Third Succession War saw him mustered out with all honors. While he welcomed a more peaceful era for his people and his family, he knew he could never adapt to such a life, so he headed to the Periphery to continue the work he enjoyed as a mercenary.
column2:
乔什·杜兰德出生在联邦太阳一处军事基地附属的乡村小镇，父亲是一名早早退伍、定居下来组建家庭的士兵。对老师们来说，乔什算是个问题儿童，尽管他很喜欢与家人待在一起。他虽然接受了还算合格的技术教育，心思却在别处，常常一待几个小时看军事基地里的演习。

一到合格年龄，他就入伍了。学校的纪律让他恼火，军队的纪律却适合他。他立刻走上特种部队路线，当通信军官，后来转向作战与情报工作。

随后，随着军方需求变化，他接受了驾驶战斗机甲的训练。他为联邦太阳担任机甲机师五年，因为偏爱前线而得了“子弹磁铁”这个呼号。第三次继承战争结束，他带着全部荣誉退伍。虽然他乐见自己的同胞与家人迎来更和平的时代，却知道自己永远无法适应那样的生活，于是他前往外缘区，继续以雇佣兵身份做自己喜欢的工作。

column1:
The bureaucracy of the Draconis Combine is legendary, and Aaron Doukas grew up at the heart of it, raised by parents who worked in the Bureau of Bureaucracy. By the time he was twelve, he was sick to death of paper and everything related to it. He promised himself a life of action.

Fortunately, the Combine has a place for bored boys who want a more active lifestyle. He was quickly enrolled in a military school and, according to his breeding and his aptitude scores, set on a technician track. He started out his adult career working on armored personnel carriers. But his impressive zeal studying BattleMech mechanisms — along with several very fine haiku on the subject of myomer — earned him a transfer to a MechTech division.

It wasn't enough for Aaron, who had a childhood promise to himself to fulfill. He took the exams at every opportunity, and even though his written answers were perfect and his literary allusions divine, he was never allowed the chance to take the practical exam. His childhood aptitude scores and his father's position had fixed his fate.

When he was presented with the wife that had been chosen for him, it was too much. He fled the Combine, traded a family treasure for a forged history, and soon found himself piloting a mercenary company BattleMech for the first time. It didn't fall over and he didn't die, and so he found a new life.

Now that he's proved himself in a 'Mech, the story of his escape from the Combine is a funny tale to share over drinks. But the touch of the Dragon lingers and, perhaps, just a little, he misses the family he left behind.
column2:
德拉科尼斯联合体的官僚体系堪称传奇，而亚伦·杜卡斯正是在其核心长大，父母都在官僚事务局工作。到十二岁时，他已对纸张及一切与之相关的东西厌恶至极。他发誓要过一种充满行动的生活。

幸运的是，联合体为那些渴望更活跃生活方式的厌烦男孩留了位置。他很快被送入一所军事学校，并根据其出身与能力测评分数，被安排走技师路线。他的成年职业生涯始于修理装甲运兵车。但他在研究战斗机甲机构方面展现出的惊人热情——以及几首关于肌纤维的极佳俳句——为他赢得了转入机甲技师部门的调令。

这对亚伦来说还不够，他还有儿时对自己的承诺要兑现。他一有机会就参加考试，尽管他的笔试答案完美无缺、文学典故堪称神妙，他却从未获准参加实操考试。他童年的能力测评分数与父亲的职位已经决定了他的命运。

当那个被选定给他的妻子被送到他面前时，他再也受不了了。他逃离联合体，用一件家族珍宝换了一份伪造履历，很快便第一次驾驶着一台雇佣兵公司的战斗机甲。它没有倒下，他也没有死，于是他找到了新的人生。

既然他已在机甲中证明了自己，他从联合体出逃的经历就成了酒桌上的趣谈。但“龙”的触感仍挥之不去，也许，只是也许，他有些想念自己抛下的家人。

column1:
Kenrik was born on Bellevue in the Federated Suns, to parents who were executed promptly after his birth for failing to keep oaths made to a local crime lord. Kenrik himself was adopted into the crime lord's extensive 'family', and from his earliest years was employed doing 'errands' for the family matriarch.

As he grew, so did his 'family'. By the time he was an adult, they were a 'syndicate', and he was running smuggling operations between cities, escorting the convoys in a BattleMech that had been 'adopted' just like him. Eventually, a long-term investigation fingered him, and the family matriarch shipped him off-planet to Solaris VII, to protect him as well as herself.

On Solaris VII, under instructions to create a new identity for himself, he settled into training to join a gladiatorial stable. While there, he dueled and defeated a spunky younger pilot who quickly decided he was her new mentor. When he received word from Bellevue that it was time for him to move on from Solaris VII, the kid followed him all the way out to the Periphery.

Intermittently, they work together now. When they aren't on the same contracts, he answers her mail. Occasionally. Sometimes. But the letters from Bellevue telling him he can come home again, those, he ignores.
column2:
肯里克出生在联邦太阳的贝尔维尤，他的父母在他出生后不久便因未能履行对当地一名犯罪头目的誓言而被处决。肯里克本人被收养进这位犯罪头目庞大的“家族”，从幼年起就为家族的女家长跑“差事”。

随着他长大，他的“家族”也在壮大。到他成年时，他们已是一个“辛迪加”，而他负责运营城市间的走私活动，驾驶一台和他一样被“收养”的战斗机甲护送车队。最终，一场长期调查揪出了他，家族女家长把他送离星球，前往 Solaris VII，既是为保护他，也是为保护自己。

在 Solaris VII，他遵照指示为自己打造新身份，安顿下来受训，准备加入一家角斗训练营。在那里，他与一名活力十足的年轻机师决斗并将其击败，对方很快认定他就是自己的新导师。当他从贝尔维尤收到消息，该离开 Solaris VII 了，那个小伙子一路跟着他来到了外缘区。

如今他们时断时续地一起工作。不在同一份合约时，他会回她的信。偶尔。有时候。但来自贝尔维尤、告诉他可以回家的那些信，他一概不理。

column1:
Andaelas was born on Meacham in the Lyran Commonwealth, to parents who died in the endless conflict with the Draconis Combine before he could even be named. One of the many orphanages of Meacham took him in and he was given the house name 'Alistair' for his own. Growing up, he was taught to be proud of his parents' sacrifice, and expected to follow in their footsteps when he came of age.

When that day came, they conscripted him before he could volunteer. With poor equipment and very little training, he was sent to the Draconis Front, a meat grinder where his dedication to the Commonwealth was tested time and again. Mostly, it held.

Everybody who survived was promoted, so as to inspire next batch of conscripts. But promotion just meant more challenges. Finally, his squadron of foot soldiers was thrown against a lance of BattleMechs without backup. When Andaelas climbed into a nearly crippled Catapult and turned its missiles on the enemy DropShip delivering yet more troops, he knew he could never go back to being a groundpounder again.

His loyalty to the Lyran Commonwealth had become ambivalent as well. He couldn't shake his pride for his planet and his people, but he was too aware of the pointlessness of the endless war and sacrifice. At last, with the full support of his troubled commanders, he left the LCAF and went to the Periphery, looking for a cause he could once again believe in.
column2:
安达拉斯出生在莱伦联合体的米查姆，他的父母在与德拉科尼斯联合体无休止的冲突中丧生，那时他甚至还没来得及取名。米查姆众多孤儿院中的一家收留了他，并给他取了“阿利斯泰尔”这个家族姓氏。成长过程中，他被教导要为父母的牺牲感到骄傲，并被期望在成年后追随他们的脚步。

那一天到来时，他还没来得及自愿报名，他们就已经把他征召了。他带着糟糕的装备和极少的训练被送往前线，那里是一座绞肉机，他对联合体的忠诚在那里一次又一次受到考验。大体上，忠诚守住了。

活下来的人都被提拔，以激励下一批新兵。但提拔只意味着更多挑战。最终，他的步兵小队在没有支援的情况下被投入对抗一个小队的战斗机甲。当安达拉斯爬进一台近乎瘫痪的 Catapult，将其导弹射向正在运送更多部队的敌方空投艇时，他知道自己再也回不去当步兵了。

他对莱伦联合体的忠诚也变得矛盾起来。他无法摆脱对自己星球与同胞的自豪，但他太清楚这场无休止的战争与牺牲何其毫无意义。最终，在那些同样烦恼的指挥官们的全力支持下，他离开 LCAF 前往外缘区，寻找一个他能再次相信的事业。

column1:
Coming from a sleepy agricultural world of no strategic value in the Free Worlds League, Astraeus Veisi was the first member of his family in 75 years to express any interest in getting off-planet. Astraeus decided young, staring up at the sky, that he was going to the stars. It wasn't so much that life was hard on the farm, but that nothing he did there would ever really matter.

 When he was old enough, he enrolled in a local tech school, specializing in military equipment, because maintaining tractors wasn't that different from maintaining tanks. 'Mechs were more challenging, but the principles were the same, and repairing 'Mechs was his ticket off the farm.

He signed on with a small mercenary company as a tech, but took advantage of the informal setting and his personal relationship with the commander to get some cockpit time. When one too many of the regular pilots was benched, he had his opportunity to show what he could do as a pilot.

Once the status quo returned, he knew he couldn't return to being just a MechTech. He said a fond farewell to the company that had lifted him to the stars and set out on a career as a freelance agent. He drifted from one temporary company to another, looking for someplace where he'd fit as well as he did in his first company - and still be able to pilot a 'Mech of his own.
column2:
阿斯特赖乌斯·维西来自自由世界联盟一个毫无战略价值的宁静农业世界，是家族七十五年来第一个表现出想离开星球意愿的成员。阿斯特赖乌斯年少时仰望天空，便下定决心要前往群星。倒不是说农场生活有多苦，而是他在那里做的任何事都永远不会真正有意义。

到了合适的年纪，他进入当地一所技术学校，专攻军用装备，因为保养拖拉机与保养坦克并没有太大区别。机甲更具挑战性，但原理相同，而修理机甲正是他离开农场的门票。

他以技师身份签进一支小型雇佣兵公司，但利用那里非正式的氛围以及自己与指挥官的个人关系，捞到了一些驾驶舱时间。当常规机师中又一个躺进医务室时，他得到了展示自己驾驶本领的机会。

一旦常态恢复，他就知道自己再也不能只当个机甲技师了。他向那家把他送上群星的公司温情告别，踏上自由代理人的职业生涯。他从一家临时公司漂到另一家，寻找一个既能像在最初那家公司一样合得来、又能让自己驾驶属于自己机甲的地方。

column1:
Peter Chang was born on Old Kentucky, in the Capellan Confederation, to an established family of skilled metalworkers. He preferred books to metallurgy, and his supportive family encouraged him to work hard and attend a local vocational school after his militia training. When he graduated at the top of his class and was accepted into Sian University, they couldn't have been prouder.

They were less pleased when they realized he intended to study literature and philosophy rather than something useful, but Peter didn't care. Having achieved a place in academia, he fully intended to stay there. He underestimated the viciousness of the tenure track, though. Soon, via maneuverings only sketchily recorded, he was strongly encouraged to travel, and travel far.

Relying on a small stipend provided in exchange for his silence, he explored the Inner Sphere and discovered that adventure was more to his taste than academia anyhow. On one journey, he found himself piloting a Marauder — and found that he was good at it. When he received word that his benefactor had died and his stipend would no longer be provided, he knew exactly what to do next: mercenary work, out in the Periphery.

He's something of a curiosity among MechWarriors, with his academic background and extensive civilian travels. But that very background makes him useful in a lance with more traditional MechWarriors, so he's found plenty of work since he first sat in that Marauder.
column2:
彼得·张出生在卡佩兰联盟的老肯塔基，家境殷实，世代是技艺精湛的金属工匠。比起冶金，他更喜欢书本，而支持他的家人鼓励他努力读书，并在民兵训练结束后进入当地一所职业学校。当他以班级第一毕业并被暹罗大学录取时，他们再骄傲不过了。

当他们意识到他打算研读文学与哲学，而不是什么实用的东西时，他们就没那么高兴了，但彼得并不在意。既然已在学术界争得一席之地，他打算就此扎根。然而他低估了终身教职之路的凶险。不久，经过一些记录语焉不详的运作，他被强烈建议去旅行，而且要去得很远。

靠着为换取他沉默而提供的少量津贴，他游历内天体，并发现冒险比学术更合自己口味。在一次旅途中，他发现自己驾驶着一台 Marauder——并发现自己很擅长这个。当他收到消息说他那位资助人已去世、津贴不再发放时，他非常清楚下一步该做什么：去外缘区当雇佣兵。

在机甲战士中间，他算是个奇人，因为他的学术背景和丰富的平民旅行经历。但正是这样的背景，让他在与传统机甲战士同队时显得有用，所以自从第一次坐进那台 Marauder 以来，他一直不缺活干。

column1:
For many, being born into the nobility of the Capellan Confederation means limitless possibilities, but for Abe Chung, it was only a burden. One of far, far too many cousins, his entire life was ordered for him and he was only ever looked at to be corrected.
