“她对我说，正是因为你的贡献，她才终于取得了所需的突破。我会为她的出色工作寄去一点奖金，是我在外围星域时的东西。”

“哦，还有一件事。”凯尔顿了顿，捻着胡须。“如果你哪天听到关于幽灵机甲的传闻，别去纠正他们。”全息影像闪烁熄灭，凯尔消失了。

column1:
You're not inclined to trust anybody right now, open hand or no. You keep your own pistol out. "Stay where you are."

His friendly smile fades. "I don't want to fight you, Commander."

"The feeling's mutual. So you go your way and we'll go ours and," turning to Sumire, "to hell with future Star League ruins tours."

"I keep saying we should bring the 'Mechs...'" Sumire mutters, but the other tourist just gives you an informal salute and steps out of your way, allowing you to return safely to the Leopard.

"If you change your mind, look up [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTest9],Test9]] in the local Hiring Hall. If you think I'm handy with my pistols, you'll really like what I can do with a pair of autocannons. But hey, if not now, I'm sure we'll meet again. The Periphery is smaller than you think."
column2:
你现在不想相信任何人，无论对方是否摊开手掌。你握着自己的手枪不放。“站住别动。”

他友善的笑容消失了。“我不想和你打，指挥官。”

“彼此彼此。所以你走你的路，我们走我们的，”你转向澄丽，“至于未来的星际联盟废墟观光，去他的。”

“我一直说我们该把机甲带来……”澄丽嘟囔道，但那位同行的游客只是向你随意行了个礼，让开了路，让你安全返回“豹”式。

“如果你改变主意，就去当地的招募大厅找 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTest9],Test9]]。如果你觉得我用枪还算顺手，那你一定会喜欢我用双联自动炮的本事。不过嘛，就算现在不行，我相信我们还会再见。外围星域比你想的要小。”

column1:
I'd like to meet him myself, you admit. Yang grins and flags the pilot over.

Despite the reckless abandon of his fighting style, he doesn't seem drunk, just exuberant. He introduces himself as [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreArchangel],Archangel]], and gladly takes Yang up on the offer of a few drinks.

When he finds out you command a 'Mech mercenary company, he buys the next round himself and starts feeling you out for any openings in your crew.

"Soon as we're done here, I'm going to register with the local Hiring Hall. But hey, if you don't have an opening now, that's fine, I think it's time for me to leave this rock, anyway. I'm sure we'll meet again."
column2:
“我想亲自见见他，”你承认道。杨咧嘴一笑，把那位机师招了过来。

尽管他的战斗风格鲁莽放肆，他看上去并不像醉了，只是精力过剩。他自我介绍叫 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreArchangel],大天使]]，并欣然接受了杨请几杯的提议。

当他得知你指挥着一支机甲雇佣兵连时，他自己买了下一轮酒，开始试探你的队伍里有没有空缺。

“这边的事一完，我就去当地招募大厅登记。不过嘛，如果你现在没有空缺，也没关系，反正我觉得我该离开这块石头了。我相信我们还会再见。”

column1: option one
column2: 选项一

column1:
You clap Yang on the back. "I'm going to get our supplies back on the ship, but you have fun. Let me know if you learn anything useful."

Twelve hours later, you have to send Darius to get Yang out of the local lock-up. Apparently Yang's new pal [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreArchangel],Archangel]] managed to incite a bar-wide brawl.

Despite still being drunk off his ass, the Chief remains firm in his opinion that 'Drinks With Archangel' was worth it. "Boss, we need to go to the Hiring Hall and find Archangel before we leave the system. I want to see what he can do in one of our 'Mechs."

"Perhaps," you answer. "But I get the feeling that this rock has gotten too small for your friend. If we don't hire him today, I bet we'll run into him again."
column2:
你拍了拍杨的背。“我要把补给运回船上，你玩得开心。学到什么有用的东西就告诉我。”

十二小时后，你不得不派达里乌斯去把杨从当地拘留所里弄出来。显然杨的新朋友 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreArchangel],大天使]] 成功煽动了一场整间酒吧的大混战。

尽管仍然醉得不成样子，这位总技师依然坚持己见，认为“和大天使喝酒”是值得的。“老板，我们得在离开这个星系之前去招募大厅找大天使。我想看看他在我们的机甲里能有什么表现。”

“也许吧，”你回答。“但我有种感觉，这块石头对你的朋友来说已经太小了。今天我们就算不雇他，我打赌我们还会再遇到他。”

column1: option 1
column2: 选项 1

column1: Chief, we still have to finish the supply run. And since you've spent half the day having fun, why don't you go do that while I get to know this pilot. "Sir, yes sir!" Yang mutters in a mockery of military formality. Yang introduces you and then begs off to do his duties. He runs his hand longingly along the side of the AgroMech on his way back to town. The pilot introduces himself as [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreArchangel],Archangel]]. Despite the reckless abandon of his fighting style, he doesn't seem drunk, just exuberant. Nevertheless he gladly takes you up on the offer of a drink. When he finds out you command a 'Mech mercenary company, he buys the next round himself and starts feeling you out for any openings in your crew. "Soon as we're done here, I'm going to register with the local Hiring Hall. But hey, if you don't have an opening now, that's fine, I think it's time for me to leave this rock, anyway. I'm sure we'll meet again."
column2: “总技师，我们还得把补给采购跑完。既然你已经玩掉了半天，不如你去把活干完，顺便让我认识认识这位机师。” “是，长官！”杨学着军中的正式腔调嘟囔道。杨为你们做了介绍，然后就告退去干自己的活了。回镇的路上，他恋恋不舍地用手抚过那台农业机甲的侧面。 那位机师自我介绍叫 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreArchangel],大天使]]。尽管他的战斗风格鲁莽放肆，他看上去并不像醉了，只是精力过剩。不过他还是欣然接受了请喝一杯的提议。 当他得知你指挥着一支机甲雇佣兵连时，他自己买了下一轮酒，开始试探你的队伍里有没有空缺。 “这边的事一完，我就去当地招募大厅登记。不过嘛，如果你现在没有空缺，也没关系，反正我觉得我该离开这块石头了。我相信我们还会再见。”

column1: Sumire takes the Leopard for a low altitude circuit of the moon, relaying her findings back to the Argo's computers. Over the course of the week she studies the collected data, then delivers her report.\n\n"Commander, we didn't find anything radical, but we did get decent data on some more obscure parts of the landscape. If we're lucky, we'll be able to offset the cost of acquiring the scans. Full disclosure, though… I'm not feeling very lucky at the moment."
column2: 澄丽驾驶“豹”式绕这颗卫星低空飞行了一圈，把发现传回 Argo 号的计算机。这一周里她研究收集到的数据，随后提交了报告。\n\n“指挥官，我们没发现什么惊人的东西，但确实拿到了一些关于地貌中较冷门区域的可靠数据。运气好的话，我们能抵掉获取这些扫描图的成本。不过提前说明……我现在感觉不太走运。”

column1: Darius demands the first agenda item in the morning briefing. "Commander, I've secured an invitation to the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlackMarket],Black Markets]] here in the Periphery." Yang claps Darius on the back. "About time! You've been haggling and calling in favors for months. It was kinda like you enjoyed it." Darius smirks. "Who, me? Well... persuading that cabal of crooks, merchants and politicians wasn't boring." Sumire cuts through the joviality. "Don't forget the pirates. Your cabal may vote us in, but our history with their primary customers is setting our membership fee." Dr. Murad frowns. "Improvements to the Argo aren't getting any cheaper. Surely we can just continue looting what we need?"
column2: 达里乌斯要求把第一项议程放在早间简报的开头。“指挥官，我拿到了一份进入外围星域 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlackMarket],黑市]] 的邀请。” 杨拍了拍达里乌斯的背。“终于！你为了这事讨价还价、四处求人情，折腾了好几个月。看着倒像是你还挺享受的。”达里乌斯一咧嘴。“我？嗯……说服那帮骗子、商人和政客结成的联盟可不无聊。” 澄丽打断了这份欢快。“别忘了还有海盗。你那个联盟也许能投票让我们加入，但我们和他们主要客户的过往交情正在决定我们的会费。” 穆拉德博士皱起眉头。“Argo 号的升级可一点都不便宜。我们就不能继续抢我们需要的吗？”

column1: the risky option
column2: 高风险选项

column1: Darius opens the morning briefing with a familiar refrain. "Commander, I've persuaded the cabal that controls access to the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlackMarket],Black Markets]] to consider, again, our possible membership." Sumire laughs. "They don't usually make that offer more than once. Times must be desperate." Yang gasps in feigned insult. "Or Darius is just that good of a negotiator!" "Our reputation with the pirates in the Periphery is still a gating factor." Dr. Murad points out. "The Black Market isn't going to offend their best customers. What is their asking price this time?"
column2: 达里乌斯以一句熟悉的开场白开启了早间简报。“指挥官，我已经说服掌控 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlackMarket],黑市]] 准入的那伙人，重新考虑我们的入会可能。” 澄丽笑了。“他们一般不会给出第二次机会。看来世道是真的很艰难。”杨倒抽一口气，装出被冒犯的样子。“或者达里乌斯就是这么会谈判！” “我们在外围星域海盗中的名声依然是个关卡。”穆拉德博士指出。“黑市不会得罪他们最好的客户。这次他们要什么价？”

column1: In the morning briefing, Darius cautiously begins with, "Commander, after our earlier missteps with the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlackMarket],Black Markets]], I thought that we were banned for good... but what can I say? Money talks." Yang claps his hands. "You can't keep Iron Beard down! Am I right?" Sumire shakes her head. "Are we really going down this road again? How much do they want this time?"
column2: 在早间简报上，达里乌斯谨慎地开口道：“指挥官，鉴于我们早先与 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlackMarket],黑市]] 的失手，我以为我们已经被永久封杀了……但怎么说呢？有钱能使鬼推磨。” 杨拍了拍手。“铁胡子可压不下去！我说得对吧？” 澄丽摇了摇头。“我们真的要再走这条路吗？这次他们要多少？”

column1:
In the morning briefing, Darius is unusually excited. "Commander, our pirate friends have vouched for us with the cabal that controls access to the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlackMarket],Black Markets]] in the Periphery. They'll even waive the usual membership fee!"

Sumire chuckles darkly. "We keep such sterling company. Considering our reputation with the Great Houses, though, it's hard to find welcoming ports these days."

Dr. Murard reluctantly agrees. "The Black Markets are almost our only option for new supplies. It's got to be worth the extra scrutiny we'll receive from the system authorities."
column2:
在早间简报上，达里乌斯异常兴奋。“指挥官，我们的海盗朋友已经向掌控外围星域 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlackMarket],黑市]] 准入的那伙人替我们作了担保。他们甚至愿意免掉通常的入会费！”

澄丽阴郁地轻笑。“我们交往的尽是些了不起的人物。不过考虑到我们在大贵族家族中的名声，这年头想找个欢迎我们的港口还真难。”

穆拉德博士勉强同意。“黑市差不多是我们唯一能搞到新补给的渠道了。为此多受些星系当局的盘查也是值得的。”

column1:
As you arrive at the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlackMarket],Black Market]] rendezvous, you realize, too late, that something isn't right. There's a burst of lights and sirens as the local authorities surround your group.

A senior officer steps forward. "This can be easy or hard, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. Turn over the access codes, secret handshakes, and whatever other tradecraft you use to gain access to the Market, and you'll walk away scot-free, with ¢100,000 C-Bills in your pocket."

She crosses her arms in smug determination. "Or you can pretend you don't know anything and pay a frankly staggering fine for wasting our time."
column2:
你抵达 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlackMarket],黑市]] 的接头地点时，才迟迟意识到事情不对劲。一阵灯光与警笛大作，当地官府包围了你们一伙。

一名高级军官走上前来。“这件事可以很简单，也可以很难，{COMMANDER.LastName} 指挥官。交出准入代码、秘密握手暗号，以及你用于进入黑市的其他一切门道，你就可以毫发无伤地走开，口袋里多出 ¢100,000 C-Bills。”

她得意地抱起双臂。“或者，你也可以装作什么都不知道，然后为我们浪费的时间付出一笔大得吓人的罚款。”

column1:
At the sound of the door sliding open, Darius and Yang turn in unison to face you.

"Commander," Darius intones, his voice tinged with exasperation. "The colony on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} has requested our help--"

Yang cuts in—he's practically giddy with excitement. "Boss, they have [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAgroMech],AgroMechs]]! Herders, Farmhands… even a CattleMaster! These are some of the wonkiest machines ever to walk on two legs. You've gotta let me work on them."

Darius' frown deepens. "This is not the best use of our time or resources."

"Come on, Boss." Yang clasps his hands, pleading. "AgroMechs!"
column2:
听到门滑开的声音，达里乌斯和杨同时转身面向你。

“指挥官，”达里乌斯开口，语气里带着明显的烦躁。“{TGT_SYSTEM.Name} 的殖民地请求我们帮忙——”

杨打断了他——他几乎兴奋得发抖。“老板，他们有 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAgroMech],农业机甲]]！Herder、Farmhand……甚至还有一台 CattleMaster！这些都是有史以来最古怪的两足机械。你一定得让我去修修它们。”

达里乌斯的眉头皱得更深了。“这可不是我们时间和资源的最佳用法。”

“来吧，老板。”杨合起双手恳求道。“农业机甲啊！”

column1: Don't let the stubby 'Urbie' fool you—it may look like a walking trash can, but it can mount heavy armor and a grown-up-sized Autocannon. R60s aren't known for their speed, but they are very useful if you can draw the enemy into their firing range.\n\nDrop Cost Multiplier: 0.97.
column2: 别被矮墩墩的“乌尔比”骗了——它看起来像只走路的垃圾桶，却能装上重型装甲和成人尺寸的自动炮。R60 系列不以速度闻名，但如果你能把敌人引到它们的射程内，它们就非常有用。\n\n投放成本系数：0.97。

column1:
A few days later, you're back in the Command room, facing Yang and Darius again. You rub your temples, hoping you heard wrong. "Explain that one more time, Yang."

Yang shifts uncomfortably. "Well, Boss, we were showing the colonists just what those AgroMechs could do. Their top speed is… well, anyhow. The crew got a little competitive, way too close to one of their barns. And, uh, those machines don't stop as well as a BattleMech. The barn didn't have a chance when those behemoths plowed into it."

You sigh. "Okay, make it right, Darius. Pay for the barn and replenish the lost supplies."
column2:
几天后，你回到指挥室，再次面对杨和达里乌斯。你揉着太阳穴，但愿自己听错了。“再解释一遍，杨。”

杨不安地动了动。“嗯，老板，我们正在给殖民者展示那些农业机甲能干什么。它们的最高速度……呃，总之。弟兄们有点好胜，离他们的一座谷仓太近了。而且，呃，那些机器刹车可不如战斗机甲。那些巨兽撞上去的时候，谷仓一点机会都没有。”

你叹了口气。“好吧，去把事情处理好，达里乌斯。赔谷仓的钱，再把损失的补给补上。”

column1: Go for the supplies
column2: 选择补给

column1: Go for the money
column2: 选择金钱

column1: Sumire calls a special briefing about a communique from a nearby transport. "Their crew has contracted a virulent case of the Periphery Pox..." She leans in. "But the captain knows that we have access to the local [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlackMarket],Black Market]], and that the Market has some experimental antivirals for sale. They'll cover the cost and an extra ¢50,000 for our trouble. We just need to do the footwork." Darius scowls. "The Black Markets aren't risk-free for us. The authorities could intervene and cause problems. Or this could all be a set up." Dr. Murad bristles. "Spacers should stick together, Commander. We have access to the Market; we should use it."
column2: 澄丽召集了一次特别简报，内容是关于附近一艘空投艇发来的通讯。“他们的船员染上了一种凶猛的外围星域痘……”她凑近了些。“但是，船长知道我们能进入当地的 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlackMarket],黑市]]，而且黑市有一些实验性抗病毒药物在售。他们会承担费用，外加 ¢50,000 作为我们的辛苦钱。我们只需要跑一趟腿。” 达里乌斯沉下脸。“黑市对我们并非没有风险。当局可能介入并制造麻烦。或者这整个都可能是个局。” 穆拉德博士不悦道。“太空人应该团结一致，指挥官。我们能用得上黑市，就该用。”

column1:
Yang's eager face makes it a little harder to strike a stern tone. "Chief, I'm going to give you this shipment. But," you add forcefully, "this time, I don't want to find half of your technicians in the MedBay. I mean it."

Two days later, Yang shows up unannounced in your quarters. There's sweat on his brow, and his mechanical hand fiddles with an oil-soaked rag. "Boss… I swear it wasn't the Triple-F's fault. We cooked those patties until they were practically charcoal briquettes!"

You unconsciously try to rub the stress out of your forehead. "What's the bottom line?"

Yang considers for a moment. "I've scheduled shorter and more frequent shifts, and I've set up a couple rows of emergency latrines. Our efficiency should only be negatively impacted for a week, Boss. Tops."
column2:
杨那热切的脸让你很难摆出严厉的语气。“总技师，这批货我交给你。但是，”你加重语气补充道，“这次我不想发现你的技师有一半躺进医疗舱。我说真的。”

两天后，杨没打招呼就出现在你的舱室。他额头冒汗，机械手摆弄着一块浸满机油的抹布。“老板……我发誓这不是三重F的错。我们把那些肉饼煎得几乎成了炭块！”

你无意识地想把手上的压力从额头上揉掉。“所以结果如何？”

杨想了想。“我已经把班次改得更短更频繁，还立了两排应急厕所。我们的效率最多只会受影响一周，老板。绝对不超过一周。”

column1: morale option
column2: 士气选项

column1:
An idea pops into your head. "Chief… you're kind of an expert on Triple-F burgers. Do you think that the hydroponics garden has what you'd need to recreate the real thing?"

Yang's face takes on the stony expression that you've come to associate with complicated refit orders. "From what I've heard, this stuff is basically whale meat, so I'll have to improvise… but yes. Challenge accepted!"

By the end of the week, Yang and his MechTechs had raided the garden and retrofitted a blast furnace into a makeshift grill. Somebody even decorated the mess hall in Triple-F's trademark colors.

While only those who've traveled in Davion space can attest to the accuracy of the burgers, everyone agrees that they're delicious.
column2:
一个念头忽然冒了出来。“总技师……你算得上是三重F汉堡的专家了。你觉得水培园里有你需要的材料，能还原出真正的味道吗？”

杨的脸上浮现出你早已熟悉的、接到复杂改装订单时那种坚毅表情。“据我所知，这东西基本上就是鲸肉，所以我得临场发挥……不过行。接受挑战！”

到周末，杨和他的机甲技师们已经洗劫了水培园，还把一座爆破炉改装成了临时烤架。有人甚至把食堂装饰成了三重F的招牌配色。

虽然只有去过戴维恩地盘的人才能证实那些汉堡是否地道，但所有人都一致认为它们很好吃。

column1: You shake your head. "I want to stay focused on the contracts available here in [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]]. Maybe another time."\n\nSumire slowly nods in agreement. "Of course, Commander. I'll keep watching the opportunities as they zip by." She turns on her heel and briskly marches the other direction.
column2: 你摇了摇头。“我想把精力放在 [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] 这里可接的合约上。也许下次吧。”\n\n澄丽缓缓点头表示同意。“当然，指挥官。我会继续留意那些一闪而过的机会。”她转过身，快步朝另一个方向走去。

column1: Sumire falls in beside you as you depart the mess. "Did you notice the odd moon around this planet? It's quite the point of interest for Periphery scientists… they just can't get enough data on it."\n\nShe eyes you speculatively. "If we bring the Argo close enough, I could take some sensor readings. Could make for a little easy money. Or, hey, here's an idea, I could take the Leopard down to the surface to do more extensive research. What do you think?"
column2: 你离开食堂时，澄丽走到你身旁。“你注意到这颗行星周围那颗古怪的卫星了吗？外围星域的科学家对它相当感兴趣……他们怎么也搞不够关于它的数据。”\n\n她揣度地看着你。“如果我们把 Argo 号开得足够近，我可以做一些传感器读数。说不定能轻松赚点小钱。或者，嘿，我有个主意，我可以驾驶“豹”式降落到表面做更广泛的研究。你觉得怎么样？”

column1: Darius opens the morning briefing with a scowl on his face. "We picked up new supplies a few weeks ago, and we're just now opening some of the crates of machine tools. And, well, I can't believe this has happened again, but…" Yang practically explodes from his chair. "We have more frozen [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTripleFBurger],Triple-F Burger]] meat! Do you know how hard this stuff is to come by in the Periphery?" Dr. Murad sighs audibly. "Please tell me that the refrigeration was still operational. I don't want a repeat of last time." "Don't worry, Doc—my team will take care of the goods." Yang flashes you a winning smile. "What do you say, Commander? Burgers on the menu?"
column2: 达里乌斯脸上带着怒容开始了早间简报。“几周前我们进了一批新补给，现在我们才打开其中几箱机床。然后，嗯，我真不敢相信这种事又发生了，可是……” 杨几乎是从椅子上弹了起来。“我们又有冷冻的 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTripleFBurger],三重F汉堡]] 肉饼了！你知道这东西在外围星域有多难搞到吗？” 穆拉德博士大声叹了口气。“请告诉我冷冻装置还在运转。我可不想上次那样的事重演。” “别担心，博士——我的人会照顾好这些货的。”杨冲你露出一个自信的笑容。“你说呢，指挥官？汉堡要不要上菜单？”

column1: As Darius enters the morning briefing room, he slams the door behind him. "Those filthy, no good, back-stabbing... pirates!" Yang tries desparately to keep a straight face. "How do you really feel, Darius?" The XO takes a deep breath. "If we want to retain our access to the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlackMarket],Black Markets]], we're being asked, none-too-politely, to pay another membership fee."
column2: 达里乌斯走进早间简报室时，把门重重甩上。“那些肮脏、没用的、背后捅刀的……海盗！” 杨拼命憋住笑。“你到底什么感受，达里乌斯？” 这位副指挥官深吸一口气。“如果我们想保住进入 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlackMarket],黑市]] 的门路，他们就要我们——而且很没礼貌地——再交一次会费。”

column1:
As Darius enters the morning briefing room, he slams the door behind him.  "Why can't we just have nice things? The agents who represent the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlackMarket],Black Market]] want us to pay the membership fee. Again."

Sumire sighs, "I suppose it was too much to hope for permanent membership. No honor among thieves, huh?"

Yang shakes his head. "Now Sumire, don't go calling us thieves. We're just entrepreneurs, right?"

Darius ignores both of them. "Commander, what do you want to do?"
column2:
达里乌斯走进早间简报室时，把门重重甩上。“我们为什么就不能有点好事？代表 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlackMarket],黑市]] 的那些代理人要我们交会费。又是。”

澄丽叹道：“我本来就不该指望永久会籍。盗贼之间果然没有信义，是吧？”

杨摇了摇头。“澄丽啊，别叫我们盗贼。我们只是创业者，对吧？”

达里乌斯把两人都当空气。“指挥官，你想怎么做？”

column1: Restrict card games to Barracks
column2: 限制纸牌游戏只能在营房进行

column1: Darius grants shore leave to several of the most deserving, or perhaps the most disruptive, MechWarriors. \n\nRumors of the crazy things they got up to on [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] make their way to the senior staff, but when they return, Darius imposes tighter discipline than before. The time off results in compliance with few further complaints.
column2: 达里乌斯批准了几名最该受奖——或者也许是最爱闹事——的机甲战士上岸休假。\n\n他们在 [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] 上干的荒唐事传到高级军官耳中，但等他们回来时，达里乌斯实施了比以往更严格的纪律。这次休假换来的是服从，几乎再没有抱怨。

column1: Allow card games on the mess deck
column2: 允许在食堂甲板玩纸牌

column1: Vasquez's ragtag crew of soldiers arrive with little fanfare. As Yang escorts them to the Mech Bay to go through the selection of available supplies, they stare in awe at the Argo. Vasquez limps over and offers his hand. "You've got a very interesting bird here, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. Do I get a tour?" Unexpectedly, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] appears at your shoulder. "Commander?" {SCN_MW.SUBJ_C}{SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'re|Default:'s} talking to Vasquez. Vasquez is as surprised as you are. "I never expected to see you again! I'm glad to see that you've landed here, though." He turns to you. "{COMMANDER.Callsign} has always did have a talent for working with the best."
column2: 巴斯克斯那帮杂牌士兵到来时没引起什么动静。杨带他们去机甲舱挑选可用的补给，他们敬畏地盯着 Argo 号。 巴斯克斯跛着脚走过来伸出手。“你这儿有只很有意思的大鸟，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。能带我参观一下吗？” 出乎意料地，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 出现在你肩旁。“指挥官？”{SCN_MW.SUBJ_C}{SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'re|Default:'s} 正在和巴斯克斯说话。 巴斯克斯和你一样惊讶。“我真没想到还能见到你！不过很高兴看到你落脚在这里。”他转向你。“{COMMANDER.Callsign} 一直有和最强的家伙共事的天赋。”

column1: I'm sorry, Vasquez, but even for the sake of old times, I just can't help you right now.\n\nThere's a lengthy pause on the other end of the line. When Vasquez finally responds, there is ice in his voice. "Well, I guess I won't be owing you any favors. That's… disappointing, but I suppose you have to look after your own. Good luck out there."
column2: “抱歉，巴斯克斯，但即使看在旧日情分上，我现在也没法帮你。”\n\n电话另一端沉默了很久。当巴斯克斯终于回应时，他的声音冷得像冰。“好吧，看来我不会欠你什么人情了。真是……令人失望，但我想你也得照顾自己人。祝你在外面好运。”

column1: Blaring klaxons interrupt an otherwise quiet morning routine as several fast-moving ships appear, pacing the Argo. Darius broadcasts their hail to the bridge. "You're flying through our space, strangers. It's awfully dangerous out here. Just awful, especially for a ragged-looking ship like… the Argo, is it? Tell you what, we'll provide you with a safe passage. For a price, of course." While you consider your options, Sumire pipes up. "Commander, if you can buy me some time, I could do a rapid fire-up of the Leopard. That'll teach them not to mess with us."
column2: 刺耳的警报打断了本来平静的晨间例行工作，几艘高速飞船出现，与 Argo 号并速同行。达里乌斯把他们的呼叫广播到了舰桥。 “你们正在飞越我们的空域，陌生人。这外面可危险得很。非常危险，尤其对一艘像……Argo 号这样破破烂烂的船来说，是吧？这样吧，我们可以为你们提供安全通行。当然，要付钱。” 当你考虑选项时，澄丽开口了。“指挥官，如果你能替我争取点时间，我可以给‘豹’式做一次快速启动。这样他们就该知道别来惹我们了。”

column1: The frustrated pirate tries to walk you through the money transfer one more time. "No, the last account number is a ZERO, not the letter O. It's never the letter O!" Just then, the Leopard leaps free from its docking collar on the side of the Argo and fires a barrage of LRMs at the pirate ships. The pirates retaliate with laser blasts and the whole ship groans as emergency systems activate. After another flash of light from the Leopard, the enemy captain gives the order to retreat. Unfortunately, it's too late for [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], who was caught on the wrong side of a blast door and ends up in the MedBay.
column2: 那个气急败坏的海盗又一次试着指导你完成转账。“不，账号最后一位是数字零，不是字母 O。从来就不是字母 O！” 就在这时，“豹”式从 Argo 号侧面的对接环上挣脱飞出，向海盗飞船射出一连串 LRM。 海盗以激光齐射还击，整艘船在应急系统启动时呻吟作响。 “豹”式又是一道闪光之后，敌方船长下令撤退。可惜对 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 来说太晚了，他被困在了气密门的错误一侧，最终进了医疗舱。

column1: Swallowing your pride, you approve the payment. The look of disappointment on Sumire's face echoes that of the rest of the bridge crew. Adding insult to injury, the voice over the bridge's speaker drips with satisfaction. "A wise decision, Commander. You're welcome in our space any time." As the pirate ships disappear into the starry distance, it's not the first time you find yourself wishing that the Argo was a battleship…
column2: 你咽下自尊，批准了付款。澄丽脸上失望的表情和舰桥其他船员如出一辙。 更糟的是，舰桥扬声器里的声音满是满足。“明智的决定，指挥官。我们的空域随时欢迎你。” 当海盗飞船消失在星空中时，你又一次希望 Argo 号是一艘战列舰……

column1:
Vasquez…? Through your rush of old memories, Darius goes on. "He claims to be a friend from your military days. I'll put him through to your quarters."

Vasquez's voice has weathered with age. "It's been a long time, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. I've heard you've been busy. Me too. But let's not beat around the bush… I need a favor."

He's signed on with a rebel army on the planet's surface, but after a slogging campaign, his unit has been cut off from its supply line. Vasquez is hoping that you can hook him up with some surplus inventory, and he's willing to pay.
column2:
巴斯克斯……？在你涌起的旧日回忆中，达里乌斯继续说道。“他自称是你军旅时期的朋友。我把他接到你的舱室。”

巴斯克斯的声音已随岁月变得沧桑。“好久不见了，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。听说你一直很忙。我也是。但我们就别绕圈子了……我需要你帮个忙。”

他签下了一份为行星表面一支叛军效力的合约，但在一次艰苦的推进战役之后，他的部队与补给线被切断了。巴斯克斯希望你能给他弄到一些剩余库存，而且愿意付钱。

column1: Rackam…? Through your rush of old memories, Darius goes on. "He claims to be a friend from your pirate days. I'll put him through to your quarters." Rackam's voice has weathered with age. "It's been a long time, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. I've heard you've been busy. Me too. But let's not beat around the bush… I need a favor." His crew bit off more than they could chew while robbing a well-protected merchant caravan carrying rare Holovid products. He wants to dock his DropShip at the Argo, borrow your MechTechs, and pay for the privilege.
column2: 拉卡姆……？在你涌起的旧日回忆中，达里乌斯继续说道。“他自称是你当海盗时期的朋友。我把他接到你的舱室。” 拉卡姆的声音已随岁月变得沧桑。“好久不见了，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。听说你一直很忙。我也是。但我们就别绕圈子了……我需要你帮个忙。” 他的船员在抢劫一支护卫严密、载有稀有全息影片产品的商队时，胃口大过了本事。他想把他的空投艇停靠到 Argo 号上，借用你的机甲技师，并为此付钱。

column1: When Taranquil disembarks the shuttle, she stops to stare at the Argo. Then she strolls over to you and offers her hand. "What a treasure you have here, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. I hope you'll tell me all about her."\n\nUnexpectedly, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] appears at your shoulder. "Taranquil?" Your old friend is as surprised as you are. "I never expected to see you again! I'm glad to see that you've landed here, though." She turns to you. "{COMMANDER.Callsign} always did like to work with the best."
column2: 塔兰基尔下穿梭机时，停下来盯着 Argo 号看。然后她漫步走过来伸出手。“你这儿可真是件宝贝，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。希望你把她的事都讲给我听。”\n\n出乎意料地，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 出现在你肩旁。“塔兰基尔？”你这位老朋友和你一样惊讶。“我真没想到还能见到你！不过很高兴看到你落脚在这里。”她转向你。“{COMMANDER.Callsign} 一向喜欢和最强的家伙共事。”

column1: I'm sorry, Rackam, but even for the sake of old times, I just can't help you right now.\n\nThere's a lengthy pause on the other end of the line. When Rackam finally responds, there is ice in his voice. "Well, I guess I won't be owing you any favors. That's… disappointing, but I suppose you have to look after your own. I hope you have better luck than I have."
column2: “抱歉，拉卡姆，但即使看在旧日情分上，我现在也没法帮你。”\n\n电话另一端沉默了很久。当拉卡姆终于回应时，他的声音冷得像冰。“好吧，看来我不会欠你什么人情了。真是……令人失望，但我想你也得照顾自己人。希望你的运气比我好。”

column1: Rackam's ragtag crew of pirates arrive with little fanfare. As Yang escorts them to the Mech Bay, they stare in awe at the Argo. Rackam limps over and offers his hand. "You've got a very interesting bird here, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. Do I get a tour?" Unexpectedly, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] appears at your shoulder. "Commander?" {SCN_MW.SUBJ_C}{SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'re|Default:'s} talking to Rackam. Rackam is as surprised as you are. "I never expected to see you again! I'm glad to see that you've landed here, though." He turns to you. "{COMMANDER.Callsign} always did have a talent for working with the best."
column2: 拉卡姆那帮杂牌海盗到来时没引起什么动静。杨带他们去机甲舱时，他们敬畏地盯着 Argo 号。 拉卡姆跛着脚走过来伸出手。“你这儿有只很有意思的大鸟，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。能带我参观一下吗？” 出乎意料地，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 出现在你肩旁。“指挥官？”{SCN_MW.SUBJ_C}{SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'re|Default:'s} 正在和拉卡姆说话。 拉卡姆和你一样惊讶。“我真没想到还能见到你！不过很高兴看到你落脚在这里。”他转向你。“{COMMANDER.Callsign} 一直有和最强的家伙共事的天赋。”

column1: Low MechTech impact
column2: 机甲技师影响低

column1: The unsuspecting pirate tries to walk you through the money transfer one more time. ''No, the last account number is a ZERO, not the letter O. It's never the letter O!''. Just then, the Argo's hidden weapons come fully online, and unleash a barrage of LRMs and laser fire at the pirate ships.
column2: 那个毫无察觉的海盗又一次试着指导你完成转账。“不，账号最后一位是数字零，不是字母 O。从来就不是字母 O！”。就在这时，Argo 号隐藏的武器全部上线，向海盗飞船倾泻出一连串 LRM 和激光火力。

column1: Risky option, cheapest option
column2: 高风险选项，最便宜选项

column1: It's not hard to find an unoccupied corner of the Argo big enough to lay out a spread of food and an impromptu dance floor. Although the mercenaries are from all corners of the Periphery and the Inner Sphere, drink and music manage to bridge all differences, and a good time is had by all.\n\n[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] demonstrates one other universal truth, as {SCN_MW.Subj} drunkenly {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:capsize|Default:capsizes} the dessert table.
column2: 在 Argo 号上找一块够大、没人占用的角落摆开一桌食物和临时舞池并不难。尽管这些雇佣兵来自外围星域和内天体的各个角落，酒与音乐还是弥合了所有分歧，大家都玩得很开心。\n\n[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 又演示了另一条普世真理：{SCN_MW.Subj} 醉醺醺地 {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:capsize|Default:capsizes} 了甜品台。

column1: Nothing builds esprit de corps like shared suffering. A daily regimen of early rising and regular exercise soon has the entire crew bonding despite their many differences.\n\n[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] especially embraces the routine, rising earlier and exercising longer than any of the others.
column2: 没有什么比共同受苦更能培养团队精神了。每天早起和规律锻炼的日程很快让整船人尽管差异众多却凝聚在一起。\n\n[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 尤其投入于这套例行安排，起得比谁都早，练得比谁都久。

column1: Later in the day, Darius arrives back at the Argo. While his crew begins unloading all of the new supplies, he takes you aside.\n\n"Commander, the vendor who sold us the machine tools was… well, relieved is an understatement." He describes how she buried her face in her hands when he departed.
column2: 当天晚些时候，达里乌斯回到 Argo 号。他的船员开始卸下所有新补给时，他把你拉到一边。\n\n“指挥官，卖给我们机床的那个商贩……嗯，用如释重负来形容都算轻的。”他描述她在他离开时如何双手捂住了脸。

column1: Yang closes the shuttle hatch on the raucous and excited crew, shutting off the noise with a click. As he joins you, he says, "Oh to be young again, eh Boss?" \n\n Sumire, also watching, says, "Would you like to bet that one of them is going to miss the return shuttle and take an extended leave? My bet is [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]."
column2: 杨关上穿梭机舱门，把那些喧闹兴奋的船员和噪音一并隔断，咔哒一声切断。他走到你身边时说：“啊，要是能再年轻一次，是吧老板？”\n\n同样在看着的澄丽说：“你要不要打赌，他们中有人会错过返程穿梭机，延长休假？我赌是 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]。”

column1: It's a small gesture, but even a little attention helps. Soon requests come pouring in from the crew for books and periodicals originating in systems across the Periphery and the Inner Sphere.\n\n[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] even donates a personal collection of chips {SCN_MW.Gender?Male:he's|Female:she's|NonBinary:they've} been lugging around ever since being hired on.
column2: 这只是个小小的举动，但哪怕一点点关心也有帮助。很快，船员们纷纷提出请求，索要来自外围星域和内天体各星系的书籍和期刊。\n\n[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 甚至捐出了一批私人收藏的数据芯片，那是 {SCN_MW.Gender?Male:he's|Female:she's|NonBinary:they've} 自被雇来起就一直随身带着的。

column1: Other option
column2: 其他选项

column1: Darius sends an SOS, and you set about buying time until help arrives. Before long, the pirate captain informs you she's having a bad day and fires a few glancing laser blasts off the side of the Argo to express her displeasure. The whole ship groans as emergency systems activate.\n\nJust then, several interceptors arrive on the scene, bearing the colors of the local authorities. With a curse, the enemy captain gives the order to retreat. Unfortunately, it's too late for [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], who was caught on the wrong side of a blast door and ends up in the MedBay.
column2: 达里乌斯发出求救信号，你着手拖延时间直到援军到来。没过多久，海盗船长通知你她今天心情很糟，并朝 Argo 号侧面打了几发擦过的激光来发泄不满。整艘船在应急系统启动时呻吟作响。\n\n就在这时，几架截击机抵达现场，机身上涂着当地官府的徽色。敌方船长骂了一声，下令撤退。可惜对 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 来说太晚了，他被困在了气密门的错误一侧，最终进了医疗舱。

column1: Dr. Murad says, "I'll begin the repair immediately, Commander." She returns to the Command Center six hours later, frustrated. "I've done my best, but the Argo's power system is, and will continue to be, my nemesis. MedBay power is restored… mostly." "What does 'mostly' mean?" you ask. "It means only one defibrillator at a time, Commander. I've warned the medical techs that pulling too much power at once will cause my patch to blow, and we'll be right back to where we were."
column2: 穆拉德博士说：“我马上开始修理，指挥官。” 六小时后她回到指挥中心，满脸沮丧。“我尽力了，但 Argo 号的电力系统过去是、将来也会是我的克星。医疗舱的供电已经恢复……大部分。” “‘大部分’是什么意思？”你问。 “意思是同一时间只能用一台除颤器，指挥官。我已经警告过医疗技师，一次抽太多电会让我的补丁烧掉，我们就又回到原点了。”

column1: MechTech boost option
column2: 机甲技师加成选项

column1: Commander, says Darius at the morning briefing. "Your senior staff has—" Yang interrupts with, "There's a MechTech conference here starting tomorrow!" "—requested the opportunity to—" Sumire jumps in. "Look at this seminar on the Periphery systems, Commander!" "—take shore leave to further their education. I—" Dr. Murad says quickly, "There are several MedBay tech courses I must take." "—recommend that not everybody leave the ship at once." Darius finally finishes and cocks an eyebrow at you.
column2: “指挥官，”达里乌斯在早间简报上说。“你的高级军官们已经——” 杨插话道：“明天这里有个机甲技师大会！” “——请求有机会——” 澄丽也插了进来。“看看这个关于外围星域系统的研讨会，指挥官！” “——上岸休假继续进修。我——” 穆拉德博士飞快地说：“有好几门医疗舱技术课程我必须去上。” “——建议不要所有人同时离舰。”达里乌斯终于说完，冲你挑起了眉毛。

column1:
Darius nods and heads down to the Mech Bay. 

When he reappears an hour later, he's spattered with oil. You pin him with a question: "What happened down there?"

Darius shakes his head. "Apparently the tech punctured a pressurized tube of hydraulic fluid on his lifter, and it… went everywhere. They're still cleaning it up, and the equipment is going to need repairs."

"Hydraulic fluid?"

"Everywhere," Darius repeats.
column2:
达里乌斯点点头，走向机甲舱。

一小时后他重新出现时，浑身溅满油污。你用问题盯住他：“下面发生了什么？”

达里乌斯摇了摇头。“显然那技师把他升降机上一根带压的液压油管扎破了，然后……溅得到处都是。他们还在清理，设备也需要维修。”

“液压油？”

“到处都是，”达里乌斯重复道。

column1:
After Dr. Murad sends her refusal to [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMorganKell],Morgan Kell]], she calls you to the Command Center. A Holovid of Kell shimmers in the air. "I'm surprised, Commander. We both know that Dr. Murad didn't come to this decision alone. This was an incredible opportunity for her." He shakes his head.

"You don't get many chances to turn down a MechWarrior like me. While I regret not going to you directly, it's hard to know who I can trust anymore. I thought I could protect the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKellHounds],Kell Hounds]] by going into exile, but my enemies have only multiplied."

"Needless to say, this meeting never happened." The Holovid abruptly ends.
column2:
穆拉德博士把拒绝的回复发给 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMorganKell],摩根·凯尔]] 之后，把你叫到了指挥中心。凯尔的全息影像在空中闪烁。“我很意外，指挥官。我们都清楚，穆拉德博士不是独自做出这个决定的。对她来说这是个不可思议的机会。”他摇了摇头。

“拒绝像我这样的机甲战士的机会可不多。虽然我很遗憾没有直接找你，但如今很难知道还能相信谁。我本以为通过流亡能保护 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKellHounds],凯尔猎犬]]，但我的敌人只是成倍增加。”

“不用说，这场会面从未发生过。”全息影像骤然中断。

column1:
While you're inspecting a {SCN_UNIT.Chassis.Description.Name}, an intense power surge ripples through the cavernous Mech Bay.

From the top of a gantry ladder above you, Yang hollers at his MechTechs as repair tools spark wildly. Cables and lifts spasm, and a barrel of something oily-looking inexplicably combusts.

Scanning for a way to help, you find a master control panel. A massive emergency shut-off breaker beckons, as well as numerous individual power switches. Something labeled "Automated Safety System" blinks fitfully…
column2:
你正在检视一台 {SCN_UNIT.Chassis.Description.Name} 时，一阵剧烈的电涌穿过巨大的机甲舱。

在你头顶的高架梯顶端，杨对着他的机甲技师们大吼，维修工具迸出火花。线缆和升降台痉挛般抽动，一桶看起来油乎乎的东西莫名其妙地烧了起来。

你四下寻找能帮忙的办法，发现了一块主控面板。一个巨大的应急断路开关在向你招手，旁边还有许多单独的分路电闸。有个标着“自动安全系统”的东西在忽明忽暗地闪烁……

column1: With a bang of your balled-up fist on the control panel, the blinking light strobes urgently then settles into a solid, reassuring glow. Immediately, numerous safety systems spring into action. Between the automated systems and the coordinated efforts of Yang's MechTechs, the threatening disaster is averted. With a widening grin on his face, Yang calls down to you, "That's how we handle things here, Boss! If only the term 'automated' would mean 'always on' I'd be a lot happier." He thinks for a moment, "You know, there are more improvements to automation in the Argo we could pursue, if we had the C-Bills…"
column2: 你握拳在控制面板上一砸，闪烁的指示灯急促地频闪，随后稳定成一片令人安心的恒光。 立刻，众多安全系统开始运作。在自动化系统和杨的机甲技师们协同努力之下，这场迫在眉睫的灾难被避免了。 杨咧嘴笑着向下朝你喊道：“我们这儿就是这么办事的，老板！要是‘自动’能真的意味着‘永远开着’，我就高兴多了。”他想了想，“你知道吗，Argo 号上还有更多自动化改进可以做，只要我们有 C-Bills……”

column1:
As you start flipping switches, Yang's shouted "Noooo!" trails off as he realizes the power surge has already run its course. A disquieting silence fills the Mech Bay.

Then there's a clatter of noise as a now-powerless winch drops a pile of scrap to the floor, clipping the shoulder of the loitering [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] as {SCN_MW.Subj} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:fail|Default:fails} to dodge out of the way.

As the MechWarrior is shuttled off to MedBay, Yang delivers the other bad news. "Sorry Boss, but these 'Mechs are gonna be in the shop longer than planned."
column2:
当你开始扳动电闸时，杨喊出的“不——！”渐渐弱了下去，因为他意识到电涌早已过去了。机甲舱里弥漫起令人不安的寂静。

接着是一阵杂乱的巨响，一台失去动力的绞盘把一堆废铁砸到地上，擦过了在旁边闲晃的 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 的肩膀——{SCN_MW.Subj}{SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:fail|Default:fails} 没能躲开。

当这位机甲战士被送去医疗舱时，杨带来了另一个坏消息。“抱歉老板，但这些机甲在修理厂待的时间要比原计划更久了。”

column1: Refuse option.
column2: 拒绝选项。

column1:
After Dr. Murad returns from helping [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMorganKell],Morgan Kell]], she calls you to the Command Center. A Holovid of Kell shimmers in the air.

"I regret not going to you directly, Commander, but my self-imposed exile hasn't kept the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseKurita],Kuritans]] from hunting for me. It's hard to know who I can trust anymore, but I took a calculated risk with Dr. Murad."

"She really could have used more of your support to finish the job. She played down what she managed, but she’s far better than my last engineer. You're lucky to have her in your crew. I'll send over a token of thanks from my time in the Periphery. Just don't go waving it around, alright?"

"Oh, one more thing." Kell pauses, stroking his beard. "If you ever hear any tales about a phantom 'Mech, don't correct 'em." The Holovid blinks out and Kell vanishes.
column2:
穆拉德博士帮完 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMorganKell],摩根·凯尔]] 回来后，把你叫到了指挥中心。凯尔的全息影像在空中闪烁。

“我很抱歉没有直接去找你，指挥官，但我自我放逐也没能让 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseKurita],栗田家族]] 停止追猎我。如今很难知道还能相信谁，但我在穆拉德博士身上冒了一次经过计算的风险。”

“她本来确实需要你更多的支持才能完成工作。她对自己做到的成果轻描淡写，但她比我上一位工程师强得多。你队里有她真是幸运。我会寄去一份感谢的小礼物，是我在外围星域时的东西。只是别拿着到处显摆，好吗？”

“哦，还有一件事。”凯尔顿了顿，捻着胡须。“如果你哪天听到关于幽灵机甲的传闻，别去纠正他们。”全息影像闪烁熄灭，凯尔消失了。

column1:
After Dr. Murad returns from helping [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMorganKell],Morgan Kell]], she calls you to the Command Center. A Holovid of Kell shimmers in the air.

"I regret not going to you directly, Commander, but my self-imposed exile hasn't kept the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseKurita],Kuritans]] from hunting for me. It's hard to know who I can trust anymore, but I took a calculated risk with Dr. Murad."

"She tells me that you provided limited support. I'm surprised you didn't trust her more. She's a rare genius. I'll send over a little bonus for her exceptional work, something from my time in the Periphery. And next time I'll contact you directly."

"Oh, one more thing." Kell pauses, stroking his beard. "If you ever hear any tales about a phantom 'Mech, don't correct 'em." The Holovid blinks out and Kell vanishes.
column2:
穆拉德博士帮完 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMorganKell],摩根·凯尔]] 回来后，把你叫到了指挥中心。凯尔的全息影像在空中闪烁。

“我很抱歉没有直接去找你，指挥官，但我自我放逐也没能让 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseKurita],栗田家族]] 停止追猎我。如今很难知道还能相信谁，但我在穆拉德博士身上冒了一次经过计算的风险。”

“她告诉我你提供的支持很有限。我很意外你没有更信任她。她是个罕见的天才。我会为她的出色工作寄去一点奖金，是我在外围星域时的东西。下次我会直接联系你。”

“哦，还有一件事。”凯尔顿了顿，捻着胡须。“如果你哪天听到关于幽灵机甲的传闻，别去纠正他们。”全息影像闪烁熄灭，凯尔消失了。

column1: Low reward option.
column2: 低奖励选项。

column1:
After Dr. Murad returns from helping [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMorganKell],Morgan Kell]], she calls you to the Command Center. A Holovid of Kell shimmers in the air.

"You played down your success, Dr. Murad, but this [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreLosTech],LosTech]] is running better than it has in years. Your commander is lucky to have you. Even one more activation could save my life. Next time you ask for help, I hope you get it. I'll send over a token of thanks from my time in the Periphery."

Kell pauses, stroking his beard. "Needless to say, if you ever hear any tales about a phantom 'Mech, don't correct 'em." The Holovid blinks out and Kell vanishes.
column2:
穆拉德博士帮完 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMorganKell],摩根·凯尔]] 回来后，把你叫到了指挥中心。凯尔的全息影像在空中闪烁。

“你对成功轻描淡写，穆拉德博士，但这件 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreLosTech],失落科技]] 如今运转得比多年来都好。你的指挥官有你真是幸运。哪怕再多一次激活，也可能救我的命。下次你请求帮助时，我希望你能得到。我会寄去一份感谢的小礼物，是我在外围星域时的东西。”

凯尔顿了顿，捻着胡须。“不用说，如果你哪天听到关于幽灵机甲的传闻，别去纠正他们。”全息影像闪烁熄灭，凯尔消失了。

column1:
After Dr. Murad returns from helping [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMorganKell],Morgan Kell]], she calls you to the Command Center. A Holovid of Kell shimmers in the air.

"It's hard to believe you did this all on your own, Dr. Murad. Your commander should trust you more. You're a genius. Next time you ask for help, I hope you get it. Imagine what you could do with proper resources. I'll send over a token of thanks from my time in the Periphery."

Kell pauses, stroking his beard. "Needless to say, if you ever hear any tales about a phantom 'Mech, don't correct 'em." The Holovid blinks out and Kell vanishes.
column2:
穆拉德博士帮完 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMorganKell],摩根·凯尔]] 回来后，把你叫到了指挥中心。凯尔的全息影像在空中闪烁。

“很难相信这全是你一个人干的，穆拉德博士。你的指挥官应该更信任你。你是个天才。下次你请求帮助时，我希望你能得到。想想如果有合适的资源你能做到什么。我会寄去一份感谢的小礼物，是我在外围星域时的东西。”

凯尔顿了顿，捻着胡须。“不用说，如果你哪天听到关于幽灵机甲的传闻，别去纠正他们。”全息影像闪烁熄灭，凯尔消失了。

column1: desperate option
column2: 孤注一掷选项

column1: I'm sorry, Scythia, but even for the sake of old times, I just can't help you right now.\n\nThere's a lengthy pause on the other end of the line. When Scythia finally responds, there is ice in her voice. "Well, I guess I won't be owing you any favors. That's… disappointing, but I suppose you have to look after your own. Good luck out there."
column2: “抱歉，斯基提亚，但即使看在旧日情分上，我现在也没法帮你。”\n\n电话另一端沉默了很久。当斯基提亚终于回应时，她的声音冷得像冰。“好吧，看来我不会欠你什么人情了。真是……令人失望，但我想你也得照顾自己人。祝你在外面好运。”

column1: Scythia…? Through your rush of old memories, Darius goes on. "She claims to be a friend from your earliest mercenary days. I'll put her through to your quarters." Scythia's voice has weathered with age. "It's been a long time, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. I've heard you've been busy. Me too. But let's not beat around the bush… I need a favor." Her lance of 'Mechs took an absolute beating on a contract that went sideways on her, and two critical MechWarriors were injured. She wants to dock her DropShip at the Argo and get some medical help, and she's willing to pay.
column2: 斯基提亚……？在你涌起的旧日回忆中，达里乌斯继续说道。“她自称是你雇佣兵生涯最开始时的朋友。我把她接到你的舱室。” 斯基提亚的声音已随岁月变得沧桑。“好久不见了，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。听说你一直很忙。我也是。但我们就别绕圈子了……我需要你帮个忙。” 她的机甲小队在一份出了岔子的合约里被打得很惨，两名关键机甲战士受了伤。她想把空投艇停靠到 Argo 号上接受医疗帮助，并愿意付钱。

column1: High MedTech impact
column2: 医疗技师影响高

column1:
Taranquil…? Through your rush of old memories, Darius goes on. "She claims to be a friend from your time as a merchant guard. I'll put her through to your quarters."

Taranquil's voice has weathered with age. "It's been a long time, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. I've heard you've been busy. Me too. But let's not beat around the bush… I need a favor."

She has a hold full of goods that she was ready to move, but her buyer reneged on the deal. She needs to make space for her next pickup and is willing to sell you your pick of the items in her inventory.
column2:
塔兰基尔……？在你涌起的旧日回忆中，达里乌斯继续说道。“她自称是你当商队护卫时的朋友。我把她接到你的舱室。”

塔兰基尔的声音已随岁月变得沧桑。“好久不见了，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。听说你一直很忙。我也是。但我们就别绕圈子了……我需要你帮个忙。”

她的货舱里满是她准备出手的货物，但买家毁约了。她需要为下一批收货腾出空间，愿意让你从她的存货中随意挑选购买。

column1: Scythia's ragtag crew of mercenaries arrives with little fanfare. As the wounded warriors are moved to MedBay, their companions rubberneck at the Argo. Scythia limps over and offers her hand. "You've got a very interesting bird here, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. Do I get a tour?" Unexpectedly, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] appears at your shoulder. "Commander?" {SCN_MW.SUBJ_C}{SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'re|Default:'s} talking to Scythia. Scythia is as surprised as you are. "I never expected to see you again! I'm glad to see that you've landed here, though." She turns to you. "{COMMANDER.Callsign} always did like to work with the best."
column2: 斯基提亚那帮杂牌雇佣兵到来时没引起什么动静。受伤的战士被送往医疗舱时，他们的同伴伸着脖子张望 Argo 号。 斯基提亚跛着脚走过来伸出手。“你这儿有只很有意思的大鸟，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。能带我参观一下吗？” 出乎意料地，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 出现在你肩旁。“指挥官？”{SCN_MW.SUBJ_C}{SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'re|Default:'s} 正在和斯基提亚说话。 斯基提亚和你一样惊讶。“我真没想到还能见到你！不过很高兴看到你落脚在这里。”她转向你。“{COMMANDER.Callsign} 一向喜欢和最强的家伙共事。”

column1: Valravn arrives with much fanfare. Despite all they've seen, her entourage gawks at the Argo as Darius herds them to the Barracks. Yang and his techs reverently move her heavily modified Griffin, Koschei, into the Mech Bay. Over the course of the next weeks, Valravn relaxes, drinks, and gets to know the Argo's MechWarriors. With the Training Modules available, the Mercs eventually persuade her to accept challenges to virtual gladiatorial combat. 1-on-1 fights soon become many-on-1 as she proves her mettle again and again. By the time Valravn needs to leave, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] is the only MechWarrior who has managed to best the professional in single combat.
column2: 瓦尔拉文到来时排场很大。尽管见多识广，她的随行人员在达里乌斯把他们赶去营房时还是目瞪口呆地盯着 Argo 号。杨和他的技师们虔诚地把她那台经过重度改装的格里芬——Koschei——推进机甲舱。 在随后的几周里，瓦尔拉文放松下来，喝酒，并逐渐认识了 Argo 号的机甲战士们。借着可用的训练模块，雇佣兵们最终说服她接受了虚拟角斗挑战。一对一很快变成以多打一，因为她一次又一次地证明了自己的本事。 到瓦尔拉文该离开时，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 是唯一一位在一对一战斗中击败过这位职业选手的机甲战士。

column1: I'm sorry, Douglass, but even for the sake of old times, I just can't help you right now.\n\nThere's a lengthy pause on the other end of the line before Douglass finally responds. His voice is like ice. "Well, I guess I won't be owing you any favors. That's… disappointing, but I suppose you have to look after your own. Good luck out there."
column2: “抱歉，道格拉斯，但即使看在旧日情分上，我现在也没法帮你。”\n\n电话另一端沉默了很久，道格拉斯终于回应。他的声音冷得像冰。“好吧，看来我不会欠你什么人情了。真是……令人失望，但我想你也得照顾自己人。祝你在外面好运。”

column1: Douglass…? Through your rush of old memories, Darius goes on. "He claims to be a friend from your freelancing days. I'll put him through to your quarters." Douglass' voice has weathered with age. "It's been a long time, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. I've heard you've been busy. Me too. But let's not beat around the bush… I need a favor." His crew has had a rough go of it lately, and if he doesn't line up a new contract soon, he's going to lose them. He'd like to send them to the Argo for a little R&R while he does some networking on the planet below.
column2: 道格拉斯……？在你涌起的旧日回忆中，达里乌斯继续说道。“他自称是你自由雇佣兵时期的朋友。我把他接到你的舱室。” 道格拉斯的声音已随岁月变得沧桑。“好久不见了，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。听说你一直很忙。我也是。但我们就别绕圈子了……我需要你帮个忙。” 他的船员最近过得很艰难，如果他不能尽快敲定一份新合约，他就要失去他们了。他希望把人送到 Argo 号上休整一下，自己则到下面的行星上做些关系运作。

column1:
Valravn…? Through your rush of old memories, Darius goes on. "An old friend from Solaris VII, huh? I'll put her through to your quarters."

Valravn's voice has weathered with age. "Hey, {COMMANDER.FirstName}! I see you've been keeping busy. Nice work. But let's get straight to business."

The local government on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} hired her to do a promotional tour, but now they're trying to alter the deal. She needs an interesting place to stay off-planet until her agent can sort things out.
column2:
瓦尔拉文……？在你涌起的旧日回忆中，达里乌斯继续说道。“索拉里斯 VII 的老朋友，是吧？我把她接到你的舱室。”

瓦尔拉文的声音已随岁月变得沧桑。“嘿，{COMMANDER.FirstName}！我看你一直没闲着。干得不错。不过我们直接谈正事吧。”

{TGT_SYSTEM.Name} 的地方政府雇她做一次宣传巡演，但现在他们想改条件。她需要一个有意思的地方，在星系外待着，等她的经纪人把事情理清。

column1: Valravn arrives with much fanfare. Despite all they've seen, her entourage gawks at the Argo as Darius herds them to the Barracks. While Yang and his techs reverently move her heavily modified Griffin, Koschei, into the Mech Bay, Valravn struts up to you. She takes a swig from her hip flask. "This is quite a ride, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. I might want one." Unexpectedly, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] appears at your shoulder. "Captain?" Valravn blinks. "{SCN_MW.Callsign}! I never expected to see you again! It's great to see you." She jerks a thumb at you. "{COMMANDER.Callsign} is clearly collecting the best."
column2: 瓦尔拉文到来时排场很大。尽管见多识广，她的随行人员在达里乌斯把他们赶去营房时还是目瞪口呆地盯着 Argo 号。杨和他的技师们虔诚地把她那台经过重度改装的格里芬 Koschei 推进机甲舱时，瓦尔拉文昂首阔步走到你面前。她从腰间扁壶里灌了一口。 “这玩意儿可真带劲，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。我也许也想要一艘。” 出乎意料地，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 出现在你肩旁。“队长？” 瓦尔拉文眨眨眼。“{SCN_MW.Callsign}！我真没想到还能见到你！见到你太好了。”她朝你竖了竖拇指。“{COMMANDER.Callsign} 显然在收集最强的人手。”

column1: I'm sorry, Valravn. As much as I'd like to see you, I can't afford to get involved in a contract squabble right now.\n\nThere's a lengthy pause on the other end of the line, before Valravn finally responds carelessly. "That's… unexpected. Refreshing! Well, you know your own business. Look me up anytime you need cold water thrown on your plans."
column2: “抱歉，瓦尔拉文。虽然我很想见到你，但我现在没法卷进一场合约纠纷。”\n\n电话另一端沉默了很久，瓦尔拉文终于漫不经心地回应。“这倒是……出人意料。让人觉得新鲜！好吧，你自己的事你自己清楚。哪天需要有人往你的计划上泼冷水，随时来找我。”

column1: Don't let the stubby 'Urbie' fool you, it may look like a walking trash can, but it can mount heavy armor and a grown-up-sized Autocannon. R60s aren't known for their speed, but they are very useful if you can draw the enemy into their firing range.\n\nDrop Cost Multiplier: 0.97.
column2: 别被矮墩墩的“乌尔比”骗了，它看起来像只走路的垃圾桶，却能装上重型装甲和成人尺寸的自动炮。R60 系列不以速度闻名，但如果你能把敌人引到它们的射程内，它们就非常有用。\n\n投放成本系数：0.97。

column2: 腿部驱动器 +20% 速度

column2: 腿部驱动器 +10% 速度

column1: The Federated Commonwealth started development of the Blue Shield Particle Field Damper (PFD), a defensive system that would reduce damage from Energy Weapons. While the field damper did shield the equipped unit from Weapons fire, it was also notoriously unreliable in ground units. After roughly a minute of operation, the dust and other miscellaneous debris it sucked in began to adversely affect the operation of the damper, eventually resulting in shutdown of the system.
column2: 联邦联合体开始研发蓝色护盾粒子场阻尼器（PFD），这是一种能降低能量武器伤害的防御系统。虽然场阻尼器确实能为装备它的单位挡住炮火，但在地面单位上它也是出了名的不靠谱。运转大约一分钟后，它吸入的灰尘和其他杂物开始对阻尼器的运作产生不利影响，最终导致系统停机。

column1: Reduces effectiveness of stealth and ECM shielded units
column2: 削弱隐形与 ECM 防护单位的效能

column2: 定点射击提升 15%

column1: Reduces recoil
column2: 降低后坐力

column1: It's a PPC designed for a small spacecraft. The EMP Field is generates is massive, affecting units near the target, disrupting myomer and sensor systems. It's hard to focus it on nearby targets due to the large minimum range in safe mode. FIOFF Has no minimum range penalty and does full damage at close range, but is very likely to fry the weapon. Boosted Mode greatly increases damage, but has distance falloff and requires a recharge period.
column2: 这是一种为小型航天器设计的 PPC。它产生的 EMP 场极为巨大，会影响目标附近的单位，干扰肌纤维与传感器系统。由于安全模式下巨大的最小射程，很难将它聚焦在附近目标上。 FIOFF 没有最小射程惩罚，在近距离造成全额伤害，但极有可能烧毁武器。 增强模式大幅提高伤害，但有距离衰减，并且需要一段充能时间。

column1: High energy residue reduces heat efficiency by 20%.
column2: 高能残留物使散热效率降低 20%。

column1: Hurling Insults hurts you
column2: 辱骂他人会伤到自己

column1: An incredibly rare prototype C3 Master unit, the C3 Overlord Command Unit is the pinnacle of Kuritan design and research into the C3 Network. The bulky Overlord Command Unit features a variety of targeting and command technologies but, ultimately, was retired in favor of individual components that are easier and faster to manufacture.
column2: 一种极为罕见的 C3 主控单元原型，C3 霸主指挥单元是天龙联合体在 C3 网络设计研究上的巅峰之作。笨重的霸主指挥单元集多种瞄准与指挥技术于一身，但最终仍被淘汰，改用更易、更快制造的独立部件。

column1: This target should follow us to the Great Deku Tree!
column2: 这个目标应该跟着我们去大德库树！

column1: The Remote Drone Command Console is a modification of the standard Cockpit Command Console, changing the role of the second MechWarrior to instead control remote drones. Allows either deploying a remote drone network or a single UAV under your control. The UAV may be either the default UAV or another compatible unit from the Beacons you own aboard the Argo. Costs 10,000 C-bills per use! Press the button, then hold Shift while placing the unit to open the selection menu! Basic UAV carries a BA RL5. It can Sensor Lock enemies in a 30 meter radius with a 3 turn cooldown. 20 armor, 10/15 move, 150 meter fly height.
column2: 遥控无人机指挥控制台是对标准驾驶舱指挥控制台的改装，把第二名机甲战士的职责改为操控遥控无人机。它允许你部署一套遥控无人机网络，或在你控制下部署一架单独的 UAV。该 UAV 可以是默认 UAV，也可以是你存放在 Argo 号上的信标中另一台兼容单位。 每次使用耗费 10,000 C-Bills！ 按下按钮，然后在放置单位时按住 Shift 以打开选择菜单！ 基础 UAV 携带一门 BA RL5。它可以对 30 米半径内的敌人进行传感器锁定，冷却时间 3 回合。20 点装甲，10/15 移动，150 米飞行高度。

column1: The NAIS developed the Silver Bullet Gauss Rifle (or SB Gauss) in an attempt to bring the functionality of an LB-X Autocannon to the Gauss Rifle. Though the cluster-like ammunition made it easier to hit a target and was particularly effective in the anti-aircraft role, gave them a unreliable damage profile. Uses Gauss Ammo. VOLATILE!
column2: NAIS 研发了银弹高斯步枪（SB Gauss），试图把 LB-X 自动炮的功能引入高斯步枪。虽然类集束弹药让它更容易命中目标，在防空任务中尤其有效，但也让它拥有一个不可靠的伤害分布。 使用高斯弹药。 易爆！

column2: 该单位的闪避充能上限提升

column2: 激活能力（使用射击动作）。可以举起战场上的任何单位（最多 30 吨）。敌对单位被放下时会受到伤害。

column1: Flammable Oil increases Incoming Heat Damage +25%.
column2: 易燃油脂使受到的过热伤害 +25%。

column2: 机甲的行走速度降低 50%。

column2: 无视 1 层闪避

column2: 从单位的储物仓或 Argo 号部署一架 UAV。 每次使用耗费 10 000 C-Bills！ 每份合约可部署一架 UAV！

column2: 侦察距离增加 50%

column2: 该单位每回合额外散热 15 点。

column1: The Broadside is Barrymore Munitions very own take on the Mech Mortar, able to fire 10 Shells per trigger pull it does deliver a barrage of all types of Barrymore Munitions finest choices. \n\n Uses Mortar Ammo.
column2: Broadside 是巴里摩尔弹药公司自己对机甲迫击炮的诠释，它每次扣动扳机可发射 10 发炮弹，倾泻出巴里摩尔弹药公司最精良产品组成的各类齐射。\n\n 使用迫击炮弹药。

column1: Developed by the Clans, Enhanced Imaging is an advanced targeting and piloting system for use with humanoid shaped combat vehicles such as BattleMechs. While offering considerable advantages, EI inflicts serious side effects on the user, including possible mental instability, nerve damage and death. For some reason this cockpit does not allow ejections.
column2: 增强影像系统由氏族研发，是一种用于类人形战斗车辆（如战斗机甲）的先进瞄准与驾驶系统。虽然提供了相当多的优势，EI 会对使用者造成严重副作用，包括可能出现的精神失常、神经损伤和死亡。出于某种原因，这个驾驶舱不允许弹射。

column1: Haley Flannigan's Cyclone, Hail Storm, features a pair of reinforced retractable blades; what they lack in finesse, they make up for in brute force. \n\n Requires a Hand Actuator to be installed in same Location.
column2: 海莉·弗兰尼根的“气旋”，“冰雹风暴”，装有一对强化伸缩刀刃；它们在精巧上有所欠缺，却以蛮力弥补。\n\n 需要在同一部位安装手部驱动器。

column1: Come! Lay down your weapons! It is not too late for my mercy...
column2: 来吧！放下你们的武器！现在接受我的怜悯还不算晚……

column1: Buffered Vehicular Direct Neural Interface was an improvement on standard VDNI developed for the Manei Domini. Introduced several years after the start of the Jihad, buffered VDNI was available only to those who held the rank of Omicron. While operating similarly to standard VDNI, the buffered model further enhanced the neurological fail-safes to create a safer, more potent system.
column2: 缓冲式车辆直接神经接口是在标准 VDNI 基础上改进的型号，专为马内·多米尼打造。在圣战开始数年后推出，缓冲式 VDNI 仅限持有 Omicron 军衔者使用。其运作方式与标准 VDNI 类似，但缓冲型号进一步强化了神经失效保护，打造出更安全、更强力的系统。

column1: A prototype armor-integrated version of the Void Signature System, removing the need for extra space for its components. By using the tight integration into the armor, the prototype even performed slightly better than its standard counterpart.
column2: 这是一种装甲集成式虚空信号系统的原型，省去了为其组件预留额外空间的需要。由于与装甲紧密整合，这型原型机甚至比标准型号表现略好。

column1: Increased Sensors
column2: 传感器增强

Then some Pirates found it and made it 'working' again, the chambering system is a complete mess that only accepts 'Canisters' with 'Magnetic Materials'. VOLATILE! Uses Railgun Ammo. Reduced Damage from Movement
column2: 这门可怜、被折腾得不成样子的武器曾是星际联盟时代的遗物，一件失落科技的杰作，一门“轨道炮”。后来一些海盗找到了它，让它重新“能用”，装填系统成了一团彻底的乱麻，只接受装有“磁性材料”的“弹罐”。 易爆！ 使用轨道炮弹药。 移动造成的伤害降低

column2: HGR 命中使陀螺仪失稳，稳定性阈值降低 10%。

column2: 这门武器“曾经”是一门大型激光器，有人把一台 TAG 直接短接进了系统，让电容器过载，然后还是把聚焦系统弄坏了。

column1: A Product of the RISC MML Program for the Raptor II Experimentals, it has an Advanced Targeting System that Securely Guides in the First Volley. Uses Clan SRM/LRM Ammo. Left Click on Chance to hit during battle to toggle between LRM or SRM.
column2: 这是 RISC 的 MML 项目为 Raptor II 实验机打造的产物，配备一套先进瞄准系统，能在第一轮齐射时精准制导。 使用氏族 SRM/LRM 弹药。 战斗中左键点击命中率即可在 LRM 与 SRM 之间切换。

column1: Yeah, well so this is pretty much half of a Raven, its all there, Electronics Suite and even the whole Cockpit, so whoever drives it can shoot the still functioning Large Pulse Laser
column2: 嗯，好吧，这基本上就是半台渡鸦，该有的都在，电子设备套件，连整个驾驶舱都在，所以谁开着它都能发射那门还在运转的大型脉冲激光器

column1: An elegant union between a Sniper Artillery Piece and a Ultra Autocannon/5 feeder, the Big Steel is the custom-built namesake for the Helepolis 2L 'Big Steel'. Capable of firing two successive artillery shells with a reduced payload, nobody dares to ask Big Steel's business.\n\nUses Sniper Ammo.
column2: 作为狙击炮与超级自动炮/5 供弹机的优雅结合体，大钢是为 Helepolis 2L“大钢”量身定制的同名武器。它能连续发射两发装药减少的炮弹，没人敢去打听大钢的底细。\n\n使用狙击炮弹药。

column1: You step back and let your people do their job. Several hours later you get the good news. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] has responded well to emergency treatment and is out of danger.

column1: Yang's voice crackles over the internal comm, out of breath and a little too excited for a man standing in a storage room full of dust. "Commander, you're gonna want to see this. I am in sub-floor 7B, in the far storage room in the aft cargo section." By the time you reach the aft cargo section, Yang and his crew have cleared out most of the junk. Crates stacked to the ceiling, tarps thick with grime, spare parts nobody's touched in decades, stacks of rusted tubing, the typical gathering of junk that builds up over time in a rear cargo area of a dropship. But all of it is shoved aside to expose a bare stretch of bulkhead, and set into that bulkhead is a wide door no one has noticed before. Yang wipes his hands on his coveralls and grins. "Wasn't looking for it. Just trying to make room for the new ammo crates. Moved a stack of scrap that's probably older than you, and there it was. Door's not on any deck plan I've ever seen." He hauls it open. Beyond it, a narrow staircase drops into darkness, the air stale and cold. The stairs seem to go on longer than they should. When you finally reach the bottom and the work lights sweep out across the space, nobody says anything for a moment. Some of it looks like a proper hangar, gantries mounted, deck plating laid, berth markings still faintly visible on the floor. But past the halfway point it just stops. Bare support ribs with no plating between them. Coiled cable that never got run. A gantry frame standing without a single panel bolted to it, tools still racked beside it like whoever was working just walked off one shift and never came back. Fifteen bays by the layout, maybe more, but less than half of them ever got finished. Whoever built this stopped partway through, and stopped for good, long before you ever took command of the Argo. "That's why it's not on any plans." Yang's voice echoes off the unfinished half of the deck. "Project like this, you don't file the paperwork till it's done. Somebody started building themselves a second hangar and ran out of money or time, or maybe both, before they ever got to call it finished." Darius crosses his arms, looking around with his usual face when his mind is running through the options. "A whole extra hangar. That's too good to just stumble upon randomly, Yang. What's the catch." Yang shrugs. "Catch is it's half a hangar dressed up as a whole one. The finished side, I could probably get that running without too much trouble. The rest needs plating, wiring, the works, same as building it new. And whoever started this never got as far as putting in a proper lift shaft big enough for a Mech. I can run elevators down here easy enough for crew and gear, that part I'm not worried about. But nothing sized for transporting a fully assembled Mech, and I'm not confident I can retrofit one into the hull with all the other changes we have done and half the systems still only partially working. Whatever gets put together down here, stays down here or comes apart to make the trip up." Sumire leans against a bulkhead, unimpressed but curious. "So we'd have two hangars, connected for everything except the one thing that matters." "Pretty much." Yang taps a bare support rib, listening to it ring. "Not gonna pretend that's convenient. But this many bays, even half finished, is a lot of bays somebody else already paid to start building." You take it in. Half a hangar, abandoned mid-build, buried inside your own ship for who knows how long. It could be worth finishing. It could also be a hole you pour money into for nothing.
column2: 杨的声音从内部通讯器里嘶嘶作响地传来，他气喘吁吁，对一个站在满是灰尘的储物间里的人来说，兴奋得有点过头了。“指挥官，这个你得来看看。我在 7B 层底层，后部货舱区最里面的那间储物室。” 等你赶到后部货舱区时，杨和他的手下已经清走了大部分杂物。堆到天花板的板条箱、积满污垢的防水布、几十年没人碰过的备用零件、成堆生锈的管材——空投艇后部货舱区经年累月堆积起来的典型破烂。但所有这些都被推到一边，露出一段光秃秃的舱壁，而舱壁上嵌着一扇从没人注意过的宽大舱门。 杨在工装裤上擦了擦手，咧嘴一笑。“我可不是在找它。只是想给新的弹药箱腾地方。搬开一堆大概比你还老的废料，它就在那儿了。这扇门我在任何甲板图上都没见过。” 他用力把门拉开。门后，一道狭窄的楼梯向下没入黑暗，空气陈旧而寒冷。 这段楼梯似乎长得不合常理。等你终于走到最下面，工作灯的光扫过整个空间时，一时没人说话。其中一部分看起来像是一座正规机库：吊架已安装，甲板铺板已铺设，地面上还隐约可见泊位标记。但过了中点之后就戛然而止。裸露的支撑肋架之间没有铺板。从未铺设的成卷线缆。一具吊架框架立在那里，却没有一块面板用螺栓固定上去，旁边的工具还摆在架子上，仿佛干活的人刚下班走掉，再也没回来。按布局算有十五个泊位，也许更多，但完工的不到一半。建这座机库的人半途停了工，而且是永久停工——远在你接管 Argo 号之前。 “所以它不在任何图纸上。”杨的声音在未完工的那半边甲板上回响。“这种工程，完工之前是不会归档的。有人给自己建第二座机库，建到一半钱或时间不够了，也许两样都不够，就再也没能把它叫做完工。” 达里斯抱着双臂，脸上是他权衡选项时惯有的表情，环顾四周。“整整一座额外的机库。这也好得太过头了，不像是随便撞上的，杨。有什么猫腻？” 杨耸耸肩。“猫腻就是它只是半座机库，却装成一整座。完工的那半边，我大概不用太费劲就能让它运转起来。剩下的部分需要铺板、接线、全套工程，跟新建一样。而且当初动手的人根本没建一台能容纳机甲的升降井。用电梯往下运人员和设备没问题，这部分我不担心。但没有一样东西是按运输一台完整组装好的机甲来设计尺寸的，而且以我们做过的其他改动、还有半数系统仍只勉强能用来判断，我没把握能在舰体上加装一台。不管在这下面组装出什么，要么留在下面，要么拆散才能运上去。” 苏米尔靠在舱壁上，不为所动，却很感兴趣。“所以我们会有两座机库，什么都连通，唯独那件要紧的事不通。” “差不多吧。”杨敲了敲一根裸露的支撑肋，听它发出回响。“我不想假装这很方便。但这么多泊位，就算只完工一半，也是别人已经花钱开工的一大堆泊位。” 你细细品味着这一切。半座机库，半途废弃，不知在你自己的舰船里埋了多久。它可能值得完工。也可能是个只会白白往里砸钱的无底洞。

Costs, raw material needs, how long it would take, and what are the chances of it just being an impossible dream." Yang snaps a lazy salute. "Copy that. I'll get Farah down here, she can run the numbers on the structural and electrical side while I figure out what kind of materials and manpower we need." [Yang and Farah will report back with a full assessment of the secondary hangar in a few weeks time]

column1: You look over the schematic one more time, then nod. "Let's do it. Get me that material, get me that crew, and let's put this hangar to actual use." Farah is already keying notes into her datapad. "I will flag the requirements for the crew." Yang grins and claps his hands together once. "Now we're talking. I'll start putting feelers out for people who know what they're doing." [The naval-grade [[DM.UpgradeDefs[ConstructionMaterials_FerroAluminum],Ferro-Aluminum]] needed for the hangar's structure can only be recovered from the cargo containers of IndustrialMechs or cargo vehicles. Salvage from Ambush Convoy contracts offers the best chance of finding such containers. The [[DM.UpgradeDefs[ConstructionMaterials_CablesAndDataLinks],Cables and Data Links]], [[DM.UpgradeDefs[ConstructionMaterials_CableConduits],Cable Conduits]], [[DM.UpgradeDefs[ConstructionMaterials_SensorsAndProbes],Sensors and Probes]], and [[DM.UpgradeDefs[ConstructionMaterials_CommunicationsEquipment],Communications Equipment]] needed to outfit the hangar can appear in the system store of any star system with the Electronics attribute. You only need to buy each item once. Once all the materials have been gathered the construction crew can be hired by remaining in port at a star system with the Manufacturing attribute once the materials are gathered. This may take some time to trigger.
column2: 你又看了一眼图纸，然后点了点头。“就这么办。把材料弄来，把工人找来，让这座机库真正派上用场。” 法拉已经在往数据板里记录要点。“我会把人员需求标出来。” 杨咧嘴一笑，双手拍了一下。“这才像话。我这就去打听有哪些懂行的人。” [机库结构所需的军用级 [[DM.UpgradeDefs[ConstructionMaterials_FerroAluminum],铁铝合金]] 只能从工业机甲或货运车辆的货柜中回收。伏击运输队合约中的战利品最有机会找到这类货柜。 为机库配备所需的 [[DM.UpgradeDefs[ConstructionMaterials_CablesAndDataLinks],线缆与数据链]]、[[DM.UpgradeDefs[ConstructionMaterials_CableConduits],线缆导管]]、[[DM.UpgradeDefs[ConstructionMaterials_SensorsAndProbes],传感器与探测器]] 以及 [[DM.UpgradeDefs[ConstructionMaterials_CommunicationsEquipment],通讯设备]]，会出现在任何拥有 电子 属性的星系的星系商店中。每种物品只需购买一次。 材料全部集齐后，在拥有 制造 属性的星系留港，即可雇佣施工队。这可能需要一段时间才会触发。

column1:
<color=#BFBFBF>Farah's already got the projector going by the time you walk into the conference room, a wireframe schematic of the half-built hangar rotating slowly above the table.</color> "Commander. I have finished my study of the work that has been done so far."

<color=#BFBFBF>She flicks through readouts without looking up.</color> "Good news is the structural bones really are good. Bad news is the deck and Mech bays aren't. Every load bearing beam down there needs reinforcement before I'll sign off on putting a dozen Mechs anywhere near it. I'm talking a full metric ton of naval-grade Ferro-Aluminum, minimum, worked into the support structure before we touch anything else."

<color=#BFBFBF>Darius whistles low.</color> "A ton. That's not exactly something you pick up at the corner store."

"No, it is not." <color=#BFBFBF>Farah says flatly.</color> "That grade of Ferro-Aluminum is built for capital ship hulls, not BattleMechs. It does not move through our normal supply channels, and our less legal contacts will not have that amount available."

<color=#BFBFBF>Sumire, leaning in over the table, speaks up.</color> "Then we look at less conventional means of acquisition."

<color=#BFBFBF>Darius raises an eyebrow.</color> "Less conventional meaning what, exactly. Ripping it out of somebody else's cargo hold?"

"More or less." <color=#BFBFBF>Sumire's expression doesn't change.</color> "Material like that ships in bulk on transport Mechs and cargo haulers. Hit the right convoy, and it falls into our lap instead of costing us a single C-bill."

<color=#BFBFBF>Farah swipes to the next readout, unbothered by the detour.</color> "Beyond the structure, the bay needs a full electronics fit as well. Several hundred meters of advanced cabling and conduit, new sensor arrays for the bay itself, data links back to the main hangar network, and a proper communications suite so the deck isn't running blind. That part is comparatively simple. Any system with a developed electronics industry should stock what we need."

<color=#BFBFBF>Yang speaks up while leaning against the doorway, arms crossed.</color> "And even once we've got the material, none of my people are free to actually install it, even if we could. We're a combat crew, not a shipyard crew."

"He's right." <color=#BFBFBF>Farah nods.</color> "This needs experienced hands. I would estimate a dozen qualified workers, and a project timeline of up to four months once materials are on hand."

<color=#BFBFBF>Yang shrugs.</color> "Good news is that kind of crew isn't hard to find, not if we go looking in the right places. Any system that's actually building things ought to have people who know one end of a rivet gun from the other."

<color=#BFBFBF>Farah closes the projection.</color> "So. A ton of naval-grade material we cannot buy outright, a full electronics fit we can, and a construction crew we will need to hire. It will not be free, nor will it be quick, but definitely doable."

<color=#BFBFBF>She looks at you directly.</color> "So what do you think, Commander?"
column2:
<color=#BFBFBF>你走进会议室时，法拉已经打开了投影仪，半建成的机库线框示意图在桌子上方缓缓旋转。</color>“指挥官。我已经完成了对目前已完工部分的勘查。”

<color=#BFBFBF>她头也不抬地翻着读数。</color>“好消息是结构骨架确实不错。坏消息是甲板和机甲泊位不行。下面每一根承重梁都需要加固，我才会同意把十几台机甲放在那附近。我的意思是，至少一整公吨军用级铁铝合金，先加进支撑结构里，然后我们才能碰别的东西。”

<color=#BFBFBF>达里斯低声吹了声口哨。</color>“一吨。这可不是街角小店能买到的东西。”

“确实不是。”<color=#BFBFBF>法拉面无表情地说。</color>“那个等级的铁铝合金是给主力舰舰体用的，不是给战斗机甲用的。它不走我们的常规供应渠道，而我们那些不太合法的关系户也拿不出这个量。”

<color=#BFBFBF>苏米尔俯身靠在桌边，开口道。</color>“那我们就用不那么常规的获取手段。”

<color=#BFBFBF>达里斯挑起一根眉毛。</color>“不那么常规具体是指什么？从别人的货舱里硬拆出来？”

“差不多。”<color=#BFBFBF>苏米尔的表情没有变化。</color>“那种材料是按批量装在运输机甲和货运船上发运的。劫下合适的那支运输队，它就会落进我们手里，一个 C-bill 都不用花。”

<color=#BFBFBF>法拉毫不在意这段插曲，划到下一页读数。</color>“除了结构，泊位还需要一整套电子设备。几百米高级线缆和导管、泊位自用的新传感器阵列、连回主机库网络的数据链，还有一套像样的通讯设备，免得甲板上的人两眼一抹黑。这部分相对简单。任何电子工业发达的星系应该都有现货。”

<color=#BFBFBF>杨靠在门框上抱着手臂开口。</color>“而且就算材料到手，我的人手也没空去装，就算他们会装。我们是战斗人员，不是船厂工人。”

“他说得对。”<color=#BFBFBF>法拉点头。</color>“这需要老手。我估计要十二名合格工人，材料到位后工期最多四个月。”

<color=#BFBFBF>杨耸耸肩。</color>“好消息是这种人不难找，只要找对地方。任何真正在搞建设的星系，总会有分得清铆钉枪哪头朝前的人。”

<color=#BFBFBF>法拉关闭投影。</color>“那么，一吨我们买不到的军用级材料、一整套我们能买的电子设备，还有一支需要雇佣的施工队。既不免费，也不快，但肯定办得到。”

<color=#BFBFBF>她直视着你。</color>“你觉得怎么样，指挥官？”

column2: Beta 舱段修复后，包含一处显然曾是水培设施的场所，位于 Argo 的脊柱附近，其正上方还有一座低重力健身房。两者都没能挺过硬真空和恒星辐射的侵袭，但它们诱人地昭示着 Argo 曾经拥有的奢华配置。\n\n 偏好衰减前 +10 天。

<color=#BFBFBF>Darius strides onto the bridge with a datapad in hand, looking pleased with himself.</color> "Commander, got something for you. Called in a few favors, checked around with contacts groundside. Found ourselves a construction outfit that's actually worked shipyard contracts before, not just planetside warehouses."

"Ashford Yards. Small outfit, but they know their business." <color=#BFBFBF>He hands the datapad over.</color> "Foreman already sent over a formal estimate."

<color=#BFBFBF>Farah takes the datapad, scanning through it.</color> "Reasonable staffing plan. A dozen certified riggers and fabricators, materials handling included on their end." <color=#BFBFBF>She pauses on the total.</color> "Cost comes to just over fifty million C-bills for their work alone, then add other costs and we might be looking towards sixty."

<color=#BFBFBF>Sumire lets out a low whistle.</color> "That's quite the number."

"And it is not fast." <color=#BFBFBF>Farah continues.</color> "Their timeline has the work running past a hundred days from the day they start. Structural work first, then the electronics fit, then final inspection before it is fit to berth a Mech."

<color=#BFBFBF>Darius crosses his arms.</color> "Not cheap, not quick. But considering what that hangar's worth once it's done, still seems like the best offer we're going to find out here."

<color=#BFBFBF>Sumire speaks up with a questioning voice.</color> "Almost sixty million and over a hundred days of workers underfoot. Worth asking if this ship can even absorb that kind of expense right now."

<color=#BFBFBF>You weigh it over, the estimate glowing steady on the datapad. It is a long commitment and a lot of C-bills. But the hangar is sitting there half-built regardless, waiting on someone to finish the job.</color>
column2:
<color=#BFBFBF>达里斯手里拿着数据板大步走上舰桥，一副颇为得意的样子。</color>“指挥官，有东西给你。我动用了几个关系，跟地面的熟人打听了一圈。找到了一家真正做过船厂合约的施工队，而不只是干过地面仓库的活儿。”

“阿什福德船厂（Ashford Yards）。规模不大，但懂行。”<color=#BFBFBF>他把数据板递过来。</color>“工头已经把正式报价发过来了。”

<color=#BFBFBF>法拉接过数据板，扫了一遍。</color>“人员配置方案合理。十二名持证装配工和制造工，材料搬运由他们那边负责。”<color=#BFBFBF>她在总额那行停了一下。</color>“光是他们的工钱就略高于五千万 C-bill，再加上其他开支，可能要奔着六千万去。”

<color=#BFBFBF>苏米尔低声吹了声口哨。</color>“这数字可够大的。”

“而且不快。”<color=#BFBFBF>法拉继续道。</color>“按他们的工期表，从开工那天算起要干一百多天。先做结构，再做电子设备安装，最后是交付前的最终检查，然后才适合让机甲入驻。”

<color=#BFBFBF>达里斯抱着手臂。</color>“既不便宜，也不快。但想想那座机库完工后的价值，看起来仍然是我们在这片地方能找到的最好条件。”

<color=#BFBFBF>苏米尔用疑问的语气开口。</color>“将近六千万，还有一百多天工人在舰上走来走去。值得问问这艘船现在到底吃不吃得下这种开销。”

<color=#BFBFBF>你权衡着。报价在数据板上稳定地亮着。这是一份长期承诺，也是一大笔 C-bill。但无论如何，那座机库就半建成地搁在那里，等着有人把活干完。</color>

column1: <color=#BFBFBF>Darius taps through a supply manifest as the last container gets logged into the hold.</color> "That's the last of it, Commander. Cable and data line, the conduit to run it all through, a solid stock of sensors and probes, and a full set of communications gear to tie the hangar together with the rest of the Argo."\n\n<color=#BFBFBF>Yang leans over his shoulder, scanning the list.</color> "Everything we needed for the wiring and the eyes and ears of the place. Hangar's actually starting to look like it might work one day. We finally have everything needed to finish the job properly, just need the construction crew now."
column2: <color=#BFBFBF>最后一个货柜登记入舱时，达里斯在补给清单上划着条目。</color>“就这些了，指挥官。线缆和数据线、用来铺设它们的导管、一批充足的传感器与探测器，还有一整套通讯设备，把机库和 Argo 其余部分连成一体。”\n\n<color=#BFBFBF>杨凑到他肩头看那份清单。</color>“布线所需的、还有让这地方长眼长耳所需的东西全齐了。机库看起来真有一天能用起来了。把活干利索所需的一切我们终于都有了，现在就差施工队了。”

column1: You look over the manifest one last time and nod. "Good work, both of you. Get it all staged and ready to go." Darius gives a small nod and heads off to arrange the staging. column1:
Brett Finnegan Bozeman was born to minor nobility on Gulkana in the Federated Suns, but moved early with his family to Maldive near the Taurian Concordat as part of a business consolidation. There he received a comprehensive education in physical and intellectual pursuits from personal tutors.

As he grew, he witnessed the tumultuous handling of the planetary government by the local governing corporation, and resisted family pressure to take his place in the family business; he wanted no part of such an undisciplined and untrustworthy environment. Instead, he enlisted in the AFFS as soon as he was of age.

Shortly after his enlistment, his record was blanked. His family lost contact with him, except for the occasional update from his superior offices reassuring them he was still alive. When peace loomed in the 3020s, he finally resurfaced, a hardened MechWarrior unwilling - or unable - to talk about what he'd been doing for so many years.

After a year of peace with his family on New Avalon, he could no longer take the quiet life. While he was not allowed to return to active duty in the AFFS, they couldn't stop him from seeking out mercenary work on the Periphery. This time, though, he promised to keep his family updated on his movements
column2:
Brett Finnegan Bozeman 出生于联邦太阳国古尔卡纳（Gulkana）的一个小贵族家庭，但很小就随家人迁往金牛协约国附近的马尔代夫（Maldive），作为一次商业整合的一部分。在那里，他从私人教师那里接受了体能与智力方面的全面教育。

随着年岁增长，他目睹了当地统治企业对行星政府的混乱管理，并顶住了家人让他接手家族生意的压力；他不想沾上这种毫无纪律、不值得信任的环境。于是，他一到法定年龄就加入了 AFFS。

入伍后不久，他的档案就被清空了。家人与他失去联系，只能偶尔收到他上级机关的通报，向他们确认他还活着。3020 年代和平将至时，他终于重新露面，成了一个饱经风霜的机甲战士，不愿——或者无法——谈论自己这些年都在做什么。

在新阿瓦隆（New Avalon）与家人度过一年和平时光后，他再也受不了这种安静的日子。虽然 AFFS 不允许他重返现役，但他们拦不住他去外围地带找雇佣兵的活儿干。不过这一次，他答应会让家人知道自己的行踪

column1: When I hear Speed of the Dead... I'm thinking someone in a walker, slowly plodding along, not someone going faster.  Though, I guess if you look at it more like running away from Death, you would want to be very fast.  And considering being slow in a 'Mech can kill you, this speed will help keep the Reaper from catching up. Well, until the Reaper decides to go nuclear on you, in which case... I'm glad I'm up here on the Argo until the battle is over. What? You're not really thinking of making me a pilot now, are you? Boss? Boss! BOSS!
column2: 听到“亡者之速”这个名字……我想到的是有人开着一台步行机，慢吞吞地挪着走，而不是跑得更快。不过，要是换个角度，把它想成是在逃离死神，那你肯定想跑得飞快。再考虑到在机甲里行动太慢可能会要你的命，这个速度能帮你不让死神追上来。嗯，除非死神决定对你动用核弹，那样的话……我很庆幸战斗结束前我都在 Argo 上待着。什么？你现在不会真打算让我去当机师吧？老大？老大！老大！

column1:
You nod at Yang. "I agree, equipping a 'Mech will make for a far less enticing target for ROM agents from ComStar."

Later, Farah calls you into Engineering. You find her standing in front of a terminal, a huge smile on her face. "I have managed to penetrate the fortress around Necromos—you know, this is some dangerous territory,— but I've done it! Seems Fortresses are generating HPG pulses that throw off navigation computers. The trick is to manually calculate the Jump."

You nod. "Good work, Farah. We will get Darius' men back, thanks to you."
column2:
你朝杨点头。“我同意，把应答器装到机甲上，会让它成为通讯之星 ROM 探员远没那么诱人的目标。”

后来，法拉把你叫到工程部。你发现她站在一台终端前，脸上挂着灿烂的笑容。“我成功突破了 Necromos 周围的要塞封锁——你知道的，那一带相当危险——但我做到了！看来要塞会生成 HPG 脉冲，干扰导航计算机。诀窍是手动计算跳跃。”

你点点头。“干得好，法拉。多亏了你，我们能把达里斯的人救回来。”

column1:
You nod at Sumire. "Okay, Meyer your idea sounds promising. Follow up on it. For the time being, this is your top priority."

Later, she calls you to the bridge. You find her standing by the viewscreen, a weary half-smile on her face. "We got it. Commander, we can slip right in now—ship and all. Seems ComStar has nav computers automatically failing jumps to Necromos, it's kind of a Fortress system. I've got Necromos back on the star map. We can get going whenever you want. "

You nod. "Good work, Sumire. Our rescue plan is back on, thanks to you."

She looks stern. "Don't remind me."
column2:
你朝苏米尔点头。“好，Meyer，你的想法听起来很有希望。继续跟进。眼下这就是你的头等大事。”

后来，她把你叫到舰桥。你发现她站在显示屏旁，脸上挂着疲惫的半个笑容。“我们搞定了。指挥官，现在我们可以直接溜进去——连船带人一起。看来通讯之星让导航计算机自动拒绝跳跃到 Necromos，那算是个要塞星系。我已经把 Necromos 标回星图了。你想什么时候出发都行。”

你点点头。“干得好，苏米尔。多亏了你，我们的营救计划又能继续了。”

她一脸严肃。“别提醒我。”

column1: Apparently someone wanted to keep some zombies as pets, and put them inside a Zorb, which... is really prophetic naming. Anyway, the fool kept them near some heaters too long, and made some zombie stew.  Lost a tech to it when they tried to clean it out; dissolved him completely. Tried some armor, same thing, so we're thinking to make some lemonade from this... well, horrific creation.  Toss 'em at your enemies, melt their armor, maybe spook them with the bones or whatever still floating around... Oh, XO, why are you here? Search for some giant balls? Wait, THEY'RE YOURS!?
column2: 显然有人想养几只僵尸当宠物，就把它们塞进了一个 Zorb 球里——这名字还真是预言得离谱。总之，那傻瓜把它们放在加热器旁边太久，煮出了一锅僵尸汤。有个技师去清理时丢了命，整个人被溶得干干净净。拿装甲去试，结果一样，于是我们琢磨着从这个……呃，骇人的造物里榨点柠檬水出来。把它们扔向敌人，熔掉他们的装甲，也许还能用那些还在里面漂着的骨头什么的吓唬吓唬人……哦，副官，你怎么在这儿？来搜几个巨型球？等等，这些球是你的！？

column1: The Marian Hegemony is a small Periphery state, located anti-spinward of the Magistracy of Canopus. Ruled by Imperator Marius O'Reilly, the Hegemony is a strict absolute monarchy with a rigid social structure.

column1: Boss... I'm very concerned. This is an actual brain, in a jar, and you're asking me to hook it up to the sensors of the 'Mech. Not to mention you'll probably have tons of issues with hallucinating sensor blips, data being forgotten and whatever else happens when you try and run a rotting brain as your sensors, as the brain tries to coerce the data into what it thinks it is looking at, which then gets reported to you. This isn't a criminal brain, is it? Because that's at least another 20 movies!!

column1: Boss, if I'm reading the serial numbers right, this TSM is from the very first batch made by the Capellans. And chemical analysis shows that the Anti-TSM chemicals used by the Fed Suns somehow caused a slow reaction that resulted in the TSM going, well, wonky, over the years. You can use it, sure, but don't expect it to help you when you overheat, in fact I'm pretty sure it will have some negative effects. I'm guessing the Capellans used 'Mechs equipped with it for some research projects instead of paying for a whole new 'Mech or doing the expensive repairs.
column2: 老大，要是我没看错序列号，这台 TSM 是卡佩兰人生产的第一批货。化学分析显示，联邦太阳国使用的反 TSM 化学剂不知怎么引发了缓慢反应，导致这台 TSM 这些年变得……呃，不正常了。你当然可以用它，但别指望过热时它能帮上忙，事实上我相当肯定它会有一些负面效果。我猜卡佩兰人把装了它的机甲拿去做某些研究项目，而不是花钱买新机甲或者做昂贵的大修。

column1:
Darius calls you to the bridge, where you find him fiddling with a small electronic box. "This is what we were looking for, Boss. What we have here is an old ComStar Transponder, something that is nearly impossible to obtain nowadays."

Yang raises his hand. "I think we will need to equip a 'Mech with it and then strap that 'Mech on to the hull of the Argo. Keep it off our ship itself, if we don't we will be attracting ROMS from two jumps away. We can sweep in grab the Mechwarriors and leave." 

Sumire rubs her temples. "I disagree with Yang. We're going to have to change our ship's IFF completely... I mean, if I am reading this correctly. In 30 days there will be an opening for ComStar vessels to slip through and investigate Necromo's primary base. With this on we can get to the planet just in time for the show. We can blow this abomination off the face of the universe once and for all; And not risk further Infection."
column2:
达里斯把你叫到舰桥，你发现他正摆弄着一个小电子盒。“这就是我们要找的东西，老大。我们手上的是一台旧通讯之星应答器，这东西如今几乎不可能弄到。”

杨举起手。“我觉得我们得把它装到一台机甲上，再把那台机甲绑在 Argo 的舰体外面。别让它上我们的船，否则我们会把两跳跃外的 ROM 探员都招来。然后我们就能冲进去把那些机甲战士抓回来走人。”

苏米尔揉了揉太阳穴。“我不同意杨的看法。我们得把船上的 IFF 彻底改掉……我是说，如果我没读错的话。三十天后会出现一个空档，让通讯之星的船只溜进来调查 Necromo 的主基地。把这个打开，我们就能正好赶上那场好戏。我们可以把那头怪物一次性从宇宙中抹掉，而且不用冒进一步感染的风险。”

column1: You turn to Darius, “Ok, who’s up for a treat? Darius, get a team over there in our Leopard and let’s see what’s behind Door Number Two.” Darius keys in some commands, “The Leopard is dispatching in 10 minutes to dock with the TREAT door, Commander.” The crew watch the live feed on the screen as the away team docks with the derelict ship, then manually unlocks and opens the cargo door. We have 15 minutes before critical mass!” “Get them out if there and back to the Argo now,” you shout. As the Leopard leaps away from the derelict, its hull shudders and a few seconds later explodes into a ball of fire and molten metal. You turn to the bridge crew, “Well, that could have gone better. Let’s go see what treats were brought aboard the Argo.” ﻿
