column1: Sumire looks up from her console, “Commander, I’m picking up readings of an unknown object in high orbit around [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]].” “Put it on the main screen,” you tell her. Moments later the screen switches to a small uniformly shaped object, obviously man made, “Zoom in and enhance.” Sumire adjusts some controls and zooms in the object, “It’s a dropship, but there are no signs of life or power.” Darius points at the screen, “There is something on the hull. Is that… a pumpkin?” The screen zooms to max and painted on the hull is an orange pumpkin with a face and the words TRICK OR TREAT next to it. Darius scratches his head, “What does that mean?” Dr Murad steps forward, “I believe it is a reference to an old Terran holiday known as Halloween. Originally a day to remember the dead, it transitioned into a holiday where Terran children would dress up in costumes and go door to door to be given treats, usually in the form of candy.” You look at Dr Murad, “so what is the Trick?” Dr Murad smiles, “Some residences would try to scare the children or play pranks on them and what not.” You ponder this information, “So, there are two access doors on the dropship, one for Trick and one for Treat. Which one should we choose?”
column2: 苏米尔从操作台前抬起头，“指挥官，我在 [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] 的高轨道上探测到一个不明物体的读数。” “放到主屏幕上，”你告诉她。 片刻后，屏幕上切换出一个外形匀称的小物体，显然是人工制品，“放大并增强。” 苏米尔调整了几个控件，把物体放大，“是一艘空投艇，但没有任何生命或能源活动的迹象。” 达里斯指着屏幕，“舰体上有什么东西。那是……一个南瓜？” 屏幕放到最大，舰体上画着一个橙色南瓜，长着一张脸，旁边写着 TRICK OR TREAT 几个字。 达里斯挠了挠头，“那是什么意思？” 穆拉德博士走上前来，“我想这是指一个古老的地球节日，叫做万圣节。最初是用来缅怀逝者的日子，后来演变成地球的孩子们穿上戏服、挨家挨户讨要糖果的节日。” 你看着穆拉德博士，“那 Trick 又是什么？” 穆拉德博士笑了笑，“有些人家会试图吓唬孩子，或者对他们搞点恶作剧之类的。” 你琢磨着这些信息，“所以那艘空投艇上有两扇入口门，一扇对应 Trick，一扇对应 Treat。我们该选哪一扇？”

column1:
The Dark Nebula is not a system, but an area of space—a vast cloud of ionized gas near the Periphery border of the Trellshire Province of Lyran Commonwealth's Tamar Pact (later Clan Jade Falcon occupation zone), roughly between the systems of Somerset, Apollo, and Wotan. The coordinates given designate the nebula's approximate center point.

The nebula interferes with sensors and communications and gives off intense radiation. There are several white and red dwarf stars in the nebula, as well as seventeen known pulsars.

A Star League naval base, Camelot Command, was hidden in a hollowed-out asteroid around one of the red dwarf stars. After the facility's rediscovery in 3050, "Dark Nebula" was often used to refer to Camelot Command or the specific star within the nebula that the facility orbits, though this is technically incorrect.
column2:
暗星云不是某个星系，而是一片太空区域——莱兰联邦塔玛协定区（后为翡翠猎鹰氏族占领区）特雷尔郡外围边界附近的一大片电离气体云，大致位于萨默塞特、阿波罗和沃坦三个星系之间。所给坐标标示的是该星云的近似中心点。

星云会干扰传感器和通讯，并释放强烈辐射。星云中有若干颗白矮星和红矮星，以及十七颗已知脉冲星。

一个星际联盟海军基地——卡美洛指挥部——隐藏在一颗红矮星附近被掏空的石质小行星中。该设施于 3050 年被重新发现后，“暗星云”常被用来指代卡美洛指挥部，或星云中该设施所环绕的那颗特定恒星，不过严格来说这并不准确。

column1: A warrior whose personal honor would not allow them to serve as a bondsman could avoid this fate through ritual suicide known as a bondsref. Prior to being claimed by the victor and given a bondcord, a warrior could take their own life or have an accomplice kill them and so 'refuse the bond.' Once a bondcord had been given, the bondsref could only be performed with the permission of the bondholder; to do otherwise was considered a cowardly and dishonorable act..
column2: 若战士的个人荣誉不允许其成为羁绊者，便可通过名为“羁绊拒斥”的仪式性自杀来避免这一命运。在被胜者认领并授予羁绊索之前，战士可以自尽，或让同伙杀死自己，以此“拒绝羁绊”。一旦羁绊索已被授予，羁绊拒斥便只能在羁绊持有者许可下进行；否则会被视为懦弱而可耻的行为..

column1:
You look your former opponent in the eyes, "You fought valiantly, and I now claim you as my [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBondsman],bondsman]].  You will wear this [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBondcord],bondcord]] until you have sufficently demonstrated all three virtues: combat talent, integrity and loyalty."

As you reach forward to place the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBondcord],bondcord]] on the MechWarrior's wrist, they pull their arm behind them, "My honour will not allow me to become a [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBondsman],bondsman]].  I claim my right of refusal."

You nod assent, "As you wish."

You feel saddened at the loss of a potentially great pilot.
column2:
你直视着曾经的对手，“你战斗得很英勇，我现在认领你为我的 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBondsman],羁绊者]]。你将佩戴这条 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBondcord],羁绊索]]，直到你充分展现出三项美德：战斗才能、正直和忠诚。”

你伸手要把 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBondcord],羁绊索]] 系到这名机甲战士手腕上时，他却把手臂缩到身后，“我的荣誉不允许我成为 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBondsman],羁绊者]]。我行使拒绝权。”

你点头同意，“如你所愿。”

你为失去一位可能前途无量的机师而感到难过。

column1: Star Captain Lukas Furey, like his trothkin Lumen Furey, has Enhanced Imaging Neural Implants. The constant usage has had side effects, the most notable of which are paranoia and psychosis. After his capture and becoming a bondsman, his constant outbursts and accusations resulted in everyone calling him "Mental".\n\n
column2: 星队长 Lukas Furey 和他的同族（trothkin）Lumen Furey 一样，植入了增强成像神经植入体。长期使用带来了副作用，其中最明显的是偏执和精神病症。他被俘并成为羁绊者后，不时爆发情绪、胡乱指控，于是所有人都叫他“Mental”。\n\n

column1: Star Commander Lateekah was a formidable opponent, downing numerous enemy 'Mechs prior to getting captured and becoming a bondswoman. The other mercenaries have taken to calling her "Zulu" after a barkeep mentioned her appearance reminded him of images of the warriors of the ancient Terran tribe.\n\n
column2: 星指挥官 Lateekah 是个强悍的对手，在被俘并成为羁绊者之前击落了大量敌军机甲。有个酒保说她的外貌让他想起古老地球时代某个部落战士的形象，此后其他雇佣兵就开始叫她“Zulu”。\n\n

column1: Star Captain Lumen Furey, along with her trothkin Lukas Furey both chose to receive Enhanced Imaging Neural Implants. This process made Lumen a force to be reckoned with on the battlefield, and it took the combined efforts of multiple 'Mechs to defeat her in combat. Her indenture as a bondswoman has not dulled her abilities, which have earned her the callsign "Tornado".\n\n
column2: 星队长 Lumen Furey 和她的同族 Lukas Furey 都选择了植入增强成像神经植入体。这一过程让 Lumen 在战场上成为一股不可小觑的力量，需要多台机甲联手才能在战斗中击败她。沦为羁绊者的劳役并未削弱她的能力，这些能力为她赢得了“Tornado”这个呼号。\n\n

column1: Earning an impressive three kills during his Trial of Position and attaining the rank of Star Captain, Mytch Hoff is a very capable MechWarrior. Whilst a lucky shot to his 'Mech's cockpit rendered him unconscious, and subsequently a bondsman, the others have taken to calling him "Cap" in recognition of his abilities and former rank.\n\n
column2: Mytch Hoff 在定位试炼中取得了令人瞩目的三次击杀，并获得星队长军衔，是一位非常能干的机甲战士。虽然一发幸运的炮弹击中他的机甲驾驶舱，使他昏迷并随后成为羁绊者，但其他人还是根据他的能力和昔日军衔，开始叫他“Cap”。\n\n

column1: Nearly relegated to the Technician Caste, MechWarrior Mychel was able to down her opponent in her Trial of Position only seconds before her 'Mech was incapacitated. Similar circumstances led to her capture and indenture as a bondswoman. Her skills at field repairs earned her the callsign "Wrench" from the other mercenaries.\n\n
column2: 机甲战士 Mychel 差点被贬入技术种姓，但在定位试炼中，她仅比自己的机甲失去战斗力早了几秒击倒对手。类似的境况导致她被俘并沦为羁绊者。她的战地维修本领为她在其他雇佣兵中赢得了“Wrench”这个呼号。\n\n

column1: Star Commander Holli Jones has an inherent ability to read the battlefield and know where to go to hit the enemy. Not every battle goes to plan though, and a critical hit to her 'Mech's sensors and ECM suite led to her defeat and capture as a bondswoman. Cool and collected under fire, the others joke she has liquid nitrogen for blood and have taken to calling her "Nitro" as a result.\n\n
column2: 星指挥官 Holli Jones 天生具备解读战场、判断该往哪里打的能力。但并非每场战斗都能按计划进行，一次对机甲传感器和 ECM 套件的要害命中导致她战败被俘，成为羁绊者。她在炮火下冷静沉着，其他人开玩笑说她血管里流的是液氮，于是开始叫她“Nitro”。\n\n

column1: Star Commander Alek Yanev spends almost as much time in the cockpit as he does running laps around the base. Even as a bondsman, he continues his exercise regime diligently, which has earned him the callsign "Circuit".\n\n
column2: 星指挥官 Alek Yanev 待在驾驶舱里的时间几乎和绕基地跑步的时间一样多。即使成了羁绊者，他仍坚持刻苦锻炼，这为他赢得了“Circuit”这个呼号。\n\n

column1: The Trial is over and you have proven yourself in the ways of the Clans.\n\nDarius approaches, "Commander, do you wish to enact your rights to claim your opponent as a [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBondsman],bondsman]]?"
column2: 试炼结束了，你已证明自己懂得氏族的行事之道。\n\n达里斯走上前来，“指挥官，你要行使权利，把对手认领为 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBondsman],羁绊者]] 吗？”

column1: MechWarrior Dante was captured and became a bondsman after he was forced to eject from his severely crippled and nearly destroyed 'Mech. Everyone calls him "King" as a jab at his constant reminders to the other mercenaries that his status as a bondsman has ruined his chances of earning his Kingston Bloodname.\n\n
column2: 机甲战士 Dante 被迫从严重受损、几近摧毁的机甲中弹射出来，随后被俘成为羁绊者。他总是不停提醒其他雇佣兵，说自己沦为羁绊者毁掉了赢得 Kingston 血脉名号的机会，于是大家都叫他“King”，算是拿他打趣。\n\n

column1: MechWarrior Fergus only just managed to pass his Clan's Trial of Position. Most of his shots went sailing past his chosen opponent, with one occasion resulting in him landing the killing blow on another 'Mech and stealing the kill for himself. After being captured as a bondsman, the local mercenaries have nicknamed him "Bandit".\n\n
column2: 机甲战士 Fergus 只是勉强通过了氏族的定位试炼。他的大部分射击都从选定的对手身边滑过，有一次还误打误撞击毁了另一台机甲，把这个击杀算到了自己头上。被俘成为羁绊者后，当地的雇佣兵给他起了个绰号“Bandit”。\n\n

column1: Point Commander Erin has always had an aversion to BattleMechs. So much so that she pointedly failed her Trial of Position in order to move into the Armor Corps. Captured after her Savannah Master was disabled and made a bondswoman, she was given the callsign "Jumper" due to her always wearing a jumpsuit everywhere she went.\n\n
column2: 点指挥官 Erin 一向厌恶战斗机甲，厌恶到刻意在定位试炼中失利，以便转入装甲部队。她的 Savannah Master 被击毁后她被俘并成为羁绊者，因为她无论去哪儿都穿着连体飞行服，大家给她起了呼号“Jumper”。\n\n

"We can't keep this up forever Commander, the MechWarriors are already starting to talk about abandoning this endeavor. We need to finish this fight before we are attacked again."
column2: 达里斯汇报最新情况。“我把你说的话转告了所有人：防止再次遭袭的最好办法，就是集中精力让我们的机甲和机甲战士时刻保持战备状态。”\n\n他低下头。“指挥官，我们没法永远这样下去，机甲战士们已经开始讨论放弃这摊事了。我们得在再次被袭击之前结束这场战斗。”

column1:
You stumble upon Yang sitting quietly in a dark corner and ask how he's doing. "Boss, it's just that attack on Tiverton. This is the second time it has happened to me, first time was when I got this." Raising his artificial hand. 

"Even got hit there again." He points out a freshly gouged line on his bicep's plate. "Feels like I won't be so lucky if this happens a third time. As if I'm cursed to die in a 'Mech Bay, and I live there."

"You got any ideas how to get over this?"
column2:
你偶然发现杨安静地坐在一个昏暗的角落里，便问他怎么样。“老大，就是蒂弗顿那次袭击的事。这已经是第二次发生在我身上了，第一次就是让我丢了这个的时候。”他抬起那只假手。

“连这儿又被击中了。”他指着自己上臂护板上一道新刮出的沟痕。“感觉要是再来第三次，我不会有这么好的运气了。好像我注定要死在机甲库里，而我偏偏就住在那里。”

“你有什么办法让我迈过这个坎吗？”

column1: Darius nods, and makes the order.\n\n"I'll brief the medical staff, it's not their job but we need to survive. Injuries are going to heal slowly, but we'll be alive to treat our wounds. We can't keep getting hit like this Commander, it's making our MechWarriors talk about leaving. We need to end this fight ASAP."
column2: 达里斯点点头，下了命令。\n\n“我会向医护人员交代。这不是他们的本职，但我们必须活下去。伤势会恢复得很慢，但至少我们还能活着治疗伤口。指挥官，我们不能这样一直挨打，机甲战士们已经在议论要走了。我们得尽快结束这场战斗。”

column1: Darius pulls up beside you in a hurry. "We just lost a lifeboat and one of our MedTechs is missing, along with months of supplies."\n\nDarius frowns. "Maybe a sleeper for the Black Market. I pulled up the Tech's files, background is clean, maybe too clean. I'm stepping up security with a buddy system, extra guard shifts and augmenting our lookouts immediately. Farah's crew will conduct interior patrols. We can't afford to use our MechWarriors, who should I pull to help monitor the exterior sensors?"
column2: 达里斯匆匆赶到你身旁。“我们刚丢了一艘救生艇，一名医疗技师失踪，还有够用数月的补给。”\n\n达里斯皱起眉头。“也许是黑市安插的内应。我调了那名技师的档案，背景很干净，干净得有点过分。我马上加强安保：实行结伴制度、增加哨班，并补充瞭望人手。法拉的团队负责内部巡逻。我们的机甲战士耗不起，你觉得我该抽谁去协助监控外部传感器？”

column1: The main enforcer of the Black Market. While not serving as the boss' personal bodyguard, The Muscle appears where the syndicate wants to apply pressure by force. It's rumored that he drives a heavily customized Atlas covered with cosmetic bolt-ons for intimidation.
column2: 黑市的主要打手。在不担任老大私人保镖的时候，“The Muscle”会出现在辛迪加想要以武力施压的地方。据说他驾驶一台经过大幅改装、布满用于恫吓的装饰性外挂件的阿特拉斯。

We're ready for another surprise attack or inside job. Commander, we can't keep this up forever. We need to finish this fight before it finishes us."
column2: 达里斯汇报最新情况。“我在排班上稍微动了点脑筋。”\n\n他迟疑了一下。“话虽如此，我们的维修和医疗设施都只能以最低限度的班组运转。我们已经准备好应对下一次突袭或内应破坏。指挥官，我们没法永远这样下去。我们得在这场战斗拖垮我们之前结束它。”

column1: You assign Darius to train up Yang and the MechTechs. At the end of the first session, Yang approaches you. \n\n"Boss, my crew are really taking to this tactical stuff. I'm going to ask Darius to come back for the rest of the week. It shouldn't impact our schedule too much. The crew already looks like they'll be sleeping easier tonight, this is what I needed."
column2: 你安排达里斯去训练杨和机甲技师们。第一节课结束后，杨来找你。\n\n“老大，我的伙计们对这套战术玩意儿还真挺上心。我打算请达里斯这周剩下的时间都过来。这应该不会太影响我们的进度。伙计们看起来今晚能睡得安稳些了，这正是我需要的。”

column1: Farah brings you modified blueprints. "You know, if we just opened this area here and used it to store our armor scraps, it would place 'Mech armor against the bulkhead. In the bays, we can replace this panel with a hidden door to make a safe room."\n\nAfter inspecting the changes, Yang approaches you. "Thanks Boss, now there's tons more armor between us and the outside. My crew will sleep better tonight and so will I."
column2: 法拉拿来修改过的图纸。“你看，如果我们把这里这块区域打开，用来存放装甲废料，就等于在舱壁前堆了一层机甲装甲。在泊位那边，我们可以把这块面板换成暗门，做成一个安全室。”\n\n检查完这些改动后，杨来找你。“谢谢你老大，现在我们和外面之间多了好多层装甲。我的伙计们今晚能睡得更踏实，我也是。”

column1: You place a tick next to [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]]'s name on the datapad and scribble your signature. Handing the pad to Darius as you stand up, "Ok, lets get [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] to the MedBay and confirm {TRT_MW.SUBJ} {TRT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:still want|Default:still wants} to do this. Darius jumps up and heads off to the barracks as you proceed to the MedBay to speak to the Argo's surgeon. You arrive to find the surgeon inspecting the Neural Implant matrix. They look up when you arrive, "Hello, Commander. [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] is being prepped for surgery as we speak." You nod, "You feel comfortable performing this procedure?" The surgeon nods back, "I do Commander. I have done similar types of surgeries in my past before I hired on with your company." You turn to exit the room, "Very well, let me know how the procedure goes." :::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: Hours later, Darius finds you in the lounge, "Boss, I just wanted to tell you that everything seems to have gone fine with [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]]'s implants. {TRT_MW.Subj_C} should be up and moving in the next couple of days and by the end of the month should have enough simpod training to go out into the field." You smile, and raise your glass, "Good news indeed! Keep me posted Darius."
column2: 你在数据板上 [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] 的名字旁打了个勾，草草签上名字。起身时把数据板递给达里斯，“好，把 [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] 送到医疗舱，确认一下 {TRT_MW.SUBJ} {TRT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:still want|Default:still wants} 做这个手术。” 达里斯跳起来往宿舍去，你则前往医疗舱去见 Argo 号的外科医生。 你到的时候，外科医生正在检查神经植入体矩阵。你进来时他们抬起头，“你好，指挥官。[[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] 正在准备手术。” 你点点头，“你有把握做这个手术吗？” 外科医生也点点头，“有，指挥官。我在加入你们公司之前做过类似的手术。” 你转身走出房间，“很好，手术情况随时告诉我。” :::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: 几小时后，达里斯在休息室找到你，“老大，我只想告诉你，[[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] 的植入体手术看起来一切顺利。{TRT_MW.Subj_C} 应该再过几天就能下床活动，到月底应该就有足够的模拟舱训练，可以上战场了。” 你笑了笑，举起杯子，“确实是好消息！有情况随时告诉我，达里斯。”

column1:
A knock sounds on your office door and you call out, "Come in..."

The door opens and Darius strides in with a somber look on his face, "Commander, we were just unloading the cargo from one of our supply runs, and I noticed the coffin containing the body of [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] was on the manifest."

You slump back in your chair, "What?!?  No way... what happened?"

Darius sighs, "According to the attached holovid recording, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] attempted a radical maneuver to try and take out their assigned drone target.  Unfortunately, it ended up with their VTOL slamming into a radio tower.  They died instantly.  How do you want to proceed?"
column2:
你办公室的门上响起敲门声，你喊了一声“进来……”

门开了，达里斯大步走进来，脸上神情凝重，“指挥官，我们刚才在卸一批补给物资，我注意到清单上有装着 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 遗体的棺材。”

你瘫坐回椅子里，“什么？！不可能……发生了什么事？”

达里斯叹了口气，“根据附带的影像记录，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 试图做一个高风险机动，想干掉分配给他们的无人机目标。不幸的是，他们的 VTOL 最后撞上了一座无线电塔。当场死亡。你想怎么处理？”

column1: A knock sounds on your office door and you call out, "Come in..."\n\nThe door opens and Darius strides and hands you a datapad, "Commander, you asked me to get you the information about attending Air Today, Gone Tomorrow's Aircademy [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRipperVTOL],VTOL]] training school. Pretty much anyone can apply, provided they have proper ground vehicle experience beforehand. You just need to fill out and sign that form on the screen and we can submit the application. Their response time is pretty quick."
column2: 你办公室的门上响起敲门声，你喊了一声“进来……”\n\n门开了，达里斯大步走进来，递给你一块数据板，“指挥官，你让我查的关于报名 Air Today, Gone Tomorrow 航空学院 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRipperVTOL],VTOL]] 训练学校的信息，我弄到了。基本上谁都能申请，只要之前有正规地面车辆的驾驶经验。你只需要在屏幕上那份表格上填好并签字，我们就能提交申请。他们的回复速度挺快。”

column1: You look over the name and record of the candidate. You scroll back through their file numerous times, before letting out a long sigh and close the datapad. You hand the pad back to Darius, "Thanks Darius, but I do not think that pilot meets our needs here. See if there are any other suitable candidates. We do not need to rush into this blindly." Darius takes the datapad, "As you wish, Commander. Air Today, Gone Tomorrow will still bill us the cost of the assessment. The Aircademy also states the applicant must wait 90 days before they can be reassessed should you change your mind later." The following pilot is not eligible again for 90 days: [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]
column2: 你看了一遍候选人的姓名和档案。你把他们的档案来回翻了好几遍，最后长叹一声，合上数据板。 你把数据板递回给达里斯，“谢谢你，达里斯，但我觉得这名机师不符合我们的需求。看看还有没有其他合适的人选。这事不用急着盲目决定。” 达里斯接过数据板，“如你所愿，指挥官。Air Today, Gone Tomorrow 仍会向我们收取评估费用。航空学院还声明，如果你之后改变主意，申请人必须等 90 天才能重新接受评估。” 以下机师在 90 天内不再符合资格： [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]

This training course, supplemented by neurostimuli and training simulators, can be yours for no more than ¢750,000. Your tuition fee covers all costs associated with your training including room and board for up to 6 months. Stop letting your worms eye view affect your performance on the battlefield! WARNING! Tuition costs ¢750,000 and the chosen pilot will not be available for up to 6 months. Applicant MUST have prior vehicle experience. Slots are limited, so only ONE pilot may attend at a time. Our reps are not responsible if you do not have the funds to pay the tuition. Avoid buying until you have a proper bankroll. NOT ALL APPLICANTS WILL BE ACCEPTED! VTOL Training is dangerous. Accidents do happen and Air Today, Gone Tomorrow's Aircademy Flight School will not be held responsible for pilot injury or death.

There is one pilot who has completed the assessment and should meet the requirements: [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] You just need to sign that form on the screen and we can proceed from there."

column1: Darius watches as the shuttle docks with the Argo. It's been a long haul with the Commander away at VTOL training, so hopefully with their arrival back on board things can get back to normal. A MedTech disembarks the shuttle and heads over to Darius, "Are you Darius, XO of the Argo?" Darius nods, "Affirmative. How can I help you?" The MedTech shoves a datapad at Darius, "Sign here, please. He's all yours now." Darius looks down at the datapad and sees a release form for a wounded passenger being transported to the Argo: Commander {COMMANDER.FirstName} {COMMANDER.LastName}, wounded during VTOL Flight Training; Current Status: Stable, "What the hell happened?" The MedTech shrugs, "Can't really say, sir. Scuttlebutt has it that your commander tried to outmaneuver one of the other cadets in an attempt at top marks or something, and there was a mid-air collision. Pretty lucky to be alive if you ask me. In any event, I was instructed to get them safely here, and I have done that. Now it's up to you to nurse them back to full health." Darius signs the release form as a hover-gurney floats over with the Commander strapped in, obviously drugged to the max, Darius pulls a paper free that was clutched in their hand. Reading it, it would appear the Commander at least passed their training, just not in one piece. An Argo MedTech handling the hover-gurney speaks up, "Uh, sir... where shall I take the Commander?"
column2: 达里斯看着穿梭机与 Argo 对接。指挥官外出参加 VTOL 训练已经很久了，希望随着他们回到舰上，一切能恢复正常。 一名医疗技师走下穿梭机，朝达里斯走来，“你是达里斯吧，Argo 的副官？” 达里斯点点头，“是的。有什么可以帮你？” 医疗技师把一块数据板塞给达里斯，“请在这儿签字。他现在归你们了。” 达里斯低头看向数据板，上面是一份运往 Argo 的伤员交接单：指挥官 {COMMANDER.FirstName} {COMMANDER.LastName}，在 VTOL 飞行训练中受伤；当前状态：稳定，“到底出什么事了？” 医疗技师耸耸肩，“我真说不上来，先生。传言说你的指挥官想甩开另一名学员拿最高分什么的，结果在空中撞了。要我说，能活着已经算运气好了。总之，我的任务是把他们安全送到，我做到了。接下来就看你们能不能把他们养回满状态了。” 达里斯在交接单上签了字，一台悬浮担架飘过来，指挥官被固定在上面，显然被下了大剂量的药。达里斯从他们手里抽出一张被攥着的纸。读了一遍，看来指挥官至少是通过了训练，只是没能囫囵个儿地通过。 一名负责推悬浮担架的 Argo 医疗技师开口问：“呃，先生……我把指挥官送到哪里去？”

column1:
A knock sounds on your office door and you call out, "Come in..."

The door opens and Darius strides in, "Commander, I have good news, and bad news.  The good news is [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] passed their training and are now fully qualified to fly pretty much any VTOL out there."

You smile, "That's great, now what's the bad news?"

Darius grimaces, "During the course of the flight tests, they suffered some injuries and will be out of action for some time.  We can speed up their recovery time if we allocate a medical team specifically to look after them."
column2:
你办公室的门上响起敲门声，你喊了一声“进来……”

门开了，达里斯大步走进来，“指挥官，我有好消息，也有坏消息。好消息是 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 通过了训练，现在完全有资格驾驶几乎任何型号的 VTOL。”

你笑了，“那太好了，坏消息呢？”

达里斯一脸苦相，“在飞行测试过程中，他们受了些伤，会有一段时间无法出战。如果我们专门派一个医疗小组照看他们，可以加快恢复速度。”

column1: A knock sounds on your office door and you call out, "Come in..." The door opens and Darius strides in with a datapad and a smile, "Commander, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] has returned and they passed their training with Flying colours!" The pun makes you smile, but not as much as the memory of a friend who would have turned green hearing it. Still smiling, you ask Darius, "Very good news indeed. What's on the datapad then?" Darius hands it over to you, "Well, because [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] did so well, the Air Today, Gone Tomorrow has offered to sell us a [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRipperVTOL],Ripper VTOL]] that they did their training in. The details are all there."
column2: 你办公室的门上响起敲门声，你喊了一声“进来……” 门开了，达里斯带着笑容大步走进来，手里拿着一块数据板，“指挥官，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 回来了，而且是以飞一般的优异成绩通过了训练！” 这个双关让你笑了，但比不上你想起一位朋友时的笑意——他要是听到这话，脸都会绿了。你仍带着笑问达里斯，“确实是好消息。那数据板上是什么？” 达里斯把它递给你，“嗯，因为 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 表现太好了，Air Today, Gone Tomorrow 提出要卖给我们一台他们训练时用的 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRipperVTOL],Ripper VTOL]]。详情都在里面。”

column1: As the shuttle docks with the Argo, you wait impatiently for the techs to lower the disembarkation ramp. The moment it is safe, you leap from your seat and head onto the deck of the Argo. You see Darius waiting for you off to the side and head over towards him with a big smile on your face. . As you approach, Darius pipes up, "I take it you passed, Commander?" You grin widely, "No, I'm just happy to see your ugly face," You slap Darius on the shoulder as you continue, "You bet your ass i did, Darius! Wow! What a blast that was! I never knew how exhilarating flying could be." Darius smiles and hands you a datapad, "Well, it appears that Air Today, Gone Tomorrow has offered to sell you one of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRipperVTOL],Ripper VTOLs]] that you flew your training in. The details are all there in this datafile they sent over. And good to have you back, Commander."
column2: 穿梭机与 Argo 对接时，你不耐烦地等着技师放下下舰坡道。坡道一安全，你就从座位上跳起来，走上 Argo 的甲板。你看到达里斯在一边等你，便满脸笑容地朝他走过去。 . 你走近时，达里斯开口了，“我猜你通过了吧，指挥官？” 你咧嘴大笑，“没有，我只是高兴看到你那张丑脸，”你拍了拍达里斯的肩膀，接着说，“我当然过了，达里斯！哇！太爽了！我从不知道飞行能这么让人亢奋。” 达里斯笑了笑，递给你一块数据板，“嗯，看来 Air Today, Gone Tomorrow 提出要卖给你一台你在训练中驾驶过的 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRipperVTOL],Ripper VTOL]]。详情都在他们发来的这份数据文件里。还有，欢迎回来，指挥官。”

column1: You read through the information on the datapad, "You know it's tempting, but at that price, we're paying nearly full market value for a used VTOL.  We will allocate [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] an appropriate ride to utilitise thier new skill."\n\nDaruis takes back the datapad, "Understood, Commander."
column2: 你看了一遍数据板上的信息，“你知道这挺诱人，但按那个价钱，我们等于几乎按全价市价买一架二手 VTOL。我们会给 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 分配一台合适的座驾，好用上他们的新技能。”\n\n达里斯拿回数据板，“明白了，指挥官。”

column1:
I… don't know this one. The color drains from [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s face as the rest of the team stares at {TGT_MW.OBJ} expectantly.

"Hey, don't worry," Darius says as he does some quick math in his head. "Even if we lose this round, we come in second place and take home some good money. Seriously good money. You've been incredible."

[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] chimes in. "Yeah, don't sweat it. Who the hell ever heard of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSchwartzSystem],Schwartz]] system, anyway?"
column2:
“我……这个我不知道。”[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 脸色煞白，其他队员都满怀期待地盯着 {TGT_MW.OBJ}。

“嘿，别担心，”Darius 一边飞快地在心里盘算，一边说道。“就算这轮输了，我们也能拿第二名，带一笔不少的钱回去。真的是不少。你已经很了不起了。”

[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 插话道：“是啊，别紧张。话说回来，[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSchwartzSystem],Schwartz]] 星系这地方，谁他妈听说过？”

column1: How bad is it, you ask as you keep an eye on a crestfallen [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. Darius shrugs. "Bad, but not horrible. I was trying to save some money from each round, but I lost track during that losing streak. We took a loss, but it wasn't everything… I mean, we still have the Argo." {TGT_MW.Callsign} blanches. "I'm so sorry, Commander…" "We're fine," you say firmly. "Don't worry about it. We went in together, we went down together." But your words of comfort don't do much. Looking at the other losing teams provides a grim reminder that it's called 'gambling' for a reason.
column2: “有多糟？”你一边问，一边留意着垂头丧气的 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。 Darius 耸了耸肩。“很糟，但还不算灾难。我本来想每轮都省下点钱，可那阵连败的时候我算乱了。我们是亏了，但没亏光……我的意思是，我们至少还有阿尔戈号。” {TGT_MW.Callsign} 脸都白了。“真的对不起，指挥官……” “我们没事，”你坚定地说。“别放在心上。我们是一起去的，也是一起栽的。”可你的安慰并没起多大作用。 看着其他输掉的小队，你不由得苦涩地想起：这玩意儿叫“赌博”，是有原因的。

column1: In the middle of the night, you're flung from your bed. Metal screeches deep inside the Argo. Dr. Murad's voice crackles over the comms. "Everything is under control, Commander, but [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] needs adult supervision." Darius drags the pilot into your quarters. "{TGT_MW.Callsign} discovered how to destabilize a DropShip with a penlaser." Quickly {TGT_MW.Det} face reddens. "It was an accident!" Darius crosses his arms. "You've had a lot of accidents. Luckily, nothing major, but this one nearly sent the drive stabilizer flying into the fusion reactors. How do you want to handle this, Commander?"
column2: 半夜里，你被人从床上掀了下来。金属尖啸声从阿尔戈号深处传来。Murad 博士的声音在通讯器里噼啪作响。“一切都在控制之中，指挥官，但 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 需要有人看着点。” Darius 把那名机师拖进了你的舱室。“{TGT_MW.Callsign} 琢磨出了用笔形激光器让空投艇失稳的办法。” {TGT_MW.Det} 的脸一下子红了。“那是个意外！” Darius 抱起双臂。“你已经出过不少意外了。幸好都不算严重，可这次差点把推进稳定器甩进聚变反应堆里。指挥官，这事你想怎么处理？”

column1: WE WON! WE WON IT ALL!!! Darius roars at the top of his lungs. Even the audience is chanting [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s callsign, making {TGT_MW.OBJ} stand on the table and take bow after bow. Doubling every round was an insane move on Darius's part, and your heart is still racing from the moment when he let everything ride on an obscure question about the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreFivePillars],Five Pillars]]. Looking around the room, you discover that Sumire and the rest of the vacationing crew have been watching your performace. She gives a sincere slow-clap for the team's efforts.
column2: “我们赢了！我们全赢了！”Darius 扯着嗓子吼道。 就连观众都在齐声高喊 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 的呼号，弄得 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 站上桌子，鞠了一躬又一躬。 每一轮都翻倍下注，是 Darius 疯狂至极的一手，而当他拿全部筹码押在一道关于 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreFivePillars],五柱]] 的冷门问题上时，你的心到现在还在狂跳。 环顾四周，你发现 Sumire 和其余正在休假的船员一直在看你们的表现。她为团队的努力真诚而缓慢地鼓起了掌。

column1:
Both Darius and [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] are disappointed, but they enter themselves as a two person 'casual' team, pooling their own personal money for the entry fee. [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] waves goodbye and heads toward the slot machines.

Later in the evening, Darius drops down into the seat next to you. "Ten in a row to close out the night. {TGT_MW.Callsign} is a bit of a genius. So, yeah…" He clinks glasses with you. "We would've made a tidy sum. Not that I'm bitter, of course."

You grin right back at him. "Of course you're not."
column2:
Darius 和 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 都很失望，但他们还是以两人“休闲组”的名义报了名，自掏腰包凑出报名费。[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 挥手告别，朝老虎机那边去了。

当晚稍晚，Darius 在你旁边的座位坐下。“收官连中十题。{TGT_MW.Callsign} 算得上是个天才。所以说嘛……”他跟你碰了碰杯。“我们本来能赚一笔不小的钱。当然，我一点都不记恨。”

你冲他咧嘴一笑。“你当然不记恨。”

column1:
Ten in a row to close out the night! You haven't seen Darius this happy since he got the best of a three-way trade with a Davion noble and a Taurian merchant.

"[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] is a genius!" He slaps {TGT_MW.OBJ} generously on the back. "I'm buying you a helmet. We need to keep that brain of yours safe!"

As the team arrives at the shuttle, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] runs over to tell the rest of the shore leave crew about Trivia Night. {TGT_MW.Callsign} sheepishly soaks up their praise.
column2:
“收官连中十题！”你从没见过 Darius 这么高兴，上次还是他跟一位 Davion 贵族和一位 Taurian 商人做成一桩三方买卖的时候。

“[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 是个天才！”他大方地在 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 背上拍了一记。“我要给你买个头盔。你这颗脑袋可得好好保护起来！”

小队抵达穿梭机时，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 跑过去把问答之夜的事告诉其余休假船员。{TGT_MW.Callsign} 则腼腆地享受着大家的夸赞。

column1:
Thanks to [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], your team held its own… but some of the other teams were simply better at playing the game. They buzzed in more quickly, or questioned the wording of possibly-correct answers to get them dismissed.

Darius, of course, protested everything. "Did you see that Magistracy team start working the judge after we got on a roll?"

Seeing {TGT_MW.Callsign} staring morosely into {TGT_MW.Det} drink, Darius shakes {TGT_MW.Obj} encouragingly by the shoulders. "Don't worry about it! At least we broke even, Besides, I hate to toss C-Bills away on a rigged game. Unless I'm the one cheating, of course."
column2:
多亏了 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]，你的小队才勉强撑住了场面……可有些队伍就是更擅长玩这个游戏。他们抢答更快，或者揪住某个可能正确的答案的措辞不放，把对手的答案判掉。

Darius 自然什么都抗议。“你看见了吗？我们刚连对几题，那支 Magistracy 的队伍就开始给裁判做工作了。”

看到 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 闷闷不乐地盯着 {TGT_MW.Det} 杯子，Darius 扶着 {TGT_MW.Obj} 的肩膀鼓励地晃了晃。“别往心里去！至少我们没赔本。再说，我可不想把钱扔在一场被人做了手脚的赌局上。当然，除非做手脚的是我自己。”

column1:
You garnish [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s wages to pay for the repairs.

Darius secures new parts and the Techs work overtime to patch up the smoking remains of the stabilizer. It smells like burnt hair, but there are no more incidents of late-night turbulence.

When you pass {TGT_MW.Callsign} in the barracks, {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:avert|Default:averts} {TGT_MW.DET} gaze and {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:fidget|Default:fidgets} with the zipper on {TGT_MW.DET} uniform.

"Chin up, MechWarrior. You should count yourself lucky to be alive, let alone allowed to stay aboard this ship." {TGT_MW.Callsign} nods dutifully but avoids the mess for the rest of the week.
column2:
你从 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 的薪水里扣钱支付维修费用。

Darius 搞到了新零件，技师们加班加点，把稳定器冒烟的残骸修补好。闻起来像烧焦的头发，不过深夜颠簸的事故再没发生过。

你在营房过道里碰到 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 时，{TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:avert|Default:averts} {TGT_MW.DET} 的目光，{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:fidget|Default:fidgets} 着 {TGT_MW.DET} 制服上的拉链。

“抬起头来，机甲战士。你该庆幸自己还活着，更别说还能留在这艘船上。”{TGT_MW.Callsign} 老老实实地点了点头，但接下来整整一周都躲着食堂走。

column1:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] raises {TGT_MW.DET} chin, looking you in the eye. "I'll be more careful."

"Oh, I know you will." You clasp {TGT_MW.Callsign} on the shoulder. "You've been assigned to reflex and precision training."

{TGT_MW.Callsign} opens {TGT_MW.DET} mouth to interject, but you raise a hand. "Let's make sure there are no more accidents, MechWarrior. You're lucky we didn't have to mop you off the floor." 

The next day {TGT_MW.Callsign} points out a handmade sign in the barracks. It reads: "Days since last explosion: 1."

{TGT_MW.Callsign} gives you a wry smile. "Next time I destabilize a DropShip, it'll be because you ordered me to."
column2:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 抬起 {TGT_MW.DET} 下巴，直视着你的眼睛。“我会更小心的。”

“哦，我知道你会的。”你抓住 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 的肩膀。“你被安排去参加反应与精准度训练。”

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 张开 {TGT_MW.DET} 嘴想要插话，但你抬起一只手。“我们得确保不再出事故，机甲战士。你运气好，我们不用拿拖把把你从地板上铲起来。”

第二天，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 指着营房里一块手写的牌子。上面写着：“距上次爆炸天数：1。”

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 冲你苦笑了一下。“下次我再把空投艇弄失稳，那一定是因为你下的命令。”

column1:
It wasn't your imagination after all. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] really has been hiding a kitten in {TGT_MW.DET} room, and now that they're both in front of you, the cat is making all sorts of noise at the indignity of being held up for inspection.

You fix {TGT_MW.Callsign} with a stern look until {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:start|Default:starts} talking.

"Commander, I found this cat in my bag after I came back from shore leave. I think she climbed in looking for food. I didn't have the heart to, you know…"
column2:
原来不是你的错觉。[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 确实把一只小猫藏在 {TGT_MW.DET} 房间里，而现在它们俩都站在你面前，猫正因为被举起来接受检查这种屈辱而叫个不停。

你板着脸盯着 {TGT_MW.Callsign}，直到 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:start|Default:starts} 开口。

“指挥官，我休假回来以后，在包里发现了这只猫。我想她是钻进来找吃的。我实在不忍心，你知道的……”

column1: All right, you tell [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. "The cat can stay. There is a fine naval tradition of ship's cats to uphold. But if she's going to be a member of this crew, she needs a name. Have you given her one?"\n
column2: \n{TGT_MW.Callsign} shakes {TGT_MW.DET} head. "Not yet, Commander."\n

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 张开 {TGT_MW.DET} 嘴想要插话，但你抬起一只手。“我们得确保不再出事故，机甲战士。你运气好，我们不用拿拖把把你从地板上铲起来。”

第二天，你注意到营房里有一块手写的牌子。“距上次爆炸天数：1。”

column1:
You assign [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] two weeks of hard labor to pay for the repairs.

Later that day, {TGT_MW.Callsign} nearly topples a cart of dinnerware in the mess. You grab {TGT_MW.OBJ} by the shoulder, wrenching {TGT_MW.OBJ} back forcefully. "Pay attention, {TGT_MW.Callsign}." 

{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:stammer|Default:stammers} out a response, but you cut {TGT_MW.OBJ} off, remaining firm in front of the pilots gathered in the hall.

The next time you hear about {TGT_MW.Callsign}, there has been another accident: a small explosion in the Mech Bay. No one is hurt, but Yang scrambles to repair the equipment. Darius secures more parts and the Techs work overtime to patch up the smoking remains.
column2:
你罚 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 干两周苦役，以抵偿维修费用。

当天晚些时候，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 在食堂差点撞翻一整车的餐具。你一把抓住 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 的肩膀，用力把 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 拽了回来。“注意点，{TGT_MW.Callsign}。”

{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:stammer|Default:stammers} 着想辩解几句，但你打断 {TGT_MW.OBJ}，在食堂里聚集的机师面前毫不松口。

你下次听到 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 的消息时，又出了一起事故：机甲库发生了一场小爆炸。没人受伤，但 Yang 手忙脚乱地抢修设备。Darius 弄来更多零件，技师们加班加点修补那堆冒烟的残骸。

column1:
It's Trivia Night, and one of the largest casinos in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} is packed. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] entered and has been on a hot streak.

"Come on, Commander!" Darius leans closer, but still has to shout to be heard. "{TGT_MW.Callsign} just got the last six answers right. Even at a minimum bet, we would have made ¢5,000. Let's see if we can make some money tonight!"

Just then, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] totters past, drink in hand. Darius grabs {SCN_MW.OBJ}. "Better yet, {SCN_MW.Callsign} here gives us four for a high-stakes competition team."
column2:
今天是问答之夜，{TGT_SYSTEM.Name} 最大的赌场之一里挤得水泄不通。[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 报了名，而且一路手气火热。

“来嘛，指挥官！”Darius 凑近了些，但还是得扯着嗓子喊才能被听见。“{TGT_MW.Callsign} 刚刚连着答对了最后六道题。就算按最低赌注算，我们也能赢 ¢5,000。今晚咱们试试赚点钱吧！”

就在这时，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 端着酒杯摇摇晃晃地走过。Darius 一把拉住 {SCN_MW.OBJ}。“更妙的是，这位 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 能凑出第四个人，正好组一支高额赌注的参赛队。”

column1: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] responds, "Right away, Commander. We'll save what we can." At the next morning briefing, Dr. Murad gives an update. "The MechWarriors were able to extinguish the fire with minimal damage to the hab and no injuries. It really was a heroic effort on their part." She continues, "Now, this fire was caused by a fault in the power system itself, which not-incidentally also disabled the Argo's automated fire suppression systems. I strongly advise upgrading the ship's power conduits as soon as possible."
column2: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 回答：“马上就去，指挥官。能救多少我们就救多少。” 第二天早上的简报会上，Murad 博士通报了最新情况。“机甲战士们把火扑灭了，居住舱损伤很小，无人受伤。他们这次真是英勇之举。” 她接着说：“这场火是电力系统本身的故障引起的，而这次故障还顺带让阿尔戈号的自动灭火系统失灵了。我强烈建议尽快升级本舰的电力导管。”

column1: Speaking into the comm, you address your MechWarrior. "You want to try putting it out yourself, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]?" {TGT_MW.Callsign} shouts out a hasty reply: "Happy to do so if it saves our stuff!" In the background, you hear [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]'s protestations. At the next morning briefing, Dr. Murad gives an update. "{TGT_MW.Callsign} was able to extinguish the fire, but not before significant damage to the hab. Additionally, {TGT_MW.Subj} inhaled too much smoke and ended up in the MedBay for treatment. Now, this fire was caused by a fault in the power system itself, which not-incidentally also disabled the Argo's automated fire suppression systems. I strongly advise upgrading the ship's power conduits as soon as possible."
column2: 你对着通讯器向你的机甲战士发话。“你想自己试着把火扑灭吗，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]？” {TGT_MW.Callsign} 匆忙回了句：“只要能保住我们的东西，我很乐意！”背景里，你听见 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 在出声反对。 第二天早上的简报会上，Murad 博士通报了最新情况。“{TGT_MW.Callsign} 把火扑灭了，但居住舱已经严重受损。此外，{TGT_MW.Subj} 吸入过多浓烟，最后进了医疗舱接受治疗。嗯，这场火是电力系统本身的故障引起的，而这次故障还顺带让阿尔戈号的自动灭火系统失灵了。我强烈建议尽快升级本舰的电力导管。”

column1: Speaking into the comm, you address your MechWarrior. "You want to try putting it out yourself, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]?" {TGT_MW.Callsign} shouts out a hasty reply: "Happy to do so if it saves our stuff!" In the background, you hear [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]'s protestations. At the next morning briefing, Dr. Murad gives an update. "{TGT_MW.Callsign} was able to single-handedly extinguish the fire, preventing damage to the hab and avoiding getting injured {TGT_MW.Refl}." She continues, "Now, this fire was caused by a fault in the power system itself, which not-incidentally also disabled the Argo's automated fire suppression systems. I strongly advise upgrading the ship's power conduits as soon as possible."
column2: 你对着通讯器向你的机甲战士发话。“你想自己试着把火扑灭吗，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]？” {TGT_MW.Callsign} 匆忙回了句：“只要能保住我们的东西，我很乐意！”背景里，你听见 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 在出声反对。 第二天早上的简报会上，Murad 博士通报了最新情况。“{TGT_MW.Callsign} 单枪匹马扑灭了大火，保住了居住舱，还躲过了受伤的风险 {TGT_MW.Refl}。” 她接着说：“这场火是电力系统本身的故障引起的，而这次故障还顺带让阿尔戈号的自动灭火系统失灵了。我强烈建议尽快升级本舰的电力导管。”

column1: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] responds, "Right away, Commander! We'll save what we can." At the next morning briefing, Dr. Murad gives an update. "The MechWarriors were able to extinguish the fire, but they inhaled too much smoke and ended up in the MedBay for treatment." She continues, "Now, this fire was caused by a fault in the power system itself, which not-incidentally also disabled the Argo's automated fire suppression systems. I strongly advise upgrading the ship's power conduits as soon as possible."
column2: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 回答：“马上就去，指挥官！能救多少我们就救多少。” 第二天早上的简报会上，Murad 博士通报了最新情况。“机甲战士们把火扑灭了，但他们吸入过多浓烟，最后进了医疗舱接受治疗。” 她接着说：“这场火是电力系统本身的故障引起的，而这次故障还顺带让阿尔戈号的自动灭火系统失灵了。我强烈建议尽快升级本舰的电力导管。”

column1:
Yang rummages around for an old-fashioned clipboard. "We track tech that old with printed forms. Write out the part number, and I'll start looking for it," he says, handing [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] a pen.

Then he hides his expression with his mechanical hand and waits.

{TGT_MW.Callsign} mutters, "B A—is there a dash?—eleven hundred…" As {TGT_MW.Gender?Male:he's|Female:she's|NonBinary:they're} halfway through the N, {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:freeze|Default:freezes}, then {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:look|Default:looks} up at Yang. "Chief? What's going on?"

Yang says, "Well, {TGT_MW.Callsign}, it looks to me like you've just requisitioned a balloon for your 'Mech. We only have red ones. That okay?"

{TGT_MW.Callsign} dashes off, yelling, "[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]! I'm gonna get you for this!" As soon as {TGT_MW.Gender?Male:he's|Female:she's|NonBinary:they're} gone, you and Yang burst out laughing.
column2:
Yang 翻箱倒柜找出一块老式写字板。“那么老的器材，我们得用纸质表格登记。把零件编号写下来，我就开始找。”他说着，递给 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 一支笔。

然后他用机械手挡住自己的表情，等着。

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 咕哝着：“B A——中间有横杠吗？——一千一百……”写到 N 的一半时，{TGT_MW.Gender?Male:he's|Female:she's|NonBinary:they're} {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:freeze|Default:freezes} 住了，接着 {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:look|Default:looks} 头看向 Yang。“主管？这是怎么回事？”

Yang 说：“这个嘛，{TGT_MW.Callsign}，在我看来，你刚刚给自己的机甲申领了一只气球。我们只有红色的。行吗？”

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 冲了出去，喊着：“[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]！这账我记你头上了！”等 {TGT_MW.Gender?Male:he's|Female:she's|NonBinary:they're} 一走，你和 Yang 就大笑起来。

column1:
In the Command Center, the comm system squawks."Command? Anybody?" It's [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], with a nervy edge in {TGT_MW.Det} voice. "There's a big fire in the Barracks! Everybody's out, but… not our stuff. Is there anything else I can do?"

Dr. Murad calls out a reply. "How did…" Her voice is sharp with alarm. Moments later, she continues: "…Commander, I've turned off power and ventilation, but the fire won't go out while there's oxygen to burn. I'm going to have to remotely vent the pod."

"Commander, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] just found some dusty fire extinguishers behind a panel!" says {TGT_MW.Callsign}.
column2:
指挥中心里，通讯系统发出刺耳的响声。“指挥部？有人在吗？”是 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]，{TGT_MW.Det} 的声音里透着一丝紧绷。“营房着起大火了！人都出来了，可是……东西还在里面。我还能做点什么吗？”

Murad 博士出声回应。“怎么会……”她的声音因警觉而尖锐起来。片刻之后，她接着说：“……指挥官，我已经切断了电力和通风，可只要有氧气助燃，火就不会熄。恐怕我得远程给那个舱段泄压了。”

“指挥官，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 刚在一块面板后面找到了几个积满灰的灭火器！”{TGT_MW.Callsign} 说。

column1: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s protestations are abruptly cut off by Dr. Murad's brisk response. "Venting now, Commander." The entire Argo wobbles as flame follows air out of the decompressed hab pod, and then winks out. At the next morning briefing, Dr. Murad gives an update. "We extinguished the fire, but both problem and solution wreaked havoc on the interior spaces. That will be expensive. Now, this fire was caused by a fault in the power system itself, which not-incidentally also disabled the Argo's automated fire suppression systems. I strongly advise upgrading the ship's power conduits as soon as possible." Meanwhile, the MechWarriors pick through their ruined belongings, salvaging some, but throwing out most of the rest.
column2: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 的反对被 Murad 博士干脆的回应骤然打断。“现在泄压，指挥官。” 随着火焰追着空气冲出失压的居住舱段，整艘阿尔戈号都晃了一下，接着火就熄灭了。 第二天早上的简报会上，Murad 博士通报了最新情况。“火扑灭了，可问题和解决办法都给舱内空间造成了严重破坏。这会很费钱。嗯，这场火是电力系统本身的故障引起的，而这次故障还顺带让阿尔戈号的自动灭火系统失灵了。我强烈建议尽快升级本舰的电力导管。” 与此同时，机甲战士们翻拣着被毁的家当，救回了一些，其余大部分只能扔掉。

column1:
After hearing that [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] was involved in an accident, you stop by MedBay to visit the MechWarrior as {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:recover|Default:recovers}.

"Hi, Commander." {TGT_MW.Callsign} touches the bandage on {TGT_MW.DET} head. "I was doing pull-ups on the wall shelf, and it came loose. The shelf above it came down, too. Right on my head."

You shake your head, frowning. "You know those shelves aren't rated for your weight."

{TGT_MW.Callsign} laughs. "I wish I had a better option, Commander. There's just not enough room to roam right now."
column2:
听说 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 出了事故，你顺路去医疗舱探望，此时 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:recover|Default:recovers}。

“嗨，指挥官。”{TGT_MW.Callsign} 摸了摸 {TGT_MW.DET} 头上的绷带。“我在墙上那层架子上做引体向上，结果它松了。上面那层架子也塌了下来。正好砸在我头上。”

你皱着眉摇了摇头。“你知道那些架子承受不住你的体重。”

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 笑了。“我也想有更好的选择，指挥官。可眼下实在没地方活动。”

column1:
Under a white sheet in the MedBay, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s lifeless body lies between you and Darius. "By the time the MedTechs started operating, {TGT_MW.Callsign} was beyond repair, Commander. {TGT_MW.DET_C} injuries were exacerbated by {TGT_MW.DET} [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTBI],TBI]]."

You pass a photo of {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s mother to the XO. "Make sure you find her and any other next of kin. Inform them immediately."

The XO nods. "There's more. I overheard [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] talking like you got {TGT_MW.Callsign} killed. {SCN_MW.SUBJ_C} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:weren't|Default:wasn't} the only one. You need to get ahead of these rumors fast."

"{TGT_MW.Callsign} knew the risks. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} wanted back in the cockpit more than anything."

"You and I know that, but not everyone sees it that way. During the memorial service, you could take ownership of {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s death—appease your critics—but that won't exactly boost morale. Or you can commemorate {TGT_MW.Callsign}. That'll lift spirits, though {SCN_MW.Callsign} might take it the wrong way. It's your call, Commander."
column2:
医疗舱里，白布单下 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 毫无生气的遗体横在你和 Darius 之间。“医疗技师开始手术时，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 已经救不回来了，指挥官。{TGT_MW.DET_C} 的伤势因为 {TGT_MW.DET} [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTBI],TBI]] 而进一步恶化。”

你把 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 母亲的照片递给副官。“务必找到她，以及任何其他近亲。立刻通知他们。”

副官点了点头。“还有别的事。我听到 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 在说，是你害死了 {TGT_MW.Callsign}。{SCN_MW.SUBJ_C} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:weren't|Default:wasn't} 唯一这么想的人。你得赶紧抢在这些流言前面。”

“{TGT_MW.Callsign} 清楚风险。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} 比什么都想重新坐回驾驶舱。”

“你我都明白这一点，可不是每个人都这么看。追悼会上，你可以把 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 的死揽在自己身上——安抚那些批评你的人——但那不会真的提升士气。或者你可以追思 {TGT_MW.Callsign}。这能鼓舞人心，不过 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 可能会想歪。由你决定，指挥官。”

column1: You gaze down at the vague shape of [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] beneath the covering. "{TGT_MW.DET_C} death falls on my shoulders, no matter what. I'll take full responsibility." In the evening, the mess is crowded with grief-stricken faces. You climb onto a table, raising your voice. "In this business, there are no guarantees. We all know it. But we fight like hell to beat the odds. {TGT_MW.Callsign} never stopped fighting. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:were|Default:was} a talented MechWarrior and a friend. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C}'ll be missed, but I don't regret a moment we spent together." A murmur stirs the crowd, but [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] nods with approval. "Now you might have heard that {TGT_MW.Callsign} returned to combat, despite {TGT_MW.DET} critical condition. It's true. {TGT_MW.Callsign} asked me to keep {TGT_MW.OBJ} on the roster. This outfit was all {TGT_MW.SUBJ} had left. It was my call in the end. I honored {TGT_MW.DET} request. I hope you will, too." Half-hearted applause follows your speech. Weary eyes meet your gaze, while others stand dazed. In the following days, the air in the Argo feels heavy with anguish, but {SCN_MW.Callsign} pulls you aside. "It must have been hard to stand up there, but you didn't shy away from your responsibility. That takes guts. I'm glad you're leading us."
column2: 你低头看着白布下 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 模糊的轮廓。“无论怎样，{TGT_MW.DET_C} 的死都算在我头上。我会承担全部责任。” 当晚，食堂里挤满了悲痛的面孔。你爬上一张桌子，提高嗓门。“干我们这一行，从来没有保障。这一点我们都清楚。可我们还是拼了命去搏那点胜算。{TGT_MW.Callsign} 从未停止过战斗。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:were|Default:was} 一位出色的机甲战士，也是我们的朋友。我们会怀念 {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C}，但我不后悔我们一起度过的每一天。” 人群中响起一阵低语，而 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 赞许地点了点头。 “你们可能已经听说，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 在 {TGT_MW.DET} 伤势危重的情况下仍然重返战场。这是真的。{TGT_MW.Callsign} 请求我把 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 留在名册上。这支队伍是 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} 仅剩的一切。最终的决定是我做的。我尊重了 {TGT_MW.DET} 的请求。希望你们也能。” 你的讲话换来稀稀拉拉的掌声。疲惫的目光迎上你的视线，另一些人则茫然地站着。接下来的日子里，阿尔戈号上的空气沉重得令人窒息，但 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 把你拉到一旁。“站在那儿讲话一定很难，可你没有回避自己的责任。这需要胆量。我很高兴是你在带领我们。”

column1: Tonight will be about [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. You can almost make out {TGT_MW.DET} serene expression beneath the thin sheet. "We'll commemorate {TGT_MW.DET} life." In the evening, the mess is crowded with grief-stricken faces. You climb onto a table, raising your voice. "{TGT_MW.Callsign} was prepared to put {TGT_MW.DET} life on the line for this company. That's what {TGT_MW.SUBJ} signed up for. But that doesn't make saying goodbye any easier." Acknowledgment ripples through the crowd. Your gaze lingers on [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], but {SCN_MW.SUBJ} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:look|Default:looks} away. You continue, "I can still remember when {TGT_MW.SUBJ} first joined this company. I thought {TGT_MW.Callsign} was an odd callsign. Still do, in fact. I also remember visiting {TGT_MW.OBJ} in the MedBay after {TGT_MW.SUBJ} took a big hit. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:were|Default:was} hurting. I could see it. The future frightened {TGT_MW.Callsign}, but {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:were|Default:was} brave, too. {TGT_MW.Callsign} knew the risks, but {TGT_MW.SUBJ} still wanted to serve with this crew. We were {TGT_MW.DET} family. I won't mourn {TGT_MW.DET} death, but I will give thanks for {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s life each day." The crew erupts in applause, but {SCN_MW.Callsign} is nowhere in sight. More bittersweet stories follow, and the tales everyone shares fill the Argo with a lasting sense of pride and determination. But {SCN_MW.Callsign} becomes increasingly adversarial.
column2: “今晚属于 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。”你几乎能看清薄布单下 {TGT_MW.DET} 安详的神情。“我们要追思 {TGT_MW.DET} 的一生。” 当晚，食堂里挤满了悲痛的面孔。你爬上一张桌子，提高嗓门。“{TGT_MW.Callsign} 愿意为这支队伍豁出 {TGT_MW.DET} 性命。{TGT_MW.SUBJ} 报名时就是这么选的。可这并不能让告别变得容易些。” 人群中泛起一阵认同的低语。你的目光在 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 身上停留，可 {SCN_MW.SUBJ} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:look|Default:looks} 开了视线。 你接着说：“我还记得 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} 刚加入这支队伍的样子。我当时觉得 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 这个呼号挺怪的。说实话现在还是这么觉得。我也记得去医疗舱看望 {TGT_MW.OBJ}，那是在 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} 挨了一记重击之后。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:were|Default:was} 很痛苦。我看得出来。{TGT_MW.Callsign} 害怕未来，但 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:were|Default:was} 同样勇敢。{TGT_MW.Callsign} 清楚风险，但 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} 仍然想和这群船员一起作战。我们是 {TGT_MW.DET} 的家人。我不会为 {TGT_MW.DET} 的死哀悼，但我会每天为 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 的生命送上感谢。” 船员们爆发出掌声，可 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 却不见踪影。之后又有更多苦乐参半的故事，大家分享的往事让阿尔戈号上弥漫着持久的自豪与决心。但 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 变得越来越充满敌意。

column1:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] considers your suggestion. "Back in the service, we used to run five klicks every morning before breakfast."

You can see the wheels start spinning, "We don't have much space in here. Whatever we do, we're bound to get in somebody's way. Maybe some simple bodyweight exercises… Yeah, I think I can come up with something!"

{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:look|Default:looks} at you hopefully, "Hey, Commander, when this ship was new, there was a gym in Beta Pod, right?"

You nod. "Your interest is noted, {TGT_MW.Callsign}."
column2:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 考虑着你的建议。“当年在部队里，我们每天早上吃早饭前都要跑五公里。”

你能看出那家伙脑子开始转起来了：“我们这儿没多少地方。不管做什么，肯定会挡着别人的路。也许可以做些简单的自重训练……对，我想我能琢磨出点东西来！”

{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:look|Default:looks} 满怀期待地看着你：“嘿，指挥官，这艘船刚下水的时候，Beta 舱段里有一间健身房，对吧？”

你点了点头。“你的意见我记下了，{TGT_MW.Callsign}。”

column1:
Over the next week, you and Darius develop a daily training routine for the MechWarriors involving simple bodyweight exercises and jogging laps around the Alpha Pod corridors.

When [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] gets out of MedBay, {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:join|Default:joins} in with enthusiasm.

Darius reports that the warriors are in better spirits and hopes this will help keep them out of trouble. "Y'know, {COMMANDER.FirstName}, we should really consider reopening the damaged gymnasium in Beta Pod."
column2:
接下来一周，你和 Darius 为机甲战士们制定了一套日常训练计划，包括简单的自重训练和绕 Alpha 舱段走廊慢跑。

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 一出医疗舱，{TGT_MW.SUBJ} 就热情地 {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:join|Default:joins} 了进来。

Darius 报告说战士们的精神状态好多了，希望这能帮他们少惹麻烦。“你知道吧，{COMMANDER.FirstName}，我们真该考虑重新开放 Beta 舱段那间损坏的健身房。”

column1:
Over the next week, you and Darius develop a daily training routine for the MechWarriors involving simple bodyweight exercises and jogging laps around the Alpha Pod corridors.

When [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] gets out of MedBay, {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:join|Default:joins} the training.

Darius reports that the warriors are grumpy about having exercise imposed on them, but he hopes that this will help keep them out of trouble. "If we repair and reopen the gymnasium in Beta Pod, that would probably be better received."
column2:
接下来一周，你和 Darius 为机甲战士们制定了一套日常训练计划，包括简单的自重训练和绕 Alpha 舱段走廊慢跑。

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 一出医疗舱，{TGT_MW.SUBJ} 就 {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:join|Default:joins} 了训练。

Darius 报告说战士们对被强加锻炼这事颇有怨言，但他希望这能帮他们少惹麻烦。“要是我们把 Beta 舱段的健身房修好重新开放，他们大概会更容易接受。”

column1:
Later in the week, Darius reports that the MechWarriors have grown increasingly frustrated with the cramped quarters. "They've begun improvising their own exercise program, and they're using the entire ship to do it."

Yang is positively steaming. "If they run laps through my Mech Bay one more time, I'm gonna drop a 'Mech on one of 'em!"

Dr. Murad consults her ever-present datapad. "Just a thought, Commander… but if we were to repair and reopen the gymnasium in Beta Pod, I imagine that would help?"
column2:
这周晚些时候，Darius 报告说机甲战士们对拥挤的住处越来越不满。“他们开始自己琢磨锻炼方式了，而且动用了整艘船。”

Yang 气得直冒烟。“他们要是再在我机甲库里跑圈，我就把一台机甲砸到他们头上！”

Murad 博士查了查她那块形影不离的数据板。“只是提个想法，指挥官……要是我们把 Beta 舱段的健身房修好重新开放，我想会有帮助？”

column1:
You've placed a difficult burden on me, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], you say. "We can't have unlicensed animals running around the ship. So we have to do something about this."

Downcast, {TGT_MW.Callsign} begins, "Commander, I—"

You interrupt {TGT_MW.OBJ} and continue, "We'll just have to license this cat as a member of the crew. That requires a name. Have you given her one?"

{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:blink|Default:blinks} in surprise. "No, no I haven't."
column2: \nYou lift up the kitten and intone, "Since this is the Argo, we'll call her Artemis, after the ancient goddess of the hunt. She'll have a fine naval tradition of ship's cats to uphold. But don't think you're off the hook for this, {TGT_MW.Callsign}."

column1: You receive a call from Dr. Murad. "Commander, the Argo is testing me. I have a negative reading from one of our rotational assembly's coupling joints. If it's not repaired quickly, it'll shut down our grav modules. "Our problem joint is near the reactor shielding, in a very hard to reach place. I can try to patch around it, but I'm not sure that will work. "What I'd prefer to do is have someone go EVA to perform the repair. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] has plenty of experience with external ship work, and is ready to attempt the fix. Now, it's a bit risky, and I know how you value your MechWarriors. I'd like your call before I authorize the repair."
column2: 你接到 Murad 博士的电话。“指挥官，阿尔戈号在考验我。旋转组件的联轴节传出了异常读数。要是不尽快修好，我们的重力模块就得停摆。 “出问题的那处联轴节在反应堆屏蔽层附近，位置非常难够到。我可以试着绕过去打补丁，但我不确定管不管用。 “我更倾向于派人做舱外活动来完成这次维修。[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 在舰外作业方面经验丰富，也准备好尝试这次修复。不过这事有点风险，我知道你有多看重你的机甲战士。在批准维修之前，我想听听你的决定。”

column1:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] joins you on a supply run in one of {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}'s major cities. As the trip winds down, you realize you're being followed. Not long after, a dirty man with a dangerous sneer steps in front of {TGT_MW.Callsign}. "We've been looking for you, {TGT_MW.Firstname}," he says as several more figures close in around you.

You look the man over. "What's this about, {TGT_MW.Callsign}?"

"Ah, this is a little creep I used to know, Commander. Back before I joined up with you. I don't think he likes me much anymore."
column2:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 和你一起去 {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} 的一座主要城市采购补给。行程接近尾声时，你发现有人在跟踪你们。没过多久，一个满身脏污、笑容阴狠的男人挡在 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 面前。“我们找你很久了，{TGT_MW.Firstname}。”他说着，又有几个人影围了上来。

你打量了一下那个男人。“{TGT_MW.Callsign}，这是怎么回事？”

“啊，这是我以前认识的一个小混混，指挥官。那是在我跟着你之前的事了。我觉得他现在不太喜欢我。”

column1: You shove the man out of the way and run, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] right beside you. The other men are surprised, which allows you to get some distance before they give chase. The pursuit lasts several blocks before you lose them in the crowded streets.\n\nOn the flight back to the Argo, you ask {TGT_MW.Callsign} if there are any more ghosts from {TGT_MW.DET} past you should know about. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:sigh|Default:sighs}. "Probably."
column2: 你一把把那男人推开，拔腿就跑，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 紧跟在旁。其他人没反应过来，让你们先拉开了一段距离，他们才追上来。追了几条街，你们才在拥挤的人群里甩掉他们。\n\n返回阿尔戈号的途中，你问 {TGT_MW.Callsign}，{TGT_MW.DET} 的过去还有没有别的鬼魂是你该知道的。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:sigh|Default:sighs}。“大概有吧。”

column1:
The next day, MechWarriors and crew crowd into a narrow barracks hallway to watch [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] face off against [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] in one final game of corridor bocce.

In what turns out to be the last play, {TGT_MW.Callsign} makes an unfortunate throw that causes {TGT_MW.DET} ball to ricochet off a protruding service panel, bounce up, and hit {SCN_MW.Callsign} square in the nose. {SCN_MW.SUBJ_C} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:collapse|Default:colllapses} to the floor in a heap.

Despite the outcome, the crew continue to talk about the match for days afterward, and visit {SCN_MW.Callsign} in the MedBay for some light-hearted ribbing.
column2:
第二天，机甲战士和船员们挤在营房狭窄的走廊里，围观 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 与 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 最后一场走廊滚球对决。

在最后一投中，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 那一掷不幸失手，{TGT_MW.DET} 的球从一块凸出的检修面板上弹开，跳起来正中 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 的鼻子。{SCN_MW.SUBJ_C} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:collapse|Default:colllapses} 倒在地上一动不动。

尽管结果如此，船员们之后好几天都在谈论这场比赛，还去医疗舱看望 {SCN_MW.Callsign}，善意地打趣一番。

column1:
You give permission for the MechWarriors to continue to play their game.

The next day, MechWarriors and crew crowd into a narrow barracks hallway to watch [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] face off against [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]].

In the winning play, {TGT_MW.Callsign} bounces {TGT_MW.DET} final ball off the corridor wall twice to send {SCN_MW.Callsign}'s ball spinning away from scoring marker. The crew erupts in cheers, and continue to talk about it for days afterward.
column2:
你准许机甲战士们继续玩他们的游戏。

第二天，机甲战士和船员们挤在营房狭窄的走廊里，围观 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 与 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 的对决。

在制胜的一投中，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 让 {TGT_MW.DET} 最后一颗球连撞走廊墙壁两次，把 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 的球撞得远离得分标记。船员们爆发出欢呼，之后好几天都在津津乐道。

column1:
You give permission for the MechWarriors to continue to play their game.

The next day, MechWarriors and crew crowd into a narrow barracks hallway to watch [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] face off against [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]].

Unfortunately, an errant ball from {SCN_MW.Callsign} slams into an exposed power coupling and smashes it, blacking out the corridor and ending the game.

You can almost feel Dr. Murad's displeasure from six decks away. Closer at hand, however, is an "I told you so" look from Darius as he walks over and snatches the ball from {SCN_MW.Callsign}'s hand.
column2:
你准许机甲战士们继续玩他们的游戏。

第二天，机甲战士和船员们挤在营房狭窄的走廊里，围观 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 与 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 的对决。

不幸的是，{SCN_MW.Callsign} 一颗失手球重重砸在一处裸露的电力耦合器上，把它砸得粉碎，走廊一片漆黑，比赛就此结束。

你几乎能感觉到六个甲板之外 Murad 博士的不满。不过更近的是 Darius 那副“我早说过了”的表情——他走过一把从 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 手里抢过球。

The next day, MechWarriors and crew crowd into a narrow barracks hallway to watch [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] face off against [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] in one final game of corridor bocce.

In the winning play, {TGT_MW.Callsign} bounces {TGT_MW.DET} last ball off the corridor wall twice to send {SCN_MW.Callsign}'s spinning away toward the audience.

The crew erupts in cheers, and continue to talk about the match for days afterward.
column2:
第二天，机甲战士和船员们挤在营房狭窄的走廊里，围观 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 与 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 最后一场走廊滚球对决。

在制胜的一投中，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 让 {TGT_MW.DET} 最后一颗球连撞走廊墙壁两次，把 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 的球撞得朝观众那边飞了出去。

船员们爆发出欢呼，之后好几天都在谈论这场比赛。

column1: You're talking to the wrong person, friend, you say to the dirty man. "[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] works for me now. So however your problem started, it ends with me." The lowlife looks at you, and his eyes widen. "Oh, okay. So the thing is, {TGT_MW.Firstname} owes me—" You jab a finger at his chest. "Wrong! {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} no longer {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:owe|Default:owes} you anything. Whatever your connection was, it's dead," you say. "Now get out of my way. I'm busy." The lowlife drops his gaze and steps aside. You and {TGT_MW.Callsign} move on before he can reconsider. On the flight back to the Argo, {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:talk|Default:talks} to you about {TGT_MW.DET} past—a rare event for such a secretive MechWarrior.
column2: “你找错人了，朋友，”你对那个脏兮兮的男人说。“[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 现在替我干活。所以不管你这麻烦是怎么起的，都到我这儿为止。” 那个混混看着你，眼睛睁大了。“哦，好吧。事情是这样的，{TGT_MW.Firstname} 欠我——” 你伸手指着他的胸口。“错！{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} 不再 {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:owe|Default:owes} 你任何东西了。不管你们以前是什么关系，都断了，”你说。“现在让开。我忙着呢。” 那混混垂下目光，退到一边。你和 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 趁他还没反悔就走了。返回阿尔戈号的路上，{TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:talk|Default:talks} 跟你说起了 {TGT_MW.DET} 的过去——对这么一位守口如瓶的机甲战士来说，这可难得。

column1: Everyone aboard the Argo snaps into action. Techs prep the Leopard for takeoff, the bridge crew tracks the incoming debris, and everyone else secures breakables. At last, the Leopard pushes away from the docking collar, spirals gracefully towards the debris cloud, its weapons spitting fire in all directions.\n\nThere's shuddering and banging as the Argo passes through the cloud. Then it's past and the clatter fades away. Darius announces, "Commander, the Barracks suffered extensive damage. [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] was wounded there. And [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] took a minor injury aboard the Leopard."
column2: 阿尔戈号上所有人都立刻行动起来。技师们为豹式做起飞准备，舰桥船员追踪着迎面而来的碎片，其他人则把所有易碎物品固定好。终于，豹式脱离对接环，优雅地螺旋着冲向碎片云，武器朝四面八方喷吐着火舌。\n\n阿尔戈号穿过碎片云时，船体一路震颤、砰砰作响。等它穿过去，噼啪的撞击声才渐渐消失。Darius 通报：“指挥官，营房严重受损。[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 在那里受了伤。另外 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 在豹式上受了点轻伤。”

column1: Everyone aboard the Argo snaps into action. Techs prep the Leopard for takeoff, the bridge crew tracks the incoming debris, and everyone else secures breakables. At last, the Leopard pushes away from the docking collar, spirals gracefully towards the debris cloud, its weapons spitting fire in all directions.\n\nThere's shuddering and banging as the Argo passes through the cloud. Then it's past and the clatter fades away. Darius announces, "Commander, both the MedBay and the Barracks suffered damage, and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] was wounded. Fortunately, that's the only significant damage report."
column2: 阿尔戈号上所有人都立刻行动起来。技师们为豹式做起飞准备，舰桥船员追踪着迎面而来的碎片，其他人则把所有易碎物品固定好。终于，豹式脱离对接环，优雅地螺旋着冲向碎片云，武器朝四面八方喷吐着火舌。\n\n阿尔戈号穿过碎片云时，船体一路震颤、砰砰作响。等它穿过去，噼啪的撞击声才渐渐消失。Darius 通报：“指挥官，医疗舱和营房都受损，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 受了伤。幸好，这就是全部的重大损失报告了。”

At last, the Leopard pushes away from the docking collar, spirals gracefully towards the debris cloud, its weapons spitting fire in all directions.\n\nThere's shuddering and banging as the Argo passes through the cloud. Then it's past and the clatter fades away. Darius announces, "Commander, the Barracks suffered extensive damage, and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] was wounded."
