column1: Emergency klaxons blare as Darius reports, "Commander, this planet's orbit is choked with space junk and an uncharted cloud of debris is about to hit the Argo. There's not much we can do to avoid it on such short notice. If we get hit, we're going to feel it." Sumire grins mischievously. "I could take the Leopard out and mount an aggressive defense! [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] can fire the guns, while I dodge the debris." Darius says, "If we do that, we need to decide which systems to prioritize defending."
column2: 紧急警报尖啸着响起，Darius 报告：“指挥官，这颗行星的轨道上塞满了太空垃圾，一片未标注的碎片云正要撞上阿尔戈号。这么短的时间，我们没什么办法避开。要是被撞上，我们会很不好受。” Sumire 露出调皮的笑容。“我可以把豹式开出去，来一场主动防御！[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 负责开火，我来躲碎片。” Darius 说：“要是这么做，我们就得决定优先防守哪些系统。”

column1:
You're talking to the wrong person, friend, you say to the dirty man. "[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] works for me, now. So however your problem started, it ends with me."

The lowlife shrugs. "Right. You wanna settle {TGT_MW.Firstname}'s debts? Fine by me."

The kick to your leg from behind isn't exactly a shock, but it does take you down to your knees. {TGT_MW.Callsign} lashes out at your attacker, and unavoidable violence ensues.

A few minutes later, all of the thugs are down and {TGT_MW.Callsign} is holding {TGT_MW.DET} side where someone stabbed {TGT_MW.OBJ}. "We don't wanna be here when the police show up," {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:gasp|Default:gasps}.

But once you make it to the shuttle, it's all over except for applying first aid to {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s wound.
column2:
“你找错人了，朋友，”你对那个脏兮兮的男人说。“[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 现在替我干活。所以不管你这麻烦是怎么起的，都到我这儿为止。”

那混混耸了耸肩。“行啊。你想替 {TGT_MW.Firstname} 还债？我没意见。”

从背后踹在你腿上的那一脚并不算意外，但确实把你踹得跪了下去。{TGT_MW.Callsign} 朝袭击你的人扑了上去，一场混战就此不可避免。

几分钟后，所有打手都倒下了，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 捂着 {TGT_MW.DET} 腰侧，那里有人捅了 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 一刀。“我们最好在警察来之前离开这儿，”{TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:gasp|Default:gasps}。

不过等你们赶到穿梭机，除了给 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 的伤口做急救，别的事都结束了。

column1:
This is obviously going to be a fight, so you get things started early by sucker punching [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s old pal. Meanwhile, {TGT_MW.Callsign} slugs another old friend in the gut. Then the rest charge, and everything devolves into a confusion of fists and arms and heavy boots.

Some time later, you're swinging at someone's bloody face as he backs away, and you realize he's the last enemy left. {TGT_MW.Callsign} is bent over trying to catch {TGT_MW.DET} breath and the lead lowlife is gone, along with most of his gang. "Go on, get out of here!" you tell the last one. He turns and runs.

You offer {TGT_MW.Callsign} your hand. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:say|Default:says}, "That was a good scrap, Commander. But we'd better go, too."
column2:
这显然要打一场，所以你抢先动手，一拳偷袭了 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 的老相识。与此同时，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 也一拳砸在另一个老朋友的肚子上。接着其余人一拥而上，一切乱成一团拳头、胳膊和沉重军靴的混战。

不知过了多久，你正挥拳打着某人血肉模糊的脸，那人一步步后退，你才意识到他是最后一个对手。{TGT_MW.Callsign} 弯着腰想喘过 {TGT_MW.DET} 气来，那个领头的混混已经不见了，他的手下也大多没了踪影。“滚吧，快滚！”你对最后那人说。他转身就跑。

你向 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 伸出手。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:say|Default:says}：“打得挺痛快，指挥官。不过我们也该走了。”

column1: This is obviously going to be a fight, so you get things started early by sucker punching [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s old pal. Meanwhile, {TGT_MW.Callsign} slugs another thug in the gut. Then the rest charge, and you're quickly overwhelmed by sheer numbers. The fight is going poorly enough that when the local police arrive, you're relieved.\n\nThree hours later, you've paid a ¢1,000 fine, the medics are done treating {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s injuries, and you're both on your way back to the Argo. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:say|Default:says}, "Sorry about that, Commander. I didn't think that guy was still looking for me."
column2: 这显然要打一场，所以你抢先动手，一拳偷袭了 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 的老相识。与此同时，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 一拳砸在另一个打手的肚子上。接着其余人一拥而上，你们很快就被人数压垮了。这场架打得实在难看，以至于当地警察赶到时，你反而松了口气。\n\n三小时后，你交了 ¢1,000 罚款，医护也处理完了 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 的伤，你们俩踏上返回阿尔戈号的路。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:say|Default:says}：“抱歉，指挥官。我以为那家伙早就不找我了。”

column1: You confirm Darius's decision with a nod. "That's that."\n\nLater in the day, you see [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] in the mess, looking dejected.
column2: 你点头确认了 Darius 的决定。“就这么定了。”\n\n当天晚些时候，你在食堂看见 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 和 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]，两人一脸沮丧。

column1: You sound fired up [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. This isn't easy to say, but you should take [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreGraysonCarlyle],Carlyle]]'s offer. Hell, you can keep the kickback for yourself. You've earned it. You extend a hand. {TGT_MW.Callsign} takes your hand, but unexpectedly hugs you. "I won't forget you, Commander. You taught me everything I know about leadership… and you know we could throw a killer party with some of this extra cash. With your permission, of course." "Granted." You disentangle yourself from {TGT_MW.Callsign}. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} nearly {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:run|Default:runs} out of your quarters. {TGT_MW.DET_C} voice echoes down the corridor as they start spreading the word about the party. Though the details of the celebration are fuzzy, the crew buzzes with excitement after {TGT_MW.Callsign} departs.
column2: “你听起来干劲十足啊，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。这话不好开口，但你应该接受 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreGraysonCarlyle],Carlyle]] 的邀请。见鬼，那笔回扣你可以自己留着。这是你应得的。”你伸出手。 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 握住你的手，却出人意料地抱住了你。“我不会忘了你的，指挥官。关于带队伍，我会的一切都是你教的……而且你知道，有了这笔额外的钱，我们能办一场超棒的派对。当然，得经过你同意。” “准了。”你从 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 的熊抱里脱身。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} 几乎 {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:run|Default:runs} 出了你的舱室。{TGT_MW.DET_C} 的声音在走廊里回荡，开始四处宣扬派对的事。 虽然庆祝的细节已经记不清了，但 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 走后，船员们一直兴奋不已。

column1:
It's never going to work, says [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]].

"It'll work," says [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]].

"And even if it doesn't work, it'll be awesome," says [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]].

You look curiously over at the three MechWarriors clustered around a table in the mess hall. Noticing your interest, {SCN_MW.Callsign} calls you over, showing you a miniature [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreCatapultSiegeWarfare],medieval catapult]] constructed of dried noodles, bits of edible foam and elastic bands.

"…Why?" you ask.

"We were using utensils at first but the cook took them away," says {SCN_MW.Callsign}.

{TRT_MW.Callsign} says, "If we can get it tuned properly, it'll be great for radishes."
column2:
“这玩意儿永远不可能成功，”[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 说。

“它会成功的，”[[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] 说。

“就算不成功，也会很酷，”[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 说。

你好奇地看向食堂里围着桌子凑在一起的三个机甲战士。{SCN_MW.Callsign} 注意到你的兴趣，招呼你过去，给你看一台用干面条、可食用泡沫碎块和橡皮筋搭成的迷你[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreCatapultSiegeWarfare],中世纪投石机]]。

“……为什么？”你问。

“我们一开始用的是餐具，可厨子把它们收走了，”{SCN_MW.Callsign} 说。

{TRT_MW.Callsign} 说：“要是能调校好，用来投萝卜再合适不过了。”

column1:
I'm going to pretend I didn't see this, but if I get any radishes thrown at my head, I'll suddenly remember when it's time for mold-cleaning duty.

Barely minutes after you depart, cries of despair from across the mess hall tell you that the catapult has already fallen apart.

Remembering your own spoon-catapult days, it occurs to you that the cook could use a raise.
column2:
“我就当没看见这事，不过要是有什么萝卜砸到我头上，我就会突然想起该轮到谁去干除霉的活了。”

你走开还不到几分钟，食堂那头传来的绝望呼喊就告诉你，投石机已经散架了。

回想起自己当年拿勺子当投石机的日子，你觉得那厨子真该涨工资了。

column1: Look, if you take [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreGraysonCarlyle],Carlyle]]'s offer—you've got my blessing. Most mercs don't get a chance to do more than make ends meet, if that. You tilt your head. "So, go ahead and 'shake up the galaxy.'" "Really? You wouldn't be mad about me running off on you?" [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] blurts out. "Who said anything about running? You're right here, handling things like a professional. I respect that. Besides, I can't stop you from breaking your contract. But you’d be missed." "It's settled then. I'm joining the Gray Death Legion." {TGT_MW.Callsign} shakes your hand. "You know, I don't think I'd have the guts to do join 'em if it weren't for my time on the Argo. I won't forget you or this crew."
column2: “听着，你要是接受 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreGraysonCarlyle],Carlyle]] 的邀请——我祝福你。大多数佣兵连糊口都难，更别说别的了。”你偏了偏头。“所以去吧，去‘搅动整个银河’。” “真的？我这么跑掉你不生气？”[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 脱口而出。 “谁说要跑了？你现在就在这儿，把事情办得像个专业人士。我敬重这一点。再说，我也拦不住你毁约。但大家会想你的。” “那就这么定了。我加入灰死军团。”{TGT_MW.Callsign} 握了握你的手。“你知道吗，要不是在阿尔戈号上待过，我大概没这个胆量去加入他们。我不会忘了你，也不会忘了这群船员。”

column1:
You shake your head. "I'm not joking around about this, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. I can't allow an unknown animal on board the ship, and we don't have the resources to give it a proper biological check to make sure it isn't carrying parasites or disease."

The kitten squirms in your hands, sharp claws digging at your sleeve. You hand the animal back to the MechWarrior and rest a hand on {TGT_MW.DET} shoulder. "I understand you've started bonding with it, but there's no choice in the matter. You'll have to return it to the surface on the next supply run."

{TGT_MW.Callsign} closes {TGT_MW.DET} eyes and says, "Yes, Commander." The kitten mewls in apparent disagreement with your decision.
column2:
你摇头。“这事我不是在开玩笑，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。我不能允许来路不明的动物上船，我们也没有资源给它做正规的生物检查，确认它有没有携带寄生虫或疾病。”

小猫在你手里挣扎，尖爪抓挠着你的袖子。你把猫递回给那位机甲战士，一只手按在 {TGT_MW.DET} 肩上。“我明白你已经对它产生感情了，但这事没得商量。下次采购补给时，你得把它送回地面。”

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 闭上 {TGT_MW.DET} 眼睛说：“是，指挥官。”小猫喵喵叫着，显然对你的决定表示反对。

column1:
In your quarters, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] points to a compad. "Commander, I got an offer from another company, the Gray Death Legion. Their CO, [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreGraysonCarlyle],Grayson Carlyle]], is paying top dollar for mercs. He's even offering a kickback to any company he 'poaches' from—a hundred thousand C-bills."

"That's unusual," you say, examining the paused image of Carlyle on the compad. "Go on."

"Carlyle's something else. I played his message over and over. The way he talks… I know he really could shake up the galaxy. And I wanna be a part of that." {TGT_MW.Callsign} smiles bittersweetly. "But this crew is my family and leaving isn’t so easy. What do you think?"
column2:
在你的舱室里，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 指着一块便携电脑。“指挥官，另一家公司给了我个邀请，是灰死军团。他们的指挥官 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreGraysonCarlyle],Carlyle]] 出高价招佣兵。他甚至给被他‘挖走’人员的每家公司一笔回扣——十万 C-Bills。”

“这可不太寻常，”你端详着便携电脑上定格的 Carlyle 影像说。“继续说。”

“Carlyle 不是一般人。他的留言我反复听了好几遍。他讲话的样子……我知道他真的能搅动整个银河。我想成为其中的一分子。”{TGT_MW.Callsign} 露出苦乐参半的笑容。“可这群船员是我的家人，离开并不容易。你觉得呢？”

column1: I don't know if the galaxy needs anymore shaking up. It's already a mess, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. Think long and hard before you sign on with [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreGraysonCarlyle],Carlyle]]. Talk is cheap—usually it gets MechWarriors killed. {TGT_MW.Callsign} rubs the back of {TGT_MW.DET} head. "You don't trust him?" "It's not that. I don't know much about Carlyle. But you know we've got your back on the Argo. So it's your decision, {TGT_MW.Callsign}. Just take your time, do some research." {TGT_MW.Callsign} nods slowly. "You're right, I shouldn't make a decision too quickly." Later that night, {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:knock|Default:knocks} on your door. "Just wanted to say that I'll be sticking around. I gave it some serious thought, but I can't imagine a better crew than this one."
column2: “我不知道这个银河还需不需要被搅动。它已经够乱的了，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。在跟 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreGraysonCarlyle],Carlyle]] 签约之前，好好想清楚。空话不值钱——通常只会害死机甲战士。” {TGT_MW.Callsign} 揉了揉 {TGT_MW.DET} 后脑勺。“你不信任他？” “不是这个意思。我对 Carlyle 了解不多。但你知道，在阿尔戈号上我们都支持你。所以决定权在你，{TGT_MW.Callsign}。只是别急，先做点功课。” {TGT_MW.Callsign} 缓缓点了点头。“你说得对，我不该这么快做决定。”当晚，{TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:knock|Default:knocks} 响你的房门。“只是想告诉你，我决定留下来了。我认真考虑过，可想不出比这更好的队伍。”

column1: You watch the pilots work together as a team to get the little toy working. You only feel compelled to give a few hints, but you’re mostly just drinking your coffee.\n\nThe end result is only moderately successful, but you see the exact moment when [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] gains a key insight into the laws of indirect fire. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} excitedly {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:share|Default:shares} the observation with {TGT_MW.DET} fellow MechWarriors.
column2: 你看着机师们齐心协力想让那个小玩意儿动起来。你只觉得自己有必要给几个提示，大多数时候就是喝着咖啡看着。\n\n最终结果只是勉强成功，但你清楚地看到 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 顿悟间接射击原理的那一刻。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} 兴奋地把这个发现 {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:share|Default:shares} 给 {TGT_MW.DET} 的机甲战士同伴。

column1:
With a twinkle in your eye, you tell the others. "I've got an idea. Tell [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] to meet me in the mess-hall this evening. I'll have something for them."

That night, the two MechWarriors arrive to see a strange display awaiting them. Colored hexagons of paper laid out like a map on the table, many sheets of paper with charts and numbers on them, and eight tiny metal BattleMechs.

"MechWarriors—I'd like to teach you a lesson you won't learn in any cockpit. Here, you'll learn to see the big picture of managing the strategic decisions for an entire lance. Against each other!"

{TGT_MW.Callsign} picks up a tiny metal Atlas. "Pew, pew!"
column2:
你眼里闪着光，对其他人说。“我有个主意。告诉 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 和 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]，今晚在食堂等我。我给他们准备了点东西。”

当晚，两位机甲战士到了，看到眼前摆着一副奇怪的阵势。桌上铺着彩色的六边形纸片，像地图一样排开；许多张写满表格和数字的纸；还有八台小小的金属战斗机甲。

“机甲战士们——我想教你们一课，这是在任何驾驶舱里都学不到的。在这里，你们要学会从全局出发，为一整个小队做战略决策。而且是互相对抗！”

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 拿起一台小小的阿特拉斯。“咻，咻！”

column1: You say to Dr. Murad, "We've invested in repairing the power conduits, so the Training Modules are nearly ready, aren't they? Perhaps a little creative engineering could get them up and running temporarily." Dr. Murad answers your challenge with a smile. Several days later, she delivers a report. "Oh. My. God! The network kept going down, the graphics processors were overheating, and [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] got stuck in one of the cockpits when the hatch wouldn't open." After a pregnant pause, she finally laughs. "It was amazing! We have to get these things up and running for real!" She pauses, "Also, I found the phrase 'PropWash was here' scratched into one of the monitors, and 'Wicced FTW' on another. I don't know what they mean, but it looks like they've been there for years…"
column2: 你对 Murad 博士说：“我们已经花钱修好了电力导管，那训练模块也就差不多能用了，对吧？也许稍微动点创造性的工程手段，就能让它们临时运转起来。” Murad 博士微笑着接下了你的挑战。 几天后，她交来一份报告。“我的天哪！网络不停掉线，图形处理器过热，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 还被卡在其中一个驾驶舱里，舱门打不开。” 意味深长的停顿之后，她终于笑了。“太棒了！我们一定得让这些家伙真正运转起来！” 她顿了顿：“还有，我发现一台显示器上刻着‘PropWash was here’，另一台上刻着‘Wicced FTW’。我不知道是什么意思，但看样子已经刻在那儿好多年了……”

column1:
In the morning briefing, Sumire asks something unexpected: "So, what's the story with those MechWarriors bowling in the barracks hallways?"

Darius crosses his arms over his chest. "I've already put an end to that. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] were calling it 'corridor bocce'… I shut it down as a matter of discipline."

You turn to Darius. "How much trouble have their games caused?"

"They're playing in unused corridors, so not much. But it was only a matter of time before something… or someone… got damaged. We should really repair the gym in Beta Pod instead."
column2:
早间简报会上，Sumire 问了个没头没脑的问题：“那么，那些在营房走廊里打保龄球的机甲战士是怎么回事？”

Darius 双臂抱在胸前。“我已经把这事叫停了。[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 和 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 管那叫‘走廊滚球’……我以纪律为由取缔了。”

你转向 Darius。“他们的游戏惹了多少麻烦？”

“他们在闲置的走廊里玩，所以麻烦不大。但迟早会损坏什么东西……或者什么人。我们真该把 Beta 舱段的健身房修起来。”

column1:
With a twinkle in your eye, you tell the others. "I've got an idea. Tell [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] to meet me in the mess hall this evening. I'll have something for them."

That night, the two MechWarriors arrive to see a strange display awaiting them. Colored hexagons of paper laid out like a map on the table, many sheets of paper with charts and numbers on them, and eight tiny metal BattleMechs.

"MechWarriors—I'd like to teach you a lesson you won't learn in any cockpit. Here, you'll learn to see the big picture of managing the strategic decisions for an entire lance. Against each other!"

{TGT_MW.Callsign} picks up a tiny metal Atlas. "Pew, pew!"
column2:
你眼里闪着光，对其他人说。“我有个主意。告诉 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 和 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]，今晚在食堂等我。我给他们准备了点东西。”

当晚，两位机甲战士到了，看到眼前摆着一副奇怪的阵势。桌上铺着彩色的六边形纸片，像地图一样排开；许多张写满表格和数字的纸；还有八台小小的金属战斗机甲。

“机甲战士们——我想教你们一课，这是在任何驾驶舱里都学不到的。在这里，你们要学会从全局出发，为一整个小队做战略决策。而且是互相对抗！”

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 拿起一台小小的阿特拉斯。“咻，咻！”

column1: You watch the pilots try to work together as a team to get the little toy working. Given the number of dead ends they pursue, you feel compelled to give numerous hints as your cup of coffee grows cold.\n\nFinally, after the latest prototype collapses, [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] sweeps the remaining spare parts onto the floor. The project immediately devolves into a squabble, and you call in the other MechWarriors still in the mess hall to separate everyone before more serious forms of violence take place.
column2: 你看着机师们试着齐心协力让那个小玩意儿动起来。鉴于他们走进一条又一条死胡同，你不得不给出大量提示，手里的咖啡也凉了。\n\n终于，在最新的原型机倒塌之后，[[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] 把剩下的备用零件全扫到了地上。这个项目立刻演变成一场争吵，你只好叫来还在食堂的其他机甲战士，在更严重的肢体冲突发生前把大家分开。

column1: You say, "Didn't you ever learn not to play with your food? If you have time to think about shooting radishes, you have time to be training. Get to it."\n\nThe MechWarriors exchange glances and then quickly clean up their supplies and vacate the mess deck. You do notice that [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] takes the supplies with {TRT_MW.OBJ} rather than disposing of them, but conclude it will probably keep {TRT_MW.OBJ} entertained and out of worse trouble.
column2: 你说：“没人教过你不要玩食物吗？你要是有空琢磨怎么射萝卜，就有空去训练。去吧。”\n\n机甲战士们交换了一下眼神，随即迅速收拾好材料，离开了食堂甲板。你注意到 [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] 是把材料连 {TRT_MW.OBJ} 一起带走了，而不是扔掉，不过你判断这大概能让 {TRT_MW.OBJ} 有点消遣，免得去惹更大的麻烦。

column1:
In the morning briefing, Darius has a request to pass along.

"[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] want to get some training outside of getting shot at by lasers planetside."

Dr. Murad observes, "We do have those Training Modules. They'd be ideal, especially for less experienced MechWarriors. But… I'm sorry to say that they're not up and running yet."
column2:
早间简报会上，Darius 有个请求要转达。

“[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 和 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 想在行星表面被激光打之外，也做点训练。”

Murad 博士说：“我们确实有那些训练模块。它们会很理想，尤其是对经验较少的机甲战士。可是……很抱歉，它们还没能运转起来。”

column1:
You say, "That's enough, Yang." Your Chief MechTech looks disappointed, but nods.

To [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], you say, "So, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] told you to get this part installed on your 'Mech? I want you to imagine what that part number will look like if you write it on a requisition form. Just picture it in your head. B A eleven hundred N."

{TGT_MW.Callsign} pauses, then turns red. "I was asking the Chief for a balloon, wasn't I?"

"Try to be a little more discerning, {TGT_MW.Callsign}. And definitely don't trust everything {SCN_MW.Callsign} tells you."
column2:
你说：“够了，Yang。”你的首席机甲技师一脸失望，但还是点了点头。

你对 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 说：“那么，是 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 让你把这个零件装到你的机甲上？我想让你想象一下，要是把这个零件编号写在申领单上会是什么样。就在脑子里想一想。B A 一千一百 N。”

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 愣了一下，随即脸红了。“我是在向主管申请一只气球，对吧？”

“以后多留个心眼，{TGT_MW.Callsign}。还有，千万别什么都信 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 说的。”

column1: You watch with amazement from a viewscreen as the Leopard jumps from the Argo's docking collar and fires at the debris. With precise PPC barrages, Sumire carves out a gap for the DropShip to slip through as the rest of the junk drifts away. After the Argo reaches a safe distance, Dr. Murad reports into Navigation over the comms. "We were pelted by smaller shards, but hull damage was minimal. I'll run a diagnostic, but congratulations are in order—Sumire, no one else could have pulled that off." Sumire punches a fist into the air and says, "It's a whole lot easier to thread a needle after you blast a giant hole through it!"
column2: 你在显示屏上惊讶地看着豹式从阿尔戈号的对接环脱开，向碎片开火。Sumire 用精准的 PPC 齐射轰出一条缝隙，让空投艇穿了过去，其余的垃圾则飘散开来。 阿尔戈号到达安全距离后，Murad 博士通过通讯向导航部门报告。“我们被较小的碎片砸到了一些，但船体损伤很小。我会做一次诊断，不过先得道声恭喜——Sumire，换别人谁也做不到。” Sumire 一拳挥向空中：“先轰出个大窟窿，再穿针引线就容易多了！”

column1: Darius sees to it that MechWarriors and crew members with irregular climate control get portable fans to alleviate the problem.\n\nUnfortunately, the portable fans don't make enough of a difference for everyone. [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], in particular, becomes increasingly irritable, as {SCN_MW.SUBJ} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:find|Default:finds} it hard to sleep.
column2: Darius 安排人手，给气候控制不正常的机甲战士和船员们配发便携风扇，缓解问题。\n\n可惜，便携风扇对有些人来说还不够。尤其是 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 变得越来越烦躁，因为 {SCN_MW.SUBJ} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:find|Default:finds} 很难入睡。

column1: In the morning briefing, Yang says, "I've got a mystery here. The cargo lifters need replacing, but someone ripped the diagnostic circuits out of our spares. Unless those are returned, the spares can't balance." Dr. Murad makes a face. "Oh, yes. I raided those to patch holes in the Argo's internal sensors. Without them, the systems won't manage air circulation properly. And then… we get the bad odor funk. Sweat. Old food. Radishes." Dr. Murad's faraway gaze returns to Yang. "I did intend to tell you, but then the Argo went and broke again."
column2: 早间简报会上，Yang 说：“我这儿有个谜团。货运升降机需要更换，可有人把备用件里的诊断电路给拆走了。不把那东西交回来，备用件就没法匹配。” Murad 博士露出尴尬的表情。“哦，是的。我拆了那些，去补阿尔戈号内部传感器上的窟窿。没有它们，系统就没法正常管理空气循环。然后……我们就有臭味了。汗味。陈年食物。萝卜。” Murad 博士飘远的目光转回 Yang 身上。“我本来是想告诉你的，可接着阿尔戈号又坏了。”

column1: You watch with amazement as Sumire directs the Argo past the free-floating debris. The DropShip groans as it slowly wheels. On a viewscreen, you see jagged metal drift harmlessly beneath the belly of the ship. After the Argo reaches a safe distance, Dr. Murad reports in over the comms. "Hull integrity is stable—well, as stable as it ever was. You've proven yourself once again, Sumire!" Sumire punches a fist into the air. "That's why they pay me the big C-Bills!"
column2: 你惊讶地看着 Sumire 操控阿尔戈号绕过漂浮的碎片。空投艇缓缓转体，船体发出低沉的呻吟。在显示屏上，你看到参差不齐的金属从船腹下方无害地漂过。 阿尔戈号到达安全距离后，Murad 博士通过通讯报告。“船体完整性稳定——嗯，跟它一贯一样稳定。你又证明了自己，Sumire！” Sumire 一拳挥向空中。“这就是他们付我大把 C-Bills 的原因！”

column1: Rance squints at your outstretched hand, inspecting it for C-bills, then finally shakes it. He winces as your grip tightens. "Hello, Rance. Don't you recognize the last heir of House {COMMANDER.LastName}?" His pain turns to panic, as he desperately tries to free his hand from yours. "Or you can just call me… The Devil!" You finally let him go, and he falls to the ground, scrambling backwards on all fours. Darius, meanwhile, is speechless—a second unexpected occurrence for the day. Rance screams as he flees the tavern, your voice echoing after him. "Keep running, coward! I've killed you once. I'll kill you again!"
column2: Rance 眯着眼打量你伸出的手，像是在检查上面有没有 C-Bills，最后才握住。你的手一紧，他疼得龇牙。 “你好啊，Rance。你认不出 {COMMANDER.LastName} 家族最后的继承人吗？”他的疼痛变成了惊恐，拼命想把的手从你的手里抽出来。“或者你就叫我……魔鬼！” 你终于放开他，他跌倒在地，手脚并用地往后爬。而 Darius 一句话都说不出来——这是今天第二件意想不到的事。 Rance 尖叫着逃出酒馆，你的声音在他身后回荡。“继续跑吧，懦夫！我杀过你一次。我还会再杀你一次！”

column1:
Your punch blindsides the man from your homeworld, knocking him out of his chair. The locals scatter and, after Darius unholsters his sidearm, decide to let the offworlders settle things.

Your opponent is not carved from the same steel as a battle-hardened MechWarrior and quickly curls into a ball. Darius's hand on your shoulder tells you that the man has had enough.

As he looks up, blood gushing from a broken nose, recognition finally dawns in his frightened eyes. "{COMMANDER.FirstName} {COMMANDER.LastName}…" is all he manages.

"You keep my name out of your filthy mouth," you spit. "If you knew the truth… well, just be glad you don't." Shaking your head, you turn and leave a stunned silence behind you.
column2:
你一拳打得出其不意，把那个来自你母星的男人从椅子上打翻在地。当地人都散开了，而在 Darius 拔出随身武器之后，他们决定让这些外乡人自己解决。

你的对手远不像身经百战的机甲战士那样硬气，很快就缩成一团。Darius 把手按在你肩上，告诉你这人已经够了。

他抬起头，鼻血直涌，惊恐的眼神里终于露出认出了你的神色。“{COMMANDER.FirstName} {COMMANDER.LastName}……”他只说出了这几个字。

“别用你那脏嘴提我的名字，”你啐了一口。“你要是知道真相……算了吧，庆幸你不知道就好。”你摇了摇头，转身离开，身后留下一片惊愕的沉默。

column1: The crew expands the Hydroponics garden with additional racks of lettuce, cucumbers, and radishes. Soon, radishes seem to become part of every meal. So many radishes.\n\nSomehow the phrase "…and a radish," becomes the height of morbid humor aboard the Argo.
column2: 船员们扩建了水培菜园，又添了几层架子种生菜、黄瓜和萝卜。很快，萝卜似乎出现在每一餐里。好多好多萝卜。\n\n不知怎么的，“……再加一根萝卜”这句话，成了阿尔戈号上病态幽默的巅峰。

column1: You say, "If we completely replace the equipment, then we won't need to reclaim the sensors. Chief, see what you can find planet-side." Both Dr. Murad and Yang breathe a sigh of relief. Later in the week, Yang gives an update. "{TGT_SYSTEM.Name} has plenty of parts and skilled labor. I replaced the lifters, and I picked up compatible circuits for the spares. We should be good for a while. Unless someone raids the Mech Bay for parts again." Dr. Murad cringes. "I did say that I was sorry…"
column2: 你说：“要是我们把设备整套换掉，就不用去要回那些传感器了。主管，看看行星上能买到什么。” Murad 博士和 Yang 都松了口气。 这周晚些时候，Yang 汇报了进展。“{TGT_SYSTEM.Name} 有不少零件和熟练工人。我换掉了升降机，还给备用件配到了兼容的电路。我们应该能撑一阵子了。除非又有人跑到机甲库来拆零件。” Murad 博士缩了缩脖子。“我确实说过对不起了……”

column1:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], you're never going to make it as a MechWarrior if you're goofing off playing 'make believe' Mercenary. Get your ass in the Training Modules and learn some real skills.

Looking chastised, {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:apologize|Default:apologizes} and hurries out of the Arcade. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:don't|Default:doesn't} even pause to log out of the game.

Glancing at the screen, you see it's only a couple more days until {TGT_MW.DET} Blackjack is refitted, and {TGT_MW.DET} best MechWarrior is healed up, and there's one more juicy contract available in this system…
column2:
“[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]，你要是整天玩‘过家家’似的佣兵游戏，这辈子都别想成为一名机甲战士。滚去训练模块里学点真本事。”

{TGT_MW.SUBJ} 一副挨了批评的样子，{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:apologize|Default:apologizes} 了一句，匆匆走出游戏厅。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:don't|Default:doesn't} 连游戏都忘了退出登录。

你瞥了一眼屏幕，发现距离 {TGT_MW.DET} 那台 Blackjack 改装完成、{TGT_MW.DET} 最强的机甲战士伤愈复出还有两天，而这个星系里还有一份肥得流油的合约可以接……

column1:
You happen to be in the Mech Bay when [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] approaches Yang with a question. "Uh, Chief? I was wondering if you had any B A eleven hundred Ns in stock. I'd really like to get one installed on my 'Mech."

Yang looks at you to make sure you're hearing this, then turns back to {TGT_MW.Callsign} and replies with admirable gravity, "You don't see those often on the field. Are you sure you want us to install a B A eleven hundred N on your BattleMech?"

"Yes sir. [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] says it'll really improve the 'Mech's stability."
column2:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 去找 Yang 问话时，你正好在机甲库里。“呃，主管？我想问问，你们库存里有没有 B A 一千一百 N？我特别想给我的机甲装一个。”

Yang 看了你一眼，确认你也听见了，然后转向 {TGT_MW.Callsign}，用令人敬佩的严肃语气回答：“这东西在战场上可不多见。你确定要我们给你的战斗机甲装一个 B A 一千一百 N 吗？”

“是的，长官。[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 说它能大大提升机甲的稳定性。”

column1:
You insert yourself into the conversation. "Extra stability is something I can't have enough of, Chief. Put some of those on my 'Mech too."

That brings Yang up short. His mouth opens, shuts, and opens again. One eye begins twitching until he finally settles on what to say. "Sure thing, Boss. Two sets of BA eleven hundred Ns coming right up. I'll get the crew going on that right away, sir. Yes sir."

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] beams with satisfaction and the two of you walk out of the Mech Bay together, trading war stories from recent successful contracts. Later, you find your BattleMech lovingly decorated with shiny red balloons.
column2:
你插进这场对话。“额外的稳定性，再多我都不嫌多，主管。给我的机甲也装几个。”

这话让 Yang 一时语塞。他张了张嘴，又合上，再张开。一只眼睛开始抽搐，最后他终于想好了该说什么。“没问题，老板。两套 BA 一千一百 N，马上就来。我这就安排人手，先生。是，先生。”

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 一脸得意，你们俩一起走出机甲库，交流着最近几份成功合约的战斗故事。后来，你发现自己的战斗机甲被精心装饰上了一只只闪亮的红气球。

column1:
It's all about the C-Bills, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. C-Bills repair 'Mechs. C-Bills hire more MechWarriors. C-Bills keep the lights on.

{TGT_MW.Callsign} chuckles at your passionate speech.

Over the next half hour, you work with {TGT_MW.Callsign} to figure out how to maximize the game's negotiation sub-system. It's hardly like the real thing, but there's an underlying algorithm that can be min-maxed.

Hardly like the real thing, and yet later that night, you start awake with several ideas to share with Darius in the morning.
column2:
“一切都归结于 C-Bills，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。C-Bills 能修机甲。C-Bills 能雇更多机甲战士。C-Bills 能让灯一直亮着。”

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 被你激昂的演说逗笑了。

接下来半小时，你和 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 一起研究如何把游戏里的谈判子系统玩到极致。它跟现实差得远，但底层有一套算法，可以做到极限优化。

虽说跟现实差得远，可当晚你猛然惊醒时，脑子里已经装了好几个主意，打算早上跟 Darius 说说。

column1: In the middle of the afternoon, you find [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] hunkered in the Arcade playing MERCENARIES!, a tie-in to [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHolovidMercenaries],the popular Holovid show]]. "Commander, have you played this game yet? Maybe it touches a little too close to home. See, I'm managing my own Mercenary company in the Periphery!" Over {TGT_MW.DET} shoulder, you see charts and data and little icons representing all the 'Mechs at {TGT_MW.Det} disposal. You flash back to Darius' recent run-down of monthly expenses. "I'm a bit stuck. What do you think I should do?"
column2: 下午过半，你发现 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 缩在游戏厅里玩《佣兵！》，那是[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHolovidMercenaries],那部热门全息剧]]的衍生游戏。 “指挥官，你玩过这个游戏吗？也许它跟现实贴得有点太近了。你看，我在边境经营着自己的佣兵团！” 从 {TGT_MW.DET} 肩后望过去，你看到图表、数据，还有一个代表 {TGT_MW.Det} 麾下所有机甲的小图标。你脑中闪回 Darius 最近那份月度开支清单。 “我有点卡住了。你觉得我该怎么办？”

column1:
It's all about the metal, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. You can always replace the meat. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:flinch|Default:flinches}. "No offense."

Over the next half hour, you work with {TGT_MW.Callsign} to rejigger the load-outs on {TGT_MW.Det} imaginary BattleMechs.

Later that night, you start awake with several ideas to share with Yang in the morning.
column2:
“一切都在于机体，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。人肉随时可以换。”{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:flinch|Default:flinches}。“无意冒犯。”

接下来半小时，你和 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 一起调整 {TGT_MW.Det} 那些虚构战斗机甲的配置。

当晚你猛然惊醒时，脑子里已经装了好几个主意，打算早上跟 Yang 说说。

column1:
You need to get your best MechWarriors back into the field sooner. Time is money. Waiting around for your favorite pilots to heal up is time you could be spending on Contracts.

Over the next several hours, you work with [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] to earn enough C-Bills to climb the Upgrade tree to the Hospital Bay. At that point, {TGT_MW.Det} pilots begin flying through the MedBay as if it were a revolving door.

Later that night, you start awake with several ideas to share with the medical staff in the morning.
column2:
“你得让你最好的机甲战士更快回到战场上。时间就是金钱。干等着你心爱的机师痊愈，这段时间本可以用来打合约。”

接下来几个小时，你和 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 一起赚够 C-Bills，把升级树点到医院舱。到那时，{TGT_MW.Det} 的机师的伤情流转得就像旋转门一样快。

当晚你猛然惊醒时，脑子里已经装了好几个主意，打算早上跟医疗人员说说。

column1: The shot rings out and kills the din momentarily, until the entire tavern erupts as everyone runs for the door. Darius is as shocked as Rance, both of them looking from the smoking pistol in your hand to the spreading pool of blood on the man's shirt. Recognition finally dawns on Rance's face. "{COMMANDER.FirstName} {COMMANDER.LastName}…" is all he manages before toppling over. At this point, Darius takes charge of the situation, grabs you by the elbow and makes for the kitchen exit. "Well, Commander, should I start calling you The Devil instead?"
column2: 枪声响起，喧嚣短暂地停了一瞬，随即整间酒馆炸开了锅，所有人争先恐后地往门口跑。Darius 和 Rance 一样震惊，两人在你手里冒烟的枪和那人衬衫上扩散的血迹之间来回看着。 Rance 脸上终于露出认出的神色。“{COMMANDER.FirstName} {COMMANDER.LastName}……”他只来得及说出这几个字，便倒了下去。 这时 Darius 接手了局面，抓住你的手肘往厨房出口拖。“那么，指挥官，我是不是该改口叫你魔鬼了？”

column1: Having given up on dissuading you, Darius backs your play. That night, a lone security guard stumbles upon your impromptu burglary just as you remove the painting from its moorings on the wall. Seeing Darius pointing a gyroslug rifle in her direction, she quickly retreats. The next day, back on the Argo, you lead a pair of technicians all over the Mech Bay, trying to find the perfect spot to hang it. Darius looks on appreciatively. "Commander. I'm glad we didn't have to hurt anyone to put that painting where it belongs. Though it's strange how those autocannons seem to follow me, no matter where I move…"
column2: 劝不动你之后，Darius 决定支持你的做法。当晚，你把那幅画从墙上拆下来时，一名独自巡逻的保安正好撞见这场临时起意的盗窃。她看到 Darius 用一支回转滑膛步枪指着她，便迅速退走了。 第二天回到阿尔戈号，你带着两名技师在机甲库里转了一圈又一圈，想找个完美的悬挂位置。 Darius 赞许地看着。“指挥官。我很庆幸我们没为了把这幅画挂到该挂的地方而伤到人。不过奇怪的是，不管我走到哪儿，那些自动炮好像都在跟着我……”

column1: After you finish telling Darius the entire story about the painting, he rests a hand on your shoulder. "The past is the past. We can't change it, but we can remember it." He raises a glass and together you toast the painting hanging overhead.\n\n"She's a fine 'Mech, Commander. And… is it my imagination? But it seems like those autocannons are following me, no matter where I move…"
column2: 你把关于那幅画的故事原原本本讲给 Darius 听之后，他把手搭在你肩上。“过去就是过去。我们改变不了它，但我们可以记住它。”他举起酒杯，你们一起为头顶挂着的那幅画干杯。\n\n“她是台好机甲，指挥官。而且……是我的错觉吗？不管我走到哪儿，那些自动炮好像都在跟着我……”

column1: Darius watches from the bar as you spend the Argo's money on yet another hard-luck story. You're well aware of the calculations he's doing, but it doesn't stop you. After tearful thanks and awkward hugs, the couple finally departs. You look after them, hoping that their sons or daughters will now have a future with a clear horizon. "You know, Commander," Darius says cautiously, "We have our own debts to pay. I'm running out of creative ways to categorize these expenses in the monthly financial reports…"
column2: Darius 在吧台边看着你把阿尔戈号的钱花在又一个苦命故事上。你很清楚他心里在算的账，但这拦不住你。 在含泪的道谢和尴尬的拥抱之后，那对夫妇终于离开了。你目送他们，希望他们的儿女从此能有一个前景明朗的未来。 “你知道，指挥官，”Darius 谨慎地说，“我们自己也欠着债。我在月度财务报表里已经快想不出新花样来给这些开支分类了……”

column1: The owner of the tavern called "The Blackjack's Beer" unsurprisingly resists selling the painting. But between your passionate appeals and Darius's persuasive negotiating style, you eventually wear her down. The next day, back on the Argo, you lead a pair of technicians all over the Mech Bay, trying to find the perfect spot to hang it. Yang looks on appreciatively. "She's a fine 'Mech, Commander. That painting really captures her spirit. And… is it my imagination? But it seems like those autocannons are following me, no matter where I move…"
column2: 那家名叫“黑杰克的啤酒”的酒馆老板不出所料地拒绝出售那幅画。但在你充满激情的劝说和 Darius 极有说服力的谈判风格双重夹击下，她最终还是让步了。 第二天回到阿尔戈号，你带着两名技师在机甲库里转了一圈又一圈，想找个完美的悬挂位置。 Yang 赞许地看着。“她是台好机甲，指挥官。这幅画真抓住了她的神韵。而且……是我的错觉吗？不管我走到哪儿，那些自动炮好像都在跟着我……”

column1: Later in the day, Darius arrives back at the Argo. While his crew begins unloading all of the new supplies, he takes you aside.\n\n"Commander, the vendor who sold us the machine tools was… well, relieved is an understatement." He describes how she offered him ¢1,000 in a sweaty hand for his 'honesty', and how she buried her face in her hands when he departed.
column2: 当天晚些时候，Darius 回到阿尔戈号。他的手下开始卸下所有新补给时，他把你拉到一边。\n\n“指挥官，那个卖给我们机床的供应商……嗯，说她如释重负都是轻描淡写。”他描述了她如何用一只冒汗的手递给他 ¢1,000，作为他“诚实”的报酬，以及在他离开时，她如何把脸埋进双手里。

column1: Later in the day, Darius arrives back at the Argo. While his crew begins unloading all of the new supplies, he takes you aside. "Commander, things didn't go quite as smoothly as I would have liked. The customs officials waved us through after only a token inspection of a few random crates…" "But…" you prompt him. With chagrin he continues, "Yeah, I spotted someone loitering near the edge of the loading area. I'm pretty sure that she recognized the crates."
column2: 当天晚些时候，Darius 回到阿尔戈号。他的手下开始卸下所有新补给时，他把你拉到一边。“指挥官，事情没我想的那么顺利。海关官员只对几个随机挑选的箱子做了象征性的检查，就挥手放我们过去了……” “但是……”你催他往下说。 他懊恼地接着说：“是，我看见有人在装货区边上转悠。我很确定她认出了那些箱子。”

column1:
On a combat drop, you're only as good as your weapons. When you're in the middle of a fight, you need to know the capabilities—and the limitations—of whatever 'Mech you're piloting.

You do a quick search on one of the computers then flip it around for {TGT_MW.DET} to see. "Here, start with the tech behind Heat Sinks. Knowing how to push your 'Mech's limits will prove invaluable in every drop I send you on."

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] furrows {TGT_MW.DET} brow and bends low over the detailed treatise, already engrossed in the material.
column2:
“在战斗空投中，你的本事就等于你武器的本事。身处战斗之中时，你必须清楚自己驾驶的任何机甲有什么能力——以及什么局限。”

你在电脑上快速查了一下，然后把屏幕转过去让 {TGT_MW.DET} 看。“来，先从散热器背后的技术看起。懂得如何把机甲的极限推到多高，在你派我执行的每一次空投里都会是无价的本事。”

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 皱起 {TGT_MW.DET} 眉头，伏在那篇详尽的论述上，已经沉浸其中。

column1:
I have plenty of people who can pull a trigger [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. What I need are more MechWarriors that can see the big picture on the battlefield and respond to it quickly. Gaining proper positioning is key to taking down the enemy as fast as possible. For that you will need more practice in the simulators, not the books.


Taking your advice {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} goes to the simulators and gains experience.
column2:
“能扣扳机的人我有一大把，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。我需要的是更多能在战场上看清大局并迅速做出反应的机甲战士。抢占正确的站位是尽快击溃敌人的关键。为此你需要在模拟器里多练，而不是死啃书本。”


听从你的建议，{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} 去了模拟器，积累了经验。

column1: You've received a message on your console from [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[TBoneLoreDDSL],Discount Dan's Savings and Loan LLC.]] Greetings Commander, This message is a courtesy reminder that your loan term will be up in less than 15 days. Failure to repay the loan will result in unfortunate consequences including but not limited to additional late fees. Should payment become excessively late, do expect to be paid a visit by myself, or one of our other capable "collections agents." Lest you be tempted to ignore this message, I've taken the liberty of attaching a short clip of one of our former customers. Let it serve as a stern warning of what happens to those who fail to pay in a timely fashion. Sincerely, Nicia Andretta Dept. Cash and Collections DDS&L LLC.
column2: 你的控制台上收到一条来自 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[TBoneLoreDDSL],折扣丹储蓄与信贷有限责任公司]] 的讯息。 指挥官，您好： 本讯息为善意提醒：您的贷款期限将在 15 天内到期。若未能偿还贷款，将带来不幸的后果，包括但不限于额外的滞纳金。若还款严重逾期，届时将会有我本人，或我们其他得力的“催收专员”登门拜访。为避免您打算无视本讯息，我冒昧附上了一位前客户的短片。就让它作为严厉的警示，提醒各位拖欠还款者的下场。 此致， Nicia Andretta 现金与催收部 DDS&L LLC.

column1: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] returns to the Argo later that week. You see {TGT_MW.Obj} in the mess hall, regaling listeners with tales of the race.\n\n"Commander, thanks for letting me participate in the endurance competition!" {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:say|Default:says} enthusiastically. "I didn't win, but I feel like I did pretty well. Those locals, wow, they have endless stamina! I managed to keep up with them for a while, but along the way I got tired. Spending 24 hours baking in an overheating mech cockpit is probably less exhausting."
column2: 这周晚些时候，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 回到了阿尔戈号。你看见 {TGT_MW.Obj} 在食堂里，正给听众们讲比赛的种种趣事。\n\n“指挥官，谢谢你让我参加耐力赛！”{TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:say|Default:says} 兴致勃勃地说。“我没拿第一，但我觉得自己表现挺不错。那些当地人，哇，体力简直没完没了！我一度跟得上他们，可跑着跑着就累了。在过热的机甲驾驶舱里烤上 24 小时，大概都没这么累。”

column1: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] returns to the Argo later that week. You find {TGT_MW.Obj} in the mess hall, one arm in a cast, regaling listeners with tales of daring-do. "Commander, thanks for letting me participate in the endurance competition, but I, uh, may have over-reached a little bit," {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:say|Default:says}, holding up the broken limb. "Those locals, wow, they have endless stamina!. I managed to keep up with them for a while, but along the way I got tired. Spending 24 hours baking in an overheating mech cockpit is probably less exhausting."
column2: 这周晚些时候，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 回到了阿尔戈号。你发现 {TGT_MW.Obj} 在食堂里，一条胳膊打着石膏，正给听众们讲那些英勇事迹。 “指挥官，谢谢你让我参加耐力赛，不过我，呃，可能有点用力过猛了，”{TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:say|Default:says}，举起那条断了的胳膊。 “那些当地人，哇，体力简直没完没了！我一度跟得上他们，可跑着跑着就累了。在过热的机甲驾驶舱里烤上 24 小时，大概都没这么累。”

You do a quick search on one of the computers then flip it around for {TGT_MW.DET} to see. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:read|Default:reads} the passage aloud. "Procrastination is opportunity's natural assassin.."

Slapping {TGT_MW.Callsign} on the back, "You will need to forget some of your past experiences and concentrate on these new techniques. Even then there will probably be a need to make repeat visits to refresh your new skills. "
column2:
“能扣扳机的人我有一大把，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。我需要的是更多能在战场上看清大局并迅速做出反应的机甲战士。抢占正确的站位是尽快击溃敌人的关键。”

你在电脑上快速查了一下，然后把屏幕转过去让 {TGT_MW.DET} 看。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:read|Default:reads} 声念出了那段话。“拖延是机遇的天然杀手……”

你拍了拍 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 的背，“你得忘掉一些过去的经验，专注在这些新技巧上。即便如此，大概也还需要反复回来复习，才能巩固新技能。”

column1: [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[TooltipSimGameCharacterDARIUS],Darius]] pings you with an urgent message from planetside. Apparently [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] were both found in an alley, beaten and robbed. Darius has collected them and is en route to the Argo. Coincidentally, you also have a message from [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[TBoneLoreDDSL],Discount Dan's Savings and Loan LLC]]: Greetings Commander, I was sorry to hear about the misfortune that recently befell your poor pilots. While your loan is now past due, I have been authorized to offer you the option of purchasing Discount Dan's Pilot Protection Plan, which guarantees against any further "mishaps" for a period of 120 days. Certainly we wouldn't want further injuries affecting your ability to repay your loans, would we? Sincerely, Nicia Andretta Dept. Cash and Collections DDS&L LLC
column2: [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[TooltipSimGameCharacterDARIUS],Darius]] 从行星表面给你发来一条紧急讯息。看来 [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] 和 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 都被人发现倒在小巷里，遭到了殴打和抢劫。Darius 已经接到他们，正在返回阿尔戈号的途中。 巧的是，你还收到一条来自 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[TBoneLoreDDSL],折扣丹储蓄与信贷有限责任公司]] 的讯息： 指挥官，您好： 得知您可怜的机师们最近遭遇不幸，我深表遗憾。鉴于您的贷款现已逾期，我已获授权向您提供购买“折扣丹机师保护计划”的选择，该计划可在 120 天内保障您不再遭遇任何进一步的“意外”。我们当然不希望再有更多伤病影响到您的还款能力，对吧？ 此致， Nicia Andretta 现金与催收部 DDS&L LLC

column1: You know a hustle when you see one. The only way out of this is to pay off that loan as soon as possible, not give Dan's goons more of your hard-earned money.\n\nUnfortunately, [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[TooltipSimGameCharacterYang],Yang]] and [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[TBoneLoreDoc],Doc]] both report that supplies are critically low, and MedBay and MechBay performance will be seriously degraded for a while.
column2: 骗局你一眼就能看穿。唯一的出路就是尽快还清那笔贷款，而不是再给 Dan 的打手们送去更多你辛苦挣来的钱。\n\n不幸的是，[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[TooltipSimGameCharacterYang],Yang]] 和 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[TBoneLoreDoc],Doc]] 都报告说补给严重不足，医疗舱和机甲库的表现将在一段时间内明显下降。

column1: While pacing through the Mech Bay on a sleepless night, you stumble across [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} looking over the schematics of a [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[BaseDesc_Locust],Locust LCT-1V]]. A jumbled pile of Spanners, bolts, and loose papers covered in scribbles litter the deck plating around {TGT_MW.Obj}.\n\nAs you approach, {TGT_MW.Callsign} looks up, a sheepish grin on {TGT_MW.Det} face. "Uh. Hello, Commander. I was just trying to work out a way to make that Locust in storage actually useful on the battlefield. I think we can weld the legs together, cram as much scrap metal into the chassis and actually fashion it into a club that one of the bigger mechs can weild!  Can you talk to the Chief, he's already shooed me out of here once this week."
column2: 一个失眠的夜晚，你在机甲库里踱步时撞见了 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} 正在研究一台 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[BaseDesc_Locust],Locust LCT-1V]] 的图纸。{TGT_MW.Obj} 周围的甲板上散落着一堆乱糟糟的扳手、螺栓和写满涂鸦的散页纸。\n\n你走近时，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 抬起头，{TGT_MW.Det} 脸上挂着不好意思的笑。“呃，你好，指挥官。我只是想琢磨出个办法，让库里那台 Locust 在战场上真正派上用场。我想我们可以把两条腿焊在一起，往底盘里塞满废铁，把它做成一根大棒，让那些更大的机甲抡着使！你能跟主管说说吗，这周他已经把我从这儿赶出去过一次了。”

column1: MechWarriors belong in the 'Mechs. Technicians belong in the Mech Bay. Let the specialists do their jobs.\n\nAs [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] starts to get up, you gesture at the pile of bits on the ground. "And clean up this mess. I don't want the Chief stumbling across your experiment in the morning."
column2: “机甲战士就该待在机甲里。技师就该待在机甲库里。让专业人员干他们的活。”\n\n[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 正要站起来，你指了指地上那堆零件。“还有，把这些东西收拾干净。我不想让主管早上一来就撞见你的实验。”

column1: It's hard to make money when you can't repair your BattleMechs between contracts. Hopefully this "Logistics Insurance" is worth the money and you can get the company back in the black before the coverage expires again.\n\nIn the meantime, Darius has returned with the "missing" supplies.
column2: 如果不能在合约间隙修理战斗机甲，赚钱就很难。但愿这份“物流保险”物有所值，让你能在保险到期前让公司重回盈利。\n\n与此同时，Darius 带着那些“失踪”的补给回来了。

column1: It's hard to make money with your pilots laid up in the medbay. Hopefully this "Pilot Protection Plan" is worth the money and you can get the company back in the black before the "Protection" expires again.\n\nIn the meantime, Darius has returned with [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]. Although {SCN_MW.Callsign} got the worst of it physically, {TRT_MW.Callsign} seems particularly shaken by the experience. It's hard to go from feeling invincible at the controls of a BattleMech to feeling helpless in a dark alley.
column2: 机师们躺在医疗舱里，赚钱就很难。但愿这份“机师保护计划”物有所值，让你能在“保护”再次到期前让公司重回盈利。\n\n与此同时，Darius 带着 [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] 和 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 回来了。虽然 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 身体上伤得最重，但 {TRT_MW.Callsign} 似乎对这次经历格外受打击。从坐在战斗机甲驾驶舱里觉得自己不可战胜，到倒在黑暗的小巷里无助无力，这种落差很难承受。

column1: [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[TooltipSimGameCharacterDARIUS],Darius]] pings you with an urgent message from planetside. Apparently the entire resupply shipment has gone "missing," and every local retailer is claiming to be completely out of stock. Coincidentally, you also have a message from [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[TBoneLoreDDSL],Discount Dan's Savings and Loan LLC]]: Greetings Commander, A little bird told me you seem to have misplaced your resupply shipments. While your loan is now past due, I have been authorized to offer you the option of purchasing Discount Dan's Logistics Insurance Plan, which guarantees against any further loss of resupply for a period of 60 days. Certainly we wouldn't want degraded combat readiness affecting your ability to repay your loans, would we? Sincerely, Nicia Andretta Dept. Cash and Collections DDS&L LLC
column2: [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[TooltipSimGameCharacterDARIUS],Darius]] 从行星表面给你发来一条紧急讯息。看来整批补给货物都“不翼而飞”了，而当地每一家零售商都声称彻底没货了。 巧的是，你还收到一条来自 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[TBoneLoreDDSL],折扣丹储蓄与信贷有限责任公司]] 的讯息： 指挥官，您好： 有只小鸟告诉我，您的补给货物似乎放错了地方。鉴于您的贷款现已逾期，我已获授权向您提供购买“折扣丹物流保险计划”的选择，该计划可在 60 天内保障您不再遭受任何进一步的补给损失。我们当然不希望战备水平下降影响到您的还款能力，对吧？ 此致， Nicia Andretta 现金与催收部 DDS&L LLC

column1:
The crew is bubbling with enthusiasm about a local endurance competition.

In the morning briefing, Darius says, "[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] has requested permission to compete. Given the general interest, I'd like you to make the call."

Sumire says, "Let {TGT_MW.Obj} go. It'll be entertaining."
column2:
船员们对当地一场耐力赛兴致高涨。

早间简报会上，Darius 说：“[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 申请参赛。鉴于大家都这么感兴趣，我希望由你来做决定。”

Sumire 说：“让 {TGT_MW.Obj} 去吧。会挺有意思的。”

column1: Star Captain Pheona O'Reilly is just as fiery as her hair and Irish heritage. She is almost always the first into the fray. She is known as "Torch" by everyone else since becoming a bondswoman.\n\n
column2: 星队长 Pheona O'Reilly 的脾气就像她的红发和爱尔兰血统一样火爆。她几乎总是第一个冲进战团的人。成为誓缚民之后，大家都叫她“火炬”。\n\n

column1: MechWarrior Synthia has only seen a handful of battles since her Trial of Position. Her tendency to err on the side of caution, and her pale complexion, have led the crew she is a bondswoman of to calling her "China Doll".\n\n
column2: 机甲战士 Synthia 自从定位试炼以来只经历过寥寥几场战斗。她凡事谨小慎微的倾向，加上苍白的肤色，让她所隶属的船员们叫她“瓷娃娃”。\n\n

column1: Point Commander Tyler may have failed to place during his Trial of Position, but his desire to see combat led him to the motor pool. A hover-skirt failure led to his capture and him becoming a bondsman. His aptitude with all types of vehicles has earned him the callsign "Derby" amongst the crew he is bonded to.\n\n
column2: 点指挥官 Tyler 在定位试炼里或许没能拿到名次，但他对战斗的渴望把他引向了车辆部队。一次气垫裙故障导致他被俘，成了誓缚民。他对各类车辆的精通，让与他绑定的船员们给了他“德比”这个呼号。\n\n

column1: Niles, a Star Commander before his indenture as a bondsman, was a devout proponent of zellbrigen, believing any honorable fight should be fought one-on-one. The other mercenaries call him "Shogun" for his ability to read a battlefield and predict enemy movements.\n\n
column2: Niles 在成为誓缚民之前是星指挥官，是 zellbrigen 的虔诚信徒，认为任何荣誉之战都该一对一地进行。其他佣兵叫他“将军”，因为他能读懂战场、预判敌人的行动。\n\n

column1: Regent and Protector of the Star League, "Defender of the First Lord" & "Great Father" these are just some of the titles bestowed upon Alexandr Kerensky in life and in death.\n\nSome say that even in death the spirit of Kerensky lives on, occasionally giving aid to mechwarriors it finds worthy, guiding them to great things.
column2: “星际联盟的摄政与守护者”“第一领主的捍卫者”以及“伟大的父亲”，这些只是 Alexandr Kerensky 生前身后被授予的部分头衔。\n\n有人说，即便身死，Kerensky 的精神依然存在，偶尔会向它认为配得上的机甲战士伸出援手，指引他们走向伟大的成就。

column1: A sharp, metallic groan echoes through the Argo's hull, louder than any sound that should exist in the vacuum of space. Darius stiffens at his station, his eyes immediately darting to the warning lights on the console as the ship's alarms begin to wail — a siren of dread. “Another hatch failure!” Darius shouts, his voice tight as he turns toward you. Your face pales as you register the flashing alerts, the same ones as the previous accident... Without warning, a violent decompression explosion erupts in the aft section of the ship. A massive rush of air and debris tears through a section of one the carbo bays as the pressure difference between the vessel's interior and the void outside becomes catastrophic. Metal screeches, various crates hurtle into the darkness, and unsecured equipment is ripped free, smashing into anything in its path. The ship bucks, systems flickering, while the crew scrambles to brace for impact. You and Darius rush down towards the afflicted Gamma Pod Cargo bay to assess the damage. Containment bulkheads have shut off main access, and Yang is there directing the astech repair crews. You call out to Yang, "What's the damage, Yang?" Yang winces, "It's a bad one again, Boss. Another one of the external doors has failed. We won't know more until we get in to assess the situation." You nod, "Keep me posted Yang." An alert sounds on Darius' noteputer, "Commander, we have numerous injuries throughout the Argo and three of those are in critical condition. The MedTechs say they can only save two of them, but need you to specify who lives and who... doesn't." You stare at Darius for what seems like an eternity before his question pulls you out of your stupor, "Commander, the MedTechs need an answer." You rub your hands over your face and look at Darius, "Who's injured?" Darius consults his noteputer, "Three crew members were caught in the area when the hatch failed. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] was thrown into a bulkhead, knocked unconscious with serious head trauma. [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] was impaled by section of panel that tore lose. And [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] was slammed into the deck, with multiple bones shattering under the force.
column2: 一声尖锐的金属呻吟传遍阿尔戈号的船体，那声音响亮得根本不该出现在真空的太空中。Darius 在岗位上僵住了，目光立刻投向控制台上的警示灯，全舰警报随即开始哀号——那是充满不祥预感的警笛。 “又一个舱门失效！”Darius 喊道，转过头来看你时声音绷得紧紧的。 你脸色发白，认出了那些闪烁的警报——和上一次事故时一模一样…… 毫无预兆地，船体后部猛然发生剧烈的失压爆炸。船内与外太空之间的压差达到灾难性的程度，一股巨大的空气与碎片洪流撕穿了其中一个货舱的一段舱壁。金属尖啸，各色货箱飞入黑暗，未固定的设备被整个扯下，撞上路上的一切。船体剧烈颠簸，系统忽明忽暗，船员们手忙脚乱地抓住东西稳住自己。 你和 Darius 冲向出事的 Gamma 舱段货舱评估损失。隔离舱壁已经封死了主通道，Yang 正在那儿指挥助理技师抢修队。你朝 Yang 喊：“损失怎么样，Yang？” Yang 咧了咧嘴：“又是麻烦的一回，老板。又有一扇外舱门失效了。得等我们进去才能评估具体情况。” 你点了点头：“随时向我汇报，Yang。” Darius 的记事器响了一声：“指挥官，阿尔戈号上有多人受伤，其中三人情况危急。医疗技师说他们只能救回两个，但需要你指明谁活下来，谁……不能。” 你盯着 Darius，仿佛过了永恒那么久，才被他的问话拉出恍惚：“指挥官，医疗技师在等答复。” 你用手抹了把脸，看向 Darius：“受伤的都是谁？” Darius 查了查记事器：“舱门失效时有三个船员被困在那片区域。[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 被抛到舱壁上，头部受到严重创伤，昏迷不醒。[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 被一块撕裂的舱板刺穿。还有 [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] 被狠狠甩在甲板上，多根骨头在冲击下碎裂。

column1: I thought you trusted me, Commander, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] mutters, visibly sagging, but {SCN_MW.SUBJ} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:drop|Default:drops} the subject as you instruct Darius to organise the repairs.\n\nThankfully, while over-priced, the repair crew are expedient and efficient and waste no time in flying up from [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] to begin replacing all the faulty hatch bolts on the Argo. There are no further issues with the Argo, but you notice {SCN_MW.Callsign} lingering in the observation deck for the next couple of weeks, {SCN_MW.DET} gaze fixed on the view of the Argo's hull. {SCN_MW.DET_C} mind is elsewhere as {SCN_MW.SUBJ} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:attend|Default:attends} to {SCN_MW.DET} daily tasks.
column2: “我还以为你信任我，指挥官，”[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 低声说，身形明显地垮了下去，但当你要 Darius 安排维修时，{SCN_MW.SUBJ} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:drop|Default:drops} 下了这个话题。\n\n庆幸的是，维修队虽然要价高得离谱，动作却迅速高效，毫不耽搁地从 [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] 飞上来，开始更换阿尔戈号上所有有问题的舱门螺栓。阿尔戈号再没出过问题，但你注意到接下来几周里，{SCN_MW.Callsign} 一直逗留在观察甲板上，{SCN_MW.DET} 的目光定定地望着阿尔戈号的船体。{SCN_MW.DET_C} 心思明显不在这里，{SCN_MW.SUBJ} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:attend|Default:attends} {SCN_MW.DET} 日常事务时也是如此。

column1: You have Darius purchase the bolts from [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]], which arrive on the next dropship. You watch from a viewscreen as [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], in an EVA suit, floats nimbly across the puckered hull of the DropShip. {SCN_MW.Callsign} deftly replaces the numerous bolts along this section of the Argo. After a few hours, {SCN_MW.Callsign} is reeled safely back inside the ship to take a break. At this pace, all of the bolts should be replaced in a couple of weeks. On {SCN_MW.Callsign}'s last EVA to replace the remaining bolts, you learn that {SCN_MW.Callsign} was injured when a bolt shot out and punctured thier suit. You visit {SCN_MW.OBJ} in the MedBay. "You did some amazing work out there, {SCN_MW.Callsign}," you say. "Anyone else would have hesitated in a situation like that, fearfull that the whole hatch would blow out. I've already punished the crew responsible for not having that section depressurised in advance of your repair work." You hand {SCN_MW.Obj} the bolt they removed during surgery, conveniently made into a necklace.
column2: 你让 Darius 从 [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] 采购螺栓，下一艘空投艇把它们送到了。你从显示屏上看着 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 穿着舱外活动服，轻巧地飘过空投艇起皱的船体。{SCN_MW.Callsign} 利落地换下了阿尔戈号这一段船体上的众多螺栓。 几个小时后，{SCN_MW.Callsign} 被安全拉回船内休息。照这个速度，所有螺栓大概两周就能换完。 在 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 最后一次更换剩余螺栓的舱外作业中，你得知一枚螺栓弹出，刺穿了那套作业服，{SCN_MW.Callsign} 因此受了伤。你去医疗舱看望 {SCN_MW.OBJ}。“你在外面干得非常出色，{SCN_MW.Callsign}，”你说。“换别人在这种情况下早就犹豫了，怕整个舱门都被炸飞。没在你作业前给那一段减压的船员，我已经罚过了。” 你把手术中取出的那枚螺栓交给 {SCN_MW.Obj}——有人顺手把它做成了一条项链。

column1: A sharp, metallic groan echoes through the Argo's hull, louder than any sound that should exist in the vacuum of space. Darius stiffens at his station, his eyes immediately darting to the warning lights on the console as the ship's alarms begin to wail — a siren of dread. “Another hatch failure!” Darius shouts, his voice tight as he turns toward you. Your face pales as you register the flashing alerts, the same ones as the previous accident... Without warning, a violent decompression explosion erupts in the aft section of the ship. A massive rush of air and debris tears through a section of one the carbo bays as the pressure difference between the vessel's interior and the void outside becomes catastrophic. Metal screeches, various crates hurtle into the darkness, and unsecured equipment is ripped free, smashing into anything in its path. The ship bucks, systems flickering, while the crew scrambles to brace for impact. You and Darius rush down towards the afflicted Beta Pod Cargo bay to assess the damage. Containment bulkheads have shut off main access, and Yang is there directing the astech repair crews. You call out to Yang, "What's the damage, Yang?" Yang winces, "It's a bad one again, Boss. Another one of the external doors has failed. We won't know more until we get in to assess the situation." You nod, "Keep me posted Yang." An alert sounds on Darius' noteputer, "Commander, we have numerous injuries throughout the Argo and three of those are in critical condition. The MedTechs say they can only save two of them, but need you to specify who lives and who... doesn't." You stare at Darius for what seems like an eternity before his question pulls you out of your stupor, "Commander, the MedTechs need an answer." You rub your hands over your face and look at Darius, "Who's injured?" Darius consults his noteputer, "Three crew members were caught in the area when the hatch failed. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] was thrown into a bulkhead, knocked unconscious with serious head trauma. [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] was impaled by section of panel that tore lose. And [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] was slammed into the deck, with multiple bones shattering under the force.

column1: Very well, Mr. Hatcher. We agree to you terms. "Oh, that is excellent news! Excellent indeed!," Mr. Hatcher beams, his smile nearly splitting his face. column2: 你收到首席机甲技师 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[Wulf_Lore_Yang],Yang]] 的讯息：\n\n“{Commander.LastName} 指挥官，我们已经把你运上来的那台机甲重新组装好了。真是个美人。你在老家的人脉可真够硬的。”

column1: While in orbit around [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] Darius grabs your attention, "Commander, we have an incoming transmission from Riveting Enterprises responding to our enquiry about replacing our faulty door bolts." You nod to Darius to open the channel on the holoviewer,"This is Commander {COMMANDER.LastName} of the Argo." As the hologram visage sharpens, you are greeted by the face of an obvious sales rep, "Greetings Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. I am Boltan Hatcher and I hear you are in need of some orbital repairs. According to our records, the Argo is a Boeing Interstellar dropship." He chuckles to himself before continuing, "Please excuse me... it is honestly surprising that your ship is still space worthy, considering it's lineage." Tiring of the banter, you get to the point, "Can you assist us or not, Mr Hatcher? And how much will this cost?" Mr Hatcher smiles back at you, "Direct and to the point. I can respect that. Seeing as my employer, Riveting Enterprises, a supplier of materials for Jalastar Aerospace, harbors no good will towards Boeing Interstellar, we would like to quote you the reduced price of only ¢5,000,000. Normally, a project of this magnitude would be three times that amount, but, it will feel all that sweeter to 'fix' a fault-ridden dropship manufactured by a competitor. Now, before you go trying to wheedle the price down even further, know this, we will expedite your repairs first and foremost over all our other current work orders and have you safely on your way in record time. This is our one and only offer, Commander, so please, think wisely."
column2: 在 [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] 轨道上时，Darius 引起了你的注意：“指挥官，Riveting Enterprises 发来通讯，回复我们关于更换故障舱门螺栓的询问。” 你点头示意 Darius 在全息显示器上打开频道：“我是阿尔戈号的 {COMMANDER.LastName} 指挥官。” 全息影像清晰起来，映入眼帘的是一张一看就是销售代表的脸：“{COMMANDER.LastName} 指挥官，您好。我是 Boltan Hatcher，听说您需要一些轨道维修服务。根据我们的记录，阿尔戈号是一艘 Boeing Interstellar 空投艇。”他自顾自地笑了笑，接着说：“请原谅我……老实说，考虑到它的出身，您的船还能保持适航真让人吃惊。” 你懒得再听这些闲聊，直接问到点子上：“Hatcher 先生，你究竟能不能帮我们？还有，这要花多少钱？” Hatcher 先生朝你微笑：“开门见山。我欣赏这一点。既然我的雇主 Riveting Enterprises——Jalastar Aerospace 的材料供应商——对 Boeing Interstellar 毫无好感，我们愿意给你一个优惠报价：只需 ¢5,000,000。通常情况下，这种规模的工程要收三倍的钱，不过，‘修好’一艘由竞争对手制造、毛病百出的空投艇，感觉会格外痛快。另外，在你动手继续砍价之前，请记住这一点：我们会把你的维修工作排在所有现有订单之前优先处理，让你以创纪录的速度安全上路。这是我们唯一一次报价，指挥官，请慎重考虑。”

column1: You don't waste time this round. "If you're here to repeat the same complaints, save it. My answer hasn't changed." "Of course it hasn't," {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:snap|Default:snaps}. "Because nothing has. I've been sitting here wasting time while my career dies in a simulator." "You're still alive," you say coldly. "And that's all I am here," {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:fire|Default:fires} back. "Alive—and irrelevant." Silence stretches for a beat. "Then we're done," you decide. "Your contract is terminated. Effective immediately." {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:don't|Default:doesn't} look surprised this time—just angry. "Should've done that the first time." "Maybe," you reply. "But I don't make the same mistake twice." {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:turn|Default:turns} sharply and stride for the hatch. "Yeah," {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:throw|Default:throws} over {TGT_MW.DET} shoulder, "neither will I." {TGT_MW.DET} footsteps echo as {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:walk|Default:walks} away, and the Argo keeps humming like nothing at all has changed.
column2: 这一轮你不再浪费时间。“你要是又来重复那些抱怨，那就省省。我的答复没变。” “当然没变，”{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:snap|Default:snaps}。“因为什么都没变。我一直坐在这儿浪费时间，眼看着自己的职业生涯死在模拟器里。” “你还活着，”你冷冷地说。 “我在这儿就只剩这个了，”{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:fire|Default:fires} 回敬道。“活着——而且无关紧要。” 沉默持续了一拍。 “那我们就到此为止，”你做出决定。“你的合约终止了。立即生效。” {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:don't|Default:doesn't} 这次没有露出意外的表情——只是愤怒。“早该第一次就这么干。” “也许吧，”你回答。“但我不会犯同样的错两次。” {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:turn|Default:turns} 猛地转身朝舱门走去。“是啊，”{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:throw|Default:throws} 下这句话，头也不回地越过了 {TGT_MW.DET} 肩膀，“我也不会。” {TGT_MW.DET} 的脚步声回荡着，{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:walk|Default:walks} 远了，阿尔戈号依旧嗡嗡作响，仿佛什么都没发生过。

column1: The Argo's steady hum is broken only by the clipped tone of an incoming channel as you review reports in the command deck. "Commander," comes the voice of Darius Oliveira, your XO, edged with something between concern and resignation, "you might want to get over to Docking Collar 2. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] is there—bags packed. Shuttle's inbound from the surface of {TGT_SYSTEM.name}."You pause, then rise without a word. Minutes later, you arrive. Docking Collar 2 is colder than the rest of the ship, all exposed plating and harsh lighting. The outer hatch stands sealed for now, but the indicator shows an incoming craft minutes out. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] stands beside a small stack of gear—everything {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:own|Default:owns} aboard the Argo, reduced to a few bags. {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:don't|Default:doesn't} turn when you approach. "Figured you'd hear about it." "I did," you reply evenly. {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:glance|Default:glances} over their shoulder. "Then you know why I'm here. No drops. No future. I'm done waiting." Behind you, Darius remains silent, watching.
column2: 阿尔戈号平稳的嗡鸣只被一条接入频道的尖锐提示音打断，你正在指挥甲板上翻看报告。 “指挥官，”你的副官 Darius Oliveira 的声音传来，带着几分介于担忧与无奈之间的意味，“你最好去 2 号对接环看看。[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 在那儿——行李都收拾好了。穿梭机正从 {TGT_SYSTEM.name} 表面飞上来。”你顿了顿，随即一言不发地起身。 几分钟后，你到了。2 号对接环比船体其他地方更冷，到处是裸露的钢板和刺眼的照明。外舱门暂时还封着，但指示器显示有一艘飞船几分钟后抵达。[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 站在一小堆装备旁——{TGT_MW.Subj} 在阿尔戈号上 {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:own|Default:owns} 的全部家当，缩成了几个包。 你走近时，{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:don't|Default:doesn't} 转身。“我猜你会听说。” “我听说了，”你平静地回答。 {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:glance|Default:glances} 了一眼肩后。“那你就知道我为什么在这儿了。没有空投。没有前途。我不想再等了。” 你身后，Darius 沉默地看着。

column1: You step closer, lowering your voice. "Walking out now won't fix that. You think every other command is going to hand you frontline drops just because you're impatient? You've got a place here. You've trained with this crew, earned your spot. I can change your deployment status—but not if you're halfway out the airlock." {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:turn|Default:turns} to face you fully now, searching your expression. "You've said things like that before." "And I'm saying it differently now," you answer. "Next contract, you're on the roster. Not a promise to keep you quiet—a decision. Stay, and prove you belong out there." {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:hold|Default:holds} your gaze for a long moment… then {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:shake|Default:shakes} {TGT_MW.Det} head. "No," {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:say|Default:says} quietly. "I don't believe you." The shuttle proximity alarm ticks down as {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:look|Default:looks} past you, resolve settling in. "I've heard 'soon' before. I'm not hearing it again."
column2: 你走近一步，压低声音。“现在走掉解决不了这个问题。你以为换个指挥官就会因为你没耐心就给你前线空投？你在这儿有位置。你和这群船员一起训练过，挣下了自己的位置。我可以改你的部署状态——但前提是你别已经半个身子出了气闸。” {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:turn|Default:turns} 过来正对着你，审视着你的表情。“这种话你以前说过。” “这次我换个说法，”你回答。“下一份合约，你就在名册上。这不是让你闭嘴的承诺——是一个决定。留下来，证明你属于那里。” {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:hold|Default:holds} 着你的目光许久……然后 {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:shake|Default:shakes} 了 {TGT_MW.Det} 头。 “不，”{TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:say|Default:says} 轻声说。“我不信你。” 穿梭机接近警报的读数不断下降，{TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:look|Default:looks} 越过你望过去，决心已经定下。“我以前听过‘很快’。我不想再听一次。”

column1: The Argo hums with its usual steady rhythm as you move through one of its narrow passageways, bulkheads close and the lighting dim in that perpetual, shipboard twilight. You nearly pass {TGT_MW.OBJ} before you realize {TGT_MW.Subj}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'re|Default:'s} not just another crew member in transit—[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] is waiting, shoulder against the wall, arms crossed like {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'ve|Default:has} been there a while. {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:straighten|Default:straigthens} as you approach, blocking your path without quite making it an order. No hesitation this time. No pretense either. "Commander," {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:say|Default:says}, voice tight with restrained frustration, "nothing's changed. More simulator hours. Still no real combat drops. So I'm asking again—why?" You stop in the corridor, with the hum of the Argo filling the space between you. This isn't a new conversation—and neither of you pretends it is.
column2: 阿尔戈号照常以稳定的节奏嗡鸣着，你穿过一条狭窄的通道，舱门紧邻，灯光昏暗，永远是一片舰内暮色。你差点与 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 擦肩而过，才意识到 {TGT_MW.Subj}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'re|Default:'s} 不是路过的普通船员——[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 在等你，肩膀靠着墙，双臂抱胸，{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'ve|Default:has} 已经站了一会儿。 你走近时，{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:straighten|Default:straigthens} 了身子，挡住你的路，但还不算是在下命令。这次没有犹豫。也没有掩饰。 “指挥官，”{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:say|Default:says}，声音因压抑的挫败而绷紧，“什么都没变。模拟器时间更多了。还是没有任何真正的战斗空投。所以我又问一遍——为什么？” 你在走廊里停下，阿尔戈号的嗡鸣填满了你们之间的空间。这不是一场新的对话——你们俩谁也没假装它是。

column1: The Barracuda is a capital-scale weapon, capable of firing into low planetary orbit against DropShips or WarShips. It is not typically used against ground targets but when used against them it proves extremely devastating. \n\n Uses Cruise Missile/50 Ammo.
column2: Barracuda 是一种主力舰级别的武器，能够射向近地轨道，攻击空投艇或战舰。它通常不用于攻击地面目标，但一旦用于此途，破坏力极其惊人。\n\n 使用巡航导弹/50 弹药。

column1:
You sit in your command chair aboard the Argo when the hatch slides open and [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] steps in, posture tight with frustration.



"Commander," {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:begin|Default:begins}, "I've logged hundreds of hours in the simulators. Why am I not getting combat drops?"



You fold your hands, studying them for a moment before answering.
column2:
你坐在阿尔戈号的指挥椅上，舱门滑开，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 走了进来，姿态因挫败而绷紧。



“指挥官，”{TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:begin|Default:begins}，“我在模拟器里已经累积了数百小时。为什么还是轮不到我参加战斗空投？”



你交叠双手，端详了一会儿才回答。

column1:
Your expression hardens. "If you can't accept how I run this command, then you don't belong in it."

Their frustration finally boils over. "Accept it? I've been sidelined while my career stalls out. Every day in that simulator is a day no one remembers. You've wasted my time."

You don't flinch. "I've invested in keeping you alive."

"I didn't sign on to wait," they snap. "I signed on to fight."

"And I decide who fights," you reply coldly. "Your contract is terminated. You'll disembark at the next star system."

They let out a bitter laugh. "Finally—somewhere I might actually see combat."

The hatch opens behind them, and this time, they don't wait for dismissal before walking out.
column2:
你的表情冷了下来。“如果你不能接受我如何指挥这支队伍，那你就不属于这里。”

对方的挫败终于爆发。“接受？我的职业生涯停滞不前，一直被晾在一边。在那个模拟器里每待一天，就是一天没人记得我。你浪费了我的时间。”

你没有退缩。“我投入资源是为了让你活着。”

“我签约不是为了等着，”对方厉声说。“我是来打仗的。”

“而由我决定谁去打仗，”你冷冷地回答。“你的合约终止了。你将在下一个星系下船。”

对方发出一声苦涩的笑。“终于——总算有个可能真能打上仗的地方。”

舱门在他们身后打开，这一次，他们没等获准离开就走出去。

column1: You stop a few paces away, arms behind your back. "If you're done, then be done. I don't hold people here who don't want to be here." [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] turns, something sharp in {TGT_MW.Det} expression. "That's it? No argument?" {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:say|Default:says}. "You've made up your mind," you reply coldly. "And I won't waste time chasing someone who's already walking away." A bitter smirk crosses {TGT_MW.Det} face. "At least you're consistent," {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:say|Default:says}. "The shuttle's waiting," you say. {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:grab|Default:grabs} {TGT_MW.Det} bags without another word. As the docking clamps engage and the outer hatch begins its cycle, {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:pause|Default:pauses} just long enough to glance back. "Hope your next pilot likes simulators," {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:say|Default:says}. Darius watches {TGT_MW.Obj} go, then looks to you. "We'll feel that loss." "Then we adapt," you answer, as the hatch seals and the Argo returns to its steady, indifferent hum.
column2: 你在几步外停下，双手背在身后。“你要是想走，那就走吧。我不留不想留在这儿的人。” [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 转过身来，{TGT_MW.Det} 的表情里带着锋芒。“就这样？不争辩？”{TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:say|Default:says}。 “你已经下定决心了，”你冷冷地回答。“我也不会浪费时间追一个已经在走开的人。” {TGT_MW.Det} 脸上掠过一丝苦涩的笑。“至少你始终如一，”{TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:say|Default:says}。 “穿梭机在等着，”你说。 {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:grab|Default:grabs} 起 {TGT_MW.Det} 的行李，一个字也没再说。当对接夹锁合拢、外舱门开始循环开闭时，{TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:pause|Default:pauses} 了片刻，回头看了一眼。 “希望你下一位机师喜欢模拟器，”{TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:say|Default:says}。 Darius 看着 {TGT_MW.Obj} 离开，然后看向你。“这一走，我们会感觉到损失。” “那我们就适应，”你回答，舱门密封，阿尔戈号又恢复了一成不变、无动于衷的嗡鸣。

column2: 在 [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] 轨道上时，Darius 引起了你的注意：“指挥官，Riveting Enterprises 发来通讯，回复我们关于更换故障舱门螺栓的询问。” 你点头示意 Darius 在全息显示器上打开频道：“我是阿尔戈号的 {COMMANDER.LastName} 指挥官。” 全息影像清晰起来，映入眼帘的是一张一看就是销售代表的脸：“{COMMANDER.LastName} 指挥官，您好。我是 Boltan Hatcher，听说您需要一些轨道维修服务。根据我们的记录，阿尔戈号是一艘 Boeing Interstellar 空投艇。”他自顾自地笑了笑，接着说：“请原谅我……老实说，考虑到它的出身，您的船还能保持太空适航真让人吃惊。” 你懒得再听这些闲聊，直接问到点子上：“Hatcher 先生，你究竟能不能帮我们？还有，这要花多少钱？” Hatcher 先生朝你微笑：“开门见山。我欣赏这一点。既然我的雇主 Riveting Enterprises——Jalastar Aerospace 的材料供应商——对 Boeing Interstellar 毫无好感，我们愿意给你一个优惠报价：只需 ¢5,000,000。通常情况下，这种规模的工程要收三倍的钱，不过，‘修好’一艘由竞争对手制造、毛病百出的空投艇，感觉会格外痛快。另外，在你动手继续砍价之前，请记住这一点：我们会把你的维修工作排在所有现有订单之前优先处理，让你以创纪录的速度安全上路。这是我们唯一一次报价，指挥官，请慎重考虑。”

column1: Very well, Mr. Hatcher. We agree to you terms. "Oh, that is excellent news! Excellent indeed!," Mr. Hatcher beams, his smile nearly splitting his face. "Once the funds clear, we will despatch the repair crew immediately." You turn to Darius as the you terminate the transmission, "Transfer the funds and let's get this ship repaired." Thankfully, while over-priced, the repair crew are expedient and efficient wasting no time in flying up from [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] to begin replacing all the faulty hatch bolts on the Argo.
column2: “很好，Hatcher 先生。我们接受你的条件。” “哦，这真是好消息！好得不能再好了！”Hatcher 先生满脸笑意，笑容几乎要把脸咧开。“资金一到账，我们就会立刻派出维修队。” 你结束通话后转向 Darius：“把钱转过去，我们把船修好。” 庆幸的是，维修队虽然要价高得离谱，动作却迅速高效，毫不耽搁地从 [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] 飞上来，开始更换阿尔戈号上所有有问题的舱门螺栓。

column1: Tired of feeling every hit, heat spike or neural feedback when you are in your mech? Well then, Manny Dominos has the perfect solution for you: the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LorePainShunt],Pain Shunt]] surgical procedure. A Pain Shunt will help you better focus your attention on the battlefield by allowing you to ignore painful stimuli*. This technology, the backboneof every Manei Domini operative, can be yours for no more than ¢4,000,000. Stop letting agony affect your performance on the battlefield! *Not guaranteed to ignore any pain endured from that lance mate who just will not shut up WARNING! Pain Shunt surgery may cost up to ¢4,000,000. Our reps are not responsible if you do not have the funds to proceed with surgery. Avoid buying until you have a proper bankroll. Known side effects include clumsiness and may require extended physiotherapy
column2: 在机甲里挨了每一记打击、每一次热量飙升或神经反馈都感同身受，你受够了吗？那么，Manny Dominos 为你准备了完美的解决方案：[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LorePainShunt],痛觉分流器]]外科手术。痛觉分流器能让你忽略疼痛刺激*，从而更好地把注意力集中在战场上。这项技术是每位 Manei Domini 特工的支柱，现在只需 ¢4,000,000 就能属于你。别再让痛苦影响你在战场上的表现！ *不保证能忽略来自那位就是不肯闭嘴的小队队友所带来的痛苦 警告！痛觉分流器手术费用最高可达 ¢4,000,000。如果您的资金不足以进行手术，我们的代表概不负责。请在备足资金之前不要购买。 已知副作用包括动作笨拙，并可能需要长期理疗

column1: Have an [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreEnhancedImagingDisplay],Enhanced Imaging Display]] but want to get more out of it? Let one of our professional MedTechs assess three of your pilots to see if they can receive [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreNeuralImplant],Enhanced Imaging Neural Implants]]! Why do your pilots need this? Well it is simple, a pilot with [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreNeuralImplant],Enhanced Imaging Neural Implants]] will have increased combat effectiveness. Schedule your appointment today! WARNING! Neural Implant surgery may cost up to ¢4,000,000. Our agents are not responsible if you do not have the funds to proceed with surgery. Avoid buying until you have a proper bankroll. DO NOT PURCHASE IF ONLY 1 PILOT REMAINS WITHOUT IMPLANTS! Some side effects may occur such as: feedback in the form of potentially lethal electrical shocks; mental instability; paranoia; abusive personality disorder; diarrhea; introversion; Transit Disorientation Syndrome; night blindness; hair loss; amnesia; combat paralysis; catatonic insanity; death
column2: 有了一台 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreEnhancedImagingDisplay],增强成像显示器]] 却想物尽其用？让我们的专业医疗技师为你手下的三名机师做评估，看看他们能否接受 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreNeuralImplant],增强成像神经植入体]]！ 为什么你的机师需要这个？道理很简单：植入 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreNeuralImplant],增强成像神经植入体]] 的机师，战斗力会得到提升。今天就预约吧！ 警告！神经植入手术费用最高可达 ¢4,000,000。若你资金不足、无法完成手术，我方经纪人概不负责。在备足资金之前请勿购买。 若只剩 1 名机师未植入，请勿购买！ 可能出现某些副作用，例如：以潜在致命电击形式出现的反馈；精神失常；偏执；暴力人格障碍；腹泻；内向；航向迷失综合征；夜盲；脱发；失忆；战斗瘫痪；紧张性精神错乱；死亡

column1: You place a tick next to [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]'s name on the datapad and scribble your signature. Handing the pad to Darius as you stand up, "Ok, lets get [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] to the MedBay and confirm {SCN_MW.SUBJ} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:still want|Default:still wants} to do this. Darius jumps up and heads off to the barracks as you proceed to the MedBay to speak to the Argo's surgeon. You arrive to find the surgeon inspecting the neural map for [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]. They look up when you arrive, "Hello, Commander. [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] is being prepped for surgery as we speak." You nod, "You feel comfortable performing this procedure?" The surgeon nods back, "I do Commander. I have done similar types of surgeries in my past before I hired on with your company." You turn to exit the room, "Very well, let me know how the procedure goes." :::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: Hours later, Darius finds you in the lounge, "Boss, I just wanted to tell you that there were serious complications with [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]'s procedure. {SCN_MW.Subj_C} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} fine but it will take extended rehab and simpod training before they are ready to get back into the field. The extra time healing and training will set us back nearly 4x the initial costs. The MedTech also suspect it will take nearly 2 years for them to regain full coordination back." You smile, and raise your glass, "The cost is irrelevant, I am just glad they pulled through. Keep me posted Darius."
column2: 你在数据板上 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 的名字旁打了个勾，潦草地签上名。起身时把数据板递给达里乌斯：“好，我们把 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 送到医疗舱去，确认 {SCN_MW.SUBJ} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:still want|Default:still wants} 做这件事。 达里乌斯跳起来朝营房走去，你则前往医疗舱去见阿尔戈号的外科医生。 你到达时，医生正在查看 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 的神经图谱。看到你进来，他们抬起头：“你好，指挥官。[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 正在为手术做准备。” 你点点头：“你有把握做好这台手术吗？” 医生也点点头：“有，指挥官。在受雇于你的公司之前，我做过几台类似的手术。” 你转身离开房间：“很好，手术情况随时通知我。” :::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: 几个小时后，达里乌斯在休息室找到你：“老板，我只是想告诉你，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 的手术出现了严重并发症。{SCN_MW.Subj_C} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} 已无大碍，但需要长期的康复和模拟舱训练才能重新投入战场。额外的康复和训练时间会让我们的开销接近初期的 4 倍。医疗技师还推测，他们要完全恢复协调能力需要将近 2 年。” 你笑了，举起酒杯：“费用不重要，我只庆幸他们挺过来了。有进展随时告诉我，达里乌斯。”
