column1:
Dragon 66 was born Zin Ala in the Federated Suns, the child of a family of military bureaucrats. His stable, safe childhood left him craving more excitement than bureaucracy could provide, so when he was old enough, he enrolled in the planetary guards.

After boot camp, his aptitude tests placed him in logistical support roles — not that different from what his family did, but at least he was on the more exciting front lines. Through dedicated service and commitment, Zin worked his way up from driving supply vehicles to planning their routes to overseeing entire logistical operations.

All that changed when an operation he was involved with collapsed, leaving him one of the few able-bodied soldiers able to defend a key location. He did a hero's job, but when reinforcements won through, they came with military lawyers and wagging fingers over breaches of protocol.

As a result, he ended up on Solaris VII, where he stayed just long enough to establish a reputation. But knowing he had no future there, he moved on to the Periphery, looking for a chance to once again start at the bottom and work his way up.
column2:
Dragon 66 原名 Zin Ala，出生于联邦太阳国一个军人官僚家庭。他安稳无忧的童年让他渴望比官僚工作更多的刺激，因此一到足够年龄，他就报名参加了行星卫队。

新兵训练结束后，他的能力测试把他分到了后勤支援岗位——和他家人干的事没多大区别，但至少更靠近刺激的前线。凭着尽职与投入，Zin 从开补给车一路做到规划运输路线，再到统筹整个后勤运作。

这一切在一次他参与的行动崩盘后彻底改变，他成了少数还能行动、能够守卫关键地点的士兵之一。他打了一场英雄般的战斗，但援军突破进来时，带来的却是军法律师和一连串违反规程的指责。

结果，他被送到索拉里斯七号，在那里待到刚够建立起名声。但他知道自己在那里没有前途，于是前往外围，寻找一个能让他再次从底层干起、一步步往上爬的机会。

column1:
A strange illness emptied the lance of damaged BattleMechs seeking refuge at the small, peaceful mining town of X, and superstitious fear kept them empty for years. But when raiders came, four young boys who'd been playing around the 'Mechs for years climbed into them to defend their home. They failed, of course, but the impressed leader of the raiders took the 'Mechs instead of their lives, and left their community enough to rebuild with.

Some kids would have taken that defeat hard, but not Archangel. He rallied his friends and came up with a plan. When the raiders came back a few years later for another 'harvest', Archangel and his team were ready. They didn't have BattleMechs, but they had mining equipment, AgroMechs, and a whole lot of time to practice.

They still lost, but they did no worse than they'd done with BattleMechs, and with far inferior equipment. That time, the leader of the raiders left the equipment, and took the young men. She split them among her ships, and Archangel hasn't seen his friends since. He wasn't the most malleable of recruits, but the raider leader had a gift for redirecting his fury and putting his stubborn recklessness to good use.

Eventually, just prior to her retirement, the leader kicked him out of her gang, telling him he'd be better off in a proper mercenary crew with somebody who could both point him in the best direction, and yank his balls out of the fire just in case Plan A failed, failed again, and failed a third time. It turned out she was correct. In the right team, Archangel is amazing.

These days, he's starting to miss his old town, and wondering if it or a place like it needs somebody to protect it. Somebody who will never give up; somebody like him.
column2:
一场诡异的疾病清空了一整个小队受损的战斗机甲——它们原本躲进名为 X 的小型和平矿业城镇避难，而迷信造成的恐惧让这些机甲空置了多年。但当劫掠者来袭时，四个多年来在这些机甲旁玩耍的少年爬了进去，保卫自己的家园。他们当然失败了，但被打动的劫掠者头目没有取他们的命，而是带走了机甲，还给他们的社区留下了足以重建的物资。

有些孩子会把这次失败看得很重，但 Archangel 没有。他把朋友们重新聚起来，想出了一个计划。几年后劫掠者再来“收割”时，Archangel 和他的小队已经准备好了。他们没有战斗机甲，但他们有采矿设备、农用机甲，以及大把大把的时间用来练习。

他们还是输了，但他们的表现不比开着战斗机甲时差，而且手上的装备要差得多。这一次，劫掠者的头目留下了装备，带走了这群年轻人。她把他们分到她各艘船上，Archangel 从此再没见过自己的朋友。他不是最容易驯服的新兵，但那位劫掠者头目有种天赋，能把他胸中的怒火引向别处，让他那固执的莽撞派上用场。

最终，就在她退休之前，这位头目把他赶出了帮派，告诉他，他更适合去一支正规的雇佣兵队里，找一个既能给他指明最佳方向、又能在 A 计划失败、再失败、第三次失败时把他从火坑里拽出来的人。事实证明她说得对。在合适的队伍里，Archangel 表现得极其出色。

这些日子，他开始想念自己的旧镇，也在想那里——或是像那里一样的某个地方——是不是需要一个守护者。一个永远不会放弃的人；像他这样的人。

column1:
Reginald von Kaas was born and bred on Terra, the only child of ComStar Demi-Precentors. He grew up schooled in all the traditions and when he was of age, he joined the local defense force.

After some formal training, he was assigned to supervise BattleMech restoration, where he fell in love with the machines. Using his family connections, he had himself reassigned as a 'Mech pilot. He then proceeded to show such dedication to the use and care of 'Mechs that he was quickly promoted to the top of his local defense cadre despite the lack of combat opportunities.

After that, there's a blank spot in his record, the sort typical of those who have engaged in covert operations. He dropped out of sight for over five years. His next official record is in the Periphery on the MRB register, using the callsign VonKobra, and with several impressive shooting certifications under his belt.

According to those records, at one time he led a small mercenary unit of his own, but that unit dissolved without any recorded contracts. He now considers himself a freelance operative, although his personal intensity suggests the 'freelance' descriptor may be deceptive.
column2:
Reginald von Kaas 生于泰拉、长于泰拉，是彗星通讯两位副执事的独子。他自幼接受全套传统教育，成年后加入了当地的防御部队。

在受过一段时间正式训练后，他被派去监督战斗机甲的修复工作，并从此爱上了这些机器。他利用家族关系把自己改派为机甲机师，随后又表现出对机甲使用与维护近乎忘我的投入，很快被提升到当地防御骨干部队的顶层——尽管那里没什么参战机会。

在那之后，他的档案出现一段空白，正是那些从事秘密行动之人常见的空白。他有五年多时间从人们的视线中消失。他下一份官方记录出现在外围的 MRB 名册上，用的是“VonKobra”这个呼号，名下有若干令人印象深刻的射击认证。

根据那些记录，他曾一度领导过一支自己的小型雇佣兵部队，但那支部队没有任何记录在案的合约就解散了。他如今自认是自由特工，不过他本人的那股紧绷劲，让人怀疑“自由”这个描述可能并不那么简单。

column1:
James Bixby was born on Arc-Royal in the Lyran Commonwealth to a wealthy family that, as new money, lacked many of the advantages of the titled aristocracy, most notably land and a family BattleMech. Because of his wealthy background, James was easily able to enter the Somerset Military Academy, where he scored in the top 15% of his class and won a coveted position in a Cadet Trade with House Davion's Albion Military Academy.

After graduation, he earned his callsign 'Arbiter' evaluating recently dispossessed MechWarriors to see if they were worthy of a replacement machine. This was just a stepping stone to getting his own BattleMech, however. He earned assignment to a Griffin after several years of writing up reports on other pilots and attending off-hours training sessions. He was assigned to the Storm Company in the Lyran Guard, where he served faithfully for a five year tour.

However, when he was overlooked for a promotion due to his lack of family connections, he realized he had no interest in spending the rest of his life as nothing more than a 'Mech pilot for the military. He cashed out his savings and war salvage and headed to the Periphery to see what he could do about acquiring a BattleMech of his own, and bringing his family the prestige it had always lacked.
column2:
James Bixby 出生于天琴共同体 Arc-Royal 星的一个富裕家庭，但作为新贵，他们缺少有爵位贵族享有的许多优势，其中最明显的就是土地和传家的战斗机甲。凭借家中的财富，James 顺利进入萨默塞特军事学院，在那里取得全班前 15% 的成绩，并赢得了与戴维恩家族阿尔比恩军事学院交换学员的宝贵名额。

毕业后，他获得了“仲裁者”这个呼号，工作是评估那些刚刚失去机甲的机甲战士，判断他们是否配得上一台替换机体。不过这只是他拿到自己战斗机甲的跳板。在写了几年关于其他机师的报告、又参加了无数下班后的训练之后，他终于获配一台狮鹫，被分配到天琴卫队的风暴连，忠诚服役了一个五年任期。

然而，当他因为缺乏家族关系而被跳过了晋升时，他意识到自己毫无兴趣余生在军中只当一名机甲机师。他变现了积蓄和战争战利品，前往外围，看看能不能弄到一台属于自己的战斗机甲，为家族带来它一直缺少的威望。

column1:
Tony Bono has no memory of his parents, who were a gladiatorial duo on Solaris VII, and who died particularly memorable deaths that are still occasionally referenced today. He was raised by the techs and other gladiators in the stable, growing up on stories of the valor and celebrity of his parents and other famous arena champions.

When he was eighteen, despite the wishes of his favorite auntie, he decided to officially join the stable as a gladiator instead of a tech. He was an excellent duelist, able to make any fight not just entertaining but actually exciting, but his temperament was too serious. He found he was unable to showboat in a way that garnered more than passing media attention, despite his family background.

Unable to convince himself to move from piloting a 'Mech to repairing them, no matter what his stable aunties hoped, he eventually withdrew entirely from gladiatorial life. After traveling a while on the farewell gift of his adopted family, he headed to the Periphery, where his grim focus on winning small-scale battles has served him well as a MechWarrior-for-hire.
column2:
Tony Bono 对父母毫无记忆。他们曾是索拉里斯七号上的一对竞技场搭档，死法格外令人难忘，至今偶尔还有人提起。他被竞技场的技师和其他角斗士养大，听着父母和其他著名竞技场冠军的英勇与传奇故事长大。

十八岁那年，不顾最疼爱他的阿姨们的意愿，他决定正式加入竞技场当角斗士，而不是当技师。他是个出色的决斗者，能让任何一场战斗不仅好看，而且真正刺激，但他的性情太过严肃。他发现自己没法做出那种能引来媒体更多注意的花哨表演——尽管他有着那样的家世。

无论竞技场的阿姨们怎么期盼，他都无法说服自己从驾驶机甲转向维修机甲，最终他彻底退出了角斗生涯。靠着养父母送给他的告别礼物旅行了一段时间后，他前往外围，在那里，他对小规模战斗胜负的执着专注让他成为一名干得不错的受雇机甲战士。

column1: Grampa Checkers is an old damn man. Even in the Inner Sphere, where age is less of an impediment for MechWarriors due to advanced medical proceedures and prosthetics, Grampa is very old to be a pilot. He didn't age gracefully either, often going off on random tangents and falling down a lot. Still, when you get him on-topic (and on-target), he proves to still be a crackshot in the cockpit. But you still have to deal with him on comms, which might not be worth it. Your call, Commander.\n\n
column2: Checker 老爹是个不折不扣的老家伙。即便在内天体，先进的医疗手段与义肢让年龄对机甲战士的阻碍小了许多，Checker 老爹当机师也算是相当老了。他老得也不体面，常常莫名其妙跑题，还经常摔倒。不过，只要你能让他集中精神（并瞄准目标），他在驾驶舱里依然是把好手。但你得忍着跟他在通讯频道里打交道，这也许并不值得。由你决定，指挥官。\n\n

Yang nods and walks briskly out of the room on his way to the 'Mech Bay. You wait. A few seconds later he walks back through and out the other door in the direction of the bridge. column1:
As you cut the connection to your last client, Yang bursts into the command center.  He looks out of breath, 

"There's a problem, Boss," he says, leaning on a nearby console to catch his breath.



"Go on," you instruct, quirking a brow.



He goes on to explain the dilemma - while, yes, your old command vehicle was still around, there's been no small amount of confusion on the ground.  Records have been lost, found, copied wrong, lost again, copied from the copies, et cetera.

  "So, the short of it is," Yang concludes, "they have an [[DM.MechDefs[vehicledef_AWACS],AWACS Command VTOL]] and an [[DM.MechDefs[vehicledef_MOBILEHQ_C3M],C3 Mobile HQ truck]], but they don't know which one actually belongs to you. The way I see it, we can just pick the one we want and they'll be none the wiser!
column2:
你切断与最后一位客户的通讯时，杨冲进了指挥中心。他看起来气喘吁吁，

“出问题了，老板，”他说，靠在一旁的控制台上喘气。



“继续说，”你挑了挑眉。



他接着解释了这件麻烦事——是的，你以前的指挥车辆还在，但地面上已经乱成一团。档案丢了又找到，抄错了，又丢了，再从副本上抄，如此反复。

“所以说，简单来说，”杨总结道，“他们那里有一架 [[DM.MechDefs[vehicledef_AWACS],AWACS 指挥 VTOL]] 和一辆 [[DM.MechDefs[vehicledef_MOBILEHQ_C3M],C3 Mobile HQ 卡车]]，但他们不知道到底哪一件才真正属于你。在我看来，我们随便挑一件就行，他们根本分不出来！

column1: No, Darius says, firmly. His jaw is set as he folds his arms and stares pointedly at you over the holographic display in the command center. "Oh, c'mon!" You protest. "It's a small risk, sure, but the pay-off is absolutely worth it!" You and Darius have been arguing back and forth for the last fifteen minutes. You're convinced that you can flip this wayward shipment of [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHolovidMercenaries],MERCENARIES!]] before anybody in the crew finds out about it. Darius, on the other hand, is not. "Yang'll throw a fit if he hears about this. You know that," Darius reiterates. "You're playing with fire here." "And? Three million, Darius." Eventually, he sighs and throws up his hands. "Fine, go ahead, but don't whine to me if this comes back to bite us."
column2: “不行，”达里乌斯态度坚决。他抱着双臂、下颌紧绷，隔着指挥中心的全息显示屏直直盯着你。 “哦，别这样！”你抗议道。“风险是很小，没错，但回报绝对值得！” 你和达里乌斯已经来回争了十五分钟。你坚信自己能在船员们发现之前，把这批跑偏了的 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHolovidMercenaries],雇佣兵！]] 剧集脱手。达里乌斯则不这么认为。 “杨要是听说了，肯定会闹翻天。你知道的，”达里乌斯重申。“你这是在玩火。” “那又怎样？三百万，达里乌斯。” 最终，他叹了口气，摊开双手。“行吧，随你去，但要是这事回头咬我们一口，别来找我抱怨。”

column1: Your listing for the holovid series lasts a whole two hours at the outrageous price before you get your first bite. It seems that entertainment is pretty hard to come by in this system, or perhaps you found a very dedicated collector.\n\nWith the utmost secrecy, you organise a dead drop to prevent anybody in the crew from learning of the deed and cash out.
column2: 你以离谱的价格发布那套全息剧集，才过了整整两个小时就有人上钩了。看来这个星系里娱乐实在难得，又或者你碰上了一个非常执着的收藏家。\n\n你以极其保密的方式安排了一次死信箱交接，确保船上没人知道这笔交易，然后顺利收钱。

column1: As you're browsing the various commercial networks, you're struck with an epiphany. Why sell just one copy of the holovids? Oh ho ho, delightfully devilish, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. Surely there wouldn't be an kind of anti-piracy systems in place for a series enjoyed mostly by [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LorePeriphery],Periphery]] yokels. Box set in hand, you rush down to Engineering. Farah looks less than amused as you explain the scheme to her. If her brow dropped any lower it would be touching her chin. Reluctantly, she accepts the holovids from you. "I'll let you know when I'm done, I suppose, Commander," she says with an air of defeat. A few hours later and you've flooded the local market with bootleg copies of [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHolovidMercenaries],MERCENARIES!]] Surely this won't cause problems.
column2: 你浏览各种商业网络时，突然灵光一现。为什么只卖一份全息剧集呢？哦吼吼，真是坏得有趣啊，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。一部主要由[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LorePeriphery],外围]]乡下人追捧的剧集，肯定没什么反盗版系统吧。 你捧着套装盒冲进工程部。你向她解释这套方案时，法拉看起来一点也不觉得有趣。她的眉毛再往下压一点就要碰到下巴了。她不情不愿地从你手里接过了全息影像。 “我弄好了会告诉你，大概吧，指挥官，”她带着一副认输的神情说。 几个小时后，你已经用盗版拷贝淹没了当地市场：[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHolovidMercenaries],雇佣兵！]] 这肯定不会惹出什么麻烦吧。

column1:
Before you commit to hauling the crates onto the Leopard to bring home, you figure it can't hurt to check on the goods.

Approaching the crate on top of the stack, you dial the code you'd been given into the keypad. With a satisfying click, the locking mechanism releases and the lid cracks open.

Inside you find neatly packaged - with notably more care given than you've seen most military equipment subject to - a Star League era [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreUAC],Ultra AC/5]]. In one of the accompanying crates, you find ammo for the weapon.

"Nice," you say to yourself, clicking the crates back closed. "Alright, let's get this all onto the Leopard and get out of here."
column2:
在决定把箱子搬上豹式运回家之前，你觉得先验一下货总没坏处。

你走到垛顶那只箱子前，把人家给的密码敲进键盘。随着一声令人满意的轻响，锁扣松开，箱盖弹起。

里面的东西包装得整整齐齐——比大多数军用装备得到的照料明显要细致得多——是一门星际联盟时代的 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreUAC],超级 AC/5]]。在随附的一只箱子里，你找到了这门武器的弹药。

“不错，”你自言自语，把箱子重新扣好。“好了，把这些全部搬上豹式，然后离开这里。”

column1:
Before you commit to hauling the crates onto the Leopard to bring home, you figure it can't hurt to check on the goods.

Approaching the crate on top of the stack, you dial the code you'd been given into the keypad. With a satisfying click, the locking mechanism releases and the lid cracks open.

Inside you find neatly packaged - with notably more care given than you've seen most military equipment subject to - an [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreLRM],LRM-15]] launcher and paired [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreArtemisIV],Artemis IV FCS]]. A second, identical crate sits next to it. In one of the smaller accompanying crates, you find ammo for the weapons.

"Nice," you say to yourself, clicking the crates back closed. "Alright, let's get this all onto the Leopard and get out of here."
column2:
在决定把箱子搬上豹式运回家之前，你觉得先验一下货总没坏处。

你走到垛顶那只箱子前，把人家给的密码敲进键盘。随着一声令人满意的轻响，锁扣松开，箱盖弹起。

里面的东西包装得整整齐齐——比大多数军用装备得到的照料明显要细致得多——是一具 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreLRM],LRM-15]] 发射器和配套的 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreArtemisIV],阿尔忒弥斯 IV 火控系统]]。旁边放着第二只一模一样的箱子。在随附的一只较小的箱子里，你找到了这些武器的弹药。

“不错，”你自言自语，把箱子重新扣好。“好了，把这些全部搬上豹式，然后离开这里。”

column1:
It's been several years since you'd felt this ready to get back into the cockpit. You thought that [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDAMOCLES],DAMOCLES]] would've been enough excitement for a lifetime, and yet you find yourself once more itching to climb into the pilot seat. As you pace back and forth outside the 'Mech Bay, flanked by armored windows showcasing the inky black, Yang's voice catches your attention.

"Hey, Boss. She's out of [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreColdStorage],mothball]]," he informs you, "all ready to go."

Your pacing abruptly stops and a small smile graces your face. Yang seems to have noticed, since he wears one of his own.

"Well?" He asks, "are you just gonna stand there grinnin' or are you gonna come check her out?"
column2:
你已经好几年没有这么想重新坐进驾驶舱了。你以为 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDAMOCLES],达摩克利斯行动]] 带来的刺激足够用一辈子，可你还是发现自己再一次渴望着爬进驾驶座。你在机甲库外来回踱步，两侧是映出漆黑太空的装甲舷窗，这时杨的声音引起了你的注意。

“嘿，老板。她已经从[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreColdStorage],封存]]中出来了，”他告诉你，“随时可以上场。”

你的脚步戛然而止，脸上浮起一丝笑意。杨似乎也注意到了，因为他自己也笑了起来。

“怎么样？”他问，“你就打算站在这儿傻笑，还是过来看看她？”

column1:
Before you commit to hauling the crates onto the Leopard to bring home, you figure it can't hurt to check on the goods.

Approaching the crate on top of the stack, you dial the code you'd been given into the keypad. With a satisfying click, the locking mechanism releases and the lid cracks open.

Inside you find neatly packaged - with notably more care given than you've seen most military equipment subject to - a pair of BattleMech [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSNPPC],Snub-Nose PPCs]]. Inspecting another crate reveals something even more intriguing - Star League era [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDHS],double heat sinks]]!

"Nice," you say to yourself, clicking the crates back closed. "Alright, let's get this all onto the Leopard and get out of here."
column2:
在决定把箱子搬上豹式运回家之前，你觉得先验一下货总没坏处。

你走到垛顶那只箱子前，把人家给的密码敲进键盘。随着一声令人满意的轻响，锁扣松开，箱盖弹起。

里面的东西包装得整整齐齐——比大多数军用装备得到的照料明显要细致得多——是一对战斗机甲用的 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSNPPC],短管 PPC]]。检查另一只箱子时，你发现了更令人心动的东西——星际联盟时代的 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDHS],双散热器]]！

“不错，”你自言自语，把箱子重新扣好。“好了，把这些全部搬上豹式，然后离开这里。”

column1:
Ever since you'd been informed of the accident at the facility, you've been on edge. That place and the rigorous testing regimes have a special place in your nightmares. Staring out the window of the observation pod into the inky black, you start as you hear the bulkhead door open behind you.

"Oop, sorry, Boss," comes Yang's voice. The door quietly hisses shut behind him, leaving the two of you in almost complete silence. At least, until he speaks again. "We just got back with the Leopard. It's exactly as the orbital scans said - the facility's toast."

For a brief moment, you don't know what to feel. What happened within those walls was a deeply formative experience for you.

"But," Yang continues, "we did find something — a couple of those [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[ConceptProtoMech],ProtoMechs]] in complete shambles. I hope you don't mind, but we brought them back with us and I've had the boys take a look at fixing them up and seeing if we can get a full squad rolling.
column2:
自从得知那座设施出了事故，你就一直心神不宁。那个地方和那套严苛的测试流程，在你的噩梦里占有特殊的位置。你站在观察舱的窗前凝视着漆黑太空，听到身后的舱门打开，你不禁一颤。

“哎呀，抱歉，老板，”杨的声音传来。门在他身后轻轻嘶的一声合上，把你们两人留在近乎彻底的寂静里。至少在他再次开口之前是这样。“我们刚带着豹式回来。情况跟轨道扫描说的一模一样——那座设施彻底完了。”

有那么一瞬间，你不知道自己该是什么感觉。那些墙里发生过的事，对你来说是一段影响深远的经历。

“不过，”杨接着说，“我们确实找到了点东西——几台彻底散架的 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[ConceptProtoMech],原型机甲]]。希望你不介意，我们把它们带回来了，我已经让兄弟们试着修一修，看看能不能凑出一整支小队来。

column1: Thanks for the heads up, Yang, you say. The feeling isn't pleasant, but you feel a small amount of empathy for the machines. In a way, they were discarded just as much as you were. "Let me know when they're ready."\n\nYang nods and turns to leave. He pauses to clap a hand on your shoulder. "Will do, Boss," he answers, "will do."
column2: “谢谢你提醒，杨，”你说。这感觉并不好受，但你多少对这些机器生出几分共情。从某种角度说，它们和你一样被人抛弃了。“准备好了就告诉我。”\n\n杨点点头，转身要走。他停下脚步，在你肩上拍了一下。“会的，老板，”他说，“会的。”

column1:
You approach the location of the dead drop with Yang and Sumire in tow. Both of them seem somewhat anxious, a stark comparison to your relative nonchalance.

"Dead drops like this always make me uncomfortable," Yang complains, his head on a swivel.

"You get used to them after a while," Sumire says, "especially with the amount I get sent on."

"Well, I'm not you, in case you hadn't noticed," comes Yang's reply.

"Can it, you two," you butt in.

A small collection of crates sit neatly bundled at the precise location given, a locator beacon slowly blinking atop the pile.

Despite being long removed from the jarhead life, your making friends with the quartermaster sure has paid off. This is the third package of goods that's been 'misplaced', and you're certainly not going to start complaining about them now.

Only one question remains - what goodies did you ask for this time?
column2:
你带着杨和苏米尔来到死信箱地点。两人看起来都有些紧张，与你相对淡定的样子形成鲜明对比。

“这种死信箱总让我不舒服，”杨抱怨道，脑袋转个不停。

“过一阵你就习惯了，”苏米尔说，“尤其是我被派去取货的次数。”

“喂，我可不是你，你没注意到吗，”杨回嘴。

“你俩闭嘴，”你插话道。

一小堆箱子整整齐齐地捆在指定的准确位置，顶上有个定位信标缓缓闪烁。

尽管早已远离了陆战队的日子，你和军需官交朋友这件事确实值回票价。这已经是第三批被“放错地方”的货了，你当然不打算现在开始抱怨。

现在只剩一个问题——这次你要的又是什么好货？

column1:
The mood on the bridge is solemn. You and Darius watch as a spokesperson on a flickering holo-vid dispassionately informs you of the death of your great-uncle, offering the bare minimum of condolences mandated by their estate.

As the recording comes to a close and the image winks out, Yang enters the room. "Uh, hey, Boss," he begins, "Sumire found the location those coordinates point to while you were busy dealing with all the paperwork. She took the Leopard out and hauled a 'Mech back with her. If I had to guess, this is what the message calls his 'favorite little treasure'."

You raise an eyebrow, expectantly.

"I'll be honest," Yang continues, "I took a peek - it belongs in a museum."
column2:
舰桥上的气氛庄重肃穆。你和达里乌斯看着闪烁的全息影像里一位发言人面无表情地宣读你叔祖父的死讯，只给出遗产程序所要求的最低限度悼词。

录音结束、影像熄灭后，杨走进房间。“呃，嘿，老板，”他开口道，“你忙着处理那些文书的时候，苏米尔找到了那些坐标所指的位置。她开着豹式出去了一趟，拖回来一台机甲。要我说，这就是那条讯息里所称的‘他最心爱的小宝贝’。”

你挑起了眉毛，等着下文。

“老实说，”杨继续说，“我瞄了一眼——那东西该进博物馆。”

column1: They're 'Mechs! But smaller!\nQuirks: [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkMechWarrior],MechWarrior]], [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkNeuralImplants],Neural Implants]]\nUnit: random [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[ConceptProtoMech],ProtoMech]]
column2: 它们是机甲！但要小一号！\n特性：[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkMechWarrior],机甲战士]]、[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkNeuralImplants],神经植入体]]\n单位：随机 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[ConceptProtoMech],原型机甲]]

column2: 战争。战争从未改变。但老天，我们真希望它会变。\n特性：[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkBrave],勇敢]]、[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkMilitary],退伍军人]]\n装备：各式 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StarterBundleSoldier],失落科技武器]]

column2: 它本该进博物馆，现在却归你了。\n特性：[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkLucky],幸运]]、[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkNoble],贵族]]\n单位：随机稀有机甲

column1: I thought you were joking when you said you worked for [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTeamBanzai],Team Banzai]]! Yang blurts out, noting your amused expression as you look up from your datapad. You crack a small grin.\n\n"Your old ride's waiting for you in the 'Mech Bay, Boss," he informs you with no small amount of huffiness.
column2: “你说你曾为 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTeamBanzai],Team Banzai]] 效力时，我还以为你开玩笑！”杨脱口而出，看见你从数据板上抬起头时脸上那副好笑的表情。你微微一笑。\n\n“你的老座机在机甲库等你，老板，”他带着十足的怨气告诉你。

column1:
Hey Boss, I got that crate of old Solaris gear you had sent up, Yang says as he walks onto the bridge. There's an air of apprehension hovering over him.

"Alright," you say, a smirk on your face, "out with it."

Yang glances around tentatively, then clears his throat and speaks. "You had a different callsign back in your gladiator days, right? What was it? I might have seen a few of your matches."
column2:
“嘿，老板，你要的那箱索拉里斯旧装备送上来了，”杨说着走上舰桥。他周身萦绕着一种忐忑不安的气氛。

“好吧，”你说，脸上带着坏笑，“说吧。”

杨心虚地张望了一下，然后清了清嗓子开口。“你当年当角斗士时用的呼号不一样，对吧？是什么来着？我可能看过你几场比赛。”

column1: As you stare out the window into the black expanse, Yang clears his throat.\n\n"Hey Boss. That crate of battle armor stuff just arrived. I'm planning to crack her open and take inventory. Figured you'd wanna know."
column2: 你正凝视窗外漆黑的虚空，杨清了清嗓子。\n\n“嘿，老板。那箱战斗装甲的东西刚到。我打算撬开它清点一下。想着你应该想知道。”

column1:
You follow Yang down to the cargo bays, passing MechTechs hurrying in the other direction on various jobs.

"Y'know, Boss," Yang begins as you round a corner, "I've always wondered why an infantryman would want to lead a group of Mechjocks. Haven't you spent the last few years tryin' to avoid being stepped on by 'em?"

You blink at the unexpected question, taking some time to mull it over. "I guess I just wanted to turn the tables. Now I'm the one higher up and they're the ones dancing to my tune."

Yang chuckles quietly. "I can respect that, Boss. I can respect that."
column2:
你跟着杨下到货舱，一路与匆匆朝反方向赶去干活的机甲技师们擦肩而过。

“你知道，老板，”你拐过弯角时杨开口道，“我一直想不明白，一个步兵为什么会想带着一群机甲兵。你这几年不是一直在躲着别被他们踩着吗？”

这个问题出乎意料，你眨了眨眼，花了一点时间琢磨。“我大概只是想翻个身。现在轮到我在上面，他们得跟着我的调子跳舞。”

杨轻轻笑了。“这我服气，老板。我服气。”

column1:
As you make plans to retire for the evening, Yang catches you in the hallway outside your quarters. He seems out of breath and covered in a thin film of engine grease and sweat.

"Hey Boss," he begins, idly wiping his hands on his overalls, "we're done with the last of our checks. Your [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHunchback],Hunchback]] was pretty shot up, but she's all squeaky clean now."

Seeing the tiredness vanish from your face, Yang claps a greasy hand on your shoulder. "That's the spirit! Come check her out!"
column2:
你正准备回房休息，杨在舱室外的走廊里拦住了你。他看起来上气不接下气，身上覆着一层薄薄的机油和汗水。

“嘿，老板，”他开口，随手在工装裤上擦着手，“我们最后几项检查都做完了。你那台 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHunchback],驼背]] 伤得不轻，不过现在擦得干干净净、状态十足。”

看到你脸上的疲惫一扫而空，杨用一只油腻的手拍在你肩上。“这才对嘛！来看看她！”

column1: While your last raid concluded hours ago, you've barely made a dent in sifting through the spoils. You stand on the far side of the Argo's 'Mech Bay, tapping entries into a datapad as all hands ferry weaponry, shells, and slabs of BattleMech armor off the carcasses of your rivals' 'Mechs. "Hey, Boss," comes Yang's voice. You look up from the pad and see him walking over, wiping greasy hands on a rag at his belt. "One of these 'Mechs is in pretty good shape. We could get her runnin' again instead of needing to salvage her."
column2: 你上一次劫掠结束已经是几个小时前，但你连战利品的一小部分都还没理清。你站在阿尔戈号机甲库的另一头，一边往数据板里敲记录，一边看着所有人手把武器、炮弹和成片的战斗机甲装甲从对手机甲的残骸上卸下来。 “嘿，老板，”杨的声音传来。 你从数据板上抬起头，看到他走过来，用腰间的抹布擦着油腻的手。 “这些机甲里有一台状态相当不错。我们可以让她重新跑起来，而不用把她拆成战利品。”

column1: You nod in the affirmative. "Sounds good to me. Let's see exactly what old Bobbert was throwing at us."\n\nReadying the 'Mech takes another few hours, as Yang tosses out wrecked components and complains about "inelegant" workmanship. The irony is apparently lost on him as he crams the chassis full of rat's nests of his own design.
column2: 你点头同意。“听起来不错。让我们看看老 Bobbert 到底拿什么招呼我们。”\n\n让那台机甲准备好又花了几个小时，杨一边扔出报废的部件，一边抱怨手艺“不够讲究”。当他把自己的设计像老鼠窝一样塞满整个底盘时，这份讽刺显然没被他察觉。

column1:
You hurry to the 'Mech Bay to find Yang punching at his datapad by the bulkhead. As you approach, he glances up and offers a short wave.

"Hey Boss. She's all unpacked," he says, gesturing into the 'Mech Bay. "A few bangs and scrapes, but I think Carrick kept his word. Nothing important's missing. You want to see for yourself?"

You give a short nod and hurry past Yang into the bay. Sumire is loitering inside, and as you unveil your prize acquisition, her eyes go wide:
column2:
你赶到机甲库，看到杨在舱壁边使劲戳着数据板。你走近时，他抬头看了你一眼，简短地挥了下手。

“嘿，老板。她已经卸完货了，”他说，朝机甲库里指了指。“有几处磕碰刮痕，但我想 Carrick 说话算话。没缺什么要紧的东西。你要不要自己看看？”

你简短地点了下头，从杨身边快步走进机库。苏米尔在里面闲站着，当你揭开那台得意购来的机甲时，她瞪大了眼睛：

column1: Space has always called to you.\nQuirks: [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkHonest],Honest]], [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkSpacer],Spacer]]
column2: 太空一直在召唤你。\n特性：[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkHonest],诚实]]、[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkSpacer],太空人]]

column1: Alicia "Hellion" McEvedy comes from the Deep Periphery, only disclosing that she had a strict upbringing she couldn't stand anymore. A hotheaded, capable pilot, willing to get into the middle of any brawl and surprisingly adept at making LosTech just work. She has a deep distrust towards ComStar and smiles sharkishly when someone mentions the Exodus. She was also known as a Pirate Queen by the name of "Lady Alekto".\n\n
column2: Alicia“小恶魔”McEvedy 来自深外围，只肯透露自己曾受过一种她再也受不了的严苛教养。她是个火爆脾气但能力出众的机师，乐意插进任何一场混战，还意外地擅长让失落科技勉强运转起来。她对彗星通讯怀有深深的不信任，一有人提起大迁徙，她就会露出鲨鱼般的笑容。她还曾以“Alekto 女士”之名被称作海盗女王。\n\n

column1: Idget was once a tech, solving issues - called 'tickets' in the jargon - that cropped up at work. After a pirate raid which saw massive casualties, the volume of tickets dropped significantly. Seeing such effective ticket-closing action, Idget quickly trained as a MechWarrior, promising to help solve tickets everywhere, one way or another. Working for mercenaries all over, Idget started to receive a reputation of being the best anti-urban-ambush pilot around, due to the methodical way in which buildings were leveled in the area of operations. They say that if you're lucky enough, when the tickets become too deep, Idget will come and save you.\n\n
column2: Idget 原本是名技师，专门处理工作中冒出来的问题——行话里叫“工单”。一次海盗劫掠造成大量伤亡后，工单数量骤降。看到如此高效的“关单”战果，Idget 很快转行接受机甲战士训练，承诺要到处帮忙解决工单，方式不拘。在为各地雇佣兵工作期间，Idget 渐渐获得了周围最擅长反城市伏击机师的声誉，那要归功于她有条不紊地把作战区域内的建筑物夷为平地。他们说，如果你够走运，当工单堆积如山时，Idget 会来救你。\n\n

column1:
Kodiak was always a studious sort, learning about all the famous Solaris fighters over the centuries and where they and their 'Mechs came from. His research led him into the sights of Interstellar Expeditions, who had realised his knowledge of maps and technology stockpiles from different databanks did not align with their own. During his brief foray working for IE, Kodiak added much knowledge - collated from numerous sources - into the planetary databases of the Inner Sphere and the Periphery, leading to numerous updates to navigational databases across known space.

Becoming moderately wealthy due to the commission from IE, he then received passage to the Princefield Military Academy where he studied the training 'Mechs that still remained there - and learned to pilot these ancient behemoths. After graduation, the cartography royalties have kept him in a comfortable but extremely boring lifestyle, thus leading him into mercenary work. Seeking an outfit using unusual 'Mechs, Kodiak is known for being a steadfast pilot but definitely has the potential to bore other MechWarriors with tales of far-off worlds.
column2:
Kodiak 一向是好学之人，他研究了几百年来所有著名的索拉里斯斗士，以及他们和他们的机甲来自何处。他的研究让他进入了星际探险公司的视线——该公司发现，他从不同数据库中整理出的地图与技术储备资料与他们自己掌握的对不上。在为星际探险公司短暂工作期间，Kodiak 为内天体和外围的行星数据库补充了大量从众多来源汇总的知识，促成已知空间内大量导航数据库的更新。

凭借星际探险公司支付的佣金，他变得小有财富，随后获得前往普林斯菲尔德军事学院的通行许可，在那里研究仍留在校内的训练机甲——并学会了驾驶这些远古巨兽。毕业后，靠地图版税，他过着舒适却极其无聊的生活，这最终把他推向了雇佣兵这一行。为了寻找一支使用不寻常机甲的队伍，Kodiak 以坚定的机师著称，但也确实有本事用远方星球的故事把其他机甲战士烦得够呛。

column1:
Yeah, but imagine that's you:

You get your first look at the 30 ton Trash Can as you move into an intersection. But the Urbie, he knew you were there a long time ago. He moves like a heavy 'Mech: stompy, bobbing his head. And you keep still because you think, maybe, with his cheap Periphery radar he'll lose you if you don't move. But, no. Not the UrbanMech. You stare at him, and he just stares back. That's when the attack comes - not from the front, no - from the side. From the other two Urbies you didn't even know were there.

An UrbanMech is a pack-hunter, you see. He uses coordinated attack patterns and he's out in force today. And he fires at you with an Imperator AC - a 12-ton anti-'Mech weapon - like a sledgehammer on the right arm. They don't bother to go for the cockpit like a Hunchback; they just shoot here, in the center torso and here, in the leg. Or, maybe, on the gyro, spilling you across the tarmac.

Point is: you're alive when they start to eat you.
column2:
是啊，但想象一下那是你自己：

你拐进一个路口时，第一次看见那台 30 吨的垃圾桶。可那台乌比早很久就知道你在那里了。它动起来像重型机甲：脚步沉重，脑袋一晃一晃。你一动不动，因为你想，也许凭它那廉价的外围雷达，只要你不往前冲，它就会跟丢你。但不会。城市机甲不会。你盯着它，它也回盯你。就在这时攻击来了——不是从正面，不——是从侧面。来自你根本不知道也在场的另外两台乌比。

你看，城市机甲是成群狩猎的。它采用协同攻击模式，而今天它倾巢而出。它用一门帝国自动炮——一门 12 吨的反机甲武器——朝你开火，像右臂上挥出的重锤。它们不像驼背那样费劲去打驾驶舱；它们只打这里，躯干中央，还有这里，腿部。或者，也可能打中陀螺仪，让你横飞过整个停机坪。

重点是：当它们开始吃你的时候，你还活着。

column1: Although Klyst hasn't seen much real battlefield action, she has a solid experience of 'Mech warfare from her time in the Solaris Games, where she fought as a renowned lone gladiator through multiple seasons. A relentless warrior with a lone wolf mind, whose out-of-the-box thinking surprised more than one gladiator team, she favors mobility and firepower over protection - medium and heavy 'Mechs packing a punch and jump jets are her thing, although she won't give the cold shoulder to assault-class 'Mechs... as long as they are fitted with jump jets.\n\n
column2: 尽管 Klyst 没怎么经历过真正的战场行动，她在索拉里斯竞技场上积累的战斗机甲作战经验相当扎实，曾作为知名的独行角斗士征战多个赛季。她是个不知疲倦的战士，有着独狼般的心智，她的跳脱思路让不止一支角斗士队伍措手不及。比起防护，她更偏好机动性与火力——能打出重拳并装有跳跃推进器的中型与重型机甲是她的心头好，不过她也不会对突击级机甲冷眼相待……只要它们装了跳跃推进器。\n\n

column1: Dan got his start, like most enigmatic anti-heroes, on some forgotten Deep Periphery world, where the only education was the School of Hard Knocks. Realizing life on Planet Noir was not going to end well, regardless of what some woman in red claimed, Dan found passage off the planet with some space whalers who hailed from the Jarnfolk region. What he didn't know then was, they weren't just sea-shanty singing lunatics hunting hallucinations of space whales, but a top secret black-ops group hunting Killer Whale missile systems from the old SLDF. After a few years, and significant training to correct Dan's issue of calling every moving piece of metal an Atlas, the group found a cache of SLDF 'Mechs instead of the promised Killer Whales. Dan, inquisitive as ever, jumped into one and turned it on, triggering the cache's self-destruct and killing his compatriots, while he walked out unscathed in a pristine SLDF 'Mech. His last words to the group were "This will be a whale of a good time!".\n\n
column2: 和大多数神秘的反英雄一样，Dan 起步于某个被遗忘的深外围世界，那里唯一的教育就是“社会大学”。他意识到，不管某个穿红衣的女人怎么宣称，在 Noir 星生活下去都不会有好结局，于是搭上一群来自 Jarnfolk 地区的太空捕鲸人的船离开了那颗行星。他当时不知道的是，这些人不只是唱着水手小调、追逐太空鲸鱼幻影的疯子，而是一个追猎旧星际联盟“杀手鲸”导弹系统的绝密黑色行动小组。几年之后——其间他接受了大量训练，才改掉把每一块会动的金属都叫成阿特拉斯的毛病——这个小组找到的不是承诺中的杀手鲸，而是一批星际联盟机甲的储藏库。向来好奇的 Dan 跳进一台并启动了它，触发了储藏库的自毁程序，害死了他的同伴，而他自己却完好无损地开着一台崭新的星际联盟机甲走了出来。他对这个小组说的最后一句话是：“这将是一段鲸喜连连的好时光！”\n\n

column1: Frank Castle was born on New Avalon to parents of Italian ancestry. Enlisted into the Federated Suns Marine Corps, he excelled at every aspect of warfare and was soon trained to become a MechWarrior. After his long tour of duty during the Third Succession War, he came home only to see his family gunned down for no apparent reason. His life having lost all meaning, he went on to hunt down every criminal he could find.\n\n
column2: Frank Castle 出生在新阿瓦隆，父母是意大利裔。他入伍加入联邦太阳国海军陆战队，在战争的方方面面都表现出色，很快被训练成机甲战士。第三次继承战争期间漫长的服役结束后，他回到家中，却看到家人无缘无故被人用枪扫射。人生彻底失去意义后，他踏上了追猎每一个能找到的罪犯的路。\n\n

column1:
Natasha Jackson is our friendly neighborhood Black Marketeer. With her contacts, she can get us anything we need, if we are comfortable with her markups that is. Nicknamed Magpie for her love of shiny things, Natasha somehow manages to live a life of luxury even while on the run. Apparently her old network fell apart when she 'misplaced' a few packages, and she's been running from her creditors ever since. Apparently if we bring her aboard, she'll hook us up with a supply cache somewhere in-system. Even better, she claims to be a qualified mechanic and is licensed to drive a variety of ground crawlers. Maybe we could put her to use as a tank pilot?

XO's note: Boss, I hope you know what you are doing, letting Magpie on the ship. Anyone gets wind of her being on the ship before we are gone and we could have trouble on our hands.
column2:
Natasha Jackson 是我们街区里那位友善的黑市商人。凭她的门路，只要我们不介意她那点加价，她什么都能弄来。因为喜爱亮闪闪的东西，她得了“喜鹊”这个绰号。Natasha 明明在逃亡，日子却过得相当奢华。据说她的旧网络因为她“放错”了几个包裹而崩盘，从此她一直在躲债主。据说只要把她带上船，她就会给我们联系上星系内某处的一个补给藏点。更好的是，她自称是合格技工，还持有驾驶多种地面越野车的执照。也许我们可以让她当坦克机师？

副官备注：老板，希望你知道自己在干什么，让喜鹊上船。要是我们还没离开就有人听到她在船上的风声，我们可能会惹上麻烦。

column1:
Savarok grew up in comfort in a family that worked hard to pay their way with their AgroMech repair and maintenance company. This comfort bred complacency, contempt and a rebellious attitude. Despite having a natural aptitude for piloting he slacked off, bad-mouthed his parents to anyone who would listen, and ruined potential career opportunities for himself. This culminated when an ill-tempered rant about a prestigious landowner - who was going to give his family enough business for generations - was overheard. After that the contract was only going to be honored if Savarok was removed - not only from the family, but the entire planet. In just a few hours, he found himself aboard a transport to the Periphery with only a rucksack of clothes and a pocketful of C-bills.

On his trip, Savarok realised that an AgroMech pilot was going to struggle for work. So he lied, begged, and borrowed (sometimes permanently) for any work, at every opportunity, at every port. This always ended in trouble, however, until he was picked up by a pirate mercenary company as a repair tech. As the opportunity arose to pilot the ramshackle pieces of metal the pirates called BattleMechs, he grew in confidence quickly - too quickly.

His rebellious nature reared its ugly head again, and after a severe disagreement with the pirate leader he found himself stripped of uniform and heraldry - and in an airlock, about to be spaced. Just as the leader was going to press the release button for the outer doors, a local government militia ship that had snuck up boarded the pirate ship. The pirates were all killed, and the militia troopers stumbled upon him in the airlock. With some quick thinking, he was able to convince the militia he was not affiliated with the pirates, and he was spared. This was the defining moment for him, as he realised he had been granted a second opportunity to live. He vowed to not let any of his past bad habits continue. Savarok now travels between mercenary companies as a MechWarrior, looking for good, honest work.
column2:
Savarok 在一户小康之家长大，家人靠经营农用机甲维修保养公司辛苦挣钱。这份安逸滋生了自满、轻蔑和叛逆的态度。尽管他天生有驾驶天赋，却荒废懈怠，逮着谁就跟谁说他父母的坏话，还自己毁掉了潜在的职业机会。最终，他一次针对某位有声望的地主的暴躁抱怨被人听到了——那位地主本会给他家带来够几代人吃的生意。结果，那份合约只有在 Savarok 被赶走的前提下才肯继续履行——不是赶出家族，而是赶出整颗行星。短短几个小时后，他就带着一背包衣服和兜里的几张 C-Bill，坐上了前往外围的空投艇。

旅途中，Savarok 意识到农用机甲机师找工作会很艰难。于是他撒谎、乞求、借贷（有时是永久的），在每个港口、每个机会争取任何活计。可这一切总是以麻烦收场，直到他被一支海盗雇佣兵公司捡去当维修技师。当有机会驾驶海盗们称为战斗机甲的那些摇摇晃晃的金属块时，他的自信心迅速膨胀——膨胀得太快了。

他的叛逆本性又一次冒了出来。与海盗头目一场激烈争执之后，他被剥去制服和徽记——扔进气闸舱，即将被抛入太空。就在头目准备按下外舱门释放按钮的瞬间，一艘偷偷靠近的当地政府民兵舰登上了海盗船。海盗全被杀死，民兵士兵在气闸舱里撞见了他。凭着几句机敏的应对，他成功让民兵相信他与海盗无关，得以活命。这一刻对他而言是决定性的——他意识到自己得到了第二次活下去的机会。他发誓绝不再延续过去任何一个坏毛病。如今，Savarok 以机甲战士的身份在各雇佣兵公司之间辗转，寻找正当、踏实的工作。

column1: Carson is lucky. He won't tell you that he is lucky, that'd jinx the whole damn thing. While growing up in Aurigan space on Smithon offered the Volkov family a bigger fraction of safety and peace compared to many other Periphery states, Carson certainly put his luck to the test serving in both infantry and armored divisions for several years. Eventually, he took a discarded Icarus II chassis and found his way into the local gladiatorial circuit and from there, became a merc.\n\n
column2: Carson 运气很好。他不会告诉你他运气好，那会把整件事都搞砸。虽然他在 Smithon 的 Aurigan 空间长大，Volkov 家族相比许多其他外围邦国享有更大比例的安宁与和平，Carson 还是在步兵和装甲部队服役了数年，真真切切地把自己的运气赌了一把。最终，他弄到一台被丢弃的 Icarus II 底盘，踏进了当地的角斗圈，又从那里成了雇佣兵。\n\n

column1: Tank Crew Tester. Commands tanks, cannot pilot 'Mechs.\n\n
column2: 坦克乘员测试员。指挥坦克，无法驾驶机甲。\n\n

column1:
Known Info: MechWarrior identifies by the callsign Raza5. Actual name or identity currently unknown. Circumstances of their prior history are unclear, but they are known to have been on Great Gorge during the planetary disaster of '36. Cause of disaster still unclear, but rumours on planetary net - subsequently partially verified by independent sources - indicate a mysterious Black Marauder was seen on the planet in the hours before the disaster. Raza5 has claimed that the Black Marauder is sentient and of non-human origin and that it is responsible for the disaster (and numerous other events across the local region). They also claim to be a member of an unknown paramilitary unit unrelated to any faction - historical or current. ComStar and Interstellar Expeditions both maintain they do not recognise the insignia nor the so-called "Foundation" Raza claims allegiance to. However, Interconnectedness Unlimited has claimed that Raza5 was a past employee of theirs and has posted an open bounty of up to 250,000 C-Bills for their retrieval or elimination.

Regardless of the circumstances, Raza5 claims to be hunting the Black Marauder and that until recently their unit was operating from the independent DropShip known as the Raza. A DropShip known by that name was operating in the Periphery up until '26, but was lost with all hands under mysterious circumstances.

Recommendations: Do not hire, the inconsistencies in their prior history and far-fetched story aside; crossing a corporation like Interconnectedness Unlimited is not good for business.
column2:
已知情报：该机甲战士自称呼号 Raza5。真实姓名或身份目前不明。其过往经历的具体情况不清楚，但已知灾难发生的那一年（36 年）他们正在 Great Gorge 星上。灾难起因仍不明，但行星网络上的传言——后来被独立来源部分证实——指出灾难发生前数小时，行星上曾出现一台神秘的黑掠夺者。Raza5 声称黑掠夺者有自我意识，且源自非人类，并声称它应对这场灾难（以及本地区众多其他事件）负责。他们还自称隶属于一支与任何历史或现存派系都无关的未知准军事部队。彗星通讯与星际探险公司均坚称不认识该徽记，也从未听闻 Raza 所宣称效忠的所谓“基金会”。不过，互联无限公司声称 Raza5 曾是他们的雇员，并公开悬赏最高 250,000 C-Bill 通缉或除掉此人。

无论情况如何，Raza5 声称正在追猎黑掠夺者，并且直到不久前，他们的部队一直以那艘名为 Raza 的独立空投艇为基地活动。确实有一艘同名空投艇在外围活动到 26 年，但后来在神秘情况中连同全体船员一起失踪。

建议：不要雇佣。除了其过往经历中的前后矛盾和那套牵强附会的故事之外，得罪互联无限这样的企业对公司生意也没有好处。

column1: Originally a MechTech in service of House Steiner, he got annoyed having to fix the broken mess he kept being brought. So, one day, he decided to set out into the world to break stuff for other MechTechs to fix.\n\n
column2: 他原本是天琴家族麾下的一名机甲技师，被不断送来的破烂玩意儿烦得够呛。于是有一天，他决定出门闯荡世界，去替别的机甲技师制造需要修理的破烂。\n\n

column1: Hailing from the Lyran Commonwealth, "Tex" is a somewhat hotheaded but private MechWarrior. In typical mercenary fashion he's rowdy but reliable - when he's getting paid. He is also a professor of Inner Sphere history with a strong dislike of clanner society. A veteran of many campaigns, he has time and again demonstrated how to survive until payday.\n\n
column2: “Tex”来自天琴共同体，是个脾气有些火爆、却又沉默寡言的机甲战士。他很符合雇佣兵的做派：吵闹喧哗但靠得住——只要钱到位。他同时也是内天体历史的教授，对氏族社会深恶痛绝。作为身经百战的过来人，他一次又一次示范了如何活到发薪日。\n\n

column1: Oddball sees his role as essentially defensive in nature. While our armies are advancing so fast and everyone's knocking themselves out to be heroes, he is holding himself in reserve in case the Clans mount a counteroffensive which threatens Solaris... or maybe even Terra itself. Then he can move in and stop them.\n\n
column2: Oddball 认为自己的角色本质上是防御性的。当我们的军队推进得如此之快、人人都争着当英雄时，他却把自己留作预备队，以防氏族发动一场威胁索拉里斯——甚至可能是泰拉本土——的反攻。到那时，他就能出手阻止他们。\n\n

column1:
Born on Solaris VII, Chris "Harmony" Johnson was an aspiring MechWarrior as well as a match commentator. Getting his start in the more niche arenas that were not officially sanctioned by the Solaris VII board, Harmony grew in popularity among the crowds in the brutal sport of 'Mech combat both as a fighter and as a commentator.

However, once he had gotten enough experience to make it to the big leagues, his dreams were crushed when he was told that 'there's only enough room for one snarky sarcastic 'Mech jock in the business' by his agent. Disillusioned with the glimmer and glam of life in the city of gladiators, Harmony struck out into the Inner Sphere, determined to find the best match of all on a real battlefield.
column2:
Chris“和声”Johnson 生于索拉里斯七号，既是立志成为机甲战士的选手，也是比赛解说员。他从那些未经索拉里斯七号董事会正式认可的冷门竞技场起步，在机甲战斗这项残酷运动中，无论是作为斗士还是解说员，人气都在观众中不断攀升。

然而，当他积累了足够经验、即将踏入大联盟时，他的梦想被击碎了：经纪人告诉他，“这一行只装得下一个嘴碎的机甲痞子”。对斗士之城那种浮华璀璨的生活感到幻灭之后，“和声”闯向内天体，决心在真正的战场上找到最精彩的一场比赛。

职业生涯开始后，除了随机获得一批装备之外，你还可以在以下几套物品中做出选择：
 • 一具手持式喷火器与工业级 TSM；
 • 一件大型近战武器与标准 TSM；
 • 带刺战斗机甲装甲与 MASC；或
