column1:
Darius's voice rings out over the intercom."Could the Comander please report to the Command Center? Incoming message for you."" In the Command Center, Darius is arguing with someone on  the Holovid."

"Commander? Good to know I got through to you, I was beginning to think I’d die of old age before your XO would put me through. You don’t remember me but, some idiot misplaced a few crates of my AC/5 ammo on your shuttle sometime back. You did me a favour then and I’d like you to do another for me now."

"Really?

"Yes. I’m in a spot of bother with the local crime syndicate over some misplaced demolition charges. Nothing too serious, but they want blood. You hire me and get me out of this system and I’ll give you the coordinates of a supply cache I know about." Suddenly the Holovid blinks out.

"Commander, I’d recommend not associating with such a shady character, it won't end well for us." Darius says.
column2:
达里乌斯的声音从对讲机里传来：“指挥官能否到指挥中心来一趟？有你的通讯。”指挥中心里，达里乌斯正在全息影像上跟某个人争吵。”

“指挥官？很高兴能联系上你，我还以为要等到老死，你的副官才肯把我接进来。你不记得我，但之前有某个白痴把我几箱 AC/5 弹药错放到了你们的穿梭机上。你那次帮了我一个忙，现在我想请你再帮我一个。”

“真的吗？

“是的。我因为几箱放错地方的东西，跟当地的犯罪集团有点小麻烦——是些爆破装置。不是什么大事，但他们想要血。你雇我、把我弄出这个星系，我就把一个我知道的补给藏点坐标给你。”突然，全息影像熄灭了。

“指挥官，我建议别跟这种来路不明的人打交道，对我们没好处。”达里乌斯说。

column1:
Originally from the Duchy of Andurien in the Free Worlds League, James Pato grew up tinkering with anything he could get his hands on. He was drawn to an apprenticeship as a MechTech, starting with AgroMechs and moving on to BattleMechs after helping the local garrison with a broken 'Mech crossing his family's property.

Working for the militia, he quickly rose through the ranks and became the local subject matter expert on the coding for 'Mech's Targeting and Tracking Systems (TTS) and internal diagnostic computers. More than once his custom adjustments have led to his MechWarriors nearly dying in the field, almost costing him his position. He found himself putting in countless hours behind the command couch of BattleMechs in order to understand what his pilots experience, eventually earning his own title as MechWarrior.

His ability to find work as either MechTech or MechWarrior has granted him freedom to travel around the Rimward Periphery, searching for LosTech such as Star League era TTS. He's heard rumors there was once a totally autonomous BattleMech drone project run in secret but has yet to find any real evidence. If he were to find such a LosTech cache, it would allow him to establish his own brand of TTS that rival the best the Inner Sphere has to offer.
column2:
James Pato 原籍自由世界联盟的安杜里恩公国，从小什么东西到手就拆开鼓捣。他被吸引着去当机甲技师学徒，从农用机甲做起，后来在一次帮当地驻军处理一台路过他家地界的故障机甲之后，转向了战斗机甲。

在民兵中工作期间，他迅速晋升，成了当地在机甲瞄准与追踪系统（TTS）编码以及内部诊断计算机方面的专家。不止一次，他的自定义调整险些让手下的机甲战士在战场上丧命，也差点让他丢了职位。他发现自己在战斗机甲的指挥座椅后坐了无数个小时，只为理解机师们的实际感受，最终自己也赢得了机甲战士的头衔。

既能当机甲技师又能当机甲战士的本事，让他得以自由穿行于星向外围，寻找星际联盟时代的 TTS 之类的失落科技。他听说过曾有某个完全自主的战斗机甲无人机计划在秘密运行，但至今没找到任何真凭实据。若能找到那样一处失落科技藏点，他就能建立起自己品牌的 TTS，与内天体最顶尖的产品一较高下。

column1: Once an up-and-coming medium 'Mech pilot in the arenas of Solaris VII, Duncan Fisher quickly found he had a face for radio, not for tri-vid. After a decent but short stint in the arenas, Duncan fell into the life of a professional S7 caster, where he found much acclaim. He cast multiple Championship bouts in his time behind the mic and was widely beloved by the fans for his bombastic personality. Now, he's found his way into a cockpit again for a little up close and personal match analysis. Better keep the bar well-stocked with whiskey and cigars.\n\n
column2: Duncan Fisher 曾是索拉里斯七号竞技场上崭露头角的中型机甲机师，很快他就发现，自己这张脸适合广播，不适合三维影像。在竞技场里干了不长但还体面的一段时间后，Duncan 投身职业的索拉里斯七号解说生涯，在那里大受赞誉。他在麦克风后解说过多场冠军赛，以极具张力的个性广受粉丝喜爱。如今，他又找到机会重新坐进驾驶舱，近距离、亲身地做比赛分析。最好把酒吧里的威士忌和雪茄备足。\n\n

column1:
Some men have easy, soft lives, full of comfort and joy. Hardball is not one of those men. Born to nobody parents on a backwater Crucis March world in the Federated Suns, Elias was destined for nothing his whole life. His parents, subsistence farmers, had five children of which Elias was the last. He was expected to work the farm, marry, have kids, and start his own farm, like his older brothers and sisters. But he wanted more. He dreamed of traveling the stars, seeing other worlds, and fighting for his fellows and their freedoms in the Federated Suns. When a recruiter for the AFFS came to his little town one year, he knew his chance had arrived and signed up without hesitation. However, he was too young and was turned away. Of course, stowing away in their truck fixed that... until he was discovered. However, his earnestness appealed to the recruiter who took an interest in the young man and decided to give him a shot, rules be damned.

Elias earned his callsign during training where he developed a bad habit of never playing fair or nice with the other recruits. Elias played to win and everything else was irrelevant. Despite this, his obvious skill in the cockpit got him assigned to a frontline command as a scout 'Mech pilot where he saw engagement against the Draconis Combine. After several incidents where he injured other soldiers who got in his way on the battlefield, he was discharged from service and even imprisoned for a time.

His record gets spotty after that, with various reports of prison time, murder charges, and an ugly divorce, all of which have left the once bright-eyed Elias a battered, rough man. Still, he can sling shots downrange and take orders like few others, ensuring he always gets a space on a dropship. For a while, at least, until his rough ways catch up to him again.
column2:
有些人过着轻松安逸、充满舒适与欢乐的一生。Hardball 不是这种人。他出生在联邦太阳国 Crucis 边区一个穷乡僻壤的世界，父母一文不名，Elias 一生注定什么也得不到。他的父母是自给自足的农民，生了五个孩子，Elias 是最小的。按预期，他该像哥哥姐姐一样种地、结婚、生娃，再开自己的农场。但他想要更多。他梦想着遨游群星、见识别的世界，为联邦太阳国的同胞和他们的自由而战。有一年，AFFS 的招募官来到他的小镇，他知道机会来了，毫不犹豫地报了名。然而，他太年轻，被拒之门外。当然，钻进他们的卡车偷渡解决了这个问题……直到他被发现。不过，他的诚恳打动了招募官，那位招募官对这个年轻人产生了兴趣，决定不计规则给他一个机会。

Elias 是在训练中挣得呼号的，当时他养成了一个坏毛病：从不跟其他新兵公平较量、也从不友善。Elias 只为赢，其他都不重要。尽管如此，他显而易见的驾驶舱本领让他被分配到前线部队当侦察机甲机师，并在那里与天龙联合体交战。在发生数起他打伤挡路战友的事件之后，他被除役，甚至一度入狱。

在那之后，他的记录变得零碎不堪，有各种关于入狱、谋杀指控和一场难看的离婚的报告，这一切把曾经眼睛明亮的 Elias 磨成了一个伤痕累累、粗砺的人。尽管如此，他依然能把子弹送到远处、像极少数人那样服从命令，因此总能在空投艇上得到一个位子。至少能维持一阵子，直到他粗野的作风再次追上他。

column1:
You look at [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. "What's in this pod? "Magpie frowns and leans over to check the sensor readings. "Honestly Commander, your guess is as good as mine. I never asked what my clients were hiding away and I don't plan on asking now."

 Darius starts to frown and starts paging through the sensors readings, visibly agitated."Commander, you have to get us out of here now, some lunatic booby trapped this pod. Sensors are picking up a live Fusion reaction. I think some crazy bastard wired up a Fusion Core as an improvised nuke."

Magpie looks startled and alarmed."It's certainly possible, my clients were dangerous people. I only supplied the pod and the coordinates. What they did with it was never my concern." 

Magpie continues,"I certainly have no plans to end up as a smear of mildly exciting debris out in the ass end of nowhere. I have a little cash left, let me arrange to have that transferred to you instead. It’s not much but it's better than nothing."

You give the order to abort approach much to the crews relief.
column2:
你看向[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。“这舱里是什么？”喜鹊皱起眉头，俯身查看传感器读数。“说实话，指挥官，你猜的跟我一样。我从不过问客户藏了什么，现在也不打算开始问。”

达里乌斯皱起眉头，开始翻看传感器读数，明显烦躁起来。“指挥官，你必须马上让我们离开这里，有哪个疯子在这舱里装了诡雷。传感器读到了活跃的聚变反应。我觉得有个疯子在用聚变核心做了一颗简易核弹。”

喜鹊一脸惊惶。“这完全有可能，我的客户都是危险人物。我只提供舱体和坐标，他们拿它做什么从来不是我关心的事。”

喜鹊接着说：“我当然不打算在这鸟不拉屎的地方变成一撮勉强算热闹的碎片。我还有点现金，让我安排把它转给你吧。不多，但总比没有好。”

你下令中止接近，船员们大大松了口气。

column1:
You send a brief message back to the Black Marketeer explaining that your company can't take the risk. Later that night, when you return to your quarters you receive a message. Magpie fills the screen, her face flushed with rage. "God dammit, you just had to go and be a dick didn’t you?."

"I have the local cops on my trail now and the crime syndicate. When they come looking for me, I’ll be sure to point both of them at you and yours Commander."

"Watch your back from now on.
column2:
你给那位黑市商人回了条简讯，说明你的公司承担不起这个风险。当晚回到舱室时，你收到一条消息。喜鹊占满了屏幕，满脸怒容。“该死的，你非得当混蛋是吧？”

“现在本地警察和犯罪集团都在追我。等他们找上门，我一定会把你们这两位指给他们，指挥官。”

“从今往后，小心点你的后背。

column1:
Later that night, when you return to your quarters you receive a message titled: "Thanks." Magpie appears on your screen. "Thank you for giving me the benefit of the doubt Commander"

"I’m making final arrangements now and liquidating what is left of my stock, but I’ll be at the space port as agreed"

Oh and Commander, don’t think I haven’t forgotten our deal. I’ll have the coordinates for you once I’m on the Argo."
column2:
当晚回到舱室时，你收到一条标题为“谢谢”的消息。喜鹊出现在屏幕上。“谢谢你愿意给我一个机会，指挥官。”

“我正在做最后的安排，把手头剩下的存货变现，但我会按约定到太空港。”

“还有，指挥官，别以为我忘了我们的交易。我一上阿戈号就把坐标给你。”

column1:
You asked to be notified when we got to the coordinates? Turns out there's a supply pod tethered to an asteroid.

And it’s covered in hazardous material warnings.

Do you want to open it?
column2:
你让我们到达坐标时通知你？原来那里有一个补给舱，系在一颗小行星上。

而且它表面布满了危险品警告标志。

你要打开它吗？

column1: As you watch, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and the berserker strike a series of increasingly elaborate poses, shouting the whole time, until finally the berserker rushes Behemoth and sweeps her into a bear hug that would have dwarfed almost anybody else. When he releases her, the berserker glances over at you, then says, "Behemoth! You went straight? I can't believe it!" "Naw," says Behemoth. "Would I be here if I'd gone straight? I'm just taking the scenic route to hell. Commander, this is an old pal of mine, from before I joined up." That seems to be it for the introductions, but there's still drinks to be purchased and unlikely stories to cackle over. On the way back to the ship, Behemoth is in ebullient spirits and filled with stories for her fellow MechWarriors.
column2: 在你眼前，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 和那个狂战士摆出一连串越来越夸张的姿势，全程不停吼叫，直到最后狂战士冲向巨兽，把她一把揽进一个几乎能把任何人都勒扁的熊抱里。 他放开她后，那个狂战士瞥了你一眼，然后说："巨兽！你改邪归正了？我真不敢相信！" "哪有，"巨兽说。"我要是改邪归正了还会在这儿吗？我只是挑了条风景好点儿的路去地狱。指挥官，这是我以前的老朋友，在我入伍之前就认识了。" 介绍大概就到这里，但还有酒要买、还有离谱的故事要哈哈大笑地讲。回船的路上，巨兽兴致高昂，满肚子故事要讲给她的机甲战士同伴们听。

column1:
It looks like too much fun to resist. After the next exchange of postures, you step up and start roaring yourself.

After a series of increasingly unlikely and ridiculous poses, you start laughing and the impromptu contest concludes. The berserker joins you and [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], demanding to know who you are.

"This is my Commander," Behemoth explains.

"Aha! I'd heard you went straight!" The berserker gives you another one of those eye-bulging looks.

"I didn't!" protests Behemoth. "Not really."

"Aw, well, it's okay if you're working for somebody like this." The berserker hits you on the back hard enough to stagger you. "You're a good'un. Lemme buy you both a drink."

Later, on the way home, Behemoth describes to the other MechWarriors every pose and bellow that you contributed to the contest. They can't get enough of it.
column2:
这看起来太好玩了，实在忍不住。又交换了几轮架势之后，你上前一步，也吼了起来。

在一连串越来越荒诞可笑的姿势之后，你开始大笑，这场即兴比赛就此结束。那个狂战士和 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 一起走过来，非要问你是谁。

"这是我的指挥官，"巨兽解释道。

"啊哈！我听说你改邪归正了！"那个狂战士又给了你一个瞪圆眼睛的表情。

"我没有！"巨兽反驳道。"不算真的。"

"唉，好吧，你要是替这样的人干活，那也没关系。"那个狂战士在你背上狠狠拍了一下，拍得你踉跄。"你是个好人。让我请你俩喝一杯。"

后来在回去的路上，巨兽向其他机甲战士描述了你为那场比赛贡献的每一个姿势和每一声吼叫。他们怎么听都听不够。

column1:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] is recuperating in the MedBay, again, and has asked to speak with you. When you arrive, Decker waves wanly. "Hi, Commander. I didn't do so hot, did I?"


"You did take a big hit, Dekker," you say. "Any battle you can walk away from though, eh?"


He sighs. "Yeah, but I'm starting to wonder if maybe I need a different motto than that. Do you have any advice for me, Commander? What can I do better? Do I need a different 'Mech? More training? Or am I just not cut out for this business?"
column2:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 又在医疗舱里养伤，并请求见你。你到的时候，德克尔虚弱地挥了挥手。"嗨，指挥官。我表现得不太行，是吧？"


"你确实挨了一记重击，德克尔，"你说。"不过只要能走出战场的仗，都算好仗，对吧？"


他叹了口气。"是啊，但我开始怀疑也许我该换句座右铭。指挥官，您有什么建议吗？我还能怎么做更好？我需要换一台机甲吗？需要更多训练吗？还是我根本就不适合这一行？"

column1:
You do have business in the market to attend to, so you leave one of the other MechWarriors behind in case it gets out of hand, and move on.

Later, on the shuttle back to the ship, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] explains, with a hoarse voice, that the berserker was an old friend from her pirate days. "A garbage pilot, but nobody does intimidation like he does. He sure scared you away, didn't he, Commander?"

"Nah," you say. "I knew you could handle it." Behemoth grins.
column2:
你在集市上还有事要办，于是留下另一名机甲战士以防局面失控，然后继续前行。

后来，在返回船上的穿梭机上，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 用沙哑的嗓子解释说，那个狂战士是她做海盗时期的老朋友。"驾驶技术稀烂，但吓唬人没人比他更在行。他确实把你吓跑了吧，指挥官？"

"没有，"你说。"我知道你应付得了。"巨兽咧嘴一笑。

column1: As you arrive in the lounge, you catch [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] in mid-complaint. "Come on, we all know it's gonna be Norton again. It's never not Norton." [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] elbows {SCN_MW.OBJ} to stop and nods to you. "We're just about to get started, Commander. Take any seat." The Solaris Championship is about as one-sided as expected, but the real highlight of the evening occurs when {TGT_MW.Callsign} drunkenly explains exactly how {TGT_MW.SUBJ} would have beaten Gray Norton in a one-on-one duel.
column2: 你走进休息厅时，正赶上 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 抱怨到一半。"得了吧，我们都知道冠军又是诺顿。从来都不会是别人。" [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 用胳膊肘捅了捅 {SCN_MW.OBJ} 让他停下，朝你点了点头。"我们正要开始，指挥官。随便坐。" 索拉里斯锦标赛果然跟预料的一样一边倒，但当晚真正的亮点是 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 醉醺醺地详细讲解{TGT_MW.SUBJ} 如何在单挑中击败格雷·诺顿。

column1: The MechWarriors welcome you to the lounge. The Holovid set is already playing a highlight reel from last year's Championship. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] hosts the event with commentary and personal anecdotes about fighting on Solaris VII. When the action gets intense, the MechWarriors cheer and shout, and you find yourself cheering and shouting right alongside them.\n\nUltimately, Gray Norton wins another Championship, but you're having too good a time with your MechWarriors to care.
column2: 机甲战士们欢迎你来到休息厅。全息影像机已经在播放去年锦标赛的精彩集锦。[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 主持这场聚会，配着解说和自己在索拉里斯七号作战的亲身趣闻。战斗激烈时，机甲战士们欢呼呐喊，你发现自己也在跟他们一起欢呼呐喊。\n\n最终，格雷·诺顿又拿下一届冠军，但你跟机甲战士们玩得太开心，根本不在意。

column1:
While inspecting the goods in a crowded marketplace, escorted by [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and several other MechWarriors, a berserker roar erupts behind you. You wheel around to see a huge, hairy, leather-clad man bellowing in apparent fury at your group. 

As you prepare for a brawl, Behemoth says, "Hey, Commander, let me handle this." She's grinning. "You can keep shopping if you want."

You step out of her way, but linger a moment.

Behemoth takes a wide stance, raises her fists in the air, and roars back at the berserker down the street. His eyes bulge out and he changes position, leaning forward like he's about to charge, and roars again. In response, Behemoth drops low and roars at the heavens.

Whatever is going on, she seems to have it well in hand.
column2:
你在熙熙攘攘的集市上检查货物，由 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 和几名机甲战士护送，忽然身后爆出一声狂战士的怒吼。你转过身，看到一个高大、多毛、身着皮衣的男人正对着你们一伙人狂怒咆哮。

你正准备动手开打，巨兽说："嘿，指挥官，让我来处理。"她正咧着嘴笑。"你想接着逛也行。"

你让开一步，但还是多停留了片刻。

巨兽摆开宽大的架势，双手举向空中，朝街那头的狂战士吼了回去。他眼睛鼓起，换了个姿势，身体前倾仿佛要冲过来，又吼了一声。作为回应，巨兽压低身姿，对着天空怒吼。

不管这是怎么回事，她似乎完全掌控着局面。

column1:
You're doing fine, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. We need people like you on the team. Just remember, when you get hurt, that's on me as your commanding officer. I'm grateful to have somebody like you doing what needs to be done. Most MechWarriors wouldn't stick around after what you've been through.


Dekker brightens noticeably. "That's true. Nobody takes a hit like me, right?"


"Right," you say. "Well done."
column2:
你做得不错，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。我们需要像你这样的人留在队里。只要记住，你受伤了，那是身为指挥官的我该负责的事。我很感激有你这样的人去做该做的事。经历过你这些遭遇之后，大多数机甲战士都不会留下来。


德克尔明显精神一振。"这是真的。没人像我这样扛打，对吧？"


"没错，"你说。"干得好。"

column1:
Well, clearly we'll have to abandon this plan. If it doesn't work for everybody, it's useless. Shut it down, Doctor.


[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] grins as Dr. Murad protests. "But Commander, it was quite a bit of work getting the Argo systems to accept..."


"And good work it was, Doctor. But working with the Argo has always been two steps forward, one step back, hasn't it?"


With a sigh, Dr. Murad acquiesces.
column2:
好吧，显然我们只能放弃这个方案。如果它不能对所有人都有效，那就是没用的。关掉它，博士。


[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 咧嘴笑起来，而穆拉德博士提出异议。"可是指挥官，让阿戈号的系统接受这套东西花了不少功夫……"


"而且确实是出色的工作，博士。但跟阿戈号打交道一直都是进一步、退两步，不是吗？"


穆拉德博士叹了口气，只好同意。

column1:
Hm, you say. "So other pilots are letting you in. Well, it sounds like you've found a workaround for now. Doctor, try increasing the number of attempts before a lockout triggers. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], as long as you stay out of trouble, I don't think we need to be concerned."


Glitch shrugs stiffly. "Sure, Commander. It's not like I'm not used to it."
column2:
嗯，你说。"所以是其他机师放你进去的。好吧，听起来你暂时已经找到了变通办法。博士，把触发锁定前的尝试次数调高一些。[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]，只要你不惹麻烦，我想我们不必太在意。"


故障僵硬地耸耸肩。"当然，指挥官。反正我早就习惯了。"

column1:
How about a different kind of scanner? you suggest.

"Say, a voiceprint?" [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] brightens.

Dr. Murad sounds dubious. "You want me to set up a whole new system for this?"


"Keep them both. Let the pilots use whatever works. It's either this or removing the scanners entirely, Doctor. What would you prefer?"


Dr. Murad sighs. "I'll get started converting the algorithms."
column2:
换个别的类型的扫描器怎么样？你提议。

"比如说，声纹？"[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 眼睛一亮。

穆拉德博士听起来很怀疑。"你想让我为这个再搭一套全新的系统？"


"两套都留着。让机师用能用的那套。要么这样，要么干脆把扫描器全拆了，博士。你更愿意哪个？"


穆拉德博士叹了口气。"我这就开始改造算法。"

column1:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] presents herself in your office as ordered, standing at something that passes for attention. "What's up, Commander?"


"According to the logs, you haven't been using the lounge lately. Yet according to eyewitness reports, you have been. What's going on?"


Glitch sighs. "The XO had Dr. Murad install that bioscanner on the lounge door, remember? So she could restrict troublemakers? Well, it doesn't work for me. I get locked out every time."


A quick call to the engineer confirms Glitch's report. "It's very vexing, Commander," says Dr. Murad. "I've recalibrated it for her three times but it never really takes. Something about her biochemistry, maybe."


Glitch has a patient, long-suffering look as she waits for your pronouncement.
column2:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 奉命来到你的办公室，摆出一个勉强算作立正的姿势。"有什么事，指挥官？"


"根据日志，你最近没使用过休息厅。但根据目击者报告，你确实去过。怎么回事？"


故障叹了口气。"副官让穆拉德博士在休息厅门上装了那个生物扫描器，记得吗？好让她能把捣乱的人拦在外面？可它对我不管用。我每次都被锁在外面。"


一通打给工程师的简短通讯证实了故障的说法。"这很让人头疼，指挥官，"穆拉德博士说。"我给她重新校准了三次，但总是没法真正生效。也许是她的生化特征有什么特别之处。"


故障带着耐心而饱受折磨的神情，等着你的裁决。

column1:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], you're thinking about this way too hard.

He stops in the middle of asking yet another question.

"A new motto won't protect you on the battlefield. You don't need more simulator time at this point in your career. And as for 'Mechs, you'll fight in whatever 'Mech I see fit to put you in, and you'll like it."

Dekker gulps at the tone of the conversation has taken a turn.

"Look, Dekker, you're a good pilot. Believe it. What you need is to get back out there and show those bastards that they can't keep you down."

A glitter appears in Dekker’s eyes. "Yes, Commander!" he barks, his salute a bit awkward with the tubes and wires in his arm.
column2:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]，你想得太多了。

他在又要提出一个问题时停了下来。

"新的座右铭不会在战场上保护你。以你现在的职业阶段，你不需要更多模拟舱时间。至于机甲，我给你安排哪台机甲，你就驾驶哪台，而且要乐意。"

德克尔咽了口口水，谈话的口气已经变了。

"听着，德克尔，你是个好机师。相信这一点。你需要做的是回到战场上，让那些混蛋知道他们压不垮你。"

德克尔眼中闪过一道光。"是，指挥官！"他吼道，敬礼时因为手臂上的管子和导线而略显笨拙。

column1:
You consider. "Your base skills are fine, but if you want to do the work, I can direct you to some rather imaginative works that might give you a new perspective. Something to do while you're stuck in here."


"Sure," [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] says without much enthusiasm. "Let's go with that."


But he doesn't really need more education in warfare, so after some thought, you provide him with the works of Arthur Conan Doyle.

A few days later, his mood has significantly improved, although not the way you'd hoped. "I'm learning to play the violin, Commander!" he says, waving a compad with a virtual instrument. The MedBay staff, wincing, nod.
column2:
你思索了一下。"你的基础技能没问题，但如果你愿意下功夫，我可以给你推荐一些相当有想象力的作品，也许能给你新的视角。你被困在这里的时候正好可以看看。"


"好啊，"[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 没什么热情地说。"就这么办吧。"


但他其实并不需要更多战争方面的教育，所以思考一番之后，你给了他阿瑟·柯南·道尔的作品。

几天后，他的情绪明显好转了，只是方向跟你想的不太一样。"指挥官，我在学拉小提琴！"他说着，晃了晃装有小提琴虚拟乐器的掌上电脑。医疗舱的工作人员龇着牙点了点头。

column1:
Piloting a 'Mech isn't for everybody. If you're having doubts, you need some time away, because obsessing about your failures in the cockpit is just going to get you killed. I'll arrange for you to have that time at our next port.


[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] looks startled. "Commander? I didn't really..."

You frown at him. "And you aren't. You're going to get your head screwed on straight and get back here. Am I right?"


"Yes, Commander!"


You survey Dekker and feel confident he'll return a better MechWarrior.
column2:
驾驶机甲不是人人都适合的。如果你有疑虑，你需要离开一段时间，因为老想着驾驶舱里的失误只会让你送命。我会在下一个港口为你安排这段时间。


[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 看起来很意外。"指挥官？我其实没有……"

你皱眉看着德克尔。"而且你不会被淘汰。你会把脑子理清楚，然后回到这里。我说得对吗？"


"是，指挥官！"


你打量着德克尔，确信他会成为一个更好的机甲战士。

column1:
As you arrive in the lounge, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] is saying, "Come on, we all know it's gonna be Norton again." 

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] elbows {SCN_MW.OBJ} to stop and nods to you. "We're just about to get started, Commander. Take any seat."

The Solaris Championship is about as one-sided as expected, but the real highlight of the evening occurs when {SCN_MW.Callsign} and {TGT_MW.Callsign} get into an alcohol-fueled argument over the relative merits of the 'Mechs involved.
column2:
你走进休息厅时，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 正在说："得了吧，我们都知道冠军又是诺顿。" 

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 用胳膊肘捅了捅 {SCN_MW.OBJ} 让他停下，朝你点了点头。"我们正要开始，指挥官。随便坐。"

索拉里斯锦标赛果然跟预料的一样一边倒，但当晚真正的亮点是 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 和 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 借着酒劲，为参赛机甲的各自优劣争论起来。

column1:
I want [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] off my ship as soon as possible, you tell Darius. "If the others keep seeing {TGT_MW.OBJ} in the barracks and on the mess deck, it's just going to make things worse."

Darius slowly nods. "I see your point. I'll make arrangements, but it could be a bit before we can get rid of {TGT_MW.OBJ}."

"I'm sure you'll make it work."
column2:
我要 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 尽快离开我的船，你对达里乌斯说。"如果其他人还在营房和餐厅里看到 {TGT_MW.OBJ}，只会让事情更糟。"

达里乌斯缓缓点头。"我明白你的意思。我会安排，但要送走 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 可能还得等一阵。"

"我相信你会有办法的。"

column1: You bring the crew and the MechWarriors together in the Argo's lounge to give [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] a proper send-off. Darius makes a speech, and Yang presents {TGT_MW.Callsign} with a framed 'Mech repair bill. Then the drinking begins in earnest. By the end of the night, the mood is bittersweet. "Thanks for everything, Commander," {TGT_MW.Callsign} finally says to you.
column2: 你把船员和机甲战士都叫到阿戈号的休息厅，为 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 好好送行。达里乌斯发表了讲话，杨则把一张装裱好的"机甲维修账单"送给 {TGT_MW.Callsign}。 接着酒就真正开始喝了。 到夜里结束时，气氛既甜蜜又苦涩。 "谢谢你做的一切，指挥官，" {TGT_MW.Callsign} 最后对你说。

column1: You bring the crew and the MechWarriors together in the Argo's lounge to give [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] a proper send-off. Darius makes a speech, and Yang presents {TGT_MW.Callsign} with a framed 'Mech repair bill. Then the drinking begins in earnest. By the end of the night, the mood is bittersweet. You shake {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s hand. "Take care of yourself, {TGT_MW.FirstName}. We might need you again." This provokes a genuine smile. "Sure thing, Commander."
column2: 你把船员和机甲战士都叫到阿戈号的休息厅，为 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 好好送行。达里乌斯发表了讲话，杨则把一张装裱好的"机甲维修账单"送给 {TGT_MW.Callsign}。 接着酒就真正开始喝了。 到夜里结束时，气氛既甜蜜又苦涩。 你与 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 握手。"照顾好自己，{TGT_MW.FirstName}。我们也许还会需要你。" 这换来一个真诚的笑容。"没问题，指挥官。"

column1: Later in the day, you shake [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s hand. "We all appreciate your service, {TGT_MW.FirstName}. Good luck on your next assignment."\n\n{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:give|Default:gives} you a wary look. "Sure. Whatever you say, Commander. Anyway, I'll be leaving the Argo at the next opportunity. Until then, I'll stay out of your way."
column2: 当天晚些时候，你与 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 握手。"我们都感谢你的服役，{TGT_MW.FirstName}。祝你下一个岗位好运。"\n\n{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:give|Default:gives} 你一个戒备的眼神。"当然。随便你说什么，指挥官。总之，一有机会我就离开阿戈号。在那之前，我不会碍你的事。"

column1:
That's clear thinking, Ms. Meyer. I believe we can spare [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] for a week. And, by all means, please accompany {SCN_MW.Obj}. Wouldn't want {SCN_MW.Obj} to fall into a pit along the way.

Sumire bites back a wider smile. "Yes, Commander. Right away, Commander."

As Sumire begins to leave, you have one last request. "Please do take some pictures, Sumire. I think everyone would appreciate seeing what you've seen, if only secondhand."
column2:
这个想法很清楚，迈耶女士。我想我们可以放 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 一周的假。而且，务必请你陪同 {SCN_MW.Obj}。总不希望 {SCN_MW.Obj} 半路上掉进坑里。

苏米蕾强忍住更灿烂的笑。"是，指挥官。马上就去，指挥官。"

苏米蕾正要离开时，你提出了最后一个请求。"请一定拍些照片，苏米蕾。我想大家都会想看看你看到的东西，哪怕是二手见闻。"

column1:
That's clear thinking, Ms. Meyer. I believe that we can spare both [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] for a week. And, by all means, please accompany them. Wouldn't want them to trigger any ancient traps along the way.

Sumire bites back a wider smile. "Yes, Commander. Right away, Commander."

As Sumire begins to leave, you have one last request. "Please do take some pictures, Sumire. I think everyone would appreciate seeing what you've seen, if only secondhand."
column2:
这个想法很清楚，迈耶女士。我想我们可以放 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 和 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 一周的假。而且，务必请你陪同他们。总不希望他们半路上触发什么古代陷阱。

苏米蕾强忍住更灿烂的笑。"是，指挥官。马上就去，指挥官。"

苏米蕾正要离开时，你提出了最后一个请求。"请一定拍些照片，苏米蕾。我想大家都会想看看你看到的东西，哪怕是二手见闻。"

column1: Later in the day, you shake [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s hand. "We all appreciate your service, {TGT_MW.FirstName}. Good luck on your next assignment."\n\n{TGT_MW.Callsign} says, "Thanks, Commander. That means a lot. Good luck to you, too."
column2: 当天晚些时候，你与 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 握手。"我们都感谢你的服役，{TGT_MW.FirstName}。祝你下一个岗位好运。"\n\n{TGT_MW.Callsign} 说："谢谢你，指挥官。这对我意义重大。也祝你好运。"

column1: Dr. Murad's voice calls out to you from across the hall. "Over here, Commander. Near the lockers." When you round the corner, you find her, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], and something that looks suspiciously like a moonshine still. Dr. Murad looks up at you, a slight frown on her face. "This MechWarrior was just explaining to me how {TGT_MW.SUBJ} came to build a device to make—what was the term?—Engine Room Rustgut." {TGT_MW.Callsign} looks chagrined, but defends {TGT_MW.REFL} with, "I was just trying to make some money, and maybe have a bit of fun. We're all going a little stir crazy."
column2: 穆拉德博士的声音从走廊那头传来。"这边，指挥官。储物柜附近。"你转过拐角，看到她、[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]，还有一个看起来很像私酿酒蒸馏器的东西。 穆拉德博士抬头看你，眉头微微皱着。"这位机甲战士刚才在跟我解释，{TGT_MW.SUBJ} 怎么会做出一个用来制造——那个词怎么说来着？——机舱锈肠酒的装置。" {TGT_MW.Callsign} 一脸窘迫，却还是为 {TGT_MW.REFL} 辩解道："我只是想挣点钱，顺便找点乐子。我们都快闷疯了。"

column1: Yeah, why just make this a one-off deal? [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] asks, "It sounds like what they need is a partner."\n\nLater, {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:report|Default:reports}that the merchant's eyes practically glowed with dreams of future riches, right up until {TGT_MW.SUBJ} started negotiating the fee.
column2: 是啊，为什么不把这变成长期合作呢？[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 问，"听起来他们需要的是一个合伙人。"\n\n后来，{TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:report|Default:reports} 说，那位商人眼中几乎闪着对未来财富的憧憬，直到 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} 开始谈费用。

column1: Darius stops by your quarters to recite an invitation. "On behalf of our Barracks denizens, I am formally charged with requesting your attendance at an assembly of the MechWarriors in the Lounge this evening. Libations will be consumed alongside a screening of the recent Solaris Championship. "\n\nIn a less official tone, Darius adds, "[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] managed to pick up an official Holovid somehow. I expect that our MechWarriors are going to watch the fight and get very, very drunk."
column2: 达里乌斯来到你的舱室宣读一份邀请。"我代表我们营房的居民，正式受命邀请您今晚出席休息厅的机甲战士集会。届时将饮酒并观看最近的索拉里斯锦标赛录像。"\n\n换成不那么官方的语气，达里乌斯补充道："[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 不知怎么弄到了一份官方全息录像。我估计我们的机甲战士会边看比赛边喝得烂醉。"

column1: You politely decline the invitation; you have already learned the results of the tournament, and Gray Norton's victories are no longer a surprise.\n\nThe following day, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] is still enthusiastically talking about the match.
column2: 你礼貌地谢绝了邀请；你早就知道锦标赛的结果，格雷·诺顿的胜利已经算不上意外。\n\n第二天，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 仍在兴致勃勃地谈论那场比赛。

column1: On the Argo, Yang flips through the bill of lading. "Funny, I don't see these Medium Lasers on the customs forms…"\n\nHe cocks an eyebrow in the direction of Darius and [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], then holds up a small, black box. "Next time you decide to rob a group of sketchy weapons dealers, try to disable all of their tracking devices, okay? Whoever these lasers were supposed to go to won't be happy that we stole from them."
column2: 在阿戈号上，杨翻着提货单。"奇怪，我在海关表格上没看到这些中型激光器……"\n\n他朝达里乌斯和 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 的方向挑了挑眉，然后举起一个小小的黑盒子。"下次你们决定去抢一伙可疑的军火商时，麻烦把他们的追踪装置全部关掉，好吗？这些激光器原本该送到谁手上，他们可不会高兴东西被我们偷了。"

column1:
You task [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] with moving the still to the kitchen, and {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:do|Default:does} so with enthusiasm.

For a few days, {TGT_MW.Det} Engine Room Rustgut is available on the mess deck in moderate amounts. Sadly, the consensus opinion is that it is completely undrinkable. 

Nevertheless, {TGT_MW.Callsign} finishes off the final batch by {TGT_MW.REFL} before the kitchen staff takes the still apart.
column2:
你派 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 把蒸馏器搬到厨房，{TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:do|Default:does} 热情高涨地照办了。

有几天，{TGT_MW.Det} 机舱锈肠酒以适中的量在餐厅供应。可惜，大家一致的看法是它完全没法入口。

尽管如此，在厨房人员拆掉蒸馏器之前，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 还是靠 {TGT_MW.REFL} 干掉了最后一批。

column1:
You task [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] with moving the still to the kitchen, and {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:do|Default:does} so with enthusiasm.

For a week, the mess is crowded with so many crewmembers and MechWarriors that you cannot find a place to sit without pulling rank, and the stink of Rustgut is everywhere.

When the crew start showing up to shifts hung over, one day the kitchen staff arrive and the still has been mysteriously dismantled. In the daily briefing, Darius and Yang share a knowing look at the news.
column2:
你派 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 把蒸馏器搬到厨房，{TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:do|Default:does} 热情高涨地照办了。

整整一周，餐厅里挤满了船员和机甲战士，不靠军衔你根本找不到位子，锈肠酒的味道到处都是。

当船员开始带着宿醉来上班时，有一天厨房人员到来，发现蒸馏器已经被神秘地拆掉了。在每日简报会上，达里乌斯和杨听到这个消息时交换了一个心照不宣的眼神。

column1: I know this wasn't your idea, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], you say. "So whose was it?" {TGT_MW.Callsign} explains, "It all started when [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] got a letter from {SCN_MW.DET} sister…" "{SCN_MW.Callsign} doesn't have a sister, {TGT_MW.Callsign}." "Wait, then whose lifesaving medical operation are we trying to raise money for?" "Take the still apart and try to stay out of trouble for a change. Now, if you'll excuse me, I'm going to have a chat with {SCN_MW.Callsign}."
column2: 我知道这不是你的主意，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]，你说。"那是谁的？" {TGT_MW.Callsign} 解释道："这事一开始是 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 收到一封 {SCN_MW.DET} 姐妹寄来的信……" "{SCN_MW.Callsign} 没有姐妹，{TGT_MW.Callsign}。" "等等，那我们到底是在为谁的救命手术筹钱？" "把那套蒸馏器拆了，试着别再惹麻烦。现在，恕我失陪，我要去跟 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 谈谈。"

column1:
Sumire interrupts your morning rituals with an unusual communication from planetside. "Commander, you'll want to see this message."

As the video playback comes through, you see an older man, grizzled and hard-worn, with an equally-tired looking woman beside him.

"Uh, hello? This is a message for Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. We wanted to thank-you for what you've done here in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}."

He pauses and with encouragement from his wife continues. "And ah... we've heard that our boy is working for you. He goes by [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]? We were hoping you could contact us and tell us how he's doing. When he left us, we didn't really part on the best of terms. He hasn't talked to us for a long time. But recent events... well, you know. We miss him and we'd really appreciate it if you could give us a little bit of news."
column2:
苏米蕾打断了你早晨的例行事务，传来一条来自行星表面的不寻常通讯。"指挥官，您得看看这条消息。"

录像播放出来，你看到一位头发花白、饱经风霜的老人，身边是一位同样疲惫的妇人。

"呃，你好？这是一条给 {COMMANDER.LastName} 指挥官的消息。我们想感谢你为 {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} 所做的一切。"

他停顿了一下，在妻子的鼓励下继续说。"还有，呃……我们听说我们的儿子在为你工作。他的呼号是 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]？我们希望你联系我们，告诉我们他过得怎么样。他离开我们的时候，我们其实没好好道别。他已经很久没和我们说过话了。但最近发生的事……嗯，你知道的。我们很想他，如果你能给我们一点消息，我们会非常感激。"

column1:
Negotiating in a hallway is not how this is done, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], you say. "Lucky for you, I was just going over the budget with Darius and I think we can re-allocate a few C-Bills in your direction."

{SCN_MW.Callsign} nods in grim satisfaction and [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] looks pleasantly surprised.

Later in the week, however, news of the good fortune of the two MechWarriors ripples through the barracks. They have not been quiet, and now it's clear that you've just borrowed more trouble.
column2:
“在走廊里谈判可不是做事的规矩，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]，”你说。“算你走运，我刚和达里乌斯过完预算，我想我们可以往你这边重新划拨一些星币。”

{SCN_MW.Callsign} 阴沉而满意地点了点头，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 则一脸惊喜。

然而那一周稍晚，两名机甲战士走运的消息就在营房里传开了。他们可没保持低调，现在很明显，你只是给自己借来了更多麻烦。

column1: Negotiating in a hallway is not how this is done, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], you say. "Lucky for you, I was just going over the budget with Darius and I think we can allocate a few more C-Bills to MechWarrior payroll this month. Only this month."\n\n{SCN_MW.Callsign} nods in grim satisfaction and [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] looks pleasantly surprised.
column2: “在走廊里谈判可不是做事的规矩，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]，”你说。“算你走运，我刚和达里乌斯过完预算，我想这个月可以给机甲战士的薪酬多拨一些星币。只限这个月。”\n\n{SCN_MW.Callsign} 阴沉而满意地点了点头，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 则一脸惊喜。

column1: Negotiating in a hallway is not how this is done, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], you say. "Lucky for you, I was just going over the budget with Darius and I think we can allocate a few more C-Bills to MechWarrior payroll this month. Only this month." {SCN_MW.Callsign} nods in grim satisfaction and [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] looks pleasantly surprised. Later in the week, after the announcement has been made, {SCN_MW.Callsign} goes so far as to take credit for it and basks in the gratitude from {SCN_MW.DET} fellow MechWarriors.
column2: “在走廊里谈判可不是做事的规矩，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]，”你说。“算你走运，我刚和达里乌斯过完预算，我想这个月可以给机甲战士的薪酬多拨一些星币。只限这个月。” {SCN_MW.Callsign} 阴沉而满意地点了点头，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 则一脸惊喜。 那一周稍晚，消息公布之后，{SCN_MW.Callsign} 甚至把功劳揽到了自己头上，享受着 {SCN_MW.DET} 同伴机甲战士们的感激。

column1: Negotiating in a hallway is not how this is done, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], you say. "Lucky for you, I was just going over the budget with Darius and I think we can re-allocate a few C-Bills in your direction." You look at [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. "Both of your directions."\n\n{SCN_MW.Callsign} nods in grim satisfaction and {TGT_MW.Callsign} looks pleasantly surprised.
column2: “在走廊里谈判可不是做事的规矩，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]，”你说。“算你走运，我刚和达里乌斯过完预算，我想我们可以往你这边重新划拨一些星币。”你看向 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。“你们俩都有份。”\n\n{SCN_MW.Callsign} 阴沉而满意地点了点头，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 则一脸惊喜。

column1: Later that week, in the daily briefing, Darius delivers an update. "I'm just going to read this aloud, so you can appreciate their… tone. 'Thank you for trying to help us with testing, but [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] has not fit in with our team. {SCN_MW.Subj_C} not only insulted our researchers, but has also refused to take part in some of the testing, and in one case actually broke our equipment.' And that, by the way, is why they're not paying us." Sumire shrugs. "Look on the bright side, at least {SCN_MW.Callsign} will be back soon. A few days, tops." Yang chuckles. "And that's a good thing?"
column2: 那一周晚些时候，在每日简报会上，达里乌斯带来了最新消息。“我就直接念出来，好让您体会一下他们的……语气。‘感谢你们派来帮忙测试，但 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 没能融入我们的团队。{SCN_MW.Subj_C} 不仅侮辱了我们的研究人员，还拒绝参与部分测试，有一次甚至弄坏了我们的设备。’ 顺带一提，这就是他们不付钱的原因。” 苏米蕾耸耸肩。“往好处想，至少 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 很快就回来了。最多几天。” 杨笑了。“这算好事？”

column1: It's been a long day of arguing with Darius about dwindling supplies and you're finally on your way back to your quarters. Around the bend of the corridor you hear a sudden exclamation: "They pay their MechWarriors how much?!" This is immediately followed by an urgent shushing. Just then [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] come around the corner and see you. {TGT_MW.Callsign} looks abashed, but {SCN_MW.Callsign} sticks out {SCN_MW.DET} chin. "Commander, we need a raise!"
column2: 和达里乌斯为日益减少的补给争论了一整天，你终于走在回舱室的路上。 在走廊拐角处，你突然听到一声惊呼：“他们给机甲战士开那么多钱？！”紧接着是一阵急促的“嘘”声。 就在这时，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 和 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 转过拐角，看见了你。{TGT_MW.Callsign} 一脸窘迫，但 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 扬起 {SCN_MW.DET} 下巴。“指挥官，我们要求加薪！”

column1:
I'm not going to be negotiated with in a hallway, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]. We'll review our finances at the end of the month, like we always do.

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] puts a hand on the other MechWarrior's shoulder, silencing whatever unwise thought was working its way through {SCN_MW.Callsign}'s head to {SCN_MW.DET} mouth.

Satisfied that this discussion is over, you continue down the hallway and they make way for you. You call back over your shoulder, "Prove yourself on the battlefield. That's how you get paid."
column2:
“我不会在走廊里跟人谈判，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]。我们月底照常审查财务状况。”

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 把手搭在另一名机甲战士肩上，把 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 脑子里那些正往 {SCN_MW.DET} 嘴边爬的不明智念头按了回去。

你觉得这场对话可以结束了，便继续沿走廊往前走，他们给你让开路。你头也不回地说：“在战场上证明自己。那才是挣钱的路子。”

column1:
Negotiating in a hallway is not how this is done, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], you say.  "Lucky for you, I was just going over the budget with Darius and I think we find a way to give everyone a one-time bonus."

The two MechWarriors recover from their initial surprise and thank you for your generosity.

Later that day, Darius does not have the same reaction. "Commander, I know morale is a bit low right now, but we can't spend our way out of this problem every time. They're going to eventually expect changes like this to become permanent…"
column2:
“在走廊里谈判可不是做事的规矩，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]，”你说。“算你走运，我刚和达里乌斯过完预算，我想我们找到了办法，能给每个人发一笔一次性奖金。”

两名机甲战士从最初的惊讶中回过神，为你的慷慨道谢。

当天晚些时候，达里乌斯的反应可就不一样了。“指挥官，我知道现在士气有点低，但我们不能每次都靠花钱来解决这个问题。他们迟早会指望这类改变变成常态……”

column1: Later that week, you visit the Training room and check the leaderboards. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s Lance has fallen to the bottom of the standings.\n\nThe current match finishes and {TGT_MW.Callsign} emerges from one set of pods and immediately charges over to confront [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] who has emerged from the other team's pods. Taunting, recriminations and accusations ripple through the entire room.
column2: 那一周晚些时候，你去训练室查看排行榜。[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 的小队已经落到了积分榜末位。\n\n当前这场比赛结束了，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 从一组模拟舱里出来，立刻冲过去质问从对面队伍舱里出来的 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]。嘲讽、指责与控诉声传遍了整个房间。

column1: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] nods. "You're right. Now's the time for everyone to step up." Later that week, you visit the Training room and check the leaderboards. {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s Lance has fallen in the standings. [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] walks up behind you. "Commander, I know you encouraged {TGT_MW.Callsign} to keep me around. I feel bad that I let {TGT_MW.Obj} down, but I think that I need the life-or-death adrenaline from a real battlefield. Anyway, please know that I won't let you down… not when it counts, anyway."
column2: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 点了点头。“你说得对。现在是每个人都该站出来的时候了。” 那一周晚些时候，你去训练室查看排行榜。{TGT_MW.Callsign} 的小队排名下降了。 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 走到你身后。“指挥官，我知道是您鼓励 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 把我留在队里的。我让 {TGT_MW.Obj} 失望了，很抱歉，但我想我需要的是真正战场上那种生死一线的肾上腺素。总之，请相信我不会让您失望……至少在最关键的时候不会。”

column1:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] nods. "You're right. Now's the time for everyone to step up."

Later that week, you visit the Training room and check the leaderboards. {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s Lance has risen in the standings.

{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:walk|Default:walks} up behind you. "Thanks for the advice. I just wish I'd challenged the team even sooner… we may have made it into the finals. But next season we've got this, for sure."
column2:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 点了点头。“你说得对。现在是每个人都该站出来的时候了。”

那一周晚些时候，你去训练室查看排行榜。{TGT_MW.Callsign} 的小队排名上升了。

{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:walk|Default:walks} 到你身后。“谢谢您的建议。我只是真希望自己能早些向队伍发起挑战……说不定我们就能打进决赛了。但下个赛季，我们肯定能行。”

column1:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] nods. "You're right, I just couldn't bring myself to do it. I suppose that leadership requires tough decisions like this."

Later that week, you visit the Training room and check the leaderboards. {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s Lance has risen in the standings.

{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:walk|Default:walks} up behind you. "Thanks for the advice… I just wish I'd done it sooner. We might've made it into the finals. Maybe next season, though."
column2:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 点了点头。“你说得对，我只是实在狠不下心这么做。看来当领导就得做这种艰难的决定。”

那一周晚些时候，你去训练室查看排行榜。{TGT_MW.Callsign} 的小队排名上升了。

{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:walk|Default:walks} 到你身后。“谢谢您的建议……我只是真希望自己能早些这么做。说不定我们就能打进决赛了。不过，也许下个赛季吧。”

column1: Even before you enter the mess hall you can hear the palpable buzz of grumbling. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s voice rises above the clamor. "Radishes? Radishes?! I swear, if I ever see another radish on my plate, I'm going to jump out an airlock and hope the next DropShip to come along has a better cook!" The echo of agreement that follows suggests a rising disenchantment with the mess hall's current menu.
column2: 还没走进食堂，你就能听见那片明显的抱怨声。[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 的声音盖过了嘈杂。 “萝卜？萝卜？！我发誓，要是我盘子里再出现一根萝卜，我就跳出气闸舱，指望下一艘路过的空投艇上有个更好的厨子！” 随后响起的一片附和声表明，大家对食堂目前的菜单越来越不满了。

column1:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] arrives at your quarters, looking for some advice.

What had started as a competitive training exercise in the Training Module has since evolved into a shipwide tournament, with mixed Lances of MechWarriors and other crew. {TGT_MW.Callsign} and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] have been competing together.

"But Commander, {SCN_MW.Callsign} hasn't been pulling {SCN_MW.Det} weight, and my other two teammates are looking to me, as Lance captain, to do something about it. I'm feeling a bit stuck here. What should I do?"
column2:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 来到你的舱室，想讨点建议。

原本只是训练模块里的一场竞技练习，如今已经演变成全船性的锦标赛，由机甲战士和其他船员混编组成小队。{TGT_MW.Callsign} 和 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 一直在同一队里比赛。

“可是指挥官，{SCN_MW.Callsign} 一直没尽到 {SCN_MW.Det} 那份力，我另外两个队友都指望我作为小队长做点什么。我有点卡在这儿了。我该怎么办？”

column1:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] nods. "You're right, I just couldn't bring myself to do it. I suppose leadership requires tough decisions like this."

Later that week, you visit the Training room and check the leaderboards. {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s Lance has fallen in the standings.

{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:walk|Default:walks} up behind you. "I may have to do that again. Next time, remind me to get a replacement who's actually an improvement."
column2:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 点了点头。“你说得对，我只是实在狠不下心这么做。看来当领导就得做这种艰难的决定。”

那一周晚些时候，你去训练室查看排行榜。{TGT_MW.Callsign} 的小队排名下降了。

{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:walk|Default:walks} 到你身后。“我可能还得再来一次。下次记得提醒我，换个确实能带来提升的人。”

column1: Later that week, in the daily briefing, Darius delivers an update. "I'm just going to read this aloud. '[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] is professional, engaged, and stands alone as the single best tester we've ever had. {SCN_MW.Subj_C} not only helped us tune our instruments, but also suggested better testing techniques and procedures.' They even threw in some extra C-Bills for the additional help."\n\n"When {SCN_MW.Callsign} volunteered, I didn't expect much," Yang offers. "You made a good call, Boss."
column2: 那一周晚些时候，在每日简报会上，达里乌斯带来了最新消息。“我就直接念了。‘[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 专业、投入，是我们有史以来最好的一位测试员，无人能及。{SCN_MW.Subj_C} 不仅帮我们校准了仪器，还提出了更好的测试方法与流程。’ 他们还因为这份额外的帮助多付了一些星币。”\n\n“当初 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 主动报名时，我没抱多大期望，”杨说，“你这一手安排得不错，老板。”

column1: You shoot [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] a warning look. "If you weren't an ace in the cockpit, we wouldn't even be entertaining this idea… but, given your talents, my hands are tied. I'll pay off your debts with the company's funds—this one time." Darius shakes his head, but says nothing. {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s eyes widen and a big smile splits {TGT_MW.DET} face. "Really? Thanks—" "Don't thank me yet," you interrupt. "You're on probation until you prove you can be trusted—if ever. And if you pull a stunt like this again, I'll wrap you in a bow and deliver you to whoever you piss off next myself." {TGT_MW.Callsign} sags, color draining from {TGT_MW.DET} face. "Message received." Darius smirks. "And you can report to me once we're on the Argo. I've got a long list of duties for you to tackle while you pay back this debt you owe us." "I guess this beats getting stuck with those boogeymen… " {TGT_MW.Callsign} trails off. "That's one hell of an understatement." You incline your head to Darius. The XO walks off to arrange the payment. Your gaze falls back on {TGT_MW.Callsign}. "Now get back on the Leopard. We need to find a spot on [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] where you haven't made enemies."
column2: 你朝 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 投去一个警告的眼神。"要不是你在驾驶舱里是个王牌，我们连考虑都不会考虑这件事……但看在你的才能上，我没得选。我会用公司的资金替你还清债务——就这一次。" 达里乌斯摇了摇头，但什么也没说。{TGT_MW.Callsign} 睁大了眼睛，一个大大的笑容咧开在 {TGT_MW.DET} 脸上。"真的？谢谢——" "先别谢我，"你打断道。"你会一直处于察看期，直到证明自己值得信任——也许永远都证明不了。要是你再搞出这种事，我就亲自把你裹上包装、送给你下一个得罪的人。" {TGT_MW.Callsign} 泄了气，血色从 {TGT_MW.DET} 脸上褪去。"明白了。" 达里乌斯咧嘴一笑。"等我们回到阿戈号上，你来向我报到。在你偿还欠我们的这笔债期间，我有一长串差事给你。" "我想这总比被那些怪物缠上强……"{TGT_MW.Callsign} 声音渐弱。 "这话说得太轻描淡写了。"你朝达里乌斯点点头。副官走开去安排付款。你的目光又落回 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 身上。"现在回豹式运输机上去。我们得在 [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] 上找个你还没树敌的地方。"

column1:
You jerk your thumb over your shoulder, pointing to the Leopard. "Get in, MechWarrior. I've got half a mind to leave you with your new acquaintances, but you're worth a fortune on the battlefield."

As [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] scrambles into the Leopard, you keep an eye on the stranger. He waves nonchalantly, flashing bright white teeth. Once you're all inside the Leopard, 

{TGT_MW.Callsign} drops into a seat. "I half-expected that creep to pull out a gun."

Darius shakes his head as he adjusts his shoulder straps. "They wouldn't be that sloppy. A public shootout isn't good for business. These guys are professionals. They'll spread the word across their networks. Kiss any favor we had with pirates goodbye."

"And your privileges," you add. "Look {TGT_MW.Callsign}, you should know better by now. You keep choosing to put yourself and the rest of us at risk by extension. That's unacceptable."

{TGT_MW.Callsign} mumbles an excuse, but Darius cuts {TGT_MW.OBJ} off. "Forget about shore leave privileges. You'll be on probation until you can prove yourself trustworthy."
column2:
你用拇指朝肩后一指，指向豹式运输机。"上来，机甲战士。我本来打算把你就留给你的新朋友，但你在战场上的价值可不止一点钱。"

当 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 爬上豹式运输机时，你留意着那个陌生人。他若无其事地挥了挥手，露出一口亮白的牙齿。等你们全都进了运输机，

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 一屁股坐进座位。"我差点以为那个怪人会掏枪。"

达里乌斯一边调整肩带一边摇头。"他们不会那么马虎。公开枪战对生意没好处。这些人很专业。他们会把消息传遍自己的关系网。我们跟海盗之间那点情分，就此别过了。"

"还有你的特权，"你补充道。"听着，{TGT_MW.Callsign}，你现在该懂事了。你一次次选择把自己和连带的我们所有人置于险境。这不可接受。"

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 咕哝着找了个借口，但达里乌斯打断 {TGT_MW.OBJ}。"上岸休假特权免谈了。在你能证明自己值得信任之前，你会一直处于察看期。"

column1: You tilt your head toward [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. "I'm sorry, but I can't keep bailing you out every time you endanger yourself and the entire outfit. It's not fair to the rest of the crew. I have to give you up." "You're abandoning me to these creeps? After all we've been through?" {TGT_MW.DET_C} eyes bulge, mouth curling into a snarl. "We've been through a lot, it’s true. You're a good MechWarrior, maybe even a great one, but I should have cut you loose sooner. You're going to get someone—or all of us—killed over a completely avoidable mistake. You did this to yourself." You climb into the Leopard, gesturing to Darius. The XO follows suit, while {TGT_MW.Callsign} gapes for a moment. For once, {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:don't|Default:doesn't} have a retort ready. The Leopard's bay doors start to swing closed. "You're making a huge mistake!" {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:shout|Default:shouts} before the Leopard's doors snap shut and the engines roar to life. You never see {TGT_MW.Callsign} again.
column2: 你朝 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 偏了偏头。"很抱歉，但我不能每次你把自己和整支部队置于险境时都替你收拾烂摊子。这对其他船员不公平。我只能放弃你。" "你要把我丢给这些混蛋？在我们经历了这么多之后？"{TGT_MW.DET_C}眼睛鼓起，嘴角扭成一阵狞笑。 "我们确实经历了很多。你是个好机甲战士，也许甚至是顶尖的，但我早该放你走。你会因为一个完全可以避免的错误害死某个人——或者我们所有人。这是你自己造成的。"你爬进豹式运输机，向达里乌斯示意。 副官跟着上了机，而 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 呆张着嘴愣了片刻。这一次，{TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:don't|Default:doesn't} 没能马上反驳。豹式运输机的舱门开始合拢。"你犯了一个巨大的错误！"{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:shout|Default:shouts}，随后舱门砰地关上，引擎轰然启动。 你再也没见过 {TGT_MW.Callsign}。

column1: A stranger with slicked back hair and a tailored suit shoves a compad at Darius, while you're loading up the Leopard on [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]]. The XO stomps over, pulling you and [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] aside. "Unbelievable! Today, {TGT_MW.Callsign} racked up a huge debt—two million C-bills—at a crime syndicate’s gambling ring and had the gall to run out on 'em." "I don't know what you're talking about." {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s gaze flickers toward the stranger. Darius points to a video feed on the stranger's compad. On the screen, {TGT_MW.Callsign} climbs out the window of a seedy industrial structure. "They want their money, but they'll accept {TGT_MW.Callsign} in lieu of cash. It's 'strictly business,' he assured me." "I can't afford to pay that back. Let's take off!" {TGT_MW.Callsign} blurts out. "Forget this creep." Darius grabs {TGT_MW.Callsign} by the arm. "Pipe down, Card Shark. This is the Commander's call. These gentlemen are tied to pirates all over the Periphery. We might piss off a whole slew of bad guys if we bolt."
column2: 你正在 [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] 上往豹式运输机里装货时，一个留着背头、穿着定制西装的陌生人把一块掌上电脑塞到达里乌斯面前。副官大步走来，把你和 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 拉到一边。"简直难以置信！今天，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 在一个犯罪集团的赌局里欠下了巨额债务——两百万星币——还胆敢跑路。" "你在说什么，我完全不知道。"{TGT_MW.Callsign} 的目光朝那个陌生人飘去。 达里乌斯指向陌生人掌上电脑上的一段视频。画面中，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 从一栋破败的工业建筑窗户里爬出来。"他们想要回自己的钱，但也接受用 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 本人抵债。他向我保证，这'完全是生意'。" "我还不起那笔钱。我们起飞吧！"{TGT_MW.Callsign} 脱口而出。"别管这个怪人。" 达里乌斯抓着 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 的胳膊。"闭嘴吧，牌场鲨鱼。这得指挥官来定。这些先生们跟外围区各地的海盗都有联系。我们要是跑掉，可能会一下子惹上一大群狠角色。"

column1:
After the video finishes, Sumire comes back on the screen, a questioning look on her face. "Well?"

"Sumire, if [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] isn't talking to his family, he probably has his reasons. I'm going to respect that. Please send a polite non-reply citing a company policy about respecting crew privacy."

Later in the week, you see Sumire and Medusa in the mess hall, heads together. It's clear that she couldn't resist bringing up the subject.

Medusa waves you over. "No worries, Commander. You made the right call. I don't have any regrets. It's best to leave the past in the past."
column2:
视频结束后，苏米蕾重新出现在屏幕上，一脸询问的表情。"怎么样？"

"苏米蕾，如果 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 不跟家人联系，他大概有自己的理由。我尊重这一点。请礼貌地回一条不予答复的消息，就说公司政策是尊重船员隐私。"

那一周晚些时候，你在餐厅看到苏米蕾和 Medusa 凑在一起。显然她还是忍不住提起了这件事。

Medusa 招手叫你过去。"别担心，指挥官。你的决定是对的。我没有任何遗憾。过去的事就让它过去最好。"

column1:
After a moment's thought, you return the couple's call and spend a half hour sharing stories about [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]].

The old man sheds some tears and the old woman is stoic but proud. Neither of them want you to tell their son about the call. 

"If he's doing well, there's no reason to complicate things. He's got to live his own life," says the old man. "We didn't understand that then, but we figured it out eventually. Thank-you for the news, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}."
column2:
思索片刻后，你回了那对夫妇的通讯，花了半个小时和他们聊 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 的事。

老人流下了眼泪，老妇人神情坚毅却满怀骄傲。他们都不希望你把这次通话告诉他们的儿子。

"如果他过得好，就没有必要把事情搞复杂。他得走自己的路，"老人说。"我们当时不明白这一点，但后来想通了。谢谢你告诉我们这些，{COMMANDER.LastName} 指挥官。"

column1:
Instead of returning the old couple's call, you summon [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and play the message for him. His jaw tightens as he watches. When it's done, you say, "What would you like me to do?"

Clearly agitated, he says, "I don't know. They wanted me to stay on Katinka and when I refused, they disowned me. Like I wanted to inherit that collapsing prospector outfit anyhow. Why are they calling now?"

"Maybe the war made them rethink some things?" you suggest. "It's been known to happen."

Medusa sits down suddenly. "Shit. I didn't even think about that. I wonder..." He trails off, staring off into space worriedly.

"In my experience it's better to know than speculate. Why don't you give them a call yourself?"

Medusa nods slowly. "I'll do that."

When you see him the next day, he's quieter than usual, but he gives you a thumbs-up when you catch his eye.
column2:
你没有回复那对老夫妇的通讯，而是把 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 叫来，把消息放给他听。他看着录像时下巴绷紧。播放结束后，你说："你希望我怎么做？"

他显然很不安，"我不知道。他们想让我留在 Katinka，我拒绝了，他们就跟我断绝了关系。好像我多想去继承那个快垮掉的探矿生意似的。他们现在为什么打电话来？"

"也许战争让他们重新想通了一些事？"你提议。"这种事常有的。"

Medusa 忽然坐下。"该死。我完全没想到这一点。我想知道……"他声音渐低，忧虑地盯着空中。

"按我的经验，弄清楚比瞎猜好。你为什么不自己给他们打个电话？"

Medusa 缓缓点头。"我会的。"

第二天你见到他时，他比平时安静，但与你对上目光时，他朝你竖起了大拇指。

column1: We have a request to set up a live shooting range, Darius says in the staff meeting. "[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] says the pressure-safe target pistols aren't sufficiently realistic to keep the MechWarriors' skills sharp. That said, I'm not sure if the Argo has an appropriate location for that kind of thing." "For what, an indoor firing range?" Dr. Murad tilts her head, her brow furrowing. "I believe that I can find a spot in Gamma Pod. It's still a mess over there anyway. Use an armor plate as a backstop… yes, it should be fine if they're careful." Her eyes shift to you. "Your MechWarriors are careful, aren't they?"
column2: 我们收到一个设立实弹射击场的请求，达里乌斯在幕僚会议上说。"[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 说那些压力安全训练手枪不够真实，无法让机甲战士们保持枪法。话虽如此，我不确定阿戈号上有合适的地方搞这个。" "搞什么，室内射击场？"穆拉德博士歪了歪头，眉头紧皱。"我想我能在 Gamma Pod 找个位置。那边本来就还一团乱。用一块装甲板做挡弹墙……对，只要他们小心点，应该没问题。" 她的目光转向你。"你的机甲战士会小心的，对吧？"

column1:
Yes, Commander? [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] knocks and enters your office.

You offer {TGT_MW.OBJ} a seat. "A research company here in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} has requested a seasoned MechWarrior to do some testing at one of their facilities for two weeks. I'd like to send you."

{TGT_MW.Callsign} grins. "I go where you send me, Commander."
column2:
“什么事，指挥官？”[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 敲了敲门，走进你的办公室。

你示意 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 坐下。“{TGT_SYSTEM.Name} 这里有一家研究公司，请求派一名经验丰富的机甲战士到他们的某处设施做两周测试。我想派你去。”

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 咧嘴一笑。“您派我去哪儿，我就去哪儿，指挥官。”

column1:
Yes, Commander? [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] knocks and enters your office.

You offer {TGT_MW.OBJ} a seat. "A research company here in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} requests a seasoned MechWarrior to do some testing at one of their facilities for two weeks. I'd like to send you."

{TGT_MW.Callsign} salutes and says seriously, "I'd be honored, Commander. You can rely on me."
column2:
“什么事，指挥官？”[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 敲了敲门，走进你的办公室。

你示意 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 坐下。“{TGT_SYSTEM.Name} 这里有一家研究公司，需要一名经验丰富的机甲战士到他们的某处设施做两周测试。我想派你去。”

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 敬了个礼，认真地说：“这是我的荣幸，指挥官。您尽可以放心交给我。”

column1:
Yes, Commander? [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] knocks and enters your office.

You offer {TGT_MW.OBJ} a seat. "A research company here in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} requests a seasoned MechWarrior to do some testing at one of their facilities for two weeks. I'd like to send you."

{TGT_MW.Callsign}'s expression never changes . "I'd rather not, Commander. To be honest, that sounds really dull."

"The perils of being a senior pilot, {TGT_MW.Callsign}. I know you'll do your job even if you don't like it. Consider it training for having your own command someday."
column2:
“什么事，指挥官？”[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 敲了敲门，走进你的办公室。

你示意 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 坐下。“{TGT_SYSTEM.Name} 这里有一家研究公司，需要一名经验丰富的机甲战士到他们的某处设施做两周测试。我想派你去。”

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 的表情丝毫未变。“我不太想去，指挥官。说实话，听起来非常无聊。”

“这就是资深机师的烦恼，{TGT_MW.Callsign}。我知道就算不喜欢，你也会把活干好。就当是为将来自己带队伍做训练吧。”

column1: You're almost finished with the morning briefing when Darius glances up at you. "One last thing," he says as he scrolls his datapad. "A research facility here in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} has put out an open request for MechWarriors to test some modified 'Mech components. It pays ¢50,000 for two weeks onsite."\n\nDarius looks over the current roster. "If you're interested, we could send an experienced pilot like [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. Or I suppose that we could approach the more junior MechWarriors and ask for a volunteer…" He shrugs. "Your call. What do you think?"
column2: 早间简报快结束时，达里乌斯抬头看了你一眼。“还有最后一件事，”他一边滚动数据板一边说，“{TGT_SYSTEM.Name} 这里有一家研究设施公开招募机甲战士测试一些改装过的机甲部件。在岗两周，报酬是 ¢50,000。”\n\n达里乌斯看了看当前的人员名单。“如果您有兴趣，我们可以派一名像 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 这样经验丰富的机师去。或者我们也可以去找资历较浅的机甲战士，问问谁愿意自荐……”他耸了耸肩。“您来定。您觉得呢？”

column1: You break Dr. Murad's stare. "Unfortunately, caution isn't really their strong suit. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] with {TGT_MW.DET} military background is one thing, but some of the others… well, let's not tempt fate with live fire. Darius, tell {TGT_MW.Callsign} {TGT_MW.SUBJ}'ll just have to show the others how to improve with indoor target pistols."\n\nDarius nods, and moves on to the next item on his list.
column2: 你避开穆拉德博士的目光。“可惜，谨慎并不是他们的强项。[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 有 {TGT_MW.DET} 军旅背景，那还好说，但其他一些人……算了吧，还是别用实弹去试探运气。达里乌斯，告诉 {TGT_MW.Callsign}，{TGT_MW.SUBJ} 只能教其他人用室内靶用手枪提升水平了。”\n\n达里乌斯点点头，接着讲他清单上的下一项。

column1: You nod at Dr. Murad. "[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] is ex-military. If {TGT_MW.Gender?Male:he's|Female:she's|NonBinary:they're} running this, there shouldn't be any real risk. Darius, make it happen, but stress to {TGT_MW.Callsign} that final responsibility lies with {TGT_MW.OBJ}."\n\nIt doesn't take long for the MechWarriors to get the shooting range set up and start using their auto-pistols. {TGT_MW.Callsign} manages the range well. There are no immediate problems.
column2: 你朝穆拉德博士点了点头。“[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 是退伍军人。如果是 {TGT_MW.Gender?Male:he's|Female:she's|NonBinary:they're} 来负责，应该不会有真正的风险。达里乌斯，去安排吧，但要让 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 明白，最终责任由 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 承担。”\n\n机甲战士们很快就搭好了射击场，开始使用他们的自动手枪。{TGT_MW.Callsign} 把靶场管理得很好。没有立刻出现问题。

column1:
You nod at Dr. Murad. "[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] is ex-military. If {TGT_MW.Gender?Male:he's|Female:she's|NonBinary:they're} running this, there shouldn't be any real risk. Darius, make it happen, but stress to {TGT_MW.Callsign} that final responsibility lies with {TGT_MW.OBJ}."

As soon as {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:get|Default:gets} the go-ahead, {TGT_MW.Callsign} starts organizing the shooting range. The MechWarriors produce a wide variety of small arms, some of which rather stretch the definition.

When Darius catches [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] toting a [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreGyroslugRifle],Gyroslug Rifle]] and explosive ammunition through the corridor, he calls {TGT_MW.Callsign} in for a heated dressing-down. Afterward, the shooting range becomes pistols-only, and locks appear on all Gyroslug Rifle cases.
column2:
你朝穆拉德博士点了点头。“[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 是退伍军人。如果是 {TGT_MW.Gender?Male:he's|Female:she's|NonBinary:they're} 来负责，应该不会有真正的风险。达里乌斯，去安排吧，但要让 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 明白，最终责任由 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 承担。”

等到 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:get|Default:gets} 了许可，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 就开始组织射击场。机甲战士们搬出了五花八门的轻武器，其中有些相当勉强地符合“轻武器”的定义。

当达里乌斯抓到 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 拿着 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreGyroslugRifle],Gyroslug Rifle]] 和爆炸弹药穿过走廊时，他把 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 叫来狠狠训了一顿。之后，射击场只允许使用手枪，所有陀螺弹步枪的枪箱都上了锁。

column1:
That's clear thinking, Ms. Meyer. I believe that we can spare [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] for a week. And, by all means, please accompany {TGT_MW.Obj}. Wouldn't want {TGT_MW.Obj} to get eaten by a predator along the way.

Sumire bites back a wider smile. "Yes, Commander. Right away, Commander."

As Sumire begins to leave, you have one last request. "Please do take some pictures, Sumire. I think everyone would appreciate seeing what you've seen, if only secondhand."
column2:
这个想法很清楚，迈耶女士。我想我们可以放 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 一周的假。而且，务必请你陪同 {TGT_MW.Obj}。总不希望 {TGT_MW.Obj} 半路上被掠食者吃掉。

苏米蕾强忍住更灿烂的笑。"是，指挥官。马上就去，指挥官。"

苏米蕾正要离开时，你提出了最后一个请求。"请一定拍些照片，苏米蕾。我想大家都会想看看你看到的东西，哪怕是二手见闻。"

column1:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] is quarantined in one of the MedBays and provided local symptomatic treatment. {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} soon joined by [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], and not long after that, [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] falls ill as well.

Rumors and fear spread faster than the virus, with stories of paralyzed limbs, agonizing cramps, and hallucinations. Everyone finds themselves praying to whatever gods they worship.

Eventually, it is clear the quarantine has successfully limited the spread of the disease. For these three MechWarriors, however, it's going to be a long and extremely unpleasant road to recovery.
column2:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 被隔离在一间医疗舱里，接受当地的对症治疗。{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} 不久也迎来了病友 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]；再过不久，[[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] 也病倒了。

谣言与恐惧比病毒传播得更快，什么四肢麻痹、绞痛难忍、出现幻觉之类的说法满天飞。每个人都开始向自己所信奉的神明祈祷。

最终，隔离被证明成功遏制了疾病的蔓延。不过对这三名机甲战士来说，康复之路将会漫长而极其痛苦。

所幸，当地以如此高昂的代价提供的药物起了作用，把传染扼杀在了萌芽阶段。再没有别人染病，不过染上这种病的三名机甲战士仍要面对一条漫长而缓慢的康复之路。

column1:
Darius has called a rare emergency meeting. "Recently, we rescued a ship that was damaged as it departed a planet under quarantine. We hoped we'd avoided infection. We did not. Now [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] has developed a highly contagious, potentially fatal disease."

Grimly, he lays out the path ahead. "We need to isolate an entire MedBay until {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:recover|Default:recovers}. I've also contacted the local authorities, and they've offered to sell us medication for ¢120,000. An extortionate price, but without it, we may find ourselves in the same position as the ship we rescued."

Sumire adds, "I spoke to a friend at a pharmaceutical research lab, but this bug is beyond the scope of any of his experimental antivirals."
column2:
达里乌斯召开了一次难得的紧急会议。“最近，我们救下了一艘从一颗被隔离的星球出发时受损的飞船。我们本以为已经避开了感染。结果没有。现在 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 患上了一种传染性极强、可能致命的疾病。”

他神色严峻地说明了接下来的安排。“我们得把整间医疗舱隔离起来，直到 {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:recover|Default:recovers}。我也联系了当地政府，他们愿意以 ¢120,000 的价格卖给我们药物。价钱简直是敲诈，但没有它，我们可能会落得和那艘被我们救下的飞船一样的下场。”

苏米蕾补充道：“我问过一位在药物研究实验室工作的朋友，但这种病菌超出了他所有实验性抗病毒药的能力范围。”

column1:
Your team wins the toss, but that turns out to be the only easy part of the game.

In the final play, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] lofts a desperate shot from range, missing wide. [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] grabs the rebound, and kicks it back to you. A cross-over dribble leaves [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] floundering, one foot tripping over the other, and you calmly drain the winning shot.

After politely shaking hands, {TGT_MW.Callsign} looks appropriately chagrined. "That was a good game, Commander. I guess I'd better stick to killing things in my 'Mech."

{SCN_MW.Callsign} claps {TGT_MW.OBJ} on the back.  "Yeah, maybe try calling 'bank' before you Alpha Strike. It might help." The MechWarriors continue hassling each other on the way to the showers.
column2:
你们队赢了跳球，但结果那只是整场比赛唯一轻松的部分。

最后一次进攻，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 从远处绝望地抛出一球，偏得很远。[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 抢下篮板，把球回传给你。一个变向运球把 [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] 晃得脚步错乱、两腿打结，你稳稳命中制胜一球。

礼貌地握手之后，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 一脸该有的懊恼。"打得不错，指挥官。看来我还是更适合在机甲里杀人。"

{SCN_MW.Callsign} 拍了拍 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 的背。"是啊，也许在阿尔法打击之前先喊一声'擦板'会有帮助。"机甲战士们一路互相挖苦着走向淋浴间。

column1:
Your team loses the toss, which turns out to be an accurate omen for the rest of the game.

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] can't seem to miss a shot at range, and [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]]'s ball handling is deceptively effective.

Pushing yourself harder and harder to keep up, the tide is just started to turn your way when [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] rebounds an errant shot, and kicks it back to you. Coming down from your jumpshot, your ankle turns under you with an audible pop. 

{TGT_MW.Callsign} helps you to the MedBay, where the doctors begin to fuss over you. "Sorry, Commander, I think we all played a little too hard."
column2:
你所在的队伍输掉了跳球，而这结果也准确地预示了整场比赛的走向。

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 在远距离投篮几乎弹无虚发，而 [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] 的控球看似不起眼，实则极为有效。

你拼尽全力追赶，势头刚要开始向你这边倾斜，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 抢下一个偏出的投篮，把球踢回给你。你跳投落地时，脚踝在身下扭了一下，发出一声清晰的脆响。

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 扶你去了医疗舱，医生们开始围着你忙前忙后。“抱歉，指挥官，我觉得我们打得都有点太拼了。”

column1:
As the game progresses, the small group of fans grows into a crowd, as word spreads about the game.

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] can't seem to miss a shot at range, and [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]]'s ball handling is deceptively effective.

Meanwhile, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] rebounds like a machine for your team, constantly grabbing errant shots and tipping them in or dishing out to you at the perimeter.

The final play comes down to one ill-considered pass from {TGT_MW.Callsign}, a stolen ball, and your layup rolls perilously around the rim before falling in.

The crowd goes wild.
column2:
随着比赛进行，消息传开，原本寥寥几个观众渐渐聚成了一大群人。

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 在远距离投篮几乎弹无虚发，而 [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] 的控球看似不起眼，实则极为有效。

与此同时，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 像机器一样为你们队拼抢篮板，不断抓下偏出的投篮，要么补篮命中，要么分给在外线的你。

最后一攻，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 一次考虑不周的传球被断，而你上篮的球在篮筐上危险地转了几圈，才终于落进网中。

观众彻底沸腾了。

column1: Another emergency meeting. Darius says, "Commander, we're facing another outbreak of Periphery Pox. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] is the only one presenting symptoms so far." We still have access to the Pox antivirals we invested in before, but the system authorities recommend that we supplement them with drugs particular to the local strain of the disease. That would run us ¢40,000." Sumire's gaze goes distant. "With hospital-grade facilities, the anti-viral research, and enough time and cash, we could develop a serum that would protect from all local strains."
