A cross-over dribble leaves [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] floundering, one foot tripping over the other, and you calmly drain the winning shot.

After politely shaking hands, {TGT_MW.Callsign} looks appropriately chagrined. "That was a good game, Commander. I guess I'd better stick to killing things in my 'Mech."

{SCN_MW.Callsign} claps {TGT_MW.OBJ} on the back.  "Yeah, maybe try calling 'bank' before you Alpha Strike. It might help." The MechWarriors continue hassling each other on the way to the showers.
column2:
你们队赢了跳球，这似乎给整场比赛定下了基调。

最后一次进攻，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 从远处绝望地抛出一球，偏得很远。[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 抢下篮板，把球回传给你。一个变向运球把 [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] 晃得脚步错乱、两腿打结，你稳稳命中制胜一球。

礼貌地握手之后，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 一脸该有的懊恼。"打得不错，指挥官。看来我还是更适合在机甲里杀人。"

{SCN_MW.Callsign} 拍了拍 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 的背。"是啊，也许在阿尔法打击之前先喊一声'擦板'会有帮助。"机甲战士们一路互相挖苦着走向淋浴间。

column1:
You rub your chin, smiling. "MechWarrior, you've got talent, so I'll make you a deal. Clean this up and you can keep working out of an unused cargo hold."

 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s face lights up in surprise. "Really? I've got a new piece I've been working on. I call it 'Mega Yang.'"

"Then hop to it," you say. "Let's put a grand opening together."

In a couple days, the crew gathers in the makeshift gallery for the reveal. Painted across the bulkheads, Yang leaps wildly, encased in blue armor. His cybernetic arm is transformed into autocannon, blasting an unseen foe.

While the crew excitedly crowds around {TGT_MW.OBJ}, Darius sidles up next you. "I hate to say it, but I kind of wish we'd kept my mural." He crosses his arms and you realize the XO is wearing a sleeveless vest for the first time.

You raise an eyebrow. "Oh, yeah?" 

He scowls. "What? It's warm in here."
column2:
你摸着下巴笑了。“机甲战士，你有天赋，所以我来跟你做笔交易。把这收拾干净，你就可以继续用一间闲置货舱当画室。”

 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 脸上露出意外的喜色。“真的吗？我有个新作品一直在画。我叫它‘超级杨’。”

“那就赶紧动手，”你说，“我们来办个开幕展。”

几天后，船员们聚集在这间临时画廊里参加揭幕。舱壁上，杨身披蓝色装甲，狂野地腾跃着。他的机械臂化作自动炮，轰击着看不见的敌人。

当船员们兴奋地围在 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 身边时，达里乌斯悄悄凑到你身旁。“我不想这么说，但我有点希望我们当初留着我的壁画。”他抱起双臂，你这才发现这位副指挥官第一次穿了件无袖背心。

你挑了挑眉。“哦，是吗？”

他一脸不悦。“怎么了？这里头很热。”

column1: Passing by the MedBay, you spot [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] wrestling a medical monitor from a MedTech. "You need to take a second look!" {TGT_MW.Callsign} presses a hand against {TGT_MW.DET} stomach and winces. "I know something is wrong. I feel like I'm dying." You pause in the doorway. "What is going on here?" {TGT_MW.Callsign} relinquishes the monitor, and the MedTech clears her throat. "{TGT_MW.Callsign}'s complaints of abdominal pain are purely neurological. Phantom pain, Commander. There's nothing to treat. We've checked." "Please, Commander, I'm not making this up." {TGT_MW.Callsign} takes a deep breath. "If you authorize an exploratory surgery or another examination, I know the MedTechs will find something."
column2: 路过医疗舱时，你看见 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 正从一名医疗技师手里抢夺医疗监视仪。“你们得再检查一遍！”{TGT_MW.Callsign} 一只手按在 {TGT_MW.DET} 腹部，疼得直咧嘴。“我知道肯定哪里不对。我感觉自己快死了。” 你在门口停下脚步。“这里怎么回事？” {TGT_MW.Callsign} 松开了监视仪，医疗技师清了清嗓子。“{TGT_MW.Callsign} 的腹痛纯粹是神经性的。幻痛，指挥官。没有任何可治疗的东西。我们查过了。” “求您了，指挥官，我不是在瞎编。”{TGT_MW.Callsign} 深吸一口气。“如果您批准做探查性手术或者再检查一次，我相信医疗技师一定能查出问题。”

column1: I trust your judgment, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. You turn your gaze to the MedTech. "Get {TGT_MW.OBJ} another examination. Nothing invasive, unless it's warranted." Later in the day, you receive a report from the MedTechs. Their second examination of {TGT_MW.Callsign} revealed a large cyst hidden behind {TGT_MW.DET} appendix. They had to operate immediately. You rush back to the MedBay and visit {TGT_MW.OBJ} in a recovery room. The medical equipment surrounding {TGT_MW.OBJ} blinks and beeps at a steady rate. "How are you feeling?" you ask. {TGT_MW.Callsign} carefully pats {TGT_MW.DET} abdomen. "You should have seen this thing they took out of me. Nearly the size of a shotgun shell. That's no way for a mercenary to go, Commander. I won't forget this. You saved my life."
column2: “我相信你的判断，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。”你把目光转向医疗技师。“给 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 再做一次检查。除非确有必要，不要做侵入性操作。” 当天晚些时候，你收到了医疗技师的报告。他们对 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 的第二次检查发现 {TGT_MW.DET} 阑尾后方藏着一个很大的囊肿。他们不得不立刻动手术。 你赶回医疗舱，到恢复室看望 {TGT_MW.OBJ}。{TGT_MW.OBJ} 周围的医疗设备以稳定的节奏闪烁、鸣响。 “感觉怎么样？”你问。 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 小心翼翼地拍了拍 {TGT_MW.DET} 腹部。“您真该看看他们从我身体里取出来的那东西。差不多有霰弹枪弹壳那么大。佣兵可不该这样送命，指挥官。我不会忘记这件事。您救了我的命。”

column1: Your style is undeniable, but you need to clean this up, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. If I let this slide, who knows what artwork will end up on the bulkheads. It might not be quite so flattering. "What's that have to do with me?" {TGT_MW.Callsign} narrows {TGT_MW.DET} eyes. You shake your head. "I don't pay you to question my decisions. My ship, my rules." As you enter the Command Center the next day, the XO's airbrushed visage greets you on a dozen screens. Dr. Murad cover her mouth with a hand, while Sumire laughs uproariously. Doubled-over, Yang wipes a tear from the corner of his eye. Red-faced, the XO wrestles the controls, trying to remove the images "{TGT_MW.Callsign} is going to be very busy polishing every bulkhead in the Argo after this stunt." You crack a grin. "I'm sure you'll handle discipline in a balanced manner, XO."
column2: “你的风格无可否认，但你得把这收拾干净，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。要是我对此睁一只眼闭一只眼，谁知道舱壁上还会出现什么作品。说不定就没这么讨人喜欢了。” “这跟我有什么关系？”{TGT_MW.Callsign} 眯起 {TGT_MW.DET} 眼睛。 你摇了摇头。“我付你钱不是让你质疑我的决定。我的船，我的规矩。” 第二天你走进指挥中心时，十几块屏幕上都映着副指挥官那张喷绘出来的脸。穆拉德博士用手捂住嘴，苏米蕾则笑得前仰后合。杨弯着腰，擦去眼角的一滴眼泪。 副指挥官涨红了脸，手忙脚乱地操作控制台，想把这些图像删掉。“闹出这种事，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 得非常忙碌地擦拭阿戈号上每一块舱壁了。” 你咧嘴一笑。“我相信你会公平地处理这次纪律问题，副指挥官。”

column1: Annoyed, Darius calls you on the comms. "Commander, I'm going to need you over in the corridor between the barracks and the mess. I caught [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] painting my likeness on the bulkheads and I'm not amused." In the corridor, {TGT_MW.Callsign} stands next to the mural, clutching an airbrush. Behind {TGT_MW.OBJ}, the XO is depicted flexing his shirtless, rippling biceps and abs, while flames erupt behind him. "What's going on here, {TGT_MW.Callsign}?" you ask. "Everyone hates this stretch. It's cold and grey. So, I decided to turn up the heat." {TGT_MW.Callsign} grins. "You know, some members of this crew really, really like it."
column2: 达里乌斯一肚子火地通过通讯器找你。“指挥官，麻烦你到营房和食堂之间的走廊来一趟。我抓到 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 在舱壁上画我的肖像，我可一点都不觉得好笑。” 走廊里，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 站在那幅壁画旁边，手里攥着喷笔。在 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 身后，副指挥官被画成赤裸上身、屈臂展示虬结的肱二头肌和腹肌的样子，身后还腾起火焰。 “这里是怎么回事，{TGT_MW.Callsign}？”你问。 “大家都讨厌这一段走廊。又冷又灰。”{TGT_MW.Callsign} 咧嘴一笑。“所以我决定把气氛炒热一点。您知道吗，船上有些人真的、真的很喜欢它。”

column1: You turn to the XO. "Darius, you need to lighten up. This is a tribute. If anything I'm jealous I didn't get my own mural." Darius cocks his head, reconsidering his glistening physique on the wall. "If you say so." [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] picks up {TGT_MW.DET} airbrush. "Just you wait, Commander. There's plenty where that came from." The next day, you're swarmed by a crowd outside your quarters. On the bulkhead across the corridor, you're painted riding a missile through space with a sword in hand. A bolt of blue lightning erupts from the tip of the blade. As you pass through the crowd, crew members extend high fives and fist bumps.
column2: 你转向副指挥官。“达里乌斯，你得放松点。这是一幅致敬。要说的话，我还嫉妒自己没有一幅壁画呢。” 达里乌斯歪着头，重新端详墙上自己那副油光水亮的体格。“既然你这么说。” [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 拿起 {TGT_MW.DET} 喷笔。“您就等着吧，指挥官。这样的作品还多着呢。” 第二天，你的舱室外围了一群人。走廊对面的舱壁上，画着你手握长剑、骑着导弹穿越太空，剑尖迸发出一道蓝色闪电。 你穿过人群时，船员们纷纷伸出手来击掌、碰拳。

column1:
Your artistic skills are something else, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], but the rules are the rules. Clean up your mess and we'll forget this ever happened. You put a conciliatory hand on {TGT_MW.DET} shoulder.

{TGT_MW.Callsign} taps on {TGT_MW.DET} temple. "Those rippling biceps will always live on in my head."

Darius sighs. "And mine, too, unfortunately."

"Mission accomplished. If you ever want a private commission, just let me know, XO." {TGT_MW.Callsign} whistles cheerfully as {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:stride|Default:strides} away.
column2:
“你的画技真是没得说，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]，但规矩就是规矩。把你这摊子收拾干净，这事我们就当没发生过。”你安抚地把手搭在 {TGT_MW.DET} 肩上。

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 点了点 {TGT_MW.DET} 太阳穴。“那虬结的肱二头肌会永远活在我脑子里。”

达里乌斯叹了口气。“不幸的是，也会永远活在我脑子里。”

“任务完成。要是您想要私人定制，随时告诉我，副指挥官。”{TGT_MW.Callsign} 吹着口哨，{TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:stride|Default:strides} 着轻快的步子走开了。

column1:
It doesn't hurt to be extra careful, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. You turn your gaze to the MedTech. "I'm authorizing a second exam. Nothing invasive."

Later in the day, you receive a report from the MedTechs. Their second examination of {TGT_MW.Callsign} revealed no physiological basis for {TGT_MW.DET} pain.

You visit {TGT_MW.OBJ} in the barracks after {TGT_MW.SUBJ}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'re|Default:'s} discharged. "Feeling better, MechWarrior?"

{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} frowns. "It's strange. The painkillers did nothing, but the anti-anxiety meds made the pain vanish. I'll be checking in regularly with the MedTechs for counseling until we figure out what's going on."

{TGT_MW.Callsign} sticks to {TGT_MW.DET} word, not missing a day with the MedTechs. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} far less anxious when you next chat. There are no further incidents in the MedBay either.
column2:
“多小心一点总没坏处，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。”你把目光转向医疗技师。“我批准再做一次检查。不用做侵入性操作。”

当天晚些时候，你收到了医疗技师的报告。他们对 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 的第二次检查没有发现 {TGT_MW.DET} 疼痛有任何生理上的成因。

{TGT_MW.SUBJ}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'re|Default:'s} 出院后，你去营房看望了 {TGT_MW.OBJ}。“感觉好些了吗，机甲战士？”

{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} 皱起眉头。“很奇怪。止痛药一点用都没有，但抗焦虑的药却让疼痛消失了。在弄清到底怎么回事之前，我会定期找医疗技师做心理疏导。”

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 信守 {TGT_MW.DET} 的承诺，一次都没有缺席医疗技师的疏导。你下次和 {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} 聊天时，{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} 已经远没那么焦虑了。医疗舱里也再没出过事。

column1: As you're working out on a machine in the Argo's gym, a small group of MechWarriors clears equipment out of the way and starts setting up a makeshift basketball court. A ventilation seal ring apparently makes a fine hoop.\n\n[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] approach you. "Are you going to play this time, Commander? Two on two. You can be with [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]" The other MechWarriors cheer enthusiastically.
column2: 你正在阿戈号的健身房里练器械，一小群机甲战士把器材挪开，开始搭一个临时篮球场。一个通风密封圈看起来正好能当篮筐。\n\n[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 和 [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] 走过来。"这次你要上场吗，指挥官？二对二。你可以跟 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 一队。"其他机甲战士热情地欢呼。

column1:
I'm afraid not, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. Darius has a full schedule for me today. I'll need to take a rain check.

{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:look|Default:looks} disappointed, "No worries, Commander. Next time."

Later, after you've finished your workout, you pass by the game and catch the final few minutes. Seeing the caliber of play on display… it's a toss-up as to how the game would have turned out.
column2:
恐怕不行，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。达里乌斯今天给我排满了日程。我得改天了。

{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:look|Default:looks} 起来很失望，"没关系，指挥官。下次吧。"

后来，你完成训练后经过比赛场地，看了最后几分钟。看着场上展现出的水准……这场比赛本会是什么结果，还真说不准。

column1:
Your team loses the toss, which turns out to be an accurate omen for the rest of the game.

In the final play, you try to pass to [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] but [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] intercepts the ball, dishes to [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] under the hoop, who easily lays it up.

After politely shaking hands, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] turns to the crowd, "Looks like I'm better than the Commander!"

{SCN_MW.Callsign} groans. "Yeah, yeah. If only you moved half as gracefully in a 'Mech!" The MechWarriors continue hassling each other on the way to the showers.
column2:
你们队猜拳输了，结果这成了整场比赛的准确预兆。

最后一次进攻，你想把球传给 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]，但 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 断下了球，传给篮下的 [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]]，后者轻松上篮得分。

礼貌地握手之后，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 转向人群，"看来我比指挥官更强！"

{SCN_MW.Callsign} 呻吟一声。"行行行。你要是在机甲里动作能有一半这么灵活就好了！"机甲战士们一路互相挖苦着走向淋浴间。

column1:
I've heard enough. You gesture to the MedTech. "Get [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] ready for exploratory surgery ASAP."

When you visit {TGT_MW.OBJ} after surgery, {TGT_MW.Callsign} groans indistinctly and turns onto {TGT_MW.DET} side, closing {TGT_MW.DET} eyes. You motion to the MedTech, lowering your voice. "What happened?"

"The surgery failed to uncover any physiological basis for {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s abdominal pain. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'re|Default:'s} physically fit by all metrics, but an artery was nicked during the procedure and {TGT_MW.SUBJ} lost a lot of blood before we could stem the bleeding."

"Really?" You rub your brow.

The MedTech continues. "We're going to need to monitor {TGT_MW.OBJ} for a week and make sure there are no other complications."

{TGT_MW.Callsign} groans again, and {TGT_MW.DET} heart rate monitor starts beeping rapidly. The MedTechs politely suggest that it'd be best if you allowed {TGT_MW.Callsign} to rest uninterrupted.
column2:
我听够了。你朝医疗技师示意。"尽快让 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 做好探查手术的准备。"

手术后你去探望 {TGT_MW.OBJ}，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 含混地呻吟一声，转向 {TGT_MW.DET} 一侧，闭上 {TGT_MW.DET} 眼睛。你向医疗技师招了招手，压低声音。"出了什么事？"

"手术没能找到 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 腹痛的任何生理原因。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'re|Default:'s} 各项指标都显示身体健康，但手术过程中划破了一条动脉，{TGT_MW.SUBJ} 在我们止住出血前失血很多。"

"真的？"你揉了揉额头。

医疗技师继续说。"我们需要观察 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 一周，确保没有其他并发症。"

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 又呻吟了一声，{TGT_MW.DET} 心率监测仪开始急促地滴滴作响。医疗技师们礼貌地建议，最好让 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 不受打扰地休息。

column1:
You look [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] in the eye. "I believe you, but let's take this slowly. I'll make sure you get a low-dose pain reliever. If that doesn't help, then we'll keep trying until we find a treatment that works for you."

Later in the day, you receive an urgent message from Darius. {TGT_MW.Callsign} collapsed on the floor spasming in pain during daily training. The MedTechs operated immediately.

You rush back to the MedBay and visit {TGT_MW.OBJ} in a recovery room. {TGT_MW.DET_C} eyes flutter open and settle into a glare. You keep a respectful distance. "I'm sorry, {TGT_MW.Callsign}. I should have trusted your instincts." 

"And I should have ignored yours. They found a tumor the size of my fist hidden behind my kidney." {TGT_MW.Callsign} pushes {TGT_MW.OBJ}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:selves|Default:self} up. {TGT_MW.DET_C} heart rate monitor blips rapidly.

Before you can respond, a MedTech gently pulls you out of the room. "{TGT_MW.Callsign} is having an adverse reaction to {TGT_MW.DET} surgery. We had to sedate {TGT_MW.OBJ} earlier. We recommend that the XO keep an eye on {TGT_MW.OBJ} from now on."
column2:
你直视 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 的眼睛。"我相信你，但我们慢慢来。我会确保你拿到低剂量的止痛药。如果那不管用，我们就继续试，直到找到对你有效的疗法。"

当天晚些时候，你收到达里乌斯的紧急消息。{TGT_MW.Callsign} 在日常训练中倒地，痛得抽搐。医疗技师立即进行了手术。

你赶回医疗舱，在恢复室探望 {TGT_MW.OBJ}。{TGT_MW.DET_C} 眼睛颤动地睁开，凝固成一道怒视。你保持着礼貌的距离。"对不起，{TGT_MW.Callsign}。我本该相信你的直觉。"

"而我不该听你的。他们在我肾脏后面发现了一个拳头大的肿瘤。"{TGT_MW.Callsign} 撑起 {TGT_MW.OBJ}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:selves|Default:self}。{TGT_MW.DET_C} 心率监测仪急促地跳动。

你还没来得及回应，一名医疗技师轻轻把你拉出房间。"{TGT_MW.Callsign} 对 {TGT_MW.DET} 手术出现了不良反应。我们之前不得不给 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 用了镇静剂。我们建议今后由副官照看 {TGT_MW.OBJ}。"

column1:
You incline your head. "I'm not going to discount your feelings, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], but let's try some low-dose painkillers before we do anything more drastic."

Days later, {TGT_MW.Callsign} knocks on the door to your quarters. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:clear|Default:clears} {TGT_MW.DET} throat. "Sorry for the fuss earlier. That pain I was feeling went away before I even took the first painkiller. I think I was just stressed. Being listened to helped more than anything."

"Your pain was real. It just required a different treatment." You gesture to an open chair. "Take a load off. I know this is a rough job, but speaking openly about what you're going through can make a difference."

{TGT_MW.Callsign} sits down. "You know, I just kept thinking about a MechTech scraping me out of a cockpit. I thought a 'real' MechWarrior wouldn't worry about those concerns, so I bottled it up. Kept my mouth shut—but no more. Next time I'll ask for help."
column2:
你偏了偏头。"我不会否定你的感受，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]，但在采取更激烈的措施之前，我们先试试低剂量止痛药。"

几天后，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 敲响你舱室的门。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:clear|Default:clears} {TGT_MW.DET} 嗓子。"抱歉之前小题大做。那种疼痛在我吃下第一片止痛药之前就消失了。我想我只是压力太大。有人愿意听我说话，比什么都管用。"

"你的疼痛是真实的。只是需要另一种疗法。"你朝一张空椅子示意。"坐下歇会儿。我知道这份工作很艰难，但坦率地说出自己在经历什么，能带来改变。"

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 坐下。"你知道吗，我一直在想有个机修技师把我从驾驶舱里刮出来。我以为'真正的'机甲战士不会担心这些，所以我把它们憋在心里。一直没开口——但不会再有下次了。下次我会求助。"

column1: You know your body, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. You jab a finger at the MedTech. "Perform exploratory surgery immediately. I want answers." Hours later, you find {TGT_MW.Callsign} in the MedBay. "The MedTechs let me keep a souvenir. Turns out this thing was hiding behind my liver." Sitting up in bed, {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:hold|Default:holds} up a jar with a fist-sized lump of flesh floating inside. You examine it with a mix of curiosity and disgust. "That's no way to go out, MechWarrior." "Thanks to you, I'll live to fight another day. The MedTechs say I'm cleared for combat once the painkillers wear off." {TGT_MW.Callsign} smiles and then turns serious for a moment. "You saved my life. I won't forget that. I owe you, Commander."
column2: 你最了解自己的身体，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。你用手指戳了戳那名医疗技师。"立刻进行探查手术。我要答案。" 几小时后，你在医疗舱找到 {TGT_MW.Callsign}。"医疗技师让我留了个纪念品。原来这个东西一直藏在我的肝脏后面。"{TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:hold|Default:holds} 坐在床上，举起一个玻璃罐，里面漂浮着一块拳头大小的肉块。 你带着好奇与厌恶审视着它。"这可不是机甲战士该有的下场。" "多亏了你，我还能活下去再战一场。医疗技师说等止痛药效过去，我就可以获准参战了。"{TGT_MW.Callsign} 笑了笑，随后严肃了片刻。"你救了我的命。我不会忘记。我欠你一次，指挥官。"

column1:
Sumire frowns, while Darius confirms [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s quarantine. {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} soon joined by [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], and not long after that, [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] moves in.

This time, rumors are supplemented by the tales of those who were sick last time: the boils, the delirium, the prayers.

But the antivirals do their job, stemming the tide of the contagion amongst the rest of the crew. For these three MechWarriors, however, it's going to be a tedious and painful road to recovery.
column2:
苏米蕾皱起眉，达里乌斯确认了对 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 的隔离。{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} 身边很快多了 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]，没过多久，[[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] 也搬了进来。

这一次，传言之外还多了上次患病者的讲述：脓疮、谵妄、祈祷。

但抗病毒药物起了作用，止住了疫病在其他船员中的蔓延。然而对这三位机甲战士来说，康复之路将漫长而痛苦。

column1: While acknowledging the pent-up desire for violence, you still lay down the rules. "Go ahead. But if you get hurt, I'll finish killing you myself."\n\nAll but [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] suddenly recall pressing business elsewhere. {TGT_MW.Callsign} lingers, lost in thought. Then, with a grumble, {TGT_MW.Subj} finally {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:stomp|Default:stomps} off to join the others.
column2: 你虽然理解他们压抑的斗殴欲望，仍然立下了规矩。"去吧。但要是你受了伤，我就亲自把你打死。"\n\n除了 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]，其他人突然都想起了别处的急事。{TGT_MW.Callsign} 逗留着，若有所思。随后，{TGT_MW.Subj} 嘟囔了一声，终于 {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:stomp|Default:stomps} 走开，跟上了其他人。

column1: In response to the attitude, you lay down the law. "You're only allowed to bleed if it's in a 'Mech. Get back to work."\n\nAll but [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] suddenly recall pressing business elsewhere. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:linger|Default:lingers}, clearly torn. Finally, with a stiff nod and a twisted grin, {TGT_MW.Subj} resolutely {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:walk|Default:walks} off to join the others.
column2: 为了回应这种态度，你立下了规矩。"只准在机甲里流血。回去工作。"\n\n除了 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]，其他人突然都想起了别处的急事。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:linger|Default:lingers}，显然内心挣扎。最后，{TGT_MW.Subj} 僵硬地点了点头，嘴角一扭，决然地 {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:walk|Default:walks} 走开，跟上了其他人。

column1: You lay down the law. "You're only allowed to bleed if it's in a 'Mech. Get back to work." That evening, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] arrives at the shuttle, bloodied and battered. {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:try|Default:tries} to board the ship as if nothing's amiss, until Darius raises his voice. "Commander, I recall you giving explicit orders to our MechWarriors not to fight outside a 'Mech." You say, "How nice that somebody heard me." Darius smiles grimly."The MechWarriors did. But this isn't a MechWarrior. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} must be a member of the kitchen staff… for the next month or so, anyway."
column2: 你立下了规矩。"只准在机甲里流血。回去工作。" 那天晚上，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 浑身是血、伤痕累累地回到穿梭机旁。{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:try|Default:tries} 若无其事地登舰，直到达里乌斯提高嗓门。"指挥官，我记得您明确命令过我们的机甲战士不准在机甲外斗殴。" 你说："真不错，有人听进去了。" 达里乌斯冷冷一笑。"机甲战士们都听了。但这家伙不是机甲战士。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} 一定是厨房的人……至少接下来一个月是这样。"

But if you get hurt, I'll finish killing you myself."\n\nThat evening, just as the shuttle warms up its engines, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] arrives, bloodied and battered. When {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:try|Default:tries} to board the ship as if nothing's amiss, you say "I don't need more dead weight on the Argo. I need MechWarriors." Your words bring {TGT_MW.Obj} up short. "Next time you fight, you win. Remember that."
column2: 你虽然理解他们压抑的斗殴欲望，仍然立下了规矩。"去吧。但要是你受了伤，我就亲自把你打死。"\n\n那天晚上，就在穿梭机预热引擎时，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 浑身是血、伤痕累累地赶到。当 {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:try|Default:tries} 若无其事地登舰时，你说："阿戈号上不需要更多累赘。我需要的是机甲战士。"你的话让 {TGT_MW.Obj} 一下子愣住了。"下次打架，你要赢。记住这一点。"

column1: Learn anything useful in here? you ask. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] looks around the battered Argo, choosing {TGT_MW.DET} next words carefully. "Commander, this amazing ship has so much potential, but the fixed maintenance costs must be killing us." {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:launch|Default:launches} into a lengthy digression about saving expenses by putting 'Mechs into storage that are not regularly used for contracts. Finally you interrupt {TGT_MW.OBJ}. "Okay, I get it. Next time, though, maybe you could talk Darius' ear off." {TGT_MW.Callsign} laughs. "Maybe I will."
column2: 在这里学到什么有用的东西了吗？你问。 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 环顾这艘破旧的阿戈号，斟酌着 {TGT_MW.DET} 接下来的措辞。"指挥官，这艘了不起的船有这么多潜力，但固定的维护费用一定快把我们拖垮了。" {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:launch|Default:launches} 展开一大段离题的话，讲的是把不常用于合约的机甲封存起来以节省开支。 最后你打断了 {TGT_MW.OBJ}。"好吧，我懂了。不过下次，也许你可以去烦达里乌斯的耳朵。" {TGT_MW.Callsign} 笑了。"也许我会的。"

column1:
At the mining planet {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}, acquiring and sorting the plentiful supplies for Mech repairs is an all hands event.

While conferring with Darius, you overhear several MechWarriors discussing an unregulated fighting ring run by the local miners and machinists. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] says loudly, "Let's show these yokels how real warriors fight!"

Darius raises an eyebrow at you as if to say, "You got this?"

As you approach the MechWarriors, {TGT_MW.Callsign} sets {TGT_MW.Det} shoulders belligerently, as if daring you to forbid the entertainment.
column2:
在矿业行星 {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} 上，采购和分拣大量机甲维修补给是全船出动的大事。

与达里乌斯商谈时，你听到几名机甲战士在讨论当地矿工和机工经营的地下斗殴场。[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 大声说："让这些乡下人看看真正的战士怎么打！"

达里乌斯朝你挑了挑眉，仿佛在说："你来处理？"

当你走向那些机甲战士时，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 挑衅地挺起 {TGT_MW.Det} 肩膀，仿佛在激你禁止这项娱乐。

A lack of confrontation has clearly taken the shine off the idea, and after a moment {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:shuffle|Default:shuffles} off to join the others.
column2: 你虽然理解他们压抑的斗殴欲望，仍然立下了规矩。"去吧。但要是你受了伤，我就亲自把你打死。"\n\n除了 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]，其他人突然都想起了别处的急事。{TGT_MW.Callsign} 逗留着，若有所思。没有人来对峙，显然让这个主意失了光彩，片刻之后 {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:shuffle|Default:shuffles} 走开，跟上了其他人。

"\n\nAll but [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] suddenly recall pressing business elsewhere. {TGT_MW.Callsign} lingers, staring at you, fire in {TGT_MW.Det} eyes. column1: You watch the medical team clustered around [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] as they work to bandage the MechWarriors' wounds.\n\nDr. Murad taps you on the shoulder. "Commander, when I took those MedTech courses, the instructor was fascinated by the Argo. He gave me some ancient components in exchange for information on how they functioned. I've determined that they could dramatically speed up our treatment speeds, but they'll burn out after a couple weeks. Would you like me to activate them in this emergency?"
column2: 你看着医疗队围在 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 和 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 身边，为两位机甲战士包扎伤口。\n\n穆拉德博士轻拍你的肩膀。"指挥官，我当年上医疗技师课程时，教官对阿戈号十分着迷。他给了我一些古老的部件，换取我讲解它们的工作原理。我确定它们能大幅加快我们的治疗速度，但几周后就会烧毁。您要我在这次紧急情况下启用它们吗？"

column1: A weight lifts off your shoulders. "An excellent suggestion, Dr. Murad. We can't change the mistakes of the past, but we can certainly make the most of the opportunities of the present—and preserve the lives and careers of some good MechWarriors. So… get to work!"\n\nDr. Murad brushes past you to enter the MedBay, a small smile on her face. "You're welcome, Commander."
column2: 你肩上的重担落了地。"这个建议非常好，穆拉德博士。我们改变不了过去的错误，但完全可以善用当下的机会——保住一些优秀机甲战士的性命和前程。那么……动手吧！"\n\n穆拉德博士从你身边走过进了医疗舱，脸上带着一丝微笑。"不客气，指挥官。"

column1:
Sumire turns to you. "Commander, that Periphery seminar I took mentioned this system. It's famous for some ancient ruins on the primary planet. I've seen breathtaking pictures."

She's clearly leading up to something. "[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] have been moping around a lot lately, and it's starting to get on my nerves. Banishing them to these ruins for a week would give them something new to think about."

A smile flickers across her face. "Of course. I'd fly them down there, supervise them, and get them home on time, because I think those ruins will be even more amazing in person."
column2:
苏米蕾转向你。"指挥官，我上过的那个外围区研讨课提到过这个星系。它以主行星上的一些古代遗迹闻名。我见过照片，美得令人屏息。"

她显然在铺垫什么。"[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 和 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 最近一直闷闷不乐，已经让我有点受不了了。把他们'流放'到那些遗迹去一周，能给他们点新东西想想。"

一丝笑意掠过她的脸。"当然，我会送他们下去，监督他们，再按时把他们带回来，因为我觉得那些遗迹亲眼看到会更震撼。"

column1:
You respond to the attitude by breaking up the meeting. "MechWarriors have more important battles to fight. Get back to work—especially you, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]! Don't test me."

That evening, a group of miners visit the shuttle. A weathered beast of a man, clearly worried, speaks for them.

"Commander, your soldier {TGT_MW.Callsign} fought in our arena. {TGT_MW.Subj_C} didn't rightly understand the rules of the fight, and we didn't know until it was too late to put a stop to it." With a gesture from the craggy old man, the miners bring forward {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s bloody, battered corpse.

Darius barks commands intended to stop the other MechWarriors from doing anything rash, as you rest your hand on {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s head.
column2:
你用解散会议来回应这种态度。"机甲战士有更重要的仗要打。都回去工作——尤其是你，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]！别试探我。"

那天晚上，一群矿工来到穿梭机旁。一个饱经风霜、身形魁梧的男人替他们开口，明显神情忧虑。

"指挥官，你的士兵 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 在我们的斗技场里打了。{TGT_MW.Subj_C} 没弄明白比斗的规则，等我们知道时已经来不及阻止了。"随着那位皱纹深重的老人一个手势，矿工们抬上了 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 血迹斑斑、遍体鳞伤的尸体。

达里乌斯大声下令，阻止其他机甲战士轻举妄动，而你把手放在 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 的头上。

"Commander, I seem to recall that you disapproved of the local fighting ring." You say, "I'm glad someone heard me." Darius smiles grimly."Our MechWarriors did. But this isn't a MechWarrior. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} must be a member of the kitchen staff… for the next month or so, anyway."
column2: 你用解散会议来回应这种态度。"机甲战士有更重要的仗要打。都回去工作——尤其是你，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]！别试探我。" 那天晚上，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 浑身是血、伤痕累累地回到穿梭机旁。{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:try|Default:tries} 若无其事地登舰，直到达里乌斯提高嗓门。"指挥官，我记得您反对本地那个地下斗拳场。" 你说："我很高兴有人听进去了。" 达里乌斯冷冷一笑。"我们的机甲战士听进去了。但这家伙不是机甲战士。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} 一定是厨房的人……至少接下来一个月是这样。"

column1: Learn anything useful in here? you ask. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] eagerly and gingerly takes back the book. "I've been curious about LosTech all my life. Ever since I got aboard the Argo, I just can't get enough of reading these old books. I discovered this last month, on shore leave. Can't understand half of it, though, and I actually have some formal training to fall back on." You interrupt the rambling, "So the answer is… no." {TGT_MW.Callsign} laughs. "Not no, just not yet. But I do have some theories to share with the Chief when he has a few minutes."
column2: 在这里学到什么有用的东西了吗？你问。 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 急切而小心地拿回那本书。"我这一生都对外围科技好奇。自从上了阿戈号，我读这些旧书就怎么都读不够。这是我上个月休假时翻到的。不过有一半我看不懂，而我好歹还受过一些正规训练。" 你打断这番絮叨，"所以答案是……没有。" {TGT_MW.Callsign} 笑了。"不是没有，只是还没有。不过等主管有空的时候，我确实有些猜想可以跟他分享。"

column1: If we don't bypass the faulty interlock, we're looking at a 17% drop across the board! [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] is animated, practically shouting, and you try to remember how you got drawn into this argument. Apparently, with {TGT_MW.DET} technical background, {TGT_MW.Callsign} thinks {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:have|Default:has} identified a serious flaw in the Argo's secondary power interlock. For her part, Dr. Murad insists the interlock is working correctly. "We're lucky it's only 17%! That isn't the interlock. These systems have just missed several centuries' worth of annual maintenance. Your plan would potentially expose the entire central core to an overload." "Only if it doesn't work," {TGT_MW.Callsign} fires back.
column2: 如果我们不绕过那个故障联锁，整体输出会掉 17%！[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 情绪激动，几乎是在喊，你努力回想自己是怎么被卷进这场争论的。 看样子，凭借 {TGT_MW.DET} 的技术背景，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 认为 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:have|Default:has} 在阿戈号的次级电力联锁中发现了严重缺陷。 而穆拉德博士则坚持认为联锁装置工作正常。"只掉 17% 已经算走运了！问题不在联锁。这些系统只是错过了好几个世纪该做的年度维护。你的方案有可能让整个中央核心暴露在过载之下。" "前提是它不成功，" {TGT_MW.Callsign} 反唇相讥。

column1: I have to side with Dr. Murad on this, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], you say. "Don't take risks with the power system."\n\nIn victory, Dr. Murad is gracious. "We'll leave the interlock in place, but you can help me trace this power route. There's a snarl further up the line where I think we can make some efficiency gains." {TGT_MW.Callsign} nods, and the two of them continue their conversation as they head down the corridor.
column2: 在这件事上我得站在穆拉德博士这边，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]，你说。"别拿电力系统冒险。"\n\n获胜的穆拉德博士表现得很大度。"我们保留这个联锁装置，但你可以帮我追踪这条供电路线。线路更上方有一处纠结的地方，我认为可以在那里提升一些效率。" {TGT_MW.Callsign} 点了点头，两人一边沿走廊走去，一边继续交谈。

column1: You say, "Dr. Murad, can you run a small-scale test to find out what would happen?" She frowns at you, then says, "I suppose it's worth examining." She turns to [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] to develop a testing plan. Later in the day, Dr. Murad tells you {TGT_MW.Callsign} was both right and wrong. "The interlock really is causing a power drop, but there's no safe way to route around it. Add it to the growing pile of Argo issues we have no way to fix!"
column2: 你说："穆拉德博士，你能不能做个小规模测试，看看会发生什么？" 她皱起眉头看着你，然后说："我想值得查一查。"她转向 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 一起制定测试方案。 当天晚些时候，穆拉德博士告诉你，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 既对也错了。"联锁确实造成了电力损耗，但没有任何安全的绕行方式。把它加进阿戈号那一堆我们无力修复的问题里吧！"

column1: Sumire's eyes sparkle with ambition, while Darius makes arrangements for [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s quarantine to contribute to the development of a more robust treatment for Periphery Pox. Confident in the quality of the Argo's medical staff. the MechWarriors and crew remain positive throughout the crisis, especially when word spreads that {TGT_MW.Callsign} is on the mend. The MedTechs gather samples from the MechWarrior and begin creating cultures for further study in the coming months. It will be some time before a viable serum becomes available.
column2: 苏米蕾眼中闪动着雄心，而达里乌斯正在安排对 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 的隔离，以便为开发更有效的"外围痘"疗法提供帮助。 你对阿戈号医疗人员的水平很有信心。整个危机期间，机甲战士和船员都保持乐观，尤其当 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 正在康复的消息传开后。 医疗技师从那位机甲战士身上采集样本，开始培养菌株供未来数月进一步研究。要研制出可用的血清还需要相当一段时间。

column1:
Sumire frowns, while Darius confirms [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s quarantine. {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} soon joined by [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]].

This time, rumors are supplemented by the tales of those who were sick last time: the boils, the delirium, the prayers.

But the antivirals do their job, stemming the tide of the contagion amongst the rest of the crew. For these three MechWarriors, however, it's going to be a tedious, unpleasant road back to active duty.
column2:
苏米蕾皱起眉，达里乌斯确认了对 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 的隔离。{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} 身边很快多了 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]。

这一次，传言之外还多了上次患病者的讲述：脓疮、谵妄、祈祷。

但抗病毒药物起了作用，止住了疫病在其他船员中的蔓延。然而对这三位机甲战士来说，重返岗位之路将是漫长而不适的。

column1:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] is quarantined in one of the MedBays and soon [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] comes down with symptoms as well.

This time, rumors are supplemented by the tales of those who were sick last time: the boils, the delirium, the prayers. But the antivirals and the extra drugs that Sumire acquired immediately stem the worst of the symptoms, and the most fearful rumors quickly die down.

While these two MechWarriors will be out of commission for some time to come, the danger appears to be over.
column2:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 被隔离在其中一间医疗舱，不久 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 也出现了症状。

这一次，传言之外还多了上次患病者的讲述：脓疮、谵妄、祈祷。但抗病毒药物和苏米蕾立即采购的额外药品压住了最严重的症状，最骇人的传言也很快平息。

虽然这两位机甲战士还将有一段时间无法执行任务，但危险似乎已经过去。

column1:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] is quarantined in one of the MedBays and soon [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] comes down with symptoms as well.

This time, rumors are supplemented by the tales of those who were sick last time: the boils, the delirium, the prayers. But the antivirals and the extra drugs that Sumire acquired immediately stem the worst of the symptoms, and the most fearful rumors quickly die down.

Even better news comes with the prognosis that the two MechWarriors are expected to be back on duty within a couple of weeks.
column2:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 被隔离在其中一间医疗舱，不久 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 也出现了症状。

这一次，传言之外还多了上次患病者的讲述：脓疮、谵妄、祈祷。但抗病毒药物和苏米蕾立即采购的额外药品压住了最严重的症状，最骇人的传言也很快平息。

更好的消息随之而来：两位机甲战士预计将在两周内重返岗位。

column1:
You say, "Dr. Murad, can you run a small-scale test to find out what would happen?"

She frowns at you, then says, "I suppose it's worth examining." She turns to [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] to develop a testing plan.

A few hours later, the power goes out in the command center. When you find Dr. Murad, she's elbow-deep in a power conduit. "I can fix the damage {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s bright idea caused, but we're going to have to replace some parts. I will thank you to keep that MechWarrior away from critical systems in the future, Commander."
column2:
你说："穆拉德博士，你能不能做个小规模测试，看看会发生什么？"

她皱起眉头看着你，然后说："我想值得查一查。"她转向 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 一起制定测试方案。

几个小时后，指挥中心的电力断了。你找到穆拉德博士时，她正把手臂探在一条电力导管里。"{TGT_MW.Callsign} 那个馊主意造成的损坏我能修好，但有些部件必须更换。往后还请您让那位机甲战士远离关键系统，指挥官。"

column1:
Learn anything useful in here? you ask.

"I've been studying [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKerensky],Kerensky]]'s strategies during the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreOperationLiberation],Liberation of Terra]]," [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] says.

You nod. "That was a real meat grinder. But recall the guidelines about keeping the supply lines open. Best move along, MechWarrior."
column2:
在这里学到什么有用的东西了吗？你问。

"我一直在研究 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreKerensky],克伦斯基]] 在 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreOperationLiberation],地球解放之战]] 期间的策略，"[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 说。

你点点头。"那真是台绞肉机。但回想一下关于保持补给线畅通的准则。最好继续前进，机甲战士。"

column1:
Learn anything useful in here? you ask.

"I've been reading about [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreGeorgeSPatton],Patton]] back in the 20th century," [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] says.

You nod. "Tank warfare. That's good stuff, {TGT_MW.Callsign}, but it highlights the importance of clear travel routes. Best move along."
column2:
在这里学到什么有用的东西了吗？你问。

"我一直在读 20 世纪的 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreGeorgeSPatton],巴顿]]，"[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 说。

你点点头。"坦克战。那是好东西，{TGT_MW.Callsign}，但它也强调了畅通通行路线的重要性。最好继续前进。"

column1:
Spying a familiar chapter heading, you recite a line from [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreClausewitz],Carl von Clausewitz]]. "Only a fraction of booklearning will seep into practical life anyhow, and the more foolish the theory, the less of it."

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] laughs and takes back the book. "That's awesome, Commander! I was reading Clausewitz just now."

You nod. "I see you're paying attention. He also spoke of the 'fog of war', and right now you're blocking the line of sight in this corridor. Best move along, MechWarrior."
column2:
你瞥见一个熟悉的章节标题，便背诵起 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreClausewitz],卡尔·冯·克劳塞维茨]] 的一句话。"书本知识终究只有一小部分会渗入实际生活，而理论越愚蠢，渗入的就越少。"

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 笑了，拿回那本书。"太厉害了，指挥官！我刚才就在读克劳塞维茨。"

你点点头。"看得出你在用心。他还谈到过'战争迷雾'，而此刻你正挡着这条走廊的视线。最好继续前进，机甲战士。"

column1: You can't sit in the corridors, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. It blocks traffic. {TGT_MW.Callsign} looks up and down the empty corridor, but stops short of actually saying 'what traffic?' {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:get|Default:gets} to {TGT_MW.DET} feet before you can offer a suggestion of where to go. Later in the week, Yang requests, again, that the pilots stay out of the Mech Bay. "We can't repair a cockpit when there's someone sitting in it reading a book!" The Chief is not amused.
column2: 你不能坐在走廊里，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。这会妨碍通行。 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 环顾空无一人的走廊，但到底没说出口"什么通行？"。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:get|Default:gets} 在 {TGT_MW.DET} 双脚上站起身来，你还没来得及建议去哪儿。 那一周晚些时候，杨再次请求让机师别进机甲库。"有人坐在驾驶舱里看书的时候，我们没法修理驾驶舱！"主管一点也不觉得好笑。

column1: Rounding a corner in an unused corridor, you nearly trip over [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. The MechWarrior sits in a heap on the floor, nose-deep in a dog-eared, honest-to-goodness, paper book. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:look|Default:looks} up. "Oh, Commander, am I in your way? I needed to get out of the barracks. There's just no good place for me to read." You gesture at the book and {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:hand|Default:hands} it over. While you idly flip its pages, {TGT_MW.Callsign} asks, "I heard that there's a disrepaired library here in the Argo. Think we could get that online?"
column2: 在一条废弃走廊的拐角处，你差点被 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 绊倒。那位机甲战士瘫坐在地上，埋头读着一本卷了角的、货真价实的纸质书。 {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:look|Default:looks} 起头来。"哦，指挥官，我挡你的路了吗？我得离开营房。实在没地方能让我好好看书。" 你指了指那本书，{TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:hand|Default:hands} 把它递了过来。你随手翻着书页时，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 问道："我听说阿戈号上有个废弃的图书馆。你觉得我们能把它重新开放吗？"

column1:
You can't sit in the corridors, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. It blocks traffic.

{TGT_MW.Callsign} looks up and down the empty corridor, but stops short of actually saying 'what traffic?' {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:get|Default:gets} to {TGT_MW.DET} feet before you can offer a suggestion of where to go.

Later in the week, Darius takes you aside. "{TGT_MW.Callsign} has been in the mess hall at all hours, reading and eating. Pretty soon {TGT_MW.Subj} won't be fit enough for duty."
column2:
你不能坐在走廊里，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。这会妨碍通行。

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 环顾空无一人的走廊，但到底没说出口"什么通行？"。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:get|Default:gets} 在 {TGT_MW.DET} 双脚上站起身来，你还没来得及建议去哪儿。

那一周晚些时候，达里乌斯把你拉到一边。"{TGT_MW.Callsign} 整天泡在餐厅里，边看书边吃。再这样下去，{TGT_MW.Subj} 就达不到执行任务的标准了。"

column1:
You can't sit in the corridors, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. It blocks traffic.

{TGT_MW.Callsign} looks up and down the empty corridor, but stops short of actually saying 'what traffic?' {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:get|Default:gets} to {TGT_MW.DET} feet before you can offer a suggestion of where to go.

"I'll just head back to the barracks, Commander."
column2:
你不能坐在走廊里，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。这会妨碍通行。

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 环顾空无一人的走廊，但到底没说出口"什么通行？"。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:get|Default:gets} 在 {TGT_MW.DET} 双脚上站起身来，你还没来得及建议去哪儿。

"我还是回营房吧，指挥官。"

column1: Seeing your nod of concession, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] pulls out a recorder and begins capturing the performance. There's even an encore, so {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:get|Default:gets} the whole thing from the beginning. Back on the Argo, the video from the bar circulates quickly among the MechWarriors and crew. It's not surprising that there were disagreements with your decision at the time to help the embattled locals. But knowing that the company's actions have become folk song legend? Attitudes have completely turned around. The staff in the MedBay, in particular, have taken to singing The Hero of the Valley almost non-stop. MechWarriors in recovery have complained about it half-heartedly, but recovery time is certainly faster, perhaps to get away from the singing.
column2: 见你点头让步，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 掏出一台录音器，开始记录这场演出。甚至还加演了一场，所以 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:get|Default:gets} 从头听到了完整版本。 回到阿戈号上，酒吧里的录像很快在机甲战士和船员之间传开。 当初你决定去帮助那些陷入困境的当地人时，有人对此有异议，这并不奇怪。但得知公司的所作所为已经成了民间歌谣的传奇？众人的态度彻底转变了。 尤其是医疗舱的工作人员，几乎不停地唱起《山谷英雄》。康复中的机甲战士半心半意地抱怨过，但康复速度确实变快了——也许是为了躲开那歌声。

column1:
As the chords of the final verse fade away, and the applause dies down, you stand on your chair and raise your glass. "A toast!" The room responds with gusto.

"It's a delightful song to be sure, but I don't know that you truly captured the drama of the escape in the third verse. You see... I was there."

A patron close to your table, with a good look at the insignia on [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s jacket, stands and points at you. "It's {COMMANDER.Callsign}! It's really {COMMANDER.OBJ}!"

The rest of the afternoon involves the telling and retelling of the story, and many offers to buy the next round of drinks. By the time you pour yourselves into the shuttle bound for space, {TGT_MW.Callsign} is positively glowing from the adoration from the crowd. "Commander, we really made a difference. We gave hope to these people."
column2:
最后一段副歌的和弦渐渐消散，掌声也平息下来，你站到椅子上举起酒杯。“敬一杯！”房间里响起热烈的回应。

“这确实是首动听的歌，但我觉得第三段里你们并没有真正还原那次逃亡的戏剧性。要知道……我当时就在场。”

靠近你桌子的一位客人看清了 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 外套上的徽记，站起来指着你。“是 {COMMANDER.Callsign}！真的是 {COMMANDER.OBJ}！”

接下来的整个下午都在反复讲述这个故事，还有许多人争着请下一轮酒。等你们踉踉跄跄地爬上前去太空的穿梭机时，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 被众人的追捧捧得容光焕发。“指挥官，我们真的改变了些什么。我们给了这些人希望。”

column1:
You and Darius have finished networking for new contracts on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} and are walking through a farmer's market with [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], who is on shore leave.

A street preacher suddenly appears at your elbow. "Have you heard the good word of the Volkovites?" He presses a pamphlet into your hands. As he does so, you can't help but notice the watchful gaze of a patrol of soldiers wearing the livery of Liao.

The preacher studies the insignia on your gear. "You! You were there when the Capellan storm troopers descended on the great pilgrims. You are the saviours of the Prophet!"
column2:
你和达里乌斯在 {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} 上谈完了新合约的人脉往来，正和上岸休假的 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 一起逛一个农贸市场。

一个街头传教士突然出现在你手肘边。“您听说过沃尔科维特派的好消息吗？”他把一本小册子塞进你手里。就在他这么做的时候，你不禁注意到一队穿着廖氏家族制服、目光警惕的士兵。

传教士打量着你装备上的徽记。“您！当卡佩兰风暴兵扑向伟大的朝圣者时，您就在场。您就是先知的救主！”

column1: Seeing your nod of concession, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] pulls out a recorder and begins capturing the performance. There's even an encore, so {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:get|Default:gets} the whole thing from the beginning. Back on the Argo, the video from the bar circulates quickly among the MechWarriors and crew. It's not surprising that there were disagreements with your decision at the time to help the embattled locals. But knowing that the company's actions have become folk song legend? Attitudes have completely turned around. The technicians in the MechBay, in particular, have taken to singing The Hero of the Valley almost non-stop. Yang complains about it half-heartedly, but productivity is certainly higher!
column2: 见你点头让步，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 掏出一台录音器，开始记录这场演出。甚至还加演了一场，所以 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:get|Default:gets} 从头听到了完整版本。 回到阿戈号上，酒吧里的录像很快在机甲战士和船员之间传开。 当初你决定去帮助那些陷入困境的当地人时，有人对此有异议，这并不奇怪。但得知公司的所作所为已经成了民间歌谣的传奇？众人的态度彻底转变了。 尤其是机库里的技师们，几乎不停地唱起《山谷英雄》。杨半心半意地抱怨过，但生产效率确实更高了！

column1:
You and Darius have finished networking for new contracts on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} and find yourself in the tiniest dive bar in the port, along with [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], who is on shore leave.

Darius groans as a musician mounts the stage and begins to tune his guitar. {TGT_MW.Callsign} laughs. "Come on, give the guy a chance."

And so he begins...
column2:
{COMMANDER.Callsign}!

You stare daggers at [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. You breathe a word about this, and you'll be riding a Spider until the day you die. Which is likely on the first deployment."

{TGT_MW.Callsign} gulps audibly, but Darius can barely contain his mirth. Your XO pats you on the shoulder. "Come on, Commander, all PR is good PR. Maybe we can work this to our advantage."

Seeing the look on your face, he amends his statement. "Or not..."

The waitress, who was about to ask if you'd like another round, does a deft pirouette and continues her tour amongst the other tables.
column3:
你狠狠地瞪着 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。“你要是敢把这事说出去一个字，你就得一辈子开蜘蛛机甲。而这辈子大概会在第一次部署时就结束。”

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 咽了口唾沫，声音清晰可闻，但达里乌斯几乎憋不住笑。你的副指挥官拍拍你的肩膀：“得了吧，指挥官，哪怕是好宣传也是宣传。也许我们能把这变成优势。”

看到你的表情，他改了口。“……或者还是算了。”

正打算问你要不要再来一轮的女侍者灵巧地转身，继续去别的桌子招呼客人。

column1: You stare daggers at [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. "If you breathe a word about this, you'll be piloting a Spider until the day you die. Which is likely on the first deployment." {TGT_MW.Callsign} gulps audibly, but Darius can barely contain his mirth. Your XO pats you on the shoulder, "Come on, Commander, all PR is good PR. Maybe we can work this to our advantage." Later that week, moments before you arrive in the mess hall, you swear you hear the sounds of a guitar and one of the verses of The Hero of the Valley. But when you enter, everyone is eating in conspicuous silence.
column2: 你狠狠地瞪着 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。“你要是敢把这事说出去一个字，你就得一辈子开蜘蛛机甲。而这辈子大概会在第一次部署时就结束。” {TGT_MW.Callsign} 咽了口唾沫，声音清晰可闻，但达里乌斯几乎憋不住笑。你的副指挥官拍拍你的肩膀：“得了吧，指挥官，哪怕是好宣传也是宣传。也许我们能把这变成优势。” 那一周晚些时候，就在你走进食堂前的那一刻，你发誓自己听到了吉他的声音和《山谷英雄》里的某一段歌词。但你一进门，所有人都在一言不发地吃饭，气氛格外明显。

column1: Upon admitting your role in the escape of the Volkovites, the locals in the market soon surround you with thank-yous and questions about "the great escape". Darius and [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] soon have their hands full of gifts of fresh fruits and vegetables, as well as folksy arts and crafts. At the edge of the market, it's hard to miss a Liao soldier talking on a communicator, glancing in your direction. No doubt Lady Marina Liao will hear of this, and find it a twist of the dagger of your earlier betrayal. Darius says, "Commander, we made the right call. I think the crew back on the Argo will be encouraged," he gestures broadly at the crowd, "to hear that we've made a difference."
column2: 你一承认自己在沃尔科维特派逃亡事件中的角色，市场上的当地人很快就把你围了起来，连声道谢，还追问“那次大逃亡”的细节。 达里乌斯和 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 没多久手里就塞满了新鲜蔬果，还有充满乡土气息的手工艺品。 在市场边上，一名廖氏士兵正对着通讯器说话，不时朝你的方向瞥上一眼，这很难不注意到。毫无疑问，玛丽娜·廖女士会听说这件事，并把此当成你先前背叛她的又一把心头之刃。 达里乌斯说：“指挥官，我们做对了。我想阿戈号上的船员们会很受鼓舞，”他朝人群大范围地一挥手，“知道我们真的改变了些什么。”

column1:
Leaning back in your chair, you look up at the drunks nonchalantly. "Yeah, that was us. We even gave the murdering blowhard the one-on-one matchup he was asking for."

One of the fans groans loudly. "You should've dropped a full lance of 'Mechs on his head, after what he did to Arjun."

Her friend chimes in. "He didn't deserve a fighting chance, or an honorable death."

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] tenses in {TGT_MW.DET} chair, anticipating a brawl. The unruly fans aren't so drunk or stupid as to to fight hardened MechWarriors, though, and they grumble their way to the bar for another round.
column2:
你靠在椅背上，漫不经心地抬头看着那几个醉汉。“是啊，就是我们。我们还满足了那个满嘴大话的杀人犯想要的单挑对决。”

其中一个粉丝大声抱怨。“他对阿尔琼下了那种手，就该往他头上砸一整个小队的机甲。”

她的朋友接过话。“他不配得到公平较量的机会，也不配战死得体面。”

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 在 {TGT_MW.DET} 椅子上绷紧了身体，等着打起来。但这几个闹事的粉丝还没醉到、也没蠢到去和身经百战的机甲战士动手的地步，只好嘟囔着挪到吧台再要一轮。

column1: Leaning back in your chair, you look up at the drunks nonchalantly. "Yeah, that was us. We even gave the murdering blowhard the one-on-one matchup he was asking for." One of the fans starts shouting. "What do you even know? You killed The Beast just because he gave Arjun what he deserved?!?" Her friend steps forward, fist clenched. "The Steiners had been bad-mouthing The Beast for weeks. He couldn't let Arjun live after that!" [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] tenses in {TGT_MW.DET} chair, and when the third drunken fan steps too close, fists begin to fly. Later that afternoon, on the shuttle back to the Argo, {TGT_MW.Callsign} nurses {TGT_MW.Det} wounds. "We should do that again sometime, Commander!"
column2: 你靠在椅背上，漫不经心地抬头看着那几个醉汉。“是啊，就是我们。我们还满足了那个满嘴大话的杀人犯想要的单挑对决。” 其中一个粉丝叫了起来。“你懂什么？你们杀了野兽，就因为他对阿尔琼做了该做的事？！？” 她的朋友上前一步，攥紧拳头：“施泰纳人骂了野兽好几个星期。在那之后他不可能让阿尔琼活着！” [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 在 {TGT_MW.DET} 椅子上绷紧了身体，当第三个喝醉的粉丝靠得太近时，拳头就挥了起来。 当天下午，在回阿戈号的穿梭机上，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 处理着 {TGT_MW.Det} 的伤口。“下次有机会咱们再来一次，指挥官！”

column1:
Leaning back in your chair, you look up at the drunks nonchalantly. "No, you've got the wrong guys. We saw the same match you did on the Ironwood channel. Holovid quality so high, it was like you were there."

One of the fans chuffs loudly. "Yeah, I was half expecting those mercenaries to drop a full lance of 'Mechs on his head."

Her friend chimes in. "I'm glad they went with the straight up fight. The only way to win honorably. Can I buy you and your crew the next round?"

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] accepts the offer eagerly, and they spend the afternoon discussing numerous recent Solaris VII matches.
column2:
你靠在椅背上，漫不经心地抬头看着那几个醉汉。“不，你们认错人了。那场比赛我们和你们一样，是在铁木频道上看的。全息画质高得就像身临其境。”

其中一个粉丝大声哼了一声。“是啊，我有一半以为那帮佣兵会往他头上砸一整个小队的机甲。”

她的朋友接过话。“我很高兴他们选了堂堂正正打一场。那是唯一能赢得荣誉的方式。我能请你和你的船员们喝一轮吗？”

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 欣然接受，一行人花了一下午聊最近索拉里斯七号的各种比赛。

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 欣然接受，详细地给粉丝们重述了那场战斗。

column1: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] approaches the young soldiers, and has soon captivated them with heroic Mech stories from a fellow Capellan. Turning to the preacher, you admit your role in the escape of the Volkovites. The locals in the market surround you with thank-yous and questions about "the great escape". They also ply you and Darius with gifts of fresh fruits and vegetables, as well as folksy arts and crafts. It's all a bit overwhelming. Darius says, "Commander, we made the right call. I think the crew back on the Argo will be encouraged," he gestures broadly at the crowd, "to hear that we've made a difference."
column2: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 走近那群年轻士兵，很快就用一位卡佩兰同乡的英雄机甲故事把他们吸引住了。 你转向那位传教士，承认了自己在沃尔科维特派逃亡事件中的角色。市场上的当地人把你围了起来，连声道谢，还追问“那次大逃亡”的细节。 他们还把新鲜蔬果和充满乡土气息的手工艺品硬塞给你和达里乌斯。这一切都有点让人招架不住。 达里乌斯说：“指挥官，我们做对了。我想阿戈号上的船员们会很受鼓舞，”他朝人群大范围地一挥手，“知道我们真的改变了些什么。”

column1:
You approach the young soldiers and have soon captivated them with heroic Mech stories from a fellow Capellan.

Meanwhile, Darius admits the company's role in the escape of the Volkovites. The locals in the market surround him with thank-yous and questions about "the great escape".

They also ply Darius and [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] with gifts of fresh fruits and vegetables, as well as folksy arts and crafts. It's all a bit overwhelming.

When you regroup at the transport, Darius says, "Commander, we made the right call. I think the crew back on the Argo will be encouraged," he gestures broadly at the departing crowd, "to hear that we've made a difference."
column2:
你走近那群年轻士兵，很快就用一位卡佩兰同乡的英雄机甲故事把他们吸引住了。

与此同时，达里乌斯承认了公司在沃尔科维特派逃亡事件中的角色。市场上的当地人把他围了起来，连声道谢，还追问“那次大逃亡”的细节。

他们还把新鲜蔬果和充满乡土气息的手工艺品硬塞给达里乌斯和 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。这一切都有点让人招架不住。

你们在运输车旁重新会合时，达里乌斯说：“指挥官，我们做对了。我想阿戈号上的船员们会很受鼓舞，”他朝渐渐散去的人群大范围地一挥手，“知道我们真的改变了些什么。”

column1:
Turning to Darius, who is already deep in thought, you say, "What do you think? Perhaps your contacts in the Black Market could dig up the dirt we would need?"

The XO scowls but agrees. "He’ll certainly back off before he brings shame to his family or to the House. I'll get on it right away."

Later in the week, you receive a recorded message from [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRepKurita], Shugo Yamaguchi]] "Commander, I am contacting you regarding our little dispute, and how you have seen fit to involve the MRB. I have decided to concede all points in your favor."

With a thin-lipped look that seems a cross between anger and respect, he continues. "I did not expect such cunning from a mere Mercenary. We will, of course, never speak of this again."
column2:
你转向已经陷入沉思的达里乌斯，说：“你觉得呢？也许你在黑市的那些人脉能挖到我们需要的黑料？”

副指挥官皱起眉，但还是同意了。“在给家族或联合体丢脸之前，他肯定会收手。我这就去办。”

那一周晚些时候，你收到了 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRepKurita], Shugo Yamaguchi]] 发来的一段录音信息：“指挥官，我联系您，是为了我们之间那点小纠纷，以及您竟然把 MRB 牵扯进来这件事。我决定在所有问题上都向您让步。”

他抿紧嘴唇，神情介于愤怒与敬佩之间，继续说道：“我没料到一名区区的佣兵会有这样的手腕。当然，这件事我们今后不会再提。”

column1: You look over the information required, thumbing back and forth numerous times, before letting out a long sigh and closing the datapad. You hand the pad back to Darius, "Thanks Darius, but I do not think I need to be away from the company for 6-12 months. I'll look into it again at a later date." Darius takes the datapad, "As you wish, Commander. Wham-Ba-LAM will still bill us the cost of for the assessment. The LAMcademy also states the you must wait 90 days before you can reapply." Commander {COMMANDER.FirstName} {COMMANDER.LastName} is not eligible to reapply for 90 days
column2: 你把所需信息来回翻看了好几遍，最后长叹一声，关掉了数据板。 你把数据板递回给达里乌斯：“谢谢你，达里乌斯，但我觉得没必要离开公司 6-12 个月。以后有机会我再考虑这件事。” 达里乌斯接过数据板：“如您所愿，指挥官。Wham-Ba-LAM 仍会向我们收取评估费用。LAMcademy 还表示，您必须等 90 天之后才能重新申请。” 指挥官 {COMMANDER.FirstName} {COMMANDER.LastName} 在 90 天内不具备重新申请资格

column1: Tired of piloting a sluggishly slow grounded 'Mech while everything else hurtles past you? Well then, Wham-Ba-LAM has the perfect solution for you: [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreLAM],LAM]] Pilot Training. An appointment to Wham-Ba-LAM's LAMcademy Piloting School will reward you with the knowledge of the skills needed to pilot a LAM. This training course, supplemented by neurostimuli and training simulators, and taught by our very own Black Betty, can be yours for no more than ¢750,000. Your tuition fee covers all costs associated with your training including room and board for up to 6 months. Stop letting your lethargic 'Mech affect your performance on the battlefield! WARNING! Tuition costs ¢750,000 and the chosen pilot will not be available for up to 6 months. Applicant MUST have prior 'Mech experience. Slots are limited, so only ONE pilot may attend at a time. Our reps are not responsible if you do not have the funds to pay the tuition. Avoid buying until you have a proper bankroll. NOT ALL APPLICANTS WILL BE ACCEPTED! LAM Training is dangerous. Accidents do happen and Wham-Ba-LAM's LAMcademy Piloting School will not be held responsible for pilot injury or death.
column2: 厌倦了驾驶一台慢吞吞的落地机甲，却眼看其他一切从你身边呼啸而过？那么，Wham-Ba-LAM 为您提供了完美的解决方案：[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreLAM],LAM]] 机师培训。报名参加 Wham-Ba-LAM 的 LAMcademy 驾驶学校，您将学到驾驶 LAM 所需的全部技能知识。本培训课程辅以神经刺激与训练模拟器，由我们自家的 Black Betty 亲自授课，费用只需 ¢750,000。您的学费涵盖培训相关的一切开销，包括最长 6 个月的食宿。别再让您那迟钝的机甲影响您在战场上的表现了！ 警告！学费为 ¢750,000，所选机师将最长 6 个月无法到岗。申请人必须具有机甲驾驶经验。名额有限，一次只能有一名机师参加培训。若您资金不足以支付学费，我方代表概不负责。资金不足请勿购买。 并非所有申请者都会被录取！LAM 培训具有危险性。事故确有发生，Wham-Ba-LAM 的 LAMcademy 驾驶学校对机师伤亡概不负责。

column1: A knock sounds on your office door and you call out, "Come in..."\n\nThe door opens and Darius strides and hands you a datapad, "Commander, your aptitude test to attend Wham-Ba-LAM's LAMcademy [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreLAM],LAM]] piloting school has come back. Everything appears in order, you just need to fill out and sign that indemnity form on the screen, hit the submit button and you should get information on when you need to be at the LAMcademy."
column2: 办公室门上响起敲门声，你扬声说：“进来……”\n\n门开了，达里乌斯大步走进来，递上一块数据板：“指挥官，您报名 Wham-Ba-LAM 的 LAMcademy [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreLAM],LAM]] 驾驶学校的适性测试结果出来了。一切看起来都没问题，您只需在屏幕上填写并签署那份免责声明，点击提交，之后就会收到关于何时需要到 LAMcademy 报到的信息。”

column1: As the shuttle docks with the Argo, you wait impatiently for the techs to lower the disembarkation ramp. The moment it is safe, you leap from your seat and head onto the deck of the Argo. You see Darius waiting for you off to the side and head over towards him with a big smile on your face. As you approach, Darius pipes up, "I take it you passed, Commander?" You grin widely, "No, I'm just happy to see your ugly face," You slap Darius on the shoulder as you continue, "You bet your ass i did, Darius! Wow! What a blast that was! I never knew how exhilarating flying could be." Darius smiles and hands you a datapad, "Well, it appears that Wham Ba-LAM has offered to sell you one of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreLAM],LAMs]] that you flew your training in. The details are all there in this datafile they sent over. And good to have you back, Commander."
column2: 穿梭机与阿戈号对接时，你不耐烦地等着技师们放下舷梯。刚一安全放下，你就从座位上跳起来，踏上阿戈号的甲板。你看见达里乌斯在一边等你，便满脸笑容地朝他走去。 你走近时，达里乌斯开口道：“我猜您通过了，指挥官？” 你咧嘴一笑：“不，我只是很高兴见到你这张丑脸，”你拍着达里乌斯的肩膀继续说，“废话，当然通过了，达里乌斯！哇！那真是太爽了！我以前从不知道飞行能这么让人兴奋。” 达里乌斯笑着递给你一块数据板：“看来 Wham Ba-LAM 提出把您训练时驾驶过的其中一台 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreLAM],LAMs]] 卖给您。详细情况都在他们发来的这份数据文件里。还有，很高兴您回来，指挥官。”

column1: A knock sounds on your office door and you call out, "Come in..." The door opens and Darius strides in with a datapad, "Commander, the aptitude tests for candidates to attend Wham-Ba-LAM's LAMcademy [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreLAM],LAM]] piloting school have come back. There is one pilot who has completed the assessment and should meet the requirements: [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] You just need to select the pilot you wish to attend and sign the form on the screen and I'll take it from there."
column2: 办公室门上响起敲门声，你扬声说：“进来……” 门开了，达里乌斯拿着数据板大步走进来：“指挥官，报名 Wham-Ba-LAM 的 LAMcademy [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreLAM],LAM]] 驾驶学校的候选人适性测试结果出来了。有一名机师已完成评估，应该符合要求： [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 您只需选出想派去参加培训的机师，在屏幕上签署表格，剩下的交给我办。”

column1: You look over the name and record of the candidate. You thumb back through their file numerous times, before letting out a long sigh and close the datapad. You hand the pad back to Darius, "Thanks Darius, but I do not think that pilot meets our needs here. See if there are any other suitable candidates. We do not need to rush into this blindly." Darius takes the datapad, "As you wish, Commander. Wham-Ba-LAM will still bill us the cost of the assessment. The LAMcademy also states the applicant must wait 90 days before they can reapply should you change your mind later." The following pilot is not eligible again for 90 days: [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]
column2: 你看了看候选人的姓名和履历，把文件来回翻了好几遍，最后长叹一声，关掉了数据板。 你把数据板递回给达里乌斯：“谢谢你，达里乌斯，但我觉得这名机师不符合我们这里的需求。看看还有没有其他合适的人选。这件事不必急着草率决定。” 达里乌斯接过数据板：“如您所愿，指挥官。Wham-Ba-LAM 仍会向我们收取评估费用。LAMcademy 还表示，如果您以后改变主意，申请人必须等 90 天才能重新申请。” 以下机师在 90 天内不具备再次申请资格： [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]

column1:
Darius brings to the briefing an issue that has lingered on the back-burner ever since that ill-fated Contract to eliminate a defector from the Draconis Combine.

"The Mercenary Review Board has finally reviewed our claim of Non-Payment, and have invited us to a sit down with the House Kurita envoy, [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRepKurita],Shugo Yamaguchi]]." 

Sumire bristles in her chair. "Finally! I say we take our pound of flesh, and an extra pound for our troubles!"

Darius shakes his head. "I can't believe I'm suggesting walking away from C-Bills, but If we allow Yamaguchi to save face here, we could gain a significant boost in our reputation with Kurita."

Dr. Murad clears her throat and pauses, holding the room's attention. "Remember how the Shugo delegated the contract to his [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreGakuHironaka],underling]], so he could rush off to Herotitus? The notorious pleasure planet?" She pauses again before adding,  "Do you think we could get some leverage from that?"
column2:
达里乌斯在简报会上提出了一件从那次倒霉的合约起就一直搁置的问题——那次任务是去铲除一名从天龙联合体叛逃的人。

“佣兵审查委员会终于审完了我们的未付款申诉，并邀请我们与栗田家族的使节 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRepKurita],Shugo Yamaguchi]] 坐下来谈谈。”

苏米蕾在椅子上坐不住了。“终于！要我说，就该连本带利讨回来，再加一份给我们添麻烦的补偿！”

达里乌斯摇了摇头。“我简直不敢相信我会提出放弃到手的星币，但如果我们在这里让山口保住面子，我们在栗田那边的声望可能会大幅提升。”

穆拉德博士清了清嗓子，顿了顿，把全场的注意力都吸引过来。“还记得这位守护把合约丢给了他的 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreGakuHironaka],underling]]，好赶紧跑去赫罗提图斯吗？那个臭名昭著的享乐星球？”她又顿了一下，才补充道，“你们觉得我们能不能拿这件事做点文章？”

column1:
When you arrive with Darius at the local MRB offices, [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRepKurita], Shugo Yamaguchi]] is already there. He nods stiffly in your direction.

The Review Board agent walks everyone through the contract, including video footage and witness testimonies. When Darius hears the statement from [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreGakuHironaka],Chu-i Hironaka]] refuting claims regarding the quality of the intelligence provided, the discussion gets heated. Yamaguchi comes to the defense of his 'Mech Commander, and soon the MRB agent is forced to clear the room.

Finally, the MRB agent appears and delivers the ruling in the favor of the Draconis Combine. Yamaguchi turns on his heels and departs without another word.
column2:
你和达里乌斯来到当地 MRB 办事处时，[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreRepKurita], Shugo Yamaguchi]] 已经等在那里。他朝你的方向僵硬地点了点头。

审查委员会的专员向大家梳理了整份合约，包括录像资料和证人证词。当达里乌斯听到 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreGakuHironaka],Chu-i Hironaka]] 的证词否定了所提供情报的质量时，讨论变得激烈起来。山口为自己的机甲指挥官辩护，很快 MRB 专员不得不清场。

最后，MRB 专员现身，裁定支持天龙联合体。山口转身就走，一句话也没说。

column1:

The Review Board agent begins to walk everyone through the contract, including video footage and witness testimonies. Before any debate can begin, however, you interrupt. "Upon further review of the evidence, we wish to withdraw our complaint. Our apologies to the honorable representative of the Draconis Combine for any inconvenience we have caused." 

In the shocked silence that follows, you can hear the sound of Darius's teeth grinding together.

Back in the reception area, while the MRB finalizes the paperwork, the Shugo leans close enough that only the two of you can hear. "You are full of surprises, Commander. Keep an eye on your bank account for a small thank-you." Yamaguchi bows deeply and departs without another word.

随之而来的震惊沉默中，你能听见达里乌斯牙齿咬得咯咯响。

回到接待区，趁 MRB 完成文书工作，这位守护凑得足够近，只有你们两人能听见。“您真是充满惊喜，指挥官。请留意您的账户，会有一份小小的谢礼。”山口深鞠一躬，一句话也没说就走了。

column1:
Leaning back in your chair, you look up at the drunks nonchalantly. "No, you've got the wrong guys. We saw the same match you did on the Ironwood channel. Holovid quality so high, it was like you were there."

One of the fans groans loudly. "They should've dropped a full lance of 'Mechs on his head, after what he did to Arjun."

Her friend chimes in. "He didn't deserve a fighting chance, or an honorable death."

After they depart, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] stares glumly into {TGT_MW.DET} drink. "Come on, Commander. Wish we could've taken credit for punishing that murdering blowhard."
column2:
你靠在椅背上，漫不经心地抬头看着那几个醉汉。“不，你们认错人了。那场比赛我们和你们一样，是在铁木频道上看的。全息画质高得就像身临其境。”

其中一个粉丝大声抱怨。“他对阿尔琼下了那种手，就该往他头上砸一整个小队的机甲。”

她的朋友接过话。“他不配得到公平较量的机会，也不配战死得体面。”

他们走后，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 闷闷不乐地盯着 {TGT_MW.DET} 的酒杯。“得了吧，指挥官。真希望我们能认下这份功劳，是我们收拾了那个满嘴大话的杀人犯。”

column1: {SCN_MW.FirstName}... come with me. Such familiarity from {SCN_MW.DET} commanding officer brings {SCN_MW.OBJ} up short. {SCN_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:follow|Default:follows} you into the hall. "You clearly didn’t know that {TGT_MW.Callsign} took the battle with Gwydion company so personally. But you need to keep in mind just how small the Periphery can be. Every Noble House is represented on the Argo, and no small number of individual systems." {SCN_MW.Callsign} looks at {SCN_MW.DET} feet. "Yeah, I didn't think it through. But I guess every contract we take might be attacking someone's cousin. Well shit, I'll go talk to {TGT_MW.Callsign} and apologize."

column1: A comm's buzz wakes you. Darius has a message from the planet's surface. "You're not going to believe this, Commander. It's Ayasha Hadley." "Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}! So I just had to bring you this opportunity that could benefit us both." She continues as if you'd agreed. "You have a MechWarrior in your employ, goes by the callsign [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. {TGT_MW.Gender?Male:He's|Female:She's|NonBinary:They're} the spitting image of a certain Davion official who has access to a Mydron research facility I'd very much like to see the inside of." column1:
Ms. Hadley, after what you pulled the last time, you’re at the top of my list of people not to trust. Given my line of work, I hope you appreciate that.

The thief manages to pout and smile at the same time. "Oh, Commander, that's just because you don't know me yet. I'm very good to my friends."

Waving her hands to concede defeat, "Very well. Perhaps next time." At that, the signal cuts off before you can say another word.

Darius pops in, having clearly been listening to the call. "I'm not sure if I hate her or love her."
column2:
“哈德利女士，上次你搞的那一出之后，你稳居我最不信任名单的第一位。干我这一行，希望你能理解。”

这位女贼居然能同时噘嘴又微笑。“哦，指挥官，那只是因为你还不了解我。我对朋友可是好得很。”

她摆摆手认输，“好吧。也许下次再说。”话音刚落，信号就切断了，你还没来得及再开口。

达里乌斯探身进来，显然一直在听这通通话。“我都说不清自己是恨她还是喜欢她。”

"Commander, thanks for loaning me your MechWarrior. {TGT_MW.Gender?Male:He's|Female:She's|NonBinary:They're} a natural. I've already arranged shipment of the fruits of our labor." She shrugs innocently. "But I'm going to hang onto {TGT_MW.Callsign} a few weeks longer. I have some new leads I need to follow. And it's a two person job."

Later that week, you receive a coded message from Ms. Hadley. "I'm disappointed that you didn't want to play along, Commander. But it did speed my plans quite a bit, because of where Lady Cunningham decided to keep me prisoner. A temporary arrangement, of course." "Don't worry about your MechWarrior. I'll deliver {TGT_MW.OBJ} safe and sound, just like I promised, just as soon as I'm done with {TGT_MW.OBJ}."
column2: 亚历山德里娅·坎宁安夫人连声道谢，她的手下把阿亚莎·哈德利扣上镣铐，押上旁边的空投艇。 直到你回到阿戈号上，达里乌斯才问：“指挥官，你看到 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 上船了吗？”你胃里那种下坠感，也映在这位副官的脸上。 那周晚些时候，你收到哈德利女士的一条加密讯息。“指挥官，你不想配合，我很失望。不过这倒大大加快了我的计划，因为坎宁安夫人决定把我关在哪儿。当然，这只是暂时安排。” “别担心你的机甲战士。等我和 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 之间的事情办完，我就像承诺的那样，把 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 安安全全地送回来。”

They even deposit their reimbursement in full up-front.\n\nThe next day, as {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s shuttle departs, Darius thinks aloud, "You realize that we're probably not going to see {TGT_MW.OBJ} for a full month no matter what the family agreed to. We lose our leverage when that shuttle leaves."
column2: 只要准假，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 的家人对你的条件并不在意。他们甚至预先全额支付了补偿金。\n\n第二天，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 的穿梭机启程时，达里乌斯自言自语道：“你心里清楚，不管那家人答应了什么，我们大概整整一个月都见不到 {TGT_MW.OBJ}。穿梭机一走，我们手里的筹码就没了。”

It sounds like they have a few requests for special souvenirs to be slipped through customs.
