column1:
You rub your forehead for a moment. "We spent a lot of money getting the Low-G Pool fixed up, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. Why don't you knock this off and try stargazing from there?"

{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:lick|Default:licks} {TGT_MW.DET} lips as {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:consider|Default:considers} your proposal. "Uh, yeah. That's a good idea, Commander."

"Of course it is. I gave it to you." You narrow your eyes at {TGT_MW.OBJ}. "Now. I want you to tell Dr. Murad what you did to the airlock door. Offer whatever assistance she needs to close the security loophole you exploited. You do that, and you can spend as many off-hours as you like floating around in there. Deal?"

The next time you bump into {TGT_MW.Callsign}, your nostrils are assaulted by a concentrated blast of chlorine. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:snap|Default:snaps} to attention, offering you a crisp salute that's only slightly undercut by the wet towel draped across {TGT_MW.OBJ} shoulders. 

There are no further incident reports regarding the ventral airlock or any other.
column2:
你揉了揉额头。“修好低重力泳池可是花了不少钱，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。不如别再搞这些花样，去那儿看星星怎么样？”

{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:lick|Default:licks} 了舔{TGT_MW.DET}嘴唇，{TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:consider|Default:considers} 着你的提议。“呃，行。这主意不错，指挥官。”

“那当然。这是我想出来的。”你眯眼看着 {TGT_MW.OBJ}。“现在，我要你去告诉穆拉德博士，你对气闸门干了什么。她需要什么帮助来堵上你钻的那个安全漏洞，你就提供什么。办到这一点，你想在那儿漂多少空闲时间都随你。成交？”

下次你再撞见 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 时，一股浓烈的氯气味直冲你的鼻腔。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:snap|Default:snaps} 地立正敬礼，动作干脆利落，只是 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 肩上搭着的一条湿毛巾稍微削弱了这份气势。

此后，再没有关于腹部气闸或任何其他气闸的事故报告。

column1: While [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s family regrets your refusal, you detect in their reply a touch of pride that their heir is so valued by {TGT_MW.Det} employer.\n\n{TGT_MW.Callsign} also takes this as a gesture of appreciation, which takes the sting out of missing the family reunion.
column2: 虽然 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 的家人对你的拒绝感到遗憾，但你在他们的回信里察觉到一丝自豪——他们的继承人竟如此受 {TGT_MW.Det} 雇主看重。\n\n{TGT_MW.Callsign} 也把这视作一种赏识的表示，错过家族聚会也就没那么难受了。

column1: While [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s family regrets your refusal, you detect in their reply a touch of pride that their heir is so valued by {TGT_MW.Det} employer.\n\n{TGT_MW.Callsign} is, however, greatly disappointed to be missing the family reunion.
column2: 虽然 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 的家人对你的拒绝感到遗憾，但你在他们的回信里察觉到一丝自豪——他们的继承人竟如此受 {TGT_MW.Det} 雇主看重。\n\n不过，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 对错过家族聚会极为失望。

column1: Apparently, to [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s family, money is no object. They pay the higher fee without hesitation.\n\nThe next day, as the MechWarrior prepares to board the shuttle, a few other crew members arrive in the shuttle bay to see {TGT_MW.Obj} off. It sounds like they have a few requests for special souvenirs to be slipped through customs.
column2: 显然，对 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 的家人来说，钱不是问题。他们毫不犹豫地支付了更高的费用。\n\n第二天，就在这名机甲战士准备登上穿梭机时，几位其他船员来到穿梭机库为 {TGT_MW.Obj} 送行。听上去，他们提了几件想夹带过海关的特别纪念品。

column1:
You look over [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s work. "This is a temporary change, yes?"

{TGT_MW.Callsign} blinks and quickly nods. "Yes, Commander. You say the word, and I can have this back the way it was in… ninety minutes. One-twenty tops. Good as new."

You nod. "Good. Carry on. However, in the future, you will get sign-off before you start anything like this again. Are we clear?"

"Yes, Commander," {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:say|Default:says}.
column2:
你查看 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 的改造成果。“这是临时改动，对吧？”

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 眨眨眼，连忙点头。“是的，指挥官。你一声令下，我能在……九十分钟内恢复原样。最多一百二十分钟。跟新的一样。”

你点点头。“很好，继续。不过以后再做这类事之前，你必须先拿到批准。听明白了吗？”

“是，指挥官，”{TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:say|Default:says}。

column1: On your way to the Leopard's galley, you run into Sumire heading the same way. "Commander, it has been a long week. I know I can't make more hours in the day, but I can make more coffee!" When you enter the cramped galley, you find [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] in a tense stand-off in front of a nearly empty coffee pot. {TGT_MW.Callsign} sees you. "Commander, this is the last of the coffee! The XO says we won't have any more until the next supply run." {SCN_MW.Callsign} shoves {SCN_MW.DET} way forward. "I got here first, and {TGT_MW.SUBJ} almost stole it while I was looking for my favorite mug."
column2: 你前往豹式的厨房，路上遇到同样往那边走的苏米蕾。“指挥官，这周真是漫长得要命。我知道一天没法多出几个小时，但我能多煮些咖啡！” 你走进狭小的厨房，发现 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 和 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 正隔着一壶快见底的咖啡紧张对峙。 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 看见了你。“指挥官，这是最后一点咖啡了！副官说下次补给之前都不会再有。” {SCN_MW.Callsign} 把 {SCN_MW.DET} 身子往前一挤。“明明是我先到的，{TGT_MW.SUBJ} 趁我找我那只最爱的杯子的时候差点把它偷走。”

column1:
Exasperated, you squeeze your way past them into the galley and take two cups. Pouring the coffee equally into both, you say, "If you can't act like adults, we'll have to resolve this like you're children."

You hand one cup to [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and one to [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]. "Drink up. The next time I send you planet-side, I expect you to make every single shot."

After they leave, Sumire sighs as she stares at the empty pot. "That better have been worth it. Now excuse me while I go discuss shopping priorities with Darius."
column2:
你忍无可忍，从他们中间挤进厨房，拿了两个杯子。你把咖啡平均倒进两只杯子，说道：“要是你们不能像成年人一样行事，那我们就只能拿你们当小孩来处理了。”

你把一杯递给 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]，另一杯递给 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]。“喝完。下次我派你们下星球，我希望你们每一发都打中。”

他们走后，苏米蕾盯着空壶叹了口气。“最好是值得的。现在恕我失陪，我得去和达里乌斯谈谈采购优先级。”

column1:
You look [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] in the eye. "You know how the chain of command works. You have to clear changes like this before you start."

{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:shrug|Default:shrugs}. "Well? Can I?"

You look over {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s work. It's cleanly done, with no hazards. "Take a break until I make a decision."

During a chat with Darius, you compare the cost of the fines to the benefit for the MechWarriors and decide it's worth it.
column2:
你直视 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 的眼睛。“你清楚指挥链是怎么运转的。这种改动，你得先得到批准才能动手。”

{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:shrug|Default:shrugs}。“那……我到底行不行？”

你看了看 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 的成果。做得干净利落，没有隐患。“先歇着，等我做决定。”

在和达里乌斯的一次闲聊中，你把罚款的代价和机甲战士们的收益放在一起比较，认定这值得。

column1: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s family seems indifferent on the details of your requirements, as long as you allow the leave.\n\nThe next day, as {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s shuttle departs, Darius thinks aloud, "Y'know, it's probably gonna be way more than a month before we see {TGT_MW.OBJ} again, regardless of what the family agreed to. The wealthy do like to get their money's worth."
column2: 只要准假，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 的家人似乎并不在意你提出的条件细节。\n\n第二天，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 的穿梭机启程时，达里乌斯自言自语道：“你知道吧，不管那家人答应了什么，我们要再见到 {TGT_MW.OBJ}，恐怕得远远不止一个月。有钱人就爱让钱花得值。”

column1:
Banging noises draw you to the shared MechWarrior Barracks, where you find [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] disassembling one of the Leopard's internal walls. There are already several panels neatly stacked beside {TGT_MW.OBJ}.

{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:pause|Default:pauses}, then {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:explain|Default:explains}. "There's a few cubic meters of dead space back here. I'm making room so we can stretch without hitting the bunks."

As reasonable as this sounds, the banks aren't going to like you modifying their property.
column2:
敲打声把你引到共用的机甲战士营房，那里 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 正在拆豹式的一面内舱壁。{TGT_MW.OBJ} 身边已经整整齐齐地码着好几块板子。

{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:pause|Default:pauses}，随后 {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:explain|Default:explains}：“这后面有几立方米的闲置空间。我在腾地方，这样我们伸懒腰时就不会撞到床铺。”

这话听着再合理不过，可银行方面绝不会乐意你擅自改动他们的财产。

column1: You have to clear changes like this before you start, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. You know that we don't own this Leopard, right? "Well?" {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:look|Default:looks} at you expectantly. "Can I?" "No! We'll be fined more than your monthly paycheck. So unless you want the XO garnishing your wages for a year, you'll rebuild this wall." {TGT_MW.Callsign} tries to read your expression for a moment, and then sighs. "Alright, alright, Commander. Maybe someday we can get a ship with fewer strings attached."
column2: “这种改动你得先得到批准才能动手，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。你知道这艘豹式我们并不拥有，对吧？” “那……？”{TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:look|Default:looks} 满怀期待地看着你。“我能干吗？” “不行！罚款比你一个月工资还多。所以除非你想让副官扣你一整年的薪水，就把这面墙重新砌回去。” {TGT_MW.Callsign} 想从你脸上读出点什么，随后叹了口气。“好吧好吧，指挥官。也许哪天我们能弄到一艘少些牵绊的船。”

column1: You cock your head, regarding [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. "Tell you what, MechWarrior. You show Dr. Murad what you did to the airlock door and I'll let you off the hook. Hell, we can go out spacewalking together, one last time." After {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:agree|Default:agrees} to your terms, you suit up and meet in the airlock. The outer hatch opens and {TGT_MW.Callsign} glides into the twinkling darkness. Tethered, you follow {TGT_MW.OBJ}. Spinning slowly, {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s faceplate reflects a swirling nebula of blue and gold. {TGT_MW.DET} voice comes over internal comms. "Out here, you're just a tiny speck of sentient dust in an endless sea of stars. It's a relief, in a way, to be reminded of your own insignificance." You allow yourself to drift. "Sure, I get it. But the Argo isn't some existentialist thought experiment. On this ship, every decision you make has weight. A tiny slip-up can have disastrous consequences for the entire crew." "You're right. You know, I'm pretty fond of our corner of the universe," {TGT_MW.Callsign} says. "I won't put it in jeopardy again, Commander."
column2: 你歪着头打量 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。“这样吧，机甲战士。你去让穆拉德博士看看你对气闸门干了什么，我就放你一马。见鬼，我们还能一起出舱太空漫步，最后一次。” 等 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:agree|Default:agrees} 接受了你的条件，你穿上太空服，在气闸处会合。外舱门打开，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 滑进闪烁的黑暗里。系着安全索，你跟着 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 漂了出去。 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 缓缓旋转，面罩上映出一团蓝金色翻涌的星云。{TGT_MW.DET} 的声音从内部通讯里传来。“在这里，你不过是无尽星海中一粒有知觉的微尘。意识到自己有多渺小，某种程度上反倒让人释然。” 你任由自己漂着。“是啊，我明白。但阿戈号不是什么存在主义思想实验。在这艘船上，你做的每个决定都有分量。一个小小的失误，就可能给全体船员带来灾难性的后果。” “你说得对。你知道吗，我挺喜欢我们在这宇宙里的这一角的，”{TGT_MW.Callsign} 说。“我不会再让它陷入险境了，指挥官。”

column1: You sit down heavily in your chair. "All right. Thank you, Darius. I'll put together what I need to record a message for {TGT_MW.Det} next of kin. Perhaps something to say to the crew."\n\nAfter a few hours, Darius returns, a weak smile peeking through his tired face. "[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s vital signs have started to improve, Commander. {TGT_MW.Gender?Male:He's|Female:She's|NonBinary:They've} made it through this crisis. With luck there won't be another one."
column2: 你重重地坐进椅子里。“好吧。谢谢你，达里乌斯。我会准备好该说的，给 {TGT_MW.Det} 的直系亲属录一段讯息。也许还有几句要对船员们说的。”\n\n几个小时后，达里乌斯回来了，疲惫的脸上露出一丝勉强的笑。“指挥官，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 的生命体征开始好转了。{TGT_MW.Gender?Male:He's|Female:She's|NonBinary:They've} 挺过了这一关。运气好的话，不会再有下一次了。”

column1:
You clench a fist. "Thank you, Darius. I want to see {TGT_MW.Obj}, to say goodbye. {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:deserve|Default:deserves} that."

Darius accompanies you to the MedBay, where you take a seat beside the MechWarrior's bed and wait. After a few hours, other MechWarriors look in, sigh, and move on. An hour after that, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s shallow breathing deepens and {TGT_MW.Det} vital signs start to improve. Darius returns, summoned by a MedTech.

"You might as well rest now, Commander. {TGT_MW.Gender?Male:He's|Female:She's|NonBinary:They've} made it through this crisis. With luck there won't be another one."
column2:
你攥紧拳头。“谢谢你，达里乌斯。我想去见 {TGT_MW.Obj}，道个别。{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:deserve|Default:deserves} 这份尊重。”

达里乌斯陪你来到医疗舱，你在机甲战士的床边坐下等着。几个小时后，其他机甲战士探头进来，叹口气，又各自散去。又过了一个小时，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 微弱的呼吸变深了，{TGT_MW.Det} 的生命体征开始好转。一位医疗技师把达里乌斯叫了回来。

“指挥官，你现在不妨去休息吧。{TGT_MW.Gender?Male:He's|Female:She's|NonBinary:They've} 挺过了这一关。运气好的话，不会再有下一次了。”

column1:
You clench a fist. "Thank you, Darius. I want to see {TGT_MW.Obj}, to say goodbye. {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:deserve|Default:deserves} that."

Darius accompanies you to the MedBay, where you take a seat beside the MechWarrior's bed and wait. After a few hours, other MechWarriors look in, sigh, and move on. An hour after that, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s shallow breathing stops. Darius returns, summoned by a MedTech.

"You might as well rest now, Commander. You did what you could. When you wake, you can record the message for {TGT_MW.Det} next of kin."
column2:
你攥紧拳头。“谢谢你，达里乌斯。我想去见 {TGT_MW.Obj}，道个别。{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:deserve|Default:deserves} 这份尊重。”

达里乌斯陪你来到医疗舱，你在机甲战士的床边坐下等着。几个小时后，其他机甲战士探头进来，叹口气，又各自散去。又过了一个小时，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 微弱的呼吸停止了。一位医疗技师把达里乌斯叫了回来。

“指挥官，你现在不妨去休息吧。你已经尽力了。等你醒来，就可以给 {TGT_MW.Det} 的直系亲属录那段讯息了。”

column1:
You sit down heavily in your chair. "All right. Thank you, Darius. I'll put together what I need to record a message for {TGT_MW.Det} next of kin. Perhaps something to say to the crew."

Late the next afternoon, Darius arrives at your quarters with the bad news. "[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] has died. I'm sorry, Commander."

Looking down at the words you've written, they seem wholly inadequate. But you know that the MechWarriors will appreciate hearing something from their Commander. A reminder that the passing of a life will not go unnoticed.
column2:
你重重地坐进椅子里。“好吧。谢谢你，达里乌斯。我会准备好该说的，给 {TGT_MW.Det} 的直系亲属录一段讯息。也许还有几句要对船员们说的。”

第二天傍晚，达里乌斯带着坏消息来到你的舱室。“[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 去世了。我很抱歉，指挥官。”

低头看着你写下的那些话，它们显得那么苍白无力。但你知道，机甲战士们会想听到指挥官说点什么——一个提醒：一条生命的逝去不会被无视。

column1: Later that week, you visit the Training room and check the leaderboards. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s Lance has risen to the top of the standings.\n\nThe current match finishes and a grinning {TGT_MW.Callsign} exits from one pod and pounds on the adjacent pod. [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] emerges, laughing. Cheers and congratulations ripple through the entire room.
column2: 那周晚些时候，你去训练室查看排行榜。[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 所在的小队已经升到积分榜首位。\n\n当前这场比试结束，笑容满面的 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 从一个模拟舱出来，猛拍旁边的舱体。[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 大笑着走出来。欢呼与道贺声传遍整个训练室。

column1:
You study the MechWarrior. "I'll bet that you already know what to do."

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] hesitates. "Well, I have some ideas, but… I suppose I should step up as captain. All right. I'll bring this team together!"

Later that week, you visit the Training room and check the leaderboards. {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s Lance has risen in the standings.

{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:walk|Default:walks} up behind you. "Thanks for the advice. I wish I'd stepped up to my responsibilities earlier, we may have made it to the finals. Maybe next season."
column2:
你端详着这名机甲战士。“我敢打赌，你已经知道该怎么办了。”

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 犹豫了一下。“嗯，我有些想法，不过……我想我该站出来当队长了。好吧。我会把这支队伍带起来！”

那周晚些时候，你去训练室查看排行榜。{TGT_MW.Callsign} 所在的小队排名上升了。

{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:walk|Default:walks} 到你身后。“谢谢你的建议。我要是早点担起责任就好了，也许我们就进决赛了。下个赛季吧。”

A grinning {TGT_MW.Callsign} exits from one pod and pounds another, from which [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] emerges in triumph. Cheers and congratulations ripple through the entire room.
column2: 那周晚些时候，你去训练室查看排行榜。[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 所在的小队已经升到积分榜首位。\n\n当前这场比试结束。笑容满面的 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 从一个模拟舱出来，猛拍另一个舱体，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 得意地走出来。欢呼与道贺声传遍整个训练室。

column1:
That's bullshit, you snap at Darius. "I'm going over there. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] is too important to just write off like that."

"Commander…" begins Darius, before stopping himself. He follows you as you stalk over to the MedBay, where you yell at the MedTechs, yell at {TGT_MW.Callsign}, and generally clarify that death is not an option. The stressed MedTechs scurry around trying every risky solution they can think of.

A few hours after you arrive, {TGT_MW.Det} vital signs improve markedly. Just as exhausted as the MedBay staff, you allow Darius to shoo you off to rest. Another battle won.
column2:
“胡说八道，”你没好气地打断达里乌斯。“我这就过去。[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 太重要了，不能就这么放弃。”

“指挥官……”达里乌斯刚开口又咽了回去。你大步冲向医疗舱，他跟在后面。到了那儿，你冲医疗技师们吼，冲 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 吼，总之把“死亡不是选项”这件事讲得清清楚楚。压力山大的医疗技师们四处奔走，把能想到的冒险方案都试了个遍。

你到达几个小时后，{TGT_MW.Det} 的生命体征明显好转。你和医疗舱的工作人员一样筋疲力尽，任由达里乌斯把你赶去休息。又赢下一场战斗。

column1: You level your gaze at [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. "Here's the deal. You're going to tell Dr. Murad exactly what you did to that airlock door. In return, I'm going to let your behavior slide—but only this once. Mess up again, and we'll have a very different conversation." "Thank you, Commander." {TGT_MW.Callsign} nods eagerly. "You won't regret this, I promise." Two weeks later, you're jolted awake by the scream of klaxons. The comms buzz with the XO's voice. "We've got an oxygen leak. Sensors say that something's attacking the ventral airlock—from the outside." Cursing, you pull on your uniform. "Some people never learn, do they, Darius?" "Afraid not, and this time, the airlock's hatch isn't cooperating. Dr. Murad's got a team on it, they'll fix whatever's broken and bring {TGT_MW.Callsign} back inside. You want me to read {TGT_MW.OBJ} the riot act?" "Put the fear of god into {TGT_MW.OBJ}." You collapse back into your bunk. "And Darius? Tell {TGT_MW.OBJ} that if this ever happens again, we'll just let {TGT_MW.OBJ} stay out there. The Argo could use a new hood ornament."
column2: 你目光平和地注视着 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。“这么办。你去把对气闸门做的手脚如实告诉穆拉德博士。作为交换，这次我就不追究了——但仅此一次。再犯，我们的谈话就不会这么客气了。” “谢谢你，指挥官。”{TGT_MW.Callsign} 急切地点头。“我保证，你不会后悔的。” 两周后，一阵刺耳的警报把你惊醒。通讯里响起副官的声音。“我们氧气泄漏了。传感器显示有什么东西在攻击腹部气闸——从外面。” 你骂了一句，套上制服。“有些人就是永远学不会，是吧，达里乌斯？” “恐怕是的，而且这次，气闸的舱门不配合。穆拉德博士带了一队人在处理，他们会修好出问题的地方，把 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 弄回船里。你要我去狠狠训 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 一顿吗？” “让 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 知道什么叫敬畏。”你重新倒回床上。“还有，达里乌斯？告诉 {TGT_MW.OBJ}，要是再发生这种事，我们就干脆让 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 待在外面。阿戈号正好缺个新的车头装饰。”

column1:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], you know better. Tampering with an airlock door would get you thrown off of most ships, and as for the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreEVA],EVA]]…  You shake your head. "Look, I get it. Spacewalking can be a profound experience. But it can also kill you if you aren't careful."

{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:redden|Default:reddens}. "I know I was reckless. I was overwhelmed by nostalgia—I grew up in low gravity—we'd go out on 'star walks' nearly every day. That's no excuse though."

"Exactly. If you can't control yourself here, how am I supposed to trust you in a 'Mech?"

{TGT_MW.Callsign} meets your gaze. "I'll tell you how I did it. Every hatch on this ship is connected to an actuator. If you know where to look—it only takes about eight pounds of pressure to force it open. Cover the panelling with some spot welding and it'll be secure."

"You just bought yourself a break, MechWarrior. I'm giving you to Dr. Murad for a week. After this exploit has been patched, you'll return to active duty, but if this ever happens again… "

{TGT_MW.Callsign} shakes {TGT_MW.OBJ} head. "Don't worry. It won't."
column2:
“[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]，你本该更懂事。乱动气闸门，在大多数船上都够把你扔下船了，至于[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreEVA],EVA]]……”你摇摇头。“听着，我明白。太空行走可以是种深刻的体验。但要是不小心，它也能要你的命。”

{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:redden|Default:reddens} 脸红了。“我知道我太鲁莽了。我被怀旧情绪冲昏了头——我在低重力环境长大——我们几乎天天出去‘星间漫步’。但这不是借口。”

“说得好。你在这儿都管不住自己，我凭什么信任你坐进‘机甲’里？”

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 迎上你的目光。“我告诉你是怎么做到的。这艘船上每个舱门都连着驱动器。只要知道该看哪儿——大约八磅的推力就能把它强行顶开。用点焊把面板焊上就安全了。”

“你刚给自己争取到一个机会，机甲战士。我把你交给穆拉德博士一周。等你钻的这个漏洞补好，你就回到现役；但要是再发生这种事……”

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 冲 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 摇了摇头。“别担心。不会的。”

column1: You shake your head, regarding [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. "Of all the MechWarriors in this company, you should know better. Tampering with an airlock? Going on an unauthorized [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreEVA],EVA]]? It's like you're trying to get yourself killed." "And yet, here I am, alive and kicking." {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} fixes you with an irritated stare. "It's almost as if I know what I'm doing, Commander." Darius snaps. "Watch your tone, MechWarrior. Remember who you're talking to." {TGT_MW.Callsign} blinks, and all at once, {TGT_MW.OBJ} composure cracks. A wave of self-doubt washes over {TGT_MW.OBJ} face. "I'm sorry, Commander. That was out of line." "Damn right. I can't afford to remove you from active duty, but for the next month, you're gonna sleep in this box we're calling a brig." You pause and let the message sink in. "Now. If you show Dr. Murad exactly what you did to that airlock door, I might consider accepting that half-assed apology of yours. You wanna try your luck?" {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} swallows, hard. "I'll get right on it, Commander. This won't happen again."
column2: 你摇摇头，打量着 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。“这家公司里所有机甲战士当中，你最该懂这个道理。乱动气闸？未经许可就去搞[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreEVA],EVA]]？你简直像是存心送死。” “可我现在不还活蹦乱跳的。”{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} 恼怒地盯着你。“好像我真不知道自己在干什么似的，指挥官。” 达里乌斯厉声插话。“注意你的口气，机甲战士。记清楚你在跟谁说话。” {TGT_MW.Callsign} 眨了眨眼，一瞬间，{TGT_MW.OBJ} 的镇定裂开了。一阵自我怀疑掠过 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 的脸。“对不起，指挥官。我刚才过分了。” “算你识相。我没法把你从现役撤下来，但接下来一个月，你就睡在这个我们叫做禁闭室的箱子里。”你顿了顿，让这话沉下去。“现在。要是你能让穆拉德博士一字不差地看到你对那个气闸门做了什么，我或许会考虑接受你这份敷衍的道歉。想试试运气吗？” {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} 艰难地咽了口口水。“我这就去办，指挥官。不会再发生了。”

column1:
You're not wrong, Darius. But in the end, nobody got hurt. You fix your gaze on [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. "I'm willing to look past this, MechWarrior. But you're going to tell me how you opened that door, and from now on, you're going to appreciate the stars from a safe distance."

{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:nod|Default:nods} gratefully. "Absolutely, Commander. Thank you."

The next morning, before your first cup of coffee has even cooled, Sumire's voice echoes from the comms. "{TGT_MW.Callsign} won't leave the navigation room. Apparently, {TGT_MW.SUBJ} thinks that {TGT_MW.SUBJ} has your permission to spend all {TGT_MW.DET} downtime staring wistfully at the star map."

Darius rubs the bridge of his nose, frowning. "Miscommunication. I'll deal with it." He gives you a sidelong glance. "Hopefully, {TGT_MW.SUBJ} doesn't wind up back in the brig this time."
column2:
“你说得没错，达里乌斯。但说到底，没人受伤。”你把目光落在 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 身上。“这次我可以不计较，机甲战士。但你要告诉我你是怎么打开那扇门的；而且从现在起，你得在安全距离外欣赏星星。”

{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:nod|Default:nods} 感激地点了点头。“当然，指挥官。谢谢你。”

第二天早上，你的第一杯咖啡还没凉透，苏米蕾的声音就从通讯里传来。“{TGT_MW.Callsign} 赖在导航室不走了。看来 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} 以为你准许 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} 把 {TGT_MW.DET} 所有空闲时间都用来痴痴地盯着星图。”

达里乌斯皱着眉揉了揉鼻梁。“沟通有误。我来处理。”他斜看了你一眼。“但愿这次 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} 别再把自己弄进禁闭室。”

column1:
That's bullshit, you snap at Darius. "I'm going over there. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] is too important to just write off like that."

"Commander…" begins Darius, before stopping himself. He follows you as you stalk over to the MedBay, where you yell at the MedTechs, yell at {TGT_MW.Callsign}, and generally clarify that death is not an option. The stressed MedTechs scurry around trying every risky solution they can think of.

A few hours later, however, {TGT_MW.Det} vital signs continue to decline, and finally {TGT_MW.Det} shallow breathing stops.

Darius puts a hand on your shoulder. "You did what you could, Commander. Everyone did. You should get some rest now."
column2:
“胡说八道，”你没好气地打断达里乌斯。“我这就过去。[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 太重要了，不能就这么放弃。”

“指挥官……”达里乌斯刚开口又咽了回去。你大步冲向医疗舱，他跟在后面。到了那儿，你冲医疗技师们吼，冲 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 吼，总之把“死亡不是选项”这件事讲得清清楚楚。压力山大的医疗技师们四处奔走，把能想到的冒险方案都试了个遍。

然而几个小时后，{TGT_MW.Det} 的生命体征持续恶化，最终 {TGT_MW.Det} 微弱的呼吸停止了。

达里乌斯把手放在你肩上。“你已经尽力了，指挥官。所有人都尽力了。你现在该去休息了。”

column1:
That's bullshit, you snap at Darius. "We have every damn fancy machine in the Periphery in that Hospital Bay of ours. I refuse to accept that [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] will die."

"Commander…" begins Darius, before stopping himself. He follows you as you stalk over to the Hospital Bay, where you yell at the MedTechs, yell at {TGT_MW.Callsign}, and generally clarify that death is not an option. The stressed MedTechs scurry around trying every risky solution they can think of.

A few hours after you arrive, {TGT_MW.Det} vital signs improve markedly. Just as exhausted as the MedBay staff, you allow Darius to shoo you off to rest. Another battle won.
column2:
“胡说八道，”你没好气地打断达里乌斯。“我们那间医院舱里什么花哨机器没有，整个外围星域都找不出第二家。我不接受 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 就这么死掉。”

“指挥官……”达里乌斯刚开口又咽了回去。你大步冲向医院舱，他跟在后面。到了那儿，你冲医疗技师们吼，冲 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 吼，总之把“死亡不是选项”这件事讲得清清楚楚。压力山大的医疗技师们四处奔走，把能想到的冒险方案都试了个遍。

你到达几个小时后，{TGT_MW.Det} 的生命体征明显好转。你和医疗舱的工作人员一样筋疲力尽，任由达里乌斯把你赶去休息。又赢下一场战斗。

column1: Darius jabs a finger at [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], who sits sulking in a makeshift brig. "Yang caught this one sneaking through the Argo's ventral airlock last night. From the outside." {TGT_MW.Callsign} averts {TGT_MW.DET} gaze. "Apparently, {TGT_MW.SUBJ} managed to jimmy the door open without alerting anyone." The XO's lip curls into an angry frown. "How about it, MechWarrior? Care to explain why you took an unauthorized [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreEVA],EVA]]?" {TGT_MW.Callsign} sighs. "I just had to, Commander." {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:search|Default:searches} your face for a reaction. "It's so peaceful out there—floating free, just me and the stars. No explosions, no sweltering cockpit. Just calm and quiet." Darius shoots you a sidelong glance. "This little stunt could've gone wrong in a hundred different ways. Chuckles here is lucky {TGT_MW.SUBJ} didn't get anyone killed. How do you think we should handle it?"
column2: 达里乌斯伸手指着 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]——这位正闷坐在临时禁闭室里。“杨昨晚逮到这家伙从阿戈号的腹部气闸溜进来。从外面。” {TGT_MW.Callsign} 移开了 {TGT_MW.DET} 目光。 “看来 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} 不声不响地就把门撬开了。”副官气得嘴角一撇。“怎么样，机甲战士？要不要解释一下，你为什么未经许可就去搞[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreEVA],EVA]]？” {TGT_MW.Callsign} 叹了口气。“我实在忍不住，指挥官。”{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:search|Default:searches} 在你脸上寻找反应。“外面太宁静了——自由地漂着，只有我和星星。没有爆炸，没有闷热的驾驶舱。只有安宁与寂静。” 达里乌斯斜了你一眼。“这一出本来有一百种出事的可能。我们这位‘开心果’运气不错，{TGT_MW.SUBJ} 没害死任何人。你觉得我们该怎么处理？”

column1:
Make way, you say, pushing past the MechWarriors to get to the coffee pot. There's just enough coffee to fill your cup. You turn around and take a sip.

The coffee is terrible, but you're committed now. As they watch you, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] makes a face and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] heaves a sigh.

"Don't pout," you chastise. "If you bring back your 'Mech with all its limbs intact, we'll have plenty of C-Bills for more coffee. Now get to your bunks and get your heads in the game."

After they leave, Sumire stares forlornly at the empty pot. "Excuse me while I go discuss shopping priorities with Darius."
column2:
“让一让，”你说着从两名机甲战士中间挤过去拿咖啡壶。剩下的咖啡刚好够倒满你一杯。你转过身，喝了一口。

咖啡难喝极了，但你已经骑虎难下。他们看着你的时候，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 做了个鬼脸，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 重重叹了口气。

“别撇嘴，”你训道。“只要你们把‘机甲’四肢齐全地带回来，我们就有的是星币买更多咖啡。现在各自回铺位去，把心思放到正事上。”

他们走后，苏米蕾怅然盯着空壶。“恕我失陪，我得去和达里乌斯谈谈采购优先级。”

column1: When you live on a rock in Aurigan space, life is not exciting. Then, one day, a whole war over who is in control changed that. One day, he was driving a heavy dozer, clearing ground, the next he was driving a tank, clearing enemies. Being in the military after your side loses a war isn't much use though, so once the fighting was done, he put his talents up for sale. He barely remembers his civilian life any more, but he still holds the nickname "Dozer".\n\n
column2: 住在奥里根星域的一块石头上，日子并不精彩。后来有一天，一场争夺控制权的全面战争改变了这一切。前一天他还在开重型推土机平整土地，后一天就开着坦克扫清敌人。可站错队输了战争之后，当兵便没多大用处了，所以战事一结束，他就把自己的本事标价出售。平民生活他已经记不太清了，不过那个绰号他至今还留着——“推土机”。\n\n

column1: Farmboy started life on Karpathos, out in New Delphi Compact space. What more can be said - farm life gets old and people move on.\n\n
column2: “农家小子”的人生始于新德尔菲共同体星域深处的卡帕索斯。还能说什么呢——农场的日子总会让人厌倦，人总是要往前走的。\n\n

column1: A former Capellan armored recon officer, GeeGee is sharp-eyed, sharp-tongued, and twice as fast as her callsign suggests. She has a knack for threading light vehicles through impossible terrain, and a reputation for getting out of tight spots with style.\n\n
column2: GeeGee 曾是卡佩兰联盟的装甲侦察军官，眼光锐利，言辞犀利，行动速度是她的代号给人的印象的两倍。她擅长驾驶轻型车辆穿过看似无法通行的地形，也以能优雅地脱出险境而闻名。\n\n

column1: Some people say he is as much a machine as the vehicles he pilots.\n\n
column2: 有人说，他和他驾驶的车辆一样，都是机器。\n\n

column1: The Ferret 'Polecat' is armed with a Thumper Cannon, multiple ammo types and FCS Breaching Shot. The Ferret is an advanced 45 ton attack Hovertank, with 10/15 move. It has no turret, its weapons are Front mounted. Standard equipment on all models includes: 7.75 tons of Reactive Armor, Recon Sensors, CASE, Laser AMS, Guardian ECM + IFF Jammer Mk1, Beagle Probe, Advanced Optics Mk1 and the unique quirk 'Slippery Customer'. Owning this item allows you to select an alternate hovertank when using Cargo Vroom's unit deploy ability. Hold Shift while placing the unit after activating the deploy ability to select a unit from among those available.

column1: Big Tom is a grizzled veteran of the Free Worlds League militia, known more for his steady trigger finger than his tactful diplomacy. He's driven everything from hover tanks to heavy artillery haulers, and treats his crew like family. His loud, profane family. Rumor has it he once hotwired a Vedette during a live-fire exercise just to prove a point.\n\n
column2: 大汤姆是自由世界联盟民兵里一名饱经沧桑的老兵，比起圆滑的外交手腕，他那稳定的扣扳机手法更为人所知。从气垫坦克到重型火炮牵引车，他什么都开过，而且待自己的车组如同家人。他那些嗓门大、满嘴脏话的家人。据传，他曾在一场实弹演习中直接接线打火发动一辆 Vedette，只为证明一个道理。\n\n

column1: Jesse Link lost her job, her friends, and even her family... casualties of raiders in this degrading hellscape of a world. Back on her home planet, she was the ace in the hole for the Main Force Patrol. Now she, along with her dog, cruise the wastelands, out for justice... in the last of the V8 Interceptors.\n\n
column2: 杰西·林克失去了工作、朋友，甚至家人……他们都是这个日渐败坏的地狱般世界上劫掠者的牺牲品。在她的母星上，她曾是主力巡逻队的王牌底牌。如今，她带着她的狗，驾着最后一辆 V8 拦截者巡行荒野，只为寻求正义……\n\n

column1:
A knock sounds on your office door and you call out, "Come in..."

The door opens and Darius strides in, "Commander, I have good news, and bad news.  The good news is [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] passed their training and are now fully qualified to fly pretty much any LAM out there."

You smile, "That's great, now what's the bad news?"

Darius grimaces, "During the course of the flight tests, they suffered some injuries and will be out of action for some time.  We can speed up their recovery time if we allocate a medical team specificly to look after them."
column2:
办公室门上响起敲门声，你喊了一声：“进来……”

门开了，达里乌斯大步走进来。“指挥官，我有好消息，也有坏消息。好消息是 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 通过了训练，现在完全有资格驾驶几乎所有型号的 LAM。”

你笑了笑，“太好了，那坏消息呢？”

达里乌斯苦着脸，“在飞行测试过程中受了些伤，会有一段时间无法出战。如果我们专门拨一支医疗队照看，可以缩短康复时间。”

column1: Darius watches as the shuttle docks with the Argo. It's been a long haul with the Commander away at LAM training, so hopefully with their arrival back on board things can get back to normal. A MedTech disembarks the shuttle and heads over to Darius, "Are you Darius, XO of the Argo?" Darius nods, "Affirmative. How can I help you?" The MedTech shoves a datapad at Darius, "Sign here, please. He's all yours now." Darius looks down at the datapad and sees a release form for a wounded passenger being transported to the Argo: Commander {COMMANDER.FirstName} {COMMANDER.LastName}, wounded during LAM Flight Training; Current Status: Stable, "What the hell happened?" The MedTech shrugs, "Can't really say, sir. Scuttlebutt has it that your commander tried to outmanuever one of the other cadets in an attempt at top marks or something, and there was a mid-air collision. Pretty lucky to be alive if you ask me. In any event, I was instructed to get them safely here, and I have done that. Now it's up to you to nurse them back to full health." Darius signs the release form as a hover-gurney floats over with the Commander strapped in, obviously drugged to the max, Darius pulls a paper free that was clutched in their hand. Reading it, it would appear the Commander at least passed their training, just not in one piece. An Argo MedTech handling the hover-gurney speaks up, "Uh, sir... where shall I take the Commander?"
column2: 达里乌斯看着穿梭机与阿戈号对接。指挥官外出接受 LAM 训练已久，希望这次回到船上后，一切能恢复正常。 一位医疗技师走下穿梭机，来到达里乌斯面前：“请问你是达里乌斯，阿戈号的副官吗？” 达里乌斯点点头：“是的。有什么可以帮你的？” 医疗技师把一块数据板塞到达里乌斯手里：“请在这里签字。人现在交给你们了。” 达里乌斯低头看数据板，上面是一份送往阿戈号的伤员交接单：指挥官 {COMMANDER.FirstName} {COMMANDER.LastName}，在 LAM 飞行训练中受伤；当前状态：稳定。“到底出了什么事？” 医疗技师耸耸肩：“真说不好，长官。听小道消息说，你们的指挥官想要甩开另一名学员拿最高分之类的，结果发生了空中相撞。要我说，能活着就算走运了。总之，上头命令我把人安全送到这里，我已经送到了。接下来就看你们怎么把人养回满血了。” 达里乌斯签下交接单时，一张悬浮担架飘了过来，指挥官被绑在上面，显然被药物压得昏昏沉沉。达里乌斯从那只紧攥的手里抽出一张纸。读下来，看来指挥官至少是及格通过了训练，只不过不是完整地通过。 一名负责悬浮担架的阿戈号医疗技师开口道：“呃，长官……指挥官要送到哪儿？”

column1: A knock sounds on your office door and you call out, "Come in..." The door opens and Darius strides in with a datapad and a smile, "Commander, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] has returned and they passed their training with Flying colours!" The pun makes you smile, but not as much as the memory of a friend who would have turned green hearing it. Still smiling, you ask Darius, "Very good news indeed. What's on the datapad then?" Darius hands it over to you, "Well, because [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] did so well, Wham Ba-LAM has offered to sell us a [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreLAM],LAM]] that they did their training in. The details are all there."
column2: 办公室门上响起敲门声，你喊了一声：“进来……” 门开了，达里乌斯拿着一块数据板，笑容满面地大步走进来。“指挥官，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 回来了，而且是打着飞行一般漂亮的成绩通过了训练！” 这个双关让你忍不住笑，但更让你想起一位朋友——要是听到这句，他准会气得脸发绿。你仍带着笑问达里乌斯：“确实是大好消息。那数据板上写的是什么？” 达里乌斯把它递给你：“是这样，因为 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 表现这么出色，Wham Ba-LAM 提出把他们训练时用的那台 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreLAM],LAM]] 卖给我们。详情都在上面。”

column1:
A knock sounds on your office door and you call out, "Come in..."

The door opens and Darius strides in with a somber look on his face, "Commander, we were just unloading the cargo from one of our supply runs, and I noticed the coffin containing the body of [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] was on the manifest."

You slump back in your chair, "What?!?  No way... what happened?"

Darius sighs, "According to the attached holovid recording, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] attempted a radical maneuver to try and take out their assigned drone target.  Unfortunately, it ended up with their LAM slamming into a radio tower.  They died instantly.  How do you want to proceed?"
column2:
办公室门上响起敲门声，你喊了一声：“进来……”

门开了，达里乌斯大步走进来，面色阴沉。“指挥官，我们刚从一次补给航程卸货，我注意到清单上有一口棺材，里面是 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 的遗体。”

你瘫回椅子里。“什么？！？不可能……出了什么事？”

达里乌斯叹了口气：“根据附来的全息影像记录，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 想用一个极限机动干掉分配给自己的无人机目标。不幸的是，结果那台 LAM 一头撞上了无线电塔。当场死亡。你打算怎么处理？”

column1: Painless got her callsign because she won't stop, even when injured. She has been augmented with a bionic part every time she has been hurt.\n\n
column2: “无痛”之所以得到这个代号，是因为她即便受伤也绝不停下。每受一次伤，她身上就多一件仿生部件。\n\n

column1: Rafer is a driver. He's a very good driver. On his home planet, it is a custom to have to drive around for a year at a minimum of 50 miles an hour in a vehicle. If the speed ever drops below that, the vehicle explodes. This leaves Rafer with a lot of experience, a lot of regret. Lost hopes and dreams. Before the race, he rode around for fun. Now, even after leaving his planet and searching for his destiny among the stars, he must drive. Drive to survive.\n\n
column2: Rafer 是个机师。他非常擅长驾驶。在他的母星上有个习俗：必须驾驶车辆以不低于每小时 50 英里的速度绕行整整一年。只要速度掉到这条线以下，车辆就会爆炸。这让 Rafer 积累了丰富的经验，也留下了满地遗憾。失去的希望与梦想。比赛之前，他开车只是为了好玩。如今，即便已经离开母星、在群星间追寻自己的命运，他依然必须开车。开车，才能活下去。\n\n

column2: 一个看起来像个无赖的男人，却总是在帮人脱离困境。\n\n

column1:
Of the many Word of Blake operatives, few are as feared as Alicia "Lady Alekto" Sebrle. Born on the world of Sarna, the brash and outspoken Alicia often found herself at odds with Capellan authorities, while being carefully watched at the same time for having all the potential to make an excellent Maskirovka agent.

This was all put to an end with the Fourth Succession War. When Davion invaded her homeworld, the 23-year-old Alicia found herself pushed to the frontline as a member of a resistance cell defying the Federated Suns occupation. Here Alicia found herself rising though the ranks until she was the leader of the most active cell on the planet. While estimates vary, most historians estimate her activities as having claimed 1500 - 2900 occupying Davion lives.

After a particularly gruesome attack on a Davion regional headquarters, the FedSuns troops had had enough and began retaliatory strikes against the population. Fearing for the lives of her loved ones, Alicia used her contacts in the Maskirovka to arrange for them to be smuggled off-world so that she could continue her campaign against the FedSuns occupiers. Unfortunately for Alicia, one of the citizens killed by the Davion retaliation was a distant relative of the Chancellor himself. As such, the Maskirovka decided to avenge the Chancellor and to deal with a citizen they viewed as becoming too popular. So they betrayed Alicia, shooting down the DropShip carrying everyone Alicia had ever truly cared for and selling out the location of her cell's headquarters to a local Davion commander.

Davion jumped at the chance to deal with this thorn in their side once and for all and mercilessly bombed the entire village that housed her headquarters. Badly wounded, Alicia somehow survived the attack, dragging her ruined body several miles before collapsing near a remote, secret ComStar listening post. Found by a patrol, Alicia was smuggled off-world - the local ComStar Demi-Precentor seeing her potential as an operative for them. Despite the scars now covering her body, Alicia fully recovered thanks to cybernetic implants that were surgically embedded in her.

Filled with hatred for all the Successor Lords, it was of little surprise that Alicia - now going by the code name "Lady Alekto" - sided with the Word of Blake when the schism within ComStar occurred. When the Jihad broke out, Alekto soon made a terrifying name for herself. Unafraid to order even the largest scale war-crimes imaginable, Alekto brilliantly masterminded numerous devastating strikes against the Successor Lords over the years of the brutal war. In addition, it was found that she had a knack for designing BattleMech loadouts that, while appearing odd, turned out to be highly effective and virtual nightmares to face. Her personal 'Firebird' was so completely devastating that it was said to be able to ignite entire forests and overheat lances in a single pass.

Alekto's fate remains unknown, as she vanished in the chaos that was the aftermath of the Jihad. While some claim she is dead, she remains on virtually every state's most wanted list in the Inner Sphere, and some captured Blakists have stated that Alekto would one day return to bathe the Sphere in cleansing fire one last time.
column2:
在布莱克之言的众多特工中，很少有人像阿莉西亚·“阿莱克托女士”·塞布勒那样令人恐惧。阿莉西亚出生于萨尔纳世界，性格莽撞而直言不讳，常与卡佩兰当局发生冲突，同时又被当局密切监视，因为她具备成为一名出色马斯克罗夫卡特工的全部潜质。

这一切随着第四次继承战争而终结。当戴维恩入侵她的母星时，23 岁的阿莉西亚被推上前线，成为抵抗联邦太阳占领的抵抗组织成员。她在这里一路晋升，最终成为该行星上最活跃的抵抗小组的领袖。虽然估计数字各不相同，但多数历史学家认为她的行动造成 1500 至 2900 名戴维恩占领者丧生。

在对戴维恩一处地区指挥部发动了一次尤其惨烈的袭击后，联邦太阳部队忍无可忍，开始对平民实施报复性打击。阿莉西亚担心亲人的安危，便利用自己在马斯克罗夫卡的关系，安排把他们偷运出星球，以便自己能继续对抗联邦太阳占领军。对阿莉西亚来说不幸的是，戴维恩报复行动中丧生的平民里，有一位是卡佩兰大臣本人的远亲。于是马斯克罗夫卡决定为大臣复仇，同时处理掉这位他们眼中过于受欢迎的公民。他们出卖了阿莉西亚：击落了载着她所有真正在乎之人的空投艇，并把她的抵抗小组总部位置卖给了当地一名戴维恩指挥官。

戴维恩抓住机会，要一劳永逸地除掉这颗眼中钉，于是无情地轰炸了安置她总部的整个村庄。阿莉西亚身负重伤，却不知怎么活了下来，拖着一具残破的身躯爬了好几英里，最后在一处偏远而隐秘的通讯之星监听站附近倒下。一支巡逻队发现了她，把她偷运出星球——当地的通讯之星副主祭看中了她作为特工的潜质。尽管身上如今布满伤疤，阿莉西亚靠着外科植入的机械装置完全康复。

对所有继承国君主满怀仇恨，阿莉西亚——如今以“阿莱克托女士”为代号——在通讯之星内部发生分裂时站在布莱克之言一边，也就不足为奇了。圣战爆发后，阿莱克托很快为自己挣下了令人胆寒的名声。她毫不忌惮下令实施规模最大的战争罪行，在这场残酷战争的岁月里，她以出色的谋略策划了无数次对继承国君主的毁灭性打击。此外，人们还发现她擅长设计战斗机甲配置：看似怪异，实则极为有效，几乎是难以面对的梦魇。她的专属座驾“火鸟”破坏力之强，据说能在一次掠过中点燃整片森林、让整支小队过热。

阿莱克托的最终命运无人知晓，她消失于圣战之后的混乱之中。有人声称她已经死了，但她仍几乎出现在内天球各国的通缉名单上；一些被俘的布雷克信徒也曾表示，阿莱克托终有一天会回来，最后一次用净化之火洗礼整个天球。

column1:
Carl "Cargo Vroom" Vranich was born on Alpheratz in the Outworlds Alliance, and is often regarded as one of the most prolific vehicle designers to have ever lived.

Growing up in a rather spartan household typical of the Periphery, Cargo opted out of school in an early age with necessity forcing him to work as soon as he was able to help support his family. Initially Cargo learned the family trade as a run-of-the-mill vehicle mechanic, but it quickly became obvious that Cargo was meant for more as he showed a knack for not just fixing vehicles, but improving upon them.

By his 21st birthday, Cargo found himself drafted into the Alliance Borderers as a tank mechanic. There Cargo quickly rose through the ranks of the unit's engineering corps, proving not only hard-working but able to diagnose and and fix issues that even mechanics with 30 more years of experience with the same models could not.

By age 25, Cargo found himself the head mechanic of a detachment of the Borderers stationed on Cerberus, when fate struck in the form of a deep raid by DCMS troops. The Kuritan forces struck the base, scattered the battalion defenders, and began tearing through the hangars, destroying vehicle after vehicle. Provoked into rage from watching days of his hard work going up in smoke, Cargo grabbed a few of the nearest fellow mechanics by their shirts and shoved them into the tank closest to them. Taking charge, Cargo then proceeded to lead the completely green crew in fierce defensive action. Cargo and his makeshift crew not only held out while crucial reinforcements arrived, but also succeeded in crippling two 'Mechs and outright destroying one.

For his quick thinking and heroic efforts, Cargo was awarded some of the nation's most prestigious military service awards. When offered monetary awards however, he turned them down. Instead, he requested he be allowed to bring his beloved pet ferret with him to work, a request the rather stunned high command accepted.

For the next decade, Cargo served the Borderers in the dual roles of both head mechanic and tank commander in its command company before largely retiring from frontline service. This was at the behest of the Alliance high command, who had come to value his ever-increasing skill at designing vehicle variants that were both cheap to produce and extremely cost-effective.

Now heading a design bureau, Cargo has become one of these most despised people alive to many MechWarriors. So terrifying are the designs he has produced that many a MechWarrior has called them "bullshit" or decried that 'Mechs, not tanks, are supposed to be the kings of the battlefield. Perhaps it is not surprising then that when Cargo makes trips to the field for studies, he does so primarily amongst other tank crews.
column2:
卡尔·“货物轰鸣”·弗拉尼奇出生于外世界联盟的阿尔菲拉茨，常被视为有史以来最多产的车辆设计师之一。

他在典型的外围星域简朴家庭中长大，卡尔很早就退了学，迫于生计，一能干活力就出去挣钱补贴家用。起初他学的是家常手艺——维修车辆的普通修理工，但很快就能看出卡尔不止于此：他不仅会修车辆，还擅长改进车辆。

到 21 岁生日那年，卡尔被征入联盟边防军担任坦克修理工。他在部队工程兵中迅速晋升，不仅工作勤勉，还能诊断并修复那些同型号上干了三十年的老修理工都解决不了的问题。

25 岁时，卡尔已是驻扎在刻耳柏洛斯的边防军一支分遣队的首席修理工，这时命运以天龙联合体 DCMS 部队纵深突袭的形式降临。库瑞塔部队袭击了基地，击散了守备营，开始横扫机库，一辆接一辆地摧毁车辆。眼看自己数日的心血付之一炬，卡尔怒火中烧，一把揪住最近几名同事的衣领，把他们塞进最近的一辆坦克。他接过指挥，带着这支毫无经验的乘员组进行了激烈的防御战。卡尔和他临时凑起的车组不仅坚守到关键援军抵达，还成功瘫痪了两台机甲、彻底击毁一台。

由于他的机敏与英勇，卡尔获得了该国多项最负盛名的军事服务奖章。然而当奖项涉及金钱时，他拒绝了。他只请求能带着他心爱的宠物雪貂一起上班——震惊的高层居然同意了。

此后十年，卡尔在边防军中身兼首席修理工与指挥连坦克车长两职，之后基本退出一线。这是应联盟高层的要求——他们越来越看重他那日益精进的才能：设计既廉价又极具性价比的车辆改型。

如今，卡尔领导着一家设计局，成了许多机甲战士眼中世上最可恨的人之一。他设计的车辆可怕到许多机甲战士称之为“胡扯”，或声言战场之王本该是机甲而非坦克。也难怪卡尔去实地考察时，主要都待在其他坦克车组中间。

column1:
Lesser known than the mysterious "Bounty Hunter", but perhaps even more feared, is the enigmatic Jamie Rayson. Next to nothing is known about this elusive figure - including if he even exists.

What few details are consistent place him as originating from the Deep Periphery, somewhere past the Vela Sheet. References to him go back to at least the early Second Succession War and a few more cryptic ones as far back as the beginning of the Reunification War, which has lead to questions of whether he is real or if a series of MechWarriors have assumed the identity over the decades.

Either way, many acts have been attributed to this shadowy figure, most of them acts of mass destruction, war crimes or battlefields with no survivors where no enemy forces were known to be active. Needless to say, this has made Jamie a boogeyman amongst the armed forces of the Inner Sphere. Said to have been behind some of the Second Succession War's most barbaric incidents, it would appear that Jamie relishes the chaos and destruction he leaves in his wake.

The rare survivors who encounter him on the battlefield are generally left broken - and those who do speak of the experience tell of a heavy 'Mech of unknown make, adorned in all black with no unit markings present. Usually only spotted moments before the brunt of his assault, MechWarriors find their sensors and targeting computers failing or going blank just before weapons of fire scorch their 'Mechs until they shut down or suffer catastrophic engine failure or ammunition explosions. Then, just as quickly as it appeared, the 'Mech vanishes before their eyes, the air shimmering momentarily where it once stood.

Oddly enough, there seems to be a pattern to reported sightings of Jamie: Once spotted, many more sightings occur over the next couple of years, seemingly heralding periods of greater strife within the Sphere. Then, as the fires of war cool, the sightings simply stop - with no more occurring for at least the next decade.

Some of the strangest rumors and legends interweave Jamie's with sightings of the equally elusive "Mr. Bubbles", painting grand conspiracies - including attempts to burn worlds largely untouched by the devastation of the Succession Wars, such as New Avalon.
column2:
比神秘的“赏金猎人”名气稍小、或许却更令人畏惧的，是高深莫测的杰米·雷森。关于这个难以捉摸的身影，几乎无人知晓什么——甚至连他是否存在都不确定。

少数前后一致的细节表明他来自深远边境，在 Vela Sheet 之外的某处。关于他的记载至少可追溯到第二次继承战争初期，还有几条更为隐晦的提到统一战争之初，这让人们质疑：他究竟是真有其人，还是几十年来由一系列机甲战士轮流冒用这个身份。

无论如何，许多行径都被归到这个隐秘人物头上，其中大多是毁灭性破坏、战争罪行，或是无人生还、却并无已知敌军活动的战场。不言而喻，这让杰米成为内天球各武装力量口中的恐怖传说。据说第二次继承战争中最野蛮的几起事件都有他幕后操盘，看样子杰米颇为享受自己留下的混乱与毁灭。

少数在战场上遭遇过他并幸存的人，大多就此精神崩溃——那些愿意讲述经历的人说，那是一台型号不明、通体漆黑、没有任何部队标识的重型机甲。通常只在他猛攻到来前的一瞬才被发现，机甲战士们的传感器与瞄准计算机要么失灵要么一片空白，随即火焰武器灼烧他们的机甲，直到机甲停机，或是发动机灾难性损坏、弹药殉爆。然后，那台机甲就如同出现时一样迅速从他们眼前消失，原先所在的位置只剩空气短暂地颤抖。

奇怪的是，关于杰米的目击报告似乎存在某种规律：一旦有人目击，接下来几年就会冒出更多目击记录，仿佛预示着天球内部将进入更动荡的时期。而当战火冷却，目击便戛然而止——此后至少十年不再出现。

一些最离奇的传闻与传说把杰米和同样难以捉摸的“泡泡先生”扯在一起，编织出宏大的阴谋论——其中包括试图焚毁那些基本未受继承战争摧残的世界，比如新阿瓦隆。

column1:
I'll deal with it, you say. Later, you record a response.

In it, you sternly remind your lienholders that as financial institutions operating on Detroit III, they must abide by local contract law. You even cite the relevant sections of legal code from memory.

Then you point out that, as you've kept records of all payments and correspondence concerning the loans, you will be able to demonstrate in court that their proposed revisions to the agreed-upon terms would represent such a gross violation of the law that you would undoubtedly be awarded a second DropShip at the banks' expense.

Once the camera is off, Sumire says, "There's no way they push you on this. Too bad—I like to see loan sharks grovel."
column2:
“我来处理。”你说。之后你录了一段回复。

在回复里，你严厉地提醒那些留置权持有人：作为在底特律 III 上运营的金融机构，他们必须遵守当地的合约法。你甚至凭记忆引用了相关法条。

接着你指出，由于你保留了所有还款记录以及有关贷款的全部往来函件，你可以在法庭上证明：他们拟对既定条款做出的修改严重违法，你毫无疑问会赢得第二艘空投艇，且费用由银行承担。

镜头一关，苏米蕾就说：“他们绝不可能在这件事上跟你硬碰。可惜了——我就爱看放贷的恶棍跪地求饶。”

column1:
Chief, we're all trying to make things work in less than ideal conditions, I hate to say it, but you'll just need to tough it out for now.

Yang looks like he might argue the point further, but as he strokes his scraggly beard, he gets a thoughtful look in his eyes. "Maybe…"

Darius says, "If it helps, I'll just tell the MechWarriors not to get shot on the next contract. How about that?"

That gets a chuckle from the room, and you know the leadership team is going to get through this latest rough patch. For now.
column2:
“总工，我们都想在不理想的条件把事情办成。我不想这么说，但眼下你只能先硬撑过去。”

杨看上去还想再争两句，可当他捋着那撮稀稀拉拉的胡子时，眼里露出了若有所思的神色。“也许……”

达里乌斯说：“要是有用的话，我就去告诉机甲战士们，下个合约别挨枪子儿。怎么样？”

这话让屋里响起一阵轻笑，你知道管理层能熬过这段最新的难关。暂时而已。

But emotions get heated over the next week. [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] gets particularly upset when {SCN_MW.SUBJ} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:trip|Default:trips} over an unexpected box of tools.

Before long, Yang and his technicians reclaim their supplies. His mood, at least, is much better than everyone else's. When you arrive in the Mech Bay, he's grimly satisfied with the amount of reorganization he managed in the short period of time.

但一周下来，情绪开始升温。[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 尤其恼火——{SCN_MW.SUBJ} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:trip|Default:trips} 被一箱不知从哪儿冒出来的工具绊了一跤。

没多久，杨和他的技师们就把物资收了回去。至少他的心情比其他人好得多。你走进机甲库时，他对自己在这么短时间内完成的重新归置显得阴沉地满意。

column1:
You're on the Leopard's bridge with Sumire, Yang, and Darius for the daily staff briefing. Darius says, "We received three messages from the banks—"

"Loan sharks," Sumire cuts in.

"—From the people who are financing us," Darius continues. "They're considering rewriting the terms of our loans, so it will be easier to seize this ship if we miss a payment. As usual, they're only doing this because they believe we can't fight it in court."
column2:
你在豹式的舰桥上，和苏米蕾、杨、达里乌斯一起开每日的参谋简报会。达里乌斯说：“我们收到银行发来的三条消息——”

“是放贷的恶棍，”苏米蕾插嘴。

“——收到给我们提供融资的那些人的消息，”达里乌斯接着说。“他们在考虑改写我们的贷款条款，这样一旦我们错过一次还款，他们更容易把这艘船扣走。跟往常一样，他们敢这么干，只是因为他们认定我们没法在法庭上抗争。”

column1:
Of the many wonders the Star League created, perhaps one of the most underestimated was artificial intelligence. Of these, perhaps the most important and forgotten was the seminal work of Project Rain.

Spanning the better part of a decade, Project Rain laid the framework and rails for the many AI that would be created in the latter years of the Star League. The end result of the project was the creation of the AI known as RogueBot.

While proving to be somewhat unstable, RogueBot was leaps ahead of its contemporaries and soon found itself busy taking over many of the more mundane tasks required by the Star League's bloated bureaucracy. By some accounts, RogueBot handled as much as 45% the paperwork required to keep the massive government working. Although the SLDF attempted to train the AI for combat, they were never able to succeed in much more than  making it useful for commanding a BattleMech.

Ultimately, despite its success and the role it played in history, RogueBot was largely forgotten by historians. As progress marched forward, other AI programs surpassed the bot, its monolithic architecture proving unfit to be adapted to newer technology.

Eventually, under pressure to keep pace with more advanced AI, the Star League initiated a project under the SLDF to commission a new AI to regain its edge, and began to shut down RogueBot. While they were successful, there are some whispers that suggest that the AI realized its fate and created a copy of itself - one that was never found and remains somewhere in the wild to this day.
column2:
在星际联盟创造的众多奇迹中，最被低估的或许要数人工智能。而在这些之中，最重要又最被遗忘的，大概是“雨计划”那项开创性工作。

“雨计划”历时近十年，为星际联盟后期诞生的众多人工智能搭起了框架与轨道。计划的最终成果，就是名为 RogueBot 的人工智能。

RogueBot 虽然表现出一定程度的不稳定，却远超同时代的其他造物，很快便忙于接管星际联盟臃肿官僚体系所需的诸多日常事务。有说法称，维持这个庞大政府运转所需的文书工作，最多有 45% 由 RogueBot 处理。尽管 SLDF 曾试图训练这具人工智能用于作战，但除了让它胜任指挥一台战斗机甲之外，始终没能取得更大进展。

最终，尽管取得了成功、也在历史上扮演过角色，RogueBot 还是被历史学家基本遗忘。随着进步不断向前，其他人工智能程序超越了它；它那庞大单一的架构被证明无法适配更新的技术。

最后，在跟上更先进人工智能的压力下，星际联盟在 SLDF 下启动了一个项目，委托开发新的人工智能以重夺优势，并开始关停 RogueBot。他们成功了，但也有一些低语声称：这具人工智能早已意识到自己的结局，并复制了一份自己——那份副本从未被找到，至今仍潜伏在野外的某处。

column1:
As the Star League reached the pinnacle of its technological advancement, it became apparent that the artificial intelligence entrusted to help run the bloated bureaucracy was being outclassed and showing its age.

After a number of attempted upgrades failed to improve RogueBot, the Star League initiated Project Echo. The goal of the project was the creation of a next generation AI. While slow going, the project incorporated a number of unique innovations. Built on a modular and flexible design - in contrast to its predecessor - the new AI proved to be much more capable than the original. After several more years of development the new AI, now dubbed RogueBot II, was deemed ready to enter service with the Star League.

RogueBot II's initial deployment was not as smooth as many had hoped, but it nonetheless quickly took over the original RogueBot's responsibilities within the Star League, and the original was slated for decommissioning. RogueBot II's more modular design allowed for continuous improvements to be made to the AI at a relatively rapid rate, and it found itself pressed into an ever-growing number of roles within the government - primarily as a cost-saving measure.

Like the original RogueBot, the SLDF attempted to press the AI into military service, seeing drone combatants as the future. After some work, the AI proved a quick study with ground combat forces, and the army began reaching out to contractors to help design new BattleMechs and ground vehicles for mass deployment as drones. Naval combat proved trickier, but slow progress was still being made.

Ultimately, these plans were brought to an end with the Amaris Coup. While Amaris attempted to co-opt RogueBot, he found himself unable to do so, and the AI swiftly relocated its core servers to an unknown location and remained a persistent thorn in the usurper's side for the duration of his rule.After the war ended, RogueBot II evidently decided that the Star League was dead and resisted all efforts aimed at bringing it back under the control of the Star League or any of its member states.

Every now and again, some of the rare or prototype drone units the AI once commanded have been spotted raiding or defending various places throughout the Inner Sphere or the Periphery. The purpose of these deployments remains unknown, but it seems the AI has - even as the Successor Lords remained wholly unaware of their existence - been in occasional contact with the Clans over the centuries, notably having a strange relationship with the Star Adder Khan, Bearing. Some strange rumors even persist linking the fabled "Mr. Bubbles" to the rogue AI, with more than a few hinting at it having become her pet.
column2:
当星际联盟的技术发展达到顶峰时，很明显，那具受托协助运转臃肿官僚体系的人工智能已经相形见绌，显出老态。

在多次升级尝试都未能改进 RogueBot 之后，星际联盟启动了“回声计划”。该项目旨在打造下一代人工智能。进展虽然缓慢，却融入了多项独特的创新。与前代相比，新的人工智能采用模块化、灵活的设计，能力远超原版。又经过数年开发，这具如今被称为 RogueBot II 的新人工智能被认为已可交付星际联盟服役。

RogueBot II 的首次部署并不像许多人期望的那般顺利，但它仍在短时间内接管了原版 RogueBot 在星际联盟内的职责，原版则被列入退役计划。RogueBot II 更模块化的设计使其能够以相对较快的速度持续改进，它发现自己被推入政府内部越来越多的岗位——主要是作为节省成本的手段。

与原版 RogueBot 一样，SLDF 试图把这具人工智能投入军事用途，视无人机作战单位为未来。经过一番努力，这具人工智能在地面作战部队中上手极快，陆军开始联系承包商，帮助设计可大规模部署为无人机的新型战斗机甲与地面车辆。海战方面要棘手得多，但也在缓慢取得进展。

最终，这些计划随着阿玛里斯政变而终结。阿玛里斯试图拉拢 RogueBot，却发现自己办不到；这具人工智能迅速把核心服务器迁往未知地点，并在篡位者统治期间始终是他身边挥之不去的刺。战争结束后，RogueBot II 显然认定星际联盟已死，并抵制一切旨在让它重新回到星际联盟或其任何成员国控制之下的努力。

偶尔，有人在内天球或外围星域各处发现这具人工智能曾指挥过的稀有或原型无人机单位在袭击或防守某些地方。这些部署的目的至今不明，但看来这具人工智能——即便继承国君主们对其存在浑然不知——数百年来一直与氏族保持着偶发的接触，尤其是与星蝰蛇氏族的可汗 Bearing 有着某种奇特的关系。甚至还有些离奇的谣言，把传说中的“泡泡先生”与这具失控的人工智能联系在一起，不少人暗示它已成了她的宠物。
