column1: You've got a deal. You turn from [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] to the MedTech. "Take a sample of this so-called natural remedy and find out how it's working, if it is working." Later that day, a MedTech visits the Command Center with a report. "Upon second examination, we found that this substance {TGT_MW.Callsign} is using contains a natural analgesic and promotes tissue repair, but it also has traces of several illicit narcotics." You shake your head. "A narwhal speedball? No wonder {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} feeling so good." The MedTech's brow furrows. "Uh, yes. You could call it that. More importantly, the 'natural remedy' has been confiscated, so {TGT_MW.Callsign} doesn't harm {TGT_MW.OBJ}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:selves|Default:self}. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C}'ll remain in the MedBay until all side effects subside." "{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} won't be happy being cooped up in there, but it sure beats having {TGT_MW.OBJ} bouncing around the Argo hopped up on some black market drug cocktail."
column2: “成交。”你从 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 转向医疗技师。“取一份这种所谓天然疗法的样本，查清楚它到底怎么起效——如果真起效的话。” 当天晚些时候，一位医疗技师带着报告来到指挥中心。“经过二次检验，我们发现 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 使用的这种物质含有天然镇痛成分，还能促进组织修复，但其中也检出了数种违禁麻醉品的痕迹。” 你摇摇头。“独角鲸混合毒品？难怪 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} 感觉这么好。” 医疗技师皱起眉。“呃，是的。也可以这么说。更重要的是，那‘天然疗法’已经被没收了，免得 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 伤到 {TGT_MW.OBJ}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:selves|Default:self}。在所有副作用消退之前，{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} 会留在医疗舱里。” “{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} 被关在那儿肯定不痛快，但总比让 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 嗑着黑市毒品混合物在阿戈号上四处乱窜要好。”

column1: I can't argue with that x-ray, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. There's no need to keep you cooped up in here. I'll authorize your early release. A few days later, you run into {TGT_MW.Callsign}, jogging through the Argo's central corridor. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'re|Default:'s} trailed by a group of MechWarriors. "See, Commander? How could I miss this?" You look down the line at the red-faced MechWarriors, sweating and panting. One of the joggers groans in pain. "Are you sure you're feeling okay?" "Better than ever! We're only on mile nine of 26." {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:gulp|Default:gulps} from a bottle of milky liquid. "Is that your narwhal 'juice'?" You cock your head skeptically. "Try it!" {TGT_MW.Callsign} holds out the bottle, but you shake your head. "Worried about germs? No sweat. I've got five more cases of this stuff. I'll send some to your quarters. Consider it a thank-you for believing in me." Before you can reply, {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:rejoin|Default:rejoins} the crowd of runners.
column2: “有这张 X 光片，我没什么好争的，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。没必要再把你关在这里。我批准你提前出院。” 几天后，你遇到 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 正在阿戈号的中央走廊里慢跑。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'re|Default:'s} 身后跟着一群机甲战士。“看见没，指挥官？我怎么可能错过这个？” 你顺着队伍看去，那些机甲战士满脸通红、汗流浃背、气喘吁吁。有个跑步的人痛得哼哼。“你确定自己感觉还好？” “比任何时候都好！我们才跑到 26 英里里的第 9 英里。”{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:gulp|Default:gulps} 地从瓶子里灌了一大口乳白色液体。 “那就是你的独角鲸‘果汁’？”你怀疑地歪着头。 “尝尝！”{TGT_MW.Callsign} 把瓶子递过来，但你摇了摇头。“怕有细菌？没事。这玩意儿我还有五箱。我送几瓶到你舱室。就当是谢谢你相信我。”你还没来得及回答，{TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:rejoin|Default:rejoins} 已经跑回了跑步的人群里。

column1:
The x-ray is all the proof I need, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. I'll authorize your early release, but be careful. They don't exactly make spare parts for MechWarriors.

{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:pump|Default:pumps} a fist triumphantly. "Loud and clear, Commander!"

Later, you return to the MedBay after receiving an urgent message that {TGT_MW.Callsign} had an accident in the mess. When you arrive, {TGT_MW.DET} arm is in a full cast. You sigh. "After everything we talked about, what happened?"

{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:look|Default:looks} up. "The truth is just… embarrassing. I took more of the supplement to speed up recovery."

You nod your head slowly. "I hope you learned your lesson."

"Yeah, it was a disaster. I hallucinated… not in the fun way, either. A mess table sprouted fangs and claws. It started growling at me. So, I… uh, tackled it. Don't worry, the rest of that narwhal junk is already gone. I'm done with it. Next time, I'll stick to protocol." {TGT_MW.Callsign} salutes.
column2:
“这张 X 光片就是我要的全部证据，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。我批准你提前出院，但小心点。机甲战士可没有备用零件。”

{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:pump|Default:pumps} 地挥拳庆祝。“明白得很，指挥官！”

后来，你收到 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 在食堂出了事故的紧急消息，赶回医疗舱。你到时，{TGT_MW.DET} 胳膊打着整条石膏。你叹了口气。“我们谈过那么多，这又是怎么回事？”

{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:look|Default:looks} 起头。“真相实在……太难为情了。我为了加快恢复，多吃了些那个补剂。”

你缓缓点头。“希望你已经吸取教训了。”

“是啊，简直是场灾难。我产生了幻觉……而且还是不好受的那种。食堂的桌子长出了獠牙和爪子，冲我低吼。于是我……呃，扑了上去。别担心，剩下的独角鲸垃圾都已经处理掉了。我跟它没关系了。下次我一定守规矩。”{TGT_MW.Callsign} 敬了个礼。

column1:
Your results are promising. Who knows, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], maybe we need to stock the MedBay with this narwhal dust. You shrug, turning to the MedTech. "Analyze this powder and report back."

Hour later, you receive an illuminating report from the MedTech. You summarize for {TGT_MW.Callsign}. "Let's start with the bad news. Your 'natural remedy' is a mix of baking soda and granulated sugar. Any supposed benefit is purely a placebo effect."

"…Baking soda?" {TGT_MW.DET_C} face squeezes into a grimace.

You nod, continuing. "The good news is that you're being discharged. Apparently, the hairline fracture is fairly minor." You lower the report. "How much did you pay for this junk, anyway?"

{TGT_MW.Callsign} groans. "Too much… I didn't know if I'd ever find this stuff again. I bought 15 cases!"

"Look on the bright side, MechWarrior. The kitchen crew can bake a few hundred cakes with your confectionary supplies." You grin, but {TGT_MW.Callsign} sinks deeper into {TGT_MW.DET} bed.
column2:
“你的检验结果很有希望。谁知道呢，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]，也许我们该给医疗舱备点这种独角鲸粉末。”你耸耸肩，转向医疗技师。“分析一下这份粉末，结果报给我。”

一小时后，你收到医疗技师一份很有启发的报告。你向 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 做了总结。“先说坏消息。你那份‘天然疗法’是小苏打和砂糖的混合物。所谓的好处纯粹是安慰剂效应。”

“……小苏打？”{TGT_MW.DET_C} 脸皱成一团。

你点点头，继续说：“好消息是，你可以出院了。看来那道骨裂相当轻微。”你放下报告。“对了，你为这堆垃圾花了多少钱？”

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 呻吟了一声。“太多了……我当时不知道自己还能不能再找到这玩意儿。我买了 15 箱！”

“往好处想，机甲战士。厨房的人用你这些糖果原料能烤出几百个蛋糕。”你咧嘴一笑，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 却往 {TGT_MW.DET} 床里陷得更深了。

column1: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] hops off {TGT_MW.DET} bed as you enter the MedBay. "Commander, it's a miracle! I'm good as new thanks to a little-known natural remedy. Got it for a steal on shore leave." A MedTech pulls up an x-ray on a viewscreen. "I hate to admit this, but somehow {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s hairline fracture has regenerated in record time. It's perplexing." "I think you mean amazing. Don't worry, Commander—it's a completely natural supplement. The restorative power is derived from the horn of a Stratford narwhal and refined into a powder. It's pretty tasty in coffee." The MedTech's eyes widen with alarm. "It would be best if we continued to monitor {TGT_MW.Callsign}. Even though {TGT_MW.DET} fracture has healed, there's no telling what sort of unexpected side effects might be caused by this unapproved treatment." "Oh, come on," {TGT_MW.Callsign} grumbles. "It's my week to lead the daily exercises! I don't want to miss that. I've got a killer routine planned. What if the MedTechs analyze this supplement and prove it's safe, Commander?"
column2: 你走进医疗舱时，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 从 {TGT_MW.DET} 床上跳了下来。“指挥官，真是奇迹！靠着一种鲜为人知的天然疗法，我恢复得跟新的一样。休假期淘到的，捡了个大便宜。” 一位医疗技师在显示屏上调出一张 X 光片。“我不想承认，但不知怎的，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 的骨裂以创纪录的速度愈合了。真让人费解。” “我想你说的应该是太好了。别担心，指挥官——那完全是天然补剂。它的修复效力来自斯特拉特福独角鲸的角，经提炼制成粉末。加在咖啡里味道还挺不错。” 医疗技师惊恐地瞪大了眼睛。“最好还是继续观察 {TGT_MW.Callsign}。即便 {TGT_MW.DET} 骨裂已经愈合，这种未经批准的疗法会带来怎样意外的副作用，谁也说不准。” “哎呀，别这样，”{TGT_MW.Callsign} 嘟囔道。“这周轮到我带日常训练！我可不想错过。我排了一套超棒的训练计划。要不让医疗技师们分析一下这种补剂，证明它是安全的，指挥官？”

column1:
You study the x-ray and then [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. "I'm glad you're feeling better. But I don't want you to get hurt by some unintended side effect."

The MedTech nods her head in approval as she checks {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s fluids.

{TGT_MW.DET_C} mouth droops into a frown. "Don't you trust me?"

You sit down on the edge of {TGT_MW.DET} medical bed. "I do trust you, but that doesn't mean I trust this so-called remedy. If this stuff works, you should be discharged in no time. We can reschedule your slot for leading exercises. That's easy. What's not so easy is replacing you."

{TGT_MW.Callsign} rubs {TGT_MW.DET} bandaged wrist. "Really? You'd do that, Commander? Well… can I get some extra pillows, too?"

"Promise you'll get some rest?"

"I swear—cross my narwhal-fueled heart! I'll take it easy. I'll catch up on some Holovids, maybe pick up knitting. Who knows?" {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:smile|Default:smiles} as you take your leave.
column2:
你仔细看了 X 光片，又看向 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。“我很高兴你感觉好些了。但我不想让你因为什么意外的副作用再受伤。”

医疗技师一边检查 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 的体液指标，一边赞许地点头。

{TGT_MW.DET_C} 嘴角垮了下来。“你不信任我？”

你在 {TGT_MW.DET} 病床边坐下。“我信任你，但这不代表我信任这种所谓的疗法。要是这东西真管用，你很快就能出院。带训练的日程我们可以重新安排，那容易。难的是找人来顶替你。”

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 揉着 {TGT_MW.DET} 缠着绷带的手腕。“真的？你愿意这么做，指挥官？那……我能多要几个枕头吗？”

“你保证会好好休息？”

“我发誓——以我这条独角鲸能量满满的命起誓！我会悠着点。我把落下的全息影像补一补，说不定还学学织毛线。谁知道呢？”你告辞时，{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:smile|Default:smiles}。

column1:
You pat the edge of [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s bed. "Maybe everything looks good today, but who knows about tomorrow? If there are adverse side effects, you might end up spending more time stuck in here, and nobody wants that. Finish your treatment, MechWarrior."

{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:slump|Default:slumps} back into {TGT_MW.DET} pillow with a groan. "I hate it in here."

"Think of it as paid vacation. You can do whatever you want, as long as you stay in the MedBay, where you belong."

"What you're describing is prison, Commander. Not vacation."

"It's not up for discussion. Get some rest, MechWarrior."

Days later, Darius reports in. "Bad news. {TGT_MW.Callsign} downed all of that narwhal goop, hoping to get released sooner. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} had a severe reaction. The MedTechs found {TGT_MW.OBJ} passed out on the floor, drooling. Once {TGT_MW.SUBJ}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'re|Default:'s} discharged, I'll be taking strict disciplinary action."
column2:
你拍了拍 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 的床沿。“也许今天一切看着都不错，可明天谁知道？要是出现不良反应，你可能得在这儿多待更久，没人想那样。把治疗做完，机甲战士。”

{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:slump|Default:slumps} 地倒回 {TGT_MW.DET} 枕头里，呻吟了一声。“我讨厌待在这儿。”

“就当是带薪休假。你想干什么都行，只要待在医疗舱里——那才是你该待的地方。”

“你描述的是监狱，指挥官。不是休假。”

“这事没得商量。好好休息，机甲战士。”

几天后，达里乌斯来汇报。“坏消息。{TGT_MW.Callsign} 把那些独角鲸糊糊全灌了下去，想早点出院。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} 出现了严重反应。医疗技师发现 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 昏倒在地板上，还流着口水。等 {TGT_MW.SUBJ}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'re|Default:'s} 一出院，我会给予严厉的纪律处分。”

column1: You bump into [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] in the corridor, and notice that {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} in unusually high spirits. "What's new?" you ask {TGT_MW.OBJ}.\n\n{TGT_MW.Callsign} grins. "I don't want to make too big a deal out of this, but… today's my birthday."
column2: 你在走廊里撞见 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]，注意到 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} 情绪格外高涨。“有什么新鲜事？”你问 {TGT_MW.OBJ}。\n\n{TGT_MW.Callsign} 咧嘴一笑。“我不想把这事搞得太隆重，不过……今天是我生日。”

column1:
You look first to Sumire then to [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. "If you can find a way to make a buck, then go ahead, {TGT_MW.Callsign}. I won't stop you, but you're on your own. I can't spare our funds or [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] on this scheme."

{TGT_MW.Callsign}'s mouth creases into a thin line, but {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:nod|Default:nods} {TGT_MW.DET} head. "If you say so, Commander. I've got enough connections on [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] to pull this deal off myself, but the profit's all mine."

The red-and-gold sunset spills across the horizon as you wait for {TGT_MW.Callsign} to return. Sumire checks the time but says nothing. Finally, {TGT_MW.Callsign} stumbles into view. {TGT_MW.DET_C} vest is tattered, matted with blood and feathers. "What happened?" You rush over to support {TGT_MW.OBJ}.

"I don't know why they call it a bird…" {TGT_MW.Callsign} leans on you. "That damn [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAlrakisTigerfalcon],Tigerfalcon]] is a bear with wings. It broke out of the cage—nearly slaughtered my entire crew."

"I'm just glad you're alive, MechWarrior." You help {TGT_MW.OBJ} climb into the Leopard. "Let's get you patched up and forget all about this bear-bird." {TGT_MW.Callsign} groans in response.
column2:
你先看了看苏米蕾，又看向 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。“你要是有办法赚到钱，那就去吧，{TGT_MW.Callsign}。我不拦你，但这事你自己扛。这笔经费和 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 我都不能拨给你去折腾这个计划。”

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 的嘴抿成一条细线，但还是 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:nod|Default:nods} 了{TGT_MW.DET}头。“既然你这么说，指挥官。我在 [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] 上认识的人够多，自己也能把这笔生意做成，不过利润全归我。”

你在红金色的落日铺满地平线时等着 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 回来。苏米蕾看了看时间，什么也没说。终于，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 跌跌撞撞地出现在视野里。{TGT_MW.DET_C} 马甲破烂不堪，沾满了血和羽毛。“出了什么事？”你冲过去扶住 {TGT_MW.OBJ}。

“我真不明白这东西为什么叫鸟……”{TGT_MW.Callsign} 靠在你身上。“那该死的 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAlrakisTigerfalcon],Tigerfalcon]] 根本是长了翅膀的熊。它冲破了笼子——差点把我的整队人手全杀光。”

“我只庆幸你还活着，机甲战士。”你扶着 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 爬上豹式。“把伤处理好，然后把这只熊鸟的事全忘掉。”{TGT_MW.Callsign} 呻吟着回应。

column1: You give a dismissive shake of the head. "Sumire's got a point. Forget all about this scheme, {TGT_MW.Callsign}. This isn't about money. I value your life and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]'s more than any new Mech." {TGT_MW.Callsign} releases a long sigh. "I was afraid you might say something reasonable like that." "You're a MechWarrior. Isn't that enough danger for you? Actually, don't answer that." You rest a hand on {TGT_MW.DET} shoulder. "You've got real talent in the cockpit and a crew that's got your back. Why not drop your old criminal contacts and move on with your life?" {TGT_MW.Callsign} raises {TGT_MW.DET} eyes, nodding slowly. "I've never been much good at keeping my nose clean, but you're right, Commander. I've got everything and everyone I need on the Argo… maybe this will be the first decent thing I don't screw up."
column2: 你不以为然地摇摇头。“苏米蕾说得有道理。这计划就此作罢，{TGT_MW.Callsign}。这不是钱的问题。我看重你和 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 的性命，胜过任何一台新机甲。” {TGT_MW.Callsign} 长叹一声。“我就怕你说出这种讲道理的话。” “你是机甲战士。这危险还不够多吗？算了，别回答。”你把手放在 {TGT_MW.DET} 肩上。“你在驾驶舱里真有过人的天赋，还有一帮挺你的同伴。为什么不抛开你那些老犯罪门路，重新过日子？” {TGT_MW.Callsign} 抬起 {TGT_MW.DET} 眼睛，缓缓点头。“我从来不太擅长干净做人，但你说得对，指挥官。在阿戈号上，我需要的所有东西、所有人都在身边……也许这会是我第一件没搞砸的正经事。”

column1: Thanks to the modern-day miracle of the Hyperpulse Generator, it's mail day aboard the Argo. Crew members filter into and out of the communications room to receive messages from home. Later that evening, there's a knock at the door of your personal quarters. Upon opening the door, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] slips inside and hands you a datapad. "Commander, I'd already read half of this message before I realized it wasn't mine. It's addressed to [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], from a long-distance lover back home. It's a breakup letter." A torn expression creases {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s face. "I just don't know what to do. {SCN_MW.Subj_C} would be devastated… do I pass the letter on to {SCN_MW.OBJ}, or do I keep it to myself?"
column2: 得益于超脉冲发生器这一现代奇迹，阿戈号上迎来了收发信件日。船员们进进出出通讯室，接收来自家乡的讯息。 那天晚上，你私人舱室的门被敲响。你打开门，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 闪身进来，递给你一块数据板。“指挥官，这封信我读了一半才意识到不是给我的。收件人是 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]，来自家里一位远距离恋人。这是一封分手信。” {TGT_MW.Callsign} 脸上拧出纠结的神情。“我真不知道该怎么做。{SCN_MW.Subj_C} 会被击垮的……我该把信交给 {SCN_MW.OBJ}，还是自己藏着？”

column1: You shrug. "This has to be the most convoluted plan I've ever heard, but if anyone can make it work, it's you, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. You'll get the funds for this operation. But make sure you come back in one piece." "Aye, aye, Commander. This ain't my first illicit animal deal." Sumire rolls her eyes as {TGT_MW.Callsign} departs with a wink. Hours later, as you're inspecting the Leopard, a cargo ship approaches the landing pad. Sumire patches in the ship's hail. "Special delivery, Commander!" {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s voice crackles over the comms. "We got free shipping included. That [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAlrakisTigerfalcon],Tigerfalcon]] was worth more than I thought." "Made some new friends, too." [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] says. "Say the word and I'll 'acquire' whatever you need." "Why don't you tell me all about your new friends once you land?" You signal to Sumire, and she opens the Leopard's bay doors. The cargo ship lands nearby, and the MechWarriors jump out, proudly revealing the gleaming 'Mech inside.
column2: 你耸耸肩。“这绝对是我听过最绕的方案，但要说谁能办成，那就是你了，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。这次行动的经费我会给你。但你必须完整地回来。” “遵命，指挥官。这可不是我第一回做非法动物买卖。”{TGT_MW.Callsign} 眨眨眼出发，苏米蕾翻了个白眼。 几个小时后，你正在检查豹式，一艘货船靠近着陆坪。苏米蕾接通了货船的呼叫。“特别快递，指挥官！”{TGT_MW.Callsign} 的声音从通讯里噼啪传来。“还附赠免费送货。那台 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAlrakisTigerfalcon],Tigerfalcon]] 比我想的还值钱。” “还交了几个新朋友。”[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 说。“你一句话，你需要的我都能‘搞到’。” “等你着陆了，不如好好跟我讲讲你的新朋友们？”你向苏米蕾示意，她打开豹式的舱门。货船在附近降落，机甲战士们跳出来，得意地展示里面那台锃亮的机甲。

column1: Happy Birthday, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.FirstName}]], you say. "Are you doing anything to celebrate?"\n\n"No, Commander. But that's fine. It's just a normal day for everybody else." {TGT_MW.Callsign} beams at you before walking off.
column2: “生日快乐，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.FirstName}]]，”你说。“打算怎么庆祝？”\n\n“不了，指挥官。不过没关系。对其他人来说，今天不过是平常的一天。”{TGT_MW.Callsign} 冲你灿烂一笑，转身走了。

column1:
That evening you invite [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] to a small party in the Lounge, with senior staff and a few MechWarriors in attendance.

You say some flattering things about {TGT_MW.OBJ}. Then general acclaim summons {TGT_MW.Callsign} to rise and give a speech. After a couple of hours of food, music, and light drinking, the party starts breaking up and everyone wanders off in a pleasant mood.

Later that evening, you find a thank-you note from {TGT_MW.Callsign} on the door of your personal quarters. Apparently, your gesture meant the world to {TGT_MW.OBJ}.
column2:
那天晚上，你在休息室为 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 办了个小聚会，到场的有高级参谋和几位机甲战士。

你说了些夸赞 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 的话。随后在众人的欢呼簇拥下，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 起身致辞。吃喝、音乐与浅酌持续了两个小时后，聚会开始散场，大家心情愉快地各自离去。

那天夜里晚些时候，你在私人舱室门上发现 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 留下的一张感谢便条。显然，你这份心意对 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 意义非凡。

column1: While planetside on [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]], [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] slinks over to you and Sumire. "Good news, Commander. I know a guy who can get us an [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAlrakisTigerfalcon],Alrakis Tigerfalcon]], but it ain't cheap. This is an exotic, highly sought-after animal. I'm gonna need a million C-bills." "So, one question…" Sumire arches a brow. "Why do we need a bird that eats people?" {TGT_MW.Callsign} grins. "We need it only temporarily. It's for a local collector. He's got his own personal zoo and also happens to have a cache of slightly used mechs. He'll part with a Mech for the right incentive. All I need are some extra hands—[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] will do—and the funds to buy the bird. Then, I can trade it to this eccentric billionaire. You'll be getting a hell of a deal on a practically pristine Mech." "This is a bad idea, even by our standards." Sumire narrows her eyes. "You're not taking this scheme seriously are you, Commander?"
column2: 在 [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] 地表期间，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 悄悄凑到你和苏米蕾身边。“好消息，指挥官。我认识一个人，能给我们弄到一台 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAlrakisTigerfalcon],Alrakis Tigerfalcon]]，可不便宜。这是种稀有、抢手的异兽。我需要一百万星币。” “那，问一句……”苏米蕾挑起眉毛。“我们为什么需要一只吃人的鸟？” {TGT_MW.Callsign} 咧嘴一笑。“只是暂时用一下。是给本地一位收藏家弄的。他有自己的私人动物园，手头还恰好存着一批九成新的机甲。只要诱因到位，他愿意让出一台机甲。我需要的只是几个人手——[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 就行——还有买鸟的钱。然后我把它转手给这位古怪的亿万富翁。你会以超划算的价格弄到一台几乎崭新如初的机甲。” “这主意很糟糕，就算按我们的标准看也是。”苏米蕾眯起眼。“你不是真想搞这个计划吧，指挥官？”

column1:
Dr. Murad stands in the center of the hydroponic garden. She brushes a melon tendril away from her face as she addresses the company. "I want to thank our Commander for making the creation of this hydroponics unit a priority. The fresh produce that we can now enjoy is only the beginning; we're also growing medicinal herbs for use in the MedBay. And, as I'm sure you've noticed, the air in this pod is also much more enjoyable, which should serve to improve shipboard health."

Farah flashes you a smile. "…So I would like you all to take a deep breath and raise a tomato, or a strawberry, or whatever you fancy, in salute to our Commander—and to our new garden!"

The entire crew lets out a lusty cheer, followed by the sound of contented munching.
column2:
穆拉德博士站在水培园中央。她把一缕瓜藤从脸前拨开，对公司众人讲话。“我要感谢我们的指挥官，把建造这套水培单元列为优先事项。我们现在能享用新鲜农产品只是开始；我们还在种植供医疗舱使用的药草。而且，我相信大家都已经注意到，这个舱段里的空气也宜人多了，这应该有助于改善船上人员的健康。”

法拉冲你露出一个笑容。“……所以，我想请大家深吸一口气，举起一颗番茄、一颗草莓，或者随便什么你喜欢的，向我们的指挥官——以及我们的新菜园致敬！”

全体船员发出一阵热烈的欢呼，接着是一片满足的咀嚼声。

column1: Before [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] can finish the deal, security forces swarm the exchange point. Apparently {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s' broker got advance warning of the raid and didn't pass it on.\n\nThe planetary authorities demand that a huge fine be paid before eventually letting {TGT_MW.Callsign} return to the shuttle, completely exhausted from the interrogation.
column2: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 还没来得及完成交易，安全部队就包围了交换地点。看样子，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 的中间人提前得知了突袭的消息，却没把消息传出去。\n\n行星当局要求缴纳巨额罚款，最后才放 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 回到穿梭机；这名机甲战士已被审问得筋疲力尽。

column1: You send [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and Darius to the exchange along with a couple of big, tough crew members. {TGT_MW.Callsign} was smooth enough at managing the relationship that the broker is taken entirely by surprise, despite the value of the deal.\n\nLater, Darius quietly reports on just how furious {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s 'friend' was about the double-cross. "I think it wasn't even the loss of the money that made the broker so upset, Commander. It was the betrayal itself."
column2: 你派 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 和达里乌斯带上两名高大结实的船员前往交换地点。{TGT_MW.Callsign} 把关系经营得滴水不漏，尽管交易金额不小，中间人还是被打了个措手不及。\n\n事后，达里乌斯悄悄向你汇报 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 那位“朋友”对这次反水有多愤怒。“指挥官，我觉得让那个中间人气成那样的，甚至不是丢了钱，而是被背叛这件事本身。”

column1: You send [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and Darius to the exchange with a couple of big, tough crew members. Unfortunately, the broker had also planned a double-cross.\n\n{TGT_MW.Callsign} is critically injured in the ensuing crossfire. You don't get the weapon, either.
column2: 你派 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 和达里乌斯带上两名高大结实的船员前往交换地点。不幸的是，那个中间人同样计划了反水。\n\n在随之而来的交火中，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 身负重伤。武器你也没拿到。

column1: Darius arranges for the sale, and the broker gets the weapon safely loaded onto the shuttle. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and the broker then celebrate at a series of bars that evening. Darius hauls {TGT_MW.Callsign} back to the Argo early the next morning.\n\n{TGT_MW.Callsign} drunkenly waves at you as you arrive to inspect the cargo. "Everything is great, Commander! So, so great. We gotta come back and do this again later.
column2: 达里乌斯安排好交易，中间人把武器安全装上了穿梭机。当晚，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 和中间人在一连串酒吧里庆祝。第二天一早，达里乌斯把 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 拖回阿戈号。\n\n你前来检查货物时，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 醉醺醺地朝你挥手。“一切都太好了，指挥官！太太好了。我们以后一定得回来再干一票。

column1: You send [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] to the exchange with a couple of big, tough crew members. Unfortunately, your fence was prepared for dishonesty.\n\n{TGT_MW.Callsign} is seriously injured in the ensuing crossfire. You don't get the weapon, either.
column2: 你派 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 带上两名高大结实的船员前往交换地点。不幸的是，你的销赃人有备而来，就等着使诈。\n\n在随之而来的交火中，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 受了重伤。武器你也没拿到。

column1: The next time [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] meets with {TGT_MW.DET} friend, {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:mention|Default:mentions} the names of some past black market contacts that your company has dealt with. {TGT_MW.DET_C} friend seems suitably impressed.\n\nAfter Darius has returned to the ship, he fills you in on what happened next. "{TGT_MW.Callsign}'s friend hooked us up. Gave us a special deal, in part because of our company's reputation. We ought to remember them next time we're in the system."
column2: 下一次 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 与 {TGT_MW.DET} 朋友见面时，{TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:mention|Default:mentions} 起了一些公司与往昔黑市线人的名号。{TGT_MW.DET_C} 朋友似乎颇为叹服。\n\n达里乌斯回到船上后，把事情后续告诉了你。“{TGT_MW.Callsign} 的朋友帮了我们一把，给了个特别优惠，部分原因是看在我们公司的名声。下次再来这个星系，我们该记得找他们。”

column1: Darius calls up from a planetside supply run. "Commander, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] tagged along to help me wrangle supplies. {TGT_MW.Gender?Male:He's|Female:She's|NonBinary:They've} managed to get involved with a broker in the local black market."\n\n"Now this broker is offering to sell us a [[DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_Laser_Reengineered_Large],{DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_Laser_Reengineered_Large].Description.Name}]]. This is a serious deal with a pretty significant individual. What do you want to do?"
column2: 达里乌斯在一次地表补给行程中打来通讯。“指挥官，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 跟着我来帮忙张罗补给。{TGT_MW.Gender?Male:He's|Female:She's|NonBinary:They've} 跟当地黑市的一个中间人搭上了关系。”\n\n“现在这个中间人提出要卖给我们一具 [[DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_Laser_Reengineered_Large],{DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_Laser_Reengineered_Large].Description.Name}]]。这可是一笔大交易，对方也是个人物。你想怎么办？”

column1: You send [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and Darius to the exchange with a couple of big, tough crew members. Unfortunately, the double-cross goes very badly. Darius and the crew members escape, but {TGT_MW.Callsign} is captured by the broker, who apparently takes the betrayal extremely personally.\n\n{TGT_MW.Callsign}'s body is found by the local police the next morning.
column2: 你派 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 和达里乌斯带上两名高大结实的船员前往交换地点。不幸的是，这次反水变成了一场灾难。达里乌斯和船员们逃了出来，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 却被中间人抓走——看来对方把这次背叛看得极重。\n\n第二天早上，当地警方发现了 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 的尸体。

column1:
We found them, Boss. Over here. Yang points to the bodies of [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], who lie passed out in a tool alcove of the Mech Bay.

You clear the beer cans and whiskey bottles away with your foot to get a closer look. "Let's carry them to the MedBay. It looks like we're going to be down two pilots for a while. Let Darius know where these two ended up."

Yang grabs {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s feet. "Well, at least everyone had a great time."
column2:
“找到他们了，老板。这边。”杨指着 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 和 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 的身子，两人昏倒在机甲库的一个工具凹间里。

你用脚把啤酒罐和威士忌瓶踢开，凑近看了看。“把他们抬到医疗舱去。看来我们有一阵子要少两名机师了。告诉达里乌斯这两位最后在哪儿。”

杨抓住 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 的脚。“唉，至少大家都玩得很开心。”

column1: Dr. Murad arrives at a briefing, her arms full of succulent red orbs. "Look, the first harvest from the hydroponics garden." "Are those tomatoes?" Darius asks. She tosses him one and he bites into it, then sighs with satisfaction as he wipes the juice off his chin. "They are." "Tomatoes, strawberries, watermelon, squash, basil—and that's just the early harvest." With studied nonchalance, Sumire snatches her own tomato from Farah's arms. "The crew will be thrilled, Commander. How do you want to share the news?"
column2: 穆拉德博士抱着满怀红润饱满的果实来到简报会。“看，水培园的第一次收成。” “那是番茄吗？”达里乌斯问。她扔给他一颗，他咬了一口，擦去下巴上的汁水，满足地叹了口气。“确实是番茄。” “番茄、草莓、西瓜、南瓜、罗勒——这还只是早期收成。” 苏米蕾故作随意地从法拉怀里抢走一颗番茄。“船员们会乐坏的，指挥官。你打算怎么公布这个消息？”

column1: Commander, do you you have a moment? says [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] as you pass the barracks, with [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] at {TGT_MW.Det} side. "What's on your mind?" {SCN_MW.Callsign} speaks up. "We just want to let you know how happy we are about the new hydroponics unit." {TGT_MW.Callsign} adds, "We love the fresh fruits and vegetables. It's like when I was a kid." You smile. "You keep performing well out in the field and we'll keep improving the Argo. Someday this hunk of junk may just feel like a real home."
column2: “指挥官，你有空吗？”你路过营房时，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 问道，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 就在 {TGT_MW.Det} 身边。 “有什么事？” {SCN_MW.Callsign} 开口道：“我们只是想让你知道，我们对新的水培单元有多满意。” {TGT_MW.Callsign} 接话：“我们太喜欢这些新鲜蔬果了。就像我小时候一样。” 你笑了笑。“你们在战场上继续好好表现，我们就会继续改造阿戈号。总有一天，这堆破烂也能像个真正的家。”

column1: After the party, Darius presents two MechWarriors for your inspection. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s head is bowed and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], who sports a black eye, speaks quickly. "It wasn't {TGT_MW.Det} fault, Commander. I knew about {TGT_MW.Det} drinking problem. If I hadn't tried to interfere, {TGT_MW.Subj} would never have jerked the bottle back and caught me in the eye." {TGT_MW.Callsign} blurts out, "It is my fault. I'm done with the booze, Commander. I promise." You look between the two MechWarriors until they gaze at the floor. "I appreciate your honesty, both of you. As for your promise, {TGT_MW.Callsign}… I suppose we'll see."
column2: 聚会之后，达里乌斯把两名机甲战士带来让你过目。[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 低着头，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 眼睛上带着一块乌青，抢先开口。“这不是 {TGT_MW.Det} 的错，指挥官。我知道 {TGT_MW.Det} 有酗酒的毛病。要是我没去拦，{TGT_MW.Subj} 也不会把瓶子往回一拽，正好打到我眼睛。” {TGT_MW.Callsign} 脱口而出：“这就是我的错。我戒酒了，指挥官。我保证。” 你在这两名机甲战士之间来回打量，直到他们都低头看地板。“我欣赏你们两个人的诚实。至于你的保证，{TGT_MW.Callsign}……我们走着瞧吧。”

column1: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] meets up with the broker in a bar with a budget and a plan. After a few drinks, {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:start|Default:starts} dropping the names of past black market contacts the company has dealt with, along with some personal exploits. More booze flows, and more stories are shared.\n\nThe next morning, Darius returns to the Argo with the weapon and a still-drunk {TGT_MW.Callsign}. The MechWarrior waggles {TGT_MW.DET} fingers at you when you come to inspect the merchandise. "Come with us next time, Commander. It'll be fun. You've got fans now."
column2: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 带着预算和一套方案，在酒吧与中间人碰面。几杯酒下肚后，{TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:start|Default:starts} 抛出公司与往昔黑市线人的名号，还讲了些个人的丰功伟绩。酒越喝越多，故事也越讲越热闹。\n\n第二天早上，达里乌斯带着武器和仍醉醺醺的 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 回到阿戈号。你前来验货时，这名机甲战士冲你勾了勾 {TGT_MW.DET} 手指。“下次跟我们一起去吧，指挥官。会很有意思的。你现在有粉丝了。”

column1:
As the morning briefing draws to a close, Darius raises a final point of discussion. "The crew's been wound a little tight lately, and the lounge is empty too often. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] brought it to my attention, along with a suggestion that we 'do something' about it. I'm thinking that some kind of celebration is in order… anyone have any ideas?"

Sumire raises her hand. "My family used to observe the Festival of Lights around this time of year. We'd light candles for the dead, then throw a wild party in their honor."

Yang snorts. "C'mon, Sumire. That sounds a little highbrow for people who go skinny dipping in coolant tanks. How 'bout we give {TGT_MW.Callsign} permission to throw a keg party instead?"
column2:
早间简报接近尾声时，达里乌斯提出最后一个议题。“最近船员们绷得太紧了，休息室也常常空着。[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 向我反映了这个问题，还提议我们该‘做点什么’。我觉得该办一场庆祝活动……谁有想法？”

苏米蕾举起手。“我们家以前每年这个时候都过灯节。我们会为逝者点上蜡烛，然后为他们办一场狂欢派对。”

杨嗤了一声。“得了吧，苏米蕾。对一群会在冷却液罐里裸泳的人来说，这听着也太高雅了。不如我们批准 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 办个啤酒桶派对？”

column1: The lounge looks like a different place in the light of a thousand burning candles. As Sumire pours shot after shot for the attendees, the stories being shared go from sad to bawdy to riotously funny. Then the music takes an upturn, and things really start heating up.\n\nThe next morning, Darius says, "That Festival of Lights may have gotten a bit too festive. Half of the crew is either passed out or still drunk, and the MedBay is a disaster area. Someone decided to get creative with the melted wax from the candles, and… well, I'll leave it to your imagination. But we're gonna take an efficiency hit in there for the week it takes to clean things up."
column2: 在一千支燃烧蜡烛的光里，休息室像是变成了另一个地方。苏米蕾给在场的人一杯接一杯地倒酒，人们分享的故事从悲伤到荤腥，再到让人笑到打滚。随后音乐一转，场面才真正热闹起来。\n\n第二天早上，达里乌斯说：“那个灯节大概办得过于欢乐了。一半船员要么昏睡不醒，要么还醉着，医疗舱更是成了一片废墟。有人拿蜡烛融化的蜡玩出了花样，至于具体……还是留给你自己想象吧。不过接下来清理要花上一周，这段时间那边的工作效率肯定要掉。”

column1:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] considers for a moment, then nods and leaves your quarters.

Later that week, you run into [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] in the mess. {SCN_MW.SUBJ_C} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:seem|Default:seems} distracted, with dark circles under {SCN_MW.Det} eyes. It may take a while before {SCN_MW.Callsign} shakes this off.

At a table nearby, {TGT_MW.Callsign} catches your eye and nods. While it was a tough call, {TGT_MW.Callsign} is clearly at peace with {TGT_MW.Det} decision to not delay the inevitable.
column2:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 想了片刻，点点头，离开了你的舱室。

那周晚些时候，你在食堂遇到 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]。{SCN_MW.SUBJ_C} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:seem|Default:seems} 心不在焉，{SCN_MW.Det} 眼下挂着黑眼圈。{SCN_MW.Callsign} 恐怕得过一阵子才能走出来。

旁边一张桌子旁，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 对上你的目光，点了点头。虽然这个决定很艰难，但 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 显然已坦然接受了 {TGT_MW.Det} 那个不再拖延、直面必然的选择。

column1: You step between Darius and the MechWarrior. "Look [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] might be a ridiculous name, but was {TGT_MW.DET} old callsign any better? Let it go, Darius. Its {TGT_MW.DET} choice. Let's honor {TGT_MW.DET} name and get {TGT_MW.OBJ} back to work." Darius crosses his arms, but after a long inhale he begrudgingly nods his head in compliance. "Alright, The Iron Mandible." His annoyance is obvious. "Are you ready to follow orders?" The Iron Mandible jumps out of {TGT_MW.DET} bunk, standing at attention. "Yes, sir. What can the toughest THRASHAGEDDON semifinalist do for you?" Darius smirks. "Didn't realize we were working with a celebrity. We'll need your famous face to report to the cargo hold. We got a dozen supply pallets that need hauling." "Easy." {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:raise|Default:raises} a triumphant fist, flexing one arm. "Those puny pallets are no match for The Iron Mandible!"
column2: 你走到达里乌斯和那名机甲战士中间。“听我说，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 这名字也许很荒唐，可 {TGT_MW.DET} 旧代号就更好吗？算了吧，达里乌斯。这是 {TGT_MW.DET} 的选择。就按 {TGT_MW.DET} 的名字称呼 {TGT_MW.OBJ}，让人回去干活。” 达里乌斯抱起双臂，可长吸一口气后，还是不情愿地点了头。“好吧，铁颚。”他的不悦一目了然。“准备好服从命令了吗？” 铁颚从 {TGT_MW.DET} 铺位上跳起来，立正站好。“是，长官。最硬核的 THRASHAGEDDON 半决赛选手能为你做什么？” 达里乌斯冷笑一声。“没想到我们这儿还有位名人。那就请你这张名脸去货舱报到吧。我们有十二个补给托盘要搬。” “小意思。”{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:raise|Default:raises} 起一只拳头庆祝，活动着一条胳膊。“那些碍眼的小托盘哪里是铁颚的对手！”

column1: What's really going on here? You sit down on the edge of [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s bunk. "This isn't really about your old callsign is it? I mean, you've been going by {TGT_MW.Callsign} this whole time without complaint." {TGT_MW.Callsign} averts {TGT_MW.DET} gaze. "I guess I've been missing all the freedom and the fame back on [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSolaris7],Solaris VII]]… I don't know. I just wanted some attention again" "Oh, you've got my attention alright," Darius says with a scowl. You raise a hand up to quiet the XO. "This is clearly not the kind of attention you want, MechWarrior. But you can get all the recognition and glory you crave on my crew. Focus on your performance in and outside the cockpit and {TGT_MW.Callsign} will mean more than The Iron Mandible ever did." {TGT_MW.Callsign} cracks a smile. "Challenge accepted, Commander. Let's see how famous I can make {TGT_MW.Callsign}, TITAN of STEEL and BREAKER of HEARTS!"
column2: “到底是怎么回事？”你在 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 的铺位边坐下。“这其实跟你的旧代号无关，对吧？我是说，你一直用 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 这个名字，从没抱怨过。” {TGT_MW.Callsign} 移开 {TGT_MW.DET} 目光。“我想我是想念[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSolaris7],Solaris VII]]上的自由与名声了……我也说不清。我只是想再被人关注一下。” “哦，你现在可真是得到了我的关注，”达里乌斯板着脸说。 你抬手让副官安静下来。“这显然不是你想要的关注，机甲战士。但在我这艘船上，你能得到你渴望的一切认可与荣耀。把心思放在驾驶舱内外的表现上，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 这个名字会比铁颚更有分量。” {TGT_MW.Callsign} 露出一丝笑意。“接受挑战，指挥官。那就看看我能把 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 捧到多红——钢铁泰坦、芳心终结者！”

column1: So, what's really going on, You look [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] straight in the eye. "This isn't like you." {TGT_MW.Callsign} crosses {TGT_MW.DET} arms. "Before I became a merc, fans screamed my name when I got in the ring on [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSolaris7],Solaris VII]]. They lined up for autographs. Here, I get nothing, not even a thank you— "You get paid." Darius interrupts. "More than most gladiators, too." You soften slightly. "Look, you're right there are no adoring fans on the Argo, but you're here because we believe in you. Now if I can't trust you to follow orders, this isn't going to work out. We're a team. And that's just as important in the ring as it is out here. You know that." {TGT_MW.Callsign} murmurs {TGT_MW.DET} assent and agrees to behave. But later, the XO calls you. "{TGT_MW.Callsign} still has a real attitude, I nearly threw {TGT_MW.OBJ} in the brig. I'm going to stay on {TGT_MW.OBJ} until {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:shape|Default:shapes} up or {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:ship|Default:ships} out."
column2: “那，到底是怎么回事，”你直视 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 的眼睛。“这不像你。” {TGT_MW.Callsign} 抱起 {TGT_MW.DET} 双臂。“我当雇佣兵之前，只要我在[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSolaris7],Solaris VII]]的擂台上出场，粉丝们就会尖叫我的名字。他们排队等我签名。在这儿，我什么都得不到，连句谢谢都没有——” “你有钱拿。”达里乌斯打断道。“而且比大多数角斗士还多。” 你的语气缓和了些。“听着，你说得没错，阿戈号上没有崇拜你的粉丝，但你在这里是因为我们相信你。可要是我没法信任你服从命令，这事就干不下去。我们是一支队伍。这一点在擂台内外都同样重要。你清楚。” {TGT_MW.Callsign} 低声表示 {TGT_MW.DET} 同意，答应好好表现。但后来，副官来找你。“{TGT_MW.Callsign} 那态度还是很冲，我差点把 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 扔进禁闭室。我要一直盯着 {TGT_MW.OBJ}，直到 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:shape|Default:shapes} 好态度，或者 {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:ship|Default:ships} 滚蛋。”

column1:
You duck into the barracks after hearing raised voices. Darius's face is red with anger. "Get out of your bunk, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. I won't repeat myself."

{TGT_MW.Callsign} lays in {TGT_MW.DET} bunk, cleaning {TGT_MW.DET} nails with a knife. "Look, I told you, XO. I'm not going by {TGT_MW.Callsign} anymore. I'm bringing back my old callsign—The Iron Mandible. That's the name I earned in ring on [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSolaris7],Solaris VII]]. Call me The Iron Mandible and I'll be happy to comply."

"You're not in charge here, {TGT_MW.Callsign}. And for the record, The Iron Mandible is a terrible name. Way too many syllables." Darius turns to you. "This is ridiculous, Commander. What do you want to do about {TGT_MW.Callsign}?"
column2:
听到提高的嗓门，你拐进营房。达里乌斯气得满脸通红。“从铺位上起来，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。我不重复第二遍。”

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 躺在 {TGT_MW.DET} 铺位上，用刀修着 {TGT_MW.DET} 指甲。“听着，副官，我说过了。我不再用 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 这个名号了。我要恢复我的旧代号——铁颚。这是我在[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSolaris7],Solaris VII]]的擂台上挣来的名字。叫我铁颚，我就乐意配合。”

“这儿不是你做主，{TGT_MW.Callsign}。而且说句实话，铁颚这名字烂透了。音节多得要命。”达里乌斯转向你。“这太荒唐了，指挥官。{TGT_MW.Callsign} 的事你想怎么处理？”

column1:
That evening, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] arrives in your office. When {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:see|Default:sees} your expression, a cloud of worry passes over {TGT_MW.DET} face.

Darius drags out a footlocker with the MechWarrior's callsign clearly printed on the side, and empties its contents. Pilfered medical supplies cascade to the floor.

You say, "Soldier, you're lucky that we don't vent you from an airlock. Until we can dump you on the nearest planet, though, you're confined to quarters. And don't expect a severance package or a glowing letter of referral."
column2:
那天晚上，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 来到你的办公室。当 {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:see|Default:sees} 到你的表情时，{TGT_MW.DET} 脸上掠过一片忧虑的阴云。

达里乌斯拖出一只储物箱，箱侧清清楚楚印着这名机甲战士的代号，然后把里面的东西倒了出来。偷来的医疗物资哗啦啦撒了一地。

你说：“士兵，你该庆幸我们没把你从气闸扔出去。不过在我们能把你丢到最近的星球之前，你被禁足在舱室里。也别指望什么遣散补偿，或者一封漂亮的推荐信。”

column1:
That evening, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] arrives in your office. When {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:see|Default:sees} your expression, a cloud of worry passes over {TGT_MW.DET} face.

Darius drags out a footlocker with the MechWarrior's callsign clearly printed on the side, and empties its contents. Pilfered medical supplies cascade to the floor.

You say, "Soldier, it's lucky for you that you've got skills in a 'Mech, or we'd vent you from an airlock. For the next month, though, you're barred from shore leave, and we'll be docking your pay until we recoup costs for all the supplies you've stolen."
column2:
那天晚上，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 来到你的办公室。当 {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:see|Default:sees} 到你的表情时，{TGT_MW.DET} 脸上掠过一片忧虑的阴云。

达里乌斯拖出一只储物箱，箱侧清清楚楚印着这名机甲战士的代号，然后把里面的东西倒了出来。偷来的医疗物资哗啦啦撒了一地。

你说：“士兵，算你走运，你在机甲上有本事，不然我们早把你从气闸扔出去了。不过接下来一个月，你被禁止休假；在你偷走的物资成本还清之前，我们会一直扣你的薪水。”

column1: Darius's slow grin tells you how much he likes your idea.\n\n"I just so happen to have some connections in this system's black markets. I'll put [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] in touch with them. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} clearly {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:have|Default:has} a knack for this. Yeah, we can definitely turn this to our advantage."
column2: 达里乌斯缓缓咧开的笑，说明他有多喜欢你的主意。\n\n“我在这个星系的黑市里恰好有些门路。我会让 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 跟他们联系。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} 显然 {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:have|Default:has} 这方面的天赋。没错，我们完全可以把这事变成我们的优势。”

column1: You point a finger at the MechWarrior. "Darius gave you an order. Now I could throw you off this boat for insubordination, but you've got a future here. So, here's the deal. You pledge to fall in line and we'll call you whatever you want—The Iron Mandible, Thunder Pants, your choice." {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:slide|Default:slides} out of {TGT_MW.DET} bunk. "Alright, Commander. I'll be a model MechWarrior. Though I think I'll pass on Thunder Pants. I earned the name The Iron Mandible with sweat and steel and I'll do it again." "I have no doubts." You dismiss the XO and {TGT_MW.Callsign}. Later that day, Darius calls you over the comms. "Good news, Commander. Our [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSolaris7],Solaris]] star has been working like a dog all day. Let's throw {TGT_MW.OBJ} a bone. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] it is. The Argo's champ."
column2: 你伸手指着这名机甲战士。“达里乌斯给你下了命令。就凭抗命，我本可以把你赶下这条船，但你在这儿还有前途。那就这么办：你发誓服从命令，我们就按你想的叫你——铁颚、雷霆裤，随你挑。” {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:slide|Default:slides} 地从 {TGT_MW.DET} 铺位上滑下来。“好，指挥官。我会当个模范机甲战士。不过‘雷霆裤’还是算了。铁颚这个名字是我用汗水和钢铁挣来的，我会再挣一次。” “我毫不怀疑。”你让副官和 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 都退下。 当天晚些时候，达里乌斯通过通讯呼你。“好消息，指挥官。我们这位[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSolaris7],Solaris]]明星整整一天干得像条狗。给 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 一点甜头吧。还是叫 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。阿戈号的冠军。”

column1:
Later in the week, Darius delivers an update on the situation.

While confining [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] to the barracks has kept {TGT_MW.OBJ} out of the hair of the senior staff, it's done nothing to endear {TGT_MW.OBJ} to {TGT_MW.DET} fellow MechWarriors.

"Yesterday, there was an… incident. Unfortunately, by the time I arrived, things had already gotten out of hand. {TGT_MW.CALLSIGN} is laid up in the MedBay, and I assigned [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.CALLSIGN}]] to kitchen duty for the next week. I think that diffused the situation. For now."
column2:
那周稍晚，达里乌斯汇报了情况进展。

把 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 禁闭在营房里，固然让 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 不再去烦高级参谋，却丝毫没有让 {TGT_MW.DET} 机甲战士同伴对 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 产生好感。

“昨天出了……一起事件。不幸的是，等我赶到时，事情已经失控了。{TGT_MW.CALLSIGN} 躺进了医疗舱，我把 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.CALLSIGN}]] 罚去厨房值勤一周。我想局面算是压下去了。暂时。”

column1:
Later in the week, Darius delivers an update on the situation.

While relocating [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] to the undeveloped Gamma pod has kept {TGT_MW.OBJ} out of the hair of the senior staff and {TGT_MW.DET} fellow MechWarriors, it's been hard on the lonely MechWarrior.

"Commander, I don't know how much more {TGT_MW.SUBJ} can take. But Dr. Murad and I have been monitoring things and the strange electrical behavior in that part of the ship has subsided in the past 24 hours. I suggest we keep an eye on things, and let {TGT_MW.CALLSIGN} move back to quarters in a week or two."
column2:
那周稍晚，达里乌斯汇报了情况进展。

把 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 迁到尚未开发的 Gamma 舱段，虽然让 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 不再去烦高级参谋和 {TGT_MW.DET} 机甲战士同伴，却让这名孤独的机甲战士很难熬。

“指挥官，我不知道 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} 还能撑多久。不过穆拉德博士和我一直在监测，过去 24 小时里，船上那一区域奇怪的电气现象已经平复。我建议我们继续留意，过一两周再让 {TGT_MW.CALLSIGN} 搬回舱室。”

column1:
Later in the week, Darius delivers an update on the situation.

Relocating [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] to the undeveloped Gamma pod has not only kept {TGT_MW.OBJ} out of the hair of the senior staff and {TGT_MW.DET} fellow MechWarriors, it's also given the unlucky MechWarrior the solitude {TGT_MW.SUBJ} craved.

"Commander, I don't know if you've gone to down there to visit, but it's kind of impressive what {TGT_MW.CALLSIGN} has managed to do with the space. It's almost… homey."

Dr. Murad adds, "And the strange electrical behavior in that part of the ship has mostly subsided in the past 24 hours. I suggest we keep an eye on things, and let {TGT_MW.CALLSIGN} move back to quarters in a week or two. If {TGT_MW.Subj} even {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:want|Default:wants} to."
column2:
那周稍晚，达里乌斯汇报了情况进展。

把 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 迁到尚未开发的 Gamma 舱段，不仅让 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 不再去烦高级参谋和 {TGT_MW.DET} 机甲战士同伴，也让这位倒霉的机甲战士得到了 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} 渴望的清静。

“指挥官，不知道你去下面看过没有，{TGT_MW.CALLSIGN} 把那片空间收拾得还挺像样。简直……有点家的感觉。”

穆拉德博士补充道：“而且过去 24 小时里，船上那一区域奇怪的电气现象基本平复了。我建议我们继续留意，过一两周再让 {TGT_MW.CALLSIGN} 搬回舱室。如果 {TGT_MW.Subj} 甚至 {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:want|Default:wants} 搬回去的话。”

column1:
Later in the week, Darius delivers an update on the situation.

While confining [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] to the barracks has kept {TGT_MW.OBJ} out of the hair of the senior staff, it's done nothing to endear {TGT_MW.OBJ} to {TGT_MW.DET} fellow MechWarriors.

"Yesterday, there was an… incident. Fortunately, I was nearby to intervene before things got out of hand. I had to assign [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.CALLSIGN}]] to kitchen duty for a few days. I think that diffused the situation. For now."
column2:
那周稍晚，达里乌斯汇报了情况进展。

把 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 禁闭在营房里，固然让 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 不再去烦高级参谋，却丝毫没有让 {TGT_MW.DET} 机甲战士同伴对 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 产生好感。

“昨天出了……一起事件。幸运的是，我就在附近，在事情失控之前插手拦下了。我不得不把 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.CALLSIGN}]] 罚去厨房值勤几天。我想局面算是压下去了。暂时。”

column1:
You stand next to Darius, fixing [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] with a firm gaze."This ends now. No more games. The XO gave you an order, MechWarrior."

"Yeah, yeah." {TGT_MW.Callsign} groans and slides out of {TGT_MW.DET} bunk. "I'm up."

"Good." You cross your arms, circling {TGT_MW.Callsign}. "If you shape up, I think you'll find Darius far more accommodating." You leave Darius to handle the rest of {TGT_MW.DET} discipline.

Later that day, Darius reports in. "{TGT_MW.Callsign} decided that garbage detail was beneath a 'Thrashageddon semifinalist' whatever that means. So, I've put {TGT_MW.OBJ} on latrine duty for the next two weeks. I'll stay on {TGT_MW.OBJ} until they shape up, but it's an uphill battle."
column2:
你站在达里乌斯身旁，目光坚定地盯着 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。“到此为止。别再耍花样。副官给你下了命令，机甲战士。”

“知道了知道了。”{TGT_MW.Callsign} 哼哼着从 {TGT_MW.DET} 铺位上滑下来。“我起来了。”

“很好。”你抱着双臂，绕着 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 走了半圈。“要是你端正态度，我想你会发现达里乌斯好说话得多。”{TGT_MW.DET} 剩下的管教工作，你交给达里乌斯处理。

当天晚些时候，达里乌斯来汇报。“{TGT_MW.Callsign} 认为倒垃圾这种活儿配不上一位‘THRASHAGEDDON 半决赛选手’——鬼知道那是什么。所以我把 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 派去清洁厕所，为期两周。我会一直盯着 {TGT_MW.OBJ}，直到态度端正为止，不过这仗不好打。”

column1:
Even before you arrive at the morning briefing, you can hear Dr. Murad's raised voice. "…So I told [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] to leave engineering at once!"

Yang grimaces. "Yeah, and then {TGT_MW.Subj} showed up in the Mech Bay. It took a whole two minutes for one of my winches to fail."

Sumire rolls her eyes. "Well, don't send {TGT_MW.Obj} to the bridge, Chief. You want the comms to short out again?"

Finally, Darius notices you standing in the doorway and explains. "Commander, we have to do something about {TGT_MW.Callsign}. {TGT_MW.Subj_C}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'re|Default:'s} a jinx."
column2:
你还没走进早间简报会，就听见穆拉德博士提高的嗓门。“……所以我让 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 立刻离开轮机舱！”

杨苦着脸。“是啊，然后 {TGT_MW.Subj} 又出现在机甲库。我的绞盘整整两分钟就坏了一个。”

苏米蕾翻了个白眼。“那就别把 {TGT_MW.Obj} 往舰桥上派，总工。你还想让通讯再短路一次？”

达里乌斯终于注意到站在门口的你，解释道：“指挥官，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 这事儿我们得想个办法。{TGT_MW.Subj_C}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'re|Default:'s} 是个扫把星。”

column1:
The rest of the room sits in stunned silence before voicing half-hearted protestations. Only Darius nods, accepting that your decision is final.

That evening, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] arrives in your office. "The XO said you wanted to see me?" As {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:enter|Default:enters} the room, a bulb overhead flutters and winks out. {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:cringe|Default:cringes}.

You say, "While I don't personally believe in jinxes, I have to be sensitive to the beliefs of my crew. Frightened spacers make mistakes, and mistakes on a DropShip can get people killed." You let out a sigh. "…And so, {TGT_MW.Callsign}, I'm afraid that I'm going to have to let you go. The XO will make arrangements for you, and the company will cover the rest of your month's pay. Best of luck in your future endeavors."
column2:
屋里其余人愣了好一会儿，才发出几声有气无力的反对。只有达里乌斯点了点头，接受你的决定已无可更改。

那天晚上，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 来到你的办公室。“副官说你想见我？”当 {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:enter|Default:enters} 走进房间时，头顶一盏灯闪了闪就灭了。{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:cringe|Default:cringes}。

你说：“虽然我个人不信什么扫把星，但我得顾及船员的信念。恐惧的太空人会犯错，而空投艇上的错误会要人命。”你叹了口气。“……所以，{TGT_MW.Callsign}，恐怕我只能让你离开了。副官会为你安排手续，公司会结清你这个月剩余的薪水。祝你今后的路一切顺利。”

column1:
Darius frowns at your decision. "Commander, I hate to just let this go, but you're the boss."

Later in the week, you see [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] in the mess hall. {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} obviously in a good mood, as {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:joke|Default:jokes} around with the other MechWarriors at the table.

Darius catches your eye from where he's sitting, looks over at {TGT_MW.Callsign}, then back at his food.
column2:
达里乌斯对你的决定直皱眉。“指挥官，我真不情愿就这么算了，但你是老板。”

那周稍晚，你在食堂看到 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} 显然心情很好，{TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:joke|Default:jokes} 着和同桌的其他机甲战士说笑。

达里乌斯从他坐的地方对上你的目光，看了一眼 {TGT_MW.Callsign}，又低头看自己的饭。

column1: During the daily briefing, Sumire asks, "What's the story with [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]? I saw them glaring at each other in the MedBay."\n\nDarius glances at his notes and says, "Yeah, that's the next item. They got into a fight yesterday over—actually, I don't even know what it was over. Pretty serious fight, though. They're both going to be out of action for a bit. Tempers are running hot, Commander. I think we're going to see more problems like this if you don't do something to address morale."
column2: 每日简报会上，苏米蕾问：“[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 和 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 是怎么回事？我看见他们在医疗舱里互相瞪着。”\n\n达里乌斯瞥了一眼笔记。“对，这就是下一个议题。他们昨天打了一架，为了——其实我也不知道为了什么。不过打得挺凶。两人都要休整一段时间。指挥官，大家火气都很旺。我觉得你要是再不处理士气问题，这种麻烦还会更多。”

column1: You arrive in MedBay to have a talk with the injured MechWarriors. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] has a dressing over {TGT_MW.DET} nose and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] is wearing a brace around {SCN_MW.DET} ribs. After surveying the damage, you say, "Look, you idiots did this to yourselves, and you got what you deserve. The thing I want to know—the only thing I care about here—is what happens if I put you two in the same combat drop. Do you have each other's backs?" {SCN_MW.Callsign} flashes you a hard look. "Yeah, Commander. Live fire, {TGT_MW.Gender?Male:he's my brother|Female:she's my sister|NonBinary:they're my best bud}." {TGT_MW.Callsign} nods. "We know what's important." "I'm glad to hear it," you say. "Because if you do this again, I'm kicking you both off my ship. Whether there's anything on the other side of the airlock or not."
column2: 你来到医疗舱，和两名受伤的机甲战士谈谈。[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] {TGT_MW.DET} 鼻子上贴着敷料，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] {SCN_MW.DET} 肋骨上围着护具。 看过伤情，你说：“听着，你们两个蠢货是自己作的，活该。我想知道的——这里我唯一在乎的——是我把你们俩放进同一次战斗空投，会怎么样。你们会互相掩护吗？” {SCN_MW.Callsign} 给你一个硬邦邦的眼神。“会，指挥官。实弹交火，{TGT_MW.Gender?Male:he's my brother|Female:she's my sister|NonBinary:they're my best bud}。” {TGT_MW.Callsign} 点点头。“我们分得清轻重。” “我很高兴听到这个，”你说。“因为再发生这种事，我就把你们俩都赶下我的船。不管气闸另一边有没有东西。”

column1: You arrive in MedBay to have a talk with the injured MechWarriors. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] is wearing a dressing around {TGT_MW.DET} head and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]'s right arm hangs in a sling. After surveying the damage, you say, "Look, you idiots did this to yourselves, and you got what you deserve. The thing I want to know—the only thing I care about here—is what happens if I put you two in the same combat drop. Do you have each other's backs?" {SCN_MW.Callsign} shakes {SCN_MW.DET} head ruefully. "Hard to tell right now, I know, but I'm a professional. I'd never let stupid shit like this affect my judgment on the field." {TGT_MW.Callsign} nods. "Yeah. This was play time. War time is a whole different story. {SCN_MW.Callsign} and me, we're good." "I'm glad to hear it," you say. "Because if you do this again, I'm kicking you both off my ship. Whether there's anything on the other side of the airlock or not."
column2: 你来到医疗舱，和两名受伤的机甲战士谈谈。[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] {TGT_MW.DET} 头上缠着敷料，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] {SCN_MW.DET} 右臂吊在吊带里。 看过伤情，你说：“听着，你们两个蠢货是自己作的，活该。我想知道的——这里我唯一在乎的——是我把你们俩放进同一次战斗空投，会怎么样。你们会互相掩护吗？” {SCN_MW.Callsign} 苦涩地摇摇头。“我知道现在看不出什么，但我是职业的。绝不会让这种蠢事影响我在战场上的判断。” {TGT_MW.Callsign} 点点头。“对。那是玩闹的时候。战时完全是另一回事。{SCN_MW.Callsign} 和我，没问题。” “我很高兴听到这个，”你说。“因为再发生这种事，我就把你们俩都赶下我的船。不管气闸另一边有没有东西。”

column1:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] considers for a moment, then reluctantly nods and leaves your quarters.

Later that week, you find [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] arguing with {TGT_MW.OBJ} in the mess over the misdirected letter and {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s apparent dishonesty. They're both upset about what happened, and everyone else in the mess is carefully looking at their own plates.

At the sight of you, {SCN_MW.Callsign} says, "Forget it," and stomps off.
column2:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 想了片刻，不情愿地点点头，离开了你的舱室。

那周晚些时候，你发现 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 在食堂里为那封送错人的信和 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 显然的欺瞒跟 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 争吵。两人都为发生的事难过，食堂里其他人则都小心翼翼地低头盯着自己的盘子。

一看到你，{SCN_MW.Callsign} 丢下一句“算了”，重重地走了。

column1:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] considers for a moment, then reluctantly nods and leaves your quarters.

Later that week, you run into [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] in the mess. {SCN_MW.SUBJ_C} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:seem|Default:seems} far too relaxed to be struggling with a broken heart.

At a table nearby, {TGT_MW.Callsign} catches your eye and shakes {TGT_MW.Det} head. By the circles under {TGT_MW.Det} eyes, you gather that {TGT_MW.Subj} decided to withhold {SCN_MW.Callsign}'s letter, and that the guilt is cutting into {TGT_MW.Det} sleep.
column2:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 想了片刻，不情愿地点点头，离开了你的舱室。

那周晚些时候，你在食堂遇到 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]。{SCN_MW.SUBJ_C} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:seem|Default:seems} 轻松得完全不像正为失恋煎熬的样子。

旁边一张桌子旁，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 对上你的目光，摇了摇 {TGT_MW.Det} 头。看着 {TGT_MW.Det} 眼下的黑眼圈，你猜 {TGT_MW.Subj} 决定扣下了 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 的那封信，而这份愧疚正在侵蚀 {TGT_MW.Det} 的睡眠。

column1:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] considers for a moment, then reluctantly nods and leaves your quarters.

Later that week, you run into [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] in the mess. {SCN_MW.Subj_C} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:seem|Default:seems} distracted, with dark circles under {SCN_MW.Det} eyes. {TGT_MW.Callsign} clearly decided truth was more important than morale. It may take a while before {SCN_MW.Callsign} shakes this off.

At a table nearby, {TGT_MW.Callsign} catches your eye. While it was a tough call, {TGT_MW.Callsign} is clearly at peace with {TGT_MW.Det} decision to not delay the inevitable.
column2:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 想了片刻，不情愿地点点头，离开了你的舱室。

那周晚些时候，你在食堂遇到 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]。{SCN_MW.Subj_C} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:seem|Default:seems} 心不在焉，{SCN_MW.Det} 眼下挂着黑眼圈。{TGT_MW.Callsign} 显然认定真相比士气更重要。{SCN_MW.Callsign} 恐怕得过一阵子才能走出来。

旁边一张桌子旁，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 对上你的目光。虽然这个决定很艰难，但 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 显然已坦然接受了 {TGT_MW.Det} 那个不再拖延、直面必然的选择。

column1:

Later that week, you run into [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] in the mess. {SCN_MW.SUBJ_C} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:seem|Default:seems} far too relaxed to be struggling with a broken heart.

At a table nearby, {TGT_MW.Callsign} catches your eye. By the circles under {TGT_MW.Det} eyes, it looks like {TGT_MW.Subj} followed your advice to withhold {SCN_MW.Callsign}'s letter and it's cutting into {TGT_MW.Det} sleep.
