[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 想了片刻，不情愿地点点头，离开了你的舱室。

那周晚些时候，你在食堂遇到 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]。{SCN_MW.SUBJ_C} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:seem|Default:seems} 轻松得完全不像正为失恋煎熬的样子。

旁边一张桌子旁，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 对上你的目光。看着 {TGT_MW.Det} 眼下的黑眼圈，看来 {TGT_MW.Subj} 听从了你的建议，扣下了 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 的信，而这份愧疚正在侵蚀 {TGT_MW.Det} 的睡眠。

column1: You follow Dr. Murad into Navigation, where Sumire is helping [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] into an EVA suit. Dr. Murad clears her throat. "What do you think you're doing?" "There's some space junk embedded in the Argo's debris shield!" Sumire explains, closing the pressurized helmet. "If it's not removed, it could cause more damage down the line. {TGT_MW.Callsign} volunteered to help." {TGT_MW.Callsign} raises a gloved hand. "It's not just space junk, Commander. The debris could be dangerous if not removed with care." Dr. Murad points at a diagnostic display."It's called a debris shield for a reason. It's doing its job. Please, Commander, if you're not convinced, there are professionals on [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] who can inspect and repair the Argo if need be. There's no reason for {TGT_MW.Callsign} to play the hero."
column2: 你跟着穆拉德博士走进导航室，苏米蕾正在帮 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 穿 EVA 服。 穆拉德博士清了清嗓子。“你以为你在干什么？” “阿戈号的碎片防护盾上嵌了些太空垃圾！”苏米蕾一边合上加压头盔一边解释。“要是不清除，以后可能造成更大的损伤。{TGT_MW.Callsign} 自愿去帮忙。” {TGT_MW.Callsign} 抬起戴着防护手套的手。“这不只是太空垃圾，指挥官。这些东西如果不小心处理，可能有危险。” 穆拉德博士指向一块诊断显示屏。“它叫碎片防护盾是有原因的。它正在履职。指挥官，如果你不放心，[[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] 上有专业人员，必要时可以检查和维修阿戈号。没理由让 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 去逞英雄。”

column1: After deliberating, you watch from a viewscreen as [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], in an EVA suit, floats nimbly across the puckered hull of the DropShip. {TGT_MW.Callsign} gives the wreckage a careful nudge, and it breaks free, drifting far away from the Argo. After {TGT_MW.Callsign} is reeled safely back inside the ship, you review a hull integrity report from Dr. Murad. All systems are unaffected, with no signs of further complications. Throughout the next couple of weeks, you notice that {TGT_MW.Callsign} attends to {TGT_MW.DET} daily tasks with newfound enthusiasm.
column2: 斟酌之后，你通过显示屏看着身穿 EVA 服的 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 灵活地飘过空投艇皱起的船壳。{TGT_MW.Callsign} 小心翼翼地推了推那堆残骸，它脱离开来，飘向远离阿戈号的方向。 等 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 被安全收回船内后，你查看了穆拉德博士的船体完整性报告。所有系统均未受影响，没有进一步问题的迹象。 接下来两周里，你注意到 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 以一种全新的热情对待 {TGT_MW.DET} 日常工作。

column1: After deliberating, you watch with trepidation from a viewscreen as [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], in an EVA suit, struggles across the Argo's hull. The wreckage shifts dangerously in {TGT_MW.DET} hands, breaking apart and spinning free. The debris collides with {TGT_MW.Callsign}, but {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:manage|Default:manages} to bat away the other pieces with a twisted steel rod. {TGT_MW.Callsign} is reeled back inside the Argo. Later, you visit {TGT_MW.OBJ} in the MedBay. "It's likely we'd have lost an entire subsection of the Argo if it hadn't been for you, {TGT_MW.Callsign}," you say. "Anyone else would have hesitated in a situation like that." One of the crew members saved the steel rod from being scrapped, and it's mounted in the barracks with a dedication to {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s batting talents. The MechWarriors elaborate on the tale with each telling.
column2: 斟酌之后，你提心吊胆地通过显示屏看着身穿 EVA 服的 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 在阿戈号船壳上艰难移动。 残骸在 {TGT_MW.DET} 手中危险地挪动，碎裂开来，旋转着飘走。碎片撞上了 {TGT_MW.Callsign}，但 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:manage|Default:manages} 用一根扭弯的钢棒把其他碎片扫开了。 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 被收回阿戈号内。后来，你去医疗舱看望 {TGT_MW.OBJ}。“要不是你，我们很可能会失去阿戈号的一整个分舱段，{TGT_MW.Callsign}，”你说。“换作别人，遇到那种情形都会犹豫。” 一名船员把那根钢棒留了下来，没当废铁处理，它被安放在营房里，附上一段献给 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 挥棒绝技的铭文。机甲战士们每次讲起这个故事，都会添油加醋。

column1: Darius knocks on the door of your quarters. "Commander, we have a problem." You gesture for him to enter.\n\n"[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] has been stealing med supplies and selling them while on shore leave. Morale has been low lately, but theft of company resources is a fireable offense. It's your call, Commander."
column2: 达里乌斯敲响你舱室的门。“指挥官，出问题了。”你示意他进来。\n\n“[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 一直在偷医疗物资，休假时拿去卖。最近士气确实低落，但偷窃公司资源是可以开除的过错。这得你定，指挥官。”

column1: You watch from a viewscreen as [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], in EVA suit, struggles with the low gravity and the oxygen hose anchoring {TGT_MW.OBJ} to the Argo. The wreckage shifts dangerously in {TGT_MW.DET} hands, breaking apart and flying in every direction. The debris collides with {TGT_MW.OBJ} and scrapes against the side of the DropShip.\n\nLater, after you visit {TGT_MW.Callsign} in the MedBay, you receive a hull integrity report from Dr. Murad. "The Mech Bay took serious damage." She sighs. "It could have been worse, but expect power issues while I round up a team to stabilize the ruptured circuitry."
column2: 你通过显示屏看着身穿 EVA 服的 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 在低重力中挣扎，氧气管把 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 拴在阿戈号上。残骸在 {TGT_MW.DET} 手中危险地挪动，碎裂开来，朝四面八方飞散。碎片撞上 {TGT_MW.OBJ}，又刮过空投艇的船侧。\n\n后来，你在医疗舱探望过 {TGT_MW.Callsign}，收到穆拉德博士的船体完整性报告。“机甲库受损严重。”她叹了口气。“本来可能更糟，不过在我召集人手稳定破裂的电路期间，电力供应会出问题。”

column1: I could've handled it, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] argues for a moment, but {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:drop|Default:drops} the subject. "Don't worry, Commander." Sumire pats the control panel. "If the Argo could survive taking off from [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAxylus],Axylus]] with a few holes, then she can handle this." There are no further issues with the Argo, but you notice {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s mind is elsewhere as {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:attend|Default:attends} to {TGT_MW.DET} daily tasks.
column2: “我本来能处理好的，”[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 争辩了一句，但 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:drop|Default:drops} 就把话题放下了。 “别担心，指挥官。”苏米蕾拍了拍控制面板。“既然阿戈号带着几个窟窿从[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAxylus],Axylus]]起飞都能活下来，这点事她扛得住。” 阿戈号再没出什么问题，但你注意到 {TGT_MW.Callsign} {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:attend|Default:attends} {TGT_MW.DET} 日常工作时，心思明显不在上面。

column1: I thought you trusted me, Commander, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] mutters, visibly sagging, but {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:drop|Default:drops} the subject as you and Sumire continue planning.\n\nSometime later, you find a reasonably priced crew to fly up from [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] to remove the debris from the Argo. There are no further issues with the Argo, but you notice {TGT_MW.Callsign} lingering in the observation deck for the next couple of weeks, {TGT_MW.DET} gaze fixed on the debris shield. {TGT_MW.DET_C} mind is elsewhere as {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:attend|Default:attends} to {TGT_MW.DET} daily tasks.
column2: “我还以为你信任我，指挥官，”[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 低声说，整个人明显垮了下来，但 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:drop|Default:drops} 就把话放下，任你和苏米蕾继续筹划。\n\n过了一阵，你找到一支价格合理的队伍，从 [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] 飞上来清除阿戈号上的碎片。阿戈号再没出什么问题，但你注意到接下来两周里 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 常在观景甲板上逗留，{TGT_MW.DET} 目光紧盯着碎片防护盾。{TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:attend|Default:attends} {TGT_MW.DET} 日常工作时，{TGT_MW.DET_C} 心思全在别处。

column1: After deliberating, you watch from a viewscreen as [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], in an EVA suit, bounces and floats across the Argo. {TGT_MW.Callsign} wrenches the debris from the shielding with a kick and a push, and the jagged metal scrap shakes loose and floats safely away. After {TGT_MW.Callsign} is reeled safely back inside the Argo, you review a hull integrity report from Dr. Murad. All systems are functioning at high capacity. Throughout the next couple weeks, you notice that {TGT_MW.Callsign} attends to {TGT_MW.DET} daily tasks with newfound enthusiasm. When you call the MechWarriors, {TGT_MW.Callsign} is first to line up.
column2: 斟酌之后，你通过显示屏看着身穿 EVA 服的 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 在阿戈号外弹跳、漂浮。{TGT_MW.Callsign} 连踢带推，把碎片从防护盾上撬下来，那团参差不齐的金属残片松动脱落，安全地飘远。 等 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 被安全收回阿戈号内，你查看了穆拉德博士的船体完整性报告。所有系统都处于高效运转状态。 接下来两周里，你注意到 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 以一种全新的热情对待 {TGT_MW.DET} 日常工作。你召集机甲战士时，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 总是第一个列队。

column1: Before [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] can finish the deal, security forces swarm the exchange point. {TGT_MW.Callsign} is left holding the bag by {TGT_MW.DET} contact.\n\nThe planetary authorities demand a hefty fine for {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s release. After paying, your dejected MechWarrior returns to the shuttle empty-handed.
column2: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 还没来得及完成交易，安全部队就包围了交换地点。{TGT_MW.DET} 联系人把烂摊子甩给了 {TGT_MW.Callsign}。\n\n行星当局要求为释放 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 缴纳巨额罚款。付完钱后，你沮丧的机甲战士两手空空地回到穿梭机上。

column1:
When {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:disembark|Default:disembarks} from the returning shore leave shuttle, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] trots right over to you and Darius.

"Commander, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] and I were out drinking and a local MechWarrior bought us a round. He starts asking about our company, but not like he's looking for a job. More like he wants to know about you." {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:pause|Default:pauses}, uncertain.

Darius prods {TGT_MW.Obj}. "Go on, you're not in trouble. Cut to the end."

"Well, he offered us money for information about any more work we do in the system. I blew him off and left, but {SCN_MW.Callsign} stayed."
column2:
当 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:disembark|Default:disembarks} 从休假归来的穿梭机上下来，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 小跑着直奔你和达里乌斯。

“指挥官，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 和我出去喝酒，有个本地的机甲战士请了我们一轮。他开始打听我们公司，可不像是在找工作。更像是在打听你。”{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:pause|Default:pauses} 地停住了，有些迟疑。

达里乌斯催 {TGT_MW.Obj}。“说吧，你没惹麻烦。直接说结尾。”

“嗯，他出钱想买我们在本星系后续行动的情报。我没理他，走了，但 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 留下了。”

column1:
That afternoon, when you arrive in Darius' office, you find [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] fidgeting in a stiff chair, expression shifting between nervous and defiant.

Darius walks over, scratching the back of his head. "Commander… {SCN_MW.SUBJ} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:say|Default:says} that {SCN_MW.SUBJ} didn't didn't take the bait, but the story doesn't add up."

"We'll be out of the system soon enough. Put {SCN_MW.Obj} on a full schedule of kitchen duties for a few weeks. Under close supervision. Better safe than sorry."
column2:
那天下午，你走进达里乌斯的办公室，发现 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 在硬邦邦的椅子上坐立不安，表情忽而紧张忽而倔强。

达里乌斯走过来，挠了挠后脑勺。“指挥官……{SCN_MW.SUBJ} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:say|Default:says} 说 {SCN_MW.SUBJ} 没上钩，但这套说法对不上。”

“我们很快就要离开这个星系了。把 {SCN_MW.Obj} 排满厨房值勤，几周时间，严格监督。小心驶得万年船。”

column1: That afternoon, when you arrive in Darius' office, a peal of laughter tells you that the interview has gone well. [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] lifts an imaginary glass with a smirk. "Then I had him add all the MechTechs to his bar tab. And you know how much they can drink!" Darius chuckles and greets you. "Commander, we're all good here. {SCN_MW.DET_C} story checks out." You nod. "I see." A stern look in the direction of {SCN_MW.Callsign} shuts {SCN_MW.OBJ} up mid-laugh. "It would've been easier on everyone if you'd mentioned this right away." You pause for effect before continuing. "So… how much do you think he wound up spending on those drinks?"
column2: 那天下午，你走进达里乌斯的办公室，一阵大笑告诉你：这次问询进行得很顺利。 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 得意地举起一只假想的酒杯。“然后我让他把所有机甲技师的账都记在他那桌。你也知道他们喝起来有多凶！” 达里乌斯笑着招呼你。“指挥官，这边一切都没问题。{SCN_MW.DET_C} 说法对得上。” 你点点头。“我明白了。”你朝 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 方向严厉地看了一眼，{SCN_MW.OBJ} 的笑声戛然而止。“要是你当时马上说出来，对大家都省事。”你停顿一下制造效果，才继续道。“那么……你猜他最后为那些酒花了多少钱？”

column1: The MechWarrior nods, salutes and leaves without a word.\n\nLater that week, Darius reports in. "Whatever you told [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] seems to have worked. The Mech Bay is quiet and productive again. Well… as quiet as the Mech Bay can be, anyway."
column2: 那名机甲战士点点头，敬了个礼，一言不发地离开了。\n\n那周稍晚，达里乌斯来汇报。“不管你跟 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 说了什么，看来都起作用了。机甲库又恢复了安静与效率。呃……至少算是机甲库能达到的安静水平。”

column1:
You rest a hand on [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s shoulder. "You did the right thing by telling us. We'll take it from here."

After {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:leave|Default:leaves}, Darius speaks his mind. "Honestly, I don't care if we've rattled a few cages here in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}."

You agree. "Might help with closing more contracts while we're here if we're the big 'Mech on the block."

Later in the week, Darius reports that he's managed to turn this to his advantage by charging 'non-refundable negotiation fees' just to present a contract to the company. "I should try this more often."
column2:
你把手搭在 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 肩上。“你把这件事告诉我们做得对。接下来交给我们。”

等 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:leave|Default:leaves} 之后，达里乌斯说出了心里话。“说实话，我不在乎我们有没有在 {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} 这儿得罪谁。”

你表示同意。“要是我们在这儿是块头最大的那台机甲，也许能帮我们多签几个合约。”

那周稍晚，达里乌斯汇报说，他已把这事变成了优势：光是向公司提交一份合约，就要收取“不可退还的谈判费”。“这招我该多用用。”

column1:
You rest a hand on [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] shoulder. "You did the right thing telling us. Darius and I may just take this stranger up on his offer."

{TGT_MW.DET_C} brow furrows, confused. Darius laughs. "Don't worry. We'll tell you exactly what to say, and you'll work with Sumire to send the messages. All above board. You go on and join the others."

After {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:leave|Default:leaves}, you whirl towards Darius, a half-formed idea gaining traction. "Are you thinking what I'm thinking? There's a thriving black market here in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}…"

That's all you had to say. You can see his clever brain churning. "I was already planning to confuse these jokers with a disinformation campaign. But you're right! Whoever they are, they'll have enemies, and we can put everyone right where we want them."

You give a nod to Darius. "I've always liked how you think. Make it happen."
column2:
你把手搭在 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 肩上。“你把这件事告诉我们做得对。达里乌斯和我或许真会接受这个陌生人的提议。”

{TGT_MW.DET_C} 皱起眉，一脸困惑。达里乌斯笑了。“别担心。我们会告诉你该说什么，你和苏米蕾一起把消息发出去。全都在明面上。你去和其他人待着吧。”

等 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:leave|Default:leaves} 之后，你转向达里乌斯，一个半成形的念头逐渐清晰。“你在想我想的那件事吗？{TGT_SYSTEM.Name} 这儿有一片兴旺的黑市……”

你只说了这一句。能看出他聪明的脑子转了起来。“我本来就打算用一场假情报战把这帮家伙搅糊涂。但你说得对！不管他们是谁，总会有敌人，我们可以把所有人摆到我们想要的位置上。”

你朝达里乌斯点点头。“我一直很喜欢你的思路。去办吧。”

column1: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] enters your quarters and snaps to attention, glancing between you and Darius. Darius stares the MechWarrior down. "We've had a complaint about you, soldier. Causing trouble in the Mech Bay?" "That MechTech's got a grudge against me, sir. My 'Mech's been opened up for way longer than anybody else's, and for no good reason. I was just trying to get things moving." Darius glances at you. "Are you buying this, Commander?"
column2: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 走进你的舱室，啪地立正，目光在你和达里乌斯之间游移。达里乌斯盯着这名机甲战士。“我们接到对你的投诉，士兵。在机甲库惹麻烦？” “那个机甲技师跟我有仇，长官。我的‘机甲’比谁的都开膛更久，而且毫无道理。我只是想把进度推起来。” 达里乌斯看了你一眼。“你信这套吗，指挥官？”

column1:
Later that week, Darius arrives in your quarters unannounced. You've rarely seen him in a darker mood.

"Commander, I asked Sumire to monitor outbound messaging, and she intercepted a planet-bound message in the middle of the night. Together, we cracked the encryption—it was from [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] to parties unknown."

"Well, we agreed what the stakes were before we went down this path. I'll have Sumire take {SCN_MW.Callsign} back to the planet and leave {SCN_MW.Obj} there."
column2:
那周稍晚，达里乌斯没打招呼就来到你的舱室。你很少见他情绪这么糟。

“指挥官，我让苏米蕾监视对外通讯，她半夜截获了一条发往行星方向的讯息。我们一起破解了加密——是 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 发给身份不明的人。”

“这个嘛，走上这条路之前我们就说好了代价。我会让苏米蕾把 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 送回行星，把 {SCN_MW.Obj} 留在那儿。”

column1:
You hop the counter, and {SCN_MW.Callsign} follows your lead. The two of you grab [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s arms and force {TGT_MW.OBJ} to release the line cook. She backs away, rubbing her arm.

{TGT_MW.Callsign} shakes you off, and turns on you, but you can see the exact moment when {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:realize|Default:realizes} what will happen if {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:attack|Default:attacks} you. Then {SCN_MW.Callsign} wrestles {TGT_MW.OBJ} to the ground, and it's all over. All that remains is the need to enforce discipline.

Soon enough, you have {TGT_MW.Callsign} meekly apologizing to the crewmember {TGT_MW.SUBJ} assaulted. Then {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:return|Default:returns} to the barracks, where {TGT_MW.SUBJ} will stay for the next two weeks.
column2:
你翻过配餐台，{SCN_MW.Callsign} 跟着你的动作。你们两人抓住 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 的胳膊，迫使 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 松开了那名流水线厨工。她揉着胳膊往后退。

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 甩开你，转向你，但你能清楚看到 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:realize|Default:realizes} 到，要是 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:attack|Default:attacks} 你，会有什么下场的那个瞬间。接着 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 把 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 摔倒在地，事情就此结束。剩下的只有执行纪律。

很快，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 便乖乖向 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} 袭击的那名船员道歉。然后 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:return|Default:returns} 回营房，{TGT_MW.SUBJ} 接下来两周都得待在那儿。

column1:
You and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] both grab at [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s arms. {TGT_MW.Callsign} shoves the cook away, then wrenches free to furiously turn on {SCN_MW.Callsign}. There's a thud as they slam into the counter and both MechWarriors fall, still grappling.

You try to haul {TGT_MW.Callsign} off of {SCN_MW.Callsign}, but it isn't until Darius arrives that you and he can separate the two. When {TGT_MW.Callsign} snarls at you, you deck {TGT_MW.Obj}.

Then you help {SCN_MW.Callsign} up. {SCN_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:look|Default:looks} disoriented, with purpling bruises and a lump on {SCN_MW.Det} head. "Come on, {SCN_MW.Callsign}. Let's get you to MedBay."

As you guide {SCN_MW.Callsign} out, Darius calls to you. "Any opinions for how I deal with this idiot, Commander?"

You cast a glance backward. "Get {TGT_MW.Obj} to Medbay, too. After that, I don't want to see {TGT_MW.Obj} again for at least a few weeks."

The cook, still behind her counter, nods approvingly.
column2:
你和 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 一起抓住 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 的胳膊。{TGT_MW.Callsign} 一把推开厨工，然后挣脱开来，怒冲冲地扑向 {SCN_MW.Callsign}。砰的一声，两人撞在配餐台上，双双倒地，仍扭打在一起。

你试图把 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 从 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 身上拽开，但直到达里乌斯赶到，你们俩合力才把两人分开。{TGT_MW.Callsign} 冲你龇牙时，你一拳把 {TGT_MW.Obj} 打倒在地。

然后你扶起 {SCN_MW.Callsign}。{SCN_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:look|Default:looks} 得晕头转向，身上青肿发紫，{SCN_MW.Det} 头上还鼓起一块。“来吧，{SCN_MW.Callsign}。我送你去医疗舱。”

你扶着 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 往外走时，达里乌斯喊住你。“你对我怎么处置这个白痴有什么意见，指挥官？”

你回头瞥了一眼。“把 {TGT_MW.Obj} 也送到医疗舱去。之后，至少几周之内我不想再看到 {TGT_MW.Obj}。”

那名厨工仍站在配餐台后面，赞许地点了点头。

column1: Darius arrives behind you as you come to a decision. You look the crazed MechWarrior in the eye and raise your voice to a bark of command. "We DO NOT assault our support crew, EVER. Darius, get this idiot off of my ship." [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] releases the cook and stares at you in shock. "Commander, I didn't…" "Save it, {TGT_MW.Callsign}," hisses Darius. "Let's go clean out your bunk." {TGT_MW.Subj_C} quietly {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:follow|Default:follows} Darius out of the mess as you turn your attention to the cook. She glances at the shocked diners, gives you a solemn nod of gratitude, and then begins cleaning up the spilled food.
column2: 你做出决定时，达里乌斯从后面赶到了。你直视那名失控的机甲战士的眼睛，提高嗓门厉声下令。“我们绝不许攻击自己的支援人员。达里乌斯，把这个白痴赶下我的船。” [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 松开了厨工，震惊地盯着你。“指挥官，我没有……” “省省吧，{TGT_MW.Callsign}，”达里乌斯嘶声道。“走，去清你的铺位。” {TGT_MW.Subj_C} 默默 {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:follow|Default:follows} 达里乌斯走出食堂，你则把注意力转向那名厨工。她瞥了一眼惊呆的食客们，庄重地向你点头致谢，然后开始清理撒落的食物。

column1: {TGT_MW.FirstName} {TGT_MW.LastName}! That cook is a member of your crew. In this company, we don't attack our teammates. Now let her go and get over here. Let her go. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] breathes hard, then shoves the cook away. She vanishes to the kitchen while [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] grabs {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s shoulders and forces {TGT_MW.OBJ} into a chair. You loom over {TGT_MW.OBJ} and present a stinging fifteen-minute lecture. Darius arrives halfway through, but he stands back in respect. By the end, {TGT_MW.Callsign} is contrite and submissive—and confined to barracks for two weeks. When you check on the cook, she tartly informs you that she's fine. She wouldn't be on the ship if she couldn't cope with the occasional MechWarrior tantrum.
column2: “{TGT_MW.FirstName} {TGT_MW.LastName}！那名厨工是你的船员中的一员。在这家公司里，我们不攻击自己的队友。放开她，到这儿来。放开她。” [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 喘着粗气，随后一把把厨工推开。她闪进厨房，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 则抓住 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 的肩膀，把 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 按进椅子里。 你居高临下地对 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 训了刻薄的十五分钟。达里乌斯中途赶到，却出于尊重站在后面没插话。到最后，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 又悔又服帖——并禁闭在营房两周。 你去看那名厨工时，她干脆利落地说自己没事。要是连机甲战士偶尔发次脾气都应付不了，她也不会在这艘船上。

column1: Later that week, Darius arrives in your quarters, unannounced and in a thoughtful mood. "Commander, Sumire's been monitoring outbound messaging and she's seen nothing unusual. But she did notice [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] lurking around the communications room for a couple of days." Darius scratches his chin. "My read on the situation? {SCN_MW.SUBJ_C} either lost {SCN_MW.DET} nerve, or decided against it. Either way, I think we're okay." Raising your eyebrows, you say. "Good to know that fear or conscience outweighed greed… for today, at least. Nevertheless, I'd like to see {SCN_MW.CALLSIGN} assigned some particularly miserable chores around the Argo for the next month."
column2: 那周稍晚，达里乌斯没打招呼就来到你的舱室，一副若有所思的样子。 “指挥官，苏米蕾一直在监视对外通讯，没发现异常。但她注意到 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 连着几天在通讯室附近转悠。” 达里乌斯挠了挠下巴。“我的判断是？{SCN_MW.SUBJ_C} 要么是临阵丢了 {SCN_MW.DET} 胆量，要么是自己放弃了。不管哪种，我想我们没事。” 你挑了挑眉。“很高兴知道恐惧或良心压过了贪心……至少是今天。不过，我还是想让 {SCN_MW.CALLSIGN} 接下来一个月在阿戈号上干些格外苦的杂活。”

column1: You rest a hand on [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s shoulder. "Good job. You go on and join the others." After {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:leave|Default:leaves}, Darius muses. "I like that we've rattled a few cages here in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. What I like even better is the idea of making a few C-Bills on the side with a disinformation campaign." You nod, "I was thinking the same thing. Make it happen, preferably while [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] is engaged in some particularly miserable chores around the Argo."
column2: 你把手搭在 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 肩上。“干得好。你去和其他人待着吧。” 等 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:leave|Default:leaves} 之后，达里乌斯沉吟道。“我喜欢我们在 {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} 这儿得罪了几个人的感觉。我更喜欢的是，顺手用一场假情报战赚点星币。” 你点点头。“我也这么想。去办吧，最好趁 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 正在阿戈号上干那些格外苦的杂活的时候。”

column1:
After receiving a message about a 'situation on the mess deck,' you find yourself in the middle of a crisis. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] stands on the wrong side of the galley counter, holding a terrified cook by the arm and snarling. [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] approaches, hands raised. "You've gotta let her go, {TGT_MW.Callsign}. She didn't mean anything."

As you step over a fallen lunch tray, the cook gasps, "Commander!" 

{TGT_MW.Callsign} looks at you, still squeezing the cook's arm. "You didn't hear her, Commander. You didn't see her face!"
column2:
收到一条关于“食堂甲板出事了”的消息后，你发现自己置身于一场危机正中。[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 站在配餐台错误的一侧，抓着一脸惊恐的厨工的手臂，低声咆哮。[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 举起双手靠近。“你得放开她，{TGT_MW.Callsign}。她没什么恶意。”

你跨过一个掉在地上的午餐托盘时，那名厨工喘着气喊道：“指挥官！”

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 看着你，手仍死死攥着厨工的胳膊。“你没听见她说什么，指挥官。你没看见她那副嘴脸！”

column1:
When a crowd of Mechwarriors return from shore leave, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] trots over to you and Darius, frowning.

"Commander, I was out drinking when a stranger offered to buy the next round. He started asking about our company, but I could tell that he already knew about us. About you." {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:pause|Default:pauses}, uncertain.

Darius prods {TGT_MW.Obj}. "Go on, you're not in trouble. Yet. Cut to the end."

{TGT_MW.Callsign} clears {TGT_MW.Det} throat. "He provided a method for secure communication and offered to pay for information about any more contracts we take in the system."
column2:
一群机甲战士休假归来时，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 皱着眉小跑到你和达里乌斯面前。

“指挥官，我在外面喝酒，有个陌生人提出请下一轮。他开始打听我们公司，但我看得出他早就知道我们的事。知道你的事。”{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:pause|Default:pauses} 地顿住，有些迟疑。

达里乌斯催 {TGT_MW.Obj}。“说吧，你还没惹麻烦。暂时。直接说结尾。”

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 清了清 {TGT_MW.Det} 嗓子。“他给了一种安全通讯的方式，并提出出钱买我们在本星系后续接的合约情报。”

column1: Everyone aboard the Argo snaps into action. Yang and Murad prepare their staff to deal with any technical problems as they arise. Sumire tracks the incoming debris, and everyone else gets ready for a bumpy ride. Finally, there's nothing more to wait for. The Argo is rocked by impact after impact, the clatter interspersed with cursing from the comms.\n\nThen the Argo is through and the noise fades. Darius announces, "Commander, the Mech Bay suffered extensive damage. So did the Barracks, including an injury to [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]."
column2: 阿戈号上所有人立刻行动起来。杨和穆拉德安排手下随时应对可能出现的各种技术故障。苏米蕾追踪迎面而来的碎片流，其他人则做好颠簸的准备。终于，没什么可再等待的了。阿戈号一次又一次被撞击震动，噼啪的撞击声中夹杂着通讯里传来的咒骂。\n\n随后阿戈号穿了过去，噪音渐渐消散。达里乌斯宣布：“指挥官，机甲库受损严重。营房也一样，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 还受了伤。”

column1:
In an unused corridor near Gamma Pod, Darius shows you a strange chart written on the wall in chalk. Each row lists a MechWarrior callsign, and in the columns next to each name: a percentage and a number in C-Bills.

As you compare the C-Bill values and the relative experience of the MechWarriors listed, you realize that this is a perverse betting pool. The percentages must represent the survival odds for each MechWarrior.

Just then [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] rounds the corner and stops short. A stick of chalk falls from {TGT_MW.DET} fingers and snaps on the floor.
column2:
在 Gamma 舱段附近一条废弃走廊里，达里乌斯给你看墙上用粉笔画的一张奇怪表格。每一行写着一个机甲战士的代号，每行名字旁边的栏目里是一个百分比和一个以星币计的数字。

你把这些星币数值和表上机甲战士的相对经验一比，意识到这是一个扭曲的赌局。那些百分比必定代表每个机甲战士的生还概率。

就在这时，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 拐过墙角，猛地停住。一根粉笔从 {TGT_MW.DET} 指间掉落，在地板上摔断。

column1: [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] approaches you on the mess deck. "Commander, you know how [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] is sidelined in MedBay? I've been visiting {TGT_MW.OBJ}, trying to keep {TGT_MW.DET} morale up and, well, {TGT_MW.SUBJ}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'re|Default:'s} really messed up. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:think|Default:thinks} the injury was {TGT_MW.DET} own fault. Maybe you could do something?"\n\nResting a hand on {SCN_MW.Callsign} shoulder, you say, "Thanks for letting me know, {SCN_MW.Callsign}. I'll see what I can do."
column2: [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 在食堂甲板上找到你。“指挥官，你知道 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 因为养伤待在医疗舱吧？我一直去看 {TGT_MW.OBJ}，想让 {TGT_MW.DET} 情绪好一点，可……{TGT_MW.SUBJ}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'re|Default:'s} 状态真的很糟。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:think|Default:thinks} 这次受伤是 {TGT_MW.DET} 自己的错。也许你能做点什么？”\n\n你把手搭在 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 肩上，说：“谢谢你告诉我，{SCN_MW.Callsign}。我会看看能做些什么。”

column1: Everyone aboard the Argo snaps into action. Techs prep the Leopard for takeoff, the bridge crew tracks the incoming debris, and everyone else secures breakables. At last, the Leopard pushes away from the docking collar, spirals gracefully towards the debris cloud, its weapons spitting fire in all directions.\n\nThere's shuddering and banging as the Argo passes through the cloud. Then it's past and the clatter fades away. Darius announces, "Commander, the Mech Bay suffered extensive damage, and [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] took a minor injury aboard the Leopard."
column2: 阿戈号上所有人立刻行动起来。技师们为豹式做好起飞准备，舰桥人员追踪迎面而来的碎片流，其他人则把易碎物品固定好。终于，豹式脱离对接环，优雅地旋转着朝碎片云飞去，武器向四面八方喷射火舌。\n\n阿戈号穿过碎片云时震动不断、砰砰作响。随后它穿了过去，噼啪声渐渐消散。达里乌斯宣布：“指挥官，机甲库受损严重，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 在豹式上受了点轻伤。”

column1: Everyone aboard the Argo snaps into action. Techs prep the Leopard for takeoff, the bridge crew tracks the incoming debris, and everyone else secures breakables. At last, the Leopard pushes away from the docking collar, spirals gracefully towards the debris cloud, its weapons spitting fire in all directions.\n\nThere's shuddering and banging as the Argo passes through the cloud. Then it's past and the clatter fades away. Darius announces, "Commander, both the Mech Bay and the Barracks suffered extensive damage, and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] was wounded."
column2: 阿戈号上所有人立刻行动起来。技师们为豹式做好起飞准备，舰桥人员追踪迎面而来的碎片流，其他人则把易碎物品固定好。终于，豹式脱离对接环，优雅地旋转着朝碎片云飞去，武器向四面八方喷射火舌。\n\n阿戈号穿过碎片云时震动不断、砰砰作响。随后它穿了过去，噼啪声渐渐消散。达里乌斯宣布：“指挥官，机甲库和营房都受损严重，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 也受了伤。”

column1: Everyone aboard the Argo snaps into action. Techs prep the Leopard for action, the bridge crew tracks the incoming debris, and everyone else secures breakables. At last, the Leopard pushes away from the docking collar, spirals gracefully towards the debris cloud, and its weapons erupt into action.\n\nThere's shuddering and banging as the Argo passes through the cloud. Then it's past and the clatter fades away. Darius announces, "Commander, the MedBay suffered extensive damage. Also [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] took a minor injury aboard the Leopard."
column2: 阿戈号上所有人立刻行动起来。技师们为豹式做好行动准备，舰桥人员追踪迎面而来的碎片流，其他人则把易碎物品固定好。终于，豹式脱离对接环，优雅地旋转着朝碎片云飞去，武器骤然开火。\n\n阿戈号穿过碎片云时震动不断、砰砰作响。随后它穿了过去，噼啪声渐渐消散。达里乌斯宣布：“指挥官，医疗舱受损严重。另外 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 在豹式上受了点轻伤。”

column1:
Later in the day, you arrive in the MedBay and find [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] in bed, just starting at the ceiling. "Hey, Commander. I didn't expect you to come by."

"I need you back on your feet, {TGT_MW.Callsign}," you say. "This—" You make a vague gesture at the MedBay and {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s condition. "This happens to MechWarriors, but it's just bad luck. It doesn't mean anything."

"Yeah, I guess so."

"Good! Recover fast, because you've got work to do."

{TGT_MW.Callsign} cracks a smile. "Will do, Commander."
column2:
当天稍晚，你来到医疗舱，发现 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 躺在床上，呆呆地望着天花板。“嘿，指挥官。没想到你会来。”

“我需要你重新站起来，{TGT_MW.Callsign}，”你说。“这个——”你对着医疗舱和 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 的状况含糊地比划了一下。“这种事机甲战士都会碰上，只是运气不好。说明不了什么。”

“嗯，大概吧。”

“那就好！快点康复，你还有活要干。”

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 露出一丝笑容。“没问题，指挥官。”

column1:
You pick up a datapad with some huge stack of book chips on your way over to MedBay. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] opens {TGT_MW.DET} eyes as you enter. "Commander? I wasn't expecting visitors today."

"I just thought you might appreciate something to take your mind off things," you say, setting the datapad and the chips on the table beside {TGT_MW.OBJ}. "I didn't mean to interrupt your rest."

After a few minutes of conversation, you take you leave so {TGT_MW.Callsign} can go back to sleep.
column2:
去医疗舱的路上，你顺手拿了一块数据板和一大摞书芯片。你走进去时，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 睁开了 {TGT_MW.DET} 眼睛。“指挥官？我今天没料到会有访客。”

“我只是想你可能需要点东西分分心，”你说着，把数据板和芯片放在 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 床边的桌上。“不是有意打搅你休息。”

聊了几分钟后，你起身告辞，让 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 继续睡。

You pick up a datapad with some book and holovid chips on your way over to MedBay. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] is already reading from a datapad as you enter. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:look|Default:looks} up. "Oh, Commander. Were you bringing that stuff for me? Just put it over there."

Every flat surface near {TGT_MW.DET} bed is covered with books, datapads, and snacks from the mess-hall. Is that a stuffed animal?

It would appear that [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] has rallied more than just you to help {TGT_MW.DET} friend recover.
column2:
去医疗舱的路上，你顺手拿了一块数据板和几枚书芯片、全息影像芯片。你走进去时，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 已经在看数据板了。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:look|Default:looks} 起头。“哦，指挥官。那些是带给我的吗？放那边就行。”

{TGT_MW.DET} 床边的每一处平面都堆满了书、数据板和从食堂拿来的零食。那是个毛绒玩偶吗？

看来 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 发动的不只是你来帮 {TGT_MW.DET} 这位朋友康复。

column1: Later in the day, you delegate the task to Darius. "Please drop by MedBay and check in on [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. Remind {TGT_MW.OBJ} that these things happen, and that {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:they're|Male:he's|Female:she's} still an important member of the crew."\n\nThe next day, Darius shares an update. "I managed to cheer up {TGT_MW.Callsign}. I think {TGT_MW.SUBJ} just needed to hear some encouragement from someone other than a MechWarrior or a doctor."
column2: 当天稍晚，你把这件事交给达里乌斯。“请顺路去医疗舱看看 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。提醒 {TGT_MW.OBJ}，这种事难免，而且 {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:they're|Male:he's|Female:she's} 依然是船员中重要的一员。”\n\n第二天，达里乌斯带来了进展。“我总算让 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 打起精神了。我想 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} 只是需要听到机甲战士和医生以外的人给些鼓励。”

column1: Later in the day, you arrive in the MedBay and find [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] in bed, just starting at the ceiling. "Hey, Commander. I didn't expect you to come by." "You'll be back on your feet in no time, {TGT_MW.Callsign}." {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:shrug|Default:shrugs}, then {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:wince|Default:winces} in pain. "Maybe. I don't know. I feel like this happened for a reason." After fifteen minutes, you're unable to lift the cloud over {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s mood, so you bid {TGT_MW.OBJ} a speedy recovery and retreat.

column1: Darius arrives behind you as you come to a decision. You look the crazed MechWarrior in the eye and raise your voice to a bark of command. "We DO NOT assault our support crew, EVER. Darius, get this idiot off of my ship." {TGT_MW.Callsign} releases the cook and begins yelling at you instead. "You can't do that! I'm the best MechWarrior you've got! If you get rid of me, this company will be sunk!" At your signal, Darius and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] strongarm {TGT_MW.OBJ} off the mess deck. As the ranting disappears into the distance, you attend to the cook. She glances at the shocked diners, gives you a solemn nod of gratitude, and then begins cleaning up the spilled food.
column2: 你做出决定时，达里乌斯从后面赶到了。你直视那名失控的机甲战士的眼睛，提高嗓门厉声下令。“我们绝不许攻击自己的支援人员。达里乌斯，把这个白痴赶下我的船。” {TGT_MW.Callsign} 松开厨工，转而冲你大喊。“你不能这么做！我是你手上最好的机甲战士！你赶走我，这家公司就完了！” 你一个示意，达里乌斯和 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 便强行把 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 架出食堂甲板。叫骂声在远处渐渐消失，你则去照看那名厨工。她瞥了一眼惊呆的食客们，庄重地向你点头致谢，然后开始清理撒落的食物。

column1: You shrug and give [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] an encouraging smile. "As long as you keep taking care of our crew, then we can forget about your side business." {TGT_MW.Callsign} inclines {TGT_MW.DET} head, grinning."It just so happens that I ended up with a couple cases of [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTimbiquiDark],Timbiqui Dark]] and some beautiful ribeyes. We'll have a feast tonight, Commander." Lured by the aroma of seared steaks and boisterous voices, the entire crew ends up gathering in the mess. At some point, {TGT_MW.Callsign} drunkenly shouts, "Wait until you see what's next!" After the celebration, laughter and high spirits linger on the Argo. And {TGT_MW.Callsign} spends more and more time in the cargo hold, preparing for the next big payday.
column2: 你耸耸肩，给 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 一个鼓励的笑容。“只要你继续照顾好我们的船员，你那点副业我们就当没看见。” {TGT_MW.Callsign} 歪着 {TGT_MW.DET} 头笑了。“巧了，我刚好弄到几箱[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTimbiquiDark],Timbiqui Dark]]和几块漂亮的肋眼牛排。今晚我们办场宴席吧，指挥官。” 烤牛排的香气和喧闹的人声把全体船员都引到了食堂。席间某个时刻，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 醉醺醺地大喊：“等着看下一波好东西吧！” 庆祝之后，笑声与高涨的情绪在阿戈号上久久不散。而 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 越来越多地待在货舱里，为下一次大赚一笔做准备。

column1:
No harm. No foul. You shrug, but your expression remains serious. "I'm going to forget this entire conversation, but be careful, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. I don't want to see anything happen to you."

Later in the week, Darius reports in with a sigh. "I've got bad news, Commander. {TGT_MW.Callsign} got played by {TGT_MW.DET} contact. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} sent off some cargo and never got paid."

"It could be a lot worse, Darius."

"No doubt. I'm garnishing {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s wages for a month to make up for the loss. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'re|Default:'s} upset, mostly about getting screwed, but {TGT_MW.SUBJ}'ll snap out of it in due time."
column2:
“没人受伤，就不算过错。”你耸耸肩，表情却依然严肃。“这次对话我会整个忘掉，但你要小心，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。我不想看到你出事。”

那周稍晚，达里乌斯叹着气来汇报。“有坏消息，指挥官。{TGT_MW.Callsign} 被 {TGT_MW.DET} 联系人骗了。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} 把一批货发了出去，钱却一分没收到。”

“这已经算好的了，达里乌斯。”

“没错。我会扣 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 一个月的薪水来弥补损失。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'re|Default:'s} 很不高兴，主要是气自己被耍了，不过 {TGT_MW.SUBJ}'ll 迟早会缓过来的。”

column1: You narrow your eyes at [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. "You don't know where those C-bills came from. They could be marked. No more back alley deals until I can trust you and your contacts." "I've been keeping spirits high!" {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:blurt|Default:blurts} out. "Those profits were paying for the crew's steaks and booze. They won't be pleased." "They're mercenaries; they've endured worse than the Argo's kitchen." You shake your head. "I don't want you to even look at the cargo bay for the next month. You're under a strict probation." You dismiss {TGT_MW.Callsign} before {TGT_MW.SUBJ} can say anything else.
column2: 你眯眼看着 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。“你不知道那些星币从哪来的。它们可能被做过标记。在我能信任你和你的线人之前，不许再搞什么后巷交易。” “我一直在给大家鼓劲啊！”{TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:blurt|Default:blurts} 口而出。“那些利润都给船员买牛排和酒了。他们会不高兴的。” “他们是雇佣兵；比阿戈号的厨房更难熬的日子都挺过来了。”你摇摇头。“接下来一个月，你连看都不许看货舱一眼。你在严格察看期内。” {TGT_MW.SUBJ} 还没再说出什么，你就让 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 退下了。

column1: In your quarters, Darius crosses his arms. "You know, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] has been throwing these parties for the crew and I finally figured out how {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:were|Default:was} paying for them. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'re|Default:'s} selling our small arms and—" {TGT_MW.Callsign} bursts through the door. "We don't even use those dusty rifles! The [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTCE],T.C.E.]] pays way more than standard market prices. I dump the guns and buy cheap but high quality replacements. A portion of the profits funds these little morale boosting events I've been hosting. Everybody wins!" "Were you waiting outside this whole time? Don't answer that." Darius shakes his head in disbelief. "Look, if the outfit got a proper cut that'd be one thing, but that's up to the Commander."
column2: 在你的舱室里，达里乌斯抱起双臂。“你知道吗，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 一直在给船员办这些聚会，我终于弄明白 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:were|Default:was} 是怎么付账的了。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'re|Default:'s} 在卖我们的轻武器，而且——” {TGT_MW.Callsign} 猛地推门进来。“那些落灰的步枪我们根本不用！[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTCE],T.C.E.]] 出的价远高于市场价。我把枪倒掉，再买进便宜但质量好的替代品。利润的一部分用来资助我主办的这些小活动，给大伙打打气。人人都有好处！” “你一直在门外等着？别回答这个问题。”达里乌斯不敢置信地摇摇头。“听着，要是公司能拿到该得的那份，那倒是一回事，但这得指挥官说了算。”

column1:
You incline your head toward [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. "If anyone could pull off what you're suggesting, it's you, but let's not test that theory."

{TGT_MW.DET_C} smile falters. "This gear is going to rust in that dingy warehouse."

"You probably right, MechWarrior. But you've got a gift. I've seen you make fifty tons of steel dance. That kind of talent isn't worth risking on some spare parts."

{TGT_MW.Callsign} swells with pride. "Damn right. Well, if you change your mind, you know who to ask. I'll find a way to 'procure' whatever you need." {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:wink|Default:winks} knowingly.
column2:
你朝 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 侧了侧头。“真要说谁能办成你提的那件事，那就是你，不过我们还是别去验证这个说法了。”

{TGT_MW.DET_C} 笑容僵了一下。“那批装备就要在那间昏暗的仓库里生锈了。”

“你说得大概没错，机甲战士。但你有天分。我见过你让五十吨钢铁起舞。这种天赋不值得为几件备用零件去冒险。”

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 满是得意。“说得对。那好吧，要是你改主意，知道该找谁。你需要什么，我都能想办法‘搞到’。”{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:wink|Default:winks} 会意地眨眼。

column1:
Look, we've got the money, let's take care of the locals. You fix [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] with a stern look. "If what you're saying is true, then we're still getting a huge discount."

"We'll see… " {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} begrudgingly {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:agree|Default:agrees} and {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:disappear|Default:disappears} down a busy street.

Hours later, you're waiting by the Leopard, when a stranger rolls up in a rusty cargo truck. {TGT_MW.Callsign} pops {TGT_MW.DET} head out of the passenger side. "Special delivery!" Something massive gleams beneath a fluttering tarp covering the back of the truck.

While more locals drive up to help, {TGT_MW.Callsign} sidles up to you. "You should have been there when I told these folks what they were sitting on. This old fella even teared up. It felt strangely... good. I think I could get used to this, Commander."
column2:
“听着，钱我们有，那就照顾一下本地人。”你严厉地盯着 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。“如果你说的是真的，我们已经是在大捡便宜了。”

“走着瞧吧……”{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} 不情愿地 {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:agree|Default:agrees}，随即 {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:disappear|Default:disappears} 在熙攘的街道上。

几个小时后，你等在豹式旁，一辆锈迹斑斑的货车摇摇晃晃地开过来。{TGT_MW.Callsign} 从副驾驶座探出 {TGT_MW.DET} 头。“特别快递！”货车后厢飘动的篷布下，有什么庞然大物闪着光。

更多本地人开车赶来帮忙时，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 凑到你身边。“你真该在场，听我告诉这些人他们屁股底下坐着什么宝贝。有个老头还哭了。感觉奇怪地……好。我想我能习惯这种事，指挥官。”

column1: You look between Darius and [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. "We've got enough enemies in the Periphery, let's not make any more. Pay the locals or forget about the goods." "I'll give it a shot." {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} begrudgingly {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:agree|Default:agrees} and {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:dart|Default:darts} across a busy street. Hours later, you're waiting by the Leopard, when {TGT_MW.Callsign} slinks into view empty-handed. You wave {TGT_MW.OBJ} down. "No luck?" {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:sigh|Default:sighs}. "Those rubes demanded two million after I made my offer!" "You tried your best." {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:shake|Default:shakes} {TGT_MW.DET} head. "No, I tried your way and it failed. Next time we'd be better off if we did things my way. What if something special just happened to appear in the cargo hold?" You narrow your eyes at {TGT_MW.Callsign}. "You don't want to find out."
column2: 你在达里乌斯和 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 之间来回看了看。“我们在外围星域已经树敌够多了，别再添新的。付钱给本地人，或者就放弃那批货。” “我试试。”{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} 不情愿地 {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:agree|Default:agrees}，飞快地 {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:dart|Default:darts} 穿过熙攘的街道。 几个小时后，你等在豹式旁，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 空着手磨磨蹭蹭地出现。你招手叫住 {TGT_MW.OBJ}。“没谈成？” {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:sigh|Default:sighs}。“我出价之后，那些土包子竟然开口要两百万！” “你已经尽力了。” {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:shake|Default:shakes} 着 {TGT_MW.DET} 头。“不，我是按你的办法试的，结果失败了。下次还是按我的办法办更划算。要是某件特别的东西恰好出现在货舱里，怎么样？” 你眯眼看着 {TGT_MW.Callsign}。“你不会想知道的。”

column1:
You look [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] in the eye. "I remember a MechWarrior on an previous crew who was close with pirates. He'd bring us all sorts of fancy gifts until one day he didn't come back." You pause for dramatic effect. 

{TGT_MW.Callsign} nods slowly, saying nothing.

"First, we found some of his clothes. Then his hands. They'd used a torch saw. We never found the rest. Some nights, I still lie awake, wondering if he's still alive."

{TGT_MW.Callsign}'s face pales. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:swallow|Default:swallows} hard and {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:pull|Default:pulls} out a wad of C-bills from a secret pocket. "Message received, Commander. No more 'side jobs' without your approval. The crew will gripe, but I'm done. I swear." {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:leave|Default:leaves} the cash on your desk before departing.
column2:
你直视 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 的眼睛。“我记得在以前那支队伍里有个机甲战士，跟海盗走得很近。他总给我们带来各种漂亮礼物，直到有一天他没再回来。”你停顿片刻制造效果。

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 缓缓点头，一言不发。

“我们先找到了他的几件衣服。然后是他的手。他们用了割炬锯。剩下的我们再也没找到。有些夜里，我还会躺着睡不着，想他是不是还活着。”

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 脸色发白。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:swallow|Default:swallows} 地咽了口口水，从暗袋里 {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:pull|Default:pulls} 出一沓星币。“明白了，指挥官。没有你的批准，再也不接‘私活’。船员们会抱怨，但我不干了。我发誓。”{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:leave|Default:leaves} 那沓钞票在你桌上，转身离开。

column1: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] meets with {TGT_MW.Det} friend's organization, and after swapping stories of past exploits, they reach an agreement.\n\nLater, Darius says, "It sounded as if {TGT_MW.Callsign} impressed them quite a bit. They gave us a special deal and invited us to look them up again later."
column2: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 与 {TGT_MW.Det} 朋友的组织会面，双方聊过各自的往事之后达成了协议。\n\n后来，达里乌斯说：“看样子 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 给他们留下了相当深的印象。他们给了我们一个特别优惠，还请我们日后有机会再去拜访。”

column1: A message arrives from Darius, who has gone planetside for a supply run. "Commander, I brought [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] along to assist me and {TGT_MW.Gender?Male:he's|Female:she's|NonBinary:they've} managed to strike up a relationship with a dealer in the local black market."\n\n"This individual is offering to sell us a lightly-used [[DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_SRM_4_Streak_Clan],{DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_SRM_4_Streak_Clan].Description.Name}]]. It's a pretty good deal… what do you want to do?"
column2: 前去地表补给的达里乌斯发来一条讯息。“指挥官，我带了 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 来帮忙，{TGT_MW.Gender?Male:he's|Female:she's|NonBinary:they've} 跟当地黑市的一个经销商搭上了关系。”\n\n“这个人提出要卖给我们一具九成新的 [[DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_SRM_4_Streak_Clan],{DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_SRM_4_Streak_Clan].Description.Name}]]。条件相当不错……你想怎么办？”

column1: Darius arranges for the sale, and soon enough the weapon is loaded onto the shuttle. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and {TGT_MW.DET} new friend celebrate at a bar that evening. \n\nDarius hauls {TGT_MW.Callsign} back to the Argo early the next morning and {TGT_MW.Callsign} drunkenly waves at you as you arrive to inspect the cargo. "We've got to come back here again, Commander. I'm, uh… I'm pretty sure I promised my new friend something. I'll be damned if I remember what it was, though."
column2: 达里乌斯安排好了交易，武器很快装上了穿梭机。当晚，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 和 {TGT_MW.DET} 新朋友在酒吧里庆祝。\n\n第二天一早，达里乌斯把 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 拖回阿戈号；你前来检查货物时，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 醉醺醺地朝你挥手。“我们一定还得再来这儿，指挥官。我，呃……我很确定我答应了我的新朋友什么事。可要是我还记得是什么，我就不是人。”

column1: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] arrives at the arranged meeting place, but before {TGT_MW.Subj} can finalize the exchange, security forces appear. \n\n{TGT_MW.Callsign}'s friend is nowhere to be seen. Darius has to pay a fine before {TGT_MW.Callsign} is allowed to return to the transport, tail tucked between {TGT_MW.Det} legs.
column2: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 来到了约定的会面地点，但 {TGT_MW.Subj} 还没来得及敲定交换，安全部队就出现了。\n\n{TGT_MW.Callsign} 的朋友踪影全无。达里乌斯不得不缴纳罚款，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 才被放回空投艇，夹着 {TGT_MW.Det} 尾巴灰溜溜地回来了。

column1:
You rub your chin, considering [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. "If we're going to do this, let's do it right. You take a percentage, but the company keeps the rest."

{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} skeptically {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:arch|Default:arches} an eyebrow. "That sounds like less money for me."

"Think of it as insurance. You won't have to worry about ending up in jail or smeared across some back alley. If a deal goes south, I've got your back. That means you've got a hell of a lance to make sure no one fleeces you."

"You know, after meeting some of these shady dealers, I wouldn't mind back up, Commander." {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:extend|Default:extends} a hand.
column2:
你摩挲着下巴，端详 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。“要做这事，就做正经些。你拿一个百分比，剩下的归公司。”

{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} 怀疑地 {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:arch|Default:arches} 起眉毛。“这听起来是我拿的钱变少了。”

“就当这是保险。你不必再担心自己最后进了监狱，或者横尸某条后巷。生意出了岔子，我给你撑腰。这意味着你身后有一整支了不起的小队，保证没人能坑你。”

“你知道吗，见过那些鬼头鬼脑的经销商之后，我确实不介意有后援，指挥官。”{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:extend|Default:extends} 出手来。

column1:
You'll keep fencing our surplus gear. The profits will go to the outfit, minus a small fee for your talents. If a deal goes sideways, then the company has your back. You offer a hand.

"So, you want a cut. I get it." Ignoring your hand, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] pulls out a wad of crumpled C-bills and shoves them at you.

You take the money, counting it carefully. "I'm not sure you do. You're lucky you still have a job, MechWarrior."

"Gee, thanks, Commander. I'm eternally grateful." {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s voice drips with dissent, but {TGT_MW.SUBJ} begrudgingly {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:accept|Default:accepts} the terms. Not that {TGT_MW.SUBJ} really had a choice.
column2:
“你继续替我们出手多余装备。利润归公司，扣掉一小笔作为你本事的酬劳。生意要是出了岔子，公司给你撑腰。”你伸出手。

“所以你是想抽成。我懂。”[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 没理你的手，掏出一沓揉皱的星币塞给你。

你接过钱，仔细点了点。“我看你并不懂。算你走运还能保住这份差事，机甲战士。”

“哎呀，谢谢你，指挥官。我感激不尽。”{TGT_MW.Callsign} 的语气满是抵触，却还是不情愿地 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:accept|Default:accepts} 了这些条件。倒也不是 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} 真有得选。

column1: Darius checks in from the planet's surface. "Commander, while [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] has been helping me gather supplies, {TGT_MW.Gender?Male:he's|Female:she's|NonBinary:they've} developed a connection within the local black market. For what it's worth, this contact is about as sketchy as you'd expect."\n\n"Now {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s new friend is offering to sell us a [[DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_Autocannon_RAC_2_Clan],{DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_Autocannon_RAC_2_Clan].Description.Name}]]. At a discount, no questions asked. You know how it goes. What do you say?"
column2: 达里乌斯从行星地表发来联络。“指挥官，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 帮我收集补给期间，{TGT_MW.Gender?Male:he's|Female:she's|NonBinary:they've} 在当地黑市里搭上了一条线。说句实话，这个联系人可疑得跟你预想的一模一样。”\n\n“现在 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 的新朋友提出要卖给我们一具 [[DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_Autocannon_RAC_2_Clan],{DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_Autocannon_RAC_2_Clan].Description.Name}]]。打折，不问来路。你知道这套路。你怎么说？”

column1:
Not this time. You shake your head. "We need to keep a low profile. This is a routine visit."

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] sighs. "The one time I try to be honest with you and I'm shot down immediately."

"Honesty doesn't entitle you to agreement. What if they have cameras or guards hidden on the premise? If you're serious, then I need a real plan. I can't risk our entire outfit over a half-baked scheme."

"Fine, I get it. Next time I'll just show up with the gear. Then you can just thank me and move on." {TGT_MW.Callsign} sneers, raising {TGT_MW.DET} voice defiantly.

You grab {TGT_MW.DET} arm. "That would be a mistake."
column2:
“这次不行。”你摇摇头。“我们需要保持低调。这次只是例行访问。”

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 叹了口气。“难得我诚实地跟你说一次，立刻就被你否了。”

“诚实不代表我一定会同意。万一那地方藏了摄像头或者守卫呢？你要是认真的，我需要一个真正的方案。我不能为了一个半生不熟的计划赌上整支队伍。”

“行，我明白了。下次我直接把装备带回来。到时候你谢我一句就完事。”{TGT_MW.Callsign} 冷笑着，挑衅地提高了 {TGT_MW.DET} 嗓门。

你抓住 {TGT_MW.DET} 胳膊。“那会是个错误。”

column1: I decide who fights and who doesn't, not you, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]. But no one fights until the doctor gives you a clean bill of health. You turn to the doctor. "I respect the challenges you face here, but clearly [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] is going a little stir-crazy. Perhaps {TGT_MW.SUBJ} could spend some time each day in the Training Modules?" The doctor's tightened lips communicate displeasure, but she keeps those words to herself. "Very well, Commander. We'll need {TGT_MW.OBJ} on {TGT_MW.DET} feet soon enough. Walking to the Training Room and back won't be any different than doing laps in the hallway."
column2: “谁上阵、谁不上阵，由我决定，不是你，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]。但在医生给你开出健康证明之前，谁都不许上阵。” 你转向医生。“我尊重你在这里面临的难处，但显然 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 快被关出毛病了。也许 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} 可以每天去训练模块待一段时间？” 医生抿紧的嘴唇透出不满，但她把话咽了回去。“好吧，指挥官。反正我们也需要 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 尽快恢复 {TGT_MW.DET} 腿脚。走去训练室再走回来，和在走廊里绕圈也没什么区别。”

column1:
As you're on your way to the MedBay for an evaluation, you hear [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] shouting, and then a loud metallic crash.

"Commander!" {TGT_MW.Callsign} calls as you enter. "How nice of you to join us!" {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:rise|Default:rises} halfway out of bed, trailing a tangled rope of tubes and wires.

The senior doctor turns on you, flushed and angry. "Commander, your MechWarriors refuse to follow their recovery regimen."

{SCN_MW.Callsign} lounges in a nearby chair. "How come you're running around the ship? You're hurt too!"
column2:
你正前往医疗舱接受检查，忽然听见 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 和 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 在大喊，紧接着一声金属巨响。

“指挥官！”你走进去时，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 招呼道。“你能来真是太好了！”{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:rise|Default:rises} 从床上一半起身，身上拖着一团缠绕的管子与导线。

主治医生气冲冲地转向你，满脸通红。“指挥官，你的机甲战士拒绝遵守康复安排。”

{SCN_MW.Callsign} 懒散地靠在旁边的椅子上。“你怎么能在船上到处跑？你也受伤了！”

column1:
[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], I'm up and about because I have a mercenary company to run. Unlike you, my job doesn't stop when I'm not in a 'Mech.

You turning to the doctor. "I respect the challenges you face here, but perhaps allow for a bit more activity and less bed-rest? Clearly, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] is going a little stir-crazy."

The senior doctor's tightened lips communicate displeasure, but she keeps those words to herself. "Very well, Commander. We will incorporate physical therapy earlier into the treatment. If {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:push|Default:pushes} too hard too soon, however, recovery may take even longer ."
column2:
“[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]，我能四处走动，是因为我有一家雇佣兵公司要经营。不像你，我的活儿不会因为我不在‘机甲’里就停下。”

你转向医生。“我尊重你在这里面临的难处，不过能不能让他们多活动一点、少躺一点？显然 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 快被关出毛病了。”

主治医生抿紧的嘴唇透出不满，但她把话咽了回去。“好吧，指挥官。我们会把物理治疗提前纳入疗程。不过要是 {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:push|Default:pushes} 得太狠太早，康复反而可能拖得更久。”

column1: I decide who fights and who doesn't, not you, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]. But no one fights until the doctor gives you a clean bill of health. You turn to the doctor. "From this point forward, you've got my permission to restrain pilots in their beds they give you trouble." [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s protestations die in {TGT_MW.Det} throat as you turn on {TGT_MW.Obj}. "I know that you feel like a god when you're sitting in your 'Mech. I get it. But here in the MedBay, there is only one god, and she's standing right there." You point at the doctor. "I expect you to do everything that she and her staff ask you to do. And if I hear otherwise, you may never get back into a 'Mech again."
column2: “谁上阵、谁不上阵，由我决定，不是你，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]。但在医生给你开出健康证明之前，谁都不许上阵。” 你转向医生。“从现在起，我准许你在机师闹事时把他们绑在床上。” 你转向 {TGT_MW.Obj} 时，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 的抗议噎在 {TGT_MW.Det} 喉咙里。“我知道你坐在‘机甲’里时觉得自己像神。我明白。但在医疗舱里，只有一个神，她就站在那儿。”你指向医生。 “我要求你照她和她的手下说的做每一件事。要是我听到相反的消息，你可能再也没机会坐进‘机甲’。”

column1:
With your best parade ground voice, you call "Ten-hut!"

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] automatically snaps to attention, incidentally releasing the cook.

You glance at the cook, who nods her appreciation and backs away. Then you regard {TGT_MW.Callsign} sternly. "Explain to me what you were doing, MechWarrior. Right now!"

Pinned by years of military discipline, {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s back stiffens even more. "Commander! I felt disrespected by that cook! And I behaved disgracefully!"

You stare at {TGT_MW.OBJ} for a long moment, and then take the mood down a notch. "Come out from there, {TGT_MW.Callsign}. You have an apology to make, and a mess to clean. As punishment for your behavior, I'm giving you a week of KP duty in addition to your regular tasks."

"Yes, Commander!"
column2:
你拿出最标准的操场口令吼道：“立——正！”

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 条件反射般啪地立正，顺手松开了那名厨工。

你瞥了一眼厨工，她点头致谢，退到一旁。然后你严厉地看着 {TGT_MW.Callsign}。“向我解释你刚才在干什么，机甲战士。马上！”

多年的军纪压制下，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 的背挺得更直了。“指挥官！我觉得那名厨工对我不敬！而我表现得极其可耻！”

你盯着 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 看了很久，然后把语气放缓一档。“从那边出来，{TGT_MW.Callsign}。你要去道歉，还要清理一地狼藉。作为对你行为的惩罚，除了日常任务，我再派你去厨房值勤一周。”

“是，指挥官！”

column1: While planetside on [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]], [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] pulls you and Darius aside. "I found an unsecured warehouse stuffed with equipment. Looks like it belongs to some small-time corp. Say the word and I'll reappropriate the goods." "Sounds like a good way to get shot." Darius scowls. "Why not make a token offer? A few C-bills go a long way. Hell, you might even make some friends." {TGT_MW.Callsign} lowers {TGT_MW.DET} voice. "The locals have no idea how valuable this stash is. Give 'em a whiff of cash and they might get wise and ask for more, but it's your call, Commander."
column2: 在 [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] 地表期间，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 把你和达里乌斯拉到一边。“我发现一座没上锁的仓库，里面塞满了装备。看样子属于某家小公司。你一句话，我就把货‘重新调配’过来。” “听起来是个挨枪子的好办法。”达里乌斯板着脸。“干嘛不象征性出点钱？几张星币很管用。见鬼，说不定还能交几个朋友。” {TGT_MW.Callsign} 压低 {TGT_MW.DET} 声音。“本地人根本不知道这批货值多少钱。让他们闻到钱味，他们可能就聪明起来多要价，不过这得你定，指挥官。”

column1:
Make it happen, but if you catch any sign of trouble, get out of there, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. You place a hand on {TGT_MW.DET} shoulder. "You're worth far more than any equipment."

"You got it, Commander." {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:flash|Default:flashes} a devilish grin before disappearing down the street.

Hours later, you're waiting by the Leopard when {TGT_MW.Callsign} rolls up in in a rusty cargo truck. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:lean|Default:leans} out the window and excitedly {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:slap|Default:slaps} the door panel as you approach.

You notice a tarp covering something massive on a trailer behind the truck. "You didn't mention a truck."

"It followed me home." {TGT_MW.Callsign} winks and adds, "Don't worry, I'll make sure it returns to its rightful owner. You can count on me, Commander."
column2:
“去办吧，但要是发现任何不对劲的迹象，立刻撤出来，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。”你把手放在 {TGT_MW.DET} 肩上。“你比任何装备都值钱得多。”

“明白，指挥官。”{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:flash|Default:flashes} 出一个顽皮的笑容，随即消失在街道尽头。

几个小时后，你等在豹式旁，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 开着辆锈迹斑斑的货车过来了。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:lean|Default:leans} 出车窗，在你走近时兴奋地 {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:slap|Default:slaps} 起车门板。

你注意到货车后面拖着一辆挂车，上面盖着篷布，底下是个庞然大物。“你可没提过有辆货车。”

“它自己跟回家的。”{TGT_MW.Callsign} 眨了眨眼，补了一句：“别担心，我会确保它物归原主。你可以信我，指挥官。”

column1:
Rob 'em blind, but if anything feels even slightly off, get out of there, you say firmly. "It's not worth it." [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] nods dutifully and disappears down another street.

Day fades into night as you wait for {TGT_MW.Callsign} outside the Leopard. Finally, {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:limp|Default:limps} into view, clutching {TGT_MW.DET} abdomen. Blood stains {TGT_MW.DET} clothes. "Turns out these weren't locals, Commander."

Sirens sound in the distance. You throw {TGT_MW.DET} arm over your shoulder, supporting the MechWarrior. "What happened?"

"Smuggling ring. Dodged their bullets, but my spleen got caught on a fence." {TGT_MW.Callsign} croaks. "If I survive… I'm going straight. No more schemes. I swear it." For once, you actually believe {TGT_MW.OBJ}.
column2:
把他们抢个精光，但只要有一丝一毫不对劲，就立刻撤出来，你坚定地说。"不值得冒这个险。" [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 恭敬地点了点头，消失在另一条街上。

你在豹式空投艇外等候 {TGT_MW.Callsign}，白昼渐渐褪成夜色。终于，{TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:limp|Default:limps} 出现在视野里，捂着 {TGT_MW.DET} 腹部。{TGT_MW.DET} 衣服上浸着血。"结果这帮人根本不是本地人，指挥官。"

远处响起警笛。你把 {TGT_MW.DET} 胳膊搭在自己肩上，搀扶着这名机甲战士。"出什么事了？"

"走私团伙。子弹是躲过去了，可我的脾脏让铁丝网挂住了。" {TGT_MW.Callsign} 嘶哑地说。"要是我能活下来……我就金盆洗手。再也不搞这些勾当。我发誓。"这一次，你竟然真的相信了 {TGT_MW.OBJ}。

column1: Darius' voice crackles through the Argo's speakers. "The Argo has developed a mold problem. Chief Virtanen has developed a highly toxic cleaning solution that will solve this. Volunteer fungus exterminators are requested to report to the Command Center. You'll get a HazMat suit, a pressurized backpack, a wetvac, and exemption from your other duties for the next few weeks." After half an hour without a response, Darius again switches on the intercom. "We have no volunteers, so I will now randomly draw some names. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]! You're up. And helping you speed along will be… [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]. Both of you check in with the Chief for instructions. Oliveira out."
column2: 达里乌斯的声音透过 阿尔戈号 的扬声器噼啪作响。 "阿尔戈号 长了霉。维塔宁总管研制出一种剧毒清洁液，能解决这个问题。现征召志愿真菌清除员前往指挥中心报到。你会领到一套防化服、一个加压背包、一台湿式吸尘器，以及未来几周免除其他勤务的豁免。" 半小时无人应答后，达里乌斯再次打开内部通话系统。"没有志愿者，那我现在随机抽几个名字。[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]！就是你了。帮你加快进度的是……[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]。你们俩都去找总管听指示。奥利维拉，通话完毕。"

column1: Dr. Murad gestures grandly at a bright yellow growth on the corridor wall in front of you. "Meet the Argo's very own mold problem. It started in the unfinished Gamma Pod, and despite my best efforts, it's spreading unchecked." She pokes at it with a screwdriver, frowning. "I've seen this before, Boss." Yang takes the screwdriver out of Dr. Murad's hand and wipes it off. "I know how to kill it, but whoever you pick for the job needs to be in a HazMat suit. And considering how widespread this infestation is, they're gonna be stewing in that suit for a long time." Dr. Murad nods grimly. "I was afraid of that. Any thoughts on who we should saddle with such an unpleasant task? I suppose we could ask for volunteers…" "No one's gonna volunteer for HazMat duty," Yang chuckles. "We may as well draw straws."
column2: 穆拉德博士夸张地朝你面前走廊墙上一团亮黄色的霉斑比了个手势。"来见见 阿尔戈号 自己的霉菌问题。它最早出现在尚未完工的伽马舱，尽管我竭尽全力，它还是一路自由蔓延。"她用螺丝刀戳了戳它，皱起眉头。 "这玩意儿我见过，老大。"杨从穆拉德博士手里拿过螺丝刀擦干净。"我知道怎么弄死它，但你挑来做这活儿的人得穿防化服。而且考虑到这次感染范围这么广，他们得在那套衣服里闷上很久。" 穆拉德博士严肃地点了点头。"我怕的就是这个。关于该把这件苦差事派给谁，你有什么想法吗？我想我们可以征集志愿者……" "没人会自愿去干防化服的活儿，"杨笑了笑。"还不如抓阄。"

column1: Darius' voice crackles through the Argo's speakers. "The Argo has developed a mold problem. Chief Virtanen has developed a highly toxic cleaning solution that will solve this. Volunteer fungus exterminators are requested to report to the Command Center. You'll get a HazMat suit, a pressurized backpack, a wetvac, and exemption from your other duties for the next few weeks." Eventually [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] arrives. "Here I am. I guess I can take one for the team." You clap {TGT_MW.Callsign} on the back. "Excellent. Go see the Chief for instructions, and the XO will update your schedule."
column2: 达里乌斯的声音透过 阿尔戈号 的扬声器噼啪作响。 "阿尔戈号 长了霉。维塔宁总管研制出一种剧毒清洁液，能解决这个问题。现征召志愿真菌清除员前往指挥中心报到。你会领到一套防化服、一个加压背包、一台湿式吸尘器，以及未来几周免除其他勤务的豁免。" 最终 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 来了。"我来了。就当我替团队牺牲一回吧。" 你拍了拍 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 的背。"很好。去找总管听指示，副官会更新你的排班表。"

column1:
I suppose that was in storage for a reason, so we can afford to lose it if things go wrong. But really, with your skills, I don't see why you can't work on it during the day, with supervision. So, you'll be working in the Mech Bay this week. I'll talk to the Chief about it.

Later that week, {TGT_MW.Callsign} catches you in the hall, glowing with excitement.

"I did it, Commander! That LRM is purring like a kitten now. Well, a kitten that wants to kill 'Mechs. I even managed to replicate the performance specs of the [[Weapon_LRM_15_Clan],{DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_LRM_15_Clan].Description.Manufacturer} {DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_LRM_15_Clan].Description.Model}]]."
column2:
我猜那东西被收进仓库是有原因的，所以万一出了岔子，损失我们也承担得起。不过说真的，以你的手艺，我看不出你为什么不能在白天、在有人监督的情况下弄它。所以你这周去机库干活。我会跟总管说的。

那周晚些时候，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 在走廊上拦住了你，兴奋得满脸放光。

"我做到了，指挥官！那门 LRM 现在叫起来像只小猫。嗯，一只想干掉机甲的猫。我甚至把 [[Weapon_LRM_15_Clan],{DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_LRM_15_Clan].Description.Manufacturer} {DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_LRM_15_Clan].Description.Model}]] 的性能参数都复刻出来了。"

column1: While pacing through the Mech Bay on a sleepless night, you stumble across [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} fiddling with a [[DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_Laser_Medium],stock Medium Laser]]. A jumbled pile of loose metal and wire litters the deck plating around {TGT_MW.Obj}.\n\nAs you approach, {TGT_MW.Callsign} looks up, a sheepish grin on {TGT_MW.Det} face. "Uh. Hello, Commander. I was just trying to tune this beauty, maybe get a little more performance out of her. Could you do me a favor and keep this from the Chief, though? He's already shooed me out of here once this week."
column2: 在某个失眠的夜里，你在机库里踱步时撞见了 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} 正摆弄着一门 [[DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_Laser_Medium],制式中型激光器]]。{TGT_MW.Obj} 周围的甲板上散落着一堆乱七八糟的金属和电线。\n\n你走近时，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 抬起头，{TGT_MW.Det} 脸上挂着一丝讪笑。"呃。你好，指挥官。我只是想调校一下这个宝贝，看能不能榨出点额外性能。不过能不能帮个忙，别让总管知道？这周他已经把我从这儿轰出去过一次了。"

column1:
MechWarriors belong in the 'Mechs. Technicians belong in the Mech Bay. But you seem pretty knowledgeable about these things, and you've already gutted the weapon. Explain to Yang what you were going for, and maybe he can finish what you started.

Later that week, you catch [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] in the hall.

"Chief Virtanen wanted me to pass along the good news. He investigated your suggestions and managed to replicate the performance specs of the [[DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_LRM_15_Enhanced],{DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_LRM_15_Enhanced].Description.Manufacturer} {DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_LRM_15_Enhanced].Description.Model}]]."

{TGT_MW.Callsign} basks in the glow of victory. "I knew it would work! So… does that mean I'm riding out on the next contract? I feel like I should be the first to get to fire it!"
column2:
机甲战士就该待在机甲里。技师就该待在机库里。但你好像对这些东西挺在行，而且你已经把这门武器拆得七零八落了。去跟杨说清楚你想干什么，也许他能把你开头的活儿干完。

那周晚些时候，你在走廊里截住了 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。

"维塔宁总管让我转达好消息。他研究了你提的建议，成功复刻出了 [[DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_LRM_15_Enhanced],{DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_LRM_15_Enhanced].Description.Manufacturer} {DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_LRM_15_Enhanced].Description.Model}]] 的性能参数。"

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 沉浸在胜利的喜悦里。"我就知道能成！那么……这是不是意味着下个合约我能上阵了？我觉得第一个开火的人该是我！"

column1:
It's not like I'm the only noble-born person on the ship, says [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], slumping low in your guest chair. "I mean, there's you. Why can't [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] harass you about their stupid idea?" Apparently when {TGT_MW.Callsign} asked to speak to you privately about something 'Darius wouldn't understand', it was about the trials and tribulations of being nobility.

"Well, what is {SCN_MW.Callsign}'s idea?" you ask.

"I don't know. Something about cooling systems. {SCN_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:want|Default:wants} me to use my 'connections' to get the idea to people who can implement it. And {SCN_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:don't|Default:doesn't} believe me when I say that my birth doesn't automatically open doors like that. And even if it did, I can't waste it on bullshit." {TGT_MW.Callsign} gives you a plaintive look, clearly hoping for advice, or at least sympathy.
column2:
又不是这船上只有我一个贵族出身的人，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 说着，在你客座的椅子里瘫了下去。"我是说，还有你呢。为什么 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 不拿他们那个蠢主意来烦你？" 显然，当 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 请求跟你私下谈点"达里乌斯不会懂"的事时，谈的就是当贵族的种种糟心事。

"那 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 的主意是什么？"你问。

"我不知道。跟冷却系统有关。{SCN_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:want|Default:wants} 我用我的'人脉'把这想法递到能实施它的人手里。可我说我的出身并不会那样自动替我开门，{SCN_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:don't|Default:doesn't} 又不信。就算真能，我也不能把这点关系浪费在瞎扯淡上。"{TGT_MW.Callsign} 用恳求的眼神看着你，显然盼着一点建议，或者至少是同情。

column1: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] looks relieved to pass along the burden to you, and later that afternoon [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] shows up at your door.\n\nYou scan the roughly written idea and can immediately see that {SCN_MW.Subj} may actually be on to something. You tell {SCN_MW.Callsign} to work it up into a full spec and you'll arrange a follow-up meeting with Chief Virtanen to review it in more detail.
column2: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 看起来如释重负，总算把这副担子甩给了你。那天下午晚些时候，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 出现在你门口。\n\n你扫了一眼那份写得潦草的构想，立刻就看得出 {SCN_MW.Subj} 说不定真有点东西。你让 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 把它整理成一份完整的技术规格书，你会安排跟维塔宁总管再开一次会详细审阅。

那周晚些时候，你在走廊里截住了 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。

"维塔宁总管让我转达个消息。他研究了你提的建议，但没能得出什么有价值的成果。"

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 盯着地板，垂头丧气。"妈的，我还以为那肯定能成。不过还是谢谢你让总管试了试。我想我还是老老实实干我最擅长的吧：开火，而不是试着改武器。"

column1:
I suppose that was in storage for a reason, so we can afford to lose it if things go wrong. Just be careful. These weapons are meant to destroy 'Mechs, after all.

Later that week, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] catches you in the hall, glowing with excitement.

"I did it, Commander! That LRM launcher is purring like a kitten now. Well, a kitten that wants to kill 'Mechs. I even managed to replicate the performance specs of the [[DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_LRM_15_Enhanced],{DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_LRM_15_Enhanced].Description.Manufacturer} {DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_LRM_15_Enhanced].Description.Model}]]."
column2:
我猜那东西被收进仓库是有原因的，所以万一出了岔子，损失我们也承担得起。小心点就行。毕竟这些武器是用来摧毁机甲的。

那周晚些时候，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 在走廊上拦住了你，兴奋得满脸放光。

"我做到了，指挥官！那具 LRM 发射器现在叫起来像只小猫。嗯，一只想干掉机甲的猫。我甚至把 [[DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_LRM_15_Enhanced],{DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_LRM_15_Enhanced].Description.Manufacturer} {DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_LRM_15_Enhanced].Description.Model}]] 的性能参数都复刻出来了。"

column1: Do I look like your babysitter? You fix each MechWarrior with a stern look. "Get your shit together and work this out like adults if you want to deploy any time soon." "But–" You raise a hand to silence [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]. "If you can't handle this petty dispute, how can I trust you on the battlefield?" You shake your head. "I don't want to hose you out of a cockpit." The MechWarriors share a look, cheeks reddening with embarrassment now instead of anger. They both promise to work out their problems, nearly speaking up in unison. The next day, Darius pulls you aside, eyes wide with astonishment. "Commander, the garbage cans are sparkling... they're downright lemony fresh. This is a miracle. What did you say to {SCN_MW.Callsign} and [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]?" You chuckle. "I just told them what they needed to hear."
column2: 我看起来像你的保姆吗？你严厉地逐一盯着两名机甲战士。"把你们的破事理清楚，像个成年人那样解决掉，如果你们还想尽快出任务的话。" "可是——" 你抬手制止了 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]。"如果连这点鸡毛蒜皮的争执都处理不了，我怎么能在战场上信任你？"你摇了摇头。"我不想把你们从驾驶舱里冲出去。" 两名机甲战士对视一眼，脸颊因尴尬而非愤怒而泛红。他们几乎异口同声地保证会解决各自的问题。 第二天，达里乌斯把你拉到一边，眼睛因惊讶而瞪得溜圆。"指挥官，那些垃圾桶闪闪发亮……简直是柠檬般清新。这简直是奇迹。你到底说了些什么，才把 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 和 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 弄成这样？" 你轻笑。"我只是说了他们需要听的话。"

column1: You look between the two MechWarriors, raising an eyebrow and shaking your head. You walk away without wasting a word on them. Behind you, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] groans. "See! Not even the Commander wants to put up with you!" You refrain from correcting {TGT_MW.OBJ}, taking a deep breath as you turn the corner. The argument echoes down the hall, growing louder. You catch a couple bits and pieces involving "your mother" and an "LRM." Enough to get the idea. The next day, Darius pulls you aside, heaving a sigh. "[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] is in the MedBay. Got knocked out cold by {TGT_MW.Callsign}. I'm confining {TGT_MW.OBJ} to the barracks between deployments. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:need|Default:needs} to fall in line if {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:don't|Default:doesn't} want {TGT_MW.DET} contract to get torched."
column2: 你在两名机甲战士之间来回看了看，挑了挑眉，摇了摇头。你一句话都没浪费，径直走开了。 身后，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 哼哼道："看见没！连指挥官都受不了你！" 你没有去纠正 {TGT_MW.OBJ}，深吸一口气，转过拐角。争吵声沿着走廊回荡，越来越响。你零星听到几句，涉及"你妈"和"LRM"。够你明白个大概了。 第二天，达里乌斯把你拉到一边，重重叹了口气。"[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 进医疗舱了。被 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 一拳打晕了。我把 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 禁足在营房，直到下次部署前。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:need|Default:needs} 得规矩点，如果 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:don't|Default:doesn't} 想让 {TGT_MW.DET} 的合约被搞黄的话。"

column1: While pacing through the Mech Bay on a sleepless night, you stumble across [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} fiddling with a [[DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_Autocannon_AC_5],stock AutoCannon]]. A jumbled pile of loose metal and wire litters the deck plating around {TGT_MW.Obj}.\n\nAs you approach, {TGT_MW.Callsign} looks up, a sheepish grin on {TGT_MW.Det} face. "Uh. Hello, Commander. I was just trying to tune this beauty, maybe get a little more performance out of her. Could you do me a favor and keep this from the Chief, though? He's already shooed me out of here once this week."
column2: 在某个失眠的夜里，你在机库里踱步时撞见了 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} 正摆弄着一门 [[DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_Autocannon_AC_5],制式自动炮]]。{TGT_MW.Obj} 周围的甲板上散落着一堆乱七八糟的金属和电线。\n\n你走近时，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 抬起头，{TGT_MW.Det} 脸上挂着一丝讪笑。"呃。你好，指挥官。我只是想调校一下这个宝贝，看能不能榨出点额外性能。不过能不能帮个忙，别让总管知道？这周他已经把我从这儿轰出去过一次了。"

column1: Raising your hand, you silence the MechWarriors. "You're both about to lose a paycheck. The XO put you on garbage detail together for a reason. He figured you two would be forced to talk it out and resolve whatever is going on, but apparently you'd rather bicker like children." "You heard the, Commander." [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] shoves a broom at [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. "Get it together." Bristling, {TGT_MW.Callsign} pushes back. "I've got nothing left to say to {SCN_MW.OBJ}. {SCN_MW.Callsign} isn't listening. {SCN_MW.SUBJ_C}{SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'re|Default:'s} waiting for me to misstep so {SCN_MW.SUBJ} can report me to the XO." "That's enough." You raise your voice and the MechWarriors shrink back. "I've got a half a mind to lock you in a storage closet until you both shape up." The MechWarriors grow silent, refusing to look at one another, but slowly they return to garbage detail. When you check on them throughout the week, you can feel the hostility in their eyes, the frosty ambivalence of their brief exchanges. The MechWarriors get their work done without further incident, but the tension remains.
column2: 你抬起手，让机甲战士们安静下来。"你们俩都要丢一份薪水了。副官把你们一起派去清理垃圾，是有原因的。他以为你们俩会被迫把话说开，解决掉问题，可显然你们更愿意像小孩子一样拌嘴。" "指挥官的话你们听到了。"[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 把一把扫帚塞给 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。"给我清醒点。" {TGT_MW.Callsign} 竖起浑身的刺，顶了回去。"我跟 {SCN_MW.OBJ} 没什么好说的了。{SCN_MW.Callsign} 根本不听。{SCN_MW.SUBJ_C}{SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'re|Default:'s} 就等着我出岔子，好让 {SCN_MW.SUBJ} 去副官那儿告我的状。" "够了。"你提高声音，两名机甲战士都缩了回去。"我有半颗心是想把你们锁进储物间，直到你们俩都给我改好。"机甲战士们安静下来，谁也不看谁，但还是慢慢回去清理垃圾了。 这一周你几次去看他们，能感觉到他们眼里的敌意，以及简短交谈中那种冷冰冰的敷衍。机甲战士们的活儿都干完了，没再出岔子，但那股紧张感依旧在。

column1: The XO put you both on garbage detail for a reason. Stop acting like you're [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s boss. You narrow your eyes at [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]. "Nobody likes a snitch." {SCN_MW.Callsign} throws {SCN_MW.DET} hands up in disbelief. "So, the rules don't matter?" "The rules help keep this outfit sane, but what you're doing is going to make everyone hate you. You're insulting the XO, me, and the rest of this crew." You gesture to {TGT_MW.Callsign}. "Do you want {TGT_MW.OBJ} to hesitate when your life is on the line?" The heat in {SCN_MW.Callsign}'s cheeks dissipates. "Message received, Commander." {SCN_MW.SUBJ_C} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:turn|Default:turns} to {TGT_MW.Callsign}, placing a hand on {SCN_MW.DET} chest. "I'm sorry. Let me handle the cleaning. I'm the reason you're in this mess in the first place."
column2: 副官把你们俩派去清理垃圾是有原因的。别再摆出一副你是 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 老板的架子。你眯起眼睛看着 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]。"没人喜欢告密的人。" {SCN_MW.Callsign} 难以置信地摊开 {SCN_MW.DET} 双手。"这么说，规矩就不算数了？" "规矩能让这支部队保持清醒，但你这么做会让所有人都恨你。你在羞辱副官、我，还有这艘船上其余所有人。"你朝 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 比了个手势。"你希望 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 在你性命攸关的时候犹豫一下吗？" {SCN_MW.Callsign} 脸上的火气消了下去。"收到，指挥官。"{SCN_MW.SUBJ_C} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:turn|Default:turns} 转向 {TGT_MW.Callsign}，一只手按在 {SCN_MW.DET} 胸口上。"对不起。清理的活儿让我来吧。毕竟是我害你摊上这烂摊子的。"

column1: You level your gaze at [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]. "Did I miss your coronation, MechWarrior? Until the First Prince names you his successor, you need to stop acting like [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s boss." {SCN_MW.Callsign} shoves {SCN_MW.DET} hands in {SCN_MW.DET} pockets, looking away. "So, I should forget the rules?" "You should remember your place. Discipline is the XO's job, not yours." "He should do a better job." {SCN_MW.Callsign} says through clenched teeth. You shake your head. "One more word and I cancel your next paycheck." {SCN_MW.Callsign} glares, but stalks off silently. While {SCN_MW.SUBJ} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:root|Default:roots} through a storage closet, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] pulls you aside. "Thanks for putting your foot down, Commander. Everyone was getting tired of {SCN_MW.Callsign}'s attitude."
column2: 你死死盯着 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]。"机甲战士，我是错过你的加冕典礼了吗？在第一王子指定你为继承人之前，你最好别再摆出 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 老板的架子。" {SCN_MW.Callsign} 把 {SCN_MW.DET} 双手插进 {SCN_MW.DET} 口袋，把脸别开。"这么说，我该把规矩都忘了？" "你该记住的是你自己的位置。纪律是副官的事，不是你的。" "那他该干得更好一点。"{SCN_MW.Callsign} 咬着牙说。 你摇了摇头。"再说一个字，我就扣掉你下一笔薪水。"{SCN_MW.Callsign} 怒视着你，但还是默默地走开了。 当 {SCN_MW.SUBJ} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:root|Default:roots} 翻找储物间的时候，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 把你拉到一边。"谢谢你态度坚决，指挥官。大家早就受够 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 那副德性了。"

column1: You step in between the infuriated MechWarriors, holding your hands up. "This ends today. I don't know what's really going on between you two, but no more bossing [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] around. And no more slacking. You're both better than this." The MechWarriors begrudgingly agree, though they don't look directly at one another. Noticing their reticence, you gesture for them both to step forward. "Not that long ago, you two got along just fine. What happened?" {TGT_MW.Callsign} looks up. "I'm just tired of [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] getting all the praise from Darius." {SCN_MW.Callsign}'s blinks in surprise. "You're jealous? Of me? I was annoyed that the rest of the MechWarriors kept going on and on about your antics. I wanted to take you down a peg." You incline your head. "Sounds like you both have a lot to discuss and plenty of time." "I won't hold back." {SCN_MW.Callsign} looks {TGT_MW.Callsign} in the eyes. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:shrug and reach|Default:shrugs and reaches} for a trash can. "I'm not going anywhere."
column2: 你走到两名怒气冲冲的机甲战士中间，举起双手。"今天到此为止。我不知道你们俩之间到底出了什么事，但不许再对 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 指手画脚。也不许再偷懒。你们俩都该比这更好。" 两名机甲战士不情不愿地答应了，尽管他们并没正眼看向对方。你察觉到他们的迟疑，示意两人上前一步。"没多久以前，你们俩还处得挺好。发生什么了？" {TGT_MW.Callsign} 抬起头。"我只是受够了 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 老是被达里乌斯夸。" {SCN_MW.Callsign} 惊讶地眨了眨眼。"你嫉妒？嫉妒我？我是烦其他机甲战士没完没了地念叨你那点破事。我想打压你一下。" 你微微颔首。"听起来你们俩有很多话要谈，而且大把时间。" "我不会手下留情。"{SCN_MW.Callsign} 直视着 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 的眼睛。 {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:shrug and reach|Default:shrugs and reaches} 去拿垃圾桶。"我哪儿也不去。"
