"我做到了，指挥官！那门自动炮现在叫起来像只小猫。嗯，一只想干掉机甲的猫。我甚至把 [[DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_Autocannon_UAC_5_Clan],{DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_Autocannon_UAC_5_Clan].Description.Manufacturer} {DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_Autocannon_UAC_5_Clan].Description.Model}]] 的性能参数都复刻出来了。"

column1: While pacing through the Mech Bay on a sleepless night, you stumble across [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} fiddling with a [[DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_LRM_15],stock LRM]]. A jumbled pile of loose metal and wire litters the deck plating around {TGT_MW.Obj}.\n\nAs you approach, {TGT_MW.Callsign} looks up, a sheepish grin on {TGT_MW.Det} face. "Uh. Hello, Commander. I was just trying to tune this beauty, maybe get a little more performance out of her. Could you do me a favor and keep this from the Chief, though? He's already shooed me out of here once this week."
column2: 在某个失眠的夜里，你在机库里踱步时撞见了 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} 正摆弄着一具 [[DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_LRM_15],制式 LRM]]。{TGT_MW.Obj} 周围的甲板上散落着一堆乱七八糟的金属和电线。\n\n你走近时，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 抬起头，{TGT_MW.Det} 脸上挂着一丝讪笑。"呃。你好，指挥官。我只是想调校一下这个宝贝，看能不能榨出点额外性能。不过能不能帮个忙，别让总管知道？这周他已经把我从这儿轰出去过一次了。"

column1:
MechWarriors belong in the 'Mechs. Technicians belong in the Mech Bay. But you seem pretty knowledgeable about these things, and you've already gutted the weapon. Explain to Yang what you were going for, and maybe he can finish what you started.

Later that week, you catch [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] in the hall.

"Chief Virtanen wanted me to pass along the good news. He investigated your suggestions and managed to replicate the performance specs of the [[DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_Autocannon_AC_5_Light],{DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_Autocannon_AC_5_Light].Description.Manufacturer} {DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_Autocannon_AC_5_Light].Description.Model}]]."

{TGT_MW.Callsign} basks in the glow of victory. "I knew it would work! So… does that mean I'm riding out on the next contract? I feel like I should be the first one to get to fire it!"
column2:
机甲战士就该待在机甲里。技师就该待在机库里。但你好像对这些东西挺在行，而且你已经把这门武器拆得七零八落了。去跟杨说清楚你想干什么，也许他能把你开头的活儿干完。

那周晚些时候，你在走廊里截住了 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。

"维塔宁总管让我转达好消息。他研究了你提的建议，成功复刻出了 [[DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_Autocannon_AC_5_Light],{DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_Autocannon_AC_5_Light].Description.Manufacturer} {DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_Autocannon_AC_5_Light].Description.Model}]] 的性能参数。"

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 沉浸在胜利的喜悦里。"我就知道能成！那么……这是不是意味着下个合约我能上阵了？我觉得第一个开火的人该是我！"

column1:
I suppose that was in storage for a reason, so we can afford to lose it if things go wrong. Just be careful. These weapons are meant to destroy 'Mechs, after all.

Later that week, you get word that [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] is in the MedBay. When you visit {TGT_MW.Obj}, {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} grinning from ear to ear, despite the bandages.

"I did it, Commander! That cannon is purring like a kitten now. Well, a kitten that wants to kill 'Mechs. I even managed to replicate the performance specs of the [[DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_Autocannon_AC_5_Light],{DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_Autocannon_AC_5_Light].Description.Manufacturer} {DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_Autocannon_AC_5_Light].Description.Model}]]."
column2:
我猜那东西被收进仓库是有原因的，所以万一出了岔子，损失我们也承担得起。小心点就行。毕竟这些武器是用来摧毁机甲的。

那周晚些时候，你听说 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 进了医疗舱。你去看望 {TGT_MW.Obj} 时，{TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} 尽管缠着绷带，却笑得合不拢嘴。

"我做到了，指挥官！那门自动炮现在叫起来像只小猫。嗯，一只想干掉机甲的猫。我甚至把 [[DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_Autocannon_AC_5_Light],{DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_Autocannon_AC_5_Light].Description.Manufacturer} {DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_Autocannon_AC_5_Light].Description.Model}]] 的性能参数都复刻出来了。"

column1:
I suppose that was in storage for a reason, so we can afford to lose it if things go wrong. Just be careful. These weapons are meant to destroy 'Mechs, after all.

Later that week, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] catches you in the hall with an update.

"Commander, I'm sorry to report that I wasn't able to modify that weapon like I wanted to. But I was able to put it back together again just the way it was before. Double and triple-checked it, to be sure."
column2:
我猜那东西被收进仓库是有原因的，所以万一出了岔子，损失我们也承担得起。小心点就行。毕竟这些武器是用来摧毁机甲的。

那周晚些时候，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 在走廊上拦住你，带来一个消息。

"指挥官，很抱歉，我没能按自己的想法改装那门武器。但我把它完好如初地装回去了。为了保险，我反复检查了两三遍。"

column1: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] looks relieved to pass along the burden to you, and later that afternoon [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] shows up at your door.\n\nYou scan the roughly written idea and can immediately see that {SCN_MW.Subj} is wasting your time. You tell {SCN_MW.Callsign} to focus {SCN_MW.Det} energy on being a better MechWarrior and leave the engineering to Chief Virtanen.
column2: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 看起来如释重负，总算把这副担子甩给了你。那天下午晚些时候，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 出现在你门口。\n\n你扫了一眼那份写得潦草的构想，立刻看出 {SCN_MW.Subj} 是在浪费你的时间。你让 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 把 {SCN_MW.Det} 精力放在当好一名机甲战士上，工程的事交给维塔宁总管。

column1:
I'm your commander, not your mother. If you two can't resolve this yourselves, we've got bigger problems than [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s drinking. You dismiss the MechWarriors.

Hours later, Darius's troubled voice crackles over the comms. "I broke up a fight in the hallway, but not before {TGT_MW.Callsign} knocked out [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]. {SCN_MW.SUBJ_C}{SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'re|Default:'s} in the MedBay. {TGT_MW.Callsign} was raving and threatening the other MechWarriors, too."

"This has to stop, Darius."

"Damn right, Commander. I assigned {TGT_MW.OBJ} extra work shifts until {TGT_MW.SUBJ} sobers up. I'll be keeping a close eye on {TGT_MW.SUBJ} from now on."
column2:
我是你们的指挥官，不是你们的妈。要是你们俩自己解决不了这事，那我们面对的问题可就不止 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 喝酒这一点了。你打发走了这两名机甲战士。

几个小时后，达里乌斯忧心忡忡的声音从通讯器里噼啪传来。"我拦下了走廊里的一场斗殴，但 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 已经把 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 打晕了。{SCN_MW.SUBJ_C}{SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'re|Default:'s} 在医疗舱里。{TGT_MW.Callsign} 还胡言乱语，威胁其他机甲战士。"

"这事必须停下来，达里乌斯。"

"说得对，指挥官。我给 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 排了额外的班次，直到 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} 清醒过来。从现在起我会盯着 {TGT_MW.SUBJ}。"

column1:
You dismiss [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] and speak in earnest with [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] until {TGT_MW.SUBJ} eventually {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:fall|Default:falls} into your chair, dropping {TGT_MW.DET} head in {TGT_MW.DET} hands.

"I slipped up, Commander. I just wanted a break, a few hours where I could stop thinking or worrying about anything. I can't shake this feeling that my next deployment will be my last."

"Everyone has bad days." You place a hand on {TGT_MW.DET} shoulder. "Next time you're struggling, come give me a visit, {TGT_MW.Callsign}. I'll make time for you. No matter what."

{TGT_MW.DET_C} jaw tightens with determination. "I'll talk to you before I hit the bottle again, Commander. Promise."
column2:
你打发走 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]，认真地跟 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 谈了很久，直到 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} 终于 {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:fall|Default:falls} 进你的椅子里，把 {TGT_MW.DET} 头埋进 {TGT_MW.DET} 双手。

"我犯了错，指挥官。我只是想歇一歇，有几个小时不用想任何事、不用操心任何事。我总有种甩不掉的感觉：我下一次部署就是最后一次。"

"谁都有糟糕的日子。"你把手放在 {TGT_MW.DET} 肩上。"下次你撑不住的时候，来找我，{TGT_MW.Callsign}。无论如何，我都会为你腾出时间。"

{TGT_MW.DET_C} 下颌因下定决心而绷紧。"再碰酒瓶子之前，我会先来找你谈，指挥官。我保证。"

column1:
You dismiss [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] and push a chair toward [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. "Under ordinary circumstances, I'd let Darius handle this, but this is becoming a habit for you. What's going on?"

{TGT_MW.Callsign} crumples into the seat. "Last month I got word that a good friend was killed in a border dispute."

"I'm sorry, {TGT_MW.Callsign}." You rest a hand on {TGT_MW.DET} shoulder. "There's no way to make this easier, but turning to the bottle isn't going to fix anything."

"I'll throw away the hooch, Commander. Every drop, but it's not going to be easy." A bead of sweat drips down {TGT_MW.DET} forehead. "I'll make things right with {SCN_MW.Callsign}, too. I'll take {SCN_MW.DET} chore shifts for the next two weeks."
column2:
你打发走 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]，把一把椅子推向 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。"平常情况下，这事我会交给达里乌斯处理，但这对你来说已经成了习惯。到底怎么回事？"

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 瘫进椅子里。"上个月我收到消息，一个好朋友在边境冲突里阵亡了。"

"我很抱歉，{TGT_MW.Callsign}。"你把手搭在 {TGT_MW.DET} 肩上。"这种事没法让人好受一点，但借酒浇愁解决不了任何问题。"

"我会把酒全扔了，指挥官。一滴不剩，虽然这不会容易。"一滴汗从 {TGT_MW.DET} 额头滑落。"我也会跟 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 把关系修好。接下来两周的杂活班次我替 {SCN_MW.DET} 顶了。"

column1:
I don't have time to deal with this. You fix [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] with a serious look. "I trust that you can handle this on your own."

During dinner, {SCN_MW.Callsign} finds you in the mess. "We talked it out with the other MechWarriors, Commander. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] made a mess, so {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:have|Default:has} to sleep in it."

"Not exactly what I had in mind, but if this sobers {TGT_MW.Callsign} up then you have my blessing." You give {SCN_MW.OBJ} an approving nod.

{SCN_MW.Callsign} stamps a foot. "If I ever catch {TGT_MW.Callsign} piss-drunk again {TGT_MW.SUBJ} will be sleeping in an actual latrine."
column2:
我没时间处理这个。你严肃地看着 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]。"我相信你能自己搞定。"

晚饭时，{SCN_MW.Callsign} 在食堂里找到你。"我们和其他机甲战士把这事谈开了，指挥官。[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 搞出这么多乱子，{TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:have|Default:has} 自己受着。"

"这倒不是我原本的想法，但如果这能让 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 清醒过来，那我就没意见。"你朝 {SCN_MW.OBJ} 赞许地点了点头。

{SCN_MW.Callsign} 跺了下脚。"要是再让我逮到 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 喝得烂醉，{TGT_MW.SUBJ} 就得去真正的茅坑里睡了。"

column1:
You incline your head toward [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and point a finger at the MedTech. "Go ahead with the neurostimulator. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:aren't|Default:isn't} going out without a fight."

After surgery, you find {TGT_MW.Callsign} in a recovery room triumphantly tossing down a straight flush against a MedTech's two-pair. You pat the edge of {TGT_MW.DET} bed. "How do you feel, MechWarrior?"

"It's all coming back, Commander." {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:tap|Default:taps} lightly on {TGT_MW.DET} bandaged head. "I feel like myself again."

"Good. Let's do a test." You grab the photo of {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s mother off a nearby table and hold it up. "Do you know who this is?"

{TGT_MW.Callsign} cocks {TGT_MW.DET} head, arching an eyebrow. "That old hag? How could I forget that face? She's the reason I'm here—kicked me out when I was 15."

You smile. "That's the {TGT_MW.Callsign} I remember."
column2:
你朝 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 扬了扬下巴，又用手指指向那名医疗技师。"上神经刺激器吧。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:aren't|Default:isn't} 会就这么不战而退的。"

手术之后，你在恢复室找到 {TGT_MW.Callsign}，他正得意洋洋地甩出一手同花顺，压过对面医疗技师的两对。你拍了拍 {TGT_MW.DET} 的床沿。"感觉怎么样，机甲战士？"

"全都回来了，指挥官。"{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:tap|Default:taps} 轻轻敲了敲 {TGT_MW.DET} 缠着绷带的脑袋。"我觉得又变回我自己了。"

"好。我们来做个测试。"你从旁边桌上拿起 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 母亲的照片举起来。"你知道这是谁吗？"

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 歪了歪 {TGT_MW.DET} 头，挑起一边眉毛。"那个老巫婆？我怎么可能忘了那张脸？就是她害我来这儿的——我十五岁那年把我赶出了家门。"

你笑了。"这才是我认识的 {TGT_MW.Callsign}。"

column1:
You look at [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and then at the MedTech. "Prepare for surgery. That neurostimulator is {TGT_MW.DET} only chance at getting back in a 'Mech."

"Thanks, Commander. That's all I could ask for." {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s voice trembles, but {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:nod|Default:nods} {TGT_MW.DET} head resolutely.

Hours later, a MedTech finds you in the Command Center. Her mouth is drawn into a tight line. She struggles to meet your gaze. You fill in the silence. "It's not a good sign if you're here in person."

She shakes her head. "We tried our best, but there was a complication. Major hemorrhaging. {TGT_MW.Callsign} was a fighter. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} held on longer than most would, but by the time we stopped the bleeding, it was too late. I've informed the XO to make arrangements. The crew will need time to grieve."
column2:
你看看 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]，又看向那名医疗技师。"准备手术。那个神经刺激器是 {TGT_MW.DET} 重回机甲的唯一机会。"

"谢谢你，指挥官。我要的也就是这个了。"{TGT_MW.Callsign} 的声音在发抖，但 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:nod|Default:nods} 了 {TGT_MW.DET} 头，神情坚定。

几个小时后，一名医疗技师在指挥中心找到你。她抿紧嘴唇，艰难地迎上你的目光。你打破了沉默。"你亲自过来，就说明情况不妙。"

她摇了摇头。"我们尽力了，但出现了并发症。大出血。{TGT_MW.Callsign} 是个战士。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} 比大多数人撑得都久，可等我们止住血的时候，已经太迟了。我已经通知副官安排后事。船员们需要时间来哀悼。"

column1: [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] stomps into your quarters, dragging [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] behind {SCN_MW.OBJ}. "{TGT_MW.Callsign} mistook my bunk for a latrine… AGAIN!" {SCN_MW.Callsign} wrinkles {SCN_MW.DET} nose. "Third time this month." {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:stumble|Default:stumbles} forward. "I… I can explain… " {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:slur|Default:slurs}. {TGT_MW.DET_C} breath stinks like gasoline fumes and paint thinner, making your eyes water. "It's not even noon!" {SCN_MW.Callsign} narrows {SCN_MW.DET} eyes at {TGT_MW.OBJ}. "There's having a good time and then there's this. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C}'d get us killed if {TGT_MW.SUBJ} deployed in this state, Commander."
column2: [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 大步冲进你的舱室，把 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 拖在 {SCN_MW.OBJ} 身后。"{TGT_MW.Callsign} 又把我的床铺当成茅坑了……又是这样！"{SCN_MW.Callsign} 皱了皱 {SCN_MW.DET} 鼻子。"这个月第三次了。" {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:stumble|Default:stumbles} 着上前一步。"我……我可以解释……"{TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:slur|Default:slurs}。{TGT_MW.DET_C} 呼吸里全是汽油和香蕉水的味道，呛得你眼睛发酸。 "现在还不到中午！"{SCN_MW.Callsign} 眯起 {SCN_MW.DET} 眼睛看着 {TGT_MW.OBJ}。"玩得开心是一回事，这是另一回事。指挥官，{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} 要是以 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} 这种状态上了战场，会把我们全害死。"

column1:
You dismiss [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] and turn to [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], recalling an old comrade's struggle.

"... this guy had a real problem. He'd do anything to get high. One day, I found him crashed out in his cockpit. His O2 mask was connected to an empty nitrous tank, and his skin had already gone blue." You shake your head. "Hell of a mess. I don't want to see you go out the same way."

{TGT_MW.Callsign} furrows {TGT_MW.DET} brow in disbelief. "Can't say I relate, since I don't have a ‘problem’ like your friend, but thanks for the story."

Next time, you catch {TGT_MW.Callsign} in the hall, {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:sidestep|Default:sidesteps} your gentle questions, avoiding eye contact. You can't get a straight answer from {TGT_MW.OBJ}.
column2:
你打发走 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]，转向 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]，想起了一位老战友的挣扎。

"……那家伙出了大问题。为了嗑高，他什么都干得出来。有一天，我发现他瘫在驾驶舱里。供氧面罩接在一罐空的笑气瓶上，皮肤都已经发青了。"你摇了摇头。"一塌糊涂。我不想看到你也这样收场。"

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 难以置信地皱起 {TGT_MW.DET} 眉头。"我不好说有没有共鸣，我可没有你朋友那种'问题'，不过还是谢谢你的故事。"

下一次你在走廊里遇到 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 时，{TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:sidestep|Default:sidesteps} 了你温和的提问，也避开你的目光。你从 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 嘴里问不出一句实话。

column1:
You know, you're not wrong. You approach the MechTechs, taking a deep breath. "We do depend on you." You bend down and pick up a scorched remnant of the [[SCN_UNIT,{SCN_Unit.Name}]]'s center torso. It crumbles between your fingers.

"And that's alarming, given what I've seen here today. It's one thing to voice your dissent, but your antics have endangered our pilots and cost this company who knows how much. If you learned to air your grievances like professionals, you could stand to earn a lot more."

The 'Techs grumble, though they return to their stations. [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] gloats. Some of the MechTechs don't bother hiding their disdain for you and {SCN_MW.Callsign}, glaring openly.

Later that night, Yang brings a bottle of whiskey to your quarters. "The MechTechs are dragging their feet, but they'll snap out of it. Give 'em a month to gripe, and they'll get tired of yapping and get back to work." He fills your glasses. The two of you share a drink in silence.
column2:
你知道，你说得没错。你走近那些机甲技师，深吸一口气。"我们确实依赖你们。"你弯腰捡起 [[SCN_UNIT,{SCN_Unit.Name}]] 中央躯干的一块焦黑残片。它在你的指间碎成了渣。

"而看过今天这里的场面，这很让人担心。表达异议是一回事，但你们的胡闹危害了我们机师的安全，还让这家公司损失了不知多少钱。如果你们学会像专业人士那样提意见，本来能争取到多得多的东西。"

技师们咕哝着，但还是回到了岗位。[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 却是一脸得意。有些机甲技师懒得掩饰对你和 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 的鄙夷，公然怒目而视。

那天深夜，杨拎着一瓶威士忌来到你的舱室。"机甲技师们还在磨洋工，但他们会缓过来的。让他们抱怨一个月，他们自己就腻了嘴，回去干活。"他给你们俩倒上酒。你们在沉默中共饮。

column1:
The MechTechs are right. You reach for the tool rack, taking a deep breath. "We put our lives in your hands every time we mount up." You pull a blowtorch loose. "We'll set aside a year-end bonus for your work, but let's clean up this mess first."

[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] crosses {SCN_MW.DET} arms. "You're letting them off easy! They're going to keep messing with our 'Mechs!" A glimmer of paranoia enters the {SCN_MW.DET} eyes.

You fix {SCN_MW.Callsign} with a stern expression. "Listen up, MechWarrior. You get all the glory and big paydays. What do the MechTechs get? Your mess and your crap." A jet of blue flame erupts from the torch in your hand. "We're a team. Start acting like it."

The MechTechs return to their stations, setting up ladders and climbing the [[SCN_UNIT,{SCN_Unit.Name}]]. {SCN_MW.Callsign} opens {SCN_MW.DET} mouth to dissent, but [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] drags {SCN_MW.OBJ} down the hall.

Hours later, Yang reports in. "Money talks, Boss. And it looks like it told the MechTechs to work their asses off. Don't expect any further demonstrations."
column2:
机甲技师们说得对。你伸手去取工具架，深吸一口气。"每次登机，我们都把自己的命交在你们手里。"你抽出一把喷灯。"我们会为你们的付出设立一笔年终奖金，但先把这堆烂摊子收拾干净。"

[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 抱起 {SCN_MW.DET} 双臂。"你太便宜他们了！他们会继续糟蹋我们的机甲！"{SCN_MW.DET} 眼里闪过一丝疑神疑鬼。

你严厉地盯着 {SCN_MW.Callsign}。"听好了，机甲战士。荣誉和大笔酬金都是你的。机甲技师得到了什么？你的烂摊子和你的破事。"你手里的喷灯喷出一道蓝色火焰。"我们是一个团队。拿出点团队的样子。"

机甲技师们回到岗位，架起梯子爬上 [[SCN_UNIT,{SCN_Unit.Name}]]。{SCN_MW.Callsign} 张开 {SCN_MW.DET} 嘴还想反驳，但 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 把 {SCN_MW.OBJ} 拖出了走廊。

几个小时后，杨来汇报。"钱会说话，老大。看来它已经叫机甲技师们拼了命干活。以后不会再有这类抗议了。"

column1:
You climb up onto the scaffolding, raising your voice so that all can hear. "Each and every one of you works hard to ensure the success of this outfit, and you all deserve a bonus, regardless of rank or title." Everybody looks at you, murmuring in surprise.

"Our lives aren't easy along the Periphery. But each of you depends on others to survive out here. MechTechs and MechWarriors—you're two sides of the same coin. Time for you to recognize it." You pause for a moment, letting your words sink in. "We'll set aside a million C-Bills for a one-time bonus… to be divided equally." Heads nod in the crowd, and some people even cheer in agreement.
 
When you check on the Mech Bay later that day, you notice [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] and [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] hauling equipment over to the MechTechs as they weld fresh armor over the [[SCN_UNIT,{SCN_Unit.Name}]]'s scorched torso. Each crew member is pitching in and working harder than you expected, despite the tension earlier.

Yang pats you on the back. "Smell that, Boss? That's the smell of progress."
column2:
你爬上脚手架，提高嗓门让所有人都能听见。"你们每一个人都拼命干活，才让这支部队走到今天，无论职级或头衔，你们都该得到一笔奖金。"所有人都看着你，惊讶地低声议论。

"在边境外围，日子不好过。但在这里，你们每个人都得靠别人才能活下来。机甲技师和机甲战士——你们是同一枚硬币的两面。是时候认清这一点了。"你停顿片刻，让这些话沉下去。"我们会拿出一百万 C 币作为一次性奖金……平均分配。"人群中有人点头，甚至有人欢呼着表示赞同。
 
那天晚些时候你去机库查看时，注意到 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 和 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 正把设备搬给机甲技师们，而技师们正在为 [[SCN_UNIT,{SCN_Unit.Name}]] 焦黑的躯干焊上崭新的装甲。尽管先前气氛紧张，每个船员都在出力，干得比你想的还要猛。

杨拍了拍你的背。"闻到没有，老大？这是进步的味道。"

column1:
Get back to the barracks, MechWarriors. I've got more important work to do. You reach for the comms and call for Darius. "The XO will tally up your violations and handle discipline. That includes the MechTechs, too."

Yang barks at his 'Techs, gesturing to the [[SCN_UNIT,{SCN_Unit.Name}]], "Clean up your mess."

[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]'s eyes flare with anger. "They're going to get us killed! And it's going to be your fault." You level your gaze at {SCN_MW.OBJ}, but before {SCN_MW.SUBJ} can open {SCN_MW.DET} mouth, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] drags {SCN_MW.Callsign} from the Mech Bay.

Hours later, Darius's voice comes crackling over the comms. "I'm thinking about throwing {SCN_MW.Callsign} out the airlock," he says. "I caught {SCN_MW.OBJ} trying to pick a fight with the MechTechs. For now, I'll leave {SCN_MW.OBJ} in the brig for a week, and that should change {SCN_MW.DET} tune, but the damage is done. The crew's spirits are taking a dive."
column2:
回营房去，机甲战士们。我还有更重要的事要办。你伸手打开通讯器呼叫达里乌斯。"副官会统计你们的违纪记录并作出处理。机甲技师也一样。"

杨朝他的技师们吼道，指着 [[SCN_UNIT,{SCN_Unit.Name}]]，"把你们的烂摊子收拾干净。"

[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 眼里怒火直冒。"他们会把我们害死的！而这都得算你的错。"你死死盯着 {SCN_MW.OBJ}，但 {SCN_MW.SUBJ} 还没来得及张开 {SCN_MW.DET} 嘴，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 就把 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 拖出了机库。

几个小时后，达里乌斯的声音从通讯器里传来。"我在考虑把 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 扔出气闸舱，"他说。"我逮到 {SCN_MW.OBJ} 想跟机甲技师们动手。眼下我先关 {SCN_MW.OBJ} 一周禁闭，这应该能改改 {SCN_MW.DET} 性子，但伤害已经造成了。船员们的士气正在往下掉。"

column1:
You're right, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]. You turn from the MechWarriors to the comms and call the entire outfit to the mess for an impromptu meeting.

Once everyone is gathered in the mess, you order [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] to step forward as you stand up on a table and raise your voice.

"I wouldn't ordinarily dress down {TGT_MW.Callsign} like this, but it only takes one drunk in a 'Mech to endanger us all. We need to depend on one another." All eyes turns toward {TGT_MW.Callsign}, who stares red-faced at the ground. "{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} will sober up or I'll show {TGT_MW.OBJ} the door. Now I don't want to do that, so let's all band together and help {TGT_MW.Callsign} dry out."

The next day Darius reports that {TGT_MW.Callsign} volunteered to take {SCN_MW.Callsign}'s chore shifts. "Looks like your words lit a fire under {TGT_MW.DET} ass."
column2:
你说得对，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]。你从机甲战士转向通讯器，召集整支部队到食堂开个临时会议。

等所有人都聚到食堂，你让 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 上前一步，自己站上桌子，提高嗓门。

"我通常不会这样公开训斥 {TGT_MW.Callsign}，但只要机甲里有一个醉鬼，就能把我们所有人置于险境。我们必须彼此依靠。"所有目光都转向 {TGT_MW.Callsign}，涨红着脸盯着地面。"{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} 要么把酒戒了，要么我就请 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 走人。我不愿意那么做，所以大家团结起来，帮 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 把这酒戒掉。"

第二天达里乌斯来汇报，说 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 主动提出替 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 值杂活班次。"看来你那番话把 {TGT_MW.DET} 火点着了。"

column1:
This ends today. You nod your head to [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]. Turning from the MechWarriors, you turn on the comms and call the entire outfit to the mess for an impromptu meeting.

Once everyone is gathered in the mess, you order [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] to step forward as you stand up on a table and raise your voice.

"Normally, I wouldn't call you all out here like this. Unfortunately, it only takes one drunk or hungover MechWarrior to endanger the rest of the outfit. Until {TGT_MW.Callsign} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:sober|Default:sobers} up all liquor rations will be cut." {TGT_MW.Callsign} glares at you defiantly. Heads turns toward {TGT_MW.OBJ} with a mix of frustration and concern.

The next day, Darius reports that {SCN_MW.Callsign} uncovered and destroyed {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s stash of hooch. Unfortunately, {TGT_MW.Callsign} gave {SCN_MW.OBJ} a black eye. "I disciplined {TGT_MW.OBJ}, but I'll need to keep an eye on {TGT_MW.Callsign} from now on."
column2:
今天到此为止。你朝 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 点了点头。你从机甲战士那边转身，打开通讯器，召集整支部队到食堂开个临时会议。

等所有人都聚到食堂，你让 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 上前一步，自己站上桌子，提高嗓门。

"平常我不会这样把大家叫过来。但不幸的是，只要有一个喝醉或宿醉的机甲战士，就能威胁到整支部队的安全。在 {TGT_MW.Callsign} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:sober|Default:sobers} 之前，所有酒类配给一律削减。"{TGT_MW.Callsign} 挑衅地瞪着你。众人的目光转向 {TGT_MW.OBJ}，夹杂着沮丧与担忧。

第二天，达里乌斯汇报说 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 找出了 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 私藏的酒并全部销毁。不幸的是，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 把 {SCN_MW.OBJ} 打了个乌眼青。"我处罚了 {TGT_MW.OBJ}，但从今往后得盯紧 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 了。"

column1:
After receiving a troubling message from Yang, you rush down to the Mech Bay. Yang pushes between a mob of MechWarriors and MechTechs entangled in a shoving match at the [[SCN_UNIT,{SCN_Unit.Name}]]'s feet. A message welded into the {SCN_Unit.Name}'s torso reads: "No 'Techs, no 'Mechs!"

"You. Depend. On. Us." A scrawny MechTech with a black eye shoves a wrench at the 'Mech jockeys to emphasize every word. "We deserve respect, and that means a raise."

"I'll give you what you deserve." [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] rushes forward, but [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and Yang pull {SCN_MW.OBJ} back from the 'Tech. "We're the ones risking our necks!"

Yang raises his voice before anyone else can comment. "Shut your traps! All of you. How do you want to handle this, Boss?"
column2:
收到杨发来的一条令人不安的消息后，你冲到机库。在 [[SCN_UNIT,{SCN_Unit.Name}]] 脚下，一群机甲战士和机甲技师扭打推搡，杨挤在人群中间。{SCN_Unit.Name} 的躯干上焊着一行字："没有技师，就没有机甲！"

"你们。得靠。我们。"一个瘦骨嶙峋、眼圈乌青的机甲技师拿扳手一下一下戳着那些机甲骑手，以示强调。"我们该得到尊重，那就是加薪。"

"我会给你该得的东西。"[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 冲上前去，但 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 和杨把 {SCN_MW.OBJ} 从技师面前拉了回来。"冒生命危险的人是我们！"

杨在别人开口前提高嗓门。"都给我闭嘴！你们所有人。老大，这事你想怎么处理？"

column1:
You turn from the MedTech to [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. "You'll return to active duty, but only when you're ready. For now, it's bed rest. No battles. No drills. That's an order, MechWarrior."

{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:lie|Default:lies} back, defeated. "This is almost as bad as retirement."

"If you don't take your health seriously, you won't even remember how to pilot a 'Mech. Take up a hobby. Read a book. It doesn't really matter, as long as you stay put."

A few days later, a MedTech reports in. "{TGT_MW.Callsign} is showing remarkable signs of recovery. In fact, we caught {TGT_MW.OBJ} trying to sneak out a couple times already. You'll need to keep an eye on {TGT_MW.OBJ} after {TGT_MW.SUBJ}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'re|Default:'s} discharged."
column2:
你从医疗技师转向 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。"你会重返现役，但得等你准备好了。现在，卧床休息。不参战。不训练。这是命令，机甲战士。"

{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:lie|Default:lies} 了回去，一脸挫败。"这跟退休差不多难受了。"

"你要是不认真对待自己的身体，到时候连怎么开机甲都不记得了。找个爱好。读本书。干什么都行，只要老老实实待着别动。"

几天后，一名医疗技师来汇报。"{TGT_MW.Callsign} 的恢复情况好得出奇。事实上，我们已经抓到 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 想偷偷溜出去好几次了。{TGT_MW.SUBJ}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'re|Default:'s} 出院之后，你可得盯紧 {TGT_MW.OBJ}。"

column1: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] immediately come to attention as you slowly walk over. You stop in front of {TGT_MW.Callsign}, and {TGT_MW.SUBJ} carefully {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:avoid|Default:avoids} your eyes, rigidly looking just past your shoulder. "Pilot, I am the commanding officer on this ship. Not you. No one cares about your noble upbringing. You need to leave that thinking behind." Gesturing to the room, "You need these MechWarriors to have your back out there, or you are going to catch a stray AutoCannon round in the back." You give {SCN_MW.Callsign} a pointed look. "…Which had better not happen, understand? I don't need my 'Mechs getting damaged by my own employees."
column2: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 和 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 在你慢慢走过去时立刻立正。 你在 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 面前停下，{TGT_MW.SUBJ} 小心翼翼地 {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:avoid|Default:avoids} 你的目光，僵硬地盯着你肩膀后面稍远的地方。 "机师，我才是这艘船上的指挥官。不是你。没人关心你贵族的出身。你得把脑子里那套东西丢掉。" 你朝舱内比了个手势，"在外面，你需要这些机甲战士给你撑腰，否则你后脑勺上就会挨一发流弹自动炮。"你意味深长地看了 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 一眼。"……而那种事最好别发生，明白吗？我可不需要我的机甲被自己的雇员打坏。"

column1:
The following day, when you arrive in the Barracks, both MechWarriors are calmer and properly ashamed about their confinement to quarters.

Pointing to [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], "I don't care about your noble upbringing. I should know better than anyone how little that matters out here in the Periphery."

"And, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], I don't care if {TGT_MW.Gender?Male:he's|Female:she's|NonBinary:they're} a pompous jerk, you can't start fights in the mess hall."

Looking both of them in the eyes, "We're in a dangerous business. We need to be able to trust each other. And if a 'Mech gets damaged from a friendly-fire incident on the next contract, you'll both be out on your asses."
column2:
第二天你到营房时，两名机甲战士都冷静了下来，也对被禁足在舱室里感到由衷的羞愧。

你指着 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]，"我不在乎你贵族的出身。在这边境外围，那玩意儿有多不值钱，我比谁都清楚。"

"还有你，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]，我不管{TGT_MW.Gender?Male:he's|Female:she's|NonBinary:they're}是不是个自大的混蛋，你都不能在食堂里动手。"

你直视两人的眼睛，"我们干的是危险的买卖。我们必须能互相信任。要是下个合约里有机甲因为误伤受损，你们两个都得卷铺盖走人。"

column1:
The two MechWarriors circle in the makeshift boxing ring while the crew shouts encouragement.

Both MechWarriors have taken a beating over the course of the eight rounds, but while [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] has passion, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] has precision.

{SCN_MW.Callsign}, flagging and back against the ropes, springs forward with a final surge of energy.

In response to such a wild assault, {TGT_MW.Callsign} steps, turns and strikes in a pattern {TGT_MW.Subj} probably practiced hundreds of times at an expensive fighting school. {SCN_MW.Callsign} goes down hard.

As the referee reaches the 10-count, the crowd goes wild.
column2:
两名机甲战士在临时搭起的拳击台里绕着圈，船员们在一旁大喊助威。

八个回合下来，两人都挨了不少打，但 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 有的是激情，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 有的是精准。

{SCN_MW.Callsign} 精疲力竭、背靠着围绳，猛地向前一扑，迸出最后一股力气。

面对这样一轮蛮攻，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 移步、转身、出拳，那一套动作 {TGT_MW.Subj} 大概在某所昂贵的混战学校里练过几百遍。{SCN_MW.Callsign} 重重倒地。

裁判数到十时，人群沸腾了。

column1: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] immediately come to attention as you slowly walk over. You stop in front of {SCN_MW.Callsign}, and {SCN_MW.SUBJ} carefully {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:avoid|Default:avoids} your eyes, rigidly looking just past your shoulder. "I will not have fights in my mess hall. I don't care how much of a prick {TGT_MW.Callsign} is. Until you cool down, you're staying off the Contract roster. Now get out of my sight." {SCN_MW.SUBJ_C} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:turn|Default:turns} stiffly and marches from the room, one bloody fist still clenched. Later in the week, Darius reports that {TGT_MW.Callsign} has continued to throw {TGT_MW.DET} weight around with other pilots. "{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:keep|Default:keeps} that up and we'll have a friendly fire incident."
column2: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 和 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 在你慢慢走过去时立刻立正。 你在 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 面前停下，{SCN_MW.SUBJ} 小心翼翼地 {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:avoid|Default:avoids} 你的目光，僵硬地盯着你肩膀后面稍远的地方。 "我绝不允许在我的食堂里打架。我不管 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 有多讨厌。在你冷静下来之前，合约名单上没你的名字。现在给我滚。" {SCN_MW.SUBJ_C} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:turn|Default:turns} 身僵硬地大步走出房间，一只血淋淋的拳头仍然紧握着。 这周晚些时候，达里乌斯汇报说 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 还在对其他机师耍 {TGT_MW.DET} 威风。"{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:keep|Default:keeps} 这么下去，迟早要来一起误伤事件。"

column1:
Oh, come on, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. Aren't you using your 'connections' right now? If you can't find a way to handle this, I'd rather you pass it on to your own relatives than me. I have work to do.

{TGT_MW.Callsign} flushes. "Commander, I… you're right. I'll deal with it."

Later, {TGT_MW.Callsign} jubilantly follows up with you. "Commander, I passed along the cooling system improvement idea to my cousin, and she says it's quite promising. I never would have expected it of somebody like [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]!"
column2:
哦，得了吧，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。你现在不就在动用你的'人脉'吗？要是你找不到办法处理这事，我宁可你把它交给你的亲戚，也别塞给我。我还有活儿要干。

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 脸红了。"指挥官，我……你说得对。我会处理好的。"

后来，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 兴高采烈地来跟你汇报。"指挥官，我把冷却系统改进的想法转给了我表姐，她说这很有前途。我真没想到 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 这样的人能想出这种点子！"

column1:
Raised voices echo down the mess deck hallway and you arrive to find [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] nose-to-nose with [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]].

"I don't care about your noble family! You. Don't. Give. Me. Orders!" {SCN_MW.Callsign} snarls, poking the other MechWarrior in the chest with each word.

{TGT_MW.Callsign} lifts {TGT_MW.DET} chin. "Even out here in the Periphery, you should know enough to listen to your betters."

{SCN_MW.Callsign}'s fist flashes out before anyone can intervene, sending {TGT_MW.Callsign} staggering, blood erupting from a broken nose.

In the dangerous silence that follows, the room finally notices that you've arrived. A single fork clatters to the floor.
column2:
食堂走廊里传出高昂的争吵声，你赶到时发现 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 和 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 正鼻子贴鼻子地对峙。

"我才不在乎你那个贵族家庭！你。别。对。我。发号施令！"{SCN_MW.Callsign} 咆哮着，每说一个词就戳一下另一名机甲战士的胸口。

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 抬起 {TGT_MW.DET} 下巴。"就算在这边境外围，你也该懂点规矩，听比你强的人的话。"

{SCN_MW.Callsign} 的拳头在任何人来得及插手之前挥了出去，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 踉跄后退，鼻血喷涌而出。

随之而来的危险寂静中，房间里的人终于注意到你来了。一把叉子哐当掉在地上。

column1:
The two MechWarriors circle in the makeshift boxing ring while the crew shouts encouragement.

Both MechWarriors have taken a beating over the course of the eight rounds, but while [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] has training, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] has the will to win.

{TGT_MW.Callsign}, flagging and back against the ropes, darts in with a final surge of energy.

In response to such a predictable assault, {SCN_MW.Callsign} turns one of {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s own moves back on {TGT_MW.Obj}, Early in the fight, {TGT_MW.Callsign} had staggered {SCN_MW.Callsign} with it. Now, {TGT_MW.Callsign} goes down hard.

As the referee reaches the 10-count, the crowd goes wild.
column2:
两名机甲战士在临时搭起的拳击台里绕着圈，船员们在一旁大喊助威。

八个回合下来，两人都挨了不少打，但 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 靠的是训练，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 靠的是必胜的意志。

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 精疲力竭、背靠着围绳，猛地冲了进去，迸出最后一股力气。

面对这样一套早被看透的进攻，{SCN_MW.Callsign} 把 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 自己的一招还到了 {TGT_MW.Obj} 身上——开打不久，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 曾用这一招把 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 打得踉跄。现在，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 重重倒地。

裁判数到十时，人群沸腾了。

column1:
Ignoring the MedTech, you pat the edge of [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s bed. "If you want to saddle up, I won't stop you, but there's no rush."

The MedTech's eyes widen in surprise, but she says nothing.

You lean in close to {TGT_MW.Callsign}. "You're on borrowed time. We all are, but you've earned the right to call your own shots."

{TGT_MW.Callsign} looks down at the photo of {TGT_MW.DET} mother, then back up with a bittersweet smile. "This company is all I've got left, Commander."

"We're lucky to have you. Now get some rest. You'll need it."
column2:
你无视那名医疗技师，拍了拍 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 的床沿。"你要是想上战场，我不会拦你，但不必急在这一时。"

那名医疗技师惊讶地瞪大了眼睛，但什么也没说。

你凑近 {TGT_MW.Callsign}。"你已经是在借来的时间里活着了。我们都是。但你有权利自己决定怎么走。"

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 低头看着 {TGT_MW.DET} 母亲的照片，再抬起头时带着一丝苦涩的微笑。"这家公司是我仅剩的一切了，指挥官。"

"有你在，是我们的运气。现在好好休息。你需要它。"

column1:
You brush the MedTech aside and incline your head toward [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. "If you want to get back on the battlefield, then why would I get in your way?"

"You're condemning {TGT_MW.OBJ} to death!" the MedTech interrupts.

You look the MedTech straight in the eyes. "It's {TGT_MW.DET} choice, not yours. {TGT_MW.Callsign} deserves the basic dignity of deciding how {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:want|Default:wants} to go out."

{TGT_MW.Callsign} looks down at the photo clutched in {TGT_MW.DET} hand, then back to you. "Thank you, Commander. I know what I signed up for. I'm not afraid."

"It'd be okay if you were, MechWarrior. It wouldn't make you any less brave. You've had a hell of a career, and it's not over yet."
column2:
你把那名医疗技师拨到一边，朝 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 扬了扬下巴。"你要是想重返战场，我凭什么拦着你？"

"你这是在判 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 死刑！"那名医疗技师插话道。

你直直看着那名医疗技师的眼睛。"这是 {TGT_MW.DET} 的选择，不是你的。{TGT_MW.Callsign} 该有最基本的尊严，自己决定 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:want|Default:wants} 怎么收场。"

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 低头看向 {TGT_MW.DET} 攥在手里的照片，再看向你。"谢谢你，指挥官。我知道自己签的是什么。我不怕。"

"就算你怕，也没关系，机甲战士。那不会让你少半分勇敢。你的职业生涯够精彩，而且还没结束。"

column1:
You dismiss the MedTech and rest a hand on [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s shoulder. "I don't know your mother, but the lady in this photo looks like she'd chew me out if I let you throw your life away. You'll rest until you're cleared by the MedTechs."

{TGT_MW.Callsign} lowers {TGT_MW.DET} eyes, squinting down at the photo as if looking for an answer. "When this is all over, hopefully I'll be able to tell you if that's true or not."

A few days later, a MedTech reports in. "The medication has reduced {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s brain swelling and blood loss. At this rate, {TGT_MW.DET} cognitive functioning and motor skills will return to normal levels in three months, but the tissues will never fully heal."

You sigh. "So, {TGT_MW.Callsign} will be fit for duty, but if {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:suffer|Default:suffers} another major injury, {TGT_MW.SUBJ} might never recover. Got it."

Somber, the MedTech says, "It's a small miracle that {TGT_MW.Callsign} is standing at all."
column2:
你打发走那名医疗技师，一只手搭在 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 的肩上。"我不认识你母亲，但照片里这位女士看起来，要是我让你把命丢掉，她会把我骂个狗血淋头。在医疗技师放你出院之前，你就老老实实休息。"

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 垂下 {TGT_MW.DET} 眼帘，眯眼看着照片，仿佛在寻找一个答案。"等这一切结束，但愿我能告诉你她说得对不对。"

几天后，一名医疗技师来汇报。"药物减轻了 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 的脑部肿胀和失血。按这个速度，{TGT_MW.DET} 认知功能和运动能力会在三个月内恢复到正常水平，但组织永远无法完全愈合。"

你叹了口气。"也就是说，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 能胜任勤务，但要是 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:suffer|Default:suffers} 另一次重伤，{TGT_MW.SUBJ} 可能就再也恢复不了了。明白了。"

那名医疗技师语气沉重地说："{TGT_MW.Callsign} 现在还能站着，已经算是个小小的奇迹了。"

column1: You push past the MedTech. "I'm sorry, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], but you need to get as far away from the battlefield as you can. It's time to retire, settle down somewhere nice. If I kept you on, you'd deploy eventually, and I can't let that happen." After giving {TGT_MW.Callsign} time to prepare, you summon the entire crew to the mess for a retirement party. As each MechWarrior tells stories about {TGT_MW.Callsign}, {TGT_MW.DET} anguish dissolves into laughter and teary-eyed gratitude. As crumpled beer cans stack up, the stories veer into rowdier territory. The mess quiets when Dr. Murad approaches {TGT_MW.Callsign}. "For your distinguished service aboard the Argo." She holds out a star welded from scrap. "There's no medal quite like it." The company cheers as she pins it to {TGT_MW.DET} chest. The next day, the remaining MechWarriors pull you aside. "You did the right thing, Commander. {TGT_MW.Callsign} was going to get {TGT_MW.OBJ}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:selves|Default:self} killed. We won't forget this."
column2: 你推开那名医疗技师。"抱歉，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]，但你必须离战场越远越好。该退休了，找个好地方安顿下来。要是我把你留下，你迟早会出任务，我不能让那种事发生。" 给了 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 一点准备时间后，你召集全体船员到食堂，办一场退休派对。当一名名机甲战士讲起 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 的故事时，{TGT_MW.DET} 的悲痛化作笑声和含泪的感激。空啤酒罐越堆越高，故事也渐渐变得粗野起来。 穆拉德博士走向 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 时，食堂安静下来。"感谢你在阿尔戈号上的卓越服役。"她捧出一颗用废铁焊成的星星。"没有比这更像勋章的东西了。"她把星星别在 {TGT_MW.DET} 胸口时，整个公司都欢呼起来。 第二天，其余的机甲战士把你拉到一边。"你做得对，指挥官。{TGT_MW.Callsign} 本来会害死 {TGT_MW.OBJ}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:selves|Default:self}。我们不会忘记这件事。"

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] has dominated the fight over the first three rounds, bloodying the other MechWarrior repeatedly.

[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], flagging and back against the ropes, springs forward with a final surge of energy.

In response to such a wild assault, {TGT_MW.Callsign} steps, turns and strikes in a pattern {TGT_MW.Subj} probably practiced hundreds of times at an expensive fighting school. {SCN_MW.Callsign} goes down hard.

As the referee reaches the 10-count, the crowd goes wild.

[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 精疲力竭、背靠着围绳，猛地向前一扑，迸出最后一股力气。

前三个回合，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 完全压制了这场打斗，一次次把对手打得满脸是血。

column1: In the MedBay, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] cradles an old photo. Stitches lace {TGT_MW.DET} temple. "The MedTechs tell me this is my mother, but I can't remember her…" A MedTech steps in. "{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:They've|Male:He's|Female:She's} developed a [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTBI],TBI]]. {TGT_MW.DET_C} next head injury will be fatal if we don't intervene. Retirement is the safest option, but the damage is done. While there are no guarantees, there is a chance of recovery if {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} confined to bed rest, but it could take weeks or months." {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:sit|Default:sits} up, wincing. "I don't need bed rest. I need to be in the cockpit. It's all I know, Commander." "There is one more option." The MedTech hesitates. "We could implant a Davion neurostimulator. The procedure poses a high risk—the slightest error will result in complete brain death—but if the neurostimulator is successfully implanted, {TGT_MW.SUBJ}'ll be combat ready within days."
column2: 医疗舱里，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 抱着一张旧照片。{TGT_MW.DET} 太阳穴上缠着缝合线。"医疗技师们告诉我这是我母亲，可我记不起她……" 一名医疗技师走上前来。"{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:They've|Male:He's|Female:She's} 患上了 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTBI],创伤性脑损伤]]。如果不加干预，{TGT_MW.DET_C} 下一次头部受伤就会致命。退休是最安全的选择，但损伤已经造成了。虽然无法保证，但如果 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} 卧床静养，仍有恢复的可能，只是可能需要数周甚至数月。" {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:sit|Default:sits} 了起来，疼得龇牙咧嘴。"我不需要卧床静养。我需要坐进驾驶舱。那是我唯一会做的事，指挥官。" "还有一个选择。"那名医疗技师犹豫了一下。"我们可以植入一个戴维恩神经刺激器。手术风险极高——哪怕最微小的失误都会导致彻底脑死亡——但如果神经刺激器植入成功，{TGT_MW.SUBJ} 几天内就能恢复战斗力。"

column1: You grab a broom leaning against a bench and thrust it into [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s hands. "I don't want to hear your excuses. If you did your job, you wouldn't be here, MechWarrior." {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} reluctantly {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:accept|Default:accepts} the broom, {TGT_MW.DET} voice turning icy. "Fine, I'll take care of the mess. In fact, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], why don't you take the day off. I'll handle this myself." "Alright." {SCN_MW.Callsign} smiles. "I won't argue with that." You dismiss them both, before more bickering breaks out. The next day, Darius's pulls you aside. "{TGT_MW.Callsign} stuffed {SCN_MW.Callsign}'s locker with garbage. Half-eaten food scraps spilled all over {SCN_MW.OBJ}. The other MechWarriors had a good chuckle about it, but {TGT_MW.Callsign} won't be laughing while {TGT_MW.SUBJ} cleans up the barracks and the rest of the Argo."
column2: 你抓起靠在长凳上的一把扫帚，塞进 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 手里。"我不想听你的借口。要是你干好你的活儿，你就不会站在这儿了，机甲战士。" {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} 不情愿地 {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:accept|Default:accepts} 了扫帚，{TGT_MW.DET} 的声音变得冰冷。"行，烂摊子我来收拾。其实，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]，你干脆放一天假吧。这活儿我自己来。" "好啊。"{SCN_MW.Callsign} 笑了。"这我可不争。"你趁他们又要吵起来之前把两人都打发走了。 第二天，达里乌斯把你拉到一边。"{TGT_MW.Callsign} 往 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 的储物柜里塞满了垃圾。吃剩的食物碎渣撒了 {SCN_MW.OBJ} 一身。其他机甲战士为这事乐了一阵，但 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 可就没那么乐了——{TGT_MW.SUBJ} 得去打扫营房和阿尔戈号的其余地方。"

column1:
You sigh. "Spoken like a true wash-out. Well, not everybody is suited to command. Out of the way, MechWarrior. Somebody's got to sort those kids out."

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] winces. "Ah... No, Commander. I'll deal with it. Sorry to interrupt you."

Later, Darius speaks approvingly of {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s technique of defusing a tense situation by promising an even worse one if they don't 'calm the hell down.'
column2:
你叹了口气。"听起来就是个十足的废柴。算了，不是每个人都适合指挥。让开，机甲战士。总得有人去把那帮小子收拾一顿。"

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 缩了一下。"啊……不，指挥官。我去处理。抱歉打扰你了。"

后来，达里乌斯赞许地谈起 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 的手法：先威胁说要是他们不"他妈给我冷静下来"，就会有更糟的后果，以此化解紧张局面。

column1: While browsing in the Argo's library, you find [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] with a pile of printed materials, Holovid chips, and datapads. "Commander, I'm… well, I'm a bit lost, actually. I'm pretty new here, and I'd like to make myself as useful as possible." {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:gesture|Default:gestures} at the pile. "Maybe if I could do more than just pull the trigger on my LRM, I might get more contract assignments. I, uh…" {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:hesitate|Default:hesitates}. "My folks depend on the money I send them, and I can't afford to be let go from another mercenary company. What do you think I should study?"
column2: 你在阿尔戈号的图书馆里翻书时，发现 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 面前堆着一摞纸本资料、全息影像芯片和数位板。 "指挥官，我……说实话，我有点找不着方向。我来这儿时间不长，我想让自己尽量派得上用场。"{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:gesture|Default:gestures} 了一下那堆东西。 "也许如果我不只是会扣我那门 LRM 的扳机，就能接到更多合约任务。我，呃……"{TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:hesitate|Default:hesitates}。"我家人靠我寄回去的钱过日子，我不能再被一家雇佣兵公司辞掉了。你觉得我该学什么？"

column1:
I have plenty of people who can pull a trigger, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. What I need are more MechWarriors that can see the big picture on the battlefield.

You do a quick search on one of the computers then flip it around for {TGT_MW.OBJ} to see. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:read|Default:reads} the passage aloud. "Victorious MechWarriors win first and then engage the enemy, while defeated MechWarriors start the battle and then try to win."

Slapping {TGT_MW.Callsign} on the back, "When you're confident in your command of the battlefield, you can make the tough calls, the bold maneuvers, the smart decisions."
column2:
我手底下能扣扳机的人多的是，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。我需要的是更多能在战场上看到全局的机甲战士。

你在电脑上快速检索了一下，然后把屏幕转过去给 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 看。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:read|Default:reads} 出声念出那段文字："胜利的机甲战士先求胜而后求战，失败的机甲战士先求战而后求胜。"

你拍了拍 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 的背，"当你对战场指挥有底气时，你才能做出艰难的决定、大胆的机动、明智的判断。"

column1:
You sigh. "Spoken like a true wash-out. Well, not everybody is suited to command. Out of the way, MechWarrior. Somebody's got to sort those kids out."

You stalk down the hall, into the mess, and generally lay waste to everyone present. 

The next morning, everybody not confined to barracks walks on eggshells around you, especially [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]].
column2:
你叹了口气。"听起来就是个十足的废柴。算了，不是每个人都适合指挥。让开，机甲战士。总得有人去把那帮小子收拾一顿。"

你大步走过走廊，冲进食堂，把在场所有人都数落了个遍。

第二天早上，所有没被禁足在营房里的人都小心翼翼地绕着你走，尤其是 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。

column1:
You say, "In an outfit like this, you only get promoted if you take the initiative." You pause meaningfully.

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] says, "Honestly, I'm fine just being a pilot right now. So anyhow, about those guys? I don't want anybody to end up in the MedBay!"

You sigh and contact Darius to deal with the issue.
column2:
你说："在这种部队里，只有主动承担责任的人才会升职。"你意味深长地停顿了一下。

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 说："老实说，现在我就当个机师挺好的。那么，那帮家伙的事怎么办？我可不想有人最后进医疗舱！"

你叹了口气，联系达里乌斯去处理这件事。

column1:
You say, "In an outfit like this, you only get promoted if you take the initiative." You pause meaningfully.

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] looks thoughtful. Then, without another word, {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:return|Default:returns} down the corridor.

Later, you hear {TGT_MW.Callsign} dragged both bickering MechWarriors to the MedBay to have bruised foreheads examined, and everybody was remarkably cheerful about it.
column2:
你说："在这种部队里，只有主动承担责任的人才会升职。"你意味深长地停顿了一下。

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 若有所思。然后，一句话也没多说，{TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:return|Default:returns} 身沿走廊回去了。

后来你听说，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 把两个吵个不停的机甲战士都拖去了医疗舱，检查他们额头上的瘀伤，而大家对此都出奇地高兴。

column1:
You say, "In an outfit like this, you only get promoted if you take the initiative." You pause meaningfully.

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] gulps, salutes, and goes back to the brewing brawl.

Soon {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s raised voice echoes through the ship. In the end, no one is injured, but there's still bad blood for the next few days.
column2:
你说："在这种部队里，只有主动承担责任的人才会升职。"你意味深长地停顿了一下。

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 咽了口唾沫，敬了个礼，转身回到那场即将爆发的斗殴里。

很快，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 高昂的嗓音就在整艘船里回荡开来。最后没有人受伤，但接下来几天里彼此之间还是存着怨气。

column1: I have plenty of people who can pull a trigger, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. What I need are more MechWarriors that can see the big picture on the battlefield. You do a quick search on one of the computers then flip it around for {TGT_MW.OBJ} to see. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:read|Default:reads} the passage aloud. "Do not rely on the likelihood of the enemy not attacking, but rely on your own readiness to defend against him; make your position unassailable." Slapping {TGT_MW.Callsign} on the back, "Remember that the next time you get sent down to defend one of our client's facilities."
column2: 我手底下能扣扳机的人多的是，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。我需要的是更多能在战场上看到全局的机甲战士。 你在电脑上快速检索了一下，然后把屏幕转过去给 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 看。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:read|Default:reads} 出声念出那段文字："不要指望敌人不会进攻，而要依靠自己严阵以待；让自己的阵地无懈可击。" 你拍了拍 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 的背，"下次派你去守卫客户的设施时，记住这一点。"

column1: Let's go planetside. You smile. "We've earned some R&R." On a secluded patch of [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]], Yang grills [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTripleFBurger],Triple-F Burgers]] while MechWarriors play cards and toss a basketball through a corroded coupling seal they brought planetside. Once the first meteor zips across the sky, voices rise in celebration, but soon the crowd quiets and the games stop. The company looks on in awe as a hundred points of light stream through the darkness. Back on the Argo, you notice that the crew is in good spirits but still focused. In the hallway, Sumire nudges you in the ribs. "We should celebrate more often. Even when there aren't space rocks flying into nearby planets. Good call, Commander."
column2: 去地面吧。你笑了。"我们赢得了一点休假。" 在 [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] 一处僻静的地方，杨烤着 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTripleFBurger],三层F汉堡]]，机甲战士们打着牌，把一个篮球投过他们带到地面上来的一个锈蚀管接头。 第一颗流星划过天际时，欢呼声四起，但很快人群安静下来，游戏也停了。全公司的人怀着敬畏，望着上百点光芒流过夜空。 回到阿尔戈号上，你注意到船员们精神很好，但依然专注。走廊里，澄美用胳膊肘捅了捅你的肋部。"我们应该多庆祝庆祝。就算没有太空石头飞进附近行星的时候也该庆祝。干得好，指挥官。"

column1:
Let's go planetside. You shrug. "What's the worst that could happen?"

On a secluded patch of [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]], the crew looks up as storm clouds move in fast, crowding the night sky.

A shout goes up here and there as pilots catch the glimmer of a meteor, but soon heavy rains push the company back into the Leopard before they can start celebrating. Crowded inside, they return sooner than expected, griping loudly.

"Some shower," Sumire says, wringing the moisture from her hair.
column2:
去地面吧。你耸了耸肩。"还能出什么更糟的事？"

在 [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] 一处僻静的地方，船员们抬头看着暴风云迅速聚拢，挤满夜空。

机师们看到流星一闪，这边那边响起几声喊叫，但很快大雨就把大家赶回了豹式里，庆祝还没开始就结束了。挤在舱内，他们比预期更早返航，抱怨声不断。

"好一场流星雨。"澄美拧着头发里的水说。

column1: Dr. Murad knows best, you say. "Send [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] out to mount a camera." In a few hours, {TGT_MW.Callsign} returns safely to the Argo and Dr. Murad organizes an enhanced viewing party in the mess. "I adjusted the diffraction grating so we can observe the full range of the shower's spectra." On a viewcreen, the meteors flare up and cerulean tails shimmer with fuchsia and magenta. While the high fidelity display draws a number of cheers and gasps, the MechWarriors crowd around {TGT_MW.Callsign}. {TGT_MW.DET_C} story of narrowly avoiding a shooting star while mounting the camera gets repeated over and over during the following days. {TGT_MW.Callsign} clearly has a real knack for handling {TGT_MW.OBJ}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:selves|Default:self} in low gravity and continues to volunteer for more tasks that require {TGT_MW.OBJ} to venture outside the Argo in an [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreEVA],EVA]] suit.
column2: 穆拉德博士最懂行，你说。"派 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 出舱装一台摄影机。" 几个小时后，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 安全回到阿尔戈号，穆拉德博士在食堂组织了一场增强观赏会。"我调整了衍射光栅，这样我们就能观测到整场流星雨光谱的全部波段。" 在显示屏上，流星爆闪，青蓝色尾迹中泛着紫红与洋红的光泽。高保真画面引来阵阵欢呼与惊叹，而机甲战士们则围住了 {TGT_MW.Callsign}。{TGT_MW.DET_C} 在安装摄影机时险些被一颗流星击中的故事，在随后几天里被反反复复讲了一遍又一遍。 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 显然很擅长在低重力环境下控制 {TGT_MW.OBJ}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:selves|Default:self}，并继续主动承担那些需要 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 穿着 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreEVA],EVA]] 服走出阿尔戈号的任务。

column1:
You consider Yang and shake your head. "Let's stick to the observation deck."

Crew members and MechWarriors huddle on the observation deck, bottles clink and bets are placed. When the first star zips across the sky they cheer, but soon the crowd quiets.

The company looks on in awe as a hundred points of light stream through the darkness. The rocks flare up as they enter the atmosphere of [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]], leaving a radiant but brief trail.

"Shouldn't have doubted you," Yang whispers to Dr. Murad. Then he raises his voice to the crowd. "How about I break out my special stash of [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTripleFBurger],Triple-F Burgers]]?" Another cheer goes up, then music plays over the comm system. Eventually, Yang even sort-of dances.

You find Dr. Murad on the opposite end of the festivities and thank her. With a fork and knife, she slices a grilled PB&J into neat squares. "It's good to remember that space is more than just deadly anomalies and bleak emptiness."
column2:
你打量了一下杨，摇了摇头。"我们还是留在观测甲板上吧。"

船员和机甲战士们挤在观测甲板上，酒瓶碰响，赌注下了起来。第一颗星划过天际时他们欢呼起来，但很快人群安静了。

全公司的人怀着敬畏，望着上百点光芒流过夜空。那些岩石进入 [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] 的大气层时猛然燃烧起来，留下一道耀眼而短暂的光迹。

"不该怀疑你的。"杨低声对穆拉德博士说。然后他提高嗓门对人群喊道："要不要我把我私藏的 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTripleFBurger],三层F汉堡]] 拿出来？"又是一阵欢呼，接着通讯系统里放起了音乐。到最后，杨甚至算是跳了段舞。

你在庆祝活动的另一头找到穆拉德博士，向她道谢。她用刀叉把一份烤花生酱果酱三明治切成整齐的小方块。"能想起来太空不只是致命异常区和荒凉虚空，这是件好事。"

column1:
On a combat drop, you're only as good as your weapons. When you're in the middle of a fight, you need to know the capabilities—and the limitations—of whatever 'Mech you're piloting.

You do a quick search on one of the computers then flip it around for {TGT_MW.OBJ} to see. "Here, start with the tech behind Heat Sinks. Knowing how to push your 'Mech's limits will prove invaluable in every drop I send you on."

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] furrows {TGT_MW.DET} brow and bends low over the detailed treatise, already engrossed in the material.
column2:
在战斗空降中，你的武器有多强，你就有多强。身处战斗之中，你必须了解自己驾驶的那台机甲的能力——还有它的极限。

你在电脑上快速检索了一下，然后把屏幕转过去给 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 看。"来，从散热器的技术原理开始。懂得怎么把机甲的极限逼出来，我派你去的每一次空降都会受益无穷。"

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 皱起 {TGT_MW.DET} 眉头，俯身凑近那篇详尽的论述，已经读得入了迷。

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] furrows {TGT_MW.DET} brow and bends low over the detailed treatise, already engrossed in the material.

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 皱起 {TGT_MW.DET} 眉头，俯身凑近那篇详尽的论述，已经读得入了迷。

column1: During the daily briefing, Dr. Murad raises a hand. "There will be a rare meteor shower on [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]]. I thought it would boost everyone's spirits if we viewed the phenomenon from up close on the observation deck." "Sounds risky." Darius shakes his head. "It's not like the Argo has brakes." "Well, how about we install a telescopic camera on the hull?" Dr. Murad persists. "[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] volunteered to mount it." "Maybe it'd be safer to take the Leopard down to {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}'s surface and view the pretty lights from a safe distance?" Yang beams. "Hell, I'll even cook. What do you say, Commander?"
column2: 每日简报时，穆拉德博士举起手。"[[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] 上将会有一场罕见的流星雨。我想，如果我们到观测甲板上近距离观看这一现象，能提振大家的士气。" "听起来很危险。"达里乌斯摇了摇头。"阿尔戈号可没有刹车。" "那我们在船壳上装一台伸缩式摄影机怎么样？"穆拉德博士不肯放弃。"[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 自愿去安装。" "也许更安全的做法是带豹式降落到 {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} 表面，在安全距离外看那些漂亮的灯光？"杨笑得灿烂。"见鬼，我还能下厨。你说呢，指挥官？"

column1:
You say, "Good idea. Always respect the chain of command. And right now I'm commanding you to go deal with this yourself."

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] salutes and vanishes back the way {TGT_MW.SUBJ} came.

Later, Darius mentions he had to rescue {TGT_MW.Callsign} from being pounded by the other two MechWarriors, who are now on kitchen duty.
column2:
你说："好主意。永远要尊重指挥链。而现在我命令你自己去处理这件事。"

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 敬了个礼，沿 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} 来的方向消失了。

后来，达里乌斯提起他不得不把 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 从另外两名机甲战士的拳脚下救出来，那两人现在被罚去厨房值勤了。

column1:
Relax, MechWarrior…

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] slowly turns, visibly avoiding any sudden movement.

"If you're wondering how you're going to get back in that 'Mech again, reliving the moment won't help. I gather that resting patiently in the MedBay isn't working for you, either?"

{TGT_MW.Callsign} hesitates before nodding silently.

"We're orbiting one of the most popular recreation planets in the Periphery, according to their hardworking Tourism Bureau. I'm sending you down there to recuperate. Darius will find a facility that can tend to your rehabilitation in more pleasant surroundings. Get better."

It's always a roll of the dice on how a MechWarrior will come out of an injury like this. Time will tell.
column2:
放松点，机甲战士……

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 慢慢转过身，明显在避免任何突然的动作。

"如果你在想怎么才能重新坐进那台机甲，反复回想那一刻没有任何帮助。我猜，老老实实待在医疗舱里静养对你也没什么用，对吧？"

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 犹豫了一下，然后默默地点了点头。

"我们正绕着一颗边境外围最受欢迎的度假行星运行，据他们那帮勤奋的旅游局所说。我送你下去休养。达里乌斯会找一家能在更宜人环境里帮你康复的机构。好好养伤。"

机甲战士受了这种伤之后会怎么样，永远像掷骰子。时间会给出答案。

column1:
That happened to me once…

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] spins around, visibly pained by the sudden movement.

"It was during my third season on Solaris VII. I'd finally started to make a name for myself, so of course I got cocky. I rode my 'Mech too hot and got knocked on my ass. Worse still, I let it get to me, and lost my next three matches too. Lost a lot of fans that season."

You put a hand on {TGT_MW.Det} shoulder. "Remember that, {TGT_MW.Callsign}. Don't let one bad fight turn into three more. You get your head straight, and you get back in that 'Mech."

It's always a roll of the dice on how a MechWarrior will come out of an injury like this. Time will tell.
column2:
我也遇上过一次……

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 猛地转过身，明显被这一下扯得生疼。

"那是我在索拉里斯七的第三个赛季。我终于开始闯出点名气，所以当然就飘了。我把机甲开得过热，被人掀翻在地。更糟的是，我让这事影响了心态，接下来三场比赛也全输了。那个赛季掉了不少粉丝。"

你把手放在 {TGT_MW.Det} 肩上。"记住这一点，{TGT_MW.Callsign}。别让一场败仗变成三场。把脑子理清楚，然后重新坐回那台机甲里去。"

机甲战士受了这种伤之后会怎么样，永远像掷骰子。时间会给出答案。

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] spins around, visibly pained by the sudden movement.

"I was guarding a convoy of medical supplies. But the OpFor was arrogant and powerful, and it thought it could just take what it wanted. It was wrong. I was laid up for a month, but the supplies made it to their destination."

You put a hand on {TGT_MW.Det} shoulder. "Remember that, {TGT_MW.Callsign}. For some people here in the Periphery, we're the last thing standing between them and certain death. So you need to stay strong."

column1: That happened to me once. More than once… [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] spins around, visibly pained by the sudden movement. Maybe I didn't know how." You put a hand on {TGT_MW.Det} shoulder. "Remember that, {TGT_MW.Callsign}. They can knock you down, but only you can decide if you're going to stay down. When you're back on your feet, you get right back in that 'Mech. Don't let them take that away from you." It's always a roll of the dice on how a MechWarrior will come out of an injury like this. Time will tell.
column2: 我也遇上过一次。不止一次…… [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 猛地转过身，明显被这一下扯得生疼。 "那时候我还年轻，在另一家雇佣兵公司，连着三个月，一个烂合约接着一个烂合约。我大概有五台机甲被人从身下打爆，但我拒绝放弃。也许是因为我根本不知道怎么放弃。" 你把手放在 {TGT_MW.Det} 肩上。"记住这一点，{TGT_MW.Callsign}。他们能把你打倒，但只有你能决定要不要一直躺下去。等你重新站起来，就立刻回到那台机甲里。别让他们把这点东西也夺走。" 机甲战士受了这种伤之后会怎么样，永远像掷骰子。时间会给出答案。

column1:
Strolling down the hall, you collide with [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], who seems to be in a hurry. "Oh, Commander! I was looking for Darius but you'll do… [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] is on the verge of a brawl with [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]]. We need someone in authority to break this up."

You raise your eyebrows. "You have command experience, don't you, {TGT_MW.Callsign}?"

{TGT_MW.Callsign} blinks. "Well, yeah. But on board your ship, I'm just a pilot. I don't want to overstep my rank."
column2:
你在走廊里闲逛时，跟一个行色匆匆的 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 撞了个满怀。"哦，指挥官！我本来在找达里乌斯，不过找你也行……[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 快要跟 [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] 打起来了。我们需要一个有权威的人去制止。"

你挑了挑眉。"你有指挥经验，对吧，{TGT_MW.Callsign}？"

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 眨了眨眼。"嗯，是有。但在你的船上，我就只是个机师。我不想越级。"

column1:
You say, "Good idea. Always respect the chain of command. And right now I'm commanding you to go deal with this yourself."

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] salutes and vanishes back the way {TGT_MW.SUBJ} came.

Later, you hear through the grapevine that {TGT_MW.SUBJ} managed to diffuse the situation before things got out of hand.

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 敬了个礼，沿 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} 来的方向消失了。

后来你从流言里听说，{TGT_MW.SUBJ} 在事态失控之前成功把局面平息了下来。

column1:
That happened to me once…

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] spins around, visibly pained by the sudden movement.

"I was fighting for the Aurigan Coalition, back before everything went to hell. A pirate shot my 'Mech out from under me, put me in the infirmary for a month. I didn't know how good I had it back then. I wasn't in a hurry to get back out there, but I should have been."

You put a hand on {TGT_MW.Det} shoulder. "Remember that, {TGT_MW.Callsign}. You find something to fight for. Something that matters. That's what is going to get you back on your feet. Back in that 'Mech. Fighting again."

It's always a roll of the dice on how a MechWarrior will come out of an injury like this. Time will tell.

"那时候我在为奥里根联盟作战，一切都还没崩盘之前。一个海盗把我的机甲从身下打爆了，我在医务室躺了一个月。那时候我不知道自己有多走运。我当时并不急着回去，但我本该急的。"

你把手放在 {TGT_MW.Det} 肩上。"记住这一点，{TGT_MW.Callsign}。找一件值得为之战斗的事。一件真正重要的事。那才是能让你重新站起来的东西。重新回到那台机甲里。再次战斗。"

These nobles and merchant princes, it never ends with them. But we get paid every time, and in the end we'll have the last laugh." You put a hand on {TGT_MW.Det} shoulder. "Remember that, {TGT_MW.Callsign}. No one is going to give you anything in this life. You have to fight to get paid. And if you're going to fight, I recommend getting back in that 'Mech to do it." column1:
Relax, MechWarrior…

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] slowly turns, visibly avoiding any sudden movement.

"If you're wondering how you're going to get back in that 'Mech again, reliving the moment won't help. I take it resting in the MedBay isn't working for you either?"

{TGT_MW.Callsign} hesitates before nodding silently.

"We're orbiting one of the most popular recreation planets in the Periphery, according to their hardworking Tourism Bureau. I'm sending you down there for to recuperate. Darius will find a facility that can tend to your rehabilitation in more pleasant surroundings. Get better."

It's always a roll of the dice on how a MechWarrior will come out of an injury like this. Time will tell.
column2:
放松点，机甲战士……

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 慢慢转过身，明显在避免任何突然的动作。

"如果你在想怎么才能重新坐进那台机甲，反复回想那一刻没有任何帮助。我猜，老老实实待在医疗舱里静养对你也没什么用，对吧？"

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 犹豫了一下，然后默默地点了点头。

"我们正绕着一颗边境外围最受欢迎的度假行星运行，据他们那帮勤奋的旅游局所说。我送你下去休养。达里乌斯会找一家能在更宜人环境里帮你康复的机构。好好养伤。"

机甲战士受了这种伤之后会怎么样，永远像掷骰子。时间会给出答案。

Well, let's be honest… we were pirates. It wasn't a glorious life, and it wasn't safe. But it was ours and we fought like hell to keep it that way, every day." You put a hand on {TGT_MW.Det} shoulder. "Remember that, {TGT_MW.Callsign}. I can put you in another 'Mech. I can give you a paycheck and a hot meal. But the world out there is out to kill you, and you need to fight to survive. Every day." It's always a roll of the dice on how a MechWarrior will come out of an injury like this. Time will tell.

column1: You turn from Yang to Dr. Murad. "I'll trust the doctor. Send [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] out to mount the telescopic camera." After a few tense hours pass, {TGT_MW.Callsign} returns in a damaged environment suit. "Rotation assembly nearly crushed me. Sprained my ankle pretty good." Despite {TGT_MW.DET} injures, {TGT_MW.SUBJ} managed to mount the telescopic camera on the Argo's hull. While the high fidelity display draws a number of viewers, most of the crew crowds around {TGT_MW.Callsign} in the MedBay. They're clamoring to know how {TGT_MW.SUBJ} survived. "This is going to sound ridiculous, but an old spacer taught me this trick," {TGT_MW.Callsign} says. "Duct tape, of all things, actually forms a durable seal. Bought me enough time to climb back to the airlock." The story causes nearly every crew member to keep a roll of duct tape handy at all times for the next couple weeks as spirits rise and new uses for the tape keep getting discovered.
column2: 你从杨转向穆拉德博士。"我信医生。派 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 出舱安装伸缩式摄影机。" 几个小时紧张地过去后，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 穿着一身破损的环境服回来了。"旋转组件差点把我压死。脚踝扭得挺厉害。" 尽管 {TGT_MW.DET} 伤势不轻，{TGT_MW.SUBJ} 还是成功把伸缩式摄影机装到了阿尔戈号的船壳上。高保真画面吸引来不少观众，但大部分船员都围在医疗舱里的 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 身边。他们争着想知道 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} 是怎么活下来的。 "说出来你们可能觉得荒唐，但一位老太空船员教过我这招，"{TGT_MW.Callsign} 说。"说来奇怪，管道胶带居然能形成相当牢固的密封。它给我争取了足够时间爬回气闸舱。" 这个故事让接下来几周里几乎每个船员都随身备着一卷管道胶带，大家士气高涨，还不断发现胶带的新用途。

column1:
We'll all end up on that wall in the end, so here's a little advice. Loosen up a little. Enjoy the ride while you can. You pour two tall glasses of whiskey and slide one over to [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. 

As you savor the fire in your throat and the lingering taste of smoke, {TGT_MW.Callsign} gulps {TGT_MW.DET} liquor down. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:push|Default:pushes} {TGT_MW.DET} glass toward you. "In that case, how about another?"

You oblige {TGT_MW.OBJ} and {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:drain|Default:drains} another glass. After a couple more rounds, you dismiss {TGT_MW.Callsign} for the night and {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:stumble|Default:stumbles} back to the barracks.

Later in the week, Darius reports that {TGT_MW.Callsign} is in better spirits, but {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} drinking heavily each day.
column2:
我们最后都会上那面墙，所以给你个小建议。放松点。趁还能享受就享受。你倒了两大杯威士忌，把其中一杯推给 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。

当你细细品味喉咙里的烈意和残留的烟熏味时，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 却把 {TGT_MW.DET} 酒一饮而尽。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:push|Default:pushes} 把 {TGT_MW.DET} 杯子推回你面前。"既然这样，再来一杯怎么样？"

你满足了 {TGT_MW.OBJ}，{TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:drain|Default:drains} 下了另一杯。又喝了几轮后，你让 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 回去歇着，{TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:stumble|Default:stumbles} 着走回营房。

这周晚些时候，达里乌斯汇报说 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 的精神状态好转了，但 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} 每天都喝得很凶。

column1:
There's no predicting when you'll end up on the Memorial Wall. Don't let it get to you. You pause, reflecting for a moment. "I've seen MechWarriors throw their lives away over these kind of doubts."

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] lowers {TGT_MW.DET} head. "I don't want to end up like that."

"You've still got time. Feel free to stop by my quarters any time, but you should really check in with the MedTechs. They can work wonders, whether you need counselling or a prescription or anything else."

{TGT_MW.Callsign} looks into the distance thoughtfully and then nods {TGT_MW.DET} head. "I've trusted you with my life every time I've been on the battlefield. No reason to stop now. I'll see the MedTechs tomorrow, Commander."
column2:
你什么时候会上纪念墙，谁也说不准。别让它影响你。你停顿了一下，回想片刻。"我见过机甲战士因为这类疑虑把自己的命白白扔掉。"

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 低下 {TGT_MW.DET} 头。"我不想变成那样。"

"你还有时间。随时可以来我舱室坐坐，但你真的该去找医疗技师们谈谈。不管你需要心理咨询、开药还是别的什么，他们都能创造奇迹。"

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 若有所思地望着远方，然后点了点 {TGT_MW.DET} 头。"每次上战场，我都把自己的命交给你。现在没理由停下。我明天去见医疗技师，指挥官。"

column1: No one knows, MechWarrior. But there are resources for dealing with this anxiety. I've scheduled you for an appointment with the chief MedTech first thing tomorrow. You give an encouraging smile, but [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] is unmoved. "There's no shame in asking for a little help." "I know, Commander, but I'm asking you for help. Not the MedTechs." "I am helping you by getting you proper treatment. This isn't a suggestion, MechWarrior. It's an order." {TGT_MW.Callsign} utters a grunt in acknowledgment, but the conversation dwindles and ends shortly. The next day, Darius reports in: "{TGT_MW.Callsign} never showed up for {TGT_MW.DET} appointment. I hunted {TGT_MW.OBJ} down and {TGT_MW.SUBJ} got in my face. I disciplined {TGT_MW.OBJ}, but I'll be watching {TGT_MW.OBJ} from now on."
column2: 没人知道，机甲战士。但对付这种焦虑是有办法的。我已经给你约好了明天一早跟首席医疗技师的会诊。你露出鼓励的微笑，但 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 毫无反应。"寻求一点帮助没什么可羞耻的。" "我知道，指挥官，但我在向你求助。不是医疗技师。" "我正在帮你，让你接受正规治疗。这不是建议，机甲战士。这是命令。"{TGT_MW.Callsign} 哼了一声表示知道了，但对话逐渐稀落，很快就结束了。 第二天，达里乌斯来汇报："{TGT_MW.Callsign} 没去赴 {TGT_MW.DET} 会诊。我找到 {TGT_MW.OBJ}，{TGT_MW.SUBJ} 却冲我发火。我处罚了 {TGT_MW.OBJ}，但从今往后我会盯着 {TGT_MW.OBJ}。"

column1:
It all comes down to luck in the end. I've lost friends to freak accidents and seen enemies walk away from hits that should've ground them into pulp. You pour two glasses of whiskey and slide one over to [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]].

{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:sip|Default:sips} {TGT_MW.DET} drink, but {TGT_MW.DET} focus is on you. "It doesn't seem fair." 

"It's not, but I promise I'll do everything in my power to make sure you and every member of this outfit gets off the battlefield in one piece."

"This crew is all I've got." {TGT_MW.Callsign} raises {TGT_MW.DET} drink. "If it weren't for all of you, I think I would have called it quits by now. Thanks for taking the time to talk, Commander."
column2:
说到底全看运气。我失去过被离奇事故害死的朋友，也见过敌人从本该把他们碾成肉酱的打击中安然走出。你倒了两杯威士忌，把其中一杯推给 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。

{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:sip|Default:sips} 了一口 {TGT_MW.DET} 酒，但 {TGT_MW.DET} 注意力全在你身上。"这好像不太公平。"

"是不公平，但我保证，我会竭尽全力，确保你和这支部队的每一个人都能完好无损地从战场上下来。"

"这支队伍是我仅有的东西。"{TGT_MW.Callsign} 举起 {TGT_MW.DET} 酒杯。"要不是你们所有人，我想我早就撑不住了。谢谢你抽时间跟我谈，指挥官。"

column1: Late in the evening, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] ducks into your quarters. Dark circles rim {TGT_MW.DET} bloodshot eyes. "Hey, Commander… I, uh, know you're busy, but I don't know where to turn." "What's wrong, MechWarrior?" {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s voice trembles. "I haven't slept for days. I keep thinking why me? Why am I alive? I've seen ejections fail, ammo explosions, and impossible headshots. Rookies, veterans, it doesn't matter. How long until my picture is added to the Memorial Wall?"
column2: 深夜里，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 溜进你的舱室。{TGT_MW.DET} 布满血丝的眼睛周围是深深的黑眼圈。"嘿，指挥官……我，呃，知道你很忙，可我不知道该找谁。" "出什么事了，机甲战士？" {TGT_MW.Callsign} 的声音发颤。"我已经好几天没睡了。我一直在想为什么是我？我为什么还活着？我见过弹射失败、弹药爆炸、不可思议的爆头。新兵、老兵，都一样。还要多久，我的照片就会被挂上纪念墙？"

column1:
We'll all end up on that wall one day, but it takes more than luck to make it as far as you have, MechWarrior. You rest a reassuring hand on [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s shoulder. "You're here because of your talent. Frankly, you've taken some hits that would have put me in early retirement."

{TGT_MW.Callsign} stares at {TGT_MW.DET} boots. "But what if I slip?"

"Then we'll catch you. Every single member of this outfit has your back, on or off the battlefield. If you need to talk for an hour, or a night, or every night, I'm here for you."

"Thanks, Commander." A faint smile cracks {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s face. "I won't abuse this privilege. You have my word."
column2:
我们总有一天都会上那面墙，但能走到今天这一步，靠的不只是运气，机甲战士。你把手放在 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 的肩上，以示安慰。"你能在这儿，是因为你的才能。老实说，你挨过的一些打击，换了我早就提前退休了。"

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 盯着 {TGT_MW.DET} 靴子。"可要是我失手了呢？"

"那我们就接住你。这支部队的每一个人，无论在战场上还是战场下，都站在你这边。要是你需要谈一小时，或者谈一整晚，或者每晚都谈，我都在。"

"谢谢你，指挥官。"{TGT_MW.Callsign} 脸上裂开一丝淡淡的笑容。"我不会滥用自己的特权。我向你保证。"

column1:
In the end, we'll all end up on that wall, but you've got plenty of time. You're the best of the best, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. You look {TGT_MW.OBJ} straight in the eyes. "Plain and simple."

{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:sigh and shake|Default:sighs and shakes} {TGT_MW.DET} head. "I've cleaned better MechWarriors than me out of cockpits, Commander. Meat is cheap."

"Keep thinking like that and you'll end up just like them."

"Some pep talk, Commander." {TGT_MW.Callsign} slumps, resting {TGT_MW.DET} head back against the bulkhead and closing {TGT_MW.DET} eyes. "I guess I'll give sleep another shot."
column2:
说到底，我们最后都会上那面墙，但你还有大把时间。你是精英中的精英，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。你直视 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 的眼睛。"就这么简单。"

{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:sigh and shake|Default:sighs and shakes} 了一下 {TGT_MW.DET} 头。"指挥官，我从驾驶舱里清出来的机甲战士，比我强的多得是。人命不值钱。"

"你要是继续这么想，最后就会变成他们那样。"

"真是番打气的话，指挥官。"{TGT_MW.Callsign} 垮了下来，把 {TGT_MW.DET} 头靠回舱壁，闭上 {TGT_MW.DET} 眼睛。"我还是再试试睡觉吧。"

column1:
Darius nods and arranges to send [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] to the planet for a week of networking among the medical supplies vendors.

Soon, the fruits of {TGT_MW.Det} labors begin to arrive, boosting the short-term effectiveness of the MedBay with samples of cutting-edge medicines from the {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} system's best labs.

Later in the week, Darius delivers an update. "{TGT_MW.Callsign} has done all that {TGT_MW.Subj} could in such a short timeframe. I was honestly hoping for a bit more, but it will have to do."
column2:
达里乌斯点了点头，安排把 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 送到行星上，进行一周的医疗物资供应商社交活动。

很快，{TGT_MW.Det} 辛劳的成果开始到来：来自 {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} 星系最好实验室的前沿药物样本，提升了医疗舱的短期效率。

这周晚些时候，达里乌斯汇报进展。"{TGT_MW.Callsign} 在这么短的时间里已经做到 {TGT_MW.Subj} 能做到的极限了。老实说我本想多要一点，但也只能这样了。"

column1: An argument draws you into the mess hall. [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] starts toward you, red-faced and scowling. "Commander, I hate to bother you with this, but [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] is slacking off again. We're supposed to share garbage detail, but {TGT_MW.SUBJ}–" "Share? You want me to share?! Commander, this asshole is the reason we're on cleanup duty in the first place! {SCN_MW.SUBJ_C} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:act|Default:acts} like {SCN_MW.SUBJ}{SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'re|Default:'s} my boss! Just last week, {SCN_MW.SUBJ} filed two dozen complaints with the XO and got us both put on garbage detail! And {SCN_MW.SUBJ} did it over nothing!" "An infraction's an infraction." {SCN_MW.Callsign} sneers. "If you stop messing up, I'll stop reporting you."
column2: 食堂里的一场争吵把你引了过去。[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 涨红着脸、皱着眉朝你走来。"指挥官，很抱歉拿这事烦你，但 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 又在偷懒。清理垃圾的活儿本该平分，可{TGT_MW.SUBJ}——" "平分？你让我平分？！指挥官，这个混蛋才是害我们被罚去清理垃圾的罪魁祸首！{SCN_MW.SUBJ_C} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:act|Default:acts} 起来就像 {SCN_MW.SUBJ}{SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:'re|Default:'s} 我的老板似的！就在上周，{SCN_MW.SUBJ} 向副官提交了二十多份投诉，害得我们两个都被罚去清理垃圾！而且 {SCN_MW.SUBJ} 还是为了屁大点事！" "违纪就是违纪。"{SCN_MW.Callsign} 冷笑。"你要是不再犯错，我就不再举报你。"

column1: You level your gaze at [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. "If you want to be treated like a pro, start acting like one. No more excuses. No more slacking. Just do your share and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] will have nothing to report." {TGT_MW.Callsign} crosses {TGT_MW.DET} arms. "I signed on as a MechWarrior, not a janitor." "If I can't trust you to handle the garbage, what makes you think I can trust you in the cockpit?" You gesture toward {SCN_MW.Callsign}. "{SCN_MW.SUBJ_C} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:need|Default:needs} to be able to rely on you. We all do, if we're going to survive as an outfit." {TGT_MW.Callsign} resolutely snatches a garbage bag off a nearby table. "I'm the best damn MechWarrior, you've got, Commander. I'll prove it. No more write ups; no more issues. Hell, it's going to sparkle in here by the time I'm done."
column2: 你死死盯着 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。"你想被当作专业人士对待，那就先拿出专业人士的样子。别再找借口。别再偷懒。把自己的份内事干好，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 就没什么可举报的。" {TGT_MW.Callsign} 抱起 {TGT_MW.DET} 双臂。"我签的是机甲战士的合约，不是清洁工。" "我要是连垃圾都没法托付给你，你凭什么觉得我敢把驾驶舱交给你？"你朝 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 比了个手势。"{SCN_MW.SUBJ_C} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:need|Default:needs} 能依靠你。我们所有人都得能依靠你，这支部队才能活下去。" {TGT_MW.Callsign} 毅然从旁边的桌上抓过一个垃圾袋。"指挥官，我是你手下最好的机甲战士。我会证明给你看。不再有处分记录，不再有麻烦。见鬼，等我干完，这里会闪闪发亮。"

Frankly, you both need the practice."\n\nThe MechWarriors grumble and wander off. You hear later from Yang that {TGT_MW.Callsign} "absolutely trashed [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], just destroyed {SCN_MW.OBJ}" in the simulated battle, and that {SCN_MW.Callsign} has been moping ever since.
column2: 你提高嗓门，两名机甲战士都转向你，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 的拳头松了开来。"你们机甲战士要是有纠纷，去战斗模拟舱里解决。说实在的，你们俩都需要练练。"\n\n两名机甲战士咕哝着散开了。后来你听杨说，{TGT_MW.Callsign} "把 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 打得稀烂，彻底摧毁了 {SCN_MW.OBJ}"，而 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 从那时候起就一直闷闷不乐。

column1:
Leaving Darius to keep [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] calm, you gather several MechWarriors and acquire an all-terrain vehicle.

When you finally arrive at the emergency beacon, {TGT_MW.Callsign} is perched high in a tree. Blood drips from a mangled leg to the ground below, where several meter-long insectoids with trifurcated, razor-sharp mouthparts wait patiently for their prey to fall.

A few well-placed gunshots send the creatures scurrying to the safety of the ruins, and you and the others manage to get the wounded MechWarrior to safety.

你留下达里乌斯稳住 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]，自己召集了几名机甲战士，弄来一辆全地形车。

等你们终于赶到紧急信标所在地时，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 正高高地栖在一棵树上。鲜血从一条被撕烂的腿上滴落到下方地面，几头体长一米、长着三叉锋利口器的昆虫状生物正耐心地等着猎物掉下来。

几声精准的枪响把那群生物赶回了废墟的安全处，你和其余人成功把受伤的机甲战士救了下来。

When you finally arrive at the emergency beacon, {TGT_MW.Callsign} is leaning against the trunk of a tree, trying to tourniquet {TGT_MW.Det} own leg. column1: As shore leave ends, your MechWarriors and ship's crew arrive at the spaceport, sharing stories of their adventures and entertainments. Then Darius arrives, his brow furrowed in concern. He pulls you aside and puts his communicator on speaker, so both of you can hear [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]].\n\n"Commander, I'm in a bit of a situation. I went on an expedition to some nearby ruins, and I, uh, I think I'm being hunted by some of the native wildlife. Whatever these things are, I'm pretty sure they're eating some of the other tourists right now… yeah, those are definitely 'I'm getting eaten' screams. Can I get a little help?"
column2: 登岸休假快结束时，你的机甲战士和船员们陆续回到太空港，互相讲着各自的冒险和消遣。然后达里乌斯来了，眉头紧锁，满脸担忧。他把你拉到一边，把通讯器调成外放，让你们两个都能听到 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。\n\n"指挥官，我遇上点麻烦。我去附近的废墟探险，然后，呃，我觉得我正被当地的什么野生动物追猎。不管这些玩意儿是什么，我相当确定它们现在正在吃别的游客……对，那些绝对是'我正在被吃掉'的惨叫声。能来点援助吗？"

column1: Darius meets you in the galley bearing some unfamiliar fruits and a number of spice packets. "[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] returned from shore leave with gifts: a big bag of this produce, some spices, and a bunch of meat from a hunting trip. I've got no idea what the animal is called, but the haunches are bigger than I am." \n\nHe turns one of the strange fruits in the light and its color shifts from green to iridescent purple. "How do you feel about adding this to our stocks? Could make for a nice change of pace."
column2: 达里乌斯在厨房见你，带着一些你不认识的水果和几包香料。"[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 休假回来带了礼物：一大袋这种农产品、一些香料，还有打猎弄来的一堆肉。我不知道那动物叫什么名字，但它的后腿比我还大。"\n\n他把其中一颗奇怪的水果在灯光下转了转，果皮的颜色从绿色变成彩虹般的紫色。"你觉得把这些加入我们的库存怎么样？换换口味应该不错。"

column1: The deliciously-spiced meal turns to ash in your mouth when [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] suddenly clutches {SCN_MW.Det} throat and falls, gasping, to the floor. You hop over your table to pull {SCN_MW.DET} twitching form away from obstacles. Then you're tugged out of the way by one medic while another plunges a syringe of epinephrine into the victim's thigh.\n\nAs {SCN_MW.Callsign}'s allergic reaction subsides, you glance around and see the aghast expression on [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s face. A dozen plates are pushed forward in unison.
column2: 那道香气扑鼻的菜在你嘴里变成了灰烬——[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 突然捂住 {SCN_MW.Det} 喉咙，喘着气倒在地上。你跳过自己那张桌子，把 {SCN_MW.DET} 抽搐的身体从障碍物旁拖开。接着一名医护把你拽到一边，另一名医护把一管肾上腺素扎进了患者的腿里。\n\n等 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 的过敏反应平息下来，你环顾四周，看到了 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 脸上惊愕的表情。十几只盘子同时被推了出去。

column1: In the mess hall, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] chides {TGT_MW.Det} fellow MechWarriors, "Come on, back home we ate critters like this all the time. Well, not exactly like this… our birds weren't furry, and they only had two legs." Sumire's nose wrinkles as she pokes at the meat with a fork. "Technically, I think that'd make {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s mystery animal a monotreme, like a platypus or an echidna. It does smell pretty good, though."\n\nAfter some initial hesitation, the crew enthusiastically devours the evening's grand experiment, and are soon toasting {TGT_MW.Callsign} for a job well done.
column2: 食堂里，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 数落着 {TGT_MW.Det} 的机甲战士同伴们："得了吧，在我老家，这种小东西我们天天吃。嗯，也不完全是这种……我们那边的鸟不长毛，而且只有两条腿。"澄美用叉子戳着那块肉，皱起了鼻子。"严格来说，我想这会让 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 那个神秘动物变成单孔目动物，像鸭嘴兽或针鼹。不过闻起来确实挺香。"\n\n在最初的迟疑之后，船员们热情十足地把当晚这场大试验一扫而空，很快就纷纷举杯向 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 敬酒，夸他干得漂亮。

column1: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] steels {TGT_MW.DET} nerve. "You're right, Commander. Sharing a look with Darius, you gather several MechWarriors and quickly acquire an all-terrain vehicle. When you finally arrive at the emergency beacon, you see {TGT_MW.Callsign} perched high in a tree. Blood drips from a mangled leg to the ground below, where the creatures wait patiently for your MechWarrior to fall into their gaping maws.
