column1:
Lesser known than the mysterious "Bounty Hunter", but perhaps even more feared, is the enigmatic Jamie Rayson. Next to nothing is known about this elusive figure - including if he even exists.

What few details are consistent place him as originating from the Deep Periphery, somewhere past the Vela Sheet. References to him go back to at least the early Second Succession War and a few more cryptic ones as far back as the beginning of the Reunification War, which has lead to questions of whether he is real or if a series of MechWarriors have assumed the identity over the decades.

Either way, many acts have been attributed to this shadowy figure, most of them acts of mass destruction, war crimes or battlefields with no survivors where no enemy forces were known to be active. Needless to say, this has made Jamie a boogeyman amongst the armed forces of the Inner Sphere. Said to have been behind some of the Second Succession War's most barbaric incidents, it would appear that Jamie relishes the chaos and destruction he leaves in his wake.

The rare survivors who encounter him on the battlefield are generally left broken - and those who do speak of the experience tell of a heavy 'Mech of unknown make, adorned in all black with no unit markings present. Usually only spotted moments before the brunt of his assault, MechWarriors find their sensors and targeting computers failing or going blank just before weapons of fire scorch their 'Mechs until they shut down or suffer catastrophic engine failure or ammunition explosions. Then, just as quickly as it appeared, the 'Mech vanishes before their eyes, the air shimmering momentarily where it once stood.

Oddly enough, there seems to be a pattern to reported sightings of Jamie: Once spotted, many more sightings occur over the next couple of years, seemingly heralding periods of greater strife within the Sphere. Then, as the fires of war cool, the sightings simply stop - with no more occurring for at least the next decade.

Some of the strangest rumors and legends interweave Jamie's with sightings of the equally elusive "Mr. Bubbles", painting grand conspiracies - including attempts to burn worlds largely untouched by the devastation of the Succession Wars, such as New Avalon.
column2:
比神秘的“赏金猎人”更少人知晓、却也许更令人畏惧的，是难以捉摸的杰米·雷森。关于这个神出鬼没的人物几乎一无所知——连他是否真实存在都不确定。

为数不多一致的细节指出他来自深境外围，在维拉帷幕之外的某处。关于他的记载至少可以追溯到第二次继承战争的早期，还有几条更隐晦的记录甚至追溯到再统合战争之初，这让人怀疑他究竟是真实存在，还是几十年来有一连串机甲战士冒用了这个身份。

无论真相如何，许多事件都被归到这个隐秘身影的头上，其中大多是毁灭性的行为、战争罪行，或是明知没有敌军活动却无人生还的战场。不用说，这让杰米成了内层星域武装部队口中的鬼怪。据说第二次继承战争中最野蛮的几起事件背后都有他，看来杰米很享受他一路留下的混乱与毁灭。

极少数的幸存者在战场上遇到他后，通常都已精神崩溃——那些还能讲述这段经历的人说，那是一台重型机甲，型号不明，通体漆黑，没有任何部队标识。通常只在猛攻临头前的一瞬间才被发现；机甲战士们发现自己的传感器和瞄准计算机失效或一片空白，紧接着火焰武器炙烤他们的机甲，直到关机，或者遭遇灾难性的引擎故障、弹药爆炸。然后，那台机甲就像出现时一样迅速消失在眼前，原处空气只微微一颤。

奇怪的是，关于杰米的目击报告似乎有某种规律：一旦有人目击，接下来几年就会有更多目击出现，仿佛预示着星域内更剧烈的动荡时期。而当战火冷却，目击就干脆停止了——至少之后十年都不再出现。

一些最离奇的传闻与传说还把杰米与同样神出鬼没的“泡泡先生”联系在一起，编织出宏大的阴谋论——包括试图焚毁那些基本未受继承战争摧残的世界，比如新阿瓦隆。

column1:
Carl "Cargo Vroom" Vranich was born on Alpheratz in the Outworlds Alliance, and is often regarded as one of the most prolific vehicle designers to have ever lived.

Growing up in a rather spartan household typical of the Periphery, Cargo opted out of school in an early age with necessity forcing him to work as soon as he was able to help support his family. Initially Cargo learned the family trade as a run-of-the-mill vehicle mechanic, but it quickly became obvious that Cargo was meant for more as he showed a knack for not just fixing vehicles, but improving upon them.

By his 21st birthday, Cargo found himself drafted into the Alliance Borderers as a tank mechanic. There Cargo quickly rose through the ranks of the unit's engineering corps, proving not only hard-working but able to diagnose and and fix issues that even mechanics with 30 more years of experience with the same models could not.

By age 25, Cargo found himself the head mechanic of a detachment of the Borderers stationed on Cerberus, when fate struck in the form of a deep raid by DCMS troops. The Kuritan forces struck the base, scattered the battalion defenders, and began tearing through the hangars, destroying vehicle after vehicle. Provoked into rage from watching days of his hard work going up in smoke, Cargo grabbed a few of the nearest fellow mechanics by their shirts and shoved them into the tank closest to them. Taking charge, Cargo then proceeded to lead the completely green crew in fierce defensive action. Cargo and his makeshift crew not only held out while crucial reinforcements arrived, but also succeeded in crippling two 'Mechs and outright destroying one.

For his quick thinking and heroic efforts, Cargo was awarded some of the nation's most prestigious military service awards. When offered monetary awards however, he turned them down. Instead, he requested he be allowed to bring his beloved pet ferret with him to work, a request the rather stunned high command accepted.

For the next decade, Cargo served the Borderers in the dual roles of both head mechanic and tank commander in its command company before largely retiring from frontline service. This was at the behest of the Alliance high command, who had come to value his ever-increasing skill at designing vehicle variants that were both cheap to produce and extremely cost-effective.

Now heading a design bureau, Cargo has become one of these most despised people alive to many MechWarriors. So terrifying are the designs he has produced that many a MechWarrior has called them "bullshit" or decried that 'Mechs, not tanks, are supposed to be the kings of the battlefield. Perhaps it is not surprising then that when Cargo makes trips to the field for studies, he does so primarily amongst other tank crews.
column2:
卡尔·“货运轰鸣”·弗拉尼奇出生在外层联盟的阿尔菲拉茨，常被视为有史以来最多产的车辆设计师之一。

他在外围地区典型的简朴家庭中长大，年幼时便辍学，迫于生计，一到能干活的年纪就去帮衬家用。起初卡尔把家传手艺当作一名普通的车辆修理工来学，但很快就显露出他注定不止于此——他不仅擅长修车，更擅长把车改得更好。

21 岁生日前，卡尔被征入联盟边防军当坦克技师。他在部队工程兵中迅速晋升，不仅勤恳，还能诊断并修复那些同型号上干了三十年经验的老技师都搞不定的问题。

25 岁时，卡尔已是驻守刻耳柏洛斯的边防军分遣队首席技师，这时命运以 DCMS 部队一次纵深突袭的形式降临。栗田军突袭基地，打散了营级守军，开始在机库中横冲直撞，一辆接一辆地摧毁车辆。眼看自己多日的心血化为浓烟，卡尔怒火中烧，一把揪住身边几名技师的衣领，把人塞进最近的一辆坦克。他接过指挥，带领这群全无经验的乘员展开猛烈防御。卡尔和他临时拼凑的乘员不但坚守到关键增援抵达，还成功重创两台机甲、彻底摧毁一台。

因这份机智与英勇，卡尔获颁该国最负盛名的几项军功荣誉。但当对方要给他金钱奖励时，他拒绝了。他反而请求允许把自己心爱的宠物雪貂带到工作场所——大感意外的高层竟同意了。

此后十年，卡尔在边防军中身兼首席技师与指挥连坦克车长两职，之后基本退出一线勤务。这是应联盟高层之请，因为他们已越来越看重他设计车辆变型的能力——既便宜又能打。

如今卡尔领导着一个设计局，成了许多机甲战士最痛恨的在世人物之一。他设计的车辆可怕到许多机甲战士骂它们是“狗屁”，并痛斥战场上称王的该是机甲而非坦克。所以当他为研究而实地考察时，主要混在其他坦克乘员中间，也就不奇怪了。

column1: Crime doesn't pay, Teo Navarro, said his Mama. "You just keep your head down and work hard and be glad we're in the Federated Suns and not in any of those other places." Crime doesn't pay... except when it does. Crime paid for his Mama's heart surgery and his little sisters' schooling. Crime put food on the table when Mama couldn't get enough work and basic benefits were cut once again so the military could build yet more war machines. Crime does pay... until you get caught. And even then, the House Davion military industrial complex wanted to recruit him, not punish him. That was what the Third Succession War had driven proud House Davion to. He wanted to spit in their faces and accept the execution they offered him as an alternative. But would the criminal organization continue to take care of his family if he died for them? Sometimes they did, and sometimes they didn't. Best, he decided, was to appear to die. To do what the Federated Suns asked him to do. So he did, for a while. He tracked and brokered and assassinated. Until Mama died anyhow, at the bottom of an endless waiting list for another surgery. He walked away that night, collected his two youngest sisters and his orphaned nieces, and took them all out to the Periphery, away from the corrupt, treacherous Inner Sphere. Now, they live someplace safe. He still sends them most of the money he makes as a mercenary, and his kit is covered in photos of his family. The older ones are somber, but the younger ones smile. Mama would, finally, be proud.
column2: “犯罪是没好处的，Teo Navarro，”他的妈妈说。“你只管低着头埋头干活，庆幸我们身在 Federated Suns，而不是别的什么鬼地方。”犯罪是没好处的……除非它真能带来好处。犯罪付了妈妈的心脏手术费，付了妹妹们的学费。当妈妈找不到足够的活计、基本福利又再一次被削减以便军方建造更多战争机器时，是犯罪让餐桌上有了饭吃。 犯罪确实有好处……直到你被抓。可即便如此，House Davion 军工复合体想要的也是招募他，而不是惩罚他。这就是第三次继承战争把自豪的 House Davion 逼成的样子。 他想啐他们一脸，接受他们给出的处决作为替代。可如果他为他们而死，那个犯罪组织还会继续照顾他的家人吗？有时会，有时不会。他认定，最好的办法是假装死掉。照 Federated Suns 的要求去做。 于是他照做了，做了一阵子。他追踪、居间斡旋、暗杀。直到妈妈终究还是死了，死在另一场手术无尽等待名单的最末位。那一夜他抽身离去，带上两个最小的妹妹和几个成了孤儿的侄女，把她们全都带到外围星域，远离那个腐败而背信弃义的内天体圈。如今，她们住在某个安全的地方。他仍把做雇佣兵挣来的大部分钱寄给她们，他的装备上贴满了家人的照片。年长些的表情肃穆，年幼的却带着笑容。妈妈终于会为他感到骄傲了。

Once a lethal assassin in service to House Liao, she navigated the treacherous world of covert operations with deadly grace. Gifted with a mesmerizing allure and a silver tongue, she could charm her way into any target's confidence before striking them down with cold precision. However, a harrowing revelation shook her conscience, leading her to abandon her life as an assassin and seek redemption. Embracing the path of a mercenary, Lucy now plies her trade on the battlefield, fighting for just causes and seeking to balance the scales of karma.\n\n
column2: 露西·迈耶，呼号“魅惑”，是一名身世笼罩阴影的老练机师。她曾是效忠于廖家的致命刺客，在险恶的秘密行动世界中以致命的优雅穿梭。她天生魅力非凡、能言善辩，总能取得目标信任，再以冷酷的精准将其击倒。然而，一次令人痛苦的真相揭露动摇了她的良知，促使她放弃刺客生涯，寻求救赎。如今，露西走上佣兵之路，在战场上谋生，为正义的事业而战，并试图平衡因果的天平。\n\n

column1:
Quicsell Hardened Peel 'n Stick™ Armor

The latest advancement in Quicsell's patented Peel 'n Stick™ armor technology! Hardened Peel 'n Stick™ is heavier, tougher, and—most importantly—appears to repair itself continuously after taking damage.

Exactly how it does this remains a subject of ongoing research. The armor seems to spontaneously replace damaged material, even when no replacement material is available. Our engineers have several theories, none of which have survived peer review. Please do not ask where the extra armor comes from.

Unfortunately, the hardened compound is considerably heavier, meaning slightly less total armor can be applied. The material also produces minor interference with targeting systems, resulting in reduced weapon accuracy. This is completely normal and probably not a safety concern.

But who cares about a little accuracy when your armor is busy fixing itself?

Quicsell Hardened Peel 'n Stick™ — It takes a licking and keeps sticking.
column2:
Quicsell强化即撕即贴™装甲

Quicsell专利即撕即贴™装甲技术的最新成果！强化版即撕即贴™装甲更重、更坚固，更重要的是——受损后似乎会持续自我修复。

它究竟如何做到这一点，仍是持续研究的课题。即使没有可用的替换材料，装甲似乎也会自行补回受损部分。我们的工程师提出了好几种理论，但没有一种经得起同行评审。请别问多出来的装甲是从哪儿来的。

遗憾的是，这种强化材料重了不少，因此能装上的总装甲略有减少。材料还会对瞄准系统产生轻微干扰，导致武器精度下降。这完全正常，大概也不算安全隐患。

不过，当你的装甲正忙着自我修复时，少一点精度又算什么？

Quicsell强化即撕即贴™——挨了打也能继续粘。

column1: After witnessing the relative success of the cheap, easy to manufacture, Medium Range Missile systems utilized in the Inner Sphere, several Society cells began secret development their own versions for their forces. Though these new Clan-Tech MRM systems benefited from the same weight-saving technologies as Clan-Tech SRMs and LRMs, Society leaders decided that additional tubes were necessary to ensure that the lesser-trained Society pilots could effectively saturate the target area. \n\n Uses Clan MRM Ammo.
column2: 在目睹了在内层领域使用的廉价、易于制造的中程导弹系统的相对成功后，几个协会小组开始为自己的部队秘密开发自己的版本。尽管这些新的氏族科技 MRM 系统受益于与氏族科技 SRM 和 LRM 相同的减重技术，但协会领导人决定需要额外的管子，以确保训练较少的协会飞行员能够有效地饱和目标区域。\n\n使用氏族MRM弹药。

column1: An all 'round attack craft, the Medium VTOL is the bog standard, jack of all trades cavalry unit that can do almost everything. Packing a potent array of weapons, this Medium VTOL can reliably kill an enemy unit. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 7/11 hexes / 210/330 meters. Armor: Armor (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 115 15 Left 110 15 Right 110 15 Rear 90 15 Total 440 75 Quirk: Rugged
column2: 中型垂直起降飞机是一种全能攻击机，是沼泽标准、多才多艺的骑兵单位，几乎可以完成所有任务。这款中型垂直起降飞机配备了一系列强大的武器，可以可靠地杀死敌方单位。 生物群落限制：该单位无法部署在月球生物群落中。 移动：7/11六角形/210/330米。 装甲：装甲（C） 结构：结构 值 A S 前部 115 15 左 110 15 右 110 15 后 90 15 总计 440 75 怪异：坚固耐用

column1: After the ultimately failed Elemental II project, the Hell's Horses quest to improve Elementals didn't end. The Elemental III keeps the basic suit relevant for another century, incorporating a one-shot advanced SRM system to extend the suit’s reach and newly developed stealth armor to increase survivability. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 在《元素 II》项目最终失败后，地狱之马改进元素的探索并没有结束。 Elemental III 使基本套装在下一个世纪仍然适用，它采用了一次性先进的 SRM 系统来扩展套装的攻击范围，并采用新开发的隐形装甲来提高生存能力。 Quirk：标准件 下降成本乘数：0.93 可以安装全能单位，可以近战，可以蜂群。

column1: Built by Meridian Manufacturing, the Arbiter is nothing more than a light WorkMech crafted to look like a large and impressive Heavy Battlemech. Despite its unremarkable nature, Meridian has been extremely successful in selling the design in battalion sized lots with a six-month back order. The reason for this is their keen understanding of pirate psychology. Despite its thin armor and limited weaponry, the Arbiter is an intimidating sight that will quickly encourage most pirates to find an easier looking target. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.73 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 由 Meridian 制造公司打造，仲裁者只是一台伪装成大型、气势十足的重型战斗机甲的轻型工作机甲。尽管自身平平无奇，Meridian 仍凭借对海盗心理的精准把握，成功地以营规模批量出售该设计，而且订单排期长达六个月。仲裁者装甲薄弱、武器有限，却能以令人胆寒的外形迅速让大多数海盗寻找看起来更容易对付的目标。 特性：分散注意 投放成本倍率：0.73 手臂执行器限制：右下臂

column1: Built by the Wolf Empire, this suit was used extensively by second-line commands as it lacked HarJel. It did carry an Advanced SRM 4, however, giving it significant firepower. Quirk: Well Designed Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.89 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 这套由狼帝国制造的战斗服因缺少 HarJel，曾被二线部队广泛使用。不过它配备了一具先进 SRM 4，因此拥有相当可观的火力。 特性：设计精良 投放成本倍率：0.89 可安装全能组件，可近战，可进行集群攻击。

column1: As a heavy combat suit, the Fusilier combined aspects of the Grenadier and Sea Fox, and was designed to serve as a line unit alongside other similar suits. Because it was so slow-moving, the Fusilier mounted a Jump Booster to increase its mobility. Whereas other battlesuits in service to the AFFS typically earned a reputation based around their distinguishing characteristics, the best description of the Fusilier is "solid". Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: 作为重型战斗服，Fusilier 融合了掷弹兵与海狐的特点，设计目标是与其他类似战斗服并肩作战，担任战线部队。由于移动缓慢，Fusilier 加装了跳跃助推器以提升机动性。相比服役于 AFFS 的其他战斗服通常凭借鲜明特点赢得声誉，对 Fusilier 最恰当的评价就是“扎实”。 特性：精准 投放成本倍率：0.896 只能由内部舱室运输，可近战，无法进行集群攻击。

column1: Built by Luthien Armor Works of New Samarkand, the Hitotsume Kozo is a medium BattleMech designed to serve in the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery. This 'Mech's creation was partially influenced by an unofficial cultural rebirth. Keeping this in mind, LAW styled the appearance of the Hitotsume Kozo after the ancient Japanese Bushido armor worn by the samurai warriors during that time period on Terra. It received a poor reception by front-line troops due its advanced features and high heat output; however, it was appreciated when transferred to less-favored combat units, such as Ghost Regiments, as these less-fickle warriors adapted to the design's quirks and turned it into an effective combat unit. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: Hitotsume Kozo 由新撒马尔罕的 Luthien 装甲工坊制造，是一台为龙马联盟集结军设计的中型战斗机甲。这台机甲的诞生部分受到一场非官方文化复兴的影响。考虑到这一点，LAW 以远古日本武士在当时地球上穿戴的武士道铠甲为原型，设计了 Hitotsume Kozo 的外观。由于采用先进功能且热输出很高，它在一线部队中反响不佳；但调往不受重视的战斗单位（例如幽灵团）后却颇受欢迎，因为这些不那么挑剔的战士适应了设计上的怪癖，并将其变成了高效的战斗单位。 特性：稳定 投放成本倍率：1.05

column2: [负面]

column1: You look at Sumire, "I guess we prepare to jump...!" The jump clock slowly counts down... 3... 2... 1..." Moments later, the jumpship's KF Drive activates and that quesy feeling when jumping through space washes over your body. As your vision returns post jump, Darius calls out, "The Captain of the jumpship is furious and is going to file a report with the Mercenary Review Board and the Commercial JumpShip Travel Authority as soon as they finish their shipwide diagnostics and damage assessment." You look out the viewport, seeing a totally different system than the one you expected, "Where the F..." Sumire interupts your outburst, "Commander, it appears we are now in the [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] system, which is over 620 light years away from the closest known jump-safe system of New Gascony! All stations are reporting operational as well, so we do not appear to have suffered any noticable damage from the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMisjump],misjump]]. You look at Sumire and Dr Murad, both of whom wanted the Console installed, "My head hurts from all of this." You turn to Darius, "Plot a path back to civilisation. I'll be in my office. "
column2: 你看向 Sumire：“我想我们该准备跳跃了……！”跳跃计时器缓缓倒数……3……2……1……”。片刻后，跳船的 KF 驱动启动，穿越太空时那种晕眩感席卷全身。 视线在跳跃后恢复，Darius 喊道：“跳船船长非常愤怒，等完成全船诊断和损伤评估后，他就会向雇佣兵评议委员会和商业跳船旅行管理局提交报告。” 你望向舷窗，看到的完全是另一个星系，而非你预期的那个：“这到底是什么鬼……” Sumire 打断了你的爆发：“指挥官，我们似乎已经身处 [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] 星系，这里距离已知最近的可安全跳跃星系新加斯科涅超过 620 光年！ 所有站点都报告运行正常，因此我们似乎没有因这次 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMisjump],misjump]] 遭受任何明显损伤。 你看向 Sumire 和 Murad 医生——他们俩都曾要求安装控制台——“这一切让我的头好痛。” 你转向 Darius：“规划一条回文明世界的路线。我去办公室。”

column1: With a wave of your hand, you quiet the room. "Let's grab this with both hands. We might not always be on good terms with the pirates."\n\nYang strokes his chin in contemplation. "I need a cool pirate name now. Maybe 'Angry Yang', oooh, or 'Iron Beard'! Whatcha think?"
column2: 你挥了挥手，让房间安静下来。“我们要牢牢抓住这个机会。我们和海盗未必总能保持良好关系。”\n\nYang 抚着下巴沉思。“我现在需要一个酷一点的海盗名字。也许叫‘愤怒杨’，哦不，或者‘铁胡子’！你觉得呢？”

column1: When the Argo arrives on the scene, you find a handful of void-suited figures spinning aimlessly away from a gaping hole in the hull in a final, desperate bid for life. You have a moment of feeling good about your decision.\n\nThen an explosion abruptly brightens the starry expanse, enveloping the transport, the survivors, and the Argo. Dr. Murad's team spends the rest of the day repairing the damage. You spend the rest of the day repairing bruised morale.
column2: Argo抵达现场时，你发现几名穿着太空服的人影正从船体上的巨大破洞旁无助地旋转漂离，做着最后绝望的求生努力。你有那么一刻庆幸自己做出了这个决定。\n\n随后，一场爆炸骤然照亮星空，将运输船、幸存者和Argo一同吞没。Murad 医生的团队花了一整天修复损伤，而你则花了一整天修复士气。

column1: With the advancements of Ferro-Carbide 'mech armor, it was possible to add special plating to the cockpit's armor plating.
column2: 随着 Ferro-Carbide 机甲装甲技术的发展，人们得以在驾驶舱装甲中加入特殊镀层。

column1: You turn from Darius to look at the wreckage of your former opponent's mech,  "That Mechwarrior failed the Trial, and failed to impress me.  I have no need of one such as them within our ranks."
column2: 你从 Darius 身边转开，望向昔日对手机甲的残骸：“那名机甲战士没能通过试炼，也没能给我留下深刻印象。我不需要这样的人成为我们的一员。”

column1: You sit in silence staring long and hard at Front Man, "You seriously expect me to just pony up ¢7,500,000 C-Bills? That is a substantial amount to just pull out of your ass!" Front Man looks away for a few seconds before turning back to you, "Well you see, the Syndicate requires examples to be made, especially when someone goes to the lengths you have to avoid the true outcome of our Game. The amount owed, is exactly that sum." You visibly grimace at the amount, "I'll give you ¢5,000,000. And I want assurances you will not retaliate or target {TGT_MW.Callsign} ever again." Front Man stares at you for a long while, "I like you so much, Commander, so I will be candid. It is in your best interests to transfer the ¢7,500,000 C-Bills. And yes, we will release {TGT_MW.Callsign} will also wipe their slate clean with us in full. I'm sure we will speak again soon." The image of Front Man winks out as the connection is severed.
column2: 你默默坐着，久久凝视中间人：“你真以为我会乖乖拿出 7,500,000 C-Bills？这么大一笔钱，你说掏就掏得出来！” 中间人移开视线几秒，随后转回来看着你：“你看，辛迪加需要杀鸡儆猴，尤其是有人像你这样竭尽全力逃避游戏的真实结果时。欠款就是这个数。” 你看着那笔金额，明显面露难色：“我给你 5,000,000。并且我要你保证永远不再报复或针对 {TGT_MW.Callsign}。” 中间人久久凝视着你：“我很喜欢你，指挥官，所以就坦率说吧。转账 7,500,000 C-Bills 对你最有利。而且没错，我们会放过 {TGT_MW.Callsign}，也会彻底替他们抹去在我们这里的污点。我相信我们很快还会再见。” 连接切断，中间人的影像随之熄灭。

column1:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] is quarantined in one of the MedBays and provided a generic symptomatic treatment. {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} soon joined by [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], and not long after that, [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] falls ill as well.

Rumors and fear spread faster than the virus, with stories of disfiguring boils, raging fevers, and delirium. Everyone finds themselves praying to whatever gods they worship.

Eventually, it is clear the quarantine has successfully limited the spread of the disease. For these three MechWarriors, however, the road to recovery will be extremely long and unpleasant.
column2:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 被隔离在一间医疗舱内，并接受了针对症状的常规治疗。{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} 很快加入了 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]，没过多久，[[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] 也病倒了。

谣言与恐惧传播得比病毒更快，故事里充斥着毁容性的脓疱、狂热高烧和谵妄。每个人都开始向自己信奉的神祇祈祷。

最终，事实证明隔离成功限制了疾病传播。然而对这三名机甲战士来说，康复之路将会漫长而痛苦。

column1:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] is quarantined in one of the MedBays and the medication administered. {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} soon joined by [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], and not long after that, [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] falls ill as well.

Rumors and fear spread faster than the virus, with stories of disfiguring boils, raging fevers, and delirium. Everyone finds themselves praying to whatever gods they worship.

But the drugs provided by the planet do their job, stopping the contagion in its tracks. Nobody else gets sick, but the three MechWarriors who were infected are going to face a long, slow road to recovery.
column2:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 被隔离在一间医疗舱内并接受了药物治疗。{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} 很快加入了 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]，没过多久，[[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] 也病倒了。

谣言与恐惧传播得比病毒更快，故事里充斥着毁容性的脓疱、狂热高烧和谵妄。每个人都开始向自己信奉的神祇祈祷。

不过，星球提供的药物发挥了作用，将传染遏制在萌芽状态。没有其他人染病，但那三名感染的机甲战士将要面对漫长而缓慢的康复之路。

column1: Try Quicsell's Ferro armor today! It's even lighter than that the ever popular Ferro-Fibrous armour and is only slightly bulkier. Reserves 12 slots.

column1: This target was Narc'ed. +2 to hit with Missiles.

column2: 反应装甲的热排放使信号特征增加 40%

column1: REX Lasers, King of the battlefield! Quicsell's revolutionary Re-engineered X-pulse lasers have all the benefits of both re-engineered lasers and the infamous X-pulse technology!

column1: Society Scientists working on analyzing the Inner Sphere Bombast Laser found they could marry the principles to the Clan Improved Heavy Laser, allowing a pilot to fire these lasers at variable settings and with an even greater energy output. \n\n Damage Mode Deals 33% Increased Damage and Additional 20% Armor Damage at -50% reduced Range, Ranged has +50% Range and +1 Improved Accuracy with -33% reduced Damage
column2: 研究内天区爆破激光时，Society 科学家发现可以将其原理与氏族改进型重型激光器结合，使飞行员能够以可变功率档位发射这些激光器，并获得更高的能量输出。\n\n 伤害模式：在射程降低 50% 的情况下，造成伤害提高 33%，并额外造成 20% 装甲伤害；远程模式：射程提高 50%，精准度改进 +1，但伤害降低 33%

column1: More Quicsell Innovations! Try our 'Streak' SRM launchers. Thanks to our sophisticated target locking system, you can have Streak efficiency* with normal SRM ammo! *Efficiency refers to rounds fired. Some missiles are expended for their guidance hardware, leading to a 50% ammo efficiency. Uses SRM Ammo.
column2: 更多 Quicsell 创新！试试我们的“Streak”SRM 发射器。得益于先进的目标锁定系统，你可以使用普通 SRM 弹药实现 Streak 效率*！ *效率指发射的弹数。部分导弹会消耗在制导硬件上，导致弹药效率仅为 50%。 使用 SRM 弹药。

column1: The Precentor is requesting help with a top Secret project.
column2: Precentor 正在请求协助一项绝密项目。

column1: There's no room on your ship for troublemakers, not when so many talented pilots are filling the Hiring Halls.
column2: 你的舰船上没有捣乱分子的容身之处，毕竟招聘大厅里有这么多才华横溢的飞行员。

column1: Thermal damage reduced by 30%.
column2: 热伤害降低 30%。

column1:
Sumire catches your attention on the bridge. "Commander, I've picked up a distress call from a nearby civilian transport. It's not exactly our job to assist in matters like this, but we may be the nearest ship available."

She studies the display. " On the other hand, it looks like the ship's engines are in a critical state. They could explode before we get there."

Darius says sharply, "One moment! The planetary news feeds have a quarantine alert for several major cities. The alert mentions the Periphery Pox several times."
column2:
苏米尔在舰桥上引起你的注意。“指挥官，我收到了附近一艘民用运输船发来的求救信号。协助处理这类事务并非我们的职责，但我们可能是附近唯一可用的舰船。”

她研究着显示屏。“不过，看起来那艘船的引擎处于危急状态。我们赶到之前它们可能就会爆炸。”

达里厄斯厉声说道：“等等！行星新闻频道对数座主要城市发出了隔离警报。警报中多次提到边缘区痘疫。”

column1: The Davy Crockett is a compact half-kiloton nuclear device configurable for a variety of delivery systems. Unfortunately many have a range only slightly longer than the blast radius, making them rather unpopular with troops. This configuration of the Davy Crockett-M can be launched via Long Tom Artillery and operates in ground burst mode. While heavier than normal rounds at one ton each, they behave exactly as normal munitions do. Risk of propellant detonation can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E. the warhead itself will not detonate unless it is properly armed and primed.
column2: 戴维·克罗克特是一种紧凑型半千吨级核装置，可配置于多种投送系统。不幸的是，许多投送系统的射程仅略长于爆炸半径，因此不受部队欢迎。这个 Davy Crockett-M 配置可通过 Long Tom 火炮发射，并采用地面爆炸模式。虽然每发重达一吨，比普通炮弹更重，但其表现与普通弹药完全相同。使用 C.A.S.E. 可降低推进剂爆炸风险；弹头只有在正确装配引信并完成预置后才会引爆。

column1: The Micro Missile System is based on an attempt to improve on the aging MRM. Marrying advanced Guidance and Control Systems to the Launcher helped overcame several innate flaws of the MRM, yet it was ultimately deemed a failure because of prohibitively expensive and hard to produce Munitions. \n\n Uses Micro Missile Ammo.
column2: 微型导弹系统旨在改进老旧的 MRM。将先进的制导与控制系统与发射器结合后，虽克服了 MRM 的若干固有缺陷，但由于弹药成本高昂且难以生产，最终仍被判定为失败。 \n\n 使用微型导弹弹药。

column1: If you've ever wanted to throw an entire gift basket of different grenades at an enemy mech, Quicsell's got your back.
column2: 如果你一直想把一整篮不同种类的手雷扔向敌方机甲，Quicsell 会满足你的需求。

column1: A great way to beat the heat! Quicsell brand bolt-on Thermal Mass improves the amount of heat your system can take before you hit the redline.
column2: 消暑良方！Quicsell 品牌的外挂式热质量模块可提高系统在达到红线前能够承受的热量。

column1: A huge PPC, rewired to have two different damage modes; either pure damage or extreme electrical interference causing major impairment or full shutdown of the target. \n\nEXTREMLY VOLATILE!
column2: 一门巨型 PPC，重新接线后拥有两种不同的伤害模式：纯粹伤害，或产生强烈电磁干扰，导致目标严重瘫痪甚至完全停机。 \n\n极度不稳定！

column1: An attempt to improve on the Streak System, this launcher uses a proprietary MKII Guidance System, firing missiles with successful lock individually. \n\nUses Clan Streak SRM Ammo.
column2: 这是改进 Streak 系统的一次尝试；该发射器采用专有的 MKII 制导系统，仅发射成功锁定的导弹。 \n\n使用氏族 Streak SRM 弹药。

column1: -1 Arm mounted accuracy.
column2: -1 臂装武器命中率。

column1: Dumping heat to Thermal Mass
column2: 将热量倾倒至热质量

column1: Energy weapon heat generation reduced by 3.5%.
column2: 能量武器产热降低 3.5%。

column1: Half kiloton nuclear device
column2: 半千吨级核装置

column1: An example of convergent weapon evolution, the Mech-Scale Grenade Launcher closely resembles the venerable Mech Mortar. However, the MGL attempts to launch a considerably larger explosives payload and, as such, the MGL has a much shorter range than its cousin but can cause havoc for anything standing in the target area. \n\n Uses MGL Ammo.
column2: 武器趋同演化的一个例子，机甲级榴弹发射器与老牌机甲迫击炮非常相似。然而，MGL 试图发射装药量大得多的爆炸物，因此射程比其近亲短得多，却能让目标区域内的一切陷入混乱。 \n\n 使用 MGL 弹药。

column1: Desert biomes decrease heat sinking efficiency to 85%.
column2: 沙漠生物群系会将散热效率降低至 85%。

column1: Developed to meet customer demand for a cheaper fire support unit, the T3 merely swaps the Arrow IV launcher for the more common Thumper artillery piece. Otherwise unchanged, this mech is marketed to budget conscious customers looking for an artillery mech. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 为满足客户对更廉价火力支援单位的需求，T3 只是将 Arrow IV 发射器替换为更常见的 Thumper 火炮。除此之外，这台机甲没有变化，面向注重预算、希望拥有一台火炮机甲的客户销售。 特性：稳定武器 投放成本倍率：1.05

column1: The Tian Xie Zuo, named after the Scorpio star constellation seen from Terra, is a 185 ton Superheavy QuadMech designed by the Capellan Confederation. Part of their new doctrine to bring offensive capabilities above all, the design is focused on weapons rather than defensive strength, but still carries an impressive amount of armor.
column2: 天蝎座（从泰拉上空可见的天蝎星座）命名的天蝎座，是一款由卡佩兰联合体设计、重达185吨的超级重量级四足机甲。其设计遵循将进攻能力置于一切之上的新战略，侧重武器而非防御强度，但仍携带了惊人的装甲。

column1: The "Wing"-series of the Wraith was introduced in the 3140s by Hellespont Industrials, with its main trait being the integration of a partial wings system into the chassis to increase the jump range considerably. The re-design introduced a number of other improvements as well, with the result that the new line of variants slightly more expensive to maintain.
column2: “翼”系列幽灵机甲由赫勒斯庞特工业于3140年代推出，其主要特点是将部分机翼系统整合进机体，大幅提升跳跃距离。重新设计还带来了许多其他改进，结果是这一新变型系列的维护费用略有增加。

column1: The Hauberk mounts improved stealth armor to keep from being targeted effectively. The size of the battlesuit precludes its ability to be transported on OmniMechs or perform anti-'Mech operations, though it does mount a battle claw. Its slow speed generally limits its use to defensive operations, though it has been known to travel by armored personnel carrier.
column2: 豪铠装配了改进型隐形装甲，使敌人难以有效锁定。战斗服的体型使其无法由全能机甲运输，也无法执行反机甲作战，不过它确实装有一只战斗爪。其缓慢的速度通常将用途限制在防御行动上，但据说它也曾搭乘装甲运兵车转移。

column1: Hey Boss, the clans call these things the Summoner but I've always called em' the Thor.  These OmniMechs are a tad light on available pod space for their weight class and those early structural mounts are not compatible with anything else. But with that huge engine and lots of Jump Jet hardpoints you will be hard pressed to find many 'Mechs its size that are faster.
column2: 老板，氏族人把这些东西叫作召唤者，但我一直叫它们托尔。这些全能机甲对于自身重量级别来说可用的吊舱空间略显不足，而且早期的结构挂点无法兼容其他装备。不过，凭借那台巨型引擎和大量跳跃喷射器挂点，要找到同尺寸且速度更快的机甲可不容易。

column1: The Crimson Hawk was originally developed by Clan Blood Spirit in 3069 as a light strike 'Mech. Clan Diamond Shark became aware of the prototype model and won a Trial of Possession for it, developing the Crimson Hawk into its production form. Much of its mass is geared towards armor and firepower rather than speed, as it was intended for difficult terrain and swarm tactics.
column2: 赤鹰最初由血灵氏族于3069年开发，是一款轻型突击机甲。钻石鲨氏族得知原型机后，为它赢得了一场所有权试炼，并将赤鹰发展成量产型号。由于设计用于复杂地形和蜂群战术，其大部分质量都用于装甲与火力，而非速度。

column1: The Razorback is a design that excels at little, but is similarly deficient in few areas. Though the design is rather slow for a 'Mech of its size, it is rarely the slowest 'Mech on the field, either. Because of the 'Mech's general reliance on ballistic and missile weaponry, it does not have to worry about overheating under normal circumstances but is dependent on supply trains.
column2: 剃刀背的设计没有特别擅长的领域，但同样也很少有明显短板。尽管对于这种尺寸的机甲来说它相当缓慢，却很少成为战场上最慢的机甲。由于总体依赖弹道武器和导弹武器，正常情况下无需担心过热，但它依赖补给列车。

column1: The Wraith battle armor was designed by the Rasalhague Dominion to support conventional infantry as well as perform surgical strikes. It is equipped with Basic Stealth armor to hide it from enemy probes, and its jump jets allow it to cover ninety meters in a single jump. The suit was introduced after extensive testing of the Rogue Bear battle armor, and is a direct descendant of that design.
column2: 幽灵战斗装甲由拉萨哈格自治领设计，既用于支援常规步兵，也用于执行外科式突袭。它配备基础隐形装甲，可躲避敌方探测；跳跃喷射器则允许它一次跃过九十米。该战斗服是在对流浪熊战斗装甲进行广泛测试后推出的，是那一设计的直接后裔。

column1: The Blue Flame began production after the Word of Blake took possession of Terra. The same factory that had produced the Shootist was upgraded to produce four legged BattleMechs. The Blue Flame is an extremely stable platform due to its quadrupedal configuration. In the later years of the Jihad, an engineer who had help build the Mech stole the design specs and later created the Thunder Fox.
column2: 蓝焰在布莱克之词夺取泰拉后开始生产。原本用于生产射手的同一座工厂经过升级，开始制造四足战斗机甲。得益于四足构型，蓝焰成为极其稳定的平台。圣战后期，一名参与机甲建造的工程师窃取了设计规格，后来创造了雷霆狐。

column1: When Clan Ghost Bear needed a superheavy 'Mech, they took the basic Kodiak concepts and created the Nanook. A 160 ton beast of a 'Mech, fully armored and surprisingly fast thanks to its 460 XXL engine, it is meant to out-manuever other superheavies before dealing a full on alpha strike. Worth noticing is that the way the internal circuitry of the Nanook is set up, it heavily favours Laser weapons.
column2: 当幽灵熊氏族需要一款超级重量级机甲时，他们以科迪亚克的基本理念为基础，制造了纳努克。这头重达160吨的机甲披挂全甲，凭借460 XXL引擎却出人意料地迅速；它的目标是在发动全威力齐射前机动压倒其他超级重量级机甲。值得注意的是，纳努克的内部电路布局使其尤其偏好激光武器。

column1: The Grenadier II battle armor suit is an evolution of the Grenadier suit already in use by the AFFS. It uses lighter Clan-spec Standard Stealth armor mated to an Inner Sphere chassis to save weight. This allows the Grenadier II to pack as much firepower and protection as a Grenadier, but at a lighter weight. In addition, the lighter weight of the Grenadier II means it can be transported by OmniMechs.
column2: 掷弹兵II战斗装甲是现役于联邦太阳军中的掷弹兵战斗服的演进型。它将更轻的氏族规格标准隐形装甲与内圈底盘结合，以节省重量。因此，掷弹兵II能以更轻的重量搭载与掷弹兵同等的火力和防护。此外，较轻的重量还意味着掷弹兵II可以由全能机甲运输。

column1: The Tomahawk II is designed around the use of a DSAM Endo 10-Composite internal structure, which gives the design its cavernous pod capacity of 56 tons. The 'Mech is powered by a 300-Rated Starfire Extra-Light Fusion Engine, giving it a maximum speed of 54 km/h. Protecting the engine and the Tomahawk II's other vitals is 19 tons of Advanced/3 standard armor, providing nearly maximum protection against enemy fire.
column2: 战斧II围绕DSAM Endo 10复合内部结构设计，因此拥有高达56吨的巨大吊舱容量。该机甲由300级星火超轻融合引擎驱动，最高速度可达54公里/小时。保护引擎及战斧II其他关键部位的是19吨先进/3型标准装甲，几乎提供了最大程度的敌火防护。

column1: A continuation of the Timber Wolf OmniMech tradition, the Sea Wolf is the superheavy of the family of 'Mechs. At 175 ton there is plenty of room for advanced weaponry even after fitting a 430 XXL engine. The 'Mech was developed by Clan Sea Fox, but is exported to all Clans and their Allies, and although the Inner Sphere designation should be Mad Cat V, most factions use the Sea Wolf name even in the Inner Sphere.
column2: 海狼延续了森林狼全能机甲的传统，是这一机甲家族中的超级重量级成员。重达175吨，即使安装430 XXL引擎后，仍有充足空间搭载先进武器。该机甲由海狐氏族开发，但出口给所有氏族及其盟友；尽管内圈应将其命名为狂猫V，大多数派系即使在内圈也使用海狼这一名称。

column1: Originally a design by the Magistracy of Canopus, the Eurypterid was eventually licensed out to several other Periphery and Inner Sphere factions as the MoC lacked the resources to build any larger numbers of it themselves. Tasked with being a heavy vanguard unit, mainly in defensive positions, the 200 ton QuadMech can be a formidable foe if you get too close to it. but in itself, its design is nothing revolutionary.
column2: 欧律忒律德最初由金色穹顶王国设计，后来由于该王国缺乏自行大规模生产的资源，最终授权给数个外围星域和内圈派系。作为主要用于防御阵地的重型先锋单位，这台200吨四足机甲若让你靠得太近，会成为可怕的对手；但就其本身而言，设计并没有什么革命性之处。

column1: Now this one earned its name honestly. Built to hit like a neutron star going supernova, and the Hegemony didn't hold back on the armor either, nineteen and a half tons worth. Every Great House wanted a piece of it, tried every trick they knew, and never got a single unit or contract. Sabotage killed off new production once the civil war started, and the last confirmed sighting came from clan reports during Operation Klondike.
column2: 这台机甲确实名副其实。它的打击力仿佛超新星爆发时的中子星，而霸权也毫不吝惜装甲，足足装了十九吨半。每个大贵族都想分一杯羹，尝试了所有已知手段，却始终没拿到一台机体或一份合同。内战开始后，破坏活动扼杀了新生产，最后一次确认目击来自克兰代克行动期间的氏族报告。

column1: The Jupiter was designed by Clan Jade Falcon to complement their premier assault 'Mech, the Turkina, during the Jihad. Although not as versatile as the Turkina, it was developed from the most commonly available parts at the time, giving the Jupiter a rugged and easily repaired design that many other designs cannot match. Due to its durability, Jupiters have been spotted in many mercenary and House armies throughout the post-Jihad Inner Sphere
column2: 木星由翡翠隼氏族设计，用于在圣战期间配合其王牌突击机甲特基纳。虽然不如特基纳多才多艺，但它采用了当时最常见的零部件，造就了许多其他设计无法比拟的坚固且易于维修的机体。由于耐用性出众，圣战后的内圈各地都能看到木星出现在雇佣兵和各大贵族的军队中。

column1: The Thunder Fox is a medium Quad BattleMech that was produced at the end of the Jihad, with thanks to an engineer named Lara Harman. Harman, a former Mitchell Vehicles designer, secretly - and principally - combined the Blue Flame Quad 'Mech's design specs with other Blakist designs to conceive the Thunder Fox. The design became popular with the newly formed Republic of the Sphere. It was later exported to the Draconis Combine and Lyran Commonwealth.
column2: 雷霆狐是一款中型四足战斗机甲，在圣战末期问世，这要归功于一位名叫劳拉·哈曼的工程师。哈曼曾是米切尔车辆公司的设计师，她秘密地、主要将蓝焰四足机甲的设计规格与其他布莱克派设计结合起来，构想出了雷霆狐。该设计受到新成立的球体共和国欢迎，后来还出口到龙马联盟和莱拉联邦。

column1: The Wulfgar, Clan Wolf’s modernized successor to the Glass Spider, updates the classic chassis into an OmniMech while preserving its original look. Powered by an Extra Light engine with a supercharger, it can reach speeds up to 103 kph. Equipped with an Angel ECM Suite and Targeting Computer, it excels in electronic warfare and accuracy. The Endo-Steel chassis and Ferro-Fibrous armor free up weight for 24 tons of pod space, allowing heavy Clan weapons.
column2: 沃尔夫加是狼氏族对玻璃蜘蛛进行现代化改造后的继任者，在保留经典外形的同时将底盘升级为全能机甲。它由一台带增压器的超轻引擎驱动，速度最高可达103公里/小时。配备天使ECM套件和瞄准计算机后，它在电子战和射击精度方面表现出色。Endo钢底盘与铁磁纤维装甲腾出了重量空间，可提供24吨吊舱容量，搭载重型氏族武器。

column1: The Shockwave was created by the Marik-Stewart Commonwealth in the years after the Jihad. Its high top speed, strong armor, and powerful weapons make it a popular choice around the Inner Sphere. Mobile and heavily-armed for a 50-ton 'Mech, the Shockwave can deliver a withering barrage and has the heat-sinks to keep it up almost indefinitely. The use of standard armor and commonly employed weapons allows the Shockwave to be used on nearly any battlefield.
column2: 震波由马里克-斯图尔特联邦在圣战后的几年间创造。其高速、坚固装甲和强力武器使其在内圈广受欢迎。对于一台50吨机甲来说，震波机动性高且火力凶猛，能够倾泻毁灭性弹幕，并拥有足够的散热器几乎无限持续作战。采用标准装甲和常见武器，也让震波几乎能在任何战场上使用。

column1: Introduced in the 3140s, the Vandal is a Heavy Class OmniMech produced by the Capellan Confederation. The Vandal is designed to be a speedy and tough combat unit, while it is also meant to work as a team player in combat. Found in virtually all of its original OmniPod configurations, the 'Mech would feature the usage of C3 boosted slave communication systems. The 'Mech would see deployment with Confederation allies which includes the Magistracy of Canopus.
column2: 破坏者于3140年代问世，是卡佩兰联合体生产的重型级全能机甲。它被设计为速度快且坚韧的战斗单位，同时也适合在战斗中协同作战。在几乎所有原始全能吊舱配置中，该机甲都会使用C3增强型从属通信系统。破坏者还曾部署于联合体盟友部队，其中包括金色穹顶王国。

column1: The Ranger was one of Firefly Foundry's first two designs, built for both internal use and export, and it sold broadly across the Periphery and eventually into the AFFS as well. It is a dependable medium frame rather than a flashy one, the kind of workhorse that keeps a unit functional when more exotic hardware is in the shop. Later variants integrated Clan Sea Fox technology, which pushed the ceiling considerably beyond what the original design suggested was possible.
column2: 游骑兵是萤火虫铸造厂最初的两种设计之一，既供内部使用也用于出口，广泛销售到外围星域，最终还进入了联邦太阳军。它是一款可靠的中型机体，而非华而不实的设计；当更奇特的装备送修时，这种勤恳的老马仍能让部队保持运转。后续变型整合了海狐氏族技术，将性能上限大幅推高，远超原始设计所暗示的可能。

column1: The Scuti was the largest Superheavy created for most of the Star League Era. Like it's namesake, a hypergiant star amongst the largest known in the universe, the 'Mechs sheer size was very close to the physically possible limit for BattleMechs. With the SLDF's exodus, several of the Scuti were hidden in caches around the galaxy, locations kept extremely safeguarded. Several hundred years later ComStar eventually recovered these giants as their need for increased firepower rose.
column2: 盾牌座是星盟时代大部分时期制造的最大型超级重量级机甲。它的名字源自盾牌座——宇宙中已知最大的超巨星之一；这台机甲庞大的体型已经非常接近战斗机甲在物理上可达到的极限。随着星盟国防军出走，数台盾牌座被藏在银河各处的秘密储藏库中，位置受到极其严密的保护。数百年后，随着对更强火力的需求上升，ComStar最终找回了这些巨兽。

column1: A co-operation between Clan Sea Fox and Clan Nova Cat - mainly with resources from the latter, the Erebus is a specially designed chassis to mount the downsized Mass Driver - a giant ballistic weapon making autocannons look like pea shooters. The 'Mech has special stabilizing equipment and advanced targeting fire control systems, to attempt improving the Mass Driver performance. The 'Mech and its weapon is mostly seen as a waste of time by other Clans, as it is far too heavy and hot to be useful.
column2: 厄瑞玻斯由海狐氏族与新星猫氏族合作制造，主要由后者提供资源，是专为搭载缩小版质量驱动炮而设计的底盘——这种巨型弹道武器能让自动火炮看起来像玩具枪。该机甲配备特殊稳定设备和先进的瞄准火控系统，试图提升质量驱动炮的性能。其他氏族大多认为这台机甲及其武器是在浪费时间，因为它太重、太热，根本不实用。

column1: When Grumium Creations got a request from the Capellan Confederation for a new Command Mech that had to be even more potent than the Cyclops, the result was the superheavy OmniMech named the Polyphemus. At an impressive 180 tons and with a much improved Command Module, the design filled the role of Command Mech with ease. Utilizing the increase in space and weight capacity allows the engineers to not only increase the armor by a several tons, but to also add advanced Electronic Warfare Systems and
column2: 当格鲁米姆创作公司收到卡佩兰联合体的请求，要求设计一款比双足飞龙更强大的新型指挥机甲时，结果便是名为波吕斐摩斯的超级重量级全能机甲。它重达180吨，配备大幅改进的指挥模块，轻松胜任指挥机甲职责。利用增加的空间和载重能力，工程师不仅能将装甲增加数吨，还能加入先进的电子战系统以及

column1: The Thanatos is a sturdy, hard-hitting BattleMech conceived to emulate the Clan Thor OmniMech. After years licensing OmniMechs, StarCorps Industries mastered the technology and in 3060 designed their own, debuting Thanatos as an OmniMech. However, the LAAF and AFFS, citing cost and existing inventory, declined new Omni designs. Pivoting, StarCorps converted it to a standard ’Mech and resubmitted; militaries adopted it. The Thanatos excels in heavy cavalry roles, often combined with other fast 'Mechs.
column2: 萨纳托斯是一款坚固、重拳出击的战斗机甲，旨在仿制氏族托尔全能机甲。经过多年授权生产全能机甲后，星际军团工业掌握了相关技术，并于3060年设计出自己的型号，以全能机甲形式推出萨纳托斯。然而，莱拉联盟军和联邦太阳军以成本及现有库存为由，拒绝采用新的全能设计。于是星际军团将其改为标准机甲重新提交，最终被军方采纳。萨纳托斯擅长重型骑兵任务，常与其他高速机甲协同作战。

column1: First known to have been deployed in 3073, the Rogue Bear is a battle armor design produced by Clan Ghost Bear. Initially confused for the Golem, the Rogue Bear is a heavy battlesuit that was initially deployed with garrison units, especially those of the KungsArmé who were incorporated into the Ghost Bear touman. The Rogue Bear can jump up to sixty meters at a time. It is protected by almost enough armor to stop a Gauss rifle. The battlesuit uses mostly standard components with no disposable weaponry.
column2: 流浪熊最早已知于3073年部署，是幽灵熊氏族生产的一款战斗装甲设计。它最初被误认为魔像；实际上，流浪熊是一种重型战斗服，最初部署于驻防部队，尤其是后来并入幽灵熊图曼的孔斯阿米部队。流浪熊一次最多可跳跃六十米，装甲几乎足以抵挡高斯步枪。该战斗服主要采用标准部件，不配备一次性武器。

column1: The Ostsol was designed as an all-energy-weapon alternative to Ostmann Industries' previous heavy BattleMechs, the Ostwar and the Ostroc. Armed with a mix of lasers and requiring little resupply, the Ostsol is nearly impossible to interdict and is able to operate independently of supply lines for extended periods of time. A versatile 'Mech, the Ostsol can operate as part of heavy lances in order to provide close-range firepower or lead recon and raiding lances thanks to its high speed and advanced electronics.
column2: 奥斯索尔被设计为奥斯特曼工业公司此前重型战斗机甲奥斯沃和奥斯特罗克的全能量武器替代品。它装备多种激光武器，补给需求很低，几乎无法被拦截，并能在很长时间内脱离补给线独立行动。作为多用途机甲，奥斯索尔既可编入重型枪骑兵连提供近距离火力，也能凭借高速和先进电子设备带领侦察及突袭部队。

column1: The Trebaruna is a Quad configured Assault BattleMech that was originally designed by the Word of Blake Protectorate. Production plans were canceled by the Word of Blake in 3078, when Allied Coalition forces were finally closing in on Terra. The design was discovered by Coalition members, and was offered to all the partners. The design was put into production by the Republic of the Sphere as part of its newly-formed armed forces in 3081, followed shortly after by the Marik-Stewart Commonwealth and Capellan Confederation.
column2: 特雷巴鲁纳是一款四足构型突击战斗机甲，最初由布莱克之词保护国设计。3078年，盟军联军终于逼近泰拉，布莱克之词遂取消生产计划。联军成员发现这份设计后，将其提供给所有合作伙伴。3081年，球体共和国将其投入生产，作为新组建武装力量的一部分；不久后，马里克-斯图尔特联邦和卡佩兰联合体也相继生产。

column1: Following the Abjuration of Clan Nova Cat, Khan Santin West ordered a team of scientists who had been captured from Clan Smoke Jaguar to design a BattleMech that could be produced in the Inner Sphere. They attempted to create a 'Mech similar to the Pack Hunter, but ER PPCs were sparse at the time, however the team got its break when the Nova Cats acquired a cache of heavy large lasers from Clan Diamond Shark in 3065. They had to rework the original concept of duplicating the Pack Hunter, which eventually became the Ocelot.
column2: 新星猫氏族遭到废黜后，汗王桑廷·韦斯特命令一队从烟爪氏族俘获的科学家，设计一款能在内圈生产的战斗机甲。他们试图制造类似猎群者的机甲，但当时ER PPC十分稀缺；转机出现在3065年，新星猫从钻石鲨氏族获得了一批重型大型激光器。他们不得不重做复制猎群者的原始概念，最终诞生了豹猫。

column1: The Krait, a fast and deadly light OmniMech, was co-developed by the Cloud Cobras and Star Adders using lessons from the Cephalus. Designed for the renewed invasion, it features a 35-ton chassis, 16.5 tons of pod space, and 6.5 tons of Ferro-Lamellor armor. A 250-rated XXL engine gives it speeds over 112 kph. Unlike most Clan ‘Mechs, it has a fixed Improved Heavy Medium Laser in the head. While only one variant has jump jets, the Krait excels in open terrain as a cavalry and strike unit - proving lethal to Inner Sphere recon forces.
column2: 凯特是一款快速而致命的轻型全能机甲，由云蛇氏族与星蝰氏族共同开发，借鉴了头足类的经验。它为再次入侵而设计，采用35吨底盘、16.5吨吊舱空间和6.5吨铁磁层压装甲。250级XXL引擎让其速度超过112公里/小时。与大多数氏族机甲不同，它的头部固定安装了一台改进型重型中型激光器。虽然只有一个变型配备跳跃喷射器，凯特在开阔地形中作为骑兵和突击单位表现出色，对内圈侦察部队极具杀伤力。

column1: The Pit Viper is Clan Star Adder’s answer to the fast strike OmniMech role. Capable of exceeding 110 kph and mounting 13.5 tons of pod space, it delivers serious firepower while maintaining high speed and armor. Though it lacks jump jets - limiting its effectiveness in tight terrain - its durability and energy-heavy loadouts make it an ideal scout and flanker in open environments. While some variants struggle with heat and ammo dependence, modular configurations help mitigate these issues, making the Pit Viper a reliable battlefield presence.
column2: 蝮蛇是星蝰氏族对快速突击全能机甲角色的回应。它速度可超过110公里/小时，并能搭载13.5吨吊舱空间，在保持高速和装甲的同时提供强大火力。虽然缺少跳跃喷射器，限制了它在狭窄地形中的效能，但其耐久性和以能量武器为主的配置使其成为开阔环境中的理想侦察与侧翼单位。部分变型受散热和弹药依赖困扰，不过模块化配置有助于缓解这些问题，使蝮蛇成为可靠的战场存在。

column1: Designed as a fast foot scout for battle armor units, the Rottweiler pushes the envelope of what ground speed battle armor can reach. Clad in BA-grade stealth armor and equipped with ECM, the Rottweiler makes for a hard target. However, this speed and evasiveness comes with a price: the Rottweiler is lightly armed. Each suit carries a Small Laser as primary armament and carries a Firedrake incendiary needler as a backup weapon. While not a lot of firepower, it was judged to be acceptable by the Lyran Alliance and the suit was put into production.
column2: 为战斗装甲部队设计的快速步行侦察单位，罗特韦勒式战斗装甲将地面速度推向了极限。它披覆战斗装甲级隐形装甲并配备 ECM，因此很难成为目标。但这种速度和灵活性也有代价：罗特韦勒式武装轻薄。每套装甲以小型激光作为主武器，并配备一门火焰龙燃烧针枪作为备用武器。虽然火力不强，但这套装甲得到了莱茵联盟认可并投入生产。

column1: The original Fire Moth, designated Dasher by the Inner Sphere, is a light 'Mech that is known for having great speed but weak armor, and it was found that the Dasher was not very effective at swarm tactics or raiding due to this deficiency. Because of this deficiency in the design the Dasher II entered service during the Word of Blake Jihad. Much heavier and sturdier than the original Dasher, the Dasher II has a top speed of 162 km/h that equals that of the original Dasher. The Dasher II's top speed allows it to close in to effectively use its firepower.
column2: 最初的火蝠在内天体圈被命名为冲刺者，是一种速度极快但装甲薄弱的轻型机甲；人们发现，由于这一缺陷，冲刺者并不适合蜂群战术或袭扰作战。正因设计上的不足，冲刺者 II 在圣战期间的圣言之剑战争中投入服役。它比原版冲刺者更重、更坚固，但最高速度仍达 162 公里/小时，与原版冲刺者相同。冲刺者 II 的极速使其能够迅速接近目标，有效发挥火力。

column1: A Solaris VII BattleMech, the Hachiwara was commissioned by the Silver Dragon Stables and designed by the Crosby BattleMech Research firm responsible for the creation of the No-Dachi. Using the No-Dachi as their inspiration, the Crosby engineers designed a 'Mech optimized for arena combat. The already high speed was increased by using a Supercharger, allowing the Hachiwara pilot to get in close to an opponent quickly. Twelve tons of armor protects the 'Mech. Harkening back to the samurai ideal, the Hachiwara uses a Vibroblade in place of the No-Dachi's Sword.
column2: 哈奇瓦拉是一台参加 Solaris VII 赛事的战斗机甲，由银龙马厩委托、负责制造野太刀的克罗斯比战斗机甲研究公司设计。克罗斯比工程师以野太刀为灵感，打造出一台针对竞技场战斗优化的机甲。通过加装增压器，原本就很高的速度进一步提升，使哈奇瓦拉驾驶员能够迅速贴近对手。机甲配备十二吨装甲。为了呼应武士理念，哈奇瓦拉用振动刃取代了野太刀的剑。

column1: The Tian-zong is a post-Jihad design that the Capellan Confederation first developed in 3090. Equipped with thirteen and a half tons of Stealth Armor powered by an Angel ECM Suite, the Tian-zong is a premier 'Recon in Force' 'Mech. The 300-rated extralight engine propels the Tian-zong to a top speed of 64 km/h, which can make for a jarring ride given the Small Cockpit. The Tian-zong is one of the first Capellan 'Mechs to use an Endo-Composite skeleton. Twelve Double Heat Sinks dissipate the heat from the Stealth Armor. It is a popular 'Mech with CCAF commanders.
column2: 天宗是圣战后的设计，卡佩兰联邦于 3090 年首次开发。天宗配备十三吨半隐形装甲，并由天使 ECM 套件驱动，是顶尖的“武力侦察”机甲。额定功率 300 的超轻型引擎将其最高速度推至 64 公里/小时，但由于采用小型驾驶舱，驾驶体验可能颇为颠簸。天宗是首批采用 Endo-Composite 骨架的卡佩兰机甲之一。十二个双散热器负责消散隐形装甲产生的热量。它深受卡佩兰联邦武装部队指挥官欢迎。

column1: The Sphinx was designed by Clan Nova Cat as a heavier companion to the Black Hawk OmniMech. The design was originally intended to be an OmniMech, but was changed due to the need to field 'Mechs more quickly. The Sphinx is built around an array of multiple lasers, allowing it to put out a massive amount of firepower at moderate ranges. It also maintains a similar movement profile to the Black Hawk although it lacks the jump jets of the lighter design. Its heavier frame also supports 13.5 tons of standard Clan armor, making it more durable than the smaller Black Hawk..
column2: 狮身人面像由新星猫氏族设计，是黑鹰 OmniMech 的重型伴侣。它原本计划作为 OmniMech 生产，但由于急需更快投入战场，最终改为普通机甲。狮身人面像围绕多组激光武器构建，能够在中距离倾泻出惊人的火力。它的机动性能与黑鹰相近，不过没有轻型设计所配备的跳跃喷射器。更重的机架还可搭载 13.5 吨氏族标准装甲，使其比体型更小的黑鹰更加耐用。

column1: The Eyleuka is a technological marvel of the late 3060s that owes everything to the Trinity Alliance, specifically the bond between the Magistracy of Canopus and Capellan Confederation. The Canopians benefited greatly, especially in military technology, but they wanted to prove that they could design a modern BattleMech without the Confederation's help. Five years after the commencement of R&D, the team from Detroit had little to show for their work; at the same time, the CCAF wanted a modern 'Mech for their commandos to use. The result of their collaboration is the Eyleuka.
column2: 伊莱乌卡是 3060 年代末的技术奇迹，其一切成就都归功于三位一体联盟，尤其是马利加托斯卡和卡佩兰联邦之间的合作。马利加托斯卡从中获益良多，特别是在军事技术方面，但他们想证明自己无需联邦援助也能设计现代战斗机甲。研发开始五年后，底特律团队仍拿不出多少成果；与此同时，卡佩兰联邦武装部队正需要一台供突击队使用的现代机甲。双方合作最终诞生了伊莱乌卡。

column1: The Afreet is a battle armor design created by Clan Ice Hellion. The Afreet was created when Khan Raina Montose ordered two other projects merged, resulting in a battlesuit that seems to fit in well with the Hellion belief in speed over all else. The primary feature of the Afreet is its ability to leap one hundred twenty meters at a time. This comes at a sacrifice to armor, as the Afreet is only able to stop a Clan ER Small Laser. It does, however, use Improved Sensors, a holdover from one of the suits it descended from. Following the Hellion invasion of the Inner Sphere, both Clan Jade Falcon and Clan Hell's Horses salvaged and produced their own versions.
column2: 阿弗里特是冰地狱氏族设计的战斗装甲。汗·雷娜·蒙托斯下令合并两个项目后，阿弗里特由此诞生；这套战斗服完美体现了地狱氏族将速度置于一切之上的信条。阿弗里特最显著的特点是一次可跃过 120 米。不过这牺牲了装甲防护，它只能抵挡氏族 ER 小型激光。阿弗里特还配备改进型传感器，这是从其血统中的一套战斗服继承而来的功能。地狱氏族入侵内天体圈后，翡翠猎鹰氏族和地狱之马氏族都回收并生产了各自的版本。

column1: The Hiisi is a formidable 150-ton BattleMech crafted by Red Root Foundry, designed to dominate the battlefield as an intimidating zone controller. With its broad silhouette and imposing stance, the Hiisi excels at area denial and battlefield control, using heavy weapons and layered defenses to hold key positions. Its rugged construction reflects Minnesota Tribe resilience, blending advanced armor and powerful weaponry. Known for its psychological impact as much as its firepower, the Hiisi commands respect and fear, making it a preferred choice for spearheading assaults or anchoring defensive lines. Its name echoes ancient Finnish myths, symbolizing relentless strength and primal ferocity.
column2: 海西是一台由红根铸造厂打造的强大 150 吨战斗机甲，设计目标是在战场上成为令人畏惧的区域控制者。凭借宽阔的轮廓和威严的姿态，海西使用重型武器与多层防御，擅长区域拒止和战场控制，牢牢守住关键阵地。其坚固结构体现了明尼苏达部落的坚韧，将先进装甲与强大火力融为一体。海西不仅以火力闻名，也因心理威慑力而广受重视，是突击先锋或防线锚点的首选。它的名字源自古老的芬兰神话，象征着不懈的力量与原始的凶猛。

column1: The War Crow is a Heavy OmniMech fielded by Clan Snow Raven. Commissioned by Khan Sterling McKenna, she had implemented development of the War Crow as a part of efforts to prepare her Clan for a war she believed could end up coming to the Alliance. The War Crow was designed to become the backbone of a newly revived Touman of Clan Snow Raven. Powered by the Redline 350 Extra-Light Fusion Engine, the War Crow is designed to move at a modest pace with other combatants. The Snow Raven Scientist caste designed the 'Mech with the latest in their Clan's armor protection, 15.5 tons of Ferro-Lamellor. While still a heavy OmniMech, the Ravens chose to give the Mech a fully functional hand actuator in the right arm.
column2: 战争乌鸦是雪鸦氏族装备的一款重型 OmniMech。汗·斯特林·麦肯娜委托开发战争乌鸦，作为让氏族为她认为可能波及联盟的战争做好准备的一部分。战争乌鸦旨在成为雪鸦氏族新生军团的骨干。它由 Redline 350 超轻型融合引擎驱动，设计速度适中，可与其他战斗单位协同推进。雪鸦科学家阶层为这台机甲采用了氏族最新的装甲防护技术：15.5 吨 Ferro-Lamellor 装甲。尽管仍是重型 OmniMech，雪鸦氏族还是为其右臂配备了功能完整的手部执行器。

column1: The Golem is a battle armor design that was created by Clan Ghost Bear. Following their conflicts with first the Draconis Combine, then Clan Hell's Horses, the Bears decided they wanted something that could compete with the Kanazuchi and Gnome. The Golem is the result of that process and features enough armor to shrug off a Heavy Large Laser. In addition, this armor is fire resistant, so it is unaffected by Flamers and Inferno rounds. Though it cannot jump, the Golem is still speedier than the other assault-class designs. While that does not make this battlesuit fast, it does give it the ability to bring its strong weapons to bear on a target, even as it can withstand the punishment meted out by an enemy.
column2: 魔像是幽灵熊氏族设计的一款战斗装甲。在先后与龙马联盟和地狱之马氏族发生冲突后，幽灵熊决定打造一种能够与金刚武神和侏儒抗衡的战斗服，魔像便是这一过程的成果。它的装甲足以硬扛重型大型激光，而且具备耐火特性，不受火焰喷射器和地狱火弹影响。魔像无法跳跃，但速度仍快于其他突击级设计。虽然这并不足以让它成为高速战斗服，却足以让它把强力武器带到目标面前，同时承受敌人的猛烈攻击。

column1: Intended as a symbol of Inner Sphere/Clan unity, the Kuma (Japanese for "Bear") is a fast if lightly armed Ghost Bear Dominion heavy cavalry BattleMech. While derisively referred to by some as the Charger IIC, the specialist Kuma was a heavy cornerstone to light Stars in the post-Jihad Dominion touman. Built on an Endo Steel frame, powered by an enormous 360 XL fusion engine and equipped with a large number of Improved Jump Jets, the Kuma is one of the most mobile heavy 'Mechs ever built, with a ground speed equal to the medium-weight Phoenix Hawk and a jump distance as high as the light-weight Spider. Clad in ten and half tons of standard armor, eleven Double Heat Sinks are barely able to cope with the design's weaponry and jump jets.
column2: 熊（Kuma 在日语中意为“熊”）旨在象征内天体圈与氏族的团结，是幽灵熊自治领一款速度极快但武装较轻的重型骑兵战斗机甲。有些人轻蔑地称其为“充电器 IIC”，但在圣战后的自治领军团中，这款专业化的熊是轻型星群的重心。它采用 Endo-Steel 机架，由庞大的 360 XL 融合引擎驱动，并配备大量改进型跳跃喷射器，是有史以来机动性最高的重型机甲之一：地面速度与中型凤凰鹰相当，跳跃距离则可媲美轻型蜘蛛。机体覆有十吨半标准装甲，十一台双散热器勉强应付其武器和跳跃喷射器产生的热量。

column1: The Alpha Wolf's initial specification called for a blend of the Warwolf and Timber Wolf in an assault 'Mech package, with the Wulfen's stealth armor. It shares electronics packages with the Wulfen and Warwolf —amongst others— more as a means to streamline development than for any advanced abilities of the systems themselves. Applying the Wulfen's stealth   armor onto an assault 'Mech raised eyebrows initially, although this decision hinged not on a desire for the Alpha Wolf to fill roles traditionally associated with stealth, such as scouting and infiltration. Rather, the benefits that stealth armor offered in disrupting enemy targeting systems cemented the selection, as it would allow the Alpha Wolf to survive longer in standup fights.
column2: 阿尔法狼的初始规格要求将战争狼与林狼融入突击机甲框架，并采用狼人的隐形装甲。它与狼人、战争狼以及其他机甲共享电子设备套件，这更多是为了简化开发，而非因为这些系统具备什么先进能力。起初，将狼人的隐形装甲用于突击机甲引发了质疑；这一决定并非为了让阿尔法狼承担侦察、渗透等传统隐形任务，而是因为隐形装甲能够干扰敌方瞄准系统，使阿尔法狼在正面交战中存活更久。

column1: Originally developed in the thirty-second century as a replacement for the Raiden suit, the Oni was considered an ugly and generally unimpressive battlesuit by the majority of the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery, and was generally issued to either garrison units or units suffering the disfavor of the Procurement Department. Despite the problems with the Oni - perceived or actual - the suit has continued to be a presence in militia units throughout the first half of the thirty-second century, in part because of the third of a ton of Clan-spec fire resistant armor the Oni mounts. The Oni also mounts both an Extended Life Support system and an ECM Suite, and is also capable of making swarm and leg attacks as well as serving as a mechanized unit.
column2: 鬼将最初于 32 世纪研发，用来取代雷电战斗服。龙马联盟武装部队的大多数人认为它外形丑陋、表现平庸，因此通常配发给驻防单位，或配发给受到采购部门冷落的部队。无论这些问题究竟是印象还是事实，鬼将仍在 32 世纪前半叶持续出现在民兵部队中，部分原因是它搭载了三分之一吨的氏族规格耐火装甲。鬼将还配备延长生命维持系统和 ECM 套件，并能够发动蜂群攻击和断腿攻击，也可作为机械化单位使用。

column1: The Gurkha was developed by the Word of Blake in response to a request from Precentor Martial Cameron St. Jamais to keep the production lines on Terra running. To open up as much space as possible for weapons and equipment, the Gurkha is built on a lightweight endo steel chassis and is powered by a lightweight XL engine that gives it a top speed of 118.8 km/h. That, combined with the Gurkha's seven and a half tons of armor, make taking the 'Mech down a difficult proposition. Its only real deficiency is its lack of jump jets, which make maneuvering in limiting terrain difficult for the 'Mech. As the Word of Blake's opponents realized the power of this little 'Mech, Gurkhas quickly became targets to be eliminated quickly, as the C3i computer often means that an individual MechWarrior can rapidly find him or herself attacked by up to six extremely accurate 'Mechs.
column2: 廓尔喀由圣言之剑在地球上的生产线响应武术教长卡梅隆·圣·贾梅的要求而开发。为了尽可能腾出空间安装武器和设备，廓尔喀采用轻型 Endo-Steel 机架，并由轻型 XL 引擎驱动，最高速度可达 118.8 公里/小时。再加上七吨半装甲，要击毁这台机甲并非易事。它唯一真正的缺点是没有跳跃喷射器，在受限地形中机动困难。圣言之剑的对手意识到这台小型机甲的威力后，廓尔喀很快成为必须优先消灭的目标，因为 C3i 计算机常常让单个机甲战士迅速遭到最多六台高精度机甲的围攻。

column1: Prototype Mad Cat MKIV
column2: 原型疤面猫 MKIV

column1: Experimental Battle Armor
column2: 实验型战斗装甲

column1: Fire Resistant Battle Armor
column2: 耐火战斗装甲

column1: This bad boy can fit so much Battle Armor in it.
column2: 这家伙能塞下这么多战斗装甲。

column1: Boss this thing's got 78 tubes and enough missiles to fire them all week!
column2: 老板，这玩意儿有 78 根发射管，导弹多得够它打上一整周！

column1: The Leviathan is an attempt at creating the most powerful and supersized mech imaginable.
column2: 利维坦是一次打造最强、最大型机甲的尝试。

column1: A smaller version of the Crab, using very basic tech. I don't find it more useful than a Urbanmech really...
column2: 使用非常基础技术的蟹式机甲小型版本。我真不觉得它比城市机甲更有用……

column1: The Scourge is a mid thirty-second century heavy BattleMech, which is utilized as a general purpose combat unit and as well as a heavy scout.
column2: 天灾是一款诞生于 32 世纪中期的重型战斗机甲，用作通用战斗单位，同时也承担重型侦察任务。

column1: The Mhacha is another genious design from the Morrigan program, named for a protective goddess was this Chassis designed to provide Long Range Firepower and AA Protection.
column2: 莫里根计划又一项天才设计。该底盘以一位守护女神命名，旨在提供远程火力和防空防护。

column1: Looks like this is one of Luthien's homebrewed OmniMechs. I don't got much for you on this one, Boss, but the default configuration here is fast and packs a punch at long range.
column2: 看起来这是卢腾自制的 OmniMech 之一。老板，我对它了解不多，但这里的默认配置速度很快，远程火力也很猛。

column1: The Peacekeeper BattleMech is a joint venture developed in the Post-Jihad era by the Republic of the Sphere and the Draconis Combine. The design is intended for anti-insurgency combat as well as garrison duty.
column2: 和平卫士战斗机甲由星球共和国和龙马联盟在圣战后时代联合研发。该设计用于反叛乱作战和驻防任务。

column1: Rugged, effective and a workhorse; these three words describes the Jinggau. Always popular, both with the Capellan armed forces and later with the Clans, it is not uncommon to meet one on the battlefield of heavily contested areas.
column2: 坚固、有效、勤勉耐用；这三个词概括了景光。它一直深受卡佩兰武装部队和后来各氏族欢迎，在争夺激烈的战场上遇到它并不稀奇。

column1: Boss, this is another one of those Capellan stealth 'Mechs. This thing is going to be practically invisible to sensors at long ranges and packs decent firepower considering the size of the engine and the bulk that stealth tech takes up.
column2: 老板，这是另一台卡佩兰隐形机甲。远距离下它几乎不会被传感器发现，考虑到引擎尺寸和隐形技术占用的空间，它的火力相当不错。

column1: The 'jmy-wt', or Imiut, is a heavier OmniMech upgrade of the Anubis Scout Mech, sporting Clan grade Endo-Steel with a unique Stealth Suite integrated with its Ferro Fibrous Armor does it sport extreme agility and firepower to comparable Designs
column2: “jmy-wt”即伊米特，是安努比斯侦察机甲的重型 OmniMech 升级版。它采用氏族级 Endo-Steel，并将独特的隐形套件整合进 Ferro-Fibrous 装甲，使其拥有与同类设计相比极高的机动性和火力。

column1: The Crucible was introduced during the Wolf Empire's drive to Terra and was developed on top of the Stone Rhino program. It is a dedicated defensive asset usable by solahma to protect the touman's supply lines. It is a mighty fine 'Mech to have.
column2: 熔炉在狼帝国进军泰拉期间投入使用，基于石犀计划开发。它是专门的防御资产，可由 Solahma 部队使用来保护军团补给线。这是一台非常不错的机甲。

column1: Taking inspiration from the R20 series of mechs, this Urbanmech was designed from the ground up to be a cheap and nasty ambusher aimed at the mercenary market. The combination of stealth armour and rockets allow it to savage targets and withdraw.
column2: 这台城市机甲汲取 R20 系列机甲的灵感，从头打造为面向雇佣兵市场的廉价凶狠伏击者。隐形装甲与火箭的组合让它能重创目标后迅速撤离。

column1: The Word of Blake wanted to create quad BattleMechs, but were unable to produce the kind that they wanted until they acquired the light engine technology from the Lyran Alliance. As with many Word 'Mechs, the majority were funneled to secret units.
column2: Blake教曾试图制造四足战斗机甲，但直到获得了莱拉联盟的轻型引擎技术后，才得以生产出理想型号。和许多Blake教机甲一样，其中大多数都被输送给了秘密部队。

column1: A continuation of the Gray Death Standard, the Strike version of the base design was more focused on front line maneuvering and flanking strikes. This is seen by the use of a Light TAG and heavier SRM missile launcher than the Standard variants use.
column2: 这是灰色死亡标准型的延续，突击型基础设计更侧重前线机动和侧翼打击。其采用轻型TAG以及比标准型号更重的SRM导弹发射器，正体现了这一点。

column1: Based on the very common Orion, the first real Heavy 'Mech, the superheavy offspring the Master Orion was created by a secret skunkworks department within Kali Yama to help test a new, immense laser weapon developer by the weapons division, the Mauler Laser.
column2: Master Orion以极为常见的Orion——第一款真正意义上的重型机甲——为基础，由卡利亚玛内部一个秘密黑工部门打造，用于测试武器部门研发的新型巨型激光武器——Mauler激光炮。

column1: ComStar selected the Battle Cobra as the focus of their efforts to reverse-engineer and develop their own OmniMech after obtaining a large number of mostly operational units in the aftermath of a brutal conflict in the Devil's Bath during the Battle of Tukayyid.
column2: 在图卡伊德战役中经历恶战、并于魔鬼之浴冲突后获得大量基本可运作的单位，ComStar便选定战斗眼镜蛇作为逆向工程并研发自有Omni机甲的重点。

column1: A lack of Thor's Hammers during the FedCom Civil War forced engineers to come up with a field modification that could be useful without the Heavy Gauss Rifles. The solution was to replace them with paired standard Gauss Rifles, ER Medium Lasers, and an ER Large Laser.
column2: 联邦内战期间缺乏“雷神之锤”，迫使工程师设计一种不依赖重型高斯步枪也能发挥作用的战地改装方案。最终他们以成对的标准高斯步枪、ER中型激光和ER大型激光替换了原武器。

column1: This one's a hit and run specialist, built the same year MASC hit production and put it to full use. Davion snapped it up after the SLDF passed on it, ran it almost exclusively through the AFFS. Factory on Errai got destroyed in 2835, numbers dried up fast after that.
column2: 这台机甲是专精突袭和撤离的专家，恰好在MASC投入生产的同一年建成，并将其充分运用。SLDF放弃后，戴维翁立刻接收了它，几乎全部交由AFFS使用。埃莱的工厂于2835年被摧毁，此后产量迅速枯竭。

column1: The Marksman Main Battle Tank is a beast of a unit that boasts an impressive amount of armor, and I have no idea how the engineers managed to fit that many weapons in the turret. Boss, this thing should be sufficient to give even assault 'MechWarriors a moment of pause.
column2: 马克斯曼主战坦克是一头披挂惊人装甲的猛兽，我真想不通工程师是怎么把那么多武器塞进炮塔的。老板，这东西足以让任何突击机甲战士都稍微掂量一番。

column1: A true one trick pony boss, built by Davion around the brand new Ultra Autocannon-5 just a year after the Hegemony debuted it. All in on firepower, nothing held back for backup. Ammo and parts dried up fast once the Second Succession War hit, largely forgotten by the Third.
column2: 老板，这是真正的单一绝活型机甲：戴维翁在霸主合众国首次展示全新Ultra AC/5后的第二年，围绕这门武器打造了它。它把全部筹码都押在火力上，完全没为备用方案留余地。第二次继承战争爆发后，弹药和零件很快耗尽，到了第三次继承战争时几乎已被遗忘。

column1: The Nightsky is the succesor to the Hatchetman and Axeman developed by Defiance Industries. As with its predecessors, the centerpiece of the Nightsky is a massive four-ton hatchet that is built into its right arm, which allows the 'Mech to cut through another 'Mech's armor.
column2: 夜空是Defiance工业公司研发的战斧和斧头的后继型号。和前代一样，夜空的核心是一把装在右臂上的巨型四吨战斧，足以劈开另一台机甲的装甲。

column1: This one's a testbed, built by House Liao just a year after the ER PPC debuted to see how it'd perform. Simple design, no frills beyond the cannons and the heat sinks needed to run them. Project got canned inside a decade, most parts scavenged before the Amaris war even started.
column2: 这是一台测试平台，由廖氏家族在ER PPC问世仅一年后制造，用来观察其性能。设计简单直接，除了火炮和维持运转所需的散热器外没有多余配置。项目在十年内便被取消，大多数部件甚至在阿玛瑞斯战争开始前就已被拆走。

column1: The Void is a battle armor design that is produced by the Draconis Combine. The Void is protected by stealth armor and is a fairly mobile jump-capable battle armor. Many Nova Cats found the original  PPC too bulky, so they swapped it out with their version of the Magshot Gauss Rifle.
column2: 虚空是一种由龙马联盟生产的战斗装甲。它装有隐形装甲，机动性不错，并具备跳跃能力。许多新星猫认为原配PPC过于笨重，于是换成了他们自有型号的Magshot高斯步枪。

column1: This one's a scout boss, twenty tons, built when the Hegemony wanted eyes forward instead of guns blazing. Speed and that Guardian ECM were the whole point, not brawling. Factory got bombed early in the Succession Wars, so surviving units are scarce and the tech's mostly a memory now.
column2: 老板，这是一台二十吨级侦察机甲，霸主合众国当年需要的是向前探路的眼睛，而不是猛轰的火炮。速度和Guardian ECM才是它存在的意义，根本不是为了缠斗。继承战争初期，工厂遭到轰炸，幸存单位寥寥无几，这项技术如今也大多只存在于记忆中了。

column1: One expensive experiment, this one. They tried to make a scout out of a 70 ton frame long before the Charger proved it could be done cheaper. That XL engine alone cost a fortune. Production got shelved once the Charger showed up, though one survived as a museum piece for centuries after.
column2: 这是一次昂贵的实验。他们早在Charger证明低成本方案可行之前，就试图用七十吨级底盘造出侦察机甲。仅那台XL引擎就价值不菲。Charger出现后，生产被搁置，但仍有一台作为博物馆藏品存活了数百年。

column1: This Urbie is primitive repurposing at its best, but it works. A salvaged wreck of an Urbie, this has been dragged off of the battlefield and crudely repaired with parts taken from industrial mechs and ancient weapons. Little more than a mobile turret, it looks and sounds scarier than it is.
column2: 这台UrbanMech体现了原始改造的极致，但确实能用。它是一台从战场拖回来的UrbanMech残骸，用工业机甲零件和古老武器粗略修复而成。它几乎只是座移动炮塔，看起来和听起来都比实际更吓人。

column1: This one's a Periphery success story, built jointly with the Hegemony for the Magistracy and the SLDF's 17th Army. Big guns but thin ammo reserves, that was always its weakness. Sabotaged shipments during the Periphery Uprising led to swift retaliation, and the production lines never recovered.
column2: 这是边疆的一段成功故事：它由边疆与霸主合众国联合为坎诺普斯治安官和SLDF第17军打造。火力强大但弹药储备不足，一直是它的弱点。边疆起义期间，遭到破坏的运输导致迅速报复，生产线此后再也没有恢复。

column1: The Fennec is a medium BattleMech that was produced for the Federated Suns beginning in the early 3080s, conceived to help address the AFFS' need for lighter lance command 'Mechs. Corean Enterprises used components from the Legionnaire to help put the design into production at its plant on Augusta.
column2: Fennec是一款中型战斗机甲，3080年代初开始为联邦太阳生产，旨在满足AFFS对更轻型枪骑兵指挥机甲的需求。Corean企业利用Legionnaire的部件，在奥古斯塔的工厂帮助将其投入生产。

column1: A Star League era artillery platform, the Arrowhead packed two Arrow IV launchers into an 80 ton frame right when the Hegemony started fielding the tech. Barely armed for close quarters, it needed an escort to stay safe. Although very rare after the Succession Wars, it likely inspired the Naga later on.
column2: 箭头是星盟时代的火炮平台，在霸主合众国刚开始部署这项技术时，便将两具Arrow IV发射器装进了八十吨底盘。它近距离武装几乎等于没有，必须依靠护卫才能安全作战。继承战争后它已极为罕见，但很可能启发了后来的Naga。

column1: The Parash is a light BattleMech developed and produced by Clan Hell's Horses. To meet the need for new light BattleMechs, the Parash was designed not for the role of scout, but for supporting its combat vehicle formations, and was influenced by the success of the Pack Hunter and the ancient SLDF Hussar.
column2: Parash是地狱之马氏族研发并生产的轻型战斗机甲。为满足新型轻型机甲的需求，Parash并非按侦察角色设计，而是用于支援其战斗车辆编队；它的设计受到Pack Hunter的成功和古老的SLDF Hussar影响。

column1: The Hunchback's a fifty-ton brawler built around one brutal shoulder mount. Thick frontal armor, simple systems, and a squat profile make it perfect for street fights and tight terrain. Treat its right torso like a magazine, protect and feed it, and it'll delete anything that gets careless up close in our paychecks.
column2: Hunchback是一台围绕凶猛肩部武器座打造的五十吨近战机甲。厚重的正面装甲、简单的系统和低矮外形，使它非常适合街巷战与狭窄地形。把它的右侧躯干当作弹匣，保护好并及时补给，它就能干掉任何近距离粗心大意、威胁我们饭碗的家伙。

column1: Luthien Armor Works was working on an upgrade of the Mongoose for ComStar to be a faster and tougher scout 'Mech, when the chaos on Luthien during the early years of the Jihad forced them to look elsewhere. The result is the Mongoose II, an effective hunter-killer that is able to find hidden enemies and provide long range fire support.
column2: 路台装甲工厂原本正为ComStar改进Mongoose，目标是打造更快、更坚固的侦察机甲，但圣战初期路台的混乱迫使他们另寻出路。最终诞生的Mongoose II是一台高效的猎杀者，能够发现隐藏敌人并提供远程火力支援。

column1: The Flawless might just look like an upscaled 130 ton Awesome, but under the surface there are some huge changes under the skin. In fact, a huge Ion Cannon prototype has been embedded in the 'Mechs chassis. In theory nothing more than an oversized PPC, this cannon is able to impair and shutdown the electronics of most BattleMechs with a single shot.
column2: Flawless乍看只是放大的130吨级Awesome，但其内部其实进行了巨大的改造。事实上，一门巨型离子炮原型被嵌入了机甲底盘。理论上它不过是超大号PPC，但一发就能削弱并关闭大多数战斗机甲的电子设备。

column1: The Angerona Scout Suit was developed by StarCorp Industries on Terra. The suit was designed for the needs of the newly formed Republic of the Sphere's Armed Forces, with the lessons learned from Stone's Coalition during the Jihad in mind. It utilizes its stealth capacities and quick movement to scout ahead of friendly forces without being detected.
column2: Angerona侦察服由StarCorp工业公司在泰拉研发。它是为新成立的星球共和国武装部队设计的，并吸取了圣战期间Stone联盟的经验。该装备利用隐身能力和快速机动，在不被发现的情况下先于友军侦察前方。

column1: Ninety tons of pure velocity, this 'Mech proved Streak SRMs work in bulk while pushing MASC and a supercharger further than any assault chassis had gone before. Sure it cost over 32 million to build, but speed like that doesn't come cheap. Even the Amaris war couldn't kill its reputation, only the bombers who took out the factory in 2766 managed that.
column2: 九十吨的纯粹速度，这台机甲证明了大量装备Streak SRM是可行的，同时让MASC和增压器的性能超越了此前所有突击底盘。当然，造价超过三千二百万，毕竟这样的速度从来不便宜。连阿玛瑞斯战争都没能摧毁它的声誉，直到2766年轰炸机摧毁工厂后，这一切才告终。

column1: First appearing as an ad hoc and incomplete design during the last days of the Word of Blake's defense of Terra, the Gallant was a broken-terrain cavalry BattleMech. After the Word of Blake's fall, the Republic of the Sphere refined and continued to manufacture the BattleMech, while also providing its schematics to the Lyran Commonwealth and Federated Suns.
column2: 加兰特最初于Blake教保卫泰拉的最后几天以临时且未完成的设计首次出现，是一台适合崎岖地形的骑兵战斗机甲。Blake教覆灭后，星球共和国对其进行完善并继续生产，同时将设计图提供给莱拉联邦和联邦太阳。

column1: Developed by the Scorpion Empire, the OmniMech version of the Snow Fox borrows much of its initial design of the its older brother, the standard Snow Fox. Protected by four tons of armor, an Endo Steel chassis and XL engine allow the 'Mech to reach top speeds of 120 km/h. Finally a permanently-mounted MASC system allows the Prime to sprint at speeds of up to 164 km/h.
column2: 雪狐Omni机甲版由蝎子帝国研发，初始设计大量借鉴了其前身标准型雪狐。四吨装甲、Endo钢骨架和XL引擎让它最高时速达到120公里。最后，永久安装的MASC系统使Prime型冲刺时速可达164公里。

column1: Designed by Independence Weaponry and Kurita engineers together, the Marauder III is the natural progression of the Marauder line of 'Mechs. At 110 tons it allows more weapons to be added, yet doesn't move too far into the very fast increasing cost of Superheavy 'Mechs. The general idea of the design remains, stick a bunch of large weapons on it and worry about cooling later.
column2: 掠夺者III由独立武器公司与Kurita工程师共同设计，是掠夺者系列的自然演进。它重达110吨，可以加装更多武器，却没有跨入超级重型机甲飞速攀升的成本区间。设计理念依旧不变：先把一堆大型武器装上去，散热问题以后再说。

column1: Originally developed by the defunct Marik-Stewart Commonwealth to produce a local Assault BattleMech, the Juliano would go on to serve in the ranks of the newly re-formed Free Worlds League. Produced on Angell II at Irian's Mech production facilities during the mid thirty-second century, this Assault BattleMech was named after the league's first Captain-General, Juliano Marik.
column2: Juliano最初由已经解体的Marik-Stewart联邦研发，用于生产本地突击战斗机甲，后来加入了新近重组的自由世界联盟。它在32世纪中叶于Angell II的Irian机甲工厂生产，这款突击机甲以联盟首任大公Juliano Marik命名。

column1: After Defiance Industries finished constructing their Goliath production line on Hesperus, they went on to create a superheavy version of the Goliath, code named Black Rose. The 125 ton QuadMech focused on long-range indirect fire and high damage alpha strikes, utilizing the sturdy platform of the Quad chassis to mount weapons that could otherwise have compromised its stability.
column2: Defiance工业公司在赫斯珀洛斯建成Goliath生产线后，继续打造其超级重型版本，代号“黑玫瑰”。这台125吨四足机甲专注于远程间接火力和高伤害全弹齐射，利用四足底盘的稳固平台安装原本可能破坏稳定性的武器。

column1: The Dola is designed as a defensive unit, capable of arriving at a combat site quickly and finishing off an enemy just as quickly. Its impressive speed and maneuverability help it take on larger 'Mechs. The Dola uses several experimental systems to increase its effectiveness: six tons of light ferro-fibrous armor protect a composite internal structure, an XL gyro, and an XL engine.
column2: Dola被设计为防御单位，能够迅速抵达战区，也能同样迅速地解决敌人。出色的速度和机动性帮助它对抗更大型机甲。Dola采用多套实验系统提升效能：六吨轻型铁素体装甲保护复合结构、XL陀螺仪和XL引擎。

column1: The Dragoon was conceived as a heavier, more versatile battlesuit for Wolf’s Dragoons’ Seventh Kommando. The Dragoon offers more protection and flexibility than common infiltration suits. This suit was originally designed to give combat engineers a degree of battlefield protection for high-risk intrusion operations, and to incorporate the ease of movement found in much lighter suits.
column2: Dragoon是为狼之龙第七突击队构想的更重、更灵活战斗装甲。相比常见渗透服，Dragoon提供了更强防护和更高适应性。它最初旨在为战斗工程师的高风险渗透行动提供一定战场保护，同时融入轻型战斗服所具备的行动便利。

column1: The Warlock is a recent 110 ton Inner Sphere design which utilizes a combination of advanced technology originating from the infamous R.I.S.C. laboratories and Clan level tech. The 'Mech has been adopted by all the great houses to some degree, and is generally used as controlling force on the battlefield. Although not heavily armed they should never be underestimated for their alpha strike potential.
column2: Warlock是近期推出的110吨级内太阳圈设计，采用了源自臭名昭著的R.I.S.C.实验室与氏族级科技的先进技术组合。这款机甲已在各大势力中得到不同程度的采用，通常被用作战场上的控制力量。虽然武装并不厚重，但绝不能低估它的首轮齐射潜力。

column1: Introduced in 3078, the controversial and quirky Mangonel was a Clan Wolf-in-Exile heavy cavalry BattleMech built using Inner Sphere rather than Clan technology. Facing increasing shortages of Clan-grade matériel during the Jihad, Khan Phelan Kell sponsored several programs to develop Inner Sphere equipment to pad out his forces, the Mangonel being one of the most visible outcomes of these initiatives.
column2: Mangonel于3078年推出，是一款颇具争议且风格古怪的氏族狼族流亡者重型骑兵战斗机甲，采用内太阳圈技术而非氏族科技建造。圣战期间氏族级物资日益短缺，Khan Phelan Kell发起了数项开发内太阳圈装备的计划，以充实自己的部队；Mangonel便是这些计划最引人注目的成果之一。

column1: The Prey Seeker, manufactured by Achernar BattleMechs on Cahokia, was designed to be a high-speed scout and raider; while the Prey Seeker's mission profile speaks to MechWarriors who feel marginalized by the growth of combined-arms warfare, the unusual construction of the arms and the phenomenal speeds the 'Mech can reach echo the Dasher OmniMech first seen in the Inner Sphere during the Clan Invasion.
column2: Prey Seeker由Cahokia的Achernar BattleMechs制造，设计目标是高速侦察与袭扰；它的任务定位吸引了那些因合成兵种战争兴起而感到边缘化的机甲战士，而其独特的手臂结构和惊人的极速，则让人想起氏族入侵期间首次出现在内太阳圈的Dasher OmniMech。

column1: Taurus Territorial Industries built this one to prove the Concordat could still produce real BattleMechs, and it does the job. Nothing fancy, just a fast light mech that gets in your face and unloads everything at once. Raiders used to underestimate it constantly, which worked out well for whoever was piloting one. It is not going to win a slugging match against anything heavy, but it was never supposed to.
column2: Taurus Territorial Industries制造这台机甲，是为了证明Taurian Concordat仍能生产真正的战斗机甲，而它确实完成了任务。没有花哨设计，只是一台能快速冲到敌人面前并一次性倾泻全部火力的轻型机甲。袭击者过去总是不断低估它，这对驾驶它的人来说反而是好事。它不可能在与重型单位的硬碰硬中取胜，但它本来就不是为此而生。

column1: Inspired by the success of the Clan Hell's Horses' Black Hawk design, Clan Diamond Shark developed what is in essence a simplified, non-Omni version of the older Mist Lynx OmniMech. Primarily for sale to Inner Sphere customers, the Hell's Horses marketing ploy of adopting a familiar designation the 'Mech was dubbed the Koshi, a decision that did not sit well with many of the more conservative members of the Clan.
column2: 受到氏族地狱之马族Black Hawk设计成功的启发，氏族Diamond Shark开发了这款本质上是旧式Mist Lynx OmniMech简化版、且取消Omni结构的机甲。该机主要面向内太阳圈客户销售；地狱之马族采用熟悉型号作为营销手段，将这台机甲命名为Koshi，但氏族中许多保守派对此并不满意。

column1: The Siorc Wolf, Clan Sea Fox’s latest Assault-class BattleMech, is based on the Mad Cat MK II 4-6 and quickly became a bestseller. Weighing 100 tons, it combines surprising speed—up to 80+ kph via supercharger—with an endo-composite skeleton maximizing weapon space. Manufactured primarily on Tukayyid, it’s widely available across multiple factions, including Clan Sea Fox, Federated Suns, and Wolf Empire, with other factions showing varied interest.
column2: Siorc Wolf是氏族海狐最新的突击级战斗机甲，基于Mad Cat MK II 4-6开发，并迅速成为畅销产品。它重达100吨，却能通过增压器达到80公里/小时以上的惊人速度；其内骨骼复合结构最大限度地扩大了武器空间。该机主要在Tukayyid生产，如今已广泛供应给多个派系，包括氏族海狐、联邦太阳与狼帝国，其他派系也表现出不同程度的兴趣。

column1: Designed by the Marian Hegemony using the most cutting-edge gear available to them. The Marian Hegemony soon began marketing the suit for sale to the open market to help bolster the Hegemony's coffers. The Marians deploy them in squads of five called a contubernium and the suits are designed for that kind of larger deployment. While not particularly well armed, the Ravager has extensive armor coverage, making them extremely durable on the battlefield.
column2: 这款战斗装甲由Marian Hegemony采用其能获得的最尖端装备设计而成。Marian Hegemony很快开始将其推向公开市场销售，以充实国库。Marians以五人为一组部署这种装甲，称为contubernium；装甲本身也专为这种大规模部署而设计。虽然武装不算特别强大，Ravager拥有大面积装甲覆盖，使其在战场上极为耐用。

column1: The Hammerhead is a medium-sized Clan BattleMech designed as a skirmisher by Clan Sea Fox. Designed to loosely resemble a hammerhead shark, the design is intended to be aggressive with its opponents, yet also built around the concept of never getting knocked off its feet. Despite its merely adequate weapons array, the Hammerhead has achieved great success as a shock trooper wading though enemy formations to brawl with opponents twice its size at close range.
column2: Hammerhead是氏族海狐设计的一款中型氏族战斗机甲，定位为突击者。它的外形大致模仿双髻鲨，设计意图是对敌人保持攻击性，同时贯彻绝不被击倒的理念。尽管武器配置仅属够用，Hammerhead仍作为突击部队取得了巨大成功，能够穿过敌方编队，在近距离与体型两倍于己的对手缠斗。

column1: The Rabid Coyote was designed by scientists from Clan Coyote to be a complement to other, slower BattleMechs. First deployed in 3066, the 'Mech was deployed in an effort to stave off the slow decline of the previous decades that had befallen the Clan that created the OmniMech. Curiously, as the 'Mech is intended to be a bodyguard for larger 'Mechs like the Savage Coyote, front-line warriors spurn the design because they do not wish to be seen merely as "support".
column2: Rabid Coyote由氏族Coyote的科学家设计，用来补充其他速度较慢的战斗机甲。该机甲于3066年首次部署，旨在遏制过去几十年间困扰其创造者氏族的缓慢衰落。有趣的是，由于它被设计成保护Savage Coyote等大型机甲的护卫，前线战士反而鄙弃这一设计，因为他们不愿被人仅仅视为“支援”。

column1: Almost 300 years after its original creation, the Viper was reborn in the Republic era. But not because of demand for a forgotten unit, but because a stockpile of blazers was discovered in a Kallon warehouse in 3123. Kallon engineers were then developing a new 'Mech for the RAF.
