They, like their predecessors, realized that the Viper was ideal for the surplus weapons. Viper schematics survived in their database, and existing Crusader tooling could be readily adapted.
column2: 距离最初诞生近300年后，Viper在共和国时代重获新生。但这并非因为有人需要一支被遗忘的部队，而是因为3123年有人在Kallon仓库发现了一批blazer武器。Kallon工程师当时正在为共和国空军开发一款新机甲；他们和前辈一样意识到，Viper非常适合使用这些剩余武器。Viper的设计图仍保存在数据库中，现有的Crusader生产工装也很容易改造。

column1: The Rokurokubi is a light BattleMech built for the armed forces of the Draconis Combine and was styled after ancient Japanese bushido armor. Designed to be a light strike 'Mech, the Rokurokubi uses its speed and robust armor to close with an enemy unit while employing its singular ranged weapon until it can bring its sword to bear. The 'Mech was popular among the young samurai of House Kurita, who used it for honor duels between warriors in addition to regular combat.
column2: Rokurokubi是一款为龙蛇合众国武装部队建造的轻型战斗机甲，外形仿照古代日本武士铠甲。作为轻型突击机甲，Rokurokubi利用速度和坚固装甲接近敌方单位，同时使用唯一的远程武器，直到能够挥剑攻击为止。这款机甲深受Kurita家族年轻武士的欢迎，他们除了用于常规战斗外，还用它进行武士间的荣誉决斗。

column1: Named after the shield that was the primary means of defense for the Scottish Highlanders of Terra, the Targe is a lackluster recon and cavalry design born of compromise. To achieve enough movement speed to fullfill its role the 'Mech uses an engine large enough that it uses up nearly half the 'Mech's weight. The use of Heavy Ferro-Fibrous armor maximized the five tons available for armor coverage, while ten Double Heat Sinks could easily cope with the design's heat output.
column2: Targe以Terra苏格兰高地人用于防御的主要盾牌命名，是一款因妥协而诞生、表现平庸的侦察与骑兵机甲。为获得足够的移动速度来履行职责，这款机甲采用了尺寸足够大的引擎，几乎占用了机体一半的重量。重型铁磁纤维装甲最大限度利用了可用于装甲覆盖的五吨重量，而十组双重散热器足以轻松应对该设计的热量输出。

column1: A quadrupedal scout 'Mech featuring a number of advanced Clan technological features, the Jaguar proved to be a success, spreading quickly amongst the various mercenary units working for the Lyran Commonwealth. Capable of deploying in a variety of roles including mobile fire support, reconnaissance and search-and-destroy missions, the Jaguar was powered by a Light Force 280 extra-light fusion engine that could propel it at speeds of almost a hundred and thirty kilometers per hour.
column2: Jaguar是一款四足侦察机甲，配备多项先进氏族科技，事实证明大获成功，并迅速在为莱拉联邦效力的各支雇佣兵部队中流行开来。Jaguar能够执行多种任务，包括机动火力支援、侦察以及搜索歼灭任务；其动力来自Light Force 280超轻型聚变引擎，可将机体推进至接近每小时130公里的速度。

column1: The closest thing the Demon Series of battle armor has to a standard, front-line model, the Asura is a medium-weight design. Compared to the Clan Elemental the Asura is not as well armored, although its 280kg of advanced armor can withstand a hit from a Clan ER Medium Laser. The Asura does not have any enhancements to a standard trooper's ground speed but carries jump jets to leap ninety meters at a time, matching the Elemental in terms of speed, and its weaponry has a longer reach.
column2: Asura是Demon系列战斗装甲中最接近标准前线型号的产品，属于中型设计。与氏族Elemental相比，Asura装甲较薄，不过其280公斤先进装甲足以承受氏族ER中型激光的一击。Asura没有提升标准步兵的地面速度，但配备跳跃喷口，一次可跃过90米，在速度上与Elemental相当，而且其武器射程更远。

column1: The Kodiak II was built upon what Clan Ghost Bear learned and liked with the original Kodiak. The Kodiak II quickly became known for its Command facilities and its endurance. The powerful 'Mech carries 19 tons of Standard armor, giving it heavy resistance against weapons fire directed at it. At the heart of the machine is a 400-rated Extra-Light Fusion Engine, which while not as quick as other designs its weight saving qualities allows the 'Mech to carry is substantial weapons load out.
column2: Kodiak II建立在氏族幽灵熊从原版Kodiak中学到并认可的技术之上。Kodiak II很快因其指挥设施和续航能力而闻名。这台强大的机甲搭载19吨标准装甲，对射向自身的武器火力具有极强抵抗力。机体核心是一台400级超轻型聚变引擎，虽然速度不及其他同级设计，但节省的重量让它能够携带相当可观的武器装载。

column1: A second-line Clan 'Mech feared by many Inner Sphere pilots, the Supernova seems to be an advanced version of the Black Hawk, though it was actually developed before that venerable OmniMech. Plans to replace the King Crab's loadout with clusters of Large Lasers grew from a shortage of autocannon ammunition. The first prototypes met with little success due to the King Crab's integral Ferro-fibrous armor, but gave rise to a lighter and leaner new design which eventually became the Supernova.
column2: Supernova是一款令许多内太阳圈飞行员畏惧的氏族二线机甲，看起来像是Black Hawk的先进版本，尽管它实际上早于那款久负盛名的OmniMech开发。由于自动火炮弹药短缺，人们最初计划用成组的大型激光替换King Crab的武器配置。首批原型机因King Crab一体式铁磁纤维装甲而收效甚微，但最终催生出一种更轻、更精简的新设计，并最终发展为Supernova。

column1: Entering production in 2519 the FLE-14 Flea was an attempt to create an ultra-light BattleMech. Weighing a mere fifteen tons, it could arguably be regarded as a different 'Mech design than the true Flea. It was capable of a maximum ground speed of nearly 150 km/h with a 120 meter jump capability. Its weapons and armor however were very light: Only one ton of armor protected the unit, and the single Medium Laser mounted in the right arm was barely enough to make it a viable battlefield unit.
column2: FLE-14 Flea于2519年投产，是制造超轻型战斗机甲的一次尝试。它仅重15吨，可以说与真正的Flea属于不同的机甲设计。该机凭借120米跳跃能力，地面最高速度接近每小时150公里。然而，它的武器和装甲都极为轻薄：整台机体只有一吨装甲防护，右臂搭载的单门中型激光也勉强够让它成为可用的战场单位。

column1: The Tiburon is a name that hearkens back to when Clan Sea Fox was known as Clan Diamond Shark. The Tiburon is named after a large Terran shark found in the Caribbean, the design was created as the Clan transformed itself from a decimated-yet-centralized military force to a nomadic, spacefaring society of warrior-merchants. The Tiburon is just as lethal as its namesake and unlike most other 'Mechs built by the Sea Foxes, the Tiburon is not for sale and is used exclusively by its own warriors.
column2: Tiburon这个名字让人回想起氏族海狐尚被称为氏族Diamond Shark的时代。Tiburon以加勒比海发现的一种大型地球鲨鱼命名；该设计诞生于氏族从遭受重创但仍高度集中的军事力量，转变为游牧太空战士商人社会的时期。Tiburon和它的命名对象一样致命；与海狐制造的大多数其他机甲不同，Tiburon不对外销售，只供本族战士使用。

column1: The Se'irim is a battle armor design in the Word of Blake's Demon Series, named for the satyr-like beings from Hebrew folklore. Used only in significant numbers by the elite Manei Domini, the Se'irim is the stealthy complement to the Asura. Where the latter serves as a main battlesuit the former specializes in ambush tactics. It carries 330kg of stealth armor, enough to stop a Medium Pulse Laser, which it uses along with its incredible ground speed get into cover and wait for the enemy's approach.
column2: Se'irim是Blake之言Demon系列中的一款战斗装甲，以希伯来民间传说中类似羊人的生物命名。Se'irim只有精英Manei Domini大规模使用，是Asura的隐秘搭档。后者充当主力战斗服，前者则专精伏击战术。它携带330公斤隐形装甲，足以抵挡中型脉冲激光；同时凭借惊人的地面速度进入掩体，等待敌人接近。

column1: The Deimos was developed by the Snow Raven Clan and the Mech was first introduced during the middle of the 3060s, allegedly on the Kerensky Cluster world of Lum. However, Inner Sphere intelligence agencies stopped hearing rumors about the 'Mech during the Jihad and it faded from memory. In 3085, the Snow Ravens revealed the existence of the Deimos to the Inner Sphere. It is considered as the pride of the Clan making at least one assigned to every touman. The prime variant was designed for anti-air role and fire support.
column2: Deimos由雪鸦氏族开发，据称于3060年代中期首次在Kerensky星簇的Lum星球亮相。然而，内太阳圈情报机构在圣战期间不再听到有关这款机甲的传闻，它逐渐被人遗忘。3085年，雪鸦向内太阳圈公布了Deimos的存在。它被视为该氏族的骄傲，每个touman至少都会配备一台。其基础型号专为反空和火力支援任务设计。

column1: The Victor XR was a project by the Republic Institute of Strategic Combat to supersize a Victor and use it as a platform for the newly developed Micro Missile System, their replacement for the MRM. A number of variants were developed, some even including stealth or huge ballistic weapons, but all were based around the same 445 Ultralight engine and compact Gyro. Overall the project was deemed a failure, just like the MMS itself, but enough of the 'Mechs were produced that they can still be found throughout the Inner Sphere.
column2: Victor XR是共和国战略战斗研究所的一项计划，目标是放大Victor机体，并将其作为新开发的微型导弹系统平台，以取代MRM。项目开发了多个变体，其中甚至包括隐形型号和巨型弹道武器型号，但所有变体都基于同一台445级超轻型引擎和紧凑型陀螺仪。总体而言，该项目被判定为失败，就像MMS系统本身一样；但生产出的机甲数量足够多，至今仍能在内太阳圈各处找到。

column1: Sometimes called the "Flea's Flea," the Ostrichmech was a desperate attempt by OstCorp to compete with Earthwerks' FLE-14. Rushed into development using the cheapest available parts, the design was clearly derivative and lacked refinement. Its unveiling drew ridicule, most famously when an Earthwerks sales representative responded by quoting Swift: “Big fleas have little fleas, upon their backs to bite 'em, and little fleas have lesser fleas, and so, ad infinitum,” highlighting its place at the bottom of the design hierarchy.
column2: Ostrichmech有时被称为“Flea的跳蚤”，是OstCorp为与Earthwerks的FLE-14竞争而进行的孤注一掷尝试。它使用能找到的最廉价零件仓促开发，设计明显带有仿制痕迹，缺乏精雕细琢。该机亮相时遭到嘲笑，其中最著名的一幕是Earthwerks销售代表引用Swift的话回应：“大跳蚤背上有小跳蚤叮咬，小跳蚤背上还有更小的跳蚤，如此无穷无尽。”这番话凸显了它在设计层级中垫底的位置。

column1: Designed to work with the lightweight Wolfhound BattleMech, the Verfolger (German for 'Pursuer') and Wolfhound together are capable of taking out much larger BattleMechs. The Verfolger is built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a 325 XL engine that sacrifices durability for lighter weight and propels the 'Mech to a top speed of 86.4 km/h. The 'Mech uses its saved weight to carry an impressive twelve and a half tons of armor that allows the Verfolger to stand up to fire from most enemy units that it would encounter.
column2: Verfolger（德语意为“追击者”）与轻型Wolfhound战斗机甲协同作战，足以摧毁大得多的战斗机甲。Verfolger采用轻量化内骨钢底盘，搭载325级XL引擎，以较低耐久性换取更轻重量，并将机甲推进至每小时86.4公里的最高速度。它利用节省下来的重量携带了惊人的12.5吨装甲，使Verfolger能够承受所遇大多数敌方单位的火力。

column1: The Taipan is a Word of Blake quad design that came out of the Jihad-era Martinson Armaments plant on Terra, built in limited numbers before the Republic of the Sphere shut down production and the design effectively went extinct before 3090. Quadrupedal light mechs are already a niche category, and the MASC system pushing this one past 150 kph makes it genuinely difficult to engage before it has already fired and repositioned. Most of what survived ended up in museums, which makes finding a working example in the field a notable event.
column2: Taipan是Blake之言的一款四足设计，出自圣战时期Terra上的Martinson Armaments工厂；共和国关闭生产后，该机仅制造了少量，并在3090年前实际上绝迹。四足轻型机甲本就属于小众类别，而MASC系统将其速度推过每小时150公里，使它在开火并重新部署之前极难被拦截。幸存的大部分机体最终都进入博物馆，因此在战场上发现一台仍能运作的样机，会成为值得关注的事件。

column1: The Ironhold Assault Battle Armor was developed by Clan Jade Falcon during the Jihad. The roots of the Ironhold go back to development of the Anti-Personnel Gauss Rifle in 3069. After the success of that weapon, a new project codenamed Project Ferrum was started to develop a new suit of battle armor with the support of the Elemental Trinary of 3rd Falcon Talon Cluster. The Ironhold is noted for being more mobile than typical Clan Assault Armor, where it can employ its Jump Jets and give itself better tactical advantage over its opponents.
column2: Ironhold突击战斗装甲由氏族玉蟒鹰在圣战期间开发。Ironhold的根源可追溯至3069年反人员高斯步枪的研制。该武器成功后，一个代号为Ferrum计划的新项目启动，在第3猎鹰爪集群Elemental三元组的支持下开发新型战斗装甲。Ironhold以比典型氏族突击装甲更高的机动性著称，它能够使用跳跃喷口，在战术上获得相对于对手的更大优势。

column1: Designed in secret by a renegade faction within ComStar is the Kheper is a front line Medium Class BattleMech design intended to be a staple a unit within the secretly resurrected 1st Division of the Com Guard. In the aftermath of the Com Guards' destruction, the Kheper's simple construction and ease of maintenance qualities met with the needs of rebuilding the RAF. After the conflict, the New Earth-based manufacturing center would be seized by Republican forces and the production output would pour into the ranks of the Republic of the Sphere.
column2: Kheper由ComStar内部一个叛变派系秘密设计，是一款前线中型战斗机甲，原计划成为秘密复活的Com Guard第1师的主力单位。Com Guard覆灭后，Kheper结构简单、易于维护的特点满足了重建共和国空军的需求。冲突结束后，位于New Earth的制造中心被共和派部队接管，产出的机甲将源源不断编入共和国星际联邦的队伍。

column1: The Sarath was the former Free Worlds League first OmniMech. The 'Mech was named for the assumed guise of the mystic Hindu god Krishna. One of the 'Mech's most distinguishing traits was that it was constructed using a combination of advanced Inner Sphere and Clan technologies. The Sarath was constructed as an OmniMech, one of its distinguishing features being that 15 of its 19 tons of pod capacity were placed in the BattleMech turret. The 'Mech also had been designed to have enhanced movement and strength, in comparison to other similar designs.
column2: Sarath是自由世界联盟的第一款OmniMech。它以神秘的印度教神祇Krishna所采取的化身命名。这款机甲最显著的特征之一，是结合了先进的内太阳圈与氏族科技。Sarath以OmniMech形式建造，其特点之一是19吨挂舱容量中有15吨被置于战斗机甲炮塔内。与其他类似设计相比，这款机甲还针对更强的机动性与力量进行了设计。

column1: The Expunger is a 185 ton strike superheavy designed and fielded by Clan Wolverine. Any enemy is wise to never turn its back on an Expunger, as it is often used to bring their latest experimental weapons to the front - especially the Compact PPC. The Compact PPC is one of Clan Wolverine's most secret weapons, developed in parallel to the general Clan improvements of original Star League PPC technology. As a final touch, the torso mounted cockpit of the Expunger ensures the safety of the pilot, allowing the 'Mech's head to be fully utilized for Compact PPCs.
column2: Expunger是由氏族Wolverine设计并投入使用的185吨突击型超重机甲。任何敌人都明白，绝不能把后背留给Expunger，因为它经常被用来将氏族最新的实验性武器送上前线，尤其是紧凑型PPC。紧凑型PPC是氏族Wolverine最机密的武器之一，与氏族对原始星盟PPC技术的整体改进同步开发。作为最后的点睛之笔，Expunger采用躯干安装式驾驶舱来确保驾驶员安全，使机甲头部能够完全用于安装紧凑型PPC。

column1: The Spirit Cats urgently needed to replace their aging Cauldron-Born "Ebon Jaguar" OmniMechs but couldn’t produce a new design themselves due to recent turmoil and losses. They turned to the Sea Fox Spina Khanate for help, who completed the designs and passed them to Adam Tech Industries for manufacturing. The resulting Tora - a well-rounded, standard mech - is not a direct replacement but offers solid speed, mobility, and firepower. Based on the Cave Lion design for ease of manufacture, the Tora features 150-meter jump jets and a supercharger enabling bursts up to 103 kph.
column2: Spirit Cats急需替换老旧的Cauldron-Born“Ebon Jaguar”OmniMech，但由于近期的动荡与损失，他们无法自行生产新设计。于是他们向海狐Spina汗国求助；后者完成设计后，将其交给Adam Tech Industries制造。最终诞生的Tora是一款均衡的标准机甲，并非直接替代品，却提供了扎实的速度、机动性与火力。Tora基于Cave Lion设计，便于制造；配备150米跳跃喷口和增压器，短时间内可爆发至每小时103公里。

column1: The Buraq is a Clan medium-weight Quad battle armor, which was designed by Clan Hell's Horses during the early thirty-second century. The horselike Buraq was named for the mystical steed from ancient times, and like its mystical namesake, the battle armor is noted for its high ground speed. Typically, Clan Hell's Horses have used full Stars consisting of different variants of the battle armor. These Buraq Stars work as a team in their appointed mission assignments. They've been utilized on the Horses' Periphery borders to help scout and pin down pirates terrorizing their worlds.
column2: Buraq是氏族中型四足战斗装甲，由氏族地狱之马族于32世纪初设计。这款外形似马的Buraq以远古时代的神秘坐骑命名；和它的神话原型一样，这种战斗装甲以极高的地面速度著称。通常情况下，氏族地狱之马族会使用由不同战斗装甲变体组成的完整星群。这些Buraq星群会在指定任务中协同作战。它们曾被部署在地狱之马族的边疆地带，用于侦察并钳制那些侵扰其世界的海盗。

column1: Built to operate in an counterinsurgency role, the Bloodhound is designed to engage enemy guerilla units. The Bloodhound is built on an Earthwerks PXH IV endo steel chassis that carries a lightweight Hermes 315 XL engine capable of pushing the Bloodhound up to speeds of 118.8 km/h. In addition to this speed, the Bloodhound is well armored for its mission, with nine and a half tons of Durallex Light armor with CASE to protect the 'Mech against complete destruction in the event of an ammunition explosion. The Bloodhound also carries a Beagle active probe which is capable of finding hidden enemy units.
column2: 该机甲专为反叛乱作战而设计，用于打击敌方游击队。血猎犬采用 Earthwerks PXH IV 内骨骼底盘，搭载轻型 Hermes 315 XL 发动机，最高速度可达 118.8 km/h。除了速度之外，血猎犬还为其任务配备了充足装甲：9.5 吨 Durallex Light 装甲，并配有 CASE，可在弹药爆炸时保护机甲免遭彻底摧毁。血猎犬还搭载 Beagle 主动探测器，能够发现隐藏的敌方单位。

column1: The Sobek, a direct descendant of Clan Wolf’s Gargoyle, blends high speed and heavy firepower in an assault 'Mech. Designed during the Jihad on Tamar to keep pace with faster units, it favors proven technology and heavy armor over cutting-edge systems, making it efficient and cost-effective to build and maintain. Unlike the Gargoyle’s arm-heavy weapon layout, the Sobek spreads its weapons more evenly, with primary weapons torso-mounted for better protection. With 24 tons of pod space, a hard-mounted MASC system, speeds over 100 kph, and 15.5 tons of armor, it outperforms its predecessor in both firepower and durability.
column2: 索贝克是对氏族狼族石像鬼的直接继承者，将高速与强大火力融于一体，成为一款突击机甲。它在圣战期间于塔玛尔设计，用于跟上更快的部队；相比尖端系统，它更偏好久经验证的技术和厚重装甲，因此建造与维护都高效且经济。不同于石像鬼偏重手臂的武器布局，索贝克将武器分布得更加均衡，并将主武器安装在躯干上，以获得更好的防护。凭借 24 吨吊舱空间、固定安装的 MASC 系统、超过 100 kph 的速度以及 15.5 吨装甲，它在火力和耐久性两方面都胜过前身。

column1: When the RISC laboratories developed the superheavy version of the Wraith Suppression Shield System, they wanted to see how it fared in actual combat at a larger scale before they re-geared to their own heavily over-utilized superheavy factories. Three of the Great Houses were persuaded to design a number of superheavy 'Mechs around the system, all three ending up with very similar looks due to the prototype stealth system requirements and pre-designed components supplied by the Republic. Unlike the other two houses, House Davion decided to fit the stealth system into a smaller 150 ton OmniMech chassis, the Night Bastion
column2: 当 RISC 实验室开发出幽灵抑制盾系统的超重型版本时，他们希望先在更大规模的实战中检验其表现，然后再改造自家那些超负荷运转的超重型工厂。三个大贵族家族被说服，围绕该系统设计了数种超重型机甲；由于原型隐形系统的要求以及共和国提供的预制组件，三者最终拥有非常相似的外形。与另外两家不同，戴维昂家族决定将隐形系统装入更小的 150 吨 Omni机甲底盘，这便是夜堡垒。

column1: The Amarok is a unique assault 'Mech among the Clan Wolf touman, intended as a close combat 'Mech. It was built and conceived under Ramiel Bekker's idea of combating the Death From Above (or DFA for short) tactics being employed by Clan Jade Falcon. However, lacking time he had to seek assistance from Clan Sea Fox as he did with the Stormwolf. It was during his time with Clan Sea Fox that he started to investigate the Hammerhead, a new Sea Fox 'Mech, and from that 'Mech he borrowed design choices that would later be a part of the Amarok. For example, the use of Hardened Armor for better protection and modified hand actuators for use in close combat.
column2: 阿玛洛克是氏族狼族军团中独特的突击机甲，专为近战而生。它的构想源于拉米尔·贝克尔对抗氏族玉色猎鹰所采用的空降攻击（简称 DFA）战术的设想。然而时间紧迫，他不得不寻求氏族海狐的帮助，就像设计风暴狼时那样。正是在氏族海狐期间，他开始研究海狐的新型机甲锤头鲨，并从中借鉴了后来用于阿玛洛克的设计选择，例如使用硬化装甲来增强防护，以及改造手部执行器以适应近战。

column1: The Arbalest was first used during the Word of Blake Jihad by Clan Nova Cat as they sought to improve their second-line forces. The Arbalest's long range firepower makes up for its relatively slow speed when compared to other clan 'Mechs of a similar size. To make production easier and faster, Clan Nova Cat engineers used less expensive components that were readily available in the Inner Sphere. Utilizing a standard engine, standard internal structure, and basic armor allowed the Nova Cats to produce the 'Mech in large numbers. The Arbalest is manufactured on the Nova Cat's enclave capital Irece in the Draconis Combine and can be found throughout the post-Jihad Inner Sphere.
column2: 弩炮最早在圣战期间由氏族新星猫使用，当时他们正寻求强化二线部队。与同规模的其他氏族机甲相比，弩炮的远程火力弥补了其相对缓慢的速度。为了让生产更容易、更迅速，氏族新星猫的工程师采用了内层空间随处可得的廉价部件。通过使用标准发动机、标准内部结构和基础装甲，新星猫得以大批量生产这种机甲。弩炮在德拉科尼斯联合体的新星猫飞地首都伊雷斯制造，如今在圣战后的内层空间各处都能找到。

column1: A Solaris VII BattleMech, the Volkh was originally designed by Vining Engineering and Salvage Team to serve as a testbed for advanced technology. VEST designers used an XXL Engine to provide enough weight savings to mount the heavy armor. To provide bursts of additional speed, they also fitted a Supercharger to the engine. This allows the Volkh to boost its speed to 97 km/h briefly. This is usually enough to close or evade an opponent. For survivability, the Volkh uses hardened armor and a Torso-Mounted Cockpit. MechWarriors who use the Volkh are more willing to get in close to an opponent, trusting that the heavy armor surrounding the cockpit will protect them from weapons fire.
column2: 作为一台 Solaris VII 战斗机甲，沃尔克最初由维宁工程与打捞队设计，用作先进技术的测试平台。VEST 设计师采用 XXL 发动机以节省足够重量，从而安装厚重装甲。为获得额外的短时速度，他们还为发动机加装了增压器，使沃尔克能够短暂加速至 97 km/h。这通常足以接近对手或躲避攻击。为了提高生存能力，沃尔克使用硬化装甲和躯干安装式驾驶舱。驾驶沃尔克的机甲战士更愿意贴近敌人，因为他们相信包围驾驶舱的厚重装甲能保护自己免受火力伤害。

column1: When the RISC laboratories developed the superheavy version of the Wraith Suppression Shield System, they wanted to see how it fared in actual combat at a larger scale before they re-geared to their own heavily over-utilized superheavy factories. Three of the Great Houses were persuaded to design a number of superheavy 'Mechs around the system, all three ending up with very similar looks due to the prototype stealth system requirements and pre-designed components supplied by the Republic. The Kageoni - Shadow Demon - is the house Kurita design result. It's a 170 ton superheavy designed around sniping at a distance, and then repositioning under the protection of its stealth system.
column2: 当 RISC 实验室开发出幽灵抑制盾系统的超重型版本时，他们希望先在更大规模的实战中检验其表现，然后再改造自家那些超负荷运转的超重型工厂。三个大贵族家族被说服，围绕该系统设计了数种超重型机甲；由于原型隐形系统的要求以及共和国提供的预制组件，三者最终拥有非常相似的外形。影魔——影鬼——是库里塔家的设计成果。这是一台 170 吨超重型机甲，专为远距离狙击而设计，然后借助隐形系统的掩护重新部署。

column1: Built by Luthien Armor Works of New Samarkand, the Hitotsume Kozo is a medium BattleMech designed to serve in the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery. This 'Mech's creation was partially influenced by an unofficial cultural rebirth. Keeping this in mind, LAW styled the appearance of the Hitotsume Kozo after the ancient Japanese Bushido armor worn by the samurai warriors during that time period on Terra. It received a poor reception by front-line troops due its advanced features and high heat output; however, it was appreciated when transferred to less-favored combat units, such as Ghost Regiments, as these less-fickle warriors adapted to the design's quirks and turned it into an effective combat unit.
column2: 一眼小僧由新撒马尔罕的卢希恩装甲厂制造，是一款为德拉科尼斯联合体集结军设计的中型战斗机甲。这款机甲的诞生部分受一场非官方文化复兴影响。基于这一点，LAW 将一眼小僧的外观塑造成古代日本武士在当时地球上所穿的武士铠甲样式。由于其先进功能和高热量输出，它在前线部队中反响不佳；然而，当它被调往幽灵团等不受重视的作战单位后，却得到了认可，因为这些不那么挑剔的战士适应了它的设计特性，并将其变成了高效的作战单位。

column1: The Patriot is a BattleMech produced by Ronin Incorporated on Wallis. Its genesis lies in the development of the Pikeman, a 'Mech that was in R&D when Kirc Cameron-Jones declared himself Captain-General of the Free Worlds League in 3069. With an eye to developing his military, he ordered Ronin to develop a 'Mech that could command a regiment and use artillery so that the commander would not be tempted to close with the enemy. Ronin was quickly able to convert their Pikeman to the necessary specifications, leading to production in late 3070. The variants of the 2C have seen greater production numbers and more widespread use, as their more general battlefield roles have surpassed the niche of the standard version.
column2: 爱国者是由华利斯的浪人公司生产的战斗机甲。它源自长枪手的开发项目；3069 年，柯克·卡梅伦-琼斯宣布自己为自由世界联盟总司令时，这款机甲仍处于研发阶段。为了发展军力，他命令浪人公司开发一种能够指挥一个团并使用火炮的机甲，使指挥官无需冒险接近敌人。浪人公司很快将长枪手改造成符合要求的型号，并于 3070 年末开始生产。2C 型的变体产量更高、使用更广泛，因为它们更通用的战场职能已经超越了标准型号的专门定位。

column1: The Penthesilea has the distinction of being the heaviest unit built by the Magistracy of Canopus. The 75 ton 'Mech is constructed not on Detroit, but at Majesty Metals' factory on Dunianshire. This places the production line squarely under Magistracy control, something the Magestrix needed for political reasons. The Penthesilea isn't the fastest heavy 'Mech on the field, but the presence of three jump jets allows it to cover 90 meters in a single leap. This helps offset the fact that the Penthesilea has an average top speed. Using an Endo Steel chassis allows the design to carry twelve tons of ferro-fibrous armor. In addition, the Endo Steel frame allows the 'Mech to carry more weapons, without resorting to a vulnerable XL engine.
column2: 潘忒西勒亚拥有坎诺普斯治安官辖区制造的最重型单位这一称号。这台 75 吨机甲并非在底特律建造，而是在杜尼安郡 Majesty Metals 的工厂生产，因此生产线完全处于治安官辖区控制之下，这对出于政治原因行事的女王来说至关重要。潘忒西勒亚并不是战场上速度最快的重型机甲，但三台跳跃喷射器使它一次跃进即可跨越 90 米。这弥补了它平均的最高速度。采用内骨骼底盘后，该设计能够携带 12 吨铁磁纤维装甲。此外，内骨骼框架还让机甲无需使用脆弱的 XL 发动机，就能搭载更多武器。

column1: Named for the array of spikes embedded in its armor, the Porcupine is built by Innovative Design Concepts to fulfill a highly unusual niche for a light dueling 'Mech: charge specialist. No expense was spared in order to make the Porcupine as effective in this role as possible, with the 'Mech powered by a 180 XL engine and built on an endo steel chassis. The engine is capable of pushing the 'Mech up to speeds of 151 km/h, and with the experimental supercharger engaged the Porcupine is capable of speeds of up to 194 km/h in open terrain. Protection for the Porcupine is provided by three and a half tons of ferro-fibrous armor which has had spikes embedded in it, giving the 'Mech greater damage potential when performing a charging attack than its laser weapons.
column2: 刺猬因装甲中嵌入的尖刺阵列而得名，由创新设计概念公司制造，用于填补轻型决斗机甲中极为特殊的定位：冲撞专家。为了让刺猬尽可能胜任这一角色，制造商不惜一切代价；它搭载 180 XL 发动机，并采用内骨骼底盘。发动机可将机甲推至 151 km/h；开启实验性增压器后，刺猬在开阔地形中的速度最高可达 194 km/h。刺猬由 3.5 吨铁磁纤维装甲提供防护，装甲中嵌入了尖刺，使其发动冲撞攻击时造成的伤害超过其激光武器。

column1: The Valiant was developed by Vining Engineering and Salvage Team, one of the many weapon manufacturers on Solaris VII, at the behest of Irian BattleMechs Unlimited. Based on the Scarabus, the Valiant was conceived as a light skirmisher and first saw use during the Solaran resistance to the occupying Word of Blake in 3068. The two remaining prototypes were smuggled off world in 3070, when the design was picked up by Wakazashi Enterprises. Since the destruction of Luthien Armor Works, the heavy industry of the Draconis Combine was diversifying and expanding to keep the DCMS equipped, and the need for a ready-made BattleMech design overwhelmed the traditional Draconian dislike of hatchets. The 'Mech has received a tepid reception, even among the mercenaries that VEST has sold the design to.
column2: 英勇者由太阳系七号众多武器制造商之一——维宁工程与打捞队——应伊里安无限战斗机甲公司的要求开发。它以蛛形虫为基础，被设计成轻型游击机甲，并于 3068 年首次投入对抗占领太阳系七号的布莱克之语的抵抗行动。3070 年，剩余的两台原型机被偷运出星球，随后该设计被和风企业接手。卢希恩装甲厂遭毁后，德拉科尼斯联合体的重工业为维持 DCMS 装备而不断分化扩张，对现成战斗机甲设计的需求压过了德拉科尼斯人对战斧的传统厌恶。这台机甲的反响平平，即便在 VEST 售出的雇佣兵之中也是如此。

column1: The Pinion is part testbed, part leftovers. Developed by Clan Jade Falcon and introduced into service in 3065, the Pinion BattleMech is the second Clan 'Mech to be produced by Olivetti Weapons on Sudeten. The second-line BattleMech was designed as a patrol and guard duty 'Mech, so it has modest speed coupled with good maneuverability thanks to its jump jet range of 150 meters. Additionally, the Pinion is meant to test the effectiveness and drawbacks of heavy lasers, as early reports from Clan Star Adder indicated heavy lasers are unreliable and possibly damaging to the MechWarrior. In order to properly judge the effect of this new weapon, the Falcons decided to use garrison MechWarriors as guinea pigs. Their vitals were carefully tracked and medical evaluations were administered weekly as part of these tests.
column2: 凤鸟兼具测试平台与边角料的性质。它由氏族玉色猎鹰开发，并于 3065 年投入服役，是奥利维蒂武器公司在苏德滕生产的第二款氏族机甲。这款二线战斗机甲被设计用于巡逻和警戒，因此速度适中；凭借可跳跃 150 米的跳跃喷射器，它拥有良好的机动性。此外，凤鸟还用于测试重型激光器的效能与缺陷，因为来自氏族星蝰的早期报告称，重型激光器不可靠，而且可能会伤害机甲战士。为了正确评估这种新武器的影响，猎鹰族决定把驻军机甲战士当作试验品。他们的生命体征受到严密追踪，并每周接受医疗评估，作为测试的一部分。

column1: Judging by its aesthetics and nomenclature, the fifteen-ton Cherub OmniMech is meant to invoke the terrifying spirit and flexibility of the Word of Blake’s Celestial OmniMech series. Unlike the other units in this list, the Cherub is not a robotic unit but a proper—if unusually small—BattleMech intended for use by human MechWarriors. With a top running speed approaching 120 kilometers per hour and protected by about as much armor as its frame can handle, this OmniMech leaves only twenty percent of its tonnage open for weaponry. To make even this much room possible, however, the improved C3 package, a mainstay on the original Celestial Omnis, is absent here. Curiously, two of the three known variants attempt to work around this by mounting battle-armor grade weapons, backed up by packs of single-use rocket launchers.
column2: 从外观与命名来看，15 吨的天使座 Omni机甲旨在唤起布莱克之语天界 Omni机甲系列那种令人恐惧的精神与灵活性。与这份名单中的其他单位不同，天使座并不是机器人，而是一台真正的战斗机甲——虽然异常小型——供人类机甲战士驾驶。其最高速度接近每小时 120 公里，装甲几乎达到机体所能承受的上限，因此这台 Omni机甲仅有 20% 的吨位可用于武器。为了腾出这点空间，原天界 Omni机甲的主力改良 C3 套件在此被取消。奇怪的是，已知的三个变体中有两个试图通过安装战斗装甲级武器来弥补这一点，并辅以成组的一次性火箭发射器。

column1: The Brahma was designed after the Taurian Concordat was invaded during the Jihad. During that time, the Taurian Defense Force took heavy losses when they put their older machines up against the cutting edge technologies available to the Federated Suns. Though the Taurians were successful in driving the AFFS out of Taurian space and inflicted notable losses on the Federated Suns, the cost to the Concordat in men and matériel was just too high. With that realization uppermost in their minds, the TDF commissioned a new BattleMech that would force the Taurian industrial community to upgrade their factories. If the factory wasn't able to build a component the designers wanted, the TDF reallocated funds to add that production capability to the factory. Thus the Brahma serves not only as a BattleMech for combat, but as a technology driver as well. Though the designers originally wanted a 55 ton 'Mech that would complement the Griffin, Shadow Hawk, and Wolverine, they were unable to fit all the technology in a medium 'Mech chassis. The Brahma therefore displaces sixty tons.
column2: 婆罗门是在圣战期间陶里安协约国遭到入侵后设计的。当时，陶里安防卫军让老旧机体对抗联邦太阳可用的尖端技术，遭受了惨重损失。尽管陶里安人成功将 AFFS 驱逐出陶里安领地，并给联邦太阳造成了显著损失，但协约国在人力与物资上的代价实在太高。意识到这一点后，TDF 委托开发一种新型战斗机甲，迫使陶里安工业界升级工厂。如果某座工厂无法生产设计师需要的部件，TDF 就会重新分配资金，为工厂增加相应的生产能力。因此，婆罗门不仅是一台用于作战的战斗机甲，也是一项技术推动者。设计师原本想制造一台 55 吨、能够与格里芬、暗影之鹰和金刚狼协同作战的机甲，但无法将全部技术塞进中型机甲底盘，于是婆罗门最终达到 60 吨。

column1: Somewhat of a departure from most Clan BattleMechs, the Hellstar is a long-running campaign workhorse rather than the quick-and-deadly striker usually used in Clan warfare. A continuation of the collaboration between Clan Hell's Horses and the Exiled Wolves on Arc-Royal during the Jihad which resulted in the Cygnus, a machine based on the earlier Annihilator, the Hellstar is more or less a Clan Awesome. Introduced in 3079, the Wolves-in-Exile and Hell's Horses maintained exclusive production of the effective 'Mech since, with the largest number outside the ranks of their toumans being the relatively few examples the newborn Republic of the Sphere salvaged from the battlefields of Operation SCOUR. Built on a weight-saving Endo Steel frame and 380-rated XL fusion engine, the Hellstar boasts impressive speed for its weight while carrying eighteen-and-a-half tons of standard armor, the maximum possible for its weight. The real key to the design's reputation is its unprecedented thirty Double Heat Sinks, which allow it to fire all its weapons continuously without the risk of heat buildup.
column2: 与大多数氏族战斗机甲相比，地狱星有些不同：它是适合长期战役的主力，而不是氏族战争中常见的快速致命突击者。它延续了圣战期间氏族地狱之马与流亡之狼在阿克皇家进行的合作；那次合作造就了以早期歼灭者为基础的天鹅座，而地狱星基本上就是一台氏族版的威严。3079 年投入使用后，流亡之狼与地狱之马一直独占这种高效机甲的生产；在它们军团之外，数量最多的是新生的星球共和国从 SCOUR 行动战场上回收的少数样机。地狱星采用节省重量的内骨骼框架和 380 级 XL 聚变发动机，以其重量而言速度惊人，同时携带 18.5 吨标准装甲，达到该重量下的最大值。真正奠定其声誉的是前所未有的 30 个双重散热器，使它能够持续发射全部武器而无需担心热量积聚。

column2: 空天机甲的飞行系统由基础涡轮机和机翼组成。这些部件经过特殊设计，可在降低阻力的同时搭载翼下弹药。

column1: Boss... You must be kidding! This mech is based on Archangel, however version is fully packed with experimental technologies. I don't like this at all.
column2: 老板……你在开玩笑吧！这台机甲以大天使为基础，但这个版本塞满了实验性技术。我一点也不喜欢。

column1: A Jihad era field refit of the Merlin, the 1D removes the PPC and anti-infantry weapons of the 1C and replaces them with a Gauss Rifle and 2 tons of ammo.
column2: 这是圣战时代对梅林的战地改装：移除1C的PPC和反步兵武器，换成高斯步枪和2吨弹药。

column1: More of an extension of the defense protocols built into the Ecee unit. It channels plasma through a port and shapes it into roughly the size of a scimitar.
column2: 更像是内置于Ecee单元的防御协议的延伸。它通过一个端口引导等离子体，并将其塑形成大致弯刀的大小。

column1: Won in combat on Arc-Royal after the Wolf's Dragoons arrival, the reborn Black Widow Company's XO Jacob Kincaid set about upgrading his new 'Mech significantly.
column2: 狼族龙骑兵抵达阿克罗伊尔后，他在战斗中赢得了这台机甲；重生后的黑寡妇连副指挥官雅各布·金凯德随即着手对其进行大幅升级。

column1: Built by the Wolf Empire, this suit was used extensively by second-line commands as it lacked HarJel. It did carry an Advanced SRM 4, however, giving it significant firepower.
column2: 这套由狼帝国制造的战甲因缺少HarJel，被二线部队广泛使用。不过它配备了一具先进SRM-4，火力相当可观。

column2: 将串联弹头与连发制导结合于一次性火箭系统中的原型导弹系统。仅1发！ 不稳定！

column1: Double Plasma Cannons and six Medium Lasers... I am not sure I would like to get near an enemy in this thing, unless if it was in a desert and I had Inferno missiles and Flamers.
column2: 两门等离子炮和六门中型激光器……除非身处沙漠、手里还有地狱火导弹和火焰喷射器，否则我可不想靠近敌人。

column1: Shaking your head, you deliver your decision. "We'll wait for now. Perhaps we can get a better price later on."\n\nThough disappointed, Darius moves on with the rest of the meeting's agenda.
column2: 你摇摇头，给出决定。“我们暂时等等。也许之后能拿到更好的价格。”\n\n虽然失望，达里厄斯继续会议的其他议程。

column1: Take a basic Jagermech, make it even bigger, and you have Independence Weaponry's Uberjager. A 115 ton beast of raw ballistic damage, it is entirely focused on autocannons and their auxiliary systems.
column2: 拿一台基础型猎虎机甲，把它做得更大，你就得到独立武器公司的超级猎虎。这头115吨的野兽拥有纯粹的弹道火力，完全专注于自动火炮及其辅助系统。

column1: A land refitted version of the original U configuration, which was intended for aquatic combat. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 原始 U 配置的陆战改装版，原本用于水战。 特性：坚固 投放成本倍率：1.1

column1: Upgraded to use a Light PPC and XL Engine, the MON-86 has a top speed close to 150 km/h. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 升级配备轻型 PPC 和 XL 引擎后，MON-86 的最高速度接近 150 km/h。 特性：易于驾驶 投放成本倍率：0.98

column1: A Jihad era refresh of the WVR-7M, switching the Large Lasers for a Heavy PPC. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

column1: With the destruction of the former Brigadier Corporation factory on Gibson the only known manufacturing lines for the Yurei no longer exist, making it an extinct design to the best of anyone's knowledge.
column2: 随着吉布森原 Brigadier Corporation 工厂被摧毁，已知唯一的 Yurei 生产线不复存在；据目前所知，这种设计已经绝迹。

column1: Classified Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Gauss Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 机密 特性：精准武器 - 高斯 投放成本倍率：1.18 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: Developed during attempts to create the Harjel III Systems, this 'Structure' adds interlinked HarJel system throughout the BattleMech, allowing it to repair and seal any breaches received during Deployment
column2: 在尝试制造 HarJel III 系统期间开发，这种“结构”在整台战斗机甲中加入互联的 HarJel 系统，使其能够修复并封闭部署期间遭受的任何破损。

column1: Boss, this thing is ridiculously over-armored for the Anti-Aircraft role. It should have no trouble taking some hits, but firepower is lacking if you intend to take on anything other than a light aircraft.
column2: 老板，这东西对于防空任务来说装甲厚得离谱。它应该能轻松承受几次命中，但如果你打算对付轻型飞行器以外的目标，火力就不够用了。

column1: A mostly unknown mech design, with some surprising weapons that aren't found anywhere else. Quirk: Missile Jammer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.41
column2: 一种鲜为人知的机甲设计，配备了一些其他地方找不到的惊人武器。 特性：导弹干扰器 投放成本倍率：1.41

column1: The Gürteltier's electronics include a C3 slave computer and a Guardian ECM Suite. This gives the tank the ability to coordinate its actions while disrupting enemy C3 Networks and other advance electronics.
column2: Gürteltier 的电子设备包括 C3 从属计算机和 Guardian ECM 套件。这使该坦克能够协调行动，同时干扰敌方 C3 网络及其他先进电子设备。

column1: This Dark Age era variant gives up its jump jets and some weaponry for armored components. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 这个黑暗时代型号放弃了跳跃喷口和部分武器，换装装甲组件。 特性：近战执行器 投放成本倍率：1.03

column1: A primitive Retrotech variant of the Mercury, with the only weapons being two small lasers. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.75
column2: Mercury 的原始复古科技型号，唯一的武器是两门小型激光。 特性：模块化武器 投放成本倍率：0.75

column1: Well I guess if you have an unlimited budget you get things like this Boss. Just for research purposes of course, I would never use it to terrorize the local wildlife for fun on the next planet we arrive at.
column2: 老板，我想如果预算无限，你就能得到这种东西。当然只是为了研究，我绝不会为了好玩，在我们抵达下一颗行星后用它去恐吓当地野生动物。

column1: The Republic’s ARC-9R refits the -4M to current standards, with Extended LRMs and a C3 computer Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 共和国的 ARC-9R 将 -4M 翻新至当前标准，配备扩展型 LRM 和 C3 计算机。 特性：战斗拳套 投放成本倍率：1.1

column1: The 45B was a limited offering that replace the MML-9 with a snub-nose PPC and additional heat sinks. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 45B 是限量型号，用短管 PPC 和额外散热器替换了 MML-9。 特性：坚固 投放成本倍率：1.05

column1: A simple upgrade to the ARC-4M, this version trades the medium lasers for extended range versions. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1

column2: 这支炮械中队旨在为驻军提供更可靠的快速反应部队。 特性：可变射程瞄准 投放成本倍率：1.15

column1: A Dark Age variant used by the Draconis Combine this model removes the jump jets and replaces them with additional SRM-2s. The variant was named from the HUD displaying the word 'Baka' when a trooper tries to jump.
column2: 龙蛇联合使用的黑暗时代型号；该型号移除了跳跃喷口，换成额外的 SRM-2。它的名字源于士兵尝试跳跃时，HUD 上会显示“Baka”一词。

column1: Someone painted big White Bunny on this one... I've got no idea what the hell they've been thinking Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99

column1: Need more protection for your mech, but can't afford those other armors? Buy Quicsell branded Duralast armor lining today. Cheap to buy, and fast to repair, our armor leaves you adequately protected. Reserves 8 slots.
column2: 需要为机甲提供更多防护，却买不起那些其他装甲？今天就购买 Quicsell 品牌的 Duralast 装甲衬层吧。我们的装甲购买便宜、维修迅速，能为你提供足够的防护。占用 8 个槽位。

column1: What do you get when you take the iconic BRRRRRT away from the Warthog? Not much, except a cheaper LAM. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 把 Warthog 标志性的 BRRRRRT 去掉后会得到什么？没什么，只有一台更便宜的 LAM。 特性：陆空机甲 投放成本倍率：1.05

column1: The Atlas 'AS5-HAT' .....typical Pirate rewiring the IFF to be this 'subtle', is a pretty standard Atlas chassis, but it looks like they rewrote the articulation program for the hands to flip the bird when firing too.
column2: Atlas“AS5-HAT”……海盗把敌我识别系统重新接线得如此“隐蔽”，倒是相当典型。这是一具相当标准的 Atlas 底盘，但看起来他们还重写了双手的关节程序，让它在开火时竖起中指。

column1: This Dark Age variant carries a Streak missile launcher and uses Magnetic Clamps to ride on OmniMechs. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.978

column1: Darius nods, and moves on to the next item.\n\nLater in the week, Darius provides an update. "The medical staff is adjusting to rationing medical supplies. Injuries are healing more slowly, but they'll heal all the same."
column2: Darius 点头，继续处理下一项。\n\n本周晚些时候，Darius 提供了更新。“医疗人员正在适应医疗物资配给。伤势愈合得更慢了，但最终都会痊愈。”

column1: A C3 network version of the K1, the KC drops one of the ER Medium Lasers to instead mount a C3 slave computer. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02

column1: PASSIVE: The ECM carrier projects an ECM field, building Stealth Charges for itself and allies if it starts or ends its turn with no active enemy units within the field.\n\nECM carriers also receive a bonus Stealth Charge.

column1: This further development of the STG-5M replaces the weapons with an ER flamer, ER medium laser, and a laser AMS. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: STG-5M 的进一步发展型，用 ER 火焰喷射器、ER 中型激光和激光 AMS 替换原有武器。 特性：无处不在 部署费用倍率：0.97

column1: PEW PEW. But wait, there's more! Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

column1: Mostly similar to the -1B, the -1D replaces the PPC with two Large Pulse Lasers to improve the cooling somewhat. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.42

column1: With a wave of your hand, you quiet the room. "I've had enough of this 'cabal'. We can live without their pop-up stores of pilfered goods."\n\nYang heaves a sigh. "I guess it's time for Iron Beard to finally go legit."
column2: 你挥手让房间安静下来。“我受够这个‘秘密集团’了。没有他们那些弹出式赃物商店，我们也能活下去。”\n\nYang 长叹一声。“看来是时候让铁胡子终于合法经营了。”

column1: So you modified the files or had a bug, you should not have this mech. If it was a bug and you ended up with this mech please report it to Discord. If not think about this: you are riding around in a semi sentient beings body.
column2: 所以你修改了文件或遇到了错误；你不该拥有这台机甲。如果是错误导致你获得它，请在 Discord 报告。如果不是，想想这个：你正骑在一个半具感知能力的生命体躯体里。

column1: This variant is identical to the 10S, but was introduced in 3072 and replaces one heat sink with a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: 该变体与 10S 完全相同，但于 3072 年推出，并将一个散热器替换为 C3 从属单元。 特性：指挥机甲 部署费用倍率：1.15

column1: A Dark Age variant, this model removes most of the weaponry to provide electronic warfare systems to its Star. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.978
column2: 这是一个黑暗时代变体，移除了大部分武器，为其星队提供电子战系统。 特性：标准部件 部署费用倍率：0.978

column1: Classified. Quirk: Speed!!! Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.944 Can only be transported by internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.
column2: 机密。 特性：速度！！！ 部署费用倍率：0.944 只能由内部舱室运输，无法进行近战，也无法进行集群攻击。

column1: A pirate modified Grasshopper that retains it's famous jumpjets, but also adds in a stealth system and some pirate AMS. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 一台海盗改装的跳跃者，保留了著名的跳跃喷气机，还加入了隐形系统和一些海盗 AMS。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.08

column1: The CLR-03-O-C configuration is a scouting model, carrying a remote sensor dispenser and a Beagle active probe. Quirk: Quad Mech (Squad) Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.94
column2: CLR-03-O-C 配置是侦察型号，携带遥感投放器和 Beagle 主动探测器。 特性：四足机甲（小队） 部署费用倍率：0.94

column1: Another Solaris custom, the Wolverine X was designed by a wealthy Heir to compete in the Arenas as a pasttime. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 又一款 Solaris 定制机。Wolverine X 由一位富有的继承人设计，用于参加竞技场比赛消磨时光。 特性：受保护的执行器 部署费用倍率：1.09

column1: The Comminus configuration mounts a Clan-grade Medium Pulse Lasers in each arm and a Rocket Launcher 10 in each side torso. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: Comminus 配置在每条手臂上安装一门氏族级中型脉冲激光，并在两侧躯干各安装一具火箭发射器 10。 特性：灵活 部署费用倍率：0.97

column1: A Prototype of what would one day become the Gauntlet, this Bushwacker was fitted with a unique Lyran produced XL Engine that employs a unique Supercharger and TSM in an attempt to overcome having to salvage clan grade XL engines.
column2: 这是一台后来会成为 Gauntlet 的原型机。这台 Bushwacker 装配了拉纳生产的独特 XL 引擎，配备独特的超级增压器和 TSM，试图避免搜刮氏族级 XL 引擎。

column1: This 'Mech was made for punching, and thats just what it'll do, and one of these days, it's gonna be punching you.... Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 这台机甲就是用来出拳的，而它确实只会做这一件事；总有一天，它会把拳头挥向你…… 特性：战斗拳套 部署费用倍率：1.04

column1: A further adaptation of the Hardened Ferro-Fibrous armor by RISC, manage to increase the armor thickness even further at just a small increase in weight. However, due to the extensive space needs only superheavy 'Mechs can mount it.
column2: RISC 对强化铁纤维装甲进行了进一步改造，在仅略微增加重量的情况下继续提升装甲厚度。然而，由于空间需求极大，只有超重型机甲能够安装它。

column1: Similar to the B variant, the G uses five ER Medium Lasers and a HAG 20. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 与 B 变体相似，G 使用五门 ER 中型激光和一具 HAG 20。 特性：稳定 部署费用倍率：1.04 手臂执行器限制：全身

column1: Engine HeatSinks done cheaper. If you need just a little bit more room in your Quicsell brand mech, then why not try a Quicsell brand Engine HS kit to go with it? Ask about our introductory offers at your local Quicsell distributer.
column2: 以更低价格提供引擎散热器。如果你的 Quicsell 品牌机甲只差一点空间，为什么不试试配套的 Quicsell 品牌引擎散热器套件？请向当地 Quicsell 经销商咨询我们的入门优惠。

column1: Units within an ECM field gain a Stealth Charge and cannot be targeted.\n\nFiring a weapon, using an activated ability, or an enemy penetrating the ECM field removes a Stealth Charge. Being Sensor Locked removes all Stealth Charges.
column2: ECM 场内的单位获得一层隐形充能，且无法被锁定。\n\n开火、使用激活能力或敌人穿透 ECM 场会移除一层隐形充能。被传感器锁定会移除所有隐形充能。

column1: This Jihad field refit, first spotted in 3074, removes a pulse laser and mounts an experimental Angel ECM Suite in its place. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 这款圣战时期的野战改装机于 3074 年首次被发现，移除了一门脉冲激光，改装实验型 Angel ECM 套件。 特性：灵活 部署费用倍率：0.99

column1: BL1-OA's run hot as hell. It's designed as a bracket fighter - a 'Mech that's not really supposed to fire everything at once - but even then it's gonna struggle to fire its long-range weapons without melting a hole through the floor.
column2: BL1-OA 热得要命。它被设计成一台分段火力战斗机——这种机甲本来就不该一次性开火所有武器——但即便如此，它要发射远程武器仍然困难重重，仿佛会把地板烧穿。

column1: The Axman AXM-5R uses clan tech grade weapons and an upgraded engine to improve the base design concept of the AXM-2N. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: Axman AXM-5R 使用氏族科技级武器和升级引擎，改进 AXM-2N 的基础设计理念。 特性：近战执行器 部署费用倍率：1.09

column1: Created by a fan of Kuritan 'Kaiju' movies is this remodeled Annihilator Chassis equipped to prove its the King of all Monsters. Quirk: ROAR! Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24
column2: 这台重新设计的 Annihilator 机体由一位库忍“怪兽”电影爱好者打造，装备它就是为了证明自己是万兽之王。 特性：咆哮！ 部署费用倍率：1.24

column1: This variant removes all the standard weaponry and mounts an Arrow IV launcher in the right arm and torso. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 该变体移除所有标准武器，在右臂和躯干安装一具 Arrow IV 发射器。 特性：改进瞄准——中型 部署费用倍率：1.04

column1: A salvaged Conjurer from a Lyran Pirate, the Hoellenhund received mercury weapon mounts to face every possible threat. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 从拉纳海盗手中缴获的 Conjurer，Hoellenhund 配备了水银武器挂架，以应对各种可能的威胁。 特性：模块化武器 部署费用倍率：1.04

column1: The Warden variant makes use of three ATM 12s with four tons of ammunition and keeps the ER medium lasers of the original. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: Warden 变体使用三具 ATM 12，携带四吨弹药，并保留原型的 ER 中型激光。 特性：战斗拳套 部署费用倍率：1.1

column1: The Star Python only recently appeared in the Clan Goliath Scorpion Touman. It appears to derive from the original Nexus built by ComStar, of which several examples were known to exist in Scorpion ranks prior to the Hanseatic Crusade.
column2: Star Python 最近才出现在巨蝎氏族的战团中。它似乎源自 ComStar 制造的原始 Nexus；在汉萨同盟十字军东征之前，已知巨蝎军中就有数台这样的机体。

column1: The WGT-1LAW/SC3 is a field refit of the 1LAW/SC which removes one ER medium laser in order to add a C3 slave. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: WGT-1LAW/SC3 是 1LAW/SC 的野战改装型，移除一门 ER 中型激光，以便加装 C3 从属单元。 特性：改进通信 部署费用倍率：1.05

column1: This advanced vibrosword by Toho Heavy Industries is intended to allow Mechwarriors to quickly defeat a lighter opponent in melee without cutting too much into their main armament tonnage. It does generate a non-trivial amount of heat.
column2: 这把由东宝重工制造的先进振动剑，旨在让机甲战士在近战中迅速击败较轻的对手，同时尽量不占用主武器的吨位。它确实会产生相当可观的热量。

column1: A product of the Kendall BattleMech factory rebuilt as a collaborative project between Kali Yama and the Alphard Trading Corporation, the Quasimodo was intended from the outset to be the next generation of the venerable Hunchback 'Mech.
column2: Quasimodo 出自重建后的 Kendall 战斗机甲工厂，是 Kali Yama 与 Alphard Trading Corporation 的合作项目；从一开始，它就被定位为久负盛名的 Hunchback 机甲的下一代产品。

column1: The 11CS2 replaces the C3i unit with a C3 slave computer and a Guardian ECM, otherwise the loadout is the same as the 11CS. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 11CS2 用 C3 从属计算机和 Guardian ECM 替换了 C3i 单元，其余配置与 11CS 相同。 特性：战斗拳套 部署费用倍率：1.05

column1: The melee-specialized 'Gemji' CRB-GI has opened its claws, bringing Industrial-strength table flipping to a 'Mech fight. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
column2: 近战特化型“Gemji” CRB-GI 张开了钳爪，把工业级掀桌能力带入机甲战斗。 特性：近战执行器 部署费用倍率：1.06

column1: Reportedly piloted by the more or less infamous pirate "Damio," this "Beekeeper" is designed to fire large stingy "Swarms." Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 据称由或多或少臭名昭著的海盗“Damio”驾驶，这台“养蜂人”专为发射大型带刺“蜂群”而设计。 特性：战斗计算机 部署费用倍率：1.04

column1: So Some gouzaizi thought he cracked how to make a Star League Grade Engine Shielding. If this doesn't blow up your mech when it breaks, it surely will boost the engine. There is a note etched into the main board that says ''Suck It Yang''.
column2: 某个叫 gouzaizi 的蠢货以为自己破解了制造星盟级引擎屏蔽的方法。这个东西损坏时如果没把你的机甲炸飞，肯定也会增强引擎。主板上刻着一行字：‘去你的，Yang’。

column1: Looks like one of these famed Clanbusters, but theres definitely nothing where it should be. It even got real Hand Actuators! Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 看起来像著名的 Clanbuster 之一，但该在的位置绝对空空如也。它甚至还配备了真正的手部执行器！ 特性：指挥机甲 部署费用倍率：1.18

column1: The B loadout combines a LRM-20 with 2 Large and 2 Medium Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: B 配置结合了一具 LRM-20、两门大型脉冲激光和两门中型脉冲激光。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.06 手臂执行器限制：全身

column1: Winfield was originally named Treeline, but was gifted to the commander of the Stealths, Colonel Raymond Winfield, by Archon Elizabeth Steiner after their destruction in the conquest of Sakhalin in 2863 and renamed "Winfield" in his honour.
column2: Winfield 原名 Treeline；2863 年萨哈林征服战中，Stealths 部队遭到毁灭后，阿基女王 Elizabeth Steiner 将其赠予该部队指挥官 Raymond Winfield 上校，并以他的名字重新命名为“Winfield”。

column1: The TS-P1D's main armament are its three ER medium lasers and its two Magshots. These are backed up by a single Streak SRM-4 launcher. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: TS-P1D 的主武器是三门 ER 中型激光和两具 Magshot。后方还有一具 Streak SRM-4 发射器提供支援。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.02

column1: The more luxurious drone from Syberian Drone Works, it has what appears to be a XL engine and upgraded armor and firepower. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: Syberian Drone Works 制造的豪华型无人机，似乎配备了 XL 引擎，并升级了装甲和火力。 特性：狭窄／低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：0.96

column1: Extremely well armored and armed for a Griffin, this pirate refit is a mish-mash of both jury rigged and experimental technologies. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 对于 Griffin 来说，这台海盗改装机的装甲和武装都极其强大，混合采用了临时拼装和实验技术。 特性：炮管拳 部署费用倍率：1.05

column1: This one's a real workhorse, Hegemony built medium that balanced speed, armor and firepower well enough to get churned out by the thousands. Cheap to make too, though that didn't save it once the Succession Wars started grinding everything down.
column2: 这台机甲是真正的劳模：这是星盟制造的中型机，速度、装甲和火力平衡得相当出色，足以量产数千台。制造成本也很低，不过继承战争开始将一切碾碎后，这也救不了它。

column1: The 6W was a Periphery modification of the Archer built by VMI out of New Vandenberg, which used older rather than newer technology. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 6W 是 VMI 在新范登堡制造的 Archer 周边改装型，使用了较旧而非较新的技术。 特性：战斗拳套 部署费用倍率：1.08

column1: This prototype carries four medium lasers and a mace into combat. Performance and protection are identical to the standard Brigand. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 这台原型机携带四门中型激光和一把钉锤投入战斗。其性能和防护与标准 Brigand 完全相同。 特性：空中突袭 部署费用倍率：0.98

column1: Another Solaris custom, the Wolverine DS is designed to deal massive damage in a short time, and have the mobility to get out safely. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 又一款 Solaris 定制机。Wolverine DS 旨在短时间内造成巨大伤害，同时具备安全撤离所需的机动性。 特性：指挥机甲 部署费用倍率：1.05

column1: This belongs in a museum, not the hands of some damn drunken pirate tech! Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.89 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: 这东西该进博物馆，不该落在某个该死的醉鬼海盗技师手里！ 特性：稳定武器 部署费用倍率：0.89 手臂执行器限制：右上臂

column1: This variant swaps out the SRM-4 and three ER Medium Lasers and replaces them with a single ER Large Laser and an extra heat sink. Quirk: Reinforced Legs Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 该型号拆除了 SRM-4 和三门 ER 中型激光，换成一门 ER 大型激光并增加一组散热器。 特性：强化腿部 部署费用倍率：1.05

column1: The Hollander II RX sports a experimental Hyper Laser and Re Engineered Laser as Backup as well as highly volatile Caseless AMS Ammo Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 霍兰德 II RX 配备一门实验型超能激光，并以一门重构激光作为备用，同时还使用高度不稳定的无壳 AMS 弹药。 特性：稳定武器 部署费用倍率：1.08

column1: Me fifth element - supreme being. Me protect you. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.27 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 俺是第五元素——至高存在。俺来保护你。 特性：精准武器——导弹 部署费用倍率：1.27 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: The latest rework of the venerable Thunder Hawk, the TDK-7ZEM trades several tons of Thunderbolt ammo for an Emergency C3 Master unit. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 这台久负盛名的雷霆鹰最新改造型 TDK-7ZEM，以数吨雷霆霹雳弹药换装了一台紧急 C3 主机。 特性：指挥机甲 部署费用倍率：1.18

column1: This direct fire configuration mounts a single ER Large Laser in the head, supported by a Medium Pulse Laser in the center torso. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 该直射配置在头部安装一门 ER 大型激光，中央躯干配有一门中型脉冲激光支援。 特性：窄体/低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：0.98

column1: This Draconis Combine variant of the Thug 12E, introduced in 3067; replaces the C3i with a C3 Slave and a Guardian ECM Suite. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: 这款 3067 年推出的龙华联合体 Thug 12E 变型，用 C3 从机和 Guardian ECM 套件替换了 C3i。 特性：精准武器——能量 部署费用倍率：1.14

column1: The Nexus II is the natural evolution of the Nexus, based on the NXS1-B model. A reason for the chassis rename instead of just creating more original Nexus variants, was an attempt to get rid of its bad reputation and address many of its shortcomings.
column2: Nexus II 是 Nexus 的自然进化型，基于 NXS1-B 型号。之所以重新命名底盘，而不是继续制造更多原版 Nexus 变型，是为了摆脱它的坏名声并弥补诸多缺陷。

column1: The -R4 is identical to the -R3 with two exceptions; rather than standard armor, the -R4 mounts impact-resistant armor and has CASE II. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: -R4 与 -R3 基本相同，只有两点例外：-R4 不使用标准装甲，而是安装抗冲击装甲，并配备 CASE II。 特性：近战执行器 部署费用倍率：1.15

column1: The RWN-02 replaces the MASC and two of the heat sinks from the -01 with a larger 270 XXL engine, otherwise the loadout is the same. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: RWN-02 用更大的 270 XXL 引擎替换了 -01 的 MASC 和两组散热器，其余配置相同。 特性：窄体/低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：0.99

column1: Like the trickster it was named for is the 'Anansi' equipped with Advanced Stealth Systems and Flare Launcher able to trick any Sensors. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 以它所取名的骗子安纳西为灵感，‘Anansi’装备了先进隐形系统和能欺骗任何传感器的照明弹发射器。 特性：空袭 部署费用倍率：1.05

column1: The Procyon is the first ProtoMech designed and built by Clan Coyote. Procyon 5 Carries jump jets and replaces one ER Small Laser with an SRM-2 Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: Procyon 是响尾蛇氏族设计并建造的第一台原型机甲。Procyon 5 搭载跳跃喷射器，并用一具 SRM-2 替换了一门 ER 小型激光。 特性：灵巧 部署费用倍率：0.98

column1: This variant removes the standard weaponry and replaces it with a single Large Re-engineered Laser. It's protected by Ballistic-Reinforced Armor. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 该型号拆除标准武器，换成一门大型重构激光，并由弹道强化装甲提供防护。 特性：灵巧 部署费用倍率：0.99

column1: A Helepolis refit that trades the Artillery Cannon for an Arrow IV System. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是一台 Helepolis 改装型，用箭 IV 系统替换了火炮。 特性：稳定 部署费用倍率：1.11 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: A close range variant, the Turkina E is equipped with six Streak SRM-6's and a HAG 40. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 近距离作战型 Turkina E 装备六具 Streak SRM-6 和一门 HAG 40。 特性：空袭 部署费用倍率：1.18 手臂执行器限制：全身

column1: The Procyon is the first ProtoMech designed and built by Clan Coyote. Procyon 3 replaces the ER Small Lasers with a Heavy Small Laser and an LRM-3. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: Procyon 是响尾蛇氏族设计并建造的第一台原型机甲。Procyon 3 用一门重型小型激光和一具 LRM-3 替换了 ER 小型激光。 特性：灵巧 部署费用倍率：0.98

column1: The Conjurer 5 mounts two ATM 6s, each of which is allocated a single ton of ammunition. A pair of ER Medium Lasers back up this model. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: Conjurer 5 装有两具 ATM 6，每具配备一吨弹药；一对 ER 中型激光为其提供支援。 特性：扩大躯干旋转 部署费用倍率：1.1

column1: Built on Solaris VII, the Valiant K7 is a light skirmisher that relies on a trio of ER Medium Lasers, a deadly Hatchet, and MASC. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 在太阳系七号建造的 Valiant K7 是一台轻型游击机，依靠三门 ER 中型激光、一把致命战斧和 MASC 作战。 特性：改进瞄准——近程 部署费用倍率：0.99

column1: This Hunchback nicknamed the 'Flying Debris' is equipped with a jury rigged Silver 'Ware' Gauss rifle, Jury Rigged engine and a Aftermarket EWS. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: 这台昵称‘飞行残骸’的 Hunchback 装有拼凑的 Silver ‘Ware’ 高斯步枪、拼凑引擎和后市场电子战套件。 特性：战斗拳 部署费用倍率：1.02

column1: The Uller aptly named for a god of archery sports long range weapons and agility Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: 乌勒尔以弓箭运动之神命名，擅长远程武器和敏捷机动。 特性：窄体/低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：0.99 手臂执行器限制：右上臂

column1: Well, its a Piranha, though these Junkers somehow managed to mangle its targeting Systems while installing better MachineGun Mounts..... Quirk: Accurate Weapon - MG Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: 好吧，它是一台 Piranha，不过这些废品商在安装更好的机枪挂架时，似乎把它的瞄准系统弄得一团糟…… 特性：精准武器——机枪 部署费用倍率：0.97

column1: Developed by The Society this version is equipped with a Magnetic Clamp system. It's armed with a single ER Small Laser and an SRM-1 with ten reloads. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 由‘协会’开发，该型号配备磁力夹持系统。武器包括一门 ER 小型激光和一具 SRM-1，备有十次装填。 特性：灵巧 部署费用倍率：0.98

column1: Some Clan Blood Spirit variations mounted two Series 4D-2 heavy large lasers for more firepower at the expense of range and some accuracy. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 部分鲜血幽灵氏族的变型安装了两门 4D-2 系列重型大型激光，以牺牲射程和部分精度换取更强火力。 特性：受保护执行器 部署费用倍率：1.04

column1: This upgrade of the 9M replaces the lasers with a pair of Heavy PPCs. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这款 9M 的升级型用一对重型 PPC 替换了激光武器。 特性：窄体/低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：1.11 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: This variant retains the targeting computer but replaces the RAC/5 with an UAC/10. The chassis is protected by ferro-fibrous armor. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 该型号保留瞄准计算机，但将 RAC/5 换成 UAC/10。底盘由铁纤维装甲保护。 特性：改进瞄准——中程 部署费用倍率：1.04

column1: A RISC Derivative of the BLK-10, exchanging its shield for a Medium Vibroblade and employing 2 Streak MML backed up by a Snub Nose PPC and a RAC5. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22
column2: 这是 BLK-10 的 RISC 衍生型，以中型振动刃替换护盾，并使用两具 Streak MML，由短管 PPC 和 RAC5 提供支援。 特性：指挥机甲 部署费用倍率：1.22

column1: A simple field refit, the Daikyu 1r trades the Ultra Autocannon/5s of the original for two LB 5-X ACs and an experimental C3 boosted slave. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 一次简单的战地改装：Daikyu 1r 用两门 LB 5-X AC 和一台实验型 C3 增强从机替换原版的 Ultra AC/5。 特性：扩大躯干旋转 部署费用倍率：1.1

column1: A weaponized Loader Titan, by strapping as many rockets as possible to the chassis the Superheavy IndustrialMech is more dangerous than one would think. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 武装化的装载泰坦：在底盘上尽可能加装火箭后，这台超重型工业机甲比想象中更加危险。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.04

column1: Based on the 6H, the 8X keeps the UAC/10, but removes the LRM-10 and ER large laser. In their place is a thumper cannon with one ton of ammunition. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 基于 6H，8X 保留了 UAC/10，但拆除了 LRM-10 和 ER 大型激光，改装一门雷鸣炮并配备一吨弹药。 特性：战斗拳 部署费用倍率：1.04

column1: A variant developed by StarCorps for possible sale to the Capellan market, it trades the 2SC's jump jets for a 'Mech sized plasma rifle. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: StarCorps 为可能出售给卡佩兰市场而开发的变型，用一支机甲尺寸的等离子步枪替换了 2SC 的跳跃喷射器。 特性：改进通讯 部署费用倍率：1.05

column1: Originally conceived during the Star League era, the Land-Air 'Mech (or LAM) is a hybrid military unit capable of transforming between BattleMech and Aerospace Fighter forms. This ability conveys great speed and flexibility at the cost of power and protection.
column2: 空陆机甲（或称 LAM）最初构想于星盟时代，是一种能够在战斗机甲与航天战斗机形态之间变形的混合军用单位。这种能力带来极高速度和灵活性，但代价是火力与防护较弱。

column1: Not much is known about the Nuwisha X, but rumor says it carries some heavily experimental gear. Quirk: Self Repair Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.31 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 关于 Nuwisha X 的资料不多，但传闻称它携带了一些高度实验性的设备。 特性：自我修复 部署费用倍率：1.31 手臂执行器限制：全身

column1: The Osteon-E carries a HAG 20 in each arm. The head sports an ER Large Laser and ER Medium Laser. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Osteon-E 每条手臂各装有一门 HAG 20，头部配备一门 ER 大型激光和一门 ER 中型激光。 特性：多重追踪 部署费用倍率：1.18 手臂执行器限制：全身

column1: This variant is equipped with a pair of heavy large lasers as its only weapons. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
column2: 该型号唯一的武器是一对重型大型激光。 特性：精准武器——激光 部署费用倍率：1.09 手臂执行器限制：左上臂

column1: It was just a question of time that a Pirate goes and 'restores' a captured Valiant, stocked full with spiked armour and a Harpoon of all things!. Quirk: Industrial TSM Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
column2: 海盗去‘修复’一台缴获的 Valiant 只是时间问题，而这台机甲装满了尖刺装甲，甚至还有一把鱼叉！ 特性：工业级 TSM 部署费用倍率：1.01

column1: Introduced in 3068, the Merlin 1C swaps the Medium Lasers for ER Mediums. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Merlin 1C 于 3068 年推出，用 ER 中型激光替换了中型激光。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.06 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: The M configuration is focused on long range support, carrying only a Rotary AC/2 and a ER Large Laser. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: M 配置专注于远程支援，仅携带一门旋转 AC/2 和一门 ER 大型激光。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.04 手臂执行器限制：全身

column1: The fourth Sphinx variant carries eight Heavy Small Lasers and two Large Pulse Lasers. Twenty-four double heat sinks keep the heat under control. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: 第四种 Sphinx 变型携带八门重型小型激光和两门大型脉冲激光。二十四组双重散热器将热量控制在安全范围内。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.17

column1: Built in 3074 after the destruction of Nimakachi's Tematagi factory, the 7KC drops the 7K's medium pulse lasers and mounts a Light PPC and a C3 Slave Unit. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 7KC 于 3074 年 Nimakachi 的 Tematagi 工厂被毁后建造，拆除了 7K 的中型脉冲激光，换装一门轻型 PPC 和一台 C3 从机。 特性：灵巧 部署费用倍率：0.99

column1: Developed in the Dark Age, this variant of the Hollander replaces the original weaponry with a light Gauss rifle and a supercharger for the engine. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 这款霍兰德的黑暗时代变型以轻型高斯步枪和引擎增压器替换了原版武器。 特性：稳定武器 部署费用倍率：1.05

column1: The A loadout of the Republic's CLR-03-O OmniMech variant carries two Clan-spec Improved One Shot SRM-6 launchers and a 10-tube Rocket Launcher. Quirk: Quad Mech (Squad) Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.94
column2: 共和国 CLR-03-O OmniMech 变型的 A 配置携带两具氏族规格改进型一次性 SRM-6 发射器和一具十管火箭发射器。 特性：四足机甲（小队） 部署费用倍率：0.94

column1: This one's a ghost, stolen straight from Hegemony stealth tech just two years after it debuted. Combine went all out packing it with endo steel and top of the line electronics but skimped on real firepower. Less than three dozen ever built, few left by war's end.
column2: 这家伙就像幽灵一样，在星盟隐形技术问世仅两年后便被直接窃取。龙华联合体不惜血本为它装上内骨骼钢和顶级电子设备，却削减了真正的火力。总共建造不到三十台，战争结束时所剩无几。

column1: The Tolva is a medium Quad BattleMech based on the Araña MilitiaMech. Stronger and tougher than the IndustrialMech version, it was used extensively during the Hanseatic Crusade. After the war it is found in large numbers in the Hellion, Omega, and Grunt Galaxies.
column2: Tolva 是一台基于 Araña 民兵机甲的中型四足战斗机甲。它比工业机甲版本更强更坚固，在汉萨同盟十字军东征期间被广泛使用。战后，地狱行者、欧米伽和格伦特银河中仍有大量该机型。

column1:
Chassis: Manx Variant: 1499

Weapons profile: Unknown. Experimental platform. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.38 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2:
底盘：Manx 型号：1499

武器配置：未知。实验平台。 特性：精准武器——自动火炮 部署费用倍率：1.38 手臂执行器限制：右下臂

column1: Coming from the same project that took a second look at the Phoenix Super Griffin has this Wasp received substantial upgrades to nearly every piece. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
column2: 这台 Wasp 来自与凤凰计划‘超级 Griffin’相同的项目，几乎每个部件都得到了大幅升级。 特性：空袭 部署费用倍率：1.06

column1: An extension of the -8E, this 'Mech is fitted with Triple Strength Myomer to take advantage of the massive heat generated by the X-pulse lasers. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 作为 -8E 的延伸型，这台机甲装配三倍强度肌肉组织，以利用 X 脉冲激光产生的巨大热量。 特性：窄体/低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：1.08

column1: This variant uses an XXL Engine to allow the chassis to carry an ER PPC and Talons. It's frequently seen with Hell's Horses Mongol warriors. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 该型号使用 XXL 引擎，使底盘能够携带一门 ER PPC 和利爪。它经常出现在地狱之马氏族的蒙古勇士部队中。 特性：精准武器——激光 部署费用倍率：1.05

column1: The F configuration carries a ATM-6 launcher in the right torso, and two Plasma Cannons in the right arm. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: F 配置在右侧躯干搭载一具 ATM-6 发射器，右臂装有两门等离子炮。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.04 手臂执行器限制：全身

column1: This newer variant on the IIC 4 uses three Heavy Machine Guns in each arm. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这款较新的 IIC 4 变型每条手臂都使用三挺重型机枪。 特性：窄体/低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：1.02 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: Double Thumper action, of the shorter kind. Stay clear or get pummeled hard. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 双重雷鸣炮齐射，短管型。离远点，否则会被狠狠轰成碎片。 特性：360° 躯干旋转 部署费用倍率：1.24 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: Some High Octane sniffing Pirate got their hands on a perfectly fine Archer and turned it into this Monstrosity, carrying 2 LRM '30' and tons of Flamers. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 某个嗅觉灵敏的高辛烷值海盗弄到了一台完好的 Archer，把它改造成了这副怪物，搭载 2 门 LRM '30' 和成吨的火焰喷射器。 特性：战斗拳套 部署费用倍率：1.1

column1: Cyclops 11-Zs use their imposing presence and unique communications equipment to control the battlefield. Carrying the same Battle Computer as the C10, is this variant enhanced with several LosTech including a C3 Master Computer, further increasing the lances power.
column2: Cyclops 11-Z 利用其压迫性的存在感和独特的通信设备控制战场。该型号搭载与 C10 相同的战斗计算机，并以 C3 主计算机等数种失落科技强化，进一步提升了长枪的战力。

column1: An XL 380 engine powers this pirate Banshee into close range, where it opens up with the Devil's AC20 with surprising accuracy. It also has two Pirate Adv. AMS. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: 一台 XL 380 引擎推动这台海盗 Banshee 冲入近距离，用 Devil 的 AC20 以惊人精度开火。它还配备了两套海盗高级 AMS。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.17

column1: This 3134 field refit of a Hunchback-6S was developed after a minor LCAF officer replaced a damaged LB 20-X with more ER Medium Lasers and an extra SRM-6. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 这款 3134 年的 Hunchback-6S 战地改装型由一名 LCAF 初级军官开发：他将受损的 LB 20-X 换成了更多 ER 中型激光和额外的 SRM-6。 特性：战斗拳套 部署费用倍率：1.04

column1: A support variant, this configuration carries two Arrow IV missile launchers and four tons of ammunition. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是一种支援型配置，搭载两具 Arrow IV 导弹发射器和四吨弹药。 特性：多重锁定 部署费用倍率：1.08 手臂执行器限制：全向

column1: Don't let the stubby UM-R66 'Urbie' fool you. It may look like a walking trash can, but it can mount heavy armor and a grown-up-sized RAC/2 Autocannon. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: 别被矮胖的 UM-R66“Urbie”骗了。它看起来像一只会走路的垃圾桶，却能装上厚重装甲和成人尺寸的 RAC/2 自动火炮。 特性：360°躯干旋转 部署费用倍率：1.02

column1: The Procyon is the first ProtoMech designed and built by Clan Coyote. Procyon 4 Mounts a Streak SRM-3 launcher and Machine Gun in place of the standard ER lasers. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: Procyon 是由土狼氏族设计并制造的第一台 ProtoMech。Procyon 4 以 Streak SRM-3 发射器和机枪取代了标准 ER 激光。 特性：敏捷 部署费用倍率：0.98

column1: A typical Periphery Mech, nothing on this Commando actually comes from one. The entire Engine block is wired around a definitely stolen large Fuel Cell..... Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: 一台典型的边疆 Mech，但这台 Commando 上没有任何部件来自边疆。整个引擎模块都围绕一具明显是偷来的大型燃料电池布线…… 特性：战斗拳套 部署费用倍率：0.96

column1: Converts an SHS engine to DHS. A Mech' Cooling System. The Radical Heat Sink System, increases the ability of the heat sink to flush excess heat much like Coolant Pods. Radical Heat Sinks, however, can fail through repeated use, especially if used continuously.
column2: 将 SHS 引擎转换为 DHS。这是 Mech 的冷却系统。激进散热器系统提升了散热器排出多余热量的能力，效果类似冷却舱。不过，激进散热器在反复使用、尤其是连续使用时可能会失效。

column1: Whatever pirates managed to scrounge this together is either a genius or a madman, or more likely both. How anything in this 'Mech works, is just beyond me. Look at this wire here, Boss. It goes nowhere, right? But if we remove it the 'Mech doesn't start anymore. How?!
column2: 不管那些海盗是怎么拼凑出这东西的，他们要么是天才，要么是疯子，或者更可能两者都是。这台“Mech”里的东西居然能运作，真是超出我的理解。头儿，看看这根线。它根本没接到任何地方，对吧？可一旦拆掉它，这台“Mech”就再也启动不了。怎么回事？！

column1: A Experimental LandAirMech solely designed to give its Rotary Auto Cannon the Wings it so deserves. And they saw their creation and proclaimed all is Good. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: 一台实验性的陆空 Mech，唯一目的就是让它的旋转自动火炮长出应得的翅膀。他们看着自己的造物，宣称一切都很好。 特性：陆空 Mech 部署费用倍率：1.07

column1: A Dark Age configuration, the Strider H carries a pair of clan made Streak LRM-10's and 2 tons of ammo. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是一种黑暗时代配置，Strider H 搭载一对氏族制造的 Streak LRM-10 和 2 吨弹药。 特性：易于驾驶 部署费用倍率：0.97 手臂执行器限制：全向

column1: The only difference between the E and primary configuration are the two ER PPC instead of pulse lasers. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: E 型与主配置的唯一差别，是用两具 ER PPC 替代了脉冲激光。 特性：易于驾驶 部署费用倍率：0.95 手臂执行器限制：全向

column1: This model of the Horned Owl carries a large pulse laser and two medium pulse lasers. The jump jets have been removed and replaced by a targeting computer. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 这款 Horned Owl 搭载一门大型脉冲激光和两门中型脉冲激光。跳跃喷射器被拆除，换成了瞄准计算机。 特性：稳定武器 部署费用倍率：1.04

column1: This version carries a HAG/30 in each arm and eight tons of ammunition in CASE protected bays. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 该型号每条手臂搭载一门 HAG/30，并在 CASE 保护舱中携带八吨弹药。 特性：改良通信 部署费用倍率：1.05 手臂执行器限制：全向

column1: In an attempt to make the Onryo cheaper, the X2 variant design drops the C.A.S.E. and Artemis IV FCS, instead adding a Medium and a Small Laser. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 为了降低 Onryo 的成本，X2 型号设计舍弃了 C.A.S.E. 和 Artemis IV 火控系统，改为增加一门中型激光和一门小型激光。 特性：精准武器 - 导弹 部署费用倍率：0.98

column1: The Duan Gung piloted by Vaughn McDade of Youling Zhanshi replaces the LRM-10 of the original for a pair of LRM-5s. It also carries five tons of armor. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 由幽灵战士 Vaughn McDade 驾驶的 Duan Gung，以一对 LRM-5 替换了原版的 LRM-10。它还携带五吨装甲。 特性：保护执行器 部署费用倍率：1.03

column1: This Dark Age refit of the 27V replaces the missile launchers with MML racks and adds a C3 slave. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 这款 27V 的黑暗时代改装型用 MML 发射架替换了导弹发射器，并加装了一台 C3 从机。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.14 手臂执行器限制：左下

column1: This one's a jack of all trades, tried to cram a bit of everything onto a 65 ton frame for the Rim Worlds. Ended up master of none though, versatile on paper but thin on armor for its size. Pirates loved it despite the maker's denials. Got replaced by the Rampage in 2735.
column2: 这台 Mech 试图在 65 吨的机体上塞进各种功能，成为边疆世界的万金油。结果样样通、样样松；纸面上很全面，但以其尺寸而言装甲过薄。尽管制造商否认，海盗们还是很喜欢它。2735 年它被 Rampage 取代。

column1: The -1NWR refit trades the large laser of the -1NW for a medium laser, thus freeing the space to mount a super charger and Actuator Enhancement System. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: -1NWR 改装型用中型激光替换 -1NW 的大型激光，从而腾出空间安装增压器和执行器增强系统。 特性：改良生命保障 部署费用倍率：1.03

column1: This variant of the Balius carries a Streak LRM-15 and a Streak SRM-6, supported by an ER Large Pulse Laser. A single Improved Heavy Medium Laser covers the rear arc. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 该 Balius 型号搭载一具 Streak LRM-15 和一具 Streak SRM-6，并由一门 ER 大型脉冲激光提供支援。一门改良型重型中型激光负责覆盖后方弧区。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.1

column1: The Triton was designed by Clan Goliath Scorpion for their Seekers. This version carries a single ER Micro Laser in the torso and a Heavy Small Laser on each arm. Quirk: Sprinter Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.978
column2: Triton 由基于巨蝎氏族为其探索者设计。该型号在躯干中搭载一门 ER 微型激光，每条手臂各装一门重型小型激光。 特性：疾跑者 部署费用倍率：0.978

column1: The Leviathan is an attempt at creating the most powerful and supersized mech imaginable. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.42 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Leviathan 旨在打造想象中最强大、体型最大的 Mech。 特性：分散注意 部署费用倍率：1.42 手臂执行器限制：左下，右下

column1: The Leviathan is an attempt at creating the most powerful and supersized mech imaginable. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.48 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Leviathan 旨在打造想象中最强大、体型最大的 Mech。 特性：分散注意 部署费用倍率：1.48 手臂执行器限制：左下，右下

column1: Cyclops 10-Zs use their imposing presence and unique communications equipment to control the battlefield. While the 10-Z carries a lethal array of close range weaponry, its primary role is command and control, bolstering friendly units with its specialized battle computer.
column2: Cyclops 10-Z 利用其压迫性的存在感和独特的通信设备控制战场。10-Z 搭载一套致命的近距离武器，其主要职责却是指挥与控制，凭借专用战斗计算机强化友军单位。

column1: The 'Mech's only weapon is its right arm mounted large pulse laser. To support its role as a scout, the Parash mounts an active probe, ECM suite, and TAG. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
column2: 这台“Mech”唯一的武器是安装在右臂上的大型脉冲激光。为支援侦察任务，Parash 配备了主动探测器、ECM 套件和 TAG。 特性：狭窄/低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：1.06

column1: A RISC prototype version of the Ryoken III-XP experimental design. All details of the design are highly classified. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是 RISC 制造的 Ryoken III-XP 实验设计原型。该设计的所有细节均属高度机密。 特性：稳定 部署费用倍率：1.05 手臂执行器限制：全向

column1: The Jenner JR7-RX design has been adapted to carry several Multi Missile Launcher. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Jenner JR7-RX 的设计经过改造，可搭载数具多用途导弹发射器。 特性：改良生命保障 部署费用倍率：1.02 手臂执行器限制：左上，右上

column1: The Hunchback 1G is a primitive refit trying to retain the 4G's impressive firepower by replacing the weapons with a Medium and Heavy Rifle in place of the AC/20. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.82
column2: Hunchback 1G 是一种原始改装型，试图保留 4G 的惊人火力，以一门中型步枪和一门重型步枪替代 AC/20。 特性：战斗拳套 部署费用倍率：0.82

column1: This configuration carries an SRM-6 in each arm, barely fed by a single ton of ammunition in the right torso. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 该配置每条手臂搭载一具 SRM-6，右侧躯干仅有一吨弹药勉强供给。 特性：易于驾驶 部署费用倍率：0.98 手臂执行器限制：全向

column1: Produced in secret by 'The Society', an organization of Rogue Scientists within the Clans, this prototype testbed Griffin carries advanced Technology and weapons. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.23
column2: 这台原型试验 Griffin 由氏族内部的流亡科学家组织“学会”秘密制造，搭载先进技术与武器。 特性：战斗拳套 部署费用倍率：1.23

column1: The Lament is a Heavy Class BattleMech originally created for the Armed Forces of the Republic of the Sphere in late 3120s. Its blend of firepower and armor has individuals comparing the 'Mech with previous designs such as the Warhammer and the heavier Awesome Assault 'Mech.
column2: Lament 是一款重型 BattleMech，最初于 3120 年代末为球体共和国武装部队制造。其火力与装甲的结合，让一些人将这台“Mech”与 Warhammer 等旧设计，以及更重型的 Awesome 突击“Mech”相提并论。

column1: The 6WW combines an AC/10 in the right torso with two ER Medium Lasers. The source of this variant is unknown, but it is likely some bootleg periphery version. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 6WW 在右侧躯干安装一门 AC/10，并配备两门 ER 中型激光。该型号的来源未知，但很可能是某种边疆仿制版本。 特性：近战执行器 部署费用倍率：1.03

column1: A Clan-developed upgrade that enhances a BattleMech's leg actuators, boosting speed and agility with advanced stride control and servo optimization. This system allows for quicker adjustments to movement, improving both speed and maneuverability across a variety of terrains.
column2: 一种由氏族开发的升级组件，可强化 BattleMech 的腿部执行器，通过先进的步幅控制与伺服优化提升速度和敏捷性。该系统能更快地调整移动，在各种地形中改善速度与机动性。

column1: The Raider 3A upgrades the single heat sinks to the double variety, switches the armor to ferro-fibrous and replaces the Dual Saw with a Retracted Blade. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: Raider 3A 将单散热器升级为双散热器，把装甲更换为铁纤维装甲，并用收缩式刀刃替代双刃锯。 特性：集成探照灯 部署费用倍率：1.04

column1: The Alpha configuration mounts an ER PPC in each arm, with two ER Medium and one ER Small Laser for backup. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Alpha 配置每条手臂安装一门 ER PPC，并以两门 ER 中型激光和一门 ER 小型激光作为辅助武器。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.06 手臂执行器限制：全向

column1: A missile-heavy variant, the C mounts two ATM 9s with four tons of ammunition. A pair of ER Mediums supplement them, while two Medium Pulse Lasers are mounted in the rear. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 这是一种偏重导弹的型号，C 型搭载两具 ATM 9 和四吨弹药。两门 ER 中型激光作为补充，后方则安装两门中型脉冲激光。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.1

column1: A variant based off the 6T, the 6H mounts a mammoth Mydron Ultra Autocannon/20 in place of the gauss rifle. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: 该型号以 6T 为基础，在原高斯步枪的位置安装了一门巨大的 Mydron 超级自动火炮/20。 特性：炮管拳套 部署费用倍率：1.04 手臂执行器限制：右上

column1: Based on old Prototypes of the Project Phoenix 'Super Griffin', the 3-X is an attempt to create a more modern and capable upgrade of the somewhat ancient Griffin. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: 3-X 基于 Project Phoenix“Super Griffin”的旧原型，试图将这款略显古老的 Griffin 升级为更现代、更强大的型号。 特性：空中突袭 部署费用倍率：1.16

column1: The Lament-3M was developed as testbed for the newly-developed Heavy MRM launchers. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Lament-3M 是作为新开发的重型 MRM 发射器试验平台而研发的。 特性：可变射程瞄准 部署费用倍率：1.2 手臂执行器限制：左下，右下

column1: The Scorpion II was introduced as an heavy version of the classical Scorpion, developed by the Draconis Combine. Since the 'Mech is only powered by a 260 XL engine it is considerably slower than the original design, but as a compensation the armoring is significantly increased.
column2: Scorpion II 是由龙蛇联邦开发的经典 Scorpion 重型版本。由于这台“Mech”仅由一具 260 XL 引擎驱动，它比原设计慢得多，但作为补偿，装甲显著增强。

column1: A Jihad-era update of the Commando 2D, the COM-2Dr drops all of the existing weaponry and replaces it with a CASE-protected MML-7 and a single ER Medium Laser. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 这是 Jihad 时代对 Commando 2D 的更新型。COM-2Dr 舍弃全部现有武器，换装一具 CASE 保护的 MML-7 和一门 ER 中型激光。 特性：狭窄/低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：0.98

column1: The JagerMech JO is a field refit that carries 2 Light Gauss Rifles in place of its ACs. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: JagerMech JO 是一款战地改装型，以两门轻型高斯步枪替代原有的自动火炮。 特性：防空瞄准 部署费用倍率：1.09 手臂执行器限制：左上，右上

column1: The Alpha configuration uses two arm-mounted Large Pulse Lasers, with a single LRM-15 Launcher mounted in the head. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Alpha 配置使用两门安装在手臂上的大型脉冲激光，头部则装有一具 LRM-15 发射器。 特性：分散注意 部署费用倍率：1.05 手臂执行器限制：全向

column1: This variant of the Pathfinder replaces the ER Medium Laser with a TAG. As it has no real weapons this even further pushes the 'Mech towards the scouting role. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.78
column2: 该 Pathfinder 型号用 TAG 替换了 ER 中型激光。由于没有真正的武器，这进一步强化了“Mech”的侦察定位。 特性：保护执行器 部署费用倍率：0.78

column1: The Marauder II 5D is a Davion refit to showcase both UAC/10 and a Massive 400XXL Engine. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Marauder II 5D 是一款戴维翁改装型，用于展示 UAC/10 和巨大的 400XXL 引擎。 特性：狭窄/低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：1.18 手臂执行器限制：左下，右下

column1: This variant removes all the weaponry and light active probe of the original Ocelot and replaces them with a large pulse laser and two medium pulse lasers. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
column2: 该型号移除了原 Ocelot 的全部武器和轻型主动探测器，改装一门大型脉冲激光和两门中型脉冲激光。 特性：精准武器 - 激光 部署费用倍率：1.06

column1: This version received 2 Mag Shot rifles in place of its MGs as well as 2 ER Small Lasers. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 该版本用 2 挺 Mag Shot 步枪替代机枪，并增加了 2 门 ER 小型激光。 特性：狭窄/低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：0.97 手臂执行器限制：左上，右上

column1: The Dirge is a custom made variant of the Lament designed for brutal Solaris 7 combat. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Gauss Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Dirge 是 Lament 的定制型号，专为残酷的 Solaris 7 战斗而设计。 特性：精准武器 - 高斯 部署费用倍率：1.2 手臂执行器限制：左下，右下

column1: The 5B replaces the Streak SRM with Inner Sphere SRM-6 launchers to reduce the cost slightly. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
