column2: 5B 用内天体 SRM-6 发射器替换 Streak SRM，以略微降低成本。 特性：战斗计算机 部署费用倍率：1.16 手臂执行器限制：左下，右下

column1: The E configuration is equipped with an ATM 12 launcher, a HAG 20, an ER Medium Laser and a Large Pulse Laser. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: E 型配置搭载一具 ATM 12 发射器、一门 HAG 20、一门 ER 中型激光炮和一门大型脉冲激光炮。 特性：窄身/低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The Echidnae is one of the most rare and powerful Battlemech's, equipped with carefully preserved LosTech is it able to quickly strike hard and suppress the opposition. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
column2: 刺蝎是最稀有且最强大的战斗机甲之一，凭借精心保存的失落科技，它能够迅速发动猛烈打击并压制敌军。 特性：指挥机甲 部署成本倍率：1.11

column1: This variant carries a pair of experimental Clan-made Rotary AC/5s, each with two tons of ammo, an ECM Suite, and additional armor in place of the standard Ultra AC/20s. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 该变体搭载一对实验型氏族制造旋转 AC/5，每门配备两吨弹药，还装有 ECM 套件，并以额外装甲取代标准的 Ultra AC/20。 特性：战斗铁拳 部署成本倍率：1.1

column1: Meant for close in city fighting, the R60LL replaces its Autocannon 20 with an Ultra version. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: R60LL 专为城市近距离作战设计，以 Ultra 型号替换了原有的 Autocannon 20。 特性：360°躯干旋转 部署成本倍率：0.99 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: This Hercules variant is based on the 9003 model, but replaces the Angel ECM suite with a Blue Shield system. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这款 Hercules 变体以 9003 型号为基础，但用 Blue Shield 系统替换了 Angel ECM 套件。 特性：稳定武器 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂执行器限制：右下臂

column1: The TH-A4r-HD was created as many MechWarriors complained about the Machine Guns of the Arrowhead being prone to jamming, leading to them being replaced by two Medium Lasers. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: 由于许多机甲战士抱怨 Arrowhead 的机枪容易卡壳，TH-A4r-HD 应运而生，并将机枪替换为两门中型激光炮。 特性：稳定 部署成本倍率：1.14

column1: Although focused on its two large ATM-9 launchers, the Delta configuration also mounts three medium pulse lasers. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Delta 配置虽然以两具大型 ATM-9 发射器为核心，但还搭载了三门中型脉冲激光炮。 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：1.06 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The Sun Cobra was developed during the Jihad as a fast, long-range raider that was built for speed as much as solid hitting power. The lethal Sun Cobra is used mostly for fire support. The simple design and construction of the Sun Cobra leaves little to a MechWarrior's imagination.
column2: 太阳眼镜蛇是在圣战期间研发的高速远程突袭机，既追求速度，也具备强大的火力。致命的太阳眼镜蛇主要用于火力支援。其简单的设计与构造让机甲战士几乎没有发挥空间。

column1: Yeah Well Boss, this is a Hollander, or whats left of it, they replaced the myomer and stabilizers with some Industrial Junk and completely ruined the Weapon Assembly. Quirk: Industrial TSM Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 是的，老板，这是一台 Hollander，或者说是剩下的部分。他们用一些工业废料替换了肌腱和稳定器，还把武器组件彻底弄坏了。 特性：工业型 TSM 部署成本倍率：1.05

column1: Configuration D combines an Ultra AC/10 with an ER PPC and two Medium Pulse Lasers for better mid range performance. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: D 配置将 Ultra AC/10 与 ER PPC 及两门中型脉冲激光炮结合，以提升中距离作战性能。 特性：易于驾驶 部署成本倍率：1.09 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: A Uziel salvaged an refitted by the Confederacy Capella to be fielded among their Stealth and Recon Units. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这台 Uziel 经卡佩拉联邦回收并改装，供其隐形与侦察部队使用。 特性：颈甲 部署成本倍率：1.04 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: Blackjacks are supposed to be solid, well-rounded 'Mechs for their tonnage. This... isn't. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 按理说，Blackjack 应该是与吨位相称、坚固而均衡的机甲。但这台……不是。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 部署成本倍率：1.01 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The Cephalus D mounts a single Improved Heavy Large Laser backed up by a trio of Improved Heavy Small Lasers. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Cephalus D 搭载一门改进型重型大型激光炮，并由三门改进型重型小型激光炮提供支援。 特性：改进型生命维持系统 部署成本倍率：1.01 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: A long-range variant of the Dakota, the DKA-24 replaces the SRM-6 launchers with another LRM-20. The AC/2 is also replaced by two more Medium Lasers. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Missile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: DKA-24 是 Dakota 的远程变体，以另一具 LRM-20 发射器替换了 SRM-6 发射器，并用两门中型激光炮替换了 AC/2。 特性：改进型冷却套——导弹 部署成本倍率：1.15

column1: Developed by The Society this version uses an ER Micro Laser and LRM-4. It is also equipped with a Magnetic Clamp system so it can move around the battlefield more efficiently. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 该版本由社会组织研发，使用一门 ER 微型激光炮和一具 LRM-4 发射器。它还配备磁力夹持系统，能更高效地在战场上移动。 特性：灵活 部署成本倍率：0.98

column1: Yeah Boss, why do you keep bringing me junk, like any 'Cockroach' will this thing never die.... Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 老板，你为什么老是带些垃圾回来？像这样的“蟑螂”一样，这东西难道永远不会死吗…… 特性：360°躯干旋转 部署成本倍率：0.97 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: Seemingly raided from the DCMS was this mauler refit to accomodate a load of Jury Rigged Artillery. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这台 Mauler 似乎是从龙马联盟军队手中抢来的，并被改装以容纳一整套临时拼装火炮。 特性：分散注意 部署成本倍率：1.16 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: This 'Commando' was found in a Deep Periphery Weapons Cache. Named after the Furies of Terran Mythology, it packs a surprisingly mean punch for its size. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - PPC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
column2: 这台“突击队”是在深层边疆的武器库中发现的。它以地球神话中的复仇女神命名，以其尺寸而言，火力强得出人意料。 特性：改进型冷却套——PPC 部署成本倍率：1.11

column1: Developed as much to replace units lost as to prove the enduring industrial strength of the Draconis Combine, the Wight is a daring and innovative Mech design. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: Wight 的研发既是为了填补损失的部队，也是为了证明龙马联盟持久的工业实力；这是一款大胆而创新的机甲设计。 特性：改进型通信 部署成本倍率：1.05

column1: A more conservative take on the Atrax 1, the Atrax 6 replaces the Gauss rifle with two ER Large lasers to ensure combat capabilities even if the 'Mech runs out of ammunition. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.5
column2: Atrax 6 是对 Atrax 1 更为保守的改进版，用两门 ER 大型激光炮替换了高斯步枪，确保机甲即使耗尽弹药也能继续作战。 特性：多目标追踪 部署成本倍率：1.5

column1: Usually known as a Militarized Industrial Mech was this roughneck upgraded with many advanced technologies to serve as a Testbed for the RISC Hyper Assault Gauss Rifle Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12
column2: 这台 Roughneck 通常被称为军事化工业机甲，经过多项先进技术升级后，作为 RISC 超级突击高斯步枪的测试平台。 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：1.12

column1: The most popular variant in Clan Steel Viper adds a Small Pulse Laser and a pair of Streak SRM-6s to the Flamer. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是钢毒蛇氏族中最受欢迎的变体，在火焰喷射器之外增加了一门小型脉冲激光炮和一对 Streak SRM-6。 特性：受保护的执行器 部署成本倍率：0.99 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The Triton was designed by Clan Goliath Scorpion for their Seekers. This variant replaces the Streak and ER Micro Laser of the standard model for a single Heavy Medium Laser. Quirk: Sprinter Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.978
column2: Triton 由戈利亚斯蝎子氏族为其探索者设计。该变体以一门重型中型激光炮替换标准型号的 Streak 和 ER 微型激光炮。 特性：疾跑者 部署成本倍率：0.978

column1: The Blurr BL-U13 replaces the PPCs of the U11 with two AC/5s and a Medium Laser. The decreased heat generation made the variant far more suitable for hotter environments. Quirk: Well Balanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: Blurr BL-U13 用两门 AC/5 和一门中型激光炮替换了 U11 的 PPC。降低的热量生成使该变体更适合炎热环境。 特性：平衡良好 部署成本倍率：1.16

column1: The A loadout is fitted with a single ER PPC, with four additional double heat sinks to help keep the configuration stay cool. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: A 配置装配一门 ER PPC，并额外配备四个双倍散热器，以帮助维持冷却。 特性：灵活 部署成本倍率：1.09 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: This configuration carries a pair of ER medium lasers in the left arm and a single medium pulse laser in the right arm. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 该配置在左臂搭载一对 ER 中型激光炮，在右臂搭载一门中型脉冲激光炮。 特性：易于驾驶 部署成本倍率：0.98 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: Based on the LMT-3C, this version of the 'Mech uses a mix of Clan weaponry and equipment. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 该机甲以 LMT-3C 为基础，采用了氏族武器与装备的混合配置。 特性：可变射程瞄准 部署成本倍率：1.09 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: A custom Incubus II for the Zellbrigen Stables, bringing a Customized Large Laser Rifle. Designed to show as much a Clan's Combat as well as Technical Prowess. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - HandHeld Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
column2: 这是为泽尔布里根马厩定制的 Incubus II，搭载定制型大型激光步枪，旨在展现氏族的战斗与技术实力。 特性：精准武器——手持 部署成本倍率：1.11

column1: The -XJ combines huge booster jets for jump capabilities with a fast striking weapons loadout in form of ER Large Lasers, Light PPCs and Artemis IV-enabled MML launchers. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.29
column2: -XJ 将巨大的助推喷气引擎与快速打击武器配置结合起来，装备 ER 大型激光炮、轻型 PPC 和支持 Artemis IV 的 MML 发射器。 特性：战斗计算机 部署成本倍率：1.29

column1: This 'Mech seems to have an old fashioned phone booth mounted in the cockpit that says "Phone Home". Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这台机甲的驾驶舱里似乎装着一间老式电话亭，上面写着“打电话回家”。 特性：稳定武器 部署成本倍率：1.14 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: A close range variant of the Götterdämmerung, replacing the ER Medium Lasers with three Medium Pulse Lasers and an ER Flamer. The LRM launcher is also replaced by a SRM-6. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
column2: 这是 Götterdämmerung 的近距离变体，以三门中型脉冲激光炮和一具 ER 火焰喷射器替换 ER 中型激光炮，并将 LRM 发射器替换为 SRM-6。 特性：稳定武器 部署成本倍率：1.11

column1: The personal Fafnir of Peter Steiner Davion, equipped with a special 3-Pack RL 20 system in both Arms. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是 Peter Steiner Davion 的私人 Fafnir，双臂均装备特殊的三联 RL 20 系统。 特性：指挥机甲 部署成本倍率：1.22 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: However this Black Python ended up in the hands of a pirate is a mystery; the scarier mystery is how they got advanced and experimental technology into it. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
column2: 这台 Black Python 不知为何落入了海盗手中；更可怕的谜团是，他们究竟如何将先进的实验技术装进了它。 特性：改进型冷却套——激光 部署成本倍率：1.11

column1: Some pilots complained about the lack of long-range weaponry on the two other Lightray variants, so the -5W simply replaces the large pulse laser with an ER PPC. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 一些飞行员抱怨另外两种 Lightray 变体缺乏远程武器，因此 -5W 直接用 ER PPC 替换了大型脉冲激光炮。 特性：超伸展执行器 部署成本倍率：1.05

column1: Fortress installation safeguarding the surrounding area. Armor: Armor Amount: 150 Structure: Structure Amount: 1 Engine: 0 Standard Fusion Equipment: Weapons: 4x Infantry Flamer Ammunition:
column2: 守护周边区域的堡垒设施。 装甲： 装甲 数量： 150 结构： 结构 数量： 1 引擎： 0 标准融合 装备： 武器： 4x 步兵火焰喷射器 弹药：

column1: This prototype carries four medium lasers into combat. It uses six improved jump jets to provide a 180 meter jump radius. Otherwise it is identical to the other prototypes. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 这台原型机携带四门中型激光炮投入战斗，并使用六具改进型跳跃喷射器提供 180 米的跳跃半径。除此之外，它与其他原型机完全相同。 特性：空中突击 部署成本倍率：0.98

column1: The latest in the line of Wolverines from Free World's League, the WVR-11M consolidated iterative structural upgrades without improving performance of the WVR-7M2. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 这是自由世界联盟最新一代的 Wolverine，WVR-11M 整合了多项渐进式结构升级，却没有改善 WVR-7M2 的性能。 特性：改进型通信 部署成本倍率：1.05

column1: The third variant of the Ferox replaces the PPCs with four Ultra AC/5s to reduce the need for cooling. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.5 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Ferox 的第三种变体用四门 Ultra AC/5 替换了 PPC，以降低对冷却系统的需求。 特性：稳定武器 部署成本倍率：1.5 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: The Primary configuration of the Umbriel carries two ER PPC and two LRM-20 launchers besides the Astra Hammer autocannon. Quirk: Wrath of Blake Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.26 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Umbriel 的主要配置除 Astra Hammer 自动火炮外，还搭载两门 ER PPC 和两具 LRM-20 发射器。 特性：布莱克之怒 部署成本倍率：1.26 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: A second variant which also uses an Extralight Gyroscope and replaces the Autocannon/10 with an Ultra Autocannon/20. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
column2: 这是第二种变体，同样使用超轻型陀螺仪，并以 Ultra Autocannon/20 替换 Autocannon/10。 特性：近战执行器 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂执行器限制：左上臂

column1: I dont know who, or why, but someone thought a Marauder would be the perfect fit for a Long Tom Cannon Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 我不知道是谁，也不知道为什么，但有人认为 Marauder 最适合搭载 Long Tom 火炮。 特性：稳定武器 部署成本倍率：1.11 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: Failed experiment by failed scientists, this UrbanMech can convert into an almost useless tank form. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 失败科学家制造的失败实验品，这台 UrbanMech 能变形成几乎毫无用处的坦克形态。 特性：360°躯干旋转 部署成本倍率：0.97 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: This one's a real all rounder boss, built by Blankenburg for House Kurita once Gauss tech finally spread out from the Hegemony. Machine gun ammo tucked right under the cockpit earned it the nickname hot seat among pilots. Dropped from production in 2800 in favor of the BattleMaster line.
column2: 老板，这是真正的全能型机甲。高斯技术终于从霸权领域传播开后，布兰肯堡为久利塔家族打造了它。驾驶舱正下方的机枪弹药让它在飞行员中赢得了“烫手座椅”的绰号。2800 年停产，改由 BattleMaster 系列取代。

column1: Used by Christina Sante, a known associate of The Bounty Hunter, this version trades the Inner Sphere large laser for a Clan model and adds TAG to the center torso. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 这款型号由赏金猎人的知名盟友 Christina Sante 使用，以氏族型号替换了内圈大型激光炮，并在中央躯干增设 TAG。 特性：改进型通信 部署成本倍率：1.05

column1: It's a Quickdraw, whoever stole the parts for it wasnt all to stupid though, giving it Improved Jump Jets and a Jump pack turning it into a oversized Mudstomper. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - HandHeld Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 这是 Quickdraw，偷取零件的人虽然不算太蠢，但给它装上了改进型跳跃喷射器和跳跃背包，把它变成了一台超大型 Mudstomper。 特性：精准武器——手持 部署成本倍率：1.08

column1: This adorable Trashcan was refit to be used for Agrarian work and self defense on the Deep Periphery. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.77 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这台可爱的“垃圾桶”经过改装，用于深层边疆的农业工作和自卫。 特性：360°躯干旋转 部署成本倍率：0.77 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The Triton was designed by Clan Goliath Scorpion for their Seekers. This is a fire-support variant equipped with an LRM-3 launcher a pair of ER Micro Lasers and an ER Small Laser. Quirk: Sprinter Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.978
column2: Triton 由戈利亚斯蝎子氏族为其探索者设计。这是一款火力支援变体，装备一具 LRM-3 发射器、一对 ER 微型激光炮和一门 ER 小型激光炮。 特性：疾跑者 部署成本倍率：0.978

column1: Like An unstoppable Zombie, the mech known as the cauldron born takes the battlefield striking fear into its opponents. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 如同不可阻挡的僵尸，这台被称为“坩埚之生”的机甲踏上战场，让敌人心生恐惧。 特性：窄身/低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: Built with experimental RISC Technology, this Mauler excels at dealing extreme alpha strikes at all ranges. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这台 Mauler 采用实验型 RISC 技术制造，擅长在所有射程上发动极强的齐射。 特性：分散注意 部署成本倍率：1.21 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: Like An unstoppable Zombie, the mech known as the cauldron born takes the battlefield striking fear into its opponents. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 如同不可阻挡的僵尸，这台被称为“坩埚之生”的机甲踏上战场，让敌人心生恐惧。 特性：窄身/低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：1.12 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The GAL-6GLS replaces the ER PPC for the 1GLS with a Binary Laser together with two Large Lasers and four Medium Lasers. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: GAL-6GLS 用一门二元激光替换了 1GLS 的 ER PPC，另配两门大型激光和四门中型激光。 特性：易于驾驶 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂执行器限制：右下臂

column1: The Boyyi 2 variant replaces the active probe with a second Improved Heavy Medium Laser. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Boyyi 2 型号用第二门改进型重型中型激光替换了主动探测器。 特性：先进光学 部署成本倍率：1.03 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 许可使用。

column1: Appealing to patient warriors, the bravo configuration uses an LB 2-X AC, a Medium Pulse Laser, and an ER Medium Laser. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 青睐耐心战士的 Bravo 配置使用一门 LB 2-X AC、一门中型脉冲激光和一门 ER 中型激光。 特性：受保护的执行器 部署成本倍率：0.99 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The Rikki Tikki Tavi 4 is more a variation of the Rikki Tikki Tavi 1 than its own model, as it keeps the Gauss Rifle and Lasers, while the Ultra AC/20 is replaced by two LBX AC/10. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24
column2: Rikki Tikki Tavi 4 更像是 Rikki Tikki Tavi 1 的变型，而非独立型号：它保留了高斯步枪和激光武器，将 Ultra AC/20 替换为两门 LBX AC/10。 特性：分散注意 部署成本倍率：1.24

column1: The -S3-DC subvariant of the -S3 replaces the two Small Lasers and two heatsinks with a Command Cockpit. The variant quickly became the main command Atlas within the Lyran forces. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: -S3-DC 是 -S3 的子变型，用指挥座舱替换了两门小型激光和两组散热器。该变型很快成为莱拉军队的主力指挥 Atlas。 特性：战斗铁拳 部署成本倍率：1.18

column1: A design that was more Capellan than Canopian, this design utilized a standard gyro instead of the compact gyro. In addition to the ER medium lasers, the 35A utilized a pair of LRM-10s. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 这是一款比坎诺普斯更偏卡佩兰风格的设计，使用标准陀螺仪而非紧凑型陀螺仪。除 ER 中型激光外，35A 还配备一对 LRM-10。 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.05

column1: Used by RISC as a testbed, this King Crab has been rebuilt from the ground up with experimental technology.. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.29 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这台 King Crab 被 RISC 用作试验平台，从头到脚重建并采用了实验性技术。 特性：指挥机甲 部署成本倍率：1.29 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The production version of the Pandarus replaces the fragile composite internal structure with an endo steel skeleton. Aside from that difference, it is identical to the LFA-1X. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
column2: Pandarus 的量产版用内骨骼钢骨架替换了脆弱的复合内部结构。除此差异外，它与 LFA-1X 完全相同。 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：1.11

column1: Used by RISC as a testbed, this Orion has been rebuilt from the ground up with experimental technology. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这台 Orion 被 RISC 用作试验平台，从头到脚重建并采用了实验性技术。 特性：防空瞄准 部署成本倍率：1.16 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: Some 'Mech-happy Texas rednecks with too much energy C-Bills met with some Sparkle-Fish types and this is the result. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 一些精力过剩、拥有太多 C-Bills 的得州机甲狂热乡巴佬，遇上了几个 “闪光鱼”类型的人，于是就有了这个结果。 特性：360° 躯干旋转 部署成本倍率：0.95 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: This variant mounts an Artemis IV FCS enhanced LRM-20 and a pair of ER Medium Lasers in each arm. For additional short range firepower, an LB 20-X AC is carried in the right torso. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24
column2: 该变型在每条手臂上都装有一具 Artemis IV 火控系统增强型 LRM-20。为增加近程火力，右侧躯干还装有一门 LB 20-X AC。 特性：战斗铁拳 部署成本倍率：1.24

column1: The Exarch Crab XRC-00X is a special variant of the 'Mech, developed as a testbed for the prototype EPAC PPCs. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.34 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Exarch Crab XRC-00X 是该机甲的特殊变型，作为原型 EPAC PPC 的试验平台开发。 特性：指挥机甲 部署成本倍率：1.34 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The BattleMech Vibroblade was developed by Draconis Combine engineers. Using their Sword as a foundation, they were able to incorporate the same technology that makes the personal vibroblade and vibrokatana so effective. \n\n Increases Melee Damage when Activated.
column2: 战斗机甲振动刃由龙华联合体工程师开发。他们以剑为基础，成功融入了令个人振动刃和振动武士刀如此高效的相同技术。 \n\n 激活后可提高近战伤害。

column1: Would'cha look at this! Not only did they salvage and abuse a perfectly fine Hatchetman, they've put spikes all over it, even the Hatched got cut and filed down to be 'Spikey'.... Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
column2: 瞧瞧这个！他们不仅打捞并糟蹋了一台完好的 Hatchetman，还在上面到处加装尖刺，连战斧都被切割打磨成了“尖刺”形状…… 特性：近战执行器 部署成本倍率：1.06

column1: The Black Knight 7B is a refit made for and sold to Mercenary Commanders deeply in favour with the Federated Commonwealth, sporting advanced Technologies and Prototype X-Pulse Laser. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
column2: Black Knight 7B 是为深受联邦共同体青睐的雇佣兵指挥官打造并出售的改装型，配备先进技术和原型 X 脉冲激光。 特性：指挥机甲 部署成本倍率：1.11

column1: The Patriot PKM-2E has three, Artemis-enhanced MML-7s instead of the earlier versions artillery and large autocannon. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Right Lower, Left Upper
column2: Patriot PKM-2E 配备三具 Artemis 增强型 MML-7，取代了早期型号的火炮和大型自动火炮。 特性：稳定 部署成本倍率：1.09 手臂执行器限制：右下臂、左上臂

column1: The X configuration mounts a RAC/2 in the right arm, and two improved heavy medium lasers in the left arm for concentrated fire support. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: X 配置在右臂装有一门 RAC/2，在左臂装有两门改进型重型中型激光，用于集中火力支援。 特性：稳定 部署成本倍率：1.04 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: Commissioned by a Lyran Jockey, the Giftzwerg, or Poisoned Dwarf, greatly boosts the Imp's defensive capacitys. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 一名莱拉骑手委托制造了 Giftzwerg（意为“中毒的矮人”），大幅提升了 Imp 的防御能力。 特性：指挥机甲 部署成本倍率：1.24 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The Kraken may be made by pirates welding different Crab parts together but it's surprisingly well made, though theres some profanity's etched in the chassis towards their ''Queen''. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24
column2: Kraken 也许是海盗把不同的 Crab 部件焊在一起拼成的，但成品出奇地精良；不过底盘上还刻着一些针对他们那位“女王”的脏话。 特性：威慑 部署成本倍率：1.24

column1: The Raven 5F combines a ER Large Laser with three ER Medium Lasers and an Artemis IV-enabled SRM-6 launcher. Quirk: Improved Jammer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Raven 5F 将一门 ER 大型激光、三门 ER 中型激光和一具 Artemis IV 增强型 SRM-6 发射器组合在一起。 特性：改进型干扰器 部署成本倍率：1.05 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: Another prototype has performance and protection identical to the standard Brigand. Its weaponry has been changed to five standard medium lasers, and it carries an Angel ECM suite. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 另一台原型机的性能和防护与标准 Brigand 完全相同。它将武器改为五门标准中型激光，并配备 Angel ECM 套件。 特性：空中突击 部署成本倍率：0.98

column1: This Celerity model uses a smaller engine, limiting it to a top speed of approximately 230 km/h. It also removes the MASC system and some armor to make room for a TSEMP One-Shot. Quirk: Quad Mech (Squad) Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.94
column2: 这款 Celerity 使用较小的引擎，最高速度限制在约 230 公里/小时。它还拆除了 MASC 系统和部分装甲，以腾出空间安装一次性 TSEMP。 特性：四足机甲（小队） 部署成本倍率：0.94

column1: The Akuma is a experimental Assassin II with specialized targeting systems designed to destroy the equilibrium of a targets Gyro. Quirk: Integrated TSM Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Akuma 是一台实验型 Assassin II，配备专用瞄准系统，旨在破坏目标陀螺仪的平衡。 特性：集成 TSM 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: This variant uses a Magshot, Firedrake Needler, and Small Variable Speed Pulse Laser. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: 该变型使用一门 Magshot、一把 Firedrake 针刺枪和一门小型可变速脉冲激光。 特性：伏击者 部署成本倍率：0.896 只能由内部舱室运输，可近战，不可集群攻击。

column1: A Dark Age variant of the Lupus, the Lupus C pairs Improved Heavy Lasers with a Targeting Computer and a Supercharger. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Lupus C 是 Lupus 的黑暗时代变型，将改进型重型激光与瞄准计算机和引擎增压器结合起来。 特性：超伸展执行器 部署成本倍率：1.07 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: Quicsell's Medium Missile Support. The TBT-WS4 is Quicsell's premium mine laying mech. With four tons of mixed mine ammunition, you can ensure that you dictate the flow of battle. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: Quicsell 的中型导弹支援机。TBT-WS4 是 Quicsell 的高级布雷机甲。配备四吨混合型布雷弹药，你可以确保战局走向由你掌控。 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：1.02

column1: This once was just an average Commando but someone padded it up with spikes and grapplers all over, unfortunately the badly maintained actuators decrease its chance to punch anything. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: 这台 Commando 原本只是普通型号，但有人给它全身加装了尖刺和抓钩；遗憾的是，维护不善的执行器降低了它击中目标的机会。 特性：战斗铁拳 部署成本倍率：0.96

column1: This one's a bug killer, boss, built by the Free Worlds League with anti-infantry as the whole point. No expense spared either, XL engine, ferro-fibrous plating, double heat sinks all around. Production line got hit by saboteurs before the Amaris war even properly kicked off, never rebuilt after.
column2: 这家伙可是专门灭虫的，老大。它由自由世界联盟制造，目的就是反步兵，完全不计成本：XL 引擎、铁素纤维装甲，还有到处都是双重散热器。阿马里斯战争真正打响前，生产线就遭到破坏；此后再也没有重建。

column1: The Cecerops ProtoMech was designed and built by Clan Blood Spirit using materials acquired from Clan Snow Raven. Though not as heavily armored as some other ProtoMechs, the design's high speed prevents most opponents from getting a target lock. The Cecerops is armed with a single ER Micro Laser.
column2: Cecerops 原型机甲由鲜血幽灵氏族设计并制造，使用从雪鸦氏族获得的材料。虽然装甲不如其他一些原型机甲厚重，但其高速让大多数对手难以锁定目标。Cecerops 配备一门 ER 微型激光。

column1: The establishment of the WVR-10D program further allowed the implementation of the WVR-10V2, updating an old drawing board variant with increased mobility and a Gauss rifle. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: WVR-10D 项目的建立进一步促成了 WVR-10V2 的实现：这款原本停留在图纸上的变型提升了机动性，并配备一支高斯步枪。 特性：改进型通信 部署成本倍率：1.05

column1: Based on the 4C, this Taurian version introduced in 3082 uses an XL Engine, Endo Steel chassis, and five jump jets. The armament has been replaced with a Heavy PPC and Light PPC. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 这款基于 4C 的陶瑞安变型于 3082 年推出，使用 XL 引擎、内骨骼钢底盘和五具跳跃喷射器。武器改为一门重型 PPC 和一门轻型 PPC。 特性：窄身/低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：1.08

column1: Nimikatchi and Majesty Metals worked together to create this Republic era variant. 12 double heat sinks dissipate the heat generated by the heavy PPC and light PPC carried by the 'Mech. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: Nimikatchi 与 Majesty Metals 合作打造了这款共和国时代变型。12 组双重散热器负责消散该机甲搭载的重型 PPC 和轻型 PPC 产生的热量。 特性：战斗铁拳 部署成本倍率：1.05

column1: This Marauder II was introduced by the Clans for a Mercenary who earned a honoured place among the Warriors. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.28 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这台 Marauder II 是氏族为一名在战士中赢得崇高地位的雇佣兵推出的变型。 特性：窄身/低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：1.28 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: The popular -7V2 uses a simple weapon swap to increase the -7V’s range and reduce its ammunition dependence. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 广受欢迎的 -7V2 通过简单的武器替换，增加了 -7V 的射程并降低了对弹药的依赖。 特性：窄身/低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：0.97 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The Jenner JR8-X is a commissioned Mercenary Design, bringing Thunderbolt launcher with pinpoint accuracy. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Jenner JR8-X 是受委托制造的雇佣兵设计，配备一具具备精准打击能力的雷霆霹雳发射器。 特性：改进型生命维持系统 部署成本倍率：1.02 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The Lament-3L was designed around two massive Hyper Lasers as well as a Blue Shield and a pulse module. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Lament-3L 围绕两门巨型超能激光设计，同时配备 Blue Shield 和脉冲模块。 特性：可变射程瞄准 部署成本倍率：1.2 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: Some Pirate Band captured a messed up Kodiak, painted it pink, and replaced the cosmetic claws with a bunch of VibroClaws...... And Yeah, that is Pink Plush and Fluffy dice in the Cockpit Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.3
column2: 某个海盗团伙捕获了一台破破烂烂的 Kodiak，把它涂成粉红色，还用一堆振动爪替换了装饰性爪子……没错，驾驶舱里还有粉红色的毛绒骰子。 特性：战斗铁拳 部署成本倍率：1.3

column1: Fortress installation safeguarding the surrounding area. Armor: Armor Amount: 200 Structure: Structure Amount: 1 Engine: 0 Standard Fusion Equipment: Weapons: 2x Infantry LRM Ammunition: 4x Ammo LRM
column2: 守护周边区域的堡垒设施。 装甲：装甲 数值：200 结构：结构 数值：1 引擎：0 标准融合 设备： 武器： 2x 步兵 LRM 弹药： 4x LRM 弹药

column1: The Hammer is a 'Mech that was built to provide fire support for light 'Mechs. Redesigned with a low tier Stealth suite was this version redesigned as a short range brawler. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: Hammer 是一款为轻型机甲提供火力支援而制造的机甲。该型号重新设计为近程格斗机，并配备低级隐形套件。 特性：改进瞄准——远程 部署成本倍率：1.04

column1: Hey boss, the inside of this cockpit has the words 'write something funny for how we got this' scratched into it. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 老大，这个驾驶舱内部刻着这样一句话：“写点有趣的，说明我们是怎么弄到它的。” 特性：先进光学 部署成本倍率：1.15 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: It carries two Streak SRM-4 launchers in the legs, while each arm carries a Light PPC and MML-7. The 'Mech's top speed was reduced, so engineers fitted Improved Jump Jets to compensate. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 它的双腿各装有一具 Streak SRM-4 发射器，每条手臂各装有一门轻型 PPC 和一具 MML-7。由于机甲最高速度降低，工程师安装了改进型跳跃喷射器作为补偿。 特性：稳定武器 部署成本倍率：1.09

column1: Slightly differing from the base model, the K1 variant drops the base K3's ER small laser and small pulse laser for an additional ER medium laser, and upgrades the SRM-6 to a Streak SRM-6. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: K1 变型与基础型号略有不同：它拆除了基础 K3 的 ER 小型激光和小型脉冲激光，换成一门额外的 ER 中型激光，并将 SRM-6 升级为 Streak SRM-6。 特性：分散注意 部署成本倍率：1.02

column1: A field refit of the DOL-1A1 nicknamed Yoh Ti Ts'ang. This variant swaps the standard sword and Angel ECM suite for TAG and a light vibroblade. It is used mainly by the Warrior Houses. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: DOL-1A1 的战地改装型，昵称为 Yoh Ti Ts'ang。该变型用 TAG 和轻型振动刃替换了标准长剑及 Angel ECM 套件，主要由战士家族使用。 特性：近战执行器 部署成本倍率：0.99

column1: The Phantom R mounts two Improved Heavy Medium Lasers and two Medium Lasers, combined with a SRM-6 launcher for short range fights. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Phantom R 装有两门改进型重型中型激光和两门中型激光，并配备一具用于近程战斗的 SRM-6 发射器。 特性：改进传感器 部署成本倍率：1.03 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: Quicsell's Light Laser Sniper. The WSP-QS1 only has one weapon, but it uses it to great effect. A Heavy Large Chem Laser for pinpoint damage to rip apart enemy mechs from stealth. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95
column2: Quicsell 的轻型激光狙击机。WSP-QS1 只有一件武器，却能将其发挥到极致：一门重型大型化学激光，能够从隐蔽处精确撕裂敌方机甲。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 部署成本倍率：0.95

column1: A reworked variant of the original TDK-7X, the TDK-7KEM trades a Medium Laser and some Gauss ammo for an emergency C3 Master unit. The remaining Medium Lasers are upgraded to ER versions. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 这是原始 TDK-7X 的重制变型。TDK-7KEM 牺牲一门中型激光和部分高斯弹药，换装一台紧急 C3 主机；剩余的中型激光则升级为 ER 型号。 特性：指挥机甲 部署成本倍率：1.18

column1: This one's MaxTech's only try at a proper BattleMech boss, and it shows. Had to import armor and the pulse laser from the Hegemony since they couldn't make their own, cutting into profits something fierce. That AC/5 jam issue never got sorted either. Factory got wrecked in 2777, company folded after.
column2: 这是 MaxTech 唯一一次尝试制造真正的战斗机甲，而且结果显而易见。他们无法自行生产装甲和脉冲激光，只能从星盟进口，利润因此大幅缩水。AC/5 的卡弹问题也始终没有解决。工厂于 2777 年被摧毁，公司随后倒闭。

column1: The Minotaur 4 uses same armor protection as the second variant, but has speed of the third. Its only weapon is the newly developed Class 2 ProtoMech Autocannon with 16 rounds of ammunition. Quirk: Resilient Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.984
column2: Minotaur 4 使用与第二种变型相同的装甲防护，但拥有第三种变型的速度。它唯一的武器是一门新开发的 2 级原型机甲自动火炮，配备 16 发弹药。 特性：坚韧 部署成本倍率：0.984

column1: A massive 320 XL engine powers this pirate Archer towards it's foes, and the fixed Spiked Fists make sure that they feel it when it arrives. It also has a custom Pirate AMS in both torsos. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 一台巨大的 320 级 XL 引擎驱动这台海盗 Archer 冲向敌人，固定式尖刺拳确保敌人能感受到它的撞击。它还在两个躯干中各装有一台定制海盗 AMS。 特性：战斗铁拳 部署成本倍率：1.1

column1: The Hellbringer GP is a laser-heavy version of the 'Mech. Designed for sustained combat, this 'Mech can always go the distance. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Hellbringer GP 是该机甲的重激光型。为持续作战而设计，这台机甲始终能够坚持到底。 特性：集成探照灯 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: Designed as a surveillance and rescue drone, Plasma Beak has the ability to cut through heavy hull structures. Quirk: Well Designed Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 作为一架侦察与救援无人机，Plasma Beak能够切穿厚重的舰体结构。 特性：设计精良 部署成本倍率：0.95 可安装全能模块，可近战，可群袭。

column1: The Gorgon is a heavy fire support unit that often anchors ProtoMech Points. This variant utilizes short-range missiles in place of its laser weaponry, and mount a more powerful engine. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.978
column2: Gorgon是一台重型火力支援单位，常作为原型机甲编队的核心。该变体以短程导弹取代激光武器，并安装了更强力的引擎。 特性：标准部件 部署成本倍率：0.978

column1: The VP-8 replaces the Blazer cannons, using the tonnage saved to revert to a conventional structure, boost its heat dissipation, and increase its speed with a 350-rated XL engine. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: VP-8用节省下来的吨位改回常规结构，提升散热能力，并通过350级XL引擎提高速度，以取代Blazer炮。 特性：改进通信 部署成本倍率：1.1

column1: The 4G field modification, developed in 3065, replaces the ER PPC with a large pulse laser for an accurate, stronger close-range punch at the expense of the 'Mech's long-range firepower. Quirk: Improved Jammer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
column2: 4G型战地改装于3065年完成，以大型脉冲激光替换ER PPC，牺牲机甲的远程火力，换取精准且更强的近距离打击力。 特性：改进干扰器 部署成本倍率：1.01

column1: A mixed tech loadout, the Pouncer T uses two Inner Sphere Plasma Rifles as its main weapons to protect itself during its scouting role. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 作为混合科技配置，Pouncer T使用两支内太阳圈等离子步枪作为主武器，以在侦察任务中保护自身。 特性：空袭 部署成本倍率：1.03 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The Procyon is the first ProtoMech designed and built by Clan Coyote. Procyon 2 removes the heat sinks and small lasers and replaces them with a pair of LRM-4 launchers and some additional armor. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: Procyon是由Coyote氏族设计并制造的第一台原型机甲。Procyon 2拆除散热器和小型激光，换装一对LRM-4发射器及额外装甲。 特性：灵活 部署成本倍率：0.98

column1: With a full missile boat focus the Menace's M configuration mounts a total of 10 LRM-20 launchers, with two Extended Range Heavy PPCs and one Extended Range Large Laser as backup weapons. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.42
column2: Menace的M配置完全专注于导弹火力，搭载总计10具LRM-20发射器，并以两门远程重型PPC和一门远程大型激光作为备用武器。 特性：稳定武器 部署成本倍率：1.42

column1: This version carries an improved C3 computer, snub-nose PPC, ER medium laser, and two MML-3 launchers in the left torso. To make room for these weapons, the 7W uses an XL gyro. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 该版本在左侧躯干配备改进型C3计算机、短管PPC、ER中型激光和两具MML-3发射器。为腾出安装空间，7W采用了XL陀螺仪。 特性：超伸展执行器 部署成本倍率：1.05

column1: The I configuration is focused on a support role, with an iNarc beacon launcher. It also carries two SRM-4 and two Medium Lasers. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: I配置专注于支援任务，配备iNarc信标发射器，同时携带两具SRM-4和两门中型激光。 特性：加长躯干扭转 部署成本倍率：0.97 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The Harpy, the first ProtoMech ever created, it is about as effective as a single elemental, it did however show that Protomechs could be a effective weapon. This Variant carries a ER Micro Laser Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95
column2: Harpy是有史以来制造的第一台原型机甲，战斗效能大致相当于一名元素战士；但它证明了原型机甲可以成为有效武器。该变体携带一门ER微型激光。 特性：灵活 部署成本倍率：0.95

column1: Quicsell's Assault Missile Brawler. The HGN-QS2 has tons of armor and more missile tubes than ever. With a pair of MRM30's and a pair of 'Streak' SRM4's, this beast can dish out the pain. Quirk: Reinforced Legs Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: Quicsell的突击导弹格斗机。HGN-QS2拥有厚重装甲和前所未有的导弹发射管。凭借一对MRM30和一对“Streak”SRM4，这头野兽能造成毁灭性打击。 特性：强化腿部 部署成本倍率：1.14

column1: The MON-76 is an upgrade of the Mongoose. The original electronics, weapons, engine, and cooling system have been stripped from the chassis and a complete rebuild of the 'Mech has occurred. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: MON-76是Mongoose的升级型。原有电子设备、武器、引擎和冷却系统均从底盘上拆除，整台机甲完成了彻底重建。 特性：易于驾驶 部署成本倍率：0.98

column1: The Cephalus E carries a Light TAG and ER Large Laser. An extra heat sink helps deal with the heat generated by the configuration. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Cephalus E携带一具轻型TAG和一门ER大型激光。额外的散热器有助于处理该配置产生的热量。 特性：改进生命支持 部署成本倍率：1.01 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The X loadout combines a TSEMP cannon in the left arm with six ER Medium Lasers. A total of eight double heat sinks help cool the 'Mech. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: X配置在左臂搭载一门TSEMP炮，并配备六门ER中型激光。总计八个双倍散热器帮助机甲降温。 特性：战斗计算机 部署成本倍率：1.05 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: This version uses Advanced Armor for increased protection, and carries a Vibro Claw and Machine Gun for swarm attacks. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 该版本采用先进装甲以提升防护，并配备一把振动爪和一挺机枪用于群袭。 特性：精准 部署成本倍率：0.888 可安装全能模块，可近战，可群袭。

column1: The -12K2 Panther is also an upgrade of the -10K. This version is almost identical to the -10K2, but has replaced the two SRM-4 launchers with a single MRM-10 and an additional ton of armor. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: -12K2 Panther同样是-10K的升级型。该版本几乎与-10K2相同，但将两具SRM-4发射器替换为一具MRM-10，并增加一吨装甲。 特性：空袭 部署成本倍率：0.98

column1: This Celerity is protected by impact-resistant armor. Its forelegs are equipped with spikes, and thanks to its MASC and engine supercharger combination, it can top out at nearly 400 km/h. Quirk: Quad Mech (Squad) Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.94
column2: 这台Celerity由抗冲击装甲保护。其前腿装有尖刺，并凭借MASC与引擎增压器的组合，最高速度接近400公里/小时。 特性：四足机甲（小队） 部署成本倍率：0.94

column1: This Wolfhound variant got a large refit with Clan Grade Structure and Armor alongside RISC Tech Equipment and Production. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这款Wolfhound变体进行了大规模改装，采用氏族级结构与装甲，以及RISC科技设备和生产技术。 特性：精准武器 - 能量 部署成本倍率：1.13 手臂执行器限制：右下

column1: A rebuild of the previous MAD-5L, attempting to create a better profile for a stealth 'Mech. Never saw much success. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是对上一代MAD-5L的重建，试图为隐形机甲打造更佳轮廓，但从未取得多大成功。 特性：狭窄/低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：1.11 手臂执行器限制：左下，右下

column1: A rare but powerful variant, the 4X replaces all the 'Mech's weaponry and armor. These changes include a swapping in a Clan-tech ER PPC, small vibroblade, and ballistic-reinforced armor. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 这是一种罕见但强力的变体，4X替换了机甲的全部武器与装甲，包括换装氏族科技ER PPC、小型振动刀和弹道强化装甲。 特性：受保护执行器 部署成本倍率：1.08

column1: A highly classified loadout for the Nuwisha used by the Society to test the latest in experimental Clan tech. All further details are unknown. Quirk: Self Repair Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.41 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是Society为测试最新氏族实验科技而为Nuwisha准备的高度机密配置。其余细节均不为人知。 特性：自我修复 部署成本倍率：1.41 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: First produced in 3092, this variant carries the paired ER large lasers of the standard, but mounts dual ATM-6s, each fed by three tons of ammunition. It also adds a ton of armor protection. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 该变体于3092年首次生产，携带标准型的成对ER大型激光，但加装两具ATM-6，每具配备三吨弹药。此外还增加了一吨装甲防护。 特性：战斗计算机 部署成本倍率：1.08

column1: The C configuration is fully based around two Artemis IV-enabled Enhanced LRM-20 launchers. A five ton Battle Computer makes the damage capabilities of the missiles even higher. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Ballistics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.27
column2: C配置完全围绕两具启用Artemis IV的增强型LRM-20发射器构建。五吨重的战斗计算机进一步提高了导弹的伤害能力。 特性：精准武器 - 弹道 部署成本倍率：1.27

column1: This was a Thunderbolt 5S until some pirates got their hands on it. All the weapons have been sort of welded into spikes, resulting in a loadout that's much closer ranged, and much hotter. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 这原本是一台Thunderbolt 5S，直到落入海盗手中。所有武器都被粗略地焊成尖刺，导致配置射程更近、热量也更高。 特性：多重锁定 部署成本倍率：1.09

column1: The MVN-5K replaces the three Medium Lasers of the MVN-4S with two deadlier Medium Pulse Lasers. To make enough weight capacity available the C.A.S.E. protection also had to be dropped. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: MVN-5K将MVN-4S的三门中型激光替换为两门威力更大的中型脉冲激光。为腾出足够的载重空间，还不得不拆除C.A.S.E.防护。 特性：精准武器 - AC 部署成本倍率：1.03

column1: This seems to be some sort of Franken-Mech; they welded 5 Land-Air Mechs together, then strapped two dropship thrusters and a booster on it. It doesn't actually fly, it sort of just... hovers. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.32
column2: 这似乎是某种弗兰肯机甲；他们将5台空陆机甲焊接在一起，然后在上面绑了两台运输舰推进器和一台助推器。它其实不会飞，只是……悬浮。 特性：空陆机甲 部署成本倍率：1.32

column1: This version of the Cephalus carries a Plasma Cannon and a Flamer. This configuration is apparently intended as an anti-infantry unit. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Cephalus的这一版本携带一门等离子炮和一具火焰喷射器。该配置显然是作为反步兵单位而设计。 特性：改进生命支持 部署成本倍率：1.01 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: A Society refit of the Medusa 3, the Z drops the UAC20 and jump jets in favor of a Society Heavy Gauss Rifle. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是Society对Medusa 3的改装型，Z型放弃UAC20和跳跃喷口，换装Society重型高斯步枪。 特性：改进瞄准 - 近程 部署成本倍率：1.18 手臂执行器限制：左下，右下

column1: A RISC redesign of the SLDF Helepolis, with the goal of creating a Siege unit that can defend itself and actively engage a Enemy Line. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: 这是对SLDF Helepolis的RISC重设计，目标是打造一台既能自我防卫、又能主动接敌的攻城单位。 特性：稳定武器 部署成本倍率：1.16 手臂执行器限制：右上

column1: This variant changes the armaments to a single ER large laser and two heavy medium lasers. It also adds a targeting computer and an ECM suite, though it loses three double heat sinks. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
column2: 该变体将武器改为一门ER大型激光和两门重型中型激光，并增加了瞄准计算机和ECM套件，但减少了三个双倍散热器。 特性：精准武器 - 激光 部署成本倍率：1.06

column1: This configuration uses a Plasma Rifle for its main weapon. This is backed up by a single ER Small Laser and a trio of Small Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 该配置以等离子步枪作为主武器，并由一门ER小型激光和三门小型脉冲激光提供支援。 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：0.93 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: Apparently a replacement for the Fire Moth, this configuration carries three ER small lasers in each arm, all tied into a targeting computer. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这套配置似乎是用来替代Fire Moth的，每只手臂装有三门ER小型激光，全部连接至瞄准计算机。 特性：易于驾驶 部署成本倍率：0.98 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: Created in collaboration with scientists from the former NAIS, this variant carries upgraded rotary autocannons. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 该变体与前NAIS的科学家合作开发，配备升级型旋转自动炮。 特性：可变射程瞄准 部署成本倍率：1.2 手臂执行器限制：左下，右下

column1: The Dominus loadout of the Cherub mounts six Battle Armor-grade Support PPC in the Left Arm, supplemented by a single ER Medium Laser in the right arm and a 10-tube Rocket Launcher in the right torso. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: Cherub的Dominus配置在左臂安装六门战斗装甲级支援PPC，右臂另有一门ER中型激光，右侧躯干则装有一具10管火箭发射器。 特性：灵活 部署成本倍率：0.97

column1: This Dark Age variant is produced by Clan Sea Fox. It carries an XXL engine and more weaponry, but is unpopular with pilots due to heat issues. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这款黑暗时代变体由Sea Fox氏族生产。它搭载XXL引擎和更多武器，但由于散热问题而不受驾驶员欢迎。 特性：灵活 部署成本倍率：1.09 手臂执行器限制：右下

column1: I'm cap'n here by 'lection. I'm cap'n here because I'm the best man by a long space-mile. You won't fight, as gentlemen o' fortune should; then, by thunder, you'll obey, and you may lay to it! Quirk: Pirate Shanties Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.45
column2: 我是靠“选举”当上船长的。我之所以能当船长，是因为在广阔的宇宙里没人比我更强。你们不愿像真正的幸运绅士那样战斗？那就见鬼去吧，你们必须服从，也许还得乖乖躺下！ 特性：海盗歌谣 部署成本倍率：1.45

column1: The Comet Series of drones are deep space explorers. They have the ability to maneuver in both sky and extended missions in outer space. Their sensors are outfitted for observation and analysis. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: Comet系列无人机是深空探索者。它们能够在天空中机动，也能执行外太空长期任务。其传感器经过观测与分析用途的专门配置。 特性：空陆机甲 部署成本倍率：1.05

column1: The Porcupine is armed with a light arsenal of four medium lasers. These allow the 'mech to wear down an enemy's armor until it is thin enough to succumb to one of the Porcupine's ramming attacks. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: Porcupine配备四门中型激光，构成轻量级武库。这些武器能逐步削弱敌方装甲，直到装甲薄到足以承受Porcupine的冲撞攻击。 特性：干扰 部署成本倍率：0.97

column1: A further upgrade of the MVN-5k, the MVN-6L drops the AC/20 as well, to replace it with an Ultra AC/5. The engine core is also increased to a 200 rating and an extra Small Laser is added. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: MVN-6L是MVN-5K的进一步升级型，也放弃AC/20，换装Ultra AC/5。引擎核心提升至200级，并增加一门小型激光。 特性：精准武器 - AC 部署成本倍率：1.03

column1: The T configuration replaces the primary configurations LRM launchers with Streak variants, otherwise keeping much of the 'Mech similar. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: T配置将基础配置的LRM发射器替换为Streak型号，其余大部分机甲设计保持不变。 特性：受保护执行器 部署成本倍率：0.99 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The D configuration mounts an Arrow IV in each side torso, and a Thunder Bolt 5 in the center. This combination ensures the indirect fire capability of the loadout is very strong. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Ballistics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.27
column2: D配置在两侧躯干各安装一门Arrow IV，中部安装一门Thunder Bolt 5。这种组合确保该配置拥有极强的间接火力能力。 特性：精准武器 - 弹道 部署成本倍率：1.27

column1: This variant uses an ATM-12 and three tons of ammunition to maintain effectiveness at all ranges. Three ER medium lasers provide additional firepower. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 该变体使用ATM-12和三吨弹药，以维持全射程的作战效能。三门ER中型激光提供额外火力。 特性：稳定 部署成本倍率：1.04 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: After the ultimately failed Elemental II project, the Hell's Horses quest to improve Elementals didn't end. The Elemental III keeps the basic suit relevant for another century, incorporating a one-shot advanced SRM system to extend the suit’s reach and newly developed stealth armor to increase survivability.
column2: 在最终失败的Elemental II项目之后，Hell's Horses氏族改进Elemental的探索并未停止。Elemental III让这套基础战斗服在又一个世纪里保持实用性，加入一次性先进SRM系统以扩大射程，并采用新开发的隐形装甲提升生存能力。

column1: This Titan variant was introduced during the Dark Ages. Built around 3 standard PPCs, it carries a mix of srm 4's and medium lasers as secondary weapons. 16 DHS keep the heat under control. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 这款Titan变体在黑暗时代问世。它以3门标准PPC为核心，并配备SRM-4和中型激光作为辅助武器。16个双倍散热器将热量控制在可接受范围内。 特性：受保护执行器 部署成本倍率：1.18

column1: This experimental variant drops the lasers of the MLR-B2 and replaces the standard engine and gyro with an XL engine and XL gyro. The free space is filled with two SRM-4s, fed by one ton of ammo Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 这款实验型变体拆除MLR-B2的激光，并以XL引擎和XL陀螺仪替换标准引擎与陀螺仪。腾出的空间装入两具SRM-4，由一吨弹药供给。 特性：近战执行器 部署成本倍率：0.98

column1: A sub-variant of the CRD-7M Crusader, the -7M2 replaces the two leg-mounted Streak SRM 4 launchers and the two Light PPCs with two Large Lasers, a Machine Gun in the Right Arm and better cooling. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 这是CRD-7M Crusader的子变体，-7M2将两具腿部Streak SRM 4发射器和两门轻型PPC替换为两门大型激光、右臂一挺机枪，并改善冷却性能。 特性：稳定武器 部署成本倍率：1.09

column1: Don't let the stubby UM-R666 'Urbie' fool you, it may look like a walking trash can, but it is a Devil Worshiping Monster. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 别被矮胖的UM-R666“Urbie”骗了，它看起来像一只会走路的垃圾桶，实际上却是崇拜恶魔的怪物。 特性：360°躯干扭转 部署成本倍率：1.06 手臂执行器限制：左上，右上

column1: The mounts an AC/10 in the left arm with a single ton of CASE-protected ammunition stored in the left torso and the signature mace in the right hand. This 'Mech is also known as Solaris Special. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: 该机甲在左臂安装一门AC/10，左侧躯干储存一吨受CASE保护的弹药，右手则握有标志性钉头锤。这台机甲也被称为Solaris特装型。 特性：近战执行器 部署成本倍率：1.15

column1: A straightforward and early TSEMP refit developed in 3118, this third variant replaces the snub-nose PPC with a TSEMP cannon. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这是一次直接而早期的TSEMP改装，于3118年开发；该第三变体以TSEMP炮替换短管PPC。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 部署成本倍率：0.98 手臂执行器限制：右下

column1: This looks like one of Skobels MKII Vultures, and it looks way too pristine to have been Battlefield Salvage. Something ain't right here, Boss. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这看起来像Skobel的MKII Vulture之一，而且过于崭新，不像是战场回收品。老板，这里肯定有问题。 特性：战斗计算机 部署成本倍率：1.16 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The Gladiator is a commissioned Black Knight refit, carrying 2 prototype Plasma Cannons, Hardened Armour and composite internal structures. A brutal Solaris brawler with enhanced melee abilities. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: 角斗士是受委托改装的黑骑士，搭载2门原型等离子炮、强化装甲和复合内部结构。这是一台具备强化近战能力的残暴索拉里斯斗士。 特性：近战执行器 投放成本倍率：1.17

column1: The JL-3B is a further upgrade of the 3A, replacing the two MRM launchers with an all energy build; a Light PPC and four lasers of various types. Otherwise the design is similar to the 3A. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: JL-3B是3A的进一步升级型，将两具MRM发射器替换为全能量武装：一门轻型PPC和四门不同类型的激光器。除此之外，该设计与3A相似。 特性：集成探照灯 投放成本倍率：1.04

column1: The -6A focuses it's auxiliary weapons on anti-infantry defense in form of a Magshot Cannon and a AP Gauss Rifle. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.33 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: -6A将辅助武器集中用于反步兵防御，配备磁射炮和AP高斯步枪。 特性：精准武器 - 导弹 投放成本倍率：1.33 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: A simple upgrade to the Lightray to enable it to mount the C3i computer system commonly found in Word of Blake units, the 6W is armed with an ER PPC supported by three ER medium lasers. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 这是对光线号的简单升级，使其能够搭载黑暗之书部队常用的C3i计算机系统；6W装备了一门ER PPC，并由三门ER中型激光器提供支援。 特性：超伸展执行器 投放成本倍率：1.05

column1: The 5S combines an Artemis IV LRM-10 with an ER Large Laser and two ER Medium Lasers. It also has C.A.S.E. protection and a small Targeting Computer and uses Endo Steel to carry it all on the frame. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 5S将一具阿尔忒弥斯IV型LRM-10与一门ER大型激光器和两门ER中型激光器结合起来。它还具备C.A.S.E.防护和一台小型瞄准计算机，并使用内骨骼钢来容纳所有设备。 特性：战斗拳套 投放成本倍率：1.05

column1: A modification of the K2 built in 3083, the K3 removed the two Streak SRM-6 launchers and replaced them with three jump jets and a Streak SRM-4 launcher, giving the AS7-K3 incredible maneuverability. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: K3是于3083年制造的K2改型，拆除了两具Streak SRM-6发射器，换成三具跳跃喷射器和一具Streak SRM-4发射器，使AS7-K3拥有惊人的机动性。 特性：战斗拳套 投放成本倍率：1.18

column1: The latest modern Bane variant, the Bane 7, delivers a brutal assault with two HAG 40s backed up by torso-mounted lasers. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 最新的现代化巴恩改型巴恩7，凭借两门HAG 40以及安装在躯干上的激光器，发动残酷的突击。 特性：扩展躯干扭转 投放成本倍率：1.24 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: This former TBT-4M was aquired by a pirate and 'upgraded' in typical periphery style. It also has an advanced pirate ballistic AMS system. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这台原本的TBT-4M被海盗夺得，并以典型的外围星域风格进行“升级”。它还配备了先进的海盗弹道AMS系统。 特性：易于维护 投放成本倍率：1.04 手臂执行器限制：右下臂

column1: A Dark Age variant of the Lupus, the Lupus D is armed with a RAC/5, backed up by a Streak LRM-10 and a pair of ER Medium Pulses Lasers. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是狼疮的黑暗时代改型，狼疮D装备一门RAC/5，并由一具Streak LRM-10和两门ER中型脉冲激光器提供支援。 特性：超伸展执行器 投放成本倍率：1.07 手臂执行器限制：全部

column1: The Death Incarnate is a heavily modified -8K, only keeping a few of original lasers. Two ER Large Lasers and two Small Pulse Lasers were added instead, and the amount of armor increased. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 死亡化身是经过大幅改装的-8K，仅保留了少数原有激光器。它换装了两门ER大型激光器和两门小型脉冲激光器，并增加了装甲量。 特性：超伸展执行器 投放成本倍率：1.08

column1: Built for House Liao the 5L attempted to make the reliable Marauder chassis work alongside their modernized Stealth Forces. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 5L为连合国·廖设计，试图让可靠的掠夺者底盘与其现代化隐形部队协同作战。 特性：窄型/低矮轮廓 投放成本倍率：1.11 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: SaKhan Petr Kalasa acquired his Hammerhead — which he named Akitla — after he lost his Tiburon in battle on Marik in 3147. It was slightly customized with improved internal systems and a supercharger. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
column2: 萨汗·彼得·卡拉萨在3147年于马立克战斗中失去自己的提布龙后，获得了这台被他命名为阿基特拉的锤头鲨。它经过轻度定制，改进了内部系统并加装增压器。 特性：战斗拳套 投放成本倍率：1.11

column1: This looks like it once was a CN9-A, but nothing is quite like where it needs to be, they somehow went overweight with reinforcing the shield. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这看起来曾经是一台CN9-A，但各部件都不在应有的位置；他们不知怎么地为加固盾牌而把整机造得超重了。 特性：易于驾驶 投放成本倍率：1.02 手臂执行器限制：右下臂

column1: Meant for close in-city fighting, the R61L is upgraded with Stealth Equipment alongside its less expensive R60L cousin's AC20. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: R61L专为近距离城市战斗，在价格更低的R60L表亲所用AC20基础上加装了隐形设备。 特性：360°躯干扭转 投放成本倍率：0.99 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The Harpy, the first ProtoMech ever created, it is about as effective as a single elemental, it did however show that Protomechs could be a effective weapon. This Variant carries a LMG and 10 rounds of ammo. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95
column2: 哈比是有史以来制造的第一台原型机甲，其战斗力大致相当于一名元素战士；不过它证明了原型机甲可以成为有效武器。该改型携带一挺轻机枪和10发弹药。 特性：灵活 投放成本倍率：0.95

column1: This variant is a dedicated close range brawler. Adding three more heat sinks helps keep it cool as it employs nine ER Medium Lasers and two ER Large Lasers. The Gauss Rifle remains in the right torso. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24
column2: 该改型专为近距离缠斗而生。增加三组散热器后，它可以使用九门ER中型激光器和两门ER大型激光器，同时保持较低温度。高斯步枪仍位于右侧躯干。 特性：战斗拳套 投放成本倍率：1.24

column1: Piloted by Major Tara Lucas of Zeta Battalion, this Warhawk variant replaced the LRMs of the primary configuration with more heat sinks. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这台战鹰改型由Zeta营少校塔拉·卢卡斯驾驶，将基础配置中的LRM替换为更多散热器。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 投放成本倍率：1.18 手臂执行器限制：全部

column1: The A configuration of the Narayana combines two Mortar/8 with a Thunderbolt 15 and one Small ER laser. The Mortars have 6 tons of assorted ammunition available for further flexibility. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Ballistics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.27
column2: 纳拉亚娜的A配置将两门迫击炮/8与一门雷霆霹雳15和一门小型ER激光器结合。迫击炮配备6吨各式弹药，提供更大的灵活性。 特性：精准武器 - 弹道 投放成本倍率：1.27

column1: The Crusader was initially designed as a close combat BattleMech for the Star League Defense Force. Capitalizing on this many factions painted up the R line and made them into Gladiatorial fighters. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 十字军最初是为星盟防卫部队设计的近战战斗机甲。许多派系利用这一点，将R系列涂装后改造成角斗士。 特性：稳定武器 投放成本倍率：1.09

column1: This version of the Spider was a field refit of the 8X. The medium pulse lasers are removed and replaced by five ER Small Lasers. For close-in combat, this Spider carries a Sword. It retains the Partial Wing. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 这是蜘蛛8X的一次战地改装。拆除了中型脉冲激光器，换成五门ER小型激光器。为近距离战斗，这台蜘蛛携带一把剑，并保留了部分机翼。 特性：灵活 投放成本倍率：0.99

column1: A rugged and formidable variant of the Hatchetman, the 5D not only has a powerful mid range punch with its AC/10 and ER Medium Laser, but also utilizes an extra light engine to reduce overall weight. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 5D是坚固而强悍的战斧改型，不仅以AC/10和ER中型激光器提供强大的中程火力，还使用了轻型引擎以降低整体重量。 特性：近战执行器 投放成本倍率：1.03

column1: The personal 'Mech of Raul Ortega moves the RAC/5 from its torso mount to the right arm, giving it a wider field of fire. It also exchanges the targeting computer for three medium lasers. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
column2: 劳尔·奥尔特加的私人机甲将RAC/5从躯干挂载移至右臂，扩大了射界；同时以三门中型激光器替换了瞄准计算机。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放成本倍率：1.06

column1: A simple field modification that replaces the AC/10 with an HVAC/10, it isn't geared toward long range or extended engagements. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 一次简单的战地改装，用HVAC/10替换AC/10，因此并不适合远程或持久交战。 特性：360°躯干扭转 投放成本倍率：0.99 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: Yeah Boss, this is a big old Mackie, but every piece of it was upgraded, even the bloody Access Hatches uses proprietary Parts! Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.29 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 没错，老大，这是一台硕大的老麦基，但它的每个部件都升级过了，连该死的检修舱门都使用专有零件！ 特性：易于维护 投放成本倍率：1.29 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: Nicknamed "baby Warhammer", this less common Dark Elf variant replaced all lasers and the SRM with a second PPC to provide a cheap fire support option at the cost of short-range capability and heat endurance. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 这款不太常见的黑暗精灵改型被昵称为“小战锤”，用第二门PPC替换了所有激光器和SRM，以低廉的火力支援为代价牺牲了近距离作战能力和散热持久性。 特性：灵活 投放成本倍率：1.03

column1: This 'was' a K2 Catapult, but somehow they screwed Rifleman parts into the Arms and made it a Ballistic Carrier.... Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Ballistics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这“曾经”是一台K2型弩炮，但不知怎么把射手的部件硬塞进双臂，变成了弹道武器载体…… 特性：精准武器 - 弹道 投放成本倍率：1.09 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: This variant of the Grenadier removes the standard weaponry and carries a pair of Heavy Flamers instead. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: 该掷弹兵改型拆除了标准武器，改为携带一对重型火焰喷射器。 特性：伏击者 投放成本倍率：0.896 只能由内部舱室运输，可进行近战，不可进行集群攻击。

column1: Quicsell's Heavy Laser Support. The QKD-QS4 comes with the finest in Quicsell EWS, as well as the ability to target Heavy Large Chem Lasers at nearby foes while the bolt-on mortars shell far away enemies. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: 快销公司的重型激光支援机。QKD-QS4配备快销公司最精良的电子战系统，还能向附近敌人发射重型大型化学激光器，同时外挂迫击炮可轰击远处敌军。 特性：多重追踪 投放成本倍率：1.07

column1: The H carries the requisite Heavy Large Laser in a torso mount. The arms each have a Gauss rifle and ER large laser. Jump jets improve mobility. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: H型在躯干挂载了所需的重型大型激光器。两条手臂各配备一支高斯步枪和一门ER大型激光器。跳跃喷射器提升了机动性。 特性：防空瞄准 投放成本倍率：1.14 手臂执行器限制：全部

column1: The Marian Hegemony use this homegrown variant of the locust as a scout that can deliver a nasty bite just before withdrawing. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 马里安霸权将这一自制的蝗虫改型用作侦察机，在撤退前给予敌人狠狠一击。 特性：窄型/低矮轮廓 投放成本倍率：0.97 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: Based on a prototype of the AXM-6X, the Axman AXM-5S have managed to integrate the powerful Advanced Tactical Missile into the Axman line, acquired through a collaboration with the Clan Wolf-in-Exile. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: AXM-5S基于AXM-6X原型机，通过与流亡之狼氏族合作获得了强大的先进战术导弹，并成功将其整合进斧人系列。 特性：近战执行器 投放成本倍率：1.09

column1: Sooo some Pirate got their hands on a Bushwacker, and stuffed it full of Inferno weapons, theres even a smoker in the cockpit! Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 呃，某个海盗弄到了一台灌木狼蛛，把它塞满了地狱火武器，驾驶舱里甚至还有个烟鬼！ 特性：窄型/低矮轮廓 投放成本倍率：1.07 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: A Dark Age redesign, this Titan variant carries a pair of ER PPCs and a mixed arsenal of medium lasers and SRM-4s for closer range combat. Jump Jets, double heatsinks and case round out the design. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 这是黑暗时代的重新设计型泰坦，携带一对ER PPC以及由中型激光器和SRM-4组成的混合武器库，用于近距离作战。跳跃喷射器、双重散热器和CASE完善了整体设计。 特性：受保护执行器 投放成本倍率：1.18

column1: The Panther 9L carries an experimental Plasma Cannon on a improved Weapons mount and is supported by a Haywire Launcher and Flamer. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 豹式9L在改良武器挂架上搭载了一门实验型等离子炮，并由干扰发射器和火焰喷射器提供支援。 特性：空中突击 投放成本倍率：1.02 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: A Jihad-era experiment, this Stinger uses an endo steel chassis and an XL engine to increase speed to 111 km/h. A medium pulse laser is carried in each arm and it also retains the 180 meter jump capability. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: 这是一项圣战时期的实验型设计，使用内骨骼钢底盘和XL引擎，将速度提升至111公里/小时。每条手臂装备一门中型脉冲激光器，并保留了180米跳跃能力。 特性：无处不在 投放成本倍率：0.97

column1: Quicsell's Medium Ballistic Sniper. The CLNT-QS1 is our first mech to mount our revolutionary 'Gauss' rifle. Get Gauss results with the readily available AC2 ammo and get the best of both worlds. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1
column2: 快销公司的中型弹道狙击机。CLNT-QS1是我们第一台搭载革命性“高斯”步枪的机甲。使用随处可得的AC2弹药也能取得高斯般的效果，兼得两者优点。 特性：可变射程瞄准 投放成本倍率：1

column1: A Clantech variant of the Ursa. In addition to being constructed with lighter materials, the URA-2C replaces the medium X-Pulse lasers with ER Medium Pulse Lasers and adds a fourteenth double heat sink. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: 这是一台乌萨的氏族科技改型。除了采用更轻材料制造外，URA-2C还将中型X脉冲激光器替换为ER中型脉冲激光器，并增加了第十四组双重散热器。 特性：稳定武器 投放成本倍率：1.15

column1: Yet another typical Urbie, this variant sports a not too uncommon refit for planetary militias, replacing the AC10 with a Mortar. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 又是一台典型的小乌鸦，这一改型采用了行星民兵中颇为常见的改装，用迫击炮替换了AC10。 特性：360°躯干扭转 投放成本倍率：0.97 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: Completely armed with Clan weaponry, the R features a single LRM-10 launcher and two ATM-3s. Also, the 'Mech has a pair of ER medium lasers in each arm. Quirk: Well Balanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: R型完全采用氏族武器，配备一具LRM-10发射器和两具ATM-3。此外，这台机甲每条手臂还各有两门ER中型激光器。 特性：平衡良好 投放成本倍率：0.99 手臂执行器限制：全部

column1: This Verfolger variant removes the LB 10-X autocannon and anti-missile system of the original. In their place are two MML-9 missile launchers. The lasers are upgraded to extended range models. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 这一追猎者改型拆除了原版的LB 10-X自动炮和反导系统，换成两具MML-9导弹发射器。激光器也升级为延伸射程型号。 特性：超伸展执行器 投放成本倍率：1.09

column1: The I configuration utilizes a ProtoMech AC/4 combined with a Plasma Rifle provided by its Inner Sphere allies. The final armament is a single ER Medium Laser. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: I型配置使用一门原型机甲AC/4，并结合内太阳圈盟友提供的等离子步枪。最终武装是一门ER中型激光器。 特性：坚固 投放成本倍率：1.04 手臂执行器限制：全部

column1: Quicsell's Light Missile Backstabber, the WSP-QS3 is guaranteed to be the fastest Wasp you've ever seen! Put missiles exactly where the enemy doesn't want them and run circles around heavier mechs. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95
column2: 快销公司的轻型导弹背刺机。WSP-QS3保证是你见过的最快黄蜂！把导弹精准送到敌人最不想看到的位置，绕着更重型的机甲兜圈子。 特性：扩展躯干扭转 投放成本倍率：0.95

column1: This rare Catapult has been reconfigured with RISC Micro Missiles to deliver devastating volleys of specialty munitions. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这台罕见的弩炮经过重新配置，搭载RISC微型导弹，可发射毁灭性的特种弹药齐射。 特性：精准武器 - 导弹 投放成本倍率：1.11 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The 71M is an Minnesota Tribe upgrade of the 66b variant used by the SLDF Royal units in 2740. This variant trades the ER Large and Medium Lasers for a triplet of Medium Pulse Lasers and a Heavy Cockpit. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 71M是明尼苏达部落对2740年星盟防卫部队皇家部队所用66b型的升级。该改型用三门中型脉冲激光器和一具重型驾驶舱替换了ER大型激光器和中型激光器。 特性：易于驾驶 投放成本倍率：1.04

column1: Hailing from a Kuritan Gamesworld this Dragon got redesigned to spit fire and destruction upon its enemy causing the crowd to go fiery wild. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这台龙式来自库里塔竞技世界，经过重新设计后能向敌人喷吐火焰与毁灭，引得观众陷入狂热。 特性：稳定 投放成本倍率：1.12 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: This Mad Cat Mark III is a reproduction in the Inner Sphere after RISC Engineers analyzed and retrofitted the Diamond Sharks original MKIII. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这台疯狂猫III型是内太阳圈在RISC工程师分析并改装钻鲨氏族原版MKIII后重制的产物。 特性：灵活 投放成本倍率：1.12 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: The Lambor Drone model is much like the Beetle drones as they were designed for organics to ride around in. The Lambor models are vastly improved personal transport drones. Thought to be owned by the elite. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: 兰博无人机型号与甲虫无人机相似，都是为供有机生物乘坐而设计。兰博型号是大幅改进的个人运输无人机，据认为由精英阶层拥有。 特性：扰乱 投放成本倍率：1.07

column1: The side torsos of this version of the Longshot each carry a medium X-Pulse laser, small X-Pulse laser, and a Streak SRM-6. An XXL engine provides power. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 该长射改型的两侧躯干各配备一门中型X脉冲激光器、一门小型X脉冲激光器和一具Streak SRM-6。XXL引擎为其提供动力。 特性：坚固 投放成本倍率：0.98 手臂执行器限制：右下臂

column1: This version of the Roc was developed by The Society. It maintains the same ground speed, but carries a Medium Chemical Laser with 30 reloads. It's also equipped with a Magnetic Clamp system. Quirk: Accurate Weapons - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.972
column2: 这台洛克是由协会开发的。它保持相同的地面速度，但携带一门中型化学激光器和30发备用弹药，并配备磁力夹系统。 特性：精准武器 - 能量 投放成本倍率：0.972

column1: A more basic variant of the 1GLS, downgrading both the ER PPC and the Pulse Lasers to standard versions. The two Large Lasers are still kept as is. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这是比1GLS更基础的改型，将ER PPC和脉冲激光器都降级为标准型号；两门大型激光器则保持不变。 特性：易于驾驶 投放成本倍率：1.1 手臂执行器限制：右下臂

column1: A variant of the Brigand intended to bring more firepower on a target at the sacrifice of accuracy. Developed in 3066, the X1 removes the two medium pulse lasers and replaces them with four medium lasers. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 旨在牺牲精度来为目标带来更强火力的掠袭者变体。X1 于 3066 年研发，移除了两门中型脉冲激光，换成四门中型激光。 特性：空袭 投放成本倍率：0.98

column1: This Dark Age variant uses Light PPCs and an MML launcher to supplement the Gauss Rifle. It also carries a C3 boosted slave system. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这个黑暗时代变体使用轻型 PPC 和一具 MML 发射器为高斯步枪提供火力支援。此外还搭载了 C3 增强从属系统。 特性：易于维护 投放成本倍率：1.08 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: The experimental G configuration of the Menace combines two Improved Railguns with two Rotary Gauss Rifles. As there is little space left, no other weapons nor the otherwise common Nova CEWS is available. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.42
column2: Menace 的实验性 G 配置将两门改进型轨道炮与两门旋转高斯步枪结合起来。由于剩余空间极少，未配备其他武器，也没有通常搭载的 Nova CEWS。 特性：稳定武器 投放成本倍率：1.42

column1: The Prototype of the Centurion OmniMech sports an advanced FCS and Sensors system alongside a less bulky experimental Endo-Steel and more advanced Armor. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这台 Centurion OmniMech 原型机配备先进的火控与传感器系统，同时采用更轻便的实验型内骨骼钢和更先进的装甲。 特性：易于驾驶 投放成本倍率：1.01 手臂执行器限制：全向

column1: An electronic warfare variant of the FFL-4D model, the 4DA replaces the Anti-Missile System and its ammo with a Guardian ECM Suite. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是 FFL-4D 的电子战变体，4DA 用 Guardian ECM 套件取代了反导系统及其弹药。 特性：改进传感器 投放成本倍率：0.99 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The Lambor Drone model is much like the Beetle drones as they were designed for organics to ride around in. The Lambor models are vastly improved personal transport drones. Thought to be owned by the elite. Quirk: Stubble Wings Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: Lambor 无人机型号与 Beetle 无人机很相似，都是为让有机体乘坐而设计。Lambor 型号是大幅改良的个人运输无人机，据认为属于精英阶层。 特性：粗短机翼 投放成本倍率：1.07

column1: Based on the HMC-14, this model also uses Ferro-Fibrous armor for protection. It strips all the weapons and jump jets of the HMC-14 and replaces them with arm-mounted Light PPCs for long range firepower. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 该型号基于 HMC-14，同样使用铁磁纤维装甲进行防护。它拆除了 HMC-14 的全部武器和跳跃喷射器，换成安装在手臂上的轻型 PPC，以提供远程火力。 特性：易于维护 投放成本倍率：0.98

column1: A very specialized version of the Eris, used for the grasshopper tactic of jumping in, delivering a full Alpha Strike, and then immediately jump out again. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: 这是 Eris 的高度专用型号，采用“跳入、完整齐射、立即跳出”的蛙跳战术。 特性：敏捷 投放成本倍率：1.04 手臂执行器限制：右上臂

column1: This experimental model carries a Battle Armor-scale C3 computer. These suits are generally equipped with "David" Light Gauss Rifles. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.908 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 这台实验型号搭载一具战斗装甲规模的 C3 计算机。这类战斗装甲通常配备“David”轻型高斯步枪。 特性：伏击者 投放成本倍率：0.908 可搭载全向单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1: Originally a cheap recon unit, but this particular Clint was rebuilt by a Pirate with a missile phobia, and it's got several hardwired AMS. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 它原本是一台廉价侦察单位，但这台 Clint 被一名惧怕导弹的海盗重建，装上了数具硬接线反导系统。 特性：可变距离瞄准 投放成本倍率：1 手臂执行器限制：右下臂

column1: The Quickdraw 7X is an attempt to create a sturdy and fast energy platform, sporting Reinforced Structure and a Torso Mounted Cockpit with a head mounted Plasma Cannon alongside a 400XXL Engine. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: Quickdraw 7X 试图打造坚固而快速的能量平台，配备强化结构、躯干座舱，以及与 400XXL 引擎并列安装在头部的等离子炮。 特性：超伸展执行器 投放成本倍率：1.08

column1: A simple variation of the 3C, where the C3 Slave unit is swapped out in favor an additional Small X-Pulse Laser in the head. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是 3C 的简单变体，将 C3 从属单元换成头部额外的一门小型 X 脉冲激光。 特性：可变距离瞄准 投放成本倍率：1.09 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: The 7K2 scout-hunter is a variant of the 7K introduced in 3068 by Nimakachi. Its jump capability is only 210 meters and its armoring reduced to five tons, but it now carries a Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 7K2 侦猎型是 3068 年 Nimakachi 推出的 7K 变体。其跳跃能力仅有 210 米，装甲也减少到五吨，但搭载了 Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER 大型激光。 特性：敏捷 投放成本倍率：0.99

column1: After weathering many an assault by Clan Warriors, RISC Engineers have refit these Warhounds based upon the versatile Stormcrow. Carrying a Heavy Missile payload, it excells as a fast striker and fire support 'mech. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 在经历了无数次部落战士的攻击后，RISC 工程师以多用途的 Stormcrow 为基础改装了这些 Warhound。它搭载重型导弹载荷，擅长快速突击和火力支援。 特性：稳定 投放成本倍率：1.1

column1: The 3067 2H is a Periphery upgrade of the 1H model. The 'Mech removes the Machine Guns from the chassis and adds in their place six Rocket Launcher 10s. This gives the Goliath a very powerful close range punch. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12
column2: 3067 年的 2H 是 1H 型号的边区升级版。这台机甲拆除了机体上的机枪，换成六具 10 联装火箭发射器，赋予 Goliath 极其强大的近距离打击力。 特性：多重锁定 投放成本倍率：1.12

column1: However a Pirate got his hands on this tech, and then stuffed it all into a Locust ...also someone scribbled a Wang was here into the Cockpit. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 然而，一名海盗得到了这项技术，然后把它全塞进了 Locust……还有人把“Wang 到此一游”潦草地写在了驾驶舱里。 特性：敏捷 投放成本倍率：0.95 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The latest Shen Yi variant is the SHY-5B. This variant retains a single Large Laser, trading the rest of its arsenal for a pair of LRM-20 Launchers. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: 最新的 Shen Yi 变体是 SHY-5B。该型号保留一门大型激光，以其余武器换取两具 LRM-20 发射器。 特性：稳定武器 投放成本倍率：1.09 手臂执行器限制：右上臂

column1: This configuration is equipped with two Streak LRM-5 launchers and two Improved Heavy Medium Lasers. It also carries a Light TAG and a Watchdog CEWS. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 该配置配备两具 Streak LRM-5 发射器和两门改进型重型中型激光，还搭载一具轻型 TAG 和 Watchdog CEWS。 特性：受保护执行器 投放成本倍率：0.99 手臂执行器限制：全向

column1: By upgrading the ER Large Lasers to Clan specification, the Julian JLN-5C is able to also upgrade the medium lasers to Pulse versions. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 将 ER 大型激光升级为氏族规格后，Julian JLN-5C 还得以把中型激光升级为脉冲型号。 特性：战斗计算机 投放成本倍率：1.16 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: This variant uses an Extralight Gyroscope and uses the tonnage freed up to upgrade its CASE to CASE II as well as adding Spikes to the 'Mech's torso. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
column2: 该变体使用超轻型陀螺仪，并将释放出的吨位用于把 CASE 升级为 CASE II，同时在机甲躯干上加装尖刺。 特性：近战执行器 投放成本倍率：1.1 手臂执行器限制：左上臂

column1: An anti-infantry/Battle Armor design developed during the Jihad in 3072, this variant of the Hydra was given a signification armor boost for this role and armed with triple of AP Gauss Rifles. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Ballistics Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 这是 3072 年圣战期间开发的反步兵/战斗装甲设计。该 Hydra 变体为此任务大幅强化了装甲，并配备三支 AP 高斯步枪。 特性：精准武器 - 弹道 投放成本倍率：0.99

column1: This appears to be the personal LAM ride of one 'LadyAlekto'. There's something scrawled across the side of the cockpit that just says "Fire, fire, fire!" Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这似乎是“LadyAlekto”的私人 LAM 坐骑。驾驶舱侧面潦草地写着：“开火、开火、开火！” 特性：陆空机甲 投放成本倍率：0.98 手臂执行器限制：全向

column1: The E configuration mounts an ER PPC in each arm and one ER Small Laser in the Center Torso. Eight Improved Jump Jets provide extra jump capacity. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: E 配置在每条手臂上安装一门 ER PPC，并在中央躯干安装一门 ER 小型激光。八具改进型跳跃喷射器提供额外的跳跃能力。 特性：改进通信 投放成本倍率：1.11 手臂执行器限制：全向

column1: The VT-U3 replaced the MRM 10s with a pair of SRM 6s as well as a single LRM 5 mounted in the center torso. The LRM-5 was supplied with a ton of ammunition, but both SRM 6s drew from a single ton of ammunition. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: VT-U3 用两具 SRM-6 取代了 MRM-10，并在中央躯干安装一具 LRM-5。LRM-5 配有一吨弹药，但两具 SRM-6 共用一吨弹药。 特性：扰乱者 投放成本倍率：1.03

column1: One of the best first generation ProtoMechs, the Centaur combines high speed, decent armor, and a varied weapons mix. These features make it a flexible combatant, able to keep up with scout 'Mechs while supporting them. A Jihad era variant, this variation of the design employs Protomech Myomer Booster and AP Gauss rifle.
column2: Centaur 是第一代 ProtoMech 中最优秀的型号之一，兼具高速、可靠装甲和多样化武器组合。这些特点使它成为灵活的战斗单位，能够跟上侦察机甲并为其提供支援。这一圣战时代变体采用了 ProtoMech 肌肉增强器和 AP 高斯步枪。

column1: A rare refit of the venerable Black Knight Chassis often found among Mercenaries and Pit Fighters, exchanges most of the Energy Weapons for a Sawed-Off Thumper, Active Combat Shield and advanced Electronics. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
column2: 这是一种罕见的 Black Knight 机体改装，常见于雇佣兵和角斗士之中。它用短管 Thumper、主动战斗盾和先进电子设备替换了大部分能量武器。 特性：稳定武器 投放成本倍率：1.11

column1: Malvina Hazen was part of the group assigned to designing the Jadehawk, while the Khan was a galaxy commander one she shared an especially close bond with Khan Hazen. This mech was her last gift to her brother. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
column2: Malvina Hazen 曾参与 Jadehawk 的设计工作；当时的 Khan 是与她关系极为亲密的银河指挥官 Hazen Khan。这台机甲是她送给兄弟的最后礼物。 特性：扰乱者 投放成本倍率：1.11

column1: This extensive revamp of the Procyon is a new Clan Hell's Horses design introduced in 3081. Using an advanced Quad ProtoMech chassis, it weighs six tons and carries a pair of AP Gauss Rifles supported by an SRM-2. Quirk: Fearsome Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 这是 Procyon 的大规模改造型，属于 Clan Hell's Horses 于 3081 年推出的新设计。它采用先进的四足 ProtoMech 机体，重六吨，搭载一对 AP 高斯步枪，并由一具 SRM-2 提供支援。 特性：凶悍 投放成本倍率：0.99

column1: The Bushwacker S2c is a front line that upgrades the AMS to an APD system combined with an ECM to give advanced cover for its units. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Bushwacker S2c 是一种前线型号，将反导系统升级为 APD 系统，并结合 ECM 为部队提供先进掩护。 特性：窄型/低矮轮廓 投放成本倍率：1.05 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: This version is more properly adapted to a scouting role by the addition of a Light Active Probe. It also uses upgraded heat sinks to allow for an all-energy configuration. Eight ER Micro Lasers and two Micro Pulse Lasers replace the pair of ER Medium Lasers. A Targeting Computer improves the accuracy of all the weapons.
column2: 通过加装轻型主动探测器，该型号更适合侦察任务。它还使用升级型散热器，使全能量配置成为可能。八门 ER 微型激光和两门微型脉冲激光取代了原本的一对 ER 中型激光。瞄准计算机提高了所有武器的精度。

column1: The 2LAWC3 applies the ubiquitous DCMS C3 slave field refit kit to the standard 2LAW. Like many such kits it removes one of the ER medium lasers to free up the space needed for the C3 Slave computer. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 2LAWC3 将无处不在的 DCMS C3 从属野战改装套件应用于标准 2LAW。与许多此类套件一样，它拆除了一门 ER 中型激光，以腾出安装 C3 从属计算机所需的空间。 特性：改进通信 投放成本倍率：1.05

column1: Quicsell's Assault PPC Backstabber. The HGN-QS3 is surprisingly fast for a 90 ton mech. Use that mobility to be where the enemy least expects you, and unload with our specially engineered Light Streak PPC's. Quirk: Reinforced Legs Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: Quicsell 的突击型 PPC 背刺者。HGN-QS3 对一台 90 吨机甲来说速度出奇地快。利用这种机动性出现在敌人意想不到的位置，再用我们专门设计的轻型 Streak PPC 倾泻火力。 特性：强化腿部 投放成本倍率：1.14

column1: This Jihad-era field refit replaces the standard heat sinks with double strength models. An ER PPC and ER Medium Lasers replace the standard versions, with the updated heat sinks able to dissipate the increased heat. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: 这是一种圣战时代的野战改装型，用双强度型号替换了标准散热器。ER PPC 和 ER 中型激光取代了标准型号，升级后的散热器能够消散增加的热量。 特性：坚固 投放成本倍率：1.17

column1: The Z-A is an advanced Society configuration that utilizes a pair of Light Ultra Gauss Rifles and a pair of iATM3s in addition to the Nova CEWS. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Z-A 是 Society 的高级配置，除 Nova CEWS 外，还使用一对轻型超高斯步枪和一对 iATM3。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放成本倍率：1.2 手臂执行器限制：全向

column1: Converted from a full underwater loadout, this configuration carries a quartet of LRM-5 launchers in each arm and a single ER medium laser in the torso. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 该配置由完整的水下载荷改装而来，每条手臂携带四具 LRM-5 发射器，躯干安装一门 ER 中型激光。 特性：窄型/低矮轮廓 投放成本倍率：0.99 手臂执行器限制：全向

column1: This JM7 variant, introduced in 3068, utilizes twin Rotary Autocannon/2s and LB-X Autocannon/2s along with a pair of ER medium lasers. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这款 JM7 变体于 3068 年推出，使用两门旋转机炮/2 和 LB-X 机炮/2，并配备一对 ER 中型激光。 特性：防空瞄准 投放成本倍率：1.1 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The B2 variant of the Bloodhound, introduced in 3067,[5] enhances the 'Mech's firepower and capabilities by removing two of its double heat sinks and adding a Guardian ECM suite and a second ER small laser. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 3067 年推出的 Bloodhound B2 变体通过拆除两具双重散热器，并加装 Guardian ECM 套件和第二门 ER 小型激光，提升了机甲的火力与能力。 特性：改进传感器 投放成本倍率：1.03

column1: This Grenadier variant is equipped with a Firedrake Needler, Heavy Recoilless Rifle, and Battle Armor C3 system. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: 这款 Grenadier 变体配备 Firedrake 针刺枪、重型无后坐力步枪和战斗装甲 C3 系统。 特性：伏击者 投放成本倍率：0.896 只能由内部舱运载，可近战，不可群袭。

column1: The E configuration makes use of a Hyper-Assault Gauss Rifle 30 in each arm, though each one only has a single ton of ammunition to draw upon. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: E 配置在每条手臂上使用一支 30 型超强突击高斯步枪，但每支仅有一吨弹药可用。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 投放成本倍率：1.09 手臂执行器限制：全向
