column1: Introduced during the Late Republic era, this variant uses five ER small lasers in each side torso to support a single TSEMP cannon in the right arm. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 该型号于共和国晚期推出，在左右两侧躯干各使用五门 ER 小型激光，为右臂的一门 TSEMP 炮提供支援。 特性：稳定武器 投放成本倍率：1.06 手臂执行器限制：右下臂

column1: Later in the week, Darius provides an update. "I got a little creative with our budget and managed to replace the missing the Medbay inventory."\n\nHe hesitates for a moment. "That said, I've asked the medical staff to try to be economical going forward. But the pilots shouldn't notice any loss in our medical efficiency."
column2: 到了当周晚些时候，Darius 提供了最新情况。“我在预算上稍微动了点脑筋，总算补齐了缺失的医疗舱库存。”\n\n他犹豫片刻。“话虽如此，我已经要求医务人员今后尽量节省。不过飞行员们应该不会察觉医疗效率有任何下降。”

column1: An unusual configuration of the Arctic Cheetah, the combination of an ER Large Laser with a ProtoMech AC/2 pushing the 'Mech into more of a sniper role. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是 Arctic Cheetah 的独特配置，将 ER 大型激光与 ProtoMech AC/2 结合，使该机甲更偏向狙击手角色。 特性：受保护执行器 投放成本倍率：0.99 手臂执行器限制：全向

column1: Quicsell's Medium Laser Support. The CLNT-QS4 packs a potent array of E-war equipment, as well as two of Quicsell's patented Large REX Lasers for stripping off the armor of any mech that gets too close. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1
column2: Quicsell 的中型激光支援型。CLNT-QS4 搭载一套强力的电子战设备，以及两门 Quicsell 专利大型 REX 激光，用于剥离任何靠近机甲的敌机装甲。 特性：可变距离瞄准 投放成本倍率：1

column1: The Hel HL-2 replaces the Heavy PPC of the HL-1 with two large lasers, while the rest of the 'Mech's design is kept the same as the original variant. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: Hel HL-2 用两门大型激光替换了 HL-1 的重型 PPC，其余机体设计与原始型号保持不变。 特性：易于维护 投放成本倍率：1.04 手臂执行器限制：右下臂

column1: A 'Swayback' variant, the 4H replaces the AC/20 with the lighter AC/10 and two additional Medium Lasers. While this reduces its overall raw firepower, it gives the Hunchback some much needed ranged capabilities. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: “Swayback”变体。4H 用更轻的 AC/10 和两门额外的中型激光替换 AC/20。虽然这降低了整体原始火力，却赋予 Hunchback 急需的远程作战能力。 特性：战斗拳 投放成本倍率：1.02

column1: Derived from the AWS-11R, this variant uses direct fire weaponry in the form of an ER PPC, a Light Gauss Rifle, an ER Medium Laser and a Extended LRM-15. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: 该型号源自 AWS-11R，使用 ER PPC、轻型高斯步枪、ER 中型激光和一具增程 LRM-15 等直射武器。 特性：战斗拳 投放成本倍率：1.14 手臂执行器限制：右上臂

column1: This Variant replaces the two ER PPCs with Heavy PPCs, while replacing the C3 master with a C3 slave, and adds a heavy-duty gyro. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 该变体用重型 PPC 替换了两门 ER PPC，同时将 C3 主机替换为 C3 从属单元，并加装重型陀螺仪。 特性：改进通信 投放成本倍率：1.15 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: Codename the 'Hand of God', this Tercio variant carried not only two Gauss Rifles and two ER PPC, but also two experimental REDMIC autocannons. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.47 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 代号“上帝之手”的 Tercio 变体不仅携带两支高斯步枪和两门 ER PPC，还装备了两门实验型 REDMIC 机炮。 特性：多重锁定 投放成本倍率：1.47 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: A capable long-range missile boat, configuration D mounts a pair of LRM-10s in each arm with a Medium Pulse Laser and a Flamer mounted in the Left Torso. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是一艘出色的远程导弹平台，D 配置在每条手臂上安装一对 LRM-10，并在左侧躯干安装一门中型脉冲激光和一具火焰喷射器。 特性：受保护执行器 投放成本倍率：0.99 手臂执行器限制：全向

column1: The 'Mech is armed with a pair of Gauss rifles as its main weaponry. Each rifle has two tons of ammunition, keeping it in the fight. For close-in work the 'Mech carries a Extended Range Medium Laser in each arm. Quirk: Well Balanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
column2: 这台机甲以一对高斯步枪为主要武器。每支步枪配有两吨弹药，确保它能持续作战。近距离作战时，机甲每条手臂各携带一门增程中型激光。 特性：平衡良好 投放成本倍率：1.11

column1: Developed by Clan Sea Fox, the C 2 version upgrades to using Ferro-Lamellor armor while keeping most other stats of the 'Mech nearly the same. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 由海狐氏族研发，C-2 型号升级为铁层叠装甲，同时保留机甲大部分原有性能。\\n\\n特性：炮管拳\\n\\n部署费用倍率：1.21\\n\\n手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: The Dola DOL-1A is armed with a pair of ER medium lasers, which are backed up with a vibroblade capable of carving through 'Mech armor. An Angel ECM suite helps keep the 'Mech alive and make a stealthy attack. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
column2: DOL-1A 装备一对 ER 中型激光炮，并由一把能够切开机甲装甲的振动刃提供支援。天使 ECM 套件有助于维持机甲生存，并发动隐蔽攻击。\\n\\n特性：近战执行器\\n\\n部署费用倍率：1.01

column1: The D3's construction reflects its intended role as (almost) a custom design for Commanders. The 'Mech is designed for dealing punishing attacks, while retaining the survivability and speed of the original Atlas. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: D3 的构造体现了它为指挥官（几乎）量身定制的定位。这台机甲专为发动毁灭性攻击而设计，同时保留原版 Atlas 的生存能力与速度。\\n\\n特性：指挥机甲\\n\\n部署费用倍率：1.16

column1: Reinforced structure to defend an area. Armor: Armor Amount: 190 Structure: Structure Amount: 200 Engine: 300 XL Fusion Equipment: 1 x Command Bunker Weapons: 2x MARS 2x Rocket Pack 15 1x Thunderbolt 4-Pack Ammunition:
column2: 用于守卫区域的强化结构。\\n\\n装甲：装甲 数值：190\\n结构：结构 数值：200\\n\\n\\n引擎：300 XL 聚变引擎\\n\\n装备：\\n 1 x 指挥掩体\\n\\n\\n武器：\\n 2x MARS\\n 2x 火箭包 15\\n 1x 雷霆霹雳 4 联装\\n\\n\\n弹药：\n

column1: The Hel is an Inner Sphere mech that by many is considered the precursor of the Eris. Although sometimes confused with the Clan name for the Loki II, the 'Mechs are nothing alike. Using a fairly simple build the Hel is kept affordable for many mercenary companies, resulting in it being a common sighting amongst their ranks.
column2: Hel 是一台内天体机甲，许多人认为它是 Eris 的前身。虽然有时会与 Loki II 的氏族名称混淆，但这两台机甲完全不同。Hel 采用相当简单的设计，因此价格适中，许多雇佣兵公司都买得起，常见于这些公司的编制中。

column1: The -B2 is a refresh of the original SG11-B variant. Its weapons loadout is changed to use a HVAC/10 and a TSEMP Cannon amongst other changes, but over all its role is kept the same as a versatile brawler. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.4
column2: -B2 是原始 SG11-B 型号的改进版。它将武器配置改为 HVAC/10 和 TSEMP 炮等装备，但总体上仍保持多用途格斗机甲的定位。\\n\\n特性：改进型生命维持系统\\n\\n部署费用倍率：1.4

column1: Another minor variant of the ON1-M fielded in 3062. A simple weapon swap, the LB-X Autocannon/10 is exchanged for a Rotary Autocannon/5. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是 3062 年部署的另一种 ON1-M 小型变体。它只进行了简单的武器更换，将 LB-X 自动炮/10 换成旋转自动炮/5。\\n\\n特性：防空瞄准\\n\\n部署费用倍率：1.11\\n\\n手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: The Gray Death Heavy battle armor has a built-in Support PPC, two detachable one-shot SRM-4s, a Basic Manipulator, and Improved Sensors. Quirk: Armored Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.892 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: Gray Death 重型战斗装甲内置一门支援 PPC、两具可拆卸的一次性 SRM-4、基础操纵器和改进型传感器。\\n\\n特性：装甲\\n\\n部署费用倍率：0.892\\n\\n可搭载全能单位，可近战，无法进行蜂拥攻击。

column1: This configuration has an ER PPC in the left arm, supported by four ER small lasers in the right arm. These are all tied into an advanced targeting computer. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 该配置左臂装有一门 ER PPC，右臂的四门 ER 小型激光炮提供支援。所有武器都接入先进瞄准计算机。\\n\\n特性：改进型传感器\\n\\n部署费用倍率：0.99\\n\\n手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: This Goliath variant mounts a Gauss Rifle and MML-7 in an experimental BattleMech Turret. An additional MML-7 and several leg-mounted lasers (both ER Medium Lasers and Small VSP Lasers) provide additional firepower. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: 这款 Goliath 变体在实验型战斗机甲炮塔中搭载一支高斯步枪和一具 MML-7。额外的一具 MML-7 以及安装在腿部的数门激光炮（包括 ER 中型激光炮和小型 VSP 激光炮）提供了更多火力。\\n\\n特性：多重锁定\\n\\n部署费用倍率：1.14

column1: A propose upgrade of the NGS-5T, adding a PPC capacitor to the ER PPC and replacing all other weapons with ER Medium Lasers. By using an Endo Steel chassis the armor protection was further increased to 11 tons. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: NGS-5T 的改进方案，在 ER PPC 上增加 PPC 电容器，并将其他武器全部替换为 ER 中型激光炮。通过使用内骨钢底盘，装甲防护进一步增加到 11 吨。\\n\\n特性：近战执行器\\n\\n部署费用倍率：1.04

column1: The QT-314S drops the Machine Guns of the original Quest QT-314 to instead add a SRM-2 launcher, everything else of the design remains the same. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Gauss Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: QT-314S 移除了原版 Quest QT-314 的机枪，改为增加一具 SRM-2 发射器，设计的其他部分保持不变。\\n\\n特性：精准武器 - 高斯\\n\\n部署费用倍率：1.08\\n\\n手臂执行器限制：右下臂

column1: The YJ-19 introduced a SRM-4 launcher to the Yellow Jacket YJ-15 base design. However, to fit the launcher four Small Lasers and a jump jet had to be dropped, a trade most MechWarriors don't find worth it. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: YJ-19 在 Yellow Jacket YJ-15 的基础设计上增加了一具 SRM-4 发射器。然而，为了容纳这具发射器，必须舍弃四门小型激光炮和一具跳跃喷射器，大多数机甲战士认为这笔交易并不划算。\\n\\n特性：扩展躯干旋转\\n\\n部署费用倍率：0.96

column1: Quicsell's Medium Missile Brawler. The CLNT-QS2 meets Quicsell's finest quality control checks for survivability, and packs enough SRM fire to make sure that it's a target that enemies simply can't ignore. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1
column2: Quicsell 的中型导弹格斗机。CLNT-QS2 通过了 Quicsell 最严格的生存能力质量检查，并配备了足够的 SRM 火力，确保敌人无法忽视这个目标。\\n\\n特性：可变射程瞄准\\n\\n部署费用倍率：1

column1: A typical Solaris Refit, the 'Flying Hollander' upgrades the chassis with a Clan-grade Extralight Engine and Endo Steel, all to carry a Jury Rigged Heavy PPC alongside Partial Wings and Improved Jump Jets. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - PPC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 典型的 Solaris 改装型，“飞行荷兰人”用氏族级超轻型引擎和内骨钢升级底盘，以便在部分机翼和改进型跳跃喷射器之外搭载一门临时改装重型 PPC。\\n\\n特性：精准武器 - PPC\\n\\n部署费用倍率：1.09

column1: A late Republic era variant based on the 4A, this Tarantula replaces the ER PPC with an ER large laser and the C3 slave unit was upgraded to a C3 boosted slave unit. It retains the MASC system and armor of the 4A. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 这款共和国末期变体以 4A 为基础，将 ER PPC 替换为 ER 大型激光炮，并将 C3 从机升级为 C3 增强型从机。它保留了 4A 的 MASC 系统和装甲。\\n\\n特性：易于驾驶\\n\\n部署费用倍率：0.98

column1: Fortress installation safeguarding the surrounding area. Armor: Armor Amount: 150 Structure: Structure Amount: 1 Engine: 0 Standard Fusion Equipment: Weapons: 1x Grenade Gun 1x Grenade Inferno 3x Infantry Rifles Ammunition:
column2: 守护周边区域的堡垒设施。\\n\\n装甲：装甲 数值：150\\n结构：结构 数值：1\\n\\n\\n引擎：0 标准聚变引擎\\n\\n装备：\\n\\n\\n武器：\\n 1x 榴弹炮\\n 1x 燃烧榴弹\\n 3x 步兵步枪\\n\\n\\n弹药：\n

column1: Produced by Clan Ghost Bear, this version uses a 300-rated XL engine. All standard weapons have been replaced by a single ER Large Laser. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 由幽灵熊氏族生产，该型号使用 300 级 XL 引擎。所有标准武器都被替换为一门 ER 大型激光炮。\\n\\n特性：窄身/低矮轮廓\\n\\n部署费用倍率：1.04\\n\\n手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The Anand is another Prototype of the Morrigan Project, named for a Goddess that protects the Land has this Omni Received special care to it's protective abilitys Quirk: Morrigan C3i Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Anand 是 Morrigan 计划的又一款原型机，以守护大地的女神命名。这台全能机甲在防护能力方面得到了特别强化。\\n\\n特性：Morrigan C3i\\n\\n部署费用倍率：1.06\\n\\n手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: A new configuration for the Kodiak used by the Rasalhague Dominion, the 6th configuration adds two Coolant Pods after replacing the Ultra Autocannon with a LB-X AC/20 and the ER Large Laser with Medium Pulse Laser. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24
column2: Rasalhague Dominion 使用的 Kodiak 新配置。第六种配置在用 LB-X AC/20 替换 Ultra 自动炮、用中型脉冲激光炮替换 ER 大型激光炮后，又增加了两个冷却舱。\\n\\n特性：战斗拳\\n\\n部署费用倍率：1.24

column1: It has been speculated that the name Waneta draws on ancient beliefs held by the native tribes that inhabited the region of Terra once known as the United States, and that the name may have been derived from a particular myth or range of mythology relating to tales of shapeshifters, but that has yet to be proven conclusively.
column2: 有人推测，Waneta 这个名字源于 Terra 上原称美国地区的原住民部落所持的古老信仰，也可能取自某个与变形者故事有关的神话或神话体系，但这一说法尚未得到确凿证明。

column1: Similar to the K1, this variant drops base model's ER small laser and small pulse laser for two additional ER medium lasers, and swaps the SRM-6 launcher for an SRM-4 with CASE protecting the one ton ammunition bin. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: 与 K1 类似，该变体移除了基础型号的 ER 小型激光炮和小型脉冲激光炮，换成两门额外的 ER 中型激光炮；同时将 SRM-6 发射器换成 SRM-4，并用 CASE 保护一吨弹药仓。\\n\\n特性：分散注意\\n\\n部署费用倍率：1.02

column1: This variant drops the re-engineered lasers of the standard variant and instead mounts two ER Medium Lasers in each arm and one in the center torso, along with a Targeting Computer in the BattleMech's head. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 该变体舍弃了标准型号的重新设计激光炮，改为每条手臂搭载两门 ER 中型激光炮，中央躯干再搭载一门，并在战斗机甲头部安装瞄准计算机。\\n\\n特性：扩展躯干旋转\\n\\n部署费用倍率：0.99

column1: The Raven LR 'Dagger' sports a prototype Electronics Warfare suite, Stealth Armor, TAG, and a pair of NARC launchers with explosive and standard ammo. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Raven LR“匕首”搭载原型电子战套件、隐形装甲、TAG，以及一对配备爆炸弹和标准弹药的 NARC 发射器。\\n\\n特性：灵活\\n\\n部署费用倍率：1.02\\n\\n手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: Seeing the need for their Legionnaires to be able to quickly fill the holes they punch through enemy armor, the Marian Hegemony has retrofitted their stock of hunchbacks with FerroFiberous armor and a rack of RL20s. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: 马里安霸权意识到，他们的 Legionnaire 需要能够迅速填补自己在敌方装甲上打出的缺口，因此将库存中的 Hunchback 改装为铁纤维装甲，并加装 RL20 发射架。\\n\\n特性：战斗拳\\n\\n部署费用倍率：1.02

column1: The Z-B is an advanced Society configuration that utilizes a pair of Society MRM45s, a pair of Medium Supra Lasers, and a pair of Small Supra Lasers. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Z-B 是一款先进的 Society 配置，使用一对 Society MRM45、一对中型 Supra 激光炮和一对小型 Supra 激光炮。\\n\\n特性：改进型瞄准 - 中程\\n\\n部署费用倍率：1.2\\n\\n手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The DRG-1C uses an AC/2 instead of the more standard AC/5. This allows it to have extreme reach across the battlefield, but at a reduced damage rate. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: DRG-1C 使用 AC/2 取代更常见的 AC/5。这让它能够横跨战场进行极远距离射击，但伤害率也有所降低。\\n\\n特性：稳定\\n\\n部署费用倍率：1.06\\n\\n手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: An experimental upgrade of the prototype K3, this Kuritan variant carries twin Heavy and Light PPCs linked to a Prototype Capacitor. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是原型 K3 的实验型升级版，该库伦变体搭载两门重型 PPC 和两门轻型 PPC，并连接至原型电容器。\\n\\n特性：精准武器 - 能量\\n\\n部署费用倍率：1.09\\n\\n手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The Shockwave SKW-6H removes the RAC/5 and instead carries a UAC/10. The LRM-10 loses its Artemis IV fire control system, and engineers had to use an XL gyro to free enough mass for the heavy weapon and ammunition. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: Shockwave SKW-6H 移除了 RAC/5，改为搭载一门 UAC/10。LRM-10 失去了 Artemis IV 火控系统，而工程师不得不使用 XL 陀螺仪，为重型武器和弹药腾出足够质量。 \\n\\n特性：战斗拳\\n\\n部署费用倍率：1.04

column1: The origin of this mech is unknown, but all the mech's equipment indicate it's made by the Society. Its codename 'Obsidian Skull' is only known if you have seen this mech before and left alive to continue living. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24
column2: 这台机甲的起源无人知晓，但其所有装备都表明它由 Society 制造。它的代号“黑曜石骷髅”只有见过这台机甲并活下来的人才知道。\\n\\n特性：近战执行器\\n\\n部署费用倍率：1.24

column1: While outwardly a simple Hatchetman, this Solaris upgrade carries advanced Electronics and a experimental Combat Shield alongside a modified Hatchet, adding a formidable defense to an already formidable chassis. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: 虽然表面上只是一台普通的 Hatchetman，但这台 Solaris 升级型搭载先进电子设备和实验型战斗盾牌，并配有改装战斧，为本已强大的底盘增添了强悍防御。 \\n\\n特性：近战执行器\\n\\n部署费用倍率：1.16

column1: The Yari YRI-5F brings an Ultra Autocannon 10 to the design, but at the cost of reducing the amount of LRM ammunition by two tons. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.33 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Yari YRI-5F 为设计增加了一门 Ultra 自动炮 10，但代价是 LRM 弹药减少两吨。\\n\\n特性：精准武器 - 导弹\\n\\n部署费用倍率：1.33\\n\\n手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The first Scuti to ever be designed, the X1 variant, mounts an prototype Accelerated AC/20 in each arm, a Gauss Rifle and two ER PPc. Quirk: Battle Computer SLDF-X Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.43 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是有史以来设计的第一台 Scuti。X1 型号每条手臂都装有一门原型加速 AC/20，另有一支高斯步枪和两门 ER PPC。 \\n\\n特性：战斗电脑 SLDF-X\\n\\n部署费用倍率：1.43\\n\\n手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: Recovered and rebuilt by VENS by order of a rather wealthy merc client, this Prototype Atlas 3 was designed to be even more intimidating. According to her wishes, it boasts superior agility barely seen in its class. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24
column2: VENS 受一位富有的雇佣兵客户委托回收并重建了这台原型 Atlas 3，旨在让它更具威慑力。按照客户要求，它拥有同级机甲罕见的卓越敏捷性。\\n\\n特性：威慑\\n\\n部署费用倍率：1.24

column1: The 6M boasts an increase in firepower and endurance as a raider by dropping the AC/5 and replacing it with a Large Laser. This also allowed for the addition of another Medium Laser and extra Heat Sinks. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 6M 放弃 AC/5、改装大型激光炮后，作为突袭机甲获得了更强的火力和续航能力。这也为增加另一门中型激光炮和额外散热器腾出了空间。\\n\\n特性：改进通信\\n\\n部署费用倍率：1.03

column1: The Horses have supplemented their generalist and missile boat Svartalfas with a close-combat variant dropping the Streak missiles to mount more chemical lasers. Accordingly, it is slightly less sluggish once airborne. Quirk: Resilient Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.986
column2: Horses 用一种近战变体补充了其通用型和导弹艇型 Svartalfa，舍弃 Streak 导弹，改为搭载更多化学激光炮。因此，它升空后飞行时的迟滞感略有减轻。\\n\\n特性：坚韧\\n\\n部署费用倍率：0.986

column1: Designed and produced by Clan Jade Falcon in 3062 the project was terminated in 3064 due to it being a complete failure. This Variant is loaded with a Fusion 16 engine, and a single Light Machine Gun and 10 rounds of ammo. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95
column2: 这项计划由玉龙氏族于 3062 年设计并生产，却因彻底失败而于 3064 年终止。这款变体配备 Fusion 16 引擎、一挺轻型机枪和 10 发弹药。\\n\\n特性：灵活\\n\\n部署费用倍率：0.95

column1: With a wave of your hand, you quiet the room. "That's a steep price, but I don't see us getting into the good graces of the pirates any time soon. Let's take the deal on the table."\n\nYang strokes his chin in contemplation. "I need a cool pirate name now. Maybe 'Angry Yang', oooh, or 'Iron Beard'! Whatcha think?"
column2: 你挥手让房间安静下来。“价格确实很高，但我看我们短期内没法博得海盗的好感。就接受摆在桌面上的这笔交易吧。”\\n\\n杨若有所思地捋着下巴。“我现在需要一个酷一点的海盗名字。也许叫‘愤怒杨’，哦不，或者‘铁胡子’！你觉得怎么样？”

column1: Leave it to a Pirate to find a perfectly fine owens and do this to it, the BAP and Tag got Ripped out for some ECM to support its stealth abilities Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - PPC Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 交给海盗来处理吧：他们找到一台完好无损的 Owens，却把它改成了这样。他们拆掉 BAP 和 TAG，换上 ECM 来支援隐形能力。\\n\\n特性：改进型冷却套 - PPC\\n\\n部署费用倍率：0.95\\n\\n手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: Quicsell's Assault Ballistic Support. The BLR-4 is specialized in cooking your enemies out of their mechs. The revolutionary Double Autocannons can unload more inferno rounds than any other Autocannons on the market. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
column2: Quicsell 的突击型弹道支援机。BLR-4 专门把敌人从机甲里“烤”出来。革命性的双联自动炮能发射比市场上任何其他自动炮都多的燃烧弹。\\n\\n特性：指挥机甲\\n\\n部署费用倍率：1.13

column1: A field refit employed during the Jihad, the 5Sr uses an XL gyro and removes the UAC/5, allowing engineers to install a Guardian ECM suite and a heavy PPC. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 圣战期间使用的战地改装型。5Sr 采用 XL 陀螺仪并移除 UAC/5，让工程师得以安装 Guardian ECM 套件和一门重型 PPC。\\n\\n特性：易于维护\\n\\n部署费用倍率：1.02\\n\\n手臂执行器限制：左下臂

column1: Produced by the Clan Protectorate this is basically a standard TMP-3M with Clan-spec weaponry, except for the SRM which is replaced by an ATM-9. Quirk: Breaching Shot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 由保护国氏族生产，本质上是一台搭载氏族规格武器的标准 TMP-3M，唯一例外是用 ATM-9 替换了 SRM。\\n\\n特性：破袭射击\\n\\n部署费用倍率：1.09\\n\\n手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: The Catapult K9 is a refit of the venerable K2 variant, carrying twin Gauss rifles in place of PPCs, and featuring enhanced armor. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Ballistics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Catapult K9 是久负盛名的 K2 变体的改装型，用两支高斯步枪替代 PPC，并强化了装甲。\\n\\n特性：精准武器 - 弹道\\n\\n部署费用倍率：1.11\\n\\n手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The B loadout of the Republic's CLR-03-O OmniMech variant uses an Angel ECM suite to disrupt enemy electronics systems. This specific version has been further altered to add a small laser, the 'Mechs only weapon. Quirk: Quad Mech (Squad) Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.94
column2: 共和国 CLR-03-O 全能机甲变体的 B 配置使用天使 ECM 套件干扰敌方电子系统。这个特定版本经过进一步改装，增加了一门小型激光炮——这是该机甲唯一的武器。\\n\\n特性：四足机甲（小队）\\n\\n部署费用倍率：0.94

column1: An Arrow IV and four Large Pulse Lasers are nothing special on the surface. Until you realize everything is hotwired and held together by gum. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.44 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 表面上，一门 Arrow IV 和四门大型脉冲激光炮没什么特别。直到你发现所有设备都是直接接线，并用口香糖粘在一起。\\n\\n特性：360° 躯干旋转\\n\\n部署费用倍率：1.44\\n\\n手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: While outwardly a simple Hatchetman is this Solaris upgrade sporting advanced Electronics and a Experimental Combat shield alongside a modified Hatchet, adding a formidable defense to an already formidable chassis. Quirk: Integrated TSM Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
column2: 这台 Solaris 升级型外表只是一台普通 Hatchetman，却搭载先进电子设备和实验型战斗盾牌，并配有改装战斧，为本已强大的底盘增添了强悍防御。 \\n\\n特性：集成 TSM\\n\\n部署费用倍率：1.11

column1: The Prototype Prime's main weapons were an ER PPC and LB 10-X Class Autocannon. These weapons were backed up by pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and single ER Small Laser. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Prototype Prime 的主要武器是一门 ER PPC 和一门 LB 10-X 型自动炮。另有一对中型脉冲激光炮和一门 ER 小型激光炮提供支援。\\n\\n特性：分散注意\\n\\n部署费用倍率：1.05\\n\\n手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: Quicsell's Light Laser Support. The PNT-QS4 packs a wide variety of support equipment to assist lancemates. From Searchlights and EWS to Limpet Mines and Firebombs that can be thrown by the mech to hit your enemies. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: Quicsell 的轻型激光支援机。PNT-QS4 搭载了多种支援设备，协助星座队友作战。从探照灯和 EWS，到机甲可以投掷并命中敌人的蛞蝓雷和燃烧弹。\\n\\n特性：空袭\\n\\n部署费用倍率：0.98

column1: Quicsell's Heavy Ballistic Backstabber. The BL-QS3 mounts Quicsell's largest rotary cannon, the Large Rotary Rifle. Perfect for opening up an enemy mech's armor for the Heavy Machineguns to play havoc with the insides. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: Quicsell 的重型弹道背刺机。BL-QS3 搭载 Quicsell 最大的旋转炮——大型旋转步枪。它非常适合撕开敌方机甲装甲，让重型机枪肆意破坏内部结构。\\n\\n特性：指挥机甲\\n\\n部署费用倍率：1.09

column1: The preferred configuration by Clan Wolf, mounting two Improved Heavy Medium Lasers, twin LRM-10 launchers with 2 tons of ammo and an Extended Range PPC. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是狼氏族偏爱的配置，搭载两门改进型重型中型激光炮、两具 LRM-10 发射器（配备 2 吨弹药）以及一门远程 PPC。\\n\\n特性：改进型瞄准 - 短程\\n\\n部署费用倍率：1.1\\n\\n手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The FarmerMax FM-2 mounts a combine in each arm for harvesting crops, a sprayer in each side torso connected to a five ton liquid storage bay, while a flamer in the head handles controlled burns and brush clearing. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.82
column2: FarmerMax FM-2 在每条手臂上都安装了一台收割机用于收割作物，两侧躯干各有一台喷雾器并连接到容量五吨的液体储存舱；头部的火焰喷射器则负责受控焚烧和清理灌木。 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：0.82

column1: Mounting six Streak LRM-5 launchers, the G configuration of the Crossbow trades ammunition flexibility and weapon weight for preservation of ammunition. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 十具 Streak LRM-5 发射器使 Crossbow 的 G 型在弹药灵活性和武器重量之间作出取舍，以保存弹药。 特性：短程改进瞄准 部署成本倍率：1.08 手臂执行器限制：全向

column1: A simple Jihad-era refit, this version places a Guardian ECM Suite in the torso by reducing the Streak SRM systems to their four tube versions. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是一次简单的圣战时期改装：通过将 Streak SRM 系统缩减为四管型号，把 Guardian ECM 套件安装进了躯干。 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：1.14 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: This model is a Star League era awesome that was picked over by pirates. It makes use of an XL 325 core to get close enough to use it's four rotary chem lasers. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这款型号是被海盗拆解搜刮过的星盟时代 Awesome。它采用 XL 325 核心，足以接近目标并使用四门旋转化学激光。 特性：战斗拳 部署成本倍率：1.14 手臂执行器限制：右下

column1: Quicsell's Assault PPC Brawler. The BLR-QS2 brings to bear a surprising amount of firepower for a mech so heavily armored. Thanks to our patented XL ICE technology, your brand new battery of PPCs will stay cool as ICE! Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
column2: Quicsell 的突击型 PPC 格斗机。BLR-QS2 装甲如此厚重，却能释放出惊人的火力。多亏我们获得专利的 XL ICE 技术，你全新的 PPC 阵列会像冰块一样保持冷却！ 特性：指挥机甲 部署成本倍率：1.13

column1: Quicsell's Medium PPC Sniper. The TBT-QS1 packs a pair of devastating Quicsell Heavy PPCs. So long as you stay at long range, your enemies will never see you coming, especially with our integrated stealth X system. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: Quicsell 的中型 PPC 狙击机。TBT-QS1 装有两门毁灭性的 Quicsell 重型 PPC。只要保持远距离，敌人就永远看不到你逼近，尤其是在我们集成的 X 型隐身系统加持下。 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：1.02

column1: The Kintaro 18 is a beast of a machine. It's fast for its size, mounts heavy armor, and can literally shred most other 'Mechs with its almost ridiculous amount of close-range weaponry. But, it runs hotter than Hell's saunas. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: Kintaro 18 是一台凶猛的机器。以它的体型而言速度很快，装备厚重装甲，几乎能用数量荒谬的近距离武器撕碎其他大多数“机甲”。但它运行起来比地狱的桑拿房还热。 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.03

column1: A more recent loadout, the I configuration mounts an Improved Heavy Medium Laser and a Plasma Cannon, combined with two SRM 4 launchers and the standard Flamer. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是较新的配置：I 型安装一门改进型重型中型激光和一门等离子炮，搭配两具 SRM 4 发射器及标准火焰喷射器。 特性：执行器防护 部署成本倍率：0.99 手臂执行器限制：全向

column1: The Pwwka achieved one notable success on the battlefield; it completely surprised the forces from both the allied coalition and the Principality of Regulus who were engaged in combat actions against the Word of Blake. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: Pwwka 在战场上取得过一次显著成功：它完全出其不意地打击了正在与 Blake 圣言交战的盟军联军和列吉尔斯亲王领部队。 特性：陆空机甲 部署成本倍率：0.99

column1: The Primary configuration of the Alpha Wolf mounts two Rotary AC/5 and two LRM-15 launchers, with a combined load of 10 tons of ammunition for the two weapon types. Quirk: Improved Jammer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Alpha Wolf 的主配置装备两门旋转 AC/5 和两具 LRM-15 发射器，两种武器共携带 10 吨弹药。 特性：改进干扰器 部署成本倍率：1.17 手臂执行器限制：全向

column1: Being developed in 3147 by the Republic of the Sphere, this variant is based on the LMT-2R. The 2R is a experimental Drone Command Unit. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 该变体由星球共和国于 3147 年开发，以 LMT-2R 为基础。2R 是一台实验型无人机指挥单元。 特性：可变射程瞄准 部署成本倍率：1.09 手臂执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Triton was designed by Clan Goliath Scorpion for their Seekers. The main weapon, a Streak SRM-4, is very conservative with its ammunition, while the ER Micro Laser provides a weapon that isn't tied to logistical bases. Quirk: Sprinter Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.978
column2: Triton 由大毒蝎氏族为其探索者设计。主武器 Streak SRM-4 极为节省弹药，而 ER 微型激光则提供了一种不依赖后勤基地的武器。 特性：疾跑者 部署成本倍率：0.978

column1: The Black Knight 6B was the harder-hitting, cooler-running Star League ancestor to the standard BL-6-KNT we have today. This one was refitted by a bunch of Pirates with some help of whatever goes as Moonshine among them. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
column2: Black Knight 6B 是如今标准 BL-6-KNT 的星盟时代祖先，火力更强、运行更冷。这台机体由一群海盗改装而成，还用上了他们所谓的“私酿酒”提供的帮助。 特性：指挥机甲 部署成本倍率：1.11

column1: An unusual variant of the HCT-5D, the 5DD swaps out the AC/10 for a Rotary AC/2 and ER Medium Laser, giving this 'mech a unique combination of destructive long range strike potential backed up by it's melee potential. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: HCT-5D 的一个不同寻常的变体。5DD 用旋转 AC/2 和 ER 中型激光替换 AC/10，为这台机甲带来独特的组合：强大的远程打击能力辅以近战潜力。 特性：近战执行器 部署成本倍率：1.03

column1: the 20C is a clan technology refit of the Götterdämmerung. It replaces the heavy ferro-fibrous armor with ferro-lamellor, and replaces the weapons with a clan grade ER PPC, five clan ER Medium Lasers and a clan LRM-15. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
column2: 20C 是 Götterdämmerung 的氏族科技改装型。它用铁磁层装甲替换厚重的铁磁纤维装甲，并将武器换成一门氏族级 ER PPC、五门氏族 ER 中型激光和一具氏族 LRM-15。 特性：稳定武器 部署成本倍率：1.11

column1: The Orc is the first ProtoMech developed wholly by Clan Hell's Horses. The Orc reflects the unique battle tactics of the Horses. Trading armor protection for firepower, the Orc 3 mounts an additional SRM tube (totalling five). Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: Orc 是完全由地狱之马氏族研发的第一种原型机甲。Orc 体现了地狱之马独特的战术。它牺牲装甲防护换取火力，Orc 3 额外安装了一根 SRM 炮管（总计五根）。 特性：灵巧 部署成本倍率：0.97

column1: The -2F brings five Small Lasers, as its primary role as an anti-squad and infantry unit. The standard Guardian ECM and Beagle Probe were kept. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: -2F 搭载五门小型激光，主要用于反小队和反步兵任务。标准 Guardian ECM 和 Beagle 探测器得以保留。 特性：窄体/低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：0.97 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: Quicsell's Light Laser Brawler. The COM-QS2 is a tough nut to crack, and has a big stick to swing, too! Get up close and personal with the REX Medium lasers, or smash your enemies with the complementary 6 ton mace. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: Quicsell 的轻型激光格斗机。COM-QS2 很难对付，挥舞的家伙也很大！用 REX 中型激光贴近敌人，或者用配套的 6 吨钉头锤粉碎敌人。 特性：窄体/低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：0.96

column1: Built by Meridian Manufacturing, the Arbiter is nothing more than a light WorkMech crafted to look like a large and impressive Heavy Battlemech. A common refit to the Arbiter does it exchange the rifle for a 'real' Weapon. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: Meridian 制造的 Arbiter 只是一台轻型工作机甲，做成了大型威猛重型战斗机甲的外形。对 Arbiter 的常见改装是把步枪换成一把“真正的”武器。 特性：扰人 部署成本倍率：1.05

column1: The Naga T loadout combines the characteristic Arrow IV in each arm with two Improved Heavy Medium Lasers, and a light TAG to improve the Arrow IV's performance. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Naga T 配置将每条手臂上的标志性 Arrow IV 与两门改进型重型中型激光结合起来，并配备轻型 TAG 以提升 Arrow IV 的性能。 特性：扩展躯干扭转 部署成本倍率：1.13 手臂执行器限制：全向

column1: A variant mostly seen in Kurita and Comstar space, the 001 mounts both Enhanced LRMs and Pulser Lasers as complimentary weapons to the Plasma Railgun. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.34 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这一变体主要见于库里塔和 ComStar 领地，001 将增强型 LRM 和脉冲激光作为等离子轨道炮的辅助武器。 特性：指挥机甲 部署成本倍率：1.34 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: The JagerMech 7F has been upgraded to carry twin Rotary Autocannon/5s, providing ranged fire support only surpassed by Assault class Battlemechs. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: JagerMech 7F 已升级为携带双联旋转自动炮/5，为远程火力支援提供了仅次于突击级战斗机甲的输出。 特性：防空瞄准 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: This Pirate refit of a Hollander II trades the usual Gauss Rifle for some kind of rotary rifle abomination. To their credit, these pirates at least thought to put some advanced electronics and more than token armor on it. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 这台 Hollander II 的海盗改装型用某种旋转步枪怪物替代了通常的高斯步枪。值得肯定的是，这些海盗至少想到了给它装上先进电子设备和不止象征性的装甲。 特性：战斗拳 部署成本倍率：1.03

column1: An alternate version to the -1A, it is similar in much except the weapons loadout which replaces the ATM-9 launchers with two Streak LRM-10 launchers. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.38 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是 -1A 的替代版本，除武器配置外大体相似：它用两具 Streak LRM-10 发射器替换了 ATM-9 发射器。 特性：指挥机甲 部署成本倍率：1.38 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: While still Pretty much a Victor, it looks as if they tried to 'upgrade' the AC20, totally screwing up the entire balance and chassis. It has DOOMGUY written all over... Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: 虽然基本上仍是一台 Victor，但他们似乎试图“升级” AC20，结果彻底破坏了整机的平衡和底盘。机体上到处都写着 DOOMGUY…… 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.12 手臂执行器限制：右上

column1: The Yellow Jacket YJ-12 is an early variant produced in lesser numbers than the main design of the line, the YJ-15. The YJ-12 carries four Small Lasers and two Machine Guns, and a full compliment of six jump jets. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: Yellow Jacket YJ-12 是早期变体，产量少于该系列的主型号 YJ-15。YJ-12 携带四门小型激光和两挺机枪，并配备完整的六具跳跃喷射器。 特性：扩展躯干扭转 部署成本倍率：0.96

column1: A short to medium range brawler, Avalanche A swaps out its LRM-10 launchers for a pair of SRM-6 and SRM-4 Launchers. The 'Mech retains its arm mounted ER medium lasers. Quirk: Well Balanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 作为一台中短程格斗机，Avalanche A 用一对 SRM-6 和 SRM-4 发射器替换了 LRM-10 发射器。该机甲保留了安装在手臂上的 ER 中型激光。 特性：平衡良好 部署成本倍率：0.99 手臂执行器限制：全向

column1: An experimental prototype that saw service in 3078 with Devlin Stone's Coalition during the Jihad, the SDR-8X was clad in nearly double the armor of the later 8R and mounted an experimental Inner Sphere technology Partial Wing. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 这是在圣战期间于 3078 年随 Devlin Stone 联军服役的实验原型机。SDR-8X 的装甲几乎是后来 8R 的两倍，并安装了实验性的内层圈科技部分翼。 特性：灵巧 部署成本倍率：0.99

column1: Introduced by the Capellan Confederation in the Dark Age, this version replaces the main weaponry with plasma rifles and is protected by Heat-Dissipating Armor. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 该型号由卡佩兰联邦在黑暗时代推出，以等离子步枪替换主要武器，并由散热装甲提供防护。 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：1.14 手臂执行器限制：左下

column1: This variant replaces the four micro pulse lasers with a pair of small pulse lasers. This keeps the damage output the same, but the small lasers have a better range while still being effective against infantry. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 该变体用一对小型脉冲激光替换了四门微型脉冲激光。这样保持了相同的伤害输出，同时小型激光拥有更好的射程，对步兵依然有效。 特性：精准武器 - 激光 部署成本倍率：1.09

column1: Quicsell's Light Missile Support. The COM-QS4 has a half a dozen ways to blast, confuse, debuff, and otherwise harass your enemies. Included is the top of the line Quicsell EWS package, and a survivable Light engine. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: Quicsell 的轻型导弹支援机。COM-QS4 有六种以上方式可以轰炸、迷惑、削弱或骚扰敌人。它配备顶级 Quicsell EWS 套件，以及一台更耐用的轻型引擎。 特性：窄体/低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：0.96

column1: This variant of the Nightsky uses Triple Strength Myomer to maximize physical attack damage. It also uses one ER medium laser and a pair of ER small lasers. To make room for those weapons, it loses a medium pulse laser. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: Nightsky 的这一变体使用三倍强度肌肉组织，以最大化物理攻击伤害。它还使用一门 ER 中型激光和一对 ER 小型激光。为这些武器腾出空间，它舍弃了一门中型脉冲激光。 特性：近战执行器 部署成本倍率：1.04

column1: The Catapult C1M is a common Mercenary refit to the old C1 designed a selection of Multi-Missile Launchers to help with supply shortages. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Catapult C1M 是一种常见的佣兵改装型，针对老式 C1 设计，使用多重导弹发射器来缓解补给短缺。 特性：精准武器 - 导弹 部署成本倍率：1.09 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: The Highlander IIC-3, introduced 3077 carries a HAG/20 with 4 tons of ammunition for long battlefield endurance and ECM Suite instead of the standard Gauss Rifle. Quirk: Reinforced Legs Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: Highlander IIC-3 于 3077 年推出，携带一门 HAG/20 和 4 吨弹药以实现持久战斗，并以 ECM 套件取代标准高斯步枪。 特性：强化腿部 部署成本倍率：1.2 手臂执行器限制：右下

column1: This Jihad-era variant replaces the Gauss Rifle and ER PPC with an LB 10-X AC and Heavy PPC. To offset the additional heat output, more heat sinks are added. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这个圣战时期变体用 LB 10-X AC 和重型 PPC 替换了高斯步枪与 ER PPC。为抵消额外的热量输出，它增加了更多散热器。 特性：稳定 部署成本倍率：1.11 手臂执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Hobgoblin's status as a test vehicle can be clearly seen when looking at its weapons. A single AP Gauss Rifle and Fusillade launcher are less effective than other ProtoMech designs, even when gathered in a Point. Quirk: Improved Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 从武器配置可以清楚看出 Hobgoblin 的试验载具身份。单门 AP 高斯步枪和 Fusillade 发射器即使在一个点编制中集群使用，也不如其他原型机甲设计有效。 特性：改进瞄准 部署成本倍率：0.99

column1: The pirates who got their hands on this Swordsman really took its name seriously. Besides this huge ten-ton blade, it's crammed full of flamers and covered in spikes. They even found room to fit this stolen rotary AC/2. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: 抢到这台 Swordsman 的海盗确实认真对待了它的名字。除了这把巨大的十吨大刀，它还塞满了火焰喷射器，浑身布满尖刺。他们甚至找地方装上了这门偷来的旋转 AC/2。 特性：近战执行器 部署成本倍率：1.02

column1: The Delta configuration of the Bee is a modernized variant using X-Pulse lasers and an LRM-15. The rest of the configuration remains similar to the primary configuration. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Bee 的 Delta 配置是使用 X-脉冲激光和 LRM-15 的现代化变体。其余配置与主配置相近。 特性：易于驾驶 部署成本倍率：0.95 手臂执行器限制：全向

column1: Vindicator P's are basically ramshackle pieces of barely working scrap metal, typically encountered among pirates but one never knows how bad someone's mechtech really is. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: Vindicator P 基本上是由勉强能工作的废金属拼成的破烂货，通常在海盗中见到；不过谁也不知道某人的机甲技师究竟有多糟。 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.01 手臂执行器限制：右下

column1: The Y-H12GC is a Dark Age Era variant that carries a C3 boosted slave system. It also uses a Gauss rifle and a Clan-built ER PPC for its main firepower. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Y-H12GC 是黑暗时代的变体，携带 C3 增强从属系统。它还使用一支高斯步枪和一门氏族制造的 ER PPC 作为主要火力。 特性：指挥机甲 部署成本倍率：1.16 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: The 'Vollstrecker', or Executioner, is a Steiner Elite Battlemech, agile like a medium 'Mech and armed to the Teeth, is this a true Lyran Military doctrine Scout. Quirk: Reinforced Legs Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.23 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: “Vollstrecker”，即“行刑者”，是施泰纳精锐战斗机甲，拥有中型机甲般的敏捷与武装到牙齿的火力——这难道不正是利拉军事教条的侦察机吗？ 特性：强化腿部 部署成本倍率：1.23 手臂执行器限制：右下

column1: Introduced during the FedCom Civil War, this Highlander variant replaces the missiles, medium lasers, and jump jets with two Large Lasers and a Heavy Gauss Rifle. Quirk: Reinforced Legs Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 该 Highlander 变体在联邦合众国内战期间推出，用两门大型激光和一支重型高斯步枪替换了导弹、中型激光与跳跃喷射器。 特性：强化腿部 部署成本倍率：1.18 手臂执行器限制：右下

column1: The Alpha loadout replaces the Large Pulse Lasers with an Ultra AC/5 and a ER PPC. The LRM launcher is fully removed, while the Guardian ECM and Active Probe are retained. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Alpha 配置用一门 Ultra AC/5 和一门 ER PPC 替换了大型脉冲激光。LRM 发射器被完全移除，而 Guardian ECM 与主动探测器得以保留。 特性：易于驾驶 部署成本倍率：0.95 手臂执行器限制：全向

column1: Based on the popular Roughneck from Achernar Industries was this variant rebuild using Advanced Technologies, typical for Solaris sporting a massive first strike capabilities is it extremely reliant on Ballistic Weapons. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: 该变体以 Achernar Industries 广受欢迎的 Roughneck 为基础，采用 Solaris 常见的先进技术重建，具备强大的先发打击能力，但极度依赖弹道武器。 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：1.17

column1: A Jihad era refit of the Merlin, the 1Cr removes the PPC and anti-infantry weapons of the 1C and replaces them with a Gauss Rifle and 2 tons of ammo. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是 Merlin 的圣战时期改装型。1Cr 移除了 1C 的 PPC 和反步兵武器，换成一支高斯步枪及 2 吨弹药。 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：1.08 手臂执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: A short range variant of the Mad Cat III, mounting two Medium and six Micro Pulse Lasers together with four Artemis V-enabled SRM-6 launchers. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Mad Cat III 的短程变体，装备两门中型脉冲激光和六门微型脉冲激光，并配有四具启用 Artemis V 的 SRM-6 发射器。 特性：改进通讯 部署成本倍率：1.11 手臂执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: Produced as a result of interest from the LCAF, the BZK-D2 removes the UAC/10 of the BZK-D1 and replaces it with a Gauss rifle. The BZK-D2 carried a ton less armor. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: BZK-D2 因 LCAF 的兴趣而生产，它移除了 BZK-D1 的 UAC/10，换成一支高斯步枪。BZK-D2 少携带了一吨装甲。 特性：稳定武器 部署成本倍率：1.05 手臂执行器限制：右上

column1: This variant takes the primary configuration, downgrades the pulse laser to an ER Medium and replaces the Machine Guns with three Anti-Personnel Gauss Rifles. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 该变体采用主配置，将脉冲激光降级为 ER 中型激光，并用三支反人员高斯步枪替换机枪。 特性：中程改进瞄准 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂执行器限制：全向

column1: Quicsell's Light PPC Support. The WSP-QS4 has excellent detection and EWS capabilities for such a light mech, and with the Light Streak PPC, you'll never have issues with shooting your allies in the back by accident! Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95
column2: Quicsell 的轻型 PPC 支援机。WSP-QS4 对如此轻型的机甲而言拥有出色的探测与 EWS 能力；有了轻型 Streak PPC，你再也不用担心误射身后的友军！ 特性：扩展躯干扭转 部署成本倍率：0.95

column1: The E configuration trades firepower for a lot more mobility in the form of six jump jets. The only weapons the loadout brings is a Gauss Rifle and a ER PPC with a PPC capacitor. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: E 配置以火力换取更强的机动性，形式是六具跳跃喷射器。该配置唯一携带的武器是一支高斯步枪和一门带 PPC 电容器的 ER PPC。 特性：稳定 部署成本倍率：1.06 手臂执行器限制：全向

column1: Why would anyone combine expensive tech like all these proto heatsinks and targeting computers with these...homebrew weapons? Only pirates would know. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.44 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 为什么要把昂贵的技术——比如这些原型散热器和瞄准计算机——跟这些……土制武器凑在一起？只有海盗才知道。 特性：360° 躯干扭转 部署成本倍率：1.44 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: Fortress installation safeguarding the surrounding area. Armor: Armor Amount: 150 Structure: Structure Amount: 1 Engine: 0 Standard Fusion Equipment: Weapons: 1x HandHeld MML7 2x Infantry SRM 2x Laser Pistol Ammunition: 4x Ammo SRM
column2: 守护周边区域的堡垒设施。 装甲： 装甲 数量： 150 结构： 结构 数量： 1 引擎： 0 标准融合引擎 装备： 武器： 1x 手持式 MML7 2x 步兵 SRM 2x 激光手枪 弹药： 4x SRM 弹药

column1: The Minotaur is the 'assault class' of the first generation ProtoMechs. Weighing more than any other ProtoMech, it trades speed for armor and weaponry. This variant utilizes an LB 2-X Autocannon with a single ton of ammunition. Quirk: Resilient Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.984
column2: Minotaur 是第一代原型机中的“突击级”型号。它比其他原型机都重，以速度换取装甲与武器。本型号使用一门 LB 2-X 自动炮，并配备一吨弹药。 特性：坚韧 部署成本倍率：0.984

column1: The Atrax 4 keeps the twin railguns of the Atrax 1, but replaces the Gauss rifle with a miniaturized version of a Naval Laser. It is unknown where the laser originates from, as it is not a normal weapon to see amongst the Clans. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.5
column2: Atrax 4 保留了 Atrax 1 的双轨道炮，但用微型化海军激光替换了高斯步枪。没人知道这门激光的来源，因为克兰中并不常见这种武器。 特性：多重锁定 部署成本倍率：1.5

column1: The 5K replaces all the weapons of the 4K with a LBX/10 autocannon and two large lasers. The two AMS are still kept for defensive purposes. To fit the new weapons the 5K has slightly less armor and one less heat sink. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 5K 用一门 LBX/10 自动炮和两门大型激光替换了 4K 的全部武器。两套 AMS 仍保留用于防御。为安装新武器，5K 略微减少了装甲，并少装一台散热器。 特性：强化生命维持 部署成本倍率：1.09

column1: Fortress installation safeguarding the surrounding area. Armor: Armor Amount: 150 Structure: Structure Amount: 1 Engine: 0 Standard Fusion Equipment: Weapons: 2x MagShot 2x MagShot Cannon 2x Sniper Rifle Ammunition: 3x Ammo MagShot
column2: 守护周边区域的堡垒设施。 装甲： 装甲 数量： 150 结构： 结构 数量： 1 引擎： 0 标准融合引擎 装备： 武器： 2x MagShot 2x MagShot 炮 2x 狙击步枪 弹药： 3x MagShot 弹药

column1: The Clans upgraded the venerable Griffin design until the BattleMech now known as the Griffin IIC emerged. The ZA variant is a Society refit that packs a pair of Tesla Rifles, pair of Medium Supra Lasers, and a Society MRM30. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: 克兰不断升级久负盛名的 Griffin 设计，最终诞生了如今称为 Griffin IIC 的战斗机甲。ZA 型是 Society 的改装型，装备一对 Tesla 步枪、一对中型 Supra 激光，以及一具 Society MRM30。 特性：战斗拳 部署成本倍率：1.16

column1: This configuration carries an Improved Heavy Large Laser, two Medium Pulse Lasers, and a TSEMP Cannon in each arm. Twenty-one double heat sinks keep heat manageable. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 该配置在双臂各装备一门改良型重型大型激光、两门中型脉冲激光和一门 TSEMP 炮。21 台双重散热器让热量维持在可控范围。 特性：扩展躯干扭转 部署成本倍率：1.11 手臂执行器限制：全方位

column1: With an ER PPC as the main weapon, the 7K can provide a surprising punch. If the PPC is not enough, the 'Mech also carries two Medium Lasers and a Streak SRM-6. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 7K 以 ER PPC 为主武器，能打出令人意外的火力。如果 PPC 还不够，这台机甲还配备两门中型激光和一具 Streak SRM-6。 特性：扩展躯干扭转 部署成本倍率：1.02 手臂执行器限制：左下

column1: Sporting extensive ClanTech Replacements recovered during the Damocles Campaign, showing the MFB Team's ingenuity under the guide of Thomas Sorenson. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 配备在达摩克利斯行动中回收的大量克兰科技替换件，展现了 MFB 团队在 Thomas Sorenson 指导下的巧思。 特性：窄型/低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：1.13 手臂执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: A custom made adaptation of the JHK-03 ordered by Celina Santos. It replaces the the SRM-6s with an Advanced Tactical Missile System and an LB-X Autocannon/5. It was the first Jade Hawk to become (in)famous in the Inner Sphere. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
column2: Celina Santos 订购的 JHK-03 定制改型。它用高级战术导弹系统和一门 LB-X 自动炮/5 替换了 SRM-6。它是第一台在内层天体声名（或恶名）远扬的 Jade Hawk。 特性：扰乱 部署成本倍率：1.19

column1: The Catapult KC is an is a Classic FrankenMech, borrowing pieces from both the K and C variants, it pairs the firepower of a PPC and a Missile Launcher. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Catapult KC 是一台经典的拼装机甲，借用了 K 型和 C 型的部件，将 PPC 的火力与导弹发射器结合起来。 特性：先进光学 部署成本倍率：1.11 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: One of the strange configurations of the Warhawk, combing the normal two ER PPC clan weapons with two Inner Sphere Plasma Rifles and a single Rocket Launcher 10. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是 Warhawk 的奇特配置之一，将通常的两门克兰 ER PPC 与两支内层天体等离子步枪及一具火箭发射器 10 结合。 特性：强化远程瞄准 部署成本倍率：1.16 手臂执行器限制：全方位

column1: A Dark Age upgrade of the Centurion 9H, the 9H2 replaces the primitive engine with a standard Fusion Engine. The freed weight is used to install an extra Medium Laser. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.77 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这是 Centurion 9H 的黑暗时代升级型。9H2 用标准融合引擎替换了原始引擎，并将节省的重量用于加装一门中型激光。 特性：易于驾驶 部署成本倍率：0.77 手臂执行器限制：右下

column1: A refit of the WLF-3S in use among the states of the Free Worlds League, the 3M replace the ER PPC and ER Lasers with a right-arm mounted Light Gauss Rifle. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这是自由世界联盟各州使用的 WLF-3S 改装型。3M 用安装在右臂的轻型高斯步枪替换了 ER PPC 和 ER 激光。 特性：精准武器 - 能量 部署成本倍率：1.05 手臂执行器限制：右下

column1: Defensive structure capable of repelling minor threats. Armor: Armor Amount: 140 Structure: Structure Amount: 150 Engine: 200 XL Fusion Equipment: 1 x Command Bunker Weapons: 2x MARS 2x Rocket Pack 10 2x Tandem Rocket 20 Ammunition:
column2: 能够击退小规模威胁的防御结构。 装甲： 装甲 数量： 140 结构： 结构 数量： 150 引擎： 200 XL 融合引擎 装备： 1 x 指挥掩体 武器： 2x MARS 2x 火箭包 10 2x 串联火箭 20 弹药：

column1: The Orc is the first ProtoMech developed wholly by Clan Hell's Horses. The Orc reflects the unique battle tactics of the Horses. The standard Orc uses a quartet of SRM-1 missile tubes, with each of the launchers carries five reloads. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: Orc 是 Clan Hell's Horses 完全自主研发的第一种原型机。Orc 体现了马群独特的战术。标准 Orc 使用四组 SRM-1 导弹管，每具发射器都携带五次再装填弹药。 特性：灵巧 部署成本倍率：0.97

column1: The Arrowhead TH-A4-AHD mounts twin Arrow IV artillery systems with six tons of standard ammunition. Self defense relies on two medium lasers and two machine guns, with fourteen and a half tons of standard armor protecting the frame. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: Arrowhead TH-A4-AHD 装备两套 Arrow IV 火炮系统，配备六吨标准弹药。自卫依靠两门中型激光和两挺机枪，框架由十四点五吨标准装甲保护。 特性：稳定 部署成本倍率：1.14

column1: The D variant is a sniper. It has six jump jets, enabling the Balius D to vault up to 180 meters at a time. An ER PPC can fell foes at range, while four ER Medium Lasers can down them up close. Two Medium Pulses are again rear-firing. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: D 型是狙击手。它拥有六具跳跃喷射器，使 Balius D 一次可跃过 180 米。ER PPC 能在远距离击倒敌人，四门 ER 中型激光则负责近距离作战。两门中型脉冲激光同样用于向后射击。 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.1

column1: Well Boss, this is a Razorback, but these junkers replaced most of its Parts to Support its Flamers. Theres a note saying 'Be wary what you wish for'. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 老板，这是 Razorback，不过这些破烂货把大部分部件都换掉了，好让它支持火焰喷射器。有张纸条写着：“当心你许下的愿望”。 特性：窄型/低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：0.99 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: The Ar variant of the Centurion is a Periphery Refit, more used as a Sniper than anything else. The Double Heatsinks make it not too Hot, but don't try anything stupid. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: Centurion 的 Ar 型是外围星区改装型，主要用作狙击手。双重散热器让它不会过热，但别做傻事。 特性：易于驾驶 部署成本倍率：1.02 手臂执行器限制：右下

column1: Introduced in 3080, this popular Trial of Position variant dropped the four jump jets, replacing them with two arm mounted Medium Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 该广受欢迎的阵位试炼型号于 3080 年投入使用，拆除了四具跳跃喷射器，换成两门安装在手臂上的中型脉冲激光。 特性：超伸展执行器 部署成本倍率：1.16 手臂执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: A Serket captured by pirates and refit with - in their opinion - superior weapons; two Silver Bullet Gauss and two Large Rotary Chemical Lasers. The loadout is otherwise very generic, only a 3 ton Nitro Canister worth looking at. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.32
column2: 一台被海盗俘获并改装的 Serket；在他们看来，换上的武器更优秀：两门银弹高斯步枪和两门大型旋转化学激光。除此之外配置十分普通，只有三吨 Nitro 罐值得一提。 特性：多重锁定 部署成本倍率：1.32

column1: This Hermit Crab variant replaces the standard armor with Ferro-Fibrous Armor to free up weight. It also removes the center torso jump jet and uses the freed weight to mount an additional ER Medium Laser in the center torso. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 这款 Hermit Crab 用铁素体装甲替换标准装甲，以腾出重量。它还拆除了中央躯干的跳跃喷射器，并用节省的重量在中央躯干加装一门 ER 中型激光。 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：0.98

column1: Apparently intended as a capture 'Mech, this Cephalus configuration keeps the Light TAG but replaces the Modular Armor and anti-missile systems with a BattleMech Taser. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这套 Cephalus 配置显然是为捕获机甲准备的，保留了轻型 TAG，但用战斗机甲电击枪替换了模块化装甲和反导系统。 特性：强化生命维持 部署成本倍率：1.01 手臂执行器限制：全方位

column1: Named for some supposedly ancient Warrior of Terran mythology does this experimental No-Dachi carry a reforged Large Vibroblade and is equipped with advanced Myomer. Quirk: Way of the Samurai Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 这台实验型 No-Dachi 以某位传说中远古的泰拉战士命名，装备重铸的大型振动刃和先进肌肉纤维。 特性：武士之道 部署成本倍率：1.18 手臂执行器限制：左下

column1: Seizing on lore of old, and finding historical records of mighty creatures that once roamed Terra, the mighty engineers of Takara industries come forth once more, to show us how a 'Mech can be the most fearful thing on the battlefield. Quirk: ROAR! Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.44
column2: Takara 工业的强大工程师抓住古老传说，找到曾在泰拉大地漫游的巨兽历史记录，再次挺身而出，向我们展示机甲如何成为战场上最令人畏惧的存在。 特性：咆哮！ 部署成本倍率：1.44

column1: Introduced to service in 3133 from the Achernar BattleMechs plant on New Avalon, the Vulpes was intended from the outset to be a heavy but fast attack BattleMech, and was quickly adopted by the Armed Forces of the Federated Suns. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: Vulpes 于 3133 年在新亚瓦隆的 Achernar 战斗机甲工厂投入服役，从一开始就被设计为重型而快速的攻击型战斗机甲，并很快被联邦太阳军采用。 特性：扰乱 部署成本倍率：1.08

column1: Each arm on this variation is equipped with an LRT-10, SRT-2, and ER Medium Laser. To maintain a high underwater speed, the Crossbow U is equipped with five UMUs. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 该变体的每条手臂都装备一具 LRT-10、一具 SRT-2 和一门 ER 中型激光。为保持水下高速，Crossbow U 装备了五具水下机动单元。 特性：强化近程瞄准 部署成本倍率：1.08 手臂执行器限制：全方位

column1: Developed by The Society, this variant of the Minotaur uses five Extended Jump Jets and a Magnetic Clamp system to travel around the battlefield. It's equipped with an Improved Heavy Medium Laser, making it a threat to many units. Quirk: Resilient Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.984
column2: 该 Minotaur 变体由 Society 研发，使用五具强化跳跃喷射器和磁性夹具系统在战场上机动。它装备一门改良型重型中型激光，对许多单位都构成威胁。 特性：坚韧 部署成本倍率：0.984

column1: The right arm of the -7R/SF mounts a LB 5-X Autocannon, while the left arm houses two Improved Heavy medium lasers. A SRM-6 launcher in the right torso provides close range firepower, while six improved jump jets keeps the 'Mech mobile. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: -7R/SF 的右臂装备一门 LB 5-X 自动炮，左臂则装有两门改良型重型中型激光。右侧躯干的 SRM-6 发射器提供近距离火力，六具改良型跳跃喷射器让机甲保持机动。 特性：颈甲 部署成本倍率：1.05

column1: A House Kurita conceived variant, this version of the Nyx would employ a C3 slave unit; to make room for this the SRM-6 would be downgraded to an SRM-4. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是由 Kurita 家族构思的变体，Nyx 将使用 C3 从属单元；为腾出空间，SRM-6 被降级为 SRM-4。 特性：窄型/低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：0.99 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: The Primary configuration of the Night Bastion combines four Light Gauss Rifles with four Light PPCs for a surprising amount of damage at long ranges. One Large and two Small Re-engineered Lasers round out the loadout. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Gauss Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.29
column2: Night Bastion 的主配置将四门轻型高斯步枪与四门轻型 PPC 结合，在远距离造成惊人的伤害。一门大型重构激光和两门小型重构激光完善了武器配置。 特性：精准武器 - 高斯 部署成本倍率：1.29

column1: A Jihad-era refit, this model removes everything from the left torso, and replaces it with a C3 Boosted Master and Large Variable Speed Pulse Laser captured from the Word of Blake. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 这是 Jihad 时代的改装型，拆除了左侧躯干的所有部件，换上从 Blake 之道缴获的 C3 增强主机和大型变速脉冲激光。 特性：颈甲 部署成本倍率：1.17 手臂执行器限制：左下

column1: A Jihad era field refit of the Merlin, the 1D removes the PPC and anti-infantry weapons of the 1C and replaces them with a Gauss Rifle and 2 tons of ammo. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是 Merlin 的 Jihad 时代战地改装型。1D 拆除了 1C 的 PPC 和反步兵武器，换上高斯步枪及两吨弹药。 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：1.14 手臂执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: What the hell is this thing boss!? It has a similar look and loadout to the standard Hephaestus Scout Tank but its not an OmniVehicle and its got eight Jump Jets mounted on it for clearing not so small obstacles. All that extra weight had to come from somewhere though so this thing is five tons heavier and no longer carries an infantry bay.
column2: 这到底是什么东西，老板！？它看起来和标准 Hephaestus 侦察坦克、配置也相似，但它不是全向载具，还安装了八具跳跃喷射器，用来跨越不算小的障碍物。不过这些额外重量总得从某处来，所以这东西重了五吨，也不再搭载步兵舱。

column1: This version of the Jupiter sports a completely new weapons configuration. Sporting the same Ultra AC/10s as the 2 version, the rest of the weapons are replaced with a pair of HAG 30 cannons and two ER medium lasers. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22
column2: Jupiter 的这一版本采用了全新的武器配置。它装备与 2 型相同的 Ultra AC/10，其余武器则换成两门 HAG 30 炮和两门 ER 中型激光。 特性：强化远程瞄准 部署成本倍率：1.22

column1: The Spartan N3 is a more modern refit of the aging N2. Despite the age of the chassis, the N3 shows that the Spartan is still just as effective as it ever was, boasting speed, firepower, and durability in spades. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: Spartan N3 是老旧 N2 的现代化改装型。尽管底盘年代久远，N3 仍证明 Spartan 一如既往地高效，在速度、火力和耐久性方面都十分出色。 特性：强化传感器 部署成本倍率：1.14

column1: The Dreka 1S prototype was built to showcase the 2 massive Defiance Hammerfist Heavy Gauss Rifles and is the testbed for what one day will become the Fafnir. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Dreka 1S 原型机旨在展示两门巨大的 Defiance Hammerfist 重型高斯步枪，也是未来 Fafnir 的试验平台。 特性：稳定武器 部署成本倍率：1.2 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: After the success of the Mad Cat II design, which increased the tonnage and weaponry of the Mad Cat, Clan Ghost Bear applied these same changes to the medium Ryoken. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Mad Cat II 设计成功后，机体吨位和武器均得到提升，Clan Ghost Bear 将同样的改进应用到了中型 Ryoken 上。 特性：稳定 部署成本倍率：1.15 手臂执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: Long range firepower comes from an ER large laser in the right arm and a RAC/2 in the left arm, fed by two tons of ammunition. Each side torso also carries an ER medium laser. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 远程火力来自右臂的一门 ER 大型激光和左臂的一门 RAC/2，后者由两吨弹药供给。两侧躯干还各装备一门 ER 中型激光。 特性：战斗计算机 部署成本倍率：1.05 手臂执行器限制：全方位

column1: This 3083 variant uses an XL engine to push its top speed to 96 km/h. It uses an LRM-10, a pair of Light PPCs and three ER medium lasers. An Endo Steel skeleton provides the weight savings needed to install these weapons and engine. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 这个 3083 年变体使用 XL 引擎，将最高速度提升至 96 公里/小时。它配备一具 LRM-10、一对轻型 PPC 和三门 ER 中型激光。内骨骼钢结构提供了安装这些武器和引擎所需的减重空间。 特性：多重锁定 部署成本倍率：1.09

column1: Developed during the Jihad, the Avatar H has a Heavy PPC in each arm, backed by two MML-3s equipped with Artemis IV FCS. Sixteen double heat sinks keep the 'Mech cool. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Avatar H 在 Jihad 期间研发，双臂各装备一门重型 PPC，并由两具配备 Artemis IV 火控系统的 MML-3 支援。16 台双重散热器让机甲保持凉爽。 特性：强化通信 部署成本倍率：1.05 手臂执行器限制：全方位

column1: This variation of the Theseus carries a Grenade Launcher backed up nine one-shot rocket tubes (a Rocket Launcher 4 plus a Rocket Launcher 5). Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: Theseus 的这一变体携带一具榴弹发射器，并由九具一次性火箭管支援（分别为一具火箭发射器 4 和一具火箭发射器 5）。 特性：强化通信 部署成本倍率：0.888 可安装全向单元，可近战，可群袭。

column1: The Warhammer-X is a testbed for the RISC Targeting Computer Systems, hammering any Target to oblivion with 2 Hyperlaser and a Artemis Supported MML. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Warhammer-X 是 RISC 瞄准计算机系统的试验平台，凭借两门超激光和一具 Artemis 支援的 MML 将目标轰成废墟。 特性：集成探照灯 部署成本倍率：1.21 手臂执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Blurr BL-U12 upgrades to Extended Range PPCs shortly after the weapons were introduced throughout the Star League. To handle the increased heat generation one ton of Streak SRM ammo was exchanged for another double heat sink. Quirk: Well Balanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: Blurr BL-U12 在这些武器于整个星盟推出后不久，升级为远程 PPC。为应对增加的热量，一吨 Streak SRM 弹药被换成另一台双重散热器。 特性：平衡良好 部署成本倍率：1.16

column1: This variant removes the Claw and Spikes, replaces the heavy ferro-fibrous with reactive armor, swaps the Magshot for a laser AMS and adds an ER medium laser to each arm as well as adding three additional double heat sinks. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 该变体拆除了爪和尖刺，用反应装甲替换重型铁素体装甲，将 Magshot 换成激光 AMS，并在每条手臂加装一门 ER 中型激光，同时增设三台双重散热器。 特性：受保护执行器 部署成本倍率：1.09

column1: The Blackjack 1Cr is a rather unusual refit, replacing the Autocannons with a pair of Mortars to allow indirect firing support and giving AMS coverage. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Blackjack 1Cr 是相当特别的改装型，用一对迫击炮替换自动炮，以提供间接火力支援，并增加 AMS 防护。 特性：扩展躯干扭转 部署成本倍率：1.03 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: The latest variant from Wakazashi is protected by Light Ferro-Fibrous armor on the Endo Steel chassis. The ER PPC is flanked by two Streak SRM-4s. Even with that, ten double heat sinks are able to keep heat levels under control. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: Wakazashi 的最新型号在内骨骼钢底盘上采用轻型铁素体装甲保护。ER PPC 两侧各有一具 Streak SRM-4。即便如此，十台双重散热器仍能将热量控制在合理水平。 特性：空中突击 部署成本倍率：1.05

column1: The G configuration of the reworked Battle Cobra was mainly seen with mercenary outfits. It mounts a Snubnose PPC, a Plasma cannon and two machine guns - all in its arms. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 重制版 Battle Cobra 的 G 配置主要见于雇佣兵部队。它装备一门短管 PPC、一门等离子炮和两挺机枪——全部安装在双臂上。 特性：扩展躯干扭转 部署成本倍率：0.97 手臂执行器限制：全方位

column1: The -3R mounts a railgun in each side torso, making its alpha strike one of the deadliest possible. However, as it is the only weapons the 'Mech carries this leaves it extremely vulnerable if engaged at shorter ranges. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.29
column2: -3R 型号在两侧躯干各安装一门轨道炮，使其全弹齐射威力达到致命级别。然而，由于这台机甲仅搭载这些武器，一旦在近距离交战就会极其脆弱。 特性：改进型瞄准 - 长程 部署费用倍率：1.29

column1: A late Republic era configuration, this Owens carries a single TSEMP Cannon in the right torso. A supercharger on the engine allows the Owens to reach a top speed of 160 km/h. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是共和国晚期的配置，Owens 右侧躯干搭载一门 TSEMP 炮。发动机上的增压器让 Owens 的最高速度达到 160 km/h。 特性：改进型传感器 部署费用倍率：0.95 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The YMN-7V drops the two LRM-10 of the -6Y to instead mount a third LRM-15, using the freed up space to add a Guardian ECM and some more armoring. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: YMN-7V 拆除了 -6Y 的两具 LRM-10，改为安装第三具 LRM-15，并利用腾出的空间加装 Guardian ECM 和更多装甲。 特性：精准武器 - 导弹 部署费用倍率：1.08 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: Another Inner Sphere configuration of the Battle Cobra used by mercenaries. A Thunderbolt 15 launcher is mounted in the right arm, with three ER Medium Lasers in the left. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是雇佣兵使用的另一种内天体 Battle Cobra 配置。右臂安装一具 Thunderbolt 15 发射器，左臂则有三门 ER 中型激光炮。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 部署费用倍率：0.97 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: Onee of multiple variants emerged from factories with an "MSK-7#" designation. Dating to the late 2400s, these variants utilized powerful autocannons and energy weapons. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: 这是从工厂出产的多个“MSK-7#”型号之一。其历史可追溯至 2400 年代末，这些变体使用了强力自动炮和能量武器。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.16 手臂执行器限制：右上臂

column1: This Republic era variant uses a composite internal structure to free mass for an Ultra autocannon. Several smaller weapons were replaced by CASE II and an Angel ECM Suite. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这款共和国时期的变体采用复合内部结构，为一门 Ultra 自动炮腾出质量。数件较小的武器被替换为 CASE II 和天使 ECM 套件。 特性：稳定武器 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂执行器限制：右下臂

column1: The Urbanking UBK-042 mounts a Binary Laser and a Long Tom Cannon in opposite arms. Otherwise it is utterly bland, it's most advanced feature the XL engine. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Urbanking UBK-042 在左右相对的手臂上分别安装一门二元激光炮和一门 Long Tom 炮。除此之外它平平无奇，最先进的部件也只有 XL 引擎。 特性：360° 躯干旋转 部署费用倍率：1.24 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The resurrection of the Goliath manufacturing on Oliver meant that the brand new design of the 7R could start production. It still retains the typical twin LRM-10 launchers, combining them with a Gauss Rifle and two ER Medium Lasers. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: Oliver 上的 Goliath 生产线复活后，7R 这一全新设计得以开始生产。它仍保留标志性的两具 LRM-10 发射器，并搭配一门高斯步枪和两门 ER 中型激光炮。 特性：多重锁定 部署费用倍率：1.14

column1: This variant of the Piranha is fielded by Clan Ice Hellion and upgrades to double heat sinks so that the Machine Guns can be effectively swapped out for ER Micro Lasers. The other lasers were upgraded to heavy models. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 这款 Piranha 变体由冰 Hellion 氏族部署，并升级为双重散热器，使机枪能够有效替换为 ER 微型激光炮。其他激光炮也升级为重型型号。 特性：改进型瞄准 - 短程 部署费用倍率：1.03

column1: The Minotaur is the 'assault class' of the first generation ProtoMechs. This variation of the Minotaur was redesigned as a fire support model, armed with an LRM-12 Launcher as its 'main gun'. Improvements to the design include an increase of its maximum speed to 80 km/h, increase range to its jumping capacity, and additional armor protection.
column2: Minotaur 是第一代原型机甲中的“突击级”型号。这一 Minotaur 变体重新设计为火力支援型号，以一具 LRM-12 发射器作为主炮。设计改进包括将最高速度提升至 80 km/h、增加跳跃距离，以及强化装甲防护。

column1: This Strider configuration is equipped with an experimental Bombast Laser and a pair of MML-3s. Like the G configuration, it carries a ton of SRM and LRM ammunition for the MMLs. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这款 Strider 配置装备一门实验型 Bombast 激光炮和一对 MML-3。与 G 配置一样，它为 MML 携带一吨 SRM 和 LRM 弹药。 特性：易于驾驶 部署费用倍率：0.97 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The Behemoth, named after Terran mythology, this 'Mech is designed to withstand more punishment than any other 'Mech conceivable while bringing its 2 LBX20's to bear. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Behemoth 得名于 Terran 神话中的巨兽。这台机甲的设计目标是承受其他任何机甲都难以想象的打击，同时让两门 LBX20 发挥威力。 特性：稳定 部署费用倍率：1.24 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: The Clans upgraded the venerable Griffin design until the BattleMech now known as the Griffin IIC emerged. The Z variant is a Society refit that packs a pair of Light TAGs, a pair of Medium Supra Lasers, an iATM9, and a Streak NARC. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: 氏族对久负盛名的 Griffin 设计不断升级，最终诞生了如今称为 Griffin IIC 的战斗机甲。Z 型是 Society 的改装版，搭载一对轻型 TAG、一对中型 Supra 激光炮、一具 iATM9 和一具 Streak NARC。 特性：炮管拳 部署费用倍率：1.16

column1: Quicsell's Assault Ballistic Sniper. The HGN-QS1 comes with three of our exclusive 'Gauss' Rifles. In addition to plenty of our in-house brand Quicsell AC2 ammo, we also supply two tons of specially licenced 'Precision AC2 Ammo'. Quirk: Reinforced Legs Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: Quicsell 的突击型弹道狙击机。HGN-QS1 配备三支独家“高斯”步枪。除了大量自有品牌 Quicsell AC2 弹药外，我们还提供两吨特别授权的“精准 AC2 弹药”。 特性：强化腿部 部署费用倍率：1.14

column1: A fire-support variant, the Osteon-G carries two Arrow IV missile launchers with 5 tons of ammunition. Two ER Medium Lasers and two Medium Pulse Lasers provide close-range firepower. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是一款火力支援变体，Osteon-G 搭载两具 Arrow IV 导弹发射器和 5 吨弹药。两门 ER 中型激光炮和两门中型脉冲激光炮提供近距离火力。 特性：多重锁定 部署费用倍率：1.18 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: This variant replaces the Streak SRM-4 launchers with medium pulse lasers and adds an additional double heat sink, plus an extra ton of armor, but loses the Triple Strength Myomer. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 该变体将 Streak SRM-4 发射器替换为中型脉冲激光炮，并增加一台双重散热器和一吨额外装甲，但失去了三倍强度肌肉。 特性：坚韧 部署费用倍率：1.03 手臂执行器限制：右下臂

column1: A custom design of the Thanatos nick-named 'Hangover'. It replaces the MRM launcher of the -4S with four Rocket Launcher 15s and a Rocket Launcher 10 in the right arm. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Thanatos 的定制设计，昵称为“宿醉”。它将 -4S 的 MRM 发射器替换为四具 Rocket Launcher 15，并在右臂安装一具 Rocket Launcher 10。 特性：稳定 部署费用倍率：1.13 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: The -3M fits two ER Large and two ER Medium Lasers, combined with a Streak SRM-4 launcher with C.A.S.E. protected ammunition. This leaves enough free weight to also add a supercharger and 8.5 tons of Light Ferro-Fibrous armor. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: -3M 安装两门 ER 大型激光炮和两门 ER 中型激光炮，并搭配一具由 C.A.S.E. 保护弹药的 Streak SRM-4 发射器。这为机体留出了足够的质量，还能加装增压器和 8.5 吨轻型铁纤维装甲。 特性：窄身/低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：1.08

column1: This Tian-zong replaces the standard weaponry with a Light Gauss Rifle in the side torsos and an ER Large Laser in each arm. The Light Gauss Rifles each have a ton of ammunition. All other aspects of the N2 are identical to the N1. Quirk: Well Balanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
column2: 这台 Tian-zong 用两侧躯干的轻型高斯步枪和两臂各一门 ER 大型激光炮替换了标准武器。每门轻型高斯步枪各配备一吨弹药。N2 的其他方面与 N1 完全相同。 特性：平衡良好 部署费用倍率：1.11

column1: Project CORAL INTENT goal is to refit Infiltrator Mk II with reverse-engineered Mimetic armor and C3 systems captured from Blakists during New Avalon assault. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: CORAL INTENT 计划的目标是为 Infiltrator Mk II 改装逆向工程仿生装甲，以及在新 Avalon 袭击中从 Blake 教徒手中缴获的 C3 系统。 特性：伏击者 部署费用倍率：0.888 可搭载全能单位，可近战，可进行蜂拥攻击。

column1: The Keratos C replaces the iATM launchers in the arms with Hyper Velocity Autocannons, making it one of the more hybrid configurations in regards to optimal distance for its weapons. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.37 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Keratos C 将双臂上的 iATM 发射器替换为超高速自动炮，使其成为武器最佳射程极为混合的配置之一。 特性：多重锁定 部署费用倍率：1.37 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: Not to be confused with the similarly-named failed SCP-X1, this Scorpion model also never made it beyond the prototyping stages before the high production costs and overall unpopularity of the chassis saw it scrapped. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
column2: 不要将这款 Scorpion 与名称相似但以失败告终的 SCP-X1 混淆。这款 Scorpion 同样未能超越原型阶段，最终因高昂的生产成本和底盘整体不受欢迎而被废弃。 特性：改进型生命维持系统 部署费用倍率：1.13

column1: Introduced in 3074 by the Word of Blake, the Osprey Osp-25 is a minor upgrade of the original Osp-15 which swaps the Medium Lasers for Extended Range versions. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Osprey Osp-25 于 3074 年由 Blake 之言推出，是原始 Osp-15 的小幅升级版，将中型激光炮替换为扩展射程型号。 特性：稳定武器 部署费用倍率：1.05 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The HCS-21r is a common battlefield refit of the HCS-21 for a more focused weapons configuration. The Machine Gun and Flamer are dropped, which allows upgrading the LRM with an Artemis IV attachment and adding a Medium Laser. Quirk: Reinforced Structure Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: HCS-21r 是 HCS-21 在战场上常见的改装版，采用更集中的武器配置。机枪和火焰喷射器被拆除，因此可以为 LRM 加装 Artemis IV 附件，并增加一门中型激光炮。 特性：强化结构 部署费用倍率：1.07

column1: Renewing the Mad Cat legend, the Mk IV used some of the most powerful configurations of its grand brother, while also incorporating easier to find and replace components. Clan Sea Fox expected to experience the same success with this model, as it had with previous ones. This specific variant was a prototype non-Omni stolen by Clan Jade Falcon.
column2: 为了延续 Mad Cat 的传奇，Mk IV 采用其兄长型号最强大的部分配置，同时融入了更容易寻找和更换的部件。海狐氏族期待这款型号取得与前作相同的成功。这个特殊变体是被玉龙之鹰氏族偷走的非全能原型机。

column1: Based on the Royal -1Gb design, the 2M is a Minnesota Tribe upgrade. The ER PPCs are exchanged for Enhanced ER PPCs and the Large Pulse Laser is swapped for an Ion Stream Projector. Each PPC is paired with a Particle Recycler Module. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21
column2: 2M 基于皇家 -1Gb 设计，是明尼苏达部落的升级版。ER PPC 被替换为增强型 ER PPC，大型脉冲激光炮则换成离子流投射器。每门 PPC 都配有粒子回收模块。 特性：指挥机甲 部署费用倍率：1.21

column1: Mounting the Horses' newest weapon, the Balius A has a HAG 20. It also carries an ER Large Laser to supplement that weapon at range. An ER Medium Laser provides additional firepower up close, while another pair of the same protect its back. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: Balius A 搭载马的氏族最新武器 HAG 20。它还配备一门 ER 大型激光炮，在远距离提供支援。一门 ER 中型激光炮在近距离提供额外火力，另外一对同型武器负责保护后方。 特性：坚韧 部署费用倍率：1.1

column1: Introduced in 3115, the second variant of the Shrike replaces the ER Large Lasers with ER Medium Lasers allowing the autocannons to be upgraded to pair of Ultra Autocannon/10s. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.23 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: Shrike 的第二种变体于 3115 年推出，将 ER 大型激光炮替换为 ER 中型激光炮，从而允许把自动炮升级为一对 Ultra 自动炮/10。 特性：指挥机甲 部署费用倍率：1.23 手臂执行器限制：左下臂

column1: A newer variant produced by VEST for the Solaris arenas, the 3T uses a small shield like the J3, though at the cost of armor. This variant is produced solely for the arenas, as it has too little armor for actual combat. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 这是 VEST 为 Solaris 竞技场生产的较新变体。3T 像 J3 一样使用小型盾牌，但代价是装甲减少。该变体仅为竞技场生产，因为它的装甲太少，无法进行实际战斗。 特性：改进型瞄准 - 短程 部署费用倍率：0.99

column1: Without a word, you give Darius a meaningful look and the two of you walk past the stunned MechWarrior.\n\nAfter you're out of earshot, Darius shares his thoughts. "Given the current state of morale, perhaps this exercise serves some purpose in releasing the pressure. I'm not sure it's the right call to let it stay, but I guess we'll find out."
column2: 你一言不发，意味深长地看了 Darius 一眼，然后和他一起走过那名目瞪口呆的机甲战士。\n\n离开对方听力范围后，Darius 分享了他的想法。“考虑到目前的士气状况，也许这项活动确实能起到释放压力的作用。我不确定让它继续下去是否正确，不过我们很快就会知道结果。”

column1: Two Firebees leftover from the Age of War were upgraded in 3071 when Sun-Tzu Liao revealed that he had survived the WarShip bombardment of Sian. They are protected by Stealth Armor and the requisite Guardian ECM Suite. Trading on the 'Mech's name, the Large Laser is replaced with a Plasma Rifle and the SRMs gave way to a multi-missile launcher.
column2: 战争时代遗留下来的两台 Firebee 于 3071 年升级，当时孙祖·辽公开表示自己在 Sian 的战舰轰炸中幸存。它们受到隐形装甲和必备的 Guardian ECM 套件保护。为了呼应机甲的名字，大型激光炮被替换为等离子步枪，SRM 则换成了多导弹发射器。

column1: A Crusader variant, the Turkina H uses three Heavy Medium Lasers, two Medium Pulse Lasers, and two Ultra Autocannon/10s. Five additional double heat sinks keep heat under control. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 作为 Crusader 变体，Turkina H 使用三门重型中型激光炮、两门中型脉冲激光炮和两门 Ultra 自动炮/10。额外的五台双重散热器将热量控制在合理范围内。 特性：空袭 部署费用倍率：1.18 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The A loadout for the Jade Phoenix uses Improved Jump Jets, a series of Pulse Lasers and an Ultra AC/20 to be able to quickly move around and flank enemies with a large Alpha Strike. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Jade Phoenix 的 A 配置使用改进型跳跃喷射器、一系列脉冲激光炮和一门 Ultra AC/20，从而能快速机动并以强大的全弹齐射包抄敌人。 特性：分散注意 部署费用倍率：1.16 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: An ER PPC is carried in the right arm while the left arm carries five improved heavy medium lasers. To handle the increased heat, five extra double heat sinks are carried as well. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 右臂搭载一门 ER PPC，左臂则搭载五门改进型重型中型激光炮。为应对增加的热量，机体还携带五台额外的双重散热器。 特性：战斗电脑 部署费用倍率：1.05 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: Designed and produced by Clan Jade Falcon in 3062 the project was terminated in 3064 due to it being a complete failure. The standard Variant is loaded with a Fusion 12 engine, four standard jumpjets, and a single SRM 1 with 5 shots of ammo Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95
column2: 该项目由玉龙之鹰氏族于 3062 年设计并生产，却因彻底失败而于 3064 年终止。标准变体搭载 Fusion 12 引擎、四具标准跳跃喷射器，以及一具 SRM-1 发射器和 5 发弹药。 特性：灵活 部署费用倍率：0.95

column1: This Legendary variant is barely spoken of for fear it might appear, bringing 4 massive Thumper Cannons to the field on a very, very slow platform. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Ballistics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.26 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这款传奇变体几乎无人敢提，生怕它真的现身：它在极其缓慢的平台上搭载了四门巨型 Thumper 炮。 特性：精准武器 - 弹道 部署费用倍率：1.26 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: When Pirates find something New They always take advantage of it.Shortly after recovering a drone's carcus they shoved it into one of their most beloved designs. . Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 海盗找到新东西时，总会想方设法加以利用。找到一架无人机的残骸后不久，他们就把它塞进了自己最钟爱的设计之一。 特性：分散注意 部署费用倍率：1.16 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: This 'Panther' has all kinds of weird scribbles on it. They seem to be praising something called 'The Book of the Dead' and 'Naturom Demonto.' I just have to assume whatever idiot got their hands on it was stuck in some Cabin too long. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: 这台“Panther”上画满了各种奇怪的涂鸦。它们似乎在赞美某种名为《亡灵之书》和“纳图兰·德蒙托”的东西。我只能猜测，那个拿到它的蠢货在某间小屋里待得太久了。 特性：分散注意 部署费用倍率：1.07

column1:
Darius nods, and moves on to the next item.

Later in the week, he provides an update. "The medical staff is adjusting to rationing medical supplies. Injuries are healing more slowly, but they'll still heal."

Darius pauses, then adds, "The MechWarriors have noticed, though. I'll try to get us back to normal capacity on our next supply run."
column2:
Darius 点点头，继续处理下一项。

一周后，他提供了最新情况。“医疗人员正在适应医疗用品配给。伤势恢复得更慢了，但仍然会痊愈。”

Darius 停顿了一下，又补充道：“不过机甲战士们已经注意到了。我会在下一次补给行动中设法让我们的医疗能力恢复正常。”

column1: A center torso mounted Light PPC with an attached PPC capacitor lowers the heat enough to make the -6C the only properly cooled variant of the Yari. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.33 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 安装在中央躯干、带有 PPC 电容器的轻型 PPC 降低了热量，使 -6C 成为 Yari 唯一冷却能力合格的变体。 特性：精准武器 - 导弹 部署费用倍率：1.33 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: This mixed tech configuration has an engine supercharger. The right arm has seven medium re-engineered lasers and the left arm has six AP Gauss rifles with two tons of ammunition. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这款混合科技配置搭载发动机增压器。右臂有七门中型重构激光炮，左臂有六支 AP 高斯步枪，并携带两吨弹药。 特性：战斗电脑 部署费用倍率：1.05 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: One of the latest variants to be introduced, the Night Gyr T carries a LBX AC/20 and two ER PPC as its main armaments. Three Medium Pulse Lasers provide extra firepower as needed. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 作为最新推出的变体之一，Night Gyr T 的主要武器是一门 LBX AC/20 和两门 ER PPC。三门中型脉冲激光炮可在需要时提供额外火力。 特性：战斗电脑 部署费用倍率：1.12 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The Gorgon is a heavy fire support unit that often anchors ProtoMech Points. A Jihad era variant, this model utilized an AP Gauss Rifle and SRM-6 Launcher. It was given a half-set of jump jets and a rearrangement of its protection. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.978
column2: Gorgon 是一种重型火力支援单位，经常作为原型机甲小队的核心。这个圣战时期的变体使用一支 AP 高斯步枪和一具 SRM-6 发射器，并配备半套跳跃喷射器，同时重新调整了防护配置。 特性：标准部件 部署费用倍率：0.978

column1: This easy field modification removes the light active probe, one double heat sink, and a half ton of armor to mount an ER PPC in place of the heavy large laser. This effectively transforms it from a skirmisher into a sniper. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
column2: 这项简单的战地改装拆除了轻型主动探测器、一台双重散热器和半吨装甲，以便用一门 ER PPC 替换重型大型激光炮。这样一来，它就从游击机甲有效转变为狙击机甲。 特性：精准武器 - 激光 部署费用倍率：1.06

column1: This variant, developed in 3094, was armed with a RAC/5, supported by a ER medium laser and an ER small laser. This variant uses ferro-fibrous armor and a standard gyroscope. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: 该变体于 3094 年开发，装备一门 RAC/5，并由一门 ER 中型激光炮和一门 ER 小型激光炮提供支援。它使用铁纤维装甲和标准陀螺仪。 特性：模块化武器 部署费用倍率：1.08 手臂执行器限制：右上臂

column1: The end result of a very wealthy pirate deciding to see how many shells he could hurl downrange per second from a single mech. The answer was ''This many''. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.26 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 一名极其富有的海盗想知道单台机甲每秒能向远方倾泻多少炮弹，于是有了这个结果。答案是：“就这么多”。 特性：精准武器 - 自动炮 部署费用倍率：1.26 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: A pirate variant of the basic Thunderstone, focused on two LRM-30 launchers and two Heavy PPCs - all pirate flavoured of course. To save costs the 'Mech only uses single heat sinks, but needs 41 of them to even approach adequate cooling. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.42
column2: 这是基础 Thunderstone 的海盗变体，专注于两具 LRM-30 发射器和两门重型 PPC——当然，全都带有海盗风格。为了节省成本，这台机甲只使用单重散热器，却需要整整 41 台才能勉强达到足够的冷却能力。 特性：多重锁定 部署费用倍率：1.42

column1: The primary configuration of the Cherub mounts four Medium Recoilless Rifles in each arm, normally only use for battle armor. The Ultralight further carries half a ton of ammunition for the rifles and a Rocket Launcher 10 in the right torso. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
