column2: Cherub 的主要配置在每条手臂上安装四门中型无后坐力步枪，这种武器通常只用于战斗装甲。Ultralight 还携带半吨步枪弹药，并在右侧躯干安装一具 Rocket Launcher 10。 特性：灵活 部署费用倍率：0.97

column1: Quicsell's Assault Laser Backstabber. The BLR-QS3 is quite fast, for an assault, letting you run rings around other large mechs. Combine that with the inovative LBX Large Lasers, and you can be prepared to easily outmaneuver your foes. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
column2: Quicsell 的突击型激光背刺机。BLR-QS3 对突击机来说速度相当快，可以绕着其他大型机甲兜圈。再结合创新型 LBX 大型激光炮，你就能轻松机动到敌人无法应对的位置。 特性：指挥机甲 部署费用倍率：1.13

column1: What happens when Pirates are successful? They go and refit a perfectly fine Atlas II to look like a Pirate! Id say its still a pretty solid Mech, if you ignore that they welded a bloody Raven onto its Shoulder and called it Polly... Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2
column2: 海盗成功后会做什么？他们会把一台完好无损的 Atlas II 改装成海盗风格！如果忽略他们把一只血淋淋的 Raven 焊在肩膀上并称它为 Polly，我得说这仍然是一台相当可靠的机甲。 特性：近战执行器 部署费用倍率：1.2

column1: This version, developed in the same year as the BRM-5A variant, removed the anti-missile system and LAC/5 and replaced them with an experimental large X-pulse laser. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 该版本与 BRM-5A 变体于同年开发，移除了反导系统和 LAC/5，改装了一门实验型大型 X 脉冲激光器。 特性：可变射程瞄准 部署费用倍率：1.08 手臂执行器限制：右下

column1: Quicsell's Medium Laser Brawler. The TBT-QS2 has five REX Lasers (King of the battlefield) for massive close range damage. Get up in their face and hit them with the complementary 8 ton hatchet, included in all purchases of TBT-QS2. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: Quicsell 的中型激光格斗机。TBT-QS2 配备五门 REX 激光器（战场之王），可在近距离造成巨大伤害。冲到敌人面前，用随 TBT-QS2 一同购买的 8 吨战斧狠狠劈砍。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.02

column1: This experimental version introduced removes all of the weaponry. In its place, an experimental Clan-made ER Medium Pulse Laser is mounted. Quirk: Armored Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.916 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: 这一实验型版本移除了全部武器，改装了一门实验型氏族制造 ER 中型脉冲激光器。 特性：装甲强化 部署费用倍率：0.916 只能由内部舱室运输，可以近战，不能群殴。

column1: The -2A8 is very similar to the -2A4, but replaces the PPCs with Snubnose variants, upgrades two of the LRM launchers to ten tubes and adds a third Medium Laser. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.36 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: -2A8 与 -2A4 非常相似，但将 PPC 替换为短管型，两个 LRM 发射器升级为十管型，并增加第三门中型激光器。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.36 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: The TMP-4M version replaces the SRM and some lasers for Improved Jump Jets and a Snub Nosed PPC. The remaining weight is used for increased cooling and more armor. Quirk: Breaching Shot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: TMP-4M 版本用改进型跳跃喷射器和一门短管 PPC 替换了 SRM 及部分激光器。节省的重量用于提升冷却能力并增加装甲。 特性：破门射击 部署费用倍率：1.09 手臂执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: The latest model based on the Longbow chassis, the -14V mounts two Apollo MRM 20 and two LRM-5 launchers, combined with two Light PPC and two ER Medium Lasers. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是基于 Longbow 底盘的最新型号，-14V 安装两具 Apollo MRM 20 和两具 LRM-5 发射器，配合两门轻型 PPC 与两门 ER 中型激光器。 特性：防空瞄准 部署费用倍率：1.15 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: The C configuration converts the Sojourner to a missile boat by arming it with two LRM 20s. The configuration also sports a Heavy Large Laser and a Micro Pulse Laser to defend itself. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: C 型配置为 Sojourner 装备两具 LRM 20，将其改造成导弹平台。同时配备一门重型大型激光器和一门微型脉冲激光器自卫。 特性：易于驾驶 部署费用倍率：1.09 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: Named for an extraplanar villain from ancient Terra, "Annie" carries four Clan Rotary Autocannons, Class 5. This can ruin your day in a split second. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Ballistics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: “Annie”以远古 Terra 的异界恶棍命名，携带四门氏族旋转自动炮，均为 5 型。这些武器能在瞬间让你陷入困境。 特性：精准武器 - 弹道 部署费用倍率：1.14 手臂执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: A product of the Kendall BattleMech factory rebuilt as a collaborative project between Kali Yama and the Alphard Trading Corporation, the Quasimodo was intended from the outset to be the next generation of the venerable Hunchback 'Mech. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: Quasimodo 出自 Kendall 战斗机甲工厂，是 Kali Yama 与 Alphard 贸易公司合作重建的产品；从一开始，它就被定位为久负盛名的 Hunchback 机甲的下一代。 特性：战斗铁拳 部署费用倍率：1.16

column1: The Catapult 1R retrofit arose from a shortage of Materials and proper factories, it still carries 2 impressive Thunderbolt 15 Cruise Missiles, though. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.87 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Catapult 1R 的改装源于材料和合适工厂的短缺，不过它仍携带两枚威力惊人的 Thunderbolt 15 巡航导弹。 特性：精准武器 - 导弹 部署费用倍率：0.87 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: The Panther PNT-12K is the direct upgrade of the -10K. Keeping the Endo Steel structure and switching to double Heat Sinks allows switching the SRM-4 to a MRM-10 with CASE protected ammunition while still keeping the 6.5 tons of armor. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: Panther PNT-12K 是 -10K 的直接升级型。保留 Endo 钢结构并改用双重散热器后，可将 SRM-4 换成带 CASE 保护弹药的 MRM-10，同时仍维持 6.5 吨装甲。 特性：空中突击 部署费用倍率：0.98

column1: A typical variation on the Theseus, this version carries a Light Recoilless Rifle in the modular mount. To that, it adds a single Rocket Launcher 3. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 这是 Theseus 的典型变体，在模块化挂点上搭载一门轻型无后坐力步枪，并额外安装一具 3 联装火箭发射器。 特性：改进通信 部署费用倍率：0.888 可安装全能单位，可以近战，可以群殴。

column1: This variant is armed with an Ultra AC/20 backed up by four Machine Guns and a Medium X-Pulse Laser. It lacks the SRM launchers and the jump jets of the PAL-2. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Right Lower, Left Upper
column2: 该变体装备一门 Ultra AC/20，由四挺机枪和一门中型 X 脉冲激光器提供支援。它取消了 PAL-2 的 SRM 发射器和跳跃喷射器。 特性：受保护的执行器 部署费用倍率：1.08 手臂执行器限制：右下、左上

column1: The Exterminator is a BattleMech that was designed in 2630 for the most dubious, but necessary, of purposes: Headhunting. The 4M is a derivative of the Royal 4Db that trades a few lasers for a Pack Hunter Intelligence Suite and Enhanced ERPPC. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: Exterminator 是一款于 2630 年设计的战斗机甲，旨在执行最可疑却又不可或缺的任务：猎杀首脑。4M 是 Royal 4Db 的衍生型，以少量激光器换装了猎群智能套件和强化 ERPPC。 特性：灵活 部署费用倍率：1.15

column1: The Arbalest 2, introduced in 3079 removes one of the LRM-10 launchers to add a MASC system. In doing this the 'Mech is capable of disengaging from an enemy that may be beyond its combat capabilities much easier than the standard Arbalest. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: Arbalest 2 于 3079 年推出，拆除一具 LRM-10 发射器以加装 MASC 系统。这样一来，这台机甲便能更轻松地从超出自身作战能力的敌人面前脱离，远胜标准型 Arbalest。 特性：无处不在 部署费用倍率：1.02

column1: This is a rare variant of the Shiro, which is gifted to individuals by Gunji-no-Kanrei Matsuhari Toranaga. The 'Mech is armored with Ballistic-Reinforced Armor instead of the Hardened, and a Clan-Tech ER PPC replaces the LB-2X Autocannon. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
column2: 这是 Shiro 的稀有变体，由军机之官礼 Matsuhari Toranaga 赠予个人。该机甲以弹道强化装甲取代硬化装甲，并用氏族技术 ER PPC 替换 LB-2X 自动炮。 特性：分心 部署费用倍率：1.11

column1: This late Republic era variant of the Jupiter uses an XL fusion engine to reach a top speed of 64 km/h. In place of the standard weaponry, it carries two ER PPCs, two Streak SRM-4s, and a pair of Artemis IV–enhanced LRM-15s. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22
column2: 这款共和国晚期的 Jupiter 变体使用 XL 聚变引擎，最高速度达到 64 km/h。它以两门 ER PPC、两具 Streak SRM-4 和一对 Artemis IV 增强型 LRM-15 取代标准武器。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 部署费用倍率：1.22

column1: Based on the SLDF 19b, the Kintaro 27 is a Minnesota Tribe update that changes fairly little about the design. The NARC and ammo are dropped, Ferro Spall Shield structure technology is incorporated, and all of the missile systems are upgraded. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
column2: Kintaro 27 基于 SLDF 19b，是 Minnesota 部落对其进行的升级，设计变化不大。拆除 NARC 及弹药，采用 Ferro Spall Shield 结构技术，并升级全部导弹系统。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.11

column1: Refurbished on Solaris 7 by a quite successful MechJockey, this Timber Wolf has received a mix of upgrades despite lacking access to a CLAN XL Engine and losing some Omni Capability. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这台 Timber Wolf 由一名颇为成功的机甲骑手在 Solaris 7 翻修，虽然无法获得 CLAN XL 引擎且损失部分全能能力，仍完成了多项升级。 特性：高级光学 部署费用倍率：1.17 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: Produced for the Filtvelt Coalition, this variant uses ferro-fibrous armor for protection, but to prevent overheating due to the limited cooling of the 10 single heat sinks it uses a quartet of Streak SRM-2s with a ton of ammunition. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 该变体为 Filtvelt 联盟生产，使用铁质纤维装甲提供防护。由于 10 个单散热器的冷却能力有限，为防止过热，它配备四具 Streak SRM-2 和一吨弹药。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：0.99

column1: The A configuration of the Rime Otter replaces the Large Pulse Lasers with a single ER Large Laser. With the freed space a Streak SRM-6 is added, and the LRM launcher is upgraded to 15 tubes. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Rime Otter 的 A 型配置以一门 ER 大型激光器替换大型脉冲激光器。腾出的空间用于增加一具 Streak SRM-6，并将 LRM 发射器升级为 15 管。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.06 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The third variation is based on the original. It mounts an ER Large Laser and a pair of Heavy Medium Lasers. Three additional double heat sinks keep heat in check, while a Targeting Computer aids the accuracy of all three weapons. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 第三种变体以原型为基础，安装一门 ER 大型激光器和一对重型中型激光器。额外的三个双重散热器控制热量，瞄准计算机则提升三种武器的命中精度。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 部署费用倍率：1.1

column1: The QD4 variant is armed with an MML-7 and medium laser, carries light ferro-fibrous armor, and uses double heat sinks. Improved jump jets maximize battlefield mobility. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: QD4 变体装备 MML-7 和中型激光器，配备轻型铁质纤维装甲并使用双重散热器。改进型跳跃喷射器最大化了战场机动性。 特性：改进通信 部署费用倍率：0.99 手臂执行器限制：右上

column1: A Dark Age configuration, this variant carries a Snub Nose PPC and three Medium X-Pulse Lasers as its weaponry. It also carries TAG, a Bloodhound Active Probe and an Angel ECM Suite. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是黑暗时代的配置型，武器包括一门短管 PPC 和三门中型 X 脉冲激光器。此外还携带 TAG、猎犬主动探测器和天使 ECM 套件。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.03 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The -3M variant uses an extralight fusion engine to free up weight. The weapons have been removed and replaced with a single LRM-10 and three ER Medium Lasers. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: -3M 变体使用超轻型聚变引擎以腾出重量。移除原有武器，换装一具 LRM-10 和三门 ER 中型激光器。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 部署费用倍率：1.02 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: A close-combat version, the Osteon C carries four Medium Pulse Lasers and two Large Pulse Lasers tied to a Targeting Computer. Improved Jump Jets provide a surprise 150 meter jump radius. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Osteon C 是近距离战斗型，携带四门中型脉冲激光器和两门大型脉冲激光器，并接入瞄准计算机。改进型跳跃喷射器提供出人意料的 150 米跳跃半径。 特性：多重追踪 部署费用倍率：1.18 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: Defensive structure capable of repelling threats. Quirk: Stable Weapons Armor: Armor Amount: 320 Structure: Structure Amount: 200 Engine: 300 Standard Fusion Equipment: 1 x Command Bunker Weapons: 4x Light ER PPC Ammunition:
column2: 能够击退威胁的防御设施。 特性：稳定武器 装甲：装甲 数量：320 结构：结构 数量：200 引擎：300 标准聚变 设备： 1 x 指挥掩体 武器： 4x 轻型 ER PPC 弹药：

column1: The 6G variant, introduced in 3067, carries an ER large laser and two ER medium lasers. The left arm carries three ER small lasers. The sword remains, and one additional heat sink is equipped to bring the total to 11 double heat sinks. Quirk: Improved Jammer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
column2: 6G 变体于 3067 年推出，携带一门 ER 大型激光器和两门 ER 中型激光器。左臂配备三门 ER 小型激光器。它保留了剑，并增加一具散热器，使总数达到 11 个双重散热器。 特性：改进干扰器 部署费用倍率：1.01

column1: Developed by the Wolf Empire, this variant starts with an ON2-M but replaces the armor with Ferro-Lamellor and the weaponry with Streak LRMs and ER Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 该变体由 Wolf 帝国开发，以 ON2-M 为基础，将装甲替换为 Ferro-Lamellor，并将武器替换为 Streak LRM 和 ER 脉冲激光器。 特性：防空瞄准 部署费用倍率：1.11 手臂执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: This refit of the aging 4H model upgrades the weaponry to 3060's technology with an LBX class 10 autocannon, four ER Medium lasers, and a Small Pulse Laser in the head. Weight savings from new technologies allow the inclusion of jumpjets. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 这次对老旧 4H 型号的改装将武器升级为 3060 年代技术：一门 LBX 10 级自动炮、四门 ER 中型激光器，以及头部的一门小型脉冲激光器。新技术节省的重量使其得以安装跳跃喷射器。 特性：战斗铁拳 部署费用倍率：1.04

column1: The V3 is a field upgrade of the Cerberus that removes the Machine Guns and their volatile ammunition and replaces them with an additional one and a half tons of armor. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: V3 是 Cerberus 的战地升级型，移除机枪及其危险弹药，换成额外 1.5 吨装甲。 特性：枪管铁拳 部署费用倍率：1.17 手臂执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: This version uses two Machine Gun Arrays to make it more effective in combat. One array mounts Light Machine Guns, while the other mounts standard Machine Guns. The ER Medium Lasers are tied into a Targeting Computer as well. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 该版本使用两组机枪阵列提升战斗效能。一组安装轻型机枪，另一组安装标准机枪。ER 中型激光器同样接入瞄准计算机。 特性：改进瞄准 - 近程 部署费用倍率：1.03

column1: Fortress installation safeguarding the surrounding area. Armor: Armor Amount: 150 Structure: Structure Amount: 1 Engine: 0 Standard Fusion Equipment: Weapons: 1x HandHeld Light PPC 1x Infantry Rifles 1x MagShot Ammunition: 1x Ammo MagShot [HALF]
column2: 守护周边区域的堡垒设施。 装甲：装甲 数量：150 结构：结构 数量：1 引擎：0 标准聚变 设备： 武器： 1x 手持轻型 PPC 1x 步兵步枪 1x MagShot 弹药： 1x MagShot 弹药 [半装]

column1: When the Society got their hands on the Menace they armed it to the teeth, creating the S configuration. Two Improved Gauss Rifles, four Large Supra Lasers and two Heavy Gauss Rifles combine bring their greatest arms technology together. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.44
column2: Society 得到 Menace 后，将其武装到牙齿，打造出 S 型配置。两门改进型高斯步枪、四门大型 Supra 激光器和两门重型高斯步枪汇聚了他们最先进的武器技术。 特性：稳定武器 部署费用倍率：1.44

column1: The Harpy, the first ProtoMech ever created, it is about as effective as a single elemental, it did however show that Protomechs could be a effective weapon. This Variant carries a LMG and 10 rounds of ammo but includes Protomech Myomer Booster. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95
column2: Harpy 是有史以来制造的第一种原型机甲，其战斗力大致相当于一名元素战士，但它证明了原型机甲可以成为有效武器。该变体携带一挺 LMG 和 10 发弹药，并配备原型机甲肌束增压器。 特性：灵活 部署费用倍率：0.95

column1: The Kintaro 28 has become a staple among Minnesota Tribe forces and sees particular use against other agile opponents. This variant sports a pair of 8-tube Fire and Forget launchers supplemented by a Rocketstorm 30 pack and a handful of lasers. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
column2: Kintaro 28 已成为 Minnesota 部落部队的主力，并特别用于对付其他敏捷对手。该变体配备一对 8 管“发射后不管”发射器，辅以一组 Rocketstorm 30 和少量激光器。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.11

column1: The Q configuration kept the two ER PPC from the primary configuration, but replaced the rest of the weapons with four Streak SRM-6 launchers, an ER Medium Laser and a flamer. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Q 型配置保留了基础配置的两门 ER PPC，但将其余武器替换为四具 Streak SRM-6 发射器、一门 ER 中型激光器和一具喷火器。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 部署费用倍率：1.16 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The basic Gnat, designated the -2B, mounts two Medium Lasers and two Small Pulse Lasers. Like all other Gnat variants, it also carries both a probe and ECM system. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 基础型 Gnat，编号 -2B，安装两门中型激光器和两门小型脉冲激光器。与所有其他 Gnat 变体一样，它还携带探测器和 ECM 系统。 特性：狭窄/低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：0.97 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: The King Dragon DRG-23N was developed for environments that reduced the efficiency of cooling. Dropping all energy weapons except for a single ER Large Laser and instead mounting a MRM-40 launcher allows the 'Mech to better handle its heat. Quirk: Well Balanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.3
column2: King Dragon DRG-23N 专为冷却效率降低的环境开发。移除除一门 ER 大型激光器外的所有能量武器，改装一具 MRM-40 发射器，使该机甲更易控制热量。 特性：平衡良好 部署费用倍率：1.3

column1: This variant replaces the LRM-10 and Artemis IV with an ATM-12, while the heavy lasers are replaced with a targeting computer, allowing the ER large laser to fire more effectively. Quirk: Improved Jammer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 该变体以 ATM-12 替换 LRM-10 和 Artemis IV，以瞄准计算机替换重型激光器，使 ER 大型激光器能够更有效地射击。 特性：改进干扰器 部署费用倍率：1.06 手臂执行器限制：左下

column1: The YJ-22 attempts to improve the Yellow Jacket design by switching to an Endo Steel structure, which allows the addition of an LRM-5 launcher. Five of the six small lasers of the YJ-15 were removed, but a Medium Laser added instead. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: YJ-22 通过改用 Endo 钢结构来改进 Yellow Jacket 设计，从而得以增加一具 LRM-5 发射器。YJ-15 的六门小型激光器中有五门被移除，但增加了一门中型激光器。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 部署费用倍率：0.96

column1: The Ghost Bears again had need of a cheap, versatile, second-line BattleMech. Thus the Bear Cub was put into production. This Variant was intended to use for the Leaders of the Stars, upgraded with Additional Endosteel and Double Heatsinks. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: Ghost Bears 再次需要一种廉价而多用途的二线战斗机甲，于是 Bear Cub 投入生产。该变体供星之领袖使用，并升级了额外 Endosteel 和双重散热器。 特性：易于驾驶 部署费用倍率：1.08

column1: This configuration sacrifices its jump capability to mount six ER small lasers, three medium pulse lasers, and a pair of Streak SRM-4 launchers. It also has 11 double heat sinks. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 该配置牺牲跳跃能力，换装六门 ER 小型激光器、三门中型脉冲激光器和一对 Streak SRM-4 发射器。此外还配备 11 个双重散热器。 特性：改进通信 部署费用倍率：1.05 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: You read through the information on the datapad, "You know what, Darius, let's go ahead and take them up on their offer.  It's a LAM I'm particularly familiar with and it'll suffice while I clock up some hours in the cockpit."\n\nDaruis takes back the datapad, "I will make the payment now, Commander.  We should have the delivery by the end of the day."
column2: 你读完数据板上的信息后说道：“知道吗，Darius，我们就接受他们的提议吧。这是一款我特别熟悉的 LAM，在我积累驾驶舱时数期间足够使用。”\n\nDaruis 接过数据板：“我现在就付款，指挥官。我们应该能在今天结束前收到交付。”

column1: The M loadout is based around an LB 20-X AC mounted in each arm combined with a torso-mounted Large Pulse Laser. A Streak SRM-6 launcher provides ammo-efficient close quarter damage. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: M 型配置围绕安装在两条手臂上的 LB 20-X AC 展开，并配合一门安装在躯干上的大型脉冲激光器。一具 Streak SRM-6 发射器提供节省弹药的近距离火力。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 部署费用倍率：1.11 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: This configuration carries an improved heavy large laser and a plasma cannon in each arm. The plasma cannons have one ton of ammunition in each side torso, allowing them to fire 10 times. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 该配置在每条手臂上搭载一门改进型重型大型激光器和一门等离子炮。每侧躯干各装有一吨等离子炮弹药，使其能够射击 10 次。 特性：战斗计算机 部署费用倍率：1.05 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The A configuration changes the role of the Sojourner to be more of a close quarters brawler with its weaponry of a Rotary AC/2, a ProtoMech AC/8, a Large Pulse Laser and 4 ER Micro Lasers. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: A 型配置将 Sojourner 的角色改为更偏近距离格斗，武器包括一门旋转 AC/2、一门原型机甲 AC/8、一门大型脉冲激光器和四门 ER 微型激光器。 特性：易于驾驶 部署费用倍率：1.09 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The E configuration adds two Light Ultra Gauss Rifles by replacing two of the iATM launchers. Two Laser AMS are also part of loadout, making it the only Keratos with anti missile capabilities. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.37 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: E 型配置拆除两具 iATM 发射器，换装两门轻型 Ultra 高斯步枪。武器配置还包括两具激光 AMS，使其成为 Keratos 中唯一具备反导能力的型号。 特性：多重追踪 部署费用倍率：1.37 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: A short range version of the Dakota, the DKA-42 removes the LRM-20 launcher to instead add two more SRM-6 launchers, both also with the Artemis IV firing system. A Medium Pulse Laser and an engine heat sink is also added. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Missile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: Dakota 的短程版本 DKA-42 移除 LRM-20 发射器，改为增加两具 SRM-6 发射器，二者同样配备 Artemis IV 火控系统。此外还增加一门中型脉冲激光器和一具引擎散热器。 特性：改进冷却套 - 导弹 部署费用倍率：1.15

column1: An attempt to make the Imp II more versatile, the 1J downsizes the engine to a 325 Core but instead adds two massive Boosters, allowing the 'Mech to jump up to 150 meters. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.38 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 尝试让 Imp II 更加多用途，1J 将引擎缩小为 325 核心，但改为加装两具巨型助推器，使这台机甲能够跃过 150 米。 特性：指挥机甲 部署成本倍率：1.38 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: The Silver Fox's main armament are its five Magshots and its two ER medium lasers, backed up by a single ER small laser. All these weapons are linked to an advanced targeting computer. Quirk: Well Balanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
column2: Silver Fox 的主武器是五具 Magshot 和两门 ER 中型激光，另有一门 ER 小型激光支援。所有武器都连接至先进瞄准计算机。 特性：平衡良好 部署成本倍率：1.15 手臂执行器限制：左上

column1: The personal 'Mech of Josem Hawker, which eventually became the basis of the updated Tiburon 2. Replaces all the lasers with heavy versions and adding some advanced cockpit equipment, most of the 'Mech otherwise remains similar to the original. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: Josem Hawker 的私人机甲，最终成为改进型 Tiburon 2 的基础。它将所有激光替换为重型型号，并增加了一些先进驾驶舱设备；除此之外，大部分设计仍与原型相近。 特性：多重锁定 部署成本倍率：1.08

column1: Designed and produced by Clan Jade Falcon in 3062 the project was terminated in 3064 due to it being a complete failure. This Variant is loaded with a Fusion 16 engine, and a single ER Mirco Laser but sacrifices some armor for the additional speed. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95
column2: 由 Jade Falcon 氏族于 3062 年设计并生产，该项目因彻底失败于 3064 年终止。本型号搭载 Fusion 16 引擎和一门 ER 微型激光，并牺牲部分装甲换取更高速度。 特性：灵巧 部署成本倍率：0.95

column1: The C configuration, like the B is not all energy weapons, and is equipped with two Ultra AC/5s, one LB 5-X AC and Two Large Pulse Lasers. This makes it very potent against aircraft. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: C 型配置与 B 型一样，并非全能量武器，装备两门 Ultra AC/5、一门 LB 5-X AC 和两门大型脉冲激光，因此对空中目标极其有效。 特性：扩展躯干扭转 部署成本倍率：1.11 手臂执行器限制：全方位

column1: This Awesome refit, the 8BQ, or Barbecue, features 3 Plasma Cannons, 3 Olympus Flamers and 2 MML3 linked to Advanced Targeting System's able to deliver precise Incineration. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这台 Awesome 改装型（8BQ，即“烧烤”）装备三门等离子炮、三具 Olympus 火焰喷射器和两具 MML3，并连接至先进瞄准系统，能够进行精准焚烧。 特性：精准武器 - 能量 部署成本倍率：1.2 手臂执行器限制：右下

column1: A Solaris refit of the Hatchetman, sporting a fixed TSM System and a 9 Ton Axe coupled with a LosTech Chameleon Light Polarisation Shield. A highly modular "omni" hardpoint in the right torso allows rapid refits against specific opponents. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
column2: Solaris 改装型 Hatchetman，配备固定式 TSM 系统和一把 9 吨战斧，并搭载失落科技变色龙光极化护盾。右侧躯干的高度模块化“全向”硬点可针对特定对手快速改装。 特性：近战执行器 部署成本倍率：1.11

column1: A Republic era upgrade of the 14C, the 14C2 removes two of the ER medium lasers and replaces them with a C3 boosted slave unit. It is otherwise identical to the 14C. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是共和国时代对 14C 的升级型。14C2 拆除两门 ER 中型激光，换上一具 C3 增强从属单元；除此之外与 14C 完全相同。 特性：防空瞄准 部署成本倍率：1.15 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: Boss, I don't know where these things came from. I have no idea how they actually work. And finally, I have no idea why you you think it's a good idea to keep them Quirk: Black Carapace Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.87 Can mount any unit, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 老板，我不知道这些东西从哪儿来的，也完全不明白它们究竟如何运作。最后，我也不知道你为什么觉得把它们留下是个好主意。 特性：黑色甲壳 部署成本倍率：0.87 可安装任何单元，可近战，可群袭。

column1: Stormcrow F is equipped with 2 Plasma Cannons to increase the target's heat. Against infantry this variant is equipped with AP Gauss Rifles. Against hardened targets, it has four ER Medium Lasers. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Stormcrow F 装备两门等离子炮，用于提高目标热量。对付步兵时，该型号配备 AP 高斯步枪；面对强化目标时，则使用四门 ER 中型激光。 特性：稳定 部署成本倍率：1.04 手臂执行器限制：全方位

column1: The Pouncer I loadout turns the Omni into a Missile Boat, mounting a LRM-20 launcher with an attached Artemis V FCS. An ER Large Pulse Laser provides secondary long range fire capabilities. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Pouncer I 配置将这台全向机甲变成导弹艇，搭载一具配备 Artemis V 火控系统的 LRM-20 发射器。一门 ER 大型脉冲激光提供辅助远程火力。 特性：空中突击 部署成本倍率：1.03 手臂执行器限制：全方位

column1: An attempt by RISC to Retrofit older Hollander's to the more powerful spec's of a Lyran Hollander II, cramming a Heavy Gauss Rifle on the Chassis while proven possible, equally proved too cost prohibitive, requiring a complete Assembly Line. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: RISC 试图将老旧 Hollander 改装为更强大的 Lyran Hollander II 规格，在底盘上塞入一门重型高斯步枪。虽然证明可行，但成本同样高得令人难以承受，还需要完整的装配线。 特性：稳定武器 部署成本倍率：1.05

column1: The left arm carries an ER PPC with a PPC capacitor. Additional firepower comes from a Streak LRM-15 mounted in the right arm; Two tons of ammunition for the missile launcher are provided. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 左臂装备一门带 PPC 电容器的 ER PPC。右臂安装一具 Streak LRM-15，提供额外火力；并为导弹发射器配备两吨弹药。 特性：战斗计算机 部署成本倍率：1.05 手臂执行器限制：全方位

column1: This Shadowcat seems to have been looted during a Battle in the Combine and subsequently stolen by a member of the Legion of Vega before joining the ranks of a Local Pirate Gang. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这台 Shadowcat 似乎是在一次发生于星际联邦的战斗中被掠夺，随后又被 Vega 军团的一名成员偷走，最后加入了当地海盗帮派。 特性：灵巧 部署成本倍率：1.05 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: One of the most common drones produced on Syberia, it is said that they are mostly used for transportation systems across the planet. At least they were until all the organics died. They are still mass produced and zip around the cities. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: 这是 Syberia 生产的最常见无人机之一，据说主要用于行星各地的运输系统。至少在所有有机生命死亡之前是这样。它们如今仍在大量生产，穿梭于城市之间。 特性：窄型/低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：0.96

column1: The 03 variant is built with a light fusion engine and has a C3 slave unit to share targeting data with friendly units. The 'Mech replaces both of the autocannons with an MRM-20. The medium laser has been upgraded to an ER medium laser. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 03 型采用轻型融合引擎，并配备 C3 从属单元与友军共享瞄准数据。这台机甲将两门自动炮替换为一具 MRM-20，并将中型激光升级为 ER 中型激光。 特性：扩展躯干扭转 部署成本倍率：1.1

column1: The MetalMax MX-2 mounts a spot welder in place of the left hand actuator alongside a rivet gun in the right arm with two tons of rivets. Fourteen tons of industrial armor and environmental sealing with four jump jets round out the design. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.76
column2: MetalMax MX-2 在左手执行器的位置安装点焊机，右臂则装有铆钉枪和两吨铆钉。十四吨工业装甲、环境密封系统以及四具跳跃喷射器完善了这一设计。 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：0.76

column1: Introduced during the Jihad in 3070, the UrbanMech IIC 2 swaps the autocannon and laser for a Class 20 Hyper Assault Gauss Rifle with 2 tons of ammunition and a Flamer. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: UrbanMech IIC 2 于 3070 年圣战期间投入使用，以一门 20 级超强突击高斯步枪、两吨弹药和一具火焰喷射器替换自动炮与激光。 特性：360° 躯干扭转 部署成本倍率：1.05 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: A Comstar variant that never saw much use. In an attempt to improve the Caesar's alpha strike potential it mounts a Heavy PPC in the left torso, and by using a 280 Light engine still keep the Gauss Rifle in the opposite side torso. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 一款几乎未被使用的 ComStar 变体。为提高 Caesar 的全弹齐射潜力，它在左侧躯干安装一门重型 PPC，并使用 280 轻型引擎，同时保留另一侧躯干的高斯步枪。 特性：超伸展执行器 部署成本倍率：1.1

column1: Reinforced structure to defend an area. Quirk: Stable Weapons Armor: Armor Amount: 320 Structure: Structure Amount: 200 Engine: 300 Standard Fusion Equipment: 1 x Command Bunker Weapons: 3x Plasma Cannon Ammunition: 3x Ammo Plasma
column2: 用于防御区域的强化结构。 特性：稳定武器 装甲： 装甲 数量： 320 结构： 结构 数量： 200 引擎： 300 标准融合引擎 装备： 1 x 指挥掩体 武器： 3x 等离子炮 弹药： 3x 等离子弹药

column1: A pirate mech that seems to just be held together by duct tape and dream dust. It's purpose and capabilities are mostly uncertain at best or unfathomable in most cases. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.38 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 一台似乎只靠胶带和梦尘勉强拼在一起的海盗机甲。它的用途与性能充其量只能说不确定，多数情况下更是难以理解。 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：1.38 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: A side torso mounted Sniper Artillery and two Longfire LRM launchers means that the B configuration has a very long range for indirect fire, thus making it able to reach most locations of any battlefield the Quad is deployed to. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Ballistics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.27
column2: 侧面躯干安装的狙击炮和两具 Longfire LRM 发射器，使 B 型配置拥有极远的间接火力射程，几乎可以覆盖这台四足机甲部署战场上的任何位置。 特性：精准武器 - 弹道 部署成本倍率：1.27

column1: Defensive structure capable of repelling minor threats. Quirk: Stable Weapons Armor: Armor Amount: 240 Structure: Structure Amount: 150 Engine: 200 Standard Fusion Equipment: 1 x Command Bunker Weapons: 1x Heavy PPC QS Ammunition:
column2: 能够击退小规模威胁的防御结构。 特性：稳定武器 装甲： 装甲 数量： 240 结构： 结构 数量： 150 引擎： 200 标准融合引擎 装备： 1 x 指挥掩体 武器： 1x 重型 PPC QS 弹药：

column1: A new variant, just recently launched by Clan Hell's Horses, the 8 model replaces the jump jets with Actuator Enhancement Systems, sacrificing mobility for stunning accuracy. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是 Clan Hell’s Horses 最近推出的新变体。8 型用执行器增强系统替换跳跃喷射器，以牺牲机动性换取惊人精准度。 特性：扰乱 部署成本倍率：1.24 手臂执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: The I configuration mounts three Improved Heavy Large Lasers and a Gauss Rifle, focusing on medium to long ranges of engagement. To deal with the increased heat profile it also mounts extra cooling. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: I 型配置装备三门改良型重型大型激光和一门高斯步枪，专注于中远距离交战。为应对更高的散热负担，它还加装了额外冷却设备。 特性：坚韧 部署成本倍率：1.17 手臂执行器限制：全方位

column1: This variant was introduced in the Dark Age era. It carries a single medium laser and an MRM-10 into combat on an endo steel frame. It uses an XL engine and 10 single heat sinks. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 该变体于黑暗时代推出，使用内骨骼钢框架搭载一门中型激光和一具 MRM-10 参战。它采用 XL 引擎和 10 台单重散热器。 特性：扩展躯干扭转 部署成本倍率：0.95 手臂执行器限制：右下

column1: Mostly a Museum piece was this Shadow Hawk rebuild on request for a Paladins 'Special Associate', sporting upgrades sourced from basically everywhere is it able to strike unseen basically anywhere at anytime even during Planet wide Engagements. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 这台 Shadow Hawk 重建机大多只是博物馆藏品，是应一名 Paladin“特殊助理”的要求打造的。它采用几乎来自各处的升级部件，能够在任何时间、甚至行星级交战期间发动无人察觉的攻击。 特性：陆空机甲 部署成本倍率：1.1

column1: The -9V variant is the result of J.B. BattleMechs licensing production back to original creator of the Chameleon, Defiance Industries. The goal was to make the 'Mech as durable as possible, even at the cost of reducing the firepower potential. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: -9V 型是 J.B. BattleMechs 将生产许可交还给 Chameleon 原始创始者 Defiance Industries 后的产物。目标是让机甲尽可能耐用，即使代价是降低火力潜力。 特性：易于驾驶 部署成本倍率：1.04

column1: A clan tech refit of the 009, the 009C instead mounts two HAG/20 as its main damage dealers, each supported by a Plasma Rifle. Two ER Small Laser provide defensive coverage. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 009C 是 009 的克兰科技改装型，改为以两门 HAG/20 作为主要杀伤武器，每门各由一支等离子步枪支援。两门 ER 小型激光提供防御火力。 特性：指挥机甲 部署成本倍率：1.18 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: The Fafnir was intended to become Defiance Industries of Hesperus' flagship BattleMech. This variant makes use of a pair of massive experimental Improved Heavy Gauss Rifles. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Fafnir 原本计划成为 Hesperus 的 Defiance Industries 旗舰战斗机甲。本型号使用一对巨型实验型改良重型高斯步枪。 特性：稳定武器 部署成本倍率：1.2 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: Fortress installation safeguarding the surrounding area. Quirk: Stable Weapons Armor: Armor Amount: 480 Structure: Structure Amount: 250 Engine: 400 Standard Fusion Equipment: 1 x Command Bunker Weapons: 2x Heavy PPC QS Ammunition:
column2: 守护周边区域的堡垒设施。 特性：稳定武器 装甲： 装甲 数量： 480 结构： 结构 数量： 250 引擎： 400 标准融合引擎 装备： 1 x 指挥掩体 武器： 2x 重型 PPC QS 弹药：

column1: The Maxwell MXW-777 trades range for raw firepower, arming two large pulse lasers, a Streak SRM 2 and a flamer. This closer ranged loadout sacrifices the reach of earlier models in favor of concentrated damage output at shorter distances. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: Maxwell MXW-777 以射程换取纯粹火力，装备两门大型脉冲激光、一具 Streak SRM 2 和一具火焰喷射器。这种近程配置牺牲了早期型号的攻击距离，换来更集中的短距离伤害输出。 特性：受保护执行器 部署成本倍率：1.17

column1: This design was the original Lightray produced in 3064, designed before the Word of Blake ROM stole the targeting computer technology from House Davion. Instead of the computer, it used two SRM-2 packs and had one ton of ammunition. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 这是 3064 年生产的原始 Lightray，设计时 Word of Blake ROM 尚未窃取 Davion 家族的瞄准计算机技术。它没有安装计算机，而是使用两组 SRM-2 发射器和一吨弹药。 特性：超伸展执行器 部署成本倍率：1.05

column1: The Lyran 6S Griffin was built in 3066 using an Endo Steel chassis and mounting a 275 Light Fusion Engine. This allowed the 6S model to carry a ER PPC in the right arm, a LRM-15 over the right shoulder with Artemis IV, and two ER Medium Lasers. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: Lyran 6S Griffin 于 3066 年制造，采用内骨骼钢底盘和 275 轻型融合引擎。因此 6S 型能够在右臂携带一门 ER PPC，在右肩上方搭载一具配备 Artemis IV 的 LRM-15，并装备两门 ER 中型激光。 特性：战斗拳 部署成本倍率：1.05

column1: This Wight variant is used by disgraced members of Clan Nova Cat as an assassination unit. Combining Inner Sphere and Clan technology creates a fast, stealthy unit capable of quickly inflicting damage on units and unprotected targets. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 这款 Wight 变体由 Clan Nova Cat 的失势成员用作刺杀单位。内层天体与克兰技术结合，造就了一台快速、隐秘的单位，能够迅速对部队和无防护目标造成伤害。 特性：强化通信 部署成本倍率：0.98

column1: This 3077 variant is based on the 7K. It changes out the missile launcher for an MML-5 with two tons of ammunition and an experimental C3 Boosted Slave. Otherwise it is identical to the DRG-7K. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这一 3077 年变体以 7K 为基础，将导弹发射器更换为 MML-5，配备两吨弹药和实验型 C3 增强从属单元。除此之外，它与 DRG-7K 完全相同。 特性：稳定 部署成本倍率：1.08 手臂执行器限制：右下

column1: With only a pair of Thunderbolt-5 launchers and a retractable blade for weapons, “Aladdin” isn’t a flashy fighter. Its Angel ECM and stealth armor give it the ability to hide in built up terrain, and thus surprise strikes are its best hope. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: “Aladdin”只有两具 Thunderbolt-5 发射器和一把可伸缩刀刃作为武器，并不是华丽的战士。它的 Angel ECM 和隐形装甲使其能够藏身于建筑密集地形，因此突袭是它最好的希望。 特性：窄型/低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：1.04

column1: This scout version of the Stinger mounts a 160-rated XL engine for a top speed of 120 km/h, while eight jump jets provide a 240 meter jump capability. Each arm mounts a heavy machine gun and an ER medium laser provides the Stinger's main firepower. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: 这款 Stinger 侦察型搭载额定 160 的 XL 引擎，最高速度可达 120 公里/小时；八具跳跃喷射器则提供 240 米跳跃能力。每条手臂各装一挺重型机枪，另有一门 ER 中型激光作为 Stinger 的主要火力。 特性：无处不在 部署成本倍率：0.97

column1: Double Plasma Cannons and a single AC/5 is all the weapons of the -0PP, and not even with adequate cooling. This really is a subpar 'Mech, just like most pirate creations. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: -0PP 的全部武器只有双联等离子炮和一门 AC/5，散热甚至都不够。这确实是一台低劣的机甲，就像大多数海盗造物一样。 特性：360° 躯干扭转 部署成本倍率：1.24 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: This custom hand-me-down Pulverizer has been refit numerous times over the generations but has largely remained the same in Talulah McEvedy's possession. A Flechette 20 provides ample long-range support for four Improved Large Lasers. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24
column2: 这台定制的二手 Pulverizer 在数代人手中多次改装，但落入 Talulah McEvedy 手中后基本保持原样。一门 Flechette 20 为四门改良型大型激光提供充足的远程支援。 特性：精准武器 - 激光 部署成本倍率：1.24

column1: This variant was introduced in 3069 and uses a rotary autocannon/5 as its main gun, supplemented by an extra medium pulse laser. By adding a C3 slave, it can share targeting data with its lancemates and an extra heat sink helps dissipate heat. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 该变体于 3069 年推出，以旋转自动炮/5 为主炮，并由额外一门中型脉冲激光支援。加装 C3 从属单元后，它可以与编队战友共享瞄准数据；额外的散热器则有助于散热。 特性：近战执行器 部署成本倍率：1.09

column1: A variant based on the Pillager 4M, the Pillager 5M continues to keep costs down with the 300-rating standard engine but drops the heavy AC20s and Jump Jets in favor of a pair of ER Large Lasers and a pair of 10-tube Mech-scale Grenade Launchers. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24
column2: 这是基于 Pillager 4M 的变体。Pillager 5M 继续使用额定 300 的标准引擎来降低成本，但拆除重型 AC20 和跳跃喷射器，换成一对 ER 大型激光和一对十管机甲级榴弹发射器。 特性：战斗拳 部署成本倍率：1.24

column1: The A lodout of the Menace adds a second railgun in the left torso, making its alpha strike potential incredibly high even at extreme ranges. The two bulky railguns means that it can only fit four Extended Range Heavy PPCs as its other weapons. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.42
column2: Menace 的 A 配置在左侧躯干增加第二门轨道炮，即使在极远距离也拥有极高的全弹齐射潜力。两门笨重的轨道炮意味着它只能将另外四门远程重型 PPC 装作其他武器。 特性：稳定武器 部署成本倍率：1.42

column1: This version removes three of the Heavy Medium Lasers and the Ultra AC/20. In their place is a HAG/40 and three ER Medium Lasers. It carries only fifteen double heat sinks to dissipate the heat. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: 这个版本拆除了三门重型中型激光和 Ultra AC/20，改为一门 HAG/40 和三门 ER 中型激光。它只有十五台双重散热器来消散热量。 特性：稳定 部署成本倍率：1.17 手臂执行器限制：右上

column1: Quicsell's Medium Ballistic Backstabber. The TBT-QS3 comes equiped with our devastating Double Autocannon 20. Of course, as a Quicsell brand Backstabber line, you can expect stellar speeds from our mechs, with a massive 335 rated fusion core. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: Quicsell 的中型弹道背刺机。TBT-QS3 配备我们威力惊人的双联自动炮 20。当然，作为 Quicsell 品牌背刺系列的一员，你可以期待我们的机甲拥有出色速度，因为它搭载了额定 335 的巨型融合核心。 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：1.02

column1: Intended to serve as a medium assault unit, the Hydra carries heavy armor and a decent weapon suite. Introduced in 3066, the Hydra 2 was centered around the use of a set of Jump Jets, at the expense of armor protection and weaponry. Quirk: Accurate Weapons - Missile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: Hydra 旨在充当中型突击单位，拥有厚重装甲和不错的武器配置。Hydra 2 于 3066 年推出，以一组跳跃喷射器为核心，代价是削弱装甲防护和武器。 特性：精准武器 - 导弹 部署成本倍率：0.99

column1: The SKW-4G variant replaces the ER large laser with an experimental large X-Pulse laser at the expense of the Artemis IV system and one double heat sink. This version hasn't seen much action because of the alleged fragility of the laser, however. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: SKW-4G 型以实验型大型 X 脉冲激光替换 ER 大型激光，代价是拆除 Artemis IV 系统和一台双重散热器。不过，由于据称这种激光十分脆弱，该版本并未经历太多战斗。 特性：战斗拳 部署成本倍率：1.04

column1: Used by Alexander 'Sandy' Romanov, a known associate of the Bounty Hunter, this Shadow Hawk is equipped with double heat sinks, a jump range of 150 meters, and a TAG unit. The weapons have been removed and replaced with a heavy PPC and light PPC. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: 这台 Shadow Hawk 由赏金猎人的熟人 Alexander“桑迪”Romanov 使用，配备双重散热器、150 米跳跃距离和一具 TAG 单元。原有武器被拆除，换成一门重型 PPC 和一门轻型 PPC。 特性：战斗拳 部署成本倍率：1.07

column1: The E loadout of the Republic's CLR-03-O OmniMech variant carries an ER medium laser and an improved heavy medium laser, both built to Clan specifications. A rocket launcher with 10 shots is also mounted for some extra firepower when needed. Quirk: Quad Mech (Squad) Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.94
column2: 共和国 CLR-03-O 全向机甲变体的 E 配置携带一门 ER 中型激光和一门改良型重型中型激光，均按克兰规格制造。此外还安装了一具备有十发弹药的火箭发射器，以便在需要时提供额外火力。 特性：四足机甲（小队） 部署成本倍率：0.94

column1: The D loadout utilizes an LB 2-X AC in the left arm, while the right arm is home to an Artemis V FCS-guided SRM-2 launcher. Both arms have CASE II protecting the 'Mech's one ton ammunition allotments. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: D 配置在左臂使用一门 LB 2-X AC，右臂则装有一具由 Artemis V 火控系统制导的 SRM-2 发射器。两条手臂都由 CASE II 保护机甲的一吨弹药储备。 特性：灵巧 部署成本倍率：1.09 手臂执行器限制：全方位

column1: The Eris, named after the Terran Goddess of Chaos and Strife, is capable of delivering a stunning long range blow that can unexpectedly crush all but the most capable Combatants. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这台以泰拉混乱与纷争女神厄里斯命名的机甲，能够在远距离发动惊人打击，出其不意地摧毁除最强悍战士外的几乎所有敌人。 特性：多重锁定 部署费用倍率：1.16 手臂执行器限制：左下，右下

column1: A second variant of the CP-11-C3, which tries cutting costs by using cheaper weapon technology and armor. Since the main purpose of the 'Mech is the experimental boosted C3 Master computer, it was deemed weapons were a far lower priority. Quirk: Battle Computer B2000 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: CP-11-C3 的第二种型号，尝试通过采用更廉价的武器技术与装甲来削减成本。由于这台机甲的主要用途是搭载实验型增强 C3 主计算机，武器被认为远没有那么重要。 特性：B2000 战斗计算机 部署费用倍率：1.16

column1: The Kodiak 3 mounts a massive Inner Sphere MRM-40 launcher in each arm and a LBX AC/20 in the right torso. Together they can deliver a fearsome punch at medium to close ranges. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Kodiak 3 在每条手臂上安装一具巨大的内天体 MRM-40 发射器，右侧躯干还装有一门 LBX AC/20。两者结合，能在中近距离打出可怕的火力。 特性：指挥机甲 部署费用倍率：1.24 手臂执行器限制：左下，右下

column1: We call the Cataphract the "FrankenMech" because it's got a little bit of everything stitched together on it. The 1E variant was upgraded to employ an EWS and a Null Signature System. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 我们称 Cataphract 为“弗兰肯机甲”，因为它身上缝合了各种各样的部件。1E 型号经过升级，配备了 EWS 和零特征系统。 特性：受保护的执行器 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂执行器限制：右下

column1: The Basilisk is an agile Fire Support Platform, able to dish out high damage at extreme ranges while staying relatively safe itself, some refer to it as a Mad Catapult. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Basilisk 是一台敏捷的火力支援平台，能够在极远距离造成高额伤害，同时自身保持相对安全；有些人称它为“疯狂弹射”。 特性：改进生命维持 部署费用倍率：1.17 手臂执行器限制：左上，右上

column1: Intended to serve as a medium assault unit, the Hydra carries heavy armor and a decent weapon suite. A 3067 design, this variant was designed as a fire support ProtoMech. It is solely armed with a single torso-mounted LRM-6 Launcher. Quirk: Accurate Weapons - Missile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: Hydra 原本被设计为中型突击单位，拥有厚重装甲和不错的武器配置。这一型号诞生于 3067 年，专为火力支援 ProtoMech 设计。它仅装备一具安装在躯干上的 LRM-6 发射器。 特性：精准武器——导弹 部署费用倍率：0.99

column1: Reinforced structure to defend an area. Quirk: Stable Weapons Armor: Armor Amount: 160 Structure: Structure Amount: 200 Engine: 300 Standard Fusion Equipment: 1 x Angel ECM 1 x Command Bunker Weapons: 2x RE Large Laser Ammunition:
column2: 用于防御区域的强化结构。 特性：稳定武器 装甲：装甲 数量：160 结构：结构 数量：200 引擎：300 标准融合 装备： 1 x 天使 ECM 1 x 指挥堡垒 武器： 2x RE 大型激光 弹药：

column1: A product of the Kendall BattleMech factory rebuilt as a collaborative project between Kali Yama and the Alphard Trading Corporation, the Quasimodo was intended from the outset to be the next generation of the venerable Hunchback 'Mech. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: Quasimodo 出自肯德尔战斗机甲工厂，是 Kali Yama 与 Alphard 贸易公司合作重建的产品。从一开始，它就被设计为久负盛名的 Hunchback 机甲的下一代型号。 特性：精准武器——激光 部署费用倍率：1.03

column1: A variant with firepower on par with the ancient Awesome, the 'Mech comes with three Extended Range Particle Projection Cannons, mounted in each arm and left torso. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是一种火力堪比古老 Awesome 的型号，机甲装备了三门延伸射程粒子投射炮，分别安装在两条手臂和左侧躯干上。 特性：可变射程瞄准 部署费用倍率：1.09 手臂执行器限制：左下，右下

column1: The Tundra Wolf 5 uses an XL engine to reach a top speed of 54 km/h. It carries an ER large laser, two Gauss rifles, four ER small lasers, an LRM-10, and SRM-4 into combat. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Tundra Wolf 5 使用 XL 引擎，将最高速度提升至 54 km/h。它携带一门 ER 大型激光、两门高斯步枪、四门 ER 小型激光、一具 LRM-10 和一具 SRM-4 投入战斗。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.17 手臂执行器限制：左下，右下

column1: Intended for extended recon missions and deep strikes, the Venom SDR-9KE carries a single ER medium laser and ER Flamer for weapons. It uses a partial wing to jump great distances, and is also equipped with a remote sensor dispenser and mine dispensers. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: Venom SDR-9KE 用于执行长期侦察任务和深入突袭，武器为一门 ER 中型激光和一具 ER 喷火器。它使用部分机翼进行远距离跳跃，还配备了远程传感器投放器与地雷投放器。 特性：敏捷 部署费用倍率：1.05

column1: This upgraded version of the 4Z removes the jump jets and a ton of Gauss ammo to mount an ER PPC. It takes advantage of the heat buildup from the Stealth Armor and PPC to mount Triple Strength Myomer so that it can move on the ground more quickly. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 这个 4Z 的升级型号拆除了跳跃喷射器和一吨高斯弹药，以安装一门 ER PPC。它利用隐形装甲与 PPC 产生的热量，安装三倍强度肌肉，从而在地面上移动得更快。 特性：战斗拳 部署费用倍率：1.18

column1: This JagerMech is in good shape for pirate work, though of course they've welded together as many AC2s as they could find, along with this "precision" targeting system... Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这台 JagerMech 很适合海盗使用，不过他们当然把能找到的 AC/2 尽可能多地焊在了一起，还加上了这套“精密”瞄准系统…… 特性：防空瞄准 部署费用倍率：1.09 手臂执行器限制：左上，右上

column1: More closely resembling the Pikeman than the 2C, this variant uses an LB-X Autocannon/20 instead of the massive artillery launcher. A pair of ER Medium Lasers round out the weaponry. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这一型号比起 2C 更接近 Pikeman，用 LB-X 自动炮/20 取代了巨大的火炮发射器。两门 ER 中型激光完善了其武器配置。 特性：稳定 部署费用倍率：1.09 手臂执行器限制：左下，右下

column1: This Republic era variant carries two PPCs, two Small Pulse Lasers, four ER Medium Lasers, and a single LRM-10. It is protected by Stealth Armor and uses a Guardian ECM Suite. Fifteen double heat sinks are augmented by a single Coolant Pod. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 这一共和国时代的型号携带两门 PPC、两门小型脉冲激光、四门 ER 中型激光和一具 LRM-10。它由隐形装甲保护，并使用守护者 ECM 套件。十五个双重散热器之外，还增设了一个冷却舱。 特性：受保护的执行器 部署费用倍率：1.18

column1: The Marauder MAD-B 'Blight' pairs arm mounted LPPCs with torso mounted UAC/10s. A trio of Light Machine Guns spread across the center torso and head round out the design. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Marauder MAD-B“Blight”将安装在手臂上的 LPPC 与安装在躯干上的 UAC/10 配对。三挺分布在中央躯干和头部的轻型机枪完善了这套设计。 特性：狭窄/低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：1.13 手臂执行器限制：左下，右下

column1: The left and right torso carry a Streak LRM-15 and ton of ammunition. The left arm carries a pair of ProtoMech AC/8s and two tons of AC ammunition, while the right arm carries a pair of ER PPCs. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 左右两侧躯干各携带一具 Streak LRM-15 和一吨弹药。左臂携带两门 ProtoMech AC/8 及两吨 AC 弹药，右臂则携带两门 ER PPC。 特性：空袭 部署费用倍率：1.18 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: A mercenary refit of the Jenner, allowing the use of three MRM-10 launchers on such a small frame by using Endo Steel structure, Ferro-Fibrous armor and a 245 XL engine. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是 Jenner 的雇佣兵改装型，通过使用内构钢结构、铁磁纤维装甲和 245 XL 引擎，使如此小巧的机体也能使用三具 MRM-10 发射器。 特性：改进生命维持 部署费用倍率：0.98 手臂执行器限制：左上，右上

column1: Don't let the stubby 'Urbie' fool you, it may look like a walking trash can. Eschewing the autocannon, this Draconis Combine variant carries an MRM-30 with two tons of ammo. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 别被矮胖的“小城”骗了；它看起来或许像一只会走路的垃圾桶。这个龙骧联合体型号放弃了自动炮，改为携带一具 MRM-30 和两吨弹药。 特性：360° 躯干旋转 部署费用倍率：0.97 手臂执行器限制：左上，右上

column1: A minimal upgrade of the Wolf Trap performed by Word of Blake, the -B downgrades the missile launcher to an LRM-5 to make room for an improved C3 CPU and an additional half-ton of armor. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: Word of Blake 对 Wolf Trap 进行的轻度升级型。-B 将导弹发射器降级为 LRM-5，以腾出空间安装改进型 C3 CPU，并增加半吨装甲。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.03 手臂执行器限制：右上

column1: This Panther was introduced in the Dark Age. It uses eleven Clan-spec double heat sinks to dissipate the heat from an ER PPC and Medium Laser. The -12KC carries a single Boosted C3 Slave into combat and is protected by Ballistic-Reinforced Armor. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 这台 Panther 于黑暗时代问世，使用十一台氏族规格双重散热器来消散 ER PPC 和中型激光产生的热量。-12KC 携带一台增强型 C3 从属计算机投入战斗，并由弹道强化装甲提供保护。 特性：空袭 部署费用倍率：0.98

column1: Reinforced structure to defend an area. Quirk: Stable Weapons Armor: Armor Amount: 160 Structure: Structure Amount: 200 Engine: 300 Standard Fusion Equipment: 1 x Angel ECM 1 x Command Bunker Weapons: 4x RE Medium Laser Ammunition:
column2: 用于防御区域的强化结构。 特性：稳定武器 装甲：装甲 数量：160 结构：结构 数量：200 引擎：300 标准融合 装备： 1 x 天使 ECM 1 x 指挥堡垒 武器： 4x RE 中型激光 弹药：

column1: Black Rose is the personal 'Mech of the legendary Shrike MechWarrior Malvina Hazen, Jade Falcon Star Colonel and later Khan. Her 'Mech was later used as the inspiration for the SRK-3 variant. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.27 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: Black Rose 是传奇 Shrike 机甲战士、玉鹞星上校、后来的可汗 Malvina Hazen 的私人机甲。她的机甲后来成为 SRK-3 型号的灵感来源。 特性：指挥机甲 部署费用倍率：1.27 手臂执行器限制：左下

column1: This 'Leviathan' was recovered from a battle on LV-426. It's completely covered in the unique compound discovered there, which has warped the entire chassis to be nearly lifelike. Quirk: Egg Clutch Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.42 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这台“利维坦”是在 LV-426 的一场战斗中回收的。它完全覆盖着在那里发现的独特复合物，使整个机体变形得几乎像生物一样。 特性：卵群 部署费用倍率：1.42 手臂执行器限制：左下，右下

column1: The KGC-009 King Crab is notoriously difficult to put down, thanks to heavy armor and a reinforced gyro that can keep the machine on its feet even when faced with withering fire. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: KGC-009 King Crab 以难以击倒而臭名昭著：厚重装甲和强化陀螺仪让这台机器即使遭受猛烈炮火也能保持站立。 特性：指挥机甲 部署费用倍率：1.18 手臂执行器限制：左上，右上

column1: The Cadaver CVR-A1 uses an MRM-10 for its long range firepower, fed by two tons of CASE II protected ammunition in the right torso. Each arm mounts an ER medium laser for close attacks, and a single flamer provides anti-infantry capabilities. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: Cadaver CVR-A1 使用 MRM-10 提供远程火力，右侧躯干内装有两吨 CASE II 保护弹药。两条手臂各装一门 ER 中型激光用于近距离攻击，另有一具喷火器提供反步兵能力。 特性：受保护的执行器 部署费用倍率：0.99

column1: The VAL-NT-JX, Hot-Knife, is a prototype Valiant that trades out the MASC and Hatchet for a Shield and VibroBlade with an Actuator Enhancement System. This means that the Hot-Knife is slower but more durable and even deadlier in close combat. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
column2: VAL-NT-JX“热刀”是 Valiant 的原型机，用护盾和振动刀以及执行器强化系统取代 MASC 与战斧。这意味着“热刀”速度更慢，但更加耐用，在近战中也更为致命。 特性：受保护的执行器 部署费用倍率：1.01

column1: This Society variant carries an iATM 9 with three tons of ammunition and an Improved Heavy Medium Laser in each arm. To offset the lower skills of The Society's MechWarriors, it also mounts a Nova CEWS. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这台协会型号携带一具 iATM 9 和三吨弹药，每条手臂各装一门改进型重型中型激光。为了弥补协会机甲战士较低的技能，它还安装了 Nova CEWS。 特性：稳定 部署费用倍率：1.04 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: One of the more common variants of the Yari, the -5B mounts a Light Gauss Rifle in the middle torso for dealing with enemy light 'Mechs or vehicles trying to flank. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.33 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Yari 较为常见的一种型号。-5B 在中央躯干安装一门轻型高斯步枪，用于对付试图侧翼包抄的敌方轻型机甲或载具。 特性：精准武器——导弹 部署费用倍率：1.33 手臂执行器限制：左上，右上

column1: Quicsell's Assault Laser Brawler. The CGR-QS2 has a wide variety of short to medium range lasers perfectly suited to cutting enemies into little pieces. Charge your enemies with full assurance that you will be more dangerous than them at close range. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12
column2: Quicsell 的突击型激光近战斗士。CGR-QS2 拥有种类繁多的中近程激光，非常适合把敌人切成碎片。尽管冲向敌人吧；你可以确信自己在近距离比他们更加危险。 特性：枪管拳 部署费用倍率：1.12

column1: This version of the Hoplite was decorated by some pirate to actually look like a Triple F burger. It comes equipped with paired Small Rotary Chemical Lasers and 10-Tube LRM racks. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这台 Hoplite 被某个海盗装饰成了 Triple F 汉堡的模样。它装备了成对的小型旋转化学激光和 10 管 LRM 发射架。 特性：分心 部署费用倍率：1.03 手臂执行器限制：左上，右上

column1: The first purely Marian mech to come from hegemony Factories. It keeps costs down with both primitive armor and engine but counteracts this with a massive alpha from it's 5 Rocket Launchers. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.82 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这是第一台完全由玛利安机甲工厂制造的机甲。它使用原始装甲和引擎来压低成本，但通过五具火箭发射器的巨大齐射来弥补。 特性：易于驾驶 部署费用倍率：0.82 手臂执行器限制：右下

column1: A RISC engineered Refit of the Old Vindicator designed to carry 2 Light PPC's with Twin-Linked Capacitors alongside a Experimental MML10 this design offers superior scouting capabilities. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这是 RISC 对老式 Vindicator 进行的工程改装型，设计用于搭载两门带双联电容器的轻型 PPC，并配合一具实验型 MML10，提供卓越的侦察能力。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.14 手臂执行器限制：右下

column1: The Gorgon is a heavy fire support unit that often anchors ProtoMech Points. Developed in the 3060s, this variant is designed for close-quarters combat. The long-range weaponry is dropped, for additional armor, Jump Jets, and a Medium Pulse Laser. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.978
column2: Gorgon 是一种重型火力支援单位，经常担任 ProtoMech 小队的核心。该型号于 3060 年代开发，专为近距离战斗设计。它舍弃远程武器，换取额外装甲、跳跃喷射器和一门中型脉冲激光。 特性：标准部件 部署费用倍率：0.978

column1: The 3A is one of the more simple Serket variants, only combing two AC-10s with two PPCs. The goal of the design is increased durability, shown bu the reinforced structure and choice to go for single heat sinks to the impact of losing one would be less. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.32
column2: 3A 是 Serket 较为简单的型号之一，仅将两门 AC-10 与两门 PPC 结合起来。该设计旨在提升耐久性，强化结构体现了这一点；同时选择单级散热器，使损失一台散热器时受到的影响更小。 特性：多重锁定 部署费用倍率：1.32

column1: This configuration carries a snub-nose PPC, ER medium laser, and a pair of SRT-4s, and also keeps the TAG of the other version. To allow it to move quickly underwater it carries six UMUs. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 该配置携带一门短管 PPC、一门 ER 中型激光和一对 SRT-4，同时保留了另一型号的 TAG。为了在水下快速移动，它携带六个 UMU。 特性：改进通讯 部署费用倍率：0.95 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: Defensive structure capable of repelling minor threats. Quirk: Stable Weapons Armor: Armor Amount: 240 Structure: Structure Amount: 150 Engine: 200 Standard Fusion Equipment: 1 x Command Bunker Weapons: 1x Large REX Laser QS Ammunition:
column2: 能够抵御轻微威胁的防御结构。 特性：稳定武器 装甲：装甲 数量：240 结构：结构 数量：150 引擎：200 标准融合 装备： 1 x 指挥堡垒 武器： 1x 大型 REX 激光 QS 弹药：

column1: Designed for both normal and melee combat, the Lamentor combines an ER Large Laser, two Medium Lasers and an SRM-4 with a large Sword in the Right Hand. A 360 XL engine and four jump jets ensures the 'Mech can get in range to use its melee weapon. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: Lamentor 同时为常规战斗与近战而设计，将一门 ER 大型激光、两门中型激光和一具 SRM-4 与右手的一把巨剑结合起来。360 XL 引擎和四具跳跃喷射器确保这台机甲能进入近战武器的射程。 特性：近战执行器 部署费用倍率：1.08

column1: Quicsell's Assault Missile Backstabber. The BNC-QS3 is our Streak SRM missile flagship, with 34 Streak SRM tubes and enough ammo to keep you going. Of course, as a Quicsell Backstabber line, it's about as fast as you can reasonably make a 95 ton mech move. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: Quicsell 的突击型导弹背刺者。BNC-QS3 是我们的 Streak SRM 导弹旗舰，拥有 34 个 Streak SRM 发射管，以及足够让你持续作战的弹药。当然，作为 Quicsell 背刺系列，它的速度已经达到了 95 吨机甲合理情况下所能达到的极限。 特性：坚韧 部署费用倍率：1.15

column1: The 6K carries a ER Large Laser in the left arm and two ER Medium Lasers in the right as its main armament. A Streak SRM-6 launcher in the right torso provides some secondary firepower. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 6K 将一门 ER 大型激光装在左臂，两门 ER 中型激光装在右臂，作为主要武器。右侧躯干的一具 Streak SRM-6 发射器提供辅助火力。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 部署费用倍率：1.02 手臂执行器限制：左下

column1: The Paladin PAL-2's main armament is the Rotary AC/2, which is backed up by an Medium X-Pulse Laser, a Streak SRM-6 launcher, and a Streak SRM-4 launcher protected by CASE. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Right Lower, Left Upper
column2: Paladin PAL-2 的主要武器是旋转 AC/2，辅以一门中型 X 脉冲激光、一具 Streak SRM-6 发射器和一具由 CASE 保护的 Streak SRM-4 发射器。 特性：受保护的执行器 部署费用倍率：1.08 手臂执行器限制：右下，左上

column1: The J loadout combines increased maneuverability by a Supercharger with several Reengineered lasers and two M-pods. The configuration also sports a large Targeting Computer for fire support. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: J 配置通过超级增压器提升机动性，并配备数门重构型激光和两个 M 荚舱。该配置还安装了大型瞄准计算机，用于火力支援。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 部署费用倍率：0.97 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The Gambit was equipped with a light PPC in each arm as well as a single MML-3 mounted in the right torso, along with one ton of ammunition in CASE-protected storage. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Gambit 每条手臂各装备一门轻型 PPC，右侧躯干还装有一具 MML-3，另有一吨弹药存放在 CASE 保护舱内。 特性：超伸展执行器 部署费用倍率：0.98 手臂执行器限制：左下，右下

column1: Manufactured by Jalastar Aerospace from their plant on Panpour, the Gunsmith entered service shortly before the Blackout. Armed with 4 medium X-Pulses lasers,the Gunsmith quickly earned a fearsome reputation as a pursuit BattleMech and raider. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: Gunsmith 由 Jalastar 航空航天公司在 Panpour 的工厂制造，于黑障前不久投入服役。它装备四门中型 X 脉冲激光，很快便以追击型战斗机甲和掠袭者的可怕声名著称。 特性：改进生命维持 部署费用倍率：0.96

column1: The final production variant of the Warlord 2XC Command 'Mech prototype. With its lowered chassis tonnage compared to other Warlord production models, the production cost was reduced even further increasing the profit margins significantly. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
column2: 这是 Warlord 2XC 指挥机甲原型的最终量产型号。与其他 Warlord 量产型号相比，它降低了机体吨位，使生产成本进一步下降，利润率也显著提高。 特性：改进通讯 部署费用倍率：1.11

column1: Reinforced structure to defend an area. Quirk: Stable Weapons Armor: Armor Amount: 400 Structure: Structure Amount: 200 Engine: 300 Standard Fusion Equipment: 1 x Command Bunker Weapons: 2x Streak MRM 20 Ammunition: 7x Ammo Streak MRM
column2: 用于防御区域的强化结构。 特性：稳定武器 装甲：装甲 数量：400 结构：结构 数量：200 引擎：300 标准融合 装备： 1 x 指挥堡垒 武器： 2x Streak MRM 20 弹药： 7x Streak MRM 弹药

column1: A minor modification to the CMA-1S, the CMA-C drops the Machine Gun and its ammunition and replaces them with a C3 Slave unit, allowing the Mech to be integrated into C3 equipped units. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: CMA-C 是 CMA-1S 的小幅改型，拆除了机枪及其弹药，换装 C3 从属单元，使这台机甲能够整合进配备 C3 的部队。 特性：敏捷 部署费用倍率：1.02 手臂执行器限制：左下，右下

column1: The third variant strips out four lasers, but replaces them with two Medium Pulse Lasers and two ER PPCs, along with a Targeting Computer; three heat sinks are removed. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 第三种型号拆除了四门激光，换装两门中型脉冲激光和两门 ER PPC，并配备瞄准计算机；同时移除了三台散热器。 特性：改进瞄准——远程 部署费用倍率：1.2 手臂执行器限制：左下，右下

column1: The E loadout is the most unusual one out of the standard configurations. It brings very long range, direct firepower by a Railgun, has some limited indirect capabilities with a Extended LRM-10 launcher and even has a head mounted AMS. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Ballistics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.27
column2: E 配置是标准配置中最不寻常的一种。它通过轨道炮提供极远距离的直接火力，借助一具扩展型 LRM-10 发射器具备有限的间接火力，甚至还在头部安装了一具 AMS。 特性：精准武器——弹道 部署费用倍率：1.27

column1: Produced with a mix of Inner Sphere and Clan technologies, the fourth variant of the Gyrfalcon carries a pair of TSEMP Cannons in place of the original's Autocannons. Similar to the third variant, this version retains the same level of Ferro armor protection. The design has been equipped with 3 additional Laser Sinks in comparison to the previous three variants.
column2: 第四种 Gyrfalcon 型号融合了内天体与氏族技术，用一对 TSEMP 炮取代原始型号的自动炮。与第三种型号类似，它保留了同等水平的铁磁纤维装甲防护。相比之前三种型号，该设计额外装备了 3 个激光散热器。

column1: Quicsell's Assault Missile Support. The CGR-QS4 contains the very best anti-missile defences that Quicsell can provide. While it is perfectly capable of dishing out pain, its main job is to ensure that no enemy missile can so much as touch the ground. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12
column2: Quicsell 的突击导弹支援机。CGR-QS4 配备 Quicsell 能提供的最佳反导防御系统。虽然它完全有能力造成杀伤，但其主要任务是确保敌方导弹无法触地。 特质: 桶拳 投放成本倍率: 1.12

column1: Fortress installation safeguarding the surrounding area. Quirk: Stable Weapons Armor: Armor Amount: 480 Structure: Structure Amount: 250 Engine: 400 Standard Fusion Equipment: 1 x Command Bunker Weapons: 2x Large REX Laser QS Ammunition:
column2: 守护周边区域的堡垒设施。 特质: 武器稳定 装甲: 装甲 数值: 480 结构: 结构 数值: 250 引擎: 400 标准聚变 装备: 1 x 指挥掩体 武器: 2x 大型 REX 激光 QS 弹药:

column1: This 'Black Marauder' was found abandoned on the Asteroid LV-426, composed of extremely advanced Materials does it sport unique Weaponry and a unnerving capacity for Self Repair... Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这台“黑色掠夺者”被发现遗弃在 LV-426 小行星上。它由极其先进的材料构成，配备独特武器，并拥有令人不安的自我修复能力…… 特质: 威慑 投放成本倍率: 1.17 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

column1: A clan conversion of the esteemed Beowulf, replacing its internal with Clan grade technology. Two Medium and one Large Pulse Laser provides some defense as the unit scouts for artillery targets, utilizing it's Light Tag to mark them once found. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 著名的贝奥武夫氏族改型，以氏族级技术替换了内部设备。两门中型脉冲激光器和一门大型脉冲激光器提供一定防御；该单位侦察炮兵目标，并在发现后使用轻型 TAG 为其标记。 特质: 延伸躯干扭转 投放成本倍率: 1.09

column1: Reinforced structure to defend an area. Quirk: Stable Weapons Armor: Armor Amount: 240 Structure: Structure Amount: 200 Engine: 300 Standard Fusion Equipment: 1 x Command Bunker Weapons: 4x Proto AC/8 (C) Ammunition: 3x Ammo Proto AC/8
column2: 用于防御区域的强化结构。 特质: 武器稳定 装甲: 装甲 数值: 240 结构: 结构 数值: 200 引擎: 300 标准聚变 装备: 1 x 指挥掩体 武器: 4x 原型 AC/8 (C) 弹药: 3x 原型 AC/8 弹药

column1: Besides its advanced armor, the Kugelblitz also brings other advanced technology such as prototype heat sinks and extensive usage of patchwork materials to save weight. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.38 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 除了先进装甲外，Kugelblitz 还采用了其他先进技术，例如原型散热器，以及大量使用拼接材料来减轻重量。 特质: 改进瞄准 - 远程 投放成本倍率: 1.38 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

column1: Taking inspiration from the R20 series of mechs, this urban mech was designed from the ground up; to be a cheap and nasty ambusher aimed at the mercenary market. The combination of stealth armour and rockets allow it to savage targets and withdraw. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 这台城市机甲的设计灵感来自 R20 系列，从零开始打造，目标是面向雇佣兵市场，成为廉价而凶狠的伏击者。隐形装甲与火箭的组合使它能够重创目标后撤离。 特质: 360° 躯干扭转 投放成本倍率: 0.99

column1: This 3079 variant uses a medium VSP, an MML-5, and a plasma rifle. Improved jump jets provide a jump range of 210 meters, powered by a 275-rated XL engine. For electronic warfare support this version uses a Guardian ECM suite and a Beagle active probe. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 这一 3079 年改型使用中型 VSP、MML-5 和等离子步枪。改进型跳跃喷气机提供 210 米跳跃距离，由一具 275 级 XL 引擎驱动。为支援电子战，该版本配备 Guardian ECM 套件和 Beagle 主动探测器。 特质: 战斗拳套 投放成本倍率: 1.05

column1: Developed from the 'MUSE EARTH' experimental prototype, Corean installed a cheaper XL engine and added a battery of re-engineered lasers to counter advanced DCMS armors. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Corean 以“MUSE EARTH”实验原型为基础，安装了更廉价的 XL 引擎，并增加一组重新设计的激光器，以对抗先进的 DCMS 装甲。 特质: 超伸展驱动器 投放成本倍率: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

column1: This Blue Flame variant introduced in 3073 carries three Light PPCs in the torsos, while a Medium Variable Speed Pulse Laser covers the rear. All these weapons are tied into a Targeting Computer. It retains the C3i system found in the original design. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 这一于 3073 年推出的蓝焰改型在躯干中搭载三门轻型 PPC，后方由一门中型变速脉冲激光器负责覆盖。所有这些武器都接入瞄准计算机。它保留了原设计中的 C3i 系统。 特质: 武器稳定 投放成本倍率: 1.03

column1: An upgrade of the Mongoose introduced in 3129, the Mongoose MON-96 is powered by a 200-rated Light Engine augmented by a Supercharger. Armed with 3 ER Medium Lasers and an ER Small Laser, the MON-96 carries a Bloodhound Active Probe in the right torso. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: Mongoose MON-96 是 3129 年推出的 Mongoose 升级型，由一具 200 级轻型引擎和增压器驱动。它装备 3 门增程中型激光器和一门增程小型激光器，右侧躯干搭载一具 Bloodhound 主动探测器。 特质: 易于驾驶 投放成本倍率: 0.98

column1: The 3D variant is designed as a direct fire mech. 2 UAC/5's and LRM-10 provide the bulk of the firepower, whilst a Machine Gun and two Medium Lasers provide close in protection. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 3D 型号设计为直射火力机甲。两门 UAC/5 和一具 LRM-10 提供主要火力，而一挺机枪和两门中型激光器负责近距离防护。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

column1: This configuration is armed with a pair of light AC/5s, one mounted in each of the 'Mechs arms. These weapons are backed up by arm mounted ER medium lasers and side torso mounted small X-Pulse lasers. Quirk: Well Balanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 该配置装备一对轻型 AC/5，分别安装在机甲两条手臂上。手臂上的增程中型激光器和侧面躯干上的小型 X 脉冲激光器为其提供支援。 特质: 平衡良好 投放成本倍率: 0.99 手臂驱动器限制: 全能

column1: The Colossus' main armament is its LB 20-X Autocannon. For long-range backup it carries two Large Pulse Lasers with X-Pulse and two Medium Pulse Lasers with X-Pulse for medium-range backup. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 巨像的主武器是 LB 20-X 自动加农炮。为获得远程支援，它装备两门带 X 脉冲的远程脉冲激光器；中程支援则使用两门带 X 脉冲的中型脉冲激光器。 特质: 稳定 投放成本倍率: 1.17 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

column1: The D loadout of the Menace is a mix of energy and ballistic weapons. Two LBX AC/10, two Ultra AC/10, four Extended Range Heavy PPC and two Large Improved Heavy Lasers provide enough firepower to handle almost any situation the Mech can find itself in. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.42
column2: Menace 的 D 型配置混合使用能量武器与弹道武器。两门 LBX AC/10、两门 Ultra AC/10、四门增程重型 PPC 和两门大型改进重型激光器，提供足以应对机甲几乎所有处境的火力。 特质: 武器稳定 投放成本倍率: 1.42

column1: The MVN-4T is an attempt to make the Merovingian work better at slightly longer distances, replacing the AC/20 with an AC/10 and a Large Laser. To free enough space for this change, the CASE and one of the Medium Lasers had to be dropped as well. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: MVN-4T 旨在让 Merovingian 在稍远距离上表现更佳，将 AC/20 替换为 AC/10 和一门大型激光器。为这次改动腾出足够空间，还必须拆除 CASE 和一门中型激光器。 特质: 精准武器 - AC 投放成本倍率: 1.03

column1: Due to the issues with heat build up of most of the other variants, the 4D main weapons are four Gauss Rifles. Their inherent lower heat generation also allows an ER PPC to be mounted in each Arm, while still almost reaching a neutral heat delta. Quirk: Superheavy Prototype Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.39
column2: 由于其他多数改型都存在热量积聚问题，4D 的主武器改为四门高斯步枪。它们固有的低热量生成还允许每条手臂安装一门增程 PPC，同时仍几乎达到热量平衡。 特质: 超重型原型 投放成本倍率: 1.39

column1: The Orion 2K is a prototype upgrade of an already impressive design, adding 2 PPCs with upgraded capacitors, and an AC/5 with specialized ammo as well as heat-dissipating armor. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Orion 2K 是一项原本已很出色设计的原型升级，增加两门配备升级电容器的 PPC，以及一门使用特种弹药的 AC/5，并采用散热装甲。 特质: 防空瞄准 投放成本倍率: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

column1: No surprise pirates got their Hands on a Trashcan, it is a surprise how they managed to 'repair' the mangled and broken Autocannon and welded 2 RocketLauncher onto the poor thing. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 海盗拿到一台“垃圾桶”并不奇怪，奇怪的是他们居然设法“修复”了那门残破的自动加农炮，还在可怜的家伙身上焊了两具火箭发射器。 特质: 360° 躯干扭转 投放成本倍率: 0.97 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

column1: The ICR-2S is an overhaul of the arcane -1S design; it utilizes an upgraded XL engine and Endo-Steel to accommodate the upgrade to an LBX-10, Medium Pulse Laser, and an extra Heatsink. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: ICR-2S 是对古老 -1S 设计的全面改造；它使用升级型 XL 引擎和内层钢，以容纳 LBX-10、中型脉冲激光器及一具额外散热器。 特质: 改进瞄准 - 近程 投放成本倍率: 1.02 手臂驱动器限制: 左下

column1: With the C loadout a Heavy LArge Laser and three ER Medium Lasers are connected through a targeting computer for optimal damage profiles. Two Streak SRM-4 launchers provide extra firepower as needed. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: C 型配置通过瞄准计算机连接一门重型大型激光器和三门增程中型激光器，以实现最佳伤害覆盖。两具 Streak SRM-4 发射器可按需提供额外火力。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.06 手臂驱动器限制: 全能

column1: Introduced in 3070, the IIC 6 carries a pair of Zeta-series X Plasma Cannons and two Series 2D-2 heavy medium lasers, all of which are tied into a Targeting Computer. Trellshire Long Lifters Improved Jump Jets enable the 'Mech to leap up to 240 meters. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2
column2: IIC 6 于 3070 年推出，携带一对 Zeta 系列 X 等离子炮和两门 2D-2 系列重型中型激光器，全部接入瞄准计算机。Trellshire Long Lifters 改进型跳跃喷气机使该机甲能够跃过 240 米。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.2

column1: The Dakota DKA-22 drops the C.A.S.E. and AC/2 to fit four more Medium Laser, with four new double heat sinks to cool the energy weapons. It saw limited success, but enough were sold that at least one full production run was completed. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Missile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: Dakota DKA-22 拆除 C.A.S.E. 和 AC/2，以安装另外四门中型激光器，并增加四具双重散热器为能量武器降温。它取得的成功有限，但销量足以完成至少一轮完整生产。 特质: 改进冷却套 - 导弹 投放成本倍率: 1.15

column1: Developed by the Draconis Combine, this version uses Inner Sphere weaponry. The head carries an ER Small Laser, the center torso mount houses a Medium X-Pulse Laser, and the side torsos each carry a Thunderbolt 5 missile launcher with a ton of ammunition. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 该版本由龙辰联合体开发，使用内天体武器。头部搭载一门增程小型激光器，中央躯干安装一门中型 X 脉冲激光器，两侧躯干各搭载一具 Thunderbolt 5 导弹发射器及一吨弹药。 特质: 战斗拳套 投放成本倍率: 1.08

column1: Introduced in 3075 this variant is a direct copy of the FS9-S except ER medium lasers replace the standard medium lasers, it carries double heat sinks, and has Light Ferro-Fibrous armor. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 该改型于 3075 年推出，是 FS9-S 的直接复制版，只是用增程中型激光器替换标准中型激光器，配备双重散热器，并使用轻型铁纤装甲。 特质: 无处不在 投放成本倍率: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

column1: A short-ranged energy boat, the A variant carries three Small Pulse Lasers in both the right and left arm, with two extra double heat sinks to keep up a sustained rate of fire. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: A 型是一台近程能量武器平台，左右两条手臂各装备三门小型脉冲激光器，并增加两具双重散热器以维持持续射速。 特质: 改进生命维持 投放成本倍率: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

column1: The Nanook 2 combines the inherent strength of laser weapons on its platform with two Streak LRM-20 launchers. The increased indirect fire capabilities over the NNK-1 improves the performance of the 'Mech on the battlefield considerably. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.42
column2: Nanook 2 将平台上激光武器的固有优势与两具 Streak LRM-20 发射器结合起来。相较 NNK-1，其增强的间接火力能力显著提升了该机甲在战场上的表现。 特质: 改进冷却套 - 激光 投放成本倍率: 1.42

column1: The Dagoth DG-B-3 model was met with a very luke warm reception in the export markets. Despite the staggering amount of RAC2 rounds it was able to send down range, the cost of the 285XL engine priced most fans of the original A-1 out of picking up a B-3. Quirk: Well Balanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: Dagoth DG-B-3 型号在出口市场上反响冷淡。尽管它能向远方倾泻数量惊人的 RAC2 炮弹，但 285XL 引擎的成本让原 A-1 的大多数拥趸无力购买 B-3。 特质: 平衡良好 投放成本倍率: 1.17

column1: This configuration carries three LRM-5 launchers, one in each side torso and one in the head. The two side torsos also carry two flamers each, for a total of four. A single ton of LRM ammunition is carried in a CASE protected bay in the center torso. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 该配置携带三具 LRM-5 发射器，分别位于两侧躯干和头部。两侧躯干还各携带两具火焰喷射器，总计四具。中央躯干的 CASE 防护舱内装有一吨 LRM 弹药。 特质: 狭窄/低矮轮廓 投放成本倍率: 0.98

column1: Introduced in 3075 this variant is a direct copy of the FS9-S1 except ER medium lasers replace the standard medium lasers, it carries double heat sinks, and has Light Ferro-Fibrous armor. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 该改型于 3075 年推出，是 FS9-S1 的直接复制版，只是用增程中型激光器替换标准中型激光器，配备双重散热器，并使用轻型铁纤装甲。 特质: 无处不在 投放成本倍率: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

column1: Quicsell's Assault Ballistic Brawler. The BNC-QS2 is the toughest mech Quicsell makes. At 95 tons, and touting the maximum armor that can be fit on the mech (Quicsell's specialty Duralast armor, at that!) the BNC-QS2 will survive almost anything you throw at it. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: Quicsell 的突击弹道格斗机。BNC-QS2 是 Quicsell 制造的最坚固机甲。它重达 95 吨，装配机甲可容纳的最大装甲（而且是 Quicsell 的特产 Duralast 装甲！），几乎能够承受你扔向它的一切。 特质: 坚固 投放成本倍率: 1.15

column1: This variant was introduced during the Late Republic, and is apparently designed for long range fire support. It carries a pair of Streak LRM-5s and a single ER PPC tied into a targeting computer. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 该改型在共和国晚期推出，显然是为远程火力支援而设计。它携带一对 Streak LRM-5 和一门接入瞄准计算机的增程 PPC。 特质: 武器稳定 投放成本倍率: 1.06 手臂驱动器限制: 右下

column1: Built to resist all forms of visual and tracking data, The Phantasm Mark 109 Drone was built on a racing platform. Apparently a kind of race was run where the orgaincs bet on which drone would even be able to cross the finish line. A kind of Death Race. Quirk: Improved Jammer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
column2: 幻影 Mark 109 无人机建造于赛车平台，旨在抵抗各种视觉与追踪数据。显然曾举办过一场比赛，有机体们下注猜测哪架无人机甚至能越过终点线——一场死亡竞赛。 特质: 改进干扰器 投放成本倍率: 1.01

column1: Used by the lance commander of Lamenkov's Liability, this Thunderbolt removes the Snub-Nose PPC of the original TDR-10M and replaces it with a C3 master computer and an additional Light PPC in the left torso. In every other respect, it is a standard TDR-10M. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
column2: 这台雷霆机甲由 Lamenkov's Liability 的长官使用，拆除了原 TDR-10M 的短管 PPC，换成一台 C3 主计算机，并在左侧躯干增加一门轻型 PPC。除此之外，它是标准 TDR-10M。 特质: 多重追踪 投放成本倍率: 1.11

column1: Jack Blacks are solid, well-rounded musicians for their tonnage. They typically play guitars, which give them an extra edge by being able to play the greatest song in the world. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Jack Black 就其吨位而言是结实而全面的音乐家。它们通常演奏吉他，这让它们拥有额外优势，能够演奏世界上最伟大的歌曲。 特质: 延伸躯干扭转 投放成本倍率: 1.07 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

column1: An anti-infantry scout configuration that carries an active probe in the left torso. Each arm carries four light machine guns mounted in a Machine Gun Array, fed by half a ton of ammo in the right torso. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 一种反步兵侦察配置，左侧躯干搭载一具主动探测器。每条手臂在机枪阵列中安装四挺轻型机枪，由右侧躯干的半吨弹药供给。 特质: 易于驾驶 投放成本倍率: 0.98 手臂驱动器限制: 全能

column1: This was once a very solid Dagger, until some pirate went at it and broke the advanced electronics, it still has some after market Warfare Suite and Stealth Systems, but I wouldnt trust them. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这曾是一台非常坚固的 Dagger，直到某个海盗动手破坏了其先进电子设备。它仍保留一些售后市场战争套件和隐形系统，但我不会信任它们。 特质: 灵巧 投放成本倍率: 0.98 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

column1: The Shadow Hawk IIC is a second-line Clan BattleMech based upon the Shadow Hawk that was first fielded by the Star League. The fifth variant uses twin Zeta-Series X Plasma Cannons and a trio of Tau-II AP Gauss Rifles to decimate non-BattleMech formations. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: Shadow Hawk IIC 是一种氏族二线战斗机甲，以星盟最初部署的 Shadow Hawk 为基础。第五种改型使用两门 Zeta 系列 X 等离子炮和三门 Tau-II AP 高斯步枪，用于摧毁非战斗机甲编队。 特质: 战斗拳套 投放成本倍率: 1.09

column1: This variant of the Griffin was based on the 6S. By dropping one of the ER medium lasers, the Artemis system, and using a Clan-spec LRM-15, engineers found enough room to add a C3 Boosted Slave and a Targeting Computer. CASE II protects the LRM ammunition. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 这一 Griffin 改型以 6S 为基础。拆除一门增程中型激光器和 Artemis 系统，并使用氏族规格的 LRM-15 后，工程师腾出空间加装 C3 增强从属系统和瞄准计算机。CASE II 保护 LRM 弹药。 特质: 战斗拳套 投放成本倍率: 1.05

column1: Extending the 3L variant even more, this Jihad-era 3077 field refit drops all the existing weaponry and replaces them with a Snub-Nose PPC, MML-5, and ER medium laser. The ammunition is protected by CASE. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这一 3077 年圣战时期的战地改装进一步扩展了 3L 型号，拆除所有现有武器，换成一门短管 PPC、MML-5 和增程中型激光器。弹药由 CASE 保护。 特质: 坚固 投放成本倍率: 1.03 手臂驱动器限制: 右下

column1: Although this configuration was originally intended for underwater combat, the version replaced the five UMUs with jump jets. It uses a light PPC and Artemis IV-enhanced LRM-10 to engage the enemy. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.94 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 虽然该配置最初用于水下作战，但此版本用跳跃喷气机替换了五具 UMU。它使用一门轻型 PPC 和一具经 Artemis IV 强化的 LRM-10 与敌人交战。 特质: 狭窄/低矮轮廓 投放成本倍率: 0.94 手臂驱动器限制: 全能

column1: The UrbanLord appears to be a very heavy counterpart to the much older UrbanMech, weighing in at 70 metric tons, making it two entire weightclasses heavier than the UM-R60 UrbanMech. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: UrbanLord 似乎是年代久远的 UrbanMech 的超重型对应型号，重量达 70 公吨，比 UM-R60 UrbanMech 足足高出两个重量级别。 特质: 360° 躯干扭转 投放成本倍率: 1.15 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

column1: This Bombard variant uses engines and Compact Heat Sinks originally intended for the HNT-181 Hornet. It also carries Light Gauss Rifles and a Chameleon Light Polarization Shield. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这一 Bombard 改型使用原本为 HNT-181 Hornet 设计的引擎和紧凑型散热器。它还搭载轻型高斯步枪和变色龙轻型偏振护盾。 特质: 延伸躯干扭转 投放成本倍率: 1.06 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

column1: The UrbanLord appears to be a very heavy counterpart to the much older UrbanMech, weighing in at 70 metric tons, making it two entire weightclasses heavier than the UM-R60 UrbanMech. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.88 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: UrbanLord 似乎是年代久远的 UrbanMech 的超重型对应型号，重量达 70 公吨，比 UM-R60 UrbanMech 足足高出两个重量级别。 特质: 360° 躯干扭转 投放成本倍率: 0.88 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

column1: A light brawler, the Wulfen's C configuration sports three ER medium lasers tied into a targeting computer. The configuration also comes with 10 jump jets giving an additional advantage in close quarters combat. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Wulfen 是一台轻型格斗机，C 型配置装备三门接入瞄准计算机的增程中型激光器。该配置还配备 10 具跳跃喷气机，在近距离战斗中提供额外优势。 特质: 灵巧 投放成本倍率: 1.09 手臂驱动器限制: 全能

column1: The Menace's B configuration switches to two Rotary AC/5 as the main weapons, with two Extended Range Heavy PPCs and an Improved ATM-12 launcher in each arm. A head mounted Laser AMS provides some defensive capabilities, something no other loadout brings. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.42
column2: Menace 的 B 型配置改用两门旋转 AC/5 作为主武器，并在每条手臂上装备两门增程重型 PPC 和一具改进 ATM-12 发射器。头部安装的激光 AMS 提供一定防御能力，这是其他配置都没有的装备。 特质: 武器稳定 投放成本倍率: 1.42
