column1: This version was introduced in the 3120s. Built around an Endo Steel chassis and protected by Anti-Ballistic Armor, it has upgraded pulse lasers and removes the smaller ballistic weaponry. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 该版本于 3120 年代推出。它以一具内层钢底盘为基础，并由反弹道装甲保护，升级了脉冲激光器，同时拆除较小的弹道武器。 特质: 桶拳 投放成本倍率: 1.17 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

column1: This variant of the downgraded MON-67, removes all the standard weaponry in exchange for a single Large Laser, the swap to a lighter 175-rated engine reducing the MON-68's ground speed by 10 km/h but freeing up the weight to mount two additional heat sinks. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: 这一降级版 MON-67 改型拆除所有标准武器，换成一门大型激光器；改用较轻的 175 级引擎使 MON-68 的地面速度降低 10 公里/小时，但腾出重量安装两具额外散热器。 特质: 易于驾驶 投放成本倍率: 0.96

column1: A typical refit seen in the periphery, this is the salvaged remains of multiple Urbanmechs; sheathed in repurposed industrial armour and carrying just enough ammo to survive a battle. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.77 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是边疆地区常见的典型改装品，由多台 UrbanMech 的残骸拼合而成，外覆再利用的工业装甲，只携带足以撑过一场战斗的弹药。 特质: 360° 躯干扭转 投放成本倍率: 0.77 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

column1: The MN-4-2 is a continuation of the Magellan project, but switches to a weapon loadout which was not ammo dependant. The Streak SRM-2 was replaced by two Medium and one Small Laser. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: MN-4-2 延续了 Magellan 项目，但改用不依赖弹药的武器配置。Streak SRM-2 被两门中型激光器和一门小型激光器替换。 特质: 狭窄/低矮轮廓 投放成本倍率: 0.95 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

column1: The Crimson Hawk is armed with a pair of ER large lasers that allow it to snipe at an enemy from long range. Utilizing its jump jets allows the 'Mech to leap up to 150 meters, keeping the enemy at distance or to attain an advantageous firing position. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 猩红鹰装备了一对ER大型激光器，使其能够从远距离狙击敌人。借助跳跃喷射器，这台“机甲”可以跃过最多150米的距离，保持与敌人的距离，或占据有利的射击位置。 特性：受保护的执行器 部署费用倍率：1.04

column1: A rare modification of the R60L model, the R60T removes the unused 11th heat sink and the AC/20 and its ammo. A Thumper Artillery piece and a ton of ammo are installed in their place. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: R60T是R60L型号的罕见改装版，拆除了闲置的第11个散热器、AC/20及其弹药，改装为一门重锤火炮和一吨弹药。 特性：360°躯干旋转 部署费用倍率：0.97 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: The Exterminator is a BattleMech that was designed in 2630 for the most dubious, but necessary, of purposes: Headhunting. This Experimental Comstar Variant was upgrade with a Void Signature System and improved weapons but had to sacrifice some of its engine speed. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
column2: 终结者是一台于2630年设计的战斗机甲，用于执行最可疑却又不可或缺的任务：猎杀首脑。这款ComStar实验型变体升级了虚空特征系统和武器，但不得不牺牲部分引擎速度。 特性：灵活 部署费用倍率：1.11

column1: An ultra rare hand-crafted King Crab, equipped with a Chameleon Light Polarization Shield. This behemoth can reliably shred its unsuspecting targets with its 2 Silver Bullet Gauss rifles. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 一台极其罕见的手工打造王蟹，装备有变色龙光偏转护盾。这头巨兽配备两支银弹高斯步枪，能够可靠地撕碎毫无防备的目标。 特性：指挥机甲 部署费用倍率：1.18 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: The Shadow Hawk 2D is an interesting model. Its default payload sacrifices a lot of armor to mount a bit more firepower, though some argue the tradeoff isn't worth it. Its Alpha Strikes are better, though, so I guess you can be the judge of its worth. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: Shadow Hawk 2D是一个有趣的型号。它的默认载荷牺牲了大量装甲来换取更多火力，尽管有人认为这种取舍并不值得。不过，它的齐射确实更强，所以值不值得由你来判断吧。 特性：战斗拳套 部署费用倍率：1.03

column1: This variant of the Shrike was introduced in 3116. The Shrike 3 is similar to the standard model, save the swapping out of the 'Mech's autocannons for pair of Extended Range Particle Projection Cannons. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.23 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 这款Shrike变体于3116年推出。Shrike 3与标准型号相似，只是将机甲的自动炮换成了一对远程粒子投射炮。 特性：指挥机甲 部署费用倍率：1.23 手臂执行器限制：左下

column1: This variant excels in urban combat and scouting thanks to its Active Probe. This hunter-killer makes use of four ER Medium Lasers and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers in addition to the standard Flamer. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 该变体凭借主动探测器，擅长城市战斗和侦察。这台猎杀者除标准火焰喷射器外，还配备四支ER中型激光器和一对中型脉冲激光器。 特性：受保护的执行器 部署费用倍率：0.99 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: Developed to meet customer demand for a cheaper fire support unit, the T3 merely swaps the Arrow IV launcher for the more common Thumper artillery piece. Otherwise unchanged, this mech is marketed to budget-conscious customers looking for an artillery mech. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 为满足客户对廉价火力支援单位的需求，T3仅将箭IV发射器换成了更常见的重锤火炮。除此之外没有改动，这台机甲面向预算有限、需要火炮机甲的客户销售。 特性：稳定武器 部署费用倍率：1.04

column1: This Archer variant, based on the 9K, was introduced during the Dark Ages. It retained the four MML-5 launchers and two of the three Light PPCs of the earlier design, but replaced the third Light PPC and C3 Slave with a C3 Boosted Slave and an ER medium laser. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 这款基于9K的弓箭手变体在黑暗时代推出。它保留了四具MML-5发射器和早期设计中的三支轻型PPC中的两支，但将第三支轻型PPC和C3从属设备替换为C3增幅从属设备和一支ER中型激光器。 特性：指挥机甲 部署费用倍率：1.1

column1: The primary loadout for the HellKite combines five ER Medium Lasers with a Large Pulse Laser for a mostly energy based loadout. Single LRM-10 with one ton of ammo provide some indirect fire capabilities. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: HellKite的主要配置以五支ER中型激光器和一支大型脉冲激光器为核心，主要依靠能量武器。单具LRM-10发射器配备一吨弹药，提供一定的间接火力能力。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.06 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The Voodoo SL-F101 serves as a scout, equipped with a Beagle active probe to spot hidden threats. For self defense it carries an SRM 2, medium laser and a Rocket Launcher 10, though with only three tons of armor it remains fragile if caught in active combat. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: Voodoo SL-F101担任侦察机，配备Beagle主动探测器以发现隐藏威胁。自卫武器包括SRM 2、中型激光器和一具火箭发射器10，但仅有三吨装甲，若陷入主动战斗仍然十分脆弱。 特性：陆空机甲 部署费用倍率：0.98

column1: Another laser focused configuration, the T loads 2 Improved Heavy Medium Lasers, an Improved Heavy Small Laser, a Large Pulse Laser and an ER Small Laser. A SRM6 with 1 ton of ammunition is added as extra support. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 另一种专注激光的配置，T型搭载两支改良型重型中型激光器、一支改良型重型小型激光器、一支大型脉冲激光器和一支ER小型激光器。另加一具SRM6及一吨弹药作为支援。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.04 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: Defensive structure capable of repelling minor threats. Quirk: Stable Weapons Armor: Armor Amount: 240 Structure: Structure Amount: 150 Engine: 200 Standard Fusion Equipment: Weapons: 3x Chemical Rotary Medium Ammunition: 5x Ammo Chemical Medium
column2: 能够抵御小规模威胁的防御设施。 特性：稳定武器 装甲：装甲 数值：240 结构：结构 数值：150 引擎：200 标准聚变 设备： 武器： 3x 化学旋转中型 弹药： 5x 化学中型弹药

column1: The Ostroc OSR-6R marks the latest progress in combining Inner Sphere and Clan technology. Four Clan-spec lasers, a IS Streak SRM4 and Reflective armor all makes for clear improvements over the original Ostroc design, furthering its combat capabilities. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: Ostroc OSR-6R代表着内太阳圈与氏族科技融合的最新进展。四支氏族规格激光器、一具内太阳圈Streak SRM4以及反射装甲，带来了相较原始Ostroc设计的显著改进，进一步增强了战斗能力。 特性：窄型/低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：1.08

column1: A excavated derelict Omega retrofitted and made functional by a 'very lucky' Pirate, it has a mostly functional StarLeague Era 'Railgun' permanently fixed into its center torso. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Gauss Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.26 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 一艘发掘出的废弃Omega被一名“非常幸运”的海盗改装并修复到可用状态，其中心躯干永久固定着一门基本完好的星盟时代“轨道炮”。 特性：精准武器-高斯 部署费用倍率：1.26 手臂执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: An Autocannon/20 with three tons of ammunition provides substantial close hitting power. It is backed up with three Medium Lasers, a six-tube SRM Pack, and a rear-firing small laser. A single PPC rounds out this design's weaponry, giving it some range. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 一门AC/20配备三吨弹药，提供强大的近距离打击力。三支中型激光器、一具六管SRM组件以及一支向后射击的小型激光器为其提供支援；另有一门PPC补足该设计的远程火力。 特性：受保护的执行器 部署费用倍率：1.18

column1: The Ettin ETN-C3 sacrifices some of its weapon potential to add a Boosted C3 Master. Whoever constructed the 'Mech must have access to early clan technologies, because the design incorporates both an early clan Ultra AC/20 and an Improved Large Laser. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.4
column2: Ettin ETN-C3牺牲部分武器潜力，换装增幅C3主控。制造这台机甲的人必定掌握了早期氏族技术，因为该设计同时采用了早期氏族Ultra AC/20和改良型大型激光器。 特性：改良生命维持 部署费用倍率：1.4

column1: Quicsell's Heavy Missile Sniper. The QKD-QS1 is a stealthy thunderbolt missile carrier, with our patented deadfire thunderbolt missile ammo for long range bombardment! Or try our complementary One-Shot Sniper artillery piece for a change of pace. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
column2: Quicsell重型导弹狙击手。QKD-QS1是一台隐形雷霆霹雳导弹载具，配备我们专利的远程死火雷霆霹雳导弹弹药，可进行远程轰炸！或者换用我们配套的一次性狙击火炮，改变战斗节奏。 特性：超伸展执行器 部署费用倍率：1.06

column1: The final Clan version is based off the Jade Hawk 2, dropping the Ferro-Fibrous plating and shaving the armor levels to restore the standard Jade Hawks jump-jets and upgrade two of the arm-mounted lasers to Medium Pulse versions instead of the ER Large models. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: 最终的氏族版本基于Jade Hawk 2，取消铁磁纤维装甲并削减装甲等级，以恢复标准Jade Hawk的跳跃喷射器，同时将两支臂载激光器升级为中型脉冲型号，替代ER大型型号。 特性：分散注意 部署费用倍率：1.17

column1: The Primary loadout of the Narayana fulfills the goal of long distance support through a Thumper Artillery, a Mortar/8 and a LRM-5 launcher. Three ER Medium and one ER Small Laser provides defensive firepower if the 'Mech gets engaged directly. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Ballistics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.27
column2: Narayana的主要载荷通过一门重锤火炮、一具Mortar/8和一具LRM-5发射器实现远程支援目标。三支ER中型激光器和一支ER小型激光器在机甲遭到直接交战时提供防御火力。 特性：精准武器-弹道 部署费用倍率：1.27

column1: Reinforced structure to defend an area. Quirk: Stable Weapons Armor: Armor Amount: 320 Structure: Structure Amount: 200 Engine: 300 Standard Fusion Equipment: 1 x Command Bunker Weapons: 2x Rotary AC/5 RISC Ammunition: 2x Ammo RAC/5 RISC [DBL]
column2: 用于防御区域的强化设施。 特性：稳定武器 装甲：装甲 数值：320 结构：结构 数值：200 引擎：300 标准聚变 设备： 1 x 指挥掩体 武器： 2x 旋转AC/5 RISC 弹药： 2x RAC/5 RISC弹药 [双联]

column1: MAD-ness! This Marauder Variant was exclusively designed for the Deadly Sins stable on Solaris VII and has specialized support systems for Gauss & PPC Weapons. Hitting like an angry God. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: MAD疯狂！这款Marauder变体专为Solaris VII上的致命罪孽竞技团设计，配备高斯与PPC武器专用支援系统，打击力如愤怒的神祇。 特性：先进光学 部署费用倍率：1.17 手臂执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: This variant uses Hyper Assault Gauss technology to its fullest. Armed with a HAG-20 and a HAG-30, this variant can lay down incredible flak at range. Backing up this variant is a pair of ER Medium Lasers. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 该变体充分发挥超强突击高斯技术。装备HAG-20和HAG-30，可在远距离倾泻惊人的防空火力；一对ER中型激光器为其提供支援。 特性：战斗计算机 部署费用倍率：1.12 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The first variant of the Kageoni, the KGO-3K, mounts Railgun as the main damage dealers with two Enhanced LRM-20 launchers as support. One large and two medium extended range lasers are housed in the left torso as secondary firepower when extra output is needed. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.38
column2: Kageoni的第一个变体KGO-3K以轨道炮作为主要伤害来源，并以两具增强型LRM-20发射器提供支援。左侧躯干配备一支大型和两支远程中型激光器，在需要额外输出时提供次要火力。 特性：多目标追踪 部署费用倍率：1.38

column1: The Imp II IMP-2-1H is based on the -1E but trades firepower for durability It downgraded the pulse lasers to medium size, but can as a result add protective padding to all torso locations. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.38 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Imp II IMP-2-1H基于-1E，但以火力换取耐久性。它将脉冲激光器降级为中型型号，因此可以为所有躯干部位加装防护填充。 特性：指挥机甲 部署费用倍率：1.38 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: This variant of the 1X version was used as an arena fighter in the Solaris Games. Two single heat sinks were removed to allow for the installation of a dual cockpit and additional armor. Quirk: Improved Jammer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这一款1X变体曾作为竞技场战士参加Solaris赛事。它拆除了两个单散热器，以安装双人驾驶舱并增加装甲。 特性：改良干扰器 部署费用倍率：1.05 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: The Archer 9K carries four new MML-5 launchers. These give the 'Mech a great deal of tactical flexibility. For long range direct fire capabilities, the 'Mech has three Light PPCs and a C3 Slave that allowed the 'Mech to share targeting data with friendly units. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 弓箭手9K搭载四具全新的MML-5发射器，为机甲提供极大的战术灵活性。为实现远程直射能力，机甲配备三支轻型PPC和一台C3从属设备，可与友军共享瞄准数据。 特性：战斗拳套 部署费用倍率：1.1

column1: The C configuration of the Menace is based around two Hyper Assault 40 Gauss Rifles and two Extended Range Heavy PPC, with four LRM-20 launchers as indirect firepower. The design also adds a 6 ton targeting computer to ensure optimal battlefield performance. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.42
column2: Menace的C型配置以两支超强突击40高斯步枪和两支远程重型PPC为核心，并以四具LRM-20发射器提供间接火力。该设计还增配一台6吨瞄准计算机，以确保战场性能达到最佳。 特性：稳定武器 部署费用倍率：1.42

column1: This looted Viper retains its traditional high mobility and energy-resistant armor, but the weapons have been replaced with heavy inner-sphere pulse lasers. Living up to its inner-sphere nickname, this 'Dragonfly' packs a nasty punch at close range. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: 这台缴获的Viper保留了其传统的高机动性和抗能量装甲，但武器被替换为重型内太阳圈脉冲激光器。为了符合其内太阳圈绰号“蜻蜓”，它在近距离拥有凶猛的打击力。 特性：精准武器-激光 部署费用倍率：1.02

column1: The 2D has a classical brawler build, starting with a combination of Medium Lasers, two TSEMP cannons and an SRM-6 launcher. An AMS Mk2 has been added for defensive protection, and an LRM-20 for indirect fire before closing in to engage with its twin PPCs. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.31
column2: 2D采用经典的近战斗士构型，配备中型激光器、两门TSEMP炮和一具SRM-6发射器。它加装AMS Mk2用于防御，并配备LRM-20，在接近并以双PPC交战前提供间接火力。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.31

column1: The primary configuration of the Ion Sparrow carries two improved heavy medium lasers in the left arm, and a pair of AP Gauss rifles in the right arm fed by one ton of ammunition provided in the right torso. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Ion Sparrow的主要配置在左臂搭载两支改良型重型中型激光器，右臂搭载一对AP高斯步枪；右侧躯干提供一吨弹药。 特性：易于驾驶 部署费用倍率：0.98 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: After the success of the Arbiter Meridian Manufacturing began producing a more limited and advanced design, that actually does carry a big scary gun. Still armored with nothing more then Paper and Wishes, is it able to destroy most targets within a single Salvo. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 在Arbiter成功之后，Meridian制造公司开始生产一种更有限但更先进的设计，它确实装上了一门巨大而可怕的火炮。虽然装甲只有纸张和愿望般薄弱，却能在单次齐射内摧毁大多数目标。 特性：分散注意 部署费用倍率：1.04

column1: A Jihad era upgrade of the EXT-5E, the Exterminator EXT-5F is used by Comstar. Boasting the same specs as the 5E, the 5F upgrades the ER Medium Lasers to a pair of Light PPCs and swaps the iNarc for an MML-7. An ER Small Laser is added with the remaining free weight. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: EXT-5E的圣战时代升级版，Exterminator EXT-5F由ComStar使用。5F拥有与5E相同的规格，将ER中型激光器升级为一对轻型PPC，并把iNarc换成MML-7；利用剩余重量加装一支ER小型激光器。 特性：灵活 部署费用倍率：1.09

column1: The Hammerhands 5M2 is a slightly more advanced version of the 5M variant that involves exchanging the AC10s and PPCs for a pair of deadly Flechette 20s and a Pack Hunter Intelligence Suite. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Hammerhands 5M2是5M变体的略微先进版本，将AC10和PPC替换为一对致命的Flechette 20以及一套猎人智能支援系统。 特性：枪管拳 部署费用倍率：1.17 手臂执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: A Republic era variant mainly seen in the Periphery, this model has a top speed of 110 km/h and can cover 210 meters in a jump. For offensive operations it carries an ER medium laser and a RL-10. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这是一款主要见于边疆地区的共和国时代变体，最高速度达110公里/小时，跳跃距离可达210米。进攻时配备一支ER中型激光器和一具RL-10发射器。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 部署费用倍率：0.95 手臂执行器限制：右下

column1: Designed for Urban combat, the 45 ton Wyvern blends heavy armor, jump jets and a versatile weapons package. Powered by a 180-rated Fusion Core, the Wyvern 10N is armed with an ER PPC and an LRM-10. For close range combat, the Mech carries a single Medium Pulse Laser. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 这台45吨的Wyvern专为城市战斗设计，融合了厚重装甲、跳跃喷射器和多用途武器套件。Wyvern 10N由180级聚变核心驱动，装备一门ER PPC和一具LRM-10；近距离战斗时，机甲配备一支中型脉冲激光器。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.03

column1: The Raider JL-3C upgrades the engine core of the JL-2 to a 200-rated core, as well as switches to the use of double heat sinks and ferro-fibrous armor. The dual saw is replaced by a retractable blade and one ton of ammunition for the RAC/2 is dropped. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: Raider JL-3C将JL-2的引擎核心升级为200级核心，并改用双散热器和铁磁纤维装甲。双锯被替换为可伸缩刀，同时减少一吨RAC/2弹药。 特性：集成探照灯 部署费用倍率：1.04

column1: This variant uses a Heavy Medium Laser and a pair of Heavy Small Lasers for short-range firepower. For long range, it has an ER Large Laser. Three additional double heat sinks keep heat levels in check. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 该变体使用一支重型中型激光器和一对重型小型激光器提供近距离火力，远距离则依靠一支ER大型激光器。额外的三具双散热器可控制热量。 特性：受保护的执行器 部署费用倍率：0.99 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The Rikki Tikki Tavi 3 is a missile boat variant of the Rikki Tikki Tavi, combining LRM-20 launchers with advanced Artemis IV fire control system attachments. A single Large Pulse Laser and two Extended Range Medium Lasers are mounted for extra damage as needed. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24
column2: Rikki Tikki Tavi 3是Rikki Tikki Tavi的导弹艇变体，将LRM-20发射器与先进的阿耳忒弥斯IV火控系统附件结合起来。另装一支大型脉冲激光器和两支远程中型激光器，以便在需要时增加伤害。 特性：分散注意 部署费用倍率：1.24

column1: Defensive structure capable of repelling minor threats. Quirk: Stable Weapons Armor: Armor Amount: 240 Structure: Structure Amount: 150 Engine: 200 Standard Fusion Equipment: 1 x Command Bunker Weapons: 1x Arrow V (S) Ammunition: 4x Ammo ArrowV
column2: 能够抵御小规模威胁的防御设施。 特性：稳定武器 装甲：装甲 数值：240 结构：结构 数值：150 引擎：200 标准聚变 设备： 1 x 指挥掩体 武器： 1x 箭V（S） 弹药： 4x 箭V弹药

column1: The B configuration combines an MML-3 with two ER Large and two ER Medium Lasers. Running slightly hot even with two extra heat sinks, this loadout needs a skilled MechWarrior to balance the cooling properly. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: B型配置将一具MML-3与两支ER大型激光器和两支ER中型激光器结合起来。即使有两具额外散热器，这套载荷运行时仍略微过热，需要熟练的机甲战士妥善平衡冷却。 特性：易于驾驶 部署费用倍率：0.95 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: An experimental variant of the Night Gyr mounting a RAC/5 in each arm and a Streak LRM-10 launcher in each side torso. 7 tons of ammo ensures the 'Mech can deal with prolonged engagements on the battlefield. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是一款实验型Night Gyr，每只手臂安装一门RAC/5，两侧躯干各装一具Streak LRM-10发射器。7吨弹药确保机甲能够应对战场上的持久交战。 特性：战斗计算机 部署费用倍率：1.12 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: This Jihad-era field refit was based on captured Word of Blake equipment. It replaces the C3i system with a standard C3 slave and a Guardian ECM Suite. It keeps the Improved Narc Launcher. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这款圣战时代的战地改装机基于缴获的Blake之言设备。它用标准C3从属设备和Guardian ECM套件替换了C3i系统，并保留改良型Narc发射器。 特性：战斗计算机 部署费用倍率：1.04 手臂执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: Quicsell's Heavy Laser Backstabber. The QKD-QS3 has a pair of Quicsell's Large REX Lasers (King of the battlefield) to rip off enemy armor from close range, and an engine to get you there. It's not a complicated mech, but it excells at what it does. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
column2: Quicsell重型激光背刺者。QKD-QS3配备一对Quicsell大型REX激光器（战场之王），可近距离撕开敌方装甲，并配有能将你送到目标身边的引擎。这台机甲并不复杂，但非常擅长自己的职责。 特性：超伸展执行器 部署费用倍率：1.06

column1: The production version of Arc-Royal MechWorks' GHR-7X prototype, the 7P uses a Torso Mounted Cockpit, Endo Steel and a Light Fusion Engine, and mounts four Improved Jump Jets. The Type VI Bloodhound Active Probe was also retained. It carries 2 X-Pulse LL, and 3 ER ML. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: Arc-Royal机甲工厂GHR-7X原型机的量产版本。7P采用躯干驾驶舱、内骨骼钢和轻型聚变引擎，并安装四具改良跳跃喷射器，同时保留VI型猎犬主动探测器。它搭载2支X脉冲大型激光器和3支ER中型激光器。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.1

column1: The X1 was the original Roncone prototype version, carrying a similar, although upgraded, weapon loadout to the Battlemaster BLR-4L. Two ER PPC, two MML-9 launchers and a Gauss Rifle makes sure the 'Mech can engage from a distance before it is fully detected. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.29
column2: X1是最初的Roncone原型机，携带与Battlemaster BLR-4L相似但有所升级的武器配置。两支ER PPC、两具MML-9发射器和一支高斯步枪，确保机甲在完全暴露前就能从远距离交战。 特性：战斗计算机 部署费用倍率：1.29

column1: Eris has produced a limited run of JLP-NH, code-named 'Tepoztēcatl', using stealth armor systems. These Jackalopes were widely distributed, with no single force procuring more than one. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Eris限量生产了JLP-NH，代号“特波兹特卡特尔”，采用隐形装甲系统。这些Jackalope被广泛分发，没有任何单一部队采购超过一台。 特性：窄型/低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：1.05 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: Quicsell's Medium Ballistic Brawler. The VND-QS2 is a hearty mech, and comes equiped with three rotary rifles for knocking opponents down after you smash into them! Comes bundled with a full bandoleer of one ton Mech Grenades, as well as a Mech Lance for close combat. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
column2: Quicsell中型弹道近战者。VND-QS2是一台结实的机甲，装备三支旋转步枪，可在撞入敌阵后将对手击倒！随附一整条带子弹的弹药带，内含一吨机甲手雷，以及用于近战的机甲长枪。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.01

column1: The Prime configuration uses the six tons of pod space to mirror the original Snow Fox. Equipped with an ER Medium Laser in the head and each side torso, tied into a Targeting Computer. An extensive electronics suite includes an Active Probe and ECM Suite. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: Prime配置使用六吨模块空间，复刻了原始Snow Fox。头部和两侧躯干各装备一支ER中型激光器，并接入瞄准计算机。广泛的电子设备套件还包括主动探测器和ECM套件。 特性：窄型/低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：0.98

column1: An experimental loadout for the Headsman, mounting a massive Railgun in each side torso. Due to their massive size, the only other weapons that could be fitted during the 'Mech's development was two Ultra AC/2. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.43 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Headsman的实验型载荷，在两侧躯干各安装一门巨型轨道炮。由于体积巨大，在机甲开发期间唯一还能装下的其他武器只有两门Ultra AC/2。 特性：威慑 部署费用倍率：1.43 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The K config is equipped with a Rotary AC/2 and ton of ammunition in the right arm while the left arm carries a single ER Large Pulse Laser. Additional protection comes from a Laser Anti-Missile System. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: K 配置的右臂配备旋转 AC/2 和大量弹药，而左臂则携带单个 ER 大型脉冲激光器。激光反导弹系统提供额外的保护。 怪癖：窄/低调 下降成本乘数：1.01 手臂执行器限制：全方位

column1: The Orc is the first ProtoMech developed wholly by Clan Hell's Horses. The Orc reflects the unique battle tactics of the Horses. This version tries to take the best features of the Orc 2 and Orc 3. It carries three SRM tubes in its torso, and a machine gun in each arm. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: 兽人是第一个完全由地狱马氏族开发的原型机甲。兽人体现了马匹独特的战斗策略。此版本试图发挥 Orc 2 和 Orc 3 的最佳功能。它的躯干中携带三个 SRM 管，每只手臂上各有一挺机枪。 怪癖：敏捷 掉落成本乘数：0.97

column1: Defensive structure capable of repelling minor threats. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Armor: Armor Amount: 240 Structure: Structure Amount: 150 Engine: 200 Standard Fusion Equipment: Weapons: 1x Heavy PPC+CAP (P) 1x Medium Chem Laser (P) Ammunition:
column2: 能够击退轻微威胁的防御结构。 怪癖：集成探照灯 装甲：装甲数量： 240 结构：结构数量： 150 引擎： 200 标准融合 装备： 武器： 1x 重型 PPC+CAP (P) 1x 中型化学激光 (P) 弹药：

column1: Developed as an experimental testbed for a unique XXL Gyro and paired with a HAG-40, this Urbanmech is test model with which to develop new combat doctrine and test radical new inovations. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这款 Urbanmech 是作为独特 XXL 陀螺仪的实验测试台而开发的，并与 HAG-40 搭配使用，是一种测试模型，可用于开发新的战斗理论并测试全新的创新。 怪异：360° 躯干扭转 下降成本乘数： 1.07 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: Four Extended Range PPC, two in each arm, utilizes the stable weapons platform included in the chassis. The performance of the P3 variant is otherwise quite similar to the P1 with its lasers. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.4 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 四个增程 PPC，每臂两个，利用底盘中包含的稳定武器平台。 P3 变体的性能在其他方面与带有激光的 P1 非常相似。 怪癖：稳定武器 掉落成本乘数：1.4 手臂执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: A Republic era model, this version uses a 400XL fusion engine to reach a top speed of 64 km/h. It is protected by standard armor and CASE II in case the two Clan-spec Gauss Rifles explode. The Gauss Rifles are supported by four Clan-built ER Medium Lasers. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 共和国时代车型，该版本采用400XL融合发动机，最高时速可达64公里/小时。它受到标准装甲和 CASE II 的保护，以防两支氏族规格的高斯步枪爆炸。高斯步枪由四支氏族制造的 ER 中型激光器提供支持。 怪异：受保护的执行器 掉落成本乘数：1.18

column1: The T variant is a hybrid missile boat configuration featuring the powerful Artemis V guidance system for its two LRM20s. An ER Large and ER Medium Laser in each arm provide additional firepower. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: T 型是一种混合导弹艇配置，其两艘 LRM20 配备强大的 Artemis V 制导系统。每只手臂上的 ER 大型和 ER 中型激光器可提供额外的火力。 怪癖：改进的定位 - 中 下降成本乘数：1.09 手臂执行器限制：全方位

column1: The most recent variant of the Wraith, the -TR5 upgrades the design to use X-Pulse lasers, Improved Jump Jets and an Endo-Composite chassis at the cost of a smaller 330 engine core. This change even leaves room for 3 extra heat sinks, greatly improving its cooling. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 作为 Wraith 的最新变体，-TR5 升级了设计，使用 X 脉冲激光器、改进的跳跃喷气机和 Endo-Composite 底盘，但代价是更小的 330 发动机核心。这一变化甚至为 3 个额外的散热器留出了空间，从而大大改善了其冷却效果。 怪异：无处不在 降低成本乘数：1.05

column1: The -5B mounts two ER PPC and three MML-7 launchers, making it quite similar to the -5A. All the great houses use the design, like the rest of the -5 series of the Peacemaker. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - PPC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.35 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: -5B 安装了两个 ER PPC 和三个 MML-7 发射器，使其与 -5A 非常相似。所有伟大的房子都使用这种设计，就像和平缔造者 -5 系列的其他产品一样。 怪癖：改进的冷却夹克 - PPC 下降成本乘数：1.35 手臂执行器限制：左下，右下

column1: What happens when an Industrial Mech Pilot turns into a Gladiator on the outskirts of the Periphery? With extra spikes, a Wrecking Ball and industrial Chainsaw it has everything to give someone a bad time. And lets not forget the Redneck Pilot's favorite, the Boomstick! Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: 当工业机甲飞行员在外围的郊区变成角斗士时会发生什么？配有额外的尖刺、破坏球和工业电锯，它拥有一切让某人度过难关的一切。别忘了乡巴佬飞行员最喜欢的 Boomstick！ 怪异：坚固 掉落成本乘数：1.17

column1: The Night Bastion B configuration is focused around a massive Railgun in the right torso, combined with a strange mix of other weapons: a LBX AC/5 in the right arm, a Silver Bullet Gauss in the left, and a Heavy PPC and ER Large Laser in the left torso. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Gauss Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.29
column2: 夜间堡垒 B 配置集中在右躯干的巨型轨道炮上，并与其他武器的奇怪组合相结合：右臂有 LBX AC/5，左臂有银弹高斯，左躯干有重型 PPC 和 ER 大型激光。 怪癖：精确武器 -高斯 下降成本乘数：1.29

column1: Defensive structure capable of repelling minor threats. Quirk: Stable Weapons Armor: Armor Amount: 240 Structure: Structure Amount: 150 Engine: 200 Standard Fusion Equipment: 1 x Command Bunker Weapons: 1x 'Gauss' Rifle QS Ammunition: 2x Ammo AC/2
column2: 能够击退轻微威胁的防御结构。 怪癖：稳定武器 装甲： 装甲数量： 240 结构： 结构数量： 150 引擎： 200标准融合 装备： 1 x 指挥碉堡 武器： 1x 高斯步枪 QS 弹药： 2x 弹药 AC/2

column1: A simple modification of the R4L model, the 3065 R4O model of the Huron Warrior carries double heat sinks, enabling it to drop one heat sink and carry an additional ton of ammunition for the Gauss Rifle. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 休伦战士的 3065 R4O 型号是 R4L 型号的简单修改，配备双散热器，使其能够放下一个散热器并为高斯步枪携带一吨额外的弹药。 怪癖：改进的传感器 掉落成本乘数： 1.04 手臂执行器限制：左下

column1: This version, introduced in 3077, is based on the 11-C as well but uses an experimental C3 Boosted Master computer to cut through the ECM commonly found on Jihad-era battlefields. It carries a Streak SRM-4, Gauss Rifle, and an ER Medium Laser in each arm. Quirk: Battle Computer B2000 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: 这个版本于 3077 年推出，同样基于 11-C，但使用实验性 C3 Boosted Master 计算机来突破圣战时代战场上常见的 ECM。它的每只手臂上都携带一把 Streak SRM-4、高斯步枪和 ER 中型激光器。 怪癖：战斗计算机 B2000 掉落成本乘数：1.16

column1: Defensive structure capable of repelling minor threats. Quirk: Stable Weapons Armor: Armor Amount: 200 Structure: Structure Amount: 150 Engine: 200 Standard Fusion Equipment: 1 x Command Bunker Weapons: 3x SRM 10 QS Ammunition: 3x Ammo SRM Inferno
column2: 能够击退轻微威胁的防御结构。 怪癖：稳定武器 装甲： 装甲数量： 200 结构： 结构数量： 150 引擎： 200标准融合 装备： 1 x Command Bunker 武器： 3x SRM 10 QS 弹药： 3x Ammo SRM Inferno

column1: The Rikki Tikki Tavi 2 combines two ER PPC, an Ultra AC/10, two ER Large Lasers and two Medium Pulse Lasers into quite a dangerous combination of weapons. The only flaw the design has could be the heat generation, but most Clan MechWarriors are used to running hot. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24
column2: Rikki Tikki Tavi 2 将两个 ER PPC、一个 Ultra AC/10、两个 ER 大型激光器和两个中脉冲激光器组合成一个相当危险的武器组合。该设计唯一的缺陷可能是发热，但大多数氏族机甲战士都习惯于过热。 怪癖：分散注意力 掉落成本乘数：1.24

column1: Defensive structure capable of repelling minor threats. Quirk: Stable Weapons Armor: Armor Amount: 240 Structure: Structure Amount: 150 Engine: 200 Standard Fusion Equipment: 1 x Command Bunker Weapons: 2x Rotary AC/2 (C) Ammunition: 1x Ammo RAC/2
column2: 能够击退轻微威胁的防御结构。 怪癖：稳定武器 装甲： 装甲数量： 240 结构： 结构数量： 150 引擎： 200标准融合 装备： 1 x 指挥掩体 武器： 2x 旋转式 AC/2 (C) 弹药： 1x 弹药 RAC/2

column1: A Taurian Concordat version of the Royal Marauder that swaps the standard autocannon for an LB 5-X. The standard medium lasers in both arms are replaced with the corresponding ER version. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 皇家掠夺者的金牛协约版本，将标准自动加农炮替换为 LB 5-X。两个手臂中的标准中型激光器均替换为相应的 ER 版本。 怪癖：窄/薄型 下降成本乘数：1.11 手臂执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: Fortress installation safeguarding the surrounding area. Quirk: Stable Weapons Armor: Armor Amount: 480 Structure: Structure Amount: 250 Engine: 400 Standard Fusion Equipment: 1 x Command Bunker Weapons: 1x LBX L. Laser QS 1x LBX PPC QS Ammunition:
column2: 保护周围区域的堡垒装置。 怪癖：稳定武器 装甲： 装甲数量： 480 结构： 结构数量： 250 引擎： 400标准融合 装备： 1 x 指挥碉堡 武器： 1x LBX L. Laser QS 1x LBX PPC QS 弹药：

column1: The personal BattleMech of Rim Worlds Army General Viktoria Benbaoudaoud. Based on the Rampage 5G, the 4G "Benbaoudaoud" was a minor custom refit, most notably removing the MASC for additional missile tubes. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 环世界陆军将军维多利亚·本巴乌达的个人战机。 4G“Benbaoudaoud”以 Rampage 5G 为基础，进行了一次小型定制改装，最引人注目的是移除了 MASC 以增加额外的导弹发射管。 怪异：坚固 降低成本乘数： 1.17 手臂执行器限制：左下

column1: A modified version of the -4D, the -5D uses Clan tech to improve its performance by upgrading to Clan Double Heat Sinks, replacing all weapons with their Clan counter-parts and adding a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: -5D 是 -4D 的修改版本，它使用氏族技术通过升级到氏族双散热器、用氏族对应部件替换所有武器并添加 C3 从属单位来提高其性能。 怪癖：稳定 掉落成本乘数： 1.11 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: Used by Veronica Monteiro-Montoya of Lamenkov's Liability, this variant replaces the Heavy PPC with an extended range model, C3 slave, Guardian ECM Suite, and an extra half ton of armor. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Right Lower, Left Upper
column2: 由拉缅科夫责任队的维罗妮卡·蒙泰罗-蒙托亚使用，该变体用扩展射程模型、C3从机、守护者 ECM 套件和额外的半吨装甲取代了重型 PPC。 怪癖：扩展躯干扭曲 掉落成本乘数： 1.13 手臂执行器限制：右下、左上

column1: Reinforced structure to defend an area. Quirk: Stable Weapons Armor: Armor Amount: 400 Structure: Structure Amount: 200 Engine: 300 Standard Fusion Equipment: 1 x Command Bunker Weapons: 4x Double AC/2 QS Ammunition: 4x Ammo AC/2 1x Ammo AC/2 QS
column2: 防御区域的强化结构。 怪癖：稳定武器 装甲： 装甲数量： 400 结构：结构数量： 200 引擎： 300 标准融合 装备： 1 x 指挥碉堡 武器： 4x 双联 AC/2 QS 弹药： 4x 弹药 AC/2 1x 弹药 AC/2 QS

column1: An strange mix of short and very long range weapons, the -018 brings both two MMS-40 launchers and a combination of a HAG and a Hyper Laser. With the role of the variant so unclear, it never saw much use. Quirk: Tacticon TC7000 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.45 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: -018 是短程和超远程武器的奇怪组合，它配备了两个 MMS-40 发射器以及 HAG 和超级激光的组合。由于该变体的作用如此不清楚，因此从未见过太多用途。 怪异：Tacticon TC7000 下降成本乘数：1.45 手臂执行器限制：右上

column1: Astoundingly little was broken as they repaired this Uziel, even the XL is intact! Just dont look at these missile launcher they jury rigged into that poor little pumpkin... Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Missile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 令人惊讶的是，他们修复这个 Uziel 时几乎没有损坏，甚至 XL 也完好无损！别看他们临时在那个可怜的小南瓜上装了这些导弹发射器... 怪癖：改进的冷却夹克 - 导弹 下降成本乘数：1.04 手臂执行器限制：左下，右下

column1: With a pair of Enhanced ERPPCs and a pair of Flechette 10s, the Emperor 7M has a long range punch and, unlike many other variants, lacks the fragility and cost of an XL engine. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - PPC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 拥有一对增强型 ERPPC 和一对 Flechette 10，Emperor 7M 具有远程攻击力，并且与许多其他变体不同，缺乏 XL 发动机的脆弱性和成本。 怪癖：改进的冷却护套 - PPC 下降成本乘数：1.22 手臂执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: Quicsell's Assault PPC Support. The BNC-QS4 fires more PPC bolts than any mech you've ever seen. With a trio of our exclusive LBX PPCs, you can saturate the horizon with PPC fire, ensuring that your enemies know that you're there, but can't actually do anything about it. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: Quicsell 的突击 PPC 支持。 BNC-QS4 发射的 PPC 螺栓比您见过的任何机甲都要多。借助三台我们独有的 LBX PPC，您可以用 PPC 火力覆盖地平线，确保敌人知道您在那里，但实际上无能为力。 怪异：坚固 掉落成本乘数：1.15

column1: The Warhawk's L configuration uses a combination of two ER PPC, two ER Flamer and an ATM 12, where both the PPC are equipped with a capacitor. The 'Mech also mounts a supercharger and a Watchdog CEWS. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Warhawk 的 L 配置使用两个 ER PPC、两个 ER Flamer 和一个 ATM 12 的组合，其中两个 PPC 都配备了电容器。 'Mech 还安装了增压器和看门狗 CEWS。 怪异：改进的定位 - 长 下降成本乘数：1.16 手臂执行器限制：全方位

column1: This variant is based on the first Combine variant. It trades the heavy large laser and targeting computer for an experimental BattleMech taser, but leaves the rest of the Combine version's weaponry intact Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 该变体基于第一个组合变体。它将重型大型激光和瞄准计算机换成了实验性的 BattleMech 泰瑟枪，但保留了联合版本武器的其余部分完好无损 怪异：稳定武器 掉落成本乘数：1.06 手臂执行器限位：右下

column1: Introduced by the Raven Alliance for pilots on the edge of burnout, this Cecerops variant replaces the standard engine with a Magnetic Clamp system. Armed with an AP Gauss Rifle this Cecerops is designed to support OmniMechs and possibly provide them with more protection. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: 这款 Cecerops 变体由乌鸦联盟为处于倦怠边缘的飞行员推出，它用磁力夹紧系统取代了标准发动机。这款 Cecerops 配备 AP 高斯步枪，旨在支持 OmniMech，并可能为它们提供更多保护。 怪癖：灵活 掉落成本乘数：0.96

column1: As Ultra Autocannons became harder to source, the UAC-BG-414 variant was born. It replaces two of the UAC/5s with a LBX AC/10 and a Large Laser. Two additional heat sinks were also added. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 随着超级自动炮的采购变得越来越困难，UAC-BG-414 变种诞生了。它用 LBX AC/10 和大型激光器取代了两个 UAC/5。还添加了两个额外的散热器。 怪癖：精确武器 - AC 下降成本乘数：1.11 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: The Design that would Later become the Fafnir, this prototype carries two massive StarLeague Era Railguns, but suffers from many typical Superheavy Design issues, such as bad cooling and mobility. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.42 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 该设计后来成为法夫纳，该原型携带两门大型星际联盟时代轨道炮，但存在许多典型的超重型设计问题，例如冷却不良和机动性差。 怪癖：分散注意力 降低成本乘数： 1.42 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: This modified Elemental version was created by Clan Jade Falcon engineers in 3069 and replaces SRM ammunition with Fire-Resistant Armor. It carries a one-shot SRM-2 and an AP Gauss Rifle. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 这个修改后的元素版本是由玉隼氏族工程师于 3069 年创建的，并用防火装甲取代了 SRM 弹药。它携带一把单发 SRM-2 和一把 AP 高斯步枪。 怪癖：标准零件 掉落成本乘数：0.93 可以安装 Omni 单位，可以近战，可以群。

column1: Forming the foundation of the new Zosma factory, the Blood Reaper 3 was upgraded with advanced targeting systems for all weapons while the ATMs were swapped for SRMs and coolant pods Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 作为新 Zosma 工厂的基础，Blood Reaper 3 进行了升级，配备了适用于所有武器的先进瞄准系统，而 ATM 则更换为 SRM 和冷却剂吊舱 怪异：超扩展执行器 降低成本乘数： 1.16 手臂执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: Defensive structure capable of repelling minor threats. Quirk: Stable Weapons Armor: Armor Amount: 240 Structure: Structure Amount: 150 Engine: 200 Standard Fusion Equipment: 1 x Command Bunker Weapons: 3x MRM10 Streak Ammunition: 5x Ammo Streak MRM
column2: 能够击退轻微威胁的防御结构。 怪癖：稳定武器 装甲： 装甲数量： 240 结构： 结构数量： 150 引擎： 200标准融合 装备： 1 x 命令碉堡 武器： 3x MRM10 条纹 弹药： 5x 弹药条纹 MRM

column1: This configuration carries two Improved Heavy Large Lasers and two LRM-10 launchers. For anti-infantry work, a Micro Pulse Laser is included. An engine Supercharger allows it to move at 100 km/h in brief bursts. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 该配置携带两个改进型重型大型激光器和两个 LRM-10 发射器。对于反步兵工作，还包括微脉冲激光器。引擎增压器使其能够以 100 公里/小时的速度短暂移动。 怪异：高级光学 跌落成本乘数：1.01 手臂执行器限制：全方位

column1: The Hel E combines the fearsome alpha strike potential of a Rotary AC/5 with several extended range lasers and two Streak SRM launchers. All together the loadout is a true menace at medium to close range battles. Quirk: Experimental TC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Hel E 将 Rotary AC/5 的可怕阿尔法打击潜力与多个增程激光器和两个 Streak SRM 发射器结合在一起。总而言之，负载对于中近距离战斗来说是一个真正的威胁。 怪癖：实验TC 掉落成本乘数：1.1 手臂执行器限制：全方位

column1: The Locust-2M is loosely based on the 1Vb used by the Star League's Royal brigades. The 2M exchanges the laser compliment of the 1Vb for an Ion Stream Projector and a pair of Small Lasers. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Locust-2M 大致以星际联盟皇家旅使用的 1Vb 为基础。 2M 将 1Vb 的激光补充替换为离子流投影仪和一对小型激光器。 怪癖：窄/低调 下降成本乘数：1.03 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: A Jihad-era repair yard refit of the venerable Stinger unveiled in 3071, the 3P was built on an Endo Steel chassis and carried, as its only weapon, either a Fusigon Mini or a Lord's Light 3 Light PPC capable of striking a target at up to five hundred and forty meters. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: 3P 是圣战时代修理厂对 3071 年推出的古老 Stinger 进行的改装，采用 Endo Steel 底盘制造，唯一的武器是 Fusigon Mini 或 Lord's Light 3 Light PPC，能够打击最远 540 米的目标。 怪癖：无处不在 下降成本乘数：0.97

column1: This configuration carries a Nova CEWS and Light TAG. Each arm carries three Improved Heavy Small Lasers, while each side torso carries an iATM 12 with two tons of ammunition. Seventeen double heat sinks keep it cool. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 该配置带有 Nova CEWS 和 Light TAG。每只手臂携带三把改进型重型小型激光器，而每侧躯干则携带一把装有两吨弹药的 iATM 12。十七个双散热器使其保持凉爽。 怪异：Multi Trac 下降成本乘数：1.08 手臂执行器限制：Omni

column1: This version was apparently created by the Word of Blake, as it removes the Beagle Probe and a Medium Laser from the PHX-HK1R and replaces that equipment with an Improved C3 Computer. The Snub-Nose PPC remains and the two remaining lasers are extended-range models. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 这个版本显然是由 Blake 的话语创建的，因为它从 PHX-HK1R 中删除了 Beagle 探针和中型激光器，并用改进的 C3 计算机取代了该设备。 Snub-Nose PPC 保留下来，剩下的两个激光器是增程型号。 怪癖：陆地航空机甲 掉落成本乘数：1.04

column1: Still Using the powerfull Void Signature System was this Raptor II designed during early RISC Trials to bring a more advanced Warfare Suite and Tactical Munitions to the field Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Missile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这款 Raptor II 在早期 RISC 试验中仍然使用强大的虚空签名系统，旨在为战场带来更先进的作战套件和战术弹药 怪癖：改进的冷却夹克 - 导弹 下降成本乘数： 1.09 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: The sales model of the Mad Cat MK II lacks many important Clan upgrades, being equipped with basic Free Inner Sphere technology and downgraded Electronics is it still a capable foe. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Mad Cat MK II 的销售模式缺乏许多重要的氏族升级，配备了基本的免费内球技术和降级的电子设备，它仍然是一个强大的敌人。 怪癖：改进的定位 - 中 下降成本乘数： 1.18 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: The Shinigami, 'Death Spirit', is a Kurita Prototype using stolen and reverse engineered Stealth Systems, striking from the shadows while being just as respectable a foe at shorter ranges. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 死神“死亡之魂”是栗田原型机，使用被盗和逆向工程的隐形系统，从阴影中攻击，同时在较短距离内也是一个值得尊敬的敌人。 怪癖：延长躯干扭曲 掉落成本乘数： 1.21 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1:
Chassis: Manx Variant: 965

Weapons profile: 6 x Rotary Autocannon 5.

Optimal engagement range: 260 - 300 meters.

Combat Profile: Medium distance, staggered volleys for knockdowns. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.38 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2:
底盘：马恩岛型号：965

武器配置：6 x 旋转自动加农炮 5。

最佳交战范围：260 - 300 米。

战斗配置：中等距离，交错齐射进行击倒。 怪癖：精确武器 - AC 下降成本乘数：1.38 手臂执行器限制：右下

column1: The T configuration carries an ER PPC with a PPC Capacitor in each arm. An extra double heat sink is in the left and right torso, but to handle heavy heat loads the right torso carries a triple Coolant Pod. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: T 配置带有一个 ER PPC，每个臂上都有一个 PPC 电容器。左右躯干上有一个额外的双散热器，但为了处理重热负荷，右躯干带有一个三重冷却剂舱。 怪癖：窄/低调 下降成本乘数：1.01 手臂执行器限制：全方位

column1: The well-known Archer is the epitome of the "missile boat" concept. It is commonly found hurling deadly swarms of LRMs at targets from behind the safety of a hill. It's not too shabby in closer-range fights, either. Its only real weakness is terrible heat management. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 众所周知的“弓箭手”号就是“导弹艇”概念的缩影。人们通常会发现它从安全的山后向目标投掷致命的远程导弹群。在近距离战斗中也不算太糟糕。它唯一真正的弱点是糟糕的热量管理。 怪癖：命令机甲 掉落成本乘数：1.08

column1: Quicsell's Medium Missile Backstabber. The VND-QS3 comes equiped with two Thunderbolt 10 missile lauchers carrying our exclusive Deadfire Thunderbolt ammo. With our patented 'Speedy Leg Acutator Replacement' and a large engine, you can run around the battlefield with style. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
column2: Quicsell的中型导弹背刺者。VND-QS3装备两具雷霆10导弹发射器，装填我们独家的死火雷霆弹药。凭借专利“迅捷腿部作动器替换件”和大型引擎，你可以潇洒地在战场上奔走。 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.01

column1: A Retro Tech upgrade to the aging Catapult design, remodelled to employ 2 MARS Rocket Artillery Systems, Partial Wings and a uncanny ability to redeploy its mighty but limited payload as required. Quirk: Stubble Wings Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 对老旧的弹射设计进行复古科技升级，改装为使用2套MARS火箭炮系统、部分翼，并具备按需重新部署其强大但有限载荷的非凡能力。 特性：短翼 部署成本倍率：1.07 手臂作动器限制：左上臂，右上臂

column1: Well, it is a Longbow, for the most parts just a pretty normal looking one too, and if it werent for that engine and these weird Thunderbolt '30' id say they just stole it somewhere...... Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 嗯，它就是长弓，大体上看起来也很普通；要不是那台引擎和这些奇怪的雷霆“30”，我会说他们肯定是从什么地方偷来的…… 特性：集成探照灯 部署成本倍率：1.13 手臂作动器限制：左上臂，右上臂

column1: This version of the Pack Hunter II was introduced during in 3093.[9] The B-Pods and ER medium lasers have been removed, leaving it with only the single ER PPC, but in place of secondary weapons, each arm and leg has been equipped with an actuator enhancement system. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 这个猎群者II型号于3093年间列装。[9] B型吊舱和ER中型激光器被拆除，只剩一门ER PPC；作为替代，每条手臂和腿都安装了作动器增强系统。 特性：武器稳定 部署成本倍率：1.05

column1: The X4 is the only variant to only mount a single AAC/20, in the left arm. The right arm houses a Gauss rifle instead, while the right torso mounts a Railgun and the left torso an ER PPC. Quirk: Battle Computer SLDF-X Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.43 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: X4是唯一仅在左臂安装一门AAC/20的型号。右臂装有高斯步枪，右侧躯干安装轨道炮，左侧躯干安装ER PPC。 特性：SLDF-X战斗计算机 部署成本倍率：1.43 手臂作动器限制：左上臂，右上臂

column1: The 7A was designed by Blue Short Weapons, as opposed to the other variants all designed by General Motors. Created solely within the Lyran Alliance during the Jihad, the 7A shortened the range of engagement of the 6Y and turned it into a deadly close range brawler. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 7A由蓝短武器公司设计，其他型号则全部由通用汽车设计。它是在圣战期间仅于莱拉联盟境内制造的，缩短了6Y的交战距离，将其变成致命的近距离斗士。 特性：武器稳定 部署成本倍率：1.09

column1: Quicsell's Light Ballistic Support. The VLK-QS4 is armed with a light rotary rifle for enemies that decide to get close, but the main purpose of the mech is the impressive array of detection and E-war gear that can support other Quicsell units on the field! Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: Quicsell的轻型弹道支援机。VLK-QS4装备轻型旋转步枪，用于应对胆敢靠近的敌人；但这台机甲的主要用途，是凭借其令人印象深刻的探测与电子战装备，为战场上的其他Quicsell单位提供支援！ 特性：通信增强 部署成本倍率：0.97

Two tons of CASE protected ammunition is carried to feed the hungry weapon; when this is depleted the left torso mounted ER medium laser is the 'Mech's only fallback weapon. Ferro Spall Shield technology and a Heavy Cockpit attempt to give the design more staying power. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1

column1: Cyclops 11-Zs use their imposing presence and unique communications equipment to control the battlefield. Carrying the same Battle Computer as the C10, is this variant enhanced with several LosTech including a C3 Master Computer, further increasing the lances power. Quirk: Tacticon TC7000 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: 独眼巨人11-Z利用其压迫性的存在感和独特的通信设备来控制战场。该型号配备与C10相同的战斗计算机，并以包括C3主计算机在内的多项失落科技进行强化，进一步提升小队战力。 特性：Tacticon TC7000 部署成本倍率：1.16

column1: Manufactured on Emris IV by StarCorps Industries, the Carronade was designed to fill roles normally taken by two separate 'Mechs within the same lance - punching holes in the armor of enemy units, and then exploiting those holes with waves of small munitions. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Gauss Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 卡隆纳德由星际军团工业公司在埃姆里斯IV制造，旨在让一支小队中的一台机甲承担通常由两台机甲分担的职责——先在敌方单位装甲上打穿缺口，再用成群的小型弹药加以利用。 特性：精准武器—高斯 部署成本倍率：1.1

column1: The JagerMech H is a Marian Hegemony retrofit designed as a multipurpose command mech. Able to support at range while still crippling any over eager headhunting unit with a barrage of rockets. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 猎豹H是玛丽安霸权改装的多用途指挥机甲。它既能在远距离提供支援，也能用火箭弹齐射重创那些过于热衷猎杀头部的单位。 特性：防空瞄准 部署成本倍率：1.09 手臂作动器限制：左上臂，右上臂

column1: Quicsell's Heavy PPC Support. The GHR-QS4 comes with a bevy of Quicsell exclusives. Our infamous EWS combined with Exclusive Stealth X means your enemies won't know what to think! Also comes with enough PPC fire to ensure that anything you point your guns at will get tagged! Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: Quicsell的重型PPC支援机。GHR-QS4配备大量Quicsell独家装备。我们臭名昭著的EWS结合独家隐形X，让敌人无从判断！它还拥有充足的PPC火力，确保你瞄准的任何目标都会被标记！ 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.08

column1: The TT loadout mounts a large Rotary AC/5 in the right arm and two ER Medium Pulse Lasers in the left arm, five jump jets spread throughout the side torsos and a partial wing system to even further enhance its jump capacity. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: TT配置在右臂安装一门大型旋转AC/5，在左臂安装两门ER中型脉冲激光器；五具跳跃喷射器分布于两侧躯干，并配备部分翼系统以进一步增强跳跃能力。 特性：稳定 部署成本倍率：1.06 手臂作动器限制：全向

column1: The S3 Atlas is a rearmament of the S2 version introduced in 3062. The Heavy Gauss Rifle is reduced to a standard model Gauss Rifle with sixteen shots while each arm contains a PPC and a Small Laser. An additional small laser is mounted in the head. For extra defense, an AMS is installed on the left arm. The Artemis IV-enhanced LRM-15 and Guardian ECM Suite of the S2 model remain.
column2: S3阿特拉斯是3062年推出的S2型号的重新武装版本。重型高斯步枪被削减为标准高斯步枪，携带16发弹药；每条手臂各装有一门PPC和一门小型激光器，头部另装一门小型激光器。为加强防御，左臂安装了AMS。S2型号的Artemis IV增强型LRM-15和Guardian ECM套件得以保留。

column1: The H configuration uses a pair of heavy medium lasers and a pair of heavy small lasers. Another pair of medium pulse lasers provide more accurate fire, while three additional double heat sinks keep the 'Mech cool. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: H配置使用两门重型中型激光器和两门重型小型激光器。另有两门中型脉冲激光器提供更精准的火力，三具额外的双倍散热器则让机甲保持凉爽。 特性：传感器增强 部署成本倍率：0.99 手臂作动器限制：全向

column1: The Osteon-D carries four Large Pulse Lasers. Unlike the Osteon-C this version lacks jump jets and the Targeting Computer. Instead it carries nineteen double heat sinks which allow it to stay in the fight for a long time. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 奥斯顿-D携带四门大型脉冲激光器。与奥斯顿-C不同，该版本没有跳跃喷射器和瞄准计算机，转而携带十九具双倍散热器，使其能够长时间留在战斗中。 特性：多重追踪 部署成本倍率：1.18 手臂作动器限制：全向

column1: The Sun Cobra 2 carries two ER PPCs tied into the Targeting Computer. A larger XL engine allows it to reach a top speed of 96 km/h. It also carries an additional three and a half tons of armor. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 太阳眼镜蛇2携带两门接入瞄准计算机的ER PPC。更大的XL引擎使其最高速度达到96公里/小时，并额外携带三吨半装甲。 特性：作动器防护 部署成本倍率：1.11 手臂作动器限制：左下臂，右下臂

column1: The Sphinx 3 is the reverse of the Sphinx 2. It removes the ER Large Lasers of the original, but retains the ER Medium Lasers. It adds a Targeting Computer and MASC to quickly enter close range combat. An ECM Suite disrupts enemy communications and targeting systems. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: 斯芬克斯3与斯芬克斯2正好相反。它移除了原版的ER大型激光器，但保留ER中型激光器；增加瞄准计算机和MASC，以便迅速投入近距离战斗。ECM套件会扰乱敌方通信与瞄准系统。 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：1.17

column1: Ah, the Catapult P. At first it looks like a perfectly fine C1, but they removed almost all tracking systems and added stubble wings all over it, I have no idea what they wanted to achieve with that. Quirk: Stubble Wings Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 啊，弹射P。乍看之下它像一台完好的C1，但他们几乎拆掉了所有追踪系统，还在机身各处加装短翼，我完全不知道他们想达到什么目的。 特性：短翼 部署成本倍率：1.09 手臂作动器限制：左上臂，右上臂

column1:
You think for a long moment before responding, "Get the work done, Darius.  We have the funds, and what are the odds of another misjump like that happening again anyways?"

Darius smiles, "Hopefully very slim, Commander."

Later that day, you run into Dairus in one of the corridors, "Commander, The work has commenced and should be done soon.  The final bill came in at ¢3766055.
column2:
你思索了很久才回答：“把工作完成，达里乌斯。我们有资金，再说那种跳跃失误还会再次发生的概率能有多大？”

达里乌斯笑道：“希望非常低，指挥官。”

当天晚些时候，你在一条走廊遇到达伊鲁斯：“指挥官，工作已经开始，应该很快就能完成。最终账单是¢3766055。”

column1: The Tocho A configuration is armed with an iATM-3 missile launcher and an ER Medium Pulse Laser, providing a balanced mix of missile and energy weaponry for versatile combat roles. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: 东扈A配置装备一具iATM-3导弹发射器和一门ER中型脉冲激光器，为多用途战斗提供均衡的导弹与能量武器组合。 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：0.98 经Aries Games and Miniatures许可使用。

column1: This variant removes some armor and the Fusillade. Instead the Hobgoblin 2 carries three more AP Gauss Rifles, bringing the total to four. Each has five reloads, which is enough to devastate conventional infantry forces, but not enough to turn the tide of a battle. Quirk: Improved Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 该型号削减了部分装甲和齐射武器。作为替代，妖怪2携带三支额外的AP高斯步枪，总数达到四支。每支备有五次装填，足以摧毁常规步兵部队，却不足以扭转战局。 特性：瞄准增强 部署成本倍率：0.99

column1: Like the -7C this Lyran Commonwealth version has an ER PPC and Medium X-Pulse Laser in each arm. The torso cannon is a Gauss rifle protected by CASE II. Two tons of Gauss rifle ammo are carried. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 与-7C一样，这款莱拉联邦版本的每条手臂都装有一门ER PPC和一门中型X脉冲激光器。躯干火炮是一门由CASE II保护的高斯步枪，携带两吨高斯步枪弹药。 特性：窄型/低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：1.11 手臂作动器限制：左下臂，右下臂

column1: This rather unique Bushwacker seems to have been made to order by a rather obsessive RISC Engineer, sporting not only upgrades to its Electronics and Actuators, but firepower on par with far Heavier Mech's. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这台独特的灌木狼似乎是由一名极度执着的RISC工程师定制的，不仅升级了电子设备和作动器，火力也足以媲美更重型的机甲。 特性：灵巧 部署成本倍率：1.16 手臂作动器限制：左下臂，右下臂

column1: Developed during the Draconis Combine's push into the Federated Suns during the 3140s. This variant swaps the Thunderbolt launchers for Silver Bullet Gauss Rifles and are excellent anti-aerospace platforms. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是在3140年代龙马联盟进军联邦太阳系期间开发的型号。该版本用银弹高斯步枪替换雷霆导弹发射器，是出色的反空天平台。 特性：稳定 部署成本倍率：1.16 手臂作动器限制：左上臂，右上臂

column1: Quicsell's Heavy Missile Support. The BL-QS4 is our close range support missile carrier. With enough armor to get close to the enemy, and our innovative 'Streak' SRMs, you can launch a wide variety of specialty missiles at the enemy and be certain that you'll never miss. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: Quicsell的重型导弹支援机。BL-QS4是我们的近距离支援导弹载具。凭借足够的装甲接近敌人，再配合创新的“Streak”SRM，你可以向敌人发射多种特制导弹，并确信绝不会落空。 特性：指挥机甲 部署成本倍率：1.09

column1: The Thunderstone TDS-1E retains the LRM-20 and SRM-6 launchers of the 1B, but replaces the lasers with four ER Flamers and two TSEMP cannons, making the variant focus more on disabling the enemy than raw damage. However, two Light PPC are used to provide some actual damage. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.42
column2: 雷石TDS-1E保留1B的LRM-20和SRM-6发射器，但用四具ER火焰喷射器和两门TSEMP炮替换激光器，使该型号更专注于瘫痪敌人而非造成直接伤害。不过，它使用两门轻型PPC来提供实际杀伤力。 特性：多重追踪 部署成本倍率：1.42

column1: Used by the Word of Blake's Protectorate Militia in 3078, this Archer variant carried a pair of ER Large Lasers and Artemis IV-enhanced LRM-15 launchers, with a maximum speed of 58 km/h. For protection, the 9W used an experimental Angel ECM Suite and Void Signature System. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 这款弓箭手型号于3078年由布莱克之言保护国民兵使用，携带两门ER大型激光器和Artemis IV增强型LRM-15发射器，最高速度为58公里/小时。为加强防护，9W采用实验型天使ECM套件和虚空特征系统。 特性：指挥机甲 部署成本倍率：1.1

column1: Although based on the BL-7-KNT, the BL-16-KNT is meant to fight primarily at long range. It features a light Gauss rifle and twin ER PPCs and is powered by an XL fusion engine. Four extended range medium lasers and six additional double heat sinks round out its firepower. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
column2: 虽然以BL-7-KNT为基础，BL-16-KNT主要用于远程作战。它配备轻型高斯步枪和两门ER PPC，由一台XL融合引擎驱动。四门扩展射程中型激光器和六具额外双倍散热器完善了其火力。 特性：指挥机甲 部署成本倍率：1.11

column1: A modernization of the Whitworth line, the 2H has two MRM-10 launchers with attached Apollo FCS and two ER Medium Laser as the main armaments. A standard Medium Laser is kept as backup for emergency defense. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 作为惠特沃斯系列的现代化型号，2H以两具配备阿波罗火控系统的MRM-10发射器和两门ER中型激光器为主要武装。它保留一门标准中型激光器，作为紧急防御时的备用武器。 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.02 手臂作动器限制：左下臂，右下臂

It was armed with a RAC/2, two ER medium lasers, had a Beagle active probe, and an additional half-ton of armor. The LGN-2X prototype was chosen for production instead. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
column2: 这是3068年制造的原型机，最初设计为侦察机甲。它装备一门RAC/2、两门ER中型激光器、猎犬主动探测器，并额外配备半吨装甲。最终选定LGN-2X原型机投入生产。 特性：瞄准增强—中型 部署成本倍率：1.06

column1: Approximately twice as expensive as the original, the Hellfire 2 uses an 300-rated XL Engine to increase the 'Mech's speed to 86 km/h. In place of the LRMs are a pair of ATM 6s. The heavy smalls are replaced with a single ER Small Laser and an additional double heat sink. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: Hellfire 2的价格约为原版两倍，使用一台300级XL引擎将机甲速度提升至86公里/小时。它以两具ATM 6替代LRM，并将重型小型激光器换成一门ER小型激光器和一具额外双倍散热器。 特性：易于驾驶 部署成本倍率：1.14

column1: The Volkh's main armament are its four ER Medium Lasers, these are backed up by a single SRM-4 launcher. The lasers are also tied into an advanced Targeting Computer, providing more effective fire. At point-blank ranges it can cause crippling damage with its two Lances. Quirk: Reinforced Legs Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 沃尔克的主要武装是四门ER中型激光器，另有一具SRM-4发射器辅助。激光器还接入先进瞄准计算机，提供更有效的火力。在近距离，它的两把长枪能够造成毁灭性伤害。 特性：强化腿部 部署成本倍率：1.05

column1: The Mech's principal armament is a pair of arm-mounted Extended Range Large Lasers. These weapons give the 'Mech its ranged combat ability. For intermediate ranges, the 'Mech can turn to its ten Extended Range Medium Lasers, all of which are mounted in its side torsos. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: 这台机甲的主要武器是一对安装于手臂的扩展射程大型激光器，赋予它远程作战能力。在中距离，它可以使用十门扩展射程中型激光器，全部安装在两侧躯干。 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：1.17

column1: Based on the D configuration, this version mounts an ER PPC and Ultra AC/20, both of which are tied into a Targeting Computer. It also has five jump jets. The Small Lasers of the D configuration are replaced by a Nova CEWS. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 该型号基于D配置，安装一门接入瞄准计算机的ER PPC和一门超重型AC/20，并配备五具跳跃喷射器。D配置的小型激光器被Nova CEWS替换。 特性：多重追踪 部署成本倍率：1.08 手臂作动器限制：全向

column1: In their attempts to industrialize their worlds toward mech production the Marian Hegemony came up with this half way point of the tried and true stock catapult and the Combines lethal K2. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 玛丽安霸权试图将各世界工业化、推进机甲生产，于是设计出这款介于久经考验的标准弹射和结合体致命K2之间的过渡型号。 特性：精准武器—导弹 部署成本倍率：1.07 手臂作动器限制：左上臂，右上臂

column1: Quicsell's Assault Laser Sniper. The BNC-QS1 is our flagship sniper. It is a pure, destructive examplar of the power available in Quicsell Heavy Lasers. Unleash a wave of boiling death at anything within spotting distance. Comes with enough ammunition for an extended engagement. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: Quicsell的突击激光狙击机。BNC-QS1是我们的旗舰狙击机，是Quicsell重型激光器可用威力的纯粹、毁灭性典范。向任何侦察范围内的目标释放沸腾死亡之潮，并配备足够弹药以应对持久战。 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.15

column1: Based on the NDA-2KO, this Jihad-era variant adds a C3 slave unit in place of the rear-firing right torso laser. This model proved to be so popular that after the Jihad ended it went into production at the factory. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 该圣战时代型号基于NDA-2KO，将后向右侧躯干激光器替换为C3从属单元。事实证明这个型号极受欢迎，圣战结束后便在工厂投入生产。 特性：近战作动器 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂作动器限制：左下臂

column1: Clan Ice Hellion, always prolific users of fast light 'Mechs, copied the original redesign of the Incubus, but decided to create their own variant. This fifth version mounts an ATM 6 with two tons of ammunition, two ER Medium Lasers, and four Light Machine Guns. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: Clan Ice Hellion一向大量使用快速轻型机甲，他们复制了最初的Incubus改造版，但决定创建自己的型号。这个第五版安装一具ATM 6、两吨弹药、两门ER中型激光器和四挺轻机枪。 特性：精准武器—激光 部署成本倍率：1.05

column1: Quicsell's Medium PPC Backstabber. The CLNT-QS3 has twin Streak PPCs to ensure that you're never wasting heat blasting away at the air and dirt. Feel free to hold down the trigger as you run circles around enemy mechs, confident in your ability to hit your target. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1
column2: Quicsell的中型PPC伏击者。CLNT-QS3配备两门Streak PPC，确保你不会把热量浪费在向空气和尘土射击上。尽管在敌方机甲周围绕圈疾驰，也可放心扣住扳机，相信自己一定能命中目标。 特性：可变射程瞄准 部署费用倍率：1

column1: Quicsell's Assault Missile Sniper. The BLR-QS1 is our attempt at making a mech that can drown an enemy in long range missile fire. With 8 tons of LRM ammo to send down range and enough heatsinking to do it constantly, your enemies are all set for a spectacularly rainy day! Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
column2: Quicsell的强袭导弹狙击者。BLR-QS1旨在用远程导弹火力淹没敌人。携带8吨LRM弹药向远方倾泻，并配备足够的散热能力持续开火，让敌人迎来一场壮观的“暴雨”！ 特性：指挥机甲 部署费用倍率：1.13

column1: Quicsell's Heavy Missile Brawler. The QKD-QS2 comes with an 8 ton hatchet and an 8 ton combat shield, supported by our innovative Hybrid TSM (Patent Pending). And for when the enemy refuses to come to meet you in combat, you've got 70 missile tubes waiting to encourage them. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: Quicsell的重型导弹斗士。QKD-QS2配备一把8吨重斧和一面8吨重的战斗盾牌，并由我们创新的混合TSM（专利申请中）提供支持。若敌人拒绝主动迎战，还有70具导弹发射管等着“鼓励”他们。 特性：多重追踪 部署费用倍率：1.07

column1: This version is equipped with a single PPC, while each arm mounts an LB-5 X autocannon. It also carries an Improved C3 Computer. It uses a Small Cockpit, Endo Steel, and Light Ferro-Fibrous armor. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 该型号装备一门PPC，双臂各装有一门LB-5 X自动加农炮。此外还配备改进型C3计算机。采用小型驾驶舱、Endo Steel内骨骼和轻型铁纤维装甲。 特性：防空瞄准 部署费用倍率：1.08 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: This version of the Kuma is based on the original model developed. It carries an ER Large Laser backed up by two ER Medium Lasers. Each arm and torso location are equipped with a Harjel III repair system. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 该Kuma型号基于最初开发的原型。它配备一门ER大型激光，并由两门ER中型激光辅助。双臂和躯干各部位都安装了Harjel III修复系统。 特性：精准武器 - 激光 部署费用倍率：1.14 手臂执行器限制：左下

column1: Quicsell's Heavy PPC Sniper. The BL-QS1 is our largest Heavy Sniper, with two of our massive Heavy Streak PPCs. Thanks to the sophisticated target lock technology, the enemies will never know you're there until they get hit with the strength of an AC20 from across the map! Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: Quicsell的重型PPC狙击者。BL-QS1是我们最大的重型狙击机甲，装备两门巨大的重型Streak PPC。凭借复杂的目标锁定技术，敌人直到被地图另一端足以媲美AC/20的火力击中前，都不会知道你的存在！ 特性：指挥机甲 部署费用倍率：1.09

column1: This upgrade of the R40 model drops both the ER large laser and medium pulse laser, one ton of ammo, and an actuator to add an XL gyro, stealth armor, Guardian ECM suite and a PPC with PPC capacitor. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这次R40型号升级拆除了ER大型激光和中型脉冲激光、一吨弹药及一个执行器，换装XL陀螺仪、隐形装甲、Guardian ECM套件以及带PPC电容器的一门PPC。 特性：改进传感器 部署费用倍率：1.04 手臂执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: The -5D mounts an optimized M9 Gauss Rifle in addition the four fixed Rotary LRM launchers. This change from the -5B was introduced to handle larger enemy 'Mechs and heavily armed vehicles. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.33 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: -5D除了四具固定式旋转LRM发射器外，还安装了一门经过优化的M9高斯步枪。这项相较-5B的改动，是为了应对更大型的敌方机甲和重装车辆。 特性：精准武器 - 导弹 部署费用倍率：1.33 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: This variant of the Raven incorporates the Confederation's new Stealth Armor. The 'Mech carries six tons of Stealth Armor and also uses ten double heat sinks for greater heat dissipation capabilities. Quirk: Improved Jammer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这一型Raven采用了联邦合众国的新型隐形装甲。该机甲携带6吨隐形装甲，并使用10组双重散热器以提升散热能力。 特性：改进干扰器 部署费用倍率：1.05 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: Geier is a custom refit of Skobels MKII Vulture, installing Skinwalker's Interface Cockpit, experimental non-modular targeting computer and a rare Tracker Mk2 sensors to create an extremely effective long range sniper. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Geier是对Skobel公司的MKII Vulture进行的定制改装，安装了Skinwalker接口驾驶舱、实验型非模块化瞄准计算机和稀有的Tracker Mk2传感器，打造出极其高效的远程狙击者。 特性：战斗计算机 部署费用倍率：1.16 手臂执行器限制：全能型

column1: The B configuration of the Alpha Wolf mounts two Large Pulse Lasers in the left arm and a Gauss Rifle in the right. Two shoulder mounted Artemis V-enabled SRM-6 launchers with two tons of ammo add the close range punch. Quirk: Improved Jammer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Alpha Wolf的B型在左臂安装两门大型脉冲激光，右臂安装一门高斯步枪。两具肩载、配备Artemis V的SRM-6发射器和两吨弹药，增强了近距离火力。 特性：改进干扰器 部署费用倍率：1.17 手臂执行器限制：全能型

column1: The support variant of the Sea Monkey, the Smog combines the Carronade artillery system with two mortar launchers to fire as much smoke and fire as possible. It is the only variant to not mount the Rotary TAG. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.43 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Sea Monkey的支援型Smog将Carronade火炮系统与两具迫击炮发射器结合，尽可能倾泻烟雾和火焰。它是唯一不安装旋转式TAG的型号。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.43 手臂执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: As Streak ammunition and spare parts became increasingly difficult to acquire, the MN-4R was introduced. It downgrades the Stream SRM-2 to a standard SRM-2 launcher, but adds a Small Laser instead. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 随着Streak弹药和备件越来越难以获取，MN-4R应运而生。它将Stream SRM-2降级为标准SRM-2发射器，但换来了一门小型激光。 特性：窄型/低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：0.97 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: The Thanatos-8S has been refit with an Emergency Coolant System and Prototype DHS, sporting both a Mortar and MML with a wide variety of ammo is it able to stay longer in the fight and dominate the engagement. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Thanatos-8S经过紧急冷却系统和原型双重散热器改装，同时配备迫击炮和MML，凭借多种弹药能够更长时间留在战斗中并掌控交战。 特性：稳定 部署费用倍率：1.13 手臂执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Keratos F is the least similar to the primary configuration, mounting two Arrow V launchers and only two iATM-12 launchers. This however allows a better weapon profile for many situations, so has seen quite a bit of use. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.37 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Keratos F与基础配置最为不同，安装两具Arrow V发射器和仅两具iATM-12发射器。这种配置在许多情况下拥有更佳的武器组合，因此得到相当广泛的使用。 特性：多重追踪 部署费用倍率：1.37 手臂执行器限制：全能型

column1: The Quicsell line of machine guns all come with an integrated ammo supply for no extra weight! How did we do this you ask? By stripping out all those fancy firing controls that allow for variable rates of fire. Everyone knows that if you're getting a machine gun, it's because you need FULL AUTO. 12 Salvos VOLATILE!
column2: Quicsell系列机枪都配有一体化弹药供应，不增加额外重量！想知道我们是怎么做到的吗？我们拆除了那些允许调节射速的精密击发控制装置。谁都知道，既然要用机枪，就是为了全自动射击。 12轮齐射 易挥发！

column1: An electronic warfare variant of the WLF-4W model introduced in 3071, the 4WA retains the trio of torso mounted Fusigon Longtooth Light PPCs, but exchanges the arm-mounted lasers for a Guardian ECM Suite. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这是3071年推出的WLF-4W电子战型。4WA保留了安装于躯干的三门Fusigon Longtooth轻型PPC，但将双臂激光替换为Guardian ECM套件。 特性：精准武器 - 能量 部署费用倍率：1.05 手臂执行器限制：右下

column1: The Tau D configuration blends defense and precision, using an Angel ECM Suite to evade enemy targeting and combining an ER PPC with an ER Medium Laser for accurate medium-to-long range combat. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Tau D型兼顾防御与精准，使用Angel ECM套件躲避敌方瞄准，并结合ER PPC与ER中型激光，进行精准的中远程战斗。 特性：灵活 部署费用倍率：1.04 经Aries Games and Miniatures许可使用。

column1: Cyclops 11-Zs use their imposing presence and unique communications equipment to control the battlefield. Carrying the same Battle Computer as the C10, is this variant enhanced with several LosTech including a C3 Master Computer, further increasing the lances power. Quirk: Battle Computer B2000 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: Cyclops 11-Z利用其压迫性的存在感和独特通信设备掌控战场。它搭载与C10相同的战斗计算机，并进一步强化了多项失落科技，包括C3主计算机，从而提升了整个长机编队的战力。 特性：B2000战斗计算机 部署费用倍率：1.16

column1: The OSE-1M parts with the typical Ostend brawler role to instead mount a full on missile build by four LRM-20 launchers. Two SRM-6 launchers and two ER Medium Lasers provide complimentary direct fire power. All six launchers are Artemis IV enabled for better performance. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.31
column2: OSE-1M放弃了Ostend典型的斗士定位，改为安装四具LRM-20发射器的全导弹配置。两具SRM-6发射器和两门ER中型激光提供辅助的直接火力。六具发射器全部启用Artemis IV，以获得更佳性能。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.31

column1: This version of the Valkyrie like the QS5 uses an endo steel chassis and small cockpit. Carrying a light PPC and a single ELRM-10 missile launcher creates a 'Mech that excels at extremely long range combat. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这一型Valkyrie与QS5一样采用Endo Steel底盘和小型驾驶舱。配备一门轻型PPC和一具ELRM-10导弹发射器，使其擅长超远程战斗。 特性：改进通信 部署费用倍率：0.99 手臂执行器限制：右下

column1: New build Spectors or those with irreparable CLPS systems within Minnesota Tribe space typically are refit into the 6M variant. A 210XL engine frees up enough tonnage for an Enhanced ERPPC, Medium Laser, and a Small Laser. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 在明尼苏达部落领地内，新造的Spector或CLPS系统无法修复的机体通常会被改装为6M型。210XL引擎释放出足够吨位，可安装增强型ERPPC、中型激光和小型激光。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.06 手臂执行器限制：右下

column1: The Joermungandr, named for the great 'Midgard Serpent' of ancient Norse legend said to herald Ragnarok and bring an end to the Gods, brings a terrifying rain of fire and death to the battlefield. Quirk: Advanced Missile TTS Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Jörmungandr以古老北欧传说中的“尘世巨蟒”命名，据说它会预示诸神黄昏并带来众神终结；这台机甲向战场倾泻恐怖的火焰与死亡之雨。 特性：高级导弹TTS 部署费用倍率：1.24 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: This Dark Age era variant carries two "King David" Light Gauss Rifles and is equipped with a Battle Armor Mechanical Jump Booster. It is protected by Improved Stealth armor. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.892 Can only be transported by internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.
column2: 这款黑暗时代型号携带两门“King David”轻型高斯步枪，并装备战斗装甲机械跳跃助推器。机体由改进型隐形装甲保护。 特性：精准 部署费用倍率：0.892 只能由内部舱室运输，无法进行近战，无法进行集群攻击。

column1: Unlike its cousin, the CRB-21 fields Light Autocannon/5s and MML Launchers, while retaining most of its energy weaponry. Practically every aspect of the 'Mech has been upgraded from the stock version. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 与其同族型号不同，CRB-21装备轻型自动加农炮/5和MML发射器，同时保留大部分能量武器。该机甲几乎每个方面都进行了升级。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.04 手臂执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: This experimental variant of the Dasher II was first seen in 3084[3] by Republic of the Sphere intelligence. This version replaces the engine with an XXL engine, adds MASC, and increases the armor protection. The ER micro lasers are replaced by ER medium lasers as well Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 这款Dasher II实验型于3084年首次被共和国情报部门发现[3]。该型号将引擎替换为XXL引擎，加入MASC并强化装甲防护，同时将ER微型激光替换为ER中型激光。 特性：窄型/低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：1.08

column1: A Minnesota Tribe update of the classic Hunchback 4G, the 4M features 250XL and a quintet of Jump Jets to give it more speed and agility and to bring its Improved AC20 into range. Ferro Spall Shield technology and a Heavy Cockpit attempt to give the design more staying power. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 这是明尼苏达部落对经典Hunchback 4G的升级型。4M配备250XL引擎和五具跳跃喷射器，提升速度与敏捷性，并让改进型AC/20进入射程。Ferro Spall Shield技术和重型驾驶舱试图赋予该设计更强的持久力。 特性：战斗拳 部署费用倍率：1.1

column1: The STY-4C offers significantly improved firepower through the inclusion of ClanTech weaponry, acquired both from Defiance Industries and Clan Sea Fox merchants. This enables MechWarriors to hold their own against any foes. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: STY-4C通过加入氏族科技武器显著提升火力，这些武器既来自Defiance Industries，也来自氏族Sea Fox商人。这使机甲战士能够与任何敌人抗衡。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.04 手臂执行器限制：右下

column1: Based upon the 4WA from Arc-Royal MechWorks is this version made to order to incorporate a Chameleon Light Polarization Suite to bring its Capacitor enhanced PPCs close enough for a deadly precision strike. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 该型号基于Arc-Royal MechWorks的4WA定制制造，加入变色龙轻型偏振套件，使带电容器增强的PPC能够在足够近的距离发动致命精准打击。 特性：精准武器 - 能量 部署费用倍率：1.02 手臂执行器限制：右下

column1: Likely starting life as a standard 9S, this modified variant used by Victor Benedict trades the traditional PPC for a MGL5 and the SRM pack for a pair of Steak 2 launchers. Thanks to an upgraded 175XL Engine, an Ion Stream Projector and Active Probe are able to be fitted. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
column2: 这款改装型号很可能最初是标准9S，由Victor Benedict使用；它用MGL5取代传统PPC，用两具Steak 2发射器取代SRM组。得益于升级后的175XL引擎，还能安装离子流投射器和主动探测器。 特性：空中突击 部署费用倍率：1.06

column1: The Tocho B configuration relies on a single iATM-6 launcher supported by three tons of ammunition, ensuring prolonged missile firepower that keeps it in the fight for extended periods. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Tocho B型依靠一具iATM-6发射器，并由3吨弹药支援，确保能够持续输出导弹火力，在战场上长时间作战。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：0.98 经Aries Games and Miniatures许可使用。

column1: The C configuration mounts six ER Medium Lasers, but also takes inspiration from Inner Sphere 'Mechs in using a Hatchet. The combination of a supercharger, jump jets and MASC makes the melee attacks more threatening than expected. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: C型安装六门ER中型激光，同时受到内天体机甲启发，配备了一把战斧。增压器、跳跃喷射器和MASC的组合，让其近战攻击比预期更加危险。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.06 手臂执行器限制：全能型

column1: This variant carries a pair of Streak SRM-6s in the right torso and a Streak LRM-15 in the left. The Mad Dog G carries a single ER PPC in the left arm, while the right mounts a trio of ER Medium Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 该型号在右侧躯干安装两具Streak SRM-6，在左侧安装一具Streak LRM-15。Mad Dog G型左臂装有一门ER PPC，右臂则安装三门ER中型脉冲激光。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中型 部署费用倍率：1.09 手臂执行器限制：全能型

column1: This variant adds Triple Strength Myomer and a C3 slave, reorganizes the laser complement (four ER medium lasers, Medium Pulse Laser, Small Pulse Laser, and medium laser), and carries a single ER PPC. One of the Heavy PPCs is removed in exchange for this equipment. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: 该型号加入三倍强度肌肉组织和C3从属计算机，重新编排激光配置（四门ER中型激光、中型脉冲激光、小型脉冲激光和中型激光），并携带一门ER PPC。它拆除了一门重型PPC以换取这些装备。 特性：改进通信 部署费用倍率：1.14
