column1: Fortress installation safeguarding the surrounding area. Quirk: Stable Weapons Armor: Armor Amount: 480 Structure: Structure Amount: 250 Engine: 400 Standard Fusion Equipment: 1 x Command Bunker Weapons: 2x Gauss Rifle HA30 (C) Ammunition: 8x Ammo Hyper Gauss
column2: 堡垒设施，守护周边区域。 特性：稳定武器 装甲：装甲 数量：480 结构：结构 数量：250 引擎：400标准融合 装备： 1 x 指挥掩体 武器： 2x Gauss Rifle HA30 (C) 弹药： 8x Ammo Hyper Gauss

column1: The personal 'Mech of Lt. Hannah McQuarters of the 1st Kestrel Grenadiers, all of Gertrude's medium pulse lasers were removed and replaced with eight forward facing ER medium lasers, two in each arm, two in the center torso, and one in both left and right torsos. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12
column2: 第1“红隼掷弹兵团”汉娜·麦夸特斯中尉的私人机甲。Gertrude原有的所有中型脉冲激光都被拆除，换成八门朝前的ER中型激光：双臂各两门，中央躯干两门，左右侧躯干各一门。 特性：超伸展执行器 部署费用倍率：1.12

column1: The personal 'Mech of Wild Geese member Major Sandy Reich, the ex–Com Guard's Thug has been retrofitted with Clan-spec replacement weaponry, with Clan ER PPCs and Streak SRM-6s fitting neatly into the old locations. Four jump jets are included to increase mobility. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: Wild Geese成员桑迪·赖希少校的私人机甲。这台前内卫军的Thug经过改装，换上符合氏族规格的替代武器，氏族ER PPC和Streak SRM-6恰好装入原有位置。另加四具跳跃喷射器以提升机动性。 特性：精准武器 - 能量 部署费用倍率：1.16

column1: After TharHes failed to produce a good updated Crusader during the Project Phoenix craze during the 3060s, they returned to form with the CRD-10s in the post-Jihad era. Utilizing clan tech to produce a mixed tech design, they managed to strengthen the weaponry significantly. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 在3060年代的凤凰计划热潮中，TharHes未能生产出优秀的升级版Crusader；圣战后时代，他们以CRD-10s重拾正轨。通过使用氏族科技打造混合技术设计，其武器威力得到显著增强。 特性：稳定武器 部署费用倍率：1.09

column1: A simple field refit used during the Jihad, this version mounts a C3 slave unit in the torso and a second arm-mounted laser by removing the rear-firing model, while replacing the original autocannon with a light autocannon/5. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这是圣战期间使用的简单战地改装型，在躯干安装C3从属单元，并拆除后向射击型号换上第二门臂载激光，同时将原有自动加农炮替换为轻型自动加农炮/5。 特性：稳定 部署费用倍率：1.08 手臂执行器限制：右下

column1: The third variant of the Yen-Lo-Wang, the YLW3 replaces a Gauss rifle, a LRM-20 launcher and a single ER Medium laser - all Clan spec. Further it upgrades the 'Mech to use double heat sinks and light Ferro-Fibrous armor. Quirk: Yen Lo Wang Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: Yen-Lo-Wang的第三种型号。YLW3替换了一把高斯步枪、一具LRM-20发射器和一门ER中型激光，全部为氏族规格；此外还升级为双重散热器和轻型铁纤维装甲。 特性：Yen Lo Wang 部署费用倍率：1.06 手臂执行器限制：右下

column1: This Republic era version of the Locust has a top speed nearing 170 km/h. It carries an ER medium laser in the center torso and a medium pulse laser in each arm. It's protected by Ferro-Fibrous armor. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这款共和国时代的Locust最高速度接近170公里/小时。中央躯干装有一门ER中型激光，双臂各装一门中型脉冲激光。机体由铁纤维装甲保护。 特性：窄型/低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：0.97 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: The Roncone RNC-XB mounts huge booster jets to the chassis to enable a similar movement to the Battlemaster BLR-4L's jump jets. Its only weapons are two Silver Bullet Gauss rifles and two ER Medium Lasers, but it does also mount an AntiMissile System for defensive purposes. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.29
column2: Roncone RNC-XB在底盘上安装大型助推喷气，以实现类似Battlemaster BLR-4L跳跃喷射器的机动能力。它仅装备两把银弹高斯步枪和两门ER中型激光，但还安装了反导系统用于防御。 特性：战斗计算机 部署费用倍率：1.29

column1: Reinforced structure to defend an area. Quirk: Stable Weapons Armor: Armor Amount: 320 Structure: Structure Amount: 200 Engine: 300 Standard Fusion Equipment: 1 x Command Bunker 1 x Warfare Suite QS Weapons: 3x Laser AMS QS 3x Small REX Laser QS Ammunition:
column2: 加固结构，用于防御区域。 特性：稳定武器 装甲：装甲 数量：320 结构：结构 数量：200 引擎：300标准融合 装备： 1 x 指挥掩体 1 x Warfare Suite QS 武器： 3x Laser AMS QS 3x Small REX Laser QS 弹药：

column1: Based on the LNG-3 this version also uses an XXL engine. By downgrading the SRM-6 launchers to SRM-4s it has enough room to mount an iNarc system with one ton of ammunition; the rest of the weaponry is identical to the LNG-3. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 该型号基于LNG-3，同样使用XXL引擎。将SRM-6发射器降级为SRM-4后，腾出空间安装一套iNarc系统及一吨弹药；其余武器与LNG-3相同。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：0.98 手臂执行器限制：右下

column1: The Solitaire is a fast, heavily armored light BattleMech. The twenty five-ton design is one of the fastest in existence, allowing it to pick off enemy units that stray too far from support like a lioness hunting a pack of wildebeest. The Solitaire is capable of operating far from supply lines, as it carries an all-energy weapon complement and four and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor.
column2: Solitaire是一台速度极快且装甲厚重的轻型战斗机甲。这款25吨设计是现存速度最快的机甲之一，能够像母狮捕猎角马群一样，迅速猎杀离开支援范围的敌方单位。Solitaire可以远离补给线作战，因为它全套武器均为能量武器，并携带4.5吨铁纤维装甲。

column1: Debuting in 3101, the Valkyrie QD-5 is a revamp of the older QD-4 model. Powered by a 150-rated XL Engine and armored with Light Ferro-Fibrous; the QD-5 is armed with a Medium Pulse Laser, MML-7 and an ATM-3. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: Valkyrie QD-5于3101年首次亮相，是旧式QD-4型号的改进版。QD-5由150级XL引擎驱动，装有轻型铁纤维装甲，并配备一门中型脉冲激光、MML-7和ATM-3。 特性：改进通信 部署费用倍率：0.99 手臂执行器限制：右下

column1: Designed before the Jihad this version only entered service after that war started. An XL engine increases the 'Mech's top speed to 86 km/h while eight Improved Jump Jets maximizes mobility on the battlefield. An XL Gyro allows the PNT-13K to carry a SRM-4 and a Plasma Rifle. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 该型号在圣战前完成设计，却直到战争开始后才投入服役。XL引擎将机甲最高速度提升至86公里/小时，八具改进型跳跃喷射器最大化了战场机动性。XL陀螺仪让PNT-13K能够携带一具SRM-4和一支等离子步枪。 特性：空中突击 部署费用倍率：0.98

column1: the Catapult II C7 is a unique and rare variant, sporting a integrated Chameleon Light Polarization Suite and advanced Jump Systems is it able to deliver a Devastating Blow Anywhere at Anytime. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Catapult II C7是一种独特而稀有的型号，配备一套变色龙轻型偏振套件和先进跳跃系统，能够随时随地发动毁灭性打击。 特性：精准武器 - 导弹 部署费用倍率：1.12 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: Manufactured in small numbers by Skobel MechWorks from their facilities in the Russia region of Terra prior, the Omega represented the first truly viable superheavy BattleMech design to appear on the battlefield. Although the Omega was a prototype, almost thirty of the huge 'Mechs were produced by Skobel prior to the Superheavy manufacturing wing of their Russian facility being destroyed.
column2: Omega由Skobel MechWorks在此前位于Terra俄罗斯地区的工厂少量制造，是战场上出现的第一种真正可行的超重型战斗机甲设计。尽管Omega只是原型机，Skobel仍在其俄罗斯工厂的超重型制造部门被摧毁前，生产了近30台这种巨型机甲。

column1: The Cyclone known as the "Peeper Peddler" is rumoured to have held down the fort against invading Blakists on a nondescript Periphery backwater. Convenient that not a single part of this tale is verifiable. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这台被称为“窥视者贩夫”的旋风，据传曾在某个不起眼的边疆星球上抵御布莱克教徒的入侵。可惜，这段故事没有任何一部分能够得到验证。 怪癖：敏捷 掉落成本乘数：1.05 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: I don't even want to know from whom they looted a Wolfhound, but whoever did, surely indulged themself with upgrading it's weapons, all these lasers sure pack a whallop, if it doesn't just melt looking at the trigger. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 我甚至不想知道他们是从谁那里抢来这台猎狼的，但无论是谁干的，肯定都沉迷于升级它的武器。这些激光器威力惊人，没准一扣扳机它自己就先融化了。 怪癖：战斗计算机 掉落成本乘数：1.02 手臂执行器限制：右下

column1: The Hachiwara's main armament is its experimental Vibroblade. This is backed up by an Ultra 10 Autocannon, as well as two ER medium lasers for medium-long range attacks and four M-Pods for additional close-range power. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
column2: 哈奇瓦拉的主武器是实验型振动刀。除此之外，它还配备一门 Ultra 10 自动加农炮、两门 ER 中型激光器用于中远距离攻击，以及四个 M 炸弹舱提供额外的近距离火力。 怪癖：近战执行器 掉落成本乘数：1.1 手臂执行器限制：左上

column1: Reinforced structure to defend an area. Quirk: Stable Weapons Armor: Armor Amount: 400 Structure: Structure Amount: 200 Engine: 300 Standard Fusion Equipment: 1 x Command Bunker Weapons: 1x Large REX Laser QS 1x MG Heavy QS 1x Medium REX Laser QS Ammunition:
column2: 用于守卫区域的加固结构。 怪癖：稳定武器 装甲：装甲 数量： 400 结构：结构 数量： 200 引擎： 300 标准融合 装备： 1 x 指挥碉堡 武器： 1x 大型 REX 激光 QS 1x 重型机枪 QS 1x 中型 REX 激光 QS 弹药：

column1: A long-range fighter, this configuration features a light PPC and ER medium laser in each arm, while each of its side torsos receives a Thunderbolt 5 missile launcher, fed by two tons of ammunition located in the right torso. Quirk: Well Balanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是一款远程战斗配置：每只手臂配备一门轻型 PPC 和一门 ER 中型激光器，左右侧躯干各装有一具 Thunderbolt 5 导弹发射器，弹药两吨，存放在右侧躯干内。 怪癖：平衡良好 掉落成本乘数：0.99 手臂执行器限制：全方位

column1: A simple refit, this version carries a Guardian ECM Suite in the center torso to offset the Blakist C3i system. To make room for this system, all rear defenses have been removed except for a single ER Small Laser. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是一次简单的改装：该版本在中央躯干安装了 Guardian ECM 套件，用来抵消布莱克教团的 C3i 系统。为了腾出安装空间，所有后方防御武器都被拆除，只保留一门 ER 小型激光器。 怪癖：稳定 掉落成本乘数：1.11 手臂执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: The 4K's main weapon is a large shoulder mounted Gauss rifle with two tons of ammunition. Four medium lasers provide anti-infantry and -flanking capabilities. The 'Mech also carries two AMS for better self-defense and a C3 slave computer for improved lance coordination. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 4K 型的主武器是安装在肩部的大型高斯步枪，配备两吨弹药。四门中型激光器提供反步兵和反侧翼能力。这台机甲还配备两套 AMS 以增强自卫能力，以及一台 C3 从属计算机以改善长枪协同。 怪癖：改进生命保障 掉落成本乘数：1.09

column1: The I configuration, popularized by Star Commander Lauren Hawker, features an ER PPC paired with a capacitor in the left arm, and two Rotary Autocannon/2s in the right arm to exploit holes opened up by the PPC. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: I 配置由星际指挥官劳伦·霍克推广，左臂安装一门带电容器的 ER PPC，右臂则装有两门旋转 AC/2，用来利用 PPC 打开的缺口。 怪癖：改进的定位 - 中 掉落成本乘数：1.09 手臂执行器限制：全方位

column1: The Kageoni KGO-4K is the successor of the KGO-3K, replacing the Enhanced LRM-20 launchers with two Extended range PPCs in each arm. The massive railgun is still kept in the same location, while the lasers are downgraded to a single Extended Range Small Laser mounted in the head. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.38
column2: KGO-4K 是 KGO-3K 的后继型号，用每只手臂上的两门增程 PPC 替换了增强型 LRM-20 发射器。巨型轨道炮仍安装在原来的位置，而激光器则降级为安装在头部的一门增程小型激光器。 怪癖：多重锁定 掉落成本乘数：1.38

column1: Reinforced structure to defend an area. Quirk: Stable Weapons Armor: Armor Amount: 320 Structure: Structure Amount: 200 Engine: 300 Standard Fusion Equipment: 1 x Command Bunker Weapons: 5x MML 7 Ammunition: 1x Ammo LRM [DBL] 1x Ammo SRM 1x Ammo SRM [HALF]
column2: 用于守卫区域的加固结构。 怪癖：稳定武器 装甲：装甲 数量： 320 结构：结构 数量： 200 引擎： 300 标准融合 装备： 1 x 指挥碉堡 武器： 5x MML 7 弹药： 1x LRM 弹药 [双倍] 1x SRM 弹药 1x SRM 弹药 [半份]

column1: The Arctic Cheetah Prime-EWR is an emergency refit developed by the Invading Clans to improve the Mechs combat effectiveness. The specialist electronics are stripped out and the free weight used to upgrade the LRM racks. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Arctic Cheetah Prime-EWR 是入侵氏族为提升机甲战斗效能而开发的应急改装型。它拆除了专用电子设备，并将腾出的重量用于升级 LRM 发射架。 怪癖：受保护的执行器 掉落成本乘数：0.99 手臂执行器限制：全方位

column1: A strange one-off refit of a MSK-11-2A, the MSK-11-L10-JON, eschews nearly all staying power in favor of unleashing an unholy amount of rockets at the enemy, preferably from an ambush position. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是 MSK-11-2A 的奇怪一次性改装型。MSK-11-L10-JON 几乎放弃了全部持久作战能力，转而从伏击阵地向敌人倾泻数量惊人的火箭。 怪癖：精确武器 - 导弹 掉落成本乘数：1.24 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: Another Jihad-era field expedient version, this variant carries a Heavy PPC and a Light PPC instead of the Gauss rifle. Though techs added more heat sinks, they cannot completely cool the 'Mech when all weapons are fired. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这是另一个圣战时代的临时战地改装型，以重型 PPC 和轻型 PPC 替代了高斯步枪。虽然技术人员增加了散热器，但所有武器齐射时仍无法完全冷却机甲。 怪癖：易于驾驶 掉落成本乘数：1.1 手臂执行器限制：右下

column1: Defensive structure capable of repelling minor threats. Quirk: Stable Weapons Armor: Armor Amount: 240 Structure: Structure Amount: 150 Engine: 200 Standard Fusion Equipment: 1 x Command Bunker Weapons: 1x Hv. Lg. Chem Laser QS Ammunition: 2x Ammo Chemical Large
column2: 能够击退轻微威胁的防御结构。 怪癖：稳定武器 装甲：装甲 数量： 240 结构：结构 数量： 150 引擎： 200 标准融合 装备： 1 x 指挥碉堡 武器： 1x 重型化学激光 QS 弹药： 2x 大型化学弹药

column1: This variant was developed by the Taurian Concordat during the Jihad. It carries a light PPC and a Streak SRM-6. An XL engine increases the top speed to 111 km/h, while 10 double heat sinks keep the 'Mech cool. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 该型号由塔利安协约在圣战期间研发，配备一门轻型 PPC 和一具 Streak SRM-6。XL 引擎将最高速度提升至 111 公里/小时，10 个双散热器则让机甲保持冷却。 怪癖：改进通信 掉落成本乘数：0.99 手臂执行器限制：右下

column1: The first real redesign of the Viper for three centuries, the VP-7 replaces the Pulse Lasers of the original VP-1 with three ER Medium Lasers. The switch to Composite internal structure as a result allowed adding both an advanced Targeting Computer and an Active Probe. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 这是猎蝠三百年来首次真正的重新设计。VP-7 用三门 ER 中型激光器替换了原 VP-1 的脉冲激光器。改用复合内部结构后，腾出了空间，可同时安装先进瞄准计算机和主动探测器。 怪癖：改进通信 掉落成本乘数：1.1

column1: The 10K uses Ferro-Fibrous armor to increase the armoring above the levels of more standard Battlemasters while still being able to fit a Heavy PPC, four ER Medium Lasers and a LRM-10 launcher. Eighteen double heat sinks provide enough cooling to make the weapons loadout viable. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: 10K 型使用铁纤维装甲，在仍能装下重型 PPC、四门 ER 中型激光器和一具 LRM-10 发射器的同时，比标准战斗大师拥有更高的装甲防护。十八个双散热器提供了足够冷却，使这套武器配置得以运作。 怪癖：指挥机甲 掉落成本乘数：1.15

column1: As favored, if rare, assault mech among Minnesota Tribe forces, the Nightstar did eventually receive an update. The 9M variant upgrades to a 380XL and replaces the Gauss Rifles with a pair of Flechette 10s and all other weapons were removed to replace the ERPPC with a Hyper PPC. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.23
column2: 作为明尼苏达部落部队中备受青睐但十分稀有的突击机甲，夜星最终还是获得了更新。9M 型升级为 380XL 引擎，并用两门 Flechette 10 替换高斯步枪；其余武器全部拆除，改装为一门 Hyper PPC。 怪癖：指挥机甲 掉落成本乘数：1.23

column1: The -10K2 Panther retains the ER PPC of the -10K and removes the Artemis IV as well as a heat sink. In exchange, the remaining heat sinks have been upgraded to double strength versions, alleviating the heat problems that plague the 10K, while an additional SRM-4 has been added. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: -10K2 黑豹保留了 -10K 的 ER PPC，拆除了 Artemis IV 和一具散热器。作为交换，剩余散热器升级为双倍强度型号，缓解了困扰 10K 的散热问题，同时增装了一具 SRM-4。 怪癖：空中突击 掉落成本乘数：0.98

column1: A Clan Jade Falcon variant that uses Experimental Technology extensively, the Kraken-XR was first spotted at Olivetti Weaponry on Sudeten. Replacing most Weapons with 4 Rotary AC/2 and 2 Streak LRM-10. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是大量使用实验技术的 Jade Falcon 氏族变体，Kraken-XR 最初在苏德坦的奥利维蒂武器公司被发现。它用 4 门旋转 AC/2 和 2 具 Streak LRM-10 替换了大部分武器。 怪癖：延长躯干扭转 掉落成本乘数：1.24 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: The A configuration carries an energy only loadout consisting of three Extended Range PPCs, all with a PPC capacitor attached. A head-mounted ER Medium Laser is connected with the PPCs through an advanced targeting computer. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: A 配置是纯能量武器装载，包括三门增程 PPC，每门都连接一个 PPC 电容器。安装在头部的 ER 中型激光器通过先进瞄准计算机与 PPC 联动。 怪癖：易于维护 掉落成本乘数：1.17 手臂执行器限制：全方位

column1: The predecessor to the 2D, the Commando 1D was meant to give the MechWarrior a little more long range punch with a Large Laser. at the cost of some of its armor. While the 2D is superior in most aspects, there are still a number of this older design still in service today. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: 作为 2D 的前身，突击队 1D 旨在用一门大型激光器为机甲战士提供更强的远程火力，但代价是减少部分装甲。虽然 2D 在大多数方面都更优秀，如今仍有不少这种老旧设计在服役。 怪癖：窄/低调 掉落成本乘数：0.96

column1: The PKP-2K replaces the SRM-2 and ER Large Laser with a Medium X-Pulse Laser and a C3 Master computer. The other major change is the use of Anti-Penetrative Ablation Armor instead of Ferro-fibrous or standard plate. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: PKP-2K 用一门中型 X 脉冲激光器和一台 C3 主计算机替换了 SRM-2 与 ER 大型激光器。另一项重大改动是采用抗穿透消融装甲，取代铁纤维装甲或标准装甲板。 怪癖：坚固 掉落成本乘数：1.17 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: Fortress installation safeguarding the surrounding area. Quirk: Stable Weapons Armor: Armor Amount: 480 Structure: Structure Amount: 250 Engine: 400 Standard Fusion Equipment: 1 x Command Bunker Weapons: 5x MML 9 Ammunition: 1x Ammo LRM [DBL] 1x Ammo SRM [DBL]
column2: 守护周边区域的堡垒设施。 怪癖：稳定武器 装甲：装甲 数量： 480 结构：结构 数量： 250 引擎： 400 标准融合 装备： 1 x 指挥碉堡 武器： 5x MML 9 弹药： 1x LRM 弹药 [双倍] 1x SRM 弹药 [双倍]

column1: This variant uses a Small Cockpit to free some room. A TAG and ER Medium Laser are mounted in the head, while another ER Medium Laser, two Medium Pulse Lasers, and a Snub Nose PPC make up the rest of the armament. This White Flame carries thirteen double heat sinks. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 该型号使用小型驾驶舱以腾出空间。头部安装了 TAG 和一门 ER 中型激光器，其他武器则包括另一门 ER 中型激光器、两门中型脉冲激光器和一门短鼻 PPC。这台白焰配备十三个双散热器。 怪癖：改进的定位 - 中 掉落成本乘数：1.1

column1: The -C3 was modified to be integrated into a standard C3 lance, it removes the C3i computer and replaces it with a C3 slave unit. The weight savings allows the -C3 to carry an additional Medium Pulse Laser. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: -C3 经过改装，可并入标准 C3 长枪；它拆除了 C3i 计算机，换成 C3 从属单元。减轻的重量使 -C3 能够额外携带一门中型脉冲激光器。 怪癖：战斗计算机 掉落成本乘数：1.04 手臂执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: This Dragon 'P' is in pretty good condition for a pirate 'Mech, but all its weapons have been replaced with Incendiary variants and it's covered in all kinds of unicorn graffiti. A real joker owned this. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这台“P”型巨龙对于海盗机甲来说状态相当不错，但它的所有武器都被替换成了燃烧型，而且机身布满各种独角兽涂鸦。它的前主人显然是个真正的滑稽家伙。 怪癖：窄/低调 掉落成本乘数：1.07 手臂执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: A highly mobile BattleMech, this custom Shadow Hawk was piloted by a bloodnamed MechWarrior. Records indicate that the bloodname "Vickers" originally resided in Clan Widowmaker, before it was absorbed into Clan Wolf, then continuing use once Clan Wolf became Wolf-In-Exile. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: 这台高度机动的定制暗影鹰由一名拥有血名的机甲战士驾驶。记录显示，“维克斯”这一血名最初属于寡妇制造者氏族，后来该氏族被狼氏族吸收；狼氏族成为流亡之狼后，他们仍继续使用这一血名。 怪癖：战斗拳套 掉落成本乘数：1.15

column1: The UAC-BG-421 adds Ferro-Fibrous armor, freeing enough weight capacity to add two Machine Guns and one Small Laser for better self-defense. It does drop the C.A.S.E. protection, to cut costs slightly. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: UAC-BG-421 增加了铁纤维装甲，腾出足够重量空间，加入两挺机枪和一门小型激光器以改善自卫能力。为稍微降低成本，它舍弃了 C.A.S.E. 防护。 怪癖：精确武器 - AC 掉落成本乘数：1.11 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: This version of the 'Mech utilizes standardized technology. The 'Mech utilizes 13.5 tons of standard armor and has additional heat sinks. WD1 lacks the WF1's Light Ferro and the Actuator Enhancement System. Quirk: Reinforced Legs Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Right Lower, Left Upper
column2: 这个版本的机甲采用标准化技术，使用 13.5 吨标准装甲，并增加了散热器。WD1 没有 WF1 的轻型铁纤维装甲和执行器增强系统。 怪癖：强化腿部 掉落成本乘数：1.09 手臂执行器限制：右下、左上

column1: The Tau Prime configuration is a focused long-range striker, relying solely on a single Class 20 Hyper Assault Gauss Rifle for consistent, heavy-hitting firepower across various engagement distances. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Tau Prime 配置是一台专注于远程打击的突击机甲，仅依靠一门 20 级 Hyper Assault 高斯步枪，在各种交战距离上持续输出强大火力。 怪癖：敏捷 掉落成本乘数：1.04 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 许可使用。

column1: This version uses an Endo Steel skeleton, which freed up weight for arm-mounted Snub Nose PPCs and Actuator Enhancement Systems instead of the ER Large Lasers. The armor has also been replaced with Reflective Armor. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 该版本使用 Endo Steel 骨架，腾出重量空间，将 ER 大型激光器换成安装在手臂上的短鼻 PPC 和执行器增强系统。装甲也被替换为反射装甲。 怪癖：稳定 掉落成本乘数：1.11 手臂执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: The D9-G10 was introduced during the Jihad, where it was enhanced by the new technologies of the times. The 'Mech's armor is replaced by stealth armor, and the LRM-10 is dropped in favor of a light PPC; it also gets a Guardian ECM suite as part of the stealth armor upgrade. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: D9-G10 于圣战期间推出，并以当时的新技术进行了增强。机甲装甲被替换为隐形装甲，LRM-10 则改为轻型 PPC；作为隐形装甲升级的一部分，它还获得了 Guardian ECM 套件。 怪癖：受保护的执行器 掉落成本乘数：0.98

column1: Dont expect this Nova Cat to play nice, they broke most of the OmniAssembly and somehow managed to make whatever they did to the Torso impossible to change Armor or Structure without breaking the whole thing Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 别指望这台新星猫会好好相处。他们破坏了大部分 OmniAssembly，还不知怎么把躯干改造成了无法更换装甲或结构的样子，否则整台机甲就会散架。 怪癖：360° 躯干扭转 掉落成本乘数：1.1 手臂执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Shadow Hawk IIC is a second-line Clan BattleMech based upon the Shadow Hawk that was first fielded by the Star League. This version uses a HAG 20 and three tons of ammunition. To back it up, the IIC 6 mounts two Medium Pulse Lasers, an ER Small Laser, and a Small Pulse Laser. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 暗影鹰 IIC 是一种二线氏族战斗机甲，基于星际联盟首次列装的暗影鹰设计。这一型号使用 HAG 20 和三吨弹药。作为辅助火力，IIC 6 配备两门中型脉冲激光器、一门 ER 小型激光器和一门小型脉冲激光器。 怪癖：战斗拳套 掉落成本乘数：1.09

column1: Defensive structure capable of repelling minor threats. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Armor: Armor Amount: 240 Structure: Structure Amount: 150 Engine: 200 Standard Fusion Equipment: Weapons: 2x Medium Chem Laser (P) 1x SB Gauss (P) Ammunition: 1x Ammo Gauss [DBL]
column2: 能够击退轻微威胁的防御结构。 怪癖：集成探照灯 装甲：装甲 数量： 240 结构：结构 数量： 150 引擎： 200 标准融合 装备： 武器： 2x 中型化学激光 (P) 1x SB 高斯 (P) 弹药： 1x 高斯弹药 [双倍]

column1: This variant carries a ProtoMech AC/4 in the right arm and an improved heavy large laser in the left arm. One ton of autocannon ammunition is also carried. Finally, a supercharger allows the Fire Falcon to sprint at 160 km/h. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 该型号右臂配备一门 ProtoMech AC/4，左臂装有一门改进型重型大型激光器。它还携带一吨自动加农炮弹药。最后，增压器让火凤凰能够以 160 公里/小时的速度冲刺。 怪癖：改进传感器 掉落成本乘数：0.99 手臂执行器限制：全方位

column1: The Yellow Jacket YJ-15 relies on close range firepower, mounting an array of six small lasers alongside a single medium laser for mid-range support. Backed by 5.5 tons of armor and five jump jets, it can close distance quickly to unleash an alpha strike rivaling an AC/20. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: 黄夹克 YJ-15 专注于近距离火力，在一门中型激光器之外还安装了六门小型激光器，为中距离作战提供支援。凭借 5.5 吨装甲和五具跳跃喷气机，它能够迅速接近敌人，释放不逊于 AC/20 的全弹齐射。 怪癖：延长躯干扭转 掉落成本乘数：0.96

column1: A Dark Age update to the Civil War era BJ-4, the Blackjack BJ-5 pairs quad Light PPC’s with a duo of Light AC/2’s. A combination of a Light Engine and Endo Steel create the free weight for the weapons. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是内战时代 BJ-4 在黑暗时代的升级型。黑杰克 BJ-5 将四门轻型 PPC 与两门轻型 AC/2 组合起来。轻型引擎和 Endo Steel 骨架共同腾出了安装武器所需的重量。 怪癖：延长躯干扭转 掉落成本乘数：1.03 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: A subvariant of the original, while the removal of five heat sinks forced MechWarriors to rely on volley fire to avoid overheating, the inclusion of a Targeting Computer in turn made those shots deadly accurate. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.23 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是原型的子型号。拆除五个散热器迫使机甲战士依靠分组齐射来避免过热，但安装瞄准计算机后，这些射击变得极其精准。 怪癖：枪管拳套 掉落成本乘数：1.23 手臂执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: A modification of the Charger BattleMech, the Cudgel 2A made its debut in the Solaris VII arenas in 3066. Built by Innovative Design Concepts with brutal melee combat in mind, the 2A comes fitted with Triple Strength Myomer and enough lasers to easily activate it. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: 这是冲锋者战斗机甲的改装型，棍棒 2A 于 3066 年在 Solaris VII 竞技场首次亮相。Innovative Design Concepts 以残酷的近战为设计目标，为 2A 安装了三重强化肌肉纤维，以及足以轻松激活它的激光器。 怪癖：近战执行器 掉落成本乘数：1.14

column1: One of the more recent configurations, the G loadout mounts a single ProtoMech AC/4 and a single ER Medium Laser as its weapons, fully focusing on mobility and repeated strikes by the autocannon to slowly batter enemies down. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是较新的配置之一。G 型装载一门 ProtoMech AC/4 和一门 ER 中型激光器，完全专注于机动性，并通过自动加农炮的连续打击逐步削弱敌人。 怪癖：改进传感器 掉落成本乘数：1.03 手臂执行器限制：全方位

column1: The C configuration of the Hel switches to a full ATM loadout, totalling 48 tubes spread over four launchers. As this leaves the 'Mech more vulnerable to flanking attacks, this loadout should always be protected by other units. Quirk: Experimental TC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Hel 的 C 配置改为完整的 ATM 装载，共 48 个发射管，分布在四具发射器中。由于这使机甲更容易遭受侧翼攻击，这种装载必须始终由其他单位保护。 怪癖：实验型瞄准计算机 掉落成本乘数：1.1 手臂执行器限制：全方位

column1: A modification of the Charger BattleMech, the Cudgel 2B made its debut in the Solaris VII arenas in 3068. Built by Innovative Design Concepts with brutal melee combat in mind, the 2B comes fitted with Triple Strength Myomer and enough lasers to easily activate it. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: 这是冲锋者战斗机甲的改装型，棍棒 2B 于 3068 年在 Solaris VII 竞技场首次亮相。Innovative Design Concepts 以残酷的近战为设计目标，为 2B 安装了三重强化肌肉纤维，以及足以轻松激活它的激光器。 怪癖：近战执行器 掉落成本乘数：1.14

column1: The Tocho D configuration is equipped with a Light Active Probe to detect hidden enemies and uses a Targeting Computer to accurately deliver heavy damage with its Improved Heavy Large Laser. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Tocho D 配置配备轻型主动探测器，用于发现隐藏敌人，并通过瞄准计算机利用改进型重型大型激光器精确造成巨大伤害。 怪癖：易于维护 掉落成本乘数：0.98 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 许可使用。

column1: Factory refit on Solaris S7 for a Collosseum Champion, this Fafnir forgoes basically all engine power to replace its Movement with Mechanical Jump Boosters, turning it into something of a Flying Turret. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这台 Fafnir 是为角斗场冠军在 Solaris S7 工厂改装的。它几乎放弃了全部引擎动力，用机械跳跃助推器取代常规移动能力，变成了某种飞行炮塔。 怪癖：精确武器 - AC 掉落成本乘数：1.24 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: An all energy variant of the -1A, replacing the missile launchers and Medium Pulse Lasers with two Large Improved Heavy Lasers. The cooling is not improved, however, leaving the 'Mech susceptible to overheating. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.38 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是 -1A 的纯能量变体，用两门大型改进型重型激光器替换了导弹发射器和中型脉冲激光器。不过冷却能力没有改善，使机甲容易过热。 怪癖：指挥机甲 掉落成本乘数：1.38 手臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: This version uses five Improved Jump Jets to provide a 150 meter jump radius. It carries nineteen double heat sinks to dissipate the heat from four Small Pulse Lasers, two ER Large Lasers, a Large Pulse Laser, and an LB 10-X Autocannon. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 该版本使用五具改进型跳跃喷气机，提供 150 米的跳跃半径。它携带十九个双散热器，用于消散四门小型脉冲激光器、两门 ER 大型激光器、一门大型脉冲激光器和一门 LB 10-X 自动加农炮产生的热量。 怪癖：坚固 掉落成本乘数：1.16 手臂执行器限制：全方位

column1: Built for Solaris by Barrymore Munitions, this Marauder replaces the usual autocannon with a large mech mortar. The rest of the loadout is dedicated to flexibility, carrying a bit of just about everything. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这台掠夺者由 Barrymore Munitions 为 Solaris 制造，用一门大型机甲迫击炮替换了通常的自动加农炮。其余装载专注于灵活性，几乎什么武器都带了一点。 怪癖：窄/低调 掉落成本乘数：1.13 手臂执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Maxwell MXW-775 mounts a Gauss Rifle backed by five medium lasers, allowing it to fire continuously without heat trouble. Its main weakness lies in ammunition, carrying only a single ton to feed the rifle, leaving little room for sustained engagements once that runs dry. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: Maxwell MXW-775 安装一挺高斯步枪，并由五门中型激光器辅助，因此能够持续射击而不用担心过热。它的主要弱点是弹药，仅携带一吨供步枪使用；弹药耗尽后，几乎没有余力进行持久交战。 怪癖：受保护的执行器 掉落成本乘数：1.17

column1: You nod at Dr. Murad. "An excellent point, Doctor. The treatment certainly was an expensive endeavor. Reach out and see if they're interested in it."\n\nDarius and Dr. Murad immediately set to work arranging relief for the ailing shuttle.
column2: 你向穆拉德医生点头。“说得很好，医生。这种治疗确实代价高昂。联系他们，看看他们是否有兴趣。”\n\n达里乌斯和穆拉德医生立即开始为患病的穿梭机安排救援。

column1:
You nod at Dr. Murad. "An excellent point, Doctor. The treatment certainly was an expensive endeavor. Reach out and see if they're interested in it."

Darius and Dr. Murad immediately set to work arranging relief for the ailing shuttle.

Over the next several days, however, word of your decision trickles through the ship and not everyone agrees. Those who previously suffered through the Periphery Pox are especially loathe to extort payment from other victims of the unforgiving disease.
column2:
你向穆拉德医生点头。“说得很好，医生。这种治疗确实代价高昂。联系他们，看看他们是否有兴趣。”

达里乌斯和穆拉德医生立即开始为患病的穿梭机安排救援。

然而接下来的几天里，你的决定逐渐传遍全船，并非所有人都赞同。那些曾饱受边疆瘟疫折磨的人尤其不愿向同样遭受这种无情疾病的受害者勒索费用。

column1:
You nod at Dr. Murad. "We're only one bad bug away from the same situation ourselves. Make arrangements for a transfer of supplies."

Over the next several days, word trickles through the ship about your decision and the large contingent of lifelong spacers in the crew express their support.

Sumire also passes along a message of thanks from the planet's surface for resolving the situation favorably.
column2:
你向穆拉德医生点头。“我们离同样的处境只差一场严重的传染病。安排转移物资。”

接下来的几天里，你的决定传遍全船，船员中那些一辈子在太空生活的人纷纷表示支持。

堇米蕾还转达了行星地表发来的感谢，感谢你妥善解决了这次事件。

column1: You nod at Dr. Murad. "We're only one bad bug away from the same situation ourselves. Make arrangements for a transfer of supplies."\n\nSeveral days later, Sumire passes along a message of thanks from the planet's surface for resolving the situation favorably.
column2: 你向穆拉德医生点头。“我们离同样的处境只差一场严重的传染病。安排转移物资。”\n\n几天后，堇米蕾转达了行星地表发来的感谢，感谢你妥善解决了这次事件。

column1:
You nod at Dr. Murad. "We've been here before, and we have a stash of antivirals in the MedBay to show for it. We have an obligation to pass on our good fortune. Make arrangements for a transfer of supplies."

Over the next several days, word trickles through the ship about your decision. Between the large contingent of lifelong spacers in the crew and those MechWarriors who survived their own personal brush with the Periphery Pox, there's a wave of support.

Sumire also passes along a message of thanks from the planet's surface for resolving the situation favorably.
column2:
你向穆拉德医生点头。“我们以前经历过这种事，医务舱里还留着抗病毒药物就是证明。我们有义务把这份好运传递下去。安排转移物资。”

接下来的几天里，你的决定传遍全船。船员中有大量终身太空人，还有曾亲身挺过边疆瘟疫的机甲战士，支持声如潮水般涌来。

堇米蕾还转达了行星地表发来的感谢，感谢你妥善解决了这次事件。

column1:
After almost a full day of meticulous searching by the customs crew, their officer approaches you, clipboard in hand. You can see mostly red check marks on the list.

He clicks his pen rapidly in annoyance. "Commander, you run a sloppy ship here. Nevertheless, I'm prepared to let you enter the port. After we've finished confiscating the following items and you've paid a fine."

As expected, they've discovered a number of illicit materials on board, as well as a broad list of "infractions" with vague descriptions. This won't help your reputation with the local government.
column2:
海关人员进行了近一整天细致搜查后，他们的长官拿着清单来到你面前。你看到清单上大多是红色勾选。

他恼火地快速按动笔。“指挥官，你把这艘船管理得很马虎。不过我准备放你们进港，前提是我们没收以下物品，而且你得缴纳罚款。”

不出所料，他们在船上发现了不少违禁物资，还列出一长串描述含糊的‘违规事项’。这会损害你在当地政府中的声誉。

column1: After an hour of somewhat indifferent searching by the customs crew, their officer approaches you, clipboard in hand. You can see mostly green check marks on the list.\n\nHe gives a click of his heels and a polite nod. "Commander, you run a tight ship here. I'm prepared to let you enter the port. Thank-you for your cooperation."
column2: 海关人员进行了一小时颇为敷衍的搜查后，他们的长官拿着清单来到你面前。你看到清单上大多是绿色勾选。\n\n他并拢脚跟，礼貌地点头。“指挥官，你把这艘船管理得井井有条。我准备放你们进港。感谢配合。”

column1:
After several hours of thorough searching by the customs crew, their officer approaches you, clipboard in hand. You can see a mix of red and green check marks on the list.

He clicks his pen officiously. "Commander, you run an adequately respectable ship here. I'm prepared to let you enter the port. After we've finished confiscating the following items and you've paid a small fine."

As expected, they've discovered a number of illicit materials on board, mostly among the personal effects of your MechWarriors. This won't sit well with the crew.
column2:
海关人员进行了数小时彻底搜查后，他们的长官拿着清单来到你面前。你看到清单上红绿勾选交错。

他一本正经地按动笔。“指挥官，你把这艘船管理得还算体面。我准备放你们进港，前提是我们没收以下物品，而且你得缴纳一笔小额罚款。”

不出所料，他们在船上发现了不少违禁物资，大多藏在机甲战士的个人物品中。这可不会让船员们高兴。

column1: Darius grumbles to you as the port authorities depart the ship. "Those fees look a lot like state-sanctioned bribes to me."\n\nYang flips through the paperwork they left behind and holds up a coupon card for the local entertainment district. "Now, that's the forces of law and order for you."
column2: 港口当局离舰后，达里乌斯对你抱怨道：“这些费用在我看来很像国家授权的贿赂。”\n\n杨翻着他们留下的文件，举起一张当地娱乐区的优惠卡。“这就是所谓的法律与秩序。”

column1: Sumire explains the unpleasant variation in the usual planetary approach. "Commander, the port authorities want to search us. Apparently the Argo's gotten onto a watch-list because of our tendency to be spotted in the company of pirates. If we choose not to comply, we're going to pay a hefty fine." Yang sounds skeptical. "If they do search us, I bet they're going to find something to complain about -- real or not." Darius has been notably quiet. "Or... we can try to bribe the inspectors." He grins. "I can work some connections to try to arrange for a sympathetic ear when they come aboard."
column2: 堇米蕾解释着这次不同寻常的行星接近流程。“指挥官，港口当局要搜查我们。显然，阿戈号因为经常和海盗一起出现而被列入监视名单。如果我们拒绝配合，就得缴纳巨额罚款。” 杨听起来将信将疑。“如果他们真的搜查，我敢打赌他们肯定会找到些可以抱怨的东西——不管是真是假。” 达里乌斯异常安静。“或者……我们可以试着贿赂检查员。”他咧嘴一笑。“我可以动用一些关系，设法让他们登船时遇到愿意通融的人。”

column1:
Sumire reports a call for help from a nearby ship. "It's another ship that's contracted the Periphery Pox."

Darius begins to speak, but Dr. Murad cuts him off. "I know what our XO will say." She continues in a perfect imitation of Darius, "We went to the trouble of developing this serum, let's make back some of that investment!"

With a smile, Darius plays along. "Speaking for our dear Dr. Murad, we've suffered from the Pox ourselves. Let's give away our serum, and maybe the locals will smile at us afterward."

Dr. Murad finishes with, "If we do sell the serum, I think we could easily get ¢80k."
column2:
堇米蕾报告说附近一艘船发来求助。“又有一艘船染上了边疆瘟疫。”

达里乌斯刚要开口，穆拉德医生便打断了他。“我知道我们的副执行官会说什么。”她继续用完美的达里乌斯口吻说道：“我们费了那么大力气研发这种血清，当然要收回一部分投入！”

达里乌斯笑着配合道：“替我们亲爱的穆拉德医生说一句：我们自己也遭受过瘟疫。把血清送给他们吧，也许当地人之后会对我们友善些。”

穆拉德医生补充道：“如果出售血清，我想轻松就能卖到¢80k。”

column1:
You lay out the plan. "Send the lead inspectors to meet in my office while their people conduct the search."

Sumire grins. "Individuals are always easier to bribe than institutions."

Hours later, after a little smooth talking, a refreshing drink, a glance at a compad, and a small crate waiting at the airlock, Darius looks over the results of the inspection. "All green check marks as far as the eye can see. Ah, the forces of law and order."
column2:
你说明计划。“让首席检查员到我办公室来，他们的人负责搜查。”

堇米蕾咧嘴一笑。“个人总是比机构更容易贿赂。”

数小时后，经过一番圆滑交涉、一杯提神饮料、瞥一眼数据板，以及气闸旁等候的一只小箱子，达里乌斯查看检查结果。“目之所及全是绿色勾选。啊，这就是所谓的法律与秩序。”

column1:
You lay out the plan. "Send the lead inspectors to meet in my office while their people conduct the search."

Sumire grins. "Individuals are always easier to bribe than institutions."

Sometimes, however, they're stubborn, self-righteous prigs. After an embarrassing scene in your office, your company is fined for attempted bribery, as well as a minor infraction the inspectors spotted in your office.

Darius looks over the results of the inspection. "Red check marks all the way down. Some days you just can't win."
column2:
你说明计划。“让首席检查员到我办公室来，他们的人负责搜查。”

堇米蕾咧嘴一笑。“个人总是比机构更容易贿赂。”

不过有时他们也会是顽固、自以为是的蠢货。在你办公室发生了一场尴尬闹剧后，公司因企图行贿以及检查员在你办公室发现的一项轻微违规而被罚款。

达里乌斯查看检查结果。“一路都是红色勾选。有些日子就是怎么都赢不了。”

column1: You look at Sumire, "I guess we prepare to jump...!" The jump clock slowly counts down... 3... 2... 1..." Moments later, the jumpship's KF Drive activates and that quesy feeling when jumping through space washes over your body. As your vision returns post jump, Darius calls out, "The Captain of the jumpship is furious and is going to file a report with the Mercenary Review Board and the Commercial JumpShip Travel Authority as soon as they finish their shipwide diagnostics and damage assessment." You look out the viewport, seeing a totally different system than the one you expected, "Where the F..." Sumire interupts your outburst, "Commander, it appears we are now in the [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] system, which is over 810 light years away from the closest known civilised system of Ksabi! All stations are reporting operational as well, so we do not appear to have suffered any noticable damage from the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMisjump],misjump]]. You look at Sumire and Dr Murad, both of whom wanted the Console installed, "My head hurts from all of this." You turn to Darius, "Plot a path back to civilisation. I'll be in my office. "
column2: 你看向堇米蕾。“看来我们得准备跳跃了……！” 跳跃倒计时缓缓进行……3……2……1……片刻后，跳船的KF驱动启动，穿越空间时那阵恶心感席卷全身。 视线在跳跃后恢复，达里乌斯喊道：“跳船船长气疯了，等完成全船诊断和损伤评估后，就会向佣兵审查委员会和商业跳船旅行管理局提交报告。” 你望向舷窗，看到的完全是另一个系统，不是你预期的那个。“这他妈……” 堇米蕾打断你的叫喊：“指挥官，我们现在似乎位于[[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]]系统，这里距离已知文明系统Ksabi最近也有810多光年！ 所有站点都报告运转正常，因此我们似乎没有因[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMisjump],误跳]]遭受任何明显损伤。 你看向堇米蕾和穆拉德医生，她们当初都希望安装控制台。“这一切弄得我头疼。” 你转向达里乌斯。“规划一条回到文明世界的航线。我去办公室。”

column1: You mull over everything Howe Zeng has just outlined to you, while glancing through the precise data on the noteputer. As you hand the noteputer back to Darius, you turn towards Howe, "Thank you for this information. I think we will need to go with the Cost Saver Package. We are on a pretty tight budget and while I realize there are potential risks and issues, the savings will go towards keeping {COMPANY.CompanyName} afloat. Darius, make the arrangements." Darius nods as he escorts Mr Zeng back to her DropShip, "Understood, Commander" GAMMA POD UPGRADE UNLOCKED VISIT ENGINEERING TO BEGIN UPGRADE CONSTRUCTION
column2: 你一边回想着豪·曾刚才向你说明的一切，一边浏览数据板上的精确数据。你把数据板递还给达里乌斯，转向豪。“谢谢你的信息。我想我们需要选择节省成本方案。预算相当紧张，我知道其中存在潜在风险和问题，但节省下来的钱能帮助{COMPANY.CompanyName}维持运转。达里乌斯，安排一下。” 达里乌斯护送曾先生返回他的运输船时点头道：“明白，指挥官。” 伽马舱升级已解锁 前往工程部开始建造升级

Darius gives Dr. Murad a pointed look, but they both keep any further thoughts to themselves.

Over the next several days, word trickles through the ship about your decision, leading to heated arguments on both side.

column1: [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] crosses through the docking hatch to board the Moirai, stopping at the closed hatchway to proceed further into the ship. The hatch behind {SCN_MW.OBJ} closes, and a gas billows out from the overhead vent. {SCN_MW.SUBJ_C} tries to cover {SCN_MW.DET} face, but {SCN_MW.SUBJ} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} soon rendered unconscious. ::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::Back on the ARGO:::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: Darius knocks at the open doorway to your office, then enters, "Commander, there is an incoming priority message from Front Man." You look up, "Patch it through, Darius." Darius punches in some information on the terminal next to the large display screen mounted on the wall in your office, "Transmission coming in now, Commander." The black screen shimmers to life, the blurry images slowly taking focus. The image resolves into a view of [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], slumped in a chair. You and Darius are glued to the screen watching the events unfold: ::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::Hidden game arena on [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]]:::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] awakens and discovers that {SCN_MW.SUBJ} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} chained to a desk in front of a mirror that fills the wall. One hand is secured to the chair, the other is extended and secured to the desk. Within reach of {SCN_MW.Det} fingers are four buttons with a different symbol on each: CIRCLE, SQUARE, TRIANGLE, STAR. Also mounted on the desk, pointed directly at the mirror is a [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlazerLaserPistol],Blazer Laser Pistol]], which is wired to a panel above the buttons. The comms panel activates, and a digitized voice speaks, "Welcome Player 203. The game you are about to play is called Mirror, Mirror. The rules of the game are simple. You are pitted against your opponent, seated on the opposite side of the mirror in front of you. When the game starts, the buttons will be active and you must press one of the four buttons before your opponent presses theirs. The winner is the player who can press the correct button, the fastest." [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] tries to move {SCN_MW.DET} head to look around, but it is strapped to the high back of the chair. {SCN_MW.SUBJ_C} can only use {SCN_MW.DET} eyes to scan the small room, which is empty of anything else. The comms activate, "The game will begin in 3... 2... 1... column2: [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]穿过对接舱门登上莫伊莱号，在关闭的舱门前停下，准备继续深入舰内。{SCN_MW.OBJ}身后的舱门关闭，气体从头顶通风口涌出。[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]试图捂住{SCN_MW.DET}的脸，但很快{SCN_MW.SUBJ}便{SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:失去意识|Default:失去意识}。 ::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::回到阿戈号:::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: 达里乌斯敲了敲你办公室敞开的门，随后走进来。“指挥官，有来自Front Man的优先级消息。” 你抬头。“接进来，达里乌斯。” 达里乌斯在办公室墙上大型显示屏旁的终端输入信息。“现在接入传输，指挥官。” 黑色屏幕闪烁着亮起，模糊影像逐渐聚焦。画面变成[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]瘫坐在椅子上的影像。你和达里乌斯紧盯屏幕，看着事态展开： ::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::[[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]]上的秘密游戏场:::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]醒来，发现{SCN_MW.SUBJ}被铐在一张桌子前，面前是一面占满整面墙的镜子。一只手被固定在椅子上，另一只手伸出固定在桌面。{SCN_MW.Det}的手指触手可及处有四个按钮，每个按钮上都有不同符号：圆形、方形、三角形、星形。桌上还安装着一把直指镜子的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlazerLaserPistol],光刃激光手枪]]，并连接到按钮上方的面板。 通讯面板启动，数字化声音说道：“欢迎，203号玩家。你即将参加的游戏名为镜中镜。规则很简单。你的对手坐在镜子另一侧、你正对面的位置。游戏开始后，按钮会被激活，你必须在对手按下按钮前按下四个按钮中的一个。谁能最快按下正确按钮，谁就是赢家。” [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]试图转动{SCN_MW.DET}的头观察四周，但头部被绑在高背椅上。[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]只能用{SCN_MW.DET}的眼睛扫视这间小房间，里面空无一物。 通讯器启动，“游戏将在3……2……1……后开始。” ::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::回到阿戈号:::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: ::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::信号丢失:::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: 回到阿戈号，你从椅子上跳起来，大喊：“不！达里乌斯，立刻重新建立连接！” 达里乌斯疯狂地在终端上输入：“正在处理，指挥官！” ::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::[[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]]上的秘密游戏场:::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]将{SCN_MW.DET}的手指伸向前方，决定……

column1: You look Front Man directly in the face, "How much?" Front Man looks intrigued, "How much for what, my dear Commander?" "How much to buy [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]'s marker? No strings, no further obligations," you state succinctly. Front Man steeples his fingers, "You would be willing to bail [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] out of the hole they dug themselves into? Interesting... very well, if you wish to end this here an now it will cost you ¢1,199,932. My assistant has just sent you the account details." You turn to Darius, "Make the transfer." Darius types in some information into the console, then nods, "Transfer complete Commander." Front Man looks away for a minute before turning back to you, "The deal is done, Commander. You are an interesting one, I do so hope we meet again!" As you kill the connection, you state, "The feeling is NOT mutual." The holocom connection closes. [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] rushes over and grabs your hand, "Thank you! I... I do not know what to say!" You smile at [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], "Just do your job and be the best MechWarrior you can. Oh, and no more gambling!" [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] cannot keep the smile of {SCN_MW.OBJ} face, "Absolutely Commander!"
column2: 你直视Front Man的脸：“多少钱？” Front Man饶有兴致：“什么多少钱，亲爱的指挥官？” 你简洁地说：“买下[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]的赌债要多少钱？不附带条件，也没有后续义务。” Front Man十指交叉：“你愿意把[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]从自己挖的坑里捞出来？有意思……好吧，如果你想现在就结束这一切，需要支付¢1,199,932. 我的助理刚刚把账户详情发给你。” 你转向达里乌斯：“进行转账。” 达里乌斯在控制台输入信息，随后点头：“转账完成，指挥官。” Front Man移开视线片刻后转回来：“交易完成了，指挥官。你真有意思，希望我们还能再见！” 切断连接时，你说道：“我可完全没这种感觉。”全息通信随之关闭。 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]冲过来抓住你的手：“谢谢！我……我都不知道该说什么！” 你对[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]微笑：“做好你的工作，成为最优秀的机甲战士。还有，不许再赌博！” [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]脸上的笑容怎么也藏不住：“遵命，指挥官！”

"20 Seconds Remaining..." {SCN_MW.SUBJ_C} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:close|Default:closes} {SCN_MW.DET} eyes and mumbles what appears to be a prayer. "15 Seconds Remaining..." [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] opens {SCN_MW.DET} eyes and stares intently at the reflection of the wires in the mirror, quickly inspecting each one, hoping for some sign of which is the correct wire to cut. "10 Seconds Remaining..." {SCN_MW.SUBJ_C} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} about to choose a wire when... "Players 17, 36, 54, 112, 185 and 247 have been eliminated." "7 Seconds Remaining..." {SCN_MW.Subj_C} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:grab|Default:grabs} the BLACK wire and puts the wire snips in position to cut it.. "Players 12, 82, 136, 215 and 249 have been eliminated." "3 Seconds Remaining..." {SCN_MW.SUBJ_C} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:close|Default:closes} {SCN_MW.DET} eyes and cuts the BLACK wire... ::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::Back on the ARGO:::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: The holo-feed screen flares bright white and a resounding boom pops through the speakers. Slowly, the screen comes back into focus. Lying on the floor, in a pool of gore and blood is the headless body of [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]. {SCN_MW.SUBJ_C} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} only identifiable by the bloodstained PLAYER 203 on {SCN_MW.DET} shirt. The holo-feed continues to flicker, obviously damaged by the explosion. A voice is heard, "Player 203, Eliminated." You watch as Darius, Sumire, Dr Murad and Yang stare at the holo-feed in stunned silence, before dropping yourself into your chair at your desk, mumbling various expletives more to yourself than anyone in the room. Yang breaks the silence, "That has to be the dumbest thing I think I have ever witnessed! Who would concoct such a game?" Dr Murad speaks up, barely able to talk without choking up, "Actually Yang, these types of games are spread throughout history. On Terra, there was a game called Russian Roulette which involved a rotary firearm and a single round, and each participant pointing the weapon at the other one until it eventually fired on a loaded chamber. These games offer similar odds along with a permanent result. Another is one in the history books of Circinus where..." Yang interrupts, "Stow it Doc! It is stupid and idiotic." A PING alert sounds on the comm panel at your desk. You move over to it and see an automated text message. It appears to be from Front Man. You click OPEN to read the message: My condolences, Commander {Commander.Lastname}. Since you are reading this message, it means that [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] did not survive ROUND 2 of the game. Know that {SCN_MW.DET} debt is now paid in full, and there will be no further reparations needed on {SCN_MW.DET} behalf. In fact, we will be giving you and your crew, a consolation prize. When [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] left on our dropship, we left behind a crate. You will find it magnetically attached to your hull outside the docking collar we used to pick up [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]. It is a shame the game did not go the full term, we could have made so much more money and your prize would have been that much greater. Regards, Front Man You lean back in your chair, exhausted from the watching the ordeal that [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] went through, "Advise the crew, they need to know that [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] is not returning to us. We need to get past this and get on get on with our jobs." As Darius and the others leave, you cannot help but wonder if your path will cross Front Man's again.

column1: A close-range fighter with the added role of anti-infantry striker, this configuration features a right arm mounted large pulse laser, a pair of AP Gauss rifles split between the arms, two ER medium lasers, and a flamer mounted in the left arm. column2: 近距离战斗兼反步兵突击型，右臂装大型脉冲激光，双臂分装两把AP高斯步枪，另有两门ER中型激光和左臂火焰喷射器；八具改进跳跃喷射器帮助其接近目标。 特性：分散注意 部署费用倍率： 1.04

column1: A co-operation between Brigadier and Bandar BattleMechs, the -9R sports a 325 XXL engine and XL gyro to leave a lot of weight for weapons yet reach very high top speeds. The full armament consists of a LRM-15, a light PPC and a Machine Gun in each arm, and two SRM-6 mounted in the legs. The 3.5 ton of combined ammunition is protected by a CASE II. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: Brigadier与Bandar机甲合作打造的-9R配备325级XXL引擎和XL陀螺仪，在保持极高极速的同时为武器留出大量重量。武器包括LRM-15、轻型PPC及双臂各一挺机枪，腿部安装两具SRM-6；3.5吨弹药由CASE II保护。 特性：稳定武器 部署费用倍率： 1.09

column1: A common Periphery rebuild, this mech is a mix of different weapons systems. A primitive medium laser copied from the original Wasp model provides subpar firepower, backed up by the one shot punch of an RL15. A small calibre rifle makes for a semi effective sniper weapon whilst its ammo lasts. The rest of the mech is almost standard spec, rebuilt by a succession of engineers to specs nearly identical to Inner Sphere counterparts. Surprisingly enough, this rebuild offers somewhat superior capabilities compared to most Inner Sphere models. Produced in any number of Periphery junk yards and back alley chop shops, this mech is incredibly common amongst periphery factions; who field the mech in vast quantities, praising its cheap firepower and easily repaired chassis. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

Like the 4C, this variant adds an Artemis IV FCS to the LRM-5. The D, however, upgrades the lasers to ER Medium Lasers. Due to space constraints, the 4D uses twelve single heat sinks that are sorely taxed. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

Built with a mixture of periphery and advanced tech, the center piece of this mech are the heavy rocket launchers that enable this mech to go toe to toe with foes, many times it’s weight class. It’s relatively high cost and limited production, has so far kept it confined to the more advanced periphery nations. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

column1: A complete redesign of the Ostroc, the 4L carries the best technology the Capellan Confederation has to offer in 3067. It uses an Ceresplex Ostroc Light Endo Steel chassis to carry two Martell ER Large Lasers and two Ceres Arms ER Medium Lasers split between the side torsos. Five HildCo 13 jump jets split between the side and center torsos gives it a jumping distance of 180 meters. Finally, the 4L Ostroc has a Guardian ECM Suite for electronics warfare use and also to work with ten and a half tons of Stealth Armor which makes it extremely difficult to hit. While it was originally suppose to use only standard armor, the addition of stealth capabilities makes this variant well suited for operating as a member of Capellan Shadow Lances. For electronics the Ostroc carries the Ceres Metals Model 686 and Ceres Bullseye systems. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: Ostroc的彻底重制型，4L采用联盟最先进技术，装备两门ER大型激光、两门ER中型激光、五具跳跃喷射器，并配备Guardian ECM和10.5吨隐形装甲。 特性：Narrow/Low Profile 部署费用倍率： 1.08

column1: A complete redesign of the Ostsol unveiled in 3064, the 6D is powered by a GM 300 XL engine and is built using triple strength myomer, which push the 'Mech's top speed to 97.2 km/h when operating in its optimum heat range. Carrying fourteen double heat sinks, the 'Mech is protected with eleven and a half tons of StarGuard Ferro-Fibrous armor. The weapons payload of the 6D consists of two Diverse Optics ER Large Lasers, two Diverse Optics ER Medium Lasers, two Magna 600P Medium Pulse Lasers, and two Magna 200P Small Pulse Lasers. The extended-range lasers are split between the side torsos, the medium pulses split between right torso and head, and both small pulse systems are in the center torso. All of these weapons are linked to an advanced Targeting Computer, making them more accurate at range. The valuable but aging TRSS 2L3 targeting system could not function properly with the targeting computer, however, requiring its replacement with a Federated Stalker system. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08

column1: {COMMANDER.FirstName}! It's poker night! Darius is prowling outside your quarters as you return after dinner.\n\nPoker night. Darius first insisted because he said it would help 'keep his skills sharp.' He doesn't always win, so perhaps he's right. It's usually the senior staff he ropes into playing, although occasionally some other 'lucky' crew member or guest is invited to the table. But you're the boss. He can't make you play.
column2: “{COMMANDER.FirstName}！今晚打扑克！”晚餐后你回到舱房，达里乌斯正在门外徘徊。\n\n扑克之夜。达里乌斯坚持举办，是因为他说这能“保持他的技巧”。他并不是总能获胜，所以或许他说得没错。通常他会拉上高级职员一起玩，偶尔也会邀请其他“幸运”的船员或客人入席。但你是老板，他不能强迫你参加。

column1: I've got other plans this evening, Darius, you say.\n\n"Excellent," says Darius. "I wasn't sure I could win if you were there tonight." He pauses, cocking an eyebrow to see if you're biting. When you just shake your head and smile, he says, "Damn!" and goes off to round up everybody else, leaving you to yourself for the evening.
column2: “今晚我另有安排，达里乌斯。”你说道。\n\n“太好了。”达里乌斯说，“我还不确定你在场时自己能不能赢。”他停下来，挑眉观察你是否会上钩。你只是摇头微笑，他便说：“该死！”然后去召集其他人，把你独自留在今晚的舱房里。

column1:
This is just a friendly game, Darius intones as he shuffles the deck of cards.

You lean forward. "Speak for yourself. I'm here to win."

Dr. Murad, who only attends to socialize, soon vanishes, and Yang is out early, but the bout between you, Sumire and Darius goes late into the night. 

Eventually Sumire shakes her head. "I have to get some sleep," and withdraws, stalking away from the game table. 

Shortly after that, Darius says, "You win, Commander. This time. That was an excellent game. I'll see you in about three hours for our daily meeting." He too departs, leaving you alone with a big pile of chips representing some of your staff's earnings. They'll get them back again when you pay them next, anyhow.
column2:
“这只是友谊赛。”达里乌斯一边洗牌一边说道。

你身体前倾。“那是你的看法。我来这里是为了赢。”

穆拉德博士只是来社交，很快便离开了；杨也早早出局，但你、菫和达里乌斯之间的对局一直持续到深夜。

最终菫摇摇头。“我得睡觉了。”她说着退出牌局，快步离开牌桌。

不久后达里乌斯说道：“你赢了，指挥官。这次赢得很漂亮。三小时后日常会议见。”他也离开了，只留下你和一大堆筹码，那代表着部分职员的收入。反正下次发薪时他们就会拿回去。

column1:
This is just a friendly game, Darius intones as he shuffles the deck of cards.

You lean forward. "Speak for yourself. I'm here to win." 

Dr. Murad, who only attends to socialize, soon vanishes, and Yang is out early, but the bout between you, Sumire and Darius goes late into the night.

Sumire doesn't miss a beat tonight, either. "The biggest advantage you have in your negotiations," she says to Darius as she collects another pot, "is that your victims don't know you like I do."

"You've just been lucky," Darius says, frowning.

"Keep telling yourself that and play another hand," Sumire challenges. But Darius does a bit of math and withdraws. You wisely follow him out, leaving Sumire snickering in front of her winnings.
column2:
“这只是友谊赛。”达里乌斯一边洗牌一边说道。

你身体前倾。“那是你的看法。我来这里是为了赢。”

穆拉德博士只是来社交，很快便离开了；杨也早早出局，但你、菫和达里乌斯之间的对局一直持续到深夜。

今晚菫也毫不手软。“你谈判时最大的优势，”她收走又一池筹码，对达里乌斯说，“就是你的受害者不了解你，而我了解。”

“你只是走运。”达里乌斯皱眉说道。

“继续这样安慰自己，再来一局。”菫挑衅道。但达里乌斯算了算，选择退出。你明智地跟着他离开，只留下菫在自己的战利品前窃笑。

column1:
This is just a friendly game, Darius intones as he shuffles the deck of cards.

You lean forward. "Speak for yourself. I'm here to win." 

Dr. Murad, who only attends to socialize, soon vanishes, and Yang is out early, but the bout between you, Sumire and Darius goes late into the night. Eventually Darius, master negotiator, talks both you and Sumire into giving up the fight and heading to bed.

"He would have won everything eventually anyhow," Sumire says, as the two of you leave Darius smugly counting the largest pile of chips.
column2:
“这只是友谊赛。”达里乌斯一边洗牌一边说道。

你身体前倾。“那是你的看法。我来这里是为了赢。”

穆拉德博士只是来社交，很快便离开了；杨也早早出局，但你、菫和达里乌斯之间的对局一直持续到深夜。最终，谈判大师达里乌斯说服你和菫放弃对局去睡觉。

“反正他迟早会赢走一切。”菫说道。你们离开时，达里乌斯正得意地数着那堆最大的筹码。

column1: Darius cracks open a new deck of cards. "Because not everybody here follows the rules." You blink innocently, consider the mental state of your staff, and decide how you want the game to resolve. Despite close scrutiny, it isn't hard for you to throw the game to Yang. Your Chief MechTech enjoys himself hugely, crowing over each hand he wins and refusing to believe that you've been manipulating the game. The final hand is played shortly before midnight and Yang goes off to his quarters whistling. "That was fun," you say. "Look how happy he is. You two don't really mind, do you?" Darius gives you a hard smile. "Of course not, Commander. I was playing from the company's petty cash fund." "Hey!" Sumire says, outraged. "Next time let me in on that!"
column2: 达里乌斯拆开一副新牌。“因为这里不是每个人都遵守规则。”你无辜地眨眨眼，考虑着职员们的精神状态，决定让牌局如何收场。 尽管你受到了严密监视，但把牌局输给杨并不难。你的首席机修师玩得极其开心，每赢一手就欢呼雀跃，完全不相信你在操纵牌局。最终一手在午夜前不久结束，杨吹着口哨回了自己的舱房。 “真有意思。”你说，“看他多开心。你们两个不会介意吧？” 达里乌斯露出僵硬的笑容。“当然不，指挥官。我用的是公司的零用金。” “嘿！”菫气愤地说，“下次也让我参与！”

column1: Darius cracks open a new deck of cards. "Because not everybody here follows the rules." You blink innocently, consider the mental state of your staff, and decide how you want the game to resolve. You have to play carefully to give Sumire the game, because neither she nor Darius trusts you at the table. But Yang inadvertently helps, over and over, and Sumire is happy enough to accept each hand she wins. After the game concludes and only you and Darius are left finishing your drinks, you say, "Have you noticed how the MechWarriors pick up on Sumire's moods? How can you mind losing when the whole ship is happier this way?" Darius gives you a hard smile. "I don't mind, Commander. I was playing from the company's petty cash fund."
column2: 达里乌斯拆开一副新牌。“因为这里不是每个人都遵守规则。”你无辜地眨眨眼，考虑着职员们的精神状态，决定让牌局如何收场。 你必须小心翼翼地把牌局输给菫，因为她和达里乌斯都不信任牌桌上的你。但杨无意中一次又一次地帮了忙，菫也欣然接受每一手胜利。牌局结束后，只剩你和达里乌斯喝完手中的酒，你说：“你注意到机甲战士会察觉菫的情绪吗？全船因为这样更开心，你怎么会介意输掉？” 达里乌斯露出僵硬的笑容。“我不介意，指挥官。我用的是公司的零用金。”

column1: Despite being designed by the Star League before the Exodus, the Dragon Fire was not seen in the Inner Sphere until the 3050s. However, an updated version of the original Star League design was developed as proposed to Clan leadership during the Golden Century but was never adopted in favor of Omnimechs designs. Not willing to give up on the design, several members of the Society continued redesigning the Dragon Fire in secret. By the Wars of Reaving, the Dragon Fire IIC Omnimech is vastly more advanced than it's Inner Sphere cousin. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 尽管龙火由大迁徙前的星盟设计，却直到3050年代才在内太阳圈出现。然而，黄金世纪期间有人向氏族领导层提议开发原始星盟设计的更新版，但最终因全向机甲设计而未被采用。不愿放弃该设计，社会的数名成员继续秘密重新设计龙火。到掠夺战争时期，龙火IIC全向机甲已远超其内太阳圈近亲。 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.2 手臂作动器限制：全向

column1: First known to have been deployed in 3073, the Rogue Bear is a battle armor design produced by Clan Ghost Bear. Initially confused for the Golem, the Rogue Bear is a heavy battlesuit that was initially deployed with garrison units, especially those of the KungsArmé who were incorporated into the Ghost Bear touman. The Rogue Bear can jump up to sixty meters at a time. It is protected by almost enough armor to stop a Gauss rifle. The battlesuit uses mostly standard components with no disposable weaponry. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.935 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: 已知最早于3073年部署的流浪熊，是由幽灵熊氏族生产的战斗装甲设计。最初被误认为魔像，流浪熊是一种重型战斗服，最初与驻防部队一起部署，尤其是被纳入幽灵熊图曼的KungsArmé部队。流浪熊一次可跳跃达60米。它拥有几乎足以抵挡高斯步枪的装甲。该战斗服主要采用标准部件，不配备一次性武器。 特性：标准部件 部署成本倍率：0.935 可安装全向单位，可近战，不可群袭。

column1:
In the daily briefing, Sumire brings up an open hail from a nearby ship. "They say their crew has contracted a virulent case of the Periphery Pox, but the local government is preventing them from landing to receive medical care."

Darius shrugs. "We could sell them some of our medical supplies. It would limit us in the MedBay for a bit, but given their situation, I expect they'd pay up."

Dr. Murad bristles at this suggestion. "Spacers should stick together, Commander. Besides, the local authorities might appreciate our generosity."
column2:
在日常简报中，菫提到附近一艘飞船发来的公开呼叫。“他们说船员感染了严重的外围瘟疫，但当地政府不允许他们着陆接受医疗。”

达里乌斯耸耸肩。“我们可以卖给他们一些医疗用品。这样会让我们的医疗舱暂时受限，但考虑到他们的处境，我想他们会付钱。”

穆拉德博士对这个建议很不满。“太空人应该互相帮助，指挥官。而且当地当局或许会感激我们的慷慨。”

column1: Inspired by the success of the Clan Hell's Horses' Black Hawk design, Clan Diamond Shark developed what is in essence a simplified, non-Omni version of the older Mist Lynx OmniMech. Primarily for sale to Inner Sphere customers, the Hell's Horses marketing ploy of adopting a familiar designation the 'Mech was dubbed the Koshi, a decision that did not sit well with many of the more conservative members of the Clan. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 受地狱之马氏族黑鹰设计成功的启发，钻石鲨氏族开发了一款本质上是旧式Mist Lynx 全向机甲简化非全向版本的机体。它主要面向内太阳圈客户销售；借用地狱之马的营销手段，采用熟悉的名称，这台机甲被命名为Koshi，但氏族中许多保守成员对此颇为不满。 特性：窄型/低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：0.98

column1: Of the three designs that formed the Spectral LAM series built and deployed by the Word of Blake, the Yurei was the middleweight design Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: 由布莱克之言建造并部署的幽灵LAM系列包含三种设计，幽灵是其中的中型型号。 特性：陆空机甲 部署成本倍率：1.02

column1: One of Clan Coyotes contributions to the Homeworld Clans, the Telippa is a fast and well armoured heavy tank. A 75 ton wheeled Omni-Tank, the Telippa is powered by a 355 XXL and clad in 18 tons of Ferro Lamellor armour; giving it 27 tons of podspace. Known variants include: An ER PPC/iATM-12 combo augmented by an Angel ECM suit and 4 Machine Guns, a HAG/20 paired with 3 ER Medium Lasers and an iATM-9; and 2 iATM-12s mated to an ER Large Laser and an Angel ECM suit.Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 5/8 hexes / 150/240 meters. Armor: Ferro-Lamellor (C) Structure: Endo-Steel (C) Values A S Front 360 40 Left 285 40 Right 285 40 Rear 225 40 Turret 285 40 Total 1440 200 Quirk: Main Battle Tank
column2: 泰利帕是郊狼氏族献给本土氏族的设计之一，是一款快速且装甲厚重的重型坦克。作为75吨轮式全向坦克，泰利帕由355级XXL引擎驱动，覆盖18吨铁磁层叠装甲，拥有27吨吊舱空间。已知型号包括：由天使ECM套件和4挺机枪增强的ER PPC/iATM-12组合；HAG/20配3门ER中型激光器和一具iATM-9；以及两具iATM-12配一门ER大型激光器和天使ECM套件。经Aries Games and Miniatures许可使用。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：5/8格 / 150/240米。 装甲：铁磁层叠（C） 结构：内骨钢（C） 数值 A S 前方 360 40 左侧 285 40 右侧 285 40 后方 225 40 炮塔 285 40 总计 1440 200 特性：主战坦克

column1: Part of the Serpentus series of OmniVehicles. The Wraith Superheavy Hovercraft is designed as a Stealthed Support Platform. Equipped with an Experimental Vehicular Null Signature System, 24 tons of Turret podspace and a generous 6 tons of munitions secured in a CASE. Unlike other Word of Blake Tanks this does not have a DNI despite its Advanced Electronics. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 7/11 hexes / 210/330 meters. Armor: Vehicle Adv. Stealth Structure: Vehicle Composite Values A S Front 220 70 Left 210 70 Right 210 70 Rear 150 70 Turret 200 70 Total 990 350 Quirk: Main Battle Tank Omni Vehicle
column2: 幽灵超级重型悬浮艇属于蛇神系列全向载具，设计为隐形支援平台。它配备实验型载具零特征系统、24吨炮塔吊舱空间，以及由CASE保护的充裕6吨弹药。与其他布莱克之言坦克不同，尽管拥有先进电子设备，它没有DNI。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：7/11格 / 210/330米。 装甲：载具高级隐形 结构：载具复合 数值 A S 前方 220 70 左侧 210 70 右侧 210 70 后方 150 70 炮塔 200 70 总计 990 350 特性：主战坦克 全向载具

column1: Produced by Leopard Armor for the Word of Blake, the Red Shift is one of many new BattleMechs being fielded by the Word of Blake Militia. The Red Shift is designed to spot for the Padilla artillery tank, which is also built by Leopard Armor, with its TAG target designator. The Red Shift is built on a lightweight Leopard Mark I Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a GM 180 XL engine that pushes the 'Mech's top speed up to 151.2 km/h. To give the 'Mech the ability to protect itself from advanced electronic warfare systems, the Red Shift has a Guardian ECM Suite. For protection from conventional weapons, the Red Shift has four tons of 1/Star Slab Ferro-Fibrous armor. To dissipate the 'Mech's scant waste heat, the Red Shift is outfitted with ten heat sinks. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 红移由装甲豹公司为布莱克之言制造，是布莱克之言民兵部署的众多新型战斗机甲之一。红移以TAG目标指示器为同样由装甲豹建造的帕迪拉炮兵坦克进行引导。它采用轻型豹I型内骨钢底盘，由GM 180 XL引擎驱动，最高速度达到151.2公里/小时。为抵御先进电子战系统，红移配备Guardian ECM套件。为防御常规武器，红移拥有4吨1/星板铁磁纤维装甲。为耗散少量余热，红移配备10具散热器。 特性：通信增强 部署成本倍率：0.97 手臂作动器限制：左下臂，右下臂

column1: Produced on Terra by StarCorp Industries, the Quirinus is a late thirty-first century Medium battle armor which was originally produced for general sale. Developed as a mainline trooper in the early years of the Republic Era, the Quirinus was sold initially to the fractured Free Worlds League. While not as flashy as many of its contemporaries of its time, the suit is known for its reliability and as a good unit in the field. The battle armor would find its way into hands of mercenary units and elements of the Republic of the Sphere. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 奎里努斯由星际军团工业公司在泰拉生产，是31世纪末的中型战斗装甲，最初面向市场销售。它在共和国时代早期作为主力步兵开发，最初售予分裂的自由世界联盟。虽然不如同时代许多同类装备华丽，但该战斗服以可靠性和战场表现出色而闻名，后来进入佣兵部队和星球共和国部队手中。 特性：标准部件 部署成本倍率：0.888 可安装全向单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1: Produced on Terra by StarCorp Industries, the Quirinus is a late thirty-first century Medium battle armor which was originally produced for general sale. Developed as a mainline trooper in the early years of the Republic Era, the Quirinus was sold initially to the fractured Free Worlds League. While not as flashy as many of its contemporaries of its time, the suit is known for its reliability and as a good unit in the field. The battle armor would find its way into hands of mercenary units and elements of the Republic of the Sphere. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.89 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 奎里努斯由星际军团工业公司在泰拉生产，是31世纪末的中型战斗装甲，最初面向市场销售。它在共和国时代早期作为主力步兵开发，最初售予分裂的自由世界联盟。虽然不如同时代许多同类装备华丽，但该战斗服以可靠性和战场表现出色而闻名，后来进入佣兵部队和星球共和国部队手中。 特性：标准部件 部署成本倍率：0.89 可安装全向单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1: Slower than the Medium Tank, but possessing heavier armor and fire power, the Heavy Tank is a fearsome combatant. Packing a potent array of heavy weapons, the Heavy Tank is a serious threat to any Tank or Mech that encounters it. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Glazed (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 280 30 Left 235 30 Right 235 30 Rear 190 30 Turret 220 30 Total 1160 150 Quirk: Main Battle Tank
column2: 重型坦克比中型坦克速度更慢，却拥有更厚装甲和更强火力，是令人生畏的战斗单位。凭借强大的重型武器组合，重型坦克对任何遭遇它的坦克或机甲都是严重威胁。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：4/6格 / 120/180米。 装甲：镀层（C） 结构：结构 数值 A S 前方 280 30 左侧 235 30 右侧 235 30 后方 190 30 炮塔 220 30 总计 1160 150 特性：主战坦克

column1: So look Commander, this thing is a gigantic beast but it's really an IndustrialMech SLDF Prototype made for working on DropShips that is over 300 years old. I am not sure how _these_ fraggers have kept the thing running for 300 years, but I'm pretty sure one of the arms is like 6 legs of various UrbanMechs welded together. The ''armor'' is just the chest pieces of what has to be dozens of other mechs welded onto this freakshow. I have no idea why but the locals have been using it to build barns. For cows. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.32
column2: 所以，指挥官，这东西虽然是个巨大怪物，但其实是300多年前制造、用于在DropShip上工作的工业机甲星盟原型。我不知道这些混蛋是如何让它运行300年的，但我敢肯定其中一条手臂是把大约6条UrbanMech的腿焊在一起。所谓“装甲”只是几十台其他机甲的胸部部件焊到这个怪胎身上。我不知道为什么，当地人一直用它来建谷仓。给牛用的。 特性：扰乱 部署成本倍率：1.32

column1: Sumire catches your attention on the bridge. "Commander, I've picked up a distress call from a nearby civilian transport. It's not exactly our job to assist in matters like this, but we may be the nearest ship available."\n\nShe studies the display. "On the other hand, it looks like the ship's engines are in a critical state. They could explode before we get there."
column2: 菫在舰桥上引起你的注意。“指挥官，我接收到附近一艘民用运输船的求救信号。协助这种事务并非我们的职责，但我们可能是最近的可用船只。”\n\n她查看显示器。“另一方面，那艘船的引擎似乎处于危急状态。我们赶到前它们可能就会爆炸。”

column1: Taking inspiration from the R20 series of mechs, this Urbanmech was designed from the ground up to be a cheap and nasty ambusher aimed at the mercenary market. The combination of stealth armour and rockets allow it to savage targets and withdraw. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这台城市机甲受到R20系列机甲启发，从头开始设计为面向佣兵市场的廉价凶狠伏击者。隐形装甲与火箭的组合让它能够重创目标后撤离。 特性：360°躯干扭转 部署成本倍率：0.99 手臂作动器限制：左上臂，右上臂

column1: The 'jmy-wt', or Imiut, is a heavier OmniMech upgrade of the Anubis Scout Mech, sporting Clan grade Endo-Steel with a unique Stealth Suite integrated with its Ferro Fibrous Armor does it sport extreme agility and firepower to comparable Designs Quirk: OmniStealth Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: “jmy-wt”或伊米乌特，是一款更重型的阿努比斯侦察机甲全向升级版。它采用氏族级内骨钢，并将独特隐形套件整合进铁磁纤维装甲，具备相较同类设计更强的机动性与火力。 特性：全向隐形 部署成本倍率：1.03 手臂作动器限制：全向

column1: The Angerona Scout Suit was developed by StarCorp Industries on Terra. The suit was designed for the needs of the newly formed Republic of the Sphere's Armed Forces, with the lessons learned from Stone's Coalition during the Jihad in mind. It utilizes its stealth capacities and quick movement to scout ahead of friendly forces without being detected. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 安格洛娜侦察服由星际军团工业公司在泰拉开发。该战斗服面向新成立的星球共和国武装部队设计，吸取了圣战期间斯通联盟的经验。它利用隐形能力和快速移动，在不被发现的情况下侦察友军前方。 特性：灵巧 部署成本倍率：0.888 可安装全向单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1: The Buraq is a Clan medium-weight Quad battle armor, which was designed by Clan Hell's Horses during the early thirty-second century. The horselike Buraq was named for the mystical steed from ancient times, and like its mystical namesake, the battle armor is noted for its high ground speed. Typically, Clan Hell's Horses have used full Stars consisting of different variants of the battle armor. These Buraq Stars work as a team in their appointed mission assignments. They've been utilized on the Horses' Periphery borders to help scout and pin down pirates terrorizing their worlds. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can only be transported by internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.
column2: 布拉克是32世纪初由地狱之马氏族设计的氏族中型四足战斗装甲。其形似马匹，名字取自古代神话中的神驹；和神话原型一样，这套战斗装甲以地面速度极快著称。地狱之马氏族通常使用由不同型号组成的完整星组，这些布拉克星组会在指定任务中协同作战，并被部署于马族外围边境，侦察和牵制骚扰其世界的海盗。 特性：通信增强 部署成本倍率：0.93 只能由内部舱运输，不可近战，不可群袭。

column1: The closest thing the Demon Series of battle armor has to a standard, front-line model, the Asura is a medium-weight design. Compared to the Clan Elemental the Asura is not as well armored, although its 280kg of advanced armor can withstand a hit from a Clan ER Medium Laser. The Asura does not have any enhancements to a standard trooper's ground speed but carries jump jets to leap ninety meters at a time, matching the Elemental in terms of speed, and its weaponry has a longer reach. Quirk: Fearsome Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.872 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 恶魔系列战斗装甲中最接近标准前线型号的阿修罗，是一种中型设计。与氏族元素人相比，阿修罗装甲较薄，不过其280千克先进装甲可以承受氏族ER中型激光器的一击。阿修罗没有提升标准步兵地面速度的强化，但配备跳跃喷射器，一次可跃过90米，速度与元素人相当，且武器射程更远。 特性：威慑 部署成本倍率：0.872 可安装全向单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1: The Djinn is the first known example of the so-called Demon Series of battle armor designs produced by Word of Blake for their Manei Domini. The Djinn has been carefully crafted to instill fear in its enemies. Its slim profile shows that it is obviously specially designed for Manei Domini troopers, since their use of cybernetic enhancements make up for the muscular bulk that "frail" Elementals and their Inner Sphere counterparts need to operate battle armor. Quirk: Fearsome Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.886 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 妖灵是布莱克之言为其人类支配者生产的所谓恶魔系列战斗装甲设计中已知的首个型号。妖灵经过精心打造，旨在让敌人心生恐惧。其纤细轮廓表明它专为人类支配者设计，因为他们的义体强化弥补了“脆弱”元素人及其内太阳圈对应型号操作战斗装甲所需的肌肉体型。 特性：威慑 部署成本倍率：0.886 可安装全向单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1: The Gauntlet is a medium-class OmniMech that was manufactured for the Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces. It was designed as a swift cavalry unit capable of keeping up with lighter 'Mechs while also being able to bring the flexibility and firepower of a medium 'Mech. Quirk: Adv. M.A.S.C. Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 护手是为莱拉联邦武装部队制造的中型全向机甲。它被设计为敏捷的骑兵单位，既能跟上轻型机甲，又能发挥中型机甲的灵活性和火力。 特性：高级M.A.S.C. 部署成本倍率：1.06 手臂作动器限制：全向

column1: The Ghost Bears again had need of a cheap, versatile, second-line BattleMech. Thus the Bear Cub was put into production. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: 幽灵熊再次需要一种廉价、灵活的二线战斗机甲，于是熊崽被投入生产。 特性：易于驾驶 部署成本倍率：1.02

column1: The Goshawk II is a Medium BattleMech built by Clan Snow Raven in the mid-3080s. Based on the heavier Vapor Eagle (also known as the Goshawk), it is produced on the Inner Sphere world of Dante. The Goshawk II was designed as a second-line BattleMech for use exclusively by the Ravens. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 苍鹰II是雪鸦氏族于3080年代中期建造的中型战斗机甲。它基于更重型的蒸汽雄鹰（也称苍鹰），在内太阳圈的但丁星生产。苍鹰II被设计为仅供雪鸦使用的二线战斗机甲。 特性：灵巧 部署成本倍率：1.07 手臂作动器限制：右下臂

column1: The Hitman was designed to work as a spotter 'Mech for advanced Arrow IV missile artillery rounds. In order to do this, the 'Mech is built to be able to close to effective range for its Forward-1 Target Acquisition Gear spotting gear rapidly with a Kagushima 210 XL propelling it up to 118.8 km/h and a MASC system pushing the 'Mech up to 151.2 km/h in short bursts. The 'Mech also carries an Apple Churchill Guardian ECM Suite to foul any enemy electronics warfare equipment and a Wunderland Beagle Active Probe to detect any hidden enemy units. With the recent invention of semi-guided LRMs the Hitman can also guide LRM fire to a unit targeted with its TAG unit. The Hitman carries five tons of armor protection to protect it against any attacks that may hit it. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 杀手被设计为先进箭IV导弹炮弹的观察机甲。为此，它采用Kagushima 210 XL推进器，可迅速接近前置-1目标获取设备的有效观测距离，速度达118.8公里/小时；MASC系统短时爆发可将速度推至151.2公里/小时。它还配备Apple Churchill Guardian ECM套件，用于干扰敌方电子战设备，以及Wunderland Beagle主动探测器，用于侦测隐藏敌军。随着半制导LRM的发明，杀手还能引导LRM火力攻击TAG锁定的单位。杀手携带5吨装甲以抵御可能命中的攻击。 特性：武器稳定 部署成本倍率：0.99 手臂作动器限制：左下臂

column1: The Ironhold Assault Battle Armor was developed by Clan Jade Falcon during the Jihad. The roots of the Ironhold go back to development of the Anti-Personnel Gauss Rifle in 3069. After the success of that weapon, a new project codenamed Project Ferrum was started to develop a new suit of battle armor with the support of the Elemental Trinary of 3rd Falcon Talon Cluster. The Ironhold is noted for being more mobile than typical Clan Assault Armor, where it can employ its Jump Jets and give itself better tactical advantage over its opponents. Quirk: Armored Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: 铁堡突击战斗装甲由玉冕鹰氏族在圣战期间开发。铁堡的起源可追溯到3069年反人员高斯步枪的开发。该武器成功后，代号“费鲁姆计划”的新项目启动，在第三猎鹰爪集群元素人三进制支援下开发新的战斗装甲。铁堡比典型氏族突击装甲更机动，能够利用跳跃喷射器取得对敌人的战术优势。 特性：装甲化 部署成本倍率：0.96 只能由内部舱运输，可近战，不可群袭。

column1: The Mhacha is another genious design from the Morrigan program, named for a protective goddess was this Chassis designed to provide Long Range Firepower and AA Protection. Quirk: Morrigan C3i Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 玛查是莫里甘计划的又一项天才设计，以守护女神命名。这款底盘旨在提供远程火力和防空保护。 特性：莫里甘C3i 部署成本倍率：1.03 手臂作动器限制：全向

column1: The Pack Hunter II is a light BattleMech produced by Clan Wolf-in-Exile on Arc-Royal during the Jihad. The 'Mech would first appear in combat in 3077 after a considerable amount of delays in its development. The design was originally seen as the OmniMech successor to the original Pack Hunter, however the Blakist attack against Arc-Royal and other priorities caused the delays. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 猎群者II是由流亡狼氏族在圣战期间于弧皇家生产的轻型战斗机甲。经过大量开发延误后，该机甲于3077年首次参战。它原本被视为最初猎群者的全向机甲继任者，但布莱克派对弧皇家发动的袭击及其他优先事项导致进度延误。 特性：武器稳定 部署成本倍率：1.05

column1: The Phalanx is a battle armor design created and produced by Irian Technologies in the Free Worlds League. This design is the FWLM's answer to larger, harder-hitting battle armor such as the Kanazuchi and Gnome. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.898 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: 方阵是由伊里安科技在自由世界联盟设计并生产的战斗装甲，是自由世界联盟民兵军面对金刚武神和侏儒等更大型、更强力战斗装甲的答案。 特性：伏击者 部署成本倍率：0.898 可安装全向单位，可近战，不可群袭。

column1: The Schildkröte Line Tank is a Medium sized Combat Vehicle, originally designed for the Lyran Commonwealth's armed forces in 3122. A durable but slow tank, the Schildkröte was not well regarded when it first premiered. Due to this perception of it being too slow for frontline units, the vehicle was distributed among the Commonwealth's lower tier combat formations and planetary militia. However, over time the tank's durability would win over many with its performance in the field. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. column1: The Se'irim is a battle armor design in the Word of Blake's Demon Series, named for the satyr-like beings from Hebrew folklore. Used only in significant numbers by the elite Manei Domini, the Se'irim is the stealthy complement to the Asura. Where the latter serves as a main battlesuit the former specializes in ambush tactics. It carries 330kg of stealth armor, enough to stop a Medium Pulse Laser, which it uses along with its incredible ground speed get into cover and wait for the enemy's approach. Quirk: Fearsome Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.872 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 塞伊里姆是布莱克之言恶魔系列中的战斗装甲设计，名字取自希伯来民间传说中类似萨堤尔的生物。只有精英人类支配者大量使用这种装甲；塞伊里姆是阿修罗的隐形搭档，后者作为主力战斗服，前者则专精伏击战术。它携带330千克隐形装甲，足以阻挡中型脉冲激光器，并凭借惊人的地面速度进入掩体，等待敌人接近。 特性：威慑 部署成本倍率：0.872 可安装全向单位，可近战，可群袭。

The Skadi was originally designed by Clan Jade Falcon, but the main factory fell to the Lyran Commonwealth. For the next few decades, the Commonwealth sold the Skadi to any interested party. The combination of good protection, high speed, and a heavy gun proved to be very popular, and the Skadi was exported across the Inner Sphere. The Falcons later recaptured the facility and have restricted the Skadi to their own forces. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 10/15 hexes / 300/450 meters.
