column1: The Snake is a 'Mech that was built under the aegis of an Elemental hunter. With the power of hindsight though the Snake is clearly designed to hunt Inner Sphere Battle Armor suits. The 'Mech is built using a Vox 225 XL Engine to move at a top speed of 86.4 km/h. The Snake also has a jumping capability of one hundred and fifty meters making it capable of outmaneuvering any battle armor suit and also keeping it on par with most medium 'Mechs. The Snake is also armored with seven tons of armor and uses double heat sinks to cool the 'Mech's excess heat. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 毒蛇是在元素人猎手主导下建造的机甲。事后看来，毒蛇显然是为猎杀内太阳圈战斗装甲而设计。它采用Vox 225 XL引擎，最高速度86.4公里/小时；跳跃能力达150米，能够机动压制任何战斗装甲，速度也足以匹敌大多数中型机甲。毒蛇还装有7吨装甲，并使用双倍散热器冷却多余热量。 特性：瞄准增强—近程 部署成本倍率：1.03 手臂作动器限制：右下臂

column1: The Xiphos assault battle armor was developed by Irian Technologies specifically to create an infantry suit protected against artillery attacks, one of the most commonly-used tactics for defeating battle armor. Manufactured on Irian and Washburn for the Marik-Stewart Commonwealth (prior to the capture of Washburn by Clan Wolf) the Xiphos was manufactured in three common configurations and specifically incorporated a high-powered communications system to allow battlefield commanders to keep lines of communication open even in the face of hostile electronic countermeasures. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: 西弗斯突击战斗装甲由伊里安科技专门开发，用于制造能够抵御炮击的步兵战斗服；炮击是击败战斗装甲最常用的战术之一。该型号在伊里安和沃什本为马立克-斯图尔特联邦（沃什本被狼氏族占领前）生产，共有三种常见配置，并特别配备高功率通信系统，使战场指挥官即使面对敌方电子反制也能保持通信畅通。 特性：通信增强 部署成本倍率：0.896 只能由内部舱运输，可近战，不可群袭。

A salvaged wreck of an Urbie, this has been dragged off of the battlefield and crudely repaired with parts taken from industrial mechs and ancient weapons. Little more than a mobile turret, it looks and sounds scarier than it is. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.77 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

column1: When the Argo arrives at the source of the distress beacon, a bleak picture greets you. The transport drifts aimlessly, no longer even venting oxygen from a gaping hole in its hull.\n\nWhile you're too late to help, your tech staff does manage to salvage some scrap for the Mech Bay from the floating tomb. Grim work, but necessary for survival in the Periphery.
column2: 当阿尔戈抵达求救信标来源处时，眼前是一幅凄凉景象。运输船漫无目的地漂浮，再也无法从船体巨洞中排出氧气。\n\n虽然你们赶到得太晚，技术人员仍设法从这座漂浮坟墓中打捞出一些可供机甲舱使用的废料。工作阴惨，却是外围生存所必需。

column1:
With a tone that brooks no discussion, you say, "We're not in the business of bailing out every wayward traveler. We need medical supplies to get MechWarriors back into the fight."

Darius and Dr. Murad share a pointed look, but they keep any further thoughts to themselves and the daily briefing moves onto other topics.

Over the next several days, word trickles through the ship about your decision, leading to heated arguments on both sides.
column2:
你用不容讨论的语气说道：“我们不是来救助每个迷途旅客的。我们需要医疗用品，让机甲战士重返战场。”

达里乌斯和穆拉德博士交换了一个意味深长的眼神，但没有再说什么，日常简报转向了其他话题。

接下来几天，你的决定传遍全船，引发了双方的激烈争论。

column1: You fill out all the information required in the form, check it twice, then hit the submit link. You hand the datapad back to Darius, "There, all done. Now we wait and see what..." A DING alert sounds on the datapad. Darius opens it up, "Well, Commander, looks like you are going back to school to learn how to fly VTOLs!" You smile, "I guess I better start packing. And Darius, don't bankrupt the company while I'm away!" Darius looks shocked, placing a hand on his chest, "Commander! I'm more than capable of running things while you are away." You shake your head as you head to your quarters to pack hoping that this course only takes less than 6 months to complete.
column2: 你填写表格所需的全部信息，检查两遍后点击提交链接。你把数据板递回给达里乌斯：“好了，全部完成。现在等着看……” 数据板发出叮的一声提示。达里乌斯打开它：“指挥官，看来你要回学校学习如何驾驶垂直起降机了！” 你微笑道：“看来我得开始收拾行李了。还有达里乌斯，我离开期间别把公司搞破产！” 达里乌斯震惊地捂住胸口：“指挥官！我完全有能力在你离开时管理好一切。” 你摇摇头，前往舱房收拾行李，同时希望这门课程不会超过6个月。

column1: You nod at Darius. "You're right. If anyone can appreciate their plight, it's the Argo. We'll share the treatment." Darius and Dr. Murad immediately set to work arranging relief for the ailing shuttle. Over the next several days, word of your decision trickles through the ship. Those who previously suffered through the Periphery Pox are extremely enthusiastic about helping victims of the unforgiving disease. Several days later, Sumire passes along a message of thanks from the planet's surface for resolving the situation favorably.
column2: 你向达里乌斯点头。“你说得对。如果有人能理解他们的困境，那就是阿尔戈。我们共享治疗方案。” 达里乌斯和穆拉德博士立即开始安排对患病穿梭机的援助。 接下来几天，你的决定传遍全船。那些曾遭受外围瘟疫的人，对帮助这种无情疾病的受害者表现得极其热情。 几天后，菫转达了来自行星地表的感谢信息，感谢你妥善解决了这起事件。

column1: A hastily constructed battlefield repair, the Goliath "Steel Rain" was the personal BattleMech of Indri Boral. While never intended to remain in its patchwork configuration, the Steel Rain proved itself time and time again as an indirect fire support platform during the 2781 Aurigan revolution against the Taurian Concordat. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2

column1: A modified ANH-1E, the Mean Baby upgrades the engine to a 300-rated XL Engine. The arm mounted lasers are removed, one of the two center-torso lasers are moved to the head and both are upgraded to ER Medium Lasers. If an enemy manages to close the distance, 4 Streak SRM-6s with 5 tons of ammo provide a devastating close-range punch, with fifteen and a half tons of armor providing adequate defense. Sixteen double heat sinks are hard-pressed to dissipate all the waste heat, so care must taken when firing the weapons. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 改装型ANH-1E“Mean Baby”将引擎升级为300级XL引擎。拆除双臂激光，将中央躯干两门激光中的一门移至头部，并将两门都升级为ER中型激光。敌人若成功接近，四具Streak SRM-6和5吨弹药可造成毁灭性的近距离打击，15.5吨装甲则提供足够防护。16组双重散热器难以排散全部废热，开火时务必谨慎。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率： 1.2 手臂执行器限制： Left Lower, Right Lower

column1: A modified Minsk 101, the 102 is not a true upgrade. Instead Ghost Bear engineers opted to remove the Star League era Active Probe in favour of a modern model. With the freed weight, the engineers installed an additional 2 Machine Guns. Produced with Minsk 101's pulled out of a Brian Cache, the Bears would use the design as a bodyguard unit for PGC units; freeing up more resources for Operation Revival. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 改装型Minsk 101的102并非真正的升级版。幽灵熊工程师拆除了星盟时代主动探测器，换装现代型号，并利用腾出的重量增装两挺机枪。该设计由从Brian Cache回收的Minsk 101改造而来，幽灵熊将其用作PGC单位的护卫，从而为复兴行动腾出更多资源。 特性：受保护执行器 部署费用倍率： 1.14 手臂执行器限制： Left Lower, Right Lower

column1: Developed prior to Gray Monday, the Hel is a Heavy Class OmniMech, which was originally created for the touman of Clan Jade Falcon. Also known as the Hel internally among the Clans, the Loki is an upgraded version of the venerable Hellbringer developed by Clan Hell's Horses in 2926. The new 'Mech differs from its thirtieth century originator by having heavier equipment capacity and improved armor protection but a lower top speed. The 'Mech would become primarily used by Clans Jade Falcon and Hell's Horses in 3145, where the 'Mech would see action during those Clans' invasions of the Inner Sphere powers such as the Republic of the Sphere and Lyran Commonwealth. A noted action that utilized the Loki was during the Jade Falcon's occupation of Sargasso in 3142. The 9th Talon deployed a binary of Lokis to suppress resistance in the city of Salicastrum. The Cluster's Lokis (fitted with B Configurations) used their Long Tom Cannons to blast rebel forces. However, a Nova of Wolf-In-Exiles forces ambushed the binary, and the ensuing battle rendered half the Jade Falcon Lokis destroyed, however the survivors would withdraw temporarily. A Star's worth of survivors from the 9th would return to force a Clan Wolf retreat and prevent the world from falling back into Commonwealth hands. Quirk: Experimental TC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

column1: The Chameleon was designed to help a new MechWarrior master the skills of maneuvering and heat management, with a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping distance of one hundred and eighty meters. BattleMechs Incorporated purchased the rights to the design. J.B. BattleMechs also introduced two battle-worthy variants of the Chameleon. It can be fitted out with extra plates to modify its appearance, and carries special electronics to falsify its signature; these special abilities let it look and scan as something other than what it is, hence the machine's name. column1: The Lineholder was the first BattleMech design to come from Kressly Warworks. The Lineholder is designed around a set of `Common Sense Rules` for 'Mech design. This approach has produced a 'Mech with a good ground speed and respectable amount of armor and firepower. The 'Mech has a top speed of 86.4 km/h, allowing it to keep up with all but the fastest light and medium 'Mechs. The Lineholder also carries ten tons of armor protection and has fourteen heat sinks. Its mix of off-the-shelf weapons and equipment makes the Lineholder a reliable 'Mech that is easy to repair and is dependable in battle. However, the ultimate selling point for the Lineholder, especially to its target audience of small units and minor nobles, is value and price. In the first year of sales, the Lineholder was historically successful compared with other 55-ton BattleMechs. For minor factions able to afford brand new BattleMechs, the Lineholder has become the garrison machine of choice. Still, Nathan retained the 'Mech for his subsequent assignment to Omega Galaxy and successfully piloted it in combat on Novo Cressidas in the Star's End system on 11 April 3064. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 战斧是狼氏族于3065年设计的突击级全向机甲。同年9月，少数原型机已造出并进行试运行。其中一台由内森·沃尔夫驾驶，他在塔玛尔平等之环中晋升星上校。虽然他战胜了雷神，但战斧仍存在大量系统错误和小故障，尚未准备好量产。内森仍保留该机甲，随后调往欧米伽星系，并于3064年4月11日在星尽系统的新克雷西达斯成功参战。 特性：战斗计算机 部署成本倍率：1.17 手臂作动器限制：全向

column1: The Tomahawk is an assault-class OmniMech designed by Clan Wolf in 3065. By September of that year, a few prototypes had been built and were being tested in trial runs. One these prototypes was piloted by Nathan Wolf in a Circle of Equals on Tamar when he attained the rank of Star Colonel. Although he was victorious against a Thor, it was noted that the Tomahawk still suffered from numerous system errors and gremlins and was not yet ready for mass production. Still, Nathan retained the 'Mech for his subsequent assignment to Omega Galaxy and successfully piloted it in combat on Novo Cressidas in the Star's End system on 11 April 3064. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 战斧是狼氏族于3065年设计的突击级全向机甲。同年9月，少数原型机已造出并进行试运行。其中一台由内森·沃尔夫驾驶，他在塔玛尔平等之环中晋升星上校。虽然他战胜了雷神，但战斧仍存在大量系统错误和小故障，尚未准备好量产。内森仍保留该机甲，随后调往欧米伽星系，并于3064年4月11日在星尽系统的新克雷西达斯成功参战。 特性：战斗计算机 部署成本倍率：1.19 手臂作动器限制：全向

column1: The two massive railguns defines the Arachnid's primary configuration, both in appearance and in design. Even with the railguns taking up almost two thirds of the available internal space and weight capacity in the giant QuadMech, two ER PPC and an ER Large laser are mounted in the center torso to provide even more firepower. Using 33.5 tons of the latest Titano-Carbide Lamellor armor still allows more than enough armor to survive even the strongest attacks with just minor damages. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.45
column2: 两门巨大的轨道炮定义了蛛形机的主要配置，无论外观还是设计皆如此。即使轨道炮占据这台巨型四足机甲近三分之二的内部空间和载重，中央躯干仍安装两门ER PPC和一门ER大型激光器，以提供更多火力。使用33.5吨最新钛碳化物层叠装甲后，它仍有足够防护承受最强攻击，仅受轻微损伤。 特性：威慑 部署成本倍率：1.45

column1: The UrbanLord appears to be a very heavy counterpart to the much older UrbanMech, weighing in at 70 metric tons, making it two entire weightclasses heavier than the UM-R60 UrbanMech. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 城市领主似乎是年代久远的城市机甲的重型对应型号，重达70公吨，比UM-R60城市机甲整整高出两个重量级别。 特性：360°躯干扭转 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂作动器限制：左上臂，右上臂

column1: The Void is a battle armor design that is produced by the Draconis Combine. The Void is protected by stealth armor and is a fairly mobile jump-capable battle armor. Many Nova Cats found the original PPC too bulky, so they swapped it out with their version of the Magshot Gauss Rifle. Quirk: Void Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.89 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 虚空是由龙马联盟生产的战斗装甲设计，采用隐形装甲，是相当灵活且具备跳跃能力的战斗装甲。许多新星猫认为原有PPC过于笨重，于是换成了他们版本的Magshot高斯步枪。 特性：虚空 部署成本倍率：0.89 可安装全向单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1: The Word of Blake's Bolla Stealth Tank was designed during the early part of the Jihad as part of the Serpentus Series of OmniVehicles. The Bolla's inception was made possible from salvage of Capellan stealth vehicles in 3069 and was first seen in combat in 3072. The tank was designed to support cybernetically enhanced infantry of the Manei Domini and produced by Krupp Armament Works on Terra. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 5/8 hexes / 150/240 meters. Armor: Vehicle Stealth Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 190 30 Left 160 30 Right 160 30 Rear 150 30 Turret 200 30 Total 860 150 Quirk: Off Roader Can Resupply/Repair Omni Vehicle Can carry 1 Battle Armor Squads.
column2: 布莱克之言的博拉隐形坦克于圣战初期作为蛇神系列全向载具的一部分设计。3069年从卡佩兰隐形载具中打捞的部件促成博拉诞生，它于3072年首次参战。该坦克用于支援人类支配者的义体强化步兵，由克虏伯军械厂在泰拉生产。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：5/8格 / 150/240米。 装甲：载具隐形装甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 前方 190 30 左侧 160 30 右侧 160 30 后方 150 30 炮塔 200 30 总计 860 150 特性：越野 可补给/维修 全向载具 可搭载1个战斗装甲小队。

column1: The Wraith battle armor was designed by the Rasalhague Dominion to support conventional infantry as well as perform surgical strikes. It is equipped with Basic Stealth armor to hide it from enemy probes, and its jump jets allow it to cover ninety meters in a single jump. The suit was introduced after extensive testing of the Rogue Bear battle armor, and is a direct descendant of that design. Quirk: Well Designed Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.928 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 幽灵战斗装甲由拉萨尔哈格共和国设计，用于支援常规步兵和执行外科式打击。它配备基础隐形装甲以躲避敌方探测器，跳跃喷射器一次可跃过90米。该战斗服在广泛测试流浪熊战斗装甲后推出，是其直接后裔。 特性：设计精良 部署成本倍率：0.928 可安装全向单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1: The Wraith battle armor was designed by the Rasalhague Dominion to support conventional infantry as well as perform surgical strikes. It is equipped with Basic Stealth armor to hide it from enemy probes, and its jump jets allow it to cover ninety meters in a single jump. The suit was introduced after extensive testing of the Rogue Bear battle armor, and is a direct descendant of that design. Quirk: Well Designed Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 幽灵战斗装甲由拉萨尔哈格共和国设计，用于支援常规步兵和执行外科式打击。它配备基础隐形装甲以躲避敌方探测器，跳跃喷射器一次可跃过90米。该战斗服在广泛测试流浪熊战斗装甲后推出，是其直接后裔。 特性：设计精良 部署成本倍率：0.93 可安装全向单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1: The Zou - or "Elephant" - is one of the third generation of battle armor suits to be designed and fielded by the Draconis Combine. The suit was originally developed to be the successor to the Kanazuchi, an assault suit. It wasn't until the Zou was further developed by being upgraded with command-and-control (C2) capabilities that it came into its own, providing Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery commanders a heavier ground unit when deployed on combined-arms operations, directing troops, calling in long-range fire and artillery. Quirk: Intuitive Controls Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.892 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: 象，也称“大象”，是龙马联盟设计并部署的第三代战斗装甲之一。它最初作为突击战斗服金刚武神的继任者开发。直到进一步升级并获得指挥控制（C2）能力后，象才真正成熟：在联合兵种行动中为龙马联盟集结部队指挥官提供更重型的地面单位，负责指挥部队、呼叫远程火力和炮击。 特性：直觉控制 部署成本倍率：0.892 可安装全向单位，可近战，不可群袭。

column1: This Dark Age variant is used by the Duchy of Andurien. It carries a Mine Dispenser instead of the Modular Weapon Mount of the original. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount any unit, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 这款黑暗时代型号由安杜连公国使用，用布雷散布器替换了原版的模块化武器挂架。 特性：标准部件 部署成本倍率：0.888 可安装任意单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1: This modified Elemental version was created by Clan Jade Falcon engineers in 3069 and replaces SRM ammunition with Fire-Resistant Armor. It carries a one-shot SRM-2 and a Flamer. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 这款改装元素人版本由玉冕鹰氏族工程师于3069年制造，用耐火装甲替换SRM弹药。它携带一具一次性SRM-2和一具火焰喷射器。 特性：标准部件 部署成本倍率：0.93 可安装全向单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1: This Thunderbolt had its warhead replaced with a Tactical Nuke. \n\n Use with Caution. May cause sudden Mushrooms and upset Bureaucrats.
column2: 这枚雷霆的弹头被替换成战术核弹。\n\n 谨慎使用。可能突然长出蘑菇并惹恼官僚。

column1: This variant has had its battlefield endurance and flexibility reduced in favor of maximizing its killing power. It mounts an SRM-5 with only four shots, though that is still more ammunition than most battle armor with missiles carry. A Missile-Capable Modular Weapon Mount can hold a MagShot or a Compact Narc Launcher. Finally, the anti-personnel mount has been replaced with a Firedrake Support Needler Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: 该型号牺牲战场耐久与灵活性，以最大化杀伤力。它安装一具SRM-5，仅有4发，但仍比大多数携带导弹的战斗装甲弹药更多。可装导弹的模块化武器挂架能够容纳MagShot或紧凑型Narc发射器。最后，反人员挂架被Firedrake支援针刺器替换。 特性：伏击者 部署成本倍率：0.896 只能由内部舱运输，可近战，不可群袭。

column1: This variant trades the Beagle probe for a Guardian ECM suite, allowing Coalition forces to disrupt Word of Blake communication networks and targeting systems. The Sprint scout helicopter is a nimble fast scout platform popular within the Inner Sphere. It was first released in 3052 with much success to the beleaguered units along the Clan invasion corridor, where it was able to keep tabs on the swift deployments of the Clans and call in artillery from afar. Such was its success that it quickly became a favored unit within scout and recon detachments throughout the Inner Sphere where it continues to see widespread use. However the nature of battlefields within the Inner Sphere often highlight the one flaw of the design, its mediocre armor. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 13/20 hexes / 390/600 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 40 5 Left 20 5 Right 20 5 Rear 20 5 Total 110 25 Quirk: Improved Communications
column2: 该型号用Guardian ECM套件替换猎犬探测器，使联盟部队能够干扰布莱克之言的通信网络和瞄准系统。冲刺侦察直升机是内太阳圈广受欢迎的灵活高速侦察平台。它于3052年首次发布，成功支援氏族入侵走廊上苦苦作战的部队，既能跟踪氏族快速部署，也能远程呼叫炮火。它的成功使其很快成为内太阳圈各侦察和战术侦察分队的首选，并持续广泛服役。然而，内太阳圈战场环境常常凸显其唯一缺陷：装甲平庸。 生物群系限制：该单位无法部署于月球生物群系。 移动：13/20格 / 390/600米。 装甲：铁磁纤维 结构：结构 数值 A S 前方 40 5 左侧 20 5 右侧 20 5 后方 20 5 总计 110 25 特性：通信增强

column1: This was an Advanced Tactical Missile system, before someone turned it into this wreckage. This is the famous case of getting a weapon into some nutcase's hand but no ammo for it. The whole system has been turned upside down, the Artemis got completely yanked out and they put a jury rigged RAC-feeder in its place, allowing to fire all common Inner Sphere Munitions. VOLATILE! Uses LRM/MRM/SRM Ammo. Firing Modes: LRM, MRM, SRM
column2: 这原本是一套先进战术导弹系统，直到有人把它变成了这堆废铁。这就是把武器交给疯子却不给弹药的典型案例。整套系统被彻底改造，Artemis被完全拆除，换上临时拼装的RAC供弹器，从而能够发射所有常见内太阳圈弹药。 不稳定！ 使用LRM/MRM/SRM弹药。 射击模式：LRM、MRM、SRM

column1: Two Firebees leftover from the Age of War were upgraded in 3071 when Sun-Tzu Liao revealed that he had survived the WarShip bombardment of Sian. They are protected by Stealth Armor and the requisite Guardian ECM Suite. Trading on the 'Mech's name, the Large Laser is replaced with a Plasma Rifle and the SRMs gave way to a multi-missile launcher. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 两台战争时代遗留的火蜂于3071年升级，当时孙祖·廖公开表示自己在锡安的战舰轰炸中幸存。它们由隐形装甲和必需的Guardian ECM套件保护。借用机甲原名，大型激光器被等离子步枪替换，SRM则换成多导弹发射器。 特性：战斗计算机 部署成本倍率：1.05

column1: Wanting to improve on the Raven but finding themselves constrained by the core equipment loadout, House Liao engineers looked at radical changes. Most promising of these attempts was the Gui Guisui, so named because it "flew in like a stealthed spirit". Being a 25t LAM version of the Raven, the Gui Guisui carries a similar EWAR loadout including stealth armor, as well as a pair of built in Medium lasers and a wing-mounted pulse laser, as well as a weapon bay of Chaff. The versatility of the wing mount and bay have allowed alternative loadouts to be utilized; several operations consisting of Gui Guisui stealthily dropping support equipment to resistance fighters have been reported. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 为了改进乌鸦，却受到核心装备配置限制，廖家工程师着眼于激进改造。其中最有希望的是鬼鬼祟，因此得名是因为它“像隐形幽灵一样飞来”。作为25吨乌鸦LAM版本，鬼鬼祟拥有类似的电子战配置，包括隐形装甲、两门内置中型激光器、一门翼载脉冲激光器，以及装有干扰箔的武器舱。翼挂和武器舱的灵活性允许采用替代配置；据报道，数次行动中鬼鬼祟隐蔽地向抵抗战士投放支援装备。 特性：陆空机甲 部署成本倍率：0.98

column1: When the Argo arrives at the source of the distress beacon, a bleak scene greets you. The transport drifts aimlessly, no longer even venting oxygen from a gaping hole in its hull.\n\nWhile you're too late to help, your tech staff does manage to salvage some scrap for the Mech Bay from the floating tomb. Darius, watching with you, says, "Grim work, but necessary for survival in the Periphery."
column2: 当阿尔戈抵达求救信标来源处时，一幅凄凉景象映入眼帘。运输船漫无目的地漂浮，再也无法从船体巨洞中排出氧气。\n\n虽然你们赶到得太晚，技术人员仍设法从这座漂浮坟墓中为机甲舱打捞出一些废料。达里乌斯与你一起观察，说道：“工作阴惨，却是外围生存所必需。”

column1: With its focus on defense, the 'Mech is armed with very few weapons for an Assault. The GTR-1's main armament is its Large X-Pulse Laser, which is backed up by three Medium X-Pulse Lasers, all of which are linked to a Targeting Computer. To provide additional mobility, the Great Turtle is equipped with three torso-mounted Jump Jets. These allow the Great Turtle to get out of sticky situations relatively quickly. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 这台机甲专注防御，因此作为突击机甲只装备极少武器。GTR-1的主武器是大型X脉冲激光器，另有三门中型X脉冲激光器辅助，全部接入瞄准计算机。为提升机动性，大乌龟配备三具安装于躯干的跳跃喷射器，使其能迅速摆脱困境。 特性：瞄准增强—近程 部署成本倍率：1.18

column1: With the success of the Mad Cat Mk II design Clan Diamond Shark developed the Mad Cat III as a medium 'Mech to accompany the heavy Mad Cat and assault Mad Cat II. Intended for sale to both Inner Sphere and Clan customers, it has been shunned by the Clans save for the Nova Cats and Exiled Wolves as '...an outrage against everything Nicholas Kerensky stood for and taught us.' However, it has proven popular with the Successor States. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 随着疯狂猫II设计的成功，钻石鲨氏族开发疯狂猫III，作为伴随重型疯狂猫和突击型疯狂猫II的中型机甲。它面向内太阳圈和氏族客户销售，却遭氏族冷落，只有新星猫和流亡狼例外，称其为“……对尼古拉斯·克伦斯基所坚持和教导的一切的侮辱”。不过，它在继承国中很受欢迎。 特性：通信增强 部署成本倍率：1.11 手臂作动器限制：左下臂，右下臂

column1: Won in combat on Arc-Royal after the Wolf's Dragoons arrival, the reborn Black Widow Company's XO Jacob Kincaid set about upgrading his new 'Mech significantly. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 在狼龙骑兵抵达后于弧皇家赢得战斗，重生黑寡妇连的执行官雅各布·金凯德开始大幅升级他的新机甲。 特性：头罩 部署成本倍率：1.06 手臂作动器限制：左下臂，右下臂

column1: You are on the bridge when Sumire calls out, "Commander, there appears to be someone hacking into our holovid system. They are attempting to..." Sumire is interrupted by the holovid activating and displaying an unknown figure before you, "Greetings, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. My apologies for interrupting you at this time, but you currently employ someone who owes me over ¢1,000,000. I grow weary chasing [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] all over the galaxy, so now I must involve you." You look at the screen, "So I am to just take your word that [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] owes you this money? I do not even know who you are!" The figure places a hand on his chest, "Forgive me, I have not properly introduced myself. You may call me Front Man. My employer, well, you do not need to concern yourself with that, but they wish to offer you, and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], a way to not only remove the debt on their head, but to also potentially be rewarded handsomely as well." You start to respond but Front Man continues speaking, "You may choose to decline the invitation to participate in this game, in which case we will implement whatever means necessary to either recoup our money from [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], or... well, we wouldn't want to spoil the surprise now would we?" [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] turns to you, "Commander, I have been running from them for a long time, if they are now willing to wipe my debt AND reward us at the same time, I am all in!" You address Front Man, "So, what is your proposal?" Front Man steeples his fingers in front of him, "My employer asks that [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] plays in a game. Winning the game will result in {SCN_MW.DET} debt being wiped and your company will receive a crate of 'goodies'." [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] yells out, "Count me..." You quickly interrupt {SCN_MW.DET}, "You have not mentioned what happens if they do not win?" Front Man smiles deliciously, "Well, we would hope that they win, would we not?" There is a long silence before he continues, "Oh very well then, should [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] fail in achieving victory, their debt will be paid in a more permanent manner." [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] grabs your arm, spinning you around, "Commander, I cannot keep running from them, and I cannot afford to pay them off. I can win whatever 'game' they have planned. Let me do this!" "What is your decision, Commander?" says Front Man.

column1: A Sidegrade of the Taurian Brahma, this Variant comes with multiple changes to the 5A. Most Notable of these Changes, it now Carries Reflective Coated Armour, and a Lyran Endo composite Structure. The AMS has been moved to make Space for a little bit of Ewar, While almost all of the Weapons have been Changed into Periphery Friendly Chem Lasers and Rifle's. Dont ask where the Gyro XL comes from, those are Technically only in Comstar Mechs... Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这是Taurian Brahma的侧向升级型，对5A进行了多项改动。最显著的是换装反射涂层装甲和拉伊纳Endo复合结构，AMS移位后腾出空间安装电子战设备，几乎所有武器都替换为适合边疆的化学激光和步枪。别问XL陀螺仪从哪来，那种装备理论上只存在于ComStar机甲中。 特性：可变射程瞄准 部署费用倍率： 1.16 手臂执行器限制： Right Lower

column1: A sidegrade of the Yeoman, replacing the traditional Missile Weapons with Rocket Launchers and adding 2 Heavy PPC. The addition of energy weapons frees the Yeoman from the ammunition dependencies that plagued the earlier models. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Yeoman的侧向升级型，以火箭发射器取代传统导弹武器，并增加两门重型PPC；能量武器让Yeoman摆脱早期型号的弹药依赖。 特性：精准武器 - 导弹 部署费用倍率： 1.08 手臂执行器限制： Left Upper, Right Upper

column1: A significant departure from the Osiris' usual loadouts, a Machine Gun in each arm provides defense against infantry, while an SRM-4 in each side-torso and two center torso mounted Medium Lasers provide a powerful close-range punch. A ton of ammo feeds the machine guns, while the SRMs are fed by 2 tons of ammo. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Osiris大幅偏离常规配置，双臂各一挺机枪用于防御步兵，两侧躯干各一具SRM-4，中央躯干两门中型激光提供强力近距离火力。机枪使用一吨弹药，SRM使用两吨弹药。 特性：延展躯干旋转 部署费用倍率： 0.99 手臂执行器限制： Left Upper, Right Upper

column1: A simple conversion, often seen among mercenary units; the UM-R60LRM or LRMbie is an attempt to provide cheap fire support. The AC/20 is replaced with an LRM-20 and 2 tons of ammo, while 2 medium lasers are added to the mech for improved mid range efficiency. Cheaper and easier to maintain then the expensive AC versions, the LRMbie is proving surprisingly popular amongst its pilots. The longer reach of the LRM pairs better with its slower ground speed and has led to claims that it improves the mech's survivability rates in combat situations. With Helm Core technology becoming increasingly widespread, many owners plan to mate the LRM with the increasing range of speciality munitions, creating an effective support mech that can provide everything from mine laying capability to indirect fire support in a cheap package. A number of examples are known to have been obtained by various manufactures, who are keen to experiment with the design. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 常见的简单改装，常见于佣兵单位。UM-R60LRM或“LRMbie”旨在提供廉价火力支援，以LRM-20和2吨弹药替代AC/20，并增加两门中型激光提升中程效率。它比昂贵的AC型号更便宜易维护，受到飞行员欢迎。LRM更远的射程弥补了较慢速度，提高了战场生存率。随着Helm Core技术普及，许多拥有者计划为LRM配备射程更远的特种弹药，使其成为能布雷或提供间接火力的廉价支援机甲。 特性：360°躯干旋转 部署费用倍率： 0.97 手臂执行器限制： Left Upper, Right Upper

column1: A simple refit of the Royal Catapult C1b performed as part of the SLDF's Gunslinger program, the -GSR saw more use in duels than in actual combat. Taking advantage of the common assumption that a Catapult would be carrying LRMs, the -GSR instead replaces them with 4 Holly SRM6 racks with Artemis IV fire controllers and swaps the Medium Lasers for a pair of Raker-IV Medium Pulse Lasers. This surprisingly short-ranged loadout secured the SLDF several victories over Kuritan duelists. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: SLDF Gunslinger计划对Royal Catapult C1b的简单改装，-GSR更多用于决斗而非实战。利用人们认为Catapult会携带LRM的惯性，它以四具带Artemis IV火控的Holly SRM6取代LRM，并将中型激光换成两门Raker-IV中型脉冲激光。这个近程配置让SLDF在对抗库里塔决斗家时取得多次胜利。 特性：精准武器 - 导弹 部署费用倍率： 1.17 手臂执行器限制： Left Upper, Right Upper

column1: A slightly less mobile but more heavily armed variant, the Kuma 2 replaced the heavier Improved Jump Jets with standard versions which reduced its jump distance to 180 meters. The weight saved allowed the replacement of the Heavy Large Laser with a Plasma Cannon with two tons of ammunition, and a 9-Tubed Advanced Tactical Missile Launcher with four tons of ammunition. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: Kuma 2机动性稍低但火力更强，将重型改进跳跃喷射器换成标准型号，跳跃距离降至180米；节省的重量用于把重型大型激光换成等离子炮和2吨弹药，并安装9管高级战术导弹发射器及4吨弹药。 特性：精准武器 - 激光 部署费用倍率： 1.14 手臂执行器限制： Left Lower

column1: A Society built Laser Carrier, this unit totes a quartet of Improved Heavy Medium Lasers along with a pair of SRM6 launchers into battle. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 320 30 Left 260 30 Right 260 30 Rear 140 30 Turret 250 30 Total 1230 150 Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile
column2: 协会制造的激光运输坦克，携带四门改进型重型中型激光和两具SRM6发射器。 生物群系限制： 无。 移动： 3/5格 / 90/150米. 装甲： 铁纤维（C） 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 320 30 左侧 260 30 右侧 260 30 后方 140 30 炮塔 250 30 总计 1230 150 特性：窄型/低矮轮廓

column1: A Society configuration apparently based on the Epona B, the Epona Z is a showcase for the Society's new HVAC/10. An iATM-6 with provides extra fire power. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 9/14 hexes / 270/420 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 120 25 Left 105 25 Right 105 25 Rear 90 25 Turret 95 25 Total 515 125 Quirk: Quick Off The Line Omni Vehicle
column2: 协会配置的Epona B改型，Epona Z展示协会新型HVAC/10，并以一具iATM-6增强火力。 生物群系限制： 无。 移动： 9/14格 / 270/420米. 装甲： 铁纤维（C） 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 120 25 左侧 105 25 右侧 105 25 后方 90 25 炮塔 95 25 总计 515 125 特性：快速起步 全能载具

column1: A Society configuration of the relatively young Shadow Cat Omni-Mech, the Z config replaces the Gauss Rifle with a Society MRM60 and the ER Medium Lasers with Heavy Medium Lasers. Where possible, Society engineers also incluided additional or upgraded systems and a Nova CEWS to provide superior EW capabilities. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 较新的Shadow Cat Omni机甲协会配置，Z型用协会MRM60替换高斯步枪，以重型中型激光替代ER中型激光，并尽可能加入升级系统及Nova CEWS以强化电子战。 特性：窄型/低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率： 1.12 手臂执行器限制： Omni

column1: A Society take on the Nanook, this 'Mech carries a Large and Medium Supra Laser in each arm, all with the addition of a Laser Insulator, thus utilizing the laser enabling traits of the basic chassis design to its fullest. In the side torsos a Heavy Gauss Rifle and an iATM-9 launcher reside, allowing both indirect and long range damage. The design further uses the Society developed Chameleon Light Polarizing Shield stealth system to hide its presence before it is able to engage its foes. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.44

column1: A somewhat radical departure from the stock Centurion, the CN9-AH Variant trades out the stock AC/10 and Medium Lasers for a single AC/20. While this amounts to the same degree of firepower, it has the benefit of concentrating the damage to a single location. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: Centurion的激进改型CN9-AH以单门AC/20替换标准AC/10和中型激光，火力总量相当但集中于单一部位。 特性：易于驾驶 部署费用倍率： 1.02 手臂执行器限制： Right Lower

column1: A sort of fusion between the B and C variants, the Warhawk E mounted an ER PPC, a Large Pulse Laser, and an SRM-6. The new addition to the design was three Plasma Cannons. The Targeting Computer made the energy weapons more accurate. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: B与C型的融合配置，Warhawk E装备ER PPC、大型脉冲激光和SRM-6，并新增三门等离子炮；瞄准计算机提升能量武器精度。 特性：改进瞄准 - 远程 部署费用倍率： 1.16 手臂执行器限制： Omni

column1: A special refit for a Star Colonel in the Snow Raven military, this Deimos was called 'Air Superiority' even though it was unnecessary. Armed with six LBX/5s and two LBX/2s, its role was to shoot down any and all flying assets. Considering that almost nobody other than Clan Snow Raven was fielding a force of flying units, this Deimos didn't see much use. Nonetheless, it will certainly shred any flying hostile in its way. There is even a Bolt-On Anti Air Missile Pod - I would like to know how this Honorable Clanner got that on there without getting reprimanded. Not very Honorable, but who actually knows what that means. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 雪鸦族上校专用Deimos改装型，虽称“空中优势”却并非必要。六门LBX/5和两门LBX/2专门击落飞行目标，另有外挂防空导弹舱。 特性：防空瞄准 部署费用倍率： 1.2 手臂执行器限制： Omni

column1: A Special Refit from the Escorpio Empire, Mixing Tech they had available at the Time. Clan Ultracannons, Medium lasers and MG's Round this Phoenix hawk off to a Good Start. A MASC gives it Good Speed, while a Single AMS protects it from Missiles. The most Special part about this Phoenix Hawk is the Ferro Lamellor, giving this Mech the edge it needs. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24
column2: Escorpio帝国特殊改装的Phoenix Hawk，混用氏族超自动加农炮、中型激光和机枪，MASC提供速度，AMS抵御导弹，Ferro Lamellor装甲赋予额外优势。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率： 1.24

column1: A special refit of the Sun Spider, made deadlier by using Streak Launchers and Battlecomputers. Everything in the 'Mech is Clan spec, but the launchers look like they're a weird mix of Clan and Inner Sphere Tech. From the markings it looks like either a showcase Mech for research, or a museum showpiece. The close range viability of this Sun Spider is deadly, but it has few options at long distance. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Sun Spider特殊改装型，使用Streak发射器和战斗计算机增强杀伤力；全套氏族规格但发射器似乎混合氏族与内天体科技，近距离极其致命，远距离选择有限。 特性：窄型/低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率： 1.15 手臂执行器限制： Omni

column1: A Special variant of the Thunderbolt 5S, The breacher was Adopted into Periphery Units needing a Mech that can Walk in, Take and Deal a lot of Damage. Especially in this Case, it was Refitted with Reactive Plates and JumpJets, to increase Survivability. AMS and Case Round out the Package Deal, Just to make sure it will get to where it needs to. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13
column2: Thunderbolt 5S特殊型号“破门者”，为需要承受并输出大量伤害的边疆单位采用；换装反应装甲和跳跃喷射器提升生存性，AMS和CASE完善配置。 特性：多重追踪 部署费用倍率： 1.13

It retains Small X-Pulse Lasers in the left arm, and a Streak SRM-6 is in the left torso. There is one ton of Streak ammo, but four tons of autocannon ammunition allows the 6C to carry special munitions for particular foes. The most important feature however is the Command Console in the BattleMaster's head. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: Regulan Hussars专用设计，以四门轻型AC/5取代传统躯干和臂载能量武器，保留左臂小型X脉冲激光和左躯干Streak SRM-6；BattleMaster头部的指挥控制台是最重要特征。 特性：指挥机甲 部署费用倍率： 1.15

Two ArtemisIV-capable LRM10 launchers, in addition to keeping the dual LB 10-X Autocannons, ensures the long range capabilities of the 'Mech. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

column1: [Society Version] The Hadur Fast Support Vehicle was developed by Clan Hell's Horses and introduced in 3102. Capable of reaching a top speed of 151 km/h, the Hadur can quickly position itself to provide heavy missile artillery support. It performs best when paired with forward scouts like the Asshur scout. The crew is protected by six tons of standard plate armor. The primary weapon of the Hadur is the Class 16 Arrow IV launcher. This massive weapon provides missile artillery support to friendly forces. However, unlike the Naga OmniMech, the Hadur has a single twenty round magazine instead of four smaller five round magazines. This means that switching ammunition types is a problem for Hadur crews. To remedy this, the Horses typically load the magazine with homing Arrow IV rounds. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 9/14 hexes / 270/420 meters. "Player 203, you have passed this round and will advance to the final game." Barely able to contain the smiles on your faces, everyone watches the events continuing to unfold on the screen. ::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::Hidden game arena on [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]]:::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: The door behind [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] opens and two armed and fully masked guards enter. They remove the collar and belt device and confiscate the wire snips. [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] looks at them, knowing the drill and shuffles out the open doorway towards {SCN_MW.DET} own cell. When they finally stop in front the door with the numbers 203 painted on it, the door opens and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] enters the room. [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] sits on the bed and mutters, "One more game, and then my debt is erased. I can do this. One more game." The voice sounds over the comms, "All players, the next round will begin tomorrow. Lights out in 15 minutes." ::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::Back on the ARGO:::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: The screen fades out, and is replaced with a SIGNAL TERMINATED notice. Darius looks at you, "Commander, I said it yesterday, pure randomness here, no skill involved. At least we know that [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] only needs to win one more game." Both Yang and Sumire look at Dr Murad when Yang states, "Hey Doc, what is your scientific analysis of this 'game'?" Dr Murad finishes re-watching some of the holo-feed, "Well, the only 'scientific' data I can present actually confirms what Darius has stated. This appears to be nothing more than a series of random tests, a 'leave it to the roll of the dice' decision." You drop into your chair, exhausted from the elation that [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] has survived to reach the final game, but fearful that {SCN_MW.DET} situation can change in the blink of an eye. You look up at Darius, "Let the crew know that [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] has successfully passed Round 2 and is proceeding to the final game soon. "

column1: ::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::Hidden game arena on [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]]:::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: At the count of THREE, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] throws his hand out in the shape of PAPER. {SCN_MW.SUBJ_C} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:look|Default:looks} at PLAYER 99's hand, and sees SCISSORS. [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]'s hand trembles and {SCN_MW.SUBJ} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:look|Default:looks} up at PLAYER 99's face. Expecting to see relief, {SCN_MW.SUBJ} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} instead surprised to see PLAYER 99 shaking his head in disappointment. PLAYER 99 looks at [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], "Ah, it is a shame. I had truly hoped you would win and take my place as Champion." As the guard walks over PLAYER 99 addresses the guard, "{SCN_MW.SUBJ_C} deserves respect and honour." Without waiting for an answer, PLAYER 99 turns to walk towards the only exit from the courtyard. The guard holster his blaster, and pulls out a canister from his utility belt. He then sprays a small blast of mist into [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]'s face. [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], startled by this, inhales deeply, {SCN_MW.DET} eyes flutter and {SCN_MW.SUBJ} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:collapse|Default:collapses} to the ground. The guard leans down, checks for a pulse, then waves to two orderlies standing on the far side of the courtyard to come over. "PLAYER 203, ELIMINATED." ::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::Back on the ARGO:::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: The screen fades out, and is replaced with a SIGNAL TERMINATED notice. You stare in disbelief at the screen, mouth open. Darius' shout breaks your trance, "Noooo!" Yang, in anger, throws his glass of Timbiqi Dry against the wall while Sumire and Dr Murad hug each other, tears streaming down their faces. A PING alert sounds on the comm panel at your desk. You move over to it and see an automated text message. It appears to be from Front Man. You click OPEN to read the message: My condolences, Commander {Commander.Lastname}. Since you are reading this message, it means that [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] did not survive the final round of the game. Know that {SCN_MW.DET} debt is now paid in full, and there will be no further reparations needed on {SCN_MW.OBJ} behalf. In fact, we will be giving you and your crew, a consolation prize. When [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] left on our dropship, we left behind a crate. You will find it magnetically attached to your hull outside the docking collar we used to pick up [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]. It is a shame the game did not go the full term, we could have made so much more money and your prize would have been that much greater. Regards, Front Man You look up from the screen and Darius looks at you, "Commander, it appears that these games were purely chance, with almost no skill involved. [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]'s chances of surviving were not that good, I think." Yang snarls at Darius, "State the obvious, why don't you." You lean back in your chair, exhausted from the watching the ordeal that [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] went through, "Advise the crew, they need to know that [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] is not returning to us. We need to get past this and get on get on with our jobs." As everyone leaves, you cannot help but wonder if your path will cross Front Man's again.

column1: You start to leave your office when you run into Darius, Yang, Sumire and Dr Murad. Darius motions you back towards your office, "Commander, the live feed from Front Man of [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]'s last game is getting ready to broadcast." You turn back to your office, motioning at everyone to follow, "Put it on the screen, Darius. Ok folks, let's hope [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] makes it through the final challenge." Darius punches in some information on the terminal next to the large display screen mounted on the wall in your office, "Transmission coming in now, Commander." The black screen shimmers to life, the blurry images slowly taking focus. The image resolves into a view of [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] in a courtyard along with a number of other players. Each player has a number displayed on their shirts. Everyone is watching the screen, when Yang yells out, "C'mon [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], you got this! ::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::Hidden game arena on [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]]:::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] stands in a courtyard with {SCN_MW.DET} fellow contestants. There are guards everywhere, their faces still covered with full masks so that no one can see their faces. A bell chimes and a voice is heard over the comms channel, "Welcome players to the next game. For this game, you will pair off into groups of two. Choose your opponent now." [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] looks around, when a big burly man walks up, PLAYER 5 stenciled on his shirt, "YOU will be my opponent." [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] looks at the man towering over {SCN_MW.OBJ}, hesitates, but sees that everyone else has teamed up already. {SCN_MW.SUBJ_C} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:shrug|Default:shrugs} and nods {SCN_MW.DET} agreement. The speaker activates and the voice continues, "Now that all players are paired up, we can begin. The name of today's game is Kai Bai Bo. ::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::Back on the ARGO:::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: Yang snarls, "What the hell is Kai bye baby or whatever they called it?" Dr Murad speaks up, "It was an old child's game from Terra. It was used to settle disputes by children and in some countries, was also used by adults." Sumire enquires, "Do you know the rules?" Dr Murad nods, "Yes, I have played this as a child, more as a fun competition than to settle any disagreements. Where I grew up, we called it 'Rock, Paper, Scissors. The principle is quite simple, you would face your opponent, and both count to three while shaking your closed hand in front of each other. On the final 3, you would quickly resolve your hand into one of the poses: A closed fist, ROCK; an open palm, PAPER or your two fingers extended in a V with the rest tucked in: SCISSORS. The winner is determined by the strongest hand." Yang interrupts, "Well that is a stupid game, rock wins every time!" Dr Murad shakes her head, "No, Yang, it does not. The strength of each is as follows: ROCK breaks SCISSORS, SCISSORS cuts PAPER and PAPER covers ROCK." You mull this over, "So [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] needs to pick someone whom {SCN_MW.SUBJ} can either outsmart or intimidate into picking a weaker hand?" Darius looks on skeptically, "I don't know Commander, I think this is just another random game of pure chance." ::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::Hidden game arena on [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]]:::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: The voice continues, "You and your opponent will extend one closed hand in front of each other. Count to three and form your and into the shape of a ROCK by keeping your fist closed. Form the shape of PAPER by extending your hand out flat. Form SCISSORS by extending your two fingers out in a V and tucking the others into your palm. Rock beats Scissors, which beats Paper, which beats Rock. The winners will face off against each other until only one winner is left. That person will win be crowned 'Champion'. Refusing to play will result in the player opting to forfeit. The game begins... NOW!" [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] stares into the eyes of PLAYER 5. They put their hands out before them and count: ONE... TWO... THREE... [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] forms {SCN_MW.DET} hand into ROCK while PLAYER 5 forms SCISSORS. [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] smiles coldly, "Looks like I win." PLAYER 5 growls and starts to lunge for [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] when a guard walks up and shoots PLAYER 5 in the chest, killing him instantly. The voice sounds, "PLAYER 203 wins. Find another player and continue." [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] finds another player and wins again. {SCN_MW.SUBJ_C} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:continue|Default:continues} for 5 more 'rounds' before it is down to one final opponent, a tall, skinny monk-like man with oversized thick glasses and PLAYER 99 on his shirt. As [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] approaches, PLAYER 99 extends his hand and says, "May good fortunes shine upon us today." [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] shakes their hand, "Good luck to you too." They square off against each other counting: ONE... TWO... THREE... [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] forms {SCN_MW.DET} hand into ROCK at the same time as PLAYER 99 forms ROCK as well. PLAYER 99 bows and starts counting again: ONE... TWO... THREE... [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] forms {SCN_MW.DET} hand into SCISSORS and PLAYER 99 also chooses SCISSORS. [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] looks on calmly as PLAYER 99 smiles back. They both begin again. ONE... TWO... THREE... [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] chooses PAPER. PLAYER 99 forms his hand into PAPER. Yet another tie. PLAYER 99 chuckles, "Oh ho ho, aren't you a clever one! A worthy opponent indeed." You both start counting again: ::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::Back on the ARGO:::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: Darius yells out to the screen, "Choose Paper!" Yang looks at Darius, "You're an idiot! Clearly Rock is the best choice." Sumire smiles, "I myself would go with Scissors at this point. What would you choose Dr Murad?" Dr Murad ponders the options before responding, "I think I will abstain. I do not wish to jinx things." ::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::Hidden game arena on [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]]:::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: ONE... TWO... THREE... [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] forms {SCN_MW.DET} hand into...

column1: A long lost prototype produced by Orguss Industries, this LAM was a failed experiment. Designed to capitalise on the Star League LAM tech, the UM-R60-LAM is a mech without a purpose. Too slow for front line combat or special operations work, and not nimble enough for dogfighting at close range, Orguss struggled to find a willing buyer for their wonder machine. Armed with a large pulse laser and a single small laser, it lacked the range of its ground-based counterparts or rival LAM models. Rumour has it that Orguss sealed the unsold models in a storage cache and forgot about them; and that the cache has survived the chaos of the succession wars. Unsurprisingly the design suffered high losses in combat and many mech warriors refused their assignments; only accepting them once the alternatives were made clear. column1: A relatively common refit package for the Zhuckov upgrades its autocannons to Hyper Velocity versions. This improves it's performance in open terrain allows it to take on some fire support roles. However as always HVAC are temperamental. In 3030, Aldis Industries deployed the successful follow up to its venerable Demolisher design, the slightly lighter Zhukov. While it shares many of the parts and features of the design that inspired it, the Zhukov is smaller, better armored, and packs less weaponry than its predecessor. Its first major deployment was with the Wolf's Dragoons whereupon the Zhukov has since seen constant improvements and tweaks as suggested to Aldis Industries by the field units that use it. Two turret mounted SarLon MaxiCannon Autocannon/10s are more than adequate at providing sufficient firepower for the discriminating buyer while imitating its larger cousin the Demolisher. column1: An excellent close quarters 'Mech, the Blade XL is built around a rotary autocannon/5 supplied with three tons of reloads as its primary weapon, supported by a pair of ER medium lasers, all three weapons located in the 'Mech's right arm. While critics pointed out the risk of locating all the 'Mechs weapon in a single location, the decision was based on the manufacturer's attempts to achieve an OmniMech level ease of maintenance on a standard BattleMech. column1: An experimental 'Mech ahead of its time, the HER-7S is the brainchild of Baron Roderick Axel of Lopez, who long believed he knew better than the military industrial complex how to develop an advanced upgrade of the Hermes II. Unfortunately, he was short on practical understanding of the true cost involved. Built on a composite internal structure, powered by a massive 320-rated XXL engine and clad in relatively low seven an half tons of armor, the HER-7S had a top speed of over 120 km/h and a 240 meter jump distance. Mounting 10 double heat sinks, an ER flamer, a Clan-spec large pulse laser, and a light PPC linked to a Clan-grade targeting computer, the 'Mech is a deadly combatant. However, due to the absurd expense and extreme fragility of the design, only three prototypes were manufactured, and in fact the whole proceedings seem to have been just a way for IBMU to use the Baron's money to gain more hands-on experience with the technologies involved. column1: Founded in 3132, Jötunn BattleWorx's one purpose was the local development of reinforced chassis technology in a workable BattleMech. Flush with Bear-Krona thanks to Gray Monday appropriations, Jötunn took an old Grizzly and rebuilt it. The Bruin’s superior durability and similar armament had relegated the Grizzly to obsolescence decades earlier. Four years of testing saw endless permutations of weapons to find the ideal combatant. To allocate mass lost to the chassis, the sturdy old reactor was replaced with an XL model with no loss in resilience, proving the concept. Its arsenal remained largely the same, though a Plasma rifle replaced the Gauss rifle and targeting was improved for all weapons. The Grizzly that marched off Jötunn’s first production line in 3138 was highly compromised, but the lessons learned informed the development of a new generation of OmniMechs Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

column1: From the start, the YLE-1 had a bad reputation for exploding from the smallest of hits. The Improved Gauss Rifles may have saved weight and space, but suffered from the fatal flaw of always being ready to explode, even when shut down. The Improved Heavy Medium Laser was similarly flawed, in that it could explode if damaged, but could at least be shut down to mitigate that. And, of course, the use of MRM's and their volatile ammunition; the detonation of a single volley's worth could destroy the entire side of the 'Mech. While the design team named it the YLE because it was a Prototype (Y) Limited Edition (LE) design, pilots claimed it was really 'You Like Explosions', after several spectacular failures in testing, including one where, after chasing after a captured Roadrunner for several minutes caused a catastrophic self-detonation. Still denying that the 'Mech design was at issue, engineers started to refer to the mech by the old Terran cartoon character "Wile E" instead, claiming that "only the foolish blow themselves up". This led to several fights between test pilots and engineers, as blame and consequences were constantly shifted to the other party. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

column1: Having dealt with years of incompatible systems with Clan-tech refits of the standard Beowulf, Odin built the Beowulf IIC from scratch in the hopes of avoiding them, only to use the same electronic systems which results in frequent glitches in combat. The main benefits of the switch to Clan-grade components was increased survivability for its 270-rated XL engine and the saving of half a ton through the use of Clan ferro-fibrous armor. Aside from that, the Beowulf IIC offers identical ground speed, bolstered by MASC, and jump distance as the ComStar BEO-12 model. The most notable and hotly contested change was the replacement of the Beagle active probe and TAG with a Watchdog CEWS and light TAG; while technically offering the same abilities with the added bonus of an ECM suite for less weight, the significantly reduced range forces the Beowulf IIC to put itself at much greater risk to fulfill its intended role. Similar to the ComStar original, the Beowulf IIC carries a right-arm mounted Series PPS-XX ER large pulse laser supported by a pair of left-arm mounted Series PPS-XIX ER medium pulse lasers. While doing more damage than the less advanced Inner Sphere weapons, the range brackets of the ComStar and Dominion models are almost identical, leading to further questions as to the value of the newer and more expensive design. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

column1: One of the most notable attributes of the Night Stalker NSR-K3 is its speed. Powered by its 320 XL extralight engine, the 40 ton design can quickly close distance between it and its objective. In its role as a recon and pursuit 'Mech, the Night Stalker is fitted with a Beagle active probe to find hidden units. Other design features include a torso-mounted cockpit and TAG - the latter of which can be used to call in artillery support. Protecting the 'Mech's hull are six and a half tons of ferro-fibrous armor. column1: Produced by Maverick Industries after Operations Serpent and Bulldog, the TsarBomba is an attempt to improve the flexibility and survivability of artillery units. Noting the loss of many Arrow IV equipped units and the slaughter of their crews during Clan breakthroughs, the Maverick Industries design teams looked for ways to improve the situation. With a license to produce the Hollander BZK-F3 already secured, it was decided to produce an upgraded model that utilised an XL Engine to mount the Arrow IV launcher. Modern artillery tactics called for the deployment of anti-air and anti-mech units to protect the precious assets, so Maverick only mounted a Small Pulse Laser on the mech, augmented by a TAG; so that the Hollander could handle infantry infiltrators and spot for either its own launcher or the rest of its lancemates. The design's speed was judged sufficient for it to evade other threats that might threaten the mech, especially with its armor unable to stand up to much punishment. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04

"Thought I should introduce you to the new crew, Boss." Yang smacks a few shoulders encouragingly as he goes down the line. You shake hands and do your best to pair names with faces, but it's all a blur. While you're leading the new hires on a tour of the Argo, someone shouts, "SCABS!" You hunt for the voice of dissent, but there's no one in sight. You brush off the comment, reassuring the 机甲Techs of their value and importance, but the accusation hangs over your heads, dampening the earlier enthusiasm.

column1: You look at Sumire, "Find a way to turn that damned console off!" Sumire quickly flicks a couple switches and the console dims and shuts down, "Commander, the Console is set to shutdown. The jump clock shows our ride will be jumping us out in 3... 2... 1..." Moments later, the jumpship's KF Drive activates and that quesy feeling when jumping through space washes over your body. "Report," you yell as your vision returns post jump and you turn to see the Console smoking. Sumire and an astech are dousing it with an extinguisher. After the smoke clears, Sumire examines the Console, "Commander, the Console is offline and some of the components have been destroyed. Engineering reports extensive damage to the engine and structure of the Argo." Darius moves over to the sensor station, "Commander, we appear to be in the [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] system, which is over 1160 light years away from the closest known jump-safe system of Helvetica! We have a message from the Captain of the jumpship. Their astechs have traced the power flux back to the Argo and will be filing reports to the Mercenary Review Board and the Commercial JumpShip Travel Authority as soon as they finish their shipwide diagnostics and damage assessment." The KF Console is damaged and offline. Travel times are increased until repairs can be made to the console and engines.

As your vision returns post jump, Darius calls out, "The Captain of the jumpship is furious and is going to file a report with the Mercenary Review Board and the Commercial JumpShip Travel Authority as soon as they finish their shipwide diagnostics and damage assessment." You look out the viewport, seeing a totally different system than the one you expected, "Where the F..." Sumire interupts your outburst, "Commander, it appears we are now in the [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] system, which is over 1160 light years away from the closest known jump-safe system of Helvetica! All stations are reporting operational as well, so we do not appear to have suffered any noticable damage from the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMisjump],misjump]]. You look at Sumire and Dr Murad, both of whom wanted the Console installed, "My head hurts from all of this." You turn to Darius, "Plot a path back to civilisation. I'll be in my office. "

column1:
You shake your head slowly. "I can't authorize an end-of-the-year bonus. We need to hang onto every C-Bill we've got. Our margins are slim enough as it is. Surely you can talk some sense into the MechTechs, Chief."

Hours later, Yang meets with you and Darius in the Command Center. "Used my charm, Boss." He forces a smile. "The MechTechs will stick around, because they're loyal and they don't want to run out on me, but from the sound of it, they're going to make up for those missing C-Bills one way or another. That's nonnegotiable. Expect delays."

"You made the best of a bad situation, Chief." You pat Yang on the shoulder.

Darius shakes his head. "We'd better lock up their tools every night and secure the Mech Bay doors. I don't want anything to 'go missing.'"

column1: A Dark Age rebuild of the Mauler, the Mauler 4K is a Kuritan update of the older 3R variant. Designed as a heavy brawler and urban assault unit, the Mauler 4K swaps the LRM-20’s of the 3K for Apollo enhanced MRM-30’s and the LB-10X’s for Snub Nose PPC’s. The XL Engine is removed to lower costs and increase durability, though this has resulted in the loss of 3 tons of armor which is seen as an acceptable trade-off. The C3 Slave is retained, allowing the 4K to transmit data which it’s longer range lance mates can take advantage of. 16 DHS keep the 4K cool while 4 tons of MRM ammo in CASE protected bays give the MRM’s plenty to shoot with.Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16.

column1: A light field artillery, experimental BattleMech, the Pandarus, named for a famous archer from the mythical battle of Troy on ancient Terra, is an Extended LRM Missile boat. Originally a Kali Yama design team proposal for an OmniMech missile boat capable of carrying both common and Experimental Technology missile systems, ultimately the high cost of building an all new design with all new OmniPods proved too high, with the design team forced to scale back their project to a non-Omni ELRM-equipped prototype built on a mothballed Orion chassis.

Flush from the success of the Karhu OmniMech and eager to make the 15-year-old Beowulf more profitable, Odin set about developing IIC style remake under its own initiative. column1: Developed by Majesty M&M from battle data gathered in engagements with the Word of Blake's patterns of Phoenix Hawk BattleMechs, the Agrotera is a fast, hard-hitting Medium 'Mech packed with some of the most cutting-edge technology available. column1: Named for a canine predator adapted to Randis IV, the HawkWolf is a unique BattleMech constructed by the Brotherhood of Randis that entered production in 3076. column1:
Merchant of Death, "Reaper of Detroit", "Traitor", and "just a typical Capellan". These are all titles that have been used to describe the figure known as "Ruin", "Rapture", and "Teatime." Little concrete information is available about this figure. Even the secret records of the Capellan Confederation offer precious few details other than confirming that he is a Capellan citizen.

A deeper dive into some unofficial channels seems to indicate that Teatime was a Maskirovka agent once tasked with advising the Chancellor himself. At some point during this assignment, it seems that Teatime went rogue and used his influence to betray several allies of the Confederation.

Revealed as the root of the betrayal, Teatime was forced to flee, taking on several aliases. Over the course of the next several years, Teatime kept busy by plying the trade routes of Capellan and Canopian space under the guise of a weapons merchant. However, it was eventually found that much of his merchandise was stolen from the Magistracy of Canopus' own stockpiles and those of the neighboring Andurien state.

Now hunted by three governments and their agents, Teatime fled to the world of Detroit where forces from all three nations converged to capture the man. However, thanks to years of training, Teatime not only eluded his would-be-capturers, but turned them against one another. As the three forces battled for the right to catch the rogue agent, Teatime unleashed a store of chemical weapons on the planet, decimating its population along with his hunters.

Following the Detroit massacre, Teatime disappeared for several more years, eventually surfacing once more, this time at the head of a mercenary band under the employ of the Society during their invasion of the Inner Sphere using the subverted MRBC.

Finally, Teatime disappeared altogether, with no confirmed sightings since. Mysteriously, the Capellan records of his crimes and most other documents regarding him vanished at roughly the same time. 

Some unconfirmed theories resound that state that Teatime did not actually betray the Confederation at all. Instead they hypothesize he remains a Maskirovka agent, playing out a long and subtle operation. What the aim of this operation is varies from one theory to another, but if any are true, then every citizen in the Sphere should fear what one of the most dangerous Maskirovka agents has in store.

column1: So, if I cannot provide the current whereabouts of my former crew, the MRBC is going to screw me over? you ask Mr. Sevar. Mr. Sevar calmly responds, "That is not how the MRBC works, Commander. There are rules and procedures in place to report MechWarriors, and other crew for that matter, of mercenary companies that die in combat. This is for any family or beneficiaries that they have listed with the MRBC to not only obtain their belongings, but for any insurance policies that they may have had active at the time. Your failure to report their deaths is, in effect, robbing their relatives of any proceeds due to them." You calmly address Mr. Sevar, "Look, running a Mercenary Company is not an easy task. I cannot answer to the missing personel because I do not know where they are right now. Yes, they were hired by us and yes, we failed to submit termination papers. But you have to understand that it wasn't an intentional slight. We didn't realise it was a contractural requirement. Surely we can be given some lenience, especially as we have never had any issues with the MRBC in the past?" Mr Sevar, listens intently to your reasons for not following protcols. He types a bunch of information into his terminal and then looks back to you, "I just relayed all you have told me to my superiors. Now we wait." Approximately 20 minutes later an alert chimes on Mr Sevars terminal. He reads over the information, "So, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}, it would seem that the MRBC is inclined to be lenient with you seeing as this in fact the first time you have run afoul of MRBC policy." You give a relieved sigh, "That is good to hear. I assure you that we will keep all our paperwork up to date from here on out. At least we can put this behind us and I can get my company back to work then." You reach over to disconnect the holofeed when Mr Sevar interrupts you, "Well, there is still one more issue that has to be resolved, Commander. Whilst the MRBC has decided to be lenient with you regarding the whereabouts of your former crew members, there is still the matter of failing to adhere to MRB Guidelines. You did not submit a change of status form to the MRBC for at least 5 of your crew. That is multiple offenses that carry, if the max penalties were to be applied in this situation, of ¢25,000,000 in fines and your MRB standing reduced to ZERO." You fall back in your chair, mouth agape, unable to make a coherent sentence. Mr Sevar continues, "But, as you have indicated, and records confirm, your company has never had a breach of contract or policy before, the MRBC has decided to waive all but one of the breaches. As such, the MRBC has decreed that {COMPANY.CompanyName} shall be fined the amount of ¢1,206,272 and your MRBC Rating will be reset to 237. Please sign this affidavit with your thumb print Commander and I will be on my way." Your whole body feels numb as you blindly press your thumb to the scanner. A few seconds later the a beeping tone sounds. You do not even recall Mr. Sevar signing off, lost in thought as how this all came about.

Relief floods through {SCN_MW.OBJ} and {SCN_MW.SUBJ} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:tense|Default:tenses} as {SCN_MW.SUBJ} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:look|Default:looks} up into PLAYER 99's eyes expecting to see anger. Instead, {SCN_MW.SUBJ} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} greeted with a warm smile. A chuckle issues from PLAYER 99, "You are a very good player! I am honoured to have been defeated by you." PLAYER 99 executes a formal bow. The guard walks over, raising their pistol and PLAYER 99 nods and addresses the guard, "If we may conduct the rest of our business elsewhere, and spare the 'Champion' any further pain, it would be appreciated." Without waiting for an answer, PLAYER 99 turns to walk towards the only exit from the courtyard. "PLAYER 99, ELIMINATED. PLAYER 203, YOU HAVE WON THE FINAL GAME." Tears of joy stream down {SCN_MW.DET} face as reality sinks in that {SCN_MW.SUBJ} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:have|Default:has} won! ::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::Back on the ARGO:::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: You and the rest of the bridge crew shout out in unison, "{SCN_MW.SUBJ_C} did it!" Well done indeed!" [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] looks skeptically at 前方 Man,"Is this sick contest over?" 前方 Man smiles, "Why of course! Your debt has been fully paid. In fact, the Syndicate has made quit a bit of money off betting on your win. So much so that they are sending a prize package back with you to take to your Commander." 前方 Man still has his hand out in front of him. In any case, shall I go and see to this crate that is arriving?" column1: Farah is the first to break the silence, her voice shaking. "Two hundred gigaton. That's from the Old Kentucky project. The [[DM.Factions[faction_FreeWorldsLeague],Free Worlds League]] deployed one in 2787 and it permanently scarred the planet. They abandoned the entire program because the weapon was too destructive to control. How did Marcus acquire one?" Darius barely manages to speak. "Does it matter how? Two hundred gigaton. That's more of a massive geological event than a weapon." Yang's voice shakes. "He has a weapon that can scar an entire planet. If he detonates that thing, we don't just die. We get atomized along with everything else, nothing would remain but superheated dust and plasma." Sumire's hands are shaking as she pulls up a basic simulation based on historical data. "He told us the consequences while we were still on the call. He wanted to make sure we understood he'd already made the decision." Farah looks stricken. "Marcus has a weapon that was used once in human history and considered so horrifying they never used it again. He's willing to use it on us if we fail. On an planet inhabited by innocent civilian researchers." Darius looks at you, his expression showing barely controlled terror. "Commander, we're already here. We're already committed. Two engagements back to back, no recovery time, no reinforcements, no extraction option. If we fail either of the assaults, we don't get a second chance, Marcus makes that choice for all of us. There's no backing out now." Yang's voice is tight with fury and fear. "So we fight through two consecutive assaults, destroy a superheavy prototype, and make absolutely certain we win. Because if we don't, Marcus erases us and everything else on this planet." Sumire forces herself to breathe carefully. "Win both, or none of us leave this planet. That's the arithmetic. There is no middle ground, no reinforcements available, no withdrawal, no rescue. No margin for error. And we can't leave. We're already here. The weapon is here. Marcus is here with a doomsday device." Farah's voice is barely steady. "Then we win. We breach the perimeter and we destroy the weapon without stopping. We get off this planet before Marcus has to detonate that warhead and kill everyone on the surface." The crew looks to you. They're terrified, but they're committed. They are ready for one final operation. [A new contract is available in the Command Center]

column1: Farah steps onto the bridge, datapad already in hand, and silently offers it to you. "There's not a lot on Landrum II," she says, voice quiet but firm. "It's a medium-sized arid planet with two moons, both in irregular orbits thanks to gravitational interference from a nearby gas giant. Most of the surface is dominated by massive inland saltflats. Over time they've steadily contaminated the oceans with runoff, pushing salinity through the roof. Only the coasts manage any real vegetation." She shifts her weight, brow furrowing slightly. "The locals live simple. Primitive, really. Tech level's like early 21st-century Terra. Scattered settlements, no major cities, and practically no infrastructure. Nothing you'd expect a major operation to care about." She pauses, then adds, "There's one curiosity. An enormous sponge-like fungus that grows in crevices beneath the surface. The mycelial networks stretch for kilometers underground, but no one's ever found a use for it. Research teams pulled out years ago." She looks up from the datapad. "So either the Tribe is hiding something they don't want found... or they're using this place for logistics because nobody else ever would."

column1: Farah taps a few keys on her datapad and brings up the planetary dossier, her brow furrowed. "Fröislandis VII is a mid-sized arctic planet in the outermost fringe of the Deep Periphery. Thin atmosphere, hostile cold, and a dense asteroid ring in orbit. Nothing you'd expect to be worth fighting over. Only point of interest before the Tribe moved in was a fringe research outpost studying extremophile fungi. "The team built a small agricultural and packaging lab to test growth and viability, but all contact with the site dropped off six months ago. No distress call. No comms. Just silence." She looks up. "And now we know why." [A Flashpoint is now available in the Fröislandis system]
