column1:
Casparamaris represents perhaps one of the most bizarre chapters of history within the Inner Sphere's long and storied annals. As with many things regarding Amaris and the fall of the Star League, records concerning the origin of this rather unique drone are fragmented, incomplete, and unlikely to ever be fully uncovered.

What records do exist point to a breakthrough in artificial intelligence just prior to Amaris' coup d'état. This breakthrough would have made it possible to create AI with what was dubbed a 'personality matrix', allowing the AI to emulate the individual the matrix was based on to a near indistinguishable degree. As these matrices were too large to be mounted on anything smaller than a capital WarShip, the SLDF envisioned the creation of specialty Drone WarShips - fleets of which would be run by drones based on their most skilled naval commanders. This would have all but ensured the SLDF's continued naval dominance.

After the Amaris Coup, it seems that research and development on the system continued, and records make clear that at least one functional prototype based on the infamous 'M5 Caspar' drone was created. Paranoid and self-absorbed to the extreme, it is perhaps not surprising that Amaris would see no personality more suitable for testing these new WarShips than his own. Thus, Casparamaris was born.

No records in the Inner Sphere tell of any action - or the fate of this 'Casparamaris' - but it would seem that the unit survived not only the downfall of the Amaris Empire but also the maelstrom of the early Succession Wars. With no recorded activity during these years, the questions of where Casparamaris was and what it was doing remain unanswered. What is known is that the Drone WarShip made itself known to the House Lords around the year 3047 when it appeared high in orbit around Harrow's Sun and proceeded to annihilate a stunned Draconis Combine garrison in the name of the Federated Suns. After this, Casparamaris would make regular appearances in systems under invasion, offering its services to the highest bidder. Despite being a WarShip, with fully functional capital-scale weapons, Casparamaris would instead drop BattleMechs onto the field. These were equipped with some form of remote drone control, a technology that the Word of Blake would use to dramatic effect a few decades later - perhaps indicating this technology was far older than previously thought.

Becoming a famed mercenary unit, it also became increasingly clear that Casparamaris was searching for something - but what that something was remains unknown even to this day. What is known is that the unit's now ancient personality matrix was either starting to decay or the personality was becoming ever more like the real Amaris: somewhat obsessed with bibs and making near constant orders at the Golden Corral - despite not requiring food.

After it turned hostile towards everyone, elements of ComStar and various mercenary groups had enough and banded together and attacked the rogue drone, eventually crippling it. In a desperate attempt to escape, the drone attempted to execute a blind jump, which resulted in a spectacular explosion. This was the last time Casparamaris was spotted, yet in the aftermath of the explosion there was not enough debris to conclusively confirm the destruction of the drone. While most ComStar analysts, pointing to the huge drop in unconfirmed sightings and destruction of supply convoys, state the rogue WarShip was destroyed, others point to the fact that Casparamaris once went over two hundred years without being sighted or known about, suggesting the AI may once again have changed how it was operating.

Naturally, there are many questions surrounding Casparamaris: Where was the Drone WarShip for over 200 years between end of the Star League and what was it doing? What caused the it to suddenly return? Why did it turn on everyone? What was it searching for? Was it acting alone or was it under the control of a yet unknown actor? What was it doing with all the bibs and food it received from the Golden Corral?

Some believe that the answers to at least some of these questions might be found in the secret archives of Aleksandr Kerensky and his son Nicholas, but Clan Wolf outright refuses to admit to being in possession of such documents, let alone comment on the contents to any such material. If these documents do exist, perhaps they hold the answer to the most burning of questions: Was there more than a single prototype constructed? And if so, how many others are out there, still functioning?

Following his passing and seeing no reason to stay she became a stowaway on an SLDF cargo vessel leaving Zathras at the onset of the Amaris Uprising. As the war waged on and the ranks of MechWarriors declined she was selected to become one herself, seeing combat in the final year of the civil war.

After the war she would follow General Kerensky on his exodus. Following the forming of the clans she was sorted into the warrior caste of Clan Snow Raven.  After the migration of a periphery nation near the Kerensky Cluster she was chosen to lead a team to follow them back to the inner sphere, posing as the mercenary company AGASGV KOGA on a mission to gather information and lay the groundwork for the clans arrival. She became embedded among the embattled Outworlds Alliance to aid in their, aiding in the reconquering of core territories.  AGASGV KOGA, retained by Outworlds Alliance, would go on to assist in numerous conflicts and eventually be integrated as an official regiment.

Having become a trusted advisor of President Avellar, Connie continued working to influence Outworlds Alliance to be receptive to a planned merger upon Clan Snow Ravens arrival.

column1: Hailing from the Deep Periphery, the exact origins of the mercenary known as "Sierra3" remain unknown, although a slight Spanish accent in his speech strongly suggests that he either hails from or has spent significant time in the distant Nueva Castile. Appearing as a rough figure, he is often seen sporting a Stetson-styled hat and a long trench coat, evoking images of 'Wild West' of the ancient Terran nation of America, and a personality to match. Sierra3 can be summed up as 'all business, no play' when it comes to his work, and he takes any job he accepts with the utmost seriousness and professionalism. Favoring lighter 'Mechs, usually equipped with relatively low-tech but reliable and easily repairable parts, Sierra3 is known to track his quarries across the stars at a relentless pace only few can match. If they go to ground, he has no qualms about hunting them down on foot, digging them out of their hideouts to face his brand of frontier justice. However, do not believe that these choices hinder him in any way, as he is known to be an incredible duelist and has a near impeccable record with the MRBC for completing the contracts he takes on. Given his often grim personality, his somewhat reclusive nature and nomadic work, it is little wonder that Sierra3 has few whom he calls friends. For those who have earned this title though, Sierra3 will go to any lengths to protect and if necessary, avenge. "Sometimes, in the pursuit of the hunted/criminal/pirate/brigand/wascally wabbit, it becomes necessary to pursue them on foot... as they are want to evade capture by going into areas too small for 'Mech or vehicle to follow." - Sierra3 "From the arenas of Solaris to the fighting pits of the Periphery, there is nothing as bloodthirsty and profitable as old-fashioned gladiatorial combat... whether it be opponents facing off with knives/swords/axes or pitting infantry versus a 'Mech, all for the pleasure of the crowds." - Sierra3

Jack Amaris, better known as "Captain Jack", was born on some world that was once part of the long dead Rim Worlds Republic. Growing up hearing stories of his distant relative and being taught from a young age that House Steiner was to blame for the hardships forced on his world because of their destruction of the RWR, Jack turned to a life of piracy at the young age of 16.

Rising through the ranks fairly quickly, it became apparent that Jack had an affinity for fixing and understanding LosTech, and he was particularly fascinated by the HPG network administered by ComStar.

Jack was eventually made captain of his crew after the previous captain came down with a good, old-fashioned case of being Atlas-stomped. As captain, Jack launched raids into the Lyran Commonwealth, and after accidentally capturing a world with a functional HPG, he at last had a chance to undertake an in-depth study of one.

As a result of this study, Jack was able to successfully create a miniature version of hyperpulse generator technology with a shorter range. Calling his invention 'WiFi' after an ancient Terran wireless communication technology, Jack led the Valkyrate pirates in an attempt to spread this new technology to all worlds within their reach. Favoring the use of scavenged Atlas 'Mechs to turn into 'WiFi towers', Jack eventually created a network of systems and a pirated content service, much to the annoyance of ComStar.

On more than one occasion, Jack raided the Lyran capital of Tharkad just to acquire more Atlas towers. Eventually, he was forced to retreat from the front due to his health, but the Valkyrate carried on his work, plundering the Commonwealth. Jack's final contribution was helping to invent the amazing 'GoatFi' technology.

Several outsiders have noted he bears a striking resemblance to the missing Carl Marik, a distant cousin to Corrine. Whatever his origin, Jarl was a natural leader amongst the JarnFolk and, together with Figing, he helped shape their military doctrine. A favored tactic of Jarl was loading 'lutefisk' into his mortar launchers and dropping them on his enemies, both confusing his opponents and covering their cockpit and sensors, effectively blinding them.

Like Figing, Jarl dreamed of turning the JarnFolk into a Clan and it is said that he had a plan to do so, even if he was never able to enact it. Ultimately, Jarl retired to the world of Goat Path and proceeded to start a business selling goat milk to the Lyrans in finely crafted wooden bottles. Against all odds, it was an overnight success.

column1:
Khan Han Hill, also known as "The Iron Khan", is one of Clan Coyote's most celebrated heroes. Though not well known outside of his Clan, he is credited with reversing the slow decline of the Coyotes that followed their dominance after the invention of the OmniMech in the Golden Century.

Critically wounded during the Wars of Reaving, Han's survival was considered miraculous, as was his fast return to the battlefield. Earning the respect of his peers, Han was a natural choice for the khanship of the Clan when Khan Leo Koga died in a Trial defending the Coyotes' honor amongst the other Clans in the wake of the Society invasion.

Under Han's rule, the Coyotes were able to regain much of their lost standing in the eyes of their peers, though this came at the cost of becoming bitter enemies with Clan Blood Spirit. Seeing the Spirit's ever-shifting demands, Han lead a coalition of the remaining Home Clans to expel the Blood Spirits, exiling them to Colleen and the invasion corridor.

After a war to keep the Magistracy of Canopus out of the K-Cluster, Han decided that the Home Clans must invade the Inner Sphere, as it was clear that there was no way to keep the taint of the Inner Sphere away from their homes without conquest.

Leading the Coyotes, Stone Lions, Star Adders, and Cloud Cobras towards the Sphere, they were rebuffed by the juggernaut that was Clan Ghost Bear and it was made clear that they would not allow the Home Clans to pass through their space. This forced the Coyotes to retreat for a time but, undeterred, Han decided that they would instead travel through the invasion corridor and avoid Ghost Bear space.

This unfortunately meant pushing through the exiled Blood Spirits, and so Han started an invasion of their space. For the next three years, the Coyotes and Blood Spirits fought in a near standstill, neither Clan being able to make significant passage through the corridor. During this time, Han earned his lasting callsign of 'Iron Khan' for his determination to reach the Sphere. Eventually both Clans came to grudgingly respect one another, and slowly they began to co-operate to reach the Sphere. Eventually Han reached the space of the Hanseatic League only to discover that they had arrived too late and were now blockaded from entering the Near Periphery - once more by the Ghost Bears.

The Coyotes and Ghost Bears fought a brief war in the stars between the League and the Chainelane Isles, but ultimately the Coyotes were not able to match the Bears and all seemed lost for Han's quest.

However, it soon turned out that the Society was not as defeated as once thought, and it was revealed they had infiltrated the MRBC. As the Society's chaos swept through the Sphere, the Coyotes slipped into Davion space, eventually settling a sector of Periphery space near the Taurian Concordat. Relations between the Clan and House Davion quickly soured, and the Coyotes found themselves soon in battle against the Federated Suns.

Around this time, the Primus of ComStar and the Aurigan Coalition offered the Coyotes a chance to join the so-called 'New Star League'. With little to lose, Han chose to align himself with this new alliance and, by the war's end several years later, the Coyotes found themselves as one of the major Clans operating within the Sphere, second only to the irksome Ghost Bears.

Though the 'New Star League' fell apart in the years after the war, the Coyotes were well-positioned to dominate the area against their former allies, while a burgeoning alliance formed between Han and his former enemies in Clan Blood Spirit.

Never destined to become the ilKhan of the Clans, Han nonetheless represented the rebirth of his Clan and for decades to come, his influence was felt in the Kerensky Cluster as the Coyotes dominated it once more.

column1:
Little is known about the enigmatic being known as "Mr. Bubbles", only that references to her go back many centuries.

All-seeing, ever-present, and slow to anger, some say Mr. Bubbles is nothing more than an urban myth designed to scare MechWarriors and keep them in line. Others claim that she is a herald of an elder god known as "Server Overlord" and that her appearance can either mark joy and laughter or signal doom.

Descriptions of Mr. Bubbles consistently describe her as donning a great metal suit that resembles ancient diver outfits from over a millennium ago now only seen in museums on Terra. It is said that those who invoke her wrath find themselves shredded by a large and powerful drill arm capable of tearing through even the hardest of armors like butter.

Some sources claim that the advanced Star League era AI known as "Roguebot" is her pet and that she is capable of summoning minions known as voidlings to do her bidding. Others say she adores foxes and gives blessings to Clan Hell's Horses. The only concrete fact - assuming Mr. Bubbles even exists - is that she speaks an ancient Terran language known as "gifs".

column1:
Quizel Narf has been described as either one of the greatest or one of the worst pirate lords to have ever graced the history books.

Born on a backwater world in the Circinus Federation, Narf grew up hearing stories of daring raids, buried treasure, and fortunes won and lost. Enthralled by these tales, even if most weren't true, Narf quickly decided the pirate's life was for him and, at the young age of 17, joined his first pirate crew.

There Narf stood above his peers, proving to be both cunning, fearless, and a natural at finding hidden 'booty'. These qualities soon found Narf rising through the ranks of command until the age of 26, when the entire crew he was serving under was wiped out in a Lyran sting operation.

Barely escaping himself, Narf decided to start his own crew instead of joining someone else's. It was here that Narf's true talent was discovered: his ability to recruit people to his cause. Such was his talent that before his 30th birthday, Narf found himself a pirate lord, having recruited enough people to create and run no less than a dozen different crews - all under his command.

Despite his disdain for politics, Narf's power meant he was a household name within the loosely governed Federation, and he soon found himself a central figure of it. It is here that the Federation's craze with raccoons is said to have come from, as Narf was so fond of the Terran raccoon that he underwent numerous surgeries in the nearby Magistracy of Canopus until he outwardly looked like one.

Upon learning of the Clan invasion of the Inner Sphere, Narf fantasized of leading the Federation to become a Clan itself, less out of a desire to be recognized as a member of a warrior-people and more because he thought it would be funny and would annoy other Clans to no end. A mere five years later, taking full advantage of the Word of Blake's Jihad, Narf and his crews manged to pull off one of the greatest feats any pirate ever has: not only landing on - but sacking - Strana Mechty itself. While Clan reinforcements drove the pirates off-world within hours and years later altered their histories to state the sacking never happened, it did not stop Narf from proclaiming himself Khan of a new Clan known as "Skull-Squid". While no Clan would ever recognize the claim - in fact, some actively attempted to kill the now infamous pirate lord - it did not stop Narf or his crews from using the term whenever possible.

That is not to say all of Narf's plans went off without a hitch, and one of his greatest failures came with his alliance to Hans O'Reilly and his attempt to help place him on the throne of the Marian Hegemony. When the Circinus invasion badly backfired, Narf's legendary status within the Federation was dimmed for several years.

Narf's final fate is not clear. What is known is that the Republic of the Sphere attacked and tried to murder him during his own wedding, successfully assassinating his bride-to-be. Reports from the time are hazy, and it is not clear one way or another if Narf himself was killed. For years after the incident, sightings of the famous Raccoon-Pirate continued to occur, and the Federation itself grew fat off the pirate activity as it preyed on the helpless Free Worlds League. However, none of these sightings could ever be confirmed, nor could the enrichment of the Federation be directly tied to Narf.

In the end however, perhaps it doesn't matter if Narf died that day or lived to plunder for years more. His stories were already out there, his exploits both real and made up inspiring new generations of pirates. And after we are gone, our stories are what remain.

Glancing at your face, Darius cocks an eyebrow. "Why do I get the feeling there's a story here?"

By the time you finish your tale of betrayal and revenge, the table is covered with empty glasses and the lights are low.

Darius finally leans back and whistles appreciatively. "Commander, I don't know if I would've shown such restraint if I were in your shoes. That said, he'll never stop running. You've given him a lifetime of looking over his shoulder."

column1:
Svelte Sobral is something of an oddity amongst the well-known MechWarriors within the Inner Sphere. While regarded as a great MechWarrior, this is not what Svelte is known for. Nor is he amongst those infamous for war crimes. Instead, Svelte is known for being cursed.

No one is sure how or why he is cursed, only that bad luck seems to befall all his employers shortly after the end of his contracts with them. Svelte has found himself blamed for the collapse of the Rasalhague Dominion, the Aurigan Directorate, a Free Worlds League-wide HPG blackout, and a failed Wolf invasion of the Magistracy of Canopus.

As a member of a group called "The New Wolverines", many questions have been raised by his employers, including questions of his origin, any allegiances, and who or what were the old wolverines if these are the new ones? Svelte, however, doesn't seem to ever answer these questions.

Despite his cursed nature, Svelte still finds employers willing to pay for his services, hoping to avoid the curse that seems to follow him around.

Even after the collapse and disbanding of TNW, Svelte could be found fighting for one cause or another before ultimately disappearing. What exactly happened to the mighty MechWarrior is not exactly known. Some say his curse finally caught up with him proper, and even stranger rumors suggest he was disembodied and turned into a sentient fax machine by the mysterious Casparamaris and left at some backwater location of the Golden Corral.

column1:
Sweeny Papavic, perhaps better known by the moniker 'Sweet Papa Jelly Roll', is strange even as far as MechWarriors go.

Born in the Capellan Confederation, Jelly Roll is amongst the rare number of Capellan citizens who went on to found a hugely successful business empire. Starting from a humble food truck selling tacos, Sweet Papa quickly made a name for his delicious food and jolly demeanor, something the average Capellan does not posses. His business went on to flourish into a nation-wide chain with tens of thousands of taco trucks, that even made its way into neighboring Federated Suns and Free Worlds League worlds.

With wealth nearly unimaginable to the average spheroid and still very young, Jelly Roll took an interest in BattleMechs and started training as a MechWarrior in his spare time away from his taco truck. He was quickly found to have a knack for it, and soon enough found himself deploying alongside CCAF troops during the ComStar-Republic war.

In this war, Jelly Roll made a name for himself and ended the war in charge of a regiment of CCAF troops, and was entrusted with the hiring of mercenary forces to supplement the Capellan regulars. After the end of the war, Jelly departed the Confederation, thanks to a generous bribe to his Liao superiors. With this newfound freedom, instead of settling down to spend his wealth in a more free nation, Jelly instead traveled up to the Ghost Bear Dominion and to everyone's amazement was able to join the ranks of the touman, getting the near unheard of privilege of being treated by Clan trueborn as equals.

For the next few decades, Jelly Roll could be found deploying with Ghost Bear forces in a myriad of campaigns undertaken by the Clan, all the while getting the Clan addicted to his tacos.

Most who have deployed with Jelly Roll call his demeanor refreshing and happy - not the grizzled, war-weary personality that most MechWarriors seem to take on. With his legendary cooking talents and Sphere-wide famous tacos, adding Jelly Roll to the roster is an almost surefire way to boost the morale and spirits of nearly any company.

column1:
Takashi Kurita is one of the more mysterious members of the storied Kurita House. He once served as the Coordinator of the Draconis Combine during one of its most troubled times. Takashi's reign was marred by attacks of a resurgent JarnFolk, and the Combine suffered greatly at the hands of their raids.

Like his other contemporaries, Takashi nearly formed the so-called 'Third Star League', almost assuredly because of the Combine's dire need. While Takashi was able to escape from the disaster that was meant to be the signing of the new Star League accords on St. Ives, the experience shattered the once proud Coordinator's psyche.

Upon hearing rumors that the JarnFolk devastating his nation were secretly FWL troops dressed in viking attire, the Coordinator flew into a rage and immediately boarded one of the last WarShips remaining at the Combine's disposal and set course to Atreus. Takashi was believed killed when his WarShip was intercepted and destroyed while attempting to unleash nuclear bombardment on the FWL capital to avenge their supposed attacks on the DC. As a result, Takashi is rarely spoken about within the Combine.

You touch glasses with Darius. "Perhaps a bit of both."

column1:
The daughter of Trex "Kamea" Arano, Julimarie Arano grew up in the waning years of the Coalition's efforts to rebuild the Aurigan Reach following its brutal civil war. As the nation reached its near-golden age, Trex began to slowly integrate Julimarie into the everyday running of the nation.

In this way, Julimarie was groomed from a relatively young age to be a successor to her mother. As Trex reached her senior years, she passed the reins of leadership to her daughter, now a very experienced figure in her own right - and in her prime.

Unfortunately for Juli, her reign would quickly turn from a golden age into one of conflict and devastation, as a new cycle of war rippled through the Inner Sphere and Periphery. Before her reign was more than three years old, the Taurian Concordat swiftly and brutally invaded the Reach. With the aid of elite mercenary units, the Coalition forces were routed time and time again, and in short order Julimarie was forced into hiding with what remained of the nation's military.

For the next four years, Julimarie worked in secret, evading Taurian patrols and preparing for a guerrilla-style campaign to reclaim her beloved nation. Eventually, having gathered her strength, Julimarie launched herself into the fray, into a quest to reclaim her nation, just like her grandmother before her.

Taking the Taurians by relative surprise, Julimarie was able to rapidly re-secure most of the worlds of the Coalition in fairly short order, capturing huge amounts of Taurian war materiel in the process. Seeking to punish the Taurians for their betrayal, Julimarie ordered the annexation of several Taurian worlds before the Taurians sued for peace.

The next several years were relatively peaceful for the fragile nation, but Julimarie continued her military build-up, determined to break the cycle of war that had repeatedly torn her nation apart. When given the chance to join the so-called new 'Star League', Julimarie jumped at the chance and allied herself with ComStar and the recently arrived Clan Coyote. Launching an assault on the Federated Suns, the Aurigans were met with great success and eventually doubled their size by absorbing some key Davion worlds before the flames of war were slowly put out across the Sphere.

For the rest of her reign, peace was maintained and the nation prospered in ways a Periphery nation could rarely dream of, thanks to the advanced technologies they were able to access from their allies. However, the military might of the nation was drained, with little chance of a quick re-build as neither ComStar nor the Coyotes would provide advanced military hardware.

Towards the end of her reign, the friction of dealing with the alien culture of Clan society began to rise ever higher, and Julimarie began to wonder if allowing the Coyotes into the Rimward Periphery was a mistake or not. Leaving the throne to her daughter, Julimarie watched the so-called 'Star League' alliance collapse in her final years, just like all previous leagues. On her deathbed, she predicted that conflict with the Coyotes would come as the previous allies found themselves, increasingly, on different sides of the rising tensions in the Sphere. Julimarie however took comfort in knowing her daughter would guide the coalition through the coming storm.

column1: The Enhanced Imaging Display is a modular Heads-Up Display based on the Star League's Brain Wire program.[1] Forming part of the Clans' Enhanced Imaging system, the EI display is an advanced battle computer which simplifies the warrior's battlefield view with an enhanced virtual reality display. By combining sensor information from surrounding friendly units with preloaded terrain data, the EI display constructs a virtual view of the battlefield which clearly identifies all targets as friendly or hostile and allows technical data on a selected unit to be called up with a simple command. Besides removing the need to look down at cockpit controls and preventing the warrior from being overloaded with unnecessary data, the virtual display also presents a moveable perspective, allowing the warrior to change his point-of-view to observe any area of the battlefield from any angle.

The feed cuts to black.

Sumire huffs and leans against the console, her tone biting. "What a bunch of sensationalist drivel. That 'general' looked like a recruitment poster got drunk and wandered into a news booth. But people'll eat it up."

Farah closes the console slowly, arms crossed. "They gave INN enough footage for the story to stick, not enough for any attribution. This wasn't a leak. Someone packaged this deliberately."

Yang narrows his eyes at the final image. "Yeah, if INN's getting clean visuals like that, someone's either feeding them… or the Tribe's putting on a show. Making sure just enough leaks to stir the pot."

Darius mutters, "INN stokes the fire, and when the blaze reaches us, nobody's gonna care which way the wind was blowing. Just who to burn."

No one replies.

Across the stars, fear is rising, and the mercs caught in the middle are now part of the story, whether they want to be or not.

You take a deep breath, calming your nerves. Time is running out and Arelle better have a plan ready.

column1: The Magnothermic Plasma Engine is a fearsome evolution of the Vectored Plasma Engine, reserved for the Minnesota Tribe’s superheavy 'Mechs, where brute force outweighs finesse. Through thermoplasma vectoring, the engine’s cooling cycle superheats and ionizes working fluids, which are then precisely manipulated by electromagnetic fields. These fields channel the plasma via reinforced conduits into weapon manifolds known as Thermo-Electro-Magnetic Plasma Energy Synchronization Transducers (TEMPEST). TEMPEST units amplify thermal flow into PPC, flamer, plasma, and TSEMP systems,dramatically increasing destructive output while also reducing internal heat buildup, as the ionized plasma acts as an auxiliary coolant fluid that enhances connection to the core’s immense heat dissipation systems.\n\nThis pursuit of raw firepower comes at a cost. Jump jets are unusable, as their operation destabilizes the engine’s delicate thermo-electromagnetic flow balance. Additionally, the intense electromagnetic activity dramatically increases the ‘Mech’s visibility to enemy sensors. While the engine is lighter than conventional fusion cores in its class due to structural optimizations, its volatile nature makes it a walking powder keg; damage to plasma conduits can trigger catastrophic detonations. Despite the risks, Tribe MechWarriors embrace its brutal potential with unwavering conviction.

column1:
Trex "Kamea" Arano was the daughter of Kamea Arano. Trex was often simply called Kamea the Second due to her near identical looks to her mother, so much so that historians have difficulty figuring out which holo-images to attribute to either one. 

Born only a few years after her mother's victory over Santiago Espinosa's Directorate, Trex grew up watching as her people struggled in the post-wars years to rebuild and became determined to help her people no matter the cost.

Trex ascended to the throne at the age of 19 when her mother decided that she had ruled long enough and stepped down as High Lady of the Reach. Like her mother before her, Trex proved a natural leader, and she was able to inspire her people to not only make the Aurigan Reach prosperous for a Periphery state, but to successfully defend it and even launch a counteroffensive against the Capellan Confederation. It is said that Trex herself planned and led the campaign that seized chancellor Slippy's personal salt mine and drove him insane.

After the war, Trex returned her focus on making her nation the best that it could be before handing down the throne to a new generation of leadership like her mother before her - setting a tradition within the Reach of voluntarily giving up power before old age and world-weariness caught up with the High Lord/Lady.

column1: You are on the bridge when Sumire calls out, "Commander, there is a Priority Alpha holocom alert for you. It's marked CONFIDENTIAL." "Send it to my office, Sumire," you say as you stand and exit the bridge. As you enter you office, a RED light blinks on the holocom. You sit down, key in your personal passcode: D4R1U5_15_4N_ID10T. The holocom activates and you see the spinning emblem of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMRBC],Mercenary Review and Bonding Committee]] in front of you, followed by a flashing SECURE CONNECTION ESTABLISHED. The emblem fades and is replaced by a distinguished looking elderly man, "Greetings Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. I am Jorus Sevar, Legal Counsol for numerous mercenary companies registered with the MRBC. I am the assigned Counsel for {COMPANY.CompanyName} and responsible not only in ensuring all contracts are fulfilled properly and legally, but also if there are any issues or informalities arising from complaints about a company for which I am responsible. As we have not formally met, which is not uncommon, I do need you to confirm you are Commander {COMMANDER.LastName} by submitting a retinal scan please." A confused look passes across your face, but you opt to comply and see where this leads. You lean forward and allow the camera to scan your eye. You watch as Sevar checks the information on his terminal, "Thank you Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. Now we can get to meat of what is actually happening. The MRBC has been contacted by at least 5 citizens, including a one [[DEAD_MW,{DEAD_MW.FirstName}]] [[DEAD_MW,{DEAD_MW.Callsign}]] [[DEAD_MW,{DEAD_MW.LastName}]]. Each is claiming a missing relative was last employed by you and is now missing. Can you elaborate on that Commander?" You sit up in your chair, "Mr Sevar, we are a mercenary company contracted to do various jobs which have a high risk of fatality for those involved. Any of these missing persons were most likely KIA." Mr Sevar looks at something on his terminal before turning back to you, "Commander, I am not a jury or judge. I am here to help you, but to do that, I need to know what happened. The MRBC has records of you hiring each of the missing persons. They all show at least one or more pay packets going into their accounts from {COMPANY.CompanyName}. What they do not show, is any evidence these pilots have been reported as KIA. As you well know, Section IV, Item C, Paragraph 7 lists all the necessary procedures when a pilot dies, or is lost in combat. You have not lodged any of those files." You open you desk and grab the crew ledger, skimming through the names of all the pilots that have ever been hired to work for {COMPANY.CompanyName}. All listed there have documented files as to where, when and how they left the company. All except the current active crew members and a few who are no longer with the company because of Front Man. You clear your throat before addressing Mr Sevar, "Ah, it looks... um, what happens if my records are, um... incomplete?" Mr Sevar looks at his terminal and reads out, "MRBC Guideline 264 states the following: MechWarriors, and other personnel, in the employ of a mercenary company, which have been hired via any MRB Hiring Hall, must have updated records submitted to the MRBC upon any event which changes the status of said MechWarrior or other personnel. Failure to submit valid updates to the MRBC can result in fines of up to ¢3,500,000 and/or reputation penalties lowering your Reputation to below 300. This means that if you cannot provide evidence that they are still alive, and by this I mean that someone from the MRBC can actually get in touch with them, you could face serious sanctions against your company and your mercenary license. If you know what has happened to them, then tell me and I'll relay the info and hopefully the MRBC will be more lenient with you for assisting in this enquiry."

column1: You awaken to an unusual knocking sound. It is quite at odds to the even pulsing rhythm coming from the jumpship's Kearny-Fuchida drive that the Argo is docked to as it charges in preparation for the next jump. You look at your chronograph, the digits showing it is after midnight in the standard sleep cycle. You reach over to your nightstand and key in the intercom code for Engineering. Click... Click... A voice answers, "Engineering." You clear your throat, "This is Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}, What's going on down there? What the hell is that knocking noise?" The ensign nervously answers, "Uh, Commander, Sir, uh, we don't know yet what is causing it. Dr Murad has gone to Navigation to investigate it further." "Thank you, ensign," you respond as you disconnect the call. You punch in the code for Naviagtion. Click... Click... A voice answers, "Navigation." You do not even identify yourself, "Put Dr Murad on the line." Seconds later Dr Murad answers, "I presume the knocking noise woke you, Commander?" You let out a short laugh, "What in blazes is going on up there? Do I need to come to the bridge?" Dr Murad calmly responds, "I don't thinks so Commander. I've narrowed it down to something in Navigation, but am not 100% sure of the cause yet."

column1: You hear a knock on the door to your office, "Enter," you call out as you press the OPEN button on your desk. The door slides back to reveal Dr Murad and Sumire. They both stride in and begin talking at once, "Commander, we have..." You hold up your hand, "One at a time, please!" They look at each other before Sumire turns to you, "Commander, we have just acquired all the components to put together a KF Console." You raise your eyebrows, "What, pray tell, is a KF Console?" Sumire smiles, "Well, it is... umm, well... it is pirate tech and from what other navigators have told me, it is a way to potentially use [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LorePiratePoint],Pirate Points]] to get to systems quicker." Your brow wrinkles, "Do I really have to remind you that the Argo is not jump capable, it is a giant dropship?" Dr Murad smiles, "Yes, the Argo is a dropship, but it is massive, and has very powerful engines. Although the KF Console is supposed to be installed on a jumpship, I have a way to install it on the Argo." You still look confused, "Without a Kearny-Fuchida drive, we still need to use jumpships for travel. So I fail to see how this console thingy will benefit us at all." Dr Murad taps her datapad and sends images and schematics onto the screen on the wall in your office, "The basic premise is this, Commander. With an activated KF Console onboard the Argo, we can send data to whichever jumpship we have docked with and substitute their NavCom data with that generated by the Console. This will mean the jumpship will then arrive at a pirate point of the system we are going to." You steeple your fingers in front of you, "You think you can just convice a Jumpship Captain to risk using a [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LorePiratePoint],pirate point]]?' Dr Murad speaks up, "Actually, the navigator will never even know their coordinates have been replaced. They will most likely assume there was a system malfunction or something. The chances of us being singled out as the cause are slim." You shake your head, "Still sounds a lot like using a virus to deliver data to a computer that does not belong to us. What if we do [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMisjump],misjump]]? What then?" Dr Murad clears her throat, "Well, there is always a risk of a [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMisjump],misjump]] regardless of whether a [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LorePiratePoint],pirate point]] is used or not. Aside from the absolute worst case scenario, total structural implosion, my research suggests that if we were to misjump from the use of the Console, it would either fling us to an uncharted system, we could sustain damage to the Argo's engines, or a combination of both." Sumire looks at you, "How do you wish to proceed, Commander?"

column1: You look at Sumire, "Find a way to turn that damned console off!" Sumire quickly flicks a couple switches and the console dims and shuts down, "Commander, the Console is set to shutdown. The jump clock shows our ride will be jumping us out in 3... 2... 1..." Moments later, the jumpship's KF Drive activates and that quesy feeling when jumping through space washes over your body. "Report," you yell as your vision returns post jump and you turn to see the Console smoking. Sumire and an astech are dousing it with an extinguisher. After the smoke clears, Sumire examines the Console, "Commander, the Console is offline and some of the components have been destroyed. Engineering reports extensive damage to the engine and structure of the Argo." Darius moves over to the sensor station, "Commander, we appear to be in the [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] system, which is over 350 light years away from the closest known jump-safe system of Mostaganem! We have a message from the Captain of the jumpship. Their astechs have traced the power flux back to the Argo and will be filing reports to the Mercenary Review Board and the Commercial JumpShip Travel Authority as soon as they finish their shipwide diagnostics and damage assessment." The KF Console is damaged and offline. Travel times are increased until repairs can be made to the console and engines.

"Report," you yell as your vision returns post jump and you turn to see the Console smoking. Sumire and an astech are dousing it with an extinguisher. After the smoke clears, Sumire examines the Console, "Commander, the Console is offline and some of the components have been destroyed. Engineering reports moderate damage to the engine and structure of the Argo." Darius moves over to the sensor station, "Commander, we appear to be in the [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] system, which is over 95 light years away from the closest known jump-safe system of Transfer Station J239H2! We have a message from the Captain of the jumpship. Their astechs have traced the power flux back to the Argo and will be filing reports to the Mercenary Review Board and the Commercial JumpShip Travel Authority as soon as they finish their shipwide diagnostics and damage assessment." The KF Console is damaged and offline. Travel times are increased until repairs can be made to the console and engines.

"Report," you yell as your vision returns post jump and you turn to see the Console smoking. Sumire and an astech are dousing it with an extinguisher. After the smoke clears, Sumire examines the Console, "Commander, the Console is offline and some of the components have been destroyed. Engineering reports no obvious damage to any other systems or structure of the Argo." Darius moves over to the sensor station, "Commander, we appear to be in the [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] system, which is over 200 light years away from the closest known jump-safe system of Trelleborg! We have a message from the Captain of the jumpship. Their astechs have traced the power flux back to the Argo and will be filing reports to the Mercenary Review Board and the Commercial JumpShip Travel Authority as soon as they finish their shipwide diagnostics and damage assessment." The KF Console is damaged and offline until repairs can be made.

"Report," you yell as your vision returns post jump and you turn to see the Console smoking. Sumire and an astech are dousing it with an extinguisher. After the smoke clears, Sumire examines the Console, "Commander, the Console is offline and some of the components have been destroyed. Engineering reports major damage to the engine and structure of the Argo." Darius moves over to the sensor station, "Commander, we appear to be in the [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] system, which is over 850 light years away from the closest known jump-safe system of Ksabi! We have a message from the Captain of the jumpship. Their astechs have traced the power flux back to the Argo and will be filing reports to the Mercenary Review Board and the Commercial JumpShip Travel Authority as soon as they finish their shipwide diagnostics and damage assessment." The KF Console is damaged and offline. Travel times are increased until repairs can be made to the console and engines.

Their astechs have traced the power flux back to the Argo and will be filing reports to the Mercenary Review Board and the Commercial JumpShip Travel Authority as soon as they finish their shipwide diagnostics and damage assessment." The KF Console is damaged and offline until repairs can be made.

column1: You mull over the options before you, "Darius, coordinate with [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] to have them hack into the CJSTA database and expunge all details of any misjumps recorded while the Argo was docked to any afflected jumpship." Darius nods, "Yes, Commander." You look over at [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], "Thank you for bringing me this information. You can coordinate with Darius to get all of this in motion." [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] nods, "I will inform my former associates, Commander, but from here on out, Darius will be able to commincate directly with group. As I said, I have no desire to go back to that version of my life." As [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] stands up, they hold out a datakey, "This datakey will allow you to get in touch with the group if you ever needt them again in the future." You motion Darius to take the datakey and they both depart your office. :::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: The next day, Darius returns to your office, "Commander, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] was able to get in touch with one of thier contacts who happended to be on [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]]. Everything went as promised and they were successful in removing all negative marks on our file with the CJSTA." You smile, "Excellent news, ¢7,500,000 is a bit steep, but at least we don't have to worry about being blacklisted." A grin appears on Darius' face, "Well you'll like this then, the fee was only ¢6,056,304." You grab a couple glasses and the bottle of [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreGBL],Glengarry Black Label]] out of your desk drawer, "That is good news indeed!"

column1: You read through the information displayed on the datapad and scribble your signature. Handing the pad to Darius as you stand up, "Ok, let's get this show on the road! Darius stands up, "I will inform the rest of the Command Staff," and heads off to the bridge as you proceed to the MedBay to speak to the Argo's surgeon. You arrive to find the surgeon inspecting the Neural Implant matrix. "Hello, Commander, do you have any questions before we get you prepped?" You nod, "Yes, yes I do. Do you feel comfortable performing this procedure?" The surgeon nods back, "I do Commander. I have done similar types of surgeries in my past before I hired on with your company. You should be up and moving in the next couple of days. You can then begin physical and simpod training and by the end of the month should be well enough to go out into the field." You smile, "This will be glorious!"

column1: You rush through the corridor, alarms blaring throughout the ship, and arrive on the bridge just in time to see the Fire Crew extinguish the last flames on the Console, “What the hell happened?” Dr Murad’s barely concealed anger contorts her face into a snarl, “I told you there was something wrong with one of those components, but no, you were too frugal to replace them! It was a weird feeling being dressed down by one of your crew and the bitter pill you just swallowed was that she was right about it. column1: You say, "Would you continue to investigate the problem, Dr. Murad?" "As I've told you on past occasions," she begins, "there is a software defect in the habitat pod rotation controller. The pods are folded for travel, and the controller is supposed to be dormant, but it continues to count rotation cycles anyway. On the 512th cycle, it tries to rotate the pods despite them being folded. That's our 2.4 hours. It cannot actually perform the rotation because of mechanical safety measures that prevent that from happening. That's our shaking." Sumire says, "I liked it better when it was a mystery." Dr. Murad shakes her head. "There's nothing for me to 'fix'. I inspect the safeties for stress and wear every time we break orbit. As absurd as this issue is, the Argo was designed to handle it."

column1: You say, "Would you continue to investigate the problem, Dr. Murad?" Dr. Murad nods. "Of course. Let me set your expectations, however. The Star League abandoned the Argo's design after making only two ships of its class. This may be a defect their engineers didn't manage to solve before the project ended." She returns seven hours and three shakier-than-usual episodes later. "I'm no closer to a fix, but I know why this is happening. The Argo's rotation controller is disabled while the pods are folded. There are even mechanical safeties to ensure the ship doesn't tear itself apart by trying to rotate under thrust. But there's a bug in the controller software kernel that is trying to wake it up periodically. Thus, the shaking." "But the safeties are functioning?" you ask. "Yes, Commander. It's annoying, but perfectly safe. For now."

column1: You sit in your command chair, nursing a cup of coffee while staring at the Console, the feeling of this scenario having played over and over again multiple times flitting through your head, "I'm beginning to question whether the benefits of faster travel times by using Pirate Points is worth it." Dr Murad has the panel to the Console open again, playing around with the Cheatah Nav Computer. She leans back from her work and looks over to you, "I've tried everything I can Commander, but I think our only option is to just replace the Cheatah Nav Computer and see if the sound goes away." Your head pounding from the random banging resounding out of the Console makes it hard to think clearly, "So we just yank out a potentially good part in the hopes it fixes the issue? Sounds expensive." Dr Murad stops work on the Console, "After labour from the astechs as well as other bits and pieces, it should not be more than ¢400,000 C-Bills." You moan, "Ugh, more expenses. Can we at least sell or reuse it?" Dr Murad shakes her head, "No Commander. The way these pirates have cobbled this device together basically means you have to literally destroy the part to replace it. So I can either try replacing the [[DM.UpgradeDefs[Gear_CheatahNavComputer],Cheatah Nav Computer]] or we can ignore it and hope it goes away on its own."

column1: You stare at the pulsing ACTIVATE? image on the screen for a few minutes before reaching out and pressing the image. The text disappears and is replaced by a series of numbers cascading rapidly across the screen. Various lights flash and dim and the fans inside the console ramp up their speed. Occasional beeps sound from the console. You look at Sumire, "Now what?" Sumire smiles, "Now we let it calculate any possible Pirate Points related to the systems stored in our navigation computer and our current position. The beeps means it has stored the temporary coordinates for a system. It will send those coordinates to the JumpShip when we dock with it." You cross your arms in front of you and smile, "Sounds good. Quicker travel times will mean we can get around to new contracts sooner and hopefully make more C-Bills, but for now, please turn off the KF Console until we are ready to start using it." When set to ACTIVE, the Argo will arrive at systems slightly sooner. The console is currently IN-ACTIVE and you will need to wait for a random event pop-up to be able to activate the console later on.

column1: Debuting in 3063, the 5E is a Word of Blake designed upgrade to the older 4E design. Intended for deployment with Protectorate Militia units and Free Worlds League formations, the Blakists sought to rebuild the design with newer technology and correct some of the flaws apparent in the older design. column1: Designed and constructed during the Jihad, the 4S updated the design of the popular 3S series of Marauders with new technology designed to improve its effectiveness on the modern battlefield. Built around 18 Double Heat Sinks, the 4S has similar design principles to its predecessor; designed for ease of maintenance and repair. With an extra ton of armor and a targeting computer, it is capable of taking a heavier pounding at close range and boasts superior accuracy at mid to long range. Aside from this it is functionally similar to it’s predecessor, retaining the medium laser and PPC loadout; though the PPCs have been updated to ER versions and the old single heat sinks swapped for more efficient double heat sinks. Production has been brisk, with General Motors taking orders from across the Inner Sphere and the Periphery; as mercenaries and planetary militias look to upgrade the older Marauders in their arsenals.

column1: Designed by Adam Tech Industries and manufactured from their plant on Abadan, the Havoc was inspired by the JR7-K Jenner and managed to improve on many of the JR7-K's design features. The combination of almost double the Jenner's armor, a 10% increase in speed thanks to the 280 XL engine and a weapons loadout that allowed it to battle 'Mechs heavier than itself spurred the Adam Tech advertising campaign, which was geared exclusively towards pilots of light BattleMechs. The key to the Havoc's success was the Octagon Tartrac System E, considered the best short-range targeting and tracking system available on the market at the time and often compared to the highly successful and effective Garret D2j targeting system. The Octagon system identified threats faster than comparable systems, an invaluable aid to MechWarriors in the field. The Havoc also mounted five jump jets distributed throughout the Havoc's torso locations, allowing it to jump up to 150 meters.

column1: The Sojourner is a simple 'Mech designed by Clan Wolf-in-Exile after the staggering loss at Arc-Royal. The 'Mech went through several design phases resulting in a final design that was both easy to maintain and pilot, with the primary use being to teach younger MechWarriors the trade of 'Mech-on-'Mech combat. As a result the pilots of these 'Mechs have a considerably higher survival rate compared to other, harder to pilot 'Mechs like the Linebacker. The base variant of the Sojourner carries a Gauss Rifle, with the compliment of a single ER Large Laser and a Plasma Cannon. The combination of 3 Jump Jets, a Supercharger and an AES system makes the 'Mech quite mobile on the battlefield despite its somewhat underpowered 240-rated Fusion Core. A CASE II system and a single external Double Heat Sink finishes up the design.

column2: 这是一款圣战时代的杀手变体，舍弃所有标准武装和陀螺仪，改装XL陀螺仪、MML-7和双联ER中型激光器。

column1: Boss... This mech is based on Seraph, however version is fully packed with experimental technologies. I don't know where you got it, but I smell troubles.
column2: 老板……这台机甲基于炽天使，但该版本充满实验技术。我不知道你从哪弄来的，不过我感觉麻烦不小。

column1: Mech Grenade Launcher rounds are low-velocity, high-explosive projectiles able to damage several units on impact. Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.
column2: 机甲榴弹发射器子弹是低速、高爆炸弹，能够在撞击时损坏多个单位。受到致命一击后，弹药箱内储存的任何剩余弹药都会爆炸，对安装位置造成伤害。使用 C.A.S.E 可以降低风险。

column1: mechbay down, morale okay
column2: 机甲低迷，士气还好

column1: mechbay okay, morale down
column2: 机甲还好，士气低落

column1: Melody’s Rockers, one of the few mercenary commands to survive the Jihad, continues serving clients under the legendary James Degenhardt. Now in his 80s, James still designs and tests custom ’Mechs, leaving heavy lifting to trusted young pilots. His persistence led to the creation of the Ghostmaker, a fully custom design like the Impaler and Crossfire. The Ghostmaker combines Marauder IIC legs with a heavily reinforced Targe chassis. It offers average speed for a heavy ’Mech, thick armor, and devastating medium-range firepower, making it a formidable adversary on the battlefield.
column2: Melody’s Rockers 是圣战中幸存下来的少数雇佣兵组织之一，在传奇人物詹姆斯·德根哈特 (James Degenhardt) 的领导下继续为客户提供服务。现在，詹姆斯仍然在他的 80s 中设计和测试定制的机甲，将繁重的工作留给值得信赖的年轻飞行员。他的坚持导致了幽灵制造者的诞生，这是一个完全定制的设计，就像穿刺者和交叉火力一样。 Ghostmaker 将 Marauder IIC 腿与经过强化的 Targe 底盘相结合。它提供重型机甲的平均速度、厚重的装甲和毁灭性的中程火力，使其成为战场上的强大对手。

column1: Mia Thompson, callsign "Reaper", was drafted into the Steiner military after her family was killed in a pirate raid. Mia, as a 12-year-old child, climbed into her father's AgroMech - a Cattlemaster used for farming - and fought off the pirates alone for over an hour before help arrived. After that, she was drafter and raised in the military. Her natural talent and understanding has seen her quickly rise through the ranks as a respected MechWarrior. These days, however, she prefers to choose her own path, and left Steiner after her last campaign.\n\n
column2: 米娅·汤普森（Mia Thompson），呼号“死神”，在她的家人在一次海盗袭击中丧生后被征召入伍。 12 岁的米娅 (Mia) 爬进了父亲的 AgroMech（一种用于耕种的 Cattlemaster），独自与海盗战斗了一个多小时，然后救援人员才赶到。此后，她成为起草者并在军队长大。她的天赋和理解力使她迅速晋升为受人​​尊敬的机甲战士。然而如今，她更愿意选择自己的道路，并在上次竞选后离开了施泰纳。\n\n

column1: Michael Fastback, renowned as "Razor", is a battle-hardened MechWarrior known for his lightning-fast reflexes and precision in combat. Hailing from a lineage of MechWarriors, he inherited an affinity for piloting BattleMechs at an early age. Today, his expertise in piloting and tactical finesse make him a formidable adversary, able to swiftly engage and disengage with deadly efficiency.\n\n
column2: 迈克尔·法斯特巴克（Michael Fastback），绰号“剃刀”，是一位久经沙场的机甲战士，以其闪电般的反应速度和战斗精确度而闻名。他出身机甲战士血统，从小就继承了驾驶战机的爱好。如今，他在驾驶和战术技巧方面的专业知识使他成为令人畏惧的对手，能够以致命的效率快速交战和脱离交战。\n\n

column1: Micheal Coleman, a Periphery Militia Captain, was able to beat a Clanner in a Batchall and Won this Jaguar out of it. Looking at the Mech, and at the Available Resources, he Created this. On first Looks, the Mech itself seems very Archaic, yet it Still Works. Coleman Reportedly Blasted Multiple Enemies to Pieces in this Jaguar, untill one day the Knockback from the Howitzers Proved too much, Knocked the Mech over and Hurt Coleman Fatally.
column2: 外围民兵队长迈克尔·科尔曼 (Micheal Coleman) 在一场批量比赛中击败了一名部落成员，并赢得了这辆美洲虎。看着机甲和可用资源，他创造了这个。乍一看，机甲本身看起来非常古老，但它仍然有效。据报道，科尔曼驾驶这辆美洲虎将多个敌人炸成碎片，直到有一天，榴弹炮的击退效果实在太严重，将机甲撞翻，科尔曼身受重伤。

column1: Micro Missile Inferno Munitions
column2: 微型导弹地狱弹药

column1: Micro Missile Smart Munitions
column2: 微型导弹智能弹药

column1: Modified to carry a C3 Master Computer, the 3B downgrades its autocannon to an LB 10-X AC and replaces the LRM-15 with an LRM-10 with an Artemis IV FCS. The 3B uses its C3 computer to link together an entire C3 Lance and gives the 'Mech unparalleled accuracy when part of a C3 lance.
column2: 3B 经过改装可携带 C3 主计算机，将其自动加农炮降级为 LB 10-X AC，并用带有 Artemis IV FCS 的 LRM-10 取代 LRM-15。 3B 使用其 C3 计算机将整个 C3 枪连接在一起，并在作为 C3 枪的一部分时为“机甲”提供无与伦比的准确性。

column1: More closely in line with the traditional Annihilator, the 4A carried two LB-X Autocannon/10s from the 2A, but removed two to make room for a pair of Heavy PPCs. Two Light Autocannon/2s from the 3A provide defense against conventional troops. A Compact Gyro freed up enough room for fifteen double heat sinks that kept heat from being completely out of control.
column2: 与传统的歼灭者更接近的是，4A 从 2A 上携带了两架 LB-X Autocannon/10s，但去掉了两架，以便为一对重型 PPC 腾出空间。 3A 中的两架轻型 Autocannon/2s 提供对常规部队的防御。紧凑型陀螺仪为十五个双散热器腾出了足够的空间，防止热量完全失控。

column1: More flexible than the 3S at the cost of more wasteful ammunition usage, but the longer strike distance makes it a better variant.
column2: 比 3S 更灵活，但弹药使用更浪费，但更长的打击距离使其成为更好的变体。

column1: More of a 'what was on hand' refit of a SLDF-era Mech, this Steel Viper unit was made as a last hope reinforcement that never saw the light of day. Equipped with Clan spec gear and pre-Clan weaponry, it is a hodge podge of technology that would be a nightmare to keep working. Even in the Inner Sphere, this thing would be a rarity to encounter.
column2: 这台钢蝰蛇装置更像是对 SLDF 时代机甲的“现有”改装，它是作为最后希望的加固而制造的，但从未见过世面。它配备了部落规格的装备和部落前的武器，这是一个技术大杂烩，继续工作将是一场噩梦。即使在内天界，这种东西也很少见。

column1: Mostly a Museum piece was this Shadow Hawk rebuild on request for a Paladins 'Special Associate', sporting upgrades sourced from basically everywhere is it able to strike unseen basically anywhere at anytime even during Planet wide Engagements.
column2: 主要是博物馆的一件作品，是根据圣骑士“特别助理”的要求重建的暗影鹰，其运动升级基本上来自任何地方，即使在全球范围内的交战中，它也能够基本上随时随地进行看不见的攻击。

column1: Named after a mythological Pirate from pre-spaceflight Terra, this one has been given extensive upgrades in every direction. A heavier Hatchet lets this refit cleave 'Mechs of the same weight class apart with ease. Stealth armor makes it hard to detect while it's closing in, and the 330-rated engine makes sure it doesn't take long. Five Medium Lasers and a SRM6 see to it that it's also a dangerous brawler for its weight class. Fifteen Double Heat Sinks ensure this Buccaneer won't die of heatstroke out in the sun - or of a trigger happy mech-jock.
column2: 这艘船以太空飞行前的泰拉神话中的海盗命名，在各个方面都进行了广泛的升级。较重的斧头让这款改装可以轻松地将相同重量级别的机甲分开。隐形装甲使其在接近时难以被发现，而 330 级发动机确保它不会花费很长时间。五个中型激光器和一个 SRM6 使其在重量级别上也是一个危险的争斗者。十五个双散热器确保这款海盗不会在阳光下因中暑而死亡，也不会因快乐的机甲运动员而死亡。

column1: Named after a stealth fighter, and it's easily the best armed of the whole Shattered Skies line. Every weapon system on it was top shelf for the era, Artemis IV, Streak SRMs, pulse lasers, the works. Heaviest of the four too at 55 tons. Same story as its siblings in the end though, chewed up by the civil war and gone from almost every army by 2850.
column2: 以隐形战斗机命名，它无疑是整个破碎天空系列中武装最好的。其上的每一个武器系统都是那个时代的顶级武器系统，Artemis IV、Streak SRM、脉冲激光器等等。四者中最重的也是 55 吨。不过，最终的故事和它的兄弟姐妹一样，都受到内战的摧残，到 2850 年几乎从每支军队中消失。

column1: Named for a canine predator adapted to Randis IV, the HawkWolf is a unique BattleMech constructed by the Brotherhood of Randis that entered production in 3076. To help support their activities, the Brotherhood set aside resources to develop production facilities to build "RetroMechs", in order to both fill out its own forces and to sell as a means of generating further capital. Initially starting with RetroTech Firebees and Dervishes, their success led the Brotherhood to develop an entirely new design. Intended mainly for fire-support roles, the HawkWolf was generally assigned to the Brotherhood's "squires" as a means for its youngest warriors to gain experience and avoid placing the primitive design at threat against more advanced opponents in direct combat.
column2: 鹰狼以适应兰迪斯 IV 的犬类掠食者命名，是由兰迪斯兄弟会建造的独特战斗机甲，于 3076 年投入生产。为了帮助支持他们的活动，兄弟会拨出资源来开发生产设施来建造“复古机甲”，既可以充实自己的部队，也可以通过出售来获得更多资本。最初从 RetroTech Firebees 和 Dervishes 开始，他们的成功促使兄弟会开发了全新的设计。鹰狼主要用于火力支援，通常被分配给兄弟会的“侍从”，作为其最年轻的战士获得经验并避免在直接战斗中对更先进的对手构成威胁的手段。

column1: Named for some supposedly ancient Warrior of Terran mythology does this experimental No-Dachi carry a reforged Large Vibroblade and is equipped with advanced Myomer.
column2: 这款实验性的 No-Dachi 以一些所谓的古代人类神话战士的名字命名，它携带着重铸的大型振动刀，并配备了先进的 Myomer。

column1: Named for the eight-legged horse ridden by the Norse god Odin, the Sleipnir is piloted by Ariana Winston of the Eridani Light Horse. Based off a CP-11-B, but built around a 360 XL Engine and Endo Steel frame, Sleipnir is armed with a Gauss Rifle in each side torso, a SRM-4 in the center torso and a Medium Laser in each arm and the head. Carrying four tons of Gauss rounds and a single ton of SRM missiles, Sleipnir mounts fifteen Double Heat Sinks with the remaining weight used on armor.
column2: 斯莱普尼尔号以北欧神奥丁骑乘的八足马命名，由埃里达尼轻马的阿丽亚娜·温斯顿驾驶。 Sleipnir 以 CP-11-B 为基础，但围绕 360 XL 引擎和 Endo Steel 框架构建，Sleipnir 在两侧躯干配备一把高斯步枪，在中央躯干配备一把 SRM-4，在每只手臂和头部配备一门中型激光枪。 Sleipnir 携带四吨高斯弹和一吨 SRM 导弹，安装了 15 个双散热器，其余重量用于装甲。

column1: Named for the legendary spy plane, and it lived up to that reputation with a Guardian ECM fit for staying hidden. Heavier than the Voodoo but still built around scouting first, fighting second. Same fate as the rest of the project though, nearly wiped out in the civil war and mostly gone by 2850.
column2: 以传奇的间谍飞机命名，它凭借适合隐藏的 Guardian ECM 名副其实。比 Voodoo 重，但仍然以侦察为先，战斗为其次。不过，与该项目其余部分的命运相同，在内战中几乎被消灭，到 2850 年大部分都消失了。

column1: Never seen this model of Goliath before, Boss - must be some mercenary unit's custom job. Not that we'd know anything about that, am I right?
column2: 以前从来没有见过这个模型的歌利亚，Boss——肯定是某个雇佣兵部队的定制工作。并不是说我们对此一无所知，对吗？

column1: Nightstars are normally pretty scary but this version might take the cake. That Hyper PPC will rip of tons of armor at a time while the Flechettes tear into everything beneath.
column2: 夜星通常非常可怕，但这个版本可能更胜一筹。 Hyper PPC 会一次撕裂成吨的装甲，而箭弹会撕裂下面的一切。

column1: Nimakachi built this one specifically for the Draconis Combine as a security mech. Saw a lot of use keeping Rasalhague worlds in line before they got their independence. Has a real ugly reputation honestly. The Fluid Gun was supposed to be non-lethal but that's not really how it played out in practice. Fell out of favor after the Clan Invasion when actual BattleMechs started costing the same. Production came back during the Jihad when parts got scarce.
column2: Nimakachi 专门为 Draconis 联合体建造了这个作为安全机甲。在拉萨尔哈格世界获得独立之前，我们看到了很多让它们保持一致的用途。老实说，名声确实很丑陋。流体枪本来应该是非致命性的，但实际上却并非如此。在氏族入侵之后，当实际的 BattleMech 开始花费相同的价格时，它就失宠了。圣战期间，零件短缺，生产恢复了。

column1: No surprise pirates got their Hands on a Trashcan, it is a surprise how they managed to 'repair' the mangled and broken Autocannon and welded 2 RocketLauncher onto the poor thing.
column2: 毫不奇怪，海盗们拿到了一个垃圾桶，令人惊讶的是他们如何设法“修复”受损和破损的自动加农炮，并将 2 个火箭发射器焊接到这个可怜的东西上。

column1: No. This is a bad idea. I don't care how cool it would be to see this thing flying in from above and planting those two harpoons into something. See that little sticker there? It says that the Mech will explode if I don't feed it. Feed it what? I don't know, they scratched that bit off.
column2: 不，这是一个坏主意。我不在乎看到这个东西从上面飞来并将那两个鱼叉插入某个东西会有多酷。看到那里的小贴纸了吗？它说如果我不给它喂食，机甲就会爆炸。喂它什么？我不知道，他们把那一点刮掉了。

column1: Nope, I can't agree with this refit. It is a clear downgrade, the ability to use different ammunition types does not make up for the loss of the Ultra.
column2: 不，我不能同意这次改装。这是明显的降级，使用不同弹药类型的能力并不能弥补Ultra的损失。

column1: Normally I'd say that the Royal BattleMaster is about as quintessential a BattleMech as you'll ever see. Guess the Clans didn't see it that way and felt they could improve on it. Well ... they tried, I suppose. This thing'd run hot as hell if not for all this extra gear, but I suppose they were limited on space, too. This baby is crammed to the gills.
column2: 通常我会说皇家战斗大师是您所见过的最典型的战斗机甲。我想族群并不这么认为，并认为他们可以改进。嗯……我想他们尝试过。如果没有这些额外的装备，这东西会热得要命，但我想它们的空间也有限。这个宝贝是crammed到腮帮子的。

column1: Not Much is known about this Mech, It handles just like a Normal Ostscout. The Engine has been Upgraded, and it was up Armoured. According to the Onboard Logs, the Targeting System for the Laser is Advanced, but i cant see anything Special about it. Maybe it gets better if a Certain person Pilots it?
column2: 关于这个机甲我们知之甚少，它的操作方式就像普通的东侦察兵一样。发动机已升级，并且已加装装甲。根据机载日志，激光瞄准系统很先进，但我看不出有什么特别之处。如果由某个人来驾驶的话，也许情况会更好？

column1: Not often you find one of these, Boss; this is a custom job, for sure. None of the Pulverizers I've ever heard of ran a full compliment of this kind of weaponry. She pales in comparison to what the Clans field today, but back in her day I bet she was a force to be reckoned with.
column2: 老板，你很少能找到这样的人；当然，这是一项定制工作。我听说过的粉碎机都没有对这种武器进行充分的赞美。与今天的族群相比，她相形见绌，但在她那个时代，我敢打赌她是一股不可忽视的力量。

column1: Not really that useful for us, this 'Mech is all about those LMGs.
column2: 对我们来说并不是那么有用，这个机甲就是那些轻机枪。

column1: Not sure what the purpose is here. Combining a single Clan tech level weapon with two machine guns doesn't make the most impressive variant, even if it has good speed.
column2: 不确定这里的目的是什么。将单一氏族科技级武器与两挺机枪结合起来并不能产生最令人印象深刻的变体，即使它具有良好的速度。

column1: Not sure why anybody'd go to the trouble of redesigning a chassis as old as this, but I guess profit is profit for somebody. The -03 carries a pair of MML-7 launchers and an ER Large Laser, so it can put the hurt on at any range you want.
column2: 不知道为什么有人会不厌其烦地重新设计这么老的底盘，但我想利润对某些人来说就是利润。 -03 携带一对 MML-7 发射器和一个 ER 大型激光器，因此它可以在您想要的任何范围内造成伤害。

column1: Nothing really makes this variant different from other recent Wolverines. That Heavy PPC does suffer a bit from shorter range, but overall the 'Mech does just fine on the battlefield.
column2: 这个变种与其他最近的狼獾没什么区别。重型 PPC 确实因射程较短而受到一些影响，但总的来说，“机甲”在战场上表现得很好。

column1: Now this I can work with, boss. No finicky pulse lasers or high tech missile launchers to babysit, just honest guns even a Periphery wrench-turner can keep running. Cheap, tough, and it still hides behind that big shield. VEST knew their market.
column2: 现在我可以合作了，老板。没有挑剔的脉冲激光器或高科技导弹发射器来照顾，只有诚实的枪支，即使是外围扳手也可以继续运行。便宜、坚固，而且它仍然隐藏在那个大盾牌后面。 VEST 了解他们的市场。

column1: Now this is a proper upgrade. The original Penetrator suffered from heat issues that prevented it to reach a good level of damage over long engagements. More heat sinks, a battle computer and some longer weaponry will make some good differences.
column2: 现在这是一次适当的升级。最初的穿甲弹遭遇过热问题，导致其在长时间交战中无法达到良好的伤害水平。更多的散热器、战斗计算机和一些更长的武器将会带来一些好的变化。

column1: Now this is pretty much a thing of nightmares, a stealthy Jinggau with advanced ECM and sensors. It'd be always stalking, but whenever you look behind you, it can not be seen!
column2: 现在这几乎是一场噩梦，一个拥有先进 ECM 和传感器的隐形 Jinggau。它总是在跟踪，但每当你回头看时，它就看不见了！

column1: Now this is what i call a Engineer's dream, fully upgraded Void Mimetic Systems, Command and Control System able to guide a whole company, the finest Electronics available and its all coming pretending to be just a old Longbow
column2: 现在，这就是我所说的工程师的梦想，完全升级的虚空拟态系统，能够指导整个连队的命令和控制系统，可用的最好的电子设备，而这一切都假装是一把旧的长弓

column1: Now would'ya look at this, this thing must have been kept alive and be loved for Hundreds of Years, It 'is' a Mackie, but they managed to cram Endo Steel and more modern tech into it, every piece shows signs of being repaired dozens if not hundreds of times. Theres also a '<3 Nature' sticker on the Engine!
column2: 现在你看看这个，这个东西肯定已经被保存并被人们喜爱了数百年，它“是”麦基，但他们设法将远藤钢和更现代的技术塞进里面，每件作品都显示出被修复了数十次甚至数百次的迹象。引擎上还有一个“<3 Nature”贴纸！

column1: Odin Manufacturing built this for former KungsArmé soldiers after they got folded into the Ghost Bear Dominion. Those veterans wanted something that fit how they fought and the Dengier delivered. Ten official variants by 3155, which tells you how well the base chassis worked. Ghost Bear warriors eventually started using it too, which is about as good an endorsement as you can get.
column2: 奥丁制造公司为前 KungsArmé 士兵在加入鬼熊领地后建造了这个。那些退伍军人想要一些适合他们战斗方式的东西，而丹吉尔交付了。 3155 的十个官方变体，告诉您基础底盘的工作情况如何。鬼熊战士最终也开始使用它，这几乎是你能得到的最好的认可。

column1: Old is the new new? Wolverines have been around for ages and with the continued refreshes it seems like they will not go away anytime soon.
column2: 旧的就是新的吗？狼獾已经存在很多年了，随着不断的更新，它们似乎不会很快消失。

column1: On one hand, that PPC is putting a lot of eggs into a particular basket but, on the other hand, that is one helluva big PPC.
column2: 一方面，PPC 将很多鸡蛋放入特定的篮子中，但另一方面，这是一个巨大的 PPC。

column1: Once again it is proven that the best 'Mechs are created on the battlefield, not in the design lab. These changes are much more to my liking than the -6M variant.
column2: 事实再次证明，最好的机甲是在战场上制造的，而不是在设计实验室中制造的。这些更改比 -6M 变体更符合我的喜好。

column1: Once the Republic Institute of Strategic Combat found out about the Urbiestator, they immediately acquired a number of them and created the UMS-R9999 experimental variant. Even though filled with a lot of the cutting edge technology, such as Superheavy Ferro-Alloy Armor, the design was never seen as of any real value due to its huge issues with heat management, but the existing copies can still be found on the battlefield.
column2: 共和国战略作战研究所发现Urbiestator后，立即购买了一批并创建了UMS-R9999实验变体。尽管充满了许多尖端技术，例如超重型铁合金装甲，但由于其热管理方面的巨大问题，该设计从未被视为具有任何实际价值，但现有的副本仍然可以在战场上找到。

column1: One hell of a speed beast, with some decent weapons.
column2: 一只速度猛兽，拥有一些像样的武器。

column1: One of only 50 of its kind, this 'Mech is supposedly a large improvement over the earlier variants. At least if you ask the Duke that designed it. Personally, I say it as good or bad as any other Bandersnatch.
column2: 这种机甲是仅有的 50 架同类机甲之一，据说比早期的变种有了很大的改进。至少如果你问设计它的公爵的话。就我个人而言，我认为它与其他《潘达斯奈基》一样好或坏。

column1: One of the best first generation ProtoMechs, the Centaur combines high speed, decent armor, and a varied weapons mix. These features make it a flexible combatant, able to keep up with scout 'Mechs while supporting them. Centaur 3 drops all weapons and a considerable amount of armor for a single ER Medium Laser.
column2: 半人马是最好的第一代原型机甲之一，它结合了高速、体面的装甲和多样化的武器组合。这些功能使其成为灵活的战斗人员，能够在支持侦察机甲的同时跟上它们。 Centaur 3 会为单个 ER 中型激光器掉落所有武器和大量装甲。

column1: One of the best first generation ProtoMechs, the Centaur combines high speed, decent armor, and a varied weapons mix. These features make it a flexible combatant, able to keep up with scout 'Mechs while supporting them. Developed during the 3060s, this variant utilizes then-newly developed Heavy Laser technology.
column2: 半人马是最好的第一代原型机甲之一，它结合了高速、体面的装甲和多样化的武器组合。这些功能使其成为灵活的战斗人员，能够在支持侦察机甲的同时跟上它们。该变体是在 3060s 期间开发的，采用了当时新开发的重型激光技术。

column1: One of the best known BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere for its low production and operation costs, the Locust is also well known in the Clans. In 2832, Clan Mongoose unleashed an upgraded version of the venerable 'Mech on the Clans, known as the Locust IIC. The Z variant  is a Society refit that replaces the engine with a 200SL engine and replaces the weapons payload with 6 Small Supra Lasers and a Nova CEWS.
column2: 蝗虫因其低廉的生产和运营成本而成为内层界最知名的战机之一，在氏族中也广为人知。 2832 年，猫鼬氏族释放了古老的氏族机甲的升级版，称为蝗虫 IIC。 Z 变体是协会改装的，将发动机替换为 200SL 发动机，并将武器有效载荷替换为 6 个小型 Supra 激光器和一个 Nova CEWS。

column1: One of the first mass production QuadMechs, the 55 ton Scorpion entered production in 2570 as an infantry support unit. Shunned by most MechWarriors due to its notoriously unstable gait, the Scorpion would nevertheless see uninterrupted use throughout the Succession Wars and beyond. The Scorpion 10M is powered by a 385-rated XL Engine giving it a top speed of 110 km/h. A Heavy PPC and an LRM-10 form the Mechs weapons load.
column2: 作为首批大规模生产的四机甲之一，重 55 吨的“蝎子”于 2570 年作为步兵支援单位投入生产。由于其步态不稳定而被大多数机甲战士所回避，但蝎子在整个继承战争及以后的战争中仍被不间断地使用。 Scorpion 10M 由 385 级 XL 发动机提供动力，最高时速可达 110 公里/小时。重型 PPC 和 LRM-10 构成机甲武器负载。

column1: PASSIVE: The ECM carrier projects an ECM field, building Stealth Charges for itself and allies if it starts or ends its turn with no active enemy units within the field.\n\nECM carriers also receive a bonus Stealth Charge.
column2: 被动：ECM 航母投射出一个 ECM 力场，如果在回合开始或结束时场内没有活跃的敌方单位，则为自己和盟友建立隐形冲锋。\n\nECM 航母还会获得额外的隐形冲锋。

column1: Pretty boring mech to be honest. Other than their knock-off stealth system, it's just a bog standard LRM40 boat crammed into a 30 ton mech. Due to weight limitations for the ammo, it'll struggle with extended engagements.
column2: 老实说，相当无聊的机械。除了他们的山寨隐形系统之外，它只是一艘塞进 30 吨机械的沼泽标准 LRM40 船。由于弹药的重量限制，它很难适应长时间的交战。

column1: Pretty rare build you've found here, Boss. Judging by the serial number on some of these parts, only a handful of these things were made. Not surprised, honestly. Back then, some of these parts were expensive as hell. That and the whole Star League exploding thing.
column2: 老板，你在这里找到的建筑相当罕见。从其中一些零件的序列号来看，这些东西只生产了极少数。老实说，并不感到惊讶。当时，其中一些零件非常昂贵。那和整个星际联盟的爆炸事件。

column1: Produced by Cosara Weaponries for the Word of Blake following their capture of the facility in 3069, the 008 uses the latest technologies available at the time. The autocannons have been upgraded to Heavy PPCs. The powerful weapons are backed up by paired Light Autocannon/2s, sharing one-ton of ammo in CASE-protected ammunition bin. Two ER Medium Lasers back up these guns. Like other Blakist units, a C3i Computer is included.A Guardian ECM Suite is also included. With seventeen double heat sinks and Jump Jets, this unit can jump and fire both of its main guns even with some heat to spare. Luckily this variant can be visually distinguished from others based on its more streamlined chassis, giving opponents some measure of warning.
column2: 008 是由 Cosara Weaponries 在 3069 年占领该设施后为布莱克之言生产的，采用了当时最新的技术。自动加农炮已升级为重型 PPC。这些强大的武器由成对的 Light Autocannon/2s 提供支持，在受 CASE 保护的弹药箱中共享一吨弹药。两台 ER 中型激光器为这些枪提供支持。与其他 Blakist 装置一样，还包括 C3i 计算机。还包括 Guardian ECM 套件。凭借十七个双散热器和跳跃喷气机，该装置可以跳跃并发射其两门主炮，即使有一些余热。幸运的是，由于其更流线型的底盘，该变体可以在视觉上与其他变体区分开来，从而给对手一定程度的警告。

column1: Produced by Hilltopper Engineering (a spin off of the mercenary command Holt's Hilltoppers) for the Fronc Reaches' Colonial Marshals the TinStar came as a shock both to the Fronc Reaches' neighbors and the local pirate groups when it was introduced in 3086. The initial suit contained a mixture of Clan and Inner Sphere technology that, while being powerful, was regarded as undesirable by the Marshals due to its reliance on outside suppliers. Hilltopper Engineering would accommodate the Marshals request for a more production friendly variant which would lead to the first mass production line outside of vehicles for the Fronc Reaches at the time.
column2: TinStar 由 Hilltopper Engineering（雇佣军指挥部 Holt's Hilltoppers 的衍生品）为 Fronc Reaches 的殖民元帅生产，在 3086 年推出时，震惊了 Fronc Reaches 的邻居和当地海盗集团。最初的套装混合了氏族和内部球体技术，虽然功能强大，但由于依赖外部供应商而被元帅们视为不受欢迎。 Hilltopper Engineering 将满足元帅们对生产更友好的变型的要求，这将导致当时 Fronc Reaches 车辆之外的第一条大规模生产线。

column1: Produced during the Jihad, this configuration employs pair of ER Medium Lasers in left torso, while fitting pair of Light PPCs in each arm actuator slot.
column2: 该配置是在圣战期间生产的，在左躯干中采用了一对 ER 中型激光器，同时在每个手臂致动器插槽中安装了一对轻型 PPC。

column1: Produced in secret by 'The Society', an organization of Rogue Scientists within the Clans, this prototype testbed Griffin carries advanced Technology and weapons.
column2: 这个格里芬原型测试台由部落内的流氓科学家组织“协会”秘密生产，携带着先进的技术和武器。

column1: Produced in the last years of the Amaris Civil War for the SLDF, the Thunder Hawk emphasizes firepower over speed. A 100-ton mech, the Thunder Hawk TDK-7S is built around a 300-rated Light Engine and is armed with a trio of Gauss Rifles, with a pair of Medium Lasers as back up weapons.
column2: 雷霆鹰是在阿马里斯内战最后几年为 SLDF 生产的，它强调火力而不是速度。雷霆鹰 TDK-7S 是一款重达 100 吨的机甲，围绕 300 级光引擎打造，配备三把高斯步枪，以及一对中型激光器作为备用武器。

column1: Produced on Shitara for The Republic of the Sphere, the Thunderbird II battle armor is an upgrade of the Thunderbird battle armor produced by Clan Nova Cat expats. The modular weapons mount of the original were replaced with a Detachable Weapon Pack in each arm. The left arm carries a single AP Gauss Rifle while the right arm carries a LB-X (Battle Armor). Reflective armor protects the Thunderbird II. What makes it so deadly in the Republic Armed Forces is the integrated Battle Armor C3 system.
column2: Thunderbird II 战斗装甲是在 Shitara 为球体共和国生产的，是 Clan Nova Cat 外籍人士生产的 Thunderbird 战斗装甲的升级版。原版的模块化武器安装座被每个手臂上的可拆卸武器包所取代。左臂携带一把AP高斯步枪，右臂携带一把LB-X（战斗装甲）。反光装甲保护雷鸟 II。使它在共和国武装部队中如此致命的是集成战斗装甲 C3 系统。

column1: Project Rewrite was Penelope Centrella's program and this is the second thing that came out of it. One of a kind, reserved for special operations only, still active into the ilClan era. The Taser alone makes it worth studying carefully. Most commanders want to destroy what they fight. Whoever built this wanted the option to capture it intact instead. That tells you a lot about how Riley's Rangers operated.
column2: Project Rewrite 是 Penelope Centrella 的计划，这是该计划产生的第二件事。其中一种，仅供特殊行动使用，在伊氏族时代仍然活跃。仅泰瑟枪就值得仔细研究。大多数指挥官都想摧毁他们所战斗的东西。无论是谁建造了这个，都希望能够选择完整地捕获它。这告诉你很多关于莱利的流浪者队是如何运作的。
